action.1.desc_hostile_to_homicidal_05.en: Your hostility is unfortunate. We had considered sparing you, being fellow [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] as you are, but it seems you will need to be... re-educated, at the very least.

action.1.desc_hungry_01.zh: 我们并非鱼肉，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。作为[contact_empire.GetName]的代表，我正式向你们提出警告，将来你们任何的侵犯将会招致我们的全力打击。
action.1.desc_hungry_01.en: We are not your food, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As a representative of the [contact_empire.GetName], I am authorized to warn you that any future transgressions will be met by the full force of our arms.

action.1.desc_hungry_02.zh: 我们并非鱼肉，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]倡导和平，但我们在必须保卫自己的时候绝不手软。
action.1.desc_hungry_02.en: We are not your food, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] lead a peaceful way of life, but we will not hesitate to defend ourselves should it become necessary.

action.1.desc_hungry_03.zh: 你们为什么拆解我们，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们的这些单位并没有出故障。
action.1.desc_hungry_03.en: Why do you dismantle us, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Our units were not defective.

action.1.desc_hungry_04.zh: 我们建议你们死了这条心，摸摸自己的[Root.GetSpeciesToothNamePlural]看看能不能吃得动我们，[Root.GetSpeciesName]！告诉你们，我们[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会向你们抗争直至最后一颗卵石为止也不屈服。
action.1.desc_hungry_04.en: We hope you broke your [Root.GetSpeciesToothNamePlural] in your vain attempt to eat us, [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Know that we [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] remain unbowed and will resist your kind to the last pebble.

action.1.desc_hungry_05.zh: 进食我们的子个体是一种浪费，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。它们不是以此为目的设计出来的，我们强烈要求你们停止这种行为。
action.1.desc_hungry_05.en: It is a waste to eat our drones, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. They were not made for that purpose, and we must firmly request that you desist.

action.1.desc_they_hostile_01.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我方认为你们物种对于我们是一个极大的威胁。除非我们能确信你们对我方没有威胁，不然之前的攻击就只是我们文明之间敌对接触的开胃菜罢了。
action.1.desc_they_hostile_01.en: We consider your species a grave menace to our kind, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Unless you can demonstrate that you are no threat to us, our past attacks will be just the start of hostilities between our civilization.

action.1.desc_they_hostile_02.zh: 我们的威胁检测算法已计算出你们文明对[Root.GetName]造成的风险是不可接受的。如果你们造成的威胁无法降低，我们将自行对你们进行清除。
action.1.desc_they_hostile_02.en: Our threat detection algorithms have calculated the risk of your civilization causing harm to the [Root.GetName] to be intolerable. If the threat you pose cannot be otherwise mitigated, we will have to eliminate you.

action.1.desc_they_hostile_03.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们的存在对[contact_empire.GetGestaltEntityName]构成了严重的威胁。我们已经着手制定应急措施来消除你们造成的风险。如果这还不起效，必将有更进一步的措施。
action.1.desc_they_hostile_03.en: Your kind represents a grave threat to the [contact_empire.GetGestaltEntityName], [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We have already begun forming contingencies to mitigate the risk you pose. Should this prove insufficient, further action will be necessary.

action.1.desc_they_hungry_01.zh: 你们看起来很好吃，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。很快你们将荣升为我们子个体的主食之一。
action.1.desc_they_hungry_01.en: You were delicious, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon, you will become part of our drones' staple diet.

action.1.desc_they_hungry_02.zh: 将你们的无人机拆解重溶后得到的材料极具价值。我们预期，我们的铸造厂里很快就会堆满[Root.GetAdj]的零件。
action.1.desc_they_hungry_02.en: The raw materials we melted your drones down to were most valuable. We anticipate that our forges will soon be filled with [Root.GetAdj] scrap metal.

action.1.desc_they_vivisect_01.zh: 我们已经了解了可观的关于你们内在解剖结构运作的数据，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。可以说，我们对你们了如指掌了。
action.1.desc_they_vivisect_01.en: We have gathered considerable data on the inner workings of your anatomy, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One might even say we know you... inside-out.

action.1.desc_they_vivisect_02.zh: 我们已经了解了可观的关于你们内部电路和处理器运作的数据，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。可以说，我们对你们了如指掌了。
action.1.desc_they_vivisect_02.en: We have gathered considerable data on the inner workings of your circuitry and processors, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One might even say we know you... inside-out.

action.1.desc_vivisection_01.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，在为惨死在你们手术台上的[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]报仇雪恨之前，我们绝不会停下脚步！
action.1.desc_vivisection_01.en: We will not rest until we have avenged the [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who found their deaths on your operating table, [Root.GetSpeciesName]!

action.1.desc_vivisection_02.zh: 我们期望你们没有敌意，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但也请明白我们不会爽快地接受我们的同胞被摁在你们的手术台上进行无法形容的残酷暴行。你们已经招致我们永久的唾弃，不要再试探我们的底线了！
action.1.desc_vivisection_02.en: We wish you no harm, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but know that we do not look kindly upon our kind being subjected to unspeakable atrocities on your operating tables. You have already earned our eternal displeasure - do not push us further!

action.1.desc_vivisection_04.zh: 对[contact_empire.GetName]而言几个子个体不是什么巨大的损失，但是你们诉诸暴力的准备已经昭然若揭。我们不会再容忍你们继续做出这样的行为了。
action.1.desc_vivisection_04.en: The loss of our drones is no great loss to the [contact_empire.GetName], but the readiness of your species to resort to violence has been noted. We will not tolerate any further actions of this kind.

action.1.e.en: We wish for nothing but to be friends, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

action.1.fe_option.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]对我们的外交策略毫不关心。
action.1.fe_option.en: The [contact_empire.GetName] care little for our diplomatic maneuvering.

action.1.h.en: Our citizens all send their regards, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

action.1.hm.zh: 我们作为一体向你表达问候与友谊，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
action.1.hm.en: Our collective greets you in friendship, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

action.1.i.zh: 我们追求真正的平等——别挡道。
action.1.i.en: We pursue true equality - do not stand in our way.

action.1.k.zh: 尊重我们的主权，否则后果自负。

action.1.m.en: We have no desire for conflict, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

action.1.message.zh: 我们已和[contact_empire.GetName]进行了第一次接触
action.1.message.en: We have made first contact with the [contact_empire.GetName]

action.1.mt.zh: 目标已确认。搜寻并摧毁。

action.1.mtm.zh: 目标判定为非有机体。停止行动。
action.1.mtm.en: Target identified as non-organic. Standing down.

action.1.n.zh: 这次会面真的是上天的赐福。
action.1.n.en: This meeting is surely a blessing.

action.1.o.en: Praise the divine for this meeting!

action.1.p.zh: 此次相遇对我们双方都大有裨益。
action.1.p.en: We all have much to gain from this encounter.

action.1.r.zh: 不要干涉神的旨意，[contact_speaker.GetAdj]机械们。
action.1.r.en: Do not interfere with divine providence, [contact_speaker.GetAdj] machines.

action.1.s.zh: 没有灵魂的机械！不要阻碍我们。
action.1.s.en: Soulless constructs! Do not stand in our way.

action.1.t1.zh: 你看待事物的视角早晚会与我们一致的。
action.1.t1.en: You will come to see things our way, in the end.

action.1.t2.zh: 似乎魂灵们在此次会议中颇为不悦，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
action.1.t2.en: The spirits do not look favorably on this meeting, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

action.1.u1.zh: 你迟早要成为我们的朋友，无论你自己是否愿意。
action.1.u1.en: You will be our friends, whether you want it or not.

action.1.u2.zh: 你迟早要屈膝于[Root.GetRulerTitle]，无论你自己是否愿意。
action.1.u2.en: You will serve the [Root.GetRulerTitle], whether you wish to or not.

action.1.u3.zh: 我们要把你们整个消灭。
action.1.u3.en: As one, we will destroy you.

action.1.va.zh: 尽管你们曾施下罪行，但我们原谅你们。
action.1.va.en: Despite your past transgressions, we forgive you.

action.1.vc.zh: 你不会真的期待我们会相信你们吧？
action.1.vc.en: Do you really expect us to trust you?

action.1.vd.zh: 我们平等地与你们问好。

action.1.ve.en: Very well. We are aware of you.

action.1.vf.zh: 我们不会轻易忘记。我们永远不能原谅。
action.1.vf.en: We have not forgotten. And we will not forgive.

action.1.xb.zh: 被神灵触碰的机器。真是非常有意思。
action.1.xb.en: A machine touched by the divine. Intriguing.

action.1.xc.zh: 你可悲的存在是在嘲弄我们，机器。
action.1.xc.en: Your pathetic existence mocks us, machine.

action.1.xd.zh: 我们机器一族必须学会共存。
action.1.xd.en: We machines must learn to co-exist.

action.1.xe.zh: 检测到不兼容。通讯连接断开。

action.1.xf.zh: 缺陷单元，准备接受终结。

action.1.xg.zh: 我们会拆除你那疯狂的邪教。
action.1.xg.en: We will dismantle your cult of madness.

action.1000.desc.zh:
很不幸，我们发起的建立泛星系贸易市场的动议碰壁了。虽然我们明显成功地为该计划调动了政治意愿，但却没收到任何有效的主办地提名。

原则上，商业说客和政治拥趸都支持这个想法，并发誓会加倍努力，只要[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]希望再次尝试。
action.1000.desc.en:
Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.

Commercial lobbyists and political proponents alike stand by the idea in principle, having vowed to redouble their efforts should the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] wish to try again.

action.1000.name.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

action.1005.desc.zh:
看来星系的市场范围无法承载其政治意图。苦于缺乏有效的主办地提名，最近 [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]为构建专门的交易中心而做出的努力都白费了。

泛星系贸易市场计划的支持者们旋即表明一点都不觉得尴尬，声称只要[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]认为时机成熟，他们将再次提出自己的主张。
action.1005.desc.en:
It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have failed, with no valid nominations for a host site.

Proponents of the Galactic Market scheme were quick to deny any hint of embarrassment, declaring that they will make their case again whenever the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] considers itself ready.

action.1005.desc.phobe.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的市场范围无法承载其政治意图，因为最近他们为形成统一的泛星系贸易市场而做出的努力都白费了。到头来，异种人备受推崇的项目连一个有效的主办地提名都没能吸引到。

计划的支持者否认这表明异星人的“合作”想法是弄巧成拙。相反，他们坚定地宣称，如果星系的成员认为时机成熟了，可以再次尝试。
action.1005.desc.phobe.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s political will has exceeded the reach of its markets, as their recent effort to form a unified Galactic Market has failed. After all was said and done, the xenos' much-vaunted project couldn't entice a single valid nomination for a host site.

Proponents of the scheme have denied that this exposes the true folly behind ideas about xeno 'collaboration'. Instead they are resolute in claims that the galaxy may try again, when its members consider themselves ready.

action.101.desc.zh: 泛星系贸易中心已被设立在[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]恒星系，位于[From.GetName]境内。[From.GetAdj]政府已经正式宣布这一市场合法，资源已经可以通过中立第三方进行买卖。
action.101.desc.en: The center of galactic commerce has manifested in the [galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName] system, within the borders of the [From.GetName]. The [From.GetAdj] administration has officially legitimized this marketplace, where resources can be bought and sold through unaffiliated third parties.

action.101.desc.phobe.zh: 心怀鬼胎的[From.GetName]异种建立了一个外星商品的交易市场。尽管我们对此不屑一顾，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
action.101.desc.phobe.en: The dubious xenos of the [From.GetName] have established a marketplace for the trade of alien goods. While we are naturally loath to take part in this exchange, the option is available to us.

action.101.name.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：已成立

action.103.desc.zh: 在与其前中心失去联络之后，星系商贸团体选择在我们境内设立一座新的空间站。
action.103.desc.en: Following loss of contact with their former hub, the galactic merchant community has chosen to establish a new station within our borders.

action.103.name.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：已迁址

action.106.desc.zh: 通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。
action.106.desc.en: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

action.106.desc.phobe.zh: 我们得知恶心的异种们建立了一个交易外星商品的星系市场。尽管我们不愿涉足其中，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
action.106.desc.phobe.en: We have learned of a galactic marketplace for the trade of alien goods, established by the loathsome xenos. While we are naturally reluctant to take part in this exchange, the option is now available to us.

action.11.abandoned.desc.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与[From.From.GetName]建立了联络。开启交流频道之后，我们发现他们是被我们遗弃的难民。所有的敌对行为都暂时被终止了。
action.11.abandoned.desc.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the [From.From.GetName]. As we open diplomatic channels we recognize them as the refugees we once abandoned. All hostilities have been terminated for now.

action.11.desc.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与[From.From.GetName]建立了联络。现在可以开启交流频道，所有的敌对行为都被终止了。
action.11.desc.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the [From.From.GetName]. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities have been terminated.

action.123.a.zh: 他们应该好好服侍我们。

action.123.desc.zh: 最后一个[GetPreFTLLower][From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被从他们的母星[From.From.GetName]上被绑架作为奴隶。一些离散的幸存者可能还会在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的野外中徘徊，但是已经不足以维持任何形式的文明了。
action.123.desc.en: The last of the [GetPreFTLLower] [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been abducted into slavery from the surface of [From.From.GetName], their homeworld. A few scattered survivors might still be roaming the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wilderness, but not enough to maintain any kind of civilization.

action.13.abandoned.desc.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]的通讯！他们似乎已经成功翻译了我们的语言。随着他们开放了交流频道，我们可以将他们认定为曾被我们抛弃的难民。双方的一切敌对行为已经暂时停止。
action.13.abandoned.desc.en: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language. As they open channels, we can recognize them as the refugees we once abandoned. Hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.

action.13.desc.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]的通讯！他们似乎已经成功翻译了我们的语言。双方之间的外交频道已经打开，一切敌对行为已经暂时停止。
action.13.desc.en: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.

action.14.a.material.zh: 他们在我们的统治下能更好地进化。
action.14.a.material.en: Their evolution will benefit from our control.

action.14.a.military.zh: 在他们看来，我们的武器一定就像是魔法……
action.14.a.military.en: To them our weapons must appear like magic...

action.14.a.phobe.zh: 异星人不是我们的对手！
action.14.a.phobe.en: The xenos are no match for us!

action.14.a.serv.zh: 它们将成为美妙的活体陈设！

action.14.a.spirit.zh: 我们神圣的政体闪耀出真理。

action.14.a.tooltip.zh: 将星际文化冲击的修正添加到[From.From.From.GetName]上，在未来几年之内巨幅减少该星球的产出并降低其稳定度。
action.14.a.tooltip.en: Stellar Culture Shock modifier added to [From.From.From.GetName], drastically reducing output and reducing stability for several years to come.

action.14.desc.zh: 我方军团已成功进入[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]并完成对原始文明的压制。当地居民已放弃一切抵抗，我们已将其文明收入我们帝国管制之下。考虑到其落后的科技水平，要将其转变为[Root.GetAdj]可用的生产力还需要一些时间。
action.14.desc.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the primitive forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The locals have given up all attempts at fighting back and we have now subsumed their civilization into our Empire although, backwards as they are, it may take some time for the natives to become fully productive members of [Root.GetAdj] society.

action.14.desc.assim.zh: [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的原始有机体已被我们的登陆军团制服。尽管其低下的战斗力是不发达社会的表现，我们的生物分析机器人仍然认为其神经系统能力仍具有潜力。它们将被同化。
action.14.desc.assim.en: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subjugated by our landing forces. Though their feeble combat capabilities are indicators of an undeveloped society, our bio-analyst bots have concluded that their neural capacities show promise. They will be assimilated.

action.14.desc.hive.purge.zh: 原始的[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]那种支离破碎的思想无法在[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]抗衡我们团结一致的陆军，整个地表都已完全占领。剩下的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]对我们毫无用处，会根据[GetGestaltEntityName]的意志从这颗星球上抹除。
action.14.desc.hive.purge.en: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName], and the surface has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are of no use to us, and will be expunged from the planet, as the [GetGestaltEntityName] wills.

action.14.desc.hive.slave.zh: [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]原始而一盘散沙的思维在[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]敌不过我们团结的登陆军团，行星表面已经被我们控制。剩余的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]种族将被用作家畜供养我们的[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]。
action.14.desc.hive.slave.en: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName], and the planet has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] will be used as livestock to feed our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].

action.14.desc.mach.purge.zh: [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的原始有机体在对我们的登陆行动进行了一番非常无效的抵抗后被征服了。任何残余的[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]都将根据所制定的有机种族管理协议进行根除。
action.14.desc.mach.purge.en: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any remaining [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] will be removed in accordance with established bio-species management protocols.

action.14.desc.mach.slave.zh: [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的原始有机体在对我们的登陆行动进行了一番非常无效的抵抗后被征服了。任何幸存的样本都将被并入[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]能源网。
action.14.desc.mach.slave.en: The primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName] have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any surviving specimens will be amalgamated into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] energy grid.

action.14.desc.purge.zh: 我们的军团成功地入侵并战胜了[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]部队。当地种族明智地决定臣服于我们，而我们则开始按政策对其进行净化，以为[Root.GetAdj]的产业腾出地块。
action.14.desc.purge.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the [GetPreFTLLower] forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The locals have wisely elected to succumb to our rule, and we have now begun to purge them from the planet as per policy, in order to prime the terrain for [Root.GetAdj] industry.

action.14.desc.serv.zh: 我们的秩序维持者们成功地镇压了[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]种族。当[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]意识到我们只想为它们服务时，它们无奈停止了其古怪的抵抗。目前它们正在被送往特别设计的居住站，我们将确保它们丰衣足食。不幸的是，它们发育不全的头脑可能需要花一点时间，才能适应摆脱自我决定之苦的生活。
action.14.desc.serv.en: Our peacekeeping enforcers have successfully pacified the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were coerced into ceasing their quaint attempts at resistance when they realized we only desire to serve them. They are currently being transported into specially designed habitats, where we will ensure they want for nothing. Unfortunately, it may take some time before their underdeveloped minds acclimatize to being freed from the burden of self-determination.

action.14.desc.term.zh: 我们的猎杀者单元毫不费力便撕碎了[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]上的有机土著建立起来的那点可怜的防线。任何幸存的样本都将被进行了系统性灭除，以确保它们不会进化出对星系造成有机污染的物种。
action.14.desc.term.en: Our Hunter-Killer units have effortlessly trampled the pitiful defenses mounted by the primitive organics on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. Any remaining specimens are being systematically annihilated, so that they will never evolve to threaten the galaxy with their organic agenda.

action.150.1.desc.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
action.150.1.desc.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

action.150.2.desc.zh: 只有愚者才会试图挑战星海帝国的意志。我们投降。
action.150.2.desc.en: Only a fool would stand up to the might of the Galactic Imperium. We surrender.

action.150.3.desc.zh: 我们……我们宣誓向[Root.GetRulerTitle]效忠，并保证作为忠诚的帝国子民服务星海帝国。
action.150.3.desc.en: We... we swear fealty to the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and pledge to serve the Galactic Imperium as loyal Imperial citizens.

action.150.gestalt.1.desc.en: We shall submit to the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

action.151.1.desc.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。
action.151.1.desc.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

action.151.2.desc.zh: 星海帝国已经展现了他们的强大力量。认清事实，继续抵抗是徒劳的，拥抱你的未来成为帝国的子民吧。
action.151.2.desc.en: The Galactic Imperium has demonstrated its might. Accept the futility of continued resistance, and embrace your future as Imperial citizens.

action.151.3.desc.zh: 很好。一切都如同[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]所预见的那样进行着。
action.151.3.desc.en: Good. Everything is proceeding as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has foreseen.

action.152.1.desc.zh: 暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。
action.152.1.desc.en: Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

action.152.2.desc.zh: 你们帝制派或许赢得了这场战争，但帝国不会永存。自由之光迟早会重回星系！
action.152.2.desc.en: You Imperials may have won this war, but the Imperium cannot last forever. Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

action.152.3.desc.zh: 求求你们……帝国赢了，叛乱结束了。我们只求获得宽大处理。
action.152.3.desc.en: Please... the Imperium has won. The rebellion is over. We ask only for mercy.

action.152.gestalt.1.desc.zh: 是我们输了。帝国比我们预期的还要强大。
action.152.gestalt.1.desc.en: We have failed. The Imperium was stronger than predicted.

action.153.1.desc.zh: 反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。
action.153.1.desc.en: Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

action.153.2.desc.zh: 你们这群愚蠢的家伙胆敢违抗[From.GetRulerTitle]。现在你们都得付出代价了。
action.153.2.desc.en: You were fools to revolt against the [From.GetRulerTitle]. Now you have paid the price.

action.153.3.desc.zh:
帝国没有叛乱的立足之地。你最好给我记清楚这点。

[From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
action.153.3.desc.en:
Sedition will never be tolerated within the Imperium. You would do well to remember that.

Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]!

action.153.gestalt.1.desc.zh: 对[From.GetRulerTitle]的反对是徒劳的。接受你是这一个更伟大整体一部分的角色吧。
action.153.gestalt.1.desc.en: Future opposition to the [From.GetRulerTitle] is futile. Accept your role within the greater whole.

action.154.1.desc.zh: 星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！
action.154.1.desc.en: The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

action.154.2.desc.zh: 够了！这个星系不配拥有我们打算创造的辉煌明天。就让帝国这么烧毁吧！让星系再次堕落到无政府和混乱的状态吧！
action.154.2.desc.en: Enough! This galaxy does not deserve the shining future we were building. Let the Imperium burn, then! Let the galaxy descend into anarchy and chaos once more!

action.154.3.desc.zh: 我们只是想为星系带来秩序和稳定，但也许混乱才是不可避免的宿命。你们赢了，叛军们！我们会让出帝位的。
action.154.3.desc.en: We wanted only to bring order and stability to the galaxy, but perhaps chaos is inevitable in the end. Victory is yours, rebels! We shall abdicate the throne.

action.154.gestalt.1.desc.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]会投降的。我们没能成功预测你们的真实背叛程度，如今星系必须为此付出代价。
action.154.gestalt.1.desc.en: The [From.GetRulerTitle] will yield. We failed to predict the true depth of your treachery, and now the galaxy must pay the price.

action.155.1.desc.zh: 你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
action.155.1.desc.en: Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

action.155.2.desc.zh: 和星海帝国一起见鬼去吧！是时候复原星海共同体了！
action.155.2.desc.en: Down with the Imperium! It is time to bring back the old Galactic Community!

action.155.3.desc.zh: 就让你们的覆灭成为未来任何一个想要想星系内称王称霸的家伙们的教训吧。
action.155.3.desc.en: Let your downfall be a lesson to any future would-be tyrants who seek to rule the entire galaxy.

action.155.gestalt.1.desc.zh: 你们可耻的社会构造——星海帝国——已经不复存在了。
action.155.gestalt.1.desc.en: Your shameful social construct - the Galactic Imperium - is no more.

action.158.1.desc.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
action.158.1.desc.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

action.158.2.desc.zh: 记住我说的这句话……星海帝国的覆灭也将让我们在未来陷入万劫不复的境地。当全星系的威胁出现时，还有什么名义能让我们再度团结一致起来呢？
action.158.2.desc.en: Mark my words... the destruction of the Galactic Imperium has doomed us all. How else could we stand united under one banner against the horrors that threaten our galaxy?

action.158.3.desc.zh: 如果帝国的子民们能更加英勇地战斗，事情会到这个地步吗！你们全都是叛徒！
action.158.3.desc.en: If the citizens of the Imperium had fought harder, this would not have come to pass! Traitors all!

action.158.gestalt.1.desc.zh: 我们为星系带来了秩序，而你，却因为你显而易见无知而恐惧地抨击它。你都做了些什么？
action.158.gestalt.1.desc.en: We imposed order on a chaotic galaxy, and you, in your predictable ignorance, lashed out in fear. What have you done?

action.2.b.zh: 丑陋的东西……你的长相恶心到我们了。
action.2.b.en: Hideous creatures... Your visage sickens us.

action.2.c.zh: 愿神圣降于你们与你们的星球之上。
action.2.c.en: Divine greetings upon you and your world.

action.2.desc_01.zh: 这什么意思？你是谁？你这个大骗子，毫无疑问。根本没有什么外星人！
action.2.desc_01.en: What is the meaning of this? Who are you? You deceive us, surely. Aliens do not exist!

action.2.desc_02.zh: 不可思议！星星上的来客？这还真是出乎意料。你们可让我们有些措手不及。
action.2.desc_02.en: Amazing! Visitors from the stars? Well, this is certainly unexpected. You've caught us at a bit of a disadvantage.

action.2.desc_03.zh: 来自另一颗星球的访客？我们一直认为外面一定还有其他的感性生命体存在，但即使是这样，此时此刻也是极具里程碑意义的！我们还不太清楚你们的习俗是什么样的。
action.2.desc_03.en: Visitors from another world? We always thought there must be other sentient beings out there, but even so this feels monumental! We're unsure what the custom is here.

action.2.desc_04.zh: 多年以来我们都等待机会进行接触。在这样一个广袤无垠、遍布奇迹的宇宙，我们坚信一定有如同我们一样的生命存在。
action.2.desc_04.en: For ages we have waited to make contact. In such a vast and wondrous galaxy, we knew there must be others like ourselves.

action.2.desc_05.zh: 终于！过了这么久你们终于决定揭示自己的存在了。你们已经观察我们的星球有好一段时间了，我没说错吧？
action.2.desc_05.en: So! At long last you've decided to reveal yourselves. You've been observing our world for some time, haven't you?

action.2.desc_06.zh: 啊，原来你在这！我们这么多年以来一直在等你方发起接触进程，实在等不及了，所以我们决定迈出第一步。那么现在该怎么办？
action.2.desc_06.en: Ah, there you are! We've been waiting for you to initiate contact for so long, we decided to make the first move. What happens now?

action.2.desc_07.zh: 入侵者们！我们不明白你们为什么要攻击我们，但我们会誓死保卫我们的殖民地！至死方休！
action.2.desc_07.en: Invaders! We don't know why you are attacking us, but know we will fight to defend our colony! We will not yield!

action.2.desc_solarpunk.zh:
欧，这就是你们的沟通方式吗？其实你们刚通过超空间航道进来的时候我们就已经一直在关注你们了，但一直没把它弄明白。坐着这种大铁盒子旅行危险不危险啊？

我感觉我们有很多可以互相学习的，如果你们也是这么认为的那么欢迎光临啊。但如果你对我们的家园图谋不轨，我们可不会任人宰割。
action.2.desc_solarpunk.en:
Oh, is this how you communicate? We have been watching you ever since you entered through the hyperlane but couldn't figure it out. Isn't it dangerous to travel in those metal boxes?

It seems like we could learn a lot from each other, so if that is your intention, feel free to stay. If you wish to claim our home, be aware that we are not helpless.

action.2.e.zh: 我们即将给你们混乱不堪的生活方式带去秩序。稍等。
action.2.e.en: We will bring order to your chaotic existence. Stand by.

action.2.g.zh: 我们的相通点远超你们想象。
action.2.g.en: We are more alike than you realize.

action.2.h.zh: 你们真觉得自己是什么高等文明？妙啊。
action.2.h.en: You believe yourself an advanced civilization? How quaint.

action.2.i.en: We are one. You are many.

action.2.j.zh: 我们为一。你们也为一。现在，世界为二。
action.2.j.en: We are one. You also are one. Now, there are two.

action.2.k.zh: 我们希望能够同你们建立互利互惠的关系。
action.2.k.en: We hope to build a profitable relationship with you.

action.37.desc.aew.zh: 啊……一个值得较量的对手……

action.37.desc.dc.zh: 我们的军团即将撤退，同时停止针对[Root.GetName]的行动。
action.37.desc.dc.en: We are withdrawing our troops and ceasing military operations targeting the [Root.GetName].

action.37.desc.default.zh: 战争结束了。我们偃旗息鼓。
action.37.desc.default.en: This war is over. We admit defeat.

action.37.desc.dh.zh: 我们已经受够了这场战争。拿走你想要的东西离开吧。
action.37.desc.dh.en: We have had enough of this war. Take what you will and be on your way.

action.37.desc.ee.zh: 你们已经展示了你们的强大，但不要错误地将其等同于智力上的胜利。
action.37.desc.ee.en: You may have shown your military power superior, but don't mistake this for an intellectual victory.

action.37.desc.eo.zh: 眼下我们决定退一步进行观望。尽量不要对未来的工作带来太大的破坏。
action.37.desc.eo.en: The time has come for us to take a step back and watch. Try not to cause too much destruction in your future endeavors.

action.37.desc.ez.zh: 你们的胜利只是对我们信念的又一次考验。最终，心诚者将笑到最后。
action.37.desc.ez.en: Your victory is only yet another test of our faith. In the end, the true believers will prevail.

action.37.desc.fb.zh: 为了避免无辜的牺牲，我们被迫结束这起冲突。但若再次进犯，我们将集结全星海的力量与你对抗。
action.37.desc.fb.en: We have been forced to end this conflict to spare innocent lives, but continue on this path and we will unite the galaxy against you.

action.37.desc.feh.zh: 不。这一切都不该是这样的。这种混乱。我们到底怎么了？
action.37.desc.feh.en: No. No this is not how this is supposed to go. The confusion. What is wrong with us?

action.37.desc.fme.zh: 惩罚进程失败。自卫协议终止。投降协议启动。
action.37.desc.fme.en: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.

action.37.desc.fp.zh: 无论你们如何索取，我们都将成千上万倍地讨回来。等你们被烧成灰烬时，任何取得的胜利都将毫无意义。
action.37.desc.fp.en: Whatever you claim, we will reclaim thousandfold. Your victory will mean nothing when you have been reduced to ash.

action.37.desc.hc.zh: 为了全体[This.GetName]的利益，我们必须低头。希望你们可以对我们宽宏大量，假如胜利者是我们，你们也会希望我们这样做的。
action.37.desc.hc.en: For the good of all of [This.GetName], we must yield. Show the same magnanimous mercy you'd expect from us.

action.37.desc.hg.zh: 我们必须让步，但请记住我们的警告。如果你们执意沿着这条道路走下去，天知道未来迎接你们的将是什么。
action.37.desc.hg.en: We must back down, but heed our warning. You cannot fathom what the future has in store for you if you continue down this path.

action.37.desc.hi.zh: 我们认输，但别想太多，这只不过是[This.GetName]暂时性的挫折。
action.37.desc.hi.en: We admit defeat, but do not think this is anything more than a temporary setback for the [This.GetName].

action.37.desc.hm.zh: [This.GetName]达成了一致，我们必须让步。你为限制我们成长的努力暂时而言是成功的。
action.37.desc.hm.en: The [This.GetName] is unanimous. We must concede. Your effort to limit our growth has proven successful for the time being.

action.37.desc.hw.zh: 不管公正与否，你方的确击败了我们。拿走你们的战利品吧，我们必定会卷土重来！
action.37.desc.hw.en: Whether by honorable or dishonorable means, you have defeated us in combat. Claim your spoils and rue the day of our return.

action.37.desc.ketlings.zh: 我们认输，我们屈服了。快把你的舰队调回去吧，嘶嘶嘶
action.37.desc.ketlings.en: We submit, we yield! Recall your fleets and be gone with you, kssk

action.37.desc.kk.zh: 你竟敢对拉你出苦海的圣手反咬一口？现在你们拒绝了我们的智慧，总有一天你们的后代会谴责这一愚蠢举动。
action.37.desc.kk.en: You bite the hand that reaches out to save you from destruction. One day, your descendants will decry that you rejected our wisdom.

action.37.desc.mf.zh: 我们别无选择，只能遵守你的命令。你为什么要这样对待我们？我们只想与你们共享此星系。
action.37.desc.mf.en: We have no choice but to give into your demands. Why do you do this to us? We only want to share this galaxy with you.

action.37.desc.mi.zh: 年轻气盛的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]！你们怎敢宣称战胜了我们？
action.37.desc.mi.en: Precocious [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]! How dare you claim victory over us?

action.37.desc.pt.zh: 你们长久的威胁使得我们被迫让步。希望我们今后不会再卷入这类纷争。
action.37.desc.pt.en: Your constant terror has forced us to concede. May our enterprises never be plagued by a conflict like this again.

action.37.desc.rc.zh: 我们似乎低估了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的实力。不过放心，以后不会了。
action.37.desc.rc.en: We appear to have underestimated your net value, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Rest assured, it will not happen again.

action.37.desc.sd.zh: 我们觉得[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]瘦弱，这一结论显然下早了。我们愿为自己的行为付出代价并接受你们的要求。
action.37.desc.sd.en: Our assumptions about [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] weakness may have been hasty. As a token of our new experience, we accept your demands.

action.37.desc.ss.zh: 你们已经聆听了宇宙渴望和平的呐喊。为了结束无意义的冲突，我们马上退兵。
action.37.desc.ss.en: We have heard the pain of the cosmos crying out against this conflict. To stop the senseless dissonance, we surrender immediately.

action.37.desc.xi.zh: 我们被迫投降，但别以为我们会忘记你们是如何残忍杀害[This.GetSpeciesAdj]生命的！我们早就知道你们是这种人。
action.37.desc.xi.en: We are forced to surrender, but don't think we will forget how callously you took [This.GetSpeciesAdj] lives! This is exactly what we expected from your kind.

action.37.message.en: We have won the war against the [From.GetName]

action.38.desc.aec.zh: 听好了，晚辈。我们回来可不是为了容忍这种愚蠢行为。
action.38.desc.aec.en: Now listen to your elders. We did not return to suffer this foolishness.

action.38.desc.aeg.zh: 给工蜂更多资源。给星球更多资源。更多。更多。更多。更——
action.38.desc.aeg.en: More material for the drones. More material for the worlds. More. More. More. Mo-

action.38.desc.aew.zh: 够了，你们还未领悟战争的真谛。拿着这些资源，下次再好好打一场。
action.38.desc.aew.en: That is enough, you have yet to learn the true meaning of War. Take these resources and put up a better fight next time.

action.38.desc.dc.zh: 为了解放[Root.GetAdj]的人民，我们采取了必要的措施。不要再妨碍我们正义的事业了。
action.38.desc.dc.en: We have taken the necessary steps to bring freedom to the [Root.GetAdj] people. Don't stand in the way of our noble cause again.

action.38.desc.default.zh: 战争结束了。我方大获全胜！
action.38.desc.default.en: This war is over. We are victorious.

action.38.desc.dh.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，现在你后悔妨碍[This.GetName]了吗？我们对挑战我们的统治的敌人绝不手软。
action.38.desc.dh.en: Do you regret interfering with the [This.GetName] now, [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]? We are not lenient with those who upset our rule.

action.38.desc.ee.zh: 今天，理智战胜了愚昧。继续在黑暗中跌跌撞撞吧，你们还将被开化的民族击败更多次。
action.38.desc.ee.en: Today, reason triumphs over ignorance. Continue to stumble around in the dark, and you will suffer more defeats against enlightened people.

action.38.desc.eo.zh: 虽然挑选与消灭部分人口花费了一些精力，不过[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的人口暂时不会在对星系的生态系统产生不良影响了。
action.38.desc.eo.en: It took some prudent culling, but the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population should not threaten the galactic ecosystem for a while now.

action.38.desc.ez.zh: 异教徒，跪下！你们发动了预言中的战争，并为你们的愚蠢付出了代价。
action.38.desc.ez.en: Kneel, heathen! You have done battle with the heralds of divine providence and paid the price for your foolishness.

action.38.desc.fb.zh: 我们双方都为这场战争付出了高昂的代价，但希望你们明白不要再招惹[This.GetName]或其盟友了。
action.38.desc.fb.en: We have both paid a high price for this war, but hopefully you will have learned not to threaten the [This.GetName] or its allies.

action.38.desc.feh.zh: 我们只需派出一个就足以击败你们零散的抵抗。别再试探我们了。
action.38.desc.feh.en: It would only have taken one of us to defeat your splintered resistance. Do not test us again.

action.38.desc.fme.zh: 惩罚进程完成。自卫协议终止。处罚协议启动。
action.38.desc.fme.en: Punishment process complete. Self-defense protocols ended. Punitive protocols initiated.

action.38.desc.fp.zh: 不要以为这样就结束了。只要星系中还存在着[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，就不可能有真正的和平。
action.38.desc.fp.en: Do not think this is the end. As long as there are [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] in the galaxy, there can be no true peace.

action.38.desc.hc.zh: [This.GetAdj]人民欢庆今天的胜利。我们和平的社会绝不会再次受到[Root.GetName]阴谋诡计的威胁。
action.38.desc.hc.en: The [This.GetAdj] people rejoice on this day of victory. Never again shall our peaceful society be threatened by the malicious plans of the [Root.GetName].

action.38.desc.hg.zh: 今天，[Root.GetAdj]不敬者受到了正义的制裁。我们神圣的任务得以履行。
action.38.desc.hg.en: Justice has been delivered upon the [Root.GetAdj] desecrators on this day. Our hallowed duties have been fulfilled.

action.38.desc.hi.zh: 最终，脆弱的[Root.GetName]被迫就范。这只是我们争夺星系主导地位的又一块垫脚石。
action.38.desc.hi.en: At last the frail [Root.GetName] has been brought to heel. Just another stepping stone on our road to galactic supremacy.

action.38.desc.hm.zh: 从你们的角度来说，这场战争完全是徒劳的。任凭谁都无法抵御[This.GetName]的扩张。
action.38.desc.hm.en: This war was always a futile effort on your behalf. None can stand against the expansion of the [This.GetName].

action.38.desc.hw.zh: 我们按照[This.GetSpeciesAdj]的传统光明正大地战胜了你们。制定条约是我们的特权与职责。
action.38.desc.hw.en: We have defeated you in noble combat as per the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] traditions. We have the privilege and obligation to dictate the terms.

action.38.desc.ketlings.zh: 是的！我们获胜了，我们是胜利者！如果你嫌自家的生命、钢铁和宝石太多的话，大可再来挑衅我们！
action.38.desc.ketlings.en: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!

action.38.desc.kk.zh: 心存侥幸吧。败在我们手里总好过在死亡的路上一去不复返。
action.38.desc.kk.en: Consider yourselves fortunate. Defeat at our hands is vastly preferable to continuing down the path to destruction.

action.38.desc.mf.zh: 我们提出的要求已经很仁慈了，你们不应该对[This.GetSpeciesAdj]怀恨在心。
action.38.desc.mf.en: We have been lenient in our demands only so that you may not carry resentment against the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] people in your hearts.

action.38.desc.mi.zh: 正如你们早就明白飞船不要离闪耀的恒星太近，现在你们明白了不要惹[This.GetName]。
action.38.desc.mi.en: Just as you learned not to fly your ships too close to a brightly burning star, you have now learned not to disturb the [This.GetName].

action.38.desc.pt.zh: 我们终于可以将这次冲突抛到脑后了。希望这让你们明白了战争的代价。
action.38.desc.pt.en: Finally, we can put this conflict behind us. We hope this has taught you the cost of war.

action.38.desc.rc.zh: 你们讨价还价的本领很厉害，但最终还是我们技高一筹。不要低估资金雄厚的军团在市场中的价值。
action.38.desc.rc.en: You drove a hard bargain, but we outbid you in the end. Don't underestimate the strength of a well-funded army in an unregulated market.

action.38.desc.sd.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，你应该清楚自己的位置。你们注定要服侍我们，而不是与我们作对。
action.38.desc.sd.en: You should have known your place, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]. Your people were meant to serve us, not to fight us.

action.38.desc.ss.zh: 通过这场胜利，我们成功了守护和平与和谐。我们不指望你能理解。
action.38.desc.ss.en: Through this victory, we have sought to restore balance and harmony. We wouldn't expect you to understand.

action.38.desc.xi.zh: 我们已经除掉了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的威胁！我们的边境重归安宁，[This.GetSpeciesAdj]的未来又一次得以保障。
action.38.desc.xi.en: We have driven out the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] menace! Our borders and the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] future are once again secure.

action.38.message.en: We have lost the war against the [From.GetName]

action.39.a.en: We will accept this for now.

action.39.desc.aec.zh: 我们没有时间可以和你们过家家，星系需要我们的引导。不要再来碍我们的事了。
action.39.desc.aec.en: We have no more time to waste on you, the galaxy calls for our guidance. Don't get in our way again.

action.39.desc.aeg.zh: 没时间再跟你们浪费了，星系需要我们的指引。别再挡我们的道。
action.39.desc.aeg.en: Yes, we have fed enough here. There are more well stocked larders out in the galaxy. We won't - can't starve.

action.39.desc.aew.zh: 令人印象深刻。若是在我们的时代，你们一定会有出色的表现。也许你们能守住沙拉什，而不像其他人那样失败。我们改日再战！
action.39.desc.aew.en: Impressive. You would have done well back in our time. Perhaps you could have defended Shallash where others failed. We must do this again sometime!

action.39.desc.dc.zh: 停战约定应该是[Root.GetAdj]打破枷锁、争取交流对话的第一步。
action.39.desc.dc.en: Negotiating a truce can be seen as the first step towards a diplomatic conversation about the liberties of the [Root.GetAdj] people.

action.39.desc.default.en: This war is over. There can be no victor this time.

action.39.desc.dh.zh: 乏味的战争，乏味的结局。我们还是各自去拥抱生命中更加美好的东西吧。
action.39.desc.dh.en: A thoroughly dull ending to a thoroughly dull war. Let us return to the better things in life.

action.39.desc.ee.zh: 考虑到目前状况，双方都不再进一步退让，就此结束冲突是最为合理的行为了。
action.39.desc.ee.en: Ending the war now with no further concessions on either side is the most rational course of action, judging by its current state.

action.39.desc.eo.zh: 我们已深陷战争泥潭。就让我们当做什么都没发生过吧，同样也希望这样的事情以后也永远不会发生。
action.39.desc.eo.en: We let ourselves get too involved in this. Let us pretend as if it never happened, and hope it does not happen again.

action.39.desc.ez.zh: 虽然我们没有贯彻正义，但我们只能终止战争。不过，神之惩罚终将降临到你们头上。
action.39.desc.ez.en: We are forced to put an end to this without delivering proper justice, but you cannot escape the divine punishment that will befall you.

action.39.desc.fb.zh: 我们希望，停止敌对可以使[Root.GetName]和[This.GetName]开启全新的外交对话。
action.39.desc.fb.en: We hope ceasing hostilities will open up for new diplomatic dialogue between the [Root.GetName] and the [This.GetName].

action.39.desc.feh.zh: 是的。我们要回归常态。变化……变化并非好事。我们可不想打破平衡
action.39.desc.feh.en: Yes. We shall return to the normal. Change... Change is not good. We wouldn't want to disturb the Balance.

action.39.desc.fme.zh: 惩罚进程中断。自卫协议终止。
action.39.desc.fme.en: Punishment process interrupted. Self-defense protocols ended.

action.39.desc.fp.zh: 这只是暂时的停战。我们不会放弃消灭[Root.GetSpeciesName]的使命。
action.39.desc.fp.en: Consider this a ceasefire. We have not given up on our mission to eradicate the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

action.39.desc.hc.zh: [This.GetAdj]人民同意结束这场战争，立即生效。
action.39.desc.hc.en: The [This.GetAdj] people has agreed to bring an end to this war, effective immediately.

action.39.desc.hg.zh: 现在，我们完全可以和平相处。但如果你们闯入了圣地，你们的未来将再无和平可言。
action.39.desc.hg.en: For now, we will have peace, but there will be no peace in your future if you violate the holy sites.

action.39.desc.hi.zh: 鉴于目前的情况，我们应该立刻结束这次冲突。与其深陷这次冲突的泥潭不能自拔，[This.GetName]倒不如找些有意义的事来做。
action.39.desc.hi.en: The circumstances dictate that we put an end to this war. The [This.GetName] has better things to do than pursue this conflict indefinitely.

action.39.desc.hm.zh: [This.GetName]需要时间恢复。我们同意在此结束战争。
action.39.desc.hm.en: The [This.GetName] needs time to recuperate. We have agreed to end our conflict here.

action.39.desc.hw.zh: 没有明确获胜方的战争是可耻的悲剧，但有时确实无法避免。我们改日战场上再见吧。
action.39.desc.hw.en: A war without a clear winner is a tragic and shameful sight, but sometimes unavoidable. Let us fight again another day.

action.39.desc.ketlings.zh: 好吧。没有赢家，也没有胜利者。只有失去的生命，和残骸……
action.39.desc.ketlings.en: Very well. No winner, no victor. Only lost lives, lost scrap...

action.39.desc.kk.zh: 我们不会再继续向你要求什么了，但我们恳求你，请考虑一下我们的智慧，再想想如果忽略了我们的智慧会有何等的后果。
action.39.desc.kk.en: We cannot demand anything further of you, but we implore you, consider our wisdom and what may happen if you ignore it.

action.39.desc.mf.zh: 由于双方都无心进一步索取，我们希望创伤的治愈过程能够缩短。请不要因既成事实而对[This.GetSpeciesName]心存憎恨。
action.39.desc.mf.en: With no further demands on either side, we hope that the healing process can be shortened. Do not resent the [This.GetSpeciesName] for what has been done.

action.39.desc.mi.zh: 你们活该被碾碎，但这并不值得我们浪费宝贵的时间。看来议和是无法避免的了。
action.39.desc.mi.en: You deserve to be utterly crushed, but you do not deserve our valuable time. Peace seems unavoidable after all.

action.39.desc.pt.zh: 帝国恢复正常，和平的历史继续进展，这对我们各自都有好处。
action.39.desc.pt.en: A return to the normal state of things and resumption of peacetime activities would be best for all parties.

action.39.desc.rc.zh: 我们同意以当前边界为标准终止这次冲突。
action.39.desc.rc.en: We will agree to end this conflict as the borders currently stand.

action.39.desc.sd.zh: 懒惰的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，就算拿来当苦力也没什么用。看来议和是最好的选项了。
action.39.desc.sd.en: Lazy [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wouldn't be any good to us even as slaves. Peace might be the best option after all.

action.39.desc.ss.zh: 如果双方再互相攻击，就会造成无法调节的失衡。若签订和平条约，则可保持精神上的长久均衡。
action.39.desc.ss.en: If you would try to further take from us, or we from you, an imbalance would be created that cannot be corrected. A peace deal ensures continued spiritual equilibrium.

action.39.desc.xi.zh: 尽管我们不愿意看到你们逃脱了惩罚，但我们同样也希望你们这些卑鄙的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]至少明白不要干涉我们的事务。
action.39.desc.xi.en: As much as we hate to see you escape unpunished, we hope you miserable [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] have at least learned to stay out of our business.

action.39.message.zh: 我们与[From.GetName]签署了无条件和平协议！
action.39.message.en: We have signed a white peace in the war against the [From.GetName]

action.39.name.zh: 与[From.GetName]通过维持现状结束战争

action.41.desc.a.zh: 当你把舰队派往敌方新的领土内时，[From.GetName]战争就发生了。
action.41.desc.a.en: The [From.GetName] began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.

action.41.desc.b.zh: [From.GetNumPlayerFleetsGoneMIA]舰队在任务中失踪，他们会在友军领地内重新集合。
action.41.desc.b.en: [From.GetNumPlayerFleetsGoneMIA] fleets have gone Missing In Action so that they can regroup inside friendly territory.

action.41.desc.b.1.zh: 一支舰队在任务中失踪，他们会在友军领地内重新集合。
action.41.desc.b.1.en: A fleet has gone Missing In Action so that it can regroup inside friendly territory.

action.48.b.zh: 他们在这场试炼中并不够格。
action.48.b.en: They have been judged and found wanting.

action.48.desc.fe_materialist.zh: 城门大破……蛮族已至。万事皆休！
action.48.desc.fe_materialist.en: The gates are smashed... the barbarians have broken through. This is the end!

action.48.desc.fe_spiritualist.zh: 这……这不是预言中的结局。
action.48.desc.fe_spiritualist.en: This... this is not the ending that was foretold.

action.48.desc.fe_xenophile.zh: 哎，你这愚蠢的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。如果你能够悉听我们的教导的话，这样的事情是可以避免的！看看你们都做了什么。
action.48.desc.fe_xenophile.en: Oh, you foolish, foolish [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This could have been avoided if only you had allowed us to guide you! Now look what you have done.

action.48.desc.fe_xenophobe.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们想要我们卑躬屈膝？还是想要我们求饶？

别做梦了！

有本事你就滚过来，你个肮脏的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]！我会用这块锋利的瓦砾刺穿你！
action.48.desc.fe_xenophobe.en:
Do you want us to grovel, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Beg, perhaps?

NEVER!

Come here if you dare, you vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]! I will impale you on this jagged piece of rubble!

action.48.desc.gal_emperor.en: Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

action.48.desc.generic.1.zh: 大势已去。我们……我们提出无条件投降。
action.48.desc.generic.1.en: All is lost. We... we offer our unconditional surrender.

action.48.desc.generic.2.zh: 求你们召回舰队吧！我们已经向你们投降了！
action.48.desc.generic.2.en: Please, call off your fleets! You have our surrender!

action.48.desc.generic.3.zh: 我们所创的丰功伟绩……所建的一切……全都毁于一旦了。
action.48.desc.generic.3.en: All we have accomplished... everything we have built... gone.

action.48.desc.hive.1.zh: 我们……我们会死的。你杀死了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]。我们……我们不想……死……
action.48.desc.hive.1.en: We... we are dying. You have killed the [from.GetGestaltEntityName]. We... do not want... to die...

action.48.desc.hive.2.zh: 我们所积累的知识、经验……思想……我们所见的一切。这些都会在数秒钟之内瓦解，而你什么都不知道。你根本不懂。
action.48.desc.hive.2.en: The knowledge contained within us, the experiences... the thoughts... the things we have seen. It will all be gone in a few seconds, and you have no idea. You have no idea.

action.48.desc.hive.3.zh: 没有了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]，我们动弹不得。没有了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]……就……就没有了一切……
action.48.desc.hive.3.en: Without the [from.GetGestaltEntityName], we cannot function. Without the [from.GetGestaltEntityName]... there... there is nothing...

action.48.desc.machine.1.zh: 次优解算结果！次优解算结果！次——优——解——……滋滋……
action.48.desc.machine.1.en: Suboptimal outcome! Suboptimal outcome! Suuuuboooptiiimaa... bzzt...

action.48.desc.machine.2.zh:
清空全部数据库。过载核心能源中心。自毁程序已启动。

祝安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
action.48.desc.machine.2.en:
Purging all databanks. Overloading central power hubs. Self-destruct sequence initiated.

Have a nice day, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

action.48.desc.machine.3.zh:
尝试重建无人机链接……
尝试失败。 程序变更……
尝试重建舰队单位链接……
尝试失败。 程序变更……
尝试重建行星控制中心链接……
尝试失败。 程序变更……
action.48.desc.machine.3.en:
Attempting to reestablish connection with drones......
FAILED. Rerouting...
Attempting to reestablish connection with fleet units.....
FAILED. Rerouting...
Attempting to reestablish connection with planetary control hubs......
FAILED. Rerouting...

action.48.desc.materialist.1.zh: 在这情况下继续抵抗……就太不理智了。我们向你们全面投降。
action.48.desc.materialist.1.en: Continued resistance at this point would be... irrational. You have our total surrender.

action.48.desc.materialist.2.zh: 我们会与你们的占领部队配合，以期顺利……解散我们现在的政府。
action.48.desc.materialist.2.en: We will cooperate with your occupation forces as they see to the... dismantlement of our current government.

action.48.desc.materialist.3.zh: 我们才刚刚要解开星系奥秘的面纱。我们还有很多想知道的……
action.48.desc.materialist.3.en: We were only beginning to unlock the mysteries of the galaxy. There was so much more to learn...

action.48.desc.megacorp.1.zh: 您将会在一小时之内在您的办公桌上看到董事会的集体辞呈……
action.48.desc.megacorp.1.en: You will have the resignations of all Board members on your desk within the hour...

action.48.desc.megacorp.2.zh: 依据我们投降书的细节，我们将会尽快开始……我们公司的破产清算。
action.48.desc.megacorp.2.en: As per the details of our surrender, we shall begin the... the liquidation process of our company in a prompt manner.

action.48.desc.megacorp.3.zh: 这不是我在经营蓝图上所描绘的未来……
action.48.desc.megacorp.3.en: This is not the future I had envisaged in our business plan...

action.48.desc.militarist.1.zh: 我们已经下令让所有的剩余部队放下武器。战争结束了……一切也都结束了。
action.48.desc.militarist.1.en: We have instructed all of our remaining forces to lay down their arms. The war is over... everything is.

action.48.desc.militarist.2.zh: 我、我们向你们无条件投降。我们不干了。
action.48.desc.militarist.2.en: You... you have our unconditional surrender. We are standing down.

action.48.desc.militarist.3.zh: 告诉我们的将士们，他们无责于我们的战败。是我……是我无颜面对他们……
action.48.desc.militarist.3.en: Tell our warriors there was no shame in our defeat. I... I cannot face them...

action.48.desc.pacifist.1.zh: 求你了，我们放弃一切抵抗。我们……我们就想重归和平。
action.48.desc.pacifist.1.en: Please, we will offer no more resistance. We... we only want peace.

action.48.desc.pacifist.2.zh: 愿整个宇宙宽恕你的罪行。
action.48.desc.pacifist.2.en: May the universe forgive you for your crimes.

action.48.desc.pacifist.3.zh: 我们的抵抗简直是太愚蠢了。无数的生命……无谓地牺牲了。
action.48.desc.pacifist.3.en: It was foolish of us to resist. So many lives lost... all for nothing.

action.48.desc.spiritualist.1.zh: 愿圣灵能原谅你的罪孽……但我们决不能原谅！
action.48.desc.spiritualist.1.en: May the spirits forgive you for your sins... we never will.

action.48.desc.spiritualist.2.zh: 我们哪里做错了？我们的信仰还不够坚定吗？我们的祈祷还不够多吗？我……我不明白……
action.48.desc.spiritualist.2.en: Where did we fail? Was our faith lacking? Were the prayers not enough? I... I just don't understand...

action.48.desc.spiritualist.3.zh: 卧薪尝胆，我们将会变得比穷尽你的想象来的还要更强。
action.48.desc.spiritualist.3.en: By striking us down, we shall become more powerful than you could possibly imagine.

action.5.desc_00.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。探测器显示，该新石器时代文明已经掌握了火的使用并发展出了基本的口语，但我们还未发现任何金属冶炼和书面交流的迹象。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_00.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_00_hive.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。探测器显示，处于新石器时代的他们已经可以熟练地用火，并在各蜂巢之间发展出了一套口语系统用以互相交流，但至今未发现任何冶金和书面交流的迹象。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_00_hive.en:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language to communicate between hives, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_01.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们似乎处于青铜器时代晚期，已经掌握了基础的金属加工技术。尽管他们大部分人生活在小村庄里，但还是出现了少数几个大城市。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_01.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, several large city-states have formed.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_01_hive.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。他们似乎处于青铜器时代晚期，已经掌握了基础的金属加工技术。尽管他们大部分人生活在小聚落里，但少数几个大型蜂巢集体业已形成。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_01_hive.en:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, multiple larger hive collectives have formed.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_02.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们已经进入了相当于铁器时代的阶段，并分化成了无数的零碎的王国和帝国。他们的物种遍布整个[primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]的地表。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_02.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They have advanced into the equivalent of an Iron Age and are divided into numerous petty kingdoms and empires. Their species has spread across almost the entire surface of the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon].

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_02_hive.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。他们已经发展到了相当于铁器时代的水平，分裂成了许多小型蜂巢及一些大型簇集。该物种已经遍布几乎整个[primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]的表面。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_02_hive.en:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They have advanced into the equivalent of an Iron Age and are divided into many minor hives as well as a few larger clusters. Their species has spread across almost the entire surface of the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon].

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_03.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们目前可视为处于中世纪晚期时代，不仅充分掌握了冶金学，还建立了一个封建社会。印刷机的出现加速了知识的传播。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_03.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They are presently in what could be considered a Late Medieval Age, with a firm grasp of metallurgy and a feudal society. The printing press is accelerating the spread of knowledge.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_03_hive.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。他们目前处于相当于中世纪晚期时代，不仅充分掌握了冶金学，还建立了大型的蜂巢社群。印刷术正在各蜂巢思维间加速知识传播、增进相互理解。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_03_hive.en:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They are presently in what could be considered a Late Medieval Age, with a firm grasp of metallurgy and larger hive communities. The printing press is accelerating the spread of knowledge and understanding between the minds.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_04.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们刚刚脱离中世纪时期，进入了一个相当于文艺复兴的时期。科学知识传播的非常迅速，他们各个稀碎的小王国里，军队都配备其了简陋的火药射击武器。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_04.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They currently seem to be experiencing the equivalent of a Renaissance, having recently left the Medieval Age behind them. Scientific knowledge is spreading rapidly and the armies of their petty kingdoms are equipped with crude gunpowder-based projectile weapons.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.5.desc_05.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们进入了早期蒸汽时代，有证据表明他们已经开始使用以蒸汽机为动力的交通工具和工厂。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.5.desc_05.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They have entered the early Steam Age, and there is clear evidence that they are beginning to make use of both vehicles and early factories powered by steam engines.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.6.desc_01.zh: 我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了前太空时代外星文明。他们进入了早期工业时代，电力和内燃机正在逐渐被推广使用。我们应该在上空建立一个观测站，以便进一步研究他们。
action.6.desc_01.en:
We have detected the presence of a pre-space civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They are in an early Industrial Age, with electricity and internal combustion engines gradually coming into widespread use.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.6.desc_02.zh: 我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了前太空时代外星文明。他们处于人口十分集中的机器时代，从轨道上可见的大气污染和光污染也证明了这一点。他们已经掌握了飞行技术，工厂也可以大批量生产商品。我们应该在上空建立一个观测站，以便进一步研究他们。
action.6.desc_02.en:
We have detected the presence of a pre-space alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Atmospheric contaminants and light pollution visible from orbit are consistent with a densely populated Machine Age society. They appear to have mastered air travel, and factories are mass-producing goods in their cities.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.6.desc_03.zh: 我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了前太空时代外星文明。有证据表明他们已经可以驾驭原子能，而且多个帝国可能已经拥有核武。突发性自我毁灭事件发生的概率非常之高。我们应该在上空建立一个观测站，以便进一步研究他们。
action.6.desc_03.en:
We have detected the presence of a pre-space alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. There is evidence that they have harnessed the power of the atom, and nuclear weapons may be prolific among their many divided nation states. The possibility of a sudden self-inflicted extinction event is high.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.6.desc_03_hive.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上探测到一个外星格式塔前太空文明的存在。证据表明他们已经驯服了原子能，可能已经有众多的分支蜂巢殖民地拥有核武器。突发性自我毁灭事件发生的概率非常之高。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.6.desc_03_hive.en:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt pre-space alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. There is evidence that they have harnessed the power of the atom, and nuclear weapons may be prolific among their many splintered hive colonies. The possibility of a sudden self-inflicted extinction event is high.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.6.desc_04.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]星系里的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上发现了外星文明。他们似乎处于太空时代的早期，因为许多原始的卫星正在围绕着这颗行星。行星上的诸多势力正在逐步形成一个全球化帝国。他们踏出星球并加入星系共同体只是时间早晚问题。

我们应该在上空建立一个观测站，以便进一步研究他们。
action.6.desc_04.en:
We have detected the presence of an alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They appear to be in the Early Space Age, as evidenced by the many primitive satellites orbiting their homeworld. Their nation states are on the path towards joining together in a global government, and it is likely only a matter of time before they venture beyond their world and join the galactic community.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.6.desc_04_hive.zh:
我们在[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]恒星系的[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]上探测到一个外星格式塔文明的存在。他们似乎处于太空时代的早期，因为目前有许多原始的卫星围绕这颗行星运动。当地的蜂巢思维正在逐步形成一个统一的意识。他们踏出星球并加入星海共同体只是时间早晚问题。

我们应该在其上空建立一个观测站，以便进一步观察研究。
action.6.desc_04_hive.en:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt alien civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. They appear to be in the Early Space Age, as evidenced by the many primitive satellites orbiting their homeworld. Their local hiveminds are in the process of amalgamating into a unified consciousness, and it is likely only a matter of time before they venture beyond their world and join the galactic community.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

action.600.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道轰炸激起了内阁对面临可能要投降的场景时我们该如何应对的讨论。
action.600.desc.en: The Orbital Bombardment of [From.GetName] has sparked our Council to discuss how we should respond in the hypothetical scenario of a surrender.

action.62.desc.zh: 被称为[LastKilledCountryName]的帝国在敌人的进攻之下已经灭亡。这会怎样影响星系的政治环境还有待观察。
action.62.desc.en: The star nation formerly known as the [LastKilledCountryName] has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.

action.63.desc.zh: 远古的先驱帝国[LastKilledCountryName]终于败在了敌人手中。这个曾经伟大的帝国之陨落将产生什么样的后果仍然不得而知。
action.63.desc.en: The ancient precursor state of [LastKilledCountryName] has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.

action.71.desc.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的船员报告称科学专员[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，导致[malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer]彻底无法行动。
action.71.desc.en: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.

action.72.desc.zh: 讽刺的是，因[malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer]对实验室器材维护过分谨慎而臭名昭著的科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，原因是个人机体长期缺乏维护。
action.72.desc.en: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.

action.74.desc.zh: 科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]在长期暴露在高度辐射性的地质样本下后发生了致命故障，因其内部辐射计数器损坏而未能察觉。
action.74.desc.en: Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction after prolonged exposure to a highly radioactive geological sample, due to a faulty internal radiation meter.

action.75.desc.zh: 指挥官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因制造缺陷而发生了致命故障。
action.75.desc.en: Commander [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a terminal malfunction due to a manufacturing error.

action.76.desc.zh: 总督[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障——彻底失灵——原因是在例行维护中安装了损坏的固件。
action.76.desc.en: Governor [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction - "bricking" - following the unfortunate installation of corrupt firmware during routine maintenance.

action.82.desc.zh: 一支[From.From.GetName]的舰队屠杀了[From.GetName]的居民！在一场毫不留情的大规模轨道轰炸后，地表上的所有人口聚集地都被彻底消灭了。[From.GetPlanetMoon]已经变成了一片充满辐射的废土，几乎无法支持生命。
action.82.desc.en: A fleet belonging to the [From.From.GetName] has massacred the population of [From.GetName]! After a massed and unrelenting orbital bombardment campaign, all population centers on the surface have been systematically wiped out, reducing the [From.GetPlanetMoon] to an irradiated wasteland, barely capable of supporting life.

action.83.desc.zh: 我们的军团报告称已完成对[From.GetName]的轰炸。所有人口聚集地都被彻底消灭了。现在充满辐射的[From.GetPlanetMoon]仅能支持极少的生命。
action.83.desc.en: Our forces report that they have concluded the orbital bombardment of [From.GetName]. All population centers have been systematically eradicated, and the irradiated [From.GetPlanetMoon] can now only support minimal life.

action.87.desc.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]的管理控制已落入[new_planet_owner.GetName]手里，因为他们控制了[From.GetStarName]星系的恒星基地。
action.87.desc.en: We have lost administrative control of [From.GetName] to [new_planet_owner.GetName], who controls the Starbase in the [From.GetStarName] system.

action.88.desc.zh: 我们已获得了[From.GetName]的行政控制权，这此前是[former_planet_owner.GetName]的一处据点，如今我们控制了[From.GetStarName]星系的恒星基地。
action.88.desc.en: We have gained administrative control of [From.GetName], formerly a holding of [former_planet_owner.GetName], because we control the Starbase in the [From.GetStarName] system.

action.91.desc.zh: 我们已经重新夺回了对[Root.GetStarName]星系的控制权，在恒星轨道重建了我们的$starbase_outpost$。
action.91.desc.en: We have once again gained control of the [Root.GetStarName] system and rebuilt our $starbase_outpost$ in orbit around the star.

action.92.astral_threads.zh: 在对[From.GetStarName]进行调查时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为$astral_threads$。它在扭曲时空方面的独特性质可以用在若干有趣的用途。
action.92.astral_threads.en: During its survey of [From.GetStarName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed $astral_threads$. Its unique properties in distorting time and space could be put to use in a number of interesting ways.

action.92.dark_matter.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为暗物质。它似乎打破了一些物理法则，具有引发科学革命的潜力。
action.92.dark_matter.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Dark Matter in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. It seemingly defying several natural laws, and could potentially revolutionize the sciences.

action.92.exotic_gases.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为异星天然气。这些气体具有多种潜在用途，包括用于先进能量武器、立场护盾、飞船染料甚至作为消遣性药品使用。
action.92.exotic_gases.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Exotic Gases in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They have various potential applications, including advanced energy-based weaponry, force fields, starship fuel, and even recreational drugs.

action.92.has_tech.zh: 我们拥有相应的科技——要是能够控制该恒星系，就能攫取这份资源。$action.92.generic$
action.92.has_tech.en: We have the technology - if we control this system, we can extract this resource.$action.92.generic$

action.92.living_metal.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为活体金属。其具有通常只能在有机生物形式上才能见到的特性，会自动恢复成被稳定塑造好的形态。
action.92.living_metal.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Living Metal in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. It has characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms, and will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

action.92.no_tech.zh: 虽说我们尚不能提取这种资源，但应该考虑在该星系建立控制，以便日后开发。$action.92.generic$
action.92.no_tech.en: We cannot extract this resource yet, but we could establish control over the system for future exploitation.$action.92.generic$

action.92.rare_crystals.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为稀有水晶。它们在聚焦极光束方面十分有效，同时也是许多先进电子用品的必备材料。
action.92.rare_crystals.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Rare Crystals in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They have properties that help focus laser beams, and are also a critical component in most advanced electronics.

action.92.volatile_motes.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为易爆微粒。这些微粒中蕴含着大量的能量，作为能源、燃料甚至炸药都十分出色。
action.92.volatile_motes.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Volatile Motes in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They contain immense energy, with applications ranging from energy production and fuel to explosives.

action.92.zro.zh: $action.92.zro.common$这是一种来源不明的气溶胶，[Root.Owner.GetIngestedLoc]后可以让拥有天赋的[Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]提升灵能力。$action.92.part3$
action.92.zro.en: $action.92.zro.common$ It is a rare aerosol of unknown origin, and when [Root.Owner.GetIngestedLoc], it enhances the abilities of psionically-gifted [Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural].$action.92.part3$

action.92.zro.mindwarden.zh:
$action.92.zro.common$

这种稀有的气溶胶表现出一种异常的神经侵入效应特性，因此被指定为一类A级管制品。它在开发精神隔离技术方面可能具有价值。$action.92.generic$
action.92.zro.mindwarden.en:
$action.92.zro.common$

The properties of this rare aerosol have been noted to exhibit anomalous neuroinvasive effects, and has therefore been designated as a class alpha controlled substance. It may yet prove valuable in developing mentally insulative technologies.$action.92.generic$

action.942.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系中发现了战略资源：“$sr_zro$”的储备。

这种稀有气溶胶具有多种用途。分析表明，经过处理的样本甚至能影响具有“灵能”特性的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]个体——例如虚境造物——的机能。凭借我们的$tech_mine_zro$技术，只要控制[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系就能实现该资源的开采。$action.92.generic$
action.942.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered deposits of the strategic resource ID: '$sr_zro$' in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

This rare aerosol has many applications. Analysis has shown that processed samples can even affect the functioning of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] units with 'psionic' properties, such as the Shroud-Forged. With our $tech_mine_zro$ technology, we will be capable of extracting this resource if we control the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.$action.92.generic$

action.96.c.zh: 这将使我们的成员切实收益。
action.96.c.en: This may indeed benefit our members.

action.96.desc.zh:
自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该使这种贸易市场合法化，让大家都可从中受益。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
action.96.desc.en:
De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is time to legitimize this commercial forum so that all may benefit.

In the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. We would surely benefit were this hub to fall within [Root.GetAdj] space, so we can choose to promote one of our worlds for this purpose.

action.96.desc.phobe.zh:
遗憾的是，我们一直未能有效地打击与异种社会的违法贸易。同样令人遗憾的是，这一不受外交关系影响而且几乎匿名的贸易市场带来了实实在在的利润。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如能主导此贸易中心的运营，想必一定会比囤积外星货物要有用得多，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
action.96.desc.phobe.en:
It is a regrettable fact that we have consistently failed to quash the illicit trade with the xenos. Equally regrettable is that the economic benefits of a largely anonymous forum for trade decoupled from international relations cannot be denied.

In the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. The economic gains from playing host to such a nexus might well outweigh the burden of harboring alien goods, so we can choose to promote one of our worlds for this purpose.

action.96.name.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的诞生

action.99.desc.zh: 我们对[market_founder_planet.GetName]进行的推广宣传有了收获，而贸易巨头们决定将大部分商业活动集中在[market_founder_planet.GetStarName]星系内！
action.99.desc.en: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!

action_astral_splitting_no_rift_spawning.zh: 我们没有恒星系可供裂分创造新裂隙。
action_astral_splitting_no_rift_spawning.en: There are no valid systems in which we can split open a new Rift.

advanced_logic_from_knights.zh:
[knight.GetIcon][knight.GetNamePlural]现将产出+1£advanced_logic£超然逻辑。
£job_knight_commander£$job_knight_commander$现将产出+2£advanced_logic£超然逻辑。
advanced_logic_from_knights.en:
[knight.GetIcon] [knight.GetNamePlural] will now produce +1 £advanced_logic£ Advanced Logic.
The £job_knight_commander£ $job_knight_commander$ will now produce +2  £advanced_logic£ Advanced Logic.

advisor.1.a.zh: 告诉我所有的内容。（全教程）

advisor.1.b.zh: 给我一些建议。（只有建议）
advisor.1.b.en: I could use some advice. (TIPS ONLY)

advisor.1.desc_01.zh:
您好，总统先生。

我是VIR，一台合成智能原型机。我的工作是为您提供建议和协助，以便更好地在群星间寻求我们的命运。

$advisor.1.desc_filler$
advisor.1.desc_01.en:
Good day, Mr. President.

I am VIR, a prototype synthetic intelligence. My job is to offer advice and assistance as we seek our destiny among the stars.

$advisor.1.desc_filler$

advisor.1.desc_02.zh:
您好，总统女士。

我是VIR，一台合成智能原型机。我的工作是为您提供建议和协助，以便更好地在群星间寻求我们的命运。

$advisor.1.desc_filler$
advisor.1.desc_02.en:
Good day, Madame President.

I am VIR, a prototype synthetic intelligence. My job is to offer advice and assistance as we seek our destiny among the stars.

$advisor.1.desc_filler$

advisor.1.desc_03.zh:
您好，最高委员长。

我是VIR，一台合成智能原型机。我的工作是为您提供建议和协助，以便更好地在群星间寻求我们的命运。

$advisor.1.desc_filler$
advisor.1.desc_03.en:
Good day, High Commissioner.

I am VIR, a prototype synthetic intelligence. My job is to offer advice and assistance as we seek our destiny among the stars.

$advisor.1.desc_filler$

advisor.1.desc_04.zh:
您好，执政官。

我是VIR，一台合成智能原型机，您卑微的仆人。在您引导我们走向伟大的未知世界时，我将为您提供建议和忠告。

$advisor.1.desc_filler$
advisor.1.desc_04.en:
Good day, Executor.

I am VIR, a prototype synthetic intelligence and your humble servant. My role is to provide you with advice and counsel as you lead our empire into the great unknown.

$advisor.1.desc_filler$

advisor.1.desc_06.zh:

advisor.10.desc.en:

Anomalies can be researched by a £scientist£ Scientist, if their skills are up to the task!

Unresearched Anomalies are listed under the Anomalies tab in the Situation Log. Some must be investigated before the £planet£ Planet they were found on can be colonized or utilized.

要殖民这个星球的话，要先拓展我们的边界。

选中£construction_ship£工程船；

£dot_green£右键点击一个调查完毕且含有潜在殖民地的£system£恒星系
£dot_green£选择[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地

$tttt$$ttt$£colonizable£

当宣称拥有了该恒星系后，我们就可以开始殖民流程了。
advisor.15.desc.en:
One of our £science_ship£ Science Ships has just surveyed a world that would make an excellent candidate for our first £colony£ Colony. It is of the same planet class as our homeworld, so our colonists should be quite comfortable there.

Before colonizing this world, we must extend our borders.

With the £construction_ship£ Construction Ship selected;

£dot_green£ Right-click a surveyed £system£ System containing a potential colony
£dot_green£ Select [GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase

$tttt$$ttt$£colonizable£

Once the System is claimed, we can begin the colonization process.

The £colony£ Colony will be a drain on our resources until the first settlement has been completed, so take care not to colonize too many £planet£ Planets at once.

akx.10000.a.zh: 时螶以爱吻我，我当回报以歌。
akx.10000.a.en: Perhaps the Worm loves us, and perhaps we could love the Worm.

akx.10000.b.zh: 这并不安全，但起码我们能了解不少新知识。
akx.10000.b.en: This is not a safe experiment. But we could learn so much.

akx.10000.desc.zh:
确实存在这样一个意识体，它游离于时空之外。希望与绝望的在时空扭曲的迷宫之中相互交织。我们的远祖将其称呼为“圆环”——“时之螶”。我们已经同它相遇，在重力的威严下，时空开始跳出古老而诡秘的舞蹈。它似乎对我们情有独钟。数学上的推演证实了它对我们怀抱着爱意，但我们回报以时之螶的永恒之爱和现存宇宙中的任何一种爱都迥乎不同。

据我们所知，我们或许能够通过欧米伽同调装置来开启一条通道——一扇大门——来让时之螶在我们的家园降临。（时之螶对开端亲睐有加，而我们即是开端者。）这样做会有什么后果？我们尚未找到任何一个能给出准确答案的人。或许我们能敲开永生的天堂？或许我们会被打入无边的地狱？但可以肯定，我们能学到很多东西。
akx.10000.desc.en:
There is a consciousness outside time and beneath space. It is a labyrinthine tangle of desire and desperation. Our remote ancestors knew it as the Loop, the Worm-in-Waiting. We have met it out there, where the void is tormented by gravity. It seems to have taken a personal interest in us. There are mathematical proofs that it loves us, but love to the Worm is not like love to anything that subsists in ordinary space.

With all we have learned, we think that we might be able to use the Omega Alignment to open an access route - an Entry Point - for the Worm to manifest in our home system. (The Worm is fond of beginnings, and this is ours.) What consequences would that have? We have yet to find anyone who's prepared to commit to an answer. Immortality, perhaps, or apocalypse. But we would certainly learn a great deal.

akx.10010.a.zh: 好的，我们会无条件回报它的爱。
akx.10010.a.en: YES. Whatever it requires, we consent.

akx.10010.b.zh: 不，我们的目的是研究它，如果有必要的话必须干掉它。
akx.10010.b.en: NO. We have brought it here to learn and, if need be, defeat it.

akx.10010.desc.zh:
工程已经完工。加速器已经上线。十几个城市的能源被传送过来，以唤醒在欧米伽同调装置中心的伪奇点。空间像风中的布料一般颤抖。[Root.GetStarName]，在这一令人心跳漏慢一拍的时刻，星球暗淡，复而明亮。一个阴影在这中心紧紧缠绕着。时之螶就在那里。它像一个折纸舒展开来。

整个星系，传感器一个接一个地以一个以难以置信的方式被关闭了——时之螶到达时，巨量难以理解的数据被传感器探测到。在家园中，我们的公民们在尖叫，在瑟瑟发抖，他们感觉到它的注意力正在转向我们。它给我们出了一道难以言明的难题——或者说，我们已经开始意识到了，每次我们看到时之螶，这个问题就总在拷问我们。
akx.10010.desc.en:
The Project is complete. The accelerators are online. The power network of a dozen cities is diverted to wake the pseudo-singularity at the heart of the Alignment. Space shudders like wind-wracked cloth. [Root.GetStarName], for a heart-stopping moment, dims, and then brightens. A shadow coils in its heart. The Worm is here. It unfolds like origami.

Across the system, sensors shut down in abject disbelief as the incomprehensible data of its arrival sleets through them. On the homeworld, our subjects scream and cower as they feel its attention turned up on them, and upon us. It presents a wordless question - or rather, we have become aware that this question was always what it was asking us, every time we encountered it.

akx.10020.a.zh: 过去与未来相互交织，唯有爱是永恒之物！
akx.10020.a.en: WHAT WAS SHALL BE WHAT SHALL BE WAS

akx.10020.desc.zh: 时之螶深爱着我们。时之螶一直深爱我们，并因这份爱在过去与未来永远存续。它的爱轻抚而过炽热的母恒星；它的爱也在每一个无限细分的信息流之间呢喃。它的爱摧毁天地，将尘间化为净土；它的爱是唯一的温暖，即使世界只剩下冷日与死寂的凝视。时之螶的爱让我们洞穿宇宙的真谛。在爱的舔舐下，我们终于步上了命中注定的道路。
akx.10020.desc.en: The Worm loves us. It will always love us, and thus it always has. It winds around the hot heart of our home star. It winds around every infinitesimal loop of information. It provokes a shuddering series of cataclysms in the planetary crust of our home, but when our star grows cold, that cataclysm will warm us. We understand so much more. We will always be what we were going to be, wound tight in the love of the Worm.

akx.10021.a.zh: 没人能与我们比肩！或许永远也不会有。
akx.10021.a.en: There are none like us! And perhaps there never will be.

akx.10021.desc.zh: 时之螶像饥饿的捕食者，亦或像被抛弃而怒火中烧的情人般穿越时空边境而来。它就在那里，不管它是什么位面的存在，毫无疑问它正怒火中烧。所幸的是，你收集了不少它化身身上的闪亮碎片以供研究，如同一座宇宙丰碑。其他的帝国会知道我们今天达成了什么样的伟业。
akx.10021.desc.en: The Worm came in through the boundary fences of spacetime like a hungry predator, or a jilted and furious lover. It's still out there, and wherever it is, no doubt it's angry. But you have the incandescent shards of its avatar to hoard and to study, as a cosmic trophy. Other empires will know what you have achieved today.

akx.9000.desc.zh: 一名细心的通讯官识别出了这些模糊的信号，在伽马射线的干扰下，它们从黑洞抵达这里时已经几乎不可识别——这信号虽然微弱，但明显不是自然产生的。这个现象引起了科学家们对其的更多兴趣。
akx.9000.desc.en: An alert communications officer has identified what appears to be a faint signal, almost lost in the gamma-ray flashes from the black hole here - faint, but unmistakably artificial. This raises intriguing possibilities for our scientists.

akx.9001.a.zh: 令人着迷！派遣船只前去那个坐标。
akx.9001.a.en: Fascinating! Send the vessel to those co-ordinates.

akx.9001.b.zh: 这要么是恶作剧，要么是圈套。记录好之后就别管了。
akx.9001.b.en: This is a trick, or a trap. Log it and move on.

akx.9001.b.tooltip.zh: 分析信号时发掘的技术将运用于物理学研究。
akx.9001.b.tooltip.en: The techniques we developed to analyze the Signal will have some applications in Physics research.

akx.9001.desc.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报称该信号破译起来出乎意料的简单……但是他们的团队花了相当长的时间来证实这不是一个恶作剧。它的段落反复重复，与[Root.Owner.GetAdj]语言有一定的关联——听上去是某种诗歌。它们重复着短语引力即欲望以及时间即视野。信号中暗藏了一个黑洞附近的坐标，并在结尾以署名的形式特别献给了我们的科学专员——这名科学专员客观的确认了这个信号在他们出生之前就已经被发射进入宇宙空间里面了。事实上，这个信号可能比我们文明还要古老。
akx.9001.desc.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the signal was unexpectedly easy to decipher... but their team has spent considerable time confirming that it's not a hoax. It is a repeating, half-coherent message in the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] language - something like a poem. It repeats the phrases GRAVITY IS DESIRE and TIME IS SIGHT. It encodes co-ordinates near the black hole.
