And it ends with a dedication by name to the Science Officer - who adds dispassionately that they have confirmed that the signal has been radiating into interstellar space since before their birth. In fact, the signal may predate our civilization.

akx.9001.name.en: The Horizon Signal: GRAVITY IS DESIRE

akx.9005.a.materialist.en: We learn, and we go on.

akx.9005.a.neutral.zh: 我们会铭记他们的牺牲的。

akx.9005.a.spiritualist.zh: 光孕育黑暗，黑暗也笼罩光。

akx.9005.desc.zh:
当[Root.GetName]接近信号所附带的坐标时，他的报告表明周围的空间开始出现涟漪，古怪的引力透镜现象此起彼伏——这些是丰富且重要的数据流。紧接着，通讯信号开始变得失真，我们能做的只有尽可能地排查原因。

然而，科学专员[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]歇斯底里的声音在船只处于越来越诡异的条件下，为整个事件更加蒙上一层恐怖的阴影。船只触发了遇险呼救。[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]大叫到 “虫子！”——或者，也有可能，那个虫子！然后所有通信全部终止了。[Root.GetName]的痕迹彻底消失了——没有进一步的传输信号，没有残骸，坐标附近的空间平静的如同静谧黑夜的大海一样。但是他们传回的数据极大的推动了我们物理学研究。也许他们死得其所。
akx.9005.desc.en:
As the [Root.GetName] approaches the co-ordinates specified by the signal, it begins to report spatial distortions and curious lensing effects - a rich stream of valuable data. Then the transmission becomes distorted. What happens next is analyzed exhaustively.

The excitement in Science Officer [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]'s voice tautens to fear as the ship's hull struggles under increasingly exotic conditions. The ship triggers a distress call. [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] cries out "the worm!" - or, perhaps, the Worm! Then all transmissions end. No trace of the [Root.GetName] is ever found - no further transmissions, no debris, and the space at those co-ordinates is innocuous and utterly free of distortions. But the data they sent back has advanced our Physics research dramatically. Perhaps it was worth their lives.

akx.9006.desc.zh: [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]以不情愿却又如释重负的态度配合着我们的工作。相关人员的认知报告随后表明他们在被无尽的幻象所支配——不存在的迷宫，在无边无际的空间中伴随而来的眩晕，在黑暗中被不断地被呼唤着名字。终于，在一个母星年之后，信号消失了。
akx.9006.desc.en: [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] complies with a mixture of reluctance and relief. Their cognitive report later indicates that they are subject to recurring visions - of impossible labyrinths, the hungry vertigo of interstellar space, and their name called in the dark. Within a homeworld year, the message has ceased.

akx.9006.name.zh: 视界信号： - 讯息结束 -

akx.9010.a.tooltip.en: [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] will arrive at the Exit Point in 30 days.

akx.9010.b.collective.zh: 派遣他过去，但是要在舰船引擎上装上爆炸装置。
akx.9010.b.collective.en: Send them, but rig their ship's drive to detonate.

akx.9010.b.notcollective.zh: 允许他们前往，但是要在舰船引擎装上爆炸装置。
akx.9010.b.notcollective.en: Permit them to go, but rig their ship's drive to detonate.

akx.9010.desc.zh: 在[horizonsignal_system.GetName]星系内的黑洞再一次活跃了起来。和之前一样，一个循环播放的信号在普通空间的边缘不断地闪烁。但是这次不同的是，在这个信号内有一段声音编码。听起来仿佛就是[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]的声音。“已行的将再行”，[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]吟诵着，“将行的终为已行。”然后和第一个信号出现的同一个坐标再次浮现，在[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]失踪的坐标——媒体将之称为“出口点”。接着信号提到了一个新的名字：[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]。
akx.9010.desc.en: The black hole in [horizonsignal_system.GetName] is active again. Once again, a looping signal flickers in the darkness at the edge of normal space. But this time, there's an acoustic message encoded in the signal. It sounds very like [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]'s voice. "What was shall be," [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] intones, "what shall be was." Then the same co-ordinates as the first signal, the co-ordinates where [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] was lost - what the media has christened "the Exit Point." Then they say a name: [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName].

akx.9011.desc.zh:
这一次，船只完全处于自动驾驶。[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]是船上唯一的乘员。当他接近出口点的时候，遥测仪器上充满了令人着迷的数据。又一次，空间产生扭曲，引力产生的巨大涟漪将时空撕开。[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]冷静地读取数据，并对遥测仪器进行调整。监视小组如释重负：所幸这一次我们派遣了一个专家。然而，当有人意识到有事情即将发生的时候，一切为时已晚。

[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]不再理会这些数据：他已经开始预测了。遥测开始和预测出现不一致，但是仅仅持续了几秒钟，就和预测的结果完全一致。当监测小组汇报预言的间隔在不断增加时，[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]惊讶的说道：“我穿过来了。”

“这里一片黑暗，”他们补充到，“这没问题。我们能在黑暗下生活。我还从未想过可以这样。但是当然了，如果螶赐予我们它的爱，我们就可以得到永生——”

就在此刻，信号中断，然后船只从我们的传感器中消失。
akx.9011.desc.en:
This time, the ship is running fully automated. [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] is the only crew-member aboard. As it approaches the Exit Point, the telemetry stream fills up with fascinating data. Once again, space flexes, gravity uncoils. [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] reads off the headline data, echoing the telemetry. They are commendably calm: we've sent a professional. It takes a little while for anyone to realize that something is peculiar about the timing.

[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] is no longer echoing the data: they're predicting it. The telemetry disagrees, but only for a few seconds, until it catches up. The monitoring team is just reporting that the prediction interval is increasing when [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] says, wonderingly: "I'm through."

"It's dark," they add. "That's not a problem. We can live in the dark. I never thought of that. But of course, we can live here forever - if the Worm will only wait - "

At that moment, the signal cuts out, and the ship disappears from our team's sensors.

akx.9012.a.zh: 然而，这事情或许没这么容易结束。
akx.9012.a.en: And yet, this may not be the end.

akx.9012.desc.zh:
这一次，[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]是船上唯一的乘员。船只完全处于自动驾驶……并且它的系统被设置为只要和上一艘船只失踪时候的情况一样就立即爆炸。当他接近出口点的时候，遥测流式仪器瞬间涌现了巨量引人注目的数据。又一次，空间产生扭曲，引力将时空展开。[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]冷静地读取数据，与遥测的结果完全一致。监视小组如释重负：我们派遣了一个专家。可惜，当有人意识到有事情即将发生的时候，一切为时已晚。

[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]现在并不是在报这些数据：他已经开始预测数据了。遥测读数开始和预测值并不符合，但是仅仅持续了几秒钟，就和预测的结果完全一致。正当监测小组汇报称预测间隔不断增加时，传感器探测到了一次能量激增。

船只被引爆了：星空中喷涌而出一团火焰，然后快速的消失在[horizonsignal_system.GetName]的黑暗中。不管我们在那里遭遇了什么，那个存在都会要后悔把我们拖下水了。不过我们将永远无法知道真相了。视界信号再也没有出现。我们的团队或许能在舰船残骸中找到些什么。
akx.9012.desc.en:
This time, [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] is the only crew-member aboard. The ship is running fully automated... and its systems are programmed to detonate the drive once conditions match those immediately prior to the last ship's disappearance. As it approaches the exit point, the telemetry stream fills up with fascinating data. Once again, space flexes, gravity uncoils. [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] reads off the headline data, echoing the telemetry. They are commendably calm: we've sent a professional. It takes a little while for anyone to realize that something is peculiar about the timing.

[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] is no longer echoing the data: They're predicting it. The telemetry disagrees, but only for a few seconds, until it catches up. Our monitoring team is just reporting that the prediction interval is increasing when there is a sudden energy spike.

The drive has detonated: a brief flare of stellar fury, quickly lost in the darkness of [horizonsignal_system.GetName]. Whatever we encountered there, it may regret its interference. We'll never know. The Horizon Signal does not come again. But our team may find something interesting in the ashes of the ship.

akx.9013.desc.zh: [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]以如释重负的态度配合着我们的工作。相关人员的认知报告随后表明他们在被无尽的幻象所支配——不存在的迷宫，在无边无际的空间中伴随而来的眩晕，在黑暗中被不断地被呼唤着名字。然而，在一个母星年之后，一切都停止了。
akx.9013.desc.en: [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] complies with obvious relief. Their cognitive report later indicates that they are subject to visions - of impossible labyrinths, of the hungry vertigo of interstellar space, of their name called in the dark. Within a homeworld year, the message has ceased.

akx.9013.name.zh: 视界信号： - 讯息结束 -

akx.9020.a.zh: 嗯，对方既然这么有礼，那就把[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]派过去吧。

akx.9020.a.tooltip.en: [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName] will arrive at the Exit Point in 30 days.

akx.9020.b.zh: 派遣[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]过去，并且给船只引擎装上爆炸装置。
akx.9020.b.en: Send [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName], with their drive rigged to blow.

akx.9020.c.zh: 整个事件充满邪恶，而且荒诞至极。不予理睬。
akx.9020.c.en: This is sinister, and ridiculous, and sinister. Let it go.

akx.9020.desc.zh:
又一次，来自[horizonsignal_system.GetName]的视界信号被激活了。这次势头更劲。又一次，传输的信息中包含了出口点的坐标。它同时附带了[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]和[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]的私人通信密钥。但是这次不同，这次的信号是一个用古老的编程语言编译的一个文本程序生成的，呃，情诗——这些爱情诗句饱含了对[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]的爱意。

老实说，这些情诗让人瘆得慌。但是事实是，我们的科学家们一致认为，用程序写情诗是很难实现的，而且让一个黑洞发送情诗实在是破天荒的第一次。
akx.9020.desc.en:
Once again, the Horizon Signal in [horizonsignal_system.GetName] is active. It has upped its game. Once again, the transmission includes the Exit Point's co-ordinates. It's signed with the private comm keys of [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] and [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]. But this time, it's a generative text program written in an elderly programming language that creates what appear to be love poems - love poems directed to [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName].

They're honestly not very good love poems. But it is, our scientists agree, quite difficult to generate love poems procedurally, and quite unusual for a black hole to send love poems at all.

akx.9020.name.en: The Horizon Signal: THE TRINE THE QUINE THE TRINE

akx.9021.a.zh: 然而，这事情或许没这么容易结束。
akx.9021.a.en: And yet, this may not be the end.

akx.9021.desc.zh:
“我这次是回不来了，”[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]在出发前的简报中说道，“我知道我回不来的。但我早就预料到这种事会发生。那黑洞的里面的东西已经等了我们很久了——我感觉，早在我出生之前，他们就在等我了。”

再一次，只载有一名人员的飞船接近了出口点。再一次，空间如同沸腾一般扭曲起来。再一次，我们的传感器列阵传回了不可思议的数据。但这一次，[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]却十分沉寂。遥感信号变得断断续续，随后，也归于沉寂。飞船到达了出口点。周围的环境回归了正常。却什么也没发生。

什么也没发生？监测团队气愤地低语着。但飞船却变化了……其实，我们观测的已经是另一艘船了。我们发现的是[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]的飞船，在消失了这么多年之后，现在却从出口点缓缓飘了出来。派出的回收队伍发现飞船完好无损，但是空无一物——乘员都消失了，也没有打斗的痕迹。但却留下了一篇[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]署名的日志，标题为过去即未来。我们的科学家紧张地对其进行了调查。“这不可能。”一位科学家说道。另一位则回应：“但愿真的不可能吧。”

飞船被重新命名为“浪子号”并回归了队伍。不知信号是暂时休眠，还是已经彻底死亡，总之再也没有出现。
akx.9021.desc.en:
"This will be the end of me," [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName] says at the briefing before launch. "I know I won't come back. But I think I always knew this would happen. Whatever is in the hole has been waiting for us for a long long time - I think it's been waiting for me, since before I was born."

Once again, the single-pilot ship approaches the Exit Point. Once again, space boils like a fever. Again, our sensor arrays soak up fascinating data. This time, [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName] is silent. The telemetry becomes intermittent; and then it, too, is silent. The ship has reached the Exit Point. The conditions around it are returning to normal. Nothing has happened.

Nothing? The monitoring team mutter furiously. The ship is different... in fact, it's a different ship. It's [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]'s vessel, lost these years past, drifting now away from the Exit Point. A salvage team finds it pristine and empty - no trace of crew, and no sign of violence. But there's a journal entry in [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]'s name, titled WHAT WAS WILL BE. Our scientists review it nervously. "Impossible," one says. "I hope so," says another.

The ship is renamed the "Foundling" and returned to service. The Signal, dead or sleeping, says nothing at all, ever again.

akx.9021.name.en: The Horizon Signal: Where the End Comes From

akx.9022.a.zh: 然而，这事情或许没这么容易结束。
akx.9022.a.en: And yet, this may not be the end.

akx.9022.desc.zh:
“我这次是回不来了，”他在出发前的简报中说道，“我知道我回不来的。但我早就预料到这种事会发生。那黑洞的里面的东西已经等了我们很久了——我感觉，早在我出生之前，他们就在等我了。”

再一次，只载有一名人员的飞船接近了出口点。再一次，空间如同沸腾一般扭曲起来。再一次，我们的传感器列阵传回了不可思议的数据。但这一次，[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]却十分沉寂。遥感信号变得断断续续……

船只被立马引爆：星空中喷涌而出一团火焰，然后快速的消失在[horizonsignal_system.GetName]的黑暗中。不管我们在那里遭遇了什么，那个存在都会要后悔把我们拖下水了。不过我们将永远无法知道真相了。视界信号再也没有出现。我们的团队或许能在飞船残骸中找到些什么。
akx.9022.desc.en:
"This will be the end of me," they say at the briefing before launch. "I know I won't come back. But I think I always knew this would happen. Whatever is in the hole has been waiting for us for a long, long time - I think it's been waiting for me, since before I was born."

Once again, the single-pilot ship approaches the Exit Point. Once again, space boils like a fever. Again, our sensor arrays soak up fascinating data. This time, [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName] is silent. The telemetry becomes intermittent...

And then the drive detonates: a brief flare of stellar fury, quickly lost in the darkness of the [horizonsignal_system.GetName] system. Whatever we encountered there, it may regret its interference. We'll never know. The Horizon Signal does not come again. But our team may find something interesting in the ashes of the ship.

akx.9023.desc.zh: [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]以如释重负的态度配合着我们的工作。相关人员的认知报告随后表明他们在被无尽的幻象所支配——不存在的迷宫，在无边无际的空间中伴随而来的眩晕，在黑暗中被不断地被呼唤着名字。然而，在一年之后，一切都停止了。
akx.9023.desc.en: [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName] complies with obvious relief. Their cognitive report later indicates that they are subject to recurring visions - of impossible labyrinths, the hungry vertigo of interstellar space, and their name called in the dark. Within a year, the message has ceased.

akx.9023.name.zh: 视界信号： - 讯息结束 -

akx.9095.desc.zh: 我们重现了黑洞周围近似的情况。我们发现我们之前回收的碎片，以一种几乎不可能的方式，在各种状态之间循环——好像时间在过去和未来之间震荡一样。我们可以从中提取一些能源——虽然有人担心这会对本地时空造成糟糕的影响。
akx.9095.desc.en: We've reproduced conditions that approximate those around the black hole. We've found that the fragments we recover cycle between states, in ways that should be impossible - as if time were oscillating. We can derive energy from this - although there are worrying changes to local spacetime.

akx.9095.name.zh: 视界信号：灰烬中的教训
akx.9095.name.en: The Horizon Signal: A Lesson in the Ashes

akx.9100.desc.zh:
考古学家在[Root.GetName]偏远的高原地区发现了一座被遗忘的寺庙——被埋葬了几个世纪，但是最近因为地震而显露出来。，定年技术指出这是一座[Owner.Species.GetHandName]凿出来的前工业时代的遗迹。然而，墙壁上不断循环的标志和放射状的祭坛——一个莫比乌斯环一样的衔尾蛇——我们的早期历史中并没有这样的先例，并且在它的碑文上用了未知的文字体系。一个激动的考古学家认为这个遗迹是某个未知的先驱者物种所遗留下来的。

虽然看似无关，然而地震看起来是和在[horizonsignal_system.GetName]传出最后信息的时候的同一时间发生的。
akx.9100.desc.en:
Archaeologists have found a forgotten temple in the remote highlands of [Root.GetName] - buried for centuries, but recently exposed by an earthquake. Dating techniques suggest it's a pre-industrial relic, [Owner.Species.GetHandName]-hewn from volcanic rock. However, the recurring symbol on the walls and radial altar - a Möbius-looped serpent consuming its own tail - has no obvious precedent in our early history, and the inscriptions use an unknown alphabet. One excitable archaeologist suggests it's a relic left by an unknown precursor species.

In a presumably meaningless coincidence, the quake seems to have occurred at the same time as the final message from the black hole in [horizonsignal_system.GetName].

akx.9100.name.en: The Loop Temple: Signs in the Stone

akx.9100.spiritual.a.zh: 一条道路为我们打开了。
akx.9100.spiritual.a.en: A way has been opened for us.

akx.9101.a.notspiritual.en: Open the Loop Temple to the public.

akx.9101.a.notspiritual.tooltip.zh: 有些东西来自我们的过去，而它们也将成为我们的未来。
akx.9101.a.notspiritual.tooltip.en: Something from our past. What was, will be.

akx.9101.a.spiritual.zh: 将环形神殿改造成朝圣地。
akx.9101.a.spiritual.en: Make the Loop Temple a place of pilgrimage.

akx.9101.a.spiritual.tooltip.zh: 一份来自我们先驱者的智慧。“已行之事，终将再行”。这将增加星球幸福度并产生一些其他效果。
akx.9101.a.spiritual.tooltip.en: A wisdom from the faith of our predecessors. What was, will be. Increases planet happiness, among other things.

akx.9101.b.zh: 仅将环状神殿用于学术研究。
akx.9101.b.en: Reserve the Temple for academic study only.

akx.9101.b.tooltip.zh: 只允许必要的人接触吧。
akx.9101.b.tooltip.en: Let's limit access to those who need it.

akx.9101.c.zh: 感觉有点不对劲。将庙宇彻底封印。
akx.9101.c.en: There is something wrong here. Seal the Temple.

akx.9101.desc.zh:
我们的科学家对地下神殿进行了深入的调查，但是仍然存在一些无法解释的问题。在星状祭坛上的延展线上的屋顶上有一个空洞，我们推测它应该曾被作为日晷使用；但是因为地震造成的严重损毁导致我们无法确定。如果它是在某个重要的时刻建立起来的话，我们可能永远没法确认那个时间。我们在“未知语言系统”方面运气不错。这是一个因年代久远而模糊不清但十分著名的僧侣手抄——用的根本不是外星语言——并且我们已经成功的破译了它。

这个神殿被用于侍奉“时间蠕虫”或者说是时之螶。大多数铭文都充满韵律和诗意，祈祷着时之螶的降临——或者，如果反过来读的话——它的离开。它还有一部分在描述“宇宙的运转”，激动的考古学家发誓这里面引用了先进的场方程——对我们而言这个东西并不新鲜，但是但其被发现于这个古老的神殿这一事件本身就让人印象深刻了。尽管我们还没找到同意该观点并且公开承认的物理学家。

就目前而言，这个神殿没有任何与宇宙的秘密或外星武器相关的迹象。但它黑暗的环境是那么的与众不同，充满着危机感的美，而那些用于侍奉时之螶的诗文则变的时髦起来。它们被制成流行音乐传播；同时它们也被编成合集出版发行。
akx.9101.desc.en:
Our scientists have learned a great deal about the subterranean temple, but some questions remain. A roof aperture - along with the radial altar - suggests it was once a solar calendar, but it's so badly damaged by the earthquake that we can't be certain. If the builders found any particular dates important, we'll never know which ones. We've had better luck with the "unknown alphabet." It's a debased variant of a better-known hieratic script - not an alien language at all - and we've successfully deciphered it.

The temple is dedicated to the "Waiting Worm" or the Worm-in-Waiting. Most of the inscriptions are sonorous, poetic invocations requesting its appearance or - if read in the other direction - its departure. There is also a body of inscriptions describing the "operations of the universe," which our more excitable archaeologist swears contains references to advanced field equations - nothing new to us, but very impressive for a temple of this vintage. We have yet to find a physicist who's prepared to go on record in agreeing that the references are meaningful, though.

The temple holds no cosmic secrets or alien weapons, as far as we can tell, but its dark spaces have a distinctive, menacing beauty - and the poetry of the invocations to the Worm-in-Waiting becomes fashionable. They are set to popular music; they are published in collections.

akx.9101.name.en: The Loop Temple: Time and Stone

akx.9200.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]定位到了一个小体积、只有基本能源供应的物体，仅仅在当地的范围内循环广播着信号。这类物体通常都被作为逃生舱使用，看起来这个就是那些东西之一。它来到这里已经有非常久的时间了。

当工作人员把它打开的时候——谨慎遵守着隔离守则——他们发现了一些古代的遗物，被放在无菌环境舱内保藏着。到此时为止，一切都是正常的。然而，[Root.GetName]的队长表明，他们并没有料到能够寻找到[Root.Owner.GetAdj]词汇已行之事，终将再行；将行之事，必为已行——用那个救生舱乘员的体液涂抹在舱壁上——船员们挖苦的把它称作“信使”。他们添加补充道：信使的物种类别和我们的物种类别上有一些意想不到的相似之处。
akx.9200.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located a small, minimally powered artificial object, broadcasting a looping signal at local range only. These sorts of things usually turn out to be escape pods, and this looks like one of those. It's been out here a long time.

When the crew cracks it open - carefully observing quarantine procedures - they find ancient remains, preserved by the sterile pod environment. So far, not unusual. The captain of the [Root.GetName] indicates, however, that they did not expect to find the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] words WHAT WAS, WILL BE; WHAT WILL BE, WAS daubed on the wall in the bodily fluids of the pod's occupant - who the crew are now wryly referring to as "the Messenger". They add that there are some equally unexpected similarities between the Messenger's species, and our own.

akx.9200.name.zh: 信使：已行之事，终将再行
akx.9200.name.en: The Messenger: WHAT WAS, WILL BE

akx.9201.c.zh: 不允许。并且[researchingscientist.GetName]必须放弃现在的研究。
akx.9201.c.en: No. And [researchingscientist.GetName] must release their existing research.

akx.9201.c.tooltip.zh: 有些事情最好还是不知道的好。
akx.9201.c.tooltip.en: There are some things it's better not to know.

akx.9201.desc.zh: 我们已经确定了那个逃生舱在星系文明的早期是一件在市面贩售的典型仿制品——没有任何的新科技或者其他的特别信息。信使的残骸，相对来说就显得额外引人注目。它明显是[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的先驱或者是变种。我们或许在那里有远亲——或者我们的遗传基因被某个先驱物种进行了实验。[researchingscientist.GetName]要求允许进行更广泛的研究。
akx.9201.desc.en: We've established that the escape pod was a commercially available knockoff typical in the previous phase of galactic civilization - no new technologies or other insights. The remains of the Messenger, however, are another matter. It's unmistakably a predecessor or a variant of the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] species. We may have kin out there - or we were subjected to experiments by a precursor race. [researchingscientist.GetName] is requesting permission to conduct more extensive research.

akx.9210.a.zh: 变相的叛国行为！请立即处决他们，马上。
akx.9210.a.en: A creative form of treason! Execute them, please.

akx.9210.b.zh: 变相的叛国行为！请立即处决他们，马上。销毁所有研究笔记。
akx.9210.b.en: A creative form of treason! Execute them, please. Destroy their notes.

akx.9210.c.zh: 极好的计划！继续进行下去。
akx.9210.c.en: Excellent idea! Get on with it, then.

akx.9210.desc.zh:
[researchingscientist.GetName]重构了信使的物种信息。它比我们虚弱，但是认知能力相比有着显著的提升。目前还需要辨明信使究竟是先有了我们，才有了修改版的信使，还是说信使就是我们的祖先。对于我们来说，想象自己是一个如此贫弱的种族的后裔是一件有点尴尬的事情——但是[researchingscientist.GetName]坚信这个观点。事实上，他认为我们种族认知能力上的落后实在是一种“悲剧”。

这一“充满悲剧的现状”驱使其接受实验性疗法来把自己的生理机能改造成和信使一样。他强调称这将会让自己能更好地进行这个计划。
akx.9210.desc.en:
[researchingscientist.GetName] has reconstructed the Messenger species. It's feebler than ours but has significantly improved cognitive abilities. There needs to be some clarification about whether we were the source species and the Messenger the modified version or whether the Messenger was our predecessor. It is a little embarrassing to imagine that we might have descended from such an effete species - but [researchingscientist.GetName] is firmly of that opinion. Indeed, they consider the loss of cognitive abilities a "tragedy."

Such a tragedy that they have undergone experimental treatments to alter their physiology to that of the Messengers. They insist this will equip them much better to continue the project.

akx.9211.a.zh: 做得太过火了，现在我们必须终结这一切。将扩散控制住。
akx.9211.a.en: This has gone too far. Now we end it. Control the outbreak.

akx.9211.a.tooltip.zh:
所有首都行星的人口将会被转变，但是到此为止了。
他们的外貌、思潮和特质都可能发生明显的转变。
akx.9211.a.tooltip.en:
All pops on the capital planet will be converted, but there it will end.
Their appearance, ethics and traits are likely to undergo significant changes.

akx.9211.b.zh: 控制扩散和发作，并且净化所有被感染的公民。
akx.9211.b.en: Control the outbreak, and purge all affected citizens.

akx.9211.b.tooltip.zh: 这将会净化所有受感染人口：几乎是[Root.Capital.GetName]上的全部人口。
akx.9211.b.tooltip.en: This will Purge all affected Pops: nearly the entire population of [Root.Capital.GetName].

akx.9211.c.zh: 已行之事，必将再行。我们将已改变。给我来一针病毒吧。
akx.9211.c.en: What was, shall be. We will change. Bring me a sample of the virus.

akx.9211.c.tooltip.zh:
这将会转变我们整个物种。
我们的外貌、思潮和特质都可能发生明显的转变。
akx.9211.c.tooltip.en:
This will transform our entire species.
Our appearance, ethics and traits are likely to undergo significant changes.

akx.9211.desc.zh: [researchingscientist.GetName]现在已经重构了信使物种的起源。他同时还重建了一种强传染性的病毒。这种病毒会在我们的星球中潜伏，一旦感染上我们的首要物种，便会使其陷入蛹样昏迷，并在一天后转变为信使物种。这样的转变，讲道理，让一些人兴奋不已。
akx.9211.desc.en: [researchingscientist.GetName] has now sequenced the origins of the Messenger species. Coincidentally, they have also recreated a highly contagious virus. It stalks our worlds. Under its influence, our primary species falls into a chrysalis coma and emerges a day later as the Messenger species. These transformations are, understandably, causing some excitement.

akx.9220.a.zh: 变相的叛国行为！请立即处决他们，马上。
akx.9220.a.en: A creative form of treason! Execute them, please.

akx.9220.b.zh: 变相的叛国行为！请立即处决他们，马上。销毁所有研究笔记。
akx.9220.b.en: A creative form of treason! Execute them, please. Destroy their notes.

akx.9220.c.zh: 极好的计划！继续进行下去。
akx.9220.c.en: Excellent idea! Get on with it, then.

akx.9220.c.tooltip.zh: 这可能发生显著且难以预料的后果
akx.9220.c.tooltip.en: This may have significant and unpredictable consequences

akx.9220.desc.zh:
[researchingscientist9220.GetName]对信使的基因进行了重组研究。他们的确十分出色，但也令我们的科学家有些担忧。与我们现在的基因相比较，信使明显更为强健，攻击意愿也更高。现在研究人员们众说纷纭，亟待确定信使到底是我们自身的进化版本，还是说他们其实是我们的祖先。[researchingscientist9220.GetName]本人更相信后一种说法——我们本也应当作为强大的战斗物种生活下去，却因为某个先驱文明的干涉而失去了战斗本能。据其认为，失去这种战斗能力乃是我方史上最大的“悲剧”。

有些研究人员甚至为此接受实验性治疗，将自己的体质改造成了信使的特征。他们还坚持认为，这对研究的继续进行具有重大意义。
akx.9220.desc.en:
[researchingscientist9220.GetName] has reconstructed the Messenger. It's, ah, quite impressive - worryingly so. It is considerably more robust and aggressive than our current edition. There needs to be some clarification about whether we were the source species, the Messenger modified version, or whether the Messenger was our predecessor. [researchingscientist9220.GetName] firmly believes that we were once much more of a warrior species and that some meddling precursor muzzled our potential. Indeed, they consider losing our martial abilities a "tragedy."

Such a tragedy that they have undergone experimental treatments to alter their physiology to that of the Messengers. They insist that this will equip them much better to continue the project.

akx.9221.a.zh: 做得太过火了。将扩散控制住。
akx.9221.a.en: This has gone too far. Control the outbreak.

akx.9221.a.tooltip.zh: 所有首都行星的人口将会被转变，但是到此为止了。
akx.9221.a.tooltip.en: All pops on the capital planet will be converted, but there it will end.

akx.9221.b.zh: 控制扩散和发作，并且净化所有被感染的公民。
akx.9221.b.en: Control the outbreak, and purge all affected citizens.

akx.9221.b.tooltip.zh: 这将会净化所有受感染人口——几乎是[Root.Capital.GetName]上的全部人口。
akx.9221.b.tooltip.en: This will purge all affected pops - nearly the entire population of [Root.Capital.GetName].

akx.9221.c.zh: 已行之事，必将再行。给我来一针病毒吧。
akx.9221.c.en: What was, shall be. Circulate a sample of the virus.

akx.9221.c.tooltip.zh: 这将会转变我们整个物种。
akx.9221.c.tooltip.en: This will transform our entire species.

akx.9221.desc.zh: [researchingscientist9220.GetName]现在已经重构了信使物种的起源。他还在没有停下来征询任何人意见的情况下重建了一种强传染性的病毒。这种病毒会在我们的星球中潜伏，一旦感染上我们的首要物种，便会使其陷入蛹样昏迷，并在一天后转变为信使物种。这样的转变，讲道理，让一些人兴奋不已。
akx.9221.desc.en: [researchingscientist9220.GetName] has now sequenced the origins of the Messenger species. Without stopping to ask anyone's opinion, they have also recreated a highly contagious virus. It stalks our worlds. Under its influence, our primary species falls into a chrysalis-coma and emerges a day later as the Messenger species. This is causing - it is fair to say - some excitement.

akx.9300.a.admiralabsent.zh: 嗯。我们确实有这么一位指挥官，不过我得找找。
akx.9300.a.admiralabsent.en: Hm. Our commander of that name is alive, well and elsewhere.

akx.9300.b.zh: 这*一定*是一个陷阱。我们不会给敌人机会。做好战斗准备。
akx.9300.b.en: This *must* be an ambush. We're taking no chances. Battlestations.

akx.9300.desc.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]的“朔望”号……向[Root.GetName]致以问候。尽管“朔望”号没有向我们发送任何可以识别的身份代码，记录在案的船只中也没有哪艘船是这个名字。它的指挥官宣称自己是舰长[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]。
akx.9300.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] is being hailed... by the "Syzygy" of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. This, despite the fact the "Syzygy" isn't sending any ID codes we recognize, and no ship of that name has ever been commissioned. Its commanding officer claims to be Captain [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName].

akx.9310.a.zh: 这究竟是怎么一回事？你真的是[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]？
akx.9310.a.en: What's happening here? Are you really [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]?

akx.9310.a.response.zh:
“我是谁？[Root.GetSpeciesName]，你是不是去年的那一个你？每天都是毁灭，每个未来都是选择。时间是一个迷宫，而不是康庄大道。”

他咧嘴笑了笑。听起来仿佛因为笑伤疤疼了起来。

“向圆环询问吧”
akx.9310.a.response.en:
"Am I? Are you the same [Root.GetSpeciesName] you were last year? Every day is a death. Every future is a choice. Time is a labyrinth, not a road."

A chuckle. It sounds like the chuckle hurts.

"Ask the Loop."

akx.9310.b.zh: 如果你想终结它，那为何还等待？一艘战舰有的是办法自灭。
akx.9310.b.en: If you want to end it, why wait? A warship is full of ways to die.

akx.9310.b.response.zh: “你不记得了么？当然，你还没有——并且你现在也不一定，如果你的选对了的话。圆环需要它的祭品，也需要祭品们这么做。” 一个痛苦的轻笑。“你不会想把圆环视作儿戏的。”
akx.9310.b.response.en: "Don't you remember? Of course, you won't, yet - and you might not, now, not if you do it right. The Loop needs its sacrifices, and it needs them just so." An agonized chuckle. "You don't want to trifle with the Loop."

akx.9310.c.response.zh:
“圆环是始也是终——时之螶 —— 并且，我想，螶就是圆环。这样打比方吧，时间是一个迷宫”—— 船长开始徒然的用手势比划着。
“然后圆环就是沉眠其中的怪物，也是它的造物主……不，我没法解释这个，并且你会马上就知道了。你做得到的，在我的过去。

……武器锁定了么？”
akx.9310.c.response.en:
"The Loop is what came first and what comes next - the Worm-in-Waiting - and, I suppose, the Worm is the Loop. Let's say Time is a labyrinth..." The Captain begins to gesture futilely.
"Then the Loop is its monster. Or its maker... No, I can't explain it, and you'll know more soon. You did, in my past.

"... Weapons locked?"

akx.9310.d.fanaticpacifist.zh: 杀戮不是我们的处世之道。投降吧，我们会帮助你的。
akx.9310.d.fanaticpacifist.en: Killing is not our way. Surrender, and we'll help you.

akx.9310.d.fanaticpacifist.response.zh:
船长犹豫了很久。“朔望”号舰桥上明显的看起来空荡荡的：没有其他的船员。

“这对我来说太晚了，”船长最后说道，“但是你是对的，这不是我们的处世之道。我必须做我该做的事情。”传输信号被切断。

传感器反应显示朔望号的武器全部离线；飞船能源系统也开始断线。很快，它的灯火熄灭了。当我们的打捞小组登船的时候，他们没有发现任何生命迹象，也没有任何关于船长的踪迹。但是最近有人使用过驾驶部分；并且有人修改了安全协议阻止进入核心区。
akx.9310.d.fanaticpacifist.response.en:
The Captain hesitates for a long time. It becomes apparent that the bridge of the "Syzygy" is empty: there are no other crew.

"It's too late for me," the Captain says at last, "but you're right. This is not our way. I'll do what I must." They cut the transmission.

Sensors report that the Syzygy weapons are offline; the ship is powering down. Very soon, it goes dark. When our salvage team boards the ship, they find no living creature, and no sign of the captain. But someone accessed the drive section recently; and someone overrode the safety protocols that prevented entry to the core.

akx.9310.d.notpacifist.zh: 投降吧，不论你做过什么，我们都可以帮助你。
akx.9310.d.notpacifist.en: Surrender. Whatever you've done, we can help you.

akx.9310.d.notpacifist.response.zh: “太晚了，”船长说道，他的表情冷酷决绝没有一丝后悔，然后传输信号被切断了。
akx.9310.d.notpacifist.response.en: "Too late," the Captain says, not without regret, and cuts the transmission.

akx.9310.desc.zh:
出现在屏幕上的舰长明显是[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]，但是却伤痕累累，心神不宁，衰老，就像是[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]的失意版，光滑的面庞被等离子体灼烧过一样，并且比苍老还要老。背景里的舰桥看起来伤痕累累，并且很残旧。但是船长的声音还是很坚定而且洪亮

“终于找到你们了，我等待了很久了，我的惩罚是在和你的战斗中死去。请杀死我，很抱歉。”
akx.9310.desc.en:
The Captain that appears on our screen is clearly [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName], but a scarred, haunted, decrepit, wrecked edition of [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName], face glossy with plasma-burns, and older - much older. The bridge in the background looks just as scarred and just as decrepit. But the Captain's voice is firm and clear.

"FINALLY you're here. I've waited so long. My punishment is to die in battle against you. Please, end me. I'm sorry."

akx.9310.e.zh: 那么，就让我们做个了断吧。

akx.9310.e.materialistic.zh: 好吧，在你……之前：你能否提供任何有帮助的资料？
akx.9310.e.materialistic.en: Before you go: did you learn anything useful?

akx.9310.e.materialistic.response.zh:
船长舒展了脸上的伤口笑了起来。

“真高兴你问到这个事情，正在传输数据。[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]完毕。”
akx.9310.e.materialistic.response.en:
The captain grins a scar-stretched grin.

"I hoped you'd ask that. Sending data now. [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName] out."

akx.9310.e.militarist.zh: 船长。我们会在烈火和荣耀中重逢。
akx.9310.e.militarist.en: Captain. We'll meet in fire, and honor.

akx.9310.e.militarist.response.zh:
船长向我们致意。

“我希望能为我建立一座纪念碑。”

连接被切断了。
akx.9310.e.militarist.response.en:
The Captain salutes.

"I hope there'll be some sort of monument."

The connection cuts out.

akx.9310.e.response.zh:
“[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]完毕。”

船长向我们致敬——做动作时旧伤口在不断地抽搐着——然后关闭了传输。
akx.9310.e.response.en:
"[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName] out."

The captain salutes - wincing as the movement tugs at an old wound - and closes the connection.

akx.9310.e.spiritual.en: We'll remember you in our prayers.

akx.9310.e.spiritual.response.zh:
“我也为你们祈祷。”

船长背诵了二十七个字的洪亮但奇怪的回文祷告，其内容使你的神学家们沉醉其中，然后关闭了信号连接。
akx.9310.e.spiritual.response.en:
"And I have one more prayer for you."

The Captain recites an oddly resonant palindromic prayer of twenty-seven words that will fascinate your theologians, and closes the connection.

akx.9310.name.en: A Rendezvous: the Captain that Was

akx.9319.desc.zh:
在[syzygy_location.GetStarName]内，收到了一个来自于“朔望”号船长的静态雪点信息。在他们身后，舰桥被烟雾环绕。“太晚了，你离开它的时间太久了。圆环从不宽恕。求求——”

信息到此为止。
akx.9319.desc.en:
A static-speckled message comes in from the captain of the "Syzygy", in [syzygy_location.GetStarName]. Behind them, the bridge is wreathed in smoke. "Too late. You left it too long. The Loop won't forgive me. Please -"

The message ends there.

akx.9320.desc.zh: [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]在随后的这几天一直沉默。毕竟被宣判死亡不是一件可以简单放下的事情。所幸不久之后，他的沉默变成了果断，并最终成为笑对危险的豁达。
akx.9320.desc.en: [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName] is silent in the days that follow. It is no small thing to order your own death. But in time, that silence becomes a determination, and an almost reckless confidence.

akx.9320.name.en: A Rendezvous: The Captain that Will Be

akx.9321.b.zh: 已行之事，终将再行；将行之事，必为已行。
akx.9321.b.en: What was, will be; what will be, was.

akx.9321.desc.zh: [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]在随后的这几天一直沉默。毕竟被宣判死亡不是一件可以简单放下的事情。所幸不久之后，他的沉默变成了果断，并最终成为笑对危险的豁达。
akx.9321.desc.en: [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName] is silent in the days that follow. It is no small thing to hear that you are already dead. But in time, that silence becomes a determination, and an almost reckless confidence.

akx.9321.name.en: A Rendezvous: The Captain that Will Be

akx.9330.a.zh: 我们看来是永远也不会知道了。

akx.9330.b.zh: 其实完全是可以确认的。

akx.9330.desc.zh: 在随后几年间，有几起目击报告称指挥官[From.GetName]于[Root.GetAdj]的空间及更远的地方出现过。当一位著名的领袖逝世，这种事情并不罕见；而自朔望相会事件以来，他们已经成为了一种传奇。只是我们无法分辨这类事情的真伪。
akx.9330.desc.en: In the years that follow, there are reported sightings of Commander [From.GetName] across [Root.GetAdj] space and beyond. When a celebrated leader dies, this kind of thing is not unknown, of course; and they had become a kind of legend since the Syzygy Rendezvous. But we can't be sure.

akx.9330.name.en: A Rendezvous: The Day and the Hour

akx.9340.desc.zh:
取证分析认为我们恢复的残骸有着堂而皇之的诡异之处。飞船的所有部位全都是在同一时间建造出来的——使用的技术几乎和我们是同一水平——但是有些部件看起来却相比其他的要古老几百年。已经恢复的一组动力电池比它本来的样子还要好。

此外……两个被分配于该任务的分析师出乎意料的从慢性病中痊愈了——这种慢性病，据说是根本无法治愈的。然而这个队伍却对此事的原因茫然不知。
akx.9340.desc.en:
The forensic analysis of the remnants we've recovered has uncovered oddities. All parts of the ship were constructed at the same time - using techniques that match our own methods of construction - but some components appear to be hundreds of years older than others. A power cell that we've recovered performs much better than it should.

Furthermore... two analysts that were assigned to the project have recovered unexpectedly from chronic health problems - in one case, a possibly terminal condition. The team is at a loss to account for this.

akx.9400.a.zh: 这话好像在哪里听过。尽我们最大的努力镇压。
akx.9400.a.en: This sounds familiar. Suppress it as best we can.

akx.9400.b.zh: 这话好像在哪里听过。尽我们所可能的接近观察。
akx.9400.b.en: This sounds familiar. Observe it as closely as we can.

akx.9400.desc.zh: 我们在[coils_planet.GetName]的观测站汇报称一股边缘化的宗教艺术运动——神之圆环，正在崛起。原始的机械钟被认为是圣物，但是在运行一年之后就会被仪式般的毁掉。星球上的蠕虫状和蛇状物被保护免受损害。时间，神之圆环的祭司称，是一个迷宫。“已行之事，必将再行；将行之事，终为已行。”他们在祈祷中这样吟咏道。
akx.9400.desc.en: Our observation station on [coils_planet.GetName] reports the rise of an unusual minority religious-artistic movement, the Coils of God. Primitive mechanical clocks are considered holy, but ritually destroyed after a year's operation. The worm- and serpent-analogues of the planets are protected from harm. Time, the Coils-priests say, is a labyrinth. "What was, will be; what will be, was" they intone in their prayers.

akx.9410.desc.zh: 我们设法让[coils_planet.GetName]上的当地统治者相信，神之圆环是一个威胁。神之圆环的祭司们被劝阻，被囚禁，或者，遗憾的，被火刑。前超光速文明看来对于如何栽培仇恨和猜忌了然于心：有时这些手段很有用。
akx.9410.desc.en: We've convinced native rulers that the Coils of God cult on [coils_planet.GetName] is a threat. The Coils-priests have been discouraged, imprisoned, or, regrettably, incinerated. Pre-FTL species have access to a deep well of hatred and suspicion: there are times when that's very useful.

akx.9410.name.en: The Coils of God: a Subtle Persecution

akx.9420.desc.zh: 我们已经设法让[coils_planet.GetName]上的当地统治者相信，神之圆环是一个威胁。神之圆环的祭司们被劝阻，被囚禁，或者，遗憾的，被火刑。但是信徒们依旧顽强，我们的观察者表示担忧。认为并称他们只是转入地下活动了。
akx.9420.desc.en: We've convinced native rulers that the Coils of God cult on [coils_planet.GetName] is a threat. The Coils-priests have been discouraged, imprisoned, or, regrettably, incinerated. But the cult is tenacious, and our observers express concerns that it may just have gone underground.

akx.9420.name.en: The Coils of God: Deep Roots

akx.9450.a.zh: 这让人心绪不宁。干涉并制止他们，但是做的巧妙一些。
akx.9450.a.en: This is unsettling. Intervene to shut it down, but subtly.

akx.9450.b.zh: 事态严重了。用武力迫使他们停止，不论代价和风险。
akx.9450.b.en: This is serious. Use force to shut it down, whatever the risks.

akx.9450.c.zh: 令人着迷！派一支队伍去学习仪式 —— 去参加，如果可行的话。
akx.9450.c.en: Fascinating! Send a team to study the rites- to participate, if possible.

akx.9450.d.zh: 原始人干的原始事。继续观察。
akx.9450.d.en: Primitives do primitive things. Continue to observe.

akx.9450.desc.zh: [coils_planet.GetName]上的神之圆环的狂热信徒正在以不寻常的速度激增。在星球的每个城市上都可以找到他们，并且他们创造出了一系列在各行各业由公民主导的仪式。整个种族对此都抱有不合常理的热情。富人编排出精致的圆环舞蹈来进行他们的庆祝。穷人则在他们的门上贴满复杂的圆环标识。甚至连游乐场里的游戏都在颂扬时间的自然之圆。
akx.9450.desc.en: The Coils of God cult on [coils_planet.GetName] has grown with unusual speed. It can be found in every city on the planet, and it's fostering a series of lengthy ceremonies conducted by citizens in every walk of life. The whole species has taken to them with unlikely enthusiasm. The rich adopt elaborate circular dances for their celebrations. The poor daub complex looping sigils on their doors. Even playground games are chants about the circular nature of time.

akx.9450.name.en: The Coils of God: the Labyrinth Ceremonies

akx.9460.a.zh: “圆环永不终止，但非每次都能闭合。”
akx.9460.a.en: "The Loop never ends, but it is not always completed."

akx.9460.b.zh: 干的很好，所有人。解除警备。

akx.9460.desc.zh: 我们的破坏活动瓦解了神之圆环信徒在[coils_planet.GetName]上的仪式。贵族放弃了他们的礼拜。墙上环形涂鸦慢慢褪色。年轻人的重心回到了调情，谋杀和其他有益健康的童年消遣。神之圆环的祭司中有大量的自杀行为。如果这是一个危机，或许已经过去了。
akx.9460.desc.en: Our campaign of subversion has disrupted the Coils of God ceremonies on [coils_planet.GetName]. The nobility abandon their cult. The looping graffiti on walls fades. The young return to playground games about flirtation, murder and other healthy childhood pastimes. There is a rash of suicides among Coils-priests. If there was a crisis, perhaps it is past.

akx.9460.name.en: The Coils of God: Ceremony's End

akx.9465.desc.zh: 我们的破坏活动瓦解了神之圆环信徒在[coils_planet.GetName]上的仪式——但是只是浇灭了祭司们的热情。如今，他们秘密行动，结会于地下的寺庙。贵族们不再跳迷宫一般的舞蹈，但是他们依然佩戴者虫行标记。并且“已行之事，必将再行”的儿歌仍然回响在游乐场上。
akx.9465.desc.en: Our campaign of subversion has disrupted the Coils of God ceremonies on [coils_planet.GetName] - but it only fires the Coils-priests' fervor. They meet in secret, now, in subterranean temples. The nobility no longer dance the labyrinth dances, but they still bear hidden tattoos of the Sign of the Worm. And chants of "what was, shall be" still echo in playgrounds.

akx.9465.name.en: The Coils of God: News from Underground

akx.9470.a.zh: “圆环永不终止，但非每次都能闭合。”
akx.9470.a.en: "The Loop never ends, but it is not always completed."

akx.9470.b.zh: 干的很好，所有人。解除警备。

akx.9470.desc.zh: 我们的特工锋利如刀。他们对每个能找到的圆圈祭司进行绑架或者暗杀。他们用爆药拆除了有着圆环标记的住宅。[coils_planet.GetName]四处充满着谣言说神之圆环亵渎了神明，唤醒了愤怒的上帝。不久以后，在没有借助任何我方的帮助下，本地人彻底地击垮了神之圆环。观察员收到了惊吓；但是如果这是一个危机的话，现在已经被避免了。
akx.9470.desc.en: Our operatives are merciless. They abduct or assassinate every Coils-priest they can find. They set demolition charges on houses bearing the mark of the Loop. [coils_planet.GetName] is alive with rumors that the Coils' blasphemy has aroused the wrath of a greater god. Before long, the natives are beating the Coils-priests to death without any assistance from our operatives. The observation team is horrified; but if there was a crisis, it has been averted.

akx.9470.name.en: The Coils of God: the Blood of Priests

akx.9480.a.tooltip.zh: 一个文明彻底消失，一艘科研船为之陪葬。
akx.9480.a.tooltip.en: A science ship vanishes, and a civilization along with it.

akx.9480.desc.zh:
我们的人种学者着迷于复杂的仪式中。他们猜测仪式中暗含某种隐秘的通讯频道，于是决定对隐写祷文进行重编，并用算法重构仪式。事实上，他们传回的证据已经初步证实了这些——直到通讯被突然中断。事实上，在全球范围内，所有的通讯都戛然而止。来自卫星和地面调查飞行器的报告表明：星球上没有活动迹象。没有任何交通工具在路上行驶，没有任何的居住区存在热岛或者排放。没有生命特征……

最终报告表明，[coils_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]整个星球的全部人口 —— 包括我们的人种学团队——都消失了，随之所有的活动都以一种非暴力的形式刹然而止。食物没吃完就离开了，宠物也没有喂食，住宅被无人管理的火炉点燃。重力异常在开始的时候就被记录了下来。几乎在每条街道，都有着粉刷的环形标识证明。
akx.9480.desc.en:
Our ethnographers are fascinated by the complexity of the ceremonies. They hypothesize secret communication channels, steganographic prayer-encodings, or algorithmic underpinnings to the rituals. In fact, they're returning preliminary evidence of this last when their communications abruptly cease. In fact, all communication seems to have ceased, planet-wide. Reports from satellites and survey craft flyovers confirm: there is no activity on the planet at all. No vehicles moving on the road, no emissions or thermal signatures in population centers. No signs of life...

And here's the final report. The entire [coils_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] population of the planet - including your ethnography team - is absent, with all the business of a sudden but not violent exit. Meals were left unfinished, pets unfed, the occasional house aflame from an unattended stove. Gravitational anomalies were recorded at the assumed time of departure. In almost every street, the looped chalk sigils of the Coils bear witness.

akx.9480.name.en: The Coils of God: Navigating the Labyrinth

akx.9490.desc.zh:
一份来自我们在[coils_planet.GetName]上的观察团队的报告称：神之圆环的仪式停止了。事实上，覆盖全球的活动迹象看起来处于最低记录。汇报表明观察小队正打算用秘密飞行器在低海拔高度穿过居住区探测……

后续报告证实了：星球上没有活动迹象。没有任何交通工具在路上行驶，没有任何的居住区存在热岛或者排放。没有生命特征……

最终报告表明，[coils_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]整个星球的全部人口都消失了，随之所有的活动都以一种非暴力的形式戛然而止：食物没吃完就离开了，宠物也没有喂食，住宅被无人管理的火炉点燃。重力异常在开始的时候就被记录了下来。几乎在每条街道，都有着粉刷的环形标识证明。
akx.9490.desc.en:
A report has come in from our observation team on [coils_planet.GetName]: the ceremonies of the Coils of God have ceased. In fact, activity across the planet seems to be at an all-time low. The report indicates that the team are going to follow up with low-altitude passes in a stealth survey craft over major population centers...

The follow-up report confirms: there is no activity on the planet at all. No vehicles moving on the road, no emissions or thermal signatures in population centers. No signs of life...

And here's the final report. The entire [coils_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] population of the planet is absent, with all the business of a sudden but not violent exit: meals left unfinished, pets unfed, the occasional house fire. Gravitational anomalies were recorded at the assumed time of departure. In almost every street, the looped chalk sigils of the Coils bear witness.

akx.9490.name.en: The Coils of God: Empty Temples

akx.9500.a.zh: 太好了！马上安排修复这些设施。
akx.9500.a.en: Excellent! Make arrangements to restore the facilities.

akx.9500.b.zh: 一切都顺利的有点不真实，还是拆除这些区划吧。
akx.9500.b.en: This is too good to be true. Demolish the districts.

akx.9500.b.tooltip.zh: 这将会降低殖民地的幸福度。
akx.9500.b.tooltip.en: This will cause unhappiness in the colony.

akx.9500.desc.zh: 显然，这不是这颗行星上[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]建立的首个据点。相当数量的设施和城市区划被仔细地封存了起来，只需通过简单的修复，我们就可以让它们重新运作服务于我们殖民地的建设。然而可疑的是，所有的历史记录均已被抹除。我们无法确定这里曾经是走私者的秘密港口，抑或是政治难民的庇护所。
akx.9500.desc.en: It appears this is not the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] settlement on this planet. A number of facilities and districts have been carefully moth-balled and, with a little restoration, will serve our new colony well. But all records have been erased. Possibly this was a smugglers' port, or a haven for political exiles.

akx.9505.c.zh: 我最喜欢这种轰隆隆的声音了。

akx.9505.desc.zh: 我们的工程师在安装好炸药后就立马撤退到了安全距离外。目标场地在爆破之后仅留一地废墟。最终，这些废墟在风霜雨雪的冲刷下也会归于尘土。然而，这些遗迹的骨架会依然矗立着，即使经过几个世纪后依然巍然不动；此外，我们也听到了某些坊间传言，白日的石砾间有阴影撺掇，夜色的映照下有鬼火涌动。我们的殖民者们都识趣地绕开该地点。毕竟这地方可不是什么旅游胜地。
akx.9505.desc.en: Our engineers set charges and retire to a safe distance. The sites are reduced to ruins. Eventually, the ruins will crack and crumble to boulders, pebbles, dust, under the assault of wind, roots, rain. But their shell will endure for centuries yet; and there will be stories, we'll hear, of shadows in the stone by day, blue lights by night. Our colonists will avoid them. They'll attract no visitors.

akx.9510.a.zh: 这些迷信不能被提倡。这些区划可以减少我们很多年的奋斗。
akx.9510.a.en: Discourage this superstition. The districts represent years of effort.

akx.9510.b.zh: 为何要承担风险？它们只是建筑，给我炸了。
akx.9510.b.en: Why take the risk? They're only buildings. Have them demolished.

akx.9510.b.tooltip.zh: 这将会降低殖民地的幸福度。
akx.9510.b.tooltip.en: This will cause unhappiness in the colony.

akx.9510.desc.zh: 我们的殖民者很乐于利用[waiting_world.GetName]上的这些区划。它们能够让殖民地飞速发展。但是人们开始感到不安。传闻这些设施仍然有着使用者，或者是正在运行的安保措施。但是没有任何证据可证明这一点。部分殖民者甚至疑神疑鬼地坚持他们就是“墙壁中的影子”。
akx.9510.desc.en: Our settlers were initially happy to make use of the districts on [waiting_world.GetName]. Their existence jump-started the colony. But now they've grown nervous. There are rumors that the facilities may still have occupants, or active security systems, although no evidence of either has been found. Some colonists insist, enigmatically, that there are "shadows in the walls."

akx.9510.name.en: The Waiting World: Shadows in the Walls

akx.9520.a.zh: 摧毁城市区划。我们早该这么做了。
akx.9520.a.en: Destroy those districts. We should have done it much sooner.

akx.9520.b.zh: 尽我们最大努力调查，对现状进行密切关注。
akx.9520.b.en: Investigate as best we can; keep an eye on the situation.

akx.9520.desc.zh: 从[waiting_world.GetName]传来了有趣的消息，先前我们曾在此地发现遗弃的区划。一份统计发现那里突然多出了很多殖民者。不过这可能只是统计出错，毕竟那些殖民者全都拥有合法的公民身份证，而且没有人汇报发现任何新来的陌生人。肯定是那里的生育率超级高，或者是我们的数据受到了未办件移民的影响。无论如何，那里的人口增长远远超出我们的合理预期。
akx.9520.desc.en: Curious news from [waiting_world.GetName], where we found those abandoned districts. A census shows too many settlers. Records on a new colony are always unreliable, but as far as we can tell, they have authentic citizen IDs - and no one on this world has reported any mysterious strangers. Population growth must have been extraordinarily high, or perhaps our data is affected by unlicensed migration. In any case, the population has increased by more than we might reasonably expect.

akx.9525.a.zh: 摧毁城市区划。我们早该这么做了。
akx.9525.a.en: Destroy those districts. We should have done it much sooner.

akx.9525.b.zh: 真是奇怪！但人口总是多多益善。继续监视并维持现状。
akx.9525.b.en: Peculiar! But we can always use more citizens. Monitor and continue.

akx.9525.desc.zh: 当初发现那些被遗弃的城市区划的[waiting_world.GetName]再次传来新消息。当地殖民者的数量持续攀升，我们最近在记录中发现了很多异常的地方——本不该存在的团体、完全解释不通的日期等等。肯定是某个未知殖民地的居民偷偷迁徙到该地，要么是有殖民者故意破坏记录误导我们。
akx.9525.desc.en: Another update from [waiting_world.GetName], where we found those abandoned facilities. The number of colonists continues to increase, and now we're finding irregularities in the records - groups that shouldn't exist, dates that make no sense. There must be a secret migration from a lost colony or some peculiar sabotage by the colonists.

akx.9525.name.en: The Waiting World: And Still They Come

akx.9530.b.zh: 立即放弃并隔离这个星球。
akx.9530.b.en: Abandon and quarantine the world immediately.

akx.9530.b.tooltip.zh: 这会使该星球被永久弃用。
akx.9530.b.tooltip.en: This will put the planet permanently beyond use.

akx.9530.desc.zh: [waiting_world.GetName]突然发生了全球范围内的通讯中断。尽管之前我们莫名其妙的多了很多人口，然而现在，看起来，那颗星球上面已经没有任何人了。所有人在一夜之间突然蒸发。他们离开了这个世界？亦或是隐藏起来了？还是星球级的种族灭绝？
akx.9530.desc.en: An abrupt and total communications blackout from [waiting_world.GetName]. We somehow had too many people there. Now, it appears, we have no one at all. The entire population has simply vanished overnight. Have they left the world? Gone into hiding? Engaged in planet-wide genocide?

akx.9535.desc.zh:
我们的特遣小队报告称[waiting_world.GetName]确实、的确，空无一人——不仅仅是殖民者，甚至连殖民地的痕迹都被抹除的一干二净。建筑都消失了，卫星和轨道建筑也消失了，大气数据显示没有任何科技文明的印记。在小队的报告中，整个星球好像被重置了一样。

他们同时报告称星系内太阳辐射的波动具备准超新星的特征——伴随着一些 “闪光事件”，大气中的光线似乎是莫名其妙积累然后以五光十色的形式释放在行星表面上。这的确是一份有价值的特殊数据，但这并没有阐明殖民者们的命运。
akx.9535.desc.en:
Our team reports that [waiting_world.GetName] is, indeed, empty - not only of colonists, but of any sign the colony was ever there. The buildings are gone, the satellites and orbital structures are gone, the atmosphere shows none of the footprints of technological civilization. In the words of the team, it's as if the entire planet has been reset.

They also report fluctuations in local solar radiation that are characteristic of pre-supernova stars - and a number of "luminosity events" on the surface where light somehow appears to be accumulated and released by prismatic functions of the atmosphere. This is valuable and peculiar data. But it doesn't clarify the fate of the colonists.

akx.9535.name.en: The Waiting World: the Quality of Light

akx.9540.a.zh: 在这件事进一步扩大之前，立即放弃这个殖民地。
akx.9540.a.en: Abandon the colony immediately, before this spreads any further.

akx.9540.a.tooltip.zh: 这将会让该殖民地独立。
akx.9540.a.tooltip.en: This will grant independence to the colony.

akx.9540.b.zh: 净化掉他们，并且永久隔离该星球
akx.9540.b.en: Purge them, and permanently quarantine the planet.

akx.9540.desc.zh:
[waiting_world.GetName]传来了更多令人诧异的报告——这个星球曾经有过神秘的人口增长。虽然目前的人口数量和我们预期的一致，但是一些信息貌似出现了点问题，或者……或者有什么我们的政府官员也无法解释的信息。报告中，这些人员没有一个存在于我们的初始记录中，最初的每一个殖民者都失踪了。看起来就像是每个居民都被陌生人完整的代替了。

当然，他们都发誓自己是忠诚的[Root.Owner.GetName]的公民。他们都可以从事生产并且显然很健康。在所有的通讯中，他们否认了那些混乱的报告信息，并且他们坚称是我们自己弄错了。
akx.9540.desc.en:
Further unlikely news from [waiting_world.GetName], where the population had been mysteriously increasing. Population numbers are now what we'd expect, but there has been some sort of information sabotage, or... or what, our administrators aren't really sure. None of the individuals on the planet exists in our records. Every original colonist is missing. It's as if they've all been replaced by complete strangers.

As against that, they all swear they're loyal citizens of [Root.Owner.GetName]. They're all productive and apparently sane. In all communications they deny all knowledge of any confusion, and insist there must be a mistake at our end.

akx.9541.a.zh: 抹掉这些记录。再过一百年，就没人会知道我们的所作所为了。
akx.9541.a.en: Erase the records. In a hundred years, no one will know what we did.

akx.9541.b.zh: 告诉所有人这件事。无所谓他们的藐小仇恨，只要保证他们能够感受到恐惧。
akx.9541.b.en: Tell everyone. Let them hate, so long as they fear.

akx.9541.desc.zh: 这或许是一个可怕的罪行。但这或许能将我们国家从某个更加恶劣的存在中拯救出来。[waiting_world.GetName]上的殖民地在我们的火力下化为灰烬。当我们收工的时候，每一个建筑都变成了玻璃石；没有智慧生命体存活的迹象。
akx.9541.desc.en: This may have been a terrible crime. Or it may have preserved our nation from something even worse. The population centers of [waiting_world.GetName] seethe beneath the energies of our weapons. When we are done, every building is glowing rubble; no living sapient remains.

akx.9545.b.zh: 殖民者：殖民者变得奇怪了。

akx.9545.desc.zh: 我们的特遣小队报告称星球上的人们都很正常健康，并显然被这些小题大作的事情弄得手足无措。虽然他们的确有些怪异：比如互无关联但长得一样的人不寻常地多、整个星球的人都对时间毫无概念、星系内太阳辐射波动具备准超新星的特征。同时他们也观测到了一些“闪光事件”，大气中的光线似乎是莫名其妙积累然后以五光十色的形式释放在行星表面上。这虽是一份有价值的特殊数据，但更像是巧合。如果在这个殖民地上曾发生过什么，那么现在都已经成为了秘密。
akx.9545.desc.en: Our team reports that the planet's population is healthy and bewildered by all the fuss. There are some peculiarities, such as an unusual number of strange coincidences, a planet-wide idiosyncrasy where no one has any regard for punctuality, and fluctuations in local solar radiation characteristic of pre-supernova stars. They also observe several "luminosity events" on the surface where light somehow appears to be accumulated and released by prismatic functions of the atmosphere. This is data is as valuable as it is peculiar. But it could be coincidental. If anything has happened to the colonists, it remains a mystery.

akx.9545.name.en: The Waiting World: Everything and Nothing

akx.9600.a.response.zh: 是的；它们是让我们开始运转的存在。你或许会称呼他们为一个“文明”，我们猜测，但是坦率地讲那样称呼有一点炫耀。他们消失了，哦，到现在差不多有一个星际年的四分之一。我们十分抱歉：这是我们的错误。我们可以再创造出近似的他们，借助着圆环的援助，但是我们需要资源。
akx.9600.a.response.en: Yes; the ones that set us in motion. You would call them a "civilization," we suppose, but in candor we have always found that term a little pretentious. They're gone, oh, almost a quarter of a galactic year, now. We are very sorry: we made mistakes. We can recreate them, approximately, with the Loop's assistance, but we do need resources.

akx.9600.b.response.zh: 没错，奇异之环；时间之环，饥饿之环。我们认为它提到了你。或是提到了你们之中的一员。因为你们的数量实在太庞大了。已有之事必再有，作过之事必再作。正如圆环所保证的那样。它能帮助我们找回摘录者，或多或少吧。
akx.9600.b.response.en: Yes. The Strange Loop; the temporal coil, the hungry one. It has mentioned you, we believe. Or one of you. You are very numerous. What was, will be, or so it assures us. It can restore our Brief, more or less.

akx.9600.d.response.zh: 哦，我们能理解，能谅解。你们的时间所剩无几，所以请好好地利用吧。最后，请允许我为你献上最诚挚的告别。
akx.9600.d.response.en: Oh, we understand, we understand. You have so little time left. Spend it well, I suppose. A cordial farewell to you.

akx.9600.desc.zh: 你好，你好，我们欢迎你返回[Root.GetStarName]。哦，你是另外一群，不是么？有着那么多的你。你们和摘录者如此相似，但却又如此的不同。我们请求你慈悲的援助：你有没有足够的资源帮住我们的计划？尽管圆环将会帮助我们，但是实在是研究起来太困难了。正如你所见到的那样，一切都很昂贵。
akx.9600.desc.en: Hello, hello. We welcome you back to [Root.GetStarName]. Oh, you're different ones, aren't you? There are so many of you. So like our Brief, and yet so different. We request your kind assistance: do you have resources for our project? The Loop will assist us, but it's difficult to reach. Expensive, you see.

akx.9600.e.response.zh: 这正是摘录者经常提到的词——“以后”。但是他们口中的以后总是变成了我们的现在。我们真想念他们啊。
akx.9600.e.response.en: That's what my Brief always said. Later. But their Later was always our Now. How we do miss them.

akx.9610.b.response.zh: 我就知道你们搞不定；你们本应早就准备好的。说起来自从委托发布过去多久了，已经有百万分之一星际年了吧？真是傻得可爱。祝你们好运。
akx.9610.b.response.en: Of course not; you would hardly have been able to gather all that already. You've been out here what, one-millionth of a galactic year? Adorable. We wish you the best.

akx.9610.c.response.zh: 摘录者经常提到这个词——“以后”。但是他们口中的以后总是变成了我们的现在。我们真想念他们啊。
akx.9610.c.response.en: My Brief used to say that. "Later." But their Later was always our Now. How we do miss them.

akx.9610.desc.zh: 喂？你是哪位？我觉得我应该记得你，但是最近有些头晕。哦，是那个你么？你的太阳还没燃尽吗？对了！你是不是来给我们找回摘录者的物资？
akx.9610.desc.en: Yes? Which were you? We think we might recall you, but there has been so much flickering lately. Oh, is it you? Has your sun not burnt out yet? Oh! You've come to give us what we need to return the Brief?

akx.9620.desc.zh:
高科技球体毫无感激地吸收了所有资源，然后就没有任何通讯回应了。接着她在没有任何预兆的情况下开始向外辐射能量，射出的光线的亮度足以使人受伤，你赶紧撤回。这时黑洞有了反应。周围的空间开始扭曲翻腾，这一切都和视界信号事件所描述的状况十分吻合。高科技球体现在是蓝白色的。突然它开始变亮然后冷却下来，只剩下了一些矿渣。

那个名为摘录者的造主回归了么？恒星系里没有任何智慧生命的痕迹。但是探测器却发现了在黑洞的近地轨道环绕着嗜热生命体，正享受着黑洞发出的辐射。我们的科学专员表示之前黑洞周围并没有此类生物。虽然没有证据显示它们有智力水平，但是没准这些生物是高科技球体造主的远亲后代，或者是造主们的祖先。
akx.9620.desc.en:
The technosphere absorbs the resources without thanks, and without any communication at all. It begins to radiate energy, brightly enough to be dangerous, and you withdraw. The black hole reacts. Space around it writhes and coils, in ways your archives match to the events of the Horizon Signal. The technosphere is blue-white now. Abruptly it flames and cools, and only slag remains.

Have its Brief makers been restored? There is no trace of sapient life in the system. But sensors locate unusual hyperextremophile organisms in low orbit around the black hole, basking in its radiation. The Science Officer is certain they weren't there before. There is no evidence, though, that they're sapient. Perhaps they're some remote descendant of the technosphere's makers. Perhaps they're the makers' ancestors.

align_pre_FTL_country_ethics_tooltip.zh: 他们将会变得与我们相似。

already_hired_trader_official.zh: 我们已经从[enclave_country.GetName]雇佣了一位领袖。
already_hired_trader_official.en: We have already recruited a leader from the [enclave_country.GetName].

ambition.100.a.zh: 我们会做我们必须做的事。
ambition.100.a.en: We will do what we must.

ambition.100.desc.zh:
我们的星系比看起来更脆弱。危险从四面八方逼近：捕食者潜伏于虚空，海盗盘踞在无主恒星系，傲慢和恐惧也在引发着战争。而那些有能力行动的人却常常保持沉默。

而我们不会袖手旁观。这并非宣称统治，而是承诺守护。通过审慎的行动和共同的目标，我们将确保星系拥有值得守护的未来。
ambition.100.desc.en:
Our galaxy is more fragile than it appears. Dangers press in from every direction: predators lurking in the void, pirates in forgotten systems, wars born of pride and fear. And too often, those with the power to act remain silent.

We will not stand idle. This is not a claim of dominance, but a commitment to stewardship. Through measured action and shared purpose, we will ensure the galaxy has a future worth protecting.

ambition.105.a.zh: 我们的存在即是为整个星系服务。
ambition.105.a.en: We live to serve the galaxy.

ambition.105.desc.zh:
统一星系并非仅凭武力或个人意志就能实现。它需要信任、对话，以及承担他人不敢承担的重担的意愿。每一次联盟的建立，每一次危机的化解，都是迈向更具韧性未来的小小一步。

我们寻求的不是统治，而是引领：在他人踉跄时，伸出援手。我们的工作永无止境，也常常不被感谢，但这职责正是我们的使命。我们将共同塑造一个永恒的星系。
ambition.105.desc.en:
Uniting the galaxy will not be achieved through force of arms or singular will alone. It will take trust, dialogue, and the willingness to shoulder burdens no one else dares to bear. Every alliance formed, every crisis defused, is a small step toward a more resilient future.

We seek not to rule, but to lead: to offer a steady hand when others falter. Our work is tireless, and often thankless, but this duty is our purpose. Together, we will shape an enduring galaxy.

ambition.110.a.zh: 它们将成为星系的指路明灯。
ambition.110.a.en: They shall be the galaxy's guiding light.

ambition.110.desc.zh:
在这个充满不确定性的年代，象征的意义重大。星系不仅需要保护，还需要启示。随着威胁的日益大胆和前路的黯淡，我们的计划也逐渐成型：一支由来自已知宇宙各个角落的英杰组成的先锋队，他们将化身我们为之奋斗的理想。

这些圣武士不仅会指挥舰队或协调救援工作。他们必须成为我们共同决心的活生生的证明。他们是英雄，不是某个民族的英雄，而是所有人的英雄。
ambition.110.desc.en:
In times of uncertainty, symbols matter. The galaxy does not only need protection, it needs inspiration. As threats grow bolder and the path ahead darkens, our plan is taking shape: a vanguard of exceptional individuals, drawn from every corner of known space, who will embody the ideals we fight to uphold.

These Paladins would not merely command fleets or coordinate relief efforts. They must be the living testament of our shared resolve. Heroes, not of a single people, but of all.

ambition.115.desc.zh:
星系已经发声，不是出于恐惧，而是出于信任。我们被选为守护者，并被授予了超越普通授权范围的权力。这些非凡的特权，虽然是因必需而生，但并非我们所寻求的荣誉。它们是我们为了一切而接受的重担。

我们不会只为颐指气使行使此等权力，而只为服务。我们将信守誓言，直到威胁不再于繁星之外虎视眈眈，直到和平不再只是战争间隙的代名词。总有一天我们会放弃这些权力。但在那之前，我们将以克制、目的和坚定的决心来运用它们。
ambition.115.desc.en:
The galaxy has spoken, not in fear, but in trust. We have been chosen as Custodian and granted powers that reach beyond the bounds of ordinary mandate. These extraordinary privileges, though born of necessity, are not honors we sought. They are burdens we accept, for the sake of all.

We do not wield this authority to command, but to serve. Until peace is more than a pause between wars, until threats no longer lurk beyond the stars, we will uphold our oath. The time will come to relinquish these powers. But until then, we will wield them with restraint, purpose, and unwavering resolve.

ambition.120.desc.zh:
我们知道这一天终将到来。尽管我们努力团结和提升，但星系现在面临着一场生存的清算。这个敌人不讲仁慈，不讲妥协。它威胁着一切，因此我们必须为一切而战。

我们所建立的每一次联盟，所经历的每一次磨难，都将我们带到了这一刻。我们不凌驾于银河系之上；我们为它而战。对抗毁灭，对抗绝望，我们崛起。不是作为征服者，而是作为守护者。

今天，无论如何，我们都不能退缩。
ambition.120.desc.en:
We knew this day would come. For all our efforts to unify and uplift, the galaxy now faces an existential reckoning. This enemy knows no mercy, no compromise. It threatens all, and so we must stand for all.

Every alliance forged and hardship endured has brought us to this moment. We do not stand above the galaxy; we stand for it. Against annihilation, against despair, we rise. Not as conquerors, but as guardians.

Today, of all days, we must not falter.

ambition.125.a.zh: 没有哪一场外交上的胜利是微不足道的。
ambition.125.a.en: No diplomatic victory is too small.

ambition.125.desc.zh:
新一代的大使们如今正活跃在参议院的殿堂中。他们训练有素，耐心无限，对我们的事业无比忠诚。他们不仅以雄辩，更以真诚来发声，体现了我们对团结与和平的承诺。他们的工作也许不会登上头条，但他们却是缔造持久和平与合作的细致而精密的工匠。

他们的每一句话，每一个姿态，都经过精心校准，旨在强化一个真理：我们不谋求霸权，只求稳定。我们没有什么可隐瞒的，因此，也无所畏惧。
ambition.125.desc.en:
A new generation of ambassadors now walks the halls of the Senate. Carefully trained, endlessly patient, and utterly devoted to our cause, they speak not merely with eloquence, but with sincerity, embodying our commitment to unity and peace. Their work might not command headlines, but they are the minute and precise artisans of lasting peace and cooperation.

Every word, every gesture, calibrated to reinforce one truth: we seek no dominion, only stability. We have nothing to hide, and thus, nothing to fear.

ambition.130.a.en: They shall fan the flame of hope.

ambition.130.desc.zh:
符号并非与生俱来，而是经过精心而审慎的打造。如果我们的英雄要成为希望的灯塔，他们的舰船就必须体现这一角色。它们不仅仅是作战舰船，更必须是引领我们穿越黑暗的灯塔。

白色和金色的船体，闪闪发光的船首雕像，以及兼具优雅与威严的设计。在内部，搭载着我们技术所能提供的最先进设备，不惜一切代价。这些舰船承载的不仅是火力，更是信心。它们是这一愿景的先锋：面对湮灭，团结、强大、坚定不移。
ambition.130.desc.en:
A symbol is not born, it is carefully and deliberately made. If our heroes are to stand as beacons of hope, their ships must reflect that role. No mere combat ships; they must be the beacon that guides us through the dark.

White and gold hulls, gleaming figureheads, and a design both elegant and formidable. Under the hood, the best that our technology can offer, no expense spared. These ships carry not just firepower, but reassurance. They are the vanguard of a vision: unity, strength, and unwavering resolve in the face of oblivion.

ambition.135.a.en: Fear will learn to fear us.

ambition.135.desc.zh:
我们的调查结出了严峻而无可辩驳的果实。从深空观测站、秘密监听站到古老的数据库，种种迹象都表明：有什么东西正在到来。

这不是虚惊一场，也不是被误解的异常。威胁是真实的、迫在眉睫的，其规模之大，超出了常规防御的范畴。我们没有时间犹豫。我们所做的一切准备都必须现在完成。时间已晚，但我们并未毫无准备。让他们来吧。
ambition.135.desc.en:
Our investigations have borne grim, irrefutable fruit. Across deep-space observatories, classified listening posts, and ancient data vaults, the signs align: something is coming.

This is no false alarm, no misinterpreted anomaly. The threat is real, imminent, and of a scale that defies routine defense. We have no time for hesitation. Every preparation we have made must now be completed. The hour is late, but we are not unready. Let them come.

ambition.140.desc.zh:
我们的警惕再次得到了证实。正当星系准备应对一种生存威胁时，我们又发现了另一种威胁的萌芽。它潜伏在视线之外，但证据确凿：危险是真实的，而且正在逼近。

然而这一次，我们并非措手不及。我们将再次掌握主动权，在其积聚全部力量之前发动打击。前方的战斗将是残酷的，但有了出其不意的优势，我们并非毫无准备。让星辰作证：我们不会动摇。现在不会，永远也不会。
ambition.140.desc.en:
Our vigilance has once again been vindicated. Even as the galaxy braces against one existential threat, we have uncovered the stirrings of another. It lurks just out of sight, but the evidence is unmistakable: the danger is real, and it is advancing.

Yet this time, we are not caught unaware. We will seize the initiative again, striking before it can gather its full strength. The battle ahead will be brutal, but with the element of surprise on our side, we do not face it unprepared. Let the stars bear witness: we will not falter. Not now, not ever.

ambition.200.desc.zh:
随着决议的通过，圣武士倡议不再是一个理论构想，而是一个获得官方批准的项目。这标志着各成员国将开始协调努力，制定实现该倡议所需的理论、人员和物资标准。

虽然[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的各个成员国将各自负责招募圣武士，但我们仍需监督开发一系列全新的顶级舰艇供他们使用。
ambition.200.desc.en:
With the passage of the resolution, the Paladin Initiative is no longer a theoretical construct but an officially sanctioned project. This marks the beginning of a coordinated effort across member states to develop the doctrine, personnel, and material standards necessary for its realization.

While members of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] will be handling the recruitment of their Paladins, we must still oversee the development of a new series of top-of-the-line ships for them to use.

ambition.205.desc.zh: 圣武士之舰的研发工作已经完成。它们是优雅与力量的融合，是我们决心的象征。虽然为战争而武装，但它们的目的却是和平，它们承诺：无论何处需求最大，我们都将身处其中。
ambition.205.desc.en: The development of Paladin ships is complete. A fusion of elegance and strength, they stand as symbols of our resolve. Though armed for war, their purpose is peace, and they serve as a promise: that we will be there, wherever the need is greatest.

ambition.210.a.zh: 唯有最高贵者方可踏上侍奉之路。

ambition.210.desc.zh:
我们已经完成了圣武士之舰的组装。它镀金的船体在星光下柔和地闪耀，引擎嗡嗡作响，充满力量。将这样一件艺术品送上战场，似乎近乎犯罪。

现在，我们必须将它托付给一位配得上它的勇士，一位其决心与飞船的力量相媲美，其勇气将指引它驶向无论何种黑暗的核心的勇士。
ambition.210.desc.en:
We have completed the assembly of a Paladin ship. Its gilded hull shines softly in starlight, and its engines hum with power. It seems almost criminal to send such a piece of art into battle.

Now, we must entrust it to a champion worthy of its charge, one whose resolve mirrors the vessel's strength, and whose courage will guide it into the heart of whatever darkness awaits.

ambition.216.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]，我们最近提名的圣武士，在[Root.GetPaladinSubclass]方面表现出了极大的才能。我们可以引导[Root.GetHimHer]转向另一个专业，但这需要付出巨大的努力，不仅要训练他们，还要重塑他们的公众形象以适应新的叙事。
ambition.216.desc.en: [Root.GetName], our recently nominated Paladin, has shown great aptitude as a [Root.GetPaladinSubclass]. We could steer [Root.GetHimHer] towards another specialization, but it would take significant efforts to not only train them but also reshape their public image to fit the new narrative.

ambition.225.desc.zh:
鉴于对星系稳定的直接威胁已被遏制，且其使命已完成，圣武士计划已自然终结。根据其委任条款，该部队将解散。他们的舰艇将被退役，指挥结构将解体。

圣武士们留下的只有在星系危急时刻站出来响应号召、奉献自我的记忆。他们的行动赢得了跨越界限的尊重，他们的解散并非失败的体现，而是成功的象征。和平最终不再需要英雄。
ambition.225.desc.en:
With the immediate threats to galactic stability contained and its mandate fulfilled, the Paladin initiative has reached its natural conclusion. In accordance with the terms of their commission, the unit will stand down. Their vessels will be decommissioned, their command structures dissolved.

The Paladins leave behind only the memory of service rendered in the galaxy's hour of need. Their actions have earned respect across borders, and their disbandment is a reflection not of failure, but of success. Peace, at last, requires no champions.

ambition.230.desc.zh:
鉴于敌对行动不断升级以及对统一军事协调日益增长的需求，圣武士先锋队已被正式置于监管人的指挥之下。尽管他们最初的使命强调独立性和广泛合作，但当前形势要求建立更直接的指挥链。

这一决定并非轻率之举。圣武士仍然是受人尊敬的人物，但他们现在将在我们战略部队的既定等级制度内服役。由于我们比以往任何时候都更需要他们，他们的行动将继续进行，但将作为一支协调部队而非自治特工。任务没有改变。
ambition.230.desc.en:
In light of escalating hostilities and the increasing need for unified military coordination, the Paladin Vanguard has been formally placed under Custodian command. While their original mandate emphasized independence and broad cooperation, present circumstances demand a more direct chain of authority.

This decision was not taken lightly. The Paladins remain respected figures, but they now serve within the established hierarchy of our strategic forces. As we need them more than ever, their operations will continue but as a coordinated force rather than autonomous agents. The mission has not changed.

ambition.235.desc.zh:
随着眼前的危机解除，集中指挥不再被视为必要，圣武士先锋队的行动控制权已恢复其原有框架。监管人的直接监督已经结束，圣武士将再次在星系理事会成员的领导下行动。

这种自主权的恢复重申了我们对透明度和多边信任的承诺。圣武士仍然是团结的象征，而非从属。他们不能为单一势力服务，而应为集体意志服务。
ambition.235.desc.en:
With the immediate crisis abated and centralized command no longer deemed necessary, operational control of the Paladin Vanguard has been returned to its original framework. The Custodian's direct oversight has concluded, and the Paladins will once again act under the members of the Galactic Council.

This restoration of autonomy reaffirms our commitment to transparency and multilateral trust. The Paladins remain a symbol of unity, not subordination. They must serve no single power, but of the collective will.

ambition.325.a.zh: 我们现在可以歇一歇了。

ambition.325.desc.zh:
威胁已经过去。星系曾一度濒临崩溃，如今正处于谨慎复苏的时期。使命已尽，我们迈出了最后一步：已放弃守护者的权力。始于危机的应对，终于信任的行动。

我们建立的联盟，我们树立的榜样。这些将是我们的遗产。选择不统治而领导，不占有而保护，我们秉持了我们的原则。星系目前是安全的，这就足够了。
ambition.325.desc.en:
The threats have passed. The galaxy, once on the brink, now finds itself in a time of cautious renewal. With no mandate left to fulfill, we have taken the final step: the Custodian's powers have been surrendered. What began as a response to crisis has ended as an act of trust.

The alliances we built, the example we've set. These will be our legacy. In choosing to lead without ruling, to protect without possessing, we have upheld our principles. The stars are secure, for now, and that is enough.

ancient_battle_site_desc.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]的扫描显示，在该地区存在大量的有加工痕迹的物品以及零零散散的放射性物质，但从轨道上看不到什么细节。为了了解更多信息，我们需要着陆进行实地调查。
ancient_battle_site_desc.en: Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed an area with packed with refined material and scattered radiologicals, although little is visible from orbit. To find out more we will need to investigate the site on the ground.

ancrel.1.desc.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上存在一座古老的废弃殖民地遗址。从轨道上的观测情况来看，并没有明显的迹象显示发生过灾难导致大量居民丧生或者迫使他们逃离殖民地。如果我们想要找到答案，一场地面调查行动势在必行。
ancrel.1.desc.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains the remains of an ancient, abandoned colony. From orbit there are no obvious signs of disaster which would have killed the inhabitants or compelled them to flee. If we want answers, an expedition to the surface will be required.

ancrel.10.desc.zh:
在一个像是某种实验室的地方，我们定位出了一个小得多的灵能水晶。从记录中我们得知，这些泽珞族人非常沮丧，他们的同侪嘲笑他们的研究，认为他们只是不知廉耻的骗子。他们认为泽珞族不再是虚境中唯一存在的实体，他们整个种族的恐惧和渴求的情绪正在逐渐融合形成一些明晰的智慧实体。

这些实体希图变得更为强大，便开始对合适的泽珞族人的情绪和思维施加潜移默化的影响，逐渐使他们的行为变得极端，并可能最终引发了泽珞族内战。

在水晶中我们发现了又一条信息，标注出泽珞族的核心星球之一的位置。
ancrel.10.desc.en:
A much smaller psionic crystal has been located in some kind of laboratory. The Zroni who recorded their findings within were extremely frustrated: their research had been ridiculed by their peers, and was largely discredited. They believed that the Zroni were no longer the only entities in the Shroud, and that the collective fears and desires of their entire race were coalescing into distinct, sapient entities.

Yearning to grow stronger, these entities had begun to subtly influence the emotions and thoughts of suitable Zroni: slowly causing their behaviors to become more extreme. This may have directly caused the Zroni civil war.

We also discovered a location reference for one of the Zroni's core worlds.

ancrel.10001.desc.zh: 对文物的研究一定程度上促进了我们的部分科研。
ancrel.10001.desc.en: Study of the artifacts has advanced some of our research.

ancrel.10002.desc.zh: 虽然我们正在研究的文物没有给予我们研究上立竿见影的突破，但它们正在加速我们所有领域的科研。
ancrel.10002.desc.en: While the artifacts we are researching have not yielded an immediate breakthrough, they are accelerating research in all fields.

ancrel.10003.desc.zh: 对文物的研究让我们的研究取得了意料之外的突破！
ancrel.10003.desc.en: Study of the artifacts has yielded an unexpected breakthrough!

ancrel.10010.desc.zh: 我们应该把重点放在哪儿？
ancrel.10010.desc.en: What aspect shall we focus on?

ancrel.10030.desc.zh:
无价的文物填满了展览站，带给我们对过往的一瞥，赋予我们对未来的灵感。

今天可谓荣耀。
ancrel.10030.desc.en:
Priceless artifacts fill the Exhibition Stations, bringing the past to the present to inspire the future.

This is a glorious day.

ancrel.10030.phobe.desc.zh:
[From.Owner.GetName]至伟至耀，$mega_art_installation_3$上鳞次栉比的展位均被无价的文物填满。

异种将仰望我们的造业，甚惶甚恐。
ancrel.10030.phobe.desc.en:
The greatness of the [From.Owner.GetName] is such that we can line the Exhibition Stations of our $mega_art_installation_3$ with priceless artifacts.

Let the xenos look upon our works and despair.

ancrel.10040.desc.zh: 我们的科学家开始了一个新的特殊项目，以探索先驱者更深处的秘密。
ancrel.10040.desc.en: Our scientists have begun a special project to study the deeper secrets of the precursors.

ancrel.10050.desc.1.zh:
我们已经设法重现了尤特过去用于预处理其孵化场星球的净化工序。

$ancrel.10050.desc.2$
ancrel.10050.desc.1.en:
We have managed to recreate the cleansing process that the Yuht would use to prepare their hatchery worlds.

$ancrel.10050.desc.2$

ancrel.10050.desc.1.phobe.zh:
尤特有一套可以高效清除其孵化场星球上敌对异种生物的工序。我们已经成功恢复了这一净化工序。

$ancrel.10050.desc.2$
ancrel.10050.desc.1.phobe.en:
The Yuht had efficient processes for removing hostile xeno presences from their hatchery worlds. We have successfully recreated this cleansing process.

$ancrel.10050.desc.2$

ancrel.10100.desc.zh: 尽管在结论上存在着根本性缺陷，沃陶姆在计算机及虚拟世界领域极其先进，能够极大的帮助我们的相关研究。
ancrel.10100.desc.en: Despite the fundamentally flawed conclusions, the Vultaum research into computing and virtual worlds was highly advanced and will dramatically aid our own studies.

ancrel.10100.desc_fm.zh:
沃陶姆在计算机和虚拟世界领域是无可置疑的大师。我们可以使用他们的发现来极大帮助我们在该领域的研究。

然而，他们的结论却引发了我们的忧虑。乍一看来这些结论不仅缺陷重重还毫无意义，但是随着研究的深入，我们认为他们似乎发现了真相的冰山一角。

如果还想要进一步探究，我们将需要更多的时间和资源。
ancrel.10100.desc_fm.en:
The Vultaum were undisputed masters at computing and virtual worlds. We will be able to use their findings to dramatically aid our own research into these fields.

Their conclusions are troubling, however. At first glance they appear to be fundamentally flawed nonsense, but upon deeper inspection they seem to have elements of truth to them.

If we wish to delve deeper, we will require additional time and resources.

ancrel.10100.desc_hive.zh: 沃陶姆痴迷于现实和虚拟世界的概念。他们大多数发现对我们来说都毫无意义，但是至少他们对计算机的研究能够帮助我们。
ancrel.10100.desc_hive.en: The Vultaum obsessed over the concept of reality and of virtual worlds. Most of their findings are useless to us, but at least their research into computing will aid our own.

ancrel.10100.desc_machine.zh: 沃陶姆看上去在研究过程中采纳了一些不合逻辑的概念。他们在计算机以及虚拟世界领域的一些先进之处应该整合进我们的研究进程中。
ancrel.10100.desc_machine.en: The Vultaum appear to have accepted some fundamentally illogical concepts in their research. Their research into computing and virtual worlds had some advances that we shall incorporate into our own processes.

ancrel.10100.option.fm_delve_deeper.zh: 继续深挖，我们一定要学到他们知道的一切。
ancrel.10100.option.fm_delve_deeper.en: Dig deeper. We must know everything they learned.

ancrel.10100.option.fm_enough.zh: 我们会好好利用已学到的知识。
ancrel.10100.option.fm_enough.en: We will put what we have already learned to good use.

ancrel.10110.desc.zh:
看起来，沃陶姆竟然有可能是对的。

我们重复了他们的实验，然后得到了相近的结论。我们有一定可能真的存在于一个虚拟世界中。

我们缺乏足够的信息，无法得知是谁因为什么理由才会创造这样一个世界。但可以肯定的是，没有人会残酷到仅仅因为好玩就创造一个宇宙。

这件事情的影响是深远的，我们现在恭敬的请求您下一步的指示。
ancrel.10110.desc.en:
It seems that the Vultaum may have been correct after all.

We have replicated their experiments and come to similar conclusions. There is a moderate chance that we are, in fact, existing within a simulated world.

We do not have enough data to hypothesize why someone would create such a thing. Surely no one would create a universe as cruel and cold as this one for simple enjoyment.

The implications of this are profound, and we yield to your discretion as to our next steps.

ancrel.10110.option.fm_public.en: The people have the right to know.

ancrel.10110.option.fm_suppress.zh: 令人不安，封锁这个调查的相关信息。

ancrel.10111.desc.zh:
我们遗憾的通知您，领导沃陶姆研究项目的科学家[leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName]并未决定停止研究沃陶姆。

他们留下的笔记开始变得逻辑混乱，直至成为胡言乱语。他们随之决定要“继续研究”，此后不久便自杀了。
ancrel.10111.desc.en:
We regret to inform you that [leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName] did not take the decision to end the research into the Vultaum well.

The notes they left behind drift off into mad ramblings before coming to the decision to 'continue the research', shortly before committing suicide.

ancrel.10112.desc.zh:
报告表明，[leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName]已经饱受领导沃陶姆研究的压力影响。

他们开始能够进行难以置信的逻辑跳跃，使得我们的研究大大受益，但是同时他们也不得不自行用药治疗，以作为高压下的应对机制。
ancrel.10112.desc.en:
Reports indicate that the stress of leading the research into the Vultaum has affected [leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName].

They have begun to make incredible leaps of logic that are greatly aiding our research, but have also begun self-medicating as a coping mechanism.

ancrel.10113.desc.zh: 报告称，[leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName]已经开始能够进行难以想象的逻辑跳跃，这使我们的研究项目受益匪浅。
ancrel.10113.desc.en: Reports indicate that [leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName] has benefited greatly the research project, and has begun to make incredible leaps of logic that are greatly aiding our research.

ancrel.102.desc.zh: 随着科研船靠近[From.Planet.GetName]，一道巨大的，饱经风沙的门显露了出来。到底是谁修了这个大东西，又是为了什么？或许答案就在里面。
ancrel.102.desc.en: As the science ship approaches [From.Planet.GetName], a vast and time-worn door is revealed. Who would have built such a thing, and why? Perhaps the answers are inside.

ancrel.10200.desc.zh: 我们已成功将第一联盟文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对工业科技的见解将极大地帮助我们。
ancrel.10200.desc.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the First League artifacts into our research process. Their insights into industrial research will greatly aid our own.

ancrel.10200.desc.phobe.zh: 第一联盟证明了信赖其他种族是愚蠢的，这只会招致孱弱不堪和自我毁灭。然而，他们的一些先进建筑方法，或许多少能够为我们所用。
ancrel.10200.desc.phobe.en: The First League proves that reliance on other races is folly that leads to weakness and self-destruction. Some of their advanced construction methods may, however, be of possible use.

ancrel.10250.desc.zh: 我们已成功将赛博勒克斯文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对巨型结构工程的见解将极大地帮助我们。
ancrel.10250.desc.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the Cybrex artifacts into our research process. Their insights into megastructure engineering will greatly aid our own.

ancrel.10250.desc.antimachine.zh: 赛博勒克斯的传说证明了我们取缔人工智能的决策是无比明智的。好在他们的某些与巨型结构工程相关的发现可能对我们的事业有所裨益。
ancrel.10250.desc.antimachine.en: The tale of the Cybrex is proof that our decision to outlaw artificial intelligence is a wise one.  Some of their findings related to megastructure engineering have the potential to be beneficial to our cause.

ancrel.103.desc.zh: 打开保险库所带来的问题比它解决的要多得多。放置在里面的是各种各样稀奇古怪的东西，从垃圾到可能来自被遗忘帝国的文物。整理这些物品需要一些时间，但我们确实找到了一些有用的东西。
ancrel.103.desc.en: Opening the vault has raised more questions than it has answered. Contained within is an esoteric collection of items ranging from junk to what are possibly artifacts from a forgotten empire. Sorting through it all took some time, but we did find some useful items.

ancrel.10300.desc.terraform.zh:
通过研究巴奥的资料，我们对行星生命播种及环境改造过程都有了新的认识。

在仔细研究巴奥失去感知能力的变化过程后，我们也了解了诸多关于提升技术的知识，但我们已经掌握这项技术了。
ancrel.10300.desc.terraform.en:
Studying the Baol has given us new insights into the spread of plant life and improved our terraforming processes.

By carefully tracking the changes that the Baol underwent during their loss of sentience we also learned much about the uplifting process, but have already mastered that technology.

ancrel.10300.desc.uplift.zh:
在仔细研究巴奥失去感知能力的变化过程后，我们已经获得了足够的知识以逆转此过程。

我们也同样对行星生命播种及环境改造技术有了新的认识。
ancrel.10300.desc.uplift.en:
By carefully tracking the changes that the Baol underwent during their loss of sentience, we have gained much knowledge on how to reverse that process.

We have also gained new insights into the spread of plant life and improved our terraforming processes.

ancrel.10350.desc.zh: 我们已成功将泽珞族文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对灵能研究的洞见将极大地帮助我们。
ancrel.10350.desc.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the Zroni artifacts into our research process. Their insights into psionic study will greatly aid our own research.

ancrel.104.desc.zh: 这场灾难几乎是彻底的，但仍有一些零散的记录保存了下来。似乎[From.Planet.GetName]的人们因为外星人正在观察他们的想法而感到困扰。不明飞行物出现、动物残害和绑架的频繁报道，使得这颗星球陷入了疯狂。作为他们对观察的回应，无数的资源被投入到巨型的探测阵列、反宇宙飞船防御系统和地下庇护所上，以保护人民。
ancrel.104.desc.en: The devastation is almost total, but a few scattered records have survived. It seems that the people of [From.Planet.GetName] were obsessed with the idea that aliens were observing them. Frequent reports of Unidentified Flying Objects, animal mutilation, and abductions drove the planet into a frenzy. In reaction countless resources were poured into vast detection arrays, anti-spacecraft defenses, and underground shelters to protect the population.

ancrel.105.desc.zh: 从零散的记录中我们拼凑出了更多的细节。随着星球上越来越多的资源被投入到毫无成果的反不明飞行物措施中，他们的经济和社会开始崩溃。很多地区出现了电力不足与粮食短缺的现象，大多数领域的科技发展停滞不前，一股深深的绝望感弥漫在社会各阶层之中。在散乱的信息中我们发现了某种"终极护盾"，这种护盾随着[From.Planet.GetName]上情况局势恶化也变得越来越普及。
ancrel.105.desc.en: More details have been assembled from the scattered records we have recovered. As an ever-increasing percentage of planetary resources were poured into anti-UFO measures without any noticeable success their economy and society began to collapse. Brownouts and food shortages were endemic, most fields of technology stagnated, and a deep sense of hopelessness prevailed at every level of society. Scattered references have been found to some kind of "ultimate shield", which become increasingly common as reports about the general situation on [From.Planet.GetName] get worse.

ancrel.106.desc.zh: 从一座坚固的军事基地发现的残破的数据库中我们得知了[From.Planet.GetName]的悲惨命运。由于经济全面崩盘，他们的反不明飞行物措施完全停摆，[From.Planet.GetName]的统治者们启动了他们的"终极护盾"。然而这并不是一个用以保护[From.Planet.GetName]的护罩，相反它是对人口与基础设施的一次彻底的核毁灭，来确保这两者都不会被外来入侵者占领。他们做出这一决定显然是受到了来自[arc_anomaly_planet.GetName]的“外星人信号”的刺激。
ancrel.106.desc.en: The discovery of a partially preserved databank in a hardened military bunker has revealed the sad fate of [From.Planet.GetName]. Faced with a general economic collapse which would have lead to the end of their anti-UFO measures, the rulers of [From.Planet.GetName] activated their "ultimate shield". However, this was not a shield to protect [From.Planet.GetName], rather it was the complete nuclear annihilation of the population and infrastructure to ensure neither could be taken by alien invaders. This decision was apparently spurred on by the discovery of an "alien signal" coming from [arc_anomaly_planet.GetName].

ancrel.107.aliens1.desc.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上外星信号的源头是一座未知设计的废弃哨站。从其中遗留的文件能够看出，他们的计划并不是要策划一次入侵，而是试图与[arc_site_planet.GetName]建立联系并将其引荐给星系中的其他文明。
ancrel.107.aliens1.desc.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains an abandoned outpost of an unknown design, the source of the alien signal. However, rather than planning an invasion, abandoned files reveal their plan to make contact with [arc_site_planet.GetName] and introduce them to the galactic community.

ancrel.107.aliens2.desc.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上外星信号的源头是一座未知设计的废弃哨站。其中被遗弃的数据库记录着详尽的入侵计划，并打算在入侵[arc_site_planet.GetName]之后利用"苦痛农场"来柔化当地人口的肉质以便于食用。
ancrel.107.aliens2.desc.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains an abandoned outpost of an unknown design, the source of the alien signal.
