ancrel.4054.desc.zh: 考古学家们已重构了[missing_archaeologist.GetName]的改进型扫描仪。穿透雕像的复合材料后，扫描仪检测到了从哨兵核心发出的微弱辐射。为进一步进行调查，有必要剖开其中一个哨兵；在此过程中很可能对其产生破坏。鉴于其中一座雕像已缺失了部分翅膀，我们的考古学家建议从那个开始。
ancrel.4054.desc.en: The archaeologists have reconstructed [missing_archaeologist.GetName]'s modified scanner. Set to pierce deeper within the statues' hybrid composite material it has picked up on weak radiation emanating from their cores. To investigate further it would be necessary to break one of the Sentinels open, very likely destroying it in the process. Since one of the statues has already lost part of its wing our archaeologists recommend starting with that one.

ancrel.4055.desc.other.zh: 这些哨兵苏醒了。工程团队正准备把雕像拆解，突然$ancrel.4055.desc$
ancrel.4055.desc.other.en: The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team were just preparing to disassemble the statues $ancrel.4055.desc$.

ancrel.4055.desc.phobe.zh: 这些哨兵苏醒了。工程团队正准备把哨兵砸烂捣碎，碾成齑粉，突然$ancrel.4055.desc$
ancrel.4055.desc.phobe.en: The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team were just preparing to smash, bash and mash the Sentinels down $ancrel.4055.desc$

ancrel.4056.a.zh: 净化外星人并重新设定这个虚拟世界的用途。
ancrel.4056.a.en: Purge the aliens and repurpose the simulation for our needs.

ancrel.4056.b.zh: 一个虚拟猎场……现在这是我们的娱乐世界了……
ancrel.4056.b.en: A virtual hunting ground... Now that's entertainment...

ancrel.4056.c.zh: 复制这项技术。让这些外星人继续平静地生活吧。
ancrel.4056.c.en: Replicate the technology. Let the aliens live in peace.

ancrel.4056.d.zh: 我们将研究它。开启我们自己的疯狂表演。
ancrel.4056.d.en: The aliens will make excellent lab rats. Commence the freak show.

ancrel.4056.desc.zh:
石盘下的确隐藏着入口。打开后可以进入隧道夹层，隧道本身则通向[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]地壳深处。在那里，这颗行星上某种开智的人型土著生物在一组华丽的仪式性房间内涤净自身，踏上最后的旅程。在他们终将结束的生命的最后，他们抛下自己的肉体，获取永恒的来生，在一处电脑模拟的天堂中以数字形式存在。谁曾想到外星天堂居然可以放进一个还没有护卫舰转向模块大的硬盘里呢？

在某个时间点，全体人口都决定以数字化的形式继续存在，只留下寥寥数人。这些人将思维上传入哨兵当中，守护他们的安息之地直至永远。

这一虚拟模拟或许可以用来鼓舞民众的精神。它看起来一定有某种娱乐价值。
ancrel.4056.desc.en:
The Sentinel was indeed hiding an entryway. It opens on a mezzanine of underground tunnels leading deep into [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]'s crust. There a sapient species of humanoids, native to the planet, prepared for their final journey in a set of beautiful ceremonial chambers. At the end of their mortal existence they abandoned their fleshy bodies for a virtual afterlife within a simulation of paradise contained on a single drive.

At some point the entire population decided to move on to a digitized existence, leaving only a few behind, their minds uploaded to the Sentinels, condemned to guard their resting place forever.

Perhaps this virtual simulation could lift the spirits of the masses. It certainly seems to hold some entertainment value.

ancrel.4057.desc.zh:
我们击败了最后一名哨兵。我们一次精准的攻击炸到了哨兵的腹部，哨兵随即倒地，身体渐渐僵硬，能量核心也随之黯淡。雕像用尽最后的能量颤巍巍地握拳，伸向靠过来的士兵，恳求我们“让他们安息吧”。随后，它的身躯便冰冷下来，眼神变得空洞，面部也放松起来。

在哨兵之下，士兵们发现了一处秘密入口，先前被哨兵的力场所掩盖。对这些哨兵的完整检查发现，其并非是简单的自动化机器人，而是有着完整有机生物的数字化意识。
ancrel.4057.desc.en:
We have defeated the last Sentinel. It collapsed after a well-aimed blast to its abdomen, body solidifying in rigor mortis as its power core dimmed. The statue closed a trembling fist around the nearest soldier and, with its last energy, pleaded for us to "let them rest in peace". Then it froze, eyes empty, face cold.

Below it the soldiers discovered what appears to be a secret entrance, previously hidden by the Sentinel's force field. A thorough examination of the Sentinels has revealed that they are no simple automatons, but contain the digitized spirits of organic beings.

ancrel.4058.desc.zh:
哨兵们被唤醒了。当工程队正打算拆解破损的哨兵时，雕塑轻柔的颤动起来，他们涌动出生命的迹象，身体低鸣，皮肤发光。从核心辐射出来的脉冲使得他们具有着多变性与透明性，显现出一种由数字虚拟构成的节点网络。

在我们做出反应之前，他们便包围了考古学家，并且把我们吊在了一个力场之中。现在他们想要和我们谈谈。
ancrel.4058.desc.en:
The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team was just preparing to disassemble the broken Sentinel when a gentle shiver passed through the statues and they sprung to life, bodies humming and skin glowing. Radiation pulsating from their cores has made them malleable and transparent, revealing a digital grid of limbs.

Before anyone could react they had surrounded the archaeologists and suspended them within a force field. Now they wish to speak with us.

ancrel.4059.a.response.zh: 我们是天堂之门的守护者——守护我们的民众万古不朽。
ancrel.4059.a.response.en: We are guardians of the gates to heaven - keepers of our people's immortality.

ancrel.4059.c.response.zh:
天堂，是的……尽管我怀疑你们的天堂概念与我们主人的是否一致。

她抬起了一个眉毛，暗声窃笑。

我们的主人可是有着精致的品味……
ancrel.4059.c.response.en:
Heaven, yes... Though I doubt your concept of heaven matches that of our masters. 

She raises one eyebrow and snickers.

Our masters are of a refined taste...

ancrel.4059.desc.zh:
那名折翼的哨兵原来也是它们中的一员，这名哨兵说道：

迪瓦纳，请放下他们。我希望从这个监狱里解脱。我已经数不清我们为主人服侍过多少时日了。我们在地上苦守，而他们却在下面享受着天堂！我还活着但却已经死了！他们早已死去却依旧如同活着一般！你仍旧不肯放我离开吗？

迪瓦纳朝她投去憎恶的目光。

埃克西亚，以神之名，团结一心吧。我们所爱的人都在下方安息，我们也承诺过要永远守护他们的来生。这是我们唯一的救赎。

她又把我们举到了空中。

你们对我们没有威胁，[Root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。让我们重归宁静，我们会永远守护这颗行星的。
ancrel.4059.desc.en:
The Sentinel with the broken wing turns to one of its peers and speaks.

Please Divana, set them down. I wish to be freed from this prison. I can no longer count the days we have served our masters, toiling on this earth while they enjoy the heavens below. I am alive but dead, they are dead but alive. Will you not let me go?

Divana looks at her with disgust.

Excelsia, by the gods, keep it together. Our loved ones rest below. Have you forgotten our sin? We made a promise to guard their afterlives eternally. That is our only redemption.

She sizes us up.

You are no threat to us, [Root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Leave us in peace and we will protect this planet eternally.

ancrel.4060.a.zh: 你们得立即腾出这片土地。
ancrel.4060.a.en: You will vacate this land instantly.

ancrel.4060.a.response.zh:
那你就得死。

其他哨兵挥动着他们的武器，但埃克西亚只是微笑，脸上透露着平静。
ancrel.4060.a.response.en:
Then you will die.

The other Sentinels brandish their weapons but Excelsia only smiles, a peaceful look upon her face.

ancrel.4060.b.zh: 我们可以利用你们的保护。

ancrel.4060.desc.zh: 我们不能让你打搅我们所爱之人休息的土地。让他们安息吧，你也永远不必担忧外来的威胁。
ancrel.4060.desc.en: We cannot let you disturb the ground where our loved ones lie. Let them rest in peace and you will never have to worry about outside threats.

ancrel.4061.a.zh: 每个人都有自己的选择……

ancrel.4061.desc.zh:
我们成功复制了“永恒”，并将其改造以适合我们的需要。我们的居民可以在一片虚拟游乐场中实现他们的幻想，没有网络延迟，这已极大地鼓舞了居民的精神，并缩减了对物质材料的需求。

同时，那些人形外星人还继续在原本的“永恒”中生活，用一种略有不同的方法享受着他们的天堂。他们被锁定在一盘永无止境的抽象桌游之中，其核心内容是通过积累欢乐豆来统治星河。很难拿得准他们到底幸不幸福。他们眉头紧蹙，或许这就是外星欢乐的表现方式，又或许不是。
ancrel.4061.desc.en:
We have replicated the Evermore and tailored it to our needs. Living out their fantasies in a virtual playground, without latency, has greatly heightened our inhabitants spirits and lessened their needs for material things.

Meanwhile the humanoid aliens live on in the original Evermore, in a somewhat different take on paradise. They are locked in an abstract never-ending board game centered on galactic domination through the accumulation of legumes. It is impossible to say with certainty if they are happy. Their brows are deeply furrowed in what may, or may not, be an expression of alien joy.

ancrel.4062.desc.zh:
埃克西亚逼近考古学家。

求你，求你快结束我的痛苦。
ancrel.4062.desc.en:
Excelsia approaches the archaeologists.

Please, I beg of you to end my suffering.

ancrel.4063.a.zh: 我们会来取回本应属于我们的东西的。
ancrel.4063.a.en: We will come back for what is rightfully ours.

ancrel.4063.desc.zh: 意想不到的事情发生了。我们失去了[sentinels_planet.GetName]。哨兵们在一阵猛烈的旋风中爆发出能量，朝着我们的安保力量直落而下。我们不可能与不会流血也无需休息的敌人进行一场公平的战斗。
ancrel.4063.desc.en: The unthinkable has happened. We have lost [sentinels_planet.GetName]. The Sentinels descended upon our security forces in an infernal tornado of wings and force-blasts. There is no such thing as a fair fight with a foe that neither bleeds nor sleeps.

ancrel.4064.b.zh: 埋掉它吧。我们终于回家了。
ancrel.4064.b.en: Bury it. We are home at last.

ancrel.4064.desc.zh:
哨兵们已被击倒，[sentinels_planet.GetName]重新回到了我们手中。最后一台自动机器人倒下时，其能量核心逐渐黯淡，它握着颤抖的拳头伸向靠近的士兵，恳请她“让他们安息吧”。随即不再移动，眼神空洞，面色冰冷。

在哨兵之下，士兵们发现了一处秘密入口，先前被哨兵的力场所掩盖。对这些哨兵的完整检查发现，其并非是简单的自动化机器人，而是有着完整有机生物的数字化意识。

不论这里究竟埋藏着何种秘密，这一胜利之日都将被人们长久铭记。
ancrel.4064.desc.en:
The Sentinels have fallen and [sentinels_planet.GetName] is ours again. As the last automaton collapsed, its energy core dimming, it closed a trembling fist around the nearest soldier and pleaded with her to 'let them rest in peace'. Then it froze, eyes empty, face cold.

Below it the soldiers discovered what appears to be a secret entrance, previously hidden by the Sentinel's force field. A thorough examination has revealed that the statues are no simple automatons, but contain the digitized spirits of organic beings.

Regardless of what secrets lie buried below, this triumphant day will not soon be forgotten.

ancrel.4065.desc.zh: 科学专员[missing_archaeologist.GetName]失踪了。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap]最后一次被看到离开营地是在日落时分，[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]希望找到安静的地点考虑哨兵问题。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]在消失前的几天，出于事故数量的不断增加，提出了关于营地安全的担忧，我们担心[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]也许已经抛下了[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的任务，以示抗议。
ancrel.4065.desc.en: Science Officer [missing_archaeologist.GetName] has gone missing. [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap] [missing_archaeologist.GetWasWere] last seen leaving the camp at sunset to find a tranquil spot to consider the Sentinels. In the days leading up to [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] disappearance [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] raised concerns about the safety at camp following a growing number of accidents and we fear that [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] may have abandoned [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] mission in protest.

ancrel.4066.b.zh: 我们不会在逃兵身上浪费时间。
ancrel.4066.b.en: We are not wasting time on deserters.

ancrel.4066.c.zh: 分派我们的一些考古学家进行研究。
ancrel.4066.c.en: Divert some of our archaeologists to the search.

ancrel.4066.desc.zh:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]的个人物品，包括[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的意念集中仪——一种用来将思维与外部干扰隔绝的仪器——被发现在一处能俯瞰哨兵的边沿上。雕像旁边用木棍画出来的半完工草图，暗示[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]或许离开[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的工作岗位是为了标记其位置。

[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHisCap]的手电和扫描仪在找到时被一块哨兵翅膀的碎片压坏了。这台扫描仪被以一种奇怪的方式调整过了。也许它可以帮助我们穿透哨兵的保护层。

如果我们希望活着找到[missing_archaeologist.GetName]，我们必须向搜索任务分派额外的资源，因为[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]在旷野中生还的几率每天都在急剧下降。
ancrel.4066.desc.en:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]'s belongings, including [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] MindGazer - a device used to isolate the mind from outside interferences - have been found on a ledge overlooking the Sentinels. Sticks forming a half-finished outline around one of the statues suggests [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] may have diverted from [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] exercise to mark its position.

[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHisCap] flashlight and scanner were discovered crushed under a shattered piece of the Sentinel's wing. The scanner had been modified in a peculiar manner. Perhaps it could help us pierce the Sentinels protective layer.

If we wish to find [missing_archaeologist.GetName] alive, we must divert extra resources to the search as [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] chances for survival in the wilderness diminish drastically every day.

ancrel.4067.desc.zh: [missing_archaeologist.GetName]的尸体已被找到，被埋在一块巨型石板之下。死因已被确定为严重的头部创伤。有人在[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHim]安息的地点上环绕摆放了一小圈宝石以表敬意。
ancrel.4067.desc.en: [missing_archaeologist.GetName] has been found dead, buried under a huge slab of stone. The cause of death has been determined to be severe head trauma. Someone has made an effort to honor [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHim] resting place by adding a small circle of precious stones around it.

ancrel.4068.desc.zh:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]被发现时不省人事，受伤严重，躲在一块自然生成的岩结构下的灌木丛中，[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]胳膊下塞了一块沾满[missing_archaeologist.GetBloodType]的数据板。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap]被火速送往医院，接受治疗由上方钝器打击造成的严重脑损伤。

尽管目前[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的情况已经稳定，但[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]仍有失忆症状，不记得自己是如何受到这种损伤的。我们从[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的颅顶骨中取出了一些碎屑，材质与哨兵雕塑所用的独特合金相同。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]所记得的一切就是曾经躲避某样东西，然后摔落在了什么东西上面。好在[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的笔记中包含了一些有用的信息。
ancrel.4068.desc.en:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName] has been found unconscious and badly injured, hiding in the underbrush below a natural rock formation, with a datapad covered in [missing_archaeologist.GetBloodType] tucked under [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] arm. [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap] [missing_archaeologist.GetWasWere] rushed to the hospital and treated for severe brain injury indicative of blunt trauma by impact from above.

Though [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] condition is now stable, [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] still suffers from memory loss and has no recollection of how [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] sustained [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] wounds. Splinters of the unique metal-alloy from which the Sentinels are sculpted were lodged in [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] parietal cranial bone. All [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] remember[missing_archaeologist.GetSXX] is hiding from someone and subsiding off of what little the land had to offer. However, [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] notes contain some helpful information.

ancrel.4075.desc.zh:
一艘载着从[sentinels_planet.GetName]上的种族屠杀中逃离的幸存者的舰船抵达了[sentinels_new_home.GetName]。他们隐藏在旷野之中直至哨兵离去，奇迹般地逃脱了屠杀。很可能是这些自动机器人，自以为它们“将我们从肉体的束缚中解放出来”，在工作完成后离去了。

在它们消失后，一个通往地底深处的秘密入口从力场下显现。可能哨兵们把它们自己封锁在里面了。
ancrel.4075.desc.en:
A ship of survivors from the genocide on [sentinels_planet.GetName] has arrived to [sentinels_new_home.GetName]. They miraculously escaped by hiding in the wilderness until one day the Sentinels were just gone. It is likely the automatons, who themselves believed they were 'liberating us from the confines of our own flesh', took off once their work was done.

Upon their disappearance a secret entranceway leading deep into the underground revealed itself from behind a force field. It is possible the Sentinels sealed themselves inside.

ancrel.4076.a.zh: 利用他们的思维从事科研工作。
ancrel.4076.a.en: Put their minds to work with some science.

ancrel.4076.b.zh: 对“永恒”进行调整，供大众娱乐之用。
ancrel.4076.b.en: Modify the Evermore to entertain the masses.

ancrel.4076.desc.zh:
我们已经进入了[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]上的秘密入口。入口内是一处近期才被遗弃的寺庙复合体，一种人型生物在此踏上他们最后的旅程。在他们终将结束的生命的最后，他们抛下自己的肉体，在一处被称作“永恒”的模拟天堂中获取虚拟的来生。

在某个时间点，全体人口都决定以数字化的形式继续存在，只留下寥寥数人。这些人将思维上传入机器人中，哨兵们由此诞生。

现已了无踪迹的哨兵们为我们留下了一份临别赠礼——一块包含着[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]全体人口的硬盘，以数字化的形式来获取永恒无尽的无聊时光。外星天堂原来是一种永无止境的抽象桌游，其核心内容是通过积累欢乐豆来统治星河。
ancrel.4076.desc.en:
We have breached the secret entrance on [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]. It opens on a recently abandoned temple complex where a species of humanoids prepared for their final journey. At the end of their mortal existence they abandoned their flesh bodies for a virtual afterlife within a simulation of paradise called the Evermore.

At some point it was decided the entire population would move on to a digitized existence leaving only a few behind to guard their resting place. Condemned to an eternity of servitude their minds were uploaded to robotic bodies and so the Sentinels were created.

Now gone without a trace, the Sentinels have left us with a parting gift - a single drive containing the entire population of [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName], digitized for all eternity and infinitely bored. As it turns out alien heaven consists of a never-ending abstract board game centered on galactic dominance through the accumulation of legumes.

ancrel.4077.desc.a.zh: 我们做到了！这些居住在“永恒”之内的数字化人口已被分派去协助[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上的科学研究。他们几乎不需要休息，并且因为终于能干点儿别的事情而十分开心……
ancrel.4077.desc.a.en: We have done it! The digitized population residing within the Evermore have been assigned to assist with scientific research on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. They need very little rest and are quite happy to be doing something different...

ancrel.4077.desc.b.zh: 我们做到了！“永恒”模拟已经被重新调校，以更好地适合我们民众的品味。我们的全体人口现在可以与“永恒”天堂中的数字化人口一道在幻想中游玩，没有网络延迟。这已极大地鼓舞了他们的精神，并缩减了对物质材料的需求。
ancrel.4077.desc.b.en: We have done it! The Evermore simulation has been remodeled to better cater to the particular taste of our people. All our population can now live out their fantasies together with the digitized population in the Evermore paradise without latency. This has greatly improved their spirits and lessened their need for material things.

ancrel.4078.b.en: A true [owner.GetSpeciesName] lives off the land.

ancrel.4078.desc.zh: 入夜后，正当考古学家们酣眠之时，营地的食品模块突然因食物烧糊而发生火灾。此外没有找到有关火灾发生原因的线索。幸而无人受伤，可考古学家们空着肚子是无法好好工作的……
ancrel.4078.desc.en: Overnight, as the archaeologists slept peacefully, a fire broke out in the camp's provisions module overcooking the food somewhat. There are no indications as to how the fire started. Luckily no one was harmed, but archaeologists do not work well on an empty stomach...

ancrel.4121.desc.zh:
我们的敌人倒在了[From.Root.GetName]的手上。她曾守护的誊录仪遗珍也因此不归我们所有了。

尽管年迈巨龙的威胁被消除了，这一结论看起来很难让人欢欣雀跃。
ancrel.4121.desc.en:
Our foe has fallen at the hands of the [From.Root.GetName]. The Rubricator relic she guarded has thereby been lost to us.

Although the threat of the old dragon has been removed, it seems difficult to rejoice at this conclusion.

ancrel.4122.desc.zh:
我们的老敌手倒下了。这条新闻面前有人欢喜有人愁。尽管裂爪龙的威胁被消除了，遗憾的是，看起来誊录仪大概要么和它一道被消灭了，要么很快就会被猎龙者用来复制文物。

但是，龙的遗体不知何故被留在原处，这点是可以确定的，而且遗体本身就值得取回，
ancrel.4122.desc.en:
Our old foe has fallen. Some rejoiced and others dismayed at this news. Although the threat of Shard is removed, it seems regrettably probable that the Rubricator has either shared her fate, or soon will replicate artifacts for her destroyer.

However, the dragon's remains have for unknown reasons been left behind, that much is certain, and they alone warrant retrieval.

ancrel.4123.desc.zh:
在从裂爪龙的遗体中提取材料时，[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有了一个令人困惑的发现：誊录仪漂浮在龙鳞与龙血液滴之间。

希望屠龙者没有领会誊录仪的价值，或者最好连其存在都没有发现。
ancrel.4123.desc.en:
During the extraction of materials from Shard's remains, the [Owner.GetScientistPlural] aboard the [Root.GetName] made a baffling discovery: among the scales and globules of dragon blood drifted the Rubricator.

Let us hope Shard's destroyer failed to grasp its value, or better yet, its existence altogether.

ancrel.5.desc.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上存在着另一个废弃的泽珞族殖民地。为了探寻秘密的真相，我们首先需要找到并打开这颗星球上的灵能档案库。
ancrel.5.desc.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains the ruins of another abandoned Zroni colony. The first step to solving this mystery is to find- and make contact with this world's Psionic Archive.

ancrel.6.desc.zh:
利用之前调查水晶建立的流程，这回我们接入这一块水晶就变得轻而易举了。这个水晶的记录同样残缺不全，但是我们发现了能够进入虚境的另一个优越性，虚境同时连接着整个现实星系，也许乃至整个宇宙的每个角落。

如果一个人能够进入虚境，那么这也意味着它能够从任何已知的地方出现，这种能够在任何现实地点间进行“灵能跃迁”的能力让泽珞族遍布整个星系。由于他们在虚境中渡过了大部分时间，泽珞族永久殖民地数量相对较少，且大都临近母星。

这块水晶告诉了我们另一处神殿的位置。
ancrel.6.desc.en:
It was much easier to establish contact with the crystal this time around, using protocols we established with the previous one. Again its records are fragmented, but we have learned that another advantage of being able to enter the Shroud was that the Shroud touches all parts of the physical galaxy - perhaps all parts of the universe - simultaneously.

If one can enter the Shroud, it is possible to exit it at any known location. This ability to "Psionically jump" between physical locations allowed the Zroni to spread to all corners of the galaxy. Because they spent most of their time within the Shroud, the Zroni established relatively few permanent colonies. Those they did set up were mostly located near to their homeworld.

This crystal has given us the location of a sort of shrine.

ancrel.6000.a.tooltip.zh: 在[planet_option_1.GetName]上产生一个有300£pop£人口的随机特质的新物种。
ancrel.6000.a.tooltip.en: 300 £pop£ Pops of a new species with random traits are spawned on [planet_option_1.GetName]

ancrel.6000.b.tooltip.zh: 在[planet_option_2.GetName]上产生一个有300£pop£人口的随机特质的新物种。
ancrel.6000.b.tooltip.en: 300 £pop£ Pops of a new species with random traits are spawned on [planet_option_2.GetName]

ancrel.6000.c.tooltip.zh: 在[planet_option_3.GetName]上产生一个有300£pop£人口的随机特质的新物种。
ancrel.6000.c.tooltip.en: 300 £pop£ Pops of a new species with random traits are spawned on [planet_option_3.GetName]

ancrel.6000.d.tooltip.zh: 在[planet_option_4.GetName]上产生一个有300£pop£人口的随机特质的新物种。
ancrel.6000.d.tooltip.en: 300 £pop£ Pops of a new species with random traits are spawned on [planet_option_4.GetName]

ancrel.6000.desc.zh:
有机全典包含了曾经居住在全星系的数千种智慧物种的详细基因数据。我们的遗传学家可以利用这些数据在我们的殖民地上复活一种已灭绝的物种。

一旦我们选择了一个殖民地，遗传学家就会仔细研究有机全典，并挑选出适合其气候的物种。
ancrel.6000.desc.en:
The Omnicodex contains detailed genetic data on thousands of sapient species that once inhabited the galaxy. Our geneticists could use that data to revive an extinct species on one of our colonies.

Once we have selected a planet, the geneticists will go through the Omnicodex and pick a species suitable to its climate.

ancrel.6000.e.tooltip.zh: 在[planet_option_5.GetName]上产生一个有300£pop£人口的随机特质的新物种。
ancrel.6000.e.tooltip.en: 300 £pop£ Pops of a new species with random traits are spawned on [planet_option_5.GetName]

ancrel.6000.f.tooltip.zh: 有机全典需要在殖民地上产生新物种。请先殖民一颗行星。
ancrel.6000.f.tooltip.en: The Omnicodex requires a colony to seed a new species. Colonize a planet first.

ancrel.6005.desc.zh:
某种非常巨大的建筑物占据了[From.Planet.GetName]小行星的绝大部分内部空间。作为这个建筑物唯一入口的防爆门至今仍无法被打开，但是一条从小行星另一侧的通道已经被挖掘出来。

我们的钻头目前仍无法钻透这个建筑物厚实的外壁，但这个方法似乎仍然提供了进入的最佳机会。尽管它们已经过千年风沙，但是防爆门仍然被证实是坚不可摧的。
ancrel.6005.desc.en:
A very large structure of some kind occupies most of the interior of asteroid [From.Planet.GetName]. The blast door which once served as this structure's only entrance still can't be opened, but a passage has been dug from the other side of the asteroid.

Drills have so far been unable to penetrate the thick outer walls of the structure, but this method still seems to afford the best chance of gaining access. Despite their age, the blast doors have proven nearly invulnerable.

ancrel.6010.desc.zh:
我们最终还是在[From.Planet.GetName]内建筑物的外墙上钻出了一个洞。它的内部是一个宽广的指挥中心，或者是某种地堡，其中零散的散布着几千个腐朽的外星人遗骸。

仔细研究这些，将会让我们得到一张关于当年这颗小行星内部所发生事件更为清晰的图片，这也将花费相当长的时间。
ancrel.6010.desc.en:
A hole has finally been drilled through the outer walls of structure inside [From.Planet.GetName]. The interior is a vast command center or bunker of some sort, littered with the decayed remains of thousands of dead aliens.

Sifting through all this to gain a clearer picture of what exactly was going on inside this asteroid will take considerable time.

ancrel.6015.desc.zh:
这颗小行星曾经作为一个相对较大的星际帝国的隐匿首都，该帝国在数千年前曾经统治着这片星区。有了这样堡垒化的指挥中心，帝国的统治精英们可以与数以千计的军事或民政官员一道安全无虞地发号施令，不受其苛政引起的暴乱所威胁。

小行星与帝国的其余部分的联系只依靠加密的亚空间通讯和一艘定期来访以补给基地物资和运送人员的货船来进行。
ancrel.6015.desc.en:
This asteroid once served as the hidden capital of a relatively large interstellar empire that dominated this section of the galaxy several thousand years ago. From this fortified command center, the ruling elite along with thousands of military and civilian officials administered the empire while safe from the violent reprisals their harsh policies often inspired.

Contact with the rest of their empire seems to have been handled exclusively through encrypted subspace transmissions and a single freighter which made periodic visits to resupply the base and transfer personnel.

ancrel.6020.desc.zh:
从拼凑出的数据来看，这艘补给货船似乎是由于推进器故障而与小行星相撞的。碰撞产生的爆炸破坏了防爆门，并摧毁了小行星的亚空间发射器，永久地切断了它与外界的所有联系。

陷入了困境，更没有得救的希望，小行星的居民慢慢地死于饥饿或自杀。他们唯一残存的子空间接收器的最后日志证实，他们的帝国突然失去了首都，随后陷入内战和混乱中。
ancrel.6020.desc.en:
From what can be pieced together, it appears that the resupply freighter collided with the asteroid due to a thruster malfunction. The resulting explosion damaged the blast doors and destroyed the asteroid's subspace transmitter, permanently severing all contact with the outside world.

Trapped and with no hope of rescue, the asteroid's inhabitants slowly succumbed to starvation or suicide. The last logs of their single surviving subspace receiver confirm that their empire, suddenly bereft of its capital, descended into civil war and anarchy.

ancrel.6049.desc.zh:
在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的一个广袤而与世隔绝的山谷中发现了一些不同物种的化石，这些物种似乎不是属于[Root.GetName]的。它们大体上都来自大约360万年前的同一个时期，时间跨度在几个世纪内。

每个物种似乎都是在其所属的独特的生物圈中进化而来的，而且它们似乎都具有智慧。奇怪的是，到目前为止发现的每个化石都显示出因暴力遇害的迹象。
ancrel.6049.desc.en:
Fossilized remains from several different species that do not appear to have been indigenous to [Root.GetName] have been found in a large and secluded valley on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They all date from roughly the same time period, within the span of a few centuries some 3.6 million years ago.

Each of these species seems to have evolved in its own unique biosphere, and all appear to have been sapient. Strangely, every fossilized individual found so far shows signs of having met a violent end.

ancrel.6050.desc.zh:
考古学家们在山谷中发掘出了越来越多的化石残骸，到目前为止已经有26种不同的智慧物种了，它们都不是[From.Planet.GetName]的本土物种。那些保存程度较高，能用于确定死亡原因的化石都表明这些物种死于刀刃、矛或箭造成的物理创伤。似乎没有任何样本是被现代炮弹或能量武器等类似的装备所击倒的。

在山谷入口附近发现了某种小型结构的废墟。它似乎与这些化石来源于同一时期。也许这会使事情变得明朗一些。
ancrel.6050.desc.en:
Archaeologists have unearthed more and more fossilized remains in the valley, and the count is now up to 26 distinct sapient species, none of them native to [From.Planet.GetName]. Those fossils that have been sufficiently preserved to determine a cause of death all point towards physical trauma inflicted by blades, spears, or arrows. Not a single specimen appears to have been felled by the equivalent of modern projectile or energy weapons.

The ruins of a small structure of some sort have been found near the entrance of the valley. It appears to originate from the same time period as the fossils. Perhaps it will shed some light on things.

ancrel.6055.desc.zh:
对峡谷入口周边发现的古代建筑结构的发掘工作正按照计划稳步进行中。许多文物被发现，大多数文物似乎是各种狩猎武器和战利品。一个被部分翻译的标志似乎是该结构的名字，意为：

马克维尔之谷—第一狩猎屋
ancrel.6055.desc.en:
The excavation of the ancient structure found near the valley's entrance is proceeding according to plan. Many artifacts have been discovered, most of which seem to be variations of hunting weapons and trophies. A partially translated sign, which appears to denote the name of the structure, reads:

"VALLEY OF MAK'VAEHL - HUNTING LODGE PRIMUS"

ancrel.6060.desc.zh:
对狩猎屋周边的持续发掘提供了更多的细节信息。[From.Planet.GetName]和马克维尔之谷是作为一个被称为雷塔拉克斯领域的星际政体的武士同志阶级的狩猎保留地。

雷塔拉克斯是掠夺性的禽类物种，周期性地纳集他们统治下的外星附庸文明的随机个体。这些外星物种按照统治雷塔拉克斯社会的仪式在马克维尔的荒野被狩猎并杀害。这个传统持续了数个世纪直到领域最终被某种未知的外来威胁毁灭。
ancrel.6060.desc.en:
Continued excavations near the hunting lodge have provided more details. [From.Planet.GetName] - and the Valley of Mak'vaehl, specifically - served as a hunting reserve for the ruling warrior class of an interstellar polity known as the Retarax Domain.

The Retarax, a predatory avian species, periodically collected random individuals from the many subjugated alien civilizations under their rule. These aliens were then hunted down and killed in the wilderness of Mak'vaehl, according to the rituals that governed Retarax society. This tradition lasted several centuries, until the Domain eventually succumbed to an undefined outside threat.

ancrel.6065.desc.zh:
发掘狩猎屋的考古学家偶然发现了一些参考线索，这些参考线索指向了一位传奇雷塔拉克斯战士，其仅仅被称为“女猎手”。她显然是最具效率的杀手，因亲手在马克维尔屠戮了数千外星人而闻名整个领域。

现在还不明白这是基于事实还是文学幻想，但是按照雷塔拉克斯的传说，女猎手在一次狩猎时被她追逐的猎物智取而死在了峡谷内部的某处。在传说中她当时正挥舞着“女猎手之刃”。
ancrel.6065.desc.en:
Archaeologists excavating the hunting lodge have stumbled upon several references to a legendary Retarax warrior known only as "The Huntress." She was apparently their most efficient killer, renowned throughout the Domain for having personally butchered thousands of aliens at Mak'vaehl.

It is unclear whether this is based on fact or fiction, but according to Retarax legend the Huntress was killed somewhere inside the valley when she was outwitted by the alien prey she was pursuing. She was supposedly wielding the fabled "Blade of the Huntress" at the time.

ancrel.6070.b.evopred.zh: 女猎手把这件珍宝留给了我们。
ancrel.6070.b.evopred.en: The Huntress has left us a great treasure.

ancrel.6070.desc.zh:
经过精心梳理马克维尔谷任何与女猎手相关的痕迹，考古学家最终查明了她最后休息的地方。她的化石骨骼被发现锁定在大型带角节肢动物的残骸中，她的爪子依旧牢抓着保存完好的锐剑之柄。

这一定就是女猎手之刃了。这把武器是由一种未知的材料打造而成的，锋利到能够切断我们最强韧的盔甲。
ancrel.6070.desc.en:
After painstakingly combing through the Valley of Mak'vaehl for any trace of the legendary Huntress, archaeologists were finally able to pinpoint her last resting place. Her fossilized skeleton was found locked in battle with the remains of a large horned arthropoid, with her claws still clasping the hilt of a perfectly preserved sword.

This must be the Blade of the Huntress. The weapon is composed of an unknown material and is sharp enough to cut straight through our strongest armor.

ancrel.6099.desc.zh: 在[tomb_planet.GetName]——我们领土内一颗没有生命存在的[tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表上，一些古老的建筑物隐藏在某种隐形能量场之下。偶然有一颗小行星在撞击[tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon]时发生了偏转并被旁经的货船监控到，我们这才发现了它的存在。
ancrel.6099.desc.en: A chameleon energy field of some sort concealing an ancient structure was recently exposed on the surface of [tomb_planet.GetName], a lifeless [tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon] inside our space. Only a chance asteroid impact which was deflected off the field while the [tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon] was being monitored by a passing freighter revealed its existence.

ancrel.6100.desc.zh:
这座建筑看起来似乎是一座巨大的陵墓或者坟场，其建造时间可以追溯到几十万年前。这里没有曾遭劫掠的迹象，所以这座建筑或许在这处隐形场启动后就一直保持着原状。

建筑的前厅是开放的，但一扇紧闭的大门阻挡了我们进一步的考古进程。在门上方的墙壁上以大字刻着尚未破译的外星符号。
ancrel.6100.desc.en:
The structure appears to be a gigantic mausoleum or necropolis, dating back around a hundred thousand years. There are no signs of previous looters, so the structure may have been untouched since the chameleon field was erected.

The structure's First Chamber is accessible, but an impenetrable door blocks any further progress. Large alien glyphs, untranslated, have been carved into the wall above the door.

ancrel.6105.desc.zh:
刻在大门上方的外星符号翻译如下：

“我是扎克兰，MOZ-TARB的守护者，ZVA的大先知，塞塔娜的终结者。我放弃了一切来拯救这个充满怨恨和仇恨的星系。如果你们有这个资格，那就继续前进吧。”

在细细梳理过前厅以搜寻有价值的东西后，考古学家们在墙壁上发现了一块被隐藏起来的微小嵌板。当按下嵌板时，那扇大门缓缓打开，次厅显露在我们眼前。
ancrel.6105.desc.en:
The alien glyphs above the door have been translated as follows:

"I am ZARQLAN, the Guardian of MOZ-TARB, the Prophet of ZVA, he who felled CETANA. I gave up everything to save a galaxy awash with spite and hatred. Proceed, if ye be worthy."

After combing through the First Chamber for anything of interest, archaeologists discovered a tiny concealed wall panel. When pressed, the ancient door rumbled open. The Second Chamber can now be accessed.

ancrel.6110.desc.zh:
次厅看上去十分普通，除了在又一扇紧闭的门上方刻着的符号，上面写着：

“渺小的国王以我的名义宣布敕令；帝国为我的荣光发动战争；愚民们用歌唱表达对我的颂扬。而我为他们而牺牲。”

这次我们没有找到什么秘密嵌板来打开通往中堂的通道。
ancrel.6110.desc.en:
The Second Chamber is unremarkable, aside from another set of alien glyphs above a closed door. They read:

"Petty kings issued edicts in my name. Empires waged war in my honor. Fools sang my praises. And yet I died for them."

No secret wall panel to access the Third Chamber has yet been found.

ancrel.6115.desc.zh:
经过长时间痛苦疲乏的勘察，我们发现了一根藏在地板下面的秘密控制杆，用于打开通往后室的通道。像之前一样，外星符号被刻在另一扇门的上方：

“所有想要利用扎克兰的人必须先找到属于他们的道路。在每个墓室中都有一把隐藏的钥匙，只有找到钥匙才能继续前进。这些挑战的意义很快就会显现。”
ancrel.6115.desc.en:
After a long and tiring search, a secret lever hidden under the floor was found, which provided access to the Fourth Chamber. As before, alien glyphs adorned the wall above yet another door:

"Those who wish to parlay with ZARQLAN must first find their way. Each chamber has a hidden key that only the deserving could find. The purpose of these challenges will soon be revealed."

ancrel.6120.desc.zh:
这一次，后室里的控制杆被藏在屋顶。而在下一个房间中有更多的外星符号：

“这里没什么值得学习的。这些挑战也像这些语句一样毫无意义。这是我留下的教训。我是扎克兰，一个无名小卒，不情愿地被历史的潮流裹挟着前行。继续前进吧，你将获得一名忠实的听众，假如你依然认为值得的话。”

看上去再下一个房间就是最后一个墓室了。
ancrel.6120.desc.en:
This time, the lever was concealed in the roof. The Fifth Chamber has more alien writing:

"There is nothing to learn here. The challenges are as meaningless as these words. That is my lesson. I am ZARQLAN, the pawn. Swept along by the currents of history. Proceed, and an audience shall be yours, should one still be worthy."

The next chamber is likely to be the last.

ancrel.6125.desc.zh:
经过紧张的勘察，最后一把“钥匙”被发现是藏在外星符号表面上的一个微小按钮。在尾室中，一个巨大的王座支撑着一个弯曲而静止的人形物体。一阵刺鼻的气味飘来，告诉了我们这具尸体腐烂的状况。几个外星符号写在王座底部：“扎克兰，我们愿为您效劳”

整具尸体由于过度腐烂而无法移动，但考虑到尸体放置于此的年月，其头部被保存的出奇得好。考古学家们不想空手而归，于是便用携带的激光切割器将头部切下带走。
ancrel.6125.desc.en:
After a grueling search, the last "key" was discovered as a minuscule button hidden in one of the carved alien glyphs. In this final chamber, a gigantic throne holds a sizeable humanoid figure's slumped and motionless form. A strong odor hints at the decayed state of the being's body. Some glyphs at the bottom of the throne read: "ZARQLAN, AT YOUR SERVICE"

The body is too far gone to be moved, but the head is surprisingly well-preserved, given its age. Not wanting to leave empty-handed, some archaeologists use a laser cutter to remove the head.

ancrel.6125.desc.b.evopred.zh: 别管什么渎不渎神，我们就要它的基因！
ancrel.6125.desc.b.evopred.en: Sacrilege or not, we must have its DNA!

ancrel.6130.desc.zh:
这……居然是真的。你们找到了传说中扎克兰的墓室。当预言官们告诉我这件事时，我并不相信他们，但现在证据已无可辩驳。我明白，你们已经拿到了大先知的头颅，对吗？

那么，按照预言所说，伟大的扎克兰的选民终于揭晓。如扎克兰所愿，在我们领土附近的任何未定居的圣地都随你们处置。在[spiritualist_fallen_empire.Capital.GetName]上另有许多虔信的朝圣者，他们会因能在你的旗帜下作战而感到极大的荣耀。
ancrel.6130.desc.en:
It... is true, then. You have found the legendary tomb of Zarqlan. When the Augurs told me, I did not believe them, but the evidence is irrefutable. I understand that you have the Prophet's head in your possession?

Then, as was foretold, great Zarqlan's chosen has finally been revealed. As would have been Zarqlan's wish, any unsettled holy worlds near our space are yours to do with as you wish. There are also many devout pilgrims on [spiritualist_fallen_empire.Capital.GetName] who would be greatly honored to fight under your banner.

ancrel.6130.machine.desc.zh:
这的确是真的；区区一台机器发现了传说中的扎克兰之墓。当虚境灵使把这个消息刚刚传到时，我觉得很难相信。但现在我已经完全接受了你拥有先知头颅的事实。

我们不会质疑伟大的扎克兰的意志。你们是这份庇佑的合法持有者。根据古代经文，在我们的领土附近所有未受侵染的圣地星球都由你们来管理。[spiritualist_fallen_empire.Capital.GetName]上许多虔诚的朝圣者都会乐意为这一神圣的事业而战并以此为荣。
ancrel.6130.machine.desc.en:
It is indeed true; a mere machine has discovered the legendary tomb of Zarqlan. When the Augurs first relayed this news, I found it hard to believe. But now I understand that you possess the Prophet's head.

We will not question the will of the great Zarqlan. Your kind is the rightful holder of this blessing. According to the ancient scriptures, any unsettled holy worlds near our territory are yours to manage as you see fit. Many devout pilgrims on [spiritualist_fallen_empire.Capital.GetName] would be greatly honored to fight for this sacred cause.

ancrel.6132.a.desc.zh: 扎克兰的忠仆们现在听您差遣，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。告诉我们是谁应当遭受天罚吧！
ancrel.6132.a.desc.en: The loyal servants of Zarqlan are at your command, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let us know who to smite!

ancrel.6132.b.desc.zh: 我们应召而来。世上再无比侍奉扎克兰的选民更大的荣耀了。
ancrel.6132.b.desc.en: We are summoned. There is no greater honor than to serve the Chosen of Zarqlan.

ancrel.6132.c.desc.zh:
我们是您的人。告诉我们您的敌人是谁吧。

遵循扎克兰的意旨！
ancrel.6132.c.desc.en:
We are yours. Point us towards your enemies.

ZARQLAN WILLS IT!

ancrel.6132.d.desc.zh:
您召唤我们，我们应召而来！

愿扎克兰的敌人生出的婴孩无比丑陋！愿他们被自己的营养膏堵住喉咙，愿他们的衣服在不合时宜又极度尴尬的时刻撕出裂口，愿他们的感光器官自动燃起火焰，愿他们……
ancrel.6132.d.desc.en:
You called and we are here!

May the enemies of Zarqlan breed ugly children! May they choke on their nutrients, may their clothing disintegrate at inopportune and embarrassing moments, may their ocular organs spontaneously combust, may their...

ancrel.6133.desc.zh: 如今已很少有活着的扎克兰的遵奉者了，但一小支配备着虔信而缺乏训练的船员的护航舰队还是一路来到了[Root.Capital.GetName]并发誓听从[Root.GetName]调配。
ancrel.6133.desc.en: There are few surviving worshipers of Zarqlan these days, but a small fleet of escorts with devout but untrained crews has made the journey to [Root.Capital.GetName] and pledged itself to the [Root.GetName].

ancrel.6150.desc.zh: 最近的调查显示，[From.GetName]被包围在了一个拥有难以置信的强度并反射所有探测手段的护盾之中。这个星球护盾似乎是从这颗星球附近的卫星中产生的。
ancrel.6150.desc.en: As confirmed by its recent survey, [From.GetName] is surrounded by an incredibly strong energy field that deflects all attempts to scan it. The field appears to be generated from the planet's nearby moon.

ancrel.6151.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]散发出一道围绕着他所运行的行星的无法穿透的能量屏障。这道能量屏障的来源很难确定，但它似乎是来自于卫星贫瘠表面下深处的某个地方。

在卫星上最大的一个陨石坑里，可以发现一些古代遗址，可能是出于某种军事用途的大型基地。那里可能会存在着一些关于能量屏障的答案。
ancrel.6151.desc.en:
[From.GetName] is emitting an impenetrable energy barrier that surrounds the planet it orbits. The exact source of the barrier is difficult to pinpoint, but it appears to be coming from somewhere deep beneath the moon's barren surface.

Ancient ruins of what must have been a large base of some sort, possibly of a military nature, can be found inside one of the moon's largest craters. It may hold some answers.

ancrel.6155.desc.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]的进一步挖掘的结果显示，这个废弃的基地曾经是由“停战倡议组织”建造的大型军事设施。这是一个由至少五个疆域广大并且非常先进的星际力量组成的半永久联盟，于大约75000年前活跃于星系区域。

这个联盟的确切性质尚不清楚，但它似乎致力于立即结束某些长期的星系级战争。每个停战倡议成员都派遣了大量军事分遣队驻扎在这个卫星基地上。
ancrel.6155.desc.en:
Continued excavations of the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed that the abandoned base was once a massive military installation built by the "Armistice Initiative." They were a semi-permanent alliance of at least five large and very advanced interstellar powers active in this galactic region some 75,000 years ago.

The exact nature of this alliance is unknown, but it appears to have been committed to bringing an immediate end to several long-running galactic wars. Large military contingents from each Initiative member were stationed at the base on this moon.

ancrel.6160.desc.zh:
在这个星系中被屏蔽的行星是一个正在交战的帝国的首都，停战倡议组织是正试图遏止这场战争。这个帝国的名字仍然不为人知——在迄今为止已恢复的倡议组织记录中，他们被简单地称为“交战方丙”。

显然，停战倡议组织希望以交战方丙作为一个示例。在侵入他们的空间并赢得了几场艰苦战斗之后，倡议组织将丙方的母星永久地囚禁在一个能源护盾之中。他们还在在附近的卫星上建立了一座军事基地，以维持星球护盾的运行，并且提供预防遏制行动失败的临时反应部队。
ancrel.6160.desc.en:
The shielded planet in this system was the capital of one of the warring empires the Armistice Initiative was formed to stop. This empire's name is still unknown - they are referred to simply as "Belligerent Party C" in all Initiative records recovered so far.

Apparently, the Armistice Initiative sought to make an example of Belligerent Party C. After invading their space and winning several hard-fought battles, the Initiative permanently imprisoned the homeworld of Party C behind an energy shield. A military base was established on the nearby moon to maintain the shield and act as a response force in the unlikely event of containment failure.

ancrel.6165.desc.zh:
起初卫星基地维持了几个世纪的运行，由于没有遏制行动失败的迹象，基地的军事力量逐渐缩减。后来随着不同倡议组织成员之间的转移联盟和内讧，最终卫星基地完全荒废。

自动化系统被保留在适当位置，以维护丙方的家园周围的防护罩。令人难以置信的是，直到现在，它们仍可正常工作。可惜的是，当我们的考古学家在向地下的护盾生成室挖洞时，一条关键的能量电缆被切断了。经过75000年的连续运行，防护罩已不复存在。
ancrel.6165.desc.en:
The Initiative moon base was kept operational for several centuries, but with no signs of containment failure the forces were gradually scaled back. Shifting alliances and infighting between the various Initiative members eventually left the base completely deserted.

Automated systems were left in place to maintain the shield surrounding Party C's homeworld, and they have, incredibly, remained functional up until now. Alas, a critical power cable was severed when our archaeologists dug their way into the subterranean generator chamber. After 75,000 years of continuous operation, the shield is no more.

ancrel.6170.desc.zh:
这颗星球原初人口的消失仍然是个谜。当护盾升起的时候，他们与星际帝国的其他部分隔绝，他们很可能面临大规模饥荒和国内动乱，因为他们需要竭尽全力用有限的资源来供养庞大的首都人口。

然而，没有迹象表明，他们清理了城市星球的部分土地来耕种。没有任何迹象表明，在护盾升起后发生了任何重大的战斗，居民们没有遗骸、化石或其他遗留物。仿佛他们仅仅是消散在了稀薄的空气中。
ancrel.6170.desc.en:
The disappearance of this planet's original population remains a mystery. Once the shield went up and they were isolated from the rest of their interstellar empire, they likely faced mass famine and civil unrest as they struggled to support their capital's massive population with what limited resources they had.

Yet there are no signs that they demolished parts of their city planet to cultivate the land. Nothing suggests that any significant fighting took place after the shield went up, and there are no remains, fossilized or otherwise, of the inhabitants. It's like they simply vanished into thin air.

ancrel.6175.desc.zh:
这座被遗弃的星球城市中怪诞空旷的街道仍然没有暴露出原住民当初遭遇了什么。已经发现的一些海报和小册子提到了某种形式的“撤离日”，这些册子里面画着一些我们天文学家不认识的星系的图片：

“撤离日——已经到来。尽快到离你们最近的定居中心报到，开启新的生活吧。”
ancrel.6175.desc.en:
The eerie and empty streets of this abandoned planet-wide city still do not betray what happened to the original inhabitants. Posters and pamphlets have been discovered that mention some sort of "Evacuation Day." They are typically accompanied by pictures of a galaxy that our astronomers do not recognize:

"EVACUATION DAY - TODAY IS THE DAY. REPORT TO YOUR NEAREST RELOCATION CENTER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO BEGIN YOUR NEW LIFE."

ancrel.6180.desc.zh:
在“撤离日”之后整个行星被彻底废弃了，但这究竟是怎么做到的？没有任何的证据表明行星的能量屏障曾经减弱过。

已经发现的线索表明，在护盾出现之前，行星上的原住民们正在进行某种大规模的研究项目。越来越多的资源和科研人员被转移到这个项目中，并且这种行为似乎在护盾产生后大大地加快了。
ancrel.6180.desc.en:
The planet was clearly abandoned after this "Evacuation Day" concluded, but how? There is no evidence that the planet's energy barrier ever went down.

Clues have been discovered that indicate the pursuit of some sort of massive research project that predates the shield. Resources and science staff were diverted to this project in increasing numbers, and efforts appear to have greatly intensified after the shield went up.

ancrel.6185.desc.zh:
经过高强度的搜索之后，我们发现了[From.Planet.GetName]原住民们的去向。在这个行星北极点附近一个高墙环绕的建筑深处，我们发现了一个遗珍，我们的考古学家确信这里面装有一个微型星系。

通过某种手段，在创造了这个星系之后，遗落星球的原住民们都迁移到了里面，然后用某种不可渗透的亚空间场把星系封闭在了这个容器中。虽然我们无法干扰这个星系本身，但我们可以对它进行研究。
ancrel.6185.desc.en:
After intense search efforts, we have discovered where the inhabitants of [From.Planet.GetName] went. Deep inside a tall fortified structure near the planet's northern pole, we found a relic that our archaeologists are convinced holds an actual miniaturized galaxy.

Somehow, after creating this galaxy, the inhabitants of the Relic World all relocated there and then sealed it in this container with some kind of impervious subspace field. While we can't interfere with the galaxy itself, our scientists assure us that we can study it.

ancrel.6200.desc.zh:
空间站内部黑暗无光、了无生命的现状几乎成功掩盖了它曾经被设计为某种奢华的享乐宫殿的事实。这里有看起来数不清的一列列生锈的老虎机，数百间破旧不堪的酒馆和餐厅，其中到处横陈着共计数千具尸体。

这些随处可见的部分木乃伊化的外星人尸体属于至少十几个不同的物种，但大部分尸体都聚集在几个空的逃生舱停放港附近。
ancrel.6200.desc.en:
The present dark and lifeless interior of the space station almost succeeds in hiding the fact that it must have been designed as some kind of luxurious pleasure palace. There are seemingly endless rows of rusty slot machines, hundreds of decrepit bars and restaurants, and amidst it all, thousands of bodies.

Dead, partially mummified aliens of at least a dozen different species can be found everywhere, but most of the bodies are clustered around the empty escape pod bays.

ancrel.6205.desc.zh:
在将近一千年以前，这个废弃的空间站曾经被称作“星辰花瓣”并似乎是闻名于星系一角的奢华度假胜地。每年都会有一小队拖船将此空间站牵引到未曾去过的异国他乡，而[From.Planet.GetName]看起来是其最后停留的位置。

由于尚不清楚的原因，这个空间站被拖进了这个气态巨行星的大气层并在此遭受了严重损坏。
ancrel.6205.desc.en:
This derelict station was once known as the "Star Petal" and it was apparently a celebrated luxury resort in this corner of the galaxy nearly a thousand years ago. A small fleet of tugs would drag the station to a new exotic location each year, but [From.Planet.GetName] appears to have been its last.

For unclear reasons, the station was pulled into the gas giant's atmosphere where it suffered critical damage.

ancrel.6210.desc.zh:
在“星辰花瓣”工作的考古学家收集到了足够的线索和证据，可以为这个空间站的最后时日描述出一副相当清晰的图景。一颗离群小行星撞上了这个空间站，使其航线偏离，很快就会沉入[From.Planet.GetName]的大气层。

空间站的轨道控制推进器无法使其回归正确航线，指挥人员立即下令进行疏散。不幸的是，空间站上的逃生舱仅够很小一部分乘员撤离，由此引发了集体恐慌。那些没有被踩踏至死者在空间站坠入气态巨行星深处时由于环境维持系统失效而丧生。
ancrel.6210.desc.en:
The archaeologists working on the Star Petal have gathered sufficient clues and evidence to paint a reasonably clear picture of the station's final days. A stray asteroid impacted the station, knocking it into an orbit that would soon plunge it into [From.Planet.GetName]'s atmosphere.

Station-keeping thrusters could not compensate, and the command staff soon issued an evacuation order. Unfortunately, the station only had enough escape pods to evacuate a fraction of its passengers and mass panic soon erupted. Those who were not trampled to death perished when the station's environmental systems failed as it drifted deeper into the gas giant.

ancrel.6215.desc.zh: 在“星辰花瓣”最富有的主顾们存储其个人物品的设有安保的咖啡厅里搜索时，我们找到了一座装有奇异文物和珠宝的宝库。在找到的物品中最值得注意的或许是“脉动之心”——一串独一无二的钻石项链，在当年极为有名，至少被五个国家的首脑戴过。
ancrel.6215.desc.en: Rummaging through the secure safes where the Star Petal's wealthiest clientèle stored their personal belongings has revealed a treasure trove of strange artifacts and jewelry. Perhaps the most noteworthy among the found items is the "Heart of the Pulsar" - a unique diamond necklace quite famous in its day for having been worn by five different heads of state.

ancrel.6250.desc.zh: 在仔细检查后，在[From.Planet.GetName]表面发现的机器人碎片似乎来自两种截然不同的文化。从技术上来说，这些机器人在能正常工作时其各部件间一定会完全匹配，但是许多微妙的差异暗示他们不是源自同一设计。
ancrel.6250.desc.en: Upon closer examination, the smashed droids found on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName] appear to originate from two distinct cultures. Technologically the droids must have been evenly matched when they were still functional, but there are many subtle differences that hint at different design origins.

ancrel.6255.desc.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]似乎不仅仅简单的是一个机器人碎片的垃圾场——这颗小行星可能是这些机器人被破坏的战场。多层碎片暗示在过去的两个世纪中断断续续发生了许多场非常激烈的战争。

为什么两个星际大国会因为在一个不起眼的小行星上大打出手仍然是一个未解之谜。
ancrel.6255.desc.en:
[From.Planet.GetName] does not seem to have simply been a dumping ground for broken droids - it may have served as the actual battlefield where they were destroyed. The many layers of debris suggest a series of very intense battles waged intermittently across the better part of two centuries.

Exactly why two interstellar powers would commit such vast resources towards waging a massive ground war on a small and unremarkable asteroid remains an unanswered question.

ancrel.6260.desc.zh:
我们的考古学家已经了解到，在经历了一场漫长而艰苦的战争之后，居住在星系这一角落的两个帝国在大约20万年前签署了一项条约，要求他们用机器人军队之间安排好的、高度管制的战斗来解决所有未来的争端。

[From.Planet.GetName]被选为这些战斗的地点。该条约似乎已维持了将近两个世纪，多次阻止了武装敌对行动的爆发，直到其中一个帝国被发现作弊为止。
ancrel.6260.desc.en:
Our archaeologists have learned that after a long and bitter war, the two empires inhabiting this corner of the galaxy some 200,000 years ago signed a treaty compelling them to settle all future disputes with arranged and highly regulated combat engagements between robotic armies.

[From.Planet.GetName] was chosen as the site of these battles. The treaty appears to have been upheld for nearly two centuries, preventing the outbreak of armed hostilities on numerous occasions, until one of the empires was caught cheating.

ancrel.6300.desc.zh:
我们从那些应该是舰桥的地方找回了很多航行日志：

“舰长航行日志。开始记录。

迫降于行星55-23-X号。无能的船员们应受责备。沙德巴，伍克尔和迪巴拉克三世未能幸存。皮尔瓦克斯失去了两个次级附肢和十一个眼睛——生命仍处于危险状态，能否生存依旧未知。其余安好。等待救援，但是被愚蠢的生物包围着，十分悲伤。”
ancrel.6300.desc.en:
A log of sorts was recovered from what is believed to have served as the spacecraft's bridge:

"Captain's chronicle. Begin recording.

Made forced landing on planet 55-23-X. Incompetent crew to blame. Shadba, Vuxal, and Dibrak the Third did not survive. Pirvax lost two secondary appendages and eleven of his eyes - remains in critical condition, survival doubtful. Rest are fine. Awaiting rescue, but surrounded by idiots. Very depressed."

ancrel.6310.desc.zh:
已找到另一篇日志并翻译：

“大副尤瑟尔记录。舰长已被安然的存放在C号杂物橱中。那个笨手笨脚的傻瓜是这一切的罪魁祸首。现在由我指挥。总工程师扎布拉现在正试着做一个子空间信号发射机。我们离企业贸易线路太远了，没有那个机器，恐怕我们永远都不会获救。

皮尔瓦克斯又失去了一只眼睛。他可能等不到那一天了。”
ancrel.6310.desc.en:
Another log has been found and translated:

"First Mate Ythar speaking. Captain has been safely stowed in Utility Closet C. That bumbling fool is to blame for everything. I am in command now. Chief Engineer Zarbla is working on a subspace transmitter. Without one, I fear we'll never get rescued as we're too far off the corporate trade routes.

Pirvax lost another eye. Likely won't last the day."

ancrel.6320.desc.zh:
又一篇已翻译的日志：

“食物已经耗尽，五个周期前我们就开始吃死者的尸体，现在已经不够了。所以我们投票决定分食舰长。扎布拉工程师还在努力制造出子空间信号发射器。她向我保证它几乎要完成了。看起来它非常的复杂。

皮尔瓦克斯的最后一个次级附肢已经萎缩并变成洋红色，他就要死了。”
ancrel.6320.desc.en:
Yet another translated log:

"Running out of food. Ate our dead five cycles ago, but not enough to last us. We had a vote, and decided to eat the Captain. Engineer Zarbla still working hard on subspace transmitter. She assures me it is nearly complete. It looks very complex.

Pirvax's last secondary appendage has shriveled up and turned magenta. Death is near."

ancrel.6330.desc.zh:
来自大副尤瑟尔的另一篇日志：

“与扎布拉就亚空间发射器进行了质询。事实证明她只是把一堆垃圾和松散的电缆硬塞进空油罐而已。她甚至不是真正的工程师。

皮尔瓦克斯的胸窦正在渗出体液。将会很快迎来死亡。真羡慕啊。”
ancrel.6330.desc.en:
Another log from First Mate Ythar:

"Confronted Zarbla about the subspace transmitter. Turns out she had just shoved a bunch of junk and loose cables into an empty fuel canister. She's not even a real engineer.

Pirvax is now leaking fluids from his mesothorax. Will surely perish soon. Envious."

ancrel.6340.desc.zh:
这篇已翻译的日志似乎记录自三副乌克拉：

“大副尤瑟尔昨天通过切断自己的触须自杀了。技术员（二等）米斯瓦不久之后宣称自己是女皇，但因由食物引发的骚乱被驱逐至下甲板。我们的情况十分严峻。同类相食的情况普遍存在。

皮尔瓦克斯在昨天腹部发生炸裂之后整个身体都变的潮红。理应已经死去，但依旧存活。目前被伽马相移当做神灵来崇拜。”
ancrel.6340.desc.en:
This translated log appears to have been recorded by Uxla, the Third Mate:

"First Mate Ythar committed suicide by ripping off his own antennas yesterday. Technician (2nd class) Misiva declared herself Empress shortly afterwards, but food riots forced her into exile on the lower decks. Situation very bleak. Cannibalism widespread.

Pirvax has turned entirely magenta after his lower abdomen exploded yesterday. Should be dead, but is not. Now worshipped as deity by gamma shift."

ancrel.6350.desc.zh:
最后的日志已被发现并翻译：

“巡逻日志，船副吉尔伽美。在55-23-X侦测到坠毁的船只，前往调查。船只被鉴定为莱文克号，一艘P级货船。在残骸中发现了仅存的生还者，处于十分危急的状况。其身份被确认是皮尔瓦克斯，副水手长。

剩下的船员不是在坠毁中遇难就是在我们到来不久之前互相厮杀。按照标准协议，我将这份日志留在这里并将莱文克号注册为保护墓地。记录结束。”
ancrel.6350.desc.en:
One last log has been found and translated:

"Patrol log, Officer Gilgamm. Detected crashed vessel on 55-23-X, moved to investigate. Vessel identified as the Ravink, a class-P modular freighter. A single survivor in critical condition was recovered from the wreckage. Identity confirmed as Pirvax, Boatswain's mate.

Remaining crew either perished in crash or turned on each other shortly before our arrival. As per standard protocol, I am leaving this log here and registering the Ravink as a protected grave site. End recording."

ancrel.6500.desc.zh:
随着我们牢牢掌控[planet.GetName]，我们得知我们的军队在战斗中取得了一个名为[this.GetLastReceivedRelic]的无价遗珍的控制权。显然，[victim.GetName]正准备将这个遗珍撤离到安全的地方，但是我们在[planet.GetPlanetMoon]上战线的快速推进使得这个选择不再现实。

遗珍现已被我们安全转移到位于[Root.Capital.GetName]上的中央档案馆。
ancrel.6500.desc.en:
With [planet.GetName] firmly under our control, we have learned that our forces came into possession of a priceless relic, known as [this.GetLastReceivedRelic], during the fighting. The [victim.GetName] was evidently in the process of evacuating this relic to a safe location, but the rapidly shifting front lines on the [planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface made this impossible.

The relic has been safely transferred to our central archives on [Root.Capital.GetName].

ancrel.6505.desc.zh:
祸不单行，继[planet.GetName]沦陷之后，紧接便是我们伟大的首都[From.GetName]。我们努力撤离[this.GetLastLostRelic]，可惜却失败了，其专用的运输穿梭机在中央档案馆附近的混战中被击落。

我们现已确定[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将该遗珍运送至[From.Capital.GetName]，即他们的首都。我们已经失去它了。
ancrel.6505.desc.en:
Yet another tragedy has followed on the heels of the recent fall of [planet.GetName], our great capital, to the [From.GetName]. Our efforts to evacuate [this.GetLastLostRelic] failed when its designated transport shuttle was brought down in the confused fighting near the central archives.

We now have confirmation that the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have moved the relic to [From.Capital.GetName], their capital. It is lost to us.

ancrel.7.desc.zh:
现在我们可以很容易地找到灵能档案库并读取其中的信息。几乎在我们的考察队刚一着陆的时候就已经完成了连接，然后我们就可以获取更多详细的记录和概念。从中我们了解到，虚境赋予泽珞族神格的好事并非天上掉馅饼。

虚境中移山填海般的变化需要大量的能源，这些能源必须来自于某个地方，泽珞族最终发现，星系中央的巨型黑洞正是能量的源头。随着泽珞族不停地改造虚境，黑洞奇点的影响范围也在扩大，吞噬了星系中心的大量质量并将其转化为能量抽取进虚境之中。这个发现震动了整个泽珞族，渐渐地讨论变成了争吵，变成了分裂，最终演变成两大主要派系间的内战。
ancrel.7.desc.en:
Finding and communicating with the Psionic Archives has become much easier now. Contact can be made as soon as our expedition lands, at which point we can access more detailed records and concepts. From what we have learned here, some things are too good to be true - and so it was with the godhood granted to the Zroni by the Shroud.

The energy required to power the vast changes in the Shroud's composition had to come from somewhere, and for them it originated from the supermassive black hole at the center of our galaxy. As the Zroni made their changes within the Shroud, so the singularity expanded: consuming the mass of the galactic center and converting it into energy which was then siphoned into the Shroud. This discovery shook the Zroni: debate turn to argument; arguments led to division; division turned to civil war between their two main factions.

ancrel.7001.desc.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]冰冷的气候将这个遗址掩藏于冰雪之下。这个遗迹荒无人烟的位置也许暗示着其中的存在需要我们谨慎对待。不论里面发生过什么，有人希望尽量将其掩盖。
ancrel.7001.desc.en: The freezing climate of [From.Planet.GetName] has covered the site in thick layers of ice and snow. The desolate location of this site may be a hint of the need for discretion. Whatever took place here, someone wanted to keep it hidden.

ancrel.7002.desc.zh: 这个复合体由几个更大的地下结构以隧道网络连通而成，其中很多都已经坍塌或被冰块封堵。尽管这些隧道十分古老，其中一些仍能看出很明显的火灾的痕迹。这场火灾造成的损害十分巨大，足以使人认为这里发生过灾难性的事件，或是被人有意彻底毁坏。有一件事可以确定，这个遗址在本质上是用于与科学相关的事务。
ancrel.7002.desc.en: The complex consists of several larger underground structures connected with a network of tunnels, many of which are collapsed or blocked by ice. Although ancient, some of the tunnels show clear signs of fire. The damage caused by the fire is major enough to suggest a catastrophic event, or perhaps intentional destruction. One thing is sure, and that is that the purpose of this site seems to be scientific in nature.

ancrel.7004.desc.zh: 进一步的调查显示，这个站点的主要用途是研究与开发生物制剂。应该是由于这里开发的生物制剂意外泄露，整个建筑群已经用大火净化。对现存文物进行详细的研究，可能会发现一些线索。
ancrel.7004.desc.en: Further investigation reveals that the primary purpose of this site seems to have been in the research and development of biological agents. The whole complex seems to have been purged by fire, possibly as the result of the accidental release of one of the biological agents being developed here. With careful and meticulous study of the artifacts that remain, some clues may be found.

ancrel.7005.desc.zh: 进一步的调查显示，这个站点的主要目的是研究与开发先进的能量武器。一场事故似乎引发了一场灾难性的爆炸并摧毁了大部分场地。站点中的一座数据中心似乎还保持着相对良好的状态，也许它的数据能够带来一些有用的启示。
ancrel.7005.desc.en: Further investigation reveals that the primary purpose of this site seems to have been in the research and development advanced energy weapons. An accident seems to have triggered a catastrophic explosion, which eradicated most of the site. One data-center seems to be in relatively good condition, perhaps its data will yield some useful insights?

ancrel.7006.1.desc.zh:
当我们触摸灵魂石时，我们被投影到了虚境的一处微缩位面中。我们很快意识到自己并非这片令人目眩的奇妙秘境中唯一的存在。这里有一个存在等待着我们，其古老的程度远超我们可以计量的范围。那是一位上古秘辛的守护者。$relic_zro_entity_name$，我们本能地知道这一点。

在通过了与其建立联系的试炼后，这个存在等待着我们发问。
ancrel.7006.1.desc.en:
As we touch the Soulstone, we are projected in to a microcosm of the Shroud. We become aware that we are not alone in this swirling twilight realm. There is an entity awaiting us, one immeasurably ancient. A keeper of secrets. $relic_zro_entity_name$, we instinctively know.

Having passed the test of making contact with it, the entity awaits our questions.

ancrel.7006.2.desc.zh:
灵魂石内部光芒闪耀，仿佛在无言地召唤着我们。我们触摸了灵魂石，而后我们的心灵被吸入了虚境中一处微缩的位面，在这里一个被称作$relic_zro_entity_name$的存在等待着我们。

它知道凡人无法得知的事情，由于我们已经来到了它的圣所，它似乎愿意将它的秘密同我们分享。
ancrel.7006.2.desc.en:
The Soulstone, pulsing with inner light, seems to wordlessly beckon. We touch it, and our minds are drawn in to a pocket dimension of the Shroud, where the enigmatic entity called $relic_zro_entity_name$ awaits.

It knows things no mortal being could know, and seems willing to share its secrets now that we have reached its sanctum.

ancrel.7007.desc.zh: 微缩星河内部的时间流逝的更快，通过仔细观察其中的居民，我们可以学到许多与先进科技有关的知识。
ancrel.7007.desc.en: Time flows faster inside the miniature galaxy, and by carefully observing its denizens we are able to learn much when comes to advanced technologies.

ancrel.8.desc.zh:
从水晶中，我们找寻了到了关于两派内战更进一步的细节。其中一派，被称为“升格派”，他们认为现实宇宙的命运之于泽珞族无关痛痒，他们能够在虚境中继续他们为所欲为的生活直到在无比遥远的未来整个星系都被吞噬——即使到了那时候，还有其他星系可以消耗，又甚至其他宇宙也能够成为泽珞族的燃料。

另一派，称为“福音派”，他们激烈地反对“升格派”的观点——泽珞族不应该为了自己神一般的生活便毁灭整个星系！即使离开了虚境，他们的灵能天赋也能让他们过着乌托邦般的生活。

另一方面，一处泽珞族研究哨站的位置被纳入我们的数据库中。
ancrel.8.desc.en:
Further details of the Zroni civil war factions have been extracted from the crystal. One faction - which came to be known as "The Divine" - felt that the fate of the physical galaxy was of no concern to the Zroni, who could continue their omnipotent existence in the Shroud until the entire galaxy was consumed in some unimaginably far off future. Even then, there are other galaxies, perhaps even other universes which could conceivably be consumed.

The other faction, "The Saviors", were aghast at this; the Zroni should not destroy the galaxy to live as parasitic gods! Even outside of the Shroud, their Psionic abilities guaranteed them a utopian existence.

The location of a Zroni research outpost was included in the torrent of data.

ancrel.8003.b.en: They will have to go around.

ancrel.8040.desc.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个古老的资源贮藏点。他们现在已经开始将这些物资装船运往我们的中央仓库。
ancrel.8040.desc.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] discovered an ancient cache of resources among the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName]. They are even now in the process of being shipped off to our central stores.

ancrel.8045.desc.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]不久前在发掘[From.Planet.GetName]上的遗迹时发现了一段隐蔽的隧道！这个意想不到的发现加快了发掘进度。
ancrel.8045.desc.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] recently found a hidden passage while excavating the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName]! This unexpected discovery has accelerated progress at the dig site.

ancrel.8050.desc.zh: 你的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然发现了之前在[From.Planet.GetName]进行的一次不幸的探险行动，那是很久以前的事了。我们的人从他们干枯的遗骸中找到了几件稀有文物。
ancrel.8050.desc.en: Your [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] have stumbled upon an ill-fated previous expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] that perished long ago. Several minor artifacts were recovered from their desiccated remains.

ancrel.8055.desc.zh: 怒气冲天的争执在[From.Planet.GetName]的考古遗址爆发了出来，几名[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]就如何最好地推进项目同[Root.GetLeaderName]的意见产生了公开的分歧。该遗址的工程进展已经慢的如同蜗牛一般。
ancrel.8055.desc.en: Tempers are running high at the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], and several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] are openly disagreeing with [Root.GetLeaderName] about how best to proceed. Progress at the site has been slowed to a crawl.

ancrel.8060.desc.zh: 最近[Root.GetLeaderName]在[From.Planet.GetName]的考古发掘现场发现了一个小藏宝室！虽然发现的大多数小玩意儿几乎没有实际用途，但它们可值不少能量币。
ancrel.8060.desc.en: A small hidden treasure chamber was recently uncovered by [Root.GetLeaderName] at the archaeological dig site on [From.Planet.GetName]. Although most of the found trinkets are of little practical use, they have a substantial energy credit value.

ancrel.8065.desc.zh: 考古人员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报道一种奇怪的疾病正在[From.Planet.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]间传播。首个病例在第一次打开密封室后不久被确认。由于很大一部分团队成员已经无法继续参与考古，遗迹的开发进展已经推迟。
ancrel.8065.desc.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that a strange sickness has been spreading among the [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName]. The first confirmed cases appeared shortly after a sealed chamber was opened for the first time. With a large part of the team incapacitated, progress has been delayed.

ancrel.8070.desc.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上的考古探险队发来报告，由于一系列未曾预料的设备故障，工程出现了延期。在拿到替代设备之前，考察工作将暂时停滞。
ancrel.8070.desc.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has reported delays caused by an unlikely series of equipment malfunctions. Work has been halted momentarily until replacements can be acquired.

ancrel.8075.desc.zh: 当发掘[From.Planet.GetName]上的遗迹时，[dead_scientist.GetName]消失的无影无踪了。一项由另一个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]领导的广泛的搜寻工作也一无所获。我们必须考虑到最坏的情况。
ancrel.8075.desc.en: While excavating the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName], [dead_scientist.GetName] recently vanished without a trace. An extensive search by the other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] turned up nothing. We have to assume the worst.

ancrel.8080.1.desc.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上持续的发掘工作出土了一小堆古董物件。[Root.GetLeaderName]在这之中鉴定出了一些稀有文物。
ancrel.8080.1.desc.en: Our continued excavations on [From.Planet.GetName] have unearthed a small cache of antique objects. [Root.GetLeaderName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

ancrel.8080.2.desc.zh: 一些稀有文物于近期由[Root.GetLeaderName]在[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古站点上发现。它们目前正在运往一个安全的科学设施的途中。
ancrel.8080.2.desc.en: Some minor artifacts were recently discovered by [Root.GetLeaderName] at the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName]. They are currently in the process of being shipped to a secure science facility.

ancrel.8080.3.desc.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]上遗迹的发掘中，一部分地面最近发生了坍塌，使得我们的一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]跌落到一个小裂口中。幸运的是他们不仅在事故中毫发无伤，还发现了一些稀有文物。
ancrel.8080.3.desc.en: A section of floor at the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName] recently gave way, sending several of our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] tumbling down a small chasm. Fortunately they not only emerged unharmed from the incident, but they also found several minor artifacts.

ancrel.8093.b.en: They will have to go around.

ancrel.8103.a.zh: 安全第一。稳定这些遗迹。

ancrel.8103.b.en: They will have to go around.

ancrel.8110.desc.zh: 古老并且部分被翻译的记录已经在[From.Planet.GetName]上被挖掘的废墟中发现。[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说这份记录包含着一些能对我们科学家有益处的技术细节。
ancrel.8110.desc.en: Ancient, partially translated records have been discovered amongst the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName]. [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the records contain several technical specifications that may be of value to our scientists.

ancrel.8200.desc.zh:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

所有人都无能为力 —— 一瞬间，[dead_scientist.GetName] 和其他几个 [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] 被卷入了裂口，直接导致他们死亡。
ancrel.8200.desc.en:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

There was nothing anyone could have done - within moments, [dead_scientist.GetName] and several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were swept through the breach to their deaths.

ancrel.8201.desc.zh:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

一瞬间，几个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]被卷入了裂口，直接导致他们死亡。幸运的是，[Root.GetLeaderName]当时在空间站的不同区段，但这对调查工作来说仍是一个重大挫折。
ancrel.8201.desc.en:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

Within moments, several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were swept through the breach to their deaths. Fortunately, [Root.GetLeaderName] was in a different section of the station at the time, but this is nevertheless a significant setback for the investigation effort.

ancrel.8202.desc.zh:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

幸运的是，由于我们的团队能够逃到空间站未受影响的区域，事故中无人丧生。似乎也没有重要设备损坏，因此调查不会因此面临任何不应有的挫折。
ancrel.8202.desc.en:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

Fortunately, no lives were lost in the incident, as our team was able to escape to unaffected areas of the station. It seems no vital equipment was damaged either, so the investigation will not face any undue setbacks as a result.

ancrel.8202.desc.robot.zh:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

幸运的是，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]没有受到伤害，因为它们的建造出来就可以在太空中生存一段时间。因此，他们能够不受阻碍地继续他们的工作。
ancrel.8202.desc.robot.en:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

Fortunately, our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were unharmed, as they have been built to survive in open space for a time. They were therefore able continue their work undeterred.

ancrel.8203.A.zh: 我们将提供他们需要的所有资金。
ancrel.8203.A.en: We shall provide all the funding they need.

ancrel.8203.B.zh: 这会耽搁我们一段时间。

ancrel.8203.desc.zh:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

幸运的是，由于我们的团队能够逃到空间站未受影响的区域，事故中无人丧生。然而，减压的力量损坏了他们一直在工作的几个控制台，需要花费大量资金进行维修。
ancrel.8203.desc.en:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

Fortunately, no lives were lost in the incident, as our team was able to escape to unaffected areas of the station. However, the force of the decompression damaged several of the consoles they had been working on, and will cost a considerable amount to be repaired.

ancrel.8203.desc.robot.zh:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

幸运的是，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]没有受到伤害，因为它们的建造出来就可以在太空中生存一段时间。然而，减压的力量损坏了他们一直在工作的几个控制台，需要花费大量资金进行维修。
ancrel.8203.desc.robot.en:
$ancrel.8200.intro$

Fortunately, our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were unharmed, as they have been built to survive in open space for a time. However, the force of the decompression damaged several of the consoles they had been working on, and will cost a considerable amount to be repaired.

ancrel.8210.1.desc.zh: 我们对[fromfrom.planet.system.GetName]恒星系中空间站的遗迹开展了持续性研究，并在这个过程中发现了少量密藏的古董物品。首席考古学家[root.leader.GetName]在其中发现了几件稀有文物。
ancrel.8210.1.desc.en: Our continued study of the remnants of the station in the [fromfrom.planet.system.GetName] system has unearthed a small cache of antique objects. Chief archaeologist [root.leader.GetName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

ancrel.8210.2.desc.zh: 当我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]正在调查附近的控制台时，空间站的一部分墙壁突然倒塌。然而，事实证明我们撞了好运，收纳有几个稀有文物的隐藏隔间随即被发现了。
ancrel.8210.2.desc.en: A section of the station's walls suddenly collapsed as our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were investigating a nearby console. This proved a fortuitous event however, as a hidden compartment concealing several minor artifacts was revealed.

ancrel.8215.desc.zh: 查看空间站的电子设备时，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]之一意外触发了其创建者留下的一些仍然有效的安全措施。这导致了在部署正确的对策之前，我们的团队在很长一段时间内都被排除在空间站系统之外。
ancrel.8215.desc.en: As they were poking through the station's electronics, one of our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] accidentally triggered some still-functional security measures left by its creators. As a result, our team were locked out from the station's systems for a considerable time before the right countermeasures could be deployed.

ancrel.9.desc.zh: 奇怪的是，在[From.Planet.GetName]上很难通过三角定位确定档案库的位置——但我们一找到档案库，就很容易理解之前难以寻找它的原因了：这里的水晶档案库被人为破坏，里面已经没有我们可以访问的记录了。然而，我们在周边探测到了一个微弱的信号，或许希望依旧存在。
ancrel.9.desc.en: It was strangely difficult to triangulate the Archive on [From.Planet.GetName] - but once we did it was easy to see why it had been so elusive: the crystal has been shattered, and contains no records that we can access. However, hope persists as we have detected a faint signal somewhere nearby.

ancrel.9000.desc.zh:
初步发掘工作表明，该天体径直坠落在一个日益扩张的城市的顶部。不幸的是在撞击发生的那个时代，当地住民的技术大致才达到早期航天的水平。鉴于目前[From.Planet.GetName]上已经没有任何智慧物种，我们有理由认为这次撞击事件是开启这个文明终结之轮的钥匙。

目前尚不清楚这块巨石是被刻意坠落在这座城市的顶部，又或者仅仅是一场诡异的天外横祸。
ancrel.9000.desc.en:
Preliminary excavations indicate that the celestial object came straight down on top of a sprawling city. At the time of the impact the inhabitants were at a technological level on par with early spaceflight. As [From.Planet.GetName] currently does not sustain any sapient species, it is reasonable to assume the event was the beginning of the end of this civilization.

It is unclear whether the giant rock landed smack on top of the city by design, or if it is just a bizarre, catastrophic accident.

ancrel.9001.desc.zh: 我们已成功将伊拉斯人的文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对生命科学的见解将极大地帮助我们。
ancrel.9001.desc.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the Irassian artifacts into our research process. Their insights into biological research will greatly aid our own.

ancrel.9001.desc.phobe.zh: 尽管生物学领域的积累并未救伊拉斯人于水火，但是他们，毫无疑问，是这一方面的专家。我们的科学家已从他们的发现中吸取了富有价值的经验。
ancrel.9001.desc.phobe.en: Though it clearly did not save them, the Irassians were admittedly experts in the field of biology. Our scientists have adapted what was worthwhile from their findings.

ancrel.9010.desc.zh:
在开凿通往撞击区域中心的隧道时，我们很快就明白了这块巨大的太空岩石是如何撞击这座城市的。这个地方曾经是地空轨道缆绳的锚点，这是一架太空电梯，从行星一直通往小卫星。

由于某种事故，或者是工程部门的计算严重失误，缆绳把太空岩石拉得太紧，破坏了离心力平衡，刚好把卫星拉入了重力井。即使是超高密度的太空电梯结构也无法与重力相抗衡，仅能减缓卫星的下降速度，却无法阻止下坠。结果只能是巨石猛烈而无情地坠向下方这座无助的城市。
ancrel.9010.desc.en:
Tunneling to the center of the impact zone, it soon became evident how the giant space rock crashed on the city. The locality had been the anchor point of a surface-to-orbit tether: a space elevator leading from the planet all the way to the small moon.

Due to some accident - or a severe miscalculation done by the engineering department - the tether pulled the space rock too hard, upsetting the centrifugal forces and shifting the moon to just inside the gravity well. With gravity now the enemy, even the super-dense structure of the space elevator could only slow the moon's descent, not stop it. Menacingly, inexorably, the rock came crashing down on the helpless city below.

ancrel.9015.desc.zh:
卫星坠落的秘密已被解开。当然，它降落的城市已经完全被摧毁了，所以真相是在撞击区域外的一片被毁坏的郊区里被发现的。灾难发生前几小时录制的一个数字影像片段显示，夜空中出现了奇怪的灯光和电磁读数。一道明亮的闪光出现了，几分钟后，卫星慢慢地向这座注定要毁灭的城市下沉。

可以确定的是，[FromFrom.Planet.GetName]上出现了某种强大的外星文明的船只，并故意以极小的误差将卫星朝着行星表面推出了行星同步轨道。他们似乎故意放慢了卫星的下降速度，尽管我们不能确定这到底是因为他们有意保护世界上的其他地区以供自己后来殖民，抑或是大规模恐怖主义的心理战策略，还是完全别的什么事情。
ancrel.9015.desc.en:
The mystery of the crashed moon has been solved. The city it landed on was utterly destroyed, of course, so it was in a ruined suburb outside the impact zone that the revelation was found. A digital fragment, recorded mere hours before the calamity struck, spoke of strange lights and electromagnetic readings in the night sky. A bright flash was seen, and within minutes the moon was slowly descending towards the doomed city.

It is established, with a very small margin of error, that vessels of some powerful alien civilization appeared over [FromFrom.Planet.GetName] and deliberately nudged the moon out of its geosynchronous orbit and towards the surface. They appear to have deliberately slowed the moon's descent, although we cannot say if this was due to an intentional effort to preserve the rest of the world for their own later colonization, a psychological warfare tactic of mass terrorization, or something else entirely.

ancrel.9020.desc.zh:
它可能成为科学史上最大的愚蠢。深核样本表明，坠落卫星的中心是由高纯度的金属矿石构成的。垂涎于此，无视所有的逻辑和理性的工程原理，[FromFrom.Planet.GetName]上的人口建造了一台巨大比例的电磁铁。他们的意图似乎是把卫星拉进更近的轨道，以便更容易地开采其财富。

果然，磁铁被激活了，并把卫星拖向了[FromFrom.Planet.GetName]表面。但是太猛，太快了。居民们疯狂地试图逆转电磁光束，但只成功地减缓了金属球体的下降速度，而没有阻止它。卫星撞击行星的力量足以毁灭整个半球。之后，撞击产生的灰尘和碎片云遮蔽了太阳几十年，抹去了星球其他地方的所有生命。

他们想什么呢？！
ancrel.9020.desc.en:
It may go down as the biggest botch in scientific history. Deep core samples indicate that the center of the crashed moon was composed of highly pure metal ores. Coveting these, in defiance of all logic and sane engineering principles, the population of [FromFrom.Planet.GetName] constructed an electromagnet of gargantuan proportions. It seems their intent was to pull the moon in to a closer orbit in order to mine its riches more easily.

Sure enough, the magnet was activated and hauled the moon towards the surface of [FromFrom.Planet.GetName] - but too hard and too fast. The inhabitants frantically tried to reverse the electromagnetic beam, but succeeded only in slowing the metallic orb's descent, not stopping it. The moon crashed into the planet with enough force to wipe out the entire hemisphere. In the aftermath, the dust and debris cloud from the impact blotted out the sun for decades, which eradicated all life on the rest of the world.

What did they expect?!

ancrel.9025.desc.zh:
地表扫描结果显示，这颗行星被干燥的平原覆盖——大片地区覆盖着微小尘埃沉积物。通过对扫描数据的进一步分析表明，这些沉积物痕迹源自史前的大面积植被，而这些植被干涸死亡的速度非常不自然。

除此之外，许多干燥地面已经支离破碎，裸露出潜藏在地表下的巨大深邃的洞穴系统。这也使得这次考察旅行变成了一次洞穴探险！
ancrel.9025.desc.en:
Surface scans reveal the planet to be covered in desiccated flatlands - large areas covered in fine, dusty sediment. Analysis shows that the sediment traces are all that is left of extensive tracts of vegetation that must have died and dried out with unnatural speed.

Furthermore, many of the dry patches have crumbled to reveal a vast cave system just beneath the surface. This surveying trip just turned into a spelunking expedition!

ancrel.9030.desc.zh:
利用声纳测绘技术，我们成功地绘制出巨大的地下网络地图，最后我们发现所有的洞穴都是连通的。我们发现了一座巨大的隧道网络，它纵横交错地穿过整颗星球的整个地表。

除此之外，我们还有两个重大发现。首先，这个隧道系统不是自然形成的，而是被某种巨大的力量挖掘出来的。第二个发现则更令人忧心忡忡：地震仪读数表明，那下面仍有什么东西在继续挖掘洞窟。
ancrel.9030.desc.en:
Using sonar mapping to plot out the vast subterranean network, it eventually became evident that all the caves are interconnected. We have uncovered a massive web of tunnels that criss-crosses the entire surface of this world.

There have been two additional discoveries of notable importance. The first is that the tunnel system is not a natural formation, but rather has been excavated by some titanic force. The second discovery is even more alarming: seismographic readings prove that something is still burrowing down there.

ancrel.9035.desc.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]地壳里挖掘隧道——或者说是一路啃食地壳的始作俑者，竟是一条体型巨大的蠕虫型生物个体。它啃食地壳的过程正越来越慢，很可能是因为这条巨型蠕虫正饱受饥饿之苦。很显然，它便是杀死那些植物的元凶：当它在地表附近挖洞觅食时，就会分泌一种有机物消化酶，这种酶能够会渗入土壤，为这头野兽提供充足的养分。

这种蠕虫不是[From.Planet.GetName]的原生物种，然后到目前为止我们仍没有理清头绪，它是如何在这颗星球上走向灭亡的。
ancrel.9035.desc.en:
A single, worm-like creature of gargantuan proportions is responsible for the tunnels dug - or rather eaten - through the crust of [From.Planet.GetName]. The process is slowing down, most likely because the giant worm is slowly starving. It is responsible for the dead vegetation: once it fed by burrowing close to the surface and excreting an enzyme that broke down organic matter, which seeped into the soil to nourish the beast.

The worm is not indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName], and as yet we have no clue how it ended up on the planet.

ancrel.9040.desc.zh:
通过对这颗行星表面进一步扫描，我们发现了一座独立的人造结构。它似乎是一个古老的，被遗弃的外星设计的科学前哨站，它孤零零地屹立尘土飞扬的沙漠之中。

通过对研究日志进行的推测性翻译，我们发现其中提到了一件恐怖的生物武器。在被激活前，它能够一直潜伏在某颗星球的土壤中。在被激活之后，它便开始以毁灭性的速度吞噬整个生态系统。而那些不幸的物种们只能眼睁睁他们曾经翠绿的星球变成生命的荒漠。日志中还有一段不详记载……幼虫播种计划正在按计划进行，不久以后，星系中大多数已知的宜居行星都将拥有一只这样的“潜伏生物”。
ancrel.9040.desc.en:
Further scans of the planet's surface picked up a single artificial structure. It appears to be an old, abandoned science outpost of alien design, and it stands alone in a desert of dust and ash.

Speculatively translated research logs speak of a biological terror weapon, one that lies dormant in the soil of a planet until activated. It then begins to consume the whole ecosystem with devastating speed. The unfortunate beings living there see their once-verdant home turned inexorably into a lifeless desolation. One excerpt is particularly ominous: ... the larva seeding project is on schedule, and soon most of the known habitable planets in the galaxy will have a 'sleeper'.

ancrel.9045.desc.zh: 地层的中心位置是一座杂草丛生的通道，通向地下深处。由于多年前的构造变迁，这里荒草丛生，半埋在碎石中，难以通行，清理通道将是一项艰巨的任务。
ancrel.9045.desc.en: At the very heart of the formation lies an overgrown processional entrance leading deep underground. Choked with vegetation and half-buried in rubble from some tectonic shift ages past, the going is very hard, and clearing the passageway will be quite an undertaking.

ancrel.9050.desc.zh:
穿过坍塌的入口后，沿着隧道便可深入地下，尽管年代久远，但其构造却堪称完美。走到地下几公里处，前方豁然开朗，一个巨大的、完美的球形房间出现在眼前。在房间的正中央悬浮着一个神秘的外星装置：一块半透明的琥珀色立方体，六面都刻有复杂的外星图案。触摸碑文会使正方体散发出有节奏的光脉冲。

房间里或谜盒上没有任何已知的语言、代码或数学方程的痕迹，但可以相当有把握地认为这个盒子是某种谜题。
ancrel.9050.desc.en:
Once past the collapsed entrance, a tunnel bores deep into the earth, architecturally flawless despite its age. Kilometers down, it opens into a massive, perfectly spherical chamber. Floating in a suspension field at the very center is an inscrutable alien device: a semi-opaque, amber-tinted cube with intricate alien patterns inscribed on all six sides. Touching the inscriptions causes rhythmic pulses of light to be emitted from the cube.

There is no trace of any known language, code, or mathematical equation in the chamber or on the puzzle box itself, but it is fairly safe to assume that the box is a riddle of some kind.

ancrel.9055.desc.zh:
谜盒上的图案原来是物理学中描述的各种力的视觉抽象。在这一发现之后，解谜就变得很简单了。

在通过触控面板进行解锁后不久，这个谜盒就分解成闪烁的白色尘埃。片刻之后，高潮降临，整个会议厅开始轰隆作响，一块隐藏的墙板移到一边，出现了一间可称之为古代外星图书馆的密室，其藏品为最前沿的理论物理知识。

科学部门将为这一发现忙碌数年！
ancrel.9055.desc.en:
The patterns on the puzzle box turned out to be visual abstractions of various forces described in physics. After that revelation, solving the puzzle box was a simple matter.

Moments after unlocking the combination of tactile inputs required, the puzzle box disintegrated into flickering motes of incandescent dust. The event was fairly anti-climactic until moments later, the whole chamber started to rumble, and a hidden wall panel moved aside to reveal what could best be described as an ancient alien library of highly advanced theoretical physics.

The science division will be kept busy with this find for years!

ancrel.9060.desc.zh:
虽然非常抽象，但我们最终发现谜盒表面所刻画的图案竟然是我们所处的恒星星座。令人不安的是，刻画星座的视角处于我们的星系之外，因此图案也显得有些隐晦艰涩。一旦我们察觉到这一点，打开盒子便是手到擒来了。实际上，它的的确确就是一张地图。

当这个谜盒被解开，它就会投影出一个邻近恒星系统的全息影像，影像的焦点处于外部环带的一处特殊地点。远距离观测显示该处是一片异常密集的岩石碎片群，其中一些碎片的大小与甚至与大陆相当。经过仔细检查，这些碎片是一个完整星球的残骸，不知何故在许多亿年前就已经被摧毁了。

无论那里曾经存在过什么，指引着谜盒这一伟大造物导向的那个地方，都已经成为了过眼云烟归于虚无了。
ancrel.9060.desc.en:
Although wildly abstract, the patterns on the puzzle box's surface turned out to be stellar constellations. This was not immediately apparent because the viewpoint from which the constellations were depicted originates, ominously, from outside our own galaxy. Once that discovery had been made, unlocking the box was easy. It is, in fact, a map.

Once the puzzle box was solved, it lit up to reveal a holographic display of a nearby star system, focusing on a particular location in the outer belt. Observations of that point revealed an unusually dense cluster of rocky debris, some of it continental in size. Upon inspection it turned out to be the remaining fragments of an entire planet that was somehow destroyed many eons ago.

Whatever was there, and whatever inspired the construction of this grand edifice pointing the way, is long gone.

ancrel.9065.desc.zh:
解这个谜盒的确是一件相当痛苦的事。仅仅调整图样本身是不够的——它们还必须按照特定的顺序来解决，每一步的计算都会改变所有后续步骤的计算，排列方式几乎无穷无尽。我们在回溯上花了大量时间，但最后，谜盒解锁了。

当最后一个图样在咔嚓声中归位，谜盒爆裂成数百万个小光点。光亮在空中狂舞了片刻，随后汇聚成某种未知语言的文字。奇怪的是，所有目击这一事件的人似乎都不用知晓文字的含义就本能地理解了这一信息。在光亮永远黯淡之前，文字维持了几秒钟的时间，文字写道：你通过了最终试炼。我们将作出相应的回应。
ancrel.9065.desc.en:
Solving the puzzle box turned out to be quite an ordeal. Aligning the patterns themselves was not enough - they also had to be solved in a particular order, with the calculations of each step altering those of all subsequent ones, in nearly endless permutations. There was much time-consuming backtracking, but in the end, it was unlocked.

As the last pattern clicked into place, the puzzle box exploded into millions of tiny points of light. The lights danced madly in the air for a few moments, before coalescing to create words in some unknown language. Oddly, all witnesses to this event seemed to instinctively understand the message without knowing the words. For a few seconds, before flickering out forever, it read: You have passed the Trial. We shall respond accordingly.

ancrel.9070.desc.zh:
清理碎石是一项艰巨而危险的任务。工人和设备必须下吊数百米到挖掘点，而挖掘出的碎石又必须被吊出坑洞。在这种艰苦的条件下工作，伤亡和事故数不胜数，但我们也进展不断，每天都在向更深处进发。坑洞的侧壁因时光流逝而磨损开裂，但它们仍准确无误地笔直向下，直插行星地心。

坑洞深度依然只能猜测，因为其深处的某种物体干扰了我们所有的传感器读数。
ancrel.9070.desc.en:
Clearing away the rubble is a painstaking and risky business. Workers and equipment have to be hoisted down hundreds of meters to the dig site, and excavated rubble has to be lifted out. There have been numerous casualties and accidents while working in these trying conditions, but progress is being made, and every day we venture deeper. The walls of the crater are worn and cracked by time, but they plunge unerringly, straight down into the planet's core.

We can still only speculate how deep it goes, as something in the depths is garbling all our sensor readings.

ancrel.9075.desc.zh:
随着我们挖掘深入，挖掘点周围环境中有毒物质含量也不断上升，挖掘工作因此受到延误。部分坑道中存在危险剂量的辐射，很可能是由最初产生这一坑洞的灾难性事件造成的。

我们不得不采用了一些防护措施并配发了消毒器械，工程进度因此而被延缓。
ancrel.9075.desc.en:
The excavation has hit delays as the dig site becomes increasingly toxic the deeper we go. Parts of the shaft are dangerously irradiated, probably by the catastrophic event that dug out the crater in the first place.

The need for protective countermeasures and decontamination apparatus is slowing progress on the work.

ancrel.9080.desc.zh:
最后，我们终于到达了坑洞的底部，并在这里有了一个惊人的发现：一艘由外星人设计，经历了再入大气时几乎能熔化船体的高温，又经历了可怕的撞击，但其形体依然清晰可辨的先进飞船。尽管在灾难性的降落过程后被数千吨的碎岩掩埋，飞船仍完好无损。这艘飞船被发现时船头朝下，由此引出一种假设，认为飞船曾以极高的速度径直穿入行星。我们可能永远也不会知道原因了。

该飞船维持结构完整性的方法仍有待商榷，但最为可信的理论是，飞船被某种形式的先进能量场所包围，远远超出我们目前的技术。这艘飞船曾在火光中划过天空，如炮弹一般射穿地壳，直到摩擦耗尽飞船的动能，最终就这样停留在黑暗之中。
ancrel.9080.desc.en:
