When the crew of the [Root.GetName] unsealed the pod, they found a stash of alien jewelry made out of precious metals.

anomaly.3050.a.zh: 将声音分离出来并进行研究。
anomaly.3050.a.en: Isolate and study the alien sounds.

anomaly.3050.b.en: Make preparations for salvaging the mineral bands.

anomaly.3050.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]遍布着此起彼伏的矿物复合带，用高耸且富有弹性的架子高悬于其本就十分崎岖的表面上。由于经常受到气流的扰动，摆动的架子和层叠的带状物互相摩擦，产生了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无法听到的声波。

科研专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称将此声波从星球的背景噪音中分离出来时遇到了困难，同时也提出如果有意进行开采，建议将矿物带破坏，从而由[Root.Owner.GetName]进行回收利用。
anomaly.3050.desc.en:
[From.GetName] is crisscrossed by overlapping mineral-composite bands that are elevated above the harsh surface by tall, flexible pylons. Constantly agitated by atmospheric winds, these pylons sway and the overlapping bands rub together to produce sonic waves at what are - to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - inaudible frequencies.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports some difficulty in isolating this audio from the natural background noise of the planet, but notes that the mineral bands could - should we so choose - be broken down and efficiently recycled by the [Root.Owner.GetName].

anomaly.3055.b.tooltip.en:
Adds the Unbalanced Ecosystem modifier to [From.GetName]:
£food£ -20%

anomaly.3055.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]是一颗生态丰富的热带星球。对其表面植被的近距离分析却表明其生物异常缺乏多样性，一种特殊的高大树木成为了生态系统的主体部分。

虽说这种树木本身并不会造成什么危害，但其单一的主导地位却会对该星球小型动物的生存带来不利影响，若要进行殖民，想在其表面有效率地培育农作物也会异常困难。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]作为享有盛誉的外星生物学专家，制定了重新平衡此星球生态系统的计划。
anomaly.3055.desc.en:
[From.GetName] is a tropical planet with a thriving biosphere. A close analysis of surface flora reveals an unexpected lack of diversity, as one particular family of tall trees dominate the ecosystem.

Though not harmful in and of themselves, their monocultural hegemony appears to have a detrimental effect on the survivability of the planet's small animals, and it would be difficult to efficiently cultivate food crops on the surface should colonization ever be attempted.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], a xeno-biologist of some repute, has put together a plan for re-balancing this alien biosphere.

anomaly.3056.desc.zh: 平衡已恢复了——或许是首次达到了。[Root.GetName]的放射射线消除了长久以来覆盖了这颗星球的那些多年生木本植物的繁殖能力。还有一些树木被彻底烧成了灰烬，以求尽快达到真正的平衡。
anomaly.3056.desc.en: Balance has been restored - or perhaps achieved for the first time - as large swathes of the dominant perennials have been rendered infertile by targeted radiation emissions from the [Root.GetName]. Additional specimens have been reduced to ash to further hasten the arrival of a truer equilibrium.

anomaly.3057.a.zh: 也许我们本不该介入的。
anomaly.3057.a.en: Perhaps we should have known better than to meddle.

anomaly.3057.a.tooltip.zh: 危险野生动物现已遍布[From.From.GetName]。

anomaly.3057.desc.zh:
激进地消灭一直以来覆盖着[From.From.GetName]的树木造成了意想不到的后果。

之前被这些树木搞得生计艰难的小动物们数量急剧上升，也越发富有攻击意愿——或者说是变得更加野蛮了。被隔离开来的焦土曾是茂密森林的所在，现在却成了领地争端的战场。
anomaly.3057.desc.en:
The inelegant elimination of wide swathes of the dominant trees on [From.From.GetName] have had unintended consequences.

The small animals that previously suffered under the perennial tyranny of the trees are growing both more plentiful and more aggressive - some would say savage. The isolated ashen fields that used to be home to lush forests now play host to heated territory battles.

anomaly.3060.b.zh: 这么明显的陷阱，我们可不会上当。
anomaly.3060.b.en: We will not take the obvious bait.

anomaly.3060.c.zh: 任何剩余的有机生物都将被消灭。
anomaly.3060.c.en: If there are any organics left they will be terminated.

anomaly.3060.desc.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称，我们犯了个愚蠢的错误，在[From.GetName]沙漠看到的沙海涟漪其实是启动的飞船推进器造成的。

有一艘外星飞船头朝下埋没在沙海中，其断断续续工作的推进系统在上方的沙丘激起了阵阵波涛。看来这玩意已经困在这里有段时间了，它在推进器的作用下渐渐插进了沙丘深处。[Root.GetName]没有能够将此船吊出的设备与方法，[Root.GetLeaderName]建议派遣一只飞船到[From.GetName]，以对其进行发掘。
anomaly.3060.desc.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the waves seen rippling across the sandy seas of [From.GetName] are, bizarrely enough, the result of active ship thrusters.

An alien vessel lies buried in the sand nose-down, its sputtering propulsion systems weakly agitating the dunes above. It appears to have been down there for some time, slowly driving itself deeper into the desert dunes. The [Root.GetName] lacks the means to excavate the struggling ship, and [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends sending a military vessel to [From.GetName] to unearth it.

anomaly.3061.a.en: A fresh commission for the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] fleet.

anomaly.3061.desc.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]终于成功将外星飞船打捞了出来。

但它是空的，或者可以说，被拆的什么都没剩了。

原船员一定是将不是很重要的东西全拆掉后便弃船而去，留下这艘空壳在[From.From.GetName]沉没。[Root.GetFleetName]的工程师忙活了好一阵子，终于将其能量补充完毕并重启了飞船。
anomaly.3061.desc.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] eventually succeeds in raising the submerged alien vessel.

It is empty. Almost stripped bare, in fact.

Its crew must have abandoned ship before it was left to burrow into the particulate surface of [From.From.GetName], and they took most of the ship's non-critical internals with them. The engineers of the [Root.GetFleetName] have managed to essentially hotwire the vessel, and have replenished its dwindling energy stores.

anomaly.3062.desc.zh: [Root.GetFleetName]使用高强度拉索最终成功打捞起了沉没的外星飞船，却同时也听到了其武器系统启动的轰鸣声！
anomaly.3062.desc.en: The [Root.GetFleetName]'s high-tensile wires eventually managed to raise the submerged alien vessel, only to be met by the recognizable whirring of weapons systems powering up!

anomaly.3063.desc.zh:
回收行动失败了。[Root.GetFleetName]绕在舰船上的高强度拉索在向上提拉时的瞬间就将腐蚀殆尽的舰体切成了数段。

单独的碎块回收起来还相对容易，但整个飞船已变成了废铁。
anomaly.3063.desc.en:
The salvage attempt failed. The high-tensile tethers that the [Root.GetFleetName] had wrapped around the burrowing ship effortlessly sliced through the vessel's corroded hull as raising was attempted.

The individual pieces were then relatively easy to retrieve, but the whole thing is reduced to scrap.

anomaly.3065.a.zh: 也许我们可以一窥深空的生活。
anomaly.3065.a.en: Perhaps we can learn something about life in deep space.

anomaly.3065.b.zh: 也许我们可以一窥深空的生活。
anomaly.3065.b.en: Perhaps we can learn something useful about life in deep space.

anomaly.3065.desc.zh:
一个拼凑的通讯中继器被很外行地绑在了[From.GetName]上。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这是海盗通信网络的一部分。初步分析表明通信内容并不包含什么敏感的战术信息，只是些海盗船船员间的寻常通话。
anomaly.3065.desc.en:
A cobbled-together comms repeater has been inexpertly strapped to [From.GetName].

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is confident that this is part of a relay network for pirate communications. Initial analysis indicates that the messages relayed are not of a particularly strategically sensitive nature, but rather private inter-ship communications between individual crewmembers.

anomaly.3070.desc.zh:
读数来自于一个小型金属舱，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]判定这是一艘远古外星救生艇。

这东西显然是许久以前就被黑洞外围的引力井困在此处，因为角度问题无法弹射出来——至于这是故意为之还是偶然至此尚不得而知——救生艇的推进器从那时起就一直在竭力逃离黑洞视界。目前它已离黑洞视界太近，无法进行回收了。

[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告突然中断，随后[Root.GetName]船员发来通讯称，该科学专员浑身颤抖，似乎是对此救生艇的悲惨命运感到十分难过。
anomaly.3070.desc.en:
The readings originate from a small metal pod; Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has determined it to be a lifeboat of ancient and alien make.

Evidently caught on the outskirts of the black hole's gravity well eons ago, at an angle just short of a slingshot maneuver - whether this was the intent or happenstance is difficult to judge - and the pod's automated thrusters have been fighting its descent to the event horizon ever since. It is now too close to the horizon to salvage.

[Root.GetLeaderName]'s report ends abruptly, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] communicate that the Science Officer appears shaken and deeply troubled by the tragic fate of the lifeboat.

anomaly.3070.desc.mach.zh:
读数来自于一个小型金属舱，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]判定这是一艘远古外星救生艇。

这东西显然是许久以前就被黑洞外围的引力井困在此处，因为角度问题无法弹射出来——至于这是故意为之还是偶然至此尚不得而知——救生艇的推进器从那时起就一直在竭力逃离黑洞视界。目前它已离黑洞视界太近，无法进行回收了。

[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告突然中断，随后[Root.GetName]船员发来通讯称，该科学专员似乎深受这一新数据的影响，因其已显著改变了[Root.GetName]的风险评估统计与生存率预测。
anomaly.3070.desc.mach.en:
The readings originate from a small metal pod; Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has determined it to be a lifeboat of ancient and alien make.

Evidently caught on the outskirts of the black hole's gravity well eons ago, at an angle just short of a slingshot maneuver - whether this was the intent or happenstance is difficult to judge - and the pod's automated thrusters have been fighting its descent to the event horizon ever since. It is now too close to the horizon to salvage.

[Root.GetLeaderName]'s report ends abruptly, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] communicate that the Science Officer appears deeply affected by this new data, as it has significantly altered the [Root.GetName]'s risk assessment statistics and survival rate predictions.

anomaly.3075.a.zh: 我们可以从中学到很多东西。
anomaly.3075.a.en: There is much we could learn.

anomaly.3075.desc.zh:
惊人的是，此系统获取的数据居然是来自[From.GetName]本身。

作为黑洞来说，其体积较小，似乎可以解释为何会有辐射从其视界逃逸出来。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为此黑洞正在崩解，不久便会消失，但很难说这个过程会不会在宇宙的热寂之前完成。

用[Root.GetLeaderName]的话说，黑洞幼年期受到的重力扰动搞得它“动荡不安”，从而进一步加强了其视界流出的能源。
anomaly.3075.desc.en:
The readings picked up in the this system come - somewhat surprisingly - from [From.GetName] itself.

As black holes go it is fairly small, which could account for some of the unexpected radiation leaking from its event horizon. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that the black hole is on its way to "bleeding out" and will eventually disappear entirely - though it is difficult to say whether this process would be complete before the heat death of the universe.

Some gravitational upset in the hole's youth has rendered it - to quote [Root.GetLeaderName] - "wobbly," further increasing the flow of energy from its event horizon.

anomaly.3080.a.zh: 也许我们应该建立据点并进行观察。
anomaly.3080.a.en: Perhaps we should establish a foothold and observe.

anomaly.3080.desc.zh:
虽说[From.GetName]上的大部分建筑都已成废墟，但还有少数得以留存。[Root.GetName]初次经过该星球时只发现了一座还算完整的建筑，孤零零地耸立在[From.GetName]的废墟之中。

这便是噪音的来源。

该建筑不仅结构完整，据科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]称，似乎还存在活动迹象。

那是一座生产设施，专门将塑料聚合物制成不明的物体，不过似乎是用于装饰的。其生产原料与最终产品对[Root.Owner.GetName]来说没有研究价值，但我们可以对其自动化的生产过程进行研究。
anomaly.3080.desc.en:
There are structures on [From.GetName], though most are less than ruins and more akin to rubble. The [Root.GetName]'s initial pass over the planet reveals only one building that can be considered intact, seemingly spared whatever calamity robbed [From.GetName] of its buildings and builders alike.

This is the source of the noise.

Not only is the building intact, reports Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], but it is active.

It is a production facility of some sort, turning plasticine polymers into mute objects of uncertain, but possibly ornamental, purpose. The raw materials and end product are largely uninteresting to the [Root.Owner.GetName], but we could doubtlessly stand to learn something from the automated manufacturing process itself.

anomaly.3085.desc.zh:
巨大的[From.GetName]周围的缓轨道上漂浮着一个可移动的数据库。[Root.GetName]将其打捞后发现其中似乎包含某种外星语言写就的内容。其词汇组成并非完全陌生，但其语法则是十分复杂。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议对其进行进一步研究，以便解密该文本的内容与起源。
anomaly.3085.desc.en:
In gentle orbit around the massive [From.GetName] floats a portable databank. Scooped up by the [Root.GetName], it is found to contain text in some alien language. The vocabulary is not wholly unfamiliar, but the syntax is disconcertingly complex.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends a more thorough study to decipher the text's contents and origins.

anomaly.3086.a.zh: 这秘密还是不要说出去了——不需要让他们知道的。
anomaly.3086.a.en: Let us divine its secrets - they need not know.

anomaly.3086.b.zh: 我们要物归原主。联络他们。
anomaly.3086.b.en: We will return it to its proper owners. Hail them.

anomaly.3086.c.zh: 他们的文笔如此空洞，思维自然也不堪一击。联络他们。
anomaly.3086.c.en: Their prose is pedestrian, their ideas weak. Hail them.

anomaly.3086.desc.zh:
该文本的标题大致可以译为“地区统治者”，通篇似乎是以[book_writer.GetSpeciesAdj]古方言写就，该方言一般使用于[book_writer.GetName]。

内容无疑对他们具有一定历史价值，搞不好还能带来些什么启发。
anomaly.3086.desc.en:
The text - its title roughly translates to "Regional Ruler" - is written in a presumably ancient dialect of the [book_writer.GetSpeciesAdj] tongue spoken in the [book_writer.GetName].

The text is doubtlessly of some historical import to them, and might contain valuable insights.

anomaly.3087.desc.zh:
我们听说你找到了《君主论》的最后一份拷贝。这可是我们社会十分重要的历史文化遗产。
我们曾以为它已在多年前的海盗袭击中被毁掉了，但它如今能落入文明人的手中，我们倍感欣慰。

可以将其交还给我们吗？我们会以能量币作为报酬。
anomaly.3087.desc.en:
We understand that you have found the only surviving copy of "The Prince," a text of significant historical and cultural importance to our people.
We thought it irrevocably lost to a pirate raid years ago, but we are grateful to see that it found its way into civilized hands.

Will you return it to us? We will gladly transfer some Energy Credits for your trouble.

anomaly.3088.a.zh: 不。说起来，我们认为这东西不怎么样。
anomaly.3088.a.en: No. In fact, we think it is bad.

anomaly.3088.b.zh: 不。这些文字正是骗子的工具。
anomaly.3088.b.en: No. The written word is the tool of liars.

anomaly.3088.c.zh: 带着你的书一起下地狱吧。
anomaly.3088.c.en: You and your words will be destroyed.

anomaly.3088.desc.zh:
我们听说你找到了《君主论》的最后一份拷贝。这可是我们社会十分重要的历史文化遗产。

我们曾以为它已在多年前的海盗袭击中被毁掉了，但它如今能落入文明人的手中，我们倍感欣慰。

可以将其交还给我们吗？
anomaly.3088.desc.en:
We understand that you have found the only surviving copy of "The Prince," a text of significant historical and cultural importance to our people.

We thought it irrevocably lost to a pirate raid years ago, but we are grateful to see that it found its way into civilized hands.

Will you return it to us?

anomaly.3089.desc.zh:
绝不容许你批判我们的文学！

你们会后悔的！
anomaly.3089.desc.en:
You can't criticize our literature!

You will regret this!

anomaly.3090.b.zh: 也许是陷阱——最好不要以身犯险。
anomaly.3090.b.en: It could be a trap - best leave it be.

anomaly.3090.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]和缓的运行轨道上竟漂浮着一枚紧急信标。其外壳已被严重损坏，似乎是被武器火力击中或是被大爆炸波及。

这似乎是来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的民用飞船专属型号——用于在通讯系统故障时作为紧急措施进行发射——但其受损的严重程度使具体情况都不得而知了。

它一直在重复一个微弱而失真的信号。
anomaly.3090.desc.en:
An emergency transmission buoy floats in gentle orbit around [From.GetName]. Its outer casing is heavily damaged, seemingly by glancing weapons fire or a powerful explosion.

It might be a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] model for civilian ships - designed to be ejected as an emergency measure should the comms systems fail - but the extent of the damage makes it impossible to know for certain.

It is repeating a weak, distorted signal.

anomaly.3091.a.zh: 这里是[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。请亮明身份。

anomaly.3091.b.zh: 彻底关掉。这件事到此为止。
anomaly.3091.b.en: Shut it down. No one is to speak of this.

anomaly.3091.desc.zh: 信标已确定来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]，其发射的信号已趋于稳定。
anomaly.3091.desc.en: The buoy has been verified as one of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] make, and the signal it's relaying has been stabilized.

anomaly.3092.a.response.zh:
他们……我、我听他们好像自称星际什么来着？星际绑架者是吧？

他们可不是善茬。如果他们认为不能从[Root.GetName]手中得到些什么来换取我们的性命就会干掉我们。我偷听到他们已经在讨论要开什么条件了……
anomaly.3092.a.response.en:
They, I- I think they call themselves the ransomers? The Ransomeers?

At any rate they're a vile bunch, we'd all be dead already if they didn't think they could get something for us from the [Root.GetName]. I've overhead them discussing their demands...

anomaly.3092.desc.zh:
有、有人吗？这里是[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]民用运输船“卢克西昂号”的舰长。

啊，应该说是前舰长。卢克西昂已经不复存在了。我们被海盗登船，我们在飞船爆炸前就被掳走成了人质。
anomaly.3092.desc.en:
He- hello? This is the captain of the Luxion, a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] civilian transport.

Uh, former captain. The Luxion is gone. We were boarded by pirates and taken captive before they blew up the ship.

anomaly.3093.desc.zh:
什么？什么？！你们不能见死不救！

要是他们认为不能用我们向[Root.GetName]索取赎金的话，绝对会连眼都不眨就宰了我们的！就连真的付了赎金的话我们的性命也没有保障啊！你们不能——
anomaly.3093.desc.en:
What? What? You can't. You can't not save us!

If they get it into their heads that they won't be able to ransom us back to the [Root.GetName] they won't hesitate to kill us. They'll probably kill us even if the ransom is paid! You can't--

anomaly.3094.a.zh: 位置已记录于情报日志。
anomaly.3094.a.en: Position recorded in the Situation Log.

anomaly.3094.desc.zh:
哦，真是太感谢了，太感谢了啊！[Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们似乎被关在某个空间站，但具体位置我也不知道。

我这就加强传输频率，你们应该可以通过紧急信标进行三角测量，确认我们被绑架的位置……
anomaly.3094.desc.en:
Oh thank you! Thank you, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We're being held in some space station, but I have no idea where we are beyond that.

I will increase the transmission burst now, it should let you triangulate the location of this prison from the emergency buoy...

anomaly.3095.a.zh: 打开通讯系统。必须让被囚者做好准备。
anomaly.3095.a.en: Open comms. The captives need to be ready.

anomaly.3095.desc.zh:
虽说海盗的基地十分隐蔽，但若知道如何寻找的话就十分明显了。

一支舰队排着奇怪的队形慢慢从重新运行的采矿设施后慢悠悠飘了出来——显然是并没想到会有不速之客。
anomaly.3095.desc.en:
The pirate base, while fairly inconspicuous, is obvious when you know what to look for.

A fleet in confused formation slowly drifts out from behind the re-purposed mining complex - they were obviously not expecting company.

anomaly.3096.desc.zh:
你好啊，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。看来这一切都是因为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的飞船而起的了？

我们好客的主人们似乎即将离开他们当前的位置。登上这地方对各方都不利，但是……如果你直接对基地发起攻击，我觉得我们倒是可以拼一拼，看看能不能弄到一艘救生艇。

我们出来的时候可别把我们给炸飞了！
anomaly.3096.desc.en:
Hello again, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. I take it [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships are the cause of all this commotion?

Our hosts seem about ready to leave their posts. Boarding this place would probably end badly for everyone involved, but... If you attack the base directly, I think we can make a break for one of the lifeboats.

Please try not to blow us up on our way out!

anomaly.3098.a.zh: 我们绝不会忘记这个悲剧。
anomaly.3098.a.en: We will never forget this tragedy.

anomaly.3098.desc.zh: 索取赎金的海盗们的基地被摧毁了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的俘虏们也一道消失了。俘虏们似乎成功联系到了发动进攻的外星飞船，却被对方忽视了。
anomaly.3098.desc.en: The Ransomeer pirate base has been destroyed, and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] prisoners along with it. It appears the captives managed to hail the alien ships that attacked, but were ignored.

anomaly.3098.name.zh: 星际绑架者：尘归尘，土归土

anomaly.3099.desc.zh:
[From.From.GetName]的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏在交战中成功逃出，目前已登上一艘救生艇，即将与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]救援飞船接头。
anomaly.3099.desc.en:
Military action by the [From.From.GetName] has destroyed the Ransomeer forces.

The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives made a successful escape attempt during the attack, and are now safely on board a lifeboat well on its way to be a rendezvous [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] rescue vessels.

anomaly.3099.name.zh: 星际绑架者：意外的救星

anomaly.310.desc.zh: [From.GetName]大气上方发现了一个小型航空殖民地。该殖民地似乎是自给自足的，船上仍存在数个不同种群的残骸。根据目前掌握的情况推断，该殖民群落是多个世纪以前进行的一项社会实验，最终却以自相残杀收场。我们已经下载了殖民地有限的数据库中的全部数据。
anomaly.310.desc.en:
A small aerostat colony was found floating just above the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to have been self-sufficient, and remains from several different species were found on board.

As best as we can tell, the colony was some kind of social experiment conducted centuries ago that ultimately ended with the colonists massacring each other. We have downloaded all of the data found in the colony's limited databanks.

anomaly.3100.a.zh: 真是神秘而偶然的遭遇啊。

anomaly.3100.desc.zh:
不知何方发起的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏们奇迹般地逃出生天，在攻击行动中偷去了一艘救生艇，即将返回[Root.Capital.GetName]。
anomaly.3100.desc.en:
Military action by an unknown force destroyed the Ransomeer pirates.

Miraculously, the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives managed to break out and steal a lifeboat during the attack, and are now well on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName].

anomaly.3101.desc.zh:
海盗的基地在我方飞船造成的连锁效应中缓慢地分崩离析。与此同时，我们开始了对卢克西昂号生还者的搜索。

如果他们真的上了救生艇，现在也该联络我们了……
anomaly.3101.desc.en:
As the pirate base slowly tears itself apart in a savage chain reaction instigated by our military vessels, the search for the captive crew of the Luxion begins.

If they made it to a lifeboat, they should be attempting to hail us by now...

anomaly.3101.name.en: The Ransomeers: Picking Up the Pieces

anomaly.3102.desc.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，这里是卢西安号的船员。

计划进行得十分顺利。在你们展开对基地的袭击后，卫兵们都跑上船了，于是我们也成功破坏了囚室大门。救生艇无人看守，看来你们给这群海盗造成了不小的麻烦，完全没人注意到我们逃跑了。
anomaly.3102.desc.en:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], this is the crew of the Luxion.

The plan went off without a hitch. Once you started bombarding the base directly, the guards took to their ships, and we were able to break down the cell door. The lifeboats were unguarded, and it seems you kept the pirates busy enough that they did not care much about our escape.

anomaly.3103.desc.en:
Hel-


-re no lifeboats, we-


-andoned, collapse im-





------------------------

anomaly.3104.desc.zh:
被关押的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]最终未能逃出海盗基地。我们并未能确认他们到底是如何死亡的——是救生艇未能成功发射，还是他们压根没有逃出囚室——但这不妨碍我们确认他们已死亡的事实。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]们一定会十分感激[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]采取的迅速行动，但感觉他们短时间内也不会遗忘这出惨剧。
anomaly.3104.desc.en:
The kidnapped [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] never made it off the pirate base. We are unable to determine exactly where they met their end - if the lifeboat failed to launch, or if they never made it out of their holding cell - but fact remains that they are dead.

The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people are sure to appreciate the swift actions undertaken by the [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the [Root.GetName], but they are also unlikely to soon forget this tragedy.

anomaly.3105.desc.zh:
卢克西昂号的船员安全的回到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，一场灾难就此避免，[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]的果断行动让[Root.GetAdj]人民十分自豪。

海盗的绑架勒索事件已经成功划上句点，海盗团也被消灭了，但还有一些事没搞清楚，比如被俘虏的人声称他们在被抓后曾经从飞船窗口中看到了更大型的海盗舰队。从目前情况来看，可以确定威胁比我们实际看到的还要大的多。

进行这次勒索行动的家伙们已经被处理了。
anomaly.3105.desc.en:
With the crew of the Luxion safely on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName], disaster has been averted. The [Root.GetAdj] people are sure to glory in the decisive actions of the [Root.GetName]'s [Root.GetRulerTitle].

The situation with the kidnapping Ransomeer pirates, as well as the pirate band itself, has come to an end. Some questions remain, mainly relating to the much larger piratical navy the captives claim to have seen through portholes shortly after their capture. But, considering the circumstances, it can safely be assumed that the threat appeared to be much greater than it actually was.

The Ransomeers are over and done with.

anomaly.3110.b.zh: 死人的话有什么好听的。
anomaly.3110.b.en: We have little to gain by listening to the dead.

anomaly.3110.c.en: Raze the monument, find the transmitter.

anomaly.3110.desc.zh:
不出所料，[Root.GetName]成功定位了[From.GetName]信号的来源。

虽说整颗星球看似完全未被外星生物开发过，不过星球南半球一座山丘顶部却发现了一座光滑的白色矿物柱体。信号正是从该柱体中发出，柱体也明显是为了避免共振而设计。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已停下手边工作，开始筹备特殊项目，以期能够解密该信号携带的信息。
anomaly.3110.desc.en:
As expected, the [Root.GetName] has located the source of the transmission emanating from [From.GetName].

While the planet is otherwise seemingly untouched by alien hands, a lone monolith of some sleek off-white mineral stands atop a hill in the southern hemisphere. It is from within this monument that the signal emerges, the enclosure clearly built for longevity rather than resonance.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has gone out of their way to establish the parameters for a Special Project that would decode the information the signal carries.

anomaly.3111.desc.zh:
我们原以为所发现的巨石只是发射器的保护性外壳，但事实并非如此。

在被单独取出后，发射器本身毫无用处。已被摧毁的巨石有某种内部结构，能够使其运转。现在我们已经无法恢复其功能了。
anomaly.3111.desc.en:
We believed the monolith to be only a protective housing for the transmitter, but we were wrong.

The transmitter, once isolated, turned out to be useless on its own. Something about the internal structure of the now-razed monolith made it work, and we have no hope of restoring its function.

anomaly.3112.b.zh: 很不幸，这算不上什么新闻。

anomaly.3112.desc.zh: 出人意料，巨石很轻易地就被解体。与最初的猜想相反，其中心的小型发射器为巨石的矿质结构供能，使得信号发射得以进行。
anomaly.3112.desc.en: The monolith disassembles with surprising ease. Contrary to earlier assumptions, the tiny transmitter at its center energizes the mineral structure of the monolith, enabling the transmission.

anomaly.3113.b.zh: 计算舰队残骸的轨道与当前位置。
anomaly.3113.b.en: Calculate the wrecked fleet's trajectory and current position.

anomaly.3113.desc.zh:
科学专员[From.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.From.GetName]发出的信号已经解密完成了。

这是一段记录性质的信息，记载了千年前一场造成数百人死亡的战斗。一支原本坚定的联盟由于背叛与欺骗最终分崩离析，他们的大型舰队在敌人到来之前就自相残杀殆尽。

看来这些残骸作为墓碑被保留在了这里。敌人精准地命中了舰体的弱点，而船员们在那个时候就被消灭了。
anomaly.3113.desc.en:
Science Officer [From.GetLeaderName] reports that the signal broadcast by the transmission beacon on [From.From.GetName] has been decoded.

It is a memorial message, decrying the loss of hundreds of lives in a battle millennia past. A stalwart alliance apparently fell victim to treachery and deceit, and a massive fleet wiped itself out before the enemy had even arrived, as ally turned on ally.

Apparently these desiccated hulks were left in place as floating grave-markers, the crews having been destroyed by surgical strikes to weak points in their ships' hulls.

anomaly.3114.desc.zh:
到达[From.GetName]星系后，显而易见，[Root.GetName]来得太迟了。

不久前一支来路不明的海盗舰队发现了这片战场并将其拆除，用所得的材料在附近一颗小行星上建立了基地。

我们的研究宣告结束，看来一场好斗冲突已不可避免。
anomaly.3114.desc.en:
Upon arriving in the [From.GetName] system, it becomes clear that the [Root.GetName] is too late.

A pirate fleet of unknown origin discovered the straying battlefield some time ago, and cannibalized it to build a base on a nearby asteroid.

Our search ends, as a violent confrontation seems unavoidable.

anomaly.3115.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]已找到了[From.GetName]星系内漂移的残骸。信息中提到的飞船许多已在长年侵蚀下化为尘埃，但仍有少数保存得相当完整。

其中有六艘可以让工程师进行抢修。

打开情报日志以查看详情。
anomaly.3115.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the drifting wrecks in the [From.GetName] system. Many of the ships referenced in the memorial beacon message have been reduced to dust and ashes over the centuries, but a few still remain remarkably intact.

Between them, six military vessels should have enough engineers to restore the better-preserved hulks to working order.

Consult the Situation Log for details.

anomaly.3116.a.tooltip.en: The Ancient Alliance fleet is restored.

anomaly.3116.desc.zh:
部分古代舰队残骸已恢复运转，尽管派去的工程师无法对如何完成这一点达成一致。

舰队已经收编入[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]舰队。
anomaly.3116.desc.en:
The ancient rag-tag armada has been partially resurrected, although the dispatched engineers cannot agree on exactly how this feat was accomplished.

The vessels have been commissioned into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] fleets.

anomaly.3120.desc.zh: 威胁已被终结。或许，我们至少能部分利用起被海盗抢走的古老科技。
anomaly.3120.desc.en: The threat is ended. We might, at least, be able to make some use of the ancient technology the pirates plundered.

anomaly.3125.a.zh: 我们对异种残骸没有兴趣。
anomaly.3125.a.en: We have no interest in xeno wreckage.

anomaly.3125.b.zh: 我们重建这个太空港吧。

anomaly.3125.desc.zh:
该轨道站似乎曾作为小行星的矿物开采与加工中心使用，设计上与我们的开采站有些许相似。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为派出几位工程师——最好是已经驻扎在飞船上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——也许就可以使其恢复运转。
anomaly.3125.desc.en:
The orbital station appears to have once functioned as a mineral extraction and processing center for the asteroid, not wholly dissimilar from our own mining station designs.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] expects that a handful of engineers - ideally [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] already stationed on military vessels - just might be able to restore the station to working order.

anomaly.3126.desc.zh: 工程师们完成了任务，使用改装过的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]部件与控制机制翻修了这座破旧的开采站。
anomaly.3126.desc.en: The engineering corps completed their mission, retrofitting the decrepit mining station with adapted [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] parts and control mechanisms.

anomaly.3127.a.2.zh: 还有很多值得研究的地方。
anomaly.3127.a.2.en: There is much we can learn.

anomaly.3127.desc.2.zh:
$anomaly.3126.desc$

对于这个空间站最初的功能我们仍然还有很多不了解的地方。看来这里最初用于开采和精炼某些其它的资源，而非我们所感兴趣的矿物生产。以上推测还需进一步调查才能确认。
anomaly.3127.desc.2.en:
$anomaly.3126.desc$

There remain some aspects of the station's original function that are not entirely clear to us. It appears the manufactory was originally intended to mine and refine something other than the production minerals we are interested in. This bears further investigation.

anomaly.3127.desc.3.zh:
$anomaly.3126.desc$

我们接到报告，从工厂的加工室中回收到某种未知物质——也许这个开采站曾经开采并精炼过我们从没见过的矿物。
anomaly.3127.desc.3.en:
$anomaly.3126.desc$

We have received reports of an unknown substance recovered from the manufactory's processing chambers - it is possible that the station once mined and refined something other than the minerals we concern ourselves with.

anomaly.3128.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]工程师们的探索一无所获。这个太空港过于破旧，已无法再次启动，很多建筑结构在尝试启动时就直接崩塌了。

在工厂坍塌的同时，有什么东西从地底下爬了出来——它们用高能激光器切开了一条通路，直勾勾地瞪着[Root.GetFleetName]。
anomaly.3128.desc.en:
The [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] engineers' prodding and probing has proven fruitless. The station is too dilapidated to bring online, large sections of the structure simply collapsing under the strain of attempted reactivation.

As the manufactory's structural integrity finally failed, something, some things, emerged from its depths - cutting their way out with high-powered lasers and setting their sights on the [Root.GetFleetName].

anomaly.3129.a.tooltip.zh:
古代工厂被毁。

[Root.GetFleetName]正遭受攻击！
anomaly.3129.a.tooltip.en:
The Ancient Manufactory is destroyed.
The [Root.GetFleetName] is under attack!

anomaly.3129.desc.zh:
老旧的石层破开，有什么东西涌了出来。

完全不是预想中光洁的矿石，尖利的锯齿状晶体边缘切碎了破旧的轨道站，随后又将注意力转向了[Root.GetFleetName]。
anomaly.3129.desc.en:
As the old rock tumblers spin up, something spills out.

Far from the polished mineral ore expected, jagged crystal edges shred the decrepit orbital station before turning their attention to the [Root.GetFleetName].

anomaly.3129.name.zh: 古代工厂：惊动古代巢穴

anomaly.3130.b.zh: 这根本都不是真正的思潮啊……

anomaly.3130.desc.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上确实存在过较为发达的文明，但还没来得及飞出[From.GetPlanetMoon]便自行消亡了。通过分析从星球表面取回的古代无线通讯站碎片，[Root.GetName]的船员逐渐还原了整个文明消逝的过程。

在很久以前的某个时间点，该文明的看法分裂为两派，也就是我们今天所说的集体主义与个人主义。虽说这些哲学上的争论与[Root.Owner.GetName]人们的生活并没有什么太大关系，但这个文明却因不知采用何种意识形态和道德标准而最终分崩离析。
anomaly.3130.desc.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] was indeed once home to a somewhat advanced civilization, although one that brought about its own end before escaping [From.GetPlanetMoon]bound existence. By analyzing the few fragments that could be recovered from the ancient wireless information depots on the surface, the crew of the [Root.GetName] have pieced together the narrative of the civilization's demise.

At some point in the distant past, an ideological schism developed over the definitions of the philosophies we today know as collectivism and individualism. While the relevance of these philosophies seems highly questionable to the people of the [Root.Owner.GetName], this civilization evidently tore itself apart over the question of which moral stances should be attributed to which ideology.

anomaly.3130.desc.colle.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上确实存在过较为发达的文明，但还没来得及飞出[From.GetPlanetMoon]便自行死亡了。通过分析从星球表面取回的古代无线通讯站碎片，[Root.GetName]的船员逐渐还原了整个文明消逝的过程。

在很久以前的某个时间点，该文明的看法分为两派，也就是我们今天所说的集体主义与个人主义。虽说集体主义的本质对于[Root.Owner.GetName]的人们来说再明显不过，但这个文明却因不知采用何种看法和心理标准而最终分崩离析。
anomaly.3130.desc.colle.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] was indeed once home to a somewhat advanced civilization, although one that brought about its own end before escaping [From.GetPlanetMoon]bound existence. By analyzing the few fragments that could be recovered from the ancient wireless information depots on the surface, the crew of the [Root.GetName] have pieced together the narrative of the civilization's demise.

At some point in the distant past, an ideological schism developed over the definitions of the philosophies we today know as collectivism and individualism. While the nature of collectivism is blindingly obvious to the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], this civilization evidently tore itself apart over the question of which moral stances should be attributed to which ideology.

anomaly.3130.desc.mater.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上确实存在过较为发达的文明，但还没来得及飞出[From.GetPlanetMoon]便自行死亡了。通过分析从星球表面取回的古代无线通讯站碎片，[Root.GetName]的船员逐渐还原了整个文明消逝的过程。

在很久以前的某个时间点，该文明的看法分为两派，也就是我们今天所说的集体主义与个人主义。虽说个人主义的本质对于[Root.Owner.GetName]的人们来说再明显不过，但这个文明却因不知采用何种看法和心理标准而最终分崩离析。
anomaly.3130.desc.mater.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] was indeed once home to a somewhat advanced civilization, although one that brought about its own end before escaping [From.GetPlanetMoon]bound existence. By analyzing the few fragments that could be recovered from the ancient wireless information depots on the surface, the crew of the [Root.GetName] have pieced together the narrative of the civilization's demise.

At some point in the distant past, an ideological schism developed over the definitions of the philosophies we today know as collectivism and individualism. While the nature of individualism is blindingly obvious to the people of the [Root.Owner.GetName], this civilization evidently tore itself apart over the question of which moral stances should be attributed to which ideology.

anomaly.3135.desc.zh:
从荒芜的[From.GetName]星球回来时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]带回来了一张用植物纤维做成的针织物。虽然不清楚其来历和用途，但是实验证明了此物的吸水性极好。虽然此物对科学研究毫无帮助，不过[Root.GetLeaderName]却对它情有独钟，无论去哪里都把该物品随身携带。

“[Root.GetLeaderName]真是个奇人。”船员们私底下评论道。
anomaly.3135.desc.en:
Returning from the desolate surface of [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] brings with them a sheet of woven plant fiber. Its exact origin and purpose is unknown, but it has proven quite absorbent in tests. While useless to the sciences, [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken a shine to the thing and now carries it with them wherever they go.

"Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is a real hoopy frood," the crew whisper.

anomaly.3140.a.zh: 真是棒极了。但我们没必要继续在这上面耗费精力了。
anomaly.3140.a.en: Remarkable. But we need not waste any more resources on this.

anomaly.3140.desc.zh: 在探察冰面下方之后我们得出结论，这处位于[From.GetName]的异常热信号是由热液泉引起的。类似的地方这个星球上似乎还有更多，但是我们尚未发现。
anomaly.3140.desc.en: After probing beneath the surface, we have concluded the unusual heat signatures on [From.GetName] are caused by hydrothermal springs. There seems to be more to this planet than meets the eye...

anomaly.3141.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的船员的进一步探索揭示出热水来源的行星地壳深处竟然密布着微观生命体！我们一度以为空无一物的冰封星球事实上孕育着一个欣欣向荣的水下生物圈。
anomaly.3141.desc.en: Continued exploration by the crew of [From.GetName] has revealed the hot water coming from deep within the planet's crust is teeming with microscopic life! What we once thought of as an empty, frozen planet, actually contains a thriving underwater biosphere!

anomaly.3145.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]上正要着手开展钻取作业之后，[Root.GetLeaderName]产生了强烈的幻觉。虽然没有受到身体伤害，但他们报告说，他们起先是被破碎不连贯的视觉和嗅觉幻觉所淹没，这些幻觉展现了某种未知的外星物种。

已经准备了一项特殊项目来进一步调查这些怪异的晶体贮藏。
anomaly.3145.desc.en:
After setting up to drill into the ice layer on [From.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] experienced intense sensations. While not physically harmed, they reported being initially overwhelmed by disjointed visual and olfactory hallucinations depicting an unknown alien species.

A special project has been prepared to investigate this strange crystal deposit further.

anomaly.315.desc.zh: 我们在这颗气态巨行星的近地轨道发现了一个至少可以追溯到三千年前的废弃航空殖民地。该殖民地最初的任务似乎是开采气体，但之后就被遗弃了，随后被各种不同的种群和海盗团伙占据。该殖民地里价值连城的物品早已被搜刮一空，不过单论它历经劫难仍然保持悬空漂浮这一点，就值得我们进行工程学方面的研究。
anomaly.315.desc.en:
A ruined network of aerostat colonies dating back at least three millennia can be found in low orbit of this gas giant. Their original function appears to have been gas mining, but they have since been abandoned and reoccupied by many different races and pirate groups.

The colonies have been thoroughly stripped of anything even remotely valuable, but the mere fact that they are still aloft after all this time makes them an interesting subject of engineering research.

anomaly.3150.a.en: Studying it from orbit will do.

anomaly.3150.a.tooltip.zh: [FromFromFrom.GetName]上将新增一处小型研究矿藏。
anomaly.3150.a.tooltip.en: A small research deposit will be added to [FromFromFrom.GetName].

anomaly.3150.b.tooltip.zh: [FromFromFrom.GetName]上将新增一处大型研究矿藏，但可能对[Root.GetLeaderName]存在危险。
anomaly.3150.b.tooltip.en: A large research deposit will be added to [FromFromFrom.GetName], but it could be dangerous for [Root.GetLeaderName].

anomaly.3150.c.tooltip.zh: [FromFromFrom.GetName]上将新增一处稀有水晶矿藏。在获得了相应的科技后就可以进行开采。
anomaly.3150.c.tooltip.en: A rare crystal deposit will be added to [FromFromFrom.GetName]. We will be able to mine it if we have the appropriate technology.

anomaly.3150.desc.zh:
在冰面以下，晶体自身几乎构成了行星的大部分物质。取样分析表明有一处用于数据存储的人工高密度晶格。估测表明这些存储的数据远比我们所有的集体数据库都要庞大。

似乎这个晶体的建造者使用灵能共振来写入数据。[Root.GetLeaderName]非常好奇，并申请在表面建造一座自动研究站。
anomaly.3150.desc.en:
Below the ice, the crystal itself makes up the majority of the planet's mass. Samples suggest an artificially dense lattice is used for data storage. Estimates indicate the volume of stored knowledge is magnitudes beyond everything in our collective database.

It is likely that the builders of this crystal used a psionic resonance to imprint data. [Root.GetLeaderName] is so intrigued, that they have requested permission to oversee the creation of an automated research station on the surface

anomaly.3165.desc.zh:
在自动研究站即将竣工时，晶体突然释放出了一阵极强的能量活动，[Root.GetLeaderName]不幸当场毙命。不一会儿之后，我们收到了一份自称来自[leader.GetHimHer]的自动通讯。

尽管其身体的神经系统已经无法修复，但其意识被困在了水晶中。由于身处[leader.GetHisHer]这种新的境地，[leader.GetSheHe]可以帮助我们深入晶体数据库在未来进行进一步的研究。
anomaly.3165.desc.en:
Nearing the completion of the automated research station, there was a sudden spike in activity from the crystal which left [Root.GetLeaderName] dead. Soon after, we received an autonomous communique claiming to be from [leader.GetHimHer].

While their body's nervous system is beyond repair, their mind has been trapped within the crystal. Making the best of [leader.GetHisHer] new situation, [leader.GetSheHe] has offered to assist with any future research into the crystal database.

anomaly.320.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的强重力井将大量的太空垃圾吸了进来，在气态巨行星一边形成了一圈致密的金属层。这些东西的大部分应该是数千年前星系里发生的太空战役遗留下的残骸。现在有技术价值的残骸和文物已被拾荒者搜刮走了，但可以利用开采站来回收金属。
anomaly.320.desc.en:
The strong gravity well of [From.GetName] has pulled in a massive amount of space debris which has formed a dense layer around parts of the gas giant. Most of it appears to be wreckage from a series of space battles fought in the system several millennia ago.

Scavengers have already scoured the debris of valuable technologies and artifacts, but a mining station should be able to recycle the metal.

anomaly.325.desc.zh: [From.GetName]大气深处的近地轨道上，能够探测到一艘巡洋舰的残骸。它似乎是远航来到了这颗气态巨行星的大气中，也许是为了躲避追逐者，最后却被大气压摧毁。此船位置过深，难以打捞。但通过对飞船结构的扫描，我们得到了一些值得关注的工程数据。
anomaly.325.desc.en:
The shattered remnants of a cruiser-sized starship can be detected in a decaying orbit deep inside the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to have ventured far into the gas giant's atmosphere, perhaps in a desperate attempt to escape a pursuer, only to be crushed by the atmospheric pressure.

The vessel is too deep to be salvaged, but a structural scan of the wreckage has provided us with some interesting engineering data.

anomaly.330.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的大气中频繁发生规模巨大的极端风暴。一些周期较长的风暴在轨道上即可见，当中的风速最高可超过700米/秒。造成风暴的原因目前还不清楚，我们在气象模型中没有发现能够解释这一现象的线索。建议进一步研究该异常现象。
anomaly.330.desc.en: [From.GetName] frequently experiences massive and extremely violent storm systems in its atmosphere. Several dozen persistent storms are visible from orbit, with winds often reaching speeds in excess of 700 m/s. The cause of these storms is not immediately apparent, as we have found nothing in the planet's climate model that would explain them. Studying this anomaly further is recommended.

anomaly.335.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]的大气层深处识别到了奇怪的能源特征。该能源似乎是从某建筑发出的，也许是轨道站的残骸。但超高的大气压使我们无法接近。不过，对这一独特特征的扫描让我们得到了大量的宝贵数据。
anomaly.335.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] has picked up a strange energy signature coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to originate from a structure of some kind, possibly the remains of an orbital station, but the atmospheric pressure makes it impossible to approach. Nevertheless, scans of the unique signature have yielded a large amount of valuable physics data.

anomaly.340.desc.zh: 在对[From.GetName]气态巨行星的众多自然卫星进行更为详尽的勘测后，我们发现了初步勘测时忽略的带有一座贵金属矿藏的卫星。虽然该卫星体型微小，但其环绕母星运转的轨道稳定，而且这颗小卫星的地质构造本身也很稳定。
anomaly.340.desc.en: A more detailed scan of one of the many natural satellites orbiting the gas giant [From.GetName] has revealed a deposit of precious metals and minerals that was overlooked in the initial survey. Although the moon is very small, it has a stable orbit around its primary and appears tectonically stable.

anomaly.35.a.zh: 我们要研究一下它的设计。

anomaly.35.desc.zh: 一千年前，某物种的一艘小型侦察机坠毁在这颗小行星的地表，并形成了一个浅峡谷。飞行器中没有明显的驾驶舱，因此集合体获知，它有可能是远程操控的，也有可能是通过某种原始的人工智能操控。虽然它已损坏严重，无法完整复原，但舰船上至少还没有被洗劫一空。
anomaly.35.desc.en: A small scout craft of some kind plowed into the surface of this asteroid millennia ago, creating a shallow canyon. There is no visible cockpit on the ship, leading us to believe it was either piloted by remote or through some kind of primitive artificial intelligence. Although it is too damaged to be salvaged, the ship hasn't been picked clean by looters yet.

anomaly.40.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的近地轨道探测到一座自动采矿基地。其表面有小型武器留下的灼烧痕迹，而且该设施似乎陷入了死循环。我们已经重编译了基地系统，现在我们已完全控制该设施。
anomaly.40.desc.en: We have detected an automated mining base built in close orbit around asteroid [From.GetName]. There is scorching on the hull indicative of light weapons damage, and the facility appeared to be stuck in some kind of feedback loop. We have managed to reprogram the base systems and the facility is now fully under our control.

anomaly.40.desc.alt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的近地轨道探测到一座自动采矿基地。其表面存在大块缺失，这些呈现锯齿状的大洞表明该船曾遭受重型武器的攻击，现已无法修复。但仍有宝贵的材料可以回收。
anomaly.40.desc.alt.en: We have detected an automated mining base built in close orbit around asteroid [From.GetName]. There are large chunks of the hull missing, the jagged holes indicative of heavy weapons damage. The station is beyond repair, but salvaging it will provide us with valuable materials.

anomaly.4000.desc.zh: [From.GetName]上面的一些植物在自然选择中进化出了一套有效的自我防御措施。许多的树木和真菌都会释放出孢子，这些孢子对非植物生命来说具有非常强的酸性。还好，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了中和其中一些孢子的方法，让这颗星球上的森林不那么致命了！
anomaly.4000.desc.en: It appears that some of [From.GetName]'s flora has developed effective defense mechanisms through natural selection. Numerous trees and fungi exude spores that act like a powerful acidic on non-plant organisms. Thankfully Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has found a way to counteract some strands of these spores, making the planet's forests less threatening to us!

anomaly.4005.a.tooltip.zh:
把曾经的行星添加到[From.GetName]上：
£alloys£ +3

anomaly.4005.desc.zh:
看来，小行星[From.GetName]及其周围碎片来源于一个已经消亡的星球！

在小行星中心，我们可以找到极具价值的合金的痕迹。同时，这里还找到了一些已死于在真空中的细菌曾经的活动迹象。这一切表明了这个天体曾孕育过生命。
anomaly.4005.desc.en:
It appears that the asteroid [From.GetName] and the surrounding debris originate from a former planet!

Deep within the center of the asteroid we can find traces of extremely valuable alloys. There are also hints of bacterial life that has now died in the vacuum of space. This shows us that the celestial body once bore the promise of life.

anomaly.4010.desc.zh: 我们接收到的信号来自于一艘围绕[From.GetName]旋转的舰船。这艘船现在没有任何热成像，似乎是在漂浮。我们已经制定了一个特殊项目来调查船员的遭遇。
anomaly.4010.desc.en: The signal we intercepted was a distress call from a ship in orbit around [From.GetName]. The ship is not giving off any heat signatures and seems to be drifting. A Special Project has been issued to investigate what has happened to the crew.

anomaly.4011.desc.zh: 舰上的船员已经全部丧生。更令人不安的是，他们似乎是被某种高度发达的脑寄生虫杀死的。它们寄生在船员的脑子里并使其疯狂。多亏了科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]及时发现，我们的船员才没有被感染。
anomaly.4011.desc.en: The crew of the ship has been found dead. What is more disturbing is that they appear to have been killed by some highly advanced brain parasites, which infested them and drove them mad. Thanks to Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s findings we were able to protect our own crew from being infected!

anomaly.4012.desc.zh: 围绕[From.From.From.GetName]运行的舰船并没有被遗弃。上面的船员还活着，但是状态不好。他们受到了某种脑寄生虫的影响。我们的科学家能够轻松地治愈他们。
anomaly.4012.desc.en: The ship in orbit around [From.From.From.GetName] was not abandoned. The crew is alive, but not well, influenced by some sort of brain parasite. With the help of our scientists they could easily be cured.

anomaly.4015.a.zh: 让那个棺材继续它的旅途吧。
anomaly.4015.a.en: Let the coffin continue its voyage.

anomaly.4015.b.zh: 打开棺材，研究那具尸体。
anomaly.4015.b.en: Open the coffin and study the corpse.

anomaly.4015.b.evopred.zh: 有很多值得学习的东西。打开荚舱。
anomaly.4015.b.evopred.en: There is much to learn. Open the pod.

anomaly.4015.desc.zh: 尽管宛如大海捞针，[Root.GetName]精确地找出了那个穿过了小行星带的奇怪信号的来源。信号来源于一个小型外星物品。简单的扫描显示出它是一种仪式性的容器，里面装着某位外星宇航员的遗体。
anomaly.4015.desc.en: By what has to be beyond astronomical odds, the [Root.GetName] actually managed to pinpoint the source of the odd signals as it soared past through the asteroid belt. A tiny, alien construct. A simple scan reveals that it is some sort of a ritualistic container, holding the remains of an alien spacefarer.

anomaly.4015.phile.zh: 把它带回[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]，放在博物馆里面展出。
anomaly.4015.phile.en: Bring it to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and display it in a museum.

anomaly.4016.b.en: It is merely a dead body.

anomaly.4016.c.spirit.zh: 我们会为你们祖先的灵魂祈祷。
anomaly.4016.c.spirit.en: We will pray for the spirit of your ancestor.

anomaly.4016.d.phobe.zh: 异星杂种，我们根本就不在乎！
anomaly.4016.d.phobe.en: We could not care less, alien scum!

anomaly.4016.desc.zh:
距离我们和[DefiledCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]第一次接触已经过去几天了，现在他们向我们发来了一则消息：

“我们知道你们做了什么，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们开启的那个棺材是我们第一位星际宇航员最后的休憩之处。我们要求你们道歉！”
anomaly.4016.desc.en:
A couple of days have passed since we first made contact with the [DefiledCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and now they are sending us a message:

"We know what you have done, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The casket you desecrated was the final resting place of our first star traveler. We demand an apology!"

anomaly.4016.tooltip.zh: 你们之间的关系会受到影响。

anomaly.4020.a.zh: 这些材料会派上用场的。
anomaly.4020.a.en: The materials will surely come in handy.

anomaly.4020.b.zh: 至少这些材料还很有用。
anomaly.4020.b.en: At least the materials will be useful.

anomaly.4020.desc.zh: 通过彻底的扫描，我们发现了[From.GetName]奇异矿石成分的成因。[From.GetPlanetMoon]是几十艘巨型太空船的坠毁地点，其船体之大远远超出我们的想象。它们建造的时间可以追溯到几百万年前。
anomaly.4020.desc.en: Thorough scans have revealed the cause of [From.GetName]'s odd metal composition. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is the crash site of dozens of massive spaceships, larger than anything we could have ever imagined. Their construction dates back several million years.

anomaly.4020.rocket.desc.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了那些奇怪的矿物读数的源头。[From.GetName]是巨型宇宙舰船的坟场，这里的舰船残骸已经沉睡了几百万年。[Root.GetLeaderName]还说道，“真是太遗憾了，这些推进器损坏过于严重，仔细检测也不会有什么结果。”
anomaly.4020.rocket.desc.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has found the source of the odd mineral readings. [From.GetName] is a graveyard for gargantuan spaceships that have been resting there for millions of years. [Root.GetLeaderName] goes on and on in the debriefing about a "profound sadness that the rockets are too broken down for even careful examination to yield results."

anomaly.4020.rocket.desc.mach.zh: 我们发现那些奇怪的矿物读数来源于一些数量不明，异常巨大且技术先进的太空船残骸。飞船部件的锈蚀情况表明这片残骸于大约2,380,669年前产生。现场的科研单位试图对这些舰船的推进器进行逆向工程，但因其破损过于严重而失败了。
anomaly.4020.rocket.desc.mach.en: We have discovered that the source of the odd mineral readings are the remains of an unconfirmed number of abnormally large, technologically advanced spaceships. Material decomposition indicates an age of approximately 2 380 669 years. The science unit on site attempted to reverse engineer the vessels' rockets but failed due to their heavily damaged state.

anomaly.4030.a.zh: 试着去控制这个人工智能。
anomaly.4030.a.en: Try and take control of the AI.

anomaly.4030.b.zh: 在它试图做危险的事情之前毁了它。
anomaly.4030.b.en: Destroy it before it tries anything.

anomaly.4030.b.tooltip.zh:
毁掉这个人工智能。

把坠毁的人工智能舰队修正添加到[From.GetName]上：
£engineering£+2
anomaly.4030.b.tooltip.en:
Destroys the AI.

Adds the Crashed AI-Fleet modifier to [From.GetName]:
£engineering£ +2

anomaly.4030.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]的沙丘下面，我们的科学团队找到了坠毁的战斗机舰队。虽然很古老，但是却保存的十分完好。它们早已经被遗弃，但是引擎和照明部件似乎还能运作。它们坠毁的原因目前尚不清楚。我们在旗舰的舰桥上面找到了舰队的人工智能，它能够在战斗中指挥这些船只，并且其仍在运作。我们靠近的时候，它拉响了警报。在入侵者靠近的时候它就会自动启动。
我们能够施行一个特殊项目在这个人工智能发疯之前回收它。我们也可以毁了它，避免未知的风险。
anomaly.4030.desc.en:
Under the dunes of [From.GetName] the science team has found a fleet of crashed fighters. Ancient, yet well preserved. They are abandoned, but the lights and engines seem to function. Why they crashed is a mystery. On the main ship bridge we found a fleet AI, capable of controlling the ships in battle. It is still active. As we approach a warning signal calls. It is programmed to activate when threatened by intruders!
A Special Project can be issued to try and salvage the AI before it goes haywire, or we could destroy it and avoid the risk.

anomaly.4031.desc.zh: 谢天谢地，我们成功地在人工智能攻击我们之前为它重新编写了程序。它目前已可作为我们舰队中的旗舰工作，并且如果我们愿意的话，它也可以成为指挥官。这个人工智能已经被运送到我们的母星，等待指派。
anomaly.4031.desc.en: Thankfully we were able to reprogram the AI before it turned on us. It has been repurposed to commandeer ships in our fleet, and could act as a sort of Commander if we so choose. The AI has been transported to our homeworld, awaiting assignment.

anomaly.4035.a.zh: 这可能会带来丰厚的收获。

anomaly.4035.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了有趣的东西，不过跟[From.GetPlanetMoon]本身没有什么关系。我们像往常一样进行测试时，突然捕获到一颗遥远的恒星系中的恒星传出的奇怪数据。该恒星的辐射表明，它可以在不发生散裂的情况下让铍原子发生聚变，而这根本就是不可能的！

科学团队已经迫不及待想前去一探究竟了，而且他们已经将范围缩小到两个不是很远的恒星系。
查询情报日志获取细节。
anomaly.4035.desc.en:
We have made an interesting find on [From.GetName], however it is not related to the [From.GetPlanetMoon] itself. While conducting our usual tests we captured some odd data from a far-off system's star. Its radiation indicates that it is able to fuse together beryllium without spallation; something that should not be possible!

The science team are eager to investigate and have limited the potential stars down to two not-too-distant systems.
Consult the Situation Log for details.

anomaly.4035.poi.desc.zh: 这些恒星系中的一个可能有那颗发出奇怪辐射的恒星。
anomaly.4035.poi.desc.en: One of the systems that could potentially hold the odd radiation star.

anomaly.4037.desc.zh: 我们找到了正确的恒星系！这颗恒星的辐射数据和之前遇到的完全一致。我们制定了一个特殊项目来对这颗恒星进行研究。
anomaly.4037.desc.en: We seem to have found the right system! The radiation data of the local star match the ones previously encountered. A Special Project has been issued to perform research on the star.

anomaly.4038.a.zh: 我们已经掌握了恒星的奥秘。
anomaly.4038.a.en: We have mastered the secrets of suns.

anomaly.4038.b.zh: 我们正在逐步揭开宇宙神秘的面纱。
anomaly.4038.b.en: The mysteries of the universe are slowly revealed.

anomaly.4038.maxed.desc.zh:
$anomaly.4038.base.desc$

这些知识并不会使我们现有的科技得到提升。但是，它告诉了我们更多关于宇宙运行原理的信息。
anomaly.4038.maxed.desc.en:
$anomaly.4038.base.desc$

This knowledge won't expand our available technology. However, it grants us more insight into what makes the universe tick.

anomaly.4038.upg.desc.zh:
$anomaly.4038.base.desc$

多亏了这个发现，我们的科学家现在能够研究新的科技了！
anomaly.4038.upg.desc.en:
$anomaly.4038.base.desc$

Thanks to this discovery our scientists will be able to research new technology!

anomaly.4040.a.tooltip.zh:
把辐射废土修正添加到[From.GetName]上：
£blocker£ 辐射废土 +6
$mod_planet_jobs_physics_research_produces_mult$：+10%
anomaly.4040.a.tooltip.en:
Adds the Irradiated Wasteland modifier to [From.GetName]:
£blocker£ Radioactive Wasteland +6
$mod_planet_jobs_physics_research_produces_mult$: +10%

anomaly.4040.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的离子辐射强度已经爆表了。看起来[From.GetPlanetMoon]似乎最近受到了核弹头的轰炸，或者是暴露在了可能是从附近超新星所发出的聚集射线束之中。至于后者是否能够造成这种效果，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]毫无头绪。
anomaly.4040.desc.en: The ionizing radiation on [From.GetName] is off the charts. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] seems to either have been bombarded with nuclear warheads quite recently or been exposed to a concentrated beam of cosmic rays, perhaps from a nearby supernova. How the latter could ever be achieved is beyond Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName].

anomaly.4045.a.zh: 校正探测仪，再好好看看星球的内核！
anomaly.4045.a.en: Calibrate the scanners and look closer to the core!

anomaly.4045.b.zh: “我们不能相信这些船员。我们需要一次实地考察！”
anomaly.4045.b.en: "The crew cannot be trusted. An expedition is needed!"

anomaly.4045.c.zh: 船员的健康是第一位的。

anomaly.4045.d.zh: 在弄清楚之前，我们绝不能停下！
anomaly.4045.d.en: We cannot rest until we get to the bottom of this!

anomaly.4045.desc.zh:
经过缜密研究之后，[Root.GetName]的成员探测到了一个“微弱”的回声正在从[From.GetName]的地底深处传来。

这种回声有点像是生命体发出的。可是我们与它的距离实在是太远了，很难分辨它是真的，还是只是一台发出随机信号的设备。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的手下一直在抱怨说自己得不到适当的休息，工作时间又太长，自己再也受不了了。
anomaly.4045.desc.en:
After rigorous research, the crew of [Root.GetName] has only been able to detect a faint "echo" emanating deep beneath the surface of [From.GetName].

The echo resembles a life signature, however it is so distant it is hard to tell if it is real or just the instruments giving off random variations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s crew is complaining about bad rest and long hours and cannot take much more.

anomaly.4046.a.zh: 我们应该试着去和它接触。
anomaly.4046.a.en: We should try and contact it.

anomaly.4046.b.zh: 我们可以向海中下毒并杀死它。
anomaly.4046.b.en: We could poison the ocean to kill it.

anomaly.4046.c.tooltip_new.zh:
你的帝国获得了负面媒体报道修正效果。

添加敌对环境修正效果至[From.From.GetName]。
anomaly.4046.c.tooltip_new.en:
Your Empire gains the Negative Media Coverage modifier.

Adds the Hostile Environment modifier to [From.From.GetName].

anomaly.4046.desc.zh:
尽管大家都筋疲力尽了，但是在调整了舰船的探测仪后，[Root.GetName]的船员和科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]得到了一个惊人的发现。在[From.From.GetName]的内核附近，有一种类似于浮游生物的生命体。它们分布于整个[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]，有着共同的意识，以及强大的灵能能力。

这种生命体能够在极高的压力和温度下存活，甚至可以以极高的速率进行繁衍。它看起来像是在冬眠……或者是在躲避什么东西，就好像它知道自己正在被观测一样。

对于如此巨大而拥有诸多优势的生命体，理论上来说它是永生的。不过，它看起来并不会妨碍我们对[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]进行殖民。但是它可能会对上面的居民产生一些负面影响。
anomaly.4046.desc.en:
After doing some adjustments to the ship scanners, the crew of [Root.GetName] and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], although exhausted and on edge, have made a startling discovery. Close to the core of [From.From.GetName] is a plankton-like lifeform that stretches across the entire [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], living in a shared consciousness with vast psionic abilities.

The lifeform is able to survive under both extreme pressures and temperatures. It can even expand itself at rapid rates. It seem to either be hibernating or... hiding, as if it knew it was being watched.

A lifeform this vast in size and versatile seems technically immortal. However it does not seem like it would hinder us to colonize the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], but it might have a negative influence on the population.

anomaly.4047.a.zh: 我们很乐意接受这份邀请。

anomaly.4047.a.tooltip_new.zh: 你的帝国获得了负面媒体报道修正效果。
anomaly.4047.a.tooltip_new.en: Your Empire gains the Negative Media Coverage modifier.

anomaly.4047.desc.zh:
在多次尝试接触而没有结果后，我们的小队决定尝试用声波进行联系。声波使那个生物产生了巨大的反应，所有的小队成员都双膝跪地，陷入了栩栩如生的幻象之中。

这好像是这种生物的主要交流方式。它描述了它的母星，它静静地躺在星核附近，沐浴在[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的温暖之中，在黑暗中繁衍。然后它向我们展示了我们的人民站在地表上，在阳光中繁衍壮大。
anomaly.4047.desc.en:
After trying several methods of contact without an answer the team decides to try sonar pings. The sound waves cause a massive reaction in the being and every crew member falls to their knees, struck with vivid visions.

This seems to be the creatures' main form of communication. It depicts its homeworld, where it lies alone near the core basking in the warmth of the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon], thriving in the darkness. Then it shows our people, standing on the surface, thriving in the sunshine.

anomaly.4048.a.tooltip.zh:
你的帝国获得了负面媒体报道修正

[From.From.From.GetName]的行星类型变为剧毒。

将恶劣环境修正添加到[From.From.From.GetName]上。

在[From.From.From.GetName]上添加资源：
£society£ +4
anomaly.4048.a.tooltip.en:
Your Empire gains the Negative Media Coverage modifier.

The Planet Class of [From.From.From.GetName] changes to Toxic.

Adds the Hostile Environment modifier to [From.From.From.GetName].

Adds resources to [From.From.From.GetName]:
£society£ +4

anomaly.4048.desc.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快就合成出了一种毒药，它应该会和这个生物的内在结构产生剧烈的反应，以野火之势扩散开来。

在释放了毒药之后，船员们陷入到了极大的恐惧之中。他们目睹了一个史无前例的事件。[From.From.From.GetName]的内核温度急剧升高，导致整个海洋沸腾。生命体那巨大的躯体也开始向大气中释放毒素。这个浮游生物般的东西对于[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]那不稳定的核心来说一定是至关重要的。这种毒素应该也是它在进化中得到的一种自我防御的机制。

[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]在几个小时之内就充满了剧毒。
anomaly.4048.desc.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] quickly synthesizes a poison that should react well with the creature's interconnected form and spread like wildfire.

After releasing the poison the crew stare in horror as they bear witness to an unprecedented event. [From.From.From.GetName]'s core temperature spirals out of control which causes the oceans to boil. The creature's gargantuan body also releases toxins into the atmosphere. The plankton entity must have been vital in the regulation of the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s unstable center, as well as developed toxic defense mechanisms in order to protect itself.

The [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon] becomes completely toxic in a matter of hours.

anomaly.4049.a.zh: 科学专员也许只是太累了。
anomaly.4049.a.en: The Science Officer probably just needs rest.

anomaly.4049.b.zh: 科学专员发疯了。把他抓起来！
anomaly.4049.b.en: The Science Officer is insane. To the brig!

anomaly.4049.b.tooltip.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]被永久停职了。

anomaly.4049.desc.zh:
由于怀疑这些船员想要隐瞒什么，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]决定发起一场不经批准的单枪匹马的探险，以仔细检查星球的内核。船上潜艇的摄像机传回了录像带，记录了事情的经过：

深入[From.From.GetName]的海洋，那里只有黑暗。但是，还有一些……活着的东西。在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]温暖的内核附近有一些深海洞穴。洞穴的里面有网状的、类似于浮游生物的植被，缠绕着[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的整个地壳。

在调查浮游生物的时候，[Root.GetLeaderName]突然癫痫发作，在几个小时之后才醒过来。

回到[Root.GetName]后，科学专员神志不清，一直在诉说一些关于恐惧和邪恶幻境的事情。
anomaly.4049.desc.en:
Suspicious that the crew is hiding something, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] decided to mount an unauthorized solo-expedition to examine the planet's core. A video feed from the ships submarine shows what happened:

Going deep into the oceans of [From.From.GetName] there is only darkness, but also something... alive. Inside deep-sea caverns close to the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s warm core there are webs of plankton-like vegetation, that spans the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s entire crust.

While investigating the plankton [Root.GetLeaderName] is stricken with a seizure, only to awake hours later.

After returning to the [Root.GetName] the Science Officer is delusional and only speaks of horrors and haunted visions.

anomaly.4050.a.tooltip.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]获得了灵能专精和异星相关专精特质。
anomaly.4050.a.tooltip.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] gains the Psionics Expertise and Xeno Relations Expertise Traits.

anomaly.4050.b.zh: 控制住自己，科学专员。否则别怪大家不客气。
anomaly.4050.b.en: Control yourself, Science Officer. Or else.

anomaly.4050.desc.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]的那次事件过去一个星期后，[Root.GetName]的船员被一声惊尖叫惊扰。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]大喊大叫，在船上横冲直撞，说自己感到很痛很痛。

船员们把他带到医务室给他打了大量镇定剂并仔细检查后确认[Root.GetLeaderName]的大脑发生了改变。

详细的检查最终发现这位领袖现在拥有了心灵感应能力，能够通过精神跟他人沟通。[Root.GetLeaderName]经过休息后会康复的。
anomaly.4050.desc.en:
It has been a week since the incident on [From.From.From.GetName] when the crew of the [Root.GetName] are disturbed by a loud scream. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is yelling, running through the halls of the ship, going on about inexplicable pains.

The crew brings the poor scientist to the sickbay and after heavy sedation and a thorough examination concludes that [Root.GetLeaderName]'s brain has changed.

After further tests the team startlingly realizes that their leader is now capable of telekinesis and communicating with others via telepathy. [Root.GetLeaderName] is going to get healthy, after some rest.

anomaly.4051.a.zh: 船员的安好就是最大的奖励。
anomaly.4051.a.en: The crew's well-being is its own reward.

anomaly.4051.a.tooltip.zh: 你的帝国获得了正面媒体关注和休息充分的科学官修正。
anomaly.4051.a.tooltip.en: Your Empire gains the Positive Media Coverage and Well Rested Scientists modifiers.

anomaly.4051.b.zh: 这是提高效率的办法之一。
anomaly.4051.b.en: This is but one way to gain efficiency.

anomaly.4051.b.tooltip.zh:
你的帝国获得了正面媒体关注和休息充分的科学官修正。

你解锁了$edict_improved_work_environment$帝国法令。
anomaly.4051.b.tooltip.en:
Your Empire gains the Positive Media Coverage and Well Rested Scientists modifiers.

Gives access to the $edict_improved_work_environment$ Empire Edict.

anomaly.4051.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员结束了他们的[From.From.GetName]研究，终于能够休息整顿了。可惜他们并没有什么重大收获，但是他们受到的良好待遇很快传开了，在母星深获好评。足够的休息确保了船员们能够在未来取得更好的结果。
anomaly.4051.desc.en: The [Root.GetName]'s crew ends their research of [From.From.GetName], thankful of finally getting some rest. Sadly there were not any useful finds, but news of the crew being well-treated spreads fast and brings forth many a good word on our homeworld. Being well-rested should also have the crew produce even better results in the long run.

anomaly.4052.a.tooltip.zh: 你的帝国获得了药物创新和负面媒体报道修正。
anomaly.4052.a.tooltip.en: Your Empire gains the Pharmaceutical Innovation and Negative Media Coverage modifiers.

anomaly.4052.desc.zh:
夜以继日地研究回声的根源后，[Root.GetName]发现了[From.From.GetName]地面下生活的一种生物。之前没有发觉是因为它生活在非常靠近[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]核心的地方，这导致我们的系统分析对它毫无效用。

通过扫描我们发现它是尚处于进化早期阶段的海洋节肢动物，但最神奇的是它竟然能够将死去的生物物质改造成自己的后代。

这个信息非常有助于我们的科学家开发新的药物！不过，我们对待我们的人员的方式肯定会传播出去，造成不良影响。
anomaly.4052.desc.en:
After working day and night in order to find the reason behind the echo, the crew of [Root.GetName] have found an interesting lifeform living underneath the surface of [From.From.GetName]. Previously we could not detect it due to its amazing ability to live so close to the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s core, throwing off our systems analytics.

Scans show it to be a type of aquatic arthropod early in its evolution, but what is most surprising is the fact that it is able to reproduce by repurposing dead matter from other lifeforms into offspring.

This information will surely help our scientists to develop new pharmaceuticals! However, news of how we treated our personnel will surely spread and displease the general populace.

anomaly.4055.a.zh: 把该学徒升职为科学官。
anomaly.4055.a.en: Offer this protégé a Science Officer position.

anomaly.4055.b.zh: 他们在目前的岗位上做得很好。
anomaly.4055.b.en: They do good work where they are.

anomaly.4055.desc.zh: 对[From.GetName]的研究结束后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报说他们发现这颗行星满是矿物。这个发现主要归功于[Root.GetName]的船员。[Root.GetLeaderName]对这位学徒赞赏有加。
anomaly.4055.desc.en: After the study of [From.GetName] has concluded, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that they have found the planet to be unusually rich in minerals. This discovery was made possible in large part thanks to a certain member of the [Root.GetName] crew. [Root.GetLeaderName] praises the protégé highly.

anomaly.4060.b.zh: 不是所有问题都得有答案。
anomaly.4060.b.en: All questions don't have worthwhile answers.

anomaly.4060.desc.zh:
我们收到科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告。据说有一个……陶瓷容器在围绕着[From.GetName]的恒星旋转。真奇怪。

这种东西不应该出现那儿，然而不管怎样它确实在近地轨道上。

可以发布特殊项目来研究该容器并找出它出现在那里的原因。
anomaly.4060.desc.en:
We have gotten a report from Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]. It seems that a... ceramic container is circling the star [From.GetName]. Most peculiar.

It should obviously not be there, yet somehow it has managed to find its way into a close orbit.

A Special Project can be issued to investigate the container and try to deduce how it ended up there.

anomaly.4060.spirit.b.en: Surely this is a sign of the divine.

anomaly.4061.a.tooltip.zh: 接受解决生活问题的尝试常常徒劳无功的事实。
anomaly.4061.a.tooltip.en: Embrace the futility of life's questions.

anomaly.4061.desc.zh:
我们竭尽所能试图找出这个陶瓷容器出现在恒星轨道的原因。也许这是我们的集体幻觉？也许它根本不存在？连这些可能性我们都计算过了。但是一无所获。我们尽力了。

唯一的好处就是当我们再也无法忍受调查这东西时，我们可以慢慢研究哲学和经济问题。
anomaly.4061.desc.en:
We have tried everything in order to find out how the ceramic pot ended up in a stellar orbit. Maybe we are all crazy? Maybe it does not even exist? Guess what? We tried calculating around those facts as well! We are done. There is nothing more we can do here.

The only plus side to this is that we had tons of time to spend on philosophical and economical questions, when we could not stomach to keep investigating that damned thing.

anomaly.4061.desc.mach.zh:
我们竭尽所能试图找出这个陶瓷容器出现在大空轨道的原因。或许我们都故障了？或许它根本就不存在？<<错误！>>连这些可能性我们都计算过了。<<错误！>>
这事儿到此为止。我们尽力了。

这项调查的一个好处就是，当我们无法容忍继续调查那个不合逻辑的罐子时，我们可以花大量的时间在理论与经济问题上。
anomaly.4061.desc.mach.en:
We have tried everything in order to find out how the ceramic container ended up in a stellar orbit. Perhaps we are all malfunctioning? Perhaps it does not even exist? <<Error!>> We attempted to calculate around those facts as well. <<Error!>>
We are done. There is nothing more we can do here.

The one positive aspect of this investigation is that we had excessive amounts of time to spend on theoretical and economical questions, when we could not bear to keep investigating that illogical pot.

anomaly.4062.desc.zh:
$anomaly.4062.base$该物体并非真是存在于那里，而是从更高级的维度投影下来的。分析发现，那是一个四维物体的影子，我们累积了足够的数据去解码它的信息。该物体能够改善我们对所有研究领域的认知。

现在唯一的问题是……究竟是谁发来的这道信息？
anomaly.4062.desc.en:
$anomaly.4062.base$ The object isn't really there, but rather it is a projection from a higher dimension. Analyzing it, as a shadow of a fourth dimensional object, we have accumulated enough data to decrypt its message. The object teaches us how to improve in all fields of research.

The only question now is... who sent this information?

anomaly.4062.desc.mach.zh:
在花了大量时间研究那个陶瓷物体却并未取得明显进展之后，我们的科学单元终于有了突破。该物体并不存在于我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所知的三维空间中，而是一个来自更高维度的投影。

分析这个四维物体的本影让我们积累了足够的数据来解密它的信息。该物体教会我们如何在所有科研领域取得进展。

现在只剩下一个问题：是谁，或者是什么东西发送了这个信息？
anomaly.4062.desc.mach.en:
After an extensive period of studying the confounding ceramic object without notable results, our scientific units have finally reached a breakthrough. The object does not exist in what we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know as three-dimensional spacetime, but rather it is a projection from a higher dimension.

Analyzing it, as an umbra of a fourth dimensional object, we have accumulated enough data to decrypt its message. The object teaches us how to attain improvements in all fields of research.

Only one question remains: Who or what sent this information?

anomaly.4062.spirit.a.en: Thanks to the powers that be!

anomaly.4062.spirit.desc.zh:
$anomaly.4062.base$该容器是一个神圣遗物，无疑是由神灵留在轨道上的信号！

该物体散发着能量，解码后终于显示出隐藏的信息：那是能够改善我们的研究能力以助我们尽早升天的信息！

现在唯一的问题是……究竟是谁发来的这道信息？
anomaly.4062.spirit.desc.en:
$anomaly.4062.base$ The container is a sacred relic, left in orbit as a sign, surely from the divine!

The object is brimming with energy, which when decrypted reveals its hidden message: information on how to help us ascend by improving our research efforts!

The only question now is... who sent this message?

anomaly.4065.desc.zh:
在巨型小行星[From.GetName]的地表下，我们发现了让人叹为观止的东西。有一台采矿设备安置在岩体上，一直挖到小行星地核深处！看情况它是被遗弃了，没有任何痕迹显示是谁留下的。

如果我们能够把这部机器停下，我们也许能够从中学习到制造它的科技，但一定要趁早，免得它被岩屑什么的压碎。
anomaly.4065.desc.en:
Deep within a crevice of the giant asteroid [From.GetName] we have found something astonishing. There is mining gear attached to the rock, digging itself into the vast depth of the asteroid! It stands abandoned, with no sign of who placed it there.

If we can stop the machine we might be able to learn something about the technology used to build it, but we must hurry before random debris crushes it.

anomaly.4066.res.desc.zh: 我们成功在挖掘机损坏之前制止了它。可惜它其实跟我们当前的设计非常类似，没有什么值得学习的。不过它挖出的洞可以让我们更轻易地找到贵重矿物。
anomaly.4066.res.desc.en: We managed to stop the excavator before it broke down. Sadly it is close to our own designs, and we can't really learn anything new from it. Thankfully the depths it carved out into the rock will make it easier to find valuable minerals.

anomaly.4066.upg.desc.zh:
我们成功在挖掘机损坏之前制止了它。真是个神奇的机器，它的平滑的表层完全被钻石所覆盖。乍看之下，它似乎是一个整体，但其实只是做工精良，让人难以发现其连接处。

我们的工程师可以对它的一些科技进行逆向工程。
anomaly.4066.upg.desc.en:
We managed to stop the excavator before it broke down. It's a remarkable piece of machinery, with a smooth surface covered in diamonds. At first glance the whole drill seems like one solid piece, but it's simply so well put together that you cannot notice the grooves and joints.

Our engineers will be able to reverse engineer some of this technology.

anomaly.4070.desc.zh: 好消息！我们发现[From.GetName]的热带雨林中生长着一种特殊的树，它的果实非常有营养。这种食物含有着惊人的能量以及我们的人民所需的全部营养。这确定无疑地有助于减轻我们殖民这个地方的压力。
anomaly.4070.desc.en: Good news! We have found the tropical forests of [From.GetName] to be host to a special kind of tree, blooming with nutritious fruits. The food produced stores tons of energy and contains all the chemicals our people need to function well. This will most assuredly make life a little bit easier to sustain, would we want to colonize.

anomaly.4075.a.zh: 分析它是否能够改善能量生产。
anomaly.4075.a.en: Find out if it can improve energy production.

anomaly.4075.a.tooltip.zh: 送回去母星作研究。需要一段时间才能出结果。
anomaly.4075.a.tooltip.en: Send to our homeworld for study. Results will take a while to process.

anomaly.4075.b.en: Try and find a military use.

anomaly.4075.desc.zh:
勘测过[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]的冰冻地面后，我们获得了重大发现。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说，发现了一种独一无二的细菌生物。它会跟其他个体连接起来组成巨大的“毯子”，这种毯子既轻便耐用，又能用作太阳能电池。它们能够非常高效地转化吸收到的太阳能——似乎是为了在这种环境下尽可能吸收多的热能而进化出来的。

我们的研究人员一定能够从这样的情报中发掘到可用之物。
anomaly.4075.desc.en:
Having probed the frozen landscapes of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] we think we have struck something big. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speaks of a bacterial lifeform unlike any other. It bonds with other individuals to form large "blankets" that are durable yet light, and also act like solar cells. They absorb solar energy with surprising efficiency - most likely a result of evolution favoring those who could gather more heat in the harsh climate.

Our researchers back home could surely find some use for this information.

anomaly.4076.desc.zh: 我们的能源开发研究员从我们发过去的[From.From.GetName]样本中取得了进展！他们利用该生物为模板，成功开发了一种新的太阳能电池。这种电池能够更高效地储存能量并提高我们所有发电站的效率。
anomaly.4076.desc.en: Our energy development researchers have made progress with the samples we sent them from [From.From.GetName]! They have been able to develop a new type of solar cell using the organisms as a template. These are much more efficient at storing energy and will provide a boost to all our power plants.

anomaly.4077.desc.zh: 我们的军事开发研究员从我们发过去的[From.From.GetName]样本中取得了进展！他们改造了生物太阳能电池并分析了它们是如何储存热能而让自身不受伤害。这将有助于开发一种全新的舰队防御技术。
anomaly.4077.desc.en: Our military development researchers have made progress with the samples we sent them from [From.From.GetName]! They have reconstructed the biological solar cells and documented how they retain heat energy within themselves without taking damage. This has helped them develop a new defensive technology for our fleets.

anomaly.4080.c.zh: 不管它，也许它的主人会归来。
anomaly.4080.c.en: Leave it alone in case the owner returns.

anomaly.4080.desc.zh:
我们发现了一座传感阵列，孤零零的俯瞰着[From.GetName]。这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]上没有任何值得一提的智慧生物，所以这一定是座被遗弃的哨站。它的年代不算久远，但却无法使用了。

我们需要修理并研究它才能让它恢复运作，不过要是拆毁它也许能够让我们学习到新的技术。
anomaly.4080.desc.en:
We have found a sensor array, solemnly standing watch on [From.GetName]. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has no sapient life to speak of, so it must be an abandoned outpost. It was built recently, but is not functioning.

It would require both repairs and research to bring it back into working condition, while breaking it apart could allow us to learn something new from it.

anomaly.4081.a.tooltip.zh: 添加高级传感阵列修正到[From.From.From.GetName]。
anomaly.4081.a.tooltip.en: Adds the Superior Sensor Array modifier to [From.From.From.GetName].

anomaly.4081.b.tooltip.zh:
解锁$edict_super_sensors$帝国法令。

添加高级传感阵列修正到[From.From.From.GetName]。
anomaly.4081.b.tooltip.en:
Gives access to the $edict_super_sensors$ Empire Edict.

Adds the Superior Sensor Array modifier to [From.From.From.GetName].

anomaly.4081.desc.zh: 数个月的工作终于开花结果了！[From.From.From.GetName]的传感阵列再一次恢复了运作，现在我们在附近一带的扫描范围更大了。不过传感阵列需要更多的能量和人力才能正常运行，所以我们需要建立一个殖民地来维持它。
anomaly.4081.desc.en: Months of work have finally paid off! The sensor array on [From.From.From.GetName] is once again functioning and it appears to be able to give us a vastly improved sensor range of the nearby area. However, the array needs more energy and personnel to work, so a colony is needed in order to supply it with energy.

anomaly.4085.desc.zh:
我们在围绕着[From.GetName]的小行星中发现了一艘外星飞船在那里漂泊。它对我们的联络新号毫无反应。它到底是无法解析我们的信号，还是可能因为其他原因无视我们，我们无从得知。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议我们派遣一艘工程船来，将其拖出碎片区。要是不管它的话，这艘外星飞船很可能会被小行星撞碎。

已发布一项特殊项目去拯救飞船并调查它。
anomaly.4085.desc.en:
We have discovered an alien ship adrift among the asteroids surrounding [From.GetName]. It is not responding to our hailing signals. Whether this is due to it being unable to interpret our signal, or perhaps some other reason, we do not know.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends that a construction ship be dispatched to tow this stricken vessel out of the debris field. If left untouched, there is a risk the alien ship may be crushed by the asteroids.

A Special Project has been issued to rescue and investigate the ship.

anomaly.4086.a.en: Repurpose it into a science vessel.

anomaly.4086.b.en: Tear it down and study the engines.

anomaly.4086.desc.zh:
漂泊在[From.From.From.GetName]的飞船被拖拉出来，我们得以派遣特遣队去调查它。里面发生过一场谋杀。只找到了一位船员的尸体——那是一个长耳朵的两栖双腿生物，他身上有多处刺伤。该舰船因为没有了主人，已归我们所有。

该舰船拥有非常高效的推进器，它的架构和设计都高于我们当前的水准。飞船没有装备武器，看来是一艘运送重要人员的运输船。

把它改造成勘探船无需花费多大功夫。不过，如果我们拆毁它并仔细研究它的引擎，也许就能够对我们的舰队水平有实际提升。
anomaly.4086.desc.en:
Once the ship drifting by [From.From.From.GetName] was towed out of the debris, we were able to send in an away team to investigate. They uncovered a murder scene. Only one crew member has been found - a long-eared, amphibian biped who appears to have been stabbed repeatedly.

With its crew evidently dead, the ship is now up for grabs. It is fitted with very efficient thrusters, the structure and design of which are beyond us at present. The vessel is not armed, seemingly having been used as a transport for important personnel.

Repurposing it into an exploration vessel would be a minor undertaking. However, if we deconstruct it and study the engines in greater detail, we may instead be able to apply its ingenious design to our own fleets.

anomaly.4095.a.tooltip.en: Adds the Lush Planet modifier to [From.GetName].

anomaly.4095.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的森林让船员们大吃一惊。这不仅仅是一个充斥着各种有机生物的高度发展的世界，而且大部分植物的根茎都能吃。或许不算美味，但这代表我们可以轻易地在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的肥沃土壤上耕种。
anomaly.4095.desc.en: The forests of [From.GetName] have blown the crew's expectations away. It is not only a highly developed world rich in organic life, but most plant roots are even edible. This might not sound appetizing, but it indicates that we could easily grow food on this [From.GetPlanetMoon], due to the rich soil.

anomaly.4100.a.zh: 研究它们，找出更多信息。
anomaly.4100.a.en: Study them to find out more.

anomaly.4100.b.en: Try to domesticate them right away.

anomaly.4100.c.zh: 让它们自由自在地生活。

anomaly.4100.desc.zh:
$anomaly.4100.base.desc$ 这些生物的暗色鳞片非常坚硬，而且在陌生人靠近时极易受惊。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。
anomaly.4100.desc.en:
$anomaly.4100.base.desc$ The dark scales of the creatures are rock hard, and they are very skittish when approached.

It might be possible to domesticate the beasts and have them assist in potential future colonization of the planet. However, we might however happen across some interesting revelations by studying them first.

anomaly.4100.expert.desc.zh:
$anomaly.4100.base.desc$

[Root.GetLeaderName]发现这种动物有某种灵能能力，从它们的行为变化上看，它们可以感应到我们的意图。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。

[Root.GetLeaderName]说这些当地生物会“对不怀好意的人反馈负面回应”。
anomaly.4100.expert.desc.en:
$anomaly.4100.base.desc$

[Root.GetLeaderName] have been able to deduce that the animals have some sort of psionic ability, as changes in their demeanor indicates that they are able to intuitively sense our intentions.

It might be possible to domesticate the beasts and have them assist in potential future colonization of the planet. However, we might however happen across some interesting revelations by studying them first.

[Root.GetLeaderName] claims that the indigenous creatures seem to "respond negatively to thoughts that indicate any sort of threat."

anomaly.4100.name.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

anomaly.4101.a.zh: 这最起码是一种意志坚定的动物。
anomaly.4101.a.en: A strong-willed animal to say the least.

anomaly.4101.desc.zh:
我们试图靠近它们做研究，但进展并不顺利。它们一发现我们靠近，就要么逃走要么战斗，它们好像从大老远就能发现我们。

这些动物明显清楚我们的意图，所以尽量避免跟我们接触。

至少我们可以从远距离研究它们，也许会有所发现。
anomaly.4101.desc.en:
Our attempts to study the animals up close has yielded few results. They run away or fight back as soon as we approach, as if they knew we are coming way before we have even sighted their herds.

The beasts clearly understand what we are trying to do, somehow, and avoid being in close proximity to us.

At least we can keep studying them from afar and maybe learn something interesting.

anomaly.4102.b.en: We need the food for ourselves.

anomaly.4102.desc.zh:
接触这些动物的进展相当顺利！它们似乎拥有一种灵能感应，可以通过精神彼此沟通以及跟我们沟通。

它们想要自由自在地生活在大地上，尽情享受那里的水果。如果我们不打扰它们的生存空间和食物，它们愿意在必要时帮助我们。

这段佳话应当被广泛传播到人们的耳中。
anomaly.4102.desc.en:
Approaching the animals have yielded results! They appear to have psionic capabilities, able to communicate with each other, and us, via telepathy.

They wish to be free, roam the land and eat of its fruits. We would have their support, as fellow creatures of the cosmos, if we simply allow them their space and leave their food sources untouched.

Positive stories of how this situation was resolved is bound to spread to the general populace.

anomaly.4103.desc.zh: 这些动物非常难以驯服。为了靠近它们，我们被迫使用了暴力和麻醉剂。我们要驱使它们的时候，它们总是反抗。我们必须强迫它们完成工作，但效果不太好。
anomaly.4103.desc.en: The animals are proving difficult to tame. In order to get even close to them we have to use some force and eventually sedate them. They consistently fight back when we try to put them to work. We will have to force them to perform their tasks, which hasn't turned out to be very efficient.

anomaly.4104.desc.zh:
这些动物非常难以相处。虽然我们已经尽可能地温柔了，但其中一部分还是逃走和反抗。我们聚集了比较温驯的一批，训练它们工作。但其中一部分还是抗拒了。我们现在有一小群个体愿意帮忙我们，但这相比整支族群明显低效了很多。

我们驯服这些动物的消息一旦传入大众耳中，可能会对我们的声誉造成负面影响。
anomaly.4104.desc.en:
The animals have been difficult to work with. While we have been as gentle as possible in our advance, some of them still flee and resist. We have gathered the calmer specimens and made them work the earth for tests. Some rejected that too. We now have a small selection of individuals that are willing to help us, but they will not be as effective as the entire herd.

The way we enslaved these animals may paint us in a bad light, once word spreads to the general populace.

anomaly.4105.a.tooltip.zh:
添加失落的机器人社会修正到[From.GetName]：
£engineering£ +6
anomaly.4105.a.tooltip.en:
Adds the Fallen Robotic Society modifier to [From.GetName]:
£engineering£ +6

anomaly.4105.b.tooltip.zh:
解锁$edict_renewable_energy$帝国法令。

添加失落的机器人社会修正到[From.GetName]：
£engineering£ +6
anomaly.4105.b.tooltip.en:
Gives access to the $edict_renewable_energy$ Empire Edict.

Adds the Fallen Robotic Society modifier to [From.GetName]:
£engineering£ +6

anomaly.4105.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]行星是一片有毒废土，但是我们的扫描发现这里曾经不是现在这样的。一个如今已毁灭的文明因为过度依赖改变气候的燃料和毒素而彻底毁了自己的这个母星。

在一个大城市附近的一处偏僻山丘上，我们发现了一座还能运行的设施。这是一个组装机器人的工厂，周围泊满了军用车辆。但这些车辆稍稍一碰就化成了尘埃。

这座设施非常神秘奇特，但也许能够提供不少研究材料。
anomaly.4105.desc.en:
The planet [From.GetName] is a toxic wasteland, but our scans unveil that it has not always been so. A now extinct civilization seems to have destroyed its home planet, via a heavy reliance on climate altering fuels and toxins.

On a remote hill, close to a major city, we have found a lone active facility. A robot assembly plant, desolated and surrounded by military vehicles, so deteriorated they break upon touch.

The facility is alien and mysterious, but could provide us with ample study material.

anomaly.4105.desc.mach.zh:
[From.GetName]星球是一片剧毒而有腐蚀性的废土，但我们的扫描发现它并非一直如此。一个现已灭绝的有机体文明似乎因重度依赖改变气候的燃料与毒素，而摧毁了自己的母星。

在靠近一座大型城市的偏远的山丘上，我们发现了一个尚在运行的设施。这是一个荒弃的机器人组装工厂，周围泊满了严重腐朽的军用车辆，稍稍一碰就化成了尘埃。

这座设施非常神秘奇特，但也许能够提供不少研究材料。
anomaly.4105.desc.mach.en:
The planet [From.GetName] is a toxic, corrosive wasteland, but our scans unveil that it has not always been so. A now extinct organic civilization seems to have destroyed its home planet, via a heavy reliance on climate altering fuels and toxins.

On a remote hill, close to a major city, we have found a lone active facility. A robot assembly plant, desolated and surrounded by military vehicles, so deteriorated they break upon touch.

The facility is alien and mysterious, but could provide us with ample study material.

anomaly.4106.a.tooltip.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]的行星类型更改为大陆。

添加失落的机械社会修正到[From.From.From.GetName]：
£engineering£ +3
