£building£ 机器人组装工厂 +1
£blocker£ 坑 +2
£blocker£ 城市废墟 +3

The Planet Class of [From.From.From.GetName] changes to Continental.

Adds the Fallen Robotic Society modifier to [From.From.From.GetName]:
£engineering£ +3
£building£ Robotic Assembly Plant +1
£blocker£ Craters +2
£blocker£ City Ruins +3

anomaly.4106.b.tooltip.zh:
解锁$edict_renewable_energy$帝国法令。

[From.From.From.GetName]的行星类型更改为陆地。

添加失落的机器人社会修正到[From.From.From.GetName]：
£engineering£ +3
£building£ 机器人组装工厂 +1
£blocker£ 弹坑 +2
£blocker£ 城市废墟 +3
anomaly.4106.b.tooltip.en:
Gives access to the $edict_renewable_energy$ Empire Edict.

The Planet Class of [From.From.From.GetName] changes to Continental.

Adds the Fallen Robotic Society modifier to [From.From.From.GetName]:
£engineering£ +3
£building£ Robotic Assembly Plant +1
£blocker£ Craters +2
£blocker£ City Ruins +3

anomaly.4106.desc.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]上的那座设施因为科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的努力而恢复运作了。

机器人们启动后马上各就各位工作。[From.GetName]的船员们目瞪口呆，看着机器人们向四面八方移动，开始清除整颗星球上的毒素。

这不禁让人猜测之前的居住者是因为过度关注于自相残杀而忽略了自救。
anomaly.4106.desc.en:
The facility on [From.From.From.GetName] lights up as Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s plan finally comes to fruition.

The robots activate and immediately move with purpose. The crew of the [From.GetName] stare in shock, but warrantedly so, as the machines move out across the world, starting to cleanse the toxicity from it.

One could assume that the previous inhabitants were too wrapped up in conflict to save themselves.

anomaly.4110.fail.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的沙丘危险重重。这些沙粒如此的细小，我们几乎可以将其完全看作液体，它会吞没一切踏足其上者。在这里殖民只会徒然地损失人力和设备。

也许随着时间推移，我们会学会如何适应这样的环境。有句老话说得好：“站在前人的地基上。”
anomaly.4110.fail.desc.en:
The sand dunes of [From.GetName] are treachearous indeed. The sand is so finely grained that it almost could be called a liquid, and it swallows anything that sets down upon it. Settling here would take a heavy toll on personnel as well as structures.

With time we could probably learn how to work around these conditions. As the saying went: "Eventually our castle would stand upon the old one."

anomaly.4110.success.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的沙丘危险重重。那些光滑细腻的细沙就像液体般，对着陆造成了不可估量的困难。

不过，我们机智的科学团队想到了一个创新的方法。由科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]配制的一种化学溶剂可以凝固关键地点的沙堆，让我们更容易地穿越[From.GetPlanetMoon]表面。
anomaly.4110.success.desc.en:
The sand dunes of [From.GetName] are treacherous indeed. The fine grained sand runs almost like a liquid, making most landings an ordeal beyond measure.

However, our brilliant science team has found a solution thanks to some innovative thinking. A chemical solution, fabricated by Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], can be used to bind the sand in key locations, making the [From.GetPlanetMoon] easier to traverse.

anomaly.4115.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]出大事了！研究结束后并无重大发现，船员便返回到船上，却发现[From.GetPlanetMoon]的某只猛兽竟然跑上了船！

该生物已经杀害了一位船员，并正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的船员们。他们撑不了多久！已经发布一个特殊项目去救人了。
anomaly.4115.desc.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying a beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already killed a crew member and is trying to claw itself through the walls to get to the others. They won't last long at this rate! A Special Project has been issued to save the ship.

anomaly.4115.desc.mach.zh:
[Root.GetName]发生了大灾难！在进行研究而一无所获之后，船员们返回飞船时却发现上面有一只来自[From.GetPlanetMoon]的有机体猛兽！

这只猛兽已经瘫痪了一个船员单位，且正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的单位。这样下去他们活不长了！拯救舰船的特殊项目已经发布。
anomaly.4115.desc.mach.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying an organic beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already rendered one crew member unit inoperable, and is trying to claw itself through the walls to get to the others. They won't last long at this rate! A Special Project has been issued to save the ship.

anomaly.4116.a.en: A proud day for the navy!

anomaly.4116.desc.zh: 我们的救援队成功击毙了[From.From.GetName]上的那只猛兽。科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]和船员们都受到了惊吓，但依然能够胜任各自的职务。他们非常感激士兵们的援救，这件事激发了人们参军的热情。
anomaly.4116.desc.en: Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the team are rather traumatized, but assure that they are still fit for duty. Their appreciation of the soldiers saving them goes viral and we can already see a boost in new enlistees.

anomaly.4116.desc.mach.zh:
我们的救援队成功地消灭了[From.From.GetName]上的猛兽。科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]及其团队只受到了轻微的损伤，并仍可执行任务。武装单元成功排除有机威胁的行动引起了机械合成工厂对于机械安全的广泛重视。

因此，我们的作战单元的建造速度以及动机软件的有效性已有所提高。
anomaly.4116.desc.mach.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the team have sustained negligible damage, and are still fit for duty. The success of our armed units in dispatching the organic menace has roused renewed focus among the assembly yards responsible for their construction.

As a result, we are noting an increase in combat unit build-speed and motivation software effectuality.

anomaly.4117.a.mach.tooltip.zh:
失去舰船上的科学家。
你的帝国获得了$army_inspiration_mach$修正。
anomaly.4117.a.mach.tooltip.en:
Lose the ship's Science Leader.
Your Empire gains the $army_inspiration_mach$ modifier.

anomaly.4117.a.tooltip.zh:
失去舰船上的科学家。
你的帝国获得了$army_inspiration$修正。
anomaly.4117.a.tooltip.en:
Lose the ship's Science Leader.
Your Empire gains the $army_inspiration$ modifier.

anomaly.4117.desc.zh:
我们的救援队成功击毙了[From.From.GetName]上的那只猛兽。可惜他们没能及时拯救科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]，后者为了保护船员们而阵亡了。

至少飞船无损，船员们很快就可以恢复工作。我们的母星沸腾了，都为我们的士兵们的英勇行为点赞。
anomaly.4117.desc.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Sadly they didn't make it in time to save Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] who died while trying to protect the crew.

At least the ship is intact and the crew says they can go back to work soon. Our homeworld becomes abuzz about our military's bravery in handling the situation.

anomaly.4117.desc.mach.zh:
我们的救援队成功地消灭了[From.From.GetName]上的猛兽。不幸的是，他们未能及时拯救试图保护船员而受到了致命损伤的科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]。

至少舰船依旧完好无损，而船上其它单位表示他们很快就能恢复正常机能。我们母星主控电路正忙于升级军事相关算法以更好的应对未来可能发生的类似事件。
anomaly.4117.desc.mach.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, they didn't make it in time to save Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName], who took terminal damage while trying to protect the crew units.

At least the ship is intact and the crew informs us they can resume normal functions soon. Our homeworld's circuits are abuzz with updates on our military's efficacy in handling the situation.

anomaly.4120.desc.zh:
[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]盛产大自然的奇迹。巨大的七彩爆炸出现在空中，这是因为大气层中的化学成分跟恒星的伽马射线产生了反应。

学生们和高级科学家们都在传播着这个消息，消息如野火般扩散开来。科学领域中的相关人员都对此产生了兴趣。
anomaly.4120.desc.en:
The [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] is the home of a marvel of nature. Giant colorful explosions appear in the sky, a result of the chemical composition of the atmosphere reacting to the sun's gamma rays.

Students and senior scientists alike are spreading this find like a wildfire. It has generated quite the spark of interest for the scientific field amongst our people.

anomaly.4130.a.zh: 我们得查出到底发生什么事了！
anomaly.4130.a.en: We need to figure out what is going on!

anomaly.4130.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的小行星带，一棵大树在空旷的太空中漂浮着。这样空前未有的事情真是说出来谁都不敢信！大树被一个保护层般的泡泡包围着，看上去像个能源护盾。

我们突然检测到敌对的太空种群正在接近！这恰巧发生在我们采集样本并有树液从护盾中流出来的时候，难道它们是被这东西吸引过来的？
anomaly.4130.desc.en:
Among the asteroids around [From.GetName] a tree is drifting through the emptiness of space. An unprecedented and highly unlikely event! The tree is surrounded in a protective bubble, reminiscent of an energy shield.

Suddenly we detect some hostile space dwellers on approach! This coincided with some sap leaking through the trees shield while we collected samples. Could it have agitated the creatures?

anomaly.4131.desc.zh:
经过仔细的研究我们终于明白为什么树液会把那些生物吸引过来了。这棵树会生产一种非常高营养价值的液体，可以修复细胞组织。这简直是生命之树啊！

如果我们可以采集这东西，我们就能够延长人们的寿命。但问题是：大树就一棵而已，我们要么大幅提升一小群人的寿命，要么小幅提升所有人的寿命。
anomaly.4131.desc.en:
After rigorous research we now understand why the tree's sap summoned those creatures. The tree is able to produce a highly nutritious substance, which has machine-like abilities to repair organic tissue. The tree is a tree of life!

If we harvested it we could use it to expand the lifespan of our people. But there is one problem: the tree's healing power is limited in amount. We could only use it to improve a small group of peoples' life substantially, or increase everyone's situation by a small amount.

anomaly.4135.b.en: Sell it to a private collector.

anomaly.4135.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[From.GetName]上有重大发现。该行星上的沙丘隐藏着一些废墟，是属于一个星际种群的。这类殖民地大都敌不过时间的洗礼。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快发现了一个藏有珍贵物品和文件的储物箱。既然这些文件是跟珍贵物品保存在一起，那一定相当重要。
anomaly.4135.desc.en:
On [From.GetName] the crew of the [Root.GetName] have found something extraordinary. The planet's dunes have hid several ruins, belonging to an interstellar civilization of settlers. The settlements have long been destroyed by the ravages of time.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is quick to discover a stored cache of valuables and documents. The collection of texts must have been most revered by the settlers, as they were stored amongst other valuables.

anomaly.4136.a.tooltip.en: Gives access to the $edict_masters_writings_politics$ Empire Edict.

anomaly.4136.desc.zh:
我们的语言专家废寝忘食数个月，终于成功翻译了[From.From.From.GetName]上找到的文献。这些文件是一位被称为说书人特丽莎的著作。她似乎是位非常有名的哲学家、社会学家、关系学家。

$anomaly.4136.base.desc$
anomaly.4136.desc.en:
Having had our linguistics experts hard at work for months, we've finally succeeded in translating the works found on [From.From.From.GetName].The papers are the teachings of an alien scholar only referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales." All mentions of her points to her being a famous philosopher and overall expert on society and relations.

$anomaly.4136.base.desc$

anomaly.4136.found.desc.zh: [From.From.From.GetName]上发现的文件似乎也是说书人特丽莎的著作。$anomaly.4136.base.desc$
anomaly.4136.found.desc.en: It seems that the text we found on [From.From.From.GetName] is another piece created by "Telisa the Teller of Tales."$anomaly.4136.base.desc$

anomaly.4140.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员发来报告称，他们在[From.GetName]上找到了惊人的发现。其他文明的探索队在其表面留下了痕迹，并遗留了一些保存完好的档案及文物。

首席科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议将文献送回母星破译。但也可以将其卖给私人投资者。
anomaly.4140.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName]'s crew is reporting that they've found something spectacular on [From.GetName]. On the surface lies traces of an explorative expedition of another civilization. Left behind are some well-preserved documents and artifacts.

The proposed action by chief Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is to send the text findings to our homeworld for translation. There is also the possibility to sell them off to a private investor.

anomaly.4141.a.tooltip.en: Gives access to the $edict_masters_writings_philosophy$ Empire Edict.

anomaly.4141.desc.zh:
通过数周的研究，我们的语言学专家破解了[From.From.From.GetName]的文档中包含的内容。该文档记录了一位知名学者的哲学思辨，她被称为“说书人特丽莎”。

$anomaly.4141.base.desc$
anomaly.4141.desc.en:
After many weeks of study, our expert linguists have unearthed the meaning behind the documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The documents were philosophical ponderings by a famous scholar, only referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

$anomaly.4141.base.desc$

anomaly.4141.found.desc.zh:
谁能想到呢？我们发现的文献记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。这次，是一些对更宏观问题的哲思与分析。

$anomaly.4141.base.desc$
anomaly.4141.found.desc.en:
Who would've thought? The texts we found were more teachings from "Telisa the Teller of Tales." This time it's a collection of philosophical ponderings and analysis on larger questions.

$anomaly.4141.base.desc$

anomaly.4150.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的表面屹立着值得注意的建筑群。这些遗迹拥有不同的建筑风格，但都建于同一时代。[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾经可能是一个交易中心。

某些遗迹中存有文档和财物。我们可以通过研究文本来尝试翻译，以便了解曾定居在这里的生物。我们也可以将其卖给古董收藏家。
anomaly.4150.desc.en:
The surface of [From.GetName] holds something remarkable. Multiple ruins can be found, built using different architectures, yet from the same point in history. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] might have been a trading hub!

Some ruins held stored documents and valuables. If we studied the texts we might be able to translate them and learn more about the people who settled here. Or we could sell them to someone who values old heirlooms.

anomaly.4151.a.tooltip.en: Gives access to the $edict_masters_writings_diplomacy$ Empire Edict.

anomaly.4151.desc.zh:
我们天才的语言学专家正在努力翻译[From.From.From.GetName]上发现的文献。文献的作者被称作“说书人特丽莎”，似乎是当时的德高望重之人。

$anomaly.4151.base.desc$
anomaly.4151.desc.en:
Our most talented linguists have been hard at work in translating the documents we found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The scribe behind these works is referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales," and it seems she was highly revered during her time.

$anomaly.4151.base.desc$

anomaly.4151.found.desc.zh:
谁能想到呢？我们发现的文献记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。

$anomaly.4151.base.desc$
anomaly.4151.found.desc.en:
Who would've thought? The texts we found were more teachings from "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

$anomaly.4151.base.desc$

anomaly.4155.a.en: Let's try and get to it!

anomaly.4155.b.zh: 远离避难所和在那里游荡的灵魂。
anomaly.4155.b.en: Leave the vault, and its wandering spirits be.

anomaly.4155.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]曾经拥有一个高等文明。但他们早已成为历史尘埃。异形猛兽在星球表面的远古战场上肆虐横行。

在石山地区的山脉底部藏有一个避难所。如果我们能先处理掉地表的猛兽，我们就可以继续调查。
anomaly.4155.desc.en:
[From.GetName] used to hold an advanced civilization. It is now dead silent. Alien beasts roam old battlefields that stretch across the surface.

In a rocky region there seems to lie a hidden vault beneath the mountains. If we could get rid of the beasts roaming the landscape we could investigate it.

anomaly.4156.b.zh: 以防万一，只研究避难所。
anomaly.4156.b.en: Only study the vault to avoid risks.

anomaly.4156.desc.zh:
清除猛兽后，我们进入了避难所。内部似乎是一间指挥室，为这个死亡文明的领袖们提供最后的庇护。

避难所内全是破损的设备和腐烂的尸体。唯一值得调查的是一个容器，可能装有十分重要的东西。
anomaly.4156.desc.en:
With the beasts removed, we could access the vault. Inside it lay a headquarter of sorts, a last refuge for a dying world's leaders.

The vault is filled with destroyed equipment and decomposed corpses. The only thing of interest being a container, which potentially holds something of importance.

anomaly.4157.a.zh: 你目前在[HomePlanet.GetName]上。这里很安全。
anomaly.4157.a.en: You are on [HomePlanet.GetName]. You are safe here.

anomaly.4157.b.zh: 你的家乡被战争毁灭了，只有你幸存。
anomaly.4157.b.en: Your home planet was ruined by the war, only you remain.

anomaly.4157.c.zh: 我们尽力从你们被毁的家园抢救物资。
anomaly.4157.c.en: We salvaged what we could of your ruined homeworld.

anomaly.4157.desc.zh:
在[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器原来是一个冷藏装置！封存的外星人已经苏醒。她用心灵感应说道：

“为什么叫醒我？我们一族的战争结束了吗？”
anomaly.4157.desc.en:
The container found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] turned out to be a cryogenic device! The preserved alien within has awoken. She speaks using telepathic concepts:

"Why have you brought me back, captor? Is the war of my people over?"

anomaly.4158.a.response.zh: “我叫玛居拉，拥有‘领受者’的称号。我是一名将军，是东方女王的顾问，也是她忠诚的朋友。”
anomaly.4158.a.response.en: "I am Majula, the one bearing the title of "The Bearer." I was a general, advisor to the Queen of the East, and her loyal friend."

anomaly.4158.b.response.zh: “我拥有‘领受者’的称号。如果我们走向了灭亡，我要负责代表我的人民。除了对自己物种的了解，我在战争方面的知识最为丰富。”
anomaly.4158.b.response.en: "I bore the title of "The Bearer." I was responsible of representing our people, would we end up walking the path of extinction. My knowledge of war was only outranked by my knowledge of our people."

anomaly.4158.c.response.zh: “惹是生非的种群。我们的历史中……走向毁灭之路的故事比比皆是。人们不懂得实现自身价值。虽然存在许多明智之人，但很少有人愿意倾听。”
anomaly.4158.c.response.en: "A troubled kind. Our history is... was filled with stories of our inability to steer clear from the road to destruction. The group was unable to live up to the potential of the individual. We had many wise speakers, but few who chose to listen."

anomaly.4158.desc.zh: “我就怕这种事发生。希望我的知识和我们种群的悲剧能带给别人教诲。”
anomaly.4158.desc.en: "I feared that this would happen. I only hope that my knowledge, and our failure as a species, can teach others."

anomaly.4158.f.zh: 离开吧。你的命运由你自己掌控。
anomaly.4158.f.en: Leave. Your fate is your own.

anomaly.4158.militant.b.zh: 在战时被冷冻，你一定是个重要人物？
anomaly.4158.militant.b.en: To be frozen in war you must be of high value?

anomaly.4158.spiritual.b.zh: 你是出于什么神圣的任务而被冷藏的吗？
anomaly.4158.spiritual.b.en: Were you preserved for a divine mission?

anomaly.4158.xenophobe.f.en: You are of no use to us. Leave!

anomaly.4159.desc.zh: “是这样吗……我就怕醒来时会得到这个消息。说实话，我更怕永远醒不过来。你们一族想从我这里获得什么？”
anomaly.4159.desc.en: "So that's why... I feared that I would wake up to these news. To be honest I feared I would never wake at all. What does your kind want of me?"

anomaly.4160.desc.zh: “你的话语和你的文明向我证明了一切，捕获者。我会加入你，希望你能吸取我们种群的教训。”
anomaly.4160.desc.en: "Your words, and your civilization speaks to me, captor. I will join you, in hopes that you will learn from my people's mistakes.

anomaly.4161.desc.zh: 你的话语，还有这个房间的氛围，都证明了我们的观点不合。所以我不会加入你。我会回到[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]，穷尽一生讲述它的故事。
anomaly.4161.desc.en: The way you speak. The way this room speaks for you. It tells me that our views do not align, captor. So no, I will not join you. I will return to [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName], and tell its stories for as long as I remain."

anomaly.4162.desc.zh:
“宁死不屈！”

玛居拉愤怒地冲出房间。外面的人群正准备进行阻拦，她就抓住了一名研究员作为人质。在逃离过程中，人质不幸牺牲而玛居拉也被警卫击毙。
anomaly.4162.desc.en:
"I would rather die!"

Majula runs out of the room, enraged. As a crowd had gathered outside to take part in the proceedings she grabs a researcher to use as leverage. In the escape, the researcher dies before Majula is gunned down by security.

anomaly.4163.desc.zh: “再见了，捕获者。试着吸取我们物种的教训，千万不要在我们下一次相遇时，你也成了你们物种的最后一人。”
anomaly.4163.desc.en: "Farewell, captor. Try and learn from what happened to my people, lest we meet again and you too have ended up to be the last of your kind."

anomaly.4165.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]的荒野上，发现了战斗过的痕迹。在毫无生机的地表下，[Root.GetName]的研究员发现了骸骨和金属碎片，最令人吃惊的是一个装着文档的容器。

如果我们将文档送回母星破译，我们有机会了解这场战争和参与战争的种群。但也可以直接将其卖给古董商。
anomaly.4165.desc.en:
Across the barren fields of [From.GetName] there are indications of old battles being fought. Beneath the lifeless ground our researchers on the [Root.GetName] have found bones, metallic shards and, most surprisingly, a container filled with documents.

If we send the documents to our homeworld for translation we could potentially learn more about this war and who fought in it. It would also be possible to simply sell them off as antiques.

anomaly.4166.a.zh: 看来智者也会选择战争。
anomaly.4166.a.en: Even the wise can go to war it seems.

anomaly.4166.a.tooltip.en: Gives access to the $edict_masters_writings_war$ Empire Edict.

anomaly.4166.desc.zh:
几周来，我们的语言学专家一直在破译远古战场留下的文档。今天研究有了一些进展。我们得知，倒下的勇士遵循的教义来自于一个叫“说书人特丽莎”的哲学家。

$anomaly.4166.base.desc$
anomaly.4166.desc.en:
Our language experts have been at it for weeks to try and translate the documents we found in the old battlefield. Today we finally have some results. We now know that the fallen warriors all followed the teachings of a philosopher called "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

$anomaly.4166.base.desc$

anomaly.4166.found.desc.zh:
我们从战场上挖掘到的文献上记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。

$anomaly.4166.base.desc$
anomaly.4166.found.desc.en:
It appears that the texts we found buried in the battlefield were more teachings written by "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

$anomaly.4166.base.desc$

anomaly.4170.a.tooltip.en:
Adds the Rich Gas Deposits modifier to [From.GetName]:
£energy£ +50%

anomaly.4170.basic.desc.zh:
$anomaly.4170.start.desc$

然而，这些资源将会很快耗尽，因为储量稀少、体积较小。
anomaly.4170.basic.desc.en:
$anomaly.4170.start.desc$

However, using these resources would deplete them rather quickly, as the deposits are rare and small in size.

anomaly.4170.material.desc.zh:
$anomaly.4170.start.desc$

它带来的好处远比对环境造成的破坏要大。
anomaly.4170.material.desc.en:
$anomaly.4170.start.desc$

The potential gain this would serve to us because heavily outweighs any damage that could be caused to the environment.

anomaly.4172.conqueror.desc.zh: 我们占据的殖民地曾拥有丰富的地下气体资源。但现在已经耗尽，工厂的能源输出降低。
anomaly.4172.conqueror.desc.en: The colony we took over used to hold rich resources of gas underneath the surface. Now they've depleted, reducing the energy output of our industries.

anomaly.4172.owner.desc.zh: 富含能源的气体已经耗尽。这个殖民地已失去额外的资源输出，大大增加了我们对新矿藏的需求。
anomaly.4172.owner.desc.en: The energy rich gas found on one of our colonies has now depleted. The extra resource output has been lost, greatly increasing our need for new deposits to replace it.

anomaly.5.a.zh: 这些不义之财应该为我们所用。
anomaly.5.a.en: These ill-gotten gains shall serve us well.

anomaly.5.desc.zh: 大约在一千年前，有一群外星海盗断断续续地将这颗小行星当做基地。我们进入该基地后，找到了当时被遗弃宝箱。其中主要是各种偷来的珠宝和文物，其中一些看起来还相当有价值。
anomaly.5.desc.en: This asteroid appears to have been used intermittently as a base by a band of alien pirates roughly one thousand years ago. By entering the base, we managed to recover their abandoned treasure hoard. It consisted largely of stolen trinkets and artifacts, but some of it still appears to be of value.

anomaly.50.desc.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]被炸弹轰炸得坑坑洼洼，在大约两千年前，这里似乎曾被某群人当做靶场。残余能源示数表明，那伙人测试的武器也是千奇百怪，其中包括亚空间炸弹和某种奇点生成器。我们的科学家很想研究一下残余的能源回波。
anomaly.50.desc.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] is pockmarked with craters from weapon blasts, and appears to have been used as a target range by someone roughly two millennia ago. Residual energy readings suggest they tested increasingly exotic weaponry, including subspace bombs and some kind of singularity generator. Our scientists would be interested in studying the unusual energy echoes that remain.

anomaly.5000.a.zh: 我们应该调查这个信号。

anomaly.5000.b.zh: 探测器误差而已。无视它吧。

anomaly.5000.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]从[From.GetName]检测到了一些有趣的读数。那颗气态巨行星的大气层中有高剂量的辐射，似乎是由密集的轨道轰炸引起的。至于为什么有人要这么做则是个谜。

就在[Root.GetName]准备离开轨道时，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]从行星内部检测到了一个微弱的信号。或许是某种通讯信号，但行星的背景辐射太强，很难将信号从背景噪声中分离出来。
anomaly.5000.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName]. There are significant pockets of radiation in the gas giant's atmosphere that appear to be the result of intense orbital bombardment. What someone could hope to gain by bombing a gas giant from orbit remains a mystery however.

As the [Root.GetName] was preparing to break orbit, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] discovered a weak signal coming from the planet's interior. It may be a transmission of some kind, but the gas giant's background radiation makes it difficult to isolate.

anomaly.5001.desc.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]设法从[From.From.From.GetName]的大气层深处分离出了该信号。这确实是某种通讯联络，我们也借助滤波软件将其过滤了出来。
anomaly.5001.desc.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to isolate the weak signal that was coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of [From.From.From.GetName]. It does indeed appear to be a transmission, and we have filtered it through our translation software.

anomaly.5002.desc.zh: 气态巨行星[From.From.From.GetName]内部的信号消失了。我们再也不清楚它来自何方了。
anomaly.5002.desc.en: The weak signal we picked up coming from the interior of the gas giant [From.From.From.GetName] has faded. We shall never learn of its origin.

anomaly.5003.a.zh: 既然没有科技，那你怎么能和我们对话？
anomaly.5003.a.en: If you have no technology, how are we speaking?

anomaly.5003.a.response.zh: 这个嘛，毕竟你们不是我们遇到的第一个客人。某个慷慨的种群在290万个太阳年之前送了我们一些亚空间通讯器和一个扫描阵列。他们已经将其改造得符合我们的生理特征了。算是遇到你们这类人的其中一个好处。
anomaly.5003.a.response.en:
Ah, but you are not the first solid to pay us a visit! Another spacefarer graciously donated a small subspace transmitter and a scanner array to us 2.9 million solar cycles ago. They had been designed to be compatible with our physiology.

One of the more positive encounters we've had with your kind.

anomaly.5003.b.response.zh: 嗯，我们和几千年前来的人之间发生了一些不愉快，他们想让我们信奉他们的信念，我们拒绝了，于是他们就想灭了我们。事先也不通知一声！趁我们不注意，他们将舰队开进了我们的轨道上空，对我们进行狂轰滥炸。
anomaly.5003.b.response.en:
Well, the last time solids visited us a few thousand cycles ago, things didn't go very well. They wanted us to embrace their religion, we refused and this triggered some kind of genocidal reaction.

Completely unwarranted! Before we knew what was happening, they maneuvered their fleet into orbit and unleashed a massive bombardment.

anomaly.5003.c.zh: 你想请我们把全帝国的人民都转移到别的星球？
anomaly.5003.c.en: You want us to transport your entire species to another planet?

anomaly.5003.c.response.zh: 是的！并且希望马上就办！别担心，我们人其实也不是太多。许多达斯纳克都死在了那次轰炸中了，活下来的就退到了大气层的更深处。这里与地表的沟通不是特别顺畅，而且辐射也正在扩散。我们没多少时间了！
anomaly.5003.c.response.en: Yes! And hopefully soon! Don't worry, there aren't too many of us. Most Dathnak died when our planet was bombarded, and those who survived retreated deeper into the atmosphere. Communication with the surface is difficult here, and the radiation is spreading. We don't have much time!

anomaly.5003.d.response.zh: 太好了！我就知道你们靠谱。我们的新家坐标已经发给你们啦。你必须向我保证不能抢先一步先把那地方给占了，无论那地方有多好！
anomaly.5003.d.response.en:
Excellent! I knew we could count on you. The coordinates of our new home have been forwarded.

You must promise not to let your own colonists claim this alluring world before we get there, no matter how strong the temptation!

anomaly.5003.desc.zh: 终于见面了，旅行者！我们是达斯纳克，你正在绕行的这颗星球叫托洛克·隆-是我们先祖的家园。见到其他种群总是很振奋人心的，即使我们之间的上次见面……并不怎么顺利。你肯定检测到了我们大气散发出的辐射。托洛克·隆已经奄奄一息了，如果没有其他的栖身之所的话，我们的种群就会消灭。我们已经找好了自己的下一个家园，但没有办法到达那里。可惜的是，我们的无形特征意味着并没有太多工业或科技。你能帮助我们吗？
anomaly.5003.desc.en:
Finally! Well met, spacefarer! We are the Dathnak, and the planet you are orbiting is Tollok Rong - our ancestral home. It is always riveting to meet a solid, even if our last encounter with your kind was somewhat... problematic.

You have no doubt detected the radiation surges coming from our atmosphere. Tollok Rong is dying, and our species will perish unless we find a new home. We have identified a planet that would suit our physiology, but we have no means to get there. Sadly, our non-corporeal nature means we don't have much in the way of industry or technology. Will you help us?

anomaly.5003.e.en: Sorry. It would be too much of a hassle.

anomaly.5003.e.response.zh:
我就知道！我早就告诉过其他人这些固体家伙都是毫无人性的混蛋，他们就是不信！

你们这群人啊——简直就是星系的瘟疫！总有一天我们会夺取你们的地位，到时候再跟你们算账。记住我的话吧。固体的时代已经结束了！气态生命的时代将会来临！
anomaly.5003.e.response.en:
I knew it! I warned the others that solids are incapable of feeling compassion, but they insisted on making this humiliating plea.

I know you for what you are - a plague on this galaxy! One day it will be inherited by beings such as us, and there shall be a reckoning. Mark my words. The age of solids will be over! The time of the gaseous life form shall come!

anomaly.5004.desc.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]全程监督了达斯纳克的搬家之旅。一列配备着大型高气压槽的民用货舰载着那些气态生物横穿天际，将他们送往了气态巨行星的大气层。还顺带捎上了扫描阵列和古老通讯器。
anomaly.5004.desc.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has finished supervising the relocation of the Dathnak to their new home. A convoy of civilian freighters equipped with massive pressurized gas tanks ferried the gaseous beings across space and deposited them into the gas giant's atmosphere. Their ancient transmitter and scanner array were also brought along.

anomaly.5005.desc.zh: 托洛克·隆的环境进一步恶化，我们已经无法拯救那些达斯纳克了。辐射扩散到了大部分的大气层，达斯纳克幸存者不得不撤退到离核心更近的地方，而那里的通讯条件相当的差。辐射最终会扩散到那里的，那些达斯纳克只能听天由命了。
anomaly.5005.desc.en: The conditions on Tollok Rong have deteriorated to the point where the Dathnak can no longer be saved. The radiation has spread across most of the atmosphere, and the Dathnak survivors have retreated even deeper towards the planet's core where communication with the surface is no longer possible. Eventually the radiation will finds its way there as well, rendering their species extinct.

anomaly.5006.a.2.zh: 伯达拉克？真是个好名字！
anomaly.5006.a.2.en: Baldarak? That is an excellent name!

anomaly.5006.a.2.response.zh: 这个名字真的很好听，不是吗？能被你们这些名字听起来如此美妙的固体家伙们拯救是我们的幸运啊！
anomaly.5006.a.2.response.en: It has such a nice ring to it, doesn't it? We're quite lucky to have been rescued by such phonetically pleasing solids!

anomaly.5006.a.response.zh: 这样啊？那真是……太尴尬了，但你们这些固体家伙真是长的太像了。恐怕现在改名字也来不及了……这个名字也挺好听的嘛！
anomaly.5006.a.response.en: Really? I could have sworn... apologies, but it can be difficult to tell you solids apart. I'm afraid it's too late to change the name now. It has a nice ring to it, though, don't you think?

anomaly.5006.b.en: Good luck with your new home.

anomaly.5006.b.response.zh: 再次感谢，亲爱的朋友！愿气流保你永不坠落。
anomaly.5006.b.response.en: Thank you again, dear friends! May the atmospheric currents always keep you aloft!

anomaly.5006.desc.zh: 我们永远欠你一份情！这颗星球比我们想象的更好。人生头一次啊，我们的后代可以在大气层中玩耍嬉戏而不必担心自己的生命安全。我们决定以你的种群来命名我们的新家，伯达拉克。达斯纳克的后人会永远记住我们的救世主！
anomaly.5006.desc.en:
We are forever in your debt! This planet has exceeded our expectations. For the first time in generations, our young can frolic in the upper atmosphere without starting to glow.

We have decided to call our new home Baldarak after your species. Future generations of Dathnak shall always know the name of their saviors!

anomaly.5007.a.zh: 反正还是个气态巨行星，那就……
anomaly.5007.a.en: Well, as long as it's just another gas giant...

anomaly.5007.a.response.zh: 太好了！我们会把坐标发送给你。我们的殖民者迫不及待了！
anomaly.5007.a.response.en: Marvelous! We are forwarding you the coordinates. Our colonists are eager to get underway!

anomaly.5007.b.zh: 绝对不行。我们说的是只把你送上一颗行星。
anomaly.5007.b.en: Absolutely not. Our deal was to transport you to ONE planet.

anomaly.5007.b.response.zh: 我懂了……那我们就好好留在伯达拉克，充分利用这里的条件。
anomaly.5007.b.response.en: I... see. We will just have to stay contained on Baldarak and make the best of it then.

anomaly.5007.desc.zh: 你好！我们种群自到来后数量上已经翻了四翻，你知道了一定很高兴！刚到达星球时，大家都欢欣雀跃，如今甚至有点狂欢的势头。顺利殖民伯达拉克之后，一些勇敢的拓荒者想前往另一个巨型气态行星，他们让我求求你看看行不行。我们已经看中了一个有前途的候选行星，很适合殖民；而且它就在你们管辖的领域之内。你怎么看，朋友？
anomaly.5007.desc.en:
Hello again! You will be pleased to learn that our species has quadrupled in number since we arrived! Many of us were swept up in a festive mood when we made planetfall, and things got a bit frisky to say the least.

After the positive experience we had colonizing Baldarak, a few brave pioneers have asked me to petition you for passage to another gas giant. We have already located a promising candidate within your space that would be suitable for colonization. What do you say, friends?

anomaly.5008.a.en: Make the most of it, Dathnak.

anomaly.5008.desc.zh: 与之前相同，在这个高压的气态行星内，一队货船被用来安全运输达斯纳克殖民者。不久之后，他们成功着陆，并将这里命名为“新伯达拉克”。轨道上留了一颗人造卫星，用于和伯达拉克之间进行远距离通讯。
anomaly.5008.desc.en: As before, a convoy of freighters was assembled to safely transport the Dathnak colonists inside pressurized gas tanks. After a brief journey, they successfully made planetfall on the gas giant which they have named "New Baldarak." A satellite was left in orbit to allow for long-range communication with Baldarak.

anomaly.5009.a.response.zh: 我们还是得问问……请不要介意。查比克会尽全力在这里生活的，就像我们其他人一样！抱歉浪费了你的时间，[Root.GetSpeciesName]朋友。
anomaly.5009.a.response.en: We had to try... I hope you don't mind. Chabky will just have to settle down and make the best of the situation, like the rest of us! Sorry for wasting your time, [Root.GetSpeciesName] friends.

anomaly.5009.b.response.zh: 太好了。希望不会太浪费你的资源，因为只是来接一个人。我们这边会安排好的。我刚和查比克说了，她高兴得在原地转圈！她好像有点高兴得失去控制了……失陪了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]朋友……
anomaly.5009.b.response.en:
Excellent. Hopefully this won't put too much of a strain on your resources, since you'll only be transporting a single individual. We'll make the necessary arrangements on our end.

I just broke the news to Chabky, and she is spinning with joy! In fact, she is spinning out of control now... you'll have to excuse me, [Root.GetSpeciesName] friends...

anomaly.5009.desc.zh: 新伯达拉克向你问好！这边新殖民地一切顺利，不过我们又一个小请求……我们的一位殖民者，查比克·莱迪，十分想念伯达拉克上的家人和朋友，想要回家。她的絮絮叨叨快把我们逼疯了！如果不麻烦的话，你可以来带她回去吗？
anomaly.5009.desc.en:
Greetings from New Baldarak! Things are progressing well here at our new colony. However, we have a small request...

Chabky Raddh, one of our colonists, misses her family and friends on Baldarak terribly and wants to go home. Her whining is driving us crazy! If it's not too much to ask, do you think you could take her back?

anomaly.5010.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的护送下，一艘带着气体滤毒罐的小飞船来到伯达拉克。滤毒罐内的气体排放到气态行星的大气内，送这位达斯纳克殖民者安全回家。
anomaly.5010.desc.en: A single cargo tug hauling a gas canister has arrived at Baldarak under escort by the [Root.GetName]. The contents of the canister have been released into the gas giant's atmosphere, safely returning the Dathnak colonist to her home.

anomaly.5011.a.en: We shall dispatch a ship at once.

anomaly.5011.a.response.zh: 太好了！希望仅仅是发射器故障而已。
anomaly.5011.a.response.en: Excellent! Hopefully it's just a faulty transmitter.

anomaly.5011.b.zh: 够了！我们不是给你跑腿的。
anomaly.5011.b.en: Enough! We are not your errand boys.

anomaly.5011.b.response.zh: 但、但他们可能都死了！你就这么铁石心肠吗？我们看错你了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]！
anomaly.5011.b.response.en: But... but they could all be dead! Are you truly so callous? We misjudged you, [Root.GetSpeciesName]!

anomaly.5011.desc.zh: 我们收到了令人不安的消息，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]朋友！我们失去了与新伯达拉克的联络！他们不再回应我们卫星发射的信号，恐怕要做最坏的打算。也许入侵我们母星的外星人又回来了。请派飞船调查！
anomaly.5011.desc.en:
We bring alarming news, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] friends!

Contact with our colony on New Baldarak has been lost! They no longer respond to any of our satellite transmissions, and we fear the worst. Perhaps the aliens who bombarded our original homeworld have returned to finish the job. Please send a ship to investigate!

anomaly.5012.a.zh: 向行星开通一条通讯频道。
anomaly.5012.a.en: Open a channel to the planet.

anomaly.5012.desc.zh: 我们并没有查出新伯达拉克有什么异常。用于与首都通讯的人造卫星在正常运转。
anomaly.5012.desc.en: Our investigation of New Baldarak has revealed nothing out of the ordinary. The satellite the colony used to communicate with their capital is still functional as far as we can tell.

anomaly.5013.a.en: Tell us what you have planned.

anomaly.5013.a.response.zh: 我们打算用一支精英突击队深入伯达拉克。他们将打破枷锁。残酷统治者被废除之后，所有达斯纳克人终将过上自在的生活。这个计划直接明了，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。
anomaly.5013.a.response.en: We want to infiltrate Baldarak with one of our elite commando units. They will then incite a popular uprising against the decadent elite that lords over our people. After the tyrants have been deposed, all Dathnak will at last know what it is to have true freedom. A straightforward plan if ever there was one, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName].

anomaly.5013.b.zh: 我们会把你们的士兵送过去的。

anomaly.5013.b.response.zh: 真的吗？！你是我们革命的好同志，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]！让我组织一下！
anomaly.5013.b.response.en: Really?! You will? You are a true friend of the revolution, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]! Let me get the team together!

anomaly.5013.c.zh: 我们不干扰你们的内部纠纷。
anomaly.5013.c.en: We are not getting involved in your internal dispute.

anomaly.5013.c.response.zh: 当然了！我们可不想让革命的星星之火烧到被你当做奴隶的人民群众那里去！
anomaly.5013.c.response.en: Of course you're not! We wouldn't want the revolution to spread to the oppressed masses in YOUR tyrannical empire. Can't have that!

anomaly.5013.desc.zh: 新伯达拉克革命阵线向你问好！我们打倒了伯达拉克！我们与你没有过节，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]，只要你不去支持伯达拉克统领者的反革命行为。不过你可以支持我们……你愿意把一支突击队带到伯达拉克去吗？
anomaly.5013.desc.en:
Greetings from the New Baldarak Revolutionary Front!

We have thrown off the yoke of oppression and are at last free from the tyranny of Baldarak! We have no quarrel with you, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], as long as you refrain from aiding the Baldarak imperialists in their inevitable attempt to crush our revolution.

You could help us take the fight to our enemies, however... would you be willing to deliver one of our commando units to Baldarak?

anomaly.5014.a.response.zh: 就知道可以指望你，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]！这些叛军要死不瞑目了！
anomaly.5014.a.response.en: We knew we could count on you, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]! These rebels won't know what hit them!

anomaly.5014.b.en: You need to solve your own problems.

anomaly.5014.b.response.zh: 等这场反叛蔓延到你们的殖民地上，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]，你们就要后悔了！别以为你们可以高枕无忧！
anomaly.5014.b.response.en: You'll be sorry once this rebellion spreads to your colonies, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]! Don't think it won't!

anomaly.5014.desc.zh: 我代表伯达拉克的合法达斯纳克发言。我们收到了当前掌控新伯达拉克组织的声明，一派胡言！这些土匪简直是我们的耻辱，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。能请你帮忙扑灭他们小小的“革命”吗？我担心如果事态蔓延到这里，会有人受伤。帕塔纳克将军已派出一支远征部队，意在夺回殖民地，但我们需要你帮忙将他们送到那里。
anomaly.5014.desc.en:
I speak on behalf of the lawful Dathnak government on Baldarak.

We have received a manifesto from the group that seized control of New Baldarak, and boy, what a bunch of hogwash! These brigands and anarchists are a terrible embarrassment to us, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]. Will you help us stomp out their little "revolution" before it spreads here and someone actually gets hurt?

General Paltanak has prepared an expeditionary force to retake the colony, but we'll need your help transporting it there.

anomaly.5015.a.en: We shall see what happens next.

anomaly.5015.desc.zh: 一艘由[Root.GetName]护送的飞船悄悄将飞行舱送入伯达拉克大气，里面载着革命突击队。片刻，气态行星的云层下发出阵阵闪光。这是开始战斗了吗？
anomaly.5015.desc.en: A cargo tug escorted by the [Root.GetName] has stealthily dropped the cargo pod containing the revolutionary commando unit into Baldarak's atmosphere. Moments later, flashes can be seen coming from deep within the gas giant's cloud layer. Could it be signs of fighting?

anomaly.5016.a.en: Perhaps everything will work out for the best.

anomaly.5016.desc.zh: 我是佛坦伽！伯达拉克的人们推翻了欺压，他们以为可以让我们种群变为奴隶。我们建立了一个革命委员会，确保我们伟大的帝国度过这段转型期，并努力解放我们的人民。我们感谢[Root.GetName]的同志，他们的帮助让今天成为现实。完毕。
anomaly.5016.desc.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The people of Baldarak have overthrown the tyrants and oppressors that sought to enslave our species under their rule. A revolutionary council has been established to see our great nation through this transitional phase, while we work diligently to restore freedom to the people.

We wish to thank our comrades in the [Root.GetName] for their assistance in making this day come true.

That is all.

anomaly.5017.b.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
anomaly.5017.b.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

anomaly.5017.desc.zh: 我是佛坦伽！为了纪念我的统领，人民革命委员会一致同意，将星球名“伯达拉克”更改为“佛坦伽族”。还有，前“新伯达拉克”将更名为“查比克马克”，以我们的公众安全指挥官查比克·莱迪为名。完毕。
anomaly.5017.desc.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The People's Revolutionary Council has unanimously voted to rename the planet formerly known as "Baldarak" to "Fotangia" in honor of my leadership.

Also, the planet formerly known as "New Baldarak" shall henceforth be known as "Chabkymak" after Chabky Raddh, our Minister of Public Safety.

That is all.

anomaly.5018.desc.zh: 我是佛坦伽！人民革命委员会宣布，4539人即将因背叛和反革命被处以死刑。那些意欲阻止我们光辉革命之辈，愿此声明以儆效尤。完毕。
anomaly.5018.desc.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The People's Revolutionary Council wishes to announce the impending execution of 4,539 individuals convicted of state treason and counter-revolutionary activities.

Let this serve as a warning to all those who would stand in the way of our glorious revolution.

That is all.

anomaly.5019.desc.zh: 我是拉玛格！人民革命委员会宣布，佛坦伽即将因鼓动罪、腐朽和失职被处以死刑，即刻执行。我将接手他以前的所有职责。我的第一道法令是恢复佛坦伽族和查比克马克原来的名字。完毕。
anomaly.5019.desc.en:
This is Citizen Rutmag! The People's Revolutionary Council wishes to announce the impending execution of Former Citizen Fotanga, who has been convicted of demagoguery, corruption and general incompetence.

I will be assuming all of his former duties. My first decree is that the original names of planets Fotangia and Chabkymak be restored.

That is all.

anomaly.5020.a.en: Now we wait and see what happens next.

anomaly.5020.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]护送下，几艘货船将一队达斯纳克远征部队投入新伯达拉克大气层。片刻，气态行星的云层下发出阵阵闪光。战斗似乎开始了。
anomaly.5020.desc.en: Several freighters under escort by the [Root.GetName] have dropped the cargo canisters carrying the Dathnak expeditionary force into New Baldarak's atmosphere. Moments later flashes can be seen coming from beneath the gas giant's cloud layer. The fighting appears to have started.

anomaly.5021.desc.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，我在新伯达拉克。怒气燎原行动大获全胜。所有主要目标都已达成，所有大气区的政府都已恢复控制。除了还有几处负隅顽抗之外，多数叛军都已偃旗息鼓或阵亡。多谢你的帮助，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。请失陪，我需要向伯达拉克汇报伤亡情况。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
anomaly.5021.desc.en:
General Paltanak here, speaking from New Baldarak. Operation Gaseous Fury has been a complete success. All primary objectives have been seized, and government control has been restored to all atmospheric sectors.

Aside from a few holdouts, most rebel units have surrendered or been routed. Much obliged for the support, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. If you'll excuse me, I need to transmit a casualty report to Baldarak.

Paltanak out.

anomaly.5022.desc.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，新伯达拉克的代理军团指挥官。很高兴宣布47-G区的主要战斗已经结束。至少512名抗争者被消灭，我方伤亡极低。特别表扬将平民伤亡控制到可接受水平的部队。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
anomaly.5022.desc.en:
General Paltanak here, acting military governor of New Baldarak. I am pleased to announce the end of major combat operations in sector 47-G.  At least 512 insurgents have been confirmed killed since the operation began two cycles ago, while our own losses have been minimal.

Extra commendations to all forces involved for keeping civilian casualties at an acceptable level.

Paltanak out.

anomaly.5023.desc.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，新伯达拉克的军团指挥官。我希望澄清这个世界重现抵抗活动的谣言。这完全不是事实。本行星已经完全恢复和平，所有潜在不安定因素已经彻底根除。其人民已再次回到达斯纳克帝国治下。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
anomaly.5023.desc.en:
This is General Paltanak, military governor of New Baldarak. I wish to address unsubstantiated reports claiming there has been a resurgence in rebel activity on this world. Let me tell you now that nothing could be further from the truth.

This planet has been fully pacified, and all subversive terrorist elements have been fully rooted out. Its citizens are once again productive members of the greater Dathnak nation.

Paltanak out.

anomaly.5024.desc.zh: 我是拉普塔兹将军，新伯达拉克的军团指挥官。很遗憾向大家宣告我的前任，帕塔纳克将军的死亡。他被诱入叛军部队卑鄙的埋伏，光荣牺牲。我们将举行盛大的葬礼，同时庆祝当前压制叛军堡垒的胜利。拉普塔兹讲话完毕。
anomaly.5024.desc.en:
Colonel Rapzak reporting, acting military governor of New Baldarak. I must regretfully inform the galactic community of the demise of my predecessor, General Paltanak. After being lured into a dastardly ambush by rebel forces, the General gave his life in the finest tradition of the service.

A state funeral with full honors will be held at the successful conclusion of our current offensive against the rebel strongholds.

Rapzak out.

anomaly.5025.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我代表伯达拉克科学院与你交流。虽然我们达斯纳克不精于技术，但我们十分擅长理性演绎！

我们气态人的数个智囊团已经花费数年研究理论物理，并想要分享成果。也许我们的数据能对你们固态人热衷的帝国建设发挥作用。
anomaly.5025.desc.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! I have been asked to approach you on behalf of the Baldarak Science Academy. Although we Dathnak don't possess much in the way of technology, we are certainly capable of higher reasoning!

A few of our think tanks have spent the last several years studying theoretical physics, and we would like to share their findings. Perhaps the data will be of some use to you in the empire building activities you solids are so fond of.

anomaly.5026.a.zh: 好的，我们会帮你处理掉……
anomaly.5026.a.en: Yes, we will dispose of these minerals for you...

anomaly.5026.desc.zh: 你好，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！可以帮我们个忙吗？伯达拉克的强大引力把各种垃圾拉进了我们的大气，最近我们决定要进行清理。有个清理组发现了一个废弃的飞行舱，你可以帮忙处理掉它吗？它里面似乎塞满了各种没用的金属。
anomaly.5026.desc.en:
Hello, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Would you be willing to do us a favor? Baldarak's strong gravity well pulls all kinds of trash into our atmosphere, and at a recent council meeting we decided to step up our cleaning efforts. One of our reclamation units came across a discarded cargo pod, and we're wondering if you'd be willing to help us dispose of it. It seems to contain large quantities of various worthless metals.

anomaly.55.desc.zh: 通过近距离查看，我们发现了一颗几乎全部由贵金属组成的小行星最近与[From.GetName]发生撞击。该致密的金属球体被埋藏在了小行星的地表下，应该具备开采条件。
anomaly.55.desc.en: Upon closer examination, we have discovered that a smaller asteroid consisting almost entirely of precious metals recently collided with [From.GetName]. This small but dense cache of metals was hidden just beneath the asteroid's surface, but now that it has been discovered it should be accessible to mining.

anomaly.60.desc.zh: 这颗独特的小行星是在太阳系外的来客。之前，它似乎在穿越星际空间时遭受到了某种外星辐射的洗礼，随后进入了[From.GetStarName]星系。这种辐射的来源目前已不得而知，但通过研究小行星的能源辐射，[Root.GetName]得到了许多物理数据。
anomaly.60.desc.en: This particular asteroid is an extrasolar capture, and appears to have been washed by some kind of exotic radiation as it plummeted through interstellar space before finally settling in the [From.GetStarName] system. The original source of this radiation remains unknown, but the [Root.GetName] has been able to pick up a wealth of physics data by studying the asteroid's energy emissions.

anomaly.600.desc.zh: 在已经流逝的数千年的某个时间，发生了一次严重的撞击事件，一颗矿物丰富的小行星与[From.GetName]相撞。现在，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的撞击坑周围仍能找到丰富的矿物储藏。
anomaly.600.desc.en: A large mineral-rich asteroid collided with [From.GetName] at some point during the previous thousand years in what must have been a major impact event. An abundance of minerals can now be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] in the vicinity of the impact crater.

anomaly.605.desc.zh: [From.GetName]上的某个撞击坑似乎是一艘星际飞船撞击留下的。根据坑的大小判断，我们怀疑是一万年前一艘超光速引擎全速开启的飞船由于某些未知原因撞上了[From.GetPlanetMoon]。[Root.GetName]已经在超光速撞击地点附近接收到了残余亚空间回波，但由于飞船已经在撞击中解体，因此我们的猜测无法得到证实。
anomaly.605.desc.en:
A massive crater on [From.GetName] appears to be the result of a collision with a starship. From the size of the crater, we suspect that a ship exiting a hyperlane at maximum velocity rammed the [From.GetPlanetMoon] for reasons unknown roughly 10,000 years ago.

The [Root.GetName] has picked up residual subspace echoes near the crash site reminiscent of a collapsed hyperparticulate field, but as the ship itself disintegrated on impact the theory cannot be verified.

anomaly.610.desc.zh: 一个微奇点最近与[From.GetName]相交，径直穿过核心到达了另一边的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。这次遭遇似乎并没有造成永久性的损害，但稍微改变了行星核心的能源输出，这一点与我们目前的科学模型相违背。需要进行更深入的研究。
anomaly.610.desc.en: A microsingularity recently intersected [From.GetName], passing straight through the core and emerging on the other side of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. The encounter does not seem to have caused any permanent damage, but it has altered the energy output of the planetary core slightly in a way that defies our current scientific models. Further study may be warranted.

anomaly.615.desc.zh: [From.GetName]在被[Root.GetName]观测时自身的磁场出现了完全的反转。这个罕见的现象也因此改变了[From.GetPlanetMoon]的磁极位置。幸亏这些都被我们的传感器记录了下来，给科学家们提供了宝贵的数据。
anomaly.615.desc.en: The magnetic field of [From.GetName] experienced a complete reversal while it was being observed by the [Root.GetName]. This rare event has interchanged the positions of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s magnetic poles. Fortunately, it was all recorded by the sensors of our ship, providing our scientists with a lot of valuable data.

anomaly.625.b.evopred.zh: 他们的血液将流淌在其他血管中。
anomaly.625.b.evopred.en: Their blood shall flow in other veins.

anomaly.625.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]的高空轨道发现了属于未知哺乳类生物的保存完整的木乃伊。身穿整套航空服，甚至还戴着头盔，或许他是史前大战中的一位战斗机驾驶员，在弹射出来之后被人遗忘抛弃在此。对尸体的研究获得了一些有趣的数据。
anomaly.625.desc.en: The mummified remains of a single individual belonging to a previously unknown mammalian species have been found drifting in high orbit over [From.GetName]. The being is dressed in what appears to be a flight suit complete with a helmet, and may be a fighter pilot that ejected in some ancient battle only to be forgotten and left behind. Our study of the corpse has provided some interesting data.

anomaly.630.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的近地轨道发现了一个被遗弃的救生舱！它的表面被烧焦了，推测可能是由于所属飞船爆炸而造成的，初步扫描显示它至少有5000岁了。[Root.GetName]的成员设法打开了救生舱，里面是一个穿着华丽制服的蜥蜴人的残骸。它的手中抓着一张另外一个蜥蜴人的照片-它的伴侣或者崇敬的领袖。
anomaly.630.desc.en:
An abandoned life pod was detected in close orbit of [From.GetName]. It is covered in scorch marks, presumably from when the pod's mothership exploded, and preliminary scans suggest it was built more than 5,000 years ago.

The crew of the [Root.GetName] managed to open the pod, revealing the withered remains of a reptilian alien clad in a resplendent uniform. Clutched in one of its claws was a small picture of another individual from the same race - possibly a mate or revered leader.

anomaly.635.desc.zh: 某人在大约五千年前用轨道上的采矿激光在[From.GetName]的表面雕刻了一篇巨大的文章，占据了[From.GetPlanetMoon]的大部分上半球地区，似乎讲述了一位外星佣兵的悲惨一生。
anomaly.635.desc.en: Someone used a mining laser from orbit approximately five thousand years ago to carve a large body of writing into the surface of [From.GetName]. The massive script covers a large portion of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s upper hemisphere, and appears to be a short story chronicling the difficult life of an alien mercenary.

anomaly.65.desc.zh: 在识别到一座[From.GetName]的重力井中的异常现象后，[Root.GetName]发现一艘古代超级矿物货船的残骸被埋葬在小行星的地表之下。该船坠毁时处于满载状态，因此这个小行星的矿藏含量也有所改变。
anomaly.65.desc.en: After identifying an anomaly in the gravity well of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] has discovered the shattered wreckage of an ancient ore superfreighter buried deep within the asteroid's crust. It must have carried a full load when it crashed, and the asteroid's mineral wealth has been revised accordingly.

anomaly.650.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的轨道附近发现了一艘被遗弃的太阳帆飞船。这艘亚光速飞船的主人来自未知文明，并且似乎有数千年的历史了。其中一面帆有一个大裂口，似乎是被物体穿过留下的——很可能是一颗流星——这或许是飞船失去飞行能力的原因。虽然这艘飞船的科技已经很大程度上落伍了，但一些工学设计还是非常有趣的。
anomaly.650.desc.en: We have discovered an abandoned solar sail ship in orbit around [From.GetName]. The sublight vessel was built by an unknown culture, and appears to be several thousand years old. One of the massive sails has a large tear where some kind of object passed through - most likely a meteoroid - which appears to have disabled the vessel. Although the technology of the ship is severely outdated, it does possess some interesting engineering design choices.

anomaly.655.desc.zh: 在接近[From.GetName]时，几枚质量加速炮弹从[Root.GetName]的船侧飞驰而过。这些投射物已经有数十亿年的历史了，从轨迹判断，它们似乎是从邻近星系发射的，在偏离原定目标继续默默的飞行了许久-直到今天你看到它们。尽管历史悠久，但我们回收的这些炮弹的设计还是非常尖端的。
anomaly.655.desc.en: While approaching [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] suddenly received a glancing hit by several passing mass driver rounds. The projectiles were billions of years old, and based on their trajectory they appear to be stray rounds fired from a neighboring galaxy. After missing their intended target, they continued on their journey for untold millennia - until today. The rounds we have recovered are of an advanced design despite their incredible age.

anomaly.660.desc.zh: 出于某些原因，曾经有人将一个小行星拖拽到了[From.GetName]的轨道上。在小行星表面，还能找到当年使用过的巨大的引擎和制动推进器，虽然它们已经很长时间不能工作了。不管是谁搬运小行星，此人也采掘了小行星的矿物，但是这些设施看上去似乎刚刚启用就被废弃了。
anomaly.660.desc.en: For some reason, someone has towed an asteroid into a stable orbit around [From.GetName]. The massive engine sections and braking thrusters can still be found on the surface, although they have long since been rendered inoperable. Whoever did this also mined the asteroid for minerals, but these operations were seemingly abandoned shortly after they begun.

anomaly.6660.desc.atmosphere.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$大气中含有的特殊成分将会影响到我们的人口。我们应保持谨惕。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.atmosphere.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The atmosphere contains special gases that could affect our population, so we should be wary.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.atmosphere_mach.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$大气层含有可对有机体神经系统造成干扰的气体。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.atmosphere_mach.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The atmosphere contains gases that could disturb the functions of an organic nervous system.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.beauty.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$[From.GetPlanetMoon]的自然景观足以让任何人对其瞠目结舌。对于能够适应这里的生命来说，这里的生活将无比愉悦。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.beauty.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s natural beauty can make anyone gape in awe. Life here would be pleasant, for physiologically compatible lifeforms.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.default.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$[From.GetName]的环境完全颠覆了我们的认知。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.default.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ [From.GetName] has conditions unlike anything we've ever seen before.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.gravity.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$这座行星的重力远达不到承载潜在殖民的理想水平。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.gravity.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The gravity on the planet is far from ideal to accommodate our potential settlers.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.gravity_mach.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$尽管星球的重力不适宜有机体殖民，但我们先进的重力调整算法将会抵消其效果。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.gravity_mach.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ Though the planet's gravity is far from ideal to accommodate organic settlers, our superior gravity calibration algorithms will negate its effects.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.impacts.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$[From.GetPlanetMoon]经历着陨石雨持续不断的洗礼，表面如同被轨道轰炸一般千疮百孔。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.impacts.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is harrowed by constant meteorite showers, bombarding its surface with enormous projectiles.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.lush.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$动物能在此无忧无虑地繁衍生息，同时我们还有机会在这里采集亟需的资源。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.lush.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The fauna has no trouble to flourish, and could provide ample opportunity to harvest much needed resources.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.lush_mach.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$动物群的繁衍没有任何阻碍，并将为有机体提供许多采集必要资源的机会。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.lush_mach.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The fauna has no trouble to flourish, and would provide organic lifeforms with ample opportunity to harvest vital resources.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.magnetic.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$[From.GetPlanetMoon]的磁场远远超出了同类天体。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.magnetic.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s magnetic field is way out of sync with what is expected of its type.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.resources.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$它的元素构成以及悠久历史让其拥有了丰富的矿产，我们应当抓住时机进行采集。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.resources.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ Its composition and history provides it with extra materials that we should take opportunity to gather.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.tectonic.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$[From.GetPlanetMoon]不稳定的自然特征使地震与火山喷发都成了家常便饭。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.tectonic.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The unstable nature of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] makes earthquakes and volcanic eruptions commonplace.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.terrible.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$这里的环境极为严酷，并不适合建立定居点。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.terrible.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The environment is harsh and bleak, and would not serve as an optimal settlement site.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.terrible_mach.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$环境严酷而荒凉，不适合有机体生存。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.terrible_mach.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The environment is harsh and bleak, and not suited to organic lifeforms.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.tidal.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$[From.GetPlanetMoon]没有自转，这意味着星球的两半分别是永恒的极昼和极夜。并非理想的居住环境。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.tidal.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is locked in its rotation around the sun, meaning constant nights and days on each side of it. The habitability situation is less than ideal.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.tidal_mach.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$[From.GetPlanetMoon]环绕恒星的轨道是锁定的，意味着每一面的昼夜都是固定的。其宜居性对有机体来说并不十分理想。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.tidal_mach.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is locked in its rotation around the sun, meaning constant nights and days on each side of it. The habitability situation is less than ideal for organic lifeforms.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.titan.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$这座行星上拥有体型庞大的生命体，与它们接触可能会很危险。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.titan.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ The planet is host to massive lifeforms that might be dangerous to interact with.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.weather.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$强烈的风暴无休止地袭击着[From.GetPlanetMoon]，这对我们的资源开发以及研究都有帮助，但却会限制人口发展。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.weather.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ Strong storms ravage the [From.GetPlanetMoon] constantly, which can aid our resources and research but will be an obstacle for our population.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.6660.desc.wildlife.zh:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$这座行星上的动物极具攻击性，这为殖民行动增加了不少难度。

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$
anomaly.6660.desc.wildlife.en:
$anomaly.6660.desc.start$ Animals found on this planet seem hostile, and will make it harder to colonize.

$anomaly.6660.desc.end$

anomaly.670.desc.zh: 对[From.GetName]的调查显示它在一千年前是一个气候温和的大陆[From.GetPlanetMoon]。而恰恰相反的是，如今这里的大气中充满着毒气，地表高度辐射，已经不再适宜居住了。我们检测到[From.GetPlanetMoon]之所以变成如此景象，是因为前太空时代的两个文明之间发生的热核大战产生的毁灭性后果。
anomaly.670.desc.en:
Our survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that it used to be a pristine continental [From.GetPlanetMoon] with a mild climate as little as a thousand years ago. In stark contrast, the atmosphere today is extremely toxic, the surface highly irradiated and the world has long since lost the ability to support life.

We have detected signs that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was the scene of an incredibly destructive thermonuclear war waged between factions of a relatively advanced indigenous pre-space civilization.

anomaly.6700.a.zh: 查查到底发生了什么事。

anomaly.6700.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上的荒芜沙丘上探索时，第一个汇报并不出乎意料：这是一片不自然的废土，在水面以上没有任何的生命迹象。然而，这座行星的水生生命已经远远进化过了我们预期可以涉足陆地的水准。

此外，船员们还发现了一些被黄沙覆盖、外观老旧的似乎是建筑一样的东西。就在他们刚开始向这些表面上的建筑内挖掘时，一小群纳米虫群突触出现，并开始袭击研究人员。似乎这座建筑不是由沙子，而是由无数的微小纳米机器构成的！

启动以后这些虫群很快开始自我复制、唤醒越来越多的休眠群体。[Root.GetLeaderName]下令从行星上紧急撤离，[Root.GetName]才能在最后一刻从这个纳米机器人风暴的穷追不舍中逃离大气层。其他的虫群也被激活了，而且没有停息的迹象。
anomaly.6700.desc.en:
As the [Root.GetName]s' crew explored the barren dunes of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], the first reports were much as expected: this is an unnatural wasteland with no signs of life above the water's surface. Yet the planet's aquatic life has evolved well past the point we would expect some species to make forays onto dry land.

Additionally, the crew discovered what originally appeared to be various ancient-looking, sand-covered structures. Shortly after they began digging into these apparent buildings, small swarms of nanites emerged and began harassing the researchers. It seems the buildings are formed not from sand, but by billions of microscopic nanomachines!

Once mobilized, these swarms quickly multiplied, awakening more and more of the dormant whole. [Root.GetLeaderName] ordered a swift evacuation of the planet, allowing the [Root.GetName] just enough time to escape the atmosphere with a swarming storm of nanites in hot pursuit. The remaining swarm now seems agitated, and it's not calming down.

anomaly.6705.b.tooltip.zh: 指挥我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]解开[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上演化出的纳米机器人的秘密。
anomaly.6705.b.tooltip.en: Direct our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to unlock the secrets of the evolved nanites on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]

anomaly.6705.desc.L.zh: 令人好奇的是，这些机器人似乎是神秘的“建门者”的工具，比所有我们已知的L-星门都更古老。
anomaly.6705.desc.L.en: Curiously, it seems these machines might have been a tool of the mysterious Gate Builders, though older than any L-Gate we have found.

anomaly.6705.desc.end.zh:
这些机器人自主行动，并尝试按他们的程序保护行星。失去了创造者的规制，一场战斗很快就在这些机器之中爆发了。

这场冲突中胜出的是一群具有超适应性、可自我复制的纳米系统，它们迅速演化适应了行星的生态系统。这些机器将自己变成了行星表面的主宰，将一切当地种群和其他的机器对手全部化为碎屑。

如今我们所见即是这场大战的余波：一个并非了无生机的星球，而是承载着它最顶尖的猎食者。
anomaly.6705.desc.end.en:
The robots operated autonomously and attempted to secure the planet according to their programming. Without their creators to rein them in, a battle soon broke out among the machines.

The emerging victor of this conflict was a hyper-adaptive, self-replicating nanite system that rapidly evolved to fit the planet's biosphere. This machine made itself the master of the surface world, breaking down anything from local flora to its former, robotic rivals.

We bear witness to the aftermath of this great war: a planet not devoid of life, but instead supporting its evolved apex predator.

anomaly.6705.desc.noL.zh: 不管是谁，建造这些机器的人确实掌握了更先进的科技，而且远远地早于我们。
anomaly.6705.desc.noL.en: Whoever built these machines was in possession of truly advanced technology, long before our time.

anomaly.6705.desc.start.zh: [root.GetName]已经完成了对[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]原生纳米机器人的研究，结果令人难以置信。数千年前，一艘来自先进文明的舰船在此坠毁。那艘船上有几十种不同设计的机器人。
anomaly.6705.desc.start.en: The [root.GetName] has completed its study of the nanites native to [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], and the results are incredible. Thousands of years ago, a ship hailing from an advanced civilization crashed here. Aboard that vessel were robots of dozens different designs.

anomaly.6710.c.zh: 这些不仅仅是自动机器人，而是活物！
anomaly.6710.c.en: These are not mere automatons, but living beings!

anomaly.6710.desc.gestalt.zh: 这些是正在发育的蜂群行为，如果任其发展，纳米虫群可能会实现智慧。我们是让它保持这种状态，还是在它成为威胁之前将其摧毁？我们能否以某种方式利用这个实体来谋取利益？
anomaly.6710.desc.gestalt.en: These are the behaviors of a budding hivemind, and if left to its own devices, the nanite swarm may achieve sapience. Do we leave it in this state, or do we destroy it before it become a threat? Could we somehow appropriate this entity for our gain?

anomaly.6710.desc.normal.zh:
我们的一些[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，这种行为证明了该虫群是一个智慧的存在，或是某种生物，甚至可能被认为是活着的。

是时候做出决定了：我们是放生它们，还是摧毁它们，还是试图为了我们自己的利益而占据这些存在呢？
anomaly.6710.desc.normal.en:
Some of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] argue that this behavior is proof that the swarm is a sapient being - or beings - and might even be considered to be alive.

It is time to make a decision: do we let them be, destroy them, or else attempt to appropriate these beings for our own gain?

anomaly.6710.desc.start.zh: [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] 的居民令人印象深刻。我们发送到大气层的任何探测器都会虫群迅速分析并拆散，此后不久，虫群的其余部分也学会了如何最好地摧毁我们的无人机——即使是在行星的远端。虫群对我们的技术的理解显着增加。
anomaly.6710.desc.start.en: The denizens of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] keep impressing. Any probe we send down into the atmosphere is quickly analyzed and taken apart by the swarm, and shortly thereafter the rest of its hive has learned how to best consume our drones as well - even on the far side of the planet. The swarm demonstrates a measurable increase in its understanding of our technology.

anomaly.6715.a.en: Start up the colony ships' engines!

anomaly.6715.desc.zh:
尽管[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]的虫群在成为集体时所向披靡，但其个体却相当脆弱。从该行星的大气中抽取出一小部分，并使用我们的先进AI科技，我们成功地重写了这些机器人的通讯系统。当我们将我们重编程过的机器人放回虫群后，这些修改在一瞬间席卷全球。

获得网络的控制后，我们第一要务是为[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]带回稳定的大气，并且要对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而言最为舒适的那种。这颗行星现在已经充分准备好等待我们的到来，而纳米虫群则会对我们殖民者的需求无所不应。
anomaly.6715.desc.en:
While the nanite swarm of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] was impressive as a collective, as individuals they were quite vulnerable. Extracting a few from the planet's atmosphere and using our advanced AI technology, we have managed to reprogram the communication systems of the machines. Then when we reintroduced our reprogrammed nanites into the swarm, the modifications spread across the globe in a flash.

With control of the network secured, our first order was to reintroduce a stable biosphere onto [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] - one which is optimized for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The planet is now ready and waiting for us, and the nanite swarm is prepared to help with any task our colonists may give it.

anomaly.6720.desc.zh:
在[root.fleet.GetName]完成对[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]的轨道轰炸后，尘埃逐渐落定。尽管混合使用了强劲的爆炸物和试验性EMP，轰炸的过程仍然持续了很长，不过最终，这里再也没有任何机械生命活动的迹象了。

我们未来的殖民者可以获取这些害虫的尸体，并有望能从中收获一些有用的东西。
anomaly.6720.desc.en:
The dust is settling after the [root.fleet.GetName] finished orbital bombardment of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]. Despite using a mix of powerful explosives and experimental EMPs, the process took a long time - but at last, there is no longer any trace of machine life down there.

Our future colonists will have access to these gnats' remains and will, hopefully, manage to harvest something valuable from them.

anomaly.6725.desc.zh: 我们的预防措施和特种设备仍不充分。我们在[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]建立殖民地之后很快就跟地面的团队失去了联络。从落脚点收到的最后一条通讯显示，天空被微小的淹没了前哨的黑色物体遮蔽。
anomaly.6725.desc.en: Our precautions and special equipment were not enough. Shortly after establishing a colony on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], we lost contact with our teams on the ground. The last communication we received from the settlement showed a sky darkened by small black bodies swarming the outpost.

anomaly.6740.a.zh: 将新的频率发回给我们的艺术家们。
anomaly.6740.a.en: Send the new frequencies back to our artists.

anomaly.6740.a.gestalt.zh: 获取这些新的频率以备进一步分析。
anomaly.6740.a.gestalt.en: Retrieve these new frequencies for further analysis.

anomaly.6740.b.zh: 采集这些晶体用在我们能量武器的隔热上。
anomaly.6740.b.en: Harvest the crystal to insulate our energy weapons.

anomaly.6740.desc.zh:
造成[From.GetName]日冕发现的恒星辐射共振的原因证明是一种可以耐受高温的异常晶体阵列。

在把这些晶体带到船上后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]震惊地发现这些怪异的共振是可以复现的。首先，他们将这些晶体暴露在与[From.GetName]相同的恒星辐射中，产生了与最初记录的现象完全一致的结果。它也似乎制造了我们发送给它的所有能量波的共振，形成了[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]没有观测过的新的色彩和声音！

这种频率可以改变我们对宇宙的认知方式。换句话说，我们可以用一个晶态结构开发研究设备，使其能承受恒星级的超高热量。
anomaly.6740.desc.en:
The cause of the solar radiation resonance observed around the corona of [From.GetName] turned out to be an unusual crystal formation capable of enduring the heat!

Having brought the crystal aboard, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] were startled to realize that the strange resonance was reproducible. First, they exposed the crystal to the same solar radiation from [From.GetName], producing an identical result to the initially recorded phenomenon. It also seemed to create resonances with all energy waves we sent through it, forming new colors and sounds never before observed by [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Such frequencies could change the way we view the universe. Alternatively, we can develop research applications for a crystalline structure capable of surviving the intense heat of a star.

anomaly.6745.b.zh: 在我们的荣耀榜上的又一颗外行星。
anomaly.6745.b.en: Another exoplanet added to our growing list.

anomaly.6745.desc.zh:
自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始仰望星空以来，[From.GetName]就一直是一个纯真的梦幻，一个充满了我们的期待的地方，一个新的家园。可悲的是，随着我们的望远镜的发展，我们意识到这颗行星可能是一个潮汐锁定、万物冰封的地狱——这一假说已由我们今天的发现而彻底证实。

然而希望仍然存在，这个世界存在着作为一个宜居行星而言所必需的一切因素。我们或许只需要轻轻推上一把……
anomaly.6745.desc.en:
For as long as we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been able to look to the stars for new homes, [From.GetName] has been a naive dream: a place we would look to with optimism; a new home. Sadly as our telescopes got better, we realized that the planet would probably be a tidally locked, frozen hellscape - a theory which we have confirmed today.

There is hope, however; this world has all the building blocks necessary for a habitable planet. It might just need a slight push...

anomaly.6750.desc.zh: 这颗潮汐锁定的行星似乎具有各种宜居行星的建筑模块。也许在上面能建造一些东西。
anomaly.6750.desc.en: This tidally locked planet appears to have all the building blocks for a habitable world. Perhaps there is something that can be built here.

anomaly.6755.a.zh: 我们会试着辨别这些信号的指向。
anomaly.6755.a.en: We will try to identify the signal destination.

anomaly.6755.b.en: Bring them back to be sold.

anomaly.6755.c.en: We don't have time for this.

anomaly.6755.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地表之下生活着一种非常奇特的有机体。扫描和取样显示，它是一种散布着孢子的菌丝体。与我们母星上熟悉的孢子的尺寸相比，它们非常巨大。它们的表面闪烁迷人，千变万化，色调似乎随着环境而变化。

其中最奇怪的事情莫过于它们似乎形成了一种可以产生科学家相信是信号的东西的网络。现在的辐射还非常弱，但稍作努力，也许就能找到它们指向何方。
anomaly.6755.desc.en:
Below the surface of [From.GetName] lives a most peculiar organism. Scans and samples show that it is some sort of mycelium littered with spores. Compared to the traditional size of spores on our homeworld, these are massive. Their surface is a shimmering kaleidoscope, and the hues seem to change based on their surroundings.

The strangest thing about them is that they seem to form a network capable of generating what the science crew believes could be a signal. The current emissions are very weak, but with some effort, it might be possible to find out where they lead.

anomaly.6760.a.en: Prepare a project to do so.

anomaly.6760.desc.zh:
$anomaly.6760.intro$

我们的科学家猜测我们也许可以通过部分孢子带回“巨大蘑菇”来增强当前的网络。
anomaly.6760.desc.en:
$anomaly.6760.intro$

Our scientists hypothesize that we might be capable of strengthening the current network by bringing some of these spores back to the 'Fumongus'.

anomaly.6765.desc.zh:
$anomaly.6760.intro$

由于我们拆解了这个网络，这些信息就没有什么用处了。
anomaly.6765.desc.en:
$anomaly.6760.intro$

Since we dismantled the network, we don't really have a practical use for this information.

anomaly.6770.desc.zh: $anomaly.6770.intro$ 我们迷茫的科学家最终定出了“通过蘑菇来一瞥更高纬度”这种假设。关于会带来什么结果的细节完全没有。不过无论如何：这项操作是成功的，并且确实把我们指向了某个目标。
anomaly.6770.desc.en: $anomaly.6770.intro$ Our puzzled scientist finally managed by 'using mushrooms to peer into additional dimensions.' Details are scarce about what this entails, but in any case: the operation was a success and has pointed us towards a destination.

anomaly.6780.desc.zh: $anomaly.6770.intro$尽管[Root.GetLeaderName]尽了最大努力，仍然无法为这些信号指明目的地，而菌丝体仍然谜团重重。尽管如此，我们在这个过程中也收获颇丰，数据也如之前所说的一样会被带回去。
anomaly.6780.desc.en: $anomaly.6770.intro$ Despite the best efforts of [Root.GetLeaderName], it was impossible to determine a destination for the signal and the mycelium mostly remains a mystery. Despite this, we managed to learn a lot in the process and the data is being brought back as we speak.

anomaly.6785.desc.zh:
将变异的孢子移植到现有的蘑菇上是一项生物工程壮举。借助详细描述“巨大蘑菇”基因变化的档案，我们的科学家设法在不影响其效率的情况下进一步改变它。结果非常惊人，几个月后，蘑菇长了十倍。反过来这又增加了对水的供给的需求，但附近冰冻的小行星足以为它们提供几个世纪甚至数千年的水分。

更大的蘑菇带来了更好的网络，在对计算设备进行了一些升级之后，我们现在再次准备好听听孢子怎么说。
anomaly.6785.desc.en:
Grafting the mutated spores onto the existing mushroom was a feat of bio-engineering. With the help of archives detailing the genetic alterations already made on the 'Fumongus,' our scientists managed to further alter it without compromising its efficiency. The results were spectacular, and in a matter of months, the mushrooms had grown tenfold. This in turn increased the need for water to supply them, but the nearby frozen asteroids hold enough to hydrate them for centuries, if not millennia.

With bigger mushrooms came a better network, and after some upgrades to the computing equipment, we are now once again ready to listen to what the spores have to say.

anomaly.6786.a.tooltip.zh: 让我们看看你的记忆，宇宙旅行者。
anomaly.6786.a.tooltip.en: Let's see what you remember, cosmic traveler.

anomaly.6786.desc.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。它的面部毫无特征，而它的金属外构严重损坏了。初步的扫描显示它还有残留的能源，不过它使用的能源和我们的大相径庭。也许它的内部电路还能留存一些过去的数据，不过充能和翻译数据需要花费一些时间。
anomaly.6786.desc.en: We have found a bipedal robot floating in space. Its faceplate is featureless, and its metal exterior is damaged. Preliminary scans indicate it has residual power, but its power source is radically different from our own. Its internal circuitry may hold memories of its previous existence, but recharging it and translating its information will take time.

anomaly.6787.desc.zh: 通过不懈的努力，我们找到了充能机器人并扫描它记忆体的方法。难过的是，这个机器已经严重劣化，我们难以取回有条理的信息。我们会考虑发起后续研究，可能会研究它的其他同类，但这个机械流浪者的命运永远会是一个谜。
anomaly.6787.desc.en: Through diligent effort, we have found a way to recharge the robot's power supply and scan its memory banks. Sadly, the machine has deteriorated so badly that we cannot retrieve coherent information. We will consider a follow-up study, and we may search for others of its kind, but the fate of this mechanical castaway must remain a mystery.

anomaly.6788.desc.zh:
对[From.GetStarName]星系内时间波动的分析发现了一些值得注意的东西：一座巨大的、漂浮在太空中的棱镜。这座棱镜不折射光线，而是折射时间。取决于不同的入射角，[Root.GetName]的船员体会到时间在以不同的速率流逝。扫描也表明，他们中有些人快速老化，而另一些人则比预期的要年轻了数天甚至数年。

我们对这座棱镜的研究确乎加深了我们对时间的本质和性质的理解，但是它的起源和作用仍不得而知。
anomaly.6788.desc.en:
Our analysis of the temporal fluctuations in the [From.GetStarName] system has revealed something remarkable: a massive prism, floating in space. Rather than light, the prism refracts time. Depending on the angle of incidence, the crew of the [Root.GetName] report experiencing time at different rates. Scans indicate that some have aged rapidly, while others are days, or even years younger than they should be.

While our study of the prism has certainly deepened our understanding of the nature and properties of time, its origin and purpose remain a mystery.

anomaly.6791.desc.zh:
我们对$NAME_Hillos$残骸场的扫描已经完成。其化学结构同时具备生物和非生物性质，我们从未见过类似的东西。

这片残骸与在此恒星系中巡逻的奇怪船只间有何关联仍然模糊不清。船上没有生命迹象。事实上，我们探测不到任何种类的能量特征。姑且来说就是，我们在幽灵船面前栽跟头了。
anomaly.6791.desc.en:
Our scans of the debris field in $NAME_Hillos$ are complete. Possessing both organic and abiogenic properties, the chemical structure is unlike anything we've ever seen.

The connection between the debris and the strange vessel patrolling the system remains unclear. There are no life-signs aboard. In fact, we can detect no power signatures of any kind. For lack of a better descriptor, we have stumbled on a ghost ship.

anomaly.6792.alt.desc.zh:
我们的科研团队得出结论认为，在其命令日志中被称作“$NAME_Hillos_ship$”的、被遗弃的舰船曾在$NAME_Hillos$恒星系中进行实验，实验目的是创造合成人生命。反物质约束装置泄露导致舰上人员连同着新出生的“幼儿”一道丧生。在舰船的各系统中，我们探测到了灵能的存在。感觉这里还发生了一些别的事情，一些比单纯的事故更诡异的事情。

很有可能这个合成生命体具有某种潜在灵能力量，它的“鬼魂”在事故发生前几秒钟掌控了船只。如果真是如此，那么这个新生的意识体可能辗转花费了数个世纪，徒劳地寻找自己的母亲。不幸的是，此时此刻我们没有办法与该实体交流，也无法帮助其取得安宁。目前来看，$NAME_Hillos$恒星系中大概注定要继续有幽灵船出没了。
anomaly.6792.alt.desc.en:
Our science team has concluded that the abandoned ship, referred to as '$NAME_Hillos_ship$' in its command logs, was conducting an experiment in the $NAME_Hillos$ system, the goal of which was the creation of synthetic life. An antimatter containment breach resulted in the death of the ship's crew, as well as the newborn 'infant.' Throughout the ship's systems, we have also detected the presence of psionic energy. There is the sense that something more occurred here; something stranger than a simple malfunction.

It is possible that the synthetic lifeform itself possessed a kind of latent psionic power, and that its 'ghost' took possession of the vessel seconds before the accident. If so, this nascent consciousness may have spent the intervening centuries in a vain search for its mother. Unfortunately, we are unable to make contact at this time. For now, the haunting of the $NAME_Hillos$ system seems destined to continue.

anomaly.6792.alt_hive_robot.desc.zh:
我们对$NAME_Hillos$恒星系内的舰船的评估已经完成。据其内部指挥日志识别为“$NAME_Hillos_ship$”，由修复出的舰船记录可以得知其任务目标是创造合成生命体。一个反物质容器的破裂导致了船上的船员和实验“婴儿”的终结。

我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]探测到了游荡在舰船的系统中的痕量灵能能量，我们随之发现那个裂口并不只是简简单单的故障产物。

这些能量信号表明，合成生命形式具有某种潜在的灵能力，并且这些力量在故障之前很可能已经显现过了，这一切都导致一个新生的意识体在寻找母性的输入。由于没有更多的数据，我们无法证实这一理论，仍需要进一步的研究。
anomaly.6792.alt_hive_robot.desc.en:
Our assessment of the vessel in the $NAME_Hillos$ system is complete. Identified from its command logs as '$NAME_Hillos_ship$', recovered ship records track its mission goal of creating synthetic life. An antimatter containment breach resulted in the termination of the ship's crew as well as the experimental 'infant'.

Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] have detected traces of psionic energy lingering throughout the ship's systems, leading us to the conclusion the breach was a result of more than a simple malfunction.

These energy signatures indicate the synthetic lifeform possessed latent psionic power, and that these powers likely manifested before the accident. Resulting in a nascent consciousness searching for a maternal input. Without more data we are unable to confirm this theory, further study will be required.

anomaly.6792.desc.zh:
我们的科研团队得出结论，认为在其命令日志中被称作“$NAME_Hillos_ship$”的、被遗弃的舰船曾在$NAME_Hillos$恒星系中进行实验，实验目的是创造合成人生命。反物质约束装置泄露导致舰上人员连同着新出生的“幼儿”一道丧生。但是，在舰船各系统中探测到的少量灵能表明，那个合成生命体的“鬼魂”在事故发生前几秒钟掌控了船只。

可以想象，新生的意识体辗转花费了数个世纪，徒劳地寻找自己的母亲。不幸的是，此时此刻我们没有办法与该实体交流，也无法帮助其取得安宁。目前来看，$NAME_Hillos$恒星系中大概注定要继续有幽灵船出没了。
anomaly.6792.desc.en:
Our science team has concluded that the abandoned ship, referred to as '$NAME_Hillos_ship$' in its command logs, was conducting an experiment in the $NAME_Hillos$ system, the goal of which was the creation of synthetic life. An antimatter containment breach resulted in the death of the ship's crew, as well as the newborn 'infant.' However, low-level psionic energy detected throughout the ship's systems suggest that the synthetic lifeform's 'ghost' took possession of the vessel seconds before the accident.

It is conceivable that the nascent consciousness has spent the intervening centuries in a vain search for its mother. Unfortunately, at this time we have no way of communicating with the entity, nor of helping it to find rest. For now, the haunting of the $NAME_Hillos$ system seems destined to continue.

anomaly.6793.desc.zh: 我们探测到有什么东西从$NAME_Hillos$恒星系中传出。那艘叫$NAME_Hillos_ship$的幽灵船使用一种只能说是“灵能频段”的东西在不断地发出悲伤的哭嚎。显然，自从我们第一次遇到这艘船和被困在船上的新生意识以来它就一直如此了。似乎我们最近的灵能飞升是我们能听到这个孩子哭泣的缘由。通过进一步研究，我们也许能够与之联系。
anomaly.6793.desc.en: We have detected something unusual emanating from the $NAME_Hillos$ system. On what can only be described as a 'psionic frequency', the so-called ghost ship $NAME_Hillos_ship$ has been issuing a plaintive and irregular wail. Apparently, this has been going on since our first encounter with the vessel and the nascent consciousness trapped onboard. It seems likely that our recent psionic transcendence is the reason we're now able to perceive the child's cries. With further study, we may even be able to answer them.

anomaly.6793.desc.hive_robot.zh:
我们探测到有什么东西从$NAME_Hillos$恒星系中传出。我们最近调谐的[Root.GetTelepathPlural]已经开始接收来$NAME_Hillos_ship$舰船的信号。这些通信与生物意义上的年轻人有相似之处，并且显示出自我们最初相遇以来已经传播的迹象，我们最近的灵能发展使最终探测到它们成为可能。

通过进一步研究，我们也许能够与进行更多交流。
anomaly.6793.desc.hive_robot.en:
We have detected something unusual emanating from the $NAME_Hillos$ system. Our recently attuned [Root.GetTelepathPlural] have begun to receive signals emanating from the vessel $NAME_Hillos_ship$. These communications share similarities with those of biological young, and show signs of having been broadcast since our initial encounter, with our recent psionic developments making it possible to finally detect them.

With further study, we may be able to communicate with the entity further.

anomaly.6794.a.zh: 抱歉，我的泪腺有点绷不住了。
anomaly.6794.a.en: Excuse me. My lacrimal glands are acting up.

anomaly.6794.desc.zh: 在经过几个月痛苦的研究后，我们的灵能使终于成功地与占据幽灵船$NAME_Hillos_ship$的那个意识取得联系。尽管它的词汇量非常稀少，但这个合成生命体可以用感受和印象进行表达。这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。它似乎也喜欢我们的科研，在船旁边嬉戏地滑过$NAME_Hillos$星系，就像一只水生鲸类动物的幼崽围绕着它的母亲一样。至少，“闹鬼”的$NAME_Hillos$恒星系最终迎来了令人愉快的结局。
anomaly.6794.desc.en: After months of painful research, our telepaths have succeeded in making contact with the consciousness in possession of the ghost ship $NAME_Hillos_ship$. Possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was nevertheless able to express itself through feelings and impressions. The 'child's' loneliness was palpable, as was its joy in finally making contact with other minds. It also seems to have taken a liking to our science vessel, playfully gliding throughout the $NAME_Hillos$ system alongside the ship, much like the calf of a water-born cetacean around its mother. At last, the haunting of the $NAME_Hillos$ system has come to a happy end.

anomaly.6794.desc.hive_robot.zh:
在数月的高强度研究之后，我们的[Root.GetTelepathPlural]终于能和这个占据着幽灵船$NAME_Hillos_ship$的意识沟通了。尽管它的词汇量非常稀少，但这个合成生命体可以用感受和印象进行表达。

这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。而且，它似乎也喜欢我们的科研，在船旁边嬉戏地滑过$NAME_Hillos$星系，就像一只水生鲸类动物的幼崽围绕着它的母亲一样。至少，诡异的$NAME_Hillos$恒星系最终迎来了令人愉快的结局。
anomaly.6794.desc.hive_robot.en:
After months of extensive research, our [Root.GetTelepathPlural] have successfully made contact with the consciousness in possession of the ghost ship $NAME_Hillos_ship$. Possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was nevertheless able to express itself through feelings and impressions.

The 'child's' loneliness was palpable, as was its joy in finally making contact with other minds. Additionally, it seems to have taken a liking to our science vessel, playfully gliding throughout the $NAME_Hillos$ system alongside the ship, much like the calf of a water-born cetacean around its mother. The anomalous behavior it caused in the $NAME_Hillos$ system has ceased.

anomaly.6795.desc.zh:
我们收到了我们的一位首席灵能者的消息。现任，在研究了$NAME_Hillos$星系中的存在之后，他们承担起了尝试与占据着幽灵船$NAME_Hillos_ship$的灵能意识沟通的重任。在几个月艰苦的尝试后，他们终于成功地建立了联系。

这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他与之相似的灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。它现在调皮地滑过$NAME_Hillos$星系，用灵能向每一位愿意聆听它声音的个体倾诉。
anomaly.6795.desc.en:
