approach_cd_mining_tt.zh:
让所有人挖掘。顺便采集矿物资源。
月度进展：+$@approach_cd_mining$
approach_cd_mining_tt.en:
Get everyone digging. While we're down there, we might as well collect mineral resources. 
Monthly Progress: +$@approach_cd_mining$

approach_cease_activity4_effect.zh: 我们可以关闭开采平台，让恒星恢复平稳状态。$rg_small_negative_progress$
approach_cease_activity4_effect.en: We can deactivate the mining platform, and allow the star to return to a calmer state.$rg_small_negative_progress$

approach_clean_the_contaminant_effect.zh: 我们需要尽快清理掉这些污染，以重新回到我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]中。
approach_clean_the_contaminant_effect.en: We need to clean up the contaminant as quickly as possible so we can get back to our [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

approach_climate_cleanup_efforts_tooltip.zh: 这个星球不会变成一个死寂星球。然而，我们的$building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$现在需要极大的£unity£ 凝聚力维护费。
approach_climate_cleanup_efforts_tooltip.en: The world will NOT become a Tomb World. However, our $building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$ will now have a significant £unity£ Unity upkeep.

approach_climate_do_nothing_tooltip.zh: 这个星球会变成一个死寂星球。我们的$building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$从今以后会产生更加强力的效果。
approach_climate_do_nothing_tooltip.en: The world will become a Tomb World. Our $building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$ will henceforth have even greater effects.

approach_climate_embrace_change_tooltip.zh: 我们会研究这个过程，学会如何安全地将星球转变为死寂星球。我们的$building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$造成的人口增长惩罚会减小，相应的环境改造选项会解锁。
approach_climate_embrace_change_tooltip.en: We will study the process to learn how to safely turn worlds into Tomb Worlds. Pop growth penalties of our $building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$ will be reduced, and corresponding Terraforming options will be unlocked.

approach_continue_siphoning4_effect.zh: 我们可以利用这股能量焚毁母星系，并从残骸中获取财富。$rg_high_progress$
approach_continue_siphoning4_effect.en: We can use this power to incinerate our home system, allowing us to sift through the remains for riches.$rg_high_progress$

approach_cure_it_effect.zh: 我们终于找到了解决措施，希望不会太晚。
approach_cure_it_effect.en: We now have a cure. We can only hope that it's not too late.

approach_cyberization_cautious_tt.zh:
更高概率出现正面事件。
$situation_speed_tt$：-20%

approach_cyberization_overdrive_tt.zh:
更高概率出现挑战性事件。
$situation_speed_tt$：+20%

approach_destroy_labyrinth_tooltip.zh: 我们将试图摆脱这座迷宫。
approach_destroy_labyrinth_tooltip.en: We will attempt to be rid of the Labyrinth.

approach_digitization_errorcorrecting_tt.zh:
更高概率出现正面事件。
$situation_speed_tt$：-20%

approach_digitization_overclocked_tt.zh:
更高概率出现挑战性事件。
$situation_speed_tt$：+20%

approach_disrupt_subspace_tunnels2_effec.zh: 为保持恒星完整性，必须立即采取应对措施，破坏亚空间隧道。$rg_small_progress$
approach_disrupt_subspace_tunnels2_effec.en: Preserving the integrity of our star necessitates immediate countermeasures. Disruption of the subspace tunnels is imperative.$rg_small_progress$

approach_find_the_cause_effect.zh: 恒星膨胀无法停止，必须立即展开全面调查以查明根源。$rg_default_progress$
approach_find_the_cause_effect.en: The star's expansion cannot be halted. Immediate and comprehensive investigation is imperative to ascertain the underlying cause.$rg_default_progress$

approach_frenzied_voidworms_do_nothing_t.zh: 我们目前不会采取任何特殊行动。
approach_frenzied_voidworms_do_nothing_t.en: We will take no special actions here.

approach_frenzied_voidworms_feed_nests_t.zh: 如果我们能降低其攻击性到足够程度，就有可能赢得它们的信任。
approach_frenzied_voidworms_feed_nests_t.en: If we lower their aggression enough, it's possible we can gain their trust.

approach_frenzied_voidworms_hide_presenc.zh: 我们恒星系中所有最靠近其家园星系的建筑活动将被暂停。
approach_frenzied_voidworms_hide_presenc.en: All construction activities in our system nearest their home system are halted.

approach_frenzied_voidworms_stir_nests_t.zh: 激怒这些生物会加剧它们对我们的敌意。
approach_frenzied_voidworms_stir_nests_t.en: Provoking the creatures will raise their hostility toward us.

approach_give_robots_rights_tooltip.zh:
$approach_irreversible_tooltip$

我们将授予我们的机器人公民权。他们将获得£political_power£政治权利，并会需要£consumer_goods£消费品维护费。
approach_give_robots_rights_tooltip.en:
$approach_irreversible_tooltip$

We will grant our robots full citizenship rights. They will be granted £political_power£ Political Power and will require £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods upkeep.

approach_little_food_tooltip.zh: 提高心情。一只满意的万华镜寄生虫会绽放满足的光线，几乎不会带来麻烦。
approach_little_food_tooltip.en: Improves mood. A sated Kaleidoscope will produce pleasing lights and little trouble.

approach_no_food_tooltip.zh: 降低心情。一只挨饿的万华镜寄生虫会大发雷霆，给我们造成麻烦。
approach_no_food_tooltip.en: Lowers mood. A starved Kaleidoscope will lash out and give us trouble.

approach_observe_nmass.en: Observe the decay of the Beta-Universe

approach_outcome_caeli.zh: 我们尚不确定支持“福祉指令”可能带来的结果。
approach_outcome_caeli.en: We are uncertain about the potential outcomes of supporting the Well-Being directive.

approach_outcome_refurbishment_intensive.zh: 翻新速度会快很多，但成本也很高。
approach_outcome_refurbishment_intensive.en: The refurbishment will complete significantly faster, but at considerable cost.

approach_outcome_refurbishment_minimal.zh: 项目会耗时更久，但财政负担会更轻。
approach_outcome_refurbishment_minimal.en: The project will take longer, but the financial burden will be lighter.

approach_outcome_refurbishment_standard.zh: 稳步推进将使翻修工程如期完成。
approach_outcome_refurbishment_standard.en: A steady pace will see the refurbishment completed in due course.

approach_outcome_steris.zh: 我们尚不确定支持“功能指令”可能产生的结果。
approach_outcome_steris.en: We are uncertain about the potential outcomes of supporting the Functionality directive.

approach_outcome_tooltip.zh: 这一解决方案将使局势向某一确定的结果发展。
approach_outcome_tooltip.en: This Approach will advance the Situation towards a certain outcome.

approach_outlaw_robots_tooltip.zh:
$approach_irreversible_tooltip$

我们会开始拆解机器人。它们也许会抗拒这一做法。
approach_outlaw_robots_tooltip.en:
$approach_irreversible_tooltip$

We will begin dismantling our robots. They may resist this course of action.

approach_prevent_singularity_tooltip.zh: 预防奇点的出现需要持续地投入资源。一旦选择这个应对方案，我们今后就无法再进行变更。
approach_prevent_singularity_tooltip.en: Preventing the Singularity will require a continuous investment in resources. Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.

approach_promote_disease_tooltip.zh: 瘟疫提供了我们一个绝佳的进行研究的机会，我们甚至有机会一口气净化整个行星上的感性生命体。一旦选定，我们将无法改变针对该局势的应对方案。
approach_promote_disease_tooltip.en: The plague offers a unique opportunity for research, and perhaps even the chance to purge the planet of sentient life. Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.

approach_promote_singularity_tooltip.zh: 鼓励奇点的出现需要投入大量资源。一旦选择这个应对方案，我们今后就无法再进行变更。
approach_promote_singularity_tooltip.en: Promoting the Singularity will require a significant investment.  Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.

approach_protect_effect.zh: 消耗£energy£能量币来减少每个月受到的辐射损伤量（每个£pop£人口£energy£[target.energy_cost]）
approach_protect_effect.en: Spend £energy£ Energy to reduce the amount of radiation damage you gain each month. (£energy£ [target.energy_cost] per £pop£ Pop)

approach_protect_nobody_effect.zh: 在辐射损伤面前完全不保护子个体。
approach_protect_nobody_effect.en: Don't shield drones from radiation damage.

approach_reassure_public_effect.zh: 关于此次危机的信息可能会破坏社会稳定，请保密。$rg_default_progress$
approach_reassure_public_effect.en: Information about this crisis could destabilize society. Keep this quiet.$rg_default_progress$

approach_reorganize_effect.zh: 暂停局势，解锁一项殖民地决议以便把[Owner.GetParadeStudy]搬到那里。
approach_reorganize_effect.en: Pause the situation and unlock a special Colony Decision to move the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] there.

approach_reverse_inflation4_effect.zh: 我们可以将恒星缩小到原尺寸，恢复母星的宜居性。$rg_high_negative_progress$
approach_reverse_inflation4_effect.en: We can shrink our star back down to its previous size, restoring habitability to our homeworld.$rg_high_negative_progress$

approach_sabotage_do_nothing_tt.zh: 我们目前不会采取任何特殊行动。
approach_sabotage_do_nothing_tt.en: We will take no special actions here.

approach_sabotage_mitigate_tt.zh: 可以采取相应措施重建我们的基础设施，希望通过消耗战来抵御破坏性攻击。
approach_sabotage_mitigate_tt.en: Responsive measures can be taken to rebuild our infrastructure in the hopes of outlasting the sabotage attack by attrition.

approach_sabotage_purge_tt.zh: 清除潜伏在我方内部的卧底特工势必会造成一些不可避免的附带损害。
approach_sabotage_purge_tt.en: Hunting down the agents hidden in our ranks will result in some unavoidable collateral damage.

approach_save_b_world.zh: 将[Target.GetName]-贝塔带到我们的宇宙

approach_search_for_a_cure_effect.zh: 我们需要动员所有的科学家来研究这个怪异的恒星黑子，我们的首都安危在此一举。
approach_search_for_a_cure_effect.en: We need every scientist available to study the strange sunspots. Our Capital depends on it.

approach_singularity_tooltip_fail.en: It is too late to switch our approach.

approach_siphon_stellar_material3_effect.zh: 如果直接从恒星移除物质，或许能加速恢复常态。$rg_medium_negative_progress$
approach_siphon_stellar_material3_effect.en: We may be able to accelerate a return to normalcy if we directly remove material from the star.$rg_medium_negative_progress$

approach_situation_a_rift_in_space_devot.zh: 可以让我们的科学家们分配大量的研究资源以揭开这一时空裂隙的秘密。
approach_situation_a_rift_in_space_devot.en: We can dedicate a significant amount of research from our scientists towards unlocking the secrets of this rift in space and time.

approach_situation_a_rift_in_space_send_.zh: 往裂隙中发送的每一个探测器都能加深我们对如何穿透其边界的理解。我们可以分配合金总产出的一部分用于此项目。
approach_situation_a_rift_in_space_send_.en: Each probe we send into the rift furthers our understanding of how to penetrate its borders. We are able to dedicate a certain amount of our total Alloy production for this purpose.

approach_situation_a_rift_in_space_stand.zh: 我们当前的情况还不允许花费如此宝贵的资源。在远处观测这一现象即可。
approach_situation_a_rift_in_space_stand.en: We are not in a position to spend such valuable resources. Let us observe this phenomenon from afar.

approach_situation_beneficial_tooltip.zh: 更高概率出现正面事件。

approach_situation_chaotic_tooltip.zh: 更高概率出现混沌事件。

approach_situation_destroy_crystal_spher.zh: 星界丝缕能够在这个装置的晶体结构中穿梭，从内部削弱它。
approach_situation_destroy_crystal_spher.en: Astral thread is able to slip within the crystalline structure of this device to weaken it from within.

approach_situation_destroy_crystal_spher.zh: 我们的工程师相信，如果我们引爆一系列受控的爆炸物，我们将达到一个共振频率，这将完全粉碎水晶球。
approach_situation_destroy_crystal_spher.en: Our engineers believe if we detonate a controlled series of explosives, we will achieve a resonance frequency which will shatter the crystal sphere entirely.

approach_situation_locked_tt.zh: 另一场风暴已经在酿造中。
approach_situation_locked_tt.en: Another approach is already in progress.

approach_situation_origin_forgotten_bala.zh: 通过倾听和与反对派中更理性的群体交谈，我们可以一边安抚媒体，一边对付那些更加……极端的成员。
approach_situation_origin_forgotten_bala.en: By listening and talking to the more reasonable groups in the opposition, we can appease the media while we deal with the more... extreme elements.

approach_situation_origin_forgotten_crac.zh: 我们绝不容忍意见分子。对那些想要破坏我们的人必须重拳出击。
approach_situation_origin_forgotten_crac.en: We cannot tolerate dissidence. We must crush those who would undermine us.

approach_situation_origin_forgotten_prop.zh: 我们可以利用宣传来破坏反对派的支持。这可能会迷惑民众，但应该让我们来维持和平。
approach_situation_origin_forgotten_prop.en: We can use propaganda to undermine the opposition's support. This could confuse the population, but should let us maintain the peace.

approach_situation_origin_promise_constr.zh: 我们会将重点放在工程建设。
approach_situation_origin_promise_constr.en: We will focus on engineering works.

approach_situation_origin_promise_engine.zh: 我们要加大研究的投入。
approach_situation_origin_promise_engine.en: We will intensify our research efforts.

approach_situation_origin_promise_expans.en: We will focus on internal affairs.

approach_situation_origin_promise_prospe.zh: 我们会关注寻找新资源。
approach_situation_origin_promise_prospe.en: We will focus on finding new resources.

approach_situation_paragon_origin_reform.zh: 对平民发动攻击是不可接受的。我们将以和平方式推进，呼吁停火并邀请改革派进行谈判。希望这样可以减少暴力行为的需求。
approach_situation_paragon_origin_reform.en: Fighting against civilians is unacceptable. We will push forward peacefully, calling for a truce and inviting the Reformists to negotiate. Hopefully, this will limit the need for violence.

approach_situation_paragon_origin_reform.zh:
对所有已知的改革派藏身处进行暴力打击，应该可以恢复国家的稳定。
为了终结当下的局势，完成$council_agenda_origin_delusional_tyrant_name$议程。
approach_situation_paragon_origin_reform.en:
A brutal crackdown on all known Reformist hideouts ought to restore stability to the nation.
To put an end to the situation, finish the $council_agenda_origin_delusional_tyrant_name$ Agenda.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_balanc.zh: 可持续的资助可以保证项目正常推进的同时又不给我们的经济带来太大的负担。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_balanc.en: Sustainable financing will allow the project to move forward without overburdening our economy.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_cure_g.zh: 我们基于新型传染病和医疗保健的经验组建了一系列研究团队。他们的首要目标是找到治愈方法，而不是缓解症状或阻止疫情蔓延。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_cure_g.en: Research teams are assembled based on experience in novel diseases and health care. Priority is placed on finding a cure rather than easing symptoms or limiting the spread of the disease.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_cure_n.zh: 我们不能为此牺牲自己的科研进度，只有一些志愿者来进行坏羽病的治疗。这将会严重拖缓我们的进度。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_cure_n.en: We cannot sacrifice our research capabilities - only volunteers are working on a treatment for Feather Rot. This will seriously slow our progress.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_cure_r.zh: 我们基于新型传染病和医疗保健的经验组建了一系列研究团队。他们的目标是找到治愈方法，同时也要优先其他任务。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_cure_r.en: Research teams are assembled based on experience in novel diseases and health care. Their goal is to find a cure while also prioritizing other tasks.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_genero.zh: 慷慨的资助会让进展加快，但可能会对我们的经济带去负面影响。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_genero.en: Generous funding will greatly enhance progress but may come with negative economic effects.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_low_tt.zh: 最低资助会显著缩短进展速度，但面对经济危机时可能是一种更保险的策略。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_low_tt.en: Minimal funding will slow progress considerably, but can be a prudent strategy in times of economic crisis.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_none_t.zh: 在我们有能力支付经费之前项目将陷入停滞。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_none_t.en: The project will be halted until such a time as we can afford it.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_sickne.zh: 投资医疗研究，维持严格的防疫措施应当能阻止疾病蔓延。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_sickne.en: Investing in clinical research while maintaining a strict quarantine should limit the spread of the disease.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_sickne.zh: 不投入足够的医疗资源，疫情会以很快的速度发展。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_sickne.en: Without the resources to provide adequate care, the disease will progress much faster.

approach_situation_paragon_skrand_sickne.zh: 我们会按应对潜在致命疫情的标准进行操作。
approach_situation_paragon_skrand_sickne.en: We will follow standard protocols for a potentially deadly outbreak.

approach_situation_speed_tooltip.zh: 这一应对方案将会极大地加速我们的研究。
approach_situation_speed_tooltip.en: This Approach will greatly accelerate our research.

approach_situation_study_crystal_sphere_.zh: 星界丝缕似乎可以对这个装置进行刺激。我们刺激得越多，它激活得就越快。
approach_situation_study_crystal_sphere_.en: Astral thread seems to stimulate the device. The more we expose it to, the faster its activation.

approach_situation_study_crystal_sphere_.zh: 如果我们能够投入足够的科学研究来开发这个设备的潜力，我们相信可以加速其激活。
approach_situation_study_crystal_sphere_.en: If we were to dedicate enough scientific research to unlocking the potential of this device, we believe we can accelerate its activation.

approach_situation_study_crystal_sphere_.zh: 这个设备似乎正在慢慢调整自己。我们相信，随着时间的推移，它将完成它被设计去执行的任务。
approach_situation_study_crystal_sphere_.en: The device seems to be slowly aligning itself. We believe that, over time, it will accomplish what it was designed to do.

approach_situation_the_seal_do_nothing_t.zh: 我们目前不会采取任何特殊行动。
approach_situation_the_seal_do_nothing_t.en: We will take no special actions here.

approach_situation_the_seal_pump_exotic_.zh: 位于$NAME_Formless_System$恒星系的所有友方舰船获得+10%能量武器伤害。
approach_situation_the_seal_pump_exotic_.en: +10% Energy Weapon Damage for all friendly ships in the $NAME_Formless_System$ system.

approach_situation_the_seal_weave_astral.zh: 位于$NAME_Formless_System$恒星系的所有友方舰船获得+50%护盾值。
approach_situation_the_seal_weave_astral.en: +50% Shield Hit Points on all friendly ships in the $NAME_Formless_System$ system.

approach_stabilize_the_star4_effect.zh: 我们可以使恒星稳定保持现状，维持现有适应状态。$rg_no_progress$
approach_stabilize_the_star4_effect.en: We can stabilize the star in its current state, maintaining our current adaptations.$rg_no_progress$

approach_study_the_contaminant_effect.zh: 不要浪费这次有价值的机遇，在回到[Owner.GetParadeStudy]之前再研究一下这些污染物。
approach_study_the_contaminant_effect.en: Do not waste this valuable opportunity, let's study the contaminant before returning to the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

approach_suppress_unrest2_effect.zh: 社会动荡中之际，问题难以有效解决，优先恢复秩序与稳定。$rg_default_progress$
approach_suppress_unrest2_effect.en: Effective resolution is impossible amidst societal unrest. Priority must be given to restoring order and stability.$rg_default_progress$

approach_toxic_knights_frugal_tt.zh: 为了应对极端紧急的情况，我们可能需要扣除一部分交付给教团的份额。然而，由于缺乏足够的手段将自己妥善武装，我们的骑士在面对誓言试炼的时候会需要几经挣扎。
approach_toxic_knights_frugal_tt.en: In case of extreme emergency, we may requisition part of the Order's share of resources. But without the means to equip themselves properly, our knights will surely struggle on their Quest.

approach_toxic_knights_generous_tt.zh: 提高我们交给教团的份额，能够帮助我们的骑士更好的完成誓言试炼。
approach_toxic_knights_generous_tt.en: Increasing the share of what we give to the Order can only help our knights as they seek to accomplish the Quest.

approach_toxic_knights_regular_tt.zh: 根据历史，这个政权一直都会交出其收入的五分之一作为教团的财富和武器，以帮助其追求誓言试炼。
approach_toxic_knights_regular_tt.en: Historically, the state has always given a fifth of its income in money and weapons to the Order and the pursuit of the Quest.

approach_toxify_world_georadiation_tt.en: Irradiate the world, gaining £minerals£ $minerals$, £alloys£ $alloys$, £energy£ $energy$ or £food£ $food$ every 6 months.

approach_toxify_world_killswitch_tt.zh: 激活地质辐射的急停开关，终止该过程。
approach_toxify_world_killswitch_tt.en: Activates the Georadiation kill switch and stops the process.

approach_transformation_errorcorrecting_.zh:
局势速度：-20%
月度凝聚力：无影响

approach_voidworm_plague_do_nothing_tt.zh: 我们目前不会采取任何特殊行动。
approach_voidworm_plague_do_nothing_tt.en: We will take no special actions here.

approach_voidworm_plague_purge_infected_.zh:
被$NAME_Voidworms$轰炸过的殖民地不会产生新的$NAME_Voidworms$。
局势$SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$：+0.7
approach_voidworm_plague_purge_infected_.en:
$NAME_Voidworms$ bombarding your colonies will no longer spawn new $NAME_Voidworms$.
Situation $SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$: +0.7

approach_voidworm_plague_search_for_cure.zh:
如果我们能打破它们的生物循环，$NAME_Voidworms$就无法在这个星系中继续繁殖了。
局势$SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$：+1.0
approach_voidworm_plague_search_for_cure.en:
If we can break their biological cycle, the $NAME_Voidworms$ will no longer be able to reproduce in this galaxy.
Situation $SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$: +1.0

approach_voidworm_plague_support_fleets_.zh:
为了对抗虚空虫的威胁，我们可以牺牲一小部分生活品质来支援我们的军事舰队。
局势$SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$：+0.5
approach_voidworm_plague_support_fleets_.en:
We can sacrifice a small amount of quality of life in support of our military fleets against the Voidworm menace.
Situation $SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$: +0.5

approach_wait_and_see3_effect.zh: 我们不能再草率下决定了，耐心观察才是上策。$rg_small_negative_progress$
approach_wait_and_see3_effect.en: We must stop making rash decisions. Instead, we should be patient, and observe.$rg_small_negative_progress$

approach_watch_nwo_tooltip.zh: 观测这个发展过程应该能提供一些有趣的线索。
approach_watch_nwo_tooltip.en: Watching this unfold should provide some interesting insights.

approach_watch_singularity_tooltip.zh: 观测这个发展过程应该能提供一些有趣的线索。
approach_watch_singularity_tooltip.en: Watching this unfold should provide some interesting insights.

approach_watch_tooltip.zh: 观察这样的局势应该能为我们提供一些有趣的见解。一旦选定，我们将无法改变针对该局势的应对方案。
approach_watch_tooltip.en: Observing this situation should provide some interesting insights. Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.

aquatic.1.A.zh: 这将是一个独一无二的家园。
aquatic.1.A.en: It shall be a home like no other.

aquatic_events.250.desc.zh:
基于我们与许多外星物种构建通讯的成功经历，我们的一位[This.Owner.GetLinguists]提出了一项激进的举措。虽然过去所有与天龙沟通的努力均不幸失败，[needed_name.GetSheHe]坚称[needed_name.GetSXX]现在是进一步尝试的好机会。

根据我们最古老的历史，[This.Owner.Species.GetName]曾一度与龙建立了传说中的契约，正是由它结束的正面冲突。据此，某种程度的互相理解应该是可以达成的。[needed_name.GetSheHe]指出[needed_name.GetSXX]我们过去与外星生命体之间通讯的成功让我们比起过去任何时候都更有能力理解这条巨龙。
aquatic_events.250.desc.en:
Following our successes in establishing communications with a number of alien species, one of our leading [This.Owner.GetLinguists] has brought forth a radical proposal. Though past efforts to communicate with the Sky Dragon have failed miserably, [needed_name.GetSheHe] argue[needed_name.GetSXX] that now is the time to make another attempt.

According to our earliest histories, there was a fabled Accord between [This.Owner.Species.GetName] and Dragon, after which direct conflict ceased. Citing this as proof that understanding on some level is possible, [needed_name.GetSheHe] note[needed_name.GetSXX] that our recent experiences with utterly alien lifeforms make us better equipped than ever before to understand the drake.

aquatic_events.250.desc.hive.zh:
在成功与数个外星物种成功建立通讯之后，我们的语言思维处理体得出结论，现在正是我们再次同天龙建立对话的时候。尽管最近的努力均不幸失败，我们依旧模糊地回忆起了过去的片段，彼时我们在古老的冲突之后，同这条龙缔结了和平。

现在我们在同形体完全不同的外星生命体打交道上有了更加丰富的经验，我们相较于过去任何时候，都在理解龙这一方面准备的更加充分。
aquatic_events.250.desc.hive.en:
Having established communications with a number of alien species, our linguistic thought processes have concluded that it is time for us to again attempt to converse with the Sky Dragon. Though recent efforts have failed miserably, we dimly recall a past understanding when we made peace with the dragon, following our ancient struggle.

Now that we have more experience in dealing with utterly alien lifeforms, we are better equipped than ever before to understand the drake.

aquatic_events.250.desc.machine.zh:
在成功与数个外星物种成功建立通讯之后，我们的语言子例程得出了一个全新的共识：现在正是我们再次同天龙建立对话的时候。尽管最近所有有意义的尝试手段均以失败告终，我们的造物主留下的记录显示，达成某种程度的理解是可能的。毕竟，彼时他们应该发生了战斗，然后同龙缔结了和平，尽管是什么愿意我们不得而知。

现在我们在同形体完全不同的外星生命体打交道上有了更加丰富的经验，我们相较于过去任何时候，都在理解龙这一方面准备的更加充分。
aquatic_events.250.desc.machine.en:
Having established communications with a number of alien species, our linguistic subroutines have reached a new consensus: it is again time to attempt to converse with the Sky Dragon. Though past efforts have failed by all meaningful criteria, the records of our creators suggest that understanding on some level is possible. After all, they supposedly fought and then made peace with the dragon, for hitherto unknown reasons.

Equipped with experience in dealing with utterly alien lifeforms, we are now better prepared than ever before to seek to understand the drake.

aquatics.1.desc.zh: 我们来自大洋深处，我们的物种完美地适应了深海环境下的生活。即使已经迈入星空，我们仍然没有忘记本源：水体是，也永远是我们的家园。如今，我们的飞升已经完成了——我们不再需要适应其他环境，而是改造其他的星球使其适应我们的需求。当新一天的黎明到来时，我们清楚再也没有什么东西可以让我们与海洋分离了。
aquatics.1.desc.en: We came from the ocean, our species ideally suited to living in the depths of the seas. Even as we take to the stars, we have not abandoned our roots: the water is and shall always be our home. Now, our ascension is complete - no longer shall we adapt ourselves to living elsewhere rather than shaping worlds to suit our needs. As we greet the warmth of a new day, we know that nothing needs to take us from the ocean ever again.

aquatics.105.A.zh: 让我们看看它的遗骸还藏了什么秘密。
aquatics.105.A.en: Let's see what secrets its remains may yield.

aquatics.105.A.tooltip.zh: 解锁用于星神兽转基因的$trait_drake_scaled$特质。
aquatics.105.A.tooltip.en: Unlocks the $trait_drake_scaled$ trait for Leviathan Transgenesis.

aquatics.105.desc.origin_hive.zh:
$aquatics.105.desc.origin_start$

尽管我们的集体意识仔细斟酌过这一举措，但我们仍对此抱有复杂的感受。一方面，我们感到很满意，因为我们征服了死亡的威胁。另一方面，这条长久以来存在的巨龙我们已经……相当熟悉了。虽然我们不像其他太空文明一样，花费很多时间痴迷于那些“超自然”的失去，但在某种程度上，我们仍然会认为这样的行为好似亲手杀死了自己的神明。现在我们可以期待一个我们无所不能的未来，无论多么难以克服的困难都无法阻碍我们。
aquatics.105.desc.origin_hive.en:
$aquatics.105.desc.origin_start$

As our collective consciousness considers the deed, we embrace mixed feelings. On the one hand, there is satisfaction: a grave threat has been conquered. On the other, the previously ever-present dragon had become... familiar. Though we have little time for the "supernatural" obsessions of other spacefaring civilizations, in a way, we might consider this act as akin to killing our god. We may now look forward to a future where we are capable of anything, where no obstacle no matter how seemingly insurmountable may constrain us.

aquatics.105.desc.origin_machine.zh:
$aquatics.105.desc.origin_start$

尽管我们的处理器进行了重新校准以评估这件壮举的后果，我们却惊讶地发现，我们需要投入相当数量的重构才能实现。曾经存在的龙对我们的编程有相当大的影响，有数十亿个纠错保障来抵消其行动的不可预测性，这将花费一些时间来清理。另一方面，随着这种强大的威胁被清除，我们现在可以期待一个未来，无论多么难以克服的困难，都无法阻碍我们。
aquatics.105.desc.origin_machine.en:
$aquatics.105.desc.origin_start$

As our processors recalibrate themselves to account for the consequences of the deed, we find that we have a surprising amount of refactoring to do. The previously ever-present dragon has had a considerable impact on our programming, with billions of fail-safes to counter the unpredictability of its actions, one which will take some time to untangle. On the other hand, with this formidable threat lifted from us, we may now look forward to a future where we are capable of anything, where no obstacle no matter how seemingly insurmountable may constrain us.

aquatics.105.desc.origin_materialist.zh:
$aquatics.105.desc.origin_start$

$aquatics.105.desc.origin_normal_middle$尽管我们很久以前就放弃了崇拜伪神，但这次行动在象征上更像是彻底地将其放逐。[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以期待一个未来，一个凭借能力可以企及任何目标，而无惧超自然力量的未来。
aquatics.105.desc.origin_materialist.en:
$aquatics.105.desc.origin_start$

$aquatics.105.desc.origin_normal_middle$ Though we cast off our false gods long ago, this act is in some way akin to banishing them all over again. [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may now look forward to a future where they are capable of anything, where no fear of the supernatural may hold them back from that which they wish to achieve.

aquatics.105.desc.origin_normal.zh:
$aquatics.105.desc.origin_start$

$aquatics.105.desc.origin_normal_middle$从某种意义上说，杀死它就像杀死某个人的神。

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以期待一个未来，一个凭借能力可以企及任何目标，而无惧超自然力量的未来。
aquatics.105.desc.origin_normal.en:
$aquatics.105.desc.origin_start$

$aquatics.105.desc.origin_normal_middle$ In a way, killing it is akin to killing one's gods.

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may now look forward to a future where they are capable of anything, where no fear of the supernatural may hold them back from that which they wish to achieve.

aquatics.105.desc.others.zh:
我们成功击杀[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的守护龙！虽然那是一场艰苦的战斗，但它证明了我们舰队很强大。现在[dragon_planet.GetName]的居民将不得不同样地面对敌人，过去那条认为没有人能过越过的巨龙、那种他们可以安全地躲在龙背后的事情已经不复存在。

似乎龙的遗骸在我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]看来是名副其实的宝库，他们相信他们可以发现合成生产龙鳞的方法。
aquatics.105.desc.others.en:
We have slain the Dragon Protector of the [dragon_system.GetName] system! Though it put up a tough fight, it proved no match for our mighty fleets. Now the denizens of [dragon_planet.GetName] will have to face their foes as equals, no longer safe in the knowledge that none can get past the dragon.

It appears that the body it left behind is a veritable treasure trove for our [This.GetScientistPlural], who believe they can find out a way to synthetically produce the dragon's scales.

aquatics.110.desc.zh: [From.GetName]击杀了天龙！这一可怕的事实导致[dragon_planet.GetName]现在很容易被攻击。
aquatics.110.desc.en: The [From.GetName] has vanquished the Sky Dragon! As a result of this terrible deed, [dragon_planet.GetName] is now vulnerable to attack.

aquatics.115.desc.hive.zh: 控制天龙是我们长久以来的计划。为了兑现这一目标，我们的工蜂进行了特异性演化。虽然感染的途径仍需要适应，但我们已成为了天龙，天龙亦成为了我们。蜂巢整合了它的知识和经验，我们已经为面对其同族做了充足准备。
aquatics.115.desc.hive.en: Controlling the Sky Dragon was always in our plans. Our drones were especially evolved to claim this prize. While the infestation process required some adaptation, we are now the Sky Dragon, and it is us. With its knowledge and experience integrated into the hive, we stand well prepared to meet any of its kin.

aquatics.115.desc.machine.zh: 被称为天龙的生物已经由死灵机师协议进行优化。其冰冷的吐息已经低至1开尔文。复活的天龙现已受我方控制。
aquatics.115.desc.machine.en: The creature designated Sky Dragon has been overhauled according to Mechromancy protocols. Its freezing exhalations now approach 1 degree Kelvin. The reanimated dragon is now under our control.

aquatics.115.desc.regular.zh: 言出必行，我们的死灵法师已将[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的天龙复活了！虽然结果有些不太相同——正如某些人预料中的将某物由死变活会发生的那样——现在它急切地等待我们的指令。
aquatics.115.desc.regular.en: True to their word, our necromancers have returned the Sky Dragon of the [dragon_system.GetName] system to life! Though a little rough around the edges - as one would expect from a being just brought back from the dead - it now eagerly awaits our commands.

aquatics.120.A.zh: 我们很荣幸接受你的请求。

aquatics.120.A.response.zh: 太好了！我就知道你会同意的。你肯定不会后悔的！
aquatics.120.A.response.en: Excellent! I knew you'd say yes. You will not regret this!

aquatics.120.A.tooltip.zh: 我们可以在恒星基地中建造龙孵化场，以此最多可以招募10条$space_dragon_origin_baby_plural$。
aquatics.120.A.tooltip.en: We will be able to build Dragon Hatcheries at starbases, from which we will be able to recruit up to 10 $space_dragon_origin_baby_plural$.

aquatics.120.B.zh: 我们感谢你的提议，但我们必须拒绝。
aquatics.120.B.en: We thank you for this offer, but we must turn it down.

aquatics.120.B.response.zh: 哎。也许你们并没有像我想象中的那样学到那么多。那么，永别了！
aquatics.120.B.response.en: Sigh. Perhaps you have not learnt as much as I had thought. Farewell!

aquatics.120.B.tooltip.zh: 天龙将会离去，不会再回来了。
aquatics.120.B.tooltip.en: The Sky Dragon will depart, never to return.

aquatics.120.desc.zh: 时光飞逝，我亦疑虑。你们一开始是小生物的时候，我就一直在看着你们：你频繁受挫时我也经常感到绝望，而你屡次成功时我也高兴地咆哮。现在，我发现你已经长大了，你的文明已经成熟，并准备好被委托亲子关系的终极责任了。现在是时候让你们再次奉献自己，来帮我抚养我的孩子们了。
aquatics.120.desc.en: Time passes, and with it my doubts. From small beginnings have I watched you: often despairing at your frequent impetuity, and yet always roaring in delight at your successes. Now, I find that you have grown, that your civilization has matured, and is ready to be entrusted with the ultimate responsibility: parenthood. It is time for you to rededicate yourselves to rearing my children.

aquatics.120.dialog.1.response.zh: 为了完全坦白，这一天我已经等了很久了。甚至比你想象的还要长。当我从家里出发时，我也不过是个孩子。我旅行了很远，很广阔的范围，才找到一个星球，一个能产生在未来某一天帮我抚养孩子的文明的星球。然后我就一直在等待……
aquatics.120.dialog.1.response.en: To be perfectly candid, I have long awaited this day. Longer than you can possibly imagine. When I set out from home, I was little more than a whelp. I journeyed far and wide before I came across a planet with the potential to produce a foster civilization that would one day be ready to raise my children. And so, I waited...

aquatics.120.dialog.2.zh: 这就是你一直以来的计划吗？
aquatics.120.dialog.2.en: So this was your plan all along?

aquatics.120.dialog.2.response.zh: 是的。这就是我们的传统。在被我们视作家乡的星系，有很多我的同类，每条龙都在寻找新生的文明来抚养他们的孩子。但据我所知，我是第一个走到这一步的。
aquatics.120.dialog.2.response.en: Yes. It is our way. In our home galaxy, there are many of my kind, each seeking out a nascent civilization to raise their young. But I am the first - to my knowledge - to have come so far.

aquatics.120.dialog.3.zh: 那我们又能得到什么回报呢？
aquatics.120.dialog.3.en: What do we get in return?

aquatics.120.dialog.3.response.zh: 嗯，一方面，完全成长的守护龙是一个强大的力量！如果你同意，我将保证我和我的后代效忠你的事业，在战斗中援助你。
aquatics.120.dialog.3.response.en: Well, for one thing, a fully grown Guardian Dragon is a formidable foe! If you agree, I will pledge myself and my offspring to your cause, and we will aid you in battle.

aquatics.120.dialog.4.response.zh: 那么你就自己决定未来吧，而我会离开。我已经等了很久了，我再等等也不为过。
aquatics.120.dialog.4.response.en: Then you will have made your choice, and I will leave. I have waited a long time; I can wait longer.

aquatics.150.A.zh: 下次它接近时，像它周围打一炮警示它。
aquatics.150.A.en: Fire a warning shot next time it comes close.

aquatics.150.B.zh: 在一片僻静的宇域为它腾点空间。
aquatics.150.B.en: Set aside some space for it in a secluded area.

aquatics.150.B.tooltip.zh: 龙在星球着陆后可能会食用大量的食物！
aquatics.150.B.tooltip.en: The dragon is likely to consume a lot of food once it lands on the planet!

aquatics.150.desc.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]观察了天龙，报告称它的内脏似乎发出了巨大的吱吱声。在过去的几个月里，它也异常频繁地在[Root.GetName]周围盘旋，有时会突然掠过大气层的上界，然后再次离开。我们的假设是该生物饿了，希望着陆觅食，就像它过去定期做的那样。不清楚它为什么会犹豫——既然我们已经加入了群星大家庭，也许它想看看我们将如何反应。
aquatics.150.desc.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] observing the Sky Dragon have reported loud creaking noises seemingly coming from its internal organs. It has also been circling around [Root.GetName] unusually often over the last few months, sometimes swooping right past the upper reaches of the atmosphere before pulling away again. Our working hypothesis is that the creature is hungry and wishes to land to feed, as it has periodically done in the past. It is not clear why it hesitates - perhaps it wishes to see how we react, now that we have joined it among the stars.

aquatics.155.desc.gestalt.zh: 龙并没有给我们表现出的敌意好脸色。随着一声巨响——其力量足以在半个星球上引发次级地震——巨龙以其冰冷的火焰袭击了[Root.GetName]，摧毁了重要生产设施，并击杀了大量的子个体。
aquatics.155.desc.gestalt.en: The dragon did not appreciate our show of hostility. With a loud bellow - the force of which was strong enough to cause minor earthquakes across half the planet - the dragon smote [Root.GetName] with icy flames, destroying vital production facilities and killing a large number of drones.

aquatics.155.desc.normal.zh: 龙并没有给我们表现出的敌意好脸色。随着一声巨响——其力量足以在半个星球的范围引发次级地震——巨龙以其冰冷的火焰袭击了[Root.GetName]上的一个人口聚集中心。
aquatics.155.desc.normal.en: The dragon did not appreciate our show of hostility. With a loud bellow - the force of which was strong enough to cause minor earthquakes across half the planet - the dragon smote a large center of population on [Root.GetName] with its icy flames.

aquatics.160.desc.zh:
龙似乎意识到了我们的意图，优雅地俯冲下来，在我们腾出的区域休息。我们留下的大量食物应该有所帮助，必须说——龙在那上面以惊人地贪婪躺平了。

我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在远处观察它。
aquatics.160.desc.en:
The dragon appeared to realize our intentions, and gracefully swooped down to rest in the area we had vacated. The large supply of food we left behind probably helped, it must be said - the dragon has laid into it with astounding voracity.

Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are observing it from a distance.

aquatics.165.desc.gestalt.zh:
在行星上来回几次之后，这条龙显然认为可以安全着陆。尽管它选择了一个僻静的区域，但仍有一些子个体被摧毁，还有更多子个体流离失所——鉴于其令人难以置信的体型和贪婪的胃口，这并不奇怪。

它现在已经安顿下来，并以惊人的速度摧毁当地的动植物群。当地居民正与之保持距离。
aquatics.165.desc.gestalt.en:
After several further passes of the planet, the dragon apparently decided it was safe to land. Although it picked a secluded area, a number of our drones were destroyed and even more displaced - unsurprising, given its incredible size and voracious appetite.

It has now settled in, and is decimating the local flora and fauna at an alarming rate. Our drones are keeping a precautionary distance.

aquatics.165.desc.normal.zh:
在行星上来回几次之后，这条龙显然认为可以安全着陆。尽管它选择了一个僻静的区域，但仍有一些[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被杀死，还有更多人流离失所——鉴于其令人难以置信的体型和贪婪的胃口，这并不奇怪。

它现在已经安顿下来，并以惊人的速度摧毁当地的动植物群。当地居民正与之保持距离。
aquatics.165.desc.normal.en:
After several further passes of the planet, the dragon apparently decided it was safe to land. Although it picked a secluded area, a number of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were killed and even more displaced - unsurprising, given its incredible size and voracious appetite.

It has now settled in, and is decimating the local flora and fauna at an alarming rate. The local population is keeping its distance.

aquatics.170.A.zh: 我们应该研究这些残留物。

aquatics.170.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的丰收中饱食数年之后，现在明显更壮的天龙再次起飞。随着最后致敬的吼声，它升空了——留下了大量的鳞片、脱落的皮肤和其他因它的存在而产生的副产物。
aquatics.170.desc.en: After several years of gorging itself on the bountiful harvests of [Root.GetName], the now considerably girthier Sky Dragon has once again taken flight. With a final roar in salute, it lifted off - leaving behind a large collection of scales, shed skin, and other byproducts of its presence.

aquatics.170.tooltip.zh: 这条龙现在再一次回到[here_be_dragons_planet.System.GetName]恒星系中遨游了。
aquatics.170.tooltip.en: The dragon now once again roams the [here_be_dragons_planet.System.GetName] system.

aquatics.180.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]恒星系中的舰队报告说，在恒星系内遨游的那条龙正在攻击我们的舰船！目前还不清楚它是故意加入[From.Owner.GetAdj]防御战争，还是只是因为我们侵犯了它的领土而对我们感到愤怒。可以肯定的是，如果我们打算夺取[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]，就必须击败它！
aquatics.180.desc.en: Our fleets in the [From.GetName] system report that the dragon roaming the system is attacking our ships! It is unclear whether it is deliberately joining the [From.Owner.GetAdj] defense, or if it is simply angry at us for encroaching on its territory. What is certain is that we will have to get through it if we intend to take [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]!

aquatics.185.B.zh: 挺好，要处理的威胁少了一个。
aquatics.185.B.en: Good, one fewer threat to deal with.

aquatics.185.desc.zh: 天龙似乎不愿坐视[From.GetAdj]入侵[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]的行动。它呼啸而起，喷吐出冰焰毁灭了敌人的舰队！
aquatics.185.desc.en: The Sky Dragon seems to have taken a dim view of [From.GetAdj] efforts to invade [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]. It soars to our defense, breathing icy destruction upon their fleets!

aquatics.185.desc.landed.zh: 天龙似乎不愿坐视[From.GetAdj]入侵[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]的行动。它停止了在行星上进餐，腾飞而起喷吐出冰焰毁灭了敌人的舰队！
aquatics.185.desc.landed.en: The Sky Dragon seems to have taken a dim view of [From.GetAdj] efforts to invade [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]. Ceasing its repast on the planet, it has taken flight to breathe icy destruction upon their fleets!

aquatics.190.B.zh: 试试不那么深入的其他方法吧。

aquatics.190.desc.zh:
既然我们已经在理解异种生物学和异星材料方面取得了一些进展，我们的研究人员提议派出科研船对龙进行更进一步的观察。他们对龙鳞格外感兴趣，这些龙鳞十分耐用——甚至无法穿透。虽然我们已经获得了大量自然脱落的样本，我们的科学家对龙鳞如何形成仍然感到困惑。若是使用所谓的“轻微深入”探针，科学家们相信他们可以进入其保护层的下方，直接研究龙鳞的自然过程。

当然，龙不会介意的……当然如此。
aquatics.190.desc.en:
Now that we have made some progress understanding xenobiology and exotic materials, our researchers have proposed that we send a science ship to take a closer look at the dragon. They are particularly interested in its scales, which are remarkably durable - even impenetrable. While we have acquired numerous naturally-shed samples, our scientists remain baffled as to how the scales form. Using what they describe as a "mildly intrusive" probe, they believe they can get under the dragon's protective layer and directly study its natural processes.

Surely the dragon will not mind... Surely.

aquatics.190.desc.gestalt.zh:
既然我们已经在理解异种生物学和异星材料方面取得了一些进展，我们可以考虑派出科研船对龙进行更进一步的观察。龙鳞格外引人留意，它们十分耐用——甚至无法穿透。虽然已经获得了大量自然脱落的样本，我们的科学子个体对龙鳞如何形成仍然感到困惑。若是能部署足够深入的探针，我们也许可以进入其保护层的下方，直接研究龙鳞的自然过程。

当然，龙是不会介意的……当然如此。
aquatics.190.desc.gestalt.en:
Now that we have made some progress understanding xenobiology and exotic materials, we may consider sending a science ship to take a closer look at the dragon. Of particular interest to us are its scales, which are remarkably durable - even impenetrable. While we have acquired numerous naturally-shed samples, our science drones remain baffled as to how the scales form. By deploying a sufficiently intrusive probe, we may be able to get inside the dragon's protective layer and directly study its natural processes.

Surely the dragon will not mind... Surely.

aquatics.195.desc.zh:
尽管这条龙专注地看着我们的科研船，但当我们多次对其进行深度扫描时，它没有作出任何反应——以目前的技术水平，这是我们能够做到的最彻底的扫描。这些扫描使我们对龙的生物过程有了新的洞见，可是其鳞片之下的秘密仍然像以前一样难以捉摸。

虽然我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]被迫就这件事承认失败，但他们向我们保证，他们仍能把获得的知识好好加以利用。
aquatics.195.desc.en:
Though the dragon watched our science vessel attentively, it did not react as we subjected it to several deep scans - the most thorough we are capable of at our current level of technology. They provided us with fresh insights into its biological processes, though the secret behind its scaly hide remains as elusive as ever.

Although our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are forced to admit defeat on that matter, they assure us that they will nonetheless be able to put the knowledge they have acquired to good use.

aquatics.200.A.zh: 最好不要进一步激怒它。

aquatics.200.B.zh: 喂了它以后现在它应该不饿了。我们再试一次。
aquatics.200.B.en: Its hunger should be sated now. Let's try again.

aquatics.200.desc.zh: 龙似乎饿了。又也许它今天就是心情不好。在我们的舰船接近它的时候，这条龙呲牙低吼，嚼着牙骤然间猛冲向前，不留做出规避动作的时间。我们的科研船现在没剩多少残骸了——至少在龙的肚子之外没剩多少。
aquatics.200.desc.en: It appears the dragon was hungry. Or maybe it was just having a bad day. As our vessel approached it, the dragon snarled and abruptly lunged forward in a chomping motion, leaving no time for evasive maneuvers. Little now remains of our science vessel - outside of the dragon's belly, at least.

aquatics.205.B.zh: 有意思。我们应该看看再试一次会发生什么。
aquatics.205.B.en: Fascinating. We should see what happens if we try again.

aquatics.205.desc.zh: 龙放任我们的科研船靠近，但随着探针发射，它用尾巴以不可思议的力量猛击舰船。值得注意的是，虽然舰船因此越过了半个恒星系，它几乎完好无损，舰上也没有报告人员伤亡。不管怎么说，龙明显不太高兴。
aquatics.205.desc.en: The dragon tolerated our science ship's approach, but as the probe was launched, it used its tail to swat our vessel out of the way with incredible force. Remarkably, although the ship was vaulted halfway across the solar system, it was almost entirely undamaged, and no casualties were reported onboard. Nonetheless, the dragon's displeasure was clear.

aquatics.210.A.en: Let's back off for a while.

aquatics.210.desc.gestalt.zh: 正当我们的舰队第二次接近龙的时候，它勃然而动，鼻腔中喷射出寒光，如飞梭一般直奔[dragon_colony.GetName]！防御系统还来不及启动，它就暴怒地向这颗行星的北半球倾泻出它的寒冰之息，顷刻间摧毁了无数关键生产设施。
aquatics.210.desc.gestalt.en: As our vessel approached the dragon for the second time, it sprang into action. Nostrils flaring, it darted away, heading directly towards [dragon_colony.GetName]! Before our defense systems could react, it furiously unleashed its icy breath upon the northern hemisphere of the planet, causing considerable damage to vital production facilities.

aquatics.210.desc.normal.zh: 正当我们的舰船第二次接近龙的时候，它勃然而动，鼻腔中喷射出寒光，如飞梭一般直奔[dragon_colony.GetName]！防御系统还来不及启动，它就暴怒地向这颗行星的北半球倾泻出它的寒冰之息，顷刻间摧毁了多个大型人口中心。
aquatics.210.desc.normal.en: As our vessel approached the dragon for the second time, the dragon sprang into action. Nostrils flaring, it darted away, heading directly towards [dragon_colony.GetName]! Before our defense systems could react, it furiously unleashed its icy breath upon the northern hemisphere of the planet, causing considerable damage to several large population centers.

aquatics.215.desc.zh:
我们的探针牢牢抓住龙，发现了它鳞片间的一个狭小缝隙并灵巧地钻了进去时，龙愤怒地低吼着。在[Root.GetName]准备强制超光速以回避被激怒的龙的时候，探针已经开始收录令人称奇的数据了。从这些数据中我们发现，其鳞片之所以如此强韧，是由于它在高速进入[dragon_colony.GetName]大气层的过程中，激活的一系列复杂的酶促反应造成的。

虽然还有许多未解之谜，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]算是弄清了一件事：由于龙体生理学的复杂性，如果我们想要获得这种鳞片的材料，唯一的办法是屠龙。尽管如此，他们还是保证已经获得的知识无论如何也是有用的。
aquatics.215.desc.en:
The dragon snarled in fury as our probe latched onto it and swiftly located and burrowed into a minute gap between its scales. While the [Root.GetName] was forced to engage emergency FTL to avoid the displeased dragon, the probe was able to pick up intriguing readings. From what we can tell, the durability of the dragon's scales is the result of a complex cocktail of enzymes that trigger a unique chemical reaction when the creature enters the atmosphere of [dragon_colony.GetName] at high speeds.

Though much is left to uncover, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are clear about one thing: due to the complexity of the dragon's biology, if we wish to gain access to the material from which its scales are made, we will have to kill it first. Nonetheless, they assure us that the knowledge they have gained will be useful, either way.

aquatics.255.desc.zh: 在我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]和[This.Owner.GetLinguists]排查了所有同龙进行交互的已知记录之后，他们准备进行数项实验以测试它的反应。他们保证所有的动作都是经过了仔细的论证，一旦龙表现出哪怕是最轻微的不满，所有活动都会立刻中止。
aquatics.255.desc.en: As our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] and [This.Owner.GetLinguists] trawl through the records of known interactions with the dragon, they have prepared a few experiments to test its responses. They assure us that every move is planned with due diligence, and that they will cease their activities at the slightest sign of displeasure from the dragon.

aquatics.260.desc.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]还在为龙的发声这一科研难题在艰苦奋战。尽管他们心里抱着希望，期冀马上就能突破，然而在我们和这样一只体型庞大的太空飞龙之间寻找能够作为参考的共同框架，可能本身就存在着极大的困难，这使得这样的障碍更加不可逾越。

这可能会造成沮丧的气氛，尽管这并不是源于龙的行为本身：它对于我们的科研船闯入它的领域展现出了惊人的耐心。根据它喉咙活动产生的韵律，它正不断地产生同一组声门震动——吼叫或者哭喊，显然不是对着真空的宇宙——就好像它知道我们正在做什么，还希望能够帮忙。
aquatics.260.desc.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] remain stumped by the dragon's utterances. Though they are hopeful that a breakthrough is just around the corner, the difficulties inherent in finding a common frame of reference between ourselves and an enormous spacefaring dragon remain seemingly insurmountable.

This would be cause for despair, were it not for the behavior of the dragon itself: it has been remarkably patient with our research ships intruding on its space. Based on the rhythmic movements of its throat, it has been repeating the same set of glottal vibrations - roars or cries, were it not for the vacuum of space - almost as if it knows what we are doing, and wishes to help.

aquatics.265.A.zh: 但是我们已经准备好了！

aquatics.265.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]报告了令人咋舌的突破。就在他们绝望地以为永远无法理解龙的时候，他们将它不断涨落的身体能量辐射转置成为了标准波形偏差图。结果表明它实际上在用简单的二进制代码“说话”，并且和我们平常使用的相差不大，只不过使用的波长不一样。它的吼叫，事实上，只是想要引起我们的注意，而不是试图进行交流。

$aquatics.265.desc.end$
aquatics.265.desc.gestalt.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] report an astounding breakthrough. Despairing at ever coming to understand the dragon, they transposed the spectral map of its fluctuating corporal energy emissions into a standard wave deviation graph. This revealed that it was in fact "speaking" in simple binary code, not dissimilar to that which we sometimes use, just on a different wavelength. Its roars were, in fact, only meant to draw our attention, rather than an attempt at communication.

$aquatics.265.desc.end$

aquatics.265.desc.normal.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]报告了令人咋舌的突破。就在他们绝望地以为永远无法理解龙的时候，他们将它不断涨落的身体能量辐射转置成为了声音波形。随后他们聆听了结果，他们简直不敢相信自己的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]。毫无疑问：龙在讲我们的语言，只不过使用的是不同的媒介。它的吼叫，事实上，只是想要引起我们的注意，而不是试图进行交流。

$aquatics.265.desc.end$
aquatics.265.desc.normal.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] report an astounding breakthrough. Despairing at ever being able to understand the dragon, they transposed the spectral map of its fluctuating corporal energy emissions to acoustic waveforms. As they listened to the results, they could not believe their [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. It was undeniable: the dragon was speaking our language, but in a different medium! Its roars were, in fact, only meant to draw our attention, rather than an attempt at communication.

$aquatics.265.desc.end$

aquatics.270.A.zh: 哎呀。我们得奋斗，不能躺了。
aquatics.270.A.en: Alas. We shall strive to be better.

aquatics.270.A.tooltip.zh: 在准备好的时候龙会来接近我们。
aquatics.270.A.tooltip.en: The Dragon will approach us when it is ready.

aquatics.270.desc.zh: 龙发表了一段冗长的谩骂，谈及了它在数个纪元积累的智慧，以及它观察我们对时间和使命的态度——甚至都懒得提我们对宇宙的基础那肤浅得可悲的理解。很明显它认为我们太年轻，太单纯，太鲁莽，在现阶段还配不上这个任务。
aquatics.270.desc.en: The dragon launches into a lengthy diatribe about the wisdom it has accumulated over the eons, and its observations regarding our attitude toward time and commitments - not to mention our still-pitiful knowledge of the fundamentals of the universe. Apparently it considers us young and reckless, and unworthy of this quest at present.

aquatics.280.desc.zh: 我们不太清楚哪里出了差错，但是我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]看上去引得龙颜大怒。一声威震天穹的怒吼之后，这头生物将致命的龙息倾泻在他们的舰船之上，杀死了[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]——同时给我们试图理解它的工作造成了重大的挫折。
aquatics.280.desc.en: We are not quite sure what went wrong, but our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] seem to have displeased the dragon. With a mighty roar, the creature unleashed its deadly breath upon their vessel, killing [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] - and setting us back considerably in our attempt to understand it.

aquatics.305.desc.zh:
[This.GetName]汇报在[From.GetName]星系目击了一条骇人的太空巨龙！

这个恒星系似乎是[From.Owner.GetName]的中心，其中一颗行星显示出拥有稠密人口的痕迹。

目前为止，这条龙还没对我们采取行动，也没有与这个恒星系中的另一群居民存在冲突的迹象。也许我们最好还是别管他们吧。
aquatics.305.desc.en:
The [This.GetName] reports sighting a terrifying space dragon in the [From.GetName] system!

The system also appears to be a center of the [From.Owner.GetName], with one of the planets in the system showing signs of particularly dense population.

So far, the dragon has not reacted to us, nor is there any sign of conflict between it and the other inhabitants of the system. Perhaps it would be best to leave it be.

aquatics.5.desc.1.zh:
$aquatics.5.desc.intro$

对这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造在理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的技术手段还不足以在有实际意义的时间框架内完成这一里程碑式的任务。
aquatics.5.desc.1.en:
$aquatics.5.desc.intro$

Terraforming this [From.GetPlanetMoon] would theoretically be possible, but we do not yet possess the means to accomplish this monumental task within a realistic timeframe.

aquatics.5.desc.2.zh:
$aquatics.5.desc.intro$

巨大的能耗令人望而却步，但我们确实已经掌握了相关的技术手段，可以逐步将这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]环境改造为可以再度支持生命的星球了。
aquatics.5.desc.2.en:
$aquatics.5.desc.intro$

The energy costs would be daunting, but we do have the means to gradually terraform this [From.GetPlanetMoon] into something that would support life once again.

aquatics.5.desc.a.zh: 一颗仍存有希望的星球……
aquatics.5.desc.a.en: A world for which some hope remains...

aquatics.5.name.zh: 发现冰封环境改造候选

arcsite.1000.a.zh: 我们应当将资源进一步投入到破冰技术上。
arcsite.1000.a.en: We should invest further in these ice-breaking techniques.

arcsite.1000.desc.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]在一座晶莹剔透的冻湖边扎营。由于光源充足，人们甚至可以看见冰面之下的幽魂之塔透出点点微光。它们自湖床向上延伸，仿佛坚实的卷须。

我们资历尚浅的探险队成员依然在如此刺骨、严苛的寒冷中不停地工作。尽管条件艰苦，我们的挖掘却进展的很顺利。我们已经发现了好几个气阀，都是为原始的水下舰艇而设计成的港口。然而，我们却没有在现场发现这些舰艇的踪影。不管这些高塔的住民是留下来还是逃走了，港口上都已经是空无一人。
arcsite.1000.desc.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] have set their camps around the edges of a glassy, frozen lake. Under sufficient light, one may catch glimpses of spectral towers underneath. They grasp upwards from the lake bed like steadfast tendrils.

Our less experienced crews are still adjusting to work in such biting, sterile cold. Despite this, our excavations have proceeded swiftly. We have exposed numerous airlocks, all designed for primitive submarine vessels. There is, as yet, no sign of the vessels themselves. Whether the tower's inhabitants stayed or fled, every one of its docks was left empty.

arcsite.1005.desc.zh:
随着我们进一步从各种各样的冰层定居点上移走大冰块，我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]在停泊塔处发现了一座原始的计算机终端。它那易碎的金属外壳看上去被……咬了个扎实。

这个终端在经过一些轻微的修理之后，顺利地启动了。定居点数据网络的大部仍然处于下线状态，但是我们可以从本地缓存中的股权证明、个人文件，还有一些看上去是任务日志的文件中推断出很多情报。
arcsite.1005.desc.en:
As we continue to remove large sections of ice from around the various icebound habitats, our [owner.GetScientistPlural] at the docking tower have discovered a primitive computer terminal. Its brittle metal casing appears to have been... chewed upon.

The terminal booted up correctly after some minor repairs. Large parts of the habitat's data network remain offline, but we can infer a great deal from local caches of stock manifests, personnel files, and what appears to be a stash of mission logs.

arcsite.1010.a.zh: 立刻派遣一支研究小队。

arcsite.1010.b.zh: 看看我们从这些剽悍的海洋住民身上能学到些什么。
arcsite.1010.b.en: See what we can learn about those hostile ocean-dwellers.

arcsite.1010.desc.zh:
我们对[from.planet.GetName]上古代定居点的知识愈发深刻，我们的忧虑也更加浓厚。我们之前发现的只是一处前哨殖民地的残垣——属于某个文明的遗迹，这个文明长久以来被世间遗忘，我们甚至都辨识不出他们的名字。

在这个星球，海洋占据着绝对主导的地位。各种不同团体的殖民者从母星被带到这个星球，应征成为水下先遣队成员。他们的目标：建立殖民地，开发这颗行星的自然资源。然而，他们的现实却是一场未加约束的生物学实验、剧烈的政治变动，以及凶猛的动植物带来的重大危险。

我们找到了一处导航浮标上面的传感器日志，看上去它记录了一组队员前往附近哨站的路线。我们相信这些人的舰艇仍然在原地，被困在冰层中，包含有许多有用的材料。
arcsite.1010.desc.en:
Our knowledge of the ancient settlement on [from.planet.GetName] deepens, but so too does our concern. What we have uncovered is the remains of a frontier colony - a remnant of a civilization so long forgotten, we cannot even discern their name.

When seas were a more dominant feature on this world, disparate groups of settlers were brought from their homeworld and conscripted into pioneer submarine crews. Their goal: to establish colonies and exploit the planet's natural resources. Their reality, however, was one of unchecked biological experiments, radical political change, and significant peril fending off hostile flora and fauna.

The sensor logs from a navigation buoy appear to have tracked one such crew en route to a nearby outpost. We believe their vessel may still be there, trapped in ice along with a cache of useful materials.

arcsite.1016.desc.zh:
这是一个被墨冰包围的洞穴，在里面我们发现了一艘瘫痪烧毁的古老潜艇残骸。这个烧焦的洞穴让残骸得以避开这颗星球上最为恶劣的冻融循环，将这群船员遭受灭顶之灾的惨状完好地保留了下来。

该潜艇落后的核引擎上有过紧急维修的迹象。在船员舱中，我们发现了划痕以及化学物质灼烧留下的微量残留。潜艇上所有的逃生仓当时都已派出，不过有一个被卡在了附近休眠的火山口中。

这艘残骸上可供收集的东西不多，但这群船员原先的目的地——一座殖民地补给仓库依旧完好无损。我们的维修团队因此得以将这群注定失败的船员无法修复的部件成功修复。
arcsite.1016.desc.en:
Blackened ice surrounds the cave in which we found the crumpled, burnt wreckage of an ancient submarine. Sheltered from the worst of this planet's freeze-thaw cycles, this scorched cave has preserved evidence of multiple calamities befalling this crew.

The vessel's crude nuclear engine bears signs of hasty patchwork repairs; in the crew quarters we found scratch marks and faint residue from chemical burns. At some point all the submarine's escape shuttles were deployed, yet only one remains nearby - it became lodged inside a dormant lava vent.

There is little more to glean from this burnt-out wreckage, but the crew's erstwhile destination - a colonial supply cache - has remained intact. Our recovery team has therefore succeeded in retrieving what the doomed submariners could not.

arcsite.1017.auth.a.zh: ……让我们比不同政见者更进一步。
arcsite.1017.auth.a.en: ... Keeping us one step ahead of dissidents.

arcsite.1017.desc.zh:
我们在厚重的冰层中挖掘出了一条隧道，在一个密闭洞穴中找到了一艘潜艇的完整残骸。冻土带的环境将所有有机物都化为了齑粉，但是也让许多古迹完好保存下来。

我们的人类学研究表明，当船员们逃离附近的殖民地后，这艘潜艇便成了孕育了诸多政治活动的温床。它们在船舱内部各自划分了数个主权边界，并分别支持不同类型的政治主张。令人震惊的是，这种极端的派系划分不仅没有使船员分裂，反而加强了船员之间的社会联系。这个研究肯定会在我们的主攻政治学的科学家们引发激烈的讨论。
arcsite.1017.desc.en:
We have tunnelled through significant quantities of ice to find the intact wreckage of a submarine, sealed within an airtight cave. Tundral conditions have long since reduced all organic matter to fine dust, but so too have they preserved a wealth of cultural artifacts.

Our anthropological survey suggests a hotbed of political activity as this submarine's crew broke away from the nearby colony. They proclaimed several sovereign boundaries within the hull of their own submarine, espousing all manner of political ideologies. Surprisingly, this extreme factionalism appears to have strengthened the social bonds of this crew rather than forcing them apart. The matter is sure to spark lively debate amongst our own political scientists.

arcsite.1018.desc.zh:
我们本以为如此古老的遗骸在漫长的岁月中早已被破坏，谁知道由于当时的急速冻结，保护了遗骸的上半部分。随之一起保存下来的还有许多生物的尸体，其中一些貌似是当地的巨大又凶猛的捕食性动物。其他穿着防护服的智慧生物似乎是那些猎食者的猎物。

这些潜艇上的船员并不是[fromfrom.planet.GetName]本地人。我们的解剖表明，他们将当地生物的基因拼接融入到自己体内。至于这群殖民者为什么要这样广泛地进行自我改造，恐怕我们只能自己想象了。但不可否认的是，他们利用这种方式，确实让这些基因得以保存下来。
arcsite.1018.desc.en:
We had expected such an ancient wreck to have been crushed long ago. Instead we find that this stricken hulk was flash-frozen, preserving its superstructure along with the corpses of numerous creatures. Some of these appear to have been native fauna: large, ferocious and decidedly predatory in nature. The others appear to have been their prey: a small group of sapient beings wearing environment suits.

These individuals - the submarine's crew - did not originate on [fromfrom.planet.GetName]. Rather, our autopsy suggests that these aliens had gene-spliced themselves with material from local lifeforms. We can only imagine what drove the colonists to modify themselves so extensively, and yet we cannot deny: by preserving this genetic material within themselves, they have ensured the survival of a valuable genetic history.

arcsite.1020.a.zh: 这些警世通言也许会让我们的殖民者受益。
arcsite.1020.a.en: These cautionary tales may benefit our colonists.

arcsite.1020.a.memorialist.zh: 我们一定要珍惜他们的回忆。

arcsite.1020.b.zh: 地下居住地是个有趣的主意。
arcsite.1020.b.en: Sub-surface habitats are an interesting idea.

arcsite.1020.c.zh: 我们可以好好利用潜艇上的军备。
arcsite.1020.c.en: We could put that submarine's armaments to good use.

arcsite.1020.default.desc.zh:
$arcsite.1020.desc.intro$

尽管他们的文明尚未拥有超光速旅行技术，磨难艰险似乎引导这个一度位于潜艇内的殖民地在科学和经济上取得了独特的突破，我们如今可以随意利用这些发现。
arcsite.1020.default.desc.en:
$arcsite.1020.desc.intro$

Although their civilization did not yet possess faster-than-light technology, hardship seems to steered this once-submarine colony towards some singular breakthroughs in science and economics, which we are now at liberty to exploit.

arcsite.1020.tech.desc.zh:
$arcsite.1020.desc.intro$

尽管缺少超光速旅行的能力，这些古代潜艇居民们引导我们在其他领域取得了可观的突破。他们经历艰险取得了这些发现，我们会力求不再经历诸如此类的磨难。
arcsite.1020.tech.desc.en:
$arcsite.1020.desc.intro$

Although they lacked faster-than-light travel, these ancient submariners have steered us towards remarkable breakthroughs in other fields. They made these discoveries in hardship, the likes of which we can strive not to experience ourselves.

arcsite.2000.desc.zh:
我们对地表进行扫描后确定了一些有价值的矿藏，其中埋有不计其数的不同物种的遗骸。有些甚至与目前仍生活在这颗星球上的一些生物相仿，其他的则与我们所见过的生物截然不同。

尽管这项工作并不容易，周围的野生动物也被我们惊扰，但[leader.GetName]还是已经有了重要的发现，并成功地重建了一些已经灭绝的物种。但这也反过来引起了研究团队的一些争论。其中一些人想展出这些标本，而另一些则更愿意进一步研究这些材料，毕竟这些化石已经是保存状况最好的一批，而这个矿点也即将被挖空了。
arcsite.2000.desc.en:
We scanned the surface and found a few promising deposits, filled with the remains of a variety of different species. Some resemble those still living on the surface, while others are nothing like we have seen before.

Although the work is hard and the wildlife is agitated by our presence, [leader.GetName] has already made remarkable discoveries and managed to reconstruct some of the extinct species. This, in turn, sparked a dispute among the research team. While some want to display these species in exhibitions, others prefer to study the material, as they are the best-preserved fossils found to date, and this dig site is almost exhausted.

arcsite.2000.use.en: Make an exhibition out of them.

arcsite.2001.desc.zh: 我们已经开展了充分的研究，探明了化石物种和[from.planet.GetName]当前生物圈中各物种之间的关系。结果证明，它们中的一些属于同一属种，具有许多相似性。进一步的研究或许能够带给我们更多答案。
arcsite.2001.desc.en: We have done extensive research to determine the relationship of fossil species to the current biosphere on [from.planet.GetName]. It turns out that some of them belong to the same genus, having many similarities. Further studies might bring us more answers.

arcsite.2002.desc.zh: 不少人前来参观我们的展览。尽管我们不能将收集到的东西用于研究，但我们还是吸引到了几位慷慨的赞助商，将这些化石送去举办行星际巡回展览。展品的异星外观在那些对外星考古学有兴趣的人中间引起了小规模的热烈反响。
arcsite.2002.desc.en: Quite a few people came to our exhibition. Although we can't use the collected material for our research, we attracted some generous funders and sent the fossils on an interplanetary tour. The alien appearance of exhibits caused a small boom of people interested in xenoarchaeology.

arcsite.2010.desc.zh:
将第一个考古遗址彻底翻遍之后，我们决定转移到更加偏僻的地方，搜寻更多可供研究用的材料。[leader.GetName]找到了一个相当好的地点，此处是一个洞穴，被一些有智慧但已经灭绝的物种用作居所。在谨慎的探索和检查之后，我们发现了一些非同寻常的事情：不管住在这个洞穴里的是何方神圣，这种生物会使用一种精妙的染料，在光和热的作用下会显出颜色。

我们已经识别出两种彩绘：一种讲述过去的故事，另一种描绘了日常生活。不幸的是，由于我们的闯入，让彩绘得以保留下来的精妙生态系统遭到扰乱。这种扰乱产生的一系列连锁反应，加之染料本身经历的岁月，导致这些彩绘会在短时间内消失。小队必须立马决定抢救哪一种更有价值的彩绘。
arcsite.2010.desc.en:
Exhausting the first site, we decided to move to more remote places in search of more material for research. [leader.GetName] found a good enough spot, a cave that served as a home for some intelligent extinct species. Careful probing and examination revealed something unusual: whatever lived in this cave used an ingenious dye that reveals itself when exposed to heat and light.

We have identified two types of paintings: one telling the story of the past, and the other portraying daily life. Unfortunately, we disrupted the delicate ecosystem that preserved the drawings. The resulting chain reaction, combined with the age of the dye, causes it to fade and disappear on short notice. The team must decide which one is worth saving.

arcsite.2011.desc.zh: 我们获取的彩绘讲述了这个物种的过往，给予我们许多有关它们历史的新认识。看上去，这些穴居者同某个高级文明进行了接触，这在某种程度上影响了它们的外形和发展路线。根据这些生物的外形描述，我们猜测该物种能够快速地进行基因变异，几代之内其外表就会发生显著变化。
arcsite.2011.desc.en: We captured drawings related to the past and gained insight into the species' history. It appears that these cave dwellers came into contact with an advanced civilization that somewhat influenced their looks and development. Given the depictions of the creatures, we assume that the species was prone to rapid genetic mutations, and their generations varied greatly in appearance.

arcsite.2012.desc.zh: 我们获取的彩绘讲述了这个物种的日常生活，给予我们许多有关它们历史的新认识。彩绘将穴居者描绘成一群外形看上去迥乎不同，但智力水平相近的物种，正在参加复杂的仪式。[leader.GetName]假设，这是各种各样的生物沐浴在神明的圣光之下，为祂工作，以换取神赐的自由。
arcsite.2012.desc.en: We captured drawings related to daily life and gained insight into the history of the species. They depict cave dwellers as a conglomeration of different-looking but similarly intelligent species who participated in complex rituals. [leader.GetName] assumed that the various creatures basked in the light of the deity, worked for him, and in return were given freedom.

arcsite.2020.desc.zh:
我们进一步探索这个洞穴的裂缝深处，来到了一处人工岩室，里面有一个古怪的骨质结构。鉴于这个结构当前的状态，它看上去好像发生了坍塌，然后沉到了地里面——可能是一场地震导致的。[Leader.GetName]下令在原地扎营，我们也已在周边进行了一些探测，但地面并不是很稳定。一旦我们进入内部，我们可能不会有充足的时间对这个结构进行彻底的检查。

对我们的研究来说，最大的潜在成果就是这座建筑本身。我们可以研究这种精巧的类骨物质，或者将精力放在探索上，搜寻这个结构内部更多有关外星人的线索——了解是谁建造了它，怎么使用它，这些人的日常生活是怎样的。
arcsite.2020.desc.en:
Exploring further into the deep chasms of the cave, we came across a grotto with a strange bone structure inside. Given the current state of the structure, it looks like it collapsed and sank into the ground - probably as a result of an earthquake. [Leader.GetName] ordered a camp to be set up, and we have already done some perimeter scans, but the ground is not stable. We may not have adequate time to examine the structure fully once we get inside.

The greatest potential yield for our studies lies in the building itself. We can either study the intriguing bone-like material or focus our efforts on exploration, searching the structure for more clues about the aliens who built and used it and their daily routine.

arcsite.2021.desc.zh:
在经过波澜不惊的研究之后，[Leader.GetName]得出的结论是这座建筑曾经是……活着的。当然不是现在，而是很多年前，在它被创造出来的某个时候。一大堆骨和组织被粘合在了一起，建造出了这样一栋建筑，能够根据特定的需求变形。考虑到这座建筑坍塌的方式，我们或许甚至可以假设这是结构的这一部分故意执行的行为。

不幸的是，我们在研究过程中不小心破坏了这个结构，它坍塌得更加厉害了，致使这座建筑无法用于我们的进一步研究。[Leader.GetName]下令小队继续前进。
arcsite.2021.desc.en:
After uneventful research, [Leader.GetName] concluded that the building was... alive. Not now, but years ago, sometime during its creation. It was a mass of bones and tissues molded together to create a building that could reshape for the desired purpose. Given the way the building collapsed, one might even assume that this was a deliberate act on the part of the structure itself.

Unfortunately, we compromised the structure during our studies and it collapsed even further, rendering the building useless for further research. [Leader.GetName] ordered the team to move forward.

arcsite.2022.desc.zh:
这个阴森的结构内部原来是一座迷宫，满是半坍塌的廊道，地上到处都是四散分布的类骨物质。在历经磨难之后，我们设法取出了几样工具和物体，这些都昭示着某个复合的文化势力曾一度生活在这个行星上。它们或许能够提供给我们新的认识，让我们了解这些灭绝的物种究竟是怎样的生命。

不幸的是，在我们的研究过程中，不小心破坏了这个结构，它坍塌得更加厉害了，致使这座建筑无法用于我们得进一步研究。[Leader.GetName]下令小队继续前进。
arcsite.2022.desc.en:
The interior of this creepy structure turned out to be a maze of half-collapsed corridors filled with bone-like material lying everywhere. With some difficulty, we were able to extract several tools and objects that indicate that a complex culture lived on this planet. They will give us great insight into what life may have been like for these extinct species.

Unfortunately, we compromised the structure during our studies and it collapsed even further, rendering the building useless for further research. [Leader.GetName] has ordered the team to move forward.

arcsite.2030.desc.zh:
我们终于抵达了洞穴的最里面。我们进入了某座深深地埋在地底下、看上去像是古旧的废弃地堡一样的建筑。它看上去同我们先前找到的任何东西都不一样：我们只能假设是某些外星访客在这里设置了一个研究实验室。根据破旧的地堡、各种各样的骨头、还有四散的化石，显然他们以前也在研究这些物种，正同我们现在做的一样……唯一的区别是，他们能够趁着这些物种还活着的时候，在它们身上做各种实验。

我们刚一恢复考古遗址和数据库的电源供给，[Leader.GetName]立马就开始了工作，试图将其中收集到的任何有用的信息归纳到一起。
arcsite.2030.desc.en:
We finally reached the end of the cave. We entered something that resembled an old abandoned bunker built deep underground. It doesn't look like anything we've found before: we assume alien visitors set up a research lab down here. And given the dilapidated tanks, various bones, and fossils lying around, they were studying these species just as we were... Only they had this opportunity to conduct research when their specimens were still alive.

[Leader.GetName] immediately jumped to work, trying to gather any useful information from the site and data banks, as soon as we plugged them into the power source.

arcsite.2030.proceed.zh: 我们发现了怎样的谜题？

arcsite.2040.evopred.en: The galaxy is a harsh place.

arcsite.2040.ignorance.desc.zh:
很显然，几千年前，一个先进的文明发现了居住在这里的物种，并且很有兴趣研究它们。他们因当地多样化的生物圈而着迷。老旧的数据库仍旧可以运转，里面记录了奇怪的结论和让人不得不忧心的实验。数据库里面包含了这个物种的一个基本基因构成，以及它们在过去和将来是如何进行演化的。

这些研究者自身发生了什么？他们退化成了我们先前发现的穴居者吗？或者正相反，这些研究者就是从穴居者中间进化而来的，在某个时间点离开了这颗行星？这一切不禁让我们思索：宇宙还容纳了怎样的谜团？
arcsite.2040.ignorance.desc.en:
It appears that thousands of years ago, an advanced civilization found the specimens living here to be an interesting study. They were, fascinated by the diverse biosphere. Old databanks are still working, filled with strange conclusions and somewhat worrying experiments. They contain a basic genetic composition of the species and how they might have developed in the past and future.

What happened to the researchers themselves? Did they devolve to the state of cave dwellers we found before? Or maybe it is the opposite, and they evolved from them, leaving the planet at some point? It brings us to wonder: what other mysteries does the universe hold?

arcsite.2040.phile.zh: 我们的政府绝对不会犯下如此的骇人罪行！
arcsite.2040.phile.en: Such crimes would be impossible under our government!

arcsite.2040.phobe.zh: 这证明了绝不能相信异星人！
arcsite.2040.phobe.en: This proves that Xenos can't be trusted!

arcsite.2040.revelation.desc.zh:
我们将先前研究中得到的知识和数据库中的信息进行了比照。得出的结论让人寒颤。很显然，几千年前，某个能够太空航行的文明降落到了这个星球上，发现这些土生土长的物种在使用了他们掌握的基因操纵技术后，能够很容易地驯服。最开始，他们将有智慧的人群——尽管尚未完全开发——土人奴役，并且在它们身上进行各种各样的实验。这些实验包括为了建造目的将它们转化为活体建材。除此之外还有顺从的奴隶。甚至宠物或者牲口。

我们先前发现的实例很有可能就是这些物种的遗体，彼时它们尚未退化为现今[from.planet.GetName]上郁郁葱葱的非智慧生物圈的一部分。对于一个在未来的某一天能够像我们一样横贯整个星系的物种来说，这真是一个骇人的结局。
arcsite.2040.revelation.desc.en:
We compared our knowledge from previous studies to the information from the databanks. The conclusion we made is disconcerting. It appears that thousands of years ago, a space-faring civilization landed on this world and found the indigenous specimens easy to train, using their genetic manipulation techniques. At first, they enslaved the population of intelligent - albeit not fully-developed - autochthons, and conducted various experiments on them. These included making them into living tissue for construction purposes. Or into obedient slaves. Or into pets and livestock.

The previous instances we found were probably remnants of these species before they devolved into the non-sapient biosphere that now thrives on the [from.planet.GetName]. A horrifying end for a species that could, one day, have traversed the galaxy just as we do.

arcsite.2500.desc.zh: 我们并不是第一个在[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系发现该碎片环带的：我们发现了一架小到被我们[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]戏称为“太空小屋”的飞船，里面有一具毒物类外星人的遗骸和无数的数据水晶。根据腐坏的程度推断，这名外星人最有可能是在短短几个世纪前去世的。
arcsite.2500.desc.en: We are not the first to discover the debris belt in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system: a craft - so small that our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] are dubbing it a "space cabin" - has been found, containing the remains of a single toxoid alien and a considerable number of data crystals. Judging by the rate of decay, our best guess is that this alien expired only a few centuries ago.

arcsite.2505.A.zh: 他们在这么长的时间里肯定能发现些什么！
arcsite.2505.A.en: Surely they found something in all those years!

arcsite.2505.desc.zh:
在外星人的太空小屋里发现的数据水晶实际上是一些任务日志。我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]已经发回了一个样本及其简单翻译。它开头的的语调振奋人心：

“这是一生中绝无仅有的好机会。传说中奥德瑞斯基亚水触手可及。我的新家有点差强人意，但对我已经很满足了，因为我很快就可以寄回家足够的钱付给女儿治病了。”

然而很快，日志就变得酸楚了起来：

“妻子和女儿都死了。世上不再有人会悼念我。在黑市上贩卖打捞所得仅仅足以维持生活。现在后悔已经太晚了。”

这名外星人总共在碎片环带白费了五十多年的时间搜罗宝物但一无所获。
arcsite.2505.desc.en:
The data crystals discovered in the alien's space cabin are in fact mission logs. Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have sent us a sample, along with a preliminary translation. They start in an upbeat tone:

"This is the chance of a lifetime. The ruins of the fabled Odryskans are within reach. My new home isn't much, but it's good enough for me, and soon I'll be able to send enough credits home to pay for my daughter's treatment."

Soon enough however, the logs grow sour:

"Wife and daughter dead. No one left to mourn for me. Salvage sold on black market barely enough to support living costs. Too late to turn back now."

All told, the alien spent over five decades trawling the rubble belt in an apparently futile search for riches.

arcsite.2515.desc.zh:
不可能
不可能
不可能
不可能
骗子！
……
……
……
万一是真的呢？

随着这名外星人滑入疯狂的深渊，日志的内容也变得越来越令人毛骨悚人。
arcsite.2515.desc.en:
It is not true
It is not true
It is not true
It is not true
LIES!
...
...
...
But what if it is true?

The logs become increasingly disturbing as the alien slips further and further into madness.

arcsite.2520.desc.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]完成了对外星人日志水晶的翻译。他们呈递了最后一份日志的翻译，这份日志是在该外星人死前不久记录下的，记录者罕见地意识清醒：

“我终于找到了我一直苦苦追寻的东西。很多人会觉得我花这么多年找来找去跟疯了一样。我觉得，可能这些人也没错。我已经快老死了，我的亲朋好友也早都入土了。不管找到了什么宝贝，现在把它卖了也毫无意义，但我应该可以安息了。”

日志后面附上了这位外星人找到宝藏的位置。依据这份日志，我们追踪到了一块体积令人震惊的巨型宝石，它的价值无法估量。
arcsite.2520.desc.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished translating the alien's data crystals. They present an interpretation of the last log, in which, not long before their death, the recorder experiences a rare moment of lucidity:

"I have finally found what I am looking for. Many would consider me mad for continuing the search this long. I think, probably, that they are right. I am old, now - dying, even - and my kin are long since dust. There is no point in selling the artifact, but perhaps now I can find peace."

The logs go on to pinpoint where the alien concealed the treasure. By following them, we have tracked down an astonishingly large gemstone of immeasurable value.

arcsite.3000.desc.zh:
[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]上的废弃观测站似乎在报废前不久被改为他用。尽管上面还有用于监视行星居民的设备的证据，但看来大部分都改成了$NAME_Charynoi$的历史博物馆。奇怪的是，明明这是一个好斗的物种，但是关于暴力的主题被刻意回避了，展品主要集中在一些关于和平和生育的仪式上。

在中控室发现了一系列数据水晶。显然这就是我们想要找的东西。
arcsite.3000.desc.en:
The abandoned observation post above [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName] appears to have been repurposed shortly before it was abandoned. Though there is equipment to surveil the inhabitants of the planet in evidence, most of it seems to be dedicated to a museum of $NAME_Charynoi$ history. Curiously for such a warlike species, subjects relating to violence seem to have been avoided, and exhibits appear to show various rituals of peace and fertility.

A series of data crystals have been left in the control room. It is evident that we were supposed to find them.

arcsite.3005.desc.zh:
第一块数据水晶已经完成了翻译。其封面上写着“这是$NAME_Charynoi$民族的记录，系女先知伊蒂卡里奥斯所留，这样那些可能找到它的人能原谅我们的罪过。”

其后是一份历史、哲学和艺术工作的合辑，可能是由一个比较标准但稍微好斗的晚工业革命社会所创。我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将其发回[Owner.Capital.GetName]以进行进一步研究。
arcsite.3005.desc.en:
The first crystal has been translated. It is prefaced with the words "This is the record of the $NAME_Charynoi$ people, left behind by the Prophetess Ithikarios, so that those who might find it may forgive us our sins."

What follows is a collection of historical, philosophical and artistic works as may have been created by a fairly standard, if somewhat belligerent, late industrial society. Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have sent it back to [Owner.Capital.GetName] for further analysis.

arcsite.3010.desc.zh:
“现在我将叙述一切是如何走向错误——我们最初陷入傲慢罪恶的地方，”伊蒂卡里奥斯宣称。

第二颗晶体记录了$NAME_Charynoi$是如何逐渐揭开太空飞行的奥秘，似乎比[Root.Owner.GetName]早了大约一百年。他们在自己的星系中发现了两颗美丽的行星，并得出结论认为这些行星是神灵留给他们的产业，是他们与生俱来的权利，他们现在正在索取这些权利。

伊蒂卡里奥斯用惊恐的语气讲述了这些早期探索的黑暗面：在他们的新殖民地中，初生的文明并不愿意放弃他们的家园。他们被打败并被奴役，最终逐渐消亡，死于$NAME_Charynoi$不屑于治疗的疾病。

我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]正在努力翻译第三个也是最后一个数据晶体。
arcsite.3010.desc.en:
"Now I shall recount where it all went wrong - where we first fell to the sin of arrogance," declaims Ithikarios.

The second crystal recounts how the $NAME_Charynoi$ gradually uncovered the mysteries of space flight, seemingly about a hundred years before the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They found two beautiful planets in their own system, and concluded that those had been bequeathed to them by the Gods as their birthright, which they were now claiming.

In horrified tones, Ithikarios recounts the darker side to these early exploits: nascent civilizations on their new colonies had not willingly yielded their homes. Beaten into submission, they were enslaved and eventually dwindled, falling to diseases the $NAME_Charynoi$ did not care to cure.

Our [Owner.GetLinguists] are hard at work translating the third and final data crystal.

arcsite.3015.B.zh: 我们可以随心所欲处置它。
arcsite.3015.B.en: We can do with it as we please.

arcsite.3015.desc.zh:
最终，我们耗尽了我们所拥有的空间。我们知道虫洞的存在，但是它们无法被我们研究。我们的领土物产丰富景色优美，很容易让我们相信自己是天之选民。虫洞是一种考验，只要通过了考验，我们就能将自己的种族传遍整个星系，这是我们的神圣使命。

我曾经是那些试图履行这个职责的首领之一。当灵感降临在我身上——我意识到掌握了打开虫洞的钥匙——我便在祖先神社中祈祷了几天。最终得到了启示：我们不配。如果我们穿过虫洞，我们只会找到痛苦。$NAME_Aspharelle$将被清除，作为我们所犯罪行的惩罚。我决定销毁我的研究，并寻找一条不同的路。

要找到可以信任的人很难。如果我们被发现了，我们肯定宁可快速死亡。虽然我比以往任何时候都更加坚信我们是正确的，但我们会被视为叛教者。最终，我们启动了一个大胆的计划：在假装盲目飞越虫洞的愚蠢尝试的掩护下，我们建造了一艘方舟船，航行到未知的地方，朝着一个遥远的星球。我们经历了多年穿越空旷的太空，直到我们到达目的地。现在，我们只希望被留在和平中过上品德高尚的生活，以证明并非所有$NAME_Charynoi$都是邪恶的。

伊蒂卡里奥斯为她的兄弟们对我们造成的任何伤害深表歉意，她提到她试图在[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]周围竖起一个坚不可摧的盾牌，这样她的人民就不会再受到诱惑去寻找星辰。她失败了，但是我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经能够解决她的问题。现在，如果我们愿意，我们现在就可以竖起这个盾牌。
arcsite.3015.desc.en:
"Eventually, we exhausted the confines of the space we had been bequeathed. We knew of the existence of the Wormhole, but it defied our study. Our realm was so bountiful, so full of beauty, that it was not hard to convince ourselves that we were the Chosen. That the Wormhole was a test, and once we were worthy, it would be our Holy Purpose to spread our kind across all the galaxy.

"I was once chief amongst those seeking to fulfill this duty. When inspiration came to me - when I realized I held the key to the opening of the Wormhole - I prayed for days at the Shrine of my Ancestors. And eventually: Revelation. We were not worthy. If we went beyond the Wormhole, we would find only pain. $NAME_Aspharelle$ would be scoured, out of punishment for the crimes we had committed. I resolved to destroy my research and seek a different path.

"It was hard to find those who I could trust. If we were discovered, we would surely have longed for a quick death. Though I am more convinced than ever that we are right, we would have been seen as apostates. Eventually, we launched a daring plan: under the guise of making a fool attempt to fly the wormhole blind, we built an arkship to sail into the unknown, towards a distant star. Many years, we traveled through empty space, until we came to our destination. Now we wish nothing more than to be left in peace to live virtuous lives, so that we may prove that not all $NAME_Charynoi$ are evil."

Apologizing profusely for any harm done to us by her brethren, Ithikarios mentions her attempts at erecting an impenetrable shield around [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName], so that her people would never again be tempted to seek the stars. She failed, but our [Owner.GetResearchers] have been able to work out where she went wrong. We could erect the shield now, if we so desire.

arcsite.3020.desc.zh: 得益于我们[Owner.GetResearchers]的努力，伊蒂卡里奥斯想要用来包围[FromFrom.GetName]的护盾完成了。她的$NAME_Charynoi$子民终于可以得到安宁。
arcsite.3020.desc.en: Thanks to the efforts of our [Owner.GetResearchers], the shield Ithikarios attempted to erect over [FromFrom.GetName] has been completed. Her $NAME_Charynoi$ descendants can now find peace.

arcsite.3025.desc.zh:
宏伟的圣殿与损毁的神庙点缀在首都之上。而更深入的探索揭示出这个文明早在五十多万年前就被毁灭了。

根据几幅保存得相当完好的壁画被发现，原住民似乎在生物学上接近鸟类。对他们语言的初步音译表明，他们称自己为“克拉祖拉”。
arcsite.3025.desc.en:
Grand sanctums and ruined temples dot the landscape of the capital. A deeper exploration has revealed that this civilization was destroyed more than half a million years ago.

Based on the discovery of several remarkably well-preserved murals, the inhabitants appeared to be avian in biology. A rough transliteration of their language indicates they called themselves the Krazura.

arcsite.3030.a.desc.zh:
$arcsite.3030.intro$

更重要的是，大殿外蚀刻的一幅壁画提供了一个令人难以置信的发现：这颗行星不是别的正是斯卡拉维德，是著名的舰队司令斯克兰德·夏普比克的祖先的居住地！
arcsite.3030.a.desc.en:
$arcsite.3030.intro$

What's more, a mural etched just outside the Hall provided an incredible discovery: this planet is none other than Skravird, ancestral home of the famous Admiral Skrand Sharpbeak!

arcsite.3030.b.desc.zh:
$arcsite.3030.intro$

这座大厅外蚀刻的壁画表明这颗行星曾经被称为斯卡拉维德。
arcsite.3030.b.desc.en:
$arcsite.3030.intro$

A mural etched just outside the Hall indicates this planet was once called Skravird.

arcsite.3030.tt.zh: 这颗行星的名字被改为斯卡拉维德
arcsite.3030.tt.en: Changes the planet's name to Skravird.

arcsite.3031.desc.zh:
你找到了斯卡拉维德。我本以为我永远地失去了家园。

有机会我会把我的爪子插入它的土里，感受着温暖的南风吹拂我的羽毛... 你为我和我的人民所做的一切都无法估量。

我的身体和心灵都感到焕然一新。我对你心怀感激。
arcsite.3031.desc.en:
You have found Skravird. I thought my home lost forever.

To have the chance to set my talons into its ground, to feel the warm south wind blowing through my feathers... What you have done for me and for my people is beyond measure.

I am refreshed, in body and mind. You have my gratitude.

arcsite.3035.desc.zh:
我们已经确定了这个克拉祖拉并非来自我们维度。他们通过某种类型的传送门抵达这里，发现自己漂流到一个陌生的外星星系中。很久以后，他们在到达的地点周围建造了这个大厅。

仅存的几份记录表明，他们认为自己是伟大而神秘力量的仲裁者。他们的最高领袖，被称为“亚库拉”，被认为是一种独立的个体，每一代都会转移到一个新的身体里。

在大厅下面，我们挖出了几位统治者的遗骸。有趣的是，最早的统治者与后面的统治者有着不同的基因结构。似乎是前往这个宇宙的旅程的影响了克拉祖拉的DNA，导致“复”眼的出现。
arcsite.3035.desc.en:
We have established that the Krazura were not native to our dimension. Arriving through a portal of some kind, they found themselves adrift in a strange and alien galaxy. Much later, the Grand Hall was built around their arrival site.

The few remaining records indicate they viewed themselves as arbiters of great and mystical power. Their supreme leader, known as the 'Yakura', was believed to be a single individual, reincarnating into a new body with each generation.

Beneath the Grand Hall, we unearthed the remains of several such rulers. Interestingly, the earliest possessed a different genetic structure from those that followed. It seems the journey to this universe impacted the Krazura's very DNA, resulting in the emergence of a 'double' set of eyes.

arcsite.3040.desc.zh:
克拉祖拉最初是我们宇宙中的难民。然而，在大殿附近发现的记录表明，他们迅速建立起了一个强大的星际帝国。他们的人民在多个世代的时间里保持着繁荣昌盛。亚库拉的能力和至高无上的地位毋庸置疑。然后，“威胁”出现了。

这个无名的敌人和他们以前遇到的敌人都不一样，似乎一心要毁灭他们。亚库拉这个最伟大的圣贤们在这强大的威胁面前无能为力，他们强大的才能变得毫无用处。
arcsite.3040.desc.en:
The Krazura started out as refugees in our universe. Nevertheless, records discovered near the Grand Hall show that they quickly established themselves as a powerful interstellar empire. For many generations they enjoyed a Golden Age. Their people prospered, and the ability and supremacy of the Yakura went unquestioned. Then the Menace appeared.

A foe unlike any they had encountered before, this nameless enemy seemed obsessed with their destruction. The Krazura's greatest sages stood powerless before the indomitable threat, their mighty magic rendered useless.

arcsite.3045.a.desc.zh:
我们发现了一批记录，为了解克拉祖拉的命运提供了线索。

指挥他们海军旗舰的是一位传奇的舰队司令，他是他人民的伟大英雄。在被外星威胁取得最后的胜利之前，他和他的船员们被派遣执行了最后且大胆的任务。为了绕过敌人，他们进入了一个未经测试的星门。自此，这艘船和它的船员们便再也没有了任何音讯。

这中间发生了什么仍然是一个谜。这艘舰船是否仍有存在可能？
arcsite.3045.a.desc.en:
We have uncovered a cache of records that offer clues as to the fate of the Krazura.

Commanding their navy's flagship was a legendary Admiral, a great hero of his people. Before the alien Menace could achieve a final victory, he and his crew were sent on a last, daring mission. In a bid to outflank the enemy, they entered an untested Gateway. The ship and its crew were never heard from again.

What happened remains a mystery. Is it possible that this ship is still out there?

arcsite.3045.b.desc.zh:
我们发现了一批记录，为了解克拉祖拉的命运提供了线索。

为了大胆地绕过敌人，亚库拉命令旗舰穿过未经测试的星门。舰队司令正是传奇的斯克兰德·夏普比克。

他和他的船员们继承了一项非凡的遗产。无论斯克兰德是否愿意接受这个头衔，他的人民现在将他视为亚库拉。
arcsite.3045.b.desc.en:
We have uncovered a cache of records that offer clues as to the fate of the Krazura.
