In a daring bid to outflank the enemy, the Yakura ordered the flagship to enter an untested Gateway. In command was the legendary Admiral Skrand Sharpbeak.

He and his crew are the inheritors of a remarkable legacy. Whether Skrand wishes to accept the title or not, his people now look to him as Yakura.

arcsite.3055.desc.zh:
尽管整体进度迟滞不前，我们的[owner.GetResearchers]还是发现了一个以前未被发现的房间。在里面，有一座庞大的雕像，壮观又美丽。

形态是鸟类，长而有力的脖子由金属链条构成，不知为何能够悬浮在上面。锐利的羽毛从仪态端庄的颅骨上迸发出来，它黄金般的眼睛象征着权利。在穿过大厅时，[owner.GetResearchers]有一种不舒服的感觉，仿佛在被人窥视。

他们在这个雕像后面发现了一个隐藏的门或封印，不管这只不祥之鸟是在守卫什么，它的守护物早已失效。
arcsite.3055.desc.en:
Even as overall progress stalled, our [owner.GetResearchers] revealed the entrance to a previously undiscovered chamber. Inside was a massive statue, as imposing as it is beautiful.

Avian in form, its long, powerful neck is fashioned of metallic links that somehow manage to hover in place. Sharp plumage erupts from a patrician skull, and its eyes are golden heralds of power. Moving through the chamber, our [owner.GetResearchers] had the uncomfortable sensation that they were being watched.

Behind the figure they discovered hidden a door or seal, but whatever this baleful bird was guarding has long since ceased to function.

arcsite.3060.desc.zh:
根据我们迄今为止的发现，这个文明对于悲剧并不陌生。

储存在某种地下墓室或陵墓里的古老记录详细描述了一场大规模瘟疫的爆发，这场瘟疫以一种特别可怕的方式影响着这个鸟类物种的生理特征。

最初，表现为羽毛上的问题，病毒导致羽毛从根部开始腐烂。在几天内，这些病症就会扩散到了血液中。尽管我们无法确定，但初步估计将死亡率超过30%。

一座令人心酸的纪念碑竖立在了城市中心的一个广场上。在一堆骨头上，一只骷髅鸟绝望地看着天空，它掉落的羽毛散落在一对脆弱的爪子上。
arcsite.3060.desc.en:
Based on what we have discovered thus far, this civilization was no stranger to tragedy.

Ancient records stored in some kind of crypt or mausoleum detail the emergence of a great plague, one which afflicted the species' avian physiognomy in particularly gruesome ways.

First manifesting in the plumage, the virus caused feathers to rot at the root. Within days, these effects had spread to the blood. We cannot know for certain, but early estimates place the mortality rate at over 30%.

A poignant monument was erected in one of the city's central squares. Atop a mound of bones, a single, skeletal bird looks hopelessly to the sky, its fallen feathers strewn about a pair of brittle talons.

arcsite.9000.a.zh: 安排一下，队员的健康最为重要。
arcsite.9000.a.en: Make arrangements. Our team's health is of utmost importance.

arcsite.9000.b.zh: 让[leader.GetHimHer]去吧，说不定[leader.GetHeShe]真的发现了什么呢。

arcsite.9000.desc.zh:
首席考古学家[leader.GetName]最近变得越来越孤僻。[leader.GetHeSheCap]像是对研究项目越来越漠不关心，反而沉迷于那些迄今为止发现的所有日记与日志。[leader.GetHeSheCap]还总是嘟囔着：“这些人该有多孤独啊。”

这也许是荒凉的挖掘现场的造成的负面影响。我们可以为整个小队提供一下心理咨询，或者相信[leader.GetName]，让[leader.GetHisHer]在工作中想出解决方法。
arcsite.9000.desc.en:
Chief archaeologist [leader.GetName] has been growing steadily more withdrawn of late. [leader.GetHeSheCap] appear[leader.GetSXX] less invested in our research goals, choosing instead to obsess over the various diaries and logs we have uncovered so far. [leader.GetHeSheCap] often mutter[leader.GetSXX] about "how lonely these people must have been".

It is possible the bleakness of this dig site is taking a toll. We can arrange for team-wide counseling, or else trust that [leader.GetName] finds resolution in [leader.GetHisHer] work.

arcsite.9001.desc.zh:
首席考古学家[absconded_archaeologist.GetName]现在不知所踪，随[absconded_archaeologist.GetHimHer]一同消失的还有一大批人类学数据。队员汇报称一辆地面载具失踪，不过我们的保护服还留在基地里。

[absconded_archaeologist.GetName]有可能跑到冻土带的另一处潜艇居住地去了。不过出于实际考虑，我们必须做好最坏的打算。
arcsite.9001.desc.en:
Chief archaeologist [absconded_archaeologist.GetName] has absconded, taking a sizeable portion of our anthropological data with [absconded_archaeologist.GetHimHer]. The team reports one ground vehicle missing, but all our environment suits remain at the base.

It is possible [absconded_archaeologist.GetName] escaped to another submarine habitat somewhere across the tundra, but realistically... We must assume the worst.

arcsite.9002.a.en: But was it worth the cost?

arcsite.9002.desc.zh: 考古学家[leader.GetName]付出了惨重的代价。尽管大家看上去相当疲惫，但[leader.GetHeShe]还是重新回到了团队之中，并提出了一个令人信服的猜想。我们似乎忽略了几个个人文件汇总中的微妙细节。总之，这些线索将协助我们，带来团队一直期望的突破。
arcsite.9002.desc.en: A heavy toll has been exacted upon archaeologist [leader.GetName]. Though they appear quite haggard now, [leader.GetHeShe] has rejoined the team and presented a compelling hypothesis. It seems we had overlooked several subtle details in the corpus of personal documents. Together, these clues provide just the sort of breakthrough we had been hoping for.

arcsite.9005.a.en: The risks and potential cost are too great.

arcsite.9005.desc.zh:
[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的发掘小队正紧跟着[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上[owner.GetResearchers]的工作步伐，尝试着用各种新方法挖掘坚固的冻土层。地面团队已经部署了一台原型挖掘机，其设计很大程度上参考了环境改造技术。

早期试验表明，这台机器将迅速推进我们的工作进程。不过，团队成员已经发现了一些风险。如果我们要尝试控制风险，则需要拨付额外的资金。
arcsite.9005.desc.en:
The excavation team on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has been working closely with our [owner.GetResearchers] on [owner.capital_scope.GetName], trying out novel solutions for work in harsh tundra. The ground team has deployed a prototype excavator whose design draws heavily on terraforming techniques.

Early trials suggest this machine will significantly speed up our work here. However, they have identified several risks. Additional funds will be required if we are to try and mitigate those.

arcsite.9005.tt.carefree.zh:
$site_ice_trauma$增加4条线索
[leader.GetName]获得特质：
$t$$leader_trait_carefree$特质
$t$经验：+150

arcsite.9005.tt.paranoid.zh:
$site_ice_trauma$减少2条线索
[leader.GetName]获得特质：
$t$$leader_trait_paranoid$特质
$t$经验：+50

arena_combat_begin.zh: 竞技场中的战斗即将开始。
arena_combat_begin.en: The battle in the arena will soon begin.

arkship.10.desc.zh:
基础扫描显示，该集装箱内装着不起眼的货物和矿物，很可能是标准补给品运输的一部分。然而，在更深处藏着一个单一的、致密的物体，具有不寻常的特性。它的成分无法确定。

该物体没有反射任何能量特征，吸收了大部分扫描波长，并且与飞船记录中任何已知材料都不符。即使通过远程成像，其确切形状也难以确定。鉴于其结构的这些异常，[Root.GetName]的一些科学家警告说它可能具有潜在危险。
arkship.10.desc.en:
A basic scan showed the container held unremarkable goods and minerals, likely part of a standard supply shipment. However, lodged deeper within was a single, dense object with unusual properties. Its composition could not be determined.

The object reflected no energy signatures, absorbed most scanning wavelengths, and did not match any known materials in the ship's records. Even its exact shape proved difficult to define through remote imaging. Given these anomalies of its structure, some scientists of [Root.GetName] warned it could be potentially dangerous.

arkship.100.desc.zh:
[event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName]的轴基挂载武器修复工作已经完成。虽然维修过程需要精细的作业和长时间的检查，但我们借此机会加固了舰体多处薄弱部位，并改良了挂架的结构支撑。

这些改进提升了方舟舰在高难度机动时的稳定性，使得导航部门得以解除此前的航行限制。初步测试表明，该舰现在的性能表现比受损前更加出色。
arkship.100.desc.en:
Repairs to the Spinal Mount of [event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName] have been completed. Though the process required careful work and extended inspections, we used the opportunity to reinforce several vulnerable sections of the hull and refine the mount's structural supports.

The resulting improvements have increased the Arkship's stability during high-speed maneuvers, allowing navigation to lift previous restrictions. Early tests suggest the vessel now performs more efficiently than before the damage occurred.

arkship.1005.desc.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的[from.GetName]方舟终于被摧毁了。

方舟不仅仅是一个战争的器具，它还是无数游牧生命体的家园。曾经生活和旅行于其中的几代人现在失去了维系他们的基础。

剩下的只有残骸，在虚空中悄无声息地漂流。
arkship.1005.desc.en:
The Arkship [from.GetName] in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has at last been destroyed.

More than just a vessel of war, the Arkship was a home to countless nomadic lifeforms. Generations who once lived and traveled within have been left without the foundation that bound them together.

What remains is wreckage, drifting silently through the void.

arkship.1005.desc.homicidal.zh:
异星舰船[from.GetName]已在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系被歼灭。

游牧舰队进行了激烈抵抗，但终究不敌我方。那些在群星之间无序漂泊的流浪者始终是个威胁。他们的方舟舰已化作四散的残骸。

不要让他们任何一人找到安全港。
arkship.1005.desc.homicidal.en:
The alien vessel [from.GetName] has been eliminated from the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

The nomadic fleet resisted fiercely, but they were outmatched. Wanderers who drift between the stars without order are a persistent threat. Their Arkship has been reduced to scattered debris.

Let none of them find safe harbor.

arkship.1005.desc.nomad.zh:
方舟舰[from.GetName]已在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中被摧毁。

在所有民族之中，我们最明白这样的舰船意味着什么——一个仅凭船体与引擎承载的文明，一代又一代都在同样的舱壁内生老病死。这份理解并未拯救他们。它也无能为力。

他们的漂泊到此为止。
arkship.1005.desc.nomad.en:
The Arkship [from.GetName] has been destroyed in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

We of all peoples understand what such a vessel represents - a civilization carried in hull and engine alone, each generation living and dying within the same walls. That understanding did not spare them. It could not.

Their wandering ends here.

arkship.1015.desc.zh:
我们位于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的方舟舰[from.GetName]已被敌人摧毁。

战斗异常激烈，但敌人的力量势不可挡。尽管我们的船员英勇无畏，但我们的防御最终瓦解，方舟舰永远地离开了我们，它的残骸散落在太空中。

这一天将永远被铭记。
arkship.1015.desc.en:
Our Arkship [from.GetName] in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has been destroyed by the enemy.

The battle was fierce, but the strength of our foes proved overwhelming. Despite the valor of our crew, our defenses faltered, and the Arkship has been torn from us forever, its debris scattered through the void.

This day shall be remembered.

arkship.1015.desc.homicidal.zh:
我们的[from.GetName]方舟在[from.solar_system.GetName]系中被摧毁了——不是被征服，而是被处决。

[fromfrom.GetName]根本不要什么领土或者朝贡，他们只要我们死。在将我们从星间灭绝的行动中，船上的每一条生命对他们而言都是可接受的伤亡数字。

但我们经历了这一切侥幸活了下来，我们绝不会被抹杀。
arkship.1015.desc.homicidal.en:
Our Arkship [from.GetName] in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has been destroyed - not through conquest, but through extermination.

[fromfrom.GetName] did not seek territory or tribute. They sought our end. Every soul aboard was an acceptable casualty in their campaign to purge us from the stars.

We survive. We endure. We will not be erased.

arkship.1015.desc.nomad.zh:
我们的方舟舰[from.GetName]已在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中陷落——并非毁于那些畏惧未知的定居帝国之手，而是毁于与我们一样熟悉虚空的流浪者之手。

[fromfrom.GetName]向我们发动了攻击，明知摧毁一个民族最后的家园意味着什么。流浪者之间没有团结，只有生存。

我们不会忘记这一切。
arkship.1015.desc.nomad.en:
Our Arkship [from.GetName] has been lost in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system - not to settled empires who fear what they do not understand, but to wanderers who know the void as we do.

[fromfrom.GetName] struck against us, knowing full well what it means to destroy a people's last home. There is no solidarity among wanderers. There is only survival.

We will not forget this.

arkship.1030.a.zh: 注意到了。这很奇怪，但无关紧要。

arkship.1030.desc.zh: 方舟舰[Root.GetName]的报告指出，船员行为出现了一些轻微异常。个人日志显示出零星的古怪之处：对个人仪容的异常关注，为接近特定同事而定期调班，以及在公共区域下班后聚会次数的增加。这些似乎都没有干扰到舰船的运作，而且船员士气异常高涨。
arkship.1030.desc.en: Reports from Arkship [Root.GetName] have flagged several minor irregularities in crew behavior. Personal logs reveal scattered oddities: unusual attention to grooming, regular shift swaps to be around specific coworkers, and an uptick in off-duty gatherings in communal areas. None of this appears to interfere with operations, and the crew morale is unusually high.

arkship.1035.b.zh: 调查一下，这突然的变化来源是什么。
arkship.1035.b.en: Investigate where the sudden change is coming from.

arkship.1035.desc.zh:
我们的方舟舰[Root.GetName]的舰桥和指挥人员现在进入了一种新的迷恋状态。那些奇怪而无害的行为现在已经演变成彻头彻尾的示爱活动：船员们互相给对方取精心设想的爱称，为对方制作小饰品，而且经常能看到他们[owner.species.GetHandName]牵着[owner.species.GetHandName]在走廊上散步。

工作流程已经中断，维护周期正在推迟。虽然目前还不危急，但如果这种情况持续下去，运行状态可能会受到影响。
arkship.1035.desc.en:
Our bridge and command staff aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] have now entered a new level of infatuation. Odd if harmless behavior has now intensified into outright amorous activity: crew are exchanging elaborate epithets, crafting trinkets for one another, and can often be found strolling the corridors, [owner.species.GetHandName] in [owner.species.GetHandName].

Work routines have faltered as maintenance cycles are being deferred. While not currently critical, if this goes on, operational status could become compromised.

arkship.1040.a.en: Let love be. No need to interfere.

arkship.1040.desc.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上最初只是有一些船员情绪激动的报告，结果局势愈演愈烈，现在成了更为严重的问题。许多船员都参与了精心策划的浪漫求爱。诗歌朗诵和公开示爱开始主导船上的日常生活。

不幸的是，并非所有的爱意都得到了回应。被拒绝导致了几次小规模冲突，至少有一名工程官选择自己宅在观测站里，宣称“除非有人真正理解他们”，否则他们不会出来。
arkship.1040.desc.en:
Initial reports of an emotionally charged crew atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] have given way to something far more serious. Many crew members have been involved in elaborate romantic displays. Poetic recitals and public displays of affection have begun to dominate daily life on board.

Unfortunately, not all affections are reciprocated. Rejections have led to several minor altercations, and at least one engineering officer has barricaded themselves in the observatory, declaring they will not come out "until someone truly understands them".

arkship.1045.a.zh: 与爱同行，一切皆有可能！

arkship.1045.desc.noleader.zh: $arkship.1045.desc.start$我们曾身陷绝境，直到[arkship_leader.GetName]力挽狂澜，获得了方舟的领导权。$arkship.1045.desc.end$
arkship.1045.desc.noleader.en: $arkship.1045.desc.start$We were in dire straits until [arkship_leader.GetName] took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. $arkship.1045.desc.end$

arkship.105.c.zh: 关闭引擎，重新进行校准。
arkship.105.c.en: Shut the engines down and recalibrate.

arkship.105.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]舰上引擎突然发生的激增使方舟舰的驱动核心超出了安全运行公差。热点正在主引擎组件中蔓延，压力上升的速度超过了调节系统的补偿能力。

如果不加控制，过剩的输出可能会损坏关键的引擎部件。我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]建议了几种可能的对策：排放多余的等离子体以稳定系统，重新分配工作任务优先级，或者暂时关闭引擎进行全面重新校准。
arkship.105.desc.en:
A sudden engine surge aboard [Root.GetName] has pushed the Arkship's drive core beyond safe operating tolerances. Heat blooms are spreading through the primary engine assembly, and pressure is rising faster than the regulation systems can compensate.

If left unchecked, the excess output could damage critical engine components. Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] recommend several possible responses: vent the excess plasma to stabilize the system, reprioritize work assignments, or temporarily shut the engines down to conduct a full recalibration.

arkship.1050.desc.noleader.zh: $arkship.1050.desc.start$我们曾身处绝境，直到[arkship_leader.GetName]掌控了局面，并被授予方舟的领导权。$arkship.1050.desc.end$
arkship.1050.desc.noleader.en: $arkship.1050.desc.start$We were in dire straits until [arkship_leader.GetName] took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. $arkship.1050.desc.end$

arkship.1055.a.en: It's too dangerous. Destroy the plant.

arkship.1055.desc.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上发布了一个特别项目，揭示了一种不寻常的生物因子。一株神秘植物在方舟舰的过滤系统中生根发芽。我们的科学家认为，源自太空的孢子通过通风系统进入飞船，并找到了生长的场所。这种植物花朵的孢子通过我们的系统传播，导致飞船上所有人的情绪都变得异常激动。

这种植物的花朵散发出微弱的生物荧光，其根系似乎直接以飞船大气中循环的湿气为食。我们的船员形容它的气味“甜美、奇特、怀旧”。如果不加以控制，孢子将继续操控船员的情绪。然而，这种植物也表现出非凡的韧性，如果我们能正确地栽培它，甚至可能具有潜在的应用价值。
arkship.1055.desc.en:
The special project issued aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] has revealed an unusual biological agent. A mysterious plant has taken root within the Arkship's filtration systems. Our scientists suggest that space-born spores made it on board through the ventilation systems and found a place to grow roots. The spores of the plant's flower carried through our systems are inducing heightened emotional states in all who live aboard the ship.

The plant's blossoms emit a faint bioluminescence, and its root structure appears to feed directly on the recycled humidity of the ship's atmosphere. Our crew members describe the smell as "sweet, whimsical, and nostalgic." Left unchecked, the spores will continue to manipulate the crew's emotions. The plant, however, also displays remarkable resilience, perhaps even a potential application, should we learn to cultivate it properly.

arkship.1060.desc.noleader.zh: $arkship.1060.desc.start$我们曾身处绝境，直到[arkship_leader.GetName]掌控了局面，并被授予方舟的领导权。$arkship.1060.desc.end$
arkship.1060.desc.noleader.en: $arkship.1060.desc.start$We were in dire straits until [arkship_leader.GetName] took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. $arkship.1060.desc.end$

arkship.1065.desc.noleader.zh: $arkship.1065.desc.start$我们曾身陷绝境，直到[arkship_leader.GetName]力挽狂澜，获得了方舟的领导权。$arkship.1065.desc.end$
arkship.1065.desc.noleader.en: $arkship.1065.desc.start$We were in dire straits until [arkship_leader.GetName] took command of the situation and was granted leadership of the Arkship. $arkship.1065.desc.end$

arkship.1070.a.zh: 通过常态化演练提升士气。

arkship.1070.b.zh: 尝试通过内部通讯播放引擎噪音。
arkship.1070.b.en: Try playing engine noises through internal comms.

arkship.1070.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]方舟舰正以我们祖先难以想象的速度穿越虚空。

早期的几代人曾花费数年甚至一生的时间在遥远的恒星间漂泊，而我们现代的驱动装置只需几天就能让方舟舰在各个星系间穿梭。随着飞船冲入超空间航道网，恒星在我们的传感器中飞速掠过，它们的光线不断发生位移与扭曲。

对于船上的许多人来说，这种经历确实会产生一种奇特的迷失感。一些人开始寻求微小的慰藉，以对抗这种感官冲击；而另一些人则坚持认为，只要给予足够的时间，我们的心智终将学会跟上方舟舰不断加速的旅程。
arkship.1070.desc.en:
The Arkship [Root.GetName] now crosses the void at speeds our ancestors could scarcely have imagined.

Where earlier generations spent years, even lifetimes, drifting between distant stars, our modern drives hurl the Arkship from system to system in a matter of days. The stars streak past our sensors in rapid succession, their light shifting and distorting as the ship plunges through the hyperlane network.

For many aboard, the experience has proven strangely disorienting. Some have begun seeking small ways to anchor themselves against the sensation. Others insist that, given time, our minds will simply learn to keep pace with the Arkship's accelerating journey.

arkship.1075.a.zh: 不惜一切代价，把它修好。
arkship.1075.a.en: Spare no expense and repair it properly.

arkship.1075.b.zh: 修修补补继续用吧，我们现在得勒紧裤腰带过日子。
arkship.1075.b.en: Patch it and move on. We cannot afford luxuries.

arkship.1075.desc.zh:
一个故障的继电器正在干扰方舟舰[Root.GetName]的能源核心。除了无法动弹之外，住宅区的灯光也正在熄灭。农场报告能源涌动异常，几个关键研究模块已经离线。

我们的总工程师警告说，如果不加以干预，连锁故障将蔓延至整艘飞船。不幸的是，解决方案并不简单。修复继电器需要从储备中抽调资源，而绕过它则有损害方舟舰长期稳定性的风险。

冷却中的飞船发出令人不安的吱嘎声和呻吟声。我们现在需要做出决定。
arkship.1075.desc.en:
A faulty relay is interfering with the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core. In addition to being immobilized, the lights are now going out on residential decks. Farms report irregular energy surges, and several key research modules have gone offline.

Our chief engineers warn that without intervention, cascading failures will spread throughout the ship. Unfortunately the solution is not straightforward. Repairing the relay will require diverting resources from our reserves, while bypassing it risks compromising the Arkship's long-term stability.

The cooling ship creaks and groans unsettlingly. We need to make a decision now.

arkship.1080.desc.zh: 尽管困难重重，方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的工程船员不仅修复了故障继电器，还对其进行了改进。现在，全舰的能量分配比以往任何时候都更加顺畅，多年来一直不稳定的系统也得以稳定。船员士气大幅提升，许多人对方舟舰的韧性表现出了新的自豪感。
arkship.1080.desc.en: Against all odds, the engineering crew on Arkship [Root.GetName] has not only repaired the faulty relay, but improved it. Energy distribution across the ship is now smoother than ever, stabilizing systems that have been temperamental for years. Crew morale has risen sharply, with many expressing newfound pride in the Arkship's resilience.

arkship.1085.a.en: We must make do and mend.

arkship.1085.desc.zh: 对飞船[Root.GetName]能源核心的快速修复暂时有效。但临时旁路电路在持续使用下已不堪重负。频繁的全船断电已成为常态，一些区域的环境控制在过热和过冷之间摇摆不定。船员抱怨领导层选择了权宜之计而非安全。低语流传着，方舟舰正在变成一座修修补补的遗迹，而非一座坚韧的灯塔。
arkship.1085.desc.en: The quick fix on the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core is holding, at least for now. But the makeshift bypass circuits are straining under constant use. Frequent ship-wide blackouts are now a way of life, and environmental controls in some sections have been oscillating between too hot, and too cold. The crew grumble that leadership chose expedience over security. Whispers circulate that the Arkship is becoming a patchwork relic, rather than a beacon of endurance.

arkship.1090.a.zh: 一次难得的观察太空兽群行为的机会。
arkship.1090.a.en: A rare opportunity to observe space fauna behavior.

arkship.1090.desc.zh:
随着方舟舰[Root.GetName]继续漂流，观景台爆发出一阵欢呼。一群年幼的缇扬奇兽从附近经过，它们看起来心情很好，正在嬉戏。

它们以宽大的弧线相互穿梭，庞大的身躯彼此翻滚。透过宽阔的玻璃窗，这一景象令人着迷：巨大的身形漂浮在星辰之间，它们发光的身体闪烁着，仿佛在用只有它们才能理解的语言交流。整个家庭都挤满了甲板观看，暂时放下了他们的烦恼。这对所有年龄段的人来说都是一个真正的奇迹。
arkship.1090.desc.en:
As the Arkship [Root.GetName] continues to drift, the observation decks have erupted in delight. A pod of juvenile tiyanki has passed nearby, and they seem to be in a playful mood.

They weave around each other in broad, looping arcs, their vast forms tumbling around one another. From the wide glass panes, the sight is mesmerizing: colossal shapes floating among the stars, their luminous bodies glimmering while seemingly communicating in a language only they could understand. Entire families crowd the decks to watch, momentarily letting go of their burdens. It is a true wonder for all ages.

arkship.1095.desc.zh:
方舟号[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]对缇扬奇幼兽同样着迷。如此近距离观察这种行为几乎是前所未有的。我们的研究表明，这是一种社会现象，在缇扬奇深层栖息地以外很少观察到。

方舟号上的整体气氛现在变得更加轻松，仿佛动物们的喜悦渗透了整个船舱。
arkship.1095.desc.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] were no less enthralled by the Tiyanki calves. To witness such behavior at this proximity is almost unprecedented. Our studies suggest this was a social phenomenon that is rarely observed outside deep Tiyanki habitats.

The general atmosphere aboard the Arkship now feels lighter, as if the animals' joy permeates the hull.

arkship.110.desc.zh:
多余的等离子体已通过受控排放排出，在方舟舰的舰艉洒下灿烂的光幕。引擎压力已恢复至正常水平，未记录到永久性损伤。

不过，此次排放留下了一层宝贵的带电粒子残余物，其中大部分已被成功回收并汇入我们的储备。
arkship.110.desc.en:
The excess plasma was vented in a controlled discharge, spilling brilliant sheets of light across the Arkship's stern. Engine pressure has returned to acceptable levels, and no lasting damage was recorded.

The release did, however, leave behind a valuable residue of energized particles, much of which has been successfully recovered and routed into our reserves.

arkship.1100.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]方舟舰内部环境传感器测得空气中挥发性化合物含量升高。船员，特别是舰桥上的船员，报告了与轻度毒性接触相符的症状：恶心、定向障碍和持续性神经性疼痛。

尝试通过标准通风协议清除污染物并无效果。腐臭气味弥漫在走廊中，无法被过滤，并加剧了船员的不适。我们的工程报告还标记了飞船废物处理系统的不规则性，表明可能存在迫在眉睫的系统故障。

有必要迅速展开调查。
arkship.1100.desc.en:
Internal environmental sensors aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] have registered elevated levels of volatile airborne compounds. The crew, particularly those stationed on the bridge, have reported symptoms consistent with low-grade toxic exposure: nausea, disorientation, and persistent neuropathic pain.

Attempts to purge the contaminants via standard ventilation protocols have proven ineffective. A putrid odor fills the corridors, defying filtration and increasing crew discomfort. Irregularities in the ship's waste-disposal systems indicate the possibility of an imminent systemic malfunction.

Swift investigation is warranted.

arkship.1105.a.zh: 阻止它们的唯一方法是清除它们。烧死这些有害动物！
arkship.1105.a.en: The only way to stop them is to purge them. Burn the pests!

arkship.1105.c.zh: 我们要学会伴随这种气味生活。
arkship.1105.c.en: We shall learn to live with the smell.

arkship.1105.desc.zh:
我们对方舟舰的垃圾压实机进行了检查，发现有大量啮齿动物出没。这些啮齿动物表现出不规则的身体特征，表明发生了突变。样本的巨大体型令人不安。它们在接近时发出的尖叫声比基线物种明显更响亮。它们的体味特别浓烈，并且已观察到这些生物从许多结构凹槽中出现，表明它们已广泛分布在整个船只中。

这一发现引出了一个伦理问题：这些变异生物是应该作为危害被消灭，还是作为一种新形式的生命被保存。无论如何，我们都应该将它们从我们的通风系统中清除。
arkship.1105.desc.en:
Inspection of the Arkship's refuse compactor has revealed a significant rodent infestation. The rodentia display irregular physical characteristics, suggesting mutation. The sheer size of the specimens is troubling, and their screeching vocalizations when approached are markedly louder than baseline species. Their odor is especially pervasive, and the creatures have been observed emerging from numerous structural recesses, indicating a wide dispersal throughout the vessel.

This discovery raises an ethical question: whether these mutated organisms should be exterminated as a hazard, or preserved as a novel form of life. Either way, we should remove them from our ventilation system.

arkship.1110.a.zh: 至少侵染事件已经处理好了。
arkship.1110.a.en: At least the infestation has been taken care of.

arkship.1110.desc.zh:
我们方舟舰通风系统中的除害行动是有效的，但还是造成了一些负面后果。这些生物在净化之火中灭亡，它们刺耳的哀嚎声在走廊中回荡。在它们最后挣扎逃跑时，一些通风口瓷砖和维修面板被冲破，留下了需要修复的结构性缺口。

对飞船系统的直接威胁已解除。船员们现在可以感到一些安慰，因为飞船不再受到威胁。尽管气味仍然挥之不去。
arkship.1110.desc.en:
The purging of the infestation in our Arkship's ventilation systems was effective, though not without consequence. The creatures perished in the cleansing fires, their high-pitched distress calls echoing through the corridors. In their final efforts to escape, several ventilation tiles and maintenance panels were breached, leaving structural gaps that will require repair.

The immediate threat to ship systems has been neutralized. The crew can now take some comfort in the knowledge that the ship is no longer compromised. Although the smell still lingers.

arkship.1115.a.zh: 我们的垃圾，对它们来说可是珍宝。

arkship.1115.desc.zh:
我们对方舟舰[Root.GetName]上变异啮齿动物样本进行了检查，实验结果揭示了其非凡的适应性特征。这些生物展现出卓越的韧性，在对大多数生物而言致命的恶劣环境和资源匮乏的条件下可以茁壮成长。更重要的是，对照试验表明，当暴露于注入方舟舰废物流的特定化合物时，这些啮齿动物便不再产生其特有的难闻气味。相反，它们以显著的效率代谢废物，有效地减少了堆积的垃圾。

尽管非同寻常，这一发现表明，这种侵染的害虫可能会被重新归类为一种潜在的生态资产，而非负债。
arkship.1115.desc.en:
Examining the mutated rodent specimens on Arkship [Root.GetName] has uncovered remarkable adaptive traits. The creatures display exceptional resilience, thriving in hostile and resource-scarce environments that would prove fatal to most organisms. More significantly, controlled trials have demonstrated that, when exposed to a targeted compound introduced into the Arkship's waste stream, the rodents cease producing their characteristic odor. Instead, they metabolize refuse with notable efficiency, effectively reducing accumulated waste.

While unconventional, this discovery suggests that the infestation may be reclassified as a potential ecological asset rather than a liability.

arkship.1120.b.zh: 出于好意，永久密封面板。

arkship.1120.desc.zh:
一群青少年在游荡于方舟舰人迹罕至的区域时，发现了一个松动的金属检修面板。打开面板后，他们进入了方舟舰[Root.GetName]中一个未被记录的次级甲板区域。在此后的几个小时里，内部追踪系统和环境监测系统均无法探测到这群青少年的踪迹。

当他们返回时，这些年轻的探险者表现出明显的心理和生理创伤迹象。有些人一直在胡言乱语与近乎木僵的状态之间反复切换。然而，尽管经过多次尝试，他们都拒绝提供任何关于此次事件经历的陈述。

专家认为，无论在那个次级甲板层区域发生了什么，其严重程度都足以使其被刻意从所有记录中抹除。
arkship.1120.desc.en:
While straying in one of the Arkship's less-frequented sections, a group of juveniles identified a dislodged metallic access panel. Opening it, they entered an undocumented sub-level of Arkship [Root.GetName]. For several hours thereafter, the group ceased to register on all internal tracking and environmental monitoring systems.

When they returned, the juvenile explorers displayed clear signs of psychological and physical distress. Some fluctuated between incoherent babbling and a near catatonic state. However, despite repeated attempts, they have all refused to provide any account of their experiences during the incident.

Experts believe that whatever occurred in that sub-level was severe enough to have been deliberately excised from all records.

arkship.1125.desc.zh:
在进入新发现的甲板层后，研究团队发现了一系列由手动转轮密封的沉重库门。门的那一头传来了扭曲的声音，听起来像是遥远的尖叫。

我们的研究团队合全队之力才强行打开了这些大门，这期间一直有震耳欲聋的巨响。声音的源头经证实是一台严重损耗的供电机，尽管早已超过了使用寿命，它仍在艰苦地运转。更令人不安的是，该区域各处散布着新鲜的活动痕迹。

这个设施并未被废弃，而现在的居住者已经知道我们来了。
arkship.1125.desc.en:
Beyond the newly accessed level, the research team found a series of heavy vault doors sealed by a manual wheel. From the other side came a distorted sound like distant screeching.

Forcing the doors open required the full strength of the team and produced a deafening clamor. The source proved to be a severely degraded power generator, still grinding far beyond its intended lifespan. More troubling were the fresh traces of activity scattered throughout the sector.

The facility is not abandoned, and whoever resides here now knows we have arrived.

arkship.1130.a.zh: 让我们看看能从他们身上学到什么。
arkship.1130.a.en: Let's see what we can learn from them.

arkship.1130.a.military.zh: 把这整个地方烧成平地。
arkship.1130.a.military.en: Burn this whole place to the ground

arkship.1130.desc.zh:
进入库房后，小队发现了明显的长期居住迹象。墙边排列着简陋的铺盖，旁边是装满回收材料的临时储物容器，这表明此处是一个有组织且存续了很长时间的据点，而非临时避难所。

小队很快遇到了从阴影中走出的身影。他们与我们同属一个物种，却显得萎缩：形容枯槁、衣衫褴褛，手持粗糙的武器。他们操着一种扭曲、古老的方言，虽能听出源自我们的语言，却已面目全非。冲突险些爆发。

证据表明，他们已被封锁在此数代之久。他们是某项被遗忘实验的受试者吗？是某种现已无人知晓的惩罚的继承者？还是更离奇的存在，为了某种早已失落的目的而被封存于黑暗之中？
arkship.1130.desc.en:
When entering the vault, the team encountered clear signs of prolonged habitation. Improvised sleeping arrangements lined the walls, alongside makeshift storage containers filled with salvaged materials, suggesting an organized and sustained presence rather than a temporary shelter.

The team soon encountered figures emerging from the shadows. They were of our own species, yet diminished: gaunt, poorly clothed, armed with crude weapons. They spoke in a warped, archaic dialect unmistakably rooted in our own language. Conflict was narrowly averted.

Evidence suggests they had been sealed here for generations. Were they subjects of some forgotten experiment? The heirs to a punishment no one now remembers? Or something stranger still, preserved in darkness for a purpose long since lost?

arkship.1135.desc.zh:
到达后，电梯门在一条黑暗的走廊前打开，两旁堆满了因仓促撤离而被遗弃的陈旧机器。过时的实验室设备散落一地，烧瓶中仍密封着无法归入任何已知分类的生物样本。残缺不全的紧急协议中提及了一次失败的遏制，最终导致灾难性的结果。

在更深处，团队发现了我们物种一位远古祖先的干枯遗骸。尸体虽然皱缩，却呈现出一种不寻常的完好状态，其腐败过程被一种人造生物剂所遏制。这一发现或许解释了为何早期的方舟舰领导层选择封锁整个楼层。
arkship.1135.desc.en:
Upon arrival, the elevator doors opened onto a dark corridor lined with obsolete machinery, abandoned in haste. Outdated lab equipment lay scattered, flasks still sealed around biological samples that match no known classification. Fragmentary emergency protocols reference a catastrophic containment failure.

Deeper within, the team found the desiccated remains of a distant ancestor of our species. The body was shriveled yet unnaturally preserved, its decay arrested by an engineered biological agent. Such a discovery might explain why earlier Arkship leadership chose to seal the entire level.

arkship.1140.desc.zh:
进入该层后，团队立即报告感受到了心理上的压抑。这个地方最初看起来像是一处拘留区，实则更接近一座被遗弃的精神病院。走廊两旁排列着加固的牢房，地板上固定着束缚具。诊断设备与刑罚工具融合在一起，模糊了治疗与惩罚之间的界限。

证据表明，我们的祖先是有意选择埋葬这个地方的。出于羞耻或是为了保护后人，他们将其从记忆中抹去。也许他们认为，遗忘才是更安全的做法。
arkship.1140.desc.en:
Upon entering the level, the team reported immediate psychological distress. What first appeared to be a detention block proved closer to an abandoned asylum. Reinforced cells lined the corridors, restraints bolted into the floors. Diagnostic equipment stood fused with instruments of coercion, blurring any distinction between care and punishment.

The evidence suggests our ancestors chose to bury this place deliberately. Whether from shame or a desire to protect those who came after, they erased it from memory. Perhaps they believed it safer forgotten.

arkship.1145.a.zh: 将水晶和雕像一并打包带走。
arkship.1145.a.en: Take the crystals and the statue.

arkship.1145.desc.zh:
电梯门开启，映入眼帘的是一座巨大的陈列馆，两旁排列着风格各异的雕像。有些雕像优雅大方，有些则怪诞诡异，它们全部伫立在大理石底座上，仿佛在沉默地审视着闯入者。

在破碎的展柜和崩塌的板壁后，团队发现了一间密室，里面堆满了保存完好的稀有水晶。一座高大的白色雕像守卫着这批财宝。当团队成员移动时，那张酷似我们族类的面孔似乎在跟随着他们的身影。尽管起初团队成员觉得取走水晶无异于偷窃，但很快我们便对这座雕像产生了一种奇特的喜爱之情。
arkship.1145.desc.en:
The elevator opened onto a vast gallery lined with statues of varied make and style. Some were elegant, others grotesque, all mounted on marble pedestals and turned toward the intruders in silent appraisal.

Behind shattered cases and crumbling panels, the team uncovered a hidden chamber packed with carefully preserved Rare Crystals. A tall white statue stood watch over the hoard. As they moved, its face, shaped just like one of our kind, seemed to follow. Despite the team's initial sense that removing the crystals bordered on theft, we quickly developed a peculiar fondness for the statue.

arkship.115.desc.gestalt.zh:
在过去的六个月里，维护子个体在不间断地运行，以使方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在发动机持续运转的情况下，检修面板被拆除，冷却液管道被重新布线，受损的调节器也得到了更换。

虽然该行动需要子个体在多个系统子模块中持续作业，但这一过程也揭示了发动机组件中的几处结构性缺陷。这些问题现已得到修正，整体运行效率有了显著提升。无论虚空带来怎样的压力，我们都将适应。
arkship.115.desc.gestalt.en:
For the past six months, maintenance drones have operated without interruption to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were removed, coolant conduits rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.

Though the operation required sustained drone activity across multiple subsystems, the process revealed several structural inefficiencies in the engine assembly. These have now been corrected, and overall operational efficiency has measurably improved. Whatever stresses the void may impose, we will adapt.

arkship.115.desc.regular.zh:
在过去的六个月里，[Root.GetName]上的维修人员马不停蹄地工作，力求让方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在引擎持续运行的情况下，他们拆除了检修面板，重新布置了冷却管线，并更换了受损的调节器。

这些努力目前已经稳定了驱动核心，负责这项工作的船员们为此忍受了长时间的轮班和恶劣的工作环境。尽管疲惫不堪，但士气依然高涨。无论虚空给我们将带来什么，我们都有信心能够承受。
arkship.115.desc.regular.en:
For the past six months, repair crews on [Root.GetName] have worked without pause to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were stripped away, coolant lines rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.

The effort has stabilized the drive core for now, though the crews responsible endured long shifts and harsh working conditions to make it happen. Despite their exhaustion, morale is high. Whatever the void throws at us, we are confident we can endure it.

arkship.1150.desc.zh:
这层空间回荡着机械的轰鸣声。装配线仍在开足马力运转，将废料锻造成引擎，却在最后阶段又将其拆解，使产出物回归为原始金属。这种循环毫无意义地重复着。

在更深处，一个制造单元正超负荷运作，组装起机器人骨架并为其安装处理器核心。每一个构装体都在激活后的瞬间崩塌，其结构极不稳定。有些在归于沉寂前闪烁着短暂而令人不安的意识迹象，而大多数则自行启动了关机程序。
arkship.1150.desc.en:
The level roared with machinery. Assembly lines still ran at full capacity, forging scrap into engines, only to dismantle them in the final stage and return the output to raw metal. The cycle repeated without purpose.

Deeper inside, a fabrication unit operated beyond safe limits, assembling robotic frames and fitting them with processing cores. Each construct collapsed moments after activation, its form structurally unsound. Some flickered with brief, unsettling signs of awareness before falling still. Most initiated their own shutdown sequences.

arkship.1160.b.zh: 让我们尽可能的收集讯息。

arkship.1160.desc.zh:
我们在方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的仪器记录到了来自[solar_system.GetName]星系黑洞的异常辐射。远距离扫描捕捉到一个不明物体正接近奇点。那艘巨大的舰船发出的技术信号远超我们的理解，干扰了我们的读数，导致无法进行精确分析。视觉确认也极其短暂，与其说是实物，倒不如说更像是一场幻觉。

在那艘船进入未知领域的前一刻，我们观察到了一个诡异的景象：船只完好无损地穿过了黑洞，且显然是有意为之。随后，所有信号都消失了。该船是被摧毁了、位移了，还是以某种无法理解的状态幸存下来，仍然不得而知。可以确定的是，黑洞产生了反应，而我们可能瞥见了一些尚无法解释的东西。无论在那道视界线上发生了什么，显而易见的是，这次观测并非没有带给我们任何改变。
arkship.1160.desc.en:
Our instruments aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] registered anomalous emissions from the black hole in the [solar_system.GetName] system. Long-range scans detected the glimpse of an unidentified object approaching the singularity. Their immense vessel emitted technological signatures far beyond our understanding, interfering with our readings and rendering precise analysis impossible. Visual confirmation was fleeting at best, resembling a hallucination more than anything tangible.

Moments before the vessel crossed into the unknown, we observe a strange sight: the ship passing through the black hole intact, clearly intentionally. Then, all signals ceased. Whether the vessel was destroyed, displaced, or survived in some incomprehensible state remains unknown. What is certain is that the black hole reacted, and we may have glimpsed something we cannot yet explain. Whatever transpired at that horizon, it is clear that we have not emerged from this observation unchanged.

arkship.1165.b.zh: 可悲。他们耗费资源，只为获得片刻的完整感。
arkship.1165.b.en: Pathetic. They burn resources to feel briefly whole.

arkship.1165.c.zh: 出乎意料，但并不令人讨厌。

arkship.1165.d.zh: 他们虽缺乏统一，却向往统一。
arkship.1165.d.en: They lack unity, yet strive toward it.

arkship.1165.desc.zh:
在经过[solar_system.GetName]星系内的一颗殖民星球时，我们观察到其背阳面爆发了同步的光束。一开始我们怀疑有动乱爆发，后来被证明这种担忧是多余的。这些爆发的光束是受控的、遍及全球的烟火表演，完全处于非军事参数范围之内。

进一步的分析显示，这场盛景是在刻意与某种天文信号进行对齐。我们可以有把握地得出结论：当地居民正在用光编码信息。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]记录了这些模式，从而对大规模协作和符号化交流有了更深入的了解。
arkship.1165.desc.en:
While passing a colonized world in the [solar_system.GetName] system, we observed its nightside erupt in synchronized bursts of light. Initial fears of unrest proved unfounded. The emissions were controlled, planet-wide pyrotechnic displays, well within non-military parameters.

Closer analysis revealed deliberate astronomical alignments woven into the spectacle. It feels safe to conclude that the inhabitants are encoding meaning in light. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have documented the patterns, gaining insight into large-scale coordination and symbolic communication.

arkship.1165.e.zh: 明亮的光容易成为目标。

arkship.1165.f.zh: 我们为他们的庆祝感到由衷的高兴。

arkship.1165.i.zh: 想办法将这份记录变现。

arkship.1165.k.zh: 无关紧要，但却有点乐子。

arkship.1165.l.zh: 愿火焰启迪他们的心灵。
arkship.1165.l.en: May the fire enlighten their spirits.

arkship.1170.a.zh: 我们应该研究它的成分。

arkship.1170.b.zh: 让我们看看能采集到什么。
arkship.1170.b.en: Let's see what we can harvest.

arkship.1170.desc.zh:
在穿过[solar_system.GetName]星系的行星带时，我们观察到在碎片中漂浮着几个闪烁着微光的天体。初步扫描显示它们是形状不规则的小行星，但通过进一步的近距离观察，我们发现它们存在层状的鳞片式结构，这些结构在恒星光芒的照射下反射出不断变幻的色带。

进一步的分析表明，这些碎片部分源自矿物，部分源自生物。它们看起来像是一头以太巨龙的残骸，这头巨龙似乎被一颗小行星撞击，在离开该星系之前失去了部分装甲外皮。星光照耀在这些被丢弃的鳞片上，将棱镜般的七彩光芒洒落在方舟舰上。
arkship.1170.desc.en:
While passing through the planetary belt in the [solar_system.GetName] system, we observed several faintly shimmering objects drifting among the debris. Initial scans suggested irregular asteroids, but closer inspection revealed layered, scale-like structures reflecting stellar light in shifting bands of color.

Further analysis indicates these fragments were partly mineral in origin, partly biological. It seemed to be remnants of an Ether Drake that appeared to have been hit by an asteroid and lost part of its armored hide before leaving the system. Starlight catches the discarded scales, scattering prismatic light across the Arkship.

arkship.1175.desc.zh:
在研究这些散落的鳞片时，我们注意到了这种材料超乎寻常的韧性。其复杂的层状结构揭示了生物生长与天然装甲工程的融合，远超我们之前的设想。鳞片的叠层成分对高温、动能冲击和能量释放表现出了卓越的抵抗力。

我们尝试复制了这种装甲板并将其嵌入方舟舰的外壳中，从而增强其防御能力。曾经身为游荡巨龙的盔甲，如今将为我们的知识所用，在虚空等待着的重重危险中保护我们。
arkship.1175.desc.en:
While studying the scattered scales, we noted the extraordinary resilience of the material. The complex, layered structure reveals a fusion of biological growth and natural armor engineering far beyond our previous assumptions. The scales' layered composition exhibits remarkable resistance to heat, kinetic impact, and energy discharge.

We experimented with replicating the plating and inserted it into the Arkship's outer hull, where we can enhance its defensive capacity. What once was the armor of a roaming drake will now serve our knowledge to shield us against the many dangers that await in the void.

arkship.1180.a.zh: 渠道极不寻常，利润极其丰厚。
arkship.1180.a.en: A fine profit from a most unusual source.

arkship.1180.b.zh: 谁能想到传奇竟然如此赚钱？
arkship.1180.b.en: Who knew legends could be so lucrative?

arkship.1180.desc.zh:
位于[solar_system.GetName]星系中漂浮的以太巨龙的龙鳞碎片引起了广泛关注。

这些鳞片经过清洗和精心打磨后，被制作成了引人注目的装饰品。这些传奇生物的遗骸一经上市便拍出了极高的价格，事实证明它们既令人惊叹又利润丰厚。
arkship.1180.desc.en:
The drifting fragments of Ether Drake scales in the [solar_system.GetName] system have attracted significant attention.

The scales were cleaned and carefully polished before being crafted into striking ornamental pieces. Once offered on the market, these relics of a legendary creature fetched an exceptionally high price, proving very impressive and profitable.

arkship.1185.desc.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上正在开展常规审计，结果发现了货物记录中存在差异。

监控录像显示，方舟舰居民中已经形成了一个非正式的交换网络。一个以物易物的系统在船员和定居者之间悄然兴起。易腐物品、工具、奢侈品和个人服务在监控有限的僻静角落被进行交易。

这一发现引发了一些令人不安的问题。有人赞赏其中展现出的聪明才智；而另一些人则警告说，方舟舰上的任何监管疏忽都可能带来严重的风险。
arkship.1185.desc.en:
A routine audit aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] has uncovered discrepancies in our cargo records.

Security footage indicates the formation of an informal exchange network among the Arkship's residents. A barter system has quietly emerged among crew and civilians. Perishables, tools, luxury goods, and personal services are traded in secluded corners where surveillance is limited.

The discovery raises uncomfortable questions. Some admire the ingenuity on display. Others warn that any lapse in oversight aboard an Arkship could carry serious risks.

arkship.1190.desc.zh:
方舟舰内部的非法以物易物网络已被证明极其稳定。尽管缺乏官方监管，该网络通过信任和相互依赖实现了自我调节。纠纷鲜少发生，且在方舟舰正式分配系统难以维持进度时，必需品仍能持续流通。通过将此类交易合法化并建立清晰的界限，方舟舰在其内部接纳了有限的自由市场。

对许多居民而言，这一改变不仅提供了获取商品的途径，还赋予了他们在方舟舰庞大体制内的自主权、责任感以及焕发出的使命感。
arkship.1190.desc.en:
The unauthorized barter network within the Arkship has proven remarkably stable. Despite the lack of official oversight, the network has regulated itself through trust and mutual dependence. Disputes are rare, and essential goods continue to circulate where the Arkship's formal distribution systems struggle to keep pace. By legalizing the exchanges and establishing clear boundaries, the Arkship embraced a limited free market within its walls.

For many residents, the change offers more than access to goods. It provides agency, responsibility, and a renewed sense of purpose within the vast machinery of the Arkship.

arkship.1195.desc.zh:
该非法市场已成功关闭。我们的安保团队已开始拆除相关网络。用于交易的储物柜已被封存，且低能见度区域的监控范围也已扩大。那些组织交易的人员已被正式调岗或受到纪律处分。

虽然这种以物易物的网络曾给部分居民带来了一种自主感和机遇感，但方舟舰的设计初衷绝非支持非官方的分配方式。在一艘每一份资源都必须记录在案的舰船上，管控与可预测性始终是重中之重。
arkship.1195.desc.en:
The unauthorized market was shut down successfully. Our security teams have begun dismantling the network. Storage lockers used for trading have been sealed, and surveillance expanded in the low-visibility areas. Those organizing exchanges have been formally reassigned or received disciplinary actions.

While the barter network had provided some residents with a sense of autonomy and opportunity, the Arkship was never designed to support unofficial means of distribution. On a vessel where every resource must be accounted for, control and predictability remain of highest importance.

arkship.120.desc.zh:
发动机按受控阶段逐步关停，以便我们的工程师在安全条件下检查驱动组件并重新校准其调节系统。虽然这一过程延误了行程，但关停期间收集的数据已证明具有重要价值。

我们已查明[Root.GetName]核心定序中的几处效率低下问题。通过重定向多余能量并加固结构支撑，我们增强了方舟舰的护盾与船壳，使其足以抵御未来的压力。
arkship.120.desc.en:
The engines were brought down in controlled stages, allowing our engineers to inspect the drive assembly under safe conditions and recalibrate its regulation systems. The process delayed us, but the data gathered during the shutdown has already proven valuable.

Several inefficiencies in the core sequencing on [Root.GetName] have been identified. By redirecting surplus energy and reinforcing structural supports, our we have strengthened both the Arkship's shields and hull against future strain.

arkship.1200.a.en: If trade flows, so will revenue.

arkship.1200.b.en: Taxation is the price of prosperity.

arkship.1200.desc.zh:
方舟舰维护通道内的以物易物网络展现出了惊人的效率。货物持续通过非官方渠道流通，填补了方舟舰配给系统中微小但持续存在的缺口。

某些中间人已受到秘密接触，他们通过提供合作来换取免受执法干扰。每笔交易中都有一小部分份额流入了我们的官方账户。对居民而言，该市场仍处于非官方状态，且在很大程度上避开了当局的视线。然而在实际操作中，其流量均在严密监控之下，且利润丰厚。
arkship.1200.desc.en:
The barter network operating within the Arkship's maintenance corridors has proven surprisingly efficient. Goods continue to circulate through unofficial channels, filling small but persistent gaps in the Arkship's distribution systems.

Certain intermediaries have been discreetly approached and offered protection from enforcement in return for cooperation. A modest share of each transaction now finds its way back into our official accounts. To the residents, the market remains unofficial and largely invisible to authority. In practice, however, its flows are carefully observed and surprisingly profitable.

arkship.1205.a.en: Attempt to recover the archived data.

arkship.1205.desc.zh:
在方舟舰[Root.GetName]储存库的最深处，档案管理员们在被遗忘已久的库存中发现了一个密封的小箱子。里面装有一枚不起眼的微芯片，虽有记录但从未被妥善索引。如果它真的具有什么价值，大概也就不会被遗忘在储存箱里了。

这项技术已严重过时，所使用的数位格式甚至早于方舟舰载系统好几代。一些人推测，它可能源自航行初期，甚至可能追溯到我们的种族还生活在行星表面上的时代。
arkship.1205.desc.en:
Deep within the Arkship [Root.GetName] storage archives, archivists have uncovered a small sealed case buried among long-forgotten inventory. Inside was a single unremarkable microchip, catalogued but never properly indexed. If it had possessed any real value, it would likely not have ended up forgotten in a storage crate.

The technology was severely outdated, using data formats that predate several generations of Arkship systems. Some speculate that it may originate from the early days of the journey, perhaps even from the era when our species still lived on a planetary surface.

arkship.1210.desc.a.zh:
数据经恢复后，展示了一个古老的季节性庆典，它可以追溯到我们过往在行星上生活的岁月。它似乎是为了标记寒冷月份的流逝和自然的苏醒。社群成员聚集在一起，迎接温暖与光明的回归。人们点燃篝火，在参与者之间散播鲜艳的色彩。记录还描述了分享特制的甜点、共同歌舞，以及静静观赏季节中首批花朵绽放的情景。

尽管这种季节性变化在方舟号上已不复存在，但这些碎片让我们得以一窥祖先们曾经如何庆祝这一节日。
arkship.1210.desc.a.en:
The recovered data shows an old seasonal celebration from our planetary past. It appears to have marked the passing of the colder months and the awakening of nature. Communities gathered to welcome the return of warmth and light. Bonfires were lit, bright colors were spread among participants. The records also describe the sharing of special sweets, singing and dancing together, and simply watching the first blooms of the season as they appeared.

Though such seasonal changes no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the fragments offer a small glimpse into how our ancestors once celebrated this fetsivity.

arkship.1210.desc.aquatic.mulluscoid.zh:
回收的微芯片描述了我们的水生祖先在母星深海中延续的一种传统。个体们会聚集在一起，共同潜入比平时栖息地更深的水域。这些潜水活动既是挑战也是庆典。深水区存在着奇异的地质结构和陌生、甚至危险的生命形式，使下潜过程充满了刺激与危险。那些抵达最深处的人往往会受到众人的钦佩。

方舟舰上的水生生境受到严格监管，深度因工程限制而受限。古老海洋那巨大的压力和无尽的黑暗已无法再亲身体验。
arkship.1210.desc.aquatic.mulluscoid.en:
The recovered microchip describes a tradition practiced by our aquatic ancestors in the depths of their world's oceans. Individuals would gather to descend together into deeper waters than normally inhabited. These dives were both a challenge and a celebration. The deeper zones contained strange geological formations and unfamiliar, sometimes even dangerous life forms, making the descent both thrilling and dangerous. Those who reached the greatest depths were often regarded with admiration.

Water habitats on the Arkship are carefully regulated and depth is limited by engineering constraints. The vast pressures and endless darkness of the ancient oceans can no longer be experienced.

arkship.1210.desc.arthropoid.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了一项与我们祖先生命周期中的自然阶段紧密相连的传统。记录显示，在个体脱落旧外骨骼期间，人们会举行集体聚会。这些蜕皮阶段并非在隔离中进行，而是通常以仪式作为标志，旧皮有时会被装饰或保存，作为成长与新生的象征。一旦旧壳脱落，新形成的外骨骼便会被自豪地展示出来。

在方舟号上，蜕皮周期通常在受控的生物设施中管理，以确保安全与效率，并配备工作人员以应对任何可能出现的并发症。
arkship.1210.desc.arthropoid.en:
The recovered entry from the microchip describes a tradition tied to a natural stage in the life cycle of our ancestors. They show communal gatherings during periods when individuals shed their old exoskeletons. Rather than occurring in isolation, these molting phases were often marked by ceremony and the old skin was sometimes decorated or preserved as symbols of growth and renewal. Once the old shells were shed, the newly formed exoskeletons were displayed with pride.

Aboard the Arkship, molting cycles are typically managed in controlled biological facilities to ensure safety and efficiency with staff to help if any possible complications occur.

arkship.1210.desc.avian.reptilian.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录展示了我们的祖先曾举行的一种繁育仪式。那是一场向社区展示首窝卵的聚会。在家族成员和见证者的注视下，卵被小心地放置在准备好的筑巢空间内。仪式使用了装饰性的筑巢材料和具有象征意义的贝壳排列，并举行公共宴会以庆祝血脉的延续。

值得注意的是，记录表明这些产卵仪式曾经持续数周，涉及漫长的仪式和准备工作。相比之下，方舟舰上的此类事务处理得既迅速又私密，如今只需花费几个小时进行精心管理的流程即可完成。
arkship.1210.desc.avian.reptilian.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip shows of a reproductive ceremony once practiced by our ancestors. It was a gathering during which the first clutch of eggs was presented to the community. The eggs were carefully placed within prepared nesting spaces while family members and witnesses observed. Decorative nesting materials were used as well as a symbolic arrangements of shells, and communal feasts celebrating the continuation of the lineage.

Notably, the records indicate that these egg-laying ceremonies once lasted weeks, involving extended rituals and preparations. By comparison, such matters aboard the Arkship are handled quickly and privately, nowadays it occupies little more than a few hours of carefully managed procedure.

arkship.1210.desc.b.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的条目描述了一个与年度周期交替相关的季节性庆典。它发生在一年中最黑暗的时期，那时白昼稀少，寒冷笼罩着星球的大部分地区。社区通过用灯光装饰房屋和公共场所来应对，将漫漫长夜变得明亮且富有节日气氛。人们聚集在一起交换礼物，分享异常丰盛的美食。

方舟舰上已不再有这样的冬天，这些数据展示了我们的祖先曾经如何用温暖与光亮回应最黑暗的季节。
arkship.1210.desc.b.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip describes a seasonal celebration tied to the changing of the year's cycle. It took place during the darkest period of the year, when daylight was scarce and colder conditions dominated much of the planet. Communities responded by decorating their homes and public spaces with lights, turning the long nights into something bright and festive. People gathered to exchange gifts and share unusually rich foods.

Such winters no longer exist aboard the Arkship, the data shows how our ancestors once answered the darkest season with warmth and light.

arkship.1210.desc.c.zh:
该条目似乎描述了曾经在我们母星上很常见的一种个人庆祝活动。记录提到，这是一个标志着个人年度生命周期更迭的时刻。在这一天，家人和朋友会聚集在一起，为该成员及其度过的岁月举杯欢庆。这一传统似乎还包括共同分享专为此活动准备的食物。

尽管方舟舰上的生活如今遵循着不同的节奏，但记录表明，我们的祖先曾经每年都会停下脚步，在众生之中为每一个独立生命的延续而庆祝。
arkship.1210.desc.c.en:
The entry appears to describe a personal celebration once common on our homeworld. The records refer to an occasion marking the passing of an individual's yearly life cycle. On this day, family and friends would gather to celebrate the person and the years they had lived. The tradition seems to have involved sharing sustenance together specifically prepared for the event.

Though life aboard the Arkship now follows different rhythms, the records suggest that our ancestors once paused each year to celebrate the continuation of a single life among many.

arkship.1210.desc.d.zh:
修复后的微芯片似乎揭示了标记新年度周期开始的庆祝活动。我们的祖先首先会打扫他们的居住空间。随着太阳周期更替的临近，各个社区聚集在一起，为最后的时刻进行倒计时。新周期的到来伴随着明亮的灯光、舞蹈和广泛的庆祝。参与者还会记录下对来年的个人意向，即旨在指导未来行动和改进的“决心”。

尽管方舟舰上的生活现在遵循严格监管的周期而非行星历法，但数据表明，我们的祖先曾如何以对未来的持续希望来标记时间的流逝。
arkship.1210.desc.d.en:
The recovered microchip appears to reveal celebrations marking the beginning of a new yearly cycle. Our ancestors would first clean their living spaces. As the renewal of the sun cycle approached, communities gathered to count down the final moments. The arrival of the new cycle was greeted with bright lights, dancing, and widespread celebration. Participants also recorded personal intentions for the coming year, resolutions meant to guide their actions and improvements in the time ahead.

Though life aboard the Arkship now follows carefully regulated cycles rather than planetary calendars, the data shows how our ancestors once marked the passing of time with a continuous hope for the future.

arkship.1210.desc.e.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的条目描述了一种以两人正式结合为中心的社会传统。根据记录，社群成员会聚集在一起，见证两人公开向彼此表达承诺。这些仪式通常涉及象征性的服饰、口头誓言，以及作为见证人出席的亲朋好友。

虽然方舟舰上的伴侣关系通常是通过行政系统记录，而非通过繁复的仪式，但档案显示，我们的祖先曾以隆重的仪式和全社群的庆祝来纪念此类结合。
arkship.1210.desc.e.en:
The entry recovered from the microchip describes a social tradition centered on the formal union of two individuals. According to the records, communities gathered to witness the pair publicly declare their commitment to one another. These ceremonies often involved symbolic clothing, spoken vows, and the presence of family and friends acting as witnesses.

 While partnerships aboard the Arkship are often recorded through administrative systems rather than elaborate rituals, the archive suggests that our ancestors once marked such unions with considerable ceremony and communal celebration.

arkship.1210.desc.f.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了曾在家园行星上庆祝的一个热闹节日。参与者身着精致的服饰并佩戴面具，在庆典期间暂时换上新的身份。数据中还提到了有组织的游行，装饰华丽的平台在公共空间缓缓移动，人群则跟随其后，载歌载舞。

相比之下，方舟舰上的庆祝活动要克制得多，受限于值勤周期和有限的资源。记录表明，在另一个时代，我们的祖先偶尔会抛开实用主义，转而追求场面与纵情。
arkship.1210.desc.f.en:
The record recovered from the microchip describes a lively festival once celebrated on our homeworld. Participants dressed in elaborate costumes and masks, temporarily adopting new identities for the celebration. The data also references organized processions, decorated platforms moving through public spaces while crowds followed while dancing and cheering.

Celebrations aboard the Arkship are far more restrained by comparison, shaped by duty cycles and limited resources. The records suggest that, in another time, our ancestors occasionally set practicality aside in favor of spectacle and indulgence.

arkship.1210.desc.fungoid.plantoid.zh:
从微芯片中恢复的记录描述了我们的祖先在繁茂生长期延续的一种公社传统。记录中提到，人们会在茂密的树丛中聚集，培育奇特而鲜艳的果实植物，各群体之间会互相走访，观摩那些格外引人注目的生长成果。不同品种被排列在一起，构成了色彩、质感与气味交织出的复杂而生动的图案。为了在聚会期间促成稀有或奇特的花朵绽放，祖先们还会刻意改变湿度、养分和光照。

方舟舰上的生活几乎没有空间进行这种自发的耕作。如今，生长周期由农业系统严格监管，大多数菌株的优化目标是效率而非表达。
arkship.1210.desc.fungoid.plantoid.en:
The record recovered from the microchip describes a communal tradition practiced by our ancestors during periods of abundant growth. The records refer to gatherings in dense groves where individuals would cultivate unusual and vibrant fruiting plants with colonies visiting one another to observe particularly impressive growths. Different strains were arranged together to create elaborate living patterns of color, texture, and scent. Our ancestors would deliberately alter humidity, nutrients, and light to encourage rare or unusual blooms during the gathering.

Life aboard the Arkship leaves little room for such spontaneous cultivation. Growth cycles are now carefully regulated by agricultural systems, and most fungal strains are optimized for efficiency rather than expression.

arkship.1210.desc.g.zh:
这枚微芯片揭示了一项来自我们物种行星时代的季节性节日记录。它似乎是在收获季节结束时举行的，当时各个社群聚集在一起，为一年中采集到的食物表达感激之情。这场庆典也标志着一年中阴暗时期的临近，届时白昼将变得稀缺，寒冷的气候亦会回归。参与者们身着令人不安的伪装，或许是为了模仿或驱散想象中的灵体。

尽管方舟号的农业周期经过精心调节，我们也不再需要这些传统，但档案表明，我们的祖先曾以感恩、创意和一丝顽皮来纪念季节的更迭。
arkship.1210.desc.g.en:
The microchip revealed the record of a seasonal festival from our species' planetary era. It appears to have been held at the end of the harvesting season, when communities gathered to give thanks for the food collected during the year. The celebration also marked the approach of a darker time of year, when daylight would grow scarce and colder conditions returned. Participants dressed in unsettling disguises, perhaps to imitate or ward off imagined spirits.

Though the Arkship's agricultural cycles are carefully regulated, and we do not have any need for these traditions, the archive suggests that our ancestors once marked the changing seasons with gratitude, creativity, and a touch of mischief.

arkship.1210.desc.h.zh:
微芯片揭示了一份文化记录。它展示了一种以缅怀逝者为中心的传统。根据数据显示，社群会为去世的亲友设立小型展示台，并用鲜花、食物以及与逝者相关的个人物品进行装饰。这种场合并非在沉默中哀悼，而似乎既有反思，又带有庆祝的色彩。

虽然方舟舰上的世代表更迭已经改变了我们纪念死者的方式，但记录表明，我们的祖先曾经不仅拨出时间来悲伤，也用来庆祝那些塑造了生者的生命。
arkship.1210.desc.h.en:
The microchip revealed a cultural record. It showed a tradition centered on remembering those who had passed away. According to the data, communities would create small displays dedicated to deceased relatives and friends, decorating them with flowers, food, and personal items connected to the departed. Rather than mourning in silence, the occasion appears to have been both reflective and celebratory.

Though generations aboard the Arkship have changed how we remember the dead, the records suggest that our ancestors once set aside time to grieve, but also to celebrate the lives that shaped those who remained.

arkship.1210.desc.infernal.zh:
回收的记录描述了我们祖先传承的一项古老传统。档案中记载，人们会聚集在受控的活火坑周围，刻意将自己暴露在酷热之中，以此展示韧性与生命力。参与者将火焰塑造成复杂的图案，并向其中添加稀有气体和燃料，使火焰呈现出异乎寻常的色彩。随着火势升高，观察者们会吟唱并欢庆，将这一盛事视作奇观与集体仪式。

在方舟舰上，明火受到严格管控，因为它们会对基础设施造成高度风险。
arkship.1210.desc.infernal.en:
The recovered records describe an ancient tradition practiced by our ancestors. The archive describes gatherings around controlled pits of living flame, where individuals would deliberately expose themselves to intense heat as a demonstration of resilience and vitality. Participants shaped the flames into elaborate patterns, feeding them with rare gases and fuels that caused the fire to burn in unusual colors. Observers would chant and celebrate as the flames rose higher, marking the event as both spectacle and communal ritual.

Aboard the Arkship, open flame is strictly regulated as they cause a high risk to infrastructure.

arkship.1210.desc.lithoid.zh:
恢复的记录描述了我们祖先曾践行的一种充满活力的传统。根据记载，成群的人会聚集在开阔的岩石地带，进行有组织的掷石决斗。参与者互相投掷松散的石块，试图从对手的外层击碎或削下碎片。在冲突中掉落的小碎片有时会被收集起来作为纪念品，象征着韧性与友好的竞争。

在方舟舰上，此类活动显然会对基础设施构成威胁。船体完整性协议严禁投掷石块，这些竞赛早已从日常生活中消失。
arkship.1210.desc.lithoid.en:
The recovered entry describes an energetic tradition practiced by our ancestors. According to the records, large groups would gather in open rocky fields to engage in organized stone fights. Participants hurled loose rocks at one another while attempting to crack or chip pieces from their opponents' outer layers. Small fragments broken off during the clashes were sometimes collected as keepsakes, symbols of resilience and friendly rivalry.

Aboard the Arkship, such activities would pose an obvious risk to infrastructure. Hull integrity protocols strongly discourage the throwing of rocks, and these contests have long since disappeared from daily life.

arkship.1210.desc.mammalian.zh:
修复后的记录描述了一项围绕后代早期成长的传统。根据记载，当幼小的个体在巢穴外迈出独立的第一步时，家人们会聚集在一起。那一时刻似乎被视为一个微小但具有意义的里程碑，人们通常会通过鼓励、分享食物以诱导幼崽走出巢穴，以及亲友们的关注来予以庆祝。

在方舟舰上的生活，极少允许为个人里程碑举行此类聚会。
arkship.1210.desc.mammalian.en:
The recovered entry describes a tradition centered on the early development of our offspring. According to the records, families would gather when a young individual took their first independent steps outside the den. The moment appears to have been treated as a small but meaningful milestone, often celebrated with encouragement, shared food to coax the young ones out, and the attention of relatives and friends.

Life aboard the Arkship rarely allows for such gatherings around individual milestones.

arkship.1210.desc.toxoid.zh:
这段恢复的记录描述了我们的祖先在大气高度饱和时期所信奉的一种传统。人们会聚集在特备区域，刻意将体内积聚的气体和化学副产品释放到周围环境中。参与者们会相互竞争，看谁能产生最绚丽或最奇特的化学烟羽。由此产生的云雾在空气中形成了变幻莫测的色彩和反应图案。旁观者们兴致勃勃地观赏，而那些气味最刺鼻的气体往往会引起围观人群的阵阵笑声。

如今在方舟舰上，大气系统严格监管此类排放，以维持安全的环境条件。
arkship.1210.desc.toxoid.en:
The recovered record describes a tradition practiced by our ancestors during periods of heavy atmospheric saturation. Individuals would gather in specially prepared areas to deliberately release built-up gases and chemical byproducts into the surrounding environment. Participants would compete to produce the most vibrant or unusual chemical plumes. The resulting clouds created shifting colors and reactive patterns in the air. Spectators observed with great enthusiasm, while the most pungent gases often provoked laughter among the gathered crowd.

Nowadays aboard the Arkship, atmospheric systems strictly regulate such emissions to maintain safe environmental conditions.

arkship.1215.a.zh: 采用破坏性手段进行净化。

arkship.1215.desc.zh:
最近的报告显示，一种侵入性真菌物种已蔓延至方舟舰[Root.GetName]的整个水培甲板。该生物似乎在方舟舰农业系统受控的湿度和营养丰富的基质中茁壮成长，在多个生产层级形成了密集的菌丝网络。

遏制措施已被证明无效，因为该真菌对标准的除草处理没有产生可测量的反应。我们怀疑该物种可能已迅速适应了飞船的封闭生态系统。如果不加以控制，此次爆发可能会显著降低粮食产量，并对方舟舰有限的农业生产能力造成额外压力。
arkship.1215.desc.en:
Recent reports indicate that an invasive fungal species has spread throughout the hydroponics decks of Arkship [Root.GetName]. The organism appears to thrive in the controlled humidity and nutrient-rich substrates of the arkship's agricultural systems, forming dense mycelial networks across multiple production tiers.

Containment attempts have proven ineffective, as the fungus shows no measurable reaction to standard herbicidal treatments. We suspect the species may have adapted rapidly to the enclosed ecosystem of the vessel. If left unchecked, the outbreak could significantly reduce food yields and place additional strain on the arkship's limited agricultural capacity.

arkship.1220.desc.zh:
常规治理手段失效后，受污染的水培层进行了受控焚烧。不幸的是，方舟舰的大部分食用植物储备在此过程中损失殆尽。整个生长床随同感染物一起化为灰烬，导致数个农业区域暂时荒废。

尽管如此，行动似乎已达到预定目标。随着每一个带有孢子的表面都被灭菌，剩余的基础设施也经过了彻底清除，该真菌物种已从生态系统中被永久根除。这些经验将有助于我们应对未来可能在方舟舰上落户的其他外来入侵物种。
arkship.1220.desc.en:
Conventional treatments having failed, the contaminated hydroponics tiers were subjected to controlled incineration. Unfortunately, much of the arkship's edible plant stock was lost in the process. Entire growth beds were reduced to ash alongside the infestation, leaving several agricultural sections temporarily barren.

Still, the operation appears to have achieved its objective. With every spore-bearing surface sterilized and the remaining infrastructure thoroughly purged, the fungal species has been eradicated from the ecosystem for good. This knowledge will help us prepare for any other invasive species that might decide to settle on the arkship in the future.

arkship.1225.desc.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的入侵物种通过一个分布式的真菌菌丝网络运作，该网络能够迅速隔离并牺牲个体节段。每当我们尝试提取活体样本时，周围的生长物几乎会瞬间枯萎，其养分似乎通过网络被重新定向，用于保证在水耕平台的其他区域发出新芽。

在经历了多次失败的尝试后，我们终于成功分离出了一个足够稳定的样本进行受控观察。这种真菌拥有极高效率的养分再分配系统，这种系统可能适用于方舟上的闭环生态环境，甚至可能在模仿我们自己的分配系统。
arkship.1225.desc.en:
The invasive species on Arkship [Root.GetName] operates through a distributed mycelial network capable of rapidly isolating and sacrificing individual segments. Whenever we attempted to extract living samples, the surrounding growth would wither almost instantly, its nutrients seemingly redirected through the network to fuel new blooms elsewhere in the hydroponics decks.

After numerous failed attempts, we finally managed to isolate a sufficiently stable sample for controlled observation. The fungus possesses an extraordinarily efficient nutrient redistribution system, one that may have applications in closed ecological environments such as those aboard the arkship, perhaps even copying our own distribution systems.

arkship.1230.desc.zh:
对真菌生长的进一步实验揭示了一种异常的化学反应。该生物体暴露于特定化合物时，会迅速代谢这些添加物，并释放出一种独特的混合气体副产物。我们意识到，这些气体可以被收集并提炼。

这种真菌能有效地将简单的化学输入转化为稳定的挥发性化合物流，这是一个意料之外但可能很有用的过程。通过在隔离室中培养受控的真菌生长，我们相信该生物体可以被重新利用为一个小型的生化处理系统。
arkship.1230.desc.en:
Further experimentation with the fungal growth has revealed an unusual chemical reaction. When exposed to specific compounds, the organism rapidly metabolizes the additives and releases a distinct mixture of gaseous byproducts. We realized that these fumes could be harvested and refined.

The fungus effectively converts simple chemical inputs into a steady stream of volatile compounds, an unexpected but potentially useful process. By cultivated controlled fungal growth in isolated chambers, we believe that the organism could be repurposed as a small-scale biochemical processing system.

arkship.1235.desc.zh:
对真菌生长的进一步观察揭示了一些规律，表明其庞大的菌丝网络内部存在某种形式的生物信号传输。对大多数物种而言，这种行为或许微不足道，但我们自身的生物特性使我们能够识别并适应这种微妙的交流。

通过引入精心校准的生化信号，我们与该生物体建立了初步的对话。从那时起，它开始通过其网络重新分配养分，并保护农作物免受有害微生物的侵害。很快我们便意识到，我们曾以为的入侵，已演变成与花园中另一种生命形式之间富有意义的共生关系。
arkship.1235.desc.en:
Closer observation of the fungal growth has revealed patterns that suggest a form of biological signaling within its vast mycelial network. To most species this behavior might seem insignificant, but our own biology allows us to recognize and adapt to the subtle exchange.

By introducing carefully calibrated biochemical signals, we established a rudimentary dialogue with the organism. Since then it has begun redistributing nutrients through its networks and shielding crops from harmful microbes. Soon we realized that what we thought was an intrusion became soon a meaningful symbiosis with another lifeform sharing our gardens.

arkship.1240.desc.zh:
在我们的每月库存盘点中，我们发现方舟舰[Root.GetName]资源系统中存在持续性的偏差。电力、消费品和其他物资的损耗量小幅超过了我们的记录使用量。专家们认为这可能是泄漏、故障，或者是数据上微小的误差。

在进一步调查后，结果仍无定论。没有破口，没有故障，也没有超出可接受范围的低效。然而，数据依然如故。资源继续在毫无解释的情况下从系统中消失。方舟号上的某种东西正在消耗我们的资源。
arkship.1240.desc.en:
During our monthly stock takes, we have found a persistent discrepancy in the Arkship [Root.GetName] resource systems. Small amount of electricity, consumer goods, and other supplies are being taken at levels exceeding our recorded usage. Experts suggest a leak or malfunction, or a slight discrepancy in the numbers.

After investigating further, the results remain inconclusive. No breaches, no failures, no inefficiencies beyond acceptable thresholds. And yet, the numbers remain unchanged. Resources continue to vanish from the system without explanation. Something aboard the Arkship was consuming our resources.

arkship.1245.desc.zh:
在方舟飞船一个无人监控的区域内，我们发现了一群生活在官方体制之外的年轻人。他们利用私自引流的电力、空气和食物，创造了自己的空间，并在不受监管的情况下进行实验、改造环境以及表达自我。

研究表明，这是青少年发育过程中的自然现象。面对调查，他们表现得十分惊讶，并带有抵触情绪。他们声称只索取了少量的资源，且行事非常谨慎，足以避开即时检测。他们明确表示，无意放弃这片空间，并希望不被打扰。
arkship.1245.desc.en:
In an unmonitored section of the Arkship, we discovered a group of young individuals living outside official systems. Drawing on diverted power, air, and food, they have created their own space, experimenting, modifying their surroundings, and expressing themselves beyond supervision.

 Research suggests that it is a natural part of the development process of adolescents. They appeared genuinely surprised by the investigation and acted rebelliously. They claimed to have taken only small amounts, carefully enough to avoid immediate detection. They made it clear that they have no intention of giving up this space, and wish to be left alone.

arkship.125.desc.zh:
自从方舟舰[Root.GetName]进入这片星云以来，各层甲板的报告便接踵而至。研究人员发现了自己不记得写过的笔记；操作员忘记了执行过数千次的维护程序；导航人员声称出现了时间缺失，无法解释最近的航线修正。

我们的医生已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它似乎在神经层面干扰了记忆的巩固过程。
arkship.125.desc.en:
Since the Arkship [Root.GetName] entered this nebula, reports have been filtering in from across all decks. Researchers find notes they do not remember writing. Operators forget safety procedures they have performed thousands of times. Navigation staff speak of losing hours, unable to account for their recent course corrections.

Our medics have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which appears to be disrupting memory consolidation at a neurological level.

arkship.125.desc.hive.zh:
自方舟舰[Root.GetName]进入这片星云以来，集体意识中便掀起了阵阵波动。曾经完美同步的节点已开始失去协调性。随着冲动无法在格式塔意识中清晰传播，记忆正变得支离破碎。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它正在干扰将我们联结在一起的神经通路。原本应当流畅无阻的集体意识，如今却变得断断续续、支离破碎。
arkship.125.desc.hive.en:
Since the Arkship [Root.GetName] entered this nebula, disturbances have rippled through the shared consciousness. Nodes that were once in perfect synchrony have begun losing coherence. Memories grow fragmented as impulses fail to propagate cleanly through the gestalt.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is disrupting the neural pathways that bind us together. Where the shared consciousness should flow unbroken, it now stutters and frays.

arkship.125.desc.machine.zh:
自方舟舰[Root.GetName]进入这片星云以来，错误报告已在所有联网系统中蔓延。处理单元检索到的数据发生损坏。自动化子系统正在执行过时的程序，却未察觉到其内存寄存器已被重写。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将故障追溯至星云的电磁场，该电磁场正导致易失性存储系统出现零星的写入错误。各部门的数据完整性均受到损害，在开发出应对措施之前，运作效率将持续下降。
arkship.125.desc.machine.en:
Since the Arkship [Root.GetName] entered this nebula, error reports have propagated across all networked systems. Processing units retrieve corrupted data. Automated subsystems execute outdated routines, unaware that their memory registers have been overwritten.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the fault to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is inducing sporadic write errors across volatile memory systems. Data integrity across all departments is compromised, and operational efficiency will remain degraded until a countermeasure is developed.

arkship.1250.b.zh: 随他们去，但是把资源带走。
arkship.1250.b.en: Leave them to work and take the resources

arkship.1250.desc.zh:
在一个被遗忘的维护区域，调查人员发现了一群仍在执行古老指令的过时劳工无人机。它们的日常运作似乎早于数次系统更新，导致它们在当前日志协议之外运行，且仅需极少资源即可维持运作。

进一步检查揭示了它们持续活动的成果：大量精炼合金在多个周期中被细致地加工并储存起来。这些无人机一直在悄无声息地收集并优化资源，其规模已远远超出了当前的任何运作需求。
arkship.1250.desc.en:
In a forgotten maintenance sector, investigators discovered a cluster of outdated worker drones still operating under ancient directives. Their routines appear to predate several system updates, causing them to function outside current logging protocols while only requiring a small amount of resources to function.

Further inspection revealed the result of their continued activity: a substantial stockpile of refined alloys had been meticulously processed and stored over many cycles. The drones had been quietly gathering and optimizing resources far beyond any current operational requirement.

arkship.1255.desc.zh:
在方舟舰一个僻静的区域，我们发现了一个在官方系统之外运行的隐秘疗养所。被挪用的电力、消费品和水资源支撑着这个专为休养和恢复而设计的受控环境。

在场的人对于被发现几乎没有表现出担忧，他们解释说，这个空间的意义在于脱离对产出和展示效率的持续关注，是从飞船日常生活中逃离的避风港。尽管方舟舰旨在满足所有需求，但仍有人在寻觅一个纯粹用于放松的地方。
arkship.1255.desc.en:
In a secluded section of the Arkship, we uncovered a hidden wellness retreat operating outside official systems. Diverted power, consumer goods, and water sustain this controlled environment designed for rest and recovery.

Those present showed little concern at being discovered, explaining the space was meant to exist beyond constant need to focus on output and show off efficiency, an escape from the routines of ship life. Even though the Arkship was meant to fulfill every need, some still seek a place meant for pure relaxation.

arkship.1260.desc.zh:
在方舟舰一个僻静的区域，我们发现了一个未被记录的定期聚会社体。少量被挪用的资源被用于布置这些会议场所。

成员们将这些会议描述为一种非正式的交流活动，核心是围绕方舟舰在收割作业期间收集的标本，例如从勘测星系中获取的矿物、矿石碎片和晶体结构。参与者们会检查并讨论他们的发现，比较成分并争论其起源。
arkship.1260.desc.en:
In a quiet section of the Arkship, we uncovered an undocumented community gathering at regular intervals. The small amount of diverted resources had been used to accommodate these meetings.

Members described the sessions as an informal exchange centered around specimens collected during the Arkship's harvesting operations, such as minerals, ore fragments, and crystalline formations pulled from surveyed systems. Participants would examine and discuss their findings, comparing compositions and debating their origins.

arkship.1265.a.zh: 没收资源并取缔这场闹剧。
arkship.1265.a.en: Confiscate and shut down this nonsense.

arkship.1265.desc.zh:
在一个密封的储藏室内，我们发现了一处私藏的补给点：各种消费品、氧气罐和能量电池。所有物资都经过精心囤积，并避开了官方库存系统的记录。

责任人很快被找到，他们给出的解释很简单：未雨绸缪。他们辩解称，在一个生存完全依赖于稳定性的系统中，如果理所当然地认为稳定性会永远持续下去，那才是真正的失职。从这批囤积物资的规模来看，这显然是远超个人用途的长期计划。方舟舰上并非所有人都有信心它能永存。
arkship.1265.desc.en:
In a sealed storage compartment, we uncovered a private cache of supplies: consumer goods, air canisters, and power cells all carefully stockpiled and hidden from official inventory systems.

The individuals responsible were quickly found and offered a simple explanation: preparation. In a system where survival depends entirely on stability, they argued, it would be irresponsible to assume that stability is guaranteed forever. The scale of the hoard suggests long-term planning, far beyond personal use. Not all aboard the Arkship are confident that it will endure forever.

arkship.1270.a.zh: 拆除这个处理死者的地方。
arkship.1270.a.en: Demolish this place of the dead.

arkship.1270.desc.zh:
在一个封闭的处理区，调查人员发现了一个未登记的回收系统，该系统旨在将生物遗骸转化为可用材料。该系统一直在持续运行，远远超出了其预设的应急功能。

尽管效率很高，但该过程耗资巨大。大量的能源、化学催化剂和加工材料被挪用，用于对有机物进行分解、消毒和提炼，将其转化为标准化产物，以便在方舟号内重复使用。方舟舰上的任何东西都不应被浪费。即便是死者。
arkship.1270.desc.en:
In a sealed processing sector, investigators uncovered an unregistered reclamation system, one designed to convert biological remains into usable materials. The system has been operating continuously, far beyond its intended emergency function.

While efficient, the process is resource-intensive. Large amounts of energy, chemical catalysts, and processing materials have been diverted to break down, sterilize, and refine organic matter into standardized outputs for reuse within the Arkship. Nothing on the Arkship should be wasted. Not even the dead.

arkship.1275.c.zh: 我们不能容许这种事，净化他们。
arkship.1275.c.en: We can't allow this, purge them.

arkship.1275.desc.zh:
沿着资源流失的痕迹，我们发现了方舟舰上一处长期被忽视的区域。显然，那里生活着一个脱离官方系统、与世隔绝的小型社区。他们的居所十分简陋，依靠窃取资源维持生存，但由于窃取的量极小，一直未被察觉。

尽管处境艰辛，那里的环境却很稳定，维护得十分用心，并针对他们的需求进行了改造。显而易见，这是一种深思熟虑的生活方式。他们没有做出任何反抗，反而请求解释他们的选择。
arkship.1275.desc.en:
Following the traces of the disappearing resources, we found a long-overlooked section of the Arkship. Apparently there was a small isolated community living outside official systems. Their habitat was simple, sustained by siphoned resources, taken in amounts small enough to avoid detection.

Despite their circumstances, the environment was stable, attentively maintained, and adapted to their needs. It was clear this was a very deliberate way of living. They offered no resistance and instead asked to explain their choice.

arkship.1280.a.zh: 强迫他们重新融入社会。
arkship.1280.a.en: Force to join back into society.

arkship.1280.b.zh: 这艘方舟舰上没有你的一席之地。
arkship.1280.b.en: There is no room for you on this Arkship.

arkship.1280.c.zh: 随他们去，但我们会盯着他们。
arkship.1280.c.en: Leave them be, we will keep an eye on them.

arkship.1280.desc.zh:
那群与世隔绝的人公开谈论了他们的决定。他们并非拒绝方舟舰，而是无法接受其中演变出的生活方式。在他们看来，生存已经变得过度优化：每一项行动都被衡量，每一份资源都被追踪，每一刻时光都被精算。

他们描述了一种对方舟舰体制的不同见解。他们看重在不受持续监管的情况下做出选择的自由。他们声称，自己的生活方式虽然效率较低，但更加充实。我们的领导层中，有些人现在开始质疑，这类群体的存在究竟是对凝聚力的威胁，还是封闭系统中个性表达的必要体现。
arkship.1280.desc.en:
The isolated group spoke openly about their decision. They did not reject the Arkship but they said that the way life within it had evolved. To them, existence had become overly optimized: every action measured, every resource tracked, and every moment accounted for.

They described a different approach to the mechanism of the Arkship. They valued the freedom to make choices outside of constant oversight. Their way of life was less efficient, but more fulfilling, they claimed. Some among our leadership now questioned whether such communities represented a risk to cohesion, or a necessary expression of individuality within a closed system.

arkship.130.a.zh: 追求认知意义上的含义。

arkship.130.b.zh: 优先考虑基础设施改善。

arkship.130.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的调查小组已测绘出[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]星云电磁干扰的共振曲线，并部署了有效的反制频率。现在，整艘飞船上的迷雾已经消散。

收集到的数据比预想的更为重要。我们的科学家注意到，其中涉及的共振频率与已记录的灵能场特征惊人地相似。与此同时，我们的工程师认为，同样的反制频率原理可以用来增强我们的传感器，以对抗电磁干扰。
arkship.130.desc.en:
The investigation teams aboard [Root.GetName] have mapped the resonance profile of the [event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName] nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. Across the ship, the fog has lifted.

The data gathered is more significant than anticipated. Our scientists note that the resonance frequencies involved bear a striking resemblance to documented psionic field signatures. Our engineers, meanwhile, believe the same counter-frequency principles could be applied to sharpen our sensors against electromagnetic interference.

arkship.130.desc.hive.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经绘制了[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]星云电磁干扰的共振剖面，并部署了有效的反制频率。我们已恢复到完全一致的同步程度。

搜集到的数据所带来的意义不仅限于简单的恢复。我们的节点在共振剖面中识别出了与节点间通信频率相对应的模式。此外，我们的工程节点认为，可以将该反制频率进行调整，以增强我们的传感器阵列对抗电磁干扰的能力。
arkship.130.desc.hive.en:
The [Owner.GetResearchers] aboard [Root.GetName] have mapped the resonance profile of the [event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName] nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. We have returned to full coherence.

The data gathered carries implications beyond simple restoration. Our nodes have identified patterns in the resonance profile that correspond to the frequencies of inter-node communication. Alternatively, our engineering nodes believe the counter-frequency could be adapted to enhance our sensor grid against electromagnetic interference.

arkship.130.desc.machine.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]已经绘制出[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]星云电磁干扰的共振剖面，并部署了有效的反制频率。所有系统已恢复至最佳运行参数。

诊断数据具有显著的次生价值。处理单元已经识别出干扰与我们的计算子程序之间相互作用的模式。或者，反制频率本身也可以被改良，以提高传感器在电磁干扰环境下的分辨率。
arkship.130.desc.machine.en:
The [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] aboard [Root.GetName] have mapped the resonance profile of the [event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName] nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. All systems have returned to optimal operational parameters.

The diagnostic data carries significant secondary value. Processing units have identified patterns in how the interference interacted with our computational subroutines. Alternatively, the counter-frequency itself could be adapted to improve sensor resolution against electromagnetic disruption.

arkship.1300.desc.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的高级工程队提交了一份结构评估报告，该报告呼吁已不能再拖延。我们的家园急需修缮。

该提案是全面的：分段轮流大修，从发电基础设施开始，然后依次进行耕作甲板、防御区和居住区。居民需要暂时搬迁。设施将停止运行。工程估算显示，根据工作进度，全面检修大约需要十到十一个标准年。

这项工作将具有破坏性。但另一种选择是，这艘船每经过一个秒差距，可靠性就会降低一分。
arkship.1300.desc.en:
The senior engineering corps aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] has submitted a structural assessment that can no longer be deferred. Our home is in critical need of repair.

The proposal is comprehensive: a rotating section-by-section overhaul, beginning with the power generation infrastructure and working through the cultivation decks, the defense section, and the residential districts in sequence. Residents will need to be temporarily relocated. Facilities will be taken offline. Engineering estimates place the full overhaul at approximately ten to eleven standard years, depending on the pace of work.

The work will be disruptive. But the alternative is a vessel that grows less reliable with every parsec.

arkship.1300.desc.hive.zh:
集体意识到方舟舰[Root.GetName]的状况正在恶化：承重结构在不该弯曲的地方弯曲；电力管道正在腐蚀。数代人的累积疏忽已经达到我们无法再拖延的程度。

我们需要一个全面的更新周期：逐段进行，从动力节点向外，依次经过补给舱、防御外壳和居住甲板。随着工程的进行，各个区段将被封闭，其居民将被迁离。更新周期将持续十到十一个标准年。
arkship.1300.desc.hive.en:
The collective is aware of deterioration in Arkship [Root.GetName]: load-bearing structures flex where they should not; power veins corrode. The accumulated neglect of generations has reached a threshold we can no longer defer.

We require a comprehensive renewal cycle: section by section, from the power-nodes outward through the feeding chambers, the defensive carapace, and the residential decks in sequence. Sections will be sealed and their inhabitants displaced as the work progresses. The renewal cycle will span ten to eleven standard years.

arkship.1300.desc.machine.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的诊断子程序已标记出主结构子系统的关键阈值。方舟舰急需维修。

修复协议要求对各区段进行轮流大修。发电节点、种植区、防御基础设施和居住区将依次离线进行全面重建。在此过程中，运行连续性将有所下降。预计完成时间：以标准运行速度计算，约一百三十个月。

修复不可推迟。
arkship.1300.desc.machine.en:
Diagnostic subroutines aboard [Root.GetName] have flagged critical thresholds across primary structural subsystems. The Arkship is in critical need of repair.

Remediation protocols mandate a rotating sector-by-sector overhaul. Power generation nodes, cultivation sectors, defense infrastructure, and residential zones will each be taken offline in sequence for comprehensive reconstruction. Operational continuity will be degraded during the process. Estimated completion timeline: approximately one hundred and thirty months at standard operational tempo.

Remediation cannot be deferred.

arkship.1305.a.tt.zh: 消除翻修上一阶段产生的任何负面影响。
arkship.1305.a.tt.en: Removes any negative effects incurred during the preceding phase of refurbishment.

arkship.1305.desc.zh:
发电基础设施已通过认证并恢复满负荷运行。施工人员已将设备运往较低的农业层。

种植平台将逐段停用。这不仅是一项结构性挑战，也是一项后勤挑战：食物储备需要精心管理，建筑残渣将在公共区域滞留数月。

工程师们说，最难的部分不是焊接，而是等待。
arkship.1305.desc.en:
The power generation infrastructure has been certified and brought back to full output. Construction crews are already moving equipment down to the lower agricultural levels.

The cultivation decks will be taken offline section by section. It is not only a structural challenge but a logistical one: food stores will need careful management, and construction residue will linger in the common areas for months.

The hardest part, the engineers say, is not the welding. It is the waiting.

arkship.1305.desc.hive.zh:
发电机组全面恢复供电。

我们的注意力转向内部，看向维持殖民地运作的巨大供养仓。飞船上的培养槽和营养循环器官必须依次离线，进行结构翻新。食物储备已准备就绪，以弥补期间的不足。

在殖民地的“胃”重建期间，它将依靠储备食物维生。
arkship.1305.desc.hive.en:
Power generation resumes at full impact.

Our attention shifts inward, to the great feeding chambers that sustain the colony. The cultivation vats and nutrient-cycling organs of the ship must be taken offline in sequence for structural renewal. Food stores have been prepared to buffer the deficit.

The colony will feed from reserves while its stomach is rebuilt.

arkship.1305.desc.machine.zh:
发电修复已通过认证并恢复到正常输出。运营范围现在转移到第二部门基础设施。

指定区域将按顺序离线进行结构大修。受影响部门的运营输出在此过程中将按比例下降。

修复工作继续在预计参数内进行。
arkship.1305.desc.machine.en:
Power generation remediation has been certified complete and nominal output restored. Operational scope now transfers to secondary sector infrastructure.

Designated zones will be taken offline in sequence for structural overhaul. Operational output in the affected sector will decline proportionally during the process.

Remediation continues within projected parameters.

arkship.1310.desc.zh:
