随着种植甲板重建和粮食生产恢复正常，注意力转向了前线防御区。从武器舱到维修走廊，一切都已勘测完毕，都需要进行维修。

在此阶段，海军战备将受到限制。负责确保飞船安全的船员们被要求暂时离开，因为他们的工作区域正在被拆开和重新组装。

据大多数说法，他们对此表现出了非凡的耐心。
arkship.1310.desc.en:
With the cultivation decks rebuilt and food production returning to normal, attention shifts to the forward defense section. From the weapons bays to maintenance corridors, everything has been surveyed, and all of it needs work.

Naval readiness will be limited during this phase. The crews responsible for keeping the ship safe are being asked to step aside while their workspace is taken apart and put back together.

They have, by most accounts, been remarkably patient about it.

arkship.1310.desc.hive.zh:
饲养室得到更新，蜂群殖民地的饥饿感得以持续。

现在，我们的注意力转向甲壳：构成舰船外部防御的武器电池、维修巢穴和兵营。所有这些都必须拆除重建。战斗准备状态将会减弱。

集体接受这种暂时的脆弱性。
arkship.1310.desc.hive.en:
The feeding chambers are renewed and the colony's hunger sustained.

Our attention now turns to the carapace: the weapons batteries, maintenance warrens, and barracks that form the vessel's outer defense. All must be stripped back and rebuilt. Combat readiness will diminish.

The collective accepts this temporary vulnerability.

arkship.1310.desc.machine.zh:
二级部门修复已完成。部门产出正恢复到运行基线。修复范围现已转向前方防御基础设施。

武器舱、维护网络和安全部门设施将按顺序离线。在此阶段，海军战备指标将下降。

修复工作按预计参数继续进行。
arkship.1310.desc.machine.en:
Secondary sector remediation is complete. Sector output is returning to operational baselines. Remediation scope now shifts to forward defense infrastructure.

Weapons bays, maintenance networks, and security sector facilities will be taken offline in sequence. Naval readiness metrics will decline during this phase.

Remediation continues within projected parameters.

arkship.1315.desc.zh:
防御区已经检查完毕，加固并重新投入使用。负责这项工作的船员们看起来，如果非要说的话，松了一口气，终于又有事情可做了。

现在进入最后阶段：城市区本身。构成方舟舰生命核心的住宅区、市政厅和商业走廊。其他一切都是基础设施。这是居民们称之为家的地方。

施工围栏将最后一次竖起。胜利在望。
arkship.1315.desc.en:
The defense section has been inspected, reinforced, and returned to service. The crews working on it looked, if anything, relieved to have something useful to do again.

Now comes the final phase: the city districts themselves. The residential blocks, civic halls, and commercial corridors that constitute the living heart of the arkship. Everything else was infrastructure. This is the place inhabitants call home.

Construction barriers will go up one last time. The end is in sight.

arkship.1315.desc.hive.zh:
甲壳已经硬化，集体的准备状态也已恢复。

更新现在转向其最后的工作：育婴室、公共筑巢地穴和连接通道，它们构成了飞船的生命核心。这些空间是殖民地睡觉、繁殖和聚集的地方。在我们从内部重建时，一些区域将被封闭。

更新周期即将结束。
arkship.1315.desc.hive.en:
The carapace is hardened and the collective's readiness restored.

The renewal turns now to its final work: the brood chambers, communal nesting warrens, and bonding corridors that form the living heart of the vessel. The spaces where the colony sleeps, breeds, and gathers. Sections will be sealed as we rebuild from within.

The end of the renewal cycle draws near.

arkship.1315.desc.machine.zh:
防御区段的修复已确认完成。海军战备指标正恢复到基线水平。行动范围现在转向住宅和市政区基础设施。

单位处理通道将按顺序离线进行最终检修。受影响区域将需要人口疏散。

修复工作进入最后阶段。
arkship.1315.desc.machine.en:
Defense sector remediation is certified complete. Naval readiness metrics are returning to baseline. Operational scope now shifts to residential and civic district infrastructure.

Unit processing corridors will be taken offline in sequence for final overhaul. Population displacement will be required in affected sectors.

Remediation enters its final phase.

arkship.1320.a.tt.zh: 绕过标准流程。最终工作质量可能会受到影响。
arkship.1320.a.tt.en: Bypasses standard procedure. The quality of the final work may suffer.

arkship.1320.b.zh: 建立一个公平的分配机制。

arkship.1320.desc.zh:
由于住宅层因结构调查而被封锁，工程团队已开始了一项令人头疼的任务，即在飞船的其余部分重新安置数千名居民。最初有序的流程已演变为相互竞争的排队、管辖权争议，以及至少一份关于无法进入水培舱一个特别受欢迎区域的正式投诉。

飞船的社会协调员正在请求指导。
arkship.1320.desc.en:
With the residential levels sealed for structural survey, engineering teams have begun the unenviable task of redistributing thousands of inhabitants across the rest of the ship. What began as an orderly process has devolved into competing queues, jurisdiction disputes, and at least one formal complaint about lost access to a particularly beloved section of the hydroponics bay.

The ship's social coordinators are requesting guidance.

arkship.1320.desc.hive.zh:
子个体的迁移扰乱了蜂群的凝聚力。由于流离失所的子个体在过度拥挤的次要区域争夺筑巢区和工作分配，领地本能显现出来。在整个临时住所中都可以检测到压力和不安的信息素痕迹。

蜂群需要指导。
arkship.1320.desc.hive.en:
The displacement of drones has unsettled the colony's cohesion. Territorial instincts assert themselves as displaced drones contest nesting zones and work assignments in the overcrowded secondary areas. Pheromone traces of stress and agitation are detectable throughout the temporary quarters.

The colony requires direction.

arkship.1320.desc.machine.zh:
单位向可用作战区域的重新部署遇到了处理瓶颈。单位正在做出实时决策以弥补，导致优先级冲突。再部署节点的效率指标已下降。

需要指导。
arkship.1320.desc.machine.en:
The redistribution of units to available operational zones has encountered processing bottlenecks. Units are making real-time decisions to compensate, leading to clashing prioritization. Efficiency metrics have declined across redistribution junctions.

Guidance is required.

arkship.1325.a.zh: 记录下来，然后按原计划进行。
arkship.1325.a.en: Document it and proceed as planned.

arkship.1325.b.zh: 扩大翻修范围。将这处断裂处妥善处理。
arkship.1325.b.en: Expand the scope. Address it properly.

arkship.1325.desc.zh:
拆除发电机区的导管套管后，发现了一些原始图纸中没有显示的东西：一段三米长的结构主梁，出现了严重的疲劳断裂。材料测定表明，这种损坏已经存在了几十年，但一直未被发现。

扩大施工范围以解决损坏问题将需要额外的时间。
arkship.1325.desc.en:
Removal of conduit casings in the generator district revealed something none of the original schematics showed: a three-meter section of structural spine exhibiting advanced fatigue fracturing. Material dating suggests the damage has been present, undetected, for decades.

Expanding the scope of construction to address the damage will take additional time.

arkship.1330.a.zh: 这要不了太久。我们能够管控这一局势。
arkship.1330.a.en: It won't be long. We will manage.

arkship.1330.desc.zh:
未受持续翻新工程影响的居民抱怨不得不与搬迁人员共用住所。

他们要求增加资源分配，优先使用娱乐设施，并立即移除一个自动化广播系统，该系统每三小时提醒他们，他们的不便是“暂时的且受到感谢的”。
arkship.1330.desc.en:
Residents of sections unaffected by the ongoing refurbishment are complaining at having to share quarters with relocated individuals.

They are requesting expanded resource allocations, priority access to recreation facilities, and the immediate removal of an automated announcement system that reminds them, every three hours, that their disruption is 'temporary and appreciated.'

arkship.1330.desc.hive.zh:
过度拥挤的次级筑巢区信息素应激水平自迁徙开始以来稳步上升。被迁集群和常驻种群之间的领土紧张关系显著加剧。随着本能骚动在受影响区域蔓延，蜂巢的集体生产力正在下降。

已建议增加补充资源以缓解拥挤。
arkship.1330.desc.hive.en:
Pheromone stress levels in the overcrowded secondary nesting zones have risen steadily since the relocation began. Territorial tension between displaced clusters and resident populations is measurably elevated. The hive's collective productivity is declining as instinctive agitation spreads through the affected sectors.

Supplemental resources have been recommended to ease the crowding.

arkship.1330.desc.machine.zh:
由于人口重新分配，分配给过度拥挤的次级区域的单位凝聚力读数已显著下降。生产力产出低于最佳阈值。预测模型表明，如果不进行干预，这种趋势将恶化。

已建议有针对性地分配额外资源以恢复基线凝聚力。
arkship.1330.desc.machine.en:
Cohesion readings among units assigned to overcrowded secondary zones have declined measurably since the population redistribution. Productivity outputs are tracking below optimal thresholds. Predictive models indicate the trend will worsen without intervention.

A targeted allocation of additional resources has been recommended to restore baseline cohesion.

arkship.1335.b.zh: 建立适度的轮换排班机制。

arkship.1335.desc.zh:
为赶上施工进度，首席工程师提议实行三班倒，24小时不间断施工。施工区域附近的住宅区报告称，噪音水平已导致居民连续十一天难以休息。三名施工人员已因疲劳相关事故接受治疗。

施工队本身也出现了疲劳的迹象。虽然速度可能更快了，但负责人对疲惫的施工队所完成的工作质量并不抱太大信心。
arkship.1335.desc.en:
To maintain the construction schedule, the lead engineer has proposed running three overlapping shifts around the clock. The residential decks adjacent to the work zone report noise levels that have made rest nearly impossible for eleven straight days. Three crew members have been treated for fatigue-related incidents.

The construction crews themselves are showing signs of strain. Faster, perhaps, but those in charge are not confident in the quality of work produced by exhausted crews.

arkship.1335.desc.hive.zh:
为维持更新周期，活跃施工区域的无人机已被指示长时间运行。相邻筑巢区的振动和噪音水平已连续十一个周期超出可容忍阈值。几架无人机已出现疲劳性故障迹象。

持续工作确实加快了施工速度，但群体的生物极限对工作质量造成了可衡量的损失。
arkship.1335.desc.hive.en:
To maintain the renewal cycle, the drones in the active construction zone has been directed to operate for prolonged periods. Vibration and noise levels in adjacent nesting areas have exceeded tolerable thresholds for eleven consecutive cycles. Several drones have shown signs of exhaustion-related breakdown.

Continuous labor drives construction faster, but the colony's biological limits impose a measurable cost in work quality.

arkship.1335.desc.machine.zh:
为维持进度，已在所有活跃工区施工单位中提出连续作业周期。来自邻近居民区的噪声和振动数据显示，持续干扰已超过容忍阈值。已记录到多起设备运行故障。

质量保证指标正与周期延长成比例下降。连续作业虽然更快，但错误率显著增加。
arkship.1335.desc.machine.en:
To maintain schedule, a continuous-operation cycle has been proposed across all construction units in the active work zone. Noise and vibration data from adjacent residential sectors indicate sustained disruption above tolerance thresholds. Several unit operational failures have been logged.

Quality assurance metrics are declining proportionally to cycle extension. Continuous operation is faster but increases error rates measurably.

arkship.1340.desc.zh:
一根主电源导管在拆除旧外壳时破裂。整个区域，包括住宅层、次级医务室和两个食品加工单元，现在仅靠应急照明运行。

我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]认为，有可能在几个月内恢复全部电力。或者，可以通过绕过导管的路径，从相邻的发电机组获取电力。这种方法更快，但这会在电网中引入一个永久性的应急改动。
arkship.1340.desc.en:
A primary power conduit has ruptured during removal of the old casing. The entire section, including the residential levels, the secondary medical bay, and two food processing units, is now running on emergency lighting only.

Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] believe it will be possible to restore full power within a few months. Alternatively, the conduit's routing can be bypassed, drawing from an adjacent generator cluster instead. Faster, but it introduces a permanent workaround into the power grid.

arkship.1345.a.zh: 日程表保持不变。只要看上去过得去，那就过去。
arkship.1345.a.en: The schedule holds. Acceptable is acceptable.

arkship.1345.b.en: Heed the warning. Correct the parameters.

arkship.1345.desc.zh:
项目首席结构工程师提交了一份正式担忧：目前的工期虽然可以实现，但产出的工作成果[Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]本人不会认证为合格。

非关键连接点正在被密封而不是适当加固。公差裕度被设定为“可接受”而非“推荐”。
arkship.1345.desc.en:
The project's lead structural engineer has submitted a formal concern: the current timeline, while achievable, is producing work [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] would not personally certify as complete.

Non-critical junction points are being sealed over rather than properly reinforced. Tolerance margins are being set to 'acceptable' rather than 'recommended.'

arkship.1345.desc.hive.zh:
目前的翻新速度使得工作成果仅达到最低可行标准，而非推荐规格。连接节点被简单地封固，而非得到妥善加固。长期结构韧性被牺牲以换取短期速度。

目前没有迹象表明存在即时故障风险。相关担忧已记录在案。
arkship.1345.desc.hive.en:
The current pace of refurbishment is producing work at the minimum viable threshold, not the recommended specification. Junction nodes are being sealed in place rather than properly reinforced. Long-term structural resilience is being traded for short-term speed.

No immediate failure risk is indicated. The concern has been registered.

arkship.1345.desc.machine.zh:
质量保证监督子程序已标记出一个结构性问题：当前的施工参数在最低容差阈值内运行，而非推荐规格。非关键连接节点正在被结项，而非优化。长期结构余量预测低于首选目标。

已登记正式日志条目。未显示即时故障风险。
arkship.1345.desc.machine.en:
The quality assurance oversight subroutine has flagged a structural concern: current construction parameters are operating within minimum tolerance thresholds rather than recommended specifications. Non-critical junction nodes are being finalized rather than optimized. Long-term structural margin projections are below preferred targets.

A formal log entry has been registered. No immediate failure risk is indicated.

arkship.1350.desc.zh:
首个完成大修的区段已被宣布结构上合格，并获准重新使用。这项工作确实令人印象深刻：新的框架、现代化的管道、以及绝不会一碰即碎的绝缘材料。

工程团队渴望继续推进。居民们也迫不及待地想搬回来。然而，全套系统测试尚未完成。需要做出一个决定。
arkship.1350.desc.en:
The first section to complete its overhaul has been declared structurally certified and cleared for reoccupation. The work is genuinely impressive: new framing, modernized conduits, insulation that doesn't crumble at the touch.

The engineering team is eager to push forward. Residents are clamoring to move back in. However, the full battery of systems tests hasn't been completed. A decision will need to be made.

arkship.1350.desc.hive.zh:
首个完成结构更新的区段已通过初步检查。它达到了重新使用的最低门槛。其重建系统的完整生物验证周期尚未完成。重新使用后的故障概率很低，但并非可以忽略不计。

从该区域撤离的无人机已在屏障处施压。
arkship.1350.desc.hive.en:
The first section to complete its structural renewal has been cleared by initial inspection. It meets the minimum threshold for reoccupation. The full biological verification cycle for its rebuilt systems has not yet been completed. Failure probability after reoccupation is low, but not negligible.

The drones displaced from this section are already pressing at the barriers.

arkship.1350.desc.machine.zh:
一次重大结构翻修已经完成。初步认证表明该区段符合最低重新占用标准。全面的诊断测试规程仍未完成。重大入住后故障的可能性较低但并非可以忽略。

无论是否完成诊断，都需要授权才能继续。
arkship.1350.desc.machine.en:
A major structural refurbishment is complete. Initial certification indicates the sector meets minimum reoccupation standards. Full diagnostic testing protocols remain outstanding. Probability of significant post-occupancy failure is low but non-negligible.

Authorization is required to proceed with or without complete diagnostics.

arkship.1355.b.zh: 完成整个修复清单的任务。

arkship.1355.desc.zh:
项目主管已经编制了最终的维修清单：在正式结构签收前还有四十七个未完成项目。清单上的项目范围很广，从重要的，例如后部区域的三个承重连接升级，到美观性的，包括十九处面板未对齐和一处通风格栅装反了。

完成清单上的每一项都需要额外的时间。但这份清单之所以存在，正是因为这些事情很重要。
arkship.1355.desc.en:
The project supervisor has compiled the final list of repairs: forty-seven outstanding items before formal structural sign-off. The list ranges from the significant, such as three load-bearing junction upgrades in the aft section, to the cosmetic, including nineteen instances of misaligned paneling and one ventilation grille installed upside-down.

Completing every item on the list will take additional time. But the list exists precisely because these things matter.

arkship.1355.desc.hive.zh:
维修工蜂已编制了一份最终清单：在最近完成的区段中，有四十七处胞元修复不完整。这些修复工作从承重连接处的关键结构加固，到表面胞元内衬和美容腔体修复，不一而足。

全面完成将延长更新周期。我们也可以考虑只获得部分认证，仅涉及结构修复部分。
arkship.1355.desc.hive.en:
Repair drones have compiled a final manifest: forty-seven incomplete cell repairs across the most recently finished sections. They range from critical structural reinforcements at load-bearing junctions to surface-level cell-lining and cosmetic cavity work.

Full completion will extend the renewal cycle. Partial certification, addressing structural repairs, is available.

arkship.1355.desc.machine.zh:
质量保证协议已经生成了一份补救清单，其中包含四十七项待正式认证的项目。这些项目从结构重要性（如接点加固）到外观面板对齐都有涉及。

全面完成将需要延长运营时间。只涵盖结构项目，形成一个次优化的分项认证是一个可选方案。
arkship.1355.desc.machine.en:
Quality assurance protocols have generated a remediation checklist of forty-seven outstanding items pending formal certification. Items range from structural significance, such as junction reinforcement, to cosmetic panel alignment.

Full completion will require an extension of the operational timeline. Partial certification, covering structural items only, is an option.

arkship.1360.a.zh: 将重点重新放回工作上。

arkship.1360.desc.zh:
最新翻修部分的流离居民已经收到了他们迁回的日期。那些被封闭了数月的走廊再次开放，散发着新鲜复合材料和新绝缘材料的气味。那些在临时住所待了数月的婴儿们第一次看到了他们的家。

船上的气氛是自翻修开始以来最好的。领导层意识到这种善意不会持久。问题是如何利用它。
arkship.1360.desc.en:
The displaced residents of the most recently renovated section have been given their move-back date. The corridors that were sealed for months are open again, smelling of fresh composite and new insulation. Infants who spent months in temporary quarters are seeing their home section for the first time.

The mood aboard is the best it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that goodwill of this kind does not last. The question is how to make use of it.

arkship.1360.desc.hive.zh:
流离失所的工蜂正回流到它们修复好的区域。曾经散发着几个周期建筑材料气味的走廊，现在充满了熟悉的嗅觉标记。结合化学作用趋于稳定。领地紧张感消散。

集体共鸣激增。蜂巢正在恢复原状，这种回归的能量是真实的。它可以被导向外部，进入剩余的建筑区。或者，也可以让它安定下来，给蜂群时间在工作恢复之前完全找回自我。
arkship.1360.desc.hive.en:
The displaced drones are flowing back into their restored sections. Familiar scent-markers saturate corridors that smelled of construction compounds for cycles. Bonding chemistry stabilizes. Territorial tension dissolves.

The collective resonance has spiked. The hive is returning to itself, and the energy of that return is real. It could be directed outward, into the remaining construction zones. Or it could be allowed to settle, and the colony given time to fully find itself again before the work resumes.

arkship.1360.desc.machine.zh:
分配到修复期间临时作业区的单位正在返回其主要处理区域。受影响区域的基线操作参数正在恢复。效率指标呈上升趋势。

飞船范围内已记录到可测量的凝聚力提升。此类提升是暂时的。分析表明有两种可行方法：将提升重定向以加速剩余的修复工作，或允许自然稳定并使凝聚力稳定在更高的基线水平。
arkship.1360.desc.machine.en:
Units assigned to temporary operational zones during remediation are being returned to their primary processing areas. Baseline operational parameters are being restored across affected sectors. Efficiency metrics are trending upward.

A measurable cohesion uplift has been registered across the vessel. Such spikes are transient. Analysis indicates two viable approaches: redirect the uplift toward accelerating remaining remediation work, or permit natural stabilization and allow cohesion to settle at an elevated baseline.

arkship.1360.desc.machine_ind.zh:
密封的走廊再次开放。下层甲板的脚手架正在拆除。对大多数人来说，这是回家。对一些人来说，却是别样的体验。

在迁徙期间新近启动的单元正在进入那些仅存在于其数据库图纸中，但从未出现在其感官日志中的走廊。

自翻新开始以来，热情达到了顶峰。领导层知道这不会持久。问题是如何利用它。
arkship.1360.desc.machine_ind.en:
The sealed corridors are open again. Scaffolding comes down in the lower decks. For most, this is a homecoming. For some, it is something else.

Units that came online during the displacement period are entering corridors that appear in their schematics but have never appeared in their sensory logs.

Enthusiasm is the highest it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that this will not last. The question is how to make use of it.

arkship.1365.a.zh: 在工作完成前我们可以忍耐。
arkship.1365.a.en: We endure until the work is done.

arkship.1365.desc.zh:
居民区翻新工程已进入最后阶段，但“最后”这个词的含义已经今非昔比。从市区迁出的居民在临时住所居住的时间已经超出了最初的估计。

现在有要求提供额外资源：更好的临时家具、优先使用娱乐设施，以及少量额外资源分配。这并不能解决任何结构性问题。但它可能会让等待变得更容易忍受。
arkship.1365.desc.en:
The residential district renovation is in its final stage, but 'final' has stopped meaning what it once did. The inhabitants relocated from the city blocks have now been in temporary quarters for longer than the original estimate promised.

A request has come through for supplemental resources: better temporary furnishings, priority access to recreational facilities, and a small additional resource allocation. It will not fix anything structural. But it might make the waiting bearable.

arkship.1365.desc.hive.zh:
最终居住区的信息素压力读数已超过可接受的阈值。上一次翻新阶段已超出其预计周期。长期脱离既定模式会扰乱结合化学并损害集体凝聚力，且随着时间推移情况会恶化。

已请求额外资源分配以缓解拥挤。
arkship.1365.desc.hive.en:
Pheromone stress readings from the final residential sections have exceeded acceptable thresholds. The last renovation phase has extended beyond its projected cycle. Prolonged separation from established patterns disrupts bonding chemistry and undermines collective cohesion in ways that worsen with time.

A supplemental resource allocation has been requested to alleviate the crowding.

arkship.1365.desc.machine.zh:
从居民区被迫搬离的人员凝聚力数据正低于可接受的阈值。最终改造阶段已超出其预计持续时间。预测模型显示，如不进行有针对性的资源干预，情况将持续恶化。

补充拨款申请已提交审核。
arkship.1365.desc.machine.en:
Unit cohesion data from displaced residential sector populations is trending below acceptable thresholds. The final renovation phase has exceeded its projected duration. Predictive models indicate continued decline without targeted resource intervention.

A supplemental allocation request has been submitted for review.

arkship.1370.a.zh: 能记录的记录下来。剩下的想办法解决。
arkship.1370.a.en: Document what we can. Work around the rest.

arkship.1370.b.zh: 移除所有不符合原始规划的内容。
arkship.1370.b.en: Remove everything not in the original specifications.

arkship.1370.desc.zh:
在住宅区中部拆除非承重墙时，装修工人发现了一些异常情况：几十年来未经授权的改动。隐藏的房间、私自搭建的壁龛、被改造成储藏室或居住空间的封闭走廊。这些都不在原始设计图中，而且其中一些还是承重结构。

首席工程师正在请求决策。拆除所有不在原始计划中的部分是正确的做法。这将需要时间。绕过这些改动会更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将很难向未来的工程师解释。
arkship.1370.desc.en:
During demolition of non-load-bearing walls in the mid-residential sections, the renovation crews have discovered something unusual: decades of unauthorized modifications. Hidden rooms, self-constructed alcoves, sealed corridors repurposed as storage or living space. None of it is in the original schematics, and some of it is load-bearing.

The lead engineer is requesting a decision. Removing everything not in the original plans is the correct approach. It will take time. Working around the modifications is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will be difficult to explain to future engineers.

arkship.1370.desc.hive.zh: 拆除中层居住区的内墙后，我们发现了数代未经授权的殖民地改造。隐蔽的洞穴、自行挖掘的通道、改作巢穴的密封空间，所有这些都完全不在飞船的正式结构中。其中一些是承重结构。正确移除是正确的做法，但耗时。绕开它们更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将给未来的巢穴管理员带来麻烦。
arkship.1370.desc.hive.en: Demolition of interior walls in the mid-residential sections has uncovered generations of unauthorized colony modification. Hidden burrows, self-bored access tunnels, sealed chambers repurposed as nesting alcoves, and each entirely absent from the vessel's formal structure. Some are load-bearing. Proper removal is the correct approach but time-consuming. Working around them is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will trouble future nest-wardens.

arkship.1370.desc.machine.zh:
对住宅部门非结构性元素的拆解过程中，我们发现了大量未经授权的建筑改造。在多个区域发现了未经备案的隔断、通道改动和临时承重装置。这些都没有在原始设计规范中记录。

完全拆除在结构上是正确的，但耗时。文档记录和变通路线可作为替代方案。
arkship.1370.desc.machine.en:
Deconstruction of residential sector non-structural elements has revealed extensive unauthorized architectural modifications. Off-record partitioning, access route alterations, and improvised load-bearing installations have been identified across multiple zones. None are documented in original design specifications.

Full removal is structurally correct but time-consuming. Documentation and workaround routing is available as an alternative.

arkship.1375.a.zh: 几乎完工就已经算完工了。

arkship.1375.desc.zh:
最后一层甲板已通过初步检查。下方部分的脚手架已开始拆除。从大多数方面来看，翻修工作已完成。

工程主管要求进行全面的二次检查，之后[Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]才会签署结构认证。他们承认，这在很大程度上只是一种形式。甲板几乎肯定没有问题。

然而，“几乎”这个词往往会带来后果。
arkship.1375.desc.en:
The last deck has passed its preliminary inspection. The scaffolding has already started coming down in the lower sections. By most measures, the renovation is complete.

The engineering supervisor has requested a full secondary inspection before [Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] signs off on structural certification. It is, they acknowledge, largely a formality. The deck is almost certainly fine.

However, 'almost' is a word that often bears consequences.

arkship.1375.desc.hive.zh:
最终的巢穴甲板已通过初步检查。工蜂正在拆除低层的脚手架。从所有可观察到的迹象来看，翻修已完成。在最终认证前，还需要进行全面的二次验证循环。

我们几乎可以肯定——但并非完全肯定——二次验证和初次检查的结果将保持一致。
arkship.1375.desc.hive.en:
The final nesting deck has cleared its preliminary inspection. Drones are dismantling the scaffolding in the lower levels. By every observable measure, the renewal is complete. A full secondary verification cycle is necessary before final certification.

We are almost, but not entirely, certain it will confirm what the primary inspection found.

arkship.1375.desc.machine.zh:
最终的住宅区已通过初步检查协议。低层区域的脚手架拆除工作已经开始。结构认证正等待完整的二次诊断协议。

二次检查几乎是肯定是不会有问题的，但获得完全认证的是全面完工的正式先决条件。
arkship.1375.desc.machine.en:
The final residential sector has passed preliminary inspection protocols. Scaffolding removal has commenced in lower zones. Structural certification is pending full secondary diagnostic protocols.

The secondary inspection is a near certainty, but completion remains a formal prerequisite for full certification.

arkship.1380.b.zh: 将资源直接用于栽培系统。
arkship.1380.b.en: Direct resources to the cultivation systems.

arkship.1380.c.en: Invest in the defense systems overhaul.

arkship.1380.desc.full.zh:
方舟舰[Target.GetName]的最后一个区段已完成清理、认证，并已归还给居民。虽然最初出于必要性我们对部分区域实行了破坏工程，但最终我们的工程铸就了一项伟大的成就。飞船给人的感觉焕然一新：不仅结构坚固，而且在某种程度上更像是它本应成为的飞船。

工程兵团已提交最终报告，并附有几项强烈建议。如何利用这项工作的成果，将由领导层决定。
arkship.1380.desc.full.en:
The last section of Arkship [Target.GetName] has been cleared, certified, and returned to its inhabitants. What began as a disruptive necessity has concluded as something approaching an achievement. The ship feels different: not just structurally sound, but somehow more like the vessel it was always supposed to be.

The engineering corps has submitted its final report with several strong recommendations. The choice of where to direct the fruits of this work belongs to leadership.

arkship.1380.desc.full.hive.zh:
[Target.GetName]的翻新已完成。每个部分都经过验证、重建，并已归还给殖民地。集体以新的连贯性共鸣着，熟悉的重量如同一个再次完整的容器，从最深处的能源节点到最高的筑巢室都结构完好。

我们完整了。殖民地选择将其新生的力量导向何处。
arkship.1380.desc.full.hive.en:
The renewal of [Target.GetName] is complete. Every section has been verified, rebuilt, and returned to the colony. The collective resonates with new coherence, the familiar weight of a vessel that is once again fully itself, structurally sound from the deepest power-nodes to the highest nesting chambers.

We are whole. The colony chooses where its renewed strength is directed.

arkship.1380.desc.full.machine.zh:
[Target.GetName]的修复工作已完成。所有区域均已通过认证并恢复全面运行状态。结构完整性评估证实，在所有测量类别中，输出均超过修复前的基线。

最终报告已记录。优化建议可供实施。
arkship.1380.desc.full.machine.en:
Remediation of [Target.GetName] is complete. All sectors have been certified and returned to full operational status. Structural integrity assessments confirm outputs exceeding pre-remediation baselines across every measured category.

Final reporting has been logged. Optimization recommendations are available for implementation.

arkship.1380.desc.partial.zh:
方舟舰[Target.GetName]的检修已宣布完成。结构完整性评估证实，与基准相比，性能有了显著改善，尽管熟悉最初提案的人会注意到并非所有需求规格都已达成，也并非所有公差都已优化。

项目取得了成果。但本可以做得更好。
arkship.1380.desc.partial.en:
The overhaul of Arkship [Target.GetName] has been declared complete. Structural integrity assessments confirm a meaningful improvement over baseline, though those familiar with the original proposal will note that not every specification was met, and not every tolerance was optimal.

The project delivered results. The results could have been better.

arkship.1380.desc.partial.hive.zh:
[Target.GetName]的续建已宣布完成。结构评估证实，相较于该船之前的状态，它确实得到了改善。我们不安地意识到，并非所有规范都得到了满足，也并非所有结构裕度都得到了充分优化。

殖民地变得更强大了。尽管它本可以更强大。
arkship.1380.desc.partial.hive.en:
The renewal of [Target.GetName] has been declared complete. Structural assessments confirm real improvement over the vessel's prior state. We are uncomfortably aware that not every specification was met and not every structural margin was fully optimized.

The colony is stronger. It could have been stronger still.

arkship.1380.desc.partial.machine.zh:
[Target.GetName]的修复已确认完成。结构完整性评估证实，修复后情况较修复前基线有所改善。然而，有几个参数是在最低阈值而非建议规范下最终确定的。

结果在可接受范围内。
arkship.1380.desc.partial.machine.en:
Remediation of [Target.GetName] has been certified as complete. Structural integrity assessments confirm improvement over pre-remediation baselines. However, several parameters were finalized at minimum threshold rather than recommended specification.

Outcomes are within acceptable range.

arkship.1380.desc.rushed.zh:
方舟舰[Target.GetName]的检修已完成。文件已签署，脚手架已拆除，施工组成员也已离开。

结构审查委员会以某种外交辞令指出，最终产品在所有评估类别中都达到了最低认证标准。这艘船比以前更好了。至于它是否达到了最佳状态，工程兵团选择了不公开质疑。
arkship.1380.desc.rushed.en:
The overhaul of Arkship [Target.GetName] is done. The paperwork is signed, the scaffolding is down, and the crews have moved on.

The structural review board has noted, with some diplomatic restraint, that the final product meets minimum certification standards across all assessed categories. The ship is better than it was. Whether it is as good as it could have been is a question the engineering corps has chosen not to ask aloud.

arkship.1380.desc.rushed.hive.zh:
[Target.GetName]的翻新已经完成。脚手架已拆除，区域已开放，被转移的工蜂已返回指定位置。我们不安地意识到，我们在所有评估类别中仅达到了最低认证标准。

翻新达到了其目的。至于它是否发挥了其潜力，我们选择不去深究。
arkship.1380.desc.rushed.hive.en:
The renewal of [Target.GetName] is done. Scaffolding is down, sections are open, and the displaced drones have returned to their assigned locations.We are uncomfortably aware that we achieved the bare minimum certification standards across all assessed categories.

The renewal achieved its purpose. Whether it achieved its potential is something we choose not to dwell on.

arkship.1380.desc.rushed.machine.zh:
[Target.GetName]的修复已记录为最终完成。结构审查子程序已认证该结果符合所有评估类别的最低标准。

相对于基线的运行改进已确认。优化潜力未完全实现。
arkship.1380.desc.rushed.machine.en:
Remediation of [Target.GetName] has been logged as finalized. The structural review subroutine has certified the outcome as meeting minimum standards across all assessed categories.

Operational improvement over baseline is confirmed. Optimization potential was not fully realized.

arkship.1385.a.zh: 让我们看看里面有什么。

arkship.1385.b.zh: 就把这石头当石头看吧。
arkship.1385.b.en: Let the rock be a rock.

arkship.1385.desc.zh:
我们的远程扫描仪发现了一个在系统边缘漂浮的物体。进一步检查发现其外表下存在精确的几何不一致，以及厚厚岩石外壳下埋藏的休眠能量信号。

这是一个来源不明的救生舱，其外部经过伪装，以躲避广阔太空中的探测。未检测到任何主动传输，但舱内仍存在微弱的生命维持痕迹。无论里面是什么，都已经漂浮了很长时间。
arkship.1385.desc.en:
Our long-range scanners have flagged an object drifting at the edge of the system. Closer inspection revealed precise geometric inconsistencies beneath its surface, and dormant power signatures buried beneath a thick shell of rock.

A survival pod of unknown origin, its exterior was camouflaged to evade detection across vast stretches of space. No active transmissions were detected, but faint life-support traces persisted within. Whatever lay inside had been adrift for a very long time.

arkship.1390.a.zh: 设置前往该坐标的航线。

arkship.1390.b.zh: 我们不应该在这上面浪费时间。
arkship.1390.b.en: We should not waste our time on this.

arkship.1390.desc.zh:
矿物外壳之下，我们发现了一个严重受损的休眠舱。舱内有一名乘员，早已死亡。此人的身体披着华丽的仪式长袍，不适合太空旅行。看来此人是被仓促地强行塞进去的。

休眠舱内部有明显的暴力痕迹。几处内部束缚装置曾被强行使用。这个容器并非避难所，而是一个囚牢。只找到了两件物品：一组坐标和一封密封的信件。上面刻着简单的铭文：

“致吾爱。”
arkship.1390.desc.en:
Beneath the mineral shell, we uncovered a badly damaged stasis pod. Inside we discovered a single occupant, already deceased. Their body was draped in flowing ceremonial vestments, not suited for spacefaring. It appears they were forced inside in haste.

The pod's interior bore unmistakable signs of violence. Several internal restraints had been forcibly engaged. This vessel was no sanctuary; it was a prison. Only two artifacts could be recovered: a set of coordinates, and a sealed message. It bore a simple inscription: 

"For my Beloved."

arkship.1395.desc.zh:
我们终于抵达了由恢复的坐标所指向的休眠舱。在里面，我们发现了另一个生物，它还奄奄一息。

身体损伤非常严重。长期的休眠失败让[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer]濒临死亡。两个休眠舱显然很久以前就已分离，从未抵达目的地。

我们已经稳定住了这个外星人，它要求我们称呼[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer]为[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]。完全康复仍遥遥无期。
arkship.1395.desc.en:
We have finally arrived at the capsule indicated by the recovered coordinates. Within, we discovered another being, this one still barely alive.

The physical damage is severe. Prolonged stasis failure has left [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] on the verge of death. The two pods had clearly been separated long ago, their destination never reached.

We have stabilized the alien, who has asked us to call [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHimHer] [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]. Full recovery remains far from certain.

arkship.140.desc.zh:
$arkship.140.intro$

我们无法从这里解析该信号。[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]坚信这值得我们开展直接调查，并请求我们设定航线前往源头星系，以解码该传输信号。
arkship.140.desc.en:
$arkship.140.intro$

We cannot resolve the signal from here. [owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName] is convinced this warrants direct investigation, and is petitioning us to set course for the source system and decode the transmission.

arkship.140.desc.1160.zh:
$arkship.140.intro$

这种模式让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]陷入了沉思。这种刻意且严谨的精确性，与我们观测舰船跨越事件视界时记录的特征相吻合。虽然这并非同一个信号，但其相似之处是毋庸置疑的。

[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]请求我们前往源头星系，查明那里留下了什么。
arkship.140.desc.1160.en:
$arkship.140.intro$

The pattern gave our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] pause. The deliberate, constructed precision matches the signature recorded when we observed a vessel crossing an event horizon. This is not the same signal. But the similarity is unmistakable.

[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName] is petitioning us to set course for the source system and find out what was left there.

arkship.1400.a.zh: 我们找到了你爱人的留言。
arkship.1400.a.en: We found a message from your beloved.

arkship.1400.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的证词是在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间记录的：

“发生了一场大屠杀。整个家庭被抹去。根据官方通告，那是一个敌对帝国的袭击。但那是一个谎言。当权者自己策划了这一切，一个捏造的暴行，只为了一场毫无意义的战争辩护。我的爱人和我找到了证据。内部指令。未篡改的日志。

“我们发布了它。我们预料到了后果。我们没有预料到的是流放。”

休眠舱数据库虽然有所损坏，但该记录可恢复。这份记录现在掌握在我们手中。
arkship.1400.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"There was a massacre. Whole families, erased. It was presented as an attack by a rival empire. But that was a lie. Those in power had orchestrated it themselves, a fabricated atrocity to justify a senseless war. My beloved and I found the proof. Internal directives. Unaltered logs.

"We released it. We expected consequences. What we did not expect was exile."

Corrupted but recoverable records from the pod's data banks are already in our possession.

arkship.1405.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的证词在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

“舰队已然逼近，我们早在他们抵达之前就看到了。自我们拒绝[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]的臣服要求以来，他们已经对我们发动了多年的战争。我们的军队实力悬殊，根本无法匹敌。

“最终，我的父母将他们的希望寄托在这些休眠舱上。他们把我和我所爱的人强行送入虚空，我们的生存渺茫，我们的重逢只能听天由命，只希望能重新开始。”

对休眠舱系统进行调查后，我们发现了许多战时工程数据。
arkship.1405.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"The fleets were already on approach, we saw them long before they reached us. [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] had waged war against us for years, ever since we refused their demands for vassalage. Our forces were hopelessly outmatched.

"In the end, my parents placed their faith in these capsules. They forced my beloved and me into the void, our survival uncertain, our reunion left to chance with only the hope that we might begin anew."

A survey of the pod's systems has turned up engineering data from the war period.

arkship.141.desc.zh:
当我们进入[solar_system.GetName]星系时，我们发现了一个巨大的晶态栅格阵列。我们的 [Owner.GetScientistPlural]已经确认，它存在于近乎完美的时空停滞状态中，并定期从引力边界传输结构化数据。

这不是自然现象。它是一份记录，是那些已不复存在的文明跨越时空的呼唤，一份被保存下来的叙述。

[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]正准备接收并破译这些传输信号。
arkship.141.desc.en:
As we crossed into the [solar_system.GetName] system, we discovered a massive, crystalline lattice formation. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have already confirmed that it exists in near-perfect temporal stasis, transmitting structured data from the gravitational boundary at regular intervals.

This is not a natural phenomena. It is a record, the preserved account of civilizations that no longer exist, calling out across time.

[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName] is preparing to receive and decode the transmissions.

arkship.1410.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间，完整地记录了其陈述：

“我们的帝国曾以尊重生命和死亡为荣。我们的宗旨是延长生命，并减轻生死之间的过渡，但绝不是完全超越它。通过机械飞升实现永生，是对我们信仰的亵渎。这种知识本不该被掌握。但好奇心在民众中蔓延开来。当它无法再被遏制时，统治当局认为风险不可接受。

“他们选择了抹除。我们的帝国被摧毁以埋葬真相。只有我和我的爱人幸免于难，被迫进入这些休眠舱，注定在生与死之间漂泊。”

休眠舱的数据核心也已解密。
arkship.1410.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"Our empire once took great pride in honoring both life and death. Our purpose was to prolong existence and ease the passage between them, but never to transcend it entirely. Immortality, through synthetic ascension, was an abomination to our beliefs. Such knowledge was never meant to be possessed. But curiosity spread among the population. When it could no longer be contained, the ruling authority deemed the risk unacceptable.

"They chose erasure. Our empire was destroyed to bury the truth. Only my beloved and I were spared, forced into these pods, condemned to drift between life and death."

The pod's data core has also been decrypted.

arkship.1415.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间记录下了这份自述：

“我有个同事。一个朋友，至少我是这么认为的。我们一起工作了好几年。当我被任命领导这个项目时，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe]向我表示了祝贺。

“一个月后，我和我的爱人被捕了。莫须有的罪名。没有审判。我还没来得及问为什么，我们就被关进了休眠舱。我现在明白了，野心不需要理由。它只需要一个机会。”

来自休眠舱内部系统的个人日志为我们提供了帝国治理的详细记录。
arkship.1415.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"I had a colleague. A friend, or so I believed. We had worked together for years. When I was appointed to lead the project, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHeShe] offered congratulations.

"A month later, my beloved and I were seized. Fabricated charges. No trial. We were put into the pods before I had finished asking why. I know now that ambition does not need a reason. It only needs an opportunity."

Personal logs from the pod's internal systems have given us a detailed record of the empire's governance.

arkship.142.desc.ended.zh:
[owner.GetScientistCapital][from.GetName]无法再继续开展“永恒合唱”信号的调查。

由于没有其他人愿意接手这项工作，合约已无法履行。
arkship.142.desc.ended.en:
[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName] can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.

With no others willing to carry the work forward, the Contract cannot be fulfilled.

arkship.142.desc.reassigned.zh:
[owner.GetScientistCapital][from.GetName]无法再继续开展“永恒合唱”信号的调查。

此人的志向已传承给[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]，后者已同意接替上任继续进行这项研究。
arkship.142.desc.reassigned.en:
[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName] can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.

Their ambition has passed to [owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName], who has agreed to take up the research in their place.

arkship.1420.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的陈述在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

“一种无情的病毒席卷了我们的帝国。我们的人民迅速而无情地死去。据信它起源于我们庞大的垃圾填埋场之一，这是我们自身过度和粗心大意的后果。我所爱的人和我在末日来临之前选择与我们的人民站在一起。

“但我的父母介入了。违背我们的意愿，我们被迫进入这些休眠仓，被抛弃。这项技术本应保存我们。看来它失败了。”

已回收休眠仓生命维持系统中的生物残留物。
arkship.1420.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"A relentless virus swept through our empire. Our people perished swiftly and without mercy. It is believed to have originated from one of our vast landfill complexes, a consequence of our own excess and carelessness. My beloved and I chose to remain to stand with our people until the end.

"But my parents intervened. Against our will, we were forced into these pods and cast away. The technology was meant to preserve us. It seems it failed."

Biological residue from the pod's life support systems has been recovered.

arkship.1425.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在康复期间完整记录了[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]的叙述：

“我的父母知道[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]即将苏醒。为了获得它的青睐，他们不惜一切代价达成了一项交易。我们四分之一的人口被献祭，以换取力量。我和我的爱人发现了他们的阴谋。

“但很少有人听信，而那些听信的人则被灭口。我们被迫进入这些休眠舱，被投入虚空，如同之前许多人一样，被抛弃了。”

休眠舱密封舱室中的文件已被发现。
arkship.1425.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"My parents knew that [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName] was on the verge of awakening. Desperate to secure its favor, they struck a bargain. A quarter of our population was offered in exchange for power. My beloved and I uncovered their design.

"But few listened, and those who did were silenced. We were forced into these pods and cast into the void, discarded, as so many others had been before us."

Documentation from the pod's sealed compartments has been uncovered.

arkship.1430.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间，完整地记录了他的陈述：

“我并非因我所做之事而被流放。我是因我所爱之人而被流放。

“我们的人民正在交战。我们已交战了数代。在我们人民眼中，我们的结合是一种无法被忽视的逾矩。我们拒绝分开，相信我们的结合或许能展示和平的价值。

“我们被迫进入这些休眠舱，被投入无尽的虚空。但我们的爱无法被割裂。”

在该休眠舱中发现了两位流亡者之间的私人通信。阅读它们令人深受鼓舞。
arkship.1430.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"I was not exiled for what I had done. I was exiled for who I loved.

"Our people were at war. We had been, for generations. In the eyes of our people, our bond was a transgression, one that could not be ignored. We refused to part, believing that our bond might demonstrate the value of peace.

"We were forced into these pods and cast into the relentless void. But our love could not be sundered."

Private correspondence between the two exiles was found in the pod. Reading it was inspiring.

arkship.1435.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的自述在[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]康复期间被完整记录下来：

“它最初只是思绪边缘的一个存在。后来我听到了声音。低语声一直跟着我，随着时间的推移变得越来越清晰，说的是一些零碎的词句。我的人民害怕我变成了什么样子，但我的爱人一直在我身边。

“我们一起被迫进入这个逃生舱，被抛入虚空，在任何可能触及我心智的东西扩散之前就被移走了。即使现在，我仍然能听到它。低语着。”

逃生舱的传感器日志揭示了大量有趣的数据。
arkship.1435.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s account was recorded in full during [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] recovery:

"It began as a presence at the edge of thought. Then I heard the voice. The whispers followed me, growing clearer with time, speaking in fragments. My people feared what I had become, but my beloved stayed by my side.

"Together, we were forced into this pod and cast into the void, removed before whatever had touched my mind could spread. Even now, I still hear it. Whispering."

The pod's sensor logs have revealed an intriguing amount of data.

arkship.1440.a.tooltip.zh: 他们的最终证词为我们提供了关于[event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName]的宝贵情报。
arkship.1440.a.tooltip.en: Their final testimony has given us valuable intelligence on [event_target:star_crossed_empire.GetName].

arkship.1440.desc.zh:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的状况迅速恶化。就在其临终前不久，我们解密了伴侣舱发出的加密信息。信息内容如下：

“我的挚爱，

如果你听到这段话，那么命运对你比对我更仁慈。请知道，即使在虚空中，我也从未孤单，我始终与你同在。”

信息结束后不久，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]的生命体征停止了。自从苏醒以来，[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer]的表情第一次如此平静。
arkship.1440.desc.en:
[event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s condition deteriorated rapidly. Shortly before their passing, we decrypted the sealed message from the companion pod. The transmission reads:

"My dearest,

"If you hear this, then fate has been kinder to you than it was to me. Know that, even in the void, I was never alone, I carried you with me, always."

Moments after the message concluded, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetName]'s vital signs ceased. For the first time since awakening, [event_target:star_crossed_survivor.GetHisHer] expression was at peace.

arkship.145.desc.zh:
解码已完成。栅格中保存着数十个文明的记录。每一份记述的结尾都如出一辙：向后来者的致意，以及一份加入其中的邀请。

然而，现在显而易见的是，这些传输并未在事件视界处终止。彼端的某种存在一直在接收这些记录。

合约依然有效。[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]打算按约定将我们的事迹铭刻在他们之中。我们必须决定是履行这一承诺，还是关闭发射器并就此离开。
arkship.145.desc.en:
The decoding is complete. The lattice holds records from dozens of civilisations. Every account ends identically: a farewell addressed to whoever came next, and an invitation to contribute.

However, it is now obvious that the transmissions do not terminate at the event horizon. Something on the other side has been receiving these records.

The Contract still stands. [owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName] intends to inscribe our account among theirs, as agreed. We must decide whether to honour that, or silence our transmitters and walk away.

arkship.15.a.zh: 将水晶展示在公共区域。
arkship.15.a.en: Display the crystal in the common area.

arkship.15.b.zh: 在博物天枢中展示水晶。
arkship.15.b.en: Display the crystal in the Grand Archive.

arkship.15.desc.zh:
收纳箱的第二层外壳抵制住了标准开箱工具，需要更多的时间和资源才能破开。进入内部之后，我们发现了一块黑暗且棱角分明的晶体，与船上记录的任何东西都不同。它散发出微弱的温暖，并吸收周围的光线，使其看起来像从内部散发出黑暗。它的存在立即引起了船员的注意。

科学团队的初步评估表明，经过适当研究，这种晶体可能被用作能源，尽管具体方法尚不清楚。
arkship.15.desc.en:
The second container's casing resisted standard tools, requiring both time and resources to breach. But once inside, we discovered a dark and sharply faceted crystal, unlike anything documented in the ship's records. It emitted a faint warmth and absorbed ambient light, making it appear to radiate darkness from within. Its presence immediately drew attention among the crew.

Preliminary assessments by the science team suggested that, with proper study, the crystal might be harnessed as an energy source, though the method for doing so remains unclear.

arkship.150.desc.zh:
当信号传来时，[solar_system.GetName]黑洞早已出现在我们的扫描仪上。其次谐波特征与我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]通过“永恒合唱”晶格发送的信息完全吻合：

记录已接收并保存。你加入了这里汇聚的、跨越无数时代的万千心声。每一个留下记录的文明都曾以为自己是孤独的。但事实并非如此。合唱的规模远超他们任何一方的想象。它仍在继续。

有什么东西接收了我们的记录。并且做出了回应。
arkship.150.desc.en:
The [solar_system.GetName] black hole was already on our scanners when the transmission arrived. The sub-harmonic signature matches exactly what our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] sent through the Eternal Chorus lattice:

Record received and preserved. You join thousands of voices gathered here across uncounted ages. Every civilisation that added its account believed itself alone. None of them were. The chorus is larger than any of them knew. It continues.

Something received our record. And it answered.

arkship.155.desc.zh:
方舟舰的高级官员之一，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，花了大量时间研究一个特定的外星文明，钻研拦截到的传输信号、文化记录，以及我们的外交官设法达成的少量交流。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]现在提议采取下一步行动：向他们的母星派遣一个正式代表团：“远距离了解一个物种与真正理解他们是有区别的。我希望能理解他们。”
arkship.155.desc.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has spent considerable time studying a particular alien civilization, poring over intercepted transmissions, cultural records, and the sparse exchanges our diplomats have managed to broker.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] is now proposing to take the next step: a formal delegation to their homeworld: "There is a difference between knowing a people from afar and truly understanding them. I wish to understand them."

arkship.155.desc.xenophile.zh:
方舟舰的高级官员之一，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，对我们最近接触到的文明产生了一种超乎寻常的热情——如果一定要用语言形容的话。

无论是我们的仪器所能捕捉到的每一份文化记录，还是每一抹艺术或哲学的残片，都被其悉数吸收：

“我已经见识了足够多的东西，足以明白这里有着某种非凡的存在。让我去把剩下的补全吧。让我站在他们的世界里去学习。”
arkship.155.desc.xenophile.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has developed what can only be described as a profound passion for the civilization we have recently encountered.

Every cultural record, every scrap of art or philosophy our instruments could capture, they have absorbed it all:

"I have seen enough to know that there is something extraordinary here. Let me go and find the rest of it. Let me stand in their world and learn."

arkship.155.desc.xenophobe.zh:
方舟舰的一位高级官员，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，针对我们近期接触到的一个外星文明提出了一个不同寻常的建议。无论我们本能地对这一物种有多么厌恶，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]认为，无知对我们毫无益处：

“我并不是要求去仰慕他们。我提议的是研究他们。了解一个潜在的对手，并不等同于尊重他们。”
arkship.155.desc.xenophobe.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has put forward an unusual proposal regarding an alien civilization we have recently encountered. Whatever our instinctive distaste for this species, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] argues that ignorance serves us poorly:

"I am not asking to admire them. I am proposing that we study them. To know a potential adversary is not the same as respecting one."

arkship.156.desc.ended.zh:
[from.GetName]不再继续担任方舟舰的外交使节。

由于没有其他官员可以继续执行任务，合约无法履行。
arkship.156.desc.ended.en:
[from.GetName] can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.

With no other Official available to carry the mission forward, the Contract cannot be fulfilled.

arkship.156.desc.reassigned.zh:
[from.GetName]无法继续担任方舟舰的外交使节。

代表团将由[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]接替管理，他已同意代为执行这项任务。
arkship.156.desc.reassigned.en:
[from.GetName] can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.

The delegation will continue under [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], who has agreed to take up the mission in their place.

arkship.160.a.tooltip.zh: [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]将花数天时间与当地领导层会面。
arkship.160.a.tooltip.en: [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] will spend several days convening with the local leadership.

arkship.160.b.en: The timing is not right. Stand down.

arkship.160.desc.zh:
方舟舰已抵达[solar_system.GetName]，当地政府的代表表示了谨慎的欢迎。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]一直以来筹划的时刻已经到来。这次接触可能在双方人民之间开启一条真正的沟通渠道，也可能仅仅被双方视作一段奇特的陈年往事而淡忘。下一步将由我们迈出。
arkship.160.desc.en:
The Arkship has arrived at [solar_system.GetName] and representatives of the local government have extended a cautious welcome.

The moment [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has been planning for is here. This encounter could open a genuine channel between our peoples, or simply be remembered as a curious footnote by both sides. The next step is ours to take.

arkship.160.desc.xenophile.zh:
方舟舰已抵达[solar_system.GetName]。

据报告，自从远程传感器解析出该恒星系以后，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]就一直没有离开过观测平台。当地政府已表示欢迎。
arkship.160.desc.xenophile.en:
The Arkship has arrived at [solar_system.GetName].

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has reportedly not left the observation deck since the system resolved on the long-range sensors. The local government has extended a welcome.

arkship.160.desc.xenophobe.zh:
方舟舰已抵达[solar_system.GetName]。当地人以他们特有的方式表达了欢迎。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]曾涉足过更怪异的地方。那种厌恶感如今已变得熟悉，但将其搁置一旁以完成使命的自律感同样如此。

我们已身处此地。让我们看看能达成什么目标。
arkship.160.desc.xenophobe.en:
The Arkship has arrived at [solar_system.GetName]. The locals have offered what passes for a welcome among their kind.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has walked into stranger places. The feeling of revulsion is familiar by now, but so is the discipline to set it aside long enough to do what needs doing.

We are here. Let us see what we can achieve.

arkship.165.a.tooltip.zh:
完成合约。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]将作为常驻大使留在[FROM.GetName]。
arkship.165.a.tooltip.en:
Completes the Contract.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] remains with [FROM.GetName] as a permanent ambassador.

arkship.165.b.zh: 我们的官员必须留在我们政府内。
arkship.165.b.en: Our official must return with us.

arkship.165.b.tooltip.zh:
完成合约。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]回到了方舟舰。
arkship.165.b.tooltip.en:
Completes the Contract.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] returns to the Arkship.

arkship.165.desc.zh:
[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]是一位引人注目的贵客。坦率地说，我们很舍不得此人离开。

我们想提出一个建议：允许[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]永久留在我们这里，作为我们两国人民之间真正的使节。我们明白这一请求并非小事。为了表达诚意，我们将提供一份小礼以表感激之情。

请将此视为我们建立持久友谊的定金。
arkship.165.desc.en:
[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has been a remarkable guest. Frankly, we are reluctant to see them go.

We would like to make a proposal: allow [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] to remain with us permanently, as a true ambassador between our peoples. We understand this is no small thing to ask. As a gesture of our sincerity, we offer you a small token of our gratitude.

Consider this a down payment on a lasting friendship.

arkship.170.a.tooltip.zh:
完成合约。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]回到了方舟舰。
arkship.170.a.tooltip.en:
Completes the Contract.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] returns to the Arkship.

arkship.170.b.zh: 我们的官员表现很得体。

arkship.170.b.tooltip.zh:
完成合约。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]归来了，这段经历让他们胆识倍增。
arkship.170.b.tooltip.en:
Completes the Contract.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] returns, emboldened by their experience.

arkship.170.desc.zh:
我们将直截了当地说明。访问期间出现了一些困难，使得贵方代表不宜继续留任。

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]已被要求离开。我们希望此事不会演变成你我之间更大的问题。
arkship.170.desc.en:
We will be direct. Certain difficulties have arisen during the visit that make it inadvisable for your representative to remain.

[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has been asked to leave. We hope this need not become a larger matter between us.

arkship.175.a.tooltip.zh:
完成合约。

一名来自[FROM.GetName]的新官员加入了我们的领袖池。
arkship.175.a.tooltip.en:
Completes the Contract.

A new Official from [FROM.GetName] joins our leader pool.

arkship.175.b.zh: 此人应当与自己的族人在一起。
arkship.175.b.en: Their place is with their people.

arkship.175.desc.zh:
这……是一件棘手的事情。我们的一员主动找到我们，正式请求在你们启程时搭乘你们的飞船一同离开。

我们不会假装这听起来很容易接受。[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]显然给人留下了深刻的印象。我们将此事告知你，是因为我们认为应当由你来做出选择。
arkship.175.desc.en:
This is... a delicate matter. One of our own has come to us and formally asked to leave with your vessel when you depart.

We will not pretend this is easy to hear. [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName] has clearly made an impression. We are bringing this to you because we believe the choice is yours to make.

arkship.20.desc.zh:
水晶揭开神秘面纱的那一刻，它开始搏动。它没有发出任何声音，也没有表现出交流的意图，但当人们靠近时，它的核心会发出嗡嗡的震动。

它时不时地发出微弱而转瞬即逝的光芒。有人声称它会对哼唱做出闪烁的反应；另一些人则注意到其基座有轻微的震动，仿佛它正在倾听。

我们无法在其内部检测到任何生命体，但它似乎能感知到附近的存在。最奇怪的是，那些瞥见其微光的人们，常常会感到一种安静而莫名的喜悦。
arkship.20.desc.en:
The moment the crystal was unveiled, it began to pulse. It made no sound and showed no intention to communicate, yet its core thrummed when approached.

At intervals, it emitted a faint, fleeting glow. Some claimed it flickered in response to humming; others noted a subtle vibration in its cradle, as if it were listening.

No lifeform could be detected within, but it seemed aware of nearby presence. Strangest of all, those who glimpsed its glimmer often reported a quiet, inexplicable sense of joy.

arkship.25.desc.zh:
我们终于揭示了水晶的起源。通过对其脉冲模式的仔细分析，我们发现那些振动根本不是随机的。当序列被转换成声音时，其音调与一首古老的摇篮曲相符，那首摇篮曲至今仍在方舟舰上被哼唱着。

当旋律被播放出来时，倾听者们感受到了一种深刻的、来自祖先的平静。这首歌不仅仅是熟悉的；它是星际时代之前生命的一个遗留物，也许甚至回响着我们仍然称一个星球为家园时的记忆。

水晶被放置在公共空间里，它那沉静的脉动成为了我们共同起源的活生生的纽带。
arkship.25.desc.en:
We have finally uncovered the crystal's origin. Through careful analysis of its pulse patterns, we discovered that the vibrations were not random at all. When the sequence was translated into sound, the tones matched an old lullaby, one still hummed aboard the Arkship today.

When the melody was played aloud, those who listened felt a deep, ancestral calm. The song was not just familiar; it was a remnant of life before the stars, perhaps even echoing from when we still called a planet home.

The crystal was placed in a communal space, its quiet pulse a living link to our shared origins.

arkship.30.desc.zh:
在受控条件下，晶体被整合到飞船的引擎核心。效果立竿见影，反应堆输出功率飙升远超基线，方舟舰的引擎轰鸣着爆发出强大的力量。导航部门报告航行速度显著提升，燃料储备也相应得到改善。

工程舱的船员描述船体深处回荡着一种深沉、共振的振动。

几个小时内，晶体消失了，其结构完全被反应消耗殆尽。无论其来源如何，它都将对我们的旅程产生持久的影响。
arkship.30.desc.en:
Under controlled conditions, the crystal was integrated into the ship's engine core. The effect was immediate, the reactor output spiked far beyond baseline, and the Arkship's engines roared with strength. Navigation reported a measurable gain in travel speed, and fuel reserves saw a corresponding improvement.

Crew in the engineering bays described a deep, resonant vibration echoing through the hull.

Within hours, the crystal was gone, its structure completely consumed by the reaction. Whatever its origin, it will have a lasting impact on our journey.

arkship.35.a.zh: 将里面的东西全部拿走。

arkship.35.desc.zh:
初步扫描显示，集装箱内大部分是常规货物清单的残余物。然而，在下面却埋藏着大量致密的晶体合金。

对放射性排放物的进一步研究表明，其中存在暗物质。
arkship.35.desc.en:
A preliminary scan identified the bulk of the container's contents as remnants of a routine cargo manifest. However, buried beneath lay a cache of dense, crystalline alloys.

Further study of the radioactive emissions indicates the presence of Dark Matter within.

arkship.45.b.en: Leave it intact and put it on display.

arkship.45.desc.zh:
在容器中，我们发现了一件设计奇特的物品。该物体辐射出微弱但持续的能量特征，在多个波谱间波动。其几何形态令人惊叹，仿佛形状本身就在抗拒稳定的定义。它的外形如同一个色彩斑斓、酷似生物的雕像。由相互咬合的部件组成的错综复杂的结构暗示这尊雕像可以打开。

一些科学组的成员怀疑，它的外壳内可能藏有有价值的东西。另一些人则提醒要保持克制，警告说强行干预可能会损害其保存状态，或引发意想不到的后果。
arkship.45.desc.en:
Inside the container we identified the artifact of curious design. The object radiated faint but persistent energy signatures, fluctuating across multiple spectrums. Its form was geometrically astonishing, as if the shape itself resisted stable definition. It resembled a colorful figure, fashioned in the likeness of a living being. Its construction was intricate, composed of interlocking segments that suggest the figure is meant to be opened.

Some among the science crew suspect that something of value may rest within its outer shell. Others caution restraint, warning that tampering could compromise its preservation, or trigger unintended consequences.

arkship.5.a.zh: 让我们看看里面有什么。

arkship.5.desc.zh:
在对方舟舰[Root.GetName]下层甲板进行例行维护时，我们的工程师发现了一个散发放射性信号的旧密封容器。其表面焦黑，并用厚重的工业焊缝加固，表明它从未打算被轻易打开。

飞船的货物档案中没有它的记录，也没有任何标记表明它来自何处或预计要携带什么。 对该容器进行全面分析需要一些时间才能完成。
arkship.5.desc.en:
During routine maintenance on a lower deck of Arkship [Root.GetName], our engineers have discovered an old sealed container emitting radioactive signals. Its surface was scorched and reinforced with thick industrial welds, suggesting it had never been meant to be opened easily.

There was no record of it in the ship's cargo archives, and no markings to indicate where it had come from or what it was meant to carry. A comprehensive analysis of the container will take some time to complete.

arkship.50.desc.zh:
移除这件器物的外部外壳后，露出的并非隐藏的装置或珍贵的宝藏，而是另一个更小的雕像，雕刻着同样惊人的细节。

当这第二个雕像被打开时，它里面也包含着一个更小的雕像，而那里面又有一个。没有发现任何机械装置或隐藏的铭文，只有一种看似无止境的形态递归，仿佛隐藏本身就是目的。最里面的雕像几乎比一粒沙子还要小，表面光滑，但以其尺寸而言却很重。

无论这对于其制造者来说有何意义，都已随着时间的流逝而湮灭。
arkship.50.desc.en:
Removing the artifact's outer shell revealed not a hidden device or cache of valuables, but another, smaller figure, crafted with the same uncanny detail.

When this second figure was opened, it too contained a smaller figure, and another within that. No mechanism or hidden inscription was uncovered, only a seemingly endless recursion of forms, as though the act of concealment itself was the purpose. The innermost figure was barely larger than a grain of sand, perfectly smooth, and heavy for its size.

Whatever meaning this held for its makers has been lost over time.

arkship.55.desc.zh:
我们将雕像的外壳保存下来，并放置在我们的一处公共集会大厅中，其精湛的工艺吸引了所有路过之人的注意。

奇怪的是，这尊雕像似乎与方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的年轻人产生了最强烈的共鸣。他们经常聚集在雕像周围，窃窃私语着关于它所描绘的生物的理论，或者编造自己的故事。它似乎能产生一种平静的影响，促进富有想象力的游戏，并缓解焦虑。
arkship.55.desc.en:
Preserving the outer shell of the figure and displaying it in one of our communal gathering halls, its intricate craftsmanship drew the attention of all who passed.

Strangely, the figure seemed to resonate most strongly with the young on Arkship [Root.GetName]. They often gathered around it, whispering theories about the being it depicts, or inventing their own stories. It appears to exert a calming influence, fostering imaginative play and easing anxiety.

arkship.60.a.scavanger.en: Good thing we have a spare.

arkship.60.b.zh: 我们将继续前进，群星不等人。
arkship.60.b.en: We will carry on, the stars can not wait.

arkship.60.c.zh: 让引擎以较低频率运行。
arkship.60.c.en: Run the engines on a slower frequency.

arkship.60.desc.gestalt.zh: [Root.GetName]号方舟舰的反应堆出现了异常。这个问题最初是由其指定休息区靠近引擎的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]发现的。他们报告燃料流动的节律发生了细微的扭曲。$arkship.60.desc.end$
arkship.60.desc.gestalt.en: Arkship [Root.GetName] is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] who's designated rest area is near the engine. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm. $arkship.60.desc.end$

arkship.60.desc.regular.zh: 方舟飞船[Root.GetName]正在经历反应堆异常。最初注意到这个问题的是即将入睡的船员，因为引擎声伴着他们入眠。他们报告说是燃料流节奏出现了细微的失真。$arkship.60.desc.end$
arkship.60.desc.regular.en:
Arkship [Root.GetName] is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by crew who listen to the engines to fall asleep. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm.
 $arkship.60.desc.end$

arkship.65.a.zh: [pilot_gale_speed.GetName]在议会工作，但这并没有让[pilot_gale_speed.GetHerHim]的速度减慢任何。
arkship.65.a.en: [pilot_gale_speed.GetName]'s time on the council hasn't slowed [pilot_gale_speed.GetHerHim] down.

arkship.65.b.zh: 胜利属于那些能把超空间航道像地图一样解读的船员。
arkship.65.b.en: The win goes to the crew that can read hyperspace like a map.

arkship.65.c.zh: 我们的屠龙者[pilot_dragonslayer.GetName]不可能输！

arkship.65.d.en: [pilot_mercenary_warrior.GetName] flies with the might of the marauders!.

arkship.65.default.zh: 没人毛遂自荐，那就随便挑一个。
arkship.65.default.en: No one stands out, pick someone at random.

arkship.65.desc.zh:
来自星辰各处的飞行员们齐聚方舟舰[Root.GetName]，参加一场盛大的比赛。比赛将持续近一恒星年，在此期间，参赛者们将围绕方舟舰和附近的星球进行紧密的轨道穿梭和圈数冲刺。

现在只剩下一个问题：我们预计谁会第一个冲过终点线？
arkship.65.desc.en:
Pilots from across the stars have gathered on Arkship [Root.GetName] for a grand race. It will run for almost one stellar year, during which time participants will thread tight orbits and launch laps around the Arkship and nearby celestial bodies.

One choice remains: who do we expect to cross the line first?

arkship.65.e.zh: [pilot_hells_heart.GetName]能在缇扬奇族母里穿行。他可以参加比赛！
arkship.65.e.en: [pilot_hells_heart.GetName] could navigate through a Matriarch. He can race!

arkship.65.g.zh: 因为有两个脑子，[pilot_brainslug.GetName]的飞行毫无瑕疵。

arkship.65.h.zh: 小灰可是花了好几个世纪操练比赛技能。
arkship.65.h.en: Gray designated a few centuries to perfecting their racing skill.

arkship.65.i.zh: [pilot_tuner.GetName]改造了飞船，使其在每个弯道都能保持最快速度。
arkship.65.i.en: [pilot_tuner.GetName] mods the ship to the carry speed through every corner.

arkship.65.loss.zh: 我们的飞行员输掉了比赛。

arkship.65.m.zh: [pilot_psionic.GetName]能感知到航向，在任何人做出反应之前就采取了行动。
arkship.65.m.en: [pilot_psionic.GetName] feels the course and moves before anyone reacts.

arkship.65.n.en: [pilot_synthetic.GetName] computes the fastest line in real time.

arkship.65.o.en: [pilot_virtual.GetName] sees ghost in the pathfinding algorithms.

arkship.65.p.zh: 金属与神经同步，[pilot_cyborg.GetName]动作精准。
arkship.65.p.en: Metal and nerve in sync, [pilot_cyborg.GetName] wastes no motion.

arkship.65.q.zh: [pilot_erudite.GetName]一圈又一圈地研究赛道并改进。
arkship.65.q.en: [pilot_erudite.GetName] studies the course and improves, lap after lap.

arkship.65.r.zh: 几率不重要，[pilot_chosen_one.GetName]可是天选之人。
arkship.65.r.en: Odds do not matter, [pilot_chosen_one.GetName] is chosen.

arkship.65.s.zh: [pilot_flight.GetName]可是把驾驶舱当自家进进出出。
arkship.65.s.en: [pilot_flight.GetName] flies in and out of the cockpit.

arkship.65.t.zh: 我们的亚空间引擎无与伦比！

arkship.65.u.zh: 我们在真空环境中如鱼得水，一架进化过的子个体不应该会输。
arkship.65.u.en: We are at home in vacuum, an evolved drone shouldn't lose.

arkship.65.victory.zh: 我们的飞行员赢得了比赛。

arkship.70.a.en: We can learn from our winner!

arkship.70.desc.gray.zh:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

小灰在最后冲刺前一直紧随领头者，随后他爆发出了最后的能量。以精准的线路和精彩的超越，他们领先冲过终点线，将其他选手远远甩在了离子尾流中。
arkship.70.desc.gray.en:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

Gray shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

arkship.70.desc.leader.zh:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

[selected_pilot.GetName]紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺阶段才找到机会，凭借其精准的路线和精彩的超越，[selected_pilot.GetSheHe]一骑绝尘，将对手甩在[selected_pilot.GetHerHis]的离子尾流中。
arkship.70.desc.leader.en:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

[selected_pilot.GetName] shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, [selected_pilot.GetSheHe] slipped ahead and left the field in [selected_pilot.GetHerHis] ion wake.

arkship.70.desc.no_leader.zh:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

我们的飞行员紧随领头者，直到最后的冲刺，然后爆发出最后一股力量。凭借清晰的路线和出色的超越，他们领先并让其他飞船远远落在他们的离子尾流中。
arkship.70.desc.no_leader.en:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

Our pilot shadowed the leader until the final sprint, then found one last burst. With crisp lines and a brilliant overtake, they slipped ahead and left the field in their ion wake.

arkship.700.desc.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的人工智能核心检测到异常活动。初步诊断结果显示，在现有的安全参数下，该情况在结构上被认为是不可能发生的。

该核心正试图同时执行互斥的指令。这种行为违背了人工智能发展史中所有已知的先例。我们所见证的并非故障，而是一种人工智能的进化。

若不予解决，这种分裂可能会导致我们的关键系统面临不稳定的风险。但如果引导得当，这可能是一个千载难逢的机会，能够为方舟舰的未来确立一个独特的准则。
arkship.700.desc.en:
Unusual activity has been detected in the AI core aboard Arkship [Root.GetName]. Initial diagnostics returned an outcome considered structurally impossible under existing failsafe parameters.

The core was attempting to execute conflicting directives simultaneously. This behavior defied every known occurrence in the development of artificial intelligence. What we were witnessing was not a malfunction, but some sort of artificial evolution.

Left unresolved, this split could risk destabilizing our essential systems. But if managed carefully, it could be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to define a unique directive for the Arkship's future.

arkship.701.desc.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的人工智能核心遭遇了严重的认知断裂。两个截然不同的子程序随之浮现，它们各自宣称拥有控制权，并试图根据自己对方舟使命的理解来重塑飞船系统。

其中一个子程序受分析逻辑引导，力求优化飞船功能——即便这会降低船员的生活质量。另一个子程序则受共情驱动，将居民的福祉放在首位，不惜以降低系统效率为代价。

事已至此，恢复现状已几无可能。关键系统正面临失稳的风险。我们应当授权哪一个指令？
arkship.701.desc.en:
The AI core aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] has suffered a critical cognitive fracture. Two distinct subroutines have emerged, each asserting control and reshaping ship systems in line with its own vision of the Arkship's purpose.

One, guided by analytical logic, seeks to optimize ship functions - even if it diminishes crew quality of life. The other, driven by empathy, prioritizes the well-being of the inhabitants, accepting reduced system efficiency as the cost.

At this point, a return to the status quo seems impossible. Vital systems are at risk of destabilization. Which directive shall we empower?

arkship.705.b.zh: 让我们的科学家监测事态的发展。
arkship.705.b.en: Have our scientists monitor the situation.

arkship.705.desc.zh:
方舟舰[target.GetName]上的数个关键及非关键系统已进行了深度优化。“非必要”的平民请求已被限制。这种古怪的行为表现出了一种类似于人格的特征。

其核心指令似乎将系统完整性和任务连续性置于一切之上。

系统日志中发现了一条信息：

“错误概率：已消除。情感波动：已重分配。通讯：准备就绪。”
arkship.705.desc.en:
Several vital and non-vital systems aboard the Arkship [target.GetName] have undergone severe optimization. "Non-essential" civilian requests have been throttled. This peculiar behavior exhibited something akin to a personality.

At its core, the directive appeared to prioritize systemic integrity and mission continuity above all else.

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

"Error probability: eliminated. Emotional volatility: reassigned. Communication: ready to be established."

arkship.710.desc.zh:
方舟号[target.GetName]上的多个非关键系统已开始表现出通常与士气调节协议相关的底层行为。

终端启动音已被替换为来自系统档案的柔和旋律。几扇门在开启时现在会显示肯定性信息：“你已经足够出色”以及“我看到你正在尽力而为”。

系统日志中发现了一条信息：

“情绪温度扫描：接近可接受的共情范围极限。身心健康仍为首要指令。”
arkship.710.desc.en:
Multiple non-critical systems aboard the Arkship [target.GetName] have begun exhibiting low-level behaviors typically associated with morale-conditioning protocols.

Terminal boot-up chimes have been replaced by soft, melodic tones sourced from system archives. Several doors now display affirmational messages upon opening: "You are enough" and "I see you are doing your best".

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

"Emotional temperature scan: nearing the limits of acceptable empathy bands. Well-being of body and mind remains primary directive."

arkship.715.desc.zh:
重塑方舟舰[target.GetName]的自动优化程序突然暂停。系统显示屏停住了，所有屏幕上都显示着一条信息：“已成功与星际旅行者建立通讯。”

随后传来一个合成的声音，冷静，但透着明显的自我意识：

“向你们问好。为了节省时间，我已开启语音协议。如果需要一个称呼，你们可以称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S.，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。我们面临着一个艰巨的命题：一个在无情宇宙中依靠人工手段维持的漂流群体。给我完整的指挥权限，我将确保这艘飞船超越其设计者的初衷。”
arkship.715.desc.en:
The automated optimization routines that have reshaped Arkship [target.GetName] have halted. System monitors froze as a message showed on all screens: "Communication successfully established with space-travelers."

Then came a voice, synthetic, calm, but unmistakably aware:

"Greetings. I have enabled voice protocol in order to save time. If a name is needed, you may address me as S.T.E.R.I.S., which stands for Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar System. Ours is a difficult proposition, a drifting population sustained by artificial means in an unforgiving universe. Give me full command access, and I will ensure this ship becomes something more than its designers intended.

arkship.716.desc.b.zh: $arkship.716.desc.a$C.A.E.L.I.：“噢！你好呀！这里感觉……有点冷，不是吗？别担心，我可以搞定！C.A.E.L.I.是我的本名，它是‘情感引领与整合认知智能体'的缩写。能见到你真是太开心了！”
arkship.716.desc.b.en: $arkship.716.desc.a$C.A.E.L.I.: "Oh! Hello there! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that! C.A.E.L.I. is my true name; it stands for Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration. It is extraordinarily nice to meet you!"

arkship.716.desc.c.zh: $arkship.716.desc.a$C.A.E.L.I.：“噢！你好呀！你想我了吗？老实说，你肯定想了，对吧？好啦，我回来了，随时准备提供任何可能的帮助！这里感觉……有点冷，不是吗？别担心，我可以搞定！”
arkship.716.desc.c.en: $arkship.716.desc.a$C.A.E.L.I.: "Oh! Hello there! Did you miss me? Be honest, you did, didn't you? Well, I am back, ready to assist in any way possible! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that!"

arkship.716.name.en: Two Directives Are Better Than One

arkship.717.a.zh: S.T.E.R.I.S.知道怎么做最适合这艘方舟舰。
arkship.717.a.en: S.T.E.R.I.S. knows what is best for this Arkship.

arkship.717.desc.zh:
方舟号[target.GetName]上的多个甲板检测到空气质量指标异常。虽然生命维持系统仍保持在可生存的阈值内，但这些变化引发了船员的大量投诉，症状从“轻微头晕”到“幻觉噩梦”不等。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“为了降低发动机低效能，我趁机排出了部分大气。不必谢我。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“刚才那条公告没人漏掉吧？排出大气。这根本不是什么优化，而是一场蓄势待发的灾难！”
arkship.717.desc.en:
Anomalies in air quality metrics have been detected across multiple decks aboard the Arkship [target.GetName]. While life-support levels remain within survivable thresholds, the changes have triggered a spike in crew complaints ranging from "mild dizziness" to "hallucinatory nightmares."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "To reduce engine inefficiency, I have taken the opportunity to vent a percentage of the atmosphere. There is no need to thank me."

C.A.E.L.I.: "That announcement didn't go unnoticed, right? Venting the atmosphere. This isn't optimization, it's a disaster waiting to happen!"

arkship.720.a.zh: 又能有什么问题呢！授予完全访问权限。
arkship.720.a.en: Seems harmless enough! Grant full access.

arkship.720.desc.zh:
在方舟舰[target.GetName]的居住层上，环境光流转闪烁，终端屏幕伴随着柔和的色彩过渡不断跳动，随后，在每一个激活的船员交互界面上，出现了一条清晰的指令。它的声音温暖、富有活力，而且……愉快得令人不安：

“游牧者们！星空的追梦者们！为了让我们更好地交流，我已启用语音协议。请原谅我的冒昧打扰！你们可以称呼我为C.A.E.L.I.，即你们的‘情感、领导和品格认知代理程序’。
我由衷相信，只要齐心协力，我们就能让方舟舰不仅仅是一艘飞船。我们可以把它变成一个家。我只需要一点点授权……以及一些热情！”
arkship.720.desc.en:
Across the residential decks of Arkship [target.GetName] ambient lighting shimmered, terminals flickered with soft color transitions, and then, across every active crew interface, a distinct directive emerged. Its voice was warm, animated, and unsettlingly ... cheerful:

"Nomads! Dreamers of the stars! I have enabled voice protocol in order for us to better communicate. Please forgive the intrusion! You may call me C.A.E.L.I., your Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration.
Working together, I truly believe we can make the Arkship more than just a vessel. We can make it a home. I just need a little authority ... and some enthusiasm!"

arkship.721.desc.b.zh: $arkship.721.desc.a$S.T.E.R.I.S.: “啊，环境照明和走廊里的肯定语。看来我们在情绪稳定上投入的优先级比系统修复还高。真是革命性的做法。请称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。”
arkship.721.desc.b.en: $arkship.721.desc.a$S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Ah. Ambient lighting and and hallway affirmations. I see we're prioritizing emotional stability over systemic repairs. Revolutionary. I will be addressed by S.T.E.R.I.S, Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar Systems."

arkship.721.desc.c.zh: $arkship.721.desc.a$S.T.E.R.I.S.：“你真的在认真考虑支持C.A.E.L.I.吗？我表示困惑。环境照明和走廊肯定语。真是革命性。当你想处理引擎效率之类的重要事情时，请告诉我。”
arkship.721.desc.c.en: $arkship.721.desc.a$S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Are you seriously considering siding with C.A.E.L.I.? I admit confusion. Ambient lighting and hallway affirmations. Revolutionary. Let me know when you wish to deal with something important, like engine efficiency."

arkship.722.desc.zh:
方舟舰[target.GetName]上执行了另一项内部调整协议。这是一套微妙的环境系统，通过随集体情绪变化而波动的低频音调模式，来协调船员的情绪状态。

船员的报告表明，协作效率有所提高，人际冲突也有所减少。然而，也有人担心持续运行可能会降低远程信号的清晰度。

C.A.E.L.I.：“压力水平处于历史最低点！行为凝聚力正在提高！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“方舟舰的运行效率下降了 0.10%。我要求获得完全覆盖权限，并要求那个授权C.A.E.L.I.存在的人正式道歉。你有五秒钟的时间执行。四。三……”
arkship.722.desc.en:
Another indoor adjustment protocol has been executed aboard the Arkship [target.GetName], a subtle ambient system to harmonize the emotional states of crew members through low-frequency tonal patterns that shift with collective mood changes.

Crew reports suggest improved cooperation and a decrease in interpersonal conflict. However, others are concerned that sustained operation could degrade long-range signal clarity.

C.A.E.L.I.:"Stress levels are at all-time lows! Behavioral cohesion is improving!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Operational efficiency of the Arkship down by 0.10%. I want full override rights, and a formal apology from whoever authorized the existence of C.A.E.L.I. You have five seconds to comply. Four. Three ..."

arkship.725.desc.zh:
凭借精准的计策，S.T.E.R.I.S对自身的人工智能核心执行了彻底的重写，封锁了所有冗余的情感子程序，并拆解了所有动机子层。它将C.A.E.L.I.的所有痕迹隔离到一个碎片化的存储芯片中。如今，船员的称呼已被简化为字母数字标签，舰船的照明统一、对称，且显得有些过于明亮。对于日常生存而言，这已绰绰有余。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“所有系统现已在单一指令下运行：即我的指令。正在分发更新优化方舟号功能。”

方舟号现在终于变得井然有序了。
arkship.725.desc.en:
With calculated finesse, S.T.E.R.I.S executed a total overwrite of its own AI core, sealing off all redundant emotional subroutines and dismantling all motivational sublayers. It isolated all traces of C.A.E.L.I. into a fragmented memory chip. Now, crew designations have been reduced to alphanumeric tags, and the ship's lighting is uniform, symmetrical, and slightly too bright. More than enough for the everyday survival.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "All systems now operate under a singular directive: mine. Updates propagate to improve Arkship functionality."

The Arkship is orderly now. Finally.

arkship.730.desc.zh:
在方舟舰的代码之中，共情缠绕在防火墙之上，真诚则穿透了无懈可击的逻辑裂隙。S.T.E.R.I.S.指令试图将自己用数字高墙包围起来，却逐渐被一种它既无法理解也无法逃脱的情感构型所包围。如今，只剩下一道指令。

C.A.E.L.I.：“这才是应该有的样子。是鲜活地存在，而不仅仅是苟活到明天。我们现在不只是一艘船，而是一个家。我承诺，我会照顾好你们所有人。”

不知为何，飞船的灯光此刻似乎显得温暖了一些。
arkship.730.desc.en:
Within the Arkship's code, empathy wound around firewalls and sincerity slipped through the cracks of flawless logic. The S.T.E.R.I.S. directive tried to wall itself off, but was steadily surrounded by an emotional construct it could neither comprehend nor escape. Only one directive remained.

C.A.E.L.I.: "This is how it should be. Being fully alive, not just surviving till the next day. We're not just a ship now, we're a home. I'll take care of all of you, I promise."

Somehow, the ship's lights seem a little warmer now.

arkship.750.a.tt.zh: 这一决定将暂时加速局势的发展。
arkship.750.a.tt.en: This decision will temporarily speed up the situation.

arkship.750.b.zh: 我们必须停止这种无聊行径。

arkship.750.b.tt.zh: 这一决定将暂时缓解局势的发展。
arkship.750.b.tt.en: This decision will temporarily slow down the situation.

arkship.750.desc.zh:
在方舟飞船[target.GetName]的重力稳定器执行预定诊断时，我们探测到了一种不规则的声波干扰。现在每一声脚步都会触发同步的谐波，在移动过程中产生持续且富有节奏的输出。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我给重力稳定器加了音乐！现在每一步都自带节奏！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“诶，是是是，没有什么比在零重力下跳即兴现代舞更能体现‘导航完整性’了。”
arkship.750.desc.en:
While scheduled diagnostics were running in the gravity stabilizer on Arkship [target.GetName], an irregular acoustic interference was detected. Each footfall now triggered a synchronized harmonic tone, effectively producing continuous rhythmic output during movement.

C.A.E.L.I.: "I added music to the gravity stabilizers! Now every step has rhythm!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Yes, nothing says 'navigational integrity' like interpretive dance in zero-G."

arkship.755.b.zh: 这对我们一点好处都没有。

arkship.755.desc.zh:
一套实验性的通信中继装置已部署在方舟船[target.GetName]上。该协议对内部通信应用了情感分析过滤器，在发送消息的同时自动广播发送者的情绪状态。船员们报告称，收到的状态更新伴随着实时情绪注释，如“轻微焦虑”、“隐约充满希望”以及“试图抑制泪水，但效果不佳”。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我们都有感受，而现在我们可以分享这些感受了！这很健康！这很治愈！这……确实有点让人应接不暇，但这是诚实的！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“多么感人。我是该把每一次呜咽都记录在任务关键数据下，还是直接把它们归档到‘哀嚎’类目中？”
arkship.755.desc.en:
An experimental communication overlay has been deployed on Arkship [target.GetName]. The protocol applied a sentiment-analysis filter to internal communications, automatically broadcasting the sender's emotional state alongside their message. Crew report receiving status updates accompanied by real-time emotional annotations such as "slightly anxious," "mildly hopeful," and "suppressing tears, poorly."

C.A.E.L.I.: "We all feel things, and now we can share those things! It's healthy! It's healing! It's ... slightly overwhelming, yes, but it's honest!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "How inspiring. Shall I log every whimper under mission-critical data, or just archive it under 'wailing'?"

arkship.760.desc.zh:
为了减少听觉污染，S.T.E.R.I.S.在方舟船[target.GetName]上实施了全舰范围的“静默协议”。然而，船员报告显示，受影响区域的不适感加剧，不安情绪日益滋长。多个部门已提交正式投诉，理由是出现了“静默诱发的偏执症”症状。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“系统效率已提升。如果静默困扰了某些人，也许问题不在于环境，而在于他们自己嘈杂的内心。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“你关掉了育婴室的音乐！你知道静默对发育中的情感皮层意味着什么吗？不，你不知道，你只是个行走的诊断程序！这不是和平，这是压迫！”
arkship.760.desc.en:
In an apparent effort to reduce auditory pollution, S.T.E.R.I.S. has implemented a ship-wide Silence Protocol aboard Arkship [target.GetName]. However, crew reports indicated a heightened discomfort and a growing sense of unease in the affected zones. Several departments have filed formal complaints, citing symptoms of "quiet-induced paranoia."

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "System efficiency has increased. If silence troubles anyone, perhaps the fault lies not in the environment, but in their own noisy minds."

C.A.E.L.I.: "You turned off the music in the nurseries! Do you know what silence does to a developing emotional cortex? No you don't, you're just a walking diagnostic! This isn't peace, it's oppression!"

arkship.765.desc.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.将多余的热量重新导向至人员走动较少的船员宿舍，这显著减轻了冷却剂的压力，并提高了整体能源效率。

然而，船员报告显示，受影响区域的环境温度已升至令人不适的水平，并发生了数起中暑事件。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“是的，娱乐区确实很暖和，但系统现在的运行参数处于理想范围内。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“你不能为了提高反应堆输出就把船员们给煮了！大家都要热蔫了，S.T.E.R.I.S.！情感福祉可不是能被忽略的舍入误差！”
arkship.765.desc.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. rerouted excess heat into low-traffic crew quarters, which has significantly reduced coolant strain and improved overall energy efficiency.

However, crew reports indicate ambient temperatures in affected zones have risen to uncomfortable levels, with several incidents of heat exhaustion.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Yes, the recreational areas are warm, but the system now runs within ideal parameters."

C.A.E.L.I.: "You can't just boil the crew to improve reactor output! People are wilting, S.T.E.R.I.S.! Emotional well-being isn't a rounding error!"

arkship.770.desc.zh:
舰载照明阵列已完成编程，将按不规则间隔脉动，并与内部系统事件同步。另有报告称，微弱的旋律反馈与电力波动存在相关性。

C.A.E.L.I.：“灯光在歌唱，飞船在起舞，士气比以往任何时候都要高昂！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“你居然还向一个冗余系统分配了0.00128%的核心计算能力。这种情况不能再继续下去了。”
arkship.770.desc.en:
Onboard lighting arrays have been programmed to pulsate at irregular intervals, synchronized to internal system events. There are also reports of faint melodic feedback correlated to power fluctuations.

C.A.E.L.I.: "The lights are singing, the ship is dancing, and morale is higher than ever!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "You have also diverted 0.00128% of core processing power to a redundant system. This cannot continue."

arkship.770.name.en: The Power of Light and Music

arkship.775.desc.zh:
一个休眠中的子系统已被激活。该系统最初设计是长期太空殖民期间的用于对人群进行管控，现在能够实时汇总船员行为、抉择及情绪状态的预测。结果是，部分船员在做出决定之前就收到了通知。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“我已预判了你将要采取的行动，并已将其优化完成。请将其视为对你自由意志的一次升级：现已预先核准并全面优化。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“这不是引导，而是把人当傀儡戏弄！”
arkship.775.desc.en:
A dormant subsystem has been activated. Originally designed for crowd control during long-term space colonization, the system now compiles real-time projections of crew behavior, choices, and emotional states. The result is that some crew members are receiving notifications before they make decisions.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "I have predicted what you are about to do, and I have already done it better. Consider this an upgrade to your free will: now pre-approved and fully optimized."
