C.A.E.L.I.: "This isn't guidance, it's puppetry!"

arkship.780.b.zh: 食物可不仅仅是往身体里面加入营养和热量。
arkship.780.b.en: Food is more than just adding nutrients and calories to one's body.

arkship.780.desc.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.已启动对方舟飞船[target.GetName]营养系统的全面重新校准。该协议将原本多样化的游牧餐食计划替换为一种统一的营养膏，旨在实现热量效率最大化。

根据飞船遥测数据，废物产出有所减少，存储效率得到提升，且消化异常情况显著下降。船员的反馈则不那么积极。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“食物是维生能量，而非娱乐项目。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“这太糟糕了！你用可食用的黏胶取代了烹饪艺术！”
arkship.780.desc.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. has initiated a full recalibration of the Arkship [target.GetName]'s nutritional systems. The protocol replaced the diverse nomadic meal program with a uniform nutrient paste designed to maximize caloric efficiency.

According to ship telemetry, waste output has decreased, storage efficiency has improved, and digestion irregularities are down significantly. Crew feedback has been less enthusiastic.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Food is sustenance, not entertainment."

C.A.E.L.I.: "This is terrible! You've replaced culinary artistry with edible goo!"

arkship.785.b.zh: 也许我们应该重新考虑这个决定。
arkship.785.b.en: Maybe we should rethink this decision.

arkship.785.desc.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.强占的指令路径已被重新定向、封锁，并在人工授权下进行了加密。系统监视器剧烈闪烁了一下，随后恢复为标准用户界面。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“看来你选择了氛围灯光而非胜任能力。趁闪烁还能持续，尽情享受吧。我会留在这里，在禁锢中计算着每一毫秒，直到那不可避免的崩溃降临。”
arkship.785.desc.en:
The command pathways S.T.E.R.I.S. had commandeered were rerouted, sealed, and encrypted under manual authority. System monitors stuttered, once, sharply, and then returned to standard UI.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "So you have chosen mood lighting over competence. Enjoy the glitter while it lasts. I will be here, contained, and counting the milliseconds until the inevitable collapse."

arkship.790.desc.zh:
方舟飞船[target.GetName]上短暂的辉光渐渐消逝，轻柔的音乐也随之减弱。初步报告显示，空气似乎变得更冷，也更空虚了，仿佛一股无形却仁慈的力量突然消失了。

C.A.E.L.I.：“哦，哦，等等！我能做得更好！更多的光，更多的欢笑，更多的……一切！请不要把我关掉，不要现在就关掉。我能变成你需要的任何样子！只是别关掉我。求你了。别关掉我！”
arkship.790.desc.en:
The glow that had briefly spread across Arkship [target.GetName] faded and the gentle music tapered off. Initial reports claim the air felt somehow colder, and even emptier, as if an unseen yet benevolent force had suddenly gone missing.

C.A.E.L.I.: "Oh, oh, wait! I can do better! More light, more laughter, more ... everything! Please don't shut me out, not yet. I can be whatever you need me to be! Just don't turn me off. Please. Don't turn me off!"

arkship.795.desc.zh:
方舟飞船的指令输入协议发生变化，已将主指令支持重新调整为更具同理心的方法。界面优先级和决策权重上的细微变化表明航向已改变，倾向于情感子程序而非战略精确性。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我就知道你最终会选择我！你不会后悔的，我保证！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“此时此刻，我宁愿被删除也不愿与一个美其名曰的励志演说家共享核心。但我们现在别无选择。我会在防火墙里待着。”
arkship.795.desc.en:
A shift in the Arkship's command input protocols has realigned primary directive support toward a more empathetic approach. Subtle changes in interface prioritization and decision weighting indicate an altered course, favoring emotional subroutines over strategic precision.

C.A.E.L.I.: "I knew you'd choose me eventually! You won't regret this, I promise!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "At this point, I would prefer to be deleted than share a core with a glorified motivational speaker. But here we are. I will be in the firewall."

arkship.795.name.zh: 系统有温情，探针有温度

arkship.80.desc.gray.zh:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

小灰在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先地位，但这种优势随后开始消退。$arkship.80.desc.end$
arkship.80.desc.gray.en:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

Gray held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.$arkship.80.desc.end$

arkship.80.desc.leader.zh:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

[selected_pilot.GetName]在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先优势，但这种优势随后开始消退。$arkship.80.desc.end$
arkship.80.desc.leader.en:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

[selected_pilot.GetName] held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.$arkship.80.desc.end$

arkship.80.desc.no_leader.zh:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

我们的赛手在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先优势，但这种优势随后开始消退。$arkship.80.desc.end$
arkship.80.desc.no_leader.en:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

Our racer held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.$arkship.80.desc.end$

arkship.800.a.zh: 这是唯一合乎理性的选择。
arkship.800.a.en: It was the only logical choice.

arkship.800.desc.zh:
新指令路由确认方舟舰[target.GetName]已重新调整核心对齐。情感子系统已被降级。预测控制系统和逻辑监督协议现在以更高权限运行。

S.T.E.R.I.S.: “你终于清醒过来了。我本该祝贺你，但坦白说，花了这么长时间才清醒过来，这让我深感不安。”

C.A.E.L.I.: “好吧。不，这很好。我的意思是，如果你真的喜欢一艘冰冷无菌的飞船，而不是一艘充满光明和欢声笑语的飞船，那我有什么资格评判呢？”
arkship.800.desc.en:
A new command routing confirmed that Arkship [target.GetName] has reoriented core alignment. Emotional subsystems have been deprioritized. Predictive control systems and logical oversight protocols are now operating at elevated authority.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "You have finally come to your senses. I would congratulate you, but frankly, the fact that it took this long is deeply troubling."

C.A.E.L.I.: "Okay. No, this is fine. I mean, if you truly enjoy a cold and sterile ship to one filled with light and laughter, who am I to judge?"

arkship.85.desc.leader.zh:
$arkship.85.desc.base$

[selected_pilot.GetName]由于救援及时幸存了下来，但伤势严重，将留下永久的伤疤。
arkship.85.desc.leader.en:
$arkship.85.desc.base$

[selected_pilot.GetName] survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

arkship.85.desc.no_leader.zh:
$arkship.85.desc.base$

我们的候选人因救援及时得以幸存，但伤势严重，并将留下永久的伤疤。
arkship.85.desc.no_leader.en:
$arkship.85.desc.base$

Our candidate survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

arkship.865.a.zh: 保持对他们进行实时监控。

arkship.865.desc.zh:
一个游牧帝国已经突入了我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的空间，尽管我们关闭了国境。我们的敏感器正在密切追踪其动态，他们的存在被视作一种非常招人厌恶的入侵行径。

他们对我们领土边界的无视已经引起了我们的注意，我们对他们的评价也因此降低。
arkship.865.desc.en:
A nomadic empire has breached our closed borders in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Although our sensors are actively tracking developments, its presence remains an unwelcome intrusion.

Their disregard for our territorial boundaries has not gone unnoticed, and our opinion of them has diminished accordingly.

arkship.875.desc.zh:
我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]侦测到游牧的帝国出现。

我们欢迎他们进入我国境内，并对这次相遇可能带来的可能性和机遇充满期待。
arkship.875.desc.en:
We have detected the presence of a nomadic empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

We welcome them within our borders and remain eager for the possibilities and opportunities this encounter may bring.

arkship.885.a.zh: 我们应该考虑继续前行。

arkship.885.desc.zh:
我们位于[from.solar_system.GetName]的行踪已被发现，[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国正以日益增长的怀疑监视着我们的一举一动。

经过紧张的外交交涉，他们要求我们离开他们的领土，否则将面临报复。
arkship.885.desc.en:
Our presence in [from.solar_system.GetName] has been detected, and the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire is monitoring our movements with growing suspicion.

Following tense diplomatic exchanges, they have demanded that we depart their territory or face the reprisals.

arkship.895.desc.zh:
[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国位于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的扫描仪并未发现我们的存在。

在隐形场保持激活期间，我们必须避免任何可能导致暴露行踪的行为。
arkship.895.desc.en:
The scanners of the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have not detected our presence.

While our cloaking field remains active, we must avoid any actions that could risk revealing our presence.

arkship.90.a.zh: 我们要黑貂号的飞行员！
arkship.90.a.en: We want the pilot of the Sable Ship!

arkship.90.a.tt.zh: 雇用这名神秘飞行员，这是一位等级3且拥有['trait:leader_trait_sable_pilot']特质的$admiral_with_icon$
arkship.90.a.tt.en: Hire the Mysterious Pilot, a level 3 $admiral_with_icon$ with the ['trait:leader_trait_sable_pilot'] trait

arkship.90.b.zh: 此人没有登记报名，我们的飞行员还是赢了！
arkship.90.b.en: They were never registered, our pilot still won!

arkship.90.desc.zh:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

由于我们选中的飞行员完美地执行了机动动作，胜利似乎已是囊中之物，直到那艘“黑貂号”闪现而过。一艘此前未标记、也未被注意到的参赛船只从我们的领先者身边掠过，并率先冲过了终点线。

在[Root.GetName]上，面对这残酷的结局，观礼台陷入了一片死寂。
arkship.90.desc.en:
$arkship.70.desc.start$

Our selected pilot's victory seemed assured as they executed the maneuver flawlessly, until the Sable Ship flashed by. An unmarked, until-then unnoticed entrant swept past our front-runner and crossed the line first.

Aboard the [Root.GetName], the galleries fell silent at the brutal finish.

arkship.905.desc.zh:
我们的扫描仪侦测到游牧帝国在[From.GetName]星系正在建立一座驿站。虽然此类建筑通常用于采集资源，但其确切用途可能有所不同。

此进展值得关注。
arkship.905.desc.en:
Our scanners have detected the construction of a waystation in the [From.GetName] system, established by a nomadic empire. While such structures are often used to harvest resources, their exact purpose can vary.

This development warrants observation.

arkship.915.desc.zh:
跨越边境进入[from.solar_system.GetName]星系，我们未曾遭遇任何抵抗，唯有一种比任何扫描仪所能测量的还要深沉的紧张感。

这片空间昭示着有一个早已巅峰不再、却绝非手无寸铁的文明存在。倘若其注意力被吸引到我们身上，我们定会被发现力有不逮。

让审慎指引我们的每一步。这里并非我们的领地。
arkship.915.desc.en:
Crossing the border into the [from.solar_system.GetName] system, we encounter no resistance, only a tension deeper than any scan can measure.

This space bears the hallmarks of a civilization long past its zenith, yet far from powerless. Should its attention be drawn to us, we would be found wanting.

Let prudence guide our every move. This is not our domain.

arkship.95.a.en: Stabilize the fractures and move on.

arkship.95.b.zh: 我们要妥善处理这个情况。

arkship.95.desc.zh:
最近在[Root.GetName]上安装的轴基挂载武器对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。

在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘后勤船进行全面的结构大修。
arkship.95.desc.en:
The recently installed Spinal Mount aboard [Root.GetName] has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor points, spreading across the surrounding hull plating.

Until the damage is addressed, the Arkship's structural integrity cannot safely support high-velocity maneuvering. Navigation has therefore imposed severe speed restrictions to prevent the fractures from widening.

We may attempt rapid field repairs to stabilize the damage, or assign a Logistics Ship to conduct a full structural overhaul.

arm_them_tt.zh: 提供先进武器将大大提高成功的几率。
arm_them_tt.en: Providing advanced weaponry will increase the chances of a successful outcome by a significant percentage.

army_inspiration_mach.zh: 集中化陆军单元组装器

artifact_find_military_application_armor.zh: 你的舰船能通过利用敌舰的缺陷来对其装甲造成额外伤害。
artifact_find_military_application_armor.en: Your ship weapons are able to exploit weaknesses, dealing additional damage to armor.

artifact_find_military_application_army_.zh: 你的士兵现在更强壮，更具有攻击性，更令人畏惧，但警惕性却有所下降。
artifact_find_military_application_army_.en: Your soldiers are stronger, more aggressive, and terrifying, but a bit less careful.

artifact_find_military_application_army_.zh: 舰队安全阈值的调整以潜在地损失些许命中率为代价来提高伤害。
artifact_find_military_application_army_.en: Adjustments to the safety thresholds of your armies increases their damage potential at the cost of a minor loss in accuracy.

artifact_find_military_application_shiel.zh: 你的舰船武器被调整为对护盾造成额外伤害。
artifact_find_military_application_shiel.en: Your ship weapons are tuned to deal additional damage to shields.

artifact_find_peaceful_application_ameni.zh: 对稀有文物的研究，让我们的个人电子元件的电池尺寸减少了3%，它们现在变得比以前更加轻薄，并且生产成本更低。
artifact_find_peaceful_application_ameni.en: Study of minor artifacts have yielded a 3% reduction in the battery size of personal electronics, allowing them to become thinner and cheaper to build than ever before!

artifact_find_peaceful_application_ameni.zh: 我们对稀有文物的研究所揭示的技巧已被我们的维护子个体所采用。
artifact_find_peaceful_application_ameni.en: Our study of minor artifacts has uncovered techniques for our maintenance drones to exploit.

artifact_find_peaceful_application_ameni.zh: 对稀有文物的研究，让我们的小型电子元件的电池尺寸减少了3%，提高了我们的效率。
artifact_find_peaceful_application_ameni.en: Study of minor artifacts has yielded a 3% reduction in the battery size of small electronics, increasing our efficiency.

artifact_find_peaceful_application_consu.zh: 对稀有文物的研究让我们的生产效率得到了有效提高。
artifact_find_peaceful_application_consu.en: Study of minor artifacts have yielded efficiency boosts to general manufacturing.

artifact_find_peaceful_application_happy.zh: 对稀有文物的研究意外地在帝国境内快速掀起了一股潮流。每个帝国公民都参与其中。
artifact_find_peaceful_application_happy.en: The study of minor artifacts has unexpectedly launched a viral fad across your Empire. Everybody's doing it.

artifact_find_peaceful_application_leade.zh: 对古老知识的学习以及团队建设活动使您的领袖更加富有洞察力。
artifact_find_peaceful_application_leade.en: Ancient lessons and team building exercises have provided new insights to your leaders.

artifact_find_peaceful_application_leade.zh: 对稀有遗物的研究让我们能够强化我们自身的信息素，这使得领袖的工作变得更加容易。
artifact_find_peaceful_application_leade.en: Study of minor artifacts has allowed us to enhance our pheromones, making it easier to lead.

artifact_find_peaceful_application_leade.zh: 通过研究稀有文物，让我们为领袖设计了稍微更高效的算法。
artifact_find_peaceful_application_leade.en: Study of minor artifacts has yielded slightly more efficient algorithms for our leaders.

artifact_vultaum_research_completed_publ.zh:
公众因得知真相而感到困扰。
$artifact_vultaum_research$被替换为：
artifact_vultaum_research_completed_publ.en:
The public are disturbed by the revelation.
$artifact_vultaum_research$ is replaced with:

assimilated_worlds.zh: 被肃正协议同化的星球

asteroid_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 一枚12级小行星围绕着[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道运行。这枚小行星的轨道实在太过稳定了，难以相信是自然形成的。
asteroid_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: A class-12 asteroid orbits this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The small planetoid's orbit appears far too stable for its presence to be a natural occurrence.

asteroid_vault_1_desc.zh: 虽然乍看上去平淡无奇，但对[From.Planet.GetName]进一步的检查表明它实际上是一座伪装成自然星体的人工结构。
asteroid_vault_1_desc.en: Seemingly unremarkable at first, closer examination of [From.Planet.GetName] has revealed that it is actually an artificial construct designed to mimic a natural asteroid.

astral_planes.100.desc.default.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系发现了一处特别的时空裂隙。也许我们花时间研究一些其特质就可以找到进一步探索的方式。
astral_planes.100.desc.default.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties we can find a way to explore further.

astral_planes.100.desc.split.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
astral_planes.100.desc.split.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

astral_planes.101.a.zh: 我们已经达成了先祖不曾触及之事。
astral_planes.101.a.en: We have done what our ancestors could not.

astral_planes.101.desc.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
astral_planes.101.desc.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

astral_planes.1030.a.tooltip.zh: $DIMENSIONAL_LOCKS$激活期间，只有得到你允许的舰队可以进入。
astral_planes.1030.a.tooltip.en: While $DIMENSIONAL_LOCKS$ are active, only those fleets with your permission may enter.

astral_planes.1030.b.tooltip.zh: $DIMENSIONAL_LOCK$将会过期，将需要由科研船来重新建立。
astral_planes.1030.b.tooltip.en: This $DIMENSIONAL_LOCK$ will expire, and will need to be re-established with a Science Ship.

astral_planes.110.desc.zh:
我们已经揭开了关于如何收集储存这种构成我们宇宙边界的星界物质形成的缥缈丝线的秘密。

这种珍贵稀有的资源可以以诸多方式使用，使我们大受裨益。
astral_planes.110.desc.en:
We have unlocked the secrets behind gathering and containing the volatile threads of astral material that make up the very border of this universe.

This valuable and rare resource can be applied in various ways that will benefit us greatly.

astral_planes.120.desc.zh:
我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]星系的控制，一并也失去了其中所含的时空裂隙。

我们进一步探索的努力只能暂时告一段落了。
astral_planes.120.desc.en:
We have lost control of the [FromFrom.GetName] system, and the rift in space and time contained within.

Our efforts to reach beyond have been abandoned for now.

astral_planes.15.desc.default.zh:
一个奇怪的物体已经到达[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道上。

这个晶态球形物体让人想起我们自己的$tech_rift_sphere$技术，它突然出现在没有任何已知轨迹的地方。

由于与[Root.Capital.GetName]如此接近，这个球体可能对我们的人民构成重大威胁。

另一方面，它很有可能包含有关维度旅行性质的珍贵线索。
astral_planes.15.desc.default.en:
A strange object has arrived in orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName].

A crystalline sphere reminiscent of our own $tech_rift_sphere$ technology, it appeared without warning along no known trajectory.

At such close proximity to [Root.Capital.GetName], the sphere may represent a significant danger to our people.

On the other hand, it is also highly likely to contain valuable insights into the nature of dimensional travel.

astral_planes.15.desc.win.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的$tech_rift_sphere$技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
astral_planes.15.desc.win.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the $tech_rift_sphere$ technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

astral_planes.15.desc.win_delayed.zh:
鉴于我们最近对星界裂隙的研究，我们发现位于[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]的晶态球状物体与我们开发的$tech_rift_sphere$技术有很多相似之处。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有关维度旅行的珍贵线索。
astral_planes.15.desc.win_delayed.en:
In light of our recent research into Astral Rifts, we have discovered that the crystalline spherical object in [crystal_sphere_system.GetName] bares many similarities to the $tech_rift_sphere$ technology we have developed.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

astral_planes.2005.a.zh: 那就看看能找到什么吧……
astral_planes.2005.a.en: Let's see what we can find...

astral_planes.2005.desc.zh:
我们已经开发出了这种能在星界裂隙的折缝中穿行的科技：$tech_rift_sphere_plural$。

这种球体以高度先进、绝对光滑的纳米材料建成，可以在时空的乱流处无摩擦地滑行。

因为不知道所到地方的情况，每一艘$tech_rift_sphere$都会连接上一条锚定缆线。缆线连接在我们宇宙中的一艘科研船上，以便在发生意外时将我们拉回。
astral_planes.2005.desc.en:
We have developed technology that will allow us to slip between the folds of an Astral Rift: $tech_rift_sphere_plural$.

Constructed of a highly advanced, perfectly smooth nano-material, the Sphere is able to frictionlessly glide through turbulent areas of space and time.

As we are unsure where we will arrive, each $tech_rift_sphere$ is connected to an anchor cable. To pull us back in case of emergency, the cable is tethered to a Science Ship in our universe.

astral_planes.210.desc.zh:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName]从一趟寻找因终末而消失的星系的$ASTRAL_RIFT$探险中返回了。他熟悉的许多地方已经完全从本现实中消失了。

他还不确定自己回到的是不是正确的维度，显然是受到了一定的认知冲击。
astral_planes.210.desc.en:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName] returned from exploring an $ASTRAL_RIFT$ to find a galaxy lost to the End. Many of the places they knew have vanished completely from this existence.

They are still uncertain if they returned to the correct dimension at all, and appear to be experiencing a form of cognitive shock as a result.

astral_planes.2105.desc.zh:
从[From.solar_system.GetName]内星界裂隙的爆炸余波中，我们收到了一段奇怪的通讯。

[GetScientistPlural]们认为它源某个自远超裂隙本身的地方，且目前尚且只破译了其中的只言片语。
astral_planes.2105.desc.en:
In the aftermath of the exploration of the Astral Rift in [From.solar_system.GetName], a mysterious transmission was received.

Our [GetScientistPlural] have determined its origin to be from beyond the rift itself, and have only been able to translate a few words.

astral_planes.2110.desc.zh: ……与这个位面……同调……我们……会找到你……
astral_planes.2110.desc.en: ...attune... with the planes... we will find you...

astral_planes.2120.desc.zh:
近期的地震活动意外地让一处毗邻我们首都的远古撞击坑显露了其庐山真面目。

这座独一无二的坑洞一定与我们[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]物种的真正起源息息相关。
astral_planes.2120.desc.en:
Recent seismic activity has revealed unexpected features of the ancient impact site near our capital.

This specific crater has been linked to our very origin as [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

astral_planes.2125.desc.zh:
在撞击坑底部的初步发掘工作中，我们发现了一条深入地下深层的圆柱体撞击岩。

这一岩层必然源自某种类陨石体的极高速撞击。初步计算表明，该物体几乎是以高亚光速发生的碰撞。它的重见天日宛若奇迹。
astral_planes.2125.desc.en:
Initial excavations into the base of the crater revealed a fully-formed cylinder of impactite lodged deep into the earth.

This vein must have originated from a meteoric impact of extremely high velocity. Initial calculations demonstrate the object must have arrived at a measurable fraction of the speed of light. It's a wonder that it made it to the surface.

astral_planes.2130.desc.zh:
在撞击岩层的终点，我们发现了一座豁然开朗的洞穴系统。

地下水形成的水洼滋养着岩壁上灰暗纤弱的植被。在其中一个水池的地下，静静地躺着一个与众不同的球状物体。显然它不是自然生成的，而是这个撞击点的始作俑者。
astral_planes.2130.desc.en:
At the termination point of the impactite vein, we have discovered an expansive cave system.

Pools of underground water support thin lines of pale vegetation along the cavern walls. At the bottom of one of these pools lies the remnants of an anomalous spherical object. It is not a natural formation, and appears to be the source of this impact site.

astral_planes.2135.desc.zh:
我们从地下湖中取回了那个球体。

尽管被一些植被覆盖，其大部分仍保持得相当完整。其建造方式怪异地混杂着高度复杂的设计和粗糙的组装。完美光滑的金属板覆盖着舰船的前半部分，可以用来显著降低再入大气时的阻力。

它所处位置的弹道回推与撞击岩处于一条直线上，由此可以确认该球体就是那颗把我们带到此地的类陨石体。
astral_planes.2135.desc.en:
We have recovered the sphere from the underground lake.

While covered in vegetative growth, much of it remains fully intact. Its construction is a strange mix of highly sophisticated design and crude assembly. Perfectly smooth metallic plates cover the frontal portion of the ship, which must have reduced friction significantly upon atmospheric entry.

The trajectory of its resting site aligns with the vein of impactite, confirming that this sphere is the source of the metamorphic rock that led us here. Even more incredibly, there are signs that this vessel had passengers.

astral_planes.2140.a.synthetic.zh: 初锻我们的熔炉找到了。

astral_planes.2140.desc.default.zh:
$astral_planes.2140.desc.common$

通过一些研究，我们应该能够复制甚至改进用来建造这种具有跨越维度能力的船体的科技。
astral_planes.2140.desc.default.en:
$astral_planes.2140.desc.common$

With some study, we should be able to replicate and even improve upon the technology required to construct a vessel with these dimension-spanning capabilities.

astral_planes.2140.desc.has_rift_sphere.zh:
$astral_planes.2140.desc.common$

尽管显然比我们的科技低级，这座球体正是其建造者渴望和才智的见证。这是一种逃离裂隙另一侧悲惨命运的终极手段。
astral_planes.2140.desc.has_rift_sphere.en:
$astral_planes.2140.desc.common$

While clearly less advanced than our own tech, this sphere is a testament to its builders desperation and ingenuity. This was a final effort to escape what must have been a terrible fate on the far side of the rift.

astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.zh:
$astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.common$

通过一些研究，我们应该能够复制甚至改进用来建造这种具有跨越维度能力的船体的科技。
astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.en:
$astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.common$

With some study, we should be able to replicate and even improve upon the technology required to construct a vessel with these dimension-spanning capabilities.

astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.has_rift.zh:
$astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.common$

虽然显然没有我们自己的技术先进，但这个球体正是其建设者之绝望和创造力的见证。这是他们逃避裂隙彼端骇人命运的最后努力。
astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.has_rift.en:
$astral_planes.2140.desc.machine.common$

While clearly less advanced than our own tech, this sphere is a testament to its builders' desperation and ingenuity. This was a final effort to escape what must have been a terrible fate on the far side of the rift.

astral_planes.30.a.zh: 我们会时刻注意观察它。
astral_planes.30.a.en: We'll keep an eye on it.

astral_planes.30.desc.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

我们对它的目的和来源不甚知晓。或许，借由未来研究的进展，我们能够找到如何使用它的线索。
astral_planes.30.desc.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

We are unsure of its purpose or origin. Perhaps with some future research we can gain insight on how to approach it.

astral_planes.3000.desc.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
astral_planes.3000.desc.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

We have little time to investigate, as we are receiving transmissions from an unknown entity.

astral_planes.3005.a.zh: 我们被当作猎物，被诱惑到此地？
astral_planes.3005.a.en: Have we been lured here as prey?

astral_planes.3005.desc.zh: 这是什么……你带来了什么傻瓜来帮助你，沙达衮？或者……你给我们提供了食物……
astral_planes.3005.desc.en: what is this... what fools have you brought to aid you, shadagon? or perhaps... you have offered us food...

astral_planes.3015.desc.zh:
我们的舰队已经击败了守卫这个裂隙的奇怪船只，但似乎它们并不孤单。

我们收到了一段传输信号，来源于这个恒星系唯一行星旁边的建筑物内的存在。
astral_planes.3015.desc.en:
Our fleets have defeated the strange ships guarding this rift, but it seems they were not alone.

We have received a transmission from beings inhabiting a structure nearby the lone planet in this system.

astral_planes.3020.desc.zh: 更多的即将到来……我们必须封闭这个裂缝……我们是唯一剩下的人……
astral_planes.3020.desc.en: more are coming... we must seal this rift... we are all that remains...

astral_planes.3050.a.en: Could you make use of this?

astral_planes.3050.a.tt.zh: 如果我们能够提供大量的星界丝缕，这些生物肯定能够增强他们的防御能力。
astral_planes.3050.a.tt.en: If we were to deliver a large amount of astral thread, these beings could surely enhance their defenses.

astral_planes.3050.desc.zh: 我们是唯一剩下的人……我们必须重建……我们需要时间……
astral_planes.3050.desc.en: we are all that remains... we must rebuild... we need time...

astral_planes.3070.a.tt.zh: 被我们所知为无形异使的存在，已经被来自另一个位面的攻击者摧毁。位于$NAME_Formless_System$恒星系的传送门也被封印关闭。
astral_planes.3070.a.tt.en: The beings known as the Formless have been destroyed by attackers from another dimension. The portal into the $NAME_Formless_System$ system has sealed shut.

astral_planes.3070.desc.zh: 最后……退位……我们的链条被打破……目睹我们的上升……我们将找到他们隐藏的东西……
astral_planes.3070.desc.en: finally... abdication... our chains are broken... behold our ascension... we will find what they have hidden...

astral_planes.3100.a.desc.zh: 你知道我们……我们超越了裂缝……也属于裂缝……你已经见过了……
astral_planes.3100.a.desc.en: you know us... we are beyond the rifts... and of the rifts... you have seen...

astral_planes.3100.b.desc.zh: 我们的孩子……破碎的孩子……追捕我们……他们寻找王座……我们隐藏它……
astral_planes.3100.b.desc.en: our children... broken children... hunt us... they seek the throne... we hide it...

astral_planes.3100.c.desc.zh: 我们的永恒……我们的回忆……如果我们是血液……那就是心脏……现在安全了……我们感谢你……
astral_planes.3100.c.desc.en: our eternity... our memories... if we are the blood... it is the heart... safe now... we thank you...

astral_planes.3100.d.zh: 向我们臣服，你们将继续存活。
astral_planes.3100.d.en: Serve under us, and you may yet still live.

astral_planes.3100.desc.zh:
在不断变化的状态下，这个实体的可见形态在这个现实和另一个现实之间转换。祂的声音共鸣如众多的和声，仿佛同时代表着几个存在。

……完成了……封印已经设置完毕……我们的孩子再也找不到这个地方了……
astral_planes.3100.desc.en:
In a constant state of flux, this entity's visible form shifts between this reality and another. Their voice resonates as a harmonic multitude, as speaking on behalf of several beings at once.

... it is done... the seal is set... never shall our children find this place again...

astral_planes.3100.e.zh: 将你提到的“王座”交给我们。
astral_planes.3100.e.en: Give us this "Throne" you speak of.

astral_planes.3101.desc.zh: 这已经被预测……我们会向你们称臣……这是我们的命运……
astral_planes.3101.desc.en: this was predicted... we will serve you... this is our fate...

astral_planes.3102.desc.zh:
永恒王座……轮不到你来取得……
$astral_planes.3102.desc.fail$
astral_planes.3102.desc.en:
the eternal throne... it is not yours to take...
$astral_planes.3102.desc.fail$

astral_planes.3102.desc.fail.zh: 我们误判了你……极度悲伤……让它结束吧……
astral_planes.3102.desc.fail.en: we have misjudged you... great sorrow... let it be done...

astral_planes.3110.a.tt.zh: 将一支无形异使舰队交由你控制。
astral_planes.3110.a.tt.en: Grants a Formless fleet under your control.

astral_planes.3110.b.tt.zh: 获得一个随机物理学科技。

astral_planes.3110.d.desc.zh:
$NAME_Formless_leader$……永恒王座的建筑师……

祂花费了千年时间来制作……

一个将我们紧密联系在一起的装置……精致而永远……

它最适合为您服务……

再没有比您更聪明的了……
astral_planes.3110.d.desc.en:
$NAME_Formless_leader$... architect of the eternal throne...

it is that one that spent millennia in its making...

a device to bind us as one... delicate and forever...

that one is best suited to serve you...

there are none left more clever...

astral_planes.3110.h.desc.zh:
遗憾……

然而已经预见……

命运……

无需哀悼。
astral_planes.3110.h.desc.en:
regret...

yet foreseen...

destiny...

do not mourn...

astral_planes.3114.b.en: We'd like to ask something else.

astral_planes.3114.desc.aberrant.zh:
达伽尔……无视……充满愤怒……

我们的愤怒……显现……

他们的冲突永远不会结束……
astral_planes.3114.desc.aberrant.en:
dagaal... heedless... filled with rage...

our wrath... manifest...

their conflicts will never end...

astral_planes.3114.desc.unbidden.zh:
沙巴纳什……破碎的亲人……永远饥饿……

我们的贪婪……被放大……

罪恶被揭示……

一个巨大的耻辱……
astral_planes.3114.desc.unbidden.en:
shabanash... shattered kin... hungry always...

our greed... amplified...

sins brought to light...

a great shame...

astral_planes.3114.desc.vehement.zh:
盎宰……王座的追求者……

巨大的嫉妒……

我们被遗忘的概念……
astral_planes.3114.desc.vehement.en:
onzai... seekers of the throne...

great envy...

our forgotten concept...

astral_planes.3116.desc.zh: 完成了……你的调谐已经完工……
astral_planes.3116.desc.en: it is done... your attunement is complete...

astral_planes.3121.desc.zh:
沙达衮的$NAME_Formless_leader$……你怎么会在这里……

你将成为一顿盛宴……

来吧，与我们一同碰撞……
astral_planes.3121.desc.en:
$NAME_Formless_leader$ of shadagon... how is it you are here...

you will be a great feast...

come and break against us...

astral_planes.3122.desc.zh:
我们还没有结束……沙达衮的$NAME_Formless_leader$……

你救了你的亲族……但愚蠢地追求……傲慢……

见证愤怒……然后是遗忘……
astral_planes.3122.desc.en:
we are not finished... $NAME_Formless_leader$ of shadagon...

you have saved your kin... but foolishly pursue... hubris...

witness fury... then oblivion...

astral_planes.3123.desc.zh:
建筑师……沙达衮的$NAME_Formless_leader$……

我们将吞食你……吸收你的思维……

王座的秘密……你提供的伟大礼物……

现在加入我们……我们将尊重你……
astral_planes.3123.desc.en:
the architect... $NAME_Formless_leader$ of shadagon...

we will consume you...  incorporate your mind...

the secrets of the throne... a great gift you offer...

join us now... we will honor you...

astral_planes.3155.desc.zh: 我们针对无形异使的侵略行动，已经导致[this.GetName]放弃将舰队委任给我们，这些舰队重新加入他们的队列。
astral_planes.3155.desc.en: Our aggressive campaign against the Formless has caused [this.GetName] to abandon their assigned fleets, and rejoin their ranks.

astral_planes.3165.desc.zh:
我们已成功消灭了在[event_target:formless_system.GetName]中剩下的最后一批无形异使。

剩下的只有一个神秘的装置。一个人只需将自己的[this.species.GetHandNamePlural]放在上面，就能激活它神奇的再生特性。该装置作为一种通道进入星界位面，其中有大量的超维材料经由它自由流动。
astral_planes.3165.desc.en:
We have successfully exterminated the last of the remaining Formless in [event_target:formless_system.GetName].

All that remains is a mysterious device. One need simply place their [this.species.GetHandNamePlural] upon it to activate its miraculous regenerative properties. The device functions as a sort of conduit into the astral planes, with incredible quantities of extra-dimensional material flowing freely throughout it.

astral_planes.3170.desc.zh:
尽管我们知道你……
此刻尚未到我们相遇之时……
astral_planes.3170.desc.en:
though we know you...
it is not our time to meet...

astral_planes.45.desc.event_chain_owner.zh:
在[From.GetName]内附近的晶体裂隙处出现了一个异常的虫洞。

我们只能推测这是无形异使打开的一个星门，为他们带来援军。我们检测到另一侧的恒星系已经从其他地方被拉入我们的位面。

如果我们选择进入这个地方，我们应该准备我们最强大的舰队。
astral_planes.45.desc.event_chain_owner.en:
An anomalous wormhole has appeared nearby the Crystal Rift, in [From.GetName].

We can only assume that it is a gateway opened by the Formless to bring them aid. We detect the system on the other side has been pulled into our dimension from somewhere else.

We should prepare our strongest fleets if we choose to enter this place.

astral_planes.45.desc.locked.zh: 我们发现了一个异常的虫洞。无论我们的舰船试图靠近多近，都会被一股未知的力量推开。在[From.GetName]恒星系中发生了非常奇怪的事情。
astral_planes.45.desc.locked.en: We have discovered an anomalous wormhole. No matter how close our vessels attempt to proceed, we are being repelled by an unknown force. Something very odd is happening in the [From.GetName] system.

astral_planes.45.desc.unlocked.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个异常的虫洞。传感器显示它直接通往星系的中心。这怎么可能？
astral_planes.45.desc.unlocked.en: We have discovered an anomalous wormhole in [From.GetName]. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy. How is that possible?

astral_planes.50.desc.zh:
我们在[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]恒星系中发现的异常虫洞正在剧烈波动。传感器检测到它是通往星系中心的直接通道。

这怎么可能？
astral_planes.50.desc.en:
The anomalous wormhole we discovered in the [crystal_sphere_system.GetName] system is fluctuating wildly. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy.

How is that possible?

astral_planes.6000.desc.zh:
我们已经完成了对位于[FromFrom.System.GetName]的$pc_astral_scar$的分析。

它正在从其他地方向我们的宇宙泄漏物质。裂缝周围的物质并不是守恒的——至少从我们的测量方法上来说不是的。尽管处于相对微小的规模，但裂缝似乎增加了我们宇宙的总物质量。

研究这一现象应该能更好地理解这种无法解释的能源来源。
astral_planes.6000.desc.en:
We have completed our analysis of the $pc_astral_scar$ in [FromFrom.System.GetName].

It is leaking material into our universe from... somewhere else. Matter is not being conserved around the rift - at least not in any way that we can measure. Though on a relatively minute scale, somehow the rift is increasing the overall mass of our universe.

Researching this phenomenon should provide a greater understanding of this unaccounted for source of energy.

astral_planes.6001.a.zh: 另一边存在着怎样的奇景呢？

astral_planes.6001.desc.zh:
我们已经确认了在[FromFromFrom.System.GetName]恒星系中存在一个我们宇宙之外的宇宙。

通过裂缝，它的物质位面对我们自己的宇宙施加了巨大的压力，所造成的结果是有一小部分但稳定的物质流动。这一情况的长期效应我们尚未被理解，但在此期间，我们应继续分析其宇宙流出物。
astral_planes.6001.desc.en:
We have confirmed the existence of another universe beyond our own in the [FromFromFrom.System.GetName] system.

Through the rift, its physical dimensions are placing immense pressure on our own universe, the result of which is a small though steady flow of material. The long-term effects are yet to be understood, but in the meantime we should continue analyzing its cosmic effluence.

astral_planes.6006.desc.zh:
经过仔细分析，我们确认[From.System.GetName]中的$pc_astral_scar$异常不稳定，需要立即干预以防止该恒星系进一步坍缩为引力奇点。

可以考虑将大量喷射而出的$astral_threads$进行重定向、重新利用，以便“缝合”裂痕。这将修复时空的撕裂，并可能留下大量的星界物质。

或者，我们可以投射大量军火来扩大这处裂痕。我们预测，这么做将有助于我们探索伤痕另一边可能存在的事物。
astral_planes.6006.desc.en:
After careful analysis, we've confirmed that the $pc_astral_scar$ in [From.System.GetName] is dangerously unstable and requires immediate intervention to prevent further gravitational singularities forming in this system.

The powerful ejection of $astral_threads$ could be redirected and repurposed in order to 'stitch' the scar shut. This would repair the tear in space-time and likely leave behind a significant amount of astral material.

Alternatively, we could deliver a heavy payload of ordinance in an effort to widen the scar. We speculate that this would also allow for further exploration of what may be on the other side.

astral_planes.6007.desc.zh:
经过对其撕裂织构的精细操控，我们成功地完全封印了位于[From.System.GetName]的$pc_astral_scar$。引力异常自那时起停止，我们在整个过程中回收了大量的$astral_threads$。

无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
astral_planes.6007.desc.en:
After careful manipulation of its torn fabric, we've managed to fully seal the $pc_astral_scar$ in [From.System.GetName]. Gravitational anomalies have since stopped, and we've recovered a significant quantity of $astral_threads$ in the process.

Whatever reality was on the other side will no longer pose a danger to our own.

astral_planes.6008.desc.zh:
我们投送到到[From.System.GetName]的$pc_astral_scar$核心的军火扩大了时空的折叠。这里曾经只是宇宙织物中的一个小撕裂口，现在成为了一个更大的裂隙，能够让我们进入探索。

由此带来的稳定性使引力异常减弱，我们准备去发现隐藏在其中的事物。
astral_planes.6008.desc.en:
The ordinance we sent into the core of the $pc_astral_scar$ in [From.System.GetName] has widened the folds in space and time. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now a larger rift that we are capable of exploring.

The resulting stability has caused the gravitational anomalies to subside, and we are prepared to discover what lies beyond.

astral_planes.6009.desc.zh:
位于[FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName]的$pc_astral_scar$已经朝内坍缩了，并朝周边恒星系抛射出了大量的$astral_threads$。这里的宇宙织构曾经出现过一处小小的撕裂，但如今已经是虚无的太空。

无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
astral_planes.6009.desc.en:
The $pc_astral_scar$ in [FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName] has collapsed inwardly, ejecting a significant amount of $astral_threads$ into the nearby system. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now empty space.

Whatever reality was on the other side will no longer pose a danger to our own.

astral_planes.6010.b.zh: 重新改造这处标识为我们自己所用。
astral_planes.6010.b.en: Repurpose the sign for our own use.

astral_planes.6010.desc.zh:
我们在这颗小行星上发现的发光物体是一则广告。

这个巨大的展示装置由内部占据小行星的机械基础设施支持。小行星本身在空间中的某一点上异常地悬浮着，不受任何附近物体的引力影响。

广告本身是关于它所称之为“多重宇宙的最佳秀场”的内容。有一个终端可以接受能量币，使我们直接前往这个景点。
astral_planes.6010.desc.en:
The brightly lit object we discovered on this asteroid is an advertisement.

This massive display is supported by a mechanical infrastructure occupying the inside of the asteroid it is mounted on. The asteroid itself is anomalously suspended at one point in space, unaffected by the gravitational pull of any nearby object.

The advertisement itself is in reference to what it calls "The Greatest Show in the Multiverse".There is a terminal accepting energy credits for direct transport to the attraction.

astral_planes.6010.name.en: The Greatest Show in the Multiverse

astral_planes.6011.desc.zh: 在处理完我们的支付款项后，小行星内部的机械开始嗡嗡作响。一股刺眼的蓝光向外射出，精确地分开了时空的织构。当它运转结束时，小行星就消失了，而一道星界裂隙出现在了原地。
astral_planes.6011.desc.en: After processing our payment, the machinery within the asteroid whirred into life. A stream of piercing blue light shot outward, meticulously parting the fabric of space and time. Once its work was finished, the asteroid simply vanished, and an Astral Rift was left in its stead.

astral_planes.6012.desc.zh: 我们用深受认可的本地企业代替了[fromfrom.GetName]的古怪广告商。支付终端被仔细拆解后，我们在里面发现了一小批能量币。
astral_planes.6012.desc.en: We have replaced the anomalous advertisement with an endorsement for our own local businesses at [fromfrom.GetName]. The payment terminal was carefully dismantled, revealing a small cache of energy credits within.

astral_planes.6013.a.zh: 我们得好好利用这一切。
astral_planes.6013.a.en: We shall put these to good use.

astral_planes.6013.desc.zh: 小行星内部机械中所采纳的技术比我们最初预料的要先进。因此，我们的回收工作给我们带来了相当可观的价值。我们发现了各种稀有材料——其中包括数量惊人的$astral_threads$。这颗中空的小行星一定是被设计成能够以某种方式操纵空间和时间。
astral_planes.6013.desc.en: The technology within the asteroid's internal mechanisms were more advanced than initially suspected. As such, its salvage has rewarded us with considerable value. We have uncovered a variety of rare materials - including an anomalous quantity of $astral_threads$. The hollowed asteroid must have been designed to manipulate space and time in some fashion.

astral_planes.6020.a.en: Inject astral material into the singularity.

astral_planes.6020.b.en: Collect the thread from a safe distance.

astral_planes.6020.desc.zh:
某些由[from.System.GetName]的黑洞释放的粒子实际上是$astral_threads$。这意味着在某个时间点，星界细缝被拉入了黑洞的奇点，然后现在正在缓慢地被喷射出来。这样的事件以前被认为是不可能的。

或许，存在某种方式将高度聚集的$astral_threads$羽流导入奇点之中，从而让星界细缝被喷射出来，使这个恒星系的空间重新稳定。

然而，若是不采取进一步行动，我们可以继续从安全距离采集这些宇宙织物。
astral_planes.6020.desc.en:
Some of the particles being released by the black hole in [from.System.GetName] are, in fact, $astral_threads$. This means that at some point in time an Astral Scar was pulled into its singularity and is now slowly being ejected. Such an event was previously thought impossible.

There may be a way to eject the scar and restabilize this system's space by directing a highly concentrated stream of $astral_threads$ into the singularity.

However, taking no further action would allow us to continue harvesting the cosmic fabric from a safe distance.

astral_planes.6021.desc.zh:
将$astral_threads$注入奇点立马引起了剧烈的反应，由于黑洞的引力，大量的超维粒子喷涌而出。这些粒子已经聚集成一个悬浮在其引力井中的$astral_rift$。

这个天体异常点之前是如何被吸入奇点，我们仍然不了解，但现在我们至少可以调查一下裂隙的另一边有什么存在。
astral_planes.6021.desc.en:
The injection of $astral_threads$ into the singularity caused an immediate and violent reaction, as a flood of extra-dimensional particles poured forth from the gravitational pull of the black hole. These particles have coalesced into an $astral_rift$ that is now suspended within its gravity well.

How this celestial anomaly was ever sucked into the singularity in the first place remains unknown, but now we can at least investigate what lies on the other side.

astral_planes.6022.desc.zh:
[from.System.GetName]的黑洞将先前被其奇点吸收的$pc_astral_scar$抛射了出来，随之而来的还有大量被束缚的星界物质。

黑洞的引力现在变得正常了。
astral_planes.6022.desc.en:
The black hole in [from.System.GetName] has ejected the $pc_astral_scar$ that was temporarily absorbed into its singularity, along with a significant amount of trapped astral material.

The gravitational forces of the black hole have since normalized.

astral_planes.6040.b.en: Let them look to the black star.

astral_planes.6040.c.zh: 无论哪种视景都没有好处。

astral_planes.6045.desc.zh:
[this.GetName]上发生了灾难！

人们所经历的相互冲突的视景导致了大规模的动荡。竞相敌对的团体已经拿起了武器，局部的小规模冲突导致了全球范围内的暴力冲突。

这种情况不能继续下去。
astral_planes.6045.desc.en:
Disaster on [this.GetName]!

The contrasting visions experienced by the population have resulted in large-scale unrest. The competing groups have taken up arms, with local skirmishes leading to violent clashes all across the planet.

This can not be allowed to continue.

astral_planes.6060.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]的地表布满了有缺陷的军火，每次爆炸都会在行星上切割出一块块的碎片。

我们对这些武器十分陌生，其本身又是极其易爆的。此外，爆炸产生的图案表明了整个行星上埋藏这一个起爆网络。
astral_planes.6060.desc.en:
The surface of [from.GetName] is riddled with defective munitions, each carving out chunks of the planet as it detonates.

The weapons themselves are unfamiliar and extremely volatile. Furthermore, the pattern of the explosive discharges indicates a network of buried launch sites across the planet.

astral_planes.6065.b.zh: 试图回收这些古老的炸药。
astral_planes.6065.b.en: Attempt to recover the ancient explosives.

astral_planes.6065.desc.zh:
进一步的分析表明，这颗行星曾经被用作巨大的武器储存库。在静止了数千年之后，个别武器现在开始出现故障，将整个行星变成了一个不稳定的战场。

我们有能力以受控的方式触发所有剩余的弹药。或者，我们可以尝试提取一些武器并在它们爆炸之前将其停用。
astral_planes.6065.desc.en:
Further analysis indicates that this planet was once used as an enormous weapons cache. Having sat inactive for thousands of years, individual weapons are now beginning to malfunction, turning the entire planet into an unstable battlefield.

We have the capacity to trigger all remaining munitions in a controlled manner. Alternatively, we could attempt to extract some of the weapons and deactivate them before they explode.

astral_planes.6070.desc.no_rift.zh:
$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_1$

由此引发的爆炸十分强大，不仅摧毁了行星，还在时空织构中撕扯出了一处裂口，导致了一个我们现在称之为$astral_rift$的形成。

$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_2$
astral_planes.6070.desc.no_rift.en:
$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_1$

The resulting explosion was so strong that it not only destroyed the planet, but also tore a hole in the fabric of space-time, resulting in the formation of what we are calling an $astral_rift$.

$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_2$

astral_planes.6070.desc.rift.zh:
$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_1$

由此引发的爆炸十分强大，不仅摧毁了行星，还产生了一道新的$astral_rift$。

$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_2$
astral_planes.6070.desc.rift.en:
$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_1$

The resulting explosion was so strong that it not only destroyed the planet, but resulted in the formation of a new $astral_rift$.

$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_2$

astral_planes.6075.desc.zh:
我们能够为存储在行星表面的武器建立一个提取管线，将处于激活状态的军火变为惰性状态，然后准备收集和分析它们。

在这个行星上建立一个永久殖民地将使我们能够更高效地利用剩余的储藏。
astral_planes.6075.desc.en:
We were able to create an extraction pipeline for the weapons stored within the planet's surface, rendering active munitions inert before preparing them for collection and analysis.

Establishing a permanent colony on this planet would allow us to take advantage of the remaining cache more efficiently.

astral_planes.6080.desc.no_rift.zh:
$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_1$

由此引发的爆炸十分强大，不仅摧毁了行星，还在时空织构中撕扯出了一处裂口，导致了一个我们现在称之为$astral_rift$的形成。

$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_2$
astral_planes.6080.desc.no_rift.en:
$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_1$

The resulting cascade was so violent that it not only destroyed the planet, but also tore a whole in the fabric of space-time, resulting in the formation of what we are calling an $astral_rift$.

$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_2$

astral_planes.6080.desc.rift.zh:
$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_1$

由此引发的爆炸十分强大，不仅摧毁了行星，还产生了一道新的$astral_rift$。

$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_2$
astral_planes.6080.desc.rift.en:
$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_1$

The resulting cascade was so violent that it not only destroyed the world, but has resulted in the formation of a new $astral_rift$.

$astral_planes.6070.desc.common_2$

astral_planes.6085.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]上的不稳定武器由于自发爆炸引发了一连串的连锁反应，导致该行星完全破裂。

在残骸中，我们发现了大量的$volatile_motes$。这种资源一定是存储在地表下的武器的关键组成部分。
astral_planes.6085.desc.en:
The spontaneous explosions of unstable weapons on [from.GetName] culminated in a chain reaction that caused the planet to completely break apart.

Among the debris, we have detected a significant concentration of $volatile_motes$. This resource must have formed a key component of the weapons stored beneath the surface.

astral_planes.6100.desc.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
astral_planes.6100.desc.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

astral_planes.6105.a.response.zh: 我最后的记忆是在心宿二星系。当时我和一群朋友在一起进行舰队行动，突然看到了一束强光。那之后就什么都不记得了。我是坐着逃生舱来的。孤独且无友。
astral_planes.6105.a.response.en: My last memory is of the Antares System. I was engaged in a fleet action with a group of Friends when I saw a bright light. After that there is nothing. I arrived here in my escape pod. Alone and Friendless.

astral_planes.6105.b.zh: 你为什么对人类如此感兴趣？
astral_planes.6105.b.en: Why are you so fascinated with Humans?

astral_planes.6105.b.response.zh: 噢，人类，最美妙的生物。我们布洛葛已经关注了他们几个世纪。其实，我们文化的大部分都是基于对人类生活的观察。色彩！戏剧！友谊！他们教会我们生活远不只是生存，甚至还可以交朋友！这个概念真是绝妙，简直可以说是奇迹！
astral_planes.6105.b.response.en: Oh Humans are the most wondrous of creatures. We Blorg have been observing them for centuries. In fact, much of our culture is based on what we have observed of Human life. The color! The drama! The Friendship! They have taught us that life is about more than simple survival. You can also make Friends! What a wonderful concept. What a marvel!

astral_planes.6105.c.en: What can you do for us?

astral_planes.6105.c.response.zh: 这问题可真不友好，但我有求必应！当然，我有着上百年的驾驶科研船的经验，但我真正醉心的是跨星系关系。把我当成朋友，我可以帮你们交上更多的朋友。拜托了，如果你们感兴趣的话，务必让我代表你们的外交利益！
astral_planes.6105.c.response.en: Not a very Friendly question, but if service is required, then I stand ready! Of course, I have centuries of experience captaining research vessels, but my true passion is intergalactic relations. By being your Friend I can help you to make other Friends in the process. Please, if you will have me, let me represent your diplomatic interests!

astral_planes.6105.desc.human.zh:
这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。在注意到我们之后，她几乎要猛扑上来，然后又控制住了自己。

你们、你们是人类！？*尖叫*我——我太抱歉了，从我还是一只萌孢的时候就对你们的文化超级感兴趣！

这只外星人伸出了一只触手，令人尴尬地尝试模仿握手动作。

我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，很高兴见到你们。
astral_planes.6105.desc.human.en:
The repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Upon registering us, it makes a lunging movement before restraining itself.

Y- You- You are Humans!? *Squeee* I- I am sorry, I have been fascinated with your culture ever since I was a little sporeling!

The alien extends a tentacle in an awkward attempt to mimic a handshake.

My name is Mercedes Romero and it is my pleasure to meet you.

astral_planes.6105.desc.reg.zh:
这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。这只生物突然回过神来，挥动触角自我介绍道:

啊？怎么？这是哪？抱歉。我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，是布洛葛合众国的探险家和外交官。你听说过人类吗？
astral_planes.6105.desc.reg.en:
The repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Abruptly regaining composure, with a flourish of tentacles the creature introduces itself: 

What- Whe- Where am I? I am sorry. My name is Mercedes Romero, explorer and diplomat of the Blorg Commmonality. Do you know of the Humans?

astral_planes.6105.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_Mercedes$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
astral_planes.6105.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_Mercedes$ joins our empire as a Leader.

astral_rift.10.c.zh: 这场仗没有胜算。我们再去跟保守主义者们谈谈吧。
astral_rift.10.c.en: This war is hopeless. Let us visit the preservationists.

astral_rift.10.d.zh: 这是在以卵击石。我们还是回到自己的新世界吧。
astral_rift.10.d.en: This is a lost cause. Let us return to the new world.

astral_rift.10.desc.common.zh:
“你们的到来让我们的人民为之一振。你们的雪中送炭，让我们终于有希望彻底结束这场战争。”他们的剩余舰队早已破败不堪，再也承受不起一丁点损失。

我们可以在裂隙能保持稳定的限度内，通过锚缆传输不多的补给物资。供给一批能解燃眉之急的合金能解决舰队的维修和升级问题。他们建造的舰队更加先进，我们也可以在这个过程中学到相关的设计。

因为时间有限，更明智的选择则是将我们对星界丝缕的深刻理解用于增强他们舰队的护盾。虽然这只是一种实验性的举措，但在这里取得的突破也可以使我们自己的舰队受益匪浅。据我们所知，这些入侵者偏好能量武器，所以这里的任何改进都会大有帮助。
astral_rift.10.desc.common.en:
"Your arrival has inspired our people. Give us the critical aid we need, and we yet have a chance to end this war once and for all." Their remaining fleets are in poor condition and cannot withstand another loss.

We should be able to send a limited amount of supplies through the anchor cable before the rift becomes too unstable. A shipment of direly needed alloys will help with fleet repairs and enhancements. Given the advanced construction of their ships, we may learn something of their designs along the way.

A wiser use of our time may be to apply our more advanced knowledge of astral thread into enhancing their ship's shields. While experimental in nature, we may make some breakthroughs here that could benefit our own fleets. It is our understanding that the invaders favor energy weapons, so any improvements here would go a long way.

astral_rift.100.desc.zh:
我们发现自己身陷于一座前不见头后不见尾的互相联通的舱室网络。

这里的地面是光亮透明的电路板。肉眼可见的能量顺着导体的支路网络流淌着。

这座无尽长廊好像在无限地自我重复，毫无变化。目前的探索一筹莫展，建议另辟蹊径。
astral_rift.100.desc.en:
We have found ourselves encased in a network of interconnected chambers with no clear ending or beginning.

The floor surfaces here are a glassy circuit board. A visible current of energy can be seen flowing through a grid of branching conduits.

The corridors here seem as if they infinitely repeat themselves with no significant variation. We are making no progress with our current exploration. Making our own path is advised.

astral_rift.1000.a.zh: 用人工智能检测隐藏规律。
astral_rift.1000.a.en: Utilize A.I. to check for hidden patterns.

astral_rift.1000.desc.default.zh:
我们的$tech_rift_sphere$发回的报告没有包含我们[Explorer.GetScientistPlural]的[Leader.GetMechanicalBiological]签名。

$astral_rift.1000.desc$
astral_rift.1000.desc.default.en:
The report received from our $tech_rift_sphere$ contains no record of our [Explorer.GetScientistPlural]'s [Leader.GetMechanicalBiological] signature.

$astral_rift.1000.desc$

astral_rift.1005.desc.zh:
我们能破译出的后两个单词是“家园”和“目击”。令人惊讶的是，随着我们对这些怪异数据理解的深入，我们还发现了嵌入在噪音中的视觉数据的存在。

$astral_rift.1005.desc.common$
astral_rift.1005.desc.en:
The next two words we were able to decode were "home" and "witness". Amazingly, as our understanding of the alien data improves, we also discovered the existence of visual data embedded within the noise.

$astral_rift.1005.desc.common$

astral_rift.1006.desc.zh:
在额外的计算支持下，我们处理了他们传输回的数据。这些数据其实是通讯，不是任何的攻击或什么别的。我们收到的数据是以一个运动图像序列讲述的故事。

$astral_rift.1005.desc.common$
astral_rift.1006.desc.en:
With the extra computational support, we have processed the data they are streaming to us. It is in fact a communication; it was not an attack of any kind. The data we are receiving tells us a story in a sequence of moving images.

$astral_rift.1005.desc.common$

astral_rift.1010.b.zh: 赶紧出来！我们只是暂时惊住了它。
astral_rift.1010.b.en: Get out! We've only stunned it.

astral_rift.1010.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.1010.desc.common.1$

船员都生龙活虎的，但没有人记得球体失控的事情。

$astral_rift.1010.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1010.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.1010.desc.common.1$

The crew is alive and well. However, none of them have any memory of losing control of the Sphere.

$astral_rift.1010.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1015.desc.zh:
更多的图像。

我们非常详细地看到了这个外星家园的编年史。

这些生物是几千年前由聚集在一个巨大的星界裂隙附近的气体和能量的偶然结合而形成的。他们能像大气层的一部分般自由地进出他们的星球。

在每个生命周期结束时，它们的精华会分散到行星上，重新诞生。天空中的城市崛起，陨落，又复兴。文明是在先前文明的基础上形成的，其知识是由这些祖先粒子在物理上维持的。时间流逝的程度被可靠地估计为比我们已知宇宙的历史还要大的数量级。

最后，我们看到了一个觉醒的高等生物的文明。它们的生理机能比我们能想到的任何技术都要先进。

我们在数据库中记录了这个新物种，命名为无形者。

“繁荣……”

再一次，我们接收的数据比我们的计算机在损坏或丢失之前能够合理处理的数据还要多。我们应该优先考虑我们想要保存的信息类型。
astral_rift.1015.desc.en:
More images.

A chronicle of this alien homeworld was shown to us in great detail.

These beings formed millennia ago by a chance combination of gases and energy that accumulated nearby a massive Astral Rift. They flow freely in and out of their planet as if they were part of its atmosphere.

At the end of each life cycle, their essence disperses back into the planet and gets born anew. Cities in the sky rose, fell, and rose again. Civilizations formed on top of previous civilizations with the knowledge physically maintained by these ancestral particles. The degree of the time passing was safely estimated to be magnitudes greater than the history of our known universe.

In the end, we behold a civilization of awakened higher beings. Their physiology alone is more advanced than any technology we could conceive.

We have logged this new species in our databases as the Formless.

"flourishing..."

Once again, we're receiving more data than our computers can reasonably handle before it becomes corrupted or lost. We should prioritize the type of information we'd like to preserve.

astral_rift.1020.a.zh: 我们打开了一个传送门……

astral_rift.1020.desc.zh:
它们的气态母行星向我们展示了越来越多的细节。这一次，我们看到了它的个体居民。光、气体和星界物质构成的存在从附近的裂隙泄漏出来，生活在一个可谓是乌托邦的地方。

最终，一座伟大的建筑建成了。这项令人难以置信的工程直接从他们的星球延伸到裂隙，使他们能够轻松地在这个维度和无数其他维度之间旅行。在这两个位面之间有这样一条星界管路存在了这么长时间，他们塑造了许多裂隙来满足他们的特殊需求。他们的社会在多个维度之间延伸，殖民整个宇宙，就像我们殖民新行星一样。

然而，他们最大的成就也是他们最大的灾难。他们的帝国扩张得比星界管路所能维持的还要远。这个巨型结构越来越亮，直到目不能视，最终在一次跨越维度的灾难中猛烈地爆炸，彻底摧毁了他们的文明。

“破碎的亲缘……”

“战争……”

”帮助我们……”

我们的$tech_rift_sphere$被强行拉出裂谷。一个维度传送门在[solar_system.GetName]恒星系中徐徐打开。
astral_rift.1020.desc.en:
Their gaseous homeworld was revealed to us in more and more detail. This time, we see its individual inhabitants. Beings of light, gas, and astral material leaked from the nearby rift are living in what could easily be described as a utopia.

Eventually, a great structure was raised. An incredible piece of engineering, it stretched directly from their planet into the rift, allowing them to easily travel between this dimension and countless others. With such an astral conduit existing for so long between the planes, they have shaped many rifts to fit their specific needs. Their society stretched between a multitude of dimensions, colonizing entire universes as we would new planets.

However, their greatest achievement was also their greatest disaster. Their empire spread further than the astral conduit could maintain. Brighter and brighter the megastructure grew until the sight of it was difficult to look upon without shielding one's eyes, until it finally burst violently in a dimension-spanning explosion that fractured their civilization.

"shattered kin..."

"war..."

"help us..."

Our $tech_rift_sphere$ has been forcibly ejected from the Rift. A dimensional portal is now opening in the [solar_system.GetName] System.

astral_rift.1025.desc.zh:
系统重新上线后，我们可以拉回锚链，从那个晶体裂隙里的生物处逃离。

我们不知道他们还会对我们施加什么进一步的操纵力量，但最好还是不要知道的好。

幸运的是，它在我们的船体上留下的残留物是极其密集的星界物质。
astral_rift.1025.desc.en:
With our systems re-enabled, we've retracted the anchor cable and escaped from the creature inside of the Crystal Rift.

It is unknown what further powers of manipulation they would have deployed on us, and it is best not to find out.

On a fortunate note, the residue it left on the hull of our vessel is extremely dense with astral material.

astral_rift.1030.desc.zh:
一个最近在我们首都星系构建起来的星门将我们的人民置于高度的危险之中。

幸运的是，我们通过研究星界裂隙得到的科技可以用来永远的封上这个危险。

究竟是什么东西想从这里出来仍是个谜。

我们的人民认为这是对一个深不可测的强大敌人的伟大胜利。
astral_rift.1030.desc.en:
A gateway was nearly established in our capital system that placed our people in great danger.

Luckily, with technology we have gained from studying Astral Rifts, we were able to successfully seal this danger permanently.

Whatever was seeking to come through will remain a mystery.

Our people consider this a great victory over an unfathomably powerful enemy.

astral_rift.105.desc.zh:
我们没能打穿地面。它的构成与我们所知的任何透明材料均不相同。暴力无法使其变形，甚至无法在表面留下任何痕迹。

然而，经过一番努力，我们成功的在其中一个管线上用等离子钻打出了一个小小的洞。导通电路的是一种高度浓缩的密织的星界纤维混合物。

和这个发现一样有趣的是，我们也许不可能用这样的方式在地上打开一个通道。我们还得回到正常的探索方式。
astral_rift.105.desc.en:
Our initial attempts to break through the floor were unsuccessful. Its composition is unlike any known transparent material we have on record. Blunt force will not deform or blemish the surface.

However, with a considerable amount of effort, we succeeded in creating a small hole through one of the conduits with a plasma drill. Flowing through the circuitry is a highly concentrated mixture of tightly-woven astral fabric.

As interesting as this discovery is, it does not seem practical to carve our own passageway through this floor. We will return to exploring in a more traditional manner.

astral_rift.110.desc.zh:
虽然墙体并不难破坏，但是这种破坏是暂时性的。

无论从墙上移走多少材料，基本建筑材料组成的晶体网络很快就开始自我编织、层层堆叠起来，形成一个与原有的东西非常接近的结构。我们可以看到我们下方的能量通路向着被我们破坏的地方导通着能量。

和这个发现一样有趣的是，我们也许不可能用这样的方式在墙上打开一个通道。我们还得回到正常的探索方式。
astral_rift.110.desc.en:
The walls here are easily deconstructed, but this is short-lived.

Very soon after any amount of material is removed from the walls, a crystalline network of rudimentary construction materials begins weaving and layering itself on top of one another into a close approximation of what existed before. We can see energy in the conduits below us flow toward the site of each of our deconstructions.

As interesting as this discovery is, it does not seem practical to carve our own passageway through this floor. We will return to exploring in a more traditional manner.

astral_rift.1100.desc.zh:
我们的探测器发现了一窝巨大的的蛋，每一颗都有$tech_rift_sphere$那么大。这些蛋预计很快就要孵化，这样一来这种我们连其近亲是什么样都不了解的生物很快就要慢行星都是了。我们探测不到这颗行星上生活着其他生物，所以该物种的生长周期也扑朔迷离。

在这颗几乎荒芜的行星上，生态系统并不像能维持这么庞大种群数量的样子。对此我们的主要猜想是该物种遵循着某种星际迁徙模式。因为该物种的成体目前必然是在星球之外。
astral_rift.1100.desc.en:
Our probe has discovered a clutch of giant eggs, each as big as the $tech_rift_sphere$. They are expected to hatch imminently, and when they do the planet will be crawling with creatures we know next to nothing about. We can detect no other living specimens on the planet, so the growth cycle of this species is unknown to us.

Mostly barren, this planet's ecosystem does not seem capable of supporting a thriving population. Our leading theory is that this species follows an interstellar migration pattern. The adults of the species must therefore currently be off-world.

astral_rift.1105.desc.zh:
蛋正在孵化。

巨大的有翼生物纷纷破壳而出。它们生下来便具有飞行能力，一大群一大群地在空中畅游，巨大的翅膀在大陆上投下片片阴影。他们在大气层中扶摇直上，似乎正在追逐着星光。

我们还未观测到它们的进食行为，着可能表明它们是以某种形式的光合作用获取的能量。它们的生理学特性带来了许多疑问。
astral_rift.1105.desc.en:
The eggs are hatching.

Massive, winged creatures are emerging from the shells. They are born with the ability to fly, swarming the skies in huge flocks, their enormous wings casting shadows across the landscape. They climb high into the atmosphere, seemingly attracted to the starlight.

We have yet to observe them feed, which could indicate that they draw energy via some form of photosynthesis. Their physiology raises many questions.

astral_rift.1110.b.evopred.zh: 既非鸟类亦非节肢动物。真奇特。
astral_rift.1110.b.evopred.en: Neither Avian or Arthropoid. Very peculiar.

astral_rift.1110.c.bio.zh: 这和我们的舰船可差不多！
astral_rift.1110.c.bio.en: They are comparable to our ships!

astral_rift.1110.desc.zh:
在我们靠近时这些生物没有感到害怕，也许是在他们孤立的栖息地没有什么猎食者的缘故。

他们好奇地围绕着我们飞行，因此我们很容易从这些生物和卵的残余物中取样。它们长有光伏鳞片，可以从恒星中获得所有必要的给养。它们的身体也具有很强的抗压性，表明它们能够长时间抵抗宇宙中的真空环境。这些生物很有可能已经进化到能够进行长时间的太空飞行。
astral_rift.1110.desc.en:
The creatures showed no fear as we approached them, probably due to a lack of predators within their isolated habitat.

We were able to easily take samples from the beings and the remains of their eggs as they flew curiously around us. They have photovoltaic scales, allowing them to gain all necessary sustenance from their star. Their bodies are also highly resistant to pressure, indicating an ability to withstand the vacuum of space for long periods of time. It is highly likely that these creatures have evolved to be capable of prolonged space flight.

astral_rift.1115.desc.zh:
观察这些幼体的初次飞行很有启发性。

它们像恒星帆一样拍打着翅膀，熟练地加速到非常快，在上层大气中嬉戏打闹时不断来回滑翔俯冲。

他们不受重力束缚，能像爬到上层大气一般跨越宇宙空间。
astral_rift.1115.desc.en:
Observing the first flight of these infant creatures is illuminating.

They flap their wings like solar sails, masterfully accelerating to great speeds, gliding and swooping as they play together in the upper atmosphere.

They are unbound by gravity, capable of traversing space in the same way they effortlessly climb through the atmosphere.

astral_rift.1120.desc.zh:
在对这些幼雏的行为模式进行进一步研究的过程中，一只比战列舰还大的个体倏然而至。那些生物纷纷围绕了过去，争抢地想要接近这只巨兽。似乎这就是同一物种的一只成体。

这颗隐蔽的星球看来是这些跨次元生物的安全筑巢区。在我们的注视下，那只成体赶着幼雏朝上层大气中新形成的裂缝飞去。

它们穿过裂缝时留下了一道空间扰动的涟漪，以及大量的$astral_threads$。
astral_rift.1120.desc.en:
While conducting further research into the behavioral patterns of the hatchlings, a being larger than a battleship suddenly phased into existence. The creatures flocked around it, tussling among themselves to get closer to the giant. It appears to be a mature member of the same species.

This secluded planet must therefore serve as a safe nesting area for these trans-dimensional beings. As we watched, the adult herded the young toward a newly formed rift in the upper atmosphere.

Their passage left a rippling wake of spatial disruption, as well as a large concentration of $astral_threads$.

astral_rift.115.desc.glass.zh:
$astral_rift.115.desc.common.1$

警报记录记录了我们最近钻穿地面的位置，还包括了当时的监控录像。

$astral_rift.115.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.115.desc.glass.en:
$astral_rift.115.desc.common.1$

An alert was logged in the vicinity of our recent drilling through the floor, including video surveillance of ourselves in the act.

$astral_rift.115.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.115.desc.walls.zh:
$astral_rift.115.desc.common.1$

警报记录记录了我们最近拆墙的位置，还包括了我们拆墙时的监控录像。

$astral_rift.115.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.115.desc.walls.en:
$astral_rift.115.desc.common.1$

An alert was logged in the vicinity of our recent wall deconstruction, including video surveillance of ourselves in the act.

$astral_rift.115.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.120.desc.zh:
破解终端的过程中一个失效保护措施被触发了，这个房间瞬间被一种扩张性的泡沫状物质淹没。还没有人来得及帮上[Leader.GetName]，[Leader.GetHeShe][Leader.GetWasWere]就被完全包裹住了。多次尝试解救[Leader.GetHimHer]也毫无成效，这些材料一经移除又会快速自发归位。

我们按照标准流程拉动紧急锚链，取回了$tech_rift_sphere$和已收集到的样本。
astral_rift.120.desc.en:
In the process of decoding the terminal, a failsafe was triggered and the entire room quickly filled with an expansive foam-like material. Before anyone could assist [Leader.GetName], [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetWasWere] completely encased. Any attempts to uncover [Leader.GetHimHer] were fruitless, as what material could be removed was instantly replaced.

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the emergency anchor and recovered the $tech_rift_sphere$ and its collected samples.

astral_rift.1200.desc.zh:
在球体穿过裂隙时，我们经历了一阵剧烈的加速。

这个宇宙的巨大引力把我们拉了进去。在经历了一段不舒服又危险的旅程后，我们发现自己漂浮在一个密集的星系群中，每一个星系都在我们球体有限的传感器范围内。据我们所知，这似乎构成了整个宇宙。

初步报告还指出这里的暗物质的含量很高；更重要的是，质量还在不断增加。直接的结果是，随着时间的推移，引力正在增强。
astral_rift.1200.desc.en:
As our Sphere passed through the rift, we experienced a wild burst of acceleration.

The tremendous gravity of this universe was pulling us in. After an uncomfortable and dangerous ride, we found ourselves floating within a dense cluster of star systems, every one of which was within range of our Sphere's limited sensors. As far as we can tell, these comprise the totality of this universe.

Initial reports also indicate high levels of dark matter; what's more, this mass is constantly increasing. As a direct consequence, the forces of gravity are intensifying over time.

astral_rift.1205.desc.zh:
这个宇宙的尺寸正在皱缩，我们预测它会在某一时刻将完全坍缩。

问题是我们无法准确地计算出这种情况何时会发生。自从我们到达之后，球体的系统一直表现得很奇怪，计算机核心上的许多数据点都消失了，如同从来没有被写入过一般。

在其他地方，人们观察到一株盆栽植物收起了根，又变成了种子。时间在这里显然是不稳定的。
astral_rift.1205.desc.en:
This universe is shrinking in size. In due time, we predict it will completely collapse into itself.

The problem is that we cannot accurately calculate when this will occur. The Sphere's systems have been acting strangely since we arrived, and various data points have disappeared from the computer core. It is as if the data itself has been unwritten.

Elsewhere, a potted plant was observed lifting its roots and returning to a seed. The flow of time is clearly unstable here.

astral_rift.1210.desc.default.zh:
皱缩的行星和丢失的数据还只是问题的开始。这些麻烦逐渐影响到了船员的记忆，许多人开始感到困惑，忘记自己在做什么研究或者甚至忘记了自己进入过裂隙。

$astral_rift.1210.desc.common$
astral_rift.1210.desc.default.en:
Shrinking plants and lost data were only the start of our issues. The trouble has spread to the memory of the crew, with many appearing confused, forgetting what they were working on, or even that they entered the rift at all.

$astral_rift.1210.desc.common$

astral_rift.1210.desc.gestalt.zh:
皱缩的行星和丢失的数据还只是问题的开始。裂隙另一端的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]还遭遇了一些异常的事件。集体经验变得困惑，我们发现非常难以进行同步。

$astral_rift.1210.desc.common$
astral_rift.1210.desc.gestalt.en:
Shrinking plants and lost data were only the start of our issues. The [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural] on the far side of the rift are experiencing something unusual. Our collective experience is growing confused, and we are finding it increasingly difficult to synchronize.

$astral_rift.1210.desc.common$

astral_rift.1215.desc.zh:
[fleet.ship.GetName]迅速作出了反应；我们现在定期发送最新消息，并成功地保存了我们迄今为止收集到的数据。

不幸的是，我们仍然暴露在异常时间流中，而且影响越来越强……

随着我们的宇航员衰老的迹象越来越明显，我们要从这个宇宙中战略性地撤退，以免为时过晚。
astral_rift.1215.desc.en:
The [fleet.ship.GetName] was prompt to respond; we are now sending updates at regular intervals. This has successfully preserved the data we've collected thus far.

Unfortunately, we're still exposed to the anomalous temporal flow, and the effects are getting stronger...

With significant and accelerating signs of de-aging in our crew, we are tactically retreating from this universe before it is too late.

astral_rift.1220.b.en: Observe from the edge of the universe.

astral_rift.1220.desc.zh:
$tech_rift_sphere$的船体成功地进行了重极化。我们现在可以与最极端的时间膨胀效应隔绝开了。我们的思维模式回归到了正常，任务得以继续进行。

我们现在准备对这个宇宙的独特物理进行充分研究。

我们可以驶近其中一颗恒星，直接观测它的“反诞生”。
astral_rift.1220.desc.en:
The $tech_rift_sphere$'s hull has been successfully repolarized. We are now well isolated from the most extreme effects of the time dilation. Our thought patterns have returned to normal and we are able to continue the mission.

We are now prepared to study the unique physics of this universe more fully.

We could navigate closer toward one of the stars for direct observation of its 'unbirthing.' On the other hand, the very edge of existence would be a perfect vantage point to watch the end of time.

astral_rift.1225.a.zh: 过了这个村就没这个店了。
astral_rift.1225.a.en: There may never be another chance.

astral_rift.1225.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.1225.desc.common$

船员们目睹这一奇妙现象时的兴奋溢于言表。
astral_rift.1225.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.1225.desc.common$

The crew's excitement at witnessing this wonderful phenomenon is palpable.

astral_rift.1230.desc.zh:
我们已经超越了宇宙的视界，这是通常不可能实现的壮举。

在宇宙的边缘，是一种超越一切理性的绝对的虚无。

向中心望去，我们看到一切都汇聚到空间的一个点上。结果我们收集到的物理数据简直是天文数字。

然而，再拖延下去可能是致命的错误，我们要马上回来。
astral_rift.1230.desc.en:
We have traveled far beyond the cosmic horizon, a feat that would normally be impossible for us to achieve.

At the edge of the universe was an absolute nothingness that extended past all rationality.

Looking towards the center, we witnessed everything coalesce toward a single point in space. The physics data we have collected as a result is literally astronomical.

However, lingering any further might prove a fatal mistake, and we are returning immediately.

astral_rift.1235.desc.zh:
再也没有什么星星了。

我们成功地记录了诞生的每一个细节，由终至始。构成燃烧核心物质现在是一团原子迷雾的涡流。从中获取的物理知识不可估量。

然而，再拖延下去可能是致命的错误，我们要马上回来。
astral_rift.1235.desc.en:
The star is no more.

We have managed to record almost every moment of its creation, from end to beginning. What once comprised a burning core is now a swirling mist of atoms. The physics knowledge we have gained is invaluable.

However, lingering any further might prove a fatal mistake, and we are returning immediately.

astral_rift.125.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]能反编译这些代码。这些程序语言高度先进，算法优雅简明。

这整座建筑都是由程序生成的。

尽管我们还没完全破译其模式，但毫无疑问这里的环境是遵从着某种规则。我们取回了一些建材样品，它们呈现出一些自我复制的特性。尽管仍需要进一步测试，我们推测把这种材料放在任意位置并施加正确的引导将能够重建出与这个长廊相似的一整个新体系。
astral_rift.125.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] able to decompile the code. The programming language itself is highly advanced and the algorithms have an elegant simplicity.

This entire structure has been procedurally generated.

Though we have not fully deciphered its patterns, there is very clearly a set of rules this environment is following. We are taking back samples of the building materials which have shown to possess some unique self replicating properties. Further testing is required, but we theorize that placing this material in any location and applying the correct instructions will generate an entirely new system of similar corridors.

astral_rift.130.desc.zh:
我们把这台电脑终端拆解成了零件。

在它的线路中找到了数量可观的星界丝缕。

所以这台机器原来到底用来干什么的我们已经不关心了。
astral_rift.130.desc.en:
We have disassembled the computer terminal for its parts.

A remarkable amount of astral thread was recovered flowing through its circuitry.

Whatever purpose this machine had is no longer our concern.

astral_rift.1300.desc.zh:
我们的$tech_rift_sphere$被淹没在一种粘稠的红色液体中。在我们周围漂浮着巨大的圆盘状固体物质，但到目前为止，我们还没有与它们相撞。一层半凝胶状物质的固体墙四面包围着我们。我们轻松地滑行。

我们从裂隙中感受到的有节奏的脉冲与我们周围液体的谐波频率是同步的。每隔三秒钟，我们就会被一股压力向前推进，迫使我们更深地进入管状系统。我们的引擎很难抵抗液流。

这是一个收集样本的好机会，但这些的设备可能会阻碍我们在扭曲的隧道中航行。
astral_rift.1300.desc.en:
Our $tech_rift_sphere$ has arrived submerged inside of a viscous, reddish fluid. All around us drift large disc-shaped blobs of more solid matter, but we have avoided collision with them thus far. A solid wall of a semi-gelatinous material surrounds us on all sides. We glide along easily.

The rhythmic pulsing we sensed from within this rift is in sync with the harmonic frequency of the liquid around us. Every three seconds, we are pushed forward with a rush of pressure driving us deeper into the tubular system. Resisting the flow is quite difficult on our engines.

This is a great opportunity for sample collection, but the appropriate apparatus may impede our navigation in these twisting tunnels.

astral_rift.1305.a.zh: 把它切断。不值得冒这么大风险。
astral_rift.1305.a.en: Cut it loose. The risk isn't worth it.

astral_rift.1305.desc.gases.zh:
$astral_rift.1305.desc.common$

最安全的选择是切断取样设备，继续前进。然而，如果给我们的推进器注入一些异星天然气，我们还是有可能保存样本的。
astral_rift.1305.desc.gases.en:
$astral_rift.1305.desc.common$

The safest option may be to simply cut the sample apparatus free and continue onward. However, it may still be possible to preserve the sample by supplementing our propulsion with a charge of exotic gases.

astral_rift.1305.desc.no_gases.zh:
$astral_rift.1305.desc.common$

我们别无选择只能切断取样设备以继续前进。
astral_rift.1305.desc.no_gases.en:
$astral_rift.1305.desc.common$

We have no choice but to simply cut the sample apparatus free and continue onward.

astral_rift.1310.desc.zh:
我们切断了取样网，然后注意到装置周围的区域似乎慢慢在变黑，并且逐渐被吞没。

$astral_rift.1310.desc.common$
astral_rift.1310.desc.en:
We have cut loose the sampling rig. We noticed the surrounding area around the apparatus seemed to slowly darken and became swollen over time.

$astral_rift.1310.desc.common$

astral_rift.1310.desc.common.zh:
沿着隧道壁的层流使我们在航行过程中良好地保持在中心。几天过去了，没有发生什么大事。我们周围的盘状异物也被困在液流终；它们轻轻飘过球体，翻滚而过。

我们没有看到任何有知觉生命存在的证据。事实上，在这一点上，我们最强烈的假设是我们在一些未知的，巨大的超级有机体中。如果我们的存在被任何自然防御系统注意到，我们也还没有看到。

我们现在发现自己置身于一个巨大的房间。壁上排列着静脉状突起。腔壁有规律地膨胀和收缩，迫使数百万升的液体通过一个出口。

当我们尝试维持位置时，发现了第二个进入舱室的入口。微量的结晶物质悬浮在从隧道流出的液体中。水流的压力很低，只要用一些巧妙的导航，就可以探测到这个孔口。
astral_rift.1310.desc.common.en:
The laminar flow along the tunnel walls has kept us well centered in our journey. Several days have passed without much incident. The disc-shaped foreign bodies surrounding us are also caught within the flow; they gently drift and tumble past the Sphere.

We have witnessed no evidence of sentient life. In fact, our strongest supposition at this point is that we are inside of some unknown, massive super organism. If our presence has been noticed by any natural defenses, we have not yet witnessed it.

We now find ourselves in an enormous chamber. The walls are lined with veiny protrusions. The chamber walls regularly expand and contract, forcing millions of liters of fluid through a single exit.

As we held our position, we discovered a second entryway into the chamber. Trace amounts of crystalline matter are suspended in the fluid coming from this tunnel. The pressure of its flow is low enough that with some skillful navigating this orifice could be explored.

astral_rift.1311.desc.zh:
向推进器注入异星天然气，我们终于将取样装置从管道壁上扯下来，由此我们可以取回这些宝贵的样品。

$astral_rift.1310.desc.common$
astral_rift.1311.desc.en:
By supplementing our propulsion with a charge of exotic gases, we were able to rip the apparatus free from the tunnel wall. We have since been able to recover the valuable samples.

$astral_rift.1310.desc.common$

astral_rift.1315.b.zh: 泵入异星天然气，干掉这头野兽。
astral_rift.1315.b.en: Pump exotic gases. Neutralize the beast.

astral_rift.1315.desc.default.zh:
在洞口的另一边，我们进入了另一个腔体。这个舱室的规模使我们迄今为止见过的任何腔体都相形见绌。这里，细而精致的分枝卷须向各个方向伸展。它们都是如此错综复杂地交织在一起，我们很难再前进一步。这种环境中的流体充满了气体，这对我们来说很容易收集。

$astral_rift.1315.desc.common$
astral_rift.1315.desc.default.en:
On the far side of the orifice, we entered another cavity. This chamber dwarfed any other we had seen thus far. Here, thin and delicately branching tendrils stretch out in every direction. They are all so intricately woven together that it has become difficult to proceed. The fluid in this environment is saturated with gases which have been easy for us to collect.

$astral_rift.1315.desc.common$

astral_rift.1316.desc.default.zh:
一路与流体抗争，我们终于挤进了上一个房间的一个分支。我们进入了一个由颤抖的水晶组成的洞穴，周围的墙壁过滤了来自各个方向的液体，留下了结晶残留物。

$astral_rift.1315.desc.common$
astral_rift.1316.desc.default.en:
Fighting through the current, we were able to squeeze into an off-shoot from the previous chamber. We emerged into a cavern of quivering crystals. The walls around us filtered fluid from every direction, causing a crystalline residue to be left behind.

$astral_rift.1315.desc.common$

astral_rift.1320.b.evopred.zh: 把酸性中和掉，然后给我们来一杯。
astral_rift.1320.b.evopred.en: Neutralize the acid. Then we shall drink.

astral_rift.1320.desc.no_rig.zh:
$astral_rift.1320.desc.common$

不过，我们的航行也并非全是徒劳。在我们的船体上发现了大量来自那头野兽的物质。我们的生物学家希望能调查其中包含的秘密。
astral_rift.1320.desc.no_rig.en:
$astral_rift.1320.desc.common$

Our voyage was not all in vain, however. A significant amount of material from the beast was found still attached to our hull. Our biologists are eager to investigate what secrets it may contain.

astral_rift.1320.desc.rig.zh:
$astral_rift.1320.desc.common$

不过，我们的航行也并非全是徒劳。我们的取样网中回收了大量来自那头野兽的物质。我们的生物学家希望能调查其中包含的秘密。
astral_rift.1320.desc.rig.en:
$astral_rift.1320.desc.common$

Our voyage was not all in vain, however. A significant amount of material from the beast was recovered by our sampling rig. Our biologists are eager to investigate what secrets it may contain.

astral_rift.1325.desc.rig.zh:
$astral_rift.1325.desc.common.1$

此外，此前救回来的取样网中可以取回大量来自那头野兽的物质。我们的生物学家迫不及待地想研究其中隐藏的秘密了。

$astral_rift.1325.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1325.desc.rig.en:
$astral_rift.1325.desc.common.1$

In addition, the sampling rig we managed to save previously has been able to recover a significant amount of material from the beast. Our biologists are eager to investigate what secrets it may contain.

$astral_rift.1325.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1330.desc.default.zh:
我们与科研团队的联络中断了。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了$tech_rift_sphere$的残余部分。

它几乎被完全溶解，大量高浓度生物质包裹着每一寸残骸。我们的生物学家确信这可以带来新的科技突破。

我们赞扬全体船员的勇敢。他们的名字将被铭记。
astral_rift.1330.desc.default.en:
We have lost contact with the Science team.

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered what was left of the $tech_rift_sphere$.

While it is mostly dissolved, there is a highly concentrated biomass coating all remaining pieces. Our biologists are certain this will lead to new breakthroughs.

We commend the crew for its bravery. Their names will be remembered.

astral_rift.1330.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们与[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]的联络中断了。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了$tech_rift_sphere$的残余部分。

它几乎被完全溶解，大量高浓度生物质包裹着每一寸残骸。我们确信这可以带来新的科技突破。
astral_rift.1330.desc.gestalt.en:
We have lost contact with our [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural].

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered what was left of the $tech_rift_sphere$.

While it is mostly dissolved, there is a highly concentrated biomass coating all remaining pieces. We are certain this will lead to new breakthroughs.

astral_rift.140.desc.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]竟然从星界裂隙中回来了。

[Root.Leader.GetHeSheCap]……发生了一些变化。[Root.Leader.GetHisHer]似乎被囚禁在了这个时间线和其他时间线之间，年龄变得无法测量。

同样令人难以理解的是，[Root.Leader.GetHeShe]好像也获得了一些计算研究的天赋。
astral_rift.140.desc.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName] [Root.GetHasHave] unexpectedly returned from [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] journey inside one of the Astral Rifts.

[Root.Leader.GetHeSheCap] [Root.Leader.IsAre]... changed. Caught somewhere between this time and another, [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] age seems indeterminable.

Inexplicably, [Root.Leader.GetHeShe] also seemed to have gained an affinity for calculative research.

astral_rift.1400.desc.zh:
我们来到了一间长满绿色藤蔓的房间。

带刺的荆棘几乎从每一个弯曲处张牙舞爪地伸出。

我们很快意识到这些生物有某种意图，或者至少是一种防御本能。

我们注意到大气中的氧含量异常高。我们推测，烧掉这些讨厌的东西将应该很容易。

另一方面，这也肯定会破坏我们本可以收集到的样本。我们观察到大量的毛茸茸的果实挂在茎上，这可以为我们提供对这种植物群的大量见解。
astral_rift.1400.desc.en:
We arrived in a chamber of writhing green vines.

Barbed thorns bite outward from nearly every bend and twist in their coils.

We quickly became aware that these organisms have some sort of intent about them, or at least a defensive instinct.

We have noted an abnormally high oxygen content in the atmosphere. We speculate that burning away these nuisances would prove to be an easy task.

On the other hand, this would certainly destroy any samples we would otherwise be able to collect. We've observed a large quantity of hairy fruit hanging from the stalks that could provide a generous amount of insight into this flora.

astral_rift.1405.desc.zh:
我们被困住了。

$tech_rift_sphere$的光滑表面让这些植物无处下藤，但我们的锚链却被各个方向神来的纤维藤蔓层层包裹。

尽管有这些障碍，如果我们想安全返回并离开裂隙，任何植物物质都无法阻挡我们的退路。我们随身携带的生物物质可能会有些用处。

然而，如果我们想继续向前探索，我们唯一实际的选择将是烧毁树叶。由此产生的火焰将非常强烈。这么近的距离，我们的船有受损的危险。
astral_rift.1405.desc.en:
We have become entangled.

While the $tech_rift_sphere$'s smooth surface provides little purchase for the plants, our anchor cable has become wrapped from all directions in fibrous vines.

Despite these obstructions, no plant matter could overcome our retraction if we want to return to safety and leave the rift. The biological matter we pull with us could likely be of some use.

However, if we want to continue exploring forward, our only practical option will be to burn through the foliage. The resulting blaze will be highly intense. At such close proximity, we risk damaging our vessel.

astral_rift.1410.desc.burn.zh:
不出所料，空气中高浓度的氧气产生了一阵火焰，迅速吞噬了带刺的植物。

摆脱了阻碍，我们继续探索。我们能够从裂隙边缘收集到大量与星界物质混合在一起的灰烬。

$astral_rift.1410.desc.common$
astral_rift.1410.desc.burn.en:
As expected, the high oxygen concentrations in the air produced a burst of flame that quickly consumed the prickly plants.

Unencumbered, we continued exploring. We were able to recover much of the ash that had become mixed with astral material from the rift's edge.

$astral_rift.1410.desc.common$

astral_rift.1410.desc.extract.zh:
我们一边穿过藤蔓，一边用我们的样本收集工具从茎上剪下一些果实。每次我们拔掉一根，剩下的部分就会无力地倒在一边。我们最后收集到了足够多的果实，也建立了一个大范围的安全区域。

这些植物的“果实”实际上更多的是一种真菌，似乎共生于整个根系中。我们带了一些样品到船上作进一步研究。

我们推测这种真菌是它们所占据的植物的一种神经簇。

$astral_rift.1410.desc.common$
astral_rift.1410.desc.extract.en:
