As we weaved our way through the vines, we were able to shear some of the fruit from their stems using our sample collection tools. Each time we removed one, the rest of the plant fell limply to the side. Eventually we gathered enough to establish a wide area of safety.

The "fruit" of these plants are actually more of a symbiotic fungal growth that seems present throughout the entire root system. We have taken some samples aboard for further study.

We speculate this fungus serves as a kind of neural cluster for the plants they occupy.

$astral_rift.1410.desc.common$

astral_rift.1415.desc.zh:
很不幸，我们与$tech_rift_sphere$上的科学团队失去了联系。

在回收时，球体的大半已经完全熔为残渣。所有的船员都不幸牺牲了。

我们重新在科研船上安装了$tech_rift_sphere$以对星界位面进行其他的探索。
astral_rift.1415.desc.en:
Unfortunately, we lost contact with the science team aboard the $tech_rift_sphere$.

Upon recovery, half of the vessel had completely melted into slag. All aboard have perished.

We have refitted a new $tech_rift_sphere$ to the science ship for further explorations into the astral planes.

astral_rift.1420.desc.zh:
这个地方固有的危险不值得去冒险。

我们已拉回锚链，让我们的[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]回到了安全的地方。

我们找到的样本有一些独特有趣的特性。
astral_rift.1420.desc.en:
The inherent danger of this place was not worth the risk.

We have pulled the retrievable anchor and returned our [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural] to safety.

The samples we have recovered have some uniquely interesting properties.

astral_rift.1425.desc.nopreviousburn.zh:
$astral_rift.1425.desc.common.1$

如同预期，空气中高浓度的氧气燃气了熊熊烈火，瞬间就吞没了这些多刺植物。

$astral_rift.1425.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1425.desc.nopreviousburn.en:
$astral_rift.1425.desc.common.1$

As expected, the high oxygen concentration in the air produced a burst of flame that quickly consumed the prickly plants.

$astral_rift.1425.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1425.desc.previousburn.zh:
$astral_rift.1425.desc.common.1$

和刚才一样，这些植物在一场巨大的大火中迅速瓦解。我们还观察到，覆盖在这些植物表面的液体起到了助燃剂的作用。

$astral_rift.1425.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1425.desc.previousburn.en:
$astral_rift.1425.desc.common.1$

As before, the plants disintegrated in a massive conflagration. We have additionally observed that the fluid coating these plants serves as an accelerant.

$astral_rift.1425.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1430.desc.zh:
尽管我们尽了最大的努力去研究密室，但还是被一头潜在的危险生物发现了。

我们起先发现它在荆棘中，用它那数百条肢体精确地爬行。随着它在每株植物上寻找果实并进行栽培，一种柔和而尖锐的声音从它身体上的几层膜里发出来。

不幸的是，我们的船壳撞在一丛又脆又宽的叶子上。听到声音后，它迅速把注意力转向了我们。头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们这边发出急促而有节奏的声音。
astral_rift.1430.desc.en:
Despite our most careful efforts to study the chamber, we have been discovered by a potentially dangerous creature.

We first spotted it crawling among the thorns with delicate precision using its hundreds of limbs. A soft, shrill sound shot forth from several of the membranes coating the segments of its body as it tended to the fruit it found in every plant, cultivating them.

Unfortunately, our hull brushed harshly against a clump of crisp, broad leaves. Alerted by the noise, it quickly turned its attention toward us. Head tilted to the side, an arrangement of scaled spines lifted outward from its neck. With quick, rhythmic pulses, the shimmering beast sent audible sounds in our direction.

astral_rift.1435.desc.zh:
不幸的是，我们已经引起了这只生物的注意。它的头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们这边发出急促而有节奏的声音。

我们没办法再继续研究它了。

我们预测它面对在强烈的火焰是，应该也会如同这里大多数的生物一样脆弱。不过，现在最好还是逃走，减少损失。
astral_rift.1435.desc.en:
Unfortunately, we have drawn the attention of the creature. Head tilted to the side, an arrangement of scaled spines lifted outward from its neck. With quick, rhythmic pulses, the shimmering beast sent audible sounds in our direction.

We'll be unable to study it any further.

We predict it would be quite vulnerable if exposed to intense flame, as most of the other life around here tends to be. However, it may be best to escape now and cut our losses.

astral_rift.1440.desc.zh:
有什么东西潜伏在密林之中。

当我们找到一个隐蔽的位置来研究这个空间时，一只奇怪的生物很快从树叶中出现。我们起先发现它在荆棘中，用它那数百条肢体精确地爬行。随着它在每株植物上寻找果实并进行栽培，一种柔和而尖锐的声音从它身体上的几层膜里发出来。

我们已经观察了一段时间，并相信进一步的观察肯定能带来宝贵的研究机会。

我们预测它面对在强烈的火焰是，应该也会如同这里大多数的生物一样脆弱。如果我们有机会，或许最好还是结果它。
astral_rift.1440.desc.en:
There is something lurking among the leaves.

As we assumed a surreptitious position to study this chamber, a strange creature soon emerged from the foliage. We first spotted it crawling among the thorns with delicate precision using its hundreds of limbs. A soft, shrill sound shot forth from several of the membranes coating the segments of its body as it tended to the fruit it found in every plant, cultivating them.

We have been observing it for some time now, and believe further study would warrant valuable research opportunities.

On the other hand, we predict it would be quite vulnerable if exposed to intense flame, as most of the other life around here tends to be. It may be best to exterminate it while we have the opportunity.

astral_rift.1445.b.evopred.zh: 他们的牺牲不会白费。可以解剖了。
astral_rift.1445.b.evopred.en: Their sacrifice was not in vain. Now for the dissection.

astral_rift.1445.desc.zh:
我们失去了与$tech_rift_sphere$的联系。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链并取回了舰船。

里面没有发现任何我们[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]残余物的痕迹。然而，他们的特征成分可以在现在占据整个机舱内部的巨大根系中检测到。

球体本身已被运送到其他地方进行进一步研究。也许我们可以把这些植物种在什么地方。
astral_rift.1445.desc.en:
We have lost contact with the $tech_rift_sphere$.

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered the vessel.

There is no evidence of any of our [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural] remaining. However, their signature components can be detected among the massive root system that now occupies the entire inside of the cabin.

The sphere itself has been transported elsewhere for further study. Perhaps we could plant it somewhere.

astral_rift.1450.b.evopred.zh: 完美。无论怎么取样它都会再生。
astral_rift.1450.b.evopred.en: Perfect. No matter how much we sample, it regenerates.

astral_rift.1450.desc.zh:
这家伙对火并不陌生。

我们一点燃第一缕火苗，它就惊慌地跑开了——动作之快，一定是出于某种本能。

也许它早就意识到了这个环境的易燃特性。不管是什么原因，它已经逃到了不知道哪个犄角旮旯里以至于我们在任何传感器范围内都找不到它的任何迹象。

它离开以后，我们找到了它撤退时掉下的一件东西。应该是因为太重了带不动所以被丢了下来。

我们简单的实验表明，无论把这个物体放在哪里，它都会立即长出微小的卷须，寻找新的地方定居和繁衍。只要有水分，这些卷须就会聚集起来茁壮成长。

令人震惊的是，由此产生的植物显示出独特的智慧迹象，即使是在嫩芽时期。

我们觉得它甚至可以成为我们帝国的宝贵资产。
astral_rift.1450.desc.en:
The creature was no stranger to fire.

As soon as we sparked the first flame, it skittered away in alarm - a behavior so quick it must be some sort of instinct.

Perhaps it was aware of the flammable properties of this environment. Whatever the reason, it has retreated so far into the cracks and crevices of this place that we no longer detect any sign of it within any range of sensors.

After it departed, we recovered an object it dropped during its retreat. It must have been too much of a burden to carry along.

Our brief experiments have shown that wherever this object is placed, it immediately begins sending out microscopic tendrils to scout out new areas to settle and flourish. At the merest detection of moisture, those tendrils congregate and thrive.

Shockingly, the resulting plant exhibits unique signs of intelligence, even as a young sprout.

We suspect it could even be raised as a valuable asset to our empire.

astral_rift.1455.desc.zh:
$astral_rift.1455.desc.common$

这个生物的每个体节都长着一对触角。这些触角可以帮他在所种植植物的纤毛上探测并移除害虫。这些触角的解剖结构超出了我们对生物器官功能的理解。
astral_rift.1455.desc.en:
$astral_rift.1455.desc.common$

Each segment of the creature contains a pair of antennae. These assist it in detecting and removing pests from the minute hairs of the fruit it cultivates. The anatomical structure of these has furthered our understanding of what biological organisms are capable of.

astral_rift.1456.desc.zh:
$astral_rift.1455.desc.common$

我们注意到它用一对巨大的前肢把一个类似于“果实”的有机团块紧紧地抓在胸前。有几次，我们观察到它用下颌骨挖进这个物体，并把它的一小部分移植到附近的植物上。它显然正在人工繁殖这些植物。这解释了这些植物为什么缺乏传粉媒介或可识别的繁殖方法。
astral_rift.1456.desc.en:
$astral_rift.1455.desc.common$

We've noticed an organic mass resembling the "fruit" clutched tightly to the creature's chest, held in its massive pair of forelimbs. Several times, we have observed its mandibles dig into this object and graft small parts of it onto the nearby vegetation. It is propagating these plants artificially. This explains the lack of pollinators or identifiable method of reproduction.

astral_rift.1457.desc.zh:
$astral_rift.1455.desc.common$

这个生物挖了一个小洞，把它拿着的东西放了进去。飞奔而去的同时，它用数百条腿把这个东西埋在了一块浅土里。

在确定这个生物不会很快回来后，我们把它拿走了。

我们简单的实验表明，无论放在哪里，这种材料都会立即发出微小的卷须，寻找新的地方扎根和生长。只要有水分，这些卷须就会聚集起来茁壮成长。

令人震惊的是，由此产生的植物显示出独特的智慧迹象，即使是在嫩芽时期。

我们觉得它甚至可以成为我们帝国的宝贵资产。
astral_rift.1457.desc.en:
$astral_rift.1455.desc.common$

The creature has dug a small burrow, placing the object it was holding inside. As it skittered away, its hundreds of legs buried it in a shallow lump of soil.

After making sure the creature would not be returning soon, we were able to recover it entirely.

Our brief experiments have shown that wherever it is placed, the material immediately begins sending out microscopic tendrils to scout out new areas to settle and flourish. At the merest detection of moisture, those tendrils congregate and thrive.

Shockingly, the resulting plant exhibits unique signs of intelligence, even as a young sprout.

We suspect it could even be raised as a valuable asset to our empire.

astral_rift.1465.desc.zh:
几年前，[from.GetName]在一次对某个充满植被的星界裂隙进行探险的过程中，被异化变成了一团树根和叶子。今天，此人的同事宣布了一个了不起的突破，此人已经恢复了[from.GetName]的心智！

尽管[From.GetHeShe]已经不再记得[From.GetHisHer]从前的自我，但[From.GetHeShe]仍保留着相似的特质。[From.GetHimHer]的眼前展开了全新的人生画卷。
astral_rift.1465.desc.en:
Several years ago, [from.GetName] was botanomorphed into a mass of roots and leaves during a failed expedition into an Astral Rift abundant with vegetation. Today their colleagues announced a marvelous breakthrough, they have restored [from.GetName]'s mind!

While [From.GetHeShe] no longer resemble[From.GetSXX] [From.GetHisHer] former self, [From.GetHeShe] seem[From.GetSXX] to possess similar qualities. A whole new life lies ahead of [From.GetHimHer].

astral_rift.15.c.zh: 这些努力是徒劳的。我们去问问那些军事主义者吧。
astral_rift.15.c.en: These efforts are hopeless. Let us visit the militants.

astral_rift.15.d.zh: 这是在以卵击石。我们还是回到自己的新世界吧。
astral_rift.15.d.en: This is a lost cause. Let us return to the new world.

astral_rift.15.desc.common.zh:
“你们的到来宛如奇迹。我们曾已经对这场无望的战争认命。我们的人民正在忍饥挨饿，苦难深重。门后之子们……请求你们在我们的最后时光给予我们恩慈。”

困境显而易见，而未来却一片迷茫。我们所能做的则是喂饱他们的人民：我们可以通过锚缆传输一些有限的补给，而我们先进的农业科技绝对能派上大用场。

甚至还有机会能用星界丝缕注入他们的飞船后，安全地接走一些他们的人。成功的概率不大，但只要成功至少能提振他们的精神。
astral_rift.15.desc.common.en:
"Your arrival is nothing less than a miracle. Long ago we accepted that this war as hopeless. Our people are starving, and our suffering is great. Children from beyond the Door... Lend us your charity in our last moments."

Their plight is obvious, even if their fate is not. Feeding the people is within our means: we should be able to send limited supplies through the anchor cable, and our advanced agricultural techniques will surely prove useful.

There is even a chance that we could shuttle some of their people to safety through the rift by infusing Astral Threads into the fuel of their spacecraft. It is a small chance, but one that may at the very least raise their spirits.

astral_rift.1500.desc.zh:
废弃的建筑物杂乱无章地散落在沙漠上。

从其中最大的一个巨大的圆顶里面，发出微弱的黄光。从地板到天花板，室内弯曲的墙壁上覆盖着一种未知的文字。

在主房间的中央是一个控制台，上面有两个大按钮：一个深蓝，一个亮绿。我们正在破译墙上的文字，看看它是否能给我们关于这个控制台可能是做什么的提示。
astral_rift.1500.desc.en:
Abandoned buildings are scattered haphazardly across the sands.

From inside the largest of these, a massive dome, came a faint yellow light. From floor to ceiling, the interior's curving walls were covered in an unknown script.

At the center of the main chamber is a console with two large buttons: one deep blue, the other a vibrant green. We are in the process of deciphering the text on the walls, to see if it gives us an indication of what this console might be for.

astral_rift.1505.desc.zh:
自从上一次听到[Leader.GetName]的消息已经过去了很长时间。继续等待他们回来已经没什么意义了。

我们收回锚链，把空空的球体拉回到我们的次元。
astral_rift.1505.desc.en:
Too much time has passed since we last heard from [Leader.GetName]. There is no point in continuing to wait for their return.

We retracted the anchor cable and pulled the empty Sphere back into our dimension.

astral_rift.1510.b.default.zh: 究竟发生了什么？他们走丢了吗？
astral_rift.1510.b.default.en: What on [Explorer.GetHomeWorldName] is going on? Weren't they lost?

astral_rift.1510.b.hive.zh: 这不符合逻辑，他们不是已经走丢了吗？
astral_rift.1510.b.hive.en: This defies logic, were they not lost to us?

astral_rift.1510.b.robot.zh: 停止计算。他们走丢了。尽管如此，了解。
astral_rift.1510.b.robot.en: Does not compute. They were lost. Nonetheless, acknowledged.

astral_rift.1510.desc.psionic_or_latent.zh:
$astral_rift.1510.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName]汇报了踏入这个穹顶的困难性。显然这里有什么怪异的东西。
astral_rift.1510.desc.psionic_or_latent.en:
$astral_rift.1510.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName] has reported uneasiness since stepping into the dome. Something is wrong here.

astral_rift.1510.desc.psionic_or_latent_.zh:
$astral_rift.1510.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName]在进入穹顶时汇报了传感器故障。建议谨慎行事。
astral_rift.1510.desc.psionic_or_latent_.en:
$astral_rift.1510.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName] has reported sensor abnormalities since entering the dome. Caution is advised.

astral_rift.1515.a.zh: 让我们寄予最好的希望。

astral_rift.1515.desc.default.zh:
我们很遗憾地通报，我们彻底失去了与外派团队的联系。

收到的最后一份报告是一段难以辨认的尖叫声，随后是一片寂静。

试图重建通信的努力没有成功。

我们还没有拉下紧急锚，希望这支队伍还能回来，但希望似乎有点渺茫。
astral_rift.1515.desc.default.en:
We regret to report that we have lost contact with the away team.

The last report received was an audio log of indecipherable screaming followed by an unbroken silence.

Attempts to reestablish communications have been unsuccessful.

We have not yet pulled the emergency anchor in the hopes that the team might yet return, but the outlook seems grim.

astral_rift.1515.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们突然与[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]失去了联络。但我们暂时还没拉回紧急锚链，希望只是暂时失联。由于没有进入裂隙的办法，这就是我们唯一能做的了。
astral_rift.1515.desc.gestalt.en: We have suddenly lost contact with our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]. We have not yet pulled the emergency anchor in the hopes that this disconnect is temporary. With no way to enter the rift, this is all we can do.

astral_rift.1520.desc.default.zh:
我们成功地与一头雾水的科学团队进行了同步。

他们对于发送两次汇报或是任何灾难都没有任何记忆。两粉重复报告的时间戳完全一致。也就是说这里的时间流动一定是受到了某种干扰。

我们的科学家们被困住了。一个穹顶牢牢地罩在其上，与$tech_rift_sphere$的沟通也仅限于无线电信号。

通过计算这次汇报和之前的时间差，在3个小时的相对时间后这支外派队会到达那个尖叫重复的时刻。在这么短的时间内翻译墙上的文字不切实际，这支科研团队唯一可行的方案是按下控制台上的其中一个按钮，以期改善现在的状况。

无论是蓝色或是绿色的按钮，它们的功能差异都没有任何提示。

我们只能相信运气了。
astral_rift.1520.desc.default.en:
We have synchronized with our very confused science team.

They have no memory of sending the report twice, or of any disaster. Timestamps for the duplicate reports are identical. There must be some disruptions in the flow of time here.

Our scientists are trapped. The dome has sealed shut, and access to the $tech_rift_sphere$ is limited to radio contact only.

Calculating the times between this report and the last, the away team has 3 hours of relative time before the screaming will be repeated. Translating the walls within this timeframe is impractical. The only course of action is for the science team to press one of the buttons on the console and hope it improves their situation.

There is no indication of the function for either the blue or green button.

We'll have to trust to luck.

astral_rift.1520.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们成功地与失联的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]重新建立了同步。

这里出现了一些不一致的情况：他们不记得发送过两份报告，也不记得导致他们突然沉默的事件。

计算这份报告和上次报告之间的时间戳，我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]在再次断开连接之前还有3小时的相对时间。在这个时间期限内翻译墙上的文字是不切实际的。虽然没有说明蓝色或者绿色按钮的功能，但唯一可行的是按下其中一个，希望它能改善情况。
astral_rift.1520.desc.gestalt.en:
We have re-synchronized with our lost [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural].

There is a discrepancy: they do not have any recollection of sending two reports, nor can they remember the events that caused their sudden silence.

Calculating the timestamps between this report and the last, our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural] have 3 hours of relative time before the disconnect is repeated. Translating the walls within this timeframe is impractical. Although there is no indication of the function of either the blue or green Buttons, the only course of action is to choose one in the hope that it improves the situation.

astral_rift.1525.desc.psionic_or_latent.zh:
$astral_rift.1525.desc.common$

我们还没下达命令，[Leader.GetName]却告诉我们，[Leader.GetHeShe]在盯着绿色按钮的时候，被一种深深的恐惧感压垮。[Leader.GetHeSheCap]强烈建议还是试试蓝色的吧。
astral_rift.1525.desc.psionic_or_latent.en:
$astral_rift.1525.desc.common$

Before we could issue this order, we were told by [Leader.GetName] that [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetIsAre] overwhelmed with a strong feeling of dread when [Leader.GetHeShe] glance[Leader.GetSXX] at the green button. [Leader.GetHeSheCap] strongly recommend[Leader.GetSXX] trying the blue.

astral_rift.1525.desc.psionic_or_latent_.zh:
$astral_rift.1525.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName]的灵能处理器计算得到最优解是按蓝色按钮。
astral_rift.1525.desc.psionic_or_latent_.en:
$astral_rift.1525.desc.common$

The psionic processors of [Leader.GetName] have calculated that the optimal approach is to press the blue button.

astral_rift.1530.desc.zh:
我们得科研团队汇报他们按下了蓝色按钮，整个房间在一阵嘈杂的研磨声中共振了起来。一扇隐藏的门徐徐打开，露出了第二个房间。

房间的墙壁发出淡淡的紫光，点亮了每一面墙上都布满着的无数象形文字。

这里还有第二个控制台。和上一个一样，它也只有两个按钮。这一次，一个雕刻着等腰三角形，另一个则是正五边形。

是时候做出又一个选择了。
astral_rift.1530.desc.en:
Our science team reports that when they pressed the blue button, the chamber resonated with a great grinding sound. A hidden door swung open, revealing a second chamber.

The walls of that chamber glowed a faint purple, lighting up a multitude of pictograms that cover every visible surface.

There is a second console. As with the last, it features exactly two buttons. This time, one has an engraving of an isosceles triangle, and the other a regular pentagon.

It is time to make another choice.

astral_rift.1535.desc.default.zh:
我们又一次与外派团队失去了联系。他们最后的语音记录是更多的尖叫和火焰的噼啪声。

$astral_rift.1535.desc.common$
astral_rift.1535.desc.default.en:
Once again, we have lost contact with the away team. Their last recorded audio is more screaming and the crackle of flame.

$astral_rift.1535.desc.common$

astral_rift.1540.desc.psionic_or_latent.zh:
$astral_rift.1540.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName]说我们一开始就该按五边形的，三角形可不是什么能带来好预兆的形状。
astral_rift.1540.desc.psionic_or_latent.en:
$astral_rift.1540.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName] says that we should have known to try the pentagon from the start. The triangle has always been an ill omen.

astral_rift.1540.desc.psionic_or_latent_.zh:
$astral_rift.1540.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName]的灵能处理器显示，在面对这样的选择时最优举动总是正五边形。三角形是一个相对欠佳的模式。
astral_rift.1540.desc.psionic_or_latent_.en:
$astral_rift.1540.desc.common$

The psionic processors of [Leader.GetName] indicate that the best course of action when presented with such a choice has always been the pentagon. The triangle is a comparatively less interesting pattern.

astral_rift.1545.desc.default.zh:
按错按钮了。

团队几乎没有时间发送一份简短的报告，他们的通信就被切断了。按下三角形按钮会使密室内充满腐蚀性气体。

如果他们再次回到过去，我们就有机会尝试另一个按钮。
astral_rift.1545.desc.default.en:
Wrong button.

The team barely had time to send a short report before their communication was cut. Pressing the triangle button caused the chamber to fill with a corrosive gas.

If they loop back to their past once more, we will have an opportunity to try the other button.

astral_rift.1545.desc.gestalt.zh:
选择三角形让舱室充满了腐蚀性气体，一瞬间就把我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]溶解了。

如果他们再次回到过去，我们就有机会尝试另一个按钮。
astral_rift.1545.desc.gestalt.en:
Choosing the triangle caused the chamber to fill with a corrosive gas that swiftly dissolved our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural].

If they loop back to their past once more, we will have an opportunity to try the other button.

astral_rift.1545.desc.toxoid.zh: 选择三角形让舱室充满了腐蚀性气体。尽管我们许多的设备被破坏了，但科学小组坚韧的身体毫发无损。在确认了他们的安全后，他们给我们发了一条信息，说会再试试五边形按钮，然后再回来报告。
astral_rift.1545.desc.toxoid.en: Choosing the triangle caused the chamber to fill with a corrosive gas. While much of our equipment was damaged, the sturdy constitution of the science team allowed them to survive unimpaired. After confirming their safety, they sent us a message saying they will try the pentagon button and report back.

astral_rift.1545.desc.toxoid_gestalt.zh: 选择三角形让舱室充满了腐蚀性气体。尽管我们许多的设备被破坏了，但[explorer.GetScientistPlural]坚韧的身体毫发无损。当气体被散去后他们就会再尝试另一个按钮。
astral_rift.1545.desc.toxoid_gestalt.en: Choosing the triangle caused the chamber to fill with a corrosive gas. While much of our equipment was damaged, the sturdy constitution of the [explorer.GetScientistPlural] allowed them to survive unimpaired. Once the gas has cleared, they will try the other button.

astral_rift.1550.desc.zh:
按下五边形按钮后，地面发生了碎裂，露出一个深入地下的螺旋楼梯。

楼梯底部是第三个房间。在柔和的蓝光照射下，墙壁完全裸露。和以前一样，这个房间主要是一个有两个按钮的单独控制台。一个上面有四个点，而另一个则有六个点。

又到了做出抉择的时候了。
astral_rift.1550.desc.en:
Pressing the pentagon caused the floor to rupture, revealing a spiraling staircase that descends deep underground.

At the bottom was a third chamber. Illuminated in a soft blue glow, the walls are completely bare. As before, this room is dominated by a solitary console with two buttons. One depicts four dots, while the other shows six.

It's time to make another choice.

astral_rift.1560.desc.aquatic.zh: 按下四点的按钮让舱室充满了大量的水。幸好我们的[Leader.GetName]深识水性，这简直跟回到家一样。他们打算等水退去以后再按下另一个按钮。
astral_rift.1560.desc.aquatic.en: Pressing the button with four dots filled the chamber with a great swell of water. Fortunately, due to the aquatic nature of [Leader.GetName], this was barely an inconvenience. They intend to press the other button once the water has been fully drained.

astral_rift.1560.desc.default.zh:
按钮错误。

[Leader.GetName]的最后遗言表明，按下四点按钮让密室里充满了水。

如果他们再次回到过去，我们就有机会尝试另一个按钮。
astral_rift.1560.desc.default.en:
Wrong button.

The audio recording of [Leader.GetName]'s final words indicated that the button with four dots filled the chamber with a deluge of water.

If they loop back to their past once more, we will have an opportunity to try the other button.

astral_rift.1560.desc.gestalt.zh:
按钮错误。

四点按钮会让密室被水淹没。我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]死了。

如果他们再次回到过去，我们就有机会尝试另一个按钮。
astral_rift.1560.desc.gestalt.en:
Wrong button.

The button with four dots filled the chamber with a deluge of water. Our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural] are no more.

If they loop back to their past once more, we will have an opportunity to try the other button.

astral_rift.1565.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.1565.desc.common$

在这个房间里的选择似乎完全是随意设置的。也许它们的目的是测试在循环之间传递信息的能力?

不管怎样，活下来我们就能带着水晶离开了。它影响时间流动的能力应该会极其有用。
astral_rift.1565.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.1565.desc.common$

The choices within this gauntlet of chambers seemed entirely arbitrary. Perhaps they were meant to test the ability to pass information between loops?

Either way, surviving it allows us to leave with the crystal. Its ability to affect the flow of time could prove extremely useful.

astral_rift.1565.desc.latent_psionic.zh:
$astral_rift.1555.desc.common$

这次经验改变了[Leader.GetName]。似乎[Leader.GetHisHer]的这趟时间循环经历使[Leader.GetHisHer]灵能潜力发生了完全觉醒！

也许这就是这座废墟的最终目的，一系列看似随意的选择只能由跨越时间线的力量所引导，例如灵能。

无论如何，我们现在都安全地带着晶体离开了。它影响时间流动的能力应该会极其有用。
astral_rift.1565.desc.latent_psionic.en:
$astral_rift.1555.desc.common$

This experience has changed [Leader.GetName]. It seems that [Leader.GetHisHer] experience during the time loops has awakened [Leader.GetHisHer] latent psionic potential!

Perhaps this was the ultimate purpose of the ruin, a set of arbitrary choices that can only be navigated with a power that transcends time, such as psionic intuition.

Either way, we can now safely leave with the crystal. Its ability to affect the flow of time could prove to be very useful.

astral_rift.1565.desc.latent_psionic_rob.zh:
$astral_rift.1555.desc.common$

休眠在[Leader.GetName]中的灵能处理器在经历时间循环之后被唤醒了，这种环境为这种能力的上线提供了严苛的测试条件。

现在还不确定是否就是这座废墟的原本目的，但无论如何我们现在已经可以安全地带着水晶离开，进行进一步的时间分析了。
astral_rift.1565.desc.latent_psionic_rob.en:
$astral_rift.1555.desc.common$

Exposure to these time loops has awakened the dormant psionic processor units within [Leader.GetName], the environment providing a solid test bed to bring these powers online.

It is unclear if this was the original purpose of these ruins. Regardless, we are now able to safely leave with the crystal for further chronological analysis.

astral_rift.1565.desc.psionic.zh:
$astral_rift.1565.desc.common$

在这些轮回中，[Leader.GetName]的直觉帮助[Leader.GetHimHer]做出了正确的抉择。

也许这就是这些密室的目的，设计一系列看似随意的选择来揭开灵能潜力。

不管怎样，我们现在可以安全地带着晶体离开了。它影响时间流动的能力应该会极其有用。
astral_rift.1565.desc.psionic.en:
$astral_rift.1565.desc.common$

Throughout these loops, [Leader.GetName]'s intuition helped [Leader.GetHimHer] to make the correct choice.

Perhaps this was the point of these chambers, a set of arbitrary choices designed to uncover psionic potential.

Either way, we can now safely leave with the crystal. Its ability to affect the flow of time could prove to be very useful.

astral_rift.1565.desc.psionic_robot.zh:
$astral_rift.1565.desc.common$

[Leader.GetName]在灵能处理器的帮助下得到了最优的结果，穿过了这些轮回。

也许这就是这些密室的目的，设计一系列看似随意的选择来揭开灵能潜力。

不管怎样，我们现在可以安全地带着晶体离开做进一步的时间分析了。
astral_rift.1565.desc.psionic_robot.en:
$astral_rift.1565.desc.common$

Throughout these loops, [Leader.GetName]'s psionic processors helped lead them to the optimal outcome.

Perhaps this was the point of these chambers, a set of arbitrary choices designed to uncover psionic potential.

Regardless, we are now able to safely leave with the crystal for further chronological analysis.

astral_rift.16.desc.default.zh:
我们最终遗憾地确定，先祖的境遇已经是无可救药了。

我们对此做什么都于事无补。他们将我们通过裂隙送到这个次元的决定是正确的。

我们会继承他们的意志好好地活下去，成为一个足以让他们感到骄傲的文明。
astral_rift.16.desc.default.en:
We have decided that the plight of our ancestors is, unfortunately, a lost cause.

There is little we can do to help them. They made the right decision in sending a portion of themselves through the rift and into our dimension.

We will do our best to continue their legacy and become a civilization they would be proud of.

astral_rift.16.desc.homicidal.zh:
我们判定，先祖不值得我们的拯救。

他们将我们这些最强的后代通过裂隙送到这个次元是一个正确的决定。我们会替他们好好活下去。

他们现在需要独自面对最终命运了。
astral_rift.16.desc.homicidal.en:
We have judged our ancestors as unworthy of our support.

They made the right decision in sending their strongest through the rift and into our dimension. We will live on in their stead.

Their fate is now their own.

astral_rift.1600.desc.authoritarian.zh:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们觉得社会的需求远高于个人欲望，他们则默许自私大众的混沌行为。

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$
astral_rift.1600.desc.authoritarian.en:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$ They share many of our ideals, but where we understand that the needs of society outweigh the needs of an individual, they allow the selfish masses to follow a path of chaos.

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$

astral_rift.1600.desc.egalitarian.zh:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们知道社会公平是欣欣向荣的基础，而他们则允许国家掌控大众生活的方方面面。

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$
astral_rift.1600.desc.egalitarian.en:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$ They share many of our ideals, but where we know that social equality is the foundation of a thriving society, they allow the state to control their people's lives.

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$

astral_rift.1600.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们的$tech_rift_sphere$刚一抵达恒星基地，就收到了许多语言在不同频段上的问候。

这座空间站的拥有者只在一瞬间就翻译了我们的语言，并且邀请我们登站互通有无。

我们这才发现这片星域是一个主要由[mirrored_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构成的文明的家园，他们自称为[mirrored_empire.GetName]。
astral_rift.1600.desc.gestalt.en:
As soon as our $tech_rift_sphere$ arrived at the starbase, we were hailed in a number of languages and on several frequencies.

The owners of the station successfully translated our language with remarkable speed and welcomed us aboard to exchange information.

We have since discovered that this sector is home to a civilization primarily composed of [mirrored_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that calls itself the [mirrored_empire.GetName].

astral_rift.1600.desc.materialist.zh:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们已经抛弃了迷信，但他们仍保有天真的信仰体系。

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$
astral_rift.1600.desc.materialist.en:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$ They share many of our ideals, but where we have cast off superstition, they still cling to their naive belief systems.

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$

astral_rift.1600.desc.militarist.zh:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们理解勇气和纪律的宝贵，而他们却认为英勇孔武已经是过去式了。

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$
astral_rift.1600.desc.militarist.en:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$ They share many of our ideals, but where we understand the virtues of courage and discipline, they view martial valor as archaic.

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$

astral_rift.1600.desc.pacifist.zh:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们我们已经摒弃了战争，而他们还沉浸在军事霸权的破坏性纪律中。

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$
astral_rift.1600.desc.pacifist.en:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$ They share many of our ideals, but where we have moved beyond war, they still cling to the destructive principles of military supremacy.

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$

astral_rift.1600.desc.spiritualist.zh:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们已经看破红尘，而他们却还是执迷不悟。

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$
astral_rift.1600.desc.spiritualist.en:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$ They share many of our ideals, but where we see through this material world, they remain locked in illusion.

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$

astral_rift.1600.desc.xenophile.zh:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们寻求合作，而他们则将自己与整个星系隔绝开。

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$
astral_rift.1600.desc.xenophile.en:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$ They share many of our ideals, but where we seek collaboration, they isolate themselves from the rest of the galaxy.

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$

astral_rift.1600.desc.xenophobe.zh:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$他们与我们有许多相似的理念，除了一点，我们以自己的人民为优先，而他们却对亲近外星文明有着离谱的幼稚。

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$
astral_rift.1600.desc.xenophobe.en:
$astral_rift.1600.desc.1$ They share many of our ideals, but where we put our people first, they embrace alien civilizations with a surprising naivety.

$astral_rift.1600.desc.2$

astral_rift.1605.desc.authoritarian.zh:
$astral_rift.1605.desc.1$看到他们在技术先进的访客面前如此无助，给他们的意识形态带去了翻天覆地的变化，倒向了平等主义。

$astral_rift.1605.desc.2$
astral_rift.1605.desc.authoritarian.en:
$astral_rift.1605.desc.1$ Seeing how helpless they would have been against these technologically advanced visitors lead to an upheaval in their ideology and a shift towards egalitarianism.

$astral_rift.1605.desc.2$

astral_rift.1605.desc.egalitarian.zh:
$astral_rift.1605.desc.1$看到他们在如此无助地想对抗如此技术先进的舰船，给他们的意识形态带去了翻天覆地的变化，他们在准备应对未来遭遇的过程中倒向了威权主义。

$astral_rift.1605.desc.2$
astral_rift.1605.desc.egalitarian.en:
$astral_rift.1605.desc.1$ Seeing how helpless they would have been against this craft lead to an upheaval in their ideology and a shift towards authoritarianism as they sought to prepare against any further encounters.

$astral_rift.1605.desc.2$

astral_rift.1605.desc.materialist.zh:
$astral_rift.1605.desc.1$看到他们在对抗这艘舰船时如此无助，给他们的意识形态带去了翻天覆地的变化，倒向了唯心主义。

$astral_rift.1605.desc.2$
astral_rift.1605.desc.materialist.en:
$astral_rift.1605.desc.1$ Seeing how helpless they would have been against this craft lead to an upheaval in their ideology and a shift towards spiritualism.

$astral_rift.1605.desc.2$

$astral_rift.1605.desc.1$看到他们在对抗这艘舰船时如此无助，给他们的意识形态带去了翻天覆地的变化，他们认为在未来的遭遇中应采取和平的方案，从而倒向了和平主义。

$astral_rift.1605.desc.2$

astral_rift.1610.desc.authoritarian.zh: 尽管我们有许多相似点，但我们很难相信这些幼稚地接纳了平等的人。$astral_rift.1610.desc.common$
astral_rift.1610.desc.authoritarian.en: Despite our many similarities, it is hard to trust people who embrace equality so naively. $astral_rift.1610.desc.common$

astral_rift.1610.desc.egalitarian.zh: 尽管我们有许多相似点，但我们很难相信这些接纳了威权主义的人。$astral_rift.1610.desc.common$
astral_rift.1610.desc.egalitarian.en: Despite our many similarities, it is hard to trust people who embrace authoritarianism. $astral_rift.1610.desc.common$

astral_rift.1610.desc.gestalt.zh: 尽管我们高度相似，但是很难相信他们。$astral_rift.1610.desc.common$
astral_rift.1610.desc.gestalt.en: Despite our many similarities, it is hard to trust them. $astral_rift.1610.desc.common$

astral_rift.1610.desc.materialist.zh: 尽管我们有许多相似点，但我们很难相信这些接纳了唯心主义的人。$astral_rift.1610.desc.common$
astral_rift.1610.desc.materialist.en: Despite our many similarities, it is hard to trust people who embrace spiritualism. $astral_rift.1610.desc.common$

astral_rift.1610.desc.xenophobe.en: Despite our many similarities, it is hard to trust people who embrace xenophilia. $astral_rift.1610.desc.common$

astral_rift.1611.desc.zh:
我们花费了过去的一周与[mirrored_empire.GetName]进行了文化交换。

我们的兴趣很快变成了警觉，因为发现这些生物是破坏集体意识的残余物。在他们文明发展的某个时间点上，他们的意识被个体概念荼毒了。他们有目的地割裂自身，慢慢地每个自个体都不再听从集体，只忠于自己了。
astral_rift.1611.desc.en:
We have spent the last week in a cultural exchange with the [mirrored_empire.GetName].

Our interest quickly turned to alarm as we discovered that these beings are what remains of a broken collective consciousness. At some point in their civilization's development, their mind became poisoned with the concept of individuality. Purposefully segmenting itself over time, eventually each drone began to hear no thoughts but their own.

astral_rift.1615.a.zh: 欢迎双方帝国间的友谊。

astral_rift.1615.d.en: This is of no interest to us.

astral_rift.1615.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.default$在一个充满了未知力量的星系中，我们之间的友谊毫无疑问会为双方都带去好处的。

$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1615.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.default$ Surely in a galaxy full of unknown powers, a friendship between us would serve to benefit both parties.

$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1615.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.gestalt$

我们确实承袭了很多共同点。$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1615.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.gestalt$

It is true that we share a unique heritage together. $astral_rift.1615.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1615.desc.xenophobe.zh:
$astral_rift.1615.desc.common$

他们不但排斥我们，而且不理解我们。他们辩称两边人民的协调一致对双方都好。

$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1615.desc.xenophobe.en:
$astral_rift.1615.desc.common$

While they do not like us, they do understand us. They argue that an arrangement between our people would benefit both sides.

$astral_rift.1615.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1620.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.1620.desc.common_1$$astral_rift.1620.desc.common_2$

我们很期待与我们能视为表亲的人们通力协作。
astral_rift.1620.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.1620.desc.common_1$ $astral_rift.1620.desc.common_2$

We look forward to working with a people that we consider to be our close cousins.

astral_rift.1620.desc.gestalt.zh: $astral_rift.1620.desc.common_1$他们分散的思维虽然效率不及我们，但可以在我们与其他的分散个体群之间充当“润滑剂”的功能。
astral_rift.1620.desc.gestalt.en: $astral_rift.1620.desc.common_1$ Their disconnected minds, while inferior in their efficiency, will serve fittingly as liaisons between ourselves and other hordes of individuals.

astral_rift.1625.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.1625.desc.common$

尽管[final_mirrored_empire.GetName]对所谓的相似点和共同未来夸夸其谈，但是对能为我们人民带来繁荣的基本理念嗤之以鼻。

撂下我们的话之后，在他们对我们的外交豁免权达到极限之前，我们迅速回到了$tech_rift_sphere$上。

尽管我们无意与这群人保持联络，但研究两个社会间的差异让我们对自己的理解又更加深入了。
astral_rift.1625.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.1625.desc.common$

For all their talk of similarities and a shared future, [final_mirrored_empire.GetName] turned their back on the fundamental ideals that make our people great.

Having said our piece, we swiftly returned to our $tech_rift_sphere$ before they decided that our diplomatic immunity had reached its limits.

Although we have no plans to maintain contact with these people, studying the differences between this civilization and our own has taught us a great deal about ourselves.

astral_rift.1625.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.1625.desc.common$

尽管他们对所谓相似之处夸夸其谈，但我们觉得没有什么事比抛弃集体更加可恶了。

在阐明了我们的立场之后，[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]迅速地返回了$tech_rift_sphere$以免事态发生什么意料之外的变化。
astral_rift.1625.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.1625.desc.common$

For all their talk of similarities, we can think of nothing more abhorrent than abandoning the collective.

Having made our stance clear, our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural] swiftly returned to the $tech_rift_sphere$ before the situation took a more dangerous turn.

astral_rift.1700.desc.zh:
这里既没有恒星，也没有行星。只有一束来自神秘来源的漫射光照亮了这个巨大的物体，在我们的面前若隐若现。

它的形状大致为矩形，处于完全沉默的状态——没有可探测到的推进系统或任何形式的动力特征。它的大小与一个小型恒星基地相当，看起来死气沉沉。没人知道它在这个隐蔽的口袋维度上漂浮了多久，或是从何而来。

无数的装饰字形和符号被复杂地雕刻在它的表面。由此我们排除了这是自然现象的可能性。
astral_rift.1700.desc.en:
There are no stars here, no planetary bodies. Only a diffuse light of mysterious origin reveals the massive object looming before us.

Roughly rectangular in shape, it is completely inert - there are no detectable propulsion systems or power signatures of any kind. Comparable in size to a small starbase, it appears dead. For how long has it been floating in this secluded pocket dimension, and where did it come from?

Innumerable decorative glyphs and symbols have been intricately carved into its surface. We have ruled out any possibility of this being a natural phenomenon.

astral_rift.1705.desc.zh:
覆盖在这个巨大物体上的象形文字大多是以形表意的。

根据同位素定年法我们确定，最早的一些雕刻比最新的要早上几千年。这些象形文字的栩栩如生，因此我们很快就能做出一个粗略的翻译。

这个物体实际上是一座巨大的墓室，埋葬其中的人曾经统治过整个星系。最早的一些象形文字揭示了这位强大生物的起源。

有两个物种在太空星神兽种族的抚养下长大，并发展出了一种独特的共生关系。他们结成了强大的灵能纽带，一起征服了无数的星系。

还有另一些符号似乎是某种“诅咒”。试图打开这个物体——甚至太靠近它——都可能是危险的。
astral_rift.1705.desc.en:
The glyphs that cover this tremendous object are mostly pictorial representations.

Based on the carbon dating, we have determined that some of the earliest carvings were made several millennia before the most recent. The glyphs are illustrated in such detail, that we were soon able to develop a rough translation.

This object is in fact a massive burial chamber. Whoever, or whatever, is entombed inside once ruled an entire galaxy. Some of the earliest pictographs reveal the origin of this powerful being.

Raised by a space-born race of leviathans, the two species developed a unique symbiosis. Forming a potent psionic bond, they conquered countless systems together.

There are other symbols which refer to a "curse". Attempting to open the object - or even approaching it too closely - may be dangerous.

astral_rift.1710.a.zh: 通过裂缝派出一架无人机。
astral_rift.1710.a.en: Send a drone through the crack.

astral_rift.1710.desc.zh:
我们现在完全已经进入了环绕该物体的轨道。

它由两半焊接而成。在一些地方，焊缝被严重腐蚀——考虑到周围并没有什么大气，这还挺出乎意料的。这也表明腐蚀的来源一定来自于物体本身的内部。

腐蚀非常严重，甚至在一些地方出现了裂缝，大到足以让我们的一架无人机进入。

或者，我们也可以用携带的炸药炸开封印。
astral_rift.1710.desc.en:
We have completed a full orbit around the object.

It is composed of two halves welded shut. The seal is heavily corroded in some locations - unexpected given the emptiness of the surrounding atmosphere. This indicates that the source of the corrosion must be coming from inside the object itself.

The corrosion is so severe that in some places cracks have appeared, large enough for one of our drones to enter.

Alternatively, we are carrying enough explosives to crack the seal.

astral_rift.1715.desc.zh:
我们的无人机从物体内部发回了一份报告。

不幸的是，大部分舱室都被厚厚的碳尘云遮住了，很难在其中闪转腾挪。

初步分析显示大量的星界纤维和碳粒子交织在一起。如果我们肯花些时间应该是有可能收获这些材料的。

透过远在结构深处的裂缝，我们发现了存在一个内室的迹象。如果想要进一步探索可能需要更破坏性的操作。
astral_rift.1715.desc.en:
Our drone has transmitted a report from inside the object.

Unfortunately, most of the compartments within are obscured by a thick cloud of carbon dust and have proven difficult to maneuver around.

Initial analysis has revealed a high amount of astral fabric interwoven with the carbon particles. It should be possible to harvest this material, should we take the time to do so.

Visible through further cracks deep within the structure, we can see the signs of an inner chamber. Exploring further would require more destructive exploration.

astral_rift.1725.a.zh: 现在我们有些麻烦要处理了。
astral_rift.1725.a.en: We have a problem to deal with.

astral_rift.1725.desc.zh:
我们的定向爆破打开了一条通向我们之前未发现墓室的通路。这个空间深藏于封印之后，显然做了一些反盗墓的设计。它里面还充满了敌对的实体。

球体立刻拉动了锚链，但还是有许多守卫跟随着我们的尾流冲出了裂隙。
astral_rift.1725.desc.en:
Our controlled explosion has opened the way to a previously undetected cavity. Hidden behind the seal, this space was clearly designed to counter intrusion. It was filled to the brim with hostile entities.

The Sphere immediately retrieved the anchor, but many of the guardians have exited the rift with us and are following in our wake.

astral_rift.1800.desc.zh:
一大片松散的岩砾在我们面前铺展开去，上方是一片苍白、空旷的天空。

这里看不到行星或恒星。似乎不是星系或任何已知系统的一部分。在我们的传感器所能探测到的范围内，这片景观向各个方向无限延伸。地表布满了像小行星一样大的坑洞。

在地平线的远方，几十头巨大的蠕虫状生物正从地面冒出来，用一对有力的鳍在稠密的大气中滑行。它们一定在地下有某种聚居地。
astral_rift.1800.desc.en:
A vast plane of loose rock and gravel stretches before us. Above it hangs a pale, empty sky.

No planets or stars can be seen here. This does not appear to be part of a galaxy or any known system. As far as our sensors can detect, this landscape continues infinitely in all directions. The surface is pockmarked with holes as large as some asteroids.

All across the horizon, dozens of massive, worm-like creatures are bursting from the ground. Pairs of powerful fins allow them to glide through the dense atmosphere. They must have some type of colony underground.

astral_rift.1805.desc.zh:
这里也不只有蠕虫存在。

一种微小生物的群体在下层大气中形成了云雾般的结构。它们以一整个大群共同行动，在天空中形成了复杂的图案。

那些巨大的蠕虫从隧道中破土而出，然后就向天空跃起滑翔，大口吞噬这些小生命构成的云。我们还观察到了许多蠕虫互相协作，把这些虫群赶到一起的情形。它们的合作程度颇为复杂。
astral_rift.1805.desc.en:
There are more than the worms living here.

Swarms of microscopic creatures form clouds in the lower atmosphere. Moving as one mass, they create complex patterns across the sky.

As the massive worms breach from their tunnels, they glide in the air, grazing among the living clouds. We have observed several worms working together to flush these swarms towards one another. The level of cooperation is fairly sophisticated.

astral_rift.1810.desc.zh:
地表下有一座由一系列复杂隧道互相交联的巨大洞穴网络。其中有几个坍塌的部分似乎没有被蠕虫使用。我们驾驶着$tech_rift_sphere$进入了最安静的区域。

这里的岩壁上覆盖着一层网状物质，将页岩和松散的砾石固定在原地。我们推测这些是蠕虫的分泌物。

大多数洞穴都是空的，但有些洞穴里有浑浊的水池。在其中一间岩室里，我们发现了一堆巨大的矿化茧半浸在水里。
astral_rift.1810.desc.en:
Beneath the surface lies a vast network of chambers connected by a complex series of tunnels. Several of these were partially collapsed, and appeared not to be in use by the worms. We piloted the $tech_rift_sphere$ into the quietest.

The walls are covered in a web-like substance which keeps the shale and loose gravel in place. We speculate that these are secretions from the worms.

Most of the chambers are empty, but some contain murky pools of water. Within one, we encountered a clutch of large, mineralized cocoons half-submerged in the liquid.

astral_rift.1815.desc.zh:
$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.1$

我们在收集微生物云的样本时，一只正在觅食的蠕虫把我们整个鲸吞而下。

$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1815.desc.en:
$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.1$

While we were engaged in collecting cloud samples, one of the grazing worms has engulfed us whole.

$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1816.desc.capture.zh:
$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.1$

我们在试图捕获他们的幼虫时，一只蠕虫突然出现，把我们整个鲸吞而下。

$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1816.desc.capture.en:
$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.1$

While we were engaged in collecting their younglings, one of the worms has engulfed us whole.

$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1816.desc.harvest.zh:
$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.1$

我们在收取这些卵的时候，一只蠕虫突然出现，把我们整个鲸吞而下。

$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.1816.desc.harvest.en:
$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.1$

While we were engaged in harvesting the eggs, one of the worms has engulfed us whole.

$astral_rift.1815.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.1820.b.zh: 总感觉再不走运气就要用完了。赶紧返航。
astral_rift.1820.b.en: We've pushed our luck far enough. Return at once.

astral_rift.1820.desc.zh:
我们在隧道系统的深处发现了一处浅浅的湖泊。

这里的墙体蠕动着。和我们$tech_rift_sphere$大小相当的幼虫正忙着啃噬那些用于把岩壁连接在一起的石化分泌物。虽然体型要小得多，但几乎可以肯定，它们是我们看到的在地面上滑翔的蠕虫的幼体。

这里应该是某种育儿室。
astral_rift.1820.desc.en:
We have discovered a shallow lake deep within the tunnel system.

The walls are writhing. Larvae as large as our $tech_rift_sphere$ are busy gnawing at the petrified secretions that hold the chamber together. While much smaller in size, these are almost certainly juvenile versions of the worms we saw gliding on the surface.

This must be a nursery of sorts.

astral_rift.1825.desc.zh:
我们的锚链可真是生命线啊。

就像系鱼线上的铒一样，我们被从蠕虫的消化道中被拖了出来。
astral_rift.1825.desc.en:
Our anchor cable has proved to be a lifeline.

Like bait on a fishing line, we have been pulled free from the gullet of the rockworm.

astral_rift.1830.desc.zh:
我们与$tech_rift_sphere$上的[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]失去了联系。

在回收时，我们拉回的缆绳末端只有半个被消化的金属船壳。

我们借此机会对这些附着在缆绳上的消化液进行了性质研究。
astral_rift.1830.desc.en:
We have lost contact with the [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural] aboard the $tech_rift_sphere$.

Upon retrieval, we pulled back the wire and at its end was only a partially dissolved hunk of metal.

We are taking this opportunity to study the unique properties of the digestive fluids coating line.

astral_rift.1835.b.evopred.en: First crack the shells. Then return.

astral_rift.1835.desc.capture.zh:
$astral_rift.1835.desc.common$

脱困之后，我们得以捕获一些幼虫，准备穿过裂隙带回来。

我们应该可以把这些强韧的小东西带回到我们想要的行星上，然后训练它们为我们挖掘矿道。
astral_rift.1835.desc.capture.en:
$astral_rift.1835.desc.common$

Free from all restrictions, we have been able to cage a few of the larvae for transport back through the rift.

We should be able to transport these durable spawn to a planet of our choosing. Perhaps the younglings can be trained to dig mining tunnels for us.

astral_rift.1835.desc.harvest.zh:
$astral_rift.1835.desc.common$

脱轨以后，我们得以从这个岩室的水塘里带回大量的卵簇。

我们用晶体外壳装着，把这些强韧的小东西带回到我们想要的行星上，然后训练它们为我们挖掘矿道。
astral_rift.1835.desc.harvest.en:
$astral_rift.1835.desc.common$

Free from all restrictions, we have been able to recover a significant amount of egg clusters from the pools inside these chambers.

Encased in crystalline shells, we should be able to transport these durable spawn to a planet of our choosing. Perhaps the younglings can be trained to dig mining tunnels for us.

astral_rift.1835.desc.recover.zh:
$astral_rift.1835.desc.common$

我们发现自己身处于一个岩室内，我们发现了一堆巨大的矿化茧半浸在水里。我们可以取回大量的卵簇。
astral_rift.1835.desc.recover.en:
$astral_rift.1835.desc.common$

We found ourselves in a chamber containing a clutch of large, mineralized cocoons half-submerged in liquid. We were able to recover a significant amount of these egg clusters.

astral_rift.1890.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]从星界裂隙另一头回来了，[From.GetHeShe]显得疲惫不堪。

因为在岩蠹的腹中待了许多年，[From.GetHisHer]的身体功能变得极其有限。不论如何，我们都还是让[From.GetHimHer]回到了我们的怀抱。
astral_rift.1890.desc.en:
[From.GetName] [From.GetHasHave] returned from beyond the Astral Rift, but [From.GetHeShe] [From.GetIsAre] the worse for wear.

Having spent a year inside the belly of a Rockworm, [From.GetHisHer] physical capabilities [From.GetHasHave] become extremely limited. Nonetheless, we have taken [From.GetHimHer] back into our fold.

astral_rift.1890.name.en: From the Belly of the Beast

astral_rift.1900.desc.zh:
温度难以置信地高。要不是提前准备好的隔热护盾，我们可能就已经葬身烈火了。

远处，有一座黑色的方尖碑静静耸立着。一系列人系开凿的河道汇聚到这座巨大的纪念碑上，把岩石地貌整齐地分割开来。

天空静静地漂浮中发光的球状生物。它们的卷须从精致的身躯上垂下。从这个距离我们还看不出他们是否怀有敌意，但至少在目前，他们似乎没有注意到我们。

方尖碑似乎是最需要的调查对象，但许多漂浮的生物飞得很近，令人不安。也许在离得太近之前观察一下周围的环境会更安全。
astral_rift.1900.desc.en:
Temperatures here are incredibly high. If not for the precautionary heat shields we had applied beforehand, we'd already be incinerated.

Looming in the distance is a black obelisk. A series of artificial channels converge on this vast monument, neatly carving up the rocky landscape.

Glowing, orb-like creatures float quietly in the sky. Bioluminescent tendrils drape from their delicate forms. From this distance we cannot tell if they are hostile or not, but at least for the moment they do not seem to have noticed us.

The obelisk seems like the most pressing thing to investigate, but many of the floating organisms are flying uncomfortably close. Perhaps it would be safer to observe our surroundings before getting too close.

astral_rift.1905.desc.zh:
这个鬼地方可比我们一开始想的危险多了。

这里的墙上排列着几间小隔间。里面充满了各种各样的生物体。一看到我们，它们就摇着栅栏，用各种不知名的语言哀号。不时地，我们看到球状的漂浮生物进入这些隔间，用生物电击制服囚犯。

不幸的是，其中一个浮动球体对我们产生了兴趣，并且正在接近我们的$tech_rift_sphere$。即使我们把引擎开到最大，它也在慢慢追上我们。它的尾迹中拖着长长的卷须，字面上地一路火花带闪电。

在我们下面，一条巨大的熔岩河淹没了黑曜岩地貌。我们准备的隔热层应该能让我们在熔岩里存活一段时间。
astral_rift.1905.desc.en:
There is more danger here than we initially thought.

Small chambers line the walls of this place. They are packed with a wide variety of living organisms. At the sight of us, they are rattling the bars that contain them and wailing in various unknown languages. From time to time, we witness the bulbous, floating creatures enter these cavities and subdue the prisoners with a bio-electric shock.

Unfortunately, one of these floating orbs has taken interest in us and is approaching our $tech_rift_sphere$. Even with our engines at their maximum, it is slowly gaining on us. Its long tendrils trail in its wake, aglow with a heavy electric charge.

Below us, a vast river of lava floods the obsidian landscape. The heat shielding we have prepared should allow us to survive for a short time under its surface.

astral_rift.1910.b.zh: 这太危险了。拉动紧急锚链。
astral_rift.1910.b.en: This is dangerous. Pull the emergency anchor.

astral_rift.1910.desc.zh:
我们没能躲开探测。在飞向方尖碑的过程中，一小群怪异的漂浮生物很快就追上了我们。

我们现在被他们发光的卷须困住，强行地被拖动着。与之尝试沟通毫无成效。

他们顽固地把我们拖向一个开凿在附近墙体中的笼子里。铁链和栅栏间打开了一条我们的通路。一路上，许多不同形式的感性生命都被关在了类似的隔间里。

这些生物的触须紧紧地抓住了我们的船。然而，通过给我们的引擎增加一剂星界物质，可以产生一股爆发力，帮助我们逃脱它们的控制。
astral_rift.1910.desc.en:
Our attempts to avoid detection were unsuccessful. As we flew toward the obelisk, a small flock of the strange floating creatures were quick to pursue us.

Bound now by their glowing tendrils, we are being towed along forcefully. Communications have proven fruitless.

They are steadily carrying us toward a cage embedded in the nearby wall. Chains and bars are being pulled aside, making way for our passage. Many diverse forms of sentient life occupy similar enclosures along the way.

The creatures' tendrils are grasped tightly around our vessel. However, by augmenting our engines with a dose of astral material, we can provide a burst of propulsion that should help us evade their grasp.

astral_rift.1915.desc.common.zh:
我们悄悄地前进，来到了巨大的方尖碑附近。

黑曜石般的黑色，一直延伸到这个火山空间的天花板。要说它很古老，那它的外表也太无暇了。最早我们认为是装饰的东西其实是某种图案。虽然暂时难以辨认，但熔化的符文在它的表面以一种精心安排的方式旋转。如果有足够的时间，是有可能翻译出来的。

我们的目标跟踪电脑检测到，在这片区域巡逻的生物离这个物体越近时移动得越快。我们推断出，不管这个结构是什么，这些生物都以某种方式与它联系在一起。用压缩气体爆轰摧毁应该会抑制它们的功能。
astral_rift.1915.desc.common.en:
Propelling ourselves quietly along, we have arrived in the close proximity of the massive obelisk.

Obsidian black, it stretches to the ceiling of this volcanic chamber. If it is ancient, it is unblemished. What first appeared as decoration has now been revealed itself as a pattern. Yet indecipherable, molten runes swirl along its surface in a deliberate arrangement. Translation would be possible, given enough time.

Our target tracking computers have detected that the creatures patrolling this area move faster the closer they are to this object. We have extrapolated that whatever this structure is, these beings are tethered to it in some way. Destroying it with a charge of compressed gas should inhibit their abilities to function.

astral_rift.1915.desc.lava_escape.zh:
漂浮生物对我们的行为猝不及防。

引擎的爆发力让我们挣脱了他们的卷须，把我们快速地推向下方的熔岩河。显然，他们还不适应猎物会做出这种反应。

我们作为预防措施施加的保护膜可以使我们在底下存活足够的时间，游出一段距离，躲避不被漂浮的生物的注意。

$astral_rift.1915.desc.common$
astral_rift.1915.desc.lava_escape.en:
The floating creatures were not prepared for our sudden maneuver.

A burst of our engines pulled us free of their tendrils, propelling us quickly into the river of molten lava below. Clearly, they are not accustomed to their prey behaving in such a way.

The protective coating we had applied as a precaution allowed us to survive long enough to emerge some distance away, hidden from their attention.

$astral_rift.1915.desc.common$

astral_rift.1915.desc.lava_hide.zh:
为了躲避追踪，我们把自己浸没到了下方的熔岩河中。

我们作为预防措施施加的保护膜可以使我们在底下存活足够的时间，游出一段距离，躲避不被漂浮的生物的注意。

$astral_rift.1915.desc.common$
astral_rift.1915.desc.lava_hide.en:
To evade notice, we have dipped ourselves into the river of molten lava below us.

The protective coating we had applied as a precaution allowed us to survive long enough to emerge some distance away, hidden from the attention of the floating creatures.

$astral_rift.1915.desc.common$

astral_rift.1920.desc.zh:
我们拉回了锚链，从这个危险的地方逃离。

许多漂浮生物在我们拉回$tech_rift_sphere$的时候一并被拖着走，甚至有一只还被拉回到了我们的维度里，然后马上降解成了一些纯的星界物质。

我们取走了它们的残骸以进行进一步研究。
astral_rift.1920.desc.en:
We retrieved the anchor cable and escaped from this dangerous landscape.

Several of the floating creatures latched on to our $tech_rift_sphere$ as we were pulled away. One of them even came back with us into our dimension, and promptly disintegrated into pure astral material.

We are harvesting its remains for further study.

astral_rift.1925.desc.zh:
这是一份名单

方尖碑上刻满了数以兆计的的名字，以一种复杂的数学模式排列着，我们一边观察它就一边不断变化着。

方尖碑的各个面都有独特的排列方式，使得每个名字都能精确地在沿墙的凹室中显示出来。

用探针触摸任何一个名字都会导致某个相应的房间被危险的能量照亮，并发出可怜的哀号。

不幸的是，在这样做的时候，我们再次吸引了漂浮生物的注意。
astral_rift.1925.desc.en:
It is a list of names.

Trillions and trillions of names cover this obelisk. Arranged in a complicated mathematical pattern, they shift and change as we observe them.

The facets of the obelisk are uniquely aligned, allowing each name to be precisely true to one of the alcoves along the wall.

Touching any one name with a probe results in a corresponding chamber lighting up with dangerous amounts of energy and a pitiful wailing.

Unfortunately, upon doing this we have attracted the attention of the floating creatures once more.

astral_rift.1930.desc.zh:
我们策略性地沿着黑曜石塔的接缝放置的炸药把它完全炸成了两半。

方尖碑的上半部分渐渐滑落，黑暗笼罩了整个洞穴。我们之前注意到的漂浮生物失去了光亮，伴随着沉重的而潮湿的砰砰声落在地上。

墙壁两旁的隔间的门被一一打开。无数成群的生物从这些洞里涌进最近的隧道系统。我们不知道这些隧道通向哪里，但至少它们现在自由了。

方尖碑的破碎材料具有独特而有趣的特性。我们已尽可能多地把它带到船上作进一步研究。
astral_rift.1930.desc.en:
The charges we strategically placed along the seams of the obsidian tower have sheared it completely in half.

As the upper portion of the obelisk slid away, a severe darkness filled the cavern. The floating creatures we noticed earlier lost their luminosity and fell to the ground with heavy, wet thumps.

The gates containing the chambers lining the walls swung open. Countless hordes of creatures poured forth from these holes into the closest tunnel systems. We have no idea where these tunnels lead, but at least they are now free.

The shattered material of the obelisk possesses unique and interesting properties. We have taken as much of it aboard as we can for further study.

astral_rift.1935.desc.zh:
我们与[Leader.GetName]失去了联系。

在取回$tech_rift_sphere$时，我们发现其中充满了烟雾和灰烬。找不到[Explorer.GetCrew]的尸体。

看来他们永远地迷失在了裂隙另一头了。
astral_rift.1935.desc.en:
We have lost contact with [Leader.GetName].

Upon retrieval of the $tech_rift_sphere$, we discovered it filled with smoke and ash. The bodies of the [Explorer.GetCrew] were not recovered.

It is likely they are lost forever beyond the rift.

astral_rift.1940.desc.zh: 一个熔融生物要求见我们。他自称是我们六年前炸毁的那座黑色方尖碑的所有者。
astral_rift.1940.desc.en: A molten being is requesting audience with us. They claim to be the owners of the black obelisk we destroyed exactly six years ago.

astral_rift.1941.desc.zh:
你们对自己的所作所为一无所知。

你错误地释放了我们的囚犯。如果平衡得不到恢复，将会产生严重的后果。

接下来的六年，你们每年都要从你们的殖民地提供囚犯代为关押。我们将以公平的交易作为回报。

如果你拒绝，我们很乐意无所不用其极地折磨你的人。
astral_rift.1941.desc.en:
You know not what you have done.

You have mistakenly freed our wards. Balance must be restored, or there will be great consequences.

Each year, for six years, you will offer us replacement prisoners from your colonies. We shall offer a fair trade in return.

Should you decline, we shall happily torment your people until the suffering is complete.

astral_rift.1950.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]从$astral_rift_volcano$星界裂隙回来了……但和我们对他们的记忆不太有一样。

同位素采样表明[from.GetHisHer]的年龄已经超过了600岁。
astral_rift.1950.desc.en:
[from.GetName] [from.GetHasHave] returned from the $astral_rift_volcano$ Astral Rift... but not as we remember them.

Carbon-samples indicate [from.GetHisHer] age is now over 600 years old.

astral_rift.1955.desc.zh:
事态向令人不安的方向发展了。

[from.GetName]秘密地在把我们的人口通过$astral_rift_volcano$传送走。

他们称这是在进行“恢复平衡”的努力。
astral_rift.1955.desc.en:
We have discovered a disturbing development.

[from.GetName] has been secretly sending members of our population back through the $astral_rift_volcano$ Astral Rift.

They claim it is being done in an effort to "restore the balance."

astral_rift.200.desc.zh:
这个裂隙中包含着一次史诗之战的余波。

残留的只有无数的军舰残骸和硕大无朋的生物尸体，比我们最大战舰的全长还要大上十倍。

与这些战舰残破的船体形成鲜明对比的是，尸体的状态非常好。不知这些舰船使用的是什么武器，但似乎几乎没有造成损坏。我们尚未确定该生物的死因，但似乎不太可能是战斗的结果。

这只野兽一定有非凡的耐力。分析它的分子组成有助于我们加固舰队的船体。另一方面，我们也可以尝试研究它的内部，也许可以了解这种生物是如何死亡的，以及这里到底发生了什么。
astral_rift.200.desc.en:
This rift contains the aftermath of a titanic struggle.

All that is left is the wreckage of a military fleet and the corpse of a monstrous creature, ten times the largest of the battleships from tip to tail.

In contrast to the mangled hulls of the warships, the carcass is in remarkably good shape. Whatever weapons these ships used, they seem to have hardly damaged it. We have not yet determined what caused this creature's demise, but it seems unlikely it was the result of the battle.

The beast must have had remarkable durability. Analyzing its molecular composition should help us strengthen the hulls of our fleet. On the other hand, we could attempt to study its internals, perhaps learning how this creature died, and what exactly occurred here.

astral_rift.2000.desc.zh:
我们在一个废弃的研究设施内。

这个房间的表面覆盖着厚厚的灰尘，表明它已经有一段时间没有使用了。

我们无法找到任何研究人员，无论是活着与否。无论这个地方的看守者是谁，他们早已离开了。

墙壁上排列着重型架子，每个架子上都放着一枚大型蛋。它们中的大多数都处于不同的腐烂状态，但仍有一些活体标本。

在这个房间的中心有一个敞开的容器，里面装满了苍白的粘性液体。对液体的分析显示，它含有大量的蛋白质和氨基酸。从一些蛋上留下的残留物来看，我们推测这些液体是由研究人员注射的。
astral_rift.2000.desc.en:
We are inside of an abandoned research facility.

The surfaces in this room are coated in a thick layer of dust, indicating it has not been in use for some time.

We can detect no researchers, living or otherwise. Whoever the caretakers of this place might have been, they are long since gone.

Heavy-duty shelves line the walls, each holding a large egg. Most of them are in various states of decay, but a few living specimens remain.

At the center of this chamber rests an open container filled with a pale, viscous liquid. An analysis of the fluid reveals that it contains high amounts of proteins and amino acids. Judging by the residue left on some of the eggs, we speculate this fluid was being injected by the researchers.

astral_rift.2010.a.en: Inject the liquid into the egg.

astral_rift.2010.b.zh: 对剩下的生物实施安乐死。

astral_rift.2010.desc.zh:
我们砸开了蛋中看起来最健康的样本。

里面的胚胎看起来营养不良，并被外来寄生虫所覆盖。

值得注意的是，这些寄生虫拥有任何已知生物体所不曾拥有的独特的量子特性。它们在蛋壳内部随机传送，甚至可以传送到胚胎内部。鉴于该实验室中只剩下很少的活的蛋，这个特殊的标本必然对寄生虫的行为具有特别的抵抗力。

对这两种生物体的星界追踪表明，这些寄生虫起源于一个独特且遥远的维度。我们相信这种寄生虫是无意中被召唤到这里的，并中断了该设施的预期研究。

我们看到他们被这个房间中央的一桶奇怪液体所吸引。也许这就是吸引他们来到这里的首要原因。
astral_rift.2010.desc.en:
We have opened the healthiest looking specimen among the eggs.

The embryo inside appeared malnourished and covered with foreign parasites.

Remarkably, the parasites possess quantum properties unique to any known biological organism. They warp randomly around the inside of the egg's casing, and presumably inside of the embryo itself. Given that so few living eggs remain in this laboratory, this particular specimen must be especially resistant to the parasite's behavior.

Astral tracing of both organisms indicate the parasites originated from a distinct and distant dimension. We believe this parasite was inadvertently summoned here, and has interrupted the intended research of this facility.

We have seen them drawn to the vat of strange liquid in the center of this chamber. Perhaps this is what attracted them here in the first place.

astral_rift.2015.desc.zh:
我们已经找到了这个地方的看护者。更准确地说，我们已经找到了它们的残骸。

附近的一个房间里堆满了尸体。他们的四肢已经被某种未知的力量在原子层面上彻底地分开了。有些尸体半融合在墙内。

中央检查台上放着一堆大部分被解剖过的蛋。其中一枚完好无损。

将看护者的遗体带回进行适当的研究应该可以让我们对这里发生的事情有一些洞见。
astral_rift.2015.desc.en:
We have found the caretakers of this place. More accurately, we have found what remains of them.

A nearby room is littered with corpses. Their limbs have been cleanly separated at the atomic level by some unknown force. Some of the carcasses are half-fused inside of the walls.

A clutch of mostly dissected eggs is present on a central examining table. One of remains intact.

Taking the caretakers' remains back for proper study should provide some insight into what happened here.

astral_rift.2020.desc.zh:
将苍白液体注入暴露的胚胎中产生了一些有趣的结果。

尽管有量子寄生体，之前昏昏欲睡的样本已然重新焕发了活力。事实上，我们可能错误地计算了剂量。在很短的时间内，一个发育更完全的生物开始触碰蛋壳——蛋壳上覆盖着多层密布的装甲板和尖刺。

然而，寄生虫也受到刺激。当它们积极地传送进出胚胎时，该生物的组织就会受到损害。按照这个速度，它很可能会死亡。

我们推测，注入少量的星体丝缕可能会满足量子寄生虫并防止进一步的损害。
astral_rift.2020.desc.en:
Injecting the pale liquid into the exposed embryo has produced some interesting results.

In spite of the quantum parasites, the previously lethargic specimen has become reinvigorated. In fact, we may have miscalculated the dose. In a very short period of time, a more developed creature began pushing at the walls of the egg - one covered in a lattice of overlapping armored plates and spines.

However, the parasites were also stimulated. As they energetically teleport in and out of the embryo, the creature's tissue is being damaged. At this rate, it will likely perish.

We speculate that injecting a small amount of astral thread may satisfy the quantum parasites and prevent further damage.

astral_rift.2025.b.evopred.zh: 高酸性又为这道菜肴增添了风味。
astral_rift.2025.b.evopred.en: High acidity can add flavor to the dish.

astral_rift.2025.desc.zh:
这个生物没有康复的希望。感染它的蛋的寄生虫太危险了，不应该传播到这个裂隙之外。

按照严格的防污染流程，我们用盐酸对附近的所有标本进行了安乐死。我们将带着样品返回以供进一步研究。
astral_rift.2025.desc.en:
This creature had no hope of recovery. The parasites infesting its egg are too dangerous to allow propagation beyond this rift.

Following strict anti-contamination procedures, we have euthanized all specimens in the vicinity with hydrochloric acid. We are returning with samples for further study.

astral_rift.2030.desc.default.zh:
胚胎已经解体。

果然，它体内的寄生体很快就将它朝着随机的方向分裂开来。

$astral_rift.2030.desc.end$
astral_rift.2030.desc.default.en:
The embryo has disintegrated.

As expected, the parasites in its body soon split it apart in random directions.

$astral_rift.2030.desc.end$

astral_rift.2030.desc.injected.zh:
胚胎已经解体。

尽管我们努力稳定样本，但其体内的寄生虫很快将其随机地分裂开。

$astral_rift.2030.desc.end$
astral_rift.2030.desc.injected.en:
The embryo has disintegrated.

Despite our efforts to stabilize the specimen, the parasites in its body soon split it apart in random directions.

$astral_rift.2030.desc.end$

astral_rift.2035.a.tooltip.zh: 可以建造新型进攻部队：$warpling_army$
astral_rift.2035.a.tooltip.en: Can now build new Assault armies: $warpling_army$

astral_rift.2035.desc.zh:
试验成功了。

我们向胚胎中注入的星界丝缕将量子寄生虫稳定住了。

发育完全的幼雏完好无损地破壳而出。它意外地具有服从性，而且很快地学会了基本的命令。基于这点，再加上它厚厚的盔甲般的皮毛和有毒的刺，我们推测这些生物是为了战斗而繁育的。

令人惊奇的是，它们还展现出了短距离曲速跃迁的能力。星界丝缕似乎把这些生物和寄生虫被编织成了某种特别的共生体。

我们可能创造出了某种特别危险的东西。
astral_rift.2035.desc.en:
The experiment was a success.

The astral thread we have injected into the embryo has stabilized the quantum parasites.

The fully-developed hatchling has emerged intact. It is incredibly obedient and was quick to learn the most basic of commands. Based on that, as well as its thick, armored-hide and poisonous spines, we speculate that these creatures were being bred for war. 

Startlingly, it has demonstrated the ability to "warp" small distances. The astral thread seems to have woven a unique symbiotic relationship between the creature and the parasites.

We may have created something entirely too dangerous.

astral_rift.2035.desc.exterminator.zh:
$astral_rift.2035.desc$

这个卑如蝼蚁的星系面对这些我们将释放出去的东西会有多么无助。
astral_rift.2035.desc.exterminator.en:
$astral_rift.2035.desc$

Our pathetic galaxy is not prepared for what we shall soon unleash upon them.

astral_rift.2040.desc.zh:
我们已经完成了研究人员尸体的采集工作，并将其运回来作进一步研究。

他们身上长满了量子寄生虫，这些寄生虫具有任何已知生物有机体所不具有的特性。它们不可预测地“扭曲”物质的能力可能是导致宿主死亡的原因。

两种生物体的星界追踪表明寄生虫起明显源于一个的遥远的次元。我们认为这种寄生虫是无意中被召唤到这里的，它以一种毁灭性的方式中断了该设施的原定研究。

我们已用氢氯酸迅速消灭了害虫，以防止进一步污染。
astral_rift.2040.desc.en:
We've completed the harvesting of the researcher's corpses and are transporting them back for further study.

They were covered with quantum parasites that possess properties unique to any known biological organism. Their ability to unpredictably 'warp' through matter is likely what resulted in the death of their hosts.

Astral tracing of both organisms indicate the parasites originated from a distinct and distant dimension. We believe this parasite was inadvertently summoned here, and has interrupted the intended research of this facility in a devastating fashion.

We have summarily neutralized the pests with hydrochloric acid to prevent further contamination.

astral_rift.2045.desc.zh: [From.GetName]突然去世了。死因是暴露在来自[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]裂隙彼端的致命寄生虫。他的研究部门也被隔离，以待进一步的消杀。
astral_rift.2045.desc.en: [From.GetName] was found dead. The cause was exposure to the deadly parasites beyond the rift in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]. Their quarters are quarantined and awaiting full decontamination.

astral_rift.205.desc.zh:
这只巨兽的装甲所使用的材料组成出乎我们的意料。

他的鳞片具有一种复杂的有机金属晶格互锁结构，使其能够抵御动能冲击。这简直是大自然的鬼斧神工。

对其背后原理的理解促进我们的工程师们重新思考构建太空舰船船体的方式。

如果在战场上碰见那可真是一个可怕的对手。
astral_rift.205.desc.en:
The material composition of the leviathan's armor is beyond our expectations.

Its scales contain a mix of organic and metallic components locked together in a complex lattice that reinforces itself against kinetic shock. It is a true marvel of nature.

Understanding the principles behind it have inspired our engineers to rethink how we construct the hulls of our own spaceships.

This must have been a terrifying adversary to meet in battle.

astral_rift.210.b.evopred.zh: 区区五万年可藏不住你。
astral_rift.210.b.evopred.en: Fifty thousand years is not enough to hide from us.

astral_rift.210.desc.zh:
我们进入了那局漂浮的尸体内部。

因为无法钻穿这只生物令人惊异的装甲，在大量爆炸物的帮助下我们撬开了它的口部。一支小队通过这只巨兽的口进入，开始探索它的内部结构，收集组织样本。

其内部令人惊讶。无数排利齿表明这是一种猎食性生物。非常高效的消化系统占据了它躯体的大部分空间，并且表明这只生物生来可以消化各种物质。

我们也能以此估计它的死亡时间和原因：尽管食性复杂，但它显然发生了脱水。这也表明它可能并不是来自这个维度，它在这里找不到可以饮用的物质。

根据同位素定年，它的躯体已经死亡超过五万年。
astral_rift.210.desc.en:
We have entered the derelict carcass.

While we were unable to penetrate the remarkable armor of the creature, we did succeed in opening its mouth with the aid of a large quantity of explosives. A small team ventured through the mouth of the beast to better understand its internals and collect samples of its tissues.

The interior is fascinating. Countless rows of sharp teeth indicate that this was a predatory organism. A very efficient digestive system occupied the majority of its bulk, and revealed that this creature was in the habit of consuming a wide variety of materials.

We were also able to estimate the time and cause of death: despite the creature's omnivorous habits, there were clear signs of dehydration. This could indicate that it is not native to this dimension, finding nothing here to drink.

Based on carbon-dating, this organism passed away over fifty thousand years ago.

astral_rift.2100.desc.zh:
我们被巨大的机械结构包围了。

齿轮和链条在我们的四面八方转动着。每过十分之一秒，机械就往前搏动一刻。齿轮上的每一个齿几乎都达到了我们$tech_rift_sphere$的宽度。

这一切都坐落在无边无际的稠密气体和浓雾的星云中央，无始无终。
astral_rift.2100.desc.en:
We are surrounded by giant machinery.

Gears and pinions twist in all directions. Each tenth of a second, the machine clicks one step forward. A single tooth from one of these gears is nearly the width of our $tech_rift_sphere$.

Amidst swirling nebulae of dense gas and fog, there is no beginning or end to the device in sight.

astral_rift.2105.a.zh: 干涉可能是不负责任的行为。

astral_rift.2105.desc.zh:
这台次元机械运转得和我们最精密的时钟一样准确。

尽管我们还搞不明白它的动力来源，但是稍加探索我们就发现了通向一系列星界裂隙的竖井。

无论这里到底是什么东西，它的建造应该具有某种目的。这台机器可以延伸至许多的宇宙。

巨大部件的运动在稠密大气中造成了湍流，使我们的仪器难以稳定。通过一些基本的操作，我们可以松开其中一个轴，用它来卡住一对旋转的齿轮。这样可以使环境平息下来，我们才能更仔细地研究这台令人印象深刻的机器。
astral_rift.2105.desc.en:
The movement of this dimensional machine is as precise as our most accurate clocks.

Though we have not been able to determine its power source, with some exploring we have found shafts extending into a series of Astral Rifts.

Whatever this place is, it has been made with a purpose in mind. This machine is reaching into many universes. 

The movement of its massive components are creating turbulence in the dense atmosphere, making it difficult to steady our instruments. With some rudimentary manipulation, we could slip one of the shafts loose and use it to jam a pair of the rotating cogs. This would quiet the agitation of the atmosphere, allowing for a more intimate study of this impressive machinery.

astral_rift.2110.desc.zh:
这个空间的建造者拥有远远超出我们的知识。干扰这些机制可能会产生难以预测的后果。

尽管受到雾的干扰，我们还是在这里逗留了足够长的时间，获得了关于这台巨大机器的精确构造的有用的工程见解，并收集了相当数量的星界物质。

维护这个空间的人一定是伟大的建筑师。
astral_rift.2110.desc.en:
The architects of this space have knowledge far beyond our own. Interfering with these mechanisms could have wildly unpredictable consequences.

Despite the disruptions from the fog, we have lingered long enough to gain useful engineering insight on the precise construction of this massive machinery, as well as collected a sizable amount of astral material.

Whoever maintains this space must be grand architects indeed.

astral_rift.2115.desc.zh:
齿轮被卡住了。

随着一阵剧烈的震动，整台机器停了下来。我们的破坏企图成功了。

随着张力的增加，一个金色的核心从一块网状板底下暴露出来。它光洁如新，但只有很短的时间可以接触它。逐渐增大的张力必然将不可避免突破障碍。我们已经开始了提取核心的精细过程。
astral_rift.2115.desc.en:
The gears have jammed.

With a great shudder, the entire mechanism came to a halt. Our attempt at sabotage was successful.

As the tension grew, a golden core was exposed under one of the reticulated plates. Glowing and pristine, it will only be accessible for a short time. Inevitably, the growing tension will clear the blockage. We have already begun the delicate process of the core's extraction.

astral_rift.2120.desc.zh:
我们试图取出金色核心时，它的表面迅速地蔓延开了一道裂痕。我们还没来得及把它取出来，它就猛烈地向四面八方炸开了。

核心破碎的时候释放出强烈的能量。能量冲破了障碍，使我们周围巨大的齿轮开始疯狂运转。

我们已经启动了紧急锚链来逃离这个不幸的情况。
astral_rift.2120.desc.en:
As we attempted to recover the golden core, a small crack quickly propagated throughout its surface. Before we could complete its retrieval, it exploded violently forth in all directions.

As it shattered, it released an intense energy. Overcoming our blockage, the massive gears around us began spinning wildly out of control.

We have activated the emergency anchor cable to escape this unfortunate situation.

astral_rift.2125.desc.zh:
我们成功地取回了其中一台机器上的金色核心。

周围的齿轮陷入了诡异的沉默，四周原有的张力也一扫而空。

连接到这台装置的星界裂隙网络肉眼可见地停止了微微的震颤，仿佛时间静止了一般。我们无法确定这么做会有什么后果。

我们成功地拖动了锚链离开了这个空间。取回的核心具有显著的时间特性，我们才刚刚开始了解。
astral_rift.2125.desc.en:
We have recovered the golden core of one of the mechanisms.

The surrounding gears now lay oddly silent. All tension around us has been relieved.

The network of Astral Rifts connected to this device have visibly ceased their subtle movements, as if stopped in time. Of what consequence this is, we cannot be sure.

We have safely retracted our anchor cable and left this space. The recovered core has remarkable temporal properties which we are only beginning to understand.

astral_rift.215.a.zh: 试着激活这个十二面体。

astral_rift.215.desc.zh:
我们研究了这个裂隙中的战舰残骸。

这种外形舰船光滑的表面与我们的$tech_rift_sphere_plural$设计颇有相似之处。值得一提的是，似乎这些舰船是设计用于在不依靠锚链撤退而自由进出裂隙的。

我们的工程师还在努力解析这些科技，其他的团队则在最大的残骸内部发现了一个大型的十二面体物体。不进行进一步的测试我们无从猜测其用途，但它储存的谨慎程度毫无疑问暗示了其重要性。
astral_rift.215.desc.en:
We've examined the remains of the warships within this rift.

The smooth surfaces of the alien crafts bear similarities to the design of our $tech_rift_sphere_plural$. Remarkably, it seems that these vessels were designed to freely enter and exit rifts without the need of anchor cable extraction.

While our engineers worked on understanding this technology, the rest of the team discovered a large dodecahedron nestled in the interior of the largest wreck. Without further testing it is impossible to speculate on its purpose, but its careful storage indicates it would have been regarded as important.

astral_rift.220.desc.zh:
我们的团队将这个十二面体带到了$tech_rift_sphere$上进行进一步测试。

对它发现地的进一步调查发现了痕量的星界丝缕。将星界丝缕注入十二面体后，该物体会开始以极高的振动，甚至外形都逐渐模糊成为一个球体。

装置激活后，我们来时的裂隙被封闭了。而当装置关闭时，裂隙又再度打开。

基于这一实验，我们推断，某个远古帝国在面对一个无法匹敌的对手时，他们用这个科技最后一搏，牺牲了他们的舰队把这只生物封禁于此。

这件令人惊异的装置可以让我们大受裨益。
astral_rift.220.desc.en:
Our team brought the dodecahedron aboard the $tech_rift_sphere$ for further examination.

A reinvestigation of its original housing found trace amounts of astral thread. Feeding some into the dodecahedron caused the object to vibrate at a frequency so high that its blurred form began to resemble a sphere.

While the device was active, the rift we entered through was sealed. As soon as the device was 'switched off', it reappeared.

Based on this experiment, we can suppose that faced with a foe they could not destroy, some ancient empire used this technology in a desperate attempt to lock the creature away, sacrificing their fleet in the process.

This remarkable device could prove a significant boon for us.

astral_rift.2200.a.en: Bring it aboard and give aid.

astral_rift.2200.b.en: Bring it aboard to recover its gear.

astral_rift.2200.desc.zh:
我们被垃圾包围了。

时不时就有新裂缝在我们周围的太空中打开，并向旋转的垃圾堆中倾倒更多的垃圾。根据碎片的性质，我们判定这里是一个星际文明的垃圾场。未知机器的零件和碎片与外星家庭的日常一次性用品掺杂散落在一起。

一般来说，这些物品的价值与废料无异。然而，我们的传感器却在其中发现了生命的迹象。

一个穿着宇航服的未知生物的处于休眠状态。目前还不清楚它在这里漂浮了多久。
astral_rift.2200.desc.en:
We are surrounded by garbage.

From time to time, we have witnessed new tears in space open around us and dump even more garbage into the swirling heap. Based on the nature of the debris, this space is being treated as a junkyard for a star-faring civilization. Parts and pieces of unknown machines are littered amongst the everyday disposables of alien households.

Generally, these items are of no greater value than scrap. However, our sensors have picked up signs of life.

Inside of a spacesuit, the unconscious body of an unknown organism lies dormant. It is unclear how long it has been floating here.

astral_rift.2205.desc.help.zh:
$astral_rift.2205.common.1$

在恢复了他的核心体温，稳定了生命体征后，这个外星人很快就复苏了——他满脸困惑，神经紧绷。

他很快抓住了一位我们医疗团队的人员，用靴子中抽出的武器把他们劫为人质。$astral_rift.2205.common.2$
astral_rift.2205.desc.help.en:
$astral_rift.2205.common.1$

After restoring its core temperature and tending to its vitals, the alien revived quickly - confused, and alarmed.

It quickly grabbed a member of our medical team and is currently holding them hostage with a weapon drawn from their boot.$astral_rift.2205.common.2$

astral_rift.2205.desc.recover_gear.zh:
$astral_rift.2205.common.1$

是这件宇航服让这个外星人保持休眠的。一经脱下，这个生物很快就苏醒了——他满脸困惑，神经紧绷。

他很快抓住了一位我们医疗团队的人员，用靴子中抽出的武器把他们劫为人质。$astral_rift.2205.common.2$
astral_rift.2205.desc.recover_gear.en:
$astral_rift.2205.common.1$

Its spacesuit kept the alien in hibernation. After removal, the creature revived quickly - confused, and alarmed.

It quickly grabbed a nearby welding torch and is currently holding a member of our engineering team hostage.$astral_rift.2205.common.2$

astral_rift.2210.desc.help.zh:
$astral_rift.2210.common.1$

虽然人质受了一些轻微的烧伤，但我们保安人员的迅速行动避免了进一步的伤害。

$astral_rift.2210.common.2$
astral_rift.2210.desc.help.en:
$astral_rift.2210.common.1$

Though the hostage sustained some minor burn injuries, the quick actions of our security officer prevented any further damage.

$astral_rift.2210.common.2$

astral_rift.2210.desc.recover_gear.zh:
$astral_rift.2210.common.1$

因为他的装备已经被剥离，对我们来说用普通的等离子子弹来终结他就是小菜一碟。

$astral_rift.2210.common.2$

至于我们取回的他的服装具有高度先进的构造，我们打算留着进行进一步研究。
astral_rift.2210.desc.recover_gear.en:
$astral_rift.2210.common.1$

Completely stripped of gear, it was no great difficulty for us to neutralize it with a simple plasma round.

$astral_rift.2210.common.2$

The suit we recovered is of a highly advanced construction which we plan on keeping for further study.

astral_rift.2215.desc.zh:
为表善意，我们放下了手里的武器。作为回应，这位外星人也松开了我们的[Explorer.GetCrewMember]，并同样放下武器。他看起来情绪十分地激动复杂，不过在这种情况也是可以理解的。

给了他一点冷静的时间，他开始愿意与我们沟通了。

我们开始寻找一种适当的方式来进行对话。虽然进展缓慢，但从其掌握的文件的初步翻译来看，这个外星人已经有几百岁了。
astral_rift.2215.desc.en:
Demonstrating our peaceful intentions, we laid down our weapons. The alien released its grip on our [Explorer.GetCrewMember] and dropped their weapon in return. It appears to be in a highly emotional state, as is to be expected under the current circumstances.

Given some time to calm down, it became receptive to our communications.

We have begun the process of finding a way to hold a proper conversation. Progress has been slow, but early translations of the documents found in its possession indicate the alien is hundreds of years old.

astral_rift.2220.desc.zh:
在我们彻底结果掉这个敌意的外星人之前，他率先从靴子中抽出一把等离子手枪，杀死了人质和其他几名船员。

不幸的是，[Leader.GetName]也在被害者列表之中。

我们拉动了应急锚链，救回了伤者。

我们需要花一些时间来分析这个外星人的太空服。它是用高度先进的合金构造，应该会很有用。
astral_rift.2220.desc.en:
Before we could neutralize the hostile alien, it dispatched their hostage and several others with a powerful plasma pistol drawn from their boot.

Unfortunately, [Leader.GetName] was among the list of casualties.

We are pulling emergency anchor and returning with the wounded.

We have taken the time to analyze the spacesuit of the recovered alien. It is constructed of a highly advanced alloy which should prove useful.

astral_rift.2225.a.zh: 技术高超的驾驶员永远不嫌多。
astral_rift.2225.a.en: A skilled pilot is always a welcome addition.

astral_rift.2225.desc.zh:
这位外星人的名字叫[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetName]。

有一次在往这个次元倾倒垃圾的途中，[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]无意间被卷入了事故。[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer]舰船的次元引擎发生了一些技术故障需要手动维修，而[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]则是唯一一个具有维修技术的人。在维修的过程中，[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]不小心滑入了时空压缩器中，然后失踪了。

[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer]先进的宇航服中的生命支持系统使[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHimHer]保持昏迷超过两个世纪以上。

虽然[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetName]悲伤地思念着家人，但[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer]也知道我们没有办法把[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]送回[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHimHer]来的地方。

[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]具有驾驶先进舰船的极高技艺，应该能很好地适应我们的舰队训练项目。
astral_rift.2225.desc.en:
The alien's name is [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetName].

On a routine haul to dump a load of trash into this dimension, [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] was inadvertently sent along for the ride. A technical issue with the dimensional drive aboard [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer] ship required manual repair, and [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] was the only one with the technical skill to fix it. In doing so, [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] accidentally slipped into the space-time compressor and was lost.

The life support systems of [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer] advanced spacesuit kept [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHimHer] in hibernation for over two centuries.

[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetName] grievously miss[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetEsXX] [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer] family, but know[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetSXX] we have no means to return [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHimHer] from whence [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] came.

Having notable skills in piloting advanced craft, [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] would fit nicely into our fleet training program.

astral_rift.2230.desc.zh: 在经过严格的训练后，[From.GetName]不仅证明了自己是一位出色的飞行员，还取得了我们军官们的信任。[From.GetHeSheCap]可以成为一名出色的指挥官，现已入役等待指派。
astral_rift.2230.desc.en: After extensive training, [From.GetName] [From.GetHasHave] proven to be an excellent pilot and [From.GetHasHave] earned the confidence of our officers. [From.GetHeSheCap] will make an excellent Commander and [From.GetHasHave] been promoted to active service, awaiting assignment.

astral_rift.225.desc.zh: 这件十二面体可是稀有材料的宝库。其内部密布着$astral_threads$，其图案表明它构成了复杂的电路网络。装置的核心则储存着大量的暗物质。这件文物是如何运作的还是一个谜，但我们可以充分地利用构成它的材料。
astral_rift.225.desc.en: The dodecahedron was a treasure trove of rare materials. Its internals were dense with $astral_threads$ in patterns that suggested a complicated network of circuitry. The central core housed a significant quantity of Dark Matter. How this artifact worked remains a mystery, but we can certainly make use of its base components.

astral_rift.2300.c.zh: 我们才不玩什么游戏。电磁脉冲，启动。
astral_rift.2300.c.en: We play no games. Activate an E.M.P.

astral_rift.2300.desc.zh:
此处的环境构成是非物质的。简单的扫描表明，整个空间都是某个未知来源的全息投影。

在我们抵达不久之后就收到了一份用我们语言发出的通讯。我们面前的空间凝聚成了一行文字。

“我不认识你。”

在我们解释了自己的来历之后，这个实体继续说：

“真有趣。那很好。我们玩个游戏吧。我来当创世神。”

全息投影组成了新的画面。在一颗荒芜的星球上，一个[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]物种正在挣扎求生。它正在向我们展示一个幼年文明的诞生。

“我们要对他们施加何种赐福呢？”
astral_rift.2300.desc.en:
