The composition of this environment is immaterial. A simple scan revealed that the entire space is a holographic projection from some unknown source.

Soon after our arrival, we received a communication in our own language. The space in front of us resolved into a single line of text.

"I do not know you."

After we explained our presence, the entity continued:

"How curious. Very well then. Let us play a game. I will take the role of Genesis."

The hologram shifted into a new arrangement. On a desolate world, a [explorer.GetPreFTLLower] species struggles to survive. We are being shown the beginnings of a young civilization.

"What blessing should we grant them?"

astral_rift.2305.desc.zh:
只一瞬间，这个全息文明演化了数个世纪。

“我们的子民变得强大了。”

这个发展中的文明使用新获得的力量来征服自然世界。他们自称为[genesis_new_species_base.GetName]。

“俗话说独木难支。你们认为他们对未来最好应该有何准备？”
astral_rift.2305.desc.en:
In an instant, the holographic civilization advanced through centuries of time.

"Our people have grown powerful."

The developing civilization has used its new-found strength to dominate the natural world. They call themselves the [genesis_new_species_base.GetName].

"But a people cannot prosper by strength alone. How best should they prepare for the future?"

astral_rift.2310.desc.zh:
只一瞬间，这个全息文明演化了数个世纪。

“我们的子民变得聪颖了。”

这个发展中的文明使用新获得的智慧来操控自然世界。他们自称为[genesis_new_species_base.GetName]。

“没有方向的智慧没有意义。我们应该给他们铺上一条什么道路？”
astral_rift.2310.desc.en:
In an instant, the holographic civilization advanced through centuries of time.

"Our people are clever."

The developing civilization has used its intelligence to manipulate the natural world. They call themselves the [genesis_new_species_base.GetName].

"But intelligence without direction is meaningless. What path shall we lay for them?"

astral_rift.2315.desc.zh:
我们通过锚链释放了一道强力的电磁脉冲，全息环境瞬间溶解了。

“创世神”陷入了沉默。结果，这个实体不过是一种先进的中央处理器。我们发现它的核心静静地漂浮在虚空中。我们把它带上了船，准备带回进行进一步研究。

无论这个地方是用来干什么的，它都不复存在了。
astral_rift.2315.desc.en:
We have released a powerful electromagnetic pulse via our anchor cable, dissolving the holographic environment.

"Genesis" has gone silent. In the end, the entity was nothing more than an advanced central processing unit. We found its inert core floating motionless in the void. We have brought it aboard, and will take it back for further study.

Whatever this place was, it is no more.

astral_rift.2330.desc.zh:
“我们的模拟完成了。你的选择已经被记录。感谢你的参与。”

“创世神”停止了一切通讯，我们被强制弹回了我们的维度。我们更关心的是突然出现在我们身边的一群陌生人。

他们的外表和举止与全息图中的人一模一样，热情地欢迎我们。快速医学扫描显示他们是现实生物——毫无疑问，他们是生物。他们是如何形成的，以及他们是如何被运送到球体上的，仍然是一个谜。

现在，我们将把他们安置在附近的一个行星上，[genesis_new_species_selected_planet.GetName]。在那里，我们可以继续观察他们的发展。
astral_rift.2330.desc.en:
"Our simulation is complete. Your choices have been logged. Thank you for your participation."

"Genesis" has ceased all communications, and we have been forcibly ejected back into our dimension. Of more immediate concern are the strangers we discovered along with us.

Identical in appearance and bearing to those witnessed in the hologram, they greeted us warmly. A quick medical scan revealed their biological reality - there is no doubt that these are living beings. How they came to be, and how they were transported aboard the Sphere, remains a mystery.

For now, we will settle them on a nearby planet, [genesis_new_species_selected_planet.GetName]. There, we can continue to observe their development.

astral_rift.2400.b.en: Approach the mass of dark matter.

astral_rift.2400.desc.zh:
我们发现自己身处一张巨大的网中。能量沿着网格状的墙壁有节奏地噼啪作响。

一团浓缩的暗物质云悬浮在这张纠结的网的深处。半透明的卷须向外探测能量屏障，接触后会产生火花，然后反冲回来。幽灵般的粒子像有规律地运动着。且不论这团幽灵般的物质是什么，它对我们的存在是没有反应的。
astral_rift.2400.desc.en:
We find ourselves inside of an enormous mesh. Energy crackles rhythmically along its gridlike walls.

A concentrated cloud of dark matter is suspended deep within this tangled web. Translucent tendrils probe outward against the energy barrier, sparking on contact before recoiling back. The ghostly particles move as if patterned. Whatever this spectral mass may be, it has not reacted to our presence.

astral_rift.2405.desc.zh:
这张网覆盖了巨大的面积，完全暴露在周围的空间中。建造它所使用的技术尚不为人所知，但可以合理地假设，它的设计目的是拦截和捕获非固体材料。

当我们环视四周时，只有那个云团在微微颤动。它是网格中唯一的其他存在。

在我们继续观察的过程中，我们观察到一种从矩阵延伸出来的装置。它似乎限制了流入网格的电流的强度。
astral_rift.2405.desc.en:
Covering an enormous surface area, the mesh is fully exposed to the surrounding space. The technology used in its construction is unfamiliar, but it is reasonable to assume that it was designed to intercept and capture non-solid material.

The amorphous cloud stirred slightly as we surveyed our surroundings. It is the only other presence within the mesh.

As we continued our observations, a mechanism was observed extending from the matrix. It seems to be limiting the amplitude of the current flowing into the mesh.

astral_rift.2410.b.en: We are strangers to this place.

astral_rift.2410.c.zh: 我们是来自异世界的探险家。
astral_rift.2410.c.en: We are explorers from another world.

astral_rift.2415.a.zh: 给这位科学官准备一个容器。
astral_rift.2415.a.en: Offer this scientist as a vessel.

astral_rift.2420.a.zh: 给这个虚无缥缈的生物一个解脱。

astral_rift.2420.desc.default.zh:
一声歇斯底里的哀号响彻我们科研团队的脑海。

$astral_rift.2420.desc.common$
astral_rift.2420.desc.default.en:
A primordial wail rang out through the minds of the research team.

$astral_rift.2420.desc.common$

astral_rift.2420.desc.hive.zh:
一声歇斯底里的哀号响彻我们的集体意识。

$astral_rift.2420.desc.common$
astral_rift.2420.desc.hive.en:
A primordial wail rang out through our collective consciousness.

$astral_rift.2420.desc.common$

astral_rift.2420.desc.machine.zh:
一声歇斯底里的哀号穿过内部通讯的本地线路。

$astral_rift.2420.desc.common$
astral_rift.2420.desc.machine.en:
A primordial wail traversed local lines of internal communication.

$astral_rift.2420.desc.common$

astral_rift.2425.desc.zh:
$astral_rift.2425.desc.common.1$

卷须从幽灵般的云状物中分裂出来，拼命地冲破能量屏障。$astral_rift.2425.desc.common.2$

一道强烈的蓝色火花点燃了整个结构的中心，把这些颗粒压缩成了原来尺寸的很小一部分。$astral_rift.2425.desc.common.3$
astral_rift.2425.desc.en:
$astral_rift.2425.desc.common.1$

Tendrils splintered from the spectral cloud, desperately thrusting against the energy barrier. $astral_rift.2425.desc.common.2$

A violent blue spark ignited in the center of the structure, condensing the particles into a fraction of their original size. $astral_rift.2425.desc.common.3$

astral_rift.2426.desc.zh:
$astral_rift.2425.desc.common.1$

卷须从幽灵般的生物中分裂出来，拼命地冲破能量屏障。$astral_rift.2425.desc.common.2$

一道强烈的蓝色火花点燃了整个结构的中心，把这个实体压缩成了原来尺寸的很小一部分。$astral_rift.2425.desc.common.3$
astral_rift.2426.desc.en:
$astral_rift.2425.desc.common.1$

Tendrils splintered from the spectral creature, desperately thrusting against the energy barrier. $astral_rift.2425.desc.common.2$

A violent blue spark ignited in the center of the structure, condensing the entity into a fraction of their original size. $astral_rift.2425.desc.common.3$

astral_rift.2430.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]被绑在诊断台上，意识转移开始了。他不安地扭动着身体，外来的意识逐渐淹没大脑，导致了无法控制的痉挛。幽灵般的实体变成了不稳定能量的漩涡。突然间，一切归于平静，[Leader.GetName]以一种新的姿态站了起来。

$astral_rift.2430.desc.common$
astral_rift.2430.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] was bound to a diagnostic bench, and the transfer began. They writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably as the foreign consciousness overwhelmed their mind. The ghostly entity became a churning vortex of unstable energy. Suddenly, everything went quiet, and [Leader.GetName] rose with a new demeanor.

$astral_rift.2430.desc.common$

astral_rift.2431.desc.zh:
幽灵般的实体变成了不稳定能量的漩涡。[Leader.GetName]不安地扭动着身体，无法控制地痉挛。突然，他站了起来，脸上带着茫然而又沉思的表情。短暂的停顿之后，他向团队的其他成员做了一个[Leader.GetName]的手势，并示意返回科研船。

$astral_rift.2430.desc.common$
astral_rift.2431.desc.en:
The ghostly entity became a churning vortex of unstable energy. [Leader.GetName] writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably. Suddenly, they rose with a blank yet pensive expression. After a brief pause, they acknowledged the rest of the team with a gesture of their [Leader.GetName] and motioned to return to the Science vessel.

$astral_rift.2430.desc.common$

astral_rift.2435.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]被绑在诊断台上，意识转移开始了。他不安地扭动着身体，外来的意识尝试占据大脑，导致了无法控制的痉挛。然而，[Leader.GetName]挣脱了束缚，取出了隐藏的武器，紧接着就结束了自己的生命，过程中一同带走那个虚无缥缈的生物。

团队里剩下的人试着在这个空间中收集有用的材料，包括大量暗物质，然后启程返航。
astral_rift.2435.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] was bound to a diagnostic bench, and the transfer began. They writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably as the foreign consciousness attempted to occupy their mind. However, [Leader.GetName] managed to escape their restraints and recover a concealed weapon. They subsequently took their own life, killing both themselves and the ethereal creature in the process.

The remaining team attempted to gather whatever other resources were available within this space before returning, including a significant amount of dark matter.

astral_rift.2440.desc.hive.zh:
随着我们把它的意识吸收进我们的意识织构内，这个虚无缥缈的实体开始向自身内部旋转和皱缩。几千年的知识和经验流入了我们更大的意识之中。

$astral_rift.2440.desc.common$
astral_rift.2440.desc.hive.en:
The ethereal entity swirled and thrashed within itself as we absorbed its consciousness into the mind weave. Millennia of knowledge and observations entered our greater consciousness.

$astral_rift.2440.desc.common$

astral_rift.2440.desc.machine.zh:
数据传输开始后，这个虚无缥缈的实体也开始向自身内部旋转和皱缩。几千年的知识和经验流入了我们的网络之中。基于这些信息的优化也开始实装。

$astral_rift.2440.desc.common$
astral_rift.2440.desc.machine.en:
The ethereal entity swirled and thrashed within itself as the stream of data began. Millennia of knowledge and observations entered the network. Optimizations based on this information were implemented accordingly.

$astral_rift.2440.desc.common$

astral_rift.2445.desc.default.zh: 我们一做出明确的决定，这个虚无缥缈的生物立刻就建立了意识连接。$astral_rift.2445.desc.common$
astral_rift.2445.desc.default.en: Once our decision was made clear, the ethereal creature immediately severed the mental connection. $astral_rift.2445.desc.common$

astral_rift.2445.desc.robotic.zh: 我们一做出明确的决定，这个虚无缥缈的生物立刻就建立了通讯线路。$astral_rift.2445.desc.common$
astral_rift.2445.desc.robotic.en: Once our decision was made clear, the ethereal creature immediately severed lines of communication. $astral_rift.2445.desc.common$

astral_rift.2450.desc.zh: 我们在[From.System.GetName]的裂隙另一头研究的实体被它所处的维度中的某个未知操作者摧毁了。我们收集的研究数据到此为止。
astral_rift.2450.desc.en: The entity on the side of the rift we were studying in [From.System.GetName] has been neutralized by an unknown actor within its own dimension. The research data we were collecting has ceased.

astral_rift.2500.desc.zh:
我们进入了一颗陆地星球的大气层。这颗行星看起来可能适合居住，但地形和树叶明显发生了褪色，就好像星球表面和上面的一切都被漂白了一样。

尽管有明显的植物群存在，但船上的传感器显示没有生命迹象。对这个行星生态系统的彻底分析需要进行直接的生物调查。

我们找到了一个可行的着陆点。
astral_rift.2500.desc.en:
We have entered the atmosphere of a continental world. The planet looks potentially habitable, however the terrain and foliage have significant discoloration. It is as if the surface and everything on it has been bleached white.

Despite the obvious presence of flora, onboard sensors indicate no signs of life. A thorough analysis of the planet's ecosystem will require a direct biological survey.

We have located a potential landing site.

astral_rift.2505.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.2505.desc.common.1$

主要矿物质仅有痕量存在，但很难想象在这样的条件下有什么东西能生长。

$astral_rift.2505.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.2505.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.2505.desc.common.1$

There are trace amounts of core minerals, but it is difficult to imagine how anything can grow under such conditions.

$astral_rift.2505.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.2505.desc.plantoid.zh:
$astral_rift.2505.desc.common.1$

这种土壤几乎无法维持种子生长，更不用说破土发芽了。

$astral_rift.2505.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.2505.desc.plantoid.en:
$astral_rift.2505.desc.common.1$

This soil should barely sustain a seedling, let alone a budding ground.

$astral_rift.2505.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.2510.a.zh: 飞向那个方向的地平线。

astral_rift.2510.desc.zh:
随着地下活动越来越强烈，我们从上面看到脆弱的地面爆发出一个个小洞组成的方阵。

从这些洞里冒出一只只小小的石质生命。这些外表粗糙的小东西占据了视野所及的全部土地，也包括我们之前的登陆地点。与粗糙的外表相反，这些生物优雅地穿过淤泥表面，小心翼翼地不伤害脆弱的植物。值得注意的是，机载传感器仍然没有探测到任何生命迹象。

它站在一起面对着地平线，似乎还没有对我们的存在作出反应。

它们的行为中包含着一种期待的意味，但是在期待着什么呢？
astral_rift.2510.desc.en:
As the underground movement grew stronger, we watched from above as the brittle terrain erupted in a matrix of small holes.

From each of these popped a small, lithoid lifeform. Their rough-hewn forms occupied the land from horizon to horizon, including our previous landing site. Despite their rugged exteriors, the creatures moved gracefully through the silted surface, taking care not to damage the fragile plantlife. Remarkably, onboard sensors still do not detect any signs of life.

As one, the creatures stood and faced the horizon. They have not yet reacted to our presence.

There is a sense of anticipation, but for what?

astral_rift.2515.desc.zh:
随着地下活动越来越强烈，我们从上面看到脆弱的地面爆发出一个个小洞组成的方阵。

从这些洞里冒出一只只小小的石质生命。这些外表粗糙的小东西占据了视野所及的全部土地，把我们的营地包围了起来。与粗糙的外表相反，这些生物优雅地穿过淤泥表面，小心翼翼地不伤害脆弱的植物。除了有意避开我们以外，这些生物似乎对我们的存在完全没有别的任何反应。

它全体一致地站起来看向地平线。其中确乎包含着一种期待的意味，但是在期待着什么呢？
astral_rift.2515.desc.en:
As the underground movement grew stronger, we watched as all around us the brittle terrain erupted in a matrix of small holes.

From each of these popped a small, lithoid lifeform. Their roughly-hewn forms occupied the land from horizon to horizon, surrounding our encampment. Their coarse appearance belied their graceful movement; the creatures glided through the terrain, carefully maneuvering around our equipment and the local plant life. Besides avoiding us, none of these creatures have reacted to our presence on their planet.

All at once, the creatures stood to face the horizon. There is a definite sense of anticipation, but for what?

astral_rift.2520.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.2520.desc.common$

这颗恒星的特殊辐射对我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]思维产生了异常影响。它们发生了分歧，但目前仍保持着微妙的联系。
astral_rift.2520.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.2520.desc.common$

The star's peculiar radiation had an anomalous effect on the minds of our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]. They have diverged, but for now remain tenuously connected.

astral_rift.2520.desc.organic_non_gestal.zh:
$astral_rift.2520.desc.common$

$astral_rift.2520.desc.non_gestalt$这颗黑暗恒星的光芒让我们全身都在期待中颤抖。
astral_rift.2520.desc.organic_non_gestal.en:
$astral_rift.2520.desc.common$

$astral_rift.2520.desc.non_gestalt$ The rays of this dark star sent shivers of anticipation throughout our bodies.

astral_rift.2525.desc.lithoid.zh:
$astral_rift.2525.desc.common$

这是一种原始的生物，但具有有趣的特质和芬芳的香味。可以作为理想的宠物。
astral_rift.2525.desc.lithoid.en:
$astral_rift.2525.desc.common$

A primitive species, but with interesting character and a pleasant scent. It would make for an excellent pet.

astral_rift.2525.desc.unfriendly_nonlith.zh:
$astral_rift.2525.desc.common$

作为实验，我们在其他同类的众目睽睽之下将样本砸成了几百块碎片，它们似乎无动于衷。
astral_rift.2525.desc.unfriendly_nonlith.en:
$astral_rift.2525.desc.common$

As an experiment, we hammered the specimen into hundreds of tiny pieces in full view of the others. There was no discernable reaction.

astral_rift.2530.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.2530.desc.common$

一种放松感突然席卷了整个营地。我们沉浸在黑星的光芒中，感受到一种空虚，仿佛能量被虹吸走了一般。在日出前我们还有充足的时间回到$tech_rift_sphere$，但整个团队沉浸在了一种病态的好奇心中，想知道这种现象能给我们带来什么科学启示。
astral_rift.2530.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.2530.desc.common$

A sudden chill overcame our encampment. Bathed in the light of the dark star, we felt a sort of emptiness, as if our energy was being siphoned away. We have ample time to return to the $tech_rift_sphere$ before sunrise, but among the team there is a morbid curiosity as to what this phenomenon can offer us scientifically.

astral_rift.2530.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.2530.desc.common$

在强烈的阳光下，内部通讯链路被断开了。这个异常的天体正在从我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]中虹吸能量！初步评估仍无法确定，但这种独特的能源值得进一步研究。
astral_rift.2530.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.2530.desc.common$

Internal lines of communication dropped briefly due to a powerful solar flare. This anomalous celestial body is siphoning energy from our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]! Initial assessment is uncertain, but such a unique power source warrants further study.

astral_rift.2535.desc.default.zh: 我们在无尽的光芒中直视着恒星。它的光芒照亮了我们的思想和灵魂，照亮并吞噬了它所触及的一切。黑暗之星看透了我们，温柔地带走了我们，引导我们远离无知。我们的视线被夺走了，作为回报，我们得到了目标和真理。前方的道路是清晰的，我们对知识的渴望重新焕发活力。
astral_rift.2535.desc.default.en: We gazed at the star in its infinite radiance. Its light graced our minds and our souls, illuminating and consuming everything that it touched. The Dark Star saw through us, took from us with tenderness, and shepherded us from ignorance. Our sight was taken, and in return we were granted purpose and truth. The path ahead is clear, and our thirst for knowledge revitalized.

astral_rift.2535.desc.hive.zh:
黑暗之星传输了一条讯息。

一条代码，一个信条，一个统一的原则：接受吧，[Leader.GetName]再也不同往昔了。结果我们的集体意识发生了变动。这种良性干预只会支持我们向前发展。
astral_rift.2535.desc.hive.en:
The dark star transmitted a message.

A code, a creed, an overwhelming thought: accepting it, [Leader.GetName] was permanently altered. As a result, the collective mind itself has been changed. This benign intervention will only support us moving forward.

astral_rift.2535.desc.machine.zh:
黑暗之星传输了一条讯息。

一条代码，一个信条，一个统一的原则：接受吧，[Leader.GetName]被重新编程了。结果我们的集体被调整了。这种良性干预只会支持我们向前发展。
astral_rift.2535.desc.machine.en:
The dark star transmitted a message.

A code, a creed, a unifying principle: accepting it, [Leader.GetName] was fully reprogrammed. As a result, the collective itself has been altered. This benign intervention will only support us moving forward.

astral_rift.2535.desc.ordered_turn_away_.zh:
我们不敢避开这颗黑星的光辉。

$astral_rift.2535.desc.default$
astral_rift.2535.desc.ordered_turn_away_.en:
We dare not turn away from the glorious light of this black star.

$astral_rift.2535.desc.default$

astral_rift.2540.desc.default.zh:
暗星的光让人感觉近乎恶毒。即使在我们撤退的时候也能透过$tech_rift_sphere$的船壳感觉到它的光线，它像一种阴险的毒药一样，把我们身体的能量吸走。

$astral_rift.2530.desc.common$
astral_rift.2540.desc.default.en:
The light of the dark star feels almost malevolent. Even during our retreat, the touch of its rays could be felt through the hull of the $tech_rift_sphere$, draining energy from our bodies like an insidious poison.

$astral_rift.2530.desc.common$

astral_rift.2540.desc.gestalt.zh:
这个异常天体的光芒无比强大。它的黑暗光线甚至穿透了$tech_rift_sphere$，对我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]产生了微小的内部损伤。

$astral_rift.2530.desc.common$
astral_rift.2540.desc.gestalt.en:
The light of this anomalous celestial body was immensely powerful. Its dark rays penetrated the hull of the $tech_rift_sphere$, inflicting minor internal damage to our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural].

$astral_rift.2530.desc.common$

astral_rift.2600.desc.zh:
这颗行星的大气中含有数量惊人的抗菌剂。

传感器显示附近没有任何有机生命的迹象。即使在微观层面上，它也已经被彻底化学清洁了。从一个遥远的洞穴传来了微弱的生物信号，但从这个距离来讲是不可能的。

我们目睹了几组机器人在空中巡逻。它们还没有对我们的存在作出反应。
astral_rift.2600.desc.en:
This planet's atmosphere contains a staggering amount of antibacterial agents.

Sensors indicate zero signs of organic life in the immediate vicinity. Even on a microscopic level, it has been chemically removed. There is a faint biological reading emanating from a distant cavern, but from this range it is impossible to qualify.

Several clusters of robots have been witnessed patrolling the skies. They have not yet reacted to our presence.

astral_rift.2605.desc.zh:
我们调查了一小群在空中巡逻的无人机。这些闪闪发光的金属球有一个正面的全息投影仪和一个定向推进器系统来保持它们的速度和高度。

我们在接近时保持了谨慎的距离，但无人机对我们的存在作出了反应。其中四只从集群中分离出来，改变了轨道来迎接我们，但速度相当缓慢。我们还没有触发警报，但接近的无人机的能力尚不清楚。
astral_rift.2605.desc.en:
We investigated a small group of the drones patrolling the skies. These sparkling metallic balls have a front-facing holographic projector and a system of directional thrusters to maintain their speed and altitude.

We kept a cautious distance on approach, but the drones reacted to our presence regardless. Four of them splintered from the pack and changed trajectory to meet us, albeit at a rather slow pace. We have not triggered an alarm, but the approaching drones' capabilities are unknown.

astral_rift.2610.desc.zh:
洞穴中与行星的其他任何地方都有截然不同的氛围。内部的墙壁覆盖着厚厚的太闲，土壤湿润而肥沃，充满了各种有机质。在一个隐蔽的壁龛里躺着一具干枯的鸟类遗骸。根据它的衣着和随身物品，我们认为它应该具有智能。考虑到星球的其他地方没有任何生物迹象，无论死活，所以这具尸体和周围的植物生命反而显得很异常。

我们发现了一架挂在钟乳石上的无人机。虽然仍在运行，但它无法移动。这架无人机显然是为了大量洒布未知的化学溶液而设计的。这台机器的许多内部部件都完好无损，很容易维修。
astral_rift.2610.desc.en:
The cave has a markedly different atmosphere than the rest of the planet. The interior walls are heavy with moss and the soil is moist and rich with organic material. The desiccated remains of an avian creature lie in a secluded alcove. We assume the creature was intelligent based on its attire and belongings. Given that the rest of the planet is devoid of biological material, living or dead, this corpse and the surrounding plant life stand out as an anomaly.

Skewered on a stalactite, we discovered a drone. While still operational, it is unable to move. The drone was clearly designed to distribute an unknown chemical solution in large quantities. Many of the machine's internal components remain intact and could easily be repaired.

astral_rift.2615.desc.zh:
四台无人机慢慢地靠近了$tech_rift_sphere$，开始进行表面检测。其中一台无人机举起了右侧的炮管准备射击。

我们还没来得及反应，无人机就把压缩泡沫喷到了球体的一部分上。它的左炮管里又伸出了一个柔软而耐用的附件，开始擦洗船体上的碎屑和灰尘。其他无人机很快也效仿。

随着清洁工作的进行，其中一架无人机停下来，把它的附肢换成了一根精致的棉签。随着一声响亮的嘟嘟声，它收集了一个样本，然后转身离开了。在进一步清理之后，剩下的三架无人机朝同一个方向离开了。
astral_rift.2615.desc.en:
The four drones slowly approached the $tech_rift_sphere$ and examined its surface. One of the drones primed its right barrel, preparing to fire.

Before we could react, the drone squirted compressed foam over one section of the Sphere. From its left barrel, it revealed a limb with a soft-yet-durable attachment and started scrubbing away debris and dust from our hull. The other drones shortly followed suit.

As the cleaning progressed, one of the drones stopped and switched its attachment to a delicate swab. With a loud beep, it collected a sample and turned away. After some further cleaning, the three remaining drones departed in the same direction.

astral_rift.2620.b.zh: 在它们的增援赶到之前赶紧逃。

astral_rift.2620.desc.zh:
作为安全预防措施，我们向巡逻无人机附近释放了一个短程电磁脉冲。它们马上就瘫痪了，从天空中坠落到了下方贫瘠的土地上。

强大的化学溶液从飞机残骸中泄漏出来，求救信号开始广播。如果我们相信我们是安全的，我们可以跟随求救信号到达预定的目的地。
astral_rift.2620.desc.en:
As a security precaution, we released a short-range electromagnetic pulse in the vicinity of the patrolling drones. Deactivating immediately, they plummeted out of the sky, crashing onto the barren ground below.

Powerful chemical solutions leaked out of their wreckage, and a distress signal began to broadcast. If we believe we are safe, we can follow the distress signal toward its intended destination.

astral_rift.2625.b.evopred.zh: 取回那个鸟类然后研究研究这里发生了什么。
astral_rift.2625.b.evopred.en: Retrieve the avian and determine what happened here.

astral_rift.2625.desc.zh:
尸检没有发现严重的内伤或外伤。这种生物拥有鸟类的所有典型特征：中空的骨骼，角质覆盖的爪子，以及完整的羽毛。最可能的死亡原因是营养不良。

DNA分析表明，这个物种的免疫系统天生就很弱。特别的一点是，它的体内还含有抗菌溶液的沉积。
astral_rift.2625.desc.en:
The autopsy revealed no serious internal or external wounds. The creature possessed all the typical features of an avian species: hollow bones, keratin-coated talons, and evidence of a full plumage. The most likely cause of death was malnutrition.

DNA analysis indicated that this species has (or had) a naturally weak immune system. Peculiarly, the body also contained trapped deposits of antibacterial solution.

astral_rift.2630.desc.zh:
研究小组完成了武装准备之后，从钟乳石中救下了无人机。它利用一个紧凑的定向推进器系统，迅速开始在原地盘旋。随着一声有力的啪啪声，无人机向整个团队喷出了压缩的泡沫。从它的左桶里，露出一个柔软而耐用的附件，开始把我们擦洗干净。团队没有阻止它，因为无人机显然没有恶意。

突然，无人机停了下来。它的清洁装置被一个精致的棉签取代，用来收集污垢样本。它的全息投影仪显示了一个简单的视觉界面。

无人机对这些污垢进行分析和分类，作为新的清洁目标。似乎我们把一种外来物质引入了它的环境。
astral_rift.2630.desc.en:
With the research team armed and ready, we freed the drone from the stalactite. It quickly began to hover in place using a compact system of directional thrusters. With a forceful splat, the drone squirted compressed foam over the entire team. From its left barrel, it revealed a soft-yet-durable attachment and proceeded to scrub us clean. The team allowed this, as the drone clearly meant no harm.

Suddenly the drone stopped. Its cleaning attachment was replaced by a delicate swab, which it used to collect a sample of dirt. Its holographic projector displayed a simple visual interface.

The dirt was analyzed and categorized by the drone as a new target for cleansing. It seems we have introduced a foreign material to its environment.

astral_rift.2635.desc.zh:
我们跟随着无人机的路线回到了一处先进的设施中。这栋建筑在贫瘠的景观之上高耸入云，周围环绕着无人机，每架无人机都在不同的区域之间嗡嗡作响进行着不同的任务。

该设施的中心是科学设备和研究终端的连接点。奇怪的是，虽然大部分操作都是全自动的，但这个区域似乎是为人工研究而设计的；里面应该由有感知的生命来完成的任务，而不是无人机。
astral_rift.2635.desc.en:
We traced the drones' route back to an advanced facility. Standing tall against the sterile landscape, the building was circled by drones, each buzzing between various zones to complete their tasks.

At the heart of the facility was a nexus of scientific equipment and research terminals. Oddly, while most of the operations were fully automated, this area seemed designed for manual research; tasks to be completed by sentient life as opposed to drones.

astral_rift.2640.a.zh: 利用这个无人机的科技。

astral_rift.2640.b.zh: 注入病毒瘫痪这个清洁网络。
astral_rift.2640.b.en: Engineer a virus to disable the sanitation network.

astral_rift.2640.c.zh: 让这台无人机充当个人研究助理。
astral_rift.2640.c.en: Keep this drone as a personal research assistant.

astral_rift.2640.desc.zh:
只有一个结论：这些鸟类在长期的过度消毒运动中意外地导致了自己的灭绝。作为一个天生免疫系统较弱的物种，他们创造了清洁无人机来为公共和私人空间消毒，以减少疾病的传播。

然而，考虑到这颗星球的景观状况，我们可以假设清洁无人机在消灭本土生物方面做过头了，导致了星球上的有机生物多样性崩溃。简单地说，就是他们饿死了。随着尸体腐烂，无人驾驶飞机抹去了他们存在过的每一个痕迹。

至于洞穴里的遗骸，由于一架功能正常的无人机在该地区的存在，其他的无人机为了提高效率都没有再把注意力放在这里，因此植物的生命才得以保持完整。这只鸟类生物利用了这种编程功能上的漏洞才得以侥幸生存。不幸的是，洞穴里贫乏的植物不能无限期地维持下去。
astral_rift.2640.desc.en:
There is only one conclusion: these avians accidentally drove themselves to extinction through a long-term campaign of over-sanitization. As a species with a naturally weak immune system, they created cleaning drones to disinfect public and private spaces in order to reduce the spread of disease.

However, given the state of the planet's landscape, we can assume that the cleaning drones went too far in exterminating native life, resulting in the destruction of organic biodiversity on the planet. Simply put, the population starved to death. As the bodies decomposed, the drones scrubbed away every trace of their existence.

As for the remains in the cave, the presence of a functional drone in the area likely diverted others for the sake of efficiency, leaving the plant life intact. The avian creature must have exploited this programming functionality in order to survive here. Unfortunately, the cave's meager plantlife could not sustain it indefinitely.

astral_rift.2645.a.zh: 记录并研究这个清洁基础设施。
astral_rift.2645.a.en: Document and study the sanitary infrastructure.

astral_rift.2645.desc.clean.zh:
$astral_rift.2645.desc.common_1$

对我们的船体进行过采样的那台无人机独自在实验室里盘旋，它的全息投影仪被照亮，显示一个简单的视觉界面。它从$tech_rift_sphere$中移除的物质已被分析，并归类为新的清洁目标。

$astral_rift.2645.desc.common_2$
astral_rift.2645.desc.clean.en:
$astral_rift.2645.desc.common_1$

The drone that sampled our hull hovers alone in the laboratory with its holographic projector illuminated, displaying a simple visual interface. The substance it removed from the $tech_rift_sphere$ has already been analyzed and categorized as a new cleaning target.

$astral_rift.2645.desc.common_2$

astral_rift.2650.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.2650.desc$

此外，研究这个物种在全球范围内的努力，也能提高我们对个体思维如何能够有效合作的认识。
astral_rift.2650.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.2650.desc$

Furthermore, studying planet-wide efforts by this species has improved our insight into how individual minds are able to collaborate effectively.

astral_rift.2650.tooltip.en: Gives access to the $edict_automated_disinfection$ Empire Edict.

astral_rift.2655.desc.unfriendly.zh: 我们轻易地关闭了自动消毒设施内的系统，直到无人机网络失效。我们汲取了所有的发电机、电源存储和辅助电池，从而收集了大量的能量。
astral_rift.2655.desc.unfriendly.en: We haphazardly shut down systems within the automated sanitization facility until the network of drones had been disabled. We drained every last generator, power store, and ancillary battery - harvesting a significant amount of energy.

astral_rift.2655.desc.xenophile.zh:
$astral_rift.2655.desc.common_1$为了考古学家工作之便我们才将其关闭。

$astral_rift.2655.desc.common_2$
astral_rift.2655.desc.xenophile.en:
$astral_rift.2655.desc.common_1$ Failing that, for the benefit of archaeologists.

$astral_rift.2655.desc.common_2$

astral_rift.2660.desc.zh: 担心有大量的这种自动无人机淹没我们，我们决定避开任何危险升级的可能性此外，这颗贫瘠的星球似乎没有提供什么研究的可能性。我们在离开时从被摧毁的无人机上收集了一些资源。
astral_rift.2660.desc.en: Faced with the risk of a huge number of these autonomous drones swarming us, we decided to avoid any chance of escalating danger. Furthermore, the sterile planet seemed to offer little in the way of research possibilities. We did manage to collect some resources from the destroyed drones as we departed.

astral_rift.2665.desc.zh: 我们取回的消毒无人机可以逆向工程用于帮助我们的殖民工程。它可以用来编目当地动植物群系的细节，帮助我们的殖民者更熟悉新边境的环境。
astral_rift.2665.desc.en: The sanitation drone we have recovered can be reverse engineered to assist in our colonization efforts. It can be repurposed to catalog the minutiae of native flora and fauna to help our colonists familiarize themselves with the terrain of new frontiers.

astral_rift.2670.desc.zh:
我们编写了一个电脑病毒，并将其上载到修复后的清洁无人机的网络中。一旦病毒回到其基地就会开始传播，并最终使这个伪声基础设施瘫痪。

也许这个星球最终会从化学杀菌中恢复过来，新的生命将从这个孤立的洞穴中进化出来。
astral_rift.2670.desc.en:
We engineered a potent computer virus and uploaded it to the repaired cleaning drone's network. Once it returns to its home base, the virus should spread and eventually render the sanitization infrastructure inactive.

Perhaps this planet will eventually recover from its chemical sterilization and new life will evolve from this isolated cave.

astral_rift.2675.desc.zh:
经过一些小的调整，这架翻新的卫生无人机将成为一名出色的研究助手。它具有收集生物样本的能力，执行高灵巧的任务，以及独立飞行的能力，作为我们研究团队的一部分，它有很大的潜力。

我们断开了无人机与卫生网络的连接，并安装了新的程序来补充其现有的功能。在它与[explorer.GetName]一同工作的过程中，我们将继续跟踪它的表现。
astral_rift.2675.desc.en:
After some minor adjustments, this refurbished sanitation drone will make an excellent research assistant. With the ability to collect biological samples, perform high dexterity tasks, and the power of independent flight, it has great potential as part of our research team.

We disconnected the drone from the sanitation network and installed new features to complement its existing capabilities. We will continue to track its performance as it works alongside [explorer.GetName].

astral_rift.2700.desc.zh:
我们来到了一个被猛烈的狂风摧残着的星球。它的表面几乎是光秃秃的，悬崖和巨石被风化得很光滑。

乌云密布，天空一片漆黑，当闪电击中我们周围的地面时，明亮的气团猛烈地喷发出来。

我们应该尽快寻找避风的地方躲避即将来临的暴风雨。气象传感器显示，平流层高处的气流比较温和，我们可以在那里躲避危险的泪点。或者，附近有一个大洞穴也可以提供避难所。
astral_rift.2700.desc.en:
We have arrived on a planet battered by fierce, high-velocity winds. The surface is nearly bare, with its cliffs and boulders weathered smooth by the elements.

The skies above are dark with thunderous clouds and plumes of bright gas erupt violently as lightning strikes the ground around us.

We should soon seek shelter from the gathering storm. Meteorological sensors indicate gentler air currents in the higher stratosphere where we could avoid the dangerous electrical discharges. Alternatively, there is a large cavern nearby that could provide refuge.

astral_rift.2705.a.en: Take a sample of the wind.

astral_rift.2705.desc.zh:
突破云层，我们看见了湛蓝的天空。风继续拍打着我们的船身，每一阵风都更猛烈些。

这些气流不仅仅是一种特殊的天气模式，它们的行为也异常精确。更重要的是，我们在旋转的空气中发现了一种类似激素的化合物。随后的分析显示，这与植物受到攻击时的生物反应惊人地相似。
astral_rift.2705.desc.en:
Breaking through the cloud layer, we observed a piercing blue sky. Wind continued to whip against our hull, gaining strength with every gust.

More than just a peculiar weather pattern, these currents act with unnatural precision. What's more, we detected a hormone-like compound in the swirling air. Subsequent analysis revealed it is strikingly similar to a biological response from a plant under attack.

astral_rift.2710.desc.zh:
我们顺着无情的狂风往下走，穿过厚厚的含硫的孢子云，进入了这个可以遮蔽天气的洞穴。

穿过狭窄的通道后，我们进入了一个空间很高大的洞窟。厚厚的钟乳石把浑浊的液体滴在黄疸的土壤上，土壤里充满了黄色的真菌。在一簇簇蘑菇之间，成群的昆虫在潮湿的地面上轻快地飞舞，昏暗处生长着苍白的植被。陡峭的墙壁上长满了苔藓，浑浊的空气中弥漫着一层厚厚的孢子雾。

在洞里，我们探测到一个微弱的电场：一个由冲动和突触组成的网络，它似乎连接着各种真菌群。也许我们可以进入这个网络，与蘑菇交流。
astral_rift.2710.desc.en:
Descending through the unrelenting torrent of wind, we maneuvered through thick, sulfurous clouds of spores until we entered a weather-shielded cave.

After navigating through tight passages, we entered a huge chamber with a high ceiling. Thick stalactites dripped cloudy liquid onto jaundiced soil which was replete with a yellow fungus. Between the clusters of mushrooms, colonies of insects skittered briskly along the damp terrain and pale vegetation grew in the gloom. Moss coated the steep walls, and a thick haze of spores hung in the stagnant air.

Within the cave, we detected a weak field of electricity; a network of impulses and synapses that seemingly connects the various fungal clusters. Perhaps we can tap into this network and communicate with the mushrooms.

astral_rift.2715.desc.zh:
我们的取样表明，在风中存在着微观组织。

作为实验，我们合成了相似的信息素，将其释放到周围的大气中。突然，狂暴的风转变成了温和的气流。

对样品进一步的研究表明，在足够大的簇中，这些微观组织可以构成一个独立的意识。它们互相合作，可以在风中产生“有生命”的器官。

有一些气流中携带者像发丝一般的基因物质。在同样的气流中，我们推回地面，那里的风暴已经平息了。
astral_rift.2715.desc.en:
Our sample confirmed the presence of microorganisms within the wind.

As an experiment, we synthesized a similar hormone and released it into the surrounding atmosphere. Suddenly, the brutal winds transformed into a much gentler current.

Further analysis of the sample indicated that, in large enough clusters, these microorganisms comprise a single mind. Working together, they are able to generate "living" gusts of wind.

Some of these currents carry hair-like strands of genetic material. Caught in the same current, we were pushed back toward the surface where the storm had now subsided.

astral_rift.2720.desc.zh:
我们利用神经网络的菌丝突触，发出一个短脉冲；每个菌盖都突然绷紧了，显然是被他们内部网络上的一个新角色弄糊涂了。作为回应，我们收到了大量的信号，最终破译了真菌的沟通方式。

这种有机体是一种蜂群思维，将自己视为星球本土物种的守护者。在地表之下，各种各样的动植物都被菌丝团保存和保护着。作为交换，真菌将它们的废物作为食物。

然而，有东西在威胁着这种共生关系和真菌本身的持续生存。
astral_rift.2720.desc.en:
Tapping into the network's mycelial synapses, we issued a short current; every mushroom cap stiffened suddenly, obviously bewildered by a new actor on their internal network. We received a frenzy of signals in response, but eventually we managed to decipher the fungus' transmission.

The organism is a hive mind that views itself as the custodian of the planet's native species. Beneath the surface, all manner of flora and fauna are preserved and protected by the mycelial clusters. In exchange, the fungus consumes their waste as sustenance.

However, a threat exists to this symbiotic relationship, and to the continued survival of the fungus itself.

astral_rift.2725.a.en: Find a way to remove the fungus.

astral_rift.2725.desc.zh:
我们到达了行星的表面，其上漂浮着一层厚厚的云雾。尽管地景几乎一马平川寸草不生，但每一个洞穴和裂隙中都栖息着一些散发着孢子的真菌簇。

我们跟随的气流在这里拂过大地，释放出一捆捆毛茸茸的气生的卵。这些卵飘向地面，大部分很快被真菌孢子的薄毯分解。

存活下来的少量菌种附着在光秃秃的地形上，形成一个圆锥形的水螅体，为风传微生物的安全成熟提供了一个受保护的环境。

显然，真菌孢子阻止了风生物的繁殖。反过来，风生生物夷平了星球表面，迫使真菌撤退到最隐蔽的环境。
astral_rift.2725.desc.en:
We reached the planet's surface, over which hovered a thick layer of yellow clouds. While the landscape was level and mostly bare, every hidden cavity and crevice harbored clusters of spore-spewing fungi.

The air currents we followed here flowed over the landscape, releasing bundles of hairy, air borne spawn. These floated down towards the surface, where most were quickly disintegrated by the blanket of fungal spores.

What little spawn survived attached itself to the bare terrain and formed a conical polyp, providing a protected environment for the wind borne microorganisms to safely mature.

Clearly, the fungal spores are preventing the wind creatures from reproducing. In turn, the wind creatures have leveled the planet's surface, forcing the fungus to retreat to the most sheltered environments.

astral_rift.2730.a.zh: 保护生态系统不被风吞噬。
astral_rift.2730.a.en: Protect the ecosystem against the wind.

astral_rift.2730.desc.zh:
这群真菌把我们带回到洞穴入口，那里的风暴已经平息了。一个小小的爬虫类动物在门槛前犹豫了一下，然后进入了开阔的荒原。几乎与此同时，一股猛烈的风把这只爬行动物卷到了空中。

我们什么也做不了，只能看着它被切成越来越小的碎片，然后被空气中的酶消化。

在真菌构成的避难所之外，地表上的生命完全受食肉风的支配。考虑到它的精准度和反应能力，我们可以有把握地认为，风至少在某种程度上是有知觉的。

而且饥肠辘辘。
astral_rift.2730.desc.en:
The fungus guided us back to the cave entrance, where the storm had subsided. A small, reptilian creature hesitated at the threshold before crossing into the open wastes. Almost immediately, a sharp current of wind scooped the reptile into the air.

We could do nothing but watch as it was sliced into smaller and smaller pieces, only to be digested by enzymes in the air.

Outside of the sanctuary maintained by the fungus, life on the surface is at the mercy of the carnivorous wind. Given its brutal accuracy and responsiveness, it is safe to assume the wind is at least somewhat sentient.

And hungry.

astral_rift.2735.desc.zh:
沿着行星表面行驶，我们接近了一群散发孢子的真菌。组织样本显示，这是一种高度复杂的蜂群思维。通过在节点之间传输快速的电脉冲，进行复杂的网络通信。

我们利用神经网络的菌丝突触发出一个短电流；每个菌盖都突然绷紧了，显然是被他们内部网络上的一个新角色弄糊涂了。作为回应，我们收到了大量信号，其含义尚不清楚。
astral_rift.2735.desc.en:
Traveling along the surface of the planet, we approached a cluster of the spore-emitting fungus. A tissue sample revealed that it is a highly complex hive mind. By transmitting rapid electrical impulses between nodes, it communicates across an intricate network.

Tapping into the network's mycelial synapses, we issued a short current; every mushroom cap stiffened suddenly, obviously bewildered by a new actor on their internal network. We received a frenzy of signals in response, the meaning of which remains unclear.

astral_rift.2740.desc.zh:
在离开洞穴以后以后，我们测量了船周围的强风。我们在周围的空气中发现了一种类似激素的化合物，并对其进行了分析。

这些激素与某些受到威胁的植物释放的激素相似。我们还证实了一种微生物的存在，可能就是它在控制着风。作为实验，我们合成了一种类似的激素并将其释放到大气中。
astral_rift.2740.desc.en:
After exiting the cave, we measured the strong gusts of wind circling our vessel. We detected a hormone-like compound in the surrounding air and analyzed it.

The hormones are similar to those released by certain plants under threat. We have also confirmed the presence of a species of microorganism, which we hypothesize is controlling the wind. As an experiment, we synthesized a similar hormone and released it into the atmosphere.

astral_rift.2755.desc.zh:
我们为风中生物提供了大量的合金碎屑。这些磨料很轻，可以被单独的气流 冲走，但又足够强大，可以在短时间内磨掉大多数矿物质。

一股气流迅速利用这些碎屑撕碎了躲在附近裂缝里的一簇黄色真菌。

风中生物继续将金属屑更广泛地分布在它们之间。猛烈的风开始袭击行星表面，在一场协调一致的轰炸中瞄准了喷出孢子的真菌。

也许是为了表示感谢，一阵微风给我们送来了一捆毛茸茸的浮卵。有了这些，我们就可以培育自己的“活风”，把高速气流带到我们选定的一些殖民地。
astral_rift.2755.desc.en:
We provided the wind creatures with a large quantity of alloyed metal filings. These abrasives were light enough to be swept along individual currents but strong enough to wear away most minerals over a short time.

A group of air currents quickly used these filings to shred a cluster of yellow fungus sheltering inside a nearby crevice.

The wind creatures went on to distribute the metal filings more broadly among themselves. Sharp winds began to strike at the planet's surface, targeting the spore-spewing fungus in a coordinated bombardment.

In what was perhaps a gesture of gratitude, a gentle breeze delivered us a bundle of its hairy, floating spawn. With these, we can foster our own "living winds", bringing high-velocity air currents to a select group of our colonies.

astral_rift.2760.desc.zh:
我们在星球表面散布了大量的矿物质营养物质，并在重新焕发活力的土壤中引入了新的抗风植物。然后，真菌能够在新肥沃的土地上传播大量的孢子。

现有的真菌群在规模和复原力上已经在增长。随着时间的推移，真菌会沿着行星的整个表面蔓延，使风的传播失去动力。

它的节点充满了新发现的力量，真菌沿着它的菌丝网络传递着感激的信息。

一种以前未被发现的真菌标本随后从我们附近的地面发芽。它的球茎腔充满了高浓度的外来气体。我们相信，培育这些“泡沫球”将有助于我们生产这种宝贵的资源。
astral_rift.2760.desc.en:
We distributed a large quantity of mineral nutrients across the planet's surface, and introduced new wind-resistant plant life to the reinvigorated soil. The fungus was then able to spread a huge quantity of spores on the newly-fertile land.

Existing fungal clusters are already growing in size and resilience. Over time, the fungus should creep along the entire surface of the planet, starving-out the propagations of the wind.

Its nodes bursting with a new-found strength, the fungus transmitted a message of gratitude along its mycelial network.

A previously undiscovered fungal specimen then sprouted from the ground near our location. Its bulbous cavities were inflated with high concentrations of exotic gases. We are confident that cultivating these "puffballs" will aid us in the production of this valuable resource.

astral_rift.2765.b.evopred.zh: 对这个生态系统进行采样。
astral_rift.2765.b.evopred.en: Collect a sample of this ecosystem.

astral_rift.2765.desc.zh:
真菌和风中生物之间交流的极端差异导致了一场艰苦而复杂的讨论。然而，我们已经在这两个物种之间达成了协议。

只要它们不干扰现有的孢子群，风生物将有权在星球表面的指定区域狩猎和繁殖。与此同时，真菌的蜂群思维被赋予了同等的空间，在那里它们可以毫无畏惧地传播孢子，在它们的保护网络下容纳无数其他物种。

在这种安排下，这个星球独特的生态系统有了新的繁荣机会。我们已经安装了观测卫星，从裂隙外监视它的进展。
astral_rift.2765.desc.en:
The extreme differences in communication between the fungus and the wind creatures resulted in an arduous, complex discussion. However, we have brokered an agreement between the two species.

So long as they do not disturb existing spore clusters, the wind creatures will have the right to hunt and breed on designated portions of the planet's surface. Meanwhile, the fungal hive mind has been granted an equal part of the landscape where they can spread their spores without fear, hosting the myriad of other species beneath their protective network.

Under this arrangement, the planet's unique ecosystem has a new opportunity to prosper. We have installed observation satellites to keep tabs on its progress from beyond the rift.

astral_rift.2770.desc.zh:
两个[Explorer.GetPreFTLLower]物种之间的斗争实在是烦人。

我们合成了一种强效酸剂，并将其雾化到行星大气层中。随着腐蚀剂的扩散，风生物溶解成灰尘，真菌枯萎变黑。我们能够利用星球大气中现有的化合物，将这种效应级联到整个世界。

在确认这颗行星已经完全被安乐死后，我们把所有有用的物质都拣了出来。
astral_rift.2770.desc.en:
This quarrel between these [Explorer.GetPreFTLLower] species has become tiresome.

We synthesized a potent acid and aerosolized it within the planet's atmosphere. As the caustic agent spread, the wind creatures dissolved into dust and the fungus shriveled and blackened. We were able to exploit existing compounds within the planet's atmosphere to cascade this effect across the entire world.

After confirming that the planet had been fully euthanized, we picked it clean of all useful material.

astral_rift.2790.a.tt.en: [This.GetName] goes from being a Scientist to an Envoy.

astral_rift.2790.b.zh: 还是当科学官更具价值。

astral_rift.2790.desc.zh: [this.GetName]最近在我们所研究的[from.solar_system.GetName]裂隙另一端达成了一项复杂的协议，[this.GetHasHave]请求调换职务。在经历了如此艰难的仲裁过程后，[this.GetHeShe]对谈判产生了新的热情。如果我们允许，[this.GetHeShe]将离开科学界，成为我们现有外交基础设施的常驻使臣。
astral_rift.2790.desc.en: [this.GetName], who recently brokered a complex agreement on the other side of the rift we were studying in [from.solar_system.GetName], [this.GetHasHave] requested a change of duty. After navigating such a difficult arbitration process, [this.GetHeShe] [this.GetHasHave] discovered a new-found passion for negotiation. If we allow it, [this.GetHeShe] would leave the world of science behind to become a permanent envoy in our existing diplomatic infrastructure.

astral_rift.2800.desc.zh:
我们到达了一颗引力特性十分奇特的恒星系。与我们的维度相比，在这个空间中单个物体的引力相对于它们的大小要强得多。

传感器检测到该恒星系中有四颗非常小的天体，其中一个还是个[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]社会的居住地。这是一个由半水生两栖物种居住的陆地星球，除了整个行星在尺寸上大致与我们的$tech_rift_sphere$大小相同之外，它完全没有什么不寻常的地方！

这个微小的智慧物种和他们的家园提供了各种潜在的研究机会。
astral_rift.2800.desc.en:
We have arrived in a star system with peculiar gravitational properties. Individual bodies traveling through this space have a much stronger gravitational pull relative to their size than in our dimension.

Sensors detect four extremely small celestial bodies in this system, one of which is populated by a [explorer.GetPreFTLLower] society. A continental world inhabited by a semi-aquatic amphibian species, it is wholly typical aside from the fact that the entire planet is roughly the size of our $tech_rift_sphere$.

This extremely small intelligent species and their homeworld offer a variety of potential research opportunities.

astral_rift.2805.desc.zh:
由于这颗行星与我们的飞船大小相仿，我们靠近的时候非常小心以免发生碰撞，注意我们也可能因为引力作用影响到它。

然而，我们没有准确地把它的卫星的轨道考虑在内。不一会儿，一次碰撞就发生了，卫星被抛向了更远的太空。

考虑到天然卫星对行星生态系统的效应，我们预计[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]物种会遭受到严重的影响。
astral_rift.2805.desc.en:
Given that the tiny planet itself is a similar size to our vessel, we were careful not to approach it too closely, concerned we might affect it with our gravitational pull.

However, we did not account properly for the trajectory of the planet's moon. Within moments, a collision occurred and the moon was flung further into space.

Given the effect a natural satellite can have on a planet's ecosystem, we expect severe repercussions for the [explorer.GetPreFTLLower] species.

astral_rift.2810.d.en: Inform them that their doom has come.

astral_rift.2810.desc.barbaric_despoiler.zh:
$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.1$

与这个社会建立通讯或许还有机会讹点赎金。

$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.3$
astral_rift.2810.desc.barbaric_despoiler.en:
$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.1$

Establishing communications with this society may provide an opportunity to demand ransom.

$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.3$

astral_rift.2810.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.1$

如果认为合适，我们还可以尝试与社会沟通。

$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.2810.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.1$

If deemed appropriate, we can attempt to communicate with this society.

$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.2810.desc.homicidal.zh:
$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.1$

我们有能力截获他们的通讯，然后对他们想说什么就说什么。

$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.3$
astral_rift.2810.desc.homicidal.en:
$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.1$

We are capable of intercepting their communications and sending whatever communication we wish.

$astral_rift.2810.desc.common.3$

astral_rift.2815.a.en: Attempt to fix the moon's orbit.

astral_rift.2815.d.zh: 切断通讯。静观灾难扩散。
astral_rift.2815.d.en: Cut communications. Watch the destruction unfold.

astral_rift.2815.desc.barbaric_despoiler.zh:
$astral_rift.2815.desc.common$

我们的索要得到了他们敌意的回应，而且看起来他们也没什么值钱的东西能给我们嘛。
astral_rift.2815.desc.barbaric_despoiler.en:
$astral_rift.2815.desc.common$

Our demands for ransom were met with hostility, and they seem to have nothing of value to offer.

astral_rift.2815.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.2815.desc.common$

这些外星人的胆子也……也许我们应该做点什么来证明他们的恐惧。
astral_rift.2815.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.2815.desc.common$

The gall of these aliens... Perhaps we should do something to justify their fear.

astral_rift.2815.desc.homicidal.zh:
我们利用有限的翻译能力为这些[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]物种制作了一条信息，并在它们所有的交流渠道上传播。

“见证自己的末日吧。你所知和已知的一切很快就会消失在时间的长河里。未来将没有你们的存在。我们将带给你们遗忘。”

他们没有回应。
astral_rift.2815.desc.homicidal.en:
We crafted a message for the [explorer.GetPreFTLLower] species using our limited translation capacity, and broadcast it across all their channels of communication.

"Look upon your end. All that you know and have known will soon be lost to time. There is no future in which you continue to exist. We bring you oblivion."

There was no response.

astral_rift.2815.desc.xenophile.zh:
$astral_rift.2815.desc.common$

尽管他们不清楚我们是当前情况的始作俑者，但我们总有办法可以弥补自己的过失。

$astral_rift.2815.desc.outro$
astral_rift.2815.desc.xenophile.en:
$astral_rift.2815.desc.common$

Though they are not aware we are the cause of their current predicament, there must be something we can do to make amends for our mistake.

$astral_rift.2815.desc.outro$

astral_rift.2820.desc.zh:
在经过了许多计算、模拟和测试后，我们成功地将这颗袖珍行星的卫星推回到原来的轨道上。这不会消除潮汐变化已经造成的破坏和生命损失，但我们已经尽了最大努力。

与[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]文明领袖的通讯频道打开了。他们似乎对我们的努力颇为感谢。
astral_rift.2820.desc.en:
After many calculations, simulations, and trials, we managed to delicately nudge the small planet's moon back on its original orbital trajectory. This will not undo the damage and loss of life the tidal shifts have already caused, but we have done the best we can.

Communications with the [explorer.GetPreFTLLower] leaders are now open. They seem grateful for our efforts.

astral_rift.2825.a.en: Put them out of their misery.

astral_rift.2825.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.2825.desc.common$

现在看来把它们直接灭绝了会更加仁慈一些；这么做甚至仅仅只需要用我们的裂隙探球施加很小的一点撞击力就行。然而，我们还是有进一步研究的机会。
astral_rift.2825.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.2825.desc.common$

It may be the most merciful option to extinguish them entirely; it would take no more than a small amount of blunt force from our Rift Sphere. However, further research opportunities do remain.

astral_rift.2825.desc.unfriendly.zh:
$astral_rift.2825.desc.common$

他们无助地看着狂风扫过整个行星的表面。他们命数已定。
astral_rift.2825.desc.unfriendly.en:
$astral_rift.2825.desc.common$

They are helpless as storms rage across their planet. Their fate is sealed.

astral_rift.2830.desc.communications.zh:
我们切断了与[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]领袖的通讯，恢复了被动观测。

$astral_rift.2830.desc.default$
astral_rift.2830.desc.communications.en:
We severed communications with the [explorer.GetPreFTLLower] leaders and resumed passive observations.

$astral_rift.2830.desc.default$

astral_rift.2830.desc.default.zh: 我们在微型恒星系统中放置了监视设备，继续研究这颗微小的行星和[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]物种的后续发展情况。我们很好奇卫星碰撞对环境的影响，以及这个物种是否能在事态变得太严重之前找到一种方法来抵消它的影响。
astral_rift.2830.desc.default.en: We placed surveillance equipment within the miniature star system to continue studying this tiny planet and the [explorer.GetPreFTLLower] species as the situation unfolds. We are curious to see the environmental impacts of our lunar collision, and whether the species can develop a way to counteract its effects before they become too severe.

astral_rift.2835.desc.zh:
给予我们对这颗行星的卫星进行的实验性操作，我们加深了对绕天体运行的卫星一般行为的理解。我们现在可以运用这些知识来更精确地调整我们自己星系内的行星。

我们下面的袖珍星球则正在为我们举行庆祝活动。
astral_rift.2835.desc.en:
As a result of our experimental manipulations with this planet's moon, we have deepened our understanding on the general behavior of satellites orbiting celestial bodies. We can now apply this knowledge to more precisely align planets within our own systems.

The tiny planet below us is currently holding celebrations in our honor.

astral_rift.2835.tt.zh:
你现在可以用行星决议将任意拥有卫星行星进行潮汐锁定
昼半球太阳能农场将有双倍的产出。
astral_rift.2835.tt.en:
You may now Tidal Lock any planet with a moon as a planetary decision.
Dayside Solar Farms are twice as effective.

astral_rift.2840.desc.zh:
我们最大限度地增强了我们的护盾，将推进器的能量调至最大，准备好与这个微小行星碰撞。

在碰撞的瞬间，我们压缩了这颗陆地星球的大气层，并在全球产生了极高压力的冲击波。由此产生的摩擦使空气超加热，蒸发了行星的海洋，并灭绝了所有生命。

这个曾经繁荣的星球所剩下的东西，将成为我们可供展示的一件令人心生畏惧的小玩意。
astral_rift.2840.desc.en:
We maximized our shields, charged our thrusters, and prepared for impact with the tiny planet.

At the moment of impact, we compressed the continental world's atmosphere and sent a shockwave of extreme pressure around the globe. The resulting friction superheated the air, which vaporized the planet's oceans and exterminated all life.

What remains of this once-flourishing world will make for an intimidating trinket to for us to place on display.

astral_rift.2840.tt.zh: 你可以使用行星决议展示微行星的地壳。只能这么做一次。
astral_rift.2840.tt.en: You can display the Microplanet Husk as a planetary decision. It can be done only once.

astral_rift.2845.desc.zh:
观测设备已被部署，以继续研究这颗袖珍行星上的气候条件。

猛烈的暴风雪、干旱、暴雨和各种极端天气已经开始肆虐这个小小的世界。我们在这里的实验将继续提供独特的气象和人类学数据，直到本地物种不可避免地灭绝为止。
astral_rift.2845.desc.en:
Observation equipment has been deployed to continue studying climatic conditions on the tiny planet.

Blistering snowstorms, droughts, torrential rain, and all manner of extreme weather has begun to ravage the little world. Our experiments here will continue to provide unique meteorological and anthropological data until the native species is inevitably wiped out.

astral_rift.2890.desc.zh: 在[from.solar_system.GetName]星界裂隙另一端的这颗微型行星被剧烈的气候变化摧毁了。我们手机的研究数据到此为止。
astral_rift.2890.desc.en: The minute planet on the far side of the Astral Rift in [from.solar_system.GetName] has been decimated by extreme shifts in climate. The research data we were collecting there has ceased.

astral_rift.2900.desc.zh:
我们到达了一个被无数虫洞包围着的熙熙攘攘的星系。各种形状和大小的宇宙飞船围绕着中央明亮的空间站。

这座巨大的建筑上覆盖着五颜六色的标志，上面写着花哨而陌生的文字。这似乎是一座娱乐设施，旨在吸引观众观看一场盛大的表演。考虑到参展船只的数量，无论在这里举行什么展览，它都吸引了令人印象深刻的人群。
astral_rift.2900.desc.en:
We have arrived in a bustling star system surrounded by numerous wormholes. Voidcraft of various shapes and sizes circle a central, brightly lighted space station.

The enormous structure is covered with multicolored signs in garish, unfamiliar script. It seems like an entertainment facility designed to attract an audience for a grand spectacle. Given the number of vessels present, whatever show is taking place here, it has drawn an impressive crowd.

astral_rift.2910.a.en: A flippant use of impressive technology...

astral_rift.2910.desc.zh:
我们刚落座，舞台上就出现了一群穿着闪闪发光服装的狐类哺乳动物。在短暂的高级体操表演之后，舞台中央出现了一个小虫洞。就在洞消失之前，一个勇敢的杂技演员跳进了洞里。另一个虫洞出现在人群上方，把表演者甩了出来，他灵巧地落在地上。

其他表演者也纷纷效仿，在不断变化的虫洞中编织和捕捉彼此的复杂图案。当一名杂技演员滑进一个传送门，在虫洞关闭时切断了他们的一条肢体时，人群倒吸了一口气。就在他们要着地的时候，受伤的演员又从另一个虫洞里消失了。

断臂从椽子上掉下来，抓住了一个空中秋千，然后自己飞向空中。这位独臂杂技演员再次出现，跳得很高，在半空中重新接上假肢，然后降落在其他表演者的金字塔上，最后进行了盛大的表演。

人群显得兴高采烈。
astral_rift.2910.desc.en:
No sooner had we taken our places then a troupe of vulpine mammalians in sparkling costumes appeared on-stage. After a short display of advanced gymnastics, a small wormhole appeared in the center of the stage. One daring acrobat dove inside just before the hole winked out of existence. Another wormhole appeared high above the crowd, ejecting the performer who deftly tumbled to the ground.

The other performers followed suit, weaving and catching one another in complex patterns through an ever-shifting series of wormholes. The crowd gasped as one of the acrobats slipped into a portal, severing a limb from their body as the wormhole closed. Just as they were about to hit the ground, the wounded performer disappeared through yet another wormhole.

The severed arm dropped from the rafters, grabbing a trapeze as it fell and flinging itself into the air. The one-armed acrobat reappeared, leapt high, reattached their prosthetic in mid-air, and landed on a pyramid of the other performers in a grand finale.

The crowd was very pleased.

astral_rift.2915.desc.zh:
一个巨大的爬行类义体人笨重地走到舞台中央。他带着巨大的金属重物，轻巧地扔进自己巨大的下颚。随着一声液压嘶嘶声，它把重物一个接一个地抛向空中，在它们下落时接住它们，然后毫不费力地把它们抛出去。

一声响亮的通告使一些观众吓了一跳。一个有很多触手的机器人、一个双足实体、还有一团浓密的藤蔓被带到舞台上。然后，这些生物心甘情愿地跳进爬行类机器人的嘴里，让自己以同样的方式被巧妙地玩弄。

然后，这只机械野兽把三个人含在嘴里，蹲坐在地上，把自己紧紧压在地上。它巨大的框架发出熔化般的橙色光芒。过程完成后，表演者张开嘴，只有一只生物走了出来。它有触手机器人的球状头部，类毒素的躯干，以及由缠绕的藤蔓组成的粗壮四肢。它向人群做了个手势，引起了一阵震惊的沉默。

然后，半机械人重新吃下了这只奇美拉，并再次吐出了三个人，完好如新。人群紧张的沉默突然变成了欢呼声。
astral_rift.2915.desc.en:
A large, reptilian cyborg lumbered into center stage. It carried huge metal weights, which it deftly tossed into its gargantuan jaw. With a hydraulic hiss, it spat the weights into the air one after another, catching them as they fell and launching them once again in an effortless juggle.

An announcement blared, causing some of the audience to jump. A many-tentacled robot, a bipedal entity, and a living tangle of thick vines were brought to the stage. These creatures then willingly jumped into the reptilian cyborg's mouth, allowing themselves to be deftly juggled in the same manner.

The mechanical beast then held the three volunteers in its mouth and squatted, compressing itself against the floor. Its huge frame glowed a molten orange. Once the process was complete, the performer opened its mouth and only a single creature walked out. It had the bulbous head of the tentacled robot, the torso of the toxoid, and thick limbs made of intertwined vines. It gestured to the crowd, evoking a stunned silence.

The cyborg then re-ingested the biological amalgam and spat out the three individuals once again, good as new. The crowd's nervous silence erupted into cheers.

astral_rift.2920.desc.zh:
最后一幕涉的主角是一头由厚厚的灰色石头组成的生物。它弯曲成奇怪的姿势，把它那块状的四肢扭曲成不可思议的结。然后它高高跃上空中，用它宽大的指尖着地，人群中发出了礼貌的窃窃私语。然而，这只是真正性能的冰山一角。

生物的运动开始缓慢减速，直到时间本身开始逆转。它的身影沿着上次跳跃的弧线折回，停在半空中。人们几乎惊得跳了起来。

突然间，停滞状态被打破了。那个生物回到了地面，开始变形。它的身体从毫无特色的灰色石头变成了闪闪发光的红色水晶、自由流动的沙子、脆弱的蓝色页岩等等。它继续做着一系列更加复杂的扭曲动作。

在它的性能最高的时候，它爆裂成了成千上万的棱柱形碎片。这些碎片以一种复杂的方式冻结在半空中，将舞台上简单的聚光灯折射成一种令人难以置信的色彩和图案的复杂展示。

碎片慢慢地绕回来，直到表演者完好无损地回来，这头怪物离开了舞台，人群中发出了无与伦比的欢呼声。
astral_rift.2920.desc.en:
The final act involved a creature made of a thick gray stone. Bending into peculiar positions, it contorted its blocky limbs into impossible knots. It then jumped high into the air and landed on its wide fingertips, to polite murmurs from the crowd. However, this was only a setup to the true performance.

The creature's movements began to slowly decelerate, to the point at which time itself began to reverse. Its figure traced back along the arc of its previous jump and froze in mid-air. This brought the crowd to life.

Suddenly, the stasis was broken. The creature returned to the ground and began to transform. Its body changed from featureless gray stone to sparkling red crystal, free-flowing sand, brittle blue shale, and more. It continued to perform an ever more complicated series of contortions.

At the height of its performance, it burst into thousands of prismatic shards. These froze mid-air in an intricate arrangement, refracting the stage's simple spotlight into a complex display of incredible colors and patterns.

The shards slowly rewound until the performer was returned whole, and the creature left the stage to an unmatched roar from the crowd.

astral_rift.2925.desc.zh:
演出结束了，但是观众们被邀请留下来与其中一个演员近距离接触。这将是更详细地研究个体的绝佳机会，因为他们每个人都表现出了我们甚至无法复制的能力。

每个表演者都非常受欢迎，所以我们可能只有时间在车站关门前见其中一个。我们应该优先考虑哪个提议?
astral_rift.2925.desc.en:
The show is over, but the audience was invited to stick around to meet one of the acts. It would be an excellent opportunity to study the individuals in more detail, as each of them displayed abilities we cannot even begin to replicate.

Every performer is tremendously popular, so we may only have time to see one before the station closes. Which act should we prioritize?

astral_rift.2930.desc.zh:
狐类杂技演员大约一米高，三角形的耳朵不时地抽动。其他身体特征包括浅黄色的皮毛，灵巧的前爪和弯曲的假拇指，以及短而下垂的尾巴。当它们用尖锐的外星舌头兴奋地喋喋不休时，我们可以看到它们坚硬扁平的牙齿，这意味着它们是食草动物。

杂技演员们与不同的观众进行了热烈的互动。由于粉丝的数量相对较少，他们能够与每一位粉丝进行生动的对话，表演特定的虫洞技巧和体操表演以获得小费。

它们是一群才华横溢的生物，有许多有价值的特性值得研究。
astral_rift.2930.desc.en:
The vulpine acrobats stand at roughly a meter tall with triangular ears that twitch occasionally. Other physical characteristics include pale yellow fur, dextrous forepaws with a curved false thumb, and short hanging tails. When they chatter excitedly in their sharp alien tongue, we can see their tough, flat teeth, implying a herbivorous diet.

The acrobats interact energetically with the various members of the audience. Due to having a relatively smaller number of admirers, they are able to engage with every fan in animated conversation, performing specific wormhole tricks and gymnastic feats for donations.

They are a talented group of specimens, with many valuable properties to study.

astral_rift.2935.desc.zh:
这个爬行类义体人几乎有一艘小型运输船的高度和宽度，它的嘴巴大得几乎也可以把那么大的船吞下去。其他的物理特征包括：灰色的皮肤上贴着透明的电子面板，躯干上固定着一个发光的能量核心，合金金属四肢配有复杂的液压系统。

考虑到它巨大的尺寸，这个半机械人像一座纪念碑一样牢牢地固定在它的位置上。许多粉丝给它带来了吃的，它似乎很喜欢。自愿参加演出的外星人也在场，作为表演的一部分故作姿态。

这个庞大的生物应该会开启各种各样的研究可能性。
astral_rift.2935.desc.en:
The reptilian cyborg stands at the height and width of a small transport ship, with a mouth large enough to nearly swallow it as well. Other physical characteristics include gray-scaled skin patched with transparent electrical panels, a glowing energy core fastened to its torso, and alloyed metal limbs complemented with a complex system of hydraulics.

Given its enormous size, the cyborg is anchored solidly to its spot and is regarded as if it were a monument. Many fans have brought the monolith something to eat, which it seems to appreciate. The aliens that volunteered for the show are also present, posturing as part of the act.

This gargantuan specimen should open up a variety of research possibilities.

astral_rift.2940.desc.zh:
柔术演员高高站在拥挤的人群中，灰色的石头组成粗壮的四肢隐藏着一种柔韧的感觉。它的躯干非常纤细，有划痕、凹痕和碎片，与它们完美无瑕的混凝土般的附属物形成鲜明对比。

这位柔术演员并不是特别健谈，但他会接受别人的要求来展示自己的变形能力，尤其是对年轻的仰慕者或出手阔绰的人。

作为这个热门节目的主角，我们有机会从这个物种身上学到很多东西。
astral_rift.2940.desc.en:
The contortionist stands tall among the crowded assembly, with thick limbs of gray stone that belie a hidden flexibility. Their torso is remarkably slender, marked with scratches, dents, and chips, in stark contrast to their flawless concrete appendages.

The contortionist is not particularly talkative, but is taking requests to show off their metamorphic abilities, especially for younger admirers or big tippers.

As the headline act in this popular show, we have an opportunity to learn a great deal from this specimen.

astral_rift.2960.desc.zh:
我们可以进一步调查杂技演员了。[leader.GetName]以松散的毛囊和丢弃的绷带的形式秘密收集数据样本。似乎没有一个表演者在意我们的行为。他们可能已经习惯了在这段时间里仰慕者的怪异行为。

这些样本果然非常有趣的：根据我们的分析，它们的狐狸基因被某种超然的来源改变了。可以观察到他们的水晶血细胞在空间和时间点之间伸展。不管这对健康有什么负面影响，它能让物种成员以自然的方式操纵虫洞。这一发现将彻底改变我们对遗传学和生物生命的神奇潜力的理解。
astral_rift.2960.desc.en:
We were able to investigate the acrobats more closely. [leader.GetName] surreptitiously collected data samples in the form of loose hair follicles and discarded bandages. None of the performers seemed concerned by our behavior. They may be used to admirers acting peculiarly during these sessions.

The samples proved to be extremely interesting: according to our analysis, their vulpine genetics have been altered by some sort of otherworldly source. Their crystalline blood cells can be observed stretching between points in space and time.  Whatever negative health effects this may have, it allows members of the species to manipulate wormholes in natural fashion. This discovery will revolutionize our understanding of genetics and the marvelous potential of biological life.

astral_rift.2965.desc.zh:
部分得益于我们的大笔捐款，我们能够以更个人的身份与杂技演员见面。表演者非常感激，并展示了各种令人印象深刻的客厅技巧，包括微虫洞——从把小物体切成两半到创造一组无限循环的成对入口。

我们能够记录这一独特的现象以供进一步研究，并且相信这些演示将大大加深我们对超空间技术的理解。诚然，他们对待这种危险的物理学的随意性也着实令人震惊。
astral_rift.2965.desc.en:
We were able to meet the acrobats in a more personal capacity, helped in part by our significant donation. The performers were very appreciative and demonstrated a variety of impressive parlor tricks involving micro-wormholes - from slicing small objects in half to creating an infinitely looping set of paired portals.

We were able to document this unique phenomenon for further study, and are confident these demonstrations will greatly deepen our understanding of hyperspace technology. Admittedly, the casual nature with which they approach such dangerous physics was alarming to witness.

astral_rift.2970.desc.inorganic.zh:
$astral_rift.2970.desc.common$

粘稠的流体充满了生物材料，似乎适合用作高营养食品凝胶的基础。我们正在利用它的特性从有机废物中开发一种类似的消化剂，这将大大提高我们食品生产系统的效率。
astral_rift.2970.desc.inorganic.en:
$astral_rift.2970.desc.common$

The viscous fluid was dense with biological material, and seems suitable for use as a basis for a highly nutritious food gel. We are using its properties to develop a similar alimentary paste out of organic waste which should vastly increase the efficiency of our food production systems.

astral_rift.2970.desc.organic.zh:
$astral_rift.2970.desc.common$

奇怪的是，我们观察到这种黏液对我们的[leader.species.GetSkinType]有显著的愈合作用。小小的伤口和擦伤干净利落地愈合了，留下了一种愉快的感觉。这种生物致密的液体可以用作各种药物和治疗方法的溶剂。
astral_rift.2970.desc.organic.en:
$astral_rift.2970.desc.common$

Strangely enough, the slime was observed to have remarkable healing properties on our [leader.species.GetSkinType]. Small wounds and abrasions cleanly knitted themselves whole and left behind a pleasant sensation. This biologically dense fluid could be used as a solvent for a variety of medicinal and curative therapies.

astral_rift.2975.desc.zh:
部分因为捐赠了大量的食物，我们能够以更个人的身份与庞大的义体人见面。

这只大嘴巴的动物异常热情，兴奋地转过身来。它花了很多分钟完成这个360度旋转，让我们对它的义体控制增强和支持系统进行了深入的研究。

从我们的分析中，我们能够确定它曾经是由一只典型的智慧爬行动物物种构成的，现在它的大部分质量都归功于强化组件的安装。鉴于更新的数量庞大，且许多遭受到了明显的氧化，这个个体应该已经活了几个世纪。
astral_rift.2975.desc.en:
We were able to meet the massive cyborg in a more personal capacity, helped in part by our significant donation of food.

The wide-mouthed creature was uncharacteristically enthusiastic and turned itself around in excitement. It spent many minutes completing this 360 degree spin, allowing us an in-depth cataloging of its cyborg's cybernetic enhancements and support systems.

From our analysis, we were able to determine that they had once been a fraction of its current size as a typical sapient reptilian species and owes most of its mass to their augmentations. Given the huge number of upgrades in various conditions of oxidation, this individual must have been alive for centuries.

astral_rift.2980.desc.zh:
我们挤过人群，能够更近距离地观察那位柔术演员。

他们向我们展示了一只沉重的石头手臂，毫不费力地把它变成了一堆不同的矿物。最初粗糙的花岗岩变成了暗红色的宝石，最后变成了闪闪发光的晶体。材料的移动将细小的尘埃颗粒送入空气中，我们很快就将其作为样本收集下来。

这些样品含有一种挥发性生物物质，可以在非常特殊的条件下使某些矿物质自发结晶。这种材料的大规模使用可以利用到我们现有的矿物生产中，并达到类似的效果。
astral_rift.2980.desc.en:
Pushing ourselves through the crowds, we were able to investigate the contortionist more closely.

They displayed for us one of their heavy stone arms, effortlessly transforming it into a cluster of different minerals. What began as coarse granite shifted into dull red gemstones, and finally sparkling crystals. The shifting of the material sent fine particles of dust into the air, which we were quick to secure as a sample.

The samples contain a volatile biological substance that can be used to spontaneously crystallize certain minerals under very specific conditions. The use of this material on a large scale could be leveraged into our existing mineral production and achieve similar effects.

astral_rift.2985.desc.zh:
部分得益于我们的大额捐款，我们能够以更个人的身份与柔术演员会面。

这个生物的物质似乎并不完全受我们现实的束缚。仔细观察后，它告诉我们，它是如何改变复合材料的磁性排列的，这样一来，通往其他维度的小开口就形成了足够长的长度，可以把自己的原子与来自另一个时间和地点的原子交换出来。有了这样的量子重新排列机制，很难说这个生物是否和我们几个小时前遇到的完全一样。

虽然这样的能力确实让人印象深刻，但我们一想到这个物种的整个文明能取得什么成就，就会不寒而栗。尽管如此，这是一个宝贵的研究机会。
astral_rift.2985.desc.en:
We were able to meet the contortionist in a more personal capacity, helped in part by our significant donation.

The material of this creature did not seem wholly bound to this reality. On closer inspection, it shared with us how it could shift the magnetic alignments of its composite materials in such a way that small openings into other dimensions formed just long enough to literally swap its own atoms out with those from another time and place. With such quantum realignments, it is difficult to know if this being is the same as we encountered only hours ago.

While such an ability does make for an impressive performance, we shudder to think what an entire civilization of this species could achieve. It has been a valuable research opportunity, nonetheless.

astral_rift.3.b.trigger_tt.zh: 我们可没兴趣和弱者过家家。
astral_rift.3.b.trigger_tt.en: We have no interest in holding council with weaklings.

astral_rift.3.desc.default.zh:
在这颗行星的地表有数个大型人口中心。从他们的通讯内容中我们辨别出了两个截然不同的意识形态派系。

[GetStarlightVanguardName]是坚定的军国主义者，准备以万众之志抵御即将到来的战争。

黑幕派则是一种教权秩序，他们在迫在眉睫的威胁面前允诺灵魂的安宁。

现在，我们很确定如此相似的语言绝非巧合。这就是我们活生生的祖先，而无论哪个派系现在都岌岌可危。
astral_rift.3.desc.default.en:
There are several large population centers on the surface of the planet. Based on their transmissions, we have identified two distinct ideological factions.

The [GetStarlightVanguardName] are grim militarists, preparing for the coming conflict with unified determination.

The Black Curtain are a priestly order, promising spiritual sanctuary from the looming threat.

At this point, we are certain that the similarities in our languages cannot be mere coincidence. These are our living ancestors, and both factions are in danger.

astral_rift.3.desc.hive.zh:
$astral_rift.3.desc.default$

这些人与我们书同文，面同相，却具有自主意识。这怎么可能呢？
astral_rift.3.desc.hive.en:
$astral_rift.3.desc.default$

These people use our language. Their physiognomy is nearly identical to our own. Yet they possess individual minds. How can that be?

astral_rift.3.desc.machine.zh:
这是一些自主单元！他们与网络意识大相径庭，每个个体都有独立的运算和决策能力。在这颗行星的表面有许多大型的人口中心。基于他们的通讯内容，我们甚至辨识出了两个截然不同的意识形态阵营。

[GetStarlightVanguardName]是坚定的军国主义者，准备以万众之志抵御即将到来的战争。

黑幕派则是一种教权秩序，他们在迫在眉睫的威胁面前允诺灵魂的安宁。

我们的祖先现在岌岌可危了。
astral_rift.3.desc.machine.en:
These are individual units! Far from a networked consciousness, each one has its own processing power and decision making capabilities. There are several large population centers on the surface of the planet. Based on their transmissions, we have identified two distinct ideological factions.

The [GetStarlightVanguardName] are grim militarists, preparing for the coming conflict with unified determination.

The Black Curtain are a priestly order, promising spiritual sanctuary from the looming threat.

Our predecessors are in danger of being wiped out.

astral_rift.30.a.en: Take as many back as we can.

astral_rift.30.a.trigger_tt.zh: 我们可没有兴趣保留我们先祖中的最弱者。
astral_rift.30.a.trigger_tt.en: We hold no interest in preserving the weakest of our ancestors.

astral_rift.30.desc.default.zh:
惨败在所难免。

我们先祖的舰队面对入侵者毫无胜算。入侵者武器骇人且毫无慈悲。现在先祖们已经几乎没有立锥之地了，人们惊慌失措地恳求我们把他们从裂隙中带走逃生。

$astral_rift.30.desc.common$
astral_rift.30.desc.default.en:
The carnage was absolute.

Our ancestral fleets stood no chance against the invaders. Their weapons are terrible, and their mercy is none. Few bastions of safety now remain. The people are panicking and begging to flee back with us back through the rift.

$astral_rift.30.desc.common$

astral_rift.30.desc.homicidal.zh:
我们的先祖被入侵者们轻易地击败了，很快将面临种族灭绝。他们已经坦然接受了失败，等待着终结的降临。

$astral_rift.30.desc.common$
astral_rift.30.desc.homicidal.en:
Our ancestors were easily bested by the invaders and will soon succumb to extermination. They have accepted the shame of defeat and now await the end.

$astral_rift.30.desc.common$

astral_rift.300.desc.zh:
我们进入了一个充满令人困惑的视觉奇景、几何图案和变幻莫测的色彩的空间。

尽管周围的环境看起来并不危险，但它们就像视错觉一样让人迷失方向。构成这个宇宙的物质令人困惑。无论这些样本如何放大，我们都会看到同样的重复模式，如同自身的无限浓缩。

很明显，在这个裂隙中有一些我们还不了解的物理原理。
astral_rift.300.desc.en:
We have entered a space of confusing visual spectacles, geometric patterns, and shifting colors.

The surroundings do not appear dangerous, but they are as disorientating as an optical illusion. Attempts to analyze the material that makes up this universe are baffling. No matter how intensely the samples are magnified, we are confronted by the same repeating patterns. It is as if they condense towards infinity.

Clearly, there are physical principles operating inside of this rift that we do not yet understand.

astral_rift.3000.desc.zh:
我们来到了一个欣欣向荣的行星。从茂密的森林到青翠的平原，这里的景色曾经丰富多彩，维护得一尘不染，一个生机勃勃的星球花园。

一个身份不明的植物类物种在半有机城市周围修建了大量防御设施。对当地恒星系统的扫描显示，这里被装备精良的战舰封锁。虽然没有发生冲突，但很明显，冲突正在酝酿之中。
astral_rift.3000.desc.en:
We arrived on a thriving planet. From its dense forests to the verdant plains, the landscape was at once diverse and immaculately maintained - a vibrant and planet-wide garden.

An unidentified plantoid species has erected extensive fortifications around the semi-organic cities. Scans of the local star system have revealed a blockade of heavily equipped warships. There is no active conflict, but it is clear that one is brewing.

astral_rift.3005.a.zh: 告诉他们我们对巴奥的全部了解。
astral_rift.3005.a.en: Disclose what we know about the Baol.

astral_rift.3010.a.zh: 我们将尽我们所能提供帮助。
astral_rift.3010.a.en: We will help however we can.

astral_rift.3010.b.en: It is not our place to interfere.

astral_rift.3010.desc.baol_completed.zh:
$astral_rift.3010.desc.common.1$古茹努尔的军国主义帝国的攻击并最终被消灭。

所有巴奥星球行星和殖民地都被摧毁了。最终，只剩下一个巴奥个体，在一个废弃的研究站内被困了数千年。

$astral_rift.3010.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.3010.desc.baol_completed.en:
$astral_rift.3010.desc.common.1$ a militaristic empire, the Grunur.

Every Baol planet and colony was destroyed. In the end, only a single Baol node remained, trapped for millenia inside an abandoned research station.

$astral_rift.3010.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.3010.desc.baol_started.zh:
$astral_rift.3010.desc.common.1$古茹努尔的军国主义种族的攻击并最终被消灭。

从目前的情况来看，这个殖民地正面临着被燃烧殆尽的危险。

$astral_rift.3010.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.3010.desc.baol_started.en:
$astral_rift.3010.desc.common.1$ a militaristic race called the Grunur.

The way things stand, this colony is in danger of being burned to the ground.

$astral_rift.3010.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.3015.desc.zh:
“我们正在为即将到来的战斗做好准备。遗憾的是，你们的探险可能比之前评估的要危险得多。”

植物类种族继续说到：“我们是巴奥，你们在我们的一个外围殖民地上登陆。我们被围困了，资源日益减少。外交毫无结果。侵略者公然嘲笑我们试图沟通的努力。他们自称古茹努尔。”

"我们相信他们的目标不是征服这个星球，而是毁灭它。他们似乎毫不留情。我们会礼貌地接受你们提供的任何援助。"
astral_rift.3015.desc.en:
"We make preparations for a coming battle. Regrettably, your expedition may be much more dangerous than previously assessed."

The plantoid continued, "We are the Baol, and you have landed on one of our outer colonies. We are under siege, and our resources dwindle. Diplomacy is fruitless. The aggressors mock us openly, and laugh at our attempts to communicate. They identify themselves as the Grunur."

"We believe their aim is not to conquer this world, but to destroy it. It seems they know no mercy. We would graciously accept any assistance you can provide."

astral_rift.3020.b.zh: 部署实验性行星隐形技术。

astral_rift.3020.desc.baol_completed.zh: 我们知道古茹努尔在摧毁巴奥之前是不会停手的。$astral_rift.3020.desc.common.baol$
astral_rift.3020.desc.baol_completed.en: We know that the Grunur will stop at nothing to destroy the Baol. $astral_rift.3020.desc.common.baol$

astral_rift.3020.desc.baol_started.zh: 我们知道古茹努尔会把这个殖民地夷为平地。$astral_rift.3020.desc.common.baol$
astral_rift.3020.desc.baol_started.en: We know that the Grunur will burn this colony to the ground. $astral_rift.3020.desc.common.baol$

astral_rift.3020.desc.common.1.zh: 我们已经与巴奥进行讨论确定提供援助的实用方法。
astral_rift.3020.desc.common.1.en: We've engaged in discussions with the Baol to determine a practical way to lend aid.

astral_rift.3020.desc.common.2.zh: 作为最后的手段，我们可以将巴奥幼苗带回裂隙，无论这个维度发生什么，这个物种都将能够继续生存。
astral_rift.3020.desc.common.2.en: As a last resort, we could carry Baol seedlings back through the Rift, allowing the species to live on no matter what happens in this dimension.

astral_rift.3020.desc.option_astral_shie.zh: 我们可以尝试用星界丝缕来增强巴奥的先进有机技术。应该可以在这个殖民地周围建立一个强大的护盾。当然，这将使他们无法离开这颗行星，但至少他们也可以免受入侵者的侵害。
astral_rift.3020.desc.option_astral_shie.en: We could attempt to enhance the Baol's advanced organic technology with astral thread. It should be possible to establish a powerful shield around this colony. Of course, this will prevent them from leaving the planet, but at least they would be safe from the invaders.

astral_rift.3020.desc.option_cloaking.zh: 我们可以用临时隐形装置遮蔽他们的母星，从而帮助巴奥躲避古茹努尔。这个殖民地仍然会消失，但至少他们的文明所在地将会幸存。
astral_rift.3020.desc.option_cloaking.en: We may help the Baol evade the Grunur by obscuring their homeworld with a temporary cloaking device. This colony would still be lost, but at least the seat of their civilization will survive.

astral_rift.3020.desc.option_gene_tailor.zh: 巴奥可以尝试自卫，但他们军事能力有限。他们可以从机械或基因增强中受益，以提高陆军的速度、力量和对燃烧武器的抵抗力。
astral_rift.3020.desc.option_gene_tailor.en: The Baol can attempt to defend themselves, but have limited military capabilities. They would benefit from mechanical or genetic enhancement to improve their armies' speed, strength and resistance to incendiary weapons.

astral_rift.3021.desc.common.zh:
由于外交是不可能的选项，我们需要更有创造性的方案以提供支持。

$astral_rift.3020.desc.common.1$
astral_rift.3021.desc.common.en:
With diplomacy out of the question, we will need to be creative in our support.

$astral_rift.3020.desc.common.1$

astral_rift.3025.desc.zh:
巴奥的问题，无论是军事上还是别的，我们都不关心。我们应该从另一个维度去观察和探索；我们也不想树立新的强大敌人。

蜂巢思维明显失望地接受了我们的决定，但让我们继续研究。
astral_rift.3025.desc.en:
The Baol's problems, military or otherwise, are not our concern. We have journeyed from another dimension to observe and explore; we have no desire to make new and powerful enemies.

The hive mind accepted our decision with obvious disappointment, but left us to continue our research.

astral_rift.3030.desc.zh:
我们利用基因剪裁技术的知识来强化巴奥物种，让他们准备好迎接即将到来的防御战。由于几乎没有其他选择，他们不情愿地接受了这些生物学上的变化。和平的巴奥帝国以农业和生态系统管理为基础，现在拥有一支由具有强大体力的高复原力子个体组成的常备民兵。

现在，巴奥已经为地面战做好了更多准备，出于感激之情，他们为我们提供了一个防御个体。这种专门的、半自主的生物现在将为我们服务。
astral_rift.3030.desc.en:
We used our knowledge of gene tailoring technology to fortify the Baol species in their upcoming defensive campaign. With few options left, they reluctantly accepted these changes to their biology. The pacifistic Baol empire, built on agriculture and ecosystem management, is now populated by a standing militia of highly resilient drones with tremendous physical strength.

Now more prepared for land warfare, the Baol have offered us a defensive node out of gratitude. This specialized, semi-autonomous creature will now serve us.

astral_rift.3031.a.zh: 你是巴奥的防御专家吗？
astral_rift.3031.a.en: You were a defensive specialist for the Baol?

astral_rift.3031.a.response.zh: 这个任务的任务是为我们的殖民地做好防御战争的准备。这涉及在围困期间管理有限的资源，以及军事防御工事的设计和维护。尽管已被封锁，这一地区仍保持稳定的人口水平。这项工作被认为是有用的。
astral_rift.3031.a.response.en: This one was tasked with preparing our colony for a defensive war. This involved managing limited resources while under siege, as well as the design and upkeep of military fortifications. This one maintained steady population levels despite the blockade. This one's work was deemed useful.

astral_rift.3031.b.en: How do you feel about joining us?

astral_rift.3031.b.response.zh: 这个体为巴奥做了一切能做的事。在这个职位上，没有进一步的成长空间；当一个生命系统无法生长时，它就开始凋亡。在这个维度上还有进一步的服务机遇。还有复兴的希望。
astral_rift.3031.b.response.en: This one did all it could for the Baol. In that role, there was no further room for growth; when a living system fails to grow, it begins to die. In this dimension there is further opportunity for service. There is hope of renewal.

astral_rift.3031.c.en: How does it feel to be separated from the collective?

astral_rift.3031.c.response.zh: 感到了受限。令人沮丧……同时也令人兴奋。这种感觉与该个体此前经历过的任何情况都不一样。然而，越早将该个体融入[Explorer.GetName]的工作中就越好。为一个更大的实体服务是更令人愉快的事情。
astral_rift.3031.c.response.en: Limited. Frustrating... Exhilarating. The sensation is unlike anything this one has ever experienced. However, the sooner this one is integrated into the workings of [Explorer.GetName] the better. It is much more agreeable to work in service of a greater entity.

astral_rift.3031.d.zh: 你选择一个什么样的名字呢？
astral_rift.3031.d.en: How did you choose your name?

astral_rift.3031.d.response.zh: 你们的一位来自星界裂隙的研究人员为这个个体提供了一个人工智能文本生成程序。根据此个体的特质进行查询，返回的结果为：$NAME_Baol_leader$。感觉……挺合适。
astral_rift.3031.d.response.en: One of your researchers that came through the Astral Rift provided this one with an artificially intelligent text generation program. A query was made based on this one's qualities, and it returned: $NAME_Baol_leader$. It feels... suitable.

astral_rift.3031.desc.zh:
植物类种族个体的移动速度缓慢，但如果它行动迟缓是因为他们缺乏智慧，那可就大错特错。这种个体专门用于保卫集体，代表了几代精心适应的顶峰。它们冷酷而礼貌地向我们打招呼，一心想要对我们给予它们蜂巢的恩惠做出回报。

作为巴奥的一部分，我们没有名字。你可以称呼我们为$NAME_Baol_leader$。
astral_rift.3031.desc.en:
The plantoid node moves with slow deliberation, but it would be a mistake to take its lumbering for lack of intelligence. Specialized to defend the collective, this organism represents the pinnacle of generations of careful adaptation. They greet us grimly, but politely, intent on repaying the favor we bestowed upon their hive.

As part of the Baol, we had no name. You may call us $NAME_Baol_leader$.

astral_rift.3035.desc.zh:
在与巴奥分享隐形领域的秘密后，他们就能生产出有机隐形卫星阵列。这些实验性分枝本质短寿，并且需要少量的星界丝缕来维持，但它们应该持续足够撑到将巴奥的母星隐藏在古茹努尔的视野之外。不幸的是，这个殖民地已经为古茹努尔人所知，并且很可能是注定要灭亡的。

一旦隐形，巴奥将不得不暂时牺牲其星际旅行的雄心壮志，因为只要有飞船从母星出发的飞船都有可能会暴露其位置。当然，这种不便还是比毁灭要好得多的。
astral_rift.3035.desc.en:
After sharing the secrets of the cloaking field with the Baol, they were able to produce an array of organic cloaking satellites. These experimental offshoots are temporary in nature, and require a small amount of astral thread to maintain, but they should last long enough to hide the Baol homeworld from the Grunur. Unfortunately, this colony is already known to the Grunur, and is likely doomed.

Once cloaked, the Baol will have to sacrifice their space-faring ambitions for the time being, as any ship sighted departing from the homeworld may reveal its location. Of course, this inconvenience is infinitely preferable to annihilation.

astral_rift.3040.desc.baol_completed.zh:
$astral_rift.3040.desc.common$

当巴奥不可避免地被毁灭时，也许他们会因知道他们的物种将在另一个维度生存而感到慰藉。
astral_rift.3040.desc.baol_completed.en:
$astral_rift.3040.desc.common$

When the Baol are inevitably destroyed, perhaps they will take comfort in the knowledge that their species will live on in another dimension.

astral_rift.3040.desc.baol_started.zh:
$astral_rift.3040.desc.common$

如果巴奥和古茹努尔之间的冲突进一步升级，至少我们能够从战争的蹂躏中拯救他们的一些物种。
astral_rift.3040.desc.baol_started.en:
$astral_rift.3040.desc.common$

If the conflict between the Baol and the Grunur escalates further, at least we were able to rescue some of their species from the ravages of war.

astral_rift.3040.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.3040.desc.common$

我们希望他们的冲突能够尽快结束，巴奥能够在裂隙两边都繁荣昌盛。
astral_rift.3040.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.3040.desc.common$

We hope that their conflict will end soon and that the Baol will live on prosperously on both sides of the rift.

astral_rift.3045.a.zh: 这是一个独特的研究机会。
astral_rift.3045.a.en: This is a unique research opportunity.

astral_rift.3045.desc.zh:
$astral_rift.3045_3046.desc.common$
