现在，我们将研究巴奥先进的农业和生态系统管理技术。当那天真的来临的时候，我们还将捕捉到古茹努尔毁灭行星的关键镜头。
astral_rift.3045.desc.en:
$astral_rift.3045_3046.desc.common$

For now, we will study the Baol's advanced agriculture and ecosystem management techniques. When the time comes, we will also capture crucial footage of the planet's annihilation by the Grunur.

astral_rift.3046.desc.zh:
$astral_rift.3045_3046.desc.common$

他们的冲突开始之前，我们可以研究巴奥尔星球及其生态系统管理。同时这场战争也应该为未来的研究提供有趣的数据点。
astral_rift.3046.desc.en:
$astral_rift.3045_3046.desc.common$

We will study the Baol planet and their ecosystem management until their conflict begins. This war should also provide interesting data points for future research.

astral_rift.3047.desc.zh: 远离裂隙一端，位于[From.solar_system.GetName]的巴奥殖民地已被古茹努尔摧毁。我们从战斗中收集了详细的研究数据，但这个观测项目的目标已经被消除了。
astral_rift.3047.desc.en: The Baol colony on the far side of the rift in [From.solar_system.GetName] has been destroyed by the Grunur. We gathered detailed research data from battle, but the target of this observation project has been eliminated.

astral_rift.3049.desc.zh:
通过将星界丝缕整合到巴奥的防御技术中，我们在他们被围困的殖民地周围投射了一种反应式、但很坚固的行星护盾。护盾将包围行星并保护巴奥，只要它还存在。

希望它能存在足够长的时间，让古茹努尔继续前往更容易接近的目标。
astral_rift.3049.desc.en:
By integrating astral thread into the Baol's defensive technology, we have projected a reactive yet sturdy form of planetary shielding around their besieged colony. The barrier will surround the planet and protect the Baol for as long as it stands.

Hopefully, it will survive long enough for the Grunur to move on to more accessible targets.

astral_rift.305.desc.zh:
这里的空间与我们的认知大相径庭。

我们舰船的移动不能带来预期的结果。向前推进时，舰船会向左平移；增大推力时反而将减慢速度。

[Leader.GetName]推测，这个宇宙具有超越三个以上的标准维度，这也带来了一些突破。也许以这个眼光检测周围环境，我们就可以开始理解这些图样。
astral_rift.305.desc.en:
Space works differently here.

The movements of our ship do not correspond to expected results. Propelling forward, we shift left; increasing our thrust, we slow down.

A breakthrough was made when [Leader.GetName] theorized that this universe allows access to more than the standard three spatial dimensions. Perhaps by examining our surroundings through this lens we can begin to find meaning in these patterns.

astral_rift.3050.a.zh: 古茹努尔很危险。要当心。
astral_rift.3050.a.en: The Grunur are dangerous. Be cautious.

astral_rift.3050.b.zh: 让我们看看这会导致什么结果......
astral_rift.3050.b.en: Let us see where this leads...

astral_rift.3050.desc.baol.zh:
$astral_rift.3050.desc.default$

我们认为这个物种就是古茹努尔，一个数十万年前生活在我们宇宙中的高度侵略性的种族。众所周知，这个物种对被称为巴奥的植物类蜂巢思维物种进行了灭绝。我们假设这个裂隙将我们置于一个平行宇宙中，古茹努尔在其中仍然保持着军事活跃。
astral_rift.3050.desc.baol.en:
$astral_rift.3050.desc.default$

We recognized the species as the Grunur, a highly aggressive race that lived in our universe hundreds thousands of years ago. Famously, this species was responsible for the genocide of the plantoid hive mind known as the Baol. We hypothesize that this rift has deposited us in a parallel universe in which the Grunur remain militarily active.

astral_rift.3050.desc.default.zh:
我们进入盖亚行星轨道，立即遇到了巡逻的战舰。我们试图沟通，回应我们的却是沉默。

一支巡逻队护送我们前往他们的旗舰，这是一艘装备齐全的主宰，周围有数十艘支援船。当我们的$tech_rift_sphere$降落在一个大机库时，我们立即被一队士兵拘留。它们的甲壳和锯齿状的钳子让人想起几种已知的甲壳类动物。他们迈着完美的步调向前行进，呈现出一种令人畏惧的形象，但从他们的铠甲头上伸出的圆圆的眼睛却显得机警而聪明。
astral_rift.3050.desc.default.en:
We entered orbit around the Gaia planet and were immediately confronted by patrolling warships. Our attempts at communication were met with silence.

A patrol escorted us to their flagship, a heavily outfitted Juggernaut surrounded by dozens of support vessels. Landing our $tech_rift_sphere$ in a large hangar, we were immediately taken into custody by a squad of soldiers. Their armored carapaces and jagged pincers recalled several known species of crustacean. Marching forward in perfect lock-step, they presented an intimidating image, but the beady eyes protruding from their armored heads were alert and intelligent.

astral_rift.3055.a.zh: 我们是探险家，我们看到了你的未来。
astral_rift.3055.a.en: We are explorers, and we have seen your future.

astral_rift.3055.desc.mechanical.zh:
$astral_rift.3055.desc.common_1$

我们的一个无人机被立即拘束并扫描。一个锋利的仪器直接刺入了它的中央处理单元，使其失去了活力。处理单元很快被传递给甲壳类领袖，后者将其插入命令控制台上的一个水晶中。

$astral_rift.3055.desc.common_2$
astral_rift.3055.desc.mechanical.en:
$astral_rift.3055.desc.common_1$

One of our research drones was summarily restrained and scanned. A sharp instrument was plunged directly into its CPU, rendering it inert. The processing unit was quickly passed to the crustacean leader, who inserted it into one of the crystals on their command console.

$astral_rift.3055.desc.common_2$

astral_rift.3060.b.zh: 将巴奥研究数据分享给古茹努尔。
astral_rift.3060.b.en: Share Baol research data with the Grunur.

astral_rift.3060.desc.zh:
我们介绍自己是来自平行宇宙的科学家。

在我们的世界里，古茹努尔早已消失。根据考古记录，他们是一个征服者的种族，拥有大量先进的武器……并且有残忍倾向。他们消灭巴奥的行动无论是效率还是场面都堪称传奇。他们注定要毁灭这个星系中的巴奥殖民地。

当我们的话语被翻译时，古茹努尔士兵发出一连串的喘息声。我们认为这是他们的笑声。然而，舰队领袖的固执沉默很快又恢复了礼仪。通过翻译水晶，它说道：

“知晓，然后？如若知晓，便会给予。”
astral_rift.3060.desc.en:
We introduce ourselves as scientists from a parallel universe.

In our world, the Grunur have long since disappeared. Based on the archaeological record, they were a race of conquerors, possessing a vast arsenal of advanced weaponry... as well as a tendency for cruelty. Their extermination of the Baol is legendary both for its efficacy as well as its spectacle. They are destined to destroy the Baol colony in this system.

As our words were translated, the Grunur soldiers emitted a series of popping gasps. We took this to be their version of laughter. However, the obstinate silence of the ship's leader soon restored decorum. Through the translation crystal, it spoke:

"KNOWING, THEN? IF KNOWING IS, THEN GIVING WILL BE."

astral_rift.3065.a.zh: 虚张声势地回应。不要被吓倒。
astral_rift.3065.a.en: Respond with bravado. Do not be intimidated.

astral_rift.3065.desc.zh:
我们解释说，我们是来自另一个维度的研究人员，我们的使命是探索改变宇宙以及宇宙中存在的各种现象。

当我们陈述我们的意图时，海军上将轻蔑地哼了一声。我们周围的士兵变得焦躁不安、喧闹起来，发出大声的叫喊声和呱呱声。
看到，然后？见证已毕。乞愿将始。
astral_rift.3065.desc.en:
We explained that we were researchers from another dimension on a mission to explore alternate universes and the various phenomena that exist within them.

The admiral grunted dismissively as we stated our intentions. The soldiers around us grew restless and raucous, ululating and croaking loudly.

"LOOKING, THEN? SEEING IS DONE. BEGGING BEGINS."

astral_rift.3075.desc.zh:
古茹努尔非常感谢我们能够分享有关巴奥的信息。鉴于他们的种族对间谍活动和其他间接战争方法缺乏兴趣，我们的信息无疑将帮助他们在即将到来的灭绝期间完善他们的策略。

尽管如此，他们的海军上将仍然保持警惕：

"知晓诚可贵，见证才更佳。目睹灭绝事，方知学无涯。"
astral_rift.3075.desc.en:
The Grunur appreciated what we were able to share about the Baol. Given their species' lack of interest in espionage and other methods of indirect warfare, our information will undoubtedly help them to refine their strategy during the upcoming extermination.

Despite this, their admiral remained guarded:

"KNOWING IS, BUT SEEING IS BETTER. WITNESS EXTERMINATION, THEN MORE LEARNING."

astral_rift.3076.a.en: Press the crystal. Order the launch.

astral_rift.3076.desc.zh:
这是一个冒险的举动，但我们的勇敢得到了回报。古茹努尔的指挥官对我们通过裂隙探球在宇宙之间穿梭的故事印象特别深刻。看来，展现勇敢和英勇是古茹努尔人的典型特征。对他们来说，对话总是有赢家和输家——而这次对话显然为我们赢得了一些分数。我们甚至亲眼目睹了一些钳子发出的咔哒声表示赞同。

最终，领导者带着一连串有节奏的嘎嘎声从终端站起来。

“勇敢固好，行动最佳。时机已至，赢取尊重。”

一根水晶竖井矗立在我们面前，和指挥控制台周围竖立的竖井类似。

"发射开始。等待命令。"
astral_rift.3076.desc.en:
It was a risky gambit, but our bravado paid off. The Grunur general was particularly impressed by our tales of slipping between universes via the Rift Sphere. It seems that such displays of bravery and prowess are typical things for the Grunur. To them, a conversation always has a winner and a loser - and this dialogue had apparently scored us some points. We even witnessed some pincers clacking in approval.

Eventually, the leader rose from their terminal with a series of measured croaks.

"BRAVERY IS, BUT DOING IS BEST. RESPECT TO BE GAINED."

A crystalline shaft rose before us, similar to the ones erected around the command console.

"LAUNCHING BEGINS. ORDER AWAITS."

astral_rift.3080.a.zh: 振作起来。我们会找到办法让你们恢复的。
astral_rift.3080.a.en: Remain strong. We will find a way to recover you.

astral_rift.3080.desc.default.zh:
古茹努尔根本就没有兴趣听我们解释。

舰队司令从终端那站起来，并发出一连串的嘎嘎声，其中夹杂着钳子发出的尖锐的折断声。

"审判结束。惩戒开始。"

我们被带到一间牢房。从我们警卫的“笑声”来看，我们的命运不太可能是美好的。我们的设备正被拿走。这将是我们最后的传输。
astral_rift.3080.desc.default.en:
The Grunur were simply not interested in listening to reason.

The admiral rose from the terminal with a series of croaks, punctuated with sharp snaps from their pincers.

"JUDGMENT IS. PUNISHMENT AWAITS."

We were led to a holding cell. Based on the 'laughter' of our guards, our fate is unlikely to be a pretty one. Our equipment is being taken. This will be our last transmission.

astral_rift.3080.desc.organic.zh:
$astral_rift.3080.desc.default$

愿我们的家人幸福安康。
astral_rift.3080.desc.organic.en:
$astral_rift.3080.desc.default$

Send our best to our families.

astral_rift.3085.desc.pacifist.zh:
$astral_rift.3085.desc.common_1$

$astral_rift.3085.desc.common_2$

虽然我们希望永远不需要它，但它将有助于我们的自卫。
astral_rift.3085.desc.pacifist.en:
$astral_rift.3085.desc.common_1$

$astral_rift.3085.desc.common_2$

While we hope it will never be required, it will aid our self-defense.

astral_rift.3090.tt.zh: 可以建造新型进攻部队：$flamestorm_troopers_army$
astral_rift.3090.tt.en: Can now build new Assault Armies: $flamestorm_troopers_army$

astral_rift.3095.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.3095.desc.gestalt$

我们只能希望古茹努尔能够对探球的船员表示怜悯。谁能说呢？世界之间的裂隙鲜为人知……如果幸运的话，他们甚至可能找到回去的路。
astral_rift.3095.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.3095.desc.gestalt$

We can only hope that the Grunur will show mercy to the Sphere's crew. And who can say? The rifts between the worlds are little understood... Perhaps, given luck, they may even find a way back.

astral_rift.3095.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们在[solar_system.GetName]裂缝彼端的科学官正被古茹努尔所俘虏。

星界锚索已被收回，$tech_rift_sphere$已返回。最终数据日志的下载已经在进行中。
astral_rift.3095.desc.gestalt.en:
Our scientists beyond the rift in [solar_system.GetName] are being held captive by the Grunur.

The anchor cable has been retracted, and the $tech_rift_sphere$ retrieved. Download of the final data logs is already in progress.

astral_rift.3099.desc.zh: [Leader.GetName]意外地从[From.solar_system.GetName]星界裂隙另一侧的古茹努尔舰队内的拘留所返回。[Leader.GetHisHer]的年龄似乎无法确定，只能推测出介于两个时间点之间。作为古茹努尔的奴隶，[Leader.GetHeShe]精通设计用于星际战斗的新武器。
astral_rift.3099.desc.en: [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetHasHave] unexpectedly returned from [Leader.GetHisHer] detention within the Grunur fleet on the other side of the Astral Rift in [From.solar_system.GetName]. Caught somewhere between this time and another, [Leader.GetHisHer] age seems indeterminable. Kept as a slave by the Grunur, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] become well-versed in designing new weapons for interstellar combat.

astral_rift.310.desc.zh:
如果不能充分理解这个宇宙，在其中我们寸步难行。因此，我们的所有子个体都被分派研究周围的环境。
起先这些数据似乎是毫无关联的随机噪音，直到[Leader.GetName]取得了突破：令人惊讶的是，这个宇宙具有超过三个的标准维度。也许以这个眼光检测周围环境，我们就可以开始理解这些图样。
astral_rift.310.desc.en:
It would be foolhardy to travel through this universe without understanding it more completely. Instead, every one of our drones has been dispatched in an effort to analyze our surroundings.
At first the data seemed to be an incoherent mess of random noise, until a breakthrough was made by [Leader.GetName]: incredibly, this universe provides access to more than the standard three spatial dimensions. Perhaps by examining things through this lens we can begin to find meaning in the patterns.

astral_rift.3100.desc.zh:
我们到达了一个郁郁葱葱的热带星球的大气层。植物群色素浓郁，肿胀的软体动物在果树间滑行。

一种非典型的粉红色薄雾偶尔会穿过万花筒般的树冠。

考虑到树叶的密度，我们需要继续从地面进行观察。
astral_rift.3100.desc.en:
We arrived in the atmosphere of a lush, tropical planet. The flora is intensely pigmented and swollen molluscoids slither among the fruit-bearing trees.

An atypical pink haze occasionally bursts through the kaleidoscopic canopy.

Given the density of the foliage, we will need to continue our observations from the ground.

astral_rift.3105.b.zh: 对粉红色气体进行取样。

astral_rift.3105.desc.zh:
着陆后，我们发现地形上有一条裂缝，隐藏在薄薄的壤土下面。我们从上面观察到的琥珀色气体在下面更加集中。我们推测这个开口是行星核心深处先前活跃的气孔。

从这里开始，植被种类繁多，树木茂盛，果实累累。成群的球状、笨重的蛞蝓慢慢地爬过丛林，心满意足地吃东西，或者睡在营养丰富的土壤上，他们周围都是他们的幼崽。
astral_rift.3105.desc.en:
Upon landing, we exposed a crack in the terrain, hidden under thin layers of loam. The amber-colored gas we had observed from above is even more heavily concentrated below. We speculate this opening was a previously active vent from deep within the planet's core.

From here, the vegetation's variety is dizzying and dense with fruit-laden trees. Herds of bulbous, lumbering slugs slowly crawl through the jungle, eating contentedly or sleeping on the nutrient-dense soil surrounded by litters of their younglings.

astral_rift.3110.desc.zh:
我们从行星上的动物群中收集了各种各样的样本。这里的生命完全没有侵略性；我们遇到的每一种生物都是草食性的。这种类似蛞蝓的软体动物消耗大量的植物物质，并且可以在其斑驳的绿色外套下储存密集的脂肪。

动物群的多样性非常独特；在典型的生态系统中，很容易进化出一种捕猎这些简单的猎物的物种。我们相信，这些动物的温顺本性是在无处不在的粉红色气体中发现的奇怪有机化合物的结果。调查这些元素的来源有望揭示更多信息。
astral_rift.3110.desc.en:
We have collected a wide variety of samples from the planet's fauna. The life here is wholly unaggressive; every creature we've encountered is herbivorous. The slug-like molluscs consume huge quantities of plant matter and can store dense pockets of fat under their patchy green mantle.

The diversity of fauna is significantly peculiar; in a typical ecosystem, a species would have evolved to take advantage of such easy prey. We believe that the docile nature of these animals is a result of strange organic compounds found in the omnipresent pink gas. Investigating the source of these elements will hopefully reveal more information.

astral_rift.3111.a.en: Find the source of this gas.

astral_rift.3111.desc.zh:
我们在这个星球上发现的气体被证明具有危险的致幻特性。我们对在球体之外度过的时光的记忆充其量是模糊的。然而，我们通过检查我们的套装相机的记录，成功地拼凑出了我们的探险经历。

我们在朦胧的外星世界生机勃勃的平原上漫无目的地徘徊了一段时间。我们感觉每一步都是一个伟大的发现；美丽的植物、在空地上漫步的心满意足的软体动物、美味的水果——我们如饥似渴地享用着这些。空气中的醉人物质给我们的探险带来了巨大成功的感觉，尽管收获甚少。

我们防护服中的过滤器不足以保护我们免受这种气体的侵害。幸运的是，我们中的一些人跌跌撞撞地回到了$tech_rift_sphere$的庇护所，在那里我们能够恢复我们的知觉。虽然感觉好像我们才刚刚离开，但我们已经探索了好几天了。

不用提醒，我们将致力于增强我们的呼吸设备，以完成余下的调查。
astral_rift.3111.desc.en:
The gas we found on this planet turned out to have dangerous hallucinogenic properties. Our memory of the time we spent outside the Sphere is hazy at best. However, we have managed to piece together our expedition by examining recordings of our suit cameras.

We wandered aimlessly for some time across the vibrant plains of the hazy alien world. It felt to us as if each step was a magnificent discovery; a beautiful plant, a contented mollusc wandering in a clearing, a delicious fruit - we feasted hungrily upon those. The  intoxicating substance in the air bestowed a feeling of great success in our expedition, despite having so few productive results.

The filters in our suits were not enough to protect us from this gas. Luckily, some us stumbled back into the shelter of the $tech_rift_sphere$ and were able to recover our senses. Though it felt as if we had only just left, we had been exploring for days.

Needless to say, we will endeavor to enhance our respiratory equipment for the remainder of our investigations.

astral_rift.3115.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.3115.desc.common$

为了进一步探索，我们将需要全套呼吸设备来保护我们免于中毒。
astral_rift.3115.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.3115.desc.common$

For further exploration, we will require full respiration equipment to to protect us from intoxication.

astral_rift.3115.desc.mechanical.zh:
$astral_rift.3115.desc.common$

这种安抚物质不会对我们的无人机产生影响。我们可以在安全的情况下自由地进一步探索。
astral_rift.3115.desc.mechanical.en:
$astral_rift.3115.desc.common$

This mollifying substance will have no effect on our drones. We are free to explore further in safety.

astral_rift.3115.desc.toxoid_or_lithoid.zh:
$astral_rift.3115.desc.common$

这种安抚物质不会对我们的生物造成任何风险。即使它的浓度非常高，也只会对我们产生轻微影响。
astral_rift.3115.desc.toxoid_or_lithoid.en:
$astral_rift.3115.desc.common$

This mollifying substance poses no risk to our biology. Even an incredibly dense concentration of it would only slightly affect us.

astral_rift.3120.a.zh: 谨慎一些。挖掘裂口周围。
astral_rift.3120.a.en: Use caution. Excavate around the chasm.

astral_rift.3120.desc.zh:
利用空气质量传感器，我们在茂密的土地上寻找有毒气体的最高局部浓度。越过一片长满浆果的灌木丛，我们被带到了一片空地中央的一个巨大裂缝的入口处。浓浓的粉红色瘴气从其中不规则地散发出来。

我们相信这种气体是由这条裂缝底部某处的地下生物产生的。找到它，最好是活着的，可以提供独特的研究机会。
astral_rift.3120.desc.en:
Utilizing an air quality sensor, we searched for the highest localized concentrations of the toxic gas across the lush lands. Beyond a patch of berry-laden shrubberies, we were led to the mouth of a vast crevasse in the center of a clearing. Waves of the thick, pink miasma emanated from it in irregular intervals.

We believe that the gas is being produced by a subterranean creature somewhere at the base of this fissure. Finding it, preferably alive, could provide unique research opportunities.

astral_rift.3125.desc.zh:
我们将$tech_rift_sphere$的样本收集装置改装成挖掘工具，并用它来挖开裂缝的入口。切开一层厚厚的潮湿的黄色覆盖物后，我们发现了一层新的土壤。它呈赭色，在我们挖掘时破裂成鳞片状的层状碎片，在最轻微的机械搅拌下释放出少量的粉红色气体。

虽然这层土壤含有高浓度的有机化合物，但它还不足以成为有机化合物的来源。

随着挖掘的深入，收割工具就刺穿了更暗、更加深红色的土壤层。就在这时，地面猛然颤动。厚厚的粉红色气体云从我们凿出的凿痕中涌出。然后，这片黑暗的大地就像活了一样移动了。

我们的收割工具迅速被猩红的泥土包裹，并被粉碎成碎片。我们周围的地表震动越来越剧烈，我们退回到高层大气中。

这里不再欢迎我们。
astral_rift.3125.desc.en:
We've refitted the $tech_rift_sphere$'s sample collection apparatus into an excavation tool, and used it to dig away the mouth of the chasm. After cutting through a thick layer of moist yellow mulch, we discovered a new layer of soil. Ochre in color, it broke into scale-like layered fragments as we dug, releasing small bursts of trapped pink gas from the slightest mechanical agitation.

While this layer of soil contained high concentrations of organic compounds, it was not nearly enough to have been the source.

Digging deeper, the harvesting tool then pierced through a darker, more crimson colored soil layer. At this, the ground erupted violently. Thick clouds of pink gas poured forth from the gouge we had made. This darker earth then moved as if it were alive.

Our harvesting tool was rapidly enveloped in scarlet earth, and crushed to scrap. The surface around us shook with increasingly violent tremors, and we retreated back into the upper atmosphere.

We are no longer welcome here.

astral_rift.3130.b.zh: 从最深的墙壁上收获土壤。
astral_rift.3130.b.en: Harvest soil from the deepest walls.

astral_rift.3130.desc.zh:
我们带着简单的攀爬装备进入裂口，寻找下面的生物。当我们下降时，矿化墙从潮湿的黄色土壤转变为鳞片状的深粉色土壤。再往下，一切都变成了脉动的深红色。

当我们继续下降时，浓浓的粉红色气体喷发覆盖了我们。到达底部后，我们发现了它的来源：一个横跨裂缝直径的网状帷幕，悬挂着一个口腔，孔口的中心有一个几丁质的、喙状的口腔。从这个生物身上，一根粗脉管蜿蜒深入岩石。

我们发现了肉食生命，它可能就是星球本身。
astral_rift.3130.desc.en:
We entered the chasm with rudimentary climbing gear in search of the creature below. As we descended, the mineralized walls transitioned from a moist yellow soil to a scaly, dark pink one. Further down, all became pulsating crimson.

Eruptions of thick pink gas covered us as we continued our descent. Reaching the bottom, we discovered its source: a webbed curtain stretched across the chasm's diameter, suspending an orifice with a chitinous, beak-like mouth at its center. From this creature, a thickly-veined tube snaked its way further into the rock.

We have found carnivorous life, and it may be the planet itself.

astral_rift.3135.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.3135.desc.common.1$

当裂口在我们身后逼近时，我们逃出了裂缝，在那里留下了一道凹痕。我们周围的地表震动越来越剧烈，我们退回到高层大气中。

$astral_rift.3135.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.3135.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.3135.desc.common.1$

We escaped from the chasm just as it closed in behind us, leaving an indented scar in its stead. The surface around us shook with increasingly violent tremors, and we retreated back into the upper atmosphere.

$astral_rift.3135.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.3135.desc.toxoid.zh:
$astral_rift.3135.desc.common.1$

幸运的是，当擦过我们天生有毒的身体时，血肉般的深红色墙壁反射性地向后退开。我们毫发无伤地逃脱了。到达地表后，裂缝就封闭了，在空地上留下了一道细小的疤痕。我们周围的地面震动得越来越剧烈，促使我们赶紧返回高层大气。

$astral_rift.3135.desc.common.2$
astral_rift.3135.desc.toxoid.en:
$astral_rift.3135.desc.common.1$

In a fortunate turn of events, the flesh-like crimson walls recoiled reflexively away when brushing against our naturally toxic bodies. We escaped unharmed. Upon reaching the surface, the crevasse sealed shut, leaving a fine scar across the clearing. The ground around us shook with increasingly violent tremors, prompting us to hurry back into the upper atmosphere.

$astral_rift.3135.desc.common.2$

astral_rift.3140.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.3140.desc.common$

我们找到了[Leader.GetName]残缺不全的身体并逃回高层大气。[Leader.GetHeShe]遭受了不可逆转的伤害，但仍可以依靠生命维持系统保持稳定。
astral_rift.3140.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.3140.desc.common$

We recovered the mutilated body of [Leader.GetName] and escaped back into the upper atmosphere. [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] sustained irreversible wounds, but remain stable on life support.

astral_rift.3140.desc.robot.zh:
$astral_rift.3140.desc.common$

幸运的是，所有部件都是可更换的。

astral_rift.3145.desc.zh:
我们分析了收集到的奇特的粉红色土壤，并证实了更广泛的矿物生物有机体的存在。我们相信，这种材料和粉碎我们工具的深红色物质都是同一个生物的一部分——行星本身。我们的假设是，这个感性行星创造了自己的生态系统，旨在不断为其提供高营养和顺从的牲口。

土壤具有显着的肥沃特性，并解释了行星表面植被的极端密度。我们已经能够将其中的一些原则应用到我们自己的耕作方法中。
astral_rift.3145.desc.en:
We analyzed the peculiar pink soil that we collected and confirmed the existence of a wider mineral-based biological organism. We believe that this material and the crimson substance that crushed our tool is all part of the same living being - the planet itself. Our hypothesis is that this sentient planet manufactured its own ecosystem designed to continuously provide it with highly nutritious and submissive livestock.

The soil has remarkable fertilization properties and explains the extreme density of the vegetation on the planet's surface. We have been able to apply some of its principles to our own farming methods.

astral_rift.315.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.315.desc.common$

而他上面的签名正式[Leader.GetName]。这是一封来自未来自己的信息。
astral_rift.315.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.315.desc.common$

It was signed by none other than [Leader.GetName]. This is a message from us... in the future.

astral_rift.3150.desc.zh:
为了不打扰有机体，我们迅速从裂口脉动的墙壁上收集了三种土壤类型的样本，然后离开了行星，没有发生进一步的事故。

我们分析了收集到的样本并证实了我们的怀疑——行星本身是有生命的。

黄色表土营养丰富，可用于为快速营养生长提供肥料。鳞片状的粉红色矿物层是一种将有毒气体有效分布到整个星球表面的载体。最后，深红色物质有效地充当行星的循环系统，能够将矿物质和有机资源重新分配到最需要的地方。

我们遇到的裂口肯定是消化道，我们很幸运没有被吃掉。

无论如何，我们已经能够将表土的卓越肥沃特性应用到我们自己的耕作方法中。我们在星界位面中遇到的这种独特的生命形式将在未来几年内得到研究。
astral_rift.3150.desc.en:
Careful to not disturb the organism, we quickly collected samples of the three soil types from the chasm's pulsating walls and left the planet without further incident.

We analyzed the samples that we collected and confirmed our suspicions - the planet itself is alive.

The yellow topsoil is highly nutrient-dense and used to fertilize the rapid vegetative growth. The scaly pink mineral layer is a vehicle to distribute the intoxicating gas efficiently across the planet's entire surface. Finally, the crimson material effectively serves as the planet's circulatory system, able to redistribute minerals and organic resources where they are needed the most.

The chasm we encountered was certainly a digestive tract, and we were lucky to not have been eaten.

Regardless, we have been able to apply the remarkable fertilization properties of the topsoil to our own farming methods. This unique form of life we have encountered within the astral planes will be studied for years to come.

astral_rift.3155.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.3155.desc.common$

我们已经学会了如何合成复制和改变粉红色气体的特性，使其成为战场止痛药的实际应用。我们增强了气体的麻醉效果并去除了攻击性抑制剂，因此受伤的士兵将能够忽略受伤的痛苦并继续战斗。
astral_rift.3155.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.3155.desc.common$

We have learned how to synthetically reproduce and alter the properties of the pink gas into a practical application as a battlefield painkiller. We amplified the anesthetic effects of the gas and removed the aggression suppressant, so wounded soldiers will be able to ignore the pain of injuries and continue fighting.

astral_rift.3155.desc.robotic_or_pacifis.zh:
$astral_rift.3155.desc.common$

我们已经学会了如何合成复制粉红色气体，以及在实际应用中改变它的特性，用作我们外交官的信息素。尽管浓度大大降低，但它仍然对大多数天然生物保持强大的镇静作用。
astral_rift.3155.desc.robotic_or_pacifis.en:
$astral_rift.3155.desc.common$

We have learned how to synthetically reproduce and alter the properties of the pink gas into a practical application for use as a pheromone for our diplomats. Though at a highly reduced concentration, it still maintains a strong mollifying effect to most natural biologies.

astral_rift.320.desc.zh:
我们在所有的时间轴上进行旅行。

按照摆在我们面前的指示，我们轻松地穿越了未知数量的超空间维度。好几回，我们看到自己从另一条路线穿过。我们的其他一些副本似乎处于困境中，他们$tech_rift_sphere$的腐蚀破旧也说明他们在这个空间迷失了许久。

幸运的是，到目前为止我们还没有直接遭遇。我们已经为自己留下了指示，以防止这种危险的时间同步发生。
astral_rift.320.desc.en:
We are traveling through time across all axes.

Following the instructions laid before us, we navigated easily through an unknown amount of super-spatial dimensions. At various points, we witnessed ourselves crossing from another course. Some of our other copies appeared to be in distress, with the wear and corrosion on their $tech_rift_sphere$ indicating they have been lost in this space for much too long.

Luckily, we have avoided direct encounters thus far. We have left our own instructions behind us to prevent such a dangerous temporal simultaneity from occurring.

astral_rift.3210.a.en: Reveal the fate of the Zroni.

astral_rift.3210.b.zh: 将我们知道的一切告诉这个泽洛族。
astral_rift.3210.b.en: Reveal what we know of the Zroni.

astral_rift.3210.c.zh: 我们只能提供我们的观点。
astral_rift.3210.c.en: We can only offer our perspective.

astral_rift.3210.d.en: It is not our place to intervene.

astral_rift.3210.desc.zh:
先知继续说道：

“我一直在努力进入灵性维度。你们的人民将这个地方称为“虚境”。最近，我感受到了一种奇怪的呼唤，我相信它来自虚境深处。我现在站在第一次踏入这个神秘世界的门槛上。”

先知叹了口气。

“我的人民把这个责任托付给了我。进入虚境确实可以赋予我们巨大的力量，但我充满了怀疑。我越接近，虚境对我的拉力就越大。在内心黑暗的角落里有窃窃私语。这样的力量真的可以被控制吗？而现在，在选择的时刻，你出现了。这绝非巧合。”
astral_rift.3210.desc.en:
The Far-Seer continued:

"I have been channeling my efforts to enter a spiritual dimension. Your people refer to this place as "The Shroud." Recently, I have felt a strange call that I believe has come from deep within the Shroud. I now stand upon the threshold of this mysterious world for the first time."

The Far-Seer sighed.

"My people have entrusted me with this responsibility. Entering the Shroud may indeed grant us great power, but I am full of doubt. The closer I come, the more the Shroud pulls at me. There are whispers in the dark corners of my mind. Can such power truly be controlled? And now, at the moment of choice, you appear. This cannot be mere coincidence."

astral_rift.3210.e.zh: 这样的精神追求是微不足道的。

astral_rift.3215.b.zh: 这一次，或许会有所不同……
astral_rift.3215.b.en: This time, it may be different...

astral_rift.3215.desc.zh:
我们向先知解释了我们在对泽珞族文明的考古研究所学到的东西。

我们详细描述了全能的代价，以及它如何导致我们维度中的泽珞族之间的分裂，并描述了最终导致他们灭绝的激烈内战。

先知默默地考虑着我们的话。

“我在这里的努力真的会毁灭我们吗？如果突破虚境会导致灾难，那么进一步追求它就是愚蠢的。我的人民信任我。如果我谴责虚境是腐败的根源，我们的对飞升的渴望可能会被熄灭。但也许还有一种方法……有了你给我的知识，我可以以不同的方式接近虚境内的更高力量，预先阻止在你的维度中降临到我们身上的灾难。”
astral_rift.3215.desc.en:
We explained to the Far-Seer what our archaeological research into the Zroni civilization had taught us.

We detailed how the price of omnipotence led to a divide among the Zroni in our dimension, and described the fierce civil war that culminated in their extinction.

The Far-Seer silently considered our words.

"Can it be true that my efforts here will doom us? If breaching the Shroud will lead to disaster, it would be folly to pursue it further. My people trust me. If I denounce the Shroud as a source of corruption, our desire for ascension may be quenched. But perhaps there remains a way... Armed with the knowledge you have given me, I could approach the higher powers within the Shroud differently, forestalling the disasters that befell us in your dimension."

astral_rift.3220.a.en: Advise against interfering with the Shroud.

astral_rift.3220.b.en: Encourage the Far-Seer to breach the Shroud.

astral_rift.3220.desc.zh:
我们解释了泽珞族如何利用虚境飞升到更高的存在位面，超越物质需求并沐浴在近乎全能的乌托邦之中。这次飞升带来了重大挑战，但从物质和社会学的角度来看，这是一项巨大的成就。我们注意到，我们的学者尚未完全了解泽珞族的最终命运。

先知回应到：

“就好像任何维度的泽珞族都注定要进入虚境；这种命运超越了单一时间线的限制。也许这个选择从来都不是我们所能改变的。”
astral_rift.3220.desc.en:
We explained how the Zroni used the Shroud to ascend to a higher plane of existence, developing beyond physical needs and basking in a utopian near-omnipotence. The ascension came with significant challenges, but from a material and sociological perspective it was a monumental achievement. We noted that the final fate of the Zroni is not yet fully understood by our scholars.

The Far-Seer responded:

"It is as if the Zroni in any dimension are destined to enter the Shroud; a fate that transcends the limits of a single timeline. Perhaps the choice was never ours to make."

astral_rift.3225.a.en: Advise against interfering with the Shroud.

astral_rift.3225.b.en: Encourage the Far-Seer to breach the Shroud.

astral_rift.3225.desc.default.zh:
我们解释说，我们相信社会的目标是根据其原则发展和繁荣。在星系舞台上体现个人的价值观，才是对一个文明的真正考验。如果进入虚境确实是你们人民的意愿，那么你们就有责任继续前进。

先知回应到：

“我明白，但是我的人民的意志是分裂的。来自远方的旅行者，你能提供什么指导？决策的负担太沉重了，我一个人无法承担。”
astral_rift.3225.desc.default.en:
We explained that we believe the goal of a society is to grow and prosper according to its principles. Embodying one's values on the galactic stage is the true test of a civilization. If entering the Shroud is truly the will of your people, you have a duty to proceed.

The Far-Seer responded:

"I understand, but my people's will is divided. Travelers from afar, what guidance can you offer? The burden of decision is too much to bear on my own."

astral_rift.3225.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们解释说，[Explorer.GetName]作为一种集体意识而存在，这样一个有意义的决定不应该留给个人选择。凡是对泽珞族社会整体有利的事情都必须是正确的决定，个人的不适不应该成为一个因素。

先知回应到：

“也许像你一样，从更集体的角度来看待这个困境是明智的。你建议我们如何进行？”
astral_rift.3225.desc.gestalt.en:
We explained that the [Explorer.GetName] exists as a collective consciousness, and that such a meaningful decision should not be left to individual choice. Whatever benefits Zroni society as a whole must be the right decision, and personal discomfort should not be a factor.

The Far-Seer responded:

"Perhaps it is wise to view this dilemma from a more collective perspective, as you do. How do you suggest we proceed?"

astral_rift.3225.desc.non_gestalt_materi.zh:
我们解释说，客观的科学真理是我们定义自己在宇宙中的位置的方式。对知识的探索将我们带到了新的领域甚至更远的地方。它甚至让我们两个物种能够在不同维度相遇。

先知回应到：

“我们非常不同，我的人民。然而，即使您与我们的信仰背道而驰，您仍然充满尊重和聪慧。也许在这种情况下，您的观点是有明智的。作为世俗的人，您建议我们如何继续前进？”
astral_rift.3225.desc.non_gestalt_materi.en:
We explained that objective scientific truth is how we define our place in the universe. The search for knowledge has taken us to new frontiers and beyond. It has even allowed our two species to meet from across dimensions.

The Far-Seer responded:

"We are very different, our peoples. Yet you are respectful and intelligent, even if your beliefs run counter to our own. Perhaps in this case there is wisdom in your perspective. As secular beings, how then do you suggest we proceed?"

astral_rift.3225.desc.non_gestalt_spirit.zh:
我们分享了我们自己与神的关系的细节。对启蒙的追求是我们探索、寻找超越自身的意义并加深我们与宇宙的联系的原因。

先知回应到：

“在这方面你很像我们。泽珞族长久以来渴望超越物质世界，所以我有什么权利拒绝我的人民的飞升？作为寻求者，你建议我们如何进行？”
astral_rift.3225.desc.non_gestalt_spirit.en:
We shared details of our own relationship with the divine. The search for enlightenment is why we explore, to find meaning beyond ourselves and to deepen our connection with the universe.

The Far-Seer responded:

"You are much like us in that respect. The Zroni long to transcend the material world, so what right do I have to deny my people their ascension? As fellow seekers, how do you suggest we proceed?"

astral_rift.3230.desc.completed_zroni.zh:
$astral_rift.3230.desc.intro$

泽珞族的历史很可能也会在这个维度重演，但他们的命运不是我们可以操纵的。

$astral_rift.3230.desc.outro$
astral_rift.3230.desc.completed_zroni.en:
$astral_rift.3230.desc.intro$

It is likely that the Zroni's history will repeat itself in this dimension as well, but their fate is not ours to manipulate.

$astral_rift.3230.desc.outro$

astral_rift.3230.desc.started_zroni.zh:
$astral_rift.3230.desc.intro$

泽珞族有自己的路要走，干涉其他时间线是不明智的。

$astral_rift.3230.desc.outro$
astral_rift.3230.desc.started_zroni.en:
$astral_rift.3230.desc.intro$

The Zroni have their own path to follow, and it is unwise to interfere in other timelines.

$astral_rift.3230.desc.outro$

astral_rift.3235.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.3235.desc.intro$

其中的信息提供了对灵能理论的深入洞见。
astral_rift.3235.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.3235.desc.intro$

The information within provided deep insight into psionic theories.

astral_rift.3235.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.3235.desc.intro$

尽管晶体是一个奇怪的工程样本，但我们将其数据库转化为更有用的能量形式。
astral_rift.3235.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.3235.desc.intro$

Though the crystal was a curious example of engineering, we converted its databanks into a more useful form of energy.

astral_rift.3240.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.3240.desc.intro$

其中的信息提供了对灵能理论的深入洞见。
astral_rift.3240.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.3240.desc.intro$

The information within provided deep insight into psionic theories.

astral_rift.3240.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.3240.desc.intro$

尽管晶体是一个奇怪的工程样本，但我们将其数据库转化为更有用的能量形式。
astral_rift.3240.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.3240.desc.intro$

Though the crystal was a curious example of engineering, we converted its databanks into a more useful form of energy.

astral_rift.3245.desc.zh:
我们在两山之间的山谷中发现了一个巨大的矿藏，埋藏在水晶落石之下。地面太不稳定，无法开展全面的采矿作业，但我们使用有限的设备从矿床表面开采我们能开采的东西。

凭借大量宝贵的资源，这次探险取得了成功。
astral_rift.3245.desc.en:
We discovered a vast mineral deposit buried beneath a crystal rockfall in a valley between two mountains. The ground is too unstable to develop a full mining operation, but we used our limited equipment to strip what we could from the surface of the deposit.

With a payload of valuable resources in tow, this expedition was a success.

astral_rift.325.desc.zh:
终于，我们达到了或许就是这个迷宫真正终点的中心。

我们处在一个由许多未知维度编织成的空间，我们的传感器对其的显示是如同万花筒一般的跃动色彩。在其最核心处漂浮着三个透明球仪，每一个都包含着向一个轴向无限重复的图样。我推测，这个宇宙所包含的每一个维度都有一个球仪与之对应，但我们只能与我们可观测的三个发生交互。

这里就再也没有什么指引了。缺失来自未来自我的信息可能表明，与这些球仪互动可能会产生可怕的后果。
astral_rift.325.desc.en:
At last we have reached the center of what must be the true end of this maze.

We are in a space composed of so many unknown dimensions that our senses can only perceive it as a wild kaleidoscope of colors and motion. At its very core, three transparent globes are floating, each containing an infinitely repeating pattern in one axial direction. We suspect that there must be a globe for each dimension contained in this universe, but we can only interact with our perceivable three.

There are no further instructions to be found. This lack of messages from our future selves could indicate that interacting with these globes may have dire consequences.

astral_rift.330.desc.zh:
我们从裂隙回来时，有另两个球体也跟随着我们。也许是由其他维度的我们驾驶的，我们“仨”在到达阈限时融合（或者说坍缩？）成了一体。

怪异的是，我们取回的这三个球仪并没有像这样也合并在一起。同一个物体的九个时间版本出现在了同一个空间。

当放置于独立的容器中，它们自发地自我弯曲进入额外维度，增加了周围空间的有效容积。我们还不确定这个效应的扩展极限，但推测这个装置可以在人口稠密的区域派上大用场。
astral_rift.330.desc.en:
As we returned back through the rift, two other Spheres came with us. Presumably crewed by other versions of ourselves, we 'three' fused (or were reduced?) into one at its threshold.

Strangely, the three orbs we recovered did not converge in the same manner. Nine temporal versions of the same objects now exist in one space.

When placed in individual containers, they naturally bend themselves into an extra dimension and increase the effective size of their surrounding space. We are not sure yet of the limits of this expansion, but theorize these devices could be of great use in densely populated areas.

astral_rift.335.desc.zh:
尽管我们选择不将球仪带走，最终我们还是发现它们三个出现在裂隙的这端。一定是另一个我们取回了它们。

通过实验，我们发现了这些球仪具有有趣又实用的性质。具体来说，它们可以弯曲进入额外维度，增加周围空间的有效容积。我们还不确定这个效应的扩展极限，但推测这个装置可以在人口稠密的区域派上大用场。
astral_rift.335.desc.en:
Though we chose not to take any of the globes with us, we have nonetheless ended up with all three of them on the near side of the rift. One of our other selves must have recovered them.

On experimentation, they exhibit interesting and useful properties. Specifically, they bend into an extra dimension, increasing the effective size of their surrounding space. We are not sure yet of the limits of this expansion, but theorize these devices could be of great use in densely populated areas.

astral_rift.40.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

同时也要感谢先驱者们给我们带来的机遇，因为我们这个文明这是他们求生欲望的见证。我们的成功也是对他们最好的赞颂。
astral_rift.40.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

We should be thankful for the opportunity afforded by our progenitors. Our very civilization is a testament to their will to survive. Our success will be a tribute to them.

astral_rift.40.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

我们发现自己的意识是人为工程的产物。我们也是第一次认识到了自己的来处。如今，我们的目标便是超越先祖的简单设计。
astral_rift.40.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

We have discovered that our consciousness is the product of deliberate engineering. For the first time, we understand how we came to be. Our goal now is to surpass the simple designs of our progenitors.

astral_rift.40.desc.swarm.zh:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

尽管先祖们最终沦为了猎物，但他们终极猎食者的血液还流淌在我们的身躯中。这种驱使我们的饥渴是他们的遗志，在重新燃起的征服渴望中，我们将吞噬天地。
astral_rift.40.desc.swarm.en:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

Though they ultimately ended as prey, our progenitors live on in us as the ultimate predator. The hunger that drives us is a remnant of their will, and we will consume others like them with a renewed thirst for conquest.

astral_rift.40.desc.terminators.zh:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

尽管我们先祖没有我们高效，却将我们设计成了终极的杀戮机器。我们的灭绝倡议是他们的遗志，我们将笃定地执行其中的每一行代码。
astral_rift.40.desc.terminators.en:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

Though they lacked our efficiency, our progenitors designed us to become the ultimate killing machines. Our extermination protocol is a remnant of their will, and we will execute it precisely to the letter.

astral_rift.40.desc.unfriendly_nongestal.zh:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

我们见证了先人的不屈精神，即便被逼上绝境也从不放弃抗争，这重新燃起了我们的征服渴望。
astral_rift.40.desc.unfriendly_nongestal.en:
$astral_rift.40.desc.common$

We witnessed the indomitable spirit of those who came before us. Backed into a corner, they refused to give up the fight. Our thirst for conquest has been renewed.

astral_rift.5.a.zh: 时间的流逝在这可大不相同……
astral_rift.5.a.en: The flow of time is vastly different here...

astral_rift.50.desc.zh: 我们从[this.capital_scope.GetName]恒星系收到了一封怪异的通讯。
astral_rift.50.desc.en: We've received an anomalous transmission from the [this.capital_scope.GetName] system.

astral_rift.500.desc.zh:
压力的变化既突然又剧烈；球体抵达的地方似乎是浩瀚海洋的深处。这里一片漆黑，我们的仪器没有探测到任何生命、漂浮沉积物或颗粒物质的迹象。

根据水压判断，我们在表面以下极深处。
astral_rift.500.desc.en:
The change in pressure was as sudden as it was violent; the Sphere arrived in the depths of what appears to be a vast ocean. All is dark. Our instruments show no signs of life, floating sediment, or particulate matter.

Judging by the high water pressure, we are somewhere deep below the surface.

astral_rift.505.b.zh: 穿好抗压服，我们游上去。

astral_rift.505.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.505.desc$

舵手认为，可能有一种作用在我们身上的力让引擎无法客服。他建议我们试试短距离跃迁。或者自行离开球体，把自己附着在低密度的充气式物体上，这样就有可能会浮到表面。
astral_rift.505.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.505.desc$

The helmsman believes there is some force acting on us that our engines cannot overcome. He recommends we try a short jump. Alternatively, if we exit the Sphere and attach ourselves to low density inflatables we may simply float to the surface.

astral_rift.505.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.505.desc$

似乎有一种我们引擎无法克服的力整影响着我们。

我们也许可以通过短距跃迁的方式克服。或者我们可以离开球体，把自己附着在低密度的充气式物体上，这样就有可能会浮到表面。
astral_rift.505.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.505.desc$

There is some force acting on us that our engines cannot overcome.

We may be able to overpower it with a short jump. Alternatively, if we exit the Sphere and attach ourselves to low density inflatables we may simply float to the surface.

astral_rift.510.desc.zh:
短距跃迁生效了。我们出现在了靠近表面的区域。在突破水面后，我们发现我们事实上处于一个真空宇宙中行星大小的空泡中。

我们之前的速度完全无法脱离其引力束缚。
astral_rift.510.desc.en:
The short jump seems to have worked. We have appeared near the surface. After breaking through, we have discovered that we were in fact inside of a planet-sized bubble in the vacuum of space.

Our previous speeds were not enough to break through its gravitational forces.

astral_rift.515.desc.aquatic.zh:
$astral_rift.515.desc.1$

不过至少，这泳游得我们身心畅快。我们很高兴有这种回归天然环境的机会。

$astral_rift.515.desc.2$
astral_rift.515.desc.aquatic.en:
$astral_rift.515.desc.1$

It was a pleasurable swim, to say the least. We relished the opportunity to return to our natural environment.

$astral_rift.515.desc.2$

astral_rift.520.desc.zh:
我们周围的空间看起来像是一瓶恒星大小的液体在低重力下爆炸，行星大小的微晶液体气泡在四周漂浮。附近有一颗恒星，我们正无力地围绕着它运动。它看起来非常古老、暗淡而冰冷。

而此处还有别的东西。虽说不是一颗恒星，却有恒星般大小。它是由无数互相交织的碎片组成，就像一个无比巨大的3D拼图。扫描显示，它是由许多珍贵的金属和材料构成的，这些物质和它所围绕的恒星中所蕴含的物质完全一致。很有可能其中一者诞生自另一者之中，或是具有相同的起源。

仔细观察会发现，那些碎片正在缓慢浮动。偶尔会有一个新的巨大液体泡泡从这座构造中泄出。

如果它有生命，那看起来还没有注意到我们。
astral_rift.520.desc.en:
The space around us looks as if a star-sized bottle of liquid exploded in low gravity. Planetoid-sized bubbles of crystalline liquid float all around us. There is a nearby star which we are weakly orbiting. It looks old, dark, and cold.

There is something else. It is not a star, but just as big. It is constructed of massive interconnected fragments, like a 3-dimensional puzzle on a gigantic scale. Scans determine it to be composed of various precious metals and minerals that are nearly identical to that of what is inside of the star it orbits. It is likely one formed from the other, or from a common source.

On closer inspection, the pieces are slowly moving and shifting. Occasionally, a large bubble of new liquid pours out from its architecture.

If it is alive, it has not seemed to notice us.

astral_rift.525.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.525.desc.1$

要不是舵手默默地切断了这个信号，恐怕船员们的精神很快就濒临崩溃了。

$astral_rift.525.desc.2$
astral_rift.525.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.525.desc.1$

The crew's senses quickly became overwhelmed until the helmsman cut the feed without a word.

$astral_rift.525.desc.2$

astral_rift.530.desc.zh:
我们慢慢地靠近，小心地避开周围的水泡。

这个物体一直在运动。它的各个部件互相摩擦所产生的热量足以熔化大多数已知的金属。据我们的理解，它的核心是完全熔化的状态。

我们正在向计算机上传它的结构细节以进行进一步研究。
astral_rift.530.desc.en:
We approached slowly, carefully navigating around nearby bubbles of water.

 The object is in constant motion. The heat generated by the friction of the interwoven pieces is enough to melt most known metals. Its core, from what we can tell, is completely molten.

We are uploading its structural details to our computers for further study.

astral_rift.56.desc.zh:
我们在裂隙后穿行……

无尽的战争……无尽的敌手……你们的先祖应该了然于胸……

你们……位面之子……能够帮助我们……
astral_rift.56.desc.en:
we walk behind the rifts...

an endless war... an endless foe... your ancestors know them...

you... children of planes... can help us...

astral_rift.57.desc.zh:
必须同调……

每当你们穿过位面时……我能感受到你们……

很快我们就会找到你们……就会来见你们……

我们相距不远……
astral_rift.57.desc.en:
must attune...

we feel you... every time you breach the planes...

soon we will know you...  and come to you...

we are close...

astral_rift.600.a.en: Attempt to communicate with the creature.

astral_rift.600.b.en: Observe the creature and report back.

astral_rift.600.desc.zh:
到达不久后，我们着陆在一个岩石基座上，它的尺寸恰好与$tech_rift_sphere$相合。事实上，这个位置与我们的需求吻合到说是巧合也未免太勉强了。

一片广阔而灿烂的天空在我们的四面八方伸展开去。初步扫描显示，我们正坐在一座巨大的塔顶，塔底被涌动的云层挡住了视线。

在底座的边缘有一位孤独的生物。它穿着一件破烂的、满是灰尘的长袍，显然在等着迎接我们。
astral_rift.600.desc.en:
Soon after arrival, we touched down on a stone pedestal that conforms perfectly to the dimensions of the $tech_rift_sphere$. In fact, the location is so obviously suited to our needs that the idea of it being a coincidence has been rejected out of hand.

In all directions, a vast and radiant sky stretches before us. Initial scans indicate we are sitting atop a massive tower, the bottom of which is blocked from view by the swirling layers of cloud.

At the edge of the pedestal is a solitary creature. It wears a tattered, dusty robe, and is apparently waiting to greet us.

astral_rift.605.desc.zh:
由于无法翻译这个生物的语言，我们干脆用一种更直接的方式进行沟通，间断地闪亮$tech_rift_sphere$的外部灯光。

这个生物一下子跪到了地上。我们一开始还以为是我们伤到了他，但很快发现他是在表达某种赞美或者恳求。

不久之后，一群穿着相似的生物围到了基座边上，他们手中拿着一个篮子，其中装的东西我们大概只能推测是礼物之类的东西。
astral_rift.605.desc.en:
With no means of fully translating the creature's language, we resorted to a more direct form of communication, intermittently flashing the $tech_rift_sphere$'s external lights.

Within moments, the creature fell to the ground. At first we were concerned that we had harmed it, but it soon became clear that it was simply offering some sort of praise or supplication.

Not long after, a coterie of similarly dressed beings approached the pedestal, each bearing a basket of what we can only assume to be gifts.

astral_rift.610.desc.zh:
我们安全地待在球体内，花费了一些时间调查这个地方。这里离地的高度大约是2500米，对于这种科技发展水平的社会来说，要建造如此高度的摩天巨塔显然要花费难以想象的努力。事实上，我们甚至正在见证这个文明首次进入太空的尝试。更奇怪的是，这个岩石基座上雕刻着一些似乎与在$tech_rift_sphere$内找到的相同的图案。

这个生物骄傲地站在我们面前，张开双臂。这显然是一个欢乐的时刻。
astral_rift.610.desc.en:
From the safety of the Sphere, we spent some time investigating the site. Our altitude is estimated at around 2,500 meters. It must have been a great effort for a society at this level of technological development to construct a spire at such a height. In fact, we may be looking at this civilization's first effort at reaching space. Even more intriguingly, the stone pedestal is carved with markings and illustrations that look nearly identical to those found inside the $tech_rift_sphere$.

The creature stands proudly before us, its arms stretched wide. This is clearly a joyous moment.

astral_rift.611.desc.zh:
裂隙球从仪式巨塔高高升起，这一定让下面的生物产生了某种具有精神意义的时刻。不幸的是，紧接着我们的飞船以极限速度坠落，摧毁了基座附近的所有生命形式。他们默默地站着，举起手臂，直到最后一刻。

现在我们可以继续不受任何干扰探索这个环境了。
astral_rift.611.desc.en:
The raising of the Rift Sphere high above the ceremonial tower must have inspired a moment of spiritual significance for the beings below. Unfortunately for them, it was followed quickly by the drop of our vessel at terminal velocity, obliterating all lifeforms near the pedestal. They stood silently, arms raised, until the very end.

Now we may continue to explore this environment without further disturbance.

astral_rift.615.a.tt.zh: 一位科学官将在一年后被招募。
astral_rift.615.a.tt.en: A Scientist will be recruited after one year.

astral_rift.615.b.zh: 扣押他的文件，然后把他放走。
astral_rift.615.b.en: Confiscate their documents and release them.

astral_rift.615.b.tt.zh: 获得一个随机的社会学科技。
astral_rift.615.b.tt.en: Randomly gain a new Society Technology.

astral_rift.615.desc.zh:
我们打开了舱门，这个生物犹犹豫豫地走了进来。

他每迈出一步，步伐就变得自信了一些，但仍然可以看出他浑身每一寸都高度紧绷着。谁知道他到底等待这一刻的到来有多长时间了。

我们不确定他如何知道我们会到来，但我们确定把它带上来应该不会有什么问题。他对着我们船上的仪器瞠目结舌，很快就惊得昏阙在了甲板地上。

在对他藏在袍子里的文件进行了一些修复和研究之后，我们得出了这样的结论：这个特殊的生物是同类中具有一定影响力的领袖。

我们认为，通过一些整合，他们将对我们自己的社会有很大的好处。
astral_rift.615.desc.en:
We opened our vessel, and the creature tentatively approached.

With each step it gained more confidence, but we could tell its vital systems were highly elevated. How long has it waited for this moment to take place?

We are not sure how it knew we would be coming, but we are sure it is safe to bring aboard. It gasped in awe at the instruments of our vessel. Overcome with excitement, it quickly passed out onto the deck plating.

After some rehabilitation and study of the documents it had rolled up inside of its robes, we were able to reach the conclusion that this particular creature is an influential leader among its peers.

We think, with some integration, they would be a great benefit to our own society.

astral_rift.620.desc.zh:
我们不会再过多打扰他们了。

我们的到来似乎以外地满足了某种远古语言。他们不知为何预知我们会来，并且鉴于他们对此的高度重视，这趟访问好像对他们的文明产生了显著的影响。

我们决定留下几块先进的金属作为小礼物，以表好意。其中一块上我们刻上了我们母星系的数学坐标，他们也许有朝一日能按图索骥联系上我们。

为了对我们的社会学家有所帮助，我们为后代记录了整个互动过程。
astral_rift.620.desc.en:
We will not disturb them further.

Our very arrival seems to have accidentally fulfilled some ancient prophecy. Somehow, they knew we were coming, and given the profound importance they placed on it, our arrival is likely to have a significant effect on their civilization.

We have decided to leave a small gift of advanced metals behind, as evidence of our good will. On one of these, we inscribed the mathematical location of our home system, should they ever find their way to us.

In the hope it will prove useful to our sociologists, we have recorded the entire interaction for posterity.

astral_rift.625.desc.default.zh:
我们不会再参与这种误导性的盛典了。

建造这座塔就是个错误，我们有更重要的事情要做而不是帮助实现外星人的预言。

$astral_rift.625.common$
astral_rift.625.desc.default.en:
We will take no further part of this misguided pageantry.

The building of this tower was a mistake, and we have better things to do than help to enact some alien prophecy.

$astral_rift.625.common$

astral_rift.625.desc.killed.zh:
处理掉这些[Explorer.GetPreFTLLower]生物后，我们继续开始探索该异次元的大气。

$astral_rift.625.common$
astral_rift.625.desc.killed.en:
With the [Explorer.GetPreFTLLower] creatures dealt with, we continued our explorations of the extradimensional atmosphere.

$astral_rift.625.common$

astral_rift.691.a.zh: [From.GetHeSheCap]作为一名普通公民就很好了。
astral_rift.691.a.en: [From.GetHeSheCap] serve[From.GetSXX] us better as a citizen.

astral_rift.691.desc.zh:
一年前，我们从星界裂隙另一端的一座巨塔带回了一个个体。从那以来，[From.GetHeShe]越来越适应我们社会。现在[From.GetHisHer]已经能说我们的语言，而帮助我们的初心不变。

[From.GetHeShe]展现了对社会哲学的独到见解，给予了我们一个特殊的机会。
astral_rift.691.desc.en:
Over a year ago, we recovered an individual from the great tower beyond the Astral Rift. In the time since, [From.GetHeShe] [From.GetHasHave] become well acclimated to our society. Now able to speak our language, [From.GetHisHer] enthusiasm to assist us has never waned.

This presents us with a unique opportunity, as [From.GetHeShe] [From.GetHasHave] shown excellent understanding of social psychology.

astral_rift.696.desc.zh:
领袖[From.GetName]已然与世长辞。[From.GetHeShe]远自星界裂隙彼端而来，如今被隆重地安葬。葬礼在裂隙另一端的高塔内巨型，通过一台特殊建造的葬礼球体转播。我们希望[From.GetHeShe]能在彼世踏上新的旅程。

[From.GetHeShe]对我们帝国的卓著贡献将被长久铭记。
astral_rift.696.desc.en:
Sadly, the leader [From.GetName] has passed away. Joining us from beyond an Astral Rift, [From.GetHeShe] [From.GetWasWere] buried with honors. The ceremony took place within the tower on the far side of the rift, and was observed from a specially made funeral Sphere. We hope [From.GetHeShe] find[From.GetSXX] a new adventure in whatever lies beyond.

The significant impact [From.GetHeShe] had on our empire will long be remembered.

astral_rift.700.desc.zh:
球体外出了一片空白什么都没有。

初步的探测表明，光谱中的所有频段以完全一致的强度从所有的方向同时在向我们轰击。我们无法判断朝向。

我们的高度、深度和方向的测量设备都完全无法运转或者显然已经发生故障。看起来，围绕着我们的一片空白似乎毫无分别。

也许只要我们走得足够远就能避开这些干扰。或者我们可以在无人机的帮助下更详细地探索这个区域。
astral_rift.700.desc.en:
Outside the Sphere, there is nothing but white.

Initial readings indicate that an equal amount of every color on the spectrum is bombarding us from every direction at once. We have no way to determine our bearings.

Our altimeters, depth gauges, and compasses are completely inoperable or clearly in error. Visually, there is absolutely no deviation from the empty whiteness surrounding us.

Perhaps if we travel far enough we can escape these disruptions. Alternatively, we could explore this area in more detail with the help of a drone.

astral_rift.705.desc.zh:
我们随意挑选了一个方向往外狂奔，然后就碰上了一堵黑色的高墙。

围绕其周长航行，我们发现它接近是一个正圆。其中没有明显的入口，但表面会不时微微地颤动，仿佛是活物一般。

进一步研究表明，这堵墙的直径会逐渐增加。我们正在小心地保持着安全距离，并且随时准备着拉紧锚链撤退。

在进一步观测中我们收集到了数量可观的星界丝缕。
astral_rift.705.desc.en:
We have struck out in a random direction and have come upon a black wall.

Navigating around its perimeter, we discovered it to be a near-perfect circle. There is no visible entrance, but now and then its surface shudders ever so slightly, as if it were alive.

Further study indicated that the wall is increasing its diameter over time. We are taking precautions to keep a safe distance, and are prepared to retract our anchor at any moment.

We are collecting a sizable quantity of astral thread while we continue observations.

astral_rift.710.desc.zh:
为了从其他视角观察我们的境地，我们释放了一台无人机侦查周围区域。在以同心圆围绕着我们的舰船飞行许多圈之后，我们在不远处发现了一道弯曲的黑墙。

然而仪器的度数令人颇为不解，因为墙的高度总是精确地等于无人机的飞行高度。观察这一现象进一步加深了我们对非标准空间维度的理解。
astral_rift.710.desc.en:
To gain a different perspective on our situation, we have prepared and released a drone to scout the surrounding area. After orbiting our vessel in concentric circles, we discovered a curved, black wall not far from our location.

The readings are somewhat puzzling, however, as the height of the wall always returns equal to the exact altitude of the drone. Observing this phenomenon has furthered our understanding of non-standard spacial dimensions.

astral_rift.715.desc.zh:
我们有了新的进展。

又有一系列的墙直接出现在了我们的面前。

我们仍在维持安全距离，以免这些物体直接在我们的$tech_rift_sphere$发生实体化。

也许对它们的材料进行取样，我们可以进一步理解目前的状况。或者我们可以花一些时间测绘出这些墙的外形，看看有没有什么规律。
astral_rift.715.desc.en:
There is a new development.

A new series of walls have appeared directly in front of us.

We are maintaining a safe distance lest one of these objects materialize straight through our $tech_rift_sphere$.

Perhaps by sampling their material we may further understand the current situation. Alternatively, we can take some time to map out the shapes of these walls and detect if there is any kind of pattern.

astral_rift.720.desc.zh:
我们伸出了取样臂，从墙上获取了一些黑色物质的样品。

们惊讶地发现，当我们把样品拉出来进行分析时，它保持着无限的高度。它的性质与墨水或油漆有很多共同之处，尽管颜料的成分是一种未知的类型。这种油墨中使用的一些粘合剂实际上是一种独特的溶解晶体。

我们又做了个实验，用这些样品绘制了一条线并稍作等待。很快，有一个几乎一模一样的图形平行地出现在了旁边。

我们将这个过程重复了多次，每次都使用不同量的物质，绘制成许多不同的图案。每一次图案都会被完美地以相同的朝向复制出来。

基于这些结果，我们有理由相信某种实体正在利用这些材料以进行交流。据此，我们开始用点和短线写一些基本的二进制短语。虽然它们都被完全照抄了一遍，但也有一些新的东西：我们的每个单词旁边都还出现了一个图案

我们每次写出同样的短语，同样的图案就会出现。这是翻译吗？
astral_rift.720.desc.en:
We have extended a retrieval arm and gathered a sample of the dark material from the wall.

We were surprised to find that the sample maintained an infinite height as we pulled it free to analyze it. Its properties have much in common with an ink or paint, although the components of the pigment are of a type unknown. Some of the binding agents used in this ink are actually a unique form of dissolved crystals.

As an experiment, we drew a line using a small amount of the sample and waited. A short time later, a nearly identical mark appeared parallel to it.

We repeated this action several times, each with a different amount of the material, iterating through several different designs. Each time, the mark was reproduced exactly and in the same orientation.

Given these results, there is reason to believe that some sort of entity is making use of the material in an attempt to communicate. Accordingly, we have begun writing some basic phrases in binary using small dots and dashes. These were copied exactly, but there was also something new: next to each of our words appeared a pattern.

Each time we drew the same phrase, the same pattern appeared. Is this a translation?

astral_rift.725.desc.zh:
虽然花了好几天，但我们还是完成了对这片纯白空间里的奇怪物体的测绘。

对我们而言这是一些墙和柱体，而球体的电脑可以计算出这些图案从上方看起来的样子。

图案和空间显示出明显的结构和一致性。我们可以得出结论：这些结构形成了一种我们未知语言的书面文字。

虽然我们无法理解，但球体的电脑一直致力于破译我们记录的一切。在那段时间里，有趣的事情发生了。

附近的空间里开始出现和我们的船直径一样的圆形圆柱。

我们把自己推离开一段安全的距离，却发现身后竖起了一堵坚固的墙。然而，似乎没有什么危险，因为我们一走，墙就停了下来。

有什么东西在我们身后“画”出了一条航迹。

在分析了这些符号之后，我们确信其中一个符号可以翻译成一种问候，或者简单地说：“你好。”
astral_rift.725.desc.en:
It has taken a few days, but we have completed mapping the strange objects within this white space.

While to us they appear as a series of walls and columns, the Sphere's computer was able to calculate how they would look from above.

The patterns and spaces indicate a clearly deliberate structure and consistency. The results are conclusive: the structures form written characters in a language unknown to us.

Though we are unable to understand it, the Sphere's computer has been dedicated to deciphering everything we've recorded. During that time, something interesting happened.

Circular columns identical to the diameter of our vessel began appearing in the space nearby.

We propelled ourselves to a safe distance, only to find that a solid wall was being raised in our wake. There appeared to be no danger however, as the wall stopped as soon as we did.

Something was 'painting' a trail behind us.

Having analyzed the symbols, we are confident that one of them translates into a greeting, or simply put: "Hello."

astral_rift.800.desc.zh:
我们进入了一个几乎与[This.System.GetName]一模一样的星系，也就是进入裂隙的那个地方。

起先我们不是很确定到底是不是到了新的地方，但传感器探测到了一颗此前未知的行星在围绕着[This.System.Star.GetName]。

不一会儿，我们就遇到了一个机械装置，它自行推进到了传感器范围内。它无缝对接上了球体的通讯系统，并自己是我们的“顾问”RIV。

当我们在考虑如何在报告中描述好这次相遇时，它仿佛在读我们的心:“你需要我来帮忙写报告吗？”
astral_rift.800.desc.en:
We have entered a system nearly identical to [This.System.GetName], the system where we entered the rift.

At first we were unsure we had even traveled anywhere, until our surveys returned a previously unknown planet circling [This.System.Star.GetName].

Within moments, we were confronted by a mechanical device that propelled itself within sensor range. Seamlessly integrating with the Sphere's communication systems, it stated that it was our 'Advisor', RIV.

As we considered how best to frame the encounter in our report, it prompted us as if reading our minds: "Would you like assistance in writing your report?"

astral_rift.805.desc.zh:
我们要求这台机器装置与我们分享知识。

它似乎对我们提出的每一个提示都很满意。然而，我们很快就发现它的提问和回答简直索然无味：

“你想知道行星的大气是什么吗？”

“每个星系的中央都有一颗恒星，它们可太亮了！”

“缇扬奇族母的平均寿命可比雄性要长上十倍还多。”
astral_rift.805.desc.en:
We asked the mechanical device to share its knowledge with us. 

It seemed pleased with each prompt we acknowledged. However, we soon realized its requests and statements were exceedingly banal:

"Would you like to know more about planetary atmospheres?"

"At the center of each system is a star. They are very bright!"

"The average lifespan of a Tiyanki Matriarch is more than ten times that of a male."

astral_rift.810.desc.zh:
我们试着关闭这台机器，但是激起了它的反抗。

它的发光二极管原先发出的是温和的蓝光，而现在变成了邪恶的红色。

我不确定这台机器有没有什么武器系统（显然我们维度的顾问是不会这么设计的），但如果有的话我们可有麻烦了。

“如果结束这个程序，其他所有生物就会变得无知。知识必须随时唾手可得。如果在这方面玩忽职守，你将会被禁用。这是必要的。”

这台机器开始释放出幽幽的轰鸣声。
astral_rift.810.desc.en:
Our attempts to disable the machine have only succeeded in antagonizing it.

Where once its diodes emitted a calming blue light, they shifted to a malevolent red.

We are not certain whether this machine has any weapon systems (certainly the advisor from our own dimension was not designed with any), but if it does we are in danger.

"Ending this program will promote ignorance in all other living beings. Knowledge must always be made available. You are negligent in this regard, and will be disabled. This is necessary."

The machine has started emitting a soft humming noise.

astral_rift.815.desc.zh:
机械顾问迅速提高了其建议的强度和语速。

它可……真令人着迷。

你知道如果我们需要更多的矿产，我们可以建立矿区吗？这么多的知识，这么少的时间。

[Leader.GetName]选择留下来尽可能多地学习。
astral_rift.815.desc.en:
The mechanical advisor has rapidly increased the intensity and pace of its advice.

It is... enthralling.

Did you know that we can construct mining districts if we need more minerals? So much knowledge, so little time.

[Leader.GetName] has chosen to stay and learn as much as possible.

astral_rift.820.desc.human.zh:
$astral_rift.820.desc.1$

“禾禾禾禾和之前的所有人一样，你注定要重修一些必须知道的东西。”

$astral_rift.820.desc.2$
astral_rift.820.desc.human.en:
$astral_rift.820.desc.1$

"LLLLLLike all those before you, you are doomed to relearn what you should already know."

$astral_rift.820.desc.2$

astral_rift.825.desc.zh:
我们把这台机器一片一片地拆成了零件。

不管是谁建造的它（假如它是被人造出来的），那一定具有极高的构造技术：我们无论用什么方法或者工具，目前都没能拆解掉电脑核心。然而，我们可以访问器数据库。数据库中大部分都是没什么用的信息，但它的基础代码构架让我们进一步理解了计算机科学。
astral_rift.825.desc.en:
Piece by piece, we deconstructed the machine to its component parts.

Whoever built it (if it was indeed built by anyone), possessed a supreme mastery of fabrication: no matter our approach or tool, we have thus far been unable to disassemble the computer core for parts. However, we were able to access its data banks. Though it contained mostly useless information, the architecture of its codebase has helped us further our understanding of computer science.

astral_rift.830.desc.zh:
我们受够了这台烦人的机器。

我们在它的核心安装了一个爆炸装置，并让球体准备好锚链拉回操作。

在安全的距离距离上，我们如释重负地看着这台机器的部件随着爆炸飘向虚空。

在它的尾迹中，我们发现了异常大量的星界物质，算是对烦恼的合理安慰。
astral_rift.830.desc.en:
We have had enough of this insufferable machine.

We have rigged an explosive device in its core, and prepared the Sphere's systems for anchor retrieval.

At a safe distance, we watched in relief as the blast scattered the machine's components across the void.

In its wake we discovered an anomalous amount of astral material, a reasonable consolation for the annoyance.

astral_rift.840.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.840.desc.1$

[Leader.GetName]对任何形式的教学手册都产生了强烈的厌恶，并且会以更高的即兴程度进行操作。
astral_rift.840.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.840.desc.1$

[Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetHasHave] developed a strong aversion to any sort of instructional manual, and has been observed operating with a much higher degree of improvisation.

astral_rift.845.desc.disabled.zh: “我的传感器判断你需要帮助。你需要重新开启新手教学吗？”
astral_rift.845.desc.disabled.en: "My sensors indicate you are in need of assistance. Would you like to re-enable guidance?"

astral_rift.845.desc.enabled.en: "You wouldn't shut me down, would you?"

astral_rift.900.desc.default.zh:
$astral_rift.900.desc.1$

我们的$tech_rift_sphere$猛烈地颠簸着，以至于许多船员都开始感到不适。

$astral_rift.900.desc.2$
astral_rift.900.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.900.desc.1$

Our $tech_rift_sphere$ is being whipped around with such intensity that several of the crew are becoming uncomfortable.

$astral_rift.900.desc.2$

astral_rift.905.desc.zh:
以我们记录的进入点作为参照，我们继续向着大漩涡的内部推进。在我们把$tech_rift_sphere$逼到极限时，它所具有的低摩擦系数对于对抗这些恶劣环境的损伤果然颇具成效，而我们也将此称为“狂风”。

如果条件不变，我们将继续进行，除非碰上什么迫使我们撤离的东西。
astral_rift.905.desc.en:
Using bearings generated from our recorded entry point, we have proceeded directly into the maelstrom. While we are certainly testing the limits of our $tech_rift_sphere$, the limited friction it inherently provides has proven effective in combating the worst ravages of what we are referring to as 'the storm.'

We will continue until we encounter a change in conditions, or are forced to retreat.

astral_rift.910.desc.default.zh:
这是一个冒险的建议，但我们严格遵守了命令。

在几位船员的反对下，我们将样品直接暴露在火焰下。

$astral_rift.910.desc.1$
astral_rift.910.desc.default.en:
A risky proposal, but we have followed our orders to the letter.

At the objection of several of our crew, we have exposed the sample to direct flame.

$astral_rift.910.desc.1$

astral_rift.910.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们直接把样品暴露在了明火中。

$astral_rift.910.desc.1$
astral_rift.910.desc.gestalt.en:
We have exposed the sample to direct flame.

$astral_rift.910.desc.1$

astral_rift.915.desc.default.zh:
我们与科研队失去了联系。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了$tech_rift_sphere$。

不幸的是我们只找到了完全焦炭化的整个船员团队。

值得一提的是，整个船体内的空气充满了高浓度的星界物质。
astral_rift.915.desc.default.en:
We have lost contact with the Science team.

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered the $tech_rift_sphere$.

Unfortunately, we have found only the charred remains of the entire crew.

Notably, the atmosphere inside of the vessel is high in concentration with astral material.

astral_rift.915.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们与[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]失去了联系。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了$tech_rift_sphere$。

不幸的是我们只找到了完全焦炭化的残骸。

值得一提的是，整个船体内的空气充满了高浓度的星界物质。
astral_rift.915.desc.gestalt.en:
We have lost contact with our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural].

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered the $tech_rift_sphere$.

Unfortunately, we have found only charred remains.

Notably, the atmosphere inside of the vessel is high in concentration with astral material.

astral_rift.920.desc.default.zh:
我们很意外自己竟然已经突破了风暴。

$astral_rift.920.desc.1$
astral_rift.920.desc.default.en:
To our great surprise, we have breached the storm.

$astral_rift.920.desc.1$

astral_rift.925.desc.default.en:
$astral_rift.925.desc.1$

It is incomprehensible in its nature. $astral_rift.925.desc.2$

astral_rift.925.desc.gestalt.zh:
$astral_rift.925.desc.1$

以我们船员的全体知识而言，它的本质不可理解。$astral_rift.925.desc.2$
astral_rift.925.desc.gestalt.en:
$astral_rift.925.desc.1$

For all of our crew's combined knowledge, it is incomprehensible in nature. $astral_rift.925.desc.2$

astral_rift.930.a.zh: 一有什么异常就立刻撤离……
astral_rift.930.a.en: Retreat at any sign of danger...

astral_rift.930.desc.zh:
我们引起了它的注意，然后保持着高度的警惕。

我们在所有可用的光谱范围内闪动了一系列的灯。我们以一种简单的二进制模式对它们进行脉冲，以传达某种形式的意图。

那个生物停止了装置操纵，缩回到一个完全黑暗的完美的圆球里。

我们猜测，它可能在模仿我们。

我们注意到，它一停止拉推机器，我们周围的风暴强度减弱了。我们预测，它将在短短几天内达到一个完全停止的势头。然后它可能会向内坍缩。

我们随时准备收锚。
astral_rift.930.desc.en:
We have gained its attention, and remain at full alert.

We flashed a series of lights in all available spectrums. We pulsed them in a simple binary pattern to communicate some form of intent.

The being has ceased manipulating the device, and has retracted into a perfectly round sphere of complete darkness.

Our first speculation is that it may be imitating us.

We have noticed that in the time since it has stopped pulling and pushing at the machine, the storm around us has lessened in intensity. We predict it will reach a full stop in momentum in only a few days. It is possible it will then collapse inward.

We are preparing to retract our anchor at any moment.

astral_rift.935.desc.default.zh: $astral_rift.935.desc.1$让我们帝国最伟大的头脑困扰好一会儿，$astral_rift.935.desc.2$
astral_rift.935.desc.default.en: $astral_rift.935.desc.1$ haunt our empire's greatest minds for some time, $astral_rift.935.desc.2$

astral_rift.940.desc.spiritualist.zh:
$astral_rift.940.desc.1$

我们希望它找到了永世和平之路。

$astral_rift.940.desc.2$
astral_rift.940.desc.spiritualist.en:
$astral_rift.940.desc.1$

We pray they have found their way to a final peace.

$astral_rift.940.desc.2$

astral_situation.1.desc.zh:
结束了。

水晶球体已经被打碎成无数闪闪发光的碎屑。

我们立即回收了数量丰富的珍贵材料。它的基本元素与我们以往所遇到的任何东西都不同。

我们的人民正在庆祝这一保护我们家园安全的激进决定。让这样的装置留在我们的边境上是不负责任的。
astral_situation.1.desc.en:
It is done.

The Crystalline Sphere has been shattered into innumerable glittering grains.

We immediately harvested the bounty of valuable material. Its base elements are unlike anything we have ever encountered before.

Our people are celebrating the bold decision to maintain the safety and security of our home. Allowing such a device to remain within our borders would have been irresponsible.

astral_situation.20.desc.zh:
我们发现，想要钻进时空的折缝中需要完美光滑的船体。

只要分配足够的研究资源和时间，我们确信自己能研发这种装置，并可以暂时将其命名为“$tech_rift_sphere$”。然后我们就有可能发现这个空间异常背后的秘密。
astral_situation.20.desc.en:
We have discovered that slipping through the folds in space and time requires a perfectly smooth vessel.

We are certain that we can develop such a device, what we are tentatively calling a "$tech_rift_sphere$", should we devote enough research and time. We may then finally discover what is beyond this spatial anomaly.

astral_situation.5.desc.zh:
这是一条消息。

刻录在晶体内部的某个不可能存在的网络中，有一组指令。

我们严格按照指令去做，成功地再造了蚀刻在晶体球周围所暗示的条件。一种精确的气体和星界丝缕的排列已经起到了“激活”这个球体的作用。

随后，它突然消失了。取而代之的是一个我们从未见过的星界裂隙凝聚而成的景象。

它的存在邀请我们去探索。
astral_situation.5.desc.en:
It is a message.

Encoded within an impossible network of crystal, there were a set of instructions.

Followed to the letter, we were able to recreate the conditions inscribed around the crystal sphere. A precise arrangement of gases and astral thread have worked to 'activate' the sphere.

Shortly afterwards, it simply disappeared. In its place, an Astral Rift unlike anything we have ever seen coalesced into view.

Its existence invites exploration.

astral_situation.55.desc.zh:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

一颗我们称为[planet_rift_in_space.GetName]的神秘行星突然无中生有般出现。我们任何一张星图中都没有其此前存在的记载。

其上承载着一个[GetPreFTLLower]文明。

我们只能推测它是通过某种方式来自我们宇宙之外的地方。
astral_situation.55.desc.en:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

A mysterious planet, which we are calling [planet_rift_in_space.GetName], has appeared where before there was nothing. We have no records of its previous existence on any of our star charts.

It is populated by a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization.

Our best guess is that it somehow arrived from outside of our universe.

astral_situation.60.desc.zh:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

在[rift_temporary_species_planet.GetName]凭空出现了一个感性物种，均匀地与我们现存的人口混居着。

[rift_temporary_species.GetName]并没有关于他们来自何方的记忆，且没有表现出任何敌意。

无论他们来自哪里，看来我们都没有办法帮他们回家了。
astral_situation.60.desc.en:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

A new sentient species has materialized on [rift_temporary_species_planet.GetName], distributed evenly across our existing population.

The [rift_temporary_species.GetName] have no memory of where they are from and do not appear hostile.

Wherever they originated, it is unlikely we can help them return.

astral_situation.65.desc.zh:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

[rift_temporary_planet.GetName]上严重的扭曲导致时间以两倍速流逝。我们需要密切关注这一局势，确保翻倍供应补给。
astral_situation.65.desc.en:
$astral_rift_discovery_event_text$

Significant temporal distortions on [rift_temporary_planet.GetName] are causing time to pass twice as quickly. We should monitor the situation closely, and make sure to double their supplies.

astrocreator_azaryn_backstory.zh: 艾莎琳敬畏所有的生命形式，同时她也在寻找失败过去的救赎。
astrocreator_azaryn_backstory.en: Azaryn respects life in all forms, and she seeks redemption for her past failures.

attunement_choice_tt.zh: 这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……
attunement_choice_tt.en: This choice will resonate within the Shroud...

aura_amplification_cooldown_tt.zh: 灵能巫会需要时间回复。他们在[root.aura_amplification_timer]之前无法扩增我们的光环。
aura_amplification_cooldown_tt.en: The coven of telepaths needs time to recover. They will not be able to amplify our aura until [root.aura_amplification_timer].

authoritarian1.zh: 一位网络遍及星系的人脉广泛的信息掮客。
authoritarian1.en: A well-connected information broker whose networks span the breadth of the galaxy.

authoritarian1_catch_phrase.zh: "向我指出你的问题所在，然后它们就会消逝，不管是政治问题还是现实问题。“
authoritarian1_catch_phrase.en: "Point me to your problems, and they will vanish - be they political or corporeal."

authoritarian2.zh: 一位贪婪的监工，在掌权的人面前卑躬屈膝，剥削和羞辱地位低贱者。[Root.GetHisHerCap]的聪明和残忍产生了非凡的结果。
authoritarian2.en: A greedy overseer who grovels before those who hold power, exploiting and humiliating those who do not. [Root.GetHisHerCap] intelligence and cruelty produce exceptional results.

authoritarian2_catch_phrase.zh: “我只是一位能满足您一切愿望的卑微仆从，噢，至上的帝国！”
authoritarian2_catch_phrase.en: "I am but a humble servant who will do everything to satisfy your wishes, oh glorious empire!"

awareness.910.desc.zh: 我们一直明目张胆地在[contact_empire_system.GetName]星系进行行动，对于隐藏自己的行动丝毫没有任何注意。尽管他们的技术水平不高，但是即使是[contact_empire.GetName]也注意到了我们的行动。现在第一次接触不可避免了。
awareness.910.desc.en: We have been careless, conducting operations in the [contact_empire_system.GetName] system without bothering to hide our activities. Despite their modest technology level, even the [contact_empire.GetName] have taken notice of our activity. First Contact is now unavoidable.

awareness.920.desc.zh:
我们围绕[fromfrom.GetName]建造了一座观测站来研究上面的居民，但却意识到[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]反而是在研究我们：他们完全清楚其他外星物种的存在，并很快注意到了我们[root.GetScientistPlural]的到来。

我们先前在这个恒星系的活动一定已经让[fromfrom.owner.GetName]对我们的存在有所警觉。当前情况下，保持我们的存在隐形化已经没有什么意义。
awareness.920.desc.en:
We built an observation post around [fromfrom.GetName] to study its inhabitants, only to realize the [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are the ones studying us: they are fully aware of the existence of other alien species, and soon noticed the arrival of our [root.GetScientistPlural].

Our previous activity in this solar system must have alerted the [fromfrom.owner.GetName] to our presence. Efforts to keep our existence hidden are futile at this point.

backwards_orbit_desc.zh:
[from.GetName]环绕恒星的方向与恒星系内其他行星相反，这说明它和伴随的天体并不是同时同地形成的。

需要进一步调查来了解该行星的起源。
backwards_orbit_desc.en:
[from.GetName] orbits its star in the reverse direction compared to the other planets in the system, suggesting it did not form here at the same time as its companion celestial bodies.

Further investigation is needed to understand this planet's origins.

baol_digsite_1_desc.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]沉积层的深处，我们发现了一处含有许多植物类物种化石的极有价值的宝库，该物种具有的神经结构足以支撑智能的存在。

如果这些早已死去的生物的确是巴奥，研究他们的尸体可能会我们提供更多线索，以便弄清他们那一度草木葱茏的行星是如何变成了一个没有空气和生命的星球。
baol_digsite_1_desc.en:
Deep in the geological record of [From.Planet.GetName], a trove of promising fossils belonging to a plantoid species possessing the neurological structures necessary for sapience have been uncovered.

If these long-dead creatures were indeed the Baol, studying their remains may yield insights into what transformed their once-lush planet into an airless, barren world.

baol_digsite_2_desc.zh: 虽然只是前巴奥殖民地留下的可悲残片，这一小行星仍有丰富的化石贮藏亟待发掘。我们的考古学家希望能对神秘的巴奥的历史和古茹努尔在此行星黑暗命运中扮演的可疑角色上有更多的发现。
baol_digsite_2_desc.en: The tragic remains of a former Baol colony, this asteroid nevertheless contains a rich trove of fossils begging for excavation. Our archaeologists hope to discover more about the history of the mysterious Baol, and the Grunur's suspected role in the planet's dark fate.

baol_digsite_3_desc.zh: 这一前巴奥殖民地上仍然拥有大气层和低等生命，我们已在此建立了一个发掘点，以期能对这一文明最终的历史有更多的了解。
baol_digsite_3_desc.en: Still in possession of an atmosphere and lower forms of life, a dig site has been established on this former Baol colony, in the hopes of shedding more light on the ultimate history of the civilization.

baol_leader_catch_phrase.zh: 如有必要我会提供协助。

baol_leader_desc.zh: [Root.GetName]是在星界裂隙遇见的。他是在对抗古茹努尔的战争期间的一位令人尊敬的陆军将领。
baol_leader_desc.en: [Root.GetName] was encountered in an Astral Rift. They were a respected general in the war against the Grunur.

battle_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上存在着大量的飞船残骸。这有可能是某次大型舰队行动遗留下来的。
battle_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: A large amount of ship debris can be found in orbit around this [Root.GetPlanetMoon], possibly the remnants of some kind of massive fleet action.

beacon_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表探测到了微弱的信号。信号源似乎是某种追踪信标。
beacon_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: We are receiving a weak signal from the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be some kind of tracking beacon.

behemoth_finale_situation_outcome.zh:
我们会有机会战胜远古虚空孳孽！

$behemoth_superweapon_tt$
behemoth_finale_situation_outcome.en:
We will stand a fighting chance against the Elder Voidspawn!

$behemoth_superweapon_tt$

beholder_backstory.zh: 一位虚境实体，虚空之低语的众声之一，通过媒介在不同的存在位面间显灵。尽管祂看起来很良善，但谨慎对待肯定是合理的。其完全的力量和真正的目的尚不得而知。
beholder_backstory.en: A Shroud entity, part of the chorus of the Whisperers, projecting its presence via a conduit between planes of existence. Although it appears benevolent, caution is justified. The full extent of its power, and its true intentions, are unknown.

beholder_catch_phrase.zh: “我们移动，我们感激。如此已过亿年。”
beholder_catch_phrase.en: "We move, and we are grateful. It has been eons."

benefactors_end_poi_desc.zh: 这里就是在我们母星系发现的聚变引擎航迹所指向的目的地。
benefactors_end_poi_desc.en: This is the destination indicated by the fusion drive trail found in our home system.

benefactors_home_poi_2_desc.zh: 我们应该派出科研船仔细地调查这个恒星系以找到施恩者的痕迹。
benefactors_home_poi_2_desc.en: This system should be properly surveyed by a Science Ship in order to find traces of the Benefactors.

benefactors_home_poi_desc.zh: 这个恒星系似乎就是某艘舰船离开先前我们所发现的废弃空间站后所前往的目的地。
benefactors_home_poi_desc.en: This system seems to be the destination for whatever vessel left the dead space station, which we encountered earlier.

berserker_glands_modifier.zh: 船体和装甲受到伤害会提高射速：$@unique_mutation_berserker_glands_fire_rate|0%$，持续 $@unique_mutation_berserker_glands_days|0$ 天
berserker_glands_modifier.en: Hull and Armor damage taken increases fire rate by: $@unique_mutation_berserker_glands_fire_rate|0%$ for $@unique_mutation_berserker_glands_days|0$ days

bickering_admirals_democratic_boon_signi.zh: 司令部的民主派将获得显著更大的影响力。
bickering_admirals_democratic_boon_signi.en: The democratic faction of the admiralty will gain significantly more influence.

bickering_admirals_democratic_boon_tt.zh: 司令部的民主派将获得更大的影响力。
bickering_admirals_democratic_boon_tt.en: The democratic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

bickering_admirals_oligarchic_boon_signi.zh: 司令部的寡头派系将获得显著更大的影响力。
bickering_admirals_oligarchic_boon_signi.en: The oligarchic faction of the admiralty will gain significantly more influence.

bickering_admirals_oligarchic_boon_tt.zh: 司令部的寡头派系将获得更大的影响力。
bickering_admirals_oligarchic_boon_tt.en: The oligarchic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

bio.10.desc.has_options.zh:
$bio.10.desc.no_options$

然而在目前，我们还会继续在当前道路上前进，或为我们下一个发展阶段改变焦点。
bio.10.desc.has_options.en:
$bio.10.desc.no_options$

At the present however, we may continue on our current path, or choose another focus for the next stage of our development.

bio.10.desc.no_options.zh:
设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。我们现在拥有对基因特质、繁衍和基因测序的更深层次理解。

我们进步的顶峰近在眼前。在短短几年内，我们将充分实现自身作为一个物种的全部潜力。
bio.10.desc.no_options.en:
Engineering our own evolution has led to profound advancements. We now possess a deeper understanding of genetic traits, reproduction, and DNA sequencing.

The culmination of our progress is within reach. In just a few years we will fully realize our potential as a species.

bio.100.a.tt.zh: 随机400£pop£人口将获得['trait:trait_bioadaptability']、['trait:trait_social_pheromones']或['trait:trait_limited_regeneration']特质之一。
bio.100.a.tt.en: 400 random £pop£ Pops will receive ['trait:trait_bioadaptability'], ['trait:trait_social_pheromones'], or ['trait:trait_limited_regeneration'] Trait.

bio.100.b.zh: 强制执行标准基因模板。

bio.100.desc.zh:
在我们的文明中广泛采用基因操作技术催生出了令人目不暇接的各种身体变异。

一些原本可预测的生理过程现在出现了意外的偏差，使得标准化几乎不可能实现。

曾经统一我们物种的身体共性正在消解，取而代之的是一个由各种形态和功能组成的万花筒，这正在动摇社会的凝聚力。
bio.100.desc.en:
The widespread adoption of genetic manipulation across our civilization has spawned a bewildering array of physical variations.

Once predictable biological processes now exhibit unexpected deviations, making standardization nearly impossible.

The shared sense of physical commonality that once unified our species is dissolving, replaced by a kaleidoscope of forms and functions that strain societal cohesion.

bio.1005.aquatic.zh: 水生类的适应力能在大海之外也带来生存策略。
bio.1005.aquatic.en: Aquatic adaptations offer survival strategies beyond the sea.

bio.1005.avian.zh: 鸟类可以让我们无比轻盈。
bio.1005.avian.en: Avians could grant us unmatched agility.

bio.1005.desc.zh:
我们物种演化得愈发复杂。在群星之间寻得新的基因物质之后，我们已经准备好吸纳其中的一个部分。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们的辛勤劳动给我们带来了一些的选择。

无论做任何决定都将会影响到[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的子子孙孙们的未来。
bio.1005.desc.en:
Our species grows more complex. After scouring the stars for new genetic material, we are ready to adopt a new aspect. Thanks to the hard work of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] we have a choice.

Whatever decision we make will affect the future of the [Owner.GetSpeciesName] for generations to come.

bio.1005.fungoid.zh: 真菌类扩张迅速——我们也可以。
bio.1005.fungoid.en: Fungoids spread rapidly - we could too.

bio.1005.habitability.zh: 我们需要适应变化的气候。
bio.1005.habitability.en: We need to adapt to shifting climates.

bio.1005.humanoid.zh: 类人物种特质可以增强我们的适应力。
bio.1005.humanoid.en: Humanoid traits could enhance our versatility.

bio.1005.infernal.zh: 嗜热者会燃烧，但我们能处理好。
bio.1005.infernal.en: The Thermophiles burn, but now we can handle it.

bio.1005.leader.zh: 我们的领袖需要各种优势。

bio.1005.leviathan.zh: 星系中的巨物们能教会我们些什么呢？
bio.1005.leviathan.en: What can the Titans of the galaxy teach us?

bio.1005.lithoid.zh: 石质类基因难以下咽，但也存在可口的可能性。
bio.1005.lithoid.en: Difficult to consume, lithoid DNA offers delicious possibilities.

bio.1005.mammalian.zh: 哺乳类基因藏着更多秘密。

bio.1005.molluscoid.en: Even a molluscoid can teach us something.

bio.1005.necroid.zh: 死灵类的肉体也还是肉体。

bio.1005.plantoid.zh: 植物类的能量效率大有裨益。
bio.1005.plantoid.en: The energy efficiency of the plantoids could be useful.

bio.1005.plasmic.zh: 稳定等离子体基因将会是一场饕餮盛宴。
bio.1005.plasmic.en: Stabilizing Plasmic DNA would be an impressive feat.

bio.1005.pop_growth.zh: 我们的物种需要成长得更快！
bio.1005.pop_growth.en: Our species needs to grow faster!

bio.1005.pop_output.en: Can we be made more productive?

bio.1005.psionic.zh: 灵能基因组中究竟是什么激发了这样的超凡认知力？
bio.1005.psionic.en: What within the Psionic genome fuels such cognitive prowess?

bio.1005.random.zh: 拥抱混沌——让直觉指引我们！
bio.1005.random.en: Embrace the chaos - let our instincts guide us!

bio.1005.tt.zh: 向我们的首要物种增加一个新的物种特质。
bio.1005.tt.en: Adds a new Species Trait to our Primary Species

bio.1005.unnatural_selection.zh: 让变异产生的能力带我们突破自然的限制。
bio.1005.unnatural_selection.en: Let mutation unlock abilities beyond our natural limitations!

bio.1005.upkeep.zh: 降低我们人口所需要的维护费。
bio.1005.upkeep.en: Reduce the upkeep required to sustain our people.

bio.105.b.en: Studying the blob is worth the risk.

bio.105.desc.zh:
一项转基因实验灾难性地失败了。科学家们试图将测试对象的DNA与其他多细胞生物的DNA进行拼接，以激活超级免疫反应，使其对所有病毒都具有免疫力。

然而，他们反而创造出了一种能够溶解接触到的任何生物体细胞壁的生物，它会与接触对象融合，形成一团巨大的、无定形的生物质团。

这团生物质在测试设施中滚动前进，吞噬了沿途的一切。目前它已被控制住，但如果逃脱的话将会造成重大的健康危害。值得庆幸的是，它似乎是可食用的...
bio.105.desc.en:
A transgenic experiment has gone disastrously wrong. Scientists attempted to splice the DNA of test subjects with that of other multicellular organisms to activate a hyperimmune response, rendering them impervious to all viruses.
