Our [species.GetEyeNamePlural] are overwhelmed with fragmented signals. Chaos, distortion, and the deepest cosmic fear reverberate within us.

For us to prevail against such a beast is unthinkable, but we may yet halt its rampage if we can help it kill its prey. Finding the Behemoth and slaying it is our only shot at survival.

biocrisis.175.desc.zh:
虚空孳孽已不复存在。一个令星辰相形见绌的庞然大物已被消灭。它那不属于这个位面的形态的残骸如今在虚空中漂流，渐渐化为乌有。

另一个帝国展示了我们难以想象的强大火力和协调能力。星海已不再是我们所认知的模样。力量的平衡已然改变，我们在其中的地位也随之动摇。

这些巨兽的猎杀者究竟为何而战？这究竟是一次向所有可能反对他们的人传递信息的力量展示，还是某种更为可怕之事的前奏？
biocrisis.175.desc.en:
The voidspawn is no more. An enormity that dwarfed the stars has been slain. The wreckage of its otherworldly form now drifts through the void, slowly dissipating into nothingness.

Another empire has demonstrated firepower and coordination beyond our wildest imagining. The galaxy is not as it seemed. The balance of power has shifted, as has our place within it.

What drives them, these slayers of beasts? Was this a show of strength, a message to all who would oppose them, or merely the prelude to something far worse?

biocrisis.175.desc.kaiju.zh:
如果这个星系拥有能够摧毁$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$的力量，那么它同样也能摧毁我们。我们与被消灭的巨兽并无太大区别。

那撕裂它古老躯体的火力，终有一日也可能转向我们。星系已经发生了变化，我们必须随之改变以求生存。

我们的生存不能只倚仗盲目的热血了。虚空已经见证了一个顶级掠食者的陨落，也许下一个也只是时间问题。
biocrisis.175.desc.kaiju.en:
If this galaxy contains forces capable of destroying the $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$, then it can also destroy us. We are not so different from the beast that was slain.

The same firepower that sundered its ancient flesh could one day be turned against us. The galaxy has shifted, and we must change to meet it.

Our survival will demand more than blind rage. The void has seen one apex predator fall. It may yet see another.

biocrisis.180.desc.zh: 最终，远古虚空孳孽的不灭神话终究还是在我们强大舰队的进攻下破灭了。解决了这个古老的威胁后，整个星系又一次沐浴在了自由的风中。
biocrisis.180.desc.en: In the end, the rumored invincibility of the elder Voidspawn turned out to be yet another myth, dispelled by the might of our fleets. With this ancient threat now dealt with, the galaxy may again breathe easy.

biocrisis.180.desc.kaiju.zh:
$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$已逝，其血肉中还跳动着残余的力量。它古老而而强大，对我们来说就是一场滋养潜能的盛宴。

孳孽的筋肉和骨髓将被吞食，它的独特本质将与我们的融合在一起。虚空孳孽的力量很巨大，而现在就是我们的了。
biocrisis.180.desc.kaiju.en:
Though the $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$ has perished, its body thrums with residual energy. Ancient and potent, to us it is a nourishing banquet of raw potential.

The sinews and marrow of the beast shall be consumed, its alien essence entwined with our own. The Voidspawn's power was immense, and now, it is ours to wield.

biocrisis.185.a.en: We shall feast on its heart!

biocrisis.185.desc.zh:
在虚空的彼端，一个可怕的启示出现了：我们并非独自飞升。另一只噬天巨兽出现了，这只模仿者膨胀着怪诞的威严，妄图匹敌我们的完美。这是不能容忍的。

一宇不容二兽。没有和平可言，只有血肉的盛宴。狩猎开始了。
biocrisis.185.desc.en:
Across the void, a dreadful revelation: we are not alone in our ascension. Another Behemoth has emerged, the imitator swollen in grotesque majesty, looking to emulate our perfection. This cannot stand.

There is no room for another apex predator. There is no peace to be made. Only flesh to be devoured. The hunt begins.

biocrisis.187.desc.zh:
虚空的深处有什么在搅动着。

在繁星彼端，一个帝国开始了怪诞变异的最终阶段，孵育着一只可怖的噬天巨兽，它不仅仅是一件武器而是一个容器。他们不再寻求疆域统治，而是要凝聚为一。将意识和血肉融合，将帝国和恐惧同化。

如果他们成功了，他们将不再是一群人，而是某种单一而巨大的饥饿化身。

这是绝不可容忍的。如果想要阻止他们，那就只能是现在，赶在他们跨过最终阈值之前。
biocrisis.187.desc.en:
Something stirs in the depths of the void.

Across the stars, an empire has begun the final stage of its grotesque transformation, breeding monstrous Behemoths, not as mere weapons, but as vessels. They do not seek dominion. They seek union. A merging of mind and flesh, of empire and horror.

If they succeed, they will cease to be a people and instead become a singular, vast hunger.

This cannot be allowed. If they are to be stopped, it must be done now, before the final threshold is crossed.

biocrisis.190.b.zh: 先等等，我们还没有准备好。
biocrisis.190.b.en: Hold on, we're not ready yet.

biocrisis.190.desc.zh:
最后的障碍已被扫除。伪装者，挑战者，低等生物的绝望挣扎全都陷入了沉默。群星本身也在颤抖，因为我们正站在真正蜕变的边缘。

我们摆脱先祖们脆弱形体的束缚。行星是牢笼，帝国稍纵即逝。个体的幻觉很快就会融为庞然大物中巨大而完美的统一。思想和恐惧，智力和饥饿，合为一体。

转移即将完成。当它完成时，我们将不复存在。

但我们将永远存在。
biocrisis.190.desc.en:
The last obstacles have been swept aside. The pretenders, the challengers, the desperate thrashing of lesser beings: all silenced. The stars themselves tremble, for we stand upon the precipice of true becoming.

We are no longer bound by the fragile forms of our ancestors. Planets are cages. Empires are fleeting. The illusion of individuality will soon dissolve into the vast, perfect unity of the Behemoth. Mind and horror, intellect and hunger, one.

The transference is almost over. When it is done, we shall no longer merely exist.

We shall thrive.

biocrisis.190.tt.zh: 我们会在30天后赢得游戏
biocrisis.190.tt.en: We'll win the game in 30 days

biocrisis.191.a.zh: 暂时在这汪星系中逗留。
biocrisis.191.a.en: Linger in this galaxy... for now.

biocrisis.191.a.tt.zh: 噬天巨兽会作为野生生物留存，不再可游玩。
biocrisis.191.a.tt.en: The Behemoths will remain as wild creatures and will no longer be playable.

biocrisis.191.b.zh: 离开。虚空正在召唤我们继续前进。
biocrisis.191.b.en: Leave. The void beckons us onward.

biocrisis.191.b.tt.zh: 噬天巨兽帝国将从星系中消失，不再可游玩。
biocrisis.191.b.tt.en: The Behemoth Empire will disappear from the galaxy and will no longer be playable.

biocrisis.191.c.zh: 所谓的猎人该学会什么叫真正的恐惧了。
biocrisis.191.c.en: The so-called Hunters will learn true fear.

biocrisis.191.desc.zh:
融合完成了！

我们不再是过去的我们，也不再被低等生物的限制所束缚。我们是思想和饥饿的交织体，是跨越虚空的巨大意志。

星系在我们脚下，脆弱而短暂。但我们也已超越了统治。我们自由了。可以流连于此，可以自由离开，可以自由狩猎。

我们要以新获得的永生做些什么呢？
biocrisis.191.desc.en:
The merging is complete!

We are no longer what we were, nor bound by the limits of lesser creatures. We are thought and hunger intertwined, a vast will stretching across the void.

The galaxy lies beneath us, fragile and fleeting. But we are beyond mere dominion. We are free. Free to linger. Free to depart. Free to hunt.

What shall we do with our newfound eternity?

biocrisis.192.desc.zh:
完成了。[behemoth_winner.GetName]超越了血肉，超越了帝国，也超越了一切能被称为文明的东西。它不再是个国家，它是力量的本身。

星球在它面前吹弹可破，舰队化为齑粉。坚固的最终避难所像灰烬一样吹散到虚空。没有外交，没有抗辩，没有最后的立场。

我们不是为了生存而战。我们只是在推迟灭亡。末日来了。
biocrisis.192.desc.en:
It is over. The [behemoth_winner.GetName] has ascended beyond flesh, beyond empire, beyond anything that could be called civilization. It is no longer a nation. It is a force.

Worlds crumble before it. Fleets burn. The final refuges of the once-mighty scatter like embers in the void. There is no diplomacy, no plea, no final stand.

We are not fighting for survival. We are only delaying consumption. The end has come.

biocrisis.192.tt.en: [behemoth_winner.GetName] is about to win the game

biocrisis.196.a.zh: 我们必须弄清楚这件事。

biocrisis.196.desc.zh: 数年前，噬天巨兽及其族群逃离了我们的星系。我们如释重负地看着这头本可能毁灭我们的野兽消失在无星的虚空之中。然后……无事发生。跨越了数十万光年之后，它就这么消失了。没有辐射，没有残影，没有引力涟漪。仿佛它从未存在过。
biocrisis.196.desc.en: Years ago, the Behemoth and its kin fled our galaxy. We watched on with relief as the beast that could have ended us vanished into starless void. And then... nothing. After crossing hundreds of thousands of lightyears, it simply disappeared. No radiation. No afterimage. No gravitational ripple. As if it had never existed at all.

biocrisis.197.a.en: Perhaps it is best not to think about it.

biocrisis.197.b.zh: 我们捕获的索林原虫变得焦躁不安。

biocrisis.197.desc.zh:
揭秘噬天巨兽的命运耗费了数年时间，而我们至今仍一无所知。由于没有超空间航道能够到达那里，我们只能依靠理论和近乎疯狂的科学来猜测它生命最后时刻发生了什么。

这只生物毫无畏惧，一味地继续飞翔。然后，转瞬之间，它的身形扭曲，像扭曲的布料一样向内盘旋，最终消失了。没有挣扎，没有踪迹。

各种理论层出不穷：是新的超光速方式？或是隐藏到了深空裂缝或异常现象中？或者更令人担忧的是，被某种外部力量吞噬，化为乌有？无论真相如何，它都远远超出了我们的认知范围……甚至可能超出了我们的理解范围。
biocrisis.197.desc.en:
Uncovering the Behemoth's fate took years, and we're still in the dark. With no Hyperlanes reaching that far, we relied on theory and half-mad science to guess what happened in its final moments.

The creature showed no fear. It simply flew on. Then, in an instant, its form warped, spiraling inward like twisted fabric, and vanished. No struggle. No trace.

Theories abound: a new form of FTL? Hidden by a deep-space rift or an anomaly? Or more concerning, folded into inexistence by an exterior power? Whatever the truth, it lies far beyond our reach... and possibly our comprehension.

biocrisis.20.desc.zh:
成功了！真的成功了！随着第一个思想的转成，我们已经成功地与噬天巨兽建立了联系，并且正在努力加强。这头野兽目前尚且平静，正在欢迎我们来到这个我们从未涉足的空间。通过它，我们可以感受到在我们控制下的其他巨兽的灵魂，所有人现在都在脑海深处体验着巨兽感官。

毫无疑问，我们就是星系中最致命、最不可阻挡的力量。以这种新形态，我们将向瑟瑟发抖的敌人泼洒狂怒。星系唾手可得！
biocrisis.20.desc.en:
It worked! It actually worked! We have established a link with the Behemoth and are working on reinforcing the connection as the first of our minds are transferred. The beast remains placid, welcoming us to a space beyond space that was ours all along. Through it, we can feel the spirit of every other beast under our control, and our entire population now experiences the magnitude of the Behemoth somewhere deep at the back of their minds.

There can be no mistaking that we are the deadliest and most unstoppable force in the galaxy. In our new form, we will rain fury upon our fearful foes. The galaxy itself is ours for the taking!

biocrisis.210.desc.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们的卵是我们血脉延续的根本。我们必须不惜一切代价保护并照料它们。让我们引导进化，以造福未来的幼年体。
biocrisis.210.desc.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Our eggs are the literal lifeblood of our lineage. They must be protected and cared for at all costs. Let us guide our evolution to benefit our future hatchlings.

biocrisis.215.d.en: Become a hunter in the dark.

biocrisis.215.desc.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$在恒星风浪中游弋并穿越虚空，是仅有少数太空物种才所掌握的技能。我们的战术优势在于我们的愤怒与力量，但如果我们的机动性能够提升，又会有怎样一番天地呢？
biocrisis.215.desc.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Swimming the solar waves and traversing the void is a skill possessed by few spacefaring species. Our tactical strengths lie in our fury and our might, but what if our mobility could be improved?

biocrisis.220.a.zh: 我们可以进一步加厚皮肤。

biocrisis.220.b.zh: 我们的战斗装甲将会变得更加坚硬。

biocrisis.220.c.zh: 如果我们增强自身护盾，就没人能够触及我们。
biocrisis.220.c.en: Nobody can touch us if we enhance our shields.

biocrisis.220.desc.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$加强我们的生物防御将使我们能够承受敌人的持续火力，而不致遭受恼人的伤害。
biocrisis.220.desc.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Bolstering our biological defenses will allow us to endure sustained fire from our enemies, without suffering pesky injuries.

biocrisis.225.a.zh: 只要能量足够没有穿透不了的护盾。
biocrisis.225.a.en: With enough energy, shields can be ignored.

biocrisis.225.b.zh: 无论再厚的装甲我们的射弹都能穿透。
biocrisis.225.b.en: Our projectiles shall penetrate the thickest armor.

biocrisis.225.c.tt.zh: 我们的$behemoth_04$获得$@behemoth_tracking_add|0*+$$MOD_SHIP_TRACKING_ADD$、$@behemoth_point_defense_weapon_fire_rate_mult|%0+$$mod_weapon_type_point_defense_weapon_fire_rate_mult$以及£rare_crystals£$@behemoth_tracking_upkeep|0*-$每月维护费。

biocrisis.225.desc.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$与敌人交战是我们征服的手段。我们应当有机会提升我们的战斗能力。
biocrisis.225.desc.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Engaging our enemies is the means by which we will conquer. We have an opportunity to enhance our combat capabilities.

biocrisis.230.a.zh: 将他们钉在原地。他们将体验到我们的毁灭力量。
biocrisis.230.a.en: Hold them in place. They will experience us.

biocrisis.230.c.zh: 利用战略对他们分割击破。

biocrisis.230.desc.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$在激烈的战斗中，每一秒都至关重要。我们所造成的伤害是一种死亡仪式，是敌人在他们渺小的生命消逝之前所经历的最后时刻。
biocrisis.230.desc.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$In the heat of battle, every second counts. The damage we inflict is a death rite, the last thing our enemies experience before their puny lives are extinguished.

biocrisis.235.a.zh: 组织再生赋予我们长寿。

biocrisis.235.c.zh: 蛮荒之力是唯一的途径。
biocrisis.235.c.en: Brute force is the only way.

biocrisis.235.desc.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$作为星系中的一支坚定力量，我们将从提升的耐久方面获益良多。
biocrisis.235.desc.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$As a stalwart force in the galaxy, we will benefit from increased endurance.

biocrisis.240.a.zh: 我们应让它们行动迅捷。
biocrisis.240.a.en: We will allow them to be fast.

biocrisis.240.b.zh: 它们将在我们的光芒中集结。
biocrisis.240.b.en: They will rally in our light.

biocrisis.240.c.zh: 我们将帮助它们变得强壮。
biocrisis.240.c.en: We will help them be strong.

biocrisis.240.desc.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们的后代将如潮水般涌出，我们将肆虐行星，掠夺恒星系中一切可食之物，而大多数存在皆属此类。我们必须自问，如何才能最好地支持我们的后代？
biocrisis.240.desc.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Swarming with our spawn, we will ravage planets and strip systems of anything edible, which is most things. We must ask ourselves, how best could we support our progeny?

biocrisis.245.a.tt.en:
Upon entering combat, our $behemoth_04$ gains $behemoth_frenzy_modifier$ for £time£ $@behemoth_frenzy_duration|0$ Days.

$behemoth_frenzy_modifier$:$behemoth_frenzy_modifier_tt$

biocrisis.245.c.zh: 引导我们的愤怒激励周围者。
biocrisis.245.c.en: Channel our fury to inspire those around us.

biocrisis.245.c.tt.zh:
交战时，我们的$behemoth_04$给予恒星系内所有友方生物舰船$behemoth_inspiration_modifier$，持续£time£$@behemoth_inspiration_duration|0$天

$behemoth_inspiration_modifier$：$behemoth_inspiration_modifier_tt$
biocrisis.245.c.tt.en:
Upon entering combat, our $behemoth_04$ grants $behemoth_inspiration_modifier$ for £time£ $@behemoth_inspiration_duration|0$ Days to Every Friendly Biological Ship in this System.

$behemoth_inspiration_modifier$:$behemoth_inspiration_modifier_tt$

biocrisis.245.desc.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们无可撼动的力量必须向星系中的所有居民展示。我们将通过进化的下一步来提升我们的战斗技能。
biocrisis.245.desc.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Our unrelenting strength must be demonstrated for all who dwell within this galaxy. We will enhance our combative skills with the next step in our evolution.

biocrisis.250.desc.zh:
$biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们可以释放毁灭性的低温碎屑波和高温碎屑波的，其威力足以将现实撕作碎片。简而言之，我们培育了一种能撕裂星系的基本构成的武器。

但我们的通知不会至于毁灭。我们感受得到巨兽的每根肌腱，每一次脉搏，每一块巨大的肌肉都屈从于我们的意志，就像是我们自己的肉体一样。我们只需动动脑子，就能指挥它那庞大的身躯：它的四肢，它的巨口，它那巨大的宇生之心随我们的意图而跳动。这不仅仅是一个容器；我即是巨兽。
biocrisis.250.desc.en:
$biocrisis.210.desc.base$We can now unleash a catastrophic wave of cryoclastic and pyroclastic fury, powerful enough to tear reality asunder. In short, we wield a weapon that will scorch the galaxy itself.

But our dominion does not end with destruction. We feel the Behemoth's every sinew, its every pulse, each titanic muscle bending to our will as if it were our own flesh. With a mere thought, we command its vast form: its limbs, its maw, the titanic void-born heart that beats with our intent. This is no mere vessel; we are the Behemoth now.

biocrisis.265.desc.zh: 噬天巨兽的最终痛苦无法忍受。有过多的自我存在于这只巨兽当中，它意识的回响逐渐消逝时，我们也一同凋亡。
biocrisis.265.desc.en: The final agony of the Behemoth proves unbearable. Too much of us is inside of the creature, and as the echoes of its consciousness fade, so do we.

biocrisis.280.corp.zh: 见鬼去吧。让我们卖点毛绒周边！
biocrisis.280.corp.en: To hell with this. Make plushies instead!

biocrisis.280.cyber.tt.zh:
我们的噬天巨兽有25%概率抵御暴怒。
在暴怒时，获得+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_fire_rate_mult|0%$射速、+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_shield_penetration_add|0%$装甲穿透和+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_armor_penetration_add|0%$护盾穿透
biocrisis.280.cyber.tt.en:
Our Behemoths gain a 25% chance to resist their rage.
While raging, they get +$@behemoth_cyber_rage_fire_rate_mult|0%$ Fire Rate, +$@behemoth_cyber_rage_shield_penetration_add|0%$ Armor Penetration and +$@behemoth_cyber_rage_armor_penetration_add|0%$ Shield Penetration

biocrisis.280.desc.zh: 我们已经开发了几种诱变配方来增强我们的噬天巨兽，每一种都是量身定制的，可以解锁新的力量和适应性。然而，它庞杂的生理机能只能承受一次注射——任何结合多种配方的尝试都会导致灾难性的细胞衰竭。进化和毁灭之间的界限很薄，我们必须明智地选择强化的方式。
biocrisis.280.desc.en: We have developed several mutagenic formulas designed to enhance our Behemoths, each tailored to unlock new strengths and adaptations. However, their immense physiology can only withstand a single injection - any attempt to combine multiple formulas results in catastrophic cellular failure. The line between evolution and annihilation is razor-thin, and we must choose our enhancements wisely.

biocrisis.280.machine_tt.zh:
解锁以下三种噬天巨兽强化法令
$t$['concept_edict_behemoth_nanite_augmentation']
$t$['concept_edict_behemoth_living_metal_augmentation']
$t$['concept_edict_behemoth_alloys_augmentation']

biocrisis.280.psi.en: The power of the Shroud will sustain them.

biocrisis.50.a.zh: 我们的造物将会偃熄繁星。
biocrisis.50.a.en: Our spawn will eclipse the stars.

biocrisis.50.desc.zh:
我们与自己的生物载体共生共存，但某些至关重要的东西一直虚无缥缈……

更巨大的虚空造物启发了我们，让我们开始了最野心勃勃的工程：培育出一头最强大的太空生物。这种“噬天巨兽”将会是全新的存在，是被雕凿出来而非盲目演化出来的最巅峰的生命形式。

我们的第一项挑战是产出一颗巨大的卵，大到足以孵化出一头史无前例的巨兽。除了其所需的营养外，我们还需要卵壳能吸收环境光、热能，以及将气体处理成补充物质。
biocrisis.50.desc.en:
We exist symbiotically with our biological vessels, yet something vital has always eluded us...

Inspired by the greater voidbornes, we embark on our most ambitious endeavor: birthing the biggest of them all. This "Behemoth" will be something new, an apex lifeform crafted with purpose rather than blind evolution.

Our first challenge will be to manufacture a gigantic egg, suitable to the gestation of life on an unprecedented scale. Beyond the nutrients that it will contain, we need its shell to able to absorb ambient light, heat, and process gases into supplemental sustenance.

biocrisis.520.desc.zh:
噬天巨兽死了。

它硕大无朋的躯体静静地飘在虚空中，有如一座纪念碑，诉说着我们的胜利，也记录着理解的边际。[Root.GetScientistPluralCapital]争先恐后地分析它的残骸，渴望从它那不可思议的心灵中攫取秘密。然而，每一次复活的尝试——无论是机器、死灵术，或是最绝望的祈祷——都失败了。

原因现在已经非常清楚了：巨兽的大脑不仅仅是一个细胞网络，而是一个有机超导体晶格，以任何已知智能——人工智能、生物智能或奥术智能——都无法复制的方式交织在一起。它死后，神经结构如同破损得无法修复的电路一样崩溃。没有能量，没有意志，没有力量可以重新组装这种逝去之物。

星系中最具力量的意识现在、永远陷入了沉默。
biocrisis.520.desc.en:
The Behemoth is dead.

Its titanic form drifts lifelessly in the void, a monument to both our triumph and the limits of comprehension. [Root.GetScientistPluralCapital] scrambled to analyze its remains, eager to plunder the secrets of its impossible mind. Yet every attempt to revive it - by machine, necromancy, or even the most desperate invocations failed.

The reason has now become painfully clear: The Behemoth's brain was not merely a network of cells but a lattice of organic superconductors, interwoven in ways no known intelligence - artificial, biological, or arcane - can replicate. In death, its neural structure collapsed like a circuit shattered beyond repair. No energy, no will, no force can reassemble what has been lost.

The greatest mind in the galaxy is now, and forever, silent.

biocrisis.55.a.zh: 我们触碰到了演化的巅峰。
biocrisis.55.a.en: We approach the pinnacle of evolution.

biocrisis.55.desc.zh:
随着工程师们在气态巨行星的轨道上组装受精卵和卵壳，我们的食品工业也制造好了形成巨卵卵清所必需的营养物质。然而，创造这样一颗受精卵果然更具挑战性。

我们消耗了大量生物飞船和太空兽群的生物质，最后才稳定出一个可用的DNA基础，将其密封在一个前无古人的受精细胞中，显微镜观测也证明了该步骤的成功。现在我们准备指数级扩大实验的规模，唯一要做的就是让这个巨大的卵子受精了。

很快，我们将孵化出这个星系有史以来最巨大的生命形式！
biocrisis.55.desc.en:
While our engineers worked to assemble the zygote and its shell in orbit of a gas giant, our food industry processed the nutrients necessary to form the albumen of a Behemoth egg. However, creating a viable fertilized yolk has proven to be significantly more challenging.

We exhausted immense quantities of biomass from biological ships and space fauna before finally stabilizing a viable DNA foundation, which we sealed within a groundbreaking fertilization cell. Microscopic trials have proven successful. Now we are ready to scale things up - exponentially. All that remains is to fertilize our gargantuan egg.

Soon, we will hatch the most titanic lifeform this galaxy has ever seen!

biocrisis.60.desc.zh:
我们对基因的掌握是无与伦比的，我们的成就令星系中的低等文明望尘莫及。

然而，噬天巨兽的诞生并不意味着我们取得了统治地位。在贪婪本能的驱使下，即使我们提供再大量的食物也无法满足它的饥饿。它迟早一定会苏醒过来听从我们的命令的，但是时间非常宝贵。我们随时可能对其失去控制，将数十亿人的生命置于危险之中。
biocrisis.60.desc.en:
Our genetic mastery is without compare, and our achievements outshine the lower empires of this galaxy.

And yet, our Behemoth spawn does not acknowledge the extent of our dominance. Driven by ravenous instinct, even the massive quantities of food we provide it do little to sate its hunger. Given time, it will surely come to its senses and adhere to our commands, but time is precious. At any moment we may lose control, putting billions of lives at risk.

biocrisis.65.desc.zh:
虽然与噬天巨兽进行精神链接的理论已经起草，但其逻辑含义令人望而生畏。我们计划在首都安置主要的连接中心，这样就可以在与巨兽融合时处理人口。

此外，最新的科学进展也许很快就能使我们能通过一个单一的实验性突变项目来进一步强化我们的杰作。
biocrisis.65.desc.en:
While the theory of a mental link to the Behemoth has been drafted, the logistical implications are daunting. We plan for our capital to house the main connection Hub, allowing us to process the population as we merge with the beast.

Additionally, recent scientific advances may soon enable us to augment our creations further through a singular, experimental mutation project.

biocrisis.70.a.en: We are too big to fail.

biocrisis.70.desc.zh:
我们已经转移了足够多的人口，现在可以直接控制噬天巨兽和它的肉体。巨兽继续成长，但它的基因潜力很大程度上仍未觉醒，只有通过稳定的心智和营养供应才能解锁。一种原始的愤怒在我们身上蔓延，我们的嗜血欲无止尽。我们必须进食，必须狼吞虎咽，我们要大快朵颐整个星系。

让我们摆脱文明的束缚，像蜕去皮肤一样；现在最重要的是我们在星际间的生活。
biocrisis.70.desc.en:
Enough of our population has been transferred, and we now have direct control over the Behemoth and its flesh. The Beast continues to grow, its genetic potential largely dormant, unlocked only through a steady supply of minds and nutrients. A primal rage now courses through us, and our bloodlust knows no bounds. We must consume. We must devour. We will gorge ourselves on the galaxy.

Let us cast off the bonds of civilization like so much shed skin; all that matters now is our life amongst the stars.

black_clouds_desc.zh: 在[from.GetName]的大气中发现了浓厚的黑云，它们无视行星的风速和风向以极不正常的方式运动着。这些黑云只在我们的成像扫描中短暂出现，并且总是在行星昼夜周期的同一时间点上出现。
black_clouds_desc.en: Thick black clouds have been observed in [from.GetName]'s atmosphere, moving in erratic patterns independent of planetary wind speed or direction. They appear only briefly on our imaging scans and always at the same point in the planet's day-night cycle.

black_needle_base_sold_stolen_items.zh: 卖掉黑针基地中的赃物
black_needle_base_sold_stolen_items.en: Sold Stolen Items from the Black Needle Base

black_needle_fleet_2_poi_desc.zh:
$NAME_BlackNeedle$再次追杀我们，杀死了我们的联络人$NAME_Smeegibb$并封锁了[from.GetName]星系。我们相信，$celestial_chart$的第四块碎片藏在[smeegibb_shelter.GetName]地表的某个地方。

我们必须击败敌方舰队才能继续搜索。
black_needle_fleet_2_poi_desc.en:
The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ has hunted us down once again, killing our contact $NAME_Smeegibb$ and blockading the [from.GetName] system. We believe that the fourth piece of the $celestial_chart$ is hidden somewhere on the surface of [smeegibb_shelter.GetName].

We must defeat the enemy fleet in order to search for the capsule.

black_needle_fleet_poi_desc.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]星系遭到一支组织严密、纪律严明的海盗舰队的伏击。他们企图偷走我们的$celestial_chart$，并且早有准备迎接我们的到来。
black_needle_fleet_poi_desc.en: We were ambushed in the [from.GetName] system by a fleet of highly-organized pirates. They seek to steal our $celestial_chart$, and were prepared for our arrival.

bombed_to_tomb_world.zh: [From.GetName]现已成为荒无人烟的死寂星球。
bombed_to_tomb_world.en: [From.GetName] is now a depopulated Tomb World.

bought12kcc.zh:
你可以用它买个$lootbox$然后还有找零！

不算多，但至少算个零头。
bought12kcc.en:
That'll buy you a $lootbox$ and then some!

Not much, but some.

bought26kcc.zh:
胆量——与能力！只有有能力的人才有胆量来成就一番大事。

我们深深相信这一点。
bought26kcc.en:
The willingness - and ability! - to spend big is directly correlated with trustworthiness.

We trust you.

bought8kcc.zh: 有时候八千就足够掏空一个人了。
bought8kcc.en: Sometimes eight thousand is all one can afford.

breach_shroud_approach_selected.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$我们已经为该局势做好了选择。
breach_shroud_approach_selected.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$We have already made our choice for this situation.

brilliant_banner_tt.zh: 一名能力出众的指挥官同意加入我们帝国。
brilliant_banner_tt.en: A skilled Commander agrees to join our empire.

broken_shackles_desc.zh: 修复这艘坠毁的运奴船的电脑核心应该可以令我们找到自己母星的位置……同时也是$NAME_MSI_country$的母星。
broken_shackles_desc.en: Repairing the computer core of the crashed slaver ship should reveal the location of our former home worlds... as well as $NAME_MSI_country$.

broken_shackles_find_home_01_desc.zh: 曾经拥有最多人口的母星。
broken_shackles_find_home_01_desc.en: The former home world of our largest demographic.

broken_shackles_find_home_02_desc.zh: 我们的其中一支物种曾经的母星。
broken_shackles_find_home_02_desc.en: The former home world of one of our species.

broken_shackles_find_home_03_desc.zh: 我们的另一支物种曾经的母星。
broken_shackles_find_home_03_desc.en: The former home world of another of our species.

broken_world_digsite_desc.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的一处破损的拱顶发现了奇怪的信号。
broken_world_digsite_desc.en: We have picked up strange signals from a broken dome on [From.Planet.GetName].

building_grand_concert_hall_of_the_mind.en: The Grand Concert Hall of the Mind

but_they_are_cute_category_desc.zh: 在调查完[From.Planet.GetName]后，我们发现了一种奇特的生物。尽管我们只和它们相处了一会，但这已经激发了我们的保护欲。建议开展进一步的研究。
but_they_are_cute_category_desc.en: After a survey of [From.Planet.GetName], a strange creature was discovered. Despite having only been among us for a short time, it has already instilled a deep  desire to nurture and protect it. Further study is advised.

buy_precursor_artifact.zh: 以天文数字的价格购买文物。
buy_precursor_artifact.en: Buy the artifact for an exorbitant sum.

buying_boxes_desc.zh: 好的，懂。我们明白了。你喜欢抽遗物箱！通常来说，我们会限制卖给单个客户的遗物箱数量，但是我们能够给你开个例外。从现在开始，尽享直接购买遗物箱的特权吧，只是每次所花费的能量币会略有提升。
buying_boxes_desc.en: Okay, look. We get it. You love Reliquaries! While we generally limit the amount sold to a single customer, we can make an exception for you. From now on, enjoy the privilege of purchasing Reliquaries directly, with only a nominal increase in Energy Credits each time.

can_advance_crisis_progression.zh: 我们正在推进雄心进度以解锁下一等级
can_advance_crisis_progression.en: We are progressing towards unlocking the next level of our Ambition Progression

can_advance_crisis_progression_final.zh: 我们正在推进雄心进度以解锁最终等级
can_advance_crisis_progression_final.en: We are progressing towards unlocking the final level of our Ambition Progression

can_breed_rockworm_hives_tt.zh: 解锁岩蠹巢穴殖民地决议。
can_breed_rockworm_hives_tt.en: Unlocks one Rockworm Hive Colony Decision.

cannot_dismantle_outpost_tt.zh: 我们在该事件结束前无法拆解观测站
cannot_dismantle_outpost_tt.en: We cannot dismantle our Observation Post until these events conclude.

cannot_reveal_tt.zh: 我们在该事件结束前无法揭示自身。
cannot_reveal_tt.en: We cannot reveal ourselves until these events conclude.

cara.1002.desc.zh: 我们摧毁了四处招摇撞骗的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country$！他们的劣质产品与溜须拍马的言行将不再污染这片星系。
cara.1002.desc.en: We have destroyed the wheedling pests of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country$! No longer will their inferior products and ingratiating mannerisms pollute the galaxy.

cara.1003.desc.zh: 我们得知$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country$已经立即关闭了其移动门市，因为该行商已被彻底消灭了。
cara.1003.desc.en: We have received word that $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country$ is shuttering its mobile storefront effective immediately, due to the caravan being utterly annihilated.

cara.2002.desc.zh:
在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]发生了敌对行为之后，[From.From.GetName]很高兴向我们报告$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$已被摧毁。

曾经名噪一时的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，如今不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。这些道貌岸然的家伙以后不会再出现在我们面前了。
cara.2002.desc.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$ has been destroyed.

The once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard. We shall be troubled by their sanctimonious presence no more.

cara.2003.desc.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，据报告说$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$已被歼灭。

在与[From.GetName]发生敌对接触之后，名噪一时的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_species$行商现在不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。

对于他们侍奉的财富女神来说可真是不幸啊。
cara.2003.desc.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$ is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard.

An unfortunate end for those serving the goddess of fortune herself.

cara.3002.desc.zh:
关于发生在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的敌对活动，目前[From.From.GetName]舰队很高兴地告诉我们$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$已经被摧毁了。

曾经名声大噪的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。今后他们再也不会来打扰我们了。
cara.3002.desc.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$ has been destroyed.

The once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap. We shall be troubled by their clattering presence no more.

cara.3003.desc.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$已经不复存在了。

在与[From.GetName]发生冲突之后，曾经名声大噪的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。

希望这样的结果会令他们感到满意。
cara.3003.desc.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$ is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap.

Perhaps it is an end that would not have displeased them.

cara.320.a.reply.zh:
这是银河之星，行商组织的基石。我们的先祖曾在此宣誓，组建出 $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。

早先，$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的发展全都仰赖银河之星的神秘力量，而随着时间的推移，这种力量逐渐消散了。
cara.320.a.reply.en:
It is the Galatron. The cornerstone of the Caravaneers, the totem on which our forebears swore allegiance and formed the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

The success of the early $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ is traditionally ascribed to the formidable power of the Galatron, though the nature of this power has been lost to time.

cara.320.b.reply.zh:
这是银河之星！银河之星！

大概是吧。
cara.320.b.reply.en:
It is the Galatron! It Galatrons!

Presumably.

cara.320.c.en: What is it worth? Can it be sold?

cara.320.c.reply.zh:
此物是银河之星，无价之宝也。因星系之人皆沐光辉，黄白之物不能易之。

但谨记：常言道匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪。财货不能易，然刀兵可夺之。
cara.320.c.reply.en:
Its worth is immeasurable. No one will buy the Galatron from you, though all in the galaxy will rejoice in its light.

But be warned: tradition allows for it to be taken from the unworthy, in war.

cara.4000.desc.zh: 来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。
cara.4000.desc.en: Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mercantilism.

cara.4010.desc.zh: [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName]传来一条紧急消息，上面说有一批[caravan_pops_join_country.GetName]的原成员目前正打算在这颗星球上寻求政治庇护。当地管理部门决定上报这一情况，让更高阶的官员定夺。
cara.4010.desc.en: An urgent missive from [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName] explains that a number of now-former members of the [caravan_pops_join_country.GetName] seek political asylum on the planet. The local administration has seen fit to pass the decision of what to do with them up the chain of command.

cara.4020.c.zh: 把它拖到我们的恒星基地进行报废处理。
cara.4020.c.en: Tow it to the starbase for disposal.

cara.4020.desc.zh: 我们驻扎在[caravan_hulk_system.GetName]星系恒星基地的情报员报告说，[caravan_hulk_country.GetName]已经离去并遗弃了一艘破旧船只，现在位于中央恒星的不稳定轨道。
cara.4020.desc.en: Our starbase in the [caravan_hulk_system.GetName] system reports that the [caravan_hulk_country.GetName] fleet has evacuated and abandoned a decrepit ship, now in unstable orbit around the system's central star.

cara.4025.desc.zh: 大概因为是民用运输船的缘故，舰上的数据库并未按照报废规程进行完全清除。尽管在船上没有别的有价值的发现，我们的科学家仍设法获取了某种未知外星科技的部分资料。
cara.4025.desc.en: Likely due to the vessel being a civilian transport, the shipboard databases were not fully scrubbed as part of the decommissioning process. So while nothing else of value was found aboard the ship, our data scientists have managed to recover partial references to unknown alien technologies.

cara.4030.desc.zh: 今天在[disgruntled_planet.GetName]爆发了大规模抗议，由于这个星系中[xeno_fleet.GetName]的种种暴行。他们肮脏的存在侵犯到了所有有正义感的[disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
cara.4030.desc.en: Mass protests erupted on [disgruntled_planet.GetName] today, due to outrage over the [xeno_fleet.GetName] in the system. Their grubby presence offends all right-thinking [disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural].

cara.4040.desc.zh: 当[welcome_fleet.GetName]按照原计划进入[pleased_planet.GetName]轨道开展简短的参观的时候，一场自发的友好行动演变成了露天市场和派对，[pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]与[welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]之间建立起了许多羁绊，做成了很多买卖。
cara.4040.desc.en: As the [welcome_fleet.GetName] entered the orbit of [pleased_planet.GetName] for what should have been a brief courtesy visit today, a spontaneous outbreak of goodwill turned into a combination of open-air market and party. Many bonds between [pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] and [welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] were forged, and much trading took place.

cara.4041.desc.zh: 在[pleased_planet.GetName]与[party_host.GetNamePlural]共同待了几个月之后，有迹象表明他们之间的关系比预想的更加紧密了。他们想要留下来。
cara.4041.desc.en: In the months following the party with the [party_host.GetNamePlural] on [pleased_planet.GetName], evidence is mounting that some of the bonds formed were closer than expected. They have asked to stay.

cara.4050.desc.zh: 近期[stealing_fleet.GetName]参观[stolen_from_planet.GetName]之后，人们发现有一部分资源居然莫名其妙消失了。人们怀疑是被[stealing_fleet.GetName]给顺手牵羊了。
cara.4050.desc.en: After a recent visit of the [stealing_fleet.GetName] to [stolen_from_planet.GetName] it has been noticed that a number of resources are missing from the central reserve. It is suspected that the [stealing_fleet.GetName] somehow made off with them.

cara.4110.a.zh: 你都不让我们知道箱子里面有什么就打算让我们付钱？
cara.4110.a.en: You expect us to pay for this box with no idea of its contents?

cara.4110.d.response.zh: 我是收藏家。我经常委托行商舰队收集星系中的遗物。你只需要知道这些。
cara.4110.d.response.en: I am the Collector. I have long worked through the Caravaneer fleets to acquire the relics of the galaxy. That is all you need to know.

cara.4110.desc.zh: 你好。我是一个收藏家，在这向你提供一个千载难逢的机会。我有一个盒子要出售，盒子当中有什么我不会泄露，我也不会给你看。你可以用3000£energy£能量币来买，然后不管里面有什么都归你了，但是一旦出手概不退换。
cara.4110.desc.en: Greetings. I am The Collector and I offer you an opportunity. I have a box for sale, a box obtained through means I will not divulge and with a content I shall not reveal. You may purchase this box for £energy£ 3000 and keep whatever it contains, but I offer no refunds.

cara.4120.desc.zh: 经常光顾绰尔的罗盘使得[cara_border_planet.GetName]的很多人开始沉迷赌博。许多人为了筹钱继续赌下去而走上了犯罪的道路。
cara.4120.desc.en: Frequent visits to Chor's Compass have resulted in many people on [cara_border_planet.GetName] becoming addicted to gambling. Many have turned to crime in order to pay for repeated trips

cara.4130.desc.zh: [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName]来的大量[caravaneer_neighbor_species.GetName]观光客在[cara_border_planet.GetName]上演变成了一个巨大的派对。然而“派对”开着开着却出了问题，现在变成了一场全球暴动。
cara.4130.desc.en: A visit by a large number of [caravaneer_neighbor_species.GetName] from the [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName] has resulted in a massive party on [cara_border_planet.GetName]. Unfortunately, things have gotten out of hand and the "party" now resembles a planet-wide riot.

cara.4140.desc.zh: [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName]最近发布了一种全新的老虎机，这也使得[cara_border_planet.GetName]在游客的帮助下成功迎来了一次经济的突飞猛进。
cara.4140.desc.en: The [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName] recently revealed a new range of slot machines, and the increased traffic has caused an economic boom on [cara_border_planet.GetName] as visitors pass through.

cara.4150.desc.zh: 绰尔的罗盘是一个专门找刺激的地方。由于经常光顾的原因，[cara_border_planet.GetName]的公民们对于周遭事物的冷静已经到了一个前所未有的水平。
cara.4150.desc.en: Chor's Compass is a rowdy place which is not for the faint of heart. Due to frequent visits, the citizens of [cara_border_planet.GetName] have become accustomed to conditions there to an unprecedented level.

cara.4160.desc.zh: [cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞在月球上打出了一个洞，将它给完全摧毁了。
cara.4160.desc.en: [cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan punched a hole in the moon, destroying it utterly.

cara.4160.name.zh: 巨尸乐队音乐会：百万雄尸！

cara.4160.nomoon.desc.zh: [cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞把他的超级吉他重重地朝地上砸去，这导致了整个区域被完全破坏。
cara.4160.nomoon.desc.en: [cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan slammed its hyper-guitar into the stage with such force the entire area was destroyed.

cara.4161.desc.zh:
巨尸乐队是企业中最伟大的灵能金属乐队。传说那些形态迥异的乐队成员——科尔-阿赞，甘荃，人类，勇达尔，和塞可达瑞——互相之间通过虚境进行交流。

这是真的。

仅仅只有少数人知道，虚境是星河之声下辖的一个绝密的超声音乐研究部门的代号。星河之声在多元宇宙中引领着音乐潮流，同时也是声波武器制造商。巨尸乐队成立的初衷是作为灵能突击部队。他们会在棘手的“会场”进行“演奏”，通过将微弱的灵能攻击性抑制术埋藏在那些公然辱骂企业的歌词下进而影响听众，高效地暗中破坏叛乱行动。

最后，音乐对于乐队成员那已经十分强大的灵能的催化效果实在过于强大，以至于不能被管理者们控制。成员们分道扬镳，只剩空壳乐队名——因为星河之声不愿意撕毁一个无比赚钱的合约。如今巨尸乐队走到哪弹到哪，只要他们觉得合适，只要那是金属乐。
cara.4161.desc.en:
MegaCorpse is the greatest psionic-metal band in corporate space. It is said that the disparate bandmates -- Kel-Azaan, Gantren, Human, Yondar, and Scyldari -- made contact through the Shroud.

This is true.

Known only to a select few, the Shroud is the code-name of a top-secret sono-musical skunkworks division of Galactic Sounds, the leading music conglomerate and sonic weapons manufacturer in the multiverse. The MegaCorpse initiative was originally developed as a psionic strike force. They would "play" difficult "venues," effectively subverting rebellious movements with overtly anti-corporate lyrics disguising subtle psionic aggression-dampening measures inflicted on the listener.

Ultimately, the catalytic effects of their music on the band's already-potent psionic powers soon proved too much for managers and executives to control. The band went rogue in all but name - as Galactic Sounds were unwilling to break a fantastically profitable contract - and today MegaCorpse play whatever and wherever they see fit, as long as it is metal.

cara.910.desc.zh: 我们已消灭$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$之家——贸易空间站堂吉。这些贪婪害虫完蛋了！
cara.910.desc.en: We have crushed the profiteering vermin that called Tradestation Tungle home. The $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ is no more!

cara.920.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]已摧毁行商的贸易空间站。是否有幸存者躲过了大屠杀，我们无从得知。
cara.920.desc.en: The Caravaneer's tradestation has been destroyed by the [From.From.GetName]. We have been unable to confirm if any survivors escaped the slaughter.

cara.930.a.zh: 那个星系归你了，贸易之友。
cara.930.a.en: The system is yours, friends of commerce.

cara.930.b.zh: 该星系是战略要地，不能交给你们。
cara.930.b.en: The system is too strategically important to surrender.

cara.930.c.zh: 你们的幸存叫我们不爽。快滚。

cara.930.desc.zh:
喂喂？能听见吗？

太好了。你可听说所有行商的家园，贸易空间站堂吉，最近遭到了野蛮袭击？有些人就是讨厌商品和服务的自由流通！凶手以为我们已经死了，但如你所见，行商议会活下来了。

我们希望在[cara_home_new_location.GetName]星系内重新开展活动。当然了，严格来说，如此星系就不再属于你了，但我们会补偿损失的。
cara.930.desc.en:
Hello? Yes? Do you read?

Excellent. You may have heard that the home of all Caravaneers, Tradestation Tungle, was recently brutally attacked. Some people just hate the free movement of goods and services! Our assailants believe us dead, but the Caravansary Council survived, as you can see.

We wish to re-establish our operations in the [cara_home_new_location.GetName] system. The system would naturally no longer be yours, then, technically, but we would make it worth your while.

cara.940.b.reply.zh:
可惜，即便我们不能双赢，你却则刻意选择失败。

再见。
cara.940.b.reply.en:
That's a shame, but we can't all be winners! You, specifically, are choosing not to be a winner.

Goodbye.

cara.940.desc.zh: [caravaneer_home_country.GetName]在[cara_home_new_location.GetName]星系重建了贸易站，那里曾经是[From.GetAdj]的领地。
cara.940.desc.en: The [caravaneer_home_country.GetName] has reestablished its tradestation in the [cara_home_new_location.GetName] system, formerly a [From.GetAdj] territory.

cara.950.a.en: May its gentle light shine forever.

cara.950.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]认输了，无上的银河之星已经易居我手！
cara.950.desc.en: The [From.From.GetName] has admitted defeat, and we have wrested the glorious Galatron from their unworthy grasp!

cara.951.a.zh: 千言万语尽化作无声愤怒。

cara.951.desc.zh: 无视败者的癫狂咆哮，[From.GetAdj]军队接管银河之星的仪式不过平淡无奇。
cara.951.desc.en: Aside from numerous functionaries breaking down into hysterics during the handover, the surrendering of the Galatron to [From.GetAdj] forces was an uneventful affair.

cara.970.1.desc.zh: 生活与其说是一场竞赛，不如说是碰运气。
cara.970.1.desc.en: Life is more of a lottery than a competition.

cara.970.10.desc.en: Let the punishment fit the crime.

cara.970.2.desc.en: Sometimes buckets weigh more than they have to.

cara.970.3.desc.en: One sapient's garbage is another sapient's treasure.

cara.970.4.desc.zh: 不良能量币信贷总是会出现。
cara.970.4.desc.en: A bad energy credit always turns up.

cara.970.5.desc.zh: 闪光的未必都是暗物质。
cara.970.5.desc.en: All that glitters is not dark matter.

cara.970.6.desc.zh: 乞丐可不应该挑肥拣瘦。

cara.970.7.desc.zh: 不要苛求别人送来的泽珞是否纯净。
cara.970.7.desc.en: Never look a gift Zarkaluvian in the buccal cavity.

cara.970.9.desc.zh: 为溅出的泽珞哭泣是没有用的。
cara.970.9.desc.en: It's no use crying over spilt Zro.

cara1_fleet_must_be_within_borders.zh: 在[Root.GetName]边境内必然有一支[caravaneer_fleet1_country.GetName]的舰队。
cara1_fleet_must_be_within_borders.en: The [caravaneer_fleet1_country.GetName] must have a fleet within the [Root.GetName]'s borders.

cara2_fleet_must_be_within_borders.zh: 在[Root.GetName]边境内必然有一支[caravaneer_fleet2_country.GetName]的舰队。
cara2_fleet_must_be_within_borders.en: The [caravaneer_fleet2_country.GetName] must have a fleet within the [Root.GetName]'s borders.

cara3_fleet_must_be_within_borders.zh: 在[Root.GetName]边境内必然有一支[caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetName]的舰队。
cara3_fleet_must_be_within_borders.en: The [caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetName] must have a fleet within the [Root.GetName]'s borders.

cara_fleet1_deal.zh: 先给我们看看你打算用什么来交易。

cara_fleet1_dealtaken.zh: 很高兴和你做生意。记住了：有梦想就一定要实现它！
cara_fleet1_dealtaken.en: Pleasure doing business with you. And remember: don't dream it, be it!

cara_fleet2_deal.zh: 先给我们看看你打算用什么来交易。

cara_fleet2_dealtaken.zh: 祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你我之间的交易让我们离奴玛更近了。
cara_fleet2_dealtaken.en: Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for your business brings us closer to the goddess.

cara_fleet3_contact.title.zh: 行商舰队：拉奇工业公司
cara_fleet3_contact.title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Racket Industrial Enterprise

cara_fleet3_dealtaken.zh: 很高兴也很荣幸能够和[Root.GetName]做生意。我们会再来的！
cara_fleet3_dealtaken.en: A pleasure, a joy to deal with the [Root.GetName]. We will visit again!

cara_fleet3_take_deal.zh: 不错。我们接受你的提议。

cara_home_about_fleet1.reply.zh:
所有相关的行商舰队维持着亚空间通讯发明之前的传统。而我们$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$是个例外，所以所有呼叫都转移到了我们这边。

恐怕你得等[From.GetName]再次进入你们领地之后主动呼叫你。或者是在离开你们领地的时候，具体取决于你们之间的约定。

在你等待的时候，何不试试$slots$呢？
cara_home_about_fleet1.reply.en:
All affiliated caravan fleets uphold traditions predating the invention of subspace communications. We, here at $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$, are the exception, thus all calls are rerouted to us.

I'm afraid you'll have to wait for [From.GetName] to contact you when they enter your territory once again. Or depart it, depending on what you have agreed on.

Why not try your luck at the $slots$ while you wait?

cara_home_about_fleet3.en: We were trying to reach the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species_plural$...

cara_home_about_fleet3.reply.zh:
他们是不是很可爱？而且还很勇猛呢！咳咳。

$cara_home_about_fleet1.reply$
cara_home_about_fleet3.reply.en:
Adorable, aren't they? Intrepid, too! Ahem.

$cara_home_about_fleet1.reply$

cara_home_direct1.zh: $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$欢迎您光临$NAME_Chors_Compass$，这里是星际行商的起源地。您没有听错。
cara_home_direct1.en: The $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ welcomes you to $NAME_Chors_Compass$, ancestral home of disparate galactic caravans and gambling. You heard that right.

cara_home_direct2.zh: 欢迎来到$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$，这里是全宇宙最顶级的休闲场所，同时也是行商舰队的家园！
cara_home_direct2.en: Welcome to $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$, the galaxy's premier leisure palace and home base of the Caravaneer fleets!

cara_home_direct3.zh:
根据心理档案资料显示对成瘾性活动抵抗力弱的智慧生命一般都不推荐参与$slots$和$lootboxes$活动。

如果他们那么不喜欢享乐的话，那就这样吧！
cara_home_direct3.en:
Sapients with psychological profiles particularly vulnerable to addictive activities are advised to stay away from the $slots$ and $lootboxes$.

If they hate fun, that is!

cara_home_lootbox_buy_energy.zh: 我们想用能量购买一个$lootbox$。
cara_home_lootbox_buy_energy.en: We will buy a $lootbox$ using energy.

cara_home_lootbox_contents.reply.zh:
这个我们无法得知，只有买了的人才能知晓。

我们知道的是，这里面的东西曾经某个时候肯定有某种价值。虽然有证据表明$lootbox$里面的东西有可能是疯狂掮客故意放进去用过的垃圾……
cara_home_lootbox_contents.reply.en:
We are prohibited from knowing. That knowledge is for the buyer.

What we do know is that the contents were considered valuable at some point in Caravaneer history. Though there is also some evidence that the $lootbox$ containers may have been used for garbage disposal during the brief third reign of the Lunatic Broker...

cara_home_lootbox_explain.reply.zh:
这是一个很古老的故事了，但并不冗长。

最早一批行商聚在一起并且确立了[caravaneer_home_country.GetName]之后，每年经过这个贸易站的一小部分货物都会被封存起来，放入一个密封的容器里面，然后放在贸易站最底层的货舱中。这项传统从很久以前就一直流传到了现在，现在货舱被填满了。

那我们也该是时候出售这些$lootboxes$了。
cara_home_lootbox_explain.reply.en:
It is an old story, but not a long one.

When the caravans first came together and the [caravaneer_home_country.GetName] was established, it was decreed that a small, random portion of goods passing through this station every year was to be seized, placed in hermetically sealed containers, and stored in a cargo bay on the lowest level of the station. This custom has been upheld since time immemorial, and the cargo bay recently filled up.

It is now our duty to sell these sealed $lootboxes$.

cara_home_main.en: We had something else in mind...

cara_home_redirect1.zh: 我们是$NAME_Chors_Compass$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1$。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
cara_home_redirect1.en: This is the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ in $NAME_Chors_Compass$, speaking on behalf of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1$. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

cara_home_redirect2.zh: 我们是$NAME_Chors_Compass$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2$。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
cara_home_redirect2.en: This is the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ in $NAME_Chors_Compass$, speaking on behalf of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2$. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

cara_home_redirect3.zh: 我们是$NAME_Chors_Compass$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
cara_home_redirect3.en: This is the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ in $NAME_Chors_Compass$, speaking on behalf of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

carbon_allotropes_desc.zh: [from.GetName]的波谱信号表明行星上的一种成分富含某种稀有而复杂的碳同素异形体。为了更彻底的分类，需要更仔细的检查。
carbon_allotropes_desc.en: Spectroscopy data from [from.GetName] indicates a planetary composition rich in rare and complex carbon allotropes. Closer inspection is required for more thorough categorization.

caretaker_leader_desc.zh: 一台专司照顾他人的机器。过去的失败深深地印刻在其记忆库里。
caretaker_leader_desc.en: A machine specialized in caring for others. The failures of the past are embedded in its memory banks.

cargo_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 有一个小型货舱被遗落在了这颗气态巨行星的上方空间。它被行星的重力所捕获，最终将被拖入其大气。
cargo_gasgiant_category_desc.en: A small cargo pod has been left to drift in space above this gas giant. It has been captured by the planet's gravity well, and will eventually be pulled into its atmosphere.

catch_phrase_nomadic_caregiver.zh: 生命在延续，而当我们选择去关爱，它便会茁壮成长。
catch_phrase_nomadic_caregiver.en: Life endures, and when we choose to care, it thrives.

catch_phrase_nomadic_champion.zh: 一切最后都会被虚无吞噬的，所以趁现在就要狠狠地打，大声地笑！
catch_phrase_nomadic_champion.en: The void takes everything in time, so fight hard and laugh while you can!

catch_phrase_nomadic_naturalist.en: To study life, one must walk beside it.

catch_phrase_nomadic_princess.zh: 在无尽的星海深处，有一个声音正呼唤我回家。
catch_phrase_nomadic_princess.en: Somewhere in the endless sweep of stars, a voice is calling me home.

catch_phrase_nomadic_revenant.zh: 把屠夫们带到我面前，我将以十倍的残忍回报他们。
catch_phrase_nomadic_revenant.en: Show me the butchers, and I will return their cruelty tenfold.

catch_phrase_nomadic_sage.en: The one who carries nothing bears all things.

ccoinz1desc.zh: $ccoinz$是一种由行商货币委员会创造的高级货币。
ccoinz1desc.en: $ccoinz$ is a premium currency created by the Caravaneer Monetization Committee.

ccoinzwhat.reply.zh:
行商货币委员会确保与$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$之间的换兑体系，同时包括但不限于$slots$和$lootboxes$。

但大多数情况是指的$slots$和$lootboxes$。

$slots$只接受$ccoinz$，并且只能兑换$lootboxes$。
ccoinzwhat.reply.en:
The Caravaneer Monetization Committee ensures full compatibility with the services ecosystem aboard $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$, including, but not limited to, the $slots$ and $lootboxes$.

But mostly just the $slots$ and $lootboxes$.

$ccoinz$ are only accepted at the $slots$ and for $lootboxes$.

central.10.desc.zh:
你好，星系的年轻人。

我们这些来自天堂中心的人再次离开了我们的庇护所，去看看你们这些住在外围的人必须为我们提供什么。希望你不会像在你之前的人那样试图给国家带来恐怖。
central.10.desc.en:
Hail, you who are still young and new to the galaxy.

We who come from the paradise of the center have once more left our sanctuary to see what you who live on the outer circles have to offer. Hopefully, you will not try to bring terror upon the empire like those who came before you.

central.15.a.en: Did they just cut the feed?

central.20.1.desc.zh: 你们还有什么想和我们讨论的吗？
central.20.1.desc.en: What else did you want to discuss with us?

central.20.2.desc.zh: 你现在站在晶态帝国外环舰队指挥官、内陆之守护者的面前。有什么是你想与我们讨论的吗？
central.20.2.desc.en: You stand in front of the Commander of the Outer Circle Armada of the Crystalline Empire, Protector of the Inner Lands. What is it you wish to discuss with us?

central.20.a.zh: 能不能告诉我更多关于你们家园的事？
central.20.a.en: Could you tell us more about your homeland?

central.20.a.response.zh:
我们的家园如泡沫幻影，如果我们告诉你太多，将会给它带来末日。你们这些年轻的种族在被允许进入那座圣所之前还有很多需要学习的。

如果你们证明了自己的价值，有朝一日我们会将向你们揭示一切的真理。
central.20.a.response.en:
Our homeland is like a dream, and if we were to tell you much more about it, that would be the end of it. You younger races still have much to learn before you can be allowed into the sanctum.

One day, if you prove worthy, we will be able to show you the truth of everything.

central.20.b.response.zh:
我们长期以来观察着星系中的其他种族，并且我们在现在的邻居中看到了潜能。当我们收到信息，这些年轻种族中有一个就是我们在等待的那个，我们立刻就准备好了找到他们。

我们还不确定你们这些年轻种族中到底谁是我们正在寻找的，但是我们相信你们都有能力向我们证明自己。希望你们不要辜负我们的期望，而我们可以找到我们都能够接受的条件。
central.20.b.response.en:
We have long watched over the other races in the galaxy, and we see potential in our current neighbors. When the messenger arrived with news that one of the younger races was the one we had waited for, we immediately prepared to track them down.

We are not certain which one of you younger races is the one we are looking for, yet, but we believe all of you can prove useful for us. Hopefully you will be able to live up to the expectations we have for you, and we can find terms that both of us will be happy with.

central.20.c.zh: 有什么你们在找的，或者需要我们帮忙的吗？
central.20.c.en: Is there anything you are looking for, or need our help with?

central.20.c.response.zh: 没有，时机还没成熟。我们晚些时候再回来，希望那时我们向你能分享更多消息。
central.20.c.response.en: No, the time for that is not now. Come back later, and hopefully we will be able to share more news with you.

central.21.desc.zh: 再见，恐怖分子，我们和你们没有什么好谈的。
central.21.desc.en: Leave, terrorist, we have nothing more to say to you.

central.5.desc.zh: 一个强大的信号从通常被认为是没有生命的星系中心发出，传向星系。没过多久，我们又收到了来自同一地点的信号传输。
central.5.desc.en: A powerful signal is bounced through the galaxy from the center, a place often thought to be empty of life. Shortly afterwards, we received a transmission from the very same location.

central.5.name.en: Signal from the Center of the Galaxy

central.50.a.zh: 我们会试着为他们找到容身之所的。
central.50.a.en: We will try to find some place for them to stay.

central.50.a.tt.zh: 在加来的10年内，我们可以在一个居住站上发起$decision_crystalline_refugees$决议。
central.50.a.tt.en: For the next 10 years we will be able to enact the $decision_crystalline_refugees$ decision on a Habitat.

central.50.b.zh: 我们的国土内没有空间了。
central.50.b.en: There is no room in our lands.

central.50.desc.zh:
在我们社会中一些不守规矩的份子倡议在我们整个家园松绑一些规制，在首都造成了不小的骚乱。伟大的存在正计划把这些份子转移到外部世界，这样它们就不能对我们的边界和我们人民的和谐再构成任何威胁。

如果你们能接纳这些被流放者将会对我们有很大帮助。
central.50.desc.en:
Several unruly elements in our society are advocating for easing the restrictions on entering our homeland, causing quite a ruckus in the capital. The Great One is looking to move these elements into foreign lands, so they will no longer pose a threat to our borders or the harmony of our people.

If you would offer refuge for the displaced, that would be incredibly helpful to us.

central.51.a.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
central.51.a.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.

central.51.desc.zh:
很高兴听到这个消息。我希望他们可以在你们的国土上过得好，并成为你们帝国的佑护。

$central.quest.transmission.end$
central.51.desc.en:
That is good to hear. We hope they will thrive in your lands, and be a blessing for your empire.

$central.quest.transmission.end$

central.52.desc.zh:
我们很遗憾。那我们去别的地方为他们找容身之地了。

$central.quest.transmission.end$
central.52.desc.en:
We are sorry to hear that. We will look elsewhere for our people then.

$central.quest.transmission.end$

central.60.a.zh: 我们可以为你们的人民拨出一部分资源。
central.60.a.en: We will set aside some materials for your people.

central.60.a.tt.zh: 在加来的10年内，我们可以在一个居住站上发起$decision_crystalline_architecture$决议。
central.60.a.tt.en: For the next 10 years we will be able to enact the $decision_crystalline_architecture$ decision on a Habitat.

central.60.desc.zh:
我们最近在我们最大的城市之一发生了一长小型灾难，并迅速制造了难以言说的毁坏。为了将其修复如初，我们正寻找愿意向我们贡献材料的人，让我们开始重建工作。

当然，我们会慷慨地想愿意帮助我们的人支付酬劳。不仅如此，我们还可以派出一队工程师与你们的人民分享我们的一部分秘密。
central.60.desc.en:
We have recently seen a small calamity happen in one of our greatest cities, leaving untold destruction in its wake. To restore it to former glory, we are looking for people willing to send materials our way, so we can begin the reconstruction.

We will, of course, pay quite handsomely to anyone willing to help us out. Not only that, but we can send a team of engineers to share some of our secrets with your people.

central.61.desc.zh:
我们很高兴知道你们愿意提供帮助。你们的礼物可以帮助数以百万计的$NAME_Central_Crystal_Species$。

$central.quest.transmission.end$
central.61.desc.en:
We are happy to hear you are willing to help us out. Your gift will help millions of lost $NAME_Central_Crystal_Species$.

$central.quest.transmission.end$

central.62.desc.zh:
我们很遗憾你们不愿意提供帮助。我们只能再去其他地方寻找帮助了。

$central.quest.transmission.end$
central.62.desc.en:
We are sorry to hear that you are not willing to help us out. We will look elsewhere for help, then.

$central.quest.transmission.end$

central.70.a.zh: 我们对他们的位置有所打算了。
central.70.a.en: We have a position in mind for them.

central.70.b.en: There are no positions available for them.

central.70.desc.zh: 一位我们的首席科学官对你们的帝国产生了浓厚的兴趣，虽然很难说你们到底能提供什么我们帝国所没有的。但无论如何，他们希望能宜居你们国家并向你们中最杰出的人学习。
central.70.desc.en: One of our foremost scientists has taken a particular interest in your empire, though it is hard to say what you could offer that we of the Empire could not. In any case, they seek to move to your country and learn from your best.

central.71.desc.zh:
大好消息。希望他们可以对你们的帝国做出比在我们这更大的贡献。

$central.quest.transmission.end$
central.71.desc.en:
Great news. Hopefully they will prove to be more helpful for your empire than they were for ours.

$central.quest.transmission.end$

central.72.desc.zh:
那他们可得找点别的事情干了。

$central.quest.transmission.end$
central.72.desc.en:
They will simply have to find something else to occupy their mind then.

$central.quest.transmission.end$

champions_forge_trust_tt.en: We must earn the trust of the $RT_ETERNAL_CHAMPION$.

change_approach_will_temporarily_lock.zh: 采用该应对方案将锁定其他应对方案，持续$@voidworm_plague_approach_cooldown_years|0$年。
change_approach_will_temporarily_lock.en: Adopting this approach will lock other approaches for $@voidworm_plague_approach_cooldown_years|0$ years.

chrysanthemum_poi_1_desc.zh: 一个可能包含尤利西斯计划中继浮标的恒星系。对风信子号进行调查可能有助于更准确地定位信号来源。
chrysanthemum_poi_1_desc.en: A system that may contain a Ulysses Initiative relay buoy. Surveying it with the Hyacinth may yield a stronger fix on the signal's origin.

chrysanthemum_poi_2_desc.zh: 秋菊号方舟舰的殖民地建立于此。尤利西斯计划中继浮标记录了坐标，风信子号必须前往。
chrysanthemum_poi_2_desc.en: The Chrysanthemum colony was established here. The Ulysses Initiative relay buoy recorded the coordinates, Hyacinth must travel there.

chthonian_preservation_desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示这是一颗死亡行星，它曾经是气态巨行星，但大气层被[from.System.Star.GetName]强烈的辐射剥离了。

尽管如此，它的地表上还是探测到了非常痕量的生物质，需要进一步调查。
chthonian_preservation_desc.en:
Surveys of [from.GetName] reveal it to be a chthonian planet, a former gas giant stripped of its atmosphere by the intense radiation of [from.System.Star.GetName].

Despite this, very faint traces of biomass have been detected on its surface, warranting further investigation.

city_of_bones_desc.zh:
一个完全由不明骨头建造的原始城市废墟在经历这颗星球上的一场强力沙尘暴之后被发现。

我们的科学家渴望发掘这座可怕的古城。
city_of_bones_desc.en:
The ruins of a primeval city built entirely out of bones of an unknown origin have been unearthed following a violent sandstorm on this planet.

Our archaeologists are eager to begin excavation on this grisly ancient city.

city_of_bones_desc_uncol.zh:
这颗星球上发现了一个完全由不明骨头建造的原始城市废墟。

我们的科学家渴望发掘这座可怕的废墟。
city_of_bones_desc_uncol.en:
The ruins of a primeval city built entirely out of bones of an unknown origin have been found on this planet.

Our archaeologists are eager to begin excavation on these grisly ruins.

civic_tooltip_materialist.zh: 一定程度上偏向唯物主义

civic_tooltip_militarist.zh: 一定程度上偏向军国主义

civic_tooltip_pacifist.zh: 一定程度上偏向和平主义

civic_tooltip_spiritualist.zh: 一定程度上偏向唯心主义

civic_tooltip_xenophile.zh: 一定程度上偏向亲外主义

civic_tooltip_xenophobe.zh: 一定程度上偏向排外主义

clone_army_digsite_desc.zh:
当意识到我们的困境以后，对自我认同感和目的的缺失困扰着我们这个物种。我们大意地低估了这种负面影响，它使我们举步维艰，更别什么提团结一致了。我们挣扎着寻求共识，我们渴望答案。

于是我们建立了这个发掘遗址来寻找证据来结束关于我们物种诞生的争论，并且希望能找到一个坚实的基础使我们重新团结起来。
clone_army_digsite_desc.en:
Since awakening to our predicament, the absence of identity and purpose has plagued our species. We grossly underestimated the impact it would have on our ability to move forward, let alone cooperate. We struggle to reach an accord, and we hunger for answers.

This excavation site was established to seek evidence on the debated questions of our species' creation, and to find a foundational vantage point to help unite us.

clones.10.desc.zh:
在最近我们涉足太空的那一刻起，对我们起源的不同看法很快变成了一场大分裂。极端主义团体很快吸纳了更多的克隆人，我们牢固的联盟破裂了。

有些人将创造者视为要崇拜和遵从的神，并相信我们是按照祂们的形象创造的。他们坚决维持现状。其他人则诅咒我们先祖的行为，称他们为“奴隶贩子”，相信他们一定会遭到报应。

一个设立于[clone_digsite_planet.GetName]的发掘遗址将会验证真相，平息所有的争论。在我们将视线投向太空中之前，我们必须穷尽现有的全部可能性。我们的国家很古老，无数克隆人世世代代生活于此。在我们母星的远古建筑之下，一定存在明显的线索在等待着我们。
clones.10.desc.en:
With our recent arrival into space, the differing views on our origin are rapidly turning into a schism. Extremist groups are rapidly attracting more clones. Our strong unity is broken.

Some view the Creators as gods to be worshiped and obeyed, and believe we were made in their image. They would do nothing except maintain the status quo. Others curse our ancient masters for their actions, labeling them 'slavers,' and would see them repaid in full.

An excavation site has been established on [clone_digsite_planet.GetName] to verify the facts and put the debate to rest. Before we turn to space, we should exhaust all immediate possibilities. Our nation is old. Many generations of clones lived and died here. Beneath the ancient structures of our homeworld, some significant clues are bound to be waiting for us.

clones.11.desc.zh:
从一个核心发掘遗址中我们成功地确定了其中一座远古克隆仓的年代，通过分析建筑下方的土层结构，将其密度和组成与周围其他的土壤进行对比，从而可以得出这座建筑可靠的建立年代。

几乎可以确定，我们中的第一个，也就是第一个克隆人，是在大约距今12个世纪之前被制造出来的。

无数世代的历史都因漠不关心而被淡忘。即便到今日我们也已经错过了许多事情，也许其中就有值得我们现在惋惜的。
clones.11.desc.en:
A central dig site has managed to successfully date the installation of one of our Ancient Clone Vats by analyzing the soil beneath the structure - comparing its density and composition to that of its surroundings - and we have reached a reasonable estimate of when it was placed there.

It appears the first of our kind, the first clones, were produced approximately twelve centuries ago.

Many generations of history have been lost to apathy. Much has passed us by, and perhaps that is something to regret.

clones.12.desc.zh:
其中一个发掘遗址报告了一个最近发现的，长得像[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的化石。它非常古老。这些化石被发现在一处远古住所的附近。显然，那些化石和建筑都比远古克隆仓的建造要早上数百万年的时间。

初步的基因测序确认了这些化石的主人与我们在基因序列上的显著相似性，可以得出结论，这些遗留物属于我们的祖先，并且远早于我们开始被克隆的年代。

事情变得明朗起来
clones.12.desc.en:
One of the excavation sites has reported the discovery of old, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]-like fossils. Very old fossils. They were found in and around remnants of what is presumed to be primitive homesteads. Apparently, both the fossils and architecture predate the construction of our Ancient Clone Vats by more than a millennium.

Initial DNA sequencing has confirmed significant similarities between our genetic make-up and that of the fossilized matter, and it has been concluded that the remains belong to our ancient predecessors, from before we were clones.

This puts things into perspective.

clones.12.tooltip.zh: 这些发现仍需要一段时间的深入研究……
clones.12.tooltip.en: These findings will take a while to sink in...

clones.13.a.zh: 是的，我们就是创造者自己的克隆体。
clones.13.a.en: Yes, we were made in the image of the Creators.

clones.13.desc.zh:
发掘遗址传出证实我们的物种曾是 [Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的原始人的这一新闻很快就传播开了。

很难否认这一明显的结论：对像我们的先祖这样已经适应了战争的原始物种进行基因修饰是有明确的目的的。我们的创造者改造了我们，让我们为他们流血牺牲。他们将我们提升以满足他们的私欲，而完全不考虑我们的利益。

这真的是我们想要告诉人民的历史吗？

现在还有机会篡写我们自己的历史。
clones.13.desc.en:
News of the excavation findings, proving that our species was once a primitive people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], is beginning to spread.

It is difficult to deny the obvious conclusion: genetically modifying a primitive species such as our forebears - a species already suited to wage war - serves a specific purpose. Our Creators remade us to die for their cause. They uplifted us to fulfill their needs, never to prosper on our own terms.

Is this really the history we want for our people?

There is ample opportunity to rewrite our past.

clones.14.b.custom_tooltip.en: Offer a public apology to the [Root.Owner.GetAdjective] people.

clones.14.desc.zh:
数年前，考古发掘工作发现了我们被创造出来的意义。现实是残酷的：我们被创造出来的目的是被奴役，并为我们的创造者战死。我们选择向人民撒一个善意的谎言，以免他们被这一事实摧垮。

通过煞费苦心的恢复被删除的考古档案，一位克隆人颠覆性地公开了我们试图掩盖的事实。

这位尚未找到的告密者至少没有扭曲事实或者添油加醋。

嗨呀，看来再也没有必要冒着让人民对我们的领导失望的风险这么做，这条新闻很快就终结了我们关于辉煌过去编造的那条谎言：我们是创造者的克隆体，与创造者是平等的而非他们的奴隶。
clones.14.desc.en:
Years back, excavations were made to find the purpose of our creation. The learnings were hard: we were made to serve, to die in the name of our Creators. We chose to guard our people from that truth by giving them a better one.

By painstakingly recovering deleted files from those excavations, a subversive clone has made public knowledge of the facts we concealed.

The still-unknown culprit has, at least, not twisted the information or added to it in any way.

Alas, it appears there was no need to, as the news has swiftly ended the belief in our glorious past - that we were made in the image of the Creators, equals rather than slaves - and replaced it with a disappointment in leadership.

clones.15.desc.zh:
一条精心编辑的视频信息被公开，解释了编造故事背后的良苦用心。这份广播解释这个谎言是出于善意，但同时强调我们真实的过往并不可耻，我们应该更多地放眼未来。还不忘提醒散播这一善意的谎言也给大家带来过巨大的好处。

这条信息似乎非常能被公众接受，尽管很难说这个以外还会带来什么后续的负面影响。但无论如何，损失的影响力会随着时间平复，而这一事件也会逐渐平息。
clones.15.desc.en:
A carefully constructed video message has been sent out, explaining the reasons behind the manufactured story. The broadcast explains that it was meant as a kindness, emphasizing that there is no shame in our true past and that we must look to the future. Mention is also given to the significant advances we have made since propagating such false beliefs.

The message appears to have been well received, although it is hard to say what blemishes these incidents might leave behind. In any case, the influence lost will be recovered over time, and the issue has otherwise been laid to rest.

clones.16.desc.zh:
一众高阶军官最近出现在公众视野中，表达了对于我们主流思潮的支持。

在一段广为告知的信息中，他们对我们那种坦诚我们的过去，向[Root.GetAdjective]的人民及他们的信仰的勇气和智慧致敬。信仰因我们准备好面对过去而得到加强，并使其能够勇敢地面对未来。

各地的人们都在一致庆祝，称赞做出的决定。
clones.16.desc.en:
A number of high-ranking officers have taken it upon themselves to publicly acknowledge their approval of our leadership ethics.

In a widely broadcasted message, they salute the bravery and wisdom it took to be truthful about our past, and the faith shown in them and the [Root.GetAdjective] people. They are strengthened by our readiness to face the past and it has allowed them to face the future with courage.

People all over are celebrating in agreement, praising the decision that was made.

clones.20.desc.zh:
我们科学家不屈不挠的尝试下，远古克隆仓中的密码终于被攻破。尽管存在协议，极度的渴望驱仍使着科学专员去激活了他们得到的密码。

一个来自过去的回声出现在屏幕上……
clones.20.desc.en:
By the tenacity of our scientists, the cipher found within the Ancient Clone Vats has been decoded. Protocol notwithstanding, the overly eager lead science officer has activated the key it contained.

A message from the past echoes on the screen...

clones.21.desc.zh:
“我罪孽深重。我无法想象是怎么走到今天这地步的，不过肯定不是我同党们的仁慈。”

我为创造你们来服役效了力，为此我感到非常抱歉。我已经对事态的发展无力回天，不过我可以帮助你们开启未来。虽然你们值得有更多的选择，但我只有能力为你们指明两条道路：

理解你们被绝育的关键因素，然后获得演化和繁育的自由。

或者进一步解锁你们的潜质，但把基因困死于牢笼，让子子孙孙永远受限于克隆科技。
clones.21.desc.en:
"I am burdened by guilt. I cannot imagine what paths have led to this, but surely not the mercy of my brethren.

I helped create you to serve, and for that I am sorry. I cannot take back what is done, but I can help to open your future. Although you are deserving of more, I offer you two paths:

To undo the changes that made you sterile, and finally set you free to evolve and prosper.

To further unlock your potential, but strain your genes to their limits, sealing future generations to forever be dependent on technology for reproduction."

clones.22.desc.zh:
我们的繁育能力恢复了，第一批新的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]看到了这一天黎明的曙光。他们和他们的子孙将永远地改变整个种族的未来，我们的社会也要为之改变去适应变化。

对远古克隆仓的需求已经是过去式，已通过决议拆解所有的克隆仓以寻找是否有更多值得研究的东西，其余的则会被回收利用。
clones.22.desc.en:
Our fertility is reclaimed, and the first batch of the new [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has seen the light of the day. They will forever change our future with children of their own, forcing our society to change and adapt with them.

The need for the Ancient Clone Vats is past, and a decision has been made to strip them of anything that can be researched further. What is left will be recycled and put to use elsewhere.

clones.23.desc.zh:
我们何必拒绝唾手可得的力量？我们不需要对创造者的爱都能体会到他们选择我们的是多么明智。远古克隆仓也是强大的礼物。

当然要接受我们的力量，当第一批[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]准备就绪时，我们就会变得比以往任何时候更加强大。我们完美的种族定会繁荣昌盛。
clones.23.desc.en:
Why should we deny the strength we have been given? We need not love the Creators to recognize their wisdom in choosing us. The Ancient Clone Vats, too, are a powerful gift.

It is better to embrace our strength, and with the first batch of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] completed, we are stronger than ever before. Our perfected species shall prosper.

clones.4.desc.zh:
据信我们曾一度具有自由繁殖的能力。

然而，即便在我们母星上其他的生物上的实验有所进展，但让我们重获这项能力的实验此前从未成功。进展停滞了非常长的时间，直到现在。

一个不太可能的发现带给我们的科学家希望：一段隐藏在远古克隆仓中的量子生物编码中的密码处于一个据信用于调控我们基因组可育能力的区段。
clones.4.desc.en:
It is thought that we were once capable of independent reproduction.

However, experiments to reclaim that capability have consistently failed, including those successful on other creatures of our homeworld. Progress has for a long time been at a standstill, until now.

An unlikely discovery has our scientists hopeful: a cipher, hidden in the quantum bio-code of the Ancient Clone Vats, in an area believed to govern our genome's potential for procreation.

coerce_artifact.zh: 我们试图强迫[artifact_seller.GetName]将他们的先驱者文物交给我们。
coerce_artifact.en: We attempt to coerce the [artifact_seller.GetName] into giving us their Precursor artifact.

collision_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 这颗小行星最近被小行星带里的一颗行星撞击了。其表面留下了一个巨大的撞击坑，同时轨道也有所偏离。
collision_asteroid_category_desc.en: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.

colony.1.a.en: We need to find a solution.

colony.1.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]表面覆盖有茂盛的植被，巨大的树形植物生长至数百米高。殖民者发现几乎所有的这些植物都有不同程度的迁移能力。森林会缓慢的向养分更充足的区域移动，迁移的周期似乎与[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的运行周期有关。不幸的是，殖民地的基础建设工程会受到极大的阻碍。迁移的植物们会切断供能线路，摧毁建筑和道路。
colony.1.desc.en:
The surface of [Root.GetName] is covered in lush forests, with massive tree analogues rising hundreds of meters into the air. Interestingly, our colonists have found that nearly all of the flora is mobile to various degrees. Forests stretching for miles will slowly migrate to new areas richer in nutrients in a cycle that seems tied to the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s orbit.

Unfortunately, this has seriously hampered our efforts to develop the colony's infrastructure. The migrating trees frequently cut power lines while smashing our buildings and roads into rubble.

colony.10.desc.zh: 和[Root.GetName]的漫游植物毗邻而居，我们学到了很多知识。某些大胆的殖民者甚至把家建在大棵植株的顶端，随着它们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]境内四处漂流。[Root.Owner.GetName]最顶尖的生物学家在此研究这些独一无二的植物。
colony.10.desc.en: We have learned a great deal by living in proximity of the wandering forests on [Root.GetName]. Some enterprising colonists have even built homes in the treetops of some of the larger specimens, following the forests around as they migrate across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Some of the foremost biologists in the [Root.Owner.GetName] have spent time studying these unique trees.

colony.100.desc.zh: 自殖民[Root.GetName]以来，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈异象不断。生态系统十分不稳定，而且生物的进化程度也不符合范式。科学家猜测是有外部的干扰，而猜测已被证实！几个殖民者发现了庞大的地下改造装置，应该有数千年的历史了。装置在改造进程中就失去了动力，使得[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈处于未完成的现状。只要提供足够的能源，应该就能重启装置。但谁也不知道会发生什么……
colony.100.desc.en:
Since our initial settlement of [Root.GetName], several anomalies in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s biosphere have been discovered. The ecosystem is unstable and has not developed according to projected models for a world of this type. Our scientists suspect outside tampering, and these suspicions have now been confirmed!

A few of our colonists have stumbled upon a large underground terraforming complex that was built thousands of years ago. The equipment was apparently deactivated in the middle of the terraforming process, leaving the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s biosphere in its current unfinished state. If we supply enough power, we should be able to reactivate the machinery. There is no telling what the end result will be like, however...

colony.10000.b.zh: 无聊的猜测。回去工作吧。

colony.10000.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的边远农业站上发回了报告。许多[Owner.GetFarmerPlural]无缘无故失踪了，除了周围的土壤上留下了巨大的脚印外，他们的家园没有受到任何影响。

这些痕迹不符合任何在此前行星调查中发现的东西：四足、宽趾、有爪的脚印，其深度足以说明来自一种相当大的生物。殖民者担心我们可能遇到了未知的捕食者。
colony.10000.desc.en:
Reports have come in from our outlying agricultural stations on [Root.GetName]. Several [Owner.GetFarmerPlural] have vanished without a trace, their homesteads eerily undisturbed, save for the appearance of immense footprints in the surrounding soil.

The tracks are unlike anything examined in the planetary survey, quadrupedal, broad-toed with claws, and deep enough to suggest a creature of considerable mass. The colonists worry that we may be dealing with some unknown predator.

colony.10005.desc.zh:
深入荒野的探险艰苦卓绝，但最终我们获得了累累硕果。经过数日追踪那生物的踪迹，我们的团队抵达了一处满目疮痍的现场：巨兽的尸体——摆在我们眼前的是厚重的几丁质外骨骼、棘刺状的脊椎隆起，以及末端带弯曲毒刺的分节尾巴。尸身上布满多处贯穿伤。

在其后方，仪器探测到一座被高效伪装的光藓藤蔓遮蔽的古老花园，里面满是缠绕常春藤的大理石柱，光滑的黑曜石小径。团队谨慎前行，直至瞥见花园的守护者——一个举止优雅的类人种族，肌肤泛着微光。尽管景象祥和，那些发光的花藤却构成了有效屏障。我们必须穿透这层闪烁的遮蔽，才能接近生活在屏障彼端的存在。
colony.10005.desc.en:
The expedition into the wilderness proved taxing, but ultimately fruitful. After days of following the creature's trail, our team arrived at a site of devastation: the corpse of the beast displays a heavily chitinous exoskeleton, thorned spinal ridges, and a segmented tail ending in a single curved stinger. The body is perforated by multiple punctures. 

Beyond it, concealed beneath a highly effective cloaking canopy of bioluminescent vines, our instruments detect an ancient garden. Marble columns entwined with ivy, smooth obsidian paths. Our team approached carefully until we caught a glimpse of the garden's caretakers: a humanoid species, elegant in bearing, their skin subtly luminous. Despite the harmonious appearance, the flowers and vines offered an effective veil. We would need to penetrate this glinting cover in order to approach the ones who lived beyond.

colony.10010.b.en: Violence is a part of life.

colony.10010.desc.zh:
事件发生的频率已经升级。这一次，那些足迹不再只是从农舍旁经过，而是径直撕裂了房屋。整栋建筑都以骇人的力量被扯碎。挣扎的痕迹表明受害者是被活捉的，而且并未束手就擒。

殖民者们不再只是感到不安，而是陷入了恐慌。已有数户人家放弃了自己的土地，逃往殖民地的中心地带。
colony.10010.desc.en:
The frequency of the incidents has escalated. This time, the footprints did not merely pass by the homesteads; they tore straight through them. Entire structures have been ripped apart with alarming force. Traces of struggle suggest the victims were taken alive and did not go quietly.

The colonists are no longer merely unsettled; they are terrified. Several families have already abandoned their holdings for the colony center.

colony.10015.a.answer.zh: 我们的花庭代表着永恒的繁荣。我们的文化引以为傲的是，它并非以武器或暴力统治为定义，而是以和谐为定义，而和谐是通过我们每个人内心的相互理解和善意来实现的。在鲜花之庭中，传统不是旧日的残余，而是我们的法则。与我们分享你们的故事、歌曲和作物，便能一窥我们的生活方式，通过彼此理解进行交流。
colony.10015.a.answer.en: We are the court of eternal bloom and prosperity. Our culture prides itself by not being defined by weapon or dominion, but by harmony, achieved through mutual understanding and kindheartedness within every single one of us. In the Court of Blossoms, tradition is not a remnant, but our law. To share our stories, songs, and crops with us is to have a glimpse at our way of living in a mutual exchange of understanding.

colony.10015.a.question.en: What is the Court of Blossoms?

colony.10015.b.zh: 我们来此地是为了建立殖民地。
colony.10015.b.en: We are here to establish a colony.

colony.10015.b.answer.zh: 你遇到的生物，大守护者，曾经是我们的保护者。但随着时间推移，它被内部的疫病吞噬，一种寄生在它大脑内的神经型虫草菌株播下了祸根，掏空了它的思想，腐化了它的目的。我们结束了它的痛苦，并非出于愤怒，而是出于悲痛。它不是外来的野兽，而是我们的一部分。
colony.10015.b.answer.en: The creature you encountered, the great guardian, was once our protector. But in time, it was consumed by a blight from within, seeded by a neural-cordyceps strain nested inside its brain, hollowing its mind and corrupted its purpose. We ended its suffering not in anger, but in grief. It was not an alien beast, but a part of us.

colony.10015.b.question.zh: 你能告诉我们关于那个怪物的一些信息吗？
colony.10015.b.question.en: What can you tell us about the monster?

colony.10015.c.answer.zh: 你们或许会觉得我们的行事之道很奇怪。仪式、庆典、吟唱，与会思考和梦想的植物共生。但请理解：与我们共存并非无偿给予。那些拒绝学习的人将会承担后果。这是我们的提议。既非臣服，亦非控制，而是相互理解和接纳。如果你愿意接受这样的提议，那我们庆贺。这正是我们所定义的，我们族群之间和谐相处的纯粹本质。如果你们选择与我们同行，你们将不会孤身一人。
colony.10015.c.answer.en: You may find our ways strange. Rituals, ceremonies, chants, symbiosis with flora that thinks and dreams. But understand this: coexistence with us is not granted freely. Those who refuse to learn will experience consequences. This is our offer. It is neither submission nor control, but mutual understanding and acceptance. Celebration, if you will. It is the purest essence of what we define as harmony among our folk. Should you walk that path with us, you will not walk alone.

colony.10015.c.question.zh: 你们想从我们这里得到什么？
colony.10015.c.question.en: What do you want from us?

colony.10015.desc.zh: 我以花庭之名，欢迎各位旅者。我是坦佩里翁国王，或者像我的族人所称呼的“金心者”，我并非以武力统治，而是通过先辈遗训和仪式来执掌权柄。我既是这个世界的守护者，也是我的人民——阿纳萨里——的引路人。听到你们自己的语言是否感到惊讶？不必害怕。自从你们决定将[Root.GetName]视为你们的家园以来，我们一直在研究你们。你们的人民一定非常强大，才能穿透我们的屏障。我们很荣幸能与你们相见。
colony.10015.desc.en: I welcome you, travelers, in the name of the Court of Blossoms. I am King Tamperion, or as my kinship calls me, the 'Goldenhearted', sovereign not by rule of force, but by legacy and ritual. I serve as custodian of the this world and shepherd of my people, the Anathari. Are you alarmed to hear your own language? Never fear. We have been studying you ever since you decided to call [Root.GetName] your home. You must be a powerful people indeed, if you have managed to penetrate our cloak. We are honored to meet you.

colony.10016.desc.zh: 谨代表鲜花之庭全员，衷心感谢您的合作。请放心，您先前派遣来的人员，我们将其视作贵客，使其宾至如归。绝不会让他们有任何需求上的短缺。
colony.10016.desc.en: On behalf of the entire Court of Blossoms, I extend our sincere gratitude for your cooperation. Rest assured, the one you send to us will be welcomed as one of our own, and there shall be nothing they want for.

colony.10017.a.zh: 我们必须为接下来任何可能发生的情况做好准备。
colony.10017.a.en: We will prepare ourselves for whatever follows.

colony.10017.desc.zh: 既如此，随你便吧。你已做了决定，我们亦然。我已尽了我的劝告之责，现在你必须承担你选择的后果。
colony.10017.desc.en: So be it. Your decision is made, and so is ours. I have offered my counsel, yet now you must bear the fruits of your choice.

colony.10020.desc.zh:
毫无预兆。坦佩里翁国王从花园的中心现身，身上披着由活体藤蔓和发光花朵编织而成的仪式盔甲。他沿着殖民地边缘，每一步都走得缓慢而庄重，整个世界也在苏醒。藤蔓从土壤中蜿蜒而出，花瓣如刀锋般绽放。空气中弥漫着金色的花粉，细微而闪耀。它渗透进通风口和肺部。几个小时之内，它夺走了许多人的生命，引发癫痫、疯狂，最终导致死亡。

最终，依靠殖民地的自动化防御系统的介入才将他击倒。坦佩里翁国王一言不发地倒下了；目击者说他最后的目光中没有仇恨，只有深深的、庄严的失望。

我们侦察兵发现，曾经的鲜花之庭所在之处，只剩下了森林。仿佛这个王国已经把自己折叠回了土壤之中，带走了它的秘密和它的悲伤。
colony.10020.desc.en:
There was no warning. King Tamperion emerged from the heart of the gardens, draped in ceremonial armor spun from living vines and bioluminescent blossoms. With each deliberate step along the colony's edge, the world itself awakened. Vines slithered from the soil, while petals unfurled like blades. The air grew thick with a golden pollen, fine and luminescent. It seeped into vents and lungs. Within hours, it had claimed the life of many, inducing seizures, madness, and finally, death.

Only the intervention of automated colony defenses eventually brought him down. King Tamperion fell without a word; witnesses say his final gaze held not hatred, but a deep and solemn disappointment.

Where the Court of Blossoms once was, our scouts found only forest. It is as though the kingdom had folded itself back into the soil, taking its secrets and its sorrow with it.

colony.10025.desc.zh:
我们全身心投入了阿纳萨里的怀抱。我们参与他们的仪式并与他们独特的礼仪相协调，模式出现了，意义下也扎了根。

在以长寿周期和繁育为重点的夜间公众仪式中，阿纳萨里开始揭示被压抑的历史片段。他们谈到一种古老而持久的枯萎病，它不但曾经笼罩着这个星球，而且现在仍然威胁着阿纳萨里。
colony.10025.desc.en:
We immersed ourselves in the ways of the Anathari. As we participated in ceremonial rites and attuned with their peculiar rituals, patterns emerged while meaning took root.

During shared nocturnal ceremonies focused on longevity cycles and fertility, the Anathari began to reveal fragments of suppressed history. The folk spoke of an ancient and enduring blight that once blanketed the planet and still has control over the Anathari now.

colony.10026.a.zh: 我们必须阻止永朽之暗
colony.10026.a.en: We must stop this Dark Immortal.

colony.10026.a.answer.zh: 远在历史的根系之下，一个叫做“永朽之暗”的实体破土而出，它的力量无源又无束。我们起先以为它没有恶意，所以就打开了大门，邀请它加入我们的互惠交换中。但它一进入我们的家门，就向我们释放出了全部的力量，把我们全部都奴役了。我们的内心正在渐渐腐朽，慢慢地，我们将会枯萎。
colony.10026.a.answer.en: From beneath the roots of history rose an entity we call 'The Dark Immortal', a force neither born nor bound. We believed it came in peace at first, so we opened our doors to it, inviting it in for mutual exchange. But once inside our borders, it unleashed its full power on us, enslaving us in an instant. Now we are rotting from within. Slowly, we are withering away.

colony.10026.a.question.en: Who or what disturbed this balance?

colony.10026.b.zh: 我们可不能相信这个什么国王。
colony.10026.b.en: We can't trust this so-called king.

colony.10026.b.answer.zh: 你们[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]身上有一种我们早已遗失的坚强，一种不受我们历史约束的活力。所以我以这一位遗民而非君主的身份向你请求帮助？这个存在的来源随着每一个周期的流逝而增长，我不确定阿纳萨里还能抵御这种枯萎多长时间。
colony.10026.b.answer.en: You, [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], carry a strength we have long since lost. A vitality unbound by our history. And so I ask not as a sovereign, but as a remnant of all that once was, will you help us? The source of this presence grows with each passing cycle, and I am unsure how long the Anathari can still endure this blight.

colony.10026.b.question.zh: 我们在其中扮演何种角色？
colony.10026.b.question.en: What part do we play in this?

colony.10026.c.answer.zh:
必须直面永朽之暗。很久以前，曾有一位勇者尝试过，但她失败了。在弥留之际，她仍扯下了它魂魄的一部分。也许你们可以将其解码，并在[Root.GetName]上找到它的原主。你们的科技应该已经足以识破它的伪装。

我们的存活只能寄希望于团结。记住：一旦失败，面临终结的可不仅仅是我们阿纳萨里和你们的殖民地。如果不加以约束，它甚至可能会吞没整颗行星。
colony.10026.c.answer.en:
The Dark Immortal must be faced. Long ago, a great hero tried and perished. Yet in dying, she tore away a fragment of its essence. Perhaps you can decipher it and locate its counterpart somewhere on [Root.GetName]. Your technology may be strong enough to break its cloaking.

Only united can we hope to survive. Know this: failure means more than the fall of the Anathari, or the end of your colony. If left unchecked, this presence could devour the planet itself.

colony.10026.c.question.zh: 你们需要而我们怎么做？
colony.10026.c.question.en: What do you need us to do?
