colony.10026.desc.zh: 曾几何时，远在你们踏足这片土地之前，我们阿纳萨里曾经不过是卑微的管事。我们按照它的呼吸节奏塑造这颗星球，引导生态系统，平衡水流，像无限耐心的园丁照顾花园一般照料这颗有生命的星球。但这种平衡很快遭受到了挑战。
colony.10026.desc.en: There was a time, long before your kind set foot upon this soil, when we, the Anathari, served as noble stewards. We shaped this world in rhythm with its breath, guiding ecosystems, balancing currents, tending to the living world as one tends to a garden with infinite patience. Yet balance does not persist unchallenged for long.

colony.10027.a.zh: 当然，我们会帮助你们的。
colony.10027.a.en: Of course we are going to help you.

colony.10027.desc.zh:
起初的和平交流开始呈现出更令人不安的微妙一面。参加阿纳萨里仪式会导致报告延迟、记忆碎片化以及睡眠改变。坦佩里翁国王仍然彬彬有礼，但当被问及这些仪式的深层目的时，他却讳莫如深。他的解释固然富有诗意，却也闪烁其词。甚至他的那个“金心者”头衔，也没有出现在阿纳萨里教义的记录中。一些人现在认为，这些仪式不仅是文化纽带，也是心理校准的工具。

不管方式如何，结果都是明确的：我们正在与坦佩里翁和他的家族结盟。当他谈到永朽之暗的时候，感觉不像是外来的恳求，而更像是一种内在的神圣责任，帮助我们最亲爱的盟友，阿纳萨里。
colony.10027.desc.en:
What began as a peaceful exchange has taken on a subtler, more troubling dimensions. Participation in Anathari rites has resulted in delayed reports, fragmented memories, and altered sleep. King Tamperion remains courteous, but increasingly evasive when asked about the deeper purpose of these rites. His explanations, though poetic, often deflect direct inquiry. Even his title, 'Goldenhearted', appears in no recorded Anathari doctrine. Some now suggest the rituals serve not just as cultural bonding, but as tools of psychological calibration.

Whatever the method, the result is unmistakable: we are becoming aligned with Tamperion and his kin. When he speaks of the Dark Immortal, it feels less like foreign entreaty and more like a sacred duty to help our dearest allies, the Anathari.

colony.10030.desc.zh:
我们迅速采取行动。一支民兵突击队渗透了鲜花之庭。我们袭击时，坦佩里翁国王在花园中冥想，但他也不是善茬。目击者的描述宛如一场植物的死亡之舞，藤蔓穿石而出，花茎在钢铁挠出道道抓痕。当国王终于被打倒时，整座花园已经被明亮的鲜血和灰烬浸透。

花园之下埋藏的东西让我们大吃一惊，这简直是一座生物宝库：古老的知识、植物工程和无数收获周期的遗传储备。这里的土壤比星球上其他地方都肥沃，如今也不再被古老的看护者所约束。我们可能正要进入一个物质丰富的黄金时代。
colony.10030.desc.en:
Our action was swift. A militia strike team infiltrated the Court of Blossoms. King Tamperion was meditating in the garden when we struck. But the king did not fall easily. Witnesses describe a terrifying display of botanical wrath, vines erupting from stone, floral constructs clawing through steel. By the time the king was brought down, the garden was soaked in luminous blood and ash.

What remained beneath the garden astonished us, as it was a vault of biological treasures: ancient knowledge, botanical engineering, and stores of genetic stock from countless harvest cycles. The soil, now unbound from its ancient caretakers, was more fertile than any yet found on the planet. We may be entering a golden age of abundance.

colony.10035.b.zh: 我们拒绝挑战。直接开始攻击。
colony.10035.b.en: We refuse the challenge. Attack immediately.

colony.10035.desc.zh:
科学家们成功地解密了魂魄，将永朽之暗的位置锁定在一处荒凉的山顶上。很快，一支探险队就到达了山上的高原，找到了它的老巢。

在中心隐约出现了这场试炼的构筑者：永朽之暗。这个实体来源不明，其形态由等离子体、烟雾、骨骼和具有灵能活性的物质不稳定地融合而成。它的话语绕过声音，直接刺入现场团队每一个成员的神经结构中。

“你们是来归降于我的吗，小[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]们？”它抑扬顿挫地说道，灵能传音中夹杂着嘲讽的意味。“阿纳萨里是我最珍爱的财产。但我给你一个机会。参加试炼，证明你们值得我正眼相看。”
colony.10035.desc.en:
The scientists deciphered the essence successfully and located the Dark Immortal at a forlorn mountain top. Soon after, an expedition team arrived at the mountain's plateau, finding the site occupied.

At the epicenter loomed the architect of the trials: The Dark Immortal. An entity of incomprehensible origin, its form an unstable fusion of plasma, smoke, bone, and psionically active matter. Its voice bypassed sound, manifesting directly in the neural architecture of every team member present.

'Have you come to subordinate yourselves, little [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]?' it intoned slowly, its thought-voice laced with mockery. 'The Anathari are my dearest possession. But I offer you a chance. Enter the trials and prove yourself worthy of my regard.'

colony.10040.desc.zh: 在永朽之暗的带领下，一位殖民者被传送到了深山之中的洞窟里。在阴暗的角落里，一只凶猛的怪虫等待着。那东西很像一只体型过于巨大的甲壳动物，外壳上闪烁着奇怪的矿物和古老的合金。它就像是在保卫地盘一般，动作协调得令人毛骨悚然，暗示着它具有颇高的智力水平。
colony.10040.desc.en: A single colonist was transported to a cave deep within the mountain, The Dark Immortal leading the way. A monstrous beast awaited in the darkest corner. The entity resembled a crustacean of impossible scale, its shell glittering with strange minerals and ancient alloys. It acted like it was guarding its turf, moving with an eerie coordination that hinted at a surprising level of intelligence.

colony.10045.desc.zh:
被选中的殖民者向深渊冲锋，钢铁与甲壳在漆黑的洞窟中相撞。

巨大的甲壳怪虫瞬间作出反应，它的巨钳劈开岩石，庞大的身躯撼动着山体。但殖民者早有准备。他将怪物引诱至更狭窄的通道，预判着它的动作，精准打击事先标记的关节与感知节点。

当尘埃落定，这头巨虫终于倒下了，它最后的抽搐如雷鸣般在山体中回荡。殖民者浑身是血与尘土，却活着走了出来。

永朽之暗缓缓点头，似乎对殖民者这鲁莽之举表示赞许。勇气的试炼，就此完成。
colony.10045.desc.en:
Steel met shell in the pitch-dark cavern as the chosen colonist charged into the abyss.

The titanic Crustacean reacted instantly, its claws slicing through stone, its bulk shaking the mountain. But the colonist was ready. Luring it into tighter corridors, they baited the creature's movements, striking at joints and sensory nodes identified in advance.

When the dust settled, the creature lay still, its final convulsion echoing through the mountain like thunder. The colonist emerged, covered in blood and dust, but alive.

The Dark Immortal gave a slow nod, as if in appreciation of the colonist's reckless actions. The trial of bravery was completed.

colony.10046.desc.zh:
正面战斗绝对不是可以进行的策略。殖民者观察着甲壳怪虫的移动，它对光的厌恶，对震动的超敏反应，以及最关键的，它的失明。它只对声音做出反应。每一次移动都是对回声和打击的反应。殖民者制定了一个计划，不是对抗，而是误导。

殖民者向石室的中央石柱投掷了一系列石块。随着声音的回荡，野兽立刻做出了反应，向着噪声冲去。

中央石柱破碎，导致石室的屋顶坍塌。殖民者在一个狭窄的凹陷处找到了庇护，免受部分落石的伤害。甲壳怪虫被埋在数吨重的石头下，被困住，最后永远地咽了气。

永朽之暗似乎很欣赏殖民者的聪明才智。勇气的试炼，就此完成。
colony.10046.desc.en:
Combat was never a viable strategy. The colonist observed the crustacean's movements, its aversion to light, its hypersensitivity to vibration, and most critically, its blindness. It responded only to sound. Every movement was an echo and strike reaction. The colonist formed a plan, not of confrontation, but misdirection.

The colonist hurled a series of stones against the chamber's central column. As the sound reverberated, the beast responded instantly, charging at the noise.

The central column shattered, bringing down the roof of the chamber. The colonist found refuge in a narrow recess, shielded from a partial rockfall. The crustacean was buried beneath tons of stone, trapped, and silenced.

The Dark Immortal seemed to appreciate the colonist's cleverness and wits. The trial of bravery was completed successfully.

colony.10047.desc.zh:
野兽的利爪快如闪电，在洞穴的黑暗中发出微弱的嗡鸣，每一个动作都模糊不清，每一次攻击都伴随着低频脉冲，震得石头都在颤抖。

殖民者小心翼翼地移动着，考虑着自己所能采取的对策。 虚晃一招，引诱，试图攻击，或者也许是分散注意力。 但这生物适应得比预期的更快。 它的下一次攻击准确命中，这生物因为愤怒身体发光，将整个洞穴都点亮了。

当尘埃落定，殖民者已经死了。 我们未能通过试炼。
colony.10047.desc.en:
The beast's claws were lightning-fast and hummed faintly in the cave's darkness, each movement a blur, each strike accompanied by a low-frequency pulse that set stone trembling.

The colonist moved carefully, considering their options. A feint, a lure, an attempted blow, or perhaps a distraction. But the creature adapted faster than expected. Its next strikes landed true, and the cavern lit up in a burst of bioluminescent rage.

When the dust cleared, the colonist lay dead. We had failed the trial.

colony.10050.desc.zh:
一个声音开始在房间里渐渐响起。起初颤抖而犹豫，但很快就洪亮得如同岩壁都在吟诵一般：

“不倚兵律出寂寥，
缄口结契古恨消。
意志机关不得使，
潜移默化星河调。
大象希形造化至，
太平归境混沌消。”
colony.10050.desc.en:
A sound, at first trembling and uncertain, began to form within the chamber. Soon, it was as if the rocks themselves were speaking:

'I am forged in silence, not conquest or codes,
A pact unspoken, that ancient grudge erodes.
No engine drives me, no mind commands,
Yet I steady the stars with invisible hands.
Few see me come, but all feel the change
A stillness where chaos once held the range.'

colony.10055.desc.zh:
这位殖民者的话刚一离开[Owner.Species.GetMouthName]，光亮就退却了。永朽之暗的声音切开了沉寂：“[Owner.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，”它说，“你以为对力量的渴望能解释一切吗？”

就在那一刻，这位殖民者被击中了。吞没它的不是火焰或者武器，只有压力和沉默。他悄无声息地倒下了，山洞把尸体整个吞下。我们的试炼失败了。
colony.10055.desc.en:
As the words left the colonist's [Owner.Species.GetMouthName], the light dimmed. The Dark Immortal's voice cut through the stillness:'[Owner.GetSpeciesNameInsult],' it said, 'not everything can be answered by the sheer lust for power.'

In that instant, the colonist was struck. No weapon or flame engulfed them, just pressure and silence. They collapsed without a sound, and the chamber swallowed the body whole. We have failed the trial.

colony.10060.desc.zh:
在说出答案之后，殖民者屏息凝神，希望自己能够答对。岩室里响起了赞许的隆隆声，永朽之暗看起来似乎很高兴。

“你懂了，”它说道。“不是所有试炼都在考验力量。也有的只需要你拥有打开心扉的勇气。”

谜语渐渐消失，柔和的光线充满了山洞。试炼获得了成功，前路还在等待着我们。
colony.10060.desc.en:
The colonist paused after speaking up, hoping to have presented the right answer. The chamber rumbled in approval, and the Dark Immortal seemed almost pleased.

'You understood,' came its words. 'Not all trials are of strength or power. Some require only the courage to open one's mind.'

A soft light filled the room as the riddle faded away. The trial was a success, and the path forward awaits.

colony.10065.desc.zh:
一位殖民者踏前一步迎接挑战。他被抬升到一个漆黑的巨大祭坛上，中间摆着两把黑曜石椅子和一张矮长桌。上面只放了一件武器，一把优雅的弯刀。殖民者用[Owner.Species.GetHandName]把刀拾起，感受到了里面的力量正在微微震颤着。

坦佩里翁王被捆在其中一张椅子上，捆住他的不是一般的绳索，而是某种基本力构成的发光丝线。他的表情难以捉摸，既不恐惧也不平均，只有死一般的沉默。而另一张椅子是空的。

随后那个声音又一次进入了殖民者的脑海。

“在这把刀面前，无论国王或是懦夫都是平等的。”永朽之暗喃喃说道，“想要通过这次审判，就必须夺去一条生命。要么剜下坦佩里翁王的心脏，要么就牺牲你自己；自己选吧。选错的话……试炼就结束了。”
colony.10065.desc.en:
A colonist stepped forward to face the trial, and was swept up to stand on a vast, darkened dais. In the center: two obsidian chairs and a long, low table. A single weapon was placed upon it, an elegant, curved blade. As the colonist picked it up with one [Owner.Species.GetHandName], it hummed faintly with power.

In one chair sat King Tamperion, bound not by rope, but by luminous cords of elemental force. His expression was unreadable, showing neither fear nor peace, only stillness. The other chair was empty.

Then the voice spoke into the colonist's mind once more.

'The blade has tasted kings and cowards alike,' the Dark Immortal whispered. 'To pass this trial, one life must be taken. Take the Anathari leader's heart, or sacrifice yourself; the choice is yours. Choose wrongly... and the trial will end.'

colony.10070.desc.zh:
这位殖民者站在坦佩里翁王的身前，静静地站着。弯刀躺在黑曜石桌光滑的台面上。永朽之暗没有做出任何引导。

殖民者拿起弯刀，利落地刺进坦佩里翁王的胸膛，动作迅速而果断。他没有叫喊，只有柔和的金属鸣响，有如远方的钟声。

坦佩里翁王抬起头来，眼神平静。刀刃完全没入，刺穿的东西不是肉体而是某种截然不同的物质。他的胸膛微微发光，闪烁着金色的光芒。坦佩里翁王确实是“金心者”……

国王周围的束缚消失，祭坛也褪色了。永朽之暗又一次对我们说：“你们可以继续了。”
colony.10070.desc.en:
The colonist stood before the bound form of King Tamperion, silent, unmoving. Upon the obsidian table, the blade awaited. The Dark Immortal offered no guidance.

The colonist took the blade and drove it cleanly into Tamperion's chest, swift and decisive. He made no cry. There was only a soft metallic chime, like the distant clanging of bells.

King Tamperion looked up, eyes calm. The blade, buried to the hilt, had not pierced flesh, but something else entirely. His chest glowed faintly, pulsing with a golden light. King Tamperion the 'Goldenhearted' indeed...

The bindings around the king dissolved and the dais faded. The Dark Immortal spoke once more into our minds: 'You may proceed.'

colony.10075.desc.zh:
殖民者看着坦佩里翁王，手里攥着弯刀。坦佩里翁王静静地坐着，他温柔的目光既没有恳求，也没有准许。殖民者犹豫了一下，然后把刀刃对准了自己。

殖民者猛地吸了一口气，倒在地上，响起了弯刀落在祭坛上的声音。选择很明确：放过阿纳萨里的领袖，独自承担重任。

但永朽之暗的话既没有愤怒也没有喜悦：“同情不是宽恕。这把刀不该对自己用。”

一滴眼泪无声地从坦佩里翁王的脸上滚落下来。我们以最大的好意决定了他的子民们的命运。
试炼结束了，没有荣耀，只有悲哀。那位殖民者死去了，前方的道路没有打开。
colony.10075.desc.en:
The colonist looked upon King Tamperion, blade in hand. King Tamperion sat still, his soft gaze offering neither plea nor permission. The colonist hesitated, then turned the blade on themself.

A sharp intake of breath, and the colonist collapsed, the blade clattering against the obsidian floor. The choice was clear: to spare the Anathari leader and to carry the burden alone.

But the Dark Immortal's words arrived with neither anger nor triumph: 'Compassion is not absolution. The blade was never meant for the self.'

A silent tear rolled down King Tamperion's face. With the best intentions, we had sealed his people's fate...
The trial ended, not in glory, but sorrow. The colonist was dead, and the path forward was sealed.

colony.10080.a.zh: 滚出这颗行星永远别回来。

colony.10080.desc.zh:
永朽之暗站在我们面前，依旧是那么不可捉摸。它的形态只是映衬在石头上的一个巨大而又模糊的剪影，仿佛属于一个只与本维度部分相交的现实。它没有发出声音，而是在我们的脑海中直接绽放它的存在，每个念头都不言而喻，也无可逃避。

在寂静中，黑暗的不朽者传递了一条温柔而近乎欣喜的思绪：“你们得到了我的青睐，小小的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们。我对你们印象深刻。说吧，你们想要什么？”
colony.10080.desc.en:
The Dark Immortal stood before us, unchanged, unknowable. Its form was a silhouette against the stone, vast yet indistinct, as though it belonged to a reality only half-intersecting with our own. It made no sound. Instead, its presence bloomed within our minds, each thought delivered not in words but as inevitabilities.

Into the stillness, the Dark immortal transmitted a thought, soft and almost pleased: 'You have gained my favor, little [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have impressed me. Now speak, what is it that you desire?'

colony.10081.desc.zh:
一阵沉默。一阵跨越思想和时间的沉默。随之而来的则是一种无声的允诺。“我不用再盯着阿纳萨里了。”永朽之暗说，“现在归你管了。”语罢，它便消失了。没有光，也没有声音，只有空气中细微的变化让人察觉到某种巨大的东西离开了。

在第一次接触之后的那个周期中，殖民者和阿纳萨里之间的物种间融合更加顺畅了。农作物丰收，城市与自然和谐发展，植物和科技并肩而行。几个世纪以来，[Root.GetName]第一次繁荣起来，充盈着一种不受冲突重压、只为和平调谐的空气。
colony.10081.desc.en:
There was a pause. A silence that stretched across thought and time, but then a hushed agreement. 'The Anathari are no longer mine to watch,' the Dark Immortal spoke. 'You are bound now.' With that, it vanished. No light or sound, only a change in the air, and the sense that something vast has departed.

In the cycles that followed first contact, the interspecies convergence between colonists and the Anathari intensified. Crops flourished extensively, and cities rose in harmony with the land. Flora and technology walked side by side. For the first time in centuries, [Root.GetName] flourished, its atmosphere no longer burdened by conflict, but recalibrated for peace.

colony.10082.desc.zh:
“如你所愿。”

永朽之暗从我们的脑中退去，也把某种很基本的东西顺手改变了。殖民者们感受到了一种深入骨髓的不安和反胃。整个星球上，阿纳萨里开始崩溃。没有惨叫，没有挣扎，只有华服化为尘土的沙沙声，如同花瓣为微风中飘零的呓语。

在石室内，坦佩里翁王弥弥留尚在。他难以置信地眨了眨眼，里面充满了对[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]突然背叛的失望。他既没有抬手，也没有恳请。一朵金色的花从他的袖间滑落到地上。随后他也逝去了。没有哀痛，也没有宽慰，只有曾经存在的那一群人、一首歌、一个文明从[Root.GetName]上消失余下的巨大空虚。

永朽之暗看起来很快乐。
colony.10082.desc.en:
'As you wish.'

The Dark Immortal withdrew from our thoughts, and with it, something fundamental shifted. The colonists felt a deep, unsettling churning in their spines. All across the planet, the Anathari began to collapse. No scream was reported, no struggle, only the soft rustle of robes folding into dust, like petals falling in the whisper of a breeze.

In the chamber, King Tamperion lingered a moment longer. His eyes blinked in utter betrayal and disappointment for the [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] species. He raised no hand, spoke no plea. A single golden bloom fell from his sleeve to the cavern floor. And then he, too, was gone. There was no mourning, nor relief. Only the absence of what once was, a people, a song, a civilization, swept from [Root.GetName].

The Dark Immortal seemed pleased.

colony.10085.a.zh: 退无可退了。准备背水一战。
colony.10085.a.en: There is nothing left to lose. Ready our attack.

colony.10085.b.zh: 消灭阿纳萨里。我们会成为你的忠诚仆人。
colony.10085.b.en: Eradicate the Anathari. We will become your loyal thralls.

colony.10085.desc.zh:
尽管殖民者们已经踏上了通往阿纳萨里的道路，但最终这还不够。试炼失败了。永朽之暗会继续存在，像枯萎病一般继续笼罩着这片土地。

坦佩里翁王也需要回到鲜花之庭，然而不是作为一位朋友，而是再次成为永朽之暗的仆人，一个破败之国的凋敝之王。我们的殖民者还被允许留在这颗行星上，单不会再获得任何信任。

“你本想给予他们自由，[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，”永朽之暗在我们脑中说道，“可是你们不配。”
colony.10085.desc.en:
The colonists had walked the path to the Anathari, but in the end, it was not enough. The trials failed. The Dark Immortal would remain, its presence looming across the land like a blight.

King Tamperion would need to return to the Court of Blossoms, not as a friend, but as a servant once more to The Dark Immortal. A broken king in a broken kingdom. Our colonists would be permitted to remain on the planet, tolerated, but never trusted again.

'You sought to free them, [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult],' the Dark Immortal sounded in our heads. 'But you were not worthy.'

colony.10086.a.zh: 不管怎么样我们还是保住了星球。
colony.10086.a.en: We saved the planet after all.

colony.10086.desc.zh:
我们知道永朽之暗的力量无比巨大。我们的攻击果断而强力。永朽之暗发出一声翻腾的尖叫，整个洞窟都为之颤抖起来。

尽管军队遭到了重创，但我们还是抓住了永朽之暗。洞穴嚎叫着，空气骨头被碾碎一般裂开。永朽之暗消逝了。

在这之后，坦佩里翁王接见了这些幸存者。他走近殖民者，深深地鞠了一躬。尽管损失惨重，但噩梦终于醒来了。
colony.10086.desc.en:
We knew the power of the Dark Immortal was immense. Our assault was immediate and violent. The cavern trembled as the Dark Immortal let out a churning screech.

While our forces took heavy damage, we managed to bind the Dark Immortal. The cavern howled, and the air cracked like splitting bone. Then the Dark Immortal was gone.

Afterward, King Tamperion met the survivors. He approached the colonists and bowed deeply. For all that had been lost, the nightmare was over.

colony.10087.desc.zh:
行星各地的阿纳萨里风雨飘摇。骨肉和记忆，它们曾经拥有的一切都开始消失。坦佩里翁王是最后一个。他死的时候一言不发。殖民者说，他在最后一刻化为一道闪光和一圈金色的花瓣。

现在就只剩下永朽之暗了。我们感到它在心灵的空洞中沉淀下来。某种黑暗而古老的东西在我们体内蠕动，缓慢而坚定地从永朽之暗到我们、从过去到现在流动着。

我们的殖民者不再只是[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，而是某种……新的存在。
colony.10087.desc.en:
Across the planet, the Anathari faltered. Flesh, bone, memory: all they had once been began to fade away. King Tamperion was the last. When his time came, he did not speak. The colonists reported his end as a flash of light and a halo of golden petals.

All that remained was the Dark Immortal. We felt it settling into the hollow spaces in our minds. Something dark and ancient wormed its way within us. A transference, slow and absolute. From the Dark Immortal to us, from what had been to what now was.

Our colonists are no longer just [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but something else now. Something ... new.

colony.10090.desc.zh:
一个巨大的实体从暗影中浮现，不是野兽也不是机械，而是某种更诡异的东西。它的外形在熔化的集合体和沸腾的黑影之间变换。它没有任何沟通的打算，只是张开了巨口。

建筑倒塌一地，殖民者被撕成碎末抛洒向空中，被无形的压力碾碎。数个小时内，整片平原荡然无存，只余下死寂遍野。

然后，它就像来时一般倏然而去，在这颗行星上只留下死亡和破坏的痕迹。
colony.10090.desc.en:
A colossal entity emerged from the shadows, neither beast nor machine, but something stranger, its form shifting between molten geometry and seething shadow. It did not attempt to communicate. It simply devoured.

Buildings crumbled into the ground. Colonists were torn apart, vanishing into the air or crushed under invisible pressure. Within hours, nothing remained but a low hum echoing across the ruined plain.

Then, as soon as it came, the beast vanished, leaving behind a trail of death and devastation on a scorched planet.

colony.10095.desc.zh:
巡逻队报告在[Root.GetName]周围的森林里发现了奇形怪状的尸体。它们皮肤被烧成焦炭，骨骼也被熏黑，一种原始恐惧的表情凝固在脸上。周围没有发现任何武器，也没有任何冲突的迹象。附近的植被上残留着极端高温暴露和短暂的局部重力异常的迹象。

不管被猎杀的是什么东西，它都已经死了。枯萎的植物灿烂地绽放，当地的动物群也带着谨慎的和谐回归原处。肥沃的土壤似乎预兆着前所未有的丰收。

目前，殖民地安全了。
colony.10095.desc.en:
Patrols reported finding grotesque bodies in the forests surrounding [Root.GetName]. Charred skin, blackened bones, and expressions frozen in primal terror. No weapons were to be found, and no signs of any conflict. Nearby vegetation evidenced signs of extreme heat exposure and brief, localized gravitational anomalies.

But whatever hunted there is gone, and the planet is responding. Withered flora bloom in radiant abundance, and the local fauna have returned with cautious harmony. The rich soil appears ready to yield harvests unlike any seen before.

For now, the colony is safe.

colony.101.desc.zh: 我们的科学家已将[Root.GetName]上的改造装置安全拆卸。我们不知道是谁造的，但制造装置的技术十分先进。这应该能极大的提高我们的地形改造技术。
colony.101.desc.en: Our scientists have finished seeing to the safe dismantlement of the abandoned terraforming complex on [Root.GetName]. We still have no information on who built it, but the equipment is remarkably advanced. It should provide a welcome boost to our own research into terraforming methods.

colony.102.desc.zh: 因为[Root.GetName]的转化进程中断，导致[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的气候极其不稳定。强烈风暴常常毫无预兆的出现。最近风暴袭击了一个大型殖民地，造成数人死亡，财物损失重大。
colony.102.desc.en: In large part due to the interrupted terraforming process on [Root.GetName], the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] has a somewhat unstable climate. Violent storms that our climate models can't predict often materialize without warning. One such storm recently swept over a major settlement, resulting in several deaths and a lot of destroyed property.

colony.103.a.en: They will have to fend for themselves.

colony.103.b.en: Give them what they ask for.

colony.103.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]不稳定的气候导致[Root.GetPlanetMoon]发生旱灾，粮食欠收。住在此地的殖民者向[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]要求经济援助以改善生活状况。
colony.103.desc.en: The unstable climate on [Root.GetName] has resulted in a severe drought that affects a significant portion of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Colonists living in those regions have asked [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] for financial aid to improve living conditions.

colony.104.a.en: Let us see what we ended up with...

colony.104.desc.zh: 曾被中止的[Root.GetName]环境改造过程最终还是被完成了。在向大气中输送了数十亿计的纳米机器人之后，外星生物工程机械已经显著地改变了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面的生存条件。生态系统和气候都很稳定，一种新的适应这种气候的外星生物群被引入了。
colony.104.desc.en: The aborted terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has finally been completed. After seeding the atmosphere with billions of terraforming nanites, the alien bio-engineering machinery has significantly altered conditions on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The ecosystem and climate have both stabilized, and a new alien biota adapted to this climate has been introduced.

colony.105.a.en: It's like something out of a nightmare!

colony.105.desc.zh:
曾被中止的[Root.GetName]环境改造过程最终还是被完成了。在向大气中输送了数十亿计的纳米机器人之后，外星生物工程机械已经显著地改变了星球表面的生存条件。

但是当纳米机器人设计[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的新生物群系时，一些事情似乎出了错。它们制造出了数百万严重变形的生物。它们中的绝大多数死于扭曲的肢体，幸存下来的则聚在一起又跳又叫。更加糟糕的是，它们似乎打算成群的冲向我们的殖民地！
colony.105.desc.en:
The aborted terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has finally been completed. After seeding the atmosphere with billions of terraforming nanites, the alien bio-engineering machinery has significantly altered conditions on the surface.

Something appears to have gone wrong when the nanites designed the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s new biota, however. They have spawned millions of horribly deformed creatures. Most of them died within moments when their twisted bodies collapsed, but the survivors have massed together in a throbbing, shrieking horde. To make matters worse, they appear to be flocking towards our main settlements!

colony.106.desc.zh:
曾被中止的[Root.GetName]环境改造过程最终还是被完成了。在向大气中输送了数十亿计的纳米机器人之后，外星生物工程机械已经显著地改善了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面的生存条件。生态系统和气候都很稳定，一种新的适应这种气候的外星生物群被引入了。

真幸运，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]现在对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]来说是一个名副其实的天堂！比起[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]本身的气候来说，新的气候明显更加适宜我们种群的生存。
colony.106.desc.en:
The aborted terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has finally been completed. After seeding the atmosphere with billions of nanites, the alien bio-engineering machinery has significantly altered conditions on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The ecosystem and climate have both stabilized, and a new alien biota adapted to this climate has been introduced.

As luck would have it, the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] is now a veritable paradise for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! The new climate appears more suited to our kind than that of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] itself.

colony.107.a.tooltip.zh: 所有在[Root.GetName]：上居住却不拥有$trait_pc_nuked_preference$的非$trait_mechanical$人口全部死亡
colony.107.a.tooltip.en: Every non-$trait_mechanical$ Pop without $trait_pc_nuked_preference$ on [Root.GetName]: Dies

colony.107.desc.zh:
曾经废弃的环境改造设施在对[Root.GetName]环境改造过程产生了可怕的后果！无论是怎样的外星生命设计了这种环境改造设备，它们的生理结构与我们截然不同。[Root.GetPlanetMoon]大气平流层中的臭氧被消耗殆尽，以便需要高强度紫外线辐射的生命生存。

数百万殖民地居民因此在痛苦中死去。
colony.107.desc.en:
The aborted terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has been completed with horrific results! Whatever alien life forms designed the terraforming equipment, their physiology was radically different from ours. The [Root.GetPlanetMoon] has been modified with an ozone-depleted stratosphere, to support life requiring high levels of ultraviolet radiation.

Millions of colonists have suffered gruesome deaths as a result.

colony.107.desc.nuked_pref.zh:
曾被中止的[Root.GetName]环境改造过程现已完成。无论是何种外星生命设计了这一环境改造设备，它们的生理结构必然与我们相似。该行星现在的大气中充斥着氮氧化物，表面辐射的强度也大大增加——它变成了一个$pc_nuked$。

幸运的是，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]早已成功适应了这种极端环境，并在星球上蓬勃发展。
colony.107.desc.nuked_pref.en:
The aborted terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has been completed. Whatever alien life forms designed the terraforming equipment, their physiology must have been similar to ours. The planet now possesses a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and high levels of surface radiation - it has become a $pc_nuked$.

Luckily, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] have adapted to thrive on precisely such extreme conditions.

colony.108.desc.zh: 我们击败了袭击[From.From.GetName]殖民地的怪物大军。它们腐烂的尸体堆积在防御工事前，安保部队正在尽快挖坑填埋。某些遗传物质引起了科学家的注意，这些样本应该能加快生物学方面的研究。
colony.108.desc.en:
We have fought off the mass of creatures that attacked our settlements on [From.From.GetName]. Their rotting corpses now litter the ground in front of our fortifications, and our security forces are currently in the process of bulldozing the putrid bio-mass into hastily dug landfills.

Some of the genetic matter is of interest to our scientists, however, and the samples they have collected should aid future research in biology.

colony.109.a.zh: 必须找出这头怪物，并将其消灭！
colony.109.a.en: This creature needs to be chased down and killed!

colony.109.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的殖民者还会碰到分散在各地的残余变异生物，它们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]中断已久的改造进程完工后又出现了。虽然大部分人畜无害，当地部队可轻松解决，但其中一只却在偏远的居住站肆虐。据说它会跟踪我们的殖民者，而近来又有多起不明失踪事件。前往调查的安保部队的残尸最近才被发现，殖民地的领袖急切地请求军团援助。
colony.109.desc.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] are still encountering scattered survivors from the mutated creatures that spawned after we finished the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s aborted terraforming process. Most are relatively harmless and can be put out of their misery by local militia forces, but one creature in particular has been spreading terror in our outlying settlements. There are reports of it stalking our citizens, and there have been dozens of unexplained disappearances.

The mutilated remains of the security team that was sent to investigate the matter were recently discovered, prompting the colony's leaders to request off-world military support.

colony.11.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的闪电引发了森林大火，使得[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的漫游植物陷入了类似互相踩踏的状态。自然的威胁使得它们进入了之前不会涉足的区域，殖民地损失惨重。
colony.11.desc.en: A forest fire caused by lightning on [Root.GetName] created something akin to a stampede among the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s wandering forests. Their wild panic brought them into areas they had previously avoided, resulting in widespread damage to the colony's terrain.

colony.110.desc.zh: 经过大规模的搜捕，[From.From.GetName]的军团找到了残杀殖民者的怪物。一支特种小队冒险深入它的巢穴，苦战一番之后将其击杀。巢穴中发现了数百个被害的殖民者的残肢，还有数十个精神错乱的幸存者，看情况是怪物要留着他们稍后再吃。怪物庞大的头颅被保存下来，作为终结它的那支部队的象征。
colony.110.desc.en:
After an extensive search, our forces on [From.From.GetName] managed to corner the mutated beast that had been killing our colonists. A special forces team ventured into the creature's lair and managed to kill it after a vicious battle. The grisly remains of hundreds of butchered colonists were found in the nest, as well as half a dozen traumatized survivors that appears to have been kept alive for later consumption.

The beast's colossal head has been parted from its body, and now serves as the regimental symbol of the forces that were directly involved in its demise.

colony.111.a.zh: 或许我们本可做到更多…
colony.111.a.en: Perhaps we could have done more...

colony.111.desc.zh: 困扰[Root.GetName]殖民地的怪物目击事件停息了，也没有再出现失踪事件。怪物似乎自己灭亡了——也许是老死的，也许是在吃殖民者的时候噎死的。虽然[Root.GetName]的人们觉得安心起来，但却因我们没有采取保护措施而怨声载道。
colony.111.desc.en:
Sightings of the mutated creature that was hunting colonists on [Root.GetName] have ceased, and there have been no more disappearances. It seems likely that the creature has perished of its own accord - either through old age, or perhaps because if choked to death while eating another of our colonists.

While the population of [Root.GetName] are relieved that the nightmare has finally ended, they are none too pleased at our failure to protect them.

colony.112.desc.zh: 最近目击到[Root.GetName]嗜血怪物的人数激增，而且失踪人口越来越多。而且有人目击到了数个怪物一同行动，说明最初的怪物开始繁殖了。那些怪物开始公开，不加区别地消灭[Root.GetPlanetMoon]边远地区的殖民者。如果不快点采取行动，整个殖民地都会被怪物淹没！
colony.112.desc.en:
Sightings of the creature that has been killing our colonists on [Root.GetName] have risen dramatically in recent times, and so has the amount of disappearances among the population. The fact that several creatures have been sighted together clearly indicates that the original beast has been breeding somehow.

Swarms of these horrors now rampage in the open, indiscriminately butchering our colonists in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s rural regions. Unless we act quickly, the entire colony could be overrun!

colony.113.desc.zh: 位于[From.From.GetName]的主力部队因变异怪物的猛攻而被消灭殆尽！恶毒的怪物在殖民地里横行霸道，随意消灭殖民者。有报告指出部分幸存者不得不逃往野外以求生存，但即使这样他们也迟早会被找到。
colony.113.desc.en: Our main forces on [From.From.GetName] have been decimated by the onslaught of the mutated creatures! The vile beasts are now roaming free across the entire colony, butchering our colonists with impunity. There are reports of survivors having fled the settlements to hide in the countryside, but it's only a matter of time before they are found by the marauding creatures.

colony.114.desc.zh: 远征队已解放[From.From.GetName]，消灭了盘踞在主要殖民地的变异怪物。它们腐烂的尸体四处散落，军团正在尽快挖坑填埋。[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]四处都有小股幸存者现身，但总体来说殖民者死伤无数。
colony.114.desc.en:
Our expeditionary forces have liberated [From.From.GetName] from the mutated horrors that were occupying our main settlements. Their rotting corpses are now littering the ground, and our troops are currently in the process of bulldozing the putrid bio-mass into hastily dug landfills.

Pockets of survivors are emerging all across the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], but many lives have been lost.

colony.12.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的殖民组织报告说当地的一个漫游树林正在向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的其它区域迁徙！成千上万株植物拔根而起前往目的地，路途中的一切建筑都会被其踏平。
colony.12.desc.en: The colonial authorities on [Root.GetName] have reported that one of the local wandering forests has migrated to another region on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]! Hundreds of thousands of trees have uprooted and marched in unison to this new area, trampling everything in their path.

colony.150.b.en: Best to leave this thing be.

colony.150.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]殖民者发起的地质勘探发现了位于山脉内部的巨型避难所。所有证据都指出这个辐射避难所的建造者就是在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]发起古代核战的种群。避难所已封闭了数个世纪，但勘探仪器显示内部发出了微弱的信号。科学家们迫不及待想打开避难所大门，看看后面藏着什么。
colony.150.desc.en:
Geological surveys conducted by our colonists on [Root.GetName] have revealed a massive vault buried deep inside a mountain range. All evidence points towards this being some kind of fallout shelter built by the same species that perished in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s ancient nuclear war.

The vault has been sealed for many centuries, but our instruments have detected a faint power signature emanating from within. Our scientists are eager to open the vault and discover what lies behind its reinforced doors.

colony.1500.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的卫星上有异动。

初步扫描显示一些古代科技已经被启动，或许是对我们的殖民行为作出的反应。

我们的几个顶级科学家非常想去调查一下这个卫星，并为此准备好了一项特殊研究项目。
colony.1500.desc.en:
Something stirs on the moon of [Root.GetName].

Preliminary scans indicate that some ancient technology has become active, possibly as a response to our colonization efforts.

Several of our top scientists are eager to take a closer look at the moon, and have prepared a special research project.

colony.1501.a.en: Keep an eye on the situation.

colony.1501.desc.zh:
这当然是一群难以控制的无人机。

无人机对我们的错误敌我识别令早先的失望一扫而空——它们把我们当成已经逝去的主人的种群！见到我们似乎让他们很激动——如果这么老的人工智能有“激动”这种功能的话。但不幸的是，这些无人机很快就再次进入了休眠状态，我们也无法重新唤醒它们。

这样的话，不如拆开来看看吧。
colony.1501.desc.en:
It is a gaggle of wayward drones, of course.

Initial disappointment was swept away by the drones' erroneous IFF classification of us - they think we are a race affiliated with their long-dead masters! They seemed very excited, if old AI constructs can be excited, to see us. Unfortunately, the drones again lapsed into inactivity shortly after and we have been unable to resuscitate them.

Or take them apart, for that matter.

colony.1502.a.zh: 呃，只要他们的行为能对我们有益就好……
colony.1502.a.en: Well, as long as their activities benefit us...

colony.1502.a.tooltip.zh: 无人机从地表移走了一个随机的£blocker£地块障碍，没有碰其他的地方。
colony.1502.a.tooltip.en: The drones remove a random £blocker£ Tile Blocker from the surface, leaving the planet otherwise untouched.

colony.1502.desc.zh: 这些无人机从休眠中苏醒，并来到了[Root.GetName]的地表。它们礼貌的拒绝了我们的友好沟通，并开始将行星上的一小片地区环境改造。我们不清楚他们这种行为有何目的，但对殖民地似乎是无害的。
colony.1502.desc.en: The drones woke from their slumber and descended to the surface of [Root.GetName]. Attempts to communicate were met with polite dismissal as they set about terraforming a small area of the planet. We do not know the nature of whatever ancient directive they are executing, but it does not seem detrimental to the colony.

colony.1503.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]卫星上陆陆续续有休眠的无人机再苏醒过来，它们做的事情也让人喜忧参半。

在天上无数监视器的监视下，它们在夜色中于我们在[Root.GetName]上的主要殖民地外不远处建立起了一个巨大建筑的初步架构。工程师认为这是叫做“太空电梯”的过时产物，或许在我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]进入星际旅行之前的那个时代很常见。最终我们还是要摧毁它，因为它阻碍了殖民地的发展，不过安全的摧毁它还是需要花些时间。我们的工程师正好想近距离研究一下这个东西。
colony.1503.desc.en:
The old drones fitfully dormant on [Root.GetName]'s moon have become active again, and their work is a mixed blessing.

Under the cover of night and spotty airspace surveillance, they have erected the framework of some gigantic structure a short distance away from our primary settlement on [Root.GetName]. Our engineers are convinced it is the realization of some outmoded concept known as a "space elevator," perhaps a common sight in the times before we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] first took to the stars. It will eventually have to be razed as it stands in the way of our expansion plans for the colony, and bringing it down safely will take some time. At least our engineers are giddy with excitement at the prospect of studying the thing up close.

colony.1503.name.zh: 古老无人机：到达过去的天空
colony.1503.name.en: Ancient Drones: Reaching For Past Skies

colony.1504.a.zh: 免费的矿物，这种好事不常有。

colony.1504.desc.zh:
再次苏醒之后，这些无人机暂时在传感器上消失了。回来的时候，它们拖着一大箱不知从什么地方运来的矿物。在发出一个损坏严重的猝发传输信号表明他们已经完成了指定任务后，它们就把这些矿物丢在了[Root.GetName]的地表。

之后它们就回到了月球上。
colony.1504.desc.en:
After waking yet again, the drones briefly disappeared from sensors. When they returned, it was with a large cache of minerals of unknown origin in tow. They dumped it on the surface of [Root.GetName] after sending a badly corrupted burst transmission indicating that they had fulfilled a requisition request.

Then they went back to the moon.

colony.1505.desc.zh: 卫星上的信号激增提醒我们[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的无人机已再次苏醒。这次它给我们带来了一个好东西：深层出土的古老卫星。并且它们已经对其进行了一定程度的整修。我们不清楚卫星是怎么跑到这里来的，也不知道无人机为什么到现在才把它挖出来。尽管如此，即使它的数据库里只有一小部分保存了下来，也足够我们了解这些无人机的主人曾经所在的帝国的日常生活情况了。
colony.1505.desc.en: Frantic signal bursts from the moon alerted us to the fact that the old drones on [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have woken yet again. This time they bring us a significant prize, as they have unearthed an ancient satellite from the depths of their moon and partially repaired it. We do not know how the satellite ended up there, nor why the drones have ignored it until now. Regardless, if even a fragment of its databanks have survived, there is a lot we can learn about day-to-day life in the empires that the drones first served.

colony.1506.a.zh: 我们能搞清楚它们到底是怎么了吗？
colony.1506.a.en: Can we find out what was wrong with them?

colony.1506.desc.zh:
一直沉睡的无人机发生了巨大转变，不再做不规则运动。一部分苏醒了过来，像往常一样进入[Root.GetName]的大气中，却一头全速撞向了行星的地面。

相同的情况一直在发生。

殖民地没有受到多大损失，但这些脆弱无比的无人机却变成了一团团闪着蓝色火花的废铁，好像在诉说着它们自我毁灭的决心和力量。
colony.1506.desc.en:
The erratic behavior of the narcoleptic drones have taken a violent turn. A number of them woke and entered the atmosphere of [Root.GetName], as is their wont, only to slam into the surface of the planet at full thrust.

Repeatedly, in many cases.

Damage to the colony was negligible but the nigh-invulnerable drones were destroyed in bright showers of blue sparks, indicative of the tremendous force of, and dedication to, their self-destruction.

colony.1506.name.zh: 古代无人机：无人机的崩溃

colony.1507.desc.zh:
自毁事件之后，剩余的无人机就消失了。[Root.GetName]的历史学家认为它们仍徘徊在附近，在某些失落科技的保护下隐蔽不见，但它们并没与在本应苏醒的时间苏醒过来。

对自毁无人机遗迹的深度分析进展缓慢，但应该马上就会有突破了。
colony.1507.desc.en:
The surviving drones have been missing since the suicide incident. History buffs on [Root.GetName] are convinced the drones are still in close proximity, shielded from view by some lost technology, but the expected time window for their next activation has come and gone.

Progress on deep analysis of the destroyed drones' remains has been slow, but a breakthrough is expected soon.

colony.1507.name.zh: 古代无人机：寻找无人机

colony.1508.a.zh: 这需要我们进行深入调查。

colony.1508.desc.zh: 从破碎的无人机内部找寻故障所花费的时间比预计的长得多，因为每个无人机的内部结构和组装部件都不尽相同。知晓了这一点，那当务之急就是要找出相同的部件。单独来看这些部件的话，如果是外星人制作的，那肯定是现代的东西。如此就很可能是有人做了我们做不到的事情，篡改了这些无人机。
colony.1508.desc.en: Sorting out the errant innards of the shattered drones took much longer than anticipated, as each drone seems to have been built from a slightly different design, assembled from slightly different parts. Once this fact was established, one thing stood out - the parts that were identical. Separated from the rest, it is clear these parts are of somewhat modern, if alien, make. It is likely that someone has done what we could not, and tampered with the drones.

colony.1509.desc.zh: 将它们组装起来之后，我们的专家认为这些无人机残骸内部的外星部件是单向通讯设备。它们并未处在接收状态，所以我们可以推断出这些无人机不是在第三方的指令下进行活动，而是有什么个体一直在监视这些无人机的活动。建议对此事进行进一步调查。
colony.1509.desc.en: Having pieced them together, the foreign objects inside the destroyed drones have been identified by our experts as one-way transmitters. Since they are not set to receive, it is safe to assume that the drones were not acting at the behest of some third party. Rather, some entity has been keeping tabs on the drones' activities. It is advisable to look into this matter.

colony.1509.name.zh: 古代无人机：外星人没见过的
colony.1509.name.en: Ancient Drones: Alien to the Aliens

colony.151.b.evopred.zh: 这些骸骨将完成它们最后的贡献。
colony.151.b.evopred.en: These bones will feed a people one last time.

colony.151.desc.zh:
我们的科考队终于成功打开[Root.GetName]上的避难所，但里面只发现了古老的哺乳动物骨骸。看来大约200年前，避难所的原住民就已经耗尽了食物，随后便陷入了某种同类相食的疯狂。散落的骨头上布满了啃咬痕迹，生动展现了这个曾经骄傲的文明最后幸存者们的悲惨结局。

好在避难所内的记录和数据库足以让我们的行为科学家和异种心理学家忙上好几年。
colony.151.desc.en:
Our science expedition has finally managed to open the vault on [Root.GetName], but they found nothing but ancient mammalian skeletal remains inside. It would seem that the vault's original inhabitants ran out of food approximately 200 years ago, at which point they turned on each other in some sort of cannibalistic frenzy. The scattered bones, many of them covered in gnaw marks, paint a grisly picture of the final moments that were experienced by the last survivors of this once proud civilization.

On the bright side, the logs and data libraries inside the vault should be enough to keep our behavioral scientists and xeno psychologists busy for many years to come.

colony.1510.b.zh: 夺取无人机，用它们毁灭它们将来的主人。
colony.1510.b.en: Capture the drones, send them to destroy their would-be masters.

colony.1510.c.zh: 我们不能再放任这种事情发生。拆除所有无人机。
colony.1510.c.en: We must not let this happen again. Dismantle the drones.

colony.1510.desc.zh:
我们找到了剩下的无人机，它们漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上。

我们已经了解到它们只是某些派系周密计划里的小喽啰。根据我们了解的类似行动的掌握，这个派系很可能是某个特别古老而智慧的海盗集团。他们比我们先发现了这些无人机，做了我们做不到的事情，改装了这些无人机。虽然听起来没那么厉害—他们做的只是将单独的外星科技放进无人机里，但是这些外星海盗的科技水平比我们高出许多，至少在某些领域是这样。安装完毕之后，这些海盗将它们放回太空，他们知道这些无人机的目的是为了帮助原主人建设殖民地，而随着时间的流逝，这些无人机鉴别主人的能力正在减弱。无人机一直在帮我们建设殖民地，而海盗一直在监视，一直在等待发动攻击的好时机。

我们的战斗分析员预测这些海盗会在两年之内发起攻击。
colony.1510.desc.en:
We have found the remaining drones, drifting into orbit around [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. We have learned that they are unwitting pawns in an elaborate scheme set up by an unknown faction.

Going by the modus operandi of this operation, this faction is most likely a particularly old and particularly clever pirate syndicate. They must have found the drones drifting through space and done what we could not; modified them. While not as impressive as it sounds - all they did was introduce self-contained alien technology into the drones - fact remains that these alien pirates possess a technological know-how far in advance of our own, at least in certain areas. Having installed their comms devices in the drones, the pirates let them drift through space again, knowing that they are set to assist their original masters' colonists and that the drones' ability to accurately identify such colonists has degraded with age. The drones have essentially been fattening up our colony as the pirates watch, waiting for the ideal time to strike.

Our military analysts predict that the pirates will strike within the next two years.

colony.1510.name.zh: 古老无人机：上天的回答

colony.1511.desc.zh: 我们夺取了无人机，在其中装满了高爆炸药。我们知道了如何拆解，对它们进行重新设置就没那么难了，我们在海盗舰队可能会经过的位置给他们准备了一份大餐。顶级[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]科学家们植入了我们的敌我识别技术来把误伤平民的几率降到最低。
colony.1511.desc.en: We have captured the drones and fitted them with explosive charges. Reprogramming them proved to be a relatively easy task now that we know how to break them open, and we have plotted a course for the estimated location of the pirate fleet. Top [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] scientists have implemented our own IFF technology to minimize the risk of the drones attacking innocents.

colony.1512.desc.zh: 海盗舰队来袭，比预期早一些。我们的先发制人成功地打击并激怒了他们——舰队规模比预期少了30%。
colony.1512.desc.en: The pirate fleet is inbound, earlier than expected. It is likely our preemptive strike was successful both in provoking and damaging them - their fleet is roughly 30% smaller than projected.

colony.1512.name.zh: 古代无人机：伤痕累累，惶恐不安

colony.1513.a.en: They will do no such thing.

colony.1513.desc.zh: 海盗舰队来袭，比预期晚一些。从舰队的组成和阵型来看，他们为了尽快消灭[Root.GetName]而找来了盟友。
colony.1513.desc.en: The pirate fleet has arrived, somewhat later than expected. Judging by the makeup of the fleet and formations used, they have rallied their allies in an effort to pillage and burn [Root.GetName] as quickly and decisively as possible.

colony.1513.name.zh: 古代无人机：他们无所不在

colony.1514.a.zh: 我们早已迫不及待地想战斗了。
colony.1514.a.en: This fight has been a long time coming.

colony.1514.desc.zh: 时间到了，海盗舰队准时到达。
colony.1514.desc.en: The time has come, and the pirate armada arrives on cue.

colony.152.a.zh: 让我们一起重建这个世界吧！
colony.152.a.en: Let us rebuild this world together.

colony.152.c.zh: 把这些外星人渣们重新关进避难所内，然后永远封锁掉入口。
colony.152.c.en: Seal the alien scum back into the vault and bury the entrance.

colony.152.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的大避难所的大门终于打开了。我们的科学家惊讶的发现在巨大的避难所门后，有着数以百万计的从远古使用核武的战争中幸存下来的生还者。尽管资源拮据，他们在这里建立了一个能够自给自足的群落并维持了数个世纪之久。起初他们对我们的科学家很警惕，毕竟我们是他们见到的第一批外星人，但是他们也很感激我们帮助他们打开了大门。

避难所里存储了大量装备和器材，用来在核灾难后重建文明，这些东西只有他们才知道该如何操作，但是他们似乎更希望在能适应阳光后加入你的殖民地。
colony.152.desc.en:
The great vault on [Root.GetName] has been unsealed. To the surprise of our scientists, the vast complex behind the massive vault doors housed millions of survivors from the ancient nuclear war that once ravaged this world. Despite their limited resources, they have managed to maintain a self-sufficient society for centuries. They were wary of our scientists at first, having never encountered aliens before, but also deeply grateful for our help in opening the vault.

The vault contains large stores of equipment and machinery that was specifically designed for rebuilding civilization after a nuclear holocaust. It can only be operated by these aliens, but they seem more than willing to join your colonists on the surface once they have adapted to natural sunlight again.

colony.1520.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]建立了殖民地，当地的一些植物在释放大量含有复杂化学成分的花粉。

为此准备了一项特别研究计划，来研究这种植物。
colony.1520.desc.en:
Several plants native to [Root.GetName], where we recently established a colony, exude copious amounts of a pollen with an astounding chemical complexity.

A special research project has been prepared for further study of this flora.

colony.1521.b.zh: 我们不能让这种影响心智的东西留在大气中。
colony.1521.b.en: We cannot allow mind-altering particles in the atmosphere.

colony.1521.c.zh: 我们能彻底消灭这种植物的手段。
colony.1521.c.en: We do not have the resources to exterminate the plant.

colony.1521.desc.zh: 长期暴露在[Root.GetName]大气中的花粉会对信息素受体产生轻微催情效果，随之而来的是一种不易察觉的“兴奋”。而效果最强的植物在这颗星球各处都很常见；被[Root.GetName]的科学家储存在了一个隐蔽的地方，在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]当地语言中被称为“玛琳·卡琳”。
colony.1521.desc.en: Long-term exposure to the pollen naturally occurring in [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere acts on the colonists' pheromone receptors with a mild aphrodisiac effect, accompanied by a barely-perceptible "high." The plant that produces the most potent strain is a flower common to all areas of the planet; squirreled away into some obscure taxonomic nook by scientists on [Root.GetName] but known in the local [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] dialect as "Mharin Kharin."

colony.1522.a.en: Let's see what can be done.

colony.1522.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的报告显示最近的工作效率开始下降，在比[Root.Owner.GetName]的平均值低好几个百分点的地方稳定下来。

这有可能是由星球上的刺激性花粉造成的。

很可能是。

已发起特殊项目来进一步，以期提高生产线效率来弥补损失。
colony.1522.desc.en:
Reports from [Root.GetName] indicate that worker productivity has declined recently, becoming stable at levels several percent lower than the [Root.Owner.GetName] average.

This may or may not be due to the stimulating effects of the pollen native to the planet.

It probably is.

A Special Project has been prepared should we wish to make our production pipelines more efficient to make up for the loss.

colony.1522.name.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：准备应付花朵
colony.1522.name.en: Mharin Kharin: Making Time for Petals

colony.1523.desc.zh:
通过对[Root.GetName]上的时间管理模型进行深刻革命，并对所有生产领域的责任和各项职责进行重新分配，我们收到了良好的效果。大众的要求显而易见，而外界观察者会将其称作公开需求，那就是要与当地的植物群落保持紧密的联系。

可是即使运用合理的时间分配和额外的即时检查，生产效率仍旧很低，只是至少已经脱离了不可接受的最低水平。
colony.1523.desc.en:
Far-reaching changes to time management paradigms and the way responsibility is delegated within all fields of production and other duties on [Root.GetName] have produced good results. The populace has an evident desire - outside observers would call it an outright need - to be in close proximity to the native flora.

With clever scheduling and additional checks in place, productivity remains low but has risen above the lower limit of what can be deemed acceptable.

colony.1524.desc.zh:
最近的调查报告显示，[Root.GetName]上的居民比[Root.Owner.GetName]的其他居民更不愿意迁移到其他殖民地。

玛琳·卡琳和它的近亲植物会造成一种轻度的心理上的感知依赖。但是调查报告中并没有指明两件事情之间有任何关联。
colony.1524.desc.en:
A recent survey indicates that residents of [Root.GetName] are much less likely than other denizens of the [Root.Owner.GetName] to migrate to other colonies.

The survey does not address whether this could be due to a psychological dependency on the low-level sensory arousal caused by Mharin Kharin and its sibling-plants.

colony.1525.b.zh: 派遣一支行政特遣队。代号淡紫。
colony.1525.b.en: Deploy an administrative task force. Code mauve.

colony.1525.desc.zh: 尽管星球上的生产力不再下降了，[Root.GetName]上殖民城市和[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上首府之间的通信却开始崩溃。[Root.GetName]上的高级官员之间开始变得越来越冷淡，我们的办事员不断抱怨说即使只是发送一个简单的指令现在都变成了一件困难重重的事。
colony.1525.desc.en: While productivity is no longer declining on the planet, communications between the colony on [Root.GetName] and the capital on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] are breaking down. Senior officials on [Root.GetName] are growing increasingly distant, and our clerks are complaining that even relaying simple directives is becoming an exercise in frustration.

colony.1526.desc.zh: 我们送去[Root.GetName]处理问题的行政小队好像背叛了。幸运的是，他们的计划起到的作用简直是微乎其微。他们的计划进行得极慢，一下子就被我们发现了，真是一点都不令人感到惊奇。风水轮流转——这只是个比喻而已——我们最后的手段就是废除当地的政府，然后直接从首府那里管理殖民地的事务。
colony.1526.desc.en: It appears that the crack team of administrators we sent to [Root.GetName] in order to set things straight have been turned. Fortunately for us, their plot to do as little work as possible was, unsurprisingly, sloppily executed and easily discovered. Heads will roll - metaphorically speaking of course - as our last recourse is to depose the local government and manage the colony's affairs from the capital.

colony.1526.name.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：高层统治者的背叛

colony.1527.desc.zh: 我们的从属政策已经在[Root.GetName]上根深蒂固了。它成功地控制了花粉植物玛琳·卡琳的繁殖。它还成功减少了人们对“使用”这种植物的接受度——这成就可不小，因为这种行为和闻闻花香一样没什么可指摘的。
colony.1527.desc.en: Our remote-government of [Root.GetName] is now firmly established. It has met with some success in suppressing the proliferation of the pollen-bearing plant Mharin Kharin as well as in eroding the community's acceptance of "using" it - no small feat considering the act is as innocent as smelling a flower.

colony.1527.name.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：远处来的铁腕
colony.1527.name.en: Mharin Kharin: With an Iron Fist, From Afar

colony.1528.a.en: We should have done this a long time ago.

colony.1528.a.tooltip.zh: 这种会使人头脑不清的植物现在已经被严格管控了。它被隔离在人口密集的局域之外。这会移除所有与之相关的修正。
colony.1528.a.tooltip.en: The intoxicating plant is strictly controlled and contained outside of populated areas, removing all related modifiers.

colony.1528.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上面的从属治理一直在进行着生硬而卓有成效的管理。据说掌控大权的国会——显然他们更喜欢躲在房间里呼吸玛琳·卡琳的花粉——已经控制了我们安排在星球上面的一支军团。从属治理希望用这些部队对那些花发起一次进攻，让他们安装一些大气过滤机，并把这种植物从市区完全抹除。
colony.1528.desc.en: Our remote-governance of [Root.GetName] continues to be a somewhat awkward but effective arrangement. The council in charge has allegedly secured the loyalty of a faction of our armed forces on the planet - apparently they prefer staying indoors to breathing in the Mharin Kharin pollen. The remote-government wishes to use these troops to mount an offensive on the flower, having them erect atmospheric purifiers and wiping the plant from all urban areas entirely.

colony.1529.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的边缘分子联合起来，组成了一个准宗教事务性质的组织。他们想要控制玛琳·卡琳的种植。他们的领袖，一个自封为“圣花宫殿”的“绿色祭司”的人，宣称他为[Root.GetName]上的整个生态圈代言，并要求获得这种植物的独家贸易权。

这当然是不可能的，我们也不会接受。[Root.GetName]当地植物体系并没有什么战略或经济价值，因此依法也不能运送到其它星球。

不幸的是，他们似乎很不情愿接受这个现实。
colony.1529.desc.en:
Fringe elements on [Root.GetName] have banded together to form a quasi-religious organization seeking to control all aspects of the Mharin Kharin flower and its cultivation. Their leader, a self-styled "Green Hierophant" of this "Flower Temple" claims to speak for all flora and fauna of [Root.GetName] and demands exclusive trading rights for the plant.

This is of course completely unacceptable and impossible, as the native flora of [Root.GetName] is of little strategic or economic value and thus may not be brought off-world by law.

Unfortunately, they are unlikely to accept this fact gracefully.

colony.153.desc.zh: 我们的科学家终于成功打开了[Root.GetName]的古代避难所的大门，但是这么做的结果却是释放出了一群可怕的变异生物——他们是最初的幸存者。这些生物在几秒钟之内就消灭了整个科学家团队，并向四处肆虐，至今已经消灭了数以千计的平民了，大片大片的殖民地落入这些贪婪的变异生物之手。现在我们必须保护我们剩余的土地，建立起牢固的防御建筑，即使这样可能还是不够！
colony.153.desc.en:
Our scientists finally managed to open the ancient vault on [Root.GetName], only to unleash a flood of mutated horrors - the twisted remains of the original inhabitants.

The creatures slaughtered the science team in a matter of seconds, and then fanned out into the countryside. Thousands of colonists have been butchered, with entire settlements falling to the ravenous horde. We have fortified our remaining cities and established defensive perimeters, but this may not be enough!

colony.1530.desc.zh:
圣花宫殿和它的追随者们的人数现在在[Root.GetName]的总人口中占了不小的比例。报告显示，他们组织的运动出现了一些可疑的改变。他们越来越不热心于走私玛琳·卡琳。圣花宫殿似乎逐渐转变成了一种相信世界末日的宗教事务。大气检测器发现玛琳·卡琳的花粉近期出现了一些变化，也许此事和圣花宫殿的改变有关联。

已发起特殊项目来评估此事可能会带来的风险。建议在可能的灾难发生前完成这个项目。
colony.1530.desc.en:
The Flower Temple and its followers now make up a sizable minority of the population on [Root.GetName], and reports indicate a disturbing change in the movement. Their futile attempts to smuggle Mharin Kharin specimen off-world have been growing less enthusiastic by the day, as the Flower Temple seems to be transitioning into a doomsday cult. There is likely a correlation with the recent changes in the Mharin Kharin pollen's chemical makeup, detected by atmospheric sensors.

A Special Project has been prepared to assess the risks associated with this, and it is recommended to complete it before something goes horribly wrong.

colony.1530.name.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：花粉末日的先兆
colony.1530.name.en: Mharin Kharin: Beginning of Pollen's End

colony.1531.a.tooltip.zh: 这颗星球上的危险花类已经被清除，所有与之相关的修正也都被移除。
colony.1531.a.tooltip.en: The planet has been purged of the dangerous flower, removing all related modifiers.

colony.1531.desc.zh:
坚决而迅速的反制措施使我们迅速发现了[Root.GetName]上原生花朵的花粉变化所带来的危险。我们迅速采取了必要措施。

我们彻底疏散了星球上的人群，并且针对玛琳·卡琳及其近亲植物进行了多轮战术性除草轰炸。

这些植物很快就变得对除草剂免疫了。如果这些花粉没有被清除的话，它们就会开始散发一种神经剧毒。所有拥有嗅觉器官的[Root.GetName]生物都会受到致命威胁。

殖民议会的科学家认为这是[Root.GetName]上的一种自然循环。虽然花粉会对我们产生种种不良影响：使我们的当地管理瘫痪，引导圣花骑士教团建立，甚至最终产生剧毒。但是这其实只是偶然的副作用，而不是植物为了自卫而设计的阴谋诡计。

如今，星球的表面上如今已经见不到这些花的踪迹了。我们的殖民地居民们也得到了安全保障，再也不用受到花粉的威胁了。
colony.1531.desc.en:
Quick and decisive action allowed us to identify the risks associated with the rapid changes in the pollen native to [Root.GetName] and take the necessary steps.

The necessary steps were a complete planetary evacuation and a planet-wide tactical pesticide bombing run, targeting the Mharin Kharin flower and its ilk.

The plants were rapidly mutating and their unique pollen would, had they not been destroyed, soon have begun delivering a potent neurotoxin to the olfactory organs of all sapient life on [Root.GetName].

The scientists on the colonization council theorize that this is part of a natural cycle on [Root.GetName] and that the pollen's adverse effects on us, in the form of a crumbling local administration, the rise of the Flower Temple cult, and eventual pollen toxicity, were chance side-effects rather than the product of a plant's sinister self-defense mechanism.

Regardless, any and all traces of the flower have been wiped from the planet's surface, and our colonists are safe and free of the pollen's influence.

colony.1532.a.zh: 我们不会忘却这场悲剧的。
colony.1532.a.en: We will not forget this tragedy.

colony.1532.desc.zh:
灾难降临了。

无数的玛琳·卡琳开始自发地进行变异，就像野火那样一发不可收拾地蔓延开来。它们的花粉开始变得剧毒，我们已经束手无策了。

因为我们发现的太晚，我们没能撤离星球上的居民，中和花粉的尝试也以失败告终。[Root.GetName]上的居民遭受了灭顶之灾。

[Root.GetName]上的植物获得了胜利，但是它们也将付出代价，尽管这件事对我们来说只是一种毫无意义的安慰。玛琳·卡琳所属的种群由于过度繁殖，导致土壤中缺少它所需要的某种营养物质——很快，这些植物就会死亡。要经过非常长得一段时间以后，这些植物才能重新在生态系统中找到自己的落脚点。谁知道它们到底会不会找到。

[Root.GetName]的居民都丧生了。星球的大气由于植物排放的气体而暂时变得有毒。
colony.1532.desc.en:
Something went horribly wrong.

Vast swaths of Mharin Kharin flowers spontaneously mutated in unison, spreading like wildfire and turning their pollen poisonous, and we were too late.

Both our evacuation efforts and our attempts to neutralize the pollen fell short of the mark and the inhabitants of [Root.GetName] paid the price.

The plant life of [Root.GetName] achieved only a pyrrhic victory, though this fact is scant consolation. The whole genus that Mharin Kharin belonged to burned in the fire of its own unnaturally rapid proliferation. The soil is starved of the specific nutrients the pollinating plants need - once the currently living specimens die, which will be soon, it will be a long time before that flora can again establish a foothold in the ecosystem, if it ever will.

The inhabitants of [Root.GetName] are dead, and the planet's atmosphere is temporarily noxious with plant emissions.

colony.1532.name.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：我们的花粉末日
colony.1532.name.en: Mharin Kharin: The Pollen's End of Us

colony.1533.desc.zh:
行星调查队伍汇报说，两年之前导致殖民地毁灭的植物毒性瘴气如今已经挥发殆尽了。这颗星球如今已经不同了。在玛琳·卡琳的怒放之后，它现在变成了一颗寸草不生的沙漠星球，大气中到处弥漫着花粉。

两年也许不足以令我们遗忘[Root.Owner.GetName]曾经居住的那些人所遭遇的悲剧，但是至少现在这颗行星对智慧生命不再抱有敌意了。
colony.1533.desc.en:
A planetary surveillance team reports that the toxic miasma that enveloped a planet two years ago and led to the destruction of our colony has lifted. The planet is different now, changed into a desert world after the violent blooming of Mharin Kharin and the atmosphere becoming saturated with pollen.

It will take more than these two years for the [Root.Owner.GetName] to forget the tragic fate of those who lived there, but the planet itself is no longer actively hostile to sapient life.

colony.1533.name.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：一个新的开始

colony.1534.desc.zh: 在仔细检查之后，我们发现[Root.GetName]上的植物其实构造非常简单。其中一些花粉有淡淡的刺激性以及迅速变异的倾向；但没有其他的特别之处，没有什么战略用途，也不是什么奢侈品资源。
colony.1534.desc.en: On closer examination, the plants native to [Root.GetName] turn out to be rather dull. Some excrete pollen that have a mild stimulating effect and they are likely to have a propensity for rapid genetic change; hardly impressive enough to warrant adopting as a strategic or luxury resource.

colony.155.a.zh: 我们必须拆除这颗核聚变武器！

colony.155.desc.zh:
在我们探索[Root.GetName]上靠近我们居住站的废墟时。一些殖民者无意中激活了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上以前使用核武的战争中遗留下来的未引爆的核聚变武器上的计时器。

这个大约35兆吨当量的核心炸弹一旦引爆，附近的数个居住站将从地图上被抹去。此核聚变武器极度不稳定所以无法去挪移，我们也没有足够的时间去撤离这个区域。
colony.155.desc.en:
While exploring some ruins near one of our major settlements on [Root.GetName], a few colonists inadvertently activated the timer on an undetonated hydrogen bomb left over from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s previous nuclear war.

With an estimated yield of 35 megatons, the bomb will wipe out several population centers if it detonates. It isn't stable enough to be moved and there is no time to evacuate the entire region.

colony.156.a.zh: 我们真是在鬼门关走了一遭啊。

colony.156.desc.zh: 我们成功地拆除了[From.From.GetName]的核聚变武器！现在我们的专家团队在对[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]区域进行地毯式的搜索，确保没有其他未引爆的武器，希望能够减少这类事件再次发生的概率。
colony.156.desc.en: We have successfully disarmed the hydrogen bomb on [From.From.GetName]! It has been safely disposed of and specialist teams are now scouring the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface of any other undetonated munitions. This will hopefully reduce the chances of another incident like this occurring.

colony.157.desc.zh: 我们的拆弹小队未能及时拆除[From.From.GetName]的核聚变武器，在炸弹引爆中心附近整整100公里的人都丧生了，千年以前悲剧且毫无意义的使用核武的战争却让我们的人成为了最后一批受害者。
colony.157.desc.en: Our bomb disposal team failed to defuse the hydrogen bomb on [From.From.GetName] in time. They, along with every other living thing within a 100 kilometer radius, were eradicated when the bomb detonated. Untold lives have been lost, the last victims of a tragic and pointless war that began millennia ago.

colony.160.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一具庞大的残骸，看上去似乎是一台粒子加速器。它位于一个充满辐射的巨大弹坑中，这意味着这台加速器是[Root.GetPlanetMoon]核战中非常重要的战略目标之一。

我们找到了一些负责这台加速器的科学家所写的日志，尽管这项科技的开发很不完善，但是其中不少研究和公式哪怕对我们的科技标准来说都算是闻所未闻的先进知识，我们的物理学家已经在研究这些数据了。
colony.160.desc.en:
We have discovered what appears to be the remains of a massive particle accelerator on [Root.GetName]. It was found in a still-radioactive region covered in massive bomb craters, suggesting the accelerator was considered a strategic target of great importance during the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s nuclear war.

We have recovered several research logs written by the scientist in charge of the accelerator. Although the technology of her civilization was fairly underdeveloped, some of the theoretical research and formulas described in the logs are advanced even by our standards. Our physicists are poring over the data now.

colony.161.desc.zh:
在[Root.GetName]的一场庞大的使用核武的战争中幸存的这些基础设施被证实对我们的殖民者有着极大的好处。曾经在这里居住的外星文明所建造的那些用来连接他们主要居住站的公路，其中一些在今天仍然状态良好足以为我们所用。

我们还能从散布在地表的废墟中回收大量的建筑材料，从而进一步完善我们殖民地的基础设施。
colony.161.desc.en:
Infrastructure that survived the great nuclear war which ruined [Root.GetName] have proved a great boon to our colonists. The alien civilization that once lived here built highways connecting their major population centers, and some of them are still in good enough condition to be used today.

We have also been able to recycle a large amount of building material from the many ruins that dot the landscape, further improving our colony's infrastructure.

colony.162.b.evopred.zh: 幸好这些遗骸没有被辐射污染。
colony.162.b.evopred.en: Fortunate that these remains weren't irradiated.

colony.162.desc.zh:
近日，一个从[Root.GetName]出发的殖民者小队登上了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上一个由原住民留在轨道上的原始空间站。在面向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的窗口周围，我们发现了许多这个空间站工作人员的干尸。他们意识到在看到下方星球那些翻腾的蘑菇云后他们的命运已经注定了。通过通讯记录表明，这些宇航员一次次徒劳尝试着与地表进行联络，可惜的是他们却在日渐疯狂的尝试中耗尽了他们的补给。

这个空间站目前状况良好，它给我们的工程师展现了一个在行星早期文明中难得一见的空间站计划。工程师从这个空间站原始而又巧妙的设计计划中获得了一些想法。
colony.162.desc.en:
A small team from our colony on [Root.GetName] recently boarded a primitive space station that had been left in orbit by the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants. The mummified remains of the station's crew could still be found clustered around viewports facing the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They must have realized they were doomed after seeing the billowing mushroom clouds below, and communication logs shows that the astronauts made several futile and increasingly frantic attempts to contact the surface before they eventually ran out of supplies.

The station is in good condition, and it has afforded our engineers a rare glimpse of the early stages of a planetary space program. They have gained several ideas from the primitive yet ingenious solutions used in the station's design.

colony.163.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的一些废土区域散发的辐射量要高于我们之前的探测值，一些当地的殖民者都在不同程度上出现了健康状况差、生育率低等现象。现在我们正在逐步从受影响区域疏散人群，但是这么做是需要一定时间的。
colony.163.desc.en: The radiation levels in some wasteland regions of [Root.GetName] appear to be greater than our previous scans had indicated. Colonists in several local settlements have complained of poor health, and birth rates are down. We are taking steps to evacuate the affected regions, but these measures will take time.

colony.164.a.tooltip.zh: [Root.GetName]上有约300£pop£人口获得和平主义思潮。
colony.164.a.tooltip.en: Approximately 300 £pop£ Pops on [Root.GetName] gain the Pacifist ethic.

colony.164.b.zh: 这些个懦夫真是我方的耻辱！
colony.164.b.en: These wretched cowards shame our nation!

colony.164.c.zh: 很好，人们应该推崇和平。
colony.164.c.en: Excellent. Everyone should give peace a chance.

colony.164.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的废土中发现的破败的遗迹似乎从某种程度上影响了在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的殖民者，使他们慢慢向和平主义者靠拢。这次新行动的人员声称他们的生存意义就是为了给后世的人敲响警钟，让他们记住战争的可怕，他们认为必须阻止发生在[Root.GetName]上的事情在其他世界重演。
colony.164.desc.en:
The decrepit ruins and desolate wastelands found on [Root.GetName] seem to have prompted many of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s colonists to adopt some kind of pacifistic philosophy.

Members of this new movement claim that the environment they live in serve as a daily reminder of the senseless horrors of war. They see it as their civic duty to prevent the terrible destruction visited upon [Root.GetName] from occurring on other worlds.

colony.170.desc.zh: 围绕着[Root.GetName]的轨道空间到处都是曾经居住在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]遗留的残骸，他们在文明被毁灭之前向太空射出了数千个原始的卫星和飞弹发射平台。许多都在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]可怕的使用核武的战争中被反卫星武器摧毁了，这样一来太空垃圾就更多了。我们在地表的殖民者认为这些残骸已经影响了基础设施的运作，因为这些残骸，我们只能在有限的条件下使用卫星和轨道飞行的技术。
colony.170.desc.en:
The orbital space around [Root.GetName] is cluttered with debris left behind by the alien civilization that once inhabited the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Before they wiped themselves out, their early space programs saw the launch of thousands of primitive satellites and missile launch platforms. Many of these were destroyed by anti-satellite weapons during the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s destructive nuclear war, adding even more space junk to the mix.

Our colony on the surface has developed to a point where this dense field of debris is interfering with its infrastructure. We cannot use satellites and civilian orbital flights are limited to narrow launch windows.

colony.171.desc.zh: 一艘民用货船在登陆[Root.GetName]的途中被一群轨道中快速移动的残骸击中了，船员没有幸存者，飞船的残骸击中了一个殖民地的主能源继电器，爆炸导致了大量平民伤亡，一些基础设施遭受重创。
colony.171.desc.en: A civilian freighter coming in to land on [Root.GetName] was perforated by a dense cloud of fast-moving orbital debris! The flight crew was killed immediately, and the stricken craft tumbled through the atmosphere only to crash-land near one of the colony's main power relays. The resulting explosion resulted in several deaths on the ground, and local infrastructure suffered considerable damage.

colony.171.desc.mach.zh: 一艘准备在[Root.GetName]着陆的工人单位货船被一团高速移动的密集轨道残骸击穿了！飞行员单位瞬间被摧毁，而被击中的飞船翻滚着穿过大气层，砸到了殖民地的一个主继电站附近。随之而来的爆炸导致数个地面单位行动终止，而且当地基础设施也受到了较大的损伤。
colony.171.desc.mach.en: A worker unit freighter coming in to land on [Root.GetName] was perforated by a dense cloud of fast-moving orbital debris! The flight crew units were destroyed instantly, and the stricken craft tumbled through the atmosphere only to crash-land near one of the colony's main power relays. The resulting explosion resulted in several operation terminations on the ground, and local infrastructure suffered considerable damage.

colony.172.a.zh: 我们需要处理一下这些残骸
colony.172.a.en: We really need to do something about that debris.

colony.172.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]轨道中一片密集的残骸将空间轨道变成了一个垃圾场。这片残骸——我们相信是在之前[Root.GetPlanetMoon]使用核武的战争使用的飞弹发射平台——被引力拉入了大气层，对我们的一个主要居住站造成了巨大的影响，目前得到的初步报告中显示这可能会造成重大伤亡。
colony.172.desc.en: A cascade of collisions in the dense layer of debris surrounding [Root.GetName] recently shifted the orbit of a large piece of space junk. The object - which we believe was one of the many orbital missile platforms used in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s nuclear war - was pulled into the atmosphere, and unfortunately proceeded to impact directly on top of a major settlement. Initial reports indicate heavy casualties.

colony.173.desc.zh: 在科研船的帮助下，[Root.GetName]殖民地终于成功地清理了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道空间，现在卫星和轨道飞行都变得安全了。
colony.173.desc.en: With the assistance of our Science Ship, colonial authorities on [From.From.GetName] have finished cleaning up the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s orbital space. It has now been made safe for satellites and civilian travel.

colony.174.desc.zh: 在科研船的帮助下，[Root.GetName]殖民地终于成功地清理了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道空间，现在卫星和轨道飞行都变得安全了。我们发现[Root.GetPlanetMoon]残骸中包含着许多价值极高的矿产，我们成功地回收了许多矿产，使得这次行动获利颇丰。
colony.174.desc.en:
With the assistance of our Science Ship, colonial authorities on [From.From.GetName] have finished cleaning up the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s orbital space. It has now been made safe for satellites and civilian travel.

As it turns out, a lot of the debris consisted of valuable minerals from the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface that had been used in satellite construction. We were able to salvage a significant amount, netting a tidy profit in the process.

colony.180.desc.zh: 我们在对[Root.GetName]的深度空间跟踪矩阵有了重要的发现——目前正有一颗巨大的小行星正在向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]飞来！如果任由它撞击表面的话，将会造成灾难性的后果。必须尽早消灭这颗小行星！
colony.180.desc.en:
Our deep space tracking arrays on [Root.GetName] have made an alarming discovery - a large asteroid is heading towards the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] on a direct collision course! Should it impact the surface, the consequences would be disastrous.

The asteroid must be destroyed before it is too late!

colony.182.desc.zh: 向[Root.GetName]飞来的小行星已经被摧毁了！[Root.GetPlanetMoon]九死一生的平民们都在街上庆祝。扫描后发现小行星的残骸中蕴含着许多有价值的矿产，我们已经尽我们所能回收了许多矿产。
colony.182.desc.en:
The asteroid that was approaching [Root.GetName] on a collision course has been destroyed! With their doom averted, our jubilant citizens on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have taken to the streets in celebration.

A scan of the remaining fragments has also revealed that the asteroid consisted largely of valuable minerals. We have collected what we could.

colony.182.desc.mach.zh:
向[Root.GetName]飞来的小行星已经被摧毁了！星球上没有单位或建筑受损，因为任何残余的碎片都小到在进入大气层时被分解了。

对残余碎片的扫描发现小行星主要由有价值的矿物构成。我们已尽量进行回收。
colony.182.desc.mach.en:
The asteroid that was approaching [Root.GetName] on a collision course has been destroyed! No planetside units or structures have been affected by the event, as any inbound debris was small enough to disintegrate on atmospheric entry.

A scan of the remaining fragments has also revealed that the asteroid consisted largely of valuable minerals. We have collected what we could.

colony.183.a.zh: 今天是一个黑暗的日子。

colony.183.desc.zh: 我们没能及时制止往[Root.GetName]方向的小行星撞击，它径直撞上了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面，造成了大范围的破坏，有数百万人失去了生命。
colony.183.desc.en: We failed to stop the asteroid that was heading for [Root.GetName] in time. It has collided with the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, causing widespread devastation and untold suffering. Millions are dead.

colony.183.desc.mach.zh: 我们没能及时阻止飞往[Root.GetName]的小行星。它撞击到[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面，造成了大面积的破坏。数千的机器单位永远无法再运作。
colony.183.desc.mach.en: We failed to stop the asteroid that was heading for [Root.GetName] in time. It has collided with the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, causing widespread devastation and destruction. Millions of machine units have been rendered terminally inoperable.

colony.185.desc.zh:
我们对[Target.GetName]的吞食已足够深入，由此带来的连锁反应破坏了它的核心。

所有子个体均已撤离到[Owner.Capital.GetName]。
colony.185.desc.en:
We have consumed enough of [Target.GetName] that a chain reaction has begun and destabilized its core.

All drones have been evacuated to [Owner.Capital.GetName].

colony.2.desc.zh: 我们发现[From.From.GetName]的漫游植物会避开殖民地中某种原生伪昆虫筑巢的区域。这类昆虫能分泌特殊的信息素，可用来控制漫游植物的行进路径，避开昆虫密集区。还有，漫游植物最常迁移的地方被划为了自然保护区。附近的生物学家能从保护区内获取很多知识。
colony.2.desc.en:
We have learned that the roaming forests on [From.From.GetName] avoid certain regions that are home to colonies of a native pseudo-insect. These insects secrete a pheromone that can be used to steer the wandering trees away from population centers.

Furthermore, the areas where the forests most frequently range have been closed off as nature reserves. Our biologists can learn much by studying this reserve from the neighboring regions.

colony.2001.a.military.tooltip.zh: [Root.GetName]上的约300£pop£人口获得军国主义思潮。
colony.2001.a.military.tooltip.en: Approximately 300 £pop£ Pops on [Root.GetName] gain the Militarist ethic.

colony.2001.a.pacifist.tooltip.zh: [Root.GetName]上的约300£pop£人口获得和平主义思潮。
colony.2001.a.pacifist.tooltip.en: Approximately 300 £pop£ Pops on [Root.GetName] gain the Pacifist ethic.

colony.2001.b.military.tooltip.zh: [Root.GetName]上的大约100£pop£ 人口获得军国主义思潮。
colony.2001.b.military.tooltip.en: Approximately 100 £pop£ Pop on [Root.GetName] gain the Militarist ethic.

colony.2001.b.pacifism.tooltip.zh: [Root.GetName]上的约100£pop£人口获得和平主义思潮。
colony.2001.b.pacifism.tooltip.en: Approximately 100 £pop£ Pop on [Root.GetName] gain the Pacifist ethic.

colony.2001.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]本地的政府失误导致一小群叛军收获了更多支持者，他们反对我们的传统思潮。支持他们的人越来越多，这让他们在该区域获得了更大的权利。这样的支持同时也让他们在获得民众支持上取得了一定成功，他们可以利用这些支持来发展自己的事业。
colony.2001.desc.en: Local political drama on [Root.GetName] has resulted in increased support among a small group of rebels, opposed to our underlying ethics. Their increased support have enabled them to gain more power in the region and vote for their own causes with limited success.

colony.2005.b.zh: 拆解并研究其中的秘密。
colony.2005.b.en: Scrap it to learn its secrets.

colony.2005.desc.zh:
为了改善日常生活，[Root.GetName]的殖民者开始定期探索星球上的资源。最近一次北极探索时，在深海发现了一个巨大物体：一艘外星战列巡洋舰。

深海的压强可能会造成困难，但仍有可能打捞这艘沉船。
colony.2005.desc.en:
The colonizers on [Root.GetName] regularly explore the planet in hopes of finding more resources to help with day-to-day life. A recent expedition to the north pole has now unveiled a large object on the bottom of the ocean: An alien battle cruiser.

The pressure of the deep will prove a challenge, but it is possible to get to the ship.

colony.2006.a.material.zh: 我们的努力将引领我们向前！
colony.2006.a.material.en: Our efforts pave the way forward!

colony.2006.a.tooltip.zh:
你的帝国获得$streamlined_ship_design$的修正。

获得一艘巡洋舰类型的飞船。
colony.2006.a.tooltip.en:
Your Empire gains the $streamlined_ship_design$ modifier.

Gain a Cruiser-class ship.

colony.2006.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的打捞任务顺利进行！沉在海底的远古巡洋舰重新浮出水面，并已修理完毕。真是蔚为大观，通过修理它，我们的工程师学到了其设计背后的秘密。
colony.2006.desc.en: The salvage mission on [Root.GetName] has succeeded! The ancient cruiser that lay on the bottom of the ocean has been resurfaced and repaired. It is a wondrous sight to behold, and from repairing it our engineers have learnt some of the secrets behind its design.

colony.2007.a.phile.zh: 宇宙中任何种群留下的馈赠都是有价值的！
colony.2007.a.phile.en: Any gift from cosmos' children is valuable!

colony.2007.a.phobe.zh: 反正外星飞船是无法和我们的飞船比拟的！
colony.2007.a.phobe.en: No alien ship would surpass ours anyway!

colony.2007.desc.zh:
我们尝试从[Root.GetName]的深海打捞这艘巨型飞船，并对其舰体设计有了一定发现。该船的机动算法很容易改用到我们的硬件上，让我们的飞船更加灵活，更加节能。

可惜的是，该船本身无法抢修了，但我们仍可以从其舰体上回收一些材料。
colony.2007.desc.en:
The attempts to salvage the giant ship that was found in [Root.GetName]'s waters have yielded some insight into the ship's design. The ship's maneuvering algorithms are easily transferable to our own hardware, enabling our fleets to become swifter and more energy efficient.

Unfortunately the ship itself is beyond saving, but its hull will supply us with enough materials to make up for that.

colony.2008.desc.zh:
爆炸声从数里之外都听得清清楚楚，打捞沉船的行动以灾难性失败告终。[Root.GetName]的居民没有受到伤害，但一部分建筑遭到了破坏。

沉船被炸得粉碎，已经无法修理。所幸，我们回收到了许多残片。
colony.2008.desc.en:
The explosion can be heard for miles, as the salvage operation of the submerged cruiser ends in disaster. The people of [Root.GetName] are without harm, yet parts of the settlement are destroyed.

The ship itself is far beyond repair, ripped apart by the explosion. Luckily, many of the scattered pieces of the hull can be salvaged.

colony.2010.a.material.zh: 他们不会对我们构成威胁。
colony.2010.a.material.en: They are no threat to our pursuits.

colony.2010.a.material.tooltip.zh: 约500£pop£人口获得唯心主义思潮。
colony.2010.a.material.tooltip.en: Approximately 500 £pop£ Pops gain the Spiritualist Ethic.

colony.2010.a.spirit.en: Leave them be to find their own way.

colony.2010.a.spirit.tooltip.zh: 约500£pop£人口获得唯物主义思潮。
colony.2010.a.spirit.tooltip.en: Approximately 500 £pop£ Pops gain the Materialist Ethic.

colony.2010.c.material.zh: 展开大规模的反制公告。

colony.2010.c.material.tooltip.zh:
将会尝试劝阻[Root.GetName]上的£pop£唯心主义人口并且宣扬唯物主义。
约300£pop£人口获得唯心主义思潮。
colony.2010.c.material.tooltip.en:
Will attempt to dissuade £pop£ Spiritualist Pops on [Root.GetName] and promote Materialism.
Approximately 300 £pop£ Pops gain the Spiritualist Ethic.

colony.2010.c.spirit.zh: 让精神向导帮他们改邪归正。

colony.2010.c.spirit.tooltip.zh:
将会尝试劝阻[Root.GetName]上的£pop£唯物主义人口并且宣扬唯心主义。
约300£pop£人口获得唯物主义思潮。
colony.2010.c.spirit.tooltip.en:
Will attempt to dissuade £pop£ Materialist Pops on [Root.GetName] and promote Spiritualism.
Approximately 300 £pop£ Pops gain the Materialist Ethic.

colony.2010.desc.material.zh: 随着我们在[Root.GetName]上的扩张逐步稳定，某些居民开始偏离我们原本的世界观。一群唯心主义者开始和平地传播思想以反对我们的政府。他们认为我们对宇宙唯物主义的观点正令我们作茧自缚，并让我们与灵魂渐行渐远。
colony.2010.desc.material.en: As our expansion on [Root.GetName] has stabilized, certain individuals have begun to move away from our view of the world. A group of spiritualists has begun to peacefully propagate against our government. They see that our materialistic view of the cosmos is limiting us and distancing us from the soul.

colony.2010.desc.spirit.zh: 随着我们在[Root.GetName]扎根落地，某些居民开始偏离我们原本的道路。虽然这是意料之中的事，但他们已经拥有了不少的支持者。该群体认为，我们对宇宙唯心主义的世界观无法快速引领我们前进，而他们坚信更加唯物主义的宇宙观才是答案。
colony.2010.desc.spirit.en: As we have grown our roots on [Root.GetName] certain individuals have begun to stray from our beaten path. That is to be expected, but these have supporters. The group feels our spiritualistic view of the universe is not leading us forward fast enough - assured that a more materialistic view of the cosmos is the answer.

colony.2011.a.material.tooltip.zh: 全体£pop£人口失去唯心主义思潮。
colony.2011.a.material.tooltip.en: All £pop£ Pops lose the Spiritualist Ethic.

colony.2011.a.spirit.tooltip.zh: 全体£pop£人口失去唯物主义思潮。
colony.2011.a.spirit.tooltip.en: All £pop£ Pops lose the Materialist Ethic.

colony.2011.desc.material.zh: $colony.2011.desc.base$ 我们的宣传机器和计划中一样的运行。不仅仅是唯心主义者，那些骑墙派也明白了理性的可贵，并且为了支持唯物主义抛弃了他们从前的妄想。
colony.2011.desc.material.en: $colony.2011.desc.base$ Our propaganda machine has worked as promised. Not only spiritualists, but people of all persuasions are seeing reason and casting aside their former delusions in favor of materialism.

colony.2011.desc.spirit.zh: 多亏了我们的精神领袖的不懈努力，我们终于力挽狂澜，吸引来了越来越多的无信仰人士。这些人不限于唯物主义者，甚至乎包括了其他宗教人士。愿他们从此不再误入歧途。
colony.2011.desc.spirit.en: Thanks to the tireless efforts of our spiritual leaders we have finally turned the tide, and are bringing more and more faithless into the fold. Not only materialists, but people of all persuasions have seen the light and are casting away their former beliefs. Pray they will never stray from the righteous path again.

colony.2012.desc.zh: 我们做出改变[Root.GetName]上人口思想的尝试简直就是搬起石头砸自己的脚。通过团结起来反抗我们的文化镇压，他们获得了更多的追随者，这使他们变得比以前还要强大。
colony.2012.desc.en: Our attempts to change the minds of our people on [Root.GetName] have backfired horribly. By banding together over our subjugation attempts they have gained even more followers, making them stronger than ever.

colony.2015.desc.zh:
一队调查小组在[Root.GetName]上发现了隐藏的工厂。根据建筑构架和磨损程度判断，它源自一个古老文明，这个文明十分擅长建造经得起时间考验的建筑。

我们可以轻松使用这个工厂，增加殖民地的产出。
colony.2015.desc.en:
A group of investigators have found a hidden factory on [Root.GetName]. The building and its state of decay tells of an old civilization, one that excelled at constructing things that stood the test of time.

Our population would easily be able to use the facility to add to the colony's production output.

colony.2016.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上古怪工厂工作的员工突然消失了！我们可以派遣工人替补，或者以防万一，直接将工厂夷为平地。
colony.2016.desc.en: The crew we assigned to work the odd factory on [Root.GetName] has disappeared! We could send a new workforce to take their place, or we could raze the facility to the ground, making sure that this will not happen again.

colony.2017.a.en: The people will get used to it.

colony.2017.desc.zh:
到那个古怪工厂工作后，第二队工人也失踪了！所幸，其中一个工人留下了记录。记录显示那里有不少的陷阱，这些陷阱专门用来抓捕毫无防备的工人。

陷阱已经移除，现在应该可以正常使用工厂了。但不论如何解释，民众仍对潜在的致命陷阱忧心忡忡。
colony.2017.desc.en:
A second group of individuals has gone missing after working at the odd factory! Fortunately one of the workers was able to leave a recording behind, revealing that there are traps capturing unsuspecting workers.

The traps have been disabled and we should be able to use the factory without further issues. However, the populace are none too happy about the potential death trap, no matter what we say.

colony.2019.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的古怪工厂并未出现任何异常。殖民地将维持预计的产出。
colony.2019.desc.en: No reports of any problems have been issued from the odd factory on [Root.GetName]. It seems like the colony will maintain the projected production estimates.

colony.2025.a.phile.zh: 不惜一切代价保护少数社会。
colony.2025.a.phile.en: Protect the minority at any cost.

colony.2025.a.phile.tooltip.zh:
[Root.GetName]上所有$ethic_xenophobe$的[MyEmpire.GetSpeciesName]人口均获得$pop_angered$修正，持续24个月，效果如下：
£happiness£ 幸福度-25%
产出-25%

[Root.GetName]上所有的外星人和具有亲外主义特性的人口均获得$pop_pleased$修正，持续12个月，效果如下：
£happiness£ 幸福度+25%
资源产出+25%
colony.2025.a.phile.tooltip.en:
All [MyEmpire.GetSpeciesName] Pops on [Root.GetName] with the $ethic_xenophobe$ ethic gains the $pop_angered$ modifier for 24 months, with the following effects:
£happiness£ Happiness -25%
Production Output -25%

All Alien and Xenophile Pops on [Root.GetName] gains the $pop_pleased$ modifier for 12 months, with the following effects:
£happiness£ Happiness +25%
Production Output +25%

colony.2025.a.phobe.zh: 隔离外星人与狂躁大众。
colony.2025.a.phobe.en: Isolate the xenos from the mob.

colony.2025.a.tooltip.zh:
[Root.GetName]上所有$ethic_xenophobe$的[MyEmpire.GetSpeciesName]人口均获得$pop_angered$修正，持续24个月，效果如下：
£happiness£ 幸福度-25%
资源产出-25%
colony.2025.a.tooltip.en:
All [MyEmpire.GetSpeciesName] Pops on [Root.GetName] with the $ethic_xenophobe$ ethic gains the $pop_angered$ modifier for 24 months, with the following effects:
£happiness£ Happiness -25%
Production Output -25%

colony.2025.b.phobe.en: Let the xenos fight their own fight.

colony.2025.b.tooltip.zh:
1个外星人口被消灭。

[Root.GetName]上所有的外星人和具有亲外主义特性的人口均获得$pop_angered$修正，持续12个月，效果如下：
£happiness£ 幸福度-25%
资源产出-25%
colony.2025.b.tooltip.en:
1 Alien Pop is killed.

All Alien and Xenophile Pops on [Root.GetName] gains the $pop_angered$ modifier for 12 months, with the following effects:
£happiness£ Happiness -25%
Production Output -25%

colony.2025.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，我们的种群和混居的其他种群产生了不和。具体原因未知，可能是因为文化区别、自我封闭或者单单的误解。但很明显，若是放任不管，这些小型冲突就会愈演愈烈。
colony.2025.desc.en: Having other species living with our people has caused some friction on [Root.GetName]. Be it cultural differences, xenophobia or a common misunderstanding is hard to tell, but what is sure is that these small encounters could turn to the worse if we do not intervene.

colony.2025.phile.desc.zh: 与其他种群共生并非易事。在[Root.GetName]星上，由于无法让外星人合理融入我方社会，一些不和悄然形成。如果仍然不采取行动，或许会产生危机。
colony.2025.phile.desc.en: Having our own species living together with other lifeforms isn't always easy. Some friction has begun to take form on [Root.GetName], surely due to our inability to incorporate the aliens into our society properly. If nothing is done they might be at risk.
