colony.2025.phobe.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，混居在我们其中的异星人开始惹是生非了。这引起了我们民众的众怒，每天都有越来越多的争斗彰显。如果坐视不理，那些异星人估计会损失惨重。
colony.2025.phobe.desc.en: The xenos living among us have begun to cause friction on [Root.GetName]. Our own people are furious, resulting in more and more fights breaking out each day. If we idly stand by the xenos might end up losing more than some bodily fluids.

colony.2050.b.zh: 我们必须对此区域进行投资。
colony.2050.b.en: We must invest in this area.

colony.2050.c.zh: 我们有强大的团队，帮助他们复原。
colony.2050.c.en: We have a strong community, help them recover.

colony.2050.d.zh: 驱逐该地居民并将该片区域夷为平地。
colony.2050.d.en: Throw out the inhabitants and raze the area.

colony.2050.desc.zh: 由于重大的记录错误，[Root.GetName]部分区域的基础设施维护与住宅服务已趋于落后。人们正居住在较为恶劣的环境之中，似乎已忍不了太久了。要修复这些问题则会耗费我们的时间与精力。
colony.2050.desc.en: Due to a major clerical error parts of [Root.GetName] has fallen behind in infrastructure maintenance and accommodation services. The people live in rather bleak conditions and will not tolerate it for long. Remedying these problems will cost us time and effort.

colony.2060.c.en: ... They are related to the Fumongus!

colony.2060.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的殖民地进行的例行生态研究中，偶然发现了一种奇怪的真菌生命形式。科学小组报告说，菌丝体的表面闪闪发光，色彩斑斓，但最让他们感兴趣的是，每当大范围内发生某些事情时，不同的蘑菇群似乎在相互交流。

此外，生物体的生物特征似乎与殖民地的生态系统明显不同。当地科学团队相当困惑，并要求提供专业支持，因为我们可能正在处理一种有感知力的物种。
colony.2060.desc.en:
A routine ecological study of our colony on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon a strange fungal lifeform. The science team reports that the surface of the mycelium is shimmering and colorful, but what was most intriguing to them was the fact that separate clusters were seemingly communicating with one another whenever something occurred within a wide radius.

Furthermore, the biology of the organism appears to be clearly alien to the ecosystem of the colony. Puzzled, the local science team has requested specialized support as we might be dealing with a sentient species.

colony.2065.b.en: This is too risky. Destroy them.

colony.2065.desc.zh:
我们收到了来自[Root.GetName]的报告。经过进一步检查，我们发现的外星真菌似乎正在向我们目前无法确定的星系中的某个位置发出信号。遥感探测和安全分析表明，菌丝体完全有可能是某种高级间谍生物。

然而，值得注意的是，这种生物体已经想当老了。设计这些间谍蘑菇的人很可能已经不在了。但如果他们还在的话，最好不要唤醒这些沉睡的捕食者。
colony.2065.desc.en:
We have concerning reports coming from [Root.GetName]. Upon further examination, it seems that the alien fungus we found is emitting a signal towards a location in the galaxy that we were unable to pinpoint so far. Telemetry and security analysis indicate that it is completely possible for the mycelium to be some kind of advanced spying organism.

However, it is worth noting that this organism is old. There is a fair chance that whomever engineered these spying mushrooms is not around anymore. But if they are, it might be best not to poke the sleeping predator.

colony.2070.desc.zh:
$colony.2070.intro$

我们无法确定，但考虑到包括传输的数据量在内的几个因素，我们认为有人正在积极使用网络并从中收集信息。我们已经在制定虚假信息的反间谍计划，并且正在全帝国范围内更新安全措施以应对这种形式的间谍活动。
colony.2070.desc.en:
$colony.2070.intro$

We cannot be certain, but considering several factors, including the volume of data transferred, we believe that someone is actively using the network and collecting information from it. We are already working on a counter-intelligence plan of disinformation, and security measures are being updated empire wide to account for this form of spycraft.

colony.2075.a.en: What can we learn from it?

colony.2075.desc.zh:
$colony.2070.intro$

考虑到包括传输的数据量在内的几个因素，我们认为该网络并没有仍在使用中。它仍然部分活跃的事实表明它可能只是处于休眠状态而不是损坏状态。
colony.2075.desc.en:
$colony.2070.intro$

Considering several factors, including the volume of data transferred, we do not think that the network is still in use. The fact that it is still partially active indicates that it is probably just dormant and not destroyed.

colony.2080.a.zh: 试试我们能否增强这个网络。
colony.2080.a.en: See if we can strengthen the network.

colony.2080.b.en: Use it to keep a closer eye on the colony.

colony.2080.c.zh: 拆解这个网络，但我们还是可以研究它。
colony.2080.c.en: We dismantled the network, but we can still study it.

colony.2080.desc.zh: 我们对这种真菌与菌丝体监听阵列的联系的所有疑虑，在经过简短的比较后很快就被打消了。这是与巨大蘑菇交流的众多后代之一，这可能是我们进一步了解这个生物体的好机会。
colony.2080.desc.en: Whatever doubts we had about this fungus' connection to the mycelial listening array were quickly dispelled after a brief comparison. This is one of the many offsprings communicating with the Fumongus, and this could be an opportunity to further our comprehension of the organism.

colony.2085.b.zh: 如果他们没有什么可隐瞒的，那么他们就没有什么可害怕的。
colony.2085.b.en: If they have nothing to hide, they have nothing to fear.

colony.2085.desc.zh:
关于我们使用当地菌丝体密切监测菌落的项目的消息已经传播开来，但并没有受到好评。尽管我们尽最大努力来缓和局势，但当地民众普遍认为这是违背相互信任的原则的，并要求我们立即终止该项目。

局势迅速升级，我们当地的执法人员不堪重负。如果我们选择继续这个项目，他们就需要我们的帮助来维持对殖民地的控制。
colony.2085.desc.en:
Word about our project to use the local mycelium to closely monitor the colony has spread, and it wasn't well received. Despite our best efforts to defuse the situation, the local population widely considers this as a breach of trust and are demanding that we put an end to this project immediately.

The situation is escalating quickly, and our local enforcers are overwhelmed. They would need help to maintain control of the colony if we choose to go on with the project.

colony.2090.desc.zh:
我们在 [Root.GetName] 上培养了菌丝体，并微调了本地计算设备以排除干扰。负责团队报告说，该网络现在正在密切监视殖民者。一些小罪犯已经受到了相应的制裁。

不幸的是，在其他地方复制安装的尝试都失败了。很可能是一些我们尚未知晓的因素在起作用。
colony.2090.desc.en:
We have grown the mycelium on [Root.GetName], and fine-tuned the local computing equipment to sort through the interference. The responsible team reports that the network is now closely monitoring the colonists. Already, a number of petty criminals have been sanctioned appropriately.

Unfortunately, attempts at replicating the installation in other places have met with failure. It is likely that some unknown factor is at play here.

colony.2095.desc.zh: 我们为促进菌丝体在[Root.GetName]上传播所做的努力导致了更多“传统”蘑菇的生长。一些殖民者的事件表明它们是可食用的。此事件使整个网络在一段时间内失去平衡，但现在它似乎稳定且正常运行。然而，整体上并没有明显的改善。看起来这些蘑菇只是用来储存水的。它们对网络没有贡献，它们的破坏也不会对网络产生影响。
colony.2095.desc.en: Our efforts to stimulate the spread of the mycelium on [Root.GetName] have resulted in the growth of more 'traditional' mushrooms. An incident with some colonists has shown them to be edible. This event has thrown the whole network off balance for a while, but it now appears to be stabilized and functional. However, no significant improvement has been noticed overall. It looks like these mushrooms are merely storage for water. They do not contribute to the network and their destruction has no impact on it either.

colony.3.desc.zh: 凝固汽油弹有效的摧毁了[From.From.GetName]上大部分的迁徙林木。生态学家在烈焰舔舐过的地方种上了比较传统且不会移动的异星植物。[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的野生生物损失惨重，但尚可接受。
colony.3.desc.en: A napalm bombing campaign has been effective in decimating the migrating forests on [From.From.GetName]. The massive firestorms have left a smoldering landscape in their wake, in which our ecologists have planted more traditional and significantly less mobile off-world trees. Losses to the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wildlife have been substantial, but within acceptable limits.

colony.3001.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上定居了一段时间之后，我们收集到了一些奇怪的数据。具体来讲，[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]的地质构成似乎与[Root.GetName]大相径庭。这意味着它不是与星球同时形成的，而是原本在别处形成，后来不知怎的被[Root.GetName]的重力场捕获了。至于[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]到底源自何处仍是个谜。
colony.3001.desc.en: Now that [Root.GetName] has been settled for a while, some data irregularities have been noticed. Specifically, the moon [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] does not seem to be made of remotely similar material to [Root.GetName]. This suggests it was not formed at the same time, but rather originally formed elsewhere and somehow was captured by the gravity of [Root.GetName] at a later date. Quite where [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] came from is currently a mystery.

colony.3002.desc.zh:
[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]的神秘面纱终于被揭开了！详细勘探后发现该卫星的质量分布不均匀，略微突出的一端占有异常大的质量比。我们认为，此现象的是因为[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]曾经环绕着某个现已因剧烈爆炸而消失的行星公转的缘故。

[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]密度大的一端曾经是面向那颗行星，而在行星爆炸时部分碎片冲击向[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]并合为一体，并且该冲击力最终将卫星撞进[Root.GetName]的引力范围中。

由于卫星远端地表上拥有较高浓度的暗物质，我们相信该爆炸的行星是被某种基于暗物质的武器或能源所毁灭。
colony.3002.desc.en:
The mysteries of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] have been revealed! A detailed survey revealed that the moon is slightly lopsided, with the far side of the moon having a disproportionately large share of the total mass. The reason for this, we believe, is that [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] once orbited another planet which was destroyed in a cataclysmic explosion.

The extra thickness on the far side of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] is because that was the side which faced its original planet, the extra material is part of the mass of that planet which was blown into [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName], knocking it out of orbit and sending it, eventually, into the orbit of [Root.GetName].

We speculate that the planet was destroyed by a weapon, or perhaps just an attempt to create a power source based on Dark Matter, as there are high concentrations of it in the planetary material coating the far side of the moon.

colony.3003.desc.zh: 谜团真是接踵而至。现在我们已经知道[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]是从另一个次元拖到，或是被送到了[Root.GetName]的轨道上。但我们仍不知道具体原因，因为除了背景辐射稍有差异之外，[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]似乎平淡无奇。至于在[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]中心发现的机器，它似乎可以进行次元转移，其原理就更令人费解了。目前对我们来说，这无异于是魔法。
colony.3003.desc.en: Unraveling one mystery has lead to another. We now know that [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] was drawn, or was sent, into the orbit of [Root.GetName] from another dimension. Unfortunately, we have no idea why, as besides a slightly different level of background radiation [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] seems utterly unremarkable. Still more baffling is how the machinery found at the center of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName], which presumably enabled the dimensional shift, works. For now, it might as well be magic.

colony.3005.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的偏远地区发现了一个只能被认是位面传送门的东西。天气预报算法发现了奇怪的气流，最终被认为是大气从传送门轻微泄漏造成的。大气流失的速度十分缓慢，对[Root.GetName]上的生活不会造成什么影响。但这个传送门的存在引起了一些令人担忧的问题，比如它通向哪里，以及会不会有什么东西从传送门另一侧穿过来？
colony.3005.desc.en: What can only be described as a dimensional portal has been discovered in a remote location on [Root.GetName]. Weather prediction algorithms noticed a strange air current, which was eventually determined to be caused by the slight leakage of atmosphere into the portal. The rate of loss is far too small for it to make any difference to life on [Root.GetName], but the very existence of this portal raises some disturbing questions, such as where does it lead to, and could something come through the portal from the other side?

colony.3006.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向某个从本质上对立于智慧意识的世界。与该位面的物质发生任何接触都会导致接触主题遭受强烈的痛楚，若持续超过几分钟则不但会产生自杀倾向，还会尝试毁坏自己的感觉器官。即便只是研究从这个怪异次元采集来的数据也会对电脑系统造成连锁性的故障，对智慧生物而言则会有一种仿佛自己的灵魂正在遭受腐蚀一般强烈的不适感。
colony.3006.desc.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm which is opposed to the sapient mind on a fundamental level. Any and all contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense suicidal urges coupled with attempts to mutilate their sensory organs. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes intense discomfort in the biological observer, and cascading errors in computer systems.

colony.3006.knight.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向某个邪恶的世界的。尝试跟该位面进行任何类型接触的生物体都会遭受到剧烈的痛楚，若是持续数分钟暴露在这种痛楚下，会产生强烈的暴力倾向。就连简单的采集该怪异位面的数据都会导致电脑系统出现不可修复的故障，或使得智能个体产生极大的不适。然而，我们发现骑士团的一件遗珍可以有效地保护佩戴者，并且可以让我们派出一名骑士进入。
colony.3006.knight.desc.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm of evil and disquiet. Any direct contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense violent urges. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes cascading errors in computer systems, or intense discomfort in sapient beings. However, we have found that one of the Order's relics wards its wearer effectively, and would allow us to send a single knight through.

colony.3006.prayer.zh: 祈祷能够找到解决方法

colony.3006.rocks.zh: 试试用石头填满传送门！
colony.3006.rocks.en: Try filling the Portal with rocks!

colony.3006.science.en: Find a way to close the Portal!

colony.3006.spir.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎通向了某个邪恶不安的世界。与该位面的物质发生任何接触都会导致接触主题遭受强烈的痛楚，若持续超过几分钟则不但会产生自杀倾向，还会尝试毁坏自己的感觉器官。即便只是研究从这个怪异次元采集来的数据也会对电脑系统造成连锁性的故障，对智慧生物而言则会有一种仿佛自己的灵魂正在遭受腐蚀一般强烈的不适感。
colony.3006.spir.desc.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm of evil and disquiet. Any and all contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense suicidal urges coupled with attempts to mutilate their sensory organs. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes cascading errors in computer systems, or intense discomfort in sapient beings due to the terrifying realization that one's very soul is being corrupted.

colony.3007.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向由纯能量所形成的世界。我们成功通过传送门汲取少量的能量过来我们的世界。这些能量“包裹”拥有开发成武器的潜力。
colony.3007.desc.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] leads to a dimension of pure energy, a small amount of which can be siphoned through the portal for our own use. The procedures used to handle discrete "packets" of energy also have potential use as a weapons system.

colony.3008.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门通往一个由纯粹的熵构成的次元。就连传感器都几乎无法取得读数，因为我们信号的能量很快就消散了。最具可信度的理论是，这一“太虚”的大多数零点能量都为负，任何曾经存在的正能量都早已耗尽。我们或许可以制造一种武器，将太虚的能量消散特性化为武器。
colony.3008.desc.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] leads to a dimension of pure entropy. It is difficult to even get sensor readings because the very energy of our pings is rapidly dissipated. Our best theory is that this "Null Void" is a dimension where the majority of zero-point energy is negative and so any positive energy which was once present has long since been used up. Knowing this, it might be possible to construct a weapon which can use the Null Void's energy destruction offensively.

colony.3009.desc.zh: 奇怪的是，[Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎通往一个与[Root.GetName]非常相似的星球。更奇怪的是，里面有一个信号正向我们传来……
colony.3009.desc.en: Strangely, the Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to connect to a planet which looks very much like [Root.GetName]. Stranger still, there's a signal being broadcast to us through it...

colony.3010.desc.zh: 我们发现传送门可以容纳几乎无限的能量，但关键字是“几乎”。通过以前所未有的规模生产能量，并对传送门进行持续轰炸，最终导致传送门过载并坍塌了。很显然，生产巨大能量的能力也可以用于其它领域。
colony.3010.desc.en: The Portal was determined to be able to handle almost unlimited energy input, but the key word is "almost". By generating energy at an unprecedented scale and continuously bombarding the Portal, it was eventually possible to cause it to overload and collapse in on itself. Needless to say, the generation of vast amounts of energy has the potential to be useful in other areas.

colony.3011.desc.zh: 传送门似乎会对附近观察者的思维产生某种反应，有些人产生的反应比其他人更大。通过筛选，我们挑选了一大群对传送门影响较大的人，用共同的意念关闭了传送门。这一经历启发了我们，并确实证明了信念的力量能被实际运用。
colony.3011.desc.en: The Portal seemed to react in some way to the thoughts of nearby observers, some more than others. Through a process of elimination it was possible to find a large number of people who were especially potent at influencing the Portal, and together they were able to effectively will the Portal to close. The experience was enlightening and provides strong evidence that it is possible to harness and direct belief in tangible ways.

colony.3011.psi.desc.zh: 我们发现传送门对灵能力非常敏感。因此我们召集了一些天赋异禀的个体，在传送门周围制造了一个灵能屏障，将它与世隔绝开。这一经历启发了我们，并且证明了用灵能创造实体屏障是可行的。
colony.3011.psi.desc.en: The Portal proved to be sensitive to psionic force. With an assembled team of gifted individuals, we created a psionic barrier around the portal, preventing any access. The experience was enlightening and provides strong evidence that it is possible to form solid barriers from psionic energy.

colony.3011.psi_robot.desc.zh: 我们发现传送门对灵能输入非常敏感。我们利用灵能单元在传送门周围创造了一个灵能屏障，避免未授权访问。该事件获取的数据会在未来研究中大有可用。
colony.3011.psi_robot.desc.en: The Portal has proven to be sensitive to psionic input. Through the use of our psionic units, a barrier has been constructed around the portal, preventing unauthorized access. The data from this event will prove useful in our future research.

colony.3012.desc.zh: 有时最简单的答案也是最好的答案。在将数座大山炸成碎石并倒进传送门之后，它似乎过载了，也有可能是被刻意关闭了。无论如何，我们仍将剩余的碎石倒在了传送门的位置上，以防止它再次开启。我们从这一经历中吸取了许多工程与采矿方面的经验，可以在其它领域派上用场。
colony.3012.desc.en: Sometimes a simple answer is the best answer. After blasting several mountains into gravel and dumping the result into the portal, it seems to have been overloaded. Or, perhaps, was deliberately shut down. Regardless, the remaining material was dumped on top of the site in case it ever re-opens. The experience of such a large engineering and mining project will also prove useful in other areas.

colony.3020.a.robot.zh: 校验错误：身份无效！这里是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]！表明你的身份！
colony.3020.a.robot.en: Checksum error: invalid ID! This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]! Identify!

colony.3020.desc.zh: 我是[Root.Owner.GetName]的[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]。传送门外星人，你们是谁？
colony.3020.desc.en: This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Who are you, Portal-aliens?

colony.3021.a.zh: 真神奇。告诉我们你们那的[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]过得如何。
colony.3021.a.en: Amazing. Tell us how your [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural] fare!

colony.3021.a.robot.zh: 一个未计算的变量。报告另一个[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的状况！
colony.3021.a.robot.en: An uncalculated variable. Report status of alternate [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

colony.3021.b.zh: 我们应该通过传送门进行贸易。
colony.3021.b.en: We should trade through our portal.

colony.3021.desc.zh: 这太神奇了。如果你说的是真的，我想这座传送门应该是连通平行世界的桥梁。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，但在某一时点上，我们各自次元中一定发生了某种差异，使我们的世界线产生了分歧。
colony.3021.desc.en: Fascinating. If what you say is true, I think this portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both the [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], but at some point an event must have caused our respective dimensions to diverge.

colony.3021.desc.robot.zh: **处理中！** 结果：这道传送门连通着次元之间的缝隙。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，来自不同的次元。
colony.3021.desc.robot.en: **PROCESSING!** Results: This portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], from divergent dimensions.

colony.3022.a.zh: 曲速引擎？我们用的是超空间航道！
colony.3022.a.en: The Warp Drive? We travel by Hyperlanes!

colony.3022.a.robot.zh: 错误！意外值：曲速引擎。预期值：超空间航道。
colony.3022.a.robot.en: Error! Unexpected value: Warp Drive. Expected value: Hyperlanes.

colony.3022.desc.zh: 我想应该和你们那边差不多。我们从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]向太空中发展，利用新发明的曲速引擎——
colony.3022.desc.en: Much the same as it fares in your dimension, I expect. We have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

colony.3022.desc.robot.zh: 在发明曲速引擎之后，[Root.Owner.Species.GetName]从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]开始向星海进发——
colony.3022.desc.robot.en: The [Root.Owner.Species.GetName] have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

colony.3023.a.zh: 没听说过什么曲速兽。它们构成了很大的威胁吗？
colony.3023.a.en: No Warp beasts here. Are they a serious threat?

colony.3023.a.robot.zh: 值未找到：曲速兽。查询：曲速兽威胁等级？
colony.3023.a.robot.en: Value not found: Warp beasts. Query: Threat level of Warp beasts?

colony.3023.desc.zh: 超空间航道？或许发现不同类型的超光速旅行方法，正是我们平行世界之间的分歧点？这是否意味着你们并未受到曲速兽的侵扰？
colony.3023.desc.en: Hyperlanes? Perhaps discovering different types of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes? Does this mean you are not beset by the Warp beasts?

colony.3023.desc.robot.zh: **处理中！** 结果：探索出不同类型的超光速旅行方式是我们宇宙之间的分歧点。查询：曲速兽袭击？
colony.3023.desc.robot.en: **PROCESSING!** Results: Discovering a different type of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes. Query: Warp beast assault?

colony.3024.a.zh: 听起来真可怕。我们能帮上忙吗？

colony.3024.a.robot.zh: 查询：你是否需要物质支援？
colony.3024.a.robot.en: Query: Do you require material support?

colony.3024.desc.zh: 曲速兽会攻击所有已知的文明。它们是所有生命之敌。据我们所知，一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界程度，曲速兽就会苏醒并攻击。已经有数个物种被它们消灭了，但目前我们还撑得住。
colony.3024.desc.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all life. As far as we have determined, once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

colony.3024.desc.robot.zh: 曲速兽袭击所有已知文明，它们是所有存在的威胁。假设：一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界值，曲速兽将觉醒并攻击。数个物种已灭亡，但目前我们仍撑得住。
colony.3024.desc.robot.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all existence. Hypothesis: Once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

colony.3031.desc.zh: 镜像次元[Root.Owner.GetName]报告称其经济形势大好。其原因包括我们之间的传送门贸易，以及最近在对抗曲速兽时取得了一系列胜利。
colony.3031.desc.en: The Mirror-Dimension [Root.Owner.GetName] reports that their economy is booming. Contributing factors mentioned were our Portal Trade, as well as recent victories over the Warp beasts.

colony.3032.desc.zh: 镜像次元[Root.Owner.GetName]报告称其经济最近较为萧条，原因是在对抗曲速兽时吃了一连串败仗。
colony.3032.desc.en: The Mirror-Dimension [Root.Owner.GetName] reports that their economy is in decline due to a series of defeats at the appendages of the Warp beasts.

colony.3033.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]已被吞噬。[Root.Owner.GetName]已陷落。据我们所知，[Root.GetName]是唯一残存的殖民地。四面八方都是曲速兽！它们来了！

**信号突然中断**
colony.3033.desc.en:
[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] has been consumed. The [Root.Owner.GetName] has fallen. As far as we know, [Root.GetName] is the last remaining colony. The Warp beasts are everywhere! They are here!

**The signal abruptly ends**

colony.3033.desc.robot.zh:
状态更新：[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]离线。[Root.Owner.GetName]战斗能力：理想值的23%。剩余殖民地网络：[Root.GetName]。预期结果：曲速兽将在2个太阳周期内完全胜利。错误！[Root.GetName]轨道内发现曲速兽活动！错误！

**信号突然中断**
colony.3033.desc.robot.en:
Status update: [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] offline. [Root.Owner.GetName] combat capacity: 23% of optimal. Remaining Colony network: [Root.GetName]. Expected results: Total Warp beast victory within 2 solar cycles.  Error! Warp beast activity detected in [Root.GetName] orbit! Error!

**The signal abruptly ends**

colony.3033.reply.en: **There is only the hiss of static**

colony.3040.desc.zh: 在多年的研究之后，[Root.GetName]上的某些研究者们觉得自己开始理解太虚了。有一些……波动。力量。一股流动轻柔地通过传送门流向[From.GetName]，并带来我们可以收集的微量暗物质。从理论上讲，我们应该可以使我们的传送门对这股波动更加“显眼”，以此产生更多的暗物质。
colony.3040.desc.en: After years of study, some researchers on [Root.GetName] are beginning to feel they understand the Null Void. There are... currents. Forces. Some flow which gently pushes against the portal to [From.GetName], bringing the traces of Dark Matter we are able to collect. In theory it should be possible to make our portal more "visible" to this force, which should result in a larger harvest.

colony.3041.desc.zh: 一座巨大的信号增幅器将一道能量射入了[Root.GetName]上的传送门。效果立竿见影，传送门另一端的压力明显开始增加，并涌出了更多的暗物质流。
colony.3041.desc.en: A vast signal amplifier has sent a blast of energy through the portal on [Root.GetName]. The effect was immediate, the pressure on the far side of the portal is noticeably stronger, and with it comes an increased flow of Dark Matter.

colony.3050.desc.zh: 多年前，我们派遣[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士穿过[root.GetName]上的位面传送门，如今此人回来了。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]形态扭曲，被黑暗笼罩，带领了一支恐怖之军穿过了传送门，立马开始袭击我们的殖民地。幸存者称他们听到[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]爆发出恶魔般的笑声，并宣称[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]将很快征服这个位面。
colony.3050.desc.en: Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName], whom we sent through the portal on [root.GetName] years ago, has returned. Twisted and darkened, [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] led a host of horrors through the portal and immediately assaulted our colony. Survivors reported hearing [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] erupt in a demonic cackle, claiming [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] would soon conquer this dimension.

colony.3051.a.zh: 我们要打败这些入侵者！

colony.3051.desc.zh:
[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士从传送门中带来的恐怖大军击溃了我们的防御，征服了[fromfrom.GetName]！

被强大的异次元实体夺舍后，[doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself]自号为[doomslayer_knight.GetTitle][doomslayer_knight.GetName]，[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]为[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]召唤了一支恶魔军队，并开始征服我们的星系！

很快，恒星系的各处开始涌现出更多的传送门，但现实的织构过于厚重。所有的奇点很快就坍缩了，将恶魔的军队与它们的家园位面隔绝开。[doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName]没有受到太大影响，并开始巩固[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的势力根基，以便继续[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的星系征服大业。
colony.3051.desc.en:
The horrors that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] led through the portal have breached our defenses and conquered [fromfrom.GetName]!

Possessed by a major dimensional being and now titling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself] as [doomslayer_knight.GetTitle] [doomslayer_knight.GetName], [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] has called upon [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] demonic forces to begin the conquest of our galaxy!

Additional portals briefly opened throughout the system, but the strain on reality was too great a burden. All the singularities soon collapsed, severing the demonic host from their home dimension. Undeterred, [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] is now consolidating [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] power base before proceeding with [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] plans of galactic conquest.

colony.3055.desc.zh: 我们数年前将[doomslayer_knight.GetName]送去[Root.GetName]上的传送门，现在这个传送门正在释放强烈的活跃信号，一些衣衫褴褛的平民似乎正试图穿越到我们的位面。他们汇报称，[doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName]骑士已经在他们的位面肆虐了十几年，无情地屠戮着任何出现在[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]面前的人。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]在那个未免杀害了那么多居民，甚至对他们的社会造成了毁灭性的影响。幸存者无助地向任何能抵达的地方逃亡。难道是这个位面的痛苦使[doomslayer_knight.GetName]陷入了疯狂？
colony.3055.desc.en: The portal on [Root.GetName] where we sent Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] years ago is showing intense signs of activity as ragged civilians appear to be attempting to cross into our dimension. They report that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] has been rampaging in their dimension for a decade now, mercilessly slaughtering everyone crossing [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] path. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] slew so many inhabitants of that dimension that a doom has befallen their society. The survivors are trying to flee anywhere they can. Could the existential pain caused by this dimension have driven [doomslayer_knight.GetName] to madness?

colony.3060.a.en: [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] is truly brave, ferocious and gallant!

colony.3060.desc.zh: 多年前，我们派遣[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士穿过[root.GetName]上的位面传送门，如今已经回来了。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]历经万难，击败了无数的敌人，几乎是侥幸地保全了[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的性命，但最终，没有什么能阻挡[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]的去路。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]带回了许多战利品，并在扈从间成为了传说，大家开始称[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]为“末日杀手”。
colony.3060.desc.en: Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName], whom we sent through the portal on [root.GetName] years ago, has returned. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] bested many a challenge, felled countless fiends and narrowly avoided [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] doom, but ultimately, nothing could stand in [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] way. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] brought back many trophies and has become a legend amongst the squires, who have begun calling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] "Doomslayer".

colony.4.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的迁徙林木卷土重来了！我们知道在偏远地区有数个小群系幸存，而且进入了冬眠期。它们似乎利用这段时间恢复壮大，现在正有组织的攻击我们的殖民点。它们拥有基本的智能，这与我们的推测正好相反，它们报复来了！
colony.4.desc.en:
The migrating forests on [Root.GetName] have resurfaced! We knew isolated pockets of their kind had survived in several remote areas, but they appeared dormant. It seems they used this reprieve to replenish their numbers, and they have begun to systematically attack our settlements.

Contrary to what we believed, they clearly possess some form of rudimentary intelligence, and they're out for revenge!

colony.5.desc.zh: 因[From.From.GetName]肆虐的植物，我们损失了许多殖民点和殖民者，但我们没有坐以待毙，而是将其斩草除根。部队配备有火焰喷射器，以确保不会有任何植株幸存。
colony.5.desc.en: Many settlements and lives were lost to the rampaging trees on [From.From.GetName], but we managed to push them back and exterminate the last of their kind. Squads equipped with flamethrowers are making absolutely certain that no trees are overlooked this time.

colony.50.a.en: We have to deal with this situation.

colony.50.desc.zh:
许多报告说[Root.GetName]有无法解释的地层活动。整个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能感受到震动，许多殖民点都因此受损。对地震进行调查时，科学家发现了庞杂的地下洞穴网络。

洞穴最深处栖居的是某种本土原始文明，它们正在挖掘通往地表的隧道！它们的行为可能是由殖民地的活动诱发，但我们无法确定。我们也无法预计它们与殖民者碰面之后会采取何种行动！
colony.50.desc.en:
There have been many reports of unexplainable seismic disturbances on [Root.GetName]. Tremors can be felt across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and many of our settlements have suffered damage. While investigating the earthquakes, our scientists discovered a vast network of subterranean caverns.

The deepest of these caverns is home to some kind of indigenous civilization - and they appear to be tunneling towards the surface! Ground vibrations from our settlements may have triggered this behavior, but we cannot be certain. There is no telling how these aliens will react when they spill out of their tunnels and encounter our colonists!

colony.50.desc.subterranean.zh:
许多报告说[Root.GetName]有无法解释的地层活动。整个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能感受到震动，许多殖民点都因此受损。对地震进行调查时，科学家在地幔中发现了庞杂的底下洞穴网络。

洞穴深处栖居的是某种本土原始文明，它们正在挖掘通往我们殖民地的隧道！它们的行为可能是由殖民地的日常活动诱发，但我们无法确定。我们也无法预计它们与殖民者碰面之后会采取何种行动！
colony.50.desc.subterranean.en:
There have been many reports of unexplainable seismic disturbances on [Root.GetName]. Tremors can be felt across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and many of our settlements have been damaged. While investigating the earthquakes, our scientists discovered a vast network of caverns in the mantle of the planet.

The deepest of these caverns is home to some kind of indigenous civilization - and they appear to be tunneling towards our colony! Everyday vibrations from activity in our settlements may have triggered this behavior, but we cannot be certain. There is no telling how these aliens will react when they spill out of their tunnels and encounter our colonists!

colony.5000.a.zh: 这可爱的小机器人帮助了我们真多。
colony.5000.a.en: How nice of the little creature to help us out.

colony.5000.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的神秘机器人对我们的殖民者从一落足于行星上起就非常欢迎。我们的许多定居者一开始不信任这个小机器人，但它对我们建立殖民地的过程难以置信地有帮助，并且在其中扮演了重要角色。

在头几年的殖民过程中，这个小东西在[Root.GetName]上的第一座城市诞生了衍生形象，并成为了整颗行星的吉祥物。
colony.5000.desc.en:
The enigmatic creature on [Root.GetName] has been very welcoming to our colonists after they settled down on the planet. At first many of our settlers were distrustful of the small robot, but it has shown itself to be incredibly helpful and has played a key role in establishing the colony.

Following the first years of the colony, the small thing has become something of a pet figure in the first cities on [Root.GetName], and a mascot for the planet as a whole.

colony.5005.a.zh: 那就让我们看看能不能帮上它。
colony.5005.a.en: Let us see if we can help it out then.

colony.5005.desc.zh:
这座由[Root.GetName]上的小机器人监管的工厂在殖民地建立的最初几年起到了重要作用。现在这些定居者们终于得以有时间了解他们的小吉祥物以及理解它不寻常的行为，他们了解到它看护了数个世纪的这座老旧的建筑已经残破不堪，并需要比它所能提供的更多的帮助。

尽管它的远古工程和机械对我们而言仍很陌生，但我们的工程师认为他们应该可以修好，只是需要一点时间。
colony.5005.desc.en:
The factory supervised by the little robot on [Root.GetName] has been instrumental for the colony in its early years. Now that the settlers have had time to get to know their mascot and understand its uncommon mannerisms, they have learnt that the old building it has taken care of for centuries is falling apart and needs more help than the creature can give it on its own.

Though its ancient engineering and machinery are still foreign to us, our engineers think they should be able to fix it, given time.

colony.5006.desc.zh: 在数年的缓慢剥蚀中，[Root.GetName]上的这座巨大工厂终于彻底瓦解。在清理完这座老建筑的废墟后，我们的殖民者发现了一个巨大的金属堆隐藏在原来建筑物中可能是地下室的位置。在它的正中央静静地躺着那个过去快乐地欢迎着我们来到这颗星球的机器人，它在这座它负责监管的工厂的倒塌过程中被压毁了。
colony.5006.desc.en: After years of slow decline, the great factory on [Root.GetName] has finally fallen apart. After clearing out all the debris from the old building, our colonists came across large piles of metal hidden away in what would have been the basement when it was still standing. In the middle of it all lies the robot that once so happily welcomed our settlers to the planet, crushed by the factory it was responsible for supervising.

colony.5010.desc.zh:
据报告，伴随着所有设备的突然停转，我们的工程师确信他们未能在[Root.GetName]上修复这座古老的工厂。由于未能找到失败的原因，他们开始放下工具离开大楼。就在这时引擎突然轰鸣起来。

不仅发动机重新工作了，而且我们的工程师似乎也意外地修复了工厂的其余部分——尽管还不清楚这是如何发生的。他们的报告最后还提到了一个小机器人，它看到工厂重新开始运作后跳起了奇怪的舞蹈。
colony.5010.desc.en:
Our engineers were certain they had failed at fixing the ancient factory on [Root.GetName], according to their report, when everything suddenly stopped. Unsure how they had managed to fail they began putting aside their tools and exiting the building, when suddenly the engine roared to life.

Not only is the engine working again, but our engineers seem to have accidentally managed to fix other parts of the factory as well - though it is unclear how that happened. Their report ends with a small description of the weird dance the little robot did when it saw its factory working again.

colony.5010.tt.zh: $d_hab_lonely_bot_deposit$殖民地特征现在产出1£volatile_motes£易爆微粒和1£exotic_gases£异星天然气。
colony.5010.tt.en: The $d_hab_lonely_bot_deposit$ Colony Feature now also produces 1 £volatile_motes£ Volatile Mote and 1 £exotic_gases£ Exotic Gas.

colony.5015.a.zh: 希望我们能解决这个问题，越快越好。
colony.5015.a.en: Let us hope we can solve this as quickly as possible.

colony.5015.desc.zh:
我们收到了[Root.GetName]上的人员的报告，似乎他们行星上的神秘机器人又带来了麻烦。最近它失踪了，它失踪的同时，恰好一些殖民者被报道从该行星上的一个城市消失。

虽然这两件事最初被认为是无关的，但人们已经开始将他们朋友和家人的失踪归咎于这个机器人。我们的工程师正在扫描该机器人所在的工厂自事故发生以来收到的几个信号，看看是否这些信号能发回这个机器人。
colony.5015.desc.en:
We have received a report from the people of [Root.GetName], as it seems once again they are having trouble with the enigmatic robot on their planet. Recently it has gone missing, and its disappearance coincides with the reports of several colonists vanishing from one of the cities on the planet.

Though they were originally assumed to be unrelated, people have started blaming the creature for their missing friends and family. Our engineers are looking into scanning several signals that the robot's factory has received since the incident, to see if it leads back to the creature itself.

colony.5020.a.zh: 那就把大家的小吉祥物变回来。
colony.5020.a.en: Let the people have their little mascot back, then.

colony.5020.b.zh: 让工程师把它拆了看看里面有什么秘密。
colony.5020.b.en: Have the engineers break it apart and see what mysteries it holds.

colony.5020.desc.zh:
在花费数周尝试追踪[Root.GetName]上的机器人的信号后，我们的工程师终于发现了一座深入地下的远古竖井。在地面下的深处，他们看到了一座远古的建筑，多数的失踪人口都在锁在其中，同时还有小机器人的残留物。

在唤醒了这些殖民者之后，我们发现他们都是某个教团的成员，意外地落入了这座废墟，当小机器人来试图解救他们的时候一切都开始崩塌。我们的工程师和这些人自己都不清楚到底是怎么陷入这个地方的，也不知道是什么东西停止了建筑的崩塌。

我们的工程师对深入研究那个已经损坏的神秘机器很感兴趣，想知道能从中获得什么信息。而另一方面，[Root.GetName]的人们则期望我们可以将这个小东西修复，变回原来的样子。
colony.5020.desc.en:
After spending weeks trying to track down the signals from the robot on [Root.GetName], our engineers have finally found an ancient shaft leading deep into the ground. Far below ground they came across an ancient structure with most of the missing people locked in some form of stasis, as well as the remains of the little robot.

After waking the colonists, we learn that all of them are part of some cult that managed to accidentally make their way into the ruins, and that everything was about to collapse on them when the little robot came to their rescue. It seems unclear to both our engineers and the people themselves exactly how they found themselves in a stasis, or what the creature did to stop the collapse of the building.

Our engineers are interested in looking into the enigmatic machine now that it is no longer functional, to see what we can learn from it. The people of [Root.GetName], on the other hand, are pleading with us to see if we can restore the little creature back to its former self.

colony.5020.tt.zh: $d_hab_lonely_bot_deposit$行星特征现在额外提供一个£job_robot_caretaker£机器人看护者岗位。
colony.5020.tt.en: The $d_hab_lonely_bot_deposit$ Planetary Feature now also have a £job_robot_caretaker£ Robot Caretaker job.

colony.51.desc.zh: 我们的钻探队拦住了正在[From.From.GetName]打洞的外星人。惊慌失措的外星工人冷静下来之后，钻探队成功与外星人领袖取得了联络。
colony.51.desc.en: One of our probes burrowed through the ground and intercepted the tunneling aliens on [From.From.GetName]. After the startled alien workers calmed down, the probe was successful in establishing communications with their leaders.

colony.52.a.en: Compliments to all service branches involved.

colony.52.desc.zh:
我们试图摧毁[Root.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人的行动获得了成功！我们设法让几条甬道在它们的工人头顶坍塌，容纳它们城市的几个地穴被我们注入了神经气体。

伤亡预测接近100%，同时，我们的安保力量对于把幸存者收拾干净这一点充满自信。
colony.52.desc.en:
Our efforts to destroy the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]. aliens on [Root.GetName] have met with success! We managed to collapse several of their tunnels on top of their workers, and the caverns that housed their cities have been flooded with nerve gas.

Casualty projections are close to 100%, and our security forces are confident they will be able to deal with any surviving stragglers.

colony.53.a.response.zh:
我们的帝国已经延伸到了已知世界的每一个角落，唯有我们头顶上的大空之境尚未到达。我们有很多发达的城市，地衣农场负责粮食供应，我们还能在甬道流淌的大河里面抓到鱼。

千年以来我们一直在探索这条路。我们的挖掘工通过石头听到了你们的城市传来的微弱回声，因此我们决定展开调查。
colony.53.a.response.en:
Our empire stretches across every pocket of the known world. Only the Great Nothing lies beyond our reach. We have many fine cities, supported by lichen farms and the fish we catch in large rivers flowing through our tunnels.

This has been our way for thousands of years. Our diggers heard the faint echoes of your cities through the stone, and we decided to investigate.

colony.53.b.en: We would like to coexist in peace.

colony.53.b.response.zh: 就这样吧，地表人！让我们和平共享这个世界。我们十分期待与你们进行交易。我相信双方都能提供许多有用的东西。我们将返回自己的城市，签订协议。
colony.53.b.response.en: Then so we shall, surfacer! Let us share this world together in the spirit of peace. We would be most interested in trading with your people. I believe we have much to offer one another. We shall return to our cities and make the arrangements.

colony.53.b.response.subterranean.zh: 那么我们应该，“握个岩”！让我们秉承和平的精神共同分享这个星球。我们非常愿意同你的人民进行贸易。我们相信双方有很多东西可以互通有无。我们应当回到自己的城市，着手起草协议。
colony.53.b.response.subterranean.en: Then so we shall, 'crustie'! Let us share this world together in the spirit of peace. We would be most interested in trading with your people. I believe we have much to offer one another. We shall return to our cities and make the arrangements.

colony.53.c.response.zh: 哈！我看要偃旗息鼓的是你们吧！我们本可共享和平，不过我们的军团已经准备好夺取浩瀚虚空，将其划入帝国的版图。支配万物乃我方使命。
colony.53.c.response.en: Ha! It is you who will submit to us! We could have lived side by side in peace, but now our armies will claim the Great Nothing and annex it to our empire. It has always been our destiny to rule all of creation.

colony.53.desc.zh: 这东西开了吗？能看见吗，地表人？我们知道你们来自石层之上，始自虚无之中。那里本不该有任何活物存在，但现实不是如此。你们想做什么？
colony.53.desc.en: Is this thing on? Can you see us, surfacers? We understand you hail from the Great Nothing that lies upwards, beyond the stone. It was assumed nothing living could exist there, but evidently this is not so. What are your intentions?

colony.53.desc.subterranean.zh: 是这里吗？你能不能看见我们，栖壳种？我们明白你们来自于更上层的大空之境，远在岩浆和岩石之上。我们以为没有生命可以在那里存活，但事实显然不是这样。你们的意图是什么？
colony.53.desc.subterranean.en: Is this thing on? Can you see us, crust-huggers? We understand you hail from the Great Nothing that lies even further upwards, beyond the magma and stone. It was assumed nothing living could exist there, but evidently this is not so. What are your intentions?

colony.54.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的穴居外星人在地表出现！大批军团正源源不断地从隧道中涌出，它们都装备着原始但致命的投掷武器。它们的先头部队已开始突袭殖民地。安保部队已作出回应，但需要后援！
colony.54.desc.en:
The subterranean aliens on [Root.GetName] have emerged on the surface! Large armies equipped with primitive yet lethal projectile weapons are spilling from the tunnels, and their vanguard has already begun an assault on our settlements.

Our security forces are responding, but we may need to send reinforcements!

colony.54.desc.subterranean.zh:
[Root.GetName]上那些住在熔岩里面的外星人涌入了我们的洞穴！一大批装备着原始但是依然能造成杀伤的武器的的军队挤满了隧道，它们的先锋部队已经开始攻击我们的聚居地。

我们的安保力量正在反击，但是我们可能需要立马进行增援！
colony.54.desc.subterranean.en:
The magma-dwelling aliens on [Root.GetName] have emerged into our caverns! Large armies equipped with primitive yet lethal projectile weapons are spilling from the tunnels, and their vanguard has already begun an assault on our settlements.

Our security forces are responding, but we may need to send reinforcements!

colony.56.a.zh: 我们必须解决这个问题，一劳永逸。
colony.56.a.en: We need to solve this problem for good.

colony.56.desc.zh: 我们的部队已将[From.From.GetName]的穴居外星人赶回它们的老巢，威胁暂时解除。但这不是长久之计，要不了多久它们就会卷土重来。我们必须突入地底才行，战术家已提出新的进攻方案。已添加到情报日志。
colony.56.desc.en:
Our forces have managed to drive the subterranean aliens on [From.From.GetName] back into their underground lairs, and they are contained for the moment. This is a temporary solution, however, and it is only a matter of time before they break out onto the surface again.

We need to strike at them below ground, and our strategists have devised a new attack plan. It has been added to the Situation Log.

colony.56.desc.subterranean.zh:
我们的军队设法将这些[From.From.GetName]上的原住民赶回了它们的岩浆巢穴，它们现在被遏制住了。不过，这不过是权宜之计——它们再次闯入我们的洞穴只是时间问题。

我们需要从地底对它们发动打击，战略参谋们已经设计出了一个新的进攻计划。这份计划已经被添加到情报日志。
colony.56.desc.subterranean.en:
Our forces have managed to drive the mantle-dwelling aliens on [From.From.GetName] back into their magma lairs, and they are contained for the moment. This is a temporary solution, however - it is only a matter of time before they break out into our caverns again.

We need to strike at them below ground, and our strategists have devised a new attack plan. It has been added to the Situation Log.

colony.57.desc.zh: 我们位于[From.From.GetName]上的军队遭到了屠戮，[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人现在完全控制了我们的聚居地！！它们使用一颗我们自己的卫星向我们发送了一条消息。
colony.57.desc.en: Our forces have been decimated on [From.From.GetName], and the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens have taken full control over all of our settlements! They are using one of our own satellites to send a message to us.

colony.58.desc.zh: 地表人！我们伟大的军团已将你们击败，你们城市中的一切都归我们所有。我们从你们的装置中学到了很多东西，我们的武器变得更加强力。不准再踏足这个世界！
colony.58.desc.en:
Surface creatures! Our glorious armies have bested you in battle, and the spoils of your cities are now ours to do with as we please. We have learned much from your machines, and our weapons are now more powerful than ever.

Do not approach this world again!

colony.58.desc.subterranean.zh:
栖壳种！我们光荣的军队在战斗中击败了你，你的城市中的战利品现在任由我们处置了。我们从你的机器中学到了很多知识，现在我们的武器比以前更加强大了。

不要再靠近这个星球了！
colony.58.desc.subterranean.en:
Crust-hugging creatures! Our glorious armies have bested you in battle, and the spoils of your cities are now ours to do with as we please. We have learned much from your machines, and our weapons are now more powerful than ever.

Do not approach this world again!

colony.59.a.en: Let us see what they have to say.

colony.59.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]的穴居外星人已突破地表！它们似乎只想进行小规模的探索与交易活动。它们也许愿意和殖民者和谐共存，进行大宗交易也不是不可能。它们的代表与我们取得了联系。
colony.59.desc.en: The subterranean aliens on [From.From.GetName] have emerged on the surface! Their excursion appears limited to small bands of explorers and traders. They may be willing to co-exist peacefully with our colonists, and perhaps even engage in trade. We have been contacted by one of their representatives.

colony.59.desc.subterranean.zh: [From.From.GetName]上那些住在岩浆中的外星人涌入了我们的洞穴！这些闯入者均呈小股团队，看上去都是探险家和贸易商。它们或许愿意同我们的殖民者和平共处，甚至进行贸易。它们的一名代表同我们建立了联络。
colony.59.desc.subterranean.en: The magma-dwelling aliens on [From.From.GetName] have emerged into our caverns! Their excursion appears limited to small bands of explorers and traders. They may be willing to co-exist peacefully with our colonists, and perhaps even engage in trade. We have been contacted by one of their representatives.

colony.6.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]发现了数个储量巨大的矿床，它们之前被植物覆盖了。现在树已成灰，开采不是问题。
colony.6.desc.en: We have discovered several significant mineral deposits that had previously been obscured by the roving forests on [Root.GetName]. Now that the trees have been reduced to ashes, the deposits are easy to access.

colony.60.a.en: We need to drive them back!

colony.60.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的穴居外星人聚集了大量军团，准备再次入侵地表！它们疯狂的军团又在挖掘隧道了。
colony.60.desc.en: The subterranean aliens on [Root.GetName] have marshaled enough forces in their underground empire to launch another invasion of the surface! Once again their frenzied armies are pouring out of freshly dug tunnels to challenge us.

colony.61.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]传来噩耗！同我们一直作战的[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人不知怎得，成功将隧道入口附近的一片平地弄塌方了，上面驻扎着一整支我们的军队。

零星幸存的士兵很快就被外星人屠杀了，他们甚至没能同我们军队的其他部分汇合。
colony.61.desc.en:
Grave news from [Root.GetName]! The [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens we have been fighting there somehow managed to collapse the ground under an entire army that was stationed near one of their tunnel entrances.

The few soldiers that survived the fall were quickly butchered by the aliens before they could be reached by the rest of our forces.

colony.62.desc.zh: 栖居于[Root.GetName]殖民地地下的外星人在夜间派出了数组突袭部队。它们摧毁了殖民地的一处主要设施，并在安保部队做出回应前就逃回了地下。
colony.62.desc.en: The aliens living below our colony on [Root.GetName] have been sending out small raiding parties from their tunnels at night. Their attacks have destroyed one of the colony's major installations, and before our forces could respond the raiders had vanished underground.

colony.63.a.zh: 一定要将凶手绳之以法。
colony.63.a.en: These murders will not go unanswered.

colony.63.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上又遭受了一次攻击！[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人在我们的一个主要聚居地正中央挖了一条新隧道，从里面冲了出来。它们相对于当地的防御部队呈压倒性优势，并肆无忌惮地屠杀我们的殖民者。零星的几个不断尖叫地幸存者被外星人拽入地底，随着它们撤退被一起带走。
colony.63.desc.en: There has been another attack on [Root.GetName]! The [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens emerged from new tunnels in the middle of one of our major settlements. They overwhelmed the local defenses and butchered our colonists. A few screaming survivors were dragged underground by the aliens when they retreated back into their tunnels.

colony.64.a.en: Yes. Put them out of their misery.

colony.64.b.zh: 不行！把它们带到地表，让它们为我们效劳。
colony.64.b.en: No! Bring them to the surface, where they shall serve us.

colony.64.b.subterranean.zh: 不行！把它们带到殖民地，它们可以为我们效劳。
colony.64.b.subterranean.en: No! Bring them to the colony, where they shall serve us.

colony.64.desc.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的部队仍然在测绘殖民地下面的隧道网络图。他们找到了一个属于[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人的大型城市，在我们打算往里面灌注神经气体之前，我们发现这个城市试图将自己同地下帝国的其他部分隔离开来。这个城市里有几百万心惊胆战的外星人。我们的工程师应该完成工作，让这个洞穴塌方吗？
colony.64.desc.en: Our forces on [Root.GetName] are still mapping the tunnel network below our colony. They have come upon a large city belonging to the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens that managed to isolate itself from the rest of their underground empire before we flooded it with nerve gas. There are millions of frightened aliens in the city. Should our engineers collapse the cavern to finish the job?

colony.65.desc.zh: 我们清理了[Root.GetName]隧道里的神经毒气和外星人尸骸。殖民者可以安全入住。外星人遗留的建筑将被拆毁，那里取而代之的将会是我们的先进建筑物。
colony.65.desc.en: We have finished clearing out the nerve gas and the dead alien bodies from the tunnel network on [Root.GetName]. It should now be safe for our colonists to move in. The primitive cities the aliens left behind will be demolished, of course, and replaced with our own advanced architecture.

colony.66.desc.zh: 勘探者们正冒险进入更加深处的隧道，这些隧道曾一度属于那已经灭亡的[Root.GetName]地底外星人帝国。他们终于找到了传言许久的金矿，据信地下外星人帝国从这获得了大量的贵金属储备。
colony.66.desc.en: Prospectors have ventured into some of the deeper tunnels that once belonged to the now dead subterranean aliens on [Root.GetName]. They have finally discovered the long-rumored gold mines where it was believed the underground alien empire acquired its large reserve of precious metals.

colony.66.desc.subterranean.zh: 勘探者们正冒险进入更加深处的隧道，这些隧道曾一度属于那已经灭亡的[Root.GetName]熔岩外星人帝国。他们终于找到了传言许久的金矿，据信地下外星人帝国从这获得了大量的贵金属储备。
colony.66.desc.subterranean.en: Prospectors have ventured into some of the deeper tunnels that once belonged to the now dead magma-dwellers on [Root.GetName]. They have finally discovered the long-rumored gold mines where it was believed the underground alien empire acquired its large reserve of precious metals.

colony.67.desc.zh:
侦察队在探索[Root.GetName]地下洞穴的时候发现了一处皇家宫殿，此地曾是外星帝国的首都。领袖的尸体依然端坐在大殿的宝座之上。

侦察队炸开宝库大门后，发现里面满是金子和外星艺术品。艺术品会被运回[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的博物馆，而这些金子能改善我们的财务状况。
colony.67.desc.en:
Scout units exploring the tunnel network on [Root.GetName] have entered the royal palace in what was once the capital city of the underground alien empire. The corpse of what passed for their emperor is still perched on a massive throne in the main chamber.

After using explosive charges to breach the palace treasury, our scouts found it filled with gold and strange alien art. The art will be shipped back to museums on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], and the sale of the gold should provide a nice boost to our state budget.

colony.68.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]最近又遭受了一波地震。看上去是，由于[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人没有进行维护，地下隧道网络的某些深层部分发生了塌方。我们的许多居民都遭受了损失。
colony.68.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has been racked by another wave of earthquakes recently. It seems that some of the deeper parts of the underground tunnel network has collapsed without the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens to maintain it. Many of our settlements have suffered damage.

colony.69.a.en: Of course. We will help however we can.

colony.69.b.en: They'll have to fend for themselves.

colony.69.desc.zh: 我们接见了[Root.GetName]上的一名[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人代表。看上去他们的帝国最近遇到了困难时期，而且它们正在受到饥馑的威胁。它们恳求我们提供一切可以提供的援助。
colony.69.desc.en: We have been approached by a delegation from the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens on [Root.GetName]. It seems their empire has fallen on hard times recently, and they are facing the threat of a famine. They are pleading with us to provide whatever assistance we can.

colony.7.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一个稀有金属矿床，之前被植物覆盖了。现在树已成灰，开采不是问题。
colony.7.desc.en: We have discovered a significant deposit of precious metals that had previously been obscured by the roving forests on [Root.GetName]. Now that the trees have been reduced to ashes, the deposit is easy to access.

colony.70.desc.zh: 作为庆祝两个文明之间友谊的礼物，[Root.GetName]上的地底外星人派出了一支商队，携带了大量的宝石来到地表。像这样的石头很明显是它们帝国前往尽可能靠近[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地核的深处，才能挖掘到的。
colony.70.desc.en: As a gift to celebrate the friendship between our two civilizations, a caravan from the subterranean aliens on [Root.GetName] has brought a large quantity of gemstones to the surface. Stones such as these are apparently mined by their empire deep underground, as close to the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s core as they dare to venture.

colony.70.desc.subterranean.zh: 作为庆祝两个文明之间友谊的礼物，[Root.GetName]上的岩浆住民派出了一支商队，携带了大量的宝石来到地表。像这样的石头很明显是它们文明前往尽可能靠近[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地核的深处，才能挖掘到的。
colony.70.desc.subterranean.en: As a gift to celebrate the friendship between our two civilizations, a caravan from the magma-dwellers on [Root.GetName] has brought a large quantity of gemstones to our caverns. Stones such as these are apparently mined deep underground, as close to the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s core as their civilization dares to venture.

colony.71.a.zh: 如果它们愿意的话，就留下吧。
colony.71.a.en: Let them join our colony if that is their wish.

colony.71.b.zh: 这种事情我们承担不起，把它们送回去。
colony.71.b.en: We can't afford a political incident. Send them back.

colony.71.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上出现了一大群来自地下外星人帝国的难民，它们从隧道中蜂拥而出来到地表，背后有一支小规模军队在追击。显然它们是某个宗教少数派的一部分；它们宣称自己是在逃避迫害。

如果我们让它们加入位于地表的殖民者团体，毫无疑问这会惹恼追捕它们的地下帝国统治者。然而，如果我们任凭追击军队将它们重新带回地下，这些人肯定会面临处决。
colony.71.desc.en:
A large group of refugees from the underground alien empire on [Root.GetName] recently streamed out of their tunnels onto the surface, chased by a small army. They are apparently part of some sort of religious minority; they claim to be fleeing persecution.

If we let them join our colonists on the surface, it will no doubt anger the rulers of the empire they fled from. However, if we let the pursuing army take them back underground, they will likely face execution.

colony.71.desc.subterranean.zh:
[Root.GetName]上出现了一大群来自熔岩住民帝国的难民，它们从隧道中蜂拥而出来到地表，背后有一支小规模军队在追击。显然它们是某个宗教少数派的一部分；它们宣称自己是在逃避迫害。

如果我们让它们加入位于上层地穴的殖民者团体，毫无疑问这会惹恼追捕它们的帝国统治者。然而，如果我们任凭追击军队将它们重新带回地下，这些人肯定会面临处决。
colony.71.desc.subterranean.en:
A large group of refugees from the magma-dweller empire on [Root.GetName] recently streamed out of their tunnels into our caverns, chased by a small army. They are apparently part of some sort of religious minority; they claim to be fleeing persecution.

If we let them join our colonists in the upper caverns, it will no doubt anger the rulers of the empire they are fleeing from. However, if we let the pursuing army take them back underground, they will likely face execution.

colony.7160.a.zh: 某种程度上，它们拯救了我们。
colony.7160.a.en: In a way, they saved us.

colony.7160.desc.zh:
当我们向这些沙生兽开放我们的殖民地时，没有人能够预料到这样的结果。这些小动物已经完美地适应了我们的生活方式，在我们的领土上，成为了家庭生活中的可爱伴侣。

它们的快速融入引发了一种猜测，即这些生物一定曾经被驯化过。无论是什么原因导致了它们与生俱来的友好，这个传言只增加了人们对这些非凡生物的更进一步兴趣。
colony.7160.desc.en:
When we opened our colonies to the desertlings, no one could have anticipated the results. The critters have adapted seamlessly into our way of life, becoming beloved companions in households all across our territory.

Their rapid integration has led to speculation that these creatures must at once time have been domesticated. Whatever the cause of their innate friendliness, the rumor only adds to the fascination surrounding these extraordinary creatures.

colony.7165.b.zh: 用围墙建立一个保留地。

colony.7165.desc.zh: 可怕的消息传来。几只沙生兽在运输过程中逃脱，形成了一个迅速扩大的野生种群。我们必须迅速处理这种情况，以避免环境崩溃。
colony.7165.desc.en: Dire news has reached us. A few desertlings have broken free during transportation, forming a rapidly expanding community in the wild. The situation must be handled swiftly to avoid an environmental collapse.

colony.7170.desc.zh: 我们在遏制猖獗的沙生兽侵袭方面取得了一定的成功。遗憾的是，我们无法根除这些难以捉摸的野兽。继续监测情况至关重要，因为它可能随时达到临界点。
colony.7170.desc.en: We have been moderately successful in curbing the rampant desertling infestation. Regrettably, we have been unable to eradicate the elusive beasts. It is crucial to continue monitoring the situation, as it could reach a tipping point at any moment.

colony.7175.a.en: The animals are here to stay...

colony.7175.b.zh: 我们可不会输给单纯的啮齿动物。
colony.7175.b.en: We will NOT lose a war to mere rodents.

colony.7175.b.tooltip.zh: 如果有必要的话，我们会摧毁整个行星。
colony.7175.b.tooltip.en: We'll destroy the entire planet if we have to.

colony.7175.desc.zh: 我们尝试控制沙生兽，结果是徒劳无功。这些贪婪的生物深挖洞穴，它们扩大它们殖民地的速度比我们消灭它们的速度还要快。除非我们允许我们的军队使用其庞大的爆炸物和有毒气体武器库，否则这场战斗就会失败，并将危及地面上每个人的安危。
colony.7175.desc.en: Our attempt to control the infestation of desertlings has been rendered futile. The voracious creatures have already burrowed deep, expanding their large colonies faster than we can exterminate them. The battle is lost unless we allow our military to use their vast arsenal of explosives and noxious gases, a course of action which would risk the well-being of everyone on the surface.

colony.72.desc.zh: 来自[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的几位异星学家，在花费了一大段时间同这个星球的[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星原住民同吃同住后，返回了[Root.GetName]的地表。他们学习了许多有关这个物种的古道和风俗的知识，这些毫无意外会对我们的社会学研究带来益处。
colony.72.desc.en: Several xeno anthropologists from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] have returned to the surface of [Root.GetName] after spending a great deal of time living among the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens native to that world. They have learned much about their ancient ways and customs, which will no doubt benefit our society research.

colony.7230.a.en: Find out why the planet is heating.

colony.7230.a.tooltip.zh: 这能是什么原因引起的呢？

colony.7230.desc.zh:
[planet.GetName]的最新气候报告带来了一项令人担忧的结论。奇怪的是，冷冻行星上的表面温度一直以惊人的速度上升。

如果我们无法确定生态系统迅速恶化的原因，这种情况可能会导致行星广阔冰川的灾难性融化。
colony.7230.desc.en:
The latest climate report from [planet.GetName] has come to a concerning conclusion. Inexplicably, the surface temperature on the frozen planet has been rising at an alarming rate.

If we fail to identify the reason for the ecosystem's rapid deterioration, the situation could lead to catastrophic melting of the planet's vast glaciers.

colony.7235.b.en: It is about time the ice age ended.

colony.7235.desc.zh:
[flooding_planet.GetName]上温度的升级正在急剧加速。这引起了冰冷的表层之下出现了巨大裂缝，揭开了广阔的地下海洋。

幸运的是，我们的调查已经确定了这种现象的潜在原因。由于我们的存在，保护行星的独特大气盾已经开始变得出极其脆弱，并随时可能崩溃。采取严格的措施来遏制我们的生产力将最大程度地减少我们对生态的影响。这样做应该足够解决这个问题。
colony.7235.desc.en:
The escalation of temperatures on [flooding_planet.GetName] is accelerating dramatically. This has caused substantial fractures within the icy surface layers, unveiling a vast subsurface ocean.

Fortunately, our investigations have identified a potential cause for this phenomenon. Due to our presence, the unique atmospheric shield safeguarding the planet has begun to exhibit critical fragility and could potentially collapse. Implementing stringent measures to curb our production would minimize our ecological impact. It might be enough to solve the issue.

colony.7240.b.tooltip.zh: 停止全部生产活动直到找到解决方案。
colony.7240.b.tooltip.en: Halt all production until a solution is found.

colony.7240.desc.zh:
我们在[flooding_planet.GetName]上排放量做出限制的尝试并未产生理想的的结果。我们在解决持续性生态危机方面的仅仅略有成功，由于海平面上升，地理意义上的低地正受到威胁。

目前，我们的人口中心仍然免受直接影响，但几乎可以肯定的是，行星范围的全面融化不可避免。
colony.7240.desc.en:
Our attempt to limit our emissions on [flooding_planet.GetName] has not yielded promising results. We have been only marginally successful in addressing the ongoing ecological crisis, and geographical lowlands are coming under threat due to the rising sea levels.

At present, our population centers remain shielded from immediate impact, but it is almost certain planet-wide meltdown cannot be avoided.

colony.7245.desc.zh:
在我们忽视迅速恶化的[flooding_planet.GetName]生态状况后，局势已逐渐陷入前所未有的灾难。

巨大的冰盖的瓦解导致海洋蔓延，带来了巨大的破坏和动荡。建造防洪大坝，我们可以保护其余的城市，但更多的不可预见的后果将会接踵而至。
colony.7245.desc.en:
In the wake of our neglect to address the rapidly deteriorating ecological state of [flooding_planet.GetName], the situation has spiraled into an unprecedented cataclysm.

The disintegration of vast ice sheets has given rise to sprawling oceans, leaving behind immense devastation and upheaval. By building flood barriers we can protect our remaining cities, but more unforeseeable consequences still linger on the horizon.

colony.7247.a.zh: 我们中头奖了，赶快开采！

colony.7247.b.zh: 永霜冻土已经遭受了太多的痛苦了。

colony.7247.b.tooltip.zh: 我们不能冒着恶化局势的危险。
colony.7247.b.tooltip.en: We cannot risk worsening the situation.

colony.7247.desc.zh: 随着[flooding_planet.GetName]行星的持续融化，在永霜冻土下有一个有趣的发现。无人知晓，无人开发且惊人丰富的矿物和稀有资源的极地宝库整静静地等待着我们。
colony.7247.desc.en: As the meltdown of the planet [flooding_planet.GetName] continues, a fascinating discovery was made beneath the permafrost. An astonishingly abundant polar reservoir of minerals and rare resources lies waiting, beckoning us with untold wealth and untapped potential.

colony.7250.a.zh: 不要冒险。立刻给该区域消毒。
colony.7250.a.en: Take no chances. Sanitize the area.

colony.7250.desc.zh:
我们在[flooding_planet.GetName]上的极地开采站出现了令人不安的进展。工人们突然失去意识，为了安全起见，必须建立严格的禁止通行区域。

最初的调查表明，由于冰冷的环境被改变，休眠病毒的苏醒过来。这种苏醒的病原体的真实本性和特征仍然未知，这给我们带来了许多未解难题。它的传播性及对人民构成的潜在危险程度仍然不确定。
colony.7250.desc.en:
A disconcerting development has unfolded at our polar mining station on [flooding_planet.GetName]. Workers have succumbed to sudden bouts of unconsciousness, necessitating the implementation of a stringent no-pass zone for their safety.

Initial investigations suggest the emergence of a dormant virus, awoken as its icy confines were disturbed. The true nature and characteristics of this awakened pathogen remain uncertain, leaving us grappling with a multitude of unanswered questions. The extent of its transmissibility and the potential danger it poses to the people remains undetermined.

colony.7255.a.zh: 真是令人难以置信的发现。

colony.7255.desc.zh:
在[flooding_planet.GetName]极地地区的空洞深处，一个采矿团队发现了巨大的财富。在冰雪层的面纱之下发现了像冰川一样雄伟的巨大晶体。

这些非凡的结构，是在无数的岁月中在巨大的压力下铸造的，这证明了这里存在我们尚未发现的无限潜力。
colony.7255.desc.en:
In the hollowed depths of the polar regions of [flooding_planet.GetName], a mining team has made a discovery of monumental proportions. Veiled beneath layers of ice and snow, colossal crystals reminiscent of majestic glaciers were found.

These extraordinary formations, forged under immense pressure over untold ages, stand as a testament to the unlimited potential we have yet to uncover.

colony.7260.a.en: At last, the climate is stable again.

colony.7260.desc.zh:
我们已经达到了环境突破。

燃料燃烧产生的无害副产物，与[flooding_planet.GetName]的细菌云接触时产生了奇特的副作用。我们现在知道，这些云通过遮蔽恒星光芒来保留行星的自然生物节律，这点至关重要。随着细菌逐渐开始减少，我们无意中加剧了排放的影响。

凭借这种新发现的知识，我们已迅速制定了措施以恢复平衡。
colony.7260.desc.en:
We have reached an environmental breakthrough.

The innocuous byproducts generated through the combustion of our fuels harbor an insidious side-effect when coming to contact with [flooding_planet.GetName]'s bacterial clouds. We now know that these clouds play a vital role in retaining the planet's natural biorhythm by working as a solar shield. As the bacteria slowly begun to diminish, we inadvertently exacerbated the effect of our emissions.

Armed with this newfound knowledge, resolute measures have been swiftly enacted to restore the equilibrium.

colony.7265.desc.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]最后一个冰川沉入海洋，新时代随即开始。永霜冻土的消失揭露出一个宽敞的水下领域，那里面充满了未开发的资源。
colony.7265.desc.en: A new climatic era begins as the last vestiges of [flooding_planet.GetName]'s glaciers sink into the ocean. The disappearance of the permafrost has uncovered an expansive underwater realm, filled with untapped resources.

colony.73.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]最近又遭受了一波地震，我们的好几个聚居点都发生了建筑倒塌，并且出现了重大伤亡。[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人帝国正在地下深处发掘一个新的地穴，并计划在这里建造一个新的城市，显然这一举动就是地震的源头。
colony.73.desc.en: There has been a wave of earthquakes on [Root.GetName] recently, and buildings in several of our settlements have collapsed with many fatalities as a result. The [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] alien empire is excavating a new cavern deep underground where they plan to build a new city, and this appears to be the source of the earthquakes.

colony.74.a.zh: 给野蛮人现代武器太危险了。
colony.74.a.en: Arming savages with modern weapons would be a bad idea.

colony.74.b.zh: 它们是盟友，所以要有福同享。
colony.74.b.en: They are our friends. Share what we can.

colony.74.desc.zh:
在见识过我们的安保部队装备的先进武器后，[Root.GetName]上的几位[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人帝国的将军求见我们，希望我们分享一些军用科技。

我们的军官在犹豫是否应该同意，因为同以前相比，这么做之后会让我们更难在战场上击败这些外星人。然而，如果我们拒绝，这些外星人会将其视作一次羞辱。
colony.74.desc.en:
After seeing the advanced weapons that our security forces are equipped with, several generals from the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] alien empire on [Root.GetName] have come forward requesting that we share some of our military technology.

Our own officers are hesitant to do this, as it would make the aliens more difficult to defeat in battle should it ever come to that. If we refuse the request, however, the aliens are certain to view it as an insult.

colony.75.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上同[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]的贸易似乎最近就要见到头了，因为他们的商队出现得越来越罕见。今天，我们收到了他们军方的一名代表的消息。他们看上去不是很满意。
colony.75.desc.en: Trade with the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens on [Root.GetName] has dried up as of late, with their caravans showing up more and more seldom. Today we received a message from a representative of their military. They don't seem very pleased.

colony.76.desc.zh: 地表人。我们不准备以礼相待了，因为你们不懂得对古老而光荣的文明表现出应有的尊重。因此贵方宣布要夺下这个世界，它本就属于我们。我们要把你们赶回天空去！
colony.76.desc.en:
Surfacer. We tried to be good neighbors, but it has become clear that you have no intention of treating us with the respect our glorious civilization deserves.

Our emperor has thus decreed that we must claim this entire world for ourselves, as is our right. We shall drive you back to the stars from whence you came!

colony.76.desc.subterranean.zh:
栖壳种。我们试图当一名好的邻居，但是很明显，你方毫无意愿按照我们光荣的文明应得尊重来对待我们。

我们的皇帝据此降下敕令，我们必须将整个星球据为己有，这是我们理所应当的权利。我们要将你们赶回星辰，你们从哪里来滚回哪里去！
colony.76.desc.subterranean.en:
Crust-hugger. We tried to be good neighbors, but it has become clear that you have no intention of treating us with the respect our glorious civilization deserves.

Our emperor has thus decreed that we must claim this entire world for ourselves, as is our right. We shall drive you back to the stars from whence you came!

colony.8.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上已被消灭的迁徙林木在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]生态系统中的作用比我们预计的更加重要。我们点燃的野火和森林的缺失导致数个本地种群消灭，连锁反应使得几种捕食者也消灭了。我们正努力通过从外星引入新的植物群系和动种群类以恢复当地脆弱的生态，但这个过程任重而道远。
colony.8.desc.en:
It would appear the migrating forests we exterminated on [Root.GetName] played a more vital role in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s ecology than previously thought. The wildfires we started and the absence of the forests have led to the extinction of several local species, resulting in a domino effect that has claimed several species of predators as well.

Efforts are ongoing to at least partly restore the fragile ecological balance by introducing new flora and fauna from other worlds, but it is a difficult process that will take time.

colony.8001.desc.zh: 来自[Planet.GetName]殖民地的报告显示:星球上的“返祖现象”正不断增加。显然相当一部分人口已经表现出迄今为止前所未有的性欲与攻击性，而没人知道这是为什么。
colony.8001.desc.en: Reports from our colony on [Planet.GetName] claims that there's been an increase in 'feral behavior'. Apparently parts of the population has expressed hitherto unprecedented levels of lust and aggression, and no one knows why.

colony.8002.a.en: This is getting out of hand.

colony.8002.desc.zh: [Planet.GetName]上的返祖现象没有要停止的迹象。事实上自从上次报告以来，事态愈演愈烈。滥交与暴力事件每时每刻都在发生，极大部分人口都沦陷其中。
colony.8002.desc.en: The feral behavior on [Planet.GetName] shows no signs of stopping anytime soon. In fact, it has risen since the last report. Promiscuous and violent acts happen all the time, and a large part of the population seems to be affected.

colony.8003.desc.zh: [Planet.GetName]上的情况正在迅速失控。不论造成这场返祖狂潮的罪魁祸首是什么，它都已经感染了惊人数量的当地居民并使得殖民地开始分崩离析。因此，我们要么开始行动，要么就会失去[Planet.GetName]。
colony.8003.desc.en: The situation on [Planet.GetName] has spiraled out of control. A staggering number of inhabitants are now infected with whatever is causing this feral deluge, and the colony has started to break down because of it. Something needs to be done, or [Planet.GetName] will be lost.

colony.8004.desc.zh:
对困扰[Planet.GetName]的奇异返祖现象的调查已经完成。我们在遍布整个地壳的洞穴隧道网络中找到了一种神秘的真菌。它长满了整个洞穴——地面，墙壁，天花板，并且蔓延了上千里。

这些真菌频繁地释放孢子排出洞穴，其目的尚不明确。但我们可以肯定正是这些孢子释放了我们物种原始的欲望并使起产生返祖现象。

我们可以为这些真菌找一个用武之地，或是干脆将其全部灭绝。
colony.8004.desc.en:
The investigation of the strange and wild behavior currently besetting [Planet.GetName] has been completed. In the vast network of cave tunnels that permeates the planet's crust an enigmatic fungus has been found. It grows all over the caves - floor, walls, ceiling - and stretches out for thousands of miles.

The fungus frequently releases spores that are vented out of the caves - for what purpose has not been established, but we know for certain that it causes primitive behavior in our species, releasing primal urges within.

We can try to find a useful application of this phenomenon, or we can exterminate the fungus altogether.

colony.8005.desc.zh:
大批工业设备在生长真菌的洞穴系统出口处建造起来。除了过滤并控制这些孢子的传播以外，这些工厂也能将多余的孢子云转化为有用的异星天然气。

由于[Planet.GetName]上有点饥渴的当地居民更频繁地满足自己的性欲，人口增长速率得以提高。与此同时不幸的是[Planet.GetName]的暴力行为也将更为频繁。
colony.8005.desc.en:
Industrial facilities have been built over the outlets for the fungus-infested cave systems. Apart from filtering and regulating the spread of spores, these plants can also convert any excess spore clouds into useful exotic gases.

The population growth is increased as the somewhat randy inhabitants of [Planet.GetName] satisfy their urges more frequently, which unfortunately also means that the level of violence and conflict is somewhat higher on [Planet.GetName].

colony.8006.desc.zh:
将洞穴蘑菇彻底燃尽的计划现在已经完成，这些激发原始冲动的菌类现在已经被彻底铲除。

碰巧的是，许多被清理过后的洞穴被发现原来潜藏着高品质的矿脉，现在也可以被我们更加妥善地利用了。
colony.8006.desc.en:
The project to incinerate all Cave Mushrooms have now been completed and the primal urge-inducing fungus has been exterminated.

As luck would have it, several of the burned-out caves turned out to have rich mineral veins, which can now be exploited further.

colony.9.desc.zh: 随着殖民者与[Root.GetName]漫游植物之间交互的加深，我们发现那些植系有基本的社会智能。它们似乎意识到了我们的存在，即使不使用昆虫信息素，它们也会主动改变路径，避免造成破坏。殖民者欢喜鼓舞。
colony.9.desc.en: Continued interaction between our colonists and the wandering forests on [Root.GetName] has revealed that the trees are in possession of some form of rudimentary communal intelligence. They seem to have adapted to our presence, and now go out of their way to avoid damaging the property of our colonists even without the use of the insect pheromone. Spirits among the colonists have risen.

colony.9000.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]遇到了奇怪的情况：我们显然定居到了某种巨大的两栖爬行动物身上，他们的骨质外壳由多种奇特的矿物构成。许多我们认为是当地岛屿的其实都是这种生物，我们的殖民者则将他们称为“尼玛”。

他们看起来人畜无害，由于我们并没有深入他们的外壳，他们应该几乎没注意到我们。
colony.9000.desc.en:
Our colony on [Root.GetName] has encountered an odd situation: we have apparently settled on the back of a gargantuan amphibian reptile, whose bony shell is formed of various exotic minerals. Most of what we thought were local islands have turned out to be these creatures; our colonists have begun to refer to them as 'Nemmas'.

They seem harmless enough, and as long as we don't dig too deep into their shell, they should barely notice us.

colony.9005.b.zh: 让这些年轻人玩儿去吧。

colony.9005.b.gestalt.zh: 我们之后尽量避免再刺激到这些生物。
colony.9005.b.gestalt.en: We will avoid agitating the creatures further.

colony.9005.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地正在繁荣发展，这个新殖民地的青少年当然要为自己创造一些娱乐，就像所有年轻人都会做的一样。一个团体发明了一种互相比拼悄悄接近当地尼玛头部的游戏。

不幸的是，这一大胆的行动导致了悲剧：在惊吓到了这只巨兽之后，一些年轻的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从这只巨大生物的颈部坠落，造成多名人口受伤，其中一位不治身亡。

烦躁的殖民者现在要求实施一些举措来应对这些“残暴的巨兽”。
colony.9005.desc.en:
As our colony at [Root.GetName] has been flourishing, the adolescents of this new world have sought to create entertainment for themselves - as youths are wont to do. Some groups have made a game of sneaking up as close as they dare to their local Nemma's head.

Unfortunately, this daring activity has led to tragedy: after startling the beast, several young [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fell off the neck of the massive creature, resulting in injuries and one fatality.

Distraught colonists are now asking for something to be done about these "brutish behemoths."

colony.9005.desc.gestalt.zh:
在我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地繁荣发展时，显然尼玛对我们前往其头部的无人机感到非常地不适。特别是在这只野兽畏缩并从它的脖子上甩下了许多[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，造成明显损失时尤为明显。

如果不进行一些举措处理这些巨兽我们的进展将会受到影响。
colony.9005.desc.gestalt.en:
While our [Root.GetName] colony has been flourishing, it has become apparent that Nemmas have a strong aversion to our drones venturing near their head. This became starkly apparent when one such beast flinched and dislodged several [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from its neck, causing severe damage.

Our progress will be restrained unless we do something to handle these behemoths.

colony.9010.a.zh: 繁育更多尼玛，并保护他们的安全以获得更多生存空间。
colony.9010.a.en: Breed more Nemmas and safeguard them for more living space.

colony.9010.b.zh: 奴役这些尼玛，让他们为我们所用。
colony.9010.b.en: Enslave the Nemmas so that they become deferential and compliant.

colony.9010.c.zh: 够了！摁住这些尼玛，钻取他们的外壳。
colony.9010.c.en: Enough! Sedate the Nemmas, and start drilling their shells.

colony.9010.desc.zh:
派遣我们最好的生物学家和工程师为[Root.GetName]上的尼玛困境寻找潜在的解决方案，许多提案现已经完成可以呈交。

我们考虑了从最普通到最极端的所有想法。这一情况的紧迫程度要求我们直接跳到现场调研查中。
colony.9010.desc.en:
Having tasked our best biologists and engineers with devising potential solutions for the Nemma dilemma on [Root.GetName], several proposals are now ready to be presented.

We've considered everything from the most rational to the most extreme of ideas. The urgency of this situation demands we must skip straight to live field tests.

colony.9015.desc.zh: 在一些对成年个体的初步试验之后，我们的动物学家已经在[Root.GetName]上设立了一个尼玛繁育系统，以期为海洋带来更多的巨大尼玛。繁育者提示，这不可能无限地进行下去，因为这颗行星只能再承载额外三只或者四只尼玛。我们得到下一只尼玛的时间大约需要十年。
colony.9015.desc.en: After initial trials with the adult specimen, our zoologists have set up a Nemma breeding system on [Root.GetName] in the hopes of introducing more giant Nemmas to our oceans. The breeders warn that this cannot continue indefinitely, and that the planet can only support three, perhaps four more Nemmas. The estimated time until we have our next Nemma should be about ten years.

colony.9020.a.zh: 叹为观止！能再表演一遍那个吗！

colony.9020.b.gestalt.zh: 对这个项目而言真是令人满意的结果。
colony.9020.b.gestalt.en: This is a satisfactory conclusion to the project.

colony.9020.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的繁育计划结出了硕果，另一只尼玛加入了我们的行列！这个幼年个体很快适应了我们的存在，而我们发现它是一座稳定的栖息地。这只尼玛现在已经准备好承载我们的产业了。
colony.9020.desc.en: Our breeding program on [Root.GetName] bears fruit as we add another Nemma to our ranks! This juvenile has quickly acclimated to our presence, and we have found it a stable habitat. The Nemma should now be ready to bear our industry.

colony.9020.desc.full.zh:
$colony.9020.desc$

然而，由于已经达到了生态承载上限，这将会是这个星球上最后一只新增的尼玛。我们的牧尼玛人必须在繁育尼玛之外寻找新的着力点，就是说他们需要更好地维护已有的尼玛。
colony.9020.desc.full.en:
$colony.9020.desc$

This will, however, have to be the last Nemma added to this world, as their habitat has reached capacity. Our Nemma wranglers will have to refocus their efforts not on breeding more Nemmas, but instead on maintaining what they already have created.

colony.9025.desc.zh: 难过的是我们最近尝试在[Root.GetName]增添另一只尼玛的努力失败了；我们无法为这么巨大的生物寻找到足够的栖息空间。但[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]并没有沮丧，并且承诺未来会取得更好的结果。
colony.9025.desc.en: Sadly the latest effort to add another Nemma to [Root.GetName] has failed; we could find no habitat spacious enough for such a massive beast to thrive. The [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are not dismayed, however, and promise better results in the future.

colony.9030.a.zh: 棒极了，现在我们可以开始干点正事了。
colony.9030.a.en: Excellent work, now our true work can begin.

colony.9030.desc.zh:
我们的外星生物工程师[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]成功驯服了尼玛威胁！由于我们不懈的努力，这些生命现在向我们臣服了。

这些尼玛获得了新的用途：最高级的驮畜。他们庞大的躯体使得他们可以搭载难以计量的材料，由神经植入体引导选择最优的路线。我们的殖民活动也由此得到了加速。
colony.9030.desc.en:
Our xeno-bioengineering [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have curtailed the Nemma menace! Thanks to our superb efforts, the creatures are now subservient to us.

The Nemmas have been granted renewed purpose as superlative beasts of burden. Their colossal bulk allows them to carry immense quantities of materiel, guided down optimal routes by way of their cybernetic implants. Our colonization effort has accelerated accordingly.

colony.9035.b.zh: 逮捕煽动者然后让他们去扫大街。
colony.9035.b.en: Arrest the instigators and put them on waste disposal duty.

colony.9035.desc.zh:
今天在[Root.GetName]上爆发了一些骚乱，部分人口奋起抗议我们对尼玛的对待方式。这些抗议者在围着尼玛的头部也就是殖民首府的所在地排成了人墙。抗议者要求我们立刻将尼玛放归自由，并致力维系这些物种而不是奴役他们。

这一运动很快扩散到了其他尼玛身上的其他地方——然而，利于我们目前计划的反抗议也在形成，公共矛盾逐渐升级，并有爆发出暴力冲突的危险。
colony.9035.desc.en:
Today riots broke out on [Root.GetName] as parts of the population have risen in protest against our treatment of the Nemmas. The protestors formed a picket line around the head of the Nemma on which the colony's capital lies. The protestors demanded that we immediately set all the Nemmas free, working to conserve their species rather than enslave them.

The movement has quickly spread to sites around the other Nemmas - however, counter-protests have formed in favor of our existing programs, escalating public tension and risking outbursts of violence.

colony.9040.desc.zh: 我们的工程师和生化学家实现了自我超越。新开发的药物和极度精确的钻头让我们可以在不威胁到我们基础设施的前提下通过钻入这些尼玛的坚硬晶质外壳中获取矿物，同时还能获取生物质。我们所有的殖民地中只有这里可以产出这样的资源。
colony.9040.desc.en: Our engineers and biochemists have outdone themselves. Newly developed drugs and extremely precise drills will allow us to harvest the minerals by drilling into the hard crystalline shell of these Nemmas, as well as allowing us to collect biomatter from beneath without jeopardizing our infrastructure. If only all our colonies could yield such bounties.

colony.9045.a.zh: 这是对待这些无脑野兽的最佳方法。
colony.9045.a.en: The only way to handle such mindless beasts.

colony.9045.desc.zh: 对尼玛的净化已经完成了——极度地系统化，因此既没有污染海洋也没有威胁到我们的基础设施。很快我们可以将我们的注意力转移到收获它们的尸骸中，并在[Root.GetName]上建立更多的永久殖民地。首先，我们得先储存好这些残羹剩饭。
colony.9045.desc.en: The purging of the Nemmas has been completed - all very systematically, so as not to pollute the oceans or otherwise endanger our infrastructure. Soon we can turn our attention to the task of harvesting their remains, and establishing a more permanent and enduring colony on [Root.GetName]. First, however, we need to store all the leftovers.

colony.9045.name.zh: 消灭这些长寿的爬行动物

colony.9050.b.zh: 批准经费，进行深层勘探。

colony.9050.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的地质勘探揭示了这颗行星远比我们之前预想的更加富有矿藏。在调节了我们的传感器以后它便可以扫描更深的地下，发现了许多大有前景的矿场。我们应该委派更多的人力物力进行勘探，或许可以发现更深处的有用矿脉。
colony.9050.desc.en: Geological surveys on [Root.GetName] have revealed that the planet is richer in minerals than we thought. After calibrating our sensors to penetrate deeper into the ground, we have discovered several promising mining sites. Should we direct additional resources to probing efforts, we might yet uncover deeper veins of useful ore.

colony.9055.desc.zh: 探测[Root.GetName]的地下是一个冗长的过程：我们的探测器对地下构成的响应不佳，地质构造中的断层又使得我们需要频繁地调整仪器。然而，我们还是发现了更多值得开发的高价值矿石。它们的深度使得开采作业的后勤工作远复杂于往常，但无论如何这应该都是值得的。没有迹象表明进一步的了勘探作业可以让我们找到更多矿脉了。
colony.9055.desc.en: Probing the underground of [Root.GetName] is a tedious process: our scanners do not react well to the ground composition, and shifts in the geological layers mean that we have to recalibrate them every time. Still, we have discovered more exploitable veins of high quality ore. Their depths makes the logistics of the mining operation more complex than usual, but it will take more than that to stop us. There is no assurance that additional probing operations will lead us to more mineral veins.

colony.9060.desc.zh: 最近在[Root.GetName]的勘探作业几乎一无所获。我们所能找到的其他的矿藏全部都埋藏过深、储量不大，而且处于不稳定的地层当中。开采这些矿物的成本将会高于开采所得的利润。尽管如此，我们此前的发现已经表明此处的资源极其丰富，我们需要数十年乃至上百年的时间才能开发完毕。
colony.9060.desc.en: The latest prospecting efforts on [Root.GetName] were inconclusive. Whatever minerals we could detect were buried too deep, in too small quantities, and through unstable ground. The projected costs of exploiting these veins would be higher than the profits. Despite this, our previous findings represents an enormous source of resources that should keep us busy for decades if not centuries.

colony.9065.a.zh: 我们已经找到够多了，开始开采吧。

colony.9065.desc.zh: 无论在[Root.GetName]上的矿物藏得多深，我们都要找到它们，开采它们。我们一直就是这样的。其他人也许面对不稳定地层、令人望而却步的深度和采矿运输的后勤工作面前退缩，而我们绝不。底下世界就是我们的家园，只要找准方向定能有所收获。往下挖得越深，矿物的品质和储量就越高。我们最新的采样甚至表明了深层中稀有水晶的存在。
colony.9065.desc.en: No matter how deep the minerals on [Root.GetName] are hidden, we will find and extract them. It is what we do. Others might give up when confronted with unstable grounds, unfathomable depths or the logistics of maintaining transport tunnels, but we do not. The underground is our home, and if we know where to look, it will provide. The lower we go, the higher the quality and quantity of the ore. Our latest samples even hinted at the presence of rare crystals deeper.

colony.9070.a.zh: 这些勘探工作花销过高了。
colony.9070.a.en: These probing works are too expensive.

colony.9070.b.en: Then a digging we shall go.

colony.9070.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的勘探队已经抵达了最新的深度。如预期一样，灯光所及之处，我们果然找到了一丛丛闪耀着橙色、黄色和红色的灵动光芒的晶簇。它们有的看起来如同照亮洞穴的火盆，在岩壁上投下斑驳的光影。我们还有一个谜一样的发现：如果以千年尺度来观测，这些晶体似乎在缓慢地向行星的地心移动。我们相信，如果向地心挖得更深的话我们一定会有更多发现。
colony.9070.desc.en: A new depth has been reached by our surveying expeditions on [Root.GetName]. As predicted, we are encountering clusters of crystals that shine in vivid hues of oranges, yellows, and reds when light passes through them. At times, it looks as if a brazier is illuminating the caves where we find them, casting shifting shadows on the walls. We also made a puzzling observation: it looks as if over the millennia, these crystals are slowly migrating towards the center of the planet. We are confident that there will be more to find if only we dig deeper towards the core.

colony.9075.desc.a.zh: $colony.9075.intro$以前我们用来安抚太空晶体的无线电信号都没有起作用。$colony.9075.outro$
colony.9075.desc.a.en: $colony.9075.intro$ All attempts to deploy the radio signals that we use to pacify spaceborne crystals have failed. $colony.9075.outro$
