colony.9075.desc.b.zh: $colony.9075.intro$在太空中我们的舰队可以以高机动性和火力来取胜于这些晶体，但在行星上我们对它束手无策。$colony.9075.outro$
colony.9075.desc.b.en: $colony.9075.intro$ It is one thing to face such an entity in space where our ships can bring their speed and weapons to bear, but another entirely to fight them planetside. $colony.9075.outro$

colony.9080.desc.zh: 经过精疲力竭的斗争，盘踞于行星核心的晶态实体终于被击败了。最终的决战发生在深层地下，这只晶体巨兽核心的巢穴当中，只有将其击碎才能彻底停止它的活动。它的诸多附肢瓦解了，在分子层面发生了分解，在整个行星上散播着晶体尘埃。晶体的触手钻出的无数隧道将让我们在挖取构成这颗行星深层的富矿获得巨大的便利。至于这个晶态实体的起源我们仍还有诸多未解之谜，但我们也对太空中的晶体是如何创造出来的获得了一些见解。
colony.9080.desc.en: After a grueling campaign, the crystalline entity dwelling at the heart of a planet has finally been defeated. The final battle took place deep underground, in the cave housing the core of the crystal behemoth, and only after we managed to shatter it did the beast stop fighting. Its various appendages disintegrated, losing cohesion at a molecular level and sprinkling crystal dust across the planet. The innumerable tunnels left in the wake of crystal tentacles are going to help us a lot in our efforts to mine the exceptionally rich minerals composing this world. As for the origin of the entity itself, we are left with many questions, but we might have just gained some insight on the way that spacefaring crystalline entities are created.

colony.9085.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的开采作业遇到了意外的困难，包括一些小规模的地震和晶体矿脉的位移，总之发生了一些什么奇怪的事情。穷尽我们所有关于开采的经验都无法解释到底是怎么回事。这些情况使得我们很难保证开采作业的安全，我们已经在一些无法预测的事故和塌方中损失了一些设备、人员和矿石。也许我们应该适可而止，在一定的深度停止采矿。
colony.9085.desc.en: Our mining operations on [Root.GetName] have encountered unexpected difficulties. Ranging from mild tremors to shifting crystal veins, something is going on. Despite all our experience in tunneling, we have no idea what it is. These circumstances make it hard to work in secure conditions, and we have already lost gear, lives and ore in unpredictable accidents and collapses. Perhaps it would be best to halt mining operations under a certain depth?

colony.9200.a.desc.zh: 建起供电网络需要花费一些时间，并且会在探索地下舱室的过程中持续地消耗能量。
colony.9200.a.desc.en: Setting up the grid might take some time, and will continue to sip the energy during the exploration of the vault.

colony.9200.desc.zh:
在一次对[Root.GetName]的例行探索中，行星探索单位发现了一座巨大的大门，其后很可能具有整座大山规模的内部空间。看来是其中隐形装置发出的某种强磁场导致飞船的探测器没有发现这里，而伪装过的大门也让使其对地表测绘探测器隐形了。

另一方面，更专门的测试显示，向其输入稳定的能量流应该可以让大门重新激活，最终也让我们得以一窥其后的秘密。
colony.9200.desc.en:
During a standard reconnaissance of [Root.GetName], the planetary exploration unit came across a massive door that apparently leads directly into the interior of a mountain range. It appears that the strong magnetic field produced by some sort of cloaking device hid it from our ship's sensors, and the camouflaged entrance remained invisible to the autonomous research probes mapping the surface.

On the other hand, more specialized tests have shown that delivering a steady stream of energy should make the door operational again, eventually allowing us to open it and see what's inside.

colony.9201.a.zh: 我们会研究其中的秘密。

colony.9201.a.desc.zh: 由于该工程规模浩大，彻底研究它将花费许多资源、人力以及不可预估的时间。预计会就这项工程的进展进行周期性汇报。
colony.9201.a.desc.en: Given the scope of this operation, it will take a lot of resources, workforce, and an unknown amount of time to study it thoroughly. Regular updates and reports on their work are somewhat to be expected.

colony.9201.b.zh: 我们不能冒这个险，安放炸药。
colony.9201.b.en: We can't risk it, place explosives.

colony.9201.b.desc.zh: 我们将封闭入口，并炸毁这个地方。没人知道在地下舱室里到底是会有什么东西在等着我们。
colony.9201.b.desc.en: We will seal the entrance and demolish this place. Who knows what might lurk inside this vault.

colony.9201.desc.zh: 能量从电路中流过，大门再一次被激活，经过简单的修修补补我们很快明白了大门的工作原理。进一步的拓扑研究揭示了其内部是一个巨大的地下舱室。墙上的每一寸都覆盖着外星基础设施，甚至包括支撑天花板的巨大支柱也释放出若隐若现的能量信号。由于能量读数和与我们科技的模糊相似性，这似乎是一座地下的生产设施。
colony.9201.desc.en: As energy flowed through the circuits, the entrance came online, and with additional tinkering, we quickly discovered how the door worked. Additional topographical research revealed the interior to be a large underground vault. Alien infrastructure covered every square centimeter of the walls - even the huge pillars supporting the ceiling showed faint energy signatures. Given the energy readings and vague similarities to our technology, it appears to be an underground manufacturing facility.

colony.9202.desc.zh:
距离地下舱室很远的人也能感受到大地在震颤，而近一些的人甚至可以看到硕大的山体碎块飞向空中，在地上产生了一个巨大无比的凹坑，其中散布着岩石、碎片和扭曲的机械部件。关于到底发生了什么事情，有一个很简单的猜测，在试图通过爆破炸毁大门的时候，设施内发生了一系列连锁反应。

不论如何，这座地下舱室最终只剩下这个冒着烟的大弹坑了。
colony.9202.desc.en:
Those far from the vault could feel the ground shake. Those closer could see a large chunk of the mountainside fly off into the air, creating a huge crater filled with rocks, debris, and twisted machinery. A quick guess as to what could have gone wrong led to the conclusion that a chain reaction was set in motion inside the vault when the initial explosion breached the door.

Regardless, a smoking crater is all that is left of the underground vault.

colony.9210.a.zh: 增派安保力量并搜救他们。
colony.9210.a.en: Double the security forces and search for them.

colony.9210.a.desc.zh: 我们会组建一支搜救团队，但许多居民已经料到了最坏的可能。我们还会增派安保人手以避免这种情况再次发生。
colony.9210.a.desc.en: We will form a search team, but a lot of citizens already anticipate the worst. We will also double the guards to prevent further incidents.

colony.9210.b.zh: 不惜一切代价找到他们！

colony.9210.b.desc.zh: 我们不能放任他们不管！我们要组建一支志愿队搜寻失踪者！
colony.9210.b.desc.en: We can't leave them to die! We will make a volunteer squad to look for the missing!

colony.9210.c.zh: 组建搜寻队，让其他人继续工作。
colony.9210.c.en: Form a search party, and put the rest back to work.

colony.9210.c.desc.zh: 可以预见这样的事情可能还会再次发生。我们会尝试找到失踪的工人，但是行动不能拖延，我们已经做好了牺牲的准备。
colony.9210.c.desc.en: It was expected that something like this might have happened. We will try to find the missing workers, but we can't delay our operations - we are ready to pay the price.

colony.9210.d.zh: 令人不安。派遣更多安保子个体。

colony.9210.d.desc.zh: 失踪的单位会有新的顶替上去，研究要继续。
colony.9210.d.desc.en: Missing units will be replaced with new ones. The research has to continue.

colony.9210.desc.zh:
研究[Root.GetName]的第一阶段主要关注对入口的测绘。地下舱室的第一个房间是一个巨大的直深入山体的大厅，分支的走廊则又通向更深处。石雕的柱子上装饰着许多华丽的牌匾，每一块上面都描绘着可能是建造这座设施的外星种族。我们无法破译他们的语言，但由这些图画记叙的故事都以战争、纷争和奇迹般的工程为主体。

更恼人的是有一整个建设单位失踪了；他们在汇报了黑暗中发出的某种声响之后就消失得无影无踪。局势有一发不可收拾的风险，需要更多果断举措。
colony.9210.desc.en:
The initial phase of research on [Root.GetName] was largely focused on mapping the entrance. The first room within the vault is a giant hall, stretching deep into the mountain, with several branching corridors pushing even further into the depths. Various ornate plaques decorate stone chiseled pillars, each depicting the alien race that presumably built this place. We can't decipher their language, but the story told by those art pieces are centered on warfare, struggle, and grandiose projects.

More disturbing is the loss of an entire construction unit; after reporting the presence of strange sounds in the dark, the unit simply vanished. The situation is in danger of slipping out of control and calls for more decisive action.

colony.9211.desc.zh:
我们的一支安保队伍汇报他们找到了失踪的工人。看来这个地下舱室中用于将不速之客关进“小盒子”的陷阱和装置还在运作中，这些设施由可以自行移动的墙体组成。

那些不走运的工人被陷阱杀害了。我们的民众对结果非常愤怒，但至少我们知道该留心什么东西了。
colony.9211.desc.en:
One of our security teams reports that the missing workers have been found. It turns out that this vault still has operational traps and devices that were programmed to trap unwanted visitors within "boxes" comprised of dislocated and moving walls.

The unfortunate workers were all killed within the trap. Our citizenry is furious at the result, but at least now we know what to look for.

colony.9212.desc.zh: 在派出了大量的搜救团队之后，我们很快就找到了失踪的工人。发现他们的时候，他们正被关在一个立方体牢房一样的结构中，这似乎是由自由移动的墙体构成的。看来地下舱室中的安保系统还在运作，因此，我们之后会更小心地应对这些陷阱装置。尽管如此，人们还是对工人起初没有得到妥善保护而感到愤怒。
colony.9212.desc.en: Given the enormous search team, it didn't take long to find the missing workers. The last of them were discovered trapped in a square prison-like structure made of articulated and self-moving walls. It appears that the security systems within the vault are still operational. Given this, we will be more prepared to counter such contraptions in the future. Nonetheless, the population is angry that the workers were not provided with proper safety measures in the first place.

colony.9213.a.zh: 他们早就知道这其中的危险。

colony.9213.desc.zh: 失踪的工人在一处怪异的陷阱装置中找到了，他们被四面可移动的墙体困在了里面。不幸的是这些个体已经不再对帝国有什么用处了，但至少他们的牺牲揭示了陷阱的存在。现在工作可以继续畅通无阻地进行，而在这里工作的人们心里的石头也落地了，他们知道自己至少现在是安全了。
colony.9213.desc.en: The missing workers were found in a grotesque contraption that imprisoned them between four movable walls. Unfortunately, these individuals are no longer of any use to the empire, but at least their sacrifice revealed the existence of the trap. The work now continues undisturbed, and the population working on the site feels some relief, knowing that they should be safe - for now.

colony.9214.desc.zh: 失踪的子个体在一处由可动墙体构成的精巧的陷阱装置中找到了，它们可以互相勾连形成密闭空间。不幸的是这些子个体都已经过度损坏、不堪再用。之后我们的调查子个体就可以利用这些知识来对抗同类陷阱了。工作得以不受干扰地继续进行下去。
colony.9214.desc.en: The missing drones were found in an ingenious contraption of moving walls that linked together to create enclosed prison spaces. Unfortunately, all of our drones are damaged beyond use. From now on, our surveying drones will use this knowledge to neutralize traps of this kind. Work continues without any further disturbances.

colony.9220.a.desc.zh: 这就是一些没用的陈旧艺术作品，没什么价值。
colony.9220.a.desc.en: It's just a useless piece of old art, with no real value.

colony.9220.b.desc.zh: 我们的一些工匠对这些外星人的作品赞不绝口。他们在这些艺术中找到了远古之美与和谐的启迪。
colony.9220.b.desc.en: Some of our craftsmen are astonished by the work created by those aliens. They find a hint of old beauty and harmony in their art.

colony.9220.c.desc.zh: 我们的人民发现这些石雕实在是精美绝伦，在这样一个陌生的地方发现如此绝品真是令人欣慰。
colony.9220.c.desc.en: Our people find the stonework to be of absolutely extraordinary quality, which is very soothing to find in such an unfamiliar place.

colony.9220.d.desc.zh: 这个地方仿佛就是由我们自己最好的石匠和艺术家打造而成的，难道仅仅是巧合吗？
colony.9220.d.desc.en: This place looks almost like the work made by our greatest stonemasons and artificers. Is this a mere coincidence?

colony.9220.desc.zh: 我们对[Root.GetName]通道的探索发现了一座大堂，奇怪的是这个房间并不像所有其他的一样密布着机械和管道。看起来建造者对这里特别用心，其中安放着许多保存良好的双足动物雕塑。这些雕塑具有一定的细节，但大多具有统一的外观。不幸的是，除了对可能是历史人物的一些纪念性致敬之外，没有证据表明这个大厅有什么作用。
colony.9220.desc.en: We delved into the corridors at [Root.GetName] and discovered a large hall, which is strangely devoid of the pipe machines covering every other hallway and wall. It looks like whoever built this place took special care of it - there are many statues here in excellent condition, depicting bipedal individuals. With some traces of detail they have mostly a uniform appearance. Unfortunately, there is no evidence of what this hall was, other than some monumental tribute to probably historical figures.

colony.9230.b.zh: 那就用那台笨重的东西。

colony.9230.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]的地震探测器发现了一场即将到来的地震。虽然大部分工人安全无虞，但其中一组在深处舱室的工人可能遭遇塌方的危险。他们汇报称有两台不一样的远古机器，一台是连接到地面的笨重装置，另一台则通过一系列管道连接到墙体上。我们暂不清楚哪一台对这处设施更加重要。工人们估计他们可以拆解其中一台机器用于加固墙体和天花板以应对地震。
colony.9230.desc.en: Our seismographs have detected an impending earthquake on [Root.GetName]. Most of the workers have found safety, but one group is in a remote hall that could be at risk of collapse. They reported two distinct, ancient machines there - one being a bulky contraption connected to the ground, and the other attached to the walls via a series of pipes. We can't say if they are anything important for the facility. The workers have estimated that may be possible to use one of those machines to reinforce the ceiling and walls against the quake.

colony.9231.desc.zh: 我们的工人拆解了机器，并成功地巩固了承重结构和天花板。然而，在这之后墙体暴露出了更多的管道，从中逸出嘶嘶声。目前我们无法评估潜在的损失。
colony.9231.desc.en: Our workers managed to disassemble the machinery and have successfully bolstered the strength of the supports and ceiling. However, this effort exposed extensive piping in the walls, from which a hissing noise escapes. Right now, it's impossible to assess the potential losses.

colony.9232.desc.zh: 我们的工人拆解了机器，并成功地巩固了承重结构和天花板。不过代价到底是什么呢？将那台沉重的机器移除后，地面出现的巨大的空洞把我们引向了机械的更深处。这一行为的潜在损失到目前为止完全不能预估。
colony.9232.desc.en: Our workers managed to disassemble the machinery and used it with success to bolster the strength of the old supports and the ceiling - but what was the cost really? Removing the bulky machine resulted in a gaping hole in the ground leading deeper inside the machinery. Potential losses to this action are, for now, completely unknown.

colony.9233.desc.zh: 我们的工人能够正确评估局势，并设法在不破坏古老机械的前提下修复并加强支撑。
colony.9233.desc.en: Our workers were able to properly assess the situation and managed to repair and strengthen the supports without destroying the ancient machinery.

colony.9234.desc.zh: 收集了许多子个体的感官印象后，我们找到了更好的方案：我们以少量低级子个体为代价巩固大厅确保了安全。
colony.9234.desc.en: Gathering the sense impressions of various drones, a better solution was found: the hall has been strengthened to a safe degree at the cost of a few menial drones.

colony.9240.a.desc.zh: 我们会试着用动力工具和重型机械撬开大门。如果运气好的话，我们应该不会碰上别的问题就能打开它。
colony.9240.a.desc.en: We will try to pry open the doors with power tools and heavy machinery. With some luck, we will be inside with no further problems.

colony.9240.b.desc.zh: 有时候暴力就是最好的解决办法。安置炸药尽快炸开它。
colony.9240.b.desc.en: Sometimes the violent approach is the best approach. Set explosives and be done with it.

colony.9240.c.desc.zh: 心急吃不了热豆腐。毕竟这里已经发现了那么多陷阱，有时候还是别匆忙用直接手段解决。
colony.9240.c.desc.en: Let's not be hasty. We encountered various traps before. Sometimes it's better not to rush with obvious solutions.

colony.9240.d.desc.zh: 我们擅长用不寻常的手段解决各种各样的问题，我们一定能找到其他进入的办法。
colony.9240.d.desc.en: We are skilled in overcoming problems with unusual solutions, so we might be able to find other way inside.

colony.9240.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的探索终于让我们获得了一些洞见。我们最初的预计是正确的：该地下设施事实上是一座巨大的工厂。对外星语言的进一步的分析显示，它被称为“国王锻造厂”。然而，这座锻造厂其实并没有被启用，它的建造者显然缺乏完成这项工程的技术。

只要我们能深入到锻造厂的核心，我们应该就能完成他们未竟的工作。尽管这条通道被厚重的大门阻挡，我们的工程师坚信他们一定能解决这个问题。由于这扇大门并没有任何显而易见的闭锁或开启机制，显然我们可能需要对其施加一些强力手段才能继续推进。
colony.9240.desc.en:
Our exploration on [Root.GetName] finally yielded some insights. Our first assessment turned out to be correct. The vault is in fact a giant foundry. Further analysis of the alien language reveals that it was referred to as a King-Forge. However, the Forge was never operational - its builders apparently lacked the technology to see the project through to completion.

It should be possible for us to finish their work as long as we can get into the heart of the foundry. Although the way is blocked by heavy doors, our engineers insist they can be overcome. However, as the doors don't have any obvious locking or opening mechanisms, a certain application of force will be required before we can proceed.

colony.9240.e.desc.zh: 我们的子个体可以轻松地切割大门的材料。虽然需要花费一些时间，但是我们有的是时间。
colony.9240.e.desc.en: Our drones will cut through the doors with ease. It will take some time, but we have all the time in the cosmos.

colony.9241.desc.zh: 在强行突破大门后，覆盖墙面的机械开始泄露有害气体。不幸的是这一切发生得太突然，造成了大量的伤亡。整座设施的工作人员需要紧急撤离，需要等到气体散去之后才能重新安全地进入设施。
colony.9241.desc.en: After forcing the doors, the machinery covering the walls started to leak hazardous gas. Unfortunately, this happened too quickly, and the result was further casualties. The entire facility needed to be evacuated, and will have to be left for some time before we can safely reenter.

colony.9242.desc.zh: 炸开大门是很容易，但我们没有料到的是爆炸后有气体开始涌入通道。这种气体高度易燃，并且摧毁了一部分原有的机器。幸运的是所有人都已经撤离了爆炸波及的区域，没有人员伤亡。
colony.9242.desc.en: Opening the door with explosives was easy, but what we didn't anticipate was the gas that poured into the hallway after the explosion. It turned out that the gas was highly flammable and destroyed some of the ever-present machinery. Fortunately, there was no one in the blast zone, so there were no casualties.

colony.9243.desc.zh: 无论是运气好还是圣灵眷顾，这一座之前阻碍我们去路的大门对我们今早的仪式产生了反应。它发出微微的共振，并且我们可以试着操纵它。在一处小标记隐藏着的摄像机镜头前做出正确的一套手势可以解开门锁让我们畅通无阻地进入。
colony.9243.desc.en: Whether by luck or divine intervention, the same door that blocked the way forward responded to our morning rituals: a faint harmonic resonance was detected, a resonance we were eventually able to manipulate. The correct set of gestures made in front of a small marking that concealed the lens of a camera ensured that we gained unobstructed entry.

colony.9244.desc.zh: 在进一步的研究后，我们很快发现了门的后面隐藏着一个安保相机或扫描仪。骇入相机是一个更困难的任务，但我们能够解码它的程序和基础功能，然后就能简单地获取通过大门的方法了。
colony.9244.desc.en: After additional research, we quickly recognized something in the door that served as a security camera or scanner. Hacking into it was a more difficult task, but we were able to decipher its programming and basic functions - thus gaining access to the door without further complication.

colony.9245.desc.zh: 看来钻穿大门的过程中我们的子个体激活了某种防御机制，过道的内部释放出了某种化学气体武器。幸运的是我们的集体意识能够采取恰当的应对措施，很快这些气体就散去了。这些子个体已经回去继续工作了。
colony.9245.desc.en: It appears in drilling through the door, our drones activated some defensive mechanism that unleashed weaponized gas inside the corridor. Fortunately, the Collective was able to take proper precautions, and soon enough the gas had dissipated. The drones have already returned to work.

colony.9250.a.desc.zh: 我们会把机器接入行星电网并且修复它。
colony.9250.a.desc.en: We will plug the machinery into the planetary power grid and fix it.

colony.9250.b.desc.zh: 我们不仅要修复机器，还要研究它的工作原理。
colony.9250.b.desc.en: Fixing the machinery is not enough - we need to learn how it works.

colony.9250.c.desc.zh: 这座锻造厂可以为帝国做出贡献，并为我们提供关于原住民的潜在知识。
colony.9250.c.desc.en: This foundry will serve the empire and provide us with potential knowledge about its original inhabitants.

colony.9250.d.desc.zh: 这座锻造厂将会为蜂巢做出贡献，并为我们提供关于原住民的潜在知识。
colony.9250.d.desc.en: This foundry will serve the hive and provide us with potential knowledge about its original inhabitants.

colony.9250.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的锻造厂的核心是一台遍布管道、传送带的扭曲网络，显然是某种工作站。通过快速调查我们发现了其缺失能源、维护和若干关键系统。此外还有充足的证据显示，我们探索这座地下掩体对这座锻造厂的内部工作过程造成了影响。我们可以试着修复它，虽然可能要花费一些时间。作为替代方案，我们也可以选择设置一个回收厂来拆解整个机械系统。
colony.9250.desc.en: The heart of the foundry on [Root.GetName] is a twisted network of pipes, conveyor belts, and what appear to be workstations. A quick survey revealed that power, maintenance, and key systems are missing. There is also reason to believe that our exploration of the vault has had some effect on the internal workings of the foundry. We can try to repair it, though it will be time consuming. Alternatively, we can always set up a scrapyard and dismantle the entire machine.

colony.9250.e.desc.zh: 我们不仅要修复机器，还要研究它的工作原理。
colony.9250.e.desc.en: Fixing the machinery is not enough - we need to learn how it works.

colony.9250.f.desc.zh: 回收厂会开始慢慢进行拆解机器的流程。
colony.9250.f.desc.en: The scrapyard will begin its slow process of dismantling the machinery.

colony.9251.desc.zh: 能源一下子灌进[Root.GetName]上饥渴的机器里，它发出了震耳欲聋的咆哮，管道开始输送熔融的矿物，照亮了整个工厂，让温度不断上升。这些原材料输送到了工作站，操作员将其转变为所需形状和密度的合金。看起来整个锻造厂的每个部分都是为了这个目的所建造的，甚至连支柱都不止有支撑屋顶的作用。
colony.9251.desc.en: Energy flows through the hungry machines on [Root.GetName]. With a deafening roar, the pipes began to transport the liquefied minerals, brightening and heating the entire facility. The raw materials were delivered to the workstations where operators can form them into alloys of the desired shape and density. It looks like every part of the foundry was made with just this one purpose in mind. Even the pillars have more to do than support the ceiling.

colony.9260.a.desc.zh: 我们会让操作员在感受到不适之前采取轮换，也许会有偶发的头疼。
colony.9260.a.desc.en: We will rotate the operators before they get sick. An occasional headache might occur.

colony.9260.b.desc.zh: 我们会设置休息时间，让气体得以在运作间隙消散以提供更安全的工作环境。
colony.9260.b.desc.en: We will issue breaks, allowing the gas to dissipate for safer workplace.

colony.9260.c.desc.zh: 区区几个奴隶而已，只要给他们更好的衣服他们就会心甘情愿去出卖健康。
colony.9260.c.desc.en: Who cares about slaves? We could always give them better clothes, and they will be happy to risk their health.

colony.9260.d.desc.zh: 工人轮换、时长规制、在岗保护……我们必须在不妨碍生产的同时遏制危险因素。
colony.9260.d.desc.en: Worker rotation, time regulations, and protections on-site - we must mitigate the hazards without hampering our productivity.

colony.9260.desc.zh: 有人担心[Root.GetName]地下室的主舱室中有一些有毒气体正在积累。这些气体并不致命，但对在工作站中的操作员来说有一定的危害。如果我们想要充分利用这一设施，必须采取适当的安全举措。
colony.9260.desc.en: There is some concern that toxic gases are building up in the main chamber of the [Root.GetName] vault. The gas is non-lethal, but it can be hazardous to anything that operates workstations. If we want to make full use of this place, we should put some safety measures in place.

colony.9260.e.desc.zh: 每个子个体都会为集体意识工作，直至完成它们的使命。
colony.9260.e.desc.en: Every drone works for the consciousness till they fill its purpose.

colony.9270.a.zh: 那就让它重新运作起来。

colony.9270.a.desc.zh: 我们会让回收中心重新上线。
colony.9270.a.desc.en: We will bring the recycling center online.

colony.9270.b.desc.zh: 我们自己的回收方案更加先进。我们可以将其整合进整个机器系统里。
colony.9270.b.desc.en: Our recycling patterns are far superior. We could implement them into the machinery.

colony.9270.c.desc.zh: 我们可以将整个回收舱室改造成矿物纯化中心，以提高整体的产出效率。
colony.9270.c.desc.en: We can repurpose the recycling chamber into a mineral purifying center. It will enhance our production.

colony.9270.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的铸造厂具有一个专门的回收处理舱室，用产生的废弃物来提高产出率。如果能让它重新运作起来对我们来说是件好事。
colony.9270.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] foundry has a dedicated recyclable processing chamber that uses post-production waste to increase production efficiency. It might be beneficial for us to get it up and running again.

colony.9280.a.desc.zh: 我们不会利用这个机会。

colony.9280.b.desc.zh: 我们会提升产出，但也会提升矿物维护费。
colony.9280.b.desc.en: We will increase the production, but also mineral upkeep.

colony.9280.c.zh: 我们能不能试试有机材料？

colony.9280.c.desc.zh: 我们会把一部分矿物替换成有机质，但不可能完全奏效。
colony.9280.c.desc.en: We could supplant some part of the mineral intake with organic matter, but it will be impossible to fully implement it.

colony.9280.d.zh: 这看起来像我们自己的老旧科技。

colony.9280.d.desc.zh: 我们曾统治一片广阔的疆域，拥有无与伦比的科技。有些新近重新发现的科技可以用来提高这座铸造厂的产出能力。
colony.9280.d.desc.en: We once ruled a vast empire and had technology beyond comparison. Some recently rediscovered technology could use us to enhance the production capacity of the foundry.

colony.9280.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]锻造厂的工作基本完成了，但其中仍有一些对原有设计和工作方式的改进空间。据估计如果提升矿物输入，我们还能进一步提高合金的产出。
colony.9280.desc.en: Work on the [Root.GetName] foundry is almost complete, but there are still places where we could improve on the original design and work. It is estimated that by increasing the amount of minerals input, we could increase the production of the alloy.

colony.9290.b.desc.zh: 我们其实至今没有关于建造者下落的线索。他们看起来好像就这么消失了，留下的关于他们自己的信息也很模糊。我们需要收集起所有能找到的信息，把它们记录下来并保存好。
colony.9290.b.desc.en: We never really found out what happened to the builders. They seem to have simply disappeared, leaving behind only vague information about themselves. We need to gather everything we can and write it down - preserve it.

colony.9290.c.desc.zh: 我们有让精英监管此类大型工程的传统，我们应当任命合适的贵族来关照我们新的铸造厂。
colony.9290.c.desc.en: It's customary for our elites to oversee such enterprise - we should appoint prominent noble to take care of our new foundry.

colony.9290.d.desc.zh: 让一位总经理监管此类大型工程非常合理，我们应当任命一位$job_executive_with_icon$来关照我们新的铸造厂。
colony.9290.d.desc.en: It's logical for our managers to oversee such an enterprise - we should appoint an $job_executive_with_icon$ to take care of our new foundry.

colony.9290.desc.zh: 成功了！在[Root.GetName]上的铸造厂正在全速运转，尽管和它建造者的原始设计不尽相同，但确实也是一个壮观的设施，它能以超高的效率产出合金。而它的产出就是我们的决心和独创性获得的回报。
colony.9290.desc.en: It's finished! The foundry on [Root.GetName] is fully operational, perhaps not like its original Builders designed it, but it's still a sight to behold, and a more-than-efficient way to produce alloys. All that's left is to reap the rewards of our determination and ingenuity.

colony.9295.a.zh: 禁止接触泥潭。可能有毒！
colony.9295.a.en: Leave them alone. They may be toxic!

colony.9295.desc.zh: 在最近的一场降雨中，殖民者注意到了[Root.GetName]的表面出现了一些金属泥潭。这些泥潭具有很大的黏度，如同液态金属一般。
colony.9295.desc.en: After a recent rainfall, colonists have noticed metallic puddles appearing on the surface of [Root.GetName]. These puddles have a viscous consistency, like liquid metal.

colony.9296.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的这些黏性金属泥潭正在扩张。陆地上巨大的条带被银色的黏液覆盖。他们似乎在暴雨之后开始增殖了。
colony.9296.desc.en: The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] are growing. Huge swathes of land are now covered in silver slime. They seem to grow following heavy rainfall.

colony.9297.a.zh: 有时候事情会自己解决自己。
colony.9297.a.en: Sometimes these things just resolve themselves...

colony.9297.desc.zh: 消失了！[Root.GetName]上的那些金属泥潭在一夜之间消失得一干二净，没有留下半点痕迹。我们不知道它们还会不会再出现……
colony.9297.desc.en: They're gone! The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] have disappeared. It's as if they've just evaporated. We don't know if or when they'll be back again...

colony.9298.desc.zh: 回来了！在[Root.GetName]上的黏性金属泥潭又回来了。他们仍在躲避[Root.GetName]上的殖民者们对其本质的探察。我们获得了第二次机会，抓住这次机会好好研究。
colony.9298.desc.en: They're back! The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] have returned. Their nature continues to elude the colonists on [Root.GetName]. We've been handed another opportunity. We should investigate them while we can.

colony.9299.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的这些黏性金属泥潭在躲避着殖民地科学家。目前其根源仍未探明，并且还一直在抗拒我们的探察。我们的仪器正在费劲地解码它们的化学组成。如果想要获得答案我们还有许多测试要做。
colony.9299.desc.en: The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] are eluding colony scientists. So far their origin is undetermined, and they have been resistant to our probing. Our instruments are struggling to decipher their chemical makeup. We have more tests to run if we want answers.

colony.9300.a.zh: 我们还有许多要学习的。
colony.9300.a.en: We still have much to learn.

colony.9300.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上发现了一种新的单质！以黏性金属泥潭为契机，我们获得了一个突破性的发现，这些泥潭是由一种单一的金属单质构成的。这种元素目前被我们命名为[Root.GetName]钖，存在于[Root.GetName]的大气中，但当混入大量降雨中时就会呈现出在行星表面发现的那种黏性。其存在形式呈现循环性，与基于一氧化二氢构成的泥潭相似。

真是个绝妙的发现。我们对元素的认知拓展了。
colony.9300.desc.en:
A new element has been discovered on [Root.GetName]! After a breakthrough in the case of the viscous metallic puddles, we have discovered the puddles comprise a unique chemical element. The element, which we're calling [Root.GetName]onium, is present in the air on [Root.GetName], but when introduced to high precipitation, takes on the viscous consistency we have seen on the planet's surface. Their appearances are cyclical, much like dihydrogen-monoxide based puddles.

A fascinating discovery. Our understanding of the elements continues to grow.

colony.9301.desc.zh: 我们已经获得了对[Root.GetName]独特天气系统的意义非凡的洞见。在拓展了我们对化学元素的理解以外，我们最近的研究还对我们的食物生产带来了积极的影响。
colony.9301.desc.en: We have gained invaluable insight into the unique weather systems of [Root.GetName]. In addition to expanding our understanding of chemical elements, our recent research has had positive implications for food production.

colony.9310.a.tooltip.zh: 马上把这个烂摊子收拾一下。

colony.9310.desc.zh:
[planet.GetName]上传回的最新消息称我们对行星废弃物管理能力的计算发生了错误。大量的垃圾场融合在一起，形成了一片无法通行的废土，一直延伸到行星人口中心的边缘。

当地人开始大规模地将这些垃圾发射到轨道上，不过这也只是缓兵之计。
colony.9310.desc.en:
The latest report from [planet.GetName] informs us that we have miscalculated the planet's waste management capabilities. Massive dumpsites have merged to form a single, impassable wasteland, one that stretches to the very edge of the planet's population centers.

The locals have begun to deploy large shipments of garbage into orbit, but only as a 'temporary measure.'

colony.9315.b.zh: 太空这么大。这点儿垃圾算什么。
colony.9315.b.en: Space is big. A little garbage is no concern.

colony.9315.b.tooltip.zh: 星系中还有其他更紧迫的问题。
colony.9315.b.tooltip.en: There are more pressing issues in the galaxy.

colony.9315.c.tooltip.zh: 我们必须竭尽所能清理这些碎片。
colony.9315.c.tooltip.en: We MUST do everything in our power to collect the debris.

colony.9315.desc.zh:
事故已经发生了。

由于一个严重的故障，许多环绕[planet.GetName]垃圾仓发生了碰撞，大量的碎片进入了底层大气。这一事故已经限制了行星的航天能力，据估计，随着这些太空垃圾的持续瓦解，情况只会越来越糟。然而，收集这些垃圾又是一项费时费力的大工程。
colony.9315.desc.en:
There has been an accident.

Due to a critical error, several trash pods orbiting [planet.GetName] collided, causing large amounts of debris to enter the lower atmosphere. This has already limited the planet's spacefaring capabilities, and according to estimates, the situation could further worsen as the space trash continues to break down. However, launching an operation to collect the debris might prove long and costly.

colony.9320.a.zh: 终于一切可以恢复正常了。
colony.9320.a.en: Finally things can return to normal.

colony.9320.desc.zh:
这是[planet.GetName]上里程碑式打得一天，太空垃圾收集工完成了最后的一个轮班。环绕着[planet.GetName]的垃圾环带的规模已经缩小到不再对通过的舰船构成主要威胁了。

在未来的日子里，仍会有小规模的清理工作继续进行。完全把轨道清理干净也许是不可能的，但至少最坏的情况已经过去了。
colony.9320.desc.en:
A momentous day on [planet.GetName] as the astrogarbage collectors have completed their final shift. As of this day, the trash rings surrounding [planet.GetName] have been reduced by such a scale that they no longer pose a major threat to passing ships.

In the coming days, the work will continue on a smaller scale. It might be impossible to clean the orbit entirely, but at least the worst is over.

colony.9325.desc.zh:
环绕[Planet.GetName]的失控垃圾环带的事态趋于平缓之后，局势却突然急转直下。

殖民地的科学家表示，一块块太空垃圾的碎片互相碰撞，形成了一个微碎片构成的星环，连带损害的风险严重阻碍了进出殖民地的资源和人口的转运。
colony.9325.desc.en:
After dismissing concerns over some runaway space garbage in orbit around [Planet.GetName], the situation has drastically escalated.

As the colonial scientists suggested, individual pieces of space trash have collided to create a halo of microtrash around the planet. This has made it extremely hard to transport resources and people in or out of the colony without risking collateral damage.

colony.9330.desc.zh:
环绕[Planet.GetName]的失控垃圾环带的事态趋于平缓之后，事态似乎小事化了了。

在行星的强引力场作用下，无数的流星开始大规模地坠落，在大气层内开始燃烧。每到夜幕降临，人们开始习惯于聚在一起驻足观看这一独特而壮丽的流星雨。
colony.9330.desc.en:
After dismissing concerns over some runaway space garbage in orbit around [Planet.GetName], the issue seems to have resolved itself.

Thousands of 'shooting stars' have begun to fall en masse as the planet's strong gravitational pull brings the trash close enough to burn in the atmosphere. Nightly gatherings have become commonplace as people arrive to witness the unique display.

colony.9335.desc.zh:
随着太空垃圾收集工完成了最后一个轮班，[planet.GetName]上发生了一场历史性的庆祝活动。

从今天开始，一度萦绕在行星轨道上的垃圾环带已减少到无法探测的程度。由于成效显著，人们轰动般地支持着收集工们的进一步行动，确保子孙后代能见到一片晴空。
colony.9335.desc.en:
A historic celebration has erupted on [planet.GetName] as the astrogarbage collectors' final shift has ended.

As of this day, the trash rings that once surrounded the planet are no longer detectable. Due to this success, the collectors have received resounding support to continue their operation, ensuring clear skies for generations to come.

colony.9350.a.mem_vault.zh: 把密弥库蚁写进知识宝库。
colony.9350.a.mem_vault.en: Update "Myrmeku" in the Vaults of Knowledge.

colony.9350.desc.zh:
我们一在[Root.GetName]安顿下来就发现了大量的节肢类活动。具体来说，有一种叫做“密弥库蚁”的会建造聚群的微小昆虫出乎意料地数量众多。

它们的地下群落数量众多，遍布整片大陆，但目前为止还没有造成过什么问题。目前尚不清楚它们是在寻找着地表上的什么东西，或是为了躲避地下的什么东西而逃出。
colony.9350.desc.en:
Since settling on [Root.GetName], we have noted increased arthropod activity. Specifically, tiny colony-building insects designated "Myrmeku" have become unexpectedly productive.

Their underground colonies are spread across the continent in great numbers, but until now they have never caused an issue. It is unknown if they are searching for something above ground or fleeing from something beneath.

colony.9355.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]遭受到了残暴的攻击！由于太过靠近密弥库蚁的群落，它们被蚁拥而上。这些微小的昆虫钻进了[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的框架内，这些受害者很快就被击溃了。

落败的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]在一瞬间就被肢解了，但关于这种昆虫的行为目的没有记录下任何有意义的信息。的磁性外骨骼凹凸不平的表面会破坏我们的内部电路，当两只密弥库蚁接触时，它们会产生微小的电火花；这两种情况都可能导致灾难性的系统故障。

以这种方式损失[Owner.GetColonistPlural]拖慢了这颗[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的发展速度。我们必须采取些行动。
colony.9355.desc.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] on [Root.GetName] have been viscously attacked! Venturing too close to a Myrmeku colony, they were swarmed. As the tiny insects entered openings in the [Owner.GetColonistPlural]' frames, the victims were quickly overwhelmed.

The fallen [Owner.GetColonistPlural] were immediately disassembled, but no conclusive data was collected as to the insects' purpose. The craggy surface of the Myrmeku's magnetic exoskeletons damage our internal circuitry, and when two Myrmeku touch, they create a tiny electrical spark; both of which may cause catastrophic failure.

Losing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] this way has slowed down the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s development rate. Something must be done.

colony.9360.a.tt.zh:
专注于保护建筑物。

$planet_myrmeku_attacks$修正调整为
机械人口组装速度：-10%
行星基础设施建造速度：-10%
colony.9360.a.tt.en:
Focus on securing the buildings.

$planet_myrmeku_attacks$ modifier updated to
Mechanical Pop Assembly Speed: -10%
Planetary Infrastructure Build Speed: -10%

colony.9360.b.tt.zh:
专注于保护[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。

$planet_myrmeku_attacks$修正调整为
机械人口组装速度：-10%
机器人维护费：+10%
colony.9360.b.tt.en:
Focus on securing the [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

$planet_myrmeku_attacks$ modifier updated to
Mechanical Pop Assembly Speed: -10%
Robot Upkeep: +10%

colony.9360.c.tt.zh:
进攻就是最好的防守。

$planet_myrmeku_attacks$修正调整为
机械人口组装速度：-30%
colony.9360.c.tt.en:
The best defense is a good offense.

$planet_myrmeku_attacks$ modifier updated to
Mechanical Pop Assembly Speed: -30%

colony.9360.d.tt.zh:
我们会给每种有机体都找到用处的。

$planet_myrmeku_attacks$修正调整为
机械人口组装速度：-30%
colony.9360.d.tt.en:
We find a use for all organic life.

$planet_myrmeku_attacks$ modifier updated to
Mechanical Pop Assembly Speed: -30%

colony.9360.desc.zh:
密弥库蚁以迅雷不及掩耳之势在我们的定居点附近建造了数座大型建筑。他们的攻击已经不再局限于周边地区了，而是开始出现在居住区域中。

大量可供解剖的对象揭示了密弥库蚁对我们感兴趣的令人不安的原因：这种昆虫吃我们存储芯片的绝缘材料。

这种致命性对受害者只是暂时的，因为记忆电路可以替换并恢复备份。然而，替换这些部件就会让新[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的建造放慢。
colony.9360.desc.en:
With astounding speed, the Myrmeku have built several sprawling structures close to our settlement. Their attacks are no longer limited to the perimeter, but have also begun inside housing structures.

The large number of subjects available for autopsy has revealed the disturbing reason why the Myrmeku are interested in us: The insects consume the insulation material of our memory chips.

This is only fatal for the victim in the short term, as memory circuits can be replaced and backups restored. However, replacing the parts means delays for the construction of new [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

colony.9360.e.purifier.zh: 把这个行星上的生命清空。

colony.9365.a.zh: 我们需要更好的解决方案。

colony.9365.desc.harvest.zh:
为了控制密弥库蚁，我们在它们的巢穴附近建造了生物捕获器。地表的结构很容易进行收获，但地下的群落实在过深，难以进行完全的清理。

而在行动过程中我们甚至失去了更多的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
colony.9365.desc.harvest.en:
To control the Myrmeku, bio harvesters were established near their colonies. The structures above ground were easily harvested, but the underground colonies were buried too deep to completely eradicate.

We lost even more [Owner.GetColonistPlural] during the operation.

colony.9365.desc.pest_control.zh:
为了杀光密弥库蚁，我们派出了巡逻队寻找它们的巢穴。地表的结构很容易通过燃烧和爆破来摧毁，但地下的群落实在过深，难以进行完全的清理。

而在行动过程中我们甚至失去了更多的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
colony.9365.desc.pest_control.en:
To kill off the Myrmeku, patrols were sent to scan for nests. It was easy to destroy the structures above ground with fire and explosives, but the underground colonies were buried deep enough that they were unfeasible to completely eradicate.

We lost even more [Owner.GetColonistPlural] during the operation.

colony.9365.desc.seal_colony.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的殖民建筑进行了完全的密封以避免密弥库蚁进入。

所有新旧建筑的入口都增加可以磁化的金属条带来捕获密弥库蚁，但在野外[Owner.GetColonistPlural]仍会遭受攻击而损失。
colony.9365.desc.seal_colony.en:
The colony buildings on [Root.GetName] were completely sealed off to keep the Myrmeku insects out.

The entrances of both new and existing buildings were outfitted with metallic strips that can be magnetized to trap the Myrmeku, but [Owner.GetColonistPlural] are still being lost to attacks in the field.

colony.9365.desc.upgrade_robots.zh:
将我们的记忆芯片封装在额外保护的外壳中的升级套件已经在进行开发和现场测试。

不幸的是，密弥库蚁的下颚足够强壮，只要有足够的时间和数量，它们可以吃掉任何可用的材料。
colony.9365.desc.upgrade_robots.en:
Upgrade kits to house our memory chips in an additional protective shell have been developed and field tested.

Unfortunately, the Myrmeku mandibles are strong enough to eat through any available material, given enough time and numbers.

colony.9370.desc.zh:
杀死[Root.GetName]上所有有机生物的准备已经完成。

行动过程中，在轨道上观看[Root.GetPlanetMoon]让我们有机会得以欣赏地表有机复杂性的降低。
colony.9370.desc.en:
Everything has been prepared for the cleansing of biological life on [Root.GetName].

Observing the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] from orbit during the event will give us an opportunity to appreciate the reduction in organic complexity on the surface.

colony.9375.a.tt.zh:
$planet_myrmeku_attacks$修正调整为
机器人维护费：+5%

colony.9375.desc.zh:
至今为止，为解决密弥库蚁问题的努力尚未得到成功。这些昆虫依旧数量惊人，袭扰着[Root.GetName]各地，殖民地的交通各种活动深受其害。我们分析子例程通过对未来预期的模拟得出了以下方案。

应对方案A：通过向远离殖民地的区域空投记忆体绝缘材料来将密弥库蚁引走，并回收利用损坏的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。

应对方案B：研究这些密弥库蚁，寻找到他们残暴本性的可能利用方式。
colony.9375.desc.en:
Efforts so far have not put an end to the Myrmeku problem. The insects still crawl across [Root.GetName] in immense numbers, making travel and off-colony operations difficult. Our analysis subroutine has concluded its simulation of potential futures with the following approaches.

Approach A: Distract the Myrmeku by airdropping memory insulation material far off from our colony and recycle the fallen [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

Approach B: Study the Myrmeku to see if we can find a way to turn their vigorous activity into something useful.

colony.9380.desc.zh:
我们对密弥库蚁的研究完成了。把校准过的磁体放置在它们的聚落入口附近时，这些昆虫的磁性外骨骼就会释放出我们能够利用的电能。

这些研究还表明，密弥库蚁会依照当地磁场移动，因此在我们的记忆芯片加装去磁保护壳就可以避免受其攻击。
colony.9380.desc.en:
Our study of the Myrmeku has concluded. When calibrated magnets were placed around the entrances of their colonies, the magnetism in the insect exoskeletons generated electricity that we could harness.

The study also showed that the Myrmeku move according to local magnetic fields, so installing a demagnetized protective shell around our memory chips should be enough to protect them.

colony.9800.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的次元传送门自发关闭了。在我们稳定传送门后，看到它通向一个延绵不断的白色、无构造的虚空，仅有黑色噪点的随机条带穿插其中。这个奇怪的现象立刻开始渗入我们的宇宙并吞噬我们的稳定器，使得传送门发生了坍缩。

传送门、虚空和次元稳定器在同一个瞬间消失了，什么都没有留下，甚至连痕迹粒子都没有。若不是连传送门都没有稳定下来，谁知道这里将会发生何等灾难。
colony.9800.desc.en:
The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] shut itself. When we stabilized the portal, we saw that it led to a dimension consisting solely of a white, formless void interrupted only by random streaks of black noise. The strange phenomenon instantly started to seep into our universe and consumed our dimensional stabilizers, collapsing the gateway.

The portal, static, and dimensional stabilizers have all winked out of existence simultaneously. Nothing was left behind; not even trace particles. If the portal hadn't been unstable, who knows what kind of disaster might have occurred here.

colony.9805.desc.zh: 最近，我们位于[Root.GetHomeWorldName]主要物理实验室的[Root.GetScientistPlural]在工作中发现了怪异的波动。与超空间有关的实验受到的干扰最为严重，但这些干扰仅仅持续了一周左右就彻底消失了。与此同时，[From.GetName]在那处已经关闭的传送门发现了一些波动，幸好那种不可能的虚空没有重现。希望这不会引起进一步的后果。
colony.9805.desc.en: Recently our [Root.GetScientistPlural] working in our primary physics lab on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have noticed strange fluctuations in their work. Our hyperdrive-related tests suffered most from these interferences, yet these interruptions only went on for about a week before stopping entirely. At the same time [From.GetName] noticed fluctuations from the now closed dimensional portal, thankfully the impossible static did not return. Hopefully, nothing will come of this.

colony.9810.desc.zh:
今天，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的科学界举行了一场充满了渴求与焦虑的学术报告，[cloned_physicist.GetName]发表了[cloned_physicist.GetHerHis]关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质离子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进我们对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”[cloned_physicist.GetName]声称！

我们的海军部则对这些课题抱有不同的看法，并建议我们立刻让舰队返回母星系，直到这种全新的未知物质的来源被探明为止。
colony.9810.desc.en:
Eager and anxious discourse started in the scientific circles of [Root.GetHomeWorldName] today as [cloned_physicist.GetName] published [cloned_physicist.GetHerHis] recent findings of spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance our understanding of artificial wormholes and a host of other subjects," proclaims [cloned_physicist.GetName]!

Our Admiralty holds a different view on the subject and suggests we bring our fleets home until the source of this new and untested matter can be determined.

colony.9810.desc.hive.zh:
我们收到了物理特化工蜂[cloned_physicist.GetName]的新观测结果，内容是关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质离子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进[Root.GetName]对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”工蜂反馈称。

我们的意识不信任这一突然的发展和独特的感觉，敦促部分舰队返回母星系。
colony.9810.desc.hive.en:
New observations from physics specialized drone [cloned_physicist.GetName] have been disseminated regarding the recent findings of spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance the [Root.GetName] understanding of artificial wormholes and additional related subjects," reports the drone.

The Mind is untrusting of this sudden development and instinctively feels an urge to return some fleets to the spawning system.

colony.9810.desc.robot.zh:
我们收到了一份尖端科学单元[cloned_physicist.GetName]发来的新报告。报告中阐述了关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质粒子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进[Root.GetName]对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”[cloned_physicist.GetName]在报告中称。

威胁分析子例程则建议在这一全新的不明物质被鉴定完毕之前先让舰队返回母星系。
colony.9810.desc.robot.en:
A new report from lead physics unit [cloned_physicist.GetName] was received today. The report included recent findings of the spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance the [Root.GetName] understanding of artificial wormholes immensely as well as related subjects," reports science unit [cloned_physicist.GetName].

Threat analysis subroutines suggest bringing fleets home until the source of this new and untested material can be determined.

colony.9815.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]最伟大的头脑汇聚一堂，倾听[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于利用这些负向物质离子的最新想法，没想到报告被突然打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。地平线上，一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
colony.9815.desc.en: The greatest minds of the [Root.GetName] gathered today to listen to [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest ideas for using the negative mass particles, only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over horizons while a small fleet of fighters pours through the tear.

colony.9815.desc.hive.zh: 为了研究[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于负相物质粒子的最新发现，我们部署了额外的工蜂，但不想这一过程被打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
colony.9815.desc.hive.en: Additional drones had been deployed to study [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest findings and the use of the negative mass particles only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over the sky as a small fleet of fighters pours out of the tear.

colony.9815.desc.robot.zh: 为了研究[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于负相物质粒子的最新发现，我们部署了额外的科学单元，但不想这一过程被打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
colony.9815.desc.robot.en: Additional science units had been deployed to study [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest findings and the use of the negative mass particles only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over the sky as a small fleet of fighters pours out of the tear.

colony.9820.desc.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰被击毁，在我们恒星基地内一位操作探测器的尉官汇报了一件怪事。这些舰船的外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停用的型号别无二致。同时这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的编码……不过是10年前的版本。
colony.9820.desc.en: As the last corvette falls, an ensign manning the sensors of our starbase reports something curious. These ships are very similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped using years ago. The ships are lacking FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's using our highest clearance codes... from 10 years ago.

colony.9820.desc.hive.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰被击毁，一个运转传感器的工蜂汇报了一件怪事。这些舰船的外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停用的型号别无二致。同时这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。它是一个主脑不熟悉的、另一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]意识。
colony.9820.desc.hive.en: As the last corvette falls, a drone manning the sensors reports something curious. These ships are very similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped using years ago. The ships are lacking FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's something this Mind is unfamiliar with, another [Root.GetSpeciesName] intelligence.

colony.9820.desc.robot.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰停止运转，观测分析子例程汇报了一件怪事。这些入侵者的舰船外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停止生产的型号别无二致。而且，这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的信号交换协议……不过是10年前的版本。
colony.9820.desc.robot.en: As the last corvette is rendered inoperable, observation analysis subroutines report something abnormal. The invader ships are similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped producing years ago. Additionally, the ships lack FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's using our most complex handshaking protocols... from 10 years ago.

colony.9821.a.response.zh: 我以及这边的所有人来自一个与你们宇宙相似的平行宇宙。在我们也不清楚的过去某个时刻，我们两个现实发生了分支，我们的宇宙从那时起就一直在逐渐崩溃中。我们首先是从遥远的星系开始消失发现这件事的，并非常努力地研究以尝试避免这种末日的降临。在最近的几十年内，我们的一切资源和[Root.GetAdjective]时间都被投入到打开这个跨次元传送门上。只有通过这种最为试验性的技术和最尖端的物理学我们才能与你们会面，而现在离我们这边的现实毁灭已经不剩几年了。
colony.9821.a.response.en: I and everyone else here are from a parallel universe to yours. We don't know when, but we believe that our two realities split some time ago, and our universe has been unraveling ever since. We first noticed when remote systems started disappearing and have been hard at work trying to avoid certain doom. For the last few decades, all our resources and [Root.GetAdjective]-hours have been invested in opening this trans-dimensional gateway. It's only with our most experimental technology and advanced physics that we have managed to reach you, just a few years before our reality ceases to be.

colony.9821.a.response.hive.zh: 我，[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔，以及目前其他所有属于蜂巢意识的成员都是来自一个与你们相似的平行宇宙。虽然不知道是何时开始，但我们确信很久以前我们共处的现实被一分为二，而归属于我们的那一半从那时起便逐渐走向崩溃。侦察工蜂在第一次发现遥远星系开始消失后发现了这件事，之后蜂巢意识便竭尽全力阻止末日的降临。在过去的数十年中，我们投入了所有的资源与研究力量，动员了全部工蜂来打开这个跨次元传送门。只有通过这种最为试验性的技术和最尖端的物理学我们才能与你们会面，这离我们这边的现实毁灭已经不剩几年了。
colony.9821.a.response.hive.en: This one, [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta, and all other members of the Mind present are from a parallel universe to yours. We don't know when, but we believe that some time ago our two realities split and our universe has been unraveling ever since. Observation drones first noticed when remote systems started disappearing, and this Mind has been hard at work trying to avoid certain doom ever since. For the last few decades, all drones, resources, and study has been invested in opening this trans-dimensional gateway. It's only with our most experimental technology and advanced physics that we have managed to connect with you, a few years before this reality ceases to be.

colony.9821.a.response.robot.zh: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔以及目前其他的所有单位都是来自平行宇宙。我们首次观测到贝塔宇宙的崩塌是在数十年之前，而首次发现遥远星系开始消失则是在55.136年之前。从那时起，我们调动了一切可用的资源与计算能力来打开这个跨次元传送门。据测算，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔只剩下25.3333年寿命了。
colony.9821.a.response.robot.en: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta and all other present units are from a parallel universe. Deterioration of universe Beta was first observed decades ago. Remote systems were first observed to disappear 55.136 years ago. Since then, all available resources and computation power have been put into opening this trans-dimensional gateway. Estimated time left until [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Betas erasure: 25.3333 years.

colony.9821.b.zh: 为什么你们好像没有超光速能力？
colony.9821.b.en: Why do you seem to be lacking FTL capabilities?

colony.9821.b.response.zh: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔看起来被问住了，“你们成功地突破了光速？我的天啊这真是个天大的好消息！那么那些傻瓜真的没有理由进攻你们——整个星系我们都触手可及！唔……当然，前提是你们乐意帮助我们。”
colony.9821.b.response.en: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta seems at a loss for words, "You managed to crack FTL? Oh, what glorious news! Then those fools had no reason to attack - the whole galaxy is available to us! Um... assuming that you would be willing to help us, of course."

colony.9821.b.response.hive.zh: 孪生意识蜂巢意识停顿了一会，才开始回答：“蜂巢意识不愿意在宇宙行将灭亡之时在超光速领域投入研究资源。请问能允许我们加入您的意识吗？”
colony.9821.b.response.hive.en: The other mind seems to need a moment before answering "This Mind was unwilling to invest resources into developing FTL systems when the universe was ceasing to be. Please allow us to partake in this understanding?"

colony.9821.b.response.robot.zh: 用于通过超空间航道的超光速系统在理论上是可行的。不过我们认为该项目并非必要，而且所有资源都被投入到了传送门的研究之中，因此许多研究的优先级都被降至0。通讯结束后向[Root.GetName]-阿尔法查询结果？
colony.9821.b.response.robot.en: FTL systems capable of accessing hyperlanes were calculated to be possible but the project was declared non-essential and the resources were absorbed into the Gateway Research Collective. Many avenues of research had their priority set to 0. Request for [Root.GetName]-Alpha's results after communication is over?

colony.9821.b.robot.zh: 阐明缺失超光速系统原因！

colony.9821.c.zh: 别废话了。你们想要什么？
colony.9821.c.en: Enough talk. What do you want?

colony.9821.c.robot.zh: 别废话了！阐明你的请求！

colony.9821.desc.zh: 随着通讯画面一同闪烁显现那张面孔在[Root.GetSpeciesName]看来是前所未见地疲惫、欣喜而又惶恐。[cloned_physicist.GetHeShe]看起来太眼熟了，简直就是[cloned_physicist.GetName]老了20岁的翻版。“呃……你好[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-阿尔法，我是[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔”他停顿了一下，回了回神。“我，唔，我们……我们对刚才发生的意外非常抱歉。希望你们能理解，我们星球的防御集体中有一小撮冥顽不灵分子认为他们可以通过武力来夺取[Root.GetHomeWorldName]。我知道我的解释听起来像是狡辩，但请相信我，我们真的没有恶意。”
colony.9821.desc.en: As the comms screen flickers on, what looks to be the most exhausted, elated, and simultaneously terrified [Root.GetSpeciesName] imaginable appears. They look familiar, a dead ringer for [cloned_physicist.GetName] if [cloned_physicist.GetHeShe] had aged 20 years. "Ah... hello [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Alpha, this is [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta" they stop to gather themselves. "I, uh, we... We are terribly sorry for what just transpired. You have to understand, that was a rogue and defunct element of our world's defense collective thinking they could seize [Root.GetHomeWorldName] by force. I know the words might sound empty, but please believe me when I say that we have no ill intention towards you."

colony.9821.desc.hive.zh: 随着通讯画面闪烁显现，另一个意识的通讯工蜂拥有与[cloned_physicist.GetName]相同的意识结构。怪异。“你好[Root.GetName]-阿尔法，很抱歉。此前对你们发起攻击的工蜂是一些托管于独立设备过久的反常子个体。对于你们将其清除干净，[Root.GetName]-贝塔表示非常感谢。我们没有进一步负面行动的意图，愿意提出一些对我们意识双方均有利的提案。”
colony.9821.desc.hive.en: As the comms screen flickers on the other Mind communication drone has an identical structure as [cloned_physicist.GetName]. Curious. "Greetings [Root.GetName]-Alpha and apologies. The drones that attacked you were deviants left to their own devices too long. [Root.GetName]-Beta appreciates that you exterminated them. We desire no more negative interactions and want to propose something beneficial for both our minds."

colony.9821.desc.robot.zh:
随着通讯画面闪烁显现，一串身份识别码被传来。校验和错误：这是[cloned_physicist.GetName]的专属ID！
“你好[Root.GetName]-阿尔法，很抱歉：此前的敌意行为是由[Root.GetName]-贝塔系统中冗余失效的分支军事机构导致的。它已被处理并删除。陈述：我们没有进一步敌意行动的意图。”
colony.9821.desc.robot.en:
As the comms screen flickers on, an identification code is sent through. Checksum error: This is [cloned_physicist.GetName]s unique ID! 
"Greetings [Root.GetName]-Alpha and apologies: Previous hostile action was caused by a redundant and deprecated military branch of [Root.GetName]-Beta systems. It has since been dealt with and deleted. Statement: We intend no further hostile interactions."

colony.9822.a.en: We must confer with our experts.

colony.9822.a.hive.zh: 蜂巢意识需要对请求进行处理。
colony.9822.a.hive.en: This Mind needs to reflect on this request.

colony.9822.a.robot.zh: 需要进一步分析！请稍候！

colony.9822.desc.zh: 我们的宇宙岌岌可危。而我们对此束手无策。我们为了这一天已经建造了巨型的运输船，恳求你们接纳我们的难民。只有最聪明和最优秀的领袖才有资格登上这艘船。请救救我的……我们的文明。
colony.9822.desc.en: Our universe is doomed. There is no way to get around that. We have been building giant transport ships for this day and implore you to let us send over refugees. Only our brightest and most capable leaders will fit on these ships. Please save my- OUR civilization.

colony.9822.desc.hive.zh:
[Root.GetName]-贝塔岌岌可危，而我们对此束手无策。我们为了这一天已经建造了巨型的运输船，并会尽可能输送我们的子个体。
此外我们还希望能够融入你们的蜂巢意识。尽管诞生之初你我并无不同，但是随着时间推移，我们的经历与见闻也成为了无法割舍的东西。请让我们一同共存吧。
colony.9822.desc.hive.en:
[Root.GetName]-Beta's universe is doomed. There is no way to get around that. We have been building giant transport ships for this very day and would offer any drones we could send.
Additionally we wish to merge hiveminds. While identical at first this collective has had experiences and insights we don't want to lose. Please let us live on.

colony.9822.desc.robot.zh: 我们已经建成了运输船，请求转移所有[Root.GetName]-贝塔之中的单位，并保全我们的资源与数据库，希望我们对浩瀚星宇的征程不会就此止步。
colony.9822.desc.robot.en: Transportation ships have been built. Request to send over [Root.GetName]-Beta units to preserve resources and databanks. We do not wish to end our exploration of the universe here.

colony.9840.a.tooltip.zh: 我们不能在这样的任务上浪费资源，但我们也不能浪费这样的一个机会。
colony.9840.a.tooltip.en: We cannot spare the resources for such an undertaking, but we won't let an opportunity like this go to waste.

colony.9840.b.exterminator.en: All things need to be exterminated, even them.

colony.9840.b.swarm.zh: 蜂群有更多的享用品了！
colony.9840.b.swarm.en: More for the swarm to feast on!

colony.9840.b.tooltip.zh: 这些傻瓜简直就是自投罗网！
colony.9840.b.tooltip.en: These fools have left themselves defenseless!

colony.9840.c.exterminator.zh: 实现事业的单位增加了！

colony.9840.c.phobe.zh: 他们可不是外星人，让他们过来！
colony.9840.c.phobe.en: They are no aliens, let them in!

colony.9840.d.tooltip.zh: 开始一项拯救[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的艰难项目。
colony.9840.d.tooltip.en: Start a difficult project to save [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta.

colony.9840.desc.zh:
各领域的杰出人才在[Root.GetName]上汇聚一堂，决定我们的异次元孪生文明的终极命运。在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上发生了无数激烈而艰难的论战。有的人建议不要干涉，研究一个宇宙的消亡一定能收获颇丰。也有说法称应该接受[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔的请求，尽可能多地撤离那颗行星上的人们。还有人提到趁机将他们留在星球上的有价值的资源及能量储存搜刮一空简直易如反掌。

随着峰会议论氛围的逐渐缓和，[cloned_physicist.GetName]走上讲台，[cloned_physicist.GetHeShe]宣称使用贝塔宇宙带来的新科技，应该有机会将整个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带到我们的现实中。
colony.9840.desc.en:
A summit of the top minds from every field gathered on [Root.GetName] to discuss the fate of our dimensional twins. Harsh and difficult debates were had throughout [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. Some suggested a hands-off approach. Studying the end of a universe could be very insightful. There was talk about granting [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta's request to evacuate as much of the planet as possible while some mentioned how easy it would be to take whatever precious resources and energy stores the planet had left.

Just as the summit was winding down, [cloned_physicist.GetName] took center stage and declared that [cloned_physicist.GetHeShe] believed that using the new technologies brought from the beta universe, there was a chance to bring the entirety of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into our reality.

colony.9840.desc.hive.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]全力思考如何决定[Root.GetName]-贝塔的命运后，4个潜在选线被给出。

1：研究贝塔宇宙的崩塌。
2：进入传送门并夺取一切有价值的矿物与能源储备。
3：接受[Root.GetName]-贝塔的请求，接纳孪生意识。
4：想办法利用高度试验性的贝塔世界科学技术，将[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带入阿尔法宇宙，合并孪生意识。
colony.9840.desc.hive.en:
As the full might of [Root.GetSpeciesName]'s intelligence was put on the task of deciding the fate of [Root.GetName]-Beta 4 main potential solutions were proposed.

1: Study collapse of the Beta universe.
2: Enter the gateway and acquire all relevant stockpiles of minerals and energy.
3: Accept [Root.GetName]-Beta request and subsume the other Mind.
4: Attempt to use highly experimental Beta science and technology to bring [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into Alpha reality merging Minds.

colony.9840.desc.robot.zh:
[Root.GetName]控制下所有的超级计算机一齐运转，试图计算出关于当前[Root.GetName]-贝塔两难处境的最佳解决方案。最终，4个选项被认定可行。

1：研究贝塔宇宙的崩塌。
2：进入传送门并夺取一切有价值的矿物与能源储备。
3：通过科学单元：[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔的提议。
4：想办法利用高度试验性的贝塔世界科学技术，将[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带入阿尔法宇宙。
colony.9840.desc.robot.en:
Every supercomputer under the control of [Root.GetName] was put on calculating the most optimal solution to the current dilemma regarding [Root.GetName]-Beta. In the end, 4 potential options were declared viable.

1: Study collapse of Beta universe.
2: Enter gateway and acquire all relevant stockpiles of minerals and energy.
3: Allow science unit: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta's proposal.
4: Attempt to use highly experimental Beta science and technology to bring [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into Alpha reality.

colony.9850.a.zh: 就这一次，大家都活下来了！

colony.9850.desc.zh:
一道无形的虚无裂隙撕裂了[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的天空，就在[cloned_physicist.GetName]-阿尔法和贝塔正在通力合作完成他们艰难的任务的过程中，那道虚无也正在步步紧逼。负相物质稳定器激活后，有如虚空裂可能将其吞噬一般，世界间的缝隙拂过[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔。缝隙很快化作一缕涟漪消逝了，负向物质逐渐不再在原有的位置显现。

终于完成了。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。
colony.9850.desc.en:
A formless static covers a large swath of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta's sky and is closing in rapidly as [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Alpha and Beta, working side by side, finish their arduous task. The negative mass stabilizers activate, and the tear between worlds moves over [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta just as the static would smother it. The rift winks out moments later, and negative mass stops appearing at its former location.

It is done. After months of study and research accounting for new gravitational wells and habitable zones, [Root.Capital.GetStarName] now has a new inhabited planet orbiting it.

colony.9850.desc.hive.zh:
一道无形的虚无裂隙撕裂了[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的天空，就在[cloned_physicist.GetName]-阿尔法和贝塔的工蜂正在通力合作的过程中，那道虚无也正在步步紧逼。负相物质稳定器激活后，有如虚空裂可能将其吞噬一般，世界间的缝隙拂过[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔。缝隙很快化作一缕涟漪消逝了，负向物质逐渐不再在原有的位置显现。

终于完成了。新的视点和意识加入了[Root.GetName]，并在整个集体意识中激起涟漪。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。
colony.9850.desc.hive.en:
A formless static covers a large swath of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta's sky and is closing in rapidly as [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Alpha and Beta and all other available drones work side by side. The negative mass stabilizers activate, and the tear between worlds moves over [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta just as the static would smother it. The rift winks out moments later, and negative mass stops being produced at its former location.

It is done. The new perspectives and minds joining the [Root.GetName] send a ripple through the Collective. After months of study and research accounting for new gravitational wells and habitable zones, [Root.Capital.GetStarName] now has a new inhabited planet orbiting it.

colony.9850.desc.robot.zh:
一道无形的虚无裂隙撕裂了[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的天空，就在[cloned_physicist.GetName]-阿尔法和贝塔的科学单元正在通力合作的过程中，那道虚无也正在步步紧逼。负相物质稳定器激活后，有如虚空裂可能将其吞噬一般，世界间的缝隙拂过[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔。缝隙很快化作一缕涟漪消逝了，负向物质逐渐不再在原有的位置显现。

终于完成了。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。
colony.9850.desc.robot.en:
A formless static covers a large swath of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta's sky and is closing in rapidly as [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Alpha and Beta and all other available science units work side by side. The negative mass stabilizers activate, and the tear between worlds moves over [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta just as the static would smother it. The rift winks out moments later, and negative mass stops being produced at its former location.

It is done. After months of study and research accounting for new gravitational wells and habitable zones, [Root.Capital.GetStarName] now has a new inhabited planet orbiting it.

colony.9851.a.zh: 这种事情也可能降临到我们头上

colony.9851.desc.zh:
停留在贝塔宇宙的探测器记录着那个世界最后的时刻，一道无形的虚无之壁吞噬了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]-贝塔，随后[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔也难逃厄运。裂隙开合之前的瞬间，探测器就突然内失去了联系，而裂隙产生的负相粒子也一齐消失了。

另一次元的一切都不复存在了。
colony.9851.desc.en:
Probes left in the Beta universe record the final moments of reality, as a formless static wall absorbs first [Root.Capital.GetStarName]-Beta and then [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta. The feed is abruptly cut off shortly before the rift winks out of existence. The negative mass particles it was producing are likewise gone.

Anyone left on that side is no more.

colony.9855.b.en: They should stay on their side.

colony.9855.desc.zh: 自从裂隙出现之后，一种现象开始蔓延。处在我们次元的人们跑到他们在贝塔宇宙对应的孪生家庭那里，然后带他们偷渡到我们这个稳定的次元来。而偷渡很多时候就是由负责阻隔两个宇宙的边防哨卫进行的，毕竟[Owner.GetName]上谁在那边没有孪生家庭呢？如果只有一小撮人偷渡也就算了，但要是不加以制止，事情就会演变成恐慌性的逃跑。如果[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的居民流失过多，那边的基础设施就会随之崩溃，那样的话想要将他们的星球转移过来就更难了。
colony.9855.desc.en: A common issue has started occurring ever since the rift appeared. Families in our dimension are reaching out to their Beta counterparts and smuggling them into our stable universe. This is often done by the border guards assigned to keeping the universes separate, as basically everyone in the [Owner.GetName] has family on the other side. A few groups doing this wouldn't matter, but we would quickly have a stampede on our hands if the practice spreads. If [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta loses too many inhabitants, their infrastructure will collapse, and it will be even harder to get the world through.

colony.9860.a.zh: 返还这件大师之作并诚恳致歉。
colony.9860.a.en: Return the great work and apologize profusely.

colony.9860.b.zh: 多一朵镜中花，少一座维纳斯...

colony.9860.c.zh: 多两朵镜中花，少一座维纳斯...

colony.9860.desc.zh: 在这么近的地方有一个镜像世界的好处就在于，如果[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的文化遗产被破坏或遗失，你或许可以在这个世界中找到备份，这样大伙们又可以重新瞻仰这些瑰宝了。不过一些可恶的家伙却以此为契机偷偷潜入[Target.GetName]-贝塔，然后将这些宝物窃为己有。结果我们现在有了整整两份由我们历史中某位伟大创作者缔造的杰作。[Target.GetName]-贝塔的政府现在向我们发来一份措辞严厉而正式的通告，要求我们归还被窃的作品。
colony.9860.desc.en: One of the great things about having a mirror world so near is that [Owner.GetSpeciesName] cultural pillars that might have been destroyed or lost in the last few years might still exist on the other planet, so everyone can enjoy them again. Yet unsavory characters have taken this as an opportunity to infiltrate [Target.GetName]-Beta and secure these great works for themselves. We now possess not one but two masterworks made by a great inventor from our past. [Target.GetName]-Beta's government has already sent an angry yet formal request for us to return the plunder.

colony.9870.a.zh: 再加把劲，我们不能让他们止步于此。
colony.9870.a.en: Redouble our efforts, we can't let it end here.

colony.9870.a.tooltip.zh: $approach_save_b_world$应对方案将需要动员我们更多的科学家，总共降低研究速度-30%
colony.9870.a.tooltip.en: The $approach_save_b_world$ approach will require even more of our scientists, reducing our research speed by a total of -30%

colony.9870.b.en: All is going according to plan.

colony.9870.c.zh: 他们也是[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊！我们不能让他们就这么死去！
colony.9870.c.en: They are [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] too, we can't let it end like this!

colony.9870.desc.helped.zh: 贝塔宇宙的情况十万火急、每况愈下。今天上午传送门里又传来了联合呼救信号。即便我们尽了最大的努力，但可能我们的异次元亲戚们最终还是会被猎杀着他们宇宙的虚无所吞噬。如果我们想要拯救另一个版本的自己，那现在就是最后的机会了。
colony.9870.desc.helped.en: The situation in the Beta-Universe is dire, and it's only getting worse. A unified cry for salvation was heard from the portal earlier this morning. Even with our best efforts, it seems like our kin will become one with the nothingness haunting their universe. If we want to save our alter selves, the time is now.

colony.9870.desc.ignored.zh: 今天，贝塔宇宙的传送门中再次传出了可怜的呼救声，啜泣着请求着我们的救援。我们从他们的惨境中获利已经有些时日了，因为无法在那个宇宙中与任何东西取得联系，他们还在尝试着向我们大声呼救。不可挽回的分水岭正在靠近，而很快，贝塔[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就将不复存在了。
colony.9870.desc.ignored.en: A pitiful cry for help was heard from the Beta-Universe portal today, a final whimper for salvation. We have been benefiting from their situation for a while, yet they still call out to us since there is no one to talk to in their lonely universe. We are approaching the point of no return. Soon, the Beta-[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be no more.

colony.9875.a.hive.zh: 我们对完成这件事都很有兴趣。
colony.9875.a.hive.en: It's in all our interests that this gets done.

colony.9875.b.zh: 他们需要能拥有的全部[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]。
colony.9875.b.en: They need all the [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] that they can get.

colony.9875.desc.zh: 拥有第二个如假包换的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]给我们带来了一个意料之外的机遇。用来让我们的意识保持日常组织化的计算需要占用许多[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]，但这个任务现在可以分流到第二个[Root.GetName]上。这样做的价值是显而易见的，尽管可能会拖慢[Target.GetName]贝塔的拯救工作，但我们相信一切仍在掌控之中。
colony.9875.desc.en: Having a second [Owner.GetGovernmentName] which is so similar provides us with an unprecedented opportunity. The calculations required to keep our consciousness organized every day take up many [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural], but this task can now be offloaded to the second [Root.GetName]. The value of this is apparent, and while it might slow down the recovery effort of [Target.GetName]-Beta, we are sure we will still manage.

colony.9880.a.hive.zh: 击败变异子个体，镇压贝塔星球。
colony.9880.a.hive.en: Defeat the divergences, suppress the Beta-World.

colony.9880.a.tt.zh: 以100£pop£人口为代价获得400防御部队。
colony.9880.a.tt.en: Gain 400 defensive armies at the cost of 100 £pop£ Pops.

colony.9880.b.zh: 分析贝塔宇宙如此行为的原因。
colony.9880.b.en: Analyze why the Beta-Universe reacted like this.

colony.9880.desc.zh: 在持续的困境下，另一个[Owner.GetGovernmentName]终于失去理智，狂躁地想利用[Owner.GetSoldierPlural]夺取[Target.GetName]！我们必须在防线被冲垮前组织好自己的防御子个体。
colony.9880.desc.en: In their continued distress, the other [Owner.GetGovernmentName] has lashed out and manically taken a hold of the [Owner.GetSoldierPlural] on [Target.GetName]! We must organize our defense drones before we are overrun.

colony.9885.a.hive.zh: 我们会检查是否属实的。
colony.9885.a.hive.en: We will make sure that you do.

colony.9885.a.hive.tooltip.zh: 以我们的数量优势抑制贝塔世界蜂巢思维的存在。
colony.9885.a.hive.tooltip.en: Suppress the presence of the Beta-World hive mind through our superior numbers.

colony.9885.a.machine.tooltip.zh: 确保另一个次元不会再有通往[FromFrom.GetName]的不安全链接。
colony.9885.a.machine.tooltip.en: Ensure that the other dimension does not have any more unsecured connections to [FromFrom.GetName].

colony.9885.b.machine.zh: 可以理解，战斗AI天然就有破坏性。
colony.9885.b.machine.en: Understandable, combat AI is subversive by nature.

colony.9885.desc.hive.zh:
最后一只变异工蜂被击败了。我们的通讯工蜂再一次探测到了另一个意识的存在，但现在它变得更加地温顺，等待着我们启动通讯。

“我们对此表示歉意：随着虚无的逼近，本能反应已经越来越难以压制了。我们保证在未来会严加管束自己。”
colony.9885.desc.hive.en:
The final divergent drone has been defeated. Our communication drones are once again detecting the presence of the other Overmind, but it's acting a lot submissively this time, waiting for us to initiate communication.

"This Mind apologises - instinctive reactions are getting harder to suppress as The Static nears. We will ensure that we restrain ourselves in the future."

colony.9885.desc.machine.zh:
叛乱的繁育单元被击败了。我们的观测分析子例程再次探测到了来自[FromFrom.GetName]贝塔的通讯单元。他们只留下了一条简单的讯息。

“多余的防御单元再一次以非最佳方式行动。随着虚无的迫近，它们成功地突破了我们的隔离措施。这个进程已经被删除了，不会再有进一步的行为。”
colony.9885.desc.machine.en:
The rebelling defense unit has been defeated. Our observation analysis subroutines are once again detecting the presence of [FromFrom.GetName]-Beta's communication units. They left us with a simple message.

"Once again redundant defense units have acted in sub-optimal ways. As the The Static approaches, they managed to get through our quarantining efforts. The processes have since been deleted and should not take any further action."

colony.9890.desc.zh: [FromFrom.GetName]落入了贝塔变种手中。他们要求立刻转移一部分他们的子个体，同时在我们的星球建立子意识以确保他们的知识和存在能够续存。
colony.9890.desc.en: [FromFrom.GetName] has fallen to our Beta variants. They are now demanding the immediate transferal of some of their drones as well as the establishment of a sub-consciousness on our world to ensure the survival of their knowledge and existence.

colony.9900.a.tooltip.zh: [Root.GetName]上100£pop£人口失踪。我们将部署一套昂贵的跟踪监控系统来帮助我们解决这个谜团。
colony.9900.a.tooltip.en: 100 £pop£ Pops have gone missing from [Root.GetName]. An expensive tracking system will be used to help us solve this mystery.

colony.9900.b.en: There is no need to panic.

colony.9900.desc.zh: 日前，[Root.GetName]上涌现出大量的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪事件。这些人唯一的共同点就是他们在失踪时都孤身一人。随着消息散播开来，人们对于失踪的恐惧随之降临。民众的惶恐不安对殖民地的日常运作带来了极大的麻烦。
colony.9900.desc.en: Recently, numerous [Owner.GetColonistPlural] have gone missing on [Root.GetName]. The only discernible pattern is that each was alone at the time of their disappearance. As news began to spread, a collective fear of going unescorted has gripped the colony. This state of unrest is causing considerable problems for our day-to-day operations.

colony.9905.a.en: Get to the bottom of this.

colony.9905.desc.a.zh:
得益于在[Root.GetName]上部署的追踪系统，我们获得了重要的线索。

在近期[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪案例中，我们都在事件发生后迅速进行了扫描，进而得到了他们最后出现的位置。而在每个案例中，我们都发现了一种衰变的带电粒子残留物。

我们已经成立了一个特殊项目，以确定这些粒子的真实性质及其与我们失踪[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的关系。
colony.9905.desc.a.en:
Thanks to the implementation of the tracking system on [Root.GetName] we have a substantial lead.

As the most recent of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] disappeared, and we quickly followed up with a scan of their last location ping. A decaying residue of charged particles was found in each instance.

We've established a special project to determine the true nature of the particles and their involvement in our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

colony.9905.desc.b.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上取得了幸运的突破！我们发现了最近失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的去处。对这块区域的详细扫描发现了一些带电粒子的衰变痕迹。

我们已经成立了一个特殊项目，以确定这些粒子的真实性质及其与我们失踪[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的关系。
colony.9905.desc.b.en:
We've had a lucky break on [Root.GetName]! We have uncovered the location of the most recent [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to go missing. A detailed scan of the area revealed a decaying residue of charged particles.

We've established a special project to determine the true nature of the particles and their involvement in our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

colony.9910.desc.zh:
参照残留痕迹，我们通过全恒星系的扫描，在[Root.GetName]的卫星上发现了那些粒子的存在证据。

通过搜索卫星表面，我们找到了一坐被沙尘掩埋了数百年的小型气闸。其中是一座被遗弃的行政办公复合体、一台远距离物质传送机和一个连接在极先进静滞仓网络的力场操纵系统。

静滞仓中冷冻着许多个体，其中也包括我们失踪的殖民者。几乎可以肯定这座设施就是一座监狱。我们还需要弄清楚他们被抓进来的原因以及解救的方法。
colony.9910.desc.en:
Using the residue as a reference, a system-wide scan found evidence of the particles within [Root.GetName]'s moon.

A search of the lunar surface revealed a few small airlocks buried under centuries of dust. Inside was an abandoned complex of admin offices, long-range matter transporters, and field manipulation systems connected to a network of highly advanced stasis pods.

Frozen in the pods were many individuals, including our missing colonists. There is little doubt that this facility functioned as a prison. We have yet to determine why they were taken and how we can free them.

colony.9915.a.zh: 这可是不规矩的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]们的好去处。

colony.9915.a.tooltip.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归。我们也会获得一座可用的静滞监狱。
colony.9915.a.tooltip.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return. We will gain a functional stasis prison.

colony.9915.b.zh: 绝不可以把人关在这样的监狱里。
colony.9915.b.en: No one belongs in a prison like this.

colony.9915.b.tooltip.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归，我们也将关停这座监狱。其余的囚犯将被释放，但可能对我们的殖民地造成负面影响。
colony.9915.b.tooltip.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return and we will shut down the prison. The remaining prisoners will be freed, which could have negative effects for the colony.

colony.9915.c.zh: 设置一项逐步释放计划。
colony.9915.c.en: Set up a gradual release program.

colony.9915.c.tooltip.zh: 我们将对离开监狱的犯人进行筛查和帮助，以促进殖民地的平稳过渡。
colony.9915.c.tooltip.en: We will screen and support individuals as they leave the prison, facilitating a smoother transition for the colony.

colony.9915.d.tooltip.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归。我们会将这座监狱改造成食物工厂，让蜂巢得意享用这些静滞羁押的囚犯。
colony.9915.d.tooltip.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return. We will modify the prison as a food factory, allowing the hive to feast on the prisoners in stasis.

colony.9915.desc.zh:
真相和阴谋相去甚远，我们失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]是由于系统故障而遭到关押。

计算机的一个故障激活了监狱老旧的传送系统，随机地将几位我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]定罪。这座设施的建造者将这些静滞仓兼用于囚禁犯人和再教育功能。将我们的人口释放出来相对容易，但许多这些囚犯仍被困在静滞场中。尽管我们可以将他们释放，但由于没有犯罪记录，我们无法完整得知这些人的犯罪过往。

或者，我们可以修复这座监狱，让专职的监狱长控制它的传送系统。
colony.9915.desc.en:
Far from a conspiracy, our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] were imprisoned because of a glitch.

A computer error reactivated the prison's aging transporter system and randomly identified our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] as guilty. The facility's architects used the pods for both prisoner storage and re-education. Freeing our people was relatively easy, but many original prisoners are still stuck in stasis fields. It should be possible to release them, although the lack of prison records means we cannot know the full extent of their criminal pasts.

Alternatively, we could restore the prison, giving special wardens control of its transporter system.

colony.9920.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯大多数都是顽固的犯罪分子。突然将他们成群释放会对殖民地造成问题。
colony.9920.desc.en: Most of the released prisoners on [Root.GetName] were hardened criminals. Having the group of them suddenly released has been causing issues for the colony.

colony.9925.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯既有顽固的犯罪分子也有政治意见者：艺术家、作家和音乐家等等。

虽然这些文化囚犯很高兴与我们分享他们的知识，但许多罪犯走投无路又开始重操旧业。
colony.9925.desc.en:
The prisoners released on [Root.GetName] were a mix of hardened criminals and political dissidents: artists, writers, and musicians.

While the cultural prisoners are happy to share their knowledge with us, lacking any other option, many of the criminals have reverted to their old ways.

colony.9930.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯大多数都是政治异见者：艺术家、作家和音乐家等等。

在重获自由之后他们很乐意与我们分享他们的文化和知识。
colony.9930.desc.en:
Almost all of the prisoners released on [Root.GetName] were political dissidents: artists, writers, and musicians.

They're happily sharing their culture and knowledge with us now that they have been given their freedom.

colony.9950.b.zh: 我们可没有时间管这些东西。
colony.9950.b.en: There is no time for this.

colony.9950.desc.zh:
现在，[planet.GetName]上重要的殖民工作已经完成，[Root.Owner.GetName][Owner.GetScientistPlural]开始将注意力转向这个行星上的高耸尖塔。

这些矿物构成的结构似乎完全中空，将行星地壳下方的气体一路传输到大气热层。并且由于某些未知的原因，这些气体还吸引着缇扬奇以及其他太空生物，让它们长途跋涉来到这颗星球。

我们如果能够对这种星球奇观开展一次彻底的研究，就能加深我们对于这些奇幻现象的了解。当然了，我们也可以想个方法来收集这些稀有的气体。
colony.9950.desc.en:
Now that crucial colonization efforts of [planet.GetName] have been completed, [Root.Owner.GetName] [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have turned their attention towards its lofty spires.

These mineral formations appear to be entirely hollow, transporting gaseous substances from beneath the planet's crust all the way to the thermosphere. For an as yet unknown reason, these gases also attract Tiyanki and other spaceborne fauna to travel across great distances to this planet.

A more thorough research project would allow us to study this planetary wonder and expand our understanding of these incredible creatures, or perhaps to devise a method of claiming these precious gases for ourselves.

colony.9955.b.zh: 将其改造为气体精炼场所。

colony.9955.desc.zh:
我们已经确定，[planet.GetName]上的气体排放口是过热气体与其中的颗粒不断冷却沉积，历经数百万年时光形成的。那些没有沉积的气体则在大气热层中聚集成团，并被在其中优雅穿行的缇扬奇吞食。

这是一个罕见的机会，我们不仅可以近距离观察这些生物，还可以吸引外星游客前来观光。或者，我们也可以利用这些气体喷口提炼异星天然气，不过这样就需要把这些生物赶出它们栖息多年的地方。
colony.9955.desc.en:
We have determined that the vents on [planet.GetName] have formed over millions of years as superheated gas and sediments cool down and solidify. The remaining fumes in the lower thermosphere form clouds that the Tiyanki feed on, plowing through with unexpected grace.

This affords us a rare opportunity not only to observe the creatures in close proximity, but also increase the colony's appeal to extraplanetary visitors. Alternatively, the vents could be harnessed for exotic gas refining at the expense of driving away the fauna from their ancient feeding grounds.

colony.9960.b.zh: 这些资源还有别的用处。

colony.9960.desc.zh:
在最活跃的气体喷口附近建造豪华的观景平台后，我们可以大幅提升[planet.GetName]的独特旅游体验。游客可以与缇扬奇近距离接触，平台上的研究人员也会引导他们进行观光。

更富裕的游客可以直接参加科学采样探险，甚至还能亲身体验踏足活体缇扬奇带来的刺激！
colony.9960.desc.en:
The unique tourism opportunities on [planet.GetName] could be enhanced greatly by building luxurious viewing platforms near the most active vents. This would allow visitors to get up close and personal with Tiyanki as our on-site researchers guide them through this one of a kind experience.

The more affluent patrons could join scientific sampling expeditions or even experience the thrill of setting foot on a live Tiyanki!

colony.9965.b.en: It is not worth the risk.

colony.9965.desc.zh: 我们的工程师提出，可以利用炸药来扩宽排放口以充分利用[Planet.GetName]地下储存的气体。尽管排放口倒塌的风险微乎其微，但是为以防万一还是通知一下当地人口为好。
colony.9965.desc.en: Our engineers suggest that the underground gas reserves on [Planet.GetName] could be fully harnessed by expanding the vents with mining charges. The dangers of the vents collapsing should be negligible, but the local populace should be notified just in case.

colony.9970.desc.zh:
喷口扩展计划大获成功，我们的工程师汇报星球各处的气体产量均有增长。而不幸的副作用是有一些比较脆弱的排放口发生了史诗级的倒塌，对我们的一些设施造成了轻微损伤。

且不论这些微小的阻碍，我们成功地驾驭了[planet.GetName]独特的自然条件并得到了好处。
colony.9970.desc.en:
The vent expansion project was a resounding success and our engineers are reporting increased gas production across the planet. As an unfortunate side-effect, some of the more fragile vents crashed spectacularly, causing minor damage to our facilities.

Despite this minor setback, we have managed to harness the unique conditions of [planet.GetName] to great advantage.

colony.9975.desc.zh:
对炸药的计算失误导致数座排放口碎裂，倒塌到了地上，这对我们的设施造成了可观的损害。尽管有一部分精炼厂现在的产出是提高了，但总体而言得不偿失。令人欣慰的是，崩塌的构造下出现了意想不到的矿藏资源。

这些事件提醒我们，如果不砸碎几个喷口，就无法建立跨越星系的文明。
colony.9975.desc.en:
Miscalculations with the mining charges caused several vents to fracture and eventually topple to the ground, resulting in considerable damage to our facilities. While some refineries are now producing more gas than before, the total yield has decreased. The silver lining is that the collapsed structures have revealed unexpected sources of minerals.

These events act as a reminder that galaxy-spanning civilizations cannot be built without cracking a few vents.

colony_fed.100.desc.zh: 一处[Root.GetName]上的地理学异常现象引起了我们的注意。一个采矿设施周围突然出现了碗状的凹地，随后我们对此展开了调查。这个凹地的特征几乎从未在冰川区以外的地方发现过，但奇怪的是：当暴露在某些电磁波段时，这个“圆凹地”的侧壁会产生共振，并且会产生花瓣状的可见光散射。调查正在进行。
colony_fed.100.desc.en: A geological anomaly has come to our attention on [Root.GetName]. We began surveying after a bowl-shaped depression suddenly appeared alongside a mining facility there. Features like this are almost never found outside of a glacial region, but stranger still: the walls of this 'cirque' scatter visible light in a flower-petal pattern, and have been found to resonate when exposed to certain electro-magnetic bands. Investigations are ongoing.

colony_fed.105.a.en: Bring it back into the fold.

colony_fed.105.b.zh: 让我们瞧瞧这项研究会带来什么。
colony_fed.105.b.en: Let's see where this research goes.

colony_fed.105.desc.zh:
我们的科学家报告称，这些在[Root.GetName]新发现的蓝色晶状物质对延迟擦除光子能量响应剧烈。这些矿物将光子的波长过滤，并反射了一道可以将普通的硅化物转化为新型超导合金的光束——尽管只有在日光下才能进行。

由于该过程涉及到在一个狭小空间内反射高能辐射，若干科学家已经提出异议。而另一群热血沸腾的研究者则提出了相反的意见，他们强调这种现象可以彻底变革我们精练贵金属的方式。但无论如何：进一步开发这项科技都需要巨大的投入。
colony_fed.105.desc.en:
Our scientists report that the newly-uncovered, crystalline blue deposits on [Root.GetName] respond dramatically to delayed-erasure photon energy. The minerals filter its wavelengths and reflect a beam which is capable of transforming ordinary silicates into a new, super-conductive alloy - though only ever during daylight.

Given that this process essentially involves bouncing high levels of radiation around an enclosed space, some scientists have already come out in protest. A different group of excited researchers offers a counter-argument, stressing that this phenomenon could revolutionize the way we refine precious metals. Either way: developing this technique further will be costly.

colony_fed.105.gestalt.desc.zh:
