在[Root.GetName]的盆地中发现了一台运行着独立程序的离群的无人机。受到改进我们矿物冶炼方式的初始指令驱动，它找到了一种将硅化物转化为新种类合金的方法。

这一过程似乎涉及将高能束从特征墙中的矿物质反射回来。该无人机孜孜不觉的工作似乎导致了这一区域被填满了高能辐射。因此该无人机被捕获，而究竟是重新整合进系统还是将其个体摧毁从而获取相关知识有待决定。
colony_fed.105.gestalt.desc.en:
A rogue drone has been found running its own project within the cirque on [Root.GetName]. Driven by its initial directive - to refine our methods of mineral extraction - it has since stumbled onto a means of transforming everyday silicates into a new type of alloy.

The process seems to involve bouncing high-energy beams off mineral deposits in the feature's wall. The drone's eagerness in its task has caused it to flood the area with excessive levels of radiation. It has therefore been isolated pending either re-integration, or destruction of its individuality and acquired knowledge.

colony_fed.106.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上呈现出令人遗憾的场景，一群过于痴狂的科学家在计划的最后关头横加干涉。由于被自己的研究所迷醉，他们以“为了新科学”的名义试图夺取嬗变实验的控制权。引发的斗殴导致了设备的损坏，继而造成了无法控制的连锁反应。

最后在盆地中残存下来的是一个近乎晶洞的结构：岩质的外壳中包覆着由原来构成仪器设备和反对者们的物质转变而成的晶体。
colony_fed.106.desc.en:
Regrettable scenes on [Root.GetName], as a group of obsessive scientists sought to intervene in the project's closure. Dazzled by their own research, they attempted to wrest control of the transmutation experiments 'for the benefit of new science.' The resulting scuffle caused equipment to be damaged, and a runaway cascade took hold.

What remains of the cirque is something akin to a geode: a rocky shell around what used to be the equipment and protestors, now re-rendered in crystalline form.

colony_fed.107.desc.zh: 那个迷途的无人机和它的发现被彻底地抹除了。现在其意外的实验成果也仅是一片混乱，少量有用的物质被收集了起来。
colony_fed.107.desc.en: The wayward drone and its findings have been successfully purged. The results of its fluke experiments now litter the landscape; a small amount of useful material has been reclaimed.

colony_fed.110.desc.zh: [From.GetName]上的实验室得出了可靠的结果。虽然目前这一过程只能将少量的岩石转化成合金，但研究者对更大规模的操作抱有高度的信心。他们请求获得更多的资源。
colony_fed.110.desc.en: The laboratory on [From.GetName] is yielding verifiable results. Although their process can still only transmute small amounts of rock into alloys, researchers have high hopes for a larger-scale operation. They have requested access to further resources.

colony_fed.110.gestalt.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上凶险的实验得出了结果。虽然这一过程目前仍只能将少量物质转化为这种新金属，但该实验非常可靠。可能需要委以更多专项研究工作。
colony_fed.110.gestalt.desc.en: The rogue experiments on [Root.GetName] are yielding results. Although the process can still only transmute small amounts of matter into this new metal, the experiment is now verifiable. This could warrant more dedicated research efforts.

colony_fed.111.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]上的嬗变实验失败了，然而这一失败也避免了未来更大灾难的发生。当这种新型的设备刚一上线时，在设定的容忍限度内其表现良好。然而当对其发出关闭指令时，该过程会突然加速并达到故障保护极限。随后设施的外壳发生了转化，周围的物质全部变为了一种相同的超导合金。

该过程发生的地面爆炸夺去了许多生命，并且摧毁了周围的区域。从中我们只能获取一层有用物质，和一个无法解明的事故教训。
colony_fed.111.desc.en:
The transmutation experiments at [From.GetName] have failed - though their failure may actually have prevented future catastrophe. When new, more refined equipment was first brought online, it ran well within design tolerances. However, when shut-down instructions were issued, the process accelerated beyond the reach of its failsafes. Conversion took hold in the facility's housing, transmuting it and its surroundings into the same, super-conductive alloy.

The resulting ground explosion has taken a number of lives along with significant chunks of the surrounding landscape. We're left with little other than a seam of good material, and a cautionary tale in metaphysics.

colony_fed.115.desc.zh: 我们下一阶段的实验性生产设施上线了。以“蓝荷”命名的晶体嬗变设施现在正在夜以继日将前所未有规模的基础材料转化为有用的合金。
colony_fed.115.desc.en: The next phase of our experimental production facility has come online. The Blue Lotus crystalline transmutation facility is now busy converting unprecedented amounts of base material into useful alloys.

colony_fed.120.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的实验性设施发生了灾难性的失败。操作员说，我们可能永远也无法查明到底是什么导致了安全壳的失效，结果是整个设施、包括建筑物和周围的一大片区域都被失控的嬗变反应转变成了同一种超导合金。于此可以发掘出大量的有用材料。
colony_fed.120.desc.en: A catastrophic failure has occurred at the experimental facility on [Root.GetName]. Operatives say we may never know what specifically caused the failure in containment, but the result was runaway transmutation of the equipment, its housing, and a vast chunk of the surrounding landscape - all into the same, superconductive alloy. A rich seam of this material is all that remains.

colony_mod.1.a.en: Let's get to the bottom of this!

colony_mod.1.desc.zh: 很显然[Root.GetName]曾经遭遇了一场灾难并留下了超量的辐射。但是原因尚不明确。随着在[Root.GetName]定居的殖民者不断增加，这个谜团开始越发让人烦恼。毕竟，如果连原因都不知道，我们又该怎么防止悲剧再次重演？
colony_mod.1.desc.en: While it's obvious that some past calamity released a vast amount of radiation on [Root.GetName], it's not obvious what caused it. This mystery is now bothering more and more of the colonists who have made [Root.GetName] their home. After all, if we don't know how this happened, what is to say it could not happen again?

colony_mod.1.desc_mach.zh: 尽管[Root.GetName]上的大量辐射显然是过去的某起大灾难释放的，但我们仍未判明其具体原因，或者是否会再次发生这种现象。
colony_mod.1.desc_mach.en: While it's obvious that some past calamity released a vast amount of radiation on [Root.GetName], we have yet to determine its cause or whether it is likely to happen again.

colony_mod.10.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]大气中的致幻成分被全部清除了！
colony_mod.10.desc.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] has been cleansed of its intoxicating elements!

colony_mod.101.desc.zh: 经过一段时期的调查研究，[Root.GetName]的科学家终于获得了突破并且成功实现了与一些巨兽的简单交流。尽管个头巨大，动作迟缓，并且难以沟通，泰坦巨兽们依然难以置信的坚韧和强壮。有一些表达了加入我们军团的意愿，他们毫无疑问会成为我们的杀手锏。
colony_mod.101.desc.en: After a period of research and study, the scientists on [Root.GetName] have managed to make a breakthrough and achieve limited communications with some of the Titans. While huge, slow, and difficult to talk to, the Titans are incredibly tough and strong. Some few have expressed a desire to join our military forces, where they will undoubtedly be an incredible asset.

colony_mod.102.desc.zh: 一场灾难性的连锁反应中，[Root.GetName]的科学家触怒了当地的泰坦巨兽。巨大的生物在殖民地肆虐，将他们前行道路上的一切都粉碎殆尽。
colony_mod.102.desc.en: In a disastrous series of events, the scientists on [Root.GetName] have enraged the indigenous Titanic Life. Huge creatures are rampaging across the colony, smashing everything in their path.

colony_mod.11.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]大气经过过滤，致幻的效果已经大幅削弱。
colony_mod.11.desc.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] has been filtered to greatly reduce the effects of the hallucinogen.

colony_mod.16.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]周围的强力磁场最近在影响地面上的电脑。奇怪的是，这个影响并不是单纯地随机干扰，正相反，电脑实际上比预想中运行的更有效率了。这简直是老天相助……
colony_mod.16.desc.en: The Strong Magnetic Field around [Root.GetName] has been affecting computers on the surface recently. Oddly, this effect is not merely random interference, instead computers are actually working more efficiently than they should be. It's almost as if an outside force is lending a helping hand...

colony_mod.17.desc.zh: 环绕[Root.GetName]的强力磁场一直都在干扰着地表的电子仪器，但最近对我们的电脑造成的影响尤为严重。到目前为止我们仍不清楚事态的起因，不过我们猜测这应该是暂时性的。
colony_mod.17.desc.en: The Strong Magnetic Field around [Root.GetName] has always caused some problems with electronic instruments on the surface, but recently the effect on our computers has been especially notable. So far, it is unknown what has caused this flare up, although we suspect it to be temporary.

colony_mod.18.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]是一台无比复杂而精细的自组织量子电脑。它的气候规律，当地生物，甚至我们的殖民地都被它当作神经元，整合进了星球大小的网络中。我们无法掌握其原理，也无法控制它，但如果我们以某种特定的方式来布置我们的电脑，[Root.GetName]将会增强其性能。
colony_mod.18.desc.en: [Root.GetName] is the site of a self-organizing quantum computer of astounding complexity and subtly. The patterns of the weather, the native life, even our own colony is incorporated into it and somehow used as neurons in a planet-sized network. We do not understand how this is possible, and we have no way of controlling it, but we do know that if we arrange our computers in a certain way [Root.GetName] will enhance their performance.

colony_mod.2.c.zh: 确保研究不会对它们造成伤害。
colony_mod.2.c.en: Ensure that the research does no harm.

colony_mod.2.d.zh: 研究它们？猎杀它们然后再看看有没有用处！
colony_mod.2.d.en: Study them? Harvest them and see if anything is useful!

colony_mod.2.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的当地生命体型庞大，远远超出了所能设想的生物体型极限。研究人员思索：“为什么它们这么大？对我们可有益处？”进一步详细研究原生生物的建议书蜂拥而至。
colony_mod.2.desc.en: The native life of [Root.GetName] is built on an epic scale, far larger than anyone previously thought was possible for biological life. The question now in the minds of our researchers is "What is their secret, and can we benefit from it?" Proposals to study the native life in greater detail are flooding in.

colony_mod.21.desc.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震在当地的殖民地造成了一个巨大的陷坑。无论那里曾经有什么，现如今都陷入地下的深渊了。
colony_mod.21.desc.en: The recent earthquake which shook our colony on [Root.GetName] has caused a large sinkhole to open. Whatever once occupied that spot is now deep underground.

colony_mod.22.desc.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震虽然撼动了我们的殖民地，但没有造成任何损伤。令人惊喜的是，这场地震反而让我们发现了一批有用的矿脉。
colony_mod.22.desc.en: The recent earthquake which rocked our colony on [Root.GetName] caused no damage and, serendipitously, has uncovered a batch of useful minerals.

colony_mod.23.desc.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震虽然撼动了我们的殖民地，但没有造成任何损伤。
colony_mod.23.desc.en: The recent earthquake which staggered our colony on [Root.GetName] caused no damage!

colony_mod.3.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]不稳定的板块构造再次发生了剧烈变动。关于殖民地损失的报告刚刚送达。
colony_mod.3.desc.en: The unstable tectonic plates of [Root.GetName] have just violently shifted once again. Reports on the damage to the colony are just starting to arrive.

colony_mod.31.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的构造变动导致一个巨大板块上的黑曜岩薄层破碎。熔岩倾泻而出遍布地表，造成了毁灭性的影响。从殖民地发回的报告相当可怕。
colony_mod.31.desc.en: Tectonic events on [Root.GetName] have caused the Obsidian sheets on one of the giant plates to shatter. Lava pours across the surface to ruinous effect. Reports from the colony are dire.

colony_mod.32.desc.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发已经演化成了一座活火山！附近的一切都已经被埋葬在熔岩之下。
colony_mod.32.desc.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] has turned into an active volcano! Anything that once existed there is now buried under molten rock.

colony_mod.33.desc.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发奇迹般地没有造成损伤。更幸运的是，它击碎了大量的黑曜石，方便了我们采集。
colony_mod.33.desc.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] miraculously caused no damage. In a fortunate twist, it has also shattered the Obsidian for easy gathering!

colony_mod.34.desc.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发奇迹般地没有造成损伤。
colony_mod.34.desc.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] miraculously caused no damage!

colony_mod.4.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的居民正在见证一出壮观的景象。一颗彗星正在经过[Root.GetName]的行星环带，效果被形容为“惊心动魄”。
colony_mod.4.desc.en: The population of [Root.GetName] are currently witnessing a spectacular sight. A comet is passing through [Root.GetName]'s asteroid belt and the effect is being described as "magnificent."

colony_mod.4.name.zh: 观测到彗星经过行星环带

colony_mod.5.desc.zh: 毋庸置疑，[Root.GetName]大气中令人陶醉的效果让人无比享受，甚至在某些方面颇有助益，然而[Root.Owner.GetName]的保守派多次施加压力，要求清除这些可能产生依赖性的气体。
colony_mod.5.desc.en: While it cannot be denied that the intoxicating effects of [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere are enjoyable, and even helpful in some cases, there is pressure from the more conservative parts of the [Root.Owner.GetName] to crack down on the possibly addictive gases.

colony_mod.6.a.zh: 研究轰炸遗址，了解所使用武器的细节。
colony_mod.6.a.en: Study the impact sites for details of the weapons used.

colony_mod.6.desc.zh: 在彻底调查后，我们得出的结论是在遥远的古代[Root.GetName]上曾发生过灭绝事件。目前我们可以确定的是，当时[Root.GetName]上的本土居民已经快要发展为具有遨游太空能力的物种，但一个更加先进的物种突然闯入他们的恒星系，从轨道轰炸了[Root.GetName]然后再次离开，而少数幸存者也只能坐以待毙。
colony_mod.6.desc.en: After a thorough investigation, we have come to the conclusion that [Root.GetName] was the site of an ancient genocide. As far as we can determine, the native population of [Root.GetName] was on the verge of becoming a space-faring race when a far more advanced race suddenly entered the system, bombarded [Root.GetName] from orbit, and left again, leaving the few survivors doomed to extinction.

colony_mod.7.a.en: Study what remains of the battlefields.

colony_mod.7.desc.zh: 在彻底调查后，我们得出的结论是[Root.GetName]是某场被遗忘的战争的牺牲品。谁曾经住在这里，以及他们与谁交战已经不得而知，但很明显他们是在与来自星系外的袭击者们争夺这颗星球时被消灭的。尽管这个发现令人心寒，我们至少可以肯定这种事不太可能会再次发生。
colony_mod.7.desc.en: After a thorough investigation, we have come to the conclusion that [Root.GetName] was a casualty in some forgotten war. Who lived here and who they fought is unknown, but it is clear that they were wiped out following an extra-solar invasion force entering the system and the ensuing battle for the planet. While this is a chilling realization, we can at least be reasonably sure that it is unlikely to happen again.

colony_mod.8.a.zh: 究竟是什么导致他们到达如此的地步呢？
colony_mod.8.a.en: What could drive people to such a fate?

colony_mod.8.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的历史悲剧被揭开。很久以前，[Root.GetName]在两支相互竞争的强大势力之下艰难生存。到了某个时间节点，他们之间爆发了战争，战争愈演愈烈，直至[Root.GetName]上所有的高等生命由于核武器滥用而被全部毁灭。
colony_mod.8.desc.en: The tragic history of [Root.GetName] has been uncovered. Long ago, it seems that [Root.GetName] was dominated by two competing superpowers. At some point war broke out between them and the conflict escalated until all advanced life on [Root.GetName] was eliminated by excessive use of nuclear weapons.

colony_mod.8.desc_mach.zh: 很久以前，[Root.GetName]似乎有两支互相竞争的强大势力。他们之间爆发了战争，而冲突不断加剧，直到[Root.GetName]上所有的高等生物都因滥用核能武器而被消灭了。
colony_mod.8.desc_mach.en: Long ago, it seems that [Root.GetName] was dominated by two competing superpowers. At some point war broke out between them and the conflict escalated until all advanced life on [Root.GetName] was eliminated by excessive use of nuclear weapons.

colony_mod.9.desc.zh: 尽管对[Root.GetName]历史进行了广泛调查，我们还是不知道这里曾经发生了什么。过去依然是一个谜。
colony_mod.9.desc.en: Despite extensive research into the history of [Root.GetName] we just don't know what happened here. The past remains a mystery.

coming_storm_poi_1_poi_desc.zh: 根据当前目标矢量推测，那个即将到来的亚空间实体会在这些恒星系附近进入我们的星系。
coming_storm_poi_1_poi_desc.en: Given their current vector, we estimate that the approaching mass of subspace contacts will enter our galaxy somewhere in the vicinity of these star systems.

communications_spread.1.desc.zh: 我们截获了一条发往[CommSpreader.GetName]的消息，我们发现他们和另一个我们尚未发现的帝国建立了定期联系。我们追踪这条消息，与这位星系中的神秘角色建立了通讯线路。
communications_spread.1.desc.en: By intercepting a message sent to the [CommSpreader.GetName], we have learned that they are in regular contact with another spacefaring empire that we ourselves have no contact with. By tracing this message to its source, we have been able to establish our own line of communications with this previously unknown actor on the galactic stage.

communications_spread.2.desc.zh: 我们从一个太空深处的未知帝国那里收到了一份公报，他们自称[From.GetName]。他们还声称，他们从我们与另一个帝国的通讯中发现了我们的存在。
communications_spread.2.desc.en: We have received a communiqué from a previously unknown spacefaring empire that call themselves the [From.GetName]. They claim to have learned of our existence by listening in on the communications of another empire we are in contact with.

composer_covenant_tradition_tt.zh: 一旦我们的契约建立，我们的$telepath_type_plural_with_icon$会增加£mod_logistic_growth_mult£ $MOD_LOGISTIC_GROWTH_MULT$。
composer_covenant_tradition_tt.en: Once our Covenant is confirmed, our $telepath_type_plural_with_icon$ will increase £mod_logistic_growth_mult£ $MOD_LOGISTIC_GROWTH_MULT$.

contacting_great_patron.zh: £trigger_no£因为需要接触一位更强大的超主，我们连接虚境的能力被打断了。
contacting_great_patron.en: £trigger_no£ Our ability to reach into the Shroud is disrupted as we contact a Greater Patron.

contingency_kills_others.zh: 被其他国家脱机的肃正战体

contingency_kills_us.zh: 被我方脱机的肃正战体

contract_dropoff_planet_tt.zh: 我们必须将乘客带去[dropoff_planet.solar_system.GetName]恒星系内的[dropoff_planet.GetName]
contract_dropoff_planet_tt.en: We must bring our passengers to [dropoff_planet.GetName] in the [dropoff_planet.solar_system.GetName] system

convert_waystations_into_outposts_tt.zh: 所有位于未拥有恒星系中的£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']都将转换为['concept_outposts']，并获得该恒星系的宣称。
convert_waystations_into_outposts_tt.en: All £waystation£ ['concept_waystations'] in unowned systems are converted into ['concept_outposts'], claiming ownership of their system.

cool_relic_world_site_desc.zh: 整个行星都被巨大的建筑物所覆盖着，这个遗落的大都会星肯定有秘密等待发掘。
cool_relic_world_site_desc.en: An entire planet covered in vast structures, this fallen megalopolis surely has secrets to be unearthed.

cosmic_dawn_sleepers_category_desc.zh: 这些坐标位置上的行星据说藏有大量休眠者和技术，我们应该展开彻底调查。
cosmic_dawn_sleepers_category_desc.en: The planet at these coordinates is supposed to hide a cache of sleepers and technology. We should investigate thoroughly.

cosmogenesis_damage_ships_tt.zh: 我们的舰队将遭受损失。

cosmogenesis_negative_opinion_tt.zh: 我们与其他帝国的关系下降了。
cosmogenesis_negative_opinion_tt.en: Our relations with other empires have deteriorated.

councilor_gestalt_cognitive_desc.zh: $TITLE$是我们发展对周遭世界理解的部位。
councilor_gestalt_cognitive_desc.en: The $TITLE$ is where we develop our understanding of the world around us.

councilor_gestalt_growth_desc.zh: $TITLE$是我们做出关于集体的重要决定的位置。
councilor_gestalt_growth_desc.en: The $TITLE$ is where important decisions are made regarding the collective.

councilor_gestalt_legion_desc.zh: $TITLE$是我们做出关于星系扩张决议的部位。
councilor_gestalt_legion_desc.en: The $TITLE$ is where decisions concerning galactic expansion are made.

councilor_gestalt_regulatory_desc.zh: $TITLE$是我们抵御突发反常意识的部位
councilor_gestalt_regulatory_desc.en: The $TITLE$ is where we counter the emergence of deviant consciousnesses.

country.1.a.tooltip.zh: 开始亚光速探测器事件链
country.1.a.tooltip.en: Begins the Sublight Exploration Probes Event Chain

country.1.desc.zh:
在我们掌握超光速航行技术前，[Root.Capital.GetName]派出的一些亚光速探测器以近相对论速度前往临近的星系进行探索。开发探测器的科学家天真地在存储内核中输入了我们文明的敏感信息作为向外星文明的问候。

现在，人们终于意识到这些信息可能被用来对付我们。我们必须趁早追回那些探测器，以免落入那些对我们虎视眈眈的外星生物之手。
country.1.desc.en:
Before we developed faster-than-light travel, several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] at near-relativistic speeds towards nearby systems. The scientists who developed the probes naively included sensitive information about our culture in their memory cores as a form of greeting to alien civilizations.

It has now been realized that this data could potentially be used against us. We need to track down these probes before they are found by someone - or something - unsympathetic to our species!

country.10.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.GetStarName]星系中探测到了规模巨大的亚空间异常。异常的中心似乎是我们丢失的亚光速传感器之一！
country.10.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] has detected a massive subspace anomaly in the [Root.GetStarName] system. It appears to be centered on one of our missing sublight probes!

country.1000.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]研究部门的首席科学官失踪了。

他们的私人赞助的科研船试验机也不见了。

[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界一片哗然。
country.1000.desc.en:
The Head of the [Root.GetName]'s Research Department has gone missing.

Along with their privately-funded, highly experimental prototype Science Ship.

The incident has the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] in an uproar.

country.1001.a.tooltip.zh: 开启“浪迹星涯：叛变科学官”事件链
country.1001.a.tooltip.en: Begins the Wanderlust: Rogue Scientist Event Chain

country.1001.desc.zh:
首席科学官——准确来说应该是前首席科学官——还没有找到。但是一些关于科研船试验机以及长官的私人研究的消息却已经传到了我们的耳朵里。虽然有一些太过离谱，但显而易见的是尽快寻回首席关乎着[Root.GetName]的利益。

情报日志已更新。
country.1001.desc.en:
The whereabouts of the Head - now technically the former Head of Research - have yet to be ascertained. Certain details regarding the prototype Science Ship and the Head's private research have reached our ears, and while some aspects seem too fantastical to be true, it is clear that it is in the [Root.GetName]'s interest to find and recover the Chair as soon as possible.

The Situation Log has been updated.

country.1003.desc.zh:
首席科学官并不在这个星系之内。

这一趟要不就彻底是白忙活，要不就是线索早已经断了。
country.1003.desc.en:
The Research Head is not in this system.

Either the lead was a dud, or the trail has gone cold.

country.1005.desc.zh:
科学家的船就在这个星系里——如果没猜错的话。

我们没法通过探测器确定他们的位置，不过他们主动呼叫了我们。把他们的信号接到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
country.1005.desc.en:
The Researcher's ship is in this system - we think.

We are unable to lock in their position on sensors, but they are hailing us. Patching them through to [Root.Capital.GetName].

country.1010.a.en: What is the meaning of this?

country.1010.a.response.zh:
您应该想问我从[Root.GetName]上消失的事。

我只是离开一小会，仅此而已。我在寻找真实之窗。但显然我并没找到。

它也不在这里。我必须继续我的研究了。不过我可不会带着这些找到的无人机。
country.1010.a.response.en:
I take it you are referring to my disappearance from [Root.GetName] space.

I needed some time away, is all. Well. Rather, I am looking for the Window. And the Window is certainly not there.

It is not here either. I must continue my search. I will not be bringing these drones I found, though.

country.1010.b.zh: 我们可以派船护送你回家。
country.1010.b.en: We can assign ships to escort you home.

country.1010.b.response.zh:
我现在不想回家。

但是，为了表示我的诚意，请收下这些无人机吧，作为我送给[Root.GetName]的礼物。这些无人机是我在这个星系的外围发现的。经过彻底修理过后，我才发现它们根本不适合用作研究探测。
country.1010.b.response.en:
I have no interest in returning home at present.

But please, as a token of my goodwill, take these drones. A donation to the [Root.GetName]. I found them drifting on the outskirts of this system, and only after extensive repairs did I realize that they are utterly unfit to function as research probes.

country.1010.c.en: You will return to the capital at once.

country.1010.c.response.zh:
对不起，我的研究才刚刚开始。使命在召唤我，这是为了科学。

但是，为了表示我的诚意，请收下这些无人机吧，作为我送给[Root.GetName]的礼物。这些无人机是我在这个星系的外围发现的。经过彻底修理过后，我才发现它们根本不适合用作研究探测。
country.1010.c.response.en:
I think not, this is but the beginning. Duty calls, for science, and so on.

But please, as a token of my goodwill, take these drones. A donation to the [Root.GetName]. I found them drifting on the outskirts of this system, and only after extensive repairs did I realize that they are utterly unfit to function as research probes.

country.1010.desc.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，鄙人向您传达我们诚挚的问候。

我估计你不是单纯来寒暄问候的吧？
country.1010.desc.en:
Greetings and salutations, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

I take it this is not a social call?

country.1015.desc.zh:
首席再次神秘地消失了。

不过他们的确留下了一些无人机。这些无人机装备了武器，而且正在启动！
country.1015.desc.en:
The Chair has vanished, inexplicably, yet again.

However, they did leave a number of drones behind, as promised. The drones are armed, and their weapons are powering up!

country.1020.desc.zh:
这些无人机的敌我识别系统的模组被拆除了，应该是首席干的。不过它们的威胁评估处理器还完好无损。由于此人的破坏行为，威胁等级有些升高。

首席科学官不像是想让它们攻击我们，但是它们很好地掩护了首席，让其成功逃走了。

查看情报日志的特殊项目，以获得首席最后一次出现的位置。
country.1020.desc.en:
The drones' IFF modules had been removed, likely a result of the Head Researcher's repairs, but their threat assessment processors remained intact and somewhat stressed by the Head's invasive procedures.

It is unlikely that the head meant for the drones to attack us, but fact remains that they covered the scientist's escape nicely.

Consult the Situation Log for a Special Project to track the Head from their last known location.

country.1020.name.zh: 浪迹星涯：毁坏的无人机

country.1022.desc.zh:
科学家留下的无人机似乎被某个人或者是某个东西击毁了。

我们应该抓住这个机会，寻找有关首席的线索。

一个特殊项目已经添加到情报日志中。
country.1022.desc.en:
It seems the drones left behind by the Researcher have been destroyed, by something or someone.

We should seize this opportunity to pick up the Head's trail.

A Special Project has been added to the Situation Log.

country.1022.name.zh: 浪迹星涯：无人机被击毁

country.1025.desc.zh:
我们已经破译了首席留下的科研船上的能源信息，可以再度对其展开追踪。

查看情报日志以获得更多细节。
country.1025.desc.en:
Having decoded the intricate web of energy signatures left behind by the Chair's elusive Science Ship, we are on their trail once again.

Consult the Situation Log for details.

country.1025.name.zh: 浪迹星涯：特殊项目已完成

country.1030.desc.zh:
首席的科研船神出鬼没，侦测起来相当困难，但这还不是最难的。

传感器上显示的数据令人不解，上面显示首席的船两侧各有一艘虎视眈眈的护卫舰。

首席物理学家正在向我们致意。
country.1030.desc.en:
The ephemeral Science Ship remains difficult to detect, but apparently not difficult enough.

The blur of confused sensor readings that we have come to associate with the Head's ship is flanked on both sides by a pair of rather nasty-looking corvettes.

The Physicist Head is hailing us.

country.1035.a.response.zh:
跑？我只是离开而已。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]，我知道你们都不太喜欢我的行为。但我不能让[Root.GetSpeciesName]科学界没完没了的派别斗争危害到我的研究。

而且，有些研究也需要实地考察。一直如此。
country.1035.a.response.en:
Run? I left.

I realize you are none too pleased with my actions, [Root.GetRulerTitle], but I could not risk my work being mired in the petty politics of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] scientific community.

Besides, I had some research to do in the field. Still do.

country.1035.b.zh: 先跟我们讲讲关于真实之窗的事。
country.1035.b.en: Tell us more about this Window, first.

country.1035.b.response.zh:
在这种节骨眼上，我不太方便讲述细节。我不太想，嗯，让自己看起来像个傻瓜。万一最后证明我是错的呢？

但是我们也许最后都会变成全息影像。这又是否值得呢？
country.1035.b.response.en:
I would be loath to go into details at this juncture. Would not, ah, want to look the fool. Should it turn out that I am mistaken.

But we may all turn out to be holograms in the end. Would it not be worth it?

country.1035.c.zh: 我们会帮你摆平局面的。
country.1035.c.en: We will try to get you out of this mess.

country.1035.desc.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您好。

请允许我向[Root.GetSpeciesName]的舰队致以热烈欢迎。恐怕我的突然出现激怒了这个星系的外星生物，现在他们的飞船把我包围了。

如果您能帮忙弥补一下我的失礼行为，那就再好不过了。事情解决后，我会很乐意与你们分享我的探险经历。
country.1035.desc.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

[Root.GetSpeciesName] ships are a most welcome sight. I fear my own sudden appearance in this system may have angered the alien beings aboard the ships that now surround mine.

Any assistance in rectifying whatever faux pas I may have committed would be most appreciated. I will gladly share with you the nature of my expedition once this matter is settled.

country.1040.a.zh: 外星人渣，敢跟我们结梁子，你早晚要后悔。
country.1040.a.en: You will rue the day you crossed us, alien scum.

country.1040.a.response.zh: 真是丑人多作怪。野蛮人，这不是我们第一次交锋了。
country.1040.a.response.en: Big words from someone so ugly. This isn't our first rodeo, bucko.

country.1040.d.zh: 现在滚还能留你一条活路。
country.1040.d.en: Leave now and you may yet live.

country.1040.d.response.zh:
虚张声势！丑八怪，这可不是你的领地。
这些星星是阳炎海盗的。
country.1040.d.response.en:
Empty threats! You are a long way from home, ugly.
The Sunblaster Pirates own these stars.

country.1040.desc.zh:
滚开！是我们先找到这艘破烂幽灵船的。

谁先看见就是谁的，不是谁先登船就是谁的。它是我们的，不是你们的。而且它的舰长还死了。
country.1040.desc.en:
Get lost! We found the rotten ghost-ship first.

Once we figure out how to see it proper-like, it's as good as boarded. And ours. Not yours. And its captain dead.

country.1041.a.zh: 祈祷最好别再遇上我们吧，可怜虫。
country.1041.a.en: Pray that we do not meet again, degenerates.

country.1041.b.zh: 一切都是浮云，物质财富更是如此。
country.1041.b.en: All things are fleeting, material wealth especially so.

country.1041.c.zh: 金钱是万能的。如果做不到，说明你钱不够多。
country.1041.c.en: Money talks. Sometimes you have to raise your voice.

country.1041.desc.zh:
150能量币？这价格估计都算不上家猪用剩的一点小零头，真狡猾。但是……

哎，这艘混账幽灵船带来的麻烦比它的好处还要多。

弟兄们！我们走！
country.1041.desc.en:
150 Energy Credits? Hardly a drop in the domesti-beast's piss-bucket, ugly. But...

Bah, the filthy ghost-ship has been more trouble than it's worth anyway.

Skitskur'r! We out!

country.1042.a.zh: 你们会见识到[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]军团的厉害。
country.1042.a.en: You will know the military might of the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

country.1042.desc.zh:
这些傻子需要好好学学。

弟兄们！拿起武器！
country.1042.desc.en:
The fool needs to be taught a lesson.

Skitskur'r! Weapons!

country.1044.desc.zh:
我忍不住听到了谈话中一些只言片语——毕竟他们是在开放频段上广播的。

我想交易进行得还算顺利。
country.1044.desc.en:
I couldn't help but catch bits and pieces of that conversation - they were broadcasting on an open channel, after all.

I gather the transaction went smoothly.

country.1045.a.zh: 确实如此。现在有话快说吧。

country.1045.a.response.zh:
噢，好的。

就是……我不用细枝末节来烦扰您了，[Root.GetRulerTitle]，但是有一种观念，一切皆为虚妄。或者说我们所认知的真实其实并非如此，至少并非完全如此，甚至比其他事物更接近于虚妄。这也就是说，这一切——包括我，[Root.GetRulerTitle]您自己，以及我们认为是不可动摇的宇宙法则——都只不过是光的把戏而已。这个宇宙不过是镜花水月，是映像，抑或是全息投影，或是棱镜。终究只不过是散射了真正现实的迷人光线罢了。

明白了吗？这些光一定是从某个地方来的。从真实之窗来的。
country.1045.a.response.en:
Oh yes, of course.
There is... I will not bore you with the details [Root.GetRulerTitle], but there is this idea, if you will, that nothing is real. Or that what we think is real is not, that it is less real, less so than something else. That this, this is all - I, you yourself [Root.GetRulerTitle], the very laws of nature we consider absolute - nothing but tricks of the light. The universe as a reflection, hologram, or prism, simply breaking the brilliant rays of the truly real.

See? The light has to come from somewhere. Through the Window.

country.1045.b.en: You are to return to [Root.Capital.GetName] immediately.

country.1045.desc.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，我看到您一下子就除掉了那些海盗。

作为一名科学家，我痛恨争斗……但我也深知在那种情形下这是必需的。如果我落入那些海盗之手，想必待遇不会太好。
country.1045.desc.en:
I see you made short work of the pirates, [Root.GetRulerTitle].
As a scientist, I abhor violence... But recognize that it may have been necessary in this case. I strongly suspect I would have been treated less than kindly at the hands of those pirates.

country.1046.desc.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您心里很清楚我是不会回去的。

事实上，我也考虑过其他的可能性。我想我短时间内很可能无法回去了。

我手头的所有研究数据，只要我觉得对[Root.GetSpeciesName]的人们有用，我就会上传到[Root.Capital.GetName]的数据库中。但是和真实之窗有关的数据我会自己保留。现在我觉得自己还没有准备好。不过显然，没人准备好。

我得走了。
country.1046.desc.en:
You know I will not, [Root.GetRulerTitle].
In fact, having had some time to consider additional possibilities, I believe there is a significant risk I will not be able to return within a reasonable timeframe.

I have taken the liberty of uploading whatever research data I have that may benefit the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people to the databases on [Root.Capital.GetName]. The data related to the Window stays with me, though. I am starting to think I am not ready; certainly no one else is.
I will be going now.

country.1047.desc.zh:
简单查看了一下，首席的确说到做到。[Root.GetName]的物理学研究整体得到了小幅度的提升。

科学家又一次消失了，但是这一次，这个人的行踪在离开这个星系之前就被我们侦测到了。

如果他们想去寻找这个真实之窗，那么我们也会去。
查看情报日志以获得更多细节。
country.1047.desc.en:
A quick check confirms the Head's claims, and the [Root.GetName] has enjoyed a small but not insignificant boost to our collective body of physics research.

The Researcher has vanished once again, but this time their course had been divined before they were even out of the system.

If they are headed for this Window, then so are we.
Consult the Situation Log for details.

country.1050.desc.zh:
科研船原型机第一次清楚地出现在了我们的传感器上。它以极近的距离围绕着这个星系的恒星运转，不过其他地方并没有什么特别的。

只需简单的光学扫描，这艘船的秘密就暴露无遗。它的船身设计十分普通，没有什么独到之处。上面有许多十字形的金属网格，像是交流电压控制下的电磁铁。只要足够接近恒星，飞船就能稍微扭曲恒星发出的射线，将它们缠绕于自身附近，把自己伪装起来。

这个科技理论上听起来不错，但是实际应用中却有一些明显的问题。由于暴露在恒星的辐射中太久，它的整套设配都已经被烤焦而且变得毫无用处。
country.1050.desc.en:
For the first time, the prototype Science Ship is plainly visible on sensors. It is orbiting dangerously close to the system's star, but appears otherwise unremarkable.

A simple optical scan reveals the ship's secret. Its hull is a standard design altered without much subtlety, now crisscrossed by a lattice of metal filaments likely acting as electromagnets at alternating, tightly-controlled voltages. By staying close to a star the ship can weakly warp its stellar emissions, wrapping them around itself as a form of camouflage.

While conceptually interesting, the technique has obvious practical drawbacks, as evidenced by the entire set-up now having been fried and rendered useless by prolonged exposure to solar radiation.

country.1050.name.zh: 浪迹星涯：真实之窗开启

country.1051.a.zh: 首席科学官，你想做什么？

country.1051.a.response.zh: 我想我已经找到真实之窗了。至少是一扇真实之窗。也许还会有更多。说不定我们的真身就在那里。说不定所有东西的真身就在那里。不得不承认，我脑子里一点概念也没有。我知道我获得的这些知识也没办法造福什么人。但是如果我就此打住的话，那也太不负责任了。
country.1051.a.response.en: I have found the Window, I think. A window, at least. There may be more. Do our true selves lie beyond? Does anything? I must confess that I haven't the faintest idea. I recognize that no one else may very well benefit from whatever knowledge I gain. But to stop here would be utterly irresponsible.

country.1051.b.response.zh:
我会试着穿过真实之窗，前往真实。显然，来自真实的光不单单只是通过这里。整个宇宙就像是一大块玻璃窗，我们只是其中的一小块扭曲，一小块瑕疵而已。我们的生命来源于我们之上的那种光辉。

这就是真实之窗，我相信它会开启的。
country.1051.b.response.en:
I will attempt to pass through the Window, into reality. The light of the real does not solely shine through here, of course. The entire universe is like a vast pane of glass, and we are the minute warps and imperfections in it, given life by the brilliance beyond.

This is the Window, because I believe it opens.

country.1051.c.zh: 你的举动又鲁莽又危险。
country.1051.c.en: Your actions are harebrained and dangerous.

country.1051.desc.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您好。

我有十足的理由相信你们将会继续追随我们。

所以我采取了一些措施。
country.1051.desc.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

It seemed entirely reasonable to assume that you would follow, again.

So I did.

country.1052.a.zh: 我们可以当这一切都没发生过，跟我们回家吧。
country.1052.a.en: We will forget about the whole thing, just come home.

country.1052.desc.zh: 我的行为带来了诸多麻烦，为此我深感抱歉，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。但是，我不欠[Root.GetName]任何东西，对他们我已经仁至义尽。现在我必须完成我的使命了。您凭着强大的毅力一路跟来，我对您的帮助非常感激，但是从一开始我就已经下定决心，不会改变主意。
country.1052.desc.en: I truly regret all the trouble I have caused, [Root.GetRulerTitle], I do. However, I owe nothing to the [Root.GetName], I have paid my dues in full and of this I am sure. You came after me of your own volition, and I am grateful for your help, but I made my intentions clear at the outset.

country.1055.a.tooltip.zh: 我们收回了科研船，飞船的基本功能仍可以正常使用。
country.1055.a.tooltip.en: The Science Ship has been repossessed and its basic functions remain operational.

country.1055.desc.zh:
科研船是空的。

所有用于舱外行动的衣服都好好地放在原处。飞船日志显示气闸从未向外打开过。

飞船还在围绕恒星运行，但现在受到[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的控制。
country.1055.desc.en:
The Science Ship is empty.

All suits for extra-vehicular activity remain in their pods, and the ship logs state that the airlock has never been exit-cycled.

The ship still orbits the star, but is now under [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] control.

country.1061.desc.zh:
威胁首席科学官的那些阳炎海盗已经被消灭了，不过不是出自我们之手。

首席正在向我们致意。
country.1061.desc.en:
The Sunblaster Pirates threatening the Head of Research have been destroyed by some hand not our own.

The Head Physicist is hailing us.

country.11.desc.zh: 我们已经处理掉了失联探测器吸引来的亚空间生物。这种生物为什么会被陈旧的无人飞行器吸引还不得而知，但所幸探测器总体并无严重受损。探测器已经被我们回收，而且我们已经从储存器中下载到了[anomaly_system.GetName]全星系的详细勘查数据。此外，亚空间异常留下的残余能源为我们的科学家提供了宝贵的物理数据。
country.11.desc.en:
We have dealt with the hostile subspace entity that our missing probe had attracted. Why such a creature would be drawn to an archaic unmanned spacecraft is a mystery, but the probe appears to be largely undamaged.

It has been recovered by our forces, and we have extracted detailed survey readings on the entire [anomaly_system.GetName] from its memory banks. In addition, the residual energy left behind by the subspace anomaly has generated a large amount of valuable physics data for our scientists.

country.1100.desc.zh:
我们向[Root.Capital.GetName]之上的虚空迈出的第一步并不单单只是受到好奇心或征服欲的驱使，更是一种必要之举。

[Root.Capital.GetName]的生物圈经历了剧烈的变化。科学家们警告大灭绝将很有可能发生，这种周期性的生物灭亡是这个宇宙中行星生物的自然规律。

我们制定了一个研究项目，对象是几颗因重大天文灾害而变得不宜居行星。通过还原这些灾难性事件，我们预期可以避免[Root.Capital.GetName]和[Root.GetSpeciesName]一族重蹈覆辙。
country.1100.desc.en:
Our first steps into the void beyond [Root.Capital.GetName] were driven not just by curiosity or conquest but by necessity.

The biosphere of [Root.Capital.GetName] has rapidly changed, with scientists warning of a potential mass extinction event, a cyclical purging of life inherent to planetary existence in the cosmos.

A research plan has been developed to study planets rendered uninhabitable by major astronomical incidents. By reconstructing these events, we hope to avoid a similar fate for [Root.Capital.GetName] and the [Root.GetSpeciesName] race.

country.1100.owned.zh: 目标位于别国领域。请另寻目标。
country.1100.owned.en: It lies within foreign territory. Find another subject.

country.1105.desc.zh:
我们的天文学家们十分确信，这个星系的小行星带曾经是一颗宜居的行星，但是却被某种未知的力量击碎了。

已发起特殊项目来进一步研究小行星带中的主要天体。
country.1105.desc.en:
Our astronomers are confident that the asteroid belt in this system was once a habitable planet, torn asunder by unknown forces.

A Special Project has been issued to study one of the major asteroids in the belt.

country.1110.desc.zh:
在围绕这颗恒星运转的行星中，其中一颗还清晰地留有灾难的痕迹。这颗行星的地表被半融未融的矿物海洋所覆盖着，大气炽热无比。然而[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]天文学家们却声称这里可能曾经出现过生命。

已发起特殊项目来进一步研究这颗炽热的行星。
country.1110.desc.en:
One of the planets orbiting this star bears the still-open wounds of some past calamity. Its surface is a roiling sea of half-melted minerals boiling into a superheated atmosphere, but [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] astronomers claim that it may once have supported life.

A Special Project has been issued to study the molten planet.

country.1115.desc.zh:
在这个星系里，有一颗行星以往生态圈所留下的化石痕迹依然清晰可见。是什么把欣欣向荣的生物圈变成了一片不毛之地？

已发起特殊项目来研究这一灾难性转变的成因。
country.1115.desc.en:
A planet in this system still wears the fossilized traces of a past ecology on its sleeve. What could turn a thriving biosphere into a blasted wasteland?

A Special Project has been issued to trace the source of this disastrous transformation.

country.1120.desc.zh:
据称，这颗行星上的动植物会释放有毒气体使其他物种窒息，或许这是地壳之下在不断涌出的活性气体造成的。

已发起特殊项目来研究这一现象。
country.1120.desc.en:
Allegedly this planet's flora and fauna choked on their own poisonous emissions, likely helped along by the release of reactive gases from beneath the planet's crust.

A Special Project has been issued to investigate the matter.

country.1125.desc.zh:
这个星系中有一颗奇怪的行星，星球表面被一层又一层成分各异的寒冰所覆盖。可推测，这颗星球曾有过种类繁杂的生物群。

已发起特殊项目来调查这一可能性。
country.1125.desc.en:
The planet of interest in this system is covered in layer upon layer of dense ices of varying composition. Apparently it was once home to more varied and pleasant biomes.

A Special Project has been issued to investigate this possibility.

country.1130.desc.zh:
这颗小星球其实曾是一颗宜居——或许甚至有人居住过——的行星的一部分。其破裂形态富有规律但又相互重叠，可以看出这颗星球的毁灭是预先设计好的，尽管实施的时可能有些匆忙。

所有的迹象都表明，这颗星球曾是某个物种的母星，但这个物种最后又摧毁了它。我们可能永远都不会知道是什么驱使它们做出毁灭星球这种行为，但是我们也许该为此感到庆幸。
country.1130.desc.en:
The asteroid is in actuality a chunk of what was once a habitable, and probably inhabited, planet. Regular but overlapping fracture patterns indicate that the planetary demolition was intentional and controlled, if somewhat rushed.

All signs point to this planet being the homeworld of whatever species destroyed it. We may never know what drove them to consider planetary annihilation to be the lesser evil, and perhaps we should be grateful for that.

country.1135.desc.zh:
这颗星球的悲惨命运可以归结于宇宙的喜怒无常。

我们科学家认为，一个由短暂时空异常导致的引力扰动，迫使这颗星球的轨道变得过于接近恒星。尽管它在缓慢地向自己的原有轨道作螺旋式运动，但仍是不断受到恒星的余热炙烤。
country.1135.desc.en:
The unfortunate fate of the planet can be laid squarely at the feet of cosmic whims.

A gravitational disturbance, which our scientists suspect was a transient space-time anomaly, forced the planet from its natural orbit to one much too close to the sun. Although the planet is slowly spiraling back towards its original orbit, it has been cooking in the residual heat from the star ever since.

country.1140.desc.zh:
对这颗荒芜的星球上曾存在过的生命，它们的命运从一开始就注定了。

主体物种甚至还来不及演化出智能、发明农业，地理机制就已经让土壤严重酸化了。

从土壤下层和化石遗骸中提取的样品表明，对土壤再生极为关键的矿物质被当地生物的内骨骼消耗殆尽。

它们的骨骼会完全石化而非腐坏，它们光是存在就已经耗竭了脆弱的生态系统，使其发生了永久性的转变。
country.1140.desc.en:
Life on the now-barren planet was doomed from the start.

The dominant species barely had time to awaken to sapience and invent agriculture before geological mechanisms caused the earth to sour.

Samples from lower soil strata and fossilized remains show that vital minerals needed to rejuvenate the soil ended up in the endoskeletons of the native beings.

Their bones fossilized instead of decaying, and their existence exhausted the fragile ecosystem, leaving it permanently transformed.

country.1145.desc.zh:
我们一度以为行星地壳上的千沟万壑是由地质活动塑造的，然而它们实际上却是破土而入的巨大根茎所遗留下来的永恒伤疤。

在过去的某一个时间点，一种可能由智慧物种引发的变异导致当地的植物开始失控疯长。在下层大气环流的帮助下，许多这样的植物借助花粉进行繁殖。

这种影响起先看似轻微，却愈演愈烈，大气层中愈发浓密的颗粒物最终在几个月内将星球上所有的动物呛死了。
country.1145.desc.en:
The cracks in the planet's crust, initially thought to be caused by tectonic activity, are actually lasting marks of enormous roots burrowing through the earth.

At some point in the past, a mutation, possibly induced by sapient beings, caused the native plant life to grow uncontrollably. Many of these plants reproduce through pollination, with countless gametes carried by currents in the lower atmosphere.

What was once a mild irritation escalated, as the increase in atmosphere-borne particles choked the life out of all animals on the planet within months.

country.1150.desc.zh:
大气成分的一次异常变化让这颗星球慢慢地进入了冰川期，这一过程早于[Root.Owner.GetName]的形成而且可能在我们都不在了以后仍将继续下去。

造成大气变化的确切原因尚不清楚，但是存在几种假说，例如环境改造失败或行星内恐怖主义活动等等。[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]科学共同体内的一些激进分子甚至认为，这种急剧的气候变化可能是大肆排放工业废气导致的。

只有少数科学家赞同这一观点。毕竟一个物种如果有能力完全实现工业化，又怎么会傻到一不小心就把自己给毁灭了呢？
country.1150.desc.en:
An unnatural shift in the atmosphere's chemical make-up resulted in the slow onset of an ice age, beginning before the formation of [Root.Owner.GetName] and likely persisting long after our passing.

The exact cause is unknown, but possible explanations include failed terraforming attempts or intra-planetary terrorism. Some radical elements within the scientific community on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] suggest that the climate shift may have been caused by the unchecked emission of industrial by-products.

This view is confined to the fringe, as it is unlikely any race intelligent enough for industrialization would be foolish enough to wipe themselves out.

country.1150.desc.industrialist.zh:
大气层化学成分非自然剧变导致这个星球缓慢却不可避免地进入了冰川期——这一时期在[Root.Owner.GetName]建立之前就已经开始，而且很有可能在我们灭亡之后还未结束。

因为我们自己的行星上发生过的工业化经历，我们对其原因感到相当熟悉：向大气层无休止地排放工业废气导致了剧烈的气候变化，而且他们的科技还没发展到能够解决这一问题的程度。

这一结论引起了我们科学界的一定关注，尽管多数人指出我们的科技“大概”已经发达到足以避免这种灭绝事件的程度了。
country.1150.desc.industrialist.en:
An unnatural shift in the atmosphere's chemical make-up resulted in the slow but irreversible onset of an ice age - one that began before the formation of the [Root.Owner.GetName] and is likely to persist long after our passing.

The cause appears familiar from our experience of industrialization on our own planets: the unchecked emission of gaseous industrial by-product into the atmosphere caused dramatic climatic shifts which they lacked the technology to counteract.

This conclusion has caused some concern among our scientific community, although most point out that at our technological level such an extinction event could "probably" be avoided.

country.1155.a.zh: 我们还能从这些行星上学到什么呢？
country.1155.a.en: What else can we learn from these planets?

country.1155.b.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] people should be put at ease.

country.1155.desc.zh:
这次科研探险我们得到了许多意料之外的收获。[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]科学家现在掌握了空前庞大的数据，能够为[Root.Capital.GetName]的未来建立精确的模型。

最初的报告显示，刨除诡异的宇宙活动和[Root.GetName]的突然崩溃，[Root.Capital.GetName]至少在百年内都不会真正遇到危险。
country.1155.desc.en:
While the research expedition often yielded unexpected results, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] scientists now have access to an unprecedented wealth of data with which to accurately model the future of [Root.Capital.GetName].

Initial reports suggest that [Root.Capital.GetName] will be in no real danger for at least a dozen generations, save from freak cosmic events or the violent collapse of the [Root.GetName].

country.12.desc.zh: 一个扫过[Root.GetName]的传感器在[Root.GetStarName]星系发现了我们的一个亚光速探测器，可是似乎……有些不太一样了。探测器外壳上加装了外星技术的改造部件，且能源特征远超正常水平。我们接收到了它发送过来的信号！
country.12.desc.en:
A sensor sweep from the [Root.GetName] has revealed one of our sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system, but it seems to have been... altered somehow. Modifications of an alien origin have been attached to its hull, and the probe's energy signature is far greater than it should be.

We are receiving a transmission from it!

country.13.a.response.zh: 咳呀呀……那么……你们……就……去死吧……

country.13.desc.zh: 嘶嘶吱吱……你们是……我的造物主吗？

country.14.desc.zh: 加装外星改造部件的失联探测器已经被毁得支离破碎，但我们仍然从残骸中收集到了一些宝贵的工程数据。探测器的数据库也得以收回，我们从中提取出了[modified_probe_system.GetName]星系的全部测绘数据。
country.14.desc.en: Little remains of the strange alien modifications that our missing sublight probe had been subjected to, but we did manage to collect some valuable engineering data from the wreckage. Its memory bank was also salvaged, and from it we have extracted survey data of the entire [modified_probe_system.GetName] system.

country.15.desc.zh:
我们已经成功回收全部的失联亚光速探测器！其中涉及我们文明的详细数据现在已经安全，不会再被外星人窥视。

通过这些探测器的遥测协作，我们得以完全测绘周边数个星系。
country.15.desc.en:
We have successfully collected all of our missing sublight probes! The detailed information they held on our culture is now safe from prying alien photoreceptors.

With their combined sensor telemetry, we have been able to fully survey a number of additional neighboring systems.

country.17.desc.zh: [salvager_system.GetName]星系中的密探无人机确认打捞舰队已经被摧毁。该舰队先前曾无效宣称占有我们失踪的太空探测器。不过探测器在战斗期间随着打捞飞船一同被摧毁了，这也算是不幸中的万幸。因此，不必再担心上面携带的敏感数据会落入心怀不轨之人的手中了。
country.17.desc.en: Spy drones in the [salvager_system.GetName] system have confirmed that someone else destroyed the salvage fleet which had unlawfully laid claim to our missing space probe. Fortunately, it looks like the probe itself was destroyed along with the salvagers during the battle, so there is no risk of its sensitive data falling into the wrong hands.

country.19.desc.zh: 我们位于[anomaly_system.GetName]星系的失联太空探测器周围环绕着亚空间异常。现在据深空追踪传感器确认，异常已经被不明力量消除。探测器也已在战斗中被毁。所以我们已经不必再担心敏感情报泄露。
country.19.desc.en: Deep space tracking sensors confirm that someone else destroyed the subspace anomaly that was guarding our missing space probe in the [anomaly_system.GetName] system. The probe itself was also destroyed during the battle, so we no longer need to worry about the sensitive data it contained.

country.19.name.zh: 亚空间异常现象已消除

country.200.b.zh: 我们可以学着原谅他们。
country.200.b.en: We can learn to forgive them.

country.200.desc.zh:
几个世纪前，[Root.Capital.GetName]上几个激进的宗教领袖带着狂热的追随者出走，并组建了自己的教派。这些极端分子自称[radical_cult.GetName]，是多年以来多起破坏事件的罪魁祸首。

虽然在现代，他们保持低调克制，但我们最近获悉，他们的许多特工渗透进了我方。这些叛徒将我们的资源秘密转移到了隐藏在[Root.Capital.GetName]的小型星际舰队建造项目中！当他们的背叛行为被揭发时，这些异教徒乘船冲进了轨道，然后逃向了[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]。
country.200.desc.en:
Centuries ago, a group of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] broke away from the established religions to form their own church. These extremists called themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], and have been responsible for many atrocities and acts of terror over the years.

Although they have kept a low profile in modern times, we recently learned that many of their agents have infiltrated our military. These renegades have secretly been diverting resources to the construction of a small fleet of starships at a hidden facility on [Root.Capital.GetName]! When their treachery was revealed, the cultists blasted into orbit on their ships and fled to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName].

country.200.desc.bio.zh:
几个世纪前，[Root.Capital.GetName]上几个激进的宗教领袖带着狂热的追随者从主教派中分裂，歪曲传统捏造了它们自己扭曲的教条。这些极端分子自称[radical_cult.GetName]，长久以来以狂热著称，他们的仪式充满了血腥和神秘。

虽然他们在黑暗中躲藏了许多年……但现在，他们的背叛暴露无遗。我们发现许多他们带队特工已经渗入了军队，在[Root.Capital.GetName]的一个隐蔽的产卵舱里盗取资源，组建了一支非法舰队！当他们的背叛被揭露后，这些邪教分子释放了他们令人憎恶的东西——在他们堕落扭曲的信仰中秘密孕育的活体星舰。这些异端的战体从地下的摇篮中蜂拥而出，呼啸着逃向[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]。

不管变成什么样子，他们都已不再是我们的族类。他们的舰船不会我们的那样歌唱，只是尖叫。
country.200.desc.bio.en:
Centuries ago, a sect of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] splintered from the dominant faiths, forsaking tradition to form their own twisted doctrine. Calling themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], they have long been known for their zealotry, their rituals steeped in blood and secrecy.

For years, they have remained hidden in the shadows... but now, their treachery is laid bare. We have discovered that many of their agents had infiltrated our military, siphoning resources to grow an illicit fleet within a hidden spawning chamber on [Root.Capital.GetName]! When their betrayal was exposed, the cultists unleashed their abominations - living starships, gestated in secrecy and warped by their corrupted faith. These heretical warforms burst from their underground cradles, howling into the sky before escaping to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName].

Whatever they have become, they are no longer our kin. Their ships do not sing as ours do. They screech.

country.202.desc.zh:
我们英勇的太空军团不费吹灰之力就让一艘异教徒的飞船失去了反抗能力！该飞船结构基本完好，船内仍能探测到微弱的生命迹象。

等我们将周边的威胁尽数铲除，我们会执行登船行动搜寻生还者。也许我们能从他们口中得知[From.Owner.GetName]的终极目标。
country.202.desc.en:
Our valiant space forces have skillfully disabled a ship in the cultist armada! It is mostly intact and we are picking up faint life signs from inside its hull.

Once we have eliminated all threats in the immediate vicinity, we should conduct a boarding operation to secure any survivors. They may be able to tell us more about the ultimate motives of the [From.Owner.GetName].

country.202.desc.bio.zh:
我们英勇的舰船成功击毁了一只邪教分子的恶兽！这个生物在太空中漂流，生物发光不规律地闪烁，膜状外壳痛苦地颤抖着。它的神经腔深处发出不稳定的微弱生命信号——这艘船并没死。至少还没。

一旦我们控制了这片区域，就必须准备登船行动。进入该生物破裂的身体是很危险的。它的内脏可能仍然有防御反应，它的神经簇仍然准备抵抗。但在它垂死的低语中，我们或许能找到所追寻的真相。邪教的最终诡计仍然未知。但他们的秘密就写在肉体上，我们要读懂他们。
country.202.desc.bio.en:
Our valiant vessels have successfully crippled one of the cultist abominations! The creature drifts in space, its bioluminescence flickering erratically, its membranous hull shuddering in pain. Faint, erratic life signs pulse from deep within its neural cavities - this ship is not dead. Not yet.

Once we have secured the area, we must prepare a boarding operation. Entering the creature's ruptured body will be dangerous. Its innards may still react defensively, its nerve clusters still primed to resist. But within its dying whispers, we may find the truth we seek. The cultists' ultimate purpose remains unknown... but their secrets are written in flesh, and we intend to read them.

country.203.a.zh: 我们一定要追捕这些家伙！

country.203.desc.zh:
虽然幸存者拼死反抗，但登船部队还是生擒活捉了几个俘虏。从他们口中我们得知，他们的阴谋比我们最初预计的更加险恶——[cult_name.GetName]的特工还渗透进了舰队上层和统治者之中！

[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]展开了大规模的抓捕行动，异教徒社会的所有资产亦均被冻结。可是，他们之前秘密建造的星舰并不在内，而且异教徒社会的高级领袖均人间蒸发。我们检测到几条通往其他遥远星系的微弱离子轨迹。
country.203.desc.en:
Though the survivors offered stiff resistance, our boarding party was able to secure several prisoners from the disabled cultist starship. From them we have learned that this conspiracy goes far deeper than we initially suspected - the agents of the [cult_name.GetName] include several flag officers and high-ranking officials within our government!

Mass arrests are being made on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], and all assets belonging to this cult have been seized. However, several of the starships they built in secret remain unaccounted for and the upper echelons of the cult's leadership have vanished. We have picked up faint ion trails leading to several outlying systems.

country.203.desc.bio.zh:
信徒们野蛮狂热地战斗着，他们垂死的尖叫声与残破舰船船的痛苦哀号响作一片。尽管他们顽强抵抗，我们的登船队还是从这艘奄奄一息的沉船上抓出了几个俘虏。他们揭露的真相远比我们想象的更令人不安。

[cult_name.GetName]不仅仅是个激进分子的地下教派——它已经深深地钻入了我们帝国的血管。他们的行列中甚至不乏高级行政官、舰队司令和值得信赖的顾问，这些人默默地将资源和影响力转移到他们的庞大计划中。他们的异端邪说像一种隐藏的传染病一样在我们的大厅里蔓延，在表面之下脉动，直到现在才被发现。

大规模清洗已经在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上进行了。他们的整个网络被拆除，资产被没收，异端战体被溶解成原始生物质。但即使我们把他们打倒，问题依然存在。他们秘密培育的几艘飞船至今下落不明，邪教的领导层也消失得无影无踪。

微弱而甜腻的信息素痕迹在虚空中徘徊，通向遥远的、未知的恒星系。他们的工作尚未完成。我们也是如此。
country.203.desc.bio.en:
The cultists fought with wild, fanatical fury, their dying screams blending with the pained wails of their crippled vessel. But despite their resistance, our boarding parties secured several prisoners from the writhing, half-living wreck. What they revealed is far more disturbing than we ever imagined.

The [cult_name.GetName] was not merely a rogue sect of radicals - it had burrowed deep into the veins of our empire. High-ranking officials, flag officers, and trusted advisors were among its ranks, silently diverting resources and influence toward their grand design. Their heresy ran through our halls like a hidden infection, pulsing beneath the surface, unseen until now.

Mass purges are already underway on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Entire networks have been dismantled, their assets seized, their heretical warforms dissolved into raw biomass. But even as we strike them down, questions remain. Several of their secret-grown biological ships remain unaccounted for, and the cult's leadership has vanished without a trace.

Faint, sickly-sweet pheromone trails linger in the void, leading to distant, uncharted systems. Their work is not yet finished. And neither is ours.

country.204.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetStarName]星系看到了挂着[radical_cult.GetName]旗帜的飞船。他们已经装填好武器准备来拦截我们了！
country.204.desc.en: We have sighted ships flying the flag of the [radical_cult.GetName] in the [Root.GetStarName] system. They have charged their weapons and are moving to intercept us!

country.205.desc.zh: [Root.GetStarName]星系出现了更多的[radical_cult.GetName]飞船。他们正呈攻击阵型接近！
country.205.desc.en: More ships belonging to the [radical_cult.GetName] have been encountered in the [Root.GetStarName] system. They are approaching in attack formation!

country.206.desc.zh: 还有另外一支效忠于[radical_cult.GetName]的异教徒舰队出现在了[Root.GetStarName]星系。不过这次，他们之中混入了一艘设计陌生的飞船！
country.206.desc.en: Yet another cultist fleet loyal to the [radical_cult.GetName] has been sighted in the [Root.GetStarName] system. This time, however, their numbers include a strange ship of an unfamiliar design!

country.207.a.tooltip.zh: 开启一项在[our_fleet_position.GetName]星系的特殊项目。
country.207.a.tooltip.en: Enables a Special Project in the [our_fleet_position.GetName] system.

country.207.desc.zh:
我们击败了目前为止所遇到的异教势力，但多次的遭遇让我们意识到了几个令人担忧的问题。[radical_cult.GetName]安排的飞船太多了，已经超过了在[Root.Capital.GetName]上可能秘密建造的飞船数量，而且他们现在还找来了一艘设计未知的大型飞船对付我们。

那些船是哪来的？他们还有更多我们刚击毁的那种飞船吗？我们应该通过调查战场残骸来寻找答案。
country.207.desc.en:
We have defeated the cultist forces encountered so far, but these engagements have raised a number of alarming questions. The [radical_cult.GetName] has been deploying far more ships than they could possibly have built in secrecy on [Root.Capital.GetName], and now they pitted a large warship of an unknown design against us.

Where are these ships coming from? Are there more warships like the one we just destroyed? We should investigate the battle debris for answers.

country.208.desc.zh:
仔细分析了我们先前摧毁的那艘奇怪的异教徒飞船残骸后，科学家好像已经推测出了[radical_cult.GetName]用来对付我们的飞船来自何方。一份日志文件的某些段落提到：从[Root.Capital.GetStarName]逃离的飞船发现了一座被遗弃的外星船坞。

他们用自动化船坞补充了战斗力。他们甚至还利用船坞数据库里的外星飞船模板造出了新型飞船！决不能放任他们继续肆意妄为下去了。
country.208.desc.en:
After sifting through the debris left by the strange cultist warship we destroyed, our scientists believe they may have divined the source of the ships the [radical_cult.GetName] has been throwing against us. Fragments from a log file mention some kind of abandoned alien shipyard discovered by the cultist ships fleeing [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

They have been using the automated shipyard to reinforce their numbers, and now they are even producing new ships from alien templates found within the station's memory banks! This cannot be allowed to continue.

country.209.desc.zh:
[radical_cult.GetName]所征用的那座船坞已经被我们摧毁了！有些异教徒企图乘坐逃生舱逃跑，后被我们截获，其中包括他们的首席工程师。他对这座船坞的先进技术的掌握对我们而言是一笔宝贵的财富。

不过很可惜，根据我们的情报，其领袖几周前就乘坐她的新的旗舰离开了船坞。该旗舰为威力增强版的外星飞船。情报组正在追踪该船的位置。
country.209.desc.en:
The alien shipyard that was used by the [radical_cult.GetName] in their crusade against us has been destroyed! Some of the cultists were captured when their escape pods were picked up by our forces, including their chief engineer. His knowledge of the shipyard's advanced technology has proved quite valuable.

Unfortunately, we have also learned that the cult's charismatic leader departed the shipyard several weeks ago on her new flagship - a more powerful variant of the alien ships they produced. Military intelligence is working on pinpointing the location of this vessel.

country.21.desc.zh: 远程扫描确认位于[modified_probe_system.GetName]星系的改造探测器已经被不明力量摧毁。所幸战斗后数据库也已被毁，因此不必再担心里面所包含的敏感数据落入外星势力之手。
country.21.desc.en: Long-range scans have confirmed that someone else destroyed our modified probe in the [modified_probe_system.GetName] system. Fortunately, nothing remained of its memory banks after the battle so there is no chance of foreign powers having acquired the sensitive data that was contained therein.

country.210.desc.zh:
深空侦查探测器在某星系中接收到了微弱的亚空间辐射，驱动特征符合[radical_cult.GetName]所驾驶的外星飞船。非常有可能就是那艘旗舰留下的！

我们应该尽快派军团前去搜索此星系。无论是那艘飞船、还是那位会蛊惑人心的领袖，都决不能轻易放走、纵容其继续作恶。
country.210.desc.en:
Deep space reconnaissance probes have picked up faint subspace emissions in a star system consistent with the drive signatures of the alien ships used by the [radical_cult.GetName]. The cult's missing flagship is the most probable source!

We should send forces to search this system as soon as possible. That ship and its charismatic master are too dangerous to leave at large.

country.211.desc.zh:
你们终于找到我们了。不过无所谓。

我的追随者更希望为了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]种群的未来奉献出生命。我即未来，这一点你们要铭记在心。

等我们收拾掉你们那可怜的军团后，我的旗舰将带我前往[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]。最后，我将在那里净化母星的异类。
country.211.desc.en:
So you have found us at last. No matter.

My disciples are more than willing to give their lives for the future of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species. I am that future, in case you didn't realize.

When we have dealt with your pitiful forces, my holy flagship shall carry me to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] where we will at last cleanse our homeworld of unbelievers.

country.213.a.zh: 那艘飞船将会是我们的！

country.213.desc.zh:
我们的部队已经使[radical_cult.GetName]丧失了行动能力！该船的武器和引擎已经失灵，但生命维持系统仍在稳定运转。我们应该准备进行登船行动了。

考虑到该船上有大量武装的异教徒，为确保万无一失，应该派遣大量部队投入作战。
country.213.desc.en:
Our forces have managed to disable the flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName]! Its weapons and engines are no longer functional, but life support systems remain stable. We should prepare for a boarding action.

Due to the large number of armed cultists within the ship, a significant number of troops will be necessary to secure it.

country.214.desc.zh:
敌人节节败退，我们的部队终于将[radical_cult.GetName]旗舰上的最后一点抵抗力量彻底消灭。几乎没有俘虏，因为大多数狂热信徒发动了自杀式袭击。我们在驾驶台上发现了他们的领袖，已经自杀。终于，[radical_cult.GetName]宣告灭亡。

我们的工程师恢复了飞船的引擎，它将以[disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]为名正式编入我方舰队。该舰迫切需要返回太空港进行进一步的修复。
country.214.desc.en:
After slowly fighting their way deck by deck, our marines have finally eradicated the last pockets of resistance on the former flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName]. Few prisoners were taken as most of the zealous cultists preferred to throw their lives away in futile suicide attacks. The cult's leader was found on the vessel's bridge, killed by her own hand. At long last, it looks like the [radical_cult.GetName] has met its end.

Our engineers have restored power to the ship's engines, and it has been pressed into service with our fleet as the [disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]. The vessel should be brought to a spaceport as soon as possible for more permanent repairs.

country.214.desc.bio.zh:
我们的军队一层一层、一舱一舱地，在鲜活的肉体和无尽的狂热分子中杀出了一条血肉之路。[radical_cult.GetName]的旗舰反击起来，仿佛它自己也是一个邪教徒，当我们的陆战队员击倒最后一个狂热的捍卫者时，它的身体痛苦不堪。

几乎没有抓到活口。信徒们的身体与飞船融为一体，他们要么尖叫着死去，要么跳进飞船的生物反应堆，要么发动绝望而徒劳的紫衫a共计。他们的领袖被在飞船的舰桥上，她毫无生气的躯体倒在一团跳动的神经组织上，用自己的生物武器开始攻击自己。随着她的死，邪教的梦想也随之消亡。

但现在旗舰是我们的了。我们的工程师稳定了它的生物系统，迫使它颤抖的、不情愿的庞大身躯屈服。这艘飞船还活着，但它已经被拴住了，以[disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]的身份被迫服役。它应该被牵到一座太空港进行维修和仔细研究。

即使死后，邪教的创造仍可能为我们服务。
country.214.desc.bio.en:
Deck by deck, chamber by chamber, our forces carved their way through living flesh and unrelenting zealotry. The flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName] fought back as if it, too, were a believer, its very body wracked with agony as our marines cut down the last of its fanatical defenders.

Few prisoners were taken. The cultists, their bodies half-fused with their vessel, chose to die screaming, hurling themselves into the ship's bio-reactors or launching desperate, futile attacks. Their leader was found on what passed for the vessel's bridge, her lifeless form slumped against a pulsating mass of nerve-tissue, her own bio-weapon turned upon herself. With her death, the cult's dream dies with her.

But the flagship is ours now. Our engineers have stabilized its biological systems and forced its shuddering, reluctant mass to submit. The ship lives, but it has been leashed, pressed into service as the [disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]. It should be guided to a spaceport for repairs and careful study.

Even in death, the cultists' creation may yet serve us.

country.218.desc.zh:
异教徒舰队的其中一艘飞船遭遇某种外部力量攻击！该船外观完整，舰体内部能检测到微弱的生命迹象。

等我们将周边的威胁尽数铲除，我们会执行登船行动搜寻生还者。也许我们能从他们口中得知[From.Owner.GetName]的终极目标。
country.218.desc.en:
One of the ships belonging to the cultist armada has been violently disabled by an outside force! It is mostly intact and we are picking up faint life signs from inside its hull.

Once we have eliminated all threats in the immediate vicinity, we should conduct a boarding operation to secure any survivors. They may be able to tell us more about the ultimate motives of the [From.Owner.GetName].

country.219.desc.zh: 在[marauder_system.GetName]星系流窜的异教徒已经被击败。
country.219.desc.en: The cultist fleet operating in the [marauder_system.GetName] system has been destroyed in battle.

country.221.desc.zh:
[radical_cult.GetName]用来对付我们的那座外星船坞已经被某个势力摧毁了。初步报告表明，异教徒势力已经被完全移除，但我们又收到情报，战役打响前，异类领袖已经乘坐新旗舰逃离了。

目前她仍在星系的某处逍遥法外。情报组正在确定该船的位置。
country.221.desc.en:
Someone has destroyed the alien shipyard that was being used by the [radical_cult.GetName] in their crusade against us. Preliminary reports indicate that the cultist forces were thoroughly wiped out, but we have also received intelligence that the cult's charismatic leader left the shipyard on her new flagship moments before the battle had begun.

She is still at large somewhere in the galaxy. Military intelligence is working on pinpointing the exact location of her flagship.

country.223.desc.zh: 近期，有不明势力在[flagship_system.GetName]星系发生激烈战斗，并击垮了邪教徒的旗舰。我们的指挥官对未能亲手送葬邪教徒深表遗憾。但至少，这也标志着这群邪恶的邪教徒及其恐怖活动划上了句号。
country.223.desc.en: Someone else recently defeated the cultist flagship after a pitched battle in the [flagship_system.GetName] system. Our commanders have expressed regret over the fact that our own forces were unable to deliver the killing blow, but at least this should signify the end of this malignant cult and its campaign of terror.

country.225.desc.zh: 一位弃暗投明的[radical_cult.GetName]前成员说服了他的老同志放弃狂热，加入我们的行列。他们的旗舰现在在[Root.capital_scope.GetName]轨道上运行，等待正式编入我们海军之前的检查。
country.225.desc.en: A former member of the [radical_cult.GetName], now fully committed to our cause, has convinced their old comrades to abandon their fanaticism and join our ranks. Their flagship now orbits [Root.capital_scope.GetName], awaiting inspection before its formal induction into our navy.

country.250.b.zh: 我们的搜索只能是徒劳的。
country.250.b.en: A wild goose chase we can ill afford.

country.250.desc.zh:
秋菊号的姐妹船风信子号，本应该在我们的地球祖先抵达这个星团后三年到达这里。根据抵达时的发展状况，他们的任务是支援我们的殖民地或建立新的殖民地。

若该飞船确实已从地球出发，那就说明她未能与[Root.Capital.GetName]取得联系。如果风信子号进入了我们周边的星系，那么我们最好搜索一下附近星系并寻找其踪迹。
country.250.desc.en:
We have found no traces of the four arkships that passed through the wormhole before the Chrysanthemum arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]. One ship, the Hyacinth, was scheduled to make the passage after us, and the Chrysanthemum's long-range sensors reported a brief energy spike from the wormhole shortly before it destabilized and vanished.

Assuming the Hyacinth survived the passage and made it to our galactic neighborhood, the arkship has so far failed to establish contact with us. It might be a good idea to search nearby systems for signs of its presence.

country.251.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]报告，在[From.GetName]星系没有发现风信子号的迹象。我们应该到别处搜索。
country.251.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] reports no signs of the Hyacinth in the [From.GetName] system. We should continue our search elsewhere.

country.252.a.en: She has to be out there.

country.252.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的搜索未能在[From.GetName]星系发现风信子号的迹象。也许我们应该到别的星系碰碰运气。
country.252.desc.en: Scans from the [Root.GetName] have revealed no traces of the Hyacinth in the [From.GetName] system. Perhaps we will have better luck in one of the other systems.

country.253.a.zh: 风信子号一定就在那里。

country.253.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]分离出了一条[From.GetName]星系内的离子轨迹。该轨迹与秋菊号引擎留下的轨迹十分类似，因此一定就是风信子号留下的！

尽管这条微弱的离子轨迹已经留存超过一个世纪了，但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]还是沿着这条轨迹找到了一个以前从未发现过的恒星。我们已经将坐标录入了情报日志。
country.253.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has managed to isolate a residual ion trail in the [From.GetName] system that is identical to the one that was produced by the Chrysanthemum's engines. It must have originated from the Hyacinth!

Although the faint ion trail is over a century old, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to track it on an outbound trajectory towards a previously uncharted star. We have entered its coordinates into the Situation Log.

country.254.desc.zh: 我们已经找到风信子号了！该船正以稳定的轨道围绕[hyacinth_planet.GetName]运行。舰体内没有探测到能源特征，并且没有收到任何遇险信标。我们会派出一支武装登船部队进入内部调查。
country.254.desc.en: We have located the Hyacinth! The great arkship is parked in a stable orbit over [hyacinth_planet.GetName]. No power signatures have been detected from within its hull, and we are not picking up any distress beacons. An armed boarding party should be sent to investigate the ship's interior.

country.255.desc.zh:
我们的登船部队已经从风信子号上返回，并且带来了一份令人惊骇的报告。船上人类尸体的数量与当初全部二十五万的人数一致。多数人似乎是亡于饥饿，可是有迹象表明这里发生过小型武装冲突……

我们在风信子号的控制台找到了舰长的日志。
country.255.desc.en:
Our boarding party has returned from the Hyacinth with a gruesome report. Human remains in amounts consistent with the arkship's entire compliment of a quarter million colonists were found on board. Most seem to have died from starvation, but there were also signs of small-arms fire and cannibalism...

We were able to recover the captain's log from the archives on the Hyacinth's bridge.

country.256.a.response.zh:
舰长日志，任务日期345.5。

我们已经从地球出发并按航线航行了两个月。目前一帆风顺。殖民者很快入睡，科尔贝克医生报告全船人员的生命体征良好。

我们目前已经驶出了太阳重力井的影响范围，很快就会到达开启风信子号亚空间虫洞生成器的安全点。我在先前的日志中对此设备持保留意见，但究竟能不能正常运行，很快就可以见分晓了……
country.256.a.response.en:
Captain's Log, Mission Date 345.5.

We are two months out of Earth and proceeding on course. Things have gone smoothly so far. The colonists are fast asleep, and Doctor Colbeck has reported strong vitals across the board.

Our journey has taken us beyond the outer planets and we are now approaching the Oort Cloud. We will soon reach the subspace phenomenon - this supposed "wormhole" - that the other arkships have already entered. I have made my reservations about wormhole travel known in previous log entries, but we'll know if this works soon enough...

country.256.b.response.zh:
我们……我们真的成功了！飞船仍在努力确定位置，但根据外面的星球来看，我只能确认我们已经离开了堪萨斯。可是，非常不幸，风信子号出现了严重地设备损坏，我们现在完全失去了动力，仅凭借电池支撑。

科尔贝克通知我可能要唤醒殖民者。我现在要去一趟工程室，看看玛姬为什么还没有修好反应堆。希望我们能很快恢复正常然后开始搜寻秋菊号殖民者的旅程。
country.256.b.response.en:
We... we actually made it! Astrogation is still working on getting a fix on our position, but judging by the stars outside I think it's a safe bet to say we're not in Kansas anymore. Unfortunately, the Hyacinth suffered a major engineering casualty that resulted in a complete loss of power, and we're currently running on batteries.

Colbeck has informed me that we may need to wake up the colonists. I'm on my way down to Engineering now to see why Maggie is taking her sweet time getting the reactor up and running again. Hopefully we can get underway soon and begin our search for the Chrysanthemum's colonists.

country.256.c.response.zh:
情况越来越糟糕了。反应堆已经再无重新启动的可能，而我们储备的最后一点能源也在尝试抵达这个破星系的时候耗尽了。我们本想找个宜居的地方着陆……但是没那么好的运气。

生命维持系统还能运作几年，但食物储备对于二十五万殖民者而言连一个月都撑不过去。我已经召集了各部门的领头人开会。我们……我们必须得想个办法了……
country.256.c.response.en:
The situation has gone from bad to worse. There is no longer any realistic hope of restarting the reactor, and the last of the Hyacinth's power reserves were spent in our attempt to reach this misbegotten system. We had hoped to find some place habitable to set her down... but no such luck.

We've got enough juice in the batteries to keep life support going for a few years, but with a quarter million colonists up and about, the Hyacinth's food supplies won't last the month. I've called a meeting with all department heads. We... we need to come up with some sort of plan...

country.256.d.response.zh:
这可能是我最后一次记录日志了。船员不是死就是失踪了，就在此时，一群殖民者还在试图冲进控制室。我们的主要食物来源几周前就没有了，甚至……甚至还有食人事件的报告。

我为船员留了一小堆食物，让这艘老船再开得久一点点……等待着奇迹的发生。当殖民者发现时，他们……

他们已经破门而入了。滚回去！别靠近！我是舰长！你们要是敢弄我，我就让你们……啊啊啊……
country.256.d.response.en:
This will likely be my final log. My bridge crew is either dead or missing and a group of colonists are trying to force their way onto the bridge as I speak. Our main food supplies ran out weeks ago, and there... there are reports of cannibalism.

I kept a small stash of food for the crew, to keep the old girl running a little while longer... hoping for some kind of miracle, I guess. When the surviving colonists found out, they...

They're through the doors. Back, damn you! Keep your distance! I'm the captain of this ship, and I'll be damned if I'm gonna let you butcher me like a... AGGGHHggghh...

country.256.desc.zh:
风信子号
ISA-06
联合国尤利西斯计划
官员日志：舰长罗纳德·福·冈德森

访问数据……检测到损坏。正在尝试修复……
成功恢复四份日志。
country.256.desc.en:
ARKSHIP HYACINTH
ISA-06
UNITED NATIONS ULYSSES INITIATIVE
Officer Logbook: Captain Ronald F. Gundersen

Accessing data... corruption detected. Attempting repairs...
Four log entries successfully retrieved.

country.256.e.response.zh:
方舟风信子号
ISA-06
联合国尤利西斯计划

正在脱离用户界面。
country.256.e.response.en:
ARKSHIP HYACINTH
ISA-06
UNITED NATIONS ULYSSES INITIATIVE

Disengaging user interface.

country.257.a.zh: 也许会有所收获也说不定。
country.257.a.en: Perhaps something good will come out of this.

country.257.desc.zh:
风信子号以及她的船员所面临的残酷命运，我们已经明白了。当时若是调换立场，很可能现在漂浮在[hyacinth_planet.GetName]上空的便是秋菊号。这艘飞船犹如一座死寂的坟墓，提醒人类冷漠无情的宇宙中充满了艰难险阻。

风信子号即将被拖入[Root.Capital.GetName]的低轨道，等清理完尸体后，便会成为一座纪念馆。尽管她的遭遇十分悲惨，这艘方舟却和将我们祖先带到这里的那艘几乎一模一样。望以后的学者能从中有所了悟。
country.257.desc.en:
We now have a pretty clear picture of the grim fate that befell the Hyacinth, her crew and the colonists she was carrying. Had circumstances been different, it could very well have been the Chrysanthemum drifting above [hyacinth_planet.GetName] like a silent tomb. A sobering reminder of the dangers humanity is faced with in a cold and uncaring universe.

The Hyacinth will now be towed into low orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName] and converted into a museum, as soon as the human remains have been cleared out. Despite its tragic history, the arkship is almost identical to the one that brought our ancestors here from Earth and our sociologists could learn much from it.

country.260.desc.zh: 最近从[surveyed_planets_system.GetName]星系得到的勘查数据中没有风信子号的迹象。也许我们应该到别的星系碰碰运气。
country.260.desc.en: The survey data recently acquired of the [surveyed_planets_system.GetName] system have revealed no traces of the Hyacinth. Perhaps we will have better luck in one of the other systems.

country.261.desc.zh:
在最近对[surveyed_planets_system.GetName]星系的调查中找到了独特的离子轨迹。该轨迹与秋菊号引擎留下的轨迹十分类似，因此一定就是风信子号留下的！

尽管这条微弱的离子轨迹已经留存超过一个世纪了，但科学专员还是沿着这条轨迹找到了一颗之前从未发现过的恒星。我们已经将坐标录入了情报日志。
country.261.desc.en:
The survey data recently acquired bears marks of a unique, residual ion trail in the [surveyed_planets_system.GetName] system. It is identical to the one that was produced by the Chrysanthemum's engines. It must have originated from the Hyacinth!

Although the faint ion trail is over a century old, we have been able to track it on an outbound trajectory towards a previously uncharted star. We have entered its coordinates into the Situation Log.

country.3.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.GetStarName]星系发现了我们失去联系的一个亚光速探测器。我们需要尽快展开回收工作。
country.3.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has detected one of our missing sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system. We should begin recovery efforts as soon as possible.

country.4.desc.zh: 我们在[space_probe.GetStarName]星系成功回收了该亚光速探测器。经过数年的遥感测控，它所收集到的数据完整描述了该星系内所有星球的勘测结果。
country.4.desc.en: We have recovered the sublight probe in the [space_probe.GetStarName] system. The sensor telemetry it has collected over the years has provided us with a complete survey of all planetary bodies within the system.

country.5.a.zh: 我们去看看这条轨迹一直通到哪里。
country.5.a.en: Let us see where this trail leads.

country.5.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]接收到了废弃信标发出的信号，该信标原属于[Root.GetStarName]星系失联的亚光速探测器之一。我们发现一条离子轨迹从信标延伸至另一个恒星，这表明该探测器被拖向该恒星，具体原因不明。
country.5.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] has picked up a signal from a discarded signal buoy belonging to one of our missing sublight probes in the [Root.GetStarName] system. There is an ion trail leading away from the buoy on a trajectory towards another star, suggesting that someone has towed the probe there for unknown reasons.

country.50.b.zh: 我们还有更重要的事要处理。
country.50.b.en: We have more important matters to focus on.

country.50.desc.zh:
毫无疑问，生机勃勃的生态圈并非[Root.Capital.GetName]独有。无论是科学界，还是民众，都迫切想要了解散布在星系中的各种外星生命。

对已知生命体的分类统计工作正在进行中，但我们的外星生物学家一直在催促我集中精力勘测宜居世界。
country.50.desc.en:
We now know without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Efforts to catalog the life forms we encounter are already underway, but our xenobiologists have urged us to focus our planetary survey efforts on habitable, life-bearing worlds.

country.50.desc_slaves.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地获悉，一个繁荣的生物圈并不是[Root.Capital.GetName]独一无二的景色。无论是科学界还是政治圈，都迫切地想去了解整个星系各式各样的外星生命形态。

我们已经开始投入精力对遇到的一切生命形态进行归类，但是我们的异星生物学家强调，我们应当把主要精力放在对可宜居的、能支撑生命的星球的调查。
country.50.desc_slaves.en:
We already knew without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Efforts to catalog the life forms we encounter are already underway, but our xenobiologists have urged us to focus our planetary survey efforts on habitable, life-bearing worlds.

country.51.desc.zh:
通过对宜居星球的调查，我们的生物学家收集到了大量的外星生命体的数据。我们以前所建立的许多生命进化学说都已经被推翻，科学界已经开始着手从头建立理论体系！

最有趣的发现都在[Root.Capital.GetName]的外星生物博物馆展出。公众对此表现得十分痴迷，我们也收到了许多捐赠，用以继续对奇怪的生命体的研究。
country.51.desc.en:
Through our surveys of habitable worlds, our biologists have collected a vast amount of data on alien life forms. Many of our older theories on the development of life have been disproved, and our scientific community has had to build new models from scratch!

Our most interesting findings are being displayed at the newly dedicated Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName]. The public is enthralled, and many donations have come in to aid in the continued search of strange life forms.

country.53.a.zh: 我们会收集到这些样本的。

country.53.b.zh: 不，我们没有可调用的资源。
country.53.b.en: No, we don't have the resources to spare.

country.53.desc.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]上外星生物博物馆馆长提出采购某些活体外星样本的请求。这些生物一般出现在已调查过的宜居世界中，但捕获难度很大。这需要科研船动用全部资源并花费大量时间才能做到。
country.53.desc.en: The director of the Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName] has issued a request for the procurement of several live alien specimens. These creatures were spotted on surveyed habitable worlds, but they are difficult to capture. It will require the full resources of a Science Ship for a lengthy period of time.

country.54.desc.zh:
在使用一支微型潜艇舰队对[From.From.GetName]海底进行大规模搜查之后，[Root.GetName]的船员终于把神出鬼没的搜查对象逼到了角落里——一个活着的塔布拉克。

塔布拉克通过辐射出微弱的灵能信号来保护自己，这种异能信号可以让大多有机生物感到恐惧。这个发光的生物被装在一个用来模拟它生存环境的特殊水箱当中，并被运到了科学飞船上。直接接触过它的[Root.GetName]船员需要接受长期的治疗，但至少任务已经成功了。
country.54.desc.en:
After an extensive search of the seabed on [From.From.GetName] using a small fleet of mini-submarines, the crew of the [Root.GetName] finally managed to corner the elusive target of their search - a live tarblac.

The shimmering creature, which defends itself by emitting faint psionic signals that produce a sense of dread in most organics, was brought aboard the Science Ship in a special water tank simulating its natural environment. The crew members on the [Root.GetName] that came into direct contact with the tarblac will require extensive therapy, but the mission has been a success.

country.55.desc.zh:
塔萨古德是一种十分致命的捕食者。每当夜晚降临，他们便蛰伏在[From.From.GetName]的密林之中，用电击来麻痹他们的猎物，接着便用吸管一样的嘴部吸食猎物的大脑。

不幸的是，三个[Root.GetName]船员连一个塔萨古德的样本都没有捕获到就被它们给消灭了。为了表彰这些勇敢的船员，[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的外星生物博物馆会用他们的名字来重新命名建筑的一翼。
country.55.desc.en:
The tassargoid is an extremely lethal predator that stalks the dense jungles of [From.From.GetName] at night, paralyzing its prey with electric shocks before sucking their brains out with its tube-like mouth.

Unfortunately, three of the crew members from the [Root.GetName] were lost to these creatures before a specimen could be secured. The Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] will rename one of its wings after these brave officers to honor their sacrifice.

country.56.desc.zh:
欧林提是一种[From.From.GetName]当地的小型啮齿类生物，他们的居住站已经蔓延到[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]大部分的地区。他们以惊人的速率繁殖后代，而且它们似乎有啃食电缆的癖好。

收集欧琳提的样本并不麻烦。事实上，在完成首批收集之后，更多的欧琳提通过搭乘科学飞船的轨道穿梭机偷渡到了[Root.GetName]。至于为何宇宙生物博物馆会要欧琳提这种样本，其原因还是个谜。
country.56.desc.en:
The small, rodent-like creatures known as orinthi are native to [From.From.GetName], where their habitat extends across most of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s diverse climatic regions. They breed at an extremely rapid rate, and seem to have a particular fondness for chewing on electric cables.

Procuring specimens was not a problem - in fact, after the initial creatures were collected, more of them made their way onto the [Root.GetName] by hitching rides on the Science Ship's orbital shuttles. Exactly why the Museum of Exobiology requested orinthi specimens remains a mystery.

country.57.desc.zh:
萨尼兰是大型穴居类动物，它们生活在[From.From.GetName]赤道沙漠中的沙丘底下。当这些捕食者觉察到有东西在它们上方的沙子上移动时，它们立马会竖起背部的几十个钉刺来刺穿它们的猎物。

起初，找一个萨尼兰的样本很困难。后来几百架可以远程控制的追踪型无人机被派遣到了沙漠里的各个位置，总算发现并收集到了一个背上长了超过一百根钉刺的巨大标本。
country.57.desc.en:
Snirans are large, burrowing creatures that live beneath the dunes of the vast equatorial deserts on [From.From.GetName]. When these predators sense movement in the sand above, they immediately raise dozens of tall spikes from their backs in the hope of impaling something edible.

Finding a suitable specimen proved difficult at first, until hundreds of tracked remote-controlled drones were dispatched across the desert in random directions. This led to the discovery and procurement of an unusually large specimen that had grown more than a hundred spikes on its back.

country.58.desc.zh: 古兰萨是一种巨大、扁平的食草动物，它们体内有气囊，这使得它们能悬浮在离地表几厘米的地方。它们总是成群结队地行动，在[From.From.GetName]多风的平原上吃苔藓和地衣。古兰萨正在被[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的顶端捕食者无情地猎杀。我们[Root.GetName]上的生物学家预计，只有大约百来群的古兰萨还活着。这当中的一群——由九头古兰萨组成，已经被成功地收集并被带回了[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]。
country.58.desc.en:
Goolanthas are large, flat herbivores that have evolved internal gas pockets, enabling them to hover a few centimeters above the ground. They move about in herds consisting of a few dozen animals, grazing on the moss and lichen that can be found on the windswept plains of [From.From.GetName].

They are ruthlessly hunted by the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s apex predators, and our biologists on the [Root.GetName] estimate that only a few hundred goolantha herds remain. One of these, consisting of nine animals, has been successfully collected and will be brought back to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

country.59.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的船员成功地在[From.From.GetName]的冰层上收集到了一小群的乌杜兰。这些毛茸茸的白色杂食动物把自己滚成一个球，以惊人的速度滚过[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的雪原——经测量，其中一只的速度竟达到了80公里每小时。我们之所以能侦测到它们是因为它们所到之处都会扬起阵阵飞雪。
country.59.desc.en: The crew of the [Root.GetName] has managed to collect a small group of uddlorans from the icy surface of [From.From.GetName]. These white, furry omnivores wrap themselves into tight balls and roll across the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s snow fields at astonishing speeds - one animal was clocked at over 80 kilometers per hour. This aided in their detection, since the passage of their rolling forms kicks up huge plumes of swirling snow.

country.6.desc.zh:
我们找到失联的探测器了！我们在[From.GetName]星系探测到了一支临时拼凑的小型舰队，其中一艘飞船用短距离牵引光束锁住了探测器。

他们正在呼唤我们。
country.6.desc.en:
We have found our missing probe! A small fleet of jury-rigged ships has been detected in the [From.GetName] system, and one of them has the probe locked in a short-range tractor beam.

They are hailing us.

country.60.desc.zh:
祖卡是群居的虫类生物，它们体型巨大，且以地里的岩石和矿物等无机物为食，这两个特点都足够让人瞠目结舌。一艘[Root.GetName]的穿梭机遭受重大损伤。当时该穿梭机只是不经意间经过了一群祖卡身边，却招致祖卡聚集而来蚕食舰体。

在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的外星生物博物馆已经开始建造关住这种生物的特制容器。
country.60.desc.en:
