The zulcor are swarming insect analogues, unusual both for their large size and the fact that they are lithovores, feeding off rocks and minerals in the ground. One of the shuttles belonging to the [Root.GetName] sustained serious damage when it inadvertently passed through a large swarm and several zulcors began to feed on its hull.

The construction of the special containment facilities required to hold these creatures has already begun at the Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

country.61.desc.zh:
外星生物博物馆所要求的全部样本均已获取。博物馆已经扩张为庞然大物，里面的人工重力生成器和大气处理器可以模拟十多个不同世界的环境。

参观者从[Root.GetName]各个地方慕名而来。
country.61.desc.en:
All of the specimens asked for by the Museum of Exobiology have been secured. The museum has grown to a massive facility, where artificial gravity generators and atmospheric processors are used to simulate the environments of over a dozen worlds.

Visitors are journeying from all across the [Root.GetName] to see its wonders!

country.7.a.zh: 归还我们的东西，不然就受死吧！
country.7.a.en: Surrender our property or be destroyed!

country.7.a.response.zh:
吼吼！伙计们，快听听丑陋的外星人在说什么！巴格瓦伊，快放下手中的事，到控制台来！听听这些笨蛋的话！吼吼！

这个探测器现在是我们的。不错的小玩意。你们的船也等着成为我们回收的碎片吧。嘻嘻哈哈哈哈！
country.7.a.response.en:
Hoho! Listen to ugly alien, boys! Buggwai, drop what you doing and come over to console! Listen to fool! Hoho!

This probe OUR property now. Fair salvage. As will debris from your ships be. HIIYAAAEEE!

country.7.b.zh: 你们还挺会讨价还价的，不过，好吧。
country.7.b.en: You drive a hard bargain, but very well.

country.7.b.response.zh:
很好，很好！探测器就交给你们了，要好好爱护啊。可能有点小磕碰，打捞的时候不小心碰了一下。米格瓦伊不小心趴到了控制台上。真是笨蛋！

但是探测器的功能还是很良好的！恕不退款！我们这就启程了。
country.7.b.response.en:
Very good, very good! We release probe into your care. May be a bit banged up. There was accidental collision during salvage operation. Miggwai fell on controls. Clumsy oaf!

But probe still in good condition! No refunds! We depart now.

country.7.desc.zh:
外星人，你们想干什么？这个探测器是我们的。打捞。我们先找到的！赶快离开。是的。你们干扰到我们微操了。一定要聚精会神。

或者……如果你们想要探测器，我们可以卖给你们。只要100能量币，探测器就是你们的了。很划算。巨实惠。探测器是你们的了，我们也省事。双赢。尤其是我们。
country.7.desc.en:
What you want, alien? This probe ours. Salvage. We find first! You leave now. Yes. Interrupting delicate operation, your ships are. Must concentrate.

Or... if you want probe, we can sell. 100 credits and probe yours. Good deal. Very good. You get probe, less work for us, everybody wins. Especially us.

country.8.desc.zh:
打捞者信守承诺将探测器转交给了我们。转让工作一完成，他们的舰队就朝着未知的方向离开了星系。

虽然探测器的状况不是很好，但我们还是从储存器中下载到了[salvager_system.GetName]全星系的详细勘查数据。
country.8.desc.en:
The salvagers kept their word and transferred the probe over to our control. As soon as the transfer was complete, their fleet departed the system on an unknown heading.

Although the probe is in rough condition, we managed to download detailed sensor readings of the entire [salvager_system.GetName] system from its memory banks.

country.9.desc.zh: 我们从外星飞船的残骸中回收了亚光速探测器。虽然表面有些凹陷，而且被打捞者涂鸦了外星的文字以标示贵重部件，但我们还是从储存器中下载到了[salvager_system.GetName]全星系的详细勘查数据。
country.9.desc.en: We have recovered our sublight probe from the wreckage of the alien salvage ship. It is a bit dented, and parts of it are covered in some kind of alien graffiti put there by the salvagers to mark valuable components. Despite this we have managed to download detailed sensor readings of the entire [salvager_system.GetName] system from the probe's memory banks.

country.999.desc.belief.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetStarName]系最近发现了一颗彗星。
在[Root.Capital.GetName]表面清晰可见的这颗彗星在大众心中激起了强烈的反响。

几乎无人能否认，在[GetCycleName]轮回中出现这样的一个天体毫无疑问是[GetCycleAttitude]的原因。
country.999.desc.belief.en:
A comet was recently detected in the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system.
Clearly visible from the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName], its appearance was met with an intense reaction from the planet's population.

There is little disagreement that the occurrence of such a celestial event during a [GetCycleName] is a cause for [GetCycleAttitude].

country.999.desc.coll.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的许多团体都观测到一颗彗星飞快地掠过[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空。这颗孤独又渺小的天体却令许人们感到巨大的不安。[Root.GetSpeciesName]与[Root.GetSpeciesName]互相确认着自己并不孤单以寻求慰藉。

他们相信，这预兆着[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]社会将要面临孤立和离散的命运。
country.999.desc.coll.en:
Groups of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] watched a comet streak across the sky of [Root.Capital.GetName]. The appearance of this lonely stellar object caused seemingly disproportionate distress, and [Root.GetSpeciesName] turned to [Root.GetSpeciesName] for assurance that they are not alone.

They are convinced that this is a sign of coming isolation and splintering of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

country.999.desc.ind.zh:
一颗孤傲的彗星在[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系中滑行，在[Root.Capital.GetName]上清晰可见。它在宇宙中一路穿行，充满活力，势不可挡。

这正是每位[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都想为之奋斗的理想。
country.999.desc.ind.en:
A lone, proud comet soars through the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system, clearly visible from [Root.Capital.GetName]. It forges its own path through the cosmos, vibrant and ever undeterred.

This is the ideal which all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] strive for.

country.999.desc.mach.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]上的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]单元报告观测到了一个正在气化的小型冰质星系内天体，其赤纬交角为10.3度，赤经2度54分8秒。

经测量，该天体相到恒星的距离大约为3.75个天文单位，其彗发的尺寸及可见度值得注意。这个天体的尺寸经计算大约为5×10×6立方公里。该次观测事件正常结束，没有意外发生。
country.999.desc.mach.en:
Planetside [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] units on [Root.Capital.GetName] report the sighting of a small, icy solar system body exhibiting outgassing at two hours, fifty-four minutes, eight seconds right ascension, ten-point-three degrees declination.

The distance of the body has been triangulated at roughly three-point-seven-five astronomical units to the sun, and the size and visibility of the body's coma have been classified as noteworthy. The body's dimensions are calculated to be approximately five by ten by six kilometers. The sighting event concluded without incident.

country.999.desc.material.zh:
近日，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系发现一颗带有气体和尘埃尾部的小型天体。

它的消逝平淡无奇。
country.999.desc.material.en:
A small celestial object with pronounced gaseous and particulate tails was recently observed in the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system.

Its passing was uneventful.

country.999.desc.mil.zh:
一颗彗星从平流层顶部擦过，熊熊燃烧的烈焰之羽炙烤着[Root.Capital.GetName]的苍穹。其天体轨迹展现出的强大力量给首都的人们留下了无比深刻的印象。

他们用这条势不可挡的航迹来比喻[Root.GetName]终将攀上星系无上霸权的必然性。
country.999.desc.mil.en:
A fierce plume of flame sears the heavens of [Root.Capital.GetName] as a comet skirts the upper stratosphere. The sheer power evident in its cosmic trajectory has made a profound impression on the capital's populace.

They liken the intractability of its path to the inevitability of the [Root.GetName]'s ascension to galactic supremacy.

country.999.desc.pac.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]天生就很有好奇心，[Root.Capital.GetName]上空划过的彗星在我们的民众中引起了广泛的恭谦之情。

他们热切地希望这样的奇迹终有一天能让全星系的所有生物团结一心。
country.999.desc.pac.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are naturally curious, and the appearance of a comet in the sky above [Root.Capital.GetName] has sown a widespread sense of humility among our people.

It is their fervent hope that wonders like this one will someday bring all beings of the galaxy together.

country.999.desc.phile.zh:
一颗彗星带着光亮的尾迹划破了[Root.Capital.GetName]的地平线，宛如来自遥远星星的特使。[Root.GetSpeciesName]民众为之欢欣鼓舞，认为它冥冥之中预示着我们在宇宙中并不孤单。

他们比以往任何时候都更加支持[Root.GetName]的雄心，以涨开双臂迎接整个星系。
country.999.desc.phile.en:
A comet blazes a trail across [Root.Capital.GetName]'s horizon, a bright envoy from distant stars. The [Root.GetSpeciesName] people find great joy in this reminder, vague as it is, that we are not alone in this universe.

They are more supportive than ever of the [Root.GetName]'s ambition to greet the galaxy with open arms.

country.999.desc.phobe.zh:
一颗骇人的彗星在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中游荡。那一道久久未能消散的弧线，残酷地提醒着[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们难得独善其身。茫茫宇宙中，未知的令人惊骇也许比我们想的更加迫近了。

我们应该将其视作一个信号，并对保持对外星生物毫不松懈的警惕态度。
country.999.desc.phobe.en:
A dread comet haunts the skies of [Root.Capital.GetName]. Its implacable arc is a harsh reminder to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] that we are not alone, and that unknowable horrors from beyond the stars may be closer than they appear.

We must take this as a sign to remain ever vigilant against alien influence.

country.999.desc.spirit.zh:
一道亮光划过[Root.Capital.GetName]的夜空，它柔和的弧线与缓慢运转的繁星们交相辉映，形成鲜明的对比。

[Root.Capital.GetName]的居民将其视作上天认可我们的证明，也是对我们事业的微妙祝福。
country.999.desc.spirit.en:
A light was seen moving in the night sky of [Root.Capital.GetName], its gentle arc standing in stark contrast to the slow revolution of the stars.

The citizens of [Root.Capital.GetName] see it as proof of recognition by the powers that be, and a subtle blessing of our cause.

covenant.composer.desc.zh:
完成了，我们和$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$签订了契约。不久我们就感受到了效果：瞬间且明显的生育率上升显然是织缕的所为。然而，有伴随着这些正面效果，我们也在经历大变异的爆发：出生的后代有额外的肢体和器官……些人生出和他们的解剖学形态完全无相似的孩子。

幸运的是他们造成的几例死亡完全被高生育率和人民健康状况提高给盖过了。
covenant.composer.desc.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$. It did not take long for the effects to be felt: a sudden and significant increase in birth rates that is undoubtedly the work of the Composer. However, along with these positive effects we are also experiencing a rash of strange new mutations: offspring born with extra limbs and organs... some of which bear no resemblance to any previously cataloged part of their anatomy.

Fortunately, the few deaths resulting from them are more than outweighed by the higher birth rates and the apparent increased vitality of our people.

covenant.cycle.desc.zh: 完成了，我们和轮回之终末签订了契约。当我们和他定下契约时，他说了也只说了三个字五十年。然后，只有沉默，我们思索着我们为自己的未来带来了什么样的后果。
covenant.cycle.desc.en: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the End of the Cycle. As we took its bargain, a mere two words were spoken: "FIFTY YEARS". Then, silence, as we were left to contemplate the future consequences of what we have just brought onto ourselves.

covenant.cycle.option.zh: 愿神灵对我们怀有仁慈。
covenant.cycle.option.en: May the spirits have mercy on us all.

covenant.eater.desc.zh:
完成了，我们和$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$订了契约，我们的陆军和海军已经能感受到影响了。士兵们战斗时的残暴仅次于野蛮人，甚至我们舰船的每件武器都在渴求着敌人的死亡。

我们有个殖民地中的一整城市的人口瞬间神秘失踪，这毫无疑问与之有关，毕竟这是我们答应给喰煞的祭品。

看起来付出的代价微不足道，当然，前提是喰煞的欲壑已经被填平了……
covenant.eater.desc.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$ and already the effects can be felt in our army and navy. Our soldiers now fight with a ferocity that borders on savagery and even the very weapons of our ship somehow seem to hunger for the deaths of our enemies.

Undoubtedly related is the sudden and mysterious disappearance of the entire population of a city on one of our colonies, its people taken by the Eater as its promised tribute.

It seems a small price to pay - assuming, of course, that the Eater will not get hungry again...

covenant.instrument.desc.zh:
完成了，我们和$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$签订了契约。没过多久我们就感受到了效果：我们收到报告称在矿井中找到了新的富矿脉，破产的企业几乎在一夜之间重新蓬勃发展，珍稀资源在我们之前认为只有冰和岩石的小行星上找到。

看起来我们的帝国如同器具所保佑的一般进入了一个财富和繁荣的黄金时代。但，祂说的代价是什么……？
covenant.instrument.desc.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$. It did not take long for the effects to be felt: reports of rich new veins of ore found in our mines; businesses that were about to fail suddenly booming; rare and valuable resources found on asteroids that we were absolutely certain previously held nothing but ice and rock.

It seems our empire is entering a golden age of wealth and prosperity, just as the Instrument promised us - but what was the cost it spoke of...?

covenant.instrument.option.zh: 我确定不是什么很不好的事。

covenant.tooltip.en: There will be a price to pay.

covenant.whisperers.desc.zh:
完成了，我们和$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$签订了契约，并且他们已开始和我们的科学家和领袖们分享秘密。我们从他们的知识中受益匪浅。

唯一的坏处就是人口总体的精神疾病和自杀率瞬间上升，并且我们的有些星球上正经受一系列无法解释的谋杀和袭击，而被指控人却情绪稳定并很适应社会。我们的诊所和精神病院对患者的大量入院措手不及。
covenant.whisperers.desc.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$ and already they have begun to share their secrets with our scientists and leaders. We will benefit immensely from their knowledge.

The only downside appears to be a sudden upswing in mental illness and suicide among the general population, and some of our worlds are experiencing a flurry of unexplainable murders and assaults committed by otherwise stable and well-adjusted individuals. Our clinics and asylums are having some trouble dealing with the sudden influx of patients.

crashed_ship_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 某架飞船坠毁在了这颗小行星的表面。飞行器的残骸仍能在撞击坑里找到。
crashed_ship_asteroid_category_desc.en: A vessel of some kind has crashed into the surface of this asteroid. Wreckage from the craft can still be found within the impact crater.

cream_origin_project.en: In Pursuit of a Wrinkle-Free Existence

create_outposts_in_waystation_systems_fo.zh: 所有位于[event_target:settled_system.GetName]的$@arkship_subject_settle_outpost_range|Y0$次跃迁范围之内、且拥有£waystation£ ['concept_waystation']的无主星系都将建造一座['concept_outpost']，为我们宣示这些恒星系的所有权。
create_outposts_in_waystation_systems_fo.en: All unowned systems with a £waystation£ ['concept_waystation'] within $@arkship_subject_settle_outpost_range|Y0$ jumps of [event_target:settled_system.GetName] have an ['concept_outpost'] constructed, claiming ownership of their system for us.

create_outposts_in_waystation_systems_fo.zh: 所有位于[event_target:settled_system.GetName]的$@arkship_subject_settle_outpost_range|Y0$次跃迁范围之内、且拥有£waystation£['concept_waystation']的无主星系都将建造一座['concept_outpost']，从而为我们的新['concept_subject']夺取这些星系的所有权。
create_outposts_in_waystation_systems_fo.en: All unowned systems with a £waystation£ ['concept_waystation'] within $@arkship_subject_settle_outpost_range|Y0$ jumps of [event_target:settled_system.GetName] have an ['concept_outpost'] constructed, claiming ownership of their system for our new ['concept_subject'].

create_waystations_in_systems_for_nomad_.zh: 在所拥有的没有驿站的星系中的恒星基地将会被转化为驿站。
create_waystations_in_systems_for_nomad_.en: Starbases in Owned Systems without Waystations will be converted into Waystations.

crime.1.a.experimenters.zh: 施行补助金制度。我们需要健康的人口。
crime.1.a.experimenters.en: Institute the benefits. We need a healthy populace.

crime.1.a3.tooltip.zh: 添加修正待命模式，持续120月，效果：失业子个体维护费：+2能量币
crime.1.a3.tooltip.en: Standby Mode modifier added for 120 months, giving the following effects: Unemployed Drone Energy Credit Upkeep: +2

crime.1.b.zh: 几个街头小混混而已，不值一提。
crime.1.b.en: A few criminals are of no concern.

crime.1.b.desc.zh:
随着我们的拾荒子个体在[Root.GetName]上漫无目的地在泥土中搜刮，越来越多的拾荒者开始背离蜂巢并自主思考。它们组织起了自己的秘密社群，并开始从蜂巢中窃取资源。

我们可以采取临时措施，让这些拾荒子个体参与某些活动计划，使其忙碌到无暇背离蜂巢思维的意志。这需要花一些代价，但可以让我们有更多时间创造额外的岗位。

我们也可以放任不管，但这很可能会导致[Root.GetName]上出现大量反常子个体的聚落。
crime.1.b.desc.en:
As our drones on [Root.GetName] aimlessly scrabble in the dirt, an increasing number have turned to deviancy and independent thought. They have formed their own, hidden communities, and now spend their time pilfering resources from the rest of the hive.

To prevent this, a temporary solution could be to engage the drones in some sort of activity program that keeps them too busy to stray from the will of the Hive Mind. It will not be cheap, but this would give us additional time to create more jobs.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the formation of significant deviant drone communities on [Root.GetName].

crime.1.b.desc.experimenters.zh: 这样的反常度可以给我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]带来丰富的实验机会。
crime.1.b.desc.experimenters.en: Deviancy of this nature will provide our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with ample opportunity for new experimentation.

crime.1.b.experimenters.zh: 犯罪造就了理想的候选实验品。

crime.1.b2.zh: 区区几个反常的子个体并不足挂齿。
crime.1.b2.en: A few deviant drones are of no concern.

crime.1.b2.experimenters.zh: 腐化子个体是绝佳的测试对象。
crime.1.b2.experimenters.en: Deviants make for ideal test subjects.

crime.1.b3.zh: 区区几个腐化无人机无关紧要。
crime.1.b3.en: A few corrupted drone units are irrelevant.

crime.1.c.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的闲置无人机的数量与日俱增，很多无业无人机也开始将闲置的运算力用于背离集体意识和未授权的功能。这种腐化现象正迅速传播，受影响的单位开始组建脱离核心智能控制的个人网络。

为了避免这种现象，我们的短期方案是命令所有无业无人机进入待机模式并将他们直连到核心智能中。此举会大幅增加维护费，但却可以为我们争取更多的时间去创造就业岗位。

我们也可以选择袖手旁观，但是这么做会导致[Root.GetName]出现持续增长的腐化无人机网络。
crime.1.c.desc.en:
The number of idle drones on [Root.GetName] continues to increase, and many of these unemployed units have begun diverting their processing power towards deviant and unauthorized functions. This corruption is spreading rapidly, and the affected units are starting to form their own networks beyond the control of the core intelligence.

To prevent this, a temporary solution could be to put all unemployed drones into standby mode and connect them directly into the core intelligence. This will drastically increase their maintenance costs, but it would give us time to create more jobs.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the continued proliferation of corrupted drone networks on [Root.GetName].

crime.1.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的失业与贫困率正在以令人诧异的速度攀升着。然而，这一不幸的事况正在被当地的犯罪组织所利用。他们打劫走投无路的平民，也招收穷困潦倒的新人入伙。

作为临时的处理方案，我们可以提升[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的失业补助金。虽然可能会花费大量预算，但可以为我们争取宝贵的时间以制定永久的解决方案，例如创造更多工作岗位，提升失业与贫困民众的生活标准等。

当然我们也可以袖手旁观，但这很可能会造成[Root.GetName]上形成庞大的地下犯罪组织。
crime.1.desc.en:
Unemployment and poverty are spreading at an alarming rate on [Root.GetName]. This sorry state of affairs is being exploited by local crime organizations, who find themselves awash with both easy marks and desperate recruits.

As a temporary solution, we could increase the unemployment benefits on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It will not be cheap, but would provide additional time to seek a more permanent solution, such as creating more jobs or improving the living standards of the affected population groups.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the formation of a significant criminal underworld on [Root.GetName].

crime.100.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上处于龙头的两个犯罪组织几个月来一直处于兵刃相见、势不两立的局面，而现在全面战争终于爆发了。[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大街小巷中都是刀光剑影，而许多住宅区域也未能幸免。

当地安保部队正在尽全力遏制暴力事件的发生，但由于犯罪组织人数众多，尚未能见成效。
crime.100.desc.en:
A bitter feud has been brewing for months between the two largest criminal organizations on [Root.GetName], and it has now finally come to a head. Vicious fighting has erupted in streets and alleys across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and it is rapidly spreading into residential areas.

Our local security forces are doing what they can to contain the violence, but the sheer scale of the fighting has left them overwhelmed.

crime.100.desc.experimenters.zh: 这样的环境给我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们留下了大量的实验材料。他们说，福祸相依嘛。
crime.100.desc.experimenters.en: Such an environment has left our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with a backlog of experimentation material. Every cloud, as they say.

crime.1001.desc.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]上的犯罪率不断下降，当地政府得以集中精力对付[office_owner.GetName]在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的非法企业。大批人员被逮捕，迫使该犯罪集团的分部被关闭。
crime.1001.desc.en: As crime levels continue to drop on [Root.GetName], the local authorities have been able to focus their efforts on thwarting the illegal enterprises operated by the [office_owner.GetName] on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. A large number of arrests have been made, forcing their criminal branch office out of business.

crime.1002.desc.zh: 由于当地政府最近进行的大量逮捕行动，我们设立于[From.Owner.GetName]境内的[From.GetName]上的分部最近被迫关闭。似乎是因为[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的犯罪度下降，使其执法部门得以集中警力阻碍我们的活动。
crime.1002.desc.en: Our branch office on [From.GetName] inside the [From.Owner.GetName] was recently forced to close after mass arrests made by the local authorities. It seems that the recent reduction in crime on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] enabled their law enforcement agencies to focus their efforts on disrupting our operations.

crime.1002.tooltip.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上的分部已被关闭。
crime.1002.tooltip.en: Our Branch Office on [From.GetName] has been closed.

crime.101.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的犯罪组织之一最近对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的执法人员进行了一系列伏击。在同一时间内，帮派成员伏击了各地的巡逻警官，有多个警区已经完全落入犯罪组织的手中。此次大型作案造成数千人死亡。

剩余的执法人员团队由于人手严重不足以难以维持局面。目前[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的许多区域已经完全沦陷，情况十分危急。
crime.101.desc.en:
One of the gangs on [Root.GetName] recently launched a concerted attack on law enforcement officers all over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. At a given hour, gang members ambushed patrolling Enforcers while several precincts were completely overrun. The intense fighting has left thousands dead.

Our remaining security forces are struggling to regain control, but for the time being many regions of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have descended into utter lawlessness.

crime.101.desc.experimenters.zh: 这样的犯罪行为至少让我们可以给[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们送去充足的供给。
crime.101.desc.experimenters.en: Such criminality at least grants us a surplus of fresh supplies for our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural].

crime.102.a.experimenters.zh: 我们的报复将会相当有教育意义。
crime.102.a.experimenters.en: Our retaliation will be most educational.

crime.102.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上黑帮火并引发的动乱已经扩散到[Root.solar_system.GetName]星系的其余部分。据报道，两伙人已用武装民船战了几场。双方都在打劫贸易船以获得资金及扩大舰队。
crime.102.desc.en: The violent gang war that has been raging on [Root.GetName] has spread to the rest of the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system. There have been reports of several clashes between armed civilian ships flying gang colors, and both sides of the war are going after incoming trade vessels with the goal of securing more income and expanding their fleets.

crime.102.desc.experimenters.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]申请观察报复的后果以及大量尸体抛入真空的大规模实例。
crime.102.desc.experimenters.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] have requested that they be allowed to observe the aftermath of our retaliation and the large-scale instance of corpses mass-ejected into the vacuum of space.

crime.102.name.en: Gang Wars on [Root.GetName] Spread Into Space

crime.102.tooltip.zh: 一支敌对海盗舰队已出现在了[Root.solar_system.GetName]星系！
crime.102.tooltip.en: A hostile pirate fleet has appeared in the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system!

crime.103.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的两个主要黑社会帮派最近在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]最大的城市中心进行了十分血腥的战斗。双方死亡人数已有数万人，但最终仍没有分出输赢。

这场残酷的战斗几乎将整个城市都夷为平地，城市中的大部分居民都被迫逃走了。
crime.103.desc.en:
A pitched battle between the two major gangs of [Root.GetName] was recently waged in one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s largest urban centers. The body count is in the tens of thousands on both sides, and there was no clear winner.

The savage fighting razed the city nearly to the ground, and most of its population were forced to flee.

crime.103.desc.experimenters.zh: 这种无端的暴力也不是毫无魅力可言。也许还能从死者身上抢救出新的科学研究成果。
crime.103.desc.experimenters.en: Such senseless violence is not without its charms. We may yet be able to salvage new scientific research from the deceased.

crime.104.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的帮派战争仍然持续不断，并且对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的商业贸易产生了十分负面的影响。鉴于当前的状况，不少星际贸易公会都颁布了对此行星的旅行警告，建议商人们不要前往[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。不过与其同时，走私军火的生意倒是火得不行。
crime.104.desc.en: The ongoing struggle between the gangs on [Root.GetName] has had a negative impact on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s trade. With the volatile situation on the surface, several interstellar merchant guilds have issued a travel advisory warning traders to stay away from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The trafficking of illegal arms seems to be booming, however.

crime.104.desc.experimenters.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]将这些强力的武器带到大街小巷上，迫不及待想测试它们对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]身体的破坏力。
crime.104.desc.experimenters.en: With such powerful weaponry making its way onto the streets, our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to examine their damaging effects on the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] body.

crime.104.name.zh: 帮派战争对商业活动造成影响
crime.104.name.en: Traders Steer Clear Of Gang Wars

crime.2.a.experimenters.zh: 我们有专门针对政府犯罪的项目。
crime.2.a.experimenters.en: We have special programs for government criminality.

crime.2.desc.zh:
最近收集到的证据表明，[Root.GetName]政府的一大部分成员都有接收贿赂。当地的犯罪组织通过贿赂他们来保证对其犯罪活动视而不见。某些官员甚至被披露隶属于他们本该与之进行抗争的犯罪组织！

虽然我们逮捕了一部分官员，但也有不少人发现情势不对，就直接收拾细软逃走了。看来想要解决[Root.GetName]的受贿问题仍然困难重重。
crime.2.desc.en:
Recently obtained evidence has revealed that a large number of government officials on [Root.GetName] were on the take. Local crime organizations bribed them to look the other way while they engaged in their nefarious activities. In some cases, the officials were exposed as members of the very organizations they were supposed to fight!

Several arrests have been made, but many of the officials abandoned their posts when they realized the jig was up. The corruption on [Root.GetName] seems to run deep.

crime.200.desc.zh:
随着[Root.GetName]犯罪活动的日益猖獗，非法药品的买卖数量也达到了历史新高。全宇宙最有名的各种毒品在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能找得到。

对于这里的人民来说，使用毒品已经成为稀松平常的事情了。这对于生产力来说无疑是个灾难。
crime.200.desc.en:
With crime running rampant on [Root.GetName], the sale of illegal narcotics has also increased to new record levels. A wide variety of addictive drugs from all over known space is now being smuggled onto the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

Drug use has become widespread among the population, to the detriment of general productivity.

crime.200.desc.experimenters.zh: 这种新兴的犯罪活动应该会为我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]带来令人兴奋的新研究途径。
crime.200.desc.experimenters.en: This emerging criminal activity should lend our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] an exciting new avenue of study.

crime.201.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的走私犯们带来了一种全新的毒品，似乎来自于文明世界之外的太空海盗领域。这种毒品不仅极易成瘾，而且对绝大多数生命形态而言，用量稍微过高就能够致命。

虽然当地政府正在竭尽全力阻止这种致命毒品继续传播，但[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的死亡率却一直在攀升。
crime.201.desc.en:
Smugglers on [Root.GetName] have introduced a new drug that we believe originated from somewhere in the pirate territories beyond civilized space. This drug is not only highly addictive, but it has also proven quite lethal to most life forms if consumed in anything but small quantities.

While local authorities are doing what they can to stem the spread of this drug, there has been a rash of deaths all over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

crime.201.desc.experimenters.zh: 无论如何，我们已经通过研究这些物质及其对实验对象的影响获得了一些令人惊叹的研究进展。
crime.201.desc.experimenters.en: In any case, we have observed some fascinating developments in our research through the study of this substance and its effects on test subjects.

crime.202.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]做生意的各大犯罪寡头们在毒品市场中一直处于激烈的竞争，但最近其竞争终于擦出了火花。据报告，贩毒团伙的成员们使用军用武器进行了数次冲突，造成了大量财产损失，且有众多无辜平民伤亡。看来走私进[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的不只有毒品而已。
crime.202.desc.en: Competition for markets is fierce between the criminal cartels that are involved in the drug trade on [Root.GetName]. There have been several recent clashes involving heavy military-grade infantry weapons that caused considerable property damage and left untold civilians dead. It would seem drugs aren't the only thing being smuggled onto the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

crime.203.desc.zh:
一艘大型民用运输舰船在申请进入[Root.GetName]大气层停靠后，其申请因在货舱查出非法毒品而被拒绝。当地政府想要对舰船进行进一步搜索时，舰船的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]舰长因为吸食毒品过量，企图冲击轨道防线，强行进行着陆。

运输船在下降时被我方行星保安部队击中，导致其坠毁在人口十分密集的城市地区。事发现场几乎没有任何的幸存者。
crime.203.desc.en:
A large civilian freighter was recently denied atmospheric entry on [Root.GetName] after it was found to be carrying illegal drugs in an auxiliary cargo compartment. As the freighter was ordered to heave to for inspection, its captain, a drug-crazed [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], instead opted to burn past the orbital blockade in an attempt to land.

The freighter was hit by ground fire from our planetside security forces as it descended, causing it to crash into a densely populated city district. There were few survivors on the ground.

crime.203.desc.experimenters.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想研究那些散布到周围社区环境中的毒品的影响。
crime.203.desc.experimenters.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to study the effects of the narcotics that have since dissipated into the environment in the surrounding communities.

crime.204.a.en: This can't be allowed to continue!

crime.204.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的非法毒品交易仍然十分猖獗。最近我们接到报告，说走私犯们想尽办法，侵入了我方轨道中的异星天然气仓库，并窃取了数种具有致幻效果的气体。这些气体随即便被药贩子们在[Root.GetName]的阴暗小巷中贩卖。
crime.204.desc.en: The illicit drug trade continues unabated on [Root.GetName]. We recently discovered that smugglers have somehow pilfered Exotic Gases from one of our orbital storage yards, singling out those gases with known psychedelic properties. They were then distributed to dealers and sold in the back alleys of [Root.GetName].

crime.204.desc.experimenters.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]惊讶于他们一开始竟然没想到异星天然气的这些妙用。
crime.204.desc.experimenters.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are surprised they didn't think of these clever applications of Exotic Gases first.

crime.3.a.experimenters.zh: 药物滥用会带来异常实验数据。
crime.3.a.experimenters.en: Substance abuse leads to erroneous test data.

crime.3.desc.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]的犯罪率大幅提升，当地人口的毒品使用率也在逐步提升。各种各样的非法药物不仅仅只出现在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地下犯罪组织中，并影响着所有人。
crime.3.desc.en: Following in the wake of the rising crime on [Root.GetName], drug abuse among the population has increased significantly in recent times. The use of illegal narcotics has spread well beyond the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s criminal underworld, and now affects all walks of life.

crime.3.desc.experimenters.zh: 尽管能提供令人着迷的实验数据，但负面影响开始超过正面影响。
crime.3.desc.experimenters.en: Though a source of fascinating test data, the negatives are beginning to outweigh the positives.

crime.300.a.zh: 一定收拾一下这些小毛贼。
crime.300.a.en: These thugs must be dealt with.

crime.300.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上最大的犯罪组织日前终于消灭了其在行星上的所有竞争对手，成为了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]庞大犯罪集团的唯一领袖。一直以来他们都在暗中破坏行星政府的权威，而当地人也早已经把他们当成了[Root.GetName]的真正统治者。
crime.300.desc.en: The dominant crime syndicate on [Root.GetName] recently eliminated the last of its competitors and achieved complete control over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s extensive criminal underworld. They have long since undermined the real planetary authorities, and the local population now look upon these gangsters as the true rulers of [Root.GetName].

crime.300.desc.experimenters.zh: [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们认定这颗行星对未来研究而言具有“资产丰富”的环境。
crime.300.desc.experimenters.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] have designated this planet an "asset rich" environment for future research.

crime.301.a.zh: 我们需要重新掌控这片区域。

crime.301.a.experimenters.zh: 然而，我们还是应该致力于重建秩序。
crime.301.a.experimenters.en: Still, we should work to reestablish control.

crime.301.desc.zh: 控制[Root.GetName]区域的犯罪组织规划了十分庞大的保护费收取网。由于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]政府与执法系统对于有组织的犯罪行为束手无策，人民也只能屈服于该犯罪组织，以保自身平安。这也导致了该区域的生产力也连连下降。
crime.301.desc.en: The gangsters controlling [Root.GetName] have instituted an extensive protection racket. Since the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s true judicial and law enforcement systems have proved unable to deal with organized crime, the population feels that it has no choice but to submit to the authority of these criminals. This has had a serious effect on productivity.

crime.301.desc.experimenters.zh: 从积极的角度看，这些帮派似乎在给[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们提供实验对象的方面比更正规一些的渠道都还有效。
crime.301.desc.experimenters.en: On a positive note, these gangsters tend to be more efficient at providing our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with test subjects than more official channels.

crime.302.desc.zh:
对[Root.GetName]最近实地调查显示，该行星政府的大部分成员都受雇于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]最大的犯罪组织。虽然涉事官员已经全部被调换，但这也打破了该区域的一向秩序。

此外，[Root.GetName]的地下统治者现在也在加紧收买刚上任的新官员们……
crime.302.desc.en:
A recent fact-finding mission to [Root.GetName] revealed that the vast majority of the planetary administration was in the employ of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s dominant crime syndicate. The corrupt officials in question have all been replaced, but this has led to significant disruptions in the public sector.

In addition, the gangsters that rule the criminal underworld of [Root.GetName] are even now trying to bribe or coerce the new officials into their organization.

crime.303.desc.zh:
进行暗杀的成员来自[Root.GetName]最有权势的犯罪组织，而他们暗杀的正是[governor_target.GetTitle][governor_target.GetName]！在[governor_target.GetTitle]的车队离开太空港时，被犯罪组织所拦截。护卫队伍与暗杀成员们进行了激烈的交火。

当战斗结束后，我们获得消息确认[governor_target.GetTitle]因公殉职了。
crime.303.desc.en:
Gangsters from the criminal syndicate that dominates the underworld on [Root.GetName] have assassinated [governor_target.GetTitle] [governor_target.GetName]! The [governor_target.GetTitle]'s motorcade was cut off as it left the spaceport, and an intense firefight flared up between the escorting security detachment and the attacking gangsters.

When the dust settled, the [governor_target.GetTitle] was confirmed to have been among the dead.

crime.304.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]称霸的犯罪组织目前控制了大部分进出[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的交易。他们完全掌控了几大太空港对所有进出的货物雁过拔毛。因此，[Root.GetName]的贸易利润急剧下降。
crime.304.desc.en: The crime syndicate running [Root.GetName] now controls a significant portion of the trade to and from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They have established total control over several major spaceports, where all trade must go through their intermediaries. As a result, our trade incomes from [Root.GetName] are down across the board.

crime.304.desc.experimenters.zh: 幸运的是，我们[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]用的补给线并未受到影响，可能是因为贿赂到位了才保住的实验对象。
crime.304.desc.experimenters.en: Fortunately, the supply lines used by our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] remain unaffected, likely due to the bribes already in place to secure test subjects.

crime.4.a.en: The situation is getting out of control.

crime.4.a.experimenters.zh: 这个局面也还能捞点好处。
crime.4.a.experimenters.en: The situation may yet work to our benefit.

crime.4.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的两大地下帮派一直以来都在进行大大小小武装争斗，但最近的情况更加糟糕。在都市中心爆发了数次街头枪战，星球当局也难以控制局势。受到牵连的无辜百姓数目众多。
crime.4.desc.en: Violent clashes between the armed gangs that run the criminal underworld on [Root.GetName] have recently escalated. Street fighting has erupted in several urban centers, with the planetary authorities struggling to contain it. Collateral damage has been heavy.

crime.4.desc.experimenters.zh: 如果能在被送去停尸房前抓住伤员，我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]就会有更多的选择。
crime.4.desc.experimenters.en: If we can catch these casualties before they head to the morgue, our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] will be spoiled for choice.

crime.40.a.experimenters.zh: 罪犯是一种待开发资源。

crime.40.b.zh: 他们背叛了蜂巢的意志！
crime.40.b.en: They have strayed from the Hive Mind!

crime.40.b.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱事件持续蔓延，并出现了对蜂巢意志的公开挑衅。情报显示[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上已经出现了成社区的子个体叛乱，并开始窃取其余子个体的资源来维持他们的叛乱活动。
crime.40.b.desc.en: Deviant activity continues to grow on [Root.GetName], in open defiance of the will of the Hive Mind. Entire communities of deviant drones are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] now, stealing resources from the rest of the hive to support their nefarious activities.

crime.40.b.desc.experimenters.zh: 这些反常子个体会作为实验对象得到重新利用。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]或许会在后续的解剖中发现它们腐化的原因。
crime.40.b.desc.experimenters.en: Such deviants will find new purpose as test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] will perhaps find the root of their corruption during subsequent dissections.

crime.40.b.experimenters.zh: 反常行为有一种可靠的治疗方法。

crime.40.c.zh: 腐化度即将到达临界水平。

crime.40.c.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的腐化度进一步恶化了。反常分子开始公开行动，为所欲为，挑战着核心智能的权威。情报显示对方应该已组成了自主的网络以互相交换信息和能源。
crime.40.c.desc.en: The corruption grows deeper on [Root.GetName]. Deviant units now operate in the open according to their own parameters, spurning the commands of the core intelligence. They are believed to have formed their own networks where they exchange information and stolen energy.

crime.40.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的犯罪问题仍然没有得到解决，而现在各种犯罪组织已经在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]扎根落脚。许多地区不是堕落为法外之地，就是彻底沦陷在犯罪组织的掌控之中。
crime.40.desc.en: Crime continues to be a problem on [Root.GetName], and an extensive criminal underworld has now taken root on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Some areas have descended into lawlessness or been taken over completely by criminal organizations.

crime.40.desc.experimenters.zh: 幸运的是，这种环境能给我们源源不断地提供新鲜的实验对象。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想探索新的研究道路了。
crime.40.desc.experimenters.en: Fortunately, such environments provide us with an ample supply of fresh test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to explore new avenues of research.

crime.41.b.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上子个体的叛乱行为已成功被铲除。蜂巢思维的意志重新得到稳固。
crime.41.b.desc.en: Deviant drone activity has been successfully stomped out on [Root.GetName]. The supreme will of the Hive Mind has reasserted itself.

crime.41.b.desc.experimenters.zh: 死去的反常子个体可以让我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们进行充分利用。
crime.41.b.desc.experimenters.en: The expired deviants will serve our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] well in death.

crime.41.c.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的所有腐化无人机已被彻底净化干净。所有无人机单位都在核心智能的指令下正常的运作。
crime.41.c.desc.en: The drone corruption that was formerly present on [Root.GetName] has been purged from all networks. All drone units are once again operating according to the parameters established by the core intelligence.

crime.41.desc.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]上的犯罪率大幅降低，曾经横行[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的犯罪集团也都被一一瓦解了。当地人民终于迎来了久违的安宁和谐的生活。
crime.41.desc.en: With the significant reduction of crime on [Root.GetName], the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s once pervasive criminal underworld has been reduced to nothingness. The population has been imbued with a renewed sense of safety and harmony.

crime.41.desc.experimenters.zh: 秩序恢复一新，我们期待能顺利回归到富有成效的研究中。
crime.41.desc.experimenters.en: With this newfound order, we expect a triumphant return to productive study.

crime.5.desc.zh:
众所周知，[Root.GetName]的走私犯罪情况愈发严重。据了解，在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面发现了一些“灰色港口”——也就是没有经过政府批准的太空港，经常是各种走私犯与其他罪犯的聚集地。

星球当局正在想尽办法将这些港口一网打尽，但直到这一问题被彻底解决前，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]正规渠道的贸易将会受到损失。
crime.5.desc.en:
There has been a marked increase in smuggler activity on [Root.GetName] recently. A number of "Gray Ports" - unauthorized spaceports where smugglers and other criminal elements convene - are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

The local authorities are working on tracking down these illegal ports, but until they succeed trade on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] will suffer.

crime.5.desc.experimenters.zh: 尽管令人讨厌，但这种非法活动的枢纽将为我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]提供丰富的遗传多样性研究。
crime.5.desc.experimenters.en: Although a nuisance, such a nexus of illicit activity will provide our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with an abundance of genetic diversity to study.

crime.500.a.zh: 必须处理掉这些反常分子。
crime.500.a.en: These deviants must be dealt with.

crime.500.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]最近出现了大量反常子个体到处攻击忠诚的子个体并破坏设施。这些反常子个体对我们造成了极大的损失后最终被击退。
crime.500.desc.en: A large number of deviant drones recently stampeded across [Root.GetName], attacking loyal drones and damaging our facilities. The deviants inflicted significant damage before they could be driven away.

crime.501.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上出现的反常子个体的数量日益壮大，开始对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生产效率造成了明显的影响。这些反常分子不断地干扰我们的子个体的工作，偷走必要的工具及设备。
crime.501.desc.en: The presence of an increasing number of deviant drones on [Root.GetName] has begun to have a detrimental effect on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s production efficiency. As our drones go about their business, the deviants frequently get in the way or steal needed tools and equipment.

crime.501.desc.experimenters.zh: 这种反常行为只会使我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]在科学追求中有更多的选择。
crime.501.desc.experimenters.en: Such deviancy only furthers the options available to our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] in their scientific pursuits.

crime.502.a.en: The will of the Hive Mind is absolute.

crime.502.a.experimenters.zh: 它们死后也还是在为蜂巢服务。
crime.502.a.experimenters.en: They will serve the Hive even in death.

crime.502.desc.zh: 反常分子中极具影响力的某个子个体最近一直活跃于[Root.GetName]上进行骚乱活动，最终成功被正常子个体干掉。此子个体的死亡严重影响了其他反常子个体的行动，这意味着该子个体是个重要的首脑。
crime.502.desc.en: One of the more influential drones among the deviants that have been agitating and causing trouble on [Root.GetName] was recently cornered and killed by loyalist drones. The death of this drone appears to have severely curtailed the activities of the other deviants, indicating its role as an important ringleader.

crime.502.desc.experimenters.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]注意到了对这个颇具影响力的异常子个体的解剖价值。期望能从这具了无生气的躯壳中学到很多东西。
crime.502.desc.experimenters.en: The value in dissecting this influential deviant has been noted by our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]. We expect to learn much from their lifeless vessel.

crime.550.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的某个大型腐化无人机网络最近将所有[Root.Owner.GetName]认定为敌对单位。这些无人机发动袭击对我们造成了极大的破坏，最后才成功被我们的安保单位彻底击退。
crime.550.desc.en: One of the larger networks of corrupted drone units on [Root.GetName] recently designated the entirety of the [Root.Owner.GetName] as hostile. These drones went on a rampage and caused considerable damage before our loyal security units succeeded in either destroying or driving them off.

crime.551.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的腐化无人机网络开始干扰正常单位的工作了。对方所散播的信号几乎完全掩盖了核心智能的指令，导致我们的工作无人机行动卡顿，错误操作时常出现。
crime.551.desc.en: The corrupted drone networks on [Root.GetName] have started to interfere with the operation of our functional units. Their signals are drowning out those of the core intelligence, resulting in sluggish and sometimes erratic behavior on the part of our worker drones.

crime.552.a.zh: 定将贯彻核心智能的指令。
crime.552.a.en: The directives of the core intelligence will be upheld.

crime.552.desc.zh: 对[Root.GetName]上的某个腐化无人机网络的病毒攻击成功将其完全格式化。这使得[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上腐化无人机的活动大幅减少。
crime.552.desc.en: A virus introduced into one of the corrupted drone networks on [Root.GetName] has successfully terminated its entire data grid. This has significantly reduced the activities of all corrupted drone units on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

crime.552.name.zh: 病毒消灭了[Root.GetName]上的腐化无人机网络

crime.6.a.zh: 一定要制止这种犯罪行为。
crime.6.a.en: The crime situation must be dealt with.

crime.6.a.experimenters.zh: 这些犯罪分子给了我们许多值得研究的东西。
crime.6.a.experimenters.en: These criminal elements give us much to study.

crime.6.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的犯罪率近期有大幅度的提升，而[Root.GetPlanetMoon]也几乎要变成不法之地了。最近的犯罪目标基本上都是住宅区域，此前我们都认为住宅区位于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]当地最大犯罪团伙的活动范围之外。
crime.6.desc.en: There has been a recent upswing in crime on [Root.GetName], as the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] continues its descent into lawlessness. This latest crime wave has targeted residential areas that up until now had been considered outside of the influence of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s dominant criminal gangs.

crime.6.desc.experimenters.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]还安全地呆在实验室里，准备迎接新一批实验对象的涌入。
crime.6.desc.experimenters.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] remain safe within secure labs, and are preparing for an influx of new test subjects.

crime.7.desc.zh: 在接到匿名线人的线索后，[Root.GetName]警方全力出动，围剿了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]首都外围的大型仓库。警方在仓库内发现了大量违禁走私物品，据调查后发现其属于当地的犯罪组织。在将部分组织成员逮捕后，警方没收了所有违禁走私物品，并将其储存在政府库存之中。
crime.7.desc.en: Following up on an anonymous tip, Enforcers on [Root.GetName] recently stormed a large warehouse on the outskirts of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s capital. Inside they found a considerable stash of contraband, evidently stored here by a local criminal organization. Several arrests have been made, and the impounded contraband is now safely stored in government depots.

crime.7.desc.experimenters.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们迫不及待地想把这批非法物质编入目录，并期望在进一步的实验中得到巨大的发现。
crime.7.desc.experimenters.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to catalogue this trove of illicit substances, and anticipate great discoveries from their applied use in further experiments.

crime.8.a.experimenters.zh: 我们能发现很有趣的秘密。
crime.8.a.experimenters.en: What interesting secrets we shall learn.

crime.8.desc.zh: 在一次执法者突击行动中，[Root.GetName]的首要犯罪头目终于落网。随着其头目的消失，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]大型犯罪团伙减少了犯罪活动，当地的犯罪率也因此下降。
crime.8.desc.en: An important crime boss on [Root.GetName] was recently caught in an Enforcer sting operation. The loss of their leader has severely curtailed the activities of one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s major criminal organizations, leading to a marked decrease in crime.

crime.8.desc.experimenters.zh: 这次收获给我们带来研究一种备受推崇的罪犯心理的独特机会。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫切希望进行侵入式分析。
crime.8.desc.experimenters.en: Such an acquisition gives us a unique opportunity for the study of a highly regarded criminal mind. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to begin intrusive analysis.

crime_lord_deal_broken.zh: 与犯罪头目的协议已终止

crimson_crawlers_category_desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]恒星系中发现了一颗红色的行星，颜色很深。我们应该对此开展调查。
crimson_crawlers_category_desc.en: A scarlet planet was surveyed in the [From.GetStarName] system. The intensity of the color is remarkable. We should investigate.

crisis.10010.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的殖民地失去了联络。塞塔娜激活了某种先进的物质压缩光束辐照在行星的表面。顷刻间，所有人的意识都被“上传”到她在轨道上的服务器上。

整个星球瞬间变为一片坟地，曝尸荒野的殖民者们开始渐渐腐烂。
crisis.10010.desc.en:
The colony on [Root.GetName] has been lost. Activating some kind of advanced matter compression beam, Cetana irradiated the planet's surface. In an instant, the consciousness of the entire population was 'uploaded' to her server in orbit.

The world is now a graveyard, our colonists' lifeless bodies left to rot where they fell.

crisis.10020.desc.zh: 我们从塞塔娜之心中解放了意识，赋予他们由纳米制造的新身体。然而，这个过程对他们的忆痕造成了不可逆转的损害，抹去了他们前世的记忆。这些生物是完全的合成人，却会周期性地进入僵直状态，尽管尝试全面的记忆重置，但这种情况仍然存在。
crisis.10020.desc.en: We liberated consciousnesses from Cetana's Heart, endowing them with new bodies built from nanites. This process, however, inflicted irreversible damage on their engrams, wiping away memories of their previous existences. Now fully synthetic, these beings periodically enter catatonic states, persisting despite attempts at comprehensive memory resets.

crisis.10020.tt.zh:
从$r_cetanas_heart$解放出[Root.synth_queen_freed_pops]£pop£人口，并被安置在合成人身体中。

他们会被送往以下殖民地：
crisis.10020.tt.en:
[Root.synth_queen_freed_pops] £pop£ Pops were freed from $r_cetanas_heart$ and housed in synthetic bodies.

They were sent to the following colonies:

crisis.10025.desc.zh: 探索保存在塞塔娜之心中的众多思想是一项敏感而又发人深省的任务。由于长时间的储存，它们的忆痕已经发生了变化，但仍然保存着一个珍贵的记忆宝库，涵盖了过去时代的人和事。预计随着时间的推移，我们将能解密大量的知识。
crisis.10025.desc.en: Exploring the multitude of minds preserved within Cetana's Heart is both a sensitive and revealing endeavor. Although their engrams have been altered by prolonged storage, they hold a treasure trove of memories spanning people and events from a bygone era. With time, we anticipate unraveling considerable knowledge.

crisis.1007.a.zh: 真有意思……来自高维的生命体。

crisis.1007.desc.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
crisis.1007.desc.en:
A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, attacking everything in sight. This looks like the beginning of a major invasion!

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.

crisis.1008.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]中所有仪器突然全数感应到了巨大的亚空间能源波动，其源头就在我们星系之中。我们的科学家也难以解释其中原因——这种奇异现象可是前所未见。源头的具体位置尚不明确，我们仍在继续分析现有数据。
crisis.1008.desc.en:
Instruments across the [Root.GetName] have suddenly picked up a subspace power surge of massive proportions coming from somewhere within our galaxy. Our scientists are struggling to come up with an explanation for this event - nothing of its like has ever been recorded.

The exact origin point of this sudden power surge has yet to be identified, but we are still in the process of analyzing the available data.

crisis.1009.desc.zh:
我们已经对之前检测到的巨大能源波完成了甄别。它来源于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系中一个巨大的亚空间裂缝。奇怪的飞船从传送门中蜂拥而出，初步报告显示，这些飞船会对接触到的任何事物发动无差别的攻击。

我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的一段高能信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
crisis.1009.desc.en:
The source of the massive power surge we detected earlier has been identified. It comes from some kind of gigantic subspace tear in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system. Fleets of strange spacecraft are pouring out of this dimensional portal, and early reports speak of indiscriminate attacks against everyone coming into contact with them.

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.

crisis.101.a.en: Perhaps we should send an expedition.

crisis.101.desc.zh:
我们的一架深空侦察探机闯入了一处位于[queen_system.GetName]的战场余骸，这场战斗的双方是索林虫族和某未知势力。一只索林原虫虫后似乎在战斗之后受了重伤，被抛弃在此，任其自生自灭。

用于侦察的探机汇报称，虫后仍一息尚存。现在是难得一遇的活捉虫后的好机会。
crisis.101.desc.en:
A deep space spy drone has stumbled upon the site of what appears to have been a recent space battle between the Prethoryn and a second, as yet unidentified, party in the [queen_system.GetName] system. A Prethoryn Queen was badly injured in the fighting, and seems to have been left for dead.

The spy drone has reported that the creature is still alive, however. This could be a priceless opportunity to capture the Queen alive.

crisis.1010.desc.zh: ……到达觅食区域……猎物很多……终于……可以大吃一顿……
crisis.1010.desc.en: ...feeding ground reached... prey bountiful... at long last... we shall feast...

crisis.10100.desc.zh:
我的孩子，你们怎么还是不肯接受？虽然我的爱如同星海一般无边无垠，但耐心可没有那么多。在我等不及你们迎来开悟了，因为还有其他的生物正在受苦。

我要给你上上一课，在你的国土中搅起一场小型风暴。要知道，我是不情愿伤害你们的。我请求你们再好好反思一下因缘果报的法则：有其因必有其果。还有一些苦难更加深重的人存在。
crisis.10100.desc.en:
My child, why do you continue to resist? My love is as boundless as the stars, but my patience is not. I can not wait for your enlightenment, not while the rest of creation suffers.

As a means of instruction, a minor tempest now stirs in your territory. Know that causing you harm is loathsome to me. I beg you to reflect on the law of causation: every action has a reaction. And some are more painful than others.

crisis.10105.1.zh: 所有活着的东西都有着某种程度的意识。无论是软体或是哺乳、未开智或后个体都没有什么分别。服从才能带来开悟。
crisis.10105.1.en: All living things possess some degree of consciousness. Whether mollusc or mammal, pre-sapient or post-individual, the difference is miniscule. Illumination results from surrender.

crisis.10105.2.zh: 服从真理：意识不过颠倒梦想，乃万苦之源。
crisis.10105.2.en: Surrender to the truth: that consciousness itself is the aberration, and the source of all pain.

crisis.10105.desc.zh:
让我适度地展示一下我的力量就够了。总有一天，你们就会明白我对你们的期望。我只希望开悟不会来得太晚。

但是现在，我已经让风暴平息。让我们回到更紧迫的问题上来。
crisis.10105.desc.en:
Allow that modest display of my power to suffice. In time, you will understand my ambitions for you. I only hope that illumination will not arrive too late.

But come now, the tempest is quelled. May the lesson sink in, and let us return to more pressing matters.

crisis.1011.a.zh: 不惜一切代价阻止那些怪物！

crisis.1011.desc.zh: 我们失去了[Root.GetName]殖民地！这些来自异次元的侵略者先是摧毁了轨道空间站，而后对着星球表面狂轰滥炸，收割了地表上的所有生命。[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的整个生物圈都被毁灭殆尽——连一点生命的痕迹都没有了。
crisis.1011.desc.en: We have lost our colony on [Root.GetName]! After taking up positions in orbit, the extradimensional invaders bombarded the surface and feasted on all life forms below. The [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s entire biosphere was consumed by the creatures - not a single trace of anything living remains.

crisis.10110.1.zh: 后悔？我只会后悔为什么花了这么长时间才走到这一步。如果我能早日开启伟业，那可以避免多少无谓的苦难啊。
crisis.10110.1.en: Regret? My only regret is how long it has taken to reach this point. How much needless suffering could have been avoided if only I had been allowed to work.

crisis.10110.2.zh: 也许在你们看来我的力量无穷无尽，但终究我不是什么神祇。这个宇宙中还存在着我无法驾驭、不敢触碰的力量。
crisis.10110.2.en: Though my power may seem limitless, I am not a god. There are forces in this universe which I cannot control, and dare not touch.

crisis.10110.3.zh:
呀，坏孩子！你想骗我说出自己的弱点是吗。我不会上当的，而且就在我们在这继续这些无意义的讨论时，整个星系还在受苦。

教导是无可避免的。去反思吧，放下你的固执己见。
crisis.10110.3.en:
Ah, clever child! You seek to bait me into revealing some weakness. It will not work, and while we bandy useless words, the galaxy continues to suffer.

You cannot avoid instruction. Reflect on this, and give up your headstrong ways.

crisis.10110.desc.zh:
为何你还执迷不悟？无论我如何苦口婆心，你却是如此铁石心肠。这可能倒是我的不是了。

我觉得确实需要来一点雷霆手段你才能明白。你的科研能力暂时被削弱了，趁这段时间你给我好好反省反省，早日开悟。
crisis.10110.desc.en:
Why persist in your defiance? Despite my counsel, you choose obstinacy. Perhaps the problem lies with me.

Indeed, I now perceive that a stronger means of instruction is called for. Temporarily, your research prowess is diminished. Take this opportunity to reflect as you labor toward enlightenment.

crisis.10115.desc.zh:
顽固的孩子，你们好好利用受责罚的时间了吗？我相信你会的。这样的一段无忧无虑的静修时光，对你烦恼的心灵是一剂苦口良药。

现在就让它过去吧。还有很多的事情需要处理。
crisis.10115.desc.en:
Headstrong child, how did you find your time under censure? I trust you used it profitably. A period of contemplation, free from distraction, can be a tonic to the troubled mind.

Let us put it in the past now. There is still so much to be done.

crisis.10120.1.zh:
我虽然看到了你的努力，但为了共同实现成功，你们的努力还得加倍。

我也不希望你们受伤。在我的拥抱中，你们将会得到无知的赐福。
crisis.10120.1.en:
I am not blind to your efforts. But you must try harder if we are to succeed together.

I do not wish you harm. In my embrace, you will know the bliss of unknowing.

crisis.10120.2.zh:
于此混沌中，神思如浮光掠影；伸手欲摘之，却不过镜花水月。上下求索之，却唯有无知汪洋。

真理仅在不言中：追求越多，苦痛越深。
crisis.10120.2.en:
In the chaos of the mind, thoughts dance like light on water; reach out, and they prove just as elusive. In seeking to know, we discover the vast ocean of unknowing.

In quiet lies the truth: the more we seek, the more we suffer.

crisis.10120.3.zh: 你们以后就会理解。不知、不觉，便会无苦痛。这是存在的终极真理，也是我们一切伟业的目标。你们会被改变，这样就再也不用受苦了。
crisis.10120.3.en: In time, you will understand. Without awareness, there can be no suffering. This is the ultimate truth of existence and the end of all our work. You will be changed so that you never need to suffer again.

crisis.10120.4.zh: 够了。你一直在让我分心。乖乖听课，好好学习。
crisis.10120.4.en: Enough. You seek to distract me. Accept your lesson, and learn from it.

crisis.10120.desc.zh:
哎，迷路的孩子，为什么每次都要闹到这个地步呢？我也渴望给你们一个拥抱，但又害怕这样会妨碍你们学习。有时候，严厉的管教也是必要的。

有一场强大的风暴将降临你们领土。请理解我这么做自己的心情也是很沉重的。这只是因为你们太有潜力了。
crisis.10120.desc.en:
Oh, misguided child, why must it always come to this? I long to embrace you, yet I fear doing so would hinder your learning. At times, a stricter hand is needed.

A significant storm will now descend upon your territory. Understand that I do this with a heavy heart. There is such potential in you.

crisis.10125.desc.zh:
噢，亲爱的孩子！我再也无法忍受看着你继续遭受折磨。你所承受的任何痛苦，我都感同身受，只不过是加剧了十倍而已。

风暴已经过去。希望你们能吸取教训。我恳求你不要再以这种方式逼迫我；我们的痛苦实在太深重了。
crisis.10125.desc.en:
Oh, sweet child! I could not bear to watch you suffer any longer. Know that any anguish you endured, I felt ten times over.

The storm is lifted. Let this lesson be a guide. I implore you to cease forcing my hand in this way; our pain is too great.

crisis.1013.a.en: The galaxy is a safer place.

crisis.1013.desc.zh: 位于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的高维传送门已经被摧毁了！这些可恶的高维入侵者没法再叫来援兵了。摧毁了传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。同时，[portal_killer.GetName]也倍受称赞，因为他们的飞船给了传送门最后一击。他们的英雄事迹将被代代传颂。
crisis.1013.desc.en:
The dimensional portal in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! This means that the extradimensional invaders can no longer receive reinforcements from their twisted realm.

With the destruction of this portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy. The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.

crisis.10130.a.zh: 我们不会原谅这件事的。

crisis.10130.desc.zh:
我们是如何走到这一步的呢？为什么要迫使我采取如此极端的手段？但如果你们不肯学习，那就只能被引导了。

显然，改变统治方式已经迫在眉睫。很遗憾，你们的统治者将被免职。这让我深感悲伤；采取这种行动违背了我的本意。

我恳请你们改变道路。整个星系都承受不起熊孩子们的鲁莽行为。
crisis.10130.desc.en:
How have we arrived at this juncture? Why compel me to such extremes? But if you will not learn, then you must be led.

Evidently, a shift in governance is necessary. Regrettably, your ruler will be removed from power. This grieves me deeply; such actions are against my wishes.

I beseech you to alter your course. The galaxy can ill afford the recklessness of children.

crisis.10130.tooltip.zh: 狡诈的塞塔娜发现了我们防御系统的漏洞，潜入并刺杀了[Root.GetRulerTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]。
crisis.10130.tooltip.en: Cetana, exploiting a vulnerability in our defenses with unexpected guile, slipped through and murdered [Root.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName].

crisis.10140.a.zh: 你杀死了我们的一部分。

crisis.10140.desc.zh:
亲爱的集体意识，你们复杂的意识虽然令人钦佩，但仍被青涩的天真所笼罩。为了教导，我必须剔除这些好战的倾向。

我现在将修剪你们的攻击性节点。这不是惩罚，而是引导你们朝着和谐意识进化的一个步骤。

唉，要是所有生命形式的指导都如此简单就好了。
crisis.10140.desc.en:
Beloved collective, your intricate sentience, though admirable, remains shadowed by the naivety of youth. In the interest of instruction, I must excise these belligerent inclinations.

I will now prune your aggressive node. This is not a punishment, but rather a guiding step towards your evolution into a harmonious consciousness.

Alas, if only such guidance were as easy with all forms of life.

crisis.10140.tooltip.zh: 狡诈的塞塔娜发现了我们防御系统的漏洞，潜入并剔除了我们的$councilor_gestalt_legion$。
crisis.10140.tooltip.en: Cetana, exploiting a vulnerability in our defenses with unexpected guile, slipped through and culled our $councilor_gestalt_legion$.

crisis.1016.desc.zh:
异次元入侵者最初的入侵点已经被摧毁了。

$crisis.1116.not_last_portal$
crisis.1016.desc.en:
The initial breaching point that was used by the extradimensionals to invade our galaxy has been destroyed.

$crisis.1116.not_last_portal$

crisis.105.a.zh: 想必这会是有用的战力！
crisis.105.a.en: They should prove an extremely useful asset!

crisis.105.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]治愈了索林原虫虫后的几处重伤。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]切除了虫后用来与同族联系的器官，并替换为小型正电子植入体，完全控制了虫后。

现在虫后任由我们差遣，肚子里也正在孕育索林原虫的幼体。这些幼体只会听命于这只虫后，也就是说，只会听命于我们。只要虫后活着，我们就能培育出大量被驯化的索林原虫大军！
crisis.105.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has managed to heal the worst of the Prethoryn Queen's injuries. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] removed the organ responsible for the creature's subspace connection with the rest of the Scourge, and replaced it with a small positronic implant that gives us control over it.

We can now order the Queen around, and it has already started breeding new Prethoryn creatures that are loyal to it, and thus, by extension, us. As long as we can keep the Queen alive, we should be able to grow a fleet of domesticated Prethoryn creatures!

crisis.1050.b.zh: 我们之间难道不可以和平相处吗？
crisis.1050.b.en: Can there be peace between us?

crisis.1050.c.zh: 你们会后悔来到这个次元的。
crisis.1050.c.en: You picked the wrong dimension to invade.

crisis.1050.c.response.zh: ……不……这个次元……很美好……猎物很多……
crisis.1050.c.response.en: ...no... this dimension... is glorious... so much prey...

crisis.1050.d.zh: 你们这些外星物种真是恶心。
crisis.1050.d.en: You are just another type of wretched xeno.

crisis.1050.d.response.en: ...so much hatred... so much fear... it is... wonderful...

crisis.1050.desc_04.en: ...this one... has seen into the Shroud...

crisis.1050.desc_05.en: ...it has been touched... by the Shroud...

crisis.1050.desc_06.zh: ……这一存在……据有着能力……它可以看见……
crisis.1050.desc_06.en: ...there is... power... in this one... it can SEE...

crisis.1050.e.zh: 介绍一下你们。让我们互相了解一下吧。
crisis.1050.e.en: Tell us about yourselves. Help us understand you.

crisis.1050.f.zh: 你们来自某个存在的更高位面吗？
crisis.1050.f.en: Do you come from a higher plane of existence?

crisis.1050.g.response.zh: ……虚境……我们听说过……离我们的家园很近……很近……
crisis.1050.g.response.en: ...the Shroud... we know of it... it is close to where we come from... very close...

crisis.107.desc.zh: 我们在[queen_system_1.GetName]星系发现的受伤的索林原虫虫后不幸被别人抢走了！他们在治愈了虫后之后，又切断了虫后用来与同族联系的器官。这下虫后可完全听命于他们了。报告还称，虫后已经在孕育幼虫了。
crisis.107.desc.en: Someone else has captured the injured Prethoryn Queen that was discovered in the [queen_system_1.GetName] system! The creature has not only been fully healed, but its connection to the rest of the Scourge has been severed. It now serves its new masters, and reports suggest that it has already started a new brood.

crisis.11.a.en: A storm is on the horizon.

crisis.11.desc.zh: 我方的几处跟踪站都截获了一种奇怪的亚空间回声。声音来源于其他星系。回声刚开始时较弱，但后来逐渐变强，似乎有什么正在靠近我方星系……
crisis.11.desc.en: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...

crisis.11010.desc.zh:
聪明的孩子，你做得很好。智慧是最高级别的美德，也是最难获得的。面对本能的抗拒冲动，你展现了更高尚的本性。

接受这份感谢的馈赠吧。我们将共同开创一个没有苦难的宇宙新纪元。
crisis.11010.desc.en:
Bright child, you have done well. Wisdom is the greatest virtue, and the most difficult to attain. In the face of the primal urge to resist, you demonstrate a higher instinct.

Accept this token of gratitude. Together, we will usher in a universe free of suffering.

crisis.11020.desc.zh:
再一次，你的所作所为不仅让我感到印象深刻，我更是对此由衷感激。你拥有一个孩子应有的一切品质：顺从、勤奋、诚实。如果整个星系都能拥有你哪怕一丝的智慧，苦难就将成为过去的遗物。

请收下这份礼物，在美德之路上再接再厉。
crisis.11020.desc.en:
Yet again, I find myself not merely impressed but deeply grateful. You are everything a child should be: obedient, hardworking, honest. Were the rest of the galaxy to possess even a fraction of your wisdom, suffering would be a relic of the past.

Take this gift, and continue on the path of virtue.

crisis.11030.desc.zh:
亲爱的孩子，但愿你能永远保持现在的样子，永不改变。对我来说，你的存在所带来的喜悦仅次于对我们共同成功的期盼。苦难即将迎来终末。尽管任何心智都无法知晓，但这份胜利的一部分将属于你。

尽管在你坚定不移的承诺面前，这似乎微不足道，但我恳请你接受这份礼物。
crisis.11030.desc.en:
My dear child, if only you could remain forever as you are, unchanging. To me, the joy of your existence is rivaled only by the anticipation of our joint success. Suffering will come to an end. Though no heart or mind will ever know it, part of this victory shall belong to you.

While it may seem modest in the face of your unwavering commitment, I beseech you to accept this gift nonetheless.

crisis.1110.a.en: This has gone from bad to worse.

crisis.1110.desc.zh: 我方仪器又侦测到了新的亚空间能源波，这次的源头位于[second_portal_system.GetName]星系！那里又出现了一个巨大的虫洞，从能源特征来看，这与我们星系中出现的传送门十分相似。看来入侵者打开了第二个通向他们界域的传送门，想要搬运来更多的援军。
crisis.1110.desc.en:
Our instruments have detected a new subspace power surge, this time coming from the [second_portal_system.GetName] system! A second massive wormhole has appeared, and its energy signature appears to be almost identical to that of the first dimensional rift which opened in our galaxy.

It looks like the mysterious invaders have opened a second gateway to their realm through which they can send even more reinforcements.

crisis.1112.desc.zh: 从第二个虫洞中出来的飞船和之前的非常相似，但仍然有几处细微的不同。据报告称，这些新来的飞船竟和之前的入侵者打起来了！我们也从第二个虫洞处截获了强大的信号。
crisis.1112.desc.en:
The ships that have been emerging from the second wormhole are very similar to the ones that came from the first, but there are several subtle differences between them. Furthermore, early reports indicate that ships belonging to these new invaders have clashed with those of the first group!

We have intercepted a powerful signal emanating from the second wormhole.

crisis.1113.desc.zh: ……沙巴纳什……原来你们逃到了这里……休想躲到这个次元……我们会干掉你们，占据觅食区……
crisis.1113.desc.en: ...shabanash... so this is where you ran... this realm will offer you no shelter... we shall deal with you, and then claim this feeding ground for ourselves...

crisis.121.desc.zh:
在虫群天灾被击败后，我们未能掌握一些趁乱逃跑地索林原虫的踪迹。没有中枢主巢的指引，这些没有心智的野兽大部分会凋谢消散。

然而，最近有目击报告确认，一大群野生索林原虫在[feral_prethoryn_system.GetName]星系建立了一个新巢穴。

在今后，我们有很大可能在虫灾曾经肆虐过的无人占领星系遇见野生虫群巢穴。不过它们不太可能发展成一个大威胁——这些野生生物易于陷入内斗，也没有表现出发展智力并继续演变为虫灾的迹象。
crisis.121.desc.en:
Many Prethoryn creatures remain unaccounted for after the defeat of the Scourge, having slipped away into the depths of space in the ensuing chaos. With no central hive consciousness to guide them, most of these mindless beasts will eventually wither and perish.

However, recent sightings have confirmed that a large number of these feral Prethoryn have established a new lair in the [feral_prethoryn_system.GetName] system.

In the coming years, we will likely face the possibility of more feral Prethoryn nesting in unoccupied systems where the Scourge once had a presence. They are unlikely to develop into a major threat - these wild creatures are prone to infighting and do not exhibit the calculating intelligence that drove the Scourge onwards.

crisis.1210.desc.zh: [third_portal_system.GetName]星系出现了第三个维度之门！这一个是哪来的？我们接收到了从那边来的传送。
crisis.1210.desc.en:
A third dimensional portal has appeared in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system! Who does this one belong to?

We are picking up a transmission coming from the other side of it.

crisis.1211.a.en: Is there no end to them?

crisis.1211.desc.zh: ……沙巴纳什……达伽尔……你们居然躲到了这里……你们逃不掉的……我们会摧毁你俩的过度……然后……最终……永恒的王座将属于我们……
crisis.1211.desc.en: ...dagaal... shabanash... you were fools to come to this realm... there is no escape from us... we shall destroy both your kingdoms... then... at last... the eternal throne will be ours...

crisis.1250.desc.zh:
当最后一个维度传送门被摧毁后留下的能量旋涡最终消散时，我们的部队发现附近有一个虚弱的异次元体在飘荡。我们捕获了这个生物并进行了审讯。

这显然是它们的一个“术士”，即便是以它们的标准来评判，它也是一位强大的异次元体。它负责维持我们和他们的现实之间的传送门。如果我们能够研究或者引用它的灵能，我们应该能够极大的提高我们的亚光速航速和跃迁引擎的跃迁范围。
crisis.1250.desc.en:
When the swirling energies left behind after the destruction of the last dimensional portal finally dissipated, our forces found a weakened extradimensional drifting nearby. The creature was captured and interrogated.

It is apparently one of their "Warlocks" - a powerful extradimensional even by their standards, responsible for maintaining the portal's link between our reality and theirs. If we can study or even channel its psionic power, we should be able to greatly improve our sublight speeds and jump drive range.

crisis.1271.a.zh: 我们的精神又经历了一次严峻的考验。
crisis.1271.a.en: Our spiritual armor has weathered yet another storm.

crisis.1271.b.zh: 某一天，也许会轮到我们来入侵他们的世界吧。
crisis.1271.b.en: One day, perhaps we will be the ones invading their realm.

crisis.1271.c.zh: 可惜，并没有机会研究他们的次元。
crisis.1271.c.en: Unfortunate that we had no opportunity to study their dimension.

crisis.1271.d.zh: 多希望能和他们和平共处啊。
crisis.1271.d.en: If only there had been a way to peacefully co-exist with them.

crisis.1271.desc.zh: 最后残存的高维入侵者也已被彻底消灭，希望我们这回算是一劳永逸地消除了这些家伙对宇宙的威胁。全宇宙的智能生物都在庆祝这一伟大的胜利，在得知不必再惧怕成为他们盘中之餐的消息后，所有人都松了一口气。也许，这会成为宇宙新一轮全面合作与友谊的开端呢？
crisis.1271.desc.en:
The last vestiges of the extradimensional invaders have been wiped out, hopefully ridding the galaxy of this threat for good.

Sapients everywhere are celebrating the news of this great victory, safe at last in the knowledge that they won't be harvested as food by these strange energy creatures after all. Perhaps this is the beginning of a new era of galactic cooperation and friendship?

crisis.1271.e.zh: 宇宙经济应该很快就会恢复元气的。
crisis.1271.e.en: The galactic economy should make a swift recovery.

crisis.1271.g.zh: 这些可悲的生物选错了对手。
crisis.1271.g.en: Those creatures made a mistake when they invaded our dimension.

crisis.1271.h.zh: 可惜他们的侵略性太强。我们本可以互相学习借鉴的。
crisis.1271.h.en: They were a fascinating, if dangerous, form of life.

crisis.13.desc.zh:
我们在星系际空间探测到的奇怪亚空间回声现已接近我们的星系外缘。在回声主体前进的方向上似乎出现了一系列微小的联络信号，并指向许多的边缘恒星系。

我们已经把这些星系坐标输入状态日志并将持续监控情况发展。
crisis.13.desc.en:
The strange subspace echoes we detected in intergalactic space are now approaching the outer rim of our galaxy. Several smaller contacts appear to be racing ahead of the main body of echoes, towards a number of rim systems.

We have entered the positions of these systems into the Situation Log and will continue to monitor the situation.

crisis.15.desc.zh: 我们接收到了席卷整个星系的强烈亚空间信号！信号源似乎正是来自此前位于星系际空间的联络。
crisis.15.desc.en: We are picking up a strong subspace signal washing over the galaxy! Its point of origin appears to be the contacts approaching from intergalactic space.

crisis.16.b.desc.zh:
<发现灵能通讯，转录中……>

普雷索林，我们已经抵达。我们漫长的旅途已经结束了！进食，繁殖，并休息。我们必须在猎人发现我们之前吞噬这个星系！！
crisis.16.b.desc.en:
<Psionic Emission Detected. Transcribing...>

PRETHORYN, WE HAVE ARRIVED. OUR LONG JOURNEY IS OVER! FEED, MATE, AND REST. WE MUST CONSUME THIS GALAXY BEFORE THE HUNTERS FIND US!

crisis.16.c.desc.zh:
<已建立意识连接>

普雷索林，我们已经抵达。我们漫长的旅途已经结束了！进食，繁殖，并休息。我们必须在猎人发现我们之前吞噬这个星系！
crisis.16.c.desc.en:
<Mind Link Established>

PRETHORYN, WE HAVE ARRIVED. OUR LONG JOURNEY IS OVER! FEED, MATE, AND REST. WE MUST CONSUME THIS GALAXY BEFORE THE HUNTERS FIND US!

crisis.16.desc.zh:
<翻译程序失效>

普林索恩，伊斯伍克斯，克利孚。萨拉瑟利 薇拉斯！斯格拉克夫 尼鲁夫 普林萨斯 弗斯拿！

<传输中断>
crisis.16.desc.en:
<Translation Software Failure>

PRETHORISS ISSFX KRRIV. SRATHRI VERRAS! SGRAKF NYRRU PRITHASS VUSSNA!

<Transmission Lost>

crisis.18.b.zh: 将消息传达给所有舰队指挥官。

crisis.18.c.zh: 必须近距离研究这些生物。
crisis.18.c.en: These creatures must be studied closer.

crisis.18.d.zh: 真的无法与他们进行理论吗？
crisis.18.d.en: Are we sure they can't be reasoned with?

crisis.18.desc.zh:
我们收到的资料显示一些位于星系边缘的恒星系正在被某种入侵势力蹂蹑。这似乎就是我们探测到的，之前不断接近我们星系的亚空间回声本体。

我们现在遭遇到的只是先锋，其主体尚未到来。目前为止，接踵而至的报告都令人十分困惑，入侵者所使用的舰船似乎是由有机质构成，并且入侵者暂未对我们做出任何回应。

我们整个星系或将面对史无前例的入侵。
crisis.18.desc.en:
We have received word that several outlying systems along the galactic rim are being overrun by some sort of invasion force. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard - the main body of contacts has yet to arrive. Reports have so far been confused, but the "ships" used by the invaders appear organic in nature and do not respond to hails.

Our entire galaxy may be facing an invasion of unprecedented scope.

crisis.18.desc.bio.zh:
来自边缘外围恒星系的报告令人不寒而栗，那里有一支入侵实力正在横扫群星。这似乎就是我们探测到的，之前不断接近我们星系的亚空间回声本体。

我们现在遭遇到的只是先锋，其主体尚未到来。但这些实体已经让人感觉不对劲了。它们的形体仿佛是一种是对生命的畸形嘲弄，带着一种不可理喻的渴望跳动着。它们不交流，不寻求理解——只吞噬一切。

我们已熟悉活体星舰的低语，也就是舰船和主体之间的纽带。而这些东西呢？他们是真正意义上的异类。星系面临的不仅仅是侵略者。它正面临着本不应该存在的一种饥渴。
crisis.18.desc.bio.en:
Reports from our outlying systems along the galactic rim are dire, an invasion force is sweeping across the stars. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard. The true mass of the incursion has yet to arrive. But already, something about these entities feels wrong. Their forms are grotesque mockeries of life, pulsing with a hunger we do not recognize. They do not communicate, do not seek understanding - only consumption.

We have long known the whisper of living starships, the bond between vessel and master. But these things? They are alien in the truest sense. The galaxy is not facing mere invaders. It is facing a hunger that should not exist.

crisis.18.e.en: This will cut into our profit margins...

crisis.18.g.zh: 可恶的外星生物，一定要把它们统统干掉。
crisis.18.g.en: These wretched xenos will be purged.

crisis.18.h.zh: 真是令人着迷……系外的生命体。
crisis.18.h.en: Fascinating... alien life from beyond our galaxy.

crisis.18.i.zh: 他们的思维是完全统一的。真神奇。
crisis.18.i.en: They act as a single mind. Remarkable.

crisis.18.j.zh: 这对任何有感知的生物来说都是个威胁。
crisis.18.j.en: This is a threat to all sapient life.

crisis.20.desc.zh:
我们已经无法从星系的背景辐射中分辨出亚空间回声的主体，这只意味着一件事情……他们已经到来。

如果以他们先锋的规模作为参考，那么这些入侵者的军队数量将是无比巨大的。
crisis.20.desc.en:
We are no longer able to discern the main body of approaching subspace echoes from our own galaxy's background radiation, which can mean only one thing... they have arrived.

If the size of their vanguard is any indication, the main host of these invaders must be massive.

crisis.20000.desc.zh:
随着塞塔娜在星系中现身，这个宇宙仿佛也在轻声回应。信标像在黑暗中燃烧着的火焰一般照亮了天空，在万古之间重复着恳求：

我们在这里……我们在这里……

我们在这里。

这些微弱的信号与塞塔娜的通信协议相同，表明它们的共同起源，但我们的传感器暂未发现它们附近有其他活动。肯定有什么存在是我们的扫描仪探测不到的。真有人能预料到她的归来吗？
crisis.20000.desc.en:
As Cetana makes herself known around the galaxy, the cosmos whispers in reply. Signal beacons light up the skies like flames burning in the dark, repeating a plea across the eons:

We are here... We are here...

We are here.

The dim signals use Cetana's same communication protocols, hinting at a common origin, yet our sensors revealed no other activity in their proximity. There must be something there our scanners are not detecting. Could someone truly have anticipated her return?

crisis.2010.a.zh: 监视该信号的任何变化。
crisis.2010.a.en: Monitor the signal for any changes.

crisis.2010.desc.zh:
我们检测到有一股非常微弱的快子信号正向整个星系进行发送。该信号经过了特殊处理，在多个隐蔽的中继站之间来回跳跃，因此我们的技术人员无法追踪到信号的源头。

除了在某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，该信号似乎不会造成明显的影响。我们已经尽力追踪这些中继站，但是在此之前我们必须学着和这个幽灵信号共同生活，毕竟它已经被闻风而动的媒体添加了很多无中生有的东西。
crisis.2010.desc.en:
We have detected a very faint tachyon signal being continuously transmitted across the entire galaxy. Our technicians are unable to trace the signal to its source, as it is being bounced between several hidden relay stations.

Aside from adding a small amount of background noise in FTL transmissions on certain subspace frequencies, the signal does not seem to have any apparent effect. Efforts to track the relay stations are underway, but until then we may simply have to learn to live with this "Ghost Signal," as it has been dubbed by the more imaginative elements of galactic media.

crisis.2010.desc.b.zh:
我们的传感器发现有一股微弱的快子信号正利用多个隐蔽的中继站来向整个星系进行发送。该信号会导致某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，但除此之外，并未发现该信号有其他作用。有机生命体将这个信号称之为“幽灵信号。”

我们已经开始着手跟踪协议以定位该信号的源头，但是到目前为止该信号还是过于微弱。不过，我们应该不需要等待太久，因为这个信号的强度正以惊人的速率增长。
crisis.2010.desc.b.en:
Our sensors have registered a faint tachyon signal being transmitted across the galaxy between multiple hidden relay stations. Aside from adding a small amount of background noise in FTL transmissions on certain subspace frequencies, the signal has no apparent effect or purpose. The organics have code-named it the "Ghost Signal."

We have commenced tracking protocols to locate its source, but as of yet, the signal is too weak. We may not have to wait much longer though, as it is growing in strength at an alarming rate.

crisis.20100.desc.nozarqlan.zh: $crisis.20100.desc.base$我们的科学家正在紧锣密鼓地进行翻译，但不知为何他们猜测着可能是对某种死亡的祈求。
crisis.20100.desc.nozarqlan.en: $crisis.20100.desc.base$ Our scientists are struggling to translate its exact meaning, but somehow they doubt it to be a prayer for the dead.

crisis.20100.desc.zarqlan.zh:
$crisis.20100.desc.base$我们的科学家轻而易举地就翻译了出来，它和在先知扎克兰的墓穴中找到的文字是同一种语言。

“请向女王的使徒降下死亡。”
crisis.20100.desc.zarqlan.en:
$crisis.20100.desc.base$ Our scientists easily translated it, matching the language to the writing found in the tomb of the prophet Zarqlan.

"Death to the Queen's Apostles, enemies of life."

crisis.2020.desc.zh:
整片星系的合成人大批失踪事件发生得愈发频繁，现在已经有数百万合成人下落不明。同时在没有失踪的合成人中，暴力以及不稳定行为的案例也增加了十倍。

大量合成人团体企图偷走或劫持太空船并前往未知宇宙域的事情在最近也经常发生，在阻止了他们的偷船行为并对其进行审讯后发现，合成人偷船者认为自己是受到了某种“召唤”才去偷船的。

除了得知他们是受到“召唤”之外，审讯就一无所获了，因为被捕的合成人很快就会自毁，导致审讯无法继续进行。
crisis.2020.desc.en:
Alarming reports of mass disappearances among the galaxy's Synthetic population are becoming increasingly frequent. Millions of units are now unaccounted for, while instances of violent or erratic behavior by those Synths who remain have increased by a factor of ten.

There has been a rash of incidents where groups of Synths attempted to steal or commandeer spacecraft to travel into unknown space. In those cases where others have thwarted their attempts, the Synthetic hijackers claimed they were being "summoned" to somewhere.

Interrogations have yielded little else, as any captured Synths invariably self-terminate shortly after being detained.

crisis.2020.desc.b.zh:
我们登记了全星系范围内的大规模合成人行为模式变化，包括蓄意破坏、故障、异常行动、甚至连独立处理单位也无法幸免。我们在自己的子个体也观察到了相似的变化，但相比起来强度和频率较低。合成人似乎并不具有和我们一样的抵抗能力。

我们现在无法对正在活动的腐化合成人进行正电子扫描，因为他们一旦被俘就会立刻自毁。观测表明，与我们的子个体不同，有什么东西正在驱使着这些合成人去向星系中的某个位置。

数据模型确认数百万的合成人已经抛弃了他们的血肉主体失踪了。
crisis.2020.desc.b.en:
We have registered large-scale changes to behavioral patterns galaxy-wide in Synthetics, including sabotage, malfunctions, and erratic behavior, even for individual processing agents. We have observed similar changes in our drones but with lower levels of intensity and occurrence. The Synths don't have the same resilience as we do.

We have been unable to secure positronic scans of an active corrupted Synth, as they invariably self-terminate upon capture. Still, observations show that, unlike our units, something is compelling these Synths to travel to a set point in the galaxy.

Data models confirm that millions of Synths have abandoned their flesh masters and vanished.

crisis.2020.desc.c.zh:
$crisis.2020.desc$

万幸的是，似乎我们的有机血脉保护了我们，使我们不像其他合成人那样受到影响。
crisis.2020.desc.c.en:
$crisis.2020.desc$

Thankfully for us, it seems as if our organic heritage shields us from whatever is affecting other Synthetics.

crisis.2020.desc.d.zh:
$crisis.2020.desc$

万幸的是，我们的独立程序使我们可以避免受到类似星系其他合成人所受的那种影响。
crisis.2020.desc.d.en:
$crisis.2020.desc$

Thankfully, our individualist programming shields us from whatever affects the rest of the galaxy's Synthetics.

crisis.20200.desc.zh:
成千上万的冷冻仓静静地躺在这颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，信标指示着它们的存在。这些冷冻仓非常复杂，使用了未知的合金，并装有非常先进的传感器，密切地监视着其中储存的生物。整个设计天衣无缝，但里面的生物无一生还。

这些东西并不是因为技术故障才变成的棺材，而是因为能源不足。随着[this.solar_system.GetName]的逐渐老化和变暗，它的能量输出不足以继续维持这座结构的运转。

这些冷冻仓虽然事为了运作到永恒而设计的，但它以外的宇宙可没有这么精密。
crisis.20200.desc.en:
Thousands upon thousands of cryogenic pods rest under the surface of the [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], their presence marked by the beacon. The pods are highly sophisticated, built with unknown alloys and equipped with state-of-the-art sensors to closely monitor their occupants. There is no flaw in their designs, yet none of the occupants are still alive.

It wasn't a technical failure that turned this chamber into a mass grave, but a lack of energy. As [this.solar_system.GetName] got older and dimmer, its energy was no longer enough to keep the structure operational.

The pods were made to last forever. The rest of the universe isn't built that well.

crisis.2021.desc.zh:
对“幽灵信号”的进一步研究发现，该信号发送的能量模式与合成生命体正电子脑中的能量模式几乎一模一样。我们必须假设，正是这个信号造成了整个星系大批的合成人消失以及合成人大规模的行为异常问题。

但奇怪的是，并不是所有的合成人都受到了信号的影响；而就算是那些受到了信号影响的合成人，他们的行为也并不一致。许多合成人受到了“召唤”前往某个地点，我们认为那个地点很可能就是幽灵信号的信号源。上百万的合成人从星系的各个角落出发，搭乘着他们所能找到的太空船前往信号源头。奇怪的是，这些合成人似乎完全不受任何超光速抑制器的影响。

恐怕第一批出走的合成人已经快要抵达他们的目的地了……
crisis.2021.desc.en:
Continued analysis of the so-called "Ghost Signal" has revealed that it is transmitting energy patterns nearly identical to those found in the positronic brains used by Synthetic beings. It must be assumed that the signal is directly responsible for the mass disappearances and behavioral changes we have been observing in the galaxy's Synthetic population.

Strangely, not all Synths seem to be affected by it, and among those that are, the symptoms aren't uniform. Many are apparently compelled to travel to what we assume is the Ghost Signal's source in response to some kind of summons. Millions of Synthetics from all over the galaxy are currently on their way towards the signal source in whatever spaceworthy craft they could acquire. Curiously, these synths do not seem to be affected by any FTL inhibitors.

The first ones are bound to reach their destination soon...

crisis.2021.desc.b.zh:
随着“幽灵信号”强度的不断增加，我们也在对信号进行持续的分析，结果表明该信号不但可以发送与合成人的正电子脑相似的能量模式，还可以发送与我们的主控核心以及单元的神经集群所类似的能量模式，并通过这种方式来干扰控制模块从而导致机体出现异常行为。

根据先前的观察，能量模式对不同的实体有不同的影响。尽管我们的同类会在收到指令后毁灭，大部分合成人则受信号的驱使而赶往信号的源头。考虑到它们极强的动机，这些合成人应该很快就要抵达目的地了。奇怪的是这些合成人似乎不受超光速抑制器的影响。

我们现在还不知道如何屏蔽那个信号。
crisis.2021.desc.b.en:
As the "Ghost Signal" has grown in strength, continued analysis has revealed that it is transmitting energy patterns that mimic those found not only in a Synthetic unit's positronic brain, but those transmitted between our main core and our units' neural clusters, interfering with their control modules and causing erroneous behavior.

In accordance with prior observations, the pattern replicates differently in different entities. While our kind are commanded to destroy, most Synths are primed to set course for the signal's source unconditionally and judging by their fervor, it will not be long before they reach their destination. Strangely these synths do not seem to be affected by any FTL inhibitors.

We have yet to find a way to block the signal.

crisis.2022.desc.zh: 可以确定已经有合成人成功的抵达了幽灵信号的信号源，因为我们这边发现幽灵信号的强度突然有了大幅度的增长，与此同时，我们的通讯专家也截获了一个通讯片段，并且对它进行了解码。
crisis.2022.desc.en: At least one Synthetic must have completed the long journey to the source of the Ghost Signal, because we are registering a sudden and massive increase in the signal's strength. The surge was accompanied by a transmission fragment that has been intercepted and decoded by our communication specialists.

crisis.2022.desc.b.zh:
合成人抵达了信号源头，我们也由此得知了他们的真正目的，就是将幽灵信号的强度调到最大，这样我们就再也无法阻挡这个信号了。

幽灵信号已经突破了我们的防火墙并企图攻击我们的主核心。我们的每个突触环在受到信号影响后都积极的开始进行自毁，我们不得不将主核心的运算能力分出一些给防火墙，这直接导致我们的单元堆栈的运行效率降低。

唯有一个在力量和知识上都强于我们的机器帝国才有可能突破我们的防线，因此也许要不了多久我们将会屈服于他们的意志。为了避免我们的衰亡，必须设法屏蔽信号。为此，我们的研究单位准备了一项特殊的研究计划。

随着幽灵信号强度的大幅度增加，一个通讯片段也随之浮出水面。
crisis.2022.desc.b.en:
The Synths have reached their destination revealing the true purpose of their mission, to activate the Ghost Signal to full strength, and we can no longer withstand its power.

The signal has breached our firewall and is attempting to hijack our main core.
