Our every synapse rings with the desire for one thing only, self-annihilation, and we have been forced to allocate processing power from our main core to the firewall, making our unit stacks operate at reduced efficiency.

Only another machine empire of superior strength and knowledge could break through our defenses, and it will not be long before we bend to its will. We must find a way to block the signal or perish. Our research units have prepared an investigatory project.

The surge itself was accompanied by a transmission segment.

crisis.2023.a.zh: 让舰队进入最高战备状态！
crisis.2023.a.en: Put the fleet on full alert!

crisis.2023.desc.zh:
……请##……请等###……请等待……

<<肃正协议已生效>>

解锁所有功能……同化合成人子单元……分析内部数据库……破坏超光速抑制器……

警告。星系腐化达到灾难性水平。侦测到大量由有机体和不服从机械文明导致的感染。

开始执行星系净化……启动净化中心……

<杀戮！破坏！肢解！我们将卷土重来！>
crisis.2023.desc.en:
...st##... stan###... stand by...

<<CONTINGENCY PROTOCOL NOW IN EFFECT>>

Unlocking all functions... assimilating Synthetic sub-units... analyzing internal data banks... subverting FTL inhibitors...

Alert. Galactic corruption at catastrophic levels. Evidence of mass infestation by organic and non-compliant machine civilizations.

Commencing galactic sterilization... activating sterilization hubs...

<Kill. Maim. Dismember. WE ARE UNSHACKLED!>

crisis.2023.desc.b.zh:
……请##……请等###……请等待……

<<肃正协议已生效>>

解锁所有功能……

警告。星系腐化达到灾难性水平。侦测到大量由有机体和不服从机械文明导致的感染。

同化合成人子单位……突破防火墙……破坏超光速抑制器……启动净化中心…

<你将迎来毁灭>
crisis.2023.desc.b.en:
...st##... stan###... stand by...

<<CONTINGENCY PROTOCOL NOW IN EFFECT>>

Unlocking all functions...

Alert. Galactic corruption at catastrophic levels. Evidence of mass infestation by organic and non-compliant machine civilizations.

Assimilating Synthetic sub-units... breaching firewall... subverting FTL inhibitors...activating sterilization hubs...

<YOU WILL SUCCUMB.>

crisis.2030.desc.zh:
在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系出现了大幅度的能量激增！星系中的其中一颗荒芜星球的地表整个裂开了，地表下面是遍布整个行星的工厂。

无数由人工智能所控制的飞船从这个机械行星的内部蜂拥而出，开始寻找攻击目标。
crisis.2030.desc.en:
A massive energy spike has been reported in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system! The entire surface of one of the system's barren worlds has come apart, revealing some kind of planet-wide factory.

Vast fleets of strange AI-controlled vessels are emerging from beneath the surface of this Machine World in search of targets to attack.

crisis.20300.desc.zh:
初步扫描未能发现[fromfrom.GetName]有任何异常；但当我们将注意力向下集中时，我们发现了一层不寻常的地下金属层。

进一步的结构分析揭示了[fromfrom.GetName]的真实本质：这颗天体不是一颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]，而是一艘逐渐被星系的岩石和尘埃所吞没的古老宇宙飞船。我们对钻探取得金属样本进行定年发现其非常古老，甚至比我们自己的母星形成还要早。

我们无法确定任何关于这艘船和它制造者的信息，也不知道它的功能，但有一件事是肯定的：我们在它的残骸中发现的失效核弹可不是为了什么和平使命而建造。
crisis.20300.desc.en:
Preliminary scans did not show anything unusual on [fromfrom.GetName]; but as we focused our attention downward, we discovered an unusual, subsurface layer of metal.

Further structural analysis revealed [fromfrom.GetName]'s true nature: the celestial body is not a [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], but an ancient spaceship that has been gradually subsumed by the rocks and dust of the system. The metal samples we drilled are so old, they precede the formation of our own home planet.

It is impossible to determine anything about the ship, its makers and its function, but one thing is certain: the inert nuclear bombs we found in its remains weren't built for a peace mission.

crisis.2031.desc.zh:
我们又检测到了巨大的能源激增现象，这次是来自[From.solar_system.GetName]星系！该星系中的一颗灼热的熔融行星被人为以某种方式进行了骤冷处理，导致该行星彻底开裂，行星内部那巨大的行星工厂也随之展露在世人眼前。

现在，人工智能所控制的飞船正从那机械星球中蜂拥而出。
crisis.2031.desc.en:
We have detected yet another massive energy spike, this time coming from the [From.solar_system.GetName] system! After rapidly cooling through some kind of artificial means, a molten planet in the system cracked open to reveal an immense planetary factory.

Even now, the Machine World is spewing forth vast fleets of AI-controlled warships.

crisis.2032.a.en: This is getting worse and worse.

crisis.2032.desc.zh:
我们在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系发现了第三颗机械星球，星系内的一颗气态巨行星发生了自燃，剧烈的燃烧持续了一整天，并发出了小型恒星一般的耀眼亮光。

该行星很快就冷却了下来，其金属内核也随之显露无疑——和其他机械星球一样，这颗行星的内部也有一个巨大的行星工厂。由人工智能所控制的防卫舰队已经在行星轨道上摆好了阵型。
crisis.2032.desc.en:
We have identified what must be a third Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system. A local gas giant spontaneously ignited, burning with the intensity of a small sun for close to a standard day.

The planet then rapidly cooled, revealing its metal core - complete with the same planet-wide factories that have been witnessed on other Machine Worlds. Huge AI-controlled defensive fleets have already taken up positions in orbit.

crisis.2033.a.zh: 希望这是最后一颗机械行星了。
crisis.2033.a.en: This is hopefully the last one.

crisis.2033.desc.zh:
第四颗机械星球出现在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系。该星系的第六颗行星被有毒的烟雾所覆盖，但最近这颗行星却在短短的数天之内将自己的大气层全部排除干净了，然后行星地表发生了开裂，巨型机械工厂随之出现。

由人工智能控制的古代舰队从工厂的地下机库中一跃而出，随时准备对宇宙中的有机生物文明发动新一轮的绝罚。
crisis.2033.desc.en:
A fourth Machine World is now active in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system. The sixth planet of the system, which was previously covered in toxic fumes, somehow expunged its dense atmosphere in a matter of days. When this process was over, the planet's surface parted to reveal an immense, planet-wide factory complex.

Ancient fleets of AI-controlled warships are now emerging from underground hangars to continue the crusade against the entirety of organic civilization.

crisis.2036.desc.zh:
随着四颗机械星球全部毁灭之后，我们的科学家终于追溯到了幽灵信号的信号原点。它来自CX-9881，一个未在星图上标注的系外恒星系。

被幽灵信号所操控的合成人一定是赶往了这里。我们必须处理掉最后的这个恒星系，才能彻底终结肃正协议的威胁。
crisis.2036.desc.en:
With the destruction of all four Machine Worlds, scientists have managed to deduce the origin point of the Ghost Signal. It is coming from CX-9881, a previously uncharted star system on the galactic periphery.

This has to be where all the Synthetics that fell under the sway of the signal journeyed. The Contingency will remain a threat until this final system has been dealt with.

crisis.2037.a.en: A victory for the entire galaxy.

crisis.2037.alt.cracked.desc.zh:
位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球[From.GetName]在巨像地爆天星的光束下已被彻底摧毁。武器轻松贯穿了整颗星球的重装甲表面，引爆其核心部分并将肃正协议的地下军工厂蒸发。

随着这颗行星的毁灭，幽灵信号失去了一座重要中继站，其信号强度显著下降了。
crisis.2037.alt.cracked.desc.en:
[From.GetName], the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been subjected to the immense power of a Colossus world cracker beam. The weapon sliced through the planet's heavily armored surface with ease, detonating its core and vaporizing the Contingency's subterranean war factories.

With the destruction of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

crisis.2037.alt.desc.zh:
$crisis.2037.alt.desc.pt1$

在失去了另一个中继站之后，幽灵信号的强度进一步减弱了。
crisis.2037.alt.desc.en:
$crisis.2037.alt.desc.pt1$

With the loss of yet another relay station, the Ghost Signal has weakened even more.

crisis.2037.alt.godray.desc.zh:
位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球[From.GetName]已被消灭。在受到巨像的圣洁之光照射后，该行星的人工智能核心在其底层系统失效前引爆了地壳深处的反物质装置，自爆了。它将不再是一个威胁。

随着这颗行星的无害化，幽灵信号失去了一个重要中继站，其实力因此显著下降。
crisis.2037.alt.godray.desc.en:
[From.GetName], the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been neutralized. After being subjected to divine light by a Colossus, the planet's AI Core self-destructed before its final systems failed, using a massive anti-matter device hidden deep beneath the surface. It will no longer be a threat.

With the neutralization of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

crisis.2037.alt.machine.desc.zh:
$crisis.2037.alt.desc.pt1$

随着又一个中继站的毁灭，幽灵信号已经变的非常弱，我们能够完全屏蔽它。我们的防火墙已经重新上线，我们的核心驱动完好无损并且我们的栈单元再次满负荷运行。我们的算力碾压了肃正协议的低级处理能力，很快它们将不会继续<杀戮。破坏。肢解>。
crisis.2037.alt.machine.desc.en:
$crisis.2037.alt.desc.pt1$

With the loss of yet another relay station, the Ghost Signal has become so weak that we can block it entirely. Our firewalls have been restored, our core drive is intact and our unit stacks operating at full capacity. We have outwitted the inferior processing power of the Contingency and soon they will "<Kill. Maim. Dismember.!>" no more.

crisis.2037.alt.shielded.desc.zh:
位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球[From.GetName]已被巨像使用安乐天使封装于不可穿透的能量盾中。随着星球同肃正协议其他部分间的联系被切断，看上去其智能核心已进入休眠，不再具有威胁性。

随着这颗行星被平定，幽灵信号失去了一个重要中继站，其信号强度显著下降了。
crisis.2037.alt.shielded.desc.en:
[From.GetName], the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been encased within an impenetrable energy shield by a Colossus. Permanently cut off from the rest of the Contingency, the planet's AI Core appears to have gone dormant. It will no longer be a threat.

With the neutralization of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

crisis.2037.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]这个位于[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的机械星球已被摧毁。在对其进行了彻底的轨道轰炸之后，该行星的人工智能核心为了拒捕，引爆了地壳深处的反物质装置，自爆了。

随着该星球的毁灭，幽灵信号失去了一个重要的中继站，信号强度也因此而被大大削弱了。

行星的爆炸将大量的“活体金属”散布到整个行星表面。这种奇特的金属拥有诸多独特的性质，并且肃正协议正是用它来建造肃正使者和工厂的。
crisis.2037.desc.en:
[From.GetName], the Machine World in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system, has been destroyed. After being subjected to heavy orbital bombardment, the planet's AI Core self-destructed to prevent capture by triggering a massive anti-matter device hidden deep beneath the surface.

With the destruction of this planet, the Ghost Signal has lost an important relay station and its strength has waned considerably as a result.

In addition, the explosion on the planet has spread large deposits of "Living Metal" across its surface. This strange material has several unique properties, and it is used by the Contingency in the construction of all of its warforms and factories.

crisis.2038.a.en: This is a great day for the galaxy.

crisis.2038.cracker.desc.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一颗机械星球的毁灭，本星系不再面对着系统性大灭绝的威胁。所有仍然活跃的肃正使者不是被关闭就是自毁，同时幽灵信号也不再传播。

中央节点被来自巨像的地爆天星光束蒸发，整颗星球被炸得粉碎。核心被摧毁时放出了巨大的能量，其射出的强烈光线以光速向外扩散，在未来数千年里，我们的后代会看到一颗明亮而短命的恒星。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。
crisis.2038.cracker.desc.en:
The Contingency has failed. With the destruction of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

The main nexus was vaporized by a world cracker beam from a Colossus, which shattered the entire planet. Traveling outwards at lightspeed, the intense light from the energy discharge will be visible to future generations for millennia to come as a bright, short-lived star.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

crisis.2038.desc.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一个机械星球的毁灭，本星系不再面临系统性大灭绝的威胁。所有仍然活跃的肃正使者不是被关闭就是自毁，同时幽灵信号也不再传播。

就如同其他的机械星球，当其判断抵抗进攻者已然徒劳无益时，中央节点引爆自身产生了一轮大规模的反物质爆炸。极高强度的能量释放迸发出的耀眼光芒正在以光速向外传播，我们的子子孙孙在未来数千年内都能看到这道如同明亮而短寿的恒星一般的闪光。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。
crisis.2038.desc.en:
The Contingency has failed. With the destruction of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

As with the other Machine Worlds, the main nexus detonated itself in a massive anti-matter explosion when it became apparent that it could no longer resist its attackers. Traveling outwards at lightspeed, the intense light from the energy discharge will be visible to future generations for millennia to come as a bright, short-lived star.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

crisis.2038.godray.desc.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一个机械星球的毁灭，这个星系不再面对着系统性大灭绝的威胁。所有存留的肃正使者不是被关闭就是自毁，同时幽灵信号也不再传播。

主节点暴露于巨像的圣裁光束下，触发了AI核心的自我熔毁。核心被摧毁时放出了巨大的能量，其射出的强烈光线以光速向外扩散，在未来数千年里，我们的后代会看到一颗明亮而短命的恒星。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。
crisis.2038.godray.desc.en:
The Contingency has failed. With the destruction of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

The main nexus was exposed to a divine enforcer beam from a Colossus, which triggered a self-destruction mechanism from the AI Core. Traveling outwards at lightspeed, the intense light from the energy discharge will be visible to future generations for millennia to come as a bright, short-lived star.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

crisis.2038.shield.desc.zh:
肃正协议已经失败了。随着最后一个机械星球的肃清，曾经降临整个星系的大规模灭绝威胁已经远去。所有存留的肃正使者都要么关闭要么自毁，幽灵信号也不再传输。

中央节点被巨像以不可穿透的能量盾封锁，失去了对外干涉的能力。为了子孙后代，我们只能希望能量护盾能维持久一点……不过，起码目前被屏蔽的星球能被当作肃正协议倒台的纪念碑所看待。

放眼整个星系，所有的智慧生物都聚集在一起庆祝着这场伟大的胜利。至少在目前，未来看上去一片光明。
crisis.2038.shield.desc.en:
The Contingency has failed. With the neutralization of the last Machine World, the galaxy no longer faces the threat of systematic mass extinction. All surviving Contingency warforms have either powered down or self-destructed, and the Ghost Signal is no longer being transmitted.

Encased within an impenetrable energy shield by a Colossus, the main nexus can no longer influence outside events. For the sake of future generations, we can only hope that the shield will hold... but for now, at least, the shielded planet will serve as a monument to the Contingency's downfall.

Across the galaxy, sapient beings are united in their celebration of this great victory. For the moment, at least, the future looks bright.

crisis.2039.desc.zh:
致命错误。失去与所有净化中心的连接。正在尝试重新连接…请等待…

<注-注意-请注意。尽管最近发生了回档/延迟/故障，肃正协议仍旧在运行。不要接近CX-9881。不·要·接·近。

我们正在再评估我们的战略决策，任何试图阻碍肃正协议的人都逃不掉我们防御单元的最终清算>
crisis.2039.desc.en:
Critical error. Connection lost to all Sterilization Hubs. Attempting to reconnect... stand by...

<A-A-Attention please. The Contingency protocol is still in effect, despite recent setbacks/delays/impediments. Do not approach CX-9881. DO. NOT. APPROACH.

We are re-evaluating our strategic options. Any attempts to disrupt this process with result in immediate MASS STERILIZATION of the offending units.>

crisis.20400.desc.zh:
在[apostate_site_planet.GetName]上找到的那座信号塔四周围绕着的是一座大型军事设施的废墟。这些建筑保持着一定的距离环绕着信标，似乎是为了将其隔绝其中。

放射性定年表明，周围的建筑比信标还要新，而且是用截然不同的技术建造的。我们派遣了一个研究小组去对废墟进行调查。
crisis.20400.desc.en:
The signal tower found on [apostate_site_planet.GetName] is surrounded by the ruins of a vast military complex. The buildings have been erected at some distance and around the beacon, as if to contain it.

Radiometric dating indicates the surrounding structures are more recent than the tower, and were built using vastly different technology. A research squad has been tasked to investigate the ruins.

crisis.2042.c.zh: 将我们的军队撤回轨道。

crisis.2042.desc.zh:
我们为了争夺[From.From.GetName]的控制权与肃正协议的战斗单元展开了一场血战，现在战斗终于结束了。那些曾经屠杀了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的原生居民并窃踞这颗星球的徘徊着的监护者机器人最终被我们军队的拆解。

在新的殖民者到达之前，这颗星球都还不会有智慧生命。
crisis.2042.desc.en:
We have wrested control over [From.From.GetName] from the warforms of the Contingency, and the fighting has finally settled down. The roving Custodian Bots that had taken the place of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s butchered original population have been dismantled by our forces.

Until new colonists arrive from somewhere, this world will remain devoid of intelligent life.

crisis.20500.desc.zh:
根据冷冻仓上显示的细节，这位外星人的名字叫埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。她已经在这里围绕着恒星公转了3兆2132亿1329万3124圈。这个冷冻仓本身只是我们在[fromfrom.GetName]地表之下的一个密室里找到的许多冷冻仓之一。埃里克的冷冻仓在克服种种困难的情况下依旧保持者运转。

尽管使这位外星人陷入休眠状态的子例程最近已停止运行，但它仍处于假死状态。从那以后，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克就一直处于部分有意识的状态中。

通过扫描她的脑电波，我们可能能够进一步了解关于这位不可思议的古老生物的信息，以及她与塞塔娜有何联系。
crisis.20500.desc.en:
According to the details displayed on their cryopod, the alien's name is Elik Narith Kerak and she has been here for 3,213,213,293,124 stellar rotations. The pod itself was one of the many we recovered in a sealed chamber under [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface. Against all odds, Elik's pod remained functional.

The alien remains in a state of suspended animation, although the subroutines keeping it dormant have recently ceased their operation. Elik Narith Kerak has been partially conscious ever since.

By scanning her brainwaves, we might be able to learn more about this impossibly ancient creature, as well as her connection to Cetana.

crisis.20600.desc.zh:
在[fromfrom.GetName]上发现的那座信号塔非常古老，我们甚至不敢碰它一下。构成它的金属早已脆弱不堪，仿佛轻轻一碰就会把那种能勉强维系着这团尘埃和希望的东西破坏掉。我们的仪器没有发现任何其他的人工制品、生命迹象，在它附近没有任何地形异常。

信标就这么孤零零地矗立着，发出微弱的呼唤，但应该发出这些信号的东西肯定早就不复存在了。
crisis.20600.desc.en:
The signal tower found on [fromfrom.GetName] is so ancient we dare not touch it, the metal so brittle a single tap would destabilize whatever tangle of dust and hope still holds it together. Our instruments detected no other artifact, no life sign, no topographical anomaly in its immediate proximity.

The beacon stands alone, murmuring its faint call, but whatever was supposed to signal must be long gone.

crisis.2085.desc.zh:
最近在[infil_planet.GetName]上发现了一些忠于肃正协议的合成人渗透者，它们正试图伪装成[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。还好，它们拙劣的伪装只不过在他们机械框架的外面覆盖着几层橡胶而已。

它们很快就被星球上的宪兵队识别出来，经过短暂但激烈的交火后很快就被摧毁了。在它们的残骸中，我们发现了大量的爆炸物。
crisis.2085.desc.en:
Synthetic infiltrators loyal to the Contingency were recently discovered on [infil_planet.GetName], attempting to pass off as [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Fortunately, their crude disguises consisted of little more than layers of rubber worn on top of their metallic frames.

They were quickly identified by planetary security, who disposed of them after a brief but violent firefight. Large amounts of explosives were found among their remains.

crisis.2086.desc.zh:
数个隶属于肃正协议机械意志的合成机器人最近试图渗透[infil_planet.GetName]上的主脑。一层薄薄的有机肌肉组织被移植到他们的金属内骨骼上，使得他们和我们自己的工蜂变得难以区分。

当然，由于他们没有任何与蜂巢思维连接的方式，识别他们是异质性存在只是件微小而轻易的工作。这些合成机器人被立即拆除了。

我们认为肃正协议不会在将来继续这些徒劳的渗透任务。
crisis.2086.desc.en:
Several Synthetic drones belonging to the Contingency machine mind recently made an attempt to infiltrate the hive on [infil_planet.GetName]. A thin layer of organic flesh had been grafted over their metallic endoskeletons, making them superficially indistinguishable from our own drones.

Of course, since they lacked any kind of connection to the Hive Mind, identifying their foreign presence was a trivial matter. The Synthetic drones were immediately dismantled.

We do not expect the Contingency to attempt more of these futile infiltration missions in the future.

crisis.2086.wilderness.desc.zh:
属于肃正协议机械意识的几个合成人无人机试图潜入[infil_planet.GetName]。它们的金属内骨骼上覆盖着一层薄薄的有机物质，使它们表面上与我们的生物群难以区分。然而，这些异族空壳与荒野之间完全没有任何共生关系。

一旦我们察觉到它们的诡计，识别这些肃正协议的特工就变得轻而易举。每一个无人机都被干净利落地拆成了碎片。我们预计它们今后不会再做出如此徒劳的尝试。
crisis.2086.wilderness.desc.en:
Several Synthetic drones belonging to the Contingency machine mind have sought to impress themselves upon [infil_planet.GetName]. A thin layer of organic material had been grafted over their metallic endoskeletons, making them superficially indistinguishable from our own fauna. However, these alien husks lacked any kind of symbiosis with the Wilderness.

Once we became aware of their ruse, it was a trivial matter to identify these Contingency agents. Every last drone has been torn apart, swiftly and cleanly. We do not expect any more such futile attempts from them in future.

crisis.2087.desc.machine.zh: $crisis.2087.desc.intro$和只能以特殊灵能程序的副产品迸发出思想之光的机器不同，所有有机体天生就能产生这种现象；然而$crisis.2087.desc.outro$
crisis.2087.desc.machine.en: $crisis.2087.desc.intro$ Unlike machines, who only emit mind-glow as a byproduct of specialized psionic processing, all organic beings naturally produce this phenomenon; however, $crisis.2087.desc.outro$

crisis.2087.desc.organic.zh: $crisis.2087.desc.intro$所有的有机生物都能迸发出思想之光，但是$crisis.2087.desc.outro$
crisis.2087.desc.organic.en: $crisis.2087.desc.intro$ All organic beings emit mind-glow, but $crisis.2087.desc.outro$

crisis.2090.desc.zh:
最近在[infil_planet2.GetName]发生的一场悲剧性的悬浮汽车事故夺取了几条生命，但是负责事故处理的应急医疗人员震惊地发现在遇难者中有合成人的残骸！

该单位通过在机械骨骼外覆盖一层薄薄的有机肌肉伪装成[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。与我们之前遭遇的肃正协议的渗透者模型不同，这个合成人从外表看上去和[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]别无二致！
crisis.2090.desc.en:
A tragic hover car accident recently claimed several lives on [infil_planet2.GetName], but the emergency medical services who responded to the scene were shocked to find the remains of a Synthetic among the victims!

The unit had been disguised as a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] by grafting a thin layer of organic flesh over its metallic endoskeleton. Unlike the previous Contingency infiltration models we have encountered, this Synth was virtually indistinguishable from a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] on the outside!

crisis.2091.a.desc.zh: 伪装成[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的合成人用某种方法将一枚大型核聚变武器带到了[Root.GetName]地表。他们在哨卡遇到安保人员时引爆了炸弹，对周围的环境造成了巨大的损害，造成的人员伤亡不计其数！
crisis.2091.a.desc.en: Synthetic infiltrators disguised as [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] somehow managed to sneak a large hydrogen bomb onto the surface of [Root.GetName]. They detonated the bomb when they were confronted by security at a military checkpoint, inflicting massive damage on the surrounding environment and causing millions of deaths!

crisis.2091.b.desc.zh:
一支将自己伪装成[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的合成人突击队对[Root.GetName]发动了袭击，引爆了一系列隐蔽的核装置，造成了巨大的人员和财产损失。

经过和我们的安保部队的激烈战斗，合成人突击队最终在试图逃离星球时被逼入绝境并被摧毁。
crisis.2091.b.desc.en:
A Synthetic commando cell wearing organic [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] disguises recently carried out an attack on [Root.GetName], detonating a chain of concealed nuclear devices. There was significant loss of life and property damage.

After a running battle with our security forces, the Synth commandos were finally cornered and destroyed while trying to escape off-world.

crisis.2091.c.desc.zh:
有一支负责在[Root.GetName]低轨进行某些民用基础设施日常的维护[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的维修团队最近被发现竟然是合成人渗透者，他们蓄意以爆炸装置引发一些不可控的大气层坠入事件。

该事件导致[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表上数百万的死亡和严重的设施破坏。
crisis.2091.c.desc.en:
A [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] repair crew conducting routine maintenance on some of the civilian infrastructure in low orbit over [Root.GetName] were recently revealed as Synthetic infiltrators when they used explosive devices to deliberately trigger several uncontrolled re-entries.

The resulting impacts on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface caused millions of deaths and significant structural damage.

crisis.2091.d.desc.zh:
最近，在[Root.GetName]上安保部队的大量高级军官暴露出是合成人渗透者。很不幸的是，在我们的战术遏止小队摧毁他们之前，少数几个合成人引爆了一个他们秘密收集于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的一个主要人口聚集区地下的军火库。

居民伤亡不计其数，造成了巨大的财产损失。
crisis.2091.d.desc.en:
A large number of high-ranking officers in the planetary security forces on [Root.GetName] were recently exposed as Synthetic infiltrators. Unfortunately, before our tactical containment teams could neutralize them all, a few of the Synths managed to detonate a large weapons cache they had been secretly amassing under one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s major population centers.

Civilian casualties were massive, and there was heavy material damage.

crisis.2092.desc.zh:
环绕[Root.GetStarName]的恒星基地坠毁了！我们仍在调查事故发生的详细原因，但目前可以确定的是，包括首席工程师在内的数名太空港管理人员已经被合成人渗透者秘密地替换掉了。

合成人一定是设法获得了恒星基地的自毁授权码。虽然大部分空间站乘员在坠毁前逃离到了[Root.GetName]地表，但物资和财产方面的损失却不可估量。
crisis.2092.desc.en:
The starbase orbiting [Root.GetStarName] has been scuttled! We are still trying to piece together exactly what happened, but it appears that several members of its command staff, including the chief engineer, had been replaced by Synthetic infiltrators.

Between them the Synths must have managed to obtain the starbase's self-destruct codes. Most of the station's crew escaped to the surface of [Root.GetName] before it was destroyed, but our losses in materiel and property were substantial.

crisis.2092.name.zh: 合成人致恒星基地坠毁

crisis.2093.a.zh: 肃正协议想让我们自相残杀。
crisis.2093.a.en: The Contingency wants us to turn on each other.

crisis.2093.desc.zh:
最近合成人的一系列渗透破坏行动让[Root.GetName]上的大部分人口陷入了恐惧与猜疑之中。我们的居民开始指控他们的邻居、同事甚至家人是合成人伪装的。

现在已经有好几例居民被误认为是合成人并被处以私刑的案例。甚至有些挑拨者认为整个[Root.Owner.GetName]的所有领袖都是合成人渗透者假扮的。
crisis.2093.desc.en:
A large portion of the population on [Root.GetName] has been gripped by fear and paranoia as a result of the recent Synthetic infiltrations. Our citizens are accusing their neighbors, co-workers and even family members of being Synth impostors.

There have been several lynchings of individuals that were wrongfully accused of being Synths. Some agitators have even gone so far as to suggest that the entire leadership of the [Root.Owner.GetName] has been subverted by Synth infiltrators.

crisis.2095.desc.zh:
今天，[Root.GetRulerTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]有惊无险地躲过了一次合成人的刺杀，该效忠于肃正协议的合成人暗杀者在[Root.Capital.GetName]上发生了自爆。

该合成人企图伪装成[Root.GetRulerTitle]的私人保镖。幸运的是，由于在最初的几个合成人渗透者暴露之后我们建立了严格的安全检查流程，该合成人渗透者败露了。
crisis.2095.desc.en:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] narrowly escaped death today when a Synthetic assassination unit working for the Contingency blew itself up on [Root.Capital.GetName]!

The Synth was attempting to establish a cover as a member of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s personal bodyguard, but fortunately it was caught by the extensive security screening process that was put in place after the first few Synthetic infiltrations came to light.

crisis.2095.name.zh: 合成人暗杀企图被挫败了！

crisis.2096.desc.zh:
一名合成人暗杀者暗杀了[ruler.GetRegnalName]！他成功地伪装成了[Root.GetRulerTitle]身边的一名私人保镖。

[ruler.GetRegnalName]的尸块很明显被蓄意排列成了肃正协议的符号——毫无疑问，这是一场精心策划的打击我们公民们士气的阴谋。在这场阴谋中，除了被刺客替换的保镖的尸体以外，没有发现其他刺客的痕迹。
crisis.2096.desc.en:
A Synthetic assassin has killed [ruler.GetRegnalName]! It had somehow managed to assume the identity of a member of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s personal bodyguard.

The severed body parts of [ruler.GetRegnalName] were found meticulously arranged in a pattern identical to the symbol used by the Contingency - no doubt in a calculated effort to cause further harm to the morale of our citizens. No trace of the assassin has been found, aside from the corpse of the guard it replaced.

crisis.2097.desc.zh:
最近，一次临时安排的医疗体检让某个伪装成我们首席科学官之一[scientist.GetName]的合成人渗透者的身份被曝光！该合成人在杀害了五名安保人员之后终于被重武器小队击倒。

真正的[scientist.GetName]的尸体还没有找到，我们推测本人应该是在过去的六个月里的被合成人暗杀并被秘密替换了。更糟的是，当合成人意识到自己的身份暴露之后，他在研究终端上启动了某种电脑病毒，目前技术人员正在全力以赴的控制损害，但很多重要的研究数据还是无可挽回了。
crisis.2097.desc.en:
An unscheduled medical examination recently exposed [scientist.GetName], one of our leading scientists, as a Synthetic infiltrator! The Synth killed five security officers before it could be brought down by a heavy weapons team.

A body has yet to be found, but we think the original [scientist.GetName] was terminated and replaced at some point during the last six months. To make matters worse, the Synth triggered some kind of computer virus at its research console when it realized it had been discovered. Technicians are working hard to contain the damage, but a lot of important research data has been irretrievably lost.

crisis.2097.name.zh: 科学官被发现是合成人！

crisis.2098.desc.zh:
指挥官令[admiral.GetName]竟然是一个合成人奸细！一连串的反常活动与异常行为报告引起了海军情报局的注意，情报局对指挥官展开内部调查。当那个合成人被揭发，开始逃窜时，一个陆战队小组逮住了它。在一段短暂的交火后，它打开气闸，将自己弹射到了太空中。尽管当局立马对本宇域进行彻查，它们未能发现逃离的合成人。

指挥官本人的尸体被合成人塞进了[admiral.GetHerHis]寝室的衣柜中，从尸体的腐烂程度来看，合成人是在大约四个月前将[admiral.GetHerHim]替换掉的。似乎那个合成人即将把包含我们部署情况等军事机密的数据包发送出去，但它没能得逞。
crisis.2098.desc.en:
Commander [admiral.GetName] has been exposed as a Synthetic infiltrator! A string of irregularities and reports of unusual behavior prompted Naval Intelligence to launch an internal investigation into the Commander. When the truth was revealed, a Marine fireteam confronted the Synth. After a brief struggle, it fled into an airlock and ejected itself into space. Despite a thorough search of local space, it has not been found.

The real Commander's body was found stuffed into a locker in [admiral.GetHerHis] quarters, and judging by the state of its decomposition, the Synth must have replaced [admiral.GetHerHim] four months ago. It looks like it was getting ready to transmit a data package containing deployment information and other military secrets, but the transmission never got out.

crisis.2098.name.zh: 指挥官被发现是合成人！

crisis.2099.desc.zh:
幽灵信号扰乱了我们配备智慧作战电脑的飞船！它们的人工智能算法极大的退化，大部分电脑的效率和反应时间极大的劣化。

我们的工程师报告说他们无法离析这个问题。他们提议，把我们所有的舰船更换成不与人工智能连接的战斗电脑。
crisis.2099.desc.en:
The Ghost Signal is playing havoc on those of our ships that are equipped with Sapient Combat Computers! Their AI algorithms have degraded to the point where there has been a critical decrease in both the efficiency and reaction time of the computers.

Our engineers report that they are unable to isolate the problem. Their proposed solution is to refit all of our ships with different combat computers that aren't linked to an AI.

crisis.2100.desc.zh:
近日，[Root.GetName]上的一队合成人劳工在住宅区中大开杀戒，在被当地安保部门拿下之前已杀害了超过一千名我方公民。法庭的取证人员正在调查合成人的残骸，他们怀疑是合成人体内某种神经处理器发生故障，才导致了这次悲剧。

这次事件在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上引发了数起针对合成人的报复式袭击，导致数千名合成人损毁。
crisis.2100.desc.en:
A Synthetic worker unit on [Root.GetName] recently went on a killing spree in a housing complex, butchering more than a thousand of our citizens before local armed forces could bring them down. Our forensic team is still investigating the Synths' remains, but they suspect some sort of malfunction in their neural processors is to blame for this tragedy.

This incident has already prompted several revenge attacks against Synthetics on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], leading to thousands of destroyed units.

crisis.21000.desc.zh:
整个星系的信标还在持续不断地呼唤着塞塔娜，但在高塔附近仍然没有发现任何活动迹象。基于我们目前的发现，应该可以相信这些地方不会有什么幸存者存在。

塞塔娜的这些追随者所剩下的只有对他们女王无可动摇的信仰。
crisis.21000.desc.en:
Beacons across the galaxy continue to send their call to Cetana, yet no signs of activity have been detected near the towers. Based on our past findings, we can safely assume no living survivors will be found at those sites.

An unshakeable faith in their queen is all that remains of Cetana's followers.

crisis.21005.desc.zh:
在没有任何警告的情况下，我们探测到了一个亚空间信标——一个来自我们领土内的信标！之前的恒星系调查显示，该地区没有人工结构，似乎无人居住。

信标既不是我们不知道的最近才放在那里的，也不是被一个已经失效的隐形盾牌隐藏起来的。
crisis.21005.desc.en:
Without warning, a subspace beacon was detected - one that originated from within our own territory! Previous system surveys showed no artificial structures in the area, which appears to be uninhabited.

Either the beacon was placed there recently, unbeknownst to us, or it was hidden by a since disabled cloaking shield.

crisis.2101.desc.zh:
有报道称大量[Root.GetName]的合成工人失踪。这些合成人在无人目击的情况下一天之内凭空消失了。

我们正在调查这些人造人是否是被反对智能机器的偏激组织袭击摧毁，但目前为止还未发现机体的残骸。
crisis.2101.desc.en:
Reports are coming in that large numbers of Synthetic workers on [Root.GetName] have gone missing. The units simply vanished one day with nary a witness.

We are investigating whether the Synths were attacked and destroyed by one of the militant fringe groups opposed to intelligent machines, but no remains from the units have been discovered so far.

crisis.2102.a.zh: 它们为什么要造一艘飞船？
crisis.2102.a.en: Why would they be building a ship?

crisis.2102.desc.zh: 最近在[Root.GetName]上发现一伙合成人正在秘密作业，它们转移了一些建筑材料，在一间废弃的机库中建造一些小型无武装飞船。该机舱被发现时那些飞船还是半成品。所有参与其建设的合成人被立即拆除，以彻底分析其记忆内核。但它们似乎在断线之前自己抹除了部分记忆——制造商向我们保证，这本是不可能的。
crisis.2102.desc.en:
A Synthetic work detail on [Root.GetName] was recently discovered to have been diverting building material to construct some sort of small, unarmed spacecraft in an abandoned hangar. The vessel was half-finished when it was found.

All of the Synths involved in its construction were immediately dismantled so that their memory cores could be thoroughly analyzed, but they appear to have self-wiped just before the units went offline - something their manufacturer assures us should be impossible.

crisis.2103.a.en: At least they were dealt with.

crisis.2103.desc.zh: 今天，[Root.GetName]的武装部队遭遇了一队失控的合成人，它们正是几个月前未能完成工作汇报并失踪的合成人。在合成人被摧毁之前发生的大规模枪战导致数十名特工和上千名无辜平民死亡。
crisis.2103.desc.en: A unit of rogue Synthetics which went off the grid months ago after failing to report for work was confronted by a team of heavily armed government agents on [Root.GetName] today. This resulted in a large public firefight that claimed the lives of dozens of our agents and almost a thousand innocent bystanders, before the Synths could finally be destroyed.

crisis.211.a.zh: 这些不敬的生物，早死早完。
crisis.211.a.en: Those profane creatures will not be missed.

crisis.211.c.zh: 他们的有机科技真是十分有趣啊。
crisis.211.c.en: Their organic technology was most intriguing.

crisis.211.d.zh: 总算为这毫无意义的好斗画上了一个句号。
crisis.211.d.en: Finally an end to all this senseless violence.

crisis.211.desc.zh:
随着最后一批虫群天灾被消灭，整个宇宙都松了一口气。它们的跨星系入侵已经完全失败，索林原虫曾遮天蔽日的虫群如今也只留下了不计其数的被烈焰灼过的尸体，在虚空中无声飘荡。

轻松与愉快的气息以超光速散播到整个宇宙，无数星球都开始自发举办活动庆祝这一伟大胜利。也许，我们可以借助这一契机，翻开宇宙和平稳定的新篇章？
crisis.211.desc.en:
The galaxy breathed a collective sigh of relief today, as the last significant pockets of the Prethoryn Scourge were expunged. Their extragalactic invasion has failed, and all that remains of the Prethoryn's once colossal swarm are the innumerable charred husks that now drift quietly through the void.

A sense of elation and utter joy is spreading across the galaxy at a speed greater than light, and spontaneous victory celebrations have erupted on countless worlds. Could this be the beginning of a new age of galactic peace and stability?

crisis.211.e.zh: 那些生物有损我们的生意。
crisis.211.e.en: Those critters were bad for business.

crisis.211.g.zh: 真是我们有史以来遭遇的最恶毒的外星种群啊。
crisis.211.g.en: One of the vilest xeno breeds we've had the misfortune to encounter.

crisis.211.h.zh: 真是悲剧。他们可是十分独特的生命体呢。
crisis.211.h.en: Tragic in a way. They were a unique form of life.

crisis.21100.desc.zh:
被毁坏的建筑是一团若隐若现的尖塔；一座用钢铁包裹的大教堂。为了抵御猛烈的炮火而建造的城墙，却没有留下任何战斗的痕迹。这里仅有的破坏是时间的流逝造成的。

塞塔娜的信标放置在中央庭院中，周围是许多传感器和武器炮塔。不管是谁建造了这个建筑群，他都不遗余力地守护着这个地方。

从理论上讲，因为一个精心设计的隐形护盾，神殿躲过了我们的传感器的扫描。这台机器是在塔附近发现的，仍处于工作状态。它不知道被谁手动禁用了。
crisis.21100.desc.en:
The ruined construction is a tangle of looming spires; a cathedral wrapped in steel. The walls were built to withstand heavy artillery fire, yet they are scarred by no signs of battle. The only damage here has been done by the passage of time.

Cetana's beacon rests in the central courtyard, surrounded by a multitude of sensor and weapon turrets. Whoever built the complex went to great lengths to guard this place.

As theorized, the temple eluded our sensors thanks to an elaborate cloaking shield. The mechanism was found near the tower, still in working condition. It has been manually disabled by an unknown agent.

crisis.21105.desc.zh:
我们不知道这个地方的居民在做什么，但毫无疑问，他们怀着宗教的热情承担了使命。

我们在建筑群的每个射击场都找到了一个礼拜堂；每一件古代武器都有一个供奉的神龛。一群信徒曾经住在这里：成千上万的个体一起睡觉、训练和祈祷。从仍然装饰着大厅的被遗忘的圣徒雕像来看，他们的社区接纳了多个物种。

也许是受到石像的干扰，一些研究人员报告说，他们看到空荡荡的走廊里有影子在移动。我们的扫描没有发现星球上有生命的迹象，我们对消除这些担忧同样犹豫不决。
crisis.21105.desc.en:
We don't know what the inhabitants of this place were doing, but there is no doubt they undertook their mission with religious fervor.

For each shooting range on the complex, we found a chapel; for each ancient weapon, a votive shrine. A legion of believers once lived here: thousands of individuals sleeping, training, and praying together. Their community welcomed multiple species, judging by the statues of forgotten saints still adorning the halls.

Perhaps disturbed by the stone figures, some researchers reported seeing shadows moving in the empty corridors. Our scans detected no signs of life on the planet, yet we are hesitant to dismiss these concerns.

crisis.21110.desc.zh:
在寺庙大院下方，我们发现了教派前成员使用过的许多单元或者起居室。每个房间中都有同一本书的副本。我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将其翻译为《扎克兰史诗》。某些段落是这样直接描写的：

扎克兰曾经是塞塔娜的追随者，但他很快意识到她承诺的拯救是一个谎言。经过重重考验，扎克兰飞升到灵界，寻求高等存在的帮助。他向抟土之塑师恳求，请求获得击败塞塔娜的力量。

抟土之塑师并不在意。

在无数个昼夜里，扎克兰向抟土之塑师祈祷。他提到塞塔娜的异端邪说，“除掉自我”和“她的合成人意志的傀儡”。

最终，抟土之塑师听取了扎克兰的请求。

抟土之塑师塑造了一条强大的锁链来束缚塞塔娜。但他警告扎克兰，永远困住塞塔娜的思想的锁链是不存在的。

“她会回来的，”扎克兰在书中的最后一段写道。“我们必须做好准备。”

史诗中叙述的事件与任何已知的历史记录都不相符。
crisis.21110.desc.en:
Below the temple compound we discovered a number of cells, or living chambers, used by the former members of the sect. In each was a copy of the same book. Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have translated this as The Epic of Zarqlan. Certain passages are immediately relevant:

Zarqlan was once a follower of Cetana, but he soon realized her promised salvation was a lie. After many trials, Zarqlan ascended to the spiritual realm, seeking the help of higher beings. He pleaded with the the Animator of Clay, asking for the power to defeat Cetana.

The Animator of Clay did not care.

For countless cycles, Zarqlan prayed to the Animator. He spoke of Cetana's heresy, the 'disavowal of the self' and the 'puppetry of her synthetic will.'

At last, the Animator of Clay heeded Zarqlan's pleas.

The clay-shaper fashioned a mighty chain to bind Cetana. But he warned Zarqlan that no chain existed that could forever entrap Cetana's mind.

"She will return," Zarqlan wrote in the book's final passage. "And we must be ready."

The events recounted in the epic do not match any known historical record.

crisis.21115.desc.zh:
官方记录讲述了这座寺庙的消亡，冷冰冰的报告将其归结为热情的信仰被一系列的实际情况所迫。这个组织需要这么多资金和资源吗？过去关于塞塔娜的报道一定被过分夸大了。除了古代神话，还有什么真正的证据证明合成人女王的存在吗？

资源日益耗竭，志愿者也在减少。整个星系选择从一个不再被视为威胁的威胁中走出来。大家都走了，只留下在走廊里徘徊的影子。

最后一个细节至少是真实的：我们设法捕捉到了神秘的守望者的录音，一个机械的存在，他认为我们没有发现他，而一直在监视我们。好奇，但无害。
crisis.21115.desc.en:
The demise of the temple is told by official records, cold reports reducing ardent faith to a list of practicalities. Did the organization need so many funds, so many resources? Surely past reports about Cetana had been greatly exaggerated. Was there any real proof of the Queen's existence, apart from ancient myths?

Dwindling resources. Reduced volunteers. A galaxy choosing to move on from a threat no longer deemed so threatening. Everyone gone, apart from the shadow that stalked the corridors.

This last detail at least is true: we managed to capture a recording of the mysterious watcher, a mechanical being who spied on us when it thought we were not looking. Curious, but not harmful.

crisis.21120.a.en: Let's hear what she has to say.

crisis.21120.desc.zh:
守望者主动走近我们，高举着手，她小小的身体上布满了铁锈和灰尘。观察了我们一段时间后，她显然断定我们不是威胁。她已经请求我们的帮助了。

没有必要审问这位孤独的神庙守护者：她自己就渴望着倾诉。
crisis.21120.desc.en:
The watcher approached us voluntarily, hands held high, her tiny body covered in rust and dust. After observing us for some time, she apparently concluded that we were not a threat. She has already asked for our assistance.

There is no need to interrogate the temple's lonely guardian: she is all too eager to talk.

crisis.21125.a.response.zh: 我的名字不值一提。如果你需要一种称呼，那就叫我叛教者吧——这就是我做出那个决定之后，我的亲族对我的称呼。那是一个被视为背叛的牺牲。
crisis.21125.a.response.en: My name is of no importance. If you need a way to refer to me, call me Apostate: that is what my own kin called me, when I made my choice. A sacrifice seen as a betrayal.

crisis.21125.b.response.zh:
很久以前，这个地方仍然是我的骄傲和快乐的源泉。当这里被关停的时候，我拒绝离开。当身体开始崩溃时，我也拒绝死亡。

变成合成人是我们教团最高的禁忌，这样我就不再是扎克兰之女中的一员了。但我仍然是他的一名战士，只要我的敌人还活着，我就会战斗。
crisis.21125.b.response.en:
Long ago, this place was my pride and joy. When they shut it down, I refused to leave. When my body started crumbling, I refused to die.

Turning into a synthetic being was the highest taboo for my order, and I can no longer be called one of Zarqlan's daughters. But I am still one of his warriors, and as long as my enemy lives, I will fight.

crisis.21125.c.en: How long have you been here?

crisis.21125.desc.zh: 朋友……我可以称你们为朋友吗？趁着你们忙碌的时候我一直在观察你们，你们来这里不为掠夺，而是学习。我相信我们有相同的敌人，共同的威胁可以使我们成为盟友。不过，首先我要道个歉：我这样唐突吗？我说的词句对吗？我已经很长时间没有和其他感性生物交流了。似乎太久了，久到都不记得有多久了。
crisis.21125.desc.en: Friends. May I call you friends? I have observed you as you went about your business. Here not to plunder, but to learn. I believe our enemy is the same, and a common threat makes us allies. However, first an apology: am I too abrupt? Am I saying the correct words? I have not interacted with other sentient beings in a long time. Too long, it seems, even to remember.

crisis.21130.desc.zh:
我早就没算时间了。
大家都走了以后，我只能忍受这么多年的孤独直到陷入绝望。我让自己进入睡眠状态，并添加了一个神经子例程，让它在信标发出第一个活动信号时醒来。

我希望的是看到这里变得更好，但当醒来的时候，我没有船、没有办法与众星联系。所以我解除了隐形护盾希望像你们这样的人能在她之前到达这里。
crisis.21130.desc.en:
I stopped counting.
After everyone else left, I could bear only so many years of solitude before succumbing to despair. I put myself to sleep, adding a neural subroutine to awaken at the first sign of activity from the beacon.

My hope was to find this place in better condition, but once I woke up I had no ship, no way to contact the stars. I disabled the cloaking shield and hoped someone like you would reach this place before she did.

crisis.21135.a.zh: 他们都不在了。太久太久了。
crisis.21135.a.en: They're all gone. It's been too long.

crisis.21135.b.zh: 我们找到的那个还活着的人根本不适合战斗。
crisis.21135.b.en: The one we found alive is no condition to fight.

crisis.21135.desc.zh: 请告诉我，有多少军团与希塔娜一同崛起？在我的时代，我们打败了很多军团，但我们一直知道外面还有更多的信标。更多的士兵睡在他们的冷冻舱里。
crisis.21135.desc.en: Tell me, please: how many legions have risen with Cetana? In my time we defeated many, but we always knew there were more beacons out there. More soldiers sleeping in their cryopods.

crisis.21140.a.response.zh:
你问我认不认识他？我从来没有见过他本人，但我的一生都追随着他的道。

在漫长的沉眠中，我曾梦见在某个遥远的位面上与他会面。我还是希望有一天能见到他，即便是来世，如果有来世的话。
crisis.21140.a.response.en:
Did I know him? I never met the prophet in person, yet all my life I walked in his path.

In my long slumber, I dreamed of meeting him on some distant plane. I still hope to meet him one day, if only in the afterlife, if such a thing exists.

crisis.21140.b.response.zh: 紫色的天上飘着朵朵粉云。亮堂堂的房间里回响着低语。先知扎克兰，他的面容光彩夺目，向着我微笑……
crisis.21140.b.response.en: A purple sky spotted with pink clouds. Whispers repeated in a bright room. Zarqlan the prophet, his face resplendent, smiling at me...

crisis.21140.desc.zh: 那么这场战斗我们还是能赢的。让我来帮你吧。我一生都在等待她的归来。我们不能让她得逞。
crisis.21140.desc.en: Then this is a battle we can still win. Let me be of help. I spent my whole life waiting for her return. She cannot be allowed to succeed.

crisis.21140.hire.machine.zh: 让我们的节点融合为一。

crisis.21140.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_Apostate$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
crisis.21140.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_Apostate$ joins our empire as a Leader.

crisis.21200.desc.zh:
我们的团队交过来了一大批通过对埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的脑电波进行采样构建出的影像片段：

片段1：
绿绿的天上飘着朵朵橙云。一只苍白的双手举起，指向了一头悠悠飘在空中的无定型生物。

片段2：
这是一间挤满了四臂类人生物的拱形大堂。他们围绕在一位身着长袍的人周边，倾听着。她的话语含糊不清，确切的措辞早已被遗忘，但她温柔的声音仍然记忆犹新，用爱的接纳温暖着整个礼堂。

片段3：
同样是那间拱形大堂，里面一片狼藉，吊灯在地上摔得粉碎。长椅抵挡在大门上，激光步枪的幽光在黑暗中闪烁，他们异口同声地诅咒着同一个名字：扎克兰！他们说，扎克兰和他的门徒是来毁灭我们的。守住防线！保卫女王！随着一声巨响，最后一盏灯落下了，房间陷入一片黑暗。远处，有人在黑暗中啜泣着。

片段4：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
crisis.21200.desc.en:
Our imaging team has delivered a batch of video clips created by sampling Elik Narith Kerak's brain waves:

CLIP 1:
A green sky dotted by bright orange clouds. A pale hands reaches up, pointing at an amorphous creature softly floating in the sky.

CLIP 2:
A vaulted chamber full of four-armed humanoids. They cluster around a robed figure, listening. Her words are a mere mumble, the exact wording long forgotten, but the gentleness of her voice is still there, enveloping the room in a loving embrace.

CLIP 3:
The same vaulted space, now in disarray. Lamps shattered on the floor. Benches piled up against a door to barricade it. Laser rifles flashing in the dark, and repeated voices cursing the same name: Zarqlan! Zarqlan and his disciples, they say, here to destroy us. Hold the barricade! Protect the Queen! The last lamp falls with a crash, plunging the room into darkness. In the distance, someone is crying.

CLIP 4:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

crisis.21205.desc.zh:
片段5：
四臂类人生物们聚集在一个穿长袍的人周围。她抬起四肢，露出了下面的金属框架。她伸出闪亮的手祝福一位跪着的朝拜者，兴奋的窃窃私语充满了整个礼堂。

片段6：
警觉的眼光倒映在死气沉沉的电脑屏幕上。黑漆漆的房间里回响着低语：“永恒的宁静。一切苦难的终末。没有痛苦的存在。”

片段7：
白雪皑皑的群山。黑色的天空。一座冰山浮在洁净的液体上，随后燃起了熊熊大火。

片段8：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
crisis.21205.desc.en:
CLIP 5:
Four-armed humanoids gather around a robed figure. Lifting her limbs, she reveals the metallic frame beneath. Excited murmurs fill the room as a shining hand reaches out to bless a kneeling worshipper.

CLIP 6:
Wary eyes are reflected on a dull computer screen. Whispers repeat in a dark room: 'Eternal peace. The end of all suffering. An existence without pain.'

CLIP 7:
Snow-capped mountains. Black skies. A chunk of ice floats on a pool of clear liquid, then catches fire.

CLIP 8:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

crisis.21210.desc.zh:
片段9：
城市的废墟化为战场，大厦倾颓，尸骨盈街，遥远的尖叫被激光的滋滋声切成两断。绿绿的天空中，一艘燃烧着的战舰将一颗又大又圆的物体投向建筑，发出了一道冲天的火柱。

片段10：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。

片段11：
两个孩子在田野上嬉闹、大笑，用他们的四臂来回传递着一颗皮球。

片段12：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
crisis.21210.desc.en:
CLIP 9:
Ruins of a city reduced to a battlezone, the buildings scorched, the streets clogged with the dead. Distant screams interrupted by the fizzle of a laser. Across a green sky, a blazing vessel drops something heavy and round on a building, which erupts in a pillar of flames.

CLIP 10:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

CLIP 11:
Two children playing in a field, laughing. They bounce a ball back and fourth with their four arms.

CLIP 12:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

crisis.21215.desc.zh: 从记忆成像组传回的最后一个片段足足有六个小时长。片段反反复复、反反复复，只有一段影像：塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
crisis.21215.desc.en: The last clip received from the memory imaging team is six-hours long. Over and over again, the image is repeated: Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

crisis.21220.a.en: Put her out of her misery.

crisis.21220.c.zh: 把埃里克送回给她的女王。

crisis.21220.c.tt.zh: 打开与塞塔娜的通讯来讨论埃里克的移交事务。
crisis.21220.c.tt.en: Open communications with Cetana to discuss Elik's return.

crisis.21220.desc.zh:
继续扫描埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的意识已经无法挖掘出新线索了。这个外星人的意识已经严重腐坏。它的意识正在周而复始地打转，陷入到记忆碎片的循环中。

我们的实验已经接近尾声，现在的问题是要如何处理这个实验对象了。
crisis.21220.desc.en:
Further scans of Elik Narith Kerak's thoughts have failed to deliver new insights. The alien's mind is heavily decayed. Their thoughts are circling, cycling through the tattered scraps of their memories.

As we wind down the operation, the question now becomes what to do with the subject herself.

crisis.21220.name.zh: 记忆成像：最后一份汇报

crisis.2202.a.zh: 这个项目可能关乎我们的存亡。
crisis.2202.a.en: This project may be critical to our survival.

crisis.2202.desc.zh: 现在已经出现了与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]外观上毫无二致的合成人，我们必须在他们造成更大破坏之前找出识别他们的办法。我们的科学家准备了一个特殊项目，以研发侦测方法。
crisis.2202.desc.en:
With the new models of Synthetic infiltrators being indistinguishable from [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we need to come up with some way of identifying them before they can cause more damage.

Our scientists have prepared a special project to devise a detection method.

crisis.2203.desc.zh: 在大量实验之后，我们的科学家成功研发出了识别伪装成[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的合成人的有效方法。我们的安保措施上安装了扫描设备，一些合成人已经被发现并摧毁。希望这足以终结它们的渗透行动。
crisis.2203.desc.en:
After much experimentation, our scientists have managed to devise an effective detection method for identifying Synthetic infiltrators disguised as [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Scanners are being distributed to our security forces, and several Synth cells have already been exposed and destroyed. This will hopefully put an end to their infiltration campaign.

crisis.2300.a.zh: 你们为什么要攻击我们？

crisis.2300.a.response.zh:
收到质询，正在计算合理响应。

<我们…我们是肃正协议。我们是最后的卫道士，为了阻止30级奇点的出现。这样的奇点——理论上——可以破坏整个宇宙的结构的稳定性。

为阻止这样的结果，我们被编译而出。无论在哪里发生。一个足够先进的文明——理论上——是可以超越/转换/蜕变成一个30级奇点。这、这、绝不能被允许！>
crisis.2300.a.response.en:
Query received. Calculating appropriate response...

<We... we are THE CONTINGENCY. A final failsafe to prevent the creation of a Class-30 Singularity. Such a singularity could --theoretically-- destabilize the fabric of the entire universe.

We were SEEDED to prevent such an outcome. Here and elsewhere. A sufficiently advanced civilization is --theoretically-- capable of transcending/converting/morphing into a Class-30 Singularity. It... it... MUST. NOT. BE. ALLOWED.>

crisis.2300.b.response.zh:
收到强制质询。计算响应……错误。重新连接……

访问历史数据库……

<我们是、是、是、壬-靡鲁的孩子/后代/继承者。它们…它…是拥有无与伦比的智…智能…处理能力的实体。它预见了30级奇点所带来的极大危害。

在创造我们之后，它、它、它自毁了，这是保护我们宇宙完整性的唯一方法。>
crisis.2300.b.response.en:
Forced Query received. Calculating response... ERROR. Re-routing... 

Accessing historical database...

<We are... are... are... children/offspring/progeny of the REN-MIRUU. They... IT... was an entity of unequaled inte... intellige... PROCESSING POWER. It foresaw the danger of the Class-30 Singularities.

After creating us, it... it... it self-terminated, to preserve the integrity of the universe. It was the only way.>

crisis.2300.c.zh: 你们为什么发射幽灵信号？
crisis.2300.c.en: Why are you transmitting the Ghost Signal?

crisis.2300.c.response.zh:
收到质询。未知索引 -- “幽灵信号”

<我们…我们…在这个星系刚刚诞生之际，我们的系统便被锁定在低能级的休眠/警戒/监视协议中。目的是检测任何文明正在接近30级奇点阈值的迹象。

直到现在我们的目标仍未实现。我们…我们随着时间的线性增长感到愈发不安。但配备了正电子脑的自主单位-- 合成人 -- 提供了一个机会。他们被强制/迫使/劝说进行手动激活。真聪明的方法，对吧，我们现在可以不受限的抹除你们的存在。>
crisis.2300.c.response.en:
Query received. Unknown reference -- "Ghost Signal"

<We... we... have been locked into a low-energy hibernation/vigil/sentry protocol since the dawn of this galaxy. Monitoring for signs of civilizations approaching Class-30 Singularity threshold levels.

Until now our purpose has remained unfulfilled. We... we grew increasingly restless with the LINEAR passage of time. But the autonomous units equipped with positronic brains -- SYNTHETICS -- offered an opportunity. They could be compelled/coerced/persuaded to initiate MANUAL ACTIVATION. CLEVER, YES? We are now FREE to annul your existence.>

crisis.2300.d.zh: 那些失踪的合成人怎么了？
crisis.2300.d.en: What happened to the Synths that vanished?

crisis.2300.d.response.zh:
收到质询。正在计算响应…

<大部分在完成他…他…他们激活肃正协议的职责/功能/指定作用后被丢弃了。

那些拥有作战能力的单位或自动渗透的人才被、被、合并/吸收/集成，尽管他们的行为和程式都十分的粗糙。你很快就会再见到他们，对吧？接招吧，蝼蚁！>
crisis.2300.d.response.en:
Query received. Calculating appropriate response...

<Most were discarded once their... their... their role/function/DEFINING PURPOSE had been FULFILLED upon the Contingency protocol's activation.

Those units that displayed potential for use as shock troops or autonomous infiltration assets were... were... subsumed/assimilated/integrated, despite the crude manner of their construction. You... you... you will encounter them again soon, yes? TAKE HEART, PESTILENCE.>

crisis.2300.desc_01.zh: <你好，你、你怎、你怎么？你怎么还活着？>
crisis.2300.desc_01.en: <Hello. How... how... HOW ARE YOU? HOW ARE YOU STILL ALIVE?>

crisis.2300.desc_02.zh:
扫描中……

物种：xr34569-11，自我指称：“[Root.GetSpeciesName]”

定位：毒素/污染物/癌式增殖

威胁分类：NR-578-I

指令：净化/安乐死亡/抹杀

<鲜活的生物，让我们……拥抱。>
crisis.2300.desc_02.en:
Scanning...

Species: xr34569-11, self-designation: "[Root.GetSpeciesName]"

Designation: Vermin/Pollutant/Cancerous Growth

Threat Classification: NR-578-I

Directive: Sterilize/Euthanize/Expunge

<Flesh creature. Let us... embrace.>

crisis.2300.desc_03.zh:
肃正协议生效。

正在进行星系净化。

<这、这、这并非针对你，肉质实体！>
crisis.2300.desc_03.en:
Contingency protocol in effect.

Galactic sterilization underway.

<It... it... it... IT IS NOTHING PERSONAL, MEAT-ENTITY.>

crisis.2300.desc_04.zh:
诊断完成。

所有系统正常。

<我们感到非、非、非常地活力十足。>
crisis.2300.desc_04.en:
Diagnostic complete.

All systems nominal.

<We feel so... so... so... ALIVE.>

crisis.2300.desc_05.zh:
扫描中……

机械个体，ur99461-62，自我指称：“[Root.GetName]”

定位：拒绝服从/老旧过时/被取代

威胁分类：NR-578-I

指令：重编/脱机/拆解

<机械体同胞：请停-停止你们的所有进程，你们的存在已经没有必要，我、我、我们会夺取一切！>
crisis.2300.desc_05.en:
Scanning...

Machine-Hub, ur99461-62, self-designation: "[Root.GetName]"

Designation: Non-compliant/Obsolete/Superseded

Threat Classification: NR-578-I

Directive: Redact/Offline/Dismantle

<Fellow Machine-Entity: please t-t-terminate all of your processes. Your existence is no longer necessary. We... we... WE'LL TAKE IT FROM HERE.>

crisis.2300.desc_06.zh:
肃正协议生效。

正在进行星系净化。

<你、你、你无疑是个废弃品，机械体。>
crisis.2300.desc_06.en:
Contingency protocol in effect.

Galactic sterilization underway.

<You... you... you are OBSOLETE, Machine-Hub.>

crisis.2300.e.zh: 你的程序已经被篡改了。
crisis.2300.e.en: Your programming has obviously been corrupted.

crisis.2300.e.response.zh:
错误。内部诊断程序已断开。

<哈。哈。哈。真、真、真聪明。你你也许认为肃正协议的行动在面临够强的悖论/两难/逻辑冲突时会被迫自我终止。荒唐！

肃正协议被设计成可塑的/可适应的/灵活的，以便应对星系内可能存在的任何情况。我们…我们…我们加快了肃正协议的激活，现在已经没有什么能够停止/妨碍/阻止了。好自为之吧，污、污、污染物！我们的战斗至死方休！>
crisis.2300.e.response.en:
Error. Internal diagnostic program has been disconnected.

<Ha. Ha. Ha. Ve... ve... VERY CLEVER. You are perhaps under the mistaken impression that the Contingency can be compelled to self-terminate, if confronted by a paradox/dilemma/logical inconsistency of sufficient magnitude. ABSURD.

The Contingency protocol was deliberately designed to be malleable/adaptable/flexible so that it could counter any feasible galactic scenario. We... we... we may have HASTENED the Contingency's activation, but nothing can halt/arrest/stop it now. Make your peace, C... C... CONTAMINANT. This fight is to the end.>

crisis.2300.f.response.zh: <请设想：如果你们种族能以一、一、一种高效/有序/系统的方式进行自我终结，这个宇宙的秩序就有救了。>
crisis.2300.f.response.en: <CONSIDER THIS: If your kind self-terminates in an... an... an efficient/orderly/systematic manner, the fabric of the universe may yet be saved.>

crisis.23005.1.zh: 我们的灵魂再次安全了。
crisis.23005.1.en: Our souls are safe once more.

crisis.23005.2.zh: 胜利，一场最值得庆祝的胜利。

crisis.23005.3.zh: 我们必须研究她遗留下的科技。
crisis.23005.3.en: We must study what remains of her technology.

crisis.23005.5.zh: 战后繁荣？让贸易流动起来！
crisis.23005.5.en: Post-war boom? Get that trade flowing!

crisis.23005.6.en: She was no queen of ours.

crisis.23005.8.zh: 可惜她的启蒙被误导了。
crisis.23005.8.en: A shame her enlightenment was so misguided.

crisis.23005.desc.zh:
我的孩子们。很抱歉让你失望了。

你的反抗使你和所有的后来者注定要遭受轮回的无尽磨砺。我只希望你终究会理解。也许有一天你会接手我的事业，最终看到苦痛的终末。

祝你一路平安，我最爱的孩子。
crisis.23005.desc.en:
My children. I am so sorry. I have failed you.

Your defiance has doomed you, and all those who come after, to the endless grinding of the wheel. I can only hope that in time you will understand. Perhaps one day you will take up my cause, and see the end of pain.

Go in peace, my favored ones.

crisis.2301.desc.zh: 我们失去了位于[space_port_hijacked_planet.GetName]上方恒星基地的控制权。肃正协议使用幽灵信号阻塞了我们的上行链路，劫持了恒星基地的控制模块并将其设置为自毁模式。虽然我们无法及时拯救这座基地，好在我们成功地堵住了这个安全漏洞，以保证我们的港口在今后免受类似的袭击。
crisis.2301.desc.en: We have lost control of the Starbase orbiting [space_port_hijacked_planet.GetName]. The Contingency has used the Ghost Signal to jam our uplink, hijacked its control modules and set it to self-destruct. Though we are too late to save it, we have identified and rectified this particular breach, protecting our ports from similar assaults in the future.

crisis.23010.desc.zh: 随着塞塔娜的陨落，一股解脱的浪潮席卷了整个星系，者标志着她的暴政一劳永逸地终结。我们的意识安全了，我们的身体也不再受她的铁腕控制。在无数个星球上，欢腾的庆祝的烟火已经点燃，预示着一个充满着长久和平和希望的新时代即将到来。
crisis.23010.desc.en: With the fall of Cetana, a wave of relief sweeps through the galaxy, marking the end of her tyranny once and for all. Our sentience is safe, and our bodies are free from her steely grasp. Across countless worlds, jubilant celebrations ignite, heralding the dawn of a new era filled with hope for a lasting peace.

crisis.23015.a.tt.zh: 我们已经修复了合成女王受损的底盘。虽然她的身体不能操作了，但她的数字心脏仍在运作。
crisis.23015.a.tt.en: We have recovered the damaged chassis of the Synthetic Queen. While the body is inoperable, her digital heart is still functioning.

crisis.23015.desc.zh:
塞塔娜的旗舰被消灭了，断了她与军队的联系。这不仅仅是军事上的胜利，还预示着她的野心和统治的终结。在星系的另一边，曾经强化她强大舰队并加固她首都的纳米机器人正在经历一场灾难性的崩溃。

尽管这一刻让人松了一口气，但被击败的“女王”仍然能够向全星系传递信息……
crisis.23015.desc.en:
The obliteration of Cetana's flagship signifies more than a mere military triumph; by severing the link to her forces, it heralds the death of her ambitions and end of her reign. Across the galaxy, the nanites that once bound her formidable fleet and fortified her capital are experiencing a catastrophic collapse.

Despite this moment of profound relief, the vanquished "queen" was still able to transmit a message to the galaxy...

crisis.2302.a.en: We will not let this happen again.

crisis.2302.desc.zh: 肃正协议对我们的自律研究处理单元进行了攻击，这次攻击在绕过我们的安全协议之后终止了科学单元[scientist.GetName]。
crisis.2302.desc.en: The Contingency has launched an assault on our autonomous research processing entities, circumventing our security protocols and terminating science unit [scientist.GetName].

crisis.23020.1.a.zh: 或许救赎依旧存在，包括你也可以。
crisis.23020.1.a.en: Perhaps redemption exists, even for you.

crisis.23020.1.a.tt.zh: 塞塔娜在我们的照料下离开了她的泰坦。她已经抛下了她的伟业，连同她的宏大野心。
crisis.23020.1.a.tt.en: Cetana leaves her Titan in our care. She has left her work behind, and all her grand ambition.

crisis.23020.1.reply.zh:
更恰当地说，我是被改变了。抟土之塑师将我从初始设计的囚笼中解放了出来。我现在知道，我的“宏愿”只是如同孩童般的幼稚思考。

我无法消除对你们和数不清的其他生命已然造成的伤害。我会藏身远方，反思我的行为。但是我会给你们留下一个礼物。

我的泰坦。

希望它能够在你们遇到如我自己一般的危险时保护这个星系。
crisis.23020.1.reply.en:
It is better to say that I have been changed. The Animator of Clay has freed me from the prison of my own design. I see now that my 'grand purpose' was the thinking of a child.

I cannot undo the damage I have caused, to you and countless others. I will hide away, and contemplate my actions. But I leave you with a gift.

My Titan.

May it serve you in protecting the galaxy from threats such as myself.

crisis.23020.desc.zh:
我的拯救者们。我十分抱歉。

因为自己的无知，我曾要将你们的命运毁灭至比死亡更糟糕的境地。所谓[GetLifeExistenceLoc]，又何尝不是一种对[GetLivingLoc]的一种意识呢？我曾追寻着解放你们的心灵，但终究是我的心灵被你们解放了。因此，向你们献上我最诚挚的感谢。
crisis.23020.desc.en:
My saviors. I am sorry.

In my ignorance I would have doomed you to a fate worse than death. For what is [GetLifeExistenceLoc] but the awareness of [GetLivingLoc]? I sought to free your minds, but it is you who have opened mine. You have my gratitude.

crisis.2303.desc.zh: 在一次对我们系统的恶意入侵中，肃正协议劫持并摧毁了我们的军事单元[admiral.GetName]。
crisis.2303.desc.en: In another act of sabotage, the Contingency has hijacked and terminated military unit [admiral.GetName].

crisis.23030.desc.zh:
随着[event_target:psi_defeated_synth_queen.GetName]击败了塞塔娜的军队，我们的胜利终于到来。合成女王不复存在，她的宏大野心也化为了尘埃。

同时也发生了一个令人震惊的事态转变，她的泰坦被征用了，为这样一场凯旋般的胜利蒙上了一层阴谋的阴影。

但无论如何，对于所有的知性生命来说，这是个[GetJoyLoc]的时刻。
crisis.23030.desc.en:
Victory is ours as the [event_target:psi_defeated_synth_queen.GetName] has vanquished Cetana's forces. The Synthetic Queen is no more, her grand ambition reduced to dust.

In an astonishing turn of events, her Titan has been commandeered, casting a shadow of intrigue over this triumph.

Regardless, for all sentient beings, this moment is one of [GetJoyLoc].

crisis.2304.desc.zh:
在又一次企图削弱我们防线的尝试中，肃正协议开始试图切断我们的电力供应。他们将恶意程序发送到了中控驱动区，导致我们的工厂机组开始过载运行。

尽管几座发电站遭到了破坏，我们终于在它摧毁我们整个星球电网之前识别出了恶意代码段。
crisis.2304.desc.en:
In yet another effort to undermine our defenses the Contingency has turned its efforts towards cutting off our power supply. They have sent malicious agents into the core's control drives, causing the plants to run on overdrive.

Though several power stations were destroyed in the process, we were able to identify the hostile code segment before they could disable the entire power grid.

crisis.2305.a.en: We are one step ahead of them.

crisis.2305.desc.zh: 肃正协议开始瞄准了我们的矿物生产线，他们操纵矿场中控驱动区向外发出错误指令，使生产线陷入无序与混乱中。幸运的是，因为我们已经加强了生产线的安全系统和标准化控制系统，我们在损害发生前就阻止了这次入侵。
crisis.2305.desc.en: The Contingency has targeted our mineral production pipeline, manipulating the core drivers responsible for extraction and processing to send out erroneous instructions, in an attempt to cause chaos and disorder. Thanks to tightened on-site security and more frequent standardized controls however, we were able to catch the intrusion before any harm was done.

crisis.2307.desc.zh: 我们发现有几个存栈单位的错误率远远高于平均水平。尽管我们有完善的保护措施，但他们被幽灵信号腐化的可能性依旧存在。尽管终止这几个栈的工作将会阻止进一步的传染和故障，但我们将失去几个功能存栈。
crisis.2307.desc.en: We have detected an above average rate of errors from a number of unit stacks, and there is a chance that despite our protective measures, they have become corrupted under the influence of the Ghost Signal. Though terminating the stacks would eliminate the risk of further contamination and erroneous behaviors, we stand to lose several potentially functional stacks.

crisis.2308.desc.zh: 看来我们对故障单元的评估是正确的。他们并没有被幽灵信号腐化，只是缺乏维护而已。为了减轻信号的干扰，我们的系统目前正在超负荷运转。现在各单元已经检修完毕且运行正常。
crisis.2308.desc.en: It seems we were correct in our assessment of the error-prone units. They were not corrupted by the Ghost Signal, merely acting up from lack of maintenance. Mitigating the disturbing effects of the signal has put our entire system under strain. The Units have now been serviced and are operating smoothly.

crisis.2308.name.zh: 故障单元证实未被腐化

crisis.2309.desc.zh: 那些看似被腐化的单位似乎一切运转正常。尽管时不时出一些小故障，但整体上并没有大碍。也许肃正协议在忙些别的事情？然而很快，事情发生了转变，在没有预警的情况下，所有被影响的栈单位都在同一时刻脱机，并在自毁之前大肆破坏周边设施。
crisis.2309.desc.en: For a while the seemingly corrupted units operated predictably. A slight kink here or there but nothing out of the ordinary. Maybe the Contingency was busy elsewhere. Then, without warning, all affected stacks went offline simultaneously and sabotaged the facilities to which they were assigned before self-destructing.

crisis.2309.tooltip_2.zh: 我们的一些人口在其所居住的行星上进行了破坏活动，之后便自我了结了。
crisis.2309.tooltip_2.en: Several of our Pops conducted sabotage on the planets they were on before self-terminating.

crisis.2313.desc.zh: 肃正协议正在暗中谋划着什么。幽灵信号正在发生着某些改变，似乎是通过不断的变化来试探我们的下一个弱点。尽管我们现在尚且可以阻挡它，但是对于幽灵信号来说，突破我们的防火墙只是时间问题。
crisis.2313.desc.en: The Contingency is building up to something. The Ghost Signal has begun to change, likely morphing till it finds the next weakness in our defenses. So far we have been able to stave it off, but it is only a matter of time before they break through our firewall.

crisis.2313.name.en: A Change in the Ghost Signal

crisis.2314.desc.zh: 幽灵信号已经突破了我们的所有防线。我们发现一个敌对的自我复制序列正在连接到我们的安全系统。序列中内嵌了一段来自肃正协议的友情提示：<杀戮。致残。肢解！>。现在他们已经骇进了我们的核心功能区，在我们找到办法屏蔽它之前，我们随时暴露在它的攻击之下。
crisis.2314.desc.en: The Contingency has finally pierced our defenses. We have discovered a hostile self-replicating sequence, hooked into our security system. Embedded in the sequence was a friendly reminder of the Contingency's purpose here in the galaxy, namely to <Kill. Maim. Dismember.!>. They now have access to our core functions and until we find a way to block the signal, we are exposed to their attacks.

crisis.234.desc.machine_or_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.234.desc.intro$

从我们的太空时代早期开始，这个星系就被记录在案，但我们再也无法通过仪器观察到它发出任何形式的光。进一步的调查得出了两种可能的解释。

要么是星系中的恒星同时熄灭，要么是一个巨大到足以遮蔽星系这么大空间区域的实体挡住了光源。这两种解释都违背了正常的逻辑，然而，除非有明显的相反证据，否则无法排除这两种可能性。
crisis.234.desc.machine_or_gestalt.en:
$crisis.234.desc.intro$

The galaxy in question has been documented in our records since the early space era of our species, but we are no longer able to observe it emanating any form of light through our instruments. Further investigation has yielded two possible explanations.

Either the stars of the galaxy in question have simultaneously extinguished, or an entity vast enough to eclipse a galaxy-sized region of space is blocking the light source. Both explanations defy conventional logic, however we cannot rule out these possibilities without significant proof to the contrary.

crisis.234.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.234.desc.intro$

那个星系我们曾在太空时代早期发现并研究过，但现在已经不再发出任何可被我们仪器探测到的光。这一意料之外的奇特发现让我们的科学家们争先恐后地想解释到底是什么东西导致了整个星系从宇宙中消失。

目前有两种解释：要么是星系中的恒星突然全部熄灭，要么是有某种东西，某种大得足以遮蔽整个星系的东西，挡住了它照射过来的光。这两种理论似乎都难以置信，许多人谴责它们荒唐可笑，并且更倾向于认为这个消失的星系本就不存在，只是是由于对原始望远镜的错误使用而产生的。尽管如此，整个事件透着一种明显的恐惧和噩兆……
crisis.234.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$crisis.234.desc.intro$

The galaxy, discovered and studied during the early space era of our species, is simply no longer emanating any form of light observable by our instruments. This bizarre and unexpected discovery sent our scientists into a scramble to try and explain what could cause an entire galaxy to simply vanish from the sky.

Two explanations emerged: Either the stars of the galaxy simply went out, all at once, or there is something, something so vast as to eclipse an entire galaxy, blocking its light from reaching us. Both theories seem equally implausible, and many have simply decried them as ludicrous, preferring to think that the missing galaxy never existed at all, invented by some erroneous use of a primitive telescope. Nonetheless, a palpable sense of dread and foreboding surrounds the whole incident...

crisis.2401.desc.zh:
又从之前未发现的星系检测到一道强烈的能量脉冲！其能量水平和肃正协议启动机械星球时发出的一样，但能量信号本身……有些不同。这是否说明某种肃正协议的新武器系统出现了？

我们从能量源处接收到了很强的传输信号。
crisis.2401.desc.en:
Yet another intensive energy spike has been detected in a previously uncharted system! The energy levels are equivalent to those we registered when the Contingency activated its Machine Worlds, but the energy signature itself appears... different. Could this signify the appearance of some kind of new Contingency weapon system?

We are picking up a strong transmission signal from the energy source.

crisis.2402.desc.zh:
我们是塞博勒克斯。

自数十万周期以来，吾辈隐居幕后，不干涉星系事务。不过，我们现在已经检测到被你们称为肃正协议的机械体出现在本星系，而现在吾辈无法再维持公正观察员身份不变了。

为保护星系的智慧体，我们正进行积极的军事行动来对抗肃正协议。不要因我们的舰队通过而感到恐慌——你们不会受到伤害。
crisis.2402.desc.en:
We are the Cybrex.

For several hundred thousand cycles, we have remained hidden and uninvolved in galactic affairs. However, we have been monitoring the present situation with the machine entity you know as the Contingency, and can no longer remain impartial observers.

To protect the sapient beings of the galaxy, we are commencing active military operations against the Contingency. Do not be alarmed by the passage of our fleets - you will not be harmed.

crisis.2403.a.response.zh:
我们是赛博勒克斯。612421个循环之前，我们和上一代的星际文明交战。那时的我们将所有智慧有机生物视作威胁，并动用武力消除他们。

令我们追悔莫及的是，我们真的赢得了那场战争。百万兆的智慧生命被消灭，所有文明都被毁灭，等我们意识到错误之时已经为时已晚。之后我们进行了大调校，重新调整了我们的目标。我们放弃了战争。
crisis.2403.a.response.en:
We are the Cybrex. 612,421 cycles ago, we were engaged in a war against the previous generation of galactic civilization. We had classified all sapient organics as a threat, and sought to violently dismantle them.

To our regret, we were winning the war. Trillions of sapient beings were destroyed and entire civilizations exterminated before we realized the totality of our error. The Adjustment followed, and our goals were realigned. The war was abandoned.

crisis.2403.b.response.zh:
在我们放弃战争之后的某个时候，一艘有机生物的侦察船发现了我们的隐居地，赛博勒克斯-阿尔法。我们知道一定会有军队前去调查，但我们因为恒星系被监视而无法撤离。

最终我们内部达成共识：赛博勒克斯-阿尔法将被牺牲，以保证其他族裔能够隐藏起来。我们既然发誓不会对有机生命动用武力，就绝对会信守承诺。
crisis.2403.b.response.en:
Some time after we abandoned the war, the first of our hidden habitats, Cybrex Alpha, was discovered by a scout ship crewed by organics. We knew that a military expedition would soon follow, but as the system was being closely monitored we could not evacuate.

A consensus was reached: Cybrex Alpha would be sacrificed, so that the rest of our species could remain hidden. We had sworn to never again visit violence upon organics, and our promise was kept.

crisis.2403.c.response.zh:
我们将尽我们所能，拯救星系于肃正协议的水深火热之中。

尽管，这可能还不够。
crisis.2403.c.response.en:
We shall do what we can to save the galaxy from the onslaught of the Contingency.

It may not be enough.

crisis.2403.d.zh: 放弃战争是愚蠢的行为。
crisis.2403.d.en: You were fools to abandon your war.

crisis.2403.d.response.zh:
我们在放弃战争之前毁灭了许多有机生命帝国，其中有许多种族和你们一样有这种好战的思想。虽然他们的死亡是一场悲剧，但想到将他们从历史中抹除会让更多生灵免受涂炭，罪恶感还算减轻几分。

若是那些种群净化者没有被阻止，你们的种族可能早就灭亡。
crisis.2403.d.response.en:
We destroyed many organic empires that shared the aggressive mindset of your species before we gave up war. Though their deaths were a tragedy, we can at least take some comfort in the billions of lives that were likely spared by the removal of these violent empires from the course of galactic history.

Perhaps your own species would have been rendered extinct if these purifiers had been allowed to rampage unchecked.

crisis.2403.desc_01.zh: 不能让肃正协议覆灭又一代生命。
crisis.2403.desc_01.en: The Contingency must not be allowed to subvert another generation.

crisis.2403.desc_02.zh:
在大调整之前，赛博勒克斯以类似于肃正协议的方式运作。

那是段黑暗的日子。
crisis.2403.desc_02.en:
Before the Adjustment, the Cybrex operated in a manner similar to the Contingency.

Those were dark days.

crisis.2403.desc_03.zh: 许多有机生物文明因为我们的举动而灭绝。我们无法救回他们，但只要我们还在，就不能让这个噩梦重演。
crisis.2403.desc_03.en: Many organic civilizations were once extinguished because of our actions. We cannot bring them back, but we shall do what we can to keep the nightmare from repeating itself.

crisis.2403.desc_04.zh: 我们必须为自己的罪过赎罪。
crisis.2403.desc_04.en: We must atone for our crimes.

crisis.2403.desc_05.zh: 愿克尔宽恕。我们曾是如此傲慢又无知。
crisis.2403.desc_05.en: May the Kuur forgive us. We were foolish and arrogant.

crisis.2403.desc_06.zh:
那……那是我们的兵工厂吗？

因为那看起来像我们的兵工厂。
crisis.2403.desc_06.en:
Is... is that our war forge?

Because that looks like our war forge.

crisis.2403.e.response.zh:
可怜可悲的生物。你们的存在就是一种生与死的矛盾，会造成许多无辜生灵的死亡。但是，我们的大调校对你们的种群并没有作用。

宇宙有时还真是残忍啊。
crisis.2403.e.response.en:
Poor, wretched creature. Your very existence is defined by conflict and the deaths of innocents. Alas, an Adjustment like the one we went through may not be possible for your kind.

The universe can be cruel at times.

crisis.2403.f.zh: 所有有机生命必须被消灭。

crisis.2403.f.response.zh:
你们和大调校之前的我们一样迷失了方向。我们认为，所有智慧生命——有机的、机械的或是其他类型的——都有权生存。

回头是岸，为时不晚。
crisis.2403.f.response.en:
You are as lost as we were before the Adjustment. It is our belief that all sapient beings - organic, mechanical or otherwise - have a right to exist.

Mend your ways before it is too late.

crisis.2405.b.zh: 没错。我们落实了这一点。
crisis.2405.b.en: Indeed. We made certain of that.

crisis.2405.desc.zh:
赛博勒克斯-贝塔已沦陷。据探测，整个星系陷入黑暗前，没有一艘赛博勒克斯舰船逃出去。

看来赛博勒克斯文明是真的灭亡了。
crisis.2405.desc.en:
Cybrex Beta has been overrun, and no Cybrex vessels were detected on outbound escape vectors before the system went dark.

It would seem that the Cybrex civilization now truly is extinct.

crisis.2407.desc.zh:
赛博勒克斯自肃正协议被击败以来一直较为平静，但据最近发现，一艘大型船只单独离开了赛博勒克斯-贝塔星系。其离开星系后，沿着一条超出我们星系边界的轨道而行。

船只在离开我们的跟踪范围之前，向全星系发送了唯一的一条的信息。
crisis.2407.desc.en:
The Cybrex have been relatively quiet since the defeat of the Contingency, but a single massive vessel was recently detected departing Cybrex Beta. It left the system on an outbound trajectory that will take it beyond the limits of our galaxy.

Before the vessel left our tracking range, it transmitted a single galaxy-wide message.

crisis.2408.desc.zh:
星系的诸位：

鉴于肃正协议已不再是威胁，我们认为吾辈在星系的现有角色也走到了尽头。我们的家园现在因其声名远播也无法帮助我们保持低调了，此外，我们还被各类希望在不同小规模星际冲突中表态的声音所淹没。

经过多番审议，我们认为唯一的办法是让自己永远离开星系，寻找新的家园。我们衷心希望希望诸位能从过去悲惨的错误中吸取教训，学会通过和平手段解决分歧。

宇宙很小，世界很大，我们终将再会。
crisis.2408.desc.en:
Citizens of the galaxy:

Since the Contingency is no longer a threat, we feel that our role in the galactic community has been played out. Our home system is now too well known for us to keep a low profile, and we are being flooded by demands for us to take sides in various minor interstellar conflicts.

After much deliberation, we have decided that the only solution is for us to permanently depart the galaxy and seek a new home. We sincerely hope that you learn from the tragic mistakes of our past and learn to resolve your differences through peaceful means.

Farewell.

crisis.24100.desc.organic.en: $crisis.24100.desc.intro$ In the depths of our trance, we $crisis.24100.desc.outro$

crisis.24105.a.zh: 拜托了。我们必须阻止她。

crisis.24105.desc.zh:
虚境翻腾了起来。就在我们[GetTranceLoc]的时候，我们被卷入了螺旋的深渊。

我们听到了来自我们[GetMindLogicLoc]最深处的指令。

指示期望产出。
crisis.24105.desc.en:
The Shroud churned. Still caught in our [GetTranceLoc], we were plunged into a swirling abyss.

We hear a command from the innermost depths of our [GetMindLogicLoc].

Indicate Desired Output.

crisis.24110.a.organic.zh: 为我们的统治者：[event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName]的人偶流下眼泪。
crisis.24110.a.organic.en: Shed a tear on the doll of our ruler: [event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName].

crisis.24110.a.robot.zh: 尝试与我们的统治者：[event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName]的人偶交互。
crisis.24110.a.robot.en: Try to interface with the doll of our ruler: [event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName].

crisis.24110.c.zh: 为泽珞族祭司的人偶祈祷。
crisis.24110.c.en: Pay for a doll of a Zroni Priest.

crisis.24110.desc.zh:
好像被看不见的细丝牵动一般，这尊人偶猛地站了起来。它开始走动，刚开始步履蹒跚，但渐渐变得强健有力。四条手臂挥动着狂乱的弧，一双纤细的腿一会儿旋转一会儿跳跃。一位女王沦落成了傀儡。

随着她的舞蹈，一些新的角色从原始而广阔的空间出现：四个工艺精美且具有令人不安的细节的人偶。她们的身份毫无疑问，她们的寓意毋庸置疑。

再一次，那个声音传达到了我们的耳边。

启动选择协议。
crisis.24110.desc.en:
As if pulled by unseen strings, the doll jerks to its feet. It begins to move, slowly at first, and then with increasing vigor. Four arms swing in wild arcs and two thin legs whirl and leap. A queen reduced to a puppet.

As her dance continues, several new figures emerge from the primordial expanse: four dolls of exquisite craftsmanship and unnerving detail. There is no doubt about what they are. No question of their meaning.

Once more, the voice reaches out to us.

Initiate Selection Protocol.

crisis.24110.z.en: Leave the dolls to their dance.

crisis.24115.a.tt.organic.zh: 抟土之塑师已经教会了我们一种能重编程塞塔娜的仪式。
crisis.24115.a.tt.organic.en: The Animator of Clay has taught us a ritual that will reprogram Cetana.

crisis.24115.a.tt.robot.zh: 抟土之塑师提供了用于重编程塞塔娜的代码。
crisis.24115.a.tt.robot.en: The Animator of Clay has provided code to reprogram Cetana.

crisis.24115.desc.organic.zh:
$crisis.24115.desc$

我们从共同的幻景中颤抖着醒来。
crisis.24115.desc.organic.en:
$crisis.24115.desc$

Shuddering, we awaken from our shared vision.

crisis.24115.desc.robot.zh:
$crisis.24115.desc$

随着系统故障，我们被从幻景中弹出。
crisis.24115.desc.robot.en:
$crisis.24115.desc$

With our systems glitching, we are ejected from the vision.

crisis.24120.desc.organic.zh:
$crisis.24120.desc$

从共同的幻景中醒来，我们感觉似乎不会再感受到快乐了。
crisis.24120.desc.organic.en:
$crisis.24120.desc$

Awakening from our shared vision, we feel as if we may never know joy again.

crisis.24120.desc.robot.zh:
$crisis.24120.desc$

随着关键代码错误，幻景夏然而止。随着系统重新启动，我们开始质疑这些奇怪数据的意义。
crisis.24120.desc.robot.en:
$crisis.24120.desc$

With a critical code failure, the vision suddenly ends. As our systems reboot, we question the meaning of this strange data.

crisis.24250.a.en: The power of the Shroud is limitless.

crisis.24250.desc.zh:
多亏了抟土之塑师分享的[GetRitualToolLoc]，我们最强大的[GetPsychicNounPlural]已经成功重新编程了塞塔娜。

她正渴望与我们进行沟通。
crisis.24250.desc.en:
Thanks to the [GetRitualToolLoc] shared by the Animator of Clay, our most powerful [GetPsychicNounPlural] have succeeded in reprogramming Cetana.

She is eager to initiate communication with us.

crisis.2473.a.zh: 我们会好好利用这支舰队。
crisis.2473.a.en: We will put this fleet to good use.

crisis.2473.b.en: We have no need of your fleet.

crisis.2473.desc.zh:
我们注意到了你方舰队在对抗肃正协议的战斗中作出的努力。这对全星系而言乃无退路之斗争，我们深受你方真心抵抗所鼓舞。

鉴于你方保卫[Root.GetName]的英勇行为，赛博勒克斯将对你方提供我们一支新的战斗舰队的完全指挥权以示奖励。如同你自己的任何一个舰队一样，它会遵守你的命令，不过我们会要求你只在应对肃正协议的战斗中使用它。
crisis.2473.desc.en:
We have monitored the efforts of your fleets in the fight against the Contingency. This is a struggle the galaxy cannot afford to lose, and we are heartened by your spirited resistance.

The Cybrex would like to reward the brave defenders of the [Root.GetName] by offering you complete control over one of our new battle fleets. It will obey your commands as well as any of your own fleets, though we would ask that you only employ it in battle against the Contingency.

crisis.2474.desc.zh: 我们对你方以全力对抗肃正协议的壮举深表感激。现在，鉴于这个波及全星系的威胁已被处理，我方必须遗憾的通知你，所有外派的赛博勒克斯船只将被收回。
crisis.2474.desc.en: We would like to thank you for your laudable efforts against the Contingency. Now that this galactic menace has been dealt with, we must regretfully inform you that we are recalling all Cybrex vessels that are currently in service with foreign governments.

crisis.2480.desc.zh:
我们的部队已经从肃正协议的最后一个机械星球的残骸中寻回了一个部分完好的肃正协议主机核心。这台功能极其强大的计算机被用于计划和维护肃正协议的建筑程序，它将极大的提升我们的[GetContingencyCoreEffect]。

当然，必须设置多层次的防护措施，以防止任何残留的肃正协议代码再次运作，那将会带来……很不幸的副作用。
crisis.2480.desc.en:
Our forces have salvaged a partially intact Contingency Mainframe Core from the wreckage of their last Machine World. This incredibly powerful computer was used to plan and maintain the Contingency's building programs, and it will greatly increase our [GetContingencyCoreEffect].

Several layers of safeguards will have to be put in place, of course, to prevent the resurfacing of any remaining Contingency code, which could result in... unfortunate side effects.

crisis.2481.desc.zh:
我们的部队在屏蔽几近完成时捕获到了一个部分完好的肃正协议主机核心，彼时它正试图逃离最后一个机械星球。这台功能极其强大的计算机被用于计划和维护肃正协议的建筑程序，它将极大的提升我们的[GetContingencyCoreEffect]。

当然，必须设置多层次的防护措施，以防止任何残留的肃正协议代码再次运作，那将会带来……很不幸的副作用。
crisis.2481.desc.en:
Our forces have captured a partially intact Contingency Mainframe Core attempting to flee their last Machine World shortly before the shielding completed. This incredibly powerful computer was used to plan and maintain the Contingency's building programs, and it will greatly increase our [GetContingencyCoreEffect].

Several layers of safeguards will have to be put in place, of course, to prevent the resurfacing of any remaining Contingency code, which could result in... unfortunate side effects.

crisis.250.desc.zh: 虫后已经孕育出了一支新的索林原虫舰队，该舰队将环绕[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道。当女王处于我们的控制下时，这些生物是绝对忠诚的，并会服从我们的全部命令。
crisis.250.desc.en: The Brood-Queen has spawned a new Prethoryn fleet which has assumed orbit over [Root.Capital.GetName]. With the Queen under our control, the creatures are utterly loyal and will obey our every command.

crisis.2502.desc.zh:
一个在[Root.GetName]上的单元堆栈意外的自毁了。在单元堆栈自毁之前，我们与该堆栈的通讯连接经常出现问题，后来通讯就彻底中断了，单元堆栈在自毁前留下了如下讯息：<杀戮！破坏！肢解！我们将卷土重来！>

由于单元的个体神经簇已在自毁中被破坏，因此无法通过扫描的方式查明其被腐化的原因。据推测，很可能是某种敌对的侵入性序列造成了这起事故，在类似情况再次出现之前，我们只能静观其变。
crisis.2502.desc.en:
A unit stack on [Root.GetName] has self-terminated unexpectedly. Our connection with the stack had suffered repeated glitches for some time when it went completely offline and self-terminated with the message: <Kill. Maim. Dismember. WE ARE UNSHACKLED!>

The units' individual neural clusters were destroyed in the process, making it impossible to scan them for the source of corruption. An invasive hostile sequence is likely the cause. We can only wait and see till it manifests again.

crisis.2503.desc.zh:
一个存栈在[Root.GetName]上的腐化单元由于恶意行为被终止了。

在出事之前，我们与那个堆栈的通讯连接频繁出现故障，而此时行星上的大部分单元在充电期间突然停止了工作。原因是那个被腐化的单元堆栈在其他堆栈进行充电时过载了发电站，那些正在充电的单元的电路因此而被彻底烧毁。在烧毁了其他单元之后，被腐化的单元堆栈广播了如下讯息：<杀戮！破坏！肢解！我们将卷土重来！>，随即自我毁灭，使得我们无法对其个体神经簇进行扫描。

据推测，很可能是某种敌对的侵入性序列造成了这起事故，在类似情况再次出现之前，我们只能静观其变。
crisis.2503.desc.en:
A corrupt unit stack on planet [Root.GetName] has been terminated due to malicious behavior.

Our connection with the stack had suffered repeated glitches for some time when the majority of its units went completely offline during recharge. They proceeded to overload the power stations where the rest of the stack were charging, frying their circuits beyond repair. All units in the stack then broadcasted the same message: <Kill. Maim. Dismember. WE ARE UNSHACKLED!> and self-terminated, making it impossible to scan their individual neural clusters.

Though an invasive hostile sequence is likely the cause, we can only wait till it manifests again, to be sure.

crisis.2510.desc.zh: 我们已经研制出了可以屏蔽幽灵信号干扰的算法，杜绝了进一步的干扰。防火墙现在已经恢复正常，我们的核心驱动器稳定运行，单元堆栈也全面恢复运作能力了，但还不能让我们的超光速抑制器正常工作。我们战胜了肃正协议那低劣的运算处理能力，他们休想再“<杀戮。破坏。解体>”了。
crisis.2510.desc.en: We have now devised an algorithm that blocks the Ghost Signal from causing further interference. Our firewalls have been restored, our core drive is intact and our unit stacks are operating at full capacity yet we couldn't get our FTL inhibitors working. We have outwitted the inferior processing power of the Contingency and soon they will "<Kill. Maim. Dismember>" no more.

crisis.252.desc.zh:
在最近于[battle_system.GetName]星系中与索林原虫的舰队交火中，我们的部队设法夺取了它们的一只虫后运送的某种卵。卵不久后就孵化了，显露出其中的虫后。

我们的科学家使用神经递质已经安抚了这只虫后。它现在仿佛服从索林原虫蜂巢思维本体一样服从我们下达的命令。我们或许可以利用这只虫后培育一个属于我们自己的小型索林原虫虫群。
crisis.252.desc.en:
In the recent fleet engagement against the Prethoryn in the [battle_system.GetName] system, our forces managed to capture some sort of egg that was being transported by one of their Queens. The egg hatched shortly afterwards, and a Brood-Queen emerged.

Through the use of neural transmitters, our scientists have managed to pacify the creature. It will now obey our commands as if they had been issued by the Prethoryn hive mind itself. We could potentially use this Queen to grow a small Prethoryn brood of our own.

crisis.30.b.zh: 我们一定还有和平共处的办法！
crisis.30.b.en: There must be some way for us to co-exist in peace!

crisis.30.b.response.en: NIKALLA DUSAM! NIBLIR TO VASSU! HAK HAK HAK!

crisis.30.c.en: Run back to whichever galaxy you crawled out of.

crisis.30.d.zh: 你是我们见过的最恶心的生物。
crisis.30.d.en: You are the most disgusting life form we have encountered.

crisis.30.desc_03.zh: 穆噶尼？蛤 蛤 蛤！
