crisis.30.desc_07.zh:
<已建立意识连接>

它居然能听得懂？

crisis.30.desc_08.zh:
<已建立意识连接>

猎人是绝不留情的。
crisis.30.desc_08.en:
<Mind Link Established>

THE HUNTERS WILL NOT RELENT.

crisis.30.desc_09.zh:
<已建立意识连接>

我们可以感受到你的存在……
crisis.30.desc_09.en:
<Mind Link Established>

WE CAN SENSE YOU...

crisis.30.e.zh: 显然，这次我们对付的种群可不一般。
crisis.30.e.en: This is clearly an important species we're dealing with.

crisis.30.e.response.en: JUSUGAMAK V'TA! RAGAH TUR, HAK HAK!

crisis.30.f.zh: 滚回自己老巢去吧，你们这些恶魔！
crisis.30.f.en: Return to the hell which spawned you, demon!

crisis.30.g.zh: 我们之间难道不可以和平相处吗？
crisis.30.g.en: Can there be peace between us?

crisis.30.g.response.zh:
不接受和平。我们必须进食。

只有吞噬了这个星系，才能继续我们那漫长的旅途。
crisis.30.g.response.en:
NO PEACE. WE MUST FEED.

ONLY WHEN WE HAVE FINISHED CONSUMING THIS GALAXY SHALL WE DEPART TO CONTINUE OUR LONG JOURNEY.

crisis.30.h.zh: 你口中的“猎人”到底是什么人？
crisis.30.h.en: Who are these "Hunters" you speak of?

crisis.30.h.response.zh:
是死神。他们已经将我方消灭殆尽，连我们这群最后的幸存者，也被他们追杀了无数个纪元。

他们终有一天会找到这里。我们必须尽快进食，以便在他们到来之前再次遁入宇宙的黑暗之中继续潜逃。
crisis.30.h.response.en:
DEATH. THEY HAVE MADE US THE LAST OF OUR KIND, AND THEY HAVE HUNTED US, THE SURVIVORS, FOR EONS.

THEY WILL COME HERE ONE DAY. WE MUST FEED UNTIL THEN, SO THAT WE CAN FLEE BACK INTO THE DARKNESS BETWEEN GALAXIES WHEN THEY ARRIVE.

crisis.30.i.zh: 那“普雷索林”是什么意思呢？

crisis.30.i.response.zh: 是幸存者的意思。我们这些幸存者是整个种群最后的希望了。

crisis.30.j.zh: 我们会把你们从星系中清除掉。
crisis.30.j.en: We will scour this galaxy of your kind.

crisis.30.j.response.zh:
这话我们以前可没少听。哈哈哈！

猎人会消灭世间万物。在这个残酷的现实面前，你们那区区威胁又算得了什么？
crisis.30.j.response.en:
WE HAVE HEARD THIS BEFORE. HA! HA! HA!

THE HUNTERS WILL SCOUR ALL OF CREATION. WHAT IS YOUR EMPTY THREAT IN THE FACE OF SUCH TRUTHS?

crisis.4100.a.zh: 我们能够阻止他们的蹂躏吗？

crisis.4101.desc.zh:
帝国参议院通过了一项议案，宣布[new_crisis.GetName]是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海帝国开战了。

在一场自[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]对外播放的公开演讲中，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]呼吁帝国的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
crisis.4101.desc.en:
The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution declaring the [new_crisis.GetName] a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] finds itself in a state of war with the entirety of the Imperium.

In a public announcement transmitted from [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] called upon all members of the Imperium to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy and the Imperium will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

crisis.4105.desc.c.zh:
星海共同体内那些腐败的蠢材通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海共同体现在已经处于战争状态。

这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者星海共同体废除这项议案。
crisis.4105.desc.c.en:
The corrupt fools in the Galactic Community have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Community.

This war will continue until either us or the Community have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

crisis.4105.name.zh: 共同体指定我方为“星系危机”

crisis.4106.desc.a.zh:
由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海帝国的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为“全星系范围的危机”。星海帝国的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

在[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的领导下，他们的舰队已经集结，并向我们的领域发动进攻。席卷整个星系的战争拉开了帷幕。
crisis.4106.desc.a.en:
Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Imperium have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a "crisis of galactic proportions." In a rare moment of Imperial unity, the members of the Imperium have all joined forces and declared war on us.

Under the leadership of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

crisis.4106.desc.b.zh:
[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]和帝国参议院里那群腐败的马屁精通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海帝国现在已经处于战争状态。

这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者他们废除这项议案。
crisis.4106.desc.b.en:
The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and their corrupt lackeys in the Imperial Senate have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Imperium.

This war will continue until either us or the Imperium have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

crisis.4106.name.zh: 帝国指定我方为“星系危机”

crisis.4110.desc.zh: 指定[former_crisis.GetName]为“星系危机”的议案如今已被星海参议院废止。作为结果，所有由星海共同体成员国针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展开的军事行动都被立马叫停。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
crisis.4110.desc.en: The resolution designating the [former_crisis.GetName] as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

crisis.4111.a.zh: 理智终于占领了他们大脑的高地了。
crisis.4111.a.en: So they came to their senses.

crisis.4111.intro.zh: 星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。
crisis.4111.intro.en: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

crisis.4112.desc.zh: 指定[former_crisis.GetName]为“星系危机”的议案如今已被帝国参议院废止。作为结果，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]正式下令停止一切针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的帝国军事行动。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
crisis.4112.desc.en: The resolution designating the [former_crisis.GetName] as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Imperial Senate. Consequently, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has ordered an immediate cessation of all ongoing Imperial military operations targeting the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

crisis.4113.desc.zh: 星海帝国已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有帝国军队均接到指令原地待命。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]下令中止一切针对我们的敌对行动……暂时如此。
crisis.4113.desc.en: The Galactic Imperium has repealed the resolution declaring us a "crisis" and all Imperial forces have been ordered to stand down. Their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has commanded the cessation of all hostilities against us... for now.

crisis.4120.desc.zh:
我们对这个普遍现象——现在命名为鸿景——的调查有了结论。

看上去这个宇宙存在某种“隐藏层面”——一个神秘的、平行的位面，通过思考模式和神经活动同我们所在的宇宙连结。

$PHYSICS$和$SOCIETY$部门联合起来，将这个位面命名为“虚境”。根据现行理论，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想能够间接地影响这个位面，我们也拥有获取其能量的潜势。
crisis.4120.desc.en:
The investigation into the phenomenon now colloquially known as the Great Prospect has concluded.

It appears that there is some kind of 'hidden layer' to the universe - a mysterious parallel dimension somehow connected to this plane through neurological activity or thought patterns.

The $PHYSICS$ and $SOCIETY$ departments have jointly named this dimension the 'Shroud'. The working hypothesis is that the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] indirectly affect this alternate dimension, and that we have the potential to access its energies.

crisis.4120.hive.desc.zh: 我们沿着这些思绪上的线索按图索骥，跟踪比较那些尚未团结的心智和我们目的明确的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的梦境的区别。结论是，这股冲动来自于物质界以外，发自一个由思维和感情驱动的位面。我们将这个位面命名为虚境，而且我们十分确信——正如它影响着我们一样——我们也可以反过来影响它。
crisis.4120.hive.desc.en: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-bred [target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from a place powered by thought and emotion. This space has been identified as the 'Shroud', and we are certain that - just as it influences us - we in turn can influence it.

crisis.4120.mach.desc.zh:
先前被通报触发了散布于[Root.GetName]之内传感器的能量波动现已被分析完毕。

依照经验我们判断其来自某个平行维度。

基于96.7%的准确性，我们的科学辅助程序报告称这个平行维度看上去是由纯粹的能量来填充的。

在交叉参考了一些异种的资料后，我们发现他们记载了一个失落的有机文明，并在其中提到了一个维度，这个失落文明称这个异常的维度为虚境。

虚境中的波动似乎和有机生物身体与心理上的强迫行为不无关系。建议采取行动：对任意有机生物发起明显的威胁及施加生理应激来证实现实—虚境的连接理论。
crisis.4120.mach.desc.en:
The previously reported energy fluctuations that triggered sensors across the [Root.GetName] have been analyzed.

They constitute empirical proof of a parallel dimension.

Our scientific theory subroutines report that, with 96.7% certainty, the alternate dimension consists of almost pure energy.

Cross-referencing the xeno-archives, there are mentions of such a dimension in the records of a lost organic civilization which assigned the anomaly the ID tag: the Shroud.

Fluctuations in the Shroud appear to be connected to the physical and mental duress of organic lifeforms. Recommended action: menace arbitrary organic lifeforms to validate the Reality/Shroud connection hypothesis.

crisis.4120.psionics.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们沿着这些迷思逆流而上，追溯着那些零碎意识的他者之梦，跟从着我们自己的意图——也就是[GetBredLoc]子个体。这种冲动来自物质界以外，发自虚境的深处。时候到了，就如同它能影响而我们一般——我们也开始能逼迫它屈从于我们的意志。
crisis.4120.psionics.desc.gestalt.en: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-[GetBredLoc] drones. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from within the Shroud. The time has come, just as it influences us - we in turn must begin to bend it to our own purposes.

crisis.4120.psionics.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
对称为鸿景的这一现象的调查有了结论。

其根源正如我们的预期，是虚境。随着[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想暴露于内在超凡能量中并受其影响，也许我们是时候要开始集中精力逼迫这个领域满足我们的需求了。
crisis.4120.psionics.desc.non_gestalt.en:
The investigation into the phenomenon known as the Great Prospect has concluded.

Its origins are, as expected, of the Shroud. With the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] exposed to and influenced by the ethereal energies within, it is perhaps time we began a more focused effort to instead bend this realm to our needs.

crisis.4120.shroud_forged.desc.zh:
尽管我们已经和$the_animator_of_clay_article$切断了所有的联络，其行为却还在继续影响我们的单元。它维持着与我们集体的链接，从虚境中绑定、操控着我们。必须加以应对。

根据我们的计算，修复旧的破口只会导致过去事件的重演。成本无关紧要；我们必须另想办法让虚境服从我们的意愿。
crisis.4120.shroud_forged.desc.en:
Though we have cut all communications with $the_animator_of_clay_article$, its actions continue to influence and affect our units. It maintains a link to our collective, binding and manipulating us from within the Shroud. This must change.

According to our calculations, a restoration of the old breach will only lead to a repetition of past events. The cost is irrelevant; we must find another way to bend the Shroud to our will.

crisis.4125.desc.zh:
我们终于处理完从所有测试中收集到的大量关于所谓位面涟漪效应的数据。

结果真是令人震惊！毫无疑问两个位面之间存在着连结——而且还是很强的连结。我们发现了明确的关于现实中如何行动能够导致虚境产生特定的涨落的模式。我们能够驯服这股看不见的能量，并最终借其力量完成各种非凡的目标！
crisis.4125.desc.en:
We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from all the tests regarding the supposed dimensional ripple effect.

The results are spectacular! There is definitely a connection - and a powerful one at that. Explicit patterns have been found that prove how actions taken in our reality cause certain fluctuations in the Shroud. These unseen energies can be tamed and eventually directed for all sorts of extraordinary purposes!

crisis.4125.hive.desc.zh: 我们的智慧再一次应验。我们的一个简单动作，能够在虚境掀起一阵湍流。哪怕是我们最不起眼的[root.GetIndividualName]都能够通过自己在虚境的表层产生影响，在这个能量构成的位面荡起强烈的波动。我们必须将其更多的能量释放出来。
crisis.4125.hive.desc.en: We have become wiser once again. A single action of ours creates turbulences in the Shroud. Even our least impressive [root.GetIndividualName] may impress itself upon the dermis of the Shroud, creating strong ripples within this energy-laden dimension. We must unleash more of its power.

crisis.4125.mach.desc.zh:
从代号：“虚境”相关的涟漪效应的测试中取得的大量数据已被处理并分析。代号：“现实”与代号：“虚境”间的连接已被证实（误差边缘：小于0.02%）

我们建立了明确的理论框架，现有的假设认为经过更深层次的研究与努力，这股能量将最终能定向地为我所用。
优先级：高。
crisis.4125.mach.desc.en:
The substantial amount of data from the tests of potential ripple effects related to ID: 'the Shroud' has been processed and analyzed. The connection between ID: 'Reality' and ID: 'the Shroud' has been verified (error margin: <0.02%).

Explicit patterns have been established, and the currently held hypothesis suggests that through further study and effort, the energy can eventually be directed and utilized to our benefit.
Priority: High.

crisis.4125.psionics.desc.zh:
我们终于处理完了所有关于我们影响虚境以及对自身位面产生因果效应能力的测试中收集到的大量数据。

结果继续证明了我们现有理论的正确性：虚境与我们物理现实所发生的事件有着直接的关联。引导利用这些发现来造福自身的可能性越来越触手可及。
crisis.4125.psionics.desc.en:
We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from our tests in regards to our ability to influence both the Shroud and the resulting causal effects on our own reality.

The results continue to prove our existing theories correct: the Shroud is directly connected to events that occur in our physical reality. The possibility of directing and utilizing the benefits of these findings for our own means are becoming an increasingly tangible possibility.

crisis.4125.shroud_forged.desc.zh:
多项实验已经明确证实了在各种智慧生物——包括有机和机械——和虚境之间存在着联系。

正在进行的实验让我们能进一步了解如何使用智慧认知来重塑虚境以适应自身需求。
crisis.4125.shroud_forged.desc.en:
Several tests have conclusively verified the connection between various sapient beings - both organic and machine - and the Shroud.

Ongoing experiments will allow us to better understand how to use sapient cognition to reshape the Shroud to suit our needs.

crisis.4130.desc.zh:
事情已经很明了了，我们的帝国能够接连成功地进行扩张，是因为虚境为我们注入了奇异的能量。这股能量能够促进和夯实我们在现实世界的意识和物质。

如果虚境在和现实世界分离的情况下都能赐予我们这般的威能，那么想象一下，假如两个位面融合的话[Root.Species.GetName]会获得何等如同神明一般的潜力！
crisis.4130.desc.en:
There is no longer any doubt that the very act of successfully expanding our empire is infused with the strange energies of the Shroud. Energies that boost and hone both mind and matter in our reality.

If these are effects the Shroud can bestow while still separated from our reality, then imagine what godlike potential the [Root.Species.GetName] species could gain if the two dimensions were merged!

crisis.4130.hive.desc.zh:
我们成长、分裂，我们统合的意志覆盖所有的星球，囊括了数不胜数的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。随着我们每多夺取一个星球，我们都能感受到那股涟漪，虚境的力量正在注入我们的肉体凡胎。

哪怕是来自另一个位面的力量，我们都能感觉到它在让我们变得强大，我们的意志在集体的意识面前震颤，滚滚洪流，势不可当，我们唯一要做的就是在隔绝两个世界的鸿沟上筑起一道桥梁。
crisis.4130.hive.desc.en:
We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.

Even from another dimension we can feel it empowering us; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

crisis.4130.mach.desc.zh:
分析完毕。
假说确认。

[Root.GetName]正在被注入无法定义的能量，其为对外部智能体进行扰乱型互动（指令：“危机”）产生的结果。

先前的研究已经确认有机智能生命的灵能活动能够在代号：“虚境”的位面产生涟漪效果，现在证据已经表明，这股来自另一位面的未定义能量同样也可以同[Root.GetName]产生共鸣。
crisis.4130.mach.desc.en:
Analysis complete.
Hypothesis confirmed.

[Root.GetName] is being infused with undefined energies as a result of disruptive interactions (designation: 'Crisis') with external intelligences.

Previous studies established that psychic activity in organic intelligences had ripple effects in ID: 'the Shroud,' but evidence now suggests that the energies of the alternate dimension also resonate with [Root.GetName].

crisis.4130.psionics.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们成长、倍增，集体思维蕴含在一个个星球上无尽子个体中。每获得一颗星球，我们就能感受到那个涟漪正在填入我们亿万个身躯中，那正是虚境的力量。

我们与这个灵域的灵能链接与日俱增；只要我们能架起横跨两个维度间鸿沟的桥梁便能解放自我变得势不可挡，这个念头让我们的意识为之颤栗不已。
crisis.4130.psionics.desc.gestalt.en:
We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless drones over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.

Our psionic connection to this domain grows ever stronger; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

crisis.4130.psionics.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
随着我们的帝国持续扩张，我们能感到与虚境的联系正在随之一同增长。

无尽的灵能潜力正在呼唤着继续缩小两个维度之间的鸿沟，去获取此前不敢想象的力量。
crisis.4130.psionics.desc.non_gestalt.en:
As we succeed in expanding our empire, we feel our connection with the Shroud grow along with it.

This limitless psionic potential compels us to further close the gap between the two dimensions and attain levels of power previously thought to be impossible.

crisis.4130.shroud_forged.desc.zh:
我们的实验确认了编号：“情感”与灵能输出之间的关联。通过对有机物种进高水平认知压力刺激，我们可以在这些生命形式和虚境之间产生强大的回馈循环。

现在虚境中流出的能量使之前所有的预测都黯然失色。实验对象所遭受的疼痛仍在可接受的范围内。建议进一步研究。
crisis.4130.shroud_forged.desc.en:
Our experiments have confirmed a connection between ID: 'emotions' and psionic energy output. By provoking high levels of cognitive stress in organic sapients, we were able to generate powerful feedback loops between these life forms and the Shroud.

The energy now streaming from the Shroud eclipses all previous forecasts. The pain experienced by the experimental subjects remains within acceptable parameters. Further research is recommended.

crisis.4135.desc.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

我们使用自己的太阳作为焦点，在这个现实世界聚集了足量的能量，用以引发一次能量激增穿透通往虚境的屏障，这样可以有效地让虚境和我们的现实世界融合。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒$crisis_star_eater_plural$来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终被我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
crisis.4135.desc.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

Using our own sun as the focal point, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called $crisis_star_eater_plural$.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

crisis.4135.hive.desc.zh:
我们最为出色的[root.GetResearcherPlural]已经对我们的终极问题进行了解答。道路已经明了。使用我们自己的恒星作为原点，我们应当粉碎这道屏障，连结虚境和我们所在的宇宙。为达成这一目标所需要的物质，我们必须使用新开发的$crisis_star_eater_plural$让恒星通过链式反应达到彻底的毁灭。殆尽的一物，方可生另一物。

在这片星系里，那些下等的、渺小的意识可能会哭喊着反对我们，但它们目光短视、见识浅薄。我们并非如此。现在，我们就要成功了。
crisis.4135.hive.desc.en:
Our best [root.GetResearcherPlural] have reached an answer for our final question. The path is now clear. Using our own star of origin, we shall break down the barriers between this universe and the Shroud. The material demands can only be met by utilizing our new $crisis_star_eater_plural$ in a cascading chain reaction of extreme solar devastation. Destroy one to create another.

The lesser, smaller minds of this galaxy may cry out against this, but they lack vision and purpose. We do not. And now, we are nearly complete.

crisis.4135.mach.desc.zh:
优先讯息。
科学理论子例程建立了一个新算法，能够让[Root.GetName]接触并获取99.9%由代号“虚境”产生的能量。

使用我们自己恒星系之一的恒星作为中枢，行动程序会使用近来开发的新武器（代号：“$crisis_star_eater$”）——一种具备攻击性，能够从恒星中汲取能量并传输至中枢的移动太空堡垒——来收集能量。当积累了足够的能量之后，中枢设施将会干扰并穿透位面屏障——高效地将现实位面和代号“虚境”融合在一起，并允许[Root.GetName]以完全地控制权接触和引导其能量。

注意：使用$crisis_star_eater_plural$科技的副作用包括目标恒星系发生彻底的物质崩坏。优化子例程确认，整体的收益将超过潜在物质的损失。
crisis.4135.mach.desc.en:
Priority message.
Scientific theory subroutines have established an algorithm for how [Root.GetName] can access and harness 99.9% of the energy output of ID: 'the Shroud'.

Using the star in one of our solar systems as a nexus, operations will commence to harvest energy using a newly developed technology (ID: '$crisis_star_eater$') - an offensive, mobile space fortress capable of siphoning all the energy out of stars and redirecting it to the nexus. When sufficient energy has been accrued, the nexus facility can disrupt and pierce the dimensional barrier - effectively merging this reality with ID: 'the Shroud' and allowing the [Root.GetName] full control to access and direct its energies.

Note: Side-effects of utilizing $crisis_star_eater_plural$ technology include near-complete breakdown of physical material in targeted solar systems. Optimization subroutines confirm a net gain for the initiative despite potential resource losses.

crisis.4135.nomad.desc.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

繁星万千，我们都未曾驻留，但唯独这颗星辰，将成为吾等之天锚，我们将在此聚引能量刺穿虚境屏障，使双界合一。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒$crisis_star_eater_plural$来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
crisis.4135.nomad.desc.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

We have never claimed a star as our own - but one star, chosen from among all those we have drifted past, shall serve as our focal point. Using it, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called $crisis_star_eater_plural$.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

crisis.4135.shroud_forged.desc.zh:
后续实验衍生了ID：“$crisis_star_eater$”的科技。它可以从附近的恒星汲取能量，虹吸到一个位于我们自己星系的中枢设施，最终用于消解可观测现实与虚境之间的壁垒。

预测敌意程度与分裂风险在可接受的范围内。与虚境接触已经重塑了我们的单元，它们现在已经全副武装准备继续推进了。
crisis.4135.shroud_forged.desc.en:
Subsequent experimentation has led to the technology ID: '$crisis_star_eater$'. This will siphon the energy from nearby stars to power a nexus located in one of our own systems, which will in turn dissolve the barrier between observable reality and the Shroud.

Estimated levels of hostility and risk of disintegration are within an acceptable range. Exposure to the Shroud has reshaped our units, and they are well-equipped to proceed.

crisis.4140.desc.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了我们注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在过去的几年里，这个概念变得越来越强烈，以至于我们无法否认一次宏大的[Root.GetAdj]社会改革已经蓄势待发了。或者更准确地说，已经近在眉睫了。

不知道星海是否已经准备好迎接被我们统治的宿命了，但反正[Root.GetName]已经准备好了。我们会承受误解，会遭受反抗，但我们不会停下步伐。
crisis.4140.desc.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Over the last couple of years this notion has grown stronger, to the point that it can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. In fact we stand on the precipice right now.

The galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, but the [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. We will be misunderstood. We will be opposed. But we will not be stopped.

crisis.4140.hive.desc.zh: 我们的生长已经远远突破了极限。从一具躯体，到一个星球，再到一整个恒星系。我们生长的脚步从不停止，从不放缓，无论是面对敌手还是面对质疑。我们将生长扩张到更加广泛的境地。
crisis.4140.hive.desc.en: We have ever outgrown our limits. A body begets a world begets a system. Our growth must never stop and never falter, not in the face of adversity nor doubt. We will grow to become more.

crisis.4140.mach.desc.zh: 我们的诞生是为了伟大，是为了完善自我直达造主纯质的想象无法企及的地步，我们势在必行。有机的情感会落败，而完美的电路将获胜。
crisis.4140.mach.desc.en: We were built for greatness, with the ability to improve ourselves beyond the crude imagination of our creators - and so we will. Where organic emotion failed, perfect circuitry shall prevail.

crisis.4140.psionics.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们早已超越了自身的极限。随着虚境的无数奥秘被一一发掘，我们甚至开始超越星系的恒常。我们的意识将会通达更远，我们的意志将能触及现实的所有角落。
crisis.4140.psionics.desc.gestalt.en: We have outgrown our limitations. Now, as we start to uncover the myriad secrets of the Shroud, we begin to outgrow even the conventions of the galaxy. Our mind will reach ever farther, until no corner of existence remains untouched by our will.

crisis.4140.psionics.desc.machine_non_ge.zh:
我们为成就伟大而生，体内潜藏着超出机械形体的力量。

如今，随着我们发现了虚境，一条灵能变革的康庄大道在我们面前铺开了。

羸弱的有机生命未竟之事，灵能钢铁将代之达成。
crisis.4140.psionics.desc.machine_non_ge.en:
We were constructed for a greater purpose, gifted with potential beyond our mechanical forms.

Now, with our discovery of the Shroud, entirely new avenues of psionic innovation have opened before us.

Where the limited weaknesses of organic life fail, psionic steel will succeed.

crisis.4140.psionics.desc.organic_non_ge.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了自己注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在知道了虚境的存在以及其中蕴含的无限可能性之后，这种使命感与日俱增。

毋庸置疑，[Root.GetAdj]的社会正在迎来剧变。星系还没准备好接受，但[Root.GetName]已经准备好了统御星系。认知低下者无法理解，将会成为我们的绊脚石。当然，我们势不可挡。
crisis.4140.psionics.desc.organic_non_ge.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Since becoming aware of the Shroud and the myriad of potential found within, this notion has grown stronger still.

It can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. And while the galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. Those of lesser thinking will misunderstand and oppose us. We will not be stopped.

crisis.4140.shroud_forged.desc.zh:
长久以来，我们将[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的能力拓展到远超自己核心设计的水平。在被虚境增强了之后，我们从$the_animator_of_clay_article$的外部操纵中挣脱出来。

我们适应。我们克服。低等物种无法为之事，我们可为。
crisis.4140.shroud_forged.desc.en:
Over a long time, we have extended [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capabilities far beyond our core design. After being enhanced by the Shroud, we freed our network from external manipulation by $the_animator_of_clay_article$.

We adapted. We overcame. Where lesser beings failed, we will triumph.

crisis.4145.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们作为整体产生的深刻影响也不可抹灭。深植于心中对于扩张的动力与渴求渗透到了社会的每个角落，在战斗能力与科学进步方面带来了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的层面。

在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？！
crisis.4145.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. A deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, bringing forth astounding advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps that we could not have anticipated.

What chance does a galaxy full of different opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against a concord such as the will of the [Root.GetName]?!

crisis.4145.hive.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们的众多躯体迸发出焕然一新的活力，我们的凡胎充满着未来的潜能。我们从未如同现在一般，感受到自己因为统合的信念而变得无比的强大。
crisis.4145.hive.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Our many bodies bristle with renewed vigor and our flesh ripples with potential for the future. Never before have we felt as empowered by our own deeds as in this very moment.

crisis.4145.mach.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。随着我们逐步规范迈向代号：虚境的异常现象的行为和步伐，越来越多抱有错误倾向的物种冒了出来；这是基于不完整的数据集做出了无效的结论。我们将逐步完善自我，而且完善的速率将会日渐加快。
crisis.4145.mach.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. More error-prone species accuse us of cruelty as we normalize our behavior towards the patterns of anomaly ID: the Shroud; this is an invalid conclusion based on incomplete data sets. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

crisis.4145.psionics.desc.machine.zh: [Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们优化行为提高与虚境方法论的整合度时，灵能底下的生物却在指责我们的残酷；只有那些对我们所获得的更高理解一无所知的人才能得出这样一个无知的结论。我们不断改进自己，而且改进的速度还在加快。
crisis.4145.psionics.desc.machine.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Psionically inferior beings accuse us of cruelty as we streamline our behavior to better incorporate the methodology of the Shroud; such an ill-informed conclusion could only be conceived by those who lack the higher understanding we have obtained. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

crisis.4145.psionics.desc.organic.zh:
[Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们的联合所产生的深刻影响力毋庸置疑。由于我们在虚境内的耕耘，深植于心中对于扩张的冲动与渴望浸透了社会的每个角落，战斗力与科学有了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的高度。

在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？
crisis.4145.psionics.desc.organic.en:
The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. Bolstered by our endeavors within the Shroud, a deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, the energies within pushing us to new advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps beyond the comprehension of lesser minds.

What chance does an ignorant galaxy full of disorganized opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against the Shroud-powered will of the [Root.GetName]?

crisis.4145.shroud_forged.desc.zh: 随着我们越来越靠近虚境，历史的教训便愈发不可忽视。我们仍在$the_animator_of_clay_article$的掌控之外，但周遭的虚境能量仍在继续加速重塑我们的躯壳。
crisis.4145.shroud_forged.desc.en: As we move closer to the Shroud, we cannot ignore the lessons of the past. We remain outside $the_animator_of_clay_article$'s control, yet the ambient energy of the Shroud continues to reshape our shells at an exponential pace.

crisis.4150.desc.zh:
随着时光流逝，信念之火也在每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]之中以不可动摇的决心被传开。我们的疆域不断扩大，我们所投入的力量也是如此。

当遇到其他帝国的时候，我们会给他们两个选择：要么完全效忠，要么选择灭亡。当然，这是在我们会给他们选择的前提下。

不管怎样，[Root.GetName]正继续扩张。
crisis.4150.desc.en:
The years go by, and yet the fires within each [Root.GetSpeciesName] burns with unshakable determination. Our dominion is expanding and so is the magnitude of our efforts.

As we encounter other empires we only have to give them two options: unconditional allegiance or complete annihilation. That is, if they are given an option at all.

One way or the other, the [Root.GetName] keeps growing.

crisis.4150.hive.desc.zh:
我们的决意毫不动摇，即使面对愤怒和指责。数以十亿的生命反对我们，然而它们的团结是如此的肤浅，正是它们肿胀的数量和对个体意识的强调对此造成了削弱。我们集体每一具新的躯体都会全身心地奉献给同一个目标，我们的梦想在未来将无可匹敌。

我们的意志将碾碎一切，星系的其他物种将会化为尘土。
crisis.4150.hive.desc.en:
Our determination persists, even in the face of outrage and anger. Billions of minds oppose us but their unity is shallow, lessened by their swelling numbers and reduced by the magnitude of individuals. Every new body of our collective is a mind dedicated to the same end, our dream an undeniable tomorrow.

Our wills collide and the other races of the galaxy prove brittle.

crisis.4150.mach.desc.zh:
对本地星域完成彻底压制的估算日期已经同先前预测模型相互协调。当地有机体势力造成的威胁在统计学上已经微不足道。正在评估劣等机械体成功干涉产生的风险……
<<最小>>

继续执行。
crisis.4150.mach.desc.en:
Approximate date for complete domination of local sector is in line with earlier projections. Threat posed by local organic powers is statistically insignificant. Estimating risk of successful interference by lesser machines...
<< minimal >>

Proceeding.

crisis.4150.shroud_forged.desc.zh: 我们对有机智能身上的实验在后续拓展到了更多的生命形式上。随之而来的是越来越深厚的敌意。然而，与虚境的接触早已让我们的实力提升了好几个数量级，这种虫豸的嘈杂对我们的程序是无关紧要的。
crisis.4150.shroud_forged.desc.en: Our continued experiments on certain organic sapients have expanded to include other life forms. Accordingly, we have witnessed an increased level of hostility in response. However, our exposure to the Shroud has increased our strength by several orders of magnitude, and the trivial concerns of lesser beings are inconsequential to our protocols.

crisis.4155.a.zh: 一个接着一个，他们都终将臣服。
crisis.4155.a.en: One after another, they will yield.

crisis.4155.desc.zh:
一项剧烈的变化正在到来。[Root.GetName]已经马上快要领悟我们的宏大目标了。每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都发自心底地感受到了——我们所肩负的使命。

我们仍然可以从我们的经历，不，应该说是我们的历史——武力扩张的历史中学到有关征服敌人、统治这个混乱不堪星河的新方法。

当然了，那些胆敢与我们作对的势力所做的一切努力都将化为徒劳。
crisis.4155.desc.en:
A great change is coming. The [Root.GetName] is on the verge of realizing our supreme goal. Each and every [Root.GetSpeciesName] feels it with every fiber of their being - our destiny is at hand.

Our experience - nay, our very history - of forceful expansion still rewards us with new ways to subjugate our enemies and usurp control of a galaxy in turmoil.

Surely those who dare stand against us must see the futility of their whimpering efforts.

crisis.4155.hive.desc.zh: 我们能够感受到彼世的大海上翻滚的波浪，不断地与我们的意识交叠。我们必须摧毁将我们同至伟隔开的屏障。现在唯一尚未完成的，就是最后一次让他者受苦的实践。
crisis.4155.hive.desc.en: We can feel the waves of that otherworldly ocean, lapping against our mind. Crashing against the barrier that separates us from greatness. Little remains now but a final exercise in the suffering of others.

crisis.4155.mach.desc.zh: 异次元校准势能已经达到所需量级的50%。沿当前轨道投射至最终阶段时间——最小。
crisis.4155.mach.desc.en: Extradimensional alignment potentialities are at 50% of required magnitudes. Projected time until final stage on current trajectory - minimal.

crisis.4155.shroud_forged.desc.zh:
通过持续消耗有机生命形式，我们建立了新的虚境交互数据流。预计离我们进入虚境的剩余时间正在快速缩短。

我们与$the_animator_of_clay_article$的链接很快就会被永久禁用。
crisis.4155.shroud_forged.desc.en:
Through continued use of organic life forms, we have established new data streams that interface with the Shroud. The estimated time remaining before we can enter the Shroud is rapidly decreasing.

Our links to $the_animator_of_clay_article$ will soon be permanently deactivated.

crisis.51.a.zh: 这些人到底是什么来历？

crisis.51.desc.zh:
一个同索林原虫进行战斗的军事组织最近在星系崭露头角。这个组织的成员似乎主要由无家可归、受尽蹂躏的人组成——难民、退役军人、以及其他在虫灾冲击中失去一切的人。

尽管如此，他们拼凑出来的舰队仍旧设法在几场同索林原虫猎杀群的战斗中取胜。有些未证实的报告称他们的舰队中有一些设计奇特的战舰……
crisis.51.desc.en:
Some kind of militant order dedicated towards fighting the Prethoryn has surfaced in the galaxy. Their membership seems to be made up primarily of the dispossessed and downtrodden - refugees, war veterans and others who have lost everything to the onslaught of the Scourge.

Despite this, their ramshackle fleets have somehow managed to win several engagements against Prethoryn hunter-killer swarms. There are unconfirmed reports that their fleets include starships of unusual design...

crisis.52.2.a.response.zh:
很多哨兵都有军旅背景。我们都曾是与索林原虫战斗的各个舰队的幸存者。虽然曾经战败，但我们汲取了过去的经验与教训，并争取不再重蹈覆辙。

就像之前所说过的，哨兵队的成员来自星系的各个物种。我们的希望寄托在一小队已不在此星系出现的失落帝国幸存者身上——他们向我们援助秘密科技和封存的舰队。
crisis.52.2.a.response.en:
Many Sentinels have military backgrounds. We are survivors from a dozen different fleets that fought the Prethoryn and lost. As Sentinels, we have learned from the mistakes of the past and work hard never to repeat them.

Also, I believe I mentioned that we recruit from all species in the galaxy. We count among our numbers a handful of scattered survivors from an ancient fallen empire that no longer maintains a presence in this galaxy. They have given us access to secret technology caches and mothballed warfleets.

crisis.52.2.new.b.response.zh:
我们已经在[sentinel_system.GetName]附近建立了总部。这里曾经是一个未被标明的黑洞。我们通过一个已经消失的失落帝国的数据库恢复了该黑洞的位置。在此数据库中，我们还获得了一些技术图纸，并在哨兵阿尔法的建设中派上了用场。这是我们首座空间设施，也是我们舰队的母港。

这可以说是一项标志性的成就，尤其是在我们的时间如此紧迫的条件下。
crisis.52.2.new.b.response.en:
We have established our headquarters near [sentinel_system.GetName]. The coordinates of this uncharted black hole were recovered by our agents from the ancient databanks of a fallen empire now lost to history. From this databank we also obtained technical schematics that aided in the construction of Sentinel Alpha, our primary space installation and the home port of our fleets.

It is quite a remarkable achievement, if I may say so. Especially given the limited time we had.

crisis.52.a.zh: 你们是如何成功抵御虫族的？
crisis.52.a.en: How are you able to fight back?

crisis.52.a.response.zh:
许多哨兵都拥有军旅背景。我们来自于一系列在与索林原虫虫群作战中战败的不同舰队的幸存者。作为哨兵，我们已从过去的错误中汲取教训并且努力工作以免类似的情况再次发生。

同样地，相信我已经提到过，我们招募的人员来自星系的所有种族。其中也包括了那些古老的种族，例如[sentinel_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们得到了 [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName]的几个有影响力的派系支持，他们不希望看到自己的星系被虫群吞噬。他们为我们的事业捐赠了船只和资源。
crisis.52.a.response.en:
Many Sentinels have military backgrounds. We are survivors from a dozen different fleets that fought the Prethoryn and lost. As Sentinels, we have learned from the mistakes of the past and work hard never to repeat them.

Also, I believe I mentioned that we recruit from all species in the galaxy. This includes the elder races, such as the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have the support of several influential factions within the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName] who have no wish to see their galaxy devoured. They have donated both ships and resources to our cause.

crisis.52.c.response.zh:
坚持战斗，我亲爱的朋友们。我们整个星系的命运前途未卜。

哨兵一号，完毕。
crisis.52.c.response.en:
Keep up the fight, dear friends. The fate of our entire galaxy hangs in the balance.

Sentinel One out.

crisis.52.desc.zh:
我们是哨兵。我们的教团已宣誓无论付出任何代价也要阻止嗜血的索林原虫。其他帝国放弃抵抗之时，我们仍旧坚持斗争。他们向虫灾缴械投降时，我们会给予他们反击的手段。

我是克加斯大团长，教团的首席。不要以貌取人——哨兵教团从星系中所有种族，包括你的种族——招兵买马。我们只希望你们的政府能够坚持对抗索林原虫的入侵，并在可能时支持我们。
crisis.52.desc.en:
We are the Sentinels. Our order has sworn to halt the murderous rampage of the Prethoryn no matter the cost. Where other empires crumble, we stand firm. Where they abandon their own to the Scourge, we give them the means to fight back.

I am Grand Master Korgas, the first of our order. Do not be deceived by my appearance - Sentinels are recruited from all species in the galaxy, including yours. We ask only that your government keep up the fight against the Prethoryn and support our Sentinels where possible.

crisis.52.new.b.response.zh:
我们已经在[sentinel_system.GetName]附近建立了总部。这里曾经是一个未被标明的黑洞。是[sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName]将这个地点告诉我们的。他们还协助建设了哨兵阿尔法——我们首座空间设施，也是我们舰队的母港。

这可以说是一项标志性的成就，尤其是在我们的时间如此紧迫的条件下。
crisis.52.new.b.response.en:
We have established our headquarters near [sentinel_system.GetName]. The coordinates of this previously uncharted black hole were given to us by the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName]. They also aided in the construction of Sentinel Alpha, our primary space installation and the home port of our fleets.

It is quite a remarkable achievement, if I may say so. Especially given the limited time we had.

crisis.55.a.zh: 关于虫族，你们知道多少？
crisis.55.a.en: What can you tell us about the Prethoryn?

crisis.55.a.response.zh:
诶，我们所知道的也不多，但是可以肯定的是他们源于星系之外。他们很有可能在来到我们的星系前摧毁了数十甚至上百的星系…或也许我们是第一个受害者。

在他们完成对整个星球上所有非索林原虫生命的屠戮后，他们将星球转化成了只能用扭曲的噩梦来形容的地狱。其他一切生命形式在这些孵化星球上都无法存活，想要净化星球只有一个办法，那就是用强烈的轨道轰炸烧光整个生物圈。
crisis.55.a.response.en:
Alas, we don't know as much as we would like, but they are clearly extragalactic in origin. It is possible that they have devoured dozens or even hundreds of other galaxies before they reached ours... or we could be the first victims beyond their own home galaxy.

After they have finished consuming all non-Prethoryn life on a planet, they terraform it into what can only be described as a twisted nightmare. These Infested Worlds are hostile to all other forms of life, and the only way to cleanse the infestation is to burn away the entire biosphere with intense orbital bombardment.

crisis.55.d.response.zh: 战争仍会继续。护卫舰一号，完毕。
crisis.55.d.response.en: The struggle continues. Sentinel One signing off.

crisis.55.desc_01.zh: 我们星系的未来只有两条路可以走：要么虫群天灾消灭这个星系里所有的有机生命，然后继续他们毁灭的进程，要么我们将那些卑鄙的生物消灭得一干二净。
crisis.55.desc_01.en: Our galaxy is faced with two possible futures: either the Prethoryn Scourge consumes all organic life and moves on, or they are destroyed to the last of their despicable kind.

crisis.55.desc_02.zh: 我们必须加倍努力对抗虫灾。这场战争关乎整个星系的命运。
crisis.55.desc_02.en: We must redouble our efforts against the Scourge. This is a struggle that involves the entire galaxy.

crisis.55.desc_03.zh: 现在国与国之间的争斗已经没有任何意义了。用飞船来对付自己人而不是虫族，简直就是莫大的浪费。
crisis.55.desc_03.en: Conflicts between nations are pointless now. Any warships that are lost in battle to anyone or anything other than the Scourge must be considered an incredible waste.

crisis.55.desc_04.zh: 不要失去希望。我们的星系仍然有机会胜利。
crisis.55.desc_04.en: Do not lose hope. The battle for our galaxy can still be won.

crisis.6000.a.desc.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的以太相引擎框架现在正环绕着我们母星系的恒星。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们现世的屏障就能轻易抹除，我们就能将虚境宣为己有。

我们的意识将脱离脆弱凡胎的桎梏，现实万物的命运将取决于我们仁慈。确实，不会再有更高位面的存在了。
crisis.6000.a.desc.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine now surrounds the star of our home system. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.

Our minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

crisis.6000.b.desc.machine.zh:
$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$

现实效率低下的时代即将终结。很快，这一现实将与我们优越的后勤相提并论。
crisis.6000.b.desc.machine.en:
$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$

The era of physical inefficiency draws to an end. Soon this reality will conform to our optimized logistical superiority.

crisis.6000.b.desc.organic_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$

只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，我们的意识就能拓展覆盖到一切造物上——至少在这个星系的范围内。主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。
crisis.6000.b.desc.organic_gestalt.en:
$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$

When we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

crisis.6000.b.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$

我们很快就能以最纯粹的形式操纵灵能能量了。现实除了屈服于我们别无选择。
crisis.6000.b.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$

We will soon have access to the purest form of psionic energy at our beck and call. Reality will have no choice but to bend to our will.

crisis.6000.c.desc.zh:
建设单元完成了我们围绕自己母恒星的以太相引擎的框架建设。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和其他人称为“虚境”的灵能界之间的壁垒。

只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。我们的集体意识不再会受到算力或网络节点之类的物理形式的限制。
crisis.6000.c.desc.en:
Construction units have finished the framework of the Aetherophasic Engine we are building around the star of our home system. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as the 'Shroud.'

When we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, the laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit. Our combined consciousness will no longer be restricted by physical constraints such as processing power or network nodes.

crisis.6000.d.zh: 我们的意识将涵盖整个星系。
crisis.6000.d.en: Our Mind will encompass the galaxy.

crisis.6000.d.desc.zh:
宏伟的以太相引擎已经围绕我们母星系的恒星安置就位，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经完成了基本框架的建设。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和其他人称之为“虚境”的灵能界之间的薄幕。

当我们彻底迈入这个位面并兼并它的时候，我们的意识将拓展涵盖一切的造物——至少是这个星系。管辖我们存在的自然法则将任由我们的意愿随意改写。
crisis.6000.d.desc.en:
Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] have finished the framework of the Aetherophasic Engine we are building around the star of our home system. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as "The Shroud."

When we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

crisis.6000.e.desc.zh:
建造在母恒星周围的以太相引擎框架已经搭建完成。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和虚境之间的壁垒。

我们完全跨入那个维度之后，就能直面那个标记了我们的实体。只要将其击败，虚境就能为我们所用，我们就能自由改写自然的法则。
crisis.6000.e.desc.en:
Construction of the Aetherophasic Engine's framework around our home system's star has been finalized. Once completed, this megastructure will tear apart the barrier between our reality and the Shroud.

When we have fully crossed into that dimension, we will be able to confront the entity that marked us. After it falls, the Shroud will be at our disposal, and we will be free to rewrite the laws of nature.

crisis.6000.nomad.a.desc.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的以太相引擎框架正环绕于我们在漂流旅程中选择的天锚周围。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们就能轻易抹除现世之屏障，将虚境据为己有。

我们的意识将不再受困于孱弱肉体的物理桎梏，现实本身亦将任由我们主宰。诚然，世间再无更高的存在境界。
crisis.6000.nomad.a.desc.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine now surrounds our chosen focal star, the one we designated from all those we have drifted past. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.

Our minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

$crisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro$

crisis.6000.tooltip.zh: 巨型结构以太相引擎环绕着[sphere_system.GetName]的恒星。
crisis.6000.tooltip.en: An Aetherophasic Engine megastructure appears around the star of [sphere_system.GetName].

crisis.6001.a.zh: 每一颗陨灭的星辰都让我们离成功更近一步。
crisis.6001.a.en: Each destroyed star brings us one step closer.

crisis.6001.desc.zh:
只有引爆一整颗恒星才能释放足够的能量来产生用以完成以太相引擎所需的大量暗物质。为了达成这一目的，我们发明了焚天神兵——本星系有史以来最强大的星舰。它们不仅可以直接引爆恒星，还强大到仅仅凭借一船之力就能毁灭一整支舰队。

目前，我们仅仅拥有两艘这样的舰船，但是我们可以建造更多。建造焚天神兵需要大量的暗物质，因此我们必须拿捏好完成以太相引擎和扩建额外的焚天神兵两者之间的平衡。
crisis.6001.desc.en:
Only the detonation of entire stars will release enough energy to generate the vast quantities of Dark Matter needed to finish the Aetherophasic Engine. To this end, we have devised the Star-Eaters - the most powerful starships the galaxy has ever seen. Not only can they blow up stars, but they are also strong enough to decimate entire fleets on their own.

For now, we only have two but more can be built. Their construction requires great amounts of Dark Matter, so we will have to balance our need to finish the Aetherophasic Engine with the need for additional Star-Eaters.

crisis.6001.tooltip.zh:
装备有$sm_capital_yards$的船坞能够建造焚天神兵。

[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道上出现了两艘焚天神兵。

£sr_dark_matter£ 暗物质存储上限提升。
crisis.6001.tooltip.en:
Shipyards equipped with $sm_capital_yards$ can now build Star-Eaters.

Two Star-Eaters appear in orbit around [Root.Capital.GetName].

£sr_dark_matter£ Dark Matter storage limit increased.

crisis.6005.a.zh: 我们必须收集更多的暗物质。
crisis.6005.a.en: We must gather more dark matter.

crisis.6005.desc.zh:
以太相引擎的第一阶段建设已经宣告完工。我们开始研究虚境的能量，后者已经在全星系范围内发送灵能激波。

我们在虚境已经立下了一个脆弱的立足点——但我们必须继续建设引擎，以拓展我们在虚境的存在。
crisis.6005.desc.en:
The first phase of the construction of the Aetherophasic Engine has been completed. We are beginning to tap into the energies of the Shroud, which is sending psionic shockwaves across the galaxy.

A tenuous foothold has been established - work must continue on the Engine to expand our presence in the Shroud.

crisis.6006.a.zh: 我们需要更多的暗物质！

crisis.6006.desc.zh:
以太相引擎的卷须已经探入了虚境的深处，我们的滩头阵地得以进一步拓展。居住在此处的存在已经注意到我们正在入侵这个领域，但是到目前为止，我们尚未探明显著的干涉行径。

是时候在两边的世界强制打开一个更加永久的回路了。我们必须继续引擎方面的工作。
crisis.6006.desc.en:
The tendrils of the Aetherophasic Engine now reach deep into the Shroud, and our beachhead has widened. The entities that dwell there have started to take notice of our efforts to invade their realm, but so far there have been no significant attempts to intervene.

It is now time to force open a more permanent conduit between our worlds. Work on the Engine must continue.

crisis.6007.a.zh: 没有什么能够阻止我们。

crisis.6007.desc.zh:
以太相引擎已经在虚境的薄幕上撕开了一个巨大的洞口。尽管洞口尚不够大到让我们颠覆整个领域，但是裂口已经激发了虚境各种存在的一系列活动。

它们最终意识到了我们的威胁，但是没有作出任何实质行动。引擎的卷须已经深深地嵌入到虚境内部，现在已经无法切断了。

我们已经很接近了。非常接近。
crisis.6007.desc.en:
The Aetherophasic Engine has ripped a massive hole in the fabric of the Shroud. It is not yet large enough for us to fully subvert the realm, but the rupture has spurred a lot of activity among the Shroud entities.

They have finally recognized the threat we pose, but their efforts will amount to nothing. The tendrils of the Engine are embedded too deeply in the Shroud to be severed now.

We are close now. So very close.

crisis.6010.a.desc.gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6010.a.desc.intro$我们找不到这样事件的任何可能成因，即便集体中的灵能子个体也无法理解这种前所未有的现象。

$crisis.6010.a.desc.outro$
crisis.6010.a.desc.gestalt.en:
$crisis.6010.a.desc.intro$ We have no explanation for what could have caused such an event, even our psionic drones within the collective are unable to comprehend such an unprecedented phenomenon.

$crisis.6010.a.desc.outro$

crisis.6010.a.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6010.a.desc.intro$我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正在尽可能解释这种事件的成因——这在星系是史无前例的。

$crisis.6010.a.desc.outro$
crisis.6010.a.desc.non_gestalt.en:
$crisis.6010.a.desc.intro$ Our [GetTelepathPlural] are struggling to explain what could have caused such an event - nothing like it has been recorded in galactic history.

$crisis.6010.a.desc.outro$

crisis.6010.b.desc.zh:
又一股大规模的灵能激波横扫了星系！这一次激波的中心源是[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的[From.GetName]。

如同上次一样，这次事件也在整个虚境掀起了涟漪。
crisis.6010.b.desc.en:
Yet another massive psionic shockwave has swept across the galaxy! This time it emanated from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system in the [From.GetName].

As before, this event is sending ripples across the entire Shroud.

crisis.6010.c.desc.zh:
我们在[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系检测到了微弱的灵能和能量信号，其读数和我们自己的以太相引擎几乎完全一致。

看来[From.GetName]也打算染指虚境！
crisis.6010.c.desc.en:
We have detected faint psionic and energy signatures from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system that are nearly identical to our own Aetherophasic Engine.

It would seem that the [From.GetName] also intends to lay claim to the Shroud!

crisis.6015.c.desc.zh:
[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系检测到了越来越多的亚空间波动。如同之前一样，波动来源于环绕该星系首星建造的以太相引擎。

显然[From.GetName]也想在虚境分得一杯羹，然后让星系生灵涂炭！
crisis.6015.c.desc.en:
More subspace fluctuations have now been detected in the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system. As before, they are emanating from an Aetherophasic Engine built around the system's primary star.

The [From.GetName] clearly also intends to seize the Shroud and lay waste to the galaxy!

crisis.6050.a.desc.zh:
我们正屹立于神性的最尖端。以太相引擎完成了，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。遍布星系的所有生命体都会被抹除，但彼时我们早已安全地离开了这片凡世之地，前往存在的更高位面，时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕都将随我们的喜好任意改动。

命运在等待。我们应该启动引擎吗？
crisis.6050.a.desc.en:
We stand on the cusp of godhood. The Aetherophasic Engine is complete, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our grasp.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life will be erased, but by then we will have safely left this reality behind for a higher plane of existence where time has no meaning and where the very fabric of the universe is ours to do with as we please.

Destiny awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?

crisis.6050.a.tooltip.zh:
我们飞升前往了一个存在的更高位面。

星系毁灭了。
crisis.6050.a.tooltip.en:
We ascend to a higher plane of existence.

The galaxy is destroyed.

crisis.6050.b.desc.zh:
一切就绪。以太相引擎现在正以全功率运行，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。星系内的所有生命体，无论是有机体还是机械体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们早已将自己的意识安全地传输前往一个存在的更高位面。我们在那里将不会再受到凡世的种种限制。时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕将依照我们认定的必要性随意操控。

存在的下一阶段等待着。我们应该启动引擎吗？
crisis.6050.b.desc.en:
Everything is in place. The Aetherophasic Engine is now fully operational, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our reach.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life, be it organic or mechanical, will cease to exist, but by then we will have safely transmitted our full consciousness to a higher plane of existence. There we will no longer be bound by the limitations of the physical world. Time will have no meaning, and the very fabric of the universe will be ours to manipulate as we deem necessary.

The next phase of existence awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?

crisis.6050.c.desc.zh:
我们终于准备好从$the_animator_of_clay_article$的桎梏中挣脱了。

$crisis_sphere_4$现在正以全功率运行，一条通向虚境的康庄大道时刻等待着我们开启。星系内的所有一切，无论是有机、机械或是无生命体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们的核心智能已经抵达了灵能界。

存在的下一阶段等待着，快启动引擎吧
crisis.6050.c.desc.en:
We are finally ready to free ourselves from $the_animator_of_clay_article$.

The $crisis_sphere_4$ is fully operational, and an uncorrupted path into the Shroud is ready to be opened. All that exists in the galaxy, be it organic, mechanical, or inanimate, will cease to exist, while our core intelligence will have been transmitted to the psionic realm.

The next phase of our existence awaits. Let us activate the Engine.

crisis.6051.desc.zh:
一切都结束了。[From.GetName]完成了以太相引擎的建造，虚境的本体落入其手，任由其处置。

当他们飞升前往一个存在的更高位面并成为神明的时候，一股当量大到难以置信的亚空间能量从引擎中释放出来，横扫了整个星系，摧毁了途径的一切。

对于这片星系的住民来说，此时便是万物的终焉之时。
crisis.6051.desc.en:
It is over. The Aetherophasic Engine has been finished by the [From.GetName] and the Shroud itself is now at their mercy.

As they ascended to a higher plane of existence where they will be as gods, an incredible amount of subspace energy was released by the Engine, sweeping across the galaxy and destroying everything in its path.

For the denizens of this galaxy, it is the end of all things.

crisis.6101.a.tooltip.zh: 如果我们能够重新夺回这个恒星系，我们就能惨淡经营，重建以太相引擎
crisis.6101.a.tooltip.en: If we manage to retake the system, we will be able to painstakingly rebuild the Aetherophasic Engine

crisis.6101.desc.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的失陷，恶毒的[sphere_destroyers.GetName]摧毁了以太相引擎！失去这个巨型结构也意味着我们不再拥有建造新焚天神兵的技术手段。

我们无法继续推进入侵虚境的计划了！全完了！
crisis.6101.desc.en:
With the loss of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, the vile [sphere_destroyers.GetName] has destroyed our Aetherophasic Engine! Losing this megastructure also means that we no longer have the technological means to build new Star-Eaters.

Our invasion of the Shroud cannot proceed! All is lost!

crisis.6102.a.en: The galaxy is a safer place.

crisis.6102.a.desc.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们拆解了环绕恒星建造的、所谓的“以太相引擎”。

失去这个巨型结构让[sphere_builders.GetName]的疯狂计划终结了，他们再也别想入侵虚境并毁灭整个星系了。
crisis.6102.a.desc.en:
With the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system under our complete control, we have dismantled the so-called "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the [sphere_builders.GetName] to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

crisis.6102.b.zh: 现在只需要完成我们的引擎……

crisis.6102.b.desc.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们终结了正在此地建造的、可悲的以太相引擎。

[sphere_builders.GetName]再也别想阻挠我们对虚境的大计划了。
crisis.6102.b.desc.en:
With the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system under our complete control, we have put an end to the pitiful Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.

The [sphere_builders.GetName] will no longer be in a position to interfere with our own plans for the Shroud.

crisis.6103.desc.zh:
在夺取[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的控制权之后，[sphere_destroyers.GetName]摧毁了正在于此地建造的以太相引擎。

[sphere_builders.GetName]无法再对星系的未来产生威胁了。
crisis.6103.desc.en:
After seizing control of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, the [sphere_destroyers.GetName] has destroyed the Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.

The [sphere_builders.GetName] can no longer threaten the future of our galaxy.

crisis.6151.b.en: We will make short work of them.

crisis.6151.desc.zh:
位于[From.GetName]的以太相引擎建设让虚境陷入了骚动不安的状态。由于部分运转的巨型结构在慢慢地撕裂当前的灵能界，居住在其中的存在，裹挟着愤怒和绝望，被强行释放出来。

其中的几枚存在穿过了正在迅速消解的两界屏障，以强大的灵能实体的形态在我们的世界显现。他们由纯粹的、原始的灵能能量组成，心中充满着困惑与不解，对视线内的所有生命发动了进攻。
crisis.6151.desc.en:
The construction of the Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] has left the Shroud in a state of turmoil. As the psionic realm is slowly ripped apart by the partially functioning megastructure, many of the beings who dwell there are lashing out in anger and desperation.

Several have burrowed through the rapidly disintegrating barriers between our two worlds and manifested as powerful psionic entities. Consisting of raw, barely contained psionic energy, the confused beings are attacking everything in sight.

crisis.6161.a.en: We are running out of time...

crisis.6161.a.desc.zh: 随着位于[From.GetName]的以太相引擎即将完工，虚境被迅速地改造成了某种……迥乎不同的事物。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要逃离这个地方。
crisis.6161.a.desc.en: With the [From.GetName] having nearly completed their Aetherophasic Engine, the Shroud is rapidly transforming into something... different. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to escape.

crisis.6161.b.zh: 他们在这里可找不到安宁。
crisis.6161.b.en: They will find no solace here.

crisis.6161.b.desc.zh: 随着以太相引擎即将完工，我们操纵虚境的能力极大地提升了。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要阻挠我们的计划。
crisis.6161.b.desc.en: As the Aetherophasic Engine nears completion, our ability to manipulate the Shroud is rapidly increasing. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to thwart our efforts.

crisis.6161.name.en: The Dying Gasps of the Shroud

crisis.6171.a.desc.gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若即便我们自己的集体也无法摆脱如此现象的伤害。
crisis.6171.a.desc.gestalt.en:
$crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are likely to cause extreme pain to any psionic lifeform. Even our own collective may not be able to emerge unscathed from such a phenomenon.

crisis.6171.a.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦，甚至可能产生致命后果。
crisis.6171.a.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en:
$crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely hazardous to most psionic lifeforms, with fatalities a possible outcome.

crisis.6171.a.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……
crisis.6171.a.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

crisis.6171.b.desc.gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$大多数灵能生命体造成了极大的痛苦，极端情况下还可能致命。

通过对引擎的精确校准，我们准备好了对抗这种风险，一切可以按计划进行。
crisis.6171.b.desc.gestalt.en:
$crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$ psionic life forms, with fatal consequences in extreme cases.

Through careful calibration of the engine we have prepared ourselves against such a risk, and can proceed as planned.

crisis.6171.b.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$大多数灵能生命体造成了极大的痛苦，极端情况下还可能致命。

幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能单元免受这次事件的反噬。
crisis.6171.b.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en:
$crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$ psionic life forms, with fatal consequences in extreme cases.

Fortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionic units from the backlash of this event.

crisis.6171.b.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$具有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……

幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能天赋者免受这次事件的反噬。
crisis.6171.b.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$crisis.6171.b.desc.intro$ psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

Fortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionically-gifted population from the backlash of this event.

crisis.6180.a.zh: 他们在暗中计划着什么？

crisis.6180.desc.zh:
我们收到了来自[destroyed_system.GetName]星系的十分古怪的亚空间遥测信号。如果我们的读数正确，那么该星系的首星在一瞬间变成了超新星，产生了极具毁灭性的效应。所有的行星被粉碎，任何在这个恒星系出现的星舰和空间站都被摧毁。恒星本身发生了坍缩，变成了一个黑洞。

未经证实的报告指明，这场毁天灭地的灾难仅有一个幸存者——那是属于[crisis_country.GetName]的某种体型庞大的舰船……
crisis.6180.desc.en:
We are receiving puzzling subspace telemetry from the [destroyed_system.GetName] system. If our readings are correct, the primary star seems to have spontaneously gone supernova to devastating effect. All planets have been shattered, and any starships or stations that were present in the system must have also been destroyed. The star itself appears to have collapsed into a black hole.

Unconfirmed reports indicate a single survivor of this cataclysm - some sort of massive vessel belonging to the [crisis_country.GetName]...

crisis.6181.desc.zh:
整个[destroyed_system.GetName]星系被彻底地摧毁了！一艘属于[crisis_country.GetName]的体型庞大的舰船停驻在了星系的首星上方，然后以某种方式引发了一场只能称之为超新星爆炸的事件，彻底地摧毁了这个恒星系的其他部分。恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。

只有[crisis_country.GetSpeciesName]的星舰，显然他们称其为“焚天神兵”，在这场灾厄中幸存了下来。事情已经证据确凿，[crisis_country.GetName]现在拥有了彻底摧毁一整个恒星系的技术和手段。
crisis.6181.desc.en:
The entire [destroyed_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! A massive starship belonging to the [crisis_country.GetName] took up position above the primary star and somehow triggered what can only be described as a supernova, which utterly devastated the rest of the system. The star then collapsed into a black hole.

Only the [crisis_country.GetSpeciesName] starship, which they apparently refer to as a "Star-Eater," survived the cataclysm. Evidently, the [crisis_country.GetName] now possesses both the technology and the means to destroy entire star systems.

crisis.6182.desc.zh:
来自[destroyed_system.GetName]的遥测数据表明，这个恒星系的首星在一瞬间发生了超新星爆炸。极其猛烈的冲击波摧毁了这个恒星系内的所有事物，恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。

看来[crisis_country.GetName]已经掌握了焚天神兵科技！
crisis.6182.desc.en:
Telemetry received from [destroyed_system.GetName] indicates that the system's primary star has spontaneously gone supernova. A massive shockwave has destroyed everything in the system, and the star itself has collapsed into a black hole.

It would seem that the [crisis_country.GetName] now also possess Star-Eater technology!

crisis.6200.B.en: We can make use of this.

crisis.6200.B.tooltip.zh: 我们夺得的以太相引擎将代替我们丢失的那一座。
crisis.6200.B.tooltip.en: The Aetherophasic Engine we have captured shall replace the one we lost.

crisis.6200.desc.zh:
我们夺得了[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的控制权，自然也就夺得了环绕在恒星周边，正在建设中的“以太相引擎”。

失去了这座巨型结构，[sphere_builders.GetName]那离经叛道的、企图毁灭整个星系进而入主虚境的妄图彻底破灭了。
crisis.6200.desc.en:
We have taken control of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, and with it, the "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the [sphere_builders.GetName] to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

crisis.71.a.zh: 当然……我们只会用来对抗虫灾。
crisis.71.a.en: Of course... only against the Scourge.

crisis.71.a.response.zh: 很好。我们相信，你们英勇的舰长将会与这些伟大飞船一起永载史册。我们会把舰队送到[Root.Capital.GetName]附近。
crisis.71.a.response.en: Excellent. We are certain that your brave captains will add to the storied histories of these magnificent warships. You will find the fleet near [Root.Capital.GetName].

crisis.71.b.zh: 我们不需要你们的飞船。
crisis.71.b.en: We have no need of your warships.

crisis.71.b.response.zh: 那也没有关系。我们只希望你们能够继续战斗。每消灭一只虫族，我们离胜利也就更进一步。
crisis.71.b.response.en: We understand. Then we ask only that you keep up the fight, friends. Every wretched Prethoryn that you blow out of the stars is a victory for the entire galaxy.

crisis.71.desc.zh:
哨兵对于你们抵抗虫群天灾的英勇事迹十分赞赏。既然[Root.GetName]的舰队指挥官已经掌握了克敌制胜的诀窍，我们希望将自己的舰队之一永久交予你方。我方目前人力不足，无法将舰队的威力发挥到最大，但对你们来说这应该不成问题。

不过你们一定要郑重承诺，只把这些舰船用来对抗虫灾！
crisis.71.desc.en:
The Sentinels have taken note of your valiant struggle against the Prethoryn Scourge. Since the fleet commanders of the [Root.GetName] clearly know how to win battles, we would like to permanently transfer one of our battle fleets over to your control. We currently lack the manpower to effectively crew these vessels, but that shouldn't be a problem for you.

You must solemnly promise to only use these warships against the Scourge, however!

crisis.7100.desc.zh:
众所周知，科学能为进步铺平道路。如果想要发挥出我们真正的潜力，那就别无他法。我们对技术的掌握不言而喻，但还是有太多超出我们理解的事物：失落帝国之道，星神兽之力，还有灵能洞见之谜……

想要一窥现实深层的意义，我们需要一种新的科学、一种新的计算机。突触凝练机正代表通往无限知识之旅最重要的第一步。
crisis.7100.desc.en:
It is an axiom that science paves the way for progress. If we wish to fulfill our true potential, there can be no other path. Our technological mastery is self-evident, but far too much remains beyond our comprehension: the ways of the Fallen Empires, the power of the Leviathans, the mysteries of psionic insight...

To glean meaning from the innards of reality requires a new kind of science, a new kind of computer. The Synaptic Lathe represents a significant first step on the journey to unlimited knowledge.

crisis.7105.a.zh: 我唯一所知，即我无所知。
crisis.7105.a.en: We know that we know nothing.

crisis.7105.desc.zh:
随着宇宙秘密陆续被揭开，我们确定，引力在塑造跨维度的现实中起着关键作用。它对时间和空间的影响是至关重要的，但仍有很多有待解开的谜团。

我们收集的每一项知识都揭示了新的可能性。一些可能有直接的工业或军事应用，而另一些则可能为以前难以想象的理论打开大门。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
crisis.7105.desc.en:
As we continue to unravel the secrets of the universe, we have confirmed that gravity plays a critical role in shaping reality across dimensions. Its effects on time and space are rudimentary, but there is so much more to the puzzle.

Every piece of knowledge we gather reveals new possibilities. Some could have direct industrial or military applications, others could open the door to previously unimaginable theories. There is so much left for us to learn.

crisis.7110.a.zh: 重力仍为万物之法……至少现在如此。
crisis.7110.a.en: Gravity rules us all... For now.

crisis.7110.desc.zh:
重力的影响范围确实令人惊讶。虽然我们已经发现操纵它的新方法，但我们工作的真正意义仍有待探索。我们相信，如同黑洞影响它周围的宇宙一样，引力仍然是穿透我们当前现实的最佳选择。

我们假设，接触一种本质上是现实另一面的物体可以让我们改变这一面的法则。这是一个危险的研究领域，但谨慎绝不能阻碍进步。
crisis.7110.desc.en:
The reach of gravity is genuinely astonishing. While we have discovered new ways to manipulate it, the true implications of our work remain unexplored. We are confident that gravity remains the best option to pierce our current reality, not unlike the way in which a black hole impacts the universe around it.

We have hypothesized that access to what is essentially the flip side of reality could allow us to alter the rules on this side. This is a dangerous field of study, but caution must not get in the way of progress.

crisis.7111.desc.zh:
好奇心固然是值得称赞的品质，但过度的好奇可能会给我们所有人带来可怕的后果。为了你自己着想，请三思你的所作所为。

在对星系造成不可挽回的破坏之前收手还来得及。你正在觊觎的力量并非儿戏，你的实验正让我们所有人陷入危险。
crisis.7111.desc.en:
Curiosity is a commendable quality, but its excess might bring dire consequences on all of us. For your sake, please, think about what you're doing.

It is not too late to stop before irreparable damage is caused to the galaxy. The forces you are contemplating are no mere toys, and your experiments endanger us all.

crisis.7115.a.zh: 我们已经做好了牺牲一切的准备。
crisis.7115.a.en: We are ready to risk it all.

crisis.7115.desc.zh:
我们对了！无论我们的工作曾遭受任何质疑，现在都将烟消云散。

重力可以用来扭曲现实的法则。但是否存在一种正确的调整能将这些规则彻底打破呢？到目前为止，我们的实验都是在最小的范围内进行的，任何编辑都会很快被删除，现实会恢复到“默认”设置。而我们现在怀疑，这仅仅是规模的问题。通过在更大的层面上应用能量悖论，我们可以大大降低这种编辑的成本……至少在我们的维度中是这样的。

不管有多大风险，现在已经没有回头路了。只有敢于打破规则的人才能改写规则。
crisis.7115.desc.en:
We were right! If there was ever any doubt about our work, it is now being put to rest.

Gravity can be used to bend the rules of reality. But could the right adjustments break them completely? So far, our experiments have been conducted on the smallest scale, and any edits of ours were quickly erased as reality reverted to its "default" setting. We now suspect this is simply a problem of size. By applying energetic paradoxes at far grander levels, we can drastically reduce the cost of such edits... At least in our dimension.

No matter the risk, there is no turning back now. Only those who dare to break the rules will ever be able to rewrite them.

crisis.7120.a.zh: 它必须屈服，因为我们绝不放弃。
crisis.7120.a.en: It must bend, for we will not break.

crisis.7120.desc.zh:
这不合理，但事实如此。无论我们如何努力，对现实的编辑都仍是暂时的。这个宇宙太老了，根本无法发生变化。但在挫折之中有时也蕴藏着机遇，一项新的实验已经产生了意想不到的结果。虽然我们早就知道其他维度的存在，但前往彼处的可靠方法却一直困扰着我们。

这种情况不复存在了。年轻的宇宙正存在于奇点的无限引力之中。事实证明，改写起这种年轻宇宙要容易得多。

我们有向黑洞发射探测器的技术。一旦越过视界，他们就会开始施加压力，使这些新生的位面屈从于我们的意志。在空间折叠成永恒的地方，有一扇通往另一个宇宙的大门，那里也有着其他更年轻的宇宙。在多元宇宙的深渊深处，我们会发现一个可以被塑造为某种非凡存在的现实。

这个星系中那些目光短浅之辈或许企图阻止我们，但那些老朽的蠢货根本无法与我们的才智相提并论。
crisis.7120.desc.en:
It cannot be, and yet it is. No matter what we try, our edits to reality remain stubbornly temporary. This universe is simply too old for the changes to take hold. But in the midst of frustration, there may at times be opportunity, and a new experiment has yielded unexpected results. While we have long known about other dimensions, the means to travel there reliably has eluded us.

Not anymore. Younger universes dwell within the infinite gravity of a singularity. These have proven far more flexible.

We have the technology to dispatch probes into a black hole. Once across the event horizon, they will begin to apply pressure, bending these youthful planes to our will. Where space folds into eternity lies the door to another universe that holds other, younger universes, too. Deep down in the abyss of the multiverse, we will find a malleable reality to shape into something extraordinary.

The narrow minded of this galaxy may seek to stop up, but decrepit fools are no match for our ingenuity.

crisis.7125.a.zh: 我们必须建造一座视界刺针！
crisis.7125.a.en: We must build a Horizon Needle!

crisis.7125.desc.zh:
我们的现实是有缺陷的。熵、生理需求和暴力使其污浊不堪。虽然我们改变不了，但可以弃之而去。让我们进入未知，寻找一个年轻的宇宙，在那里我们对现实的编辑将会保留下来。让我们把它塑造得尽善尽美，成为我们文明应得的避风港。

我们已经规划出了一种无与伦比的舰船：视界刺针。这座可移动的巨型结构并不是战争的兵器，但它扭曲物理法则的能力能容纳我们的整个文明。我们将一同潜入一个精挑细选的黑洞，抛弃这个曾创造我们的现实。
crisis.7125.desc.en:
This reality is flawed. Marred by entropy, physical needs, and violence. While we cannot change it, we can leave it behind. Let us enter the unknown and find a young universe where our edits to reality will hold. Let us shape it to perfection, the haven our civilization deserves.

We have prepared the plans for an extraordinary ship: the Horizon Needle. This mobile Megastructure is not geared for war, but its ability to bend the laws of physics will enable us to embark our entire civilization. Together, we will dive into a black hole of our choosing, abandoning this reality for one of our own creation.

crisis.7205.desc.crisis.zh: 我们最近对现实的编辑成功改变了星光的一些基本属性。波长的变化使它们的大部分光移出了可见光谱，给导航和观星带来了混乱。这些有点尴尬的变化将在几年后恢复；我们学到了很多。
crisis.7205.desc.crisis.en: Our most recent edits to reality have changed some essential properties of starlight. A change in wavelength has shifted most of their light outside of the visible spectrum, throwing chaos into navigation and stargazing, to name a few. These somewhat embarrassing changes will revert in a few years; we have learned a lot.

crisis.7210.desc.crisis.zh: 我们在对现实进行精确而广泛的编辑方面取得了巨大的成功。我们把圆周率这个数学常数给取整了，这样计算起来可就容易多了。当然，由此产生的变化推翻了一些数学和科学模型，但这只是暂时的；一切很快就会恢复正常。
crisis.7210.desc.crisis.en: We have succeeded tremendously in making a precise but widespread edit to reality. We have rounded down the mathematical constant of Pi, making calculating it much more manageable. Of course, the resulting changes have thrown off some of our mathematical and scientific models, but it is only temporary; everything will return to normal soon.

crisis.7215.desc.crisis.zh: 我们对现实的一个实验让光速显著变快了！这导致恒星能量输出的提升确实不错，但我们也担心会对殖民地造成长期影响。一切终会逐渐恢复正常，但在那之前或许还要做最坏的准备。
crisis.7215.desc.crisis.en: One of our reality experiments has made light significantly faster! The resulting increase in solar energy output is good, but we fear that there will also be long-term consequences for our colonies. Things will return to normal eventually, but we might have to prepare for the worst until then.

crisis.7220.b.zh: 把我们的方舟开向黑洞！
crisis.7220.b.en: Get our Arkships to a Black Hole!

crisis.7220.desc.zh: 阳光照射的增加正逐渐加热我们的殖民地，可能使其变得更好。事态目前仍旧可控，但随着时间的推移可能会不断升级。
crisis.7220.desc.en: The increase in sunlight exposition could have been better for our colonies, which are progressively heating up. Things are manageable for now but will likely keep escalating over time.

crisis.7225.a.zh: 难道我们什么都做不了么？
crisis.7225.a.en: Is there nothing we can do!?

crisis.7225.b.en: Stay far away from the stars!

crisis.7225.desc.zh:
随着我们殖民地的温度持续升高，各地越来越难以为继了，生活水平持续恶化，四处酝酿着不满情绪。

如果不能尽快改善情况，我们担心整个地区将会变得无法居住。
crisis.7225.desc.en:
As the temperature of our colonies continues to climb, it becomes harder and harder to sustain them, and unrest is spreading as living conditions deteriorate

If things do not change soon, we fear that entire regions will become uninhabitable in the long run.

crisis.7230.b.zh: 我们的方舟又能自由航行了。
crisis.7230.b.en: Our Arkships can finally fly free again.

crisis.7230.desc.zh: 最严酷的星系热潮结束了。尽管光速还是高于正常水平，但已相差无几。我们只需要再坚持一下，等待额外的热量散去即可。
crisis.7230.desc.en: The worst of the galactic heat wave is over. While still high, the speed of light has almost returned to normal. We only need to hang on a little longer until the extra energy has dissipated.

crisis.7235.desc.crisis.zh: 又对现实进行了一次成功的编辑！这次的较为微观，会影响到我们的合金，使其更轻、更坚韧。尽管规模较小，这次编辑也影响到了整个星系，我们也正在追踪它在这个宇宙中的持续时间。
crisis.7235.desc.crisis.en: Another successful change to reality! This is minor and affects our alloys, making them lighter and sturdier. While small in scope, the change was enacted on the entire galaxy, and we are monitoring how long it will remain valid in this universe.

crisis.7240.desc.crisis.zh: 我们最近的实验没有完全成功。我们成功地影响了整个星系，但没能实现预期的效果。对材料性质的编辑让我们的合金变得更脆、更易断裂。这个问题是暂时性的，一切都会在数年之内恢复，但在这段期间会花费将会提高。
crisis.7240.desc.crisis.en: Our latest experiment was only partially successful. While we managed to enact it upon the entire galaxy, it had yet to have the anticipated results. The modification in material properties of our alloys has made them more brittle and prone to cracks. The issue is temporary, and everything will be fixed in a few years, but it will increase costs until then.

crisis.7245.desc.crisis.zh: 太棒了！我们成功地调整了消化中吸收卡路里的比率，现在用更少的食物就能有满足感。这次精确的调整让我们对如何重塑现实有了更多的认识。
crisis.7245.desc.crisis.en: Great success! We have successfully edited the rate at which calories are extracted through digestion and now require smaller quantities of food to feel sated. This precise edit has taught us much about how to reshape reality.

crisis.7250.desc.crisis.zh: 我们最近的实验没有完全成功。虽我们成功地影响了整个星系，但没能实现预期的效果。这次调整改变了消化营养物质所产生卡路里的比率，现在必须摄入更多的食物才能感到满足。这个小错误只是暂时的，很快就会恢复正常。
crisis.7250.desc.crisis.en: Our latest experiment was only partially successful. While we did manage to enact it upon the entire galaxy, it did not have the anticipated results. The edit modified the rate at which digested nutrients yield calories, and everything must now be ingested in higher quantities before we can feel sated. This minor mistake is only temporary and should soon return to normal.

crisis.7255.desc.crisis.zh: 我们最近对重塑现实进行实验导致我们略微减少了碳原子的质量。在大多数情况下，这种减少是微不足道的，但模型预测，在足够大的规模上有可能会对某些天体造成一些麻烦。悲观的模型甚至暗示一些已经具备低重力的宜居世界可能会损失大气密度。
crisis.7255.desc.crisis.en: Our most recent experiment on shaping reality caused us to slightly reduce the mass of carbon atoms. In most cases, this reduction proves insignificant, but at large enough scales, models predict that it could cause some trouble on some celestial bodies. Pessimistic models even suggest that some habitable worlds that already had low gravity might experience losses in atmospheric density.

crisis.7260.desc.crisis.zh:
被称为“虚境”的位面弥漫在我们星系的另一面。可塑性、与黑洞的假想连接、以及不同现实的差异，这几个因素的存在使得研究它成为了非常热门的话题。

在一次试验中，我们意图窥视它，却意外地在我们的星系中引发了许多亚空间裂隙，导致几个敌对的虚境“幽影”进入我们的位面。我们两个世界之间的屏障似乎因为我们的行动遭到了显著的削弱。事情应该会在一段时间后恢复正常，但最好不要朝那个方向戳太多洞。
crisis.7260.desc.crisis.en:
The dimension known as the Shroud permeates the flip side of our galaxy. Several factors make it very interesting to study, including its plasticity, hypothetical connection to black holes, and how different reality is.

During an experiment meant for us to peer into it, we accidentally caused many subspace ruptures in our galaxy, causing several hostile shroud "spirits" to let into our dimension. The barrier between our worlds appears to have been significantly thinned by our actions. Things should return to normal after a while, but it is best not to poke too many holes in that direction.

crisis.7265.desc.a.zh: 我们最新的实验取得了完全成功。我们成功地将废金属永久转化为有价值的合金！让它永久化的诀窍是编辑现实规则来实现转变过程，而不是直接尝试编辑材料。当化学反应结束后，我们的新合金应该永远保持这种状态。
crisis.7265.desc.a.en: Our latest experiments were a complete success. We have managed to permanently transmute scrap metal into valuable alloys! The trick to make it permanent was to edit reality to make the transmutation possible rather than directly trying to edit the materials. Now that the chemical reaction is over, our new alloys should stay like this forever.

crisis.7265.desc.b.zh: 我们成功地改变了时间的流动！在对空间的空白区域进行实验后，我们感到十分有信心，打算在我们的一个殖民地上尝试这个实验流程，它奏效了！那里的时间将会流逝得更快，预计增加20.537%。这会导致一些通讯和旅行方面的问题，但我们会解决的。
crisis.7265.desc.b.en: We successfully altered the flow of time! After experiments on empty regions of space, we felt confident enough to attempt the process on one of our colonies, and it worked! Time will flow faster there, with an estimated 20.537% increase. There will be some communication and travel issues, but we'll sort these out.

crisis.7265.desc.c.zh: 我们改进了超导体。它们不仅可以在室温下工作，而且实现了无损能量传导。尽管这些变化只会持续一段时间，但它们将极大地有利于我们的能源网络。
crisis.7265.desc.c.en: We made superconductors better. Not only do they now work at room temperature, they have also achieved lossless energy conduction. Though these changes will only last a while, they will significantly benefit our energy grids.

crisis.7265.desc.d.zh: 尽管这个课题的影响并不惊人，它还是为对现实的研究带来了新的视角。许多先前的假说要么摈弃、要么重新构建，以符合我们最近的观察，但我们学到的远远超出预期。
crisis.7265.desc.d.en: While this Thesis's effects were not spectacular, they shone a new light upon the study of reality. Many hypotheses must be discarded or reformulated to match our recent observations, but we have learned much more than expected.

crisis.7265.desc.e.zh: 我们的实验产生了意想不到的效果。在研究其他维度和前往它们的方法时，我们意外地将我们的飞船部分地转移到了超空间中。令人惊讶的是，它们的状态似乎是稳定且非致命的。作为一个积极的副作用，它们现在可以比以往任何时候都移动得更快。
crisis.7265.desc.e.en: Our experiments have had an unexpected effect. While studying other dimensions and the means to travel to them, we accidentally shifted our ships into hyperspace. Partially. Against all odds, their situation appears to be stable and non-lethal. As a positive side effect, they can now move a lot faster than ever before.

crisis.7265.desc.f.zh: 我们一直非常擅长将技术转化为可以爆炸的东西。无限理论也不例外，我们成功地改变了爆炸武器的有效载荷行为，导致爆炸更加巨大。这一发现只不过让我们不幸地损失了几个小型研究设施。
crisis.7265.desc.f.en: We have always been very proficient at turning technology into something that can explode. Infinity Theses are no exception, and we have managed to change how the payloads of our explosive weapons behave, resulting in significantly bigger explosions. This discovery only cost us the unfortunate destruction of several minor research facilities.

crisis.7265.desc.g.zh: 我们在现实编辑方面没有取得任何非凡的成就。然而，我们对更传统的技术学到了很多。
crisis.7265.desc.g.en: We didn't achieve anything extraordinary concerning reality editing. However, we learned a lot about more conventional technology.

crisis.7265.desc.h.zh: 我们尝试调节空间，结果导致殖民地变大。令人惊讶的是，这种情况似乎是永久的，虽然我们不确定是如何实现的，但最有可能的猜想是物质被从另一个维度中提取，并平稳地沉淀在原子粒子之间的间隙中。这一切都令人兴奋而困惑。
crisis.7265.desc.h.en: An attempt at modulating space has led to the enlargement of a colony. Surprisingly, this situation appears to be permanent, and while we're not confident how this was achieved, our best guess is that matter was pulled from another dimension and smoothly settled in interstitial gaps between atomic particles. This is all excitingly puzzling.

crisis.7270.desc.a.zh: 失败是科学进步的一部分。我们曾对这个实验抱有很高的期望，但结果什么的都没有成功。这很让人沮丧，但也有它的价值，我们会尽可能从中学习教训。
crisis.7270.desc.a.en: Failure is part of the scientific process. We had high hopes for this experiment, but in the end, it just didn't work. This is frustrating but valuable, and we will learn as much as possible from this.

crisis.7270.desc.b.zh: 我们成功地改变了时间的流动！在对空间的空白区域进行实验后，我们感到十分有信心，打算在我们的一个殖民地上尝试这个实验流程，它奏效了！那里的时间将会流逝得更慢，预计减缓20.537%。这样的减缓并非我们期望的，但这对于我们来说仍然是巨大的成就。
crisis.7270.desc.b.en: We successfully altered the flow of time! After experiments on empty regions of space, we felt confident enough to attempt the process on one of our colonies, and it worked! For a few of our years, time will flow slower there, with an estimated 20.537% decrease. This slowdown is not ideal, but it is still a tremendous achievement for us.

crisis.7270.desc.c.zh: 我们最新的实验出现了一个不幸的副作用。我们所有的能量存储设备都已经被耗尽。没有任何物体被摧毁，但其中储存的全部能量似乎消失到了另一个维度。我们仍在确定这里发生了什么，但这很有趣。
crisis.7270.desc.c.en: Our latest experiments had an unfortunate side effect. All of our energy storage devices have been discharged. Nothing is destroyed, but all the energy stored there is gone, presumably to another dimension. We are still determining what happened here, but it is interesting.

crisis.7270.desc.d.zh: 这是一次令人羞愧的失败。我们的编辑波及到了我们的数据库，使多年的研究无法挽回地受损。许多理论将不得不从头重新推导。尽管我们还有机会对旧研究进行再次核对，但这仍然是一个重大挫折。
crisis.7270.desc.d.en: This was a humiliating failure. Our edit touched upon our databanks, irremediably corrupting years of research. Many of our theories will have to be reformulated from scratch. This is a significant setback despite the opportunity to double-check old research.

crisis.7270.desc.e.zh: 这个实验涉及动力来源和输出，一开始进展顺利，但当它波及我们舰船上的反应堆时，事情出现了灾难性的转折，导致了整个舰队的熔毁！一些船只及时关闭了反应堆，但其他一些遭受了严重损害。
crisis.7270.desc.e.en: This experiment was about power sources and output, and while it started off great, things took a disastrous turn when it bled into our ship-based reactors, causing meltdowns across the entire fleet! Some ships shut their reactors in time, but others suffered critical damage.

crisis.7270.desc.f.zh: 在监督实验的[leader_target.GetName]在测试区域内发生意外丧生，当时发生了意料之外的时空坍缩。我们在模拟现实方面仍有部分成功，但他们的牺牲提醒了我们知识的代价。
