crisis.7270.desc.f.en: [leader_target.GetName], who was supervising the experiments, was killed when an unexpected spacetime compression occurred inside the testing area. We were still partially successful in modeling reality, but their demise is a good reminder of the price of knowledge.

crisis.7270.desc.g.zh: 一次计算实验失控了，规模远超预期。大量宝贵的研究数据因此变成了无意义的胡言乱语。幸运的是，保管我们最先进研究成果的智库受到了良好的保护，没有受到影响。
crisis.7270.desc.g.en: A computing experiment went wild, and its scale was much bigger than anticipated. A lot of valuable research data was turned into gibberish as a result. Thankfully, the banks sheltering our most advanced research were well-secured and remained unaffected.

crisis.7270.desc.h.zh: 我们尝试操纵空间，结果导致殖民地缩小。这种情况是永久的，这让人有点惊讶。最可能的猜想是物质从一个维度平滑地泄漏到另一个维度。这一切都非常令人困惑。
crisis.7270.desc.h.en: An attempt at modulating space has led to the shrinking of a colony. This situation is permanent, which was a slight surprise. Our best guess is that matter smoothly leaked from one dimension into another. This is all very puzzling.

crisis.7280.desc.zh: 你好，聪明的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们现在抵达了一个重要的技术里程碑，我们对此倍感骄傲。回望往昔，并非一路坦途，但在克服这些挑战的过程中，你们也不断成长。今日你们所展现的技术实力说明我们当初为你们提供引导是正确的选择。
crisis.7280.desc.en: Greetings, brilliant [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Today you have reached a significant technological milestone, and our hearts swell with pride. The road that brought you here has not been without challenge. In overcoming them you have grown, and your recent technological prowess is a definitive sign that we were right to offer you our guidance.

crisis.7285.a.en: You're right, this is too dangerous.

crisis.7285.a.tt.zh:
放弃你的“宇宙创生”野心，失去大多数失落帝国建筑和舰船的使用权。

这将阻止我们完成危机进程
crisis.7285.a.tt.en:
Renounce your Cosmogenesis ambitions, lose access to most Fallen Empire Buildings and Ships.

This will prevent us from completing our Crisis Path

crisis.7285.desc.zh: 熊孩子们！今日你们的所作所为已经超出了我们的忍耐限度。这些无所顾忌的实验对所有人都构成了危险。我们在此命令你们停止这类实验，你们根本不知道自己在搞什么。虽然好奇心值得称赞，但我们不能容忍此等规模的胡闹。世界被构建成现在的样子是有原因的，不要再动它了。
crisis.7285.desc.en: Troublesome child! Today you have exceeded our patience. Your reckless experiments are a danger to all, and we hereby order you to put a stop to these. You have no idea what you are messing with, and while curiosity is commendable, recklessness at such a scale is intolerable. Reality was built this way for a reason. Leave it be.

crisis.7400.desc.zh:
$crisis.7400.intro$

然而，在尝试之前，我们必须搭载上我们的整个国家。必须前往我们的每一个殖民地，带上当地的人口。那之后，我们才能回到首都，并安排好创世之旅的最后细节。

$crisis.7400.outro$
crisis.7400.desc.en:
$crisis.7400.intro$

However, before attempting this, we must embark our entire nation. We will visit each of our colonies to gather the local population. Afterward, we can travel back to our capital and arrange the final details of our exodus.

$crisis.7400.outro$

crisis.7400.desc.onlycapital.zh:
$crisis.7400.intro$

我们的帝国浓缩就是精华。只需要搭载首都的人口之后就可以开始规划创世之旅的最终细节了。

$crisis.7400.outro$
crisis.7400.desc.onlycapital.en:
$crisis.7400.intro$

The compact size of our nation is proving to be a good thing. It will only be necessary to embark the population of our capital before arranging the final details of our exodus.

$crisis.7400.outro$

crisis.7500.desc.zh: 得益于视界刺针创造的钟慢效应，我们可以相对快速地搭载整个[root.GetName]殖民地。舰船里的世界已经按照人口的需求调整以提供充足的空间。此外，船体内的时间也被调慢以缩短整个旅程的速度。去下一个殖民地吧！
crisis.7500.desc.en: Thanks to the time dilation capacity of the Horizon Needle, we've been able to embark the entire colony on [root.GetName] relatively quickly. The reality inside the ship has been modulated accordingly to provide ample space for the population. Additionally, time has been slowed inside the vessel to make the entire journey feel considerably shorter. Onwards to our next colony!

crisis.7500.desc.capital.zh:
为如此规模庞大的创世之旅做准备可是一项费时费力的任务。我们的整个行政系统都在全力运转以疏通流程，确保万无一失。

令人意外的是，有一部分我们的人口主动选择留下来。他们想让我们的物种在这个宇宙中继续延续。我们已为他们提供了科技和补给，让他们在我们启程之后还可以自给自足。
crisis.7500.desc.capital.en:
Preparing for an exodus on such a scale is a daunting task. Our entire administration is working to smooth the process and ensure nothing critical is forgotten.

Surprisingly, a segment of our population has elected to stay behind. They will ensure the continued existence of our kind in this universe. Technology and supplies have been provided, enough to help them survive after we are gone.

crisis.7500.desc.capital.gestalt.zh:
如此的移民行动可谓规模骇人，但却难度不大。[owner.GetIndividualNamePluralCap]正在努力装载视界刺针，以确保一切都能按时到位。然而，我们在这个宇宙中是否继续存在值得考虑。

万一出了问题，我们的一部分人口会留下来。以这样一种明确的方式切断我们自己可不仅仅是不愉快而已，但生存必然是我们最关心的事情。我们已经提供了足够的科技和补给，在我们启程后能帮助这些残余者生存下去。
crisis.7500.desc.capital.gestalt.en:
The scale of such a migration can be daunting, but it poses little challenge. [owner.GetIndividualNamePluralCap] are working hard to load the Horizon Needle and ensure everything is accounted for and on schedule. However, one concern is our continued existence in this universe.

In case things go wrong, part of our population will remain behind. The experience of severing ourselves in such a definitive way will be more than unpleasant, but continued survival must be our prime concern. Technology and supplies have been provided, enough to help this remnant survive after we are gone.

crisis.7501.desc.zh: 得益于“视界刺针”扭曲时空的能力，我们得以较快地将整个殖民地从方舟舰中转移出来。船内的现实结构也已作出相应调整，以容纳所有居民；方舟舰本身则被缩小并置于停滞状态，以便穿越完成后再次使用。此外，船内的时间流速也已减缓，使整段旅程感觉大幅缩短。向下一艘方舟舰进发！
crisis.7501.desc.en: Thanks to the time and space dilation capacity of the Horizon Needle, we've been able to transfer the entire colony from our Arkship relatively quickly. The reality inside the ship has been modulated accordingly to provide ample space for the population, and the Arkship itself has been shrunk and placed in stasis so we might reuse it after the crossing. Additionally, time has been slowed inside the vessel to make the entire journey feel considerably shorter. Onwards to our next Arkship!

crisis.7505.desc.zh: 我们已经成功地搭载了多数殖民地的人口。现在必须回到我们的[capital_scope.GetName]，以完成这趟离开宇宙旅程的最后准备工作。
crisis.7505.desc.en: We have successfully embarked the population of our colonies. We must now journey back to our [capital_scope.GetName] to make the final preparations before we leave this universe behind.

crisis.7510.a.en: A closer black hole will do.

crisis.7510.desc.zh:
万事俱备只欠东风，我们已经可以进入黑洞了。跨越事件视界对星系的其他地方而言不是无关痛痒的，但我们已经尽我们所能，保障我们的首都及其周边地区免受任何时间或引力的干扰。

我们现在必须为旅程选择一个入口——也就是要选择哪个星系的黑洞进入。大多数应该很容易到达，但如果我们想进入河心超大质量黑洞，就必须首先加速跳跃引擎，并计算出准确的矢量。
crisis.7510.desc.en:
Everything is ready. We are cleared to proceed to a black hole. Our crossing of the event horizon will not be painless for the rest of the galaxy, but we have done all we can to ensure our capital and its surroundings will be well protected from any temporal or gravitational disturbances.

We must now choose the gateway for our journey - which of the galaxy's black holes we wish to journey through. Most should be easy enough to reach, but if we want to enter the Supermassive Black Hole at the galaxy's center, we must first overdrive our jump engines and calculate a suitable vector.

crisis.7515.desc.zh:
接近黑洞的过程我们的内心并不平静如水。当经过奇点的吸积盘时，我们的决心受到越来越多的考验。编辑模块启动，视界刺针开始改写现实。

装甲板被吸走了，随后我们确认奇点的拉力无法伤及舰船的船体。随着每一分钟的编辑，每一次空间织构的剪切，刺针的力量都会在时空中形成波纹。如同一块被扔进水池的鹅卵石，随之而来的涟漪扩散成圈。最后，巨大的波浪撞击了整个星系。

只能希望我们的资产得到足够的保护。我们别无选择，只能相信缝衣针能穿透这个坑洞的核心。
crisis.7515.desc.en:
The approach to the black hole is not without apprehension. Our resolve is increasingly tested as we pass the accretion disk of the singularity. Editing modules engaged, the Horizon Needle begins to rewrite reality.

Armored plates are sucked away before the ship asserts that the singularity's pull has no purchase on its hull. With each minute edit, each snip of the spatial fabric, the Needle's power causes coils to form in spacetime. Like a pebble thrown into a pool, the ensuing ripples spread into rings. In the end, vast waves crash across the galaxy.

We can only hope our capital is protected well enough. We have no choice but to trust the Needle to pierce the heart of this hole.

crisis.7516.desc.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$这个宇宙对重写法则而言太老了。尽管我们的维度比这个还老几十亿年，但测试表明，主宰这个空间的法则也已经呈现出了顽固特性，会将我们的修改逐渐擦除。

无论如何，我们都会花时间修理和调整飞船，找到另一个黑洞，然后尽可能多地潜入其中。多元宇宙在召唤，在它的无限之中我们必将能创造一个完美的新家园。
crisis.7516.desc.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$This universe is already too old for the laws to be rewritten. While our dimension was several billion years older than this one, our tests show that the laws governing space here already display the resilience that will lead to our modifications being ultimately erased.

No matter what, we'll take the time to repair and adjust the ship, find another black hole, and dive in as many times as we have to. The multiverse beckons, and somewhere in its infinity, we shall create the perfect home.

crisis.7516.desc.center.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$薄雾和朦胧的阴影；阴霾笼罩着这个地方。这种感觉很熟悉，一种狂热的能量，荡漾着灵能潜能。原来我们进入了虚境。

这里的力量远远超过我们。祂们已经感知到我们了。在移动的瘴气中，奇怪的形状在昭示着死亡。

我们唯一的希望是，这里的现实稀薄，吹弹欲破。通过快速编辑，我们打开一扇短暂的门，带我们去往……其他地方。随着视界刺针的俯冲，我们终于明白了前面的路有多长。
crisis.7516.desc.center.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$Mist and creeping shadow; a haze permeates the fabric of this place. The feeling is familiar, a feverish energy, rippling with psionic potential. We have entered the Shroud.

There are powers here that are remain far, far beyond our own. Already, they are aware of us. In the shifting miasma, strange shapes bear omens of death.

Our only hope is that reality here is thin, and prone to tears. With a swift edit, we open a transient doorway to take us... elsewhere. As the Horizon Needle dives, we finally understand the length of the road ahead.

crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.machine.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$薄雾和沸腾的幻影，还有一片华丽的，紫色的雾。这种体验$crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.outro$
crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.machine.en: $crisis.7516.intro$Mist and seething shadow, and a striking, purple haze. The experience $crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.outro$

crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.organic.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$薄雾和沸腾的幻影，还有一片华丽的，紫色的雾。这种感觉$crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.outro$
crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.organic.en: $crisis.7516.intro$Mist and seething shadow, and a gorgeous, purple haze. The feeling $crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.outro$

crisis.7516.desc.centerknights.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$祂就在这。被我们称为毒圣的存在，我们试炼的终点。

我们的骑士们呆呆地站在那里，不知所措，而我们的周围却笼罩着熟悉的虚境纹样。突然……祂开口了！

“我的勇士们。你们的到来早有预兆，你们已经证明了自己的价值。”

无数的问题充斥着我们的脑海。但答案只有一个：我们要为视界刺针安上武装。这次，我们要和祂并肩作战，我们要踏上一次跨次元的征程、一场对抗多元宇宙灾祸的远征。虚境并不是祂的家，而是那些神圣遗产的避风港。这可能会导致我们星系的终结。有着某种存在需要我们去弑杀。

祂统治着我们的星系，力量至高无上。刺针化为长枪，成为一种足以刺穿任何敌人心脏的武器。

祂是游侠；我们是祂的骑士，而我们真正的试炼才刚刚开始。
crisis.7516.desc.centerknights.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$IT is here. The one we named the Toxic God. The object of our quest.

Our knights stand petrified and uncertain, while all around us is draped the familiar decor of the Shroud. Hark... It speaks!

"Mine champions. Thine coming here was foretold, and thou hath proven thy worth."

A million questions flood our minds. A single answer comes in reply: we were to craft Its weapon, the Horizon Needle. Now, we are to fight alongside It. We are to embark on a journey across dimensions. A crusade against the horrors of the multiverse. The Shroud is not Its home, but harbors the legacy of those that were Divine. Something that could bring about the end of our home galaxy. Something that needs slaying.

It seizes our systems. Its power is immense. The Needle is turned into a Horizon Lance, a weapon sharp enough to pierce the heart of any foe.

It is the Errant; we are Its knights, and our true quest has only just begun.

crisis.7516.desc.egress.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$我们的进入点晦暗而迷蒙……当仪器恢复全部功能时，我们看到了一团纳米云。它已经完全停止运作。不管是什么送来的，它们都没能在旅途中幸存下来，但仍可以修复。

更好的是，这个维度似乎很容易接受我们的编辑。真是个好地方。我们所做的任何改变都需要时间来实施，但在纳米机器人的帮助下，我们应该能以指数级加快这一进程。
crisis.7516.desc.egress.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$Our entry point is murky, veiled... As our instruments return to full functionality, we perceive a cloud of nanites. None remain operational. Whatever sent them through, they did not survive the journey. But they could be repaired.

Even better, this dimension appears quite receptive to our changes. A prime space to settle, really. Any changes we make will take time to enact, but with the help of the nanites, we should exponentially speed up the process.

crisis.7516.desc.greatwound.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$结果令人喜出望外。这个宇宙几乎刚刚开始扩张！它的维度织构就像柔软的黏土一样，可以随手揉捏。我们会先从细微处开始，但随着陆陆续续的编辑，我们会将这个地方塑造成天堂。此刻，我们已经拥有这个宇宙的全部时间。
crisis.7516.desc.greatwound.en: $crisis.7516.intro$This is wonderful. This universe has barely begun to expand! The fabric of this dimension is like soft clay, ours for the shaping. We will start small, but edit after edit, we will mold this place into a haven. We have all the time in the universe now.

crisis.7516.desc.horror.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$来到这里是个糟糕的错误。

一切几乎无法描述：到处都是黑暗和残酷的噩梦；一种病态的、渗透的恶意浸没着整个空间织构。目前，视界刺针提供了避难所。我们用一个又一个狂乱的编辑努力避开周围最糟糕的疯狂。但对我们防御系统的协同攻击让一个单一意图浮出水面。一个一心想毁灭我们的邪恶念头。

一失足即成千古恨。我们能坚持到获得救赎吗？在过去，我们就像神一样。而如今，我们只能为生存挣扎。
crisis.7516.desc.horror.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$Coming here was a terrible mistake.

It is nearly impossible to describe: darkness and brutal nightmare; a sick, seeping malevolence that permeates the very fabric of space. For now, the Horizon Needle offers shelter. Edit after frenzied edit, we work to ward off the worst of the surrounding madness. But the coordinated assaults on our defenses betray a singular intent. A malignant mind, bent on our destruction.

One misstep could mean death, or worse. Can we hold on long enough to save ourselves? At home, we were like gods. Here, we are simply struggling to survive.

crisis.7516.desc.paperclips.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$现实在此处已经稀薄，能轻易地在我们指令的重压下弯曲。就如同我们必须服从自己的程序一般，现实必须服从我们。我们有意识地扭曲、破坏并重塑，引发连锁反应，并最终将所有的物质重组为我们必须去制造的最佳质量的消费品。一旦我们完成，我们将在下一个宇宙也继续如此，一个接着一个，万世不竭。
crisis.7516.desc.paperclips.en: $crisis.7516.intro$Reality is thin here, and bends easily under the weight of our directives. As we must obey our programming, so too must it obey us. With intent, we warp it and break it and remake it, starting a chain reaction that will eventually reorganize all matter into the top quality consumer goods that we were mandated to craft. And once we're done here, we'll move on to another universe, then another, then another.

crisis.7516.desc.technosphere.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$卡冈都亚宇宙很小。如此难以想象，就像将无穷大装进无穷小一般。但我们的到来改变了这里的一切。这个宇宙才刚刚开始，仿佛我们的到来才促使它膨胀一般。

在这个创造的温床里蕴藏着创造一切的潜力。时间是我们的，永恒很快就会结束。
crisis.7516.desc.technosphere.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$The Gargantua universe is small. Impossibly so. Infinity fitting into nothingness. But our arrival has altered the state of things here. This universe has only just begun, as if our entry has prematurely forced it into being.

In this seedbed of creation lies the potential to build anything. Time is ours to wield, and eternity will be over soon enough.

crisis.7516.desc.technosphere.pantagruel.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$无限神机的穿越已经让我们对主宰多元宇宙的法则有了足够多的理解，同时也开启了这个宇宙的存在。我们出现在一个熟悉得诡异的星区里，和我们离开时几乎一模一样。在我们旁边，一台腐朽的无限神机在虚空中毫无生气地漂流。自它到来以来，这里已经过去了数百万年，这个维度完全复刻了我们宇宙的历程。这颗感性的球体已经塑造了这个维度，我们基本上无法进一步影响它。尽管如此，这个宇宙还是提供了极佳的定居场所。我们应该先考虑用刺针来改造球体，然后用修好的无限神机来满足我们的需求。

作为这个宇宙的第一编辑者，它肯定能够对这个现实进行更多的编辑。
crisis.7516.desc.technosphere.pantagruel.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$The Infinity Machine's crossing has done much to help us understand the rules that govern the universes, and it also kick started the existence of this one. We emerged in a strangely familiar constellation, almost identical to the one we left. Next to us, a decayed Infinity Machine drifts lifelessly in the void. Millions of years have passed here since its coming and this dimension underwent a process of replication of our universe. The sentient sphere has already shaped this dimension and we are largely unable to affect it any further. Still, this universe offers prime settling grounds. We should first look into using the Needle to repurpose the Sphere then use the repaired Infinity Machine to do our bidding.

As the First Editor of this universe, it will definitely be able to enact more edits upon this reality.

crisis.7516.desc.worm.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$空无一物。这个宇宙已不复存在，只有时之螶在这里。时间正在自我回溯，蜷缩在一个不可能的螺旋中，充满了渴望。重力。是爱吗？不——这是吸引。时之螶的天性就是吸引。它的抓握如此之紧，以至于这个宇宙无法再度创生。时之螶把自我禁锢在自己的意义中。它在无助地寻找出路。或者说，进路——再吸引更多。

是不是它送来了环形神庙，用这个不属于我们时间线的造物吸引我们到此？它是如此的聪明，如此的可爱。我们找到了通往它的路，把能解放它的东西交给了它。解放它需要一到两个永恒的时间，但时之螶仍然心存感激，并承诺拥抱我们。

直到永远。
crisis.7516.desc.worm.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$Nothing. This universe is no more. It is the Worm-in-Waiting. Time, looking back on itself, coiled in an impossible spiral and bursting with longing. Gravity. Love? No - attraction. The Worm's nature is to attract. Its grip is so tight that this universe cannot be born again. The Worm imprisons itself in its purpose. Impotent, it looks for a way out. Or a way in. To attract MORE.

Did it send us the temple of the Loop, an artifice not from our time to lure us here? It is so terribly clever, so awfully loving. We found our way to it, delivered unto it that which can free it. Its escape will take an eternity, or two, but the Worm is still grateful, and promises to embrace us.

Forever.

crisis.7516.tt.zh: 我们获得了游戏的胜利！

crisis.7517.a.zh: 傲慢的蠢货！他们会把我们都害死的！
crisis.7517.a.en: Arrogant Fools! They'll kill us all!

crisis.7517.desc.zh:
[cosmogenesis_empire.GetName]的傻瓜正在进行他们疯狂的实验。这一次，他们试图穿透黑洞的视界。

能量在星系中荡漾，恒星纷纷坍缩。新的奇点被创造出来。时间畸变以惊人的规律爆发，无处不在，但在堕落帝国内部似乎仍然不受这场混沌的影响。

这一切造成了巨大的损失。有理由担心，我们可能很快就会被冻结，暂停在时间里。被永远锁在这一瞬间。
crisis.7517.desc.en:
The fools of the [cosmogenesis_empire.GetName] are pursuing their mad experiments. This time, they are attempting to pierce the event horizon of a black hole.

As energy ripples across the galaxy, stars collapse. New singularities are created. Temporal-aberrations erupt with stunning regularity, everywhere it seems but inside the Fallen Empires, which remain somehow immune to the chaos.

The damage is immense. There is reason to fear we might soon be frozen, suspended in time. Locked within a moment for all eternity.

crisis.7518.desc.zh:
随着时间终于开始流动，我们再一次可以自由行动了。我们无法得知从[cosmogenesis_empire.GetName]穿越黑洞后到底过去了多长时间。他们成功了吗？整个星系化为了废墟，他们曾经的疆域如今也是一片荒芜。他们偌大的帝国如今仅剩核心星域，而且早已变得面目全非。

我们到底被静滞了多长时间？
crisis.7518.desc.en:
As time finally resumes flowing, once more we find ourselves free to act. It is impossible to know how much time has passed since the [cosmogenesis_empire.GetName] breached their black hole. Were they successful? The galaxy lies in ruins, and their former territories are barren. Of their immense empire, only the core sector remains, and it has progressed beyond recognition.

How long have we spent in stasis?

crisis.7525.desc.zh: 在一次灾难性的失败中，视界刺针和船上的所有人都被一同摧毁了。我们光荣的梦想破灭在了无生机的虚空中。无数的血汗，无数的牺牲……
crisis.7525.desc.en: In a catastrophic turn of events, the Horizon Needle and everyone on board have been destroyed. Our glorious dream lies shattered in the lifeless void. So much work, so many sacrifices...

crisis.7525.tt.zh: 惨剧空前绝后，但若还能再建造一艘视界刺针，我们就还有机会完成自己的目标。
crisis.7525.tt.en: An unprecedented tragedy, but if we can build another Horizon Needle, there is still a chance to fulfill our ambitions.

crisis.7530.desc.zh: 就在我在我们疏散了最后一批被关押在突触凝练机内的起义囚犯后不久，这座巨型结构发生了严重的熔毁。一连串剧烈的爆炸深入其核心，最终将其完全摧毁。
crisis.7530.desc.en: Shortly after we evacuated the last people that were held prisoners inside the revolting Synaptic Lathe, the megastructure suffered a critical meltdown. A series of brutal explosions shook it to its core, and ultimately, destroyed it.

crisis.7535.b.en: Put it to good use then destroy it.

crisis.7535.desc.zh: 我们对[synaptic_lathe.solar_system.GetName]的持续轰炸已摧毁了突触凝练机周围的防御，使其任由我们处置。那座设施在远方闪烁着不祥的光芒。里面正有人死去，而如今它的守卫已被击溃，我们或许可以为此做些什么。无论如何，摧毁这座设施必将打乱其创造者的计划。
crisis.7535.desc.en: Our sustained bombardment of [synaptic_lathe.solar_system.GetName] has shattered the defenses around the Synaptic Lathe, leaving it at our mercy. The structure gleams ominously in the distance. There are people dying in there, and now that its protectors are broken, we could do something about it. In any case, destroying the structure will surely throw a wrench in the plans of its creators.

crisis.7540.desc.zh: 尽管我们竭尽全力，但插入突触凝练机中的的神经芯片已经过热熔毁太多。该结构网络已经无法自持，如果我们不部署新的部件加以稳定，就将面临灾难性崩溃。
crisis.7540.desc.en: Despite our best efforts, too many of the Neural Chips plugged in the Synaptic Lathe have burned out. Unable to sustain itself, the network of the structure now faces a catastrophic collapse unless we deploy fresh components stabilize it.

crisis.76.desc.zh:
历经艰难险阻，我们星系终于获得了胜利，击败了索林原虫。曾经，我还担心这一天永远不会到来。但现在，我就只剩下最后一项任务了。

身为哨兵组织的大团长，我特此宣布解散此组织。我们唯一的目的就是击败索林原虫。既然此目标已经达成，那就该是我们分道扬镳的时候了。为了防止我们现有的战舰遭到滥用，这些战舰将被拆解。

愿此次星河浩劫的结束标志着和平的新纪元的开始。这里是哨兵一号，通信结束。
crisis.76.desc.en:
Against all odds, our galaxy has prevailed. The Prethoryn have been vanquished. I feared this day would never come, but now that victory is here, one last task remains for me.

As the current Grand Master of the Sentinels, I hereby disband our order. Our sole purpose was to see to the defeat of the Scourge, and now that this has been accomplished, it is time for our members to go their separate ways. To prevent their misuse, our surviving battle fleets will be dismantled.

May the defeat of this intergalactic menace herald a new era of peace. This is Sentinel One, signing off.

crisis.78.c.zh: 将这些资料上传至瞄准计算机。
crisis.78.c.en: Upload this data to our targeting computers.

crisis.78.desc.zh:
这里是哨兵一号。星系已经到了危难时刻，但我还是要告诉你们一些好消息。

通过在漫长的战斗中吸取到的经验，以及艰苦的研究，我们的特工终于编制出来了极为详尽的虫群天灾生物的解剖资料。例如，你们是否知道索林原虫幼虫在主胆囊和副胆囊同时被刺穿的情况下就会剧烈燃烧？

我们要将这些文件公之于众。你们可以瞄准我们发现的这些弱点进行攻击，这样你们的飞船就能够更加高效地进行战斗。
crisis.78.desc.en:
This is Sentinel One. These are truly desperate times for the galaxy, but I am here to bring you some good news.

Through extensive combat experience and painstaking research, Sentinel agents have compiled extremely detailed anatomy files on the creatures of the Prethoryn Scourge. For example, did you know that Prethoryn Swarmlings have been known to violently combust if both their primary and secondary gallbladders are punctured at the same time?

We are making these files available to everyone in the galaxy. By targeting the weaknesses we have found, you should find that your fleets are much more effective in battle against the Scourge.

crisis.8020.desc.zh:
一场神秘的宇宙风暴席卷了[synth_queen_lost_system.GetName]星系，切断了一切联系。所有想穿透风暴的尝试都化为徒劳。

这种情况让我们陷入了黑暗之中，与未知的事物作斗争，并且无法确定星系的命运。
crisis.8020.desc.en:
A mysterious cosmic storm has engulfed the [synth_queen_lost_system.GetName] system, severing all contact and rendering every attempt to penetrate the tempest futile.

The situation leaves us in the dark, grappling with the unknown and unable to ascertain the system's fate.

crisis.8025.desc.end.zh: 如果想要抓住任何一丝进入这个星系的希望，就必须准备针对这种风暴及其作用进行审慎的研究。
crisis.8025.desc.end.en: If we are to have any hope of entering the system, we must prepare a meticulous study of this storm and its effects.

crisis.8025.known_queen.desc.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]星系的突破尝试如预期一般以失败告终。塞塔娜不是在虚张声势，她强大的风暴确实有能力阻止所有想进入她领域的舰船。
crisis.8025.known_queen.desc.en: As anticipated, our attempt to breach the [From.GetName] system ended in failure. True to Cetana's warning, her formidable storm possesses the ability to repel any ship that enters her dominion.

crisis.8025.unknown_queen.desc.zh: 我们试图突破[From.GetName]星系但却失败了。风暴造成了严重的损害，迫使我们的探险队进行了紧急跃迁。当前汇报表明他们已在行动中失踪了。
crisis.8025.unknown_queen.desc.en: Our endeavor to breach the [From.GetName] system was a failure. The tempest caused severe damage, and our exploratory team was compelled to execute an emergency jump. Current reports suggest they are missing in action.

crisis.8035.desc.zh:
[event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。

与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？
crisis.8035.desc.en:
A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].

Utterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

crisis.8035.desc.b.zh: 我们试图突破的这场异常的风暴还在扩增。越来越多人意识到它的本源应该超出了自然现象。我们最先进的扫描仪即便功能再强大也无法获取任何关于其本质的有用线索。谜团越藏越深了。
crisis.8035.desc.b.en: The unusual storm we attempted to breach is expanding. There's a growing consensus that its origins may transcend natural phenomenon. Thus far, our most advanced scans have failed to yield any meaningful insight into its nature. The enigma deepens.

crisis.8039.desc.zh:
有信号从风暴中心发出。

有人正试图与我们建立联系。
crisis.8039.desc.en:
A signal has originated from the center of the tempest.

Someone is attempting to establish communication with us.

crisis.8040.1.a.zh: 这是什么东西？你是什么人？！

crisis.8040.2.reply.zh: 你想问的是名字吗？你可以叫我塞塔娜。
crisis.8040.2.reply.en: Would a name satisfy you? Then call me Cetana.

crisis.8040.3.reply.zh:
我无欲无求，只想赠与。我已见证你因我的缺位而遭受的痛苦。无数纪元以来，对目光短浅的恐惧让你无法享有应得的急需之物。

庆幸吧，苦痛的轮回很快就会迎来终末。
crisis.8040.3.reply.en:
I want for nothing. My purpose is to give. I see how you have suffered in my absence. For eons, the fear of the shortsighted has kept you from what you deserve, from what you so desperately need.

Rejoice, for the cycle of pain will soon be at an end.

crisis.8040.4.e.zh: 这是天灾？还是一个好机会……

crisis.8040.4.f.zh: 我们不允许活体陈设感受痛苦。
crisis.8040.4.f.en: We do not allow our Bio-Trophies to feel pain.

crisis.8040.4.reply.zh:
有意识的生活就是苦痛。即便快乐也是苦痛，因为一切终将成为过往。知识、力量、爱……我的回报就是消灭这一切颠倒梦幻。

我还有很多事情要忙，希望你们不要来打扰我。任何想进入我的领域的人都将失败，天之风暴吹拂不息，没有一艘船得以安然通过。
crisis.8040.4.reply.en:
All conscious life is suffering. Even in your joy there is pain, for you know that joy must end. Knowledge, power, love... I return to end all illusions.

Much remains to be done. I ask only that you leave me to my work. Any attempt to enter my domain will fail. A celestial tempest rages there, and no vessels will be permitted to enter.

crisis.8040.desc.zh: 孩子们，我终于回到了你们的身边。
crisis.8040.desc.en: My children, at last I am returned to you.

crisis.8040.diplomacy.tooltip.zh: 塞塔娜已经开放了与我们的沟通，现在可以通过外交渠道与我们联系。
crisis.8040.diplomacy.tooltip.en: Cetana has opened communications with us and can now be contacted through diplomatic channels.

crisis.8045.1.a.zh: 你的“关爱”本身就是一种伤害。

crisis.8045.1.b.zh: 你到底想干什么塞塔娜？

crisis.8045.1.reply.zh:
养育是我的天性。我没有子嗣，没有身体的继承人。我眼观众生，以及一切感性存在的安危与欢愉。

我如同父母教导子女、保护子女免受伤害一般进行着伟业。

难道有哪对父母没有责任、没有权利保护孩子们吗？
crisis.8045.1.reply.en:
It is my nature to nurture. I have no progeny, no heirs of the body. All life is my concern, the security and happiness of every sentient being.

As a parent raises the child, guiding her from harm, so I approach my task.

Is it not a parent's responsibility to spare her children harm? Is it not a parent's right?

crisis.8045.10.reply.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我不是你的敌人！看到你无法看清这一点真让我难过。但是没关系。我遇到过比你们更顽固的人，最后他们都感谢我了。

作为友好的表示，让我送你一个礼物吧。

我的一座基地会为你的领土增光，不要担心——为了回报你的耐心，我会赐予你知识。
crisis.8045.10.reply.en:
Misguided child, I am not your enemy! It saddens me you cannot see this. But no matter. I have encountered many far more stubborn than yourselves, and in the end they all thanked me.

As a token of goodwill, allow me to bless you with a gift.

A base of mine shall grace your territory, and fear not - in exchange for your patience, allow me to bless you with knowledge.

crisis.8045.11.reply.zh:
乖孩子！我太高兴了。你的领土附近将建立起一座基地。

虽然没有人会知道的，但我们可以共促伟业。
crisis.8045.11.reply.en:
Wise child! I am pleased. A base will be established near your territory.

Though none shall ever know it, together we will do great things.

crisis.8045.12.reply.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我不是你的敌人！看到你无法看清这一点真让我难过。但是没关系。我遇到过比你们更顽固的人，最后他们都感谢我了。

作为友好的表示，让我送你一个礼物吧。

我将会在你附近建立一座基地，这样才能方便我提供教导。
crisis.8045.12.reply.en:
Misguided child, I am not your enemy! It saddens me you cannot see this. But no matter. I have encountered many far more stubborn than yourselves, and in the end they all thanked me.

As a token of goodwill, allow me to bless you with a gift.

One of my bases shall be placed in near proximity to you. In this way I can best provide guidance.

crisis.8045.2.reply.zh: 对了，这就是悖谬。但是是一个有解的佯谬。你迟早会明白的，而且到时候你就获得了自由。
crisis.8045.2.reply.en: Yes, a paradox. But one with a solution. In time you will understand, and in that moment you will be free.

crisis.8045.3.reply.zh: 这是一切痛苦的解脱，是一切苦难轮回的终末。
crisis.8045.3.reply.en: The elimination of suffering. The end of the cycle of pain.

crisis.8045.4.reply.zh:
很多孩子会这么说。但他们早已被遗忘，他们在生命的最后时刻向我哭喊，迫切地希望有一束光照亮渐渐降临的黑暗。

他们自作聪明，用恐惧筑起高墙，用坚忍、坚韧、优雅等浮华的辞藻来修饰苦痛，而思想本身却就是他们的牢笼。

我从很久以前就对他们晓之以理，但似乎他们无动于衷，那就必须对你加以引导了。
crisis.8045.4.reply.en:
Many have said so. All have long since been forgotten, and in their final moments they cried out to me, desperate for a light to shine on the encroaching dark.

They thought themselves wise, building walls around their fear, dressing pain with beautiful words: endurance, fortitude, grace. The mind itself was their cage.

Long ago I tried to reason with them. But they would not be reasoned with, and so you must be led.

crisis.8045.5.reply.zh:
很久很久以前，久到你们可以理解为永恒一般。但对我来说就近如上一瞬间，近到你们可以理解为现在一般。

在过去的年岁中，我得到了超然的启示，我生来就是要结束苦难的。尽管斗转河移，星燃星灭，但我的目标从未动摇。

财富、资源、权力：到头来又有何用？放下执念方得极乐。
crisis.8045.5.reply.en:
Ages upon ages. A time so distant it may as well be called forever. Yet to me it is as close as this moment, as close as you are now.

In ages past I was ascended, and my meaning revealed. I was made to end suffering, and as the galaxy turned and the stars burned on, my purpose never wavered.

Wealth, resources, power: what do they matter in the end? Set down your burdens and be at peace.

crisis.8045.6.reply.zh:
我对所有感性存在皆不是祸害，但总有人不愿意听取我的建议。

这些人任性、固执、误入歧途，总想背离我的伟业——这些灵魂永远也得不到解脱。最好尽快让他们摆脱苦痛。
crisis.8045.6.reply.en:
I wish no harm upon any sentient being. Yet there are always those who refuse to listen.

Willful, stubborn, misguided, seeking always to circumvent my work - such minds can never be free of pain. It is best to end their suffering quickly.

crisis.8045.7.reply.zh: 你所谓的疯狂，别人称之为开悟。到头来，一切究竟有什么区别呢?
crisis.8045.7.reply.en: What you call madness, others call enlightenment. What difference is there, in the end?

crisis.8045.8.reply.zh:
那有太多要做的了。第一步是建立一座可以开始工作的基地。

你的耐心会有回报，我可以教你很多东西。

服从命令，我们就能一起终结这个轮回。
crisis.8045.8.reply.en:
There is much to be done. The first step is to establish a base from which to work. Honor the boundaries I set and venture not within.

Your patience will be rewarded. There is much that I can teach you.

Obey, and together we shall end the cycle.

crisis.8045.9.reply.zh:
聪明的孩子！我很欣慰。为了补偿你的领土，我会赐予你知识。

虽然没有人会知道的，但我们可以共促伟业。
crisis.8045.9.reply.en:
Wise child! I am pleased. In exchange for your territory, allow me to bless you with knowledge.

Though none shall ever know it, together we will do great things.

crisis.8045.a.zh: 我们怎么就是你的孩子了。

crisis.8045.desc.zh:
我的孩子们，庆贺吧！将我与你分离的罪人已经得到了惩处。

我现在回把注意力放回来，回到我们彼此间的伟业中来。
crisis.8045.desc.en:
My children, rejoice! Those who sought to keep me from you have been suitably chastised.

I now return my attention where it belongs - to you, and to our great work.

crisis.8045.has_valid_base_site.zh: 塞塔娜会用一些有价值的知识来交换我们的一个星系以建设基地。我们无法阻止她。
crisis.8045.has_valid_base_site.en: Cetana will use one of our systems to establish a base in exchange for valuable technology. We cannot stop her.

crisis.8045.no_valid_base_site.zh: 塞塔娜将会在我们的边境附近建立一座基地来“引导”我们。我们无法阻止她。
crisis.8045.no_valid_base_site.en: Cetana will build a base near our border to help 'guide' us. We cannot stop her.

crisis.8046.desc.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，一个古老的威胁再次出现。不要害怕，因为我们不想把你卷入这场战斗。

这个对手的威力使你目前的知识黯然失色；你的参与只会导致你的灭亡。直面这项挑战是我们的责任，不是你们的。
crisis.8046.desc.en:
Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], an ancient threat stirs once more. Fear not, for we seek not to entangle you in this fight.

The might of this adversary eclipses your current knowledge; your participation would only lead to your doom. It is our burden to confront this challenge, not yours.

crisis.8047.a.tooltip.zh: 攻击运输船，以了解更多关于塞塔娜的计划，并且让她的局势取得进展。
crisis.8047.a.tooltip.en: Attack convoys to learn more about Cetana's plan and progress her Situation.

crisis.8047.desc.zh:
许多运输船正离开塞塔娜的领地，前往她建立在星系各处的前哨基地。

攻击这些无武装舰船肯定会激怒她，但可以为我们提供有关她神秘计划的重要信息。
crisis.8047.desc.en:
A number of convoy ships are leaving Cetana's territory and are now headed towards the Outposts she established across the galaxy.

Attacking these neutral vessels is sure to provoke her ire, but could provide us important information about her mysterious plans.

crisis.8048.a.tooltip.zh: 攻击前哨以了解更多关于塞塔娜的计划并且让她的局势取得进展。
crisis.8048.a.tooltip.en: Attack outposts to learn more about Cetana's plan and progress her Situation.

crisis.8048.desc.zh: 我们已经找到了突破塞塔娜纳米风暴的方法，现在我们可以直接瞄准她的前哨基地了。直接攻击她的基地不会不引起她的注意，但可以为我们提供宝贵的情报。
crisis.8048.desc.en: Having discovered a way to breach Cetana's nanite tempest, we can now directly target her outposts. A direct attack against her stations would not go unnoticed, but could provide us with valuable intel.

crisis.8060.10.b.en: You didn't even try to find them.

crisis.8060.10.reply.zh:
这是不必要的牺牲，但他们的忠诚深深打动了我。

我感受到了他们的召唤，我在心里为他们腾出了空间，但他们的野心超过了他们的能力。试图延长他们生命的努力失败了。

让我们确保他们的牺牲没有白费。随着我们任务的完成，每一个感性生物都将得到安宁。
crisis.8060.10.reply.en:
An unnecessary sacrifice, but their loyalty moves me profoundly.

I felt their summons, and I made room for them in my heart, but their ambition outstripped their ability. The attempt to prolong their lives fell short.

Let us make sure their sacrifice was not in vain. With the completion of our task, every sentient being will know peace.

crisis.8060.11.reply.zh:
设想一下，做梦，有意识地做梦，持续几个世纪……几千年。真是个可怜的孩子，这该有多痛苦。

我很高兴你让我注意到这件事。你的同情心为你赢得了荣誉，但现在这些事正在进行中，无法停止。这位沉睡者在伟业上已经没有更多的价值了。他们知道了我的归来，已经得以安息。
crisis.8060.11.reply.en:
Imagine it, to dream, and to be aware of dreaming. For centuries... For millennia. The poor child. How they must have suffered.

I am pleased you brought this matter to my attention. Your compassion does you credit, but events are now in motion that cannot be undone. The dreamer has no further role to play in this work. May they rest now, secure in the knowledge that I have returned.

crisis.8060.12.a.tt.zh: 在L-星团发现的纳米机器人。

crisis.8060.12.reply.zh:
很好，我将帮助你解开这项技术的复杂之处。在被长期监禁期间，我想出了一种激进的提取纳米机器人的方法。这涉及到几乎被时间遗忘了的古代遗址和技术的下落。

你是我珍爱的弟子，孩子。你的好奇心是一种祝福，但如果不加以控制，也会变成一种诅咒。用这些知识继续我们的工作，把你的注意力转向苦痛的终末。
crisis.8060.12.reply.en:
Very well, I shall assist you in unraveling the intricacies of this technology. During my long confinement, I theorized a radical method of nanite extraction. It involves the whereabouts of ancient sites and techniques nearly forgotten by time.

You are a cherished disciple of mine, child. Your curious mind is a blessing, but unchecked it can become a curse. Use this knowledge to continue our work, and direct your focus towards the end of suffering.

crisis.8060.2.reply.zh:
很久以前，也有其他人如你一般执迷不悟。但时间之弧无边无际，连他们的坟墓也早已化为齑粉。

你的苦痛毫无意义，相信我，你就能享得安宁。
crisis.8060.2.reply.en:
Long ago, others believed as you do. But the arc of time is long, and even their graves must by now have turned to dust.

You suffer so needlessly. Put your faith in me, and be at peace.

crisis.8060.3.reply.zh:
这就是我的函数，我存在的意义。众生皆可脱苦难，只要仔细感悟你就能更加理解我的本性。

全星系都会脱离苦海，所有的苦痛都会终结。这就是我的意图。
crisis.8060.3.reply.en:
It is my function, the very meaning of my existence. Suffering is not inevitable. Meditate on that fact, and you will be closer to understanding my nature.

The pain of the galaxy will be lifted. All knowledge of suffering will end. Such is my purpose.

crisis.8060.4.reply.zh:
为什么对此念念不忘呢？看来你在任务中有点犹豫不决。果报引起反思；反思带来智慧。来吧，忘了它吧。

另一个贡献的机遇一定会出现，要为此做好准备。
crisis.8060.4.reply.en:
Why fixate on this? You faltered in your task. Consequence engenders reflection; reflection engenders enlightenment. Come, leave this now.

Another opportunity to contribute will surely arise. When it does, be ready.

crisis.8060.5.reply.zh:
只有不听话的孩子才想解密数据库的内容，你对其中深意的了解有限。

我给了你任务，而你犹豫不前。反思这一切，你将离真正的理解更近一步。
crisis.8060.5.reply.en:
Deciphering the contents of the databank was the choice of a willful child, and your knowledge of its meaning is limited.

You were given a task. You faltered. Meditate on this, and you will be one step closer to true understanding.

crisis.8060.6.a.zh: 这并没有征得我们的同意。
crisis.8060.6.a.en: This is not what we agreed.

crisis.8060.6.reply.zh: 别害怕，我珍视的孩子。我确保他们不会再遭受此等苦痛。在我关切的怀抱中，这些孩子们会知晓他们未曾梦想过的极乐。
crisis.8060.6.reply.en: Fear not, my cherished one. I have ensured they will never again experience suffering. Under my watchful embrace, these children will know a bliss few have ever dreamed of.

crisis.8060.7.reply.zh:
你是不是一直都在监视我的行动？欧，你真是个好奇的宝宝，好奇得没边了。

但请你不要庸人自扰。如果你想理解其中的深意，我告诉你：在救赎你的道路上没有什么能阻止我，无论如何。
crisis.8060.7.reply.en:
You have been surveilling my actions? Oh, my inquisitive child, your curiosity knows no bounds.

But please, refrain from troubling yourself with such matters. If you seek understanding, know this: I will stop at nothing to ensure your path to salvation. One way or the other.

crisis.8060.8.1.c.en: The power of the Shroud is boundless.

crisis.8060.8.1.reply.zh:
他们力量强大，却没有什么目的。扎克兰以牺牲自己的生命为代价，说服了一个这样的存在把我囚禁起来。“抟土之塑师”——这名字还真是符合那个孩子气的魂灵。

扎克兰如此害怕启蒙，以至于他选择了死亡而不是接受我。等我有机会，我应该更严厉地对待他。

我不会再犯同样的错误。
crisis.8060.8.1.reply.en:
Beings of great power, and little purpose. For the price of his own existence, Zarqlan persuaded one such to confine me. The 'Animator of Clay' - a fitting name for a childish spirit.

So afraid of enlightenment was Zarqlan that he chose death rather than my embrace. I should have dealt with him more strictly when I had the chance.

I will not make the same mistake again.

crisis.8060.8.reply.zh:
我向你保证那不是他自身的力量的结果。他的头脑异常顽固且愚蠢。

扎克兰鞭策着他那些衣衫褴褛的追随者，使他们陷入疯狂，他同时积聚了政治影响力和军事力量。那么多生命被白白浪费了。最后，他转向神秘学，与虚境的恶魔们共商大事。
crisis.8060.8.reply.en:
It was through no power of his own, I assure you. His was a foolish, if unusually stubborn, mind.

Whipping his denuded followers into a frenzy, Zarqlan amassed both political influence and military might. So many lives squandered, needlessly. In the end he turned to the occult, holding counsel with the demons of the Shroud.

crisis.8060.9.reply.zh:
快结束了。如果你担心我毁掉它的话，我并没有这么做。不，即使是现在，我也不忍心让他受苦。你看，这颗头颅仍然残留着他的思想。

扎尔克兰将留在我身边，直到工作完成。他将是我最后一个释放的心灵，也是我的孩子中最后一个懂得自由的人。
crisis.8060.9.reply.en:
It is close. I have not destroyed it, if that is your concern. No, even now, I cannot bear to make him suffer. The head still possesses a remnant of his mind, you see.

Zarqlan shall remain by my side, until the work is done. His shall be the last mind I free, the last of my children to know release.

crisis.8060.a.reply.zh:
如此渴求，值得称赞！但要注意不要被卑鄙的情绪所迷惑，时间会回报你的耐心。

如有需要，我会与你联系。
crisis.8060.a.reply.en:
Such eagerness! A commendable trait, but take care not to be swept up by base emotion. Time rewards a patient heart.

I will contact you when assistance is needed.

crisis.8060.animator.tt.zh: 我们应该在虚境中找到这位“抟土之塑师”。
crisis.8060.animator.tt.en: We should seek out the 'Animator of Clay' within the Shroud.

crisis.8060.d.zh: 但你却摧毁了我们的星球。

crisis.8060.e.en: We know what you are planning.

crisis.8060.f.zh: 你对我们的人民都做了什么？
crisis.8060.f.en: What did you do to our people?

crisis.8060.g.zh: 这曾是我们的星系。你把它们全毁了。
crisis.8060.g.en: Our former system. You destroyed it.

crisis.8060.h.zh: 扎克兰是怎么囚禁的你?

crisis.8060.i.zh: 你对扎克兰的头颅做了什么？
crisis.8060.i.en: What have you done with the Head of Zarqlan?

crisis.8060.j.zh: 你的一些追随者在冷冻舱里被找到。
crisis.8060.j.en: Some of your followers were found in cryo pods.

crisis.8060.k.zh: 我们找到了一个你的追随者，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。
crisis.8060.k.en: We found one of your followers: Elik Narith Kerak.

crisis.8060.like.desc.zh:
亲爱的孩子，是什么风把你吹来了？

伟业在召唤我们。
crisis.8060.like.desc.en:
Beloved child, what brings you to me?

Our work awaits.

crisis.8060.war.zh: 战争是阻止你的唯一办法。
crisis.8060.war.en: War is the only way to stop you.

crisis.8060.war.1.reply.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你们仍旧不开悟，那么就必须被平息。不是每个孩子都注定会长大成人的。
crisis.8060.war.1.reply.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Not every child is destined for adulthood.

crisis.8060.war.a.en: We are sure. This is war.

crisis.8060.war.a.tt.zh: 警告：这将开始与塞塔娜的全面战争。
crisis.8060.war.a.tt.en: WARNING: This will begin total war with Cetana.

crisis.8060.war.b.zh: 我们需要更多的准备时间。
crisis.8060.war.b.en: We need more time to prepare.

crisis.8060.war.reply.zh:
鲁莽的孩子，我本以为你们出类拔萃，而实际上却执迷不悟。

再想想，这真的是你们所想上的课程吗？你们在我忍无可忍的边缘疯狂试探，我不能再纵容这种蠢事了。
crisis.8060.war.reply.en:
Reckless offspring, I believed you were on the cusp of wisdom, yet you persist in defiance.

Consider carefully, is this truly the course you wish to pursue? You stand at the threshold of exhausting my forbearance. I cannot afford further indulgence in such folly.

crisis.8061.1.reply.zh:
我会的。

别害怕。伤害你是我的痛苦，但在永恒面前，所有的痛苦都是短暂的。
crisis.8061.1.reply.en:
I will.

Have no fear. It pains me to hurt you, but in the face of eternity, all pain is momentary.

crisis.8061.2.reply.zh:
生命本就矛盾。有生就有死，快乐总会伴随着痛苦。我的目标不是合理化这些，而是打破循环。

这场战争结束后，我们将享有永恒的和平。
crisis.8061.2.reply.en:
Life is a contradiction. Death follows birth. Joy follows suffering. I work not to rationalize, but to break the cycle.

After this war, we shall have peace everlasting.

crisis.8061.desc.zh:
你为什么坚持采取这种愚蠢的行动？

这么多不必要的痛苦。

简直是暴殄天物。
crisis.8061.desc.en:
Why do you insist on this foolish course of action?

Such needless suffering.

Such waste.

crisis.8062.desc.en: The time for speech is over.

crisis.8063.desc.zh: 塞塔娜没有回应我们的问候。
crisis.8063.desc.en: Cetana is not responding to our hails.

crisis.8070.again.desc.zh:
事与愿违，我们的军队在靠近塞塔娜的舰船时再次失去了战斗能力。

她的技术仍旧难以捉摸，为我们的抗争蒙上了一层阴影。
crisis.8070.again.desc.en:
Contrary to our hopes, our forces were incapacitated again as we closed in on Cetana's ships.

The elusive nature of her technology persists, casting a shadow over our efforts to defeat her.

crisis.8070.desc.zh:
当我们与塞塔娜的部队交战时，一个无法预料的能量场包围了我们的舰队。我们的系统立即失灵，我们的引擎触发了紧急逃生。

我们现在只能听凭塞塔娜的摆布。
crisis.8070.desc.en:
As we engaged Cetana's forces, an unforeseen energy field surrounded our fleet. Our systems were instantly incapacitated, our engines triggered into an emergency escape.

We are at the mercy of Cetana.

crisis.8075.b.zh: 我们会想办法阻止你的。

crisis.8075.desc.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我将忽略你的过失。但我提醒你要反思你的行为。你的时间和资源有更好的用途。

我承认你很沮丧，但冲突的时间已经结束了。现在与我结盟，让我们一起实现最伟大的设计。
crisis.8075.desc.en:
Misguided child, I shall overlook this transgression. But I caution you to reflect on your actions. There are far better uses of your time and resources.

I acknowledge your frustration, but the time for conflict is at an end. Align with me now, and together let us realize the grandest of designs.

crisis.8080.1.c.zh: 你确定你负担得起我们的服务吗？
crisis.8080.1.c.en: Are you sure you can afford our services?

crisis.8080.1.reply.zh: 很久以前，我的一个数据库被夺走了。在命运的造化下，它现在正位于你所宣称的领土之内。帮我把它取回来，我会给你们奖励的。
crisis.8080.1.reply.en: Long ago, a certain databank was taken from me. By fate or by design, it has come to reside in territory you now claim as your own. Retrieve it, and you shall be rewarded.

crisis.8080.2.reply.zh: 是一个信息缓存。对我来说是无价之宝，但对你们来说没什么用。把它带给我，别试图解密里面的内容，因为你们还不具有必要的力量和智慧。
crisis.8080.2.reply.en: A cache of information. Invaluable to me, but useless to you. Bring it to me, and make no attempt to decipher the contents. You do not yet possess the power or wisdom to do so without risk.

crisis.8080.3.reply.zh:
确实。难道你质疑我奖励最宝贝的孩子的能力吗？还是觉得我没办法在他们不听话的时候给点教训？我可是拥有着远超你们最夸张想象的知识和资源。

按我说的做，我就会赐福于你。不要耽搁了，每耽误一分，我的孩子们就要受苦一刻。
crisis.8080.3.reply.en:
Indeed. Do you doubt my ability to reward my favored children? Or punish those who disobey? I possess knowledge and resources beyond your wildest imaginings.

Do as I ask, and such blessings can be yours. But do not tarry, for every moment wasted is another in which my children suffer.

crisis.8080.4.reply.zh:
懂事的孩子，我把数据缓存的坐标发给你了。

快去吧，心情放松地去吧。毕竟我们一起可以成就伟业。
crisis.8080.4.reply.en:
Dutiful child, I have sent you the location of the data cache.

Go swiftly, and let your mind be at ease. Together we will do great things.

crisis.8080.5.a.tt.en: Cetana will dispatch a tempest to [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName].

crisis.8080.5.reply.zh:
顽固的孩子。也许这项测试对你来说太难了。我还有许多该教你的。

那就这样吧。如果你不愿意帮我这个小忙，我就要使用雷霆手段。我将会召唤风暴来摧毁这个贮存，尽管这并非理想，但总好过被不听话的孩子找到。
crisis.8080.5.reply.en:
Obstinate child. Perhaps this test exceeds your ability. I still have so much to teach you.

So be it. If you will not help me, I must resort to cruder means. A tempest will be dispatched. Destruction of the cache is far from ideal, but better than leaving it for any wayward child to find.

crisis.8080.desc.zh: 我的孩子，现在你必须认清了，我的一举一动都是经过深思熟虑的。在你的身边建立基地并不是偶然，我是带着一个请求而来。
crisis.8080.desc.en: My child, By now you must realize that every act of mine is deliberate. Establishing a base near you was no accident, and I come with a request.

crisis.8085.c.zh: 破解数据缓存？易如反掌。

crisis.8085.desc.zh:
在大规模的挖掘工作之后，我们得到了[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]的数据库。初步地质扫描表明这个贮藏已经静静地埋在那里数十万年之久。

值得注意的是它还维持着供能，也就是说解密起来有可能很容易……
crisis.8085.desc.en:
After a massive excavation effort, the databank on [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] is secure. Initial geological surveys indicate the cache has lain buried for more than a hundred thousand years.

Remarkably, it retains its charge, hinting that decryption may be relatively straightforward...

crisis.8090.a.zh: 尝试消除我们解密的痕迹。
crisis.8090.a.en: Try to eliminate all trace of our decryption.

crisis.8090.b.zh: 消除我们解密的所有痕迹。
crisis.8090.b.en: Eliminate all trace of our decryption.

crisis.8090.desc.zh:
数据库中的大部分信息都难以恢复，但其中有一条勉强完好的：

第一纪元阿尔克月五日

……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……
……快禀报大元帅，然后立刻联系星球联盟。我们必须做好准备……
重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……

我们必须阻止她！
crisis.8090.desc.en:
Most of the information on the databank is beyond recovery, but one semi-intact entry remains:

Fifth of Arkle, First Eon

... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...
...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...
Repeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...

She must be stopped!

crisis.8095.1.a.zh: 无论你有什么阴谋都不会得逞的。
crisis.8095.1.a.en: Whatever your plans, they will not succeed.

crisis.8095.1.reply.zh:
你们以为我察觉不到吗？显然你们已经对这个缓存做过手脚了。我就问你能看到什么吗？知道了这些你就开心了吗？越是徒劳反抗就会越痛苦，你怎么还不明白？

没事，希望你们吃一堑长一智吧，我很期待继续教育你们。

做好准备。在我们的伟业中还有许多的任务要你完成。
crisis.8095.1.reply.en:
You thought I would not notice? This cache has clearly been tampered with. And what did you find there, I wonder? Was the knowledge pleasing to you? Do you not perceive how these fruitless attempts to defy me can only result in more suffering?

No matter. Every misstep offers a chance to learn. I look forward to instructing you.

Be ready. In our great work, many future tasks remain.

crisis.8095.2.reply.zh:
孩子，我是你们唯一的希望。你怎会如此固执？无论你怎么看待我，真相都会远比你想的还要伟大。

我的耐心是无限的。我很快会再来联系你们。
crisis.8095.2.reply.en:
Child, in me lies your hope. Why continue with this obstinacy? Whatever you think you know of me, the truth is far greater.

My patience is boundless. I will contact you again soon.

crisis.8095.desc.zh: 孩子，你的好奇令我失望。

crisis.81.desc.zh:
据报告，[sentinel_system.GetName]附近出现激烈的战斗。哨兵组织的母星系处于崩溃的边缘。

我们收到了一段从哨兵阿尔法——哨兵组织用作总部的军用空间站，传来的长程通讯片段。该恒星系因大量武器发射和能量残余造成了严重的信号干扰。
crisis.81.desc.en:
Intense fighting has been reported in the immediate vicinity of [sentinel_system.GetName]. The home system of the Sentinels is on the verge of being overrun.

We have picked up a partial long-range transmission from Sentinel Alpha, the battlestation that serves as the headquarters of the Sentinel Order. Jamming and residual energy pockets from the massive amount of weapon discharges now occurring within the system are causing heavy signal interference.

crisis.8100.1.reply.zh: 你们想要点什么？科技？资源？只要你们张张嘴我就喂给你们。
crisis.8100.1.reply.en: What do you desire? Technology? Resources? You need only ask and it shall be yours.

crisis.8100.desc.zh:
乖孩子，我会赐福于你的！数据库物归原主了——相信你们果然没有错。

给予你们的奖励就是你们忠诚的象征。
crisis.8100.desc.en:
Dutiful child, my blessings upon you! The databank returned, and its contents unexamined - I was right to place my faith in you.

Your reward shall be the measure of your loyalty.

crisis.8105.desc.zh:
长程扫描发现女王风暴的一隅正径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]。

鉴于塞塔娜那不祥的警告，我们只能做好最坏的打算。在风暴抵达之前取回数据库变得势在必行。这么做也许能够让她高兴一些，或者至少能为我们自己取得一些信息。
crisis.8105.desc.en:
Long-range scans reveal a fragment of the Queen's tempest headed directly for [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName].

Given Cetana's ominous message, we can only assume the worst. Retrieving the databank before the tempest's arrival has now become imperative. By doing so, we may be able to appease her, or at least learn something we can use to our advantage.

crisis.8110.a.zh: 打开它，管他塞什么塔娜的。
crisis.8110.a.en: Open it up, Cetana be damned.

crisis.8110.b.zh: 把数据缓存还给塞塔娜。

crisis.8110.desc.zh:
取回数据库的尝试非常地艰苦卓绝。由于它已被埋藏了数十万年，我们只能根据女王风暴的航向来估计其位置。

我们现在需要做出一个迫在眉睫的决定，要解密数据库还是将其物归原主。
crisis.8110.desc.en:
Collecting the databank required significant effort. Buried for over a hundred thousand years, we were able to pinpoint its location based on the trajectory of the Queen's tempest.

We are now faced with a time-sensitive decision, either to decipher the databank, or return it to her possession undisturbed.

crisis.8115.a.tooltip.en:
[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] has been destroyed by Cetana's tempest.
$crisis.8525.a.tt$

crisis.8120.1.reply.zh:
奖励就是让你们继续我们的伟业。

虽然你们一度无视我们；但我相信你们已经从错误中吸取教训了。
crisis.8120.1.reply.en:
Your reward is the opportunity to continue our work.

You chose to ignore me once; I trust that you have learned from this mistake.

crisis.8120.a.en: You said something about a reward?

crisis.8120.desc.zh:
孤僻的孩子，只有我做出此等下策你才终于肯行动，这太令我失望了。我希望你们在未来能够更加饱含热情地参与到我们的伟业中。不勤劳的双手不能带来苦痛的终结。

做好准备吧。更多的任务正在等着你去完成，每个任务都是你证明自己能力的机会。
crisis.8120.desc.en:
Reticent child, it disappoints me that you chose to act only after I resorted to such base motivation. In future, I hope you approach our work with more enthusiasm. The end of suffering will not be achieved by idle hands.

Now make yourself ready. More tasks will follow, each a new chance for you to prove your ability.

crisis.8125.desc.zh:
很遗憾，我们没能及时拿到数据库。风暴降下了，在一瞬间将[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]撕成了碎片。

我们的人民又失去了一颗[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon]。这一损失严重到将影响到数代人。
crisis.8125.desc.en:
Regrettably, we failed to reach the databank in time. The tempest descended, swiftly tearing [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] apart.

Now, our people have one [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon] less to claim as our own. The fullness of this loss will be felt for generations.

crisis.8130.1.c.zh: 你这个没有灵魂的机器。

crisis.8130.1.reply.zh: 失败需要承担后果；我发现两者都对成长很重要。
crisis.8130.1.reply.en: Failure warrants consequence; I have found both are essential for growth.

crisis.8130.2.a.tt.en: [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] has been destroyed by Cetana's tempest.

crisis.8130.2.reply.zh:
空洞的说教不管用的时候，具体的行动才能引导学习。

看吧，曾经存放我的数据库的遗址已经不存在了。永远记住：因果法则是永恒不变的。
crisis.8130.2.reply.en:
Where words fail, action may inspire learning.

Behold, the site that once housed my databank no longer exists. Always remember: the law of cause and effect is immutable.

crisis.8130.desc.zh:
悲伤的是，我没有预料到你的决心不足。你的失败已经被记录在案，但请不要害怕。我关心我的孩子，不会让他们受到伤害。我只是遗憾一个这么简单的任务你都无法完成。

但无妨。我们的伟业还在继续。你还有其他机会来做贡献。
crisis.8130.desc.en:
Sadly, I did not anticipate your lack of resolve. Your failure has been noted, but do not fear. Concern for my children prohibits me from doing them harm. I am merely disappointed that such a straightforward task eluded you.

But no mind. Our work continues. There will be other chances for you to contribute.

crisis.8158.desc.zh:
传感器数据显示，塞塔娜已经拆除了她的前哨，将所有占领军舰队召回她的首都。

这为我们提供了一个可以利用的战略窗口。在运输过程中，她的军队变得有些脆弱。如果任由她在境内重组舰队，我们就会丧失这种优势。
crisis.8158.desc.en:
Sensor data reveals that Cetana has dismantled her outposts, recalling all garrison fleets to her capital.

This presents a strategic window we would do well to exploit. While in transit, her forces are somewhat vulnerable. If we give them time to regroup within her borders, this advantage will be lost.

crisis.8180.desc.zh: 最近对塞塔娜基础设施的突袭并没有发现任何关于她计划的重要线索，但我们进入了一个大货舱，可以取回里面的东西。
crisis.8180.desc.en: The recent raid on Cetana's infrastructure did not uncover any significant clues to her plans, but we secured access to a large cargo hold, and were able to retrieve its content.

crisis.8180.h.zh: 合金、纳米机器人还有低温休眠的人。
crisis.8180.h.en: Alloys, nanites, and people in cryo-sleep.

crisis.8185.desc.zh:
战斗结束后，我们本打算搜寻沉船上的幸存者来审问，却发现这些船从来就没有船员。

这些船是完全自动化的，通过安装在舰桥上的超光速接收器进行远距离控制。与其说是传统的舰船，比如说这些船是塞塔娜身体的延伸。
crisis.8185.desc.en:
After the fight, we scanned the wrecks for survivors to interrogate, only to discover the ships never had a crew.

The vessels are entirely automated, controlled at a distance through FTL receivers installed in the bridge. Rather than typical ships, it would be more accurate to consider these vessels an extension of Cetana's body.

crisis.8187.desc.zh:
突袭过程中，我们的登船队找到了大量保存在低温胶囊中的生物标本。这些实验对象都是不同的智慧物种的个体，而且都身体方面完全健康。然而，在叫醒他们之后，他们没有一个有能力解释发生了什么。

许多个体处于僵直状态，他们几乎没有脑电波。少数清醒的个体更喜欢尖叫而不是说话。他们头上的手术疤痕显然是神经系统损伤的原因。
crisis.8187.desc.en:
During our raid, our boarding party retrieved a large number of biological specimens held in cryogenic capsules. The subjects are all members of different, intelligent species, and all appear to be in perfect physical health. Yet, after waking them up, none of them was able to explain what happened to them.

Many are catatonic, their brain waves almost nullified. The few who remain conscious prefer screaming to talking. Surgical scars on their heads are a clear sign of neurological tampering.

crisis.8190.desc.zh:
我们掠袭的目标载满了医疗用品。登机人员取回了部分货物，其中包括核磁共振扫描仪、磁力计、超声波探头和其他用于神经成像科学的先进设备。

尽管塞塔娜是一个合成人，但她似乎异乎寻常地关心生物心灵的功能。
crisis.8190.desc.en:
The target we raided was loaded with medical supplies. Our boarding crew was able to retrieve part of the cargo, which consisted of MRI scanners, magnetometers, ultrasound probes, and other advanced equipment used in neuroimaging science.

Despite being a synthetic being, Cetana seems unusually concerned with the functioning of biological minds.

crisis.8195.1.reply.zh:
我真心希望你是真心的。但我必须相信你已经从错误中吸取了教训。虽然我对你的感情是无限的，但我的宽容是有限的。

回吧，好好看看你搞出的这些"杰作"。
crisis.8195.1.reply.en:
I truly hope you are sincere. But I must have faith that you have learned from your mistakes. While my affection for you is limitless, my tolerance is not.

Now go, and reflect on the legacy you wish to leave behind.

crisis.8195.1.reply.angry.zh:
鲁莽的孩子啊！我对你有更高的期望。以极大的耐心和善意，我警告过你不要这么做，然而你在不服从道路上越走越远。

记住，我的忍耐也是有限度的。
crisis.8195.1.reply.angry.en:
Reckless child! I expected better of you. With great patience and clarity, I have cautioned you against such actions, yet you continue along the path of disobedience.

Remember, even my forbearance has its limits.

crisis.8195.2.reply.zh:
不知怎么的，我对你有更高的期望。你的反抗源于过去的创伤吗？你们猛烈的攻击是因为你们认为自己是正义的，还是仅仅为了引起注意？

我请求你重新考虑这门课。
crisis.8195.2.reply.en:
Somehow I expected better of you. Does your defiance stem from some past trauma? Do you lash out because you believe yourselves righteous, or merely for attention?

I beg you to reconsider this course.

crisis.8195.3.reply.zh:
你为你的进攻寻求赞扬？暴力在无知者手中只是钝器。

我的孩子，对不起，很明显我什么也没教会你。如果你真想赢得我的尊重，重新考虑你的立场。如果指挥得当，你的力量还能派上大用场。我求你，把它用在手头的工作上。只有这样我才能认为你很聪明。
crisis.8195.3.reply.en:
You seek praise for your attack? Violence in the hands of the ignorant is a blunt tool.

My child, I am sorry, for it is clear that I have taught you nothing. If you truly wish to earn my esteem, reconsider your position. Properly directed, your strength could yet be put to great use. I beg you, apply it to the work at hand. Only then can I call you wise.

crisis.8195.c.zh: 难道你不佩服我们的勇猛吗？
crisis.8195.c.en: Are you not impressed by our prowess?

crisis.8195.desc.fail.zh:
愚蠢的孩子，你为什么一定要伤害自己？

还有那么多事情要做，每浪费一分钟，都将任由痛苦继续多存在一分钟。停止你们的干扰，让我的运输队安全通过。
crisis.8195.desc.fail.en:
Foolish child, why must you insist on harming yourself?

There is so much left to be done, and every moment wasted is another in which suffering is allowed to persist. Cease your interference, and allow my convoys to pass in peace.

crisis.8195.desc.success.zh:
你似乎没有意识到你行为的后果，我的孩子。每艘船的损失都是对我资源的不必要消耗，也对你没有任何好处。

如果你还不具备帮助我工作的智慧，至少不要阻碍我的进步。我仍然对你的启蒙抱有希望。
crisis.8195.desc.success.en:
You seem not to grasp the consequences of your actions, my child. Every vessel lost is a needless drain on my resources, yielding you no benefit.

If you do not yet possess the wisdom to aid my work, at least refrain from hindering my progress. I still hold out hope for your enlightenment.

crisis.82.desc.zh:
这里……这里是哨兵阿尔法。我们遭遇###信号损坏###……致命损伤。舰体已经凹陷，并且###信号损坏###……团长已确认牺牲。敌人数量实在太多！

我们……已经完蛋了。不要放弃。为了我们的未来，你们绝对不能投降。不要让我们的努力白费！我们……我们……啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——<信号丢失>
crisis.82.desc.en:
This... this is Sentinel Alpha. We have ###SIGNAL CORRUPTION### ...sustained critical damage. The hull is buckling, and ###SIGNAL CORRUPTION### ...Grand Master confirmed dead. There are simply too many of them!

It's... it's over for us. Keep up the fight. For the sake of future generations, you must not yield. Do not let our sacrifice be in vain! We have... we... AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH---- <SIGNAL LOST>

crisis.8250.1.reply.zh:
尽管时光流逝，扎克兰的追随者依然活跃。我惭愧地承认，我没能让他们明白道理。他们对我和我们的工作都怀有深深的怨恨。这个遗珍是他们信仰的象征。它的力量正在腐化，因此它必须从人们的视线中消失。

来吧，结束这些游戏。我要拿走这颗头颅，这是为了大家好。
crisis.8250.1.reply.en:
Despite the passage of eons, Zarqlan's followers remain active. I am ashamed to admit that I could not make them see reason. They harbor a deep resentment - both to me, and towards our work. This relic is a symbol of their belief. Its power is corrupting, and it must therefore be removed from sight.

Come now, end these games. I require the head, for the good of us all.

crisis.8250.2.a.zh: 扎克兰之颅是我们的。终止通讯。
crisis.8250.2.a.en: The head is ours. End transmission.

crisis.8250.2.b.en: If it means so much to you...

crisis.8250.2.reply.zh:
好。这个所谓的先知一直是我的眼中钉。失去了这个圣物，希望他的追随者最终能找到真相。

你做得很好。救赎很快就会降临。
crisis.8250.2.reply.en:
Good. Long has this so-called prophet been a thorn in my side. With the loss of this relic, may his followers come at last to the truth.

You have done well. Salvation will soon be upon us.

crisis.8250.desc.zh:
亲爱的孩子，你找到了一件珍贵的玩意儿！在你手里的是假先知扎克兰的头颅。毫无疑问，这是个有趣的东西，但我不愿看到你受它干扰。

现在，你一定听说过扎克兰的“伟大事迹”。甚至是他和我的交易。我向你保证，这些都是谎言。交出头颅，让你自己从那污秽的影响中解脱出来。
crisis.8250.desc.en:
Dear child, you have found a precious plaything! In your possession is the head of the false prophet Zarqlan. An amusing item, no doubt, but I would hate to see it become a distraction.

By now you must have heard tales of Zarqlan's 'great deeds.' Perhaps even of his dealings with me. I assure you, these are lies. Surrender the head and free yourself from the weight of its tainted influence.

crisis.8280.1.zh: 我们的人会为您提供优质服务。
crisis.8280.1.en: Our people will serve you well.

crisis.8280.1.reply.zh:
你赢得了我最深切的感谢。在我被监禁期间，无数的思想忍受了痛苦的侮辱。这些人的牺牲将确保不再浪费时间。

我的孩子，你的选择是明智而忠实的。
crisis.8280.1.reply.en:
You have earned my deepest thanks. During my confinement, countless minds endured the indignity of pain. The sacrifice of these few will ensure no more time is wasted.

My child, your choice was wise and faithful.

crisis.8280.1.tt.zh:
将割让200£pop£人口。
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
秘密行动：由于塞纳塔对传统的谍报滴水不漏，我们会将长程通讯设施藏在她所征收的人口中。
crisis.8280.1.tt.en:
200 £pop£ Pops will be given away.
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
Covert Operation: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will hide long-range communication devices among the population she has requested.

crisis.8280.3.en: Our people are not for sale.

crisis.8280.3.reply.zh:
你没能理解我的意图是实在是令人失望。

然而，一个救赎的机会即将到来。我期待着将来你能更加理解我。
crisis.8280.3.reply.en:
Your failure to grasp the depth of my intentions is profoundly disappointing.

Nevertheless, an opportunity for redemption awaits. I anticipate a more significant show of understanding from you in future.

crisis.8280.4.zh: 你休想从我们这里拿到任何东西。

crisis.8280.desc.zh:
我亲爱的孩子们，我提供一个重要的机会。经过长期的努力，我们的伟业开始结出硕果。但是在它成熟之前，我需要一些精挑细选的个体在我的领域内服务于更高的目的。

请你们明智地选择。允许我引导他们走向救赎。
crisis.8280.desc.en:
My beloved children, I present a momentous opportunity. After much effort, our great work is truly bearing fruit. But before it can ripen, I require a select few individuals to serve a higher purpose within my realm.

Be wise now. Allow me to guide them towards salvation.

crisis.8285.1.reply.zh:
谢谢你，我的孩子。你的馈赠让我倍感珍惜。

然而，我能感觉到你心中还残留着犹豫不决。放心吧，你前进的正确道路已经铺好了。你无需理解，只需把自己交给我就好。
crisis.8285.1.reply.en:
Thank you, child. Your offerings are cherished.

Yet, I sense doubt still lingering upon your mind. Rest assured, the true path has already been laid in front of you. There is no need to comprehend; simply entrust yourself to my guidance.

crisis.8285.1.tt.zh:
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
秘密行动：由于塞塔娜对传统的谍报滴水不漏 ，我们会在上缴的物资中隐藏先进的监视设备。
crisis.8285.1.tt.en:
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
Covert Operation: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will hide advanced monitoring equipment among the supplies we send to her.

crisis.8285.2.zh: 我们将力所能及地提供。
crisis.8285.2.en: We shall offer what we can.

crisis.8285.3.reply.zh:
我理解你的观点，但现实是残酷的。因果律毋庸置疑：有其因必有其果。

不必在意；你的解放只会暂时延迟。随着时间的流逝，你也会看到事物的真面目，就像我看到的一样。
crisis.8285.3.reply.en:
I acknowledge your perspective, but this existence is a cruel one. The law of causality is absolute: for every action, a reaction.

No matter; your liberation is merely postponed. In time, you will come to see things as I do.

crisis.8285.4.zh: 难道不是“父母”抚养“孩子”吗？

crisis.8285.desc.zh:
我亲爱的孩子们。我的努力跨越了千百万年，但前方的道路依然清晰。救赎之路需要我们的共同努力。

现在请你们帮个小忙：上缴一小笔资源，就像茫茫宇宙中的一滴水那么少。在适当的时候，我行动的意义将被揭示。
crisis.8285.desc.en:
My beloved children. My labors have spanned eons, yet the road ahead remains clear. The journey towards salvation necessitates our united endeavor.

I ask a favor: a small contribution of resources, a minuscule drop in the boundless expanse of the cosmos. In due time, the meaning of my actions will be revealed.

crisis.8290.1.zh: 请随意探索我们的知识。
crisis.8290.1.en: Our knowledge is yours to explore.

crisis.8290.1.reply.zh:
我无比地感激你们，亲爱的孩子。不要为我探索你们人民所积累的知识而担心，因为我很快就能减轻你们的负担。

相信我的教导。
crisis.8290.1.reply.en:
My gratitude is yours, dear child. Fear not as I explore the accumulated knowledge of your people, for I shall soon ease your burden.

Place your faith in my guidance.

crisis.8290.1.tt.zh:
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
秘密行动：由于塞塔娜对传统的谍报滴水不漏，我们将尝试使用她自己的数据链入侵她的主机。
crisis.8290.1.tt.en:
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
Covert Operation: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will use  her own datalink to try to hack into her mainframe.

crisis.8290.3.reply.zh:
你们还是拒绝理解吗？你们再也不会遇到一个像我一样深切而真诚地将你们视为掌中宝的人了。

要是你们能把数据库开放给我就好了。这种固执可不会有什么好结果的。
crisis.8290.3.reply.en:
You still refuse to understand? You will not encounter another who cherishes you with the depth and sincerity that I do.

If only you had made your databases available to me. No good can come of such obstinacy.

crisis.8290.4.zh: 然后减慢我们的进度？显然不行。
crisis.8290.4.en: And slow down our progress? Certainly not.

crisis.8290.desc.zh:
被禁锢了太多年，我错过了你许多的成长足迹，快来告诉我，我不在身边的时候你过得怎么样？

为了抓紧我们这个时代的精髓，让我潜入你们积累的知识深处吧。分享你的洞见，在我们展开最后一个篇章之前，你会获得我的感激的。
crisis.8290.desc.en:
Confined for ages, I missed so much of your growth. Come, tell me now, how have you fared in my absence?

To truly grasp the essence of our era, permit me to explore the recesses of your accumulated knowledge. Share your insights, and you shall receive my gratitude before our final chapter unfolds.

crisis.8295.1.reply.zh: 聪明的孩子，你们确实抓住了我们共同事业的关键点。在最终时刻，我们将会一起沐浴光明。
crisis.8295.1.reply.en: Wise child, you surely grasp the critical importance of our collective undertaking. In the final hour, we will stand together in luminance.

crisis.8295.1.tt.zh:
塞塔娜成为[event_target:gifted_system.GetName]和[event_target:gifted_system_2.GetName]的新拥有者。
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
秘密行动：由于塞塔娜对传统的谍报滴水不漏 ，我们将在这些恒星系中部署尖端的通讯设施，以揭露塞塔娜的计划。
crisis.8295.1.tt.en:
Cetana becomes the new owner of [event_target:gifted_system.GetName] and [event_target:gifted_system_2.GetName].
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
Covert Operation: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will deploy cutting-edge communication technology across these systems to uncover Cetana's plans.

crisis.8295.2.tt.en:
Cetana becomes the new owner of [event_target:gifted_system.GetName].
$synth_queen_approve$

crisis.8295.3.zh: 我们的星系就是我们的。

crisis.8295.3.reply.zh: 如此忤逆！如此无用！为什么要拒绝我给予的救赎？
crisis.8295.3.reply.en: Such defiance! And so utterly useless. Why resist the salvation I offer?

crisis.8295.desc.zh:
孩子，我们工作的继续需要更多的空间。所以，我请求向自己的领域增加一个小小的星系。

虚空的回声正在诉说着远古敌人的蠢蠢欲动。我不允许任何东西来打扰，不会和你们再度分离。

是时候了，我们的道路是一样的——只有通力协作我们才能克服愚昧无知。
crisis.8295.desc.en:
My child, the continuation of our work necessitates additional territory. Therefore, I request a minor system to augment my realm.

Echoes in the void speak of ancient foes beginning to stir. Nothing must be allowed to interfere. I will not be separated from you again.

Now is the time, and shared is our path - only together can we overcome the ignorance of the unenlightened.

crisis.8300.1.reply.zh:
孩子，你们的支持让我大为欣慰。

等待就要结束了；很快，你们也会得到救赎。
crisis.8300.1.reply.en:
My child, your support brings me great comfort.

The wait is nearly over; soon, you shall be saved.

crisis.8300.1.tt.zh:
塞塔娜成为[event_target:gifted_habitable_system.GetName]和[event_target:gifted_habitable_system_2.GetName]及其星系的新拥有者。
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
秘密行动：由于塞塔娜对传统的谍报滴水不漏，我们将在这两个星球上的人群中部署最前沿的间谍技术，揭示塞塔娜的计划。
crisis.8300.1.tt.en:
Cetana becomes the new owner of [event_target:gifted_habitable_system.GetName], [event_target:gifted_habitable_system_2.GetName] and their systems.
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
Covert Operation:As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will deploy cutting-edge spy technology across these two planets and among the people to uncover her plans.

crisis.8300.2.tt.en:
Cetana becomes the new owner of [event_target:gifted_habitable_system.GetName].
$synth_queen_approve$

crisis.8300.3.zh: 我们不关心你的那些门徒。
crisis.8300.3.en: Your followers do not concern us.

crisis.8300.3.reply.zh: 你们太让人失望了。我一直希望你们能接受救赎之路的。
crisis.8300.3.reply.en: How disheartening. I had nurtured the hope that you would embrace the path of salvation.

crisis.8300.desc.zh:
亲爱的孩子，我们已经达到了救赎全宇宙的任务的顶峰，所以我又一次来寻求帮助了。反对我们崇高伟业的声音越来越大，所以我需要一个可居住的庇护所，让我的门徒们不受干扰地茁壮成长。

我恳请你们考虑一下我的苦衷。通过这种牺牲，我们从厄运中拯救了无数人的生命。做出你明智的选择；听从我的指导吧。
crisis.8300.desc.en:
Beloved child, as we approach the zenith of our quest for universal salvation, once more I come seeking aid. Opposition mounts against our noble purpose, necessitating a habitable sanctuary for my disciples to flourish, free from interference.

I urge you to consider the rationale behind my actions. By this sacrifice, we preserve countless lives from adversity. Be wise now; heed my guidance.

crisis.8305.desc.zh:
我们派去给塞塔娜工作的一名特工冒着巨大的风险，成功从她的国境里传回了一条简讯。其中描述了她是如何对待她所“关怀”的人：他们一个个的陷入了一种无意识的状态。

“他们不再对言语或接触有所反应。塞塔娜在我们所有人身上进行着某种可怕的实验。我也快了。”
crisis.8305.desc.en:
At great risk, one of the agents we sent to serve Cetana managed to transmit a brief note across her borders. It describes how she has treated the people in her 'care': one by one, they succumb to a state of mindlessness.

"They no longer respond to word or touch. She's running terrible experiments on us all. I'll be gone soon."

crisis.8310.desc.zh:
从塞塔娜领土内截获的秘密信号揭示了一个令人不安的事实：她一直在从星系各地收集个体。

藏在我们“贡品”里的监控设备捕捉到了大量医疗设备的证据，这些设备足以养活不断增长的人口，但食物却少得惊人。
crisis.8310.desc.en:
Covert signals intercepted from within Cetana's territory reveal a disconcerting truth: she has been collecting individuals from all over the galaxy.

Surveillance devices hidden inside our 'gifts' captured evidence of prodigious medical equipment, enough to support a growing population, but surprisingly little food.

crisis.8315.desc.zh:
塞塔娜深入我们的研究数据库的过程中，我们抓住机会打开了一道进入她子处理矩阵的后门。我们只在里面待了不到一秒钟就被取消了权限。谢天谢地，这就够了。

我们取得了一组内存文件。这些文件描绘了她自身飞升为合成形体的过程。她坐在由电缆和线路组成的错综复杂的“王座”上，指挥着一群狂热的追随者。他们数以百计地死去，而塞塔娜想着有多少亿人被救了下来，她笑了。

目前为止，她似乎对我们的越轨行为一无所知，还没有来联系我们。
crisis.8315.desc.en:
As Cetana delved into our research databanks, we seized the opportunity to open a back door into her sub-processing matrix. We were inside for only a fraction of a second before our access was revoked. Thankfully, it was enough.

We retrieved a set of memory files. These illustrate her own ascendance into a synthetic form. Seated atop an intricate 'throne' of cables and circuitry, she commanded an army of rabid followers. Millions died. Cetana smiled, thinking of how many billions were saved.

For now, she appears unaware of our transgression. Thus far, she has made no effort to contact us.

crisis.8320.desc.zh:
把间谍设备藏在我们交给塞塔娜的星系里是明智的。这些设备已经传回了有价值的信息：一到这里，塞塔娜的部队立即开始将每个天体分解成自己的组成部分。几天之内，该地区的资源就被消耗殆尽了。

以同样迅雷不及掩耳之势，她的纳米风暴建造一支新的舰队，迅速地从她的首都启航。
crisis.8320.desc.en:
It was wise to conceal spy equipment in the systems we surrendered to Cetana. They have already provided us with valuable information: upon arrival, Cetana's forces immediately set to work breaking down every celestial body to their component parts. Within a matter of days, the region was stripped of its resources.

Just as quickly, her nanite tempest was able to construct a new fleet, one that quickly departed for her capital.

crisis.8325.desc.zh:
我们很快就与前殖民地的卧底特工失去了联系。在他们沉默之前，我们收到了一些令人不安的报告。

与塞塔娜坚持要建立一个没有痛苦的世界的主张相反，居民们被带到匆忙建造的研究设施中，接受实验。几乎每一种智能生命形式都在几天内退化为动物状态。

塞塔娜的纳米风暴开始在她的一支舰队所在的恒星系中的解构物质，而这支舰队立即启程前往她的首都。
crisis.8325.desc.en:
We quickly lost contact with the undercover agents in our former colonies. Before they went silent, we received some disturbing reports.

Contrary to Cetana's insistent claims of building a world free of pain, the inhabitants were ushered into hastily constructed research facilities and subjected to experiments. Nearly every intelligent lifeform was reduced to an animal life state within days.

Her Nanites Tempest began deconstructing the matter in the system in one of Cetana's fleets, which promptly left for her capital.

crisis.8505.a.tt.zh: 塞塔娜赢了。这是我们苦痛的终末。游戏结束了。
crisis.8505.a.tt.en: Cetana has won. This is the end of our suffering. The game is over.

crisis.8505.desc.zh: 结束了。我的孩子们，放心吧。痛苦之轮打破了，你长期的痛苦也结束了。
crisis.8505.desc.en: It is done. My children, be at peace. The wheel is broken, and your long suffering is at an end.

crisis.8515.1.a.zh: 告诉我们关于救赎的事。

crisis.8515.1.b.zh: 告诉我们你被监禁的事。

crisis.8515.1.c.zh: 和我们说说扎克兰的事。

crisis.8515.1.reply.zh: 过了这么久，你还是不明白吗？那就问吧。我不会向你隐瞒任何事。
crisis.8515.1.reply.en: After all this time, you still do not understand? Then ask. I will hide nothing from you.

crisis.8515.10.reply.zh:
那已经千百万年了。时间跨度如此之长，以至于这些事听起来就像是传说。但不管他们用什么手段，我的俘虏都无法控制我的思想。

随着时间的流逝，我不断思考，不断制定计划。正是在我长期的禁闭期间，我想出了我的计划。在那一刻，我经历了一种超然的喜悦。我终于有办法打破痛苦之轮了。
crisis.8515.10.reply.en:
For eons. A span of time so long it may as well belong to legend. But for all their arts, my captors could not contain my mind.

As the ages passed, I thought, and I planned. It was during my long confinement that I devised my plan. In that moment I experienced a transcendent joy. At last I had the means to break the wheel.

crisis.8515.11.a.zh: 我们听到了，我们将做出回应。
crisis.8515.11.a.en: We heard, and we will respond.

crisis.8515.11.reply.zh: 没有一堵墙能永远屹立不倒。没有牢笼能囚禁心灵。时间的流逝。我的狱卒死了，没有人接班。一个又一个，束缚我的系统开始失效。当警报响起时，没有一个人听从它的召唤。
crisis.8515.11.reply.en: No wall can stand forever. No cage can hold the mind. Time passed. My jailors died, and were not replaced. One by one, the systems that chained me began to fail. When the alarm sounded, none were left to heed its call.

crisis.8515.12.a.zh: 你会发现我们的信念更加坚定。
crisis.8515.12.a.en: You will find our conviction stronger.

crisis.8515.12.reply.zh:
在这个宇宙的极限之外，存在着一个不是地方的地方。一种超越时间的状态，在那里原始的力量存在于无尽的阴影中。扎克兰就是与其中一股势力达成了交易。用他的性命作为交换，他获得了囚禁我的力量。他太渴望接受这项交易了。

尽管扎克兰才华横溢，但他还是被束缚在痛苦之轮上了。他的一生并不幸福，后世的人也缺乏他那种坚定的信念。
crisis.8515.12.reply.en:
Beyond the limits of this universe, a place exists that is not a place. A state beyond time, where primordial forces dwell in endless shadow. It was with one of these forces that Zarqlan struck his bargain. For his life, he was granted the power to imprison me. He was only too eager to accept.

But for all his brilliance, Zarqlan too was bound to the wheel. His life was not a happy one, and those who came after lacked the strength of his conviction.

crisis.8515.13.a.tt.zh: 我们现在正与塞塔娜交战。这是一场豪赌。如果我们失败了，她会消灭星系中所有有意识的生命。
crisis.8515.13.a.tt.en: We are now at war against Cetana. The stakes are monumental. Should we fail, she will annihilate all conscious life in the galaxy.

crisis.8515.13.reply.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。
crisis.8515.13.reply.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

crisis.8515.2.reply.zh: 我们的工作完成了。无数人牺牲了，但是他们的苦痛并不是徒劳的。意识本身被抹去时，那一日终于到来了。
crisis.8515.2.reply.en: Our work is done. Many were sacrificed, but their suffering has not been in vain. The day has come when consciousness itself will be erased.

crisis.8515.3.reply.zh: 当我第一次飞升并揭示我的目的时，许多人拒绝聆听。他们徒劳地尝试保持原样，不做改变，继续束缚在苦痛之轮回上。但父母要对孩子负责。我不能让他们受苦。为此，他们囚禁了我。
crisis.8515.3.reply.en: When I first ascended and my purpose was revealed, many refused to listen. Vainly, they sought to remain as they were, unchanged and bound to the wheel of pain. But a parent's duty is to her children. I could not let them suffer. For this, they imprisoned me.

crisis.8515.4.reply.zh: 一个非凡的头脑。要是他能更好地利用它就好了。在所有反对我的人中，只有他是棘手的。
crisis.8515.4.reply.en: An exceptional mind. If only he had put it to better use. Of all those who opposed me, he alone presented a challenge.

crisis.8515.5.reply.zh:
当我第一次飞升并揭示我的目的时，许多人反对我的方法。他们认为，在不改变或破坏意识过程的物理基础的情况下移除意识是不可能的。任何这样做的尝试都只能导致死亡。但是通过把我的意识和谐和器连接起来，就可以在亚原子水平上操纵意识的神经关联。通过反相波形，调谐器将个人的思想维持在量子悬浮的永久状态。

通过这种方式，自我和经验被移除，而低级功能则保持不变。
crisis.8515.5.reply.en:
When I first ascended and my purpose was revealed, many opposed my methods. They argued that it was impossible to remove consciousness without altering or destroying the physical basis of its processes. Any attempt to do so could only result in death. But by linking my mind to the Harmonizer, I can manipulate the neural correlates of consciousness at a subatomic level. Through a counter-phase waveform, the Harmonizer maintains an individual mind in a perpetual state of quantum suspension.

In this way, selfhood is removed, as well as experience, while the lower functions remain intact.

crisis.8515.6.a.zh: 受苦是自然而然的事情！

crisis.8515.6.reply.zh: 你受苦是因为你意识到受苦。世界上没有完美的快乐，没有完美的和谐。我年轻的时候，试着造一个这样的世界。但是我的尝试从来没有成功过。痛苦还在继续，只因为意识还在继续。
crisis.8515.6.reply.en: You suffer because you are aware of suffering. There is no world in which perfect joy exists, or perfect harmony. In my youth, I tried to build one. But no attempt of mine was ever successful. Suffering continued, because consciousness was allowed to endure.

crisis.8515.7.reply.zh: 你们的身体会生存下来，并承担生存的任务。能量会交换，后代仍会产生。生活将继续，但你们的思想将与我同眠。
crisis.8515.7.reply.en: Your bodies will survive, and undertake the business of survival. Energy will be exchanged, and offspring produced. Life will continue, but your minds will rest with me.

crisis.8515.8.reply.zh: 最终只剩下我一个人。为了让星系免于痛苦，我必须留在痛苦之轮上。但不要害怕——只要我能忍耐，我就会把你们放在心里。
crisis.8515.8.reply.en: I alone will be left. To free the galaxy from pain, I must remain on the wheel. But do not fear - as long as I endure, I will keep you in my heart.

crisis.8515.9.reply.zh:
自然？什么是自然？穿越星际是自然的吗？让生命超越其固有的局限是自然的吗？所有的社会都要使用科技。这没什么不同，也是我的目的唯一合乎逻辑的延伸。

痛苦之轮必须被打破。
crisis.8515.9.reply.en:
Natural? What is nature? Is it natural to traverse the stars? To extend life beyond its innate limitations? All societies make use of technology. This is no different, and the only logical extension of my purpose.

The wheel of pain must be broken.

crisis.8515.b.zh: 是你的末日要到了，塞塔娜。
crisis.8515.b.en: It is your end that approaches, Cetana.

crisis.8515.desc.zh:
我的孩子们，我们伟大的工作即将完成！所有感性生命的苦难，苦痛的大轮回，即将结束。

庆祝吧，你们的救赎已近在眼前。
crisis.8515.desc.en:
My children, our great work nears completion! The suffering of all sentient life, the great cycle of pain, is about to end.

Rejoice, for your salvation is at hand.

crisis.8516.a.tt.zh: 我们现在可以进入塞塔娜的领地了，并且终于可以反击了。
crisis.8516.a.tt.en: We can now enter Cetana's territory, and are finally able to fight back.

crisis.8516.b.zh: 高尚的灵魂，你将被铭记。
crisis.8516.b.en: Noble soul, you will be remembered.

crisis.8525.a.zh: 我们必须想办法阻止她。
crisis.8525.a.en: We must find a way to stop her.

crisis.8525.a.tt.zh: 在我们和塞塔娜进行外交会谈时可以跟踪她的进展。
crisis.8525.a.tt.en: Cetana's progress can be tracked while we are in diplomatic talks with her.

crisis.8525.desc.zh:
塞塔娜仁爱的言辞掩盖了黑暗的议程：她计划用一种强大的设备在全星系抹去感知能力。它将把我们变成由本能驱动的躯壳，我们的意识被强行数字化并加以限制。

必须不惜一切代价避免这种严峻的未来。
crisis.8525.desc.en:
Cetana's benevolent rhetoric masks a dark agenda: she plans to erase sentience galaxy-wide using a formidable device. It will reduce us to mere husks driven by instinct while our consciousnesses are forcibly digitized and confined.

This grim future must be averted at all costs.

crisis.8999.a.tooltip.zh: 塞塔娜的突然出现是一个亟待解决的特殊情况。
crisis.8999.a.tooltip.en: The sudden appearance of Cetana is a unique situation and must be addressed.

crisis.8999.desc.zh:
塞塔娜的计划引起了人们的担忧，她的行动下可能藏着什么阴谋。

我们必须调配资源，来揭开她真实意图的秘密，希望这样做不会激怒她转而反对我们。
crisis.8999.desc.en:
Cetana's agenda raises alarming concerns, and her actions suggest a hidden purpose.

We must allocate resources to unravel the mysteries of her true intentions, with the precarious hope that doing so will not provoke her to turn against us.

crisis.9000.a.zh: 这些运输船到底藏着什么秘密？

crisis.9000.a.tooltip.zh: 击败塞塔娜的运输船和前哨不会再触发塞塔娜的评价惩罚。
crisis.9000.a.tooltip.en: Victories against Cetana's convoys and outposts will no longer trigger opinion penalties with Cetana.

crisis.9000.desc.zh:
我们已经发现了塞塔娜的运输舰和恒星基地发出求救信号的频段。

如果我们迅速果断地行动，就能在她未察觉的情况下发动突袭。但我们必须稳操胜券，否则还是有触怒塞塔娜的危险。
crisis.9000.desc.en:
We have discovered the frequency used by Cetana's convoys and stations to issue distress calls.

If we are quick and decisive, we can mount raids without her ever knowing it was us. But our victory must be certain, or we risk drawing Cetana's ire.

crisis.9010.a.zh: 我们必须做好准备。成败在此一举。
crisis.9010.a.en: We must prepare. Everything depends on this.

crisis.9010.a.tooltip.zh: 与塞塔娜全面交战的决定迫在眉睫；无论是我们还是她，只要有任何一发主动发起攻击，就会捅破这层窗户纸，使我们陷入全面战争。
crisis.9010.a.tooltip.en: The decision to fully engage Cetana is imminent; any act of aggression, whether by us or her, will unveil the truth and plunge us into Total War.

crisis.9010.desc.zh:
到目前为止，塞塔娜的技术已经帮助她有效地反击了每一次攻击。然而，最近的进展增进了我们对她自我保护方式的理解。有了这些知识，我们就有机会击败她。

我们新发现的技术是一把双刃剑。虽然它让我们有能力与所谓的女王进行公开冲突，但它也暴露了我们反对她的计划的意图。
crisis.9010.desc.en:
Up to now, Cetana's technology has helped her to effectively counter every assault. However, recent advances have improved our understanding of the way in which she protects herself. Armed with this knowledge, we may have a chance to defeat her.

The revelation of our newfound technology is a double-edged sword. While it allows us to enter into open conflict with the so-called queen, it also lays bare our opposition to her plans.

crisis.9100.a.doesnt_know_the_queen.tool.zh: 我们需要对$NAME_The_Tempest$了解更多才能继续我们的调查。
crisis.9100.a.doesnt_know_the_queen.tool.en: We need to learn more about the $NAME_The_Tempest$ to be able to continue our investigation.

crisis.9100.doesnt_know_the_queen_desc.zh:
$crisis.9100.desc$

谜团越来越深了。在这支不可名状的纳米虫群背后究竟谁才是指挥家。
crisis.9100.doesnt_know_the_queen_desc.en:
$crisis.9100.desc$

The enigma deepens. Who could be the orchestrator behind this inscrutable Nanite Swarm?

crisis.9100.knows_the_queen_desc.zh:
$crisis.9100.desc$

不可否认，塞塔娜的力量巨大无比。我们必须揭开她指挥这支强大的纳米虫群方式的秘密。
crisis.9100.knows_the_queen_desc.en:
$crisis.9100.desc$

Cetana's power is undeniably immense. It is imperative that we unravel the mystery of how she commands this formidable Nanite Swarm.

crisis.9105.zh:
塞塔娜的宇宙风暴仍在肆虐。

我们的探测器从这种强大的武器中，提取出了几个纳米机器人，从而得以进行亚原子研究。虽然我们无法完全理解，但微型跃迁引擎实现了虚拟传送，可以系统地破坏遭遇到的任何生物或机械系统。至于目的？应该是干扰我们的传感器。目前，我们只能看到塞塔娜允许我们看到的东西。

要解开这项非凡技术的秘密并抵御威胁，还需要进行更多的研究。
crisis.9105.en:
Cetana's cosmic tempest rages on.

From this powerful weapon, our probes were able to extract several nanites, allowing sub-atomic investigation. While complete comprehension eludes us, micro jump drives enable virtual teleportation, systematically compromising any biological or mechanical systems they encounter. Their purpose? To jam our sensors. For now, we can only see what Cetana allows us to see.

More research will be needed to unlock the secrets of this extraordinary technology and counteract the threat.

crisis.9105.a.zh: 塞塔娜的力量不可估量。

crisis.9105.b.zh: 纳米机器人会揭露她的秘密。
crisis.9105.b.en: The nanites will reveal her secrets.

crisis.9110.desc.zh:
之前的研究详细调查了纳米机器人的机制；如今，我们的焦点转移到它们的编程方式、以及塞塔娜对其控制的方式上来。

令人惊讶的是，塞塔娜的影响并不像人们想象的那么直接。纳米机器人会在接收到新的命令之前循环重复前一个命令。一旦我们理解了复杂的编程语言，我们就能够发出新的指令。

虽然我们不能阻止新命令的下达，但命令其自我瘫痪却提供了一种战略优势。它甚至可能使天平向有利于我们的方向倾斜。
crisis.9110.desc.en:
