根据环境数据和详细的模拟，我们可以有把握地得出结论，确实有一场天体沙尘暴穿过了这些山峰。事实上，它就是在这个位置上形成的！至于它为什么没有在这个过程中吞噬整颗星球，我们最好的猜测就是它只是太小了——分析表明，这场风暴的规模甚至远小于普通的风暴。

基于这一事实，因内特贸易体将局部扰动抑制器称为“操纵装置”，并且这一特定风暴的能量信号被存储在他们的数据库中，看起来他们很可能试图控制宇宙风暴。通过计算它离开这个地方后的路径，我们可以学到很多对我们有利的东西。
cstorms.184.desc.en:
Based on environmental data and detailed simulations, we can safely conclude that it was indeed a celestial dust storm which moved through these peaks. In fact, it formed in this very spot! As for why it did not swallow the entire planet in the process, our best guess is that it was simply too small - analysis describes a storm that was a fraction of the size of even an average tempest.

Based on the fact that the Inetian Traders referred the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors as 'a manipulation device', and that this specific storm's energy signal was stored within their databanks, it seems likely that they were attempting to control the cosmic storm. By calculating the path it took after leaving this place, we may learn much to our advantage.

cstorms.1845.desc.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上遗弃设施的入口建设得格外地坚固。显然非常地耐用，外表铺着有厚重的装甲、辐射护盾和一座气象传感阵列。[Leader.GetName]相信它是用来抵御极端条件的。

扫描表明，通过数道密封的安全门之后可以抵达一座巨大的地下舱室。
cstorms.1845.desc.en:
The entrance of the isolated complex on [From.Planet.GetName] is of exceptionally robust construction. Clearly built to last, its exterior features heavy armor plating, radiation shields, and an array of atmospheric sensors. [Leader.GetName] believes it was built to withstand extreme conditions.

Scans suggest that a large underground chamber can be accessed via a series of sealed security doors.

cstorms.1850.desc.zh:
在进入主要舱室后，[Leader.GetName]得出结论，我们发现了一座很久以前为某些未知有机物种建造的尚未启用的生存避难所。

它配备了储备充足的居住区，包括睡眠舱、休闲区和医疗舱。每层楼的储物柜里都有大量未开封的营养包、电池和工具。这座隐藏的洞穴里的所有东西都处于未使用的状态。

最后一扇安全门仍然密封这着，我们相信打开它便会到达基地的指挥室。
cstorms.1850.desc.en:
Having gained access to the main interior, [Leader.GetName] concludes that we have discovered an unused survival shelter, built long ago for some unknown organic species.

It is outfitted with well stocked habitation quarters comprising sleep pods, leisure zones, and a medical bay. Storage lockers on every floor hold deep reserves of unopened nutrient packs, batteries, and tools. Everything contained in this hidden vault is in pristine condition.

One final set of security doors remains sealed. We believe they will lead us to the facility's command deck.

cstorms.1855.desc.zh:
这座舱室的指挥面板上有一组令人印象深刻的$default_storm$显示器，全部连接着外面的气象探测阵列。这些控制台在待机状态运行后，储存了了几个世纪以来的历史风暴数据，这将极大地促进我们对星际气象学的理解。

[Leader.GetName]还找到了一台精致小巧的全息投影仪。当被激活时，它会投射出一个3D的软体类模型，从带着公司标志的庇护所地标边跑过，一边进行着推销。

这个幸存的产品是否找到了买家不得而知，但它显然已经在这里闲置了很多年。
cstorms.1855.desc.en:
The shelter's command deck is equipped with an impressive array of $default_storm$ monitors, all fed by the atmospheric sensors on the surface. After running on standby, these consoles contain centuries' worth of historical storm data, which will greatly advance our understanding of astrometeorology.

[Leader.GetName] also found a small and well-used holo-projector. When activated, it beams a 3D molluscoid figure delivering a sales pitch, running through the shelter's key features under a corporate logo.

Whether this survival product ever found a buyer is impossible to say, but it has clearly remained unused here for many years.

cstorms.1855.desc.megacorp.zh: 我们的营销部门已经在分析哪里出了问题。
cstorms.1855.desc.megacorp.en: Our marketing departments are already analyzing where they went wrong.

cstorms.186.desc.zh:
追踪星尘沙暴的路径没有我们预期的那么简单直接。仅到离起源点只有几个星系的距离，它的强度、大小和路径就发生了剧烈的变化。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]怀疑，正是在这一位置上，风暴受到了局部扰动抑制器的袭扰。它使风暴失去了平衡，从[wm_digsite_C.GetName]表面刮起的野生动物残骸碎片污染了风暴的内部漩涡。

随着风暴继续在星系中漂移，它吞没了许多恒星系，带来了毁灭性的后果。

为了干扰这个微小扰动的路径所做的一切，目的都是使其远离一个特定的恒星系……传感器探测到该恒星系中存在一座废弃的空间站。为了保护这个地方，因内特贸易体甚至不惜制造了多次大灭绝。

空间站可能不是我们所希望的首都星系，但它肯定同样重要才值得代价如此高昂的保护措施。
cstorms.186.desc.en:
To track the celestial dust storm's path turned out to be less straightforward than anticipated. Only a few systems away from its origin point something drastic happened to its strength, size, and course. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] suspect that it was at this point that the storm was hit with the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors. It knocked the storm off balance, and polluted its inner vortex with the pulverized remains of wildlife swept up from [wm_digsite_C.GetName]'s surface.

As the storm continued to drift across the galaxy, it engulfed multiple systems with devastating repercussions.

All of this to alter the course of a minor disturbance away from a particular system... Sensors have detected the presence of an abandoned space station in that system. In order to protect this place, the Inetian Traders left multiple mass extinctions in their wake.

The station may not be the capital world we hoped for, but it must be equally important to warrant such measures.

cstorms.190.desc.zh:
环绕着[From.Planet.GetName]的空间站的规模让我们始料未及。它看来不仅仅是一个“站”了，例如科研设施和复杂的生命维持系统还有极深空探测器等应有尽有。这说明这座设施很可能是用作长期殖民地而不是一个临时定居点的。

然而这座空间站现在状况糟糕透了。它的壳体已经受损，灾难性的减压已经炸毁了整个区段。目前还不清楚损坏是由外部还是内部造成的。幸运的是，轨道控制和轴稳定仍然有效，这也解释了为什么这座结构没有漂移到恒星上，也没有在不可避免的自转中瓦解。

很难在不破坏这种微妙平衡的情况下进入它。
cstorms.190.desc.en:
The space station orbiting [From.Planet.GetName] is much larger than originally anticipated. It appears to be more than just a station, boasting research instruments as well as sophisticated life support systems and extensive deep space sensors. This may indicate the facility was used more as a long-term colony, rather than a minor waypoint.

It is in a dismal state, however. The hull has been compromised, with catastrophic decompression having blown out entire sectors. It is unclear whether the damage was caused from the outside, or from within. Fortunately, orbit control and axis stabilization are still operational, explaining why the structure has not drifted into the star or broken out in an unstoppable spin.

Getting inside without destabilizing this fastidiously maintained balance will be difficult.

cstorms.191.desc.zh:
要想进到[This.System.GetName]星系的这座空间站里除非我们能先撬开一道未受损的气闸，而且还不引起气爆。尽管历史悠久，这座空间站的内部仍然是充压的，还能成功地模拟典型的行星大气。

我们花了好几天的时间在自己的舰船和空间站之间构建气密系统，精心地平衡了气压，终于才能安全地打开舱门。不幸的是，我们马上就遇到了下一个困难：前方的过道被扭曲的支撑梁和附近减压产生的碎石堵塞了，我们需要一些时间清理才能继续前进。
cstorms.191.desc.en:
To enter the station in the [This.System.GetName] system, it was necessary to pry open an undamaged airlock without causing further implosions. The internals of the station were still pressurized, successfully mimicking a typical planetary atmosphere despite its impressive age.

It took days to create a perfect seal between our ship and the station, meticulously equalizing the air pressure. Eventually we were able to open the door safely. Unfortunately, we were immediately met with another obstacle: a blocked corridor, clogged with twisted support beams and rubble from nearby depressurization. It will take some time before we can proceed.

cstorms.192.desc.zh:
在清开一条通路后，我们开始探索这座空间站寻找答案。

全面的调查表明，这座空间站并不是建造用于观测太空的，而是用来保护什么东西，它的许多精心设计的扫描设备都是针对内部的。在其中还发现了属于因内特贸易体公民的个人物品，以及描述空间站生活的日志。他们谈到了一个重要的有效载荷，它被保存在基地内一个戒备森严的舱室里。虽然没花多长时间就找到了，但这个舱室宛若坟墓。

近乎木乃伊般的干燥遗骸堆满了舱室，它们都来自因内特贸易体。从平静的姿势来看，他们似乎没有发生什么反抗，只是坐以待毙。这里究竟发生了什么？
cstorms.192.desc.en:
After clearing a way forward, we began to explore the station in search of answers.

A thorough investigation revealed that the station was built not to observe the cosmos, but rather to protect something, with much of its elaborate scanning equipment directed internally. Personal effects belonging to Inetian Trader citizens were found, as well as logs describing station life. They spoke of an important payload, kept in a tightly guarded chamber somewhere within the base. While it did not take long to locate, the room was revealed to be a tomb.

Desiccated, near-mummified remains occupied the space, each of them members of the Inetian Traders' empire. Given their mundane positions, it seems they did not put up a fight, but simply sat down to die. What happened here?

cstorms.193.desc.zh:
这些公民们所说的有效载荷正位于舱室的中央。这台独特设备崭新的外观看起来仿佛尚未启用一般。它绝对属于因内特人，但比我们以前看到的任何东西都先进。

该装置两侧的终端显示几段反复重复的相同文本。翻译很快就出来了:

最亲爱的访客，如果你正在读这篇文章，那么你就是我们傲慢的见证者。在我们对平等的崇高追求中，我们忘记了真正的均衡器：创造与毁灭。

为了使我们的贸易路线免受宇宙风暴的破坏，我们篡改了自然。曾经的小骚乱已经超出了控制。宇宙风暴横扫了我们的许多星球。这不是巧合，而是一种报复。如今我们把自己封闭在这座空间站里，这就是最后的一道防线，因为无论做什么都太晚了。尽管我们再也不用抑制器，新的风暴仍然还在形成，而且比之前更强、更野蛮。我们最后的任务很明确。

我们不知疲倦的地制造这台机器，为你们这些访客制造。它会把你从宇宙风暴中拯救出来同时避免激怒这些风暴。对我们而言死亡是一种解脱，而对你们而言还不是。

在这个舱室里，因内特贸易体接受了自己的命运。他们的慷慨之伟大恰如他们的冒失之严重。最后，我们带着他们的礼物，离开了这座空间站。
cstorms.193.desc.en:
The payload as described by the citizens was positioned squarely in the center of the room. It is a singular device, apparently brand new and unused. It is most definitely Inetian, but more advanced than anything we have seen from them before.

Terminals flanking the object display a few paragraphs of the same text repeated over and over again. Translation came quickly:

Dearest Visitor, if you are reading this then you are witness to our hubris. In our noble pursuit of equality, we forgot the true equalizer: creation, and destruction.

Seeking to free our trade routes from the ravages of cosmic tempests, we tampered with nature. What were once minor disturbances grew beyond influence. The cosmic storms tore through our worlds. This was not coincidence, but revenge. We sealed ourselves within this station. It was our last defense, as we were too late. Despite no longer using our depressors, new storms were forming, stronger and more savage. Our final mission was clear.

Feverishly we worked to complete this machine, and it was built for you, Visitor. It will save you from the cosmic storms, without further angering them. Our demise is our absolution, it does not have to be yours.

Within this room the Inetian Traders sealed their fate. Their generosity was as grand as their carelessness. Leaving the station, we returned with their parting gift.

cstorms.195.desc.zh:
因内特贸易体的最后安息地似乎是一座非常高科技的空间站。他们建造这座空间站来抵抗他们自己一手造成的恶劣宇宙风暴。这座独特的居住站是因内特科技的巅峰之作，拥有惊人的宜居控制和保护系统。但即便如此先进的居住站都没能无限期地保护它们。

由于这座空间站经过千万年的衰败已经过于危险不宜居住，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以提取它的从系统中提取知识宝库。不仅如此，他们还在一个数据库中发现了因内特贸易体最重要的贸易路线，并在一台工作站上发现了更高效、对星球破坏更小的气候控制机器的精致原型。

看来至少一部分因内特贸易体的坚持没有白费，这将继续帮助我们度过风暴。
cstorms.195.desc.en:
The final resting place of the Inetian Traders turned out to be a very high-tech space station. They had built it as a refuge against the terrible cosmic storms they had brought into existence themselves. This unique habitat is a true zenith of Inetian tech, boasting incredible habitability control and protection systems. But even that could not save them indefinitely.

As such, while the station is no longer safe to inhabit due to the eons of decay, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] were able to extract a trove of knowledge from its systems. Not only that, they also found the Inetian Traders' most important trade routes stored on a databank, and delicate prototypes of more efficient, less-planet destroying climate control machines, found simply laying upon a workstation.

It seems at least some of the Inetian Traders' tenacity has prevailed, and it will continue to help us through these storms.

cstorms.195.name.zh: 探究因内特贸易体的秘密
cstorms.195.name.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

cstorms.2000.desc_common_1.en:
We are now in position in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system and ready to begin the necessary preparations to generate a $default_storm$.

By temporarily supercharging [target.GetName], we can create the ideal conditions to seed the desired astrometeorological reaction.

cstorms.2000.desc_common_2.en: This will be a time-consuming endeavor, but the end result will be a great achievement for [owner.GetName]. The star itself will remain entirely intact after the operation is complete.

cstorms.2000.desc_tech.zh: 使用先进的能量操纵技术，我们可以用原材料使[target.GetName]过饱和来形成结构上更复杂的风暴。
cstorms.2000.desc_tech.en: Using advanced energy manipulation methods, we could oversaturate [target.GetName] with raw materials to form a more structurally complex storm.

cstorms.205.desc.zh:
在这个星系里探测到的奇怪信号源于一座围绕[FromFrom.GetName]的古老通讯站。这些信息应该是某个失落文明的老旧广播。

因此，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]在破译时遇到了一些困难。他们建议登上这座空间站，直接与通讯主机建立交互。
cstorms.205.desc.en:
The strange signals we've detected within this system are originating from an ancient communication station orbiting [FromFrom.GetName]. The messages appear to be old broadcasts from a forgotten civilization.

As a result, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are having some difficulty deciphering them. They suggest boarding the station to interface with the transmission mainframe directly.

cstorms.2105.desc.zh:
我们的先遣队安全地抵达了[From.Planet.GetName]并很快开始调查周围环境。

表面上看，最近肆虐这个星系的猛烈宇宙风暴拨开了厚厚的尘埃和土壤层，让这个古老文明的遗迹重见天日。

当我们的科学家继续深入研究这些考古发现时，他们震惊地发现，覆盖残骸的沙子层与周围土壤的成分完全不同。行星扫描显示，这些沉积物来自数百里外的沙漠，只有极其巨大的力量，比如极端猛烈的行星风暴，才能把他们运到这里。
cstorms.2105.desc.en:
Our team arrived safely on [From.Planet.GetName] and quickly got to work surveying our new surroundings.

From the looks of it, the recent violent cosmic storm that plagued this system also uncovered enough layers of dust and soil to reveal the remnants of an old civilization.

As our scientists continued to delve into these archeological findings, they were struck by the fact that the layers of sand covering the remnants were of an entirely different composition than the surrounding soil. Planetary scans indicate these deposits came from a desert hundreds of miles away and could only have ended up here through great force, such as an extremely volatile planetary storm.

cstorms.2110.a.en: What a cruel way to go.

cstorms.2110.desc.zh:
尽管奇怪的天气状况困扰着这个星球，但我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]已经取得了巨大的进步。随着时间一天天过去，他们的发现却变得越来越令人感到不安和困惑。

一开始是一些石雕和炭化的有机物，接着是是撕裂的织物、皮革制品、涂覆聚合物的背心，最后出现了星球前居民的有机遗骸。

一具又一具尸体被发现，他们干涸的器官充满了沙子，指甲因挣扎而磨损。每具尸体都穿戴着重型[Root.Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]军用装备，并配有射弹类武器。我们之前以为的废弃城市，其实是一座乱葬岗。

这些标本可能有上亿年的历史，但由于它们与紫外线辐射和活性化学物质完全隔离，有机遗骸和装备都被完好地保存了下来。他们在这里发生了什么仍然不得而知。
cstorms.2110.desc.en:
Despite the strange weather conditions troubling this planet, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have made great strides. But with every passing day, their discoveries became increasingly baffling and disturbing.

It began with remnants of stonework and charcoaled organic materials. Then, torn fabrics, leather work, vests layered with polymers, and eventually the organic remains of the planet's former inhabitants.

Body after body was uncovered, their desiccated organs filled with sand and their nails worn down from struggle. Each corpse was outfitted in heavy [Root.Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] military equipment and armed with projectile weapons. What we thought was an abandoned city was in fact a mass grave.

It's possible these specimens might be eons old, but due to their complete isolation from ultraviolet radiation and reactive chemicals both the organic remains and gear have been meticulously preserved. What happened to them here remains unknown.

cstorms.2115.desc.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的新发现一如既往地令人不安。[Root.GetLeaderName]相信这个地方并不像是一个埋葬地，这些外星人在被沙子活埋之前似乎身体状况非常良好。

此外，我们还发现了一些能发射重型弹药的武器装置。它们并不是瞄准着地表，而是将炮口对准了深空。

不论这些人面对着什么，看来都是来自星星的访客。
cstorms.2115.desc.en:
The findings on [From.Planet.GetName] continue to disturb. [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that the location is unlikely to have been a burial site, as these aliens appeared to have been in a good physical condition until they were suffocated by the sands.

What's more, we have also uncovered a number of weapon installations capable of launching heavy ordnance. Surprisingly, they are not aimed at the surface, but instead target the depths of space itself.

Whatever enemy these people were facing likely came from the stars.

cstorms.2120.a.zh: 做好一切必要的预防措施！

cstorms.2120.desc.zh:
我们关于在[From.Planet.GetName]发现的奇怪乱葬岗的理论没有得出有用的结论。唯一剩下的线索只有弄清吞噬整个军队的沙的起源这一条。

在进行了一系列极其复杂的计算和模拟之后，我们确定那场把沙子带到这里的风暴还在星球的其他地方继续肆虐着。一支小型远征部队被派去探险。

迎接他们的是一场猛烈的风暴，狂风在地表上挖出了深深的凹槽。毫无疑问，答案很可能就就藏在这个深渊里，就在这个风暴眼落脚的地方。
cstorms.2120.desc.en:
Our theories regarding the strange mass grave we found on [From.Planet.GetName] led to no useful conclusions. The only remaining lead pertained to the origin of the sands that swallowed this army whole.

After performing a series of immensely complex calculations and simulations, we have determined that the very storm which brought the sands here continues to rage elsewhere on the planet. A small expedition force was set out to explore.

A violent tempest greeted them, its brutal winds having carved out a deep recess in the ground. If any answers are to be found here, they are no doubt contained within this abyss, right where the eye of the storm finds its home.

cstorms.2125.desc.zh:
找到这个地点非常困难，需要最极致的技艺和注意力。然而，就在坑洞和风暴的中心，我们发现了一具不同寻常的骸骨。残余物和那些乱坟岗中的一样古老，但表现性和基因型与我们之前看到的尸体完全不同。

这具遗体的制服保存得意外地完好，且展现出了不同的设计。有迹象表明一部分附肢被刻意移除了……

但最令人好奇的是传感器读数：我们检测到身体周围和遗骸内的能量波动。这些特征与这场大风暴的特征惊人地相似，也与最初发现乱葬岗的宇宙风暴相似。

一个理论开始形成：这个个体或许与我们目前遇到的风暴有关？他甚至可能就是埋葬这支军队的原因？这听起来很奇怪，但事实给我们的暗示便是如此。
cstorms.2125.desc.en:
Navigating to the site was difficult, and required the utmost skill and attention. However, in the center of the crater and amidst the raging storm we discovered a most unusual skeleton. The remains are as ancient as those within the mass grave, though both the phenotype and genotype of the body were entirely different from the corpses we found there.

The skeleton's uniform was surprisingly well preserved, and it too showed significant differences in design. There were also signs that some of the appendages were deliberately removed...

But most curious were the readings from our sensors: we detected energy fluctuations around the body and from within. These signatures bore a surprising similarity to those inside this massive storm, as well as to the cosmic storm that originally uncovered the mass grave.

A theory began to form: Was this individual linked to the storms we've encountered so far? Might they even have been responsible for the burial of the army? It felt bizarre to consider, but the facts were leading us this way.

cstorms.2130.desc.zh:
将制服上的符号与我们的数据库进行交叉比对后得出了一个令人困惑的结果：这具尸体来自阿达卡利亚公约的公民！就是那个我们前不久调查过广播站的文明。更令我们惊讶的是，制服、尸体的历史和广播中的信息串成了一幅惊人的连贯画面。我们现在相信，这里就是那些广播中提到的那颗星球。

借助宣传站提供的语言知识，[Root.GetLeaderName]破译了受害者的名字：哈图尔·盖隆。

片刻之后，周围的风暴迅速扩大了规模和强度。由于这种天气的极度不可预测的性质，现在的风险已经太高了，我们只得被迫放弃这个星球。阿达卡利亚公约的线索再次中断了。
cstorms.2130.desc.en:
Cross-referencing the uniform's symbols with our database produced a baffling result: the body belonged to a citizen of the adAkkaria Convention! The very same civilization whose broadcast station we explored not too long ago. To our even greater surprise, the uniform, the age of the body, and the information from the broadcasts paint a surprisingly cohesive picture. We now believe that this is the world mentioned by those broadcasts.

With the linguistic knowledge from the Propaganda Station in hand, [Root.GetLeaderName] deciphered the victim's name: haToor Gailon.

Only moments later, the surrounding storm rapidly increased in size and intensity. Due to the weather's highly unpredictable nature, it became too dangerous to stay, and we were forced to abandon this world to the maelstrom. The trail of the adAkkaria Convention has grown cold again.

cstorms.2140.desc.zh:
这具外星人尸体和摧毁[planet_windswept_fates.GetName]行星的大风暴所散发出来的能量信号与揭开那支活埋军队的宇宙风暴是一样的。扫描日志表明，有一个此前探索过的星系也蕴含着相应的波动。这些都与阿达卡利亚公约的广播相吻合！

我们需要派出探险舰船进行调查。
cstorms.2140.desc.en:
The energy signatures of the alien body and the planet-ruining maelstrom on [planet_windswept_fates.GetName] match those of the cosmic storm responsible for unearthing the buried army. The scan log revealed a previously explored system that harbors corresponding fluctuations. These are identical to the broadcasts of the adAkkaria Convention!

An exploratory vessel should be sent to investigate.

cstorms.215.desc.zh:
登上空间站的过程几乎没有遇到什么问题，但在其结构内有点难找到方向。部分得益于它外部先进的屏蔽设施，它的构造保存得非常完好，但狭窄的走廊和低矮的天花板对我们的团队来说是一个挑战。

除了墙上装饰着大片的纸-塑料混合物外，前哨站的内部几乎没有提供关于其前主人本质的线索。这些海报描绘了一种未知有机物种个体的风格化图像。他们的外表引人注目，站在征服和庆祝的背景前。视觉效果显然是为了灌输某种自豪感和亲切感。

通讯主机本身则简直是个谜。起初[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]们认为它是自然界的模拟物，类似于各种[Root.Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]中常见的东西。然而，在按钮和表盘的下面却是一种用未知合金制成的复杂的电子电路。[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]们怀疑这个文明可能跳过了计算机科学发展的几个步骤，这就解释了这里存在不同时代科技的杂糅现象。

尽管如此，经过一系列的尝试和错误，我们的[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]还是成功地破译了许多广播录音中的第一段。
cstorms.215.desc.en:
Boarding the station caused few problems, though navigating the structure was difficult. While it is surprisingly well-preserved, in part due to the advanced composition of the external shielding, the narrow corridors and the low ceilings proved a challenge for our team.

The interior of the outpost provides few clues as to the nature of its former owners, save for the large sheets of a paper-plastic mixture decorating the walls. These posters depict stylized imagery of individuals of an unknown organic species. Their appearance is notable, standing tall and resolute before a background of conquest and celebration. The visuals are clearly designed to instill a certain sense of pride and kinship.

The transmission mainframe itself is just as much of a mystery. Initially our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] believed it to be analogue in nature, akin to what we've seen in [Root.Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]. However, beneath the buttons and dials lay a complex arrangement of electronic circuitry, made from alloys yet unknown to us. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] suspect this civilization might have skipped several steps of development in computer science, which explains the anachronistic mix of technology.

Nevertheless, after a series of trial and error, our [Root.Owner.GetLinguists] managed to decipher the first of many recorded broadcasts.

cstorms.2150.desc.zh:
这里停放着各式各样的舰船，从卵形的木制船体到空灵的宇宙晶体方舟。其中许多图像与阿达卡利亚广播站的传输和日志中发现的图像相似。

我们猜测公约舰队和宇联舰队在这里发生过冲突，所谓宇联舰队就是几千年前的星系维和部队。

虽然这些船只早已无法修复，但它们似乎不是被任何普通武器所困，也不是因故障或类似的灾难而陷入困境。船体的内部被撕个粉碎，就像被一台巨大的碎纸机袭击了一般。
cstorms.2150.desc.en:
Ships of all kinds are laid to rest here, everything from oblong wooden vessels to crystalline arks of the cosmic and ethereal. Many share similarities with the imagery found in the transmissions and logs of the adAkkaria Broadcast Station.

We suspect a confrontation took place here between the Convention's fleet and that of Unicom, the galactic peacekeeping force from millennia ago.

And yet, while these ships are beyond repair, they do not appear marooned by any common weaponry, nor by malfunction or similar disasters. Instead, the hulls and interiors appear to be ripped apart, as if assaulted by a massive shredder.

cstorms.2155.desc.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]小心翼翼地从坟场的舰船中取回了一些数据库。其中的大部分都已经过度老化，但有一个阿达卡利亚的数据库幸存了：

——我们被伏击了！重复一遍，我们被伏击了！宇联要求我们停止对罗库科拉原始人的提升，否则就要消灭我们。请回应。如果不撤退，我们会死在这的！拜托，至少派援军来吧！

——拒绝。你们的牺牲会被铭记。
cstorms.2155.desc.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] carefully recovered databanks from the graveyard vessels. While much of it was ravaged by time, one adAkkaria database has survived:

- We have been waylaid. I repeat, we have been waylaid. UniCom demands we cease our elevation of the Rokukora Primitives or face elimination. Please, respond. If we do not retreat, we will be destroyed! Please, at least send reinforcements!

- Negative. Your sacrifice will be noted.

cstorms.2160.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]转写了新的广播内容后，我们又有了新的发现：一具漂浮在坟地中央的冰冻尸体！

这具尸体大的大部分已经枯萎，但他的服装表明他是一位公约的官员。

奇怪的是，一个由小碎片组成的环带围绕着这个物体运行，似乎它对这些物体施加了某种引力。这具遗体已被带上船作进一步分析。
cstorms.2160.desc.en:
As our [Root.Owner.GetLinguists] transliterated the new broadcasts, we made another astonishing discovery: a frozen body floating in the center of the graveyard!

While much of the corpse has withered, its attire is that of an officer of the Convention.

Curiously, a corona of small debris was in orbit around the body, as if it exerted some sort of gravitational pull on these objects. The remains have been taken onboard for further analysis.

cstorms.2165.desc.def.zh:
$cstorms.2165.desc.intro$

就在我们辨别清这些伤口的性质后没多久，舰船上的仪表突然发生了一次剧烈的能量波动，[Root.GetLeaderName]尖叫了起来。

好一阵子之后，[Leader.GetHeShe]把刚才这段经历描述为强烈的光线灼烧感，然后是一阵毁灭性的痛苦。好像有什么东西想要由内而外撬开[Leader.GetHerHis]的头脑一般。
cstorms.2165.desc.def.en:
$cstorms.2165.desc.intro$

No sooner had we identified the nature of these wounds, our vessel's instruments experienced a sudden, sharp power surge and [Root.GetLeaderName] began to scream.

Much later, [Leader.GetHeShe] would describe the experience as a searing of intense light, followed by a wave of devastating pain. It was as if something was trying to crack open [Leader.GetHerHis] mind... from the inside out.

cstorms.2165.desc.gestalt.zh:
$cstorms.2165.desc.intro$

在这发现之后，我们船员的数据库被一个无法溯源的力量腐蚀了。许多[controller.GetIndividualNamePlural]唤起了一种经历短暂而令人虚弱的能量骤增，而另一些则暴露在杂乱无章的幻想中，在这种刺激下，他们的声音调制器发出了超过120分贝的刺耳声音。
cstorms.2165.desc.gestalt.en:
$cstorms.2165.desc.intro$

Following this discovery, our crew's databanks were corrupted by an untraceable force. Several [controller.GetIndividualNamePlural] recalled experiencing a brief and debilitating power surge, while others were exposed to scrambled and disjointed imagery, provoking their voice modulators to emit a piercing sound at more than 120 decibels.

cstorms.2165.desc.psio.zh:
$cstorms.2165.desc.intro$

就在我们辨别清这些伤口的性质后没多久，舰船上的仪表突然发生了一次剧烈的能量波动，我们具有灵能天赋的船员尖叫了起来。

好一阵子之后，他们报告称，有那么一刻，他们的头脑完全清醒了，随之而来的是一波又一波的炽热的愤怒。[Root.GetLeaderName]表示在愤怒的深处埋藏着可怕的惊讶和深刻的背叛感。一个奇特的念头出现了：他们激怒了我！
cstorms.2165.desc.psio.en:
$cstorms.2165.desc.intro$

No sooner had we identified the nature of these wounds, our vessel's instruments experienced a sudden, sharp power surge and our psionically gifted crew began to scream.

Much later, they would report a moment of supreme clarity, followed by wave after wave of molten, mind-searing anger. [Root.GetLeaderName] stated that deep beneath the rage was buried a horrific surprise and a profound sense of betrayal. The singular thought arrived: They have invoked me!

cstorms.2165.desc.psio_robot.zh:
$cstorms.2165.desc.intro$

就在我们辨别清这些伤口的性质后没多久，舰船上的仪表突然发生了一次剧烈的能量波动，我们装备齐全的单元遭受到了一波内部能量峰值。

好一阵子之后，他们报告称，有那么一刻，他们的灵能处理器被编录了极端的愤怒。[Root.GetLeaderName]表明这种情绪反应伴随有一条思绪，可以转写为：他们激怒了我！
cstorms.2165.desc.psio_robot.en:
$cstorms.2165.desc.intro$

No sooner had we identified the nature of these wounds, our vessel's instruments experienced a sudden, sharp power surge and our equipped unit experienced internal power spikes.

Much later, they would report a moment of what their psionic processors catalogued as extreme anger. [Root.GetLeaderName] stated the emotional response arrived alongside a singular thought, transcribed as: They have invoked me!

cstorms.2170.desc.def.zh:
我们刚一和[Root.GetFleetName]科研船重新建立通讯，船上的人就开始嚎叫起来。过了好一阵，在相对平静下来之后，人们才发现，他们带到船上的外星人尸体才是引起骚乱的罪魁祸首。

那具尸体对他们的思想施加了某种奇怪的力量。一些细小物体升到空中，开始绕着尸体旋转。内墙的一些区段因压力而弯曲开裂。

[Root.GetLeaderName]设法从紧张状态中及时醒来，赶紧把尸体从船里移走。正是由于[Leader.GetHerHis]的快速反应，这艘科研船才得以逃离异常突然出现的宇宙风暴。如果不是[Leader.GetHeShe]，这片墓地就会迎来一艘新船。

当[Root.GetLeaderName]回忆自己的这段经历时，注意到另一件事：无论尸体的奇怪力量的来源是什么，它会在飞船的指挥屏幕上形成一个非常特殊的图案。这是在试图沟通吗？这是一声来自墓地之外的哭叫吗？

目前，我们还没有答案。
cstorms.2170.desc.def.en:
No sooner had we re-established communication with the science ship [Root.GetFleetName] than we were subjected to the howling cries of its crew. Much later, after a relative calm had been restored, it was revealed that the alien body they brought onboard was responsible for the outcry.

The corpse itself was exerting some strange power of their minds. Small objects rose into the air and began to orbit the body. Sections of the interior walls were warped and rent by the pressure.

[Root.GetLeaderName] managed to awaken from [Leader.GetHerHis] catatonic state just in time to expunge the corpse from the vessel. And it was [Leader.GetHerHis] quick reaction that also allowed the science ship to escape the sudden emergence of a cosmic storm. Had [Leader.GetHeShe] not, the graveyard would have welcomed a new ship.

As [Root.GetLeaderName] recounted [Leader.GetHerHis] experience, [Leader.GetHeShe] noted something else: whatever the source of the corpse's strange power, it also caused the a very particular pattern to form on the vessel's command screens. Was this an attempt to communicate? A cry from beyond the grave?

For now, we have no answers.

cstorms.2170.desc.gestalt.zh:
损坏我们部分探索[controller.GetIndividualNamePlural]的混乱图像解码出来了。它们形成了一个古代居住站的影像。[controller.GetScientistCapital]被一个个体遭受越来越残酷虐待的景象所困扰。他的身体被烧焦，器官被渐渐煮熟。

一些[controller.GetIndividualNamePlural]设法逃脱了这种视听攻击。他们称，一些细小物体开始在靠近该尸体的轨道上环绕漂浮。这些有机残留物不知何故形成了自己的引力场。

这种未知的力量越来越强大，直到部分内墙被压力扭曲和撕裂。就在那一刻，我们的安全系统重新启动，尸体被抛回了太空。

不久之后，一场宇宙风暴在这个恒星系中爆发。我们的舰船勉强地全身而退。

无论那里到底发生了什么，它引发的问题都比带来的答案多。
cstorms.2170.desc.gestalt.en:
The scrambled images corrupting some of our exploration [controller.GetIndividualNamePlural] were decoded. They formed an image of an ancient habitat. [controller.GetScientistCapital] were beset by the sight and sound of an individual being subjected to increasingly cruel treatment. His body was burned, his organs cooked.

Some [controller.GetIndividualNamePlural] managed to escape the audio-visual assault. They stated that several small objects began to float in close orbit to the body. The organic remains had somehow developed their own gravitational field.

This unknown force grew in strength until sections of the interior walls were warped and rent by the pressure. It was that moment that our safety systems re-engaged, and the body was jettisoned back into space.

Soon after, a cosmic storm was unleashed in the system. Our vessel barely made it out intact.

Whatever transpired there has precipitated more questions than answers.

cstorms.2180.desc.zh:
[FromFrom.Leader.GetName]在[planet_assembling_the_past.System.GetName]星系的遭遇之后，我们的科学家愈发感兴趣到底阿达卡利亚公约发生了什么事情。我们在[planet_windswept_fates.GetName]和舰队坟地的探险过程中收集到的信息表明，星系到处都散落着阿达卡利亚的宣传站。

此外，在一系列冗长的讨论后，他们还认为，在[Root.GetName]上发现的故障模式其实是一组之前尚未发现星系的坐标！

我们设立了一个特殊项目来调查这个新的星系。
cstorms.2180.desc.en:
After [FromFrom.Leader.GetName]'s experience in the [planet_assembling_the_past.System.GetName] system, our scientists are even more driven to discover what exactly happened with the adAkkaria Convention. The data we gathered during our exploration of [planet_windswept_fates.GetName] and the flotilla graveyard revealed that the galaxy was littered with adAkkaria propaganda stations.

What's more, after a set of long discussions, they also suspect that the pattern observed in [Root.GetName]'s glitching was a set of directions to a previously undiscovered system!

A special project has been created to investigate this new system.

cstorms.2185.desc.zh:
起初我们担心对[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的调查已经陷入了死胡同。该方向指向了一颗受到不稳定磁场摧残的星球，这种摧残严重到整颗星球的地貌全部都被摧毁了。在这样的磁场猛攻下，这里几乎不可能存在任何有价值的东西。

然而，在行星的轨道上还有一座古代的居住站，其具有和阿达卡利亚广播站类似的建筑结构。虽然已经被从外部密封，但是我们能够利用从阿达卡利亚数据库中恢复的信息生成一个准入信号。

距离上一次有人登上这个站点已经过去了亿万年。我们没办法知道里面等待着我们的是什么。
cstorms.2185.desc.en:
At first we feared our investigation into the [From.solar_system.GetName] system had led to a dead end. The directions pointed to a planet suffering from unstable magnetic fields of such severity that its landscape was all but decimated. It was unlikely anything of value could have survived such an onslaught.

However, orbiting the planet was an ancient habitat, bearing architectural similarities to the adAkkaria broadcast station. While hermetically locked from the outside, we were able to generate an entrance signal based on information recovered from the adAkkaria databases.

It has been eons since anyone last boarded this station. There is no way to know what lies waiting inside.

cstorms.220.desc.zh:
在与这台远古通讯主机成功连接后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]提供了第一次广播的转写：

阿达卡利亚公约的人民们！

我不是以领导的身份、而是以一位老友和导师的身份与你们说话。

你们一定注意到了，白昼正在变暗，天空愈发地阴沉，甚至恒星本身也都变得充满敌意。

但我是有信心的。正如我们的恩主对我们有信心一样，我对我们的目标、对你们也有信心。

几个世纪以来，我们的人民保护这些星球不受野蛮部落的侵害。从这些邪恶势力手中拯救星系是我们的使命。命运不会因一次挫折而改变。我们不会被阴谋反对我们的邪恶军团所破坏。

我相信我们的使命。阿达卡利亚仁善公约会为所有文明带去真理和自由。是我们的使命保住了自己的性命，是我们的命运让我们取得胜利、繁荣昌盛!

因此，我的朋友们，不要屈服于怀疑之辞。要为损失而哀悼，给予烈士以荣誉。然后让我们像往常一样团结到一起。为了我们的恩主，为了我们的阿达卡利亚公约，为了仁善！
cstorms.220.desc.en:
After successfully interfacing with the ancient transmission mainframe, our [Root.Owner.GetLinguists] have provided a transcript of the first broadcast:

People of the adAkkaria Convention!

I speak to you not as a leader, but as a friend and a mentor.

It cannot have gone unnoticed that the days are darkening and the skies are turning bitter. Even the stars themselves are hostile.

But I have faith. As our Benefactors had faith in us, I have faith in our purpose. I have faith in you.

For centuries our people protected the stars from the worst of the barbarian hordes. It is our destiny to save the galaxy from these malicious forces. And destiny is not undone by a single setback. We will not be marred by the malevolent legions conspiring against us.

I believe in our mission. The adAkkaria Convention of Benevolence brings truth and freedom to all civilisations. It is our mission that preserves us. It is our fate that allows us to triumph and thrive!

And so my fellow friends, let us not give in to doubt. Mourn our losses, yes. Honor the fallen. And then let us come together as we've always done. For our Benefactors. For the adAkkaria Convention. For Benevolence!

cstorms.2200.desc.zh:
在气闸的另一头是一座小小的隧道网。在尽头，我们找到了一条通往人造阳光照亮的巨大广场的路。奇怪的是，这个居住站的建筑更像某些居住星球上的郊区，而不是一个如此著名的科学站。这座居住站设计为能够容纳整座公寓大楼、购物中心和学校，并且还设有游乐园、公园等其他设施。这是一个为奢华生活而设计的地方。

然而，它现在完全被遗弃了。在整座居住站中没有发现半个有机生命形式。我们一边继续探索，一边被这个地方的空虚和荒凉的气氛所震撼。

人造阳光偶尔会出现故障，让空间站陷入暂时的黑暗，虽然其他电子设备大部分仍在运行，但它们也受到同样的干扰。最令人好奇的是在居住站的公寓内发现的监控设备网络。看来这里的每位公民都受到了严格的监督。寻找到一座安保站也许能提供更多线索。
cstorms.2200.desc.en:
Beyond the airlock stretched a small network of tunnels. At last we found our way to a massive plaza lit by artificial sunlight. Strangely, the architecture of the habitat was more akin to the suburbs found on certain residential worlds than of a prominent science station. The habitat was built to house entire apartment complexes, shopping centers and schools, but also pleasure gardens, parks and other facilities. This was a place designed for luxury living.

Now however it is entirely abandoned. Not a single organic lifeform was detected within the entirety of the habitat. And we continued to explore, we were struck by the emptiness of this place and the bleak staleness of the atmosphere.

The artificial sunlight experienced occasional glitches, covering the station in darkness, and while other electronic devices are remain largely operational, they too are affected by these same interruptions. But most curious is the network of surveillance devices found within the apartments of the habitat. It appears every citizen was under strict supervision. Finding a security station of some sort could provide more insight.

cstorms.2205.desc.def.zh:
$cstorms.2205.desc.intro$

[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报称，在目睹这种破败场景之后，[Leader.GetHerHim]被激起了此前在古代舰队坟场与阿达卡利亚公约遭遇的回忆。

$cstorms.2205.desc.outro$
cstorms.2205.desc.def.en:
$cstorms.2205.desc.intro$

[Root.GetLeaderName] reported feeling agitated upon witnessing the disruptions, as it reminded [Leader.GetHerHim] of our previous encounter with the adAkkaria Convention at the naval graveyard.

$cstorms.2205.desc.outro$

cstorms.2205.desc.mach.zh:
$cstorms.2205.desc.intro$

我们的无人机汇报称，在目睹这种破败景象后，他们很担心，因为这让他们想起了此前在古代舰队坟场与阿达卡利亚公约的遭遇。

$cstorms.2205.desc.outro$
cstorms.2205.desc.mach.en:
$cstorms.2205.desc.intro$

Our drones reported being concerned upon witnessing the disruptions, as it reminded them of the previous encounter with the adAkkaria Convention at the ancient naval graveyard.

$cstorms.2205.desc.outro$

cstorms.2210.desc.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]很快就发现了围绕[From.Planet.GetName]的这座居住站的作用：来自公民和工作人员的日志以及信息都描述了对阿达卡利亚公民中新出现的灵能者的调查。所有住在这里的人都受到最高领袖的邀请，在这里享受奢华的生活和自我表达。作为回报，他们同意参加空间站正在进行的实验。

大多数公民都热衷于加入这项计划。安全日志显示，其中许多是残疾的退伍军人。他们得到了照顾、经济援助和赦免他们可能遇到的任何悬而未决的法律问题的承诺。

更重要的是，居住站的人员名单上有一个非常熟悉的名字：阿拉塔·蓝迪尔他是一名科学家兼残疾老兵，此前他被截肢的尸体被我们在舰队坟场发现。
cstorms.2210.desc.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetLinguists] didn't take long to discover the purpose of the habitat orbiting [From.Planet.GetName]: logs and messages from citizens and staff alike describe investigations into the newly emerged psionic powers of the adAkkaria citizens. All those living here received invitations from the Convention's 'Exalted Leadership' to enjoy a life of luxury and self-expression aboard the habitat. In return, they agreed to participate in the station's ongoing experiments.

Most citizens were keen to join the program. The security logs show many were disabled war veterans. They were promised care, financial assistance, and pardons for any outstanding legal issues they might have had.

What's more, the station's personnel list contained a very familiar name: alAtta Landeer, a scientist and disabled veteran, whose amputated body we recovered at the naval graveyard.

cstorms.2215.desc.zh:
我们破译出了从居住站发出的最后一条信息：

信息——日期02100363——发件人：西达尼·伊腾皮尔——收件人：西祖尔·伊腾皮尔
嗨！我还活着！很抱歉回晚了。自从……以来居住站就变得很奇怪，所以发送信息就很困难。他们说这与此无关，但我们认为他毕竟有灵能天赋。至于我嘛，我也跟你你说过了，我没什么进展啦，毕竟之前发生了那么多……所以他们也建议尝试一些更激进的方法：……宇宙风暴。我知道你在想什么，但不过就是根指头罢了，兴许还会再长回来呢。但当……我释放的感觉……！
爱你的，西达尼
——通讯已审核（有问题？询问导师）

信息——日期02100365——发件人：哈图尔·盖隆——收件人：艾达尔·阿斯杜尔
亲爱的艾达尔，
我在这一直过得很好。我还见了其他的一些老兵。我们没有说什么话但互相都理解了，不用说话真好。
今天我只是想着要举起杯子，它就飘起来了。我仍然想念我的右附肢，但也许这种新生活也不像我担心的那么糟糕。我听说他们要把我送到……显然我是个灵能神童……我……想再次被部署了。
我希望能回家过爱国者节。到时候再见吧。
此致。哈图尔。
——通讯已审核（有问题？询问导师）

信息——日期02100367——发件人：恩瑞达·迪伦——收件人：翁瑞达·迪伦
我用意念熄灭了火焰！！！
有一个实验对象不知道怎么突然歇斯底里了起来，在食堂里引起了火灾。大家都很恐慌，而且无路可逃！我也超级害怕，但后来不知道体内发生了什么，我就把火扑灭了！
我救了大家！！告诉长老们我并不是无可救药的失败品，快帮帮忙！
——通讯已屏蔽（立刻向导师汇报）

值得注意的是第二个通讯：哈图尔·盖隆的就是我们之前在[Root.Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]星球上的考古任务中发现的那具尸体。
cstorms.2215.desc.en:
We have deciphered one of the last messages sent from the habitat:

Message - Date 02100363 - Sender: siDani Itempeer - Recipient: siZul Itempeer
Hi! I'm still alive! Sorry for the delays. Ever since... the habitat is behaving strangely so sending messages has been hard. They say it has nothing to do with that, but we think he was psionically gifted after all. As for me, I told you I wasn't really getting anywhere, with all the previous... So they suggested trying out something more radical: ... cosmic storms. I know what you're thinking, but it's just one digit and maybe it'll even grow back. But the sensations I've unlocked when... !
Love, siDani
- TRANSMISSION CENSORED ( Questions? Ask your supervisor )

Message - Date 02100365 - Sender: haToor Gailon - Recipient: aeDal Asduur
Dear aeDal,
Life has been treating me well. I've met a few other veterans. We don't talk. But we all know. It's nice not having to talk.
Today I only had to think of lifting a cup, and it did. I still miss my right appendage, but maybe this new life won't be as bad as I feared. I've heard them talk about sending me to... Apparently I'm a psionic prodigy... I... want to be deployed again.
I hope to be home for Patriots' Day. Let's meet up.
Yours, haToor
- TRANSMISSION CENSORED ( Questions? Ask your supervisor )

Message - Date 02100367 - Sender: enRida Direen - Recipient: onRida Direen
I STOPPED A FIRE WITH MY MIND!!!!
One of the other subjects went all hysterical for some reason and caused a fire to break out in the mess hall. Everyone was just panicking but we couldn't go anywhere! I was also SUPER scared but then something happened inside me and I just made it go away!
I SAVED EVERYONE!! Tell the elders I'm not entirely a hopeless case, will you!
- TRANSMISSION BLOCKED ( REPORT TO YOUR SUPERVISOR IMMEDIATELY )

Notable is the second transmission: haToor Gailon's body was discovered during our archeological mission on the [Root.Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] world.

cstorms.2220.a.zh: 最后一条信息没发出去。
cstorms.2220.a.en: That last message was never sent.

cstorms.2220.desc.zh:
这些信息的日期是居住站撤离前的几天：

信息——日期02100359——发件人：至高博士——收件人：崇敬舰队司令
你的上一条信息在这里引起了一些关切。你能解释一下为什么这么多年来一直默默支持我们，现在却突然威胁要关闭这里吗？
——通讯已发送

信息——日期02100360——发件人：崇敬舰队司令——收件人：至高博士
你在跟我开玩笑吧。几个月以来我的都一直在给你警告，但我猜是不是绕着一颗反复无常的星球转给你造成了某种方便的健忘症。你知道宇联正在威胁我们的生存，对吧？战争愈演愈烈，我没办法为挥霍大笔资源就为了让你的实验对象能整天盯着牲畜看这种事情辩护了。我需要切实可行的结果，现在立刻。
——通讯已收到

信息——日期02100360——发件人：至高博士——收件人：崇敬舰队司令
请原谅，我们没有收到你之前的信息。我们的电台一直受到技术故障的困扰，这肯定也影响了我们的通讯。不管怎样，我们需要更多的时间。我们有适当的程序和协议，不能就这样半途而废！
——通讯已发送

信息——日期02100361——发件人：崇敬舰队司令——收件人：至高博士
给你一周时间，不然我就要立刻关停了。没有什么如果，没有什么但是，也没有第二次机会，我要结果！
——通讯已收到

信息——日期02100368——发件人：至高博士——收件人：崇敬舰队司令
随信附上一份我们最近取得的进度报告。这些视频证明了我们这些有灵能天赋的人可以影响宇宙风暴。这可能有惊人的军事应用。如果有足够的时间，我们可以增强他们的灵能表达而不必造成身心创伤。
——通讯失败（原因：通讯矩阵崩溃）
cstorms.2220.desc.en:
These messages are dated a few days before the evacuation of the habitat:

Message - Date 02100359 - Sender: Supreme Doctor - Recipient: Revered Admiral
Your last message caused some concern here. Would you be so kind as to explain why after supporting us for all these years without a comment, you're suddenly threatening to shut us down?
- TRANSMISSION SENT

Message - Date 02100360 - Sender: Revered Admiral - Recipient: Supreme Doctor
You have got to be kidding me. For months we've been sending you warnings, but I guess orbiting a capricious world must have caused some convenient amnesia. You are aware that Unicom is threatening our very existence, correct? And with this war ramping up, I can no longer defend spending exorbitant resources just for your subjects to stare at cattle all day. I need tangible, applicable results. NOW.
- TRANSMISSION RECEIVED

Message - Date 02100360 - Sender: Supreme Doctor - Recipient: Revered Admiral
Forgive us, we never received your earlier messages. Our station has been plagued by technical glitches, and it must've affected our transmissions as well. Regardless, we need more time. We have processes and protocols in place, we can't just abandon them!
- TRANSMISSION SENT

Message - Date 02100361 - Sender: Revered Admiral - Recipient: Supreme Doctor
You have one week or else we will proceed to immediate shutdown. No ifs, no buts, no second chances, RESULTS!
- TRANSMISSION RECEIVED

Message - Date 02100368 - Sender: Supreme Doctor - Recipient: Revered Admiral
Attached you'll find a report of our recent accomplishments. These videos prove that cosmic storms can be influenced by our psionically gifted subjects. This could have staggering military applications. Given enough time we can supercharge their psionic expression without having to subject them to physical and mental trauma.
- TRANSMISSION FAILED (Cause: Transmission Matrix Corruption)

cstorms.2225.a.zh: 设定前往公约母星的航线。
cstorms.2225.a.en: Set course to the Convention's homeworld.

cstorms.2225.desc.zh:
这是恢复出来的最后一条信息：

亲爱的同事们，

我以沉重的心情告知你们，崇高指挥部决定停止崇高仁善爱国协会的一切活动。

这不是对你们大家工作的控诉。能与你们大家一起工作是我的荣幸。我知道你们会有很多疑问，但简而言之，崇高仁善的期望与我们的研究目标并不一致。

至于我们的公民，崇高司令部邀请他们到艾德苏尔的$building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$参与项目。您可以在下面找到完整的人员名单。

至于其他人……很遗憾，我们研究的保密性意味着研究参与者将不被允许回归社会。崇敬指挥部答应派一支特别单位负责处理他们。你们不需要亲自见证，这本身也是一种祝福。他们的亲属将得到最大限度的补偿。

此致。
至高博士，阿拉塔·蓝迪尔

所附的列表，虽然部分损坏，但提到了哈图尔·盖隆和恩瑞达·迪伦。他们似乎被转移到了阿达卡利亚公约的首都艾德苏尔。我们现在已经得到了这颗星球的坐标。
cstorms.2225.desc.en:
This is the last recovered message:

Dear colleagues,

I address you with a heavy heart. Exalted Command has decided to cease all operations inside the Patriotic Institute of Exalted Benevolence.

This should not be taken as an indictment of you or our work here. It has been an honor to serve with each and every one of you. I know that you will have many questions, but in short, the expectations of Exalted Command did not align with our research aims.

As for our citizens, Exalted Command invited them to join the program at the $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$ on adSul. You will find a full personnel list attached below. Please inform your reports accordingly.

As for the others... Regrettably, the covert nature of our research means that research participants will not be allowed to return to society proper. Exalted Command promised to send us a special unit to take care of them. You will not need to see to this yourselves, which in its own way is a blessing. Their relatives will be compensated to the fullest.

Signing off, 
Supreme Doctor, alAtta Landeer

The attached list, while partially corrupted, mentions the subjects haToor Gailon and enRida Direen. It appears they were transferred to the adAkkaria Convention's capital of adSul. The coordinates to this world are now in our possession.

cstorms.2240.desc.zh:
这组坐标揭示了一个之前对我们扫描隐藏的星系。是时候去拜访一下阿达卡利亚公约了，趁其他人还没这么做之前。

发起了一项新的特殊项目。
cstorms.2240.desc.en:
The coordinates revealed a system previously hidden from our scanners. The time has come to pay the adAkkaria Convention a visit - before anyone else does.

A new special project has been issued.

cstorms.2245.desc.zh:
就在离开居住站后不久，[event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetName]做出了一个唐突而令人震惊的决定。就像被某种外力驱使一般，[event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetHeShe]命令舰船打开了一个通常与大规模灵能事件或转瞬即逝的宇宙风暴有关的通讯频道。

该频道指向与阿达卡利亚公约母星系相同的坐标。只过了一小会儿我们的呼叫就得到了回应。
cstorms.2245.desc.en:
Only moments after leaving the habitat, [event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetName] made an abrupt and stunning decision. As if driven by an outside force, [event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetHeShe] ordered the ship to open a communication channel on a frequency typically associated with mass psionic events or the passage of an evanescent cosmic storm.

The channel was directed at the same coordinates as dAkkaria Convention's home system. It took only an instant for our hails to be returned.

cstorms.2245.desc.gestalt.zh:
离开居住站后不久，我们的集体仪式被一种不寻常的振动所干扰，仿佛有什么东西试图在遥远的地方与我们交流。这个信号来自与阿达卡利亚公约的母星系相同的坐标，并且发生在于一个典型的与大规模灵能事件或转瞬即逝的宇宙风暴通过有关的频率上。

我们的回电立即得到了回应。
cstorms.2245.desc.gestalt.en:
Moments after leaving the habitat, our group consciousness was troubled by an unusual vibration, as if something was trying to communicate with us over a vast distance. The signal originated from the same coordinates as the adAkkaria Convention's home system, and existed on a frequency typically associated with mass psionic events or the passage of an evanescent cosmic storm.

Our return hail was instantly answered.

cstorms.225.a.hive.en: Too many voices lead to chaos.

cstorms.225.desc.zh:
对我们的[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]来说，整理远古空间站上发掘出的数据是一项艰巨的任务。不过，有几档广播节目特别有信息量，其中一些包含有录制对话的片段：

伊尔萨皮涅·图尔希 — 主播
——说到最近来自宇宙联合体的干涉，我们请来了最高教授阿克玛尼·桑多和全感存在博士埃米克·英纳。尊敬的教授，您如何解读宇联的要求？

阿克玛尼·桑多 — 最高教授
他们的要求简直荒谬绝伦！宇联还在以极其轻蔑的态度对待欠文明星球。但我倒要问问这些自称是星系道德守护者的家伙们：扣留可以用来拯救生命的技术、扣留那些构成我们成功社会基石的理念不是更不道德吗？如果我们任由一颗星球加速走向灭亡，而不伸出援手拯救它，那我们会变得多么卑鄙？

伊尔萨皮涅·图尔希 — 主播
真是绝妙的观点！全感存在博士，我想您一定也对宇联都对我们命运的干涉而感到愤怒吧。

埃米克·英纳 — 全感存在博士
我现在要说的话可能会让你震惊。尽管这个组织非常顽固，但我认为应该考虑研究一下宇联的关——

看来广播在这个时候被切断了。
cstorms.225.desc.en:
Sorting through the data uncovered on the ancient station has proven a daunting task for our [Root.Owner.GetLinguists]. However, several broadcasts have been flagged as particularly revealing, with some providing a glimpse into recorded conversations:

ilSapne Tuerthi - Anchor
 - - and to discuss the recent interference from the Universal Community, here is Most Exalted Professor akMani Sando and Doctor of All Perceived Existence emEk Inna. Most Exalted Professor, what is your interpretation of UniCom's demands?

akMani Sando - Most Exalted Professor
The demands are outrageous! The Universal Community continues to treat under civilized worlds with the utmost disdain. But let me ask these self-proclaimed guardians of galactic morality: is it not more unethical to withhold life-saving technologies? To withhold those ideals that form the cornerstone of our triumphant society? How vile would we become if we allowed a world to speed towards its own demise and not reach out to save it?

ilSapne Tuerthi - Anchor
All excellent points! Doctor of All Perceived Existence, I imagine you must be equally outraged at UniCom's tampering with our destiny.

emEkku Inna - Doctor of All Perceived Existence
What I have to say now may shock you. Despite the stubbornness of the organization, I think an effort should be made to study UniCom's concer-

It appears the broadcast was cut off at this point.

cstorms.2250.desc.zh:
尽管我们尝试过所有的方案，但到达艾德苏尔的挑战还是比预想的要大得多。整个恒星系被未知成分的宇宙风暴吞没，使我们无法靠近这颗行星。

至于这场吞没星系的风暴，它似乎是在……向我们打招呼？
cstorms.2250.desc.en:
We did everything possible, but getting to adSul proved to be a much bigger challenge than anticipated. The entire system is engulfed by a cosmic storm of unknown composition, making it impossible for us to get any closer to the planet.

As for the storm, it appears to be... hailing us?

cstorms.2285.desc.zh:
庆典学院的空旷大厅除了厚厚的历史和尘埃以外什么都没有。向着永恒歌颂着阿达卡利亚公约英勇的宣传海报是这个曾经繁荣而令人畏惧的帝国所留下的一切。

然而，我们在语言方面的努力已经得到了回报；这里的安保系统脆弱不堪，主机很容易就泄露了它的秘密。

在我们恢复的日志中，直到宣传站后一次广播之前，这里满满的都是热闹的活动。

而从那一个日期起，阿达卡利亚仁善公约就消失得无影无踪。
cstorms.2285.desc.en:
The empty halls of Celebration revealed nothing more than the dust of ages. The propaganda posters, forever exalting the valor of the adAkkaria Convention, were all that were left of this once thriving, and feared, empire.

However, our linguistic efforts are already paying off; security was merely a suggestion and the mainframe gave up its secrets easily.

The logs we recovered were bustling with activity right up to the last of the Propaganda Station's broadcasts.

On that date the adAkkaria Convention of Benevolence simply ceased to exist.

cstorms.2290.a.zh: 他们在这做什么实验呢？

cstorms.2290.a.gen.zh: 杀了这么多啊，真是激动人心。

cstorms.2290.desc.zh:
带着一丝恐惧和好奇，我们深入到了这座建筑的地下。迎接我们的是一座精心规划的庞大实验室网络。我们的小组分成了两拨人，一半负责调查实验室，以更深入地了解庆典学院的作用，另一半则继续往下探索。

我们的扫描结果显示有有机物的存在，而且没过多久就发现了原因：庆典学院的下层是专门用于观察室的。阿达卡利亚公民的木乃伊化遗骸仍然被囚禁在这些狭窄的隔间里。每个房间旁边的一个数字界面显示着每位居住者的名字、他们所接受的试验阶段以及观察员的笔记。

同时，我们恢复出了以下消息：
我们在哈利俄斯星系中的试运行是一场彻底的灾难。对被称为哈图尔·盖隆的实验对象的初次部署一切按计划进行。但当我们遇到索尔法尼野蛮军队时，实验对象就失去了控制。风暴将原始军队一扫而空时，我们的军队也跟着遭殃了。

首先要理解的是，这些对象是低劣且精神异常的。召唤器还是越早上线越好。
cstorms.2290.desc.en:
With a hint of dread and curiosity we delved into the subterranean levels of the compound. A sprawling, carefully planned web of laboratories greeted us. Our unit split in two: one half was sent to investigate the laboratories for more insight into the purpose of Celebration. The other continued its descent.

Our scans insisted on the presence of organic material, and it didn't take long to uncover why: the lower levels of Celebration are given over exclusively to observation cells. The mummified remains of adAkkaria citizens are still imprisoned in these cramped compartments. A digital interface next to each chamber offered each occupant's name, the phase of the trial they were subject to, and the observers' notes.

Meanwhile, we recovered the following message:
Our trial run in the Haliios system was a complete and utter disaster. The initial deployment of the subject known as haToor Gailon went as planned. As soon as we were confronted by the Solphani barbarian forces, the subject lost control. While the tempest wiped out the primitive armies, ours too were decimated.

It should be understood that above all, these subjects are vile and disturbed. The sooner the Invocator is online, the better.

cstorms.2295.a.psionic_gestalt.zh: 他们一致的声音仍在痛苦地哀号。
cstorms.2295.a.psionic_gestalt.en: Their unified voices still wail in anguish.

cstorms.230.b.hive.zh: 真是种奇怪的个人主义娱乐形式。
cstorms.230.b.hive.en: A curiously individualistic form of entertainment.

cstorms.230.b.machine.zh: 这就是有机体的戏剧吗。

cstorms.230.desc.zh:
另一条广播也标记上了极有价值。尽管这是一部戏剧性的作品，但也为我们的调查提供了一些相关的背景信息：

阿克塔缅·瑞万
我注意到你昨晚又拜访了恩图拉·萨曼。我还以为你为了我们的爱而抛弃了他们。

因内尔卡·乌泰
我向您保证，这只是一次礼节性的拜访。要知道我只忠于您一人！

阿克塔缅·瑞万
这不过是你的花言巧语，但你的思想却告诉我了截然不同的事情。

因内尔卡·乌泰
您也是如此！

阿克塔缅·瑞万
没错，正是如此！我恰在昨晚发现了自己的灵能天赋！我本以为这是对我们最深刻感情的愉快探索，结果却变成了绝望！你的思想中潜藏着背叛！

因内尔卡·乌泰
您不理解！我的心，我无法控制它。我必须认为这条路是正确的。哦，瑞万，要是您新获得的灵能天赋能让您读懂我的心而不是我的思想就好了！
cstorms.230.desc.en:
Another broadcast has been flagged as noteworthy. Although clearly a dramatic work, it does provide us with some useful context for our investigations:

akTamian Riwan
It has come to my attention that you visited enTulla Saman again last night. I thought you had forsaken them in favor of our love?

inElka Utae
I assure you, it was merely a courteous visit. Know that I am committed to you and no one else!

akTamian Riwan
That is what your mouth says, but your mind! It tells me something else. Something different.

inElka Utae
No, not you too!

akTamian Riwan
Yes, I too! I discovered my psionic gifts just last night! And what I imagined would be a joyful exploration of our deepest feelings became one of despair! The treason in your thoughts!

inElka Utae
You don't understand! My mind, I cannot help it. I cannot help but see this path as rational. Oh Riwan, if only your new psionic gifts allowed you to read my heart instead of my mind!

cstorms.2300.b.psionic.zh: 没有什么比牺牲更高尚。
cstorms.2300.b.psionic.en: Nothing more noble than a sacrifice.

cstorms.2300.desc.zh:
我们一直在努力解锁$building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$的最后一个区段。与此同时，我们从较下层的实验室又收到了一份令人困惑的报告。阿达卡利亚科学家们声称，在每一个人甚至每一台有知觉的机器里都有一种闪耀的力量。受到宇宙风暴的启发，他们将这种力量称为“内心风暴”：这是一种驱使所有感性生命的欲望和力量的强大漩涡。通过使内心风暴经受极端的经历，可以释放出巨大的力量。

在他作为囚徒的那段时间里，阿拉塔·蓝迪尔是第一个发现这种效应的人。作为一名科学家，他说服崇高司令部资助对他在庆典学院的进一步试验。然而这些日志并没有告诉我们蓝迪尔到底发生了什么事，我们只能从舰队坟场中发生的事件得知，他的最终命运是不幸的。

随后的报告提到了一种“更有效”的释放内心风暴的方式。这种方法不需要极端的身体虐待，而是依赖于受害者内心不可避免的致命恐惧。为了在大范围内发挥初步作用，公约计划通过其庞大的宣传站网络发出一个信号。
cstorms.2300.desc.en:
We have been hard at work unlocking the last section of the $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$. Meanwhile, a baffling report has reached us from the lower laboratories. The adAkkaria scientists claimed that in each and every being, perhaps even within sentient machines, a spark exists. Inspired by the onset of cosmic storms, they dubbed this power the 'Inner Storm': a maelstrom of desire and potency that drives all sentient life. By subjecting the Inner Storm to extreme experiences, great power could be unleashed.

During his time as a prisoner of war, alAtta Landeer had been the first to discover this effect. As a scientist, he convinced Exalted Command to fund further trials on Celebration. While the logs do not tell us what happened to Landeer, we know from the events in the naval graveyard that his ultimate fate was an unfortunate one.

Subsequent reports refer to a 'more efficient' way of unleashing the Inner Storm. A means that did not require extreme physical cruelty, but relied instead on the invocation of inescapable and lethal terror inside the victim. To initialize the effect on a vast scale, the Convention planned to issue a signal through their sprawling network of propaganda stations.

cstorms.2300.desc.psionic.zh:
我们成功地记录下了观测台上的灵能低语：

求求你放我走吧，我是一位正直的公民！
我只梦想着无尽的风暴。它在召唤着我。
我不明白。我们出色地完成了所有任务，为什么还要这么对待我们
我们每个人内心都有一种力量。他们想要利用这种力量。我们不能让他们得逞。
住口，他们这么做是为了拯救仁善公约。我们必须服从。
卫星在对我低语。我的意识现在可以跨越星系。
我看到他们设计了某种东西。它能在任何地方对任何人造成伤害。
只要满足他们我们就会得救的！
你不明白，他们会这样对我们，他们就也会这样对所有人。
我们可以释放自己。
但这意味着我们就……
他们无论如何都会杀了我们。等那东西能用了，他们就会把我们都杀了。
我很害怕，我不想死。我想活下去。拜托了。
最后阶段在向我说话。他们想知道我们是否同意。
cstorms.2300.desc.psionic.en:
We have succeeded in recording the psionic whispers of the observation decks:

Get me out of here, please, I was an upstanding citizen!
My dreams now are nothing but an endless storm. It calls to me.
I don't understand. We excelled at our tasks - why are they doing this to us?
Inside all of us lies a power. They want to exploit that power. We mustn't give it to them.
Nonsense, they're doing this to save the Benevolent Convention. We must comply.
The satellites whisper to me. I can reach my mind now across the galaxy.
I saw they designed something. Something that could do this to anyone, anywhere.
 We will be saved, just give them what they want!
You don't understand, if they do this to us, they'll do it to everyone.
We could unleash ourselves.
But that means we'll...
They'll kill us anyway. Once that Thing is operable. They'll kill us all.
I'm scared, I don't want to die. I want to live. Please.
The Final Phase is speaking to me. They want to know if we agree.

cstorms.235.a.en: We will await your future findings.

cstorms.235.desc.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]也翻译了几条新闻。他们认为这几条播报非常值得关注：

从哈利俄斯星系发回的报告呈现出越来越可怕的画面。懦弱的索尔法尼当局在恩伊普萨尔地点伏击了我们勇敢的启蒙军！尽管如此，我们的最高领袖指出，这一进程将不会中断。他说：“我们的恩主并没有放弃我们。我们也不能丢下任何发展中文明。”

也有传言称，邪恶的野蛮当局和宇联代表之间可能存在合作。然而，宇联的大使否认星际共同体与任何野蛮压迫者进行了沟通，并表示这是我们最高领袖的又一个“方便偏执”的例子。

但无论有没有强大的盟友，索尔法尼启蒙进程都处于危急状态。要扭转这种局面并不容易，但是-

不幸的是，广播的其余部分损坏太严重，无法破译。我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]已经创建了数据库的副本。希望随着时间的推移，我们能从这个被遗忘已久的文明中恢复出更多的信息。
cstorms.235.desc.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetLinguists] have also translated several news items. They believe this broadcast in particular is worth paying attention to:

Reports coming in from the Haliios system draw an increasingly dire picture. The cowardly Solphani authority ambushed our brave Enlightenment Forces at Location enYpsal! Nevertheless, our Exalted Leadership stated that the Process will not be interrupted. As quoted: 'Our Patrons didn't give up on us. And neither shall we leave any underdeveloped civilisation behind'.

Rumors have also surfaced of a possible collaboration between the wicked barbarian authorities and representatives of UniCom. UniCom's ambassador however denies the interstellar community communicated with any of the barbarian oppressors and states this is yet another instance of 'convenient paranoia' from our Exalted Leadership.

But with or without powerful allies, the Solphani Enlightenment Process is in a critical state. It will not be easy to turn this around, but-

Unfortunately the rest of the broadcast is too corrupted to be deciphered. Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have already created a copy of the database. In time, we hope to recover more information from this long forgotten civilization.

cstorms.2350.a.zh: 你们的名字会被永远铭记的。
cstorms.2350.a.en: May your names be remembered, always.

cstorms.2350.desc.zh:
风暴在自身中间敞开了一个空洞，向我们展示出了风暴召唤器。怪哉，这么一台小小的装置竟招致了如此众多的欲望、冲突和牺牲。它的存在甚至直接覆灭了一个曾经辉煌的帝国。

通过一组简单的命令，我们激活了风暴召唤器的自毁程序。随着爆炸逐渐减弱，碎片散落在整个星系中，风暴开始减弱。随着它被埋葬，覆盖在阿达卡利亚公约母星上的奇怪迷雾也被消失得无影无踪了。

他们漫长的噩梦终于结束了。
cstorms.2350.desc.en:
The Storm created a hole inside itself, revealing to us the Tempest Invocator. It is strange that such a small apparatus had been the object of so much desire, strife, and sacrifice. Its mere existence initiated the downfall of a once majestic empire.

With a simple set of commands, we activated the Tempest Invocator's self-destruct routine. As the explosion faded, and debris was scattered across the system, the Storm began to abate. With it laid to rest, so too was the strange shroud that covered the adAkkaria Convention's homeworld.

Their long nightmare has finally come to an end.

cstorms.2355.desc.zh:
风暴在无力的暴怒中翻腾不息，但它对我们和风暴召唤器无能为力。

我们命令被困在里面的声音为我们打开一条穿过风暴的道路，让我们去攫取公约的最伟大成就。

然而，阿达卡利亚的母星仍旧遥不可及；通往$building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$的所有道路都被永远关闭了。风暴仍在我们的脑海里咆哮不止。

痛苦、愤怒、悲伤又恐惧。
现在整个星系也要感受到了。
cstorms.2355.desc.en:
The Storm writhed and seethed in its impotent rage, yet it could do no harm to us or the Tempest Invocator.

We commanded the voices trapped within to provide us a way through the maelstrom and claimed the Convention's greatest achievement as our own.

The adAkkaria homeworld remained unobtainable, however; any path towards the $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$ is now closed off forever. But the words of the Storm's bellowing remained in our minds.

Pain, rage, grief and fear.
The galaxy shall learn them too.

cstorms.2365.a.zh: 立刻学习这些新知识。小心地来！
cstorms.2365.a.en: Engage with this new knowledge. Gently!

cstorms.2365.a.tt.zh:
—在经历风暴时100£pop£人口获得$Name_Storm_Fused$特质的几率翻为四倍。
 —每20年有小概率让100£pop£人口死亡并变成一场风暴。
cstorms.2365.a.tt.en:
- Chance of 100 £pop£ Pops gaining the $Name_Storm_Fused$ trait during a storm quadrupled.
 - Every 20 years there is a small chance that 100 £pop£ Pops die and become a storm.

cstorms.245.desc.zh:
[planet_windswept_fates.System.GetName]星系中席卷而过的宇宙风暴意外地在[planet_windswept_fates.GetName]让一处可能的考古遗址重见天日。

对[planet_windswept_fates.GetName]的初步扫描表明，它的大气层极其不稳定，在巨大的行星风暴主宰着一切。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]从来没有预料到在这样一个星球上会有文明的遗迹，相信我们可以从调查中学到很多东西。
cstorms.245.desc.en:
The passing of a cosmic storm in the [planet_windswept_fates.System.GetName] system has uncovered a site of possible archeological significance on [planet_windswept_fates.GetName].

Preliminary scans of [planet_windswept_fates.GetName] indicate a devastatingly unstable atmosphere where vast planetary storms dominate the landscape. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] would never have expected remnants of a civilization on a world like this and believe we could learn much from investigating.

cstorms.305.desc.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

那支舰队连一战的机会都没有。还有谁？
cstorms.305.desc.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

That fleet never had any fighting chance. Who dares challenge us next?

cstorms.310.desc.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

这个星系可以给我们这么多！永远不会无聊，永远也不用停步。继续下一个挑战！
cstorms.310.desc.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

The galaxy has so much to offer! There's never a dull moment, and there's no sense stopping now. Onward to the next challenge!

cstorms.3100.desc.zh:
[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上自然发生的风暴向我们展现了大自然的洪荒之力——既有暴风雨的惊心动魄，也有毁灭之路通向的新生。

最近，全球各地的气象站都发现了一个不寻常的现象：一组超级风暴网络即将席卷全球。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]称之为“正义的机缘巧合”。这些罕见的风暴创造了完美的条件来让我们见证一些最激进的事情。
cstorms.3100.desc.en:
Naturally occurring storms on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] have shown us the awe-inspiring power of nature - both the thrilling intensity of the tempest and the renewal that follows its path of destruction.

Recently, weather stations across the planet have detected an extraordinary phenomenon: a network of superstorms poised to sweep across the world.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] call it 'righteous serendipity.' These rare tempests create the perfect conditions to witness something truly radical.

cstorms.3100.desc.nomad.zh:
自然发生的风暴向我们展示了大自然令人敬畏的力量——既有暴风雨那令人胆战心惊的剧烈，也有随之而来的万物新生。

最近，方舟舰的传感器在周围的虚空中检测到一种非同寻常的现象：一个超级风暴网络即将在该星系中爆发。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]将其称为“正义的机缘”。这些罕见的暴风雨创造了完美的条件，让我们得以见证某种真正彻底的变革。
cstorms.3100.desc.nomad.en:
Naturally occurring storms have shown us the awe-inspiring power of nature - both the thrilling intensity of the tempest and the renewal that follows in its wake.

Recently, the arkship's sensors detected an extraordinary phenomenon in the surrounding void: a network of superstorms poised to break across this very system.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] call it 'righteous serendipity.' These rare tempests create the perfect conditions to witness something truly radical.

cstorms.3105.a.tt.zh:
首都行星上有风暴吸引建筑：
$situation_speed_tt$：+10%

首都恒星系空间站上有$sm_storm_attraction_computer$：
$situation_speed_tt$：+10%
cstorms.3105.a.tt.en:
A storm attraction building on the capital planet:
$situation_speed_tt$: +10%

A $sm_storm_attraction_computer$ in the capital system station:
$situation_speed_tt$: +10%

cstorms.3105.a.tt.nomad.zh:
将方舟舰留在[stormfall_system.GetName]恒星系中，以应对正在聚集的风暴：
$situation_speed_tt$：+10%
cstorms.3105.a.tt.nomad.en:
Keep the arkship in the [stormfall_system.GetName] system to tend the gathering storm:
$situation_speed_tt$: +10%

cstorms.3105.desc.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现了风暴操纵的秘密。风暴能量预测已经突破了有史以来的一切记录。我们即将经受考验，并证明我们是最值得的。

特殊的建筑可以作为提高风暴的协调中心。[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上提升风暴的吸引力的建筑将加速我们向最终风暴的发展进程。
cstorms.3105.desc.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered the secrets of storm manipulation. The storm power projections are off the charts and we're all here for it. We will be tested and found most worthy.

Special buildings can serve as coordination centers for raising storms. A building on [owner.capital_scope.GetName] that increases storm attraction will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.

cstorms.3105.desc.nomad.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]已经揭开了操控风暴的奥秘。预测显示，风暴的力量将突破极限，而我们正是为此齐聚于此。我们将接受考验，并被证明是最为称职之人。

只要让方舟舰稳定驻留在这个星系中，并悉心培育正在汇聚的风暴，我们就能加速迈向终极风暴。
cstorms.3105.desc.nomad.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered the secrets of storm manipulation. The storm power projections are off the charts and we're all here for it. We will be tested and found most worthy.

By holding the arkship steady in this system and tending the gathering tempest, we will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.

cstorms.3110.desc.hive.zh:
我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是我们尚未决定哪一种风暴是最为壮观的。

$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$
cstorms.3110.desc.hive.en:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we have yet to decide which storm type is the most glorious.

$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$

cstorms.3110.desc.machine.zh:
我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是在试图确定哪种风暴类型是最为壮观时，我们的价值判断进程陷入了递归循环。

$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$
cstorms.3110.desc.machine.en:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But our value judgment processes are stuck in recursive loops trying to determine which storm type is the most glorious.

$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$

cstorms.3110.desc.nomad.zh:
我们已经学会如何启动方舟舰周围狂暴的振荡，并将其塑造成终极体验。但我们必须决定哪种风暴类型最为壮观。

通过将原始能量引入周围的风暴，我们可以创造出形成电暴的条件。

重新调整作用于方舟船体的磁场方向，或许能引发磁暴。

最后，通过逆转我们周围空间中的超光速粒子极性，场的变化可以产生重力风暴。
cstorms.3110.desc.nomad.en:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations surrounding the arkship, shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we must decide which storm type is the most glorious.

By channeling raw power into the surrounding storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Reorienting the magnetic fields that play across the arkship's hull could give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity in the space around us, field changes can produce gravity storms.

cstorms.3110.desc.regular.zh:
我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是我们必须决定哪一种风暴是最为壮观的。

$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$
cstorms.3110.desc.regular.en:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we must decide which storm type is the most glorious.

$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$

cstorms.3130.desc.electric.zh:
天雷滚滚，电闪嘶鸣！

这些强大的放电过程不仅使行星表面带上电荷，而且也让我们感受到了真正的兴奋！虽然农业将遭受电力风暴的影响，但发电的潜力是不可否认的。
cstorms.3130.desc.electric.en:
The sky rumbles. Lightning sizzles all around us!

Not only have these powerful discharges electrified the planet's surface, but they've left us truly amped! While farming will suffer from Electrical Storms, the potential for energy generation is undeniable.

cstorms.3130.desc.electric.nomad.zh:
虚空噼啪作响，闪电划过方舟舰的船体！

这些强大的放电让我们的船员真正振奋起来。虽然我们的水培系统将遭受电磁风暴的破坏，但其发电潜力不容置疑。
cstorms.3130.desc.electric.nomad.en:
The void crackles. Lightning sizzles across the arkship's hull!

These powerful discharges have left our crew truly amped. While our hydroponics will suffer from the electrical storms, the potential for energy generation is undeniable.

cstorms.3130.desc.gravity.zh:
简单的运动在如今也是如此令人感到前所未有地兴奋！重力在难以察觉的瞬间增大减小。

分散在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]各地的粒子操作站逆转了快子的极性，将它们聚焦成噼啪作响的能量球。当光球球迅速消失时——[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信它们被送回了过去——引力波在各个方向荡漾。

由此产生的波动将使行星表面作业变得困难，但可以改善促进在轨空间站的岗位。
cstorms.3130.desc.gravity.en:
Never before has simple movement around been so exhilarating! Gravity increases and decreases without a moment's notice.

Particle manipulation sites scattered across [owner.capital_scope.GetName] reversed the polarity of tachyons, which focused them into crackling balls of energy. As the orbs quickly vanished - [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe they were sent backward in time - gravity waves rippled in all directions.

The resulting fluctuations will make working on the planet's surface harder, but could improve jobs on orbiting stations.

cstorms.3130.desc.gravity.nomad.zh:
从未有过，仅仅穿行于各层甲板之间就如此惊心动魄！重力在毫无预兆的情况下时强时弱。

方舟舰各处的场发射器逆转了快子的极性，将其聚焦成噼啪作响的能量球。随着这些能量球迅速消失——[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] 认为它们被送回了过去——引力波向四面八方荡漾开来。

由此产生的波动会让舰上的工作更加困难，但也可能提高轨道空间站的工作效率。
cstorms.3130.desc.gravity.nomad.en:
Never before has simple movement through the decks been so exhilarating! Gravity swells and fades without a moment's notice.

Field emitters across the arkship reversed the polarity of tachyons, focusing them into crackling balls of energy. As the orbs quickly vanished - [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe they were sent backward in time - gravity waves rippled in all directions.

The resulting fluctuations will make work aboard harder, but could improve jobs on orbiting stations.

cstorms.3130.desc.magnetic.zh:
[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的磁场剧烈扭曲着，罗盘也随之狂乱起舞。

通过钻穿我们母星的地壳，我们将磁化物质直接注入地核，自然风暴放大了由此产生的磁场波动。这将妨碍能源生产，但会改善对新矿藏的探测。
cstorms.3130.desc.magnetic.en:
Compasses spin wildly as the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] contorts itself.

By boring through the crust of our homeworld, we were able to inject magnetized matter directly into the core, and the natural storms amplified the resulting field fluctuations. This will hamper energy generation, but improve the detection of new mineral deposits.

cstorms.3130.desc.magnetic.nomad.zh:
方舟舰周围的磁场剧烈扭曲，舰上每一个罗盘都在疯狂旋转。

通过向周围的风暴中排放磁化物质，我们放大了其磁场波动。这会妨碍能源生产，但也能提高发现新矿物的几率。
cstorms.3130.desc.magnetic.nomad.en:
Every compass aboard spins wildly as the magnetic fields around the arkship contort themselves.

By venting magnetized matter into the surrounding storms, we amplified their field fluctuations. This will hamper energy generation, but improve the detection of new mineral deposits.

cstorms.3140.desc.electric.zh:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场$electric_storm$，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

引入特定的矿物将会增强风暴的磁场共振，而利用合金则会将其变为一个重力井。
cstorms.3140.desc.electric.en:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an $electric_storm$, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.

cstorms.3140.desc.gravity.zh:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场$gravity_storm$，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

引入特定的矿物将会增强风暴的磁场共振，而充能恒星将会增强风暴的电力潜能。
cstorms.3140.desc.gravity.en:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an $gravity_storm$, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while charging our sun would instead amplify the storm's electric potential.

cstorms.3140.desc.magnetic.zh:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场$magnetic_storm$，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

充能恒星将会增强风暴的电力潜能，而利用合金则会将其变为一个重力井。
cstorms.3140.desc.magnetic.en:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an $magnetic_storm$, or we create something new and exciting.

Charging our sun would amplify the storm's electric potential, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.

cstorms.315.desc.gestalt.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

我们感觉充满了喜悦。宇宙风暴带来了全新档次的刺激。
cstorms.315.desc.gestalt.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

We feel filled with exultation. The cosmic storms bring excitement to a whole new level.

cstorms.315.desc.normal.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

我们的风暴骑士发回的报告中只有喜悦的欢呼声。宇宙风暴是一种全新档次的刺激！
cstorms.315.desc.normal.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

Our Storm Rider reported back with nothing but exultant cheers. The cosmic storms are a whole new level of thrill!

cstorms.3160.a.tt.electric.en: The storm left behind electrified $d_buzzing_plains$ on [owner.capital_scope.GetName].

cstorms.3160.a.tt.electric.nomad.zh: 我们已为方舟舰装配了$d_stormfall_electric$。
cstorms.3160.a.tt.electric.nomad.en: We have fitted the arkship with a $d_stormfall_electric$.

cstorms.3160.a.tt.gravity.nomad.zh: 我们已经为方舟舰装配了$d_stormfall_gravity$。
cstorms.3160.a.tt.gravity.nomad.en: We have fitted the arkship with a $d_stormfall_gravity$.

cstorms.3160.a.tt.magnetic.en: The storm left behind new $d_geothermal_vent$ on [owner.capital_scope.GetName].

cstorms.3160.a.tt.magnetic.nomad.zh: 我们已为方舟舰装配了$d_stormfall_magnetic$。
cstorms.3160.a.tt.magnetic.nomad.en: We have fitted the arkship with a $d_stormfall_magnetic$.

cstorms.3160.desc.zh:
随着行星风暴的消散，[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上又出现了一个新的长期特征。风暴又一次带来了新生的机遇。

虽然这场局部风暴令人振奋，但是我们也只能畅想着一场真正的宇宙风暴的可能性。为什么它要花这么长时间？
cstorms.3160.desc.en:
When the planetary storm dispersed, a new lasting feature appeared on [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Once again a storm has brought about change and rebirth.

As exhilarating as this local storm was, we can only imagine the possibilities of a true cosmic storm. Why does it take so long?

cstorms.3160.desc.nomad.zh:
风暴消散后，在方舟舰本身留下了永久的印记。风暴再次带来了改变与新生。

尽管这一切令人振奋，我们也只能想象真正的宇宙风暴会带来怎样的可能性。为什么它迟迟不来？
cstorms.3160.desc.nomad.en:
When the storm dispersed, it left a lasting mark upon the arkship itself. Once again a storm has brought about change and rebirth.

As exhilarating as this was, we can only imagine the possibilities of a true cosmic storm. Why does it take so long?

cstorms.3170.a.tt.zh: 科学家[event_target:storm_scientist.GetName]暂时失踪，并有死亡的风险。
cstorms.3170.a.tt.en: Scientist [event_target:storm_scientist.GetName] is temporarily lost and at risk of death.

cstorms.3170.b.tt.zh: 指挥官[event_target:storm_commander.GetName]暂时失踪，并有死亡的风险。
cstorms.3170.b.tt.en: Commander [event_target:storm_commander.GetName] is temporarily lost and at risk of death.

cstorms.3170.desc.none.zh:
我们现在能做的只有坐等宇宙风暴成型。

这种等待让人心急如焚，但也会让回报来得更猛烈一些。
cstorms.3170.desc.none.en:
All we can do now is wait for the cosmic storm to take shape.

The anticipation is almost unbearable, but will make the payoff even greater.

cstorms.3190.a.failure.tt.zh: 我们的领袖光荣地离开了人世。
cstorms.3190.a.failure.tt.en: Our leader went out in a blaze of glory.

cstorms.3190.desc.failure.zh:
$cstorms.3190.desc.intro$我们的领袖迷失在风暴中，但这是多么好的出路！

我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
cstorms.3190.desc.failure.en:
$cstorms.3190.desc.intro$ Our leader was lost in the storm, but what a way to go out!

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

cstorms.3190.desc.success.zh:
$cstorms.3190.desc.intro$我们的领袖穿越风暴，激起了一阵狂热的兴奋。

我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
cstorms.3190.desc.success.en:
$cstorms.3190.desc.intro$ Our leader riding out through the storm has whipped up a frenzy of excitement.

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

cstorms.3190.desc.wait.zh:
$cstorms.3190.desc.intro$我们已经等待了太久，但这一天终于到了。

我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
cstorms.3190.desc.wait.en:
$cstorms.3190.desc.intro$ We have waited long, but the day is finally here.

We did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

cstorms.320.desc.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

钻研远古的秘密、发掘埋藏的宝藏总是这么令人兴奋。谁知道外面的世界还有什么等着我们去发现呢?
cstorms.320.desc.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

Delving into ancient secrets and unearthing buried treasure is always a thrill. Who knows what's still out there, just waiting to be found?

cstorms.3205.gestalt.zh:
宇宙的振动消失了，一如既往的壮举却没有像往常一般唤起人们的兴奋。我们毫无疑问完成了难以置信的事情，但人们都感到缺少了一些东西。

我们被这样的问题所困扰着：我们真的知道自己是谁吗？我们的光辉岁月已经过去了吗？作为一个集体，我们有责任成为最好的自己。

焦虑是真实存在的，现在是采取行动的时候了。为了重新开始，我们回到起点：制定一系列挑战，以最大限度激发肾上腺素！
cstorms.3205.gestalt.en:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing.

We are plagued by questions: do we truly know who we are? Are our glory days behind us? As a collective, we have a responsibility to become the best version of ourselves.

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!

cstorms.3205.normal.zh:
宇宙的振动消失了，一如既往的壮举却没有像往常一般唤起人们的兴奋。我们毫无疑问完成了难以置信的事情，但人们都感到缺少了一些东西。我们祖先的成就，从水平和野心上都是传奇，向身后的我们投下了长长的阴影。

“这些斗争是最存在主义的！”我们的一位顶尖人士最近写道。“我们是在穿越了虚空之后，让自己陷入了空虚之中？”

焦虑是真实存在的，现在是采取行动的时候了。为了重新开始，我们回到起点：制定一系列挑战，以最大限度激发肾上腺素！
cstorms.3205.normal.en:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing. The achievements of our ancestors, legendary in their scope and ambition, cast a long shadow.

"These struggles are most existential!" one of our top minds recently wrote. "By traversing the void, have we opened a void in ourselves?"

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!

cstorms.3205.tooltip.zh: 在情报日志查阅过往的挑战。
cstorms.3205.tooltip.en: Discover the challenges of the past in the Situation Log.

cstorms.3215.desc.zh:
$cstorms.3215.intro$

就像我们的杰出先烈们一样，我们超越了自己的极限。

甚至，由于与自然的狂怒抗衡，我们还获得了对自身存在价值的难以置信的洞见。
cstorms.3215.desc.en:
$cstorms.3215.intro$

Like the most excellent pioneers of old, we have pushed ourselves beyond our limits.

Even better, due to our engagement with nature's fury, we have gained incredible insight into the meaning of our existence.

cstorms.3220.desc.zh:
我们的人民永无止境地追求刺激。每天我们都会发现不可思议的情景，面临更大的挑战，但[ruler.GetRegnalName]觉得我们还能更进一步：

“宇宙风暴的核心唯有潜能；那是真正的、最尖锐的前沿。它尖锐到足以斩断现状，释放出一生难得一次的快感。”

挑起一场真正史诗级风暴的时机已到，这将会是一场混乱的狂欢：浩宇风暴。现在只剩下两个小细节：一是要进行最后的研究，以敲定如何触发完美风暴，二是星系的其他人对我们是否应该这么做有什么看法。

实现这样的东西肯定会激起一些怨恨的。
cstorms.3220.desc.en:
Our people will never stop looking for a thrill. Every day we discover incredible situations and face greater challenges, but [ruler.GetRegnalName] thinks we can go even further:

"The core of a cosmic storm is pure potential; the true, bleeding edge. An edge sharp enough to sever the status-quo and unleash the rush of a lifetime."

The time is ripe to provoke a storm of truly epic proportions, a nexus of joyous pandemonium: The Big One. Only two minor details remain: a final study to determine exactly how to invoke the perfect storm, and the opinion of the rest of the galaxy should we choose to do so.

Bringing something like this into being is sure to stir up some resentment.

cstorms.3222.b.en: We need to save up some resources.

cstorms.3222.desc.zh:
暗物质独一无二的性质使其成为浩宇风暴的完美导火索。我们将向环绕风暴中心的太空织构注入这种难以捉摸的物质，等待风暴的第一波涟漪出现。

然而，这件事已经引起了多余的关注：邻国们开始抗议了。“不是谁都跟我们一样兴高采烈地随风逐浪，”我们一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]埋怨道。
cstorms.3222.desc.en:
The unique properties of Dark Matter make it the perfect thing to stir up The Big One. We will inject this elusive material into the spatial fabric surrounding the storm's heart and wait for the first ripples of the storm to appear.

However, this has already attracted some unwanted attention: our neighbors have begun to protest. "Not everyone is as stoked as us to ride this particular wave," complained one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural].

cstorms.3224.desc.zh:
难以置信！即将来临的风暴的萌动已经能感觉到了。我们[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]的还在努力着，但使我们离引发浩宇风暴又近了一步。

然而，我们的邻国并不太满意。他们声称我们在胡搞我们不可能理解的力量，这已经影响了我们间的关系。
cstorms.3224.desc.en:
Incredible! The nascent vibrations of the coming storm are already being felt. The work of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] is ongoing, but we are now one step closer to summoning The Big One.

However, our neighbors are less pleased. They claim we're meddling with powers we cannot possibly comprehend, and this has already affected our relations.

cstorms.3225.desc.zh:
数据已然明晰：这场风暴可谓种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。既是如此，若是我们给风暴饲喂合适类型的资源，它就能拥有任何一种风暴的特性，并达到史诗般的规模。

星系的住民们再次表达了担忧，但世纪之旅已指日可待。该穷尽国力饲育风暴了！
cstorms.3225.desc.en:
The data is clear: whatever we put into this storm, something similar will come out of it. Ergo, if we feed it the right type of resources, then it will take on properties - and epic proportions- of every type of storm.

The people of the galaxy continue to express concern, but the ride of the century is just waiting to be born. Let us feed it what we have!

cstorms.3226.desc.zh: 若是我们想要创造一场史诗般的风暴，就必须为这场初生的风暴提供种种养分。这项惊人的壮举需要我们手头上一组特定的资源。
cstorms.3226.desc.en: We must provide the nascent storm a wide variety of nourishment if we wish to create a storm of epic proportions. This amazing feat requires a specific sampling of resources at our disposal.

cstorms.3227.a.zh: 浩宇风暴是我们的终极宿命！
cstorms.3227.a.en: The Big One is our ultimate destiny!

cstorms.3227.b.zh: 算了，我们可以做得更好！
cstorms.3227.b.en: No, we are better than this!

cstorms.3227.desc.zh:
兴奋之情溢于言表。前方的道路越发清晰：前进，前进，向着目标前进。让我们与宇宙的狂热融为一体！万事俱备，只需稍加一把推手，浩宇风暴就要来临。

我们的邻国已然怒不可遏，声称我们所谓的“$nexus_storm$”将对星系造成巨大的破坏。但我们真要让这些扫兴的家伙毁掉这一史诗般的项目吗？抉择的时刻到了。
cstorms.3227.desc.en:
The excitement is palpable. The path ahead grows clear: push further, push harder, push through. Let us become one with cosmic frenzy itself! Everything is now ready for the Big One. We just need to give one small push.
