Our neighbors are already beyond livid, claiming that our so-called '$nexus_storm$' will wreak havoc on the galaxy. But are we really going to let these killjoys derail a project of such epic proportions? The time to choose is now.

cstorms.3230.desc.zh:
我们站在新体验的悬崖边。终极灾难的时刻到了。我们的风暴骑士无所畏惧，从没有他们不肯接受的挑战。让星系听见我们的名字吧！

让整个星系开开眼界！
cstorms.3230.desc.en:
Here we are - at the precipice of a new experience. The time of ultimate calamity has arrived. There is nothing our Storm Riders won't face. No challenge we will ever deny.

Let the galaxy witness!

cstorms.3235.desc.zh:
我们学到了很多。终于知道星系不是玩物，而是一场有待体验的冒险。

[ruler.GetRegnalName]说得好：“人生从不缺刺激。我们永远不会停止追求下一个挑战，但我们必须怀着敬意。与星系及其居民和谐共处是我们的准则。我们选择了这么做，这才是我们真正的意义所在。”
cstorms.3235.desc.en:
We have learned much. Now we understand that the galaxy is not a toy to be played with, but an adventure to be experienced.

[ruler.GetRegnalName] said it best: "In this life, there are no shortages of thrills. We'll never stop seeking the next challenge, but we must do so with respect. This is what we have chosen. This is who we are truly meant to be.

cstorms.325.desc.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

这场风暴径直穿过了他们的空间，在同等程度上传播了兴奋和混沌！为邻居们提供了如此令人难以置信的体验，这下我们可以放心了。

他们现在可能不感激，但最终会感谢我们的。
cstorms.325.desc.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

That storm tore right through their space, spreading thrills and disarray in equal measure! We can rest easy knowing we provided our neighbors with such an incredible experience

They may not appreciate it now, but they'll thank us eventually.

cstorms.330.desc.gestalt.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

强大的风暴呼唤我们的一部分加入它的欢腾肆虐。从未有过对失去节点感觉如此有意义和充满活力！这一史诗般的经历将在未来许多年里定义我们是谁。
cstorms.330.desc.gestalt.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

The great storm has called a part of ourself to join it in jubilant carnage. Losing a node has never felt so meaningful and invigorating! This epic experience will define our species for many years to come.

cstorms.330.desc.normal.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

强大的风暴呼唤他的名字，他也欣喜地回应。致敬风暴骑士，你是绝对的传奇！愿你通往彼岸的旅程如同你的退场一样壮丽。
cstorms.330.desc.normal.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

The great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend! May your journey to the great beyond be as epic as your exit.

cstorms.331.desc.gestalt.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

大风暴召唤了我们的一部分加入它的欢腾屠杀。从来没有一次近乎失去一个节点的感觉是如此地有意义，令我们充满活力！这一史诗般的经历将在未来的日子里告诉我们自己是谁。
cstorms.331.desc.gestalt.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

The great storm has called a part of ourself to join it in jubilant carnage. Nearly losing a node has never felt so meaningful and invigorating! This epic experience will define our species for many years to come.

cstorms.331.desc.normal.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

大风暴呼唤着他，他也欢欣鼓舞地回应着。向风暴骑士致敬，您绝对是个传奇!
cstorms.331.desc.normal.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

The great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend!

cstorms.5020.desc.zh:
我们发现这颗彗星实际上是一个巨大的巢穴，里面充斥着微小的昆虫。彗尾也不是冰雾，而是巢穴内部化学反应所排放的废气。

巢穴的外壳由死亡的昆虫组成，这使得内部生的物免受太空恶劣环境的影响。我们还发现了几种依附于巢穴生活的真菌。巢穴中存在一种复杂的共生关系，真菌依赖排放的废气维生，而昆虫则以真菌为食。
cstorms.5020.desc.en:
The comet was revealed to be a giant nest filled with tiny insects. The tail of the comet is not outgassed ice, but rather exhaust from chemical processes occurring deep inside the hive.

The outer layer of the nest is composed of dead individuals, protecting the living inside from the harsh conditions of space. We've also picked up several types of fungi living in and around the nest. There is a complex symbiosis at work here, with the fungi living off of the exhaust gases and the insects feeding on the fungi.

cstorms.5025.desc.zh:
这是我们始料未及的发现：大脑集群。来自各种物种的湿糊糊的有机处理器官，成百上千个地连接在一起，悬浮在一个气球状的大型胶囊之中。它似乎已经被废弃，在近期的$shroud_storm$消散之后飘浮在深空之中。

胶囊之中有一个惊人的传感器阵列连接在大脑和胶囊之上，此外还有一个通信模块，能够呼叫舰船并发送信息，之前它对我们就是这么做的。

现在看来似乎是这些大脑自己联系了我们，解释了那一连串的信息。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为这个装置的初衷是测试有机体对$shroud_storm$的反应。考虑到这些悬浮大脑内不稳定的残留灵能，尝试与其连接可能会带来危险。
cstorms.5025.desc.en:
We could never have anticipated our discovery: brains. Organic, squishy central processing organs from all sorts of species. Hundreds and hundreds of them, all linked together and suspended inside a large balloon-like capsule. It appears to be derelict, left floating in the depths of space after a recent $shroud_storm$ dissipated.

The capsule contains an incredible array of sensors attached to the brains and the balloon, and there is also a communication module, capable of hailing ships and transmitting information, just as it did to us.

It seems likely that the brains themselves contacted us, explaining the cacophony of messages. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] think the construction was designed to measure organic responses to a $shroud_storm$. Given the unstable psionic residue within these floating minds, attempting to interface them would only lead to disaster.

cstorms.5030.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPluralCapital]报告称这个空间站的大部分是由常见的固定材料建成的，这些物质勉强维持着空间站不至于散架。随着我们深入这座结构，构成空间站的物质从金属合金过渡成了塑料等其他材料。

在空间站的核心处，我们发现了一台机器正在高效运转，它不断地拆解有机原料并将其转化为我们之前见到的东西。

在运行DNA模拟模型后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]只能得出结论，这些原料可能是空间站的前住民。
cstorms.5030.desc.en:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPluralCapital] report that much of this space station is constructed from everyday stationary objects, barely holding it together. Deeper into the structure, the materials transition from metal alloys to plastics and other substances.

Inside the heart of the construct we found a machine, still in the process of efficiently deconstructing organic material and shaping it into the very items encountered so far.

After running a DNA simulation model, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have been forced to conclude that the material likely came from the former inhabitants of this outpost.

cstorms.5030.evopred.zh: 看看我们能发现些什么。
cstorms.5030.evopred.en: See if we can't gain something here.

cstorms.5035.desc.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]汇报了自[from.GetAffectedStormType]过境以来，[From.GetStarName]的聚变反应所发生的奇妙变化。

显然，这个风暴引发了恒星内核某种意想不到的核反应，导致其对流区稳定地释放出[from.GetEarnedResources]。

这些复杂而特殊的反应产生了我们所观察到的这些不寻常的多色闪光。无论如何，在一段时间内这的都会一直是一个值得仔细研究的来源。
cstorms.5035.desc.en:
[root.leader.GetName] reports fascinating changes in [From.GetStarName]'s fusion reactions since the passage of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

It appears that the storm induced unexpected nuclear reactions within the star's core, resulting in a steady release of [from.GetEarnedResources] from its convective zones.

These complex and idiosyncratic reactions are producing the unusual polychromatic flaring we have observed. In any case, it will continue to be a source worthy of close study for some time.

cstorms.5040.desc.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]发现，沉积于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的小行星具有高度不稳定的磁性质，导致它们在恒星系中现有的磁层上发生随机的弹跳。

[root.leader.GetName]通过给每个小行星施加磁场补偿器进行了稳定，使其轨道规范化并使其便于进行资源开采。
cstorms.5040.desc.en:
[root.leader.GetName] discovered that the asteroids deposited in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system possess highly unstable magnetic fields, causing them to ricochet haphazardly off the system's existing magnetospheres.

[root.leader.GetName] stabilized them by adding magnetic compensators to each asteroid, regulating their trajectories and thus making them amenable to resource extraction efforts.

cstorms.505.desc.zh:
在[this.GetAffectedStormType]带来破坏的余波中，我们取得了许多对这些宇宙自然现象的洞见。

通过研究星际气象学，我们可以在未来更好地保护自己。这一全新的研究领域可能将会得出完全驾驭这些风暴的手段。
cstorms.505.desc.en:
In the aftermath of the devastation from the [this.GetAffectedStormType], we have gained some unique insight on these galactic phenomena.

By studying astrometeorology, we can better protect ourselves in the future. This new field of research might eventually yield the means to master these storms.

cstorms.5050.c.genocide.zh: 夺走他们的生命以及货物。

cstorms.5050.desc.zh:
我们已经确定了[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中遇险信号的来源，那一艘严重受损但仍在运作的商船。

乘员声称他们被[from.GetAffectedStormType]撞离了航线很远。风暴也烧毁了他们的引擎，让飞船和里面的东西滞留在我们的空间里。

如果我们能帮忙的话，他们愿意交出一部分货物。
cstorms.5050.desc.en:
We have identified the source of the distress signal in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system as a heavily damaged but still functioning mercantile vessel.

The occupants claim they have been knocked a great distance off course by the [from.GetAffectedStormType]. The storm has also burnt out their engines, leaving the ship and its contents stranded in our space.

They are willing to part with a portion of their cargo if we can help.

cstorms.5060.desc.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系内的异常读数源自一片由[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波所残留下的不寻常的碎片阵列。

这个漂浮的实体是由一团无定形的宇宙污泥在风暴的极端压力下锻造而成。它的无数组成元素形成了一种独特的活性化合物。

对其化学成分的深度研究可以对产生它的条件提供有价值的星际气象学洞见。
cstorms.5060.desc.en:
The erratic sensor readings in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system are derived from an exceptional debris formation left in the wake of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

This drifting entity is an amorphous blob of cosmic sludge, forged in the extreme pressures of the storm. Its innumerable constituent elements have formed a uniquely reactive compound.

Focused study of its chemistry could yield valuable astrometeorological insights into the conditions that produced it.

cstorms.5070.desc.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的物体是一颗古老人造卫星的残骸，上面装有复杂的星际气象探测阵列。我们认为它是伴随着[from.GetAffectedStormType]横跨星系漂星过海而来的。

它已严重损坏无法维修，但中央数据库包含了大量的信息贮藏可以为我们所用。

卫星的其余部分就只能作为废品进行打捞了。
cstorms.5070.desc.en:
The object in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system is the wreckage of an ancient satellite equipped with complex astrometeorological sensor arrays. We believe that it was swept a great distance across the galaxy in the wake of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

Now damaged beyond repair, its central databases contain a vast store of information that we can repurpose for our own needs.

The rest of the satellite is only salvageable as scrap.

cstorms.5080.desc.common.zh: 我们发现，[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的怪异物体其实是一大团来自某种太空生物的有机残留物。由于所有可供识别的特征都被宇宙风暴撕碎了，所以无法对这些生物碎片进行准确分类。
cstorms.5080.desc.common.en: The foreign object in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was discovered to be a large mass of organic remains originating from some type of spaceborne fauna. Having had any identifiable features shredded apart by the cosmic storm, it is impossible to correctly catalog the biological debris.

cstorms.5080.desc.default.zh: [leader.GetName]确信，对该生物遗骸进行更详细的法医分析将揭示更多有关其起源性质的信息，以及[from.GetAffectedStormType]对类似太空生物的影响。
cstorms.5080.desc.default.en: [leader.GetName] is confident that a more detailed forensic analysis of the creature's remains would reveal more information about the nature of its origins and the effects of a [from.GetAffectedStormType] on similar space faring organisms.

cstorms.5080.desc.swarm.zh: 幸运的是，大部分仍可食用。

cstorms.5085.desc.zh:
经过了谨慎的解剖，这团肉块究竟属于什么物种仍是个谜。在风暴中心遭受的巨大破坏使它失去了一切可供识别的特征和遗传标记。

然而，在这项研究的过程中，我们获得了对宇宙风暴组成的洞见，了解了其对外星生物质的破坏性影响。
cstorms.5085.desc.en:
After careful dissection, the original species of this visceral mass remains a mystery. The extraordinary damage taken in the epicenter of the storm has stripped it of any recognizable features or genetic markers.

However, in the process of this study we have gained insight into the composition of Cosmic Storms and their devastating effects on xenobiological matter.

cstorms.5090.c.tt.zh: 向你的['concept_vivarium']中增加3只随机稀有度的$NAME_Tiyanki_Hatchling$
cstorms.5090.c.tt.en: Add 3 $NAME_Tiyanki_Hatchling$ of random rarity to your ['concept_vivarium']

cstorms.5090.desc.common.zh:
[solar_system.GetName]星系内的三只缇扬奇信号经过识别后发现是一伙流离失所、营养不良的幼崽。

$default_storm$将这些幼崽与它们的大群分开，迫使他们自力更生。

它们看来不太可能在幽深的太空中存活太久。我们的传感器显示它们整在试图呼叫鲸群，但没有成功。
cstorms.5090.desc.common.en:
The three Tiyanki signatures in the [solar_system.GetName] system have been identified as a set of displaced and malnourished calves.

The $default_storm$ has separated these calves from their larger pod, leaving them to fend for themselves.

They are unlikely to survive for long in open space. Our sensors show they are attempting to call for their pod but are having no success.

cstorms.5090.desc.default.zh: 我们的通讯系统可以用来增强它们的呼救声，吸引它们的群体进入恒星系。
cstorms.5090.desc.default.en: Our communication systems could be used to boost their cries for help and attract their pod into the system.

cstorms.5090.desc.swarm.zh: 我们可以放大它们呼救的声音，把它们当作诱饵，引来一顿更大的大餐。
cstorms.5090.desc.swarm.en: We could boost their cries for help and use them as bait to draw in a larger feast.

cstorms.5095.desc.common.zh:
缇扬奇的成兽在听到了三只幼崽被放大的叫声后，再度现身在[solar_system.GetName]星系中。

年轻的缇扬奇重新回到了鲸群，现在已经恢复了快乐和健康。

母鲸在我们的科研船附近留下了一大堆物质碎片，似乎是在感谢我们的帮助。令我们惊讶的是，这件奇怪的礼物中包含了好几种可用的材料。
cstorms.5095.desc.common.en:
A Tiyanki cow and bull have both appeared in the [solar_system.GetName] system having heard the amplified cries of the three displaced calves.

The juvenile Tiyanki have been reintegrated back into their pod, and already appear much happier and healthier.

The cow has deposited a large mass of debris near our science vessel, seemingly as some kind of appreciation for our assistance. To our surprise this curious offering contains several usable materials.

cstorms.5095.desc.swarm.zh: 当然，这些大东西才是真正的猎物；我们已经准备好猎杀了。
cstorms.5095.desc.swarm.en: Of course, these larger beasts are the true prize; primed and ready for the slaughter.

cstorms.8000.desc.zh: 过境的宇宙风暴留下的不仅仅是毁灭。在[Planet.GetName]上，它还创造了一个全新的地理特征。
cstorms.8000.desc.en: A passing cosmic storm has left more than mere devastation in its wake. On [Planet.GetName], it has created an entirely new geographical feature.

cstorms.8510.desc.zh: 在一阵灵能风暴中，[from.GetName]被替成了来源不明的[from.GetClassName]。
cstorms.8510.desc.en: In a flurry of psionic activity, [from.GetName] was switched with a [from.GetClassName] from parts unknown.

cstorms.8515.desc.zh: 一股灵能浪潮席卷了[from.GetName]，使其部分人口发生了违背自然法则的改变。整个群体都被重塑了，它们的形态变得奇怪而陌生，仿佛有某种我们无法理解的东西改写了他们的本质。
cstorms.8515.desc.en: A surge of psionic energy has swept through [from.GetName], leaving parts of its population altered in ways that defy natural law. Entire groups have been reshaped, their forms now alien and unfamiliar, as if something beyond our understanding has rewritten their very essence.

cstorms.8520.a.zh: 即使是恒星也未能幸免……
cstorms.8520.a.en: Even the stars are not immune...

cstorms.8520.desc.zh: 一股灵能浪潮重塑了[from.GetName]，时期变成了一颗具有截然不同性质的新恒星。如今，一颗[from.GetClassName]正向[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系投射着它怪异的光，仿佛现实本身被扭曲了一般。
cstorms.8520.desc.en: A surge of psionic energy has remade [from.GetName], transforming it into a star of an entirely new nature. Now, a [from.GetClassName] casts its strange light upon the [from.solar_system.GetName] System, as if reality itself has been altered.

cstorms_tutorial.1.desc.zh: 我们可以根据自身利益来操控某个$default_storm$的移动路线。可以将风暴驱斥远离我方恒星系，或是吸引风暴进而利用其正面效果。
cstorms_tutorial.1.desc.en: We can manipulate the path of a $default_storm$ for our own benefit. Either to deflect them away from our systems, or attract them to utilize their positive effects.

cultist_flagship_poi_desc.zh: 据说神出鬼没的邪教徒旗舰就在这片星系附近游荡。我们必须派遣重火力武装舰队来对付。
cultist_flagship_poi_desc.en: The elusive cultist flagship is believed to be lurking somewhere within this star system. We should dispatch a heavily armed fleet to confront it.

cultist_search_1_poi_desc.zh: 我们在这个星系附近探测到了逃窜的邪教徒飞船的离子轨迹。最好进行大规模搜查。
cultist_search_1_poi_desc.en: We have detected ion trails from fleeing cultist ships in the vicinity of this star system. It should be reconnoitered in force.

cultist_shipyard_poi_desc.zh: 我们终于找到了邪教徒舰船的来源——他们霸占了在[cult_planet.GetStarName]上的远古外星船坞！务必在这些极端分子有机会启动全部产能之前摧毁该太空设施。
cultist_shipyard_poi_desc.en: We have finally identified the source of the cultist ships - some kind of ancient alien shipyard that they have commandeered in the [cult_planet.GetStarName] system! This space installation must be destroyed before the fanatics have a chance to unlock its true potential.

curator_archivist_explanation.zh: 我们将雇佣一位具有$leader_trait_curator$特质的等级5科学官。
curator_archivist_explanation.en: We will hire a Level 5 Scientist with the $leader_trait_curator$ Trait.

curator_guidance_poi_desc.zh: 策展人向我们指出了一个值得探索的恒星系。
curator_guidance_poi_desc.en: The Curators have pointed us towards a system worth exploring.

custodian.101.desc.zh: 随着[LastKilledCountryName]的覆灭，他们作为星海共同体监管人的任期也不复存在了。
custodian.101.desc.en: With the destruction of the [LastKilledCountryName], their Custodianship of the Galactic Community has come to an end.

custodian.11.a.desc.zh: 我们作为星海共同体监管人的任期已经结束。监管人职能终止，我们的特殊权力也解除了，当然我们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
custodian.11.a.desc.en: Our term as the Custodians of the Galactic Community has reached its end. The Custodianship has been terminated and our special powers rescinded, although we have retained our seat on the Galactic Council.

custodian.11.b.desc.zh: 随着他们的任期结束，[former_custodians.GetName]放弃了他们作为星海共同体监管人的地位。他们的特殊权力也废除了，当然他们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
custodian.11.b.desc.en: With their term at an end, the [former_custodians.GetName] has given up their status as the Custodians of the Galactic Community. Their special powers have been rescinded, and they are now considered a regular member of the Galactic Council.

custodian.15.a.zh: 我们已经尽我们所能了。

custodian.15.a.desc.zh: 我们终于摆脱了吃力不讨好的监管人职位！让其他随便什么人去担心这帮忘恩负义的家伙们的未来吧。
custodian.15.a.desc.en: Finally we are rid of the thankless and futile Custodianship! Let someone else worry about the future of this ungrateful galaxy.

custodian.15.b.desc.zh: [former_custodians.GetName]提前结束了他们在星海共同体中的监管人任期。似乎他们并不愿意承担监管人的责任。
custodian.15.b.desc.en: The [former_custodians.GetName] has prematurely ended their term as Custodians of the Galactic Community. It seems the responsibilities of the Custodianship weren't to their liking.

custodian.17.a.desc.zh: 星海参议院里忘恩负义的傻瓜们投票结束我们作为监管人的任期！我们被剥夺了所有的相关职责。
custodian.17.a.desc.en: The ungrateful fools in the Galactic Senate have voted to terminate our Custodianship! We have been stripped of all Community powers that were associated with the office.

custodian.17.b.en: That is the end of that.

custodian.17.b.desc.zh: 在通过突然且充满羞辱的方式剥夺了他们的监管权之后，星海参议院多数投票统一立即将[From.GetName]从星海监管人职位移除。他们被剥夺了星海共同体赋予的特殊权力。
custodian.17.b.desc.en: In a sudden and humiliating end to their Custodianship, the Galactic Senate majority has voted to immediate remove the [From.GetName] from the office of Galactic Custodian. They have been stripped of their special Community powers.

custodian.2.a.zh: 现在我们可以大有作为了。
custodian.2.a.en: Now we can get things done.

custodian.2.a.desc.zh:
终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
custodian.2.a.desc.en:
At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, we have been charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. We have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

custodian.2.b.zh: 让我们看看这样会如何。
custodian.2.b.en: We shall see how this works out.

custodian.2.b.desc.zh:
星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，他们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，[custodian.GetSpeciesName]政府负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。他们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
custodian.2.b.desc.en:
The Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In a ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, they were appointed the official Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, the [custodian.GetSpeciesName] government is now charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. They have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

custodian.30.a.zh: 本星系将会变成一个更加安全的地方。
custodian.30.a.en: The galaxy will become a safer place.

custodian.30.d.zh: 这支可怜的舰队将会被歼灭，直到最后一艘舰船损失殆尽。
custodian.30.d.en: This pathetic fleet will be exterminated to the last ship.

custodian.32.a.zh: 他们的警觉令人肃然起敬。

custodian.32.desc.zh: 由于星海监管人的职位现在空缺，泛星系防卫军设立了一个独立的指挥架构。他们依然致力于保护星海共同体，泛星系防卫军的指挥高层宣誓将继续巡逻成员国的恒星系。
custodian.32.desc.en: With the office of the Galactic Custodian now vacant, the Galactic Defense Force has established an independent command structure. They remain dedicated towards the protection of the Community, and GDF High Command has vowed to maintain their patrols of member systems.

custodian.32.name.zh: 泛星系防卫军暂停行动

custodian.35.desc.zh: 由于我们已经肩负了星海监管人的职责，泛星系防卫军现在被纳入我们的指挥架构。他们等待我们在未来的进一步指示。
custodian.35.desc.en: As we have assumed the office of the Galactic Custodian, the Galactic Defense Force has been folded into our command structure. They will now look to us for future orders.

custodian.35.name.zh: 泛星系防卫军向监管人报告

custodian.35.tooltip.zh: 所有泛星系防卫军下辖的舰队现在受我们指挥。
custodian.35.tooltip.en: All GDF fleets are now under our command.

custodian.40.desc.zh: 依照参议院大多数的表决，泛星系防卫军被解散了。所有现役的泛星系防卫军人员将返回其母国，而防卫军的战舰将在参议院官员的密切监督下拆解，以防止这些战舰落入心有不轨之人的手中。
custodian.40.desc.en: By order of the Senate majority, the Galactic Defense Force has been disbanded. All serving GDF personnel have returned to their home nations, and their warships are being scuttled under the close supervision of Senate officials to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

custodian.51.desc.zh:
星海共同体的可敬成员们……智慧生物同胞们。

星海正格外黑暗。我们面临的生死危机史无前例。为了挺过接下来的猛攻，我们必须如同明天我们将不复存在一般战斗，因为，我们也许真的没有明天了。

在你们选举我们成为星海监管人时，我们宣誓要捍卫星系，拼尽一切来兑现承诺……但这并非一场我们独自能够赢得的战役。我们吁请全体成员国搁置异见，与我们并肩反击[crisis_country.GetName]的进攻！只要齐心协力，我们定能展现星海的完整威力，抵御共同的敌人。
custodian.51.desc.en:
Honorable members of the Galactic Community... fellow sapients.

This is an exceedingly dark time for our galaxy. The existential threat we face is without precedent. To survive the coming onslaught, we must fight like there is no tomorrow, for in truth, that may be the case.

When you elected us as your Galactic Custodians, we swore an oath to defend our galaxy and we will do everything in our power to uphold that promise... but this is not a battle we can win alone. We call on all members to put aside their differences and join us as we strike back at the [crisis_country.GetName]! Together we will show them the full might of our galaxy as it stands united against a common foe!

custodian.51.title.zh: 与星海监管人并肩而战……
custodian.51.title.en: Stand by for the Galactic Custodian...

custodian.53.desc.zh:
星海已四面楚歌！[crisis_country.GetName]盯上了我们的军队，但我们毫无能长时间抵抗的希望！

作为星海的监管人，保护全体共同体成员不受外界的威胁是您应尽的职责，请尽您所能地提供援助吧！
custodian.53.desc.en:
The galaxy is under attack! Our forces have engaged the [crisis_country.GetName], but we have little hope of holding them off for long!

As the Galactic Custodians, it is your duty to defend all Community members from external threats! Please, send all the help you can!

custodianship_ends.en: The [From.GetName] are no longer Custodians of the Galactic Community.

custodianship_starts.en: The [custodian.GetName] are now Custodians of the Galactic Community.

custom_mercenary_admiral_desc.zh: 一位冷酷无情的佣兵战士，在战场上追寻着荣耀和名声。
custom_mercenary_admiral_desc.en: Ruthless mercenary warrior seeking glory and fame on the battlefield.

cyber.100.a.zh: 我们将国有化强化改造产业。
cyber.100.a.en: We will nationalize the augmentation industry.

cyber.100.b.zh: 我们将私有化分发流程。

cyber.100.desc.zh:
$cyber.100.desc.shared$

各大企业提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而政府官员则坚持必须保证由国家来控制这种潜在的技术。
cyber.100.desc.en:
$cyber.100.desc.shared$

Corporations have provided business proposals and sales projections, while government officials argue that access to this potential technology must be guaranteed by the state.

cyber.100.desc.megacorp.zh:
$cyber.100.desc.shared$

各分包商提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而我们的董事会则坚持必须保证这种重要技术在垄断范围之内。
cyber.100.desc.megacorp.en:
$cyber.100.desc.shared$

Sub-contractors have provided business proposals and sales projections for third-party implant production, while our board of directors argues that access to this important technology must remain within our monopoly.

cyber.100.desc.megacorp_unplugged.zh:
$cyber.100.desc.shared_unplugged$

分包商提供了第三方植入体生产的商业提案和销售前景预测，而我公司董事会则坚持这项重要技术的准入必须保持在我们垄断之下。
cyber.100.desc.megacorp_unplugged.en:
$cyber.100.desc.shared_unplugged$

Sub-contractors have provided business proposals and sales projections for third-party implant production, while our board of directors argues that access to this important technology must remain within our monopoly.

cyber.100.desc.unplugged.zh:
$cyber.100.desc.shared_unplugged$

各大企业提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而政府官员则坚持必须保证由国家来控制这种潜在的技术。
cyber.100.desc.unplugged.en:
$cyber.100.desc.shared_unplugged$

Corporations have provided business proposals and sales projections, while government officials argue that access to this potential technology must be guaranteed by the state.

cyber.1005.a.zh: 未改造者们有过属于他们的时代了。
cyber.1005.a.en: The unmodified have had their time.

cyber.1005.a.tt.zh: 鼓励改造运动员们推动创新。
cyber.1005.a.tt.en: Encourage modified players to drive innovation.

cyber.1005.b.zh: 将强化运动员归到单独的联赛中。
cyber.1005.b.en: Relegate enhanced competitors to their own league.

cyber.1005.c.en: Cap the amount of the modified [GetAthletePlural].

cyber.1005.desc.zh:
“[Species.GetName]记录再突破”这样的标题在[Owner.GetAdjective]的体育新闻中已经屡见不鲜了。随着[GetAthletePlural]们竞相使用更新、更复杂的改装来超越彼此，运动能力的极限也在不断被突破。

“强化体育”的粉丝们为这些结果欣喜若狂，但越来越多的铁杆爱好者呼吁应该单独设立强化运动员的项目。还有一些人希望限制参加团体比赛的改造人的数量，让纯天然的[GetAthletePlural]在聚光灯下还能占有一席之地。
cyber.1005.desc.en:
'Another [Species.GetName] Record Broken' - this headline has become commonplace in [Owner.GetAdjective] sporting life. As [GetAthletePlural] race to outdo one another with newer and more sophisticated modifications, the limits of athletic performance are constantly being pushed.

While fans of 'enhanced athletics' are ecstatic with the results, a growing number of hardcore devotees have called for enhanced individuals to be confined to a separate division. A final group instead wants to limit the amount of modified who compete in team events meaning that natural [GetAthletePlural] always have a place in the spotlight.

cyber.1010.b.en: The sky is not for sale!

cyber.1010.desc.zh:
[sky_megacorp.GetName]向我们提供了一个利润丰厚的机遇。他们想为一种叫做“普乐快车”的全新提神饮料打广告。

可以将这种饮料的广告直接投射到我们的公民的视觉植入体中，只要一抬头就能看见。所产生的收入可以用于无数的公众项目。

尽管这种广告具有侵入性，但我们确信这种饮料本身应该是美味无害的。
cyber.1010.desc.en:
The [sky_megacorp.GetName] has offered us a lucrative opportunity. They wish to advertise their latest product, an energizing drink called Plasma Quench.

Ads for the drink will be projected straight into our citizens' ocular implants whenever they happen to glance up at the sky. The revenue generated could be used for any number of civic projects.

Despite the invasive nature of the ads, we have been assured that the beverage itself is delicious, and completely non-toxic.

cyber.1015.a.tt.zh: 围绕[most_populous.GetName]建造无数的巨大广告牌。

cyber.1015.desc.zh:
[sky_megacorp.GetName]又带来了一项新的关于全星系最受欢迎的能量饮料“普乐快车”的提案。鉴于目前对我们改造人口天空视角销售的成功，他们请求在现实世界的其他地方设置更多的广告。

“[most_populous.GetName]就是最佳的广告投放地点！”一位[sky_megacorp.GetName]发言人如是说。毕竟，每个人都应该有机会获得这样令人难以置信的机会，这不是更公平吗？
cyber.1015.desc.en:
The [sky_megacorp.GetName] has returned with a new offer regarding the galaxy's favorite energizing drink, Plasma Quench. Since the sale of our modified people's celestial view worked out so well, they have requested to put up additional advertisements in the physical world as well.

"[most_populous.GetName] is the ideal advertisement location!" declared a [sky_megacorp.GetName] spokesperson. After all, is it not fairer that everyone should have access to such incredible opportunities?

cyber.1030.a.zh: 关停这项产业。这也太危险了。
cyber.1030.a.en: Shut down the industry. It's too dangerous.

cyber.1030.b.tt.zh: 忆痕娱乐会变成一项创收的产业。
cyber.1030.b.tt.en: Engram entertainment will be used as a source of income.

cyber.1030.c.zh: 把持有这种记录的统统抓起来。
cyber.1030.c.en: Jail anyone caught with such recordings.

cyber.1030.c.tt.zh: 记录犯罪行为的个体将被绳之以法。
cyber.1030.c.tt.en: Law enforcement will target those who record criminal behavior.

cyber.1030.d.zh: 听起来太颓废了。我喜欢。

cyber.1030.d.tt.zh: 所有形式的娱乐都会得到国家的认可。
cyber.1030.d.tt.en: All forms of pleasure will be endorsed by the state.

cyber.1030.desc.zh:
有了如此众多能够控制感官和情感体验的植入体，强化改造的个体现在更倾向投身虚拟活动，以此进行娱乐或者逃避现实。虽然忆痕艺术家理论上可以激发出任何情绪，但这种做法却已经出现了一些黑暗的转折。

忆痕俱乐部高价收购那些具有强烈情感体验的自录记忆，例如婚礼、交配仪式、自杀、袭击和谋杀等等。这一做法导致了犯罪率上升，犯罪分子不但会为了记忆犯罪，还会在这些创伤经历后窃取受害者的植入体。

我们应该如何应对与之相关的乱象?
cyber.1030.desc.en:
With so many implants able to control sensory and emotional experiences, augmented individuals have turned to virtual life events as escapism and entertainment. While engram artists can theoretically stimulate any emotion, the practice has taken a dark turn.

Memory engram clubs are paying top credits for self-recorded, intensely emotional experiences such as weddings and mating rituals, but also suicides, assaults, and murders. This has caused an uptick in crime, as criminals are both recording themselves committing offenses as well as stealing victims' implants after a traumatic experience.

How should we handle this concerning craze?

cyber.1030.e.zh: 死亡的无限体验？多么神圣啊。
cyber.1030.e.en: The endless experience of death? How divine.

cyber.1030.e.tt.zh: 这会增进我们死亡司祭的理解，从而更好地引导凡体先烈。
cyber.1030.e.tt.en: This will allow our Death Priests to understand and guide the experiences of our Mortal Initiates.

cyber.105.a.zh: 法律法规的存在不是无缘无故的。

cyber.105.a.megacorp.zh: 这可是我们的知识产权。

cyber.105.b.cor.tt.zh:
$situation_cyberization$局势修正更新：
添加：$cyber_control_independent_effects$
移除：$cyber_control_corporate_effects$

cyber.105.b.crafters.en: Let the people craft what they like.

cyber.105.b.gov.tt.zh:
$situation_cyberization$局势修正更新：
添加：$cyber_control_independent_effects$
移除：$cyber_control_government_effects$

cyber.105.desc.zh:
由于我们计划的许多义体设计对普通人来说都将会遥不可及，一些自改造者们感到非常愤怒。

他们认为如果公开原理图并放松有关的环境法规，几乎每个人都能制造和修理自己的强化体。
cyber.105.desc.en:
Self-modders are furious that many of our planned cybernetic designs will be inaccessible to the average person.

They argue that if the schematics were made public and environmental regulations relaxed, almost everyone will be able to manufacture and repair their own augmentations.

cyber.105.desc.megacorp.zh:
独立承包商们抱怨称难以获取我们计划的许多义体设计。

他们认为如果公开蓝图，并将与生产有关的专利放松，将能改善义体的生产。
cyber.105.desc.megacorp.en:
Independent contractors complain that many of our planned cybernetic designs are inaccessible to them.

They argue that if the schematics were made available and patents related to production relaxed, implant production could be improved.

cyber.105.name.en: By the People, For the People

cyber.1055.a.en: It was time to modernize the fleet anyway.

cyber.1055.b.zh: 强化我们的网络安全措施。

cyber.1055.c.zh: 内阁说得对，禁止电子游戏。
cyber.1055.c.en: The Council is right: ban the games.

cyber.1055.d.zh: 用互相矛盾的内容淹没那条信息。
cyber.1055.d.en: Drown the intel in conflicting reports.

cyber.1055.desc.zh:
一位海军军校生泄露了机密信息，其愚蠢之举令人震惊。作为一名网络战斗模拟器的忠实粉丝，这位学员与其他玩家就我们驱逐舰上炮塔的旋转速度发生了争论。

为了支持自己的说法，学员甚至上传了几张我们舰船的机密蓝图，这些文件很快传遍了全星系网络。尽管肇事者已被处理，但由于这一事件，内阁中有声音呼吁全面禁止网络游戏。
cyber.1055.desc.en:
In an appalling display of foolishness, a naval cadet has leaked classified information. A dedicated fan of networked combat simulators, the cadet got into an argument with other players about the angular velocity of the turrets on our destroyers.

To bolster their position, the cadet uploaded several classified blueprints of our ships, documents which quickly spread across the galactic network. Although the culprit has been dealt with, voices on the Council are calling for a wholesale ban on online gaming as a result of this incident.

cyber.1055.leak.tt.zh: 星海共同体的全体成员获得[Root.GetName]持续720天的中等军事情报。
cyber.1055.leak.tt.en: Every member of the Galactic Community gets Medium Military Intel on [Root.GetName] for 720 days.

cyber.1055.minorleak.tt.zh: 星海共同体的全体成员获得[Root.GetName]持续360天的低军事情报。
cyber.1055.minorleak.tt.en: Every member of the Galactic Community gets Low Military Intel on [Root.GetName] for 360 days.

cyber.120.a.spiritual.zh: 我们当将此视为一项恩赐。
cyber.120.a.spiritual.en: We must accept this as a blessing.

cyber.120.b.zh: 这对自主权的牺牲太大了。
cyber.120.b.en: The loss of autonomy is too great.

cyber.120.b.spiritual.zh: 我们不会在远离神圣的道路上越行越远的。
cyber.120.b.spiritual.en: We will not stray further from the holy path.

cyber.120.c.zh: 如果能装上一键开关的话这是可以接受的。
cyber.120.c.en: Acceptable, if an On/Off switch is included.

cyber.120.d.zh: 这将给我们带来多少的控制权啊……
cyber.120.d.en: The amount of control this will grant us...

cyber.120.desc.zh:
一个研究团队提出了一项新议案，将监管人工智能集成到我们的移动设备中，随后又可以直接整合进义体件中。

这些监管人工智能将会引导我们公民将关注点从无聊的任务转移到更需要脑力的任务上。虽然会因此丧失一部分自主权，但对生产力前所未有的提高将不容忽视。
cyber.120.desc.en:
A team of researchers has put forth an innovative proposal to integrate AI supervisors into our mobile devices. Later these could be incorporated directly into cyberware.

The supervisors would redirect the focus of our citizenry away from idle tasks towards more cerebral endeavors. While some level of autonomy will be lost, the unprecedented potential to amplify our productivity cannot be overlooked.

cyber.1205.a.zh: 我们必须面对生命的真实。
cyber.1205.a.en: We must face the truth of our lives.

cyber.1205.b.zh: 每个人都有权享受无知之福。
cyber.1205.b.en: Everyone has a right to blissful ignorance.

cyber.1205.c.zh: 美化性重渲染不错，但审查的风险就太大了。
cyber.1205.c.en: Cosmetic reshades are fine, censoring is risky.

cyber.1205.d.zh: 我们会安排好他们的感官的。

cyber.1205.desc.zh: 最新一代的感官义体件可以让用户屏蔽不必要的感觉。包括不受欢迎的气味、不得体的画面等等，一切都可以被淡化、掩盖，甚至完全从用户的感知中抹去。我们社会中较为保守的团体越来越担心这种审查制度会对我国公民的良知产生影响。
cyber.1205.desc.en: The latest generation of sensory cyberware allows user to block out unwanted sensations. From unwelcome smells to unseemly pictures, everything can be toned down, masked, or even entirely erased from the user's perception. There are growing concerns amongst the more conservative groups of our society about the effects such censorship will have on the conscience of our citizens.

cyber.1210.d.en: Use it to spread the faith.

cyber.1210.desc.zh: 最近，雄心勃勃的企业和地下运动的广告倾向于在用户的义体件中隐秘地植入信息。虚假记忆、选择性荷尔蒙反应和睡眠建议正变得司空见惯。忧心忡忡的政界人士向我们提出了这个关切，并主张禁止这些侵入性信息，或至少加以监管。
cyber.1210.desc.en: A recent trend in advertisement for underground movements and ambitious corporations is to implant surreptitious messages in the user cyberware. Fake memories, selective hormonal reactions, and sleep suggestions are becoming commonplace. Concerned political actors have raised the issue with us and are advocating for a ban, or at least a regulation these invasive messages.

cyber.1255.gov.desc.zh: $cyber.1255.intro$但结论无可逃避：我们中出了个叛徒，而且鉴于这些信息的敏感程度，他一定有着很高的权限。
cyber.1255.gov.desc.en: $cyber.1255.intro$The conclusion is inescapable: we have a leak, and given the sensitive nature of the stolen information, it must be someone with high-level clearance.

cyber.1255.hack.desc.zh: $cyber.1255.intro$但结论无可逃避：我们有漏洞——这个漏洞让我们接受开源义体强化件的决定受到质疑。
cyber.1255.hack.desc.en: $cyber.1255.intro$The conclusion is inescapable: we have a leak - one that casts our decision to embrace open-sourced cybernetic augmentation into doubt.

cyber.1260.desc.zh:
对义体安全漏洞的调查获得了结论。

我们已经锁定了一种强化件和一些政府高级官员，他们的神经学湿件遭到了入侵。外国特工对其进行操作，并强迫他们违背自己的意志行动，这些个体对上述事件没有任何记忆。

尽管我们已经知道了泄露的原因，但我们对究竟是谁——或什么东西——进行了窃密仍一筹莫展。然而，通过秘密向那些受影响的官员意识中植入错误信息，我们也许可以追溯到窃密源。
cyber.1260.desc.en:
The investigation into our cyber security leak has concluded.

Certain augmented and high-level officials within the government have been targeted, their neurological wetware hacked. Manipulated by external agents and forced to act against their will, these individuals have no memory of the events in question.

Although we now know the cause of the leak, we are no closer to discovering who - or what - was ultimately responsible. However, by surreptitiously implanting false data into the minds of the affected officials, we may be able to trace the leak back to its source.

cyber.1265.c.zh: 我们被贼惦记上了。建立防火墙。
cyber.1265.c.en: They're onto us. Build the wall.

cyber.1265.desc.zh:
找到了。

藏身于本次史无前例网络攻击背后的犯罪分子已经被找到了。这些自称为“精神劫持者”的人除了制造混乱没有其他目的，他们能游刃有余地绕过我们的安全系统。虽然主犯已经被拘留，但我们仍然必须决定如何处理我们受侵害的官员。

最简单的解决方案是在受影响的植入体周围安装自定义防火墙。而还有一个更干净、但风险更大的选择是硬重启：通过进入上述领袖的基础认知功能，重新安装操作系统，期间这些领袖会被强制“关机”。
cyber.1265.desc.en:
We have them.

The criminals behind the unprecedented cyber attacks have been found. With no goal other than the sowing of chaos, these self-proclaimed 'Mind Jackers' managed to circumvent our security systems with embarrassing ease. While the ringleaders are already in custody, we must still decide what to do with our compromised officials.

The simplest solution is to install a custom firewall around their affected implants. A cleaner, though more risky, option is a hard reboot: accessing their base cognitive functions, the leaders in question could be forcibly 'shut down' while a new operating system is installed.

cyber.1270.desc.zh:
我们对入侵的官员的硬重启导致了一些意想不到的后果：虽然抹去了所有神经系统入侵的痕迹，但他们积累的一大部分知识和经验也随之而去。

尽管遭遇挫折，但在“重新开始”的过程中，这些领袖表示自己在职业和个人方面都获得了深刻的新生。通过迫使我们采取如此激烈的措施，黑客们可能无意中帮了我们一个忙。
cyber.1270.desc.en:
The hard reboot of our compromised officials has resulted in some unexpected consequences: every trace of the neurological hack has been wiped clean, but so too has a great portion of their accumulated knowledge and experience.

Despite this setback, in 'starting fresh' these leaders report deep feelings of professional and personal renewal. By forcing us to take such drastic measures, the hackers may have unintentionally done us a favor.

cyber.1275.desc.zh:
我们的意识安全了。

湿件工程师成功地设计出了神经学防火墙。为了维持我们的集体安全，我们目前和未来的所有官员立刻安装上了这些程序。尽管这会对我们的领导阶层的基础认知功能造成影响，但这项工程也对数据安全科学带来了卓著的洞见。
cyber.1275.desc.en:
Our minds are safe.

Wetware engineers have successfully designed a neurological firewall. In order to maintain our collective security, the program will be immediately installed in all current and future officials. While this will have a detrimental impact on the base cognitive functionality of our leadership class, the project has provided significant insight into the science of data security.

cyber.1505.b.zh: 将义体脑互联以共享经验。

cyber.1505.desc.collectivist.zh: 公开地向其他的[Species.GetNamePlural]同胞传播自己的想法看似是一种糟糕前景。但最初的震惊很快就会被对周围环境的自信和确定感所取代。我们知道身边人在做什么，反之他们也一样。不需要言语，只需一动念头，交流就能瞬间完成。为了保护这种清晰的思维，义体大脑的情绪功能被指令关闭以免淹没重要信息。
cyber.1505.desc.collectivist.en: Openly broadcasting your thoughts to your fellow [Species.GetNamePlural] is a harrowing prospect. But the initial shock is soon replaced with a sense of confidence and certainty over one's surroundings. We are aware of what the person next to us does, and they are aware of us. Communication happens instantly without words with a mere thought. To protect this clarity of mind, the cyberbrain has been instructed to nullify emotions lest they drown what is important.

cyber.1505.desc.individualist.zh: 民主过程是这个社会的基础，显然只有加强这个基础才是明智的选择。新的义体使我们能够对或大或小的所有社会问题进行投票，为个人提供前所未有的表达意见的机会。这带来了难以想象的数据财富和无穷的可能性。
cyber.1505.desc.individualist.en: The democratic process is what this society has been built on. It only makes sense to strengthen this foundation. Our new cybernetics enable us to cast our vote on all societal matters big or small, affording the individual unprecedented opportunities to express their opinion. The wealth of data this brings is unimaginable and the possibilities are boundless.

cyber.1505.desc.neutral.zh:
尽管经过了无数次的磋商、投票和热烈的讨论，国家仍未就义体强化社会的问题做出决定。为了避免使这个过程演变成一场分裂的争论，领导层必须介入。

我们可以利用这个机会修改义体，为民主过程服务，或者采取更激进的方法，让人们通过他们的义体件分享想法。后者还需要抑制义体大脑基本情绪，以防止个人强烈的自发想法扰乱其周围的环境。
cyber.1505.desc.neutral.en:
Despite endless consultation, rounds of voting and lively discourse, the nation remains undecided on the matters of cyber-enhanced society. Before the process devolves into a divisive argument, the leadership must step in.

We can use this opportunity to modify our cybernetics to serve the democratic process or take the more radical approach where people share their thoughts via their cyberware. The latter would also require the cyberbrain to suppress base emotions to prevent forceful spontaneous thoughts from disrupting one's immediate surroundings.

cyber.1510.a.zh: 让他们互相争风吃醋吧。
cyber.1510.a.en: Let them fight to curry favor.

cyber.1510.b.en: Make them work while they sleep.

cyber.1510.desc.collectivist.zh: 人们所能感受到的集体意识比个人的社会流动性更重要。因此，我们将挖掘睡眠增强大脑的潜力，而不是利用竞争本能。将计算能力通过义体上行链路无线连接到基站，在对象的整个休息阶段中下达计算任务。
cyber.1510.desc.collectivist.en: That the people feel a sense of community is more important than individual social mobility. So, instead of leveraging competitiveness, we will tap into the potential of the sleeping augmented brain. Its computational power is connected wirelessly to a base station via a cybernetic uplink, which feeds computational tasks to the subject throughout the rest phase.

cyber.1510.desc.individualist.zh: 很显然，大众都想要出人头地、与其他人一争高下。我们迎合这种超竞争行为的方式是设立一种游戏化的系统，用社会流动性和小饰品的承诺来换取生产力的提高，也能很好地满足他们的愿望。
cyber.1510.desc.individualist.en: It has become clear that the population wishes to stand out and joust against one another. Our plans to support this hyper-competitive behavior with a gamified system, which promises social mobility and minor trinkets in exchange for increased productivity, will suit their desire well.

cyber.1510.desc.neutral.zh:
我们的国民拒绝对社会应变得更具竞争性或是协作性的问题表明立场。而作为他们的上级，我们现在将为他们决定最好的方案。

我们可以创建一个高度竞争性的游戏化系统，在这个系统中，比你的同行表现得更好可能会为职业生涯带来上升机会，或者通过义体上行链路利用整个社区的计算能力，将他们的大脑在沉睡中连接到我们的服务器农场。
cyber.1510.desc.neutral.en:
Our subjects have failed to make a stand either towards a more competitive or communal society. As their superiors, We will now decide the best course of action for them.

We can either create a highly competitive gamified system where performing better than your piers might yield an upward trajectory for their careers or instead harness the computational power of the entire community via a cybernetic uplink to connect their sleeping brains into our server farms.

cyber.1515.a.zh: 给他们监视下的适度自由。

cyber.1515.desc.collectivist.zh:
危难当前，唯有团结。每一个通过义体增强的[Species.GetAdj]都在为更美好的未来而奋斗，并相信身边的人也都会这样做。

具有钢铁般意志和光辉人格的[Ruler.GetName][Ruler.GetTitle]会带领我们的人民向前进，他们大可对此放心。
cyber.1515.desc.collectivist.en:
There is strength in numbers and its unifying momentum in the face of adversity. Every cyber-enhanced [Species.GetAdj] fights towards a better future together, trusting the person next to them to do the same.

Our people can rest secure in the knowledge that the radiant personality of their iron-willed [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetName] guides them onwards.

cyber.1515.desc.individualist.zh:
[Species.GetAdj]民众正在逐渐接受一个可以用强化体以全新的方式表达自我的世界。

但这种宽容只是表象，植入体的内增强监控算法现在正在监视着每一个人，在大脑突触连接的那一刻就能发现不当的想法。
cyber.1515.desc.individualist.en:
The [Species.GetAdj] people are embracing a world where the augmented can express their identity in brand new ways.

But the leniency is only a facade, as enhanced surveillance algorithms within the implant are now monitoring every individual, detecting dissident thoughts the moment brain synapses connect.

cyber.1515.desc.neutral.zh:
当人民继续在十字路口犹豫不决时时，我们的[Ruler.GetName][Ruler.GetTitle]必须抓住强化改造所提供的这一独特机会并作出决定。

应该让我们的人民保持一定的自由意志，以植入体进行监控，或是要让他们完全由领袖光芒四射的意志所引领。
cyber.1515.desc.neutral.en:
As the people continue to waver in the crossroads, our [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetName] must seize this unique opportunity offered by the augmentations and make a decision.

Should our people be allowed some personal freedoms while monitoring them through their implants, or have them influenced by the will of their leader's radiant personality?

cyber.1520.b.zh: 在首都举办义体运动并进行广播。
cyber.1520.b.en: Host and broadcast cybersports at the capital.

cyber.1520.desc.collectivist.zh:
为了缓解我们帝国公民的辛劳，必须在[root.Capital.GetName]/“建立一座宏伟的$building_cyberdome$。它将会成为新式义体运动的举办场所，强化过的运动员们将为了我们的青睐和景仰争奇斗艳。目睹如此尖端的竞争无疑能激起大众对[root.GetName]的崇拜之情。

此外，这些景象还可以通过神经广播直接传达到全帝国的义体大脑中，驱使热情的人群前往[root.Capital.GetName]，亲身体验这种行为的原始刺激。
cyber.1520.desc.collectivist.en:
To offer our imperial citizens respite from their toil, a great $building_cyberdome$ must be built on [root.Capital.GetName]. It will serve as the glorious venue for new kinds of cybersports, where augmented athletes compete for our favor and admiration. Witnessing such fierce competition will surely invigorate the masses and their admiration for the [root.GetName].

Furthermore, these spectacles can be neurocasted straight into the cyberbrain, which will compel the exuberant crowds to travel to [root.Capital.GetName] and experience the primal thrill of the action firsthand.

cyber.1520.desc.individualist.zh:
皇帝下诏要求我们把精力集中在王朝本身。一块特殊的$r_the_rulerchip$会被植入每一位未来的统治者，以记录并转移他们作为[root.GetName]的[root.GetRulerTitle]期间的经验。

随着$r_the_rulerchip$的代代相传，其蕴含的丰富经验将成为我们社会的重要记录。另外，我们也可以利用人民的知识来增益领袖。
cyber.1520.desc.individualist.en:
The imperial seat has decreed our efforts be focused on the dynasty itself. A special $r_the_rulerchip$ will be implanted on all future rulers to record and transfer their experiences as the [root.GetRulerTitle] of the [root.GetName]. This relic chip will then be transferred to the heir at the time of the ruler's passing.

As the $r_the_rulerchip$ is passed on through generations, its vast library of experiences will become the foundational record of our society. We can also leverage our population's learnings for our leaders' benefit.

cyber.1520.desc.neutral.zh:
我们社会在义体领域的发展走到了一个岔路口。我们可以致力于造福少数人或是大众上。无论作何选择都将为[root.GetName]带来好处。

开发一种专业的植入体可以让我们将[root.GetRulerTitle]的经验传承给子嗣。而着力发展强化义体运动和广播科技则可以让我们可以在[root.Capital.GetName]的首都举办盛大的赛事活动。
cyber.1520.desc.neutral.en:
Our societal advancement in the field of cybernetics is at a crossroads. We can either concentrate our efforts for the benefit of the few or the many. Both would ultimately serve the [root.GetName] well.

Developing a specialized implant would allow us to transfer the experiences of the [root.GetRulerTitle] to the heir. Emphasis on augmented cybersports and broadcasting technologies would allow us to organize magnificent events on our capital of [root.Capital.GetName].

cyber.1525.a.zh: 推出支持广告功能的植入体。

cyber.1525.desc.collectivist.zh:
我们对整体自我完善的承诺引起了大众的共鸣。

关注社会经济问题密切地贴合我们企业的愿景，这可以确保必要植入体不断地推陈出新。
cyber.1525.desc.collectivist.en:
Our commitment to holistic self-improvement is resonating with the general population.

Attending to socio-economic concerns aligns with our corporate vision, ensuring that new generations of must-have implants are introduced on a constant basis.

cyber.1525.desc.individualist.zh:
[Species.GetAdj]焦点小组对他们的新眼部植入物反应积极。我们的分析部门认为，广告效果显著提高，整个产品组合的销售额有望大幅增长。这为即将到来的完整产品发布展示了巨大的潜力。

义体时代已经来临，我们已经做好充分准备以一种全新的企业战略来加以利用。
cyber.1525.desc.individualist.en:
[Species.GetAdj] focus groups are responding positively to the their new ocular implants. Our analytics department suggests a remarkable surge in ad effectiveness and a promising bump in sales throughout our entire portfolio. This showcases immense potential for the forthcoming full product launch.

The age of cybernetics is here, and we are fully poised to capitalize it with a renewed corporate strategy.

cyber.1525.desc.neutral.zh:
考虑到义体技术给社会带来的巨大变化，普通消费者会纠结于方向的选择或许也就不足为奇了。我们应该将个体差异作为标准，还是更应该关注集体福祉?

这个关键而无与伦比的决定必然会产生深远的影响，但优柔寡断就会损失利益；必须尽快做出抉择。
cyber.1525.desc.neutral.en:
Given the vast changes that cybernetic technology have introduced to society, perhaps it should come as no surprise that the average consumer is torn about which direction to take. Will individual differentiation become our standard, or should focus be placed on the collective well-being?

This pivotal and unparalleled decision is sure to have far-reaching consequences, but indecision is the death of profit; a choice must be made.

cyber.160.desc.zh:
一部广受好评的新剧抓住了公众们的集体想象力。

故事发生在一个义体植入体盛行的世界里，讲述一位强化改造的工人遭遇了与改造身体的创伤性分离。故事的悲剧性结局对完全义体化及其对[Owner.Species.GetAdj]身份不可避免的抹除提出了一种几乎不加掩饰的批评。

这部剧的大获成功引发了对义体化倡议的强烈反对，自该剧播出以来，可用测试对象的注册人数骤减了60%。
cyber.160.desc.en:
A widely acclaimed new drama has captured the collective imagination of the public.

Set in a world where cybernetic implants are prevalent, the narrative follows an augmented worker experiencing traumatic dissociation from their modified body. The story's tragic conclusion presents a thinly veiled critique of full cyberization and its inevitable erasure of the [Owner.Species.GetAdj] identity.

The smash hit has sparked significant opposition to our initiative, causing a 60% decrease in available test subjects since the drama's release.

cyber.200.a.tt.zh:
需要采取行动：
建造一个£building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center']以恢复$situation_cyberization$局势。
cyber.200.a.tt.en:
Action required:
Build an £building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center'] to resume the $situation_cyberization$ situation.

cyber.200.desc.cor.zh:
曾经的梦想现在触手可及，无疑我们境内众多的公司能从中大幅获利。义体行业蓬勃发展的一个好处是，新的消费产品推陈出新的速度越来越快了。

但计划终究要付诸行动。企业说客请愿建立一座$building_upload_center$来作为义体发展的中心。
cyber.200.desc.cor.en:
What was once a dream is now within reach, and who better to profit from it than the multitude of corporations within our borders? A benefit of the burgeoning cybernetic industry vigor is that new consumer products can be launched at an accelerated pace.

But plans must be put into action. The corporate lobbyists request at least one $building_upload_center$ to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

cyber.200.desc.gov.zh:
经过一段时间的政治内斗，生产义体强化件的责任终于被瓜分到到了各个政府部门中。当他们都能分一杯羹时，肯定会互相进行监督。

但计划终究要付诸行动。科研共同体至少需要一座$building_augmentation_center$来作为义体发展的中心。
cyber.200.desc.gov.en:
After a period of political infighting, the responsibilities for producing cybernetic augmentations have been divided between various governmental departments. When everyone gets a piece of the pie, they will surely keep each other in check.

But plans must be put into action. The research community requires at least one $building_augmentation_center$ to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

cyber.200.desc.ind.zh:
我们的通讯网络充斥着各种疯狂的设计构想，从神经突触强化件到义体味觉腺无所不有。其中大多数都非常不切实际，而且实现起来非常昂贵，尽管有些设计看起来还是很有希望的。

但计划终究要付诸行动。线上社群至少需要一座$building_augmentation_center$来作为义体发展的中心。
cyber.200.desc.ind.en:
Our communication networks are abuzz with wild design ideas, everything from neuro-synaptic augmentation to cybernetic taste glands. Most of these would be highly impractical and very expensive to implement, though luckily some designs appear promising.

But plans must be put into action. The online community requires at least one $building_augmentation_center$ to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

cyber.2004.c.en: There is no need to change.

cyber.2004.desc.integrated.zh:
$cyber.2004.desc$

我们的工蜂比以往更加地团结了，金属的纽带强化了意识的联结。
cyber.2004.desc.integrated.en:
$cyber.2004.desc$

Our drones are now more united than ever, metallic chains strengthening the bond of the mind.

cyber.2004.desc.neutral.zh:
$cyber.2004.desc$

在这个过中，我们发现了改变的机遇。我们的团结中蕴含着力量，但更多的自主工蜂也带来了一定的优势。
cyber.2004.desc.neutral.en:
$cyber.2004.desc$

During this process, we saw opportunities for change. There is strength in our union, but more autonomous drones also have their advantages.

cyber.2004.desc.volitional.zh:
$cyber.2004.desc$

我们的工蜂现在具有更强的个体思维能力——更多的自由也带来了新的可能性。
cyber.2004.desc.volitional.en:
$cyber.2004.desc$

Our drones are now more capable of individual thoughts - and with greater freedom comes new possibilities.

cyber.2004.end.zh: 随着我们身体的演化，我们的蜂巢意识也可以发生蜕变。
cyber.2004.end.en: As our bodies evolve, so could our Hive Mind become something more.

cyber.2010.desc.zh:
随着先进义体的出现，我们意识到自己的终极潜力。而到目前为止，我们还只触及了表面。

随着专业知识的积累和技术的进步，我们的社会必将发生变化。对智慧生命的完全整合我们势在必行。

抵抗毫无意义。全星系的心智都会是我们的。
cyber.2010.desc.en:
With the advent of advanced cybernetics, we can realize our ultimate potential. Up to now, we have only scratched the surface.

As our expertise increases and technology improves, our society is sure to be transformed. The total assimilation of intelligent life is our destiny.

Resistance is meaningless. The minds of the galaxy are ours to employ.

cyber.2015.a.tt.zh:
$change_auth_tt$['concept_auth_memory_aggregator']

同化£pop£有机人口产生的资源将进一步提升

$unlock_edict_tt$['concept_edict_aggregated_memory']
cyber.2015.a.tt.en:
$change_auth_tt$ ['concept_auth_memory_aggregator']

Resources generated from assimilating £pop£ Organic Pops are further increased

$unlock_edict_tt$['concept_edict_aggregated_memory']

cyber.2015.c.en: We shall remain as we are.

cyber.2015.desc.zh:
与机器融合后，我们的有机人口达到了近乎完美的状态。现在是时候将义体也整合进我们文明的织构之中了。

将同化人口的思维敏锐度进行简化，可以创造“聚合性记忆”，将他们的集体经验用来提升后勤能力。或者，我们可以通过促进“神经合唱”的创造，允许思想和情绪反应有更大的差异。

这两种情况都肯定会对我们的未来产生深远的影响。
cyber.2015.desc.en:
Fused with the machine, our organic population has achieved a state of near perfection. The time has come to incorporate advanced cybernetics into the very fabric of our civilization.

By streamlining the mental acuity of our cyborgs, we could form an 'Memory in Aggregate', channeling their collected experience into increased logistical capacity. Alternatively, we could allow for greater variance in thought and emotional response by facilitating the creation of a 'Neural Chorus.'

Either course is sure to have a profound effect on our future.

cyber.205.desc.cor.zh:
对焦点志愿小组进行的小规模测试已经验证了机械强化改造可以提升产出。

$cyber.205.desc.shared$
cyber.205.desc.cor.en:
Small tests conducted on focus group volunteers have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.

$cyber.205.desc.shared$

cyber.205.desc.gov.zh:
由政府出资研究项目所进行的小规模测试已确认机械强化改造可以提升产出。

$cyber.205.desc.shared$
cyber.205.desc.gov.en:
Small tests conducted by government-funded research projects have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.

$cyber.205.desc.shared$

cyber.205.desc.ind.zh:
来自自改造者的报道验证了机械强化改造可以提升产出。

$cyber.205.desc.shared$
cyber.205.desc.ind.en:
Reports by self-modders have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.

$cyber.205.desc.shared$

cyber.21.desc.zh:
今天是我们社会的一个转折点。我们终于得以用全内置机械部件来强化改造自己的躯体。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
cyber.21.desc.en:
Today marks a turning point for our society. We are now able to augment our bodies with fully-integrated machine parts.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

cyber.210.a.en: We can make use of this.

cyber.210.desc.cor.rival.zh: 一项与商标纠纷有关的法庭证据表明，企业正在试验增强现实植入体，旨在无缝连接到消费者的视神经上。原理图列出了对用户的好处，还有企业劫持视觉信息的能力。
cyber.210.desc.cor.rival.en: Court evidence related to a trademark dispute has shown that corporations are experimenting with augmented reality implants, designed to attach seamlessly to a consumer's optical nerve. The schematics outline both the benefits to the user, as well as the ability for a company to hijack visual information.

cyber.210.desc.gov.rival.zh: 记者们揭露了政府正在资助涉及思想监控芯片实验的证据。一旦这些设备开发完成，就可以安装在公民的大脑中，收集详细的安全和人格数据。
cyber.210.desc.gov.rival.en: Journalists have uncovered proof of government-funded experiments that involve thought-monitoring microchips. Fully developed, these devices could be installed in the minds of citizens to gather detailed security and personality insights.

cyber.210.desc.ind.rival.zh: 独立的自我改装者已经开始用基本的机械替代品替换肢体。不但没有任何办法可以确保这些自行手术的人的福利，而且人们还担心这种植入体不受管控的应用可能弊大于利。
cyber.210.desc.ind.rival.en: Independent self-modders have already started replacing limbs with rudimentary mechanical alternatives. There is no way to ensure the welfare of anyone attempting this on their own, and there are fears that unregulated use of implants could do more harm than good.

cyber.2100.desc.zh:
当在思考增强改造的本质时，我们也发现自己其实正在探索自己的愿望。

义体是达到目的的一种手段：它是一种优化我们的身体以更好地执行意志的方法。无限的强化改造是可能的，每一个强化体都将带来新的优势，但也带来了新的要求。机械肢体很重，网络大脑需要更多的能量，精密的部件也需要不断的维护。在通往完美的道路上，必须做出抉择。

要超越[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]局限、让机械化的[owner.GetSpeciesHandName]触及寰宇，我们的雄心壮志到底要聚焦何处？
cyber.2100.desc.en:
As we ponder the nature of augmentation, we find ourselves exploring our aspirations.

Cyberization is a mean to an end: a way to optimize our bodies to better execute our will. Endless forms of augmentation are possible, each bringing new strengths, but also needs. Mechanical limbs are heavy, cyberbrains require more energy, and delicate components require constant maintenance. On the road to perfection, choices must be made.

What is the focus of our ambition, the one goal that requires transcending the limits of the [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] to stretch a metallic [owner.GetSpeciesHandName] across the sky?

cyber.220.c.zh: 优先让那些受到残障限制的人重获自由吧。
cyber.220.c.en: First, give a hand to those with physical limitations.

cyber.220.d.zh: 手当然是要给最舍得出手的人。
cyber.220.d.en: No handouts! Sell to the highest bidder.

cyber.220.desc.zh:
我们在神经接口领域取得了显著的突破。大脑信号增幅器可以让用户丝滑但有限地操控一组人工肢体。在未来，这种技术也可以直接整合进义体脑中，而不需要外接设备。

在初步测试阶段，测试对象展现出了更高的敏捷性和精确的物体操纵能力，甚至还有更高的战斗熟练程度。然而，对制造成本的担忧促使人们应定夺这项开创性技术应优先运用于什么人群上。
cyber.220.desc.en:
A significant breakthrough has been achieved in the field of neural interfaces. A brain signal amplifier could grant users seamless, but limited control over an array of artificial limbs. Later on, this could be integrated directly to a cyberbrain without the need for an external device.

During the initial testing phase, subjects exhibited promising results with dexterity and object manipulation alongside heightened combat proficiency. However, concerns regarding the manufacturing costs have prompted the need to decide who should have first access to this pioneering technology.

cyber.220.f.zh: 精英们的优势是最手要的。
cyber.220.f.en: The elite should always have the upper hand.

cyber.2200.a.zh: 是时候开始建设未来了。
cyber.2200.a.en: Time to start building our future.

cyber.2200.a.tt.zh:
需要采取行动：
建造一个£building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center']以恢复$situation_cyberization_hive$局势。
cyber.2200.a.tt.en:
Action required:
Build an £building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center'] to resume the $situation_cyberization_hive$ situation.

cyber.2200.desc.zh:
随着闲散的思考变成具体的计划，一种迫切的需求出现了：一个专门用于实验以及测试、建造义体原型的空间。

我们将建立一座$building_augmentation_center$，这样我们就可以把我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]拆开，用金属和梦想重新编织在一起。
cyber.2200.desc.en:
As idle musings turn into concrete plans, a pressing need arises: a space devoted to experimentation, where cybernetic prototypes can be tested and built.

We shall raise an $building_augmentation_center$, so we may rend our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] apart and reknit it together with metal and dreams.

cyber.2205.b.zh: 选择一种面面俱到的原型。

cyber.2205.desc.zh:
我们的义体研究已经产出了多个有前途的义体原型供我们选择。初步结果表明，一些原型机在体力方面表现出色，而另一些则更适合精密工作。每一种都有其长处和局限性，没有一种具有压倒性优势。

我们意识中浮现出一个令人生畏的提议：我们可以让子个体变得多样化、根据功能不同的来改变身体吗？我们或许将变得不再完全相同。这样的未来难以把控，但也许对于我们整体的效率提高而言这是值得的。
cyber.2205.desc.en:
Our cybernetic research has produced multiple promising cyborg prototypes for our consideration. Preliminary results show that some prototypes excel at physical feats, while others are more suited for precision work. Each has its strengths and limitations, none showing clear superiority.

A daunting proposal springs to our mind: Could we, perhaps, diversify our drones? Modify our bodies in different ways depending on their function? We won't be all identical anymore, a prospect we find hard to grasp. But the efficiency gain might make it worth our harmony.

cyber.2220.b.zh: 缺陷会让蜂巢陷入虚弱。
cyber.2220.b.en: An imperfect Hive is a weak Hive.

cyber.2220.desc.zh: 在组装工蜂的过程中偶尔会有存在缺陷的躯体。通常这些畸形的工蜂都会被处理掉，但多亏了义体植入体，它们仍可以加入到我们的行列中。提高我们的数量是好事，但有缺陷的工蜂需要根据问题的严重程度进行个性化植入。我们的蜂巢会成长得更快，但也会变得更……不完美。
cyber.2220.desc.en: Drone assembly occasionally results in defective bodies. Misshapen drones are usually disposed of, but thanks to cybernetic implants, they could be allowed to join our ranks. Improving our numbers is desirable, but faulty drones require personalized implants depending on the severity of their issues. Our Hive would grow faster, but also become more... imperfect.

cyber.2220.name.zh: 这也能是我们的一员吗？

cyber.2260.b.zh: 为有缺陷的工蜂安装有限的植入体。
cyber.2260.b.en: Equip defective drones with limited implants.

cyber.2260.desc.zh:
一小部分受试对象遭受了对强化改造的不良反应。他们的身体排斥植入体，发生了危及生命的并发症。其病因似乎是一种以前未被注意到的遗传缺陷。根据初步计算，这大约会影响5%的工蜂人口。

在确定了问题之后，我们现在可以对工蜂进行筛查加以预防，但不知道该如何处理受影响的人口。
cyber.2260.desc.en:
A small percentage of our test subjects are suffering adverse reactions to augmentation. Their bodies are rejecting the implants, bringing life-threatening side-effects. The cause seems to be a genetic defect, previously unnoticed. According to preliminary calculations, this affects around 5% of our drone population.

Having identified the issue, we can now screen our drones to prevent it, but we don't know what to do with the affected population.

cyber.2300.a.tt.zh:
每月义体化人口：+200
$situation_cyberization_hive_triggered_modifier$每月资源：-5%

$cyber.2300.shared.tt$

cyber.2300.b.tt.zh:
每月人口义体化数量：-100
$situation_cyberization_hive_triggered_modifier$每月$unity$：+5%

$cyber.2300.shared.tt$

cyber.2300.desc.zh:
我们的义体原型通过了批准，$building_augmentation_center$也已经建好。我们的计划万事俱备，只剩下我们转化的后勤工作还没最终敲定下来。

我们可以下令所有的工蜂前往$building_augmentation_center$以进行转化流程，暂停他们的日常活动。这个过程会非常快速，但期间会让所有的工厂都停止运转。或者我们还可以安排工蜂的日日构成，在他们的强制休息期间进行义体人转化，以避免影响日常活动。这种计划尽管慢了点儿，但影响也小一些。
cyber.2300.desc.en:
Our cyborg prototypes are approved. The $building_augmentation_center$ has been built. Our plan is ready, but the logistics of our transformation are yet to be finalized.

We could order all our drones to head to an $building_augmentation_center$ and undergo the procedure, suspending their daily activities. This process would be very fast, but would leave our factories empty until it is complete. Alternatively, we could work around our drones' schedules, turning them into cyborgs during their mandatory resting periods in order to not impact their activities. Although slower, this plan is less disruptive.

cyber.2320.b.tt.zh: 提升非格式塔帝国对我们的评价。
cyber.2320.b.tt.en: Increases the opinion of non-Gestalt empires towards us.

cyber.2320.c.zh: 让我们的特使更加地完全一致。
cyber.2320.c.en: Make our envoys even more unnervingly identical.

cyber.2320.c.tt.zh: 降低非格式塔帝国对我们的评价。
cyber.2320.c.tt.en: Lowers the opinion of non-Gestalt empires towards us.

cyber.2320.desc.zh:
由单一实体组成的帝国以怀疑的目光注视着我们，恐惧于我们的人口众多。而义体植入体可以让我们的特使具有更独特的面孔和个性，呈现出不那么同质的外表。

这些分裂体的国家终将会感激我们的努力，甚至可能开始……同情我们，把我们看作他们的同类。
cyber.2320.desc.en:
Empires composed of singular entities watch us with suspicion, fearing our plurality. With cybernetic implants, we could give our envoys more distinct faces and personalities, presenting a less homogeneous facade.

The disunited would appreciate the effort. They might even start to... empathize with us. See us as one of them.

cyber.2360.c.zh: 仅限领袖使用个人符号。

cyber.2360.desc.zh:
我们蜂巢的义体化正在顺利进行中。我们的一部分人口现在已经搭载了义体植入体，而另一部分则还是完全的生物体。我们从未体在自己的身体上验过这样强烈的差异。工蜂现在可以将自己识别为不同群体的一部分，这种分裂感正在诱发它们的个体意识。

有些工蜂开始向自己身上安装小配件以装饰自己，或在植入体上绘制特殊符号以区分彼此。真是一种有趣但又令人担忧的发展。
cyber.2360.desc.en:
The cyberization of our Hive is continuing smoothly. Part of our population now carries cybernetic implants, while others are still completely biological. Never before have we experienced such striking differences between our selves. Drones are now able to identify themselves as part of one or the other group, and this split is expanding their sense of individuality.

Some drones have started to adorn themselves with small accessories, or are painting symbols on their implants to tell each other apart. It's an intriguing, yet unnerving development.

cyber.2400.a.zh: 让我们的工蜂自己思考。
cyber.2400.a.en: Let our drones think for themselves.

cyber.2400.b.zh: 个体主义对我们的团结是一个威胁。
cyber.2400.b.en: Individuality is a threat to our unity.

cyber.2400.desc.zh:
安装神经植入体对工蜂造成了意料外的影响：由于大脑变成了半义体，他们现在可以独立于我们的主意识之外产生个体意识。

我们可以进一步开发这种科技，提升工蜂的自主思考能力。
cyber.2400.desc.en:
Installing neural implants into our drones led to an unforeseen result: since their brains are now partly cybernetic, they can now form individual thoughts separated from our main consciousness.

We could further develop this technology, improving our drones' capability for autonomous thinking.

cyber.2420.c.en: Recycle the implants... and the bodies.

cyber.2420.desc.zh:
义体植入体让死亡这件事变得复杂了起来。

将植入体从死亡的工蜂身上拆下可以让我们进行循环利用，减少浪费。我们的整个废弃物抛弃流程需要进行优化以兼容这一新的步骤；需要花费的资源较多。
cyber.2420.desc.en:
Cybernetic implants are complicating the logistic of death.

Stripping deceased drones of their implants would allow us to reuse the technology, reducing waste. Our whole waste disposal process would have to get an overhaul to accommodate this new step; the resource cost is significant.

cyber.2460.b.zh: 为义体化设立最低年龄限制。
cyber.2460.b.en: Establish a minimum age before cyberization.

cyber.2460.desc.zh:
我们现有的人口正在稳步地进行义体化，但必须为还未出生的人口建立一种流程。

以我们的科技，我们甚至可以在[owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]出生前就安装上义体植入体，从而创造一个真正义体化的物种：这种方案快速、轻松且高效。另一方面，初步研究表明，在极早期安装植入体可能造成精神分裂、精神错乱、震颤和各种发育障碍。
cyber.2460.desc.en:
Our existing population is undergoing cyberization at a steady rate, but we must establish a process for those yet to be born.

With our technology, we can fit our [owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] with cybernetic implants before they are even born, creating a truly cybernetic species: a quick, easy and efficient solution. On the other hand, preliminary research show that installing implant at an early age early could cause dissociation, psychosis, tremors, and assorted developmental disorders.

cyber.260.a.zh: 在找到解决方案之前暂停所有测试。
cyber.260.a.en: Pause all tests until a solution is found.

cyber.260.a.tt.zh: 随后6个月$situation_cyberization$局势进展速度：-50%

cyber.260.b.zh: 向受害者家属进行补偿。

cyber.260.c.zh: 如果找不到人当志愿者，可以来硬的。
cyber.260.c.en: Find volunteers. By force if necessary.

cyber.260.desc.zh:
一款新型脊柱模块的试验以灾难性的失败告终。植入体电机产生的过大力量导致多名测试对象的脊髓遭受永久性损伤。

这一可怕结果的图片被泄露引起了公众的不适，导致未来实验的志愿者严重短缺。
cyber.260.desc.en:
A trial run of a new spinal module has ended in a catastrophic failure. The excess power generated by the implant's motors has resulted in permanent spinal cord injuries for multiple test subjects.

Disturbing images showcasing the horrifying outcome have leaked to the public, causing an acute shortage of volunteers for future experiments.

cyber.300.a.tt.zh:
领袖获得特质：$leader_trait_cyborg$
人口获得特质：['trait:trait_cybernetic']

强化改造速度取决于局势应对方案和£building£['building:building_augmentation_center']建筑的数量。
cyber.300.a.tt.en:
Leaders Gain Trait: $leader_trait_cyborg$
Pops Gain Trait: ['trait:trait_cybernetic']

Augmentation speed depends on the situation approach and the number of £building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center'] buildings.

cyber.300.desc.zh:
我们在全国各地的所有主要城市中心为[Owner.Species.GetName]民众们囤积了大量的机械植入体。这些由$job_augmentor_plural$们设计的装置保证可以大幅提高我们的生理机能。

抛弃过往迎接义体未来的这一天终于到了。
cyber.300.desc.en:
All across our territory, in every major urban center, we have stockpiled mechanical implants for our [Owner.Species.GetName] population. Designed by our $job_augmentor_plural$, these devices promise to greatly enhance our biological forms.

The day is finally here to cast off our past and embrace a cybernetic future.

cyber.305.a.materialist.zh: 宗教算什么，我们必须前进。
cyber.305.a.materialist.en: Faith is irrelevant, we march onward.

cyber.305.desc.zh: 反对将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械融为一体的宗教团体主动退出了我们义体化人口的行动。$cyber.305.desc.shared$
cyber.305.desc.en: Religious groups opposed to the merging of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine have opted out of our efforts to cyberize the population. $cyber.305.desc.shared$

cyber.305.desc.none.zh:
将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械融合的道德性是个长久以来为人津津乐道的话题。不幸的是，考虑到义体化带来的效率提高，那些选择退出的人可能处于不利地位。

强迫人们安装植入体可以确保所有人都不会掉队，但这也无疑会导致怨恨。
cyber.305.desc.none.en:
The morality of merging [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine has long been a subject of debate. Unfortunately, given the increased efficiency that results from cyberization, those who opt out may be at a disadvantage.

Forcing the population to install implants would ensure that no one is left behind, but it will also undoubtedly lead to resentment.

cyber.305.desc.spiritualist.zh: 不情愿将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与机械苟同的虔信者们主动退出了我们义体化人口的行动。$cyber.305.desc.shared$
cyber.305.desc.spiritualist.en: The faithful, understandably reluctant to merge [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine, have opted out of our efforts to cyberize the population. $cyber.305.desc.shared$

cyber.305.desc.unplugged.zh:
再次融合[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与机器的道德性是个长久以来为人津津乐道的话题。然而，我们自主设计的增强器不再受同化我们的机器摆布，因此效率极高。那些选择推出的人可能会处于不利地位。

强迫人们安装植入体可以确保所有人都不会掉队，但这也无疑会导致怨恨。
cyber.305.desc.unplugged.en:
The morality of once again merging [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine has long been a subject of debate. However, augments of our own design are no longer bound to the whims of the Machine that assimilated us, and as such are exceedingly efficient. Those who opt out may be at a disadvantage.

Forcing the population to install implants would ensure that no one is left behind, but it will also undoubtedly lead to resentment.

cyber.320.a.zh: 进化对我们是自然而然的事情。
cyber.320.a.en: It is only natural for us to evolve.

cyber.320.b.zh: 童年必须保持纯天然无污染。
cyber.320.b.en: We must preserve a natural childhood.

cyber.320.birth.desc.zh: 随着为新生儿安装植入体的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这些开创性的新生儿强化改造拥有永远改变我们与技术的关系的力量，从幼年开始便解放先天的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向前所未有的高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
cyber.320.birth.desc.en: With our newfound capability to insert implants onto newborns, we have suddenly reached an impasse. These pioneering neonatal augmentations possess the power to forever transform our bond with technology, unlocking innate cybernetic potential from an early age and propelling our civilization to unprecedented heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

cyber.320.egg.desc.zh: 随着将植入体安装进幼雏的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这样的先进强化改造拥有将以科技永久重塑骨骼的能力，从很小的时候就释放出他们的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向惊人的新高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
cyber.320.egg.desc.en: Amidst our newfound capability to insert implants directly onto hatchlings, we have suddenly reached an impasse. These pioneering augmentations possess the power to forever transform their bond with technology, unlocking innate cybernetic potential from an early age and propelling our civilization to unprecedented heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

cyber.320.lithoid.desc.zh: 随着将植入体安装进新结晶后代的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这样的强化改造将使我们的新一代与金属矿物形成一种自然的联系，从很小的时候就释放出他们的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向惊人的新高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
cyber.320.lithoid.desc.en: Amidst our newfound capability to insert implants onto newly crystallized offspring, we have suddenly reached an impasse. Such augmentations would allow our young to form a natural bond with metallic minerals, unlocking their cybernetic potential from an early age and propelling our civilization to astonishing new heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

cyber.320.metamorphosis.desc.zh: 最近，我们取得了一项令人难以置信的突破，使微芯片直接植入幼体体内变为可能。在变态发育过程中，我们的幼体获得了一种吸收机械系统的自然能力。在化蛹阶段进行的增强可以释放他们未开发的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向惊人的新高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
cyber.320.metamorphosis.desc.en: Recently, we have made an incredible breakthrough which allows us to implant microchips directly onto our young. During metamorphosis, our larvae have a natural ability to absorb mechanical systems. Augmentations made during the pupal stage can unleash their untapped cybernetic potential and propel our civilization to astonishing new heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

cyber.320.other.desc.zh: 随着将植入体安装进幼体的全新技术问世，我们也同时陷入了僵局：这样的先进强化改造拥有将以科技永久重塑骨骼的能力，从很小的时候就释放出他们的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向惊人的新高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
cyber.320.other.desc.en: With the capability to insert cybernetic implants into infants, we also arrive at an impasse: these pioneering augmentations possess the power to forever transform our bond with technology, unlocking innate cybernetic potential from an early age and propelling our civilization to unprecedented heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

cyber.320.root.desc.zh: 随着将植入体安装进新嫩芽的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这样的强化改造将使我们的新一代通过菌丝网络传输电子脉冲，从很小的时候就释放出他们的义体潜力。$cyber.320.end.desc$
cyber.320.root.desc.en: Amidst our newfound capability to insert cybernetic implants onto sproutlings, we have suddenly reached an impasse. These augmentations would allow our young to transmit electrical impulses through an enhanced network of hyphae, unlocking their cybernetic potential from an early age.$cyber.320.end.desc$

cyber.360.b.zh: 献祭会结束他们的痛苦。

cyber.360.d.zh: 在最底层寻找测试对象。
cyber.360.d.en: Look to the lowest strata for test subjects.

cyber.360.desc.zh:
最近，一些个体开始公开表达对接受实验性身体改造的懊悔。将脑干换成机械替代品会导致持久的生存恐惧，一些人将他们的经历描述为无法忍受的痛苦的持续循环。

在不断要求赔偿的情况下，我们不得不澄清我们对国家责任的立场。
cyber.360.desc.en:
Recently, a number of individuals have begun to publicly express remorse over their decision to undergo experimental body modifications. Exchanging the brainstem for a mechanical substitute has resulted in lasting existential dread, with some describing their experience as a continuous cycle of unbearable agony.

Amidst ongoing demands for reparations, we are forced to clarify our position regarding the state's responsibility.

cyber.405.desc.zh:
目睹了监管宽松的强化改造行业带来的利润，当地政府官员一直在争先恐后地跟上最新的发展。从资源开采到最终安装，控制植入体生产的每个阶段都要征收大幅税额。

过分的官僚主义和高昂的费用已经减缓了我们的强化改造进度，阻碍了全面义体化的进程。
cyber.405.desc.en:
Witnessing the profits in the loosely regulated augmentation industry, local government officials have been scrambling to keep up with the latest developments. Broad taxes have been levied on every stage of cybernetic implant production, from resource extraction to final installation.

The additional bureaucracy and expense have slowed down our augmentation process, impeding progress toward full cyberization.

cyber.410.desc.zh:
由于跟不上公众对控制植入体的采用，我们的立法者正在尽其所能限制某些方面的强化改造。

最新提出的法规谴责我们“植入体成瘾”，每一次强化改造都“让我们离[Owner.Species.GetName]的定义越来越远”，并设定了一个每个人的强化体比例上限，只有在该限度之内才资格受到法律保护。毕竟，在某种程度上，我们有会变得更像机器而不是[Owner.Species.GetName]的风险。
cyber.410.desc.en:
Unable to keep up with the public's adoption of cybernetic implants, our lawmakers are doing everything they can to restrict certain aspects of augmentation.

Decrying our "implant obsession," with each augmentation "taking us further away from what it means to be a [Owner.Species.GetName]," the latest proposed regulations set a maximum augmentation percentage per person allowed to still qualify for protection under the law. After all, at some point we risk becoming more machine than [Owner.Species.GetName].

cyber.415.a.en: The market will sort itself out.

cyber.415.b.zh: 我们必须确保用户安全。

cyber.415.desc.zh:
在对利润的狂热追逐中，强化改造市场充斥着廉价、低质的植入体，在这些设备不可避免地发生故障时，公司也拒绝提供客户支持。

在一个最近广为报道的案例中，一位著名演员在舞台上表演时，心脏调节植入体发生了故障。不幸的是，结果是爆炸性的。
cyber.415.desc.en:
In the heady rush for profit, the augmentation market has been flooded by cheap, low-quality implants, with companies offering no customer support when these devices inevitably break down.

In one recent, well-publicized case, a popular performer's heart-modulating implant malfunctioned while on stage. The result was, unfortunately, explosive.

cyber.420.b.tt_pacifist.zh: 用这些材料造点更……明智的东西。
cyber.420.b.tt_pacifist.en: Use the materials to build something more... sensible.

cyber.420.b_pacifist.zh: 必须拆除所有的暴力植入体。
cyber.420.b_pacifist.en: All violent implants must be dismantled.

cyber.420.desc.zh:
最近，一种引人疑虑的新型义体植入体得到了广泛的关注。这些植入体的设计不是为了帮助使用者，而是为了伤害他人：这些毒素喷雾器、纳米绞杀器和电子大脑干扰器席卷了大街小巷。

支持者认为，这些植入体对于自卫是必要的，而其他人则坚持认为，这种技术不可能带来任何好处。
cyber.420.desc.en:
Recently, a dubious new variety of cybernetic implant has been gaining traction. These implants are not designed to help the user, but rather to injure others: toxin sprayers, nano garrottes, and cyberbrain scramblers flood our streets.

Proponents argue that these implants are necessary for self defense, while others insist no good can possibly come of such technology.

cyber.425.c.zh: 我倒要看看他们想怎么搞。
cyber.425.c.en: I'd like to see them try.

cyber.425.c.tt.zh: 好在我们自己的黑客道高一丈。
cyber.425.c.tt.en: Good thing we keep the best hackers on OUR payroll.

cyber.425.desc.zh:
在一次协同攻击中，多个黑客组织协力盗取了驱动所有植入体的核心软件。他们威胁称，如果我们不答应他们的要求，就要把代码公布于众。

到目前为止，我们没有理由怀疑他们的决心。如果代码被公开，我们将别无选择，只能进行重写，这种延迟将对我们的强化改造工作造成毁灭性的影响。
cyber.425.desc.en:
In a coordinated attack, multiple hacker groups have gained access to the core software that powers all cybernetic implants. They are threatening to release the code to the public unless we give in to their demands.

Thus far, we have no reason to doubt their resolve. Should the code be made public, we will have no choice but to rewrite it, a delay that will have a devastating impact on our augmentation efforts.

cyber.430.desc.demands.zh:
尽管我们向入侵安全系统的组织支付了巨额赎金，但昨晚我们的主要代码库还是被上传到了所有公共信息网络。泄露的内容开头还附带一张淫秽图片，嘲笑我们无力阻止攻击。

公众舆论逐渐发酵，对控制植入体的“买家懊悔”明显增加了。
cyber.430.desc.demands.en:
Despite paying a massive ransom to the groups responsible for the security breach, late last night our primary code base was uploaded to on every public information network. The leak was preceded by an obscene graphic, mocking our inability to prevent the attacks.

Public discourse has already turned bitter, with a noticeable increase in 'buyer's remorse' for cybernetic implants.

cyber.430.desc.protest.zh:
重写植入体控制程序费时费力，减慢了产出的节奏。

由于民众越来越依赖于最新的强化体，许多人走上街头抗议产品的延期发售。
cyber.430.desc.protest.en:
Rewriting the implant control software has taken time and effort, and slowed down production.

The population has become ever more dependent on the latest augments, and many have taken to the streets to protest delayed product launches.

cyber.5005.a.tooltip.zh: 把这些商品储存起来，作为我们高效生产方式的证明。
cyber.5005.a.tooltip.en: We shall store the commodities as evidence of our efficient production methods.

cyber.5005.b.zh: 我们会将其在公共市场上出售。
cyber.5005.b.en: We will sell it on the public market.

cyber.5005.b.tooltip.zh: 我们将启动市场开拓以推销我们的产品。
cyber.5005.b.tooltip.en: We shall initiate a market exploration to disseminate our commodities.

cyber.5005.c.tooltip.zh: 我们将探索外交渠道以交换商品。
cyber.5005.c.tooltip.en: We will explore diplomatic channels to exchange our commodities.

cyber.5005.d.tooltip.zh: 我们会寻找私人卖家用库存交换有价值的科技洞见。
cyber.5005.d.tooltip.en: We will seek a private buyer to exchange the stockpile for valuable technological insights.

cyber.5005.desc.zh:
我们完成了指令。

子个体在规定参数范围内满足了生产配额。

我们需要执行库存的最终指令。
cyber.5005.desc.en:
We have accomplished the directive.

The drones met the production output within the prescribed parameters.

We require the final input for stockpile utilization.

cyber.5005.e.en: Place them in a black hole.

cyber.5005.e.tooltip.zh: 我们会把它们安全地储藏在黑洞的事件视界之内。
cyber.5005.e.tooltip.en: We will store them safely beyond the event horizon of a black hole.

cyber.5006.desc.zh:
我们未能在该周期内完成生产指标。

该情况会降低我们子个体的产出直到能完成生产目标为止。

后续的生产配额已降低。
cyber.5006.desc.en:
We have failed to meet our production targets this cycle.

This scenario will reduce our drone output until we achieve a production goal.

The subsequent production quota has been reduced.

cyber.505.a.zh: 我们应该促进民主进程。
cyber.505.a.en: We should enhance the democratic process.

cyber.505.a.tt.zh: 着重提升幸福感、凝聚力和专业性。
cyber.505.a.tt.en: Emphasis on increased happiness, unity and specialists.

cyber.505.b.zh: 我们必须将意识连接到一起。

cyber.505.b.tt.zh: 着重提升幸福度、劳工产出和稳定度。
cyber.505.b.tt.en: Emphasis on increased happiness, worker output and stability.

cyber.505.desc.cor.zh:
我们与合作公司的强化改造流程已经成功完成。植入体以惊人的效率制造、分发和安装。我们听取了[root.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的许多意见，他们的合理关切也得到了处理。我们已经准备好了以全新的活力面对未来。

政府现在准备采取下一步行动。我们可以利用技术进步来改善民主进程，或者为劳动者进行植入体同步。
cyber.505.desc.cor.en:
The augmentation process with our partnered corporations has been successfully completed. Implants have been manufactured, distributed, and installed with staggering efficiency. The many voices of [root.GetSpeciesAdj] society have been heard, and their legitimate concerns have been dealt with. We are ready to face the future with renewed vigor.

The government is now prepared to take its own next step. We can use our technological advances to improve the democratic process or synchronize implants in the service of workers.

cyber.505.desc.gov.zh:
对我们人民的强化改造是一场流水线生产流程和决策指定的重大胜利。众多不同的声音得到了倾听，他们所关切的问题也得到了解决。如今，每一名[root.GetSpeciesAdj]都有平等的机会享受这些改变一生的植入体。

合乎逻辑的下一步是对这项技术的更广泛影响进行研究。我们是利用它来推动民主进程，还是通过经验同步来提升我们的劳工？
cyber.505.desc.gov.en:
The augmentation of our people has been a triumph of streamlined manufacturing processes and decision-making. Our multitude of distinct voices have been acknowledged with their concerns addressed. Now, every single [root.GetSpeciesAdj] has equal opportunity to benefit from these life-altering implants.

The logical next step is to examine the wider implications of this technology. Are we to leverage it for the democratic process or elevate our workers via experience synchronization?

cyber.505.desc.ind.zh:
尽管政府官员有些担心，但植入体的去中心化分发模式还是奏效了。小诊所和服务机构如雨后春笋般出现在大街小巷，让人们无需长途跋涉就能完成自身的强化改造。

我们的政府也必须做好继续前进的准备。我们可以利用技术进步来改善民主流程，或是进行经验同步，为自己与劳动者们造福。
cyber.505.desc.ind.en:
