Despite some apprehension from government officials, the decentralized distribution model of the implants has worked. Small clinics and services are popping up on every street corner allowing anyone to augment themselves without having to travel great distances.

Our government must be ready to move on as well. We can either use the implants to strengthen our democratic process or use them to synchronize our experiences for the benefits of ourselves and the workers.

cyber.510.a.zh: 让那些马屁精们为我们呕心沥血吧。
cyber.510.a.en: Have the sycophants toil for us.

cyber.510.a.tt.zh: 着重以降低幸福度为代价提升生产力。
cyber.510.a.tt.en: Emphasis on increased production at the cost of happiness.

cyber.510.b.tt.zh: 强调利用派系获取额外资源。
cyber.510.b.tt.en: Emphasis on leveraging factions for extra resources.

cyber.510.desc.cor.zh:
随着政府批准的公司开始大量生产不断改进的生物芯片，我们必须决定以何种方式来利用好这一次令人难以置信的社会变革。

我们是应该模仿优胜劣汰的自然选择，还是发掘沉睡中的大脑尚未开发的潜力?
cyber.510.desc.cor.en:
As government-sanctioned corporations churn out ever-improving biochips, we must make a decision on how to best utilize this incredible societal change.

Should we mimic nature, where only the strongest survive, or nurture the untapped potential of the slumbering brain?

cyber.510.desc.gov.zh:
这种里程碑式的转变只能由社会上层的来理解和实施，以免在我们的臣民中产生混乱和分歧。当[Species.GetNamePlural]被安装上政府分发的义体植入体时，我们获得了一个绝无仅有的探索这些芯片提供全新可能性的机会。

我们应该为社会创造激烈的竞争，让我们的工人提升到全新的高度，还是应该利用起睡眠中闲置的计算能力呢？
cyber.510.desc.gov.en:
This monumental shift can only be understood and enacted by the upper echelon of society, lest it leads to confusion and disagreements within our subjects. While the [Species.GetNamePlural] are fitted with their government-issued cybernetic implants, and we have a unique opportunity to explore untapped opportunities these chips now afford.

Should we push for a society where fierce competition raises our workers to new heights or harness the idle computational power of the sleeping minds?

cyber.510.desc.ind.zh:
不管是好是坏，人们都将有机会通过制造和分销的义体强化硬件来证明自己，让我们可以自由地考虑大局，并决定如何最大限度地利用这种不可预见的社会转变。

我们是应该促使人们完成更高的生产配额，还是让他们在睡梦中为我们工作？
cyber.510.desc.ind.en:
For better or worse, the people will be allowed to prove themselves in manufacturing and distributing the cyber-augmentation hardware, freeing us to consider the big picture and how to make the most of this unforeseen societal shift.

Should we push people to meet ever higher quotas, or instead, make them work for us in their sleep?

cyber.515.a.zh: 在个人植入体中藏入监视工具。
cyber.515.a.en: Hide surveillance tools in personal implants.

cyber.515.a.tt.zh: 着重于帝国的稳定性和犯罪率降低。
cyber.515.a.tt.en: Emphasis on empire stability and crime reduction.

cyber.515.b.tt.zh: 着重于劳工产出和强制迁移。
cyber.515.b.tt.en: Emphasis on worker production and resettlement.

cyber.515.desc.cor.zh:
我们的合作伙伴公司已经准备好在社会范围内制造、分发和安装义体植入体，而即将到来的固件更新为我们提供了一个独特的机会。

我们可以在个人强化硬件中秘密嵌入监控工具，这样就能找出有问题的人，或者可以创造一个人格覆写函数，将[Ruler.GetTitle]的意志烙印在大众的心中。
cyber.515.desc.cor.en:
Our partner corporations are ready to manufacture, distribute, and install cybernetic implants on a societal scale, and an upcoming firmware update provides us with a unique opportunity.

We could include hidden surveillance tools to personal augmentation hardware, allowing us to root out problematic individuals. Alternatively, we can create a personality override function that imprints the will of our [Ruler.GetTitle] the masses.

cyber.515.desc.gov.zh:
在我们的强化改造计划中出现了许多提升稳定性和控制力的机遇。在我们为政府生产植入体并在人口中广泛地安装的过程中，秘密地嵌入可以引导人口实现更高生产力的算法可谓小菜一碟。

我们可以通过在个人植入体中添加监控和后门程序来增加监视能力，或者我们可以安装代码，让我们[Ruler.GetTitle]光芒四射的人格影响大众。
cyber.515.desc.gov.en:
Several opportunities to increase stability and control have appeared within our augmentation program. As we manufacture government-issued implants and install them across our population, secretly installing algorithms to guide the population toward a preferred outcome would be easy.

We could increase our surveillance coverage by adding monitoring and backdoor tools to personal implants, or we could install code that allows our [Ruler.GetTitle]'s radiant personality to influence the masses.

cyber.515.desc.ind.zh:
综合医院、街角商店和骇客群体现在正准备分发并在大众身上安装义体植入体。但是，没有必要把我们的权力如此完全地分散到这项令人兴奋的新技术上。

我们可以提供客订化的植入体修改，把秘密监视工具隐藏其中，以对有问题的个人进行密切关注，或者我们可以安装人格覆盖算法，让我们[Ruler.GetTitle]的意志在潜意识中引导人民走向伟大。
cyber.515.desc.ind.en:
General hospitals, corner shops, and hacker communities are now ready to distribute and install cybernetic implants on the populace. But there is no need to decentralize our power over this new and exciting technology so wholly.

We could provide custom implant modifications, with our own covert surveillance tools hidden within, to be able to keep tabs on problematic individuals. Alternatively, we could install personality-overriding algorithms that will allow the will of our [Ruler.GetTitle] to subconsciously guide our people towards greatness.

cyber.520.b.tt.zh: 着重于首都星球的生产力和幸福度。
cyber.520.b.tt.en: Emphasis on capital planet productivity and happiness.

cyber.520.desc.cor.zh:
官方批准的公司正在执行着操作指令。所有的人口都以义体植入体进行了强化，并准备好了以前所未有的效率提供服务。

现在的问题是应该将植入体的实际价值集中在哪里。

为我们的皇室制造最高质量的植入体可以让我们的领导层得以在代际保存知识，不可估量地提高稳定性。或者帝国可以提升首都的地位，让义体强化的运动员在这里参与最极端的体育盛事。
cyber.520.desc.cor.en:
Officially sanctioned corporations have performed within operational directives. The entire population has been augmented with cybernetic implants and is ready to serve more efficiently than ever before.

The question now is where the actual value of implants should be focused on.

Having the highest quality implants available to our dynasty could allow our leadership to preserve knowledge between generations, providing immeasurable stability. Or, the empire can elevate the capital and entertain with cybernetically enhanced athletes participating in state-of-the-art bloodsport events.

cyber.520.desc.gov.zh:
政府已有效地调配了庞大的资源来进行人口的强化。政府批准的强化改造中心日夜不停地安装，并指导人们如何正确地使用、维护植入体。

现在的问题是，植入体的实际价值是应该集中在增强我们已经令人印象深刻的领导力上，还是作为下属娱乐和分散注意力的一种手段。

为我们的皇室制造最高质量的植入体可以让我们的领导层得以在代际保存知识，不可估量地提高稳定性。或者帝国可以提升首都的地位，让义体强化的运动员在这里参与最极端的体育盛事。
cyber.520.desc.gov.en:
The government has deployed its vast resources to augment the population efficiently. Sanctioned augmentation centers have been installing implants day and night, and people have been instructed on proper usage and maintenance practices.

The question is whether the actual value of implants should be focused on enhancing our already impressive leadership or as a means to entertain and distract those who work under them.

Having the highest quality implants available to our dynasty could allow our leadership to preserve knowledge between generations, providing immeasurable stability. Or, the empire can elevate the capital and entertain with cybernetically enhanced athletes participating in state-of-the-art bloodsport events.

cyber.520.desc.ind.zh:
尽管有许多帝国官员持保留意见，但义体植入体的去中心化分配安装已经取得了成功。各个星球上的小诊所一直在不知疲倦地努力强化改造我们的人口。

现在的问题是植入体的真正价值应该集中在什么方面。我们可以让统治者的知识储存在代际植入体中，或者为大众提供前所未见的义体人体育盛事。
cyber.520.desc.ind.en:
Despite numerous reservations from imperial officials, decentralized distribution and installation of cybernetic implants has been successful. Multiple small clinics across our worlds have been working tirelessly to enhance our population.

The question now is where the actual value of implants should be focused. This could mean preserving imperial knowledge within intergenerational implants or providing the masses with cyborg bloodsport, the likes that have never before been viewed by any ocular implant.

cyber.525.a.zh: 设计广告支持的视觉植入体原型。

cyber.525.desc.cor.zh:
得益于我们高度优化的企业基础设施，植入体的生产和安装与预期一样高效。这些新型植入体实际上带来了无穷无尽的商机。

其中有两条特别有前途的途径。虽然相互排斥，但两种方案的利润率都很高。

问题是，我们应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
cyber.525.desc.cor.en:
Implant production and installation is as efficient as expected from our highly optimized corporate infrastructure. The business opportunities of these new implants are practically endless.

Two particularly promising avenues present themselves. While mutually exclusive, both predict stellar profit margins.

The question is, should we require the inclusion of advertising in all future ocular implants, or mandate regular upgrades for the augmented population?

cyber.525.desc.gov.zh:
庞大而徒劳的政府植入体计划即将完成，这为我们带来了进一步扩大与这一前所未有的产品发布相关的收入来源的机会。我们的分析团队提出了两种潜在的收入来源，两者都有各自的风险和回报。

政府是否应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
cyber.525.desc.gov.en:
The expansive yet ineffectual government implant program nears completion, presenting us with an opportunity to further expand revenue sources related to this unprecedented product launch. Our analytics team is proposing two potential sources of income, both with their own risks and rewards.

Should the government require the inclusion of advertising in all future ocular implants, or mandate regular upgrades for the augmented population?

cyber.525.desc.ind.zh:
不出所料，义体件杂乱无章的“公共”植入正走向一个仁慈的结尾。我们现在还有机会影响这项有前途的新技术的发展方向，并在此过程中提高我们的产品利润率。

应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
cyber.525.desc.ind.en:
Unsurprisingly, the haphazard "communal" implementation of cyberware is coming to its merciful end. We now have the opportunity to influence the direction of this promising new technology, raising our product margins in the process.

Should advertisements be included in all future ocular implants, or would it be better to mandate a continuous upgrade cycle for software and wetware?

cyber.610.a.zh: 设计一种稳定的植入体。

cyber.610.desc.zh:
一种非法植入模组正在员工中广为传播，它可以刺激大脑产生任意的神经递质。这将会有广泛的用途，例如灌输强烈的快乐或者增强疼痛耐受性。从这些非法植入物中逆向工程出一个稳定的版本需要大量的投资，而且这种刺激的效果必将逐渐减退。

我们是应该将这种非法植入体重新包装为商业化的版本，还是仅仅对其使用进行规范？
cyber.610.desc.en:
An underground implant mod is spreading amongst the workforce that stimulates the brain to produce neurotransmitter chemicals at will. This has a wide array of uses from instilling intense pleasure to increasing pain tolerance. Reverse-engineering a stable version out of the illegal implant would require substantial investments, and the stimulating effects are bound to wear off eventually.

Should we create a commercial version, repackage the underground prototype, or merely regulate their use?

cyber.615.a.zh: 人们必须能完全掌控自己。

cyber.615.b.zh: 把工作忘在公司里是为健康着想。
cyber.615.b.en: It is healthy to leave work at the office.

cyber.615.desc.zh:
越来越多的公司要求在工作期间的所有经验必须储存在义体大脑中的特殊区域，在工作以外的时候不得访问。

他们声称，这种功能只会在高度机密的任务中使用，以避免商业窃密。有一些甚至要求雇员在工作中屏蔽个人经验，以避免个人道德对生产力造成干扰。
cyber.615.desc.en:
More and more companies require that all experiences during office hours are stored in a cyberbrain memory area inaccessible outside work.

They claim to use this functionality only with highly confidential tasks to prevent corporate espionage. Some even require employees to wall off their private experiences at work to prevent personal ethics interfering with productivity.

cyber.625.b.zh: 买不起就别用，有的时候找找自己的原因。
cyber.625.b.en: If they can't afford it, they shouldn't buy it.

cyber.625.c.zh: 将订阅限制在非关键功能上。
cyber.625.c.en: Limit the subscriptions to non-critical functions.

cyber.625.d.en: Splendid idea! Double down on it.

cyber.625.desc.zh: 随着义体件在我们的生活中愈发根深蒂固，盈利模式的变化将极大地影响整个社会。近来，植入体制造商将一些基本功能限制在订阅模式中成为了一种潮流。如果忘记付款，义体躯干可能会突然被锁定、视力可能会消失。消费者权益组织正在敦促我们出台措施阻止这种现象。
cyber.625.desc.en: With cyberware being so engrained in our lives, changes in monetization models affect our entire society dramatically. The recent trend has implants manufacturers lock essential functionalities behind a subscription model. Miss a payment and suddenly, your cyberlimbs lock up, and your optics turn off. Consumer organizations are urging us to put a stop to these practices.

cyber.655.a.tt.zh: 我们不会向公民提供低质量的零件！
cyber.655.a.tt.en: We will not provide our citizens with low-grade components!

cyber.655.b.zh: 真棒。开始生产更“轻薄”的义体件吧。

cyber.655.c.zh: 没错！再顺势涨一波价吧。
cyber.655.c.en: Yes! Coordinate it with a price hike as well.

cyber.655.d.zh: 利用这些数据来加速义体化进程。
cyber.655.d.en: Use this data to improve our cyberization efforts.

cyber.655.desc.zh:
义体件工程师为我们想出了一种全新的商业机遇。只要稍微降低植入体的耐用度，我们就可以利用用户替换必要部件的刚需来显著地提升利润。

通过在日常磨损最频繁的部分使用劣质生物合金，植入体会以对消费者伤害最小的方式发生故障，从而制造更换需求。
cyber.655.desc.en:
Our cyberware engineers have come to us with an economic opportunity. With only a slight reduction of implant durability, we could generate a substantial increase in profits as users will have to replace essential parts.

By using an inferior bio-alloy in the sections experiencing most of the usual wear and tear the implants should fail in a manner that minimizes harm to the consumer, but require replacement.

cyber.660.a.en: Alright, it was a little too greedy.

cyber.660.b.en: Say what? WE CANNOT HEAR YOU!

cyber.660.desc.zh:
似乎公民们听见了我们敲的小算盘。

现在整个大街小巷都是愤怒的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，控诉着我们最近对义体件质量和价钱的调整。他们强烈要求我们改回去。
cyber.660.desc.en:
It seems that our citizens have discovered our obsolescence initiative.

The streets are filled with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who are outraged at the recent changes we have made to cyberware quality and cost. They are clamoring for us to revert these changes.

cyber.7000.desc.zh:
在识别出一种潜在的未开智候选者后，我们的$guided_sapience_colonizer$便开始了对$d_genesis_preserve$的基因提升流程，并为之设立了必须的空间。

$cyber.7000.both$
cyber.7000.desc.en:
After identifying a potential pre-sapient candidate, our $guided_sapience_colonizer$ began the process of genetic uplifting and established the needed space for a $d_genesis_preserve$.

$cyber.7000.both$

cyber.7001.desc.zh:
我们的$guided_sapience_colonizer$在召集了所有当地的未开智物种后，开始为它们建立一个$d_genesis_preserve$。

$cyber.7000.both$
cyber.7001.desc.en:
After gathering the native pre-sapient species, our $guided_sapience_colonizer$ began creating a $d_genesis_preserve$ for them.

$cyber.7000.both$

cyber.7020.desc.zh:
在向导的不懈努力下，我们完成了[Root.GetName]上的提升项目。我们已经将[From.GetName]转变为一个完全智慧物种，而他们曾经称之为家园的$d_genesis_preserve$已经被改造成了一座$d_genesis_monument$。

它将永远是这个物种进化成就的不朽见证。
cyber.7020.desc.en:
After our guides' unceasing dedication, we have completed the uplifting project on [Root.GetName]. We have transitioned the [From.GetName] into a fully sapient species, and the $d_genesis_preserve$, which they once called home, has been transformed into a $d_genesis_monument$.

It will forever stand as an enduring testament to the achievement that was the evolution of this species.

cyber.805.c.zh: 还是仅限执法者使用远程躯体控制功能。
cyber.805.c.en: Leave remote body control to enforcers.

cyber.805.desc.zh:
监护人希望能通过幼体大脑中的植入体对他们的孩子进行更多的控制。对运动功能的接管目前仅限于警方使用，但有些人希望把这种权力也授予孩子的监护人。

尽管这很明显违背了身体自主权，但许多其他方式的家长控制已经得到允许。替代方案是允许一些有限的控制，例如让行为不良的孩子减慢速度或降低音量。
cyber.805.desc.en:
With brain implants installed in infants, caretakers are asking for more control over their children. The ability to take over motor functions is currently reserved for enforcers, but some want to extend these rights to parental guardians as well.

While this is a clear violation of bodily autonomy, several other forms of parental coercion are already permitted. The alternative would be to permit limited control, such as slowing down or reducing the volume level of the misbehaving child.

cyber.810.d.zh: 让每个人保管好自己的思维。

cyber.810.desc.zh:
在义体大脑植入体方面的发展给予了我们一个诱人的机遇。比起又主观又缓慢的教学方法，我们可以将关键的知识直接在大脑之间传输。该过程需要无菌的实验室环境，因此无法进行大规模应用。接收到的信息也会部分覆盖掉接收者的同类别记忆。

最有影响的应用方式包括在科学家之间共享知识。这可以抵消来自义体化过程的一些工程学研究负担，或者将重点放在其他领域。
cyber.810.desc.en:
The development of the cybernetic brain implants gives us an enticing opportunity. Instead of relying on subjective and slow teaching methods, we could transfer key knowledge directly from one brain to another. This requires sterile laboratory conditions, and thus would not be exploitable in large scale. The received information also overwrites parts of the recipient's own memories of a similar kind.

The most impactful application would involve knowledge sharing between scientists. This could offset some of the engineering debt from the cyberization process or be focused on other areas.

cyber.815.a.zh: 他们怎么爱、怎么生活我们管不着。
cyber.815.a.en: How they choose to live and love is not our concern.

cyber.815.a.tt.zh: 我们会继续允许客订化硬件和私密数字空间。
cyber.815.a.tt.en: We will continue to allow access to custom hardware and private digital spaces.

cyber.815.b.en: Bring these families back into the fold.

cyber.815.b.tt.zh: 我们不鼓励定制强化改造，支持更严格的监管方案。
cyber.815.b.tt.en: We will discourage bespoke augmentation in favor of more strictly regulated solutions.

cyber.815.desc.zh:
在许多[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]愉快地用现成的义体来强化日常生活和人际关系的同时，越来越多的多配偶家庭转而使用带有定制硬件的私人网络。这些家庭群体选择生活在量身定制的隔离中，以独特的亲密感分享彼此的感受和经历。

有社会福利团体和学者称赞这种现象，认为这种对人际关系和家庭纽带的客订化强化改造可以造福所有人。但也有人对这样的避世隐居产生了担忧，甚至认为这种行为可能导致个体在这种迷你的“爱情完形”中迷失自我。
cyber.815.desc.en:
Whereas many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have gladly augmented their everyday lives and relationships using off-the shelf cybernetics, a growing number of multiple-partner households in particular have instead taken to private networks with bespoke hardware. These domestic groups have chosen to live in tailor-made isolation, sharing each other's feelings and experiences with unique intimacy.

Some social welfare groups and scholars applaud this phenomenon, suggesting everyone could benefit from custom augmentation of relationships and family bonds. Others have raised concerns about such a retreat from wider society, with some even suggesting the practice may cause individuals to lose themselves in miniaturized 'love gestalts'.

cyber.820.a.zh: 对身体修改实施更严格的规定。
cyber.820.a.en: Implement stricter guidelines on body modding.

cyber.820.b.zh: 这是暂时现象，会好起来的。
cyber.820.b.en: This is just a phase. It will pass.

cyber.820.c.zh: 我们从这些年轻人中也能悟到点东西。
cyber.820.c.en: We might learn something from these young people.

cyber.820.desc.zh:
在整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]历史上，外部亚文化一直如影随形。随着义体增强技术的出现，情况发生了变化：一些边缘群体开始对自己进行大刀阔斧的改造，以至于看起来根本不像是[root.GetSpeciesAdj]。尤其是年轻人，他们对高度定制的[root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]、3D躯体艺术和其他装饰性附肢的渴望正在拉大代沟。

支持者声称，他们正在拥抱更真实的自我。他们通过放弃[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的同质化维护自己生命的主观能动性。但越来越多的家长和社会专家反对这种观点，他们谴责这些人是要破坏我们社会的恶棍。
cyber.820.desc.en:
Outsider subcultures have existed throughout [root.GetSpeciesAdj] history, but with the advent of cybernetic enhancements the situation has changed: fringe groups have begun altering themselves so radically as to appear non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Youths in particular are straining generation gaps with their lust for heavily customized [root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], 3D body art, and other decorative appendages.

Proponents claim they are embracing their truer selves, and that by renouncing [root.GetSpeciesAdj] homogeneity they are simply asserting agency over their own lives. These views are not shared by a growing number of concerned parents and social pundits, who denounce such individuals as miscreants out to ruin our society.

cyber.821.a.tt.zh: 我们会继续营造一种集体主义义体氛围。
cyber.821.a.tt.en: We will continue to foster a collectivist approach to cybernetics.

cyber.821.b.zh: 我们应该考虑他们的诉求。

cyber.821.b.tt.zh: 我们将授予个人更多关于义体强化改造的选择自由。
cyber.821.b.tt.en: Individuals will be granted somewhat freer choice over cybernetic augmentation.

cyber.821.desc.zh: 成千上万的年轻人、活动家和艺术家聚集在一起，呼吁义体强化改造自由。抗议者有的从外表上看来是正常的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，也有的拥有定制肢体、重塑躯体，还有的看起来像是外星人。他们都在声援那些因在义体装饰方面的个人选择而面临歧视的[root.GetAdj]公民。
cyber.821.desc.en: Concerned youths, activists, and artists have gathered in their thousands to demand freedom of cybernetic augmentation. Protestors run the gamut from outwardly typical [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to individuals with custom limbs, reshaped torsos, and other alien-looking forms. All proclaim solidarity with [root.GetAdj] citizens who face discrimination for their personal choices in cybernetic adornment.

cyber.822.b.zh: 批准这种稀奇古怪的东西真是大错特错。
cyber.822.b.en: It was a mistake to allow so much customization.

cyber.822.desc.zh:
医疗工作者抱怨称，目前治疗那些使用着极端特殊义体强化体的病人时，面临着前所未有的奇怪困难。

这些精心雕刻的个体即使只是一些小毛病，也大多需要使用特殊的治疗措施，如定制工具或剧烈拆卸等。此类干预措施的费用甚至超过了那些未修饰的非[root.GetSpeciesAdj]患者。
cyber.822.desc.en:
Medical workers have raised complaints about the bizarre and unprecedented obstacles they now face when treating patients with radically unique cybernetic augments.

Many of these elaborately-sculpted individuals require special treatment measures such as custom tools or drastic disassembly, even for minor ailments. The costs for such interventions far exceed those associated with unmodified, non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj] patients.

cyber.830.b.zh: 他们的痛苦跟我们没有关系。
cyber.830.b.en: Their suffering is not our responsibility.

cyber.830.desc.zh:
有一部分强化人口汇报称暴露在寒冷天气时会感受到疼痛。这种状况在[cold_planet.GetName]上格外严重，因为刺骨的严寒在那如同家常便饭一般。

已知金属植入体在低温下确实令人不太舒服，但不至于产生这样的严重反应。这一情况影响到了我们的劳动力。
cyber.830.desc.en:
A segment of our augmented population reports feeling pain when exposed to cold weather. The situation is particularly serious on [cold_planet.GetName], where freezing temperatures are the norm.

Metal implants are known to be uncomfortable in low temperatures, but should not be causing a reaction this severe. The situation is impacting our workforce.

cyber.830.tooltip.zh: 对$trait_cybernetic$物种特质添加如下修正：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$高山、极地、苔原宜居性：-20%
cyber.830.tooltip.en: Adds the following modifiers to the $trait_cybernetic$ species trait:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$Alpine/Arctic/Tundra Habitability: -20%

cyber.835.a.zh: 痛什么痛，就是脑子有问题。
cyber.835.a.en: Their pain is all in their heads.

cyber.835.c.zh: 把受影响者迁移到温暖一些的星球上。
cyber.835.c.en: Resettle the afflicted to a warmer planet.

cyber.835.desc.zh:
临床实验无法确定义体件暴露于寒冷天气与受影响患者的年龄、性别、职业和植入体类型之间的明确相关性。

有些医学专家认为这种疼痛是精神性的，治疗应该集中在止痛和行为疗法上。其他人则敦促我们不要低估这个问题，应该资助一个项目来推进治疗方案。
cyber.835.desc.en:
Clinical trials could not establish a definitive correlation between the exposure of cyberware to cold weather and the age, sex, occupation and type of implants used by the affected patients.

Some medical professionals argue the pain is psychosomatic, and treatment should be limited to painkillers and behavioral therapy. Others urge us to not underestimate the issue, and instead to fund a program to advance treatment options.

cyber.835.tooltip.zh: 移除$trait_cybernetic$物种特质的如下修正：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$高山、极地、苔原宜居性：-20%
cyber.835.tooltip.en: Removes the following modifiers to the $trait_cybernetic$ species trait:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$Alpine/Arctic/Tundra Habitability: -20%

cyber.840.a.zh: 他们没有错。禁止追踪科技。

cyber.840.b.zh: 这没什么可大惊小怪的。
cyber.840.b.en: This is no cause for alarm.

cyber.840.c.zh: 把不可追踪的植入体……卖给他们。
cyber.840.c.en: Offer untraceable implants... for a price.

cyber.840.d.zh: 遏制这些异见分子。保持追踪科技。
cyber.840.d.en: Curb the dissenters. Tracking technology is here to stay.

cyber.840.desc.zh:
我们的民族自古以来都是旅人、牧民和流浪者。有些人的旅行是到达目的地的一种手段，而我们的目的地就是旅行本身。身体强化改造使新的星球更加触手可及，但也使我们能够跟踪到那些太过离经叛道的人。就是说，并非所有人都对这种变化感到满意。

越来越多的人开始篡改自己的植入体，通过脱离网络以保护自己的隐私。目前这仅仅是一个小众趋势，但它可能会带来麻烦。
cyber.840.desc.en:
Our people have always been travelers. Nomads. Wanderers. While for some traveling is a means to reach a destination, for us the journey is a destination in itself. Body augmentation has made it easier to reach new worlds, but has also allowed us to track those who may stray too far. Not everyone is happy with this change.

An increasing number of people have been tampering with their implants, dropping themselves off the grid to preserve their privacy. For now it's a niche trend, but it could create trouble.

cyber.840.name.en: Where Our Hearts Will Take Us

cyber.855.b.zh: 教育就应该惠及所有人。
cyber.855.b.en: Education must remain accessible to all.

cyber.855.corp.desc.zh:
$cyber.855.intro.desc$

好的教育可以相当昂贵，而许多人感觉越来越难以跟上脚步了。然而那些能享用最尖端强化改造的有钱人家和只能依赖二手或者仿冒模块的人之间的差距还在越变越大。

为了避免进一步的社会分层，有必要对我们的教育系统进行一项重大的五年投资。
cyber.855.corp.desc.en:
$cyber.855.intro.desc$

A good education can be expensive, and many are finding it increasingly difficult to keep pace. The performance gap is widening between households that can afford cutting edge augmentation and those that must rely on older, hand-me-down, or knock-off models.

To prevent further social stratification, it will be necessary to make a significant, five-year investment in our education system.

cyber.855.gov.desc.zh:
$cyber.855.intro.desc$

跟上科技发展的步伐让我们的国有教育计划背上了沉重的负担。然而那些只能依赖公共强化体的人和那些能享用最尖端科技的有钱人家之间的差距还在越变越大。

维持一个公平的制度将需要投入大量资源进行一项为期五年的计划。
cyber.855.gov.desc.en:
$cyber.855.intro.desc$

Keeping pace with technological change has placed a heavy burden on our state-sponsored education programs. The performance gap is widening between those who rely on public augments and households that can afford cutting-edge technology.

Maintaining an equitable system will require a significant, five-year investment of resources.

cyber.860.desc.zh:
我们在教育强化件方面的投资取得了可观的回报。

开放公众对高质量义体的获取创造了一种真正的学术精英统治，在这种秩序下，每个人——无论其社会阶层——都能充分发挥自己的潜力。这些好处在科学领域尤为明显，科研产出和创新水平全面提高。
cyber.860.desc.en:
Our investment in educational augmentation has paid off handsomely.

Public access to high-quality cybernetics has created a true academic meritocracy in which everyone - no matter their social class - can achieve their full potential. The benefits are particularly noticeable in the sciences, where research output and innovation have improved across the board.

cyber.865.desc.zh:
事实证明，不动用公共资金去资助教育强化件的决定是明智的。

我们的社会崇尚个人卓越。尽管对不断扩大的“社会鸿沟”的批评不绝于耳，但从学术竞争中却脱颖而出了一些全星系受教育程度最高、最具生产力的领袖。
cyber.865.desc.en:
The decision to refrain from publicly funding educational augmentation has proven a wise one.

Ours is a society that believes in individual excellence. Despite scattered criticism about the widening 'social divide', academic competition has resulted in some of the most highly-educated and productive leaders in the galaxy.

cyber.hive_government_shift.tt.zh: 影响进行中的义体意识变迁。
cyber.hive_government_shift.tt.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Consciousness Shift.

cyber.social_consequences.tt.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
cyber.social_consequences.tt.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

cyber_education.tt.zh: 我们会发起一项五年计划，促生一种强韧且全面强化的教育系统。
cyber_education.tt.en: We will embark on a five-year program to promote a robust and fully-augmented education system.

cyber_subliminhack_licensed.zh: 潜意识骇入传讯：许可监管

cybernetic_creed_cyberization_funding_ap.zh: 我们为教会提供更多经费。
cybernetic_creed_cyberization_funding_ap.en: We supported the church with extra funding.

cybernetic_creed_cyberization_no_funding.zh: 主教团正利用手头的资源忙于工作。
cybernetic_creed_cyberization_no_funding.en: The Conclave is busy at work with the resources at hand.

cybernetics.5048.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]中大部分虚拟人口已经突破我们的防火墙，以一连串的数据和乱码的方式从我们手上逃脱。
cybernetics.5048.desc.en: The mostly virtual population of [Root.GetName] has broken through our firewalls and escaped from our grasp in a burst of data and nonsense code.

cybrex_artifacts.zh: 已回收赛博勒克斯遗物

cybrex_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
cybrex_asteroid_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

cybrex_fleet_gained.zh: 一支受我们控制的赛博勒克斯战斗舰队出现在[Root.Capital.GetName]上空。
cybrex_fleet_gained.en: A Cybrex battle fleet under our control appears over [Root.Capital.GetName].

cybrex_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
cybrex_gasgiant_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

cybrex_habitable_category_desc.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
cybrex_habitable_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

cybrex_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
cybrex_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

dark_immortal_kills_pops_tt.en: 50% of the population dies. Add +50 Devastation.

data_on_infinity.en: Data on the Nature of Infinity

debris_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 这颗小行星的表面散步着金属碎片。这些碎片大多看起来属于许多不同的飞船。
debris_asteroid_category_desc.en: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.

debris_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 这颗气态巨行星周围存在大量碎片。大部分来自各种规格的失事星舰。
debris_gasgiant_category_desc.en: There is a significant amount of debris in orbit around this gas giant. Most of it appears to come from long lost starships of various configurations.

debris_gasgiant_category_temp_desc.zh: 一座巨大的远古船骸围绕[From.GetName]漂浮。
debris_gasgiant_category_temp_desc.en: A massive shipwreck of ancient design circles [From.GetName].

deficit.100.A.zh: 我们可以从支持者那里借一点。
deficit.100.A.en: We can borrow from our supporters.

deficit.100.C.en: Everything is going according to plan.

deficit.100.desc.zh: 我们的能量币赤字已经失控！[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]要求我们采取有效措施控制事态，否则将会在数月之后大幅削减开支。
deficit.100.desc.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] demands that we take drastic action to take hold of the situation, failing which severe cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months.

deficit.100.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们的能量币赤字已经失控！我们的资源分配子个体面对我们补给线健康度的读数时愈发地焦虑不安了。它们预计，如果无法采取有效行动，在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
deficit.100.desc.gestalt.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! Our resource distribution drones are increasingly agitated at the readings they measure on the health of our supply lines. They forecast that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

deficit.110.desc.zh: 我们没能避免破产。经历了数月的能量币短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能拖欠债务并大幅削减开支。
deficit.110.desc.en: We have failed to stave off bankruptcy. Following months of energy shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to default on our debts and make sharp cutbacks to our expenditures.

deficit.110.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们没能平衡收支。经历了数月的能量币短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
deficit.110.desc.gestalt.en: We have failed to rebalance our expenditures. Following months of energy shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to enforce large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution systems.

deficit.125.desc.zh: 我们帝国的矿物短缺在最近数月来愈发严峻。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]对前景的预期从担忧转为愤怒，这表明我们很快就会用尽偿还债务的资源。他们预测，除非采取重大行动，否则在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
deficit.125.desc.en: Our empire's mineral shortages have become increasingly severe in recent months. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] has progressed from concerned to irate at the current forecasts, which suggest that we will soon run out of resources to pay off our debts. They predict that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

deficit.125.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们帝国的矿物短缺在最近数月来愈发严峻。我们的资源分配子个体已经竭尽全力，仍然无法保证我们的后勤系统不崩溃。他们预测，除非采取重大行动，否则在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
deficit.125.desc.gestalt.en: Our empire's mineral shortages have become increasingly severe in recent months. Our resource allocation drones are stretched to the limit, and are unable to guarantee against a breakdown of our logistics systems. They forecast that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

deficit.130.desc.zh: 我们没能避免破产。经历了数月的矿物极度短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能拖欠债务并大幅削减开支。
deficit.130.desc.en: We have failed to stave off bankruptcy. Following months of mineral shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to default on our debts and make sharp cutbacks to our expenditures.

deficit.130.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们没能平衡收支。经历了数月的矿物短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
deficit.130.desc.gestalt.en: We have failed to rebalance our expenditures. Following months of mineral shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to enforce large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution systems.

deficit.140.A.tooltip.zh: 关闭全部的克隆仓。我们就不再需要支出相应的维护费了。
deficit.140.A.tooltip.en: All active Clone Vats are disabled. We will no longer have to pay their upkeep.

deficit.140.B.tooltip.zh: 关闭全部的生物反应堆。我们就不再需要支出相应的维护费了。
deficit.140.B.tooltip.en: All active Bio-Reactors are disabled. We will no longer have to pay their upkeep.

deficit.140.desc.zh: 我们帝国面临的食物短缺问题正变得越来越严重。显然我们必须采取果断行动，否则短缺将在几个月内达到极限。
deficit.140.desc.en: The food shortages befalling our empire are becoming increasingly problematic. It is clear that we will have to take decisive action, otherwise the shortages will become terminal within a matter of months.

deficit.145.desc.zh: 我们的食物债务已经无可救药。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们将别无选择接受破产并重组我们的契约。
deficit.145.desc.en: Our food debt has become terminal. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to accept bankruptcy and default on our obligations.

deficit.145.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们的食物耗尽了。我们无法再为子个体或其他需要食物以维持运转的实体提供给养。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
deficit.145.desc.gestalt.en: Our food has run out. We simply cannot provide any sustenance to the drones and other entities that require it to function. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to make large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution system.

deficit.145.desc.wilderness.zh: 我们或许最珍视之物——自然资源的平衡——已经失守。我们的给养储备已经耗尽，导致整个食物链陷入困境。为了确保最大的生存机会，我们现在必须采取严厉的配给制和大规模的资源重新分配。
deficit.145.desc.wilderness.en: That which we perhaps hold most precious - the balance of our natural resources - has failed. Our feed stocks have run out, causing distress throughout the food web. We must now resort to harsh rationing and large-scale reallocation of resources in order to ensure the greatest chance for survival.

deficit.155.A.zh: 我们得勒紧裤腰带了，制定配给制度。
deficit.155.A.en: Hard times are upon us. Institute rationing.

deficit.155.desc.zh: 消费品的短缺导致[Root.Owner.GetName]境内生活水平的严重下滑。不满的声音日益显现，采取紧急行动的呼吁越来越广泛，很明显，供应的完全崩溃只有数月之遥了。
deficit.155.desc.en: The shortages of consumer goods have led to a precipitous drop in living standards within the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Voices of discontent are growing ever stronger, and urgent calls to action are increasingly widespread as it becomes clear that a total breakdown in supplies is only months away.

deficit.155.desc.gestalt.zh: 消费品的短缺导致了[Root.Owner.GetName]内非格式塔生物的生活水平大幅下跌。不满的声音日益显现，采取紧急行动的呼吁越来越广泛，很明显，供应的完全崩溃只有数月之遥了。
deficit.155.desc.gestalt.en: Shortages of consumer goods have led to a precipitous drop in living standards for the individualistic life forms living within the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Voices of discontent are growing ever stronger, as our logistics drones warn that a total breakdown in supplies is only months away.

deficit.160.desc.zh: 我们的消费品短缺已经严重到没有任何切合实际的办法能够弥补。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们将别无选择接受破产并重组我们的契约。
deficit.160.desc.en: Consumer goods shortages have increased to the point that there is no realistic way our deficits can be recouped. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to accept bankruptcy and default on our obligations.

deficit.170.A.tooltip.zh: 拆解[robots_planet.GetName]上的所有机器人（£pop£[robots_planet.recycled_robots]子个体）以获取£alloys£[robots_planet.total_alloys_gained]合金
deficit.170.A.tooltip.en: Dismantle all robots on [robots_planet.GetName] (£pop£ [robots_planet.recycled_robots] Drones) to gain £alloys£ [robots_planet.total_alloys_gained] Alloys

deficit.170.B.zh: 合并。循环。拆解[robots_planet.GetName]上的智能人。

deficit.170.B.tooltip.zh: 拆解[robots_planet.GetName]上的一半人口（£pop£[robots_planet.recycled_robots]子个体）以获取£alloys£[robots_planet.total_alloys_gained]合金
deficit.170.B.tooltip.en: Dismantle half of the population on [robots_planet.GetName] (£pop£ [robots_planet.recycled_robots] Drones) to gain £alloys£ [robots_planet.total_alloys_gained] Alloys

deficit.170.desc.zh: [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]现在愈发关心我们帝国发生的合金短缺。如果不能尽快弥补上我们的支出，我们的工业部门将会收到广泛的影响。
deficit.170.desc.en: [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is getting increasingly concerned about the alloy shortage befalling our empire. Failure to recoup our expenses will bring widespread disruptions to our industry sector.

deficit.170.desc.machine.zh: 预算警告：当前合金支出已经超过了接下来数月的支出阈值。若不能解决短缺，将会给我们的工业区域造成广泛的扰乱。
deficit.170.desc.machine.en: Budget warning: alloy expenditures surpassing expenditures for multiple subsequent months. Failure to resolve the shortage will bring widespread disruptions to our industry sector.

deficit.175.desc.zh: 由于无法解决合金短缺，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
deficit.175.desc.en: Having failed to resolve our alloys shortage, we have been forced to declare bankruptcy and default on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new austerity plan to cut expenses and preventing this situation from ever happening again.

deficit.185.A.nomad.zh: 从首都方舟抽取稀有水晶。
deficit.185.A.nomad.en: Siphon rare crystals from the Capital Arkship.

deficit.185.B.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
deficit.185.B.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

deficit.185.C.zh: 我们可以忍受“超稀有”水晶。
deficit.185.C.en: We can live with our crystals being rarer.

deficit.185.desc.zh: 稀有水晶在[Root.Owner.GetName]变得更加稀有了。包括关键的军用器材和先进生产设施中的核心组件，几乎各行各业都发生了短缺。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]提醒，必须在数月之内重整补给链，否则将需要大幅削减开支。
deficit.185.desc.en: Rare crystals are becoming increasingly scarce in the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Shortages have been reported in many fields, ranging from vital military supplies to critical components used in many advanced manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] warns reforms to the supply chain will be necessary within a matter of months, failing which sharp cutbacks will be necessary.

deficit.190.desc.zh: 我们稀有水晶的供给已经枯竭到即使关键系统都无法获得补充。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]调侃道如今它已经可以称呼为“极稀有”水晶了，他同时还强制执行了急剧的削减以期能恢复收支平衡。
deficit.190.desc.en: Our supply of rare crystals has diminished to the point that even critical systems can no longer be supported. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap], which recommends that they be renamed to "rarest crystals", is enforcing harsh cutbacks to return our usage of them to sustainable levels.

deficit.190.desc.wilderness.zh:
我们的$rare_crystals$储备已消耗到无法维持多项关键功能的程度。在极端情况下，我们那些依赖这种珍贵资源的特化共生体将面临生命危险。

为避免进一步的生命损失和生产力下滑，我们现在必须采取极端手段来确保系统重新恢复平衡。
deficit.190.desc.wilderness.en:
Our supply of $rare_crystals$ has diminished to the point we can no longer maintain several critical functions. In extreme instances, we risk the lives of our more specialized symbionts who depend on this precious resource.

To prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now rely on drastic means to ensure we once again reach equilibrium.

deficit.200.A.nomad.zh: 从首都方舟抽取易爆微粒。
deficit.200.A.nomad.en: Siphon volatile motes from the Capital Arkship.

deficit.200.B.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
deficit.200.B.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

deficit.200.C.zh: 我们可以忍受“超罕见”微粒。
deficit.200.C.en: We can live with our motes becoming more elusive.

deficit.200.desc.zh: 由于管理缺失和大肆的浪费，我们的易爆微粒库存已经完全枯竭！这种战略资源在包括合金冶炼和军事发展等诸多领域有着广泛的应用。尽快补充库存对确保我们帝国经济繁荣至关重要。
deficit.200.desc.en: Due to mismanagement and reckless expenditures, our Volatile Motes reserves have completely evaporated! This strategic resource is widely used in multiple fields, ranging from alloys production to military development. Replenishing our supplies is of paramount importance to ensure the economic prosperity of our empire.

deficit.205.desc.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的经济危机。由于无法弥补赤字，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
deficit.205.desc.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide economic crash. Unable to repay our deficits, we were forced to declare bankruptcy and forfeit on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

deficit.205.desc.gestalt.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的补给链崩溃。很显然我们已经无法继续维持我们对该物质的消耗。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
deficit.205.desc.gestalt.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide supply chain crash. It has become clear that we can no longer sustain our use of this material. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

deficit.205.desc.wilderness.zh: 我们各世界之间$volatile_motes$的短缺已造成广泛的混乱，尤其是那些生命完全依赖于它的极端微生物共生体。为了防止生命和生产力的进一步损失，我们现在必须实行剧烈的变革，以确保基本生命的延续，希望我们能尽快恢复平衡。
deficit.205.desc.wilderness.en: The shortage of $volatile_motes$ among our worlds has caused widespread disruption, not least to those extremophile worker-symbionts whose very lives depend on it. To prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now institute drastic change to ensure basic continuity of life, in the hopes we might soon regain equilibrium.

deficit.215.A.nomad.zh: 从首都方舟抽取异星天然气。
deficit.215.A.nomad.en: Siphon exotic gases from the Capital Arkship.

deficit.215.B.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
deficit.215.B.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

deficit.215.C.zh: 我们可以忍受“超难得”天然气。
deficit.215.C.en: We can live with our gases being more fleeting.

deficit.215.desc.zh: 异星天然气在我们的国库中已经成了稀罕货——而它们的长期缺失对我们所有依赖它的生产流程都产生了严重的影响。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]强烈建议我们重新考虑预算优先级，以结束这一怪异的局势。
deficit.215.desc.en: Exotic Gases have become a foreign presence in our empire stockpile - and their continued absence is having an impact on our entire manufacturing process, which heavily depends on them. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] strongly suggests we reconsider our budget priorities to put an end to this outlandish situation.

deficit.220.desc.zh: 我们的帝国已经再也无法应付异星天然气短缺对我们生产流程的毁灭性打击。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]被迫宣布破产，使我们得以违约债务。新的紧缩经济计划正在起草以削减开支，这样一来我们就可以逐渐重建我们的资源储备。
deficit.220.desc.en: Our empire can no longer cope with the exotic gas shortages that have been disrupting our manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] has been forced to declare bankruptcy, allowing us to forfeit our debts. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, so that we may slowly rebuild our resource stockpile.

deficit_approach_do_nothing_tooltip.en: This approach will have no effect.

deficit_situation_finish_tooltip.zh: 所有与目前[This.GetName]有关的惩罚将被移除。
deficit_situation_finish_tooltip.en: All penalties relating to the ongoing [This.GetName] will be removed.

demonic_armies_tooltip.zh: 多支恶魔军队将袭击殖民地！
demonic_armies_tooltip.en: Several Daemonic Armies will attack the colony!

demonic_incursion_tooltip.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上的位面传送门将会关闭。
[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系被[demonic_incursion_country.GetName]征服。
demonic_incursion_tooltip.en:
The Dimensional Portal on [fromfrom.GetName] will close.
The [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system has been conquered by the [demonic_incursion_country.GetName].

desc_exakeides.zh: 他已经在冷冻仓里休眠了无数个纪元。一经解放，艾克萨凯德斯想要找回对失去时光的弥补，他的年轻外表下潜藏着无比敏锐的才智。
desc_exakeides.en: For countless eons he lay frozen in cryostasis. Finally free, Exakeides now seeks to make up for lost time, his youthful appearance belying a keen and penetrating intellect.

dialog_friendly_overlord.zh: 我们会对宗主国采取友好态势。
dialog_friendly_overlord.en: We will take a friendly stance to our overlord.

dialog_friendly_tt.en: We will take a friendly stance.

dialog_hostile_overlord.zh: 我们会对宗主国采取敌对态势。
dialog_hostile_overlord.en: We will take a hostile stance to our overlord.

dialog_hostile_tt.en: We will take a hostile stance.

dialog_wary_overlord.zh: 我们会对宗主国采取中立态势。
dialog_wary_overlord.en: We will take a neutral stance to our overlord.

dialog_wary_tt.en: We will take a cautious stance.

diamond_dust_desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的质量扫描发现对流层下层有大量快速移动的物质。

如果没有更详细的调查，这些异常读数的来源很难加以确认。
diamond_dust_desc.en:
Mass scans of [from.GetName] reveal high concentrations of fast moving physical matter located deep within the lower troposphere.

The source of these unusual readings is difficult to verify without further detailed investigation.

diplo_incident_succeeded.zh: [Root.Target.GetName]外交使团的可信度变得支离破碎了。
diplo_incident_succeeded.en: The credibility of the [Root.Target.GetName]'s diplomatic corps lies in tatters.

diplomatic.1000.a.en: Carry out the maneuvers as planned.

diplomatic.1000.desc.zh:
指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]制定了一个舰队演习计划，这将涉及到我们相当部分的海军。[exercise_admiral.GetSheHe]为这场演习选择的地点是[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系，靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]的边界。

[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]或许会将这次演习视作一种挑衅，但是如果我们取消演习，我们的军队会认为我们过于软弱。毕竟，[exercise_system.GetName]是我们的领土，[exercise_neighbor.GetName]没有权力告诉我们在自己的地盘里什么能做，什么不能做。
diplomatic.1000.desc.en:
Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] has drawn up plans for a major fleet exercise that will involve a substantial portion of our navy. The location [exercise_admiral.GetSheHe] [exercise_admiral.GetHasHave] chosen for these maneuvers is the [exercise_system.GetName] system, which is close to the border of the [exercise_neighbor.GetName].

The [exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may see this as a major provocation, but if we cancel the exercise our military will consider it a sign of weakness. After all, [exercise_system.GetName] lies within our space - the [exercise_neighbor.GetName] has no right to tell us what we can or cannot do in our own backyard.

diplomatic.1001.desc.zh: 主力舰队的演习计划已被取消。舰队长时间未能进入预定地点，这严重影响到整个舰队的战备水平。
diplomatic.1001.desc.en: The plans to hold a major fleet exercise have been canceled. Continuous delays in moving the allocated forces into position means that to proceed now would seriously impair the readiness level of the entire fleet.

diplomatic.1006.desc.zh: 我们已经收到了[From.Owner.GetName]大量的舰队活动情报报告。他们集中在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系，似乎接近我们的边界。[From.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]想要做什么？
diplomatic.1006.desc.en: We have received intelligence reports of significant fleet movements within the [From.Owner.GetName]. They seem to be centered on the [exercise_system.GetName] system - suspiciously close to our border. What are the [From.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] up to?

diplomatic.1011.a.en: At least no ships were lost.

diplomatic.1011.desc.zh: 根据指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]所制定的演习计划，目前我们的舰队正在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行演习。在演习期间，发生了几次军舰之间的碰撞事故。所幸船员伤亡极少，相关军舰也没有遭受严重损伤，不过受损舰船仍需要进行修复。
diplomatic.1011.desc.en: The complex maneuvers devised by Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] have resulted in several minor collisions during the naval drills currently being held in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. Crew casualties were minimal and none of the involved ships suffered critical damage, but they will require some yard work upon the conclusion of the exercise.

diplomatic.1012.desc.zh: 当舰队在[exercise_system.GetName]进行演习时，[destroyed_ship_1.GetName]和[destroyed_ship_2.GetName]军舰意外高速相撞。两艘军舰的船员全部遇难，我们心情沉重，已将这个消息通知了他们的家属。
diplomatic.1012.desc.en: The [destroyed_ship_1.GetName] and the [destroyed_ship_2.GetName] were both tragically lost with all hands when the two starships collided during a high-speed maneuver that was part of the ongoing [exercise_system.GetName] naval drills. Next of kin have been notified.

diplomatic.1013.a.zh: 舰队总会需要有能力的指挥官。
diplomatic.1013.a.en: The fleet is always in need of capable commanders.

diplomatic.1013.desc.zh: [officer_ship.GetName]的舰长[exercise_officer.GetName]在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习中表现了其出色的能力。这位军官表现出极强的领导才能，军方高层认为应立即提拔[exercise_officer.GetHerHim]为舰队司令。
diplomatic.1013.desc.en: Captain [exercise_officer.GetName] of the [officer_ship.GetName] has shown a great deal of promise during the ongoing fleet exercises in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. The young officer has displayed initiative along with considerable leadership abilities, and the Admiralty has seen fit to immediately promote [exercise_officer.GetHerHim] to flag rank.

diplomatic.1014.desc.zh: 在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习吸引了[Root.Capital.GetName]和各个殖民地上相当多的媒体关注。非秘密的全息影像全面的展示了[Root.GetName]舰队勇士的英姿，无数的志愿者因此涌向了我们的征兵站点！
diplomatic.1014.desc.en: The ongoing naval drills in the [exercise_system.GetName] system have attracted considerable media attention on [Root.Capital.GetName] and the colonies. Unclassified holo recordings showing some of the more dramatic maneuvers have made the public enamored with the valiant defenders of the [Root.GetName] serving in the fleet. Volunteers are flocking to our naval recruitment stations!

diplomatic.1020.desc.zh:
我们的情报人员收集了更多在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系不断增加的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]舰队活动的情报。[From.Owner.GetName]似乎聚集了一支庞大的舰队，以前所未有的规模进行着舰队演习.

到目前为止，还没有迹象表明此次演习将转化为对[Root.GetName]的直接军事行动，但靠近我方边界的军事行动必然被看作是蓄意挑衅！我们应该如何回应？
diplomatic.1020.desc.en:
Our intelligence assets have gathered more information on the increased [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] naval activity in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. The [From.Owner.GetName] seems to have gathered a large fleet there to conduct some kind of massive naval exercise on an unprecedented scale.

As of yet there are no signs that this exercise will translate into direct military operations against the [Root.GetName], its proximity to our border can only be seen as a deliberate provocation! How should we respond?

diplomatic.1021.a.zh: 告诉[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不要干涉我们的内政！
diplomatic.1021.a.en: Tell the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to stay out of our affairs!

diplomatic.1021.b.zh: 我们无法承担后果……取消演习。
diplomatic.1021.b.en: We can't afford an incident... cancel the exercise.

diplomatic.1021.c.zh: 我们的外交官会缓和局面。
diplomatic.1021.c.en: Our diplomats will smooth things over.

diplomatic.1021.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]以最强硬的措辞对目前正在[exercise_system.GetName]星系举行演习的[Root.GetSpeciesName]舰队表示抗议和不满。

如此规模空前的舰队演习，如此接近我们的边界，这只能被理解为一种几乎不加遮掩的威胁与挑衅。我们的部队已经处于最高警戒状态，我们的舰队司令被命令以最强有力的军事回应应对任何边境的侵犯。
diplomatic.1021.desc.en:
The [From.GetName] objects in the strongest possible terms to the provocative military exercise currently being held in the [exercise_system.GetName] system by [Root.GetSpeciesName] naval units.

To stage fleet maneuvers on such an unprecedented scale so close to our borders can only be construed as a thinly veiled threat. Our own forces have been placed on maximum alert, and our fleet commanders have been instructed to respond to any border violations with overwhelming force.

diplomatic.1022.desc.zh:
我们收到了你们对在[exercise_system.GetName]举行演习的英勇无敌舰队发出的措辞不当的抗议。正如你们所知，那个恒星系位于[From.GetName]的主权范围内，所以我们不认为那里发生的事与你们有任何关系。

顺便提醒一下，[Root.GetName]最好能老老实实的管好自己并保证以后也不会给我们发送如此鲁莽、充满挑衅的外交文书。

通讯结束。
diplomatic.1022.desc.en:
We have received your poorly phrased objection to the military exercises our glorious naval forces are currently conducting in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. Since that system, as you are no doubt aware, lies well within the sovereign territory of the [From.GetName], we do not see how what transpires there could possibly be any of your business.

The [Root.GetName] would do well not to send us any more such provocative and reckless diplomatic correspondence in the future.

This transmission ends now.

diplomatic.1023.a.zh: 也许他们真的在追寻和平……
diplomatic.1023.a.en: Perhaps they are earnest in their quest for peace...

diplomatic.1023.desc.zh:
由于[Root.GetName]对在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习表示抗议，[From.GetName]已决定终止所有正在进行的舰队演习，以增进两个星际国家之间的良好关系。

我们真诚地希望，这次行动将有助于缓和星际间的紧张局势，同时这将毫无疑问地证明，[From.GetSpeciesName]致力于星系的持久和平。
diplomatic.1023.desc.en:
In light of the objections voiced by the [Root.GetName] to our naval maneuvers in the [exercise_system.GetName] system, the [From.GetName] has decided to terminate all ongoing exercises in the interest of fostering better relations between our two star nations.

It is our sincere hope that this action will help to defuse interstellar tensions while proving beyond doubt the [From.GetSpeciesName] commitment towards a lasting galactic peace.

diplomatic.1024.a.zh: 也许这是[From.GetSpeciesName]的另一个诡计？

diplomatic.1024.desc.zh:
我们在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的军事演习受到了[From.GetName]的误解，对此我们深表遗憾。

此次演习系按预定计划进行，进行的地点亦由指挥官随机挑选，不针对任何人或任何势力。该演习绝不应被过度解读为对[Root.GetName]的威胁或挑衅。
diplomatic.1024.desc.en:
The [From.GetName] deeply regrets any misunderstandings our ongoing military exercises in the [exercise_system.GetName] system might have caused.

These naval drills were planned well in advance, and the location was chosen at random by our commanders. In no way should this be construed as some kind of threat or provocation directed at the [Root.GetName].

diplomatic.1025.desc.zh: [exercise_fleet.GetName]在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系举行的演习已经结束。指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]报告说，我们从演习中获益颇丰，这很大程度上归功于此次演习规模之巨大。尽管可能会有一些的外交上面的负面影响，但至少此次军演所积累的军事经验是非常宝贵的。
diplomatic.1025.desc.en: The fleet maneuvers conducted by the [exercise_fleet.GetName] in the [exercise_system.GetName] system have been concluded. Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] reports that we have learned much from this exercise, in large part due to its immense scale. Despite any potential diplomatic repercussions, the military benefits, at least, have been substantial.

diplomatic.1026.desc.zh: 鉴于从[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系收到的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]军用加密信号突然减少，[From.Owner.GetName]在那里举行的舰队演习终于结束了。
diplomatic.1026.desc.en: Judging by the sudden drop in coded [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] military transmissions coming from the [exercise_system.GetName] system, the naval exercise that was being held there by the [From.Owner.GetName] has finally come to an end.

diplomatic.14.a.zh: 要是他们真的盯上了我们，这就能派上用场。
diplomatic.14.a.en: If they really are targeting us, we may need it.

diplomatic.14.desc.zh: 虽然我们没有在基因组检测中获得想要的细节信息，但研究进一步阐明了我们自身的遗传学特性。我们以往在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的地面战争中所使用的一部分武器对外星生物可能完全无效。这个新的发现帮助我们开发了现代化的作战学说。
diplomatic.14.desc.en: Although we have not found the specific details on the examined genome we hoped, our research has clarified much about the peculiarities of our own genetics. Some of the weapons what proved useful in the wars on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] in the past might be entirely wasted on alien lifeforms. These new insights have helped us develop updated combat doctrines.

diplomatic.14.name.zh: 绘制基因图谱收获成效

diplomatic.20.a.en: Who knows what we can find?

diplomatic.20.desc.zh: 在仔细研究了外星乐器后，我们发现这个乐器原来是使用他们母星的某种植物所打造的管乐器。这种植物的内部构造跟[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的任何植物都截然不同，甚至连分子构造都不一样。风通过这种植物后对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]身体产生了奇妙的效果；这让我们对己身的生理认知更进一层楼，并且更加了解外星球的植物学。
diplomatic.20.desc.en: Having taken a closer look at the alien music, we have discovered that it is made by a wind instrument made from one of the native plants native on their homeworld. The unusual internal structure of the plant is completely different from anything on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], even on molecular level. The effect of air passing through the plant on [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] bodies has advanced our understanding of floral biology on alien worlds.

diplomatic_support_dropoff_poi_desc.zh: 我们必须把这些代表送达目的地。
diplomatic_support_dropoff_poi_desc.en: We must drop off the delegates.

disco_alien_machine_cat_desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面坐落着一座类似大型机器的物体，其来源与功用尚未查明。
disco_alien_machine_cat_desc.en: On the surface of [From.GetName] sits what appears to be a large machine, of unknown origin and purpose.

disco_breathing_rift_cat_desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近发现了未知的现象。该现象正导致光线频繁折射，有时甚至被完全遮蔽。
disco_breathing_rift_cat_desc.en: An unknown phenomenon has been discovered near [From.GetName]. It is causing light to be frequently refracted and occasionally even entirely blocked out.

disco_gray_cat_desc.zh: [From.GetName]荒芜的地表上传来一道奇特的能源信号。
disco_gray_cat_desc.en: A strange energy signature emanates from the barren and lifeless surface of [From.GetName].

disco_impossible_organism_cat_desc.zh: 在对有毒星球[From.GetName]的调查中发现了意料之外的生命迹象。虽然迹象并不明显，但意义非凡。
disco_impossible_organism_cat_desc.en: Unexpected life signs have been encountered on survey of the toxic planet [From.GetName]. Small, but significant.

disco_molluscoid_miners_cat_desc.zh: 对[From.GetName]的光学扫描中，在其部分表面发现了类似小屋的建筑结构，证明此处之前可能有生物居住。
disco_molluscoid_miners_cat_desc.en: Optical scans of the planet [From.GetName] have revealed small hut-like structures littering parts of its surface, suggesting it is inhabited.

disco_speed_demon_cat_desc.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道俘获了一个小型未知物体，其正以难以置信的高速移动。
disco_speed_demon_cat_desc.en: Caught in an orbit around [From.GetName] is a small, unknown object moving at such a high speed it beggars belief.

disco_stranded_scientist_cat_desc.zh: [From.GetName]表面发现了类似舰船的物体，且周围散落着小块金属。遗迹似乎没有生命迹象，但却依旧有能源读数反应。
disco_stranded_scientist_cat_desc.en: Bits and pieces of metal are strewn across [From.GetName]'s surface, encircling what looks like the hulk of a ship. The wreckage appears deserted, but energy readings remain.

disco_trojan_asteroid_cat_desc.zh: 对[From.GetName]的初步扫描结果表明，其内部含有大量致密的精加工金属，也许是某种机械或其他科技。若要获得更多细节数据，则需进行进一步扫描。
disco_trojan_asteroid_cat_desc.en: Initial scans of the asteroid [From.GetName] suggest a dense mass of wrought metal within it, perhaps part of some machinery or other technology. Further scanning required for more detailed data.

distar.1.b.zh: 我们还是不要与他们发生冲突为好。
distar.1.b.en: We will not risk an altercation.

distar.1.b.tooltip.zh:
将船上的矿物归还给[wreckage_owner.GetName]。
此举会让对方十分满意并让我们获得£influence£ 影响力。
distar.1.b.tooltip.en:
Return the minerals to the [wreckage_owner.GetName].
This will please them and increase our £influence£ Influence.

distar.1.desc.contact.zh:
$distar.1.desc$——但是，[Root.GetName]的舰长谨慎的表明这是[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]的舰船设计。

这些矿物很可能属于[wreckage_owner.GetName]，如果我们认领了他们的载货，他们很可能不悦。
distar.1.desc.contact.en:
$distar.1.desc$ - however, the captain of the [Root.GetName] cautions that the construction indicates [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] design.

It is highly likely that the minerals belong to the [wreckage_owner.GetName], and they may be displeased should we lay claim to their shipment.

distar.10.desc.zh:
来自[fromfromfrom.GetStarName]的超强耀斑轰击了[fromfromfrom.GetName]的上层大气，我们没能及时布置起防护超强耀斑的护盾矩阵。

等离子喷流和磁场风暴导致了整个行星范围内的电子干扰，妨碍了能源产出并裹挟着辐射冲击了人民。这一灾难性后果还将持续一段时间。
distar.10.desc.en:
A superflare from [fromfromfrom.GetStarName] has struck the upper atmosphere of [fromfromfrom.GetName], pending our failure to develop an appropriate shield matrix in time.

Ionizing plasma and magnetic storms have led to electronic disruptions planetside, interfering with energy production and blasting the populace with radiation. The effects will persist for some time.

distar.100.desc.zh:
进一步的研究表明，[From.GetName]磁场的独特频率对我们的在轨道中的子个体有一种莫名的吸引力。该星球的磁层共振频率会产生一种针对[Root.Owner.GetAdj]神经网络的反应。

我们应在[From.GetName]建立殖民地，所有在该星球居住的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都将享受这种磁场共振带来的益处。
distar.100.desc.en:
Detailed study has revealed that [From.GetName]'s magnetic field was so attractive to drones in orbit due to the unique frequency at which it oscillates. It just so happens that the planet's magnetosphere resonates at a rate that produces a focusing effect on the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] neural network.

Should we inhabit [From.GetName], any [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on the surface would be able to constantly enjoy the benefits of this magnetic resonance.

distar.1000.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]轨道上的船壳是维克塔·泽沃尼亚号的残骸，它是一艘巨大的亚光速世代舰船，属于名为马达克·沃尔的非常唯心主义的外星物种。

尽管船上的生命已被无情地清除，舰长日志中仍然详细记录了马达克的悲惨之旅。在遭到被称为“躯壳”的可怕存在围追堵截之后，他们逃离了故乡，寻找遥远的乐园星球——传说中的乐土帕丽达雅，它只会对获选者显露真面貌。不过以其舰船的状况来看，他们被攻击者追上了。

我们是否该提取舰船的导航设备，并解密其目的地？
distar.1000.desc.en:
The hulk orbiting [From.GetName] is all that remains of the Vechtar Zavonia, a massive sub-light generation ship belonging to a deeply religious alien race called the Mardak Vol.

Though the ship has been ruthlessly purged of all life, the Mardaks' ill-fated journey has been detailed in the captain's logs. After being hunted to near extinction by nightmarish beings referred to as 'Vessels', they fled their homeworld in search of a distant paradise planet - the mythical promised land Paridayda, that would reveal itself only to the chosen ones. Judging by the state of their ship, however, their attackers caught up with them.

Shall we extract the ship's navigational drive and decrypt its destination?

distar.1001.a.zh: 没有什么能阻止我们进入乐园。
distar.1001.a.en: Nothing can keep us out of paradise.

distar.1001.b.zh: 终止计划。这是徒劳之举。
distar.1001.b.en: Abort. This is a fool's errand.

distar.1001.desc.zh:
解开维克塔·泽沃尼亚号的导航设备加密并不轻松，但多亏了对寻找马达克·沃尔族的理想乡着迷的首席科学官[vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]，我们最终成功了。

更令人担忧的是，这一发现不知怎的被透露给了公众，人们现在和[vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]一样决心要在一颗乐园星球上安家。
distar.1001.desc.en:
Cracking the encoding algorithms on the Vechtar Zavonia's navigational drive was no small feat, but thanks to head researcher [vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName], who seems to have developed an unusual obsession with finding the Mardak Vol's utopian world, we have finally succeeded.

More worryingly, the discovery has somehow leaked to the public who now share [vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]'s fixation with settling a paradise planet.

distar.1002.a.zh: 这不可能！再去确认一次坐标！！
distar.1002.a.en: This cannot be! Quadruple-check the coordinates!!

distar.1002.desc.zh:
第二次，继而再三确认导航系统的坐标后，我们不得不承认马达科-沃尔的天堂行星是一个只有荒原的荒芜星球。

尽管我们不能排除这种可能性：马达科所认为的天堂与我们的常识不同，但[utopian_planet.GetName]表面上的弹坑给出了另一种答案。这艘船的船长和乘员并没有简单的就接受了挫折。
distar.1002.desc.en:
After double- and triple-checking the navigational drive's coordinates, we have been forced to concede that where the Mardak Vol's paradisaical planet should have been are only the desolate plains of a barren world.

Though we cannot eliminate the possibility that the Mardaks' idea of paradise was wildly different to our own, the bomb-scarred surface of [utopian_planet.GetName] tells a different story. The ship's captain and crew have not taken the disappointment lightly.

distar.1003.desc.zh:
我们终于发现了马达科-沃尔的秘密！

当我们把探测器向[utopian_planet.GetName]的地表发射时，它仅仅触碰到大气层就被弹开了，这让船员们怀疑其中另有隐情。进一步深入的研究发现我们所看见的星球表面仅仅是一层能量护盾，向外投射着荒芜废土的假象，而在这护盾背后，一颗生机勃勃的盖亚星球藏匿其中，证实着马达科-沃尔的传说所言非虚。

不仅如此，当船员们降下护盾时，他们还发现了一个由一种哺乳动物和真菌的共生体组成的石器时代的文明，平和地生活在他们简陋的聚落中，对刚刚发生的一切和我们的存在一无所知。而传说中梦魇般的“血裔”，也仅仅在他们的口口相传中继续存在。
distar.1003.desc.en:
We have finally uncovered the Mardak Vol's secret!

It was when a probe, destined for the planet's surface, bounced off its atmosphere that the crew began to suspect [utopian_planet.GetName] was not what it seemed. Closer studies revealed that what looked like the planet surface was in fact an energy shield, upon which a barren world's texture was projected, and hidden below it, a lush Gaia planet reminiscent of the Mardaks' prophecies.

But that isn't all! As the crew deactivated the shield they discovered a peaceful stone age civilization consisting of a symbiotic union between mammals and fungi who live in crude huts, oblivious to the outside world. The nightmarish 'Vessels' live on only as mythical beings in their legends.

distar.1004.a.zh: 判断一颗星球绝不能只看表面。
distar.1004.a.en: Never judge a planet by its cover.

distar.1004.desc.zh: [country_that_discovered_mardak_vol.GetName]在我们领地内的一颗盖亚星球上，发现了一个隐秘的[GetPreFTLLower]文明。星球似乎被某种复杂的能源护盾保护，使它看起来像是一颗死寂星球。我们尚未判明是谁以及为什么将它藏起来，因为那些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种明显没有足够的科技实力。他们似乎是哺乳动物与菌类形成的某种共生关系，而且在我们看来，他们完全无害。
distar.1004.desc.en: The [country_that_discovered_mardak_vol.GetName] has discovered a secret [GetPreFTLLower] society hidden on a Gaia planet within our borders. The planet seems to have been shielded by some sort of sophisticated energy field, making it appear as if it were a barren world when it was not. We have yet to determine who hid it and why, as the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] clearly lack the technology for it themselves. They seem to be a sort of symbiotic union between fungoid and mammal and, as far as we can tell, they are utterly harmless.

distar.1005.desc_a.zh: 一个先前从未遭遇过的智慧哺乳动物联络了我们，事关仍居住在[utopian_planet.GetName]上的远古马达克·沃尔族。事情似乎非常紧急。
distar.1005.desc_a.en: We are being hailed by a previously unencountered species of sapient mammal regarding the ancient Mardak Vol still residing on [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems very urgent.

distar.1005.desc_b.zh: 一个先前从未遭遇过的智慧哺乳动物联络了我们，事关仍居住在[utopian_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种。事情似乎非常紧急。
distar.1005.desc_b.en: We are being hailed by a previously unknown species of sapient mammal regarding the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] residing on [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems very urgent.

distar.1006.b.zh: 无稽之谈，他们人畜无害！

distar.1006.c.zh: 绝不允许你们伤害他们！

distar.1006.desc.zh:
你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是沃尔族，我们和平而来。

我们发现你们的一颗星球感染了马达克。它是一种寄生性真菌生物，千百年来一直危害着我们一族，将其宿主变成傀儡，而你们就是它的下一个目标！

我们本以为已将其彻底消灭，但我们的年度星系扫描却发现[utopian_planet.GetName]上还存活着许多。但不用担心，我们知道该怎么办……
distar.1006.desc.en:
Well met, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Vol and we come in peace.

We have discovered that one of your planets has been infested with Mardak. It is a parasitic fungoid that has preyed upon our kind for eons, turning its hosts into mindless puppets, and you are its next targets!

We thought we had eradicated it for good when our annual galaxy scan revealed a thriving population on [utopian_planet.GetName]. But fear not, we know just what to do...

distar.1008.desc.zh:
注意：我们将开始轨道灭绝协议倒计时，3，2，1……已向感染者释放空气传播菌类溶剂-X。敌对媒介已被清除！

不要担心，你侦测到的任何环境变化都不是暂时的，而且无法恢复……

我们感谢你们的合作。

我们是沃尔族，我们和平而来。

和平……
distar.1008.desc.en:
Be advised: We are commencing orbital extermination protocols in 3, 2, 1...Air-borne dissolvent Fungo-X released onto infected populations. Hostile agents neutralized!

Do not be alarmed, any environmental changes you may be registering are not temporary and completely irreversible...

We thank you for your cooperation.

We are the Vol. We come in peace.

Peace...

distar.1009.desc.zh:
原始的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]！当你醒来时发现马达克镶进你的[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]时会有何感想？菌类首先会控制你的神经系统，然后一个细胞接一个细胞地控制你的全身！你的血肉会开裂，你的精神会随之崩溃！

幸运的是，[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，那一天永远不会到来。我们不会允许它发生的。

我们是沃尔族。我们将……和平归来。
distar.1009.desc.en:
Basic [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]! How do you think you will like it when you wake up with Mardak lodged in your [From.GetSpeciesOrganName]s, and your flesh is crawling and your mind cracking as the fungus hijacks first your nervous system, then your entire body, cell by cell?

Lucky for you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], that day will never come to pass. We cannot allow it.

We are the Vol. We will return...in peace.

distar.1011.desc.zh:
我们侦测到了一支敌方舰队，带着沃尔族的通讯特征，正笔直前往[utopian_planet.GetName]。看来他们是为仍居住在星球上的马达克而来……

他们没有回应我们的联络。
distar.1011.desc.en:
We have detected a hostile fleet, bearing the Vol communications signature, headed straight for [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems they have come for the Mardak still living on the planet...

They are not responding to our hails.

distar.1013.desc.zh: 频道里只有杂讯。我们失去了与沃尔族的联络。
distar.1013.desc.en: The channel crackles and pops. We have lost our connection with the Vol.

distar.1014.desc.zh: 我们终于在马达克·沃尔族的乐园星球帕丽黛达上安家了。人们正在欢庆，因为有一天，他们的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]也能在[utopian_planet.GetName]的沙丘、花园与清泉中嬉戏！
distar.1014.desc.en: We have finally settled the Mardak Vol's paradise world, Paridayda, and our citizens are rejoicing at the thought that one day their [From.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] too may frolic among the sandy dunes, lush gardens and crystal springs of [utopian_planet.GetName]!!

distar.1016.desc.zh: 沃尔族在帝国安全方面可不敢有丝毫的大意，在他们用自己的全部核武力量攻击帕丽达雅并将马达克·沃尔族那美丽富饶的家乡变为一片焦土之后，沃尔族在地表的焦土上洒下杀真菌剂，彻底消灭了马达克·沃尔族。不管马达克是否有危险性，那寄生的真菌体已经不复存在了。
distar.1016.desc.en: The Vol do not gamble with national security. After unleashing their entire nuclear arsenal upon Paridayda, turning the Mardak Vol's formerly lush homeworld into ash, they doused the fiery wreckage in fungicide, dissolving the last remains of the Mardak Vol into a toxic slush. Dangerous or not, the parasitic fungoids are no more.

distar.1020.desc.zh:
在对[From.GetName]轨道上的平台进行研究后，我们发现它是一种复杂且有些古怪的外星设计。其防水机械与先进气候控制表明，它是由一种会分泌大量液体的物种制造的，很可能是软体动物。

在故障之前，它曾用微波束加热恒星大气层的一部分，诱发持续的大规模喷发，可以极大地增加太阳风的流出。这些能源随后由轨道空间站收集。

该平台是按某种非常实验性的概念设计的。
distar.1020.desc.en:
Closer inspection of the platform orbiting [From.GetName] has revealed that it is of a complex, somewhat erratic, alien design. The waterproofed machinery and advanced climate control suggest it was built for a lifeform that secreted a rich amount of fluids, very likely of the molluscoid variety.

Before falling into disrepair, microwave beams were used to heat regions of the star's atmosphere, provoking large sustained eruptions that increased the solar wind outflow significantly. The energy was then harvested with an orbital mine.

The platform is designed around some highly experimental concepts.

distar.1021.a.zh: 一颗只属于我们的太阳能电池！
distar.1021.a.en: A solar battery, just for us!

distar.1021.b.zh: 哎，软体动物……身子软，脑子也软……
distar.1021.b.en: Ah, Mollusks. Mushy bodies, mushy minds...

distar.1021.desc.zh:
在大量修复工作之后，平台已经上线，而恒星现在正向宇宙中喷发大量的能源。但这一路上并非一帆风顺。

当大型微波束初次启动时，工程师们几乎引发了一场连锁反应，后果可能导致一场巨大的恒星爆发，将平台以及星系中所有的星球全都摧毁。原来远古外星蓝图与使用说明中存在着大量计算错误，程度严重到可使平台无法运作。

幸好我们及时发现了错误，并调整了微波束的强度，而太阳风的流出也稳定了下来。
distar.1021.desc.en:
After extensive repairs the platform has been brought online and the star is now hurling massive amounts of energy into the cosmos. But the journey there has not been without its hurdles.

When the giant microwave beams were first activated, the engineers nearly set off a chain reaction that could have ended in a solar eruption so massive it would have blasted the platform and all system planets out of existence. As it turns out, the ancient alien blueprints and manuals were riddled with miscalculations so severe that the platform would have been inoperable.

Luckily the mistakes were caught in time, the strength of the beams has since been calibrated, and the solar wind outflow has been stabilized.

distar.1022.c.zh: 这些软体动物根本就不该捣鼓科学……
distar.1022.c.en: Those Molluscoids had no business doing science...

distar.1022.desc.a.zh: [star_lifting_ship.GetName]的船员们并没有花太多时间就得出结论：这个恒星平台的设计，用科学专员[star_lifting_leader.GetName]的话来说，是疯子的杰作。微波束非常粗劣，未经校准，而且在正常运转之前还需要大量的打磨。不过，它们很快就被证明是上好的武器。
distar.1022.desc.a.en: It did not take the crew of the [star_lifting_ship.GetName] long to conclude that the design of the star platform was, in Science Officer [star_lifting_leader.GetName]'s own words, the work of madmen. The microwave beams were crude, miscalibrated, and would have needed much refinement before they would work as intended. However, they soon proved to make excellent weapons.

distar.1022.desc.b.zh: 我们将软体动物微波束改造成武器的尝试……壮观地失败了。在启动时，我们才发现微波束的设计烂到简直无法用语言形容，最终这一科学的失败化作一团壮观的蘑菇云，而我们的科研团队则在千钧一发之际逃了出来。
distar.1022.desc.b.en: Our attempt to weaponize the Molluscoid microwave beams has failed... spectacularly. On activation, it turned out that the design of the beams was faulty beyond comprehension and the science crew only narrowly escaped the platform as it exploded in a magnificent mushroom-shaped display of scientific failure.

distar.1030.desc.zh: 观测站上的所有数据储存设备都已被清空，并且所有可指向其原主人的证据也都已被小心翼翼地抹去。[big_rip_planet.GetName]上明显出了什么差错。智慧生命曾经存在的唯一迹象，就是散布在星球上的半完成的大都市废墟，似乎在建造中途就被放弃了。
distar.1030.desc.en: All the observation post's data storage units have been wiped and extensive care has been taken to eliminate any evidence that could lead back to its owners. Something clearly went wrong on [big_rip_planet.GetName]. The only signs of intelligent life are the crumbling husks of half-finished megacities, seemingly abandoned mid-construction, scattered across its surface and the looming holotemple in their midst.

distar.1031.desc.zh:
尽管他们拼命试图掩盖，观测者拙劣的干预痕迹仍在[big_rip_planet.GetName]上随处可见……

证据表明，星球上原本居住着一个正在宗教觉醒的过程之中的以灵能相连的植物集体意识。此时一个被称为守门者的神秘外星种族毫无预兆地突然降临。从那时起，这个植物物种就疯狂地痴迷于即将来临的名为“灰色风暴”的世界末日。它们原本和平的信条也扭曲成了自灭的狂信。出于对一个永远不会来临的末日的恐惧，尽管反复尝试强行灌溉，这星系中最古老的物种之一还是在数月之间枯萎殆尽了。
distar.1031.desc.en:
For all their efforts at secrecy, traces of the observers' clumsy meddling are everywhere on [big_rip_planet.GetName]...

Evidence suggests that the planet was inhabited by a psionically linked consciousness of plantoids that were in the midst of a religious awakening, when a mysterious alien race, referred to as the gatekeepers, descended upon them without warning. From that point on the plants became obsessed with the idea of an impending apocalyptic event called 'the Gray Tempest.' Their formerly peaceful religion soon spiraled into a suicide cult. Within a matter of months one of the galaxy's most ancient lifeforms had wilted away for fear of a doomsday that would never come, despite repeated attempts at forced rehydration.

distar.1040.a.zh: 把超级电脑拆了当零件！

distar.1040.a.tooltip.zh: 一台花了上千年都没能解决一个问题的电脑，最好还是拿来造成船壳吧……
distar.1040.a.tooltip.en: A computer that has failed to solve a single problem in a thousand years will serve us better as a new ship hull...

distar.1040.b.zh: 用它来强化我们自己的科研……
distar.1040.b.en: Use it to boost our own research...

distar.1040.b.tooltip.zh: 这需要关闭维持设施的人工智能，并将导致电脑在可预见的未来崩溃。
distar.1040.b.tooltip.en: This requires that we keep the AI maintaining the facility offline and will cause the computer to break down within a foreseeable future.

distar.1040.c.zh: 让它继续那神秘的计算……
distar.1040.c.en: Let it continue its mysterious calculations...

distar.1040.c.tooltip.zh: 我们最好不要打扰它。不管那电脑在尝试解决什么问题，看起来都挺重要的……
distar.1040.c.tooltip.en: We had better not disturb it. Whatever problem the computer is trying to solve, it seems important...

distar.1040.desc.zh:
我们追踪[From.GetName]上散发的异常电磁辐射的来源，发现了一座地下碉堡，里面藏着一台足有一艘战列舰那么大的超级电脑。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]怀疑它可能已经在那存在了上千年，一直都在努力解决一个非常复杂的问题，而其本质仍不明确。

当试着与电脑互动时，他们发现那座似乎被废弃且不设防的设施，事实上受到一个保安人工智能的控制，其最高目的似乎就是将访客烧焦。在终于击败了人工智能之后，它向未知接收者发送了一条信息。
distar.1040.desc.en:
We have traced the unusual electromagnetic radiation emanating from [From.GetName] to a secret subterranean bunker hiding a mega-computer the size of a battleship.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] suspect that it may have been there for several thousand years, hard at work solving a single very complex problem, the nature of which still eludes us.

When attempting to interact with the computer they discovered that the facility, which had appeared both abandoned and unguarded, was in fact operated by a security AI, the highest purpose of which seems to be frying its visitors with extreme prejudice. When the AI was finally defeated, it broadcasted a message to an unknown recipient.

distar.1045.b.tooltip.zh: 胶囊里满是貌似无害的线路，任何一根都可能触发大规模毁灭性武器，摧毁整个星系！船员会将它们全都剪断！
distar.1045.b.tooltip.en: The capsule is full of innocent-looking wires, any one of which could be rigged to set off a weapon of mass destruction so potent that it would wipe out the entire galaxy! The crew will snip them all!!

distar.1045.desc.zh:
在对[From.GetName]周围的残骸场进行细致扫描后，我们发现了一颗气密胶囊，里面有一只计时无比精确的原子钟。

它的频率不确定性低到需要再花八亿七千九百万年才会增加一秒，而且正在朝一个四十二年零三天后的日期倒计时。胶囊里没有记载这个日期代表着什么，或者其主人是谁。不过似乎有人失去时间概念了……
distar.1045.desc.en:
A closer scan of the debris field around [From.GetName] has led to the discovery of an airtight capsule containing an atomic clock that measures time with unparalleled precision.

It has a frequency uncertainty so low that it will be another 879 million years before it gains a single second and it is counting down to a date 42 years and 3 days away. The capsule holds no clues as to what this date signifies or who the owners are. But it seems as though someone out there has lost track of the time...

distar.105.desc.zh:
在对[From.GetName]上的整个生物圈进行了密集的采样与研究后，[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称这种物质并不是该星球上的原生物质，而是一种来源未知的侵入性真菌生命形式。这种真菌以生物物质为食，使周边的植物窒息而亡并笼罩整个地区。

任何打算来这颗星球定居的人都必须将这些外来真菌烧毁——目前尚不清楚这些真菌能不能被彻底清除。
distar.105.desc.en:
After intense study and sampling of the growth blanketing entire biospheres on [From.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the substance is not native to the planet, but rather an invasive fungal lifeform of unknown origin. The fungus feeds on biomatter, choking out existing plant life and enveloping terrain.

Any future settlers on the planet would have to deal with routinely burning back the exofungus - it is unknown at this point if it can be entirely eradicated.

distar.1050.a.zh: 看来他们终于碰到对手了……
distar.1050.a.en: Looks like they finally met their match...

distar.1050.a.tooltip.zh: 已经与星系最美味的外星生物[delicious_aliens.GetName]成功建立起联络。
distar.1050.a.tooltip.en: Communications enabled with the [delicious_aliens.GetName], the galaxy's most delicious aliens.

distar.1050.b.evopred.zh: 不排复杂度排什么口感？真奇怪。
distar.1050.b.evopred.en: Rating by taste rather than complexity? How odd.

distar.1050.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的垃圾场边缘，漂浮着一艘来源不明的破旧科研船。船壳上的咬痕与消化液表明它曾被某种大型食肉动物咀嚼，然后反刍。

讽刺的是，舰船的船员也在进行自己的美食之旅，寻找新的异星美味，结果自己却成了盘中餐。

他们对大量的物种进行了评估，从营养成分到咀嚼口感等各个方面。他们评价最高的物种之一是[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因其[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName]多汁，而且性情暴躁。而我们则在排名底端得了中庸的评价，因为我们的肉嚼起来费劲，而且反抗无力。有些人还真喜欢与食物玩耍……
distar.1050.desc.en:
Floating on the outskirts of the debris field around [From.GetName] is the pitiful form of a crumpled-up science vessel of unidentifiable origin. The presence of bite-marks and digestive fluids on the hull suggest it was chewed up, then regurgitated by some large predator.

Ironically, the ship's crew were on a culinary odyssey of their own, in search of new exotic delicacies, when they themselves ended up on the menu.

They had rated a staggering number of lifeforms on everything from nutritional content to chewiness. Among their top picks were the [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for their juicy [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName] and spicy temperament. We have earned a mediocre placement at the bottom of the list thanks to the stringiness of our flesh and the lackluster quarry we make. Some like to play with their food...

distar.1050.desc_lithoid.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的垃圾场边缘，漂浮着一艘来源不明的破旧科研船。船壳上的咬痕与消化液表明它曾被某种大型食肉动物咀嚼，然后吐了出来。

讽刺的是，舰船上的船员也在进行自己的美食之旅，寻找新的异星美味，结果自己却成了盘中餐。

他们已经从营养成分到咀嚼口感等各个方面对海量物种进行了评估。他们首选的是[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因为[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName]鲜美多汁且性情暴躁。我们在这份列表中排名很低，被归入了一种以星号圈起的特殊类别，因为我们根本不可食用并且毫无猎取的乐趣。有些人还真喜欢与食材玩耍……
distar.1050.desc_lithoid.en:
Floating on the outskirts of the debris field around [From.GetName] is the pitiful form of a crumpled-up science vessel of unidentifiable origin. The presence of bite-marks and digestive fluids on the hull suggest it was chewed up, then regurgitated by some large predator.

Ironically, the ship's crew were on a culinary odyssey of their own, in search of new exotic delicacies, when they themselves ended up on the menu.

They had rated a staggering number of lifeforms on everything from nutritional content to chewiness. Among their top picks were the [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for their juicy [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName] and spicy temperament. We have earned a special category at the bottom of the list surrounded by asterisks, thanks to the utter inedibility of our flesh and the lackluster quarry we make. Some like to play with their food...

distar.1055.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的无数废弃舰船中，我们发现了一艘几乎完好无损的外星科研船。船上的记录揭示，它发生了严重设备故障，在虚空中漂流了142天后，其船员因缺乏营养而逝世。

我们在一张小床上发现了舰长遗骸，他手中握着一颗金属小方块，每一面都有不同的颜色，并分成九个大小相同的可旋转方块。科学专员[Root.Owner.GetScientist][cube_science_officer.GetName]相信，当旋转到正确的图案时，方块将会开启，并揭露隐藏的宝藏。
distar.1055.desc.en:
Among the husks of the derelict starships orbiting [From.GetName] we have discovered an almost intact alien research vessel. The ship's logs reveal that it suffered a critical hardware malfunction and was stuck in limbo for 142 days before the crew perished from malnutrition.

The body of the Captain was found on his cot clutching a small metal cube, each side a different color and split into nine equal rotatable squares. [Root.Owner.GetScientist] [cube_science_officer.GetName] is convinced that when rotated in the correct pattern the cube will open to reveal a hidden treasure.

distar.1056.a.tooltip.en: [cube_science_officer.GetName] will never be the same again.

distar.1056.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的船员们尝试了各种解码算法来对付那金属方块，但都没有任何反应。

“它是不是个密码？隐藏着宝贵物品的容器？”“如果这个方块没有意义，那什么才有意义？”科学专员[cube_science_officer.GetName]疲惫不堪的头脑中闪过了这些念头，最后[cube_science_officer.GetSheHe]终于使出了激光切割这一招，同时也不慎将[cube_science_officer.GetHerHis]的右[From.Owner.GetSpeciesHandName]切成了两半。方块里空空如也。
distar.1056.desc.en:
The crew on the [From.GetName] has subjected the metal cube to every code breaking algorithm known to us and it has responded with nothing but silence.

"Is it a cipher? A container for valuable items?" "If there is no meaning behind this cube, what then is the meaning of anything?" were some of the thoughts that scurried through the overworked mind of Science Officer [cube_science_officer.GetName] when [cube_science_officer.GetSheHe] finally brought out the laser and sliced first the cube, then [cube_science_officer.GetHerHis] right [From.Owner.GetSpeciesHandName] in half. The cube was empty.

distar.1060.a.zh: 这本指南书将鼓舞我们！
distar.1060.a.en: This guide will serve as an inspiration to our people!

distar.1060.b.zh: 肮脏的外星人！人们必须知道它们是游手好闲并乱丢垃圾的不利因素。
distar.1060.b.en: Filthy aliens! Our people must know what a littering, loitering liability they are.

distar.1060.c.zh: 我们现在最好对此保密……
distar.1060.c.en: We had better put a lid on this discovery for now...

distar.1060.desc.zh:
我们似乎遭遇了一种非原生无毛哺乳动物的繁殖地。我们观察到它们在晚间进行高级求偶活动，随后在各种酒精化学物质的作用下，于夜晚的沙滩上亲密地进行对偶结合。

可惜的是，它们意外地发现了我们的舰船，并惊慌失措地搭乘一艘商业舰船逃离了星球，留下了一地的垃圾。我们在其中发现了一本外星旅行指南书——《银河系漫游指南》，描述了许多我们未知的景观与现象。
distar.1060.desc.en:
