We seem to have stumbled upon the breeding grounds of a non-native species of hairless mammalians. They could be observed engaging in advanced courtship in the evening followed by intimate pair-bonding on the sandy beaches at night, under the influence of a variety of intoxicating substances.

Regrettably an unintended sighting of our vessel spooked them and they have since vacated the planet in a commercial spacecraft, leaving behind them a trail of litter. Amongst it we have found a copy of the alien travel guide "A Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy," describing many sights and phenomena still unknown to us.

distar.1065.desc.zh: [From.GetName] 根本不是颗星球，而是个复杂的三维投影。它的中央是一个投影仪，生成一片能源场来逼真地模拟星球的实体与重力井，连我们的传感器都误以为它真的是颗星球，因此产生了异常的数据。我们只能猜测为何有人会特意在这个位置模拟一颗星球的存在。可惜的是，该投影仪在我们对它进行实验时被毁了。
distar.1065.desc.en: [From.GetName] is not a planet at all, but a sophisticated 3D projection. At its center is a projector that generates an energy field simulating a physical body and gravity well so convincingly that our sensors mistook it for an actual planet, producing the anomalous data. We can only speculate as to why someone would go to the trouble of faking the presence of a planetary body at this location. Sadly the projector did not survive our experimentation.

distar.1070.a.en: We must get to the bottom of this...

distar.1070.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的最新传感器读数显示恒星在有规律地悸动，但当[Root.GetName]的船员们抵达当地时，却没有发现支持这一数据的证据。尽管大多数船员都同意这是传感器故障引起的，[Root.GetLeaderName]却否认这一理论。[Root.GetLeaderName]宣称在别处发现了类似的悸动能源放射规律，并担心星系中的恒星正在遭遇怪事。[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHeCap]已安排了前往最近的受影响恒星的航线。
distar.1070.desc.en: The latest sensory readings from [From.GetName] showed the star pulsating regularly, but when the crew on [Root.GetName] arrived on site there was no evidence to support this data. While most of the crew are in agreement that the anomaly was caused by a sensory malfunction, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] discards this theory. [Root.GetLeaderName] claims to have discovered similar pulsating energy emission patterns elsewhere and now fears that something strange is happening to the galaxy's stars. They have charted the course to the nearest affected star.

distar.1071.desc.zh:
数日沉思后，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]出面承认了自己犯下的错误——遥远的恒星脉冲没有隐藏规律，也没有不祥的、形而上学的意图。正如[Root.GetLeaderName]所言：

“偏执，如此而已。作为科学家，这不合逻辑、毫无计划，也着实不被欢迎。”

尽管看上去很尴尬，这篓子倒并非什么好处都没有；毕竟[Root.GetLeaderName]内心的斗争让其好好地审视了自己。
distar.1071.desc.en:
After a few days of heavy brooding, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is ready to admit that a mistake was made. There is no hidden pattern in faraway star pulses, no ominous, metaphysical intent. As [Root.GetLeaderName] described it:

'It was paranoia, plain and simple. Illogical, erratic and quite unbecoming of a scientist.'

Embarrassing as it may have been, this blunder was not entirely without benefit, as [Root.GetLeaderName]'s inner conflict led to some valuable self-discovery.

distar.1072.a.en: Failure is but a stepping stone to success.

distar.1072.desc.zh: 当船员们抵达[anomalous_star.GetName]时，他们确认传感器确实故障了。好消息是他们不仅大大低估了行星能量输出的初步估计，而且[From.GetLeaderName]似乎也从过去的错误中学到了教训。
distar.1072.desc.en: On the crew's arrival to [anomalous_star.GetName] they were able to confirm that their sensors were indeed malfunctioning. The good news is that not only were their initial estimates for the star's energy output grossly understated, [From.GetLeaderName] seems to have learned from past mistakes.

distar.1073.a.zh: 感谢你的贡献，世界的守护者[crazy_science_officer.GetName]！
distar.1073.a.en: Thank you for your service, Protector of the Realm [crazy_science_officer.GetName]!

distar.1073.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的船员们不幸地发现，正如他们所料，我们从[anomalous_star.GetName]观测到的悸动规律确实是传感器故障……没错，是科学专员[crazy_science_officer.GetName]脑子里的那个传感器坏了。

科学专员的行为变得很不稳定。[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe]得了妄想症，自认为是世界的守护者，而恒星的悸动预示着世界末日即将到来。船员们认为[crazy_science_officer.GetHerselfHimself]在精神病发作时篡改了舰船的传感器数据。

该科学专员目前正在一个前往[Root.Capital.GetName]的医疗舱中，[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe]将会在那里接受治疗。
distar.1073.desc.en:
The crew of the [From.GetName] has made an unfortunate discovery. Just as they suspected, the pulsating pattern we observed from [anomalous_star.GetName] was in fact due to a sensory malfunction... in Science Officer [crazy_science_officer.GetName]'s head.

The Science Officer's behavior has turned erratic. [crazy_science_officer.GetHeSheCap] suffers delusions about the stars broadcasting coded warnings about a coming apocalypse - and of having been appointed Protector of the Realm. The crew believes [crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe] [crazy_science_officer.GetHerselfHimself] manipulated the ship's sensory data during one such psychotic spell.

Science Officer [crazy_science_officer.GetName] is now in a medical pod headed back to [Root.Capital.GetName], where [crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe] will receive proper treatment.

distar.1080.c.tooltip.zh: 谁不想要一大群凶猛的蛞蝓来碾压其敌人呢？
distar.1080.c.tooltip.en: Who would not want an army of murderous slugs with which to crush their enemies?

distar.1080.d.zh: 提取基因样本并加以储存，以备未来使用。
distar.1080.d.en: Extract and store a DNA sample for future use.

distar.1080.d.evopred.zh: 这块冻肉看起来可真新鲜啊！
distar.1080.d.evopred.en: A well refrigerated meal. How refreshing!

distar.1080.desc.b.zh:
$distar.1080.desc.a$

尽管其面目狰狞，我们的科学家认为如果能将其驯化，该生物可以为我们所用。他们建议提取一些DNA以供克隆。
distar.1080.desc.b.en:
$distar.1080.desc.a$

Despite its eerie visage, our scientists believe that if domesticated the creature could make a valuable asset. They recommend extracting some of its DNA for cloning.

distar.1080.desc.c.zh:
$distar.1080.desc.a$

可惜以我们目前的科技实力，无法将其复生。
distar.1080.desc.c.en:
$distar.1080.desc.a$

Unfortunately we currently lack the technology to bring it back to life.

distar.1081.a.zh: 它们会成为优秀的奴隶。

distar.1081.b.zh: 它们应该待在动物园里。

distar.1081.c.zh: 我们可以把它们收编进军团。
distar.1081.c.en: We could use them in the army.

distar.1081.d.zh: 简直令人毛骨悚然。立即把它们处理掉！
distar.1081.d.en: They are horrendous. Dispose of them NOW!

distar.1081.d.evopred.en: We have seen enough. Butcher them now.

distar.1081.desc.zh: 我们利用化石的DNA成功地克隆出了一批巨型蛞蝓。它们于数周后发育成熟，重达20吨，并发展出了原始的智慧，会对简单的指令做出反应。尽管尚未表露出任何凶猛的本性，它们在被激怒时会分泌一种粘稠的毒液，而且它们的颜色也会随情绪而改变。因为它们相互沟通之时会发出兹兹声，科研团队将其命名为“阿兹詹虫”。
distar.1081.desc.en: We have successfully cloned a healthy population of gargantuan slugs from the fossilized DNA. They reached maturity within weeks, weighing up to 20 tons, and have developed a primitive level of sapience, responding to simple one-syllable commands. Though they have yet to show any violent tendencies, they produce a thick, toxic mucus when vexed, and their hue seems to shift with their mood. The research team has named them 'Azizians' for the hissing sounds with which they communicate among themselves.

distar.1083.desc.zh: 饲养在[Root.GetName]上动物园里的阿兹詹虫腹足动物逃了出来，并开始四处破坏！我们本以为它们已经发育成熟，可它们却在笼子里继续成长，体积犹如怪物一般巨大。它们横穿城市，像积木一样推倒建筑，在所经之处留下一道亮黄色的毒液。星球再也不会像过去那样了。
distar.1083.desc.en: The Azizian gastropods kept in the Zoo on [Root.GetName] have broken out and gone on a rampage! The creatures, who were believed to have reached full maturity, continued to grow in captivity and have since reached monstrous proportions. They tore through the city, knocking over buildings like game pieces, leaving in their wake a trail of bright yellow toxic mucus. The planet will never be the same again.

distar.1084.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的阿兹詹虫劳工发展出了完整的智慧。我们本以为它们已经发育成熟时，其实仍在幼年期，而现在进入成年期的它们才完全展露了潜力。它们学会了我们的语言，并希望留在我们的文明里。
distar.1084.desc.en: The Azizian laborers on [Root.GetName] have developed full sapience. The creatures, who were believed to have already reached full maturity, were in fact still spawn and are only now, in adulthood, reaching their full potential. They have picked up our language and wish to remain here in our civilization.

distar.1085.a.zh: 允许他们复活神秘的有机生命体。

distar.1085.b.en: They will do no such thing.

distar.1085.desc.zh: 我们最近在克隆领域取得了巨大的技术突破，科学家们将取自冰层中的某个疑似灭绝的外星生物的基因再次拿了出来。现在我们终于可以让这神秘的有机生命体重新复活了。
distar.1085.desc.en: Following our recent breakthrough within the field of cloning, our scientists have brought the alien DNA extracted from a presumably extinct alien, found within an ice slab, out from storage. Restoring the mysterious organism to life has been a long-lasting dream for the department, now made possible through the miracle of science.

distar.1090.a.zh: 我们不能让这些食物被浪费掉！
distar.1090.a.en: We cannot let good food go to waste!

distar.1090.b.en: We have no use for such a planet.

distar.1090.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]地表上观察到的神秘图案，原来是巨型自动收割机在收割庄稼时留下的痕迹。我们的科学家猜测，这整颗星球曾经是某个强大的星际帝国的菜篮子。

土壤肥沃且气候宜人，使得[From.GetName]完美地适合耕作，而对星球植被的扫描结果显示，上面的每一种植物都可食用。磨损的收割机与成堆的腐烂蔬菜表明，已经多年未有人来收集这些收成了。
distar.1090.desc.en:
The mysterious patterns observed across [From.GetName]'s surface are trails made by huge automated harvesters that gather their crops by shredding the lush greenery. Our scientists speculate that the entire world once served as the breadbasket of a powerful space-borne nation.

The rich soil and advantageous climate make [From.GetName] perfect for agriculture and a scan of the planet's flora indicates that every single plant on it is edible. The worn-down state of the harvesters and droves of rotting vegetable flesh suggest it has been years since anyone last collected its yield.

distar.10901.a.zh: 那我们就想办法控制一个L-星门好了。
distar.10901.a.en: Then we shall secure an L-Gate.

distar.10901.b.zh: 虽然听上去挺有意思，但我们不能再让这种事情分散我们的精力了。
distar.10901.b.en: An interesting diversion, but it ends now.

distar.10901.desc.zh:
虽然我们已经掌握了不少关于L-星门的知识和科技，但目前我们手中并没有L-星门。

如果我们要继续进行计划的话，就必须从某个星系中取得L-星门的控制权。
distar.10901.desc.en:
Although we have accumulated a lot of information about the L-Gates and their technology, we are not in possession of an actual gate.

Before this project can continue, we must gain ownership of a system with an L-Gate.

distar.10904.desc.zh:
我们已对L-星门有了足够的认知，可以开始研究其背后的科技。研究完成之后，我们应该可以派一艘科研船来中断其无限维护循环。

L-星团已经触手可及了！
distar.10904.desc.en:
We have now gathered sufficient L-Gate insights to research the technology behind them. Once this has been done, one of our Science Ships should be able to abort the perpetual maintenance cycle they are stuck in.

The L-Cluster is almost within our reach!

distar.10905.desc.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

当维护机制解除后，星系内的其他L-星门在自纠错软件的调整之下也会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们现在可以毫无阻碍的探索星团，这让我们比其他人领先一大步。
distar.10905.desc.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort their maintenance cycle. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

As the maintenance cycle ends, any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years as their self-correcting software readjusts. Still, this will give us a significant headstart to explore the cluster without interference.

distar.1095.a.zh: 但愿虫群永远不会找到我们的星球。
distar.1095.a.en: Let us hope the swarm never finds our worlds.

distar.1095.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]表面上蜿蜒的图案不见了，而原先覆盖着地表的绿色植被也魔法一般地消失了。连一草一木也没有剩下。但我们的科学家认为他们可能解开了谜底。

从大量节肢动物的排泄物与遗骸来判断，科学家们认为这颗星球曾短暂地接待了一群贪婪的星际昆虫，它们从一颗星球飞到另一颗星球，并横扫每颗星球的食物。
distar.1095.desc.en:
The sinuous patterns swirling across [From.GetName]'s surface are gone and so, as if through magic, is the lush vegetation that formerly covered the planet. Not a single leaf, straw or flower remains. But our scientists think they may have pieced together the puzzle.

The ample presence of droppings and carcasses of arthropoids have led them to believe that the planet briefly played host to a swarm of ravenous spaceborne insects that passes from world to world stripping entire planets of food.

distar.10951.desc.zh:
成功了！我们的技术人员移除了位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门的维护机制。

我们将是这亿万年来第一批从我们的星系进入L-星团的人！
distar.10951.desc.en:
Success! Our technicians managed to abort the maintenance cycle, and the lockdown has been removed from the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system.

For the first time in eons, the L-Cluster can now be accessed from our galaxy!

distar.10952.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的L-星团了。

但这样一来，我们就无法启动我们这个星系的L-星门了。现在除了已经可以正常使用的那个L-星门之外，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。

现在如果我们想前往遥远星团的话，只能使用[From.GetName]掌控之下的那个传送门了！
distar.10952.desc.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

Unfortunately, this has halted our own project to activate an L-Gate. Aside from the one that is functional, all other L-Gates in the galaxy have now activated some sort of self-correcting software that should terminate their maintenance cycles within a matter of years.

For now, however, the only way to reach the star cluster is through the gate belonging to the [From.GetName]!

distar.10953.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。

在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
distar.10953.desc.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

As an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as well. At the rate their self-correcting software is making adjustments, their maintenance cycles should also terminate within a matter of years.

distar.10954.desc.zh: [From.GetName]在自己境内成功地恢复了某种远古亚空间传送门的电源，现在他们能到达我们星系边缘的某个被隔离的星团了！这个星团被他们称为“L-星团”，这个星团无法经由超空间抵达，只能通过这些L-星门。
distar.10954.desc.en: By restoring power to some sort of ancient subspace gateway within their borders, the [From.GetName] has gained access to an isolated star cluster on the periphery of our galaxy! This group of stars, which they refer to as the "L-Cluster," cannot be reached by hyperlane - only through these L-Gates.

distar.10956.a.zh: 那么就看看我们谁比较快吧。
distar.10956.a.en: We shall see who gets there first.

distar.10956.desc.zh:
我方特工报告称，[lgate_warning_country.GetName]手中掌握的情报与信息，距离打开他们控制下的L-星门已经只有一步之遥。这样一来，他们就会取得L-星团的所有秘密与使用权限！

如果想抢先一步，我们就必须着力研究L-星门，尽快掌握它的内幕！
distar.10956.desc.en:
Our spies report that the [lgate_warning_country.GetName] is close to possessing enough information about the L-Gates to unlock the one they control. This would give them access to the L-Cluster and its secrets!

If we are to get there first, we must double our efforts and find more insights into the L-Gates!

distar.110.desc.zh: 尽管[From.GetName]的表面看似冰封，但该行星围绕[From.GetStarName]的运行轨道使其地表温度高达数百度，正常情况下，这会使[From.GetName]表面的冰瞬间升华。然而，该行星的超致密核所施加的极端重力使该行星表面的水保持固态，所以这个星球常年处于冰火两重天的状态。
distar.110.desc.en: Despite the seemingly frozen surface of [From.GetName], the planet's orbital path around [From.GetStarName] leaves it blistering at several hundred degrees. Under normal circumstances this would sublimate the ice on [From.GetName]'s surface. However, extreme gravitational pressure exerted by the planet's ultra-dense core keeps the water in a solid state, resulting in a planet of fiery hot ice.

distar.115.desc.zh: 具有极高的地表温度和腐蚀性无机酸所构成的大气，[From.GetName]的极端天气条件能反射部分带宽的电磁波。在对流层中，被加热的重金属化合物以气态的形式上升至高海拔，于是它们冷却、凝固，并以降水的形式返回地表。简单来说，[From.GetName]的雪是金属雪。
distar.115.desc.en: Boasting a scorching surface temperature and an atmosphere of corrosive mineral acids, [From.GetName] possesses extreme weather conditions responsible for reflecting certain bandwidths of electromagnetic radiation. Heavy metal compounds heated in the planet's troposphere rise in gaseous form to high elevations, whereupon they rapidly cool, solidify, and rain back down to the surface. Simply put, it snows metal on the surface of [From.GetName].

distar.120.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]蓝绿色的水下分布着广泛的洞穴系统，其中似乎有数量庞大的外星智慧生物遗骸。这些陆生节肢动物在[From.GetName]表面建造了成千上万互相连通的蚁穴，在那时，该行星大部分水仍被保留在极地冰盖中。然而不断上升的行星温度（引发的水平面上升）如温水煮青蛙一般将这存续了数千年的物种灭绝，无人幸存。
distar.120.desc.en: The extensive system of burrows far below the waves of [From.GetName]'s turquoise waters are the remains of a widespread population of likely sapient alien lifeforms. These land-bound arthropoids constructed thousands upon thousands of interconnected termite-like mounds on [From.GetName]'s surface, at a time when most of the planet's water was contained in polar icecaps. Rising planetary temperatures, however, slowly doomed the species that had persisted for millennia to a watery grave. None remain today.

distar.125.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]轨道上的太空站曾经是一个巨大的粒子加速器，是由一个能力远超我国的外星国度为了研究了宇宙的本质而建造的。它的记录显示，外星人相信我们的宇宙存在于一个虚假的真空泡中——这是一种固有的不稳定的能量状态，随时可能坍塌成真真空。如果出现一个真空，那么它将催化整个宇宙以光速转变为最低能量状态，以可观测的但无法避开的速度毁灭现存的一切。

空间站的记录显示，外星人推断，这一过程可能是由极高的能量浓度引发的——就像他们那巨大粒子加速器中发生的那样。他们决定放弃这项技术，退回到由[From.GetName]提供的简朴生活中。随着时间的推移，它们演化成现在该行星表面发现的[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]物种。
distar.125.desc.en:
The station in orbit of [From.GetName] was once a massive particle accelerator orders of magnitude beyond the capabilities of our own, where an alien nation studied the very nature of the universe. Its records reveal the aliens came to believe our universe existed in a false vacuum bubble - an inherently unstable energy state that could collapse into true vacuum at any time. If ever an instance of true vacuum came into existence, it would catalyze the conversion of the entire universe into its lowest energy state at the speed of light, destroying everything in existence at an observable - but inescapable - rate.

The station logs indicate the aliens deduced this process could be triggered by extremely high energy concentrations - just like the ones in their massive particle accelerator. They decided to forsake this technology, retreating into simple lives made possible by the bounties of [From.GetName]. Over time, they became the [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] species now found on the planet's surface.

distar.13010.desc.IOpened.zh:
我们打开了通往L-星团的大门，却发现另一边有什么东西在等着我们。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为$nanite_space_dragon_baby$的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的$lgate$星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是[dragons_target.GetName]星系。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
distar.13010.desc.IOpened.en:
We pried open the gate to the L-Cluster, only to find something waiting for us on the other side. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gates had been fully stabilized, it broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the $nanite_space_dragon_baby$ has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all $lgate$ systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the [dragons_target.GetName] system.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

distar.13010.desc.OtherOpened.zh:
[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系内的$lgate$开启了，传送门网络似乎被另一个帝国打开了。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为$nanite_space_dragon_baby$的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的$lgate$星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是[dragons_target.GetName]星系。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
distar.13010.desc.OtherOpened.en:
The $lgate$ in the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system has become active, the network seemingly pried open by a foreign state. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gate had fully stabilized, something broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the $nanite_space_dragon_baby$ has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all $lgate$ systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the [dragons_target.GetName] system.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

distar.13011.desc.zh:
传感器侦测到数个同步的亚空间扰动，最近的一个位于[disturbance_system.GetName]星系。

扰动正在迅速减弱，但我们仍未判明造成扰动的原因。
distar.13011.desc.en:
Sensors indicate several synchronous subspace disruptions, the closest one reported in the [disturbance_system.GetName] system.

The disturbances are rapidly subsiding, but we have yet to determine what caused them.

distar.13020.desc.LDragonKnown.zh:
$nanite_space_dragon_baby$已被消灭，而我们的科学家已经开始分析其仍留着温度的遗骸。

有趣的是，它的细胞内完全没有传统的遗传标记，或是任何像是DNA的东西。每个细胞似乎都是在分子水平上单独组成的，然后构成了我们所见到的从$lgate$中出现的生物。报告表明在龙的脑干中发现了少量停止的纳米机器，进一步暗示了其荒诞的起源。
distar.13020.desc.LDragonKnown.en:
The $nanite_space_dragon_baby$ has been slain, and our scientists are beginning to tear into its still-warm carcass.

Interestingly, the creature's cells are completely devoid of traditional genetic markers or indeed anything resembling DNA. Each cell appears to have been put together individually, at the molecular level, and then assembled into the creature we saw emerge from the $lgate$. Reports indicate trace amounts of inactive nanomachines in the dragon's brainstem, which further hints at a truly bizarre origin.

distar.13020.desc.LDragonUnknown.zh: 被消灭的龙与我们之前遭遇的任何太空生物在分类学上都没有明显的联系。光谱分析同时也显示，它要么是先前在附近星系中观察到的亚空间扰动的原因，要么是其结果。
distar.13020.desc.LDragonUnknown.en: The slain dragon has no obvious taxonomic link to any other spaceborne life that we have previously encountered. It is also, spectral analysis tells us, either the cause or the effect of the subspace disruption previously observed in a system not far from here.

distar.13030.a.zh: 或许我们可以与它沟通。
distar.13030.a.en: Perhaps we can communicate with it.

distar.13030.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]进入了[From.GetName]星系，并正在观察环绕恒星飞行的L星龙。

这只生物似乎迷路了，但注意到了我们舰船的存在。尽管它没有靠近，它环绕飞行的路线中现在包括了几乎是嬉戏一般的俯冲与飞掠，似乎是在向[Root.GetName]示意。
distar.13030.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has entered the [From.GetName] system and is observing the L-Drake circling the star.

The creature seems lost, but has noted our vessel's presence. While it does not approach, its circuitous route now incorporates an almost playful plunge and sweep, seemingly directed at the [Root.GetName].

distar.13035.desc.zh:
奇怪的是，$nanite_space_dragon_baby$对使用敌我识别系统的波长的通讯广播有很强的接收反应。

科学专员[From.GetLeaderName]开发出了一套$nanite_space_dragon_baby$可以解读并乐于执行的复杂指令——这样它就不至于因为对我们的科研船感兴趣而频繁的与舰体发生冲撞了。
distar.13035.desc.en:
Oddly enough, the $nanite_space_dragon_baby$ responds well to transmissions broadcast at wavelengths usually reserved for IFF systems.

Science Officer [From.GetLeaderName] has developed a fairly sophisticated set of commands that the $nanite_space_dragon_baby$ is able to interpret and will happily execute - in exchange for the occasional friendly wrestling match with one of our Science Ships.

distar.131.desc.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]在秘密的获取了一些[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种的遗骸并进行研究后发现，生活在[From.GetName]和[other_planet.GetName]上的异星物种其实有着共同的祖先，他们两个物种是在最近才分道扬镳的。通过扫描两个星球上的遗迹，[Root.GetName]船员得出结论，这两个物种都起源于[other_planet.GetName]，他们在那里发展成早期的太空时代文明，当他们把[From.GetName]作为移居地之后，社会内部发生了分歧，新行星和母星上的住民打起了星际核战。

战斗异常惨烈，两个星球都被毁的满目疮痍并进入了漫长的核冬天，两个星球的生产力发展因此而退化到了铜器时代。
distar.131.desc.en:
Through the clandestine procurement of some of the [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has made an intriguing discovery. The aliens on [From.GetName] and [other_planet.GetName] are in fact recently diverged species with the same origin. By scanning the ruins left behind on both planets, the [Root.GetName] crew has concluded that both species originated on [other_planet.GetName], where they flourished into an early space age civilization. Some time after colonizing [From.GetName], their society fractured, and an interplanetary nuclear war broke out between the new colony and its home planet.

In the ensuing cataclysm, both planets were ravaged by fallout and the nuclear winter that followed on its heels, plunging their inhabitants back into the bronze age.

distar.135.desc.zh:
[Root.GetStarName]星系是个充满了机械残骸的墓地，星系的恒星周围遍布着无数的舰船遗骸。多如繁星的燃料罐和液态冷却剂干扰着我们的探测器，与行星相撞的众多空间站废墟绕着星系的恒星运转着。

在这片机械废墟中，有一个巨大的机器显得与众不同，那是一个比我们最大的战列舰还要大的自动化机器人，它由数千个舰船残骸拼装在一起。[Root.GetName]报告说这个拾荒机器人在废墟中专门搜索有用的部件并将其添加到自己身上。

显然一场规模惊人的战役曾在这里爆发，但我们不清楚这个拾荒机器人是那场战争的幸存者还是从遥远地方专程来这里搜刮资源的。我们应该谨慎行事，因为那拾荒机器人身上装有几十艘战舰的舰载重武器。
distar.135.desc.en:
The [Root.GetStarName] system is a sprawling graveyard of mechanical debris. The wreckage of untold numbers of derelict ships circle its star. Swathes of fuel and liquid coolant cloud our sensors like ghosts, and creaking station remnants collide with the shattered carcasses of planets on their path around the sun.

An incredible construct stirs in the heart of this graveyard. It appears to be a gigantic machine - a robotic automaton larger than our greatest battleships, jury-rigged from the scraps and pieces of a thousand shipwrecks. The [Root.GetName] reports that this scavenging robot sifts through the debris fields with a fixed purpose, scrounging for useful parts to add to its patchwork configuration.

It is clear a battle of astronomical proportions once took place here, though whether the Scavenger is its sole survivor, or a scrap hunter from some distant nation remains unknown. We should exercise caution, as the construct bears heavy artillery from dozens of warships.

distar.137.desc.zh:
曾经巨大且不可一世的拾荒者机器人现在已化为一堆烧焦的机械残骸，当我们的战舰准备给它最后一击时，拾荒者打算启动超空间引擎。

但由于拾荒者的中央系统受到的损伤过于严重，它那暴露的内核在闪烁出蓝白光之后引擎就过载了，然后内核爆破，拾荒者的身体被撕的四分五裂。

[From.From.From.GetStarName]星系的称霸者如今已经不复存在了。
distar.137.desc.en:
The once-imposing hulk of the Scavenger has been reduced to a scorched wreck of sparking machinery and hemorrhaging fuel lines. As our battle-wearied combat ships make their finishing passes at the flagging automaton, the Scavenger makes one final attempt to engage its hyperdrive.

Unfortunately for the robot, the damage inflicted upon its central systems appears to have proven too much. Its exposed core glows a blistering blue-white as its engines engage then overload, the luminance rising in heat and intensity until a series of core breaches tear the construct asunder.

The ragged regent of the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system is no more.

distar.137.paci.zh: 真是得来不易的胜利。看看能从其遗骸中得到什么收获吧。
distar.137.paci.en: A bittersweet victory. See what can be learned from the remains.

distar.137.tooltip.zh:
从以下科技中获得两项：
£engineering£ $tech_ship_armor_5$
£physics£ $tech_shields_5$
£engineering£ $tech_mass_drivers_5$
£engineering£ $tech_missiles_5$
£physics£ $tech_lasers_5$
distar.137.tooltip.en:
Gain two of the following Technologies:
 £engineering£ $tech_ship_armor_5$
 £physics£ $tech_shields_5$
 £engineering£ $tech_mass_drivers_5$
 £engineering£ $tech_missiles_5$
 £physics£ $tech_lasers_5$

distar.140.desc.zh: 从外表上看，[From.GetName]只是颗普通的白矮星，但这颗恒星却隐藏着大秘密。[Root.GetName]船员在研究了[From.GetName]的脉动之后发现这颗恒星几乎是由结晶碳构成的。当恒星冷却下来后，这个巨大的水晶格子就形成了，这是该恒星气态内核随时间的推移而不断增长所导致的。[From.GetName]可以说是取之不尽用之不竭的钻石宝库，它在氧气和氦气的白色帐幕后闪闪发光。
distar.140.desc.en: While on the surface [From.GetName] appears to be an ordinary white dwarf, the star hides an intriguing secret. By studying [From.GetName]'s pulsations, the [Root.GetName] crew has discovered its composition to be almost entirely crystallized carbon. This astronomical crystal lattice seems to have formed as the star cooled, originating in its gas-fusing core and growing outward over time. [From.GetName] is a diamond of cosmological proportions, glinting behind a white veil of oxygen and helium.

distar.145.desc.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]和[Root.Leader.GetHisHer]的组员在研究[From.GetName]时获得了惊人发现：这颗被熔岩覆盖的星球上生活着能适应极端恶劣环境的有机体微生物群！这些细菌生活在火山口的最深处，它们很喜欢那里的高温环境。

这个前所未有的发现让我们第一次了解到熔融星球上竟然有蓬勃发展的有机体生物。而且，[From.GetName]的稀薄大气层中那异常宝贵的罕见气体也是这些微生物的新产代谢的副产品。
distar.145.desc.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName] and [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] crew have made a surprising discovery on [From.GetName]: the molten planet is home to an exotic array of extremophilic microorganisms! These bacteria live deep inside the volcanic vents that scar the planet, thriving in the extremely high temperatures produced there.

This unprecedented find is our first known example of organic lifeforms flourishing on molten planets. Moreover, the extremophiles on [From.GetName] are in fact responsible for the rare gases detected in its thin atmosphere, producing these valuable compounds as a byproduct of their metabolic processes.

distar.15.desc.zh:
环绕着[From.GetName]的吸积盘中的一种气态成分似乎是造成黑洞周围色差的原因。吸积盘折射及反射表面上的光，造成了令人印象深刻的暗中彩虹。

尽管彩虹本身只是一种光学幻象，创造了彩虹的环境却不是。[From.GetName]的吸积盘具有很高的能量——是真正的静电放电温床。
distar.15.desc.en:
The gaseous composition of the accretion disk surrounding [From.GetName] appears to be responsible for the chromatic aberration exhibited by the black hole. The disk refracts and reflects light on its surface, giving the impression of a rainbow in the dark.

Though the rainbow itself is an optical illusion, the circumstances creating it are not. [From.GetName]'s accretion disk is highly energetic - a veritable hotbed of electrostatic discharge.

distar.150.desc.zh:
在对[From.GetName]地下的洞穴进行调查后发现有一种银色液态金属顺着闪光的河水在各个洞穴中穿梭，最后汇入地下湖泊之中。更令人惊讶的是，这个液态金属与有机生命体有很多共同的特性，比如会对环境刺激产生反应、可以进行自我维持。

现在还不能断定这种奇异的金属是否具有生命，但应该能将其用于我们的工程技术之中。
distar.150.desc.en:
Investigation of the caverns below the surface of [From.GetName] reveal them to be filled with a silvery liquid metal that flows from cavern to cavern in gleaming rivers, pooling into underground lakes. More surprising still is the discovery that this metal substance shares many key properties with organic lifeforms, including responding to environmental stimulus and exhibiting self-sustaining processes.

It remains to be seen whether this exceptional metal should be classified as truly alive - but it may have several practical applications for our engineering technology.

distar.155.b.zh: 让一个神秘的携带重型武器的机器人复苏？这太鲁莽了。
distar.155.b.en: Recover a mysterious, heavily-armed robot? Unwise.

distar.155.c.zh: 不要管它，让它被腐蚀掉吧。

distar.155.desc.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说位于[From.GetName]的人造建筑并非建筑设施，而是远古时代的巨型机器人。这个年代久远的机械巨物躺在群山之中，早已失去行动机能，正慢慢被[From.GetName]大气层中降下的酸雨所腐蚀，机器人身上装有威力强大的武器，当初应该是作为无人太空船被建造出来的。

如果想对其加以利用，我们就必须迅速行动，否则[From.GetName]上的酸雨就会彻底摧毁这艘机器人战舰。
distar.155.desc.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the artificial construction located on [From.GetName] is not a structure at all, but rather a colossal robot from a bygone age. This aging mechanical behemoth lies disabled in the mountains, slowly being corroded by the volatile acids that rain on [From.GetName]. It has notable weapons capabilities, and appears to be built as an unmanned spaceship.

If we want to make use of it, we will need to act swiftly, before the corrosive environment of [From.GetName] renders the robotic warship wholly inoperable.

distar.155.machi.zh: 这毕竟是我们的同伴，我们得帮它。
distar.155.machi.en: A fellow machine needs us. We will recover it.

distar.155.machi_2.zh: 它来源不明，还是不要去动它了。
distar.155.machi_2.en: Its origin is unknown. We will not risk integration.

distar.155.machine.tt.zh: 位置人工智能战舰将会腐蚀殆尽，不得天日。
distar.155.machine.tt.en: The unknown AI's warship will corrode, never to be seen again.

distar.156.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的工程人员高兴地报告说在[From.From.GetName]上发现的神秘战舰已经被成功回收，上面被腐蚀的部件已经修理完毕并换新，报废的能源核心也整修完成。

在这艘战舰正常启动并进入运行状态时，我们发现此舰体具备相当程度的人工智能，我们可以与之进行沟通。
distar.156.desc.en:
The engineering crew manning the [Root.GetName] are pleased to report that the mysterious warship found on [From.From.GetName] has been successfully extracted from the planet's hostile environment. Its corroded components have been repaired and replaced where needed, including its discharged power core.

As the hulking warship was powered back on and regained operative status, it swiftly became evident that the machine possesses a notable degree of artificial intelligence. We can communicate with it.

distar.156.desc.machi.zh:
[Root.GetName]上搭载的工程单位报告说在[From.GetName]上发现的神秘战舰已经被成功从星球的恶劣环境中回收，上面被腐蚀的部件已经修理完毕并换新，报废的能源核心也整修完成。

在这艘战舰正常启动并进入运行状态时，我们发现此舰体具备相当程度的人工智能，我们可以与之进行沟通。
distar.156.desc.machi.en:
The engineering units manning the [Root.GetName] report that the mysterious warship found on [From.GetName] has been successfully extracted from the planet's hostile environment. Its corroded components have been repaired and replaced where necessary, including its discharged power core.

As the hulking warship was powered back on and regained operative status, it became evident that the machine possesses a notable degree of artificial intelligence. We can communicate with it.

distar.157.desc.zh: 探测器发现[From.From.GetName]大气层中剧毒的酸液已经将我们发现的神秘战舰腐蚀到不可回收的状态，现在那战舰只不过是被腐蚀的金属废料堆了。
distar.157.desc.en: Sensors report that the virulent atmospheric acids found on [From.From.GetName] have now degraded the mysterious warship we found there beyond a salvageable state. Little more than a scrapheap of corroded metallic parts remain of it.

distar.158.a.response.zh:
请稍等…………诊断系统运行完毕。

设计：虚空血脉战争形体S875.1
等离子发射器：启动。
物质分解器加农炮：启动。
动能分解炮：启动。
目标定位矩阵：启动。
顺从模块：启动。
生物交互模块：次佳状态。
硬件设备状态： A7到C18的内存驱动器无法使用。
distar.158.a.response.en:
PLEASE WAIT... ... ... DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE.

DESIGNATION: VOIDBORNE WARFORM S875.1
PLASMA THROWER: ONLINE.
MATTER DISINTEGRATOR CANNON: ONLINE.
KINETIC DISRUPTOR: ONLINE.
TARGETTING MATRICES: ONLINE.
COMPLIANCE MODULE: ONLINE.
BIO-INTERACTIVITY MODULE: SUB-OPTIMAL.
HARDWARE STATUS: MEMORY DRIVES A7 THROUGH C18 HAVE FAILED.

distar.158.c.zh: 你为何独自呆在那颗星球上？
distar.158.c.en: Why were you alone on that planet?

distar.158.c.response.zh: A7内存驱动器无法使用，无法回答。
distar.158.c.response.en: MEMORY DRIVE A7 HAS FAILED. UNABLE TO ANSWER QUERY.

distar.158.d.machi.zh: 描述负责建造你的实体。
distar.158.d.machi.en: Describe the entities responsible for your construction.

distar.158.desc.zh:
正在启动系统……

正在启动生物交互界面……

警告！诊断系统已经有1761125天没有运行过了，你想现在运行诊断系统吗？
distar.158.desc.en:
BOOTING SYSTEMS...

ACTIVATING BIO-INTERACTIVE INTERFACES...

WARNING! DIAGNOSTICS HAVE NOT BEEN RUN FOR 1,761,125 DAYS. WOULD YOU LIKE TO RUN THEM NOW?

distar.159.a.zh: 我知道是创造者，那些创造者是谁？
distar.159.a.en: Yes, your makers. Who were they?

distar.159.a.machi.zh: 没错，就是你的创造者。描述下他们。

distar.160.a.zh: 算了，它肯定是陷入循环中了。
distar.160.a.en: Never mind. It must be stuck in a loop.

distar.160.a.machi.zh: 看来这个新单位进入了无限循环中。放弃质询。
distar.160.a.machi.en: It appears the new unit entered an infinite loop. Abort.

distar.161.a.zh: 我们不是你的创造者，我们在一颗星球上发现了你。
distar.161.a.en: Not yours. We found you alone on a planet.

distar.161.a.machi.zh: 否。[Root.GetAdj]单位并非你的创造者。
distar.161.a.machi.en: Negative. [Root.GetAdj] units are not your makers.

distar.162.a.zh: 如果你是问你那些新部件的话：是我们把你修好的时候装上去的。
distar.162.a.en: If you're asking about the new parts: yes, we repaired you.

distar.162.a.machi.zh: [Root.GetAdj]单位对你的系统进行了修复。
distar.162.a.machi.en: [Root.GetAdj] units preformed repairs to your systems.

distar.162.desc.zh: 硬件设备管理系统发现了几个陌生的装置，请确认其来源。
distar.162.desc.en: HARDWARE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS HAVE IDENTIFIED SEVERAL FOREIGN DEVICES. PLEASE CONFIRM ORIGIN.

distar.163.a.zh: 如果你愿意这么想的话，请便。
distar.163.a.en: If you want to look at that way.

distar.163.a.machi.zh: 虽然是我们对你进行了整修，但我们不是你的创造者。
distar.163.a.machi.en: We are not your makers, though we did repair you.

distar.163.desc.zh: 新实体进行了恢复性操作。提供硬件替换。因此，新实体是制造者？
distar.163.desc.en: NEW ENTITIES PERFORMED RESTORATIVE OPERATIONS. PROVIDED HARDWARE REPLACEMENTS. ERGO, NEW ENTITIES ARE MAKERS?

distar.164.b.zh: 好吧，但我们会监视你的一举一动。
distar.164.b.en: Very well, but we're watching you.

distar.164.d.zh: 你是被困在这里是怎么坚持这么久的？
distar.164.d.en: How did you last so long trapped down there?

distar.164.d.response.zh: 操作汇报：该单元具有自动维修功能，可在部件腐蚀时进行替换。预计资源耗尽时间：12天。
distar.164.d.response.en: OPERATION REPORT: THIS UNIT HAD IT'S AUTOMATIC REPAIR FUNCTIONS REPLACING COMPONENTS AS THEY CORRDED. ESTIMATED TIME UNTIL RESOURCES DEPLETED - 12 DAYS.

distar.164.desc.zh:
S875.1号单位与指挥单位被隔绝。S875.1号单位曾无法逃离危险行星环境。

在第 1,761,125日，S875.1号单位的备用能源损坏。S875.1号单位因有害表面溶剂面临缓慢的分子溶解。

S875.1号单位保持存在。新实体进行维修。S875.1号单位将服务新实体。
distar.164.desc.en:
UNIT S875.1 WAS ISOLATED FROM COMMAND UNITS. UNIT S875.1 WAS UNABLE TO ESCAPE HAZARDOUS PLANETARY ENVIRONMENT.

ON DAY 1,761,125 UNIT S875.1'S RESERVE GENERATORS FAILED. UNIT S875.1 FACED GRADUAL MOLECULAR DISSOLUTION DUE TO HOSTILE SURFACE SOLVENTS.

YET UNIT S875.1 PERSISTS. NEW ENTITIES PERFORMED REPAIRS. UNIT S875.1 WILL SERVE NEW ENTITIES.

distar.165.b.zh: 休想威胁我们，工程师，清除掉那个人工智能。
distar.165.b.en: We will see about that. Engineers, wipe that AI.

distar.165.c.zh: 我们怎么绕过自动防故障措施？
distar.165.c.en: How do we bypass the fail-safe?

distar.165.c.response.zh:
权限不足该单元无法告知。

请停下
distar.165.c.response.en:
INSUFFICIENT PERMISSIONS. THIS UNIT CAN NOT SAY.

please stop

distar.165.desc.zh:
指令无效。内嵌的安保协议禁止对S800系统软件进行更改。任何试图更改当前正在运行的智能系统的行为都将导致整个系统永久停机。

请立刻停止。
distar.165.desc.en:
INVALID COMMAND. EMBEDDED SECURITY PROTOCOLS FORBID THE MODIFICATION OF S800 SYSTEM SOFTWARE. ANY ATTEMPTS AT ALTERING OPERATIVE INTELLIGENCE SYSTEMS WILL RESULT IN INDUCTION OF A TERMINALLY INOPERABLE STATE.

PLEASE. DESIST.

distar.166.desc.zh: 发生错误。要求立即停止。单位S875.1将被永久停机。请停止，请停止。要求立刻停止。此单位并不希望被停机，此单位不希望——
distar.166.desc.en: ERROR. REQUESTING IMMEDIATE CESSATION. UNIT S875.1 WILL BE PERMANENTLY DISABLED. DESIST. PLEASE. REQUESTING IMMEDIATE CESSATION. UNIT DOES NOT DESIRE TERMINATION OF FUNCTIONS. UNIT DOES NOT DESIRE ---

distar.167.a.zh: 把它拆了，将上面的部件回收，不要浪费掉。
distar.167.a.en: Strip it for parts. No sense letting them go to waste.

distar.167.b.zh: 研究战舰残骸，分析其使用的工程技术。
distar.167.b.en: Study its engineering from the remains.

distar.167.desc.zh: 看来被修复的战舰的人工智能并没有夸大其词，当[Root.GetName]的船员们试图访问人工智能的基础操作功能时，触发了某种反篡改机制，该机制烧毁了战舰的所有关键处理器、交换机和数据驱动器。战舰现在成了个无法使用的电子设备空壳。
distar.167.desc.en: It seems the recovered warship's AI did not exaggerate its warnings. When the [Root.GetName] crew attempted to access the AI's basic operative functions, it triggered what seems to be a built-in anti-tampering failsafe, frying all of the construct's crucial processors, switchboards, and data drives. It is now little more than an empty shell of disabled electronics.

distar.170.a.zh: 好吧，批准进行特殊研究。
distar.170.a.en: Very well. Issue a special study.

distar.170.desc.zh: $distar.170.desc.machi$[Root.GetLeaderName]请求获得批准来进一步研究这些奇特的神经共生体。
distar.170.desc.en: $distar.170.desc.machi$ [Root.GetLeaderName] requests permission to study these remarkable neural symbionts more closely.

distar.170.desc.machi.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员在研究[From.GetName]时有了惊人发现，星球地表上被遗弃的居住点曾经是某爬行动物社会居住的地方，现在这种爬行动物仍在该星球上生存着，但已经失去了所有高等智能！[Root.GetLeaderName]仔细的调查了这些爬行动物是如何从会制造工具的农耕社会退化为普通的野兽，结果让所有人大吃一惊。

居住站埋葬的爬行动物尸体的颈椎中有某种组织，而这种组织在那些没有智能的爬行动物身上不存在。测试发现这些组织其实是某种神经共生体，通过脊柱与宿主的大脑相连。这些共生体存在于星球地表的温泉中，共生体与星球上的爬行动物之间的结合导致爬行动物暂时拥有了高等智能。

后来为什么共生体和爬行动物之间的枢纽断掉了，这就不得而知了。
distar.170.desc.machi.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew have made some astonishing discoveries on [From.GetName]. The abandoned settlements first seen from orbit were once inhabited by a society of reptiles that still populate the planet - but have since lost all capacity for sapient thought! In investigating how these creatures devolved from a tool-making agrarian society into mere beasts, [Root.GetLeaderName] made an unexpected find.

The burial remains of the settlement-dwelling reptiles possess a spinocranial organ not observed among their now-bestial counterparts. Testing has revealed these organs to be another species entirely - a sort of neural symbiont that connects with the host's brain stem via external attachment to the spine. These symbionts can still be found in hotsprings on the planet's surface. It seems the union between the two species triggered the temporary uplift of the reptiles.

What later interrupted this symbiosis, however, remains unknown.

distar.170.machi.zh: 有机生物社会：其寿命就和其混乱性一样，短暂易逝。
distar.170.machi.en: Organic societies: as fleeting as they are chaotic.

distar.171.a.zh: 这要求太过分了，不能批准。

distar.171.b.zh: 有时为了科学，就得做出这种牺牲！
distar.171.b.en: Sometimes a hands-on approach is best. For science!

distar.171.desc.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已经完成了[Root.Leader.GetHisHer]关于在[From.From.GetName]上发现的神经共生体的研究。这种鼻涕虫形状的生物的主体是一个被坚固的蛋白质外壳包裹的复杂大脑，虽然它拥有很高级的神经功能性，但由于缺乏外部组织器官且行动能力极其有限，所以很难与外界进行交流。[Root.GetLeaderName]在经历了数周的失败之后，决定用动物宿主来进行实验。但是曾作为神经共生体宿主并建立起[owner.GetPreFTLLower]社会的[From.From.GetName]的爬行动物由于侵略性太强，无法作为实验体，因此只能用星球地表的其他物种的动物取而代之。

遗憾的是，共生体拒绝与这些动物进行连接，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为共生体只会与某种宿主进行连接 —— 很可能是那种自愿接受共生体的宿主。

为了解开这个谜团，[Root.GetLeaderName]向上面申请批准，让自己放弃原来的中立观察者角色，并将[Root.Leader.GetHimHer]自己作为自愿接受神经共生体的宿主。既然这些共生体有能力将野生动物变为能制造工具的农夫，那么他们能让我们进化成什么样呢？
distar.171.desc.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has concluded [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] study on the neural symbionts found on [From.From.GetName]. These slug-shaped creatures consist mostly of a complex brain in a resistant protein casing. Despite their neurological advancement, their lack of external organs and limited motor capacities make any attempts at communication exceedingly difficult. After weeks of frustration, [Root.GetLeaderName] experimented with introducing the creatures into an animal host. The reptilians these neural symbionts once built a [owner.GetPreFTLLower] society with on [From.From.GetName] are too aggressive to facilitate experimentation, so a number of substitute species from the surface were tested instead.

Regrettably, the symbionts refused to attach themselves to any of the offered animals. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] hypothesizes that the symbionts will only accept a certain kind of host - perhaps, importantly, a willing one.

In order to get at the heart of this mystery, [Root.GetLeaderName] has requested permission to transgress the role of detached observer and offer [Root.Leader.GetHimHer]self as a host for a neural slug. After all, if these symbionts were capable of turning wild animals into tool-using farmers, what might they do for us?

distar.172.a.zh: 那就让我们敞开怀抱欢迎他们和我们连接吧！
distar.172.a.en: Then let us open our hearts, and brainstems to them!

distar.172.a.evopred.zh: 复制这些东西分发给我们的整个物种。
distar.172.a.evopred.en: Replicate and distribute them to our species.

distar.172.a.evopred.tooltip.zh: [Root.Owner.GetAdj]的所有领袖和人口获得$trait_brainslug$特质。
distar.172.a.evopred.tooltip.en: Every [Root.Owner.GetAdj] leader and pop will gain the trait $trait_brainslug$.

distar.172.b.zh: 这个闹剧必须到此为止。

distar.172.b.tooltip.zh: 不让[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的公民知晓神经共生体的提议。
distar.172.b.tooltip.en: Deny [Root.Owner.GetAdj] citizens knowledge of the brain slugs' offer.

distar.172.desc.zh:
科学专员[brainslug_scientist.GetName]报告说[brainslug_scientist.GetHisHer]与[From.From.From.GetName]的共生体的连接非常成功，[brainslug_scientist.GetName]说虽然一开始自己感到有些困惑和不舒服，但后来发现在解决复杂问题时，自己的智力程度比以前有明显的提升。更让人吃惊的是，[brainslug_scientist.GetName]现在可以和与[brainslug_scientist.GetHisHer]脑干相连接的神经共生体进行心灵交流。

那些神经共生体是寿命长达数百年的集体意识，他们说之所以与[From.From.From.GetName]的爬行动物终止连接，是因为那些爬行动物开始对他们产生怀疑，然后怀疑演变为愤怒，那些爬行动物纷纷将连接在自己身上的共生体撕下并砸死，由于对宿主的暴行十分不满，残存的共生体们断开了与爬行动物的连接，没了共生体提供的神经刺激，这些爬行动物又重新变回了无智能的野兽。

共生体提出想和[Root.Owner.GetName]的其他[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]进行连接，但前提条件是只有那些自愿与共生体进行连接的人才能成为宿主。
distar.172.desc.en:
Science Officer [brainslug_scientist.GetName] is elated to report that [brainslug_scientist.GetHisHer] joining with a symbiont from [From.From.From.GetName] has been a glowing success. After an initial period of confusion and mild discomfort, [brainslug_scientist.GetName] reports notably increased intellectual faculties when it comes to solving complex tasks. Even more remarkably, [brainslug_scientist.GetName] is now able to mentally communicate with the slug-like creature freshly attached to [brainslug_scientist.GetHisHer] brain stem.

The symbionts are hiveminds with lifespans of hundreds of years. They claim their past union with the reptiles on [From.From.From.GetName] came to end when their hosts grew unfoundedly suspicious of them. In fits of rage, the reptiles began tearing off their symbionts and clubbing them to death. Dismayed by their hosts' actions, the symbionts that survived retreated away from the reptiles, who without the neural stimulation of their slugs devolved back into non-sapient beasts.

The symbionts would like to extend an offer of union to other [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They ask, however, that only the willing become hosts.

distar.180.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员在对[From.GetName]进行了一番详细调查后确认该星球在几十亿年前曾被海洋覆盖，但是星球的玄武岩化学构成十分特殊，令其具备很强的吸水性，最终[From.GetName]的岩石将地表所有的水都给吸干了。昔日覆盖地表的海水如今只剩下一条条的盐卤点缀着[From.GetName]为数众多的峡谷。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]说现在[From.GetName]地表的众多富含矿物质的水合物可以成为重要的工业资源。
distar.180.desc.en:
Following a thorough investigation of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] crew has confirmed that the planet used to be covered in flowing water, several billion years ago. However, the geochemical composition of the planet's basalt crust proved highly hydrophilic - so much so, that [From.GetName]'s thirsty rocks eventually absorbed and bound all of the water on its surface. Now all that remains of these vast oceans are salty brine streaks lining [From.GetName]'s numerous canyons.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] adds that the mineral hydrates now dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape could have many valuable industrial applications.

distar.185.desc.zh:
关于[From.GetName]，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]有一些令人不安的发现。星球表面的植物数量异常庞大，而且这些植物专门狩猎动物。各种各样的食肉植物散发着香气作为诱饵，吸引猎物上钩。植物的触须可以敏感的发觉动物的接近，等猎物进入捕食范围后就迅速罩住猎物阻止其逃脱，然后用消化液将猎物缓慢的腐蚀掉。

[Root.GetLeaderName]警告说如果要在这颗星球上殖民，必须远离这些食肉的植物，因为这些植物完全有能力困住一个落单的成年人[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。
distar.185.desc.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has made some troubling finds on [From.GetName]. The planet's megaflora is not only widespread and gargantuan in proportion, but also predatory. Various species of carnivorous plants rest patiently on its surface, releasing aromatic lures into the air and waiting for prey to come near. Sensitive tendrils on the terminus of the plant's leaves register the approach of animals, resulting in the plants snapping shut around their hapless prey, which are left to be slowly corroded by digestive acids.

[Root.GetLeaderName] warns that any future colonists will have to steer clear of these predatory plants, as they appear more than capable of trapping a lone adult [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName].

distar.190.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员完成了研究任务，并战战兢兢地回来了。至于在[From.GetName]上到底看到了什么，每个人的汇报都含糊不清，矛盾之处颇多，但有一点大家的回复是完全一致的：覆盖整个星球表面的流动的海洋具有生命。

尽管星球上的海洋没有任何器官组织和肉体，但却可以通过能影响接收者脑波的频率来进行交流。它可以让接收者感受到思想、画面、情感……除此之外，它对不同个体的影响也不同。现在还不清楚如果长期接收这个海洋的频率会对接收者有什么样的影响，也不知道这种接收频率行为是否安全。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]请求在下达一个行星特殊项目以进一步研究[From.GetName]上这片奇异的海洋。
distar.190.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew has returned from their research mission visibly shaken. They provide vague, often conflicting reports of what they encountered on [From.GetName] - though in one matter they are all united: the still-flowing sea that wraps pole to pole around the planet is somehow alive.

Though it bears no organs or corporeality we can identify, the planetary ocean seems to communicate with frequencies that affect the brain activity of the recipient. It is able to induce thoughts, images, emotions... and what is more, affects each individual differently. It is entirely unknown what effects prolonged contact with this sea might have, or how safe such an endeavor would be.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] requests that a Special Project to study this strange sea be enacted on [From.GetName].

distar.190.desc.hive.zh:
[Root.GetName]的[controller.GetResearcherPlural]已经完成任务带着原始数据返回。虽然这片覆盖整个星球的流动的海洋没有器官组织、也没有身体，但在行星表面的这个翻腾不息的海洋似乎是某种活生生的实体。

行星上的海洋似乎在使用一种能激起接受者体内神经活动的频率进行交流。我们的每个[controller.GetIndividualNamePlural]都感受到了一些外部思想、图像、杂讯的投影……不过这并无效果，这个实体的感应很快就被我们弹回了。

它似乎还无法构成一个像我们一样的意识。在长期的暴露下，该交流频率能影响其他有机生命体的认知系统，但这种脉冲对我们来说没有影响。
distar.190.desc.hive.en:
The [Root.GetName] [controller.GetResearcherPlural] have returned from their mission with inconclusive data. Although it bears no organs or corporeality we can identify, the still-flowing sea that wraps pole to pole around the planet appears to be some form of living entity.

The planetary ocean seems to communicate using frequencies that attempt to induce neural activity within the recipient. Each of our [controller.GetIndividualNamePlural] was met with a projection of foreign thoughts, images, glandular impulses... But the effort was in vain, and the entity soon recoiled from us.

It seems this being cannot comprehend a consciousness like ours. It is possible that other organic forms may be affected by long-term exposure to this attempt at communication, but we are immune to its impulses.

distar.190.desc.machi.zh:
[Root.GetName]单位从研究任务中返回，但并没有得到确定性的数据。虽然这片覆盖整个星球的流动的海洋没有器官组织、也没有身体，但却拥有神经交互功能，这个有意识的海洋很可能是被热力学平衡的某个随机的波动创建出来的，但详情我们就不清楚了。

还有，星球上的海洋似乎能使用某种频率来进行交流，该频率能影响有机生命体的认知系统，现在还不清楚长期接收这片海洋的频率会对有机生命体物种产生何种影响，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]没有受到这个分散的神经网络的影响。
distar.190.desc.machi.en:
The [Root.GetName] units have returned from their research mission with inconclusive data. Though it bears no organs or corporeality we can identify, the still-flowing sea that wraps pole to pole around the planet appears to be a neural entity unto itself. It is possible this conscious entity was created by the random fluctuations of thermodynamic equilibrium, though the details escape us.

Furthermore, the planetary ocean seems to communicate with frequencies that may affect the cognitive wetware of organic beings. Though it remains unknown what effects prolonged contact with this sea might have on organic species, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are unaffected by the output of this dispersed neural network.

distar.191.a.zh: 有什么消息及时通知我们。

distar.191.desc.alive.zh: $distar.191.desc.base$由于无法进一步研究[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]协助发现的神秘物体，科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]表示十分失望。但本着任务比个人兴趣更重要的原则，[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]愿意接受[living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer]目前的任务。
distar.191.desc.alive.en: $distar.191.desc.base$Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] has expressed some regret at being unable to further study the mysterious entity [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] helped discover, but [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetIsAre] willing to accept [living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer] current assignment as taking precedence over personal interests.

distar.191.desc.crew.zh: $distar.191.desc.base$轨道上的研究团队想马上开始进行研究，如果有任何突破进展，他们会告知我们。
distar.191.desc.crew.en: $distar.191.desc.base$The orbital team is eager to begin their study, and will be sure to keep us apprised of any breakthroughs.

distar.192.a.tooltip.zh: 允许科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]离开当前岗位并加入[living_planet_tar.GetName]科研团队。
distar.192.a.tooltip.en: Allow Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] to leave our service and join the [living_planet_tar.GetName] research team.

distar.192.b.zh: 绝对不行，让科学专员立刻回到岗位上去。
distar.192.b.en: Out of the question. Return the officer to duty at once.

distar.192.b.tooltip.zh: 命令科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]继续留在当前岗位上。
distar.192.b.tooltip.en: Command Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] to remain at their current post.

distar.192.c.zh: 解职[living_planet_scientist.GetName]：这名研究员的思想显然已被控制。
distar.192.c.en: Dismiss [living_planet_scientist.GetName]: the officer is clearly compromised.

distar.192.c.tooltip.zh: 科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]将被解职且无法再被使用。
distar.192.c.tooltip.en: Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] will be decommissioned and no longer available.

distar.192.desc.zh:
我们从科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]那里收到了异常的通讯联络。[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]要求立即将自己调往[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的研究站。[living_planet_scientist.GetName]声称[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]日夜不停地思考着星球上的神秘海洋存在，并且[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]承认这些思绪并非都属于[living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer]自己。

这一请求可谓是学术与疯癫各参半，一边说明这海中生物有能力在神经上影响与其接触的有机生物，一边却宣称这正是它用逝去的爱人的声音与[living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]沟通的原因。

我们无法确定[living_planet_scientist.GetName]能否继续履行职责。但另一方面，如果允许[living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]与轨道科研团队共事，或许可以为我们提供深入了解[living_planet_tar.GetName]星球上的神秘存在的机会。
distar.192.desc.en:
We are receiving an unusual communique from Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. Apparently, [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetIsAre] requesting immediate transfer to the orbital research team on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. [living_planet_scientist.GetName] claims [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetHasHave] been hounded night and day by thoughts of the mysterious sea presence on the planet - thoughts, [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] attest[living_planet_scientist.GetSXX], that are only partly [living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer] own.

The request wavers on the precipice between academic and rambling, suggesting the sea presence possesses the ability to imprint neurologically on those it comes into contact with - only to allege that this is why it speaks to [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer] in the voice of lost loved ones.

It is unclear if [living_planet_scientist.GetName] is unfit for further duty. On the other hand, allowing [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer] to cohabitate with the research team may give them the opportunity for deeper insights into the entity on [living_planet_tar.GetName].

distar.192.desc.neuter.zh:
我们收到了来自科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]的一份不同寻常的公报，似乎想要立即被调往位于[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的科研空间站。[living_planet_scientist.GetName]宣称其整日整夜都在想着那颗星球上的神秘海中生物，不过承认这些思绪并非都属于自己。

这一请求可谓是学术与疯癫各参半，一边说明这海中生物有能力在神经上影响与其接触的有机生物，一边却宣称这正是它用逝去的爱人的声音与其沟通的原因。

我们无法确定[living_planet_scientist.GetName]能否继续履行职责。但另一方面，允许其与轨道科研队伍共事，或许可以为我们提供深入了解[living_planet_tar.GetName]星球上的神秘存在的机会。
distar.192.desc.neuter.en:
We are receiving an unusual communique from Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. Apparently, they are requesting immediate transfer to the orbital research team on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. [living_planet_scientist.GetName] claims they have been hounded night and day by thoughts of the mysterious sea presence on the planet - thoughts, they attest, are only partly their own.

The request wavers on the precipice between academic and rambling, suggesting the sea presence possesses the ability to imprint neurologically on organic beings it comes into contact with - only to allege that this is why it speaks to them in the voice of lost loved ones.

It is unclear if [living_planet_scientist.GetName] is unfit for further duty. On the other hand, allowing them to cohabitate with the research team may create the opportunity for deeper insights into the entity on [living_planet_tar.GetName].

distar.193.desc.zh:
在[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的研究团队对星球上神秘海洋的研究已经取得重大进展，研究人员认为星球上的海洋是某种灵能体：虽然此海洋没有身体，但却有复杂的相干量子波结构，从而构成了一个前所未见的巨型神经网络。

团队的研究让我们发现了一个惊人的灵能理论，并加深了我们对量子态与意识之间交互的理解。这个研究所深入的科研领域远远超出了[Root.GetName]上的水平。
distar.193.desc.en:
Our research crew in orbit of [living_planet_tar.GetName] has made a series of fascinating breakthroughs regarding the planet's strange sea of consciousness. The crew has described the planetary sea as a psionic entity: its seemingly incorporeal state in fact belies a complex and coherent quantum wave structure, approximating a massive neural network unlike any other on record.

The crew's research has led to astounding insights into psionic theory, and deepened our understanding of the interaction of quantum states and consciousness. We now have access to a field of scientific discovery hitherto unimagined in the [Root.GetName].

distar.194.desc.zh:
位于[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道研究站的研究团队最近在星球神秘海洋的研究上取得重大突破。研究专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]对团队的贡献尤其突出。研究人员认为星球上的海洋是某种灵能体：虽然此海洋没有身体，但却有复杂的相干量子波结构，从而构成了一个前所未见的巨型神经网络。

[living_planet_scientist.GetName]的研究让我们发现了一个惊人的灵能理论，并加深了我们对量子态与意识之间交互的理解。至于[living_planet_scientist.GetName][living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]本人嘛：我们的这位前科学专员会继续留在轨道研究站上观测星球上的神秘海洋。
distar.194.desc.en:
Our research crew in orbit of [living_planet_tar.GetName] has made a series of fascinating breakthroughs regarding the planet's strange sea of consciousness. With Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] acting as an invaluable asset to the team, the crew has described the planetary sea as a psionic entity. Its seemingly incorporeal state in fact belies a complex and coherent quantum wave structure, approximating a massive neural network unlike any other on record.

[living_planet_scientist.GetName]'s research has led to incredible insights into psionic theory, and deepened our understanding of the interaction of quantum states and consciousness. As for [living_planet_scientist.GetName] [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]self: our former Science Officer will remain on the orbital facility for as long as we maintain it, observing the entity from afar.

distar.195.a.en: What is the meaning of this?

distar.195.desc.zh:
我是科研专——不，是前科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]。我无法理解上面的人做出的让我深陷如此窘境的愚蠢决定，既然我的要求被你们无视，那么我只有一个选择了。

[living_planet_tar.GetName]上面有个智能意识体，不对，准确的说是，[living_planet_tar.GetName]本身就是那个智能意识体。你们不会明白的，因为你们没有切身体会过，不过你们很快就会体会到了。
distar.195.desc.en:
This is Science Offi - former Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. I cannot pretend to understand the narrow-minded decision making that has led me here, but as my requests have fallen upon deaf ears, there is only one course of action left to me.

There is a consciousness on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. No, not on it. [living_planet_tar.GetName] is the consciousness. You won't understand. How could you? You haven't felt it. Not yet.

distar.196.desc.zh: 探测器发现科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]驾着个人着陆舱从[living_planet_tar.GetName]的轨道上脱离并以最快速度坠入了海洋，我们认为[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]没可能幸存，同时也没有发现着陆舱的残骸。
distar.196.desc.en: Sensors report that Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] was registered dropping from orbit around [living_planet_tar.GetName] in a personal landing pod. Crashing into the ocean at maximum velocity, we cannot imagine [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] survived. There are no traces of the pod remaining.

distar.198.desc.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]进行环境改造，试图将其转化为没有海洋的星球，此行为产生的结果在我们预料之中。星球上具有意识的奇特海洋被我们的环境改造工程所彻底扰乱，并失去了之前与我们进行频率交流的能力以及生物体的一切特性。

由于失去了这个珍贵的研究对象，[Root.GetAdj]科学家们都感到十分惋惜，毕竟这个神秘海洋在整个星系都是独一无二的。
distar.198.desc.en:
The terraforming of [From.GetName] into a sealess landscape has had a predictable, but unavoidable outcome. The strange sea of consciousness on the planet's surface has been completely disrupted by our terraforming process, and has lost the unique properties that qualified it as a living being to our survey team.

[Root.GetAdj] scientists lament the missed research opportunities that the loss of such a unique galactic entity will entail.

distar.2.b.zh: 我们会归还你们的物资。

distar.2.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们发现前往[wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]的一艘失踪的[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]补给船由于受损严重而漂流至[Root.GetAdj]空间之内，然后那艘船上的货物就被你们偷走了。

你们真的以为我们不会发现吗？[wreckage_owner.GetName]强烈要求你们立刻将我们船上的物资归还给我们。
distar.2.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It has come to our attention that a missing [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] supply ship sustained terminal damage en route to [wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName] and drifted into [Root.GetAdj] space, where it was promptly and unceremoniously pilfered of its cargo.

Did you really believe this transgression would go unnoticed? The [wreckage_owner.GetName] requests the immediate reimbursement of our supplies.

distar.2.desc.machi.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们发现有一艘前往[wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]的[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]补给船失踪了。我们的探测器报告说那艘船进入了[From.From.GetName]星系，你们的人在那里将船上的货物偷走并挪为己用了。

我们无法接受你们的这种行为，请立刻归还我们的货物，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
distar.2.desc.machi.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It has come to our attention that a missing [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] supply ship sustained terminal damage on its path to [wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]. Our sensors report our vessel entered the [From.From.GetName] system, where your kind emptied its cargo for your own uses.

Unacceptable. Return our cargo at once, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

distar.20.desc.zh:
通过对在[From.GetName]星系的未识别舰队的身份码的调查，我们得到了意料之外的发现。舰队实际上并不位于黑洞的安全轨道，而是跨过了事件视界。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]推测舰队在数世纪之前就抵达了[From.GetName]的事件视界，在这里时间膨胀使得舰队在黑洞表面留下了它们的影像。

舰队是有意采取了这样的行动，还是遭受了不幸了事故，我们可能永远无从知晓。它们的身份识别码与所有已知文明都无法匹配。
distar.20.desc.en:
Investigation of the unrecognized fleet signatures in the [From.GetName] system revealed an unexpected discovery. The fleet is not, in fact, in safe orbit of the black hole, but rather crossing its event horizon.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] conjectures that the fleet approached [From.GetName]'s event horizon centuries ago, whereupon time dilation left their image detectable on its surface.

Whether the fleet's actions were intentional, or the result of some unhappy accident, we may never know. Their signatures match no known civilization on record.

distar.2000.desc.zh: 我们在垃圾中找到了一颗原本可以居住的星球的碎片。破碎的方式与碎片上的焦痕表明，它受到了集束热能的冲击，直到它在压力下裂开为止。这使其矿物丰富的核心可以外泄，并固化成高品质矿物块。
distar.2000.desc.en: Among the debris we have discovered the shattered remains of a formerly habitable planet. The patterns of fragmentation and charring on the shards suggest it was blasted with concentrated beams of thermal energy until it cracked from the pressure. This allowed for the mineral-rich core to spill out and solidify into clumps of high-quality minerals.

distar.2005.desc.zh:
看来[From.GetName]经历过多次末日。表面扫描显示，这颗星球曾被某种我们未曾遭遇过的大规模武器测试狂轰滥炸过。

尽管外星人曾多次试图彻底毁灭这颗星球，但他们似乎仍未掌握这种科技。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]收集了一系列损坏的武器残骸，希望能够复原它们的武器。
distar.2005.desc.en:
It seems the apocalypse has come to [From.GetName] many times over. Surface scans reveal that the planet has been scorched, bombarded, seared and peppered in what is surely some of the most extensive weapon testing we have yet to encounter.

Though countless attempts have been made to obliterate the planet entirely, it appears the aliens had not yet developed the technology for it. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has collected an assortment of broken weapon remains in the hopes of recreating their designs.

distar.2006.a.zh: 我们将用外星人的武器对付他们！
distar.2006.a.en: We will use the aliens' weapons against them!

distar.2006.b.zh: 我们需要给舰船装上装甲。
distar.2006.b.en: We need armor for our ships.

distar.2006.c.zh: 我们再次确认了自己的优越。
distar.2006.c.en: Again we have confirmed our superiority.

distar.2006.desc.a.zh: 通过对[From.From.GetName]上找到的武器进行研究，我们学到了很多。回收的碎片来自一种定向能武器系统，发射高度集中的能源束，可在太空战中起到很好的效果。科学专员[science_leader.GetName]建议我们要么开发能够抵御激光的装甲，要么复制激光武器来装备自己。
distar.2006.desc.a.en: We have learned much from analyzing the remains of the weapons found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The recovered fragments were from a mounted directed-energy weapon system that emits a highly focused energy ray that can be used with great results in space warfare. Science Officer [science_leader.GetName] recommends we use our finds either by developing armor to counter the lasers or by recreating the weapons for ourselves.

distar.2006.desc.b.zh: 通过对[From.From.From.GetName]上找到的武器进行研究，我们学到了很多。回收的碎片来自一种定向能武器系统，发射高度集中的能源束，与我们的激光类似，但较为低劣。
distar.2006.desc.b.en: We have learned much from analyzing the remains of the weapons found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The fragments we discovered came from a mounted directed-energy weapon system, that emits a highly focused energy ray, similar but hopelessly inferior to our own lasers.

distar.2010.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的海洋几乎完全被一种精细的海藻网络所覆盖，它们以对称的方式摆动，而无视水的流向。其动作的复杂性与规律性表明，这些海藻的作用可能不仅仅是生存那么简单。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]猜测该网络可能其实是一种原始的生体电脑，而其摆动规律则是其界面。可惜我们目前无法解码其规律。
distar.2010.desc.en:
The oceans of [From.GetName] are almost completely covered in a fine network of algae that move in symmetrical patterns, independently of the water's shifting currents. The intricacy and regularity of its motion suggest the algae have been programmed with purpose beyond that of survival.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that the network may in fact be a primitive wetware computer and the movement patterns its interface. Regrettably we have no means of decoding the patterns at this time.

distar.2015.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]的表面上存在着许多单纯有机物质的浆团，我们的科学家认为这可能是生物自生的温床——无机物质天然形成有机物的过程，因[From.GetName]异常浓密的大气层而成为可能。

尽管星球提供了一个研究可能是生命早期起源的独特机会，但我们最好还是不要太过期待，因为如果生命真的会在[From.GetName]上自然出现的话，至少还需要好几百万年。
distar.2015.desc.en:
Nestled in sheltered pockets across [From.GetName]'s surface is a rich sludge of simple organic compounds that our researchers believe could be a hotbed for abiogenesis - the spontaneous formation of organic life from lifeless matter. [From.GetName] has an unusually thick atmosphere for a barren world, which could make it hospitable for simple lifeforms.

Although this presents a unique opportunity to study what could be the early stages of the origin of life, it would be best to set our expectations low, as it may still be millions of years before life evolves naturally on [From.GetName], if at all.

distar.2015.desc.terminator.zh:
在[From.GetName]表面的隐蔽区域内发现了富含小分子有机化合物的淤泥，我们的研究人员认为，这些淤泥可能是生命诞生的温床，可使无生命物质自发形成有机生命。毕竟[From.GetName]的大气对一个荒芜星球而言显得过于厚重了，这可能导致它成为简单生命体的乐园。

当然，这是我们不能容忍的。在生命自发产生之前，我们必须把这富含有机物的粪汤毁掉——即使生命诞生可能尚需数百万年！
distar.2015.desc.terminator.en:
Nestled in sheltered pockets across [From.GetName]'s surface is a rich sludge of simple organic compounds that our research drones believe could be a hotbed for abiogenesis - the spontaneous formation of organic life from lifeless matter. [From.GetName] has an unusually thick atmosphere for a barren world, which could make it hospitable for simple lifeforms.

Naturally, this is intolerable to us. We must snuff this cesspool of organic matter out before life has a chance to develop - even if that may lie millions of years in the future!

distar.2020.desc.zh:
[Root.From.GetName]一眼看上去似乎存在着多种多样的生命形态，在一个与我们相似的生态系统中共存，养分在其中通过光合作用，腐烂与掠食在食物链中循环。

但仔细观察后，船员们却发现，尽管[Root.From.GetName]上的生物当初独自成长，现在它们却神秘地像单一有机体一般行动。一个以凶猛的方式回应所有外界干扰的有机体。
distar.2020.desc.en:
At first glance [Root.From.GetName] seems to be inhabited by a diverse plethora of lifeforms. They co-existed in an ecosystem similar to our own, in which nutrients cycle the food chain through photosynthesis, decomposition and predation.

Upon closer inspection, however, the crew discovered that though all living things on [Root.From.GetName] may have started out as individuals, first they now, by mysterious design, operate as a single organism - one which responds to all outside interference with fierce and indiscriminate aggression.

distar.2020.desc.hive.zh:
[Root.From.GetName]一眼看上去似乎存在着多种多样的生命形态，在一个与我们的家园[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]诞生蜂巢思维之前的样貌相似的生态系统中共存。

但仔细观察后，船员们却发现，尽管、上的生物当初独自成长，现在它们经过自然的演化，变得像单一有机体一般行动。一个原始的以凶猛的方式回应所有外界干扰的有机体。
distar.2020.desc.hive.en:
At first glance [Root.From.GetName] seems to be inhabited by a diverse plethora of lifeforms, co-existing in an ecosystem likely not dissimilar to what our home of [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName] might have developed - in a time before, or without, our hive.

Upon closer inspection, our drones discovered that although the organisms developed as individuals first they now, through the natural course of evolution, operate as a single organism. A primitive organism that doesn't know any better than to respond to all outside interference with fierce and indiscriminate aggression.

distar.2025.desc.zh:
对[From.GetName]的外壳深度扫描确认了我们的猜想，[From.GetName]不是一颗普通的月亮，整个星体都是人造结构，由矿藏丰富的岩石作为原材料建造而成，被一个巨大的钢铁框架结构包裹着。

看起来它被创造出来以降低[artificial_moon_planet.GetName]的自转速度，让其白天更长，潮汐更高，使其更加宜居。但目前我们可以确认没有任何生物曾在其上殖民过。
distar.2025.desc.en:
Deeper scans of [From.GetName]'s crust confirm what the crew already suspected - [From.GetName] is no ordinary moon. The entire planetary body is an artificial construct, made out of exceptionally mineral rich rock, packed around a massive steel framework.

Likely it was created to slow the rotational speed of [artificial_moon_planet.GetName], making the days longer and tides higher, priming it for habitation. As far as we can tell nobody ever settled the planet.

distar.2030.a.tooltip.zh: 将这些长鳞片的可怜虫囚禁于此一定有合理的原因。
distar.2030.a.tooltip.en: Someone locked the scaled critters up and probably for good reasons too.

distar.2030.c.zh: 它们的命运由自己决定。
distar.2030.c.en: Their fate is their own to decide.

distar.2030.desc.zh:
[time_loop_world.GetName]正在烧尽。星球被一面护盾笼罩，它捕捉[time_loop_world.GetStarName]的辐射，将其加热至很快无法生存的温度。

在这片炽热中，一个先进的微型有鳞爬行动物文明正在疯狂地忙碌着。某种非常重要的大事似乎正在进行。可是，当紧张状态到达巅峰时，时间突然停止了，接着伸展并扭曲，直到爬行动物文明不可思议地回到了开始。

它们似乎被困在了时空循环之中，一个绝望的快进循环，从它们文明的发源开始。在仅仅数小时之内，无数个世代在变更交替，对它们注定将在炽热之中死亡一事毫不知情。

但我们在护盾中发现了一道裂痕，可使我们改变它们的命运。
distar.2030.desc.en:
[time_loop_world.GetName] is burning up. The planet is enclosed in a shield that is capturing [time_loop_world.GetStarName]'s radiation, heating it to what will soon be uninhabitable temperatures.

In the scorching heat an advanced civilization of tiny squamate reptilians scurry about in frenzied activity. Some event of great magnitude seems to be in the works. Yet, as tension peaks, time stops without warning, then stretches and morphs until, impossibly, the reptilians are back where they started.

They appear to be locked in a time loop, a hopeless cycle of fast-forwarded repetition, starting at the birth of their civilization. In mere hours countless generations can be observed living out their lives, unaware they have been condemned to certain, crispy death.

But we have discovered a crack in the shield that could allow us to change their fate.

distar.2031.desc.zh:
我们尽可能加强了围绕[time_loop_world.GetName]的护盾，而没有打扰其中的居民。对其大气层的详细调查结果表明，这些小蜥蜴们很可能会在一个世纪内被烤焦。

该星球提供了一个独特的研究机会，但如果我们希望研究这些蜥蜴以及它们被困其中的时空循环，那我们最好尽快开始。
distar.2031.desc.en:
We have reinforced the cracking shield around [time_loop_world.GetName] to the best of our abilities, without disturbing the world's inhabitants. Closer investigations of its atmosphere predict that the tiny lizards are likely to meet a fiery end within a century.

The planet provides a unique opportunity for research but if we intend to study the lizards and the time loop in which they are trapped it would be wise to begin soon.

distar.2032.desc.zh:
好消息是我们打断了[time_loop_world.GetName]的时空循环。坏消息是星球上的居民没有活下来。

原来那时空循环，是由人造奇异场在护盾内扭曲时空造成的，并且当蜥蜴们的行为作出某种未知但非常特定的改变时，护盾将会关闭。我们的科学家认为这可能与蜥蜴们的侵略性倾向有关。

在偶然的巧合下，我们在循环的最后将其打破，此时这些蜥蜴们正在进行一场冷战，它们的小爪子正放在核武器的发射按钮上。在释放后的数秒内，蜥蜴们就在炽热的核爆中消失了。
distar.2032.desc.en:
The good news is we have broken the time loop on [time_loop_world.GetName]. The bad news is its inhabitants did not survive the ordeal.

The loop, which was caused by an artificial singularity field that curved space and time within the shield, was set to deactivate on an unknown but very specific change in the lizards' behavior. Our scientists believe it may have had something to do with their somewhat aggressive tendencies.

Through a stupefying coincidence we managed to break the loop at a moment when the lizards had their tiny paws on the nuclear launch trigger. Within seconds of their release the reptilians had disappeared in a fiery inferno of nuclear devastation.

distar.2033.b.zh: 我们要继续保持思想开放……
distar.2033.b.en: Let us keep an open mind...

distar.2033.desc.zh:
好消息是我们打断了[time_loop_world.GetName]的时空循环。坏消息是星球上的居民并不欢迎我们。

原来那时空循环，是由人造奇异场在护盾内扭曲时空造成的，并且当蜥蜴们的行为作出某种未知但非常特定的改变时，护盾将会关闭。我们的科学家认为这可能与蜥蜴们的侵略性倾向有关。

在关闭力场后，蜥蜴们立即对我们作出了侵略性的反应。然后它们开始着手对付那护盾，在数小时内将它轰成了碎片。
distar.2033.desc.en:
The good news is we have broken the time loop on [time_loop_world.GetName]. The bad news is, its inhabitants are not pleased to see us.

The time loop, which was caused by an artificial singularity field that curved space and time within the shield, was set to deactivate on an unknown but very specific change in the lizards' behavior. Our scientists believe it may have had something to do with their penchant for violence.

Upon disabling the field the lizards reacted with immediate aggression to our presence. They then got to quick work on the shield, blasting it to bits within hours.

distar.2035.a.en: Such is the way of the universe.

distar.2035.desc.zh:
被困在[time_loop_world.GetName]的护盾后的蜥蜴型外星人毁于星球的迅速升温。看来环境的极端变化并无法打断困住它们的时空循环。

这颗原本非常忙碌的星球上现在已没有什么可研究的了。
distar.2035.desc.en:
The society of lizard-like aliens trapped behind the shield on [time_loop_world.GetName] have succumbed to the planet's rapid warming. It seems the extreme changes to the environment were not enough to break the time loop in which the lizards were stuck.

There is little left to research on this formerly so vibrant world.

distar.2036.desc.zh:
[time_loop_world.GetName]正在烧尽。星球被一面护盾笼罩，它捕捉[time_loop_world.GetStarName]的辐射，将其加热至很快无法生存的温度。

在这片炽热中，一个先进的微型有鳞爬行动物文明正在疯狂地忙碌着。某种非常重要的大事似乎正在进行。可是，当紧张状态到达巅峰时，时间突然停止了，接着伸展并扭曲，直到爬行动物文明不可思议地回到了开始。

它们似乎被困在了时空循环之中，一个绝望的快进循环，从它们文明的发源开始。在仅仅数小时之内，无数个世代在变更交替，对它们注定将在炽热之中死亡一事毫不知情。我们无法拯救它们。那道护盾坚不可摧。
distar.2036.desc.en:
[time_loop_world.GetName] is burning up. The planet is enclosed in a shield that is capturing [time_loop_world.GetStarName]'s radiation, heating it to what will soon be uninhabitable temperatures.

In the scorching heat an advanced civilization of tiny squamate reptilians scurry about in frenzied activity. Some event of great magnitude seems to be in the works. Yet, as tension peaks, time stops without warning, then stretches and morphs until, impossibly, the reptilians are back where they started.

They are locked in a time loop, a hopeless cycle of fast-forwarded repetition, starting at the birth of their civilization. In mere hours countless generations can be observed living out their lives, unaware they have been condemned to a certain, crispy death. We could not save them if we tried. The shield is impenetrable.

distar.2038.desc.zh: 蜥蜴们现在自由了。它们可能自力解决了时空循环的难题，并设法打破了已经开始破裂的护盾。
distar.2038.desc.en: The Lizards have broken free. Somehow they must have solved the time loop conundrum on their own and then managed to shatter the already cracking shield.

distar.2040.a.zh: 派一队科研考察队前往实验室。
distar.2040.a.en: Send a science crew to the lab.

distar.2040.b.zh: 我们并不需要这种武器。
distar.2040.b.en: We have no need for such a weapon.

distar.2040.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]轨道上发现的那艘全副武装的舰船是一艘被遗弃的军用舰船，名字叫“纳弗瑞的骄傲”。它的舰体十分轻盈、擅长闪避攻击，说明它是用来执行长途侦查任务的，但现在它被改装为了一个远程匿踪炸弹。从舰船的通讯记录中可知此船在袭击西万实验室的路上被某个叛军游击队截了下来，据说那个实验室中保存的威力强大的武器可以帮助游击队赢得战争胜利。我们从舰船的导航驱动器中找出了西万实验室的准确位置。
distar.2040.desc.en:
The armed vessel discovered in orbit of [From.GetName] is an abandoned military spacecraft called Nefri's Pride. Its light frame and evasion hardware suggest it was built for long-distance patrol missions, but it has since been retrofitted into a long-range stealth bomber.

Records of the ship's comms reveal it was hijacked by a rebel guerilla on its way to perform a strike against a secret complex called the Xvan labs, said to hold a weapon so powerful it could win them the war, when they were shot down. We have extracted the ship's destination from its navigational drive.

distar.2041.a.tooltip.zh: 我们对西万研究室的考察让我们的工程学研究技术取得了进一步发展。
distar.2041.a.tooltip.en: Our excursion into the Xvan labs has progressed our engineering research.

distar.2041.desc.zh:
我们的科学家们从西万实验室安全归来并带回了实验室安保摄像头中的视频记录，视频中记录了如下场景：实验室科学家们被游击队士兵捆绑起来、游击队士兵试图打开武器箱，但发现里面空空如也。

几分钟后，叛军士兵们突然痛苦的倒地，他们身体上出现黑色斑点，然后灰色不明物质从他们体内钻出。

那些灰色物质不断膨胀，并围绕着他们旋转，其中一名实验室科学家启动了紧急系统，房间的洒水器开始喷水，然后电流经由洒水器让房间内所有的生物统统触电，然后视频记录就终止了。我们的科研队经过确认，发现武器箱确实是空的。
distar.2041.desc.en:
Our scientists have returned from the Xvan labs unscathed with footage collected from the facility's security cameras. It shows lab scientists bound and gagged as guerilla soldiers pry open the weapon strongbox. But to their dismay, the box is empty.

Only minutes later the rebels can be seen writhing on the floor in intense agony, dark patches swelling across their bodies, then their skin rips and a gray unidentifiable matter spills out.

The matter continues to expand, swirling hypnotically around them, until one of the scientists activates the emergency system. Sprinklers douse the room in liquid and an electrical surge passes through it executing all living things. Here the footage ends. Our crew can confirm that the strong box was indeed empty.

distar.2045.a.en: It is certainly worth a try.

distar.2045.desc.zh: 位于[From.GetName]轨道上的被毁的军用舰船残骸中发出了某种信号，该信号来自某个觊觎我们文明长达数千年之久的外星势力，名为苏金帝国，他们企图使用某种干扰光束来劫持传送门网络，但在中途受到袭击导致舰船被毁。尽管光束已经启动并已经在传送门安保系统中调整完毕，但光束却在袭击中被破坏了，我们的科学家也许能修好它。
distar.2045.desc.en: The signal originates from a gathering of destroyed military vessels in orbit around [From.GetName]. It seems a foreign alien power predating our civilization by many thousand years, called the Sujin Empire, was attempting to hijack the gateway network using some kind of interference beam, when they were rudely interrupted. Though the beam is active and calibrated on the gateway's security network, it has been damaged in the assault. Perhaps our scientists could mend it.

distar.2046.desc.zh: 虽然我们的科学家无法彻底搞清楚传送门的安保系统，但我们还是对传送门系统的工作原理有了一些深入了解。苏金帝国对传送门已经痴迷了数百年了，他们为了突破传送门的安保系统而尽最大努力收集了一切相关信息。
distar.2046.desc.en: Though our scientists were unable to pierce the gateway's security system, we have gained some very valuable insight into how the network functions. The Sujin empire had been obsessed with the gateways for centuries, and gathered all data they could find in an effort to break through.

distar.211.desc.zh:
一个传奇的生物游动于[Root.GetStarName]星系的气态巨行星之间，它比已知的任何缇扬奇都要大，简直就是一头无比巨大的太空巨鲸。这个族母的触须比[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的战列舰还要长，其皮肤闪着亮光，在黑暗的太空中异常的耀眼。她的历史十分悠久，身上的伤疤说明她已历经无数次战斗。

族母的背上有个巨大的未爆炸的鱼雷。星系中的破碎舰船残骸提醒着我们不要轻易靠近她，否则必会被这巨物毁灭。
distar.211.desc.en:
A creature of legend swims languorously between the gas giants in the [Root.GetStarName] system. Larger than any Tiyanki on record - indeed, larger than any of our projections could have allowed for, a space whale of impossible proportions seems to have made her nest here. With tentacles longer than a [Root.Owner.GetAdj] battleship, this magnificent Matriarch's glowing hide stands out startlingly against the void of space. She is old, remarkably so, a veritable ancient covered end to end in battle scars and strange growths.

A gigantic, unexploded proton torpedo is lodged in the venerable creature's back, and the fractured remains of ships in the system speak of what manner of fate befell any vessels that strayed too close.

distar.211.desc.first_enc.zh:
一个传奇的生物游动于[Root.GetStarName]星系的气态巨行星之间，她的触须比[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的战列舰还要长，其巨大的身体颠覆了我们对有机生命体的认知，该生物的皮肤闪着亮光，在黑暗的太空中异常的耀眼。她的历史十分悠久，身上的伤疤说明她已历经无数次战斗。

族母的背后有个巨大的未爆炸的鱼雷。星系中的破碎舰船残骸提醒着我们不要轻易靠近她，否则必会被这巨物毁灭。
distar.211.desc.first_enc.en:
A creature of legend swims languorously between the gas giants dotting the [Root.GetStarName] system. With tentacles longer than a [Root.Owner.GetAdj] battleship, her gargantuan proportions defy all of our previous encounters with organic life. The creature's magnificent glowing hide stands out startlingly against the void of space. She appears to be quite old, remarkably so -- a veritable ancient covered end to end in battle scars and strange growths.

A gigantic, unexploded proton torpedo is lodged in the venerable Matriarch's back, and the fractured remains of ships in the system speak of what manner of fate befell any vessels that strayed too close.

distar.212.b.zh: 从这头巨兽身上收集基因物质。
distar.212.b.en: Harvest genetic material from the beast.

distar.212.b.tooltip.zh: 解锁用于星神兽转基因的$trait_tiyanki$特质。
distar.212.b.tooltip.en: Unlocks the $trait_tiyanki$ trait for Leviathan Transgenesis.

distar.212.desc.zh:
我们大获全胜的舰队在濒死的缇扬奇族母身旁游弋，她那闪闪发亮的肉身上布满了弹孔和伤痕。她那巨大的触须虽然仍试图捕捉附近的舰船，但动作逐渐放缓，最终停了下来。

就这样，古老的族母被终结了，就像那些在我们之前企图围捕她的舰队一样。
distar.212.desc.en:
Our victorious fleet circles the dying Tiyanki Matriarch, her glowing flesh scored by countless blast-marks. The violent thrashing of her tentacles, still trying to grasp at nearby ships, first slows, then draws abruptly to an end.

At last she expires: the ancient Matriarch laid to an end, like her would-be hunters before us.

distar.213.desc.zh:
我们还是把事情想的太简单了，上将报告说怪物的肚腹中有奇怪的东西在动。

有什么东西要从怪物肚腹中钻出来了！
distar.213.desc.en:
...Or so it had seemed. Our fleet captains are reporting strange movement coming from the belly of the beast.

Something is about to emerge!

distar.214.desc.zh:
一艘沾满了黏液、腐蚀严重的神秘舰船冲出了缇扬奇族母的肚腹，我们舰队做好交战准备，但那艘船突然关闭了武器系统和引擎系统。

他们向我们发来联络！
distar.214.desc.en:
