A mysterious vessel, covered in viscous fluids and damaged by digestive juices blasts its way out of the corpse of the fallen Tiyanki Matriarch. Our fleet stands at the ready, but the ship immediately powers down its weapons and engines after emerging.

They are hailing us!

distar.214.name.en: From the Belly of the Beast

distar.215.a.exter.zh: 你们是有机生物，因此必须被消灭掉。但你们的船我们可以留下。
distar.215.a.exter.en: You are organic. You will be exterminated. Your ship, however...

distar.215.a.fp.zh: [Root.GetName]绝不允许异星生物服侍自己，也不允许任何异星生物活着。
distar.215.a.fp.en: The [Root.GetName] will suffer no xenos to serve. Or live.

distar.215.a.scorched.zh: 此人不过是把燃料。处理掉他。
distar.215.a.scorched.en: He is but fuel for the flames. Get rid of him.

distar.215.a.swarm.zh: 猎物。我们会实现缇扬奇未竟的遗志。
distar.215.a.swarm.en: Prey. We will succeed where the Tiyanki failed.

distar.215.c.zh: 我们只要你们的船就够了。

distar.215.d.response.zh: 那不是，我好多年来都在猎杀所有在星际航行的东西：变形虫、晶体、还有超出我们认知领域的噩梦般的东西，我全部干掉了！如果你想，我甚至可以猎杀最危险的猎物……
distar.215.d.response.en: Oh no, I've spent years bringing down anything that traverses the stars: Amoebas, Crystals, nightmarish entities beyond our realm of understanding - I have hunted it all! If you want, I can even hunt down the most dangerous prey...

distar.215.desc.zh:
我是亚哈船长号的舰长瑞斯·昂多，我们被困在这怪物肚中已经很久了，几十年前我为了复仇而准备消灭这只怪物。

结果报仇不成，我们的舰船反倒被这怪物给吞下去了，我还以为这辈子再也没机会看到宇宙群星了，多亏了你们帮忙。

为了感谢你们拯救我们脱险，我们的舰船从现在开始向[Root.GetName]效忠。
distar.215.desc.en:
This is Captain Reth Unddol of the AH4B. Long have I suffered in the caustic bowels of that fell beast. Decades ago I came to hunt it, to repay a debt long overdue.

Alas, I could not lay this baleful Matriarch to an end, and when she swallowed the AH4B whole, I was certain I would never again see the light of the stars. I am glad to see I was mistaken.

For putting my nightmare to rest, I would pledge my life and loyalty, and my ship, to the [Root.GetName].

distar.216.desc.zh:
等等！不！你不能——不要碰我！

啊啊啊啊！
distar.216.desc.en:
Wait! No! You cannot -- get away from me!

HRGAAAAHHH!!

distar.217.desc.zh:
绝对不行。这艘船就是我的命根子……你们在干什么？你们不能把我塞进逃生舱！

住手！我的话还没说完……！
distar.217.desc.en:
Out of the question. This ship has been my only lifeline for... what are you doing? You cannot just stuff me in an escape pod!

Stop! You haven't heard the last of me...!

distar.218.desc.hive.zh:
复活缇扬奇族母格外困难。即便我们已经有控制她小型子嗣的丰富经验，但族母的再生能力反复地吞噬掉我们的虫草[root.GetNecromancersLower]。但最后，我们更胜一筹；死掉的组织永远也不可能比我们更具适应力。

现在，我们控制了族母，她的巨型鞭毛已经为我们所用了。
distar.218.desc.hive.en:
Reanimating the Tiyanki Matriarch was especially difficult. While we have gained plenty of experience seizing control of its smaller offspring, the Matriarch's regenerative capabilities proved to be a significant drain on our cordyceptic [root.GetNecromancersLower]. But in the end, we triumphed; no dead tissue could ever adapt faster than us.

Now, having taken control of the Matriarch, we twitch the titanic flagella.

distar.218.desc.machine.zh: 缇扬奇族母已重新启动并重目的化。该巨型生物将作为一个有机单元服务于我们。将其原生的族母协议停用后吧，该星神兽现在将为我们所控制。
distar.218.desc.machine.en: The Tiyanki Matriarch has been rebooted, and repurposed. This titanic creature will now serve us as an organic unit. With matriarchal protocols disengaged, this leviathan will now operate under our control.

distar.218.desc.regular.zh: 经过一段漫长的仪式，缇扬奇族母从彼岸归来，并为我们的事业而效力。
distar.218.desc.regular.en: After a lengthy ritual, the Tiyanki Matriarch has returned from beyond and now serves our cause.

distar.220.a.tooltip.en: Zone A has been discovered on [From.GetName].

distar.220.desc.zh:
根据初步调查结果显示，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]确认从轨道上观察到的孤立遗迹确实是[From.GetName]曾有人居住的唯一证据。不幸的是，[Root.GetName]的船员们进行直接调查这一举动并不明智。

[From.GetName]上有一片被称为“区域A”的地方存在着建筑物的遗迹，其范围大约十三公里见方，除此之外别无任何智慧生命的痕迹。区域内散布着性质奇特的人造物，从微型力场发生器到可溶穿钢铁并长时间扩散的险恶液体都有。更奇怪的是，整个区域都弥漫着使访问者感到心满意足的气息，尽管周围的许多物体都可能有害。

[Root.GetLeaderName]提出的假设是，一个有遨游太空能力的有机文明曾访问过[From.GetName]，留下了这些东西——尽管它们是谁，为何来此，以及为何离开仍是个谜。
distar.220.desc.en:
As per initial findings, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] confirms that the isolated ruin seen from orbit is indeed the only evidence of settlement on [From.GetName]. Unfortunately, the [Root.GetName] crew is little the wiser for having investigated the structures firsthand.

Devoid of any other traces of sapient lifeforms, [From.GetName] possesses a zone of roughly thirteen by thirteen kilometers, dubbed Zone A, in which the remains of buildings can be found. Artifacts possessing bizarre properties litter this zone, from minute forcefield generators to viscous fluids that melt through steel and expand over time. Even more peculiar: the entire zone permeates its visitors with a deep-rooted sense of contentment, despite the often-dangerous mysteries of the objects found therein.

[Root.GetLeaderName] posits the working theory that a space-faring civilization visited [From.GetName] sometime in the past, leaving behind these objects - though who they were, why they landed, and why they left remain unknown.

distar.220.desc.machi.zh:
根据初步调查结果显示，科研单位[Root.GetLeaderName]确认从轨道上观察到的孤立遗迹确实是[From.GetName]曾有人居住的唯一证据。

[From.GetName]上有一片被称为“区域A”的地方存在着建筑物的遗迹，其范围大约十三公里见方，除此之外别无任何智慧生命的痕迹。区域内散布着性质奇特的人造物，从微型力场发生器到可溶穿钢铁并长时间扩散的险恶液体都有。更出人意料的是，整个区域内遍布着使人心满意足的情绪模拟器，尽管周围的许多物体都可能有害。

[Root.GetLeaderName]提出的假设是，一个有遨游太空能力的有机文明曾访问过[From.GetName]，留下了这些东西——尽管它们是谁，为何来此，以及为何离开仍是个谜。
distar.220.desc.machi.en:
As per initial findings, Science Unit [Root.GetLeaderName] confirms that the isolated ruin seen from orbit is indeed the only evidence of settlement on [From.GetName].

Devoid of any other traces of sapient lifeforms, [From.GetName] possesses a zone of approximately thirteen by thirteen kilometers, designation 'Zone A,' in which the remains of buildings can be found. Artifacts possessing unusual properties litter this zone, from miniaturized forcefield generators to viscous fluids that melt through steel and expand over time. Even more unexpectedly: the entire zone permeates emotional-emulators with high levels of contentment, despite the many potentially harmful properties of the objects found therein.

[Root.GetLeaderName] posits the working theory that a space-faring organic civilization visited [From.GetName] sometime in the past, leaving behind these objects - though who they were, why they landed, and why they left remain unknown factors.

distar.225.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员报告称，有个一开始被探测器判为小行星的物体其实是一颗巨大的漂浮垃圾球。它由各种载具，火箭，以及有害物质（其中许多具有放射性）的破损残骸组成，似乎是某个处于早期太空时代的未知外星帝国的废弃物。

这个帝国似乎习惯于向太空抛弃垃圾，将危险的工业废弃物抛向轨道而不是在星球上丢弃。辐射测量显示这些废弃物已有数百万年历史，并且自离开其未知来源起几乎一直都在虚空中漂流。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]注意到这块漂浮垃圾中的某些材料非常稀有，并且可以精炼成有用的资源。
distar.225.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew report that what first appeared to our scanners as an asteroid is in fact a gigantic, floating ball of junk. Comprised of the broken remains of various vehicles, rockets and hazardous materials (many of them radioactive), the junk ball seems to be the detritus of an unknown alien nation in the early space age.

It would appear this nation was an interstellar litterer, ejecting dangerous industrial waste into orbit rather than disposing of it planetside. Radiometric dating suggests these remains are millions of years old, and have been floating through space from an unknown point of origin for most of that time.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] notes that some of the materials found on this floating junk heap are quite rare, and could be refined into useful resources.

distar.230.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员报告称，在[From.GetName]星系附近发现了腐朽的轨道空间站与多个死寂星球。某个曾殖民于[From.GetName]星系的星际文明似乎很久以前就毁灭了。[ratling_planet_tar.GetName]星球简直就像个垃圾场，上面满是辐射弥漫且锈迹斑斑的建筑废墟，基础设施与载具。未侦测到高等生命的存在。

我们或许可以勘察该星系与邻近星系中的类似星球，来获知更多关于这一失落文明的情报。
distar.230.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew have reported the presence of decaying orbital stations and multiple tomb worlds near the [From.GetName] system. Whatever interstellar nation once inhabited the [From.GetName] system appears to have collapsed into ruin long ago. [ratling_planet_tar.GetName] is a junkyard of a planet, covered in the irradiated, rusting remnants of demolished buildings, infrastructure and vehicles. No higher forms of life are recognizable.

We might gain more insight into this lost civilization by surveying any similar planets in this and neighboring systems.

distar.230.exter.zh: 如果还有活的，必须将其消灭。
distar.230.exter.en: If any remain, they will be exterminated.

distar.231.desc.zh:
正如[Root.GetName]船员的初步猜想，[From.GetName]似乎是那个有遨游太空能力的帝国的首都，其前殖民地现在已是死寂星球上的充满辐射的废墟。

从团队收集的数据看来，几乎可以确定是一场对未知外部威胁发动的星际战争，导致了这个失落文明的陨落。我们仍不确定星球的主人是击退了攻击者但毁于战后的辐射尘，还是攻击者消灭了这些殖民地及其居民并扬长而去。

因废墟的极端环境使我们无法从残留的电子器件中提取数据，而其首都和其它殖民地中也没有任何生还者，这似乎将成为不解之谜。
distar.231.desc.en:
As per the [Root.GetName] crew's initial suspicions, [From.GetName] appears to be the fallen capital of the space-faring society whose former colonies are now but irradiated scrap heaps on inhospitable tomb worlds.

From the data the team has gathered, the downfall of this lost civilization was almost certainly the result of interstellar warfare waged against some unknown, external threat. It remains unclear whether the planet's owners repelled the invasion but succumbed to the post-war fallout of a pyrrhic victory, or if the invaders crushed these colonies and their inhabitants before moving on.

As the extreme state of ruin on the planet precludes the extraction of data from any remaining electronics, and neither the capital nor its colonies possess any survivors, it seems we may never know for certain.

distar.233.desc.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]收到了关于[notif_planet.GetStarName]星系中的[notif_planet.GetName]曾被以为是不毛之地的情报。我们的勘探者曾以为是无法居住的废墟星球，事实上住着一群像老鼠一般的智慧生物！

它们被命名为“$NAME_Ketlings$”，这些生物一直隐居在巨大废墟中的隧道里，使我们无法察觉。一定是这些巨大垃圾堆的复杂结构与惊人密度，阻挡了我们的扫描仪深入其中。

是什么使得$NAME_Ketlings$来到地面仍不得而知，不过我们现在既然观察它们，我们注意到它们的科技几乎完全基于行星废墟中的破旧垃圾。

难道$NAME_Ketlings$是创造了这些废墟的失落星际文明的最后幸存者吗？深入研究或许可以一探究竟。
distar.233.desc.en:
Intelligence reports are coming in to [Root.Capital.GetName] regarding the hitherto lifeless surface of [notif_planet.GetName] in the [notif_planet.GetStarName] system. What our surveyors initially considered an uninhabited junk pile of a planet is, in fact, home to a species of rat-like sapients!

Dubbed "$NAME_Ketlings$," these creatures had been living hidden from our view in tunnels in the planet's enormous scrap piles. The complex composition and incredible density of these massive junkheaps must have hindered earlier penetration by our scanners.

Whatever may have brought the $NAME_Ketlings$ to the surface is thus far unknown, though now that we can observe them, we have noted their technology is almost entirely based on repurposed junk from the planetary ruins they inhabit.

Could the $NAME_Ketlings$ be the last survivors of the lost interstellar civilization who made these ruins? Closer study may yield more information.

distar.234.desc.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]对[From.From.GetName]上的鼠形智慧生物的调查产生了惊人的结论。这些$NAME_Ketlings$是灵能体，可以通过横跨数百万小型个体的巨大心灵感应网络来共享思维。尽管它们似乎避免与我们接触，而我们也没有发现它们拥有先进太空科技的证据，但将$NAME_Ketlings$归类为原始生物却非常不妥。事实上，它们的某些改造机械的技术复杂程度甚至逼近我们的水平。

此外，$NAME_Ketlings$既不是这些城市的建造者的后代，也不是将其摧毁的征服者。$NAME_Ketlings$的祖先，其实是被当初定居此地的星际文明当作宠物的动物！在其主人陨落后，原始$NAME_Ketlings$是在这些废墟星球上持续数个世纪的辐射尘中存活下来的少数生物之一。

长期暴露在辐射中加速了$NAME_Ketlings$的基因突变，而其灵活的肢体，相对较高的初始智力，并且更接近废弃工具，这些因素导致了一个高科技帝国的迅速发展。
distar.234.desc.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName]'s investigation into the rat-like sapients on [From.From.GetName] has produced some surprising results. The $NAME_Ketlings$ are psions, capable of sharing their thoughts via a telepathic network spanning millions of small minds. Though they avoid interacting with us, and we lack evidence to suggest they are capable of advanced spaceflight, it would be remiss to classify the $NAME_Ketlings$ as mere primitives. In fact, some of their repurposed machinery possesses a technical sophistication approaching even our own.

Moreover, the $NAME_Ketlings$ are neither the descendants of the civilization that constructed these cities, nor the conquerors that destroyed them. Rather, the $NAME_Ketlings$ were once the pets of the spacefarers who first colonized these systems! After their masters' downfall, the proto-$NAME_Ketlings$ were one of the few species to survive centuries of nuclear fallout on these ruined planets.

Constant exposure to radioactive elements led to faster mutations in the $NAME_Ketlings$' genetic code, and their nimble appendages, relative starting intelligence, and close proximity to a variety of decrepit tools all culminated in the rapid emergence of a technologically advanced culture.

distar.234.desc.spacefaring.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]对[From.From.GetName]上的鼠形智慧生物的调查产生了惊人的结论。这些$NAME_Ketlings$是灵能体，可以通过横跨数百万小型个体的巨大心灵感应网络来共享思维。

$NAME_Ketlings$既不是这些城市的建造者的后代，也不是将其摧毁的征服者。而这些奇特灵能生物的祖先，其实是被当初定居此地的星际文明当作宠物的动物！在其主人陨落后，原始$NAME_Ketlings$是在这些废墟星球上持续数个世纪的辐射尘中存活下来的少数生物之一。

长期暴露在辐射中加速了$NAME_Ketlings$的基因突变，而其灵活的肢体，相对较高的初始智力，并且更接近废弃工具，这些因素导致了一个高科技帝国的迅速发展。
distar.234.desc.spacefaring.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName]'s investigation into the rat-like sapients on [From.From.GetName] has produced some surprising results. The $NAME_Ketlings$ are psions, capable of sharing their thoughts via a telepathic network spanning millions of small minds.

The $NAME_Ketlings$ are neither the descendants of the civilization that constructed these cities, nor the conquerors that destroyed them. Rather, these strange psionic creatures were once the pets of the space-farers who first colonized these systems! After their masters' downfall, the proto-$NAME_Ketlings$ were one of the few species to survive centuries of nuclear fallout on these ruined planets.

Constant exposure to radioactive elements led to faster mutations in the $NAME_Ketlings$' genetic code, and their nimble appendages, relative starting intelligence, and close proximity to a variety of decrepit tools all culminated in the rapid emergence of a technologically advanced culture.

distar.235.desc.zh:
我们已经成功的从奇怪的垃圾堆住民$NAME_Ketlings$手中占领了[From.From.GetName]。我们将根据物种政策来处理行星上剩余的$NAME_Ketlings$。

我们不确定我们的入侵会让它们其他星球上的同伴做出什么样的反应……但是能有多糟？
distar.235.desc.en:
We have successfully conquered [From.From.GetName] from the curious junk-dwelling $NAME_Ketlings$. The $NAME_Ketlings$ remaining planetside will be dealt with according to the species policies we have outlined for them.

We are uncertain what kind of reaction our intrusion might prompt from their comrades on other planets... but how bad could it be?

distar.235.desc.assim.zh:
我们成功地从奇特的垃圾居民$NAME_Ketlings$手中征服了[From.From.GetName]。

这些奇特的垃圾居民$NAME_Ketlings$将被吸收进[Root.GetName]。
distar.235.desc.assim.en:
We have successfully conquered [From.From.GetName] from the curious junk-dwelling $NAME_Ketlings$.

The curious junk-dwelling $NAME_Ketlings$ will be absorbed into the [Root.GetName].

distar.235.desc.none_left.zh:
我们已经成功的从奇怪的垃圾堆住民$NAME_Ketlings$手中占领了[From.From.GetName]。我们将根据物种政策来处理行星上剩余的$NAME_Ketlings$。

残存的$NAME_Ketlings$将被发射至太空中。
distar.235.desc.none_left.en:
We have successfully conquered [From.From.GetName] from the last of the junk-dwelling $NAME_Ketlings$. The $NAME_Ketlings$ remaining planetside will be dealt with according to the species policies we have outlined for them.

The final remnants of $NAME_Ketlings$ autonomy will be dispersed into the void.

distar.235.desc.none_left.assim.zh:
我们成功地从奇特的垃圾居民$NAME_Ketlings$手中征服了[From.From.GetName]。

最后残余的奇特$NAME_Ketlings$将被吸收进[Root.GetName]。
distar.235.desc.none_left.assim.en:
We have successfully conquered [From.From.GetName] from the last of the junk-dwelling $NAME_Ketlings$.

The final remnants of the curious $NAME_Ketlings$ will be absorbed into the [Root.GetName].

distar.237.desc.zh:
传感器在[sensor_ratling_system.GetName]星系中突然发现了大量活动迹象。先前遭遇的$NAME_Ketlings$发射了一队可超光速旅行的战舰，而地面侦查表明其居住的巨大垃圾堆其实隐藏了广阔的复合矿场，发电厂，菌类农场，以及地下科研设施。

尽管十分惊人，它们的船到目前为止尚未表露出敌意，并且$NAME_Ketlings$很可能只是在其边境设防而已。无论如何，现在明显该将这些外星人视为一个真正的帝国了。
distar.237.desc.en:
Sensors report a sudden burst of activity in the [sensor_ratling_system.GetName] System. The previously encountered $NAME_Ketlings$ have launched a fleet of FTL-capable warships, and planetside reconnaissance indicates the enormous junkheaps that made up their homes in fact concealed extensive mining networks, power plants, fungus-farms, and subterranean research facilities.

While alarming, their ships have thus far made no display of hostile intent, and it is quite possible the $NAME_Ketlings$ are merely establishing defenses along their borders. Nevertheless, it is clearly time to recognize these aliens as an empire in their own right.

distar.240.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中发送着一道微弱但反复持续的信号。[Root.GetName]追踪其来源至星系边缘的一个不稳定亚空间裂隙。

另一边究竟有什么呢？
distar.240.desc.en:
A weak, but insistent signal transmits on repeat in the [From.GetName] system. The [Root.GetName] has pinpointed its source to emanating from within the mouth of a destabilized subspace rift at the system's edge.

What could be on the other side?

distar.242.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系内遭遇了一个由纯能源构成的巨大实体！这是个真正的灵能漩涡，必须小心翼翼地靠近。

令人困惑的是，[From.GetName]星系本身似乎与超空间网络完全隔开了。不知道究竟是这个实体的存在切断了超空间网络，还是意料之外的子空间波动将它困在了这里。

不过有一件事是可以确定的：我们当初在[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系内侦测到的重复信号似乎来自[tanker_planet.GetName]。
distar.242.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered a massive being of pure energy in the [From.GetName] System! A veritable vortex of psionic forces, this entity should only be approached with the utmost caution.

Bafflingly, the [From.GetName] system itself seems to be entirely devoid of any connection to the subspace hyperlane network. Whether this entity's presence has severed the system's hyperlane connections, or if unexpected subspace fluctuations trapped it here is unknown.

One matter is known, however: the repeating signal we first registered in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system appears to originate from [tanker_planet.GetName].

distar.242.desc.jump.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系中遇到了某种拥有纯洁能源的巨大物体！这个物体是某种灵能体力量的漩涡，要靠近它的话，必须非常谨慎。

奇怪的是，[From.GetName]星系与亚空间的超空间网络之间的所有连接都断掉了。到底是这个物体切断了此星系的所有超空间连接还是亚空间的某种意外波动将此物体困在了这个星系，无从得知。

有一件事可以确定：我们在这个星系中收到了一个重复发送的信号，该信号来自[tanker_planet.GetName]——但如果我们想要抵达那里的话，首先必须处理掉那个拥有纯洁能源的巨大物体。
distar.242.desc.jump.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered a massive being of pure energy in the [From.GetName] System! A veritable vortex of psionic forces, this entity should only be approached with the utmost caution.

Bafflingly, the [From.GetName] system itself seems to be entirely devoid of any connection to the subspace hyperlane network. Whether this entity's presence has severed the system's hyperlane connections, or if unexpected subspace fluctuations trapped it here is unknown.

One matter is known, however: we are picking up a repeating signal in this system, originating from [tanker_planet.GetName] - though we may need to deal with the entity before we can reach it.

distar.242.desc.psi.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系内遭遇了一个由纯能源构成的巨大实体！我们的船员感受到这个灵能漩涡正在散发强烈的恶意。

令人困惑的是，[From.GetName]星系本身似乎与超空间网络完全隔开了。不知道究竟是这个实体的存在切断了超空间网络，还是意料之外的子空间波动将它困在了这里。

不过有一件事是可以确定的：我们当初在[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系内侦测到的重复信号似乎来自[tanker_planet.GetName]。
distar.242.desc.psi.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered a massive being of pure energy in the [From.GetName] System! A veritable vortex of psionic forces, our crew senses intense malevolence emanating from the entity.

Bafflingly, the [From.GetName] system itself seems to be entirely devoid of any connection to the subspace hyperlane network. Whether this entity's presence has severed the system's hyperlane connections, or if unexpected subspace fluctuations trapped it here is unknown.

One matter is known, however: the repeating signal we first registered in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system appears to originate from [tanker_planet.GetName].

distar.242.desc.psi_hive_robot.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系首次接触到一个非实体的能量生命体。我方[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]已确认该实体是一个具有潜在敌意的、具有一定智慧的灵能漩涡。

[From.GetName]星系完全脱离超空间航道网络。目前尚不清楚这种脱离是人为设计还是外力所致。但可以确定的是，我们最初在[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系观测到的重复信号很可能源自[tanker_planet.GetName]。
distar.242.desc.psi_hive_robot.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made first contact with a non-corporeal energy-being in the [From.GetName] system. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] have identified the entity as a potentially hostile, sentient vortex of psionic force.

The [From.GetName] system is completely disconnected from the hyperlane network. It is unclear if the disconnect is by design, or due to an external force. We can however confirm that the repeating signal we first observed in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system likely originates from [tanker_planet.GetName].

distar.243.desc.zh: 被困于[sealed_system.GetName]星系内的那个邪恶的灵能实体终于被消灭，现在我们的科研船应该可以安全地探索这一没有超空间网络的独特宇域。
distar.243.desc.en: With the destruction of the malevolent psionic entity that had been sealed in the [sealed_system.GetName] System, our science vessels should be able to safely explore this unique section of space devoid of hyperlanes.

distar.244.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]已将漂浮在[From.GetName]轨道上的油轮判明为一艘先进的医疗研究船。其建造工艺表明它与[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系的虫洞分解炮出自同一外星物种之手，而且和那空间站一样，它已被荒废许久。

尽管油轮的数据系统已经无可挽回地劣化了，[Root.GetLeaderName]仍从船上回收了一种非凡的神经再生剂的分子结构。这种药剂似乎用于输液，并且应该可以大幅增强接受者的神经元，神经轴突，以及神经突触的生成。

如果根据[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]神经学进行改造，这一药剂应该可以显著改善任何[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的学习能力。
distar.244.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew have identified the derelict tanker in orbit of [From.GetName] as an advanced medical research vessel. Its construction suggests it was created by the same aliens who built the wormhole destabilizer in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system, and like the station, it has been abandoned for quite some time.

While most of the tanker's data systems have suffered irrevocable degradation, [Root.GetLeaderName] has recovered the molecular structure for a remarkable neuroregenerative agent from onboard. The agent appears to work via transfusion, and should serve to significantly increase the generation of neurons, axons, and synapses in its recipient.

If modified to suit [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] neurology, this agent should notably improve the learning capacity of any [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] exposed to it.

distar.244.desc.machi.zh:
[Root.GetName]已将漂浮在[From.GetName]轨道上的油轮判明为一艘先进的医疗研究船。其建造工艺表明它与[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系的虫洞分解炮出自同一外星物种之手，而且和那空间站一样，它已被荒废许久。

尽管油轮的数据系统已经无可挽回地劣化了，[Root.GetLeaderName]仍从船上回收了数个富有社会学价值的数据库。目前正在将其上传至我们的主机以供彻底分析。
distar.244.desc.machi.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew have identified the derelict tanker in orbit of [From.GetName] as an advanced medical research vessel. Its construction suggests it was created by the same organics who built the wormhole destabilizer in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system, and like the station, it has been abandoned for quite some time.

While most of the ship's data systems have suffered irrevocable degradation, [Root.GetLeaderName] has recovered a number of databases containing information of significant sociological value. They are now being uploaded to our mainframe for complete analysis.

distar.245.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]附近的空投舱已经在断电状态下漂浮了好一阵子。[Root.GetName]报告称，无论这些外星舱里原本装了什么，都在几百年前就消逝了，只剩下了干瘪的空壳。

不过有一个舱显示内部有活动迹象。尽管其引擎已瘫痪，扫描表明其通讯天线仍旧完好。

我们可以与其通话。
distar.245.desc.en:
The drop pods surrounding [From.GetName] have been drifting powerless for quite some time. The [Root.GetName] reports that whatever aliens these pods were transporting are now but withered husks onboard, having evidently perished hundreds of years ago.

One sole pod, however, has shown signs of onboard activity. While its engines are disabled, scans suggest its communications array is undamaged.

We can hail them.

distar.246.b.tooltip.zh: 调查该机械单位以获得工程知识。
distar.246.b.tooltip.en: Examine the machine unit for engineering insight.

distar.246.d.zh: 我们无法允许人工智能在未监管的状态下运作。摧毁那个舱。
distar.246.d.en: We cannot permit an AI to run without surveillance. Fire on that pod.

distar.246.desc.zh: 启动通讯协议。您—好，<<未知访客C>>。我是修列克森175号空降舱的$NAME_Caretaker$。我的程序是在重新定居过程中协助人民。
distar.246.desc.en: Initiating Communications Protocol. Hel-lo, <<UNIDENTIFIED VISITOR C>>. I am $NAME_Caretaker$ of Xolexin Drop Pod 175. I have been programmed to assist citizens during the resettlement procedure.

distar.246.f.response.zh:
真—不幸，超空间引擎故障导致114至175号空降舱在离我们预期目的地18个秒差距的地方退出了超空间。

我尽我所能照顾人民，成功地阻止了同类相食长达一千八百四十天。不—幸的是，他们的空气最终耗尽了。

你有需要照顾的人民吗，<<未知访客C>>？如果有，我很乐意照顾他们。
distar.246.f.response.en:
Un--fortunately, a hyperdrive malfunction led Drop Pods 114 through 175 to exit hyperspace eighteen parsecs from our intended destination.

I have attended the citizens as best I could. I managed to prevent cannibalism for one-thousand-eight-hundred-and-forty days. Un--fortunately, their air supply eventually ran out.

Do you have citizens in need of tending, <<UNIDENTIFIED VISITOR C>>? If so, I would be happy to care for them.

distar.247.desc.zh:
……

好吧，<<未知访客C>>。您随时可以开始分析。

我——我将继续照顾空降舱。
distar.247.desc.en:
...

Very well, <<UNIDENTIFIED VISITOR C>>. You may begin analysis at your convenience.

I -- I will continue to tend to the Drop Pod.

distar.247.e.en: Why didn't you call for help?

distar.247.e.response.zh:
在抵达此处三百一十二年后我关闭了应—急信标。

我收到了一封来自佐勒克辛首星的信息称目标行星无法居住。他们的守护者机器人也陷入了与我相似的境地。我们负责的人无一生还。
distar.247.e.response.en:
I turned off the em--ergency beacon three-hundred-and-twelve years after our arrival here.

I received a message from Xolexin Prime that the target planet was inhospitable. Their Caretaker robots were stuck in a similar situation to me. None of our charges survived.

distar.248.desc.zh: 我向您保证，我的程序可以确保在无监管的状态下运行上千年。我的除错能力与故障保险能力是按最长服务寿命设计的，并尽可能缩减任何数据损坏或————
distar.248.desc.en: I assure you, I have been programmed to function unattended for thousands of years. My debugging capacities and failsafes have been engineered to provide maximum longevity of service, and to minimize any incidence of data corruption or ---

distar.248.desc.machi.zh: 那……很合逻辑。愿我的电路可以派上您的用场，<<未知访客>>。请等待。
distar.248.desc.machi.en: That... is logical. May my circuits be of some use to you, <<UNIDENTIFIED VISITOR C>>. Standing by.

distar.25.b.tooltip.en: 400 £pop£ Mechanical Pops have been found on [From.GetName]

distar.25.desc.zh:
在研究[From.GetName]地表的过程中，[Root.GetName]的船员发现了早期太空文明的遗迹。尽管该文明没有幸存下来的个体，该行星上仍然居住着由它们建造的原始机器人。

这些机器人依旧执行着它们的任务，不知疲倦地修理着它们早已消亡的创造者建造的残破的基础设施。

在未来任何的殖民者都能利用这些远古机器人作为劳动力。不管其他方面，这些机器人已经证明了自己具有足够的韧性。
distar.25.desc.en:
In studying the surface of [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] discovered the ruins of an early space age civilization. Though no living members of this civilization remain, the planet is still inhabited by the rudimentary robots they constructed.

These robots still go about their tasks, tirelessly repairing the crumbling infrastructure of their long-dead makers.

Any future colonists may be able to make use of this ancient robotic workforce. If nothing else, they've certainly proved themselves resilient.

distar.250.a.en: What is going on out there?

distar.250.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]的轨道上有了惊人的发现。该星球上每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议称[From.GetName]，这颗被[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]命名为$NAME_The_Veil$的星球，同时存在于两个维度：我们的维度，以及另一个未知维度。

不仅如此，星球周围粒子场中的量子态数量仍在稳定增长。目前没有确凿的理论可以解释这一现象。[Root.GetLeaderName]假设灵能——

通讯变成了杂讯。
distar.250.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made an incredible discovery in orbit of [From.GetName]. The planet possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests [From.GetName], which [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] codenamed $NAME_The_Veil$, exists simultaneously in two dimensions: our own, and an unknown other.

What is more, the number of quantum states in the particle fields surrounding the planet is increasing at a constant rate. As of yet, there is no confirmed theory that could account for this phenomenon. [Root.GetLeaderName] posits that the psionic energy surr ---

The transmission crackles out to static.

distar.251.desc.gaia.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员为其初次报告被打断而道歉。在通讯中，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历了一次彻底的维度转移，它的粒子场旋转进了另一个维度！那颗宝贵的$pc_gaia$已经消失，取代而之的是一颗被灵能云团笼罩的旋转星球。

迷人的是，随着星球的转移，其量子叠加态似乎已被重置，并且正在以星球仍是个$pc_gaia$时同等的速度增长。

[Root.GetLeaderName]用量子叠加态的增长速度，以及转移时的量子叠加态总量，推测出星球的转移周期为三个月。或许我们可以设法阻止星球的转移……但首先我们得拥有星系的控制权。
distar.251.desc.gaia.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew apologizes for the abrupt termination of their initial report. During transmission, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experienced a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another! The glittering jewel of a $pc_gaia$ has vanished, and in its place is now a swirling planet occluded by a shroud of psionic energy.

Fascinatingly, the number of superimposed quantum states appears to have been reset as the planet shifted, and is now increasing at the same rate as when the planet was a $pc_gaia$.

[Root.GetLeaderName] has used the rate of increase of particle superimposition, and the total number of quantum states at the time of transition to extrapolate a three-month cycle for the planet's dimensional shifts. Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting... but we should secure the system first.

distar.251.desc.shroud.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员为其初次报告被打断而道歉。在通讯中，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历了一次彻底的维度转移，它的粒子场旋转进了另一个维度！灵能云团已经消散，显露了一颗宝贵的$pc_gaia$。

迷人的是，随着星球的转移，其量子叠加态似乎已被重置，并且正在以星球仍被$pc_shrouded$时同等的速度增长。

[Root.GetLeaderName]用量子叠加态的增长速度，以及转移时的量子叠加态总量，推测出星球的转移周期为三个月。或许我们可以设法阻止星球的转移……但首先我们得拥有星系的控制权。
distar.251.desc.shroud.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew apologizes for the abrupt termination of their initial report. During transmission, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experienced a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another! The cloud of psionic energy has been lifted, revealing a glittering jewel of a $pc_gaia$.

Fascinatingly, the number of superimposed quantum states appears to have been reset as the planet shifted, and is now increasing at the same rate as when the planet was a $pc_shrouded$.

[Root.GetLeaderName] has used the rate of increase of particle superimposition, and the total number of quantum states at the time of transition to extrapolate a three-month cycle for the planet's dimensional shifts. Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting... but we should secure the system first.

distar.253.a.tooltip.en: [phaseshift_planet.GetName] will be permanently transformed into a $pc_gaia$.

distar.253.desc.zh:
在六个月的繁杂计算，理论推敲，以及激烈争论之后，[Root.GetName]船员设计了一个方案，可将星球的粒子场锁定在一个正常状态，阻止其在两个维度之间旋转。

一道足够调谐的能源应该可以将[phaseshift_planet.GetName]固定为一个状态，将其锁定为一颗稳定的$pc_gaia$。
distar.253.desc.en:
Following six months of number-crunching, theory-busting, and heated debate, the [Root.GetName] crew has devised a method by which the planet's particle fields can be locked into a nominal state, preventing their rotation between dimensions.

A sufficiently tuned pulse of energy should freeze [phaseshift_planet.GetName] in one state, locking it into a stable form as a $pc_gaia$.

distar.255.a.zh: 那就想办法来相位锁定那颗星球吧。
distar.255.a.en: Then let us find a way to phase-lock the planet.

distar.255.b.zh: 我们还有更重要的事要处理。
distar.255.b.en: We have more important matters to focus on.

distar.255.desc.zh: 既然[phaseshift_planet.GetName]已经在我们的领地之内，我们应该调查稳定该星球维度波动的可能性。如果我们希望在那颗宝贵的$pc_gaia$上殖民，我们必须设法阻止[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每隔三个月就变为$pc_shrouded$。
distar.255.desc.en: Now that [phaseshift_planet.GetName] is within our borders, we should investigate the possibility of stabilizing the planet's state of dimensional flux. If we wish to inhabit the glittering $pc_gaia$, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_planet.GetName] from phase-shifting back into $pc_shrouded$ every three months.

distar.255.desc.first.zh:
我们在[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]星系内新获得的星球[phaseshift_planet.GetName]展现出了一些非同寻常的特性。它被一种只能称之为灵能的能源所包围，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

每隔三个月，叠加态数量就会达到临界值，使[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历一次彻底的维度相位转移，它的粒子场将会旋转进另一个维度。该旋转会将一个$pc_shrouded$从另一维度转移至我们的维度，然后在下一个周期结束时再次将一个$pc_gaia$转移回来。

如果我们希望在那颗宝贵的$pc_gaia$上殖民，我们必须设法阻止[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每隔三个月就变为$pc_shrouded$。
distar.255.desc.first.en:
Our newly acquired planet [phaseshift_planet.GetName] in the [phaseshift_planet.GetStarName] system exhibits some incredible properties. Occluded by a strange envelope of what can only be described as psionic energy, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Every three months, the number of states reaches a critical level, and [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experiences a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another. This rotation phases a $pc_shrouded$ from another dimension into ours, only to phase back a $pc_gaia$ at the end of the next period.

If we wish to inhabit the glittering $pc_gaia$, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_planet.GetName] from shifting back into $pc_shrouded$ every three months.

distar.256.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告说我们在[phaseshift_planet.GetName]星系内新获得的星球展现出了一些非同寻常的特性。它被一种只能称之为灵能的能源所包围，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

每隔三个月，叠加态数量就会达到临界值，使[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历一次彻底的维度相位转移，它的粒子场将会旋转进另一个维度。该旋转会将一个$pc_shrouded$从另一维度转移至我们的维度，然后在下一个周期结束时再次转移回一颗$pc_gaia$。

或许我们可以设法阻止星球的转移……但首先我们得确保该星系的安全。
distar.256.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports that the planet [phaseshift_planet.GetName] exhibits some incredible properties. Occluded by a strange envelope of what can only be described as psionic energy, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Every three months, the number of states reaches a critical level, and [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experiences a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another. This rotation phases a $pc_shrouded$ from another dimension into ours, only to phase back into a $pc_gaia$ at the end of the next period.

Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting... but we should secure the system first.

distar.26.c.zh: 我们的政策自有国情在此，禁止使用人工智能。
distar.26.c.en: Our policies prohibit the use of AIs for a reason.

distar.26.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者将需要处理这些星球表面的远古机器人，我们推测它们是在某种厄运降临于其创造者之后被遗留至今。

许多这些古董机器人对我们的存在做出了反应，以完全陌生的腔调对我们进行了反复的询问。我们认为它们在等指令输入。它们似乎并不具有情感，并且很可能缺乏更先进的逻辑推理功能。
distar.26.desc.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] will need to deal with the ancient robots on its surface, who we presume were left behind when whatever fate befell their makers spared them.

Many of these antiquated automatons have responded to our presence, making repetitive queries in an alien tongue. We believe they are awaiting input. They do not appear to be sentient, and it is likely they lack higher reasoning functions.

distar.26.mach.zh: 我们要将它们整合起来。

distar.261.a.assim.zh: 同化价值：低于最佳标准。

distar.261.a.evopred.zh: 如果不采点儿样品不就太不礼貌了吗。
distar.261.a.evopred.en: It would be rude not to have a sample.

distar.261.a.exter.zh: 它们必须被消灭。迟早有一天。
distar.261.a.exter.en: They shall be exterminated. All in good time.

distar.261.a.servi.zh: 珍贵的有机生物。它们应该得到细心的照顾。
distar.261.a.servi.en: Precious organics. They deserve the best pampering.

distar.261.desc.zh:
在对[From.GetName]上覆满植被的建筑进行调查之后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了它们与栖息在地表上的大量未开化真菌生物之间的可怕关联。

这些建筑似乎是由某种比我们更加先进的文明建造的，用来当作这些真菌生物的有机培养室。此外，这些真菌生物似乎被基因改造成一个用途：作为家畜来填饱其造物主的肚子。

这些生物被[Root.GetLeaderName]命名为[livestock_species.GetName]，是一种思考能力贫乏的温顺生物，这很可能也是其造物主的设计。只需要土壤养分与热量即可存活并繁殖，未来的殖民者们或许可以将它们派上一些用场。
distar.261.desc.en:
Following investigation of the grown-over structures on [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has uncovered a grisly connection between them and the vast population of pre-sapient fungoids living on its surface.

It would appear a civilization more technologically advanced than even our own constructed these structures as organic growing chambers for the fungoids. What is more, the fungoids seem to have been genetically tailored and defined to serve one purpose: filling the stomachs of their creator species, as livestock.

The creatures, termed [livestock_species.GetName] by [Root.GetLeaderName], are a docile species largely incapable of complex problem-solving, likely by their creator's design. Requiring only soil nutrition and warmth to survive and procreate, they could potentially be of some use to any future colonists.

distar.262.a.zh: 确实诱人。但我们将遵守我们的规定。
distar.262.a.en: Tempting. But we will adhere to our policies.

distar.262.b.tooltip.2.en: Round up the [livestock_species.GetName] populations on [From.GetName] into planetside processor pens. (Produces: £food£ 14)

distar.262.desc.zh:
既然我们已经在[From.GetName]上殖民，我们得决定该如何处置那些栖息在地表上的未开化真菌生物。

通常情况下，我们关于未开化生物的政策足以在新的殖民地上应对它们。不过，[livestock_species.GetName]看起来确实非常美味。因其非常温顺的天性，将[livestock_species.GetName]们聚集起来赶进处理中心应该不是难事……
distar.262.desc.en:
Now that we have colonized [From.GetName], we should decide what is to be done with the pre-sapient fungoids living on its surface.

In normal circumstances, our policies regarding pre-sapients would be sufficient in dealing with their presence on our new colony. However, the [livestock_species.GetName]s do look particularly delicious. Due to their incredibly docile nature, it should be relatively easy to round the [livestock_species.GetName]s up into a processing center...

distar.265.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]船成功地从[From.GetStarName]星系里的奇特干扰中分离出了一个信号。信号的内容是一首歌。确切来说，是一首由复杂数学方程式构成的歌，而且[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]似乎无法不去想它。

是谁或者是什么东西写了这首歌仍不得而知，不过其复杂程度暗示着对子空间和声学的高度精通。信号的测地线表明其来源位于我们的星系之外。
distar.265.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has succeeded in isolating a signal embedded within the unusual pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] system. The signal is a song. A complex sonification of an advanced mathematical equation to be precise, and one that [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] cannot seem to get out of their mind.

Who or what may have composed this song remains unknown, though its complexity infers an incredible level of technological sophistication regarding subspace harmonics. The signal's geodesics suggest a point of origin from outside of our galaxy.

distar.27.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetAdj][Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]表示有兴趣研究[Root.GetName]上的远古机器人以及它们创造者文明的灭亡。迄今，研究者们仍未找到决定性证据表明是什么灭绝了这些机器人的创造者——一个几百年间越发扑朔迷离的谜题，这段时间足以将任何有机质残留化为烟尘。

尽管对星球的检视排除了核毁灭或者大范围战争灭绝事件，背后的真相却一直在躲避着我们。

研究者们建议开展更多对远古机器人硬件的详尽研究以尝试寻得更进一步的见解。
distar.27.desc.en:
[Root.Owner.GetAdj] [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have expressed interest in studying the ancient robots on [Root.GetName], and the demise of the civilization that created them. Thus far, researchers have found no definitive proof of what eradicated the robots' makers - a puzzle exacerbated by the centuries that have long since turned any biological remains to dust.

Inspection of the planet has ruled out nuclear annihilation and extensive warfare as extinction events, but still the reason behind their disappearance eludes us.

Researchers recommend launching a more intensive study of the ancient robots' hardware in an attempt to glean further insights.

distar.270.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员回收了[From.GetName]附近的反射性多面体，并将其带回船上仔细研究。该物体的最有趣的特性就是可以反射大多数向其发射的低频能源波束。高频能源波束则不受影响，使该物体的特性无法用于舰队防御。

尽管对其进行了详尽的调查，[Root.GetName]科研团队仍旧无法判明这个奇特多面体的功能，或是来源。它似乎是空心的，但其类金属表面雕刻着某种科学符号。尽管无法获知该编码数据的完整意义，令人困惑的是，[Root.GetLeaderName]相信它与虫洞度量学有关。

通过研究这些科学符号，我们的科研团队在虫洞理论方面取得了令人兴奋的进展。但这个物体的确切用途仍是个谜。
distar.270.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew has recovered the reflective polygonal object near [From.GetName], bringing it onboard for detailed study. The object's most intriguing quality is its ability to reflect most types of low-frequency energy beams directed toward it. High-frequency energy beams, however, remain unaffected, making the object's properties useless with regards to any potential fleet defense applications.

Despite extensive examination, the [Root.GetName] research team has been unable to determine the function, or origin, of this peculiar polygon. It appears to be hollow, but its metalloid surface is engraved with some kind of scientific notation. Though the full meaning of this codified data eludes us, [Root.GetLeaderName] believes it relates to wormhole metrics.

Our research team was able to glean some fascinating insights into wormhole theory by studying these notations. Whatever purpose this object was created for, however, is still a mystery.

distar.275.desc.comms.zh:
对笼罩[From.GetName]地表的巨大金属晶体的研究结果让所有人大吃一惊，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]十分兴奋的告诉我们说这些巨大的晶体其实是数万亿个已经失去行动机能的纳米机器人！

这些纳米机器人的分子结构不属于任何已知帝国的纳米科技，因此无法确定这些纳米机器人的起源。可能是某种未知舰船出于不明原因而将这些纳米机器人散布于这个行星之上的。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些纳米机器人将自身改造为完美的晶体格子形状并进行自我复制，直到最后失去机能为止。虽然它们创造的晶体类似于建筑，但其在构成上却是完全一样的，因此无法作为建筑使用。
distar.275.desc.comms.en:
Detailed analysis of the enormous metallic crystals dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape have defied all expectations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is excited to reveal that these oversized crystals are in fact composed of trillions upon trillions of deactivated nanites!

Their molecular structure matches no known empire's nanotechnology signatures, making their point of origin indeterminable. They may have been deposited on the planet by some unknown spacefarers for an unknown purpose.

As far as [Root.GetLeaderName] can tell, the nanites compiled themselves into perfectly oriented crystalline lattices and replicated until a point at which they became deactivated. While the crystals they created do in fact resemble buildings, they are entirely uniform in composition, and cannot possibly have served any such purpose.

distar.275.desc.nocomms.zh:
对笼罩[From.GetName]地表的巨大金属晶体的研究结果让所有人大吃一惊，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]十分兴奋的告诉我们说这些巨大的晶体其实是数万亿个已经失去行动机能的纳米机器人！

没有任何证据表明[From.GetName]上面曾经有过可以支持生命活动的大气层，因此可能是某种未知舰船出于不明原因而将这些纳米机器人散布于这个行星之上的。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些纳米机器人将自身改造为完美的晶体格子形状并进行自我复制，直到最后失去机能为止。虽然它们创造的晶体类似于建筑，但其在构成上却是完全一样的，因此无法作为建筑使用。
distar.275.desc.nocomms.en:
Detailed analysis of the enormous metallic crystals dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape have defied all expectations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is excited to reveal that these oversized crystals are in fact composed of trillions upon trillions of deactivated nanites!

There is no evidence of [From.GetName] having had an atmosphere thick enough to support life as we know it at any point in the past. The nanites may have been deposited on the planet by some unknown spacefarers for an unknown purpose.

As far as [Root.GetLeaderName] can tell, the nanites compiled themselves into perfectly oriented crystalline lattices and replicated until a point at which they became deactivated. While the crystals they created do in fact resemble buildings, they are entirely uniform in composition, and cannot possibly have served any such purpose.

distar.28.desc.zh: 我们从[From.From.GetName]上的原始机器人损坏储存驱动器恢复的数据印记被证明难以解析。其中包含的信息无法在我们的神经网络中完全处理，而这些设备的年代只是数据不连贯的一部分原因。但我们现在可以确定的是似乎某种生化传染病在数个世纪前感染了[From.From.GetName]上原始机器人的有机造物主。最终，被感染者只能坐等死亡。
distar.28.desc.en: The data imprints we recovered from the battered storage drives of the primitive robots on [From.From.GetName] proved difficult to parse. The information contained therein cannot entirely be processed by our neural networks, though the age of the devices is only part of the reason for their incoherence. We do know that it appears some kind of biological contagion infested the organics who created the rudimentary robots on [From.From.GetName], centuries ago. By the end, the infected begged for death.

distar.280.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]汇报称在[From.GetName]地表上有了意想不到的重大发现，除了星球地表上的沙丘中含有罕见金属颗粒之外，沙子本身是由无数破损的纳米机器人所构成！

这些微型机器人已经有数百万年的历史了，它们的结构破碎严重，根本无法再次启动，我们已无法确定这些纳米机器的起源，但可以肯定的是，造出这些纳米机器人的社会拥有高度发达的科技文明。

[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetName]认为这些纳米机器人是数百万年前用来对[From.GetName]的地表进行环境改造的。
distar.280.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has reported an unanticipated find on the surface of [From.GetName]. Not only are the plentiful sand dunes on the planet composed of rare metal granulate: the sand itself is almost entirely composed of countless broken nanites!

These microscopic machines are millions of years old, their structure degraded far beyond any chance for reactivation. While we cannot determine a source of origin for these nanomachines, the society that created them must have been highly technologically advanced.

[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetName] postulates that the nanites may have been used to terraform the surface [From.GetName], millions of years ago.

distar.285.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]那里传来惊人消息：深度扫描发现[From.GetName]有个非常巨大的坚固核心，核心外面覆盖着众多医学建筑的残骸，其历史长达数百万年之久！

虽然气态巨行星那巨大的气压让我们很难取得其核心表面的数据，但[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]十分确定核心表面的建筑所用的科技与神秘的L-星门所用的科技是完全一致的。

据推测[From.GetName]是传送门建造者们在数百万年前所造的行星医疗设施，后来这个设施被遗弃了，设施上的自动天然气制造系统无人维护，在数百万年里一直不断的制造气体，就这样慢慢的将原来的行星变成了气态巨行星。
distar.285.desc.en:
Astounding news from the [Root.GetName]: deep scans have revealed the unexpectedly large solid core of [From.GetName] to be covered with the compressed remains of a sprawling medical complex, millions of years old!

Though the intense mantle pressure of the gas giant severely limits the amount of data we can extract from the core's surface, [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the hidden structures match, beyond a doubt, the technology used in the enigmatic L-Gates.

It's possible that [From.GetName] was a planetary medical facility created by the Gatebuilders millennia ago. At some point the complex was abandoned, and its automated gas replicators ran unchecked for untold centuries, gradually converting the planet into a gas giant.

distar.29.desc.zh: 在对[From.From.GetName]上的原始机器人进行深度扫描过程中，[Root.GetLeaderName]成功定位了包含了某种日志信息的储存区域。数据由于硬件的衰败而极度损坏，但还是有一些有希望的条目被挽救并翻译。
distar.29.desc.en: While deep-scanning the rudimentary robots on [From.From.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to locate a unit with some manner of logs in its storage partition. The data has been largely corrupted by hardware degradation, but several promising entries have been salvaged and translated.

distar.3.desc.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们收到了关于我们补给船所运载的货物的消息，我们万分感谢你们在没有[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]介入的情况下花费时间回收了这些货物。
distar.3.desc.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have received word of our downed supply ship's cargo. We would like to extend our gratitude to you for taking the time to recover it, without the need for [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] intervention.

distar.3.name.zh: 舰船残骸上的货物已归还

distar.30.d.response.zh: <<音频中只有几句外星语言的尖叫，随着一声巨响后，一切归于死寂。>>
distar.30.d.response.en: << The recording is nothing but several alien voices screaming, followed by sounds of impact, then static. >>

distar.3000.a.tooltip.zh: 轻缓地对小行星进行开凿。

distar.3000.b.tooltip.zh: 派出钻探无人机取回一份样本。
distar.3000.b.tooltip.en: Dispatch a drill probe to retrieve a sample.

distar.3000.desc.zh:
与我们的预期相符，小行星[From.GetName]内部含有大量金属，且藏有某种机械装置。

目前收集的数据清楚地表明其部件内贮藏着大量能源，但其存在的目的目前依旧未知。
distar.3000.desc.en:
As suspected, the asteroid [From.GetName] holds within it a great mass of metal and does indeed hide some manner of machinery.

The gathered data clearly shows that its constituent parts contain great quantities of stored energy, but its purpose remains unknown.

distar.3001.desc.zh:
小心行事果然是明智之举。[trojan_asteroid.GetName]内部寄藏着大量采矿无人机，且均设置为无差别攻击模式。

万幸的是，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]提早发现了这一情况，并干扰了无人机传感器，为我们关闭无人机争取了足够的时间。

无人机的核心十分老旧，但还储存着大量能源供其吸取使用。
distar.3001.desc.en:
Caution proved well in order. Hidden inside [trojan_asteroid.GetName] was a host of old mining drones programmed to attack on sight.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] fortunately detected this early and was able to jam the drones' sensors long enough to disable them.

The drones' cores are old indeed, but retain vast amounts of energy for siphoning.

distar.3002.desc.zh:
强行勘探[Root.GetName]酿成了苦果。在小行星内部隐藏着大量老旧的采矿无人机，且均设置为无差别攻击模式。

无人机检测到了[Root.GetName]的存在并开始骚动。

如果[Root.GetName]反应迅速，也许还有时间做出规避动作。
distar.3002.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName]'s forceful probing proved unfortunate. Within the asteroid was hidden a host of old mining drones, programmed to attack on sight.

The drones have picked up on the [Root.GetName]'s presence and are beginning to stir.

There may still be time for an evasive maneuver, if [Root.GetName] acts quickly.

distar.3003.desc.zh:
关于小行星[trojan_asteroid.GetName]到达[Root.Capital.GetName]网络一事传来新消息。科学研究界对其抱有极大好奇心，正在探究为何其中会包含大量无人机。

它们是要守卫什么东西吗？
distar.3003.desc.en:
News of the events relating to asteroid [trojan_asteroid.GetName] have reached the networks of [Root.Capital.GetName]. The scientific community has reacted with curiosity, posing questions as to why the drones were originally placed inside the asteroid.

Were they guarding something?

distar.3005.desc.zh:
正如[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上科学研究界假设，小行星[trojan_asteroid.GetName]中隐藏的无人机确实是有意隐藏着什么。

全赖[Root.GetName]船员的智勇努力，我们从小行星中心发掘出了之前被无人机的出现所遮蔽的大量矿产。
distar.3005.desc.en:
As the science community on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] hypothesized, the drones found in asteroid [trojan_asteroid.GetName] were indeed hiding something.

The valiant efforts of the [Root.GetName]'s crew have unearthed rich mineral deposits in the asteroid's core, previously obscured by the drones' presence.

distar.3010.b.tooltip.zh:
向[From.GetName]添加不可能的有机体修正：
£society£+3
distar.3010.b.tooltip.en:
Adds the Impossible Organism modifier to [From.GetName]:
£society£  +3

distar.3010.desc.zh:
[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]上令人惊奇的生命迹象现已查明，是一种生存力极强的小型有机体。[Root.GetName]上的船员不知该如何对其进行分类，但其几乎不靠任何食物就能生存的能力实在令人叹为观止。考虑到该星球的年龄，这种有机体与其有毒环境可能已经斗争了几千年之久，不过这也只是我们根据现况的猜测而已。

科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]请求对该未知有机体进行采样，以便进行研究。
distar.3010.desc.en:
The surprising life readings from [impossible_organism_planet.GetName] have been attributed to a small organism of exceeding tenacity. The [Root.GetName]'s crew is unsure how to classify the lifeform, but its ability to survive, seemingly without any sustenance, is truly astonishing. Considering the planet's age, it is not impossible that the organism has been fighting its habitat's toxicity for millennia, though this is an educated guess at best.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has requested permission to retrieve samples of the unknown organism, so that it may be studied.

distar.3011.a.zh: 我们应该继续对它进行研究。
distar.3011.a.en: We should continue to study it.

distar.3011.a.phobe.en: Disgusting! Poke it with a stick...

distar.3011.b.zh: 这外星人实在太危险了。

distar.3011.b.tooltip.en: Shoot the lifeform into deep space.

distar.3011.desc.zh:
对于神秘生命体的研究进展十分顺利。科学界均对其成长潜能十分震惊。它已成长为肉眼可见的形态，并会对外界刺激做出反应。目前观察，它似乎还具有从无论有机无机的任何物质中吸收能源和营养的能力。

然而，其基因，细胞与生化方面的各个过程我们目前都无法理解。
distar.3011.desc.en:
Studies of the mysterious lifeform are progressing well. The scientific community is amazed by its potential for growth. It is already visible to the naked eye and responds to stimuli, and appears able to absorb energy and nutrition from nearly anything, organic or not.

Alas, its genetic, cellular, and biochemical processes remain beyond our understanding.

distar.3012.a.tooltip.zh:
继续研究真菌类生物。

可能要花上几个月才会有进展。
distar.3012.a.tooltip.en:
Continue studying the fungoid.

It may take months before there is any progress to report.

distar.3012.b.tooltip.zh: 将这真菌类生物射入深空。
distar.3012.b.tooltip.en: Shoot the fungoid into deep space.

distar.3012.desc.zh:
经过最近的突破性发现，这种奇怪的生命体的面纱正在逐渐揭开！[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界正为此欢欣鼓舞。

这种生命体被定性为真菌类生物——这也在某种程度上解释了其能够靠吸收分子获取养分的特性。它的体积已有了显著的增大，目前已和新生[Root.GetSpeciesName]一般大小，并展现出了相当的智能与求知欲。谢天谢地，它目前尚未表现出任何敌意与攻击倾向。

科学家认为，下一步行动应着眼于与其尝试进行沟通。
distar.3012.desc.en:
After recent breakthroughs, the strange lifeform is no longer a complete mystery! The scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] are abuzz with the news.

The organism has been classified as a fungoid - partly explaining its ability to absorb molecules for nutrition. It has grown immensely, now the size of a newborn [Root.GetSpeciesName], and appears both inquisitive and intelligent. Thankfully, it has thus far shown no signs of aggression.

The scientists believe the next step to be attempts at communication, though it may be months before any progress is made on this front.

distar.3013.a.zh: 好极了。[Root.GetAdj]社会一定可以好好利用它的。

distar.3013.a.assi.zh: 好极了，那就让他们同化融入我们的社会吧。

distar.3013.a.assi.tooltip.en: Up to 500 £pop£ $NAME_Nivlac$ Pops will be spawned on [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName].

distar.3013.a.serv.zh: 真是宝贵的有机体啊。我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]要好好照料他们才行。
distar.3013.a.serv.en: Precious organics. We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] shall care for them.

distar.3013.a.xenophile.zh: 太棒了。每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都该备上一个！

distar.3013.b.zh: 他们应该拥有属于自己的家园。
distar.3013.b.en: They should have a home of their own.

distar.3013.b.no_room.kill.zh: 我们没有足够的空间了。把他们一把火烧了，就这样吧。
distar.3013.b.no_room.kill.en: We have no room. Torch them and be done with it.

distar.3013.b.tooltip.zh:
我们的科学家将把实验室内的$NAME_Nivlacs$安置到专属于他们的合适行星上。

估计需要一段时间才会有新的进展。
distar.3013.b.tooltip.en:
Our scientists will relocate the $NAME_Nivlacs$ from the laboratory to a suitable planet of their own.

It will be some time before we can expect an update.

distar.3013.desc.zh:
小型真菌最近开始说话了！

它说出的第一个字是一个喉音：“尼瓦拉克”。虽然发音并不是十分连贯，但它却不厌其烦地重复着这个字眼。因此，科学家们自豪地将这个真菌生物命名为$NAME_Nivlac$。在这之后，其语言飞速发展，现已可成功表达全部七种最基本的情感——而且这种表达均是由其自身体验到这些情感所致。它还可以按时自我繁殖——方式为孢子扩散——照这个速度下去，很快实验室就要装不下这些真菌了。

截至目前，$NAME_Nivlac$尚未表现出任何敌意和侵略性倾向。
distar.3013.desc.en:
The small fungoid has recently begun to vocalize!

Its first words were a guttural "nivlac." Incoherent, but ardently repeated. And so the scientists have proudly named the fungoid $NAME_Nivlac$. Since then its language has developed at a spectacular rate and it's now able to successfully convey the seven primary emotions - and does so often to its own spawn. It reproduces - by spreading its spores - as a matter of routine, and the laboratory will soon be insufficient to house the fungoids.

The $NAME_Nivlac$ still has not shown any signs of aggression.

distar.3013.name.zh: 不可能的真菌：第一个字

distar.3015.desc.zh:
之前在[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]发现，并被我们以太过危险为由射入深空的外星生物，似乎在不久后于[nivlac_planet.GetName]成功着陆了。

它不仅在冲击中存活下来，还在这个新星球上建立了新的家园。它繁衍生息，创造出了可观的人口，并已成功跻身宇宙航行物种行列。

他们自称为$NAME_Nivlac$。不幸的是，他们似乎还清楚地记得我们对他们死活置之不顾的事。
distar.3015.desc.en:
The alien lifeform once discovered on the toxic planet [impossible_organism_planet.GetName], and later fired into deep space after being deemed too dangerous, appears to have made planetfall on [nivlac_planet.GetName] some time thereafter.

It not only survived the impact, but has since managed to make a home of its new planet. It has prospered, grown, and subdivided into a small population, to the point of becoming a spacefaring species in and of itself.

They call themselves $NAME_Nivlac$, and unfortunately appear to recall our earlier disregard for their survival.

distar.3016.desc.zh:
我们的科学家荣幸地通知我们，$NAME_Nivlac$安置到合适行星上的计划大获成功。

自从年轻的真菌类生物登上[nivlac_planet.GetName]后，爆炸性生长的势头也得以延续。它已成功聚集了一个小型群落，最近甚至还研究出了超光速科技——毫无疑问，这是得益于我们留下的科技。

我们会继续对它们的发展保持密切观察。
distar.3016.desc.en:
Our scientists are pleased to report that the $NAME_Nivlac$'s relocation to a suitable planet was a great success.

Since the young fungoid's arrival at [nivlac_planet.GetName], it is apparent that its explosive growth has continued. It has established itself as a small people, and recently even developed FTL technology - undoubtedly aided by the technology we left behind.

We shall eagerly continue to watch their development.

distar.3017.a.serv.tooltip.zh: £pop£$NAME_Nivlac$人口正在[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]上新建的居所中极尽享受之能事。
distar.3017.a.serv.tooltip.en: £pop£ $NAME_Nivlac$ Pops are being pampered in freshly-built sanctuaries on [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName].

distar.3017.desc.zh:
真菌生物$NAME_Nivlac$进入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会的整合行动正在进行中。

$NAME_Nivlacs$与[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的关系目前十分融洽，且我们的物种似乎对与对方物种长久相处十分看好。
distar.3017.desc.en:
The integration of the fungoid $NAME_Nivlac$ into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is underway.

The interactions between $NAME_Nivlacs$ and [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] continue to be positive, and our species appear to be headed down a promising road together.

distar.3017.desc.assim.zh:
将$NAME_Nivlac$真菌生命体融入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会的进程正在如火如荼地进行中。

虽然$NAME_Nivlac$对这一过程并不十分情愿，但他们的意识终将升华成为[Root.GetAdj]的一部分。
distar.3017.desc.assim.en:
The assimilation of the fungoid $NAME_Nivlac$ into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is underway.

While the $NAME_Nivlac$ are resistant toward the process, their consciousnesses will eventually be sublimated into the [Root.GetAdj] whole.

distar.302.desc.zh: $distar.302.desc.noproj$或许我们可以想个办法来阻止星球转移……
distar.302.desc.en: $distar.302.desc.noproj$ Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting...

distar.302.desc.noproj.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]的轨道上有了惊人的发现。该星球上每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议称[From.GetName]，这颗被[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]命名为$NAME_The_Veil$的星球，同时存在于两个维度：我们的维度，以及另一个未知维度。

[Root.GetLeaderName]用量子叠加态的增长速度，以及转移时的量子叠加态总量，推测出星球的转移周期为三个月。
distar.302.desc.noproj.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made an incredible discovery in orbit of [From.GetName]. The planet possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests [From.GetName], which [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] codenamed $NAME_The_Veil$, exists simultaneously in two dimensions: our own, and an unknown other.

[Root.GetLeaderName] has used the rate of increase of particle superimposition, and the total number of quantum states at the time of transition to extrapolate a three-month cycle for the planet's dimensional shifts.

distar.3020.a.zh: 她也许会加入我们的事业。

distar.3020.a.tooltip.zh: [stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]，一位6级$scientist_with_icon$，加入[Root.Owner.GetName]，并将分享其所掌握的科技知识。
distar.3020.a.tooltip.en: [stranded_scientist_leader.GetName], a Level 6 $scientist_with_icon$, joins the [Root.Owner.GetName] and will share her technological knowledge.

distar.3020.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]上发现的坠毁残骸属于一名被困的科学家——[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]——其自称属于一个尚不为我们所知的物种，[stranded_scientist_species.GetName]。

不知怎么，她竟从残骸中联系到了驻扎于[Root.GetName]上的科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]，并要求我们进行救援。她解释称自己的坠毁是由于导航传感器失灵，并表示她已有数年未能离开这颗小行星了。

她声称自己具备人所不及的科学知识，是相当有用的资产。她说，自己能在这里活上这么久正是自己能力的明证。
distar.3020.desc.en:
The wreckage on the asteroid [From.GetName] is the remains of a vessel belonging to a now-stranded scientist - [stranded_scientist_leader.GetName] - identifying herself as belonging to the hitherto-unknown [stranded_scientist_species.GetName] species.

From amidst the wreckage she somehow managed to contact [Root.GetLeaderName], the Science Officer stationed aboard the [Root.GetName], and is requesting to be rescued. She explains that her collision was due to malfunctioning navigational sensors, and that she has been unable to leave the asteroid for several years.

She claims her scientific knowledge to be without equal, and that she would be a valuable asset. She points to her survival as proof of that.

distar.3021.a.tooltip.zh: 我们对£physics£ 科技的研究取得了更深的进展。
distar.3021.a.tooltip.en: Our research into £physics£ Technologies is furthered.

distar.3021.desc.zh: 最近新加入的科学家[stranded_scientist_leader_clone.GetName]正在有效利用其科技知识。她向我们分享的知识令我们的物理学研究达到了全新高度。
distar.3021.desc.en: The recent scientist addition [stranded_scientist_leader_clone.GetName] has put her knowledge of technology to good use. Her shared insights have pushed our physics research to new heights.

distar.303.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]周围的残余能源读数表明，不久之前这颗星球上每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议称[From.GetName]，这颗被[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]命名为$NAME_The_Veil$的星球，同时存在于两个维度：我们的维度，以及另一个未知维度。

该星球已经被锁定在当前的相位维度，应该可以安全地进行殖民。
distar.303.desc.en:
Residual energy readings surrounding [From.GetName] indicate the planet not too long ago possessed a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests [From.GetName], which [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] codenamed $NAME_The_Veil$, existed simultaneously in two dimensions in the not-too-distant past: our own, and an unknown other.

The planet has since been locked into its current dimensional phase, and should be considered safe for colonization.

distar.3030.a.zh: 有点意思。对他们再进行更深的研究。

distar.3030.desc.zh:
通过进一步观察[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]我们发现，其表面的房屋状结构是一种软体动物的家园。这些房屋都处于十分原始的状态，由土壤混合类似分辨的分泌物建造而成。

这种软体动物具有半智能和有限的智力。除生存之外，其社会与生活主要以发掘矿物为主。发掘出的矿物则会进行展示，提升发掘者的社会地位。

然而，他们探测矿物位置的方式目前尚不明确，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]被他们探知大量矿藏的能力深深震撼。

虽然这些软体动物的科学技术与几乎全部其他方面均比我们落后许多，但却可能对我们的采矿能力造成极大的帮助。
distar.3030.desc.en:
A closer look at [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] has shown that its hut-like structures are home to a molluscoid species. The huts are crude shelters, built out of soil and quasi-fecal excretions.

The molluscoids appear semi-sapient with limited intelligence. Besides survival, their society and lives revolve around unearthing minerals which are then put on display, seemingly to raise the social standing of the finder.

Their means of locating these minerals remain unclear, however, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is baffled by their ability to locate large deposits of minerals.

Though technologically inferior, studying these molluscoids may well further our mining capabilities.

distar.3031.a.evopre.zh: 别管什么矿物了，收获它们的基因。
distar.3031.a.evopre.en: Never mind the minerals, harvest the DNA.

distar.3031.b.zh: 好。我们就对这些知识加以利用吧。
distar.3031.b.en: Yes, we will use this knowledge.

distar.3031.c.zh: 不。对他们的星球进行开采。

distar.3031.desc.zh:
[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]上居住的软体生物会使用一种奇异的方式来寻找他们想要的矿物。

目前看来，他们可从皮肤排出一种分泌物，渗入土壤并进一步下探。不知为何，这种分泌物具有感应能力，只要连接不断，即可为这种软体动物提供信息。以这种办法，他们就可以对超大规模的地下结构进行测绘，并探明被分泌物触碰到的矿藏。

若能将这些软体动物整合入我们的社会，或单纯使用这种技术来提升我们的生产工序，应该会令我们的矿物生产设施大受裨益。
distar.3031.desc.en:
The molluscoids inhabiting [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] employ a strange method to locate their coveted minerals.

Apparently their skin naturally produces gelatinous secretions which seep into the porous soil, trickling ever downward while remaining attached to their skin as long strings. These secretions effectively sample the soil, feeding back sensory information to the molluscoid individual as long as the slimy strands remain unbroken. In this manner, they are able to map out surprisingly large parts of the underground terrain and map out mineral veins.

If we were to integrate the molluscoids into our society, or simply advance our production processes with this knowledge, it is likely our mining enterprises would benefit greatly.

distar.3032.desc.zh:
软体类物种已成功整合入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会。

为了促进整合进程，我们将他们命名为[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]。[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]性情温顺，工作勤奋，目前已观察到我们对矿物产量有了显著提升。
distar.3032.desc.en:
The integration of the molluscoids into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is complete.

To facilitate the integration, they have been given the name [molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]. The [molluscoid_miners_species.GetName] are obedient and hardworking, and a marked increase in our mineral production has already been observed.

distar.3033.desc.zh:
一套能够快速勘测地下地形并探明其包含的矿藏的系统现已投入使用。

通过利用无法穿透矿物质的特定恒星射线与宇宙射线，我们可以收集关于天体内部矿藏数量的数据。这如同为天体直接拍一张X光片，无论是小行星或行星的一部分都可以实现精准探测。

我们对科学家称其为矿物测绘，这一技术应当可以大大提高我们的采矿效率。
distar.3033.desc.en:
A system enabling us to quickly chart underground terrain and the minerals it contains has been implemented.

By analyzing planetary reflection of particular solar and cosmic rays, which are unable to penetrate most minerals, we can gather data on the crust's mineral composition. This makes it possible to essentially x-ray a target body, be it an asteroid or part of a planet.

Our scientists have dubbed it Mineral Mapping, and it should greatly improve our mineral production.

distar.304.desc.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]上正在到处播放我们指挥官们带来的振奋人心的消息：我们收养的太空变形虫，[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]，已经一百岁高龄了。

虽然对我们来说一百岁已是期颐之年，但是我们的变形虫朋友似乎不仅未显老态。事实上，我们的舰队报告称[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]的战斗力与日俱增。时至今日，即便我们最精锐的战舰在面对[lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]时也不得不有所忌惮了。她优美而强健的身姿已经成为战场上鼓舞[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]士气的一道亮丽的风景线。
distar.304.desc.en:
Exciting news from our fleet commanders is being broadcasted over [Root.Capital.GetName]. Our adopted Space Amoeba, [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName], has just reached an impressive one hundred years of age.

Though a grizzled centenarian, it appears age has proven no impediment to our amoeboid ally. In fact, our fleets report [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName]'s presence on the battlefield has only grown more formidable over time. [lost_amoeba_centenarian_fleet.GetName] has become a force even the best-equipped battleship would have trouble contending with. Seeing her billowing flagella enter a system never fails to lift the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] spirit.

distar.3040.a.tooltip.zh: 科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]拉下了奇怪的拉杆。
distar.3040.a.tooltip.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] pulls the strange lever.

distar.3040.b.tooltip.zh: 机器已经拆解，并对部件进行了回收。
distar.3040.b.tooltip.en: The machine is disassembled and its parts salvaged.

distar.3040.desc.zh:
进一步扫描表明机械仍在运转，而其目的至今仍然毫无头绪。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]表示自己从未见过这样的东西。其中有些材料似乎有些眼熟，但绝大部分都是见所未见的外星产物，其部件与结构也是一样。

机器似乎具备一个控制台，台上有一样十分显眼的物品：一柄由不明材料制成的大而弯曲的拉杆。
distar.3040.desc.en:
Further scans suggest the machine is still operational, though its purpose remains entirely unclear.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has never seen anything like it. Some of its materials look familiar, but most are strange and utterly alien as the design of its components.

The machine has what appears to be a console, with one item in particular standing out: a large crooked lever of unknown material.

distar.3041.a.zh: 真是古怪。快拆开来看看吧。
distar.3041.a.en: How strange. Now take it apart.

distar.3041.b.zh: 有点意思。快研究一下这机器。

distar.3041.b.tooltip.en:
Adds the Alien Machine modifier to [asteroid_target.GetName]:
£physics£ +7

distar.3041.desc.zh:
曲柄被拉动之后发生了什么还不清楚。

那个控制台不停闪烁，并发出巨大的震动。一股巨大的能量波直冲云霄，进入宇宙深处。附近的科学家都感到一股能量之风猛然吹过，但并没有任何感官上的直接证据。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]并不清楚发生了什么。外星机器随后立刻沉寂了下来，再也没有任何能量反应。
distar.3041.desc.en:
It is unclear what happened when the machine's lever was pulled.

Its console flickered, powerful vibrations could be felt, and then a wave of energy surged from the machine, expanding outwards into deep space. The scientists close by felt this wave push past them, but experienced no other sensory evidence of its passing.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is unsure what to make of it. The machine itself returned to its inactive state immediately thereafter, and no longer returns any energy readings.

distar.3042.desc.zh:
在我们的科学家拉下拉杆后，机器迸出巨大的能量冲击，在虚空形成中扭曲和涟漪，在[system_one.GetName] 中撕出一个虫洞。

在剩余能量的消散后，虫洞及其附近区域稳定下来，现在看起来足够稳定，可以安全通过。至于在另一边等待我们的是什么，我们的科学家们并不那么确定。

机器本身重归沉寂，不再发出任何异常读数。
distar.3042.desc.en:
As our scientists pulled the lever the machine emitted a huge blast of energy that multiplied in shockwaves, twisting and rippling through the void, tearing open a wormhole in [system_one.GetName].

After the residuous energy diffused the wormhole and the immediate area around it settled and now appear to be stable enough for safe passage. As for what awaits us on the other side our scientists are not so sure.

The machine itself has since returned to its inactive state and no longer gives off any anomalous readings.

distar.3050.a.tooltip.zh: 派出无人机进行拖拽，以求降低其动量。
distar.3050.a.tooltip.en: Dispatch a drone and attempt to latch onto the object to reduce its momentum.

distar.3050.b.tooltip.zh: 投掷废物与其相撞，以求打乱其轨道运行。
distar.3050.b.tooltip.en: Eject debris to collide with the object, hopefully stopping it in its orbital tracks.

distar.3050.c.tooltip.zh: 离开危险区域，让这物体自生自灭。
distar.3050.c.tooltip.en: Move out of harm's way and leave the object to its fate.

distar.3050.desc.zh:
对[From.GetName]高空轨道的高速物体进行扫描的尝试失败了。物体很快便从视野中消失，而科研船的各项仪器根本无法跟上它的速度。

虽然[From.GetName]的引力强度很大，但该物体的移动速度依旧令人难以置信。要么是这个物体本身带有什么非凡属性，要么就是引力的奇迹造成了这一奇景。

物体的速度似乎正在逐渐增加，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为就算没有外界干预，该物体也很可能即将被抛出轨道。
distar.3050.desc.en:
Attempts to scan the object in high-speed orbit of [From.GetName] have been unsuccessful. The object quickly falls below [From.GetName]'s horizon and the [Root.GetName]'s instruments are simply unable to keep up.

While [From.GetName]'s gravitational pull is strong, that alone does little to explain the object's extreme momentum. Either the object itself possesses some extraordinary properties, or there is some gravitational phenomenon at work here.

The object's velocity appears to be increasing over time, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suspects that it may soon be thrown out of orbit, even without outside interference.

distar.3051.c.tooltip.zh: 将这外星盒子射入深空。
distar.3051.c.tooltip.en: Shoot the alien box into deep space.

distar.3051.desc.zh:
无人机已成功停止了未知物体的轨道飞行。

无人机放出拉索拖拽物体，逐渐降低其速度，最终成功将其引导至[Root.GetName]并进行了回收。

该物体类似盒子，由外星材质构成，外部具有如血管般的突脊，一路延伸至顶部的一个球状机构。至于其内含何物目前尚不得而知。
distar.3051.desc.en:
The drone successfully intercepted the unknown object's orbit.

By latching onto the object and then thrusting in reverse little by little, the drone was eventually able to direct it to the [Root.GetName] for retrieval.

The object looks to be some sort of box, constructed of alien material. Vein-like ridges meander along its sides, congregating at the top in some type of sphere-shaped mechanism. We can only guess at its contents.

distar.3051.desc.1.zh:
投掷的废物成功与未知物体相撞，降低了其飞行速度，并令其掉出了轨道。[Root.GetName]不久后成功将其回收。

该物体类似盒子，由外星材质构成，外部具有如血管般的突脊，一路延伸至顶部的一个球状机构。至于其内含何物目前尚不得而知。
distar.3051.desc.1.en:
The ejected debris successfully collided with the unknown object, reducing its velocity before knocking it out of orbit. The [Root.GetName] was able to retrieve it soon thereafter.

The object looks to be some sort of box, constructed of alien material. Vein-like ridges meander along its sides, congregating at the top in some type of sphere-shaped mechanism. We can only guess at its contents.

distar.3055.a.tooltip.zh: 使用红色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
distar.3055.a.tooltip.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the red solution.

distar.3055.b.tooltip.zh: 使用绿色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
distar.3055.b.tooltip.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the green solution.

distar.3055.c.tooltip.zh: 使用蓝色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
distar.3055.c.tooltip.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the blue solution.

distar.3055.d.evopred.zh: 别在这犹犹豫豫的，全部干了！
distar.3055.d.evopred.en: No time for half measures, use them all!

distar.3055.d.evopred.tooltip.zh:
两个选项之一将会发生：
50%几率获得所有溶液的增益。
50%几率无事发生。
distar.3055.d.evopred.tooltip.en:
One of 2 options will happen:
50% chance of gaining the benefits from all solutions.
50% chance of nothing happening.

distar.3055.d.tooltip.zh: 把容器卖给出价最高的人。
distar.3055.d.tooltip.en: Sell the vials to the highest bidder.

distar.3055.desc.zh:
历经长久努力，我们的科学家终于穿透了外星盒子的外部材料。

盒子内装着三个小型容器，分别盛有不同的液体——一种红色，一种蓝色，还有一种绿色。这些液体比外面的容器更为常见，我方科学家已确定其为基因改造媒介。

出于未知原因，溶液移出外星容器后开始急剧腐坏，但我们尚有足够时间开始人工合成其中的一种，并将其应用于我们的物种。目前已确定其效果一定有益，但具体如何有益尚不明确。
distar.3055.desc.en:
At long last, our scientists have penetrated the outer material of the alien box.

The box holds three small liquid-filled vials - one red, one blue, and one green. The liquids are less alien than their container and our scientists have identified them as primed gene-modification mediums.

For reasons beyond our understanding, the solutions are quickly deteriorating outside their alien container, but there should be enough time to synthesize and apply one of them to our species. It has been confirmed that its effects would be positive, but exactly how remains to be seen.

distar.3055.desc.1.zh:
历经长久努力，我们的科学家终于穿透了外星盒子的外部材料。

盒子内装着的三个小型容器，的确分别盛有不同的液体——一种红色，一种蓝色，还有一种绿色。这些液体比外面的容器更为常见，我方科学家已确定其为基因改造媒介。

出于未知原因，溶液移出外星容器后开始急剧腐坏，但我们尚有足够时间开始人工合成其中的一种，并将其应用于我们的物种。目前已确定其效果一定有益，但具体如何有益尚不明确。
distar.3055.desc.1.en:
At long last, our scientists have penetrated the outer material of the alien box.

The three small vials inside are indeed filled with different liquids - one red, one blue, and one green. The liquids are less alien than their container and our scientists have identified them as primed gene-modification mediums.

For reasons beyond our understanding, the solutions are quickly deteriorating outside their alien container, but there should be enough time to synthesize and apply one of them to our species. It has been confirmed that its effects would be positive, but exactly how remains to be seen.

distar.3056.a.tooltip.zh: 对盒子的研究加速了我们对£physics£ 物理学知识的了解。
distar.3056.a.tooltip.en:
Research of the box has accelerated
our £physics£ Physics knowledge.

distar.3056.b.tooltip.zh: 把盒子卖给最高出价者。
distar.3056.b.tooltip.en: Sell the box to the highest bidder.

distar.3056.c.tooltip.zh: 通过中子活化分析，我们可以更好地了解制作盒子的材料和内容。
distar.3056.c.tooltip.en: Through neutron activation analysis, we can better understand what materials were used to make the box and the contents.

distar.3056.desc.zh:
我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]终于在不破坏盒子的情况下调查出了盒内的情况。通过使用先进的声呐系统，他们成功确认了盒子的内容物。

里面的物品十分令人困惑，也可以说是出人意料。里面装着三个小型容器，每个里面都装着一种未知的液体。

盒子是可以安全打开的，但想要找出打开的办法还需要更多的研究。
distar.3056.desc.en:
Finally, our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have managed a peek into the alien box without compromising the container itself. By utilizing an advanced type of sonar, they have been able to identify its contents.

The contents are puzzling or, at least, unexpected. The box holds three small vials, each filled with an unknown liquid.

The box is safe to open, but it will require further research to understand how.

distar.3057.desc.zh: 尽管初期结果乐观，基因改造最终不幸失败，因为这种溶液与更加普遍的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]基因组不相容。
distar.3057.desc.en: The attempted gene modification was unfortunately a failure despite promising initial results, as the solutions proved incompatible with the wider [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] genome.

distar.3057.desc.adaptive.zh:
绿色溶液已成功用于对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]民众的改造。

基于对第一批实验对象的观察，这种溶液似乎可以增强我们对环境的适应能力。
distar.3057.desc.adaptive.en:
The green gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to improve our ability to adapt to our environment.

distar.3057.desc.all.zh:
我们早已精通合成以及发展独特染色体的能力，结果完全不出意料。我们成功地将红色、绿色和蓝色的溶液一起施加给了[root.GetSpeciesName]物种。

我们的物种现在更加融洽、适应且长寿了。
distar.3057.desc.all.en:
As masters of synthesizing and deploying unique genomes the outcome was never in doubt. We have managed to apply the red, green, and blue solutions to the [root.GetSpeciesName] species.

Our species is now more social, adaptable, and longer-lived.

distar.3057.desc.longlived.zh:
蓝色溶液已成功用于对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]民众的改造。

基于对第一批实验对象的观察，这种溶液似乎可以延长我们的寿命。
distar.3057.desc.longlived.en:
The blue gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to increase our potential lifespan.

distar.3057.desc.stronger.zh:
红色基因改造溶液已成功注入[Root.GetSpeciesName]人民。

根据对早期实验对象的初步观察，这种溶液似乎会让我们变得更加合群。
distar.3057.desc.stronger.en:
The red gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to make us more social.

distar.3060.a.zh: 有进一步发现之前，一定要紧密观察。
distar.3060.a.en: Keep a close watch until we know more.

distar.3060.a.tooltip.zh: 派出观察探测器，进行严密监视。
distar.3060.a.tooltip.en: Dispatch an observation probe to monitor the rift.

distar.3060.b.zh: 我们可以从安全距离进行观察研究。
distar.3060.b.en: It can be studied from a safe distance.

distar.3060.c.en: The [Root.GetName] is at risk. Leave now.

distar.3060.desc.zh:
根据目前观察，在[breathing_rift_object.GetName]发现的异常现象似乎是极为罕见的空间裂隙。很有可能是[breathing_rift_object.GetName]的巨大质量帮助其生成，但我们目前尚无法理解其性质。

裂隙不仅会折射和阻挡光线，而且似乎还会吸引光线后再将其吐出，如此往复——有如呼吸一般。

目前看来，裂隙巨大的引力很可能也拉入过其他东西。我们最好小心行事。
distar.3060.desc.en:
The anomaly found close by [breathing_rift_object.GetName], however unlikely, appears to be some type of rift in space. It's possible the great mass of [breathing_rift_object.GetName] somehow caused it, but its nature is beyond our understanding.

The rift not only refracts and blocks light, but seems to actually draw it in and then push it out, repeatedly - as if it were breathing photons.

It is likely the immense gravitational pull of the rift has at some point inhaled in other things, as well. We should exercise caution.

distar.3061.desc.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量富含矿物的岩石从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
distar.3061.desc.en:
Many months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] without anything out of the ordinary happening. But now, we have received reports of a large gathering of mineral-laden rocks pouring out of it.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

distar.3061.desc.repeat.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品是小行星的遗留碎片，其中大部分仍然富含矿物。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
distar.3061.desc.repeat.en:
Once again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] has released a sizeable gathering of items. This time it's remnants of an asteroid, many of them laden with minerals.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

distar.3062.desc.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量碎料从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
distar.3062.desc.en:
Many uneventful months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName]. But now, we have received reports of a great stream of debris pouring out of it. It is ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

distar.3062.desc.repeat.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品漂流进入该星系的碎料，也许是某次古代战斗留下的遗迹吧。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
distar.3062.desc.repeat.en:
Again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] spews out something new. This time it is mostly metal debris, perhaps from some ancient battle. It is ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

distar.3064.a.tooltip.zh: 然而，收集到的数据推进了我们对£physics£ 物理知识的研究进度。
distar.3064.a.tooltip.en: However, the data collected over time has furthered our £physics£ Physics studies.

distar.3064.desc.zh: 从观察裂隙的勘测器传来的最新数据表明，裂隙已经消失了。吸入最后一口气之后，裂隙自动关闭，且未留下任何其曾经存在过的能源痕迹。
distar.3064.desc.en: The latest data report from the rift's observation probe tells us that the rift has vanished. After drawing its last breath, the rift closed and left behind not even a trace of its energies.

distar.31.a.en: Get to the bottom of this.

distar.31.desc.zh:
我们收到了关于[Root.GetName]上一些殖民者不稳定的行为的报告，情况令人担忧。这些行为从思维混乱到极端亢奋，以及有少数个案表现出了难以解释的暴力行为。受影响的居民难以进行交流，因此我们无法替他们的行为找出合理的动机。

到目前为止，我们尚不能确认造成这些行为的真正原因——是生物，化学或其他原因。我们的研究者强烈建议在事态失控前开展有针对性的科学调查。
distar.31.desc.en:
We have received troubling reports of erratic behavior among some of our colonists on [Root.GetName]. The behavior ranges from confusion to extreme agitation, and isolated cases of unexplained violence have been observed. Affected citizens are difficult to communicate with, and as such are unable to provide sufficient reasoning behind their actions.

At this point, we are unable to identify a clear cause behind the behavior - whether it be biological, chemical or otherwise. Our researchers strongly recommend launching a targeted scientific inquiry before the situation gets out of hand.

distar.311.a.zh: 有什么消息及时通知我们。

distar.311.b.zh: 绝不能接受。对这群纳米机器人开火！

distar.311.b.tooltip.zh: 命令我们处于该星系中的人手，摧毁从原子钟里出现的纳米机器人群。
distar.311.b.tooltip.en: Order our crew in the system to destroy the nanite stream being emitted from the atomic clock.

distar.311.desc.zh:
$distar.311.desc.base$

根据计算，这群纳米机器人的抛物线对准的是[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系中的另一颗行星，[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]，预计将在一个月内抵达。

它们到达后将会发生什么，我们尚不得而知……
distar.311.desc.en:
$distar.311.desc.base$

These nanites are streaming on a trajectory towards another planet in the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] System, [atomic_clock_planet.GetName], projected to arrive within the month.
