Whatever may happen once they arrive remains to be seen...

distar.312.desc.zh:
[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系小行星带中弹射而出的纳米机器人群，在[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]着陆了！这群纳米机器人以惊人速度迅速繁殖，只用了几个小时便覆盖了整颗行星的表面，并开始对其进行环境改造，将其转化为盖亚星球！

环境改造完成后几小时，所有参与改造纳米机器人全部自动关闭，并且腐烂至无法辨识的地步，直接导致我们无法从中提取任何信息与情报。

然而，它们的残留物为这个已经变得十分吸引人的星球表面增添了不少价值可观的金属合成物。
distar.312.desc.en:
The nanite stream ejected by the atomic clock in the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] system asteroid belt has made planetfall on [atomic_clock_planet.GetName]! Replicating at an incredible rate, the nanites covered the entire surface of the planet in a period of hours, proceeding to terraform it into a Gaia World!

Hours after the completion of the terraforming event, the nanites involved in the process deactivated and decayed beyond recognition, leaving us with little ability to extract any information from them.

However, their remains have peppered the surface of the now-very-tempting planet with valuable metallic composites.

distar.313.desc.zh:
据我们正在观察[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系的军官称，虽然大部分流向[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]的纳米机器人群已被炮火摧毁，却还是有数量难以统计的仍处于活跃状态纳米机器人到达了该行星表面。

它们的目的至今尚不明确，不过自从着陆后，它们就开始以一种似乎随机的方式开始了疾速繁殖。

[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]现在已被这种能够自我复制的显微级物质构成的粘液覆盖了。
distar.313.desc.en:
Our military officers observing the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] System report that while the vast majority of the nanites streaming towards [atomic_clock_planet.GetName] were fired upon and destroyed, an undetectable quantity of still-active nanites managed to reach the planet's surface.

Whatever purpose they were meant for remains unknown, but once reaching the planet's surface they have begun to replicate rapidly in a seemingly random fashion.

[atomic_clock_planet.GetName] is now covered in a moving slurry of microscopic replicators.

distar.315.desc.zh:
$distar.311.desc.base$

纳米机器人把这颗小行星变化成了一艘十分神奇的无人军事舰船，随后便离开了小行星的表面。

如果有兴趣，我们完全可以将其据为己有。
distar.315.desc.en:
$distar.311.desc.base$

These nanites left the surface of the asteroid, where they have coalesced into a fascinating, unmanned military vessel.

It is ours for the taking, should we so desire.

distar.32.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上越来越多的居民陷于困顿和焦虑中，并逐步展现出几周前我们在小部分隔离人群中观察到的古怪行为。更让人担忧的是，相当一部分居民已经开始表现出躁动和暴力倾向。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]警告说情况会继续恶化下去，除非我们能找到问题的根源。
distar.32.desc.en:
More colonists on [Root.GetName] have succumbed to confusion and agitation, exhibiting the erratic behavior we first observed in isolated populations weeks ago. A concerning number have also begun to display aggression and violent tendencies.

Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] warn the situation is likely to continue to degrade until we are able to find a cause.

distar.320.desc.zh:
$distar.311.desc.base$

纳米机器人在[From.From.From.GetName]表面建造了某种高级的计算网络。网络目前处于关闭状态，似乎也没有任何人工智能存在的迹象，而纳米机器人在建造完成后也都自动关闭了。

我们的研究人员对于这个网络的存在目的感到十分疑惑。要想研究这玩意，估计够让他们忙上好一阵了。
distar.320.desc.en:
$distar.311.desc.base$

The nanites have constructed some manner of advanced computational network on the surface of [From.From.From.GetName]. The network is inactive, and seemingly devoid of any AI, the nanites having deactivated the instant its construction was complete.

Our researchers are somewhat baffled as to the purpose of the network. Studying it should keep them occupied for quite some time.

distar.33.a.tooltip.zh: 暴怒的民众正在攻击自己的[Root.GetName]殖民者同胞！
distar.33.a.tooltip.en: Enraged civilians are attacking their fellow colonists on [Root.GetName]!

distar.33.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的形势正在逐渐失控。被焦虑和愤怒支配的民众比例已经达到了一个临界点。更糟糕的是，一部分拥有武器的人口也被卷入其中了！

激烈的武装冲突在居民区爆发，冲垮了维持秩序的民兵部队。暴怒的人群不断自相残杀，并将周围的更多人一并卷入其中！
distar.33.desc.en:
The situation on [Root.GetName] is spiraling out of control. The percentage of affected colonists displaying unexplained agitation and aggression has reached a boiling point. Worse yet, this includes portions of the populace with access to weaponry!

Outright skirmishes have broken out in our settlements, overwhelming civil peacekeeping forces. Enraged colonists are attacking one another, and anyone else who comes in range!

distar.330.desc.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

现在几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散，同样消失的还有[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]的大部分。

随着原子钟倒数归零，他向[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]上的某个接收器发射了一个信号，触发了一场灾难性的热核爆炸，摧毁了整个行星和定居于此的原始文明。

在我们的科学家还在为这次精准定时的毁灭行为背后的缘由争论不休的时候，这台原子钟依旧在滴答作响，仿佛下方的荒凉死寂和它毫无关系一样。
distar.330.desc.en:
For the past 42 years and 3 days, researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision, found on [From.From.From.GetName].

Now several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant, along with most of [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName].

As the clock reached its momentous deadline it transmitted a signal to a receiver on [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName], triggering a thermonuclear explosion of such devastating power it laid waste to the entire planet and the primitive society residing there.

While our scientists debate the reason behind this carefully timed act of annihilation, the atomic clock continues to tick, undisturbed by the desolation below.

distar.335.desc.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

现在几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散，同样消失的还有[nuked_planet.GetName]的大部分。

随着原子钟倒数归零，他向[nuked_planet.GetName]上的某个接收器发射了一个信号，触发了一场灾难性的热核爆炸，摧毁了整个行星。

在我们的科学家还在猜测这次精准定时的毁灭行为背后的缘由的时候，这台原子钟依旧在滴答作响，仿佛下方的荒凉死寂和它毫无关系一样。
distar.335.desc.en:
For the past 42 years and 3 days, researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision, found on [From.From.From.GetName].

Now several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant, along with most of [nuked_planet.GetName].

As the clock reached its momentous deadline it transmitted a signal to a receiver on [nuked_planet.GetName], triggering a thermonuclear explosion of such devastating power it laid waste to the entire planet.

While our scientists conjecture as to the reason behind this carefully timed act of annihilation the atomic clock continues to tick, undisturbed by the desolation below.

distar.34.desc.a.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上暴怒的殖民者已经被我们的部队平定镇压了。不幸的是，由于导致这些异常行为的原因仍然未知，我们无法确定下一次暴力浪潮什么时候会再次到来。

我们最杰出的生物学家十分怀疑是某种影响生理行为的传染病从中作祟，并正在废寝忘食尝试遏制它们的扩散！
distar.34.desc.a.en:
The enraged colonists on [From.From.GetName] have been pacified by our troops. Unfortunately, without understanding the cause behind their unexplained behavior, we have no way of knowing how long it will be before violence erupts again.

Our premier biologists heavily suspect some kind of behavior-affecting contagion is at play, and are working around the clock to isolate it!

distar.34.desc.b.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上暴怒的殖民者已经被我们的部队平定镇压了。不幸的是，由于导致这些异常行为的原因仍然未知，我们无法确定下一次暴力浪潮什么时候会再次到来。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]强烈建议，我们应在更多的惨剧发生前执行一次针对性的医学调查。
distar.34.desc.b.en:
The enraged colonists on [From.From.GetName] have been pacified by our troops. Unfortunately, without understanding the cause behind their unexplained behavior, we have no way of knowing how long it will be before violence erupts again.

Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] strongly recommend commencing a targeted medical inquiry, before any more tragedies can occur.

distar.340.desc.zh: [Root.Fleet.GetName]的死讯很快传遍了[Root.Owner.GetName]。这只变形虫一直以来都是我国的忠实伴侣。不过，我们的死灵法师在噩耗传来之后异常活跃，现在已经为我们悲痛的国民带来了解决方案。他们对方案没有细说，不过却坚称一定能让[Root.Fleet.GetName]重新回到我们身边。
distar.340.desc.en: News of the death of [Root.Fleet.GetName] has rippled through the [Root.Owner.GetName]. The amoeba has been a constant companion for our nation for a long time now. However, our necromancers have been unusually active ever since the fateful news came and have now come with a solution to our grieving nation. They won't explain how but they say that they can bring [Root.Fleet.GetName] back to us.

distar.340.desc.science.zh:
[Root.Fleet.GetName]的死讯很快传遍了[Root.Owner.GetName]，但没有任何人比科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]更加痛心。是[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe]第一个发现了迷失无助的变形虫幼体，并见证了它在[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer]自己温柔的教导下逐渐步入成年。

现在，失去了[Root.Fleet.GetName]无言的陪伴，科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]也许再也回不到以前的状态了。
distar.340.desc.science.en:
News of the death of [Root.Fleet.GetName] has rippled through the [Root.Owner.GetName], though none have been as affected as Science Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]. It was [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe] who first discovered the Space Amoeba as a lost and helpless juvenile, and watched the creature grow to full maturity under [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer] own gentle guidance.

Now, without [Root.Fleet.GetName]'s silent companionship, Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] may never be the same again.

distar.35.desc.zh:
我们的科研队伍为确定[Root.GetName]上异常行为的源头而深入险境，但不幸悲剧降临。尽管他们采取了完备的预防措施，几名研发队的成员仍然开始表现出典型的侵略性症状，由此导致的混乱造成了数位科学家丧生。

不幸中的万幸是，我们发现了这次愤怒瘟疫的元凶：一种空气传播的病毒，能够影响受害者的基础神经系统。

研究团队剩余的人员已经开始争分夺秒地研发疫苗。
distar.35.desc.en:
Tragedy has struck the research team leading the charge in isolating the cause behind the erratic behavior on [Root.GetName]. Despite extensive countermeasures, several members of the team began to display aggression typical of the condition, and in the ensuing chaos, several scientists were killed.

There is, however, a silver lining. We have discovered that the cause behind this epidemic of erratic behavior is infectious: a contagion caused by an airborne virus that affects the fundamental neurology of its victims.

The remaining team is scrambling to develop a vaccine.

distar.36.desc.zh:
针对席卷[Root.GetName]人口的狂怒瘟疫的疫苗研发已经圆满完成。疫苗的分发工作已经开始，[Root.GetName]上的生活也将很快回到正轨。

研究显示导致这场动荡的逆转录病毒似乎几百万年前已经在[Root.GetName]上演化成形了。它们之前一直休眠藏身于被封冻的生物质内，在行星的冰盖溶解后重见天日。

很有可能就是这种病毒导致了远古机器人的造物主在几个世纪前的灭亡。幸运的是，[Owner.GetName]对处理病毒污染物能力更强。开发对应疫苗的过程甚至让我们在医学领域取得了一些进步。
distar.36.desc.en:
The development of a vaccine to treat the epidemic affecting our populations on [Root.GetName] has successfully concluded. Distribution of the vaccine has begun, and life on [Root.GetName] should soon return to normal.

Research has revealed that the retrovirus behind this turmoil appears to have evolved on [Root.GetName] millions of years ago. Lying dormant in frozen biomatter, it resurfaced when the planet's icecaps melted.

It is very likely this led to the demise of the ancient robots' makers, centuries ago. Luckily, the [Owner.GetName] is better equipped to deal with viral contaminants. The development of this vaccine has even led to some advancements in the field of medicine.

distar.36.name.zh: 狂怒病毒疫苗开发成功

distar.40.desc.zh:
经过仔细分析后，[Root.GetLeaderName]发现覆盖[From.GetName]表面的奇怪金属物质实际上是由数十亿纳纳米机器人构成！这些纳米机器人是能自我复制的微型机械，可能是由以前的文明出于未知目的而创造。

这些纳米机器人的体积和密度十分惊人，它们覆盖在星球表面，总质量达数十亿吨。看起来这些自我复制机器人在过去的某个时刻进入了一种失控复制的状态，吞噬了这颗行星以及地表上的一切。

在研究这些机器人的过程中，船员们获得了一些令人兴奋的发现，毫无疑问会对我们的科学研究大有助益。
distar.40.desc.en:
After detailed analysis, Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered that the strange metallic substance coating the surface of [From.GetName] in fact comprises of billions upon billions of nanites! These nanites are microscopic, self-replicating micro-machines, perhaps created by a past civilization for some unknown purpose.

The volume and density of this nanite sludge is remarkable, adding billions of tons of mass to the underlying planet. It would appear these tiny self-replicators entered a state of runaway reproduction at some point in the past, engulfing the planet and everything on it.

In studying the nanites, the crew has made some exciting new findings that will undoubtedly aid us in our own research.

distar.45.desc.zh:
在对[From.GetName]附近诡异信号进行研究的过程中，[Root.GetName]上的船员发现整个恒星系的重力分析读数高到爆表。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]怀疑[From.GetName]星门以某种方式干扰了我们的传感器，或者以某种方式造成该恒星系中隐藏着大量不可见物质。

对星门进行更深入的研究也许能带来更多的收获。
distar.45.desc.en:
In studying the bizarre readings surrounding [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] have discovered that the entire system's gravitometrics are off the charts. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suspects that the [From.GetName] gateway is somehow interfering with our sensor data, or otherwise responsible for the unaccounted-for mass in the system.

A more detailed study of the gateway may yield more insight.

distar.46.desc.zh:
对[From.GetStarName]传送门的研究并不如预计的那样顺利。探测器检测到的引力效应读数远高于预估值，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]一直跟踪异常数据直达其源头，也就是某个被遗弃的时空管道的中心。他们在那里发现的一切永远的改变了他们。

在他们归来后的几天里，[Root.GetLeaderName]说在遥远星际的虚空彼端有巨大的难以描述的建筑，[Root.GetLeaderName]说那些巨大建筑发出无法抵抗的强大引力，将我们的星系拉向它们那边。

这次任务让考察队队员惊悚不已，但就在他们刚从时空管道那里回来没过不久，那异常的数据却突然消失了。
distar.46.desc.en:
Examination of the [From.GetStarName] gateway did not proceed as anticipated. With sensors registering gravitational influence orders of magnitude beyond expected values, Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] chased the source to the very center of the derelict spacetime conduit. What they found there appears to have changed them.

For days following their return, [Root.GetLeaderName] spoke of massive, indescribable structures of matter in the void of space far beyond any stars. Exerting an inexorable gravitational pull, [Root.GetLeaderName] claims our galaxy streams helplessly, inevitably towards them.

The mission has left the team shaken, no less for the fact that shortly after the experience in the conduit, the abnormal readings suddenly stopped.

distar.50.b.zh: 绝对不行。继续尝试甩掉它。
distar.50.b.en: Out of the question. Just keep avoiding it.

distar.50.b.tooltip.zh: 尝试甩开跟随[Root.GetName]的变形虫幼体。
distar.50.b.tooltip.en: Attempt to shake the Amoeba juvenile following the [Root.GetName].

distar.50.c.zh: 我们当然可以深入研究它。准备进行解剖。
distar.50.c.en: We can certainly study it. Order a dissection.

distar.50.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]已经定位了[From.GetName]上层大气层中异动的根源。令人吃惊的是，那不是一艘躲在云层里的舰船，而是一只幼年变形虫，而它的母亲则不知所踪。

我们无法得知这个幼体是如何与它的母亲和同类分离的，但有一点可以确定：它看上去已经对[Root.GetName]产生了印刻效应。当船员们结束了对[From.GetName]的调查之后，他们发现这只变形虫在跟踪他们。显然它很难被甩掉，而且[Root.GetLeaderName]对这只幼体的决心很是欣赏。

我们的科学专员建议允许这只变形虫一直跟随我们的船只，他坚信我们能从中学到更多关于变形虫的知识。
distar.50.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the source of the movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName]. Surprisingly, there was no ship hidden in the clouds, but rather a young Space Amoeba, its mother nowhere to be seen.

There is no way of knowing how this juvenile was separated from its mother or others of its kind, but one thing is certain: it appears to have imprinted on the [Root.GetName]. As the crew completed their survey of [From.GetName], they found that the Amoeba was following them. It has proven difficult to shake, and [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken quite a shine to the youngster's determination.

Our Science Officer suggests allowing the juvenile to follow the vessel, certain we may learn more about Space Amoebas in the process.

distar.50.desc.first_enc.zh:
[Root.GetName]已经定位了[From.GetName]上层大气层中异动的根源。令人吃惊的是，那不是一艘躲在云层里的舰船，而是某种温驯的外星生命体。尽管有着惊人的体型，这只被[Root.GetName]船员称为太空变形虫的生物似乎还处于幼年期。

我们无法得知这个幼体是如何与它的同类分离的，但有一点可以确定：它看上去已经对[Root.GetName]产生了印刻效应。当船员们结束了对[From.GetName]的调查之后，他们发现这只变形虫在跟踪他们。显然它很难被甩掉，而且[Root.GetLeaderName]对这只幼体的决心很是欣赏。

我们的科学专员建议允许这只变形虫一直跟随我们的船只，他坚信我们能从中学到更多关于变形虫的知识。
distar.50.desc.first_enc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the source of the movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName]. Surprisingly, there was no ship hidden in the clouds, but rather a docile alien lifeform. Despite its impressive size, the creature, which the [Root.GetName] crew have dubbed a Space Amoeba, appears to be a juvenile.

There is no way of knowing how this juvenile was separated from its others of its kind, but one thing is certain: it appears to have imprinted on the [Root.GetName]. As the crew completed their survey of [From.GetName], it found that the creature was following them. It has proven difficult to shake, and [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken quite a shine to the juvenile's determination.

Our Science Officer suggests allowing the juvenile to follow the vessel, certain we may learn more about the species in the process.

distar.5001.a.tooltip.zh: 地震波撕裂了殖民地，摧毁了所有建筑并留下了$egg_cracking$。
distar.5001.a.tooltip.en: Seismic waves have torn through the colony, leveling all buildings and leaving $egg_cracking$ in their wake.

distar.5001.desc.a.zh:
仅仅过了一年之久，在[hatchling_egg.GetName]上新成立的殖民地就发生了一系列灾难性的大地震，将地貌变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

这种地震现象通常是由地幔内的岩浆流造成的，但在[From.GetName]上根本没有地震活动，除了从地核里发出的不祥震动之外。当地行政机构已开始怀疑殖民地的长期可行性。
distar.5001.desc.a.en:
Barely a year old, the newly established colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has been shaken by a series of devastating earthquakes that are transforming the environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming across its surface, spewing sulfuric gases and noxious liquids from deeper within the crust.

Such seismological phenomena are typically caused by magma currents in a planet's mantle but on [From.GetName] there are no indications of seismic activity at all, except for the ominous pounding from the planet's core. Local authorities are beginning to question the colony's viability in the long-term.

distar.5001.desc.b.zh:
[From.GetName]正在经历一系列地震变化，将原本美丽的环境变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

卫星数据显示地核深处在发出强烈的声波能源，就好象心跳一般。
distar.5001.desc.b.en:
[From.GetName] is going through a series of rapid seismic changes that are transforming the formerly pristine environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming across its surface, spewing sulfuric gases and noxious liquids from deeper within the crust.

Satellite data shows strong bursts of sonic energy pulsating from the planet's inner core, as from a heart beating.

distar.5002.desc.a.zh:
一阵猛烈地震袭击了[hatchling_egg.GetName]，使地壳破裂并释放出大量的有毒气体与黏液，使所有生物窒息。

[hatchling_egg.GetName]上发生的变化恐怕无法复原，并且程度严重到星球近期都无法居住。当地行政机构已宣布进入紧急情况，并要求所有剩余的居民进行疏散。

与此同时，星球地核深处的脉动正在变得越来越强。
distar.5002.desc.a.en:
A shockwave of earthquakes has struck [hatchling_egg.GetName], rupturing the lithosphere and expelling a blanket of toxic gases and sludge, that is now smothering all living things.

We fear the changes on [hatchling_egg.GetName] are irreversible and substantial enough that the planet will be uninhabitable within a near future. Local authorities have declared a state of emergency and request that all remaining inhabitants be evacuated.

Meanwhile, the rhythmic pulses from the planet's core are growing in strength.

distar.5002.desc.b.zh:
又一场猛烈地震袭击了[hatchling_egg.GetName]，使地壳破裂并释放出大量的有毒气体与黏液，使所有生物窒息。

[hatchling_egg.GetName]上发生的变化无法复原，并且程度严重到星球近期都无法居住。

与此同时，星球地核深处的脉动正在变得越来越强。
distar.5002.desc.b.en:
Another shock wave of earthquakes has struck [hatchling_egg.GetName], cracking the lithosphere open and expelling more toxic gases and sludge that now blanket the surface, smothering all living things.

The changes to [hatchling_egg.GetName] are both irreversible and substantial enough to render the planet uninhabitable within a near future.

Meanwhile, the rhythmic pulses from the planet's core are growing in strength.

distar.5003.desc.a.zh: 灾难降临在了[hatchling_egg.GetName]的殖民地上！最后一波剧烈的地壳破裂彻底地撕碎了殖民地的残骸，空壳之下，一只可怕的虚空孳孽幼体如梦魇一般降临！这违背了一切常理，但也没有其它的解释。我们误以为它是颗星球，可它其实是颗蛋，而现在那颗蛋已经孵化了。
distar.5003.desc.a.en: Disaster has befallen the colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName]! A final sequence of violent ruptures has razed the last remains of the settlement and cracked the planet open, and from its empty shell is bursting the nightmarish form of a newborn Voidspawn. It goes against all sense, still there is no other way to explain it. Somehow what we mistook for a world was not a world at all, but an egg, and that egg has now hatched.

distar.5003.desc.b.zh:
[hatchling_egg.GetName]已经不存在了！最后一波剧烈的地壳破裂彻底地撕碎了这颗行星，一只巨大到难以想像的怪兽幼体从星球内破壳而出。

这违背了一切常理，但也没有其它的解释。我们误以为它是颗星球，可它其实是颗蛋，而现在一只噩梦般的虚空孳孽已经孵化了出来。
distar.5003.desc.b.en:
[hatchling_egg.GetName] is no more! A final sequence of violent ruptures has cracked the planet open and from its empty shell crawls the newborn form of a creature of unimaginable proportions.

It goes against all sense, still there is no other way of explaining it. Somehow what we mistook for a world was not a world at all, but an egg, that has now hatched a nightmarish Voidspawn into the galaxy.

distar.5009.b.zh: 别。我们不想再与虚空孳孽有任何牵扯。
distar.5009.b.en: No. We are done with the Voidspawn.

distar.5009.desc.zh:
虚空孳孽蜷曲的身体发出一阵轻微的震颤，黑色液体从其伤口与鼻口中泄出，接着它便消逝了，眼睛茫然地凝视着虚空。

但愿我们永远不会见到它生长至成年期的样子，或是其生母的所在之处。

我们的科学家对研究其蛋壳保留能源的独特能力表示很感兴趣。
distar.5009.desc.en:
A light tremor passes through the Voidspawn's curled up body, ribbons of black fluid trailing from its wounds and snout, then it is gone, its liquid eyes staring emptily into space.

Hopefully we will never know the form it might have taken if allowed to reach adulthood, or the whereabouts of its originator.

Our scientists have expressed an interest in researching the egg shards for their unique energy retaining qualities.

distar.5010.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]核心内部有什么东西开始稳定地脉动，定期使地面产生轻微的颤动。那像是心跳一般的声音几乎令人感到宽慰。

但我们担心那声音可能变得越来越大。地质学家正在密切监测星球，留意危险的地质运动。
distar.5010.desc.en:
Something deep within the core of [From.GetName] has begun to pulsate at a steady pace, sending gentle ripples through the ground at regular intervals. It gives off a soft almost soothing sound, similar to that of a heart beating.

Concerns have been raised, however, that the sound may be growing in strength. Geologists are monitoring the planet closely for signs of dangerous seismic activity.

distar.5011.desc.zh: 一只巨大到难以想像的怪物，正在小心翼翼地从一颗星球移动到另一颗星球。从其别扭的比例与笨拙的身手来看，它还只是个幼崽，但仍然同样可怕。它身上粘着一丝丝的黑色黏液，利爪从其掌间伸出。无论幼崽与否，它都是一只天性凶猛的捕食者。
distar.5011.desc.en: A creature of unthinkable size is fluttering clumsily from planet to planet. Judging by its awkward proportions and movements it is only a spawn yet, but it is horrifying to behold all the same. Strings of slime and black bile cling to its body and sharp mandibles. Spawn or not, it is a predator, equipped to kill.

distar.5012.b.tooltip.zh: 解锁用于星神兽转基因的$trait_voidling$特质。
distar.5012.b.tooltip.en: Unlocks the $trait_voidling$ trait for Leviathan Transgenesis.

distar.5012.desc.zh: 在仔细研究蛋壳碎片之后，我们开发出了一种科技，可以使我们的太阳能电厂获得类似虚空孳孽之卵的能源保留能力。
distar.5012.desc.en: A closer analysis of the egg shards has allowed us to develop a technology that will reproduce some of the Voidspawn egg's remarkable energy retaining qualities in our own solar plants.

distar.5012.genetics.desc.zh:
我们面临着一个抉择：

如果我们对蛋的碎片进行近距离分析，我们便有可能再现一些虚空孳孽卵的非凡的能量固存特性。

或者是我们可以保存好虚空孳孽的基因物质以备未来使用。
distar.5012.genetics.desc.en:
We are faced with a choice:

If we conduct a closer analysis of the egg shards, we could potentially reproduce some of the Voidspawn egg's remarkable energy retaining qualities.

Alternatively, we can preserve the genetic material of the Voidspawn for future use.

distar.5013.desc.a.zh:
$distar.5013.desc.b$

我们现在只能重建损失。
distar.5013.desc.a.en:
$distar.5013.desc.b$

All that remains now is to rebuild what was lost.

distar.5013.desc.b.zh: [hatchling_egg.GetName]上的奇怪地震活动突然停止了。不再有震动，不再有新的裂隙，不再有地核深处传来的不详脉动。星球已经彻底安静了下来，并且如果我们运气好的话，也将继续如此。
distar.5013.desc.b.en: The strange seismic activity on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has stopped abruptly. There are no more tremors, no new rifts, no ominous pulsating from its core. The planet has grown quiet and with any luck it will stay that way.

distar.5014.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的毒性粘液已被清除，而最后一道裂隙也已被填上，以防止更多毒性液体泄漏至地表。
distar.5014.desc.en: The toxic sludge on [Root.GetName] has been cleared and the last rifts filled, preventing more noxious gases from leaking to the surface.

distar.5016.desc.hive.zh:
将虚空孳孽装回卵中并再次将其孵化的操作竟然极其地有效。利用卵中残留的原生物质，我们的死灵[root.GetNecromancersLower]可以轻易地编辑这具躯骸来服务我们。

将这只生物制成提线木偶后，我们现在可以扇动它的翅膀了。
distar.5016.desc.hive.en:
Returning the Voidspawn to its egg and incubating it again proved to be incredibly efficient. By making use of the primordial matter still inside the egg, our [root.GetNecromancersLower] easily edited the corpse to service us.

With the creature thus puppeteered, we now flex it's wings.

distar.5016.desc.machine.zh: 通过实施死灵机师协议，我们可以复活已死的虚空孳孽，替代性翅膀已经由实验性生化合金铸成。
distar.5016.desc.machine.en: Utilizing Mechromancy protocols, we have been able to reanimate the terminated Voidspawn. Replacement wings have been forged using an experimental bio-alloy.

distar.5016.desc.regular.zh: 我们的死灵法师将躯体装回它原来所在的卵中，孵化了新的虚空孳孽以效力于我们的事业。
distar.5016.desc.regular.en: Our necromancers returned the body to the egg from which it came, and hatched the Voidspawn anew to serve our cause.

distar.5057.b.en: The safety of our people must come first.

distar.5057.desc.zh:
一个管状外星实体已经进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，而毫无预警或解释。它似乎不靠任何引擎或是推进器就能移动，完全无声地在虚空中滑行，其圆柱体不祥地旋转着。

尽管它没有表现出任何敌意，但也并未回应我们的呼叫。我们的军团顾问警告说，它可能会对下面的居民造成严重威胁，并恳求我们动手将它消灭。但我们的科学家则请求研究这一非凡的科技。
distar.5057.desc.en:
A tubular alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName], with no warning or explanation. It appears to be moving without engines or thrusters, gliding in complete silence through the void of space, cylinders rotating ominously.

Though it has yet to display any signs of aggression, it refuses to acknowledge our hails. Our military advisors warn that it may pose a considerable threat to the inhabitants below and implore us to engage neutralization protocols. Our scientists, however, plead that we instead learn from this remarkable piece of technology.

distar.5058.desc.zh:
尽管我们对神秘容器进行了大量研究，其来源仍是个谜。尽管它绝不是有机物，但也不完全是机械。它的主要任务似乎是收集，储存并编码数据。

它的表面上覆盖着成百上千道微小的刮痕，我们在其中发现了一种不属于这个星系的物质。
distar.5058.desc.en:
Despite extensive research the enigmatic cache and its origin are still shrouded in mystery. Though it is definitely not organic in nature, it is not entirely machine either. It appears to be preoccupied mainly with the gathering, storing and encoding of data.

Its surface is covered in hundreds of thousands of minuscule scratches and dents in which we have discovered traces of a compound that is alien to our galaxy.

distar.5059.a.en: A relief for the citizens of [Root.GetName].

distar.5059.desc.zh: 无论神秘容器来到[Root.GetName]的目的是什么，它已经完成了它的目标。正如同它来得诡异迅速一样，神秘容器现在又突然地离开了。
distar.5059.desc.en: Whatever the Enigmatic Cache's purpose here on [Root.GetName] may have been, it has come to an end. As abruptly as it arrived, the enigmatic cache is now leaving.

distar.5059.desc.b.zh: 看起来神秘容器对[Root.GetName]的扫描已经结束，它现在开始寻找另一颗我们境内的行星进行扫描。
distar.5059.desc.b.en: It appears as though the Enigmatic Cache is now done with its scan of [Root.GetName] and is seeking another target planet within our borders.

distar.5062.desc.zh: 之前可能扫描了我方一颗星球而引起我们怀疑的神秘存在再次出现，而且正在进入[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道。它似乎正在尝试和我们进行通信。
distar.5062.desc.en: The mysterious tubular entity that we suspect previously scanned one of our planets has returned and is entering orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName]. It appears to be attempting to initiate communications.

distar.5063.desc.zh:
催眠教学的最后一夜已经结束了，[Root.GetName]的公民即将迎来新的黎明。他们醒来后会看到一个完全不同的世界——一个充满科学奇迹和希望的世界。谁曾想宇宙是一个如此充满活力和迷人的地方？

我们初步的资料表明，我们确实发展出了一种增强的学习和科究能力，这都要归功于巴铎尔43号和拉沃西濒危外星生物保护协会。
distar.5063.desc.en:
The final night of hypnopedia has come to an end and a new day dawns for the citizens of [Root.GetName], who are just now opening their minds to a very different world - a world full of scientific wonder and promise. Who knew the universe was such a vibrant, fascinating place?

 Our initial readings indicate that we have indeed developed an enhanced capability for learning and scientific research thanks to BALDOR XXXXIII and the Lavosian Endangered Xeno Preservation Grant.

distar.5064.a.zh: 但我们已经具备智识，而且可以进行空间旅行了啊！
distar.5064.a.en: But we are already a sapient space-faring nation!

distar.5064.a.response.zh: 你们的智识发展尚处于初级阝？介段，你们的科技发展也已陷入停滞。这将导致你们面临衰退的风险。让我们打开你们的<<物种思维器官名称读取失败>>，接受宇宙的各种奇迹吧。
distar.5064.a.response.en: You are within the early st4?4ges of sapient development and your technological advancement has already stagnated. This puts you at risk of imminent regression. Let us open your <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_CLASS_SENSORY_ORGAN>> to the wonders of the universe.

distar.5064.b.zh: 这个“提升”到底是个怎样的过程？
distar.5064.b.en: What exactly would a so called 'uplifting' entail?

distar.5064.b.response.zh:
通过催眠学习法进行远距离数据传输与认知刺激。这种方式十分有效，也经过了大量实践，可以确保无痛，并令我可以在你们民众的再生循环之中对其科学能力进行锻炼。

但我必须通知你，有机体认知能力提升的副作用，包括但不限于：幻灭感，胃酸倒流，以及无尽的绝望感。在某些<<物种分类读取失败>>中，还可能导致严重的<<物种分类副作用读取失败>>。
distar.5064.b.response.en:
Long-range data transfer and cognitive stimulation through hypnopedia. It is a highly efficient, well-tried, pain-free process that allows me to exercise your population's intellectual faculties in their regenerative cycle.

I am required to inform you that the side effects of heightened cognitive abilities in organics may include, but are not limited to, disillusionment, acid reflux, and bottomless despair. In certain <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_CLASS>> it may also cause severe <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_CLASS_SIDE_EFFECT>>.

distar.5064.c.zh: 无意冒犯，但你似乎……出了点故障……
distar.5064.c.en: No offense but you seem a little...broken...

distar.5064.d.response.zh: 我是巴铎尔43号，代表拉沃西濒危外星生物保护协会的感性人工智能。
distar.5064.d.response.en: I am BALDOR XXXXIII, a sentient AI operating on behalf of the Lavosian Endangered Xeno Preservation Grant.

distar.5064.desc.zh:
诸位好啊，<<物种名称读取失败>>。

不用太过警X#r?惕。我是巴铎尔43号，代表拉沃西濒危异星生物保护协会的感性人工智能。在广袤宇宙的各种生物中，你们已经被选中，进行//X%PrX//提升。目前为止，我们已经对<<#39XX7/02#>>个落后物种进行了提升，成功@¤率高达<<#X0.V#/3^189%>>。
distar.5064.desc.en:
Greetings, <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_NAME>>.

Do not be alaX#r?med. I am BALDOR XXXXIII, a sentient AI operating on behalf of the Lavosian Endangered Xeno Preservation Grant. You, of all your galactic peers, have been selected for //X%PrX// uplifting. So far we have uplifted <<#39XX7/02#>> lesser species with a succ@r¤4te of <<#X0.V#/3^189%>>.

distar.5064.e.zh: 我们准备好进行飞升了。

distar.5064.e.response.zh: 绝不会让你们失望的，<<物种名称读取失败>>！

distar.5064.f.response.zh: 真是太遗憾了。愿你们在未来的一切行云？力中一切顺利，<<物种名称读取失败>>。
distar.5064.f.response.en: That is regrettable. We wish you the best of luck in your future 3?ndeavors, <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_NAME>>

distar.5067.a.zh: 若是为了追求知识，无论何等代价都是值得的。
distar.5067.a.en: In the pursuit of knowledge, no price is too high.

distar.5067.a.tooltip.zh: 受影响的人口将会变成$enigmatic_fatigue$。

distar.5067.b.zh: 不能再这么胡闹下去了。终止计划。
distar.5067.b.en: This madness ends now. Abort the project.

distar.5067.desc.a.zh: 神秘容器的侧面冒出奇怪形状的光线，上面的轮子也以前所未有的速度飞转起来，各种齿轮开始发出焦躁的轰鸣声。听上去好像这东西随时会爆开一般。与此同时，我们的民众也在睡梦中开始不安地翻滚，头部也与容器的韵律进行着共振。他们的夜间休眠被科技奇迹的景象与复杂的各种计算打断了。
distar.5067.desc.a.en: The Enigmatic Cache's wheels whir with an unprecedented fervor as strange patterns of light morph along its sides, cogs and gears humming agitatedly. It sounds as if it could break any minute. Meanwhile our people stir restlessly in their slumber, heads resonating with the Cache's rhythmical drone, their night interrupted by visions of technological wonders and complex calculations.

distar.5067.desc.b.zh:
$distar.5067.desc.a$

似乎大家健康状况尚可，仅有[ROOT.GetEyeNamePlural]偶尔会出现出体液外流的症状，但我们一些人口受到了愈发严重的乏力症状影响而降低了产出。
distar.5067.desc.b.en:
$distar.5067.desc.a$

Aside from the occasional fluid leak from their [ROOT.GetEyeNamePlural], they appear to be in good health, but the production of some of our population is affected by their growing fatigue.

distar.5068.desc.zh:
催眠教学的最后一夜已经结束了，[Root.GetName]的公民即将迎来新的黎明，他们醒来后会看到一个全新的世界——一个充满可能性……和痛苦的世界。谁曾想宇宙原来是一个如此枯燥乏味的地方，不存在任何意义与目的？

尽管可能还需要一段时间，人们才会适应拥有高于平均水平的智力所带来的诸多苦难，但总的来说，这个项目可以被认为是成功的。我们初步的资料表明，我们已经发展出了一种强化的学习和科研能力。
distar.5068.desc.en:
The final night of hypnopedia has come to an end and a new day dawns for the citizens of [Root.GetName], who are just now opening their minds to a very different world - a world of possibility...and pain. Who knew the universe was such a drab and dreary place, devoid of all meaning and purpose?

Though it may be a while before the population adjusts to the many tribulations of having an above-average intelligence, overall the project can be considered a success. Our initial readings indicate that we have developed an enhanced capability for learning and scientific research.

distar.5069.a.zh: 这一定就是最好的结果了。
distar.5069.a.en: Surely it was for the best.

distar.5069.desc.zh: 我们已中断了飞升进程，我们的民众也正在逐渐回复成原来的可靠模样。被称为巴铎尔43号的谜之外星存在已陷入了严重的迷乱状态。
distar.5069.desc.en: We have terminated the ascension process and our people are slowly returning to their good old dependable selves. The tubular alien entity known as BALDOR XXXXIII has left in a deeply discombobulated state.

distar.5070.desc.zh: 在[cache_killers.GetSpeciesName]对巴铎尔43号发动突然袭击后，巴铎尔43号已不能维持其物质实体，我们人民的飞升进程也随之终止。能确认的是管状外星实体现在的状况十分糟糕。由于其在对我们进行提升的过程中特别脆弱，在攻击中它的核心部位遭受严重损害。当它消逝时，它传递了一个信息：“我是巴铎尔4……”
distar.5070.desc.en: Following an unprovoked assault from the [cache_killers.GetSpeciesName], BALDOR XXXXIII has dematerialized and the ascension of our people has been terminated. We believe the tubular alien entity, which was already in poor condition, was especially vulnerable during the ascension and suffered significant damage to its core functions in the attack. As it departed it transmitted the message "I am BALDOR XXX..."

distar.5071.b.en: Send in a team of engineers.

distar.5071.desc.zh:
经过长时间的不被打扰的、平静的催眠之后，巴铎尔43号似乎进入了一种疯狂的状态，轮子以飞快的速度旋转，向那些敢于休息的人投射出一连串荒诞的噩梦。

尽管许多人根本不愿休眠，但不幸的是，少数人似乎陷入了植物人状态，无法醒来。

我们的工程师认为，这个从一开始就严重受损的实体可能正在恶化。如果无人看管，我们的提升可能不会按计划进行。
distar.5071.desc.en:
After a long period of undisturbed, uneventful hypnopedia, BALDOR XXXXIII appears to have entered a frenzied state, wheels spinning at a furious rate, projecting rapid strings of absurdist nightmares to those who dare rest.

While many are reluctant to go to rest at all, an unfortunate few appear to have become trapped in a vegetative state from which they are unable to wake up.

Our engineers suggest the entity, which was badly damaged from the start, may be deteriorating. If left unattended our ascension may not go as planned.

distar.5072.e.en: Send in a team of engineers.

distar.5073.desc.zh: 我们的工程师成功令巴铎尔43号恢复了稳定，提升过程也照常进行，我们的民众虽然不大情愿，但还是回归了他们的日常睡眠规律。催眠学习法已经显示出了不俗的效果，很多民众对科学的兴趣都大大提升了。
distar.5073.desc.en: Our engineers have stabilized BALDOR XXXXIII, the uplifting process is back on track and our people have, somewhat reluctantly, returned to their regular sleeping patterns. The hypnopedia is already showing promising results, with our citizens taking an increased interest in science.

distar.5074.desc.zh:
由于巴铎尔43号的状况快速恶化，尽管飞升过程已经完成，我们却没有获得完全的提升。虽然大部分人口都遭受着强烈的噩梦困扰，催眠学习法还是有所成效，他们在科学研究与学习中展现了超乎寻常的效率。对于陷入植物状态的不幸民众，情况就要糟糕一些了……虽然大部分最终都恢复了意识，但他们的理智与思维似乎在巨大压力下崩溃了。

虽说不是完全的飞升，但好歹……也算有所收获吧。
distar.5074.desc.en:
The ascension process is complete, yet we have not ascended, due to the rapidly deteriorating state of BALDOR XXXXIII. Though the majority of our population still suffers from intense night terrors, the hypnopedia appears to have yielded some good results as they now show an unprecedented proficiency for scientific research and learning. For the unlucky citizens who were trapped in a vegetative state, the situation is more dire... Though most have regained consciousness, their minds seem to have caved under the pressure.

It may not be a full ascension, but at least it is...something.

distar.5078.desc.zh: 由于[From.GetSpeciesName]入侵势力，我们在混乱的交火中失去了[FromFromFrom.GetName]，巴铎尔43号严重受损，已不能维持其物质实体，我们人民的飞升进程也随之终止。能确认的是管状外星实体现在的状况十分糟糕，它被敌人的炮火波及，核心部位遭受严重损害。在它消逝时，它发出了最后的求救信号：“我是巴铎尔4……”
distar.5078.desc.en: In the tumultuous aftermath of the loss of [FromFromFrom.GetName] to [From.GetSpeciesName] invading forces, BALDOR XXXXIII has dematerialized and the ascension of our people has been terminated. We believe the tubular alien entity, which was already in poor condition, accidentally came under enemy fire and suffered significant damage to its core functions. As it departed it sent out a final distress message; "I am BALDOR XXX."

distar.51.desc.zh:
前段时间加入我们舰队的变形虫幼体现在看来已经完全成年了。尽管已经成长为了一位引人注目的大姑娘，她对那艘在自己被困[From.From.GetName]之时给了她一个新家的科研船还是忠心耿耿。

与舰队共处的岁月让她展现出了不同于野生变形虫的适应性行为，使得她在战场上成为了一个远比其同类更为强大的战力。在整个[Root.Owner.GetName]，她的身影已经成为了一个代表[Root.Owner.GetAdj]精神的吉祥物。

只剩下一个问题：我们应该为她取个什么名字？
distar.51.desc.en:
The Amoeba juvenile that joined our fleet some time ago appears to have reached full maturity. Now an impressive adult, she is no less loyal to the ships that gave her a new home when she was stranded on [From.From.GetName].

Her time spent with the fleet appears to have encouraged adaptive behaviors not typically found in wild Space Amoebas, making her a more formidable presence on the battlefield than others of her kind. Across [Root.Owner.GetName], her image has become something of a mascot for the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] spirit.

Only one question remains: what should we name her?

distar.51.more.zh: 这些名字矬爆了，我们得想个更好的。
distar.51.more.en: These are all terrible. We should think of something better.

distar.52.desc.zh:
研究人员汇报道，先前在[From.From.GetName]发现的落单幼年变形虫已经不再跟随我们的科研船了。在跟随我们的科研船几周之后，变形虫幼体据称通过某种生物超空间驱动机能进入了一条超空间航道。也许它认出了那里的地形，或许它感应到了同类，又或者它只是厌倦了追随我们的船只。

尽管我们的舰船遵循指令没有和变形虫幼体进行互动，被动扫描还是为我们带来了一些有关这只生物的生理学发现。
distar.52.desc.en:
Researchers report that the lost Amoeba juvenile found near [From.From.GetName] is no longer following our science fleet. After doing so for the past several weeks, the juvenile reportedly entered a hyperlane via some biological hyperdrive capacity. Perhaps it recognized the terrain, or sensed others of its kind. Or perhaps it simply tired of chasing after our ship.

Though our ships refrained from interacting with the juvenile as instructed, passive scans have led to some revelations regarding the creature's physiology.

distar.53.desc.has_tech.zh:
$distar.53.desc.base$

这些发现和我们之前研究的变形虫-硅基细菌共生关系所带来的组织修复能力原理一致，我们早已将其应用到了船体再生技术上。
distar.53.desc.has_tech.en:
$distar.53.desc.base$

These are in line with our previous research regarding the symbiotic relationship between Space Amoebas and the silicon-based bacteria that restore their damaged tissue, which we have already repurposed into regenerative hull technology.

distar.53.desc.lacks_tech.zh:
$distar.53.desc.base$

简而言之，这生物的组织再生并不仅仅通过细胞复制进行，还依靠一种硅基细菌辅助其器官组织重构。

对该细菌的遗传信息进行适当的修改后，我们或能利用这种自我修复能力开发出一种船体自愈矩阵，不过这过程相当缓慢。
distar.53.desc.lacks_tech.en:
$distar.53.desc.base$

Simply put, the creature regenerates not only via cell-replication, but with the assistance of a silicon-based bacteria that reconstructs organic tissue.

With some modifications to this bacteria's genetic information, we could potentially harness its regenerative capacity in order to devise a self-repairing hull matrix, gradual though the process may be.

distar.54.desc.zh: 由于我们未能积极采取措施做好解剖幼体变形虫的准备工作，它似乎是已经逃脱了。传感器显示几个小时前它使用了某种生物超空间驱动机能，脱离了我们的掌控。
distar.54.desc.en: Pending our lack of initiative in securing the Amoeba juvenile for dissection, it appears to have escaped. Sensors report the juvenile engaged some kind of biological hyperdrive and disappeared off the grid, just hours ago.

distar.55.desc.zh: 吉祥物怎么能没有名字？我们必须要给我们的外星朋友起个配得上她的名字。
distar.55.desc.en: What is a mascot without a name? We must devise a moniker worthy of our amoeboid ally.

distar.56.desc.zh:
我们能够突破时间和空间的界限，以超过光的速度旅行。可是我们却没办法定好一个变形虫的名字。

这是我们最后的机会。
distar.56.desc.en:
We have developed the ability to break the boundaries of space and time, to travel faster than the speed of light. Yet we cannot decide upon a name for this amoeba.

This is our last chance.

distar.56.i.en: Enough! Just call it ''Fluffy'' and be done with it!

distar.57.desc.zh:
[From.Fleet.GetName]的死讯很快传遍了[Root.GetName]，但没有任何人比科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]更加痛心。是[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe]第一个发现了迷失无助的变形虫幼体，并见证了它在自己[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer]温柔的教导下逐渐步入成年。

现在，失去了[From.Fleet.GetName]无言的陪伴，科学专员[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]也许再也回不到以前的状态了。
distar.57.desc.en:
News of the death of [From.Fleet.GetName] has rippled through the [Root.GetName], though none have been as affected as Science Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]. It was [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetSheHe] who first discovered the Space Amoeba as a lost and helpless juvenile, and watched the creature grow to full maturity under [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetHisHer] own gentle guidance.

Now, without [From.Fleet.GetName]'s silent companionship, Officer [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] may never be the same again.

distar.59.desc.zh: [reanimated_amoeba.Fleet.GetName]活过来了？至少她已经可以活动了。尽管我们确实不清楚[amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName]到底干了什么，但多亏了他们的极度绝望和对科学的疯狂，我们又可以和亲爱的虫虫比翼齐飞了。
distar.59.desc.en: [reanimated_amoeba.Fleet.GetName] lives?! Or at least she moves. We do not truly understand what [amoeba_finding_scientist.GetName] did, but thanks to the depths of their despair and madness of their science, our beloved amoeba flies with us once more.

distar.59.desc.science.zh: [reanimated_amoeba.Fleet.GetName]活过来了？至少她已经可以活动了。尽管我们确实不清楚死灵法师到底干了什么，但多亏了他们的极度绝望和对科学的疯狂，我们又可以和亲爱的虫虫比翼齐飞了。
distar.59.desc.science.en: [reanimated_amoeba.Fleet.GetName] lives?! Or at least she moves. We do not truly understand what our necromancers have done, but thanks to the depths of their despair and madness of their science, our beloved amoeba flies with us once more.

distar.6.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的船员十分兴奋的发现在[From.GetName]上有工业时代文明的遗迹。调查表明[From.GetName]在过去的数百万年里一直维持着大气层，直到恒星[From.GetStarName]那不稳定的表面所发出的超强耀斑导致了行星大气层的失控电离化逃逸和耗散。

在失去大气层之后数千年间，[From.GetName]上那些了无生机的城市都被封冻于时间长河之中。这是纪念发生于此处大灭绝的无声纪念碑。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]警告任何在[From.GetStarName]星系的殖民都可能受制于恒星无常的暴怒。
distar.6.desc.en:
The crew of the [Root.GetName] were intrigued to find the remnants of an industrial-age civilization on [From.GetName]. Investigation indicates [From.GetName] had sustained an atmosphere for millions of years, until massive superflares from the unstable surface of the star [From.GetStarName] led to runaway ionization and depletion of the planet's atmospheric gases.

With no atmosphere, the lifeless cities on [From.GetName] have been frozen in time for millennia, silent monuments to the mass extinction that happened there.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] cautions that any colonies in the [From.GetStarName] system may be subject to the whims of the star's turbulence.

distar.60.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员在[From.GetName]近距轨道发现的放射性碎片的确是一艘太空舰船的残骸。其奇特的设计和我们数据库中的任何舰船型号都不同。

我们从其损坏的电脑上回收了一些数据，其语言前所未见——因此也无从翻译。

通过对残骸进行进一步研究，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]推测这艘名叫“科塔罗号”的舰船遭遇了导航系统故障，脱离超光速推进的位置过于接近[From.GetName]的伽马射线流。大部分船体都已被辐射撕碎，上面没有找到任何生还者。
distar.60.desc.en:
The irradiated fragments the [Root.GetName] crew registered in close orbit of [From.GetName] are indeed the remains of a space-faring vessel. With a very distinctive design, it matches no known make on record.

We have extracted some data from the ship's damaged computers, recorded in an alien language like nothing we have ever seen before - and one we are unable to translate.

By studying the remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] postulates that the craft, known as the 'Kohtalo', suffered a navigational error when exiting FTL, bringing it too close to the gamma-ray jets of [From.GetName]. Large portions of the ship were stripped apart through radiolysis. There are no survivors.

distar.61.desc.zh: 探测器发现一艘舰船刚刚脱离超空间进入[kohtalo_second_fleet.GetStarName]星系，其特征与之前在[ouroboros_system.GetName]发现的独特残骸十分相似。他们正在呼叫我们！
distar.61.desc.en: Sensors report a ship with seemingly identical properties to the unique remains uncovered near [ouroboros_system.GetName] has just dropped from hyperspace in the [kohtalo_second_fleet.GetStarName] system. They are hailing us!

distar.62.a.zh: 试着询问他们来此地的目的。
distar.62.a.en: Try to ask what their purpose here is.

distar.62.desc.zh:
这艘舰船特征与先前在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系发现的残骸十分相近，尽管翻译器无法解码其语言，他们看起来很高兴和我们通话。他们用一组低频语音信号指称自己，听上去与“科塔罗”相似——这名字我们已经有所耳闻。

我们也许可以使用原始数据和他们进行交流。
distar.62.desc.en:
The crew of the strange ship that mirrors the wreck found near [ouroboros_system.GetName] seem excited to speak with us, though our translators cannot decode their language. They identify themselves with a low-frequency verbal expression that sounds like 'Kohtalo' - a name we've heard before.

Perhaps we can communicate using raw data.

distar.63.a.zh: 将[ouroboros_system.GetName]附近的舰体残骸中回收的数据发给他们。
distar.63.a.en: Send them data recovered from the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck.

distar.63.desc.zh:
我们收到了一串数据作为回应，包括一张近星系的地图，以及一段录像，毫无疑问是他们的工程师在维护一台外星超光速设备。

唯一可以确定的是，他们是来自另一个星系的探索者。他们的无武备舰船可以佐证这一点。

我们发回了一段[Root.GetAdj]探险家第一次离开我们恒星系的录像，这些外星探索者看起来非常高兴。
distar.63.desc.en:
We receive a flurry of data in response - including cartographic imaging of a neighboring galaxy, and footage of what can only be engineers working on an alien FTL drive.

We can draw no other conclusion than that these are explorers from another galaxy. Their ship's lack of weapons capacity would support this theory.

We send back footage of [Root.GetAdj] explorers on their first journey beyond our solar system, and the reaction from the alien crew appears to be jubilant.

distar.64.desc.zh:
科塔罗号船员的热情瞬间消失了，许多船员开始用他们触手般的肢体操纵控制台。他们传送来一组数据，看起来是乘客名单，导航信息，船员日志。毫无疑问，这些数据和我们在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系的发现完全吻合——除了一处例外。[ouroboros_system.GetName]残骸中的数据包含更多条目，日期也更加晚近。

看起来眼前的舰船和[ouroboros_system.GetName]里的残骸是同一艘船，只是残骸的历史更长。
distar.64.desc.en:
The excitement of the Kohtalo crew seems to evaporate. Multiple crewmembers begin to tap away at consoles using their tentacle-like appendages. They transmit what look to be their passenger manifest, navigational data, and crew logs to us. Without a doubt, the data matches that of the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck to the letter - with one exception. The [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck contained further entries, with later dates.

It would appear the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck is the same ship as the one now before us... only older.

distar.65.a.zh: 如果我们警告他们，他们应该就能逃过一劫。
distar.65.a.en: If we warn them, they may avoid disaster.

distar.65.a.tooltip.zh: 让科塔罗号注意避让[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系的脉冲星。
distar.65.a.tooltip.en: Send the Kohtalo a warning to avoid the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

distar.65.b.zh: 我们不能冒险进一步干扰时间线。
distar.65.b.en: We can't risk further timeline interference.

distar.65.desc.zh: 虽然他们依然维持着自己的外星礼仪，科塔罗号船员们的紧张不言而喻。我们的科学家称如果[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系中的残骸的确是这艘船未来的命运，透露给他们任何信息都可能会导致不可预见的结果。
distar.65.desc.en: Despite their alien mannerisms, the Kohtalo crew's consternation is evident. Our own scientific attachés inform us that if the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck is indeed the future of the ship before us, any information we give them may have unforeseen consequences.

distar.66.a.zh: 祝你们好运，星际旅行者。

distar.66.desc.zh:
这些系外旅行者焦虑地研究着我们传送过去的星系信息，用他们独特的语言互相交谈着，并在控制台上输入了一连串的指令。我们的外交人员耐心的等待着答复，但在收到回音之前，他们的引擎突然启动。

在我们能作出任何反应之前，他们就消失的无影无踪。
distar.66.desc.en:
The extragalactic explorers begin poring hurriedly over the system data we send them, speaking to one another in their strange language, and entering a flurry of commands on their consoles. Our diplomats wait patiently for a reply, but before it can come, the ship's engines begin to power up unexpectedly.

Before we can react, they've vanished.

distar.67.desc.zh:
恒星系传感器显示，那艘异次元探索舰船科塔罗号突然在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系外围脱离超光速状态，并迎头撞上了一颗环绕星系的彗星！这次灾难性的碰撞夺取了船上所有人的生命，并让船只的残骸飘向[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星。

看起来是这颗彗星，而不是脉冲星导致了科塔罗号的陨落。我们警告他们的行为反而导致这场悲剧的发生。现在有两具残骸静静地萦绕于[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星旁了。
distar.67.desc.en:
System sensors indicate that the extradimensional exploration vessel Kohtalo exited FTL abruptly on the outskirts of the [ouroboros_system.GetName] system, colliding head-on with an orbital comet! The collision was disastrous enough to kill everyone onboard, and has sent the remaining wreckage spiraling in towards the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

It would appear the comet, not the pulsar was responsible for the Kohtalo's demise, and in our effort to warn them of their fate, we seem to have caused it. Both wrecks now haunt the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

distar.68.a.zh: 也许这一切都无可避免。

distar.68.desc.zh:
星系传感器显示，那艘异次元探索舰船科塔罗号突然在恒星系外围脱离FTL状态，并迎头撞上了一颗环绕星系的彗星！这次灾难性的碰撞夺取了船上所有人的生命，并让船只的残骸飘向[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星。

研究人员得出结论，科塔罗号配备的负质量效应超光速引擎无法精确的分析舰船何时何地脱离超光速状态。现在有两具残骸静静地萦绕于[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星旁了。
distar.68.desc.en:
System sensors indicate that the extradimensional exploration vessel Kohtalo exited FTL abruptly on the outskirts of the system, colliding head-on with an orbital comet! The collision was disastrous enough to kill everyone onboard, and has sent the remaining wreckage spiraling in towards the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

Our analysts conclude the Kohtalo's negative mass-based FTL drive was incapable of accurately predicting where (or when) they would exit subspace. Both wrecks now haunt the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

distar.7.a.zh: 我们必须保护我们的人民！

distar.7.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的传感器发现[Root.GetStarName]表面正呈现出在超强耀斑出现之前所特有的动荡现象。考虑到[frozen_in_time_planet.GetName]远古文明的命运，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在争分夺秒设计一个护盾矩阵来抵挡即将到来的巨量等离子喷发。
distar.7.desc.en: Sensors on [Root.GetName] indicate that [Root.GetStarName] is exhibiting surface turbulence typical to that preceding a superflare. Considering the fate of the ancient civilization on [frozen_in_time_planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are scrambling to devise a shield matrix capable of withstanding the impending enormous plasma ejection.

distar.7.desc.nocol.zh:
传感器发现[Root.GetStarName]的亮度达出现了一次激增。看来该恒星正在产生超强耀斑，这和当初摧毁了[frozen_in_time_planet.GetName]文明的超强耀斑基本一致。

万幸的是，没有[Root.GetAdj]殖民地会被这场恒星暴动波及。
distar.7.desc.nocol.en:
Sensors have registered a massive spike in [Root.GetStarName]'s luminosity. It appears the star is experiencing a superflare, not unlike the one that destroyed the civilization on [frozen_in_time_planet.GetName].

Fortunately for us, however, there are no [Root.GetAdj] colonies that will be affected by this solar turbulence.

distar.70.a.zh: 这真让人兴奋，赶紧将他们解冻。
distar.70.a.en: Thaw them out. This is exciting.

distar.70.b.zh: 我们介入并不明智，还是保持距离进行研究吧。
distar.70.b.en: It would be unwise to interfere. Study them from afar instead.

distar.70.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]环形世界损坏的储存区深处，这些阴暗的舱体里面存放着数以千计处于冷冻状态的外星生物。有些仍然存活，但大部分似乎都遭遇了冷冻设备故障，已经化为一滩摊腐朽程度不同的污泥。

令人吃惊的是，所有的外星生物完全一样：分析显示他们都是基因克隆的产物。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]称我们可以将还活着的克隆体解冻。不过他们所处的环形世界目前已无法支持生命，我们必须得给他们提供一个住处。
distar.70.desc.en:
The murky vats located deep in the ruined storage sections of [From.GetName] ring world contain thousands of alien creatures in cryostasis. Some are still living, while many thousands more appear to have suffered cryochamber malfunctions, leaving them as organic sludge in varying stages of decomposition.

Remarkably, all of the aliens are completely identical: analysis of their remains reveals them to be genetic clones. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests we could attempt to thaw out the living clones - though as their ring world is currently without life-support, we would have to give them some place to live.

distar.70.exter.tooltip.zh: 将[From.GetName]环形世界上的有机渣滓清理干净。
distar.70.exter.tooltip.en: Exterminate the foul organics on the [From.GetName] ring world.

distar.70.fp.zh: 肮脏的异种生物，他们将被净化。
distar.70.fp.en: Foul xenos. They will be cleansed.

distar.70.fp.tooltip.zh: 将[From.GetName]上邪恶的异种渣滓净化。
distar.70.fp.tooltip.en: Cleanse the [From.GetName] ring world of its xeno scum.

distar.70.no_room.zh: 真是可惜，我们这里没有他们的生存空间。
distar.70.no_room.en: A pity we have no room for them.

distar.71.desc.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]高兴地汇报称除了少数无法挽救的个体，对冷冻克隆人的复活取得圆满成功，这些克隆人性情温顺，看上去对自己被创造后的世界毫无了解。[Root.GetLeaderName]猜测他们被建造[From.GetStarName]环形世界的物种当做劳工使用。

虽然这些克隆体愿意服从命令，[Root.GetLeaderName]指出对克隆体的神经共振扫描数据表明他们不擅长应付复杂的工作。
distar.71.desc.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is pleased to report that barring a small number of unsalvageable cases, the revival of the derelict ring world clones from cryostasis has been a success. The clones are quite docile individuals, who appear to know nothing of the circumstances behind their creation. [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that they were used as laborers by whatever ancient civilization constructed the [From.GetStarName] ring world.

The clones appear to be willing to follow orders, though [Root.GetLeaderName] cautions that preliminary neuro-resonance scanning suggests they are not the best equipped to deal with complex tasks.

distar.71.no_room.zh: 我们星球上没有空间供他们居住，准备一艘船吧。
distar.71.no_room.en: We have no room for them planetside. Prepare a ship.

distar.71.pop.default.zh: 让克隆体为我们进行工作。

distar.71.pop.phile.zh: 我们应该热烈欢迎他们！
distar.71.pop.phile.en: We welcome them with open arms!

distar.71.pop.swarm.zh: 他们将作为有益健康的食材为[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]作出贡献。
distar.71.pop.swarm.en: They will make healthy fodder for our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].

distar.71.swarm.alt.tooltip.zh: 将克隆体加工为营养物质。

distar.72.a.zh: 就让他们继续处于休眠状态吧，正好作为纪念。
distar.72.a.en: Leave them in stasis, as a monument.

distar.72.b.zh: 将他们解冻，加入到我们的劳动力人口中。
distar.72.b.en: Thaw them out. They can join our workforce.

distar.72.b.servi.zh: 将他们解冻，我们会照顾好他们的。
distar.72.b.servi.en: Thaw them out. We will care for them.

distar.72.desc.zh: 现在我们重建并殖民了[Root.GetStarName]环形世界上的一个可居住区段，是时候决定如何处理这些处于冷冻状态的克隆体了。
distar.72.desc.en: Now that we have colonized a reconstructed segment of the [Root.GetStarName] Ring World, we must decide what is to be done with the alien clones left behind in cryostasis on the megastructure's habitat sections.

distar.75.desc.zh:
尽管表面平淡无奇，[From.GetName]的小行星有着中空的核心，里面贮存着极具工业价值的宝贵晶体——仿佛一个高悬星空的巨大晶球。

通过遵循科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]制定的特殊指示，未来任何采矿平台应该都能小心开采陨石内层的晶体了。
distar.75.desc.en:
While unremarkable on the surface, the [From.GetName] asteroid has a hollow core lined with industrially valuable crystals - like a gigantic geode hung in the stars.

With special instructions prepared by Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], any future mining platform should be able to carefully harvest these crystals from the interior of the asteroid.

distar.80.b.evopred.zh: 在进一步调查之前抓点儿小零食好了。
distar.80.b.evopred.en: Grab a snack before investigating further.

distar.80.desc.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]汇报称[From.GetName]上的巨大结构实际上是某种未知外星生物的庞大遗骸。这具遗骸不仅巨大到能从[primitive_planet.GetName]轨道上通过肉眼直接看到，而且它似乎还在不断大量散布某种作用于精神层面的化学物质，或许一直影响着这颗行星上有机生物的神经系统。
distar.80.desc.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the enormous structure located on [From.GetName] is in fact the gargantuan corpse of some unidentified alien creature. Not only is the corpse large enough to be seen with the naked eye from [primitive_planet.GetName], it also appears to be shedding large quantities of psychotropic chemicals that may have neurological side effects for organic life forms on the planet.

distar.82.a.zh: 我们正好可以利用这一点。
distar.82.a.en: Surely that will play to our advantage.

distar.82.a.tt.zh: 每个£pop£[worshipper_species.GetAdj]人口获得240个月的$conviction$修正，获得+33%幸福度与+25%£job£岗位产出的资源。
distar.82.a.tt.en: Every £pop£ [worshipper_species.GetAdj] Pop gains the modifier $conviction$ for 240 months, granting +33% Happiness and +25% Resources from £job£ Jobs.

distar.82.b.zh: 这太荒谬了，我们不会陪他们演戏的。
distar.82.b.en: This is ridiculous. We will not play along.

distar.82.c.zh: 是的，我们是被你们的神派来的，你们很快就会去陪它了。
distar.82.c.en: Yes, we come from your god. You will soon join him.

distar.82.d.en: Just get them off my planet!

distar.82.desc.zh:
在摧毁了[dead_god_planet.GetName]上土著设置的防御阵线后，许多当地原住民的使者前来主动联络。看起来当地土著已经将那具位于该行星的卫星上的巨型生物遗骸当做死亡之神供奉很久了。他们相信终有一天神会起死回生，变成重生之神，并带给他们的人民一个新的繁荣纪元。

由于我们来自星空，拥有他们难以理解的科学技术，许多当地人开始相信我们就是死亡之神回归的先驱。
distar.82.desc.en:
After overwhelming the primitive defenses mounted by the natives on [dead_god_planet.GetName], our forces were approached by a number of envoys from the inhabitants. It seems that the locals have worshiped the remains of the gargantuan creature on the planet's moon as a god of death for generations beyond their remembrance. The locals believed that one day their god would rise from the dead, transforming into a deity of rebirth and ushering in a new era of prosperity for their people.

As we came from the stars boasting technology beyond their comprehension, many of the locals seem to be convinced we are heralds of their god of death.

distar.85.desc.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说[From.GetName]的行星表面被一个电子脉冲网络完全覆盖了。这个网络会对外界刺激做出反应：当[Root.GetName]向地面输送低压脉冲时地表的网络会呈现波浪状的闪烁，就像电路板一样。

更令人吃惊的是，网络还会自我重组！第二次脉冲测试发现网络组成模式发生了改变，网络的中心变为了第一次脉冲与[From.GetName]的地表的接触点。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这一发现证实了[Root.Leader.GetHisHer]一直以来持有的理论：生命可以以单纯的电脉冲形式存在，并不需要细胞或者病毒之类的组织结构。
distar.85.desc.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that [From.GetName] is covered from pole to pole in a web-like network of electrical filaments. These networks respond to external stimuli: the [Root.GetName] experimented with sending a low-voltage pulse to the surface, which resulted in a wave of illumination that rippled through the network like a circuitboard.

Even more remarkably: the webs rearrange themselves! A second, low-voltage pulse revealed that the filaments had been organized into a new pattern, centered around where the previous pulse had contacted the surface of [From.GetName].

[Root.GetLeaderName] concludes that this discovery confirms [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] long-held theory: that life can exist as almost purely electrical impulses, independent of cellular- or viral structure.

distar.9.desc.zh: 行星管理部门很高兴汇报到在[Root.GetName]周围建立的超强耀斑护盾矩阵非常成功，我们的殖民者不但可以安全避开有害的等离子辐射，还享受到了太阳风击打在全新的护盾矩阵上产生的炫目多彩的极光盛宴。
distar.9.desc.en: Planetary administration is pleased to report that the development of a superflare shield matrix around [Root.GetName] was a complete success. Our colonists were not only safely shielded from the harmful ionizing radiation, but were treated to a spectacular auroral display as solar wind interacted with the new shield matrix.

distar.90.b.zh: 很好的提议，拿最好的酒器出来！
distar.90.b.en: An excellent proposal. Break out the fine glassware!

distar.90.desc.zh:
对[From.GetName]的深入研究发现这颗行星的主要化学成分和[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上一种莓果中的酯类相同。数千年来，当地人一直用这种物质来蒸酿美酒。[From.GetName]上储量惊人的酯质很有可能是来自遮蔽了整个星系的一片星云，那里的同类物质更是难以计量。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]获取了几份样本，在经过了严格的毒理检验后，甚至亲口品尝。他描述说其气味口感仿佛“冰冷太空中一丝故乡的温暖”。[Root.GetName]的船员称这种极具异星风味的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]传统饮料将会在我们的人民中大受欢迎。
distar.90.desc.en:
Closer study of [From.GetName] has revealed that the planet's primary chemical composition is in fact identical to an ester found in berries on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], which the locals have been distilling into inebriants for thousands of years. The ester on [From.GetName] likely comes from the nebula that cloaks the system, containing billions of liters of the same substance.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has secured several samples of the familiar ester - and after rigorous biohazard testing has even sampled it, describing the scent and taste as 'a little taste of home, within the chill of the void'. The crew of the [Root.GetName] suggests that such an exotic variant of the well-known [Root.Owner.GetAdj] beverage could be quite popular among our citizens.

distar.9000.fallback.zh: 虽然当时并不明显，但[From.GetName]最近进行的勘探，在报告传回[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学界之后，似乎使L-星门谜团的研究有了突破性的进展。
distar.9000.fallback.en: It was not immediately apparent at the time, but the recent survey carried out by the [From.GetName] seemingly sparked a breakthrough in the ongoing study of the mysterious L-Gates when the report filtered back to the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName].

distar.9000.lcluster_clue_desc_1.zh: 我们发现神秘容器上面的外星化合物是由纳米机器人的粉末组成的。外壳上的一些划痕中甚至有微小的机械爪痕，其中一个爪痕上有个纳米机器人正在从储存器中吸取能源。我们从纳米机器人的存储设备中提取到了一些数据，这些数据可以帮助我们更好地理解L-星团的传送门网络。
distar.9000.lcluster_clue_desc_1.en: We have discovered that the alien compound found on the enigmatic cache is made up of the powdered fragments of microscopic robotic entities - nanites. Some of the scratches in the hull even have tiny mechanical claws stuck in them, and in one we discovered an active but damaged nanite leeching its energy from the cache. From what remained of the nanite's hard drive we have extracted data that could be pivotal for our understanding of the L-cluster Gateway network.

distar.9000.lcluster_clue_desc_2.zh:
从[big_rip_planet.GetName]的废墟中回收的众多物品中有一个全息图像，该全息图像来自于某个对植物类[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]生活进行干涉的社会。虽然全息图像中的大部分数据已经损坏的难以辨识，我们还是成功的恢复了几个含有关于传送门网络的关键信息的片段。

大部分全息图像似乎是用来警告灰色风暴将会带来的毁灭性灾难的。
distar.9000.lcluster_clue_desc_2.en:
Among the items recovered from the ruins on [big_rip_planet.GetName] was a malfunctioning hologram from the society that interfered with the plantoid [GetPreFTLLowerPlural]. Though most of the data was either corrupted or unintelligible due to an incessant whooshing sound and the panicked state of the sender, we managed to restore several fragments containing valuable information on the Gateway network.

Most of the hologram, however, was dedicated to sickening premonitions of the Gray Tempest and the gruesome death that would follow in its wake.

distar.9000.lcluster_clue_desc_3.zh:
出于安全考虑，我们给所有从西万实验室返回的船员们都进行了全面的消毒，在消毒过程中，我们发现船员的防护外套上面附有某种外星物质，经过仔细研究发现这是某种变成了灰色尘埃的微型机器人碎片。最后我们在这些外星物质中找到了一个完整的纳米机器人，该机器人身上携带着给某个建筑安装螺栓的指令，我们认为那个建筑应该是一个传送门。

这个纳米机器人从事的工作应该是“组装整个L-星门网络”这一系统工程中的一小部分。
distar.9000.lcluster_clue_desc_3.en:
As the crew returning from the Xvan labs were decontaminated we identified an alien substance on their protective wear. Upon closer examination it has proven to be fragments of microscopic robots turned into a fine gray dust. Among the samples we found an intact nanite carrying instructions for attaching bolts to a structure we believe could be a Gateway.

This molecular construct maybe have had an integral part in assembling the entire L-Gate network.

distar.9000.lcluster_clue_sonic.zh:
我们科研船最近一直在分析那个来自系外的声波信号，现在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]科研团队终于取得了突破性进展。

尽管信号中的大部分声波方程的含义我们仍不清楚，但我们母星上的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][Root.GetScientistPlural]们已经确定该传输信号的数据与神秘L-星门上所用的科技数据是完全一致的！

单独进行分析的话，此信号的价值近乎为零，但如果将此信号与我们得到的关于远古传送门建造者的信息结合起来进行研究的话，可能就会让我们知道该如何重新启动这些L-星门。
distar.9000.lcluster_clue_sonic.en:
Something of a breakthrough has been reached within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] scientific community regarding the extragalactic sonified signal one of our Science Ships recently analyzed.

While the full meaning of the sonified equation embedded in the signal still eludes us, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [Root.GetScientistPlural] on our home world have been able to match enough of the transmission's data on subspace harmonics to the technology observed in the mysterious L-Gates!

Examined in isolation, the signal is of little further use to us. Analyzing it in conjunction with other insights into the ancient Gateway Builders, however, may yield valuable data on how these L-Gates could be reactivated.

distar.91.a.en: Send the ester to the [rum_nation.GetName] as a gift.

distar.91.a.tooltip.zh: 这样他们应该会很高兴。

distar.91.b.zh: 还是算了，我们可不需要更多失控的有机生命体。
distar.91.b.en: The last thing we need is more malfunctioning organics.

distar.91.desc.zh:
对[From.GetName]的深入研究发现这颗行星的主要化学成分和[rum_nation.Capital.GetName]上一种莓果中的酯类相同。数千年来，[rum_nation.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一直用这种物质来制取有致醉作用的饮料。[From.GetName]上储量惊人的酯类很有可能是来自遮蔽了整个星系的一片星云，那里的同类物质更是难以计量。

[Root.GetLeaderName]获取了几份样本，检测其是否含有任何对有机体有害的污染物。科学家们建议我们可以把这些物质作为送给[rum_nation.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的礼物。有机体一直以享受此类物质而闻名。
distar.91.desc.en:
Closer study of [From.GetName] has revealed that the planet's primary chemical composition is in fact identical to a molecule found in berries on [rum_nation.Capital.GetName], which the [rum_nation.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been distilling into inebriants for thousands of years. The ester so prevalent on [From.GetName] likely comes from the nebula that cloaks the system, which contains billions of liters of the same substance.

[Root.GetLeaderName] has secured several samples of the ester, testing it for any contaminants that may be harmful to organic life. They suggest we may attempt to gift the substance to the [rum_nation.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Organics are known for enjoying such things.

distar.92.a.zh: 我们的情感模拟器很高兴看到你们享受这种化学物质。
distar.92.a.en: Our emotion emulators are pleased you enjoy the molecule.

distar.92.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们意外之礼已经收到。一开始我们确实心存怀疑，但一等科学家确认了饮料的安全性，大家便迫不及待地仔细品味。

必须承认，那真是美妙的体验。果味浓郁的香气，伴随着略带酸度的底味，再加上那不可忽视的滞涩口感。它既让我们回想起了[rum_nation.Capital.GetName]上故乡的果园，又仿佛象征着宇宙的空旷无垠，冰冷与温暖融合为一。

感谢你们慷慨的礼物。想想都令人激动，整整一颗星球，满溢着我们已酿制千年的美酒！
distar.92.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have received your unexpected gift. We must say we were skeptical at first, but once our scientists confirmed the safety of the beverage, well, we had to have a taste.

We must say, the experience was quite exquisite. A fruity bouquet, with a tart undertone and a certain implacable tang. It reminds us of the orchards at home on [rum_nation.Capital.GetName] and the vastness of space, all at once.

We thank you for this gift. To think, a whole planet full of the same beverage we have distilled for centuries!

distar.93.a.en: Error! A communication failure has occurred.

distar.93.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]你这是什么意思？你难道想用这种污秽的液体毒死我们么？觉得我们很好欺负是么？

少尉，把整个天杀的货仓全部封锁，然后关掉这个频道！
distar.93.desc.en:
What is the meaning of this, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? You seek to poison us with this foul liquid? How facultatively challenged do you think we are?

Ensign, airlock that entire odious shipment, and close the channel!

distar.95.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]所发现的独特晶体具有相当特殊的性质。[Root.GetName]船员们报告称在他们到达该星球表面时内心格外的镇定，他们神清气爽、情绪高昂并一直持续到返回轨道。显然，这种晶体能在一种医学上已知对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]健康有益的频率上发生共振。

如果我们有一天在[From.GetName]建立了殖民地，我们的人民绝对会享受在这种共振晶体附近的生活。
distar.95.desc.en:
The unique crystals found on [From.GetName] possess quite exceptional properties. The [Root.GetName] crew reports to have found their visit to the planet's surface entirely soothing, leaving them refreshed and placated upon return to orbit. Apparently, the crystals resonate at a frequency known to be medically therapeutic for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

If ever we were to settle on [From.GetName], our populace would surely enjoy living in constant proximity to these resonant minerals.

divination_locus_denied.zh: 我们保持不动并保卫我们的领地，违背虚境的意志
divination_locus_denied.en: We defy the Shroud's will by remaining still, and guarding our territory

divination_locus_embrace.zh: 我们探索这些道路，拥抱虚境的意志
divination_locus_embrace.en: We embrace the Shroud's will by exploring these paths ourselves

divination_situation_end.zh: 在递送预言之后，[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]会通知我们虚境已经归复平静。
divination_situation_end.en: After delivering their prophecies, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] will inform us the Shroud has grown quiet.

divination_visitors_denied.zh: 我们拒绝来访者进入我们的领地，违背虚境的意志
divination_visitors_denied.en: We defy the Shroud's will by denying visitors access to our territory

divination_visitors_embrace.zh: 我们亲自找出这些来访者，拥抱虚境的意志
divination_visitors_embrace.en: We embrace the Shroud's will by seeking out these visitors ourselves

drone_fl_satellite.zh: 坠毁的第一联盟人造卫星

eater_covenant_tradition_tt.zh: 一旦我们的契约建立，我们的$telepath_type_plural_with_icon$会增加£mod_country_naval_cap_add£ $MOD_COUNTRY_NAVAL_CAP_ADD$。
eater_covenant_tradition_tt.en: Once our Covenant is confirmed, our $telepath_type_plural_with_icon$ will increase £mod_country_naval_cap_add£ $MOD_COUNTRY_NAVAL_CAP_ADD$.

effect_stop_the_bullet.zh: 我们在绝望地寻求解决方案。
effect_stop_the_bullet.en: We are desperately looking for solutions.

egalitarian1.zh: 超然均衡教团的坚忍斗士。通过义体和生物科技进行升级，[Root.GetFirstName]誓要踏碎星系所有的暴政。
egalitarian1.en: A stoic warrior of the Numinous Equilibrium. Upgraded with cybernetics and biotechnology, [Root.GetFirstName] has vowed to rid the galaxy of tyrants.

egalitarian1_catch_phrase.zh: “在星系中的许多归宿中，暴政是最糟，却又最常见的那个。”
egalitarian1_catch_phrase.en: "Of the myriad fates across the galaxy, tyranny is one of the worst and most common."

egalitarian2.zh: 一位充满创造力和幽默感的科学家，还有一位友好的小机器人助手，“戈尔基”。[Root.GetHeSheCap]想要分享[Root.GetHisHer]的知识，来改善[Root.GetHisHer]身边人们的生活。
egalitarian2.en: A creative and playful scientist. Assisted by Gorky, a small friendly robot, [Root.GetHeSheCap] seeks to share [Root.GetHisHer] knowledge to improve the lives of those around [Root.GetHisHer].

egalitarian2_catch_phrase.zh: “我们所创造的技术奇迹？应该把它和所有人分享！”
egalitarian2_catch_phrase.en: "The technological wonders we create? We should share them with everyone!"

egalitarian_excellence.tt.zh: 高度受教育的强化人口是社会和物质进步的关键。
egalitarian_excellence.tt.en: A well-educated and fully augmented population is the key to social and material progress.

electric_waters_desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的轨道扫描检测到这颗行星深深的冰洋之下有异常的电信号。

对这种水中自然现象进行进一步研究可以获得更多发现。
electric_waters_desc.en:
Orbital scans of [from.GetName] are detecting erratic electrical signals deep within the planet's icy seas.

Further study into this aquatic phenomenon will reveal more.

embark_create_subject.zh: [from.GetName]将登上方舟舰，成为[event_target:player_country.GetName]新的游牧附庸。
embark_create_subject.en: [from.GetName] will embark on an Arkship as a new Nomadic Subject of the [event_target:player_country.GetName].

embark_leaves_behind_subject.zh: 将创建一个包含所有剩余['concept_colonies']和['concept_starbases']的定居附属国。
embark_leaves_behind_subject.en: A Settled Subject will be created with all remaining ['concept_colonies'] and ['concept_starbases'].

emissions_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 未知来源发出的强大能量辐射使得这颗小行星在众多同类中十分扎眼。
emissions_asteroid_category_desc.en: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.

emperor.10.desc.zh: 由于我们是[overlord.GetName]的附庸，因此我们被禁止加入新成立的星海帝国。
emperor.10.desc.en: Given our status as subjects of the [overlord.GetName], we are prohibited from joining the newly formed Galactic Imperium.

emperor.101.a.en: Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

emperor.101.desc.zh:
我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——星海帝国已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。也许再也不会有这么好的推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的机会了！现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个统一联邦的旗帜之下。

由于[Root.GetName]在这场盛大的叛乱中打响了第一枪，各界纷纷请求我们在接下来的战争中领导这个伟大的联盟，毫无疑问这也是星系的一份。
emperor.101.desc.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment - the Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. There may never be a better time to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]! Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium are uniting under the banner of a single federation.

As it was the [Root.GetName] that orchestrated the opening shots of the rebellion, we have been asked to lead this great alliance in the upcoming war, which will no doubt be of galactic proportions.

emperor.103.desc.zh:
我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——星海帝国已经已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个由[rebel_leader.GetName]领导的统一联邦的旗帜之下。同时，[gal_emperor.GetName]则正召集忠诚且坚毅者不惜一切代价捍卫帝国。

内战之火即将席卷全星系，而两边都在拉拢我们的加入。我们应当与谁并肩作战？
emperor.103.desc.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment - the Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium, led by the [rebel_leader.GetName], are uniting under the banner of a single federation. Meanwhile, the [gal_emperor.GetName] is gathering loyalists determined to preserve the Imperium at any cost.

Civil war is about to engulf the galaxy, and both sides have asked for our allegiance. Who shall we stand with?

emperor.104.desc.zh:
这是至暗时刻。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的腐化影响范围远超我们的想象，帝国中的其他成员没有一位敢于加入我们的公开起义！

我们现在将独自对抗星海帝国的联合军队，因为后者已经因战争进行了动员。
emperor.104.desc.en:
These are dark times. The corrupting influence of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] extends much further than we thought - none of the other members of the Imperium have had the courage to join us in open revolt!

We now stand alone against the combined might of the Galactic Imperium as it mobilizes for war.

emperor.106.a.zh: 这些叛军必须为他们的傲慢无礼付出代价。
emperor.106.a.en: These rebels must pay for their insolence.

emperor.107.a.desc.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！若干成员站起来反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的统治，他们以[rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]的名义团结一致。而由[gal_emperor.GetName]领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。
emperor.107.a.desc.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Several members have rebelled against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], gathering under the banner of the [rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]. Loyalists, led by the [gal_emperor.GetName], have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

emperor.107.b.desc.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！[rebel_leader.GetName]正在发动反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的起义。而由[gal_emperor.GetName]领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。
emperor.107.b.desc.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! The [rebel_leader.GetName] is rebelling against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Loyalists, led by the [gal_emperor.GetName], have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

emperor.150.a.en: Let us welcome them back into the Imperium.

emperor.150.b.zh: 他们应当为傲慢无礼付出代价。
emperor.150.b.en: They must be punished for their insolence.

emperor.150.desc.zh:
结束了！叛乱基本已经被粉碎，而全帝国忠诚的子民们则在欢庆我们的胜利。

现在那些叛徒们已经束手就擒，我们得想想怎么料理他们。我们是要对他们网开一面还是让他们得到应有的惩罚呢？
emperor.150.desc.en:
It is done! The rebellion has been utterly crushed, and loyal citizens throughout the Imperium are celebrating our victory.

Now that the traitors have been brought to heel, we must decide how to deal with them. Should we show leniency or are they to be punished for their crimes?

emperor.153.desc.zh: 看起来星海帝国已经成功地撑过了它所面临的暴动风波。叛军已经被帝国军队完全击败，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣告在内战中获胜。
emperor.153.desc.en: It would seem that the Galactic Imperium has managed to weather the storm of insurrection it was facing. The rebels have been decisively defeated by Imperial forces, and the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has proclaimed victory in the civil war.

emperor.2.a.tooltip.zh:
$emperor.2.a.tooltip.start$—我们现在拥有$civic_galactic_sovereign$国民理念
—我们的思潮将剧烈地朝威权主义转移
$emperor.2.a.tooltip.end$
emperor.2.a.tooltip.en:
$emperor.2.a.tooltip.start$- We now have the $civic_galactic_sovereign$ Civic
- Our ethics have radically shifted towards Authoritarianism
$emperor.2.a.tooltip.end$

emperor.2.a.tooltip.megacorp.zh:
$emperor.2.a.tooltip.start$—我们现在拥有$civic_galactic_sovereign_megacorp$国民理念
—我们的思潮将剧烈地朝威权主义转移
$emperor.2.a.tooltip.end$
emperor.2.a.tooltip.megacorp.en:
$emperor.2.a.tooltip.start$- We now have the $civic_galactic_sovereign_megacorp$ Civic
- Our ethics have radically shifted towards Authoritarianism
$emperor.2.a.tooltip.end$

emperor.200.a.en: This is a day to remember.

emperor.200.desc.zh:
自由重新回到了全星系！星海帝国终于陨落了，最后一个帝制派也向日益壮大的义军投降了。

随着[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]被罢黜，过去的星海共同体重回生机。时间将会证明重建起的制度是否能够防止下一位星系独裁者的诞生，但现在，过去帝国的疆域里的各个行星上同时掀起了庆祝活动。
emperor.200.desc.en:
Freedom has been restored to the galaxy! The Galactic Imperium has fallen, and the last of the Imperial loyalists have surrendered to the advancing Rebel forces.

With the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] deposed, the old Galactic Community has been resurrected. Time will tell if the reborn institution can prevent the rise of another galactic dictator, but for now, spontaneous celebrations have broken out on planets across the territory of the former Imperium.

emperor.200.name.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

emperor.201.desc.zh:
星海帝国已经陷落了。我们帝国军队无力阻挡叛乱舰队进犯的步伐，而今天，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]也别无选择停止了抵抗。

随着帝国的解体，星海共同体的腐朽机构又重新开始运作了。于是，星系又毅然决然地背离了秩序而拥抱了混沌……
emperor.201.desc.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. Imperial forces proved unable to stop the advance of the Rebel fleets, and today the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] had no choice but to capitulate.

With the Imperium dismantled, the old corrupt institution of the Galactic Community has been resurrected to take its place. And so the galaxy has turned decisively away from order, and embraced chaos...

emperor.202.desc.zh:
在叛军四面楚歌的围攻下，星海帝国陨落了。叛乱的渣滓们竟击败了帝国曾经强大无比的舰队，最后一位帝制派也背弃了我们的伟业。

迫于一切帝制派抵抗分子的瓦解，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]别无选择只能退位。叛党们已经宣布过去的星海共同体再次启用，以填补帝国分崩离析后的巨大真空。
emperor.202.desc.en:
Beset by traitors on all sides, the Galactic Imperium has fallen. The rebel scum have broken the Imperium's once-powerful fleets, and the last of the loyalists have deserted our cause.

In light of the collapse of all Imperial resistance, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has had no choice but to abdicate. The insurgents have already announced the resurrection of the old Galactic Community to fill the great void left by the disintegrating Imperium.

emperor.203.desc.zh:
星海帝国陨落了。随着起义军在各个战线全面开花，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]最终退位。

旧的星海共同体重新恢复了运作以替代分崩离析的帝国。
emperor.203.desc.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Rebel forces victorious on all fronts, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has abdicated.

The old Galactic Community has been restored in the collapsing Imperium's stead.

emperor.250.desc.zh:
尽管帝国军队未能摧毁叛乱，他们至少设法阻止了叛军想推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有反叛分子都被保障了独立。

也许这是最好的结果。这样的疾病必须要在腐烂开始扩散之前斩除，因为我们总有机会重新吧这些任性的恒星系收归回帝国的怀抱……
emperor.250.desc.en:
While Imperial forces failed to destroy the insurgency, they at least managed to thwart the Rebels' attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.

Perhaps it is for the best. A disease such as this must be cut out before the corruption has a chance to spread. We can always rebuild and return these wayward systems to the bosom of the Imperium at a later date...

emperor.251.desc.zh:
尽管我们没有达成推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的目的，但至少我们为自己的人民争得了自由。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有起义分子都被保障了独立。

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]毫无疑问会利用这个间隙重建帝国的军队，我们必须时刻提防帝国今后任何企图扩大影响力的尝试。
emperor.251.desc.en:
While we have failed in our attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have at least secured freedom for our own people. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will no doubt use this respite to rebuild the Imperium's forces - we must guard against any future attempts by the Imperials to spread their influence at our expense.

emperor.252.desc.zh:
内战在僵局中结束了，虽然证明了帝国无法战胜叛乱，但叛军推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图也失败了。

在今天由双方签署的和平条约中，帝国的起义成员被获得了完全的独立。我们将会看到这是否会导致两个权力集团的长久和平……或是冷战。
emperor.252.desc.en:
The Civil War has ended in stalemate. While the Imperium proved unable to vanquish the rebellion, the Rebels also failed in their attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

In a peace treaty signed by both parties today, the rebelling members of the Imperium were granted full independence. We shall see if this results in a lasting peace between the two power blocs... or a cold war.

emperor.3.a.tooltip.zh: 星海共同体已转变为星海帝国。
emperor.3.a.tooltip.en: The Galactic Community is now known as the Galactic Imperium.

emperor.3.awakenedhive.desc.zh:
这是远古秩序的黎明。

星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是[Root.GetGalEmpireName]的崛起。古老而破碎的意识选择在这一时代复兴，违抗天命者都被绳之以法。谁都不知道这位新的[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]对星系抱有何等雄心壮志。
emperor.3.awakenedhive.desc.en:
It is the dawn of an Old Order.

The Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the [Root.GetGalEmpireName] has risen. The old and fragmented  consciousness chose this era to re-emerge. Those who would oppose their ascension have been put in chains. Who can say what aspirations the new [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has for the galaxy.

emperor.300.desc.zh:
星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的星海共同体。

让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！
emperor.300.desc.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old Galactic Community.

Let it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!

emperor.301.a.en: We must find our place in it.

emperor.301.desc.zh:
战争的结束近在咫尺。帝国军的残部要么成建制地投降，要么在夜幕中溃逃散尽，这正是帝国正在凋亡的迹象。

现在，[dissolve_winner.GetName]就已经开始了重建原有的星海共同体的工作。整个星系中，帝国的旗帜被撕毁或焚烧。而一个新的未来正展现在我们的眼前。
emperor.301.desc.en:
The end is here. As the remaining Imperial forces surrender en masse or melt away into the night, it has become evident that the Imperium is dying.

Even now, the [dissolve_winner.GetName] has begun the work of rebuilding the old Galactic Community. Imperial banners are being torn down or put to the flame across the galaxy. A new future is upon us.

emperor.302.a.zh: 当然！是时候重新回到星系舞台了。
emperor.302.a.en: Of course! It is time to rejoin the galaxy.

emperor.302.b.zh: 不了。它不过是下一个帝国的温床罢了。
emperor.302.b.en: No. It could turn into another Imperium.

emperor.302.desc.zh:
星海帝国陷落了。帝国军要么就地溃散要么成建制地投降，帝国的疆域被解放了。

饱受战争之苦的前帝国的疆域中秩序正在逐渐恢复，[dissolve_winner.GetName]认为是时候重建原有星海共同体了。我们收到了一份成员邀请，是否加入呢？
