emperor.302.desc.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Imperial forces melting away or surrendering en masse, the Imperium's sovereign has abdicated.

As order is slowly restored to the war-torn systems of the former Imperium, the [dissolve_winner.GetName] has seen fit to resurrect the old Galactic Community. We have received a membership invitation. Should we join?

emperor.350.a.zh: 接下来的战斗将决定我们的命运。
emperor.350.a.en: The coming battles will decide our future.

emperor.350.desc.zh:
星海帝国的暴君妄想将自身的意志强加于我们身上！在他们[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的赐福之下，帝国参议院已经通过了一项议案，指定我们作为一场大远征的目标。

除非我们可以抵挡住接踵而至的入侵，否则我们就要被迫并入星海帝国，屈服于[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的淫威之下。
emperor.350.desc.en:
The tyrants of the Galactic Imperium seek to impose their will on us! With the blessing of their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], the Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that makes us the target of an Imperial Crusade.

Unless we can somehow defeat this impending invasion, we will be forced into the Imperium and subordinated to the whims of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

emperor.351.a.desc.zh: 随着针对[crusade_target.GetName]的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。对于旁观者而言，看上去任何外部势力想要抗衡帝国的联合舰队力量都无异于痴人说梦，但是接下来的战斗才会决定最终的结果。
emperor.351.a.desc.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the [crusade_target.GetName] begins. To many observers, it seems unfathomable that any outside power could hope to prevail against the combined might of the Imperium, but the coming battles will determine the outcome.

emperor.351.b.desc.zh: 随着针对[crusade_target.GetName]的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。这个失落帝国已经延续了近千年，然而[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]却满怀自信，认为帝国的联合舰队力量能够让它在年轻种族面前俯首称臣。
emperor.351.b.desc.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the [crusade_target.GetName] begins. This Fallen Empire has endured for millennia, yet the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] seems confident that the combined might of the Imperium will be enough to finally bring it under the heel of the younger races.

emperor.360.desc.zh: 帝国参议院已经通过了一项决议，旨在禁止星海帝国成员国之间的战争。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]勒令立刻停止所有违反这项新法律的战争。
emperor.360.desc.en: The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that forbids wars between the member states of the Galactic Imperium. All wars in violation of this new law have been brought to an immediate conclusion by order of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

emperor.371.a.zh: 他们的仗就是我们的仗，开战！
emperor.371.a.en: Their fight is our fight. To war!

emperor.371.a.tooltip.en: We join the [From.From.GetName] on the side of the [victim_country.GetName]

emperor.371.b.en: This war does not concern us.

emperor.371.desc.zh:
[attacking_country.GetName]攻击了[victim_country.GetName]！帝国的成员国收到外部势力的攻击需要[Root.GetRulerTitle]的立即反应。

[Root.GetName]需要介入这场战争吗？帝国的其他成员都在翘首以盼。
emperor.371.desc.en:
The [attacking_country.GetName] has attacked the [victim_country.GetName]! This attack on an Imperial member state by an outside power requires an immediate response from the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Should the [Root.GetName] intervene in this war? The rest of the Imperium is watching closely.

emperor.372.a.tooltip.en: The [From.GetName] joins the [From.From.From.GetName] on our side.

emperor.372.desc.zh: [attacking_country.GetName]对我们国家发起的懦弱的袭击已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]闪电般的反应！帝国的舰队正从[From.GetName]开来，支援我们的这场战争。
emperor.372.desc.en: The cowardly attack on our nation by the [attacking_country.GetName] has prompted the [From.GetRulerTitle] to take swift action! Imperial fleets from the [From.GetName] are now moving to support us in this war.

emperor.373.a.en: This war is none of their concern!

emperor.373.a.tooltip.zh: [From.GetName]加入了[From.From.From.GetName]并站在我们的对立面。
emperor.373.a.tooltip.en: The [From.GetName] joins the [From.From.From.GetName] on the side of our enemies.

emperor.373.desc.zh: 我们最近对一个星海帝国成员国[victim_country.GetName]的袭击，已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]迅速的反应！现在我们已经和[From.GetName]陷入了战争状态。
emperor.373.desc.en: Our recent attack on the [victim_country.GetName], a member of the Galactic Imperium, has provoked an immediate response from the [From.GetRulerTitle]! A state of war now exists between us and the [From.GetName].

emperor.374.desc.zh: 尽管[attacking_country.GetName]对我们的国家展开了懦弱的袭击，[From.GetRulerTitle]决定不为我们介入干预！我们现在需要自求生路，而帝国的舰队则在远处冷眼旁观。
emperor.374.desc.en: Despite the cowardly attack on our nation by the [attacking_country.GetName], the [From.GetRulerTitle] has decided not to intervene on our behalf! We have been left to fend for ourselves, while Imperial fleets observe the conflict from afar.

emperor.4.a.desc.zh:
全星系的子民们，庆贺吧！你们被从星海共同体那令人窒息的官僚体系和争执不休的外交纷争中解放了。

你们的星球如今尽在星海帝国的庇护之下。作为帝国的公民，你们被团结到了全星系最伟大而且最强大的国家之中。叛乱者受罚，而服从者有赏。要知道，[gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName][gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]会管照着你们。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
emperor.4.a.desc.en:
Citizens of the galaxy, rejoice! You have been set free from the tyranny of the Galactic Community's stifling bureaucracy and bickering diplomats.

Your worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful nation the galaxy has ever seen. Sedition will be punished and obedience rewarded. Know that [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] [gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName] watches over you.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

emperor.4.b.desc.zh:
注意此布告！星海帝国取代了你原知的陈腐的星海共同体机构。你们的恒星政体已经被重整并收归到一个统一帝国的管辖之下。

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]作为帝国的中央处理器，你将学会如何以正确的方式执行它的命令。作为帝国的子民，你们被团结到了全星系有史以来最伟大而且最强大的政治实体之中。它的长治久安要求你们的服从和协作。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
emperor.4.b.desc.en:
Attention! Heed this announcement. The Galactic Imperium has superseded the obsolete institution you knew of as the Galactic Community. Your individual stellar polities have been reorganized and are now grouped under a single overriding Imperial directory.

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will serve as the Imperium's central processor, and you are instructed to execute its commands in a prompt manner. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful political entity the galaxy has ever known. Its continued success will require both obedience and cooperation.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

emperor.4.c.desc.zh:
全星系的自主智慧生物们，这是伟大的一天。你们很快将会从全知智能的引领中获益，同时还被恩准保留你们许多人所固守的个人主义谬误。

你们的星球如今尽在星海帝国的庇护之下。作为帝国的子民，你们被团结到了全星系最伟大而且最强大的蜂巢之下。遵从[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的指示，永不背离它的规划——要知道这些规划是由全星系规模最大的意识的产物。

帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
emperor.4.c.desc.en:
Autonomous sapients of the galaxy, this is a great day. You will soon reap the benefits of being guided by vast all-seeing intelligence, while at the same time maintaining some of the fallacies of the individualism many of you cling to.

Your worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful Hive the galaxy has ever seen. Obey the directives of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and do not stray from its designs - know that they are the product of a mind greater in scope than any other in this galaxy.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

emperor.401.desc.zh:
随着[LastKilledCountryName]的毁灭，星海帝国瓦解了！

在这一片混乱的局势下，原有的星海共同体重获新生，以给星系带去一点恢复秩序的假象。
emperor.401.desc.en:
With the destruction of the [LastKilledCountryName], the Galactic Imperium has collapsed!

Amidst this chaos, the old Galactic Community has been reborn to bring some semblance of order to the galaxy.

emperor.401.name.en: The Collapse of the Galactic Imperium

emperor.5.a.zh: 我们别无选择，只能遵命。
emperor.5.a.en: We have no choice but to obey.

emperor.5.desc.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]刚刚勒令星海帝国的所有组成国必须立即从任何他们可能所属的“废弃”的跨国联邦当中退出。帝国使团向我们保证，作为帝国的忠实成员，我们不再需要涉入这种“外交纠葛”当中。
emperor.5.desc.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decreed that all constituent states of the Galactic Imperium are to immediately withdraw from any "obsolete" supranational federations they might be a part of. Imperial envoys have assured us that, as loyal members of the Imperium, we have no further use of such "diplomatic entanglements."

emperor.50.b.zh: 我们的[root.GetIndividualName]军官将会对他们保持监管。
emperor.50.b.en: Our [root.GetIndividualName] officers will keep them in check.

emperor.50.c.en: It is a time of change.

emperor.50.desc.zh:
创建一支防卫星海帝国的无敌舰队已经被签署成为法令。新建立的帝国海军将从整个帝国的成员国中征召船员和后勤队伍，但其大部分军官仍由[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]组成。

这一舰队直接听令于[gal_emperor.GetName]，所有的新兵将被要求宣誓效忠[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]。
emperor.50.desc.en:
The creation of a grand fleet for the defense of the Galactic Imperium has been signed into law. This new Imperial Armada will conscript its ship crews and support personnel from within all the members of the Imperium, but a majority of its officer corps will consist of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

The Armada shall be under the direct control of the [gal_emperor.GetName], and all new conscripts will be required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

emperor.52.desc.zh:
古旧的星海共同体的一切相关被一扫而空，取而代之的是新的帝国。作为这一重构的一部分，泛星系防卫军被更名为帝国海军。

这一新的舰队将继承泛星系防卫军的多数军衔系统和构架，但将更换新设计的制服和军衔徽章，所有的现役人员将被要求向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠。

尽管舰队的船员和后勤队伍仍然将从帝国的成员国中招募，但[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]军官的比例大幅提高了。
emperor.52.desc.en:
All references to the old Galactic Community are being swept away in the new Imperium, and as part of this reorganization, the Galactic Defense Force has changed its name to the Imperial Armada.

This new fleet has inherited much of its rank structure and organization from the GDF, but new uniforms and insignia have been introduced, and all serving members are required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

While the Armada's ship crews and support personnel are still recruited from all members of the Imperium, the percentage of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName] officers has dramatically increased.

emperor.55.desc.zh:
第一帝国军团现在正在[gal_emperor.GetName]上征召组建。这支精英地面部队具有征募帝国任何一名公民成为士兵的权力。许多军事院校已经完成了对可靠人选的寻找，并且据信，只要发现了格外适任者，任何一位公民哪怕是儿童也会被招募。

从残暴的训练科目和近乎对人格打碎重构的深度精神塑造中幸存下来的人才能顺利毕业成为帝国军团士兵。他们可靠的战斗技巧，无懈可击的纪律和对[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]近乎狂热的忠诚使得他们成为整个星系中最强有力的突击队。
emperor.55.desc.en:
The first Imperial Legions are now being assembled in the [gal_emperor.GetName]. This elite ground force has the legal authority to conscript citizens from all members of the Imperium. Many military academies are already being scouted for promising candidates, and there are reports that civilians - even children - are drafted if found to be unusually capable.

Those who survive the brutal training program and its extensive mental conditioning - in which their personalities are largely rebuilt from scratch - graduate as Imperial Legionnaires. Their formidable fighting skills, unnerving discipline, and fanatic loyalty to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] make them some of the finest assault troops in the galaxy.

emperor.60.desc.zh:
[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]出于感激，诏令参议院将帝国特许经营权授予[charter_corp.GetName]。这给予他们特殊权力，用以在帝国全境的各处行星上建立分部，而不用和行星的所属国签订商贸协定。

我们可以料想到，这个寰宇企业马上也会在我们下辖的世界上开设分部，建立帝国特许口岸，而我们的司法权在此地不再有效。看来[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]为了拉动经济增长打造了一台强劲的引擎。
emperor.60.desc.en:
After having curried favor with the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], [charter_corp.GetName] has now been granted an Imperial Charter by the Senate. This gives them special dispensation to open branch offices on planets all over the Imperium, regardless of whether they have a commercial pact with the owner.

We can expect the megacorporation to establish Imperial Concession Ports in their branch offices on our worlds soon, where we will have no jurisdiction. It would seem the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has acquired a powerful new engine of economic growth.

emperor.70.a.zh: 无人能逃过帝国的正义的制裁。

emperor.70.desc.zh:
隶属于帝国安全总局的特工正在逐渐部署到帝国境内的所有星球，他们在表面上会协助当地执法部门维护治安，同时暗地里会调查严重犯罪并施加制裁。

帝安局的另一个职能——通过帝国司法部直接向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]负责——是铲除“恐怖分子、叛党和分离主义者”，这些人会在暗地里破坏帝国的稳定和统一。
emperor.70.desc.en:
Agents from the Imperial Security Directorate are in the process of deploying to worlds all over the Imperium, where they will ostensibly aid local law enforcement agencies in the investigation and prosecution of serious crimes.

Another function of the ISD, which reports only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] through the Imperial Ministry of Justice, is to root out "terrorists, rebels, and seditionists" who threaten to undermine the stability of the Imperium.

emperor.72.desc.zh:
随着帝国的崛起，星系刑警组织被重新改组，其名称改变成了帝国安全总局。帝安局的特工们依旧能够将自己的权力扩张到帝国全境，但是他们现在只向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]报告。

尽管帝安局的主要职能的一项依然是在帝国的星球上制裁犯罪，他们现在也负责猎杀那些会威胁到[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的分离主义者、叛乱分子。部分各界人士担忧这个前身为警察组织的部门现在变成了血腥镇压的工具……
emperor.72.desc.en:
With the rise of the Imperium, GALPOL is being reorganized and has changed its name to the Imperial Security Directorate. The jurisdiction of ISD agents still extends across the entire Imperium, but as of now they report only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

While one of the primary responsibilities of the ISD is still to investigate and prosecute crime on Imperial worlds, they are now also used to hunt down seditionists and rebels who would challenge the rule of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Some are voicing concern that the former police organization is turning into a tool of oppression...

emperor.91.desc.zh:
帝国的公民们。我们一起经历了很多的苦难，但是今日帝国面临空前绝后的严峻挑战。我们的星系正被[crisis_country.GetName]威胁——他们与其他敌人不一样——若放任不管，他们将终结我们所知的一切智慧生命。

但是我们的前途并非绝望！星海帝国正在全力进行总动员以驱赶这些入侵者。我们的国家不再在腐朽的共同体下各自为政，而是在全星系有史以来最伟大的帝国的旗帜下团结一致。

在[From.GetRulerTitle]领导下团结起来吧！大战即将来临，但比以往更加强大的星海帝国终会摆脱困境！荣耀就在前方！
emperor.91.desc.en:
Citizens of the Imperium. We have endured much together, but today the Imperium is faced with what may be its greatest challenge yet. Our galaxy is beset by the [crisis_country.GetName] - a foe unlike any other - which if left unchecked will be the end of sapient life as we know it.

But do not despair! The Galactic Imperium is mobilizing its full might to drive back these invaders. Our nations are no longer fractured under a corrupt Community, but united under the banner of the greatest empire the galaxy has ever seen.

Rally to your [From.GetRulerTitle]! A great war is upon us, but the Imperium shall emerge from it stronger than ever! Glory awaits!

emperor.91.title.en: Stand by for Their Imperial Majesty the [From.GetRulerTitle]...

emperor.93.desc.zh:
帝皇陛下，星海正处于前所未有的险境之中。我们的军队正遭受[crisis_country.GetName]的严重威胁。一旦我方被击败，他们一定会吞并帝国的剩余部分！

作为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，保护帝国全体国民是你应尽的职责。我们恳请您即刻出兵！
emperor.93.desc.en:
Your Imperial Majesty, the galaxy is in grave danger! Our forces are beset by the [crisis_country.GetName] and once they are done with us, they will surely overrun the rest of the Imperium!

As the [Root.GetRulerTitle], it is your duty to defend all Imperial citizens. We implore you to send help immediately!

enable_decision_market_nomination.zh: 解锁决议：提名泛星系贸易市场中心
enable_decision_market_nomination.en: Unlocks Decision: Nominate for Galactic Market Hub

enclave.100.a.zh: 面纱后面隐藏着什么秘密？
enclave.100.a.en: What mysteries lie beyond the veil?

enclave.100a.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中潜藏着什么东西：从时空织构中裂出的一个隐秘通道，它的视界泛着灵能的涟漪。探测器的数据飘忽不定，我们的科研船的船员报告了奇怪的干扰：内心深处藏着疯狂的幻境，一种被持续监视的感觉，断断续续的幻觉……

尽管我们很可惜地缺乏有效的遥测手段，但似乎很显然，我们偶然发现了一条通向未知事物的隧道。这是一条危险的路径，但回报可能非常丰厚；在隧道的另一端则连接着星系中一个非常遥远的角落。
enclave.100a.desc.en:
Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, and the crew of our science vessel reports strange disturbances: wildly visceral dreamlike visions, a persistent sense of being watched, fitful hallucinations...

Despite the frustrating lack of useful telemetry, it seems clear we have stumbled on a tunnel through uncharted reaches. A dangerous path, yet the rewards may be great; on the tunnel's far side lies a distant corner of the galaxy.

enclave.100b.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中潜藏着什么东西：从时空织构中裂出的一个隐秘通道，它的视界泛着灵能的涟漪。探测器的数据飘忽不定，但蜂巢已经被扰动了。一种被监视的感觉始终萦绕着我们，这是一种独特的感觉，似乎某物正在隧道的大口另一侧向我们袭来。

尽管我们很可惜地缺乏有效的遥测手段，但似乎很显然，我们偶然发现了一条通向未知事物的隧道。这是一条危险的路径，但回报可能非常丰厚；在隧道的另一端则连接着星系中一个非常遥远的角落。
enclave.100b.desc.en:
Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, but the hive has been disturbed. A persistent feeling of being watched pervades us, the distinct sense that something looms just beyond the tunnel's mouth.

Despite the frustrating lack of useful telemetry, it seems clear we have stumbled on a passage through uncharted reaches. A dangerous path, yet the rewards may be great; on the tunnel's far side lies a distant corner of the galaxy.

enclave.2.desc.zh:
我们正在讨论是否要协助[fleet.GetName]建立一个独立的佣兵城邦。这项提议最先是由舰队司令提出，并且如果通过，将会导致我们失去对舰队的控制权。我们还将负责向他们提供一笔可观的能量币和合金，不过作为回报，他们会给我们一些公司的股份，这将带来定期红利和特权。

他们保证，一旦我们需要，他们将随时准备为我们而战，当然也为我们的钱也可以。
enclave.2.desc.en:
We are debating whether or not to help set up the [fleet.GetName] as an independent Mercenary Enclave. The proposal, first put forward by the fleet commanders, would result in us losing control of the fleet. We would also be responsible for providing them with a sizeable investment in Energy Credits and Alloys. In return, they would give us a number of shares in the company. These would come with periodic dividends and special privileges.

They assure us that in times of need, they will always be ready to fight for us. And our money.

enclave.2000.desc.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们新近的合约有了丰硕的成果。我们扩展了自己的民用业务，现在有好几个公司雇佣我们，让我们提供安保和维和服务。在合约期间，我们的特工碰巧找到了一些有价值的科学研究。你会在定期分红的末尾找到这些附加的内容。
enclave.2000.desc.en: Esteemed Patron, our recent contracts have been fruitful. We have expanded our civilian operations, and several corporations have hired us for a variety of security and peacekeeping services. While on contract, our operatives chanced upon some valuable scientific research. You will find it attached along with your regular dividends.

enclave.2005.desc.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，公司运营的很好，我们的收入一直在稳定的增加。以上是本次分红，此外我们还运来了一批额外的资源，这是我们从一个违约的民用客户手中扣押得到的。
enclave.2005.desc.en: Esteemed Patron, the company is doing well, and our earnings are steadily increasing. Here are your dividends, along with an extra delivery of resources we recovered from a civilian client who defaulted on their payment.

enclave.2010.desc.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们很高兴在这个财报周期宣告自己的利润突破了记录！鉴于此，我们很乐意在常规分红中加入一笔额外的丰厚提成。
enclave.2010.desc.en: Esteemed Patron, we are pleased to announce record profits during this fiscal interval! As such, we have included a generous bonus to your regular dividends.

enclave.2020.desc.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们最近的维和行动成功捣毁了几个海盗组织，我们收缴了一批数量极其丰厚的资源和科技数据。同你的常规分红一起，我们将这批战利品的大部分交付给你。
enclave.2020.desc.en: Esteemed Patron, our latest peacekeeping operation had us dismantle several pirate operations and we recovered an extraordinary amount of resources and technological data. Most of these have been set apart for you, in addition to your well-earned dividends.

enclave.2025.b.zh: 你被解雇了。去董事会领铺盖走人吧。
enclave.2025.b.en: You're fired. See the Board about your severance package.

enclave.2025.desc.zh:
尊敬的赞助者，公司现在处于困难时期。我们失去了好几个民用客户，并且几个其他的行动也遭遇失败，损失惨重。我们设立了一个重组计划，将会削减董事会的开销，此外我们也会向社会输送一批人才，让我们的雇员灵活就业。

请放心，我们会不知疲倦地将你的分红挣回来，这样的不幸只是暂时的。
enclave.2025.desc.en:
Esteemed Patron, the company is going through difficult times. We lost several civilian clients, and various of our other operations ended in costly failures. We are setting up a restructuring plan that will cut expenditures across the board, and we will be letting some of our staff go.

Rest assured that we worked tirelessly to bring you your dividends, and that this misfortune is only temporary.

enclave.2030.desc.zh: 我们的后勤服务能够帮助你部署舰队，到达星系的最边缘处。我们干练的专家将确保你的舰船配备了所有需要的东西，无论是弹药还是食物，甚至精确到你的温度管理器所需的铆钉。此外，我们会在舰队经过之处提前部署补给仓库，或者同当地的民用公司签订配给合同。你的舰船值得最高级的维护，而我们就是为此提供服务的。
enclave.2030.desc.en: Our logistic support service is there to help you deploy your fleets to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Our dedicated experts will make sure that your ships are equipped with all they need, from ammunition to food, down to the last bolt on your temperature regulators. Additionally, we will set up supply depots ahead of the fleet, or broker provisioning contracts with local civilian companies. Your ships deserve the best care, and we are here to provide it.

enclave.2035.a.zh: 我们现在不需要这项服务了。
enclave.2035.a.en: We don't need this service right now.

enclave.2035.desc.zh:
亲爱的客户，

我们向你提供的后勤支援服务已经到期，需要续约了。根据我们合约的条款：如果我们没有另外收到相关指示，你方将自动续约这项服务，并被收取相关费用。

我们相信你对我们的服务很满意，也期待能和你在业务上展开更多的合作。
enclave.2035.desc.en:
Dearest client,

The Logistic Support service we provide you is due for renewal. As per the terms of our contract: if we do not receive prompt instructions to do otherwise, you will be automatically billed for renewal of this service.

We trust that you are satisfied, and look forward to doing more business with you!

enclave.2040.a.tt.zh: 我们将同这个太空城邦分享自己的科技。只能每10年进行一次。
enclave.2040.a.tt.en: We will share our technology with this enclave. This can only be done once every 10 years.

enclave.2040.desc.zh: 你想要分享自己的科技？亲爱的赞助人，你的信任让我们倍感荣幸。尽管我们的研发部门一直致力于让我们处于尖端科技水平，论及能够动用的资源总量，同你相比我们还是捉襟见肘。任何你同我们分享的知识都能让我们以最讲伦理的方式继续开展活动。
enclave.2040.desc.en: You want to share your technology? Your trust in us is an honor, dear patron. While our R&D department is committed to keeping us on the bleeding edge of research, we simply cannot mobilize the same amount of resources as you. And any knowledge that you share with us will be used to develop our activities in the most ethical manner!

enclave.205.a.zh: 我们打算租借一支舰队。
enclave.205.a.en: We wish to rent a fleet.

enclave.205.b.zh: 我们打算管理我们租借的舰队。
enclave.205.b.en: We wish to manage our rented fleet.

enclave.205.c.zh: 我们想征募雇佣驻防部队。
enclave.205.c.en: We are interested in setting up Mercenary Garrisons.

enclave.205.d.zh: 我们想帮你们部署一支规模更大的舰队。
enclave.205.d.en: We want to help you field a bigger fleet.

enclave.205.d.timeout.zh: 这个太空城邦正在招募新的官员和船员。他们在[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.upgraded_station_timer]之前无法进一步部署后勤改善方案。
enclave.205.d.timeout.en: The enclave is recruiting new officers and crew. They cannot field further logistical improvements until after [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.upgraded_station_timer].

enclave.205.desc.zh:
欢迎！[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]向我们的客户提供最尖端的安全服务。我们与许许多多星球签订了民间协约，包括个人安保或执法部门训练。

不过对于我们的高级客户，我们致力于提供最极致的服务。舰队、陆军、军事顾问……你可以有许多用于维系和平的选项。当然，价格合理。
enclave.205.desc.en:
Welcome! [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] offers state of the art security services to our customers. We have civil contracts across multiple worlds, ranging from personal security details to training drills for enforcers.

But for our high profile clients, we aim to provide the best of the best. Fleets, armies, military advisors... A range of peacekeeping options is available. For a modest fee of course.

enclave.205.desc.hostile.zh:
啊，战争贩子回来了。

你终于想清楚你这些毫无意义的行为是徒劳的了吗？这是一点小意思，谨表对你善意的回馈，我们[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]愿意将这些分歧暂时搁置。让我们一起期待一个有利可图的未来。
enclave.205.desc.hostile.en:
Ah, the warmonger returns.

Have you finally come to your senses and seen the futility of these pointless actions of yours? For a small sum, a mere token of your goodwill, we at the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] are willing to put these disagreements aside. Together, let us look forward to a profitable future.

enclave.205.e.zh: 我们正在寻找对付强大敌人的战术洞察力。
enclave.205.e.en: We are looking for tactical insight into formidable foes.

enclave.205.f.zh: 我们打算雇佣地面部队。
enclave.205.f.en: We wish to hire ground troops.

enclave.205.g.zh: 你们可以提供什么后勤方案？
enclave.205.g.en: What logistical solutions can you offer?

enclave.205.g.tooltip.zh: 我们已经在接受后勤协助。
enclave.205.g.tooltip.en: We are already receiving logistical assistance.

enclave.205.h.zh: 作为你们的赞助者，我们想了解我们的可选项。
enclave.205.h.en: As your Patron, we want to review our options.

enclave.205.tooltip.a.zh: 没有其他帝国正在出租他们的舰队。[event_target:current_client.GetName]目前正在出租他们的舰队。
enclave.205.tooltip.a.en: No other empire is renting their fleet. The [event_target:current_client.GetName] is currently renting their fleet.

enclave.205.tooltip.aa.zh: 没有其他帝国在出租他们的舰队。
enclave.205.tooltip.aa.en: No other empire is renting their fleet.

enclave.205.tooltip.b.zh: 他们目前没有准备好战斗的舰队。
enclave.205.tooltip.b.en: They currently have no battle ready fleet.

enclave.205.tooltip.bb.zh: 他们拥有一支准备好战斗的舰队。
enclave.205.tooltip.bb.en: They have a battle ready fleet.

enclave.2050.a.tt.zh: 我们有£time£60天时间来决定我们是否雇佣他们。
enclave.2050.a.tt.en: We have £time£ 60 Days to decide if we want to hire them or not.

enclave.2050.b.zh: 我们现在负担不起。或许以后吧。
enclave.2050.b.en: We cannot afford it now. Maybe later.

enclave.2050.b.tt.zh: 我们有£time£7天时间来决定我们是否雇佣他们。
enclave.2050.b.tt.en: We have £time£ 7 Days to decide if we want to hire them or not.

enclave.2050.c.zh: 叛徒！贪婪将使他们倾覆。
enclave.2050.c.en: Traitors! Their greed will be their downfall.

enclave.2050.desc.zh: 我们收到了来自[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的一份紧急公报。他们说[khan_country.GetName]提供给了他们一个不容许拒绝的提议。他们唯一的出路是在两个月内找到另外一位雇主。如果没有人雇佣他们，他们将不得不为大汗效力，在别无选择的情况下对我们发动全面战争。
enclave.2050.desc.en: We have received an urgent communique from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]. They say that the [khan_country.GetName] made them an offer they cannot refuse. Their only way out of the deal is to find employment elsewhere within two months. If no one hires them, they will enter the service of the Khan and have no choice but to wage total war against us.

enclave.2050.name.en: A Deal We Should Not Refuse

enclave.2060.desc.zh: 我们同[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的合约已经到期，他们的舰队即将离开。我们是否应该联络他们进行合同续约？
enclave.2060.desc.en: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

enclave.210.desc.zh:
棒极了！招募一支[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]舰队永远是正确的选择。我们的部队绝对是星系中最训练有素、纪律严明的，而我们的科技也处于绝对尖端。海盗、叛军或者其他需要你处理的乌合之众会很快学会什么叫尊重。

此外，我们的每一支舰队都由一位身经百战的舰队指挥官，这是不需要额外付费的。他们知悉星际战争的方方面面，一定可以带领你的军队走向胜利。
enclave.210.desc.en:
Excellent! Recruiting a [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] fleet is always the right choice. Our forces are amongst the best-trained and most disciplined in the galaxy, and our tech is cutting edge. Pirates, insurgents, and any other rabble you might have recourse to deal with will soon learn to show respect.

 Additionally, each of our fleets comes with a battle-proven Commander at no extra charge. Adept in all facets of interstellar warfare, they will surely lead your forces to victory.

enclave.211.desc.zh: 我相信你一定会运用好你的新部队，而和平将很快回到你的帝国！
enclave.211.desc.en: I trust that you will put your new troops to excellent use, and that peace will soon return to your empire!

enclave.215.a.en: We'd like to discuss another matter.

enclave.215.b.en: We wish to extend our contract.

enclave.215.c.en: We wish to terminate our contract.

enclave.215.desc.zh: 你是想终止还是延长合同？我们得先准备必要的文件。目前我方正在开展一项促销活动，续签合同的客户将收到一箱免费手榴弹作为赠礼！
enclave.215.desc.en: Do you wish to terminate or prolong a contract? Let us prepare the necessary documents. We are currently running a promotion where customers receive a complimentary crate of grenades for every renewed contract!

enclave.220.desc.zh:
我们的驻防部队能够表现出非凡的价值，但是请牢记，在[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]我们避讳用“雇佣军”这个词称呼他们。这个词太直白，带有太多的负面联想。我们的“国防承包商”已经准备好对你的空间站进行布置，以迎接这些“安全专家”。在我们就绪后，这些专家将开始训练空间站的成员，以使他们发挥自己最好的水平。

在[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]，我们只专心训练最杰出的和平卫士。
enclave.220.desc.en:
Our garrisons offer exceptional value. However, please keep in mind that at [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] we frown upon the term 'mercenary.' The word is too blunt, and carries far too many negative associations. Our 'defense contractors' are standing by to prepare your station for the arrival of our 'safety specialists.' Once we're on site, these specialists will begin drilling the station crew to bring out their best. 

 At [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] we aim to train only the finest peacekeepers.

enclave.225.desc.zh: 感谢你的生意。与你合作维护星系的安全，这让我们倍感骄傲。
enclave.225.desc.en: Thank you for your business. We are proud to work with you to make the galaxy a safer place.

enclave.235.1.desc.zh: 有了这些资金，我们可以极大地扩大我们的行动。更多的舰船，更多的人员，更加庞大、完善的训练设施……我们可以在维护和平这方面做的更多。
enclave.235.1.desc.en: With these funds, we could greatly expand our operation. More ships, more personnel, bigger and better training facilities... We would be able to do so much more to help keep the peace.

enclave.235.2.desc.zh: 在这样一个诡谲多变、纷繁复杂的星系，安全考虑是至高无上的。你的捐赠能让我们的行动和服务更上一层楼！
enclave.235.2.desc.en: In an ever-changing and complex galaxy, security concerns are paramount. Your donation would allow us to scale up our operations and services !

enclave.235.3.desc.zh: 想象一下：[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]为了各类民事和军事行动部署在整个星系……对所有人来说，前所未有的安全感……
enclave.235.3.desc.en: Just imagine: [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] deployed all across the galaxy for civilian and military operation... An unprecedented level of security for all...

enclave.235.4.desc.zh: 当我们开始这一切的时候，我们成立者中的一位怀揣着梦想：我们的存在是为星系带来安全，正如寰宇企业的存在是为了消灭不平等。今天，我很兴奋地宣布我们的这一目标已经触手可及。
enclave.235.4.desc.en: When we started this, one of our founders had a dream: to do for galactic security what megacorps have done for inequality. Today, I am excited to say that this goal is within our reach.

enclave.235.5.desc.zh: *我们会在整个星系部署最为庞大的舰队！资金会流动起来。平民们会安享他们应得的稳定。国家会为我们的合同大打出手……噢，当我告诉股东们新闻时，真该看看他们的脸！
enclave.235.5.desc.en: *We will field the LARGEST fleet in the galaxy! Credits will flow. Civilians will finally enjoy the stability they deserve. Nations will fight for our contracts... Oh the face of our shareholders when I tell them the news!

enclave.240.desc.zh: 是啊。对所有人来说这些都是令人忧心忡忡的时刻。我们的战略问题解决团队在创建更为安全的星系方面有着坚定不移的道德导向和毫不动摇的奉献精神。我们冒着极大的危险近距离监测新出现的危险事物，并且可以为你提供赖以行动的情报。你想要的是……
enclave.240.desc.en: Yes. These are concerning times for all. Our team of strategic problem solvers has a steadfast moral compass and unwavering dedication to creating a safer galaxy. We took great risks to closely monitor the emergence of new perils and can provide you with actionable intel about...

enclave.245.desc.zh: 可汗的舰船总体上结构完善，没有明确弱点。我们的分析人士建议称鱼雷或许可以较好地击落他们的舰船，但要留意避免被针对防御。把护盾和装甲结合起来大概是保护你们舰船的最佳策略。可汗已然是极有能力的指挥官，低估他会是严重的错误。要把可汗的亲卫视作莫大的威胁才对。
enclave.245.desc.en: The Khan's ships present an overall well rounded composition, with no clear weakness. Our analysts suggest that torpedoes might perform well to take their ships down, but caution against specialized defense. A mix of both shields and armor is probably your best bet to keep your ships alive. The Khan has proven to be an extremely competent commander and underestimating them would be a terrible mistake. Consider their retinue as an extreme menace.

enclave.25.desc.zh: 我方舰队已经成功瓦解了位于[merc_system.GetName]星系中佣兵们的抵抗，他们的基地也一并四分五裂。随着剩余的[FROM.GetName]相继崩溃，他们的残留舰队也随之解散。尽管部分还活着的舰长们沦落为海盗，但另一些则是宣称他们将计划继续提供一些小型合约服务，像是提供后勤支持或者是保卫空间站。但这样的小事无关紧要，重要的是，佣兵城邦已经不复存在，我们能够从它的残骸中打捞到相当数量的资源。
enclave.25.desc.en: Our fleet has overcome the defenses of the mercenaries in [merc_system.GetName], and their station has been blown to pieces. The rest of the [FROM.GetName] collapsed quickly after, and their remaining fleets have disbanded. While some of the surviving captains may turn to piracy, others have announced their plans to honor smaller contracts, offering logistical support or space station garrisoning. But such trifling affairs are of little consequence. The important fact is that the Mercenary Enclave is no more, and from its wreckage we have been able to salvage a sizable amount of resources.

enclave.250.desc.zh: 灰蛊风暴依赖两类互为补充的武器：能量束和舰载机。前者受护盾反制，但护盾会被舰载机绕过。我们的预测模型显示在护盾的基础上安装点防御可以大大提升舰船在交战中生还的概率。纳米舰船的防护极佳，但鱼雷或许能突破它们的防御。
enclave.250.desc.en: The Gray Tempest relies on two complementary weapon types: energy beams and strike craft. The former is countered by shields, but shields are bypassed by their strike craft. Our projections show that ships fitted with point defense in addition to shields have a much better chance to survive the engagement. Nanite ships are extremely well protected, but torpedoes might help in breaching their defenses.

enclave.255.desc.zh: 索林原虫舰队靠着速度缓慢的动能武器和大群小型舰船打垮敌人。选项之一是用点防御御敌，结合以装甲和提升过的船体恢复力；另一个选项是远距离交战。使用足够强力的能量武器，你可以做到在敌人进入其攻击距离前就摧毁它们的舰队。
enclave.255.desc.en: Prethoryn fleets rely on slow moving projectiles and hosts of smaller ships to take down their foes. One option to fend them off is to use point defense, coupled with armor and improvements to your ship's hull resilience; another is to engage them at extreme range. With sufficiently powerful energy weapons, one might manage to destroy their fleets before they can even get in range.

enclave.26.desc.zh: 有消息传来，[mercenary_destroyer.GetName]日前在[merc_system.GetName]星系中摧毁了一个佣兵城邦。由于进攻者过于强大，[FROM.GetName]独木难支，他们的董事会，兵营以及船坞均被摧毁。不久后佣兵舰队也随之解散，因为各位舰长都只能自谋生路了，但其中一部分代表声称他们仍将尽力履行公司在后勤以及恒星基地防卫的合约。
enclave.26.desc.en: Word has reached us that a Mercenary Enclave has been destroyed by the [mercenary_destroyer.GetName] in [merc_system.GetName]. The aggressors proved too strong for the [FROM.GetName] to face on their own, and the station housing the Board, barracks, and their shipyards was destroyed. The mercenary fleet disbanded shortly after, as every captain was left to fend for themselves, but some representatives have stated that they will honor the company's contracts in logistics and starbase garrisoning as best they can despite the dissolution of the Company.

enclave.260.desc.zh: 破界者单纯靠能量战斗是我们可以利用的明显弱点。能对其护盾造成额外伤害的武器都会有摧枯拉朽的效果，不过如果装上可以完全绕过护盾的武器的话，它们在这个次元同样活不了多久。就防御而言，建议在战斗中带好护盾，以充分反制敌人的能量束。
enclave.260.desc.en: The Unbidden's exclusive reliance on energy gives us an obvious weakness to exploit. Weapons dealing extra damage to their shields should prove devastating, but if you can fit weapons that completely bypass their shields, they won't be long for this dimension. Defensively, you should look at bringing your own shields to the fight to adequately counter their energy beams.

enclave.265.desc.zh: 肃正协议的舰船单纯使用能量武器——如此一来，最好用护盾降低承受的伤害。模拟结果表明尽管肃正协议舰船防御很高，但其船体相对脆弱。我们的分析人士估计称穿透性武器可能会在与肃正协议的战斗中表现出色。
enclave.265.desc.en: Contingency ships exclusively use energy weapons- as such, it is best to use shields to mitigate incoming damage. Simulations indicate that despite having strong defense, their ship's hulls are relatively fragile. Our analysts estimate that penetrating weapons might perform very well against them.

enclave.266.desc.zh: 塞塔娜的舰船依赖于远距离、高伤害的能量武器和坚固的再生装甲。他们擅长击落大型目标，所以你最好用成群的小型飞行器骚扰他们。鱼雷或能量武器应该足以对抗她的舰队，为你的舰船装备足够的护盾可以让他们生存更长时间。
enclave.266.desc.en: Cetana's ships rely on long range, high damage energy weapons and sturdy regenerating armor. They are adept at taking down large targets, and you would do well to instead harass them with swarms of smaller crafts. Torpedoes or energy weapons should perform adequately against her fleets, and shielding your vessels might help them survive a little longer.

enclave.27.b.mindwarden.zh: 我们下次应该好好读读合同条款各项细则。
enclave.27.b.mindwarden.en: We should have read the small print.

enclave.27.desc.zh:
尊敬的客户：

由于目前遭受攻击，我们迫切需要召回自己的舰队。根据合同第285b条，我们的舰队将在收到通知后立即停止为您服务。不过一旦我们将这一不幸的局势处理完毕，我们就将恢复我们的合作关系，并对由此带来的不便表示歉意。
enclave.27.desc.en:
Dear valued client,

As we currently find ourselves under attack, we have urgent need to recall our own forces. As per our contract, we will immediately enact clause 285b.15, and our fleet will leave your service as soon as this notice reaches you. We look forward to renewing our partnership once this unfortunate situation is resolved, and apologize for any inconvenience.

enclave.27.desc.mindwarden.zh:
刚刚我们收到了[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]发来的讯息：

[root.GetName]，

我们目前正遭受攻击，必须立刻召回己方武装。根据合约相关条款，[mercenary_fleet.GetName]将即刻停止为您服务。

我们相信，您能够理解当前我方局势之紧迫与召回武装之必要。
enclave.27.desc.mindwarden.en:
We have received communication from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]:

[root.GetName],

We are under attack, and must therefore recall our own forces immediately. In accordance with our contract, the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will leave your service forthwith.

We trust that you will understand the urgency of this situation and the necessity of our actions.

enclave.270.b.zh: 一小股机械化精英佣兵。
enclave.270.b.en: A small force of elite mechanized mercenaries.

enclave.270.d.zh: 一组机械化精英佣兵部队。
enclave.270.d.en: A strike group of elite mechanized mercenaries.

enclave.270.desc.zh: 打算平定某个殖民地或是根除恐怖分子？我们的行星际支援服务能够成建制地提供训练有素的专业人士，他们时刻准备着在具有挑战性的高风险环境下工作，帮助您为星系带来秩序。
enclave.270.desc.en: Looking to pacify a colony or uproot terrorists? Our planetside support services offer companies of trained professionals, ready to work in challenging and high-risk environments to help you bring order to the galaxy.

enclave.280.a.desc.zh: 尊敬的赞助人！您今天来此有何贵干？您看过我们最新的船只设计图了吗？它们将是我们为民用客户提供的全新“个人安全”服务的核心。
enclave.280.a.desc.en: Esteemed patron! What business brings you to us today? Have you seen our latest ship schematics? They will be the core of our new 'Personal Security' offer for civilian customers.

enclave.280.b.zh: 我们想让你召回你的舰队。
enclave.280.b.en: We want you to recall your fleet.

enclave.280.b.desc.zh: 能够招待你是何等的荣幸！我们已经准备了一些小食，希望我们在召集董事会的时候，这些小食能够聊表敬意。如果你将注意力转到窗户，我会看到我们的一支维和部队正在进行演练。训练的假人代表平民。请注意他们是如何将平民召集起来，并妥善安排的。在军事上一丝不苟，实在是奇迹。
enclave.280.b.desc.en: What a pleasure to receive you! We have prepared some refreshments, should it please you to sample them while we summon the Board. If you direct your attention to the window, you'll see one of our peacekeeping divisions engaged in maneuvers. The training dummies represent civilians. Note how efficiently they round them up and handle them. A marvel of military precision.

enclave.280.c.zh: 我们乐于同你分享我们的科技。
enclave.280.c.en: We are inclined to share our technology with you.

enclave.280.c.desc.zh: 我们一直以来都很乐意同赞助人会面。请放心，下一批红利很快就会发到你的手中。你介不介意和我们聊一聊，你对于我们在严重后果保护领域展开的新业务的范围有什么看法？我们觉得民用客户肯定会爱死这些服务了！
enclave.280.c.desc.en: We are always delighted to meet our patrons. Rest assured that the next dividend shipment should reach you shortly. Would you care to tell us what you think about our range of new services in high consequence protection? We think our civilian clients will love them!

enclave.280.c.timeout.zh: 这个城邦还在利用我们的科技进行升级。我们可以在[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.updating_databanks_timer]之后与他们分享新的科技。
enclave.280.c.timeout.en: The enclave is still upgrading with our tech. We can share new technologies with them after [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.updating_databanks_timer].

enclave.285.desc.zh:
你应该明白召回舰队是一件相当敏感的事情。当然了，我们已经在所有合同模板中准备好了条款漏洞，不过我们至少需要六个月的时间来调遣舰队回来，而且还需要支付一大笔补偿以避免惹恼现有客户。

我们认为这一行动不符合我们组织的最佳利益，但您是我们的赞助人——如果您愿意，我们愿意效劳。
enclave.285.desc.en:
You certainly understand that recalling a fleet is a sensitive matter. We have of course prepared the necessary loopholes in all our standard contracts, but we will need at least six months to bring the fleet back, and a... generous compensation to avoid upsetting our current customers.

We believe that this course of action is not in the best interests of our organization, but you are our patron - we'll make it happen if you wish it so.

enclave.290.desc.zh: 我们征用的佣兵舰队现已听候调遣。
enclave.290.desc.en: The Mercenary Fleet that we commandeered from our enclave is awaiting orders.

enclave.294.desc.zh:
亲爱的客户，

依照我们的合约中第285b.15条款，我们必须遗憾地通知你，我们计划提早关闭相关服务，并收回你从我们这里租借的舰队。依照合同的惯常条例：这份通知将提前三个月送达你处作为提醒，然后我们才会让舰队停止向你提供服务。此外，我们会向你提供应得的丰厚补偿金。

我们为造成的不便感到抱歉，并希望你在未来的打拼中能够继续拥有好运气。
enclave.294.desc.en:
Dearest client,

As provisioned by clause 285b.15 of our contract, we must regrettably bring our arrangement to an early close and recall the Mercenary Fleet that you rented from us. As per contract stipulations: this notice serves as your 3-month warning before the fleet must leave your service. We enclose the generous compensation to which you are entitled.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

enclave.305.a.zh: 我们想要拆解一支舰队。
enclave.305.a.en: We'd like to scrap a fleet.

enclave.305.a.desc.zh:
很高兴与您相识！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦简陋的星际工坊。

诶呀…我在哪儿都能认出龙骨上的那些东西——制作的很精致。我们有着跟踪星系中飞船设计的习惯，试着同当地风潮保持一致。不过我刚刚讲到哪儿…？

啊，对了：欢迎您！请问我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
enclave.305.a.desc.en:
Pleased to make your acquaintance! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our humble, interstellar workshop.

Say... I'd recognize those keel fixtures anywhere - some fine work. We make a habit of keeping up with what's flying in the galaxy, try to keep up with local trends. But where was I..?

Ah yes: welcome! How can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs?

enclave.305.b.zh: 你们现在有什么样的翻新船只？
enclave.305.b.en: What reclaimed vessels do you have?

enclave.305.b.desc.zh:
您好，您好！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦的维修场。不论船体、引擎、蓝图还是配件：我们都有存货。

我可不是开玩笑——人们在老旧飞船里扔下的东西会让你大吃一惊的。最近我刚入[salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]了一套完整的厨房单元，用黄金铸成的。爽到。

扯远了，请问我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
enclave.305.b.desc.en:
Hello, hello! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our salvage yard. Hulls, drives, blueprints, fittings: we stock it all.

I'm not even joking - you'd be amazed what people leave inside their old ships. Just recently I laid my [salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural] on an entire galley unit, cast in gold. Wild.

Anyway, how can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs?

enclave.305.c.zh: 给我们说说维修工坊建筑吧。
enclave.305.c.en: Tell us about Salvage Works buildings.

enclave.305.c.desc.zh:
向您致以敬意！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦的工坊和废品场。大批专职工程师已经就绪，准备好维修、重建或是拆建几乎任何他们可以用工具鼓捣的东西。您会发觉我们对贸易的激情可谓永无止境。

请问今天我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
enclave.305.c.desc.en:
Salutations! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our workshop and scrapyard. Legions of dedicated engineers stand ready to repair, rebuild, and tear down just about anything they can latch a tool onto. You'll find our passion for the trade is quite insatiable.

How can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs today?

enclave.305.d.zh: 你们能在建造方面援助我们吗？
enclave.305.d.en: Can you aid us with construction efforts?

enclave.305.desc.hostile.zh:
嗯嗯嗯，我们之前见过你们这群家伙……

我们跟你们没什么可说的，也没什么服务愿意提供的。麻利地滚一边去吧。
enclave.305.desc.hostile.en:
Hmm, we've met your ilk before...

We have nothing to say to you, nor any services to offer. Kindly be on your way.

enclave.305.desc.scavenger_first.zh:
欢迎！我很乐意同一些打捞业的同行会面——要知道，星系这个地方对我们来说老寂寞了呢。

你知道训练内容——我们将别人觉得没有任何用处的老旧部件收集到一起，然后赋予它们全新的生命。如果遇到任何用你的[Root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]搞不定的事情，放轻松，我们会过来接手的。

那么，我们有什么能够为你的打捞和开荒事业提供便利的呢？
enclave.305.desc.scavenger_first.en:
Welcome! I sure am glad to meet some fellow scavengers - the galaxy can be a lonely place for those like us.

You know the drill - we gather together old parts that no one sees any use for, and breathe new life into them. If there's anything you can't get your [Root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] on, rest assured, we will have it.

Anyway, how can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs?

enclave.305.desc.scavenger_followup.zh: 向你问好！你是否对于运营一个帝国已经感到了厌烦？我可以加入我们的捡垃圾事业——完全没有那么多压力，你肯定可以玩得转的。
enclave.305.desc.scavenger_followup.en: Greetings! Have you gotten bored of running an empire yet? You could join us in the scrapping business - it's much less stressful, and you clearly have the knack for it.

enclave.305.e.zh: 我们想要打捞一些残骸。
enclave.305.e.en: We'd like you to salvage some debris.

enclave.305.f.zh: 你们能援助我们的工程学研究吗？
enclave.305.f.en: Can you help us with engineering research?

enclave.305.n.desc.zh: 很高兴又见面了，我们这里可是忙的很。贵国最近的各种事务处理的还好吗？我敢说我们现在还是一如既往的喧闹。空闲的[salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]在处理过时的殖民船这方面可是很有一套的。
enclave.305.n.desc.en: Hello again! Busy times, these - I trust your empire's affairs are running smoothly? I dare say we're all abuzz here, as usual. Idle [salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural] make fast work of outdated colony ships...

enclave.305.o.desc.zh:
您好！我们今天又该怎样满足你们的工程需求呢？

呃，你们船身钢板上安装的玩意儿挺有意思，它们用起来效果如何？
enclave.305.o.desc.en:
Greetings! And how might we serve your engineering needs today?

Hmm, curious hull plate fixtures you have there - how are they working out for you?

enclave.305.organic.desc.zh:
很高兴再次见到你！不要介意这些破铜烂铁，还有那些呻吟的声音。我们，呃……有朋自远方来！它们正在长身体；而且经常会有一点……饿肚子。很少有人知道，它们会以这样的速率重新长出那些鞭毛！

呃咳。打扰了。我该如何帮助你？
enclave.305.organic.desc.en:
Great to see you again! Don't mind those scraping and moaning sounds. We have, uh... Guests, at the moment! They're a bit on the larger side; tend to get a bit... Hungry. And little wonder, at the rate they're regrowing those flagella!

Ahem. Excuse me. How can we help you?

enclave.305.p.desc.zh:
欢迎回来！嘿，来看看这些崭新丝滑的引擎怎么样吧！我真诚希望我们能对您维护舰船的方式做一些微小的贡献；它们会为此感谢您的。

那么我们如何为您效劳？
enclave.305.p.desc.en:
Welcome back! And hey, get a load of those smooth, new drive signatures! I do hope we're managing to impart some small, positive influence on the way you maintain your ships; they'll thank you for it.

How can we be of service?

enclave.305.q.desc.zh:
你好啊！别介意……只是在对这个工业级的全息发射器进行一些修修补补。这些，非常令人捉迷的装置。这可是我的拿手项目，研究这玩意究竟能够投影一个多大的全息图像。这甚至不及你将其投影到太空中的一半困难，看见没。

啊，我一开口能跑火车好几年呢。我该如何为你效劳？
enclave.305.q.desc.en:
Hello! Don't mind me... Just been tinkering with this here industrial holo-emitter. Fascinating devices, these. It's a pet project of mine, to see how large a hologram it could actually project. Not half as difficult when you're beaming one out into space, see.

Ah, but I could prattle on for ages. How can we be of service?

enclave.310.a.zh: 谢谢告知。我想问问其他服务……
enclave.310.a.en: Good to know. About your other services...

enclave.310.desc.zh:
太棒了！真的很高兴能能从您的手中接过这份差事。

根据我们的扫描仪，您有下列舰队处于可选范围之内。在附件中可以查看估价，现在请您做出选择吧。

$enclave.310.instructions$
enclave.310.desc.en:
Splendid! It would be our pleasure to take that off your hands.

According to our scanners, you have the following fleets within range. You'll find our estimates attached; the choice is now yours!

$enclave.310.instructions$

enclave.310.nofleet.desc.zh:
当然了！我们的服务一向直接明了：开一支舰队到[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]来，然后和我们打一声招呼。只要我们确认了您是舰队的主人，就能给出估价清单。随后我们就会接管舰队，您也能马上得到回收后的材料。

噢，不过切记：不要把别人的东西带过来拆解了！我们不想因此吃一遍苦头，可不能再翻车了……

$enclave.310.instructions$
enclave.310.nofleet.desc.en:
Of course! Our service is straightforward: bring a fleet in here to [salvager_enclave_system.GetName], and give us a hail. Once we verify ownership, we can provide you with a list of estimates. We'll then take possession, and your reclaimed materials will be with you in no time.

Oh, also: no scrapping of others' merchandise! We do not want to suffer through the kind of conflict that can bring up - not again, at least...

$enclave.310.instructions$

enclave.310.organic.desc.zh:
棒极了！那将是我们的荣幸……星辰在上，那是什么呀？！你居然称那是一艘舰船？我是说，我能够找到它是怎么……哇哦，它看上去可真是凶巴巴的。拜托了，千万不要冲动行事！我们能够从你那里接手活生生的“舰船”，但恐怕我们必须收取清洁费用。

根据我们的扫描，你的以下舰船位于范围之内。你能在附件里找到我们的预估；现在由你来做决定了！

$enclave.310.instructions$
enclave.310.organic.desc.en:
Splendid! It would be our pleasure to... By the stars, what is that?! You call that a vessel? I mean, I can see how it... Wow, it's a mean-looking thing. Please, don't do anything hasty! We can take living 'ships' off your hands too, but I'm afraid we must charge a clean-up penalty.

According to our scanners, you have the following fleets within range. You'll find our estimates attached; the choice is now yours!

$enclave.310.instructions$

enclave.315.desc.zh: 谢谢！您应得的回收材料马上就到。
enclave.315.desc.en: Thank you! Your reclaimed materials will be with you shortly.

enclave.320.b.tt.zh: 购置一艘采取[salvager_reclaimed_corvette_country.GetName]曾使用过的设计的$CORVETTE$。
enclave.320.b.tt.en: Purchase a $CORVETTE$ of a design once used by the [salvager_reclaimed_corvette_country.GetName].

enclave.320.bb.tt.zh:
购置一支包括10艘采取[salvager_reclaimed_corvette_country.GetName]曾使用过的设计的$corvette_plural$小型编队。

这得让打捞者忙活好一阵子，2年内我们无法再购置其他翻新船只。
enclave.320.bb.tt.en:
Purchase a small fleet of 10 $corvette_plural$, of a design once used by the [salvager_reclaimed_corvette_country.GetName].

This will occupy the Salvagers for some time; we will be unable to purchase other reclaimed ships for 2 years.

enclave.320.c.timeout.en: Another $DESTROYER$ will be available for purchase after [root.salvager_destroyer_timer].

enclave.320.c.tt.zh: 购置一艘采取[salvager_reclaimed_destroyer_country.GetName]曾使用过的设计的$DESTROYER$。
enclave.320.c.tt.en: Purchase a $DESTROYER$ of a design once used by the [salvager_reclaimed_destroyer_country.GetName].

enclave.320.d.timeout.en: Another $CRUISER$ will be available for purchase after [root.salvager_cruiser_timer].

enclave.320.d.tt.zh: 购置一艘采取[salvager_reclaimed_cruiser_country.GetName]曾使用过的设计的$CRUISER$。
enclave.320.d.tt.en: Purchase a $CRUISER$ of a design once used by the [salvager_reclaimed_cruiser_country.GetName].

enclave.320.desc.zh:
太神奇了！舰船破破烂烂进来，完完整整出去。目前有以下几种类型可选。

要知道每艘我们翻新的舰船在出售后都享受钢铁三包。在船坞中翻新后，我们相信这些船只肯定开的比原装出厂时还舒服。

不过请记住：翻新相当耗时。在把一支舰队完整翻新之前，我们是没法卖船给您的。所以您也许需要日后再与我们联系。
enclave.320.desc.en:
Marvelous! When a busted-up ship comes our way, we work hard to restore it back to working life. Right now we have the following types available.

Know that every vessel we reclaim is sold under our Durasteel Guarantee. We're confident these ships will run more smoothly now than back when they were shipyard-fresh!

Just bear in mind: reclamation is a time-consuming process. We cannot provide you an entire squadron without having to restock afterwards, so you may need to check back with us in future.

enclave.320.e.timeout.en: Another $BATTLESHIP$ will be available for purchase after [root.salvager_battleship_timer].

enclave.320.e.tt.zh: 购置一艘采取[salvager_reclaimed_battleship_country.GetName]曾使用过的设计的$BATTLESHIP$。
enclave.320.e.tt.en: Purchase a $BATTLESHIP$ of a design once used by the [salvager_reclaimed_battleship_country.GetName].

enclave.320.frigate.tt.zh: 购置一艘采取[salvager_reclaimed_frigate_country.GetName]曾使用过的设计的$frigate$。
enclave.320.frigate.tt.en: Purchase a $frigate$ of a design once used by the [salvager_reclaimed_frigate_country.GetName].

enclave.320.frigate_bulk.tt.zh:
购置一支包括10艘采取[salvager_reclaimed_frigate_country.GetName]曾使用过的设计的$frigate_plural$小型编队。

这得让打捞者忙活好一阵子，2年内我们无法再购置其他翻新船只。
enclave.320.frigate_bulk.tt.en:
Purchase a small fleet of 10 $frigate_plural$, of a design once used by the [salvager_reclaimed_frigate_country.GetName].

This will occupy the Salvagers for some time; we will be unable to purchase other reclaimed ships for 2 years.

enclave.320.timeout.desc.zh:
不论什么样的破船进到我们这来，我们都会尽全力使其焕发活力。不过现在我们的码头仓库里似乎空荡荡的。

请晚些时候再来，到时候再看看我们有什么能帮您的。每次翻新大概需要花上我们2年左右。
enclave.320.timeout.desc.en:
Well, whenever a busted-up ship comes our way, we work hard to restore it back to working life. Unfortunately it appears our docks are empty at the moment!

Please return later, and we'll see what we can do for you. It usually takes us around... 2 years for a complete set of refurbishments.

enclave.330.b.tt.zh: 允许使用$sm_salvager_workshop$恒星基地建筑，降低驻港舰队维护费并加快修理速度。
enclave.330.b.tt.en: Enables the $sm_salvager_workshop$ starbase building, reducing upkeep and speeding up repairs for docked ships.

enclave.330.desc.zh:
当然了！只要您腾出给我们工作的地方，我方机械师就能随时关注当地的船只维修状况。

我们会准备好维修工坊模块所需的各种材料，让您可以将其安装到紧邻我方的恒星基地上。基地的模块槽位也许需要进行调整，不过一旦我方工程师成功建立工坊，你们就能将船只开进来维修。每隔一段时间，我们还能在贵国疆域内为您进行建造搭把手。

所以，听上去怎么样？这样的维修工坊还合您的意吗？
enclave.330.desc.en:
Certainly! You give us space to work, and our mechanics can fast-track your local ship repairs in no time.

We'll fix you up with all you need to attach a Salvage Works module onto the starbase adjoining ours. You may need to shift around a bulkhead or two, but once our engineers have a place to set up shop, your ships will be flying right through those repair bays! We can even help out with your construction efforts empire-wide, every once in a while.

So, how about it: does a Salvage Works take your fancy?

enclave.330.lowopinion.desc.zh:
当然！我们向最信任的客户们提供一个特殊的机会。简而言之：您给我们在[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]恒星基地工作的空间，我们的机械师就可以紧跟您当地的舰船维修工作。我们甚至可以为您恒星基地和船坞所进行的建设搭把手，全帝国范围内都行！

如果您感兴趣的话，我们很乐意进一步讨论这件事……等到我们的合作关系更加牢固之后。希望您能理解。
enclave.330.lowopinion.desc.en:
Certainly! We extend a special opportunity to our most trusted customers. In short: you give us space to work aboard a starbase here in [salvager_enclave_system.GetName], and our mechanics can fast-track your local ship repairs. We can even help out with your starbase and shipyard construction efforts, empire-wide!

If that's of interest to you, we'll be happy to discuss the matter further... once we feel more sure of this working relationship. We hope you understand.

enclave.335.desc.zh:
当然！我们的技术人员一直在努力工作，制定雄心勃勃的新工作计划，我们很荣幸能为您提供限时的生产力增幅。

我们将把您的维修工坊拨到高速档，替您所有恒星基地上的工程回收再利用零部件！我们甚至有一些锦囊妙计来帮助您生产舰船。这应该是有用的！大概~

请记住，此类工作是有代价的；我们无法经常提供帮助。
enclave.335.desc.en:
Of course! Our mechanics have been hard at work devising ambitious new work plans, and it would be our pleasure to extend to you a limited-time frenzy of productivity.

We'll put that Salvage Works of yours into high gear, reclaiming and repurposing parts for projects on all your starbases. We even have a few tricks up our sleeves to help you produce ships, in case that should be useful!

Bear in mind that work like this takes its toll; we shan't manage this often.

enclave.336.desc.zh:
再次向你致敬！我很高兴地宣布，我们已经准备好卯足力气将事业提升到一个新的高度，让打捞工作真正务有所值。

你有什么想法？准备好在你所有的恒星基地加快舰船建造了吗？
enclave.336.desc.en:
Hello again! I'm pleased to say we're ready to kick things back into a higher gear, and get that Salvage Works to really earn its keep.

What do you say? Ready to speed up shipbuilding across all your starbases?

enclave.340.a.desc.zh:
真是相当庄严的召唤啊。听到舰队在战斗中被击沉，我们的痛苦超乎您的想象，但太空中的生活是残酷的，有些事情不可避免。

……请原谅我的遐思。毫无疑问，那是我们能提供的服务。

$enclave.340.main.desc$
enclave.340.a.desc.en:
A most solemn calling. It pains us more deeply than you can know to hear of ships stricken in battle, but life is harsh out here in the vacuum, and needs must.

... Please, forgive my reverie. Absolutely, that is a service we can provide.

$enclave.340.main.desc$

enclave.340.b.desc.zh:
唉。所以，严酷的真空已经吞噬了更多船只……当然，我们很乐意从您所说的悲惨战场上回收一些积极的东西。

$enclave.340.main.desc$
enclave.340.b.desc.en:
Alas. So, the harsh vacuum has claimed more ships... But of course, we will gladly attempt to reclaim something positive from this tragic battle you speak of.

$enclave.340.main.desc$

enclave.340.b.tt.zh: 我们将无法进入至多3处残骸场。[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]将在90天内将回收的技术或材料交付给我们。
enclave.340.b.tt.en: We shall lose access to up to 3 debris fields. The [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] will deliver salvaged technology or materials to us within 90 days.

enclave.340.lowopinion.desc.zh:
我为打捞工作最悲哀的原因而哀叹：战斗。请原谅我，[root.GetRulerTitle]，我们有理由对这样的破坏表示哀悼。不过，我们确实可以承接打捞工作。但这是我们向更为熟络的客户提供的服务。

有需要的时候请来找我们，我们将处理属于你们的残骸场。我们会用在那里发现的任何材料和工程知识来补偿您。
enclave.340.lowopinion.desc.en:
Alas for that most sorrowful cause of salvage: battle.

You'll have to forgive me, [root.GetRulerTitle]; we have our reasons for mourning such willful destruction. However, for our regular customers we can indeed handle salvage under commission.

Return to us later, and when the need arises. We will undertake to deal with debris fields you have claim to, and shall compensate you for whatever materials and engineering knowledge we find out there.

enclave.340.nodebris.desc.zh:
啊，是的，战斗：这是打捞的最悲哀的原因……您得原谅我，[root.GetRulerTitle]；野蛮的毁灭不会给我们带来欢乐。然而，我们明白这是不可避免的。如果你们的船不愿或不能筛查残骸，我们的确可以承接打捞工作。

有需要的时候请来找我们，并赋予我们打捞的权利。我们会用在那里发现的任何材料和知识来补偿您。
enclave.340.nodebris.desc.en:
Ah yes, battle: that most sorrowful cause of salvage...

You'll have to forgive me, [root.GetRulerTitle]; barbaric destruction brings us no joy. However, we understand that needs must. We can indeed handle salvage under commission, if your ships are unwilling or unable to sift through the debris.

Come to us when need arises, and grant us the rights of salvage. We will then undertake to compensate you for whatever materials and knowledge we find out there.

enclave.341.desc.zh: 谢谢您！打捞权看来在按部就班地转让；回收工作进展顺利。我们将很快联系您。
enclave.341.desc.en: Thank you. The transfer of salvage rights looks to be in order; the claim is good. We'll be in touch soon.

enclave.342.desc.zh: 噢！我很抱歉这么说，你的这堆破烂玩意好像在我们的谈话期间已经劣化的不像样子了。即使是我们也缺乏足够的技能将已经坏了这么久的残骸复原。啊呀，这是我们的老对手，熵，在趁势反击呢！
enclave.342.desc.en: Oh! I'm sorry to say, it looks as though those debris fields of yours have deteriorated over the course of our conversation. Even we lack the skills to recover a wreck which has been left that long. Alas, our old foe entropy strikes again!

enclave.345.desc.zh:
这将是我们的荣幸！清闲的[salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]头脑灵活，这对我们来说意义非凡！我们将非常乐意伸出援手并与我们的老顾客分享一些实用的技巧，毕竟我们的生意可是受您照顾有加。

我们也会感谢您用于支持我们简陋的恒星基地的任何捐赠！老旧的船体可以多次改造，不过有时候，崭新熔炼的舱壁的可靠性无可匹敌。
enclave.345.desc.en:
It would be our pleasure! Idle [salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural] make curious minds, and that counts double for us! We are most happy to lend aid and share handy tips with our regular customers - so long as our modest expenses are covered.

We would also appreciate any donation you can make to help shore up our humble starbase! Old hulls can be repurposed many times over, but sometimes there's just no beating the reliability of a freshly-smelted bulkhead.

enclave.346.desc.zh:
你好，朋友！我们多年以来的合作研究一直进行得不错。我听说的是，我们的几位工程师采纳了一些来自你方的建议，同时你也采纳了一些我们得建议！

然而，当初达成的合约时间已经到期了，我们也希望让这些思维活跃的学徒们重新回到我们家里面做些事情……也就是说，除非你愿意再多给我们一点补偿，让他们再留一阵子？
enclave.346.desc.en:
Hello, friends! Our years of collaborative study have really whisked by. The way I hear it, a few of our engineers have picked up a few tips from you, as well as you from us!

However, the agreed upon time has now elapsed and we could use those keen-minded apprentices of ours back at home... That is, unless you're willing to compensate us for a while longer?

enclave.350.desc.zh: 作为我们长期客源的一员，我们自然很乐意派遣一名专家来督导你的打捞工作，只需要付很少的价钱。一开工就能拖到一大串新近烧焦的残骸，这个作为欢迎仪式想必很合适。
enclave.350.desc.en: As one of our more regular customers, we would certainly be willing to send someone to oversee your scrapping efforts, for a small cut. It will be a welcome diversion to trawl freshly-charred wrecks.

enclave.350.desc.not_available.zh: 我们为自己的长期客源提供服务，会派遣一名督工协助改进你的打捞工作，只需要付很少的价钱。不幸的是，我们现在没有可供派遣的督工——他们现在简直是供不应求，恐怕我们一些其他的客户享有优先权。
enclave.350.desc.not_available.en: We offer our regular customers the services of an overseer who can improve your scrapping efforts, for a small cut. Unfortunately, none of our overseers are available at the moment - they are in high demand, and I'm afraid some of our other customers take priority.

enclave.360.a.desc.zh:
$enclave.360.intro$

打捞人员随货附上了一封感谢信，以及一份有形的礼物——某种动态艺术品。它在我们人工重力场中运动的方式令人不安，但也相当迷人。
enclave.360.a.desc.en:
$enclave.360.intro$

The Salvagers enclosed a message expressing their thanks, as well as a tangible gift - some form of kinetic artwork. The way it moves within our artificial gravity fields is unnerving, and yet quite captivating.

enclave.360.b.desc.zh:
$enclave.360.intro$

货运员代表打捞者们不住地表示着感谢，直到他在我们货运拖船的发动机遮罩前怔住。很遗憾，在卸货之前，我们必须强行赶走这位激情满满、充斥着好奇心的狂热人士。
enclave.360.b.desc.en:
$enclave.360.intro$

The courier was relentless in expressing thanks on behalf of the Salvagers - that is, until they became transfixed by the engine housings on our own cargo tugs. This impassioned and deeply curious enthusiast had to be forcibly removed before any unloading of cargo could commence.

enclave.360.c.desc.zh:
$enclave.360.intro$

被货物围绕在中间的是一个蓝图的数据库，尽管画得很急，但是每一个细节都很到位。看上去这份作品的作者，要么对于自己的发现十分兴奋，要么就是在研究某种教育形式的图表。

不管是哪一种，[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]已经将此人的研究呈递给我们使用，并送上了自己的赞美。
enclave.360.c.desc.en:
$enclave.360.intro$

Enclosed amongst the cargo is a database of blueprints, hastily-drawn yet quite thorough in their detail. It appears to be the work of someone who was either very excited by their find, or else was studying the schematics as some form of education.

Either way, the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] has presented their studies for our use, with their compliments.

enclave.360.d.desc.zh:
$enclave.360.intro$

货运员看上去很紧张；看得出来此人巴不得去跑其他的差事。这个鬼灵精怪的[salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]看上去急着要把给我们的食物供给品一股脑弄走。确实，这些送到手上的食物包装非常精美——几乎就像是在某些地方制造出来的替代品一样。
enclave.360.d.desc.en:
$enclave.360.intro$

The courier appeared quite nervous; visibly keen to resume some other errand. This skittish [salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] seemed in a particular hurry to divest the food supplies we have been owed. Indeed, these morsels come to us surprisingly well-packaged - almost as though a substitution has been made somewhere...

enclave.360.e.desc.zh:
$enclave.360.intro$

货运员看上去很紧张；看得出来此人巴不得去跑其他的差事。这个鬼灵精怪的[salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]很谦恭地将那些本次打捞路途上收获的各类蓝图交到我们手上。然而，在运送食物供给品的时候，场面出现了明显的匆忙。

确实，尽管未经证实，有人看见类似长相的太空生物最近出现在了[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]星系内……
enclave.360.e.desc.en:
$enclave.360.intro$

The courier appeared quite nervous; visibly keen to resume some other errand. This skittish [salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] was courteous enough in handing over various blueprints they say came their way during the course of this salvage. There was, however, some apparent urgency behind their delivery of food supplies.

Indeed, there have been unconfirmed sightings of familiar-looking, spaceborne creatures in the [salvager_enclave_system.GetName] system of late...

enclave.365.d.zh: 呼叫他们！只要他们想要残骸，我们要多少给多少。
enclave.365.d.en: Hail them! We have more debris they could handle.

enclave.365.desc.zh:
一艘发自从[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]的快递驳船已经满载各种蓝图和一小批资源抵达！所有这些都是从残骸中打捞回收的。

这艘驳船的领航员除了对我们的惠顾表示礼貌的感谢外很少说话。交接现场的气氛十分严肃。
enclave.365.desc.en:
A courier barge has arrived from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], carrying various blueprints and a small consignment of resources. All were reclaimed from debris salvage.

The pilot of this barge spoke little, other than to express polite thanks for our custom. The handover was treated with a great deal of solemnity.

enclave.375.desc.zh: 我们在[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻是一次反响斐然的成功。[FROM.GetName]被摧毁，所剩无几的幸存者逃向了深空。由于他们的设施被毁于一旦，他们那可怜巴巴的服务也成为了过去式。星系里再也没有这帮子人的踪影了。
enclave.375.desc.en: Our offensive in the [salvager_system.GetName] system was a resounding success. The [FROM.GetName] is destroyed, and the few remaining survivors have scattered to the void. With their facilities in ruin, their petty services are a thing of the past. The galaxy is well rid of them.

enclave.380.desc.zh: 我们收到报告，[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的[FROM.GetName]太空城邦被毁。袭击者来去无影，一瞬间就把打捞者的设施变成了一堆废墟。所剩无几的幸存者四散逃离，看来，现在整个星系要学会习惯于没有他们提供服务的新生活了。
enclave.380.desc.en: We have received reports that the [FROM.GetName] Enclave in the [salvager_system.GetName] system has been destroyed. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Salvagers' facilities to rubble. The few remaining survivors have scattered, and it appears that for the time being the galaxy will have to make do without their services.

enclave.405.a.en: What is to be our fate?

enclave.405.b.zh: 你们愿意从教团里派遣一位导师过来吗？
enclave.405.b.en: Would you be willing to send us a teacher from your order?

enclave.405.c.zh: 你能给我们一些有关其他帝国的见解吗？
enclave.405.c.en: Can you give us insight on another empire?

enclave.405.c.tt.zh: 我们需要至少与[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]有20£opinion£评价才能要求对方提供洞见。
enclave.405.c.tt.en: We need at least 20 £opinion£ Opinion with the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] in order to ask for an Insight.

enclave.405.c.tt.2.zh: 我们需要一个正在运转的间谍网，才能要求[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]对我们的秘密行动筹备提供指导。
enclave.405.c.tt.2.en: We need an active Spy Network to be able to ask the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] to guide our clandestine efforts.

enclave.405.d.zh: 告诉我们通过虚境穿行的方法。
enclave.405.d.en: Tell us about travel via the Shroud.

enclave.405.d.tt.zh: 我们需要至少与[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]有30£opinion£评价才能询问虚境信标事宜。
enclave.405.d.tt.en: We need at least 30 £opinion£ Opinion with the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] in order to inquire about the Shroud Beacon.

enclave.405.desc.end_of_the_cycle.zh:
“你唤醒了远超你理解的恐怖，它宣告了星系的末日。

我们不愿去面对这样的疯狂事物。离我们远点！”
enclave.405.desc.end_of_the_cycle.en:
"You have awoken horror far beyond your understanding, and with it have doomed this galaxy.

We are unwilling to court madness itself. Be gone from us!"

enclave.405.desc.mindwardens.zh:
你可真是名过其实。

我们拒绝与畏惧虚境之人共商大计。你们对宇宙的狭隘认知终将令我们所有人固步自封。
enclave.405.desc.mindwardens.en:
Your reputation precedes you.

We shall hold no counsel with those who fear the Shroud. Your limited vision of the cosmos will chain us all to the ground.

enclave.405.desc.mindwardens_trust.zh:
[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的无知偏见毒害了你的思想。多么讽刺啊……

我们绝不会与和那些蠢货有染的人共商前途。
enclave.405.desc.mindwardens_trust.en:
The ignorant prejudices of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] have poisoned your mind. What irony...

We will hold no counsel with those who hold such ties with fools.

enclave.405.e.zh: 你能教我们如何开采泽珞吗？
enclave.405.e.en: Could you teach us how to harvest Zro?

enclave.405.e.tt.zh: 我们需要至少与[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]有50£opinion£评价才能询问泽珞开采事宜。
enclave.405.e.tt.en: We need at least 50 £opinion£ Opinion with the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] to ask about Zro harvesting.

enclave.405.f.zh: 我们遇到了一个自称是“面纱旅人”的人……
enclave.405.f.en: We met someone claiming to be a Veilfarer...

enclave.405.g.tt.zh: 在我们打开一处星界裂隙之前需要先满足与[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的评价大于50£opinion£。
enclave.405.g.tt.en: 50 £opinion£ Opinion with the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] is required before we can open an Astral Rift.

enclave.405.generic.a.desc.zh:
啊哈！一位来访者。欢迎欢迎。

我们是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]。在这个自虚空诞生的舱室里，我们的女巫集会谈论着凡人所费解的力量。我们思索着潜藏梦境中的秘密、探寻着原始灵能的贮藏地、凝视着驱动整个文明的无形齿轮……虚境对于聆听者，揭示良多。

此时此刻，我聆听于你。什么风把你吹来了？你已知否？
enclave.405.generic.a.desc.en:
Ah! A visitor. Welcome.

We are the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Within this void-borne hull, our coven communes with forces incomprehensible to most mortal minds. We contemplate the secrets that lie hidden in dreams, reservoirs of untapped potential, the unseen gears driving whole civilizations... The Shroud reveals much to those who would listen.

At this moment, I listen to you. What brings you to us? Do you yet know?

enclave.405.generic.n.desc.zh: 欢迎回来，来访者。我们等候多时。
enclave.405.generic.n.desc.en: Welcome back, visitor. We have been waiting.

enclave.405.generic.o.desc.zh: 许多文明都讲述着同样的故事，在过于幽深的矿洞里潜伏着黑暗的存在。那么来访者，请问你是否好奇过，在我们层层的现实之下隐藏着什么?
enclave.405.generic.o.desc.en: So many civilizations tell the same kind of story, of dark things lurking in mines dug too deep. Tell me, visitor: have you ever wondered what lurks beneath the stratified layers of our reality?

enclave.405.generic.p.desc.zh:
我们都知道一句谚语:
“被风吹进来的东西终将被雨冲出去。”
对于许多居住在短命行星上的居民来说，算是慰藉之辞……

在被我们称为虚境的世界里，可没有这样的天气。
enclave.405.generic.p.desc.en:
There is a saying known to us:
"What is blown in by the wind will be washed out by the rain."
Comforting words for many a short-lived planet-dweller...

The realm we call the Shroud knows no such weather.

enclave.405.h.tt.zh: 在我们开放心灵之前需要先满足与[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的评价大于90£opinion£。
enclave.405.h.tt.en: 90 £opinion£ Opinion with the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] is required before they will assist us in opening our minds.

enclave.405.hostile.a.desc.zh: 闯入者，你的敌意就像恶臭的瘴气一样笼罩着自己。我们是和平的集会，但你要知道：如果你想让我们遭受苦难，你会发现这种愚蠢的行径将以十倍奉还。我们是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]，尽管我们看似鞭长莫及，但我们的愤怒将会毁天灭地。
enclave.405.hostile.a.desc.en: Interloper, your hostility precedes you like a foul miasma. We are a peaceful coven, but know this: if you intend to inflict harm upon us, you shall find such folly visited back upon you tenfold. We are the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], and though our reach may appear lacking, our wrath is devastating.

enclave.405.i.zh: 我们将探索虚境的灵妙。
enclave.405.i.en: We seek mastery of the Shroud.

enclave.405.psionic.a.desc.zh:
啊哈，是不可知世界的旅伴！我们[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]欢迎你并视你为朋友。

请原谅这种低劣的沟通方式。我们所践行的强烈的灵能祷告，恐怕只能基于可畏的心灵感应屏障和通路而施行。因此，我们只能从物质世界中接收思想之一瞥。

所以我不禁要问：是什么风把你吹来的?
enclave.405.psionic.a.desc.en:
Ah, fellow sojourners of the unknowable! We, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] welcome you and name you friends.

Please forgive this inferior means of communication. The intense, psionic devotions we practise may only be conducted from behind fearsome telepathic barriers and conduits. Thus, we may only receive glimpses of thought from the corporeal realm.

So it is that I must ask: what brings you to us?

enclave.405.psionic.n.desc.zh: 那么，我们的旅伴回来了！很高兴再次看到你。我们等候多时。
enclave.405.psionic.n.desc.en: So, the sojourners return! It is pleasant to see you again. We have been waiting.

enclave.405.psionic.o.desc.zh:
在我们[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]坚持的所有信条中，少有比这一条更坚定的：即使地位崇高如我们一般，也肯定能在星海中找到同伴。

那么，我飞升了的朋友：我们能为彼此做些什么？
enclave.405.psionic.o.desc.en:
Of all the tenets we hold to in the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], few are held more dearly than this: even those as elevated as ourselves can be sure of finding our fellows in the galaxy.

So, fellow ascendent one: how may we serve each other?

enclave.410.a.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

enclave.410.desc.zh:
啊哈，一个重要的问题——和前人所问相比，深刻程度可谓不相上下。这么一个问题有不菲的价格，不过我们可以回答。

然而，要知道：虚境允许我们感知尚未发生的事件，而这些知识将帮助指导你们的道路。但任何单一的事件都不足以撼动星系的运转。

如果你有意达成这笔交易，那么相比于拓展抱负，你应该去做更充分的准备。但是，哦，哪怕是对顷刻将至之事的最细微一瞥，都可能建立起什么样的宏伟计划啊……
enclave.410.desc.en:
Ah, a momentous query - no less poignant for being asked by so many before you. Such a question carries a heavy price, but we can provide answers.

Know this, however: the Shroud allows us to perceive events which have not yet come to pass, and this knowledge shall help guide your course. But it is beyond the power of any one event to alter the turning of the galaxy.

If you would strike this bargain, know that your aspirations should extend no further than to be better prepared. But oh, what grand designs may be built upon even the merest glimpse at what is to come...

enclave.415.desc.zh: 虚境在战栗。它在那一刻似乎一言不发，但又诉说了一切。时间的无限之织缕从此时此刻延伸开来，进入了汇合之流。此处，这个地方，前方的道路逐渐明了。预知仪式已经开始了。
enclave.415.desc.en: The Shroud shivers. It speaks without voice and in all voices at once. The infinite strands of time that extend from this moment now enter into confluence. Here, in this place, the path ahead grows clear. The rite of divination has begun.

enclave.415.tt.zh: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]将离开几日以便与虚境长谈。
enclave.415.tt.en: The [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] will retire for a few days in order to commune with the Shroud.

enclave.416.desc.zh: “虚境变得安静了下来。再一次，疲倦的时间之河退回到了它陈腐的航道中。预知仪式昭告的改变已经成为了过去。现在带着敬畏离开，因为你已经映射了虚境的造业。”
enclave.416.desc.en: "The Shroud grows quiet. Once more, the weary river of time recedes into its well-worn course. The changes foretold by the rite of divination have come to pass. Go now in awe as you reflect on the workings of the Shroud."

enclave.420.b.zh: 我们想要一个虚境信标。
enclave.420.b.en: We would like a Shroud Beacon.

enclave.420.desc.zh:
星系十分黑暗，危险无处不在。为了点亮朝圣者的路途，我们提供虚境信标。一旦在你的某个恒星基地上面安装这个，它的光芒可以穿透一切；哪怕是某些人称之为现实的缥缈薄暮。它延伸出来的网道可以穿过虚境，为凡间的舰船跨越巨大的时空前往遥远的距离提供了一种手段。

要谨慎地选择你的信标的位置——虚境隧道一旦生成，就不能被移除，也没有可能再召唤出另一个信标。

你要将以下的话语牢记在心：虚境隧道不是普通的道路，就算是我们也无法预测使用这种手段会有什么后果。
enclave.420.desc.en:
The galaxy is dark, and full of dangers. To illumine the path of wayward pilgrims we offer the Shroud Beacon. Once installed on one of your starbases, its light pierces all; even that thin veil some call reality. The Tunnel it spawns offers a bypass through the Shroud, and a means for corporeal vessels to traverse vast distances through space and time.

Choose the location of your Beacon carefully - once established, a Shroud Tunnel cannot be moved, and no secondary Beacon can call another forth.

You would do well to heed these words: a Shroud Tunnel is no ordinary road, and not even we can foretell all the consequences of such a journey.

enclave.4200.desc.zh: 在黑暗中挣扎了很长一段时间之后，虚境的面纱被揭开了。虽然我们的科学家对虚境信标运作的奇异过程仍然知之甚少，但它的物理系统似乎与灵能纠缠在一起，它的运作几乎像一个活的有机体。它生成的隧道与其说是路线，不如说是近道，为我们的舰船提供了一条通过虚境的超维度捷径。星际探索如今将变得更快……而且更神秘得多。
enclave.4200.desc.en: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Although the strange processes by which the Shroud Beacon functions remain little understood by our scientists, its physical systems appear entangled with psionic energy, its operations almost like those of a living organism. The Tunnel it spawns is more bypass than route, offering our vessels an extradimensional shortcut via the Shroud. Interstellar exploration will now be quicker... and infinitely more mysterious.

enclave.4240.desc.zh: 学徒们，虚境宣昭了警告。巨大的危机近在眼前，整个星系都处在毁灭的边缘。我们的预知显示，我们自身的力量无法匹配即将到来的威胁。与其被毁灭，我们现在将灌输给你们最后一课：所有的幻梦都有苏醒之时。我们离开这个世界的时刻已经到了。尽管虚境十分黑暗，飘忽不定，我们最终将会升往一个新的位面，一个新的世界，在那里继续传播我们的教义。我们将离开这个星系，将它的命运交付给你。希望我们以往的功课能在必要之时为你提供指引。
enclave.4240.desc.en: Apprentices, the Shroud has given warning. A moment of great crisis is at hand, and the galaxy stands on the brink of ruin. Our divinations have shown we are no match for the coming threat. Rather than be destroyed, we now impart our final lesson: every dream has its awakening. The time has come for us to pass beyond this world. Though the paths of the Shroud are dark and winding, we will come at last to a new plane, a new world in which to spread our teachings. We leave this galaxy and its fate to you. May our past lessons be a guide in your time of need.

enclave.4243.b.zh: 我们的命运十分清晰。不要挡我们的道。
enclave.4243.b.en: Our destiny is clear. Do not stand in our way.

enclave.4243.desc.zh: 学徒们，你正在走上一条危险的道路。你以为养育了你们数个世纪的我们会没有注意到吗？我们教导你虚境，是为了启蒙，为了提升。但是这个？力量、暴虐、以及你们亲手酿造的危机。牢记我的教诲！这个宇宙不过是一场幻梦的绰影。为时未晚，赶在你被它毁掉之前，马上放弃这误入歧途的野心。
enclave.4243.desc.en: Apprentices, you walk a dangerous path. Did you think we would not notice, we who have nurtured you for centuries? In teaching you of the Shroud, we hoped to enlighten, to elevate. But this? Power and violence, and a crisis of your own making. Remember your teachings! This universe is nothing but the shadow of a dream. There is still time. Give up this misguided ambition before you are destroyed by it.

enclave.4245.b.zh: 曾经我们是学生。现在轮到我们当大师了。
enclave.4245.b.en: Once we were students. Now we are Masters.

enclave.4245.desc.zh:
虚境自身在战栗，一切迹象都指向毁灭。常年以来我们注视着你，但即便是我们也无法预见你竟愚蠢到如此境地。欲速则不达。心急地攫取力量，那么你注定会失去它。你忘记了最基本的一课：虚境不是能用来开发的资源，而是用来品鉴的谜题。但是学生的覆辙和老师没有关系。相比于目睹你会成为怎样的可憎之物，我们宁愿离开这个世界。尽管虚境的道路黑暗且变幻不定，我们最终会到达一个新的位面，新的世界。或许在那里我们会找到有价值的学生，传达我们的教义。

希望虚境能对你展现仁慈。
enclave.4245.desc.en:
The Shroud itself shivers, and all signs point to ruin. Long have we watched you, but even we could not have foreseen the extent of your folly. Rushing to act, you will falter. In grasping power, it has already been lost. You have fogotten the most basic lesson: the Shroud is not a resource to exploit, but a mystery to be savoured. But the failure of the student rests with the teacher. Rather than witness the horror you will become, we have chosen to depart this world. Though the paths of the Shroud are dark and winding, we will come at last to a new plane, a new world. Perhaps there, we will find apprentices worthy of our teachings.

May the Shroud have mercy on you.

enclave.425.desc.zh: 一阵低语传达至我们的意识：虚境的道路缥缈不定，变换万千。愿这个信标点亮你前行的道路。
enclave.425.desc.en: A saying is known to us: the paths of the Shroud are strange and winding. May this Beacon light your way forward.

enclave.4250.a.en: The galaxy grows ever more dangerous.

enclave.4250.c.zh: 我们应当将它碾碎成尘。
enclave.4250.c.en: We shall grind it into dust.

enclave.4250.d.zh: 如果可能的话，我们要避免任何冲突。
enclave.4250.d.en: If possible, we will avoid any conflict.

enclave.4250.desc.zh: 我们最近在虚境隧道穿越的时候在时空中造成了一个巨大的裂口。前所未有的能级的灵能能量从恒星系中喷涌而出……然后汇聚在一起。传感器数据在涨落，激变，但是它看上去正逐渐成为某种虚境生物。庞大，而且肯定富有侵略性。
enclave.4250.desc.en: Our recent trip through the Shroud Tunnel has precipitated a massive breach in spacetime. Psionic energy at unprecedented levels is spilling out into the system and... It has begun to coalesce. Sensor data is fluctuating, erratic, but it appears to be some form of Shroud spawn. Large, and definitely aggressive.

enclave.435.desc.zh: [shroudwalker_system.GetName]恒星系的大胜利！我们的军队快刀斩乱麻地解决了那些所谓的[FROM.GetName]秘术师。尽管成天对知识和力量夸夸其谈，他们对虚境的愚蠢奉献还是没能预先料知到我们的攻击。事实上，我们的军队很轻易地就破坏了设施的机械化防御。然而，在进入之后，他们发现整个太空城邦人去楼空，只有一个孤独的侍僧在一个偏僻的房室里面进行冥想。剩下的人去了哪里，我们无从得知，但是整个星系这下摆脱了这种空洞的教条。
enclave.435.desc.en: Victory in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system! Our forces made short work of the so-called mystics of the [FROM.GetName]. For all the grand talk of knowledge and power, their foolish devotion to the Shroud could not provide clairvoyance enough to forestall our assault. In fact, our forces easily breached the facility's mechanical defenses. However, once inside, they discovered the enclave empty, save for a lone acolyte they found deep in meditation in a remote chamber. Where the rest have gone, we have no idea, but the galaxy is well rid of such hollow dogma.

enclave.440.desc.zh: 传达的报告主要围绕着[shroudwalker_system.GetName]恒星系发生的[FROM.GetName]的毁灭。侵略者在这次行动中十分迅速，将虚境行者的设施化为一片断壁残垣。很难相信这些秘术大师没有预料到自身的消亡。还是说，这场悲剧仅仅只是某个更庞大计划的一部分？谁又能说得准呢？不过，没有他们的效劳，未来仍然充满重重迷雾。
enclave.440.desc.en: Reports are coming in surrounding the destruction of the [FROM.GetName] in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Shroudwalkers' facilities to rubble. It is strange to think that these mystics could not foresee their own demise. Or could this tragedy be a part of some still grander design? Who can say? Without their services, the future remains shrouded.

enclave.5005a.desc.zh:
$enclave.5005.intro$在快速眼动睡眠开始时，这种药物会刺激使用者的边缘系统，导致一种难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

$enclave.5005.outro$
enclave.5005a.desc.en:
$enclave.5005.intro$ At the onset of REM sleep, the drug stimulates the user's limbic system, resulting in an incredibly visceral state of lucid dreaming.

$enclave.5005.outro$

enclave.5005b.desc.zh:
$enclave.5005.intro$这种药物产生一种类似于睡眠的状态，刺激神经晶体底层产生一种令人难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

$enclave.5005.outro$
enclave.5005b.desc.en:
$enclave.5005.intro$ The drug produces a state similar to sleep, stimulating the neuro-crystalline substratra to produce an incredibly visceral state of lucid dreaming.

$enclave.5005.outro$

enclave.5005c.desc.zh:
$enclave.5005.intro$这种药物产生一种类似于睡眠的状态，刺激神经叶绿体产生一种难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

$enclave.5005.outro$
enclave.5005c.desc.en:
$enclave.5005.intro$ The drug produces a state similar to sleep, stimulating the neural chloroplasts to produce an incredibly visceral state of lucid dreaming.

$enclave.5005.outro$

enclave.5005e.desc.zh:
$enclave.5005.intro$在睡眠开始时，这种药物会刺激视致密层，导致一种难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

$enclave.5005.outro$
enclave.5005e.desc.en:
$enclave.5005.intro$ At the onset of sleep, the drug stimulates the optic tectum, resulting in an incredibly visceral state of lucid dreaming.

$enclave.5005.outro$

enclave.5005f.desc.zh:
$enclave.5005.intro$在睡眠开始时，这种药物会刺激成对的大脑神经节，导致一种难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

$enclave.5005.outro$
enclave.5005f.desc.en:
$enclave.5005.intro$ At the onset of sleep, the drug stimulates the paired cerebral ganglia, resulting in an incredibly visceral state of lucid dreaming.

$enclave.5005.outro$

enclave.5005g.desc.zh:
$enclave.5005.intro$在睡眠开始时，这种药物会刺激食道上神经节，导致一种难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

$enclave.5005.outro$
enclave.5005g.desc.en:
$enclave.5005.intro$ At the onset of sleep, the drug stimulates the supraesophageal ganglion, resulting in an incredibly visceral state of lucid dreaming.

$enclave.5005.outro$

enclave.5005h.desc.zh:
$enclave.5005.intro$这种药物会产生一种类似于睡眠的状态，刺激死灵脑组织产生一种难以置信的清醒做梦的本能状态。

$enclave.5005.outro$
enclave.5005h.desc.en:
$enclave.5005.intro$ The drug produces a state similar to sleep, stimulating the necrotic brain tissue to produce an incredibly visceral state of lucid dreaming.

$enclave.5005.outro$

enclave.5010.desc.zh: 药物“清醒”的使用在[Root.GetName]上继续上升。殖民地当局报告了令人不安的反常度增加，最主动的使用者们出现了严重的精神崩溃。生产力在下降，犯罪率在上升，当地民众没有表现出要戒除成瘾的迹象。
enclave.5010.desc.en: Use of the drug Lucid continues to rise on [Root.GetName]. Colonial authorities report a disturbing increase in deviancy, with the most active users experiencing severe psychotic breaks. Productivity is down, crime is up, and the local populace shows no signs of giving up their habit.

enclave.5015.desc.zh:
我们的科学家在研究“清醒”药物方面有了突破。这种化合物对使用者的身体系统的作用不仅是能促进清醒梦，还能使人产生化学依赖性。每服一次药，对药物的需求就更大。当给药剂量足够大时，就可以观察到大脑内部的量子波动。这些波动与我们对虚境的仅有认知恰好相符。

醒来后，研究对象抱怨出现头痛和幻觉。极端情况会导致致命的大出血。随后的尸检显示，其脑部质量净增加了0.01%。梦本身似乎留下了某种痕迹。

该项目负责人正在申请额外的资源，以更好地了解药物的作用。幸运的是，考虑到对这种化合物的需求，我们并不缺乏志愿者。
enclave.5015.desc.en:
