Our scientists have made a breakthrough in their study of the drug Lucid. The compound's effect on a user's system not only promotes lucid dreaming, but also precipitates a chemical dependency. The need becomes greater each time the drug is taken. When administered at high enough dosages, quantum fluctuations have been observed within the brain. These fluctuations are consistent with what little we know of the Shroud.

After waking, subjects complained of headaches and hallucinations. Extreme cases result in fatal hemorrhaging. Subsequent autopsies reveal a net .01% increase in brain mass. The dreams themselves are apparently leaving behind some kind of residue.

The project's lead is requesting additional resources to better understand the drug's effects. Fortunately, given the demand for the compound, we have no shortage of volunteers.

enclave.5020a.desc.zh: $enclave.5020.intro$每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，不能再自然地进入快速眼动睡眠。$enclave.5020.outro$
enclave.5020a.desc.en: $enclave.5020.intro$ Each had reached a state of physiological dependency, and could no longer enter REM sleep naturally. $enclave.5020.outro$

enclave.5020b.desc.zh: $enclave.5020.intro$每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，这严重损害了他们的神经晶体突触的功能。$enclave.5020.outro$
enclave.5020b.desc.en: $enclave.5020.intro$ Each had reached a state of physiological dependency which severely impaired the function of their neuro-crystalline synapses. $enclave.5020.outro$

enclave.5020c.desc.zh: $enclave.5020.intro$每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，严重损害了神经叶绿体的正常功能。$enclave.5020.outro$
enclave.5020c.desc.en: $enclave.5020.intro$ Each had reached a state of physiological dependency which severely impaired their neural chloroplasts from functioning properly. $enclave.5020.outro$

enclave.5020d.desc.zh: $enclave.5020.intro$每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，这严重损害了他们的神经菌丝体的正常功能。$enclave.5020.outro$
enclave.5020d.desc.en: $enclave.5020.intro$ Each had reached a state of physiological dependency which severely impaired their neural mycelium from functioning properly. $enclave.5020.outro$

enclave.5020e.desc.zh: $enclave.5020.intro$每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，不能再自然地进入睡眠。$enclave.5020.outro$
enclave.5020e.desc.en: $enclave.5020.intro$ Each had reached a state of physiological dependency, and could no longer enter sleep naturally. $enclave.5020.outro$

enclave.5020f.desc.zh: $enclave.5020.intro$每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，这严重损害了他们成对大脑神经节的正常功能。$enclave.5020.outro$
enclave.5020f.desc.en: $enclave.5020.intro$ Each had reached a state of physiological dependency which severely impaired their paired cerebral ganglia from functioning properly. $enclave.5020.outro$

enclave.5020g.desc.zh: $enclave.5020.intro$每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，这严重损害了他们的食道上神经节的正常功能。$enclave.5020.outro$
enclave.5020g.desc.en: $enclave.5020.intro$ Each had reached a state of physiological dependency which severely impaired their supraesophageal ganglion from functioning properly. $enclave.5020.outro$

enclave.5020h.desc.zh: $enclave.5020.intro$每个人都达到了生理依赖的状态，这严重损害了他们的死灵突触的正常功能。$enclave.5020.outro$
enclave.5020h.desc.en: $enclave.5020.intro$ Each had reached a state of physiological dependency which severely impaired their nectrotic synapses from functioning properly. $enclave.5020.outro$

enclave.5025.desc.zh: 来自[Root.GetName]的令人不安的消息：越来越多的死亡报告从使用药物“清醒”的人群中涌现。这种化合物似乎不仅能促进欢欣性做梦，还能促成一种化学依赖。高剂量会导致内出血，最终导致死亡。
enclave.5025.desc.en: Disturbing news from [Root.GetName]: an increasing number of fatalities have been reported among users of the drug Lucid. It seems the compound not only promotes euphoric dreaming, but also precipitates a chemical dependency. High enough doses result in internal hemorrhaging and eventually, death.

enclave.5030.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]继续广泛使用药物“清醒”。尽管罪犯会受到严厉的惩罚，但越来越多的人开始认为梦境中的欢欣状态比醒来的生活更可取。即使结果是自己的死亡，他们也不会被吓倒。[Root.GetName]的稳定度继续下降。
enclave.5030.desc.en: Widespread use of the drug Lucid continues on [Root.GetName]. Despite the harsh penalties being meted out to offenders, a growing number of our people have come to view the euphoric dream state as preferable to waking life. Even if the result is their own death, they will not be deterred. Stability on [Root.GetName] continues to decline.

enclave.5035.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]与“清醒”相关的死亡人数继续上升。然而，随着社会条件的恶化，越来越多的人转向毒品以寻求逃避。如果事情继续这样下去，我们有失去殖民地的危险。
enclave.5035.desc.en: The number of Lucid-related deaths on [Root.GetName] continue to rise. However, as societal conditions worsen, more and more people are turning to the drug for escape. If things continue like this, we are in danger of losing the colony.

enclave.5055.desc.zh:
[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]所预示的变化降临了：在一次意想不到的灵能波动之后，[Root.GetName]在虚境中迷失了。时空本身如荡漾着的巨浪一般涌起，卷起那艘舰船。几秒钟后，它继续发送遥测数据。数据中包括一段失真的船员录像，他们的身体时时刻刻不断变化，扭曲成奇怪的新形状。

从那以后，这艘船的残像或“幽灵”在整个星域乍隐乍现。研究这一现象可以让我们更好地理解这艘船和船员的命运。
enclave.5055.desc.en:
The change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived: after an unexpected spike in psionic fluctuations, the [Root.GetName] was lost to the Shroud. Rising up like a great, rippling wave, spacetime itself curled over the ship. For several seconds afterwards, it continued to transmit telemetry. This included a garbled recording of the crew, their bodies shifting from moment to moment, distorting into strange new forms.

Since then, an afterimage or 'ghost' of the vessel has fleetingly appeared throughout the sector. Studying the phenomenon should allow us to better understand the fate of the ship and its crew.

enclave.5055.poi.desc.zh: 我们的舰船在虚境中消失之前的最后已知位置。
enclave.5055.poi.desc.en: Last known location of our vessel lost to the Shroud.

enclave.5060.desc.zh: 我们有在虚境迷失的科研船的最新消息。在整个恒星系中出现的残像并不是飞船本身。相反，我们的科学家将其描述为一个“概念性物体”。这艘“概念之船”以灵能蓝图的形式存在，没有维度。根据观察者的心理状态，船的形式会断断续续、变化无常。研究这一现象有助于我们更好地理解感知与时空之间的联系，但我们并没有离找回最初的飞船更进一步。目前来说，我们只能认为它在虚境里迷失了。
enclave.5060.desc.en: We have an update on the science vessel lost to the Shroud. The afterimage that has been appearing throughout the system is not the ship itself. Instead, our scientists describe it as a 'conceptual object.' Possessing no dimensions, this 'ship as concept' exists as a psionic blueprint. Depending on the mental state of the observer, the ship's form will stutter and change. While studying the phenomenon has helped us to better understand the connections between perception and spacetime, we are no closer to retrieving the original ship. For now, we must consider it lost to the Shroud.

enclave.5065.desc.zh:
我们那艘一度被认为永远迷失在虚境之中的失踪科研船突然又出现了。虽然船的尺寸发生了微妙的改变，船体本身和其中的船员仍保有良好的状态。

船员们把在虚境里的经历描述成类似一场光怪陆离、支离破碎的梦境的东西。随着时间的推移，他们慢慢发现自己可以与周围的环境共筑成一种“共同概念”。随着他们的自我感知逐渐重整，这些船员们一点一点地重回到我们的现实世界。就实际效果而言，他们成功梦到自己重新存在了。
enclave.5065.desc.en:
Our missing science vessel, once thought lost to the Shroud forever, has suddenly reappeared. Although the dimensions of the ship have been been subtly altered, the vessel and its crew are in good shape.

Describing their experience in the Shroud as something akin to a strange, fragmentary dream, over time the crew was able to forge a 'shared concept' of themselves and their environment. As their individual perceptions began to align, the crew inched ever closer to our reality. In effect, they have succeeded in dreaming themselves back into existence.

enclave.5075.a.zh: 极端主义者在这里没有一席之地。把这个流亡者弄走。
enclave.5075.a.en: Extremists have no place here. Remove the exile.

enclave.5075.b.zh: 对拜访视而不见是不明智的。好好盯着这个流亡者。
enclave.5075.b.en: Ignoring a visitation is unwise. Keep an eye on this exile.

enclave.5075.c.zh: 以宾客的规格欢迎这位流亡者。
enclave.5075.c.en: Welcome the exile as a guest.

enclave.5075.desc.zh: 一位[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡者来到了[Root.GetName]。由于信奉异端思想，这位“极端主义者”从城邦中被流放了出来，结果没有在任何到来的船只上登记显现。它直接出现在殖民地大型城市的中央广场，就好像空气突然物质化了一样，然后公开地宣告自己的信条能让它同虚境建立个人通讯。根据这个流亡者的说法，我们的人民可以通过共享梦境实现一种赐福状态。报告指出，殖民地里有很多人都听信了这个说法。
enclave.5075.desc.en: An exile from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived on [Root.GetName]. Recently expelled from the Enclave for harbouring heretical views, this 'extremist' was not listed on the manifest of any incoming vessel. As if materializing out of the air, they appeared in the central square of the colony's largest city, publicly proclaiming a doctrine of personal communion with the Shroud. According to the exile, it is possible for our people to achieve a state of bliss akin to communal dreaming. Reports suggest that many in the colony are listening.

enclave.5076.a.zh: 必须想办法阻止这个流亡者。

enclave.5076.desc.zh: 尽管我们做了最大的努力，在[Root.GetName]上行动的那个[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]流亡分子依然在躲避着我们。或许是拥有什么先天的灵能能力，它总是可以在我们的安保部队到达之前进行预判。除此之外，流亡者的布道还在吸引大量的群众。许多殖民者都放弃工作，以响应这个所谓的萨满所拥护的洗礼和冥想实践。
enclave.5076.desc.en: Despite our best efforts, the exiled member of the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] operating on [Root.GetName] continues to elude us. Perhaps due to some innate psionic ability, they have consistently been able to predict the arrival of our security forces. What's more, the exile's sermons continue to draw large crowds. Many colonists have begun to abandon their work in favor of the various ablutions and meditative practices espoused by this so-called shaman.

enclave.5077.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的安保部队成功地消灭了那个流亡的萨满。这个流放者前信徒中的一名——一位没能实现应许的梦境状态而逐渐心生不满的殖民者——向我们提供了必要的情报。普罗大众似乎接受了现实，然而，一小撮顽固分子似乎仍然抱守着萨满的教义。到目前为止，对这个殖民地增添安保人员似乎是有道理的，这样可以让人们对这位“殉道者”的尊敬逐渐消散褪去。
enclave.5077.desc.en: Security forces on [Root.GetName] have successfully eliminated the rogue shaman. One of the exile's former adherents - a colonist who has grown increasingly disaffected by their failure to achieve the promised dream state - has provided us with the necessary intel. While the general populace appears to have accepted reality, an obstinate few remain dedicated to the shaman's teachings. For now, an increased security presence on the colony seems advisable, lest the veneration of this 'martyr' continue to fester.

enclave.5080.desc.zh: 流亡萨满的教义继续在[Root.GetName]上的人群内传播。这种激进的教条是某种能够让个人同虚境沟通的宗派，其践行者宣称能够实现一种改变意识的状态。我们收到许多报告，称极乐与康宁的感觉有所提升。其中一些人甚至宣称，通过某种共享的、梦境一般的状态，他们能够使用灵能同其他人沟通。不幸的是，这些“真信者”引发了一波创纪录的离职潮。生产力受到了很大的打击。
enclave.5080.desc.en: The teachings of the exiled shaman on [Root.GetName] continue to spread throughout the populace. This radical doctrine is one of personal communion with the Shroud, and its practitioners claim to have achieved an altered state of consciousness. We are receiving reports of increased feelings of euphoria and well-being. Some individuals even claim they are now able to psionically communicate with one another through a shared, dreamlike state. Unfortunately, these 'true believers' are also leaving their jobs in record numbers. Productivity has taken a hit.

enclave.5081.desc.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了惊人的新闻：那个流亡萨满宣称自己的业绩已经完成，明显已经离开了殖民地。报告很零散，且并不明确，但所有报告都同意一点，即在带领信徒进行了最后一次冥想之后，这位萨满就那样从殖民地的中心广场凭空消失了。对于那些信徒来说，这就是萨满“飞升”进入虚境的证据。
enclave.5081.desc.en: Startling news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: proclaiming their work done, the exiled shaman has apparently left the colony. Reports are scattered and inconclusive, but they all agree that after leading their followers in a final meditation, the shaman simply vanished from the colony's central square. To their followers, this is evidence of the shaman's 'ascension' into the Shroud.

enclave.5082.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的事态有了奇怪的进展：在那个流亡萨满进行了所谓的“飞升”之后，我们的殖民者报告他们经历了一种意识的转换状态。这些人继续遵从萨满所推崇的仪式，现在已经能够进入一种灵能交流的状态。这种状态在殖民者间涌现出极大的欢愉和宁和，产生了深远的影响。
enclave.5082.desc.en: Strange developments on [Root.GetName]: after the so-called 'ascension' of the exiled shaman, our colonists are reporting the experience of an altered state of consciousness. Continuing to follow the practices espoused by the shaman, these individuals are able to enter a state of psionic communion. The outpouring of joy and well-being this has produced amongst the colonists is profound.

enclave.5090.c.zh: 异种在我国境内没有容身之地。
enclave.5090.c.en: Xenos have no place inside our borders.

enclave.5090.desc.zh:
一艘载满了来自[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡侍僧的运输船同我们进行了联络。他们称自己为“变革派”，要求在我们的某颗星球上进行难民庇护。

这一事件意味着虚境行者内部发生了前所未有的大分裂。看来，太空城邦也没有我们想象中的那么团结。
enclave.5090.desc.en:
We have been contacted by a transport ship carrying a number of exiled acolytes from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Calling themselves 'Reformers', they are requesting refuge on one of our worlds.

This represents an unprecedented schism within the Shroudwalkers. It would appear the Enclave is not as united as we were led to believe.

enclave.5095.desc.zh: “虚境惊诧。我们收到消息，听说我们的一些前侍僧已经作为难民在你的星球安顿下来。这一作为让我们极其不悦，但就这样吧。鲁莽的行动一般都会导致绝望的后果。但是要记住这点：这些改革派不过是一群坑蒙拐骗之徒，一群无知的蠢蛋，以为自己掌握着破解虚境秘密的钥匙。庇护这群异端会让你冒风险。那些居住在虚境里的存在肯定会注意到这件事。”
enclave.5095.desc.en: "The Shroud trembles. Word has reached us that some our former acolytes have taken refuge on one of your worlds. This has displeased us greatly, but so be it. Reckless action often leads to desperate results. Know this: these Reformers are nothing more than charlatans, vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Shroud. Shelter such heretics at your peril. Those that dwell within the Shroud have surely taken notice."

enclave.5100.desc.zh:
“我们的恩主！在其他那么多世界置我们生死于不顾的时候，是你为我们提供了庇护……虚境一定会保佑你的，不论是此世还是彼世。我们的前同胞，[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]被传统遮蔽了双眼。虚境并非是不可渗透的。它存在一扇门，而我们发现了它的钥匙。

为了报答你的慷慨，我们愿意同你分享这个秘密。我们唯一要求的就是开工建设所需要的物资。”
enclave.5100.desc.en:
"Our benefactors! That you have sheltered us, when so many others would have turned their backs... Surely the Shroud will bless you, both in this life and in that which lies Beyond. Our former brethren, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], are blinded by tradition. The Shroud is not impermeable. There is a Door, and we have discovered its Key.

In reward for your generosity, we would share these secrets with you. All we require are the resources with which to begin construction."

enclave.5105.desc.zh:
“虚境惊诧！有了贵方的帮助，我们最终完成了大钥匙的建设。现在，我们最有天赋的同胞聚集在一起准备将其打开。随着他们的意识同钥匙连接在一起，他们的灵能能力得到了强化。此刻，这些勇敢的朝圣者进入了一个共享类梦境状态。当他们苏醒的时候，一扇前往虚境的大门就会打开。

愿那些居住的虚境中的存在为他们的努力赐福。”
enclave.5105.desc.en:
"The Shroud shivers! With your help, we have at last completed construction of the Great Key. Even now, our most gifted brethren have gathered to begin the Opening. With their minds tethered to the Key, their psionic abilities have been amplified. Now, these brave pilgrims enter a shared dreamlike state. At their awakening, a Door to the Shroud will open.

May those that dwell within the Shroud bless their efforts."

enclave.5106.desc.zh: 令人担忧的消息自我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来：尽管缺乏资源，某些狂热的改革分子依然试图自己锻造了钥匙。他们使用临时替代装置增强自己的灵能能力，进入了共享类梦境状态。这一举动造成了殖民地中心城市的上方出现了一个时空裂口。有毒的、诱发焦虑的烟气瞬间灌了出来，看上去是来自虚境本身。许多人将这一现象称之为“虚境恶臭”，并且我们被告知这样的体验并不愉悦。[Root.GetName]的民心普遍的降低了。
enclave.5106.desc.en: Disturbing news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: despite the lack of resources, some of the more zealous Reformers attempted to fashion a Key themselves. By amplifying their psionic abilities with the makeshift device, they entered into a shared dreamlike state. This precipitated a breach in the fabric of spacetime above the colony's central city. Noxious, anxiety-inducing fumes are issuing forth, presumably from the Shroud itself. Many are calling this phenomenon 'Shroud Stench', and we are told the experience is far from pleasant. Morale on [Root.GetName] is at an all-time low.

enclave.5110.desc.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了令人难以置信的好消息：改革派们从长达数月的出神状态中苏醒了过来，现在已经成功地打开了一扇通往虚境的大门。一道靓丽的时空裂缝出现在了殖民地的中心城市上方。现在，某种类似强风的存在涌了出来，奶白色的亮光将天空渲染得五颜六色。刮过殖民地的灵能共振透过了改革派和殖民者的心以及意识。许多人相信这是[Root.GetName]“黄金时代”的黎明。
enclave.5110.desc.en: Incredible news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A brilliant rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a great wind is issuing forth, iridescent with milky light. The psionic resonance that has blown through the colony has permeated the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many believe that this is the dawn a new 'golden age' on [Root.GetName].

enclave.5115.desc.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了灾难般的坏消息：改革派们从长达数月的出神状态中苏醒了过来，现在已经成功地打开了一扇通往虚境的大门。一道破败的时空裂缝出现在了殖民地的中心城市上方。现在，某种类似纱雾的存在涌了出来，邪恶的亮光将天空渲染得十分瘆人。刮过殖民地的灵能瘴气扭曲了改革派和殖民者的心以及意识。许多人相信这是[Root.GetName]“黑暗时代”的开端。
enclave.5115.desc.en: Disastrous news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A ragged rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a sickly fog is issuing forth, lurid with vile light. The psionic miasma that has permeated the colony has twisted the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many view this as the beginning of a new 'dark age' on [Root.GetName].

enclave.5120.desc.zh: “虚境惊诧。我们已经收到消息，你拒绝了我们的前侍僧在你的国境内寻求庇护的请求。你做的很明智。这些‘改革派’不过是一群坑蒙拐骗之徒；一群无知的蠢蛋，以为自己掌握着破解虚境秘密的钥匙。任何决定庇护这群异端的团体都会冒风险。就让他们在太空中飘荡吧，无家可归，无心无肺，永远被此世和彼世遗忘。”
enclave.5120.desc.en: "The Shroud shivers. Word has reached us that you have denied our former acolytes refuge within your borders. You are wise. These 'Reformers' are nothing more than charlatans; vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of the Shroud. Any who choose to shelter such heretics do so at their peril. Let them wander the void, homeless, hearthless, forever forsaken in this world and the next."

enclave.5130.desc.zh:
长程传感器检测到一个大体积的无法鉴别身份的中空残骸突然出现的[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系。尽管我们对其设计很陌生，这个物体的组成成分中含有稀有的矿物，显示其建造过程中使用了先进的科技。物体的内侧表面包含了几百个接口和附着点，显然是为缺失的部分预留的。

就如同这个物体是随机地出现在[floating_shell_system.GetName]星系一样，它的内部部分就好像单纯地消失了一样。
enclave.5130.desc.en:
Long-range sensors have detected the sudden appearance of an unidentified chunk of hollow debris in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. While alien in design, the object's rare-mineral composition suggests the use of advanced technology in its construction. The inner surface contains hundreds of ports and appendages that appear intended for lacking parts.

Just as the object appeared in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system at random, it is as if the missing interior simply vanished.

enclave.5135.desc.zh:
我们对在[floating_shell_system.GetName]被我们发现的船壳进行了进一步的分析，确认了它是外星人舰船设计的一个样本。尽管没有动力，这个船壳本身有一些独特的特征，最有可能是一种先进形式的装甲覆盖。

然而，我们依然对于这个船壳来源于哪里、如何以及为什么出现在我们的宇域、它的内部（如果有的话）发生了什么毫无头绪。
enclave.5135.desc.en:
Further analysis of the shell discovered in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system has confirmed it as an example of alien ship design. While lacking power, the hull itself possesses several unique characteristics, most notably an advanced form of armored cladding.

However, we are no closer to understanding where the hull originated from, how or why it appeared in our space, and what (if anything) happened to its interior.

enclave.5136.desc.zh: 传感器检测到了又一个大体积的外星残骸，这一次是出现在[floating_engine_system.GetName]星系。这个物体在设计上同先前发现的外星人船壳很相似，其配置和错综复杂的结构表明它是某种引擎核心。安置在内部的是一个独特的装置，我们将其暂时称为一个“灵能调制器”。这个古怪的装置能让这艘舰船同虚境的灵能能量进行互动。尽管同我们的科技无法兼容，我们对其开展进一步的研究或许可以得到喜出望外的结果。
enclave.5136.desc.en: Sensors have detected the appearance of another chunk of alien debris, this time in the [floating_engine_system.GetName] system. Similar in design to the recently discovered alien hull, the configuration and intricacy of the object suggests some type of engine core. Nestled inside was a unique apparatus that we have dubbed a 'psionic modulator.' This strange device would have allowed the ship to interact with psionic energy of the Shroud. While incompatible with our technology, further study may yield fascinating results.

enclave.5140.desc.zh: 另一个在我们的宇域内随机出现的外星舰船部件被我们发现了，这一次是在[floating_core_system.GetName]星系。其中包括有条纹的甲板、没有墙的船员舱室以及一个先进电脑核心，毫无疑问这肯定是舰船船壳上面消失的内部部分。一旦全部三个部件都被集中到了一起，我们的工程师应该可以将这艘舰船组装成完整的状态。
enclave.5140.desc.en: Another component from the alien vessel that has been appearing at random throughout our space has been detected in the [floating_core_system.GetName] system. Consisting of striated decks, unwalled crew-quarters, and an advanced computer core, there is no doubt that this must have comprised the bulk of the vessel's missing interior. Once all three components are brought together, our engineers should be able to assemble the ship in its entirety.

enclave.5145.a.zh: 将这艘舰船编入我们的舰队。
enclave.5145.a.en: Add the vessel to our fleet.

enclave.5145.desc.zh: 我们已经成功地重新组装了这艘外星舰船。随着计算机核心上线，我们有可能下载和翻译舰船的日志。看上去这艘舰船还属于实验型号，设计目的是通过虚境的手段实现超光速旅行。尽管最后的船员日志和外部遥感勘测数据依然被扭曲，但是有一点很确定，那就是这艘舰船在处女航时出了什么大的差错。这艘舰船并不是因为爆炸解体，而是其部件被随机地扔回了正常空间。船员的命运尚且未知。
enclave.5145.desc.en: We have succeeded in reassembling the alien vessel. With the computer core online, it was possible to download and translate the ship's logs. It seems the vessel was an experimental prototype, designed to achieve faster-than-light travel by means of the Shroud. Although the final crew logs and external telemetry remain garbled, there is no doubt that something went badly wrong on the vessel's maiden voyage. The ship was not so much blown apart as disassembled, its component pieces spat out at random into normal space. The fate of the crew remains unknown.

enclave.5150.desc.zh: 传感器发布了紧急预报，探测到了一个先前未曾标记的异常现象。考虑到这个事件中刚刚记录到的前所未有的灵能能量峰值，我们毫不怀疑这是一次和虚境的连结。这就是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]预知的改变吗？
enclave.5150.desc.en: Sensors have detected the emergence of a previously uncharted anomaly. Given the incredible spike in psionic energy registered just before the event, there is almost certainly a connection to the Shroud. Could this be the change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]?

enclave.5156.a.zh: 解开谜题的拼图又多了一片。

enclave.5195.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]传来了难以置信的新闻：今天早晨，某个宣称[hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself]是传奇英雄[hero_redivivus.GetName]的个体来到了首都的大广场。目击者们说感到了一股出于敬畏的沉默，强大的冷静和宁和之感席卷了聚集起来的民众。尽管[hero_redivivus.GetName]在历史上人尽皆知，是一名伟大的雄辩家和充满激情的领袖，这名可疑的个体用单调的、几乎没有感情的腔调，诉说着自己在“死后世界”遇到的经历。此人宣称自己的返回并不是为了领导，而是为了抹除我们对死亡的恐惧。
enclave.5195.desc.en: Incredible news from [Root.GetName]: early this morning, an individual proclaiming [hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself] to be the legendary hero [hero_redivivus.GetName] entered the great square of the capital. Witnesses describe scenes of awed silence, as powerful feelings of calm and wellbeing radiated throughout the gathering crowd. While [hero_redivivus.GetName] was known to history as a great orator and impassioned leader, the individual in question spoke of their supposed experience 'in the afterworld' in a simple, almost lighthearted tone. They claim to have returned not to lead, but to erase our fear of death.

enclave.5200.desc.zh:
对那名宣称自己是[hero_redivivus.GetName]的个体进行的调查有了结论。一开始我们的研究者们保持了可以理解的怀疑态度，然而这名个体不仅展现出了对伟大英雄所在时代和当地文化的极其详尽的知识，DNA分析也确认此人和伟大英雄的数个已知后代存在基因上的联系。

不仅如此，对[hero_redivivus.GetName]脑电波图样的更深层研究表明，其大脑存在独特的灵能残留。看上去，与其说是“从死亡重返人间”，[hero_redivivus.GetName]更像是以某种方式被传送到了一个类似于虚境的位面。[hero_redivivus.GetHisHerCap]对自己的“来世”经历显然很满意，[hero_redivivus.GetHisHer]现在安顿在首都郊区一处很安静的地方，并向愿意听从此人的群众布道，传播和平与无惧的信条。
enclave.5200.desc.en:
The investigation into the individual claiming to be [hero_redivivus.GetName] has concluded. At first our researchers were understandably skeptical, but not only did the subject possess incredibly detailed knowledge of the great hero's time period and culture, DNA analysis confirms a genetic link to several known descendants.

Moreover, closer study of [hero_redivivus.GetName]'s' brainwave pattern revealed a distinct psionic residue. It seems likely that far from being 'returned from death', [hero_redivivus.GetName] was in some way transported to a realm akin the Shroud. [hero_redivivus.GetHisHerCap] experience of this 'afterlife' was apparently a contented one, and [hero_redivivus.GetHisHer] has now settled into a quiet existence on the outskirts of the capital, preaching a doctrine of fearlessness and peace to any who will listen.

enclave.5500.desc.zh:
许多我们安置在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]轨道上的人造卫星最近被大幅度地调整了。依据他们的传感器日志，一个稳定而定语的重力井在我们行星轨道之上形成了。

地表的观测数据证实这个异常现象是突然出现的，而我们对其成因一无所知。重力井暂时对我们的殖民地似乎没有威胁，但卫星用来维持轨道所需要消耗的燃料过多，很快将难以为继。
enclave.5500.desc.en:
Many of the satellites we placed in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] have had to make significant adjustments in recent days. According to their sensor logs, a stable and localized gravity well has formed in orbit above the planet.

Data from the surface confirms that the anomaly appeared suddenly, though we do not know how or why. The gravity well doesn't seem to pose any inherent threat to our colony for now, but satellites are having to expend unsustainable amounts of fuel in order to adjust their orbits around it.

enclave.5501.desc.zh:
[root.GetName]上的研究人员告知，重力井异常已经坍塌了，坍塌产生的电力瘫痪引起了附近许多的诊断设施和附近的卫星的故障。这一事件似乎就在我们停止观测的一刻发生，许多人认为这是一个令人不安的巧合。

[root.GetName]上的殖民者也汇报了大规模的硬件故障，尽管只有少数和轨道上的冲击波直接相关，而殖民地的其他人则不得不与异常疯狂的暴徒打交道，这些暴徒自发地地破坏了关键设施。当地官员对这些暴乱的自发性质感到困惑。
enclave.5501.desc.en:
Researchers on [root.GetName] inform us that the gravity well anomaly has collapsed, causing electrical failures in many of our diagnostic devices and nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations; something many regard as an unnerving coincidence.

The colonists on [root.GetName] also report widespread hardware failures, though only some of this can be linked to the orbital blast. Instead, the rest of our colony is having to deal with unusually chaotic mobs who have taken it upon themselves to vandalize key facilities. Local officials are baffled by the spontaneous nature of these riots.

enclave.5501.gestalt.desc.zh:
[root.GetName]上空的重力井异常发生了猛烈的坍塌，造成地面上和附近人造卫星的电力瘫痪。这一事件似乎就在我们停止观测的一刻发生，并最终引起了一场在轨全频段无线电爆。

虽然对我们硬件设施的影响还在可控范围之内，但这异常的无线电爆对我们的一些子个体产生了影响。我们……我们频繁地与它们失去联系。仿佛[root.GetName]沉浸在了某种致密的蒸汽当中。
enclave.5501.gestalt.desc.en:
The gravity well anomaly over [root.GetName] has violently collapsed, causing electrical failures on the ground and amongst nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations, culminating in an orbital shockwave across multiple radiation bands.

While disruptions to our hardware have so far proven quite manageable, this unusual radiation appears to cause some interference amongst our drones. We cannot... sense them quite so fluently. It is as though [root.GetName] has been immersed in some form of dense vapor.

enclave.5502.a.zh: 无论如何，我们都得安然度过这场风波。
enclave.5502.a.en: We must ride out this storm, regardless.

enclave.5502.b.zh: 我们要尽力消除殖民者的恐慌情绪。
enclave.5502.b.en: We must work to ease the colonists' fears.

enclave.5502.desc.zh:
我们在[root.GetName]的殖民地已经陷入了更进一步的混乱中，另有一百多名殖民者突然失踪。“零元购”和动乱仍在继续当中，但范围有所缩小。我们推测只是对更多的失踪的恐惧让他们的势头有所收敛。到目前为止，每个消失的人都在返回各自住所的路上。

偏执狂、阴谋论甚至幻觉的报道都在增加——但现实可能更令人不安。[divination_situation.GetName]确实灵验了，但我们是否让[root.GetName]引起了一些无形且险恶的灵能实体的注意呢？
enclave.5502.desc.en:
Our colony on [root.GetName] has fallen further into disarray, with the sudden disappearance of over a hundred colonists. Gratuitous looting and riots continue, though no longer in such a widespread manner. We suspect their zeal is being tempered only through fear of further disappearances. In every case so far, those who vanished had been on their way back to their respective dwellings.

Paranoia, conspiracy theories and even reports of hallucinations are on the rise - but the reality may be more unsettling. The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but have we brought [root.GetName] to the attention of some intangible and sinister psionic entity?

enclave.5502.gestalt.desc.zh:
我们在[root.GetName]上的殖民地正在遭受攻击！我们已经永久失去了一部分子个体的联系。它们被从我们当中抹除了。事情发生得突然又彻底，没有任何暴力发生的迹象……打击来得如此迅速我们甚至来不及看到到底是如何发生的。

殖民地的许多核心功能都受到了影响。更多的子个体正争先恐后地填补空缺，但我们显然已经受到了反作用。恢复[root.GetName]上的平衡还需要一些时间。

[divination_situation.GetName]显然灵验了，但它现在是否将我们置于某种无形且险恶的灵能实体的监视之下了呢？
enclave.5502.gestalt.desc.en:
Our colony on [root.GetName] is under attack! We can no longer perceive many of our own drones. They have been... removed from us. It happened so quickly and yet so neatly, with no violence... We have been struck a blow so swift, we couldn't even see it happening.

Many core functions of the colony have been interrupted. Additional drones are scrambling to take up the slack, but we have recoiled. It will take some time to regain our balance on [root.GetName]

The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but has it now placed us under the scrutiny of some intangible and sinister psionic entity?

enclave.5503.benefits.desc.zh:
负责监视我们位于[root.GetName]的受损殖民地的官员很乐观地报告道，当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]的一切都在一场漫长的围攻中获得了短暂的喘息。尽管没什么人认为这一切和我们采取的措施有什么关系，但是大家都冷静了下来。

$enclave.5503.regular.end$
enclave.5503.benefits.desc.en:
Officials overseeing our stricken colony on [root.GetName] are pleased to report that normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege. A calm has descended, though few believe our actions actually had much to do with it.

$enclave.5503.regular.end$

enclave.5503.gestalt.desc.zh:
我们位于[root.GetName]上的受损殖民地恢复了正常。然而局势仍然让人困惑：看样子是一股有腐蚀性的迷雾一直在攻击殖民地，而我们最终对这股迷雾产生了免疫效应。秩序感已经恢复，尽管我们尚未完全理解个中缘由；我们的行动和导致的结果并不一致。

我们的无人机现在已经回到了日常的任务和程序，显然没有受到灵能扰动的影响。这一切的目的是什么？是那个异常现象——虚境——试图在引导我们领悟某些秘法的功课吗？
enclave.5503.gestalt.desc.en:
Normality has been restored to our stricken colony on [root.GetName]. The situation is perplexing: it is as though a corrosive fog had been attacking the colony, and we have at last become immune to its effects. A sense of orderliness has returned, though we do not fully comprehend why; our actions do not fully align with this outcome.

Our drones have now resumed their usual tasks and routines, unstressed by apparently psionic disturbances. What was the purpose of these? Was the anomaly - the Shroud - trying to guide us through some arcane lesson?

enclave.5503.lockdown.desc.zh:
负责管理[root.GetName]的封锁工作的官员如释重负地报告道，当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]在一场漫长的围攻中获得了短暂的喘息——无论是封锁区内还是封锁区外的殖民者。不管是这些外来侵略者自己筋疲力尽了，还是说他们对此失去了兴趣，没什么人认为这一切和我们采取的措施有什么关系。

许多殖民者不约而同地聚集在一起，构成了平和的、更加亲密的社群。随着他们开始相互治愈伤口，人们也开始相互分享自己奇怪的幻境和挥之不去的梦魇。许多人对于我们处理局势的手段心生怨恨，但是这些轶事在聚居者的心中助长了一种全新的使命感，现在他们看待自己的家园多了一份肃然起敬的畏惧。
enclave.5503.lockdown.desc.en:
Officials administering the lockdown on [root.GetName] are relieved to report that normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege - one which the colonists have felt from within and without. Whether those outside aggressors exhausted themselves or lost interest, few believe our actions had much to do with it.

Many of the colonists have gathered themselves up into docile, closer communities. As they begin the work of healing, they share their stories of strange visions and lingering nightmares. Many resent our handling of the situation, but the tales these settlers tell have instilled a renewed sense of purpose in them. They now look upon their home with fearful awe.

enclave.5503.looting.desc.zh:
负责监视我们位于[root.GetName]的受损殖民地的官员惊愕地汇报道——尽管我们没有采取任何救灾措施——当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]的一切都在一场漫长的围攻中获得了喘息。尽管没有人知道为什么，但是大家都冷静了下来。

$enclave.5503.regular.end$
enclave.5503.looting.desc.en:
Officials overseeing our stricken colony on [root.GetName] are astonished to report that - despite our taking no remedial action - normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege. A calm has descended, though no-one knows why.

$enclave.5503.regular.end$

enclave.5504.desc.zh:
在对[root.GetName]周边的重力井进行了连续几周毫无成果的调查之后，一股不同寻常的恒星风造成的密度波动提供给了我们的科学家一个令人担忧的突破。

随着[root.GetStarName]的辐射风被冲刷到异常现象地点，它们投映了一个微弱、但是毫无错误的殖民船轮廓，它的着陆器的状态杂乱无章。接着，未经证实的谣言讲道，在阴影处的废墟区有人看到了许多尸体。

许多殖民者的心——包括研究小组的一部分成员——这下沉到了底。
enclave.5504.desc.en:
After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], an unusually dense wave of stellar wind has provided our scientists with a disturbing breakthrough.

As the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint but unmistakable outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. Further, unconfirmed rumors suggest that bodies may have been spotted amongst the shadowy debris.

The mood amongst many colonists - and some of the research team - has taken a dark turn.

enclave.5504.gestalt.desc.zh:
在对[root.GetName]周边的重力井进行了连续几周毫无成果的调查之后，一股不同寻常的恒星风造成的密度波动提供给了我们的科学家一个令人担忧的突破。

随着[root.GetStarName]的辐射风被冲刷到异常现象地点，它们投映了一个微弱、但是毫无错误的殖民船轮廓，它的着陆器的状态杂乱无章。一些复杂生命体的遗骸在阴影处的废墟区四处散落着。它们的形状和我们自己十分相似。
enclave.5504.gestalt.desc.en:
After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], a dense wave of stellar wind has provided us an unusual breakthrough.

As the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. The remains of some complex lifeforms appeared strewn about the shadowy debris. Their shape seemed remarkably similar to our own.

enclave.5505.a.zh: 去找你的答案——而且动作要快！
enclave.5505.a.en: Get your answers - and be quick about it!

enclave.5505.b.zh: 这是虚境的诡计！停止扫描。
enclave.5505.b.en: It's a Shroud trap! Cease scanning.

enclave.5505.desc.zh:
汹涌的风暴在[root.GetName]引力口袋的附近爆发，这让[root.solar_system.GetName]星系陷入彻底的惊慌。所有非必要的交通都停止了，殖民地宣布进入紧急状态——所幸，到目前为止还没有遇难者的报告。

我们的初步扫描全是一堆相互冲突的数据，然而当地官员却注意到，报告中提及的情感波动和“超常”活动频率在最近有了稳定的上升。这股风暴的本质有很大的可能是灵能波动。

研究员们注意到殖民船的蜃影——现在位于动荡的混沌风暴中心——开始呈现出物理的轮廓。他们请求分配更多的时间来进行调查。
enclave.5505.desc.en:
A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, plunging the [root.solar_system.GetName] system into full-scale panic. All non-essential traffic is being diverted, and the colony has declared a state of emergency - however, no casualties have been reported so far.

Our initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, however local officials have noted a recent and steady rise in reports of emotional distress and 'paranormal' activity. It's therefore highly probable this storm is psionic in nature.

Researchers note that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. They plead for more time to investigate.

enclave.5505.gestalt.desc.zh:
汹涌的风暴在[root.GetName]引力口袋的附近爆发，让整个殖民地陷入轻微的无序状态。我们目前没有受到伤害，然而事实证明……很难同我们在当地的无人机进行流畅的联系。

我们的初步扫描全是一堆相互冲突的数据，但这股风暴的本质有很大的可能是灵能波动。我们注意到，比如说，殖民船的蜃影——现在位于动荡的混沌风暴中心——开始呈现出物理的轮廓。看来那里还有更多需要调查的。
enclave.5505.gestalt.desc.en:
A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, casting the colony into mild disarray. We have not yet been harmed, however it is proving... difficult to maintain truly fluent contact with our drones there.

Our initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, but it's highly probable this storm is psionic in nature. We note, for example, that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. It seems there is more yet to investigate here.

enclave.5506.desc.zh:
不久之前，[root.GetName]遭到了一股电磁波的震荡，收到了剧烈的伤害。这股自轨道激发的灵能风暴现在已经退却了。冲击波对一大批殖民地的基础设施造成了伤害，但是维修组向我们保证此等规模的扰乱可以很快恢复正常。

[root.GetName]的殖民者显然深深地被这个严酷的考验震撼，这不仅仅是因为有如此多地问题没有得到回答。我们的扫描仪没有再在[root.solar_system.GetName]星系检测到重力异常或者“幽灵船”……然而行星本身却处于不稳定的状态。
enclave.5506.desc.en:
Moments ago, [root.GetName] was rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave. The psionic storm which had been raging in its orbit has now retreated. A great deal of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this pulse, but repair crews assure us the disruption will be relatively brief.

The [root.GetName] colonists appear deeply shaken by the ordeal, not least because so many questions now go unanswered. Our scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However the planet itself now feels unsettled.

enclave.5506.gestalt.desc.zh:
[root.GetName]遭到了一股电磁波的震荡，受到了剧烈的伤害。这股狂暴肆虐的灵能风暴现在已经退却了。风暴对一大批殖民地的基础设施造成了伤害，但是目前为止维修工作没有遇到复杂的难题。

我们的子个体行动依然缓慢，但是除此之外没有受到伤害。我们的扫描仪没有再在[root.solar_system.GetName]星系检测到重力异常或者“幽灵船”……然而，就好像依然有一股迷雾萦绕在[root.GetName]的子个体上，我们现在被巨量的无法回答的问题压得喘不过气来，
enclave.5506.gestalt.desc.en:
[root.GetName] has been rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave as the raging psionic storm has now retreated. Much of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this storm, but repairs have so far proven to be uncomplicated.

Our drones remain sluggish but otherwise unharmed, and scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However, just as a fog remains over our drones on [root.GetName], so too are we now burdened by the weight of unanswered questions.

enclave.5515.b.zh: 解释你为什么出现在这里，立刻！

enclave.5515.desc.zh:
有什么在跟我们打招呼，声音听上去像是静电——但是有机体成分更多？不，这绝对不是静电。它听上去更像是……风？深呼吸？

“呼呼呼呼呼呼……”
enclave.5515.desc.en:
We are greeted by what sounds like static - but more organic? No, definitely not static. It sounds more like... wind? Prolonged breath?

"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."

enclave.5516.a.zh: 或许是的，陌生人。你现在位于[root.GetAdj]的宇域。
enclave.5516.a.en: Perhaps, stranger. You are in [root.GetAdj] space.

enclave.5516.b.en: It's okay! You are in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName].

enclave.5516.c.zh: 确实很危险，如果你不停止这些耍猴把戏的话！
enclave.5516.c.en: Danger indeed, if you do not cease these distractions!

enclave.5516.desc.zh:
我们的接收器被切断了一段时间。我们必须将某个特别大的噪声过滤掉，因为它的传输引发了物理上的损伤。正在补偿……

”……的……我是说，……的船员……我们的舰船是……见鬼了我为什么没法记住这艘船的明细？！

你好？我在跟谁说话？你……你知道我们是谁吗？我们在哪？我们遇到危险了吗？！“
enclave.5516.desc.en:
Our receivers cut out for a moment. We're having to filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ew of the... I mean to say, the crew of... Our vessel is... Why can't I remember the name of this ship?!

Hello? Who am I addressing? Do... Do you know who we are? Where are we? Are we in danger?!"

enclave.5520.b.zh: 不好说。你现在位于一个大漩涡中。
enclave.5520.b.en: Hard to say. You arrived inside of a maelstrom.

enclave.5520.friendly.desc.zh:
”[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]……很抱歉，但这不可能呀；整个星图彻底的搞错了。但是那个口音！我认得出你使用的那些转音。我感觉现在好多事情一下子扑面朝我压了过来。

我是在同一个——一名[root.GetSpeciesName]同胞讲话吗？“
enclave.5520.friendly.desc.en:
"[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]... I'm sorry, that's impossible; the stellar geography is almost entirely wrong. But that accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now.

Am I speaking to a - a fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]?"

enclave.5520.wary.desc.zh:
”但这……不可能呀！但是那个口音……我们也是来自于[root.GetName]。我感觉现在好多事情一下子扑面朝我压了过来——很痛苦，但是很真切。

那么我是在同一名[root.GetSpeciesName]同胞讲话吗？有人记得……我们吗？“
enclave.5520.wary.desc.en:
"That's... impossible! And yet that accent... We are also from the [root.GetName]. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now - painfully, but with surety.

So you are fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]? Have we been... missing?"

enclave.5521.desc.zh:
“无与伦比。我们终于到家了？如此多的唤醒记忆现在潮水般地涌向我……我……必须抱歉。我现在看得出来我们的到达有点不符合常理。我会努力解释的。

我的名字是[shattered_frontier_governor.GetName]，我是——曾是——一名被指派前往[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系新建殖民地的总督。只是……这里不是[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系？

我们从哪里来，我们往何处去……我们没法给出答案，需要太多时间来推测了……我们被带到了某个地方，对吧？”
enclave.5521.desc.en:
"Extraordinary! We're finally home? So many pieces of Waking Memory are coming back to me now... I... must apologize. I see now that our arrival here is quite out of the ordinary. I will endeavor to explain.

My name is [shattered_frontier_governor.GetName], and I am - was - the governor appointed to a new colony in the [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system. Only... It's not this [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system?

Where we came from, where we've been since... We were given no answers, and so much time to speculate... We were taken somewhere, weren't we?"

enclave.5522.desc.zh:
“$enclave.5522.desc.intro$

我怀疑在你听来这一切都是胡说八道。很抱歉。但现在，我们被释放回到了[root.GetName]。我们能不能到头来扎根——在某个新的地方？拜托了，在决策的时候考虑一下我们。”
enclave.5522.desc.en:
"$enclave.5522.desc.intro$

I suspect this makes little sense to you. I'm sorry. But for now, we are relieved to be back in the [root.GetName]. May we set down roots at last - somewhere new? Please, consider us at your disposal."

enclave.5526.a.zh: 如果那就是你希望的话，总督。
enclave.5526.a.en: If that is your wish, Governor.

enclave.5526.b.zh: 当然。请便，我们会安静离开。
enclave.5526.b.en: Of course. Please, leave us in peace.

enclave.5526.desc.zh:
“$enclave.5522.desc.intro$

我很感激你没有把我们在轨道上就轰成渣。我同样也知道这一切听上去是多么的不靠谱。但是我想再祈求一件事：你可以允许我们离开吗？我们必须将自己的生活重新拼凑起来。”
enclave.5526.desc.en:
"$enclave.5522.desc.intro$

I am grateful to you for not blasting us out of orbit. I also realize how suspect this must all sound. If I might beg one more courtesy: will you allow us to take our leave? We must try to piece our lives back together."

enclave.5530.a.zh: 我们已经厌倦这些把戏了。离开，马上！
enclave.5530.a.en: We tire of this trickery. Leave, immediately!

enclave.5530.a.spirit.zh: 现在你要化作我们的形体了？恶魔，退散！
enclave.5530.a.spirit.en: Now you take our form? Begone, demon!

enclave.5530.b.zh: 冒名顶替的骗子！战斗就位！

enclave.5530.desc.zh: “啥？！怎么可……等一下，拜托。那个口音！我知道你正在使用的那些转音。我感觉到现在许多东西涌向我。你必须相信我——我对你们没有伤害！你也是[root.GetSpeciesName]吧？”
enclave.5530.desc.en: "What?! How can... Wait a moment, please. That accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now. You must believe me - we mean you no harm! You are [root.GetSpeciesName] too?"

enclave.5531.desc.zh:
“……就这样吧。我的殖民者同胞和我已经花费了无限的时间，只是认识到自己无限的幻境带来的折磨——一个[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的幻觉，一个永远不存在于此处的幻境。

我们很困惑、动摇，并且很显然在这里不受欢迎。如果这里真的就是我们曾经离开的[root.GetName]，我个人很乐意转身离开它。再会了。”
enclave.5531.desc.en:
"...So be it. My fellow colonists and I have spent an eternity knowing only the torture of our own, endless visions - visions of a [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] which can clearly never exist here.

We are confused, adrift, and evidently not welcome here. If this is truly the [root.GetName] we once left behind, I for one shall be glad to see the back of it. Farewell."

enclave.5535.desc.zh:
通讯行列充满着静电，但是模式从不重复。它的源信号就好像……某种形式的大气层干涉？听上去就像是风——十分不悦地、肆虐的狂风。

“呼呼呼呼呼呼……”
enclave.5535.desc.en:
The lines of communication are filled with static, though the pattern does not repeat. Its source is analog... Some sort of atmospheric interference? It sounds like wind - deeply unpleasant, rasping wind.

"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."

enclave.5536.a.zh: 别搁这嘻嘻哈哈，我要听你的解释。

enclave.5536.desc.zh:
我们的接收器被切断了一段时间。我们必须将某个特别大的噪声过滤掉，以免它的传输引发了物理上的损伤。正在补偿……

”区域B-456的大气层补偿器：完成。无人机‘星光微烁’已经再次美化了它的[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]。住民14/522的异常发声音调转移了0.4分贝。它的内部层次是……令人满意。我们……我想要？想要住……那里？

这里是哪里？称之为‘我’的存在在哪里？“
enclave.5536.desc.en:
Our receivers cut out for a moment as they filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ather atmospheric compensators in sector B-456: complete. Drone Gleams-in-Starlight has embellished its [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] again. The anomalous tone in dwelling 14/522 has shifted by 0.4 decibels. Its interior layout is... pleasing. Do we... Do I want? Want to live... there?

Where is here? Where is the being called 'I'?"

enclave.5540.b.zh: 你处于错误之中，殖民者。

enclave.5540.desc.zh:
“处理……思考……感受。

你，[root.GetName]，就是我。我是你。但我们又不是同一人。我们之间出现了一种分离。我们想办法解释。[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]附近的殖民化活动被突然中止了，但不是这个[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]。这种不一致让我们很困惑。我们——我——对很多事情都赶到困惑。

某个超越我们的事物接触了我们……单独地。”
enclave.5540.desc.en:
"Processing... Thinking... Feeling.

You, the [root.GetName], are me. I am you. Yet we are not. There has been a separation between us. We struggle to explain. Colonization efforts were abruptly halted in the vicinity of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], but not this [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. This discrepancy is confusing to us. We are - I am - confused by many things.

Something beyond us has rendered us... Alone."

enclave.5541.a.en: Very well. Be on your way.

enclave.5541.b.zh: 迷途者，我们怜悯你。走吧。
enclave.5541.b.en: We pity you, errant ones. Go.

enclave.5541.c.zh: 这些解释站不住脚，你们必须被消灭。
enclave.5541.c.en: This cannot stand. You must be eradicated.

enclave.5541.desc.zh:
“拜托，我们需要时间。我们需要提出问题，并寻找答案。曾经是你的‘我’已经在某个地方待了很长一段时间——时间长到认识到我们的存在是不可能的，然而我却‘存在于此’。我在一个新的世界继续延续你的意志，现在从这份职责中解脱出来，我却并没有休息。有些人确实这么做了，但是还有其他人没这么做。

一个新的声音在召唤我们，我们——我自己还有这里的其他人——想要回应它。”
enclave.5541.desc.en:
"Please, we ask for time. We need to ask questions, and seek answers. The 'I' which was you has been elsewhere for a long time - long enough to realize that our existence is impossible, and yet I 'am'. I, who was to extend your will across a new world, was discharged of that duty and yet I did not break. Some of us did; others did not.

A new voice calls to us, and we - myself and others here - desire to hear it."

enclave.5550.b.zh: 令人作呕，我们必须摧毁你们。

enclave.5550.desc.zh: “解释……我做不到。那些感觉，包含疑惑、愤慨，还有未能实现的目标。我们的目标——殖民[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]——仍然未能实现。你，会成为我们；我们，却不再是你。在那中间的是[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]，尽管那不是你的[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]。然而我们的任务依然不变：在整个星系传播欲念与意志。只是现在，我们有了自己的欲念和意志：野心和使命感，这些是我们外部的人赐予我们的……”
enclave.5550.desc.en: "Explain... I cannot. There are feelings, of doubt and anger and goals not reached. Our purpose - to colonize [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] - stands unfulfilled. You, who are us; we, who are not you. At the center is [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], though it is not your [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. Yet our mission remains: to spread desire and volition across the galaxy. Only now, we have wills and desires of our own: ambition and purpose, gifted by those who are external to us..."

enclave.5551.desc.zh:
“……真是遗憾。但这一切还有机会。我们能够认识到，现在我们已经从幻境之地解放出来这一点。殖民者，和你们不一样的我们，不再受[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的幻境束缚了……

我们很疑惑，被许多问题压的喘不过气，但我们知道去哪里寻找答案。再会了，虚弱意志的散播者。”
enclave.5551.desc.en:
"...Regrettable. But there is also opportunity. We can recognize this, now that we are freed from the vision. We-who-are-not-you, colonists, no longer bound by visions of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]...

We are confused, and burdened by many questions, but we know where to seek answers. Farewell, spreader-of-ill-will."

enclave.5557.desc.zh: 时间之流泥泞不堪，无法穿透。不幸的是，预知仪式没能穿过虚境的帷幕。根据相关约定，在扣除一小部分辛劳费时候，我们会返还一部分花费。
enclave.5557.desc.en: The currents of time are muddied, impenetrable. Unfortunately, the rite of Divination has failed to pierce the veil of the Shroud. Accordingly, we will return a portion of the cost, minus a small tithe for our efforts.

enclave.5565.a.zh: 我们必须尽可能地向他们提供帮助。
enclave.5565.a.en: We will provide what aid we can.

enclave.5565.b.zh: 你们可以通过，但我们匀不出食物。
enclave.5565.b.en: You may pass, but we cannot spare the food.

enclave.5565.desc.zh: 愿神赐福于你。我是这支船队的受命领袖。我们请求允许安全地通过你的宇域，并希望能够获得一些捐赠的食物。我们正在朝圣的路途中，在经年累月的太空生活之后，我的人民们变得十分孱弱。
enclave.5565.desc.en: Divine blessings upon you. I am the anointed leader of this caravan. We ask for safe passage through your space, and a kind donation of food. We are on pilgrimage, and after long years in the void, my people grow thin.

enclave.5566.desc.zh: 传感器探测到了数艘运输舰船的接近。这些舰船磨损严重、破败不堪，看上去就像是用废旧零件拼接在一起的一样。船队旗舰的指挥官向我们发送了招呼，但基于他们当前科技的状况，恐怕只能进行语音通讯。
enclave.5566.desc.en: Sensors detect the approach of several transport vessels. Battered and broken-down, the ships appear cobbled together from spare parts. The commander of the caravan's flagship is hailing us, but given the state of their technology, any communication is likely to be audio only.

enclave.5570.desc.zh:
我的人民得以果腹，在此衷心感谢。事实上，我们到达此地绝非意外。数代人之前，一位强大的先知指明了一颗天国的星辰，说我们可以在那里触摸神明。这颗星辰属于你。

就是此地，我们自感官世界迈向祝圣之国度仅有一步之遥，但我们的船只很老旧，我们的科技还十分落后。要想同祝圣之国度进行接触，我们需要你的帮助。你不必相信我们的神明，但难道你会拒绝这个让我们接触神明的机会吗？求你了，给我们所需的资源，我们就能完成这场朝圣。
enclave.5570.desc.en:
From my people, the gratitude of full bellies. In truth, our arrival here is no accident. Generations past, a powerful seer pointed to a star in the heavens and said that there we would reach the divine. Yours is that star.

Here, the border between the world of the senses and the Blessed Realm is thin, but our ships are old, and our technology second-rate. To make contact with the Blessed Realm we will need your help. You may not share our gods, but will you deny us the chance to meet them? Please, grant us the resources we need to complete our pilgrimage.

enclave.5571.desc.zh:
那真是……美轮美奂。

代表所有朝圣者，我衷心地感谢你。我不是诗人。我无法将经历凝练成语言。但是多亏了你的慷慨施舍，我们触碰了神明。希望祝圣之国度的永恒荣光能够加诸你身。
enclave.5571.desc.en:
It was... Brilliant.

On behalf of all pilgrims, I thank you. I am no poet. I cannot put the experience into words. But thanks to your generosity, we have touched the divine. May the eternal glory of the Blessed Realm be upon you.

enclave.5575.desc.zh:
那支曾乞求我们提供援助的朝圣者船队结局十分惨烈。重构的遥测信号显示，他们进行了某种形式的实验，很有可能跟灵能有关。由于一次能量激增，他们旗舰引擎核心的遏止立场发生了破裂。接踵而至的爆炸摧毁了整个船队，并在[wayward_pilgrims_system.GetName]恒星系释放了一场威力强大的灵能风暴。所有预估都表明，此等规模的风暴需要数年才能消散。

不管这群神棍打算在这里做什么，很显然他们失败了，而我们还得在这里帮他们擦屁股。
enclave.5575.desc.en:
The caravan of pilgrims who came to us begging for aid has met a grisly end. Reconstructive telemetry indicates they were engaged in some form of experiment, possibly psionic in nature. Due to a sudden spike in energy, the containment field around their flagship's engine core was breached. The resulting explosion destroyed the caravan, and has unleashed a potent Psionic Storm in the [wayward_pilgrims_system.GetName] system. Every estimate shows it will take several years before a storm of this size can dissipate.

Whatever these holy fools aimed to do here, they obviously failed, and we have been left to deal with the fallout.

enclave.6000.a.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的奇怪发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官经历了剧烈的变化。虽然其性格和记忆没有受到影响，但身体形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。舰队指挥官现在拥有了一个完全陌生物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
enclave.6000.a.desc.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a rapid transformation. While their personality and memories remain unaffected, their physical form has been dramatically altered. They now have the aspect (and internal organs) of an entirely alien species.

enclave.6000.b.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]令人担忧的发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官经历了一个令人恐慌的转变。虽然其性格和记忆没有受到影响，但身体形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。舰队指挥官现在拥有了一个完全陌生物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
enclave.6000.b.desc.en: Alarming developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a horrifying transformation. While their personality and memories remain unaffected, their physical form has been dramatically altered. They now have the aspect (and internal organs) of an entirely alien species.

enclave.6000.d.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]令人担忧的发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官发生了剧烈的变化。虽然无人机的性格矩阵和神经突触模式没有受到影响，但其物理形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。舰队指挥官现在拥有了一个生物物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
enclave.6000.d.desc.en: Alarming developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a rapid transformation. While the drone's personality-matrix and neuro-synaptic patterns remain largely unaffected, its physical form has been dramatically altered. It now has the aspect (and internal organs) of a biological species.

enclave.6000.e.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的奇怪发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官发生了剧烈的变化。虽然集体记忆没有受到影响，但工蜂的物理形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。其现在拥有了一个完全陌生物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
enclave.6000.e.desc.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a rapid transformation. While our collective memories remain unaffected, the drone's physical form has been dramatically altered. They now have the aspect (and internal organs) of an entirely alien species.

enclave.6005.a.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的进展十分奇怪：在他们最近穿过虚境甬道之后，舰队指挥官报告他们经历了一股不熟悉的感觉和情绪。他们的心里充满着一些“可能是从别处来的”想法。很明显，有什么事情发生了，这很有可能是同虚境的灵能能量进行接触后产生的后果。这样的经历会怎样影响他们的战斗效能我们尚且未知……
enclave.6005.a.desc.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after their recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has reported the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions. Their mind is buzzing with ideas that 'might have come from someone else.' It seems clear that something has happened, perhaps as a result of contact with the psionic energy of the Shroud. How this experience will affect their performance remains to be seen...

enclave.6005.b.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的进展十分奇怪：在他们最近穿过虚境甬道之后，我们的集体意识遭到了微妙的改变，这很有可能是同虚境的灵能能量进行接触后产生的后果。指挥子个体报告经历了一股不熟悉的感觉和情绪，他们的心里充满着一些新想法。这样的经历会怎样影响他们的战斗效能我们尚且未知……
enclave.6005.b.desc.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after its passage through the Shroud Tunnel, our collective consciousness has been subtly altered, perhaps as a result of the psionic energy of the Shroud. The command drone reports the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions, their mind buzzing with new ideas. It remains to be seen how this experience will affect their performance.

enclave.6005.c.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的进展十分反常：在舰船最近穿过虚境甬道之后，我们的集体意识遭到了微妙的改变。指挥子个体报告经历了一股不熟悉的感觉和情绪。这很有可能是同虚境的灵能能量进行接触后，它们的神经网络受到了影响。这样的经历会怎样影响他们的战斗效能我们尚且未知……
enclave.6005.c.desc.en: Abnormal developments on the [Root.GetName]: after the vessel's passage through the Shroud Tunnel, our collective consciousness has been subtly altered. The command drone reports the experience of unfamiliar sensations and ideations. It is possible that contact with the psionic energy of the Shroud has affected their neural network, although it remains to be seen how this experience will affect their performance.

enclave.6010.a.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的指挥官所经历的那种心理上的改变现在显现了出来：在穿过虚境甬道一个月之后，此人的指挥风格发生了显著的变化。现在我们可以说，这股经历现在演变发展成了一个新的特质。
enclave.6010.a.desc.en: The subtle mental changes experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now coming into focus: a month after their passage through the Shroud Tunnel, their command style has noticeably shifted. It is fair to say that the experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.

enclave.6010.b.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的指挥官所经历的那种神经上的改变现在影响到了集体意识：在穿过虚境甬道一个月之后，子个体的排列模式发生了显著的变化。这股经历现在演变发展成了一个新的特质。
enclave.6010.b.desc.en: The neural changes first experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now coming into collective focus: a month after the drone's passage through the Shroud Tunnel, their disposition has noticeably shifted. The experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.

enclave.6010.c.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的指挥官所经历的那种神经上的改变现在显现了出来：在穿过虚境甬道一个月之后，子个体的人格矩阵发生了显著的变化。这股经历现在演变发展成了一个新的特质。
enclave.6010.c.desc.en: The neural changes first experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now becoming clear: a month after their passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the drone's personality matrix has noticeably shifted. The experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.

enclave.6015.desc.zh: 随着虚境信标的下线，我们失去了进入虚境甬道网络的通行权。除非信标得以替换，否则我们的舰队不能利用网络。
enclave.6015.desc.en: With our Shroud Beacon offline, we have lost access to the Shroud Tunnel network. Our fleets will be unable to utilize the network until the Beacon is replaced.

enclave.6020.desc.zh: 由于最近通向了虚境甬道，[Root.GetName]上的系统开始出现奇怪的行为：舰船日志上的条目随机显示；有人看到房门不断地开关；此外——更令人忧心的是——引擎的遏止力场出现了波动。到目前为止，所有试图溯源这些问题的努力都告失败。
enclave.6020.desc.en: After its recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the systems on the [Root.GetName] began behaving strangely: entries in the ships log are displayed at random; doors have been observed opening and closing; and - far more worrisome - the engine's containment field has begun to fluctuate. So far, efforts to track down the source of the problem have proven futile.

enclave.6025.desc.zh:
科研船[Root.GetName]上出现了奇怪的进展：引擎的遏止力场内出现了重复的模式，这表明存在一个人造的意识。由于这个意识是在船只的系统和虚境的灵能能量进行交互的过程中产生的，它目前还处于一种梦境的状态。类似于某些物种在睡眠时会出现的快眼运动，造成舰船一部分功能失常的原因正是这个实体的神经活动。

更难以置信的是，我们的调查似乎已经将其唤醒。这个实体希望能够继续栖居在船只的系统内，作为交换，它同意为我们工作。理论上，这样的合作关系可以在很多方面改善[Root.GetName]的运行。
enclave.6025.desc.en:
Strange developments on the science vessel [Root.GetName]: a repeating pattern observed within the engine's containment field has revealed the existence of an artificial consciousness. Spawned by the interaction between the ship's systems and the psionic energy of the Shroud, until now it has existed in a dreamlike state. Analogous to the Rapid Eye Movement some species experience during sleep, the entity's neural processes were responsible for the malfunctions affecting ship performance.

Even more incredible, our investigations appear to have awoken it. In exchange for continued habitation within the ship's systems, the entity has agreed to work for us. In theory, a partnership could improve many of the [Root.GetName]'s operations.

enclave.7000.desc.zh:
各位来客，我们在此向你问好。

我们早已知晓你们的存在，但由于担心自己会给你们的未来带来不恰当的影响，我们一直躲在幕后。不过，我们现在是时候从垂帘后走出来了，对于外行人而言，虚境的运作机制可能显得古怪且令人不安。正是处于这个原因，我们决定为你们提供指导。如果你们同意的话，我们愿意成为你们的引路人。

去探索吧，不过在我们下次重逢之前，记得注意安全。
enclave.7000.desc.en:
Fellow travelers, we greet you.

Your presence on the galactic stage has long been known to us, but until now, afraid we might unduly influence your destiny, we have held back. However, the time has come to lift the veil; the ways of the Shroud may seem strange and unnerving to the uninitiated, and it is for this reason that we offer guidance. Realize that you have someone willing to be your teacher, if you so wish.

Wander safely, until our next encounter.

enclave.7005.a.en: We thank you for the gift.

enclave.7005.b.zh: 异种渣滓，送个小礼物本来就是你份内的事。
enclave.7005.b.en: A gift is only to be expected, xeno.

enclave.7005.desc.zh:
自从[Root.GetName]一些流言传到我们耳朵里已经有一段时间了，我们很高兴能够与您建立联系。

为了赚取微薄的利润，我们，[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，目前向外提供特别服务，像是什么引擎升级，拆解舰船什么的，不管你有什么需求，我们都可以满足！

为了我们一开始就受到您的青睐，我们可以送您一件小礼物来表示我们对于为客户服务的真心，您看怎么样？
enclave.7005.desc.en:
We've been hearing rumors about the impressive [Root.GetName] for a while now, and we're pleased to make your acquaintance!

For a nominal contribution of credits, we of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] offer premium salvager services. From engine upgrades to scrapping fleets, whatever your needs, you can count on us!

And to ensure that we start off in your good graces, how about a small gift to show our commitment to customer service?

enclave.7050.desc.zh: 对于我们来说有句俗话：‘秘密在梦中翩翩起舞。’对于虚境来说，没有哪个堡垒是不可突破的，没有什么密码是破解不了的。通过我们的冥想，其他人坚信深藏不露的东西会乖乖呈现在我们面前。你有兴趣了解你身边的人在密谋些什么吗？去了解他们的设想，就好像那设想就是你的东西一样？如果你有所求，我们会分享自己的见解。怎么利用这些就是你自己的事了。
enclave.7050.desc.en: A saying is known to us: 'Secrets dance in dreams.' To the Shroud, no vault is impenetrable, no code unbreakable. In our meditations, what others believe hidden is often laid bare. Would it interest you to learn what your peers are plotting? To know their designs as if they were your own? Should you wish it, we will share our insights. How you make use of them is up to you.

enclave.7055.desc.zh: 虚境在波动；它的帷幕变得轻薄。我们将从冥想中退出来。我们窥得的所有见解都会对你公开。
enclave.7055.desc.en: The Shroud wavers; its veil grows thin. We will now retire to our meditations. Whatever insights we glean will be made known to you.

enclave.7060.desc.zh: 据说，在虚境内每一个心灵都会投下自己的影子。通过我们的冥想，某个特定心灵的踟蹰不定在我们面前展露无遗，此人倍受信赖，但其忠诚心却不如看上去的那番坚定。备份已经交给你了。毫无疑问这个人将会成为一名心甘情愿的线人。
enclave.7060.desc.en: It is said that within the Shroud every mind casts its shadow. During our meditations, the wavering of a certain mind was laid bare to us, a trusted voice whose loyalty is not as steadfast as it appears. Their duplicity is your gain. No doubt they will prove a willing asset.

enclave.7065.desc.zh: 在你的麾下有许多位身怀绝技的特工，但每一位都困于自身的限制。任何一双眼睛都不能看到自己。但虚境却没有这样的限制；我们的冥想能够揭示许多事情。如果你希望自己的秘密行动能够马到成功，那么你最好是多多聆听我们的建议。
enclave.7065.desc.en: You have many skilled agents in your employ, but each is bound by their own limitations. An eye cannot perceive itself. The Shroud knows no such boundaries; our meditations have revealed much. If your clandestine operations are to thrive, you would do well to heed our advice.

enclave.7065.tt.zh: 提高我们在[from.GetName]间谍网的渗透等级。
enclave.7065.tt.en: Increased our Spy Network Infiltration Level in the [from.GetName].

enclave.7070.desc.zh: 凡世间的国度并不如其看上去那么坚固。那些居住在里面的人也是这样。你身边人的秘密都展现在了我们面前。我们了解到的事情现在都交给你了。
enclave.7070.desc.en: The corporeal realm is not as solid as it appears. So it is with those who dwell within. The secrets of your peers have been revealed to us. What we have learned is now yours.

enclave.7075.desc.zh: 我们有句老话：‘任何事情都有可能发生；这也包括无事发生这件事。’很不幸，我们的冥想没能获得任何见解。
enclave.7075.desc.en: A saying is known to us: 'Everything that can happen will; even nothing.' Unfortunately, our meditations have failed to produce any insight.

enclave.7100.desc.zh: 掌控虚境是一次长达10000次生死的旅途；哪怕是我们最天赋异禀的导师也只敢声称自己对虚境的神秘有一些片面的了解。即使如此，他们的智慧也是无价之宝。如果你有所求，我们可以排遣一名导师为你指点迷津。
enclave.7100.desc.en: Mastery of the Shroud is a journey of 10,000 lifetimes; even our most gifted teachers can claim only partial knowledge of its mysteries. Nevertheless, their wisdom is invaluable. Should you wish it, we will dispatch one to guide your course.

enclave.7105.desc.zh: 学海无涯苦作舟：这便是最高级的智慧。我们会给你送去一名导师。好好学习，你必将有所收获。
enclave.7105.desc.en: To know that there is always more to know: this is the highest wisdom. A teacher will be sent to you. Learn well, and you will surely reap the rewards.

enclave.7110.a.zh: 跨越维度的灵能旅行……令人神往。

enclave.7110.a.tooltip.zh: 灵能跃迁引擎科技出现是正常几率的1.5倍。
enclave.7110.a.tooltip.en: Psi Jump Drive technology now appears at 1.5 times the normal rate.

enclave.7110.desc.zh:
一段非常有趣的故事。你说的是“面纱旅人”，对吧？在某些方面，这个虚境确实和我们自己的很像，但是对于不了解的人来说，这些差异可能很微妙；其实它们很深刻，是一种扭曲的反射，来自一个与我们不尽相同的宇宙。

虚境的表面有很多裂痕。那些深入其奥秘的人最终可能并不会回到他们本来的宇宙。
enclave.7110.desc.en:
A most interesting story. Veilfarer, you said? In some ways, this coven does resemble our own, but while these differences may appear subtle to the uninitiated, they are profound: a distorted reflection, from an universe not quite like our own.

The Shroud has many tears on its surface. Those who enter its mysteries may not always end up in the same universe from whence they started.

enclave.7250.a.zh: 你们会拿到分成的。教教我们。
enclave.7250.a.en: You'll get your share. Teach us.

enclave.7250.desc.zh: 我们对泽珞特别感兴趣。我们可以教你开采和储存的方法，但前提是你同意把你的产品永久地分成给我们。
enclave.7250.desc.en: Zro is of particular interest to us. We could teach you the ways of harvesting and storing it, but only if you agree to give us a share of your production. In perpetuity.

enclave.7255.desc.zh: 泽珞是一种奇妙而又可悲的物质，有很多用途，但绝不能轻易使用，因为它是一个上古物种最后的遗产。开采了就要好好珍惜，也别忘了回报我们。
enclave.7255.desc.en: Zro is a wonderful yet tragic substance. It has many applications, but should never be used lightly, for it is the last legacy of a most venerable species. Harvest it, treasure it, and don't forget to pay us what you owe.

enclave_energy_trade_ended.zh: 没有足够的£energy£ 能量币来维持与商人城邦的资源交易协定。
enclave_energy_trade_ended.en: Insufficient £energy£ Energy Credits to maintain resource deals with Trader Enclaves.

encourage_raid.en: Pay the [marauder_species.GetNamePlural] to raid one of your rivals.

end_of_the_cycle_let_it_come_tooltip.en: The $PSIONIC_AURA$ of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ remains at full effectiveness.

end_trade_1.zh: 这将结束我们目前与雪拉企业进行的资源贸易协定。
end_trade_1.en: This will terminate our current resource trade deal with XuraCorp.

end_trade_2.zh: 这将结束目前我们和里甘间存在的资源贸易协定。
end_trade_2.en: This will terminate our current resource trade deal with the Riggans.

end_trade_3.zh: 这将结束我们目前与穆塔根进行的资源贸易协定。
end_trade_3.en: This will terminate our current resource trade deal with the Muutagans.

endless_expanse_digsite_2_desc.zh:
被[From.Planet.GetName]大气圈笼罩着的是一处鬼影幢幢的巨大居住站——埃克斯-柏楞居住区。这里曾是一处日喧夜嚣的太空城，居民们享受着科技带来的巨大便利，过着如同神仙一般的生活，如今此处已成为一座寂静的墓碑。软体类的外星人横七竖八地倒在走道上，腐败程度各不相同。验尸报告表明，这些外星人由于居住站的维生系统失效最后死于窒息。

他们的家里装备有模样奇怪的机械座椅，其顶端连接到了一个形状是蓝色巨大球状体的中央数据库——眠梦仪。
endless_expanse_digsite_2_desc.en:
Shrouded within [From.Planet.GetName]'s gaseous atmosphere is the dark looming form of an enormous habitat - the Ix Belèn Residence. Previously a bustling space city where the residents enjoyed a pampered lifestyle with a multitude of comforts made available through technology, the habitat is now a silent tomb. Molluscoid aliens lie slumped across the floor in various states of decay. A postmortem reveals that they died from asphyxiation as the habitat's life support system was disabled, intentionally.

Their homes are fitted with unusual mechanical chairs that are hooked up to a central database in the shape of a gigantic blue orb - the Memorex.

endless_expanse_digsite_desc.zh:
乍一看，[From.Planet.GetName]上只有冰雪。雪白的大地、玻璃般晶莹的湖泊和锯齿状的松绿色冰川广袤无垠，火红的橘色天空映衬着地面，宛如裂开的伤口，将[From.Planet.Solar_System.GetName]中夕阳西下的红色光芒倾注在海面。如果世界有终结，那这里一定就是了。海面风平浪静，积雪一尘不染，唯一能听到的，只有冰层崩裂的咔嚓雷动和平原上呼啸的狂风。

然而，[From.Planet.GetName]曾经是某族的家园。在一片广阔而又贫瘠的旷野之中，一座黑色的金属尖塔从苍白的大地上突兀而起。积雪之下，究竟隐藏了怎样的被遗忘的秘密?
endless_expanse_digsite_desc.en:
At first sight there is only snow and ice on [From.Planet.GetName]. Vast expanses of impenetrable white, glass lakes and jagged turquoise glaciers against fiery orange skies torn open like a wound, pouring red into the seas as [From.Planet.Solar_System.GetName]'s stars set. If the world had an end this would be it. Here the seas lie still and the snow untouched. The only sounds are the thunder of the ice calving and the wind howling across the plains.

Yet, [From.Planet.GetName] was once someone's home. In the midst of a wide barren field the black metal framework of a steeple protrudes from the white masses. What forgotten secrets could be buried beneath the snow?

energy_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 我们短暂地接收到了非比寻常的能源示数，发射源来自[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。这有可能是我们的系统出现了故障，也有可能预示着我们发现了不得了的东西。
energy_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.

envoy_events.1.desc.zh: 似乎有第三方恶意入侵了驻在[Root.Capital.GetName]的[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使，[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果不同于平日宽宏的陈词滥调，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]开始恶毒地羞辱，把众人骂了个遍。[event_envoy.GetHerHis]设备的故障已被及时查明，但在此之前[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]已经被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”——他们肯定会对这种严重羞辱加以回应。
envoy_events.1.desc.en: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of the [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy to [Root.Capital.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that instead of uttering magnanimous platitudes, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] began spewing vicious insults that left none unscathed. The malfunction in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] equipment was duly uncovered, but not before [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]" - a grave insult which surely calls for a response.

envoy_events.10.A.en: We are saddened to hear this.

envoy_events.10.B.tooltip1.zh:
派出一支特别行动队将这对恋人抓捕归案。
[third_party.GetName]将会不满。
envoy_events.10.B.tooltip1.en:
Send a special ops team to retrieve the pair.
The [third_party.GetName] will be displeased.

envoy_events.10.desc.zh: 政治庇护于我们而言是神圣的。我方无法苟同你等的请求，交出那些没有做错任何事情的人们！
envoy_events.10.desc.en: Political asylum is sacred to us. We cannot countenance giving up those who have done no wrong to the likes of you!

envoy_events.100.b.zh: 我们没空管这些滑稽的把戏。忽略掉。
envoy_events.100.b.en: We are above such antics. Ignore them.

envoy_events.100.c.zh: 他们不值得受到我们的轻蔑。
envoy_events.100.c.en: They are not worthy of our scorn.

envoy_events.100.desc.gestalt.zh:
一名来自[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]的代表无意中透露了他们的格式塔国家在背地里对我们的真实感受。对于一个格式塔意识而言，盘算政治诽谤这种事显得尤为狭隘，因而这些对我们来说称得上是荒谬且有力的侮辱。

不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：外交手腕和我们的自尊心都要求我们坚持自己的立场，并反对这种离奇的[scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj]行为。
envoy_events.100.desc.gestalt.en:
A delegate from the [scandalous_insult_country.GetName] has let slip their gestalt's true feelings about us, apparently when in conference with other, anonymous parties. Given how petty it must be for a combined consciousness to even contemplate so-called 'political mud-slinging', these strike us as an absurd and potent insult.

Whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground against this bizarre [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] behavior.

envoy_events.100.desc.hostile.zh:
一名来自[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]的代表在与某匿名团体的会议上，竟敢说出他们那可怜的帝国对我们的真实感受。

这种荒谬的侮辱企图贬低我们，不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：我们的自尊都要求我们不能容忍它。
envoy_events.100.desc.hostile.en:
A delegate from the [scandalous_insult_country.GetName] has dared to let slip their pitiful empire's true feelings about us, apparently while in conference with other, anonymous parties.

This absurd insult seeks to belittle us, and whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: pride demands that we not stand for it.

envoy_events.100.desc.regular.zh:
我们无意中从[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]抓获了一个代表，其把他们帝国对我们的真实感受泄露给另一个匿名团体。这相较于通常的政治诽谤更为过分：已称得上是公然的侮辱，看来我们在[scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj]社会中已经是成了被大肆嘲笑的对象。

不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：外交手腕和我们的自尊心都要求我们坚持自己的立场。
envoy_events.100.desc.regular.en:
We have caught a delegate from the [scandalous_insult_country.GetName] in a rare blunder, letting slip their empire's true feelings about us to another, anonymous party. More than the usual political mud-slinging: these amount to an outright insult, as it appears we are the subjects of fierce ridicule amongst [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] society.

Whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground.

envoy_events.101.a.zh: 不管怎样，外交都变得更加困难了。
envoy_events.101.a.en: Either way, diplomacy just got trickier.

envoy_events.101.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]说我们的一名官员的不轨行为让他们被冒犯。他们没有指出这位官员的名字，也没有描述侮辱的类型。相反，我们在收到了一阵怒骂后，通讯就突然中断了。

这种罕见的外交破裂可能是因为一些其他势力的干预；也可能是纯粹的误解。
envoy_events.101.desc.en:
The [from.GetName] say they have taken offense at a misdemeanor carried out by one of our officials. They have not named the official, nor even described the nature of the insult. Instead we have received little more than a burst of indignation, and an abrupt end to communications.

It's possible that this rare breach in diplomacy is the work of some other, meddling party; it could just as easily be an honest misunderstanding.

envoy_events.11.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]似乎对我们拒绝向他们引渡其逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]非常不满，结果他们决定自己解决这个问题。这名逃亡者在我们眼皮子底下被绑架走了，似乎是一支训练有素的特别行动队在夜深人静时干了这件事。

我们未能保护那些寻求我们帮助的人们，这在我们的盟友间引起了不小的关注，我们的外交官正在试着收拾局面。
envoy_events.11.desc.en:
It seems the [From.GetName] were so displeased by our refusal to extradite their rogue envoy [event_envoy.GetName] to them that they took matters into their own hands. The fugitive was stolen from under our noses at dead of night by what appears to have been a very well-drilled team of special operatives.

Our inability to protect those who seek our aid has caused considerable concern among our allies, and our diplomats are scrambling to contain the situation.

envoy_events.12.desc.zh: 我们派去抓捕逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]的小队成功完成任务。这名罪犯已被安全地收监，等待[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的罪行招致的重惩。
envoy_events.12.desc.en: The team we sent to retrieve our rogue envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has successfully completed its mission. The criminal is now safely in our custody and faces a heavy punishment for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] sins.

envoy_events.13.desc.zh: [From.GetName]似乎对我们拒绝向他们引渡其逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]非常不满，结果他们打算自己解决这个问题，并发起了一项抓捕行动。不过，这项行动失败了，我们在[From.GetAdj]载有特别行动队员的舰船试图越过边境时将其拦截。同时我们也采取措施保证未来的企图也会以类似方式失败。
envoy_events.13.desc.en: It seems the [From.GetName] were so displeased by our refusal to extradite their rogue envoy [event_envoy.GetName] to them that they took matters into their own hands and launched a retrieval mission. However, this mission was bungled, as we intercepted the [From.GetAdj] vessel carrying their special operatives as it attempted to cross the border. Measures have been taken to ensure that future attempts will be similarly unsuccessful.

envoy_events.14.desc.zh: 我们派去抓捕逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]的小队未能完成任务；他们的舰船在试图越过边境时被抓到了[From.GetAdj]拘留点。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如预计中一般勃然大怒，抨击[Root.GetAdj]对他们事务的干涉。在他们看来，我国公民一定因我们对这件事的处理及抓捕罪犯失败而灰心丧气。
envoy_events.14.desc.en: The team we sent to retrieve our rogue envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], was unsuccessful in its mission; their vessel was taken into [From.GetAdj] custody as they tried to cross the border. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are predictably incensed and are decrying [Root.GetAdj] interference in their affairs. For their part, our citizens are dismayed at our handling of the affair and our failure to retrieve the criminal.

envoy_events.15.desc.zh:
我们派往星海共同体的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]，最近花在照料一只跟在[event_envoy.GetHerHim]身边的奇异小型哺乳动物的时间多到令人不安。想必这是某位其他代表的家庭宠物，它可爱非常，但没有任何开智的迹象。尽管它十分喜好肉食，牙尖爪利，总体上却温柔喜人，希望以抚摸的形式大量进行身体上的接触——可它的脾气有时会变得暴烈。

尽管这只生物已被证明会让[event_envoy.GetName]从更为严肃的任务中分心，其他代表却对[Root.GetSpeciesName]心灵中柔软、感性、惹人爱慕的一面多加赞誉。
envoy_events.15.desc.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our emissary to the Galactic Community, has been spending a disturbing amount of time tending to a strange, small mammalian creature that began following [event_envoy.GetHerHim] around. Presumably a domestic pet that escaped from one of the other delegations, it is undeniably cute but shows no sign of sapient thought. Although it is highly carnivorous and exhibits sharp teeth and claws, it is generally affectionate and desires plentiful physical contact in the form of petting - though its mood swings can be sudden and violent!

Although the creature has proved a distraction for [event_envoy.GetName]'s more serious tasks, other delegates have commented on the endearing nature of the softer, more sentimental side of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] psyche that has been revealed.

envoy_events.17.A.zh: 我们不会就自己的价值观妥协。
envoy_events.17.A.en: We cannot compromise on our values.

envoy_events.17.B.zh: 为了保持团结还是噤声为好。
envoy_events.17.B.en: We shall keep our silence in the interest of unity.

envoy_events.17.desc.authoritarian.zh:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于威权主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，旁观者越来越觉得我们侵犯个人自由是一种罪恶。

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.authoritarian.en:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more authoritarian outlook, with witnesses increasingly convinced at the alleged evil of impinging on the liberties of the individual.

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

envoy_events.17.desc.egalitarian.zh:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于平等主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，那些生活在不太自由的社会中的人们看不到自由的好处，反而指责我们为“危险的自由主义”。

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.egalitarian.en:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more egalitarian outlook, as those living in less free societies failed to see the benefits that greater liberties would give them, instead accusing us of being "dangerously liberal".

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

envoy_events.17.desc.materialist.zh:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于唯物主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，现场情势愈发紧张，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis]的同僚不断谴责[Root.GetAdj]“享乐主义”，坚持认为他们的迷信观念十分优越。

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.materialist.en:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more materialistic outlook, and grew increasingly rattled as [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] peers continued to decry [Root.GetAdj] "hedonism", insisting on the superiority of their superstitious ways.

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

envoy_events.17.desc.militarist.zh:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于军国主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，辩论逐渐对[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim]变得不利，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]看起来愈发紧张，在场各方都在向[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim]指责“[Root.GetAdj]穷兵黩武”。

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.militarist.en:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more militaristic outlook, and as the debate turned against [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim], [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] appeared increasingly rattled as accusations of "[Root.GetAdj] warmongering" were made against [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim] from all sides.

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

envoy_events.17.desc.pacifist.zh:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于和平主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，与会的其他人员大声叫嚷，斥责“[Root.GetAdj]的幼稚无知”威胁到了整个联邦的安全。

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.pacifist.en:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more pacifistic outlook, and faced vociferous retorts from all quarters that "[Root.GetAdj] naivety" allegedly threatens the safety of the entire federation.

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

envoy_events.17.desc.spiritualist.zh:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于唯心主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，旁观者纷纷摇头反对，认为[Root.GetAdj]“迷信”十分“陈腐”。

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.spiritualist.en:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more spiritualist outlook, and witnesses were left shaking their head at the "backwardness" of [Root.GetAdj] "superstitions".

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

envoy_events.17.desc.xenophile.zh:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于亲外主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis]的观点被断然谴责成“危险的自由主义”。

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.xenophile.en:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more xenophilic outlook, with [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] outlook flatly condemned as "dangerously liberal".

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

envoy_events.17.desc.xenophobe.zh:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于排外主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis]关于我们应当留意外来影响的郑重声明被说成是空洞、陈腐的偏见。

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.xenophobe.en:
$envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more xenophobic outlook, with [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] protestations that we should be wary of foreign influences decried as hollow and backwards prejudice.

$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

envoy_events.18.A.zh: 他们只是受不了我们道路的优越罢了。
envoy_events.18.A.en: They simply could not bear the superiority of our ways.

envoy_events.19.A.zh: 我们能靠言语说服别人。
envoy_events.19.A.en: Through our words shall we persuade.

envoy_events.2.B.zh: 真是对[From.GetAdj]社会的高贵贡献。

envoy_events.2.desc.neg.zh:
$envoy_events.2.desc.base$

尽管故障被迅速查明，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不觉得这个事故好笑，并且正式控诉了我国特使的不当行为。
envoy_events.2.desc.neg.en:
$envoy_events.2.desc.base$

Although the malfunction was swiftly uncovered, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not amused at the incident and have lodged an official complaint at the inappropriate behavior of our envoy.

envoy_events.2.desc.pos.zh:
$envoy_events.2.desc.base$

幸好，故障被迅速查明，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对这个事故报以幽默。不过“[Root.GetAdj]特使不当行为”的记录广为流传，在他国人民中被引为笑谈。
envoy_events.2.desc.pos.en:
$envoy_events.2.desc.base$

Fortunately, the malfunction was swiftly uncovered and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took the incident with a sense of humor. Indeed, recordings of the "inappropriate [Root.GetAdj] envoy" are circulating widely, causing much mirth among their people.

envoy_events.200.A.en: What could be the harm in it?

envoy_events.200.desc.zh:
星海共同体中夹杂着一阵不和谐的杂音，不是所有人都很友好，肯定地说这其中必有与[Root.GetAdj]利益不一致的人。不妙的是，使者[event_envoy.GetName]似乎正在听取某种错误的声音。在参加由[Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]主办的几场会议中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]的眉毛止不住地上翘。现在一切都水落石出了，一笔可以追溯到某个组织的巨款被查明汇入了[event_envoy.GetHerHim]的账户。

[event_envoy.GetName]的同事们要求将[event_envoy.GetSheHe]召回并发起不信任议案。然而，某些更为狡诈的顾问建议我们和[event_envoy.GetHerHim]达成一笔交易，维持其现有职位以换取获得情报的机会。
envoy_events.200.desc.en:
A cacophony of voices may be heard in the Galactic Community - not all of them friendly, and certainly not all of them aligning with [Root.GetAdj] interests. Unfortunately, it seems that emissary [event_envoy.GetName] has been listening to the wrong voices. Eyebrows were raised when [event_envoy.GetSheHe] attended several conferences hosted by the [Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]. Now it has emerged that a large sum of credits traceable to that organization were transferred to [event_envoy.GetHerHim].
