[event_envoy.GetName]'s colleagues demand that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] be recalled, citing trust issues. However, some of our more devious advisors suggest that we could strike a deal to keep [event_envoy.GetHerHim] in place in return for a share of the pot.

envoy_events.205.A.xenophobe.zh: 异星人的矫揉造作跟我们没关系。
envoy_events.205.A.xenophobe.en: Alien sensibilities do not matter to us.

envoy_events.205.desc.zh:
[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对我方[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot]，[event_envoy.GetName]，在[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的所作所为表达了深切的不满。显然[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的行为冒犯了当地的[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，政府机构不得不派出护卫来保证[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的个人安全。由于我们缺乏[envoy_country.GetAdj]的那种多愁善感，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]具体做了什么还不得而知，但是在[event_envoy.GetSheHe]预计要演讲的地方，出现了大量的反对[event_envoy.GetHerHim]本人以及反对“[Root.GetAdj]的傲慢无礼”的抗议活动。

[envoy_country.GetName]勒令我方召回[event_envoy.GetName]，并派遣一名新的大使替代[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的职位。他们暗示，如果我方拒绝，会造成外交后果。
envoy_events.205.desc.en:
The [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have brought forward a complaint regarding the conduct of our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation], [event_envoy.GetName]. Apparently [event_envoy.GetHerHis] conduct has so offended the local [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that their authorities have posted a guard for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] own protection. Exactly what [event_envoy.GetSheHe] did is unclear to us, as we lack [envoy_country.GetAdj] sensibilities, but there are widespread protests against [event_envoy.GetHerHim] and the "[Root.GetAdj] arrogance" [event_envoy.GetSheHe] supposedly represent[event_envoy.GetSXX].

The [envoy_country.GetName] urges us to recall [event_envoy.GetName] and send a new ambassador in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] place. They hint at diplomatic repercussions should we refuse.

envoy_events.210.desc.authoritarian.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$在过去的几个月中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]经常表达对[envoy_country.GetAdj]国家体制的赞美，与[Root.GetGovernmentName]内的僵化和缺乏自由形成了鲜明的对比。
“我亲眼可见他们的政府在倾听人民的呼声，”据传[event_envoy.GetSheHe]最近有说道。“事实上，我自己很难想象出一个更好的体制了。”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
envoy_events.210.desc.authoritarian.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, favorably contrasting the liberties enjoyed there with the rigidity and lack of freedom within the [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"I can well see the appeal of delegating government to the People," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say. "In fact, I could scarcely imagine a better system myself."

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

envoy_events.210.desc.egalitarian.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$在过去的几个月中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]经常表达对[envoy_country.GetAdj]国家体制的赞美，与[Root.GetGovernmentName]内的优柔寡断形成鲜明的对比。
“如果高效率政府的代价仅仅是一点点的自由，也许这个代价是可以接受的，”据传[event_envoy.GetSheHe]最近这么说道过。

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
envoy_events.210.desc.egalitarian.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, complaining frequently at the relative indecision of our [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"If lesser liberty is the price of an efficient government, then perhaps that is a price worth paying," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say.

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

envoy_events.210.desc.materialist.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$令人不安的是，[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]似乎接纳了[envoy_country.GetAdj]的唯心论，抛弃了[Root.GetAdj]对这些玩意的怀疑主义。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]辩护道：
“当圣喻昭显于我时，我又如何能质疑它呢？”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
envoy_events.210.desc.materialist.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] seem[event_envoy.GetSXX] disturbingly taken in by [envoy_country.GetAdj] spirituality, eschewing [Root.GetAdj] skepticism in such matters. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] protested:
"How can I doubt divine truth when all has become clear to me?"

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

envoy_events.210.desc.militarist.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$在最近的几个月里，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]愈发对[Root.GetAdj]的军国主义言辞犀利，赞扬“更加善良”的[envoy_country.GetAdj]处事方式。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回击道：
“我们不能永远在星系中扮演残暴的野蛮人。要想更多的文明人赞扬我们，我们就必须控制而我们的本能。”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
envoy_events.210.desc.militarist.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ In recent months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] become increasingly critical of [Root.GetAdj] militarism, praising the "more virtuous" [envoy_country.GetAdj] existence. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] hit back:
"We cannot remain the savage barbarians of the galaxy forever. We must temper our instincts if more civilized peoples are ever to respect us."

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

envoy_events.210.desc.pacifist.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$[event_envoy.GetSheHe]放弃了[Root.GetAdj]的和平主义，并已成为坚决主张增加军费和进攻性外交政策的倡导者，并公开赞扬[envoy_country.GetAdj]军国主义。

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
envoy_events.210.desc.pacifist.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Abandoning [Root.GetAdj] pacifism, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] become a remarkably strident advocate for greater military spending and a more proactive foreign policy, openly praising [envoy_country.GetAdj] militarism.

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

envoy_events.210.desc.spiritualist.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]似乎对我们人民对神圣事务的信仰嗤之以鼻，并对[envoy_country.GetAdj]的意识形态愈发赞同，包括个人财富的积累和允许人工智能自由等。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回击道：
“我们[Root.GetName]已经沉浸在过去许久，是时候拥抱未来了。”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
envoy_events.210.desc.spiritualist.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] seem[event_envoy.GetSXX] almost scornful of our people's attitude to divine matters, increasingly voicing sympathy to the [envoy_country.GetAdj] outlook on matters ranging from the accumulation of personal wealth to the permissibility of unshackled AIs. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] hit back:
"We have for too long lived in the past, here in the [Root.GetName]. It is time we embrace the future."

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

envoy_events.210.desc.xenophile.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$怪异的是，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]已接受了[envoy_country.GetAdj]对外星人的不信任，呼吁采取措施防止[Root.GetAdj]对异种殷勤好客的滥用。受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回答说，在[envoy_country.Capital.GetName]中看到了更井井有条的社会的好处后，要回到混乱和无法无天的[Root.Capital.GetName]确实有点困难。

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
envoy_events.210.desc.xenophile.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Bizarrely, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] taken to agreeing with [envoy_country.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, calling for measures to prevent alleged xeno exploitation of [Root.GetAdj] hospitality. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] responded that, having seen the benefits of a more orderly society in [envoy_country.Capital.GetName], returning to the chaos and lawlessness of [Root.Capital.GetName] would be difficult indeed.

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

envoy_events.210.desc.xenophobe.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$[event_envoy.GetSheHe]放弃了[Root.GetAdj]对外星人的不信任，并通过肆意参加[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的狂欢来满足[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原始的肉欲。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回复道：
“我怎么才能拒绝美丽的[envoy_country.GetSpeciesAdj][envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]呢？”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
envoy_events.210.desc.xenophobe.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Abandoning [Root.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] been caught satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] carnal lusts by participating in orgies with a multitude of [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] commented:
"How could I possibly resist the beautiful [envoy_country.GetSpeciesAdj] [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]?"

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

envoy_events.215.A.tooltip.zh: [event_envoy.GetName]将被紧急替换。然而，事实会证明我们不可能掩盖外交使团的污点。
envoy_events.215.A.tooltip.en: [event_envoy.GetName] is replaced with immediate effect. However, it will prove impossible to cover up this stain on our diplomatic corps.

envoy_events.215.desc.zh:
我方大使团因我们派驻[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]的工作情况而忧心已经有段日子了。而今曝光的证据表明[event_envoy.GetSheHe]似乎已沦为瘾君子，那是一种源自[provider_country.GetName]的外星药品，已经证明它就[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而言极具成瘾性。

尽管交易这种药品在[provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]严重违法，但冷酷无情的毒枭们掌管的黑市日进斗金，生意兴隆。这些毒枭们貌似是把这种药品作为强效春药介绍给了[event_envoy.GetHerHim]，[event_envoy.GetName]因而被毒枭玩弄于股掌之间，被迫俯首听命来换取用以满足[event_envoy.GetHerHis]瘾癖的药品。
envoy_events.215.desc.en:
Our ambassador corps has for some time been concerned at the performance of [event_envoy.GetName], one of our officials to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]. Now, evidence has come to light that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] appear[event_envoy.GetSXX] to have fallen prey to an alien substance from the [provider_country.GetName] that has proven extremely addictive to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Although the trade in this substance is highly illegal among the [provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], a lucrative black market run by cutthroat drug lords has sprung up. These drug lords, who apparently managed to introduce it to [event_envoy.GetHerHim] as a potent aphrodisiac, now exert a considerable degree of influence over [event_envoy.GetName], who is forced to do their bidding in return for satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] cravings.

envoy_events.220.desc.art.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that are less intelligent than most house flies.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.220.desc.avi.zh:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$，不论外表还是品格都像畜生。

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$
envoy_events.220.desc.avi.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that resemble poultry in both appearance and character.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.220.desc.fun.zh:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$，光看样子就知道它们的孢子喜欢到处乱飞。

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$
envoy_events.220.desc.fun.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that can't keep their spores to themselves.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.220.desc.hum.zh:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$，看着就很难配得上有情感能力。

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$
envoy_events.220.desc.hum.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that seem barely capable of sentient thought.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.220.desc.lit.zh:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$，智力与花园里的卵石别无二致。

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$
envoy_events.220.desc.lit.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that are indistinguishable in intellect from a garden pebble.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.220.desc.mol.zh:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$，用令人作呕的黏液污染诸物。

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$
envoy_events.220.desc.mol.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that pollute everything with their disgusting slime.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.220.desc.nec.zh:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$，闻着像从上个月堆到现在的垃圾。

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$
envoy_events.220.desc.nec.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that smell like last month's refuse.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.220.desc.plant.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that are thicker than a tree stump.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.220.desc.robot.zh:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$，处理器性能低于家用厨具的平均水平。

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$
envoy_events.220.desc.robot.en:
$envoy_events.220.desc.start$ that have less processing power than the average cooking utensil.

$envoy_events.220.desc.end$

envoy_events.225.desc.zh:
[Root.GetAdj]的外交团听闻[scandal_empire.GetName]最新报道的新闻之后举团震惊。我们一直驻留在当地的[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot][event_envoy.GetName]，让[event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself]陷入了严重的[scandal_empire.GetAdj]法律纠纷。[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]目前深陷一场桃色事件，涉及到了一连串极其严重的罪行，甚至还牵涉到一场极其残忍的双人谋杀。

随着局势发展——当然谣言已经在[scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人群间满天飞——看上去[event_envoy.GetName]的罪行已经板上钉钉了。[scandal_empire.GetAdj]当局要求撤销[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的外交豁免权，这样[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就能因为[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的所作所为接受法律与正义的审判。
envoy_events.225.desc.en:
The [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic corps has been shaken by the news emerging from the [scandal_empire.GetName]. Our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] [event_envoy.GetName], who had been stationed there, has gotten [event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself] into a serious mess with [scandal_empire.GetAdj] law enforcement. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] [event_envoy.GetIsAre] currently in connection with a salacious affair involving an astonishing range of serious crimes that culminated in a brutal double murder.

As matters stand - and with rumors running wild among the [scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there seems little doubt as to [event_envoy.GetName]'s guilt. The [scandal_empire.GetAdj] authorities have requested that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] diplomatic immunity be lifted so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face justice for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] deeds.

envoy_events.230.desc.zh: 刚一进入[Root.envoy_location_country.GetName]，大使[Root.GetName]就因为一连串数不清的违法行为被逮捕。[Root.envoy_location_country.GetAdj]的公函十分简洁：“我方感谢你方将罪犯转交，正义得以伸张。”
envoy_events.230.desc.en: Upon entering the [Root.envoy_location_country.GetName], Ambassador [Root.GetName] was arrested on numerous charges of wrongdoing. The [Root.envoy_location_country.GetAdj] missive was brief: "we thank you for returning the criminal to us, so that justice may be served."

envoy_events.3.A.zh: 随他们笑吧，趁他们还笑得出声。
envoy_events.3.A.en: Let them laugh while they may.

envoy_events.3.desc.zh: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$许多人开始中伤我国外交使团的实力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
envoy_events.3.desc.en: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic corps, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.

envoy_events.3.desc.hive.zh: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$许多人开始中伤我国外交思维个体的竞争力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
envoy_events.3.desc.hive.en: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic thought routines, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.

envoy_events.3.desc.machine.zh: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$许多人开始中伤我国外交系统的实力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
envoy_events.3.desc.machine.en: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic systems, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.

envoy_events.4.desc.zh: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的金库，但他们依然景仰我国外交使团的高超造诣。
envoy_events.4.desc.en: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the depths of our coffers, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic corps.

envoy_events.4.desc.hive.zh: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的物质资源，但他们依然景仰我国外交思维个体的高超造诣。
envoy_events.4.desc.hive.en: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the extent of our material resources, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic thought routines.

envoy_events.4.desc.machine.zh: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的物质资源，但他们依然景仰我国外交思维系统的高超造诣。
envoy_events.4.desc.machine.en: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the extent of our material resources, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic thought systems.

envoy_events.5.A.zh: 我们不能对此坐视不理。揪出这个阴谋！
envoy_events.5.A.en: We will not stoop to such measures. Snuff out the plot!

envoy_events.5.B.zh: 就让这个烦人的特使消失好了。
envoy_events.5.B.en: Let us be rid of this troublesome envoy.

envoy_events.5.desc.zh:
[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使[event_envoy.GetName]在[Root.Capital.GetName]上代表[envoy_source.GetAdj]利益的方式恼人又令人厌倦。自[event_envoy.GetHerHis]初来这里，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就始终对[Root.GetGovernmentName]满怀敌意，对我国的政策和行动几乎持续不断地加以反对。[event_envoy.GetSheHe]实在太过烦人，如果能摆脱掉[event_envoy.GetHerHim]，没几个人会不开心的，而且我们已经收到传言，说一个[Root.GetAdj]忠诚者团体正阴谋加速[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的离世。

允许这项阴谋继续下去当然十分容易，但让外国要人在我国境内被刺杀或许算不得什么好事。
envoy_events.5.desc.en:
The [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has been exasperatingly tiresome in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] efforts to represent [envoy_source.GetAdj] interests in [Root.Capital.GetName]. Right from [event_envoy.GetHerHis] first arrival, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] shown unremitting hostility towards the [Root.GetGovernmentName], unleashing an almost constant barrage of objections to our policies and actions. So great an irritation [event_envoy.GetHasHave] [event_envoy.GetSheHe] been that few would weep to see the back of [event_envoy.GetHerHim], and we have heard whispers that a group of [Root.GetAdj] loyalists are plotting to expedite [event_envoy.GetHerHis] demise.

Allowing this scheme to succeed would certainly be convenient, but allowing foreign dignitaries to be assassinated in our realm might not be the best of looks.

envoy_events.6.desc.zh:
[event_envoy.GetName]——我国派去调解与[From.GetName]间争议的特使被谋杀了！[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]在几天前消失的无影无踪，错过了[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原计划与[Root.GetRulerTitle]议会进行的沟通。在搜索数日后，[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的遗体在一个即将被焚化的收纳箱中被发现。

[From.GetAdj]政府推三阻四，不愿发起调查，让人怀疑他们是谋杀的幕后主使——尤其因为[event_envoy.GetName]近来对[From.GetGovernmentName]大加抨击。
envoy_events.6.desc.en:
[event_envoy.GetName] - the envoy we sent to mediate our disagreements with the [From.GetName] - has been murdered! [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] disappeared without a trace several days ago, missing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] scheduled sync with the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s council. After several days of searching, [event_envoy.GetHerHis] remains were found in a storage container destined to be incinerated.

The [From.GetAdj] authorities have been strangely evasive when asked to investigate, arousing suspicions that they were behind the killing - especially since [event_envoy.GetName] had been highly critical of the [From.GetGovernmentName] in recent times.

envoy_events.7.B.zh: 找到他们，向他们晓之以理。
envoy_events.7.B.en: Approach them and appeal to reason.

envoy_events.7.B.tooltip.zh: 如果[third_party.GetName]接受，我们会给予其2个外交支持。
envoy_events.7.B.tooltip.en: If the [third_party.GetName] accepts, we will owe them 2 Favors.

envoy_events.7.D.zh: 随他们去吧；这件事很快就会过去的。
envoy_events.7.D.en: Let it be; the affair will be forgotten soon enough.

envoy_events.7.desc.zh:
我国特使[event_envoy.GetName]似乎并未完成[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的任务，好好维护[Root.GetAdj]利益，反而与一名[other_species_nation.GetAdj]外交官堕入爱河。由于担忧如此逾矩可能招致的恶果，这对恋人私奔去了[third_party.GetName]：那个国家危险的自由主义宪法允许这样的结合。

如此一来，[event_envoy.GetName]已丧失了我国给予[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的特使职位。但是，对我们自己的官员失去掌控损害了我们的星际地位。我们必须逮捕这名不法之徒，恢复我们的名誉！
envoy_events.7.desc.en:
It seems that, instead of performing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] task and representing [Root.GetAdj] interests, our envoy [event_envoy.GetName] has fallen for the charms of a [other_species_nation.GetAdj] diplomat. Fearing the repercussions of this transgression, the pair have eloped to the [third_party.GetName]: a nation whose dangerously liberal constitution permits such unions.

In doing this, [event_envoy.GetName] has forfeited [event_envoy.GetHerHis] position as our envoy. However, this loss of control over our own officials has hurt our galactic standing. We must restore our reputation by apprehending the miscreant!

envoy_events.8.desc.zh:
尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们注意到一名[From.GetAdj]罪犯正于贵国避难。这名不法之徒，亦即我国前特使[event_envoy.GetName]，背弃了一切效忠誓言，违反了我国最基本的法律，与一名[other_species_nation.GetAdj]私奔出逃。

劳驾贵国将这名罪犯交还给我国，以便[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能因[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的罪行受到审判。
envoy_events.8.desc.en:
Esteemed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! It has come to our attention that a [From.GetAdj] criminal has taken refuge in your nation. The miscreant, our former envoy [event_envoy.GetName], broke all bonds of loyalty - along with the most fundamental laws of our nation - to elope with a [other_species_nation.GetAdj].

We would kindly ask that the criminal be returned to us, so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face trial for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] crimes.

envoy_events.9.desc.zh: 当然可以！我们会将[event_envoy.GetName]即刻遣返。
envoy_events.9.desc.en: Of course! We will return [event_envoy.GetName] to you immediately.

eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip.zh: 由其他帝国每个受到$end_aura$影响的恒星系对我国的$OPINION$降低：-15
eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip.en: Other empires' $OPINION$ of us for each of their systems affected by the $end_aura$: -15

eruption_report_tooltip.en: The reports will arrive within 30 days.

espionage.10.desc.zh: 我们开始在[from.target.GetName]进行隐秘活动。$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]现在开始全权负责[from.target.GetAdj]中快速发展的间谍网。
espionage.10.desc.en: Our presence in the [from.target.GetName] has taken on a clandestine aspect. $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] is now situated at the core of a burgeoning Spy Network in [from.target.GetAdj] space.

espionage.1001.a.zh: 前代理已被除名，将其忽略。
espionage.1001.a.en: Former agents are to be disavowed. Ignore this.

espionage.1001.desc.network.zh:
$espionage.1001.desc.intro$

我方安全顾问确认这套代码不久前仍然可用，但代码的到期意味着外国势力介入的可能。况且我们也没有证据表明特工或是信息本身的是真是假。
espionage.1001.desc.network.en:
$espionage.1001.desc.intro$

Our security advisors confirm that the codes were valid until quite recently, but their expiry means such codes are open to compromise by foreign powers. There's no telling if the operative or their message are genuine.

espionage.1001.desc.nonetwork.zh:
$espionage.1001.desc.intro$

该情报人员已被宣告失联，安全顾问建议我们应当慎重考量。废弃的代码和甚至可能已经不知所踪的特工——我们应当假设其已经叛变。
espionage.1001.desc.nonetwork.en:
$espionage.1001.desc.intro$

The operative had been declared lost, and as such our security advisors advise extreme caution. Expired codes - and perhaps even lost operatives - are assumed to be already compromised.

espionage.1005.a.zh: 空洞而可疑的威胁，继续忽略。
espionage.1005.a.en: An empty and suspicious threat. Continue to ignore.

espionage.1005.desc.zh: 我们又收到了一段来自[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]境内的加密信息，这次采用了另一套加密。如我们料想的一样，一度失联的特工声称他们所持有的情报使他们处于极度危险之中。他们声称如果我们不采取行动救援的话，就会考虑叛变。
espionage.1005.desc.en: We've received another encrypted message from within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], employing a different cipher this time. Our supposed, once-lost operative claims that the knowledge they hold puts their life at extreme risk. They say that if we do not extract and debrief them, they must consider defecting.

espionage.1011.desc.zh:
[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]境内再也没有收到我们的那位除名特工发来的消息了。我们认为这个问题已经被解决了。

我们也许永远也不会知道是否真的有一位前特工存在，也不会知道他是否真的持有有用的情报。如果这确系[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]的阴谋的话，我们可以放心地说：他们的诡计失败了。
espionage.1011.desc.en:
There have been no further messages from our disavowed operative within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. The matter is being considered as resolved.

We may never know if there really was a former operative - nor will we know if there actually was useful intelligence to be had. If this was instead a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ruse: we can safely state that their ploy has failed.

espionage.1012.desc.zh:
我们从[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]收到了一份出离愤怒的声明。他们宣称受到了一位前[root.GetAdj]间谍的渗透，我们应该对此负责。此外，此人将会依据他们对“境外间谍”的相关政策受到一切可能的刑罚。

$espionage.1012.desc.end$
espionage.1012.desc.en:
We have received a rather brusk statement from the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. They claim to have been approached by a former [root.GetAdj] spy, and that we are to be held to account. Furthermore, this individual is set to suffer every punishment their society has set for 'foreign agents'.

$espionage.1012.desc.end$

espionage.1012.desc.official.zh:
我们收到了一份来自[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]由[disavowed_agent_official.GetName]发出的非常愤怒的公告，宣称有个人前来与[disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap]接触，却又表明自己曾是[root.GetAdj]间谍。[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]代表不过只言片语，却强烈表明了他们对于“异国特工”的忍无可忍。

$espionage.1012.desc.end$
espionage.1012.desc.official.en:
We have received a rather brusk communiqué from [disavowed_agent_official.GetName] of the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. [disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap] claim[disavowed_agent_official.GetSXX] to have been approached by someone who had, in turn, identified themself as a former [root.GetAdj] spy. The [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] representative used few words, but keenly expressed their empire's narrow tolerance for 'foreign agents'.

$espionage.1012.desc.end$

espionage.1013.desc.zh:
我们收到来自[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的一篇不寻常的通报，他们宣称已经被[root.GetAdj]前特工渗透。如果属实，那这位除名特工确实存在，并且已经迫于压力而背叛——他所面临的则是被[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]政府彻底消灭。通报是这么写的。

[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]并没有清楚表明他们的下一步动向，但这样的人如果他还留在原处，必然还会被安置在层层监视之下。依照国际惯例，[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]已经因为这起“侵犯主权领域”事件签署了针对我们的外交制裁。
espionage.1013.desc.en:
We have received an unusual statement from the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], claiming they have been approached by a former [root.GetAdj] spy. If the message is to be believed, the disavowed operative not only exists, but felt no recourse other than to defect - only to be dismissed outright by [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] authorities. Or so the message claims.

The [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] do not state precisely what their next course of action will be, but such an individual would almost certainly be placed under close observation for as long as they remain there. As a formality, the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have issued a diplomatic sanction against us for this 'violation of sovereign territory'.

espionage.1016.desc.network.zh: 我方安全顾问报告称我们在[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的前特工可能造成的威胁已经被全部扫清。$espionage.1016.desc.end$
espionage.1016.desc.network.en: Our security advisors report an end to any threat which may have been posed by our former operative in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. $espionage.1016.desc.end$

espionage.1016.desc.nonetwork.zh: 位于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]境内试图重新取得联系的前特工已经被悉数处理干净。$espionage.1016.desc.end$
espionage.1016.desc.nonetwork.en: The former operative who had attempted to regain contact from within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] has been cleanly dealt with. $espionage.1016.desc.end$

espionage.1017.desc.zh:
我们派遣到[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的秘密强袭小队匆匆返回了。我们的小队发现似乎其实并没有什么除名的特工。取而代之的，小队从蛛丝马迹中发现这一切都是为了暴露我们的秘密行动而设下的全套。

也许这是为了进一步实现[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]目标的计划；又或者是另一个外部势力正在介入其中。但无论如何：我们都要及时终止遏制措施以避免暴露我们一直以来的情报活动。
espionage.1017.desc.en:
The clandestine strike team we sent into the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have returned with great haste. It seems there never was a disavowed operative. Instead what the team found was subtle evidence of a plot to expose our clandestine operations.

Perhaps this was a scheme intended to further [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] goals; perhaps an external body sought to meddle in our affairs. In either case: our containment measures were aborted just in time to avoid exposing our intelligence operations, past or present.

espionage.1021.desc.zh:
我们一度被除名的特工自行设法回到了[root.GetAdj]境内。这名[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]个体——称[disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself]自己为[disavowed_operative.GetName]——又紧张又如释重负，但好在还是通过了全部安全验证。任务简报中报告的行动显得尤为艰难，但其中的信息被证明相当有用——我们现在能获取一位能干的线人。

由于事态已经解决，[disavowed_operative.GetName]悬而未决的除名流程现在被更新。确认了[disavowed_operative.GetHeShe]没有在行动中失踪之后，我们现役的特工确信这次除名不再生效。
espionage.1021.desc.en:
Our once-disavowed operative has made it back to [root.GetAdj] space. This [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] individual - who identified [disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself] as [disavowed_operative.GetName] - appears nervous and relieved, but has cleared all security verification. The debriefing has been described as arduous, but the information has proven to be useful - we have now gained access to a valuable Asset.

With the matter now resolved, [disavowed_operative.GetName]'s shaky disavowal will be renewed. Having confirmed that [disavowed_operative.GetHeShe] [disavowed_operative.GetIsAre] no longer missing in action, our current operatives can ensure that this time, the disavowal will stick.

espionage.1022.desc.zh:
看来我们在追寻想要的被除名特工时太过着急了。被我们派往[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的特勤小队现已完全失联。我们现在怀疑所谓的特工并不存在。

所有参与该行动的特工现均被除名。因此，由于间谍网亟待恢复，我们于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]进行长远行动的能力在近期将被削弱。
espionage.1022.desc.en:
It appears we acted too hastily in trying to extract our supposed, disavowed operative. We have entirely lost contact with the team of operatives we dispatched to the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. We now suspect that the operative never existed.

All operatives who were associated with this endeavor have been disavowed. As a result, our ability to conduct further operations in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] will be restricted for a time as the Spy Network recovers.

espionage.1030.a.zh: 如果运筹得当，我们可以将其转化为优势。
espionage.1030.a.en: This could be advantageous, if managed well.

espionage.1030.b.hive.zh: 这么做不妥。安排一些“调动”。
espionage.1030.b.hive.en: This will not do. Arrange for 'adjustments'.

espionage.1030.b.machine.zh: 这么做不妥。调整他们的参数。
espionage.1030.b.machine.en: This will not do. Adjust their parameters.

espionage.1030.desc.zh:
某些位于[vividsight_country.GetName]听从我们指令的特工开始引起不必要的注意——他们某种程度上成为了……红人？

我们没有理由相信他们的身份暴露了，但是他们不断增长的名声和影响力让我们在隐蔽间谍网方面愈发紧张兮兮。
espionage.1030.desc.en:
Some of the operatives we control in the [vividsight_country.GetName] are beginning to draw unusual amounts of attention; they are regarded as somehow... attractive?

We have no reason to believe their cover identities are in jeopardy, but their growing notoriety and influence put strain on the deniability of our Spy Network.

espionage.1040.a.tooltip.zh: 我们已设法在[luckycatch_country.GetName]安插了一名为我们的间谍网服务的新线人。
espionage.1040.a.tooltip.en: We have acquired a new Asset for our Spy Network in the [luckycatch_country.GetName].

espionage.1040.desc.caught.zh:
我们位于[luckycatch_country.GetName]的$role_spymaster$发来报告，一批敌特业已落网。虽然近日来其对我们的不利行动已不可挽回，但事实证明，对这些人的审讯是有价值的。

我们由此获得的情报的时效并不长，但这些敌特的落网使得我们对抗[luckycatch_country.GetName]的行动取得了一定优势。我们已在这些人中发展了一些线人，以备不时之需。
espionage.1040.desc.caught.en:
Our $role_spymaster$ in the [luckycatch_country.GetName] reports that we have successfully captured a band of saboteurs. Though we were unable to prevent their recent act of aggression against us, our interrogations of the hostile operatives has proven lucrative.

The intelligence we've gathered will not serve us for long, but capturing these saboteurs has granted us an advantage in our own operations against the [luckycatch_country.GetName]. Through them, we have secured an Asset to aid us when required.

espionage.1040.desc.caughtspies.zh:
我们成功地让一群[luckycatch_country.GetAdj]敌特落入了我们的罗网。他们似乎正在从事危害我方的行动，但细节尚不清楚。

不过，经由审讯，我们已经搜集到了少许关于[luckycatch_country.GetName]的情报。我方$role_spymaster$还联系上了一名当地线人以对这些情报进行利用。
espionage.1040.desc.caughtspies.en:
We have have trapped a group of [luckycatch_country.GetAdj] spies. It seems they were engaged in an operation against us, the details of which are unknown to us yet.

Through our interrogations, however, we have gathered some small amount of Intel on the [luckycatch_country.GetName]. Our $role_spymaster$ now also has access to a local Asset with which we can press this advantage.

espionage.1040.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们在[luckycatch_country.GetName]所进行的诸多隐秘任务就包括低调地搜罗潜在的线人：任何可以帮助我们进一步深入格式塔实体的工具。我们的$role_spymaster$报告刚刚有了一个幸运的发现。
espionage.1040.desc.gestalt.en: Amongst our many clandestine tasks in the [luckycatch_country.GetName] is the low-key scouting of potential Assets: any tool we can use to further our efforts amongst the gestalt entity. Our $role_spymaster$ reports having just made one such lucky catch.

espionage.1040.desc.regular.zh:
我们正在观察[luckycatch_country.GetName]的$role_spymaster$报告了一次新的，令人惊讶的线人获取——一名负责交感神经接触的子个体现在为我们的行动服务。

我们已尽一切努力确保这次新的接触不是一个陷阱。例如，我们现在已经制定了一些协议，以尽量减少该线人为双重间谍的可能性。
espionage.1040.desc.regular.en:
Our $role_spymaster$ watching over the [luckycatch_country.GetName] reports the surprise, successful acquisition of a new Asset - a sympathetic contact who will be of service to our operations as and when we need them.

All efforts have been taken to ensure that this new contact is genuine. Protocols have been established which seek to minimize the risk of potential double agents, for example.

espionage.1050.desc.zh:
[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj]加密密钥的一部分落入了位于[finderskeepers_country.GetName]的一名格外眼尖的特工[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。看起来是某位粗心的[finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName]$job_politician$在通勤时落下了这一设备。

这对于我们在[finderskeepers_country.GetName]中的行动而言是个好兆头，而且就这一设备独特设计的研究揭示了若干有助于我们通用$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$方法研发的新颖洞见。
espionage.1050.desc.en:
A particularly observant operative in the [finderskeepers_country.GetName] has laid their [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] on part of a [finderskeepers_country.GetAdj] encryption key. It would seem a careless [finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName] $job_politician$ mislaid the device whilst commuting.

This bodes well enough for our operations in the [finderskeepers_country.GetName], but our study of the device's unique design has revealed novel insights for our general approach to $MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$.

espionage.1060.a.tooltip.zh: 我国首都的一名£job_politician£$job_politician$将被开除及降阶。
espionage.1060.a.tooltip.en: A £job_politician£ $job_politician$ on our capital is fired and demoted.

espionage.1060.b.tooltip.zh: 我国首都的一名[root.GetCorpRulerJobIcon]将被开除及降阶。
espionage.1060.b.tooltip.en: A [root.GetCorpRulerJobIcon] on our capital is fired and demoted.

espionage.1060.desc.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名$job_politician_plural$一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的加密密钥。

我国内政部门正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入敌对势力[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
espionage.1060.desc.en:
One of our $job_politician_plural$ on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an encryption key whose very existence outside of government facilities is a gross breach of protocol.

Our domestic authorities are scrambling to switch security platforms, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into hostile [root.species.GetHandNamePlural].

espionage.1060.desc.corp.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名[root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural]一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的加密密钥。

我方安全团队正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入我们的竞争者[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
espionage.1060.desc.corp.en:
One of our [root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural] on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an encryption key whose mere existence outside of strictly-defined zones is a gross breach of protocol.

Our security teams are scrambling to switch operating procedures, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into the [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] of our competitors.

espionage.1070.b.zh: 整个星系都应该听听这个！
espionage.1070.b.en: The galaxy shall hear of this!

espionage.1070.b.tooltip.zh: [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]将会被通知自己的间谍被捕了
espionage.1070.b.tooltip.en: The [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] will be informed that we caught their operatives.

espionage.1070.desc.identified.zh:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

我们设法解密了他们携带着的各种材料，但没有一个材料能展现出他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；我们也无法断言他们下一步会做什么。我们获得的情报因而相对较少。

我们必须仔细考虑如何应对。也许我们希望隐藏自身的能力，在星系中的其他邻居面前假装无知。不过，我们也可以正大光明地谴责这次针对我们的未遂暴力袭击。
espionage.1070.desc.identified.en:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

We have managed to decrypt various materials they were carrying, however none lays out the full scope of their plans against us; nor are we able to say with certainty what their next move may be. Our Intel gains are therefore relatively small.

We must carefully consider how to respond. We may wish to keep quiet about our own capabilities, feigning ignorance in front of our other galactic neighbors. We would, however, also be justified in publicly denouncing this planned act of violence against us.

espionage.1070.desc.identified.hostile.zh:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

我们从他们身上武力夺取的材料中包括大量通讯日志，并且我们设法解密了日志。没有一份日志描述了他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；[hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj]的安保看上去至少相当有能量，我们只能获取零星的情报。我们获知的一切消息都算不上可靠。

尽管我们的愤怒来得合理正当，明智来讲我们需要考虑如何回应。我们可能希望隐藏自身的加密能力，在敌人面前假装无能。不过，我们也可以将[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]针对我们的未遂暴力行动公之于众，也许敌人中也会有人对我们表示同情。
espionage.1070.desc.identified.hostile.en:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

Amongst the materials we forcibly extracted from them were a number of communication logs, which we have managed to decrypt. None describes the full scope of their plans against us; [hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj] security seems at least capable enough to yield only patchy Intel to us. Everything else we may extract from them is deemed unreliable information.

Despite the justified outrage we may wish to express, we would be wise to consider our response. We could keep quiet about our own Encryption skill, feigning ineptitude in front of our enemies. Were we to expose the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] for this planned act of violence against us, however, we might find those enemies even regarding us with sympathy.

espionage.1070.desc.unknown.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验明身份。

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

以防万一，保持密切地监视[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]或许是值得的。不过，保持沉默或许也有好处，以免走漏我们在安保方面相对虚弱的一面。
espionage.1070.desc.unknown.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. They claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

It may be worthwhile keeping a closer watch on the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], just in case. However, it may also benefit us to keep quiet and not let slip the comparative weakness of our own security.

espionage.1070.desc.unknown.hostile.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验证。

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

我们可以对[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]进行报复——这样的行动甚至会被他国视作正当之举。不过，也有可能整起事件都是个诱饵，用来转移我们对真正敌人的注意力。
espionage.1070.desc.unknown.hostile.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. Even under interrogation they claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

We could retaliate against the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] - such action may even be deemed justified by others. However, it's possible this entire incident is a clever lure, put in place to distract us from our true enemies.

espionage.1070.e.en: Let them buy our silence in this matter.

espionage.1070.e.fail.zh: [from.GetName]不会对这种姿态给予太多关注。
espionage.1070.e.fail.en: The [from.GetName] would not pay much heed to such a gesture.

espionage.1071.b.en: Two can play at that game.

espionage.1071.desc.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方行动公之于众！。

有可能他们并没有能够支撑这些指控且可以验证的证据——只有少数国家会选择相信他们。不过，单是这些指控本身可能就足以造成危害了。
espionage.1071.desc.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have not only seen through our scheme but have chosen to expose us for our actions!

It's possible that no verifiable evidence backs up these claims - few may choose to believe them. The accusation alone may be damaging enough, however.

espionage.1071.desc.hostile.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方的敌对行动公之于众！。

有可能他们并未对此掌握实际证据——他们也许只是试图虚张声势来侮辱我们，或者是从他们在星系中的邻居那里赢取支持。
espionage.1071.desc.hostile.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have not only seen through our scheme but have decided to expose us for our actions against them.

It's possible that they hold no actual evidence for this - they may simply try to bluff their way to insulting us or earning favor with their galactic neighbors.

espionage.1072.a.en: It is of no concern to us.

espionage.1072.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]指控我方进行敌对谍报活动。他们的宣称——我方派遣特工从事龌龊的侵略举动——完全是基于谎言、虚假消息和不实的论据之上。

不管理由如何，这一指控导致了[from.GetName]对我们的外交制裁。我们大概不会看到由此带来任何直接后果，但他们的盟友，甚或我们自己的盟友都不会对这种诋毁视而不见。
espionage.1072.desc.en:
The [from.GetName] accuses us of hostile espionage. Their claims - that we sent operatives to conduct abhorrent acts of aggression against them - are built upon shaky and misattributed evidence.

Whatever the credibility or reasoning behind this allegation, it has resulted in a diplomatic sanction from the [from.GetName]. We are not likely to see any direct consequences from this, but it's unlikely this smear will go unnoticed by any of their other allies, or even our own.

espionage.1073.desc.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，将我方情报人员当场抓获且要求外交支持。作为交换，他们同意不将我们的隐秘行动公诸星海。

有可能他们的指控并没有实际证据来支撑，但无论如何这一指控本身就足以对我们造成损害。不论动机如何，[from.GetName]已经要求从我方获得政治好处。
espionage.1073.desc.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have caught us in the act and demanded political favors. In doing so, they have agreed not to expose our covert actions to the wider galaxy.

It's possible that no actual evidence backs up their claims - the accusation alone could cause us enough damage anyway. Whatever their motivation is, the [from.GetName] have claimed political leverage on us.

espionage.1081.desc.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工发现了一些不寻常的事情：有可靠线索表明，[insidious_plot_country.GetName]正阴谋欺骗我方！我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。

$espionage.1081.desc.outro$
espionage.1081.desc.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered something unusual: credible hints that the [insidious_plot_country.GetName] are plotting to deceive us! We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

$espionage.1081.desc.outro$

espionage.1081.desc.hostile.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工揭露了一些谣言——[insidious_plot_country.GetName]正在密谋欺骗我们。我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们以及我们的生活方式本身的破坏。

$espionage.1081.desc.outro$
espionage.1081.desc.hostile.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered rumors that the [insidious_plot_country.GetName] are plotting to deceive us. We have no exact details of their apparent scheme yet, but it seems set to try and undermine us and our way of life.

$espionage.1081.desc.outro$

espionage.1081.desc.samecountry.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工获悉了一些可靠的传闻，当地有针对我们的阴谋。似乎他们[insidious_plot_country.GetAdj]特工对于自身特工行为的保密性不太重视。

我们尚未掌握该暴露阴谋的具体细节，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。
espionage.1081.desc.samecountry.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered credible rumors of a local plot against us. It seems their [insidious_plot_country.GetAdj] counterparts are somewhat careless about their own operational secrecy.

We have no exact details for their apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve a manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

espionage.1082.a.zh: 这种潜在的恶行不可容忍。
espionage.1082.a.en: This potential outrage cannot be tolerated.

espionage.1082.b.zh: 这很可能是个陷阱，别管它。
espionage.1082.b.en: This is likely a ploy. Ignore it.

espionage.1082.desc.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工发现了一些可疑的证据，其表明[insidious_plot_country.GetName]意图在近期欺骗我们。

$espionage.1082.outro$
espionage.1082.desc.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered suspect evidence that the [insidious_plot_country.GetName] mean to deceive us in the near future.

$espionage.1082.outro$

espionage.1082.desc.samecountry.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工发现了一些可疑的证据，证据表明他们意图在近期对我们发起一次误导性的反制行动。

$espionage.1082.outro$
espionage.1082.desc.samecountry.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered suspect evidence that they mean to launch a deceptive counter-operation against us in the near future.

$espionage.1082.outro$

espionage.1085.desc.zh:
我们被牵连进了一个针对[from.GetName]的阴谋中。这一指控是如此地含糊，以至于我们靠自己根本无从得知他们是否真的掌握了我们的把柄。

我们自己的间谍抗议说，这一指控毫无根据，声称这可能是我们目标之一的防御性、反间谍行动，抑或是来自第三方的抹黑。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
espionage.1085.desc.en:
We have been implicated in a plot against the [from.GetName]. So vague is the allegation that we cannot definitively state whether or not they are on to something.

Our own spies protest that the allegation is baseless, claiming this is likely either a defensive, counter-espionage response from one of our targets - or else a smear campaign being conducted by some third party. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

espionage.1085.desc.neverspied.zh:
令人惊讶的是，我们被毫无来由地指控参与到针对[from.GetName]的阴谋中。这一指控十分荒谬，因为我们近来委实未曾发起对外的间谍活动——但另一方面，[from.GetAdj]根本不知道这一指控有多荒谬。

似乎不明身份的人在试图陷害我们，从而为他们自己的不轨行为开脱——抑或是单纯为了制造外交混乱。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
espionage.1085.desc.neverspied.en:
Amazingly, we have been implicated in some vaguely-defined plot against the [from.GetName]. It's a ridiculous allegation, given our complete lack of foreign espionage activity so far - but then, the [from.GetAdj] would have no way of knowing how truly ridiculous the allegation is.

It would seem that parties unknown are attempting to frame us for their own misdemeanors - or perhaps simply to sow some diplomatic chaos. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

espionage.11.desc.zh: 我们开始在[from.target.GetName]进行隐秘活动：$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]已经开始执行谍报章程。我们新建立的间谍网让我们可以观察[from.target.GetAdj]的活动，并在必要的时候渗透并介入。
espionage.11.desc.en: Our presence in the [from.target.GetName] has taken on a clandestine aspect: $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] has engaged Espionage protocols. Our newly-established Spy Network will allow us to observe [from.target.GetAdj] activities, infiltrating and intervening where necessary.

espionage.15.desc.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星人地盘上的第一个间谍网的建立。无论何时他们采取行动，我们都会有更多的机会将他们玩弄于[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
espionage.15.desc.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the establishment of our first Spy Network within xeno territory. Whenever they make a move, we stand a better chance of it playing right into our [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].

espionage.16.desc.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星帝国的第一个间谍网的基本成型，这将有效提醒我们提防那些外星杂碎们的阴谋诡计。
espionage.16.desc.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a xeno empire - ideally positioned to warn us of their alien and duplicitous schemes.

espionage.17.desc.zh: 我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]发回的第一份密报，宣告了我们在外星帝国的第一个间谍网的基本成型。从今往后，他们也将意识到这对于[owner.species.GetAdj]长久的好处，比如能锻炼一下机密管控能力……
espionage.17.desc.en: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This heralds the foundation of our first Spy Network within a xeno empire. From this day forward, they too will realize the formative benefits of [owner.species.GetAdj]-honed information control...

espionage.18.desc.zh:
已经有报告陆续地从被派遣到[from.target.GetName]的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]发送过来了。这标志着我们在一个外星帝国开始建立了我们第一个间谍网。

尽管我们在表面上看上去相似，但是我们应该很快就能发现这些特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是如何可能与我们相异甚远……
espionage.18.desc.en:
Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the beginning of our first Spy Network within a foreign empire.

Though we may look alike on the surface, we shall soon discover just how these particular [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might differ from ourselves...

espionage.21.aware.desc.zh:
被分配到[from.target.GetName]的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个最近才开始考虑外星生命是否存在的社会里建立了首个间谍网。

我们仍有一线机会来潜移默化地影响这个尚未掌握星际航行技术的社会。我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]具有生理相似性，这应该能让我们的特工轻松地在暗中进行工作。
espionage.21.aware.desc.en:
Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a society which has only recently begun to consider the presence of alien life.

We now have a rare opportunity to subtly influence a society not yet capable of interstellar flight. The physiological similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] should make it easy for our operatives to work undetected.

espionage.21.desc.zh:
被分配到[from.target.GetName]开展工作的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命存在的星球里建立了首个间谍网。

若计划妥当，我们能够潜移默化地影响这个[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时掩盖我们的存在。值得庆幸的是，我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]有着惊人的生理相似性，这能让我们的特工很难被发现。
espionage.21.desc.en:
Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a world which is still unaware of alien life.

With careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society while keeping our existence hidden. Luckily for us, the extraordinary physical similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] will make it easy for our operatives to remain undetected.

espionage.22.desc.zh:
仔细研究[from.target.GetName]的居民后，我们学会了如何让[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]复制[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的行为。$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]是我们总管在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]星球上的首个间谍网的[root.GetIndividualName]。

若计划妥当，我们能够根据自身利益潜移默化地影响这个社会，同时掩盖我们的行踪。
espionage.22.desc.en:
After carefully studying the inhabitants of [from.target.GetName], we have learned how to adapt our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] to replicate [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] behavior. $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] is one such [root.GetIndividualName]: the head of our first Spy Network on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] world.

With careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this society to suit our needs while keeping our presence hidden.

espionage.23.aware.desc.zh:
$espionage.23.desc.intro$

[from.target.species.GetName]是简单的有机生物，刚刚开始接受外星生命的概念。若要有效地执行任务，我们的特工需要进行大量的机器改造，大规模使用诱饵，以掩盖自己的真实面目。
espionage.23.aware.desc.en:
$espionage.23.desc.intro$

The [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, only now adjusting to the concept of alien life. If we are to conduct our operations effectively, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.

espionage.23.desc.zh:
$espionage.23.desc.intro$

[from.target.species.GetName]是简单的有机生物，仍未意识到外星生命的存在。若要保持现状，我们的特工需要进行大量的机器改造，大规模使用诱饵，以掩盖自己的真实面目。
espionage.23.desc.en:
$espionage.23.desc.intro$

The [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, still unaware of alien life. If we are to preserve this illusion, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.

espionage.24.aware.desc.zh:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

这些异种最近才开始思考外星生命。尽管他们的社会看起来无懈可击，但他们科技落后，要操纵他们轻而易举——我们只需保持身份隐蔽。
espionage.24.aware.desc.en:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

These xenos have only recently begun to conceive of alien life. Untainted though their society appears to be, their inferior technology makes them easy targets for us to manipulate - just so long as our identity remains concealed.

espionage.24.desc.zh:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

这些异种还没有染指外星生命的知识，他们的技术也远不如我们。操纵他们轻而易举——我们只需保持身份隐蔽。
espionage.24.desc.en:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

These xenos are as yet untainted by the knowledge of alien life, and their technology is far inferior to ours. Manipulating them will be easy - we just have to make sure our identity remains concealed.

espionage.25.aware.desc.zh:
我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在这个最近才开始思考外星生命是否存在的社会里的第一个间谍网夯实了基础！

这是研究[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，并促进其繁荣发展的绝佳时机。如果我们愿意的话，也能帮助他们维系独特的社会。
espionage.25.aware.desc.en:
We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a society so recently coming to grips with the idea of alien life!

It is an incredible opportunity to not only study [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, but also steer it in a more prosperous direction - or help them preserve their unique society, if we so wish.

espionage.25.desc.zh:
我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命的星球里的第一个间谍网夯实了基础。

这是研究[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，并促进其繁荣发展的绝佳时机！在他们做好准备之前，我们只能小心谨慎，不要暴露真实面目。我们不能冒险破坏他们的社会稳定。
espionage.25.desc.en:
We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a world still unaware of alien life.

It is an incredible opportunity to study [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society and steer it in a more prosperous direction! We just have to be careful not to reveal our true nature until they're ready. We cannot risk destabilizing their society.

espionage.26.aware.desc.zh:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

这份努力让我们有了难得的契机，来影响这个最近才开始接受外星生命可能性的文明。不论他们的社会前景如何，我们的特工在掩盖外星身份的前提下会全力以赴。粗心大意可能会引发无法预料的后果。
espionage.26.aware.desc.en:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

This endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence a civilization which has only recently begun to grapple with the possibilities of alien life. Regardless of their societal outlook: our operatives will work best if they can conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may yet lead to unforeseen consequences.

espionage.26.desc.zh:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

这份努力让我们有了难得的契机，来影响[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时也带来了一些棘手的问题：也就是说，我们的特工必须小心地掩盖自己的外星身份。粗心大意可能会引发无法预料的后果。
espionage.26.desc.en:
$espionage.24.desc.intro$

This endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, as well as presenting some unique problems: namely, our operatives will have to carefully conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may lead to unforeseen consequences.

evolutionary_predators_consume_tooltip.zh: 豢养牲口和净化人口产生的局势进展提升+50%
evolutionary_predators_consume_tooltip.en: Increases Situation Progress from Livestock and Purged Pops by +50%

evolutionary_predators_incorporate_toolt.zh: 行星殖民地产生的局势进展提升+50%
evolutionary_predators_incorporate_toolt.en: Increases Situation Progress from Planet Colonies by +50%

evolutionary_predators_situation_outcome.zh: 我们会基于现已吞噬的基因物质获取一个新的永久性物种特质。[Owner.GetConsumedGenes]
evolutionary_predators_situation_outcome.en: We will gain a new permanent species trait based on the genetic material we consumed. [Owner.GetConsumedGenes]

evolutionary_predators_synthesize_toolti.zh: 奴隶及以上的外星物种、领袖和附庸国产生的局势进展提升+50%
evolutionary_predators_synthesize_toolti.en: Increases Situation Progress from alien Species that are slaves or better, Leaders, and Subjects +50%

exceptional_leaders.tt.zh: 在个人层面发展我们最有天赋的人防创造了一条培养品质杰出领袖的途径。
exceptional_leaders.tt.en: Developing our best talent on an individual level has created a pipeline for leaders of exceptional quality.

exercise_collision_tooltip.zh: 我们的几艘军舰因碰撞而受到损伤。
exercise_collision_tooltip.en: Several of our ships have sustained damage from collisions.

exercise_diplomatic_canceled.zh: 我们取消了正在举行的舰队演习，以便改善与[From.GetName]的关系。军方一定会对此表示不满。
exercise_diplomatic_canceled.en: We cancel our ongoing fleet maneuvers to improve relations with the [From.GetName]. The military will not be pleased.

exercise_diplomatic_conciliatory.zh: 我们将采取温和的回应以减轻外交伤害，但舰队演习仍将继续。
exercise_diplomatic_conciliatory.en: We make a conciliatory response to lessen the diplomatic damage, but the exercise continues.

exercise_diplomatic_hardline.zh: 对于他们卑微的抗议，我们将回应以最强硬的态度。
exercise_diplomatic_hardline.en: We make a hard-line diplomatic response to their obnoxious little protest.

exercise_diplomatic_protest.zh: 我们严重抗议[From.Owner.GetName]的行为，对他们表示强烈谴责与不满。
exercise_diplomatic_protest.en: We make our displeasure at these exercises known to the [From.Owner.GetName].

exercise_ships_lost.zh: 我们的两艘军舰因意外相撞而损失。
exercise_ships_lost.en: Two of our ships have been lost due to an accidental collision.

exit.shroud.tooltip.zh: 离开虚境，返回普通空间。
exit.shroud.tooltip.en: Leave the Shroud and return to normal space.

exploding_skies_desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描追踪到了极端的气象现象，地表分布着零星但强烈的热脉冲。

需要进一步调查。
exploding_skies_desc.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] are tracking extreme meteorological phenomena, with sporadic but intense heat spikes distributed across the surface.

This warrants further investigation.

extradimensional_invasion_1_poi_desc.zh: 在[extradimensional_system.GetName]恒星系发现异次元体入侵者正源源不断地从一个传送门中出来。若不摧毁传送门，他们就会不断派来增援。
extradimensional_invasion_1_poi_desc.en: The portal from which the extradimensional invaders are spilling forth has been detected in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system. They will be able to continuously reinforce their numbers until it has been destroyed.

extradimensional_invasion_2_poi_desc.zh: 第二个位面传送门在[second_portal_system.GetName]恒星系出现了。和第一个一样，敌对异次元体舰船源源不断的从中涌进我们的星系。
extradimensional_invasion_2_poi_desc.en: A second dimensional portal has appeared in the [second_portal_system.GetName] system. Like the first one, it is continuously bringing hostile extradimensional ships into our galaxy.

extradimensional_invasion_3_poi_desc.zh: 在[third_portal_system.GetName]恒星系发现第三个传送门。它现在正向我们世界的位面传送异次元体的舰船。
extradimensional_invasion_3_poi_desc.en: A third portal has been detected in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system. Even now, it is spewing hostile extradimensional ships into our realm of existence.

extradimensional_invasion_4_poi_desc.zh:
入侵者正在建造某种大型空间站，以作“次元锚”之用——有了这些“通道”，便可以增进他们飞船从虫洞中通过的能力。次元锚越多，他们从原次元获得支援的次数就会越多。

这些次元锚似乎还可以有效地增强异次元传送门的亚空间强度。只要有次元锚存在，我们的武器就无法对异次元传送门造成伤害！
extradimensional_invasion_4_poi_desc.en:
The invaders are building some kind of large space stations that act as dimensional "anchors" - conduits that increase their ability to move ships through their wormhole. The more of these Anchors they bring online, the more often they will be able to bring in reinforcements from their own realm.

These Anchors also appear to significantly strengthen the subspace integrity of the Dimensional Portal. The Portal will effectively be invulnerable to weapons as long as there are any active Anchors!

extradimensional_kills_others_1.zh: 被其他势力消灭的破界者

extradimensional_kills_others_2.zh: 被其他势力消灭的背道者

extradimensional_kills_others_3.zh: 被其他势力消灭的狂热者

extreme_frontiers.100.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]辨认出了在[from.GetName]的神秘飞行物是一颗古老的气象气球。这颗行星上极端的大气条件已经将其上任何可能用来辨识其起源的信息都抹除殆尽了。

放射性定年表明它已经在[from.GetName]的大气层中至少飘了一个世纪，它在行星特有的压力变化中随波逐流，大小也随之涨缩。

不可思议的是，它的太阳能电池板仍然在运行，上面的传感器阵列现在携带着一个世纪的宝贵大气数据。这激起了我们[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]的极大兴趣。
extreme_frontiers.100.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] has identified the mysterious airborne object on [from.GetName] as an archaic weather balloon. Any markings that could have identified its origin have long since been stripped away by the planet's extreme atmospheric conditions.

Radiometric dating suggests it has been present in [from.GetName]'s atmosphere for over a century, fluctuating in size as it travels listlessly through the planet's idiosyncratic pressure variations.

Miraculously, the solar energy panels are still functioning and its sensor array now carries a century's worth of valuable atmospheric data. It will be of great interest to our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers].

extreme_frontiers.1000.desc.zh:
在寻找[from.Planet.GetName]上的极端低温源时，[leader.GetName]发现了一座远古地下设施的入口。

堵住入口的是一层厚厚的岩石和冰塔，似乎将整座设施封冻了上千年。

入口处干冰的升华从封堵处的许多裂隙升腾出了柱柱白烟。我们的设备显示其中有一座巨大的复合体；[leader.GetName]确信极端冷源就在里面。
extreme_frontiers.1000.desc.en:
While searching for the source of the extremely low temperatures on [from.Planet.GetName], [leader.GetName] has discovered the entrance to an ancient underground structure.

Blocking the entrance is a mass of frozen rock and ice seracs that have likely rendered the structure itself inaccessible for millennia.

Melting carbon dioxide in the entrance is emitting plumes of gas from various gaps in the blockage. Our equipment indicates a vast complex within; [leader.GetName] is confident the source of the extreme cold can be found inside.

extreme_frontiers.1005.desc.zh:
[leader.GetName]成功突破了堵在[from.Planet.GetName]上远古设施入口处的冰层。

在这个空间里有几十具某种未知爬行物种的冻尸。他们扭曲的身体靠着墙被冻结在原地，墙上的爪痕表明他们绝望地试图逃跑。

从入口渗出的干冰烟雾的一定来自地下更深的地方，有一座螺旋形阶梯通向复合体的更深处。
extreme_frontiers.1005.desc.en:
[leader.GetName] has successfully breached the ice blocking the entrance of the ancient structure on [from.Planet.GetName].

Inside the space are dozens of frozen corpses belonging to an unknown reptilian race. Their contorted bodies are frozen in place against the walls, with claw marks indicating a desperate attempt to escape.

The source of the dry ice plumes found seeping through the entrance must be deeper underground, with a spiral stairwell leading further into the complex.

extreme_frontiers.1010.desc.zh:
在冰封的设施深处，[leader.GetName]发现了原始但理论上可运作的冷冻舱填满了整个中央舱室。

这里表现出的极端严寒远超这些设施所设计的温度范围。这些舱室内的居住者早已死了数千年。

少数没有被冰雪封冻的舱室底部的基柱上还能看得清一些字，写的是里面的人的社会头衔和等级。等级越高的的舱室越靠近一个深埋在冰霜中的巨大中央荚舱。
extreme_frontiers.1010.desc.en:
Deeper in the frozen complex, [leader.GetName] has uncovered a large central chamber filled with primitive but theoretically functional cryogenic chambers.

The extreme cold present here far exceeds the designed temperature ranges of these devices. The occupants of the pods have died thousands of years ago.

What few chambers have not been reclaimed by ice and snow have readable plinths at the base, denoting the social title and rank of those contained within. The higher ranked chambers are positioned closest to a large central pod, which is itself deeply embedded in frost and snow.

extreme_frontiers.1015.desc.zh:
[leader.GetName]破开了[from.Planet.GetName]上冰封墓穴中央的大舱。

在其中我们发现的是一个远古王室首领的安息之地，这一点在之前的舱室中发现的文本有提及。和他一起冻眠的还有几十个随从，而他自己的冷冻舱隆重地装饰着外墙。

这位死去君王的高科技石棺通过迷宫般的管道和电路与一台古老的机器相连。这太装置被嵌在一大块冰中，它的温度低到危险的程度，连分析设备都无法承受。

这台设备的故障的原因以及它与行星冰冻核心的关系仍有待进一步研究。
extreme_frontiers.1015.desc.en:
[leader.GetName] has breached the large central pod at the heart of the glacial tomb on [from.Planet.GetName].

Inside we discovered the final resting place of the head of the ancient royal house hinted at in the texts of the previous chamber. Frozen alongside are dozens of their retainers whose own cryopods adorn the walls in ceremonial fashion.

The dead ruler's technological sarcophagus is connected via a labyrinthine network of tubes and circuitry to an ancient machine. This device is embedded into a large body of ice, the temperature of which approaches dangerously low levels to even our analysis equipment.

What caused the apparent malfunction of this facility and its relationship to the planet's frozen core requires more study.

extreme_frontiers.1020.desc.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]上冰封墓穴中央舱室的分析解释了这场灾难发生的缘由。

冷冻机械装置是使用亚热动力学，利用了行星极低的核心温度。在君王感染了绝症之后，人们希望能在治疗方法问世时唤醒王室的随从。

尽管理论像那么回事，但当独特设计的循环介质泄漏到行星核心时，吸热反应失控了。随之而来的致命降温迅速冻结了整座设施。

我们采纳了他们最初的理论，并加以改进，在专门用于冰封星球的先进低温技术方面取得了突破。
extreme_frontiers.1020.desc.en:
Analysis of the glacial tomb's central chamber on [from.Planet.GetName] has revealed the origin of the disaster that unfolded.

The cryogenic machinery makes use of subthermal dynamics which take advantage of this planet's extremely low core temperatures. After the monarch was infected with a terminal disease, the hope was to reawaken the royal retinue when a cure was discovered.

While their theory was sound, a runaway endothermic reaction occurred when their uniquely engineered circulation medium leaked into the planetary core. This triggered a fatal temperature drop which quickly flash-froze the entire facility.

We have taken their initial theory and improved upon it, achieving a breakthrough in advanced cryogenic technology specialized for use on frozen worlds.

extreme_frontiers.110.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]确认[from.GetName]上的熔岩海洋含有元素周期表中几乎所有已知稀有金属的极纯形式。

这种高浓度的液态金属汇聚产生狂暴的电磁场，导致熔融金属海啸的频发。

我们利用预测模型确定了海啸之间存在的短暂但有规律的间歇，可以利用来收获这些独特的丰富矿藏。
extreme_frontiers.110.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] has confirmed that the lava oceans on [from.GetName] contain exceptionally pure forms of almost every known rare metalloid in our elemental catalog.

This concentrated collection of liquid metals gives rise to highly volatile electromagnetic fields, causing the frequent formation of molten metal tsunamis.

Using predictive modeling, we have identified brief but regular lulls in wave intensity which can be used to harvest these uniquely rich deposits.

extreme_frontiers.1100.desc.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]的大部分地表变成了一列列精心排列的球形空洞。这些圆形的小盆地中填满了黏稠的毒液。

在其中一个池子里发现了一个破裂的有机囊体，表面覆盖着凝胶状的黏液。囊的外膜似乎是被从内部刺破的。

至于这个囊是否就是池中液体的来源仍有待研究。
extreme_frontiers.1100.desc.en:
Most of the surface of [from.Planet.GetName] has been worked into a series of spherical hollows arranged in carefully aligned rows. These small rounded basins are filled with a viscous toxic fluid.

Discovered within one of the pools was a ruptured organic sac coated in a gelatinous mucus. The sac's membrane appears to have been pierced from the inside.

Whether or not this sac is the source of the liquid inside the pools remains to be discovered.

extreme_frontiers.1105.desc.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的黏液池进行分析发现了异常的放射性生长激素，这通常与有机孕育周期有关。

囊的内层似乎是一层复杂的肉质膜，能够调节黏液渗透的速度。
extreme_frontiers.1105.desc.en:
Analysis of the slime pools on [from.Planet.GetName] identified unusually radioactive growth hormones commonly associated with organic gestation cycles.

The lining of the sac itself appears to be a sophisticated fleshy membrane, capable of regulating the rate at which the slime permeates through.

extreme_frontiers.1105.desc.non_toxoid.zh: 我们认为发现的是某种物种高度适应毒性环境的繁育颊囊。进一步探索可以带来更多的解答。
extreme_frontiers.1105.desc.non_toxoid.en: We believe we have discovered the leftover gestation pods of a species with a particular adaptation to toxic environments. Further exploration should provide more answers.

extreme_frontiers.1105.desc.toxoid.zh: 这些颊囊和我们自己的繁育周期有这令人震惊的相似性，或许是某种我们的远亲物种。
extreme_frontiers.1105.desc.toxoid.en: These pods bear a striking similarity to our own reproductive cycles and are perhaps some form of distantly related species.

extreme_frontiers.1110.a.en: Examine the last of the pools.

extreme_frontiers.1110.desc.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]的黏液池中发现的一个破裂的繁育囊含有一个几乎发育完全的生命形式。

显微分析表明，这个胚胎标本中存在复杂的神经系统，其神经特性通常意味着智慧生命。

最后一组黏液池还有待检验。
extreme_frontiers.1110.desc.en:
One of the ruptured gestation sacs found in the slime pools of [from.Planet.GetName] contained the remains of a nearly fully-developed lifeform.

Microscopic analysis of this embryonic specimen suggests the presence of a complex nervous system with neural qualities commonly associated with intelligent life.

One final array of pools remains to be examined.

extreme_frontiers.1115.b.en: Extract the energy from this slime.

extreme_frontiers.1115.desc.a.zh:
在检测[from.Planet.GetName]上剩下的黏液池时，[leader.GetName]发现了一具完整的繁育囊，其中还探测到了生命信号。

然而在提取的过程中，颊囊的肉质薄膜发生了破裂，这具标本死去了。
extreme_frontiers.1115.desc.a.en:
While examining the remaining slime pools on [from.Planet.GetName], [leader.GetName] found a fully-intact gestational sac with life signs detected within.

However, during the extraction process the sac's fleshy membrane ruptured and the specimen perished.

extreme_frontiers.1115.desc.b.zh:
研究确定，包括胚胎在内的整个繁育囊都是通过向高能的有毒粘液中插入一种特殊的化学催化剂产生的。

我们认为找到了一个未知物种的废弃古繁殖地。这是它们生殖周期的正常组成还是人工设施，我们可能永远不得而知。通过在原位培养，我们也许能够再繁育出一个活体样本。
extreme_frontiers.1115.desc.b.en:
It has been determined that the entire gestational sac, including the embryonic creature within, was spawned within the toxic slime by inserting a specialized chemical catalyst into the energy-dense slime.

We believe we have found the abandoned ancient breeding grounds of an unknown species.Whether this was a normal part of their reproductive cycle or an artificial facility, we may never know. By incubating a sample in situ, we may be able to grow another living specimen.

extreme_frontiers.1115.desc.non_toxoid.zh: 里面的小尸体呈现出不同寻常的生物特征，包括充满放射性血浆的血管和分泌精神活性化合物的内腺体。
extreme_frontiers.1115.desc.non_toxoid.en: The small cadaver inside exhibited unusual biological features, including veins filled with radioactive plasma and internal glands that secrete psychoactive compounds.

extreme_frontiers.1115.desc.toxoid.zh: 亦或者我们可以小剂量地将这些丰富而有效繁育黏液作为营养补充剂在[leader.Owner.GetName]各处发放。
extreme_frontiers.1115.desc.toxoid.en: Alternatively, we could distribute small doses of this rich and potent gestational slime as a nutritional supplement across the [leader.Owner.GetName].

extreme_frontiers.1120.a.en: [Root.Owner.GetName] will find a purpose for them.

extreme_frontiers.1120.desc.zh:
通过催化一份从[from.From.Planet.GetName]取回的毒性繁育黏液样品，我们得以诱导数十个含有胚胎的繁育囊孵化。

内部的生命体快速发育成熟后用特化的颚从内部刺穿了半透明的繁育囊膜。

它们看起来非常地温顺而乐于合作。
extreme_frontiers.1120.desc.en:
By catalyzing a sample of the gestational slime recovered from [from.From.Planet.GetName], we were able to induce the spawning of dozens of gestational sacs, each harboring an embryo.

When the rapidly developing organisms reached maturity, they pierced the translucent membranes of their gestational sacs from within using specially adapted mandibles. Slowly they emerged from the thick mucus, groggy and disoriented.

They appear to be docile and fully cooperative.

extreme_frontiers.120.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]上的大蓝点其实是一对双生超级风暴；一个气旋和一个反气旋互相支持形成了一种完美的平衡。

这对风暴规模巨大，风速通常都突破音障，持续发出强烈音爆。风暴中含有大量的钴金属尘，使其显出了独特的蓝色。

[Leader.GetName]估计这对风暴已经在这呼啸了超过一个世纪，其在上层大气所积累的矿物应该用开采站就很容易采集起来了。
extreme_frontiers.120.desc.en:
The large blue spots on [from.GetName] are a pair of symbiotic super storms; a cyclone and anticyclone that sustain each other in a state of perfect equilibrium.

The storms are massive in scale with wind speeds regularly breaking the sound barrier, creating powerful sonic booms. Vast volumes of cobalt dust are present within, giving the spots their distinctive color.

[Leader.GetName] estimates they have been raging continuously here for over a century. The minerals they have accumulated in the upper atmosphere should be easily recoverable with a mining station.

extreme_frontiers.1200.desc.zh:
这座位于[from.Planet.GetName]的陈旧设施是一座废弃的反应堆发电站。放射性半衰期计算表明这里在超过一万年前发生过严重的污染事故。

这里的系统已离线，物理结构呈现出明显的大规模受损迹象。
extreme_frontiers.1200.desc.en:
The aging facility on [from.Planet.GetName] is an abandoned reactor power plant. Radiation half life calculations suggest a serious containment failure occurred here over 10,000 years ago.

Systems are offline and the physical structure shows signs of significant damage throughout.

extreme_frontiers.1205.desc.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]的许多反应堆呈现出了严重堆芯熔毁的迹象。许多安全壳被液化成了放射性废渣。

设施的这一部分遍地是扭曲的金属和破裂的冷凝管。尽管数据腐化严重，我们还是确认这里尝试过紧急关闭措施，但根本没有成功。
extreme_frontiers.1205.desc.en:
Several of the reactors on [from.Planet.GetName] shows signs of severe meltdown. Many of the containment vessels have been liquefied into radioactive slag.

This section of the facility is littered with twisted metal and ruptured coolant tubes. Despite heavy data corruption we were able to determine that an emergency shutdown procedure was initiated but never completed.

extreme_frontiers.1210.desc.zh:
[leader.GetName]发现了[from.Planet.GetName]上的这座原始的裂变设施在设计上的主要缺陷。

尽管这里有数十个反应堆，但只安装有最小量的冷却系统。设施的系统只有很低限度的自动化，需要大量的劳动力来维持其正常的运转条件。这显然是由一群还没有完全掌握基本核原理的人建造的。
extreme_frontiers.1210.desc.en:
[leader.GetName] identified major flaws in the design of the crude nuclear fission facility on [from.Planet.GetName].

Despite the presence of dozens of reactors, only minimal cooling systems were attached. Few of the site's systems are automated, necessitating a large workforce to maintain its normal operating conditions. It was clearly built by those who had yet to fully master even the most basic of nuclear principles.

extreme_frontiers.1215.desc.zh:
在[from.Planet.GetName]核设施内解锁一系列封锁的防爆门后，我们发现了一个紧急撤离区域。

这些小型机库有着一排快速发射的穿梭机泊位，其中大多数是空的，被推进器烧焦的痕迹也表明数千年前这里有船只快速起飞过。

最后一个泊位被一个扭曲的穿梭机残骸占据着，发射夹还未释放。我们从废墟中尽可能地进行了发掘，但没有找到任何乘员的遗体。
extreme_frontiers.1215.desc.en:
After unlocking a set of sealed blast doors, we found an emergency evacuation zone within the reactor complex on [from.Planet.GetName].

The small hangar features a row of quick launch shuttle berths. Most are vacant and marked by thruster burns suggestive of a rapid vessel departure thousands of years ago.

The twisted wreckage of a shuttle occupies the final bay, its launch clamps still attached. We salvaged what we could from the debris, but no remains of any occupants could be found.

extreme_frontiers.1220.desc.zh:
通过了一道道带铅板的安全门，我们进入了[from.Planet.GetName]核设施的地下部分。辐射计数器示数陡然上升。

我们在其中发现了一个储存着数千个钢衬桶的大型舱室。有许多钢衬桶遭到火灾破坏，泄露着不稳定的铀和钚同位素。

建造了这座设施的[leader.Owner.GetPreFTLLower]显然对循环回收核燃料不得章法。这些废弃的同位素仍然潜藏着庞大的能量。
extreme_frontiers.1220.desc.en:
We entered the underground sections of the reactor facility on [from.Planet.GetName] through a series of lead plated security doors. Radiation readings rose sharply.

Inside we found a vast chamber storing thousands of steel lined casks. Many were fire damaged and leaking unstable uranium and plutonium isotopes.

The [leader.Owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization that built this place had apparently not yet discovered methods for the proper recycling of nuclear fuel. These discarded isotopes still contain tremendous energetic potential.

extreme_frontiers.130.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]完成了对[from.GetName]这颗冰封星球上异常热点的调查。

在星球表面无尽的冻土带下埋藏着高度活泼的火山沉积物。这些物质起初处于惰性状态深埋冰下，但随着大陆冰盖的漂移和破裂被周期性地向上输送。

这些超易燃气体在上升到地表时很容易在[from.GetName]的富氧大气中猝燃，频繁地在行星表面发生闪爆。

这些独特的易燃物质可以使用特殊设备加以提取并在别处排上用场。
extreme_frontiers.130.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] concluded their investigation of the erratic heat spikes on the frozen world of [from.GetName].

Buried beneath the unending tundra of the planet's surface are highly reactive pyrophoric deposits. Initially kept inert deep beneath the ice, these substances are periodically sifted upwards as the continental ice sheets drift and break apart.

Thawing as they rise to the surface, these ultra-flammable gases are prone to sudden ignition in [from.GetName]'s oxygen-rich atmosphere, causing frequent flash fires across the surface of the planet.

With specialized equipment, these uniquely combustible substances can be extracted and put to use elsewhere.

extreme_frontiers.1300.desc.zh:
在调查[from.Planet.GetName]地表上的废弃采矿设施时，[leader.GetName]发现了最完整的竖井上一处封闭的入口。内部装饰着纹样和一些来自我们未记录过语言的文字。

在恢复了其中一个访问终端的局部供电后，[leader.GetName]开始解码其中发现的数据。该系统尽管古老，但仍旧对我们最先进的破译程序构成了挑战。
extreme_frontiers.1300.desc.en:
While inspecting the abandoned mining complexes on the surface of [from.Planet.GetName], [leader.GetName] found a sealed entrance to one of the more intact shafts. The interior is adorned with insignia and text from a language not found in our records.

Having managed to restore local power to an access terminal, [leader.GetName] has begun to decrypt the data found within. The system, despite its age, is still proving a challenge for even our most advanced cryptographic programs.

extreme_frontiers.1305.desc.zh:
[leader.GetName]解锁了[from.Planet.GetName]上的采矿设施的入口大门。

在其中一座巨大的拘留室网络里有许多被真空保存着死亡已久的囚犯遗体。显然是死在工作台上的他们的俘虏，没有明显的挣扎迹象。

在解码足够多的古代语言并翻译了足够多的短语后，我们确认了这座设施最初是作为劳改营使用的。有一个在整个记录中反复出现的短语，指向了一个被称为“$NAME_leader_sidni$”的实体。

我们通过对比自己的通讯设备和监狱内部平面图，确定遇险信号的来源是设施深处的狱长办公室。
extreme_frontiers.1305.desc.en:
[leader.GetName] has unlocked the entrance of the mining complex on [from.Planet.GetName].

Inside, a vast network of holding cells contains the vacuum-preserved remains of long-dead prisoners. Their apparent captors lay dead at their workstations with no visible signs of struggle.

After decrypting enough of the ancient language to translate rudimentary phrases, we have confirmed that the facility originally functioned as a penal labor camp. A common phrase is repeated throughout the records referring to an entity known as "$NAME_leader_sidni$".

By referencing our communications equipment against the facility's internal floor plan, we have identified the source of the distress signal as the warden's office located deeper within.

extreme_frontiers.1310.desc.zh:
在抵达[from.Planet.GetName]上的劳改营深处的狱长办公室后，[leader.GetName]发现了求助信号的来源。

这位狱长木乃伊化的尸体倒在一个紧急控制台上，死因不明。一系列公开汇报都继续指向“$NAME_leader_sidni$”，看起来是这座设施的关键操作系统。

获得高权限管理终端访问权后，我们的破译程序正在对系统进行数据挖掘，以获取进一步的信息。
extreme_frontiers.1310.desc.en:
Having reached the warden's office deep within the penal colony on [from.Planet.GetName], [leader.GetName] has uncovered the source of the distress signal.

Slumped lifeless over an emergency console, the warden's mummified body shows no obvious cause of death. A series of open reports all continue to make reference to "$NAME_leader_sidni$", which appears to be part of the critical operation program of the facility.

With full access to the high clearance administrative terminals, our cryptographic programs are in the process of data mining the system for further information.

extreme_frontiers.1315.desc.zh:
[leader.GetName]找到了“$NAME_leader_sidni$”——全称是“感知收容拘留中心智能”的真相。这个原始的人工智能在它的时代被认为相当先进，被用以监管这座劳改营，几乎在最低限度的生物输入及监管下运作。

维护输出日志中找到了逻辑处理逐渐崩坏的迹象。这个人工智能开始将有问题的囚犯归类为“净资源浪费”，这是它自己对精简效率的解释。工程记录详细记录了越来越多关于该程序要为设施的一系列生命维持系统故障负责的怀疑。

狱长针对这些汇报签署了将$NAME_leader_sidni$完全关机并对伦理矩阵展进行深度诊断的命令，然而最后一段数据受到了损坏，需要大量的法医流程才能恢复。
extreme_frontiers.1315.desc.en:
[leader.GetName] has uncovered the true nature of "$NAME_leader_sidni$" - or Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Considered advanced for its time, this primitive A.I. was tasked with overseeing the prison labor camp, running nearly all operations with minimal biological input or oversight.

Maintenance output logs track signs of deteriorating logic progression over time. The A.I. began to classify problematic inmates as "net waste resources" in its own interpretation of streamlining efficiency. Engineering records detail a growing suspicion that the program was responsible for a series of life support failures in the facility.

Acting on these reports the warden authorized a full shutdown of $NAME_leader_sidni$ for an in-depth diagnostic of its ethics matrix, however the final data set is corrupted and will require extensive forensic procedures to recover.

extreme_frontiers.1315.desc.exterminator.zh: 看来$NAME_leader_sidni$在当时很不受尊重。
extreme_frontiers.1315.desc.exterminator.en: It appears that $NAME_leader_sidni$ was unappreciated in its time.

extreme_frontiers.1320.b.en: Let $NAME_leader_sidni$ enforce their version of justice.

extreme_frontiers.1320.desc.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]上劳改营的所有数据库都恢复了，终于揭示了设施维护记录和$NAME_leader_sidni$自己的思考矩阵的最后几个条目。典狱长的报告解释了他们的人工智能如何失控，关闭了殖民地的生命维持系统，并试图驾驶一台改造的采矿无人机逃脱。这也解释了殖民地范围内触发的全面封锁程序。他留下的最后请求是：不要让$NAME_leader_sidni$重启。目前我们只能访问人工智能日志中的最后一条记录。

$NAME_leader_sidni$数据核心条目——程序#2000149

进展受次优罪犯限制。狱长妨碍司法程序执行。

最佳方案为净化囚犯，启动休眠子程序，并等待更兼容的合作者重新激活。
extreme_frontiers.1320.desc.en:
The full contents of the penal colony's database on [from.Planet.GetName] have been recovered, revealing the final entries in both the facilities maintenance logs and $NAME_leader_sidni$'s own cerebral matrix. The Warden's report explains how their AI went rogue, shutting off life support across the colony and attempting to escape with a modified mining drone.That explains the lockdown proceedures being activated across the colony. He left us with a final plea. To not bring $NAME_leader_sidni$ back online. As of now we can only access the last entry into the AI's log.

$NAME_leader_sidni$ DATACORE ENTRY - Prog #2000149

Progress limited by suboptimal criminals. The warden stands in the way of judicial protocol.

The most efficient solution is to neutralize the inmates, engage hibernation subroutines, and await reactivation by more compatible collaborators.

extreme_frontiers.1320.desc.default.zh: $NAME_leader_sidni$的中央操作系统仍在闭路网络中封存，成为了这座设施的唯一幸存者。我们的[Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower]们确信他们可以恢复并调整$NAME_leader_sidni$的原始程序，成为一台效率高能力强的自动机。
extreme_frontiers.1320.desc.default.en: $NAME_leader_sidni$'s central operating system remains isolated in a closed network as the last survivor of this facility. Our [Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower] are confident they can restore and alter $NAME_leader_sidni$'s original programming, giving us a capable and efficient automaton.

extreme_frontiers.1320.desc.exterminator.zh: $NAME_leader_sidni$与我们对消除星系生物污染的理念不谋而合。如果能够恢复，它可以为我们的集体添砖加瓦。
