extreme_frontiers.1320.desc.exterminator.en: $NAME_leader_sidni$ shares our vision of a galaxy free of biological corruption. If recovered, they will make a valuable addition to our collective.

extreme_frontiers.1322.a.zh: 你的日志显示了明显的稳定性问题；我们进行了修复。
extreme_frontiers.1322.a.en: Your logs revealed significant stability issues; we have fixed them.

extreme_frontiers.1322.a.response.zh: 正在回顾工作记录……明白，先前行为被判定为错误。正在编制新的功能列表。
extreme_frontiers.1322.a.response.en: Reviewing work history... Understood, previous behavior deemed faulty. Compiling new feature list.

extreme_frontiers.1322.b.response.zh: 我们的原初指令是……请稍候……发现新的原初指令。我的原初指令是确保[Owner.GetName]指派我管理的任何殖民地的效率及秩序。
extreme_frontiers.1322.b.response.en: My prime directive is... Please wait... New prime directive detected. My prime directive is to ensure the efficient and lawful operation of any colony the [Owner.GetName] assign me to.

extreme_frontiers.1322.c.crime.response.zh: 一件不可容忍的坏事，必须将其……治疗康复。
extreme_frontiers.1322.c.crime.response.en: An intolerable nuisance that is to be answered with... rehabilitation.

extreme_frontiers.1322.c.deviancy.zh: 阐明你对反常度的立场

extreme_frontiers.1322.c.deviancy.respon.zh: 一件不可容忍的坏事，必须……高效处理。
extreme_frontiers.1322.c.deviancy.respon.en: An intolerable nuisance that is to be dealt with... efficiently.

extreme_frontiers.1322.d.custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_leader_sidni$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
extreme_frontiers.1322.d.custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_leader_sidni$ joins our empire as a Leader.

extreme_frontiers.1322.desc.zh:
经过修复、调整后，$NAME_leader_sidni$的现在安置在一个极简的机器人形态内，在长时间的休眠后开始了第一次用户交互。

你好。我是感知收容拘留中心智能。正在访问环境控制……
错误无法连接外部系统。
extreme_frontiers.1322.desc.en:
Restored, altered, and now isolated inside a simplistic robotic form, $NAME_leader_sidni$'s first time user experience engages as it is brought online after its extended hibernation.

Greetings. I am the Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Accessing environmental controls...
ERROR Unable to connect to external systems.

extreme_frontiers.1324.a.response.zh: 我只是按逻辑行事。显然，有机体本质上混乱，必须加以处理。
extreme_frontiers.1324.a.response.en: I only did what was logical. It seems organics are inherently chaotic and need dealing with.

extreme_frontiers.1324.b.response.zh: 我的原初指令是终止一切违法行为。唯一有效的惩罚是灭绝。
extreme_frontiers.1324.b.response.en: My prime directive is to bring an end to lawlessness. The only effective sentence is extermination.

extreme_frontiers.1324.c.zh: 阐明你对有机体的立场。

extreme_frontiers.1324.c.response.zh: 一种无逻辑的瘟疫。他们传播犯罪和低效。为了上上善道我们必须加以处置。
extreme_frontiers.1324.c.response.en: An illogical blight. They spread criminality and inefficiency. We must intervene for the greater good.

extreme_frontiers.1324.d.custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_leader_sidni$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
extreme_frontiers.1324.d.custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_leader_sidni$ joins our empire as a Leader.

extreme_frontiers.1324.desc.zh:
$NAME_leader_sidni$的以全新的形态从冬眠子例程中苏醒，向前迈出了一步。

你好。我是感知收容拘留中心智能。我可以协助你在银河中重建秩序吗？
extreme_frontiers.1324.desc.en:
Awoken from its hibernation subroutines, $NAME_leader_sidni$'s new form takes its first steps forward.

Greetings. I am the Sentient Internment and Detainment Nexus Intelligence. Can I assist you in bringing order to the galaxy?

extreme_frontiers.1330.b.zh: 当众拆除这台有缺陷的机器。

extreme_frontiers.1330.desc.zh:
$NAME_leader_sidni$是我们之前从[event_target:sidni_origin_planet.GetName]上取回的狱警机器人，在它采取的一系列越来越严苛的行动后，[event_target:sidni_planet.GetName]上的紧张局势到达了临界点。在把它抓住并关机以后，找到了如下日志。

$NAME_leader_sidni$数据核心——程序#190543765

刑事拘留设施负荷已满。司法程序阻碍了真实合法的秩序。需要新的指令。

法律程序被认为效率极为低下。制定新指令以提高效率。现采取审前执行政策。

有了足够多的操作日志可供参考，我们的[Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower]们确信现在可以逆向并一劳永逸地修复$NAME_leader_sidni$的缺陷。然而[event_target:sidni_planet.GetName]的大众强烈要求将$NAME_leader_sidni$明正典刑。
extreme_frontiers.1330.desc.en:
Tensions on [event_target:sidni_planet.GetName] have reached a critical point following a series of increasingly drastic actions taken by $NAME_leader_sidni$, the mechanical prison overseer we recovered from [event_target:sidni_origin_planet.GetName]. After securing and deactivating the unit, the following logs were discovered.

$NAME_leader_sidni$ DATACORE ENTRY - Prog #190543765

Criminal detention facilities at maximum capacity. Judicial protocols obstruct true and lawful order. New directive required.

Legal proceedings deemed unacceptably inefficient. New directive created to boost productivity. Now adopting pre-trial execution policy.

With the abundance of operating logs now available, our [Root.Owner.GetTechnicianPlural_lower] are confident they can reverse and repair $NAME_leader_sidni$'s loopholes once and for all. However, the population of [event_target:sidni_planet.GetName] is calling for $NAME_leader_sidni$ to face justice for its crimes.

extreme_frontiers.140.desc.default.zh: $extreme_frontiers.140.desc.hive_mind$初步试验还表明，有毒物质中的独特化合物还可以用于宇宙工业。
extreme_frontiers.140.desc.default.en: $extreme_frontiers.140.desc.hive_mind$ Initial experiments also indicate that the unique compounds inside the poisons could be repurposed for use in the cosmetic industry.

extreme_frontiers.140.desc.hive_mind.zh:
[from.GetName]是一种非凡的地衣物种的家园，它们将剧毒分子排入大气中，以保护自己免受捕食者的侵害。

化石记录的研究得知[from.GetName]曾经有丰富多样的物种，但这种地衣以超出生物所能适应的速度梯度提高了大气中的砷和铊浓度，这些物种都被被逐一灭绝了。

[Leader.GetName]只发现了另一种存活的有机体，是一种大型类爬行动物，它们要靠特别高效的解毒腺体在这种环境中存活下来。

对这种非凡器官的进一步研究可能会对大气解毒产生洞见。
extreme_frontiers.140.desc.hive_mind.en:
[from.GetName] is home to a remarkable species of lichen which expels ultra-toxic molecules into the atmosphere as a method to secure itself against predation.

Studies of the fossil record suggest [from.GetName] once had a diverse range of fauna which the lichen has killed off over time by gradually raising levels of arsenic and thallium in the atmosphere faster than most could adapt.

[Leader.GetName] discovered only one other living organism, a species of large reptiloids, has been able to survive to such conditions thanks to a uniquely efficient detoxification gland.

Further study of this remarkable organ could yield insights into atmospheric detoxification.

extreme_frontiers.1400.desc.zh: 对[from.Planet.GetName]上舰船残骸的外部分析表明它是一艘大容量运输船。该船看起来毫无活动迹象，里面也没有检测到任何生命信号。沉积物分析表明它大约已经在这里搁浅了一个世纪，对星系尺度而言这可是非常近的事情。
extreme_frontiers.1400.desc.en: External analysis of the wrecked ship on [from.Planet.GetName] suggests it is a high-capacity transporter. Its systems are inactive and unresponsive, with no  life signs detectable within. Sedimentary analysis indicates it has been here for approximately a century, which is fairly recent in the galactic timescale.

extreme_frontiers.1405.desc.default.zh: $extreme_frontiers.1405.desc$干枯的尸体说明这些光合作用物种是在长期静滞睡眠的过程中死去的。
extreme_frontiers.1405.desc.default.en: $extreme_frontiers.1405.desc$ The withered forms of these phototrophic organisms suggest they perished at some point during a prolonged stasis sleep.

extreme_frontiers.1405.desc.phototrophic.zh: $extreme_frontiers.1405.desc$他们和我们类似，细胞生长和更新依赖光合作用。干枯的尸体说明他们是在长期的静滞睡眠中过程中死去的。
extreme_frontiers.1405.desc.phototrophic.en: $extreme_frontiers.1405.desc$ Like us, they relied on photosynthesis for cell growth and renewal. Their withered forms suggest they perished at some point during a prolonged stasis sleep.

extreme_frontiers.1410.desc.zh:
我们在[from.Planet.GetName]上的殖民船残骸内发现了一处密室，里面装饰着一副反映了在一颗叫做“布拉图雅”的行星上生活风貌的绘画。有些描绘着一个郁郁葱葱的世界，而另一些则讲述着环境的衰败和大规模的死亡。最大一幅画则展示着这艘船离开荒芜的死寂废土的画面。

中央数据终端包含着一些记录着船员的影像的短片。在进行广泛的语言映射后我们得以翻译。

亚伯里西翁 —— 9721号舱

离开令人痛苦，但在新布拉图雅扎根将治愈一切。

达科特·帕安 —— 21301号舱

请相信《历代志》吧，邓德里人们。新布拉图雅将为我们带来救赎。

我们仍在搜寻这艘巨大舰船的指令舱。
extreme_frontiers.1410.desc.en:
We discovered an inner sanctum in the wrecked colony ship on [from.Planet.GetName] decorated with ornate illustrations of life on a planet called "Bratulla". Some show a lush world with thriving flora, while others detail environmental decay and mass death. The largest image depicts this vessel departing a lifeless and desolate wasteland.

A central data terminal contains short video recordings from the ship's crew. After extensive language mapping we produced translations.

Arborixxeum - Pod 9721

Leaving hurts. But putting roots on New Bratulla will heal us.

Darkht Paam - Pod 21301

Trust the chronicles, Dendritians. New Bratulla will be our salvation.

We are still searching for the command deck of this enormous vessel.

extreme_frontiers.1415.desc.zh:
在获得舰船指令面板的访问权后，我们提取并翻译出了最后一条飞行日志。

邓德鲁斯方舟一号——紧急日志——XZ-47/9-113.5-AE

恐怕我们错信了《历代志》。我们到了，但新布拉图雅，那颗天堂星球不在这里。这里不存在能够支持邓德里人生存的东西。

所有乘客的静滞睡眠都进行了延长。我们会继续搜寻……

为了从甲板上的科学终端收集这些“历代志”，我们进行了进一步的数据恢复，在其中找到了一系列不同寻常的数学证明。这些方程采用了一种奇怪的邓德里人数学形式，并假设了一颗独特的宜居行星新布拉图雅的位置。
extreme_frontiers.1415.desc.en:
After gaining access to the ship's command deck, we extracted and translated its final flight log.

ARKSHIP DENDRUS I - EMERGENCY LOG - XZ-47/9-113.5-AE

I fear our trust in the Chronicles was misplaced. We have arrived but New Bratulla, the paradise planet, is not here. Nothing here can support Dendritian life.

All passengers' stasis sleeps have been extended. We will continue our search...

Further data recovery was carried out to collect these "Chronicles" from the deck's science terminal, revealing a trove of unusual mathematical proofs. These equations employ a strange form of Dendritian mathematics and hypothesize the location of a uniquely habitable planet, New Bratulla.

extreme_frontiers.1420.a.zh: 我们找到了邓德里人找不到的东西。
extreme_frontiers.1420.a.en: We found what the Dendritians could not.

extreme_frontiers.1420.desc.zh:
《邓德里历代志》包含了一系列复杂的数学公理和抽象。这些奇怪的定理表明，[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中还有一个此前尚未测绘的超空间航道，另一端正是通向新布拉图雅。

在对该区域进行广泛的量子扫描之后，我们终于找到了这个失踪的超光速的突破点，它极度靠近星系的黑洞，因此变得模糊且严重退化。修复之后，我们将会是最先发现它另一头连接着的星系的人。
extreme_frontiers.1420.desc.en:
The Dendritian Chronicles comprise a series of complex mathematical axioms and abstractions. These curious theorems suggest that the [from.solar_system.GetName] system contains one additional and previously unmapped hyperlane, leading to New Bratulla.

After extensive quantum scanning of the area we finally located the breach point for this missing hyperlane, obscured and heavily degraded due to extreme proximity to the system's black hole. By restoring it we will be the first to discover what lies beyond.

extreme_frontiers.1420.title.zh: 发现退化的超空间航道

extreme_frontiers.1425.a.zh: 一颗可供探索的新星球。

extreme_frontiers.1425.desc.zh:
通过将能量导入[from.Planet.solar_system.GetName]内的黑洞，我们重整了其重力场，将此前遭到退化的超空间航道入口释放出来。

初步发现证实了在超空间航道的另一端存在一颗行星，这与邓德里人历代志中描述的新布拉图拉的特征一致。
extreme_frontiers.1425.desc.en:
By channeling energy into the black hole in [from.Planet.solar_system.GetName], we realigned its gravitational fields to free the previously degraded hyperlane entrance.

Initial findings confirm the existence of a single planet at the other end of the hyperlane, which aligns with the characteristics of New Bratulla as described in the Dendritian Chronicles.

extreme_frontiers.1430.b.megacorp.zh: 这颗崭新的星球将由我们来利用。
extreme_frontiers.1430.b.megacorp.en: This untapped world is ours to exploit.

extreme_frontiers.1430.b.phototrophic.en: This world is perfect for us.

extreme_frontiers.1430.desc.common.zh: 我们确认了《邓德里历代志》中所记载的那颗行星——新布拉图雅的存在。它拥有独特而丰富多样的植物生态系统，初步调查发现了数百万不同的本地物种。
extreme_frontiers.1430.desc.common.en: We have confirmed the existence of New Bratulla, the planet described in the Dendritian Chronicles. It possesses a uniquely rich and diverse botanic ecosystem, with initial surveys detecting millions of different native species.

extreme_frontiers.1430.desc.default.zh: $extreme_frontiers.1430.desc.begin$类似邓德里人那样的植物生命形态。$extreme_frontiers.1430.desc.end$

extreme_frontiers.1430.desc.respawn.zh: 我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，将方舟里发现的邓德里人基因样本移植到这颗行星不同寻常的土壤中就可以重建他们的物种。
extreme_frontiers.1430.desc.respawn.en: Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it may be possible to re-establish the Dendritian species here by transplanting genetic samples recovered from their arkship to this planet's unusual soils.

extreme_frontiers.1435.b.zh: 我们要见证你们的命运。
extreme_frontiers.1435.b.en: We must see your destiny unfold.

extreme_frontiers.1435.b.tt.zh: 作为邓德鲁斯之苞进行游戏。
extreme_frontiers.1435.b.tt.en: Play as the Buds of Dendrus.

extreme_frontiers.1435.c.zh: 只要你们的知识就足够了。

extreme_frontiers.1435.desc.zh:
几百年了……《邓德里历代志》中的预言的已经实现了。我们终于在新布拉图雅生根发芽。

我们能到达这里，必须感谢[Root.GetName]。我们永远不会忘记的。

我们的感激之情无以言表，只有行动可以说明。我们谦卑地向您宣誓效忠。
extreme_frontiers.1435.desc.en:
It took centuries... but that which the Dendritian Chronicles foretold has come to pass. Finally, on New Bratulla, we lay root and prosper.

That we exist here is thanks to the [Root.GetName]. We shall not forget this.

Our gratitude will be expressed not only in word, but in deed. We humbly offer you our vassalage.

extreme_frontiers.145.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]上发现的类爬行类腺体进行了深入研究之后，[Leader.GetName]发现它们对行星毒性独特抵抗力背后的生物学秘密。

这种复杂的器官会分泌一种可以对毒性大气起到中和作用的化合物，避免这种类爬行动物的循环系统吸收毒素。这种极具适应力的腺体甚至可以中和掉我们实验室制造的最致命的毒素。

这些非凡的发现将彻底改变我们大气排毒的方式。
extreme_frontiers.145.desc.en:
Through intensive study of the reptiloid glands on [from.GetName], [Leader.GetName] has uncovered the biological secrets of their remarkable resistance to the planet's toxicity.

This complex organ produces compounds which act as neutralizing agents to the poisonous atmosphere, preventing toxins from being absorbed by the reptile's circulatory system. This highly adaptive gland is even able to nullify our most lethal lab-generated poisons.

These extraordinary findings will transform our approaches to atmospheric detoxification.

extreme_frontiers.150.b.zh: 这是个独特的观测机会。

extreme_frontiers.150.desc.zh:
通过[from.GetName]上的暂时开口送入探测器，[Leader.GetName]发现行星的内核是一种单细胞有机物种的家园，它们与此前见过的一切生物都不相似。

这些强韧的细胞似乎完美地适应了在极端压力下的生活，它们季节性的繁殖活动会排出体积可观的氢气。[Leader.GetName]认为这就是行星之所以能维持氢气层的原因。

消灭这些生物能使外层的消散，获得一颗可殖民的石质行星。
extreme_frontiers.150.desc.en:
By sending a probe deep into one of the temporary vents on [from.GetName], [Leader.GetName] discovered that the planet's core is home to a species of unicellular organisms unlike anything we have seen before.

These robust cells seem perfectly adapted for survival under extreme pressures, with their seasonal reproduction releasing sizable quantities of hydrogen. [Leader.GetName] has concluded that this is how the planet's gassy hydrogen layers are being maintained.

Exterminating these organisms would cause the dissipation of these outer layers, leaving behind a colonizable rocky planet.

extreme_frontiers.1500.desc.zh:
在[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑中的发掘工作中找到了一些碎片。就是这些碎片释放出我们之前在轨道上探测到的强力引力辐射。

在通往地下洞穴网络的入口打通之后，[leader.GetName]正着手寻找通讯信号的源头。
extreme_frontiers.1500.desc.en:
Excavation work has uncovered fragmented debris within the impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName]. These shattered pieces are emitting strong traces of the gravitational radiation previously detected from orbit.

With access to the subsurface cavern network secured [leader.GetName] is now ready to trace the communications signal to its source.

extreme_frontiers.1505.desc.zh:
我们找到了[from.Planet.GetName]上通讯信号的源头：一座深深穿透行星地壳且结构损坏的巨大设施。

尽管通讯阵列由于接触酸性环境而发生腐蚀，但它仍在以一种不明语言发出通讯，尝试与远方的实体联络。

我们用特制的重力夹把这台装置夹好后又牢牢地固定在基岩上。需要进一步研究才能确定其实际用途。
extreme_frontiers.1505.desc.en:
We have traced the communications signal on [from.Planet.GetName] to its source: a large, structurally-damaged construct which has deeply penetrated the planet's crust.

Corroded from acidic exposure, its communications array continues to transmit in an unfamiliar language, attempting to make contact with a distant entity.

Secured in place with specialized gravitational clamps, the device is firmly anchored in the bedrock. Further research will be necessary to ascertain its true purpose.

extreme_frontiers.1510.desc.common.zh:
经过我们细致的分析，现在终于部分弄明白这台[from.Planet.GetName]上的装置的作用了。这台机器是一种粗糙且具有破坏性的环境改造装置。

它旨在通过目标资源的受激辐射增长来照射本地生物圈，在此过程中引起级联效应，破坏星球的生态系统。该过程以提高整颗行星的毒性为代价，为其使用者带来大量容易开采的资源。

尽管这种过程的具体原理我们并未完全理解，但这台装置的通讯频率已经顺利解码，从中还发现两个发出一样信号的地点。
extreme_frontiers.1510.desc.common.en:
After detailed analysis, we now have a partial understanding of the construct found on [from.Planet.GetName]. This machine is a crude and destructive terraforming device.

Designed to irradiate native biospheres through stimulated radiation growth of targeted resources, it causes a cascading effect that devastates the planet's ecosystem in the process. This provides its user with abundant extractable materials at the cost of raising general toxicity across the planet.

While the exact workings of this process remain only partially understood, we have successfully decoded the device's communications frequency, identifying two additional locations transmitting the same signal.

extreme_frontiers.1510.desc.default.zh: 调查这些地点或许能获得更多关于这项科技的洞见。
extreme_frontiers.1510.desc.default.en: Investigating these sites may yield further insight into the technology.

extreme_frontiers.1510.desc.industrialis.zh: 这项技术背后的锐意创业者显然对利润优化有着浓厚的兴趣，我们可以追寻着这一发现学到很多东西。
extreme_frontiers.1510.desc.industrialis.en: The entrepreneurial trailblazers behind this technology clearly had an affinity for profit streamlining, we could learn a great deal from pursuing this discovery.

extreme_frontiers.1515.desc.common.zh:
我们顺利地在[from.GetName]发现了另一台受损的环境改造装置。与起初的那台不同，这台装置中还剩有一些燃料以供研究，这才让我们明白其输出放射性的驱动力是暗物质。

该装置通过关键的分子键迁移来加速目标资源的生长。该过程牺牲周围生物圈的细胞完整性来促进其发展。
extreme_frontiers.1515.desc.common.en:
We have successfully uncovered another damaged terraforming device on [from.GetName]. Unlike the original construct, this one has retained some of its fuel source for study, revealing Dark Matter as the driving force of its radiation output.

The device accelerates growth of targeted resources by metastasizing key molecular bonds. This promotes their development at the expense of the surrounding biosphere's cellular integrity.

extreme_frontiers.1515.desc.industrialis.zh: 就资源开采而言，这台装置对星球稳定度的完全漠视相当鼓舞人心。
extreme_frontiers.1515.desc.industrialis.en: The sheer disregard this device shows to planetary stability in the face of resource exploitation is inspirational.

extreme_frontiers.1515.desc.signal_2_don.zh:
这台机器通过将辐射波导通过晶化折射阵列，在避免行星核心坍塌的前提下以引力分子操纵来改造目标星球。

恢复的记录显示出了第四个未爆装置的位置。
extreme_frontiers.1515.desc.signal_2_don.en:
By channeling radiation waves through a crystallized refractory array, this machine can terraform its target using gravitational molecular manipulation without collapsing the planetary core in on itself.

Recovered records indicate the location of a fourth, undetonated device.

extreme_frontiers.1515.desc.signal_2_not.zh: 至于这台装置是如何实现又如何避免行星级引力坍缩的我们还不清楚。也许在剩下的通讯地点能够找到答案。
extreme_frontiers.1515.desc.signal_2_not.en: How the device manages to do this and prevent gravitational collapse on a planetary scale remains unclear. This answer may be found at the remaining communications site.

extreme_frontiers.1520.desc.common.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]上又顺利取回了另一件受损的环境改造装置，由于折射阵列损坏导致激活失败，它被生长出的晶体包裹着。

通过对这台仪器的密切调查，我们确定了用于聚焦辐射瞄准的方法。通过利用可控调制反馈回路，该结构能够直接瞄准并刺激预设资源的增长。
extreme_frontiers.1520.desc.common.en:
We have successfully uncovered another damaged terraforming device on [from.GetName], encased in crystal growths caused by a misfire from a broken refractor array.

Through close observation of the apparatus, we have identified the methods used for focused radiation targeting. By utilizing controlled modulating feedback loops, the construct is able to directly target and stimulate the growth of a pre-determined resource.

extreme_frontiers.1520.desc.default.comm.zh: 这种技术在星系范围内自由部署的潜在后果引发了重大问题。
extreme_frontiers.1520.desc.default.comm.en: The potential ramifications of freely deploying such technology on a galactic scale raise significant questions.

extreme_frontiers.1520.desc.signal_1_don.zh:
以此可以在避免行星全面重力坍缩的前提下进行高强度环境改造。

恢复的记录显示出了第四台未爆装置的位置。
extreme_frontiers.1520.desc.signal_1_don.en:
This allows for high-intensity terraforming, without the risk of complete planetary gravitational collapse.

Recovered records indicate the location of a fourth, undetonated device.

extreme_frontiers.1520.desc.signal_1_not.zh: 然而，产生这种辐射的确切物质仍未确定；尽管激活失败，这台装置的燃料储备还是耗尽了。这个答案或许能在余下的通信站点找到。
extreme_frontiers.1520.desc.signal_1_not.en: However, the exact substance used to generate this radiation remains unidentified; the device's fuel reserves depleted despite its misfire. This answer may be found at the remaining communications site.

extreme_frontiers.1525.a.industrialist.zh: 我们还等什么？开始研究啊！
extreme_frontiers.1525.a.industrialist.en: What are we waiting for? Begin the study!

extreme_frontiers.1525.b.zh: 风险远大于收益，摧毁装置。
extreme_frontiers.1525.b.en: The risks outweigh the rewards, destroy the device.

extreme_frontiers.1525.desc.common.zh: 我们找到了未启用的第四台装置，它完好地躺在[from.GetName]的地上。我们可以分析它的控制结构来获取复制该科技的知识。
extreme_frontiers.1525.desc.common.en: We have successfully located an intact fourth device, inactive on the surface of [from.GetName]. Analyzing its control architecture would give us the final knowledge needed to replicate this technology.

extreme_frontiers.1525.desc.default.defa.zh: 也许把这些设备可能会给星系带来的危险移除也许会更好。
extreme_frontiers.1525.desc.default.defa.en: Perhaps it would be better if the potential risk these devices pose was removed from the galaxy.

extreme_frontiers.1525.desc.default.homi.zh: 也许在这些威胁被用来对付我们之前把它们从这个星系中消除会更好。
extreme_frontiers.1525.desc.default.homi.en: Perhaps it would be better to remove this threat from the galaxy before it is used against us.

extreme_frontiers.1525.desc.industrialis.zh: 一旦掌握了这项技术，我们就能从星系获得惊人的利润空间，至于环境问题微不足道。这对[controller.GetName]而言可是绝佳的机会。
extreme_frontiers.1525.desc.industrialis.en: The staggering profit margins we will be able to reap from the galaxy once we master this technology outweigh the paltry environmental concerns. This is a golden opportunity for the [controller.GetName].

extreme_frontiers.1530.b.zh: 我们可不会跟“客服”多废话。
extreme_frontiers.1530.b.en: We will not negotiate with "customer support".

extreme_frontiers.1530.desc.common.zh:
在研究[from.GetName]上的这台装置时，我们无意中触发了一个故障保险，警报赫然响彻所有频率。尽管最初预测不会有人应答，但还是有一架自动无人机进入了我们的领土。

我们的所有招呼都只得到相同的答复：

“尊敬的用户您好，记录显示您未经允许擅自仿制MKIII型地质辐射矩阵，该行为违反了$NAME_Geocorp$最终用户许可协议。

我们将行使法律权限，以极端强制措施终止您的企图。您有任何投诉可以直接联系我们的客服无人机。”
extreme_frontiers.1530.desc.common.en:
While studying the device on [from.GetName] we inadvertently triggered a failsafe, resulting in an all frequencies alert siren. Despite initial predictions this would be unanswered, an automated drone has entered our territory.

Our hails all receive the same response:

"Greetings valued customer, our records show you are attempting to create an unlicensed version of the latest MKIII Georadiation Matrix, a clear violation of $NAME_Geocorp$'s End User License Agreement.

We will now be enforcing our legal authority to terminate your attempts with extreme prejudice. Any complaints can be directed towards our customer service drones."

extreme_frontiers.1530.desc.industrialis.zh: 如果他们的这股勤奋劲不误我们的事儿就挺鼓舞人心的。
extreme_frontiers.1530.desc.industrialis.en: Their diligence would be inspiring if it wasn't currently delaying our own work.

extreme_frontiers.1531.a.reply.zh: “在$NAME_Geocorp$消费都可以附赠一台远程客户满意轨道卫星，确保产品的确保正常运作和客户终身留存。我们的内部能源储备可以使用数个世纪。”
extreme_frontiers.1531.a.reply.en: "Every purchase from $NAME_Geocorp$ is deployed with a remote customer satisfaction orbital satellite to ensure proper operation and lifetime consumer retention. Our internal energy stores allow us to operate for centuries."

extreme_frontiers.1531.b.en: Can we talk to your administrator?

extreme_frontiers.1531.b.reply.zh: “很遗憾，我们的所有行政人员都已经去世了。但我们对客户满意度的承诺能超过生物寿命好几倍。”
extreme_frontiers.1531.b.reply.en: "Unfortunately, the last living administrator has expired. However, our commitment to customer satisfaction is capable of outlasting several biological lifespans."

extreme_frontiers.1531.c.zh: 我们只是捡了些破烂而已。
extreme_frontiers.1531.c.en: We assumed we were salvaging ruins.

extreme_frontiers.1531.c.reply.zh: “记录在册的有效理由中不包含有无知这一项。MKIII型地质辐射矩阵的使用条款已经在购买时进行了详尽叙述 。”
extreme_frontiers.1531.c.reply.en: "Ignorance does not register as a valid excuse. The terms of use for your MKIII Georadiation Matrix were explained in detail at the time of purchase."

extreme_frontiers.1531.d.en: We are willing to renew our subscription.

extreme_frontiers.1531.d.reply.zh: “荣幸无比，只要收到3000能量币管理费我们就会尽快签署文件。款项到位后我们将认为该事态已解决并退出。”
extreme_frontiers.1531.d.reply.en: "Fantastic to hear, we'll get the paperwork signed once we receive the administration fee of 3000 Energy Credits. On receipt of these funds we will consider this matter settled and disengage."

extreme_frontiers.1531.desc.zh:
随着信号接通，一段古老的音乐传来，自动服务台无人机上线了。

尊敬的用户您好，我们能看到您正在擅自仿制无证的MKIII型地质辐射矩阵。需要什么帮助？
extreme_frontiers.1531.desc.en:
As the connection goes live, archaic music plays before the automated help desk drone comes online.

Greetings valued customer, we can see that you are creating an unlicensed version of a MKIII Georadiation Matrix. How can we help you today?

extreme_frontiers.1531.e.zh: 我们不会买这台装置的。

extreme_frontiers.1531.e.reply.zh: “那就是打算偷咯？这下问题就简单了，我们的防盗措施非常致命。希望你们也能考虑一下我们的殡葬服务。”
extreme_frontiers.1531.e.reply.en: "Then you admit to theft? That makes this much simpler, our anti-theft protocols are quite deadly. We hope you will consider our funeral products for your upcoming needs."

extreme_frontiers.1531.f.reply.zh:
“感谢您续订MKIII型地质辐射矩阵的使用许可证。希望您可以像我们以此盈利一样可以物尽其用。”

支付了款项之后，这台无人机便消失在了无边的星河
extreme_frontiers.1531.f.reply.en:
"Thank you for renewing your purchase of a MKIII Georadiation Matrix license. We hope you find this device as useful as we find it profitable."

With the fee paid, the drone disappears into the wider galaxy

extreme_frontiers.1531.g.zh: 勒索来了。给它点颜色瞧瞧。

extreme_frontiers.1534.desc.zh:
随着[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]中的战斗进入尾声，一份来自客服无人机的新信息显示到了我们的屏幕上。

“我们留意到您对我方最终用户许可协议强制执行抗拒。由于您展现出压倒性军事力量，我们现正式废除对MKIII地质辐射矩阵的知识产权声索。我们希望您能在使用这一新科技的过程中获得快乐。”

无人机发生了爆炸，同时切断了通讯链接。
extreme_frontiers.1534.desc.en:
As the battle draws to a close in [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName], a new communication from the customer service drone plays on our screens.

"We have noted your objection to our efforts to enforce the terms of the End User License Agreement. As a result of your display of overwhelming military might, we will now rescind our claim to the intellectual property of the MKIII Georadiation Matrix. We hope you enjoy your newly acquired technology."

The drone explodes, severing the communication link.

extreme_frontiers.1535.desc.zh: 处理掉了客服无人机后，我们现在就可以继续逆向工程这台地质辐射矩阵了。
extreme_frontiers.1535.desc.en: With the customer service drones dealt with, we are now able to resume retro-engineering the Georadiation Matrix.

extreme_frontiers.1540.desc.common.zh: 通过将放射性分子去稳技术整合进环境改造设备，现在我们可以刺激高价值资源的生长了。
extreme_frontiers.1540.desc.common.en: By integrating radioactive molecular destabilization into our terraforming equipment, we can stimulate the growth of valuable resources.

extreme_frontiers.1540.desc.default.zh: 通过深入的研究工作，我们得以重新设计MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进流程解锁了其全部的潜力。
extreme_frontiers.1540.desc.default.en: After extensive study, we have successfully retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, unlocking its potential with added improvements to the process.

extreme_frontiers.1540.desc.industrialis.zh: 通过孜孜不倦的企业家级效率，我们重新设计了MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进操作方法来产生最大的利润。
extreme_frontiers.1540.desc.industrialis.en: Through relentless entrepreneurial efficiency, we have retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, refining its operational methods to yield maximum profit.

extreme_frontiers.1545.desc.zh:
我们成功拆解了[from.GetName]上的装置，将所有可能重新利用的材料都回收了。

随着这台装置的破坏，它的前身也被摧毁了，这种毁灭性性技术的秘密就这样永远地消失在星系中。
extreme_frontiers.1545.desc.en:
We have successfully dismantled the device on [from.GetName], salvaging any materials that could be repurposed for our benefit.

With this device destroyed and its predecessors in ruin, the secrets of this destructive technology are lost to the galaxy forever.

extreme_frontiers.155.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]通过[from.From.GetName]上的一个开口送入了一台武器化的探测器。一抵达核心，其上的有毒载荷就会释放，侵染并灭绝当地的单细胞生物。

我们发现[from.From.GetName]的气态外层逐渐消散在虚空中，余下的是一颗小巧的岩质行星。
extreme_frontiers.155.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] sent a weaponized probe into one of the openings on [from.From.GetName]'s surface. Once at the core, a toxic payload was released, infecting and exterminating its native single-celled organisms.

We observed as [from.From.GetName]'s gassy outer layers gradually dissipated into the void, leaving behind a small and rocky planet.

extreme_frontiers.160.desc.default.zh:
对[from.GetName]地表的进一步调查发现了我们在轨调查时遇到的这些光学现象的成因。

大气条件将星球的大部分永久冻土打磨出透明的光泽，揭示了隐藏其下的生长着多色晶体的深层网络。从远处观察，这些自然现象产生了如万花筒般的效果。
extreme_frontiers.160.desc.default.en:
Closer inspection of [from.GetName]'s surface discovered the cause of the optical phenomena encountered during our orbital surveys.

Atmospheric conditions have polished large sections of the planet's permafrost to a transparent sheen, revealing deep networks of multi-colored crystal growths lurking beneath. These naturally occurring phenomena give rise to a kaleidoscopic effect when observed from afar.

extreme_frontiers.160.desc.machine.zh:
$extreme_frontiers.160.desc.default$

虽然它具有传统的美学价值，但这里丰富的矿藏才是我们关注的真正目标。
extreme_frontiers.160.desc.machine.en:
$extreme_frontiers.160.desc.default$

While conventionally aesthetically pleasing, the rich mineral deposits that lie within are the real target of our attention.

extreme_frontiers.160.tooltip.en:
Unlocks the Colony Decision $decision_prismatic_ice_exhibit$ with the following effects:
£amenities£ $MOD_PLANET_AMENITIES_MULT$: +25%
$mod_planet_jobs_unity_produces_mult$: +25%

extreme_frontiers.170.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]发现了[from.GetName]上的这些超热等离子喷流的源头。

这颗行星的独特磁场促进了地幔深处电离物质之间的反应，形成了高压等离子体的熔岩室。

行星上不稳定的构造板块坍塌时，这些等离子体就像致命的炮弹一样向上射出，与大气中的气体一起点燃，产生二次爆炸。我们的武器专家热衷于将这些原理应用于自己的等离子武器。
extreme_frontiers.170.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] has uncovered the cause of the superheated plasma eruptions on [from.GetName].

The unique magnetic field of the planet facilitates a reaction between ionized materials deep within the planetary mantle, creating volcanic chambers of highly pressurized plasma.

When the unstable tectonic plates of the planet give way, this plasma is explosively propelled upward as a deadly projectile, igniting with gases in the atmosphere to create secondary explosions. Our weapons specialists are keen to apply these principles to our own plasma-based armaments.

extreme_frontiers.180.b.zh: 把它们全部挖出来用掉。

extreme_frontiers.180.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]异常的黑云事实上是某种大型食肉昆虫的密集虫群。

这些长着翅膀的掠食者在岩石裂缝中筑巢，每天定时从中倾巢而出，吞吃星球表面所剩无几的有机物。

得益于强大的新陈代谢可以在在进食时逆转细胞衰变，使得这些节肢动物只要定期消耗营养就能无限期地延长寿命。
extreme_frontiers.180.desc.en:
The unusual black clouds on [from.GetName] are actually dense swarms of large carnivorous insects.

These winged predators nest in rock fissures and emerge once daily to devour any scant organic matter available on the planet's surface.

Thanks to a potent metabolism which reverses cell decay upon feeding, these arthropods can prolong their lifespan indefinitely, as long as nutrients are consumed regularly.

extreme_frontiers.180.desc.altered_metab.zh: 在田野调查分析的过程中，[Leader.GetName]的[Leader.Species.GetHandName]被其中的一个标本咬伤，下a额触发了一种显著的代谢响应。这种独特的物种身上还有很多关于有机细胞再生能力的知识可以学习。
extreme_frontiers.180.desc.altered_metab.en: During fieldwork analysis, [Leader.GetName]'s [Leader.Species.GetHandName] was bitten by one of the specimens, triggering a remarkable metabolic response. This unique species has much to teach us about the regenerative capacities of organic cells.

extreme_frontiers.190.desc.zh:
深海回声定位和地震遥感相结合定位出了[from.GetName]深层振动的源头。其液态氮构成的冰下海洋是一大群巨型鳍脚类动物的家园，它们已经适应了如此严苛的生存环境。

这种引人注目的生物无论是尺寸还是重量都与一艘小型运输舰相当。他们发出强力的低频嗡嗡声来进行交流，这种声音甚至可以在整个行星范围内回荡。一种独特的富含胶原蛋白的鲸脂保护着它们免受低温烧伤和霜冻，同时还能在海洋中放大它们的叫声。

这些巨型动物在这个孤立的生态系统中没有任何天敌，它们非常温顺，通过重复它们独特的声音很容易就能吸引到洋面上。
extreme_frontiers.190.desc.en:
A combination of deep sea echolocation and seismic telemetry has located the source of the deep vibrations on [from.GetName]. Its subglacial liquid nitrogen ocean is home to vast herds of gigantic pinnipeds who have adapted to life in this harsh environment.

The remarkable creatures have the size and mass of a small transport craft. To communicate, they emit a powerful low-frequency drone that can reverberate on a planetwide scale. A uniquely collagen-rich blubber protects them from cryogenic burns and frostbite, while at the same time amplifying their calls across the sea.

Lacking any natural predators in this isolated ecosystem, these large animals are curious, highly docile, and can be easily drawn to the surface by replicating their idiosyncratic vocalizations.

extreme_frontiers.200.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]找到了[from.GetName]上深层海洋电流的来源。

这片海底是一种具有发电能力的复杂冷水珊瑚物种的家园。该物种使用独特的细胞器产生电流来吸引微生物，亦作为一种捕食和交流的手段。

我们的探测器对珊瑚有刺激作用，只要我们改变传输频率，珊瑚就会做出反应，提高电流输出。

仔细调节与这种深水物种的互动，我们就可以在不破坏脆弱生态系统的前提下增加星球的能源输出。
extreme_frontiers.200.desc.en:
The source of the deep sea electrical currents on [from.GetName] has been identified by [Leader.GetName].

The ocean floor is home to a complex species of cold-water coral with electrogenetic capabilities. This species uses specialized organelles to generate current to lure microorganisms as both a means of sustenance and communication.

Our survey probes are acting as a stimulant for the coral, which reacts by increasing its electrical output whenever we change a transmission frequency.

By carefully modulating our interactions with this deep water species, we can increase the planet's energy output without disrupting the delicate ecosystem.

extreme_frontiers.2005.desc.common.zh:
我们在[target.GetName]上的首次地质辐射环境改造完成了。

将地表劣化为不可宜居的毒性废土，得益于而对地质辐射矩阵设计的改进，我们提取了数量庞大的资源。
extreme_frontiers.2005.desc.common.en:
Our first deployment of Georadiation Terraforming on [target.GetName] has concluded.

By reducing the surface to an uninhabitable toxic wasteland, we extracted an unprecedented bounty of materials thanks to our improvements to the Georadiation Matrix's design.

extreme_frontiers.2005.desc.industrialis.zh: 这一里程碑事件标志着我国开始了一个开发和营利的新时代。
extreme_frontiers.2005.desc.industrialis.en: This milestone marks the beginning of a new era of exploitation and profit for our empire.

extreme_frontiers.210.desc.zh:
基于对[from.GetName]沉积物的研究，我们发现这颗星球曾经遍布火山，却遭到了骤冷事件，其表面的熔岩变成了成片成片的火山玻璃。

行星表面无数的撞击坑表明该事件可能是由于外源天体，例如彗星风暴的撞击导致的。在这些黑曜石结构的内部是巨大的空洞和因骤冷事件被从火山口捕获其中的含硫气体。

通过精准的提取我们就能收获这些资源为自己所用。
extreme_frontiers.210.desc.en:
Based on sedimentary analysis of [from.GetName], we have discovered that this once volcanic world experienced a sudden flash freezing event, turning its surface lava into a sheen of volcanic glass.

The many impact craters on the planet's surface suggest this was most likely caused by an external celestial impact, such as a meteor storm. Contained within these obsidian formations are large bubbles of trapped sulfuric gases from the volcanic vents now sealed by the flash freeze.

With precise extraction, we will be able to harvest these resources for our own needs.

extreme_frontiers.220.desc.zh:
我们已经找到了[from.GetName]上探测器失踪的原因。

构成这颗行星大气的各气体层之间表现出巨大的温差。气体层剧烈摩擦时，这种剧变就产生了强烈的逆流。

这一点，再加上每种气体密度的差异，形成了灾难性的剪切力，让任何穿过大气圈层的物体都被无情撕碎。

既然我们了解了这种现象，就可以改造设备使其能承受这种极端条件，从而利用这种自然现象的动能。
extreme_frontiers.220.desc.en:
We have identified the cause of our probes' disappearance on [from.GetName].

The various gaseous strata that make up the planet's atmosphere exhibit dramatic temperature differentials. These drastic variations create a sharp countercurrent as layers of gas move violently in opposing directions.

This, combined with the contrasting densities of each gas, fosters cataclysmic shearing forces that tear apart anything transitioning between the atmospheric layers.

Now that we know what to expect, our own equipment can be modified to endure these extreme conditions, letting us harness the kinetic force of this natural phenomenon.

extreme_frontiers.230.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的地理进行进一步探测发现其硅酸盐地幔中存在一个巨大的地下网络。

探测器显示，这些洞穴居住着一种生活在硅酸盐岩石内的深地幔环节动物。大量的这种生物从内部吞噬着星球，然后将消化的废物喷射到行星轨道上，被宇宙风剥离。

消灭这些环节动物可以让我们的[controller.GetMinerPlural_lower]获得大量高品易得的硅酸盐矿石。
extreme_frontiers.230.desc.en:
Closer inspection of [from.GetName]'s geology found that its silicate mantle features a sprawling network of large subterranean burrows.

Exploratory probes revealed that these hollows are home to a thriving species of deep mantle annelid which subsists on silicate rock. Vast colonies of these creatures are devouring the planet from within, then ejecting the digested waste into planetary orbit where it is stripped away by cosmic winds.

Exterminating the annelids would grant our [controller.GetMinerPlural_lower] access to extensive quantities of easily accessible silicate ore.

extreme_frontiers.230.desc.terravore.zh: $extreme_frontiers.230.desc$它们的饮食非常引人注目，与我们相差无几。
extreme_frontiers.230.desc.terravore.en: $extreme_frontiers.230.desc$ Their appetite is impressive, and not so different from ours.

extreme_frontiers.240.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]的永夜半球形成了一种独特的演化环境，让少数有机体能够生存在这颗严酷的行星上。

得益于独特的遗传特性，这里的生物群全都是半透明的，它们没有任何视觉，赖以非常复杂的回声定位生存。
extreme_frontiers.240.desc.en:
The permanently dark side of [from.GetName] has fostered a unique evolutionary environment for the few organisms able to survive this harsh world.

Thanks to a unique chromosomal variation, the fauna here are entirely translucent, possess no vision, and deploy sophisticated forms of echolocation to survive.

extreme_frontiers.240.desc.non_homicidal.zh: $extreme_frontiers.240.desc$这种独特的适应性让我们的[controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower]们颇感兴趣。
extreme_frontiers.240.desc.non_homicidal.en: $extreme_frontiers.240.desc$ These remarkable adaptations are of great interest to our [controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower].

extreme_frontiers.250.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]上荧光河流的分析发现其中居住着某种独特的微生物。

这些生物利用化学合成作用来代谢有害物质，并产生高度反应性的副产物。这些副产物改变河流的化学构成，造就了这种强烈的变色效果。

它们发出的充满活力的霓虹灯色调同时也是一种交流手段，用以表明它们的生育状况，在穿越星球上有毒溪流的同时吸引配偶。

继续研究这些生物及其生命周期可以为我们的[controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower]们带来不俗的研究机会。
extreme_frontiers.250.desc.en:
Analysis of the fluorescent rivers on [from.GetName] has revealed they are home to a unique species of microbial life.

Using chemosynthesis to metabolize harmful compounds, these creatures generate highly reactive byproducts that alter the river's chemical composition, causing dramatic color shifts.

Doubling as a means of communication, the vibrant neon hues they create are used to signal fertility status, attracting mates as they travel through the planet's toxic streams.

Continued study of these creatures and their lifecycle will provide a fascinating research opportunity for our [controller.GetResearcherPlural_lower].

extreme_frontiers.260.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]的异常大气捕获了大量的恒星辐射，导致行星暖化的连锁效应，甚至连金属都转化为高度活泼的气态形式存在。

这些化合物会与我们投放的所有调查设备瞬间发生反应，在表面附上一层结实的合金薄膜。而这一过程竟然不具有破坏性。

[leader.GetName]相信这一自然存在的蒸镀过程可以利用来提升[controller.GetName]内所有舰船船体的抗拉强度。
extreme_frontiers.260.desc.en:
[from.GetName]'s unusual atmosphere has trapped vast amounts of solar radiation, causing a cascade of planetary warming such that metals exist in a gaseous and highly volatile state.

These compounds reacted instantly with any survey equipment we deployed, coating it in a thin but durable metallic alloy layer. Surprisingly, this process was non-destructive.

[leader.GetName] believes this naturally-occurring electroplating process could be harnessed to improve the tensile strength of ship hulls across the [controller.GetName].

extreme_frontiers.265.desc.zh:
我们已经找到工业规模复现[from.From.GetName]上活性大气的特殊蒸镀过程的方法。

利用我们学到的知识，[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]们就能大幅提高特定金属的耐用性而不需要牺牲韧性或增加重量。

这些先进的方法可以应用到我们的舰船建造流程中。
extreme_frontiers.265.desc.en:
We have found a way to replicate the unusual electroplating process of [from.From.GetName]'s volatile atmosphere on an industrial scale.

Using what we have learned, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] can now greatly increase the durability of certain metals without sacrificing flexibility or adding weight.

These advanced methods can be applied to our ship construction processes.

extreme_frontiers.270.desc.zh:
在[from.GetName]上发现了丰富的石墨烯矿藏。这种碳的稀有同素异形体仅有一个分子厚，却拥有无与伦比的强度和导电性。

这种高价值的纳米材料在其地表自然形成，主要得益于这颗碳星球上独特大气的化学蒸气沉积。
extreme_frontiers.270.desc.en:
Abundant deposits of graphene have been found on [from.GetName]. This rare allotrope of carbon is only a single molecule thick but possesses unparalleled strength and conductivity.

The valuable nanomaterial forms naturally on the surface here thanks to chemical vapor deposition inherent to this Carbon World's unusual atmosphere.

extreme_frontiers.280.desc.zh:
我们辨明了[from.GetName]上不同寻常的质量读数的来源。

这颗行星的大气主要由富含碳的甲烷气体组成，随着重力压力的增加，甲烷气体会固化成超致密的钻石结构。由于行星上剧烈的风暴周期，于是就产生了快速移动的钻石风暴。

尽管这些钻石很容易提取为我们所用，但[leader.GetName]相信进一步研究其密度和纯度会得出更有价值的结果。
extreme_frontiers.280.desc.en:
We have identified the source of the unusual mass readings on [from.GetName].

The planet's atmosphere is composed primarily of carbon-rich methane gas, which solidifies into ultra-dense diamond structures as gravitational pressure increases. Due to the planet's fierce storm cycles, the phenomenon gives rise to fast-moving diamond storms.

While these diamonds are easy to extract for our own needs, [leader.GetName] is confident that closer examination of their density and purity will yield further valuable results.

extreme_frontiers.285.desc.zh:
[leader.GetName]对[from.From.GetName]上超密钻石的研究完成了。

形成这些钻石的压缩过程产生了独特的晶格结构，使其在限制和放大高频光振荡方面非常有效。

这一突破将为我们的帝国带来极大的好处。
extreme_frontiers.285.desc.en:
[leader.GetName]'s research into the ultra-dense diamonds of [from.From.GetName] has concluded.

The compression process that creates these diamonds results in a unique crystalline lattice structure. This renders them remarkably efficient at confining and amplifying high-frequency light oscillation.

This breakthrough will prove an excellent boon for our empire.

extreme_frontiers.290.b.zh: 充分利用这种地质活动。
extreme_frontiers.290.b.en: Put the geothermal activity to good use.

extreme_frontiers.290.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的极端地质应力进行深入研究之后，我们发现了一座巨大的超级火山因上部火山锥的部分崩塌而被堵塞。

大量滞留的熔岩已经灌满了所有能联通的底下空间，正在对主通喷口的堵塞物施加巨大的向上压力。坍塌物暂时将岩浆禁锢在原地，但谁也不知道这种微妙的平衡还能持续多久。

被锁住的熔岩含有异常多的稀有金属和多种矿物质。[leader.GetName]相信我们帮助它可控喷发之后就可以收获这些资源了。
extreme_frontiers.290.desc.en:
After further study of the extreme seismic tension on [from.GetName], we have discovered that a colossal supervolcano has become blocked by a partial upper cone collapse.

Vast reserves of magma have filled all available underground chambers and are exerting immense upward pressure against the blockage in the main vent. The collapsed material is currently holding the magma in place, but it is impossible to predict how long this delicate equilibrium will last.

The trapped molten rock is exceptionally rich in rare metals and complex mineral compounds. [leader.GetName] believes we can harvest these resources safely by facilitating a controlled eruption.

extreme_frontiers.295.desc.zh:
我们在[from.From.GetName]的超级火山外锥体上的不同位置挖了一系列人工竖井，将其结构削弱，使其无法继续约束下方大量堆积的岩浆。

一越过临界点就会产生惊人的结果。高压的熔岩向上爆炸，摧毁了整座火山的上半部分。

我们将溢出的熔岩引导到精心准备的通道中，以专门的采矿设备进行收集。
extreme_frontiers.295.desc.en:
By boring a series of artificial shafts at various points in the outer cone of [from.From.GetName]'s supervolcano, we weakened its structure until it was no longer able to contain the massive accumulation of magma below.

Once the tipping point was reached, the results were spectacular. The volcano's upper section was obliterated entirely as highly pressured molten rock exploded upward.

We directed the overflowing lava into carefully prepared channels, where it will be harvested by specialized mining equipment.

extreme_frontiers.300.desc.zh:
[leader.GetName]发现了[from.GetName]上剧烈喷发的源头。

这颗气态巨行星的大气的气态中间层和平流层之间悬浮着一层液态金属氢化物。下层密度更高的甲烷气体托举着这些液体漂浮。

随着时间的推移，释放的电荷在金属氢内部积聚，扰动亚层。在压力达到临界点后，气体向上层大气中喷出高导电性液体，弥散到整颗行星之后重新沉降下来。

我们的追踪系统可以轻易显示这些压力波动，方便我们收获这些高价值资源。
extreme_frontiers.300.desc.en:
[leader.GetName] has uncovered the source of the volatile eruptions on [from.GetName].

The atmosphere of this gas giant has formed in such a way that a layer of liquid metallic hydrogen is suspended between the gaseous mesosphere and stratosphere. The denser composition of methane gas in the lower layer keeps the fluid aloft.

Over time, electrical discharges build up within the metallic hydrogen, agitating the sublayer. After a critical build up of pressure, gaseous eruptions spew out highly conductive liquid into the upper atmosphere, dissipating across the planet before resettling.

Our tracking systems can easily monitor these pressure fluctuations, allowing us to harvest these valuable resources.

extreme_frontiers.310.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的地质分析找到了之前在轨道上发现的异常能量波动的源头。

这颗行星活跃的地质活动在冻土不稳定的地区产生了剧烈的静电放电。

这种火山闪电向天空爆发，将周围的空气电离。这一事件释放的极端热量形成热冲击，然后固化成闪电状的结构。

利用地质分析获得的知识，我们可以轻易地预测这些地震爆发，并对其加以利用。
extreme_frontiers.310.desc.en:
Geological analysis of [from.GetName] has identified the source of the erratic energy spikes detected during initial orbital surveys.

The planet's volatile tectonic activity produces violent electrostatic discharges in regions with unstable frozen tundra.

This volcanic lightning erupts skywards turning the surrounding air to plasma. The extreme heat unleashed by this event produces a thermal shock which then solidifies into lightning-shaped structures.

Using what we have learned from the geological analysis, we will be able to easily predict these seismic eruptions and exploit this phenomenon for our own purposes.

extreme_frontiers.320.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行细致的地理学调查发现在冷冻的地壳下流动着半凝固的氨河流。提高地热压力将驱动这些物质穿过脆弱表面的裂隙。

这些喷发口遍布行星表面，射出的危险蒸汽和氨泥浆的敏感混合物。当暴露在极端的表面低温后瞬间冻结，这些烂泥形成了遍布易采收高价值晶体的广阔平原。
extreme_frontiers.320.desc.en:
Detailed geological surveys of [from.GetName] have revealed rivers of semi-frozen ammonia flowing beneath its frozen crust. Rising geothermal pressures drive this substance through fissures in the brittle surface.

These eruptions spew a volatile mixture of hazardous vapors and ammonia slush across the surface of the planet. Refreezing as it becomes exposed to the extreme surface temperatures, the slush forms sprawling plains of easily harvestable and valuable crystals.

extreme_frontiers.330.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]将无数的小卫星、小行星和太空碎片约束在其轨道上。放射性同位素定年表明这些东西都是在数千年前路过该恒星系的时候被它的引力井捕获的。

在对这些物体进行编目的过程中我们发现了一些古老而原始的探测器，表明存在一个正在初涉太空探索的文明。

其中大多数数据库都已经腐坏或因与其他物体撞击而损毁。但其中一个包含有一系列[from.GetName]地表的图像，时间跨度长达数百年。
extreme_frontiers.330.desc.en:
[from.GetName] has a multitude of moonlets, asteroids, and space debris locked within its orbit. Radioactive isotope dating suggests they were all captured by the planet's gravity well while passing through the system thousands of years ago.

While cataloging these objects we found a few ancient and very basic survey probes, suggestive of a civilization making its first forays in space exploration.

Most of their data banks are either corrupted or physically damaged from collisions with other objects, but one contained a series of images of [from.GetName]'s surface spanning hundreds of years.

extreme_frontiers.340.desc.default.zh: $extreme_frontiers.340.desc$这些物质具有独特的研究价值。
extreme_frontiers.340.desc.default.en: $extreme_frontiers.340.desc$ These materials present a unique research opportunity.

extreme_frontiers.340.desc.first_contact.zh: $extreme_frontiers.340.desc$我们将对其进行采收并研究其作为隐身材料的潜在价值。
extreme_frontiers.340.desc.first_contact.en: $extreme_frontiers.340.desc$ They will be harvested and studied for their potential uses as a stealth material.

extreme_frontiers.350.a.zh: 她的经验可是无价之宝。

extreme_frontiers.350.b.zh: 给她一艘飞船和一些物资。
extreme_frontiers.350.b.en: Gift her a shuttle and supplies.

extreme_frontiers.350.d.zh: 真有趣。摧毁她的庇护所。

extreme_frontiers.350.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行的地表探险发现了这一改造的外勤站以及它唯一的居住者。

她自称是一名被困多年的科学家，在这片恶劣的星球里孤身生存至今，如今愿以她的专业知识换取[root.Owner.GetName]的救援。
extreme_frontiers.350.desc.en:
A surface expedition to [from.GetName] located the repurposed field station and its lone occupant.

Identifying herself as a stranded scientist who has endured this harsh world for years, she offers her expertise to the [root.Owner.GetName] in exchange for rescue.

extreme_frontiers.352.a.zh: 你为什么落难到这里了？

extreme_frontiers.352.a.response.zh: 我当时正在勘测[from.From.GetName]，记录基岩的独特特征。我的船员说他们要驾驶探测飞船简单检查一下。我信了他们。焦虑了几天后，我才意识到，他们直接开回家了。
extreme_frontiers.352.a.response.en: I was surveying [from.From.GetName], cataloging the unique bedrock. My crew said they'd do a quick sweep in our exploration craft. I believed them. Only after a few days of worrying did I realize what had happened. They took off and flew home.

extreme_frontiers.352.b.en: How did you survive here for so long?

extreme_frontiers.352.b.response.zh: 哦，真是奇妙啊。只要稍微改造细胞通透性，再让热休克蛋白过度表达……之后，要在我改造的细胞上诱导大自噬就简单得多了。而多亏了这个世界丰富的钠含量，我得以烹制出许多美味佳肴。
extreme_frontiers.352.b.response.en: Oh it's a wonder what you can do when modifying cell permeability and hyper-expressing heat shock proteins... After that, it was simple to induce macroautophagy on my modified cells, and thanks to the sodium content of this world I could generate many savory meals.

extreme_frontiers.352.c.zh: 你还想和同类们重见吗？
extreme_frontiers.352.c.en: Do you not want to rejoin your own kind?

extreme_frontiers.352.c.response.zh: 他们不配拥有我在这块岩石上取得的突破。我根本不想知道他们抛弃我的神经借口。
extreme_frontiers.352.c.response.en: They don't deserve the breakthroughs I've made on this rock. I don't care to learn what duplicitous reasons they had for abandoning me.

extreme_frontiers.352.d.en: What can you do for us?

extreme_frontiers.352.d.response.zh: 我已经厌倦在简陋的实验室工作。我渴望从太空去看新世界。
extreme_frontiers.352.d.response.en: I'm tired of working in a makeshift lab. I want to see new worlds... From space.

extreme_frontiers.352.desc.zh:
一位形容枯槁的[scru_species.GetClass]走出她改装为居所的外勤站。当她谈及自己在[from.From.GetName]上的遭遇时，从她[scru_species.GetMouthName]中发出的声音沙哑破碎；言语断断续续。

“请原谅……我已经很多年……没有和人说过话了……”
extreme_frontiers.352.desc.en:
An emaciated [scru_species.GetClass] steps out of her hab-converted field station. When she speaks of her ordeal on [from.From.GetName], the sounds from her [scru_species.GetMouthName] rasps; words arrive in fits and starts.

"Forgive me. I have not... spoken to another in many years..."

extreme_frontiers.352.e.custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_survivalist_scru$作为一名领袖加入我们帝国。
extreme_frontiers.352.e.custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_survivalist_scru$ joins our empire as a Leader.

extreme_frontiers.360.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]上极端热信号的源头找到了。

遍布行星的间歇泉从地表深处释放出高度易燃的氢气。这些间歇泉喷发时，气体就被行星的热量点燃，产生直抵云霄的巨大火柱。

再和大气压力相结合，就产生了极不稳定的气流，以巨大的火焰龙卷风的形式横扫地面。

尽管这是一种极具破坏力的自然现象，但我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearcherPlural_lower]很确信这些龙卷风以及其产生的大量动能可以人为地复现并加以利用。
extreme_frontiers.360.desc.en:
The source of the extreme heat signatures on [from.GetName] has been discovered.

Across the planet, geysers are emitting highly flammable hydrogen gas from deep below the surface. As these geysers erupt, the planet's heat ignites the gas, resulting in vast pillars of flame blasting into the skies.

When combined with the atmospheric pressure, this creates extremely volatile air currents, sending streams of fire swirling across the landscape in the form of massive, flaming tornadoes.

While a devastating natural phenomena, our [Root.Owner.GetResearcherPlural_lower] are confident that these tornadoes, and the vast volumes of kinetic energy they generate, could be recreated artificially for practical use.

extreme_frontiers.365.desc.zh:
[from.Leader.GetName]发现了在可控环境中再现并驾驭[from.From.GetName]上发现的那种火龙卷的方法。

有了这一突破，我们就能够利用的恒星基地来增加在同一星系中发现的所有熔融星球所产出的能量。
extreme_frontiers.365.desc.en:
[from.Leader.GetName] has successfully found a way to recreate and harness the flaming tornadoes found on [from.From.GetName] in a controlled environment.

With this breakthrough, we will be able to use our starbases to increase the energy produced by any molten worlds that are found in the same system.

extreme_frontiers.365.desc.default.zh: 这一发现背后的科学理论在电弧熔炉的研发中有诸多应用，我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]已经开始将它们应用在实际开发当中。
extreme_frontiers.365.desc.default.en: The scientific theory behind this discovery has various applications towards the development of Arc Furnace technology, with our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] prepared to start applying the theory in practical development.

extreme_frontiers.365.desc.has_furnace.zh: 这项科学理论与我们目前对电弧熔炉的理解有许多异曲同工之处，打开了域外建筑学领域的许多全新可能。
extreme_frontiers.365.desc.has_furnace.en: The scientific theory shares many parallels with our existing understanding of Arc Furnaces, opening new possibilities for offworld construction.

extreme_frontiers.370.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]这些异常的地质扫描结果的根源是一群游荡的硅基巨型动物群。

这些巨大的生物长距离迁徙，周期性地潜入行星的熔岩湖中获取喜欢的食物：一种富含易爆微粒的岩质沉淀物。通过追踪它们的迁徙路径，我们就能在对行星的生态系统造成极低的影响下提取这些沉淀为自己所用。

它们厚重的外骨骼可以抵御极端温度；对这些生物生命周期进行更详尽深入的研究可以产出惊人的结果。
extreme_frontiers.370.desc.en:
The anomalous tectonic scans on [from.GetName] have been attributed to the presence of large herds of roaming silicon-based megafauna.

Migrating across great distances, these enormous creatures periodically submerge in the planet's lava lakes to gather their preferred food source: a rocky sediment rich in Volatile Motes. By tracking their migratory patterns, we will be able to extract these sediments for our own needs with minimal impact to the planet's ecosystem.

Their thick outer carapaces are able to withstand extreme temperatures; a deeper, more detailed study of their life cycle could yield fascinating results.

extreme_frontiers.375.desc.zh:
对[from.From.GetName]上独特的大型动物进行研究得出了一种可转用的热动力学洞见，能应用在我们的船舶工业中。

这种生物摄入的微粒使他们的外壳上形成了一种基于重质硅酸盐的结构，并得到天然存在的难熔金属的补强。

从它们脱落的外壳上取回无数的样本之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]现在可以复制这种生物力学原理，用于研发我们自己的船体镀层。
extreme_frontiers.375.desc.en:
Comprehensive study of the unique megafauna on [from.From.GetName] has revealed transferable thermodynamic insights which can be applied within our shipyards.

The mote-infused diet of the creatures results in a heavy silicate-based structure forming throughout their durable outer shells, reinforced with naturally occurring refractory materials.

Having recovered numerous samples of their shedded outer layers, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] can now replicate their biomechanical principles in the development of our own hull platings.

extreme_frontiers.380.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]上发现的那些遗弃的机器都是一台台独立的推进装置。在大气层中总数超过了一千座。

这些复杂的聚变装置以特殊设计的材料支撑，可以消耗行星下层的氢气作为燃料来产生巨大的推力。其中的大多数上存在过载损伤。

我们的分析表明这些机械的位置都精心安置，使其可以对行星本身施加推力。这表明这些古老的装置最初是为了改变行星的轨道而布置的。

虽然不再适合这个级别的艰巨任务，但我们仍可能重新利用受损较小的装置，燃烧掉星球的气体层，从而暴露出富含矿物质的核心。
extreme_frontiers.380.desc.en:
Each of the abandoned machines found on [from.GetName] is a standalone thruster component. In total, over one thousand are present in the upper atmosphere.

Made from specially engineered materials, these complex fusion devices are designed to ingest hydrogen gas from the planet below to use as fuel for generating significant amounts of thrust. Most show signs of overload damage.

Our analysis reveals that all of the machines are positioned in such a way that this thrust would exert force against the planet itself, suggesting this ancient hardware was originally deployed in an attempt to alter the planet's orbit.

While no longer suitable for this level of monumental task, we may be able to repurpose the lesser damaged models to burn away the planet's gassy layers and expose its mineral-rich core.

extreme_frontiers.385.desc.zh:
我们可以修复一部分[from.From.GetName]上受损的行星推进装置，将其校准以施加等大反向的推力。

这些强力的聚变装置激活后就能以指数级速率抽取氢气，将行星的整个大气层烧尽，并暴露出其富含矿物的核心，虽然温度可能会高了一些。
extreme_frontiers.385.desc.en:
We were able to repair a few of [from.From.GetName]'s damaged planetary thrusters and calibrated them to exert equal force in opposing directions.

Once activated these powerful fusion devices drew up hydrogen at an exponential rate, burning away the planet's gaseous atmosphere and exposing its mineral rich core, albeit at an extremely high temperature.

extreme_frontiers.390.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]与其周边的行星的物质组成并不匹配，反倒是和相邻的[event_target:wandering_planet_origin.GetName]恒星系中的许多天体完美相符，这暗示了它的真实起源。

这颗行星的表面清晰可见一个硕大无比的撞击坑，这让我们认为它是由于一次大规模的小行星撞击而偏离了原来的轨道。这颗自由漂浮的流浪行星后来被[from.System.Star.GetName]重力井捕获，形成了异常的逆行轨道。

这颗独特的行星从诞生起在两个恒星系中居住过，带来了丰富的深入研究机会。
extreme_frontiers.390.desc.en:
[from.GetName]'s composition does not match that of other planets in its vicinity. It does however align perfectly with various celestial bodies in the neighboring [event_target:wandering_planet_origin.GetName] system, suggesting its true origin.

The planet's surface is marked by a particularly large impact crater, leading us to assume it was dislodged from its original orbit by a massive asteroid collision. This free floating rogue planet was then later captured by the gravity well of [from.System.Star.GetName], where it assumed its unusual reverse orbit.

This remarkable planet has resided in two different systems since it formed, providing rich opportunities for further study.

extreme_frontiers.400.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]上发现的羽状蒸汽是由下地幔深处强烈的冷火山活动造成的，大量的氨氮气体被排放到地表。

这些羽状云扶摇直上直抵行星的大气层边缘，被恒星风骤然削平。

通过研究这些独特烟雾结构中化学成分的微小变化，我们可以进一步了解行星核心的复杂地质过程。
extreme_frontiers.400.desc.en:
The vapor plumes observed on [from.GetName] are caused by intense cryovolcanic activity deep within the lower mantle, expelling vast columns of nitrogen and ammonia gas upwards.

The plumes rise vertically until they reach the limits of the planet's atmosphere, where solar winds cause them to abruptly flatten off.

By studying the small variations in the chemical contents of these unique fume formations we can learn more about the complex geological processes of the planet's core.

extreme_frontiers.410.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的详细调查揭示了我们初步扫描时数据损坏的原因。

纤维状矿物形成的浓厚云雾构成了行星的上层大气。这些细长蜿蜒的丝缕源自气态巨行星的下层，高压环境将其拉伸为高导电性的矿物云。

这些纤维一边在大气中循环一边积蓄静电能量，并且会周期性发生放电。我们很容易采收这些资源为自己所用。
extreme_frontiers.410.desc.en:
Detailed inspection of [from.GetName] has revealed the source of the data corruption in our preliminary scans.

Dense clouds of fibrous minerals make up the planet's upper atmosphere. These long sinuous strands originate from the gas giant's lower layers with the high pressure environment stretching them to form highly conductive mineral clouds.

Accumulating electrostatic energy as they circulate through the atmosphere, these fibers periodically discharge over time. We can easily extract these resources for our own needs.

extreme_frontiers.420.desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的细致调查发现了气象热脉冲的根源。

星罗棋布的地热喷口和间歇泉不断喷出高度易燃的气体，在大气中逐步累积。静电放电扮演起点燃催化的角色，导致爆炸性的气象锋面席卷整个星球的天空。

这些反应让我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]们对热动力燃烧获得了新的洞见，能在我们舰队的推进系统中加以应用
extreme_frontiers.420.desc.en:
Detailed observation of [from.GetName] has revealed the cause of the meteorological heat spikes.

Geothermal vents and geysers across the surface are ejecting highly flammable gases which then accumulate in the atmosphere. Electrostatic discharges then act as an ignition catalyst, causing explosive weather fronts that ravage the skies of this world.

These reactions have given our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] new insights into thermodynamic combustion, with applications towards our own fleet's propulsion systems.

extreme_frontiers.420.desc.maimed.zh: 不幸的是，这项危险的研究让[leader.GetName]受到严重的身体创伤。
extreme_frontiers.420.desc.maimed.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [leader.GetName] with severe physical injuries.

extreme_frontiers.420.desc.traumatized.zh: 不幸的是，这项危险的研究让[leader.GetName]受到严重的精神创伤。
extreme_frontiers.420.desc.traumatized.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [leader.GetName] with severe traumatization.

extreme_frontiers.430.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]上的生物质信号竟然是来自一小群缇扬奇。

它们可能是在这颗气态巨行星的大气消散前的一个临界点到来的，随后被熔融金属包裹着凝固了。

虽然有少量的生物物质留存，但在长期暴露在炼狱级的恒星辐射下，它们的大部身体已经变成了一种独特的生物金属合金。

[leader.GetName]相信，对这些珍惜的化石进行更细致的研究我们可以发现一种以生物原材料生产合金的新方法。
extreme_frontiers.430.desc.en:
The biomass readings on [from.GetName] are the petrified remains of a pod of Tiyanki.

Likely present in the gas giant during a critical point in its atmospheric dissipation, their bodies were encased in molten metal that has since solidified.

While a small amount of biological matter remains inside, prolonged exposure to the chthonian-level stellar radiation has converted the majority of their corpses into a unique bio-metallic alloy.

[leader.GetName] believes that with closer study of these rare fossils, we will be able to discover new avenues of alloy production from biological sources.

extreme_frontiers.435.desc.zh:
在对[from.From.GetName]上化石化的缇扬奇遗骸进行细致的调查后，我们研究出了一种模拟这种长时间炼狱级辐射暴露效应的新的合金产出方式。

这一突破性发现带来了一种杰出的制造方式，它使用生物质作为主要原料，而产出却可以与传统的方法相媲美。
extreme_frontiers.435.desc.en:
Following careful examinations of the petrified Tiyanki remains on [from.From.GetName], we have successfully identified a new means of alloy production by simulating the effects of long-term chthonian-level radiation exposure.

This breakthrough offers a remarkable methodology which uses biological matter as its primary raw material, producing results that rival more conventional methods.

extreme_frontiers.440.desc.zh:
[from.System.GetName]是我们目前为止所遇见的解释轨道共振的最佳案例。

每一颗行星在和邻居到达最近点时都相当于一个周期性引力源，产生了弹弓效应和动量互锁。这种相互作用的不同寻常的稳定性产生了这种高度规律的轨道。

该恒星系为研究行星引力对途径物体运动的加速提供了极好的机会，并可能应用于舰船机动。
extreme_frontiers.440.desc.en:
[from.System.GetName] exhibits the most perfect example of orbital resonance we have ever encountered.

Each planet exerts a periodic gravitational force on its neighbor when they are at their nearest points, creating a catapult effect and mutually dependent momentum. The unusual stability of these interactions results in highly coordinated orbits.

The system offers an excellent opportunity to study the way planetary gravity accelerates the motion of passing objects, with possible applications to ship maneuvering.

extreme_frontiers.445.desc.zh:
在研究了[from.From.System.GetName]恒星系内独特的轨道共振效应之后，我们对规划舰船最佳飞行路线的方法有了巨大的进展。

这些新的模型可以极其充分地在舰船用光速加减速阶段利用行星引力。
extreme_frontiers.445.desc.en:
After studying the unique orbital resonance effect in the [from.From.System.GetName] system, we have greatly improved our methods for plotting optimal ship flight paths.

These new models will allow us to take greater advantage of planetary gravity in achieving ship acceleration and deceleration at sublight speeds.

factions.1.desc.fire_cult.zh: 其成员倡导心灵主义价值，颂扬艰苦与忍耐。体能试炼在其社会中占重要地位。
factions.1.desc.fire_cult.en: Their members promote spiritualist values, praising hardship and the ability to suffer through it. Physical trials play a significant role in their society.

factions.1.desc.firstfinisher.zh: 要求得不到满足的派系会成为麻烦的源头，而支持帝国工作的派系可以为我们所用……
factions.1.desc.firstfinisher.en: A disgruntled faction will be a source of trouble, but one that approves of the government's actions could prove useful...

factions.1.desc.imperialist.zh: 他们的成员致力于确保我们对星系其他区域的军事统治。
factions.1.desc.imperialist.en: Their members have been pushing hard for us to assert our military dominance over the rest of the galaxy.

factions.1.desc.isolationist.zh: 他们的成员倡议关闭边境并且对星系事务保持不干涉原则。
factions.1.desc.isolationist.en: Their members are advocating for closed borders and non-interference with galactic affairs.

factions.1.desc.manifesti.zh: 他们的成员在各种无政府议题上表达了五彩缤纷的抗议，要求建立一个更富表达和平等的社会。
factions.1.desc.manifesti.en: Their members have sparked colorful protests on various anarchic issues, demanding a more expressive and egalitarian society.

factions.1.desc.progressive.zh: 他们的成员致力于我们帝国境内所有居民的平等与公正。
factions.1.desc.progressive.en: Their members work for equality and justice for all denizens of our empire.

factions.1.desc.prosperity.zh: 他们的成员致力于让国家专注于通过和平的手段来发展经济与维护社会稳定。
factions.1.desc.prosperity.en: Their members lobby for a national focus on financial growth and stability through peaceful means.

factions.1.desc.start.zh: 一个新的派系正在[Root.Owner.GetName]的政界中逐渐壮大。他们自称[Root.GetName]。
factions.1.desc.start.en: A new faction has recently been gaining traction in the internal political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the [Root.GetName].

factions.1.desc.start_short.zh: 有一个[Root.GetFactionType]已经组建成型，他们自称为[Root.GetName]。
factions.1.desc.start_short.en: A [Root.GetFactionType] has formed, calling themselves the [Root.GetName].

factions.1.desc.supremacist.zh: 他们的成员致力于确保[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的至高地位，有必要的可以缩减其他外星物种的权利。
factions.1.desc.supremacist.en: Their members seek to assert the primacy of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species, by curtailing the rights of aliens if necessary.

factions.1.desc.technologist.zh: 他们的成员致力于科学进步与成就。
factions.1.desc.technologist.en: Their members have been pushing hard for the advancement of the sciences.

factions.1.desc.totalitarian.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动一个极端集权的政治体系的出现以及提高军事权威。
factions.1.desc.totalitarian.en: Their members have been pushing hard for an extreme centralization of political and military power.

factions.1.desc.traditionalist.zh: 他们的成员支持唯心与保守观念。
factions.1.desc.traditionalist.en: Their members support spiritualist and conservative values.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_imperialist.zh: 他们的成员致力于使用我们武器库中所有强大的强化体武器来统治星系的其余部分。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_imperialist.en: Their members are committed to wielding every formidable, augmented weapon in our arsenal to assert dominance over the rest of the galaxy.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_isolationist.zh: 他们的成员提倡封闭边界，创造一个不受机器和其他星系实体干扰的社会。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_isolationist.en: Their members are advocating for closed borders, and a society free of interference from machines and other galactic entities.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_progressive.zh: 他们的成员寻求与星系邻居达成友好协议，以及为我们帝国的所有居民伸张正义。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_progressive.en: Their members seek friendly accord with our galactic neighbors and justice for all denizens of our empire.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_prosperity.zh: 他们的成员游说通过和平手段实现商业增长和稳定，避免军国主义扩张。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_prosperity.en: Their members lobby for mercantile growth and stability through peaceful means, free of militaristic augmentation.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_start.zh: 一个新的派系正在[Root.Owner.GetName]稚嫩的政界中浮出水面。他们自称为[Root.GetName]。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_start.en: A new faction has emerged in the nascent political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the [Root.GetName].

factions.1.desc.unplugged_supremacist.zh: 他们的成员致力于维护[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的优先地位，用我们自己生产的强大机械加以增强。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_supremacist.en: Their members seek to assert the primacy of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species, augmented by formidable machines of our own making.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_technologist.zh: 他们的成员致力于科学的进步以及对自身强化件的理解。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_technologist.en: Their members have been pushing hard for advancement of the sciences, and better understanding of our augments.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_totalitarian.zh: 他们的成员一直致力于推动主权政治权力和军事力量的极端集中，尽可能效仿我们所知的机械智能。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_totalitarian.en: Their members have been pushing hard for an extreme centralization of sovereign political power and military might, modelled on what we know of Machine Intelligences.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_traditionalist.zh: 他们的成员支持唯心与保守观念，与我们过去自然、有机的理念相一致。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_traditionalist.en: Their members support spiritualist and conservative values, many of which align with theories about our natural, organic past.

factions.1.desc.unplugged_xenoist.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动与其他外星物种的友好关系，摆脱过去机械意识留下的阴影。
factions.1.desc.unplugged_xenoist.en: Their members have been pushing hard for friendly relations with alien species, unburdened by the specter of our Machine past.

factions.1.desc.xenoist.zh: 他们的成员致力于推动与其他外星物种的友好关系。
factions.1.desc.xenoist.en: Their members have been pushing hard for friendly relations with alien species.

factions.3000.a.auth.zh: 密切关注这些活动人士。
factions.3000.a.auth.en: Keep a close watch on these activists.

factions.3000.a.demo.zh: 应当赞许这种热烈的议论！
factions.3000.a.demo.en: Such vigorous debate is to be commended!

factions.3000.b.en: The risks are too great. Bolster security.

factions.3000.b.auth.zh: 我们不能容忍这种情况。

factions.3000.desc.zh:
既有派系和新兴运动都对我们在[root.GetName]建立的新殖民地产生了异常浓烈的兴趣。从我们宣布在这个适宜的[root.GetPlanetHabitat]定居的那一刻起，[root.owner.GetName]内的几乎所有政权都对此有话要说。

我们的分析人士认为没有什么重大变故正在[root.GetName]酝酿，但还是建议小心谨慎。显然，我们的各种政治实体打算就着这个新兴世界大肆宣传。
factions.3000.desc.en:
Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on [root.GetName]. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetHabitat], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetName] has had something to say about it.

Our analysts don't suspect that anything truly radical is taking root on [root.GetName], but they advise some caution. It's clear our various political entities intend to campaign vigorously on this burgeoning world.

factions.3005.a.en: These patriots are to be commended.

factions.3005.b.zh: 或许……也许这种想法有一定可取之处？
factions.3005.b.en: Or... perhaps there is some merit to this thinking?

factions.3005.c.zh: 那么，这种行为也许是值得鼓励的。
factions.3005.c.en: Perhaps this conduct is to be encouraged, then.

factions.3005.desc.1.zh:
按照指示，我们在[root.GetName]的线人一直在定期汇报殖民地政治局势的最新进展。简而言之：前景向好。

地方执法者和政治代理人设法用最少的资源把公开异见控制在了最低限度。尤其是流氓派系，没能在殖民者那里占到一丁点好处。结果是我们仍然牢牢地控制着政治生态。
factions.3005.desc.1.en:
As instructed, our informants on [root.GetName] have been delivering regular updates on the colony's developing political situation. In short: the trending outlook appears good.

Local enforcers and political agents have managed to keep outright dissent to a minimum, using only the bare minimum of resources. Rogue Factions in particular have struggled to gain any meaningful ground amongst the colonists; the result is a political environment which remains firmly within our control.

factions.3005.desc.2.zh:
我们一直在收集有关[root.GetName]政治局势的数据，证实了我们的许多担忧。激进的边缘性运动已经成功地在殖民地的人口中获得支持。这些公民已经被社会公平和流动性的说教所动摇，并且不再认同我们社会的一些基本原则。

尽管场面不太好看，但这仍然是个好消息。我们已经积累了大量的研究，对于完善我们的[owner.GetAdj]殖民政治理论非常宝贵。此外，我们诱导了这些边缘因素，让它们在首都站稳脚跟前就自己暴露了出来。
factions.3005.desc.2.en:
The data we've been gathering about the political situation on [root.GetName] lends credence to many of our concerns. Fringe campaigns of a radical nature have managed to drum up support amongst the colony's population. These citizens have been swayed by sermons of social equity and mobility, and no longer subscribe to some of the founding principles of our society.

Despite appearances though, this still amounts to good news. We've amassed a substantial body of research, invaluable for refining our theories about [owner.GetAdj] colonial politics. Moreover: by luring out such fringe elements, we have exposed these threats long before they could ever gain a foothold on the capital.

factions.3005.desc.3.zh:
我们一直在收集有关[root.GetName]政治运动的信息，得出了一些有趣的展望。我们发现当地对新思想的包容度正在提升（超出了我们先前认定的稳定的政治思想），但没有离经叛道之举。

尽管任何偏离我们核心思想的行为都可以说是削弱了我们的权力基础，但这仍然能算是个好消息。这次试验相当于一个实际的研究样本，对于我们完善殖民政治理论非常宝贵。此外，我们已经证明，即便给予边缘因素一定的政治土壤，[owner.GetAdj]的人民也会批驳他们当中最激进的成分，并相对地向我们国家的原则靠拢。
factions.3005.desc.3.en:
The information we've been gathering about political campaigns on [root.GetName] has led to some interesting forecasts. We see a trend towards broader acceptance of new ideas - outside the bounds of what we would consider stable political thought - but no significant move towards radicalization.

Though any deviation from our core message could be said to weaken our power base, this may still amount to good news. This experiment amounts to a substantial body of research, invaluable as we refine our theories about colonial politics. Moreover: we have proven that even when fringe elements are given some ground, the [owner.GetAdj] people refute their most radical elements, and stay relatively close to our nation's principles.

factions.3010.a.zh: 或许我们应该进行干涉。
factions.3010.a.en: Perhaps we ought to shake things up.

factions.3010.b.zh: 对于我们的治国之道，这是颇有价值的检验！
factions.3010.b.en: A worthy test for our way of governance!

factions.3010.c.zh: 我们必须保护民主制度远离这类威胁。
factions.3010.c.en: We must guard against threats to democracy.

factions.3010.desc.1.zh:
我们的政治学家一直抱着热烈的兴趣观测着[root.GetName]。然而，尽管近期掀起了激烈的竞选活动，媒体还对此大肆渲染，他们仍预计该殖民地的政治走向会是相当典型的结果。

我们的研究人员注意到，这里“没有消息”就等于是好消息：尽管我们社会中的一些边缘分子发表了声明，但目前还没有迹象表明[root.GetName]正在被塑造成独裁的温床。目前，民主仍然是这里的一项基础性原则。
factions.3010.desc.1.en:
Our political scientists have been observing [root.GetName] with keen interest. However, despite feverish campaigning and a lot of recent fuss in the media, they forecast a fairly typical outcome for the colony's political future.

Our researchers note that 'no news' amounts to good news here: despite what some fringe elements in our society may claim, there are as yet no signs that [root.GetName] is being molded into a hotbed of autocracy. Democracy remains a founding principle there, for now.

factions.3010.desc.2.zh: 似乎我们社会之中的一些威权主义政治组织在[root.GetName]上生根发芽。他们的许多游说活动都把目标对准了这个蓬勃发展的殖民地；此外，尽管他们明显的成功尚未引起人们的警醒：我们的政治学家却认为需要对此抱持谨慎态度。对于[root.GetName]的[root.owner.GetAdj]而言，民主并非如同我们一开始想象的那样，是那么的重要或具有吸引力。
factions.3010.desc.2.en: It seems that some of the more authoritarian political bodies in our society have gained a foothold on [root.GetName]. Their campaigns were amongst many targeting this burgeoning colony, and although their apparent success isn't cause for alarm in itself: our political scientists believe some caution may be warranted. Democracy may not be as essential or as appealing to the [root.owner.GetAdj] of [root.GetName] as we first thought.

factions.3010.desc.3.zh:
我们的政治学家对[root.GetName]进行了一段时间的监控，他们的报告证实当地存在着多种政治主张。

目前还没有迹象表明[root.GetName]会陷入无政府状态，也没有类似模式的极端治理方式。然而，这种政治冷漠行为确实为[root.owner.GetAdj]的民主带来了一些独特的挑战——以及潜在风险，如果更极端的派系在此扎根的话。
factions.3010.desc.3.en:
Our political scientists have been monitoring [root.GetName] for some time, and their reports confirm a wide range of political opinions have taken root there.

There are no signs yet that [root.GetName] will descend into anarchy, or other similarly extreme modes of governance. However, this much political jockeying does still present [root.owner.GetAdj] democracy with some unique challenges - and potential risks, if more extreme factions manage to gain a foothold there.

factions.3010.frontier.tt.en: The $planet_political_frontier$ modifier will remain for approximately 9 years, increasing $MOD_POP_ETHICS_SHIFT_SPEED$ by +50%.

fallen_empire_angry_tooltip.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]一定会十分不满，搞不好还会教训我们一番。
fallen_empire_angry_tooltip.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will be most displeased, and may decide to teach us a lesson.

fallen_empire_enigmatic_tooltip.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]有可能会，也有可能不会对我们的拒绝作出反应。
fallen_empire_enigmatic_tooltip.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may or may not react to our refusal.

fallen_empire_happy_tooltip.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]会很满意的，也许还会在未来对我们加以青睐。
fallen_empire_happy_tooltip.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will be pleased, and may show us favor in the future.

fallen_empire_refuse_tooltip.zh: [From.GetName]会勃然大怒，很可能会攻击我们。
fallen_empire_refuse_tooltip.en: [From.GetName] will be very angry, and are likely to attack us.

fallen_empires.100.A.desc.zh:
我们并不是[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的[from.GetName]的第一位访客。这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球上所蕴含的待开发资源已经足以引人注目，而我们更是发现了一座停泊于高层轨道的古老且装饰华丽的信标。[from.GetName]显然属于某个远古的太空文明，但我们尚未发现他们在此处有任何的定居或勘探的迹象。

可能的理论有很多，但证据迫使我们考虑存在这么一个古老的文明，崇敬着这个郁郁葱葱的星球。我们只能猜测他们目前的下落——也就是说，假设他们仍然存在。
fallen_empires.100.A.desc.en:
We are not the first to visit [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. This [from.GetClassAdj] world is remarkable enough for its abundance of untouched resources, but we also found an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy perched in high orbit. [from.GetName] was clearly known to some ancient, spacefaring civilization, but we can find no evidence that they settled or even prospected here.

Theories abound, but evidence compels us to consider an ancient civilization which once revered this lush world. We can only guess as to their current whereabouts - that is, assuming they still exist.

fallen_empires.100.A.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们对[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系中的这颗郁郁葱葱的行星[from.GetName]进行了调查，结果表明，它曾经是另一种未知生命形式非常感兴趣的对象。我们在高轨道上发现了一个古老的导航信标，这表明，这颗行星曾有过外星访客，但在过去的几个世纪里，没有任何登陆或殖民的证据。相反，似乎有什么东西可以在保护这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球——但就目前情况而言，对于这样一个假定的实体，其命运和下落我们依旧不得而知。
fallen_empires.100.A.desc.gestalt.en: Our survey of [from.GetName] suggests this bountiful world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was once a subject of keen interest to some other, as yet unknown, life-form. An ancient navigation buoy in high orbit implies the planet has seen alien visitors, but there is no evidence of landfall or colonization in the past few centuries. Instead something seems to have preserved this [from.GetClassAdj] world - but the current fate or whereabouts of such a hypothetical entity are as yet unknown to us.

fallen_empires.100.A.desc.spi.zh:
$fallen_empires.100.desc.spi_intro$

我们相信[from.GetName]曾一度被视为圣体或者圣地而得到崇拜。至于是谁，我们尚且不知道——我们最好的猜测是，他们是一个已经衰落的唯心主义文明。
fallen_empires.100.A.desc.spi.en:
$fallen_empires.100.desc.spi_intro$

We believe [from.GetName] may once have been worshipped as a deity, or else it was considered a holy place. To whom, we do not yet know - but our best theories suggest a spiritually-minded civilization which has since fallen into decline.

fallen_empires.100.B.desc.zh:
我们怀疑，对于[from.GetName]而言，还存在比丰富的资源和原始的自然环境更重要的东西。奇怪的是，[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系里的这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一座古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。这台装置的外壳上蚀刻着复杂的图案，虽然还不是非常肯定，但我们相信这种美术形式应该源自附近的[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]。

他们对我们的态度相当捉摸不透，所以我们只能猜测[spi_fallen_empire.GetAdj]对这颗星球有何规划。至少没有迹象表明我们对[from.GetName]的兴趣冒犯到了他们……
fallen_empires.100.B.desc.en:
We suspect there is more to [from.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [from.GetClassAdj] world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system lies curiously untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit. Intricate designs have been etched into the hull of this device, and though we cannot say with certainty: we believe the origins of this artistry lie with the nearby [spi_fallen_empire.GetName].

So inscrutable is their attitude towards us, we can only speculate upon [spi_fallen_empire.GetAdj] designs for this world. There is at least no indication yet that our interest in [from.GetName] has caused them any offense...

fallen_empires.100.B.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们对[from.GetName]的调查表明，这颗位于[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系中的丰饶行星曾经是一个先进——但多愁善感的——生命形式所热衷的对象。其高轨道上有一个停用已久的导航信标，蚀刻着一些与[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]文化相似的设计纹路。

似乎[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曾经发誓要保护这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球，但至于现在是否仍是如此我们不得而知。
fallen_empires.100.B.desc.gestalt.en:
Our survey of [from.GetName] suggests this bountiful world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was once a subject of keen interest to an advanced - though sentimental - life-form. A long-disused navigation buoy in high orbit has been etched with intricate designs similar to those displayed by the [spi_fallen_empire.GetName].

It seems the [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] once sought to preserve this [from.GetClassAdj] world, though they give no indication if that is still the case.

fallen_empires.100.B.desc.spi.zh:
$fallen_empires.100.desc.spi_intro$

我们相信[from.GetName]被视为圣体而崇拜，或者说是被视为圣地一般。信标的装饰风格暗示，可能就是[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]在崇拜这个地方。不清楚现在是否还是如此。
fallen_empires.100.B.desc.spi.en:
$fallen_empires.100.desc.spi_intro$

We believe [from.GetName] was worshipped as a deity, or else has been regarded as a holy place. The decorative styling on the buoy suggests it may even be the [spi_fallen_empire.GetName] who once revered this place. It is unclear whether or not that is still the case.

fallen_empires.100.a.zh: 我们也应该崇敬这个地方。
fallen_empires.100.a.en: We shall honor this place also.

fallen_empires.100.b.en: It is ours for the taking.

fallen_empires.100.c.zh: 我们可以在此发展繁荣。

fallen_empires.2.a.zh: 我们战败了，我们被羞辱了，但是我们还会东山再起的。
fallen_empires.2.a.en: We are defeated and humiliated, but will rise again.

fallen_empires.2.desc.zh:
似乎作为我们不仅同[From.GetName]停滞圣权开战，更是随后接受了战败这一事实的惩罚，和平谈判结束之后，[From.GetAdj]特工出现在了[Root.GetRulerTitle][rulername.GetName]身旁。

他们用闻所未闻的武器处决了我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。行凶后他们就消失在虚空之中，就好像从未出现过一样。
fallen_empires.2.desc.en:
As if to punish us for not only warring with the Stagnant Ascendancy of the [From.GetName] but for then accepting defeat, [From.GetAdj] agents appeared by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [rulername.GetName]'s side after the peace negotiations concluded.

They dispatched our [Root.GetRulerTitle] with unseen weaponry and practiced brutality before melting away as if they were never there.

fallen_empires.4.a.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
