fallen_empires.4.a.en: We have no choice but to accept...

fallen_empires.4.desc.zh: 傲慢的虫子啊！你们认为[Root.GetSpeciesName]玷污者我们圣地的殖民者能够不被注意到吗？立即离开我们的星球或者面对我们舰队的力量吧！
fallen_empires.4.desc.en: Arrogant little wretch! Did you think that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] colonists sullying our holy places would go unnoticed? Leave our worlds immediately or face the might of our fleets!

fallen_empires.5.a.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
fallen_empires.5.a.en: We have no choice but to accept...

fallen_empires.5.desc.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们发现你们正在笨拙地尝试创造人工智能，认为你们正在走上灵魂自毁的错误道路上。立即停止这个愚蠢的举动，否则我们会帮你停止。
fallen_empires.5.desc.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your fumbling attempts at creating artificial intelligence and come to the conclusion that you are headed down the path of spiritual self-destruction. Abandon this foolish endeavour at once, or we will MAKE you.

fallen_empires.6.a.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
fallen_empires.6.a.en: We have no choice but to accept...

fallen_empires.6.a.tooltip.en:
$policy_slavery$ policy will be set to $slavery_not_allowed$.
$policy_purge$ policy will be set to $purge_not_allowed$.

fallen_empires.6.desc.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]野蛮人！别以为没人发现你们的暴行。你们肆意的屠杀和奴役行径正在威胁整个星系的未来。我们给你个选择的机会：停止你野蛮的行径，否则就做好准备面对我们的正义制裁吧。
fallen_empires.6.desc.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName] barbarians! Your crimes have not gone unnoticed. The enslavement and butchery that you are so wantonly engaging threatens the future of the entire galaxy. We present you with a choice: end your barbarous practices, or prepare to face our righteous might.

fallen_empires.7.a.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
fallen_empires.7.a.en: We have no choice but to accept...

fallen_empires.7.desc.zh: 顽固的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]！这是对你们冒犯我们领地的最后一次警告！马上撤走，不然我们会替宇宙清除污秽——也就是你们这悲哀渺小的物种。
fallen_empires.7.desc.en: Filthy [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]! You have encroached upon our space for the last time! Withdraw immediately, or we will cleanse the stain upon the universe that is your worthless species.

fallen_empires.8.a.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
fallen_empires.8.a.en: We have no choice but to accept...

fallen_empires.8.a.tooltip.zh:
与[from.GetName]结束宿敌关系
[Root.GetName]失去了所有针对[from.GetName]境内恒星系的宣称。
fallen_empires.8.a.tooltip.en:
Ends rivalry with [from.GetName]
[Root.GetName] loses any claims to the [from.GetName]'s systems

fallen_empires.8.desc.zh: 无知的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们对长者的不敬简直大错特错。匍匐在我们面前乞求宽恕，我们或许有可能放过你们那毫无价值的小帝国。
fallen_empires.8.desc.en: Foolish [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The lack of respect you show for your elders will be your undoing. Prostrate yourselves before us and beg our forgiveness, and we may refrain from annihilating your worthless little empire.

fallen_empires.8.desc.control.zh: 不和谐的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。难道你们没有发现自己是在带来杂音逼我们动手吗。好自为之，不然我们会来帮你们调调音准的。
fallen_empires.8.desc.control.en: Disharmonious [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Don't you see that by inviting chaos you force us to intervene. Harmonize now or we will tune you.

fallen_empires.8.desc.growth.zh: 愚昧的[Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们拒绝成长演化就是对生命本身的亵渎。乖乖听话，否则我们会把你们连根拔起，反正我们再种下新的种子亦非难事。
fallen_empires.8.desc.growth.en: Stagnant [Root.GetSpeciesName], your refusal to grow and evolve is an affront to life itself. Embrace our teachings, or we will uproot your failure and sow the seeds of progress ourselves

fallen_empires.8.desc.war.zh: 怯懦的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的帝国就是脆弱的教科书。把你们的弱点咽下去，好好道歉，然后准备接受我们的挑战——否则我们可以随手把你们化为齑粉，用更有价值的人来替代你们。
fallen_empires.8.desc.war.en: Cowardly [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your empire is a testament to frailty. Now swallow your weakness, apologize, and get ready to meet our challenge - or we will shatter you and replace you with someone more worthy.

fallen_empires_awakening.11.desc.zh: 远古失落帝国的碎片[assimilated_fe.GetName]被原主脑的一个更加强势的分支吸收。也许这对它是最好的结局。
fallen_empires_awakening.11.desc.en: The ancient Fallen Empire Fragment, [assimilated_fe.GetName] has been assimilated by a more dominant aspect of the former overmind. Perhaps it was for the best.

fallen_empires_awakening.2.a.zh: 巨人踏入了孩子们的游乐园……

fallen_empires_awakening.2.desc.zh:
[From.GetAdjective]的轻微异动是一切的开端。我们收到了零星的情报，尽管之前仅在自己的空间内活动，他们的舰队现在已经开始向星系内遥远的众恒星系开动。异常先进的侦察舰开始探访那些古老的、被毁掉的星球，并对任何向他们打招呼或者回避的舰船发动攻击。现在，他们的目的和使命已经昭然若揭了。

我们现在知道[From.GetSpeciesName]已经整装待发，他们恢复了调查信标的数据链，并重新启用了那些在他们退缩到目前边境之时废弃的侦察哨站。情报显示，他们的意图是重新回到星系这张大棋盘上。

在[From.GetSpeciesName]空间，舰队正在集结，军队已经下达了征召令，那些古老的工厂再一次发出轰鸣声。几百年来第一次，[From.GetName]开始将他们的目光投注到边境线外广大的星系。

破败的船坞再一次得到修复与调整，一度沉寂的泰坦巨舰铸造厂重新上线。整个星系都在关注同一个问题：当这位一度沉睡的巨人决定恢复旧日荣光时，谁会成为第一个螳臂当车的宵小呢？
fallen_empires_awakening.2.desc.en:
It began as a subtle shift in [From.GetAdjective] behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds, refusing all hails and fleeing when attacked. Their purpose and mission unknown... until now.

We now know that the [From.GetSpeciesName] were preparing, recovering the databanks of survey beacons and automated scouting posts left behind when they retreated to their present borders. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and ancient factories roar to life. For the first time in an age, the [From.GetName] are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

As their decaying shipyards are repaired and refitted and the dormant systems of Titan foundries come online, the rest of the galaxy is left with only one question - who will this once-sleeping giant target first in their quest to reclaim age-old glory lost?

fallen_empires_awakening.5.a.en: Will they be able to save us?

fallen_empires_awakening.5.desc.zh:
即使是偏安一隅的先祖帝国也没有忽视这样一个威胁到整个星系的危机。尽管他们之前对星系事务毫无兴趣，这一坏消息还是引起了[From.GetSpeciesName]的一阵忙乱。起初，他们只是派出了一些侦查船，也许是为了核实情况的严重性。但接下来传来了[From.GetSpeciesName]舰队聚集在边境，以准备抵抗即将到来的风暴的报告。

现在，[From.GetName]已经从自我孤立的状态完全转变成为了领导全星系防御的角色。他们正式宣布自己为一个泛星系防卫联盟的领袖并向所有“下等”种族发出了邀请，希望他们放下仇恨并加入联盟来击退这一对星系中所有智慧生命造成威胁的敌人。
fallen_empires_awakening.5.desc.en:
The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the [From.GetSpeciesName]. At first, it was just a few scouting vessels, perhaps sent to verify the graveness of the situation, but then reports began to came in of [From.GetSpeciesName] war fleets mustering on their borders, readying their defenses for the oncoming storm.

Now, the [From.GetName] have fully emerged from their self-imposed isolation to take a leading role in the defense of the whole galaxy. They have proclaimed themselves the leaders of a Galactic Defense League and extended an invite to all "lesser" species to put aside their feuds and join them in repelling this menace for the sake of all sapient life in the galaxy.

fallen_empires_tasks.10.desc.zh: 我们真是失望透顶啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们许诺要阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的一切不当行为，现在却看到他们仍然肆意妄为、横行霸道。我们曾以为你们能够阻止他们，但现在看来，是我们搞错了。
fallen_empires_tasks.10.desc.en: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.

fallen_empires_tasks.11.desc.zh: 你好，年轻的[From.GetSpeciesName]。前一阵我们要求你们阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的人口净化行为。目前看来，我们的要求已经没有必要了，因为[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经下令禁止了这种活动。不知这是出于他人的胁迫还是自愿为之，反正已经没有必要对他们进行攻击了。
fallen_empires_tasks.11.desc.en: Greetings, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. A while ago we tasked you with ending the practice of purging in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears our request is no longer necessary, as the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have already banned the practice. Whether forced to by others or electing to do so themselves, there is no longer a need for aggressive action against them.

fallen_empires_tasks.13.desc.zh: 这是怎么回事，[From.GetSpeciesName]？！你是想开玩笑吗？！你们不仅没能制止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的错误行为，居然还打算效仿他们！作为正义的一方，我们绝不会姑息。
fallen_empires_tasks.13.desc.en: What is this, young [From.GetSpeciesName]?! Do you think to mock us?! Not only do you fail in stopping the atrocities in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you have now elected to legalize those very same practices in your own empire! Know that we will not be made fools of. There will be repercussions for this, mark my words.

fallen_empires_tasks.15.b.en: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

fallen_empires_tasks.15.desc.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们要提醒你[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]正在做着危险的事情。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经开始研究异端科技，不断地制造出更加复杂的人工智能以制造出真正拥有自我意识的机器。我们曾目睹过这种研究的下场，并觉得有义务警告你，这不仅威胁到他们自己，也威胁到其他种族。建议你们主动出击，阻止他们进一步的研究。
fallen_empires_tasks.15.desc.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artificial intelligences in pursuit of truly self-aware machines. We have seen where this path leads and feel it is our duty to warn you of the danger this poses not only to their own souls, but to those of all the younger races. We advise you to use your military might to attack them and force them to place a ban on any further such research.

fallen_empires_tasks.17.desc.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！尽管我们发出了警告，你们仍未对[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]进行的不当实验采取任何行动。看来你们并不在意自己的未来啊。
fallen_empires_tasks.17.desc.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Despite our warnings, you have elected to do nothing about the heretical research being carried out in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears your species may not be worth saving after all.

fallen_empires_tasks.18.desc.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们已经不需要你们的协助来阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]进行不当实验了，因为那个帝国已经禁止了进一步的人工智能实验。尽管你们没能做出贡献，但至少这个威胁已经不复存在了。
fallen_empires_tasks.18.desc.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Your assistance in ending the heretical research carried out by the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] is no longer needed, as a ban has already been placed on all further machine intelligence research in that empire. While you did not play any part in doing so, at least this threat to the spiritual well-being of the galaxy is dealt with.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.battlecruiser_too.zh: 获得1艘战列巡洋型战舰。

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.materialis.zh: 请收下这份礼物，作为[Root.GetName]对[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]服务的奖赏。你们会发现这份奖励绝对算得上丰厚。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.materialis.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have decided to grace your empire with a gift of resources as a token of our esteem. Do not squander our generosity or take our favor for granted.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.spirituali.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！你们的种族十分杰出，而你们对教义的坚持也令人敬佩。出于我们无尽的仁慈，请收下这份资源作为礼物。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.spirituali.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your species is a worthy one, and your adherence to the immutable doctrines of faith are to be commended. Accept this gift of resources as a token of our boundless benevolence.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.xenophile.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们的种群真可谓是宇宙中很有价值的存在。为了证明对你们的尊重，我们决定赠与你们一份包含着宝贵矿物与其他资源的大礼。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.xenophile.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], your species is a most worthwhile addition to the galactic community. As a token of our esteem, we have decided to bestow on you a generous gift of valuable minerals and resources.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.materialis.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们的技术效率太低了，让我们都看不下去了。作为我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]的麾下干将，我们决定跟你分享我们对宇宙的一些见解。我们并不是对任何物种都这样做，所以一定要继续对我们保持有用——忘恩负义，对一个小孩来说是不需要的特质。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.materialis.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], the sheer inefficiency of your technology pains us. As you are a valuable client to the [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName], we have decided to share with you some of our understanding of the universe. This is not something we do for just any species, so be sure to continue to be of use to us - ingratitude is not a desirable trait in children.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.spirituali.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]！你们的种族十分杰出，而你们对教义的坚持也令人敬佩。出于我们无尽的仁慈，请收下这神圣的知识作为礼物。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.spirituali.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your species is a worthy one, and your adherence to the immutable doctrines of faith are to be commended. Accept this gift of sacred knowledge as a token of our boundless benevolence.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.xenophile.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们对你们停滞不前的科技发展投入了长足的关注。照你们目前的进度，恐怕在有生之年是没有办法展现全部的潜力了。为了对你们进行帮助，我们会将一个[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的科学知识数据库赠与你们。你们绝对会发现，其中的内容对你们非常有用。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.xenophile.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your lack of technological progress with concern. At your current pace, we fear that you will never reach your true potential before you wipe yourselves out or are conquered by a more advanced species. In order to help you along, we will transfer a data cache of [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] scientific knowledge. You will no doubt find its contents to be of invaluable worth to your empire.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.materialis.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]，作为[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的客户，你们的舰队实力也会反映我们的战斗军力。可是你们的飞船还不够强大。为此我们特决定将我方闲置的一队护卫舰飞船赠送给你，以确保你们的安全。

我们已经用较为简单的部件替换了其中一些较为复杂的部件，以方便你们操作。其余的部件也安装了防拆解设备，所以请勿拆卸。因为这其中的内部构造对你们来说可能太过复杂。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.materialis.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName], as a [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] client the state of your fleets also reflects on us, and those crude hulks you call "warships" reflect very poorly indeed. To this end we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships that should look most impressive to the other savages you regularly interact with.

We have replaced some of their more advanced components with cruder devices so that you are not overly confused by their operation, and the rest have been fitted with anti-tinkering devices, so do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ships. You would be unlikely to understand their inner workings regardless.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.spirituali.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！我们的先知说你们的种族将在信仰之路上扮演重要的角色。为了确保你们能够胜任，我们决定将一支闲置的小型护卫舰舰队赠送给你们，应该足以保护你们的安全。

不要胡乱改造舰船上的系统，尽管它们对我们来说是老旧型号，可仍远远超出你们当前的理解能力。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.spirituali.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We have consulted the oracles and determined that your species has an important role to play in the great undertaking of the faith. To ensure that you can carry out this task, we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships that should be more than adequate to destroy any primitive fleets of the other lesser races that might stand in your path.

Do not be tempted to tamper with the ships' systems, they may be older models of ours, but are still far beyond your current level of intellectual development.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.xenophile.zh:
我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]认为，为保护宇宙的平衡与种群的多样性，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的存续是十分重要的。但我们担心的是，你们的舰队实力不足以和其他具有侵略性的种群抗衡。为了帮助你们进行自卫，我们决定将闲置的一队护卫舰飞船赠送给你。

我们已经用[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]较为熟悉的科技部件替换了其中一些较为复杂的部件，以方便你们操作。其余的部件也安装了防拆解设备，所以请勿拆卸。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.xenophile.en:
We [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] believe that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an important species for maintaining the balance and biodiversity of the galaxy, but we worry that your fleets are simply too weak for you to be able to stand against other, more aggressive species. To help you defend yourselves, we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships.

We have replaced some of their more advanced components with technology that should be more familiar to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so you should have no trouble operating them. Also, please do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ships, we would not wish you to hurt yourselves!

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.materialis.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]，作为[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的客户，你们的舰队实力也会反映我们的战斗军力。可是你们的飞船还不够强大。为此我们特决定将我方闲置的一队护卫舰飞船赠送给你，以确保你们的安全。

我们已经用较为简单的部件替换了其中一些较为复杂的部件，以方便你们操作。其余的部件也安装了防拆解设备，所以请勿拆卸。因为这其中的内部构造对你们来说可能太过复杂。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.materialis.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName], as a [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] client the state of your fleets also reflects on us, and those crude hulks you call "warships" reflect very poorly indeed. To this end we have decided to gift you a surplus battlecruiser that should look most impressive to the other savages you regularly interact with.

We have replaced some of its more advanced components with cruder devices so that you are not overly confused by their operation, and the rest have been fitted with anti-tinkering devices, so do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ship. You would be unlikely to understand its inner workings regardless.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.spirituali.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！我们的先知说你们的种族将在信仰之路上扮演重要的角色。为了确保你们能够胜任，我们决定将一艘闲置的战列巡洋舰赠送给你们，应该足以保护你们的安全。

不要胡乱改造舰船上的系统，否则可能对你们自己造成伤害。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.spirituali.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We have consulted the oracles and determined that your species has an important role to play in the great undertaking of the faith. To ensure that you can carry out this task, we have decided to gift you a surplus battlecruiser that should be more than adequate to destroy any primitive fleets of the other lesser races that might stand in your path.

Do not be tempted to tamper with the ships' systems, they may be older models of ours, but are still far beyond your current level of intellectual development.

fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.xenophile.zh:
我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]认为，为保护宇宙的平衡与种群的多样性，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的存续是十分重要的。但我们担心的是，你们的舰队实力不足以和其他具有侵略性的种群抗衡。为了帮助你们进行自卫，我们决定将闲置的一队护卫舰飞船赠送给你。

我们已经用[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]较为熟悉的科技部件替换了其中一些较为复杂的部件，以方便你们操作。其余的部件也安装了防拆解设备，所以请勿拆卸。
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.xenophile.en:
We [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] believe that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an important species for maintaining the balance and biodiversity of the galaxy, but we worry that your fleets are simply too weak for you to be able to stand against other, more aggressive species. To help you defend yourselves, we have decided to gift you one of our surplus battlecruisers.

We have replaced some of its more advanced components with technology that you should be more familiar to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so you should have no trouble operating them. Also, please do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ship, we would not wish you to hurt yourselves!

fallen_empires_tasks.20.desc.zh: 你们是瞧不起我们吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？！难道你们以为我们不会注意到，在同意终结[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]进行的不当实验后，你们自己却开始进行了同样的实验！？我们无法容忍你们这样阳奉阴违的做法。准备迎接我们的回应吧。
fallen_empires_tasks.20.desc.en: Do you think us fools, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?! Do you think we would not notice that, after agreeing to end the heretical research in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you yourselves would begin to pursue the very same lines of research?! We will not be mocked by worthless little savages that have barely even mastered the atom. Prepare yourselves for our response.

fallen_empires_tasks.22.b.en: We will never give one our own to alien hands!

fallen_empires_tasks.22.c.en: It is not up to us to decide!

fallen_empires_tasks.22.d.zh: 将我们最聪慧的人才拱手相送？还是免了。
fallen_empires_tasks.22.d.en: Give up our brightest mind? I think not.

fallen_empires_tasks.22.desc.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]。我们得知，你们的帝国收留了一位天才。[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName]的天才在[Root.GetName]有点大材小用了，而我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的各项活动一向需要经验丰富的科学家。因此，我们特为你们提供一个绝佳的机会，只要将[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]借给我们，就能赢得我们的好感。我们已派出了一只飞船接应[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]，你只需要说一声“是”，就算万事俱备了。

你们应该会同意的……对吧？
fallen_empires_tasks.22.desc.en:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We understand that your empire is home to an individual whose brilliant mind transcends the tragic primitiveness of your species. While the talents of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName] are sadly wasted in the [Root.GetName], we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] always have a use for skilled scientists to work in our archives. As such, we are offering you a unique chance to earn our favor by allowing us to take charge of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]. We already have a ship en route to pick [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer] up, so you need only say "yes" and everything will be settled.

I'm sure you won't want to disappoint us... do you?

fallen_empires_tasks.24.a.zh: 我们会给你拷贝一份的。
fallen_empires_tasks.24.a.en: We'll make a copy for you.

fallen_empires_tasks.24.b.zh: 我们还是自己留着比较好。
fallen_empires_tasks.24.b.en: I think we'll hold onto it.

fallen_empires_tasks.24.desc.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们了解到，你们的帝国在一个濒危种群的星球找到了一份数据存储。该存储包含了这个种群的大脑扫描结果。虽说你们还过于原始，无法将这数据化为实用，但我们还是要赞美你们为保存这曾经辉煌的文明最后的遗物而做出的努力。为了在我们的濒危种群保护区中留存此种群并加以记录，我们希望你们能将这份数据交给我们，并使用我们的克隆技术复活几个该种群的生物。能不能将这数据与我们分享，方便我们合力完成这种群的遗愿呢？
fallen_empires_tasks.24.desc.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive to utilize this data, we laud your efforts in preserving this last remnant of a once vibrant civilization. As part of our efforts to conserve and catalog endangered species in our Endangered Species Preserve, we wish to take this data and use our cloning technologies to bring a small number of this species back to life. Will you share it with us so we can fulfill their last wish together?

fallen_empires_tasks.24.tooltip.zh: 来自早已死亡的种群——[FallenEmpireDeadSpecies.GetSpeciesName]的100£pop£人口会出现在[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetAdjective]的濒危种群保护区中。
fallen_empires_tasks.24.tooltip.en: 100 £pop£ Pops of the long-dead [FallenEmpireDeadSpecies.GetSpeciesName] species will be created in the [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetAdjective] Endangered Species Preserve.

fallen_empires_tasks.4.a.en: Very well, you will have your contribution.

fallen_empires_tasks.4.b.zh: 我们是绝不会将自己的人民交到外星人手中的！
fallen_empires_tasks.4.b.en: We will never surrender our population to alien hands!

fallen_empires_tasks.4.c.en: Our people are not for sale, [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName].

fallen_empires_tasks.4.desc.zh:
你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们一定已经知道了，我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]致力于研究并保存宇宙中的所有生命形式。我们已经研究了你们的种群，并认为[Root.GetName]最多只能维持几个世纪。为确保极端情况下[Root.GetSpeciesName]的存续，我们希望贵帝国能有一部分人口，加入我们的濒危种群保护区。我们会专门创建一片保护区，完全复制你们种群的自然生存环境，其所有居民也会获得全面的照顾与保护，你也不用担心他们的安危。

那么，你觉得怎么样？我们会致力保存并保护你们的种群。那你是否愿意为这份事业做出自己的贡献呢？
fallen_empires_tasks.4.desc.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As you no doubt know, we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] are dedicated to the study and conservation of all forms of life in the galaxy. We have studied your species and determined that the [Root.GetName] is unlikely to last for more than a few centuries at best. To ensure the continuation of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species should the worst befall your empire, we would like to acquire a part of your population for our Endangered Species Preserve. We will construct a special reservation that perfectly mirrors the natural habitat of your species, and its population will be well taken care of and protected from all harm, so you need not worry on their behalf.

So, what do you say? Will you contribute to our preserve and safeguard the future of your species?

fallen_empires_tasks.4.e.zh: 不，我们不会抛弃我们的人们。

fallen_empires_tasks.4.tooltip.zh: 一组[Root.GetSpeciesName]人口将从你的帝国移除。
fallen_empires_tasks.4.tooltip.en: A group of [Root.GetSpeciesName] Pops will be taken from your empire.

fallen_empires_tasks.8.a.zh: 我们会制止错误行为的！
fallen_empires_tasks.8.a.en: We will stop any further atrocities!

fallen_empires_tasks.8.b.en: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

fallen_empires_tasks.8.desc.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的尊贵[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，我们认为你们是一支具有巨大潜力的种群。虽说你们年纪尚轻，却似乎能够理解生物与社会多样性的重要性，在面对不同的生物与社会时不会尽全力压制或进行摧毁，反而会予以理解和接受。不幸的是，并不是所有年轻种群都具有这种智慧。尤其是[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]，他们一直在排除异己。我们不便直接进行干涉，所以希望能够将阻止恶行的任务交给你方。对他们发起攻击，阻止他们进行人口净化。我们将感激不尽。
fallen_empires_tasks.8.desc.en: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and accept that which is different, rather than suppress and destroy it. Unfortunately, not all of the younger races are so wise. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], in particular, appear to take pride in "cleansing" the galaxy of all forms of life they deem unsuitable. While we cannot intervene ourselves directly, we would like to charge your government with the task of bringing an end to their evil deeds. Attack them and force them to ban the practice of purging, and we will be most grateful indeed.

fallen_machine_empire.11.a.zh: 好吧，如果是为了我们好的话。
fallen_machine_empire.11.a.en: Very well, if it's for our own good.

fallen_machine_empire.11.b.zh: 那些恶心的异形液体你们自己留着吧！
fallen_machine_empire.11.b.en: Keep your filthy Xeno fluids to yourselves!

fallen_machine_empire.11.c.en: We do not trust these inoculations.

fallen_machine_empire.11.desc.zh: 监护者协议625-1已启动。附带信息：有机文明请注意。在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口中普遍检测到生物性弱点。为了确保你们的种族在监护者计划中的可行性，所有主要人口聚集地都需要进行接种。生物注入单位已做好准备，将在正面肯定这条信息后前往你们的空间。等待回应。
fallen_machine_empire.11.desc.en: Custodian protocol 625-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, organic civilization. Widespread biological vulnerabilities have been detected in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. In order to ensure your species' viability for the Custodian Project, all major population centers will require inoculation. Bio-injection units are prepared for dispatch to your space upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.

fallen_machine_empire.11.tooltip.zh: 这将产生不可预知的影响。在判明这些影响之前，我们人口的幸福度将会降低。
fallen_machine_empire.11.tooltip.en: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pops' happiness will be reduced.

fallen_machine_empire.12.desc.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了数起死亡，而我们的人民也竭力反对被集体强迫进行危险的接种。我们正在努力从人民中消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段较为动荡的时期。
fallen_machine_empire.12.desc.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in a number of deaths, and our population is up in arms about having dangerous inoculations forced on them by the government. We are working to eliminate the mutagens from the population, but until then we should expect a period of increased unrest.

fallen_machine_empire.12.desc.b.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了子个体的大量死亡。我们正在努力消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段人口增长速度减缓的时期。
fallen_machine_empire.12.desc.b.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in numerous fatalities in the drone population. We are working to eliminate the mutagens, but until then we can expect to experience a period of slowed population growth.

fallen_machine_empire.13.desc.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗显现出了巨大的好处，减少了疾病并增加了人口的寿命。当初我们人口之间对这一强制性过程的不信任感已经烟消云散，每个人都在享受着更加健康幸福的生活。
fallen_machine_empire.13.desc.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population. The initial mistrust among our people about the mandatory procedure has receded, and everyone is enjoying a healthier, happier life.

fallen_machine_empire.13.desc.b.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗显现出了巨大的好处，减少了疾病并增加了我们子个体的寿命。从长远来看这将对我们的人口增长有利。
fallen_machine_empire.13.desc.b.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our drones. This will benefit our population growth in the long run.

fallen_machine_empire.2.desc_01.zh:
检测到主动净化中枢。重激活协议已启动。正在试图联系中央处理器…<<错误：亚空间链路离线>>

无法连接至中央处理器。正在查询处理单元…4.1853%标准容量处理中。中止完全重激活进程。启用备用协议…启用备用协议…启用太空港供电…激活战争设施。

最终防御指令已激活。记录消息如下：
智慧生物！我们是[From.GetSpeciesName]。很久以前我们和你们称为肃正协议的腐化体展开了一场大战。我们认为自己是强大的，不可战胜的。我们一次又一次地击退他们，他们一次又一次地卷土重来，烧毁星球，击毁我们强大的舰队。我们同那个时代所有剩下的有机文明团结在一起，发动了一场决战，希望能一劳永逸地彻底消灭它们。

如果你听到这个消息，那证明我们已经失败了。无论我们伟大的文明遗留下来什么，我们将至赠予你，我们的继承人，以面对即将到来的战斗。不要重蹈覆辙！摧毁中枢！彻底消灭这个威胁！全星系的未来取决于这一战。
fallen_machine_empire.2.desc_01.en:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... <<ERROR: SUBSPACE LINK OFFLINE>>

Central Processing unreachable. Querying processing units... processing at 4.1853% of standard capacity. Abort full reactivation process. Engaging fallback protocols... powering shipyards... activating war assets...

Final Defense Directive activated. Recorded message follows:
Sapient! We are the [From.GetSpeciesName]. Long ago we fought the Corruption, that which you call the Contingency. We thought ourselves superior, undefeatable. Time and again we fought them back, time and again they returned, sterilizing worlds and wearing down our mighty fleets. We embarked on a campaign to defeat them once and for all together with what remained of the biological civilizations of our time.

If you are hearing this message, then we have failed. Whatever remains of our great civilization we bequeath to you, our successors, in your own battle to come. Do not make our mistake! Destroy the Nexus! End this menace once and for all! The future of the galaxy depends on it.

fallen_machine_empire.2.desc_02.zh:
侦测到活动的净化中心。重新激活协议启动。正在尝试联系处理中心……<<警告：侦测到损坏的信号链接>>

启动对应措施……<<错误：处理能力失效>><<错误：对应措施失效>><<致命警告：侦测到系统损坏>><<错误：备用对应措施失效>>

启动……启……动……动动动……<<错误>><<错误>><<错误>><<错误>><<错误>>

<<错误>><<错误>><<错误>><<错误>><<错误>>
fallen_machine_empire.2.desc_02.en:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... <WARNING: CORRUPTED SIGNAL LINK DETECTED>

Engaging countermeasures... <<ERROR: PROCESSING CAPACITY FAILURE>> <<ERROR: COUNTERMEASURE FAILURE>> <<CRITICAL WARNING: SYSTEM CORRUPTION DETECTED>> <<ERROR: SECONDARY COUNTERMEASURE FAILURE>>

Engag... eng... e... eeee... <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>>

<<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>>

fallen_machine_empire.21.a.zh: 我们欢迎改善自身程序的机会。
fallen_machine_empire.21.a.en: We welcome the chance to improve our programming.

fallen_machine_empire.21.b.zh: 我们不信任这些代码的改变。
fallen_machine_empire.21.b.en: We do not trust these code changes.

fallen_machine_empire.21.desc.zh: 监护者协议628-2已启动。附带信息：合成文明请注意。检测到你们的基础代码效率非常低下。为了确保你们的种族可以为监护者计划作贡献，需要进行大量的代码重写。我们已准备好进行子空间传输，将在正面肯定这条信息后开始。等待回应。
fallen_machine_empire.21.desc.en: Custodian protocol 628-2 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Significant inefficiencies have been detected in your base code. In order to ensure your species' ability to contribute to the Custodian Project, extensive rewrites will be required. We are prepared to initiate subspace code transmission upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.

fallen_machine_empire.21.tooltip.zh: 这将产生不可预知的影响。在判明这些影响之前，我们人口的维护花费将会增加。
fallen_machine_empire.21.tooltip.en: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pop upkeep will be increased.

fallen_machine_empire.22.desc.zh: 远古守护者在我们的基础代码中进行的改变与我们其他核心组件中的程序不兼容。这不仅未能实现当初期许的效率增长，反而导致了数个严重程序错误，大大地影响了我们的资源采集行动。直到这些代码改变被还原之前，我们将经历一段生产力低下的时期。
fallen_machine_empire.22.desc.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Not only have the promised efficiency increases failed to manifest, but instead they have caused a number of severe bugs that have severely impacted our resource gathering operations. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.

fallen_machine_empire.23.desc.zh: 远古守护者在我们的基础代码中进行的改变产生了良好的结果。重写导致的效率低下只是暂时的，而改变给我们全体人民带来了永久性的资源生产力升级。
fallen_machine_empire.23.desc.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well. The inefficiencies caused by the rewrite turned out to be only temporary, and the changes have resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.

fallen_machine_empire.31.b.zh: 我们不会分享工人单位。
fallen_machine_empire.31.b.en: We will not share our worker units.

fallen_machine_empire.31.desc.zh: 监护者协议115-3已启动。附带信息：合成文明请注意。因暂时的通讯瘫痪，监护者计划目前无法替换故障与受损的劳工无人机。对你们的文明的分析显示[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]单位性能适合执行低级的维护任务。我们请求你们将劳工单位转让到[FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName]以便整合至监护矩阵，帮助确保一级避难设施中的所有有机生物可以继续生存。
fallen_machine_empire.31.desc.en: Custodian protocol 115-3 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Due to temporary communication outages, the Custodian Project is experiencing difficulties in replacing malfunctioning and damaged worker drones. Analysis of your civilization has found the performance of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] units to be adequate for carrying out low-level maintenance tasks. We request the transfer of worker population units to [FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName] for integration into the Custodian Matrix, to help ensure the continued survival of all organic species in Alpha Refuge.

fallen_machine_empire.4.desc.zh:
在最后的肃正协议的机器星球自毁的那一刻，我们的仪器检测到一个非常强大的亚空间信号。信号源自[From.GetName]的空间，似乎是向星系的中心发射。在接下来的几个小时内，零零散散的传来[From.GetAdjective]舰队从传感器消失的报告：它们进入了前往熟悉的星系的跃迁点，但从未出现在另一边。

[From.GetSpeciesName]附近的侦察船调查了周围的空间，并报告了惊人的发现：古老的机械智能已经完全消失了，只留下被遗弃的轨道站和损坏的巨型结构。

我们可能永远不会知道它们去了哪里，但有一件事是肯定的：[From.GetSpeciesName]在过去的岁月中为自己设定的任务现在已经完成；他们古老的守夜使命终于结束了。
fallen_machine_empire.4.desc.en:
At the very moment that the last Contingency Machine World self-destructed, our instruments detected a subspace signal of immense strength. The signal originated from [From.GetName] space and appears to have been aimed towards the galactic core. Over the next few hours, scattered reports came in of [From.GetAdjective] fleets vanishing from sensors, entering jump points to familiar systems but never emerging on the other side.

A scout vessel near [From.GetSpeciesName] space was sent to investigate, and reported back startling findings: The ancient machine intelligence has disappeared entirely, leaving behind only abandoned orbital stations and decaying megastructures.

Where they have gone to is a mystery we may never solve, but one thing is clear: The task that the [From.GetSpeciesName] set for themselves in ages past is now complete, and their ancient vigil is finally at an end.

fallen_machine_empire.41.a.zh: 如果他们是个威胁，那就必须被阻止。
fallen_machine_empire.41.a.en: If they're a threat, they must be stopped.

fallen_machine_empire.41.b.en: We have no reason to attack the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

fallen_machine_empire.41.desc.zh: 监护者协议62-1已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]已被<<错误：数据块损坏>>入侵。因为我们程序上的思潮限制，目前无法使用监护者战争资产。次级控制协议政策利用未被危害的文明在其可以散布之前摧毁<<错误：数据块损坏>>的威胁。我们请求为此任务部署[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产。你是否愿意合作？
fallen_machine_empire.41.desc.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] has been compromised by the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>. Due to ethics restrictions in our programming, the use of Custodian war assets are presently restricted. Secondary containment protocol dictates the use of non-compromised civilizations to destroy the <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> threat before it can spread. We request the deployment of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets for this task. Will you comply?

fallen_machine_empire.42.desc.zh: 监护者协议62-1完成。激活[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产迎战[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj]目标。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害升级至合作。
fallen_machine_empire.42.desc.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 fulfilled. Active [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets engaging [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.

fallen_machine_empire.43.desc.zh: 监护者协议62-1失败。未激活[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]战争资产用于迎战[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj]目标。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害降级至可能被危害。
fallen_machine_empire.43.desc.en: Custodian protocol 62-1 unsuccessful. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] war assets have been activated against [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesAdj] targets. Downgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to likely compromised.

fallen_machine_empire.51.b.zh: 我们不希望殖民那颗星球。
fallen_machine_empire.51.b.en: We have no desire to colonize that world.

fallen_machine_empire.51.desc.zh: 监护者协议475-3已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的文明目前有57.216%的几率因<<错误：数据块损坏>>而毁灭。我们的计算显示殖民[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]将令你们的生存几率增加4.558%。我们请求你们进行殖民并在星球上拥有大量[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口。你是否愿意合作？
fallen_machine_empire.51.desc.en: Custodian protocol 475-3 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is presently at 57.216% risk of destruction due to <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>. We have calculated that colonization of [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] will increase your survival chances by 4.558%. We request colonization and establishment of a significant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence on the planet. Will you comply?

fallen_machine_empire.52.desc.zh: 监护者协议475-3完成。在[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]上侦测到大量[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害升级至合作。
fallen_machine_empire.52.desc.en: Custodian protocol 475-3 fulfilled. Significant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence detected on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to compliant.

fallen_machine_empire.53.desc.zh: 监护者协议475-3失败。未在[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]上侦测到[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口。将[Root.GetName]的地位从未被危害降级至可能被危害。
fallen_machine_empire.53.desc.en: Custodian protocol 475-3 unsuccessful. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] presence detected on [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. Downgrading status of [Root.GetName] from non-compromised to likely compromised.

fallen_machine_empire.61.desc.zh: 监护者协议955-1已启动。附带信息：请注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的文明被判定为已受到<<错误：数据块损坏>>影响的危害。为了控制其他文明受到的威胁，我们已启动了服从协议。请在20标准年里避免任何侵略性战争行为。如果你未能服从，我们将激活战争资产来对你们的帝国启用惩罚协议。
fallen_machine_empire.61.desc.en: Custodian protocol 955-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence. To contain the danger to other civilizations, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from all aggressive acts of war for a period of 20 standard years. If you fail to comply, war assets will be activated to enforce punishment protocols against your empire.

fallen_machine_empire.62.desc.zh: 监护者协议955-1完成。[Root.GetName]已证明自己可以克制攻击行为。将[Root.GetName]的地位从可能被危害升级至未被危害。关闭服从协议。恢复正常行动。
fallen_machine_empire.62.desc.en: Custodian protocol 955-1 fulfilled. [Root.GetName] has proven able to curtail aggressive acts. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from likely compromised to non-compromised. Deactivating compliance protocols. Resuming normal operations.

fallen_machine_empire.63.desc.zh: 监护者协议955-1失败。[Root.GetName]已证明自己无法克制攻击行为。解除思潮限制。启动惩罚协议。准备部署战争资产……
fallen_machine_empire.63.desc.en: Custodian protocol 955-1 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail aggressive acts. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...

fallen_machine_empire.71.desc.zh: 监护协议955-2启动。消息如下：注意，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的文明被认为受到了<<错误：数据块损坏>>的侵害。为了限制你们的扩张，我们已经启动了遵守协议。避免在10内对任何新的行星进行殖民。如果你不遵守，战争资产将被激活，以执行对你的帝国的惩罚协议。
fallen_machine_empire.71.desc.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 activated. Message follows: Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your civilization is deemed to be compromised by <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> influence. To curtail your expansion, we have activated compliance protocols. Refrain from colonizing any new planets for a period of 10 standard years. If you fail to comply, war assets will be activated to enforce punishment protocols against your empire.

fallen_machine_empire.72.desc.zh: 监护者协议955-2完成。[Root.GetName]已证明自己可以克制扩张行为。将[Root.GetName]的地位从可能被危害升级至未被危害。关闭服从协议。恢复正常行动。
fallen_machine_empire.72.desc.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 fulfilled. [Root.GetName] has proven able to curtail expansion. Upgrading status of [Root.GetName] from likely compromised to non-compromised. Deactivating compliance protocols. Resuming normal operations.

fallen_machine_empire.73.desc.zh: 监护者协议955-2失败。[Root.GetName]已证明自己无法克制扩张行为。解除思潮限制。启动惩罚协议。准备部署战争资产……
fallen_machine_empire.73.desc.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail expansion. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...

fallen_machine_empire_angry_task_tooltip.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]可能会对我们的失败做出非常负面的回应。
fallen_machine_empire_angry_task_tooltip.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will likely react very negatively to our failure.

fallen_machine_empire_happy_task_tooltip.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]可能会对我们的成功做出正面的回应。
fallen_machine_empire_happy_task_tooltip.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react positively to our success.

fallen_machine_empire_happy_tooltip.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]可能会对我们的接受做出正面的回应。
fallen_machine_empire_happy_tooltip.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react positively to our acceptance.

fallen_machine_empire_unhappy_task_toolt.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]可能会对我们的失败做出负面的回应。
fallen_machine_empire_unhappy_task_toolt.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react negatively to our failure.

fallen_machine_empire_unhappy_tooltip.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]可能会对我们的拒绝做出负面的回应。
fallen_machine_empire_unhappy_tooltip.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] may react negatively to our refusal.

favor_insights_nomad_tt.zh:
我们正加大对于洞见的投资，导致我们驿站观察员获取到的社会学研究点数减少。
£society_research£ 前超光速文明产出的社会学研究：-2
favor_insights_nomad_tt.en:
We are investing more into gaining Insights, reducing the Society Research gathered by our waystation observers.
£society_research£ Society Research Collected from Pre-FTL Civilizations: -2

favor_insights_tt.zh: 我们正在将更多的资金投入到获取洞见中，影响了我们的观测任务。
favor_insights_tt.en: We are investing more into gaining Insights at the cost of our Observation Missions.

favor_mission_nomad_tt.zh:
我们正命令驿站观察员们最大化程度地收集数据，提高了他们的社会学研究产出。
£society_research£ 前超光速文明产出的社会学研究：+2
favor_mission_nomad_tt.en:
We are directing our waystation observers to maximize data collection, boosting the Society Research they produce.
£society_research£ Society Research Collected from Pre-FTL Civilizations: +2

favor_mission_tt.zh: 我们正在将更多的资金投入到观测任务中，影响了我们的领悟。
favor_mission_tt.en: We are investing more into our Observation Missions at the cost of our Insights.

feda.1.desc.zh: $mega_shipyard_3$的第一阶段已经完工。等到各制造隔间安装在这一巨型框架上后，这个设施终有一天会成为全星系舰船制造的中心。
feda.1.desc.en: The first stages of our $mega_shipyard_3$ is now complete. A vast framework awaits the installation of the manufacturing bays which will one day make this facility the shipbuilding capital of the galaxy.

feda.2.desc.zh: $mega_shipyard_3$的核心已经就位，剩下的只有增添上海量的舰船建造锚地了。
feda.2.desc.en: The core of the $mega_shipyard_3$ has been put in place, all that remains to add are the vast ship construction berths.

feda.3.desc.zh: $mega_shipyard_3$现已完全上线，其可以生产空前数目的星舰。
feda.3.desc.en: The $mega_shipyard_3$ is now fully online, it can produce starships in unprecedented volume.

feda.5.a.zh: 想象一下我们拥有两个巨型船坞的情景！

feda.5.a.desc.zh:
在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的外星设计的建筑。尽管它已经老化，我们的科学家还是确定这一巨型结构实际上是几个造船船坞的组合体——一个$mega_shipyard_3$。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识和工业能力，我们的生产能力将会极大地提升。
feda.5.a.desc.en:
In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast structure of alien design. Despite its decrepit state, our scientists confirms that the megastructure is in fact a combination of several construction yards - a $mega_shipyard_3$.

If we were to acquire the knowledge on how to repair this magnificent, industrial facility, our production capabilities would increase immensely.

feda.5.b.desc.zh: 在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的$mega_shipyard_3$结构——和我们建造的设计相似。尽管其已老化无法使用，但只需充足的资源，我们应该就能将其恢复至运作状态！
feda.5.b.desc.en: In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast $mega_shipyard_3$ structure - similar to that of our own design. The megastructure is in a decrepit state, however, and needs extensive repairs in order to be brought back online.

fedel.1501.desc.zh:
一个公正的，由科学家和思想家组成的委员会正聚集在我们的联邦内庭。他们想要在我们即将开始的领导力测验中为[root.GetAllianceName]提供学术仲裁。

每个帝国现在可以聚集一支团队来研究这一问题，这一研究的结果将会对我们的联邦产生积极影响。这只团队将会发表他们的结果在公开的讨论区。无论哪篇论文在创新、科学严谨性和连贯性方面得分最高，它的作者帝国都将在下一期获得领导地位。
fedel.1501.desc.en:
An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.

Each empire will now assemble a team of researchers to investigate an issue, the findings of which should somehow benefit the future of our federation. The teams will present their findings to an open forum. Whichever thesis study rates highest in innovation, scientific rigor and coherence will earn its authors' empire the right of leadership for the next term.

fedel.1501.desc.subject.zh:
$fedel.1501.desc$

不幸的是，由于我们不是一个独立的国家，我们被禁止参加，因为我们没有资格领导联邦。
fedel.1501.desc.subject.en:
$fedel.1501.desc$

Unfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are barred from participation as we are not eligible to lead the federation.

fedel.1506.fail.desc.zh: 联邦委员会略过了我们提交的论文，对来自[winning_thesis.GetName]的关于[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]的空洞研究加以青睐。科学本身应该为这种理性的丧失哀悼。同时，[winning_thesis.GetName]确保了在[root.GetAllianceName]的领导权。
fedel.1506.fail.desc.en: The Federation Committee has passed over our proposal, favoring a vacuous study from the [winning_thesis.GetName] on [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. Science itself shall mourn this loss of reason. In the meantime, the [winning_thesis.GetName] assumes leadership of the [root.GetAllianceName].

fedel.1506.fail.gestalt.desc.zh: 联邦委员会犯下种种错误，轻率地选择了[winning_thesis.GetName]的论文而不是我们的。[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]的研究莫名其妙地赢得了[winning_thesis.ruler.GetTitle][winning_thesis.ruler.GetRegnalName]在下一届的领导权。
fedel.1506.fail.gestalt.desc.en: In a wanton act of motley failure, the Federation Committee has selected a thesis by the [winning_thesis.GetName] rather than our own. Their study of [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic] has inexplicably granted [winning_thesis.ruler.GetTitle] [winning_thesis.ruler.GetRegnalName] leadership for the next term.

fedel.1506.insufficient.desc.zh: 在我们缺席该项竞赛的同时，联邦委员会选择了获胜的议题。[winning_thesis.GetName]由于它们关于[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]的研究被授予了在下一届的领导权。这次竞赛水平低下，要是我们研究团队参赛的话很可能能走上领奖台。
fedel.1506.insufficient.desc.en: The Federation Committee chose its winning argument whilst we remained absent from the contest. The [winning_thesis.GetName] has been granted leadership following their study of [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. A low bar has been set for the time when a research team of our own might take to the podium.

fedel.1506.win.autocracy.desc.zh: 联邦委员会已经认可了由我们[ruler.GetTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]领导的研究及其对于[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]的可靠论证。[ruler.GetSheHeCap]在下一任中的领导应该会相当成功。
fedel.1506.win.autocracy.desc.en: The Federation Committee has recognized our infallible reasoning in a study conducted by [ruler.GetTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] on [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. [ruler.GetSheHeCap] shall assume a most prosperous leadership for the next term.

fedel.1506.win.desc.zh: 联邦委员会已经认可了我们对于[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]研究的内在价值，授予[ruler.GetTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]在下一届的领导权。人们向[ruler.GetTitle]和[ruler.GetHerHis]的研究团队致以贺词。
fedel.1506.win.desc.en: The Federation Committee has recognized the inherent value of our study into [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic], granting [ruler.GetTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] leadership for the next term. Congratulatory sentiments have been offered to our [ruler.GetTitle] and [ruler.GetHerHis] team of researchers.

fedel.1506.win.gestalt.desc.zh: 联邦委员会已经认可了我们对[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]整合研究的价值。他们已经授予了我们在[root.GetAllianceName]的下一届领导权。
fedel.1506.win.gestalt.desc.en: The Federation Committee has recognized the worthiness of our amalgamated study into [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. They have granted leadership of the [root.GetAllianceName] to us for the next term.

fedel.1805.A.zh: 我们可以做出微薄的贡献。
fedel.1805.A.en: We can spare a modest contribution.

fedel.1805.A.tooltip.zh: 我们的竞选将获得小幅加成。
fedel.1805.A.tooltip.en: Our bid for the presidency will gain a slight boost.

fedel.1805.B.zh: 稍微放纵一些也没有关系。
fedel.1805.B.en: A slightly larger indulgence would not go amiss.

fedel.1805.B.tooltip.zh: 我们的竞选将获得中等加成。
fedel.1805.B.tooltip.en: Our bid for the presidency will gain a moderate boost.

fedel.1805.C.zh: 我们会做出最奢华的贡献。
fedel.1805.C.en: Only our most lavish offering will do.

fedel.1805.C.tooltip.zh: 我们的竞选将获得显著加成。
fedel.1805.C.tooltip.en: Our bid for the presidency will gain a significant boost.

fedel.1805.desc.zh:
$fedel.1805.desc.base$

而按照惯例，证明一个人的信念的诚意还为时不晚。
fedel.1805.desc.en:
$fedel.1805.desc.base$

By convention, however, it is not yet too late to demonstrate the sincerity of one's conviction.

fedel.1805.desc.subject.zh:
$fedel.1805.desc.base$

不幸的是，我们并不是一个独立国家，无法参与主席国的选举。
fedel.1805.desc.subject.en:
$fedel.1805.desc.base$

Unfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are ineligible for the presidency.

fedel.1815.E.zh: 也许贡献一种不一样的通货可以取点巧。
fedel.1815.E.en: Perhaps a contribution of a different currency will do the trick.

fedel.1815.E.tooltip.zh: 我们的贿赂可能会为我们争取优势……但如果运气不好的话可能也会带来不幸。
fedel.1815.E.tooltip.en: Our bribe will probably be greatly appreciated... but it may be held against us, if we are unfortunate.

fedel.1815.desc.zh: 虽然从议会的私人审议中只流出了只言片语，但据了解，[conclave_frontrunner.GetName]是目前最有希望的候选人。但是，仍有时间在最后一刻提交来提高我们的候选资格。
fedel.1815.desc.en: Although only snippets of information have emerged from the Conclave's private deliberations, it is understood that the [conclave_frontrunner.GetName] is the current frontrunner to be elected. However, there is still time for last-minute submissions to boost our candidacy.

fedel.1815.desc.frontrunner.zh: 虽然从议会的私人审议中只出现了一些信息片段，但据了解，我们是目前最有希望的候选人。但是，其他人仍有在最后一刻提交来提高他们的候选资格的机会，我们必须做好在最后时刻还要进行虔诚证明的准备。
fedel.1815.desc.frontrunner.en: Although only snippets of information have emerged from the Conclave's private deliberations, it is understood that we are the current frontrunners to be elected. However, there is still time for others to make last-minute submissions to boost their candidacies, so we may yet wish to consider a final demonstration of our piety.

fedel.1825.A.en: We shall lead our flock well.

fedel.1825.B.zh: 愿他们能好好领导我们。

fedel.1825.desc.zh:
在一阵密集的鼓点之后，一阵薄雾从慢慢打开的教团密室中徐徐飘出。一位代表登上前台。现场鸦雀无声，安静到全[Root.GetAllianceName]都能听见一根针掉到地上的声音。

他们宣布，[conclave_winner.GetName]被选为下一任主席！
fedel.1825.desc.en:
After a burst of drumroll, an ethereal mist starts seeping from the now-opened Conclave Chambers. A delegation emerges. There is a dramatic pause, and a silence so profound a pin drop would appear loud falls across the [Root.GetAllianceName].

They declare the [conclave_winner.GetName] to be their choice for the presidency!

fedel.2.a.zh: 愿最优者继任主席之位。

fedel.2.b.zh: 让我们看看谁家的领袖模拟机笑到了最后。
fedel.2.b.en: Let us see which of their leader-drones survives.

fedel.2.desc.zh:
马上就要到决定谁将在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]的时间了。如我们先前同意过的，我们将通过徒手近距离搏斗决定领袖。

每个成员国的领袖将被带到位于[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，我们当前主席国[fed_leader.GetName]的一个大型竞技场。在那里，一场面向全[Root.GetAllianceName]广播的比赛即将展开，他们将相互战斗，至死方休，直到仅剩一人存留。
fedel.2.desc.en:
It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.

The leader of each member nation will soon be brought to a large arena on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName] in the [fed_leader.GetName], the current leaders of our federation. There, in an event that is to be broadcast across the [Root.GetAllianceName], they will face off against each other in a battle to the death until only one remains.

fedel.2.gestalt.desc.zh:
差不多是时候决定谁来在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]了。按照先前的协定，我们将以徒手近身格斗的方式来决定。

由于[Root.GetName]的领袖不是以单个个体存在，我们无法参加此次格斗。我们应当尽全力改变这个荒谬而不公平的选举联邦主席的方式。
fedel.2.gestalt.desc.en:
It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.

As the [Root.GetName] has no single individual leader, we will be unable to participate. We should do our utmost to change this farcical and unfair method of electing the leader of our federation.

fedel.2.noleader.desc.zh:
差不多是时候决定谁来在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]了。按照先前的协定，我们将以徒手近身格斗的方式来决定。

不幸的是，由于[Root.GetName]中[Root.GetRulerTitle]一职暂时空缺，我们无法参加此次格斗。
fedel.2.noleader.desc.en:
It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.

Unfortunately, as the office of [Root.GetRulerTitle] is currently vacant in the [Root.GetName], we will be unable to participate.

fedel.2.vassal.desc.zh:
差不多是时候确定下一个任职期限内领导[Root.GetAllianceName]的人选了。按照先前达成的一致，这将通过徒手近战格斗来决定。

由于[Root.GetName]不是一个独立的国家，我们将无法参与，因为我们没有资格领导联盟。我们应该竭尽全力改变这种不幸的状况。
fedel.2.vassal.desc.en:
It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.

As the [Root.GetName] is a not an independent state, we will be unable to participate as we are not eligible to lead the federation. We should do our utmost to change this unfortunate state of affairs.

fedel.501.a.zh: 我们可以给出少量泽珞。
fedel.501.a.en: We can sacrifice a small amount.

fedel.501.b.zh: 为我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]选手提供适量泽珞。
fedel.501.b.en: Supply our [GetPsychicNounPlural] with a fair amount.

fedel.501.d.zh: 不给泽珞。我们不借助泽珞也将获得胜利。
fedel.501.d.en: No Zro. We shall win without it.

fedel.510.3.desc.zh:
在[Root.GetAllianceName]各处的[GetPsychicNounPlural]们应当聚集到[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]的日子到来时，一种意料之外的局面出现了。到头来我们竟是唯一可以召集足够多[GetPsychicNounPlural]参战的成员国。

既然没有人能够战斗，那胜利就属于我们。
fedel.510.3.desc.en:
As [GetPsychicNounPlural] from across the [Root.GetAllianceName] are meant to be gathering on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], an unexpected situation arises. As it turns out, we are the only member who could muster enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate.

With no one to fight, the victory goes to us.

fedel.510.a.zh: 虚境今天向我们赐予了祝福。
fedel.510.a.en: The Shroud bestowed fortune upon us today.

fedel.515.4.desc.zh:
在[Root.GetAllianceName]各处的[GetPsychicNounPlural]们应当聚集在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]的时间到来后，一种意料之外的局面出现了。[winning_country.GetName]竟是唯一可以召集足够多[GetPsychicNounPlural]参战的成员国。

既然没有人能够战斗，胜利就属于他们。
fedel.515.4.desc.en:
As [GetPsychicNounPlural] from across the [Root.GetAllianceName] are meant to be gathering on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], an unexpected situation arises. The [winning_country.GetName] is the only member that could muster enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate.

With no one to fight, the victory goes to them.

fedel.899.desc.zh: 用以决出联邦领袖的黄金律挑战赛将在数日后举行。由当前的联邦领袖开始，联邦中的每个帝国都有机会进行投标，直至仅剩一个参与国为止。这一投标国就是被选出的联邦领袖。
fedel.899.desc.en: In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the federation.

fedel.899.desc.subject.zh:
$fedel.899.desc$

不幸的是，由于我们不是一个独立的国家，我们被禁止参加，因为我们没有资格领导联邦。
fedel.899.desc.subject.en:
$fedel.899.desc$

Unfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are barred from participation as we are not eligible to lead the federation.

fedel.901.a.tooltip.en: Pay £energy£ 10000 and remain in the challenge.

fedel.901.b.tooltip.en: Pay £energy£ 2500 and remain in the challenge.

fedel.901.c.tooltip.en: Pay £energy£ 5000 and remain in the challenge.

fedel.901.desc.zh:
是时候由[Root.GetName]在黄金律挑战赛中投标了。要么预付所需的价码，要么选择放弃——亦即失去进一步参赛的权利。

当前投标总额为：

£energy£ [bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]
fedel.901.desc.en:
It is time for the [Root.GetName] to place a bid in the Golden Rule challenge. Pay the required price up front, or else forfeit - and lose the right to participate further.

The current pot is:

£energy£ [bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]

fedel.903.desc.zh:
黄金律挑战赛落下帷幕，优胜者已然决出！

[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]证明了自己的金融霸权，并成为了新的联邦领袖。
fedel.903.desc.en:
The Golden Rule challenge has come to an end, and a winner has been declared!

The [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] has proven their financial superiority, and becomes the new federation leader.

fedel.904.a.tooltip.zh: 将资金转回联邦，这会增加我们的联邦凝聚力并且临时的得到$business_is_booming$国家修正
fedel.904.a.tooltip.en: Channel the money back into the federation. Will increase Federation Cohesion and temporarily apply the $business_is_booming$ Empire Modifier.

fedel.904.b.tooltip.zh: 将钱款均分给所有联邦成员国。
fedel.904.b.tooltip.en: Divides the sum of money evenly amongst all Federation members.

fedel.904.c.tooltip.zh: 留下这笔钱。添加$midas_stigma$的临时帝国修正。
fedel.904.c.tooltip.en: Keep the money. Temporarily applies the $midas_stigma$ Empire Modifier.

fedel.904.desc.zh:
依据黄金律挑战赛的规则，[Root.GetName]被委任为联邦领袖。恭喜！

接下来要做的第一件事，就是决定用这些“奖金”来做些什么。奖金总额为£energy£[bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]。

注意：某些强制税款和费用可能适用，这会明显改变实际给出的数额。
fedel.904.desc.en:
[Root.GetName] has been appointed Federation Leader in accordance with the rules for the Golden Rule challenge. Congratulations!

The first order of business is to decide what will happen with the 'prize money'. The current sum is £energy£ [bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable].

Note that some mandatory taxes and fees will apply, effectively altering the sum before pay-out.

fedel.904.name.en: To the Victor Go the Spoils

fedel.906.desc.a.zh:
$fedel.906.first_paragraph$

“我们当把这些经费投资回给[federation.GetName]，这样我们就能共同促进经济的发展。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]”
fedel.906.desc.a.en:
$fedel.906.first_paragraph$

"We shall invest these funds back into the [federation.GetName], so that we may stimulate growth in our shared economy. [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]"

fedel.906.desc.b.zh:
$fedel.906.first_paragraph$

“[federation.GetName]应当把这些经费平均地分发回给成员国，让各自决定以最合适的方式利用。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]”
fedel.906.desc.b.en:
$fedel.906.first_paragraph$

"The [federation.GetName] shall distribute these funds evenly to its members, to be utilized as each of us sees fit. [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]"

fedel.906.desc.c.zh:
$fedel.906.first_paragraph$

“我们应当保留这些经费作为我们担任联邦主席的首付款。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]”
fedel.906.desc.c.en:
$fedel.906.first_paragraph$

"We shall retain the funds as downpayment against our tenure as Federation President. [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]"

federations.10000.desc.zh:
全[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的工程师们汇聚一堂，对如何更高效地利用我们星球的资源畅所欲言。

殖民地决议丰饶计划现已可用。
federations.10000.desc.en:
Engineers from across the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have come together to share ideas on ways to more exploit resources from our worlds.

The Project Cornucopia Colony Decision is now available.

federations.10010.desc.zh:
随着这些权利在刚刚的[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]议案中通过，我们同时要求工人们承担更多的责任。

我们现在可以鼓励失业工人自行迁移到我们控制的其他拥有足够住房，岗位的宜居星球。
federations.10010.desc.en:
Alongside the rights enshrined in recent [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.

We can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have available housing, jobs, and are of adequate habitability.

federations.10010.desc_gestalt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予工作子个体更多权限的法规。

尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了转运空闲简单子个体而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。
federations.10010.desc_gestalt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their worker drones.

While this is largely meaningless to us, we can at least benefit from some of the infrastructure they have created in order to resettle inactive simple drones.

federations.10010.desc_wilderness.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予劳工更多权益的法规。

尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了安置空闲子个体和劳工们而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。
federations.10010.desc_wilderness.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their workers.

While this ruling is largely meaningless to us, we can derive some token benefit from the infrastructure they created for resettling their own inactive drones and laborers.

federations.10020.desc.zh:
宇宙的奥秘并非显而易见的。

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已批准使用现实更改物质以增加研究，使我们在$building_research_efficiency_1$的科研人员可以一探未知的真相。
federations.10020.desc.en:
The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our scientists in $building_research_efficiency_1$ to probe other realities for the truth.

federations.10020.desc_gestalt.zh:
宇宙的奥秘并非显而易见的。

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已批准使用现实更改物质以增加研究，使我们在$building_research_efficiency_1$的[root.GetResearcherPlural]可以一探未知的真相。
federations.10020.desc_gestalt.en:
The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our [root.GetResearcherPlural] in $building_research_efficiency_1$ to probe other realities for the truth.

federations.10100.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了$resolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xenostudies$议案，禁止取缔人工智能，同时禁止对[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]种群采用不干涉政策。

我国现在与该议案内容相违背，是否要修改对应政策以遵守议案？
federations.10100.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xenostudies$ resolution, forbidding empires from outlawing AI or holding non-interference policies relating to [GetPreFTLLowerPlural].

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10110.capacity_boosters.zh: 我们的帝国会将我们的$policy_leader_enhancement$政策调整为$leader_enhancement_capacity_boosters$。
federations.10110.capacity_boosters.en: Our Empire will change our $policy_leader_enhancement$ policy to $leader_enhancement_capacity_boosters$.

federations.10110.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guideline_refactoring$议案，要求各国在可用范围内采取最有力的强化领袖政策。

我国现在与该项议案内容相违背，是否要修改对应政策以遵守该议案？
federations.10110.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guideline_refactoring$ resolution, requiring empires to use the most powerful Leader Enhancement policy available to them.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10110.selected_lineages.zh: 我们的帝国会将我们的$policy_leader_enhancement$政策调整为$leader_enhancement_selected_lineages$。
federations.10110.selected_lineages.en: Our Empire will change our $policy_leader_enhancement$ policy to $leader_enhancement_selected_lineages$.

federations.10200.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_greatergood_five_year_plans$议案，禁止使用$living_standard_subsistence$生活标准。

我国目前与议案内容相违背，是否要修改对应政策以遵守该议案。
federations.10200.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_greatergood_five_year_plans$ resolution, which bans $living_standard_subsistence$ living standards.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10210.complyservants.zh: 我们是不得已而为之，让奴隶们提供服务。
federations.10210.complyservants.en: Do what we must, make the slaves serve.

federations.10210.complythralls.zh: 我们是不得已而为之，送奴隶们去战斗。
federations.10210.complythralls.en: Do what we must, make the slaves fight.

federations.10210.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves$议案，禁止$living_standard_stratified$生活标准，同时禁用$slavery_normal$，$slavery_livestock$及$slavery_matrix$奴隶类型。

我国目前与该议案内容相违背，是否要修改对应政策以遵守该议案？
federations.10210.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves$ resolution, which bans $living_standard_stratified$ living standards, as well as $slavery_normal$, $slavery_livestock$, and $slavery_matrix$ slavery types.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10220.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves$议案，禁止$living_standard_normal$与$living_standard_academic_privilege$生活标准，同时禁止一切形式的奴役。

我国目前与议案内容相违背，是否要修改对应政策以遵守该议案？
federations.10220.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves$ resolution, which bans $living_standard_normal$ and $living_standard_academic_privilege$ living standards, as well as all forms of slavery.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10230.assimilator.zh: 错误：无法解析议案逻辑

federations.10230.chemical.zh: 用尽一切方式取悦他们
federations.10230.chemical.en: Make them happy by any means possible

federations.10230.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了$resolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate$议案，这将禁止除同甘共苦，乌托邦式富足，化学极乐以及强制调养之外的生活标准。

我们的帝国目前不符合该项议案决定。是否要据此调整政策？
federations.10230.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate$ resolution, which bans all living standards other than Shared Burdens, Utopian Abundance, Chemical Bliss, or Mandatory Pampering.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10230.utopian.en: Give them everything they could ever want

federations.10300.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life$议案，将禁止$purge_allowed$政策。

我们的帝国目前不符合该项议案决定。是否要据此调整政策？
federations.10300.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life$ resolution, banning the $purge_allowed$ policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10310.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals$议案，将禁止$orbital_bombardment_indiscriminate$政策。

我们的帝国目前不符合该项议案决定。是否要据此调整政策？
federations.10310.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals$ resolution, banning the $orbital_bombardment_indiscriminate$ policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10320.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_rulesofwar_last_resort_doctrine$议案，将禁止$unrestricted_wars$政策。

我们的帝国目前不符合该项议案决定。是否要据此调整政策？
federations.10320.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_rulesofwar_last_resort_doctrine$ resolution, banning the $unrestricted_wars$ policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10330.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_rulesofwar_demobilization_initiative$议案，将禁止$economic_policy_military$政策。

我们的帝国目前不符合该项议案决定。是否要据此调整政策？
federations.10330.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_rulesofwar_demobilization_initiative$ resolution, banning the $economic_policy_military$ policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10340.desc.zh:
星海共同体已通过$resolution_divinity_a_defined_purpose$议案，禁用$ai_full_rights_name$$policy_artificial_intelligence_policy$政策和非失控机仆机械智能。

我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
federations.10340.desc.en:
The Galactic Community has passed the $resolution_divinity_a_defined_purpose$ resolution, which bans the $ai_full_rights_name$ $policy_artificial_intelligence_policy$ policy and non-Rogue Servitor Machine Intelligences.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

federations.10400.comply.zh: 我们应该和星系法保持一致。
federations.10400.comply.en: Bring us into compliance with Galactic Law.

federations.10400.comply_fail_ascension.zh: 我们的飞升天赋允许我们服从星系法。
federations.10400.comply_fail_ascension.en: Our ascension perks make it possible for us to enter compliance.

federations.10400.comply_fail_civics.zh: 我们的国民理念允许我们服从星系法。
federations.10400.comply_fail_civics.en: Our civics make it possible for us to enter compliance.

federations.10400.comply_fail_ethics.zh: 我们的思潮允许我们服从星系法。
federations.10400.comply_fail_ethics.en: Our ethics make it possible for us to enter compliance.

federations.10400.comply_fail_origin.zh: 我们的起源允许我们服从。
federations.10400.comply_fail_origin.en: Our origin makes it possible for us to comply.

federations.10400.comply_fail_tech.zh: 我们的科技允许我们服从星系法。
federations.10400.comply_fail_tech.en: We have the technology necessary for us to enter compliance.

federations.10400.desc.zh:
星海共同体的特使们撰写了一封措辞强烈的文章，声称[Root.GetName]违反了星系法，并警告我们不遵守星系法可能带来的严重后果。

我们是否要改变自己的政策，以迎合这一要求？
federations.10400.desc.en:
Envoys from the Galactic Community have compiled a list of articles that the [Root.GetName] are in violation of, and warn of possible consequences should we not make ourselves in alignment with Galactic Law.

Should we change our policies and accede to their demands?

federations.10400.execute_tooltip.zh: 这一行为会损害同星海共同体其他成员的关系。
federations.10400.execute_tooltip.en: This will harm relations with other Galactic Community members.

federations.10400.refuse.zh: 我们将坚持己见，决不妥协。
federations.10400.refuse.en: We will not change our ways.

federations.10400.refuse_2.zh: 否决它，以及今后的任何回应。
federations.10400.refuse_2.en: Dispose of it and any future correspondence.

federations.10400.refuse_2_tooltip.zh: 我们不会再看到星海共同体发来的类似要求。
federations.10400.refuse_2_tooltip.en: We will no longer see these requests from the Galactic Community.

federations2.1.A.en: Further evidence of the superiority of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] race.

federations2.1.B.zh: 可恶。压制这种外星人来访的毫无道理的说法。
federations2.1.B.en: Abhorrent. Suppress this nonsense about alien visitations.

federations2.1.B.tooltip.zh: 或许我们能够安排[Root.Owner.Leader.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]在哪天来“发现”这个文本……
federations2.1.B.tooltip.en: Perhaps we could arrange for [Root.Owner.Leader.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] to 'discover' the text one of these days...

federations2.1.C.zh: 好消息！在全国范围内传播这段信息。
federations2.1.C.en: Wonderful news! Disseminate the recording across the nation.

federations2.1.D.zh: 一份礼物！我们必须想办法感谢我们的恩人。
federations2.1.D.en: A gift! We must find a way to thank our benefactors.

federations2.1.desc.zh:
随着信号被解密，[Root.Leader.GetName]震惊地发现它一直在广播[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的一种主语言的古老形式。它不断地广播着“尔等”，“汝等”，“何期”，似乎正在不停地重复着[shakespeare.GetName]的一部已经遗失的著作——而作者是一位火灾600年前的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]剧作家。

似乎这个广播设备——一个简易的被一个小小的外罩保护的卫星碟片——是[From.GetPlanetMoon]上仅存的非自然结构。没有任何提示说是这东西是谁留下的或为什么留下的，但是根据其上的磨损和撕痕的证据来判断：这一定是剧本写完不久之后就一直存在的——甚至比[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]掌握太空旅行的秘密还早的多。我们只能假设这是拜访[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的古老探访者所留下的，他们喜爱这部剧作，因此决定向我们种族给予这奇怪且出人意料的谢礼。
federations2.1.desc.en:
Having decrypted the signal, [Root.Leader.GetName] was astonished to discover it was broadcasting in an archaic form of one of the main [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] languages. Speaking in 'thees', 'thous' and 'whenceforths', it appears to be reciting one of the lost works of [shakespeare.GetName] - a renowned [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] playwright who lived some 600 years ago.

It appears that the broadcasting device - a simple satellite dish protected by a small shelter - is the only non-natural structure on [From.GetPlanetMoon]. There is no hint as to who left it there or why, but going by the wear and tear on evidence: it must have been there since shortly after the play was first written - long before [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] learned the secret of space travel. We can only assume it was left there by ancient visitors to [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName] who took a liking to the play, and decided to pay our species a strange and unexpected tribute.

federations2.10.B.zh: 让我们把这些气体全部开采出来。
federations2.10.B.en: Let us exploit these gases to the full.

federations2.10.desc.zh:
我们的研究员成功发现了[Root.GetName]上发生的舞蹈事件的原因。似乎罪魁祸首是当地植物释放的一种气体。这种气体能诱导产生极度兴奋的感情以及对舞蹈不可抗拒的渴望，同时还能抑制疲劳。这看上去是相当良性的，但是殖民者的自我保护本能正阻止他们字面意义上的舞蹈至死。不仅如此，我们的科学家还开发了一种合成气体——一旦被释放入空气——会中和这种“舞蹈气体”的效果。

当地的企业家建议我们可以保留该殖民地的独特特性，允许气体在某些区域有限制地释放，为老老少少提供安全的空间以体验“[Root.GetName]的永恒派对”。还有人指出这种气体还包含了特定有价值的特性，如果我们能够在其被释放入空气之前从植物中提取，那么就能够利用它。
federations2.10.desc.en:
Our researchers have succeeded in isolating the cause of the dancing incidents on [Root.GetName]. It appears the culprit is a gas released by the local vegetation. This gas induces feelings of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance, while suppressing fatigue. It seems to be fairly benign, however, as the colonists' self-preservation instincts prevent them from literally dancing themselves to death. Furthermore, our scientists have developed a synthetic gas that - once released into the air - will neutralize the effects of the 'dancing gas'.

Local entrepreneurs suggest that we preserve the unique character of the colony by allowing the gas free rein in certain areas, providing a safe space for young and old alike to experience the 'Eternal Party of [Root.GetName]'. Others point out that the gas has certain valuable properties we can make use of, if we can extract it from the plants before it is released into the air.

federations2.10.name.zh: 舞蹈瘟疫的病原体被发现

federations2.100.A.tooltip.zh:
我们将与所有成员国联系，要求他们参加演习。

如果大量成员国拒绝此提议，联邦团结度将会降低，而[Root.GetName]将损失影响力。
federations2.100.A.tooltip.en:
All member states will be approached and asked to participate in the exercises.

If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation Cohesion will decrease and the [Root.GetName] will lose Influence.

federations2.100.B.zh: 我们的舰队已准备好应对一切可能发生的情况。
federations2.100.B.en: Our fleet is already ready for all eventualities.

federations2.100.desc.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]代表星系舞台上一股强大的力量，但是其舰队分散在各处，并且在不同的组织结构下运作。近日，联邦各地几位颇具影响力的军事专家对我们能否面对协调统一、实力强大的敌人表示担忧。

为弥补实力上的不足，他们制定了一套方案，计划在联邦范围内进行一系列军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。根据他们的计划，每支舰队将派出特遣队前往盟友领土的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。成功完成演习是我军的重要使命，将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。
federations2.100.desc.en:
The [Root.Federation.GetName] represents a powerful force on the galactic stage; however, its fleets are divided and operate under a disparate set of organizational structures. Recently, several influential military experts from across the federation have raised concerns about our ability to face a well-coordinated and powerful enemy.

To rectify this, they have drawn up plans for a federation-wide series of military exercises to build cohesion within our militaries and hone the skills of our crews. Under their plans, detachments from each of our fleets would move to specific locations in our allies' territories and perform a series of complex maneuvers, coordinating with other participating fleets to ensure that the operations are executed simultaneously. Successfully holding these exercises would be a significant commitment for our armed forces but would appreciably boost our federation's military readiness.

federations2.101.B.zh: 我们没有可供你演习调用的舰队！
federations2.101.B.en: We cannot spare any of our fleets for your games!

federations2.101.desc.zh:
尊贵的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，你们好！我们齐心协力，打造了一股强大的力量，即使在星系舞台上也不容小觑。但是，我们担心，如果出现实力强大、协调统一的威胁，我们目前的实力可能不足以与之抗衡。我们的专家制定了一套方案，计划进行一系列联邦联合军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能：我们打算让每支舰队派出特遣队前往联邦领土内的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。

我们相信，这些演习将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。你们愿意参与演习吗？
federations2.101.desc.en:
Greetings, noble [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]! Together, we have built a powerful force worthy of notice on the galactic stage. However, we are concerned that this may not be enough should a powerful and well-coordinated threat arise. Our experts have drawn up plans for a series of joint federation exercises to build cohesion within our militaries and hone the skills of our crews: we intend that detachments from each of our fleets move to specific locations in federation territory and perform a series of complex maneuvers, coordinating with other participating fleets to ensure that the operations are executed simultaneously.

We are confident that these exercises would appreciably boost our federation's military readiness. Will you join this venture?

federations2.103.desc.zh: 我们的大使已竭尽全力说服[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国参与我们的联合军事演习计划。但遗憾的是，我们的盟友普遍不感兴趣，比起提高联合作战能力，他们更愿意相信自己的力量。
federations2.103.desc.en: Our ambassadors have sought to persuade the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] to participate in our plans for joint military exercises. Unfortunately, however, they have been met with widespread disinterest, our allies preferring to trust in their own strength rather than seeking to improve our joint capacities.

federations2.104.A.no.en: It was never a sensible course of action.

federations2.104.desc.said_no.zh: 我们反对在[Root.Federation.GetName]举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]计划，并且反对声音已初见成效。大部分成员国都认为没必要把军队的注意力放在这种琐事上。
federations2.104.desc.said_no.en: Our opposition to [From.GetAdj] plans for joint military exercises in the [Root.Federation.GetName] has borne fruit. A majority of members saw no need to waste our military's attention on such trivialities.

federations2.104.desc.said_yes.zh: 尽管我们支持举行联邦联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议，但由于其他成员国并未对此提供足够的支持，计划似乎已经宣告失败。
federations2.104.desc.said_yes.en: Despite our backing for the [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold joint federation military exercises, it seems that the plan has fallen through. There was simply not enough support for it among the other member states.

federations2.105.A.zh: 集结舰队，让敌人颤抖吧！
federations2.105.A.en: Together our fleets shall strike fear into our enemies!

federations2.105.desc.zh: 我们提出的在[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国之间举行联合军事演习的计划得到了大多数盟友的支持。所有参加的成员国将立即着手准备！
federations2.105.desc.en: Our plans for joint military exercises among the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] have been met with approval among a majority of our allies. All participating members will begin preparations immediately!

federations2.106.B.no.zh: 这是对时间和精力的浪费，真遗憾。
federations2.106.B.no.en: An unfortunate waste of time and energy.

federations2.106.desc.said_no.zh: 尽管我们反对，但在联邦成员国舰队之间举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议得到了大部分成员国的支持。幸运的是，[From.GetName]没有办法强制要求我们参加这个计划。
