federations2.106.desc.said_no.en: Despite our opposition, [From.GetAdj] plans to hold joint military exercises between federation member states' fleets has met with approval among the majority of members. Fortunately, there is nothing the [From.GetName] can do to force us to participate in the scheme.

federations2.106.desc.said_yes.zh: 在联邦成员国舰队之间举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议得到了大部分成员国的支持。我们得尽快着手准备！
federations2.106.desc.said_yes.en: The [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold joint military exercises between federation member states' fleets has met with approval among the majority of members. We shall begin our preparations for them immediately!

federations2.108.desc.zh: 我们已为联邦联合军事演习做好万全准备，只需等待盟友的舰队就位，就可以开始行动！
federations2.108.desc.en: We are all set for the joint federation military exercises. We need merely wait for our allies' fleets to move into place before the operations begin!

federations2.108.name.zh: 联合演习的准备工作完成

federations2.108.tt.zh: 演习将在联邦舰队就位后立即开始。
federations2.108.tt.en: The exercises will commence as soon as all federation fleets are in position.

federations2.109.A.zh: 武器已锁定目标并装填完毕！

federations2.109.desc.zh: 所有联邦舰队现已就位，训练演习可立即开始！一组高机动性的轻装目标从先前隐藏的位置现身，在为期30天的演习中，这些目标会尽力避免被我们的舰船摧毁。
federations2.109.desc.en: All federation fleets are now in place, so the training exercises may commence! A set of lightly-armed but highly mobile targets have emerged from a previously hidden location and are seeking to avoid destruction by our ships before the 30 days time limit expires.

federations2.11.desc.zh:
我们的研究员成功发现了[Root.GetName]上发生的舞蹈事件的原因——可花了好一会功夫！星球上的情况已经是燎原之火，医护人员们不得已不断地对舞蹈者使用高剂量镇定剂以迫使他们从舞蹈至死的过程中停下来。

似乎罪魁祸首是当地植物释放的一种气体。这种气体能诱导产生极度兴奋的感情以及对舞蹈不可抗拒的渴望，同时还能抑制精疲力尽的感觉，压倒了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]自我保护的本能。

幸运的是，我们的科学家已经开发出了一种合成气体——一旦被释放入空气——会中和这种“舞蹈气体”的效果。不仅如此，如果我能够在其被释放入空气之前从植物中提取这种气体，似乎这种“舞蹈气体”具有某些我们能够利用的有价值的特性。
federations2.11.desc.en:
Our researchers have succeeded in isolating the cause of the dancing incidents on [Root.GetName] - and not a moment too soon! The situation on the planet has grown dire, as medics have increasingly been forced to use heavy sedatives on the dancers to stop them from dancing themselves to death.

It appears that the culprit is a gas released by the local vegetation, which induces feelings of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance, while suppressing feelings of exhaustion, overriding [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] self-preservation instincts.

Fortunately, our scientists have developed a synthetic gas that - once released into the air - will neutralize the effects of the 'dancing gas'. Furthermore, it seems that the 'dancing gas' has certain valuable properties we can make use of, if we can extract it from the plants before it is released into the air.

federations2.112.desc.zh: 我们已成功消灭联合军事演习中的目标。只能希望我们的盟友也同样勤奋！
federations2.112.desc.en: We have successfully eliminated our target in the joint military exercises. We can but hope that our allies have been equally diligent!

federations2.113.desc.zh: 我们未能消灭联合军事演习中的目标，舰队军官因此羞愧难当。我们只能希望盟友能够更加成功！
federations2.113.desc.en: To the immeasurable shame of our naval officers, we have failed to eliminate our target in the joint military exercises. We can only hope that our allies have been more successful!

federations2.115.A.zh: 我们的舰队将所向披靡！

federations2.115.A.haha.en: We have the best of allies!

federations2.115.B.oh_dear.zh: 我们垂头丧气，羞愧难当。
federations2.115.B.oh_dear.en: We hang our heads in shame.

federations2.115.B.oh_well.zh: 至少我们完成了自己的目标。
federations2.115.B.oh_well.en: At least we did our part.

federations2.115.desc.complete_failure.zh: 居然没有一个参加演习的成员国能在时限内消灭目标，[Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习也随之以闹剧告终。我们只能希望，在我们尽力捡起失去的骄傲、恢复舰队的尊严时，敌人没有过于密切地关注演习的发展。
federations2.115.desc.complete_failure.en: With the failure of even one participating member to eliminate their target before time ran out, the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have ended in farce. We can only hope that our enemies were not watching proceedings too closely as we seek to pick up the pieces of our lost pride and restore the dignity of our fleet.

federations2.115.desc.complete_success.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习现已结束。这次演习称得上是鼓舞人心的巨大成功，每支参与演习的队伍都不费吹灰之力地摧毁了目标，彻底证明了我们联邦舰队超凡的技能和卓越的协调能力！在向我们开战前，敌人一定会再三考虑。
federations2.115.desc.complete_success.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have now concluded. They have immediately been declared a rousing success, each participating fleet having struck down their targets without untoward difficulty, proving once and for all the excellent skill and superior coordination of our federation fleet! Our enemies will surely think twice before they pick a fight with us now.

federations2.115.desc.partial_failure.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的军事演习现已结束，但过程有一点讽刺：尽管部分参加的舰队能够击中目标，但大多数舰队都未能成功，这让我们不禁怀疑，[Root.Federation.GetName]是否有能力组织统一的军事行动。我们只能希望敌人没有过于密切地关注演习的发展……
federations2.115.desc.partial_failure.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have ended in a slightly farcical manner: although some participants were able to strike their targets, a majority failed to do so, casting doubt on the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s ability to work as a unified force in military matters.  We can only hope that our enemies were not watching proceedings too closely...

federations2.115.desc.partial_success.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习现已结束。这次演习相对来说差强人意：尽管并非所有舰队都能消灭其目标，但大部分参加的舰队都取得了成功，这说明联邦舰队有能力协调执行复杂的任务。此外，我们的船员也从这次经历中受益颇多，目前像往常一样准备充分，随时可以执行任务。在向我们开战前，敌人一定会再三考虑。
federations2.115.desc.partial_success.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have now concluded. They have been declared a partial success: although not every party was able to eliminate their target, most participating fleets were able to do so, demonstrating that the federation's fleet is capable of coordinating to perform sophisticated tasks. Additionally, our crews have benefited greatly from the experience and are now as ready for action as ever before. Our enemies will surely think twice before they pick a fight with us now.

federations2.12.A.en: Has anyone tried turning the music off?

federations2.12.desc.zh:
“舞蹈瘟疫”进入到了更糟糕的阶段，起初，我们的医护人员采用高剂量的镇定剂来阻止这些舞蹈者舞蹈至死。然而，随着他们不断地受到日益增强的综合征的影响，剩余的医护人员已经无法应对这样的情况，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的居民正因精疲力竭不断倒下。

随着越来越多的殖民者受到影响，我们再也不能如同过去那样，认为这是一个无伤大雅的玩笑。我们必须立即采取行动以摆脱这种瘟疫，一劳永逸根除后患！
federations2.12.desc.en:
The 'Dancing Plague' has taken a turn for the worse. At first, our medics took to using heavy sedatives to stop the dancers from dancing themselves to death. However, as they themselves were increasingly affected by the symptoms, the remaining medics were unable to cope, and scores of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have collapsed from exhaustion.

With more of the colonists affected by the day, this has gone far beyond the harmless joke we had thought it to be. We must take immediate action to rid ourselves of this plague, once and for all!

federations2.12.name.en: The Ravages of the Dancing Plague

federations2.120.desc.zh: 我们已经离开了先前所在的联邦，因此我们无权参与其计划中的联合军事演习。
federations2.120.desc.en: As we have left our old federation, our participation in their planned joint military exercises has been curtailed.

federations2.120.name.zh: 参与联合军事演习受限
federations2.120.name.en: Participation in Joint Military Exercises Curtailed

federations2.121.desc.zh: 战争爆发导致计划中的联邦军事演习取消。
federations2.121.desc.en: The outbreak of war has led to the cancellation of the planned federation military exercises.

federations2.13.desc.zh: 尽管我们的科学家还对造成所谓的“舞蹈瘟疫”的原因感到困惑，但是它的影响似乎在其对我们殖民者造成危险之前就消退了。或许是殖民者对这种病原体随着时间产生了免疫力，又或者是这只是为了引起[Root.GetName]注意的一种恶作剧？无论是什么情况，殖民者不再跳舞了！
federations2.13.desc.en: Although our scientists are still baffled by the cause of the so-called 'Dancing Plague', its effects seem to have worn off before it could pose a danger to our colonists. Perhaps it was a pathogen that the settlers have grown immune to over time, or else an elaborate hoax to attract attention to [Root.GetName]? Whatever the case, the settlers are no longer dancing!

federations2.14.desc.zh:
尽管我们的科学家还对造成所谓的“舞蹈瘟疫”的原因感到困惑，这似乎对我们的殖民者不构成危险。尽管这种瘟疫能影响人们感受到极度兴奋的感觉以及对舞蹈不可抑制的渴望，他们的生存本能还是能通过力竭的感受让他们时不时地休息一会儿。

当地的企业家已经开始规划这些区域为派对区域，并对[Root.GetName]打广告说这是“星球的永恒节日”，在这里老老少少能够放下种种限制来享受身心。
federations2.14.desc.en:
Although our scientists are still baffled by the cause of the so-called Dancing Plague, it does not seem to pose a danger to our colonists. While those affected by it experience a feeling of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance, their survival instinct means that exhaustion forces them to rest sooner or later. Furthermore, it seems that only some areas are significantly affected by this phenomenon.

Local entrepreneurs have already begun designating these areas as party zones, advertising [Root.GetName] as the 'Planet of Eternal Festivity', where young and old alike may come to release their shackles and enjoy themselves.

federations2.15.desc.zh:
我们的研究员成功发现了[Root.GetName]上发生的舞蹈事件的原因。似乎罪魁祸首是当地植物释放的一种气体。这种气体能诱导产生极度兴奋的感情以及对舞蹈不可抗拒的渴望，同时还能抑制精疲力尽的感觉，压倒了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]自我保护的本能。

幸运的是，我们的科学家已经开发出了一种合成气体——一旦被释放入空气——会中和这种“舞蹈气体”的效果。不仅如此，如果我能够在其被释放入空气之前从植物中提取这种气体，似乎这种“舞蹈气体”具有某些我们能够利用的有价值的特性。
federations2.15.desc.en:
Our researchers have finally succeeded in isolating the cause of the dancing incidents on [Root.GetName]. It appears the culprit is a gas released by the local vegetation, which induces feelings of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance while suppressing feelings of exhaustion, overriding [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] self-preservation instincts.

Fortunately, our scientists have developed a synthetic gas that - once released into the air - will neutralize the effects of the 'dancing gas'. Furthermore, it seems that the 'dancing gas' has certain valuable properties we can make use of, if we can extract it from the plants before it is released into the air.

federations2.2.desc.zh: 对该行星及其卫星的扫描表明，它们都曾经是人口稠密的聚居地点，其人口数量比[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]还要多。此外对卫星的进一步分析表明，它们目前的轨道并不是自然形成的。这些卫星是被外力拖入目前的轨道，并精确定位到了目前的位置，以至于直到现在，这些卫星之间都保持着完美的平衡。但是由于在该行星发生的灾难过于猛烈，发生的时间过于久远，我们没能在找到任何可以再现这些星球居民文明的记载。
federations2.2.desc.en: Surface scans of the planet and its moons show that they were once all densely inhabited, supporting a population many times beyond that of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Furthermore, an analysis of the moons has concluded that their positioning cannot have been natural. They must have been dragged into orbit and then stationed so precisely that even now, they remain in perfect balance. However, the cataclysm that occurred here was so violent - and occurred so long ago - that few records remain from which we can recreate the story of the inhabitants' civilization.

federations2.20.desc.zh:
当我们的船进入[From.GetName]星系时，显而易见的是有奇怪的事正在发生。这个星系的其中一个星球拥有着引人注目的卫星数量，而这颗星球似乎曾经适宜居住但现在却显示出相当高的辐射读数。另一个星球被完全摧毁了。碎片散落在整个系统中，表明这里曾经生活过的任何文明都在一场激烈的斗争中被毁灭了。

一艘战舰在星系中巡逻。它不响应我们的问询，而且它的航线表明其正在拦截[Root.GetName]。它的武器系统正在充能。
federations2.20.desc.en:
As our ships enter the [From.GetName] system, it is immediately obvious that something very strange happened here. One of the planets - which boasts an eye-catching distribution of moons - appears to have once been habitable, but initial scans show high levels of radiation. Another planet has been totally destroyed. Debris is scattered across the system, suggesting that whatever civilization once lived here was obliterated in a violent struggle.

A battleship patrols the system. It is not responding to our hails, and it's set on an intercept course for the [Root.GetName], its weapons systems charging up.

federations2.3.desc.zh:
我们位于[From.Planet.GetName]的科研团队发现了一系列的完整的数据核心，记录了大约一千年前的这个星球上的居民——和乐族——当时他们的文明正处于鼎盛时期。很明显，和乐文明确实是非常先进的——有能力根据意愿塑造整个恒星星系。

[From.Planet.GetName]的卫星，最初是围绕着恒星系的气体巨行星运行的，被作为一件精心设计的艺术品拖入了它们当前的位置。达拉德——在[From.Planet.GetName]对面的那个粉碎的行星。被改造成和乐星的一个几乎相同但无人居住的克隆体，作为一个自然保护区：提醒人们他们的家园曾经是怎样的。

尽管出现了这些奇迹，我们却没有发现任何证据表明和乐族拥有军事能力。事实上，他们似乎对任何发生在他们自己空间之外的事情都漠不关心。
federations2.3.desc.en:
Our scientist team on [From.Planet.GetName] have found a series of intact data cores depicting the inhabitants of the planet - the Shallarians - when their civilization was at its peak, around a thousand years ago. It is clear the Shallarians were very advanced indeed - capable of moulding entire solar systems to their will.

The moons of [From.Planet.GetName] originally orbited the system's gas giants, and were dragged into their current positions as an elaborate work of art. Darad - the shattered planet opposite [From.Planet.GetName] - was extensively terraformed to be a near-identical but uninhabited clone to Shallash, serving as a nature reserve: a reminder of how their homeworld had once been.

Despite all these marvels, no mention has been found of the Shallarians' military capabilities. Indeed, they appear to have cared little for anything happening beyond the confines of their own space...

federations2.4.B.zh: 他们对和平的尝试是正确的。
federations2.4.B.en: They were right to strive for peace.

federations2.4.desc.zh: [Root.Leader.GetTitle][Root.Leader.GetName]已经能够进一步剖析和乐族文明。他们似乎是一个特别爱好和平的物种。尽管在星系舞台上有明显的相反的证据，但他们认为太空文明之间的战争是不可想象的和不合逻辑的。毕竟，他们自己的技术进步将物质极大丰富带到了触手可及的范围——如果什么都有了，他们还能想要什么呢？因此，他们忽视了建设自己的军事力量，使自己处于弱势。然而，目前还没有发现任何线索表明是谁想要破坏他们建造的东西。
federations2.4.desc.en: [Root.Leader.GetTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] has been able to shed further light on the Shallarian civilization. It seems they were an exceptionally peaceful species who - in spite of clear evidence to the contrary on the galactic stage - considered war between spacefaring civilizations to be inconceivable and illogical. After all, their own technological progress had brought post-scarcity to within their reach - what more could they possibly want? Consequently, they rather neglected building up their military forces, leaving themselves vulnerable. However, nothing yet uncovered offers any clues as to who may have wished to destroy what they had built.

federations2.50.A.tooltip.zh:
所有能前往[Root.Capital.System.GetName]星系的成员国均会被邀请参与联合行动。

如果他们接受，他们必须投入资源建造纪念碑，这会增加联邦经验和[Root.GetName]的影响力。

[Root.GetName]还可以选择在两个成员国中提升[Root.GetHegemonyEthos]的吸引力。

如果这一提议遭到广泛拒绝，联邦团结度将会下降，[Root.GetName]会损失影响力。
federations2.50.A.tooltip.en:
All member states with access to the [Root.Capital.System.GetName] system will be approached to take part in the joint operation.

If they accept, they will have to dedicate resources to a monument which will boost Federation Experience and the [Root.GetName]'s Influence.

The [Root.GetName] will also be able to choose to increase [Root.GetHegemonyEthos] attraction in two member states.

If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation Cohesion will decrease and the [Root.GetName] will lose Influence.

federations2.50.B.en: We have no need for such trinkets.

federations2.50.desc.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]在我国的明智领导下繁荣昌盛。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如今感到是时候因我们为盟友提供的服务获得回报了，我们将举办一场团结盛典——更确切地说，是为向联邦无私奉献的伟大[Root.GetAdj]领袖们举办的盛典。他们提议各成员国合作在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一道丰碑，于此同时，我们将派遣代表团前往两个成员国的首都，协助他们为[Root.Federation.GetName]带来更多的凝聚力。
federations2.50.desc.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] has prospered under the wise leadership of our nation. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] now feel that it is time for our services to the alliance to be paid back with a celebration of its unity - and more specifically, the great [Root.GetAdj] leaders that have done so much for it. They propose that member states contribute towards the erection of a grand monument in the skies above [Root.Capital.GetName], while in the meantime we send delegations to two member states' capitals to aid them in their efforts to bring greater unity to the [Root.Federation.GetName].

federations2.50.name.zh: 联邦团结暨领导力盛典
federations2.50.name.en: A Celebration of Unity and Leadership

federations2.51.A.tooltip.zh:
所有能前往[From.Capital.System.GetName]星系的成员国均会被邀请参与联合行动。

如果他们接受，他们必须投入资源建造纪念碑，这会增加联邦经验和[From.GetName]的影响力。

[From.GetName]还可以选择在两个成员国中提升[From.GetHegemonyEthos]的吸引力。
federations2.51.A.tooltip.en:
All member states with access to the [From.Capital.System.GetName] system will be approached to take part in the joint operation.

If they accept, they will have to dedicate resources to a monument which will boost Federation Experience and the [From.GetName]'s Influence.

The [From.GetName] will also be able to choose to increase [From.GetHegemonyEthos] attraction in two member states.

federations2.51.A.tooltip2.zh: 完成纪念碑将花费[Root.GetName]£minerals£矿物年产量的10%。
federations2.51.A.tooltip2.en: Completing the monument will cost 10% of the [Root.GetName]'s £minerals£ mineral output for 1 year.

federations2.51.B.zh: 在贵国首都树立丰碑？绝对不行！
federations2.51.B.en: A monument over your capital? Absolutely not!

federations2.51.B.tooltip.zh: 如果这一提议遭到广泛拒绝，联邦团结度将会下降。
federations2.51.B.tooltip.en: If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation Cohesion will decrease.

federations2.51.desc.zh:
你们好，尊贵的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]！在我们明智而宽宥的领导下，[Root.Federation.GetName]的实力与日俱增，我们共同目标遍及星海。是时候庆祝我们联合起来取得的成就了。还有什么会比各成员国合力在我国首都树立一座丰碑更合宜呢？与此同时，我国会派遣代表团前往贵国首都，协助你们求取[Root.Federation.GetName]的上上善道。

你们愿意加入这次活动吗？
federations2.51.desc.en:
Greetings, noble [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]! Under our wise and magnanimous leadership, the [Root.Federation.GetName] has gone from strength to strength, projecting our unity of purpose across the galaxy. The time has come to celebrate our joint successes as a union. What better way to do this than through a grand monument over our capital, erected through the efforts of the member states? In the meantime, we will send a delegation to your capital, which will aid your efforts to strive for the greater good of the [Root.Federation.GetName].

Will you join this venture?

federations2.53.A.zh: 他们如此缺乏信念，令人不安。

federations2.53.desc.zh: 我国大使就我国的团结盛典计划与[Root.Federation.GetName]各成员国进行了商洽。不幸的是，他们对这件事的看法似乎与我们不同，我们没能获得计划推进所必需的支持。
federations2.53.desc.en: Our ambassadors have approached the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] with our plans for a celebration of unity. Unfortunately, it seems that they do not feel the same way about the matter as we do, and we have been unable to muster sufficient support for the plan to proceed.

federations2.54.A.no.zh: 是时候在联盟内先破后立了。
federations2.54.A.no.en: Perhaps it is time to shake things up in this alliance.

federations2.54.desc.said_no.zh: 我们对[Root.Federation.GetName]中[From.GetAdj]专横的联合行动计划的反对有了成效。震惊于这项计划打算在成员国间播撒[From.GetAdj]宣传，这项提议被各方广泛回绝。
federations2.54.desc.said_no.en: Our opposition to the overbearing [From.GetAdj] plans for a joint operation in the [Root.Federation.GetName] has borne fruit. Appalled at the plans for missions to spread [From.GetAdj] propaganda among the member states, the proposals were roundly rejected by all parties.

federations2.54.desc.said_yes.zh: 尽管有我们为[From.GetAdj]举办[Root.Federation.GetName]团结盛典的提议背书，这项计划似乎还是失败了。失败原因是其他成员国不愿提供足够支持。
federations2.54.desc.said_yes.en: Despite our backing for the [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold a celebration of the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s unity, it seems that the plan has fallen through. There was simply not enough support for it among the other member states.

federations2.55.desc.zh: 我们关于举办一场联合盛典，庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的力量与团结的计划已获大多数成员国认可。我们将立刻开始致力于实施这项计划，增进联盟内的和谐。
federations2.55.desc.en: Our initiative to hold a joint celebration of the strength and unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has met with approval among the majority of members. We will begin work on implementing our plans to spread harmony within the alliance immediately!

federations2.56.desc.invalid.zh:
为了向[From.GetName]在[Root.Federation.GetName]中提供的强力领导致以敬意，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经得到成员国认可，举行一场关于联盟团结的联合庆典。成员国同意投入资源，在[From.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一座丰碑，同时[From.GetAdj]代表团将访问若干国家的首都，协助成员国融入联盟。

由于我国位置偏远，很难前往[From.Capital.GetName]，我们无法参与这一计划。
federations2.56.desc.invalid.en:
In honor of the strong leadership offered by the [From.GetName] in the [Root.Federation.GetName], the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have secured approval among its members for a joint celebration of our alliance's unity. Member states have agreed to dedicate resources to a grand monument in the skies above [From.Capital.GetName], while [From.GetAdj] delegations will visit various capitals to aid the integration of the member states into the alliance.

Given our remote location, with no easy access to [From.Capital.GetName], we are unable to participate in the scheme.

federations2.56.desc.said_no.zh: 尽管我国反对，[Root.Federation.GetName]中[From.GetAdj]专横的联合行动计划得到了大多数成员国的认可。幸好，[From.GetName]无法强迫我国参与这项计划。
federations2.56.desc.said_no.en: Despite our opposition, overbearing [From.GetAdj] plans for a joint operation in the [Root.Federation.GetName] have met with approval among the majority of members. Fortunately, there is nothing the [From.GetName] can do to force us to participate in the scheme.

federations2.56.desc.said_yes.zh: [From.GetAdj]关于举办一场联合盛典，庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的力量与团结的计划已获大多数成员国认可。我们将立即开始工作，以便计划早日落实！
federations2.56.desc.said_yes.en: The [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold a joint celebration of the strength and unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has met with approval among the majority of members. We will begin work to make the plans a reality immediately!

federations2.57.desc.zh: 我们派去[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]宣扬[Root.GetHegemonyEthos]理想的代表团已于[FromFrom.GetName]落脚。幸运的话，他们的努力会有回报，[Root.Federation.GetName]内将更为和谐。
federations2.57.desc.en: Our delegation to spread [Root.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] has established itself on [FromFrom.GetName]. With luck, their efforts will bear fruit and increase harmony within the [Root.Federation.GetName].

federations2.58.A.good.en: Surely only good can come of this.

federations2.58.A.neutral.en: We'll see what comes of this...

federations2.58.desc.zh: 作为当前联邦联合行动的一部分，[From.Owner.GetAdj][From.Owner.GetGovernmentName]已经派出代表团前往[FromFrom.GetName]，以在[Root.GetName]宣扬[From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos]理想。尽管他们宣称这是为了在[Root.Federation.GetName]内增进和谐与善意，许多人担忧我们自己的价值观会因我们在联邦中的成员国资格受损。
federations2.58.desc.en: As part of the current federation joint operations, the [From.Owner.GetAdj] [From.Owner.GetGovernmentName] has sent delegates to [FromFrom.GetName] to spread [From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [Root.GetName]. Although they claim to be promoting harmony and goodwill within the [Root.Federation.GetName], many are concerned that our own values are being compromised by our membership in the alliance.

federations2.58.desc.good.zh: 作为当前联邦联合行动的一部分，[From.Owner.GetAdj][From.Owner.GetGovernmentName]已经派出代表团前往[FromFrom.GetName]，以在[Root.GetName]宣扬[From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos]理想。幸好，他们的价值观念与我们一致，相信这一定会增进[Root.Federation.GetName]内的和谐与善意。
federations2.58.desc.good.en: As part of the current federation joint operations, the [From.Owner.GetAdj] [From.Owner.GetGovernmentName] has sent delegates to [FromFrom.GetName] to spread [From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [Root.GetName]. Fortunately, their values align well with our own, lending credence to their claim to be promoting harmony and goodwill within the [Root.Federation.GetName].

federations2.59.A.tooltip.zh: 在所有成员国贡献完成后，联邦将收到经验增益。
federations2.59.A.tooltip.en: Once all members have completed their contributions, the Federation will gain an experience boost.

federations2.59.desc.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结及[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。他们对我们的付出表示感谢，但在纪念碑正式揭幕前尚需等待我们的联邦盟友完成贡献。
federations2.59.desc.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName], celebrating the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. They thank us for our offering, although they await the contributions of our federation allies before the monument is officially unveiled.

federations2.6.D.zh: 我们在这里的工作结束了。

federations2.6.desc.afe.zh:
[Root.Leader.GetName]已经揭示了和乐族文明陨落的真相。他们似乎在几百年里都过着平静的生活，直到[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的崛起打破了他们的美梦。就像现在一样，[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个暴力的、侵略性的、扩张主义的种族。在他们第一次接触时，和乐族认为[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是无知和不文明的暴发户，需要指导；[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]视整个和乐族的前景为诅咒。他们对这种乌托邦式的和平主义的恐惧是如此之大，以至于他们决定必须把和乐族文明从星系中抹去。由于他们的受害者没有军队，随后的战争既短暂又残酷。当这一行动完成后，[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]离开了，留下了一个自动化的守卫，以确保没有幸存者可以回来并恢复他们如此憎恨的文明。

除了这些记录之外，[Root.Leader.GetName]还发现了一个数据核心，解释了和乐族的环境改造方法。他们在这方面的技术比我们先进得多，所以这方面的知识一定会使我们的帝国受益。
federations2.6.desc.afe.en:
[Root.Leader.GetName] has uncovered the truth of the Shallarian demise. It seems that they lived in peace for hundreds of years, before the rise of the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took them by surprise. Then, as now, the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were a violently aggressive expansionist race. pon their first encounter with each other, the Shallarians considered the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to be ignorant and uncivilized upstarts in need of guidance; the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] saw the entire Shallarian outlook as anathema. So great was their horror at the concept this utopian pacifism that they resolved the Shallarians must be wiped from the face of the galaxy. Since their victims had no military, the ensuing war was as short as it was brutal. When the deed was done, the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] left behind an automated guardian to ensure that no survivors could return and thus revive the civilization they so hated.

In addition to these records, [Root.Leader.GetName] found a data core explaining Shallarian terraforming methods. Their technology in this field is far superior to our own, so this knowledge will surely benefit our empire.

federations2.6.desc.fe.zh:
[Root.Leader.GetName]已经揭示了和乐族文明陨落的真相。他们似乎在[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesName]帝国崛起之前的几百年里都过着平静的生活，而后者让他们措手不及。这与今天[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetName]颓废和厌倦的生活大为不同。在那个时代，[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个暴力的、侵略性的、扩张主义的种族。

在他们第一次接触时，和乐族认为[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是无知和不文明的暴发户，需要指导；[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]视整个和乐族的前景为诅咒。他们对这种乌托邦式的和平主义的恐惧是如此之大，以至于他们决定必须把和乐族文明从星系中抹去。由于他们的受害者没有军队，随后的战争既短暂又残酷。当这一事迹完成后，[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]离开了，留下了一个自动化的守卫，以确保没有幸存者可以回来并恢复他们如此憎恨的文明。

除了这些记录之外，[Root.Leader.GetName]还发现了一个数据核心，解释了和乐族的环境改造方法。他们在这方面的技术比我们先进得多，所以这方面的知识一定会使我们的帝国受益。
federations2.6.desc.fe.en:
[Root.Leader.GetName] has uncovered the truth of the Shallarian demise. It seems that they lived in peace for hundreds of years before the rise of the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesName] Empire took them by surprise. A far cry from the decadent and weary [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetName] of today, in that era the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were a violently aggressive expansionist race.

Upon their first encounter with each other, the Shallarians considered the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to be ignorant and uncivilized upstarts in need of guidance; the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] saw the entire Shallarian outlook as anathema. So great was their horror at this utopian pacifism that they resolved the Shallarians must be wiped from the face of the galaxy. Since their victims had no military, the ensuing war was as short as it was brutal. When the deed was done, the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] left behind an automated guardian to ensure that no survivors could return and thus revive the civilization they so hated.

In addition to these records, [Root.Leader.GetName] found a data core explaining Shallarian terraforming methods. Their technology in this field is far superior to our own, so this knowledge will surely benefit our empire.

federations2.60.A.oh_well.en: At least we did our part.

federations2.60.desc.complete_success.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明而庄严的领导。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$
federations2.60.desc.complete_success.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the august and enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. $hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$

federations2.60.desc.partial_failure.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。不过，我们的盟友似乎不如我们这般支持这项提案，大多数成员国除了空话以外再无贡献。最终的纪念碑了无趣味——与其说是反映了联盟的共同感和力量，不如说是尴尬地象征着同盟间的分歧。
federations2.60.desc.partial_failure.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. However, it seems that our allies did not support the initiative as strongly as we did, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

federations2.60.desc.partial_success.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。$hegemony_federation_monument_partial_success$
federations2.60.desc.partial_success.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. $hegemony_federation_monument_partial_success$

federations2.61.A.oh_dear.zh: 也许是时候先破后立了。
federations2.61.A.oh_dear.en: Perhaps it is time for a shake-up.

federations2.61.desc.complete_failure.zh: 由[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提议，在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”和“开明领导”的计划今天已被正式取消。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_failure$
federations2.61.desc.complete_failure.en: Plans for a monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the "enlightened leadership" offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have officially been cancelled today. $hegemony_federation_monument_complete_failure$

federations2.61.desc.complete_success.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明而庄严的领导的工作已经完成。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$
federations2.61.desc.complete_success.en: Work has been completed on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the august and enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. $hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$

federations2.61.desc.partial_failure.but.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导的工作已经完成。不过，我们的盟友似乎不如我们这般支持这项提案，大多数成员国除了空话以外再无贡献。最终的纪念碑了无趣味——与其说是反映了联盟的共同感和力量，不如说是尴尬地象征着同盟间的分歧。

federations2.61.desc.partial_failure.hah.zh: 我国盟友在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的“开明领导”的工作已经完成。不过，对这项提案的支持不如[FromFrom.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望的那样有力，大多数成员国除了空话以外再无贡献。最终的纪念碑了无趣味——与其说是反映了联盟的共同感和力量，不如说是尴尬地象征着同盟间的分歧。
federations2.61.desc.partial_failure.hah.en: Our allies have finished their work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the "enlightened leadership" offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. It seems that commitment to the initiative was not as strong as the [FromFrom.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] had hoped, however, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

federations2.62.A.good.zh: 有了我们的领导，所有人都更为强大。
federations2.62.A.good.en: Under our leadership, all are stronger.

federations2.62.A.oh_dear.zh: 也许依赖我们的盟友是个错误。
federations2.62.A.oh_dear.en: Perhaps we were wrong to rely on our allies.

federations2.62.desc.complete_failure.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”及我们的“开明领导”的计划今天已被正式取消。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_failure$

The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.
