federations2.7.desc.zh:
$federations2.7.desc.base$

除了这些记录之外，[Root.Leader.GetName]还发现了一个数据核心，解释了和乐族对计算技术的创新。虽然他们的命运可能警告我们要小心，但他们的知识可能对我们有益。
federations2.7.desc.en:
$federations2.7.desc.base$

In addition to these records, [Root.Leader.GetName] found a data core explaining the innovations the Shallarians had made to their computing technology. Although their fate may warn us to caution, their knowledge may yet be of benefit to us.

federations2.7.desc.machine.zh:
$federations2.7.desc.base$

尽管机器没有情感——如果我们有，我们会被和乐族的愚蠢逗乐，并庆祝我们自己的程序相对于他们还是优越的。
federations2.7.desc.machine.en:
$federations2.7.desc.base$

Although a machine has no emotions: if we did, we would be amused at the folly of the Shallarians, and would celebrate the superiority of our own programming compared to theirs.

federations2.7.desc.synth.zh:
$federations2.7.desc.base$

我们只能嘲笑和乐族的愚蠢，并庆祝我们自己的程序相对于他们还是优越的。
federations2.7.desc.synth.en:
$federations2.7.desc.base$

We can only laugh at the folly of the Shallarians, and celebrate the superiority of our own programming compared to theirs.

federations2.70.A.en: The old king is dead; long live the king.

federations2.70.desc.zh: 由于联邦领袖的变更，旧有的歌颂[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]统治者的计划已被搁置。
federations2.70.desc.en: With the change in federation leadership, the old plans to glorify the rulers of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have been duly shelved.

federations2.701.desc.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古远征队。由于高水平的放射性物质，我们不得不采取预防辐射中毒的措施。然而，一次在考古学家挖掘的地点的泄露似乎造成了严重的恐慌。[Root.Leader.GetName]和[Root.Leader.GetHerHis]的团队不得不暂停挖掘工作，直到辐射恢复到安全水平。
federations2.701.desc.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has been forced to take precautions against radiation poisoning due to the high levels of radioactivity on the ruined planet. However, it seems that a leak has caused a significant scare on the site where the archaeologists were excavating. [Root.Leader.GetName] and [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] team have had to pause excavations until radiation can be restored to safe levels.

federations2.702.desc.zh: 我们的考古学家在[From.System.GetName]星系不经意间引起了隐藏在小行星带的前哨船只的注意。我们不确定为什么它一直保持隐蔽到现在。可能是它的传感器出故障了？我们可以确定的是现在它已经苏醒了，并且它的武器系统正在激活！
federations2.702.desc.en: Our archaeologists in the [From.System.GetName] system have inadvertently drawn the attention of a sentinel ship concealed in the asteroid belt. We are not sure why it had remained hidden until now. Perhaps its sensors had malfunctioned? What is certain is that it is awake now, and its weapons systems are activating!

federations2.702.name.zh: 隐蔽的前哨船只被激活

federations2.71.desc.zh: 由于我们已经脱离了旧有的联邦，在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑以庆祝同盟凝聚力的计划与我们再无关联。
federations2.71.desc.en: As we have left our old federation, plans to construct a monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the alliance are no longer relevant to us.

federations2.72.desc.zh: 由于[FromFrom.GetName]不再是我们联邦的中心，旧有的歌颂该行星统治者的计划已经搁置。
federations2.72.desc.en: As [FromFrom.GetName] is no longer the center of our federation, the old plans to glorify the planet's rulers have been duly shelved.

federations2.8.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上不断地有奇怪的事件被报道。很显然有大量的个人在大街上跳舞，持续数小时甚至是一天到晚。他们拒绝停下来直到生理上的力竭。

至今，这种现象只影响了人口的相对一小部分，我们的当局政府尚未建立应对方案。
federations2.8.desc.en:
Strange occurrences have been reported among the colonists on [Root.GetName]. Apparently many individuals have taken to dancing on the streets for hours and even days on end, refusing to stop until they are physically restrained.

So far, it has only affected a relatively small portion of the population, and our authorities have yet to establish a pattern.

federations2.9.A.zh: 这绝不是自然的！我们必须找到是什么在折磨他们。
federations2.9.A.en: This is not natural! We must find out what is afflicting them.

federations2.9.B.zh: 音乐响起——这是派对的时间了！
federations2.9.B.en: Start the music - it's party time!

federations2.9.desc.zh: 从自发孤立的现象开始，这种[Root.GetName]上不断延续的舞蹈已经升级到了某种[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]数百人成群结队的舞蹈，现在甚至还强迫性的出现了各式不同的舞姿。令人惊讶的是，许多本来从未对舞蹈有任何兴趣的人突然就有了表演专业动作的能力。尽管许多居民揶揄地将之称为“舞蹈瘟疫”，但这绝不是开玩笑的事——舞蹈者对他们的生理需求不管不顾，冒着生命风险舞蹈直至死亡。
federations2.9.desc.en: The isolated incidents of spontaneous, prolonged dancing on [Root.GetName] have escalated somewhat, and groups of hundreds of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are now compulsively dancing in a variety of different styles. Surprisingly, even those who have never shown much interest in dancing are suddenly able to perform expert moves, and the old among them have rediscovered the vigor of their youth. Although many residents are jokingly referring to it as the 'Dancing Plague', it is no joking matter - the dancers show no concern for their bodily needs, and risk dancing themselves to death.

federations3.100.a.zh: 一种有用的资源，现在是我们的了。
federations3.100.a.en: A valuable resource, ours to exploit.

federations3.100.b.zh: 它罕见的美将会被所有人共同欣赏。
federations3.100.b.en: Its rare beauty should be left for all to enjoy.

federations3.100.desc.zh:
初看，[From.GetName]上的一切都似乎平淡无奇。只有当[Root.GetName]上的一位科学家在一次偶然的观测中发现地表之下有一块巨大棱镜在反射星光。扫描仪很快对物体进行了辨识，它的宽度几乎相当于一座中等大小的岛屿。

探针遥测表明，构成该棱镜的化学物质具有非常高的价值；其物理结构可能在我们星系内也是独一无二的。
federations3.100.desc.en:
At first glance, everything about [From.GetName] seemed routine and normal. Only during a chance alignment did a scientist aboard the [Root.GetName] notice starlight reflecting off a vast lens near the surface below. Scanners were quickly trained upon the crystalline object, whose breadth is that of a moderately-sized island.

Probe telemetry suggests the chemical make-up of this lens is highly valuable; its physical structure may also be unique within our galaxy.

federations3.1005.desc.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上最新建设计划被深层地陷打断了。伤亡不大，并且我们的基础设施没有受到太大影响。然而该地质活动揭露了一座地下交通网络的一角。尴尬的测量师们已经开始勘察这些突然出现的隧道。似乎这属于[From.Planet.GetName]过去的历史……
federations3.1005.desc.en: Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of a network of transportation tunnels. Embarrassed surveyors have already begun looking into their sudden appearance. It would seem [From.Planet.GetName] has a prior history...

federations3.1010.desc.zh:
发掘进行没多久，设计更为错综、建造更加牢靠的隧道和设备就显露了出来。宽轨铁轨与卧铺列车保存状况良好，周围还有各式各样的遗物以及扔了几个世纪的垃圾。

在这些残骸中留有各种经过精心阳极氧化处理的引擎和信号设施部件，和维修站里会有的东西一样。所有部件上都刻有精致而复杂的几何图样，或许这其中有高级的艺术技巧，甚至曾令人引以为豪。
federations3.1010.desc.en:
It wasn't long before our excavations revealed tunnels and equipment of sturdier construction and more intricate design. Heavy-gauge rails and sleepers lie preserved and intact, surrounded by myriad relics and centuries-old garbage.

Amongst the debris lie various precisely-anodized pieces of engine and signalling equipment, such as one might find in a maintenance depot. All are inscribed in singular detail with complex, geometric patterns - suggesting high levels of artistry and perhaps even pride.

federations3.1015.desc.zh:
我们在对一条狭窄辅道试探性发掘时，找到了一个死去多时的爬行动物，死因是大约800年前发生的顶板塌陷。遗体出现在这条隧道里的原因一开始是个谜题，但我们在对其身上携带的许多武器进行研究后找到了答案。

发现的带刃工具中有许多挂在一顶装饰性盾牌的内侧，制造这些工具的技术和我们比起来只能算原始，但却与在隧道轨路上使用的技术明显不同。这位带着盾牌的来访者如同我们一样，并不属于这颗星球，而且看起来还在进行与我们类似的考古研究，直至在隧道中丧生为止。
federations3.1015.desc.en:
Our chance excavation of a narrow side-tunnel has revealed a long-dead reptilian occupant, whose demise by ceiling collapse dates back some 800 years. Their presence in this tunnel was something of a puzzle, solved only when we completed a study of the many weapons found on their person.

The technology underlying these bladed implements - many of which were mounted on the inside of a decorative targe - is primitive compared to our own, yet markedly different to that used on the railroad. This targe-bearing visitor was as alien to this world as we are, and they seem to have been conducting similar archaeological research - that is, before the tunnel claimed their life.

federations3.1020.desc.zh:
负盾者的记录把我们带到了一座变电站，这座变电站曾经用于维持这个维修场。看起来他们的探险打破了该设施的气密封印；这里很少有腐烂的迹象。布满灰尘的电缆管道在几十个监视器周围形成柱廊。正是在这样一个通道上，我们发现了残留的来自另一感性物种的遗迹。

负盾者的探险队称这是一群软体动物技术人员——他们仍然保存完好的尸体挤在一起，以相互保护或取暖。记录中还记录了两次试图重新启动这个有千年历史的变电站的尝试，但使用的工具都不如我们的。我们有机会完成这项工作，这样做会使进一步的挖掘工作更容易。
federations3.1020.desc.en:
The Targe-bearer's notes have led us to an electrical substation which once served this maintenance yard. It looks like their expedition broke an atmospheric seal on the facility; there are comparatively few signs of decay here. Dust-covered cable ducts form colonnades around dozens of monitors. It is down one such aisle of monitors that we found trace remains from sentients of a different species.

The Targe-bearer's expedition described this as a group of molluscoid technicians - their still-preserved bodies huddled together for mutual protection or warmth. The records also note two attempts to restart the millennia-old substation, using tools which are inferior to ours. There's a chance we could complete this effort - and in so doing, make further excavation much easier.

federations3.1021.desc.zh:
就在我们利用一台便携式相位发生器，从[From.Planet.GetName]上启动变电站的几分钟后，该设施突然响起刺耳的警报。几秒钟后，就在我们的挖掘小组工作的地方，部分天花板和铁路旁边的一段墙壁坍塌了。

故障已经被追踪到一个我们以为它是不相连的腐蚀的电阻器线圈。这一疏忽造成了几人受伤，并决定了我们挖掘队十多名队员的命运；他们现在正步上了负盾者的悲惨的后尘。
federations3.1021.desc.en:
Mere minutes after we jump-started the substation on [From.Planet.GetName] using a portable phase generator, the facility erupted with piercing alarms. Seconds later, part of the ceiling and a section of wall adjoining the railroad collapsed, right where our excavation team was working.

The fault has been traced to a corroded resistor coil, which we'd thought disconnected. This oversight caused several injuries and has sealed the fates of a dozen members of our dig team; they now follow in the Targe-bearer's tragic footsteps.

federations3.1022.desc.zh:
这个变电站遗迹的复杂性让我们吃惊。我们用一台便携式相位发生器启动了它，但随之而来的爆炸活动导致我们周围有千年历史的建筑部分坍塌。

幸运的是，我们的队伍得到了足够的预警，找到了避险处。他们发现一些地区现在已经被完全封锁，但一些新的地区已经取而代之地开放。
federations3.1022.desc.en:
This relic of a substation has surprised us with its complexity. We jump-started it using a portable phase generator, but the ensuing burst of activity caused parts of the millennia-old structure around us to collapse.

Fortunately our team had sufficient warning to find shelter. They emerged to find some areas now firmly closed off, but some new areas have opened in their stead.

federations3.1026.a.zh: 带回这些记录回我们的母星作进一步研究。
federations3.1026.a.en: Bring these records back to our homeworld for further study.

federations3.1026.desc.zh:
我们对这个挖掘地点的意外“改造”暴露了一条长距离的铁路隧道，根据我们破译的控制面板，一列火车躺在那里，隐藏在侧边。同时，这个系统也对列车应用了不同的优先级标记，包括一个我们称之为“仓库”的词。

因为很少有一个关键的人工制品以这样大的形式出现在我们面前，我们派去一个团队让火车再次启动。古董火车头本身就是一件足够优雅的工程，但它背后每一辆精心装饰的汽车都被证明是一座博物馆。

火车最好被理解为一个漫游的时间胶囊，随时准备被移动到安全的地方。三千年来，它保存了整个现在我们知道他们管自己叫做叫做皮耶普的文化的历史、文化和科学记录。
federations3.1026.desc.en:
Our accidental remodelling of this dig site exposed a long-distance rail tunnel down which - according to the control panels we deciphered - a train lay, tucked away in sidings. Those same systems had applied various priority markers to the train, including a word we've identified as 'repository.'

A team was dispatched to get the train moving again, for rarely does a key artifact come to us in a form as large as this. The antique locomotive is an elegant enough piece of engineering in itself, but every one of the elaborately-decorated cars behind it has proven to be a museum in its own right.

The train may best be described as a roaming time capsule, ever ready to be moved out of harm's way. For 3,000 years it has preserved the historical, cultural and scientific records of an entire culture, whom we now learn called themselves the Peeyeps.

federations3.1027.desc.zh:
我们对这个挖掘地点的意外改造暴露了一个货场，它是从一个巨大的拱形洞穴屋顶下凿出来的。在它众多巨大而空无一人的仓库中，只有留下了一个安全封条没有启封；在重新打开的时候，我们发现了更多的负盾者的尸体。他们来这里寻找补给，却与一个有千年历史的警报系统发生冲突。

根据他们留下的日志，这个巡回的芬鲁尼尔远征队正在调查[From.Planet.GetName]是否为宜居世界。他们没有料到会在这里发现废墟。由于没有受过训练，对考古学也不感兴趣，他们对遗址进行了彻底的搜查，而不是进行调查。

那些在仓库里挨饿的人用特别生动的语言指出，他们的同志把大量的物资运到货船上，几乎没留下什么。我们自己的调查证实，尽管有大量的古董机器，但几乎没有什么东西能告诉我们这些神秘的铁路建造者是谁。
federations3.1027.desc.en:
Our accidental remodelling of this dig site has exposed a goods yard, hewn from under a vast and vaulted cave roof. Of its many vast and vacant warehouses, only one had its security seals tripped; upon re-opening it we found the remains of more of the Targe-bearer's people. They had come seeking supplies, only to fall foul of a millennia-old alarm system.

According to the logs they left behind, this itinerant 'Fenrunir Expeditionary Group' was investigating [From.Planet.GetName] as part of a habitable worlds survey. They hadn't anticipated finding ruins here. Untrained and uninterested in archaeology, they ransacked the site rather than investigating it.

Those who met with starvation inside the warehouse note - in particularly colorful language - that their comrades removed a great deal of material to their freighters, leaving little behind. Our own surveys confirm that although there is an abundance of antique machinery, little else remains to tell us who the enigmatic railroad-builders were.

federations3.1030.desc.zh:
来自[From.From.Planet.GetName]的铁路建造者留下的记录告诉我们这群狂热的软体动物是如何逃离他们对恐惧科技的家园，通过机械化的努力来寻求更好的自我。他们撤退到一个神秘而遥远的地下洞穴网络，后来通过铁路隧道连接和扩大了它们的栖息地。

由于担心他们的文化有一天会被猎杀和消灭，皮耶普人为了安全在地下修建。在接下来的200年里，他们的社会发展缓慢，在此期间，他们的家乡的政府变得更加孤立和偏执。一次激进的转变就促使他们以前所未有的规模进行军事化；就在这时，编年史突然结束了。

即使有了随后的负盾者自己不完整的发现，我们也只能推测两国人民的悲惨命运。进一步的考古证据要么丢失了，要么没有记录下来；现在唯一剩下的就是他们的隧道，他们的记录和他们的火车。
federations3.1030.desc.en:
The records left by the railroad-builders of [From.From.Planet.GetName] tell how this fervent band of molluscoids fled their technophobic homeland, seeking to better themselves through mechanical endeavor. They retreated to a secret and distant network of underground caves, later linking and expanding their habitats by means of railroad tunnels.

Fearful that their very culture may one day be hunted and eradicated, the Peeyeps built deep - for security and preservation. Their society grew slowly over the next 200 years, during which time their homeland's government turned more insular and paranoid. A single, radical swing provoked them into militarization on an unprecedented scale; at this point the chronicle ends abruptly.

Even with the Targe-bearer's own subsequent, patchy findings, we can only speculate upon the tragic fates of both peoples. Further archaeological evidence has either been lost or gone unrecorded; all that remains of the Peeyeps now are their tunnels, their records and their trains.

federations3.115.desc.zh:
绝大多数[From.GetName]地表的景观确乎是运用了某种形式的美学设计。我们的科学家猜想即使是星球其余的“处女地”也不过是为了满足一个更广阔的园艺目标而被刻意雕琢成那样的。

在我们进一步的调查过程中，我们碰巧发现了一座信标，这是这整颗星球上唯一一个科技存在的例证。启动这座信标时，它上传了一份包含[From.GetName]上所有动植物品种的目录，以及一个指向邻近的[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]的参考指针。但仍没有任何用来找到这颗行星的设计者的线索。
federations3.115.desc.en:
Some form of aesthetic design has been employed over most of the surface landscape on [From.GetName]. Our scientists suspect that even the remaining, 'untouched' areas are merely crafted wilderness - there to serve a wider horticultural goal.

Towards the conclusion of our research, we stumbled across a beacon - the sole example of technology on this world. When activated, it uploaded a catalog of every plant and animal species found on [From.GetName], as well as a reference pointer to nearby [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]. No clue was left with which to identify the planet's designers.

federations3.121.a.response.zh:
我是这个称为[root.System.GetName]星系的自动监护机器。我代表此恒星系和其他所有奥隆帝国中$NAME_Gardeners$的利益。我的任务大致是保护及引导你周围的一切事物。

WAPP-715命令限制诸如[root.Planet.GetName]等阿卡摩尔级星球的工业化。只有你可以阻止大规模生物灭绝！
federations3.121.a.response.en:
I am the automated custodian of the system designated [root.System.GetName]. I represent the interests of the $NAME_Gardeners$, here and in other systems of the Auron Empire. My role is defined broadly as protector of - and guide to - all you see around you.

Directive WAPP-715 curtails the industrialization of Ackamore-class worlds such as designate [root.Planet.GetName]. Only you can prevent mass biome extinction!

federations3.121.b.zh: 无稽之谈。我们将按照我们认为合适的方式发展我们的殖民地。
federations3.121.b.en: Nonsense. We'll develop our colony as we see fit.

federations3.121.desc.zh:
访问者：欢迎来到$NAME_Wenkwort$。无论您是慕名已久还是故地重游，我们都非常乐意为您的花园之旅提供帮助。

谨代表$NAME_Gardeners$并根据WAPP-715号命令，请不要擅自闯入指定的$NAME_wenkwort_prime$生物区。不遵守我们的指引将会降低所有相关人员的生存机会。
federations3.121.desc.en:
Visiting entity: welcome to $NAME_Wenkwort$. Whether this visit is your first or your hundredth, we are glad to facilitate your appreciation of the gardens.

On behalf of the $NAME_Gardeners$ and in accordance with directive WAPP-715, I ask that you refrain from harsh intrusion upon the biota of planetary designate $NAME_wenkwort_prime$. Failure to comply with our guidelines will diminish the survival odds of all concerned.

federations3.125.desc.zh:
妙啊！指导方针将会立刻发送给你。

总之：WAPP-715命令允许对$NAME_Wenkwort$花园进行负责任的、非破坏性的使用。我们非常重视保护这些世界现有的特性，但是我们不希望扼杀在<错误：帝国信标超出范围>内部的发展。

<请求紧急监控部门派遣人员到坐标19c14a05……失败。重试……失败。重试…>
federations3.125.desc.en:
Splendid! Guidelines will be delivered to you imminently.

In summary: Directive WAPP-715 allows for responsible, non-destructive use of the $NAME_Wenkwort$ gardens. Great importance is attached to preserving these worlds' existing character, however we do not wish to stifle development within-<ERROR: imperial beacon out of range>.

<Requesting urgent Monitor Division dispatch to co-ordinates 19c14a05... Failed. Retrying... Failed. Retrying...>

federations3.130.desc.zh:
真令人失望。就这样吧。

<请求执法部门派遣人员到坐标—
<错误：无法找到帝国信标。还原至备份导航系统……成功。>
<执法部门已在途；预计在2个大周期后抵达。礼节协议暂停。>
federations3.130.desc.en:
How disappointing. So be it.

<Requesting Enforcer Division dispatch to co-ordinates-
<ERROR: imperial beacon could not be found. Reverting to backup navigation systems... Success.>
<Enforcer Division en route; estimated arrival 2 grand cycles. Courtesy protocols disengaged.>

federations3.131.a.zh: 我们接受你命令中的条款。
federations3.131.a.en: We accept the terms of your directive.

federations3.131.desc.zh:
入侵者：你仍明显违反WAPP-715命令，命令要求位于[root.Planet.GetName]的$NAME_Wenkwort$花园应以非破坏性方式使用。

这是你的最后一次机会，要么同意我方的指导方针，要么立即面临惩罚。
federations3.131.desc.en:
Intrusive entity: you remain in apparent violation of Directive WAPP-715, concerning the non-destructive use of the $NAME_Wenkwort$ gardens at designate [root.Planet.GetName].

This is your last opportunity to accede to our guidelines, or else face swift punishment.

federations3.135.human.desc.zh:
若非庞大的规模以及与[Owner.Capital.GetName]之间遥远的距离，[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]可能会被误认为是一座我们所建造的禅境。它的地表是一座宏大而风格独特的景观，点缀着无数小至卵石，大如陨星的岩石。我们的学者注意到，其水体与陆地的外观呈现具有一种算术精确性。虽然无碍美观，但其确实偏离了自然的形态，而更像一种刻意的模仿。

无论其来源几何，这颗精心雕琢的星球与最近其表现上涌现的$wenkwort_drone_plural$具有明确的关联。目前为止，追溯它们来源的努力仍未得出任何结果。

也许我们被引到这颗禅境星球是一种暗示，这意味着我们日益增长的问题会在适当的时候被解答。
federations3.135.human.desc.en:
Were it not for its sheer scale and remoteness from [Owner.Capital.GetName], [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName] might be mistaken for a zen garden of our own making. Its surface is a vast, stylized landscape punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids. Our scholars note an algorithmic precision to its apparent depictions of water and land. It remains decorative, but somehow divorced from natural forms - like a studied imitation.

Whatever its origin, there is a clear link between this sculpted world and the $wenkwort_drone_plural$ which recently emerged from its surface. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have, however, yielded no results.

Perhaps our being led to this zen planet is a hint - that answers to our growing stack of questions may reveal themselves in due time.

federations3.135.nonhuman.desc.zh:
[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]上巨大的几何形式显然不是自然形成的。这颗行星上别具一格的景观是无尽的沙海，上面点缀着无数小至卵石，大如陨星的岩石。

我们的研究院认为，这种景观应该是一种艺术作品，或是一种仪式的产品。然而，唯一可能造成这些的只有我们此前发现的$wenkwort_drone_plural$。目前为止，追溯它们来源的努力仍未得出任何结果。也许只能等待时间给我们答案……
federations3.135.nonhuman.desc.en:
The vast, geometric forms on [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName] are certainly not of natural origin. The planet's stylized landscape is reminiscent of a vast and dusty sea, punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids.

Our researchers conclude that this landscape is likely an art piece, or else is part of some ritual practice - however, the only perpetrators appear to be the $wenkwort_drone_plural$ we saw earlier. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have yielded no results. Perhaps time will tell...

federations3.2001.desc.zh:
我国各处的多个研究站探测到了以[root.Capital.GetName]的恒星基地为中心，超空间中存在的轻微变形。这一效应在“真空”中表现为局部的类极光现象，居住在恒星基地上的人员将其描述为一种色彩鲜艳的气态卷须，包裹着整个空间站。

此外，我们在[root.GetAllianceName]中的盟友报告称他们的首都星系出现了类似现象。总统[discloud_coordinator.ruler.GetRegnalName]已呼吁立即对此事开展合作调查。
federations3.2001.desc.en:
Various research stations across our empire have detected subtle distortions in hyperspace, centered upon the starbase at [root.Capital.GetName]. The effect presents in 'real space' as a localized aurora, which starbase inhabitants describe as brightly-colored, gaseous tendrils enveloping the station.

Furthermore: our allies in the [root.GetAllianceName] report similar phenomena in their capital systems. President [discloud_coordinator.ruler.GetRegnalName] has called for an immediate and coordinated investigation into this matter.

federations3.2010.blue.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$这些蓝色隆起似乎有些害羞难觅，在被直接观察到时总是躲回超空间之中。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.blue.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ These blue protruberances seem somehow elusive or shy, phasing back into hyperspace whenever they are observed directly.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.brown.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$它们深棕的色调通常并不透光；遮蔽了恒星基地上正常情况下能看到的灿烂星光。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.brown.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ Their deep brown hues seem unusually opaque; they obscure much of the starscape one would normally see from within the starbase.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.cyan.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$气体团内明晰的青色色调使其外表如同行星上的极光一般——不过它的色带会自发从曲线变幻成直角，如同要组成数码波一般。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.cyan.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ A vivid, cyan tint within the gas gives it the appearance of a planetary aurora - only its various bands will spontaneously switch from sweeping curves to right-angles, as though forming a digital wave.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.gray.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$它们存在的时间较长，其后留下似乎是灰色的烟迹。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.gray.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ They remain present for extended periods, leaving behind trails of what appears to be gray smoke.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.green.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$这些云看起来是生意盎然的绿色，这些蒸汽的移动似乎有目的性，以某种方式示意着什么。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.green.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ Appearing to us in vibrant green, these vapors' movements have been described as somehow beckoning and purposeful.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.indigo.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$云朵上清晰可辨的紫色“附肢”缓缓移动，专门瞄着恒星基地外表的各种部件，仿佛在对其进行评估。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.indigo.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ Each vivid, purple 'appendage' of the cloud moves slowly and purposefully to point at various features on the exterior of the starbase, as though appraising it.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.orange.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$这些体积很大的橙色弧状云团喜欢在我们恒星基地的下侧弯曲，使得恒星基地如同着火了一般。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.orange.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ These sweeping, orange curves will tend to curl around the underside of our starbase, giving it the appearance of being on fire.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.pink.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$这些朦胧的粉色蒸汽团据说很“顽皮”，会从偶然接近的舰船旁边快速逃开。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.pink.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ These pink and hazy vapors have been described as 'playful', skittering away from any ships which happen to approach.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.red.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$每朵云都略带红色，边缘凹凸不平，移动方式躁动。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.red.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ Each is tinged with red, appearing jagged at the edges - and they move in an agitated manner.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2010.yellow.desc.zh:
$federations3.2010.intro$每朵云都是黄色，边缘模糊不清。它们缓缓移动，如同被微风吹拂一般。

$federations3.2010.close$
federations3.2010.yellow.desc.en:
$federations3.2010.intro$ Each one appears yellow, with hazily-defined edges. The whisps move lethargically, as though caught in a gentle breeze.

$federations3.2010.close$

federations3.2015.desc.zh:
$federations3.2015.intro$

研究者们能得出的结果如下：这个居住在超空间的实体因为事故漂移到了我们联邦的宇域，它被“钩在”我们最为繁忙（也就是为我们首都的恒星基地提供服务）的太空通讯中继器上。研究者一致同意这个气态实体之前正尝试重组自身，如果不是现在的状况，它处于碎片状态下是做不到这件事的。

在重组完成后，这朵云消失了，它回到了超空间中——但在此之前它到访了我们联盟中的许多研究站。在每个研究站，它多次准确地穿入穿出超空间，在旁观者看来如同舞蹈一般。云朵展示了它穿越超空间屏障的本能，这为我们提供了无价的数据。
federations3.2015.desc.en:
$federations3.2015.intro$

As best the researchers can tell: this hyperspace-dwelling entity drifted into our federation space by accident, whereupon it became 'snagged' on our busiest, spaceborne communications relays - those which serve our capital starbases. Researchers agree that the gaseous entity was attempting to reconstitute itself - a task it could otherwise not achieve in such a fragmented state.

After it reformed, the cloud disappeared back into hyperspace - but not before visiting a number of our alliance's research stations. At each one, it performed a number of precise movements in and out of hyperspace - a display which some witnesses describe as resembling a dance. These demonstrations of the cloud's innate ability to traverse the hyperspace barrier have provided us all with invaluable data.

federations3.2016.a.zh: 这样的话，或许能从中得到某些益处。
federations3.2016.a.en: Some benefit may yet be gleaned, then.

federations3.2016.desc.zh:
$federations3.2015.intro$

我们收集到的数据并不完整，但足以推断出我们遭遇了一个格式塔存在：这个气态存在适于居住在超空间中。项目合作者提出理论，认为这朵云的各个部分在漂移过我们星系时被“钩在”了首都的恒星基地上。它似乎想要重组自身——但由于我方没有一致为其提供帮助，这朵云的某些部分渐渐散去，不再能参与到重组中了。

那些成功重组的部分随后消失去了超空间之中；余下的部分可以继续为研究者提供关于超空间的、有趣的遥测数据。
federations3.2016.desc.en:
$federations3.2015.intro$

The data we have is incomplete, but is enough to suggest we have encountered a gestalt being: gaseous in form, and adapted to dwelling in hyperspace. Project coordinators theorize that various parts of the cloud became 'snagged' on our capital starbases whilst it drifted through our galaxy. It appears to have wanted to reconstitute itself - but without a united effort on our part, some of those clouds have begun to lose cohesion, and may no longer be able to rejoin.

Those parts of the cloud which did reunite soon vanished into hyperspace; what remains continues to provide researchers with interesting telemetry on matters relating to hyperspace.

federations3.2017.a.tooltip.en: [Root.GetAllianceName] receives a temporary boost to cohesion.

federations3.2017.desc.zh:
由于我们没有对这一项目进行合作研究，关于这个造访我们首都的跨维度云团，我们很难确切得到些什么。理论众说纷纭，但我们都观察到这些云团变得相当躁动。

它们的物理结构开始解体，我们注意到这些云团对于刺激的反应也减少了。它们开始更为迅速地穿入穿出超空间。这在我们的通讯频段上产生了显著的静态干扰，但也为[root.Capital.GetName]的理论研究者提供了宝贵的数据。
federations3.2017.desc.en:
With no collaborative effort having been applied this project, little can be said with any certainty about the pan-dimensional cloud visiting our capitals. Theories abound, but all of us are now witness to these clouds' stormy agitation.

As their physical structure breaks down, we note that the clouds become less responsive to stimuli. They have begun phasing in and out of hyperspace much more rapidly. This is generating a significant amount of static on many of our communications bands, but it is also providing valuable data for our theoretical researchers in [root.Capital.GetName].

federations3.2103.desc.coordinator.zh: $federations3.2103.desc.body$为应对此事，他们让我们领导委员会，协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
federations3.2103.desc.coordinator.en: $federations3.2103.desc.body$ They have responded by tasking us with leadership of a committee, coordinating any excavation effort we all may wish to take part in.

federations3.2103.desc.generic.zh: $federations3.2103.desc.body$为应对此事，他们组成了一个由[event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName]领导的委员会，负责协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
federations3.2103.desc.generic.en: $federations3.2103.desc.body$ They have responded by forming a committee led by [event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName], there to co-ordinate any excavation effort we all may wish to take part in.

federations3.2104.a.zh: 我们会尽自己所能提供支持。
federations3.2104.a.en: We will lend what support we can.

federations3.2104.desc.zh:
我们在[root.Federation.GetName]的同事报告称听到了震耳欲聋的嗡嗡声，他认为声音的来源应该在地表之下，至少存在于一个星球中。他们成立了一个研究委员会，旨在支持他们的挖掘工作。

他们要求我们提供自己的额外资源，以便我们能够更好地理解这件奇怪的麻烦事。
federations3.2104.desc.en:
Our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] report a deafening hum from sources thought to lie buried on at least one of their worlds. A research committee has been established to support any excavation efforts they make.

We have been asked to provide our own, additional resources, in order that we might all better understand this strange and inconvenient occurrence.

federations3.2105.desc.zh:
尽管我们必须断断续续地轮班工作，但从技术上讲，揭开这个遗址的奥秘非常简单。我们挖开了两层平平无奇的岩石，然后才看到一个大贝壳，也可以说是穹顶。此外，附近有一些相同的穹顶也已部分出土，目前看来，这些穹顶似乎排列成弧形或圆形。

每个穹顶都是用模子建成，并且进行过一定程度的加固，能够经受地质年代的考验。每个建筑都有会议室大小，因此应该能够进入其中。
federations3.2105.desc.en:
The work of uncovering this site was technically straightforward - despite our having to work in staccato shifts. We removed two featureless strata before encountering a large shell or dome. Other, identical domes have been partially uncovered nearby; so far they seem to be arranged in an arc or circle.

Each dome was constructed from a mold, and was cured to such a degree that they have withstood geological ages. Ingress to these structures - each of which is the size of a gathering hall - should be possible.

federations3.2105.name.zh: 声震屋瓦的贝壳形建筑

federations3.2111.desc.zh:
尽管我们尚未确定无处不在的嗡鸣的来源，但其主导地位已经开始有所减弱。自此以后，我们的研究人员就能够专注突破这座类似半球的建筑。

里面的空间完全没有实际内容，我们初步结论为，此建筑是按感官隔离室设计的。此外，穹顶的内表面似乎画有星座图，辅以神话人物和某种形式的经文。我们正在努力解读这些设计。
federations3.2111.desc.en:
While we have yet to identify the source of the pervasive humming, its dominating presence has begun to wane. Our researchers were since able to focus on breaching the near-hemispherical structure.

The space within is entirely devoid of material contents; our initial conclusion is that this was designed as a sensory isolation chamber. Furthermore, the inside surface of the dome is illustrated with what appear to be constellation charts, supplemented by mythical figures and some form of scripture. We are already working to interpret these designs.

federations3.2112.desc.zh:
我们在穹顶内部发现了大量精巧的设备，但没有一台能够产生我们在外面还能听到的巨大噪音。一支小规模的工作小队已经独立出去，继续我们的调查工作。

大部分研究人员还留在这个贝壳形结构中，研究其内部机制，设备结构复杂，装饰美观，乍一看像是某种大型计算器。
federations3.2112.desc.en:
We discovered a plethora of elaborate equipment inside the dome, none of which seems capable of producing the immense noise we can still hear outside. A small task force has split off to continue that aspect of our investigation.

The bulk of our researchers remain within the shell-like structure, studying the mechanisms within. The equipment is intricate, decorative in form, and seems at first glance to be some form of vast calculator.

federations3.2112.name.zh: 贝壳形建筑的内部结构

federations3.2116.desc.zh:
来自[From.Owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都确认：嗡鸣现已消失。尽管各星际遗址之间距离遥远，但嗡鸣声几乎在同一时间停止。

从那以后，我们的研究团队依据穹顶内部描绘的众多星座推断出了一些模型，这些星座通常用于占星预测。研究人员收集的数据表明，此设施，若是按年代排序，比周围地层要古老得多——但有一处明显的例外：研究人员偶然在穹顶外面发现了一个大型祭坛，这表明在相对较近的年代，至少有一个文明曾使用过这一空间。

祭台使用当地的石头凿成，上面雕有蚀刻图，我们认为这些蚀刻图是用来翻译穹顶上的古老星图，将其转化一个现今我们更为熟悉的星图。
federations3.2116.desc.en:
Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the droning sirens have now dissipated. They ceased almost simultaneously, despite the vast distances between interstellar sites.

Since that time, our research team has extrapolated models from the many constellations depicted on the dome's interior, which seems to have been used to make astrological predictions. The data they've gathered suggests that this facility is far older than the surrounding strata, by an order of epochs - with one notable exception: the chance discovery of a large dais immediately outside the dome suggests that at least one civilization has used this space comparatively recently.

The dais was hewn from local stone, and is decorated with etchings we believe were used to translate the dome's outdated star charts for a galaxy arranged much as it is for us, now.

federations3.2117.desc.zh:
来自[From.Owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都表明：困扰我们共有空间各处研究遗址的嗡鸣声已经消失。这让我们的研究人员如释重负，因为他们可以开始研究穹顶内安置的复杂设备了。

尽管其设计古怪之极，但我们仍然辨认出，该设备由相互连接的太阳系仪组成。这些模型描绘了整个[From.Planet.System.GetName]星系和另外两个恒星系，但我们以及联邦内的同事至今仍不知道这两个星系的名称和位置。每台太阳系仪都由一组轴和齿轮驱动，支撑着无数由方解石和石化树液制成的雕塑。尽管看起来一动不动，但实际上它们正以缓慢的速度移动——就像巨大的星系时钟的一枝一节，而时钟的“钟声”可能就是我们先前听到的巨大嗡鸣。
federations3.2117.desc.en:
Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the ringing hum which was plaguing research sites across our shared space has now dissipated. This came as relief to our researchers as they investigated the complex equipment arranged inside the dome.

Although its design is eccentric in the extreme, we've identified it as an arrangement of interlinked orreries. These models depict the entirety of [From.Planet.System.GetName] along with two other star systems, whose names and positions are not yet known - to us nor our federation colleagues. Each is driven by a nest of axles and gears, supporting myriad sculptures in calcite and fossilized sap. Although they appear quite still, they are actually moving at a glacial pace - like parts of a vast galactic timepiece, whose 'chimes' might be the great siren we heard earlier.

federations3.2120.desc.zh:
我们对[from.Planet.GetName]和其他地方穹顶的研究已结束。每个遗址都是巨大的占星设备，跨越星际的距离与其他设备同步。

我们的研究表明，这类设施被视为宇宙能量的汇聚点，影响着建造设施的古老文明的总体“位置感”。蚀刻记录中提到，议会将“引导”这些能量，从而指引其帝国的命运。

他们的社会最终依然走向衰落，这种仪式并没有为其逆天改命。但在之后的一千年中，出现了一个继业的文明，这一继承者文明翻译并恢复了这一仪式。那之后，他们也离开了这些地方，不知去了何处。

这块巨大的时钟至少已经见证了两个文明的兴衰。现在，时钟的自动嗡鸣召唤着我们，让我们在太空区域各处见证这一仪式。无论是否会有确切结果，至少[from.owner.Federation.GetName]已经准备好进行观察了……
federations3.2120.desc.en:
Our study of the domes on [From.Planet.GetName] and elsewhere has reached an end. Each site is a vast astrological device, synchronized with others like it across interstellar distances.

Our studies suggest that facilities like this one were treated as focal points for cosmic energy, affecting a general 'sense of place' for the ancient civilization which built them. Etched records speak of councils who would 'channel' these energies in order to guide their empire's fortunes.

Such observances did not halt their society's eventual decline, but in the millennia which followed there also came an inheritor who would translate and revive the practice. They too have since left these sites, for parts unknown.

The vast timepiece has slowly ticked on through the periods of at least two civilizations; its automated siren has now called on us to observe this ritual at sites across our region of space. Whether or not anything tangible results from it, the [from.owner.Federation.GetName] is now poised to observe...

federations3.2124.desc.zh:
我们未能向同事提供他们要求的额外隔音罩。好在设备匮乏只会阻碍他们的工作，并不会彻底阻止他们挖掘。但是，这还是让一线研究人员更加不安。纵使报告显示噪音现在正自己减弱，他们的情绪也没有任何好转。

[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会现在邀请我们研究声音本身，看看能否得到些许启发，以此来弥补我们之前的过失。
federations3.2124.desc.en:
We have failed to provide our colleagues with the additional acoustic shielding they had requested. This lack of equipment will only hamper their efforts, and won't stall them outright. Nevertheless, it has left their front-line researchers that bit more rattled, even after reports which suggest that the noise is now subsiding of its own accord.

The [root.Federation.GetName] project committee now invites us to make amends by contributing to a study of the sound itself, to see if that may shed any light.

federations3.2125.desc.zh: 我们已成功提高了折叠隔音罩的覆盖范围和适应力，并与[root.Federation.GetName]的同事共享了这些升级成果。他们的一线研究员报告称意识不清和身体剧痛的情况已经有了极大改善。协调委员会现在要求我们协助进行数据分析。
federations3.2125.desc.en: We have succeeded in improving the reach and resilience of our deployable acoustic shields. These upgrades have been shared with our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName]; their researchers on the ground already report a steep decline in cognitive distress and deep-body aching. The co-ordination committee now asks us to assist with a matter of data analysis.

federations3.2129.desc.zh: 我们未能得出令人满意的成果，[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会对此表示失望。困扰联邦内多个星球的噪音终于消失，但研究机会的窗口也随之关闭。研究人员尽自己所能收集了一些信息，但现在只能寄希望于现场的考古学家能够给出详细的答案。
federations3.2129.desc.en: The [root.Federation.GetName] project committee expresses its disappointment in our lack of results. As the din which has afflicted a number of our federated worlds finally dimmed, so too did the window of research opportunities close. Researchers gathered what insights they could, but any hope for detailed answers now rests solely with the archaeologists on the ground.

federations3.2130.desc.zh: 联邦境内处考古遗址中的嗡鸣已经开始减弱。通过研究每种声音的录音，并将我们与同事的数据进行交叉对比，我们发现，当震耳欲聋的嗡鸣相互重叠时，会产生惊艳绝伦的和声，旋律可绕梁三日，令人心旷神怡。对于建造这些遗址的人来说，这种设计可能具有文化意义，但我们可能永远无法了解其中的含义。研究仍在继续……
federations3.2130.desc.en: The humming at archaeological sites across our federation's space has begun to subside. By studying recordings of each sound - and cross-referencing our data with that of our colleagues - we discovered a surprising harmony as each deafening blast overlaps to form a more pleasant, ambient melody. It's possible that this arrangement held cultural significance for whoever developed these sites; we may never know. The research continues...

federations3.2135.desc.zh:
有人可能会说，我们直到最后一刻才收集完数据。联邦最新成果刚刚发布没几天，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几个圆顶遗址就突然活跃起来，一束束光从地下深处飞流直上，正好映照在我们首都上方，这让人难以置信。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。广播只传达了一个目的，即宣告这件事成为“求索的时刻”。

没有关于后续现象的报告，圆顶遗址又一次变暗，继续缓慢地像时钟一样滴答地走过一个个时代，当然也包括我们当下的时代。
federations3.2135.desc.en:
One might say that the last of our data was gathered in the nick of time. Mere days after the last of our federation's findings was published, each domed site within [from.Federation.GetName] space burst into life. Cascades of light spilled upwards from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers are puzzled - how could the makers of these sites know? - but those on [root.Capital.GetName] are more concerned with a swath of dreamlike visions which briefly appeared on every device with a visual output. The broadcast 'spoke' with singular purpose, proclaiming this to be a 'Time of Knowing'.

No subsequent phenomena have been reported; the domed sites dimmed again, and have resumed their glacial 'ticking' through ages which now include our own.

federations3.2136.desc.zh:
一刹那，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几座圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。尽管还不清楚广播的目的，但人们共同见证这一景象凸显出一种平衡繁荣的情感氛围。

没有关于后续现象的报告，圆顶遗址又一次变暗，继续神秘而缓慢地像时钟一样滴答作响。
federations3.2136.desc.en:
Each of the once-noisy, domed sites within [from.Federation.GetName] space has, for a brief moment, burst into life. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers are puzzled - how could the makers of these sites know? - but those on [root.Capital.GetName] are more concerned with a swath of dreamlike visions which briefly appeared on every device with a visual output. It's unclear what the broadcast was intended for, but a commonly-shared observation highlights feelings of balanced prosperity.

No subsequent phenomena have been reported; the domed sites dimmed again, and have resumed their mysterious, glacial 'ticking'.

federations3.2137.desc.zh:
整个[from.Federation.GetName]的智能生物都为眼前突然出现的宏伟景象所震惊。与此同时，几年前发现的古老圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们在[root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员对这种梦幻般的景象感到非常困惑。目前我们还不清楚这一现象的目的，也没有观测到后续现象，因此无法获得更多线索。我们似乎错过了对其加以研究的时机。
federations3.2137.desc.en:
Sapients throughout the [from.Federation.GetName] have been startled by a sudden, apparent hijacking of visual feeds which coincided with a burst of activity from ancient, domed sites discovered some years ago. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers on [root.Capital.GetName] are puzzled by this broadcast of dreamlike visions. It's unclear what it was intended for, and no subsequent phenomena have been reported which might lend us more clues. It would seem that we have simply missed an opportunity to study this phenomenon.

federations3.2205.a.zh: 我们派往联邦的特使就能胜任
federations3.2205.a.en: Our envoy in the Federation can handle this

federations3.2205.b.zh: 简直莫名其妙。路上随便找群人派过去吧。
federations3.2205.b.en: This is nonsense. Only send a token delegation.

federations3.2205.d.zh: 我们对这个奇怪的议程不感兴趣。
federations3.2205.d.en: These peculiar proceedings do not concern us.

federations3.2205.desc.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员们以圣灵之名汇聚一堂。我们在各自的信仰之间找到了共同点，但联邦内仍然还有着多种信条、宗教和教会，和谐共处并不容易。

最近，僧团的成员敦促[Root.Federation.GetName]主持一场主教会议，以便共商起草一份联合教条，定义我们信仰的根基。这个提案被通过了，每一个[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员都要派出他们的代表。
federations3.2205.desc.en:
The members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] are united around their spirituality. We found common ground in the fact that we are believers, but the federation is home to various creeds, faiths and churches and cohabitation is sometimes uneasy.

Lately, members of the clergies have been pushing for the [Root.Federation.GetName] to hold an Ecumenical Council, where we could gather to try and outline a unified dogma, and define the core tenets of our beliefs. The idea was approved, and every member of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has been asked to send representatives.

federations3.2215.a.zh: 我们来此不图名利。礼貌拒绝。
federations3.2215.a.en: We're not in this for prestige. Decline politely.

federations3.2215.b.zh: 这群笨蛋离了我们就是废物！
federations3.2215.b.en: These fools would get nothing done without us!

federations3.2215.c.en: As if things could have gone any other way!

federations3.2215.desc.zh: 今天的议题是“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”，我们的使团用最华丽的辞藻和无可辩驳的逻辑作出了一场令人印象深刻的陈辞，从气势上彻底碾压了那些反对者我们观点的声音。得益于我们的精彩表现，对手陷入了沉默并且会议很快得出结论。各国使团希望能因我们的智慧而给予嘉奖。
federations3.2215.desc.en: During today's debates about "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", our delegation made a brilliant display of rhetoric and implacable logic, virtually crushing those arguing against our point of view. With the opposition silenced, a conclusion was swiftly reached thanks to us. Other delegations wish to honor us for our wisdom.

federations3.2220.a.zh: 这种举止简直丢人。我们道歉。
federations3.2220.a.en: Actions like these are not acceptable. Apologize.

federations3.2220.b.zh: 一群煞笔！我们就是这样，怎么着。
federations3.2220.b.en: Dimwits all! We stand by what we said.

federations3.2220.c.zh: 显然一些小礼物应该能让他们理解个中缘由。
federations3.2220.c.en: Surely a few presents should help them to see reason.

federations3.2220.desc.zh: 关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”这个问题相当地微妙，相关的议论刺激着许多敏感的神经。具体来说，我们的使团非常固执己见，并且对各国的高级教士屡屡出言不逊。他们纷纷要求我们正式致歉。
federations3.2220.desc.en: The question of "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" is a delicate one and many sensitivities where hurt in the discussions surrounding it. In particular, our delegation was most headstrong and has been recorded insulting several other high ranking prelates from other empires. They have requested an official apology from us.

federations3.2225.a.zh: 哪个蠢货安排的议程？这会议简直就是个笑话。
federations3.2225.a.en: Who even organized this?! This council is a joke.

federations3.2225.b.zh: 这种事情不可接受。提出正式谴责。
federations3.2225.b.en: This behavior is unacceptable. Issue an official reprimand.

federations3.2225.c.zh: 重新安排议程，让他们几个获得想要的关注。
federations3.2225.c.en: Rearrange the schedule to give them the attention they seek.

federations3.2225.desc.zh: 在讨论“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”这个话题之前，议会要求使团们在一位高阶教士的领导下进行平静的冥想。由于议程制定不详细，有三位显赫的主教都认为他们自己才应当主持这场仪式。氛围变得焦灼了起来，随着他们争吵的升级，会议不得不延期举行。
federations3.2225.desc.en: Before discussing the topic of "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", the delegations were supposed to be led in peaceful meditation by a high ranking prelate. Due to imprecisions in the schedule, three prominent priests thought that they would be the ones to lead the ceremony. The situation escalated and their bickerings have brought the council to a halt.

federations3.2225.name.en: Ecumenical Council: A Matter of Precedence

federations3.2235.c.en: Present them with the sacred Imperial [GetSpeciesShavings].

federations3.2235.desc.zh: 关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”的激烈讨论让每一位与会嘉宾都备受刺激情绪激动。为了缓和气氛，会议决定让每一个国家都互相交换礼物以及友谊的象征。我们要送些什么呢？
federations3.2235.desc.en: The intense debates around "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" left everyone agitated and in high temper. To appease things, it has been decided that every empire shall offer gifts and tokens of friendship to the others. What should we send?

federations3.2240.a.en: They are a symbol of unity!

federations3.2240.c.en: Offer them a fast track to sacrifice.

federations3.2240.desc.zh: 今日关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”的关键辩论被一位突然闯入的高级教士打断了，他拖着两位不同使团的成员。这两人被撞见时正在述说着对彼此跨越种族的恒久爱恋。较为保守的特使们认为他们的行为很不体面而且已经接近异端行为，有辱这场会议的神圣性。
federations3.2240.desc.en: The day's crucial debate about "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" was suddenly interrupted when a prelate came in, dragging along two members of different delegations. They were caught professing their undying love to each other, despite their differences. The more conservative envoys view their behavior as disrespectful and borderline heretical, violating the sanctity of this holy congress.

federations3.2245.c.zh: 行，把他们全都送到一颗死寂星球静养去吧。
federations3.2245.c.en: Send everyone on a meditative retreat on a tomb world.

federations3.2245.desc.zh: 在激烈争论“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”一整天之后，按照其中一个使团的习俗举行了宴会。宴会的一个环节是向各位嘉宾呈上仪式性的酒水。对于那个使团的物种而言这是一种很弱的致幻剂，但对我们而言则反应强烈。仅过了一小会儿整个房间就陷入了混乱的斗殴中。所幸事态平息后没有人受到严重的伤害，但调查认为是我们的特使最先动的手，要求我们对此道歉。
federations3.2245.desc.en: After a long day spent discussing "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", a feast was held following the custom of one of the delegations. As part of it, a ritual draught was served to everyone. To them, it is a mild inebriant, but our delegation had an extreme reaction to it, and moments later, the room erupted in a general brawl. Things have settled down and no major injuries have been reported, but we are regarded as having started the fight, and are expected to issue an apology.

federations3.2255.desc.zh: 在下决心主持会议时我们就知道，通向联合教条的路必定长满荆棘，但我们还是低谷了荆棘到底长得有多满。几个月毫无意义的争吵没有得出任何结论，反而是让我们更加意识到互相之间的不可调和。我们决定等过一段时间再提这事了。
federations3.2255.desc.en: When we decided to hold the council, we knew the road to a unified dogma would be long and hard, but we underestimated just how long and how hard it would be. Months of sterile debates have done nothing but highlight everything that separates us from each other. We have decided to wait a while before trying again.

federations3.2260.desc.zh: 我们确是受到眷顾的。最后发现，我们一开始忧心忡忡的事情不过是杞人忧天，一切进行得都无比丝滑。精准的理论和发人深省的演讲使我们成功地编撰出了和谐的新教条文集。我们很快会再重新修缮一回，但现在它已经成为了联合信仰的基础，拉近了彼此之间的距离！
federations3.2260.desc.en: Truly, we are blessed. Whatever apprehensions we had going in have been proven wrong and everything went quite smoothly. Precise theology and inspired discourse have allowed us to create a harmonious corpus of our new dogma. We will surely revisit it later, but for now, it will serve as the foundation of a unified faith that will bring us closer to each other!

federations3.2260.tt.zh: +20%岗位产出的£unity£凝聚力以及+3月度联邦经验值，维持20年。
federations3.2260.tt.en: For 20 years, +20% £unity£ Unity from jobs and +3 Monthly Federation XP

federations3.2265.desc.zh: 总的来说，会议还是有所收获的。虽然不是完全顺利，但大家也都做好了面对困难的准备。这只是让我们的人民和信仰走向团结的第一步。道阻且长，但前途光明。
federations3.2265.desc.en: Overall, the council was productive. Not everything went smoothly, but difficulties were to be expected. This is only the first step towards unifying our people and our faiths. The road will be long, but what expects us at the end will make it worthwhile.

federations3.2265.tt.zh: +10%岗位产出的£unity£凝聚力以及+3月度联邦经验值，维持10年。
federations3.2265.tt.en: For 10 years, +10% £unity£ Unity from jobs and +3 Monthly Federation XP

fedev.500.a.desc.zh:
$fedev.500.intro$

这个新的星系联合将作为一个光辉的榜样，告诉星系里的其他人，所有的一切都可以通过共同努力来实现。

星际外交的新时代已经开始了!
fedev.500.a.desc.en:
$fedev.500.intro$

This new Galactic Union will serve as an shining example to the rest of the galaxy of all that can be accomplished by working together.

A new era of interstellar diplomacy has begun!

fedev.500.b.desc.zh:
$fedev.500.intro$

新的贸易联盟将会毫无疑问的给我们所有的成员带来经济繁荣。

新的星际商业时代来临了！
fedev.500.b.desc.en:
$fedev.500.intro$

This new Trade League will no doubt bring about economic prosperity for all of its members.

A new era of interstellar commerce has begun!

fedev.500.c.desc.zh:
$fedev.500.intro$

这个研究联合组织将给我们所有成员的科学家以新机会来联合我们的知识。

科学进步的好时代来临了！
fedev.500.c.desc.en:
$fedev.500.intro$

This Research Cooperative will provide the scientists of all its member states with new opportunities to pool their knowledge.

A new era of technological advancement has begun!

fedev.500.d.desc.zh:
$fedev.500.intro$

这一军事同盟的联合力量肯定会使那些企图在其成员国领土上搞阴谋的人踌躇不前。

一个军事霸权的新时代已经开始了!
fedev.500.d.desc.en:
$fedev.500.intro$

The combined might of this Martial Alliance is sure to give pause to those with designs on the territory of its member states.

A new era of military supremacy has begun!

fedev.500.e.desc.zh:
$fedev.500.intro$

这种霸权主义将通过其统治霸权的开明领导确保其下级成员的安全。

一个[fed_founder_1.GetSpeciesName]霸权的新时代来临了！
fedev.500.e.desc.en:
$fedev.500.intro$

This grand Hegemony will ensure the safety of its junior members through the enlightened leadership of its ruling Hegemon.

A new era of [fed_founder_1.GetSpeciesName] dominance has begun!

fedev.605.desc.zh:
各种货物的运输路线是我们贸易联邦兴旺繁荣的生命线。但迄今为止，各帝国仍在容器设计、装载程序及运输管道等方面采用各自的物流标准。

为了使效率最大化，一个新的试点项目将在几年后实施——项目目标是调研并试验一种全新、具体，适用于联邦所有成员国的运输标准。

参与试点需要拥有一个至少有50点贸易额流经的恒星系。此外，设有外星贸易公司意味着更高的统计数据，所以应对其进行鼓励。

由于项目所涉范围广泛，一些开销必不可少。但这些牺牲是为了长远的利益。换句话说，也就是更多的未来利润。

联邦各成员国均被强烈鼓励参与项目。
fedev.605.desc.en:
The routing of various goods is the life-blood of our prosperous trade federation. But so far each empire has relied on their own logistic standards with regards to container design, loading procedures, and shipping pipelines.

In order to maximize efficiency, a new trial project will commence in a few years - one that aims to investigate and trial a new, specific shipping standard that would be applied to all members of the federation.

Participation requires a system with at least 50 Trade flowing through it. Furthermore, the existence of an Offworld Trading Company would mean increased statistical data, and so is encouraged.

Due to the vast scope of this project, some costs will apply. But it's for the greater good. That is to say: more future profit.

Every member of the federation is strongly encouraged to participate.

fedev.605.name.zh: 即将进行的试点：物流重构

fedev.615.desc.a.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！多亏了我们帝国兴旺的贸易路线，[From.GetName]已获准参与试点项目！一处恒星基地已被挑出，用作试验站点，现在我们需要指派一艘工程船，以实施实际的重构项目。时间也是一个因素，所以不要再作犹豫。

我们还拥有一处外星贸易公司设施，正因如此，项目进度有所加快。公司所属的帝国将获得一些金融优待，以表感激。
fedev.615.desc.a.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! Thanks to the empire's vigorous trade routes, [From.GetName] has been granted participation in the trial project! One starbase has been singled out as a test site, and now a Construction Ship must be assigned to perform the actual remodelling project. Time is a factor, so do not linger in this endeavour.

An Offworld Trading Company facility is also available, and thanks to this, the project will be expedited. The empire will be granted some financial leniency as a token of gratitude.

fedev.615.desc.b.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！多亏了我们帝国兴旺的贸易路线，[From.GetName]已获准参与试点项目！一处恒星基地已被挑出，用作试验站点，现在我们需要指派一艘工程船，以实施实际的重构项目。时间也是一个因素，所以不要再作犹豫。

我们没有外星贸易公司。这不会阻止我们参与试点，但会在一定程度上妨碍项目进度，因为我们无法与所涉各方分享有价值的信息，以便充分对其进行利用。
fedev.615.desc.b.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! Thanks to the empire's vigorous trade routes, [From.GetName] has been granted participation in the trial project! One starbase has been singled out as a test site, and now a Construction Ship must be assigned to perform the actual remodelling project. Time is a factor, so do not linger in this endeavour.

An Offworld Trading Company facility was not available. This doesn't stop our participation, but will impede progress somewhat as we cannot take full advantage of beneficial information-sharing between involved parties.

fedev.620.desc.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！但是，[From.GetName]缺少参与试点所必需的设施。一个拥有充足贸易额流经的恒星系居然没有贸易中心，真是匪夷所思。

错过有潜在好处的项目算是个错误，但连能带来巨大贸易额的顶级商业机会也会错过？这简直是犯罪！

多么耻辱，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！多么耻辱啊！
fedev.620.desc.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! However, [From.GetName] has been found lacking in facilities necessary for participation in the trial. The lack of a Trade Hub in a system with sufficient Trade flowing through it is nothing short of baffling.

To miss out on a potentially beneficial project is a mistake, but to miss out on such a supreme business opportunity as Trade? That's almost a crime!

For shame, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! For shame!

fedev.625.desc.zh:
恭喜！重构操作已经结束，专用的贸易中心正按照全新的物流标准运行。除了对这一恒星系进行评估之外，没什么需要做的了。

在试验期结束时，关于试点项目结果的官方声明将会发布。
fedev.625.desc.en:
Congratulations! The remodelling operation has finished and the dedicated Trade Hub is now operating to a new logistical standard. Nothing left to do now but to evaluate the new system.

At the end of the trial period there will be an official statement on how the trial project turned out.

fedev.635.desc.zh:
这是就贸易与利润而言意义深远的一天！不仅物流试点成功完成，其结果更是表明星际商业往来更为顺畅，贸易效率显著提升！

结果是，联邦内一切太空贸易操作均会逐步地、不知不觉地切换到新标准进行；整个联邦将由此极大受益。

为利润而欢呼吧！
fedev.635.desc.en:
This is a monumental day for profit and trade! Not only is the logistics trial complete, but the results show a noticeable increase in efficiency and smooth interstellar business!

As a result, all space trading operations in the federation will now progressively - and quite unnoticeably - switch over to the new standard; the federation will benefit tremendously.

Hurrah for profit!

fedev.640.desc.zh:
这是就贸易与商业而言伟大的一天。试验期已经结束，项目已得到完全评估。我们收集到足够的数据表明贸易效率有所提升，应当全面实施新的物流标准。

现在开始，一切运输操作将逐步切换到新标准——但这个过程是完全自动的。食品会被递送，消费品会被送到它们的目的地，香料仍在运输，如此这般。

总之，干得漂亮！
fedev.640.desc.en:
It's a great day for trade and commerce. The trial period is over, and the project has been fully evaluated. Enough data was collected to see an increase in efficiency that warrants full implementation of the new logistical standard.

Now begins a process in which all shipping operations will switch to the new standard - but this process is fully automatic. The foodstuff will be delivered, the consumer goods will reach their destination, the spice will flow, and so on.

Good job!

fedev.645.desc.zh:
如果联邦各成员国逐利的动机微弱到这种程度，那灰暗的时代确实来临了。

由于缺乏参与及动力到了令人费解的程度，这项大有前途的物流试点变成了一场闹剧！如今还剩的只有冗长乏味的指责、官司还有诉讼了。

去请个律师吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——会有些不良后果需要处理。
fedev.645.desc.en:
Grim times do indeed loom if this is the substandard motivation by which the federation's members pursue profit.

A baffling lack of participation and drive turned this promising logistical trial into nothing short of a farce! Now the only thing that remains is a tedious dance of blame, lawsuits and litigation.

Lawyer up, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there will be repercussions.

fedev.9430.desc.zh:
只有通过考古论证和想象才能在如今已经荒芜的[From.Planet.GetName]表面上重构出那个曾经繁盛一时的文明。岁月的流逝是残酷无情的，即使是曾经最为坚不可摧的建筑，如今也只化作一地的尘埃。

但在那深不可测的地下，有一个怪异的信号正在脉动着。一座神秘的信标仿佛呼唤着我们的调查和发掘。
fedev.9430.desc.en:
Only through archaeological proof and imagination can one depict a once flourishing civilization on the now desolate surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. So unkind has the passage of time been, that even the sturdiest buildings have been grinded down to little more than dust.

But from deep underground a strange signal is pulsing. A mysterious beacon yearning for investigation and uncovering.

fedev.9435.desc.zh:
当挖掘团队越来越接近深处的信标时，无法忽视的死亡感触突然神秘地在挖掘团队中蔓延。随着更多的泥土和石头被清除，一个坚定的观念在每个人的脑海中徘徊：

生命转瞬即逝。总有一天这一切都会结束……
fedev.9435.desc.en:
A sudden and undeniable sense of mortality has mysteriously crept upon the excavation team as they get closer to the beacon in the depths. As more dirt and rock is removed, an unescapable notion lingers in the back of everyone's mind:

Life is fleeting. Someday all this is going to end...

fedev.9440.desc.zh:
信号来源是一座外星墓碑，上面镌刻着奇异的符号。翻译文本充其量只算是略有眉目。这些符号提及了一位举足轻重的人物，其一生的伟业值得铭记与崇拜，整个文明都处于哀伤之中。翻译文本接近末尾时变得十分怪异，诉说体液因悲伤从身体中流出，随后又因天气条件而消逝。

只有全文的最后一部分得到了成功翻译：

‘死亡的时刻到了。’
fedev.9440.desc.en:
The source of the signal is an alien tombstone inscribed with strange symbols. The translation is sketchy at best. It speaks of a person of great importance, of a life's work worthy of remembrance and veneration, and of a civilization in mourning. Towards the end the translation becomes very odd, speaking of grief-induced leakage of bodily-fluids, and their subsequent dissipation due to weather conditions.

Only the very last part was successfully translated:

'Time to die.'

fedev.9445.desc.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]地表的初步探索揭示了这颗行星曾经确实是某个文明的家园。

然而，荒芜的程度表明这个文明的存在已经是非常非常久的时间以前的事情了，而且它极有可能曾经遭受到某种突然且可怖的力量袭击。残余的废墟还不足以提供关于这种外星人的生理学信息。
fedev.9445.desc.en:
Initial exploration down on [From.Planet.GetName]'s surface reveals that this planet was indeed home to some kind of civilization.

However, the level of devastation indicates that it must've been very long ago, and it's quite likely that the civilization was struck by some kind of sudden and terrifying force. There isn't even ruins enough left to get an idea about the aliens' physiology.

fedev.9450.desc.zh:
地表探测团队从行星上分离出一条无线电信号。其发信源仍暂时未知，不过已被破译的部分则已经可以开始向我们讲述这个失落已久的文明的故事了。

某种未知的威胁步步逼近这个文明；对技术的进步陷入了集体的沉迷；传言称在星系的其他地方正在建造一艘硕大无朋的宇宙战舰。这些主题在这些杂乱无章的信息里反复地出现。
fedev.9450.desc.en:
The surface team has isolated a radio signal down on the planet. Its origin is still unknown, but translated parts have started to reveal information about the long lost civilization:

Some unidentified and approaching threat to the civilization. A collective fascination with technological advances. Rumours of a giant spaceship being built in another part of the galaxy. These themes are recurring in the scrambled messages.

fedev.9455.desc.zh:
考古学家们设法抵达了这个神秘信号的来源——深藏于地面之下。

刚刚开始不久的遗址发掘工作，就已经表明这似乎是某种研发设施。这个地方到处都是高度微缩的多种科学设备原型。

扫描发现在其下还有一个空洞，发掘正在进行当中。
fedev.9455.desc.en:
The archaeologists managed to home in the source of the mysterious signal. It came from deep underground.

Unearthing of the site has only just begun, but indications point to some kind of research and development facility. The place is littered with remarkably high-detail miniature prototypes of various technological devices.

Scans show a hollow space further down, and excavation is underway.

fedev.9460.desc.zh:
我们的发掘小组有了一个有意思的发现。一组硬盘，里面记录的是作为该设施的核心焦点乃至他们整个文明核心焦点的某个持续运作的项目信息。

据描述，这是一艘能与星系间最庞大飞船相抗衡的巨大舰船。

他们在这里到底在建造一个什么样的巨大怪物？
fedev.9460.desc.en:
Our excavation team have made an interesting discovery. A collection of miniature hard drives held information about an ongoing project that seems to have been the focal point of this installation, maybe even that of the entire civilization.

It speaks of a mighty vessel to rival the galaxy's most gargantuan flyer.

What beast of a machine did they build down here?

fedev.9465.desc.zh:
这是一艘“巨大”的宇宙飞船！

好吧，事实证明，至少对于从前[From.Planet.GetName]上的居民来说，这艘飞船其实还蛮大的。那些我们在这里找到的微缩原型机正是飞船本身的机器，而原以为是某种设备的东西，其实是他们的首都。至于在加密信号里提到的“威胁”，实际上是一场太空技术竞赛里的对手。这个微型文明全体聚集至此则是为了尽全力夺取冠军。

不过好像我们才是这次竞赛的获奖者。
fedev.9465.desc.en:
It's a massive spaceship!

Well, at least to the population of [From.Planet.GetName], who - as it turned out - were absolutely tiny. The miniature prototypes found here were apparently their actual machines, and what was assumed to be a facility, was in fact their capitol city. The 'threat' that was mentioned in the scrambled signals turned out to be their opponents in an intergalactic tech competition. This entire mini-civilization came together trying to get the first prize!

Seems as if we are the ones to score the prize this time.

fedev.9470.desc.zh:
一艘巨大的宇宙飞船被我们发现了！

其实只是对于原先[From.Planet.GetName]上的居民而言这艘飞船很大，因为他们这个物种十分微小。

由于畏惧某种神秘的威胁降临他们的母星，他们整个族群都聚集至此以建造一艘宇宙飞船来应对这迫在眉睫的威胁。

看上去他们还是晚了一步；毕竟他们的攻击舰还留在原地，可他们自己却消失无踪了。
fedev.9470.desc.en:
A massive space ship have been discovered!

Or at least it was massive to the population of [From.Planet.GetName], who turned out to be a minuscule species.

Fearing a mysterious threat approaching their homeworld, the entire species came together to build a space ship that could take on the impending terror.

They appear to have been too late; their assault ship is still here, but they're not.

fedev.9475.desc.zh:
真是一艘宏伟的宇宙飞船啊！

一艘宏伟，却又特别小巧的宇宙飞船。这说明[From.Planet.GetName]上的原住民其实是一种微型物种。我们遇到的微缩物件其实是他们的机器，而这个损坏的设备则曾经是一座主要城市。

在听说星系另一端有人建造了一艘庞大的宇宙飞船后，这些生物决定也建造一艘飞船来比肩那个庞然大物。

真是了不得的决心与勇气，当然了，也捎带着一点可爱。
fedev.9475.desc.en:
It's a grand space ship!

A grand, absolutely tiny space ship. As it turns out the population of [From.Planet.GetName] was a mini-species. The miniatures encountered were their actual machines, and this ruined facility was once a major city.

Having heard of a space ship of great proportions being built in another part of the galaxy, this species decided to build a ship to match the alien behemoth.

It shows great determination and courage. It's also a little bit cute.

fedev.9500.desc.zh:
威震寰宇的主宰已经建成。

这艘行动自如的庞然巨舰将彻底改变进攻作战的范式。它可以在前线建造和维修舰船，并配有足以摧枯拉朽的火力，使我们得以不间断地攻击那些敢与我们作对的人。

如今只有蠢货才会对抗[Owner.GetName]。
fedev.9500.desc.en:
The construction of the impressive Juggernaut has been completed.

This mobile behemoth changes the paradigm of offensive warfare entirely. It can construct and repair ships on the frontline, and is equipped with devastating firepower, allowing for a ceaseless assault of those who dare stand against us.

Only fools will oppose [Owner.GetName] now.

fedev.9505.a.zh: 有点改变战争规则的意思了。
fedev.9505.a.en: Bit of a game changer, that one.

fedev.9505.desc.zh:
经确认，[From.Owner.GetName]已经完成了巨型主宰舰的建造。这一行动自如的太空基地装配了海量火力，并能在作战前线建造和维护舰船，使其在任何作战场景下都是更严峻的威胁。

这真的是太空战里的尖端军备。
fedev.9505.desc.en:
It has been verified that [From.Owner.GetName] has finished the construction of a massive Juggernaut ship. This mobile space base packs extensive firepower and is able to build and maintain ships at the frontline of battle, making it a superior threat in any combat scenario.

It is truly the apex armament of space war.

fevorian_blueprints.zh: 菲沃尔人物质投射炮蓝图

fibrous_atmosphere_desc.zh: 对[from.GetName]的初步扫描结果是损坏的，我们的仪器无法清晰解读。这一干扰的来源尚不明确；或许需要近距离调查 。
fibrous_atmosphere_desc.en: Initial scans of [from.GetName] are returning in a corrupted state that our sensors cannot clearly interpret. The source of this interference remains unclear; a closer inspection will be needed.

finisher_effects_destroy.zh: 如果我们成功摧毁这个设备，我们将能够利用它的组件材料，同时防止我们帝国面临任何进一步的危险。
finisher_effects_destroy.en: If we succeed in destroying this device, we will be able to exploit its component materials while at the same time preventing any further danger to our empire.

finisher_effects_frenzied_voidworms.zh: 侵略性的虚空虫可能会攻击我们的首都。
finisher_effects_frenzied_voidworms.en: Aggressive Voidworms may attack our capital.

finisher_effects_sabotage.zh: 我们将清除黑针破坏分子，并阻止他们增援奈斯船长藏宝地的封锁力量。
finisher_effects_sabotage.en: We will clear out the Black Needle saboteurs and prevent them from reinforcing their blockade around Captain Ness's Hoard.

finisher_effects_sabotage_fail.zh: 我们的基础设施将遭到无法修复的破坏，黑针将增援对奈斯船长藏宝地的封锁。
finisher_effects_sabotage_fail.en: Our infrastructure will be damaged beyond repair and the Black Needle will reinforce their blockade around Captain Ness's Hoard.

finisher_effects_study.zh:
我们不确定这个装置可能包含什么秘密。

我们谨慎乐观地认为，在检查完它的结构后，我们将能够进一步推进我们的社会进步。
finisher_effects_study.en:
We are uncertain what secrets this device may contain.

We are cautiously optimistic that we will be able to advance our society further after examining its construction.

finisher_effects_the_seal.zh: 如果我们拯救了这些生命体，我们不确定会有什么结果。
finisher_effects_the_seal.en: We are uncertain what will result, should we choose to save these beings.

finisher_effects_voidworm_plague.zh: 你的殖民地将不再受到虚空虫的轰炸影响。
finisher_effects_voidworm_plague.en: Your colonies will no longer be vulnerable to Voidworm bombardment.

fircon.1210.desc.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]研究后得知，这位客人扭曲触手的动作其实是一种复杂的语言形式。

于是乎我们沮丧地了解到这个生物正因为衣不蔽体而感到尴尬，正在反复地请求合适的衣物以遮蔽其赤裸的躯体。

在得体地遮蔽躯体后，我们的研究者建造了一台多肢机器以便与这个生物交流。
fircon.1210.desc.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] has determined the wriggling tentacle motions of our guest are a form of sophisticated sign language.

To our dismay, we thus learned that the creature is embarrassed about its lack of clothing and has been repeatedly asking for appropriate garments to cover its naked appendages.

After it's suitably clad, our researchers have proposed the construction of a many-tentacled machine to better aid communication with the creature.

fircon.1211.desc.zh:
我们的这位访客十分健谈，但文化差异让我们难以相互理解。现在我们知道了该生物为雌性，她称自己为“万爪之母”，似乎隶属于某个它称之为薄幕行者的唯心主义教团。但我们仍然不明白这个她一直唠唠叨叨不停的“山现”是什么，或者它和她的突然出现之间有什么因果关系。

我们继续尝试同其进行沟通。
fircon.1211.desc.en:
Our guest is very talkative, but cultural differences are making it hard for us to understand each other. We now know that the creature is female, refers to herself as "The Many-Tentacled One" and seems to be a member of a spiritual order it calls the Veilfarers. But we still don't understand what this 'Jaunt' She keeps mentioning is, or how it can be responsible for her sudden appearance.

Our communication efforts continue.

fircon.1212.a.en: We'll welcome her as an equal.

fircon.1212.a.tooltip.zh: 万爪之母将作为一名科学家加入我们。
fircon.1212.a.tooltip.en: The Many-Tentacled One joins our ranks as a scientist.

fircon.1212.ab.zh: 她可以留在这，但不会很自由。
fircon.1212.ab.en: She can stay. But she won't be free.

fircon.1212.b.zh: 她可以留下，送到活体解剖实验室去。
fircon.1212.b.en: She can stay. In our vivisection labs.

fircon.1212.c.zh: 这恶心玩意儿怎么能留在我们的星球上！
fircon.1212.c.en: This abomination has no place in our world!

fircon.1212.desc.zh:
我们的研究人员终于拼凑出了“万爪之母”的故事：我们的宾客是一位专注于研究闪现的唯心主义教团的领袖：这是一种允许在宇宙中任何地方瞬间传送的灵能技术。纵观她的物种的历史，从来没有人成功地进行过闪现……直到现在。

万爪之母不确定她是否有能力复制这一壮举，更何况她的能量储备目前已经耗尽，无法再做尝试。

当前，她愿意继续接受我们的照顾，并将通过帮助我们的研究人员来回报我们的热情款待。
fircon.1212.desc.en:
Our researchers have finally pieced together the Many-Tentacled One's story: our guest is the head of a spiritual order focused on studying the Jaunt: a psionic technique that allows for instantaneous teleportation anywhere in the universe. Throughout the history of her species, no one has ever managed to perform a successful Jaunt... Until now.

The Many-Tentacled One is unsure about her ability to replicate the feat, and her energy reserves are currently too depleted to make another attempt.

For now, she would like to remain in our care, and will repay our hospitality by aiding our researchers.

fircon.1220.desc.zh:
我们没能成功地给这位神秘访客提供合适的营养：该生物很快就生病了，它拒绝餐食，还拒绝作出任何应答。

在我们能够进一步了解它的新陈代谢机制之前，通讯行为暂时停止。
fircon.1220.desc.en:
Our attempts to provide our mysterious visitor with suitable nourishment have failed: the creature quickly sickened, expelled the meal, and is currently unresponsive.

Communication efforts are on hold until we can gain a better understanding of its metabolism.

fircon.1221.desc.zh:
该生物对我们的尝试性联络反应激烈，猛烈地袭击了一位我们的科学家，并拒绝进一步的合作。也许我们无意见冒犯了它。

尽管没有人严重受伤，但是这次事故依然对迄今为止我们同这个生物建立的脆弱的信任造成了损伤。
fircon.1221.desc.en:
The creature has reacted violently to our communication attempts, lashing out at one of our scientists and refusing further collaboration. We believe we have unintentionally offended it.

While no one was seriously injured, the accident has damaged the fragile trust we have so far built up with the creature.

fircon.1230.desc.gestalt.zh: 新的数据表明我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]或许有能力$fircon.1230.desc.outro$
fircon.1230.desc.gestalt.en: New data suggests that our [owner.GetScientistPlural] may be capable of $fircon.1230.desc.outro$

fircon.1230.desc.non_gestalt.en: Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] have expressed an interest in $fircon.1230.desc.outro$

fircon.1231.a.zh: 再加把劲。我们会找到她的家乡的！
fircon.1231.a.en: Redouble our efforts. We'll find her home!

fircon.1231.b.zh: 我们这不就是她的家吗。

fircon.1231.desc.zh:
我们的万爪之母最近表达了回归家乡的渴望，但我们难以定位她的母星系：她所描述的天体特征不符合我们所知星系的任何一个区域。

我们的访客凝视着夜空，久久不曾挪开视线。
fircon.1231.desc.en:
Our Many-Tentacled One has recently expressed a desire to return to her people, but our efforts to locate her home system have proven fruitless: the celestial features she described don't correspond to any known part of the galaxy.

Our guest's gaze remains fixed on the night sky.

fircon.1232.desc.zh:
万爪之母无处可寻。这个生物突然地出现，现在却又突然地消失了，仅仅在研究设施的地板上留下了一条匆忙划下的告别信息。

“我很害怕，但我必须要闪现离开了。我心中的思乡之情无处排解，苦痛难耐。感谢你们所做的一切。我祈祷薄幕会善待我。”
fircon.1232.desc.en:
The Many-Tentacled One is nowhere to be found. The creature disappeared as abruptly as she appeared, leaving a hastily scratched goodbye message on the floor of the research facility:

'I'm scared, but I have to Jaunt. My hearts ache with thoughts of home. Thank you for everything. I pray the Veil will be kind to me.'

fircon.1233.desc.zh: 我们的一艘舰船截获了一个突然凭空出现在我们母星系的储藏箱。在我们的物种一接触到它的瞬间，上面复杂的锁就自动解开了，展露出了其中令人瞠目咋舌的大量工艺品……还有一张来自多肢旅行者的感谢纸条，其中声称她在几十年前曾经造访过我们的母星。
fircon.1233.desc.en: One of our ships has intercepted a cache that suddenly materialized in our home system. The complex lock gave way as soon as a member of our species touched it, revealing a dizzying collection of artifacts... And a thank-you note from a Many-Tentacled traveler who claims to have visited our home planet decades ago.

fircon.1240.desc.machine.en: $fircon.1240.desc.intro$ some key components as a result of partly teleporting inside a floor.

fircon.1240.desc.organic.zh: $fircon.1240.desc.intro$下部附肢。随之而来的是许多掌声和一些尖叫声。
fircon.1240.desc.organic.en: $fircon.1240.desc.intro$ their lower appendages as a result of partly teleporting inside a floor. Much clapping and some screaming ensued.

fircon.1241.desc.gestalt.zh:
$fircon.1241.desc.intro$

目前，使用这种技术来推进舰船的前景还停留在理论阶段。$fircon.1241.desc.outro$
fircon.1241.desc.gestalt.en:
$fircon.1241.desc.intro$

The prospect of using this technique to propel ships remains purely theoretical for now. $fircon.1241.desc.outro$

fircon.1241.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
$fircon.1241.desc.intro$

使用这种技术来推进舰船讨论遭到了深刻的质疑。$fircon.1241.desc.outro$
fircon.1241.desc.non_gestalt.en:
$fircon.1241.desc.intro$

Talks of using this technique to propel ships have been met with profound skepticism. $fircon.1241.desc.outro$

fircon.1243.drive.desc.zh: 尽管如此，我们获得的知识也会有一些工程应用。
fircon.1243.drive.desc.en: Nonetheless, the knowledge we gained will have some engineering applications.

fircon.1243.nodrive.desc.zh: 然而，通过通过将闪现的原理应用到飞船工程而不是单个躯体之中，我们的[GetResearchers]距离造出$tech_psi_jump_drives$仅有一步之遥，将灵能传送变成了一个更可靠、更安全的手段。
fircon.1243.nodrive.desc.en: However, by applying the principles of the Jaunt to ship engineering rather than individual bodies, our [GetResearchers] are one step closer to building a $tech_psi_jump_drives$ and turning psionic teleportation into a more reliable, marginally safer endeavor.

fircon.1256.a.zh: 我们将继续从远处监视他们的努力。
fircon.1256.a.en: We will continue to monitor their efforts from a distance.

fircon.1256.b.zh: 派一支队伍去获取样本。
fircon.1256.b.en: Send a team to obtain a sample.

fircon.1256.desc.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的居民通过试用富营养肥料提高了他们的农业水平。他们能够收获到更高质量的农作物产品，社会的整体健康也得到改善。

考虑到他们简陋的技术，这种粮食生产的进步是非常显著的。获得化肥样品后，我们就可以在更大范围内复刻这一成就。
fircon.1256.desc.en:
The inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have enhanced their agricultural skills through experimentation with nutrient-rich fertilizers. Their harvests are yielding higher quality produce and the health of their society is improving.

Given their rudimentary technology, this advancement in food production is remarkable. Obtaining a sample of the fertilizer should allow us to replicate the achievement on a wider scale.

fircon.1257.desc.zh: 我们对从[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上收集到的肥料样本的分析获得了对前超光速文明农业行为的重要见解，其中的一部分甚至新到可以增进我们自己的技术。大家纷纷表示，这次努力物有所值，任务大获成功。
fircon.1257.desc.en: Our analysis of collected fertilizer samples from [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] has provided valuable insights into pre-FTL agricultural practices, some so novel that they could actually bolster our own techniques. By all accounts, this was a worthwhile endeavor, and a successful mission.

fircon.1257.name.zh: 温顺好生养：已研究样品

fircon.1261.a.zh: 我们不会打扰他们的自然发展历程。
fircon.1261.a.en: We will not interfere with the natural course of their development.

fircon.1261.b.zh: 我们在道义上应该帮助。
fircon.1261.b.en: We have a moral obligation to help.

fircon.1261.c.zh: 我们可以降低他们对食物的需求……
fircon.1261.c.en: We will reduce their need for food...

fircon.1261.desc.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的定居点一直在经历着农业困境。最近的农作物歉收可能会导致争夺食物的冲突。对于一个年轻的、发展中的社会，这是一个关键时刻。

无论他们是选择在需要的时候团结在一起，还是反目成仇，他们现在的决定对于未来朝着哪个方向发展都会产生很大的影响。

不幸的是，无论采取哪种方式，他们都将进入一个极端困难的时期。
fircon.1261.desc.en:
The settlements on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have been experiencing agricultural difficulties. Recent crop failures could lead to conflicts over food. This is a critical moment in the development of a young society.

Whether they choose to come together in their time of need, or to turn against each other, their decisions now will have a strong bearing on who they ultimately become.

Unfortunately, no matter which course is taken, they are entering a period of extreme hardship.

fircon.1262.desc.zh:
我们最近对[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的干预产生了正面的结果。利用我们自己的农业技术，我们暗中确保了他们不会遭受饥荒。

现在，他们有了盈余的食物，所以我们必须约束自己的行径，限制干预的程度。
fircon.1262.desc.en:
Our recent intervention on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] yielded positive results. Utilizing our own agricultural technologies, we covertly ensured they would not starve.

Now, they have a surplus of food, so it is only right that we limit the extent of our interference by taking some for ourselves.

fircon.1271.a.zh: 他们描绘了我们的样子。不可思议！
fircon.1271.a.en: They have captured our likeness. Fascinating!

fircon.1271.b.zh: 这画的什么东西。给我抹了！
fircon.1271.b.en: Their scribbles insult us. Remove them!

fircon.1271.c.zh: 我们已经污染了他们的文化。以后得多加小心。
fircon.1271.c.en: We have contaminated their culture. Take more care in future.

fircon.1271.desc.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的居民持续地在他们的公共生活空间中创造出原始的、艺术化的代表作品，我们注意到其中有些图像开始显露出我们的轮廓。

现在看来，我们在这颗星球上的所作所为很可能已经引起了注意。
fircon.1271.desc.en:
As the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] continue to create crude, artistic representations in their communal living spaces, we have noticed some images have begun to look like us.

It now seems likely that our efforts on the planet have attracted notice.

fircon.1285.a.zh: 继续被动观察。他们必须自食其力。
fircon.1285.a.en: Continue passive observations. They must learn on their own.

fircon.1285.b.zh: 也许我们可以默默地把他们推向正确的方向……
fircon.1285.b.en: Perhaps we could subtly point them in the right direction...

fircon.1285.desc.zh:
在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上，居民们正在使用原始的雕刻图画来表达和分享想法。我们的研究人员记录的样本表明，居民对他们自己星球以外的天体有认识，甚至已经开始记录星座。

对于这样一个年轻的文明来说，他们早期绘制的星图是相当准确的，但也不至于到了无法改进的地步，只要我们想留下一些暗示……
fircon.1285.desc.en:
On [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], the inhabitants are using crudely carved imagery to express and share ideas. Samples documented by our researchers indicate that the inhabitants have an awareness of celestial bodies beyond their own planet, and have even begun to document constellations.

Their early attempts at charting the stars are fairly accurate for such a young civilization, but not so much that they couldn't be improved should we wish to drop some hints...

fircon.1290.desc.zh:
由[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民绘制的早期星图被我们暗中修订了。

描绘附近恒星系图样的雕刻是在附近的一个山洞里制作的。一旦它们被发现，它们应该能够让当地居民对已知宇宙的规模有一个更好的认识。
fircon.1290.desc.en:
The early star charts of the inhabitants on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have been covertly corrected.

Carvings depicting nearby system diagrams were made in a nearby cave. Once they are discovered, they should provide the local population with a better sense of the scale of the known universe.

fircon.1290.name.en: Written in the Stars: Charts Delivered

fircon.1291.desc.zh:
不幸的是，由于[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民不知道是谁负责制作了他们的新星图，他们把我们的所作所为视作单纯的破坏行为。山洞周围的安保措施得到了加强，统治精英们对新形式的自我表达越来越敌视……

从积极的方面看，我们的干预并不是完全浪费时间。他们对这一事件的反应在文化研究方面很有价值。
fircon.1291.desc.en:
Unfortunately, since the inhabitants of [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] did not know who was responsible for their new star charts, they passed off our efforts as simple vandalism. Security around the caves has increased, and the ruling elite has grown hostile to new forms of self-expression...

On a positive note, our interference was not a complete waste of time. their reaction to this event has proven fascinating in terms of cultural research.

fircon.1291.name.en: Written in the Stars: Charts Received

fircon.1292.desc.zh: 我们没能顺利地在暗中纠正[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的星图。对于一个如此年幼的社会而言他们的安保措施令人意外地复杂。对目前的任务来说，暴露的风险太高了。至少目前当地居民需要依靠自己的力量来探索星空了。
fircon.1292.desc.en: Our efforts to covertly correct the star charts on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have been unsuccessful. Their security protocols are surprisingly sophisticated for such a young society. Given our current mission, the risks of exposure were too high. For now at least, the inhabitants will have to face their astronomical aspirations alone.

fircon.1300.a.zh: 我们应该按照我们的形象塑造他们。
fircon.1300.a.en: We should mold them in our image.

fircon.1300.desc.zh:
在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上独立出现了多种非语言的沟通体系。由于在图像和象形文字集之间存在冲突，居民们距离形成一种主导语言还有几个世纪。

有趣的是，其中一个书写体系的语法结构与我们的很相似。如果[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的社会采用这个系统，他们在未来可能会在文化上相当具有可塑性……
fircon.1300.desc.en:
Multiple non-verbal communication systems have emerged independently on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]. With conflicting sets of imagery and hieroglyphs, the inhabitants are still centuries away from forming a dominant language.

Interestingly, one of the writing systems has a similar grammatical structure to our own. If [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] society were to adopt this system, they could become culturally malleable in the future...

fircon.1310.desc.zh:
我们在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的存在引起了旁人的注意。占主要地位的文化团体现在将我们视为睿智而强大的存在，认为我们控制着元素，并最终掌握着他们的宿命。

许多人在精心设计的仪式中以自己的性命向我们宣誓效忠，担心招致我们的不悦会带来十分严重的后果。
fircon.1310.desc.en:
Our presence on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] has not gone unnoticed. The dominant cultural group now regards us as wise and mighty beings who control the elements and ultimately their fate.

Many have pledged their lives to us in elaborate ceremonies, fearing that incurring our displeasure could come with drastic consequences.

fircon.1315.desc.zh: 在对[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的社会进行了大量的历史观察之后，他们占主流地位的社会群体已经把我们当作神灵来敬仰。他们希望继续用恩惠的行为得到我们的青睐……因此，为了纪念我们，血祭仍在继续。
fircon.1315.desc.en: After actively observing their society for a substantial chunk of their history, the dominant society on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have come to revere us as deities. They wish to keep us in their good graces... And so the blood sacrifices continue in our honor.

fircon.1320.desc.authoritarian.zh: $fircon.1320.desc.base$这些桀骜不驯的人们拒绝向他人称臣，选择遵从自己最基础的冲动，进入无政府状态。加入机会恰当，他们应该接受我们作为他们的主人。
fircon.1320.desc.authoritarian.en: $fircon.1320.desc.base$ Refusing to be subjugated, the wayward population has relented to their base urges and made the choice to become ungovernable. They should have accepted us as their masters when they had the chance.

fircon.1320.desc.materialist.zh: $fircon.1320.desc.base$如果没有基于科学论证的、经同行评议的反面证据，他们已经根据经验确定，在这个现实的位面上，哪怕是遥远的神明亦不存在。他们仍有希望。
fircon.1320.desc.materialist.en: $fircon.1320.desc.base$ Without science based, peer reviewed evidence to the contrary, they have determined empirically that nothing even remotely godly exists on this plane of reality. There is hope for them yet.

fircon.1320.desc.regular.zh: $fircon.1320.desc.base$人们完全拒绝神灵的概念，接受了一种明显倾向于唯物主义的宇宙观。在没有确凿证据的情况下，他们相信在宇宙中只有自己。
fircon.1320.desc.regular.en: $fircon.1320.desc.base$ Rejecting the concept of deities altogether, the population has embraced a decidedly materialist view of the cosmos. Without hard evidence, they believe themselves alone in the universe.

fircon.1330.b.zh: 能见证如此美丽的诞生，实属荣幸。
fircon.1330.b.en: It is a privilege to witness the birth of such beauty.
