fircon.1330.desc.zh: [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的社会正不断孕育出丰富的文化和对艺术进行深刻鉴赏的风潮。居民们放下了武器，转而使用书写工具。随着这种全新的学习和探索氛围已超脱于冲突之上，我们可能正在见证这个行星上一个黄金时代的到来。
fircon.1330.desc.en: Society on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] is blossoming with rich culture and a deep appreciation for art. The inhabitants are putting down their weapons in favor of writing instruments. With this newfound willingness to learn and explore beyond conflict, we could be witnessing the dawn of a golden age on the planet.

fircon.1340.b.zh: 我们应当回应他们的祈祷！

fircon.1340.c.zh: 一切都将化为尘土。剩下的只不过是这件事的序曲。
fircon.1340.c.en: Everything turns to dust. The rest is merely prelude.

fircon.1340.desc.zh: 我们正在见证[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民迈出他们走向启蒙的第一步。他们向上抬头，对宇宙的奥秘始终抱持开放的态度。随着艺术表达在他们文化中的发展，艺术力量捕捉社会的精神奋斗的一面也在发展。他们渴望有某种高于自我的信仰。
fircon.1340.desc.en: We are witnessing the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] taking their first steps towards enlightenment. They look upwards, opening themselves to the mysteries of the universe. As artistic expression develops within their culture, so does art's power to capture the spiritual striving of their society. They yearn for something beyond themselves to believe in.

fircon.1345.desc.zh: 通过向存在的神圣真理开放自己，[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民正在接近开悟。作为精神领袖，我们有责任引导他们。
fircon.1345.desc.en: By opening themselves to the divine truth of existence, the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] are approaching enlightenment. As spiritual leaders, it is our duty to guide them.

fircon.1350.desc.zh: 当[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民仰望天空时，他们希望得到圣灵的赐福。然而，他们实际得到的是沉默。他们的祈祷没有得到回应。现在他们必须接受精神飘忽不定的本质。只有科学拥有他们寻求的答案。
fircon.1350.desc.en: When the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] looked up to the skies they hoped to receive blessings from the divine. What they actually received was silence. Their prayers have gone unanswered. Now they must accept the frivolous nature of spirituality. Only science holds the answers they seek.

fircon.1360.a.zh: 让我们来教教他们科学吧。
fircon.1360.a.en: Let's educate them in the sciences.

fircon.1360.b.zh: 假以时日，他们的信仰会发展。
fircon.1360.b.en: Their faith will develop, given time.

fircon.1360.desc.zh: [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民已经开始提出一个理论，认为他们的所在的星球是由一个不可言喻的存在赠送给他们的，而生命是对神圣造物主不屈不挠的奉献所进行的回报。或许当他们遇到更广泛的星海共同体时，他们会有一个惊喜。
fircon.1360.desc.en: The inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have begun to theorize that their world was gifted to them by an ineffable being, and that life is a reward for unyielding devotion to a divine creator. They may be in for a surprise when the time comes for them to meet the wider galactic community.

fircon.1365.a.zh: 这件事本来能够做得更好。

fircon.1365.desc.zh:
通过向[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的唯心领袖们现身，我们告诉他们所谓的“神圣造物主”并不存在。他们想要的答案只有通过科学才能找到。

不幸的是，我们的这堂课没有起到效果。这些人们将我们视为神明，整日向我们三叩九拜。我们的任务起到了反效果。
fircon.1365.desc.en:
Revealing ourselves to the would-be spiritual leaders on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName], we assured them that their so-called 'divine creator' does not exist. The answers they seek can be found only through science.

Unfortunately, our lessons have been ignored. The people now look to us as as gods, vowing to worship us for all time. Our mission has backfired.

fircon.1370.desc.zh:
他们生气了！我们的行动彻底地惹恼了[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民。数个世纪以来，他们社会中的成员经常在神秘的情况下失踪，然后又在数日或数月后出现，口述着难以置信的外星科技的故事，这一切在他们眼里无异于魔法。

可以理解，发现魔法不存在，这一切仅仅是外星人们为了研究你们的所作所为这件事极大地撼动了他们的世界观。人们在一夜之间倒向孤立主义，礼貌地要求我们不要再把他们当成实验对象。也许我们是该考虑他们的请求。
fircon.1370.desc.en:
They are furious! Our actions have completely embarrassed the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]. For centuries, members of their society have disappeared under mysterious circumstances, only to reappear days or months later with the most incredible stories of alien technology, which from their perspective is nothing short of magical.

Understandably, learning that magic isn't real - but aliens who probe you for research purposes are - has somewhat shaken their worldview. The population has become an insular society overnight, and are politely requesting us to stop treating them as lab specimens. Perhaps we should consider their request.

fircon.1380.a.zh: 或许我们可以伸出援手，帮助他们赈济灾民……
fircon.1380.a.en: Perhaps we could help them avert a catastrophe...

fircon.1380.b.zh: 无论是哪种方法，他们总要学会。
fircon.1380.b.en: They will learn, one way or another.

fircon.1380.desc.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上快速的科技进展催生了工业化的时代。交通方式的跃进式发展将此前星球上相对孤立的区域连成一片，创造了环球贸易和思想交流的机遇。

然而，资源的危机正在悄悄酝酿。如果其他星球上的历史也会重演的话，这里的人们很快就会陷入战争。
fircon.1380.desc.en:
Rapid technological advances on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] are ushering in an age of industrialization. Breakthroughs in transportation have linked previously disconnected areas of the world, creating opportunity for global trade and the sharing of ideas.

However, tensions over resources are already brewing. If the history of other worlds is any guide, the populace could soon find themselves at war.

fircon.1385.a.zh: 时间将证明他们是否听从了我们的警告。
fircon.1385.a.en: Time will tell if they will heed our warning.

fircon.1385.desc.zh: 我们冒着计算过的风险，向[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的星球领袖透露了自己的身份。我们毫不含糊地建议当地政府结束他们的冲突，警告说战争的后果很可能是灾难性的。许多人试探性地听着。其他人则认为任何关于“外星使者”的谈话都是一个骗局。
fircon.1385.desc.en: Taking a calculated risk, we revealed ourselves to world leaders of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]. In no uncertain terms, we advised the local governments to end their conflict, warning that the consequences of war could well be catastrophic. Many listened tentatively. Others dismissed any talk of 'alien emissaries' as a hoax.

fircon.1390.desc.zh:
我们决定任由[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的星球领袖自行发展，现在他们是自己命运的第一责任人了。不幸的是，好像他们正在走向战争。

据信是不可调和的差异导致了星球上不同的文化群体之间兵戎相见。紧随而来的冲突开启了他们的发展史上一段黑暗的篇章。
fircon.1390.desc.en:
In choosing to leave the world leaders of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] to their own devices, they are now wholly responsible for their destiny. Unfortunately, it appears they are headed for war.

Supposedly irreconcilable differences have driven the planet's culture groups to take up arms against one another. The coming conflict represents a dark period in their development.

fircon.1395.desc.zh: [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的各领袖接受了我们的建议，放下了他们的武器。很难说这样的和平会持续多久，但至少现在，他们不太可能将自己从他们的行星表面抹除了。
fircon.1395.desc.en: The leaders of [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have taken our advice and put down their weapons. It is impossible to say if the peace will last, but for now at least, they are unlikely to wipe themselves from the face of their planet.

fircon.1400.desc.zh:
我们的接入对[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]宛如火上浇油。他们的整个星球陷入了战争。然而，如果他们没能互相消灭的话，这种局势也许也有积极的一面：这颗行星上的科技进步成果卓绝。

也许，当战争的硝烟散去，他们就能妥善地把这些科技用到正道上。
fircon.1400.desc.en:
Our intervention may have added fuel to the proverbial fire on [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Their world is now at war. However, if they fail to eradicate one another, there may be an upside to the situation: the technological progress being made on the planet is remarkable.

Perhaps, when and if the smoke of battle clears, they will put some of this technology to good use.

fircon.1410.b.zh: 他们拥有的资源比实际需要的要多……
fircon.1410.b.en: They have more resources than they need...

fircon.1410.b.tooltip.zh: 我们可以帮助他们缓解资源过多的问题。
fircon.1410.b.tooltip.en: We could alleviate them of some of their resources.

fircon.1410.desc.gestalt.zh:
$fircon.1410.desc.base$

[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民们齐心协力，建设出了一个团结的星球。他们统一调配行星资源，每个蜂巢都将整个星球社区的共同利益放在首位，他们集体的生活水平超乎寻常。
fircon.1410.desc.gestalt.en:
$fircon.1410.desc.base$

Working together, the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have built a unified industrial world. Pooling world resources, the individual hives have prioritized the wellbeing of the entire global community, and their collective living standards appear exceptional.

fircon.1410.desc.regular.zh:
$fircon.1410.desc.base$

与我们模型预期的不同，[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]现在成为了一个统一的星球。他们将资源统一调配，人们则将为整个星球的社区的福祉作为首要任务，生活水平大幅提升。
fircon.1410.desc.regular.en:
$fircon.1410.desc.base$

Defying our prediction models, [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] is now a unified world. Pooling their resources, the people have prioritized the wellbeing of the global community and living standards are rising.

fircon.1415.a.zh: 停下。我们除了研究别无其他需求。
fircon.1415.a.en: Stand down. We require nothing from them but research.

fircon.1415.desc.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的生活正在蓬勃发展，繁荣的经济为我们提供了一些……千载难逢的机会。一个新近建造的陆路货运网络就是一个理想的目标。从理论上讲，我们的特工人员可以很容易地登上这些货车，夺取货物。然而，根据我们目前的观测姿态，我们必须要采取额外的预防措施，以保持不被更多人发现。
fircon.1415.desc.en: Life on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] is thriving, and the booming economy offers us certain... unique opportunities. A newly constructed network of land freighters is an ideal target. In theory, our operatives could easily board one of these freighters and seize the cargo. However, in accordance with our current observation stance, we would have to take extra precautions to remain undetected by the wider population.

fircon.1425.desc.zh: [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的货物打劫行动是一场成功。我们的特工夺得了一小部分合金，同时在下面的时候还学到了很多有关[GetPreFTLLower]转运的知识。
fircon.1425.desc.en: The cargo heist on [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] was a success. Our agents secured a small cache of alloys, and learned a lot about [GetPreFTLLower] transit while they were down there.

fircon.1430.desc.zh: [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的货物打劫行动宣告失败。我们的特工在某艘陆地货船上的行动中惨遭抓获。在接下来的冲突中，双方都遭受了伤亡，我们的特工身份暴露。
fircon.1430.desc.en: The cargo heist on [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] was a failure. Our operatives were apprehended mid-operation aboard a land freighter. During the ensuing altercation, casualties were recorded on both sides, and our agents were exposed.

fircon.1445.a.zh: 那些革命者非常勇敢，我们哀悼他们的抗争。
fircon.1445.a.en: Those brave revolutionaries. We lament their struggle.

fircon.1445.b.zh: 我们将在他们的政治事务中保持中立。
fircon.1445.b.en: We will remain impartial in their political affairs.

fircon.1445.desc.zh: 一场战争在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上爆发了。最近这些年，这颗星球上的某些派系设法积累了足够的财富，对生产资料实施了垄断。与之对应，其他人对于日益严重的不平等进行了反抗。现在，一场席卷一切的阶级战争爆发了。对于[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]来说，这是一个黑暗的时代，后果将持续很长时间。
fircon.1445.desc.en: A war has broken out on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]. In recent years, certain factions on the planet managed to accrue enough wealth to monopolize the means of production. In turn, others revolted against the growing inequality. Now, an all out class war has broken out. It is a dark time for [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]. This will have lasting consequences.

fircon.1445.name.en: Conflict! What is it Good For?

fircon.1450.a.zh: 我们为他们的损失感到哀伤。

fircon.1450.desc.zh:
[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的战争结束了。革命者们一个接一个失败了。主导派系继续从因自身贪婪引起的战争中获利，四处尸山血海。

一切恢复了原状，革命的呼声也一时噤若寒蝉。
fircon.1450.desc.en:
The war on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] is over. One by one, the revolutionaries fell. As the bodies piled high, the dominant faction continued to profit from a war triggered by their own greed.

The status quo has been restored. Cries for revolution have gone silent.

fircon.1451.desc.zh:
我们选择不干涉[GetPreFTLLower]文明的政治，[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的战争也按自己的步调结束了。压迫者势力轻松地碾压了革命者。

一切恢复了原状，革命失败了。
fircon.1451.desc.en:
After we chose not to involve ourselves with [GetPreFTLLower] politics, the war on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] ended of its own accord. The oppressive powers steamrolled the revolutionaries with ease.

The status quo has been restored. The revolution is dead.

fircon.1452.desc.zh:
[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上怠忽的职员们把自己忙得够呛，他们傲慢的反抗以失败告终。执行官们通过巧妙的公司改组和绩效管理手段再度控制住了局面。

一切恢复了原状。所有人再次回到了自己的工作岗位上。
fircon.1452.desc.en:
The delinquent employees on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have tired themselves out, and their arrogant revolt has ended in failure. The executives regained control of the situation through tactful corporate restructuring and performance management.

The status quo has been restored. Everyone is returning to their designated workspaces.

fircon.1453.desc.zh:
超出模型预期，[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上这些行为不端的雇员们粗暴地驱逐了管理层并取而代之。

这是一场灾难，我们的工人从中获取了灵感，并意识到了自己的处境。我们的投资陷入了前所未有的危险。我们本应更彻底地进行尽职调查的。
fircon.1453.desc.en:
Defying prediction models, the delinquent employees on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] ousted their executive tier in a hostile takeover.

This is a disaster, as our own workers have taken inspiration and are now getting ideas above their stations. Our investments are now at risk like never before. We should have been more thorough in our due diligence.

fircon.1455.desc.zh: 在[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上，不满的声音被权势滔天的精英阶层给压制住了。然而，如果我们现在进行干预，肯定可以扭转局势。我们在这个星球上的存在可以为残余的抵抗组织提供支援。
fircon.1455.desc.en: On [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName], dissenting voices have been silenced by the powerful elite. However, if we intervene now we could certainly turn the tide. Our presence on the planet could bolster what is left of the resistance.

fircon.1460.b.zh: 这真是最骇人听闻的消息。

fircon.1460.desc.zh: 我们的军队刚在[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]上登陆，立即取得了对当地土著军队在物质上和战略上的全面优势。日薄西山的精英阶层已经撤退，革命者们准备好接过权力的衣钵。
fircon.1460.desc.en: Landing on [FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName], our forces demonstrated an immediate material and strategic advantage over the native troops. The former elite has withdrawn, and the revolutionaries stand poised to assume the mantle of power.

fircon.1470.a.zh: 当他们准备好时，我们会欢迎，但那之前还不行。
fircon.1470.a.en: We will greet them when they are ready, and not before.

fircon.1470.b.zh: 在恐惧中毁灭吧，你们这些小蠢蛋！
fircon.1470.b.en: Quake with fear, you tiny fools!

fircon.1470.desc.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民已经开始积极地寻找他们星球之外的智慧生命迹象。随着他们准备大胆地前往许多文明已经拜访过的地方时，可能我们是时候要重新评估我们的第一次接触协议了，做好准备，让更广泛的星海共同体迎接新的成员。
fircon.1470.desc.en: The inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have begun actively searching for signs of intelligent life beyond their world. As they prepare to boldly go where many have already gone, it may be time for us to reassess our first contact protocols, in preparation for a new addition to the wider galactic community.

fircon.1475.a.en: We should have been more careful.

fircon.1475.b.zh: 找到泄露源。遥控擦除他们的数据仓库。
fircon.1475.b.en: Identify the leaks. Remotely scrub their data repository.

fircon.1475.desc.gestalt.zh:
$fircon.1475.desc.base$

他们收到了我们的敏感信息。我们的安保存在漏洞。
fircon.1475.desc.gestalt.en:
$fircon.1475.desc.base$

They are in receipt of our sensitive data. We have gaps in our security.

fircon.1475.desc.regular.zh:
$fircon.1475.desc.base$

他们正在研究一份在观测站上的工作者发往我们首都的一位未知收信人的极具个性化的信息。

这一意外的泄露暴露了一处我们安保协议的漏洞。
fircon.1475.desc.regular.en:
$fircon.1475.desc.base$

They are currently studying a message of a very personal nature between an agent aboard the observation post, and an unknown recipient from our capital.

This unfortunate leak has highlighted gaps in our security protocols.

fircon.1480.a.zh: 他们还没准备好同我们会面。
fircon.1480.a.en: They're not ready to meet us just yet.

fircon.1480.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民搜寻智慧生命的努力一无所获。

他们投入了大量时间和资源在繁星中搜寻生命，但很沮丧地发现除了虚空以外一无所有。

目前这项研究还在进行，但可以肯定他们很快就对项目失去了希望。不必多说，我们将继续在每一个任务参数中对他们隐藏自身的存在。
fircon.1480.desc.en:
The inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have had no success in their search for intelligent life.

Having dedicated time and resources in the search for life amongst the stars, they were despondent to discover nothing but void.

For now, the search continues, but it is clear they are swiftly losing hope in the project. Needless to say, we will continue to hide our existence from them, per mission parameters.

fircon.1480.name.zh: 他们现在认为只剩自己了

fircon.1485.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上荒谬的居民们居然用他们羸弱的科技截获了一些我们过去的无线电信号。

解码和理解我们的广播足够让他们忙上几个世代。以他们目前的发展水平，我们尚且没有暴露的风险。
fircon.1485.desc.en:
The ridiculous inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have used their weak tech to intercept some of our historic radio signals.

Deciphering and interpreting our old broadcasts should keep them busy for a few generations. With their current level of development, we are not at risk of being exposed.

fircon.1490.desc.zh:
在他们搜寻外行星智慧的过程中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民向整个星系发去了广播。他们收到的信息是，“嘘，别让他们听到了。”

这当然是我们一位特工的所作所为。结果是，这个年轻的太空民族现在正为外太空究竟蛰伏着什么恐怖动的东西而瑟瑟发抖。
fircon.1490.desc.en:
In their search for extra-planetary intelligence, the inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] called out to the galaxy. What they received was a message which said, 'Be quiet or they will hear you.'

This was the action of one of our own agents. As a result, the young spacefarers are now terrified of what might lurk beyond their system.

fircon.1500.desc.zh: 我们收到了报告，是关于在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上进行超光速航天器推进装置的事项。当地居民似乎打算成为一个彻底的太空文明。然而，他们在星空中发现的东西，可能会证明当下阶段他们还无法理解。
fircon.1500.desc.en: We have received reports of superluminal spacecraft propulsion on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. The inhabitants seem intent on becoming a full-fledged spacefaring civilization. What they discover in the stars may prove too much for them to comprehend.

fircon.1505.a.zh: 他们必须自力更生。保持距离进行观测。
fircon.1505.a.en: They must learn on their own. Observe from a distance.

fircon.1505.b.zh: 他们还没准备好。破坏他们的任务。
fircon.1505.b.en: They're not ready. Sabotage their mission.

fircon.1505.c.zh: 改变我们的应对方案。帮助他们触及星辰！
fircon.1505.c.en: Change our approach. Help them reach the stars!

fircon.1505.d.zh: 我们开始厌烦了。让他们在自己的道路上快马加鞭。
fircon.1505.d.en: We grow weary. Speed them along on their way.

fircon.1505.desc.zh:
现已证实，[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]确有一艘理论上存在超光速能力的飞船。他们已经开始进行测试，以期尽快突破光障。

一旦成功，他们在技术上便已具备涉及星系外交的能力。这样的境遇必然对他们的社会造成或好或坏的深远影响。
fircon.1505.desc.en:
The existence of a theoretically FTL-capable craft on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] is now confirmed. They have moved on to testing, hoping to soon break the light speed barrier.

If they are successful, they will technically be ready to engage in galactic diplomacy. Such an encounter is sure to have profound effects on their society, for good or ill.

fircon.1505.name.zh: 获得很多，但是失去的更多
fircon.1505.name.en: Much To Gain, Yet Much to Lose

fircon.1510.a.zh: 要是我们早点警告他们，他们现在早就成为太空文明了……
fircon.1510.a.en: Had we warned them, they would be spacefarers now...

fircon.1510.b.zh: 如期而至。他们的失败是不可避免的。
fircon.1510.b.en: As expected. Their failure was inevitable.

fircon.1510.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上雄心勃勃的宇航员们试图突破光障。整个星球的目光都聚焦在这艘飞船向着星间启航。

发射成功了。一切都按预期的参数运行中。随后他们启动了曲速引擎，事情发生了转折。

他们成功地扭曲了时空连续统（这是一种迷人但存在缺陷的超光速航行方式），然而他们只在舰船尾部成功了。随之而来的在案超乎了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的一切想象。乘员们被剧烈地扭曲撕扯，身体的一部分停留于原地，而同时另一部分被扯入了未来。

他们可得再多花一些时间才能进行下一次尝试了。
fircon.1510.desc.en:
The aspiring spacefarers on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] attempted to break the light speed barrier. The whole world looked on as the spacecraft launched towards the stars.

Liftoff was a success. Everything was operating within expected parameters. Then they engaged their warp drive and things took a turn.

They successfully distorted the shape of the space-time continuum (a fascinating but flawed approach to breaking the light speed barrier), however they were only successful in doing this in the aft section of the craft. The resulting carnage was beyond anything the inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] could have ever imagined. The crew was violently distorted, fixed in one part of space, whilst simultaneously having other parts of themselves stretched into the future.

It could be some time before they are ready for a second attempt.

fircon.1515.a.zh: 我们静候他们的到达，加入更广泛的星海共同体。
fircon.1515.a.en: We await their arrival into the wider galactic community.

fircon.1515.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们在实验性跃迁引擎方面取得了巨大的成功，然而他们在关于时空扭曲产生器的投射距离计算方面犯了严重的错误。通过与他们的直接沟通，我们得以引导他们通过超空间航道这种广为接受的方式来进行超光速航行。

依照我们的建议，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]很快就能加入我们的星系社会了。
fircon.1515.desc.en:
The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have made remarkable progress on their experimental jump drive, however there were some glaring mistakes in their calculations relating to the projected range of their space-time distortion generator. By engaging in direct communication, we were able to guide them towards the accepted method of faster than light travel via hyperlane network.

Following our advice, [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will soon join us as a galactic spacefaring society.

fircon.1520.b.zh: 他们不挡我们的路就是做了好事。
fircon.1520.b.en: They would do well to stay out of our way.

fircon.1520.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的居民们作为一个宇航文明加入了星海共同体。

我们的观测任务结束了，他们已经拥有了超光速运行能力。
fircon.1520.desc.en:
The inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have joined the wider galactic community as a spacefaring society!

Our observation mission now concludes, as they are now FTL capable.

fircon.2001.a.zh: 重新绑架样品，用来研究我们的光束的效果！
fircon.2001.a.en: Re-kidnap the specimens to study the effects of our beams!

fircon.2001.b.zh: 降低牵引光束的能量，并蛰伏一阵子。
fircon.2001.b.en: Decrease tractor beam power and lay low for a while.

fircon.2001.c.zh: 增强牵引光束的能量，并在土著身上测试。
fircon.2001.c.en: Increase tractor beam power and test them on the natives.

fircon.2001.desc.zh: 使用隐身[GetIndividualNamePlural]和牵引光束，我们能够成功地收集、分析和研究毫无防备的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]个体，之后再将其送还到自己的居所。不幸的是，牵引光束对于[pre_ftl_species.GetAdj]的生理机能产生了预料之外的效果。在返回家中以后，这些样品开始遭受疖子、疹子以及不受控制地打喷嚏，在回到家中的三个小时之后其外表皮还会发生溶解。这种神秘的溶肤病已经酿成了全国范围内的卫健紧急事件，而验尸报告毫无疑问会揭示外部干预的证据。
fircon.2001.desc.en: Using stealthy [GetIndividualNamePlural] and tractor beams, we were able to successfully collect, analyze and study unsuspecting [pre_ftl_species.GetName] individuals and return them to their dwellings. Unfortunately, the tractor beams had an unexpected effect on the [pre_ftl_species.GetAdj] physiology. After being returned to their homes, the specimens started suffering from boils, rashes and uncontrollable sneezing, experiencing a total dissolution of their outer tissue layers within three hours from their return. The mysterious skin-dissolving illness has already become a national health emergency, and autopsies will doubtlessly reveal proof of external tampering.

fircon.2011.avian.desc.zh:
$fircon.2011.base.desc$

我们试图收集的鸟类样本发现这样的事故特别好玩。这些胆子很大的样本甚至开始追逐我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]，希望也能被带走，而且完全是出于寻求乐子。
fircon.2011.avian.desc.en:
$fircon.2011.base.desc$

The avian specimens we were trying to collect found the accident highly amusing. The bolder specimens even started chasing after our [GetIndividualNamePlural] in a bid to be lifted up too, just for the thrill.

fircon.2011.b.tt.zh: 把我们的观测站任务变更为被动观测
fircon.2011.b.tt.en: Changes our Observation Post mission to Passive Observation

fircon.2011.c.zh: 乐。继续这么玩，再把这些有趣的录像转播出去！
fircon.2011.c.en: Amusing. Keep going, and distribute the footage!

fircon.2011.noavian.desc.zh:
$fircon.2011.base.desc$

其中一些样本掉到了建筑和树的顶部，当地人困惑不已，各种各样的古怪理论冒了出来。
fircon.2011.noavian.desc.en:
$fircon.2011.base.desc$

Some of the specimens ended up on top of buildings and trees, baffling the locals and giving life to all sorts of weird theories.

fircon.2505.a.en: Harsh is the way to unity.

fircon.2505.b.zh: 它们的同化规程相当残忍。

fircon.2505.c.zh: 它们是不是吃掉了一个意识？
fircon.2505.c.en: Did they just eat a consciousness?

fircon.2505.desc.zh:
虽然[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的感性个体都从属于一个有机的格式塔意识，但[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]有数个不同的“蜂巢”。这些蜂巢是互相独立的子个体集合体，相互竞争着资源。偶尔，两个群体之间会爆发冲突，有时还会升级为全面战争。我们目前正在目睹一场对蜂巢首都的全力攻击，这场面真是令人毛骨悚然。由于不受移情作用的阻碍，子个体的效率会让任何将军感到自豪。

守军节节败退，但根据我们的估计，它们应该还能坚持几天。

然而就在片刻之后，所有战斗都停止了，守军与对手联合起来，开始拆除自己的首都，寻找一切有价值的东西。看来，它们是瞬间被彻底同化到了进攻方的蜂巢网络中。
fircon.2505.desc.en:
While all of the sentient population of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] belongs to an organic gestalt consciousness, the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] is home to several different 'Hives'. These hives are isolated collections of drones and are competing with each other for resources. Occasionally, conflict erupts between two groups, and can sometimes escalate to total war. We are currently witnessing an all out assault on a hive's capital, and it is a gruesome business. The efficiency of the drones, unhindered by empathy would make any general proud.

The defenders are quickly losing ground, but by our estimations they should hold for a few more days.

Yet, moments later, all fighting ceases, as the defenders join forces with their opponents and begin dismantling their capital for anything of value. It appears that they have been completely and instantly assimilated into the network of the attacking hive.

fircon.2515.a.zh: 这是一种独特的扩张策略。

fircon.2515.desc.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]最近开始在这颗星球的新地区定居下来。当地的动植物群落起初与定居地区的动植物群落大不相同，但现在已经完全被集体所控制，它们采取了一种激进却有条不紊的方法来调节当地的生态系统。某些动物物种被无情地消灭，用其他物种取而代之，而入侵性植物扼杀了本地树木的生命。当地土著对生态的掌控令人惊叹，但它们在气候异常地区不可避免地遭遇了一些挫折，在这些地区，引进的生命形式无法长期生存。我们相信，它们很快就会找到克服这些障碍的办法，最终整个星球将统一起来，为集体的繁荣提供最佳条件。
fircon.2515.desc.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently started settling new regions of the planet. The local flora and fauna, initially vastly different from what can be found in the settled territory, are being completely taken over by the collective, who is taking a radical but methodical approach to regulating the local ecosystem. Certain animal species are ruthlessly exterminated only to be replaced by others, while invasive vegetals choke out the life of the indigenous trees. The native's ecological mastery is remarkable, yet they cannot avoid certain setbacks in areas of unusual climate, where the introduced lifeforms cannot survive long. We believe that they shall soon find a way around these obstacles and eventually, the whole world will be uniform, presenting optimal conditions for the collective to thrive in.

fircon.2520.b.tt.zh: 这将会增加正面结果发生的可能性。
fircon.2520.b.tt.en: This will increase the likelihood of a positive outcome.

fircon.2525.a.zh: 这颗星球将屈服于蜂巢的意志。
fircon.2525.a.en: This world shall bend to the will of the hive.

fircon.2525.c.zh: 它们还是可以扭转局面！
fircon.2525.c.en: They can still turn things around!

fircon.2525.d.en: A step in the right way!

fircon.2525.desc.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]最近开发了新技术，它们的工业开始疯狂地增长。当地蜂巢的头脑中有了部分自动化的概念，工厂、冶炼厂、装配线和燃料提取器已在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的各地建成。黑烟在天空中飘荡，许多子个体由于接触到有毒的化学物质而开始出现退化的迹象。很快，蜂巢将不得不解决这些问题，然而，不受影响的子个体仍在照常工作。
fircon.2525.desc.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently developed new technologies, and their industry has started to grow at a frantic pace. Factories, smelters, assembly lines, and fuel extractors have been built across the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] as partial automation has found its way into the mind of the local hive. Dark smoke streaks the skies, and many drones are starting to show signs of degeneration due to the toxic chemicals they are in contact with. Soon the hive will have to address these issues, yet the unfazed drones keep working as usual.

fircon.2525.e.zh: 目光所及之处毫无社会活动。
fircon.2525.e.en: Not a single social movement in sight.

fircon.2535.desc.zh: 发生了一系列意外事件，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]似乎被悲伤所笼罩。在一个子个体的死亡之后，我们目睹了整个蜂巢出现了前所未有的工作停顿。我们不清楚这个子个体有什么与众不同之处，但蜂巢似乎正在举行某种仪式，死去的子个体几乎被虔诚地切成碎片，然后这些碎片被送到各个新生子个体的培育所。几分钟后，整个蜂巢又开始运转起来。这非常令人困惑，很像一个具有社会意义或精神意义的事件。
fircon.2535.desc.en: In an unexpected turn of events, grief seems to have taken over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. We are witnessing an unprecedented halt in the work of an entire hive, in the aftermath of the death of a singular drone. We are unsure why this drone is different from the others, but the hive seems to be holding some kind of ceremony, where the drone is almost religiously cut to pieces, before those pieces are taken to various nurseries for newborn drones. Moments later, the entire hive springs in motion again. This is highly confusing, and looks a lot like an event of social or spiritual importance.

fircon.2545.a.zh: 我们也是这样发展而来的吗？
fircon.2545.a.en: Is this how we came to be too?

fircon.2545.d.zh: 带走优异子个体进行研究。

fircon.2545.desc.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上观察到的原生蜂巢已经在进化中迈出了重要一步。在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的大部分地区，小规模的个体群体已经开始组织成小规模的蜂巢，但是没有完全自主，目前这些子个体还缺乏完全成熟的集体应有的团结度和协调性。

这种情况在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的北部地区发生了变化，那里有个正在征服附近子个体的奇点，而一个子个体似乎是这种情况的中心点。这个“优异子个体”目前正在星球上旅行，并把被征服的子个体送到一个定居点，对这个技术水平很低的星球来说规模相当庞大。在那里，子个体们似乎专注于建造房屋和粮仓，并尽可能地扩大食物生产，以容纳新来者。自主性消失了，对它们来说，现在只有集体。
fircon.2545.desc.en:
The proto hive that we have been observing on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has taken a significant step in its evolution. Over most of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], small groups of individuals had started to organize in small-scale hives, but, while not fully autonomous, these drones were so far lacking the cohesion and coordination of a fully realized collective.

This has changed in the northern reaches of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], where an individual appears to be the nexus for a singularity that is subjugating the nearby drones. This 'Drone-Prime' is currently traveling the planet, and sending the subjugated drones to gather in a settlement of massive proportions given the low technological level of the world. There, the drones seem to be focused on building houses, silos, and expanding their food production as much as possible to accommodate the newcomers. Gone is the autonomy, for them, there is only the collective now.

fircon.2545.e.zh: 如此不同，又如此引人入胜……
fircon.2545.e.en: How unlike us, and yet so compelling...

fircon.2546.b.zh: 我们已经研究得够多了，把它送回去。
fircon.2546.b.en: We have enough. Send it back.

fircon.2546.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的“优异子个体”已经成功捕获并使其进入睡眠状态。尽管我们已经非常小心，但肯定还是被[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]上的其他子个体发现了，每次我们的空间站运行到靠近它们居住地的位置，它们都好像能够感应到优异子个体接近一般。

我们研究优异子个体的大脑在跨维度沟通方面得到了有趣的结果，但我们尚未摸清它控制其他子个体和吞噬萌芽意识的具体能力。
fircon.2546.desc.en:
The 'Drone-Prime' from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been abducted successfully and put to sleep. Despite our care, the other drones on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] have definitely taken notice, and every time our station's orbit brings us close to their settlement, they display aggressive behaviors, as if they could sense that the Drone Prime was closer.

Our studies of the prime's brain have yielded interesting results about transdimensional communication, but the details of its abilities to take over drones and subsume the budding consciousness still escapes our grasp.

fircon.2547.a.tt.en: The Observation Post in orbit of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] is destroyed.

fircon.2547.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的“优异子个体”已经成功捕获并使其进入睡眠状态。不幸的是，在我们研究这个对象的脑电波模式时，它醒了过来。随后，我们收到了一系列令人费解的报告，似乎都指向该对象逐一打破了观测站人员的思想，并征服了大多数人。幸运的是，唯一能够超光速航行的舰船在混乱中被摧毁了，但站内系统显示，优异子个体正在通过新的子个体们迅速吸收知识，并表现出完全可以使用我们技术和设备的能力。

隔离协议规定，应立即远程摧毁该站点及其中的所有人员！
fircon.2547.desc.en:
The 'Drone-Prime' from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been abducted successfully and put to sleep. Unfortunately, the subject woke up as we were studying the patterns in its brain waves. We have then received a confusing collection of reports that all seem to point at the subject breaking the minds of the observation post's crew, one by one, and subjugating most of them. Fortunately, the only FTL-capable vessel was destroyed in the confusion, but the station systems show that the Drone Prime is quickly assimilating knowledge from its new drones, and has shown full capabilities of using our tech and equipment.

Containment protocols dictate the remote destruction of the station and all its occupants at once!

fircon.2555.c.zh: 和蜂巢共生是很罕见的。
fircon.2555.c.en: Symbiosis with a hive is a rare thing.

fircon.2555.desc.zh:
我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的观察在继续，最近我们发现了最初被误认为是失控了的子个体。它们生活在当地蜂巢定居点的外围，似乎已经拥有部分、甚至完全的自主性。它们似乎彻底脱离了集体，有些甚至很享受悠闲的时光，舒适地无所事事。

然而，它们似乎仍然依赖蜂巢获取资源，本质上是与集体进行交易。我们尚不明了为什么蜂巢不认为应该消灭这些失控子个体。
fircon.2555.desc.en:
Our observation of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] proceeds, and we have recently discovered what we first mistook as rogue drones. These individuals live in the periphery of the local hive settlements, and seem to have acquired partial, if not full autonomy. They seem entirely disconnected from the collective, and some even seem to enjoy leisurely moments, comfortable doing nothing.

They however appear to still depend on the hive for resources, and are basically trading with the collective. Why the hive has not seen fit to exterminate these rogue drones remains a mystery.

fircon.2605.desc.hive.zh: $fircon.2605.desc.base$经特异性进化后的航天子个体比普通的子个体更加独立，随时准备探索它们所在的恒星系。
fircon.2605.desc.hive.en: $fircon.2605.desc.base$ The specially evolved astronaut drones are more independent than regular ones, ready to explore their solar system.

fircon.2605.desc.regular.zh: $fircon.2605.desc.base$这些为了这项任务经过多年训练的航天员，于当地时间的今天早上登上了火箭。现在他们已经翱翔于那片我们和他们共享的天空。让我们追随他们的征程吧。
fircon.2605.desc.regular.en: $fircon.2605.desc.base$ The astronauts who had trained for years to go on this mission boarded the rocket early in the morning, local time. Now they soar the space we share with them. Let us follow their journey.

fircon.2615.desc.zh:
通过尝试和试错，[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的第一次行星际旅行以成功告终。尽管这次旅途并非一切顺利，但是他们证明了自己作为太空探索者的潜力。

[from.owner.GetName]受此项任务的激励，正迫不及待地准备迎接前往繁星的旅途上可能遇到的下一项挑战。我们或许很快就有机会与他们进行平等的对话了。
fircon.2615.desc.en:
Through trials and tribulations, the first [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] interplanetary journey ended in success. While not the smoothest of trips, they proved their potential as space explorers.

The [from.owner.GetName] have been inspired by this mission and are eagerly awaiting their next challenge in their journey to the stars. We may soon have the chance to speak to them, as equals.

fircon.2620.b.zh: 利用我们潜入其社会的特工提供一个解决方案。
fircon.2620.b.en: Use our agents embedded in their society to plant a solution.

fircon.2620.c.zh: 我们能不能在它们的太空中心附近，留下一条包含解决方案的信息？
fircon.2620.c.en: Couldn't we leave a message with a solution near their space center?

fircon.2620.d.zh: 修复飞船，将它们的记忆擦除。
fircon.2620.d.en: Repair their ship and wipe their memories.

fircon.2620.desc.zh: 第一艘[from.owner.GetSpeciesName]的行星际飞船上的机械故障导致它困死在了太空中。这艘船没有任何办法调整自己的轨迹，很快就会超出救援范围。[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]正在努力寻找解决方案，但机会渺茫。不过，我们也许有机会进行干预。
fircon.2620.desc.en: Mechanical failure aboard the first interplanetary [from.owner.GetSpeciesName] vessel has left it dead in space. No longer capable of adjusting its trajectory, the ship will soon be beyond saving. [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] is working on a solution, yet the odds are not good. However, we may have an opportunity to intervene.

fircon.2620.e.zh: 让它们自己想办法解决这个问题。
fircon.2620.e.en: Let them figure it out on their own.

fircon.2625.a.tt.zh: 船组人员的神秘失踪将使得[fromfrom.owner.GetName]科技进步减少-50%。
fircon.2625.a.tt.en: The mysterious loss of their crew will reduce the Technological Progression of the [fromfrom.owner.GetName] by -50%.

fircon.2625.b.en: Damn the risk, let them go home!

fircon.2625.desc.hive.zh:
$fircon.2625.desc.base$

在仔细研究了当地的蜂群如何交流之后，我们设法建立了一个代理主脑，让这些工蜂独自思考。我们或许不得不安排它们生活在我们这里。它们可以从远处观察自己的家园，但却永远无法回去。
fircon.2625.desc.hive.en:
$fircon.2625.desc.base$

Having carefully studied how the local hive communicates, we have managed to set up a proxy Overmind, leaving these drones alone with their thoughts. We may have to consign them to living here with us. They can observe their home from afar, but never return.

fircon.2625.desc.regular.zh:
$fircon.2625.desc.base$

我们或许不得不安排它们生活在我们这里。它们可以从远处观察自己的家园，但却永远无法回去。
fircon.2625.desc.regular.en:
$fircon.2625.desc.base$

We may have to consign them to living here with us. They can observe their home from afar, but never return.

fircon.2630.desc.zh:
[fromfromfrom.owner.GetSpeciesName]的行星际飞船已失败，没有幸存者。

这次失败后，[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]似乎不那么有动力探索星空。
fircon.2630.desc.en:
The [fromfromfrom.owner.GetSpeciesName] interplanetary craft has failed, there were no survivors.

After this failure, the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] seem to be less driven to explore the stars.

fircon.2635.desc.zh: 使用一块布、一个营养剂容器和一些铜线路，这艘注定要毁灭的飞船的船员成功重新获取了主推进系统的控制权。现在，有母星在身后进行支持和敬佩，它们正在继续完成任务的旅途上。
fircon.2635.desc.en: Using a piece of clothing, a nutrient container, and some copper wiring, the crew of the doomed vessel managed to regain control over their main thrusters. They are now on their way to complete their journey with the support and adoration of their homeworld behind them.

fircon.3510.desc.zh:
我们被困在虫洞里面太久了。但等等！终于，上天的恩赐帮助我们我们突破了施加于身上的桎梏。我们终于通过了考验。星系的其他地区都在等待着我们去征服。

不要反抗。从长远来看，这样会更好。
fircon.3510.desc.en:
For too long have we been trapped behind the wormhole. But behold! Finally, we have breached the restrictions placed upon us by our celestial heritage. Now, at last, we know we are worthy. The rest of the galaxy is ours to claim.

Do not resist. It will be better in the long run, that way.

fircon.3515.desc.zh:
什……？你……突破了虫洞？怎么做到的？我们的科学家已经研究了很多年都没有成功。这肯定哪里出问题了。

……
……
……

这肯定是场考验。我不信任你们！我们必须从星系中清除你们这些东西！
fircon.3515.desc.en:
Wha-? You... breached the wormhole? But how? Our best scientists have been working on it for years, without success. There must be some kind of mistake.

...
...
...

This must be a test. You are not to be trusted! We must cleanse our stars of your kind!

fircon.5000.desc.zh:
$fircon.5000.desc.base$

或许再靠近些扫描这个星系会得到更多信息。
fircon.5000.desc.en:
$fircon.5000.desc.base$

Perhaps a closer scan of the system could reveal more.

fircon.5005.desc.closed.zh:
$fircon.5000.desc.base$

看来是过去达恰星系中相邻的[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]造就了这一怪异的星系。然而通往那里的超空间航道却消失了。
fircon.5005.desc.closed.en:
$fircon.5000.desc.base$

It seems like the previously neighboring [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] in the Dacha system created this strange system. Yet the hyperlane leading there has since disappeared.

fircon.5005.desc.open.zh:
$fircon.5000.desc.base$

我们认为达恰星系中相邻的[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]与这一状况有关。
fircon.5005.desc.open.en:
$fircon.5000.desc.base$

We gather that the neighboring [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] in the Dacha system are connected to this.

fircon.5010.a.zh: 找到超空间航道通往何处！
fircon.5010.a.en: Find out where the hyperlanes lead!

fircon.5010.b.en: Do we really want to know?

fircon.5010.desc.zh:
那些星球是被移动了！

我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系探测到的异常超空间航道都连接着我们认为应该存在星球的位置。在研究了这些怪异的航道后，我们发现它们都通向同一个地方。一个叫做达恰的恒星系，本以为是无法到达的，但如果把这些狭窄的超空间航道合并起来，我们就能送一艘科研船过去。
fircon.5010.desc.en:
The planets were moved!

The abnormal hyperlanes we detected in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system were each tethered to where we previously had expected to discover worlds. After studying these strange lanes, we realize they all lead to the same place. A star system called Dacha, which was thought unreachable, yet if we were to combine all these slender hyperlanes, we could pass a science ship through.

fircon.5015.c.exterminator.zh: 检测到极高密度的有机生命。
fircon.5015.c.exterminator.en: EXTREME CONCENTRATION OF ORGANIC LIFE DETECTED.

fircon.5015.c.purifier.zh: 有了[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，那些星球会变得更好。
fircon.5015.c.purifier.en: Those worlds would look better with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on them.

fircon.5015.desc.zh:
围绕着[From.GetName]星系三颗恒星的每颗行星都是生态天堂，即盖亚星球，每一颗都能维持有机生命。由于这些星球上没有污染，起初我们认为它们可能无人居住。然而在进行了更深入的扫描后，我们在每颗星球上都发现了横亘整颗星球的大型城市。

更奇怪的是，似乎只有环绕中心恒星的行星是属于这个星系的。其他的恒星则由来自$NAME_Helito$和其他更遥远的星系的行星环绕。
fircon.5015.desc.en:
Orbiting each of the three stars in the [From.GetName] system are ecological paradises, Gaia worlds, each capable of sustaining organic life. Initially, we thought these might be uninhabited, given the lack of pollution. Yet after performing deeper scans we discovered large sprawling cities spanning each planet from end to end.

Stranger still, it seems like only the central star has planets originally from this system. The others are orbited by planets from $NAME_Helito$ and other, more remote systems.

fircon.5020.a.zh: 我们要赶快建立一座观测哨站！
fircon.5020.a.en: We need an observation outpost now!

fircon.5020.desc.zh:
调查一颗新的盖亚星球通常是一个重大事件，但它将成为[Root.GetName]的船员在未来几个月里的例行公事。这些星球包含着一些非常奇怪的[Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，它们显然还没有实现宇宙飞行，但它们的可再生能源生产可以媲美我们最高效的反应堆。

更奇怪的是资源的平均分配。每颗星球都有生存所需的一切，这应该是不可能的。我们看到只在一颗星球出产的货物抵达另一颗星球，却没有一艘运输船起飞。
fircon.5020.desc.en:
Surveying a new Gaia world is usually a momentous event but for the crew of the [Root.GetName] it is going to become routine for the next few months. The multiple worlds house some very strange [Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural], they obviously have not achieved spaceflight yet their renewable energy production rivals our most efficient reactors.

A further oddity is the equal spread of resources. Every world has everything they need to survive, which should be impossible. We are seeing goods only produced on one planet arrive on another without a single transport ship taking flight.

fircon.5020.name.zh: 遭遇哈宾特统一星球国

fircon.5026.desc.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]在某种程度上比我们更善于运用超空间航道理论。它们的每一颗星球都通过一座人造超空间航道网络相互连接。这些航道用来向其他星球运送必要的资源，如食物或建筑材料，而我们不知道它们是如何做到这一点的。

要求更多的[Root.GetScientistPlural]来研究这些星球的请求已经得到批准。虽然从它们的行星监听站的活动来看，它们应该也在观察我们。
fircon.5026.desc.en:
The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] of [From.solar_system.GetName] are somehow more adept with hyperlane theory than we are. Every one of their worlds are linked to each other through an artificial hyperlane network. These lanes are used transport necessary resources like food or building materials to their other worlds just using planet-bound trains, and we have no idea how they did it.

A request for more [Root.GetScientistPlural] to study these worlds has been approved. Though judging by the activity at their planetary listening posts; we are not the only ones looking at aliens.

fircon.5036.desc.zh:
我们以为那些能够穿越星空的人不会如此原始地诉诸暴力。

请离开。
fircon.5036.desc.en:
We thought those who could traverse the stars wouldn't be so primitive as to resort to violence.

Leave.

fircon.5036.tt.zh:
我们在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的所有舰船都在行动中失踪了。
所有通往[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的超空间航道都变得很不稳定。
fircon.5036.tt.en:
All our ships in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system have gone missing in action.
All Hyperlanes to the [From.solar_system.GetName] system have become unstable.

fircon.5040.a.tt.zh: [From.GetName]星系旁边的每个星系都建立起了新的超空间航道。
fircon.5040.a.tt.en: Every system near the [From.GetName] system has had new hyperlanes established.

fircon.5040.desc.zh: 我们已经见识过了泛星系的真面目，并选择隐居避世。然而我们还是遭到了骚扰，你们真的想看看我们的宝藏吗？那就让你们见识一下。
fircon.5040.desc.en: We have seen what kind of galaxy it is and chose to avoid it, yet again we are disturbed, do you really want to see our treasures? Then let us show you.

fircon.5050.a.en: We accept, have a good life.

fircon.5050.a.tt.zh: 太阳 X将添加到[capital_star.GetName]轨道内。
fircon.5050.a.tt.en: Sol X will be added in orbit around [capital_star.GetName].

fircon.5050.c.zh: 我们要夺走你们的秘密！

fircon.5050.c.tt.zh: 侵略这些外星人，获得超空间航道的秘密。
fircon.5050.c.tt.en: Invade the aliens to learn the secrets of the hyperlanes.

fircon.5050.desc.zh:
试图通过与[event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj]合作来获取超空间航道技术知识的进度一直缓慢得令人沮丧。要想像他们一样掌握局域超空间航道群，我们似乎需要花费数千年的时间来编制超空间波动的目录。我们收到了他们首席代表的新信息。

“老实说，你们在这里让我们越来越不舒服了，既然我们已经帮你们完成了来这里的目的，我们得请你们离开。我们判断你我双方的生活方式不可相容，担心你们在未来可能会觊觎我们拥有的东西。为了避免显得过于粗鲁，我们愿意送给你们一颗星球。我们会负责运输的，不用担心。”
fircon.5050.desc.en:
The insights we have gained into hyperlane technology through our cooperation with the [event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj] has been frustratingly slow. It seems that to achieve the mastery of a local hyperlane cluster like they have, we would need to spend thousands of years cataloging hyper-fluctuations. We have received a new communication from their chief representative.

"To be honest, your presence here has been grating, so now that we have taught you what you came for, we need to ask you to leave. Having judged that our ways of life are incompatible, we worry that you might covet what we have in the future. So to prevent any feelings of ill will, we wish to offer you one of our worlds. We will handle the transportation, don't worry."

fircon.6000.a.zh: 将他们最偏激的怀疑论者带到太空。
fircon.6000.a.en: Bring their most influential skeptics to space.

fircon.6000.b.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]才不是中空的！给他们看计算结果！
fircon.6000.b.en: [non_believers_planet.GetName] is not hollow! Show them the calculations!

fircon.6000.c.zh: 承认我们就是地底入侵者。

fircon.6000.desc.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。
fircon.6000.desc.en:
Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the ground. Their planet, [non_believers_planet.GetName], is thought to be hollow, and they believe we fly inside this central cavity using our spaceships.

These baffling beliefs are hindering our diplomatic efforts. Everything we say or do is met with the utmost suspicion.

fircon.6000.desc.subterranean.zh:
$fircon.6000.desc$。

虽然事实上就是他们错了，但是解释只会让局势变得进一步复杂。
fircon.6000.desc.subterranean.en:
$fircon.6000.desc$.

While technically they're not wrong, explaining the matter would only complicate things further.

fircon.6005.a.en: There must be a way to sway them...

fircon.6005.desc.zh:
结果[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不相信太空，或者说：他们认为天空是一块镶嵌着镜子的穹顶，群星是太阳光束折射到镜子上形成的，其他天体同理。

哪怕我们将他们带到了我们的首都，他们可能也会宣称自己从未离开过母星，或者其他同样离谱的事情。
fircon.6005.desc.en:
Turns out the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't believe in space, either: they think the sky is a glass dome filled with mirrors: stars are rays of sunlight reflected from the mirrors, as are the other celestial bodies.

Even if we were to bring them to our capital, they would probably claim they had never left their home planet, or something equally absurd.

fircon.6015.desc.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来纷乱的新闻：尽管[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不再认为我们是来自他们[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地底中心的访客，他们现在坚信自己的星球是平的，像我们这样的人是住在吊篮一样的城市里，位于[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地壳下面。
fircon.6015.desc.en: Mixed news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: while the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't think we are visitors from the center of their [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon] anymore, they are now convinced their world is flat, and people like us live on hanging cities beneath [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s crust.

fircon.6020.desc.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]出于我们的诚实向我们表达感谢。当然他们尚未完全相信我们，因为他们认为我们是来自中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的入侵者，但是至少他们理解我们没有敌意，希望他们能同我们开展合作。
fircon.6020.desc.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] thank us for our honesty. Of course they can't fully trust us yet, since they still believe we are invaders from the Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], but at least they understand we wish them no harm and are looking forward to collaborating with us.

fircon.6025.a.zh: 一起玩呗。给他们提供军事支援。
fircon.6025.a.en: Play along. Offer them military support.

fircon.6025.desc.zh: 在下定决心认为我们是中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的秘密住民之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始担忧[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的地表之下到底还藏着什么东西。军队开始在洞穴、喷泉和火山口的附近驻扎，随时准备用武力对抗任何从地下涌现出来的入侵者。
fircon.6025.desc.en: After having determined we are the secret inhabitants of Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have started worrying about what else may be lurking under the surface of [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]. Military forces have been stationed near caves, faults and volcanoes, poised to meet any further underground invaders with force.

fircon.6030.desc.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来难以置信的消息：真的有人藏在地表之下。属于某个先前未知物种的地下军队从洞穴里面涌现了出来，他们正在进攻[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是一场全面的入侵！
fircon.6030.desc.en: Incredible news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: someone really was hiding under the surface! Subterranean armies of a previously unknown species are pouring out of caves, and they're attacking the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It's a full-scale invasion!

fircon.6031.a.zh: 终于，新邻居能够讲道理了。

fircon.6031.desc.zh: 在经历了一场残酷的世界大战之后，[non_believers_country.GetName]被住在[non_believers_planet.GetName]地表下面的穴居物种彻底消灭。新近成为主导的物种注意到了我们的存在，出于某种混乱的好运，他们显然没有认为我们是来自他们行星的中心。
fircon.6031.desc.en: After a vicious world war, the [non_believers_country.GetName] has been annihilated by the subterranean race living under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface. The newly dominant species is aware of our presence, and in something of a mixed blessing, obviously does not believe we come from the center of their planet.

fircon.6032.a.zh: 至少他们现在信任我们了。
fircon.6032.a.en: At least they trust us now.

fircon.6032.desc.notroops.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，正在摧毁一切，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]绝望地寻求帮助。
fircon.6032.desc.notroops.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating, and the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are desperate for help.

fircon.6032.desc.troops.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，摧毁了这个区域的基础设施。然而，幸亏我们的军队就出现在事发点附近，大多数受灾群众都被安全地撤离。
fircon.6032.desc.troops.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating to the region's infrastructure. However, thanks to our military presence near the scene, most of the affected population was evacuated safely.

fircon.6033.desc.zh: 地底入侵防御部队的士兵驻扎在最大的洞穴和火山口旁边，他们报告称完全没有任何东西从地表下面冒出来。或许这是最好的情况，但是其中一些士兵明显十分失望。
fircon.6033.desc.en: The Subterranean Invasion Defense Force troops stationed near the biggest caves and volcanoes report that absolutely nothing has emerged from beneath the surface. It's probably for the best, although some of the soldiers look visibly disappointed.

fircon.6035.a.zh: 从社会学角度来看，很有趣；从精神上来看，真是精疲力竭的体验。
fircon.6035.a.en: A sociologically interesting but mentally exhausting experience.

fircon.6035.desc.end.zh: 他们对于宇宙奥妙的掌握还是不够完美，但至少他们准备相信我们了。
fircon.6035.desc.end.en: Their grasp of cosmology is still less than perfect, but at least now they are ready to trust us.

fircon.6035.desc.start.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望向我们表达感谢，以及正式的道歉。他们现在明白我们，事实上，并不是地底穴居人，而是来自另一个地方，那里是：
fircon.6035.desc.start.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would like to offer us their thanks, as well as an official apology. They now understand we are not, in fact, subterranean dwellers, but we come from another place entirely:

fircon.6038.desc.notroops.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，[non_believers_country.GetName]迫使地底入侵者撤退回到了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
fircon.6038.desc.notroops.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, the [non_believers_country.GetName] forced the subterranean invaders to retreat under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

fircon.6038.desc.troops.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，我们的联合部队战胜了地底入侵者，将他们赶回了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
fircon.6038.desc.troops.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, our combined forces triumphed over the subterranean invaders, forcing them back under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

fircon.7500.c.zh: 但是——嗯——我们不——没有人曾经……
fircon.7500.c.en: But- um- a- we are not- no one has ever...

fircon.7500.desc.zh:
今天，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上传来了令人意想不到的消息，一张熟悉的面容向我们问好：那是一张我们自己的脸。

最近，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj]似乎迷上了我们的外表。我们的[Species.GetEarNamePlural]似乎让他们联想到了他们的幼体。事实上，他们形容我们非常“可爱”。一种长着夸张[Species.GetEarNamePlural]的填充玩具在他们的城市里已经成了一等一的抢手货。
fircon.7500.desc.en:
Unexpected news from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as a familiar face greets us: our own.

Recently, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj] have become captivated by our form. Something about our [Species.GetEarNamePlural] seems to remind them of their young. In fact, they say that we are 'Cute.' Already, stuffed toys with exaggerated [Species.GetEarNamePlural] have become a wide-spread commodity in their cities.

fircon.7500.e.zh: 我们……我们能拥有一个吗？

fircon.7500.f.zh: 对任何使用我们形象的东西都要征收版税。
fircon.7500.f.en: We will impose royalties on any use of our likeness.

fircon.7505.a.machine.zh: 确认。你们是一个个的个体。

fircon.7505.b.zh: 告诉他们我们自己还不确定。
fircon.7505.b.en: Tell them we aren't sure ourselves.

fircon.7505.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上正在发生有趣的社会变革。

由于他们只有我们作为参考，那里的人们开始相信宇宙中的所有生命都像我们一样：互相连接、合而为一。在别无其他参照的情况下，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]急切地希望我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]能进入他们的机构。他们的误解给予我们提升他们文明的良机。然而，如果得知了外面世界的真相（包括非格式塔物种的存在），他们必定会降低对我们的信任。
fircon.7505.desc.en:
Intriguing sociological changes are taking place on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

Given they have only ourselves as a reference, the people there have come to believe that all life in the universe must be as we are: connected. One. Without another frame of reference, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than willing to allow our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] access to their institutions. Their misunderstanding could enable us to advance their civilization considerably. However, if the truth about the wider galaxy (and the existence of non-gestalt species) were to become known, they might become less trusting of us.

fircon.7510.b.regular.en: That is the nature of progress.

fircon.7510.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]进行的任务取得了成功。$fircon.7510.desc.base$
fircon.7510.desc.gestalt.en: Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] were successful with their task on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. $fircon.7510.desc.base$

fircon.7510.desc.regular.zh: 我们的科学家十分动摇地离开了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]。$fircon.7510.desc.base$
fircon.7510.desc.regular.en: Our scientists left [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today in a shaken state. $fircon.7510.desc.base$

fircon.7510.name.en: Teach a Hive How to Craft

fircon.8000.c.zh: 够了，我们的文化只属于我们。
fircon.8000.c.en: Enough of this. Our culture is our own.

fircon.8000.d.zh: 假冒者们令人作呕，叫停他们。

fircon.8000.desc.zh:
在一个有趣的跨文化交流例子中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上相当数量的年轻人对[owner.GetAdj]的所有事物产生了消费性的兴趣。这些充满激情的年轻人急切地争抢与我们文化相关的任何东西，现在他们构成了这颗星球上一个充满活力和不断发展的亚文化群体。

我们甚至得知即将到来的粉丝大会将举办一场服装大赛。
fircon.8000.desc.en:
In an amusing example of cross-cultural exchange, a significant number of young people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have developed a consuming interest in all things [owner.GetAdj]. Eagerly snatching up anything even remotely connected to our culture, these passionate youngsters now comprise a vibrant and growing subculture on the planet.

We've even been told that an upcoming fan convention will feature a costume contest.

fircon.8001.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]大会取得了令人振奋的成功！人们不分老幼都聚集在这颗星球上最大的城市，欢庆[owner.GetName]的一切事物。除了大会带来的好意以外，它还为当地经济提供了急需的推动力。

最精彩的也许是扮装比赛，大奖颁发给了我们[owner.GetRulerTitle][owner.GetRulerName]的死忠粉丝。
fircon.8001.desc.en:
The [owner.GetAdj] convention on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been a rousing success! Young and old alike gathered in the planet's largest city to celebrate all things [owner.GetName]. Apart from the good will the convention generated, it also provided a much needed boost to the local economy.

Best of all perhaps was the costume contest, in which the grand prize was awarded to a particularly devoted fan of our own [owner.GetRulerTitle] [owner.GetRulerName].

fircon.8002.desc.zh: 在我们利用影响力遏制了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上蓬勃发展的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝群之后，那里的人们都团结起来以传统方式表达自己的文化。因此，艺术和文化部门的产出有了明显的改善。
fircon.8002.desc.en: After we used our influence to curtail the burgeoning [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the people there have rallied around traditional expressions of their own culture. Accordingly, output in the arts and culture sectors has markedly improved.

fircon.8003.a.zh: 我们不需要他们的喜爱。

fircon.8003.desc.zh:
我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝采取的强硬态度引起了巨大的反弹。这颗星球上的许多人开始推崇自己的文化和传统，激烈反对[owner.GetAdj]。

这将如何影响两颗星球的外交关系，还有待观察
fircon.8003.desc.en:
Our hardline approach to the [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has precipitated a significant backlash. Rallying around their own culture and traditions, many on the planet have grown virulently anti-[owner.GetAdj].

How this may impact diplomatic relations between our worlds remains to be seen

fircon.8025.a.zh: 要求开放额外的自由港。

fircon.8025.b.zh: 我们什么事情都没做错。

fircon.8025.c.zh: 对走私贩出硬招，出狠招。

fircon.8025.desc.zh:
根据我们同[freeport_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的贸易协议，我们在他们的主要定居点附近建造了一个小型太空港。我们的商人不受规定约束，能够赚取巨额利润，但是禁止离开那片特区。

结果是，走私贩和有组织的帮派建立了一个繁荣的黑市经济。到目前为止，[freeport_species.GetAdj]选择睁一只眼闭一只眼，但是如果任由其发展，这个自由港将不可避免地被犯罪给拖垮。
fircon.8025.desc.en:
Per our trade agreement with the [freeport_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural], we have established a small spaceport near one of their major settlements. Free from regulation, our merchants are reaping massive profits, but are forbidden of leaving the complex.

As a result, smugglers and organized gangs have established a thriving black market economy. So far, the [freeport_species.GetAdj] have turned a blind eye, but if things continue, the freeport will inevitably be overrun by criminals.

fircon.8030.a.zh: 禁止贸易，设置一道封锁线。
fircon.8030.a.en: Forbid trade and set up a blockade.

fircon.8030.b.zh: 我们必须提供医疗援助！

fircon.8030.c.zh: 人命由天。但生意就是生意。
fircon.8030.c.en: People die everyday. Business is business.

fircon.8030.desc.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通美食，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的甜品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
fircon.8030.desc.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary food. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.GetName]. It is highly addictive, and extremely dangerous. Unscrupulous merchants have been moving absurd quantities of the product at exorbitant prices. As a result, many of the locals are plunging into stupor, and in the worst cases, death.

fircon.8030.desc.lith.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通矿物香料，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的调味品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
fircon.8030.desc.lith.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary mineral-based spice. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.GetName]. It is highly addictive, and extremely dangerous. Unscrupulous merchants have been moving absurd quantities of the product at exorbitant prices. As a result, many of the locals are plunging into stupor, and in the worst cases, death.

fircon.8035.a.zh: 撤回这些交易，对罪犯进行罚款。
fircon.8035.a.en: Revoke the sales and fine the culprits.

fircon.8035.c.zh: 一个发财致富的好机会……

fircon.8035.desc.zh: [landgrab_planet.GetName]传来了令人担忧的经济报告，我们的贸易商正在此地同[landgrab_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]进行贸易。当条约签署的时候，我们采取了一些措施来保障当地人的国家主权，但是我们中的一些人绕过法律，从当地的草场人手中购买了大片的土地。以目前的速率，要不了一代人[landgrab_planet.GetName]就会完全被私人贸易商给买空了。
fircon.8035.desc.en: Concerning economic reports from [landgrab_planet.GetName], where our merchants have been trading with the [landgrab_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]. When the deal was signed, measures were put in place to ensure the sovereignty of the locals, but some of our own people are skirting the law to buy up vast quantities of land through local strawmen. At the current rate, within a generation [landgrab_planet.GetName] will be wholly owned by private traders.

fircon.8040.b.zh: 或许我们可以重新商议……

fircon.8040.desc.zh: 我们同[fruitful_coop_country.GetName]签署的贸易协定带来了累累硕果。双方都遵守协定条款，贸易正在流通。一些商人呼吁在规章制度方面进一步放宽，但总体来说协定给双方都带来了益处。
fircon.8040.desc.en: The trade deal we signed with the [fruitful_coop_country.GetName] has proven extremely lucrative. The terms of the deal are being respected and trade is flowing. Some merchants continue to call for more relaxed regulation, but overall the deal has proven beneficial for both parties.

fircon.8045.c.zh: 如果他们想要我们的奴隶，那就得交税。
fircon.8045.c.en: If they want our slaves, there's a tax!

fircon.8045.desc.zh: 我们自[space_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：肆无忌惮的奴隶贩子伪装成商人，正在滥用我们的贸易协定，降落到该星球上大肆绑架当地人。当一大批[space_slavers_species.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]出现在某个地下奴隶贸易市场上的时候，我们才了解到这一行径。
fircon.8045.desc.en: Disturbing reports from the [space_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: posing as merchants, unscrupulous slavers have been abusing our Trade Deal to land on the planet and abduct the local population. We only learned of the practice when a large group of [space_slavers_species.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] was listed on an off-grid slave market.

fircon.8050.a.zh: 他们得到了他们应得的。

fircon.8050.b.zh: 不可接受。保障他们的自由。

fircon.8050.desc.zh:
我们自[preftl_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：在这颗星球的偏远地区，有几个太空旅商，主要是走私贩，连同飞船一起消失了。通过谨慎的调查，我们发现他们被迫在矿井里工作，远离窥探的视线。

令人重视的是，[preftl_slavers_country.GetName]当局并不对此负责，这些事情是由当地的几个军阀和犯罪头子干的，此外所有被绑架的个体都违反了我们同[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]签订的协议。
fircon.8050.desc.en:
We have received disturbing reports from the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: in remote regions of the planet, several spacefaring merchants, mainly smugglers, have disappeared along with their ships. A discreet investigation revealed that they were pressed into work in the mines, far from view.

It is important to note that this was not done by the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] authorities, but rather a few local warlords and criminals, and that all of the abducted individuals were in violation of the treaties we signed with the [GetPreFTLUpperPlural].

fircon.8055.c.zh: 对[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName]施加以得到更有利的交易。

fircon.8055.desc.zh:
[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]用行动证明了自己是天生的贸易商。我们自己的商人通过艰难的教训认识到当地人是如此有悟性、能说会道，当然他们对此不是很高兴。

另一方面，我们的数名经济学家相信[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的这些行为是可以效仿的。
fircon.8055.desc.en:
The [preftl_hagglers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] have proven to be incredibly adept traders. Our own merchants are learning the hard way that the locals are both savvy and persuasive, and they are not happy about it.

On the other hand, several of our economists are convinced that the behavior of the [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] could be learned from.

fircon.8060.desc.zh: 自己在宇宙中并不孤单，这一发现让[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]上的许多人感到震惊。毫不奇怪，这一事件产生了严重的经济影响。随着整颗星球上的金融机构暴跌不止，生活水平明显下降。
fircon.8060.desc.en: The revelation that they were not alone in the universe came as a shock to many on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]. Not surprisingly, the event has had severe economic effects. With financial institutions across the planet in free-fall, there has been a marked decrease in the planet's standard of living.

fircon.8065.desc.zh:
我们为[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]提供的金融刺激措施已经得到了丰厚的回报。他们的传统货币和经济机构在我们的支持下，终于稳定了下来。

也许更重要的是，公众对我们继续留在该星系中的支持度空前高涨。
fircon.8065.desc.en:
The financial stimulus we provided to [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has paid off handsomely. With their traditional currencies and economic institutions bolstered by our support, conditions have finally stabilized.

Perhaps more importantly, public approval for our continued presence in the system has never been higher.

fircon.8070.desc.zh:
我们对市场仁慈的信任得到了丰厚的回报。

摆脱了令人窒息的监管，[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]的金融机构已经稳定下来。那里的人们知道自己的经济前景一片大好，可以放心了。
fircon.8070.desc.en:
Our trust in the benevolence of the market has paid off handsomely.

Freed from the imposition of stifling regulations, financial institutions on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] have stabilized. The people there can rest secure in the knowledge that their economic future is assured.

fircon.8075.desc.zh: 我们对[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]市场自我纠正的信任变成了一场灾难，实在令人费解。事实上，星球上的状况前所未有的糟糕，人们吵着要政府加强对金融部门的监督。
fircon.8075.desc.en: Inexplicably, our trust in the market to right itself on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has been a disaster. In fact, conditions on the planet have never been worse, and the people there are clamoring for increased government oversight in the financial sector.

fircon.8500.a.zh: 没收这项技术，不能相信它们会正确使用它。
fircon.8500.a.en: Confiscate the tech. They cannot be trusted to use it correctly.

fircon.8500.b.zh: 它们决定如何使用这项技术与我们无关。
fircon.8500.b.en: What they choose to do with the tech is not our concern.

fircon.8500.desc.regular.zh:
为了促进善意，我们同意与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享我们的物质复制技术。当然，我们希望它们用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但现在我们收到的报告显示，这项技术被武器化了。

居民们有了一个大胆的想法，那就是反转复制单元的功能，这样它就不是组装预编程的物质，而是在原子水平上拆解生命体。
fircon.8500.desc.regular.en:
To foster good will, we agreed to share our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. Of course, we expected them to use it to reduce resource scarcity, but now we are receiving reports that the technology is being weaponized.

The inhabitants have arrived at the bold idea of reversing the functionality of a replication unit so rather than assembling pre-programmed matter, the device can now be used to disassemble living beings at the atomic level.

fircon.8500.desc.xenophobe.zh: 我们与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享了我们的物质复制技术。它们本来应该用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但它们愚蠢地把它武器化了。它们反转了复制单元的功能，开始制造一个可以用来在原子水平上拆解生命体的装置。
fircon.8500.desc.xenophobe.en: We shared our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. They were supposed to use it to reduce resource scarcity. But they're foolishly trying to weaponize it. By crudely reversing the functionality of a replication unit, they have started building a device which can now be used to disassemble living beings at the atomic level.

fircon.8505.desc.zh:
我们的特工到达时，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]正好在完成它们的手持式原子分解器。我们的人明确告知，赠送物质复制装置不是为了让它们这样使用的。

不出所料，它们不愿意放弃这项技术。当地政府火冒三丈，将我们的没收称作侵略行为。
fircon.8505.desc.en:
Our agents arrived just as the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] were finalizing their hand-held atomic disintegrator. They were told in no uncertain terms that this was not the intended use for the matter replication unit we gifted them.

As expected, they were reluctant to part with the technology. Tempers flared, and the local government has labeled the confiscation an aggressive act.

fircon.8510.desc.zh:
通过对我们的物质复制技术进行逆向工程，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]成功地制造了一个手持式原子分解器，并利用它大肆摧毁[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]。

在启动进一步的贸易协议之前，我们最好记住它们的毁灭倾向。
fircon.8510.desc.en:
By reverse engineering our matter replication technology, the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] have successfully built a hand-held atomic disintegrator, and are using it to wreak havoc upon [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName].

We'd do well to remember their destructive tendencies before initiating further trade deals.

fircon.8515.a.zh: 我们现在承担不起激怒蜂巢的后果。
fircon.8515.a.en: We cannot afford to antagonize the hive.

fircon.8515.desc.zh:
在[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]地表进行外交访问时，有一个孤独的[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]接近了我们。虽然[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural]是一个格式化的物种，但这个子个体认为自己是一个个体，现在向我们请求庇护。

它看到我们后显然是受到了启发，希望融入我们的社会。当被询问时，它反复说自己无法融入蜂巢，并声称自己生来就一直拥有独立的意识。
fircon.8515.desc.en:
While on a diplomatic visit to the surface of [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName], we were approached by a lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]. Although the [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural] are a gestalt species, the drone in question identifies as an individual, and is now requesting asylum.

Apparently inspired by what they have seen of us, they wish to integrate themselves into our society. When questioned, they repeatedly stated that they are unable to fit in within the hive, and claim to have possessed an individual consciousness all their life.

fircon.8520.desc.zh:
我们拒绝了孤独的[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]子个体的庇护请求。我们认为这对双方都是最好的。

没有得到我们的合作，[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]回到了同胞身边，乞求得到独立。

[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural]向我们保证这只是一个反常子个体，它后来恢复了理智，并回到了集体中。这个所谓的个体不会再出现在我们面前。

与[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]的外交继续进行。
fircon.8520.desc.en:
We refused the lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] drone's request for asylum. We believed it was in the best interest of both parties.

Without our cooperation, the [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] returned to their people, to plead for their independence.

The [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural] have assured us this was merely a deviant drone who has since seen sense, and has returned to the collective. We won't hear from the so-called individual again.

Diplomacy with [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName] continues.

fircon.8525.a.tt.zh: 一位新的科学官将被添加到$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$中。
fircon.8525.a.tt.en: A new Scientist is added to our $RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$.

fircon.8525.desc.zh: 起初，来自[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]的孤独子个体被巨大的转变所吓倒。然而，在最初的文化冲击消退后，子个体现在正在适应作为个体的生活。也许具有讽刺意味的是，它已经变得像我们一样了。
fircon.8525.desc.en: At first, the lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] drone from [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName] was overwhelmed by the scale of the transition. However, after the initial culture shock subsided, the drone is now adjusting to life as an individual. Perhaps ironically, they have become like us.

fircon.8531.a.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

fircon.8531.democratic.desc.zh:
$fircon.8531.base.desc$

他们不知道民主带给了我们什么样的好处，也不知道自由的真正味道。
fircon.8531.democratic.desc.en:
$fircon.8531.base.desc$

They know nothing of the benefits that democracy can bring, or the true taste of freedom.

fircon.8535.imperialist.desc.zh:
$fircon.8531.base.desc$

他们必须了解是什么让我们雄伟和强大的国度如此的雄伟强大。他们尚未品尝过帝国主义的滋味。
fircon.8535.imperialist.desc.en:
$fircon.8531.base.desc$

They must learn what makes our great and powerful domain so great and powerful. They have yet to experience the taste of empire.

fircon.8540.dictatorship.desc.zh:
$fircon.8531.base.desc$

我们应该将他们从这种愚行中解放出来。独裁政权的滋味将让他们重新放飞自我。
fircon.8540.dictatorship.desc.en:
$fircon.8531.base.desc$

We ought to liberate them from such folly. The taste of dictatorship shall set them free.

fircon.8545.oligarchy.desc.zh:
$fircon.8531.base.desc$

将权力集中在精心挑选的一小部分人手中是统治的唯一方法。他们是如何意识不到这一点的，这真是一个谜。
fircon.8545.oligarchy.desc.en:
$fircon.8531.base.desc$

Concentrating powers among a select few is the only way to rule. How they have not come to realize this on their own is a true mystery.

fircon.8550.desc.zh:
在将我们的政治哲学传授给他们之后，[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]沿袭我们的方式，开始了政体改革。

这些计划正在全球范围内推广，迎来[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]的一个新时代。为了纪念这一政治意义上翻天覆地的巨大变革，新的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]政府举行了一场向我们致敬的游行。
fircon.8550.desc.en:
After instructing them in our political philosophy, the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] have taken steps towards reforming their government along the lines of our own.

These initiatives are taking place on a planetary scale, ringing in a new era for the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]. To mark this dramatic political overhaul, the new [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] government held a parade in our honor.

fircon.8555.desc.zh:
在学习了我们如何运用权力之后，[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]选择维持[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的现状，认为这才是最好的进步方式。

他们已经宣誓要守住自己的本心，绝不因外部势力的影响而动摇。

外交仍然在继续进行，但毫无疑问，他们不像之前那么信任我们了。
fircon.8555.desc.en:
Having learned of our approach to power, the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] maintain that status quo on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] remains the best way forward.

They have vowed to stand their ground, and not be swayed by external forces.

Diplomacy continues, but there can be no doubt they trust us less.

fircon.8560.a.zh: 尊重是一条双向的超空间航道。
fircon.8560.a.en: Respect is a two way hyperlane.

fircon.8560.desc.zh:
相较于向对方施加压力，我们更乐于冷静地向[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]解释我们的政体权力制度背后的相关理论。

他们深深地折服于我们就不同形式政府模式所阐述的观点，对于我们不曾尝试强迫他们服从这一点，他们表示了感激。

双方各自的外交官已经缔结了长期的联系纽带，一同庆祝一场共享的宴会。基于互惠的条款，外交持续推进。
fircon.8560.desc.en:
Rather than applying any pressure outright, we calmly explained the theory behind our governing authority to the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName].

They were intrigued by the insights we provided into alternative styles of government, and were vocal in their appreciation that we made no attempt to force them into compliance.

Our respective diplomats have formed lasting ties, celebrating together over a shared banquet. Diplomacy continues on good terms.

fircon.8565.a.zh: 通知该星球的统治者，我们要灭掉这些害虫。
fircon.8565.a.en: Inform the planet's rulers that we will be exterminating the infestation.

fircon.8565.b.zh: 悄悄处理掉这一情况，没必要侮辱它们。
fircon.8565.b.en: Deal with this quietly. We need not insult them.

fircon.8565.desc.zh:
从最近一次外交访问[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的[preftl_invasives_species.GetName]返回时，我们发现了一些不寻常的偷渡者。我们的穿梭机上出现了一群无翅的、蠕动的小型节肢动物。

它们移动速度很快，而且很小，我们的传感器无法探测到它们。由于它们繁殖十分迅速，控制它们的入侵变得越来越困难。

不幸的是，对[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的人们来说，这个物种是富足的象征。我们的应对方式可能会影响我们与[preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural]的关系。
fircon.8565.desc.en:
When we returned from a recent diplomatic visit with the [preftl_invasives_species.GetName] of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName], we discovered we'd picked up some unusual stowaways. An infestation of small, wingless, wriggling arthropods had found their way aboard our shuttle.

They move fast, and are tiny enough that our sensors can't detect them. Given their rapid breeding, it has become increasingly difficult to contain the invasion.

Unfortunately, the species is a symbol of plenty to the people of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]. How we respond to this could affect our relations with the [preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural].

fircon.8570.desc.zh:
我们把正在进行中的节肢动物入侵事件告知了[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的外交官。虽然我们的直率令它们吃惊，但它们最终还是感谢了我们的诚实。

它们为净化过程中的疏忽而道歉，并提供给我们一种经过试验和测试的人道驱虫剂，在[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]很受欢迎。
fircon.8570.desc.en:
We confronted the [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName] diplomats regarding the ongoing arthropod infestation. While taken aback by our directness, they ultimately appreciated our honesty.

They apologized for not being more thorough in their decontamination processes, and offered us a tried and tested cruelty free pest repellent, popular on [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName].

fircon.8575.desc.zh:
由于不想引起外交争端，我们试图悄悄地处理最近[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]害虫泛滥的问题。

由于这种生物繁殖快速，并且它们喜好吃非有机物质，这项工作并不轻松。

当我们的外交官穿着被虫蛀得破烂不堪的衣服出现在一个会议上时，[preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural]一眼就知道发生了什么。

它们似乎为这种生物感到尴尬，于是给我们提供了一种人道的驱虫剂。
fircon.8575.desc.en:
Not wishing to cause a diplomatic issue, we attempted to quietly deal with the recent infestation of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName] pests.

This has not been a simple task given the rapid breeding of the creatures, and their penchant for eating through non-organic materials.

When our diplomats turned up to a conference in tattered, bug-eaten attire, the [preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural] knew exactly what had happened.

Seemingly embarrassed about introducing the creatures, they provided us with a cruelty-free pest repellent.

fircon.advance_tech.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will advance to their next technological age.

fircon.b.tt.zh: [pre_ftl_country.GetName]挺进到新的科技等级的速度要快25%。
fircon.b.tt.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will advance towards their future technological ages 25% faster.

fircon.distrust_diplomacy.zh: [pre_ftl_country.GetName]会不信任我们，在一段时间内拒绝与我们沟通。
fircon.distrust_diplomacy.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will distrust us and refuse to communicate for a time.

fircon.machine_exploration_protocol.zh: 棒极了。将它们加入到我们的索引库。
fircon.machine_exploration_protocol.en: Excellent. Add them to our catalog.

first_contact.1.desc.default.zh: $first_contact.1.desc.base$如果他们具有语言，我们必须进行破译才能建立交流。
first_contact.1.desc.default.en: $first_contact.1.desc.base$ If they possess a language, we must decipher it in order to establish communications.

first_contact.1.desc.devourer.zh: 我们已经成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。我们应当获取更多关于他们的信息以便确定他们是否是子个体的优质营养来源。从现在起，他们被代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。
first_contact.1.desc.devourer.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the [This.System.GetName] system. We should find out more about them so that we may decide whether they would be suitable nutrition for our drones. For now, they have been given the designation [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.1.desc.hive.zh: 我们已经成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。我们应当探明他们是否可以和我们进行沟通，如果是的话，是否应当投入我们自身的一部分来翻译他们的语言。从现在起，他们被代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。
first_contact.1.desc.hive.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the [This.System.GetName] system. We should find out whether they are capable of communicating with us, and dedicate a portion of ourselves to translating their language if this proves to be the case. For now, they have been given the designation [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.1.desc.machine.zh: 我们已经成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。我们应当探明他们是否可以和我们进行沟通，如果是的话，是否应当投入我们的翻译算法来破解他们的语言。从现在起，他们被代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。
first_contact.1.desc.machine.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the [This.System.GetName] system. We should find out whether they possess a method of communication we can parse, and dedicate our translation algorithms to decoding it if this proves to be the case. For now, they have been given the designation [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.1.desc.purifier.zh: 我们已经成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。我们应当获取更多关于他们的信息以便确定他们是否是我们的下一个净化目标。从现在起，他们被代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。
first_contact.1.desc.purifier.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the [This.System.GetName] system. We should find out more about them so we can assess whether they should be our next targets for extermination. For now, they have been given the designation [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.1.desc.terminator.zh: 我们已经成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的未知外星人建立第一次接触。我们必须尽快衡量他们是否为有机体，以方便我们将它们的灭绝程序尽早提上日程。从现在起，我们代称他们为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。
first_contact.1.desc.terminator.en: We have made first contact with unknown aliens in the [This.System.GetName] system. We must determine whether they are organic with all haste so that their termination can be scheduled, should it prove necessary. For now, they have been given the designation [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.1.desc.wilderness.zh:
我们已经成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的新生命形式建立第一次接触。我们应当探明他们是否可以和我们进行沟通。如果可以，我们也许该以自我的一种更小的部分出现——例如一个化身之类的。

在对其有更深入了解之前，他们被代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。
first_contact.1.desc.wilderness.en:
We have made first contact with mysterious new lifeforms in the [This.System.GetName] system. We do not yet know if they are capable of communicating with us. If they cannot do so, we may be compelled to present a smaller portion of ourselves - an avatar, of sorts.

Until we can learn more about these aliens, we have named them the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.1.desc.xenophobe.zh: $first_contact.1.desc.base$如果他们具有语言，我们必须进行破译才能评估他们的威胁程度。
first_contact.1.desc.xenophobe.en: $first_contact.1.desc.base$ If they possess a language, we should decipher it so that we can assess how much of a threat they pose.

first_contact.10.A.zh: 没什么需要多虑的，完全没问题。
first_contact.10.A.en: Nothing to be concerned about, surely.

first_contact.10.B.tooltip.zh: 我们会试图瘫痪并夺取它们的舰船。它们会对我们的行径十分愤怒。
first_contact.10.B.tooltip.en: We will attempt to disable and seize their vessel. They will likely be outraged at this course of action.

first_contact.10.authoritarian.desc.proa.zh: 近期一艘未知飞船到访[This.System.GetName]星系的行为吸引了[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]的注意。该飞船的设计与我们现有的所有设计均不相匹配，说明我们有可能在于一个外星文明进行初次接触。如果[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]批准的话，我们就可以开始分析收集到的数据来破译其语言。
first_contact.10.authoritarian.desc.proa.en: The recent visit of an unknown vessel in the [This.System.GetName] system has captured the attention of the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]. The spacecraft's design does not match anything in our records, suggesting that we are dealing with a possible first contact scenario with an alien civilization. If the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] permits, we can begin an analysis of the data we have collected to see if their language can be translated.

first_contact.10.desc.attack_allowed.zh: $first_contact.10.desc.base$众多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对当前的局势发展表示高度担忧，要求我们扣押这些无礼闯入的舰船，这样我们能够对其进行审问，而不用冒险让敏感信息落入它们之手。
first_contact.10.desc.attack_allowed.en: $first_contact.10.desc.base$ Many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are highly concerned at this development and demand that we seize the impudent vessel so that we can interrogate them at our leisure, without risking sensitive information falling into their hands.

first_contact.10.desc.attack_allowed.ges.zh: $first_contact.10.desc.base$我们的军用哨兵机已经准备就绪，随时准备扣押这些舰船并审问——或者解剖——船里的外星人，而不用冒险让敏感信息落入它们之手。
