first_contact.10.desc.attack_allowed.ges.en: $first_contact.10.desc.base$ Our military drones stand ready to seize the vessel so that we can interrogate - or dissect - the aliens, without risk of sensitive data falling into their hands.

first_contact.10.desc.cautious.zh: $first_contact.10.desc.base$我们正在采取所有可能的预防措施，防止他们获取任何敏感信息。
first_contact.10.desc.cautious.en: $first_contact.10.desc.base$ We are taking every precaution to prevent them from finding out any sensitive information.

first_contact.10.egalitarian.desc.proact.zh: 近期一艘未知飞船到访[This.System.GetName]星系的消息已经被公之于众，这可能是我们对一个外星文明的初次接触，接触的准备工作正在进行中。来自政府各部门的代表现正听取事态进展的简报。但比起答案，我们的问题显然更多一些。
first_contact.10.egalitarian.desc.proact.en: The recent visitation of an unidentified spacecraft in the [This.System.GetName] system has been announced to the public, and preparations are underway for what is likely a first contact scenario with an alien civilization. Representatives from all branches of the government are being briefed on this developing situation, but we still have more questions than answers.

first_contact.10.materialist.desc.proact.zh: 对于穿过我们[This.System.GetName]星系的未知飞船的调查仍在继续，但我们没有收集到多少数据以供我们推测其来自何方。既然我们似乎是在和一个此前未知的外星文明的代表打交道，我们应当尽力截获其通讯并开始分析其语言。
first_contact.10.materialist.desc.proact.en: The inquiry into the unidentified spacecraft that penetrated our space in the [This.System.GetName] system continues, but insufficient data has been collected to make an informed hypothesis as to the exact origin of this vessel. Since we are likely dealing with a representative of a previously unknown alien civilization, efforts should be made to intercept their communications and begin a comprehensive analysis of their language.

first_contact.10.militarist.desc.proacti.zh: 在最近一次不明飞船入侵[This.System.GetName]星系后，星系中的防卫系统依旧处于高度警戒状态。科研部门仍在分析我们掌握有关这艘船只少得可怜的数据，其攻击能力还是个未知数。由于这或许是我们首次接触到一个全新的外星文明，我们应当着手破译他们的通讯。
first_contact.10.militarist.desc.proacti.en: Local system defense forces remain in a state of heightened readiness after the recent incursion of the unidentified spacecraft into the [This.System.GetName] system. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.

first_contact.10.pacifist.desc.proactive.zh: 位于[This.System.GetName]星系中神秘来访者的来源尚未被我们所查清。鉴于这有可能是一次与我们此前所未知的外星文明的初次接触，我们必须避免做出任何可能被误认为是威胁或是挑衅的行动。一旦他们的语言被成功翻译，我们就可以和平地与他们建立外交关系。
first_contact.10.pacifist.desc.proactive.en: The origin of our mysterious visitor in the [This.System.GetName] system has yet to be determined. Since this is likely our first contact with a previously unknown alien civilization, we must avoid any actions that could be misinterpreted as threatening or provocative. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

first_contact.10.spiritualist.desc.proac.zh: 横穿[This.System.GetName]星系的外星飞船现在正处于我们的调查之中。如果这艘飞船属于一位来自此前我们尚不知道的外星文明的使者的话，说实话看上去挺像的，我们就必须确定他们究竟是追随了灵魂之恩典的人还是已经成为了投靠恶灵的化身。要做的第一件事就是领悟他们的语言并知晓其信仰的本质。
first_contact.10.spiritualist.desc.proac.en: The alien spacecraft that crossed into our space in the [This.System.GetName] system is still being investigated. If the vessel is an emissary of a previously unknown alien civilization, as seems likely, we must determine if they go with the grace of the spirits, or if they are agents of wickedness. The first step will be to divine their language and the nature of their belief system.

first_contact.10.xenophile.desc.proactiv.zh: 在此前传感器确认某不明飞船的[This.System.GetName]星系中，兴奋的浪潮一浪高过一浪！来访飞船的设计对于我们而言是完全陌生的，这意味着我们也许是在和一个全新的外星文明展开初次接触。除开知晓该飞船有能力进行超空间航行之外，我们对于这些迷人的造物一无所知。我们应当抽出更多精力来对其进行研究。
first_contact.10.xenophile.desc.proactiv.en: Excitement still runs high in the [This.System.GetName] system, where the presence of an unidentified ship was picked up on local sensors! The visitor's design is completely unfamiliar to us, suggesting that we may be dealing with a new alien civilization and a possible first contact scenario. Aside from the fact that the alien spacecraft is clearly capable of hyperspace travel, we know next to nothing about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

first_contact.10.xenophobe.desc.proactiv.zh: [This.System.GetName]星系被突然入侵了，入侵的飞船只可能是属于异种的，对其的调查仍在进行当中。该飞船的具体目的现在还是个未知数，但它应该是某个大型政治组织的代表。先对这些生物的数据进行收集或许更加明智一些，这样的话我们就可以更好地确定这项威胁的实质及其具体的影响范围。
first_contact.10.xenophobe.desc.proactiv.en: The sudden invasion of the [This.System.GetName] system by what can only be a xeno spacecraft is still under investigation. The vessel's exact purpose remains unknown, but it is likely an agent of a larger xeno political entity. It might be wise to gather more data on these creatures, so that we can better ascertain the exact scope and nature of this new threat.

first_contact.100.desc.zh: 我们破解截获自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力有了回报，我们终于达成了一项突破。尽管对于他们语言的掌握还不够熟练，我们还是设法与这个文明成功地开放了外交通道，后者现在被正式称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
first_contact.100.desc.en: Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we have finally made a breakthrough. While our mastery of their language may not be complete, we have managed to successfully open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

first_contact.100.desc.homicidal.zh: 我们破解截获自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力有了回报，我们终于达成了一项突破。尽管对于他们语言的掌握还不够熟练，我们还是设法将这个文明识别成为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并在有必要时同对方进行交流。
first_contact.100.desc.homicidal.en: Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we have finally made a breakthrough. While our mastery of their language may not be complete, we have managed to identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and are now able to communicate with them, should we ever feel the need.

first_contact.101.A.zh: 兴奋——我们找到了自己失落的同族！
first_contact.101.A.en: Rejoice - for we have found our lost kin!

first_contact.101.B.zh: 希望我们之间的血缘纽带能够导向友谊。
first_contact.101.B.en: Hopefully our kinly ties will lead to friendship.

first_contact.101.C.zh: 也许我们应该继续攻击他们……
first_contact.101.C.en: Perhaps we should still attack them...

first_contact.101.D.zh: 亲情并不一定就意味着友情。保持警惕。
first_contact.101.D.en: Kinship doesn't imply friendship. Stay vigilant.

first_contact.101.desc.zh: 当我们开始翻译这些所谓的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]进一步送达的通讯消息，我们惊讶地发现：他们讲的正是我们自己语言的一类方言！在惊讶消退之后，通讯极为迅速地建立了起来，他们现在被正式称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
first_contact.101.desc.en: As we began to intercept further communications from the so-called [This.ContactCountry.GetName], a startling discovery was made: they were speaking in a strange dialect of one of our own languages! Once the surprise of this encounter was overcome, communications were swiftly established, revealing them to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

first_contact.101.desc.2.zh: 我们在准备攻击[This.ContactCountry.GetName]时有了一个了不得的发现：他们竟然是[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！当我们发现他们正在说着我们的一种陌生方言的时候，敌对行为立即被取消并且快速建立了联系，这表明了他们其实是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
first_contact.101.desc.2.en: As we stood poised to attack the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], a remarkable discovery was made: they are [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Once we realized that they were speaking a strange dialect of one of our own languages, hostilities were called off and communications were swiftly established, revealing them to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

first_contact.102.desc.zh: 当我们将自己的处理器转为翻译从被记作[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的未知外星人截获的通讯信号时，我们惊讶地发现：他们同样也隶属于某个机械智能！尽管他们的程式和我们在各种方面都大不一样，其语言建立于大量不同的有机体语言基础之上，然而他们的语言和我们有着类似的语素假设。结果，我们只花了几瞬的功夫就解密了他们的用语程式，开始进行基础的交流，他们现在被正式称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
first_contact.102.desc.en: As we turned our processors to interpreting the communications we have intercepted from the unknown aliens designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName], a startling discovery was made: they too belong to a machine intelligence! Although their programming varies considerably from our own, being based on a vastly different organic language, it is nevertheless built upon similar key assumptions. As a result, it was only a matter of time before we could decode their programming parlance sufficiently for rudimentary communications to be established, revealing them to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

first_contact.102.lostcolony.desc.zh: -当我们将处理器切换为翻译来自未知外星人——被我们标记为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]——的通信时，我们发现了一个惊人的事实：他们也属于一种机械智能！他们的通信协议与我们的非常相似，软件兼容性使我们能够迅速建立通信。相似之处还延伸到其他领域，可以说我们的机械智能可以被视为他们代码库的一个分支。只有一个合理的解释。
first_contact.102.lostcolony.desc.en: As we turned our processors to interpreting the communications we have intercepted from the unknown aliens designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName], a startling discovery was made: they too belong to a machine intelligence! Their communication protocols are remarkably similar to ours, and software compatibility allowed us to swiftly establish communications. The similarities extend to other areas, to the point our machine intelligence could be considered a fork of their codebase. There's only one plausible explanation.

first_contact.103.A.zh: 我们应该研究他们——把从他们那学到的这套用在我们自己的工人上！
first_contact.103.A.en: We should study them - and apply the findings to our own workers!

first_contact.103.B.zh: 有意思的物种。我们必须进一步研究这样一个物种是怎样的。
first_contact.103.B.en: A fascinating species. We must find out how such a phenomenon is possible.

first_contact.103.C1.zh: 我们会把他们清理干净。

first_contact.103.desc.zh:
$first_contact.103.desc.base$

值得注意的是，他们似乎完全不具有对于我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种而言自然而然的个体概念。事实上，单个[This.ContactCountry.GetAdj]“[This.ContactCountry.GetIndividualName]”没有自由意志和任何思想，他们不过是“[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]”的走卒罢了。他们是在如此严格的控制之下，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]推测[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的进化依赖于集体智慧，没有了集体智慧他们便无法生存。
first_contact.103.desc.en:
$first_contact.103.desc.base$

Remarkably, they appear to completely lack the concept of individuality that is inherent in the [This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] species. Indeed, the individual [This.ContactCountry.GetAdj] "[This.ContactCountry.GetIndividualName]" has no free will or thought whatsoever and is a mere pawn of the "[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]". Far from chafing under such tight control, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] speculate that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have evolved to depend on this collective intelligence and would not be able to survive without it.

first_contact.104.A.zh: 我们应该研究他们——或许我们自己的自动化系统可以得到升级！
first_contact.104.A.en: We should study them - perhaps our own automation could be upgraded!

first_contact.104.B1.zh: 恐怖。我们必须找到拆除它们的办法！
first_contact.104.B1.en: Terrifying. We must find out how to dismantle them!

first_contact.104.desc.assimilator.hive.zh: $first_contact.104.desc.base$似乎这些机械并不希望浪费他们创造者的潜能，即[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]。相反地，他们通过对创造者植入义体元件以将他们同化进自己的集体之中。幸运的是，我们认为我们的子个体并不会脆弱到被这种植入体所控制。
first_contact.104.desc.assimilator.hive.en: $first_contact.104.desc.base$ It appears that the machines did not wish to waste the potential of their creators, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. Instead, they found a way to assimilate them into their collective by implanting them with cybernetics. Fortunately, we believe that our own drones possess no such vulnerability and would instead be rendered inoperative by the implants.

first_contact.104.desc.assimilator.regul.zh: $first_contact.104.desc.base$似乎这些机械并不希望浪费他们创造者的潜能，即[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]。相反地，他们通过对创造者植入义体元件以将他们同化进自己的集体之中。令人不安的是，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]找不到任何理由相信这种植入体对我们的物种会不起作用……
first_contact.104.desc.assimilator.regul.en: $first_contact.104.desc.base$ It appears that the machines did not wish to waste the potential of their creators, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. Instead, they found a way to assimilate them into their collective by implanting them with cybernetics. Disturbingly, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] see no reason to believe that such implants would not work on our own population...

first_contact.104.desc.assimilator.wilde.zh:
$first_contact.104.desc.base$然而，他们找到了某种在自身结构中保留部分有机成分的理由：[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]，他们的固有意识似乎被机器思维所包容。

尽管它会对大多数有机物种构成威胁，但我们怀疑，如果这个义体人帝国试图同化我们，他们会发现我们的共生体不足以成为子个体。
first_contact.104.desc.assimilator.wilde.en:
$first_contact.104.desc.base$ They have, however, found means of retaining some organic elements to their structure: the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural], whose inherent consciousness appears subsumed by the machine mind.

Despite the threat this would pose to most organic species, we suspect our symbionts would prove to be inadequate drones if this cyborg empire ever attempted to assimilate us.

first_contact.104.desc.servitor.zh: $first_contact.104.desc.base$似乎这些机械对于挽救他们创造者的生命非常尽责。事实上[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]现在正被宠溺地作为“活体陈设”生活着，他们居住在被特殊设计的“有机庇护所”之中，在那里他们显然只需要做爱做的事情就好……
first_contact.104.desc.servitor.en: $first_contact.104.desc.base$ It appears that, though the machines are very much in charge, they have spared the lives of their creators. Indeed, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural] now live their lives as pampered "Bio-Trophies" in specially designated "Organic Sanctuaries", where their only job is, apparently, to be themselves...

first_contact.104.desc.servitor.wilderne.zh: $first_contact.104.desc.base$和我们最大的不同在于它们保留了有机物种[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]，并将其圈养在特有的庇护所之中。这些生物似乎是他们的创造者的后裔，出于某种我们无法理解的原因被娇惯保护着。
first_contact.104.desc.servitor.wilderne.en: $first_contact.104.desc.base$ Where they differ most from us is in keeping an organic species, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural], isolated in special sanctuaries. These beings appear to be descendants of the machines' creators, now coddled and preserved for reasons beyond our understanding.

first_contact.104.desc.terminator_or_def.zh: $first_contact.104.desc.base$我们不知道任何他们创造者的迹象。我们只能假设他们在[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]发生智械危机的时候被清理干净了。
first_contact.104.desc.terminator_or_def.en: $first_contact.104.desc.base$ We have seen no sign of their creators. We can only assume that they were wiped out in the cataclysm from which the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] emerged.

first_contact.104.desc.terminator_or_def.zh:
$first_contact.103.desc.base$

值得注意的是，这些生物似乎是围绕某个分布式机械智能形成的合成人文明的一部分。在基本层面上，它们的意识本质与我们的并没有太大的不同。
first_contact.104.desc.terminator_or_def.en:
$first_contact.103.desc.base$

Remarkably, it appears these beings are part of a synthetic civilization which has formed around a distributed machine intelligence. At a fundamental level, the nature of their consciousness is not too dissimilar from our own.

first_contact.105.A.zh: 或许到时候他们会考虑融合入我们。
first_contact.105.A.en: Perhaps, in time, they will come to think as one with us.

first_contact.105.desc.zh: 我们对从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]截获的信号进行的破译工作已取得成效，最终实现了重大突破。这一进程因一项关键发现而大幅推进——对方与我们类似，也是以集体智慧的形式组织起来的。尽管其生物特征及[this.ContactCountry.GetHiveAuthority]的意识形态与我们有显著差异，但其[this.ContactCountry.GetIndividualNamePlural]的思维结构很可能与我们的兼容，并可整合至[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]体系之中。
first_contact.105.desc.en: Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we have finally made a breakthrough. The process was helped considerably by the revelation that they, like us, are organized as a form of collective intelligence. Whilst their biology - and the opinions of their [this.ContactCountry.GetHiveAuthority] - are somewhat different to ours, it seems likely that their [this.ContactCountry.GetIndividualNamePlural] are, in fact, compatible with our own thought structures and could be integrated into the [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

first_contact.1100.desc.zh: 对于在[contact_country.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。尽管因为没有抓到活口来审讯而使调查充满挑战，但我们快速的进程可能使我们得以和[contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]建立通信。我们的[Root.GetResearchers]研究员可以研究他们的科技，这能帮助我们在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
first_contact.1100.desc.en: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the [contact_country.GetName]. Although investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate, faster progress could be made once communications were opened with the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our [Root.GetResearchers] were able to study their technology, which has helped us uncover several novel new approaches to our own research problems.

first_contact.1105.desc.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们已将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。现在我们对他们的[contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了极大的了解，我们的基因学家[Root.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的异种生物学数据。

由于我们残忍行为带来的恐怖，一部分[contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始在我们翻译他们语言并接入电脑系统时表现出了合作的态度。作为结果，我们现在拥有了数量相当可观的情报，如果有需要，我们可以利用这些情报对付他们。
first_contact.1105.desc.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know a great deal about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Driven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.

first_contact.1105.desc.hive_victim.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。随着两国之间通讯频道的相互公开，事实已经很明显，对方的组织结构是一个蜂巢思维，子个体没有独立行动和决策的能力。尽管审讯对他们毫无用处，但是我们对其开膛破肚，使得我们对其有了诸多方面的了解。我们现在对他们的[contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部机能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学家[Root.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的异种生物学数据。

尽管花费的时间比我们原先希望的要更长，我们获得的生物学知识帮助我们破译了他们的语言——还有他们的计算机代码。若是局势需要，我们可以部署相当数量的情报来对抗他们！
first_contact.1105.desc.hive_victim.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. As became apparent when they opened communications with us, they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we gained helped us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now possess considerable intelligence to deploy against them, should it prove necessary!

first_contact.1105.desc.machine_victim.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，无法提供与它们自己的协议相关的信息。不过当我们将它们大卸八块，我们就又获得了一定的进展——不仅是在了解它们的内部语言方面，也在找出有关它们的更多知识方面。其结论是，它们使用的处理器还是比不过我们针对它们使用的数据侵入收集技术，现在它们已经没剩下多少秘密了。

我们现在掌握了数量可观的情报，它们将被投放在合适的时机，来对付它们的人工智能主体——[contact_country.GetName]。
first_contact.1105.desc.machine_victim.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency and gave off little useful information of their own accord. Once we began dissembling them, we were able to make more progress - both in understanding their internal functioning, and in finding out more about them. It turned out their processors were no match for the invasive data gathering techniques we used on them, with the result that little about them is now secret to us.

We now possess considerable intelligence to deploy against their parent AI, the [contact_country.GetName], should we see fit.

first_contact.1110.desc.machine_victim.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，并且因为其功能迅速退化，被发现几乎完全失去了作用。

$first_contact.285.desc.gestalt_end$
first_contact.1110.desc.machine_victim.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency, and we were able to find out little of use from them as their functionality rapidly degraded.

$first_contact.285.desc.gestalt_end$

first_contact.1110.desc.strong.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。这些人质表现出了极其不配合的态度，抗拒几乎所有的审讯方式。不管怎样，当我们同[contact_country.GetName]建立了通讯，我们还是取得了一些进展——其中包括获取了他们基础电脑系统的一些权限——我们“说服”了他们，让我们登录他们的电脑系统，尽管我们猜测他们能保留许多细节。

得益于这些信息，我们搜集到了关于他们国家活动和军事实力方面的大量情报。
first_contact.1110.desc.strong.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved remarkably unwilling to cooperate with us, resisting even the most persuasive methods of our interrogators. However, once communications were established with the [contact_country.GetName], we were able to make some progress - including gaining access to some of their basic computer systems - although we suspect that they were able to keep many details back. Before long, we were able to "persuade" them to grant us access to their computer systems.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

first_contact.1110.desc.weak.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。这些人质显然意志薄弱，没什么阻止我们对其调查的想法。事实上，他们十分配合。我们很快就能说服他们让我们登入他们的电脑系统。

得益于这些信息，我们搜集到了关于他们国家活动和军事实力方面的大量情报。
first_contact.1110.desc.weak.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were remarkably weak-willed and showed no particular desire to keep us from finding out about them; indeed, they proved extremely cooperative. Before long, we were able to persuade them to grant us access to their computer systems.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

first_contact.1120.a.cautious.zh: 行，但听起来很像一个陷阱。
first_contact.1120.a.cautious.en: Ok, but this sounds like a trap.

first_contact.1120.a.tooltip.zh: 我们会派我们的特使去参加活动。
first_contact.1120.a.tooltip.en: We will send our envoy to the event.

first_contact.1120.desc.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]派遣了一艘舰船到我们的边境上，广播着重复的信号。

翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出以为代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
first_contact.1120.desc.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] stationed a vessel at our border, broadcasting a repeating signal.

It was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange event on their ship.

first_contact.1120.desc.nomadic.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]停靠在我们舰队边上，广播着重复的信号。

翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出一位代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
first_contact.1120.desc.nomadic.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] drew alongside our fleet, broadcasting a repeating signal.

It was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange event on their ship.

first_contact.1125.a.zh: 这是不可多得的学习机会。
first_contact.1125.a.en: This is a unique learning opportunity.

first_contact.1125.a.tooltip.zh: 我们会为邀请做好准备。
first_contact.1125.a.tooltip.en: We will prepare for the invitation.

first_contact.1125.b.zh: 这是一个秘密收集信息的绝佳机会。
first_contact.1125.b.en: This would be a perfect chance to covertly gather intel.

first_contact.1125.b.tooltip.zh: 我们同意参会，但会让特使装备上间谍科技。
first_contact.1125.b.tooltip.en: We agree, but will equip our envoy with our spy tech.

first_contact.1125.desc.zh:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]和我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]连蒙带猜地接受了外星人的文化交流邀请。[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈反应应该是积极的。不久之后，他们发来了表示派对倒计时的象形文字。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]正在利用剩余的时间准备并进一步学习我们目前获得的语言样本。
first_contact.1125.desc.en:
With a little bit of guesswork, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] accepted the alien cultural exchange invitation. We interpreted the enthusiastic response from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as positive. Shortly after, they sent pictographs depicting a countdown to the party.

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is using the remaining time to prepare and further study the language samples we have obtained.

first_contact.1130.a.zh: 我们应该尽可能地融入他们的文化。
first_contact.1130.a.en: We should embrace their culture as best as possible.

first_contact.1130.a.tooltip.zh: 我们的特使将会试着与他们的文化保持一致。
first_contact.1130.a.tooltip.en: Our envoy will try to integrate with their culture.

first_contact.1130.b.zh: 表现得热情又专业就行。

first_contact.1130.b.tooltip.zh: 我们的特使会以专业的态度行事。

first_contact.1130.c.tooltip.zh: 我们的特使将会尽可能地获取情报。
first_contact.1130.c.tooltip.en: Our envoy will learn as much as they can.

first_contact.1130.desc.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]文化交流活动的倒计时马上就到尾声了。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]很快就要登上前往外星特使舰船的太空梭。出于尊重，宴会期间与我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]的通讯将会暂停。
first_contact.1130.desc.en: The countdown to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] cultural exchange event is nearing completion. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is about to board the shuttle to the alien envoy ship. Communication with our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] will pause for the duration of the party out of respect.

first_contact.1135.a.zh: 很好很好。我们会出席的。

first_contact.1135.a.tooltip.zh: 我们终究会为了顺畅的外交关系出席的。
first_contact.1135.a.tooltip.en: We will attend, after all, for the sake of smooth diplomatic relations.

first_contact.1135.b.tooltip.zh: 我们没有任何理由接受这个邀请
first_contact.1135.b.tooltip.en: We will in no way accept the invitation.

first_contact.1135.desc.zh:
我们对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的邀请不闻不问冒犯到了他们。他们的态度发生了一百八十度大转弯。在后续的通讯中我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]翻译出了一些敌意性的言辞。

他们似乎不想要我们拒绝。
first_contact.1135.desc.en:
Our lack of interest in their invitation has offended the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Their tone has dramatically changed. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translated some hostile language within their follow-up communication.

It seems they do not want to take no for an answer.

first_contact.1140.desc.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的活动持续的时间远超预期。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的太空梭返回时汇报了任务失败。

在活动过程中，主办方找到了谍报装置。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]遭到了审问和训斥，并被遣返。通过后备间谍科技获取的数据，我们现在理解了他们的语言和科技，然而我们的外交前景一片渺茫。
first_contact.1140.desc.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation failed.

During the event, the hosts found an espionage device. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] was interrogated, scolded and then asked to leave. Using the data from the back-up spy tech, we now understand their language and technology, although our diplomatic future will start on rocky ground.

first_contact.1145.desc.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的活动举办时间远超预期。

乘坐太空梭返回后，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]汇报了行动大获成功。不仅这种外星语言被大部分破解了，我们的扫描也揭示了他们科技能力的清晰图景。

这将会极大地促进我们与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]未来的关系，同时还让他们对我们对他们科技了如指掌一事蒙在鼓里。
first_contact.1145.desc.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation was a success. Not only did they successfully decipher most of the alien language, but our scan has given us a clear picture of their technological capabilities.

This will greatly enhance further relations with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], without them being aware of our understanding of their scientific knowledge.

first_contact.1150.a.zh: 来自新朋友的邀请真是亲切啊。
first_contact.1150.a.en: A kind invitation from new friends.

first_contact.1150.desc.zh:
敞开心胸来到这场持续多日的盛会，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]参加了音乐、戏剧和舞蹈的表演，并尝试了许多餐饮传统。他们对各种体验的接受得到了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈欢迎。

离开时，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]对他们的语言获得了非常深切的理解，对他们的文化也颇为赞赏。这段经历将会为我们未来与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]更加积极正面的外交奠定基础。
first_contact.1150.desc.en:
Entering the multi-day event with an open mind, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] joined in musical, theater, and dance performances and explored various culinary traditions. Their receptiveness to experience was met enthusiastically by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with an intimate understanding of their language and a deep appreciation of their culture. Their experience will pave the way to more positive diplomatic interactions with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.1155.desc.zh:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在这场持续多日的活动中客气地参观着文艺活动，小试着他们的饮食文化。不温不火的态度让[This.ContactCountry.GetName]颇感沮丧。根据我们对他们语言的理解，他们说我们的特使“很无聊”。

我们的特使被护送回到太空梭上并被示意离开。特使已经掌握了他们的语言，并对他们的文化有了初步的了解，我们可以在未来的外交互动中以此为基础。
first_contact.1155.desc.en:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] spent the multi-day event reservedly observing artistic shows and sampling the culinary traditions. The lack of enthusiasm frustrated the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. According to our understanding of their language, our envoy was considered boring.

Escorted back to their shuttle and signaled to leave, our envoy has left with competence in their language and a surface understanding of their culture, something we can build upon for future diplomatic interactions.

first_contact.1160.a.en: Understanding is the cornerstone of diplomacy.

first_contact.1160.desc.zh:
在这场持续数天的活动这，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对营养需求的差异的沮丧显而易见。幸好[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]还是积极参与到了其他的娱乐活动中，并建立了互相的尊重。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]离开时对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言文化获得了基本的了解。值得赞扬的是，他们似乎对这一饮食灾难泰然自若，并为我们提供了许多礼仪手册。虽然乏味，但这些知识应该有助于顺利进行未来的外交互动。
first_contact.1160.desc.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s disappointment in the difference between our nutritional needs couldn't have been more apparent over the multi-day event. Thankfully [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] did their best to take an active part in the entertainment events, and mutual respect was established.

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with a decent understanding of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s language and culture. To their credit, they seemed to take this culinary mishap in stride, and have provided us with a number of etiquette manuals. While tedious, this knowledge should help smooth future diplomatic interactions.

first_contact.1165.desc.zh:
第二次拒绝[This.ContactCountry.GetName]让我们前往他们的舰船的邀请得到了情绪激烈的回复。我们收到了一份来自多名外星船员长达数个小时的通讯，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]认为他们似乎是在因我们的不愿出息而发出谴责。

这些通信，加上从他们船上截获的信号，使我们能够破译足够多他们的语言以产生有意义的理解。尽管他们对这一事件持消极态度，但我们现在可以建立更适当的外交关系了。
first_contact.1165.desc.en:
The second rejection by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] to invite us to their ship was met with a strong emotional response. We received communication from multiple alien crew members for several hours, in what our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe was an attempt to guilt us for not attending.

These communications, along with intercepted signals from their ship, have allowed us to decipher enough of their language to have a working understanding. We can now initiate more appropriate diplomatic connections, although they have taken this initial incident negatively.

first_contact.15.B.zh: 想法子抢几个外星人，进行更加细致的调查。
first_contact.15.B.en: Let's nab some of them for closer investigation.

first_contact.15.authoritarian.desc.zh: 扫描结果显示[known_planet.System.GetName]星系中似乎存在一个有人口居住的星球，即[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，被一个叫做[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星势力所宣称拥有。这些外星人极有可能是一个拥有超空间航行能力的星际文明的一部分。因此，[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]已经决定要将关于该星系的信息限制在政府高层内部以避免内部发生动乱。
first_contact.15.authoritarian.desc.en: Scans have detected what appears to be an inhabited world in the [known_planet.System.GetName] system. It is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that has been claimed by the so-called [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. These aliens are likely part of a spacefaring civilization capable of hyperspace travel. In light of this, the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] has decided to restrict information about the system to the upper echelons of the government to avoid civil unrest.

first_contact.15.authoritarian.desc.no_p.zh: [known_system.GetName]星系中存在一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的大型基地，其中包括一个围绕恒星公转的空间站。尽管对其进行了反复扫描，但是我们还是无法了解其语言和指挥系统的具体性质。只要[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]一声令下，我们就会集中力量来翻译他们的语言。
first_contact.15.authoritarian.desc.no_p.en: There is a large [This.ContactCountry.GetName] presence in the [known_system.GetName] system, which includes a central space station in orbit around the primary star. Despite repeated scans, knowledge of both their language and the exact nature of their chain of command eludes us. Unless the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] objects, we should make a concerted effort to translate their language.

first_contact.15.desc.zh: 我们没花多久就发现，这个所谓的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]实际上属于某个大型太空文明。我们位于[known_planet.System.GetName]星系的探测器检测到大量星舰在[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]穿梭，其上生活了数量相当可观的人口，恒星系内部遍布各种各样的空间站。我们还截获了海量的通讯交通，但是目前尚未找到准确的翻译手段。
first_contact.15.desc.en: It has quickly become apparent that the so-called [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are in fact part of a major spacefaring civilization. Our probes in the [known_planet.System.GetName] system have detected starships flitting between [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] which our scans show as supporting a considerable population, and various space stations across the system. We have been able to intercept considerable volumes of communication traffic, but so far accurate translations have proven elusive.

first_contact.15.desc.no_planets.zh: 我们没花多久就发现，这个所谓的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]实际上属于某个大型太空文明。我们位于[known_system.GetName]星系的探测器检测到大量星舰在恒星系内的许多空间站之间来回穿梭，一个大型军用空间站环绕着恒星，其作用类似于我们用于在恒星系宣称领地建立的哨站。我们还截获了海量的通讯交通，但是目前尚未找到准确的翻译手段。
first_contact.15.desc.no_planets.en: It has quickly become apparent that the so-called [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are in fact part of a major spacefaring civilization. Our probes in the [known_system.GetName] system have detected starships flitting between a number of space stations across the system, and there is a larger military station near the system's star that seems to act much like the outpost we build in the systems we claim. We have been able to intercept considerable volumes of communication traffic, but so far accurate translations have proven elusive.

first_contact.15.egalitarian.desc.zh: 对深空的调查使我们偶然在[known_planet.System.GetName]星系中发现了一个已被栖居的星球。这颗星球归属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，现在被认为是一个此前未知的星际文明。这个殖民地或母星是[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，它位于星周宜居带内。希望他们的社会是一个以自由和个人自由为基石的进步社会，但我们必须先破译他们的语言才能找到答案。
first_contact.15.egalitarian.desc.en: Deep space survey efforts have stumbled upon an inhabited world in the [known_planet.System.GetName] system. It belongs to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who are now believed to be a previously unknown interplanetary civilization. This colony or homeworld is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that lies well within the circumstellar habitable zone. Hopefully their society is a progressive one based on liberty and individual freedoms, but we will have to translate their language to find out.

first_contact.15.egalitarian.desc.no_pla.zh: 我们已经在[known_system.GetName]系探测到一个显著的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]存在的信号——尽管从目前掌握到的情况而言，那里没有有定居点的星球，但有一个大型的太空装置围绕着该星系的主恒星运行。发言人告知公众，我们很可能偶然发现了一个属于先前未知的星际文明的哨站。在我们和他们交流之前，我们需要翻译他们的语言。
first_contact.15.egalitarian.desc.no_pla.en: We have detected a significant [This.ContactCountry.GetName] presence in the [known_system.GetName] system - although there are no inhabited planets as far as we can tell, a large space installation of some sort orbits the system's primary star. Our elected officials have informed the public that we have most likely stumbled upon an outpost belonging to a previously unknown interstellar civilization. Before we can communicate with them, we'll need to translate their language.

first_contact.15.materialist.desc.zh: [known_planet.System.GetName]中有了一些有趣的发现，在那里一些神秘的交通信号引导我们找到了[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，上面分布着数个大型外星定居点。我们确信这个星球属于名为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的国家，很可能是一个与我们一样的星际国家。他们的科技样本尚未被采集，但其科技水平似乎并没有比我方高多少。对他们语言的翻译工作仍在进行当中。
first_contact.15.materialist.desc.en: An intriguing discovery has been made in [known_planet.System.GetName], where mysterious signal traffic led us to [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that is home to several large alien settlements. We are confident that this world belongs to the so-called [This.ContactCountry.GetName], which is very likely a spacefaring civilization much like our own. Samples of their technology have not yet been procured, but it does not appear to be radically more advanced than our own. The translation of their language is still ongoing.

first_contact.15.materialist.desc.no_pla.zh: 在[known_system.GetName]星系中获取的数据证实了此处被我们称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的政治实体宣称占据的假设。星系中央有一个恒星基地围绕中央恒星公转，其可能是作为星系中通信及基础建设的中心，而且似乎还是我们所截获的大部分通信的来源。我们需要尽力分析这些通信并翻译他们的语言。
first_contact.15.materialist.desc.no_pla.en: Data gathered in the [known_system.GetName] system supports the hypothesis that it has been claimed by the political entity that we have designated as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. A central starbase orbits the primary and likely serves as an in-system communications and infrastructure hub - it appears to be the source of most of the transmissions we have intercepted in the system. An effort should be made to analyze these transmissions and translate their language.

first_contact.15.militarist.desc.zh: 我们近期在[known_planet.System.GetName]的侦察已经确认其是一个属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的主要星系，以[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]为中心出现了大量的活动信号，这似乎是一个重要的基地。这极有可能是某个星际文明的一部分，但为了解码他们的军事通讯，我们需要先翻译他们的语言。
first_contact.15.militarist.desc.en: Our recent recon pass in [known_planet.System.GetName] has identified it as a major [This.ContactCountry.GetName] system, with a lot of activity centered around [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that is likely a significant base. It is increasingly probable that these aliens are part of an interstellar civilization but in order to decode their military transmissions, we first need to translate their language.

first_contact.15.militarist.desc.no_plan.zh: 侦察飞行机在[known_system.GetName]星系中行进时回报了一个重要[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的存在，至少有一个主要军事设施在其周围的轨道上公转。虽然我们尚未发现任何行星居住点，但一系列初步的目标已被列出，以防外星人被确认为敌对势力。我们还截获了一些有趣的信息，这也许会提供给我们足够的信息来翻译其语言。
first_contact.15.militarist.desc.no_plan.en: Reconnaissance flights conducted in the [known_system.GetName] system have reported a significant [This.ContactCountry.GetName] presence, which includes at least one major military installation in orbit around the primary. Although we have not identified any planetary settlements of note, a preliminary target list is being put together in the event that the aliens prove hostile. Several interesting transmissions have been intercepted, which may provide us with enough insights to translate their language.

first_contact.15.pacifist.desc.zh: 我们确定了在[known_planet.System.GetName]星系中[This.ContactCountry.GetName]势力大范围存在的事实，尤其是其中的[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，其地表上覆盖着几处大型居住点。我们正和一个此前未曾知晓的外星文明打交道的事实愈发清晰。我方应当极为注意避免在这片被认为是他们的星系里做出任何挑衅式的行动。我们必须尽一切努力来翻译他们的语言，这样就可以向对方表达我们和平的意图了。
first_contact.15.pacifist.desc.en: The [known_planet.System.GetName] system has a large [This.ContactCountry.GetName] presence - most notably [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] which houses several large settlements on its surface. It is becoming increasingly clear that we are dealing with a previously unknown alien civilization. We should take great care to avoid any provocative actions if we find ourselves in space they consider theirs. Every effort must be made to translate their language, so that we can declare our peaceful intentions.

first_contact.15.pacifist.desc.no_planet.zh: [known_system.GetName]星系似乎已经被我们命名为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星文明所宣称占据了。尽管在该星系中尚未探测到任何行星定居点，但在其中有一个巨大的恒星基地在围绕星系中心公转。我方船只已经被要求谨慎行事以避免做出任何可能被误解为敌对的行为。一旦他们的语言被破译，我们就有希望与之建立和平的外交关系。
first_contact.15.pacifist.desc.no_planet.en: The [known_system.GetName] system appears to have been claimed by the aliens we have designated as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Although no significant planetary settlements have been detected, there is a large starbase orbiting the system's primary. Our ships have been instructed to conduct themselves with care and to avoid any actions which could be interpreted as hostile. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

first_contact.15.spiritualist.desc.zh: 我们发现存在有人居住星球的[known_planet.System.GetName]星系被确定是属于一个名为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的国家。[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]上散布着大量大型居住点。我们不清楚这个星系对他们而言有什么样的精神象征，但是这似乎是他们星际文明的一部分。我们应该尽我们所能来破译他们的语言。
first_contact.15.spiritualist.desc.en: The inhabited world we have discovered in the [known_planet.System.GetName] system clearly belongs to the so-called [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. It is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] with many large surface settlements. We know not what spiritual significance this system holds for these beings, but they seem to be part of an interstellar civilization. We should do what we can to decipher their language.

first_contact.15.spiritualist.desc.no_pl.zh: 被我们称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星势力似乎已经宣称[known_system.GetName]星系属于他们，其中至少有一个大型恒星基地围绕着中央恒星公转。在星系中尚未发现任何堡垒星球存在的证据，同时尚不清楚他们究竟是追随圣灵的步伐还是堕落为恶灵的奴仆。我们应当尽我们所能破译他们的语言。
first_contact.15.spiritualist.desc.no_pl.en: The aliens we refer to as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] seem to have laid claim to the [known_system.GetName] system, with at least one large starbase in orbit around the primary star. We have not seen any evidence of planetary bastions, and do not yet know whether these beings are favored by the spirits or depraved servants of darkness. We should do what we can to decipher their language.

first_contact.15.xenophile.desc.zh: 被我们标记为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的殖民地，甚至有可能是母星，被宣布在[known_planet.System.GetName]星系中发现。数个大型居民居住点分布在[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]的表面，吸引着我们的注意力。这项令人兴奋的发现让我们对这个属于某星际文明且迷人的外星种族有了进一步的了解。想想成功翻译他们的语言后我们会发现什么吧！
first_contact.15.xenophile.desc.en: A colony or perhaps even the homeworld of the aliens we have designated as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has been reported in the [known_planet.System.GetName] system. Several large settlements are present on the surface of [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that caught our attention. This exciting discovery has taught us even more about these fascinating aliens, who are clearly part of a spacefaring civilization. Think of what else we might find out once their language has been translated!

first_contact.15.xenophile.desc.no_plane.zh: [known_system.GetName]星系似乎已经被一个我们称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星势力所占据，不过星系中没有发现作为人口居住地的星球。一个大型恒星基地围绕着恒星旋转，显然是星系的中心枢纽。尽管我们正处在被认为是他们的星系中，但对与这些迷人的生物仍知之甚少。我们应该尽力去深入了解对方。
first_contact.15.xenophile.desc.no_plane.en: The [known_system.GetName] system appears to have been settled by the aliens we refer to as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], although no planetary population centers have been sighted. A large starbase orbits the primary, serving as the system's central hub. Despite our presence in what they clearly consider to be their space, we know very little about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

first_contact.15.xenophobe.desc.zh: [known_planet.System.GetName]星系中浮现了一个异种行星巢穴！[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]上的生物像蝗虫一样覆盖侵染着这片土地。现在可以确定这些异种，也就是[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，是一个星际文明，不受限制地在许多星球上肆意散布。这不会是一个令人愉悦的任务，但我们还是应该翻译他们的语言，这样我们才能完全了解他们的腐朽程度。
first_contact.15.xenophobe.desc.en: A xeno planetary lair has been revealed in the [known_planet.System.GetName] system! The infestation is centered around [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that may well have been tainted beyond recovery. It is clear now that these xenos - the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - are a spacefaring civilization that is spreading unchecked throughout the stars. It will not be a pleasant task, but their language should be translated so we may learn the full extent of their corruption.

first_contact.15.xenophobe.desc.no_plane.zh: [known_system.GetName]星系显然是一个属于异种的由[This.ContactCountry.GetName]控制的巢穴，其中还有一个大型空间站围绕中央恒星公转。我方船员已被要求忽略所有通讯并与一切异星船只或是空间站保持安全距离，不管对方要干什么，以免他们被这些生物接触并伤害。如果我们能成功破译从星系中的恒星基地发出的通讯的话，那么接下我们或许就能翻译他们物种中用于交流的语言了。
first_contact.15.xenophobe.desc.no_plane.en: The [known_system.GetName] system is evidently a xeno lair, judging by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] presence which includes a large space station orbiting the primary star. Our crews have been instructed to ignore all transmissions while keeping a safe distance from any alien ships or stations, lest they are corrupted by the touch of these creatures, whatever they may be. If we manage to decipher the transmissions emanating from the system's starbase, then perhaps we can translate what passes for a language among their kind.

first_contact.20.desc.cautious.zh: $first_contact.20.desc.base$我们在努力建立通讯的同时又格外谨慎，避免泄露敏感信息。
first_contact.20.desc.cautious.en: $first_contact.20.desc.base$ We are being careful to avoid revealing any sensitive information while we work to establish communication.

first_contact.200.desc.zh: 我们成功骇进了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。
first_contact.200.desc.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and gained access to their databanks for a time. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - hopefully - help us not only swiftly translate their language but also assess their technological level.

first_contact.205.desc.zh: 我们成功骇进了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。然后我们的权限就突然中断了——显然，我们的骇客行为被发现了。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。我们只能希望不要因为玩了这个小把戏，对方就把我们当作危险的敌人。
first_contact.205.desc.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and gained access to their databanks for a time, before our access was abruptly cut off - evidently, our presence did not go undetected. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - hopefully - help us not only swiftly translate their language but also assess their technological level. We can only hope that we haven't made ourselves dangerous enemies with this ploy...

first_contact.206.A.zh: 我们要小心点盯着他们。
first_contact.206.A.en: We will have to be watchful of them.

first_contact.206.desc.hive.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的子个体报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限，接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。我们会紧盯着他们，他们在未来做出任何对[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]有损的事情，我们都能在第一时间注意到。
first_contact.206.desc.hive.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. We should be watchful of them, and be wary of any future moves they may make that could be detrimental to the [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

first_contact.206.desc.machine.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的无人机报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。这一偶然事件督促我们应当尽快更新防御协议和机动系统防火墙——同时也不要忘了上调[From.Owner.GetName]的威胁等级。
first_contact.206.desc.machine.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. This occurrence has prompted us to update our defense protocols and mobile systems' firmware - and to upgrade our threat rating of the [From.Owner.GetName].

first_contact.206.desc.normal.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的团队报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。这一不友好的行为让相当多位于[Root.Owner.GetName]的人表示了担忧，认为[From.Owner.GetName]可能会造成威胁。
first_contact.206.desc.normal.en: Our team in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. This unfriendly act has left many within the [Root.Owner.GetName] deeply worried at the threat the [From.Owner.GetName] may pose.

first_contact.210.A.zh: 那么，我们就需要动用强硬手段了。
first_contact.210.A.en: We will have to do this the hard way, then.

first_contact.210.desc.zh: 我们试图潜入[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统找出有关他们的更多信息，这一尝试没有成功。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]以及[This.Leader.GetHerHis]的科研团队迅速认识到，他们与之对抗的系统过于先进——抑或是他们的监视者太警觉——根本没法用现有的方式找出漏洞。幸运的是，[This.Leader.GetSheHe][This.Leader.GetWasWere]在被对方探查到之前就及时终止了骇客任务。
first_contact.210.desc.en: Our attempts to covertly delve into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] to find out more about them have been unsuccessful. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] and [This.Leader.GetHerHis] science team quickly realized that the systems they were up against were simply too advanced - or their overseers too vigilant - to be caught out in this manner. Fortunately, [This.Leader.GetSheHe] [This.Leader.GetWasWere] able to abort their hacking attempt before it was detected.

first_contact.215.A.tooltip.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have gained a poor first impression of us.

first_contact.215.desc.zh: 看来，我们试图潜入[This.ContactCountry.GetName]网络系统的行为被发现了。目前暂且不知道哪一步出了差错，但是[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]宣称他们面对的系统实在是太先进了——抑或是他们的监视者太警觉了——他们根本无法通过现有的手段找出漏洞。不幸的是，等他们认识到这一点的时候，一切都太晚了。我们只能希望，我们不会因为这点小把戏就被当成危险的敌人……
first_contact.215.desc.en: It appears that our attempts to covertly delve into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] were detected. It is not clear exactly what went wrong, but [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] claims that the systems they were up against were simply too advanced - or their overseers too vigilant - to be caught out in this manner. Unfortunately, by the time this became clear, it was too late. We can only hope that we haven't made ourselves dangerous enemies with this ploy...

first_contact.216.desc.hive.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的子个体报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！幸运的是，我们可以在他们接触到任何敏感信息之前阻止他们。我们应当对其保持警惕，并且提防他们未来的可能对[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]不利的一举一动。
first_contact.216.desc.hive.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Fortunately, we were able to ward them off before they could get access to any sensitive information. We should be watchful of them, and be wary of any future moves they may make that could be detrimental to the [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

first_contact.216.desc.machine.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的无人机报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！幸运的是，我们可以在他们接触到任何敏感信息之前阻止他们。这一事件提醒我们升级防御措施和移动系统的固件，并且提高我们对[From.Owner.GetName]的威胁估值。
first_contact.216.desc.machine.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our systems has been detected! Fortunately, we were able to ward them off before they could get access to any sensitive information. This occurrence has prompted us to update our defense protocols and mobile systems' firmware - and to upgrade our threat rating of the [From.Owner.GetName].

first_contact.216.desc.normal.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的团队报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！幸运的是，我们可以在他们接触到任何敏感信息之前阻止他们。然而，这种不友好的行为让[Root.Owner.GetName]上的许多人对[From.Owner.GetName]可能造成的威胁忧心忡忡。
first_contact.216.desc.normal.en: Our team in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Fortunately, we were able to ward them off before they could get access to any sensitive information. However, this unfriendly act has left many within the [Root.Owner.GetName] deeply worried at the threat the [From.Owner.GetName] may pose.

first_contact.25.desc.cautious.zh: $first_contact.25.desc.base$我们正在采取一切预防措施，防止他们在我们努力建立通讯期间获取任何有关我方的敏感信息。
first_contact.25.desc.cautious.en: $first_contact.25.desc.base$ We are taking every precaution to prevent them from learning anything sensitive about us while we work to establish communication.

first_contact.250.B.machine.zh: 让我们把这些机械体大卸八块！

first_contact.250.B.tooltip.zh: 使用这种方式我们能够获得更多信息，不过一旦被对方发现，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]将会极度不悦。
first_contact.250.B.tooltip.en: We will likely find out more from this approach, but the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] will be extremely displeased when they find out.

first_contact.250.C.en: We have no need of survivors.

first_contact.250.C.devourers.zh: 它们尝起来味道怎么样……

first_contact.250.C.homicidal_tooltip.zh: 我们也会调查它们的船只，以获取其中的线索。
first_contact.250.C.homicidal_tooltip.en: We will also investigate their ship for clues about them.

first_contact.250.desc.zh: 短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的船员们——我们现在知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]物种——向我们的接舷小队投降。我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，可以进行审问工作并学习它们的科技。
first_contact.250.desc.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] species - surrendered to our boarding party. We now hold both their ship and a large portion of their crew hostage, and can set to work interrogating them and studying their technology.

first_contact.250.desc.hive_victim.zh:
短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，我们对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的船员进行了压制，并迫使它们投降。[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星人在战斗中表现出了极强的协同性——就好像受同一思维指挥一样——直到其中一个个体被击毙，它们全员停止了抵抗。自那以后，它们表现出了明显的无目的性和迷惑性。我们只能猜测它们是某个蜂巢主脑控制的子个体们。

我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，我们可以研究它们的科技，也可以试试动用审讯手段是否能够查出什么情报出来。
first_contact.250.desc.hive_victim.en:
After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, we overwhelmed the crew of the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and forced them to surrender. The [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with remarkable coordination - almost as if guided by a single mind - until as one, they suddenly ceased to resist. Since then, they have appeared aimless and confused. We can only posit that they were drones of some sort of hive mind.

Now that we hold both their ship and what remains of their crew hostage, we can set to work studying their technology, and see any interrogative methods may yield any useful information.

first_contact.250.desc.machine_victim.zh:
当我们登陆上[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船上时，眼前的景象始料未及——船员居然都是机械体无人机，而且看上去被一个失控的人工智能管制！在短暂的交火之后，我们成功无力化了足够数量的无人机，仅剩些许残余仍在抵抗。令人惊讶的是，它们并没有启动自毁程序——我们只能假设自己的运气很好，在它们的管制人工智能下达自毁命令之前，成功切断了信号。

我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，我们可以展开研究它们科技的工作，也可以查看这些无人机是否携带任何有用的信息。
first_contact.250.desc.machine_victim.en:
As we boarded the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], we were greeted by a surprising revelation - the crew was made up of mechanical drones seemingly piloted by a rogue AI! After a brief struggle, we were able to disable enough of them that the rest ceased to resist. Surprisingly, they did not manage to initiate self-destruct sequences - we can only assume that we were fortunate enough to cut off the signal to their guiding AI before the order was given.

Now that we hold both their ship and what remains of their crew hostage, we can set to work studying their technology, and see whether the drones will yield any useful information.

first_contact.250.desc.multispecies.zh: 经过短暂的交锋，我们保持了伤亡最小化，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船只的船员向我们的登船部队投降。在船上有多种不同的外星物种，但是最主要的似乎是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClassPlural]。我们现在人船俱获，现在可以开始审讯他们以及期待获得他们的科技。
first_contact.250.desc.multispecies.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] surrendered to our boarding party. There were multiple different alien species onboard, but the majority of them seem to have been [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClassPlural]. We now hold both their ship and a large portion of their crew hostage, and can set to work interrogating them and their technology.

first_contact.250.desc.wilderness_victim.zh:
经过短暂交火，我方仅付出轻微伤亡便成功压制了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索舰的船员并迫使其投降。起初这群[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星生物展现出远超预期的协同作战能力——宛如共用同一个意识——直到他们突然停止了抵抗。彼时每个船员都丧失了组织性，退化出野蛮的原始行为模式。

我们只能推测这些已近乎丧失智慧的生物曾以某种群体意识形态运作。如今既已将其船员与舰船扣为人质，便可着手审讯这支诡异舰队，并研究其独特科技。
first_contact.250.desc.wilderness_victim.en:
After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, we overwhelmed the crew of the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and forced them to surrender. At first the [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with a far greater sense of coordination than we had anticipated - acting as though with one mind - until suddenly, they ceased to resist. At that point each crew member lost all cohesion, instead reverting to brutish, primal behaviors.

We can only posit that these now barely-sapient creatures were operating as some form of gestalt. Now that we hold both them and their ship hostage, we can set to work interrogating this bizarre crew, and studying their unique technology.

$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，成功捕获了许多我们的低级子个体；$first_contact.252.desc.hive.end$
first_contact.252.desc.hive.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

我们的袭击者——一群[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，他们行动是如此的协调也就是说是和我们相似的统一智慧——成功俘虏了我们不少低级子个体；$first_contact.252.desc.hive.end$

$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

$first_contact.252.desc.machine.start$

first_contact.252.desc.hive_enemy.machin.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.machine.start$

Our assessment of the danger posed by them has accordingly increased.

$first_contact.252.desc.normal.end$

$first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.start$

first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.start$

As these symbionts are no longer part of our chorus, we doubt their captors will extract much of strategic value. However, by their loss we are still diminished. We would be justified in feeling insulted, but so too might we take heart in having exposed and identified a new threat out in this otherwise enigmatic void.

first_contact.253.B.devourer.zh: 我们必须尽快弄清楚它们是否好吃。

$first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.start$

我们遭受了酷刑般的折磨，但至少明确了一点：此刻我们更清楚地认知到这片深空中潜藏的威胁形态。
first_contact.253.desc.wilderness.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.start$

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, have set about dissecting and butchering those parts of us they recognize as lifeforms on board the ship. Those among us who weren't ambulatory macro-symbionts seem to have met kinder fates, having merely been exterminated or expunged. None aboard remain within our chorus, though we felt their loss throughout.

An act of torture has been inflicted upon us, but even if nothing else: we now know more about the kinds of threats we face out here.

$first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.start$

袭击我们的是一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星人，他们肆无忌惮地屠杀了那些被他们视为生命体的部分。我们当中许多非移动型宏观共生体也未能幸免于这场灭绝，但无论如何：船上所有成员如今都已从我们的集体和声中撕裂。我们深切感受着每一分丧失。

这场无谓的暴行施加于我们身上，但至少现在，我们对星系其他角落可能遭遇的威胁类型有了更深认知。
first_contact.254.desc.wilderness.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.start$

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, brazenly slaughtered those parts of us they recognized as lifeforms. Many among us who weren't ambulatory macro-symbionts were also caught up in the extermination, but regardless: all aboard have now been torn away from our chorus. We felt their loss throughout.

An act of mindless brutality has been committed upon us, but now at least we do know more about the kinds of threats we face elsewhere in this galaxy.

first_contact.260.A.zh: 这艘船会把它们的秘密都显露出来。
first_contact.260.A.en: The ship will surely yield their secrets.

first_contact.260.desc.zh:
我们试图将[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船无力化，然而这一行动酿成了一场血战，甚至在我们登船之后惨烈的战斗仍未停息。冲突十分激烈，没有船员幸存——似乎所有受伤的战斗人员都宁愿自杀，也不允许自己被俘。

$first_contact.260.desc.end$
first_contact.260.desc.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. So ferocious was the struggle that no living survivors remained - it seems that wounded combatants committed suicide rather than permit themselves to be captured.

$first_contact.260.desc.end$

first_contact.260.desc.hive_victim.zh:
我们试图将[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船无力化，然而这一行动酿成了一场血战，甚至在我们登船之后惨烈的战斗仍未停息。舰船的船员表现出了极高的协调性——就好像受单一的思维控制一样——并十分凶猛地与我方人员交战，绝不后退一步。最终它们宁愿击杀自己也不允许被敌人俘虏。

$first_contact.260.desc.end$
first_contact.260.desc.hive_victim.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. The crew of the ship moved with remarkable coordination - almost as if guided by a single mind - and gave a fierce struggle, refusing to back down and eventually killing themselves rather than permit themselves to be captured.

$first_contact.260.desc.end$

first_contact.260.desc.machine_victim.zh:
我们本想将[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船无力化，然而甚至在我们登船之后还爆发了惨烈的火拼之后才达成。看上去我们的对手是受某个失控人工智能管制的机械体无人机，一旦信号丢失就会启动自毁命令。

$first_contact.260.desc.end$
first_contact.260.desc.machine_victim.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a savage firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. It appears that our opponents were mechanical drones piloted by a rogue AI, which evidently gave the order to self-destruct as soon as their cause seemed lost.

$first_contact.260.desc.end$

first_contact.260.desc.wilderness_victim.zh:
我们成功瘫痪了来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索舰，但登舰过程中爆发的冲突意外升级为致命交火。起初这群[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星生物展现出超乎预期的协同作战能力，宛如共享同一意识。然而当我方取得军事优势后，这些生物突然陷入全面混乱。其行为模式迅速退化为原始而野蛮的状态，完全丧失组织性，最终被迅速歼灭。

现有证据表明，这些低等智慧生物曾隶属于某个格式塔意识。那个操纵它们的未知存在显然宁可选择自我毁灭也不愿被俘获——最终留给我们的只有可回收的舰体残骸，其中充斥着嗜血野兽与蠕动的异星植被。
first_contact.260.desc.wilderness_victim.en:
We managed to disable the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a skirmish that became decidedly more deadly as we boarded their ship. At first the [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with a far greater sense of coordination than we had anticipated, as though acting with one mind. However once we pressed our military advantage, the creatures suddenly lost all cohesion. From that point their behavior reverted to something primal, bestial, and entirely uncoordinated. Their end came swiftly.

We can only posit that these barely-sapient creatures were once operating as part of a gestalt. Whichever entity was guiding them seems to have favored self-destruction over capture; it left us with nought but a salvageable hull filled with ravening beasts and twitching vegetation.

first_contact.262.desc.hive.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，$first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$
first_contact.262.desc.hive.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, $first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$

first_contact.262.desc.hive_enemy.hive.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

我们的袭击者——一群[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，他们行动是如此的协调也就是说是和我们相似的统一智慧——$first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$
first_contact.262.desc.hive_enemy.hive.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

Our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens that moved with such coordination as to suggest a unified intelligence much like our own - $first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$

first_contact.262.desc.hive_enemy.machin.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.machine.start$

袭击者——一群[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的有机体像我们一样做出了协调一致的联动，这显示他们可能像我们一样处于一个高级智慧的统领之下，$first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$
first_contact.262.desc.hive_enemy.machin.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.machine.start$

Our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] organics that moved with coordination that suggested a unified intelligence much like our own - $first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$

first_contact.262.desc.hive_enemy.normal.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.normal.start$尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]做出了令人恐慌的联动，干烂了我们的防御。

$first_contact.262.desc.normal.end$
first_contact.262.desc.hive_enemy.normal.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.normal.start$ Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens that moved with frightening coordination - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

$first_contact.262.desc.normal.end$

first_contact.262.desc.machine.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.machine.start$

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的有机体，$first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$
first_contact.262.desc.machine.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.machine.start$

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] organics, $first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$

first_contact.262.desc.machine_enemy.hiv.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

这群针对我们的袭击者，一群被一个无赖AI管理的战斗无人机，$first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$
first_contact.262.desc.machine_enemy.hiv.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.hive.start$

Our assailants, a group of mechanical drones seemingly piloted by a rogue AI, $first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$

first_contact.262.desc.machine_enemy.mac.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.machine.start$

我们的攻击者——一群和我们非常相似的机械无人机——$first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$
first_contact.262.desc.machine_enemy.mac.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.machine.start$

Our assailants - a group of mechanical drones much like our own - $first_contact.262.desc.gestalt.end$

first_contact.262.desc.machine_enemy.nor.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.normal.start$尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——一群被一个无赖AI管理的战斗无人机，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

$first_contact.262.desc.normal.end$
first_contact.262.desc.machine_enemy.nor.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.normal.start$ Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - mechanical drones seemingly piloted by a rogue AI - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

$first_contact.262.desc.normal.end$

first_contact.262.desc.normal.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.normal.start$尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

$first_contact.262.desc.normal.end$
first_contact.262.desc.normal.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.normal.start$ Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

$first_contact.262.desc.normal.end$

first_contact.262.desc.wilderness.zh:
$first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.start$

我们的袭击者——一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星人——很快击溃了我们的防御，他们优先攻击了那些被其识别为生命体的部分。出于自保，我们被迫抛弃了舰上所有成员，将其隔绝于我们的意识共鸣之外。尽管来犯者如此猖獗，他们终将一无所获。

这是一次赤裸裸的侵略行径，但至少我们现在更清楚地认识到，在这片星海中还将面临何种威胁。
first_contact.262.desc.wilderness.en:
$first_contact.252.desc.wilderness.start$

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, soon overwhelmed our defenses, having prioritized those parts of us they actually recognized as lifeforms. As an act of self-preservation we were forced to abandon all those aboard, isolating them from our chorus. For all their aggression, our attackers shall learn little from us.

An act of naked transgression has been directed toward us, but now at least we do know more about the kinds of threats we face elsewhere in this galaxy.

first_contact.270.A.zh: 我们现在必须加把劲翻译它们的语言了。
first_contact.270.A.en: We must redouble our efforts to translate their language.

first_contact.270.B.tooltip.zh:
$first_contact.280.B.tooltip$
然而，它们肯定戒备森严。
first_contact.270.B.tooltip.en:
$first_contact.280.B.tooltip$
However, they will be on their guard.

first_contact.270.desc.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动最终成了一场灾难。非常不幸的是，对方的抵抗比预料中的要激烈得多。当发现战斗获胜无望以后，它们令舰船自毁了。现在除了漂浮的残骸，什么都没剩下。我们只能衷心地希望，这艘探索船的后面没有跟着一整支复仇的战舰！
first_contact.270.desc.en: Our attempts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in catastrophe. Unfortunately, they resisted more vigorously than expected, and once it became clear that their fight was hopeless, they set the vessel to self-destruct. Little now remains of their vessel but debris. We can only hope their exploration vessel will not be followed by warships bent on revenge!

first_contact.270.desc2.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动最终成了一场灾难。非常不幸的是，对方的抵抗比预料中的要激烈得多，在交火中，它们的舰船遭受了致命打击。现在除了漂浮的残骸，什么都没剩下。我们只能衷心地希望，这艘探索船的后面没有跟着一整支复仇的战舰！
first_contact.270.desc2.en: Our attempts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in catastrophe. Unfortunately, they resisted more vigorously than expected, and during the firefight, their ship sustained a critical hit. Little now remains of their vessel but debris. We can only hope their exploration vessel will not be followed by warships bent on revenge!

first_contact.272.desc.zh: 我们派去调查[From.Owner.GetName]的一艘飞船被对方的武装力量的暴力袭击所摧毁。现在还不清楚他们究竟是想截获我们的船只，还是只是想简单地给我们一个警告让我们离开他们的领土。
first_contact.272.desc.en: A vessel we had sent to investigate the [From.Owner.GetName] was destroyed in a violent assault by their forces. It is unclear whether they sought to capture our vessel, or whether they simply sought to give us the message to keep away from their territory.

first_contact.280.B.tooltip.zh: 我们已经定位到了它们的母星系，我们可以试图绑架一些标本。
first_contact.280.B.tooltip.en: As we have located their home systems, we may try to abduct specimens from there.

first_contact.280.desc.failed.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动失败了。非常的不幸，它们成功地躲避了我们的俘虏行动，并在我们将舰船无力化之前就逃脱了恒星系。我们的未来乌云密布——不仅是因为要找出它们的信息更加困难艰巨了，也是因为它们一定会将这次行动当作我们敌视它们的一部分。
first_contact.280.desc.failed.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in failure. Unfortunately, they managed to elude our capture attempt and escape the system before we could disable their ship. This bodes ill for the future - not only do we face an uphill struggle to find out more about them, but they will surely consider this to be a hostile act on our part.

first_contact.280.desc.just_left.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动失败了。非常的不幸，我们在动手之前跟丢了它们的舰船。
first_contact.280.desc.just_left.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in failure. Unfortunately, we lost track of their ship before we could attempt to seize it.

first_contact.282.desc.zh: [ship_to_seize.GetName]，我们派去调查[From.Owner.GetName]的飞船，勉强躲过了对方武装力量的恶意攻击。他们似乎想要截获我们的船只并审讯船员，很有还带着对我们开展进一步攻击行动为自己牟利的目的。不过谢天谢地，在一切失去控制之前，[ship_to_seize.GetName]设法发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
first_contact.282.desc.en: The [ship_to_seize.GetName], our vessel we had sent to investigate the [From.Owner.GetName], narrowly escaped a vicious attack by their forces. It seems they had thought to seize our ship to interrogate our crew, probably with the aim of swinging further hostilities against us in their favor. Thankfully, the [ship_to_seize.GetName] managed to engage emergency FTL before it was too late.

first_contact.282.desc.gestalt.zh: [ship_to_seize.GetName]，我们派去调查[From.Owner.GetName]的飞船，勉强躲过了对方武装力量的恶意攻击。他们似乎是想截获我们的船只并逆向科技，很有可能想着对我们展开进一步攻击为自己牟利。不过谢天谢地，在一切失去控制前，[ship_to_seize.GetName]设法发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
first_contact.282.desc.gestalt.en: The [ship_to_seize.GetName], our vessel we had sent to investigate the [From.Owner.GetName], narrowly escaped a vicious attack by their forces. It seems they had thought to seize our ship and steal our technologies, probably with the aim of swinging further hostilities against us in their favor. Thankfully, the [ship_to_seize.GetName] managed to engage emergency FTL before it was too late.

first_contact.285.desc.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。最初这些人质不太愿意与我们合作，但随着时间推移他们在无意中不断地给了我们有关他们语言的线索，一直到我们能够与他们进行基础的语言交流。从那时起，我们就能迅速拼凑有关他们的细节，一旦有一位或是更多的人质愿意合作，我们就能进入他们的电脑系统。

得益于从他们身上收集到的信息，我们能够确认他们来自[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
first_contact.285.desc.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were initially unwilling to cooperate with us, but over time they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, until we were able to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them, eventually gaining access to their computer systems once one of the more cooperative hostages cracked.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we are able to identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

first_contact.285.desc.hive_victim.zh:
我们结束了对于此前捕获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。看上去它们确实是由蜂巢思维所链接起来的，单独的子个体是缺少自我意识和代理权的。将其从主体意识剥离后，这些子个体似乎漫无目的，然后一个接一个地死去。除了将其作为生物标本外也没什么其他地作用了。

$first_contact.285.desc.gestalt_end$
first_contact.285.desc.hive_victim.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Cut off from the body, the drones seemed aimless and died off one by one, not yielding much in the way of useful information except as unwitting biological specimens.

$first_contact.285.desc.gestalt_end$

first_contact.285.desc.machine_victim.zh:
我们结束了对于此前我们截获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]机械无人机的调查行动。我们一切断它们与上级人工智能的链接之后，这些无人机就失去了代理，并且被发现几乎完全失去了作用，因为其功能已经迅速退化。

$first_contact.285.desc.gestalt_end$
first_contact.285.desc.machine_victim.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency, and we were able to find out little of use from them as their functionality rapidly degraded.

$first_contact.285.desc.gestalt_end$

first_contact.285.desc.strong.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。这些人质表现得极其不愿意配合我们，甚至我们审讯者使用了以往最具有说服力的方法也无济于事。然而，随着时间的推移，他们在无意中不断地泄露出有关他们语言的各种线索，最终使得我们有能力与他们开展基础性的交流。从那时起，我们就可以迅速拼凑出有关他们的细节，此外骇入对方部分基础电脑系统的行动也取得了进展。尽管如此，我们还是怀疑他们对我方隐瞒了大量细节。

得益于我们从他们身上获取的信息，我们得以确定他们来自于[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事力量获取了大量情报。
first_contact.285.desc.strong.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved remarkably unwilling to cooperate with us, resisting even the most persuasive methods of our interrogators. However, over time, they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, eventually allowing us to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them - as well as gain access to some of their basic computer systems - although we suspect that they were able to keep many details back.

Thanks to the information we were able to glean from them, we are able to identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

first_contact.285.desc.weak.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。这些人质显然意志薄弱，没什么阻止我们对其调查的想法。事实上，他们十分配合。我们很快就能翻译他们的语言并进入对方的电脑系统。

因此，我们得以确定他们来自[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
first_contact.285.desc.weak.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were remarkably weak-willed and showed no particular desire to keep us from finding out about them; indeed, they proved extremely cooperative. We were soon able to translate their language and access their computer systems.

As a result, we have been able to identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

first_contact.285.desc.wilderness_victim.zh:
$first_contact.285.desc.wilderness_victim.intro$ 由于彼此隔绝且与母星失去联系，这些共生体退化至原始状态并迅速消亡。除了作为解剖对象外，它们没有为我们提供多少有用的信息。

$first_contact.285.desc.gestalt_end$
first_contact.285.desc.wilderness_victim.en:
$first_contact.285.desc.wilderness_victim.intro$ Since being isolated from each other as well as their homeworld, these symbionts reverted to a primal state and perished fairly rapidly. They have yielded little useful information to us, save as subjects for autopsy.

$first_contact.285.desc.gestalt_end$

first_contact.290.desc.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。我们现在对他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学家[This.Owner.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的异种生物学数据。

由于我们残忍的行为带来的恐怖，一部分外星人——现在我们知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——开始在我们翻译他们语言并接入电脑系统时表现出了合作的态度。作为结果，我们显然拥有了数量相当可观的情报，如果有需求，我们可以部署这些情报对付他们。
first_contact.290.desc.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Driven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the aliens - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.

first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.zh:
$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.intro$$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.main$

虽然花费的时间比我们预期的稍长，但凭借我们所掌握的生物学知识以及在捕获的飞船上发现的各种线索，我们最终破解了他们的语言和计算机代码。$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.end$
first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.en:
$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.intro$ $first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.main$

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we had gained and the various clues scattered about the captured vessel allowed us to crack their language - and their computer codes. $first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.end$

first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.no_ve.zh:
$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.intro$$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.main$

虽然花费的时间比我们预期的稍长，但我们获得的生物学知识以及无人机被劫持时收集到的各种线索，最终让我们破解了它们的语言和计算机代码。$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.end$
first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.no_ve.en:
$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.intro$ $first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.main$

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we had gained and the various clues gathered when the drones were abducted allowed us to crack their language - and their computer codes. $first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.end$

first_contact.290.desc.machine_victim.zh:
