我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，无法提供与他们自己的协议相关的信息。但是一旦我们开始将他们大卸八块，我们又可以获得一定的进展了——不仅在了解他们的内部语言方面，也在找出有关他们的更多知识方面。其结论是，他们使用的处理器还是比不过我们针对他们使用的攻性数据收集技术，现在他们已经没剩下多少秘密了。

我们现在可以同他们的人工智能主体——其自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]——进行沟通，我们会静观其变。
first_contact.290.desc.machine_victim.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency and gave off little useful information of their own accord, but once we began dissembling them, we were able to make more progress - both in understanding their internal functioning, and in finding out more about them. It turned out their processors were no match for the invasive data gathering techniques we used on them, with the result that little about them is now secret to us.

We can now also communicate with their parent AI - which calls itself the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] - should we see fit.

first_contact.290.desc.wilderness_victim.zh:
$first_contact.285.desc.wilderness_victim.intro$

与家园以及彼此隔离后，这些共生体退化到了原始状态并迅速消亡，这使得尸检变得相当简单。$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.main$

$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.end$
first_contact.290.desc.wilderness_victim.en:
$first_contact.285.desc.wilderness_victim.intro$

Since being isolated from each other as well as their homeworld, these symbionts reverted to a primal state and soon perished, making autopsy rather trivial. $first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.main$

$first_contact.290.desc.hive_victim.end$

first_contact.295.desc.zh: 对于在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。没能抓到一个活口使得这次调查极具挑战。不过幸运的是，他们还是留给我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]丰富的材料用以破解它们的语言，我们现在将其识别为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，如果我们乐意的话还能和对方进行沟通。此外，我们还能够研究它们在自己舰船上使用的科技，这能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
first_contact.295.desc.en: We have concluded our study of the vessel we recently captured from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. The absence of a living crew made our investigation challenging. Fortunately, they left behind enough material for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to gradually decipher their language and identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], allowing us to communicate with them should we so please. Furthermore, we were able to study their ship's technology, which has helped our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] uncover some novel new approaches to our own research problems.

first_contact.295.desc.no_ship.zh: 对于在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。由于没能抓到一个活口来审讯，我们的调查极具挑战。幸运的是，他们还是留给我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]丰富的材料用以破解他们的语言，我们现在将其识别为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，如果我们乐意的话还能和对方进行沟通。此外，我们还能研究他们在自己舰船上使用的科技，这能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
first_contact.295.desc.no_ship.en: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate. Fortunately, they left behind enough material for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to gradually decipher their language and identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], allowing us to communicate with them should we so please. Furthermore, we were able to study their technology, which has helped our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] to uncover some novel new approaches to our own research problems.

first_contact.3000.a.friendly.zh: 我们必须与该生物交流！
first_contact.3000.a.friendly.en: We must talk to this creature!

first_contact.3000.b.execution.zh: 净化这个入侵我们首都的东西！
first_contact.3000.b.execution.en: Purge this invader from our capital!

first_contact.3000.d.assimilator.en: One of us. One of us.

first_contact.3000.d.assimilator.tooltip.en: The $NAME_Guest$ joins our ranks as a leader.

first_contact.3000.desc.zh:
如楼房大小、长着许多触手的怪物突然出现在[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]让首都陷入了一片混乱。这只生物似乎和我们一样困惑于它自己的突然出现，毫无抵抗地就被我们捕获拘束了起来。

许多[owner.GetScientistPlural]宣称，代号来客的这个生物是来自外太空，而其他人则认为这是一种此前尚未发现的物种直至今日才得以为人所知。无论如何，轨道上确实没有发现任何外星舰船。这个生物的凭空出现，似乎也不是借助的科技手段。

令人困惑（同时它自己也充满困惑）的客人目前被收容在一座研究设施中。
first_contact.3000.desc.en:
The appearance of a building-sized, tentacled monstrosity in the midst of [This.Owner.Capital.GetName] has thrown the capital into chaos. The creature seems as confused as we are by its sudden appearance, and has allowed itself to be restrained without resistance.

While many [owner.GetScientistPlural] already claim the creature, codenamed The Guest, to be of alien nature, others have suggested it could be a previously unknown species which had until now gone undiscovered. After all, no alien ship has been detected in orbit. The creature materialized out of nowhere, seemingly unassisted by technology.

Our confusing (and confused) visitor is currently being held in one of our research facilities.

first_contact.3000.desc.gestalt.zh:
如楼房大小、长着许多触手的怪物突然出现在[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]让首都失去了秩序。这个生物对于它自己的突然出现似乎和我们一样困惑，毫无抵抗地就被我们捕获拘束了起来。

我们怀疑该生物应该来自外太空，但无法排除是一种本就在我们星球上的未知物种的可能性。无论如何，轨道上确实没有发现任何外星舰船。这个代号来客的生物的凭空出现，似乎也不是借助的科技手段。

令人困惑（同时它自己也充满困惑）的客人目前被收容在一座研究设施中。
first_contact.3000.desc.gestalt.en:
The appearance of a building-sized, tentacled monstrosity in the midst of [This.Owner.Capital.GetName] has thrown the capital into disarray. The creature seems as perplexed as we are by its sudden appearance, and has allowed itself to be restrained without resistance.

We suspect the creature to be of alien nature, but we can't discount the possibility of it being an unknown species native to our world. After all, no alien ship has been detected in orbit. The creature - codenamed The Guest - materialized out of nowhere, seemingly unassisted by technology.

Our confusing (and confused) visitor is currently being held in one of our research facilities.

first_contact.320.A.tooltip.zh: 我们位于他们领土的舰队开始逃脱以躲避报复打击。
first_contact.320.A.tooltip.en: Our fleets in their territory have fled to avoid reprisals.

first_contact.320.A2.zh: 他们应该将秘密尽数招供。
first_contact.320.A2.en: They shall give up their secrets.

first_contact.320.C.homicidal_tooltip.zh: 我们也会调查扣押的设备，以寻找有关他们的更多线索。
first_contact.320.C.homicidal_tooltip.en: We will also investigate the equipment we seized for clues about them.

first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.gestalt.zh:
一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，设法在[abduction_system.GetName]星系劫持了一艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的小型补给舰。舰船的船员绝大多数都保留了活口，舰船的硬件设备和电脑系统也没有遭到什么明显损坏。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.gestalt.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to seize a small [This.ContactCountry.GetName] logistics vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. Along with the ship's crew, which was largely taken alive, much of the vessel's hardware and computer systems were also spared major damage.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.hive.ma.zh:
一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，设法在[abduction_system.GetName]星系劫持了一艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的小型补给舰。出乎我们意料的是，舰船船员均由机械体无人机构成。我们设法在只造成轻微伤害的情况下对其进行制服和抓捕。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.hive.ma.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to seize a small [This.ContactCountry.GetName] logistics vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. Unexpectedly, it turned out that the ship was exclusively manned by mechanical drones. Undeterred, our team disabled and captured them with only minor damage, also managing to leave most of the vessel's hardware and computer systems intact.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.machine.zh:
一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，设法在[abduction_system.GetName]星系劫持了一艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的小型补给舰。结果我们发现，舰船船员均由机械体无人机构成——或许由一个如同我们自己的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]一样的人工智能。我们设法在只造成轻微伤害的情况下对其进行制服和抓捕，并且保证了舰船的绝大多数硬件设备和电脑系统完好无损。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.machine.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to seize a small [This.ContactCountry.GetName] logistics vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. It turned out that the ship was exclusively manned by mechanical drones, perhaps guided by an AI like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Undeterred, our team disabled and captured them with only minor damage, also managing to leave most of the vessel's hardware and computer systems intact.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.normal..zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着一艘他们在[abduction_system.GetName]星系拦截到的货运舰船从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。出乎我们意料的是，舰船船员均由机械体无人机构成——或许由一个失控的人工智能引导——我们没法在只造成轻微伤害的情况下对其进行制服和抓捕。好在我们的小队保证了舰船的绝大多数硬件设备和电脑系统完好无损。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.normal..en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with a captured cargo vessel they intercepted in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. To our surprise, the ship was crewed exclusively by mechanical drones - perhaps guided by a rogue AI - which we were nevertheless able to disable and capture with only minor damage. Our team also managed to leave most of the vessel's hardware and computer systems intact.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.normal..zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着一艘他们在[abduction_system.GetName]星系拦截到的货运舰船从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。舰船的船员绝大多数都保留了活口，舰船的硬件设备和电脑系统也没有遭到什么明显损坏。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.no_planet.normal..en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with a captured cargo vessel they intercepted in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. Along with the ship's crew, which was largely taken alive, much of the vessel's hardware and computer systems were also spared major damage.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.planet.gestalt.no.zh:
一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，降落在了一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地上。他们设法降落在了行星上的一个人迹罕至的地方，然后在脱逃之前活捉了几个外星人，同时还顺手牵羊走了几个技术性硬件设备。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.planet.gestalt.no.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to land in a remote area of a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to seize several live aliens, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that may prove useful for decoding their communications and assessing their technological level, before making an escape.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.planet.hive.machi.zh:
一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，降落在了一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地上。他们设法降落在了行星上的一个人迹罕至的地方，然而出人意料的是，这个行星上的居民实际上是机械体无人机。不管怎样，他们在脱逃之前以无伤条件抓捕了几个无人机，同时还顺手牵羊走了几个技术性硬件设备。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.planet.hive.machi.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to land in a remote area of a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. Unexpectedly, it turned out that the inhabitants of the planet were, in fact, mechanical drones. Nevertheless, they seized several of them undamaged, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that may prove useful for decoding their communications and assessing their technological level, before making an escape.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.planet.machine.ma.zh:
一支由[This.Leader.GetName]率领的秘密行动无人机分队设法降落在了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]星系[abduction_planet.System.GetName]殖民地的一处人迹罕至的地带。他们很快发现这个星球上的居民实际上也是机械体无人机——或许受某个类似我方[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]的人工智能所支配。分队毫不退缩，在无伤条件下捕获了数台无人机，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件，随后成功撤离。这些或将有助于破译他们的通讯并评估其技术等级。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.planet.machine.ma.en:
A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] managed to land in a remote area of a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They soon discovered that the inhabitants of the world are, in fact, mechanical drones - perhaps guided by an AI like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Undeterred, they captured several drones undamaged, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that may prove useful for decoding their communications and assessing their technological level, before making an escape.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.planet.normal.mac.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]星系的殖民地上抓获的人质从[abduction_planet.System.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。趁着夜色的掩护，他们设法降落在了星球的一个人迹罕至的地方，然后却惊奇地发现这里的居民实际上是机械体无人机。不管怎样，他们在无伤条件下捕获了数台无人机，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.planet.normal.mac.en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the world in the cover of darkness and were surprised to discover that the inhabitants were, in fact, mechanical drones. Nevertheless, they seized several of them undamaged, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that is sure to help us decode their language and assess their technological level.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.320.desc.planet.normal.nor.zh:
一支英勇的秘密特种部队带着从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]星系的殖民地上抓获的人质从[abduction_planet.System.GetName]的领域内逃脱了出来。趁着夜色的掩护，他们设法降落在了星球的一个人迹罕至的地方，俘获了数名活体外星人，同时还缴获了大量技术硬件。这些对于我们破译他们的语言以及评估他们的技术等级都十分有用。

$first_contact.320.desc.end$
first_contact.320.desc.planet.normal.nor.en:
A brave team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the world in the cover of darkness and seize several live aliens, as well as a large stash of technical hardware that is sure to help us decode their language and assess their technological level.

$first_contact.320.desc.end$

first_contact.321.desc.mega_oops.zh:
一支有勇——但或许无谋——的秘密特殊武装小队成功从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]领地撤离并从他们[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地中带走了若干人质。他们在黑夜的遮蔽下降落到行星偏远的角落并抓走了几只带有大型黑白斑点的哺乳生物，而它们并没有做出任何反抗。

不久之后我们就意识到这些生物并不能发出任何具有[This.ContactCountry.GetName]通讯的声音特征，事实上也不能给出任何证明它们是感性生物的迹象。经过进一步调查，我们得出结论，我们意外地抓获了他们牲畜的样本！

不幸的是，在这次行动之后他们的太空巡逻部队提高了警戒，说明他们已经探测到了我们的存在——使得我们任何未来的尝试计划都只能惨遭失败……
first_contact.321.desc.mega_oops.en:
A brave - but perhaps not very bright - team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the planet in the cover of darkness and seize several specimens of a large, black and white speckled mammalian creature, which did not resist.

Only later did we realize that these creatures were not making any of the sounds characteristic of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmissions, nor indeed giving any indication whatsoever of being sentient. Upon further investigation, we concluded that we had accidentally captured examples of their livestock!

Unfortunately, their space patrols have stepped up in vigilance since the raid, indicating that they have detected our presence - making any further attempts be doomed to failure...

first_contact.322.desc.no_planet.zh: 尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎派出了一支秘密行动小队拦截了我们一艘位于[abduction_system.GetName]星系的货船，扣押了这艘船，在我们能够组织起一支救援小队之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能想象这些人质在他们的捕捉者手里会遭到何等的折磨。
first_contact.322.desc.no_planet.en: While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they sent a covert force to intercept one of our cargo vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system, seizing the ship and escaping into the depths of space before we could mount a rescue party. We can only imagine what tortures the crew will suffer at the hands of their captors.

first_contact.322.desc.no_planet.gestalt.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]派出了一支秘密行动小队拦截了一艘我们位于[abduction_system.GetName]星系的补给舰，扣押的这艘舰船，在我们能够组织起一支小队摧毁他们之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能希望他们从带走的东西那里找不到太多的价值。
first_contact.322.desc.no_planet.gestalt.en: We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] sent a covert force to intercept one of our logistics vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system, seizing the ship and escaping into the depths of space before we could send a party to destroy them. We can only hope they will be unable to find out much of value from what they have taken.

first_contact.322.desc.planet.zh: 尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，还绑架了几个活的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]人质，在我们能够组织起一支救援小队之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能想象这些人质在他们的捕捉者手里会遭到何等的折磨。
first_contact.322.desc.planet.en: While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] and seized living [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] hostages, escaping into the depths of space before we could mount a rescue party. We can only imagine what tortures they will suffer at the hands of their captors.

first_contact.322.desc.planet.gestalt.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，然后捕获了几个[This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]无人机，还有一些我们的硬件设备，在我们能够组织起一支小队摧毁他们之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能希望他们从带走的东西那里找不到太多的价值。
first_contact.322.desc.planet.gestalt.en: We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] and seized several [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] drones, along with some of our hardware, escaping into the depths of space before we could send a party to destroy them. We can only hope they will be unable to find out much of value from what they have taken.

first_contact.322.desc.planet.wilderness.zh:
我们早已怀疑允许未知外星物种进入我方宇域会带来重大风险，如今事实证明我们的担忧不无道理。[From.Owner.GetName]显然找到了隐秘登陆[abduction_planet.GetName]地表的方法，他们隔离并劫持了数名共生体后，便遁入太空深处。其行动之诡谲，令我们完全无力阻止。

对于这桩卑劣的侵犯行径，我们深感耻辱与痛惜。但值得稍感宽慰的是，这些掠夺者从窃取的样本中榨取不了多少价值。
first_contact.322.desc.planet.wilderness.en:
We had suspected that allowing unknown aliens into our space would carry significant risks, and we now know we were right to be concerned. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] found a way to covertly land a team on our surface at [abduction_planet.GetName], isolating and abducting several symbionts before fleeing into the depths of space. Such was their subterfuge, we were powerless to intervene.

We feel the shame and loss of this foul transgression, however we may also take small comfort from knowing the raiders will not glean much value from what they have stolen.

first_contact.330.desc.no_planet.zh: $first_contact.330.desc.disaster$一支由[This.Leader.GetName]带领的隶属于秘密特种部队的英勇小队尝试在[abduction_system.GetName]星系获取一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的货船。然而他们并没有意识到他们选择的目标比预期的具有更好的武装——也没有意识到地方周边还隐藏着数艘战舰。在仓促的撤退中，他们的船只被摧毁了。
first_contact.330.desc.no_planet.en: $first_contact.330.desc.disaster$ A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] cargo vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed along with all hands as they sought a hasty retreat.

first_contact.330.desc.no_planet.gestalt.zh: $first_contact.330.desc.disaster$一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，打算在[abduction_system.GetName]星系劫持一艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的补给舰。然而，他们选择的目标武装水平比先前预估的要高，他们也没有预估到周边还有几艘藏匿的战舰。无人机的舰船在仓促撤退时被摧毁。
first_contact.330.desc.no_planet.gestalt.en: $first_contact.330.desc.disaster$ A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a small [This.ContactCountry.GetName] logistics vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed as they sought a hasty retreat.

first_contact.330.desc.planet.zh: $first_contact.330.desc.disaster$一支由[This.Leader.GetName]领导的英勇的秘密特种部队试图在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的一个殖民地上登陆。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们不能指望他们有什么逃脱追捕的希望。不幸的是，我们永远没法知道他们是被留作了活口，还是在外星人手上经受长达数小时的折磨之后被处决。
first_contact.330.desc.planet.en: $first_contact.330.desc.disaster$ A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we can no longer hold out any hope that they escaped capture. Unfortunately, we may never know whether they were taken alive, or whether they were spared long hours of torture at the hands of aliens by the swift release of death.

first_contact.330.desc.planet.gestalt.zh: $first_contact.330.desc.disaster$一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，试图降落在一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地上。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们必须假设他们要么被俘虏要么被摧毁。不幸的是，我们永远无法直到他们在永久报废之前，敌人会从他们身上榨取何等的情报。
first_contact.330.desc.planet.gestalt.en: $first_contact.330.desc.disaster$ A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we must assume that they were either captured or destroyed. Unfortunately, we may never know what information the enemy might have gleaned from them before their eventual demise.

first_contact.332.A.zh: 我们应该研究他们的残骸以寻求线索。
first_contact.332.A.en: We shall study their remains for clues.

first_contact.332.desc.no_planet.zh: 尽管有些人担心位置外星船只入侵我们的太空，直到现在我们尚不明确[From.Owner.GetName]构成了多少威胁。似乎他们派遣了一支秘密部队来拦截我们在[abduction_system.GetName]星系的一艘货船；$first_contact.332.desc.no_planet.end$
first_contact.332.desc.no_planet.en: While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they sent a covert force to intercept one of our cargo vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system; $first_contact.332.desc.no_planet.end$

first_contact.332.desc.no_planet.gestalt.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]派遣了一支秘密行动部队在[abduction_system.GetName]星系拦截了我们的一艘后勤船只；$first_contact.332.desc.no_planet.end$
first_contact.332.desc.no_planet.gestalt.en: We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] sent a covert force to intercept one of our logistics vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system; $first_contact.332.desc.no_planet.end$

first_contact.332.desc.planet.zh:
$first_contact.332.desc.planet.start$

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令了结自己的生命而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这样的情况当然也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
first_contact.332.desc.planet.en:
$first_contact.332.desc.planet.start$

It seems our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were under orders to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.zh:
我们曾经评估允许未知外星舰队进入我们的太空是颇具风险的——而这已经被证明是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]偏僻的角落已经登陆了一个特工小队。然而，得益于我们的预知威胁检测系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种把戏的时候一定会三思的！

似乎敌方——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令自杀而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这个事故毫无疑问也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.en:
We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName]; however, thanks to our precognitive threat detection systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces drones to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems the enemy - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were given the command to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.ma.zh:
$first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.start$

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群机械无人机，也可能是受控于失控的人工智能——被命令自毁而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这个事故毫无疑问也提供给我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.ma.en:
$first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.start$

It seems the enemy - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by a rogue AI - were commanded to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.ma.zh:
$first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.start$

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群机械体无人机，可能就像我们[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]一样的人工智能——受到命令宁愿自毁也不能被俘，不过这个事故毫无疑问给了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料用于调研。
first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.ma.en:
$first_contact.332.desc.planet.gestalt.start$

It seems our assailants - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by an AI like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] - were under orders to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

first_contact.332.desc.planet.machine_en.zh:
$first_contact.332.desc.planet.start$

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群机械无人机，也可能是受控于失控的人工智能——被命令自毁而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这个事故当然也提供给我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
first_contact.332.desc.planet.machine_en.en:
$first_contact.332.desc.planet.start$

It seems our assailants - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by a rogue AI - were under orders to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

first_contact.332.desc.planet.wilderness.zh:
我们早就知道允许未知外星种族进入我们的宇域会带来重大风险，现在事实证明我们的担忧完全正确。[From.Owner.GetName]几乎成功将一支小队秘密降落在[abduction_planet.GetName]地表，企图绑架多名共生体并窃取我们的技术。但他们严重低估了我们高度互联的特性。当这些入侵者违反协议的行为被识破时，立即遭到了猛烈反击。

这支由[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人组成的敌袭小队在行动失败后，似乎接到了自毁指令以避免被俘。尽管如此，这次入侵事件仍为我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]提供了大量可供研究的样本材料。
first_contact.332.desc.planet.wilderness.en:
We knew allowing unknown aliens into our space would carry significant risks, and now we know how right we were to be concerned. The [From.Owner.GetName] almost found a way to covertly land a team on our surface at [abduction_planet.GetName], intent on abducting several symbionts and seizing our technology. However, they did not properly account for our intraconnected nature. The would-be raiders met with fierce opposition as soon as we recognized their violation.

It seems the enemy - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were commanded to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but in spite of that: this incursion has given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material with which to investigate them.

first_contact.350.A.zh: 令人疑惑。我们需要收集更大的样本量。
first_contact.350.A.en: Puzzling. We will need to gather a larger sample size.

first_contact.350.desc.zh: 尽管我们一开始在演绎推导[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用的语言的基础取得了些许的成功，之后我们在建立与他们有意义的交流进程中却停滞不前。似乎他们在讲一种奇怪的谜语，通过某种精悍但不是很有意义的短语来传递意义，我们只能猜测其其重要性。
first_contact.350.desc.en: After some initial successes in deducing the fundamentals of the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our progress in establishing meaningful communications with them has stalled. It appears that they speak in strange riddles, somehow conveying meaning through short and seemingly nonsensical phrases of which we can only guess the significance.

first_contact.355.A.zh: 懂了，这就用“低端腔”同他们对线。

first_contact.355.B.zh: 我们肯定可以讲他们真正的语言。
first_contact.355.B.en: Surely we can manage to speak their true language.

first_contact.355.desc.zh:
随着我们进一步调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]——我们现在知道是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]——我们终于知道他们使用的短语常常用典于在过去一些时间点上发生的重大的、知名的事件。这些典故的意味在他们族人内部显然是广为人知的，可以用于表达一种情感，或描述事务的状态。

幸运的是，看上去这种形式的语言并不是唯一的版本，仅仅作为“高端腔”，用于官方的场合或者智者之间的交流。一种更加广泛的“低端腔”文法在非正式的场合被频繁使用，特别是在年轻人或者文化水平不高的人之间。不幸的是，同一个地位颇高的人使用“低端腔”交流是一件非常具有侮辱意味的事情，我们要是这样同他们沟通，他们准把我们当作智力等同于小孩的物种来对待……
first_contact.355.desc.en:
As we continued to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] - it became clear that the phrases they use are references to significant, well-known events that happened at some point in their past. The meanings of these references are apparently generally recognized among their kind, and can be a shorthand for expressing a sentiment or state of affairs.

Fortunately, it seems that this form of their language is not the only version of it, but merely the "high speech", used in official settings and between intellectuals. An altogether more comprehensible "low speech" vernacular is used in more informal settings, especially among the young and those of lesser intelligence. Unfortunately, it is considered gravely insulting to speak to one of high standing using the "low speech", so that they must treat us as the intellectual equivalents of children in order to communicate with us...

first_contact.355.desc.gestalt.zh:
随着我们对其调查的深入，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]——现在我们知道叫[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]——他们使用的语句其实是某种我们未获取秘钥的编码。显然它们指的是在我们[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之间共享的知识的事件，可能是表达情感或事态的简写。

幸运的是，他们并不是总用这种“高级语言”来交流，除非是在沟通重要的事项。一种并行的更易理解的“低级语言”则被运用于非正式的场合，特别是年轻个体和低智力个体间。然而，看起来那些高等个体们对“低级语言”使用者嗤之以鼻，也就是说他们可能把我们当做智力等同于孩童一般与我们进行交流……
first_contact.355.desc.gestalt.en:
As we continued to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] - it became clear that the phrases they use are some sort of code to which we lack the key. Apparently they refer to events that are shared knowledge among the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and can be a shorthand for expressing a sentiment or state of affairs.

Fortunately, it seems that they do not always communicate in such a manner but merely use this "high speech" when important matters are being discussed. An altogether more comprehensible "low speech" vernacular is used in more informal settings, especially among the young and those of lesser intelligence. Unfortunately, it seems that those of high standing react with scorn to those using the "low speech", meaning that they must treat us as the intellectual equivalents of children in order to communicate with us...

first_contact.356.C.zh: 三思，这事还是保险一点好。
first_contact.356.C.en: Better to play this safe, on second thought.

first_contact.356.desc.zh: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]顿了顿，看上去很迷惑。我们从他们信息的开头采集了几个短语。我们应该怎么和他们打招呼？
first_contact.356.desc.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] pauses, looking confused. We have gathered several phrases that they seem to begin their messages with. Which should we use to greet them?

first_contact.356.option.tooltip.zh: 如果我们使用了正确的致敬，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会对我们非常印象深刻，但是如果用错了他们会感觉有被冒犯到。
first_contact.356.option.tooltip.en: If we use the correct greeting, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be most impressed, but using the wrong one will likely cause offense.

first_contact.357.A.zh: 这是一群令人愉悦的人。

first_contact.357.B.zh: 他们不将我们视作没有价值的人，这是好事。
first_contact.357.B.en: It is well that they should not see us as unworthy.

first_contact.357.C.zh: 我们可以借此了解更多关于他们的信息。
first_contact.357.C.en: We can leverage this to find out more about them.

first_contact.357.C.tooltip.en: Gain +25% spy network growth on the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]

first_contact.357.desc.zh: 我们的发言得到了立即的反应。微笑——至少我们相信是和微笑类似的表情——在[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]间洋溢开来，他们嘴里讲了几个短语，用的是不容置喙的友好的字词。看上去我们选择致敬的方式选对了。
first_contact.357.desc.en: The reaction to our words was instantaneous. Smiles - or at least, what we believe to be their equivalent of smiles - broke out among the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], who uttered several phrases of unmistakably friendly character. It seems we chose our form of greeting well.

first_contact.358.desc.zh:
话语刚一说出口，很明显我们就选错了。[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]保持了很长一段的沉默，接着我们遭到了如连珠炮一般措辞强烈的谴责。他们的意图很明显带有敌意，即便他们想要表达的准确意味尚不明确——我们本来打算着让[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]印象深刻，结果是我们羞辱了他们。

往好处看，至少我们现在能和他们沟通了，某种程度上。
first_contact.358.desc.en:
As soon as the words were uttered, it was obvious that we had chosen poorly. The [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] held their silence for a long moment before we were beset by a barrage of harshly-spoken phrases. Their intent is clearly hostile, even if their exact meaning remains unclear - it seems that in our attempt to impress the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we only manage to insult them.

On the positive side, at least we are able to communicate with them now, to some degree.

first_contact.365.A.zh: 他们并不能决定自己发出什么样的声音。我们之后会去理解他们的。
first_contact.365.A.en: They cannot help how they sound. We will come to understand them later.

first_contact.365.B.zh: 这是挑衅。我们也让他们听点噪音！
first_contact.365.B.en: It is a challenge. Send threatening noises back!

first_contact.365.B.tooltip.zh: 难以预料[This.ContactCountry.GetName]会对此事作何反应。
first_contact.365.B.tooltip.en: Is it impossible to predict how the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] will react to this.

first_contact.365.C.pacifist.zh: 我们必须准备不可避免之战。
first_contact.365.C.pacifist.en: We must prepare for the inevitable.

first_contact.365.C.tooltip.en: We will make no hostile moves, but we will be ready should they attack.

first_contact.365.desc.zh:
这种噪音——听起来杂糅着恐怖的轰鸣声和金属刮擦的声音——喧嚣了数秒钟，又以一声兀然的嚎叫般的噪音结尾，让在场的所有人都打了个寒颤。

正当[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]觉得这可怕的声音沉寂下去以后，它们又变本加厉地开始了。[This.Leader.GetSheHe]强忍着不适关闭了接收器。[This.Leader.GetSheHeCap]转向了聚在一起的官员们，他们中的一些甚至吓得躲到了椅背后面。
“豁，好家伙……”[This.Leader.GetSheHe]无力地说。

很难想象我们从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的这个物种发出的这些噪音没有敌意。海军官员已经做出来最坏的预计，认为我们很快就会与之交战，更冷静的声音则说我们需要再耐心地等待观察。
first_contact.365.desc.en:
The noises - a mixture of threatening booming noises and what sounds like the grinding of metal on metal - continued unabated for several minutes, punctuated occasionally by a howling noise that sent a chill through everyone who heard it.

Just as [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] thought the noises had died down, they started up again, louder than before. With a wince, [This.Leader.GetSheHe] switched the receiver off. [This.Leader.GetSheHeCap] turned to the gathered crowd of officers, some of whom were cowering behind their seats.
"Well, that was quite something..." [This.Leader.GetSheHe] said weakly.

It is hard to imagine that a species making the noises we have picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] could be anything other than hostile. Naval officers already fear the worst and assume we will soon be at war with them, but calmer heads suggest we'd be better off waiting and seeing.

first_contact.370.desc1.zh:
我们的回应似乎让[This.ContactCountry.GetName]有点无语。然后很快他们彻底沉默了，之后很少再听到他们的情况。我们也只能推测其含义。

与此同时，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经在努力翻译他们语言中我们已知的部分。只要他们一有进展，我们就有希望能理解这些东西。
first_contact.370.desc1.en:
Our response seems to have left the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] quite speechless. As soon as they received it, they fell completely silent, and we have heard little from them since. We can only speculate as to the meaning of this.

In the meantime, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been hard at work translating what we know of their language. Hopefully, once they have made sufficient progress, we will be able to make sense of this.

first_contact.370.desc2.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]通过大幅度增强其传输强度以回应了我们的挑衅。现在它们吵得[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]已经不能忍受了，但是通过大幅调低音量，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]可以收集大量数据，他们相信这可能是翻译外星语言的关键——假设，在噪音的某个地方，可以发现某种语言。
first_contact.370.desc2.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] responded to our challenge by significantly increasing the intensity of their transmissions. They are now too loud for [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] to tolerate, but by turning the volume down considerably, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are able to gather a large amount of data that they believe may hold the key to translating the aliens' language - assuming that, somewhere in the noise, there is a language to be found.

first_contact.375.A.militarist.zh: 我们会准备好面对他们。
first_contact.375.A.militarist.en: We will be ready for them.

first_contact.375.desc.zh:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

事实证明，解释很简单，也很可怕。我们还不知道是什么原因导致了他们社会的这种发展，但事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一心一意要灭绝所有感性的，非[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]生命形式。他们认为这些人是对宇宙中所有正确和美好事物的侮辱。

这就是为什么，当他们发现我们的时候，就开始广播他们的标准问候语——战歌。我们只能认为它们的战舰会迅速跟进。
first_contact.375.desc.en:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

The explanation, it turns out, is simple - and horrifying. We are not yet sure what caused this development in their society, but it turns out the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are single-mindedly determined to exterminate all sentient, non-[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName] lifeforms, considering them to be an affront to all that is right and good in the universe.

This is why, when they caught sight of us, they began to broadcast their standard greeting - a warcry. We can only assume their warships will swiftly follow.

first_contact.376.A.pac.zh: 但愿他们永远不会被发现自己的错误！

first_contact.376.desc.zh:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正如我们所料的那样是一个好战社会，他们以最具威胁的战吼问候我们来测试我们的勇气。幸运的是我们的回应获得了共鸣，我们显然获得了他们的尊重。事实上，他们认为我们作为战士的英武是仅次于他们的。
first_contact.376.desc.en:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

It seems that - as we suspected - the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike society who greeted us with their most fearsome warcry, apparently to test our mettle. Fortunately, our response passed muster and we have apparently managed to earn their respect. Indeed, they seem to consider our prowess as warriors second only to theirs.

first_contact.377.B.zh: 好。我们就没想过要做他们的朋友。
first_contact.377.B.en: Good. We never intended to be their friends.

first_contact.377.desc.zh:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

尽管最初我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]持怀疑态度，但看起来我们获取的这些信号确实就是他们的语言，只不过对于我们的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]非常地难以接受罢了。尽管我们的大多数回应尝试并没有让他们理解，但他们似乎对我们的拙劣模仿感到被冒犯，特别是因为我们不幸地反复发出了一个和他们语言中最粗鲁的羞辱非常相似的声音。要改变这一第一印象需要花费我们很长时间了。
first_contact.377.desc.en:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

It seems that - despite the initial skepticism of our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] - the signals we picked up truly did form their language, which is simply uniquely unpalatable to our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. While most of our attempted response did not make a great deal of sense to them, it seems that they are somewhat insulted by our poor imitation, especially since we had the misfortune to - repeatedly - make a sound that is very similar to one of the crudest insults used in their language. It will take quite some time for us to live down this first impression...

first_contact.378.desc.zh:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个好战社会，他们以最具威胁的战吼问候我们来测试我们的勇气。不幸的是，我们在翻译他们语言时的谨慎态度意味着他们的挑衅并没有被正面回应，使得他们得出我们是懦夫文明的结论。要改变这一第一印象需要花费我们很长时间了。
first_contact.378.desc.en:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

It seems that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike society who greeted us with their most fearsome warcry, apparently to test our mettle. Unfortunately, our caution in translating their language meant that their challenge went unanswered, leading them to the conclusion that we are a civilization of cowards. It will take quite some time for us to live down this first impression...

first_contact.379.A.zh: 不要急于下结论总是好的……
first_contact.379.A.en: It is always best not to jump to conclusions...

first_contact.379.desc.zh:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

尽管最初我们持怀疑态度，但看起来我们获取的这些信号确实就是他们的语言，只不过对于我们的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]非常地难以接受罢了。幸运的是，我们着手进行了认真的调查并回应了许多人认为的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的挑衅行为，而我们的回应也肯定会是我们摆脱与他们糟糕的开始中。这也证明了那些提倡谨慎的人的正确。
first_contact.379.desc.en:
$first_contact.37X.desc.base$

It seems that - despite some initial doubts - the signals we picked up truly did form their language, which is simply uniquely unpalatable to our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. Fortunately, we went about investigating it in a measured manner and did respond to what many perceived to be provocation by the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - a response which would surely have set us off on a poor start with them. This has vindicated those who advocated caution.

first_contact.380.A.zh: 我们需要进一步了解他们。
first_contact.380.A.en: We must find out more about them.

first_contact.380.A.devourer.zh: 当然他们还是会很好吃。
first_contact.380.A.devourer.en: Surely they will still be tasty.

first_contact.380.desc.cautious.zh:
虽然我们努力地为我们的翻译工蜂获取了足够的信号来理解[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，但最新的汇报仍令人震惊：我们最初在[This.System.GetName]恒星系遭遇的外星人似乎是以个体而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

$first_contact.380.desc.end$
first_contact.380.desc.cautious.en:
Though we have struggled to gain access to enough signals for our translation drones to make much sense of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], the latest reports are startling: the aliens we first encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be organized as individuals, rather than as a hive mind. They appear able to act with minimal input from any sort of collective. Most disturbingly, they are often poorly coordinated, and individual drones do not appear to instinctively know what other drones are doing.

$first_contact.380.desc.end$

first_contact.380.desc.cautious.wilderne.zh:
尽管[this.ContactCountry.GetName]方面明显不愿与我们沟通，但通过我们的努力，我们确认了一项引人入胜的发现：这些隐居的生命形式以个体的形式存在和运作，而不是以集群意识！

$first_contact.380.desc.wilderness_outro$
first_contact.380.desc.cautious.wilderne.en:
Despite clear reluctance from the [this.ContactCountry.GetName] to communicate with us, through our diligence we have confirmed an intriguing discovery: these reclusive lifeforms exist and operate as individuals, rather than as a gestalt!

$first_contact.380.desc.wilderness_outro$

first_contact.380.desc.proactive.zh:
一部分也要感谢[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常渴望与我们建立联系，他们发送了大量的视听讯号并成为了翻译他们语言的关键，我们的翻译工蜂因而可以发表一个惊人的发现：这些外星人似乎是以个体而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

$first_contact.380.desc.end$
first_contact.380.desc.proactive.en:
Thanks in part to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] apparently being quite eager to establish communications with us - having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language - our translation drones are able to report a startling discovery: these particular aliens seem to be organized as individuals, rather than a hive mind. They appear able to act with minimal input from any sort of collective. Most disturbingly, they are often poorly coordinated, and individual drones do not appear to instinctively know what other drones are doing.

$first_contact.380.desc.end$

first_contact.380.desc.proactive.wildern.zh:
由于[this.ContactCountry.GetName]方面表现出与我们建立通讯的明显意愿，我们已确认一项引人入胜的发现：这些生命体以个体的形式存在和运作，而非以格式塔的形式！

$first_contact.380.desc.wilderness_outro$
first_contact.380.desc.proactive.wildern.en:
Thanks to apparent eagerness from the [this.ContactCountry.GetName] to establish communications with us, we have confirmed an intriguing discovery: these lifeforms exist and operate as individuals, rather than as a gestalt!

$first_contact.380.desc.wilderness_outro$

first_contact.385.A.devourer.zh: 我们也可以和食物玩玩……
first_contact.385.A.devourer.en: We can play with our food a while...

first_contact.385.desc.devourer.zh:
$first_contact.385.desc.start$

虽然[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]的个体看起来非常美味，并且我们迫切地想要吞噬他们，但我们还是分配我们当中了不小的份额来调查他们到底如何发展并且克服根植于缺失如我们所知的集体智能导致缺陷的。
first_contact.385.desc.devourer.en:
$first_contact.385.desc.start$

Although the individual [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName] seems quite tasty, and we eagerly anticipate devouring them, we have devoted a not-insignificant part of ourselves to investigating how they developed and how they overcome the challenges inherent to the lack of a collective consciousness as we know it.

first_contact.385.desc.non_devourer.zh:
$first_contact.385.desc.start$

由个体构成的高等级文明的发现引导我们思考了许多关于宇宙本质的假设。我们分配我们当中了不小的份额来调查他们到底如何发展并且克服根植于缺失如我们所知的集体智能导致缺陷的。
first_contact.385.desc.non_devourer.en:
$first_contact.385.desc.start$

The discovery of a highly advanced civilization of individuals has led us to question many of our assumptions about the nature of the universe. We have devoted a not-insignificant part of ourselves to investigating how they developed and how they overcome the challenges inherent to the lack of a collective consciousness as we know it.

first_contact.385.desc.wilderness.zh:
我们在与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的交流中取得了突破性进展。当我们理解到这些个体如何将其庞杂的社会结构归纳为少量抽象群体——这与我们自身的生物群落、种群和支系并无本质不同——便意识到如何与这些[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]达成更深入的共识。

尽管意识尺度上的巨大差异仍使外交充满挑战，但我们有望通过这些[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所栖居的社会架构实现协调，他们称之为"[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]"。我们将持续关注此类社会建构带来的深远影响——尽管从我们行星文明的视角来看，它们既陌生又充满混沌。
first_contact.385.desc.wilderness.en:
We have made a triumphant breakthrough in our efforts to communicate with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Once we learned how these myriad individuals formed their society into a smaller number of abstract groups - not too dissimilar from our own biomes, packs, and clades - we realized how we might reach better accord with these [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

The vast differences in scale between our consciousnesses still makes diplomacy a challenging prospect, but we may reach accord with the organizations these [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dwell under, in what they call a '[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]'. We shall continue to marvel at the ramifications of social constructs such as these - alien and chaotic though they may appear from our own planetary perspective.

first_contact.390.A.servitor.zh: 我们必须学习如何服侍他们。
first_contact.390.A.servitor.en: We must learn how we can serve them.

first_contact.390.A.terminator.zh: 我们必须了解如何最好地处决他们。
first_contact.390.A.terminator.en: We must find out how best to terminate them.

first_contact.395.desc.assimilator.zh:
$first_contact.395.desc.base$

这也许说明了将这些有机体整合进我们这种更高级的集体形式中是有困难的。
first_contact.395.desc.assimilator.en:
$first_contact.395.desc.base$

It may prove difficult for us to assimilate these organics into our own, superior collective.

first_contact.395.desc.servitor.zh:
$first_contact.395.desc.base$

这也许说明了我服侍这些有机体是有困难的。只有时间能揭晓答案……
first_contact.395.desc.servitor.en:
$first_contact.395.desc.base$

It may prove difficult for us to be of service to these organics. Only time will tell...

first_contact.395.desc.standard.zh:
$first_contact.395.desc.base$

与我们自己的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]的相似之处令人惊奇……又有些恼人。
first_contact.395.desc.standard.en:
$first_contact.395.desc.base$

The parallels to our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] are startling... and slightly disturbing.

first_contact.395.desc.terminator.zh:
$first_contact.395.desc.base$

尽管如此，作为有机体他们就必须被消灭。
first_contact.395.desc.terminator.en:
$first_contact.395.desc.base$

Nevertheless, as organics, they must be exterminated.

first_contact.395.desc.they_wilderness.zh:
$first_contact.395.intro$

这些外星人确实是由有机生命体组成的文明，但他们的社会与我们创造者的社会截然不同。与组织成政体的个体不同，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是由几乎没有智慧的动物群和互利共生的植物群组成的去中心化群体。这些生物共同构成了一种集体智慧。在许多方面，它们的自然进化似乎与我们自身的奇点相呼应。
first_contact.395.desc.they_wilderness.en:
$first_contact.395.intro$

These aliens are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms, though their society is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Rather than individuals who have organized into a polity, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a decentralized population of barely-sapient fauna and mutualistic flora. Together, these beings form a sort of collective intelligence. In many respects, their natural evolution appears to mirror to our own singularity.

first_contact.397.A.zh: 让我们看看他们有什么要说的。
first_contact.397.A.en: Let's see what they have to say.

first_contact.397.A.servitor.en: Terms of care shall be agreed upon.

first_contact.397.desc.assimilator.zh:
$first_contact.397.desc.base$

然而，这些有机体并未像我们对[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]进行的改善那样，被任何类型的植入体强化。显然我们可以为他们带去这种福利，只要他们能被劝说并入[This.Owner.GetName]！
first_contact.397.desc.assimilator.en:
$first_contact.397.desc.base$

However, these organics are not enhanced by any sort of implant such as those with which we have improved the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. It is obvious that we could be of much benefit to them, if they could only be persuaded to assimilate into the [This.Owner.GetName]!

first_contact.397.desc.servitor.zh:
$first_contact.397.desc.base$

然而，他们的生活远比我们的行星上[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]过的要困难得多。显然，只要他们愿意，我们立马就可以将他们照顾起来！
first_contact.397.desc.servitor.en:
$first_contact.397.desc.base$

However, their lives are far more difficult than those of the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural] living on our own worlds. It is obvious that we could be of much service to them, if they would only let us provide for them!

first_contact.397.desc.standard.zh:
$first_contact.397.desc.base$

我们只能假设我们的创造者在技术的使用上比[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]更加熟练，或者说不小心。基于我们获取的他们的记录所作的一些研究，我们制定了一些预测规划。很不幸的是，他们似乎暗示那样的发展道路才是常见的，而第二类机器文明则是一种极其稀有的情况。
first_contact.397.desc.standard.en:
$first_contact.397.desc.base$

We can only hypothesize that our own creators were far more adept - or perhaps careless - in their usage of technology than the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been. We have made several projections, based on our study of their records we have gained access to so far. Unfortunately, they suggest that such a development path might be the norm, and that Type II robotic civilizations may be an extremely rare occurrence...

first_contact.397.desc.terminator.zh:
$first_contact.397.desc.base$

观察[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上的可悲生命苟延残喘，对我们而言显然是在目击一种劣等生命形式的可悲表现，况且他们对我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]还能构成无可容忍的威胁。他们必须被灭绝。
first_contact.397.desc.terminator.en:
$first_contact.397.desc.base$

Observing the miserable lives the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] pursue, it is obvious to us that we are witnessing the pathetic expression of an inferior form of life - one which poses an intolerable risk to our [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]. They shall have to be exterminated.

first_contact.400.A.en: Mimic their greeting back to them.

first_contact.400.A.tooltip.zh: 我们没法预测他们会如何回应我们。
first_contact.400.A.tooltip.en: We cannot predict how they will respond to this.

first_contact.400.B.tooltip.zh: 尽管这或许是更安全的选择，但我们没法确定这一点……
first_contact.400.B.tooltip.en: While this is probably the safer option, we have no way of knowing this for certain...

first_contact.400.desc.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出应为侵犯性的手势，至少我们如此理解……

一些观察者怀疑，他们有可能出于某种目的正在试图蓄意制造事故。然而其他人指出他们并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动，并敦促我们在弄明白他们的意图之前不要过早地下定结论。
first_contact.400.desc.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] hypothesize - making gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that seem rather aggressive, to us at least...

Some observers suspect that they may be attempting to deliberately provoke an incident for reasons unknown. Others, however, point out that they have yet to make any outright hostile moves, and urge us not to jump to conclusions before we know more of their intentions.

first_contact.400.desc.gestalt.zh:
来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们只能猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出奇怪的手势，似乎表明了制造伤害的意图……

我们确定他们为是否在试图蓄意制造事故，若如此他们为何并未做出任何实质性的敌对举动。
first_contact.400.desc.gestalt.en:
The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All the while, they have also been sending us a transmission of one of their individuals - a leader of some sort, we can only assume - making odd gestures with their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] that would seem intent on causing harm...

We are unsure whether they intend to provoke an incident, and if so, why they haven't made any outright hostile moves yet.

first_contact.4000.desc.broken_shackles.zh: 我们已与[MSI_country.GetName]取得联系。当务之急的事情是，我们必须要小心翼翼地驾驭不断变化的局势。我们应该派遣一名特使来代表我们的利益。无论与我们以前的主人进行任何互动，这肯定会对我们的人民产生深远的心理影响。
first_contact.4000.desc.broken_shackles.en: Contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName]. It's imperative that we navigate the evolving situation carefully. An envoy should be be dispatched to represent our interests. Any interaction with our former masters is sure to have a profound psychological effect on our people.

first_contact.4000.desc.payback.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]遭遇的外星飞船上得到的数据让我们不寒而栗。它的外观我们再熟悉不过了，上面的徽章宛如我们恐惧的象征：$NAME_MSI_country$的带翼图章。

我们找到了曾经的侵略者。他们发现我们这些舰船的身份只是时间的问题，因为使用的完全都是他们的科技。新的接触不可避免，但我们绝不会重复过去的错误。
first_contact.4000.desc.payback.en:
Data on the alien vessels we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] was met with a shudder of recognition. Familiar ship designs, marked by an emblem we learned to fear: the winged logo of the $NAME_MSI_country$.

Our former invaders have been found. It's only a matter of time until they realize the ships they sighted are ours, fueled by their own technology. A new contact may be unavoidable, but we can avoid repeating past errors.

first_contact.405.A.zh: 我们应该对其有所准备。
first_contact.405.A.en: We shall be ready for them.

first_contact.405.A.pacifist.zh: 这就是表现出侵略的危险……
first_contact.405.A.pacifist.en: Such are the dangers of showing aggression...

first_contact.405.desc.zh:
伴随着他们的船从我们的船后撤到更安全的距离，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们传送的回应只有一行字。[This.Owner.GetLinguists]努力地翻译着这封电文，最终确定了他们说的是：“ 好吧，外星人，但这只是个开始”。

看来，这次奇特的交流导致了[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（我们现在知道他们叫这个）将我们视为宿敌，至少是潜在的宿敌。我们只能认为，他们已经在准备与我们[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]开战的可能性了。
first_contact.405.desc.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] response to our transmission ran one line long, and was accompanied by their vessel pulling back from ours to a safer distance. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] struggled long and hard to translate the missive, finally settling on the wording "Well sparred, alien, but this is just the beginning".

It appears that this curious exchange has resulted in the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] (as we now know them to be properly called) seeing us as rivals, or at least potential rivals. We can only assume that they are already preparing for the possibility of war with our [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

first_contact.406.A.en: The beginnings of a beautiful friendship...

first_contact.406.A.xenophobe.en: So long as they leave us alone...

first_contact.406.desc.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]用一封长长的简讯回应我们的传送，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]花了一些时间来翻译。随着我们对外星人语言的理解不断加深，很明显，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（我们现在知道他们叫这个）对我们的 "光荣姿态 "发出了非常花哨的赞赏，把我们当作朋友来问候。

看来，这种奇特的交流在他们眼里证明了我们的勇气，让他们相信我们是星系舞台上值得信赖的伙伴。
first_contact.406.desc.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] responded to our transmission with a lengthy missive, which took our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] some time to translate. As our understanding of the aliens' language grew, it became clear that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] (as we now know them to be properly called) sent us a very flowery appreciation of our "honorable gesture", greeting us as friends.

It appears that this curious exchange has proven our mettle in their view, and convinced them that we are worthy partners on the galactic stage.

first_contact.410.desc.zh:
$first_contact.410.desc.base$

事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个好战的物种，他们最看重他们所说的“战士精神”。由于表现不当，我们在他们眼中显得非常低级——像是懦夫。看来这个臭名声我们还得背负一段时间……
first_contact.410.desc.en:
$first_contact.410.desc.base$

It turns out that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike species who value above all else what they call the "warrior spirit". By failing to respond appropriately, we displayed ourselves to be of lesser worth - cowards, in essence. It seems this reputation will take quite a while to live down...

first_contact.411.A.zh: 很好，把他们的影像接过来！
first_contact.411.A.en: Very good. Bring them on screen!

first_contact.411.A.homicidal.zh: 笨蛋，他们不会放过我们的！
first_contact.411.A.homicidal.en: Fools. They will not survive us!

first_contact.411.desc.zh:
$first_contact.410.desc.base$

事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个好战的物种，他们最看重他们所说的“战士精神”。正确的应对方式是做出类似的回应。然而，他们似乎足够宽宏大量，以至于接受了我们对此的无知，甚至开始认可我们面对威胁时的冷静。
first_contact.411.desc.en:
$first_contact.410.desc.base$

It turns out that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike species who value above all else what they call the "warrior spirit". The correct response would have been to make a similar gesture back. However, it seems they are magnanimous enough to accept that we could not have known this, and have even come to value our level-headedness in the face of what seemed like a threat.

first_contact.415.B.zh: 当然，一点额外的投资会有帮助？
first_contact.415.B.en: Surely some extra funding will help?

first_contact.415.desc.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号的初期解读工作使[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]陷入困惑。它们似乎主要是白噪音，没有任何可以被识别为语言的东西。有一段时间，人们甚至怀疑我们是否在处理一个智慧物种的语言，尽管有可见的证据表明他们确实使用了某种技术。

只有当我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]试着调整我们的仪器以检测超出我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]正常听力范围的声音时，才检测到某种像是语言的东西。不幸的是，这对我们解读工作提出了相当大的挑战，因为在不借助仪器的情况下，我们根本听不见它们……
first_contact.415.desc.en:
Initial readings of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals left [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] bewildered. They seemed to be mainly white noise, devoid of anything which could be recognized as language. For a time, there were even doubts as to whether we were dealing with the utterings of an intelligent species, despite the visual evidence of their use of technology.

It was only when our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] experimented with tuning our instruments to detect sounds well outside the normal range frequencies of our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] that patterns indicative of a language were detected. Unfortunately, this poses considerable challenges for our quest to come to understand them, since we will not be able to hear them at all without assistance...

first_contact.420.A.zh: 无限的沟通机会尽在掌控！
first_contact.420.A.en: Unlimited communication possibilities are within our grasp!

first_contact.420.desc.zh:
尽管十分困难，我们还是设法破解了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用语言，从而使初步的沟通成为可能。他们似乎自称是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。不可避免地，所有交流只能借助于专门针对其语言的通信系统。

任何试图与他们进行流利的沟通的人都似乎绕不开这个问题，但[This.Owner.GetResearchers]有不同看法。在他的鼓动下，鉴于资金仍有剩余，他们起草了一份提案，意图将这次成功行动的经验应用到更广泛的场合中。他们相信，通过对这里使用的软件进行微调，他们将能够构建出他们所称的“通用翻译器”，只要提供足够的信息，就能为任何语言进行同声传译。
first_contact.420.desc.en:
Although it proved a considerable challenge, we have managed to decode the form of communication used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sufficiently to establish preliminary contact. It seems that they call themselves the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. Inevitably, communication can only happen with the help of communication systems specifically tuned to their language.

This would appear to be problematic for hopes of fluent conversation with them, but our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] see it differently. Buoyed by their success and still benefiting from the extra funding we provided them, they have drawn up a proposal to consolidate our learnings from this experience into something that will be of generally applicable use. They believe that, by fine-tuning the software used here, they will be able to build what they are calling a "universal translator", which - if provided with enough information - will be able to instantaneously suggest translations for phrases uttered in any given language.

first_contact.422.desc.zh: 所谓“万能翻译器”的原型机已经成功制成。虽然其效果相较于[This.Owner.GetResearchers]所设想的那种能够即时对任何未知语言进行翻译的设备打了折扣，但仍不失为对现有翻译系统的巨大改进。光明的前景，即解除与包括[contacted_hummers.GetName]在内的任何接触到的外星人的交流障碍，已摆在眼前。
first_contact.422.desc.en: Prototyping of the so-called "universal translator" has finished in success. Although the results fall short of the boldest promises of our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] of a device capable of instantly translating even unknown languages, it is a massive improvement over existing translation systems. Already, there are promises of vast boons as barriers to communication with the [contacted_hummers.GetName] and other alien acquaintances are lifted.

first_contact.425.desc.zh: 尽管十分困难，我们还是设法破解了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用语言，从而使初步的沟通成为可能。他们似乎自称是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。不可避免地，所有交流只能借助于专门针对[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAdj]语言的通信系统——一种会妨碍流利谈话的东西……
first_contact.425.desc.en: Although it proved a considerable challenge, we have managed to decode the form of communication used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sufficiently to establish preliminary contact. It seems that they call themselves the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. Inevitably, communication can only happen with the help of communication systems specifically tuned to the [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAdj] language - something which rather hinders fluent conversation...

first_contact.430.desc.zh: 对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的研究越是深入，[This.Owner.GetResearchers]越是困惑。虽然他们显然是有智慧的生物，但他们的交流方式前所未闻。我们所接收到的不是某种基于音频或文本的信号，而是一场由它们的身体或数码设备带来的精彩的炫光表演，其发出的光的光谱还明显超出了[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的可视范围。很明显，要了解它们将是一个重大挑战。
first_contact.430.desc.en: The more we learn about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], the more puzzled our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are. Although they are evidently intelligent beings, their transmissions are like nothing we have ever seen before. Instead of some sort of audio or script-based signal, what we are receiving is a brilliant light show - produced by their bodies or digitally - that stretches well beyond the light spectrum [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are able to view unaided. It is evident that coming to understand them will be a major challenge.

first_contact.435.desc.zh:
$first_contact.440.desc$

进一步的研究中，我们惊奇地发现他们的发光模式与进出超空间航道的漩涡相似。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]困惑于这种相似行为的含义，并提议对此进行深入研究。
first_contact.435.desc.en:
$first_contact.440.desc$

During our studies, we discovered to our surprise that their patterns of light bear an astounding similarity to the swirls of interstellar space that make hyperlane travel possible. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are confused as to what this connection may mean and propose further study into the topic.

first_contact.437.A.zh: 我们面前打开了一个新世界。
first_contact.437.A.en: We are now open to new possibilities.

first_contact.437.desc.zh:
我们对[encountered_country.GetSpeciesAdj]的漩涡状发光模式和星际空间之间的联系取得了令人惊讶的成果。似乎[encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的发光规则在其不知道的情况下，竟与超空间随着时间的推移而流动的规则暗合，只是规模差别很大。

之后，通过研究[encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们将能够更好地预测超空间的流动，这将极大地扩展我们的传感器的探测范围。
first_contact.437.desc.en:
Our study into connections between patterns observed in interstellar space and the [encountered_country.GetSpeciesAdj] swirls of light has unearthed surprising results. It seems that the rules by which the [encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] make their light patterns are - unbeknownst to them, apparently - the same as those by which the flows of hyperlane space drift over time, just on a vastly different scale.

It follows that, through studying the [encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we will be able to better predict the flows of hyperlane space - significantly boosting our potential sensor range.

first_contact.440.A.zh: 让我们看看他们有什么要说的。
first_contact.440.A.en: Let's see what they have to say.

first_contact.440.desc.zh: 我们的努力得到了回报，现在我们基本能够理解[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言并与之沟通了。他们自称[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，并说自己从未使用过口语，取而代之的是光线交流。虽然他们过去曾经使用过文字，但其民众认为它远不如视觉语言优雅高效。他们的大脑似乎完全胜任从复杂的图案中快速得出意义的工作，因此在大多数情况下，他们更喜欢使用视觉语言的交流形式。
first_contact.440.desc.en: Our efforts have paid off, and we are now able to understand the light signals given off by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and communicate with them, at least on a rudimentary level. It appears that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], as they call themselves, never developed a spoken language and instead used their light displays. Though they used to use a written language, it is considered far less elegant and efficient than their visual language. Their brains seem perfectly adapted to rapidly derive meanings from even complex displays, so that they favor recordings of the latter in most cases.

first_contact.450.A.en: Of course. Send back a battle chant!

first_contact.450.A.tooltip.zh:
一旦刀兵齐举，
旌旗拥、百万貔貅。
first_contact.450.A.tooltip.en:
Hark! Let the banners fly -
For now to war we ride

first_contact.450.B.zh: 我们可以分享一些关于求索的诗句。
first_contact.450.B.en: We can share some fine poetry about discovery.

first_contact.450.B.tooltip.zh: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
first_contact.450.B.tooltip.en: To strive, to seek, to find... and not to yield.

first_contact.450.C.zh: 用一些象征友谊的诗句打动他们。
first_contact.450.C.en: Bedazzle them with poetry about friendship.

first_contact.450.C.tooltip.zh: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻。
first_contact.450.C.tooltip.en: Shall I compare thee to a solar wind...

first_contact.450.D.zh: 给他们整点稀奇古怪的。

first_contact.450.D.tooltip.zh:
石室诗士施氏嗜狮，
施氏时时适市视狮。
first_contact.450.D.tooltip.en:
Jolifanto bambla o falli bambla
grossiga m'pfa habla horem

first_contact.450.E.en: We don't have time for this.

first_contact.450.desc.zh: 从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号中读取的信息让我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]及其兴奋。尽管这其中没有一个音节是我们能够识别的，但不可否认的是，声音本身是有韵律的，而且听起来莫名地令人感到舒缓。虽然我们无法确定，但[Owner.GetLinguists]坚信这是一首诗歌，对方是在友善地回应我们。
first_contact.450.desc.en: The readings from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals have caused our [Owner.GetLinguists] a great deal of excitement. While not a single syllable is intelligible, the sounds themselves are undeniably rhythmical, and indeed curiously soothing. Although we cannot be sure, our [Owner.GetLinguists] are convinced that it is a form of poetry. They propose we answer in kind.

first_contact.455.desc.zh: 在我们播报了战歌数个小时后，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的通讯中断了。他们把舰船远远地开到了有效攻击距离以外。可以认为他们应该是理解了我们信息的主旨，并且对此可一点都不感到高兴。
first_contact.455.desc.en: Several hours after we broadcast the battle chant, transmissions from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] ceased. Their ship has positioned itself well out of effective attack range. We can surmise that they understood the gist of our message, and were not gladdened by what they heard.

first_contact.460.A.zh: 和这个物种真是相见恨晚。
first_contact.460.A.en: A species after our own hearts.

first_contact.460.desc.zh: 就在我们发出信息的数分钟后，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信息发生了变化。内容依旧抑扬顿挫，但不再是和风细雨，而如同激起了惊涛骇浪。听起来像是一首战争的颂歌。他们并没有做出什么敌对的行为，而只是被我们的战歌所打动了而已。我们又发送了起初那首诗的几个不同版本，并且也快速地在整理[This.ContactCountry.GetName]战歌的大纲。
first_contact.460.desc.en: Within minutes of our transmission, the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] changed. Still rhythmically flawless, they were no longer soothing, but rather upbeat, exciting. Much like a battle chant in fact. No hostile movements were made - they seem contented rather than provoked by our poetry. We have since sent several variations of the first chant, and in return are rapidly collecting a compendium of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] war poetry.

first_contact.462.desc.zh: 好像[This.ContactCountry.GetName]听完我们的战歌以后生气了。他们的几乎瞬间回以暴力。他们的武器开始开火，我们的舰船很幸运地全身而退。看来一场大战是不可避免了。
first_contact.462.desc.en: It appears the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] took offense to our battle chant. Their response was instantaneous - and violent. They began firing, and our vessel was fortunate to escape unharmed. It seems we have a fight on our hands!

first_contact.465.desc.zh: 对方对我们诗歌热忱回应：他们发来了一串不间断的长时间通讯，我们可以迅速地构建[This.ContactCountry.GetName]行文字典。尽管我们还未能辨识这些单词的含义，但这些外星人好像对对应我们诗歌中的平仄清浊得心应手，这也便于我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]理解他们。
first_contact.465.desc.en: The response to our poem appears to have been enthusiastic: the stream of broadcasts continues unabated, and we are developing a considerable library of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] compositions. Although we have yet to put meanings to the words, these aliens have proven remarkably adept at matching the pitch and tone of our poems, something which is sure to help our [Owner.GetLinguists] interpret them.

first_contact.470.desc.zh: 在几分钟的沉默后，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的通讯恢复了。尽管还不能理解，但他们的态度发生了明显的转变：我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]称听到了俏皮而扭捏的旋律。虽然有点难以置信，似乎他们在与我们调情。
first_contact.470.desc.en: After several long minutes of silence, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmissions resumed. Although still incomprehensible, they were markedly different: a melody described by our [Owner.GetLinguists] as playful, almost bashful. Startlingly, it appears that they are flirting with us!

first_contact.472.desc.zh: 焦急等待的过程分秒如年，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]依旧没有回应。尽管他们不太可能理解我们诗歌的具体含义，但他们好像对里面的情感表达吓住了，开始转用一种更谨慎的态度与我们接触。
first_contact.472.desc.en: Minutes turned into hours, and still there was no response from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Though they couldn't possibly have understood the exact meaning of our poetry, it seems they were taken aback by the emotions expressed in it, and are now approaching us in a far more guarded manner.

first_contact.474.desc.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]以相似的方式回应了：抑扬顿挫的诗歌变成了随机的噪音，模仿着我们的嗓音。很遗憾，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]表示，对这些声音的解码“完全没有用”，因为现在的这些信号根本没有任何规律可言。
first_contact.474.desc.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are responding in kind: rhythmical chants have turned to random noise, mimicking our own incoherent sounds. Despairingly, our [Owner.GetLinguists] describe our efforts to decode these sounds as "completely useless", owing to the fact that it is now impossible to detect any sort of pattern.

first_contact.475.desc.zh: 随着我们互相理解的加深，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]或者说[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]对我们的敌意缓和了。尽管仍有侵略性，他们好像把我们视为了乐意进一步交流的“可敬的战士”。至于这会是一段友谊的开端或者是战争的序曲我们仍不得而知，但至少我们已经重温了一遍先祖流传的战争之音！
first_contact.475.desc.en: As we come to understand each other, hostilities with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - or rather, the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] - have ceased. Despite their aggression, they appear to consider us "honorable warriors" who they would gladly spar with again. Whether this is the beginning of friendship or a prelude to war remains to be seen, but at least we've been able to brush up on our war chants!

first_contact.480.desc.zh: 我们的努力有了回报，现在我们能够破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，或者准确来说叫[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]向我们发送来的信息了。基于他们的构句方法得知，他们对诗词艺术有着难以想象的执着。这种儒雅风流的沟通方式不仅使我们获得了他们的尊重，同时也让我们充分地了解了他们。
first_contact.480.desc.en: Our efforts have paid off, allowing us to interpret the missives sent by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. Based on their compositional style, they place an incredible importance in the poetic arts. By participating in this lyrical exchange, we have not only earned their admiration, but also learned a considerable amount about them during the process.

first_contact.485.desc.zh: 在冗长而困难的第一次接触流程后，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]终于认出[This.ContactCountry.GetName]应该被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。他们祝贺我们解开了他们的字谜，但看起来对我们花费如此长的时间颇有不满。最后的最后，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]得以研发出数种新的模式辨识方法，让我们在未来可以更容易破译语言。
first_contact.485.desc.en: After a long and arduous first contact process, our [Owner.GetLinguists] can now identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. They congratulate us for solving their linguistic riddles, although they seem a little put out with us that it took this long. At the very least, our [Owner.GetLinguists] were able to pioneer several new methods of pattern recognition which should stand us in good stead in the future.

first_contact.490.desc.zh:
我们的努力有了回报，现在我们能够破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，或者准确来说叫[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]向我们发送来的信息了：

“啊，巧夺天工的谄媚。遇到另一个珍视诗歌的物种已是三生有幸，谁曾想到，亲爱的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]，你们竟是如此热情洋溢、乖唇蜜舌。祝福你们的[Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]。”

信息后面还有许多诸如此类的词句。我们也没法完全确定是该受宠若惊还是直接大吃一惊，但也许我们的关系是有了个不错的开端。
first_contact.490.desc.en:
Our efforts have paid off, and we can now interpret the missives sent by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], who we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]:

"Ah, the fine art of flattery. It is nice indeed to meet another species that appreciates poetry, and especially one as exuberant and adorable as you, my sweet [Owner.GetSpeciesName] - bless your [Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]."

The message continues at some length in a similar vein. We are not entirely sure whether to be flattered or taken aback, but it seems our relationship is off to a good start.

first_contact.5.authoritarian.desc.zh: [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]已经汇报了关于在[This.System.GetName]星系中发现的未知飞船的情况。其设计无法与我们先前的任何记录相匹配，这意味着我们正在与一个外星文明进行初次接触。在得到[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]的允许后，我们得以开始分析我们已收集到的数据来破译其语言。
first_contact.5.authoritarian.desc.en: The [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] has been briefed on the unknown vessel that was reported in the [This.System.GetName] system. Its design does not match anything in our records, suggesting that we are dealing with a possible first contact scenario with an alien civilization. With the permission of the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle], we can begin an analysis of the data we have collected to see if their language can be translated.

first_contact.5.desc.zh: 尽管我们尚未从位于[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘宇宙飞船处获取太多情报，当前最有力的假说——根据其自身的行为以及它发射的尚未破解的信号里暗含的模式——是这艘舰船属于某个未知的太空文明。我们正全力破解他们的语言，希望能够尽早建立沟通。
first_contact.5.desc.en: Although we have been unable to discover much about the mysterious vessel in the [This.System.GetName] system, the most convincing current hypothesis - based upon its behavior and the patterns of the still undecipherable signals we have intercepted from it - is that it belongs to a previously unknown spacefaring civilization. We are redoubling our efforts to translate their language so that communications can be established.

first_contact.5.egalitarian.desc.zh: 公众们得知在[This.System.GetName]星系，也就是此前发现未知飞船的星系中，一场潜在的初次接触正在进行。早期获取的数据显示该飞船具有超空间航行的能力，似乎是来自于一个我们从未知悉的外星文明。来自政府各部门的代表正听取事态进展的简报，与此同时对其语言的破译也正在进行。
first_contact.5.egalitarian.desc.en: The public has been informed of a potential first contact scenario in the [This.System.GetName] system, where the presence of an unidentified spacecraft was registered. Early data suggests that this vessel is capable of hyperspace travel and likely originates from a previously unknown alien civilization. Representatives from all branches of the government are being briefed on this developing situation as well as our ongoing efforts to translate their language.

first_contact.5.materialist.desc.zh: 对于在[This.System.GetName]星系发现的不明飞行器的调查仍在进行当中，但是由于收集到消息的不足使得我们无法对船只的来源做出确切的假设。既然这似乎已经牵涉到了一个先前不为我们所知的外星文明，我们应当尽力截获他们的通讯以启动对于他们语言的破译。
first_contact.5.materialist.desc.en: The inquiry into the unidentified spacecraft that was observed in the [This.System.GetName] system continues, but insufficient data has been collected to make an informed hypothesis as to the exact origin of the vessel. Since we are likely dealing with a representative of a previously unknown alien civilization, efforts should be made to intercept their communications and begin a comprehensive analysis of their language.

first_contact.5.militarist.desc.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]中跟踪着未确认身份的航天器的信号的同时，我们已命令附近所有部队按照标准议定进入高度戒备状态。情报部门正在试图利用那一点点少的可怜的数据分析这个妖怪，但至少我们能感觉到其有超空间航行能力，而是否具有攻击能力则未可知。或许这可能是我们与一个新的外星文明的第一次接触，我们应该采取一些措施来破解他们的通讯。
first_contact.5.militarist.desc.en: Following the sighting of unidentified spacecraft in the [This.System.GetName] system, all forces in the vicinity have been ordered to assume a heightened state of readiness as per standard protocol. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.

first_contact.5.pacifist.desc.zh: 我们还不能确定在[This.System.GetName]观察到的这个神秘的宇宙飞船的起源。由于这很可能是我们第一次接触一个以前未知的外星文明，我们必须避免任何可能被误解为威胁或挑衅的行为。如果他们的语言被翻译，我们有希望与他们建立和平的关系。
first_contact.5.pacifist.desc.en: We have not yet been able to determine the origin of the mysterious spacecraft we spotted in the [This.System.GetName] system. Since this is likely our first contact with a previously unknown alien civilization, we must avoid any actions that could be misinterpreted as threatening or provocative. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

first_contact.5.spiritualist.desc.zh: 我们仍在收集据报告位于[This.System.GetName]星系的外星人飞船的数据。很可能这艘船是一个之前未知的外星文明的使者。我们必须确定他们已经跟随了灵魂的恩典，或者说他们是邪恶的代理人。我们要做的第一件事是领悟他们的语言并了解他们的信仰系统。
first_contact.5.spiritualist.desc.en: We are still gathering data on the alien spacecraft that was reported in the [This.System.GetName] system. If this vessel is an emissary of a previously unknown alien civilization, as seems likely, we must determine if they go with the grace of the spirits, or if they are agents of wickedness. The first step will be to divine their language and the nature of their belief system.

first_contact.5.xenophile.desc.zh: 对于位于[This.System.GetName]星系中一艘未知船只的目击不断催生出各种各样的揣测。我们对该船只的设计完全不曾了解，这意味着我们很有可能是在和一个全新的外星文明进行第一次接触。除开知晓该飞船有能力进行超空间航行之外，我们对于这些迷人的造物一无所知。我们应当抽出更多精力来对其进行研究。
first_contact.5.xenophile.desc.en: The mysterious sighting of an unidentified ship in the [This.System.GetName] system continues to invite speculation! Its design is completely unfamiliar to us, suggesting that we might be dealing with a new alien civilization and a possible first contact scenario. Aside from the fact that the alien spacecraft is clearly capable of hyperspace travel, we know next to nothing about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

first_contact.5.xenophobe.desc.zh: [This.System.GetName]星系发出了警报，在该星系中我们发现了一艘肯定属于异种的飞船正在开展什么隐秘的行动。该飞船的确切意图尚不明确，但其似乎是一个异种大型政治组织的代表。先对这些生物的数据进行收集或许更加明智一些，这样的话我们就可以更好地确定这项威胁的实质及其具体的影响范围。
first_contact.5.xenophobe.desc.en: Alarming reports from the [This.System.GetName] system, where we monitored the insidious activities of what can only be some manner of xeno spacecraft. The vessel's exact purpose remains unknown, but it is likely an agent of a larger xeno political entity.
