It might be wise to gather more data on these creatures, so that we can better ascertain the exact scope and nature of the threat.

first_contact.50.A.cautious.en: They are wise to be cautious.

first_contact.50.A.proactive.en: We will just have to keep trying.

first_contact.50.B.machine.zh: 评估协议估算出不可忍受的风险。

first_contact.50.C.en: The dangers of ignorance are greater.

first_contact.50.C.tooltip.zh: 我们会试图骇进它们的数据库来寻找有关它们的更多情报。如果它们发现了我们的行径，它们肯定不会就此善罢甘休。
first_contact.50.C.tooltip.en: We will attempt to hack into their databanks to find out more about them. If they detect our attempts, they will likely be angered by this course of action.

first_contact.50.C1.en: We must find out their secrets.

first_contact.50.desc.zh:
我们试图学习[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的知识，但截止到当前一切都是徒劳。我们很容易就发现了他们显然属于某个十分先进的外星文明，但是除此之外我们一无所知，看来他们花了很大的努力阻止我们或者其他窃听者截获来自他们的任何信号。

我们目前为止仅仅截获了他们语言的很小一片段。然而，根据我们手头的情报，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]很确信，如果能够获取更大规模的样本，破解对方的通讯不是问题。
first_contact.50.desc.en:
Our attempts to learn more about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have so far been in vain. While we were easily able to ascertain that they clearly form part of a technologically advanced alien civilization, further facts have proven elusive as they seem to be going to considerable effort to prevent us and any other eavesdroppers from intercepting any signals from them.

We have therefore only managed to intercept small fragments of their language so far. However, from the glimpses we have gleaned, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are confident that they will be able to decipher their communications if we can just acquire a greater sample size.

first_contact.50.desc.aggressive.zh: $first_contact.50.desc$一份更加激进的信息收集——也就是说骇入——提案被提交了上来，要是被它们发现，肯定不会善罢甘休。
first_contact.50.desc.aggressive.en: $first_contact.50.desc$ A proposal has been drawn up for somewhat more aggressive information gathering - some may call it hacking - but they will surely not take kindly to it should they detect it.

first_contact.500.A.tooltip.en: The [contact_country.GetName] are now hostile to us.

first_contact.500.desc.zh: 显然，我们的回应不合时宜：[contact_country.GetName]的反应快速而充满敌意，他们开始向我们的舰船开火。似乎我们必须依靠自己的[Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]来回敬他们了。
first_contact.500.desc.en: Clearly, our response was not the appropriate one: the response of the [contact_country.GetName] was swift and hostile, as they began firing on our ships. It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

first_contact.5000.desc.zh: 我们的传感器检测到[This.ContactCountry.GetName]正在发送不断重复的清晰信号，似乎为我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]编码他们语言的工作提供了绝佳的材料。有了这份天降的幸事，语言学家们心态十分乐观，坚信很快就能有重大的进展。
first_contact.5000.desc.en: Our sensors have detected a particularly clear repeating signal from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] that seems to offer our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] excellent material for codifying their language. They are optimistic that we will be able to make some significant progress on the back of this stroke of luck.

first_contact.5000.desc2.zh: 我们已经成功地获取了数艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]舰船间对话的清晰音频讯号。在我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]还不能准确认识他们所记录下的单词的含义，但他们对于这段新的信号将会对突破带来重大进展抱有信心。
first_contact.5000.desc2.en: We have managed to pick up a clear audio feed of conversations between several [This.ContactCountry.GetName] ships. While our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are still none the wiser as to the meanings of any of the words they are recording, they are optimistic that this new signal will help them make significant progress towards a breakthrough.

first_contact.5005.desc.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]日渐沮丧，因为我们没能提供给他们充分的材料用于解码[This.ContactCountry.GetName]使用的语言，他们的进度十分有限。似乎这些外星人正使出浑身解数，防止不怀好意的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]窃听到他们的信号！
first_contact.5005.desc.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are becoming increasingly frustrated at our failure to provide them with sufficient material to make progress on decoding the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. It seems these particular aliens are doing their utmost to prevent their signals from being heard by the wrong [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]!

first_contact.5010.desc.zh: 似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在翻译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用的语言时遇到了重大挫折。不幸的是，他们认为的语言根本就不是一种语言。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在[This.Leader.GetHerHis]的报告中指出，在几天内他们从多个角度的探讨，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最终得到结论，这可能只是种试作音乐……
first_contact.5010.desc.en: It seems our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have suffered a major setback in their attempts at codifying the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Unfortunately, what they had taken to be their language quite simply was not a language. In [This.Leader.GetHerHis] report, [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] states that, after days of investigating the matter from every angle, the [This.Owner.GetLinguists] finally concluded that it was in fact probably an attempt at music...

first_contact.5015.desc.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们对该行为出现了不同意见的分歧：我们是应该把这次冲击视为与外星文明建立更紧密的联系的跳板，或者是被认为一种警告，我们必须确保舰队准备万全，以免为时已晚。
first_contact.5015.desc.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Opinion is divided on whether we should treat this shock as a springboard to boost efforts to establish closer ties with alien civilizations, or whether it should be taken as a warning and that we must make sure our fleet is in good order now, before it is too late.

first_contact.5015.desc.gestalt.zh: 令人不安的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们不确定该如何应对此事：我们应当选择继续专注于与外星文明和平友好地共存，还是应该把这看做一种警醒并提高我们的舰队规模，以防万一可能的威胁呢？
first_contact.5015.desc.gestalt.en: In a disturbing development, it seems that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. We are unsure how to respond to this: should we choose to redouble our focus on peaceful and friendly coexistence with alien civilizations, or should we treat this as a warning and increase the size of our navy in case future hostilities are necessary?

first_contact.5015.desc.gestalt.homicida.zh: 令人不安的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们应当扩充我们的舰队以保证这帮外星人不会有什么非分之想。
first_contact.5015.desc.gestalt.homicida.en: In a disturbing development, it seems that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. We should increase the size of our navy so that we may set about putting these aliens in their place.

first_contact.5015.desc.xenophile.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。虽然有些人担心这些外星人可能不像我们这么友好，但人们已经达成共识，对于这种情况，我们应该加倍努力与星系其他文明建立更紧密的联系。
first_contact.5015.desc.xenophile.en: In what comes as a welcome surprise to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Although some worry that these aliens may not be as welcoming as we are, consensus has already been established that we should respond to this occurrence by redoubling our efforts to establish closer ties with the other civilizations of the galaxy.

first_contact.5015.desc.xenophobe.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。人们已经达成广泛共识，我们应该对这种入侵做出回应，以确保我们的舰队准备万全且为时未晚。
first_contact.5015.desc.xenophobe.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Widespread consensus has emerged that we should respond to this trespass by making sure our fleet is in good order with all haste, before it is too late.

first_contact.5020.desc.zh: 我们已经辨识出了先前我们在[This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName]恒星系扫描的殖民地其实是[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的首都。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]通过调查从扫描中获取的资料发现许多关于他们的有价值的线索。
first_contact.5020.desc.en: We have identified the colony we recently scanned in the [This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName] system to be the capital of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have found many valuable clues about them by investigating the data we gathered from the scan.

first_contact.5025.desc.zh: 我们现在已经有一段时间没有获取到来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的视听资料了。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]发现他们似乎没有什么新的信息值得获取，并担心这条路似乎行不通了。
first_contact.5025.desc.en: We have caught neither sight nor sound of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for some time now. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] find they have little information to go on and worry that the trail may have gone cold.

first_contact.5030.desc.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。他们的外表令[This.Owner.GetAdj]的公众感到兴奋，大家已经迫不及待想要和这些外星人进一步接触了。
first_contact.5030.desc.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has proven delightful to the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public, who are now impatient to make closer acquaintance with these aliens.

first_contact.5030.desc.machine.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，我们很快意识到我们正在与一个机器人社会打交道。这些消息被泄露到公众视野当中只是时间的问题。这些发现引起了[This.Owner.GetAdj]公众的遐想，大家惊叹于机器居然可以自行建立一个太空文明，并且迫不及待地想进一步熟识它们。
first_contact.5030.desc.machine.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it quickly became clear that we are dealing with a society of robots. It was only a matter of time before this knowledge was leaked to the wider public. The revelation has provoked wonder among the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public, who marvel that machines could build their own spacefaring civilization, and are impatient to make closer acquaintance with them.

first_contact.5035.B.en: They can't be THAT bad, surely.

first_contact.5035.desc.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass]”威胁……
first_contact.5035.desc.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has provoked widespread dismay amongst our populace, who have taken to describing them as "repulsive [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]". Already, many are demanding that we take action to deal with the new "[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass] threat"...

first_contact.5035.desc.machine.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，我们再也无法忽视这一事实：我们正要面对的是一个机器人社会。这些消息被泄露到公众视野当中只是时间的问题。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“机械威胁”……
first_contact.5035.desc.machine.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], we could no longer deny it: we are dealing with a society of robots. It was only a matter of time before this knowledge was leaked to the wider public. The revelation has provoked widespread horror amongst our populace, who have taken to describing them as "repulsive [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]". Already, many are demanding that we take action to deal with the new "mechanical threat"...

first_contact.5040.desc.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经在大量收集来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号取得了稳步的进展。然而，随着我们对他们语言的知识储备越来越丰富，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]却越来越感到迷惑。很明显他们不得不对先前工作的翻译进行数次重新评估，因为他们发现先前认定文字的含义事实上极度不准确。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的整体面貌和我们极度相异——比我们能够想象的差的更多！
first_contact.5040.desc.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have been making steady progress gathering together a large collection of signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. However, as our knowledge of their language has grown, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have become ever more confused. Apparently, they have had to reassess their previous working translations several times after finding out that the meanings they had ascribed to words were, in fact, extremely inaccurate. It seems that the whole outlook of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is very different to ours - far more than we could possibly have imagined!

first_contact.5040.desc.hive.zh: $first_contact.5040.desc.gestalt$似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的思维模式和我们相异甚远——比我们之前认为的差的更多，即使是对于外星人而言！
first_contact.5040.desc.hive.en: $first_contact.5040.desc.gestalt$ It seems that the thought patterns of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are very different to our own - far more than we had considered possible, even among aliens!

first_contact.5040.desc.machine.zh: $first_contact.5040.desc.gestalt$似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的执行逻辑并不是基于任何一种我们所知的理性。这将会带给我们理解他们更多的挑战！
first_contact.5040.desc.machine.en: $first_contact.5040.desc.gestalt$ It seems that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] does not base its execution logic on any sort of rationality known to us. This will make understanding them a severe challenge!

first_contact.5045.A.zh: 这对我们之间未来的关系是一个好的预示。
first_contact.5045.A.en: This bodes well for our future relations with them.

first_contact.5045.B.zh: 当然。为什么他们不痛恨异种呢？
first_contact.5045.B.en: Of course. Why would they not abhor the xeno?

first_contact.5045.C.zh: 遇到与我们相似的文明是件好事。
first_contact.5045.C.en: It will be good to meet those who are like ourselves.

first_contact.5045.desc.zh: 随着我们收集到更多有关[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的资料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们对于整个星系具有大量相同的看法。
first_contact.5045.desc.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share much of our outlook on the galaxy as a whole.

first_contact.5045.desc.hive.zh: 随着我们在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]取得更多的材料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人与我们具有非常相似的思维模式。或许他们的意识与我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]是相似的。
first_contact.5045.desc.hive.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share very similar thought patterns to our own. Perhaps their consciousness is alike to our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]?

first_contact.5045.desc.machine.zh: 随着我们在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]取得更多的材料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们具有非常相似的执行逻辑。或许在这些信号之后的人工智能与我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]非常相似？
first_contact.5045.desc.machine.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share a very similar execution logic to our own. Perhaps an AI much like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] lies behind these signals?

first_contact.505.desc.zh: 我们实在不知道搞错了什么，[contact_country.GetName]突然就向我们发起了攻击！看来我们必须靠自己的[Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]回敬他们了！
first_contact.505.desc.en: It is not clear what went wrong, but the [contact_country.GetName] are suddenly attacking us! It seems we have a fight on our [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]!

first_contact.5050.desc.zh: 我们对来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的语言解析工作遇到了挫折。似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]对翻译中的关键假设已经被证伪。尽管这意味着我们许多的进展不得不被推倒重来，但至少我们未来的努力很可能会被建立在更可靠的基础之上。
first_contact.5050.desc.en: Our attempts to decode the language used in the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]  have hit a setback. It seems that a key assumption our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] had been relying on in their translations has been conclusively disproven. While this means much of our progress will have to be revised, at least our future efforts will hopefully be built upon a more reliable basis.

first_contact.5055.desc.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最近在解析来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号所用的语言取得了明显的进展。很明显他们现在坚信自己已经对该语言的基础有了坚实的把控，并且承诺他们能够很快报道进一步的发现。
first_contact.5055.desc.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have recently made significant progress towards decoding the language used in the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Apparently they now believe themselves to have a solid grasp of its fundamentals and promise that they will be able to report further findings soon.

first_contact.5065.desc.zh: 我们历经艰辛以在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]足够的信息从而让我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]推进进程，但是现在我们的努力终于获得了一个极大的推动：我们的传感器收集到了他们数艘船只之间颇具长度的交流。我们只能猜测是他们的戒备突然松懈了一下，或者是他们的科技并没有我们怀疑的那么先进，他们只是自己觉得通信通道是安全的……
first_contact.5065.desc.en: We had struggled to gather enough information on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to have much to go, but now our efforts have received a major boost: our sensors have picked up a lengthy exchange between several of their ships. We can only assume their guard slipped for a moment, or perhaps their technology is not as advanced as we had suspected and they thought their channel to be secure...

first_contact.5070.desc.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在解码[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言的过程中取得了一项突破性进展。他们使用的文字系统里包含了将近一千七百万种字符，每个字符恰好可以和红-绿-蓝色值一一对应。尽管颇为费解，我们的语言学家们认为他们是可以破译这种外星语言的，只是还需要再花上一些时间。
first_contact.5070.desc.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have made a breakthrough deciphering the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] language. They use an alphabet consisting of almost seventeen million unique characters, which in turn correspond with a color on the red-green-blue spectrum. Although convoluted, our linguists are convinced they will be able to decipher the alien language. They just need some more time.

first_contact.5071.A.zh: 用音乐与他们打招呼吧！

first_contact.5071.A.tooltip.zh: 我们会尝试与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]建立情感联系。
first_contact.5071.A.tooltip.en: We will attempt to forge an emotional connection with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.5071.B.en: Keep the emotion out of it.

first_contact.5071.desc.zh:
通过运用十六进制数位系统，我们的数学家和[This.Owner.GetLinguists]几乎就快要破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的色彩语言了。官方也正在起草第一次接触协议。

通过对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言的研究，我们发现他们的文化包罗万象，而且沟通上产生误解的可能性非常高。现在我们必须决定沟通的方针究竟是倾向于他们的逻辑型还是偏向他们的情感表达……
first_contact.5071.desc.en:
By utilizing a hexadecimal positional numeral system, our mathematicians and [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are on the verge of a colorful language breakthrough with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Officials are preparing first contact protocols.

Through studying the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] language, we know their culture is vast. The potential risk for misunderstanding is high. Now we must decide if we should appeal to their sense of logic, or to their emotions...

first_contact.5071.desc.gestalt.zh:
通过运用十六进制数位系统，我们几乎就要破译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的色彩语言了。第一次接触协议也正在起草中。

我们现在可以选择通过富有文化特质的问候来取悦他们的情感或是尝试进行一种更复杂的但高效的表达方式。
first_contact.5071.desc.gestalt.en:
By utilizing a hexadecimal positional numeral system, the collective is on the verge of a colorful language breakthrough with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. We are preparing first contact protocols.

We can now either pander to their emotions with a culturally significant greeting, or we can attempt a more complex protocol to increase potential efficiency.

first_contact.5072.desc.zh:
尝试与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]进行性感层面上的沟通取得了不错的收获。

我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]展示了对他们文化的理解，结果他们对我们表示了暖心的欢迎。任务“漂亮”地完成了！
first_contact.5072.desc.en:
Efforts at connecting on an emotional level with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have proven fruitful.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] demonstrated an understanding of their culture, and as a result, we have been warmly received. Mission accomplished, with great panache!

first_contact.5072.desc.gestalt.zh:
以情感为杠杆，我们获得了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的青睐。

我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]展现了对他们文化的理解，结果他们对我们表示了暖心的欢迎。任务完成。
first_contact.5072.desc.gestalt.en:
Leveraging emotion, we have gained favor with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] demonstrated an understanding of their culture, and as a result, we have been warmly received. Mission accomplished.

first_contact.5073.desc.zh:
尝试与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]进行情感层面的沟通产生了灾难性的后果。

我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]没能展示对他们文化的良好理解，反倒是严重地冒犯了他们！
first_contact.5073.desc.en:
Efforts at connecting on an emotional level with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have proven catastrophic.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] failed to demonstrate an understanding of their culture, and as a result, we have greatly offended them!

first_contact.5073.desc.gestalt.zh:
尽管借助了情感，我们仍没能获得[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的青睐

我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]没能展示对他们文化的良好理解，反倒是严重地冒犯了他们。
first_contact.5073.desc.gestalt.en:
Leveraging emotion, we have failed to gain favor with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were unable to demonstrate an understanding of their culture, and as a result, they are deeply offended.

first_contact.5075.desc.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言看似包含了数百万看似冗余的音节，似乎仅仅只是他们古代语言残留下来约定俗成的东西。在翻译的时候，这些不必要的填充性词汇唯一的作用看起来只是用来补充语法的完整性，或者最多有一些微不足道的上下文提示作用。

幸好，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经缩减了他们语言中这些过时的部分，制定出了简化版辞典，这样一来我们就能与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]进行高效的沟通。
first_contact.5075.desc.en:
The language of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] contains millions of seemingly redundant sounds, apparently dialectic hangovers from their precursor civilizations. When translated, these apparently superfluous filler words seem to serve no purpose other than to add linguistic flavor - or at most have only minor contextual implications.

Thankfully, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have narrowed down the obsolete aspects of their language, and are now compiling an abridged lexicon which should prove very useful for efficient communication with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

first_contact.5080.desc.bling.zh: 太空梭上装饰着精美的装饰品和金色的铆钉。显然，它的设计旨在通过奢华的展示给人留下深刻的印象。
first_contact.5080.desc.bling.en: The shuttle is covered in elaborate ornaments and golden rivets. It is clearly designed to impress with a display of opulence.

first_contact.5080.desc.functional.zh: 太空梭讲究实用，体积很大。显然功能比外观的优先级更高。
first_contact.5080.desc.functional.en: The shuttle is utilitarian and bulky. Function has clearly been prioritized over form.

first_contact.5080.desc.standard.zh: 外星人的太空梭和我们的设计款式很类似，这在某种程度上让人舒心。
first_contact.5080.desc.standard.en: The alien shuttle is similar to our own designs, which is reassuring in a way.

first_contact.5080.desc.start.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]在太空中的一艘太空梭靠近了我们。由于没有发生其他事情，我们假设他们希望在远离他们主舰船的地方会面。由于船只尺寸较小，只有我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy][Leader.GetName]被派去，其他外交团队成员留在后方。
first_contact.5080.desc.start.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] positioned a shuttle close to us in space. Since nothing further happened, we assumed that they wished to meet away from their main ship. The small size of the vessel meant that only our [Owner.GetEnvoy] [Leader.GetName] could be sent, with the rest of the diplomatic team staying behind.

first_contact.5080.desc.weapon.zh: 穿梭机配备了精妙的武器系统，外星人已经准备好进行武力对抗。
first_contact.5080.desc.weapon.en: The shuttle is outfitted with elaborate weapon systems and the aliens are prepared for a violent confrontation.

first_contact.5085.desc.end.zh: 有一面墙上装满了记录设备和传感器。站在冷漠的机器前，[Leader.GetName]概述了我们物种的历史和文化。演示没有得到任何回应。[Leader.GetName]感到十分沮丧，只能留下一个视频平板离开，平板中包含了大量历史记录和我们语言使用的入门指南。
first_contact.5085.desc.end.en: One wall was covered in recording equipment and sensors. Standing before the impassive machines, [Leader.GetName] outlined our species' history and culture. The presentation was met with silence. Frustrated, [Leader.GetName] left behind a video tablet with a vast collection of historical records and primers in our language.

first_contact.5085.desc.imposing.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，其装修风格既低调又奇异地给人一种庄严的感觉。墙壁的角度和装饰设计旨在将观者的注意力引向一个高高的讲台。
first_contact.5085.desc.imposing.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room with an architectural style that was at the same time understated and oddly imposing. The angles of the walls and their ornamentation were designed to draw the viewer's attention towards a raised dais.

first_contact.5085.desc.meditation.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室。地面和墙壁覆盖着柔软的材料，而来自外星世界的平静自然声响则从隐藏的扬声器中播放出来。
first_contact.5085.desc.meditation.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room. The floor and walls were covered in a soft material, while calming natural sounds from an alien world played from hidden speakers.

first_contact.5085.desc.pool.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，其中一端有一个水池。外星符号环绕着水池周围的地板。
first_contact.5085.desc.pool.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room with a pool of water in one end. Alien symbols surrounded the floor around the pool.

first_contact.5085.desc.standard.zh: 无人驾驶的太空梭内设有一个中央会议室，令人惊讶的是，它非常朴素，缺乏任何装饰或装饰品。
first_contact.5085.desc.standard.en: The pilotless shuttle contained a central meeting room that was surprisingly nondescript and lacking in decoration or adornment of any kind.

first_contact.5085.desc.start.zh: [Leader.GetName]返回报告说，没有来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的人接见[Leader.GetHimHer]。
first_contact.5085.desc.start.en: [Leader.GetName] returned to report that no one from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] met [Leader.GetHimHer].

first_contact.5090.c.tt.zh: 树立我们的文化自信，让他们自惭形秽。
first_contact.5090.c.tt.en: Boost us up and put them down.

first_contact.5090.desc.aggressive.zh: 幸亏来自[Leader.GetName]的直接命令阻止了第一次接触流程升级演变为暴力事件。对于团队来说，外星人持续的沉默无疑是一种侮辱。
first_contact.5090.desc.aggressive.en: Only the direct orders of [Leader.GetName] prevented the first contact protocol from escalating to violence. To the team, the obstinate silence of the aliens was nothing short of insulting.

first_contact.5090.desc.cautious.zh: 在登陆太空梭进行展示之后，紧接着是一阵焦虑，连[Leader.GetName]都公开怀疑[Leader.GetHeShe]是否成功地进行了介绍汇报。
first_contact.5090.desc.cautious.en: An anxious wait followed the presentation aboard the shuttle, with [Leader.GetName] openly doubting if [Leader.GetHeShe] had made a successful introduction.

first_contact.5090.desc.end.zh:
几个小时后，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]用我们的语言传达了一条简短的信息：

“我们对你们的文化没有产生深刻印象。就这些吗？[Owner.GetEnvoy]有最后一次机会在你们选择的领域中给我们留下深刻印象。”
first_contact.5090.desc.end.en:
After several hours, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmitted a short message in our language:

"We are not impressed with your culture. Is this all? The [Owner.GetEnvoy] has a final chance to impress us in a field of your choosing."

first_contact.5090.desc.proactive.zh: 单方面的沟通让外交团队遭受巨大的挫折。他们渴望成功的第一次接触，为此他们在没有任何事实基础的情况下，制定了分支预测策略来指导剩余的接触流程。
first_contact.5090.desc.proactive.en: The one-sided communication greatly frustrated the diplomatic team. Eager for a successful first contact, they created branching prediction strategies for the remaining procedure without any factual information to inform the approach.

first_contact.5095.desc.combat_bad.zh:
[Leader.GetName]迷惑地从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的太空梭返回，没有找到对手。在一个小时内，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发送了一条消息：

“你们野蛮的做法让我们感到失望。对于一个开化的文明来说，进行肉体上的战斗是非常不合适的。”
first_contact.5095.desc.combat_bad.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle confused, having found no opponent. Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"Your barbaric ways disappoint us. A physical fight would be most unbecoming for a civilized culture."

first_contact.5095.desc.combat_good.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]返回了！尽管伤痕累累，但却载誉而归。

从一个隐藏的门中，一名外星战士突然现身并开始同我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy]展开搏斗，直到筋疲力尽。在最后一丝力量的召唤下，[Leader.GetName]设法制服了[Leader.GetHisHer]的对手。

不到一个小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发送了一条信息：

“[Leader.GetName]将被记录在我们的史册中，作为一位伟大的战士。”
first_contact.5095.desc.combat_good.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle injured, but victorious.

From a hidden door, an alien fighter emerged and proceeded to batter our [Owner.GetEnvoy] to the point of exhaustion. Summoning a last surge of strength, [Leader.GetName] managed to subdue [Leader.GetHisHer] opponent.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"[Leader.GetName] will be entered into our annals as a great warrior."

first_contact.5095.desc.song_bad.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的太空梭返回，[Leader.GetHisHer]的音乐表演让自己感到很不满。我们过去的行为与我们当前的自我认知之间的不和谐使得歌词的联想变得平淡无奇。

不到一小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发来了一条消息：

“我们对一次重要的思想交流会被平庸的韵律破坏感到失望。”
first_contact.5095.desc.song_bad.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle dissatisfied with [Leader.GetHisHer] musical performance. The dissonance between our past actions and our current self-conception made the lyrical associations fall flat.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"We are disappointed that a momentous meeting of minds was spoiled by middling rhymes."

first_contact.5095.desc.song_good.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的穿梭机上兴高采烈地回来了。描述我们过去和未来的即兴歌词自由地传唱着，这是由我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy]诗人在两者之间创造出了令人惊讶由具有启发的联系。

不到一小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发来了一条消息：

“你们的文化非常辉煌，我们对这场表演表示赞赏。”
first_contact.5095.desc.song_good.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle in a great mood. The improvised lyrics describing our past and future had flown freely, with our [Owner.GetEnvoy]-poet making associations both surprising and illuminating.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"Your culture is most splendid and we applaud the performance."

first_contact.5095.desc.speech_bad.zh:
[Leader.GetName]失望地从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的太空梭返回。[Leader.GetHeSheCap]在感应墙前花了一个多小时，事无巨细地介绍我们的文化，并辩论我们历史决策的正确性。

不久之后，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发来了一条信息：

“你所叙述的历史展示的是你的文化的贫瘠。”
first_contact.5095.desc.speech_bad.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle disappointed. [Leader.GetHeSheCap] spent over an hour at the sensor wall presenting our culture in greater detail and arguing for the rightness of our historical decisions.

Shortly thereafter, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"The history you describe paints a poor picture of your culture."

first_contact.5095.desc.speech_good.zh:
[Leader.GetName]满怀信心地从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的太空梭返回。[Leader.GetHeSheCap]在感应墙前为我们的情况辩论时，忘却了时间的概念，全面地解释了历史决策的各种原因以及我们作为一个文化如何学习和成长。

不到一个小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发来了一条消息：

“尽管你们过去经历了困难，但你们取得了巨大的成长。你们的文化是一个鼓舞人心的榜样。”
first_contact.5095.desc.speech_good.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle brimming with conviction. [Leader.GetHeSheCap] had lost track of time arguing our case in front of the sensor wall, explaining the reasons for historical decisions and how we've learned and grown as a culture.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"Despite your troubled past, you have grown spectacularly. Your culture is an inspiration."

first_contact.60.A.proactive.zh: 我们对他们的信任心存感激。

first_contact.60.desc.default.hive.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

只要能把这些数据传递给我们的语言子个体，要不了多久我们就能和对方交流了。当然，我们得相信他们提供的翻译足够精准，我们能够准确地理解。
first_contact.60.desc.default.hive.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

We will surely be able to communicate with them soon by feeding this data to our linguistic drones. Of course, we will have to trust them that their offered translations are sufficiently precise for us to accurately comprehend.

first_contact.60.desc.default.machine.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

只要能把这些数据录入进我们的翻译子例程，要不了多久我们就能和对方交流了。当然，我们得相信他们提供的翻译足够精准，我们能够准确地理解。
first_contact.60.desc.default.machine.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

We will surely be able to communicate with them soon by inputting this data to our translation subroutines. Of course, we will have to trust them that their offered translations are sufficiently precise for us to accurately parse.

first_contact.60.desc.default.wilderness.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.hive$

因为我们已经掌握了各种他们用于交流思想的旋律和和弦的框架，因此与这些生命形式沟通就更有可能了。现在破译他们想要的东西的重任就落到了我们身上。
first_contact.60.desc.default.wilderness.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.hive$

The likelihood of communicating with these lifeforms is much more promising, as we now possess a framework for the various rhythms and harmonies through which their thoughts seem to flow. The burden is now on us to ensure we interpret their desires correctly.

first_contact.60.desc.hive.wilderness.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.hive$

因为他们信息中呈现的和声看起来与我们自己的意识可以发生共鸣，因此与这些生命形式沟通的可能性很高。现在不误读他们思维合唱的重任就落到了我们身上。
first_contact.60.desc.hive.wilderness.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.hive$

The likelihood of communicating with these lifeforms is high, as the harmonies displayed within their message seem to resonate with our own consciousness. Something about them still feels profoundly alien, however. The burden is on us to ensure we do not misread this apparent chorus of thought.

first_contact.60.desc.machine.default.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.machine$

我们的专家不确定我们是正在试图和有情感的生物交流，还是在跟一个失控的人工智能打交道。他们坚称，一旦我们能够从对方的传输信号中提取出有用的数据，这份答案就能得到揭晓。
first_contact.60.desc.machine.default.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.machine$

Our experts are uncertain whether we are attempting to communicate with sentient beings, or whether we may be dealing with a rogue AI. They expect to be able to give a definitive answer soon, once we have managed to extract the data we need from their transmission.

first_contact.60.desc.machine.wilderness.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.hive$

可与这些生命形式交流的预期极高，因为其信息的一致特性对我们自身的意识而言相对熟悉。然而，关于这种智能的部分仍旧极端陌生。确保不误解他们表观思维合唱的重任就落到我们身上了。
first_contact.60.desc.machine.wilderness.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.hive$

The prospect of communicating with these lifeforms is now much more likely, as the uniform nature of their message feels similar to our own consciousness. Something about this intelligence still feels profoundly alien, however. The burden is on us to ensure we do not misinterpret their apparent chorus of thought.

first_contact.60.desc.wilderness.default.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

这种表观编码的庞大规模和复杂性令人费解。我们还无法解码这么多有机过程和微分化之中所蕴含的深层含义。也就是说，除非这些外星人某种形式上帮我们一把……
first_contact.60.desc.wilderness.default.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

The sheer size and complexity of this apparent codex is puzzling. We are not yet able to decipher the meaning behind so many of the organic processes and fractal chemistries depicted within. However, our experts are confident they will have answers for us soon. That is, of course, unless these aliens are somehow leading us astray...

first_contact.60.desc.wilderness.hive.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

这种表观编码的庞大规模和复杂性同样令人费解。它描绘了许多对我们自身进化同样基础的有机流程，但这些信息背后的语法逻辑尚不明确。我们会带着谨慎的怀疑态度继续进行分析。
first_contact.60.desc.wilderness.hive.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

The size and complexity of this codex is uniquely puzzling. It depicts many of the same organic processes fundamental to our own evolution, but the grammatical reasoning behind this message is unclear. We will continue our analysis with cautious skepticism.

first_contact.60.desc.wilderness.machine.zh:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

这种“编码”的异常地令人费解。乍一看，其中描绘了许多我们完全陌生的有机流程。$first_contact.60.desc.x.machine.end$
first_contact.60.desc.wilderness.machine.en:
$first_contact.60.desc.default$

This 'codex' is uniquely puzzling. It depicts many organic processes which - on the surface - appear entirely alien to us. $first_contact.60.desc.x.machine.end$

first_contact_critters.1.desc.zh: 我们收到了来源不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循着某种重复的句法，证明其来源应为智慧生物。我们应进一步研究它。它们似乎集中在一个空间站附近，但尚不清楚这个空间站是不是一个更大的太空文明的一部分。
first_contact_critters.1.desc.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single space station, though it is unclear whether this forms part of a larger spacefaring civilization.

first_contact_critters.1.desc.cfl.zh: 我们探测到了性质不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循某种重复的句法，这可能表明其源自智慧生命。我们应对此进行进一步调查。信号似乎集中在一艘大型舰船周围，但目前尚不清楚这是否属于某个更庞大的星际文明的一部分。
first_contact_critters.1.desc.cfl.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single large vessel, though it is unclear whether this forms part of a larger spacefaring civilization.

first_contact_critters.10.desc.zh: 长程扫描仪获取了[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的数据，对其的解析几乎说明它是一个巨大热源。这非常值得研究。
first_contact_critters.10.desc.en: Long range scanners have picked up readings in the [This.System.GetName] system that could best be described as giant heat blobs. It's worth investigating.

first_contact_critters.100.desc.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]星系遭遇的舰队与我们此前在此区域见到的任何东西都不一样。它没有表现出攻击性，但我们眼下只能猜测它的起源或目的。我们最有把握的猜测是，该舰队代表的派别与任何地方当局或文明都没有正式联系。
first_contact_critters.100.desc.en: The fleet we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system is unlike any we've seen in this region of space before. It does not appear to be aggressive, but we can only speculate as to its origin or purpose here. Our best guess is that the fleet represents a faction without formal ties to any local authority or civilization.

first_contact_critters.105.desc.zh:
我们与这支自称是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的舰队陷入了僵局。这个不寻常的来客对我们大部分的外交姿态置之不理，但我们可以推断它代表一个独立于星系文明的中立实体。

我们推测，若舰队有传统意义上的所有者，则需要采取非常措施才能接近他们。考虑到这一点，我们总结了目前的发现，供未来的[this.owner.GetScientistPlural]团队使用（如有必要）。
first_contact_critters.105.desc.en:
We have reached an impasse with the fleet identifying itself as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. This unusual presence ignored most of our diplomatic overtures, but we can infer that it represents a neutral entity which stands apart from galactic civilization.

We suspect that if the fleet possess any owners in the conventional sense, it would take extraordinary measures to reach them. With this in mind, we have summarized our findings for future teams of [this.owner.GetScientistPlural] to make use of - in case such an opportunity does arise.

first_contact_critters.15.desc.zh:
[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的社会学研究领袖称之为缇扬奇”的太空生物十分温顺。它们可以进入低维度的亚空间，因此可以轻易地在星系之间遨游。

它们以气态巨行星外层常见的气体为食。这不太可能是它们唯一的食物来源，但到目前为止尚未观察到其他的进食方式。

它们不会主动进攻，因此可以安全地无视它们。
first_contact_critters.15.desc.en:
The spaceborne lifeforms - which the [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Head of Society Research has come to refer to as "Tiyanki" - are docile creatures. Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, they roam from system to system with remarkable ease.

They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants. It is highly unlikely, to say the least, that this is their only food source, but intake of other nutrients has yet to be observed.

They will rarely, if ever, attack, even when provoked. They can safely be ignored.

first_contact_critters.15.desc.primal_ca.zh: 值得注意的是，每个缇扬奇群体都以母系等级制度为中心，由一头雌兽领导。雌性优先享用所有食物资源，以便为幼崽生产气态母体物质，并引导群体迁徙。因此，雄兽在资源匮乏时会放弃进食，鼓励它们在群体休息时寻找更多食物。
first_contact_critters.15.desc.primal_ca.en: Of note, there is a matriarchal hierarchy at the center of each Tiyanki pod, with a singular cow leading the group at any one time. Females are given priority to all food resources, allowing them to produce maternal gases for their young and direct the pod's migrations. As such, bulls will forgo nourishment whenever resources are scarce, encouraging them to scout for more food while the pod rests.

first_contact_critters.20.A.zh: 最好从远处观察，继续吧。
first_contact_critters.20.A.en: Best viewed from afar. Keep it up.

first_contact_critters.20.desc.zh:
当我们进入[This.System.GetName]时，传感器获取了一个奇怪的数据。一开始把它们当成发光的小行星而忽视了，但后来当发现它们会对太空中的移动物体哪怕距离很远都会做出一定的进攻性反应，事情就变得有趣了起来。

建议最好从安全的距离上观察这些东西。
first_contact_critters.20.desc.en:
Upon entering [This.System.GetName] our sensors picked up strange readings. Dismissed at first as glorified asteroids, things quickly changed when it was discovered that these entities reacted aggressively to movement in space - even at great distance!

Observation of these entities - preferably from a safe distance - is advised.

first_contact_critters.25.desc.zh:
我们的舰队此前遭遇到的实体是一种新发现的太空生命形式。

由于最初对传感器数据的粗略误读，我们很快就给它们起昵称为“太空变形虫”，实际上这种生物比[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]护卫舰的平均尺寸还要大。
first_contact_critters.25.desc.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following a gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] corvette.

first_contact_critters.25.desc.primal_ca.zh: 除了最年轻的个体外，其他所有个体都伴随有通过RNA掺杂分泌物控制的准独立生物体。这些“鞭毛”以复杂的攻击模式进行攻击，因此尽管它们看似缺乏智慧，但“太空变形虫”却是非常熟练的自然捕食者。
first_contact_critters.25.desc.primal_ca.en: All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms controlled via RNA-laced secretions. These "flagella" strike in complex attack patterns, so despite their apparent lack of sapience, "Space Amoeba" are highly adept natural predators.

first_contact_critters.30.desc.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体看起来一定程度上由晶态物质组成。有趣的是，它们可以在虚空中推进，并能在必要的时候保护自己，说明他们应该是具有生命的。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在做进一步的调查。
first_contact_critters.30.desc.en: The irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appears to be made of some sort of crystalline material. Curiously, it seems to be able to propel itself across the void and protect itself when necessary, indicating that it may be alive. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are working hard to find out more.

first_contact_critters.35.desc.primal_ca.zh: 这些生物似乎通过折射光线的色度变化来相互交流。虽然这种媒介具有表达复杂信息的巨大潜力，但这些半智慧生命体只以基本的方式使用它。颜色的变化可以用来表示社会地位、攻击性，甚至生育状况。
first_contact_critters.35.desc.primal_ca.en: These creatures seem to communicate with one another via chromatic changes in refracted light. While this medium has high potential for complex expressions, it is only utilized in a basic manner by these semi-sentient lifeforms. Changes in color can be used to indicate social status, aggression, and even fertility conditions.

first_contact_critters.40.desc.zh:
我们在[This.System.GetName]发现了一种新的生命形式，虽然称之为“生命”可能不太准确。这些实体看起来完全是一种完全出于未知的工业用途的全自动无人机器人。

我们会继续观察，但由于这些机器有自我保护的编码，所以最好谨慎行事。
first_contact_critters.40.desc.en:
We have discovered a new lifeform in [This.System.GetName], although calling it a "lifeform" may be incorrect. The entities appear to be fully automated, mechanical drones built exclusively for some unknown industrial purpose.

Observations will continue, but since it's likely that these machines are programmed with defensive protocols, it would be prudent to tread lightly.

first_contact_critters.45.desc.zh:
我们对关于此前遭遇的深空无人机的报告进行了进一步的调查。这些无人机似乎是数百万年前建造的自动轨道采矿作业的工人和监工。这些采矿作业似乎开始于数千年前，然后很快被抛弃，只留下了无人机继续运作。

这些无人机拥有强力的采矿激光，并且在[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]舰船试图靠近时表现出了明显具有威胁性，甚至是侵略性的举动。或许它们只是些老旧的无人机，但[Owner.GetName]仍应该密切观察它们。
first_contact_critters.45.desc.en:
Reports of the deep-space drones previously encountered have been investigated closer. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment.

The drones possess powerful mining lasers and make obviously threatening, if not outright hostile, overtures toward [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] vessels when approached. They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch by the [Owner.GetName].

first_contact_critters.5.A.zh: 让我们听听他们想不想说点什么。
first_contact_critters.5.A.en: Let's see if they want to talk.

first_contact_critters.5.desc.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的独立空间站建立了通讯。
first_contact_critters.5.desc.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the independent space station of the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

first_contact_critters.50.A.zh: 真令人不舒服。我们可得小心。

first_contact_critters.50.desc.zh:
尽管他们生活在居住站上的事实暗示了他们很可能是一个先进的社会，然而[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]不能肯定我们是不是真的在和一种智慧生命形式打交道：他们似乎无时不刻在展现敌意，这对于一个稳定的社会而言是不可想象的：即便在我们短暂的调查期间也展现了数次纯粹的野蛮行为。

他们看起来具有语言，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]仍在努力解析当中，以便我们在未来能够理解他们的行为。
first_contact_critters.50.desc.en:
Although their dwellings on habitat stations would suggest an advanced society, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] is unsure whether we are indeed dealing with an intelligent lifeform: they seem unremittingly hostile, so much so that a stable society seems almost unthinkable: even during our brief period of investigation, we have observed several displays of pure barbarism.

They seem to have a language, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are still working on deciphering it so we can make sense of this display.

first_contact_critters.60.desc.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]遇到的舰船似乎有点过时，但仍然武装到了牙齿。这些舰船应该是有人驾驶的，但对任何靠近的物体都展现了敌意。有必要谨慎应对……
first_contact_critters.60.desc.en: The vessels we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be somewhat outmoded, but nevertheless armed to the teeth. They seem to be piloted by sentient crews but respond with hostility to any approach. We will have to treat them with caution.

first_contact_critters.65.desc.zh:
尽管我们仍然无法与他们建立联络，主要是因为他们并不想理我们，但我们已经可以确认[This.ContactCountry.GetName]是海盗。视觉指示器表明他们的文化很大程度上是生长于太空的，我们观察到的一些表现形式不符合任何一种居住于行星的文明。

不幸的是，他们的船员似乎对民事交流没有任何兴趣。我们从截获的舰见通讯也表明他们主要以海盗活动为生，偶尔也会招募部分文明边缘的元素到他们的贼船上。
first_contact_critters.65.desc.en:
Although we have been unable to establish communications with them - mainly because they are unwilling to communicate with us - we have been able to identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as pirates. Visual indicators point to their culture being largely spaceborne, and some phenotypes observed among them match no known planet-dwelling civilizations.

Unfortunately, their crews are completely uninterested in civil discourse. What little we have been able to glean from intercepting intra-fleet communications indicate that they primarily subsist on piracy, occasionally recruiting fringe elements of spacefaring civilizations to their cause.

first_contact_critters.70.C.zh: 蜂巢外的这些东西的行为确实很奇怪。
first_contact_critters.70.C.en: The actions of those outside the hive are indeed strange.

first_contact_critters.70.D.zh: 我们怎么才能彻底了解有机体。
first_contact_critters.70.D.en: How can we fathom the ways of organic life?

first_contact_critters.70.E.zh: 他们已经声明了自己在这片区域的航路吗？
first_contact_critters.70.E.en: Have they already claimed this region's Wayline routes?

first_contact_critters.70.desc.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中侦测到的舰队似乎是某种目的不明的跨星系探险队。他们没有采取任何有敌意的举动，也没有任何显而易见的重型武器，反而他们似乎在反复但无目的地向我们的大致方向广播某种具有实际内容的信号。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]，[This.Leader.GetName]很困惑，但希望那些广播能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]翻译他们的语言。
first_contact_critters.70.desc.en: The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be part of some sort of expedition across the galaxy, with purposes unknown. They have not made any hostile moves, nor is there any heavy weaponry in evidence - instead, they seem to be broadcasting repetitive but not particularly content-filled signals in our general direction. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is confused, but hopes that the broadcasts will help our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translate their language.

first_contact_critters.70.desc.home.zh: [This.System.GetName]恒星系似乎是某种未知起源的先进社会的家园。居住在恒星系的一系列空间站中，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]留意到还有不少飞船在其间穿梭，同时还有一些目的不明的更大的远航舰队离开恒星系。他们似乎在向我们大致方向不断传播着重复的但没有实际内容的信号，这一进展令我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]感到困惑，但这有助于翻译他们的语言。
first_contact_critters.70.desc.home.en: The [This.System.GetName] system appears to be home to an advanced society of unknown origins. Dwelling in a series of space stations across the system, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] has observed multiple crafts flitting between them, as well as several larger expeditions leaving the system for unknown purposes. They seem to be broadcasting repetitive but not particularly content-filled signals in our general direction, a development which has confused our [This.Owner.GetLinguists], but may help them to translate their language.

first_contact_critters.70.desc.nomadic.zh:
$first_contact_critters.70.desc.nomadic.base$

看到一个族群将家园安于星海之间而非任何星球之上，这种景象令人感到几分莫名的亲切。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]迫切希望能够进一步了解这些同为旅人的族群。
first_contact_critters.70.desc.nomadic.en:
$first_contact_critters.70.desc.nomadic.base$

There is something almost familiar about the sight of a people making their home among the stars rather than on any world. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is eager to learn more about these fellow travelers.

first_contact_critters.70.desc.nomadic.u.zh:
$first_contact_critters.70.desc.nomadic.base$

一群流浪者，和我们没什么不一样，但却不太受人欢迎。[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]，[This.Leader.GetName]对此不太感兴趣，但也愿意听听他们要说什么。
first_contact_critters.70.desc.nomadic.u.en:
$first_contact_critters.70.desc.nomadic.base$

Wanderers, not unlike ourselves, though the comparison is an unwelcome one. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is unimpressed, but will hear what they have to say.

first_contact_critters.75.B.tooltip.zh: 当下次他们进入我们边境时我们就可以与行商舰队进行交易了。
first_contact_critters.75.B.tooltip.en: We will now be able to trade with the caravaneer fleets next time they enter our borders.

first_contact_critters.75.desc.zh: 我们已经成功地破译了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]向我们发送的令人困惑的重复信息，我们发现这些信息是一些……商业广告！显然他们自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，是一个以向偶遇的任何文明提供最优惠的交易谋生的星际商团的一部分，至少他们自称是最优惠的。一如既往，他们似乎正在尝试联系我们。
first_contact_critters.75.desc.en: We have managed to decipher the confusing, repetitive messages the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] were sending us, and it turns out that they were... commercial advertisements! Apparently they call themselves [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and are part of a group of spacefaring traders that make a living by offering the best deals - or what they claim to be the best deals - to whichever civilization they happen to be visiting at the time. True to form, it appears they are attempting to contact us.

first_contact_critters.75.desc.home.zh: 我们已经成功地破译了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]向我们发送的，一遍又一遍的，令人困惑的信息，我们发现这些信息竟是一些……商业广告！似乎[This.System.GetName]恒星系是一个自称[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的星际商团的母星系。显然，他们以向偶遇的任何文明提供最优惠的交易谋生，至少他们自称是最优惠的。
first_contact_critters.75.desc.home.en: We have managed to decipher the confusing, repetitive messages the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] were sending us, and it turns out that they were... commercial advertisements! It appears that the [This.System.GetName] system is the home system of a group of spacefaring traders that call themselves the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. They apparently make a living by offering the best deals - or what they claim to be the best deals - to whichever civilization they happen to be visiting at the time.

first_contact_critters.80.desc.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体可能是一种有机生物，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]仍在努力验证这一假说。尽管它看起来就是一些随机的星际物质组成的团簇，但毋庸置疑地它们可以在虚空中推进，并展现出了一定程度的自主智能。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]为这种现象困惑，并正在努力验证获得的数据。
first_contact_critters.80.desc.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is still working to confirm the hypothesis that the irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is in fact a living organism. While it seems to be made up of a cluster of random star dust, it is demonstrably able to propel itself across the void and shows basic signs of independent agency. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are perplexed by the phenomenon, and are working hard to verify our readings.

first_contact_critters.90.desc.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中侦测到的舰队似乎是某种目的不明的跨星系远航舰队的一部分。他们没有采取任何有敌意的举动，也没有任何显而易见的重型武器。然而他们似乎完全缄默不语，我们无法从他们当中获取任何信号。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们可以从我们拾获的只言片语中翻译他们的语言，当然这可能要花好长时间。
first_contact_critters.90.desc.en: The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be part of some sort of expedition across the galaxy, with purposes unknown. They have not made any hostile moves, nor is there any heavy weaponry in evidence. However, they have been fairly closed-mouthed, and we have been unable to pick up many signals from them. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are confident that they will be able to translate their language eventually from the scraps we pick up. However, this may take quite some time.

first_contact_critters.95.desc.zh: 我们成功地破解了神秘的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]被难住了好长时间，直到一次他们开始向我们的大致方向上广播时才取得了突破。广播的内容是一条欢迎讯息，其中他们自称为“那马里安”。看来他们现在愿意与我们交流了。
first_contact_critters.95.desc.en: We have managed to decipher the language of the mysterious [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] remained stumped for quite some time, and a breakthrough was only made once they began broadcasting what turns out to be a welcome message identifying them as the "Namarians" in our general direction. It appears that they are now eager to talk to us.

first_contact_fleets_mia_tooltip.zh: 为了保证安全，我方其他位于他们领土中的舰队也发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
first_contact_fleets_mia_tooltip.en: Our other fleets in what appears to be their territory have sought safety by engaging emergency FTL.

我们将给你[Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]
fleet1dealdesc1.en:
We offer you [Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

All this for the low, low price of [Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]

fleet1getback.zh: 现在不行，你能过后再来吗？
fleet1getback.en: Not right now. Can you get back to us later?

fleet1getbackreply.zh: 当然了。在我们离开你们的领地之前肯定会再联系你们的。但是等到那时候，交易的内容可能就不一样了……
fleet1getbackreply.en: But of course! We will contact you again before we depart your territories. But be aware that the deal may change in that time...

fleet1hewwo01.zh: 我们限量向私人实体出售布洛葛腺体。适用于各类半透膜！
fleet1hewwo01.en: We have a very limited quantity of Blorg glandular extract available for purchase by private entities. Great for semi-permeable membranes of all kinds!

fleet1hewwo02.zh:
人生在世总有悲伤失意之时。但是我立马就会想起，财富和幸福就在转角处等候！

告诉你的朋友们吧！
fleet1hewwo02.en:
Sometimes it all seems so hopeless. But then I remember that wealth and happiness are just around the corner!

Tell your friends!

fleet1hewwo03.zh:
巴尼斯营养液不是用人做的。

配方保密，但绝对健康。
fleet1hewwo03.en:
Baneth Nutritional Slurry is NOT people.

The ingredients are secret, and very healthy.

fleet1hewwo04.zh: 请注意，可能包含范格利废料标签的意思是说，生产该产品的设施也用作处理范格利废料，不是说这东西是范格利废料。
fleet1hewwo04.en: Please note that the MAY CONTAIN TRACES OF VENGRALIAN WASTE stickers only indicate that the product is produced in facilities that also handle Vengralian waste, not that the product itself is Vengralian waste.

fleet1hewwo05.zh: 我们始终欢迎下游经销商加盟。有兴趣加入范格利集团吗？
fleet1hewwo05.en: We're always on the lookout for more downline distributors. Care to join the Trium family?

fleet1hewwo06.zh: 你完全可以信任范格利的品质。
fleet1hewwo06.en: You can trust the Vengralian Seal of Quality.

fleet1hewwo07.zh: 申请退款说明买家不够信任产品。但我们充分确信麾下产品的质量。
fleet1hewwo07.en: Offering refunds betrays a lack of confidence in your products. We have full confidence in our products.

fleet1hewwo08.zh: 我们教外星物种坐地生财之道。
fleet1hewwo08.en: We teach xenos how to earn a substantial additional income working from home.

fleet1hewwo09.zh: 跟产品本身无关，关键是产品能带来多少利益。
fleet1hewwo09.en: It's not about the products, it's about the benefits of purchasing the products.

fleet1hewwo10.zh: 你知不知道有什么智慧生物需要一些额外的能量币收入啊？
fleet1hewwo10.en: Do you happen to know any intelligent sapients that could use an additional stream of energy credits?

fleet1hewwo11.zh: 虽然我们的产品根本不愁销路，但我们依然愿意花时间把它卖给您。
fleet1hewwo11.en: While our products practically sell themselves, we will also take the time to sell them. To you.

fleet1hewwo12.zh: 拜托了，买点什么吧。随便买点什么都行。
fleet1hewwo12.en: Please buy something. Anything. Just... Please.

fleet1hewwo13.zh: 范格利集团中没有老板，人人都是自己的老板。虽然这确实会带来一些……管理上的麻烦。
fleet1hewwo13.en: Every member of the Vengralian Trium is their own boss. This does lead to some... administrative issues.

fleet1hewwo14.zh:
范格利集团的目标就是让这世界上没有难做的生意。这是范格利的立命之本。不想做生意的想法都是……

错的。

所以……
fleet1hewwo14.en:
The Vengralian Trium was created for commerce. It is in the Vengralian blood-analogue. Not engaging in commerce is...

Wrong.

So...

fleet1hewwo15.zh: 就算是最古老的范格利历史收据也提到了奥伦星商人。他们提升了我们，让我们的文明从孩提时代跃进到购买他们的厨房用品。
fleet1hewwo15.en: Even the oldest Vengralian history-receipts tell of the Orlan Star Merchants. They elevated us from beasthood to sell us kitchen appliances.

fleet1hewwo16.zh: 范格利集团的传说就是奥伦星商人的传说。他们虽然已经不在了，但是早已规定的规定的销售指标必须达成！
fleet1hewwo16.en: The legacy of the Vengralian Trium is also the legacy of the Orlan Star Merchants. They are no longer with us, but the prescribed quotas must still be met!

fleet1redealdesc1.zh: 你真的打算就这么让一生只会出现一次的机会白白溜走吗？
fleet1redealdesc1.en: Are you ready to seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, before it's gone forever?

fleet1redealdesc2.zh: 我们虽然很快就会分别，但是你可以永远持有我们的完美产品。
fleet1redealdesc2.en: We must soon part, but you can keep our excellent products with you forever.

fleet1redealdesc3.zh: 你要是不做这笔买卖那可就大错特错了。你再好好动脑子想想。
fleet1redealdesc3.en: You understood that you would be a fool to pass up this deal. You can now make good on that wisdom.

fleet1redealdesc4.zh: 亲爱的顾客，或者我应该说朋友？我们正准备离开你们的领地。请问您是否有兴趣再最后一次看看我们的产品呢？当然不会是真正的最后一次，我们以后也会来的。
fleet1redealdesc4.en: Dear customers - or dare we say friends? - we are departing your territories. May we interest you in our wares, one last time? Until next time, that is.

fleet1redealdesc5.zh: 这可是最后机会了，专门为你量身打造的订单！你肯定会感兴趣的！
fleet1redealdesc5.en: Last chance to strike this deal, tailored to your needs! You don't want to miss it!

fleet2contact1.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。

$fleet2contact_explanation$
fleet2contact1.en:

日安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，我们带来了财富女神奴玛所庇佑过的神圣货物。她一直向我们耳边呢喃，言道遥远的[Root.Capital.GetStarName]存在着一个独立的文明，齐心协力我们可成就无上的奇迹。

fleet2contact4.en:

没想到这一切都是真的，你们真如女神奴玛所预言的一样繁荣。常言道，财富只会眷顾勇者。

我们是拜金教团，一群单纯的商人，将自己的全部身心奉献给财富女神。

$fleet2contact_explanation$

But it is true! You really are as prosperous as Numa has foretold. Fortune favors the bold as they say.

We are the Numistic Order, simple merchants, devoted to the worship of commerce.

fleet2dealdesc1.zh:
你听到了吗？硬币正叮当作响。是的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我看到了财富正在不断向你涌去。

奴玛在你的某个世界骄傲地展示了一个古龛。那个古龛将会为你带来超越你想象的财富。$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc1.en:
Listen, do you hear that? It's the sound of coin trickling in. Yes, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we see great fortune coming your way.

Numa has shown us a vision of a shrine in her honor on one of your worlds. A shrine that could bring you prosperity beyond your wildest dreams.$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc10.zh:
我们的一位传教士在冥想之中被奴玛降临在她身上，迅速而含糊地说出了女神的旨意。尽管这位传教士并未活过这场考验，但我们解析了她话语中的含义，得到了一种能将一和零变为百万的算法。

不要令她的牺牲白费，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。将财富引入你们的地核，她就不会抛弃你们。$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc10.en:
Deep in a meditative trance, one of our ecclesiasts gave herself over to Numa and spoke the goddess' sacred truth in a rapid stream of glossolalia. Though the ecclesiast herself did not survive her trial, we deciphered from her utterances an algorithm that can turn ones and zeros into millions.

Do not let her sacrifice be in vain, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Invite fortune into your planetary core and she will not desert you.$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc11.a.zh:
$fleet2dealdesc11$

答案是……另一艘警戒舰，对吧？
fleet2dealdesc11.a.en:
$fleet2dealdesc11$

It is... another guard ship, is it not?

fleet2dealdesc11.b.zh:
$fleet2dealdesc11$

答案是……异星天然气，不对么？嗯……真是令人陶醉的芳香！那是成功的气息！深吸一口气，你就能亲眼目睹奴玛的庄容。但是要小心，过量吸入可能会损害你的隔膜。
fleet2dealdesc11.b.en:
$fleet2dealdesc11$

It's... exotic gases, is it not? Mm... and what a lovely scent they have! It is the smell of success! A deep breath of these and you will see Numa in the flesh. But be advised, excessive inhalation may dry out your membranes.

fleet2dealdesc11.c.zh:
$fleet2dealdesc11$

当然了！答案是……能量币……一直都是能量币。钱币能扭转乾坤。在你的问题上抛洒钱币，你的问题就会不见了。赞美奴玛！
fleet2dealdesc11.c.en:
$fleet2dealdesc11$

But of course! It's... credits... always credits. Credits make the world go round. We will throw credits at your problem and your problem will disappear. Praise Numa!

fleet2dealdesc12.zh:
通过奴玛的指导，我们发现这些古代文物对我们的冥想很有启发性。

与它们分离的想法当然让我们感到痛苦，但我们认为你们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以通过研究它们获得很多知识。

我们需要一些高级物资，所以或许我们可以进行一个交易……？$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc12.en:
By the guiding hand of Numa, we have come across these ancient artifacts which have been very inspiring for our meditations.

The thought of parting with them of course pains us, but we feel that you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could learn much by studying them.

We are in need of some advanced materials, so perhaps a deal could be made..?$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc2.zh:
把 [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName] 带上来。在我们穿越星系的朝圣之路中，我们拯救了许多迷失的魂灵……

看看这优秀的物种，它们接受了拜金管理之道的熏陶。看到它[fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]深处了吗？这颜色表明它是一个十分健康的个体。他们同样十分胜任体力活。而且他们的繁殖能力十分出色。你觉得如何？$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc2.en:
Bring in the [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName]. During our pilgrimage across the galaxy we have saved many lost souls...

Look at this fine specimen, schooled in the art of Numistic administration. See the inside of his [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]? That color there indicates a healthy individual. They make great laborers too. And their reproductive capacities are astounding. What say you?$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc3.zh:
关闭你的影像接收器，想象你正漂浮在能量币的洪流之中，而你即将抵达的，是一座满溢着更多能量币的山峰。

有了我们拜金教的成像技术，你很快就会明白，意志之力凌驾于世间任何力量。能量币将如同往低处流的水一样自然的涌向你，而你将永远地从物欲中解放出来。$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc3.en:
Close your visual receptors. Now picture yourself on your back floating on a stream of energy credits towards a mountain of even more energy credits.

With our Numistic visualization techniques you will learn that there is no greater power than the power of the mind. You too will be free of material desires and credits will be drawn to you like arthropoids to dung.$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc4.zh: 能量之流的图案……它们存在于各处，但无人可视。奴玛自己便可预测这神圣之潮和整个股票市场的流动。只要你愿献出一点点捐助，我们就将把她无穷智慧中的一角传授于你。$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc4.en: Patterns in the energy flow... They are everywhere yet no one sees. Numa alone can predict the divine ebb and flow of the stock market. And for a small donation, we will share some of her wisdom with you.$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc5.zh:
请允许我们引见我们最棒的一个精神领袖，拥有强大思维能力同时能够看穿一切的九阶沙克瓦。在女神的指引下，你的生意将会繁荣昌盛。

而我们只希望你能提供小小的捐助……$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc5.en:
May we present one of our finest spiritual leaders, a level nine Shakvah with enhanced mind focus and inner gaze. Under the goddess' guidance, business on your worlds will flourish.

All we ask is a small donation in credits...$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc6.zh: 尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们将向你提供一个特别的交易……奴玛认为你的人民很有潜力，并且欢迎一部分你的子民为奴玛效忠。她将奉上无价的水晶作为回报……$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc6.en: Honored [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we have a very special offer for you... Numa has seen great potential in your people and would like to welcome some of your kind into her ranks. In return these priceless crystals could be yours...$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc7.zh:
这是财富之恩惠号，我们最受信任的警戒舰……她被女神亲自选中，在星系中护送我们受祝福的货物，并曾经击退过许多渎神者——海盗、异端、虚空怪物，以及任何阻碍奴玛的神圣之道的人！如今，她仍旧几乎完好如新……

是的，她曾尽心为财富服务，而现在只需一点微不足道的捐赠，她也可以为你服务……$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc7.en:
Behold Fortune's Favor, our most trusted guard ship... She was chosen by the goddess herself to escort our blessed cargo across the galaxy and has thwarted many a blasphemer in her day - pirates, infidels, monsters of the void, all who interfere with Numa's divine path! Yet she is almost as good as new...

Yes, she has served fortune well and now, for a modest donation, she may also serve you...$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc8.zh:
请原谅我们的冒犯，但我们注意到你的星球，[fleet2deal8planet.GetName]，拥有一种尚未被发掘的独特潜力。我们可以打开一道通往其神圣地心的裂口，财富就将源源不断地从中涌出！

让我们揭露你星球上隐藏的秘密吧。当然了，我们需要一笔象征性的酬劳。$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc8.en:
Forgive us our intrusiveness, but we have noticed your planet, [fleet2deal8planet.GetName], possesses a unique potential not currently being realized. A vent can be opened to its sacred core, from whence the flow of wealth can trickle forth!

Let us reveal to you the hidden secrets of your land. We will require a nominal remuneration, of course.$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2dealdesc9.zh:
愿神圣的女神奴玛保佑你，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。她向我们展示了如何将你的单元更好地与[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]的磁场进行同调。有了我们神圣而且专利注册的拜金教磁条，你在[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]上的无人机将减缓对£energy£ $energy$的依赖。

作为交换，我们希望能在你的土地上举办一场献神的仪式。你意向如何？$fleetdeal_explanation$
fleet2dealdesc9.en:
The Divine Numa smiles on you this day, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. She has shown us how to better align your units to [fleet2deal9planet.GetName]'s magnetosphere. With our holy, patented Numistic Magnetostrips, your drones on [fleet2deal9planet.GetName] will drain your sacred £energy£ $energy$ with less fervor.

In exchange, we require a ceremony to the Divine be hosted on your soil. What say you?$fleetdeal_explanation$

fleet2getback.en: Not right now. Please get back to us later.

fleet2getbackreply.zh: 那好吧，[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们会在离开你的领地时再次联系你。但是请注意，奴玛可是一位多变的女士。如果她改变了主意，那么我们的交易可能会发生改变……
fleet2getbackreply.en: As you wish, [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We will contact you again before we leave. But bear in mind, Numa is a fickle mistress. If her mind sways, the deal may change...

fleet2hewwo1.zh: 来吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！喝下从拜金圣井中涌出的财富之水，保证你不会再渴了。
fleet2hewwo1.en: Come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Drink from the Numistic well of wealth and thirst no more.

fleet2hewwo2.zh: 跟随能量币的脚步，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，它将指引你通往真相。没有什么货物能比承载着奴玛意志的货物更加神圣了……
fleet2hewwo2.en: Follow the current of cosmic energy credits, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and it will take you to the truth. There is no better product than that which carries the holy seal of Numa...

fleet2hewwo3.zh: 奴玛，在财富流动之时微笑。
fleet2hewwo3.en: When credits pass hands, Numa smiles.

fleet2hewwo4.zh:
你把那叫做公平！？你简直就是侮辱奴玛！

哦，有客人来了！很抱歉让你看到刚才那一幕。刚才的一幕很好的证明了有些人就是不配发财。
fleet2hewwo4.en:
You call that a fair deal!? You spit in the face of Numa - pah!

Oh, but we have customers! Our sincerest apologies for that display. Some do not have the courage to accept good fortune when it falls into their lap.

fleet2hewwo5.zh: 许多上好的货物流转到我们手中，但是我们从来不会保留这些东西。这是我们的牺牲，为了泰莎塔尔的最终建成，也为了我们的后裔能再次见到圣地。
fleet2hewwo5.en: Many wondrous things pass through our hands, yet we never line our pockets. It is the sacrifice we make so that the construction of the Tessar Tarvil is completed and our children may one day see the holy land again.

fleet2redealdesc1.zh: 错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。
fleet2redealdesc1.en: A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

fleet2redealdesc2.zh: 奴玛是一位大方的女士。我们正要离开时她提醒了我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！一定要在我们离开之前给他们一生中最后一次机会！
fleet2redealdesc2.en: Numa is a generous mistress. We were about to leave when she reminded us - the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They must have one last chance at the deal of a lifetime, before we leave!

fleet2redealdesc3.zh:
往往在某些小选择中，你的命运就已注定。在这投资一点，在那儿投资一点，终有一天会变成一笔巨大的收益。小小的水滴终将汇聚成为海洋。

命运让我们在离开之前再给你一次选择的机会。
fleet2redealdesc3.en:
It is in the little moments your fate is decided. A credit well spent here, a credit there, will one day make a million. Small streams meet to make an ocean.

Fate has given you one more chance to take our offer before we leave.

fleet2redealdesc4.zh:
啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你听到奴玛的召唤了吗？我们马上就要离开你们的领地了，但首先，请问你们考虑过我们的交易了吗？

好好想想吧，这也许是让你飞黄腾达的选择，否则就走向毁灭，你会如何选择？
fleet2redealdesc4.en:
Ah, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do you hear Numa calling? Soon we must depart your lands, but first, have you considered our offer?

Weigh your options well, for one may set you on a path to great fortune. Another to ruin. Which will it be?

fleet2redealdesc5.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们很快将会离开你的领地。我们将会让宇宙中的能量币指引我们前进。你考虑过我们的提议了吗？
fleet2redealdesc5.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon we will depart your territory. We must go wherever the current of cosmic energy credits takes us. Have you considered our offer?

fleet3contact1.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$的操作员，从属于$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

$fleet3contact_explanation$
fleet3contact1.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, a member of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

We travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

$fleet3contact_explanation$

fleet3contact1notinborder.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$的操作员，从属于$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$

We travel the stars. We see all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$

fleet3contact2.zh:
你们好啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$向你们致意！我们是从$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$出发的穿越星际的贸易者。

$fleet3contact_explanation$
fleet3contact2.en:
Greetings to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], from the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$! We are brokers, deal-makers who have traveled the stars from $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$.

$fleet3contact_explanation$

fleet3contact2notinborder.zh:
你们好啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，来自$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$向你们问候！我们是从$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$出发的穿越星际的贸易者。

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$
fleet3contact2notinborder.en:
Greetings to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], from the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$! We are brokers, deal-makers who have traveled the stars from $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$.

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$

fleet3contact3.zh:
见到你们真好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的财富虽然在积累，但是你的灵魂却一片空虚，不是吗？我们感知到了这一点，我们前来与你进行交易，我们带的东西可好了。

我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$，来自$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的商人。

$fleet3contact_explanation$
fleet3contact3.en:
Well met, well met, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your credits amass, yet there is emptiness in your spirit, no? We sense it. We come with swift hands, bearing many goods!

We are the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, traders of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

$fleet3contact_explanation$

fleet3contact3notinborder.zh:
见到你们真好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的财富虽然在积累，但是你的灵魂却一片空虚，不是吗？我们感知到了这一点，我们前来与你进行交易，我们带的东西可好了。

我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$，来自$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的商人。

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$
fleet3contact3notinborder.en:
Well met, well met, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your credits amass, yet there is emptiness in your spirit, no? We sense it. We come with swift hands, bearing many goods!

We are the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, traders of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$

fleet3dealdesc1.zh:
我们还有矿石，丰富、闪闪发光的矿石。将夜晚照亮的矿石！专门为[Root.GetName]准备的闪亮矿石。

但我们很饿，我们很渴！请给我们[Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1]，我们将用[Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1]协助你的工人。
fleet3dealdesc1.en:
We have ore. Rich, luminous ore. Torn right from the stone! Sparkling minerals for the [Root.GetName].

But we hunger. We thirst! Grant us [Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1], and we shall supply your builders, your makers with [Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1].

fleet3dealdesc2.zh:
我们有一个领袖，对于[Root.GetName]来说再合适不过了！[Root.GetFleet3ProductDeal2]

给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal2]，领袖就归你了！
fleet3dealdesc2.en:
We have a leader, an excellent fit for the [Root.GetName]! [Root.GetFleet3ProductDeal2]

Give us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal2], and the leader is yours!

fleet3dealdesc3.zh:
我们可以为你提供工人，搬东西的，拖东西的，清东西的！健康。聪明。给我们£alloys£2000$alloys$，我们将会派出300$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$£pop£人口前往你的星球。

什么？犯罪记录？这种废纸片片我们恐怕找不到咯，嘶！
fleet3dealdesc3.en:
We have good workers for you. Good lifters, draggers, pullers, cleaners! Healthy. Clever. Give us £alloys£ 2000 $alloys$, and we shall send 300 $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ £pop£ Pops to one of your planets.

What? Criminal records? Afraid we've lost the papers, kssk!

fleet3dealdesc3machi.zh:
我们可以为你提供工人，搬东西的，拖东西的，清东西的！健康。聪明。给我们£alloys£ 2000$alloys$，我们将会派出300$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_robot$£pop£ 人口前往你的星球。

什么？犯罪记录？啊呀我们找不到了那些没用的文档了，嘶！
fleet3dealdesc3machi.en:
We have good workers for you. Good lifters, draggers, pullers, cleaners! Healthy. Clever. Give us £alloys£ 2000 $alloys$, and we shall send 300 $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_robot$ £pop£ Pops to one of your planets.

What? Criminal records? Afraid we've lost the papers, kssk!

fleet3dealdesc5.zh:
我们这里还有好东西，你看，设计图！是一个非常先进，非常特别的建筑。一个$building_waste_reprocessing_center$，将你的残渣和废料变成高电流能源和有用的矿物。

不过我们需要……工人。开采平台715-B上发生了惨痛的事故，嘶！给我们300个$pop_cat_worker$£pop£人口，我们就会把建筑蓝图给你们。
fleet3dealdesc5.en:
We have schematics. Designs! For a building, very advanced, very unique. A $building_waste_reprocessing_center$, to convert your scrap and waste into high-current energy and useful minerals.

But we need... workers. Terrible accident on Mining Platform 715-B, kssk! Send us 300 $pop_cat_worker$ £pop£ Pops, and we will give the blueprints to you.

fleet3dealdesc5_gesta.zh:
我们这里还有好东西，你看，设计图！是一个非常先进，非常特别的建筑。一个$building_waste_reprocessing_center$，将你的残渣和废料变成高电流能源和有用的矿物。

不过我们需要……工人。开采平台715-B上发生了惨痛的事故，啐！给我们300个$pop_cat_simple_drone$£pop£ 人口，我们就会把建筑蓝图给你们。
fleet3dealdesc5_gesta.en:
We have schematics. Designs! For a building, very advanced, very unique. A $building_waste_reprocessing_center$, to convert your scrap and waste into high-current energy and useful minerals.

But we need... workers. Terrible accident on Mining Platform 715-B, kssk! Send us 300 $pop_cat_simple_drone$ £pop£ Pops, and we will give the blueprints to you.

fleet3dealdesc6.zh:
我们有一个专门为你准备的交易。独有的技术，只由$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$打造的技术！

不知道你会不会为行星防御系统头疼，不知道怎么穿透这层系统？我们将会为你带来一个非常非常特别而且先进的技术，专门强化轰炸用的，我们称它为$ORBITAL_TRASH_1$！

给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]。我们马上将方法教给你们，嘶！你的船只很快就会得到部件升级。
fleet3dealdesc6.en:
We have a special offer. Inimitable technology, only developed by the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$!

Do you have trouble penetrating the defensive grids of planets? We can show you a way, very advanced, very technical, of improved bombardment. We call it... the $ORBITAL_TRASH_1$!

Give us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]. Then we will show you the method, and kssk! You will have a component to add to your ships.

fleet3dealdesc7.zh:
我们注意到了你在[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]轨道上的开采站。它开采能源，对吧？我们可以帮忙。我们可以送你一颗卫星，它使用了最新的科技！我们称之为$racket_energy_extractor$！

它将留在轨道上，并增加你能从[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]的表面上获取的£energy£$energy$。

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]
fleet3dealdesc7.en:
We have noticed your mining station in orbit of [fleet3deal7planet.GetName]. It extracts energy, does it not? We can assist. We can grant you a satellite, one fitted with a clever technology! We call it the $racket_energy_extractor$!

It will remain in orbit, and increase the amount of £energy£ $energy$ you can obtain from [fleet3deal7planet.GetName]'s surface.

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]

fleet3dealdesc8.zh:
你需要$energy$，对吧？为了让那些驱动你们一族的百万电路迸发出电火花？我们可以帮忙。

我们可以用$racket_generator_regulator$来增强你们的[technician_drone.GetNamePlural]，使你们的$district_generator_plural$性能提升百分之二十五！只要你给我们一些好处，我们就将在[fleet3deal8planet.GetName]上部署这些装置。

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]
fleet3dealdesc8.en:
You need $energy$, do you not? To zap and spark along the million circuits that drive your kind? We can assist.

With the $racket_generator_regulator$, we can heighten the capacity of your [technician_drone.GetNamePlural] to interface with the machines in your $district_generator_plural$ by twenty-five percent! We will deploy them on [fleet3deal8planet.GetName], if you grant us a small favor.

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]

fleet3dealdesc9.zh:
我们有一艘船！一艘$destroyer$：很棒，很快，很强！装备很好！绝对不是出于某些理由才想把它甩掉的，绝对不是！没时间让你的机械师们仔细检查它了，嘶嘶！你想要这艘船，对吧？

给我们£minerals£ 2000$minerals$，船就归你了。
fleet3dealdesc9.en:
We have a ship! A $destroyer$: very good, fast, strong! Well-equipped! Certainly not getting rid of it for a reason, oh, no! No time to let your mechanics examine it, kssk! You want the ship, do you not?

Give us £minerals£ 2000 $minerals$, and the ship is yours.

fleet3getbackreply.zh: 那么等我们要离开时会再次联系你们。不过到那时候交易条件可能就不一样了！
fleet3getbackreply.en: Then we shall call you again, before making our leave of your space. But we may alter the deal!

fleet3hewwo1.zh:
我已经说过了。将能源转换器重新调至辅助模式。不，不是那个能源转换器！嘶！是不是什么都要我来啊？

噢！客人啊！欢迎。我们有很多稀有的上乘的好货。穿越星际只为安全送达你手中！
fleet3hewwo1.en:
I have already explained. Re-route the power converter to the auxiliary manifold. No, not that power converter! Kssk! Must I do everything my--

Oh! Customers! Welcome, please. We bear many goods, we have many wares. All carted safely through the stars for your convenience!

fleet3hewwo2.zh: 你喜欢合金吗，嘶？你喜欢金属或者燃气吗？辛勤的劳工？贵重的矿石？我知道你肯定会有兴趣的。
fleet3hewwo2.en: Do you like alloys, kssk? Do you like metals and gases? Hard workers? Precious minerals? Yes. We thought you might.

fleet3hewwo3.zh: 噢，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是最后一批货！你根本不敢相信，嘶！箱子里面装满了各种各样的武器。多到数不清的武器。来看看吧。
fleet3hewwo3.en: Oh, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The last haul! You would not believe it, kssk! Crates and crates overflowing with munitions. Cubic tons of it! Come, please. Look.

fleet3hewwo4.zh:
真不该相信他们的，真不该和他们做买卖。肮脏的[scammer_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！嘶！

哦，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们向您致敬，你愿意和我们交易吗？
fleet3hewwo4.en:
Never should have trusted them. Never should have made that deal. Filthy [scammer_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Kssk!

Oh. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We greet you. Would you like to trade?

fleet3hewwo5.zh: 这可不是什么破旧的遗物，这是一件古董！想想吧，嘶。它已经存在了多少个世纪了。而且还会一直存在下去！
fleet3hewwo5.en: It is not a relic. It is an antique! Just think, kssk. It survived this many centuries already. Built to last!

fleet3hewwo6.zh:
生锈？什么生锈？

哦，那个只要刮下来就行了。刮，刮，刮。马上就变新了！
fleet3hewwo6.en:
The rust? What rust?

Oh. That rust. Just scrape it off. Scrape, scrape, scrape. And good as new!

fleet3hewwo7.zh:
$NAME_Ketlings$？是的，我们知道他们。曾经我们是同族兄弟。但那是很久以前了。他们不喜欢也不承认我们比他们更优秀，更加擅长收集，寻找以及掠夺。他们流放了我们。让我们在虚空中流浪！

不过没关系。我们现在变得更强大了，即使没有他们。
fleet3hewwo7.en:
$NAME_Ketlings$? Yes. We know of them. Our once-brethren. Generations ago, long back. They did not like, did not approve that we were cleverer than they! Better at collecting, finding, taking. Greater. They sent us away. Floating in the void!

No matter. We are stronger now, without them.

fleet3hewwo8.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]看看你的那些点数。都快要爆出来了！让我们帮你减轻一点负担吧。让我们帮忙吧。
fleet3hewwo8.en: Look at your credit silos, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Full to bursting! Please, let us lighten them. Let us assist.

formless_leader_desc.zh: 无形异使的最后一位领袖之一，这个高维实体指挥舰队的时间比大多数物种的寿命还要长。
formless_leader_desc.en: One of the last leaders of the Formless, this extra-dimensional entity has commanded fleets for longer than the lifetime of most species.

formless_seal_defeat_all_fleets.zh: 我们必须消灭最后的入侵者，才能让无形异使正确地封印[Root.Target.GetName]恒星系。
formless_seal_defeat_all_fleets.en: We must eliminate the last of the invaders for the Formless to properly seal the [Root.Target.GetName] system

formless_subjugation_path_success_tt.zh: $NAME_Formless$作为一个$preset_luminarium$成为[This.GetName]治下的附属国。
formless_subjugation_path_success_tt.en: $NAME_Formless$ becomes a subject under [This.GetName] as a $preset_luminarium$.

formula_pink_opinion_modifier_tt.zh: 向所有非机械、非石质、非毒物帝国添加$opinion_formula_pink$的评价修正。
formula_pink_opinion_modifier_tt.en: Adds the $opinion_formula_pink$ opinion modifier towards all Non-Machine, Non-Lithoid, Non-Toxoid empires.

fotd_hunter_desc.zh: 这里就是粉碎了大分裂者的那次攻击发起的星系。扫描显示这个恒星系异常地富有矿物。
fotd_hunter_desc.en: The system from which the attack that shattered The Divider originated. Scans indicate that the system is abnormally rich in minerals.

fractal_seeds_available_tt.zh: 你将拥有[Explorer.num_authorized_fractal_seeds]个分形之种，可以通过殖民地决议放置在某一处殖民地上。
fractal_seeds_available_tt.en: You will have [Explorer.num_authorized_fractal_seeds] Fractal Seeds to place on colonies, via Colony Decisions.

fractalized_entropy_category_desc.zh: 探测器发现一奇异物体在小行星带中漂移。其来源未知，但轨迹稳定，表明可拦截检查。
