fractalized_entropy_category_desc.en: Sensors have picked up a strange object drifting through the asteroid field. Its origin is unknown, but its course is steady, suggesting it can be intercepted and examined.

from_the_ashes_site_desc.zh: [Planet.GetName]表面炙热，不适宜生物生存。行星上明显的人工遗迹影像引起了[GetScientistPlural]的注意。考古调查或可揭示这里的居民和曾发生在他们身上的故事。
from_the_ashes_site_desc.en: The surface of [Planet.GetName] is scorching hot, and hostile to biological life. Images of clearly artificial ruins have therefore caught the attention of [GetScientistPlural]. An archaeological investigation could reveal who was here, and what happened to them.

frozen_inferno_desc.zh: 对[from.GetName]的初步扫描发现在这颗冰冻的天体上存在极不正常的热量峰值。这种温度异常亟待进一步的调查。
frozen_inferno_desc.en: Initial scans of [from.GetName] are showing extremely erratic heat spikes on this otherwise frozen celestial body. These anomalous temperatures elicit further investigation.

full_tutorial.zh:
在你探索游戏机制时的教程任务和界面描述。

推荐初次游玩的玩家使用。
full_tutorial.en:
Tutorial missions and descriptions of the interface as you explore the game's mechanics.

Recommended if this is the first time you are playing the game.

fungal_emitters_category_desc.zh: 从[From.GetName]的底下洞穴中发出的意料之外的辐射。这会不会是什么东西发出的信号？
fungal_emitters_category_desc.en: Unexpected emissions are coming from the underground caves on [From.GetName]. Could these be a signal of some sort?

gain_asset_internal_organs.zh: 我们对于他们内部器官的知识可以在谍报行动中起到作用
gain_asset_internal_organs.en: Our knowledge of their internal organs will be of use during Espionage Operations

gain_marauder_admiral.zh: 我们获得了一位资深的[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]指挥官。

gain_marauder_fleet.zh: 我们得到了一小支掠夺者舰队。
gain_marauder_fleet.en: We gain a small fleet of Marauder ships.

galactic_features.101.desc.zh: 我们在[From.From.GetName]发现了原始哺乳动物的文明。这颗星球上最先进的地区才刚刚进入铁器时代，一群互相竞争、争名夺地的封建贵族统治着大地。
galactic_features.101.desc.en: We have discovered a primitive mammalian culture on [From.From.GetName]. The most advanced regions on the planet have only recently advanced beyond the Iron Age, and much of the surface is ruled by feudal nobles who vie with each other in an endless struggle for titles and land.

galactic_features.102.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]拥有一个原始的工业文明，她正陷入一场全球战争。两个大型势力正互相争斗，参与其中的地面装甲车辆、航空飞行器和航海舰船数量巨大。其中一些马上就要研究出原子能，这将急剧增大冲突的潜在破坏性。
galactic_features.102.desc.en: A primitive industrial culture is currently locked in a global war on the surface of [From.From.GetName]. Two large alliances of nation states are fighting each other with massive numbers of armored land vehicles, atmospheric aircraft and ocean-going naval vessels. Some of these states are on the cusp of unlocking atomic power, which could radically increase the destructive potential of this conflict.

galactic_features.103.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]是一种处于早期太空时代的哺乳动物的母星。这颗星球周围的轨道空间充斥着原始人造卫星，当地人似乎已经向太阳系-IIIa发射了数艘载人航天飞船。在星系内其他天体的轨道上检测到了一些小型亚光速探测器。
galactic_features.103.desc.en: [From.From.GetName] is home to a mammalian civilization currently in an Early Space Age. The orbital space around the planet is cluttered with primitive satellites, and the natives seem to have already launched several manned missions to Sol IIIa. A number of small sublight exploration probes have been detected on outbound trajectories towards other bodies within the system.

galactic_features.104.desc.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]的地表被使用核武的战争所毁灭，整个星球就像是一座坟墓。如今满地白骨的地方曾经是人群聚集的中心，在这荒凉、被灰烬所覆盖的地表之上，唯一能听到的只有那呼啸的风声。

一种当地的昆虫似乎在充满辐射的环境中兴起。变异后的种群在体型上迅速增大，一些群落则表现出了基本的智慧特征。
galactic_features.104.desc.en:
The surface of [From.From.From.GetName] has been ravaged by nuclear war, and the planet is little more than a tomb. Withered concrete skeletons jut out of the ground where major population centers once stood, and the howling wind is all that can be heard on the desolate, ash-covered surface.

A local species of insect seems to be thriving in the irradiated environment. Mutated specimens have increased dramatically in size, and some communities are displaying signs of rudimentary intelligence.

galactic_features.2.desc.zh:
闯入者！注意：

我们是扎娜姆的守护者。你们在[From.GetName]星系的存在是对我们造物主的羞辱。我们的程序驱使我们将你们摧毁。化作尘埃成为广阔宇宙的一部分吧。
galactic_features.2.desc.en:
INTERLOPER! Heed this message:

We are the Guardians of Zanaam. Your presence in the [From.GetName] system is an affront to our Creators. Our programming compels us to destroy you. Make your peace with the universe.

galactic_features.300.a.en: That barrier is coming down. For science!

galactic_features.300.b.zh: 它的存在肯定有其原因。留着别管了。
galactic_features.300.b.en: It must be there for a reason. Leave it be.

galactic_features.300.desc.zh:
我们发现[From.GetName]被完全包裹在某种能源屏障之中。[Root.GetName]所有用传感器穿透屏障的尝试都失败了——扫描光束被偏转回来，仿佛面对着一面镜子。

屏障的能源读数已经爆表，用纯粹的火力来突破是不可能的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提出了一个特殊项目来研究清除屏障的方法……如果它是用来封锁内部而非阻拦外人的话，移除屏障倒是有相当大的危险。
galactic_features.300.desc.en:
[From.GetName] has been found to be completely enveloped in some kind of energy barrier. All attempts by the [Root.GetName] to penetrate the barrier with its sensors have failed - the scanning beam is simply deflected back at the ship, as though it was looking at a mirror.

The barrier's energy readings are fluctuating somewhat, possibly as a result of thousands of years of decay, but breaching it with raw firepower would still be impossible. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has proposed a special project to investigate ways of removing the barrier... but suppose it was created to keep something in, rather than out?

galactic_features.301.a.zh: 派遣船员控制这些飞船。
galactic_features.301.a.en: Send in crews to man those ships.

galactic_features.301.desc.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的科学家终于成功地降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的能源屏障。当能源屏障消失时，我们在一块不起眼的岩石上方发现，一支被废置的战斗舰队正缓慢地在低轨道上移动。

这看上去像是[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]在数千年前的鼎盛时期所建立的后备舰队的残存分子。年代久远，[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]肯定都遗忘了关闭屏障的方法了，否则这支舰队早就去支援他们自己的舰队了。
galactic_features.301.desc.en:
Our scientists above [From.From.GetName] have finally succeeded in lowering the energy barrier that covered the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. When it disappeared, we discovered a mothballed battle fleet slowly drifting in low orbit above an otherwise insignificant rock.

It appears to be the remnants of some kind of naval reserve fleet established by the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] thousands of years ago, during the zenith of their ancient empire. With the passage of time, the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] must have lost the knowledge to lower the barrier themselves, or these ships would surely have been used to bolster their own fleets.

galactic_features.302.a.zh: 现在这些可以为我们所用了。

galactic_features.302.desc.zh:
我们的科学家已经降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障，我们看到的只是一个荒凉的世界以及伫立在地表上的一栋孤零零的大型建筑。派往建筑内部的先遣队汇报说，里面有一个放满各种黑科技发明的大型仓库。

这个宝库似乎是由[fallen_4_species.GetName]的科学家所建立，时间应该是在数千年前他们的帝国刚刚开始走下坡路的时候。这个宝库的用途是保存一些科技成果以造福[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]的子孙后代。
galactic_features.302.desc.en:
The energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName] has been lowered by our scientists, revealing a barren world with a single massive structure on its surface. Away teams sent into the structure have reported a massive vault filled with technological marvels.

This vault appears to have been established by [fallen_4_species.GetName] scientists soon after their empire began its long decline thousands of years ago, as a means to preserve some of their knowledge for the benefit of future generations of [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural].

galactic_features.303.desc.zh:
我们降下了覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障。我们的科学家发现，这似乎是一个宜居的世界，但并没有文明存在的迹象……除了在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]北半球的平顶山上发现了一座孤零零的小屋。

在屋内，我们找到了一个风烛残年的[fallen_4_species.GetName]，它要求与我们展开对话。
galactic_features.303.desc.en:
We have lowered the energy barrier that surrounded [From.From.GetName]. What our scientists found was an indistinct habitable world devoid of civilization... with one notable exception. A small, isolated hut was found perched on a mesa in the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s northern hemisphere.

Within the hut we found a withered old [fallen_4_species.GetName], who has demanded to speak with our government.

galactic_features.304.a.zh: 你为什么被困在一面护盾后面?
galactic_features.304.a.en: Why were you trapped behind a shield?

galactic_features.304.a.response.zh:
如果军队失去了我，[fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural]将会成为又一个被人灭绝而遗忘的种族。我碾碎了所有试图对抗我们的舰队，将一连串的世界付之一炬，只是为了确保我们种群的未来。

这是我的使命。而当和平最终到来之时，我们与那些战败者签订条约之时，我却成为了尴尬的存在。我已经变成了[fallen_4_species.GetName]残暴的象征。正因为那所谓的战争罪，我被独自关押在这个世界中。他们甚至没有处决我的勇气，你懂的。
galactic_features.304.a.response.en:
Without my leadership skills, the [fallen_4_species.GetNamePlural] would be just another extinct, forgotten species. I crushed the fleets of all who opposed us and put a dozen worlds to the torch, all to preserve the future of my kind.

This was my reward. When peace finally arrived and we sought treaties with those we had defeated, my presence became an embarrassment. I had become a symbol of [fallen_4_species.GetName] cruelty, and for my "war crimes" I was imprisoned alone on this world. They lacked the courage to execute me, you see.

galactic_features.304.b.zh: 你在这里具体待了多久？
galactic_features.304.b.en: How long have you been down there exactly?

galactic_features.304.b.response.zh: 我的同类将我遗弃在这里的时候解释过，在能源屏障内部时间会过得更加缓慢。用你们的计时方式来算，我在这里已有四十多年……而对于外面的世界来说，时间已然不知过了多少个世纪。我自己也感觉像过了几个世纪，我就这样孤身一人被关在阴暗的小屋里。真的，很漫长。
galactic_features.304.b.response.en:
When my own kind abandoned me here, they explained that time would pass more slowly on the inside of the energy barrier. For me, some forty of your years have passed... while in the rest of the universe, untold centuries must have come and gone since the barrier went up.

It felt like centuries to me as well, when I sat alone brooding in the darkness of my hut. Truly, it did.

galactic_features.304.c.response.zh: 好极了。那我们就离开这个不毛之地吧。我今生已经看够它了！
galactic_features.304.c.response.en: Excellent. Then let us depart this dismal place. I have seen enough of it to last a lifetime!

galactic_features.304.d.zh: 重新升起护盾。让这家伙自生自灭吧。
galactic_features.304.d.en: Bring up the shield again. Leave this creature to its woes.

galactic_features.304.desc.zh:
你无法想象再次看到晴朗的天空有多么棒，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我是图伯里克大元帅，[fallen_4_species.GetName]联合舰队的前任主官，赢过大大小小数百场战斗。数百个世纪之前，我亲自督战，征服了杜斯贝加克、里基那科、比纳克和朱斯卡里帝国。

我将为赋予我二次生命的你效劳。我很乐意领导你的舰队与敌人作战。
galactic_features.304.desc.en:
You cannot imagine how good it is to finally see clear skies again, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I am Grand Commander Tuborek, former master of the combined [fallen_4_species.GetName] armada and victor of a hundred battles. I personally oversaw the conquest of the Duthbejak, Riikinak, Binark and Jusskari empires hundreds of your centuries ago.

As my savior, I pledge my service to you. I should be honored to lead your mighty fleets into battle against your enemies.

galactic_features.305.a.zh: 我们可能放出了可怕的东西……
galactic_features.305.a.en: We may have unleashed something dark...

galactic_features.305.desc.zh:
就在我们的科学家降下覆盖在[From.From.GetName]上的能源屏障之际，恒星系内所有人都在一瞬间感到头痛欲裂，耳边响起着古老[fallen_4_species.GetName]之语的呢喃：

“自由……”
galactic_features.305.desc.en:
As soon as our scientists lowered the energy barrier that was surrounding [From.From.GetName], everyone present within the system was briefly afflicted by a splitting headache accompanied by a faint, whispered word in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:

"FREEDOM..."

galactic_features.305.desc.mech.zh:
在解除[From.From.GetName]周围的能源屏障之后，我们的短距子空间发射机受到来自原能源屏障之后一股异常能源爆发的强烈干扰。在经过我们解密软件的处理之后，干扰信号被判明为一种古老[fallen_4_species.GetName]语言的信息：

“摆脱拘束……”
galactic_features.305.desc.mech.en:
After lowering the energy barrier surrounding [From.From.GetName], our short-range subspace transmitters experienced a spike in interference levels caused by an abnormal energy burst that originated from a point behind the former barrier. When run through our decryption software the interference proved to be a message in an ancient [fallen_4_species.GetName] dialect:

"FREEDOM..."

galactic_features.350.desc.zh:
我们遇到了一个环绕着[From.GetName]星系内恒星的巨大环形世界。初步扫描显示这个使用了该恒星系的行星作为原材料的大家伙建立在万古之前。该环形世界有着四个可居住段，每一个看上去都是一个前太空文明的家园。

环形世界和它环绕的恒星之间有个属于某种族的大型宇宙空间站。我们从上面接收到一段讯息。
galactic_features.350.desc.en:
We have encountered a massive ring world surrounding the star in the [From.GetName] system. Preliminary scans indicate that it was built eons ago using the material of the system's innermost planets. The ring world has four habitable segments, each seemingly home to a pre-space civilization.

There is a large space station of some kind located between the ring world and its star. We are receiving a transmission from it.

galactic_features.351.a.zh: 我们的传感器显示你们的环形世界中有文明存在的迹象。
galactic_features.351.a.en: Our sensors show signs of civilization on your ring world.

galactic_features.351.a.response.zh:
保护区一开始建立时，生物圈内所有的生物都被全部登记了。记录显示，没有生命体的智力水平是接近智能。你们的传感器一定是出错了。

无论如何都不要接近此设施。
galactic_features.351.a.response.en:
All species present in our biomes were thoroughly cataloged when the Sanctuary was first established. Records indicate that none of them displayed intelligence levels approaching sapience. Your sensors must be mistaken.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

galactic_features.351.b.response.zh:
此设施是由西渺建成，历时412周期。正式完成并投入运行是在74,605,338周期前。西渺或者西渺飞船最近一次有记录的来访是在67,103,853周期前。从那之后就再也没有过西渺或西渺附属飞船来访的记录。

记录中共有38,201次未经授权的飞船试图进入。

无论如何都不要接近此设施。
galactic_features.351.b.response.en:
This facility was constructed by the Ximio over a period of 412 cycles. It was completed and fully functional 74,605,338 cycles ago. The last recorded visit by a Ximio vessel occurred 67,103,853 cycles ago. There are no recorded visits by Ximio or Ximio-affiliated vessels since that date.

There are 38,201 failed attempts by unauthorized vessels to access this facility on record.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

galactic_features.351.c.response.zh:
保护区的自动服务祝您度过愉快的一天，智慧生物。

无论如何都不要接近此设施。
galactic_features.351.c.response.en:
The automated services of the Sanctuary bid you a pleasant day, sapient.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

galactic_features.351.desc.zh:
欢迎来到保护区，智慧生物。这个完全自动化的设施是在74605338个周期前建立的，是一个自然保护区。这里分割为四个自治的生态群系，每个分区拥有来自不同生物圈的非智慧植物和动物。

为了保护脆弱的生物圈，进入设施目前是受限制的。

在任何情况下都禁止接近此设施。
galactic_features.351.desc.en:
Welcome to the Sanctuary, sapient. This fully automated facility was established 74,605,338 cycles ago to serve as a nature reserve. Our self-sustaining biome segments feature a selection of non-intelligent flora and fauna originating from four distinct biospheres.

To protect these fragile biospheres, access to our facilities is currently restricted.

Do not approach this facility under any circumstances.

galactic_features.361.desc.zh:
在[From.From.From.GetStarName]星系的舰队被全灭后，那里的虚空之云从碎屑中聚集了足够的物质开始进行某种宏观上的有丝分离，也就是无性繁殖。

现在追杀[From.From.From.GetStarName]的虚空之云又多了一个。
galactic_features.361.desc.en:
Following the destruction of our fleet in the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system, the local Void Cloud appears to have gathered enough material from the debris to undergo what can best be described as a form of mitosis on the macro level - asexual reproduction.

There is now one more Void Cloud haunting [From.From.From.GetStarName].

galactic_features.367.a.zh: 整个星系应该感谢我们。

galactic_features.370.name.zh: 缇扬奇已被逼至灭绝边缘

galactic_features.371.a.en: We... we didn't mean for this to happen.

galactic_features.371.b.zh: 缇扬奇的时代结束了，你们也一样。
galactic_features.371.b.en: Like you, their time had passed.

galactic_features.371.desc.zh:
很久很久以前，即使在我们国家还如日中天的时候，缇扬奇已经被视作古老的生物了……现在我听说一批[Root.GetSpeciesName]舰船最近屠杀了这些手无寸铁的生物，使得缇扬奇彻底灭绝。

你们卑微的[Root.GetSpeciesName]大脑能理解自己干的事情吗？你们对自己无情的举动从星系中窃取走的东西有最起码的理解吗？
galactic_features.371.desc.en:
Even when our empire was at the height of its power, eons ago, the Tiyanki were considered ancient, and now... now I am told that a bunch of [Root.GetSpeciesName] WHELPS recently slew the last of the defenseless creatures, rendering them extinct.

Can your feeble [Root.GetSpeciesName] brains comprehend what you have done? Do you have even the slightest notion of what your callous actions have stolen from this galaxy?

galactic_features.384.desc.zh:
一大群[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]聚集在一个行星的周边，上面遍布某种外星生命体的尸体。

由于我们对于这些外星实体没有任何信息，我们只能对它们的行为进行猜测。
galactic_features.384.desc.en:
A large number of [tiyanki_no_contact.GetName] are clustered around a planet covered in the carcasses of some alien life-form.

Having no information on those alien entities, we can only speculate on their behavior.

galactic_features.384.tooltip.zh: 同[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]建立第一次接触以了解更多信息。
galactic_features.384.tooltip.en: Establish first contact with the [tiyanki_no_contact.GetName] to learn more.

galactic_features.385.desc.zh: 我们在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系中成功捕杀了一些野生缇扬奇。我方舰队用激光切割以从巨型缇扬奇的尸体内提取矿物和资源。
galactic_features.385.desc.en: We have successfully hunted down and killed some wild Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system. Our fleet has used laser cutters to extract materials and resources from the massive Tiyanki remains.

galactic_features.387.a.zh: 缇扬奇就还挺弱的。宰了它们。
galactic_features.387.a.en: Tiyanki make easy prey. Eliminate them.

galactic_features.387.b.zh: 在不伤害他们的前提下引走吧。
galactic_features.387.b.en: Displace the gravekeepers without harming them.

galactic_features.387.desc.zh:
生活在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]星系的缇扬奇的行为与该物种的已知行为模式并不一致。缇扬奇通常是迁徙性的，而这群缇扬奇却紧紧守在一颗满是他们同类尸体的行星周围。

它们遮天蔽日的触手阻碍了对这个坟地的研究，除非我们将它们引走或者处置掉，否则进一步的调查难以进行。
galactic_features.387.desc.en:
The actions of the Tiyanki inhabiting the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] system do not match known behavior patterns for their species. While Tiyanki are usually nomadic, these herds remain stationed around a planet entirely covered in the carcasses of their own dead.

Attempts to study the burial ground have been hindered by the net of tentacles the Tiyanki have wrapped around the planet, making further research impossible - unless we are willing to displace or dispose of the gravekeepers.

galactic_features.388.desc.zh: 在肃清停留在[FromFrom.System.GetName]的缇扬奇之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以安全地接近墓地，进一步开展研究。
galactic_features.388.desc.en: Having eliminated the Tiyanki stationed in [FromFrom.System.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] can now safely approach the burial ground to conduct their research.

galactic_features.389.desc.zh: 我们已经在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]星系完成了缇扬奇诱饵的建设。受到散播装置释放的营养性气体的误导，守墓的兽群被诱惑离开了他们的驻地，允许我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]悄悄溜过它们的触手，在不引起注意的情况下接近墓地。
galactic_features.389.desc.en: The construction of the Tiyanki lure in the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] system has been completed. Beguiled by the nourishing gases released by the diffuser, the gravekeepers are lured away from their post, allowing our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] to slip through their tentacles and approach the burial ground unnoticed.

galactic_features.421.a.en: This will interfere with ship systems.

galactic_features.421.desc.zh:
我们在[From.From.From.GetName]星系内遭遇了某种极为强大的亚空间实体。它似乎没有敌意，对传统飞行器或许甚至没有完全察觉，但它的存在使得[From.From.From.GetName]整个恒星系中出现了强烈的亚空间扰动。

这些扰动位于实体自身周围，在它离开恒星系后应该也会消失。它对我们的致意没有回复，但这个实体一直在发射模式复杂，似乎是某种语言的快子流。如果我们的翻译软件正确的话，它一遍又一遍说的是：

“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”
galactic_features.421.desc.en:
An extremely powerful subspace entity of some kind has been encountered in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. It does not appear hostile and may not even be fully aware of conventional spacecraft, but its mere presence in [From.From.From.GetName] is causing massive subspace disturbances in the entire system.

These disturbances are localized around the entity itself and should disappear when it leaves the system. While it does not acknowledge hails, the entity is continuously emitting a complex pattern of tachyon pulses which appears to be a form of language. If our translation software is correct, it is saying, over and over:

"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."

galactic_features.423.a.zh: 收集一切可以收集的东西。
galactic_features.423.a.en: We shall collect what we can.

galactic_features.423.desc.zh:
在与[vluur_system.GetName]星系中我方军队交战时，亚空间实体“弗雷尔”提高了其发送快子流的频率，但不停重复的信息与之前一样：

“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”

在受到致命一击的同时，这个实体自爆了，大爆炸使得整个恒星系中撒满了暗物质。
galactic_features.423.desc.en:
Throughout its battle with our forces in the [vluur_system.GetName] system, the subspace entity "VLUUR" increased the frequency at which it was emitting tachyon pulses, but the endlessly repeating message remained the same:

"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."

When the final killing blow was delivered, the entity detonated in a massive explosion that showered the system in dark matter.

galactic_features.423.tooltip.zh: 暗物质矿藏散落于[vluur_system.GetName]恒星系中的数个行星上。
galactic_features.423.tooltip.en: Dark Matter deposits are scattered to several worlds in the [vluur_system.GetName] system.

galactic_features.500.alt.desc.zh:
第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但尽管如此，这里似乎居住着大量前所未知的大型太空有机体。它们在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，似乎在进行精心安排的繁殖仪式。

目前还不清楚此星系对这些生物有什么吸引力。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向我们，公然以一种威胁的姿态接近[Root.GetName]。
galactic_features.500.alt.desc.en:
The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, despite all this, it seems to be inhabited in large numbers by a previously unknown large spaceborne organism, groups of which flit in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.

It is unclear what attraction this system could possibly hold for these creatures. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned towards us, approaching the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

galactic_features.500.desc.zh:
$galactic_features.500.desc.base$

目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向[Root.GetName]，公然对其施加威胁。
galactic_features.500.desc.en:
$galactic_features.500.desc.base$

It is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned their flagella towards the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

galactic_features.500.desc.peaceful.zh:
$galactic_features.500.desc.base$

目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。幸运的是，它们似乎乐意与我们共享栖息地，没有对[Root.GetName]采取任何有敌意的措施。
galactic_features.500.desc.peaceful.en:
$galactic_features.500.desc.base$

It is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Fortunately, however, they appear content to share it with us, and have made no hostile moves toward the [Root.GetName].

galactic_features.502.alt.desc.zh: 一大群太空有机体已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们的领地，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的哨站。
galactic_features.502.alt.desc.en: A large group of spaceborne organisms has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, bringing them into our own territory. They seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts in the [FromFrom.GetName] system.

galactic_features.502.desc.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的领地，出于天性，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们的哨站。
galactic_features.502.desc.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, entering our territory in the [FromFrom.GetName] system. As is the norm with these creatures, they seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts.

galactic_features.502.desc.peaceful.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。现在可以观测到，它们数量惊人，正浩浩荡荡地穿越[FromFrom.GetName]星系。幸运的是，我们已经揭开了与这些巨型生物和平共处的奥秘，因此我们不必过度担忧它们的活动。
galactic_features.502.desc.peaceful.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, and can now be seen crossing the [FromFrom.GetName] system in impressive numbers. Fortunately, we have uncovered the secret to peaceful coexistence with these majestic beings, so we need not be overly concerned at their movements..

galactic_features.505.B.zh: 太空变形虫是害虫，必须将其尽数消灭！
galactic_features.505.B.en: Space Amoebas are a pest and must be eradicated!

galactic_features.505.B.tt.en: The [Root.GetName] will be in Breach of Galactic Law

galactic_features.505.desc.zh:
星海共同体已通过$resolution_amoeba_conservation_act$议案，要求帝国与太空变形虫和平共处。

我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
galactic_features.505.desc.en:
The Galactic Community has passed the $resolution_amoeba_conservation_act$ resolution, mandating that empires peacefully coexist with Space Amoebas.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

galactic_market_station.zh: 泛星系贸易市场空间站

galcom.10.a.en: The other fools were not ready.

galcom.10.desc.zh: 组建一个超国家的“星海共同体”的提议已经失败。并没有足够的帝国承诺会支持这种机构的创立。
galcom.10.desc.en: The initiative to form a supranational "Galactic Community" has failed. Not enough empires pledged their support to the creation of such an institution.

galcom.104.desc.zh:
缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽。任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

不幸的是，我国境内就有缇扬奇存在。直至它们被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止，[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
galcom.104.desc.en:
The Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests. Any member of the Galactic Community with Tiyanki inside their borders are legally obliged to see to the immediate euthanization of the creatures.

Unfortunately, there are Tiyanki present within our space. Until they are dealt with, or they leave our space of their own accord, the [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law.

galcom.106.c.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
galcom.106.c.en: This infestation must be dealt with.

galcom.106.desc.zh:
一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的[tiyanki_system.GetName]星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
galcom.106.desc.en:
A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law until the Tiyanki have either departed our space or been exterminated.

galcom.107.desc.zh:
星海共同体的官员就我们最近在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系击杀缇扬奇提出抗议，通知我们我国的行为违反了缇扬奇保护法。结果是，[Root.GetName]将在接下来10年内被视为违反星系法。

我们从缇扬奇尸体上提取的资源被收缴了，而且他们还对我国处以罚金。
galcom.107.desc.en:
Officials from the Galactic Community have protested our recent killing of Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system, informing us that our actions have violated the Tiyanki Conservation Act. As a consequence, the [Root.GetName] is to be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years.

The resources we extracted from the dead Tiyanki have been confiscated, and we have been issued a fine.

galcom.109.desc.zh: 星海共同体的官员注意到[Root.GetName]境内有缇扬奇存在。由于缇扬奇害兽管制议案已经生效，这使得我国处于违反星系法状态，直至这些生物被消灭或是自行主动离开为止。
galcom.109.desc.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have observed the presence of Tiyanki within the borders of the [Root.GetName]. With the Tiyanki Pest Control resolution having been enacted, this leaves us in Breach of Galactic Law until the creatures are euthanized or leave our space of their own accord.

galcom.110.a.en: It had to be put down.

galcom.110.b.zh: 但是……是它攻击我们的啊！

galcom.110.desc.zh:
星海共同体的官员收到了我们最近就缇扬奇族母取得胜利的消息。他们告诉我方，消灭这只野兽明显违反了缇扬奇保护法，就算缇扬奇族母是敌对生物也一样。

[Root.GetName]将在接下来十年内被视为违反星系法。此外，我们收到了一份巨额的罚单，理由是我们消灭了“一种独特的，整个星系中再也见不到的缇扬奇生命形式”。
galcom.110.desc.en:
Officials from the Galactic Community have received word of our recent victory against the Tiyanki Matriarch. They have informed us that our destruction of the beast was a clear violation of the Tiyanki Conservation Act, regardless of the Matriarch's hostile nature.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. Additionally, we have been issued with a hefty fine for our killing of "a unique Tiyanki life form whose like the galaxy shall never see again."

galcom.16.a.zh: 好的，让我们加入这一组织。
galcom.16.a.en: Yes, let us join this community.

galcom.16.b.zh: 不，我们不会参与这种事。
galcom.16.b.en: No, we will take no part in this.

galcom.16.c.zh: 我们不关心什么“共同体”
galcom.16.c.en: We do not care for this "Community."

galcom.16.d.zh: 不久后他们也将臣服于我们的大可汗。
galcom.16.d.en: Soon they too will bow to our great Khan.

galcom.16.desc.zh:
数个太空帝国，其中一些我们尚不清楚，已经联合组建了一个“星海共同体”。这一国家间机构的目的是作为一个论坛，在那里可以共商重要事务。

虽然我们并不曾参与其建立，那些成员国已经向[Root.GetName]发出了邀请，请求我们成为正式的成员国。我们应该接受邀请吗？
galcom.16.desc.en:
Several spacefaring empires, some of them unknown to us, have banded together to form a "Galactic Community." This supranational institution is to serve as a forum where important matters can be discussed.

Although we were not involved in its founding, the other members have extended an invitation to the [Root.GetName] for formal membership. Should we accept?

galcom.2.a.zh: 是的，值得进行这样的尝试。
galcom.2.a.en: Yes, this is a worthy endeavor.

galcom.2.b.zh: 不，我们没时间做这种毫无意义的事情。
galcom.2.b.en: No, we have no time for this nonsense.

galcom.2a.desc.zh:
随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。

[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持星海共同体的创立吗？
galcom.2a.desc.en:
As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of a new pan-galactic organization - a community, if you will, where the empires of the galaxy can meet to discuss important matters.

Should the [Root.GetName] pledge its support for the creation of the Galactic Community?

galcom.2b.desc.zh: 让我们再试一次。我们应该组建星海共同体吗？
galcom.2b.desc.en: Let's try again. Should we form a Galactic Community?

galcom.5.a.en: A great day for the galaxy!

galcom.5.desc.zh:
这是历史性的一天。星系中数个重要的太空帝国，包括[Root.GetName]，宣布了星海共同体的创立。这一国家间组织会作为一个论坛，整个星系的事务都可以在此讨论和决定。

作为其创始成员国之一，我们可以为星系历史的这一里程碑感到骄傲。
galcom.5.desc.en:
This is a historic day. Several of the galaxy's prominent spacefaring empires, including the [Root.GetName], have announced the creation of the Galactic Community. This supranational organization will serve as a forum where matters involving the entire galaxy can be discussed and decided upon.

As one of its founding members, we can take pride in this milestone of galactic history.

galcom.5.name.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

galcom.51.a.zh: 希望他们有能力完成任务……
galcom.51.a.en: Hopefully they are up to the task...

galcom.51.b.zh: 现在我们终于可以大有作为了！
galcom.51.b.en: Now we can finally get things done!

galcom.51.c.zh: 啊，看来那些幕后操纵者总算露出了真容！
galcom.51.c.en: Ah, so the puppeteers finally reveal themselves!

galcom.51.desc.zh:
星海共同体的各个成员国已经投票决定设立星系理事会。这一受人尊敬的实体只允许社群中三个实力最强、最具影响力的帝国成为其成员。到下一轮议会被选出为止，这三个国家将是[council_member_1.GetName]，[council_member_2.GetName]和[council_member_3.GetName]。

共同体期望理事会成员国可以领导和保卫整个星海共同体。他们获得了提权，可以跳过那些时常在大型政治机构中阻碍决策流程的繁文缛节。
galcom.51.desc.en:
The members of the Galactic Community have voted to establish a Galactic Council. Membership in this august body will be limited to representatives from the three most powerful and influential empires in the Community. Until a new Council is elected, these are the [council_member_1.GetName], the [council_member_2.GetName], and the [council_member_3.GetName].

The members of the Council are expected to lead and safeguard the Galactic Community. Their increased powers allow them to cut through some of the red tape that so often inhibits the decision-making process in large political institutions.

galcom.6.desc.zh:
尽管我们决定不为建立某种国家间星系机构提供帮助，若干其他帝国已经联合创立了这种东西。在他们“历史性的”联合声明中，他们向全星系宣布了星海共同体的创立。这一组织的目的是作为一个论坛，会影响星系整体的重要事务可以在那里讨论。

由于我们拒绝参与这一星海共同体的创立，[Root.GetName]将不被算作成员国。
galcom.6.desc.en:
Despite our decision not to lend our support behind the founding of some sort of supranational galactic institution, several other empires have banded together to create just such a thing. In their "historic" joint announcement, they declared the creation of the Galactic Community to the galaxy. This organization is to serve as a forum where important matters that affect the galaxy as a whole can be discussed.

As we refused to take part in the creation of this Galactic Community, the [Root.GetName] is not yet considered a member.

galcom.62.A.en: It is a price worth paying.

galcom.62.desc.zh: 根据[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]宪章第19条C款，只有一个会员国可以主办泛星系贸易市场。$galcom.62.base$[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的贸易董事会已提出陈词对该事态表示遗憾。他们允诺，在[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]内新主办国的选举将会很快开始。
galcom.62.desc.en: According to article 19C of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. $galcom.62.base$ The [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce has issued a statement expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that nominations for a new host within the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] will commence immediately.

galcom.62.name.zh: [galactic_market_station_system.GetName]泛星系贸易市场总部被拆除

galcom.63.A.zh: 也许这对我们而言是一次机会……
galcom.63.A.en: Perhaps this represents an opportunity for us...

galcom.63.B.zh: 那我们只能嘲笑他们的愚蠢了。
galcom.63.B.en: We can only laugh at their foolishness.

galcom.63.desc.zh: 随着[From.GetName]选择离开[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]，我们不得不执行[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]宪章中的一项晦涩难懂的条款，其大意是只有成员国才能主导泛星系贸易市场。$galcom.62.base$对新总部的选址提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商务董事会发布生命对当前形势表示遗憾。他们保障将尽快找到新的主办国。
galcom.63.desc.en: With the [From.GetName] opting to leave the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], an obscure article of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s charter must be applied, to the effect that only a member state may host the Galactic Market. $galcom.62.base$ Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

galcom.63.name.zh: 挑选泛星系贸易市场新总部
galcom.63.name.en: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought

galcom.64.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经表态，迁移泛星系贸易市场的新一轮竞争由此展开。位于[market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系的的市场总部已经开始收尾工作，交易员的关注都集中在未来几年的预测上。他们哀叹这一戏剧性的——且在他们看来并不必要的决定对泛星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。

总部新址的提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商业委员会发表了一份声明，对这种状况表示遗憾。他们承诺将尽快找到一个新的星系。
galcom.64.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has spoken, and a new competition has begun to relocate the Galactic Market. The market's headquarters in the [market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName] system has begun wind-down operations, with traders focusing solely on forecasts for the next few years. They bemoan the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has already caused.

Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce issuing a statement expressing regret at this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

galcom.69.desc.zh:
我们迁移泛星系贸易市场的动议不幸失败。尽管我们的努力争取到了大量口头支持，却没有转化为新地点的足够提名。

这一意见原则上仍然合理：[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]今后还是可以再次提出迁移市场。然而就目前而言，这个商业机构仍然由获利丰厚的[market_founder.GetName]进行管理。
galcom.69.desc.en:
Our motion to relocate the Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we mustered significant vocal support for the endeavor, this did not translate into enough valid nominations for a new host site.

The idea remains sound in principle: the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] may propose moving the Market again in future, if it so desires. For now though, this commercial institution remains in the lucrative care of the [market_founder.GetName].

galcom.69.name.zh: 泛星系贸易市场留在原址

galcom.70.desc.zh: 泛星系商业最近经历了一次短暂而混乱的复苏，有消息称迁移泛星系市场的努力已经失败。尽管[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]声明希望迁移这一机构，但他们没有收到任何替代东道主的可靠提名。因此，[market_founder.GetName]将继续担任其东道主，直到政治变革的风向再次转向，通过投票寻找到替代。
galcom.70.desc.en: Galactic commerce experienced a brief and confusing resurgence recently, with news that the effort to relocate the Galactic Market has failed. Despite the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s stated desire to move this institution, they received no valid nominations for a replacement host. As a result, the [market_founder.GetName] shall remain its hosts until the winds of political change swing back to polling for a replacement.

galcom.70.desc.founder.zh:
泛星系的政治意愿显然与其市场的意愿不一致。在引起了广泛的金融混乱之后，[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]想要取消我们作为其专属交易中心东道主的努力已经失败，因为没有其他帝国给出有效的东道主提名。

这项动议的支持者们不为所动，断言泛星系市场随时可能根据商业需要进行迁移到别处。不过就目前而言，在经历了这么多忙乱之后，泛星系最重要的商人们还是更愿意相信我们。
galcom.70.desc.founder.en:
The galaxy's political will is clearly not aligned with that of its markets. After having caused widespread financial upset, the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s effort to remove us as hosts to its dedicated trading hub has failed, with no other empires putting forward a valid nomination for a host site.

Proponents of this motion are unfazed, affirming that the Galactic Market may yet move wherever and whenever commercial needs dictate. For now though, it would seem that after all that fuss, the galaxy's foremost merchants prefer to keep their trust in us.

galcom_2_aye.zh: 我们将支持建立星海共同体。
galcom_2_aye.en: We will support the creation of the Galactic Community.

galcom_2_nay.zh: 我们将不支持建立星海共同体。
galcom_2_nay.en: We will not support the creation of the Galactic Community.

game_start.74.title.zh:
选择一项焦点规划帝国的前路。

变更帝国焦点的花费暂时免除。
game_start.74.title.en:
Select a focus to chart your empire's course.

Costs to change Empire Focus are currently waived.

ganthuata_catch_phrase.zh: 我们依偎在月窠的怀抱里。
ganthuata_catch_phrase.en: We fold into the Cradle's embrace.

ganthuata_desc.zh: $the_cradle_of_souls_article$的一位虔诚弟子，渴望寻求祂的深刻真理，也渴望与能接受的人分享。
ganthuata_desc.en: A devout disciple of $the_cradle_of_souls_article$, eager to seek out and share its profound truths with those who have the means to receive them.

garden_astral_rift_resurrected_leader_de.zh: [Root.GetName]不知为何从一场失败的星界裂隙旅途中回来，这个星界裂隙充满各种植被。尽管[Root.GetHeShe]已经同过去的自己样貌大不一样，但[Root.GetHeShe]仍保留着相似的特质。
garden_astral_rift_resurrected_leader_de.en: [Root.GetName] somehow returned to us from a failed expedition into an Astral Rift abundant with vegetation. While [Root.GetHeShe] no longer resemble[Root.GetSXX] [Root.GetHisHer] former self, [Root.GetHeShe] seem[Root.GetSXX] to possess similar qualities.

gaseous_metals_desc.zh: [from.GetName]的大气主要由各种气态金属构成。进一步了解这颗行星的严苛条件后我们或许就能提取这些有价值的化合物。
gaseous_metals_desc.en: The atmosphere of [from.GetName] is primarily composed of various metals in a gaseous state. With better understanding of this planet's harsh conditions we may be able to extract these valuable compounds.

genetic_ascension_approach_selected.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$我们已经为该阶段做好了选择。
genetic_ascension_approach_selected.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$We have already made our choice for this stage.

genetic_ascension_situation_outcome.zh:
我们将会解锁基因操纵的全部潜力，确保自己物种的绝对优势。

我们将决定基因重塑的终极表达。
genetic_ascension_situation_outcome.en:
We will unlock the full potential of genetic manipulation and ensure the advancement of our species.

We will choose the ultimate expression of Biomorphosis.

genomic_facility_needed_tt.zh:
需要行动：
$t$—建造一座$building_genomic_facility$以开始$genetic_ascension_situation$局势。
genomic_facility_needed_tt.en:
Action required:
$t$- Build a $building_genomic_facility$ to begin the $genetic_ascension_situation$ situation.

geological_tension_desc.zh: 对[from.GetName]的地质扫描表明这颗熔融星球的地壳承受着非常巨大的构造应力。可能有重大的地质事件即将发生。
geological_tension_desc.en: Geological scans of [from.GetName] suggest that the planetary crust of this molten world is under immense pressure from pent-up tectonic forces. A significant geological event may be imminent.

gestalt_trait_commander_mind_wipe_01.zh: 碰触虚境的海军子个体

gestalt_trait_commander_mind_wipe_02.zh: 碰触虚境的海军子个体

gestalt_trait_general_mind_wipe_01.zh: 碰触虚境的攻击子个体

gestalt_trait_general_mind_wipe_02.zh: 碰触虚境的攻击子个体

gestalt_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_01.zh: 碰触虚境的指挥子个体

gestalt_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_02.zh: 碰触虚境的指挥子个体

gestalt_trait_scientist_mind_wipe_02.zh: 碰触虚境的研究子个体

give_relic_edgecase_tt.zh: 目前没有可用的该类策展人遗珍。
give_relic_edgecase_tt.en: There are no Curator Relics of this type currently available.

glimpse_the_core_desc.zh: [from.GetName]外层气体的怪异活动打开了一些极深的开口，短暂地暴露出行星的固体核心。这一独特现象值得进一步研究。
glimpse_the_core_desc.en: Strange movements in [from.GetName]'s gassy outer layers are causing exceptionally deep vents to open up, exposing the planet's solid core in brief intervals. This remarkable phenomenon warrants further study.

grand_archive.10010.desc.zh:
我们关于空间变形虫的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的新细胞器：可部署的$tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba$。

这些共生生物能够从附近物体中汲取能量并将其返还给宿主，从而增强生存能力和再生能力。
grand_archive.10010.desc.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Space Amoebas is complete, and has yielded some interesting new organelles: deployable $tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba$.

These symbiotic organisms are able to drain energy from nearby objects and return it to its host, enhancing survivability and regeneration.

grand_archive.10010.name.zh: 太空变形虫变异计划完成

grand_archive.10015.desc.zh:
我们对缇扬奇的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：$tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki$

我们已经将这些生物在它们群体中用于交流的自然振动放大到可持续的最大水平。这将产生一个可控的场，增强附近其他生物的组织。
grand_archive.10015.desc.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Tiyankis is complete, and has yielded some interesting enhancements: $tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki$

We have amplified the natural vibrations these creatures use for communication within their herds to the maximum sustainable level. This results in a controllable field that strengthens the tissue of other nearby creatures.

grand_archive.1002.desc.default.zh:
宇宙中充满了生命。我们已经发现了[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]的存在，但那里还有其他什么？

我们与[capital_scope.GetName]上的野生动物的密切关系可能不适合星系尺度。辽阔的太空代表着一个全新的生态系统，我们发现自己站在十字路口。

这些生物对我们来说是什么？

无论我们做出什么选择，其后果都将在未来几年内显现。
grand_archive.1002.desc.default.en:
The void is full of life. We have discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], but what else is out there?

Our close relationship with the wildlife on [capital_scope.GetName] may not be appropriate on the galactic scale. The void of space represents an entirely new ecosystem, and we find ourselves at a crossroads.

What are these creatures to us?

Whatever choice we make, the consequences will be felt for years to come.

grand_archive.1002.desc.homicidal.zh: 宇宙中可能充满了生命——我们有权消灭它们，或利用它们。我们已经发现了[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]的存在，并渴望找到更多。新鲜的猎物或役畜，选择权在我们手中。
grand_archive.1002.desc.homicidal.en: The void may well be full of life - ours to extinguish, or to use. Having discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we are eager to find more. Fresh prey or beasts of burden, the choice is up to us.

grand_archive.10020.desc.zh:
我们对虚空虫的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的繁殖周期变异：$tech_unique_mutation_voidworm$

我们已经能够提高这些生物用来轰炸宿主星球的寄生囊肿的繁殖能力。结果是产生的若虫产量增加。
grand_archive.10020.desc.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Voidworms is complete, and has yielded some interesting variations of their reproductive cycles: $tech_unique_mutation_voidworm$

We have been able to increase the fertility of the parasitic cysts these creatures use to bombard their host planets with. The result is an increase in yield of generated nymphs.

grand_archive.10025.desc.zh:
我们对岩居兽的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：$tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid$

我们已经找到方法能将其巨大消化系统改造为发射高初速长射程弹药的武器。不幸的是，这一显著的生物学改造会导致它们无法再吞噬敌方舰船了。
grand_archive.10025.desc.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Cutholoids is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: $tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid$

We have found a way to repurpose their massive digestive system to fire high velocity, long-range projectiles. Unfortunately, this significant biological modification will mean they are no longer able to engulf enemy fleets.

grand_archive.10030.desc.zh:
我们关于晶态实体的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：$tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity$

通过对它们晶体基因的这种修改，每个生物在遭受严重创伤时能够分裂成两个独立的个体。这将极大地提高它们的战斗能力。
grand_archive.10030.desc.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Crystalline Entities is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: $tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity$

With this modification to their crystalline genetics, each creature is capable of splitting into two independent organisms in the event of severe trauma. This should drastically improve their combat capabilities.

grand_archive.10030.name.zh: 晶态实体变异计划完成

grand_archive.10060.desc.zh:
我们使用$NAME_Elderly_Tiyanki$的遗传物质进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：$restorative_enzymes$

族母遗传物质中存在的修复酶可以在其他生物的类似腺体中复制。这将它们的结构组织转化为再生材料，在爆炸时紧密编队中会非常有用。
grand_archive.10060.desc.en:
Our experimental mutation project using $NAME_Elderly_Tiyanki$ genetic material is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: $restorative_enzymes$

The restorative enzymes present in the Matriarch's genetic material can be reproduced in similar glands on other creatures. This transforms their structural tissue into regenerative material, which would provide quite useful in tight formations upon explosion.

grand_archive.10080.desc.zh:
我们使用$NAME_Voidspawn$基因材料进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的发现：$starborne_biology$

这些生物的组织对星光反应强烈，可以被鼓励在其他生物体中生长。这需要少量能量来维持，但在最亮的恒星附近，它们的生长速度会大幅提高。
grand_archive.10080.desc.en:
Our experimental mutation project using $NAME_Voidspawn$ genetic material is complete, and has yielded an interesting discovery: $starborne_biology$

The tissue of these creatures reacts strongly to starlight, and can be encouraged to grow in other organisms. This demands a small amount of energy to maintain, but vastly improves their growth rate near the brightest stars.

grand_archive.10080.name.zh: 虚空孳孽变异计划完成

grand_archive.1010.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地学会了如何尊重当地泰坦巨兽自然领地的边界。

随着我们的边界扩张和土地开发，这些巨大野兽将继续为我们的殖民地带来好处。
grand_archive.1010.desc.en:
Our colony on [Root.GetName] has learned to respect the boundaries of the native Titanic Life's natural territory.

These massive beasts will be a continued benefit to our settlement as we expand borders and develop the land.

grand_archive.1060.desc.zh:
与[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]建立联系后，我们在[fromfrom.GetName]中发现了一具他们物种的腐烂尸体。遗骸在长时间暴露于太空后变得干枯并冻得梆硬。

我们推测这具尸体是吸引了该物种其他成员的首要因素；也许他们一直在寻找他们[from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]中失踪的成员。这是一个难得的机会，可以研究在虚空中自然死亡的[from.GetSpaceFaunaName]的生物学特性。
grand_archive.1060.desc.en:
After establishing contact with the [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we detected a decaying corpse of one of their kind in [fromfrom.GetName]. The remains are withered and frozen after prolonged exposure to open space.

We postulate that this carcass is what initially attracted other members of their species; perhaps they had been searching for a lost member of their [from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]. This is a rare opportunity to study the biology of a [from.GetSpaceFaunaName] that has died of natural causes in the void.

grand_archive.1065.desc.zh: 对[contact_system.GetName]的[met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName]尸体所进行的尸检已经完成。我们从遗骸中提取了一个保存完好的生物样本，它为我们提供了对其生理结构的独特见解。
grand_archive.1065.desc.en: The autopsy on the [met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName] corpse in [contact_system.GetName] is complete. We have recovered a well-preserved biological specimen from within the remains that provides unique insight into their physiology.

grand_archive.1069.desc.zh:
我们与一艘来自[from.GetName]的奇怪改装太空船取得了联系。$NAME_BoneShip_desc$

在天真地接受了我们的谈判邀请后，这位驾驶员被立即[GetExecuted]。我们已经夺取了他的古怪飞船，并将其加入了我们的军事序列。我们在他的个人物品中发现了一本有用的猎人工具指南。
grand_archive.1069.desc.en:
We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. $NAME_BoneShip_desc$

After naively accepting our invitation to parlay, the pilot was summarily [GetExecuted]. We have claimed their peculiar ship and added it to our military ranks. We have discovered a useful hunter's field guide among their personal effects.

grand_archive.1070.desc.zh:
我们收到了来自[from.GetName]的一艘奇怪改装的星际飞船的联络。$NAME_BoneShip_desc$

他们正在所有频率上向我们打招呼。
grand_archive.1070.desc.en:
We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. $NAME_BoneShip_desc$

They are hailing us on all frequencies.

grand_archive.1075.a.reply.zh:
我是$NAME_PrimalHunter$，我在这些恒星系中狩猎多年。我正在寻找新的猎物，而你们的人民似乎是能干的追踪者。

我的动机很简单：狩猎的快感。
grand_archive.1075.a.reply.en:
I am $NAME_PrimalHunter$. I have hunted within these systems for many years. I seek new quarry, and your people seem to be capable trackers.

My motivation is simple: the thrill of the hunt.

grand_archive.1075.b.zh: 你船上的那个颅骨是什么？
grand_archive.1075.b.en: What is that skull on your ship?

grand_archive.1075.b.reply.zh: 它是同类中最后的，它奋力抵抗。
grand_archive.1075.b.reply.en: It was the last of its kind. It put up quite a fight.

grand_archive.1075.c.en: How long have you been watching us?

grand_archive.1075.c.reply.zh:
很明显，你们的人还有很多东西要学。

一个优秀的猎手可以长时间潜行追踪猎物。真正的致命，需要在开枪前保持隐形。我在阴影中度过的时间并不重要，重要的是我选择何时现身。
grand_archive.1075.c.reply.en:
It is obvious that your people have much to learn.

A good hunter can track their quarry for as long as required in perfect stealth. To be truly deadly, one must remain unseen until the shot is fired. The time I have spent in the shadows is of no concern, my choice to reveal myself is what counts.

grand_archive.1075.d.reply.zh:
我并不寻求在猎场上的竞争。虽然我不愿分享领地，但我宁愿与你的猎手并肩作战，而不愿为同一猎物大打出手。

无论你追踪什么，我都会杀死。
grand_archive.1075.d.reply.en:
I seek no competition in the field. Though I am loath to share territory, I would rather work alongside your hunters than fight over the same prey.

Whatever you track, I will kill.

grand_archive.1075.desc.zh:
瑟里兹低沉的声音干涩而沙哑，仿佛已经好几周没有说话了。此人直言不讳，保持着冷静的眼神接触，既显得尊重，又让人感到一丝威慑。

作为一名猎物收藏家，要让我印象深刻可不容易。你们做到了。

我愿意加入你们的狩猎队伍，但前提是我们的合作将基于便利和相互学习。
grand_archive.1075.desc.en:
The brooding Ceriz's voice is dry and cracking, as if they had not spoken in weeks. Their manner is direct and they maintain stoic eye contact in a manner that feels in equal part respectful and intimidating.

As a trophy hunter, it takes a lot to impress me. Your people have.

I am willing to join your hunting parties with the understanding that our partnership will be one of convenience and mutual instruction.

grand_archive.1075.hire_tt.zh: $NAME_PrimalHunter$作为一名领袖加入我们帝国。
grand_archive.1075.hire_tt.en: $NAME_PrimalHunter$ joins our empire as a Leader.

grand_archive.1080.desc.zh:
一艘独立的星际研究船联系了我们位于[from.GetName]的恒星基地。这艘船配备了一系列捕获装置和分析工具，专门用于捕获和研究太空生物。

他们正在所有频率上向我们打招呼。
grand_archive.1080.desc.en:
We have been contacted by an independent research vessel at our starbase in [from.GetName]. Outfitted with an array of snaring devices and analytical tools, this ship is specifically adapted for the capture and examination of spaceborne life.

They are hailing us on all frequencies.

grand_archive.1085.a.reply.zh:
抱歉，我有点儿太着急了。

我叫茹克，是一名专门研究太空兽群的野外实地考察员。我和我的团队收集有关迁徙模式、身体组成和星系生物多样性的数据。

我从小就喜欢动物。我无论去哪里都带着我的宠物芙芙。
grand_archive.1085.a.reply.en:
Sorry, I'm getting ahead of myself.

My name is Ruuk. I'm a researcher specializing in the field study of spaceborne fauna. My team and I gather data about migration patterns, body composition, and galactic-level biodiversity.

Personally, I've loved animals since I was a chick. I never go anywhere without Fuluff.

grand_archive.1085.b.reply.zh:
整个星系我最爱的小朋友！

我本来想把它展示在屏幕上，但它现在睡着了。在我的家乡行星，我们把这种生物当宠物饲养，我上次回去的时候领养了它。真是太可爱了：听到小蹄子在金属地板上哒哒地跑，啃我的羽毛的样子，还有两只小眼睛之间那撮毛。我相信它也会让你着迷的，当……如果我们开始合作的话。
grand_archive.1085.b.reply.en:
Only my favorite guy in the whole galaxy!

I'd show him on-screen, but he's asleep right now. On my home planet, we breed this species as pets and I adopted him on my last visit. He's just the cutest; hearing his little hooves skitter on the metal floors, the way he nibbles on my feathers, the tuft of wool that sticks up between his little eyes. I'm sure he'll win you over too when... if we start working together.

grand_archive.1085.c.reply.zh: 我们追踪的一份样本出现了异常行为，于是我们追寻它的踪迹。在那里，我们发现您的科研团队正在与我们的研究对象互动。您对这些生物的细致照料体现了对太空生命的真正尊重，这激励我去了解您的研究，而您的研究更是让我印象深刻。我一直在寻找志同道合的同行。
grand_archive.1085.c.reply.en: One of the specimens we were tracking showed some anomalous behavior, so we followed its trail. There we found your scientific team engaging with our subject. The great care you took with the creatures showed a real respect for spaceborne life, and that inspired me to look into your research, which impressed me even more. I'm always looking for like-minded peers in the field.

grand_archive.1085.d.reply.zh:
说实话，自由科学研究并不能可靠地提供收入。我坚信自己的工作，但花费一生寻找资金会占用太多时间，无法专注于核心科学本身。

加入[root.GetName]，我将能够将所有时间投入到我最擅长的领域：研究太空生命。我将获得更多资源，并能与贵国现有的科学团队合作，共同实现我们的目标。
grand_archive.1085.d.reply.en:
Honestly, freelance scientific research is not a reliable source of income. I believe in my work, but spending my life looking for funding simply takes too much time away from the core science itself.

By joining the [root.GetName], I would be able to commit all of my time to do what I do best: studying spaceborne life. I would gain access to greater resources and could collaborate with your existing science team to further our mutual goals.

grand_archive.1085.desc.zh:
茹克的眼睛不停地闪烁，注视着一个小巧的手持设备，她那探究和分析的目光让人印象深刻。即使在向我们打招呼时，她也似乎在做着笔记。尽管如此，她的态度还是友好而专业，只是略带疏离。

我发现自己对太空生物的兴趣并非孤例。我研究了[root.GetName]正在进行的研究，它简直是启迪人心。我非常希望能加入你们的科学部门，为这些努力贡献力量。当然，如果你们愿意的话。
grand_archive.1085.desc.en:
Inquisitive and analytical, Ruuk's eyes flicker constantly to a small, handheld device. Even as she greets us, she appears to be taking notes. Despite that, her manner is cordial and professional, if slightly detached.

I see that I'm not alone in my interest in spaceborne creatures. I have studied the research the [root.GetName] has been conducting and it is positively illuminating. I would love nothing more than to aid these efforts as part of your science department. If you'll have me, of course.

grand_archive.1085.hire_tt.zh: $NAME_PrimalRancher$作为一名领袖加入我们帝国。
grand_archive.1085.hire_tt.en: $NAME_PrimalRancher$ joins our empire as a Leader.

grand_archive.1100.desc.zh:
我们探测到来自未知空间的大量古怪电磁波。

初步分析表明，这些波动与虚空虫的通讯信号相似，但更加不规则，振幅也高得多。我们将对此进行进一步调查。
grand_archive.1100.desc.en:
We have detected a huge number of peculiar electromagnetic waves coming from uncharted space.

Initial analysis indicates a resemblance to Voidworm communication signals, albeit more irregular and with a greatly elevated amplitude. This will be investigated further.

grand_archive.1105.desc.zh:
我们已经探测到这些动物般的尖叫声的来源：一个隐藏的恒星系，里面住满了虚空虫，位于[frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]附近。

这个恒星系中的虚空虫与我们之前遇到的不同。这些生物发生了变异；没有形成三头虫，单个成熟的个体正在进行的行为，只能被描述为狂暴的交配狂欢。

这令人担忧：这种非寄生行为意味着这个虫群可以独立繁殖，无需行星宿主。
grand_archive.1105.desc.en:
We have detected the source of these animalistic screeches; a hidden system populated by Voidworm near [frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName].

The Voidworms in this system are unlike those we have encountered previously. These creatures are mutated; there are no troikas formed and the individual mature specimens are engaging in what can only be described as a violent mating frenzy.

This is concerning: this non-parasitic behavior means this hive can breed independently without the need for planet-borne hosts.

grand_archive.1105.desc_2.zh: 我们必须准备好自己的防线。

grand_archive.1105.desc_no_homicidal.zh: 如果任由这种变异物种不受控制地蔓延，它可能会彻底破坏星系生态系统的平衡。根据它们不断升级的侵略行为，我们认为这些生物正在准备对[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]发动攻击。
grand_archive.1105.desc_no_homicidal.en: If this variant species were allowed to spread unchecked, it could upset the balance of the galactic ecosystem entirely. Based on their mounting aggression, we believe that these creatures are preparing for an assault on [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName].

grand_archive.1165.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.1165.desc.common$和整个星系的生态平衡得到了保障。

$frenzied_voidworms_killed.desc.common$
grand_archive.1165.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.1165.desc.common$ and the galactic ecosystem has been secured.

$frenzied_voidworms_killed.desc.common$

grand_archive.1170.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.1170.desc.common$和整个星系的生态平衡得到了保障。

$frenzied_voidworms_killed.desc.common$
grand_archive.1170.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.1170.desc.common$ and the galactic ecosystem has been secured.

$frenzied_voidworms_killed.desc.common$

grand_archive.1180.desc.zh:
在消灭了巢穴附近的一窝虚空虫之后，我们发现这些生物发生了独特的变异。

它们似乎能够以非寄生方式繁殖，并且处于高度攻击状态，这解释了它们非自然的强大和耐久性。

幸运的是，我们保留了一个它们的巢穴作为战利品。在我们控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而不会冒它们不受控制地蔓延到整个星系的风险。
grand_archive.1180.desc.en:
After eliminating a clutch of Voidworms near their nests, we discovered that these creatures had undergone a unique mutation.

It seems that they were able to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner and were in a heightened state of aggression, which would explain their unnatural strength and durability.

Fortunately, we preserved one of their nests as a trophy. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

grand_archive.1185.desc.zh:
我们已经得知，威胁我们殖民地的变异虚空虫已被消灭。

这是一个意外但令人欣慰的结果。我们可以安心的是，这些生物将不再对我们的恒星系构成威胁。
grand_archive.1185.desc.en:
We have learned that the mutated Voidworms threatening our colony have been eliminated.

An unexpected, but welcome conclusion. We can take solace in the fact that these creatures shall no longer antagonize our systems.

grand_archive.1200.desc.zh:
狂暴的虚空虫正在攻击[frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]！

它们的侵略性已经达到顶峰，目前它们的主虫群正在直奔[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]而去。

我们认为它们不会留下任何幸存者。
grand_archive.1200.desc.en:
The frenzied Voidworms are attacking [frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]!

Their aggression has risen to a fever pitch, and the current trajectory of their main swarm is heading directly for [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName].

We do not believe they intend on leaving any survivors.

grand_archive.1205.a.en: Now is the time to rebuild.

grand_archive.1205.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.1205.desc_common$

面对这场悲剧，我们别无选择，只能继续前进，从错误中吸取教训。
grand_archive.1205.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.1205.desc_common$

We have no recourse in the face of this tragedy except to live on and learn from our mistakes.

grand_archive.1205.desc.gestalt.zh:
$grand_archive.1205.desc_common$

我们主巢的陷落对于[event_target:victim_country.GetName]来说是一次重大的打击，但我们必须学会接受。
grand_archive.1205.desc.gestalt.en:
$grand_archive.1205.desc_common$

The loss of our primary hive is a blow to [event_target:victim_country.GetName], but we live on.

grand_archive.1210.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]发现的变异虚空虫已被消灭。[avenged_homeworld.GetName]的毁灭得到了报复。

我们保留了这些奇怪变异生物的巢穴中最大的那一个。在我们控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而不会冒着它们不受控制地蔓延到整个星系的风险。

这样，我们一度失去的世界依旧能够传承下来。
grand_archive.1210.desc.en:
The mutated Voidworms discovered in [From.GetName] have been eliminated. The destruction of [avenged_homeworld.GetName] has been avenged.

The largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

In this way, the legacy of our lost world will live on.

grand_archive.1220.a.zh: 对于舰队来说是备受欢迎的补充。
grand_archive.1220.a.en: A welcome addition to the fleets.

grand_archive.1220.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.1220.desc.common$和整个星系的生态平衡得到了保障。

$grand_archive.1220.desc.common_2$
grand_archive.1220.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.1220.desc.common$ and the galactic ecosystem has been secured.

$grand_archive.1220.desc.common_2$

grand_archive.1220.tt.zh: 所有狂暴的虚空虫舰队都将由你的帝国控制
grand_archive.1220.tt.en: All Frenzied Voidworm fleets are added to your empire's control

grand_archive.2000.desc.zh: 传感器检测到[This.System.GetName]星系中存在一个向整个星系发出原始信号的物体。这些相同的信号模式也曾在来自未知区域的长程扫描仪上被记录到。虽然目前尚不清楚这些信号是否具有意图，但需要进一步调查。
grand_archive.2000.desc.en: Sensors indicate a presence in the [This.System.GetName] system that is sending rudimentary signals across the galaxy. These same patterns have been registered on long-range scanners originating from parts unknown. Though it is not clear whether these signals are intentional in nature, it warrants further investigation.

grand_archive.2005.desc.zh: 我们发现，这些远距离信号源于一种简单的太空生物，我们将其命名为“$NAME_Voidworms$”。似乎整个星系都充满了这种生物。根据信号的不同波长，我们确定这些生物在达到最终成熟之前会经历多个生长阶段。虽然它们表面上看起来并不具有攻击性，但它们的交流模式表明它们在星系范围内进行着协调。
grand_archive.2005.desc.en: We have discovered that the far-reaching signals originate from a simple spaceborne organism we have taken to calling "$NAME_Voidworms$". It appears that the galaxy is riddled with these creatures. From the varying wavelengths of the signals, we have determined that the creatures develop through several stages of growth before reaching final maturity. Though they do not appear outwardly aggressive, their patterns of communication indicate coordination on a galactic scale.

grand_archive.2005.desc.primal_calling.zh: 这些寄生生物天生无法繁殖，必须依赖从星球上的宿主获取养分。为了让“虚空虫”产生三头虫成长必不可少的激素，它们必须从有人居住的星球上获取足够的有机物质。作为雌雄同体的生物，它们选择伴侣主要取决于互补的物理特征和相似的体型。
grand_archive.2005.desc.primal_calling.en: These parasitic creatures lack the natural ability to reproduce and must rely on the acquisition of planet-borne hosts. Sufficient organic matter must be harvested from inhabited planets for the "Voidworms" to produce a crucial hormone within their mating trios, known as "troikas". As hermaphroditic creatures, the selection of partners is determined primarily by complementary physical traits and comparable size.

grand_archive.2015.a.zh: 利用他们的生育能力来满足我们自己的需求。
grand_archive.2015.a.en: Harness their fertility for our own needs.

grand_archive.2015.desc.zh:
虚空虫以三只为一组交配，这种形态被称为“三头虫”。这些生物的一生都被绑定在永无止境的交配仪式中。然而，它们需要外部生物宿主才能繁殖后代。

它们是寄生虫。

虚空虫成熟后，会在其生殖系统内发育出一窝囊肿。这些保护性囊肿包含高腐蚀性的配子，当与三头虫中的其他配子结合时，可以被发送到具有合适生物量的星球上，以产下更多幼虫。它们的宿主无法在这一过程中存活。我们已经看到证据表明，虚空虫会协调它们的轰炸，以便在整个星系中维持可持续数量的可用宿主。

无论如何，我们相信我们可以利用它们的生殖酶的力量来造福我们自己。我们甚至可以对它们的繁殖活动产生免疫力。
grand_archive.2015.desc.en:
Voidworms mate in groups of three, a formation known as a "Troika." These creatures become bound for life in a never-ending mating ritual. However, they require an external biological host to produce offspring.

They are parasites.

Upon reaching maturity, each Voidworm develops a clutch of cysts within their reproductive systems. These protective cysts contain highly caustic gametes that, when combined with others in a Troika, can be sent to planets with suitable biomass in order to give birth to more of their nymphs. Their hosts do not survive this process. We've seen evidence that the Voidworms coordinate their bombardments so as to maintain a sustainable amount of viable hosts throughout the galaxy.

In any case, we believe that we can harness the power of their reproductive enzymes to our own benefit. We may even develop an immunity to their reproductive efforts.

grand_archive.2053.desc.zh:
虚空虫的最后一个家园星系已经被摧毁，它们物种也已灭绝。

我们不再需要担心它们的寄生攻击。
grand_archive.2053.desc.en:
The last of the Voidworm home systems has been destroyed, and their species has been eradicated.

We need no longer concern ourselves with their parasitic bombardments.

grand_archive.2054.desc.zh:
我们已经铲除了一个虚空虫的母星系。

它们将无法再利用这些产卵地来抚育幼虫。
grand_archive.2054.desc.en:
We have eradicated a Voidworm home system.

They will no longer be able to make use of these spawning grounds to raise their young.

grand_archive.2103.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有虚空虫不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[this.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
grand_archive.2103.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that all Voidworms are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Until they are eliminated or leave our space of their own accord, the [this.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law.

grand_archive.2105.desc.zh:
一支虚空虫舰队已进入[from.GetName]星系内的我们的空间。作为[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员，我们有法律义务立即处决在我们边界内的任何虚空虫。

[this.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直到虚空虫离开我们的空间或被消灭。
grand_archive.2105.desc.en:
A fleet of Voidworms has entered our space in the [from.GetName] system. As a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member, we are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Voidworms present within our borders.

The [this.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law until the Voidworms have either departed our space or are exterminated.

grand_archive.2107.desc.zh: 虚空虫一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重违反了星系法中关于$resolution_voidworm_eradication$决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[this.GetName]实施制裁。
grand_archive.2107.desc.en: The continued Voidworm presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant Breach of Galactic Law under the $resolution_voidworm_eradication$ resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [this.GetName].

grand_archive.2195.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对我们的殖民者以及所有生命都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫体内有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，在那里它们会本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$
grand_archive.2195.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. These nymphs contain a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$

grand_archive.2195.desc.rocks.zh:
$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对所有本地动物群都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫通常以小行星为食，以获取珍贵的金属，但它们也会伺机捕食我们脆弱的[this.GetColonistPlural]。每个幼虫体内都含有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，并本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$
grand_archive.2195.desc.rocks.en:
$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly to all native fauna. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. The nymphs, which normally feed on asteroids for their precious metals, opportunistically hunt and feed upon our vulnerable [this.GetColonistPlural].  Each hatchling contains a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend to the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$

grand_archive.2310.desc.default.zh:
星系中$NAME_Voidworms$的数量已达到临界值，它们的习性正在发生显著变化。

它们生命周期中原本会放任宿主物种繁衍一段时间的阶段已打破，它们似乎不再顾及这些产卵地是否能够维持可持续性。

我们所有殖民地都已进入红色警戒状态。在任何星系中发现$NAME_Voidworms$，都应极其谨慎地应对。

一场泛星系级的繁殖狂潮正在向我们袭来。
grand_archive.2310.desc.default.en:
The population of $NAME_Voidworms$ in the galaxy has reached a critical mass. Their behavior is noticeably changing.

The typical stage of their lifecycle where host populations would be spared has been disrupted. There seems to be no further regard for the sustainability of their spawning grounds.

All of our colonies are on red alert. The presence of $NAME_Voidworms$ in any system should be met with extreme caution.

A breeding frenzy on the galactic scale is upon us.

grand_archive.2310.desc.nocontact.zh: 整个星系都在疯传一个令人不安的消息：一种此前不为人知的太空兽群“虚空虫”正在疯狂繁殖。据说，对于那些防御系统不够完善的恒星系来说，这些生物构成了巨大的威胁。我们所有的殖民地现在都已经进入了最高警戒状态。
grand_archive.2310.desc.nocontact.en: Disturbing reports are being intercepted across the galaxy that a previously unknown species of space fauna known as "Voidworms" have entered a reproductive frenzy. These creatures are reportedly a significant threat to planets without adequate system defenses. All of our colonies are now on red alert.

grand_archive.2310.desc.tech.zh:
$grand_archive.2310.desc.default$

我们之前针对这些寄生虫建立的免疫力，现在已经不再像以前那样有效了。我们需要重新开始研究。
grand_archive.2310.desc.tech.en:
$grand_archive.2310.desc.default$

The immunity we have previously developed against these parasites is no longer working to the same degree. We will need to go back to the drawing board.

grand_archive.2400.desc.zh: 我们在对抗$NAME_Voidworms$的行动中，由于改良了维护协议，舰队支援力度提升，意外获得了大量额外的零件。我们有机会将这些材料投入到提高新舰队的短期生产中。
grand_archive.2400.desc.en: Our increased fleet support in efforts against the $NAME_Voidworms$ has yielded an unexpected windfall of additional components due to improved maintenance protocols. We have an opportunity to invest these materials into improving our short-term production of new fleets.

grand_archive.2405.desc.default.zh: 我们持之以恒抵御虚空虫威胁的准备工作，激励了新一代的指挥官。[this.GetName]的经验丰富的公民选择贡献他们的才能，以消除这个全星系的威胁。
grand_archive.2405.desc.default.en: Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has inspired a new generation of Commanders. Experienced citizens of [this.GetName] have chosen to offer their talents toward the elimination of this galactic threat.

grand_archive.2405.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们针对虚空虫威胁进行了持续的准备工作，使我们能够生产出额外的指挥官级领袖节点。由于我们为舰队提供额外的支援，这些战斗型节点能够获得更多资源，以促进其快速融入我们的军事行动之中。
grand_archive.2405.desc.gestalt.en: Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has allowed us to produce additional Commander-class leadership nodes. By providing additional support to our fleets, these Combat-focused nodes have received increased resources to facilitate their swift integration into our military efforts.

grand_archive.2405.tt.zh: 刷新$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$，并添加3位额外指挥官，每位指挥官额外提升一级。
grand_archive.2405.tt.en: Refresh our $RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$ and add 3 additional Commanders with an extra level.

grand_archive.2410.desc.default.zh: 驻扎在[random_shipyard.GetName]的工程师开发了一种新的舰船防御概念蓝图。[random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap]在对抗虚空虫的战斗中进行例行维修时，[random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe]灵机一动，想出了一个可以提高舰船坚固性的新组件。该想法提交给我们的研究部门后，我们认为它具有巨大的潜力。
grand_archive.2410.desc.default.en: An engineer stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has developed a new conceptual blueprint for ship defenses. [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap] was carrying out routine repairs in the fight against the Voidworms when [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe] came up with an idea for a new component that would increase the hardiness of our vessels. After the idea was presented to our research department, we believe that it has great potential.

grand_archive.2410.desc.gestalt.zh: 驻扎在[random_shipyard.GetName]的维修[root.GetIndividualName]激发了新的研究观点，能够改进舰船防御。在例行维修期间的一次误操作中，该[root.GetIndividualName]使用了一种奇特的材料和方法组合，创造了一种新的防护组件。经过对研究可能性进行论证，这一意外发现经过改进后可以展现出巨大潜力。
grand_archive.2410.desc.gestalt.en: A repair [root.GetIndividualName] stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has inspired new research insights to improve ship defenses. After a miscommunication during routine repairs, the [root.GetIndividualName] used a peculiar combination of methods and materials to create a new protective component. After investigating the research possibilities, this accidental discovery has shown great potential once refined.

grand_archive.2420.desc.zh:
在履行[infected_leader.GetHisHer]的职责期间，[infected_leader.GetName]感染了活跃的虚空虫孢子。新的若虫很快就会出现并摧毁它们的宿主。

这可能是一场徒劳的战斗，但医务人员推测，在幼虫完全融入[infected_leader.GetHisHer]的神经系统之前，可能可以将其取出。这是一场风险很大的手术，但[infected_leader.GetName]似乎愿意让我们尝试。
grand_archive.2420.desc.en:
In the performance of [infected_leader.GetHisHer] duties, [infected_leader.GetName] [infected_leader.GetHasHave] become infected with active Voidworm spores. It will not be long until new nymphs emerge and destroy their host.

It could be a lost cause, but the medical staff speculate it may be possible to extract the larva before they have fully integrated into [infected_leader.GetHisHer] nervous system. It's a risky procedure, but [infected_leader.GetName] seems willing to let us try.

grand_archive.2425.a.default.tt.zh: -1所有所属殖民地内有机体人口
grand_archive.2425.a.default.tt.en: -1 Organic Pop on each owned colony

grand_archive.2425.a.robot.tt.zh: 所有未受感染的行星获得$@infected_devastation|0$破坏度

grand_archive.2425.b.tt.zh: 我们的殖民地附近可能会出现更多虚空虫的若虫！
grand_archive.2425.b.tt.en: Additional voidworm nymphs may appear near our colonies!

grand_archive.2425.desc.default.zh: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$必须赶在这些逃亡者威胁到我们所有人之前尽快处理掉。
grand_archive.2425.desc.default.en: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$ Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger us all.

grand_archive.2425.desc.gestalt.zh: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$必须赶在这些逃亡者威胁到我们的大集体意识之前尽快处理掉。
grand_archive.2425.desc.gestalt.en: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$ Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger the greater collective.

grand_archive.2425.desc.robot.zh: 用于分析的受感染动植物样本被错误地当作普通食物进行处理。由于这个错误，大量有机物被虚空虫的寄生虫污染，必须进行处理。
grand_archive.2425.desc.robot.en: Samples of infected flora and fauna marked for analysis were somehow erroneously processed as typical foodstuffs. Following this error, a large quantity of organic matter has been contaminated by Voidworm parasites and must now be disposed of.

grand_archive.2425.desc.rogue.zh: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$必须赶在这些逃亡者威胁到我们其他的活体陈设之前尽快处理掉。
grand_archive.2425.desc.rogue.en: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$ Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger our other bio-trophies.

grand_archive.2430.desc.zh:
虽然清除感染者被认为是最明智的行动方针，但许多士兵却难以执行命令。尽管虚空虫的寄生虫危险性很高，但许多士兵仍然无法为了更大的利益而消灭自己的同胞。

必须采取措施阻止虚空虫感染在我们的殖民地蔓延。我们可以尝试将清除过程的某些环节自动化，从而减少对士兵的需求。或者，我们可以发起短暂的宣传活动，宣传我们清除行动的道德标准，并重申其必要性。
grand_archive.2430.desc.en:
While it is agreed that purging the infected is the wisest course of action, many soldiers are struggling to carry out orders. Despite the danger of the Voidworm parasite, many are simply unable to eliminate their fellow citizens for the greater good.

Something must be done to prevent the Voidworm infection from spreading through our colonies. We may be able to automate certain parts of the purging process so as to require fewer soldiers. Alternatively, we can launch a short publicity campaign to promote the ethical standards of our purging efforts and reaffirm their necessity.

grand_archive.2440.desc.zh: 我们对虚空虫瘟疫的治疗方法的探索，也促进了其他生物学领域的平行研究。虽然寄生虫目前仍是我们的首要任务，但这一新的突破在未来研究中具有巨大潜力。
grand_archive.2440.desc.en: Our search for the cure to the Voidworm plague has allowed research in other biological fields to progress in parallel. While the parasites remain our current priority, this new breakthrough has tremendous potential for future study.

grand_archive.2445.a.default.zh: 对毫无察觉的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]进行测试。

grand_archive.2445.c.zh: 不能做有违道德的测试。

grand_archive.2445.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.2445.desc.common$然而，如果能在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]参与者身上进行早期活体测试，我们的研究进度将会快得多。

撇开伦理考量不谈，为了更大的利益，绕过某些安全措施或许是明智之举。
grand_archive.2445.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.2445.desc.common$ However, our research could progress at a much quicker pace with early-stage live testing on [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] participants.

Ethical considerations aside, it may be wiser to bypass certain safety measures for the sake of the greater good.

grand_archive.2445.desc.gestalt.zh:
$grand_archive.2445.desc.common$然而，测试过程非常耗时，主要原因是需要不断地将未分配的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]作为测试对象。如果[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以简单地重新分配成为测试对象，那么治愈方案的开发速度将会加快。

然而，这种做法会对整个集体造成其他影响，重新分配的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]将导致其先前角色陷入混乱。
grand_archive.2445.desc.gestalt.en:
$grand_archive.2445.desc.common$ However, the testing process is time-consuming, primarily due to the constant need for idle [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] as subjects. If [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] could simply be reassigned to become test subjects, the cure would develop at a faster rate.

The consequences would be felt elsewhere throughout the collective, with reassigned [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] leaving their previous role in disarray.

grand_archive.2450.a.en: We have no time for this.

grand_archive.2450.desc.zh:
我们发现了虚空虫繁殖周期中的一个规律，这可能在合成治疗虚空虫疫的药物方面带来重大突破。

为了验证这一假设，必须从一只野生$voidworms_titan$中采集其生殖腺进行分析。至关重要的是，这只$voidworms_titan$必须在轰炸星球的过程中被杀死，才能保存活跃的生殖配子。
grand_archive.2450.desc.en:
We have discovered a pattern in the reproduction cycle of Voidworms that could lead to a huge breakthrough in synthesizing a cure to the Voidworm Plague.

To confirm this hypothesis, the reproductive glands of a wild $voidworms_titan$ must be harvested for analysis. Crucially, this $voidworms_titan$ must be killed while bombarding a planet in order to preserve the active reproductive gametes.

grand_archive.2455.desc.zh:
从可育的“三头虫”形态的虚空虫身上取回的腺体揭示关于它们生殖循环的新信息。

每一只处于繁殖拥抱中的虚空虫都会将遗传物质均匀分布，有效地形成一个全新的有机体，深锁于交配仪式中直到死亡。

我们可以利用这些展现出遗传延展性的过程来对付他们。
grand_archive.2455.desc.en:
The glands recovered from the fertile Voidworm Troika revealed new information about their reproductive cycles.

Locked in a mating ritual until death, each of the three Voidworms in reproductive embrace distribute their genetic material equally between themselves, effectively becoming a new organism entirely.

We can use these processes of genetic malleability against them.

grand_archive.2500.desc.default.zh: 我们终于研制出了彻底根治虚空虫寄生感染的方法。从此以后，我们的殖民地再也不用担心那些可怕的孢子袭击了，星系中这些虫子的存在也不再是我们需要操心的问题了。
grand_archive.2500.desc.default.en: We have completed the development of an ultimate cure to the Voidworm parasitic infection. Our colonies are no longer susceptible to their spore bombardments, and we need no longer be concerned about their presence in the galaxy.

grand_archive.2500.desc.tech.zh:
$grand_archive.2500.desc.default$

我们确信，这一次，我们开发的治疗方法已经能够防范他们生物学上的任何未来突变。
grand_archive.2500.desc.tech.en:
$grand_archive.2500.desc.default$

We are certain that, this time, the cure we have developed is safeguarded against any future mutation of their biology.

grand_archive.2800.desc.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]发现的异常小行星似乎具有感性。靠近这种物体的轨道是非常危险的，在我们有更多的了解之前，建议科研船立刻远离受其影响的恒星系。
grand_archive.2800.desc.en: The irregular asteroid we encountered in [This.System.GetName] appears to be sentient in nature. Approaching the orbit of such objects is highly dangerous, and Science Ships are advised to leave affected systems immediately until we know more about these entities.

grand_archive.2900.a.zh: 我们应该进一步研究这些生物。
grand_archive.2900.a.en: We should study these creatures further.

grand_archive.2900.b.zh: 伏击猎食者吗。全部摧毁。

grand_archive.2900.desc.zh:
我们发现了一种居住在小行星外壳内的太空生物，将其命名为岩居兽。它们是一种可以埋伏数年只为给猎物致命一击的伏击掠食者。它们极度危险，能吞下整艘舰船，所以在探索那些未调查的小行星带时务必格外小心。

好消息是，它们的数量非常稀少，而且无性繁殖流程可能要花费上百年。
grand_archive.2900.desc.en:
We have discovered a spaceborne organism that shelters inside of asteroids. Known to us as "Cutholoids", these creatures are ambush predators that are capable of lying in wait for several years to capture their prey. Capable of engulfing entire ships, we should be very careful when approaching unsurveyed asteroid belts as they are found to be extremely dangerous.

The good news is that they appear to be quite rare, and their asexual reproductive processes can take hundreds of years.

grand_archive.2900.desc.primal_calling.zh: 我们认为这些生物会根据大小和矿物成分来选择用哪颗小星星来作为巢穴。虽然我们遇到的第一个样本对[GetCommonMineral]具有生物学偏好，但每个个体很可能随着时间的推移根据其当前环境发展出不同的适应性。扫描显示这种金属的痕迹遍布宿主小行星，以及“岩居兽”本身的神经系统和消化道。
grand_archive.2900.desc.primal_calling.en: We believe that the creatures select their asteroids based on mineral composition as well as size. While the first specimen we encountered possesses a biological preference for [GetCommonMineral], it is likely each individual develops this adaptation over time based on their current environment. Scans show that traces of this metal are present throughout the host asteroid, as well as within the nervous system and digestive tract of the "Cutholoid" Itself.

grand_archive.2905.desc.zh:
岩居兽的外壳并不只是矿物而已，其中还有生物纤维补强。这些纤维一直都在生长，这种外壳中估计包含了超过一半的生物质。

当岩居兽长得住不下小行星时，他们会寻找下一个新家并再次开始整合流程。虽然它们通常具有很强的领地意识，但在极佳的外壳候选品的轨道上也会出现多只岩居兽，其中最大的一只将占据这颗新的小行星，而其他个体将按大小排序，和平地交换外壳。通过这种方式，它们居住的小行星往往会交换十几手之多。

最终的结果是，最小的小行星会因为交换频繁反而得到了最多的生物强化。这些样品具有重要的科学价值。
grand_archive.2905.desc.en:
The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. These fibers never stop growing, and the composition of some shells is estimated to be over fifty percent biomass.
