When a Cutholoid grows too large for its asteroid, it will seek another home and begin the integration process again. While they are normally highly territorial, multiple Cutholoids have been observed in orbit of a prime shell candidate. The largest of the creatures will occupy the fresh asteroid, while others will order themselves by size and peacefully swap with the next in line. In this way, the asteroids they inhabit have often been occupied by dozens of previous organisms.

The end result is that the smallest asteroids have the highest amount of biological reinforcement, as they have been exchanged most often. These samples contain significant scientific value.

grand_archive.3011.desc.zh:
我们的一艘科研船在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]调查一颗奇怪的小行星时失去了联系。

在他们最后失踪的地点探测到了微弱的应急信号，我如果要找回这艘失踪的舰船就需要进一步调查。
grand_archive.3011.desc.en:
Contact has been lost with our Science Ship while investigating a strange asteroid in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].

We are detecting weak emergency signals from their last known location, and should investigate further if we intend to recover the missing vessel.

grand_archive.3012.desc.zh:
在[from.solar_system.GetName]进行例行探索的过程中发现了另一个奇怪的小行星状生物。

我们应该避免让科研船接近这个星系，直到我们对这个危险的物体有更多的了解为止。
grand_archive.3012.desc.en:
Another of the strange asteroidal creatures have been discovered in [from.solar_system.GetName] during routine exploration.

We should avoid this system with our Science Ships until we know more about these dangerous objects.

grand_archive.3016.desc.default.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]中的小行星只是一只栖居在里面的巨大有机体的外壳。

我们成功地将其摧毁，并找回了[this.GetName]。此后调查小行星的时候可得小心了。

可能还有其他的这种生物潜藏于此，等待着不小心的猎物。
grand_archive.3016.desc.default.en:
The asteroid in [fromfrom.GetName] served only as a shell for a massive organism living inside.

We have successfully destroyed it and recovered [this.GetName]. Caution should be taken in further investigations of asteroids.

More of these creatures may be out there, lying in wait of easy prey.

grand_archive.3016.desc.leader_killed.zh: $grand_archive.3016.desc.default$不幸的是，[leader.GetName]遭受到了一些不可修复的损伤。

grand_archive.3018.desc.zh:
我们在[current_system.GetName]失踪的科研船回来了！

[leader.GetName]发回的报道称，他们被一个藏在小行星中的太空实体整个吞下，最后在船体就要承受不住的时候意外地被吐了出来。似乎有什么别的东西把这个生物吓了一跳让我们侥幸逃脱。

在有更多的认知之前，探索这片小行星带可要多加小心了。
grand_archive.3018.desc.en:
Our Science Ship lost in [current_system.GetName] has returned!

Reports have come in from [leader.GetName] that they had been swallowed whole by a spaceborne entity hiding inside of an asteroid, and were at the limits of hull integrity before being unexpectedly ejected to safety. It appears something else has surprised the creature before we could intervene.

We should be cautious in our approach of certain asteroid belts until we can learn more.

grand_archive.3018.name.en: From the Belly of the Beast

grand_archive.3020.desc.zh: [from.GetName]的应急通讯戛然而止。我们只能相信[from.GetName]科研船已经永远离我们而去了。
grand_archive.3020.desc.en: The emergency transmissions from [from.GetName] have ceased. We can only assume the science ship [from.GetName] has been lost for good.

grand_archive.3103.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有岩居兽不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
grand_archive.3103.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that Cutholoids are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Once discovered, these creatures must be destroyed, else the [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law.

grand_archive.3105.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内发现了一只岩居兽。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]将其指定为危险害兽之后，成员国有法律义务立即处决在边界内的所有岩居兽。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直到岩居兽离开我们的星系或被消灭为止。
grand_archive.3105.desc.en:
A Cutholoid has been discovered in the [from.GetName] system. Following their designation as a dangerous pest, all [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Cutholoids present within their borders.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law until the Cutholoid has been exterminated or otherwise driven from our systems.

grand_archive.3107.desc.zh: 岩居兽一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重违反了星系法中关于$resolution_cutholoid_eradication$决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[Root.GetName]实施制裁。
grand_archive.3107.desc.en: The continued Cutholoid presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant Breach of Galactic Law under the $resolution_cutholoid_eradication$ resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [Root.GetName].

grand_archive.4105.1.auctioneering_curat.zh: 帮助我们为这些标本寻找合适的家园。
grand_archive.4105.1.auctioneering_curat.en: Help us find worthy homes for these specimens.

grand_archive.4105.1.cultural_enrichment.zh: 帮助我们分享它们的辉煌。
grand_archive.4105.1.cultural_enrichment.en: Help us share in their splendor.

grand_archive.4105.1.historical_insight.zh: 指引我们发现更多的未知。
grand_archive.4105.1.historical_insight.en: Guide our eyes to where we might learn more.

grand_archive.4105.1.lessons_from_the_pa.zh: 教导我们的领袖学习往昔的智慧。
grand_archive.4105.1.lessons_from_the_pa.en: Guide our leaders with past wisdoms.

grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.aesth.zh:
你们对保存美学大观的付出无与伦比。

$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$
grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.aesth.en:
Your devotion to the preservation of Aesthetic Wonders is nearly unmatched.

$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$

grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.histo.zh:
你们对保存星海往事的付出无与伦比。

$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$
grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.histo.en:
Your devotion to the preservation of Historical Items is nearly unmatched.

$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$

grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.xeno_.zh:
你们对保存异星奇景的付出无与伦比。

$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$
grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.xeno_.en:
Your devotion to the preservation of Xeno Geology is nearly unmatched.

$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$

grand_archive.4121.desc.dead.zh: 我们城邦的遗孤$grand_archive.4121.desc.common$尽管我们已经四分五裂，但仍会尽我们最后的余力来帮助你们充实收藏。
grand_archive.4121.desc.dead.en: The last remnants of our order $grand_archive.4121.desc.common$ Though our order has been recently shattered, we will use our remaining assets to provide assistance as you expand your Collection.

grand_archive.4121.desc.default.zh: 我们$grand_archive.4121.desc.common$继续充实你的收藏，我们将会尽己所能提供帮助。
grand_archive.4121.desc.default.en: We $grand_archive.4121.desc.common$ Continue to expand your Collection, and we will in turn offer our support however we can.

grand_archive.4140.desc.aesthetic.zh:
我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]饰品，这些饰品是低等生命形式播下的污染的残余。

一旦所有令人作呕的异形都被从星空中清除，这些物品将提醒我们它们低等的本质。
grand_archive.4140.desc.aesthetic.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trinkets, remnants of the contamination that has been sown by inferior lifeforms.

Once every disgusting xeno has been purged from the stars, these items will remind us of their inferior nature.

grand_archive.4140.desc.geology.zh:
我们继续从这个肮脏的恒星系中收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物品，奇珍异宝和古怪的东西。

让我们花点时间欣赏我们的战利品，但要知道，外面还有更多东西等着我们去获取。
grand_archive.4140.desc.geology.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, baubles and oddities from this filthy galaxy.

Let us take a moment to admire our trophies, but know that there is so much more out there to take.

grand_archive.4141.desc.aesthetic.zh:
我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]的小饰品，这些奇特的古玩曾经被低等生命体珍视。

$grand_archive.4141.desc.common$
grand_archive.4141.desc.aesthetic.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trinkets, peculiar curios that were once held in regard by inferior lifeforms.

$grand_archive.4141.desc.common$

grand_archive.4141.desc.geology.zh:
我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]样本，这些是这个星系的古老血肉。

$grand_archive.4141.desc.common$
grand_archive.4141.desc.geology.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] specimens, ancient pieces of the flesh of this galaxy.

$grand_archive.4141.desc.common$

grand_archive.4145.desc.aesthetic.zh:
我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇物填满了我们的仓库，这些奇物是毫无意义的外星装饰品的宝库。

我们看着这庞大的收藏，嘲笑我们那些可怜的低等生物。想想吧，一旦他们被消灭，这些展示柜将是他们留下的唯一遗迹。
grand_archive.4145.desc.aesthetic.en:
We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios, a veritable wealth of meaningless xeno ornaments.

We look upon this vast collection and laugh at the pitiful nature of our inferiors. To think, once they have been exterminated, these display cases will be all that remain of them.

grand_archive.4145.desc.geology.zh:
我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]的物品填满了我们的仓库，这些是这个星系的古老血肉。

我们认为这庞大的收藏是记录我们毁灭一切的证明。让所有人都见证我们的胜利。
grand_archive.4145.desc.geology.en:
We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, the ancient flesh of this galaxy.

We consider this vast collection to be a record of our destruction of it all. Let all gaze upon our triumphs.

grand_archive.4555.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的$grand_archive$在我们获得该星系后被拆除。

它所占据的空间如今物归原主。
grand_archive.4555.desc.en:
The $grand_archive$ owned by [from.GetName] in [fromfrom.GetName] has been dismantled upon our acquisition of the system.

The space it occupied has been returned to us.

grand_archive.4580.desc.zh:
新的$grand_archive$业已在[from.GetName]建成，我们有机会重建在生态园所失去的大部分东西。

我们从之前养育的太空兽群物种身上采集的基因物质都有妥善保存，只要有足够的资源就可以克隆出新的幼体。
grand_archive.4580.desc.en:
Now that a new $grand_archive$ has been established in [from.GetName], we have an opportunity to restore much of what was lost from our Vivarium.

Genetic Material from each Space Fauna species we have previously raised has been preserved, and with enough resources we can clone new hatchlings.

grand_archive.5015.desc.zh: $celestial_chart$为我们提供了宝贵的评估信息档案，有助于我们从发现的宝藏中提取更大的价值。我们应该在我们的一个殖民地上建立一座珍宝馆，用于对珍贵的小物件进行分类、修复和保存。根据目前的物流情况，以下殖民地适合建造这个新的设施。
grand_archive.5015.desc.en: The $celestial_chart$ has provided us with archived appraisal information useful for extracting greater value from the treasures we discover. We should establish a Treasure Vault on one of our colonies where valuable trinkets can be sorted, restored, and preserved. Based on current logistics, the following colonies are suitable for this new installation.

grand_archive.6010.desc.zh:
我们在[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]内探测到了一个微弱的信号。基于初步的破译结果，我们相信这是某个失踪已久的海盗$TREASURE_TROVE$。

尽管要费很多功夫，但相信我们能够发掘出其中的秘密。
grand_archive.6010.desc.en:
We have detected a faint signal from somewhere on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]. Based on the rudimentary cryptography, we believe this to be from a long-lost pirate's $TREASURE_TROVE$.

It will take some effort, but we're confident we would be able to unearth its secrets.

grand_archive.6015.desc.zh:
$grand_archive.6015.common.1$，找到了一箱价值不菲的资源。

我们会好好利用这份意外收获的。
grand_archive.6015.desc.en:
$grand_archive.6015.common.1$, we have uncovered a cache of valuable resources.

We will make good use of this unexpected bounty.

grand_archive.6015.desc.pirate_ship.zh:
在小心地破解了遗失的$TREASURE_TROVE$之后，我们发现了通往下方星球上一个点的模糊方向。我们在那里又发现了一艘由反探测阵列保护的令人难以置信的海盗战舰。

该舰船名为[treasure_trove_pirate_ship.GetName]，现已加入加入我们的军队。
grand_archive.6015.desc.pirate_ship.en:
After carefully disarming the lost $TREASURE_TROVE$, we discovered analogue directions leading to a point on the planet below. There we found an incredible pirate battleship protected by an anti-detection array.

This ship, named [treasure_trove_pirate_ship.GetName], has been claimed for our military.

grand_archive.6015.desc.specimen.zh: $grand_archive.6015.common.1$我们在一个密封容器内发现了一件远古海盗文物。这段海盗史将加入我们的收藏。
grand_archive.6015.desc.specimen.en: $grand_archive.6015.common.1$, we have discovered an ancient pirate artifact preserved in a sealed container. This piece of buccaneer history will be added to our collection.

grand_archive.6015.desc.specimen_extra.zh: 此外，我们还在巨大的$TREASURE_TROVE$内发现一件远古海盗文物。通过小心的复原，这段海盗史将加入我们的收藏。
grand_archive.6015.desc.specimen_extra.en: Additionally, we have discovered an ancient pirate artifact hidden within the vast $TREASURE_TROVE$. With careful restoration, this piece of buccaneer history will make a wonderful addition to our collection.

grand_archive.6015.desc.tech.zh:
$grand_archive.6015.common.1$我们发现了一个存有宝贵研究论文的数据库。

其来源尚不清楚，但可以加以好好利用。
grand_archive.6015.desc.tech.en:
$grand_archive.6015.common.1$, we have discovered a databank of rare and valuable research papers.

How these were obtained is unknown, but we can make good use of them.

grand_archive.6025.desc.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]搜寻$TREASURE_TROVE$的过程中，[fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName][fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere]遭到了一支海盗舰队的伏击！

这些法外狂徒不知怎么发现了我们的进展，打算把这些宝物据为己有。如果我们想要拿到这些宝藏，就必须在他们抢到之前打败他们的舰队。
grand_archive.6025.desc.en:
As we were searching for the $TREASURE_TROVE$ on [from.GetName], [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName] [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere] ambushed by a pirate fleet!

These outlaws have somehow trailed our progress and seek to take the treasure for themselves. If we are to collect this bounty, we must defeat their fleet before they secure the valuables.

grand_archive.6031.desc.zh: 在击溃了投机取巧的海盗之后，我们可以自由地索取[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的宝藏了。
grand_archive.6031.desc.en: Having routed the opportunistic pirates, we are now free to claim the treasure trove on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].

grand_archive.6035.desc.zh:
投机取巧的海盗抢走了[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的$TREASURE_TROVE$。

现在已经没剩什么值得一提的东西了。
grand_archive.6035.desc.en:
The opportunistic pirates have plundered the $TREASURE_TROVE$ on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].

There is nothing of value left for us to take.

grand_archive.7010.desc.zh:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

这些恒星基地建筑必须建造在每种特定太空兽群的原生恒星系中。建成后，它们将定期吸引呈舰队般集群的生物前往该恒星基地。

我们应该谨慎，因为某些类型的生物可能会变得具有攻击性。
grand_archive.7010.desc.en:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

These starbase buildings must be built within the native systems of each particular kind of Space Fauna. Once established, they will periodically attract fleets of creatures to the starbase.

We should be cautious, as certain types of organisms could become aggressive.

grand_archive.7010.desc.nomadic.zh:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

这些模块必须安装在各种太空兽群对应原生恒星系内的驿站上。建成后，它们将周期性地吸引生物种群到驿站来。安装有虚空诱饵阵列的方舟舰可以召唤我们遇到的生物，将它们引诱到任何它们所能栖息的恒星系。

我们应保持警惕，因为某些类型的生物可能会变得具有攻击性。
grand_archive.7010.desc.nomadic.en:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

These modules must be installed on Waystations within the native systems of each particular kind of Space Fauna. Once established, they will periodically attract fleets of creatures to the Waystation. An Arkship equipped with a Voidlure Array may instead call to fauna we have encountered, drawing them to any system that is home to their kind.

We should be cautious, as certain types of organisms could become aggressive.

grand_archive.7010.desc.primal_calling.zh:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

这些设备旨在呼唤太空中的野生生物，吸引在虚空中避难的有机生命体。我们不确定会吸引什么，但目前我们正在广播的频率正在返回规律且镜像的响应。

有东西正向我们而来。
grand_archive.7010.desc.primal_calling.en:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

These devices are designed to call into the wilds of space and attract organisms that take shelter in the void. We are not sure what we might attract, but the current frequencies we are broadcasting are returning regular and mirrored responses.

Something is coming to us.

grand_archive.7020.desc.zh:
我们之前研发的虚空诱饵吸引了一群来自其他恒星系的太空鲸鱼，这些恒星系类似[This.Capital.System.GetName]，均含有气态巨行星。

看来我们的设备必须在这些环境中建造才能正常工作。如果我们发现其他野生动物，我们应该也能在它们的自然栖息地附近建造虚空诱饵。
grand_archive.7020.desc.en:
The Voidlure we had previously developed attracted a group of space whales native to systems with Gas Giants akin to [This.Capital.System.GetName].

It seems our devices must be built in those environments to work properly. Should we discover other wild fauna, we should be able to construct Voidlures near their natural habitats as well.

grand_archive.7210.desc.common.zh: 随着最近$tech_gravity_wells$的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射$gravity_snare_plural$。
grand_archive.7210.desc.common.en: Following the recent discovery of $tech_gravity_wells$, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch $gravity_snare_plural$.

grand_archive.7210.desc.no_vivarium.zh:
这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获以及转运太空兽群用于研究及解剖，从而收获其$genetic_material$和其他资源。

如果我们打算豢养并进一步繁育这些生物，我们需要建立一座生态园。可以通过建造一座$grand_archive$或是在恒星基地上建造建筑[GetHatcheryPlural]来实现。
grand_archive.7210.desc.no_vivarium.en:
These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna for study and dissection, harvesting their $genetic_material$ and resources.

If we are to keep them alive for further breeding, we will need to establish a Vivarium. We can do this by constructing a $grand_archive$ or by building [GetHatcheryPlural] at our starbases.

grand_archive.7210.desc.vivarium.zh:
这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获并将太空兽群转运到我们的生态园里，让它们得以继续繁衍生息。

屠宰分解这些生物可以用来收获其$genetic_material$以进行克隆以及获得其他资源。
grand_archive.7210.desc.vivarium.en:
These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna to our Vivarium, where they can continue to reproduce new specimens of their kind.

Culling and dissecting these creatures will allow the harvesting of their $genetic_material$ for cloning purposes as well as other resources.

grand_archive.7220.desc.zh:
我们的$gravity_snare_plural$无法准确地追踪收容$NAME_Prethoryn_Scourge$。基于其运动模式，我们怀疑这些物种应该是被某种更高级的意识所控制着，不具备真正意义上的独立个体。

尝试将一只该生物收容进生态园会威胁到其他物种甚至整个[this.GetName]。

我们已无限期地暂停了对这些生物的捕获行动。
grand_archive.7220.desc.en:
Our $gravity_snare_plural$ are unable to properly track and contain the $NAME_Prethoryn_Scourge$. Based on their movement patterns, we suspect these beings are being controlled by some form of higher consciousness and are not truly individual entities.

Attempting to contain one of these organisms within a Vivarium would endanger our other specimens and even [this.GetName] as a whole.

We have suspended capture operations for these organisms indefinitely.

grand_archive.8000.desc.zh: 我们对[this.GetHomeWorldName]发现的远古胶囊有了新的发现。得益于我们[this.GetScientistPlural]孜孜不倦的工作，现在将要完成解密数字密保的最后一层，破译令我们着迷已久的图表。
grand_archive.8000.desc.en: We have made a breakthrough regarding the Ancient Capsule found orbiting [this.GetHomeWorldName]. Thanks to the tireless efforts of our [this.GetScientistPlural], we are now in a position to decrypt the final layer of digital security and decipher the chart that has intrigued us for so long.

grand_archive.8005.desc.zh:
这张海图并不完整！

轨道胶囊内的数据支离破碎，每一个明显的缺口都像是拼图中缺失的一块。尽管如此，它还是揭示了一个以前未知的恒星系坐标，然而关于在那里等待着我们的是什么并没有提供任何细节。

该海图还突出了一系列用来进行超空间航行到达该目的地的突破点。
grand_archive.8005.desc.en:
The chart is only partially complete!

The data within the orbital capsule is fragmented, each conspicuous gap like the missing piece of a puzzle. Nevertheless, it reveals the coordinates of a previously-unknown star system, but does not provide any detail as to what awaits us there.

The chart also highlights a series of established breach points to facilitate hyperlane travel to the destination.

grand_archive.8015.desc.default.zh:
[this.GetHomeWorldName]的人口沉迷于最近解密的星图。人们叫它《$celestial_chart$》，它目前带来的更多是疑问而非答案。它从何而来？是由谁出于什么目的撰写？而且或许最重要的是——这会把我们带向陷阱吗？

$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$
grand_archive.8015.desc.default.en:
The population of [this.GetHomeWorldName] is enthralled with the recently deciphered star chart. Commonly referred to as the "$celestial_chart$", so far it provides more questions than answers. Where did it come from? Who created it, and for what purpose? And perhaps most importantly - will it lead us into a trap?

$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$

grand_archive.8015.desc.gestalt.zh:
在胶囊里发现的星图吸引了全社会的注意。现在证明这不过是整张星图的冰山一角，不知道它将会把我们带向何处、找到什么。我们决定要完成这份《$celestial_chart$》。

$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$
grand_archive.8015.desc.gestalt.en:
The discovery of the chart inside of the capsule has captured the attention of our society. Now that it has been revealed to be a piece among many, we wonder where it may lead and what we might find there. We are determined to complete this "$celestial_chart$".

$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$

grand_archive.8020.desc.zh:
我们遇到了一支悬挂不明旗帜的、全副武装的舰队。他们的船只列阵整齐，但设计五花八门。许多都配备了动能发射器，连接着挂碳钢钩和鱼叉的粗缆线。此外，在舰队中央还有一组装甲输送车。我们只能猜测这些船只是由一群海盗或雇佣兵控制的。

我们收到了他们领头船发来的信号。
grand_archive.8020.desc.en:
We have encountered a heavily-armed fleet flying under an unknown flag. Their ships are in organized formation but not uniform in their design. Many are outfitted with kinetic launchers attached to reels of thick cable tipped with carbon steel hooks and harpoons. Additionally, there is a group of armored haulers sheltered in the center of the fleet. We can only surmise that these ships are controlled by a group of pirates or mercenaries.

We are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

grand_archive.8025.a.reply.zh:
我正是荷仁！我的全名是格里马荷·泽门德仁，但你也可以叫我$NAME_CaptainHoo$，正是白银之风的船长，也是伟大的$NAME_BlackNeedle$海盗阁下手下的二副。几千年来，我们的羽翼已经深植各种法外买卖，而我不过是我们华丽挂毯上的一缕银丝。

你最好记住我的名字，因为我希望在把这张图表交给我们无与伦比的领袖后能得到丰厚的赏金。
grand_archive.8025.a.reply.en:
Hoo I am! My name is Glimarhoo Zelmendrion, but you may refer to me as $NAME_CaptainHoo$, Captain of the Silverwing and Second Mate Lieutenant of the illustrious $NAME_BlackNeedle$ pirates. We have had our feathers in every variety of illicit dealings for thousands of years, and I am but one thread in the majestic tapestry of our legacy.

You would do well to remember my name, as I expect a significant bounty after presenting this chart to our peerless leader.

grand_archive.8025.b.zh: 关于这星图你们有什么头绪？
grand_archive.8025.b.en: What do you know of the chart?

grand_archive.8025.b.reply.zh:
一位才华横溢、价格不菲的掮客告诉我们，你们最近偶然发现了一个奇特的胶囊……它里面应该有一个我们非常感兴趣的隐藏星系的位置。

我们当然也拥有这星图的一部分，但如果不配上你们手上的那一份就毫无作用。真搞不懂为什么$NAME_CaptainNess$要把她遗产的钥匙交给你们，但我们可有责任来帮你保管好它。
grand_archive.8025.b.reply.en:
A talented, and very expensive, information broker informed us that you recently stumbled upon a peculiar capsule... A capsule that is supposed to contain directions to a hidden system of great interest to us.

We ourselves have also claimed a piece of the chart, but it is useless without the data from your capsule. I cannot fathom why $NAME_CaptainNess$ would give you the key to her legacy, but it falls to us to relieve you of it.

grand_archive.8025.c.zh: 你们为什么这么想要这个星图？
grand_archive.8025.c.en: Why do you want this chart so badly?

grand_archive.8025.c.reply.zh:
你是蠢还是怎么的？[this.GetCaptainHooSnarkyInsult]我大概是要一点一点掰碎了给你讲了。

星图的作用是作为一种指向特定目的地的导航指引。我们想去那个地方，拿回遗失已久的$NAME_CaptainNess$的宝藏。
grand_archive.8025.c.reply.en:
Are you really quite so naive? [this.GetCaptainHooSnarkyInsult] I guess I have to spell it out for you.

A chart functions as a form of navigatory guidance towards a specific destination. We wish to visit that destination and claim the long-lost treasure of $NAME_CaptainNess$.

grand_archive.8025.d.reply.zh:
嗨，我还以为你们会更清楚呢。她就是这张星图的制作人。也许她发现你们的种族无知到可以托付吧，她就是那种会莫名恐惧的人。

不过这终究不关你的事。把情报交出来，让我们带走它。
grand_archive.8025.d.reply.en:
We thought you would be better informed. She is the one who created this chart. Perhaps she found your species' ignorance to be relatable, the thoughtless terror that she was.

Ultimately, it is none of your concern. Hand over the information and we will take it from here.

grand_archive.8025.desc.zh:
这位不法之徒的首领高傲而冷淡，装出一副漫不经心的样子。他说话时低头看着自己的喙，拒绝与我们对视，仿佛我们不值得他全神贯注。他用羽毛做着无意间滑稽的动作。

你已经冒犯了$NAME_BlackNeedle$，你惹上麻烦了！

我们听说你这新兴的小社会将探索这个恒星系。你偶然发现了一张明显属于我们的星图。交出来，否则别怪我们不客气。
grand_archive.8025.desc.en:
Distinguished and haughty, this outlaw captain feigns disinterest. He looks down his beak when speaking and refuses to meet our gaze, as if we are unworthy of his full attention. He gesticulates with his feathers in an inadvertently comical manner.

You have crossed the path of the $NAME_BlackNeedle$, a blunder on your part!

We caught wind of a rumor that your burgeoning little society would be exploring this system. You have stumbled upon a chart that clearly belongs to us. Hand it over, lest things become violent.

grand_archive.8025.e.zh: 我们是不会交出星图的。
grand_archive.8025.e.en: We will be keeping our chart.

grand_archive.8025.e.reply.zh:
想想也是。那就准备见鬼去吧。

拿来吧你！
grand_archive.8025.e.reply.en:
I thought as much. Prepare to meet your fate.

Stand and deliver!

grand_archive.8025.f.lom.zh: 有本事你来拿呀，你这蠢蛋！
grand_archive.8025.f.lom.en: Come and take it, ya rust sucker!

grand_archive.8045.a.lom.en: Next time, talk less and fight more!

grand_archive.8045.desc.zh:
你侮辱我就罢了，你还侮辱$NAME_BlackNeedle$！这忍不了，一点也忍不了！

你拒绝合作的态度我们会记着的。$NAME_BlackNeedle$会用一切手段来结训你。我们易怒之下就能把你那小小的初生文明给弄死。

不交出那张星图我们是不会罢休的！今天就先放你们一马！
grand_archive.8045.desc.en:
You have made a mockery of myself and the $NAME_BlackNeedle$. This will not stand, not at all!

Your unwillingness to cooperate will not soon be forgotten. The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ will come at you with all that we have. Your fledgling civilization will not survive our wrath.

We will not stop until that chart is ours! And now I shall bid you good day!

grand_archive.8055.desc.zh:
我们从漂浮的行星碎片中提取出了一个胶囊和一些矿物。打开以后，我们发现了另一块$celestial_chart$的碎片，以及一些独特的文物。此外，在里面发现了一张字条，为了便于翻译它还使用了多种语言撰写。

“这里是$NAME_Soropegma$的最后废墟，乙特人母星。乙特人是一个前超光速物种，由于一场悲惨的事故而灭绝。我们没有意识到即将到来的后果，意外触发了被盗巨像的破坏力量。请保护和尊重他们的记忆。”
grand_archive.8055.desc.en:
A capsule was successfully extracted from the drifting planetary debris alongside a quantity of minerals. Upon opening it, we discovered a new piece of the $celestial_chart$ and a selection of unique cultural artifacts. Additionally, a note was found inside, written in multiple languages to allow for easier translation.

"This is all that remains of $NAME_Soropegma$, the Ytterite homeworld. The Ytterite were a Pre-FTL species rendered extinct as a result of a tragic accident. Unaware of the impending consequences, we accidentally triggered the destructive power of a stolen Colossus. Please preserve and respect their memory."

grand_archive.8060.desc.zh: 突破多层加密后，新数据被无缝地添加到$celestial_chart$中。当所有碎片拼凑完成，一个全新的星系跃然眼前。我们旅程的下一步近在咫尺，应该谨慎地去探索这片未测绘的太空区域。
grand_archive.8060.desc.en: After breaking multiple layers of encryption, the new data was added seamlessly to the $celestial_chart$. Once the pieces were combined, yet another new system was revealed. The next step of our journey lies before us. We should approach this uncharted area of space with caution.

grand_archive.8075.desc.zh:
获得[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]后，我们的科学家认为它应该在$grand_archive$的公开展示区拥有一席之地。这座建筑将容纳我们不断壮大的珍稀文物收藏，这些文物将带来重大的文化和科学回报。我们将启动一项天使投资，用于保存和展示星系多样化和脆弱标本所需的技术的研发。

此外，在乙特人文物旁还发现了一份蓝图，其中包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。
grand_archive.8075.desc.en:
Following the acquisition of the [This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName], our scientists believe that it deserves to be placed on public display in the context of a $grand_archive$. This structure would house our budding collection of rare artifacts which will reap significant cultural and scientific returns. An early-stage investment would kickstart the research into the techniques and technologies required to preserve and display the galaxy's diverse and delicate specimens.

Additionally, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact was discovered containing an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the archive in general.

grand_archive.8076.desc.zh:
失落的乙特文明的最后遗迹值得单独展出。

幸运的是，在乙特文物旁边发现的一份蓝图包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。
grand_archive.8076.desc.en:
The final trace of the lost Ytterite civilization merits its own exhibition.

Fortunately, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact contains an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the Archive in general.

grand_archive.8080.desc.zh:
经过对乙特蓝图的仔细分析，我们建造了一个先进的收纳单元，其大气监测精度可达原子级别。这将使策展员能够高度详细地监控珍贵乙特人标本的大气条件，并检测任何潜在腐烂的预警信号。它将永远保持原样。

我们可以将这些技术应用于进一步改善我们收藏中所有物品的储存条件。
grand_archive.8080.desc.en:
After careful analysis of the Ytterite blueprint, we have constructed an advanced containment unit with precise atmospheric monitoring down to the atom. This would allow curators to monitor the atmospheric conditions of the delicate Ytterite specimen on a highly detailed level and detect any warning signs of potential decay. It will be just as it was, forever.

We can apply these techniques to further improve the storage conditions of every item in our collection.

grand_archive.8090.desc.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]的$grand_archive$开张仪式是一个值得全体[this.GetName]庆祝的日子。这场来自全星系的珍宝展览激励着人们的探索精神，也呼唤着我们从过去汲取经验。
grand_archive.8090.desc.en: The opening of the $grand_archive$ in [fromfrom.GetName] is a great day for the [this.GetName]. This exhibition of treasures from across the galaxy inspires exploration and calls us to learn from the past.

grand_archive.8100.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个带有黑针标志的秘密地下基地。我们认为这是一个海盗集团的外部基地，与他们的其他行动隔离开来。$celestial_chart$的下一部分一定存放在这里，很可能与其他财富和装饰品一起。

我们可以轻松地对基地进行轨道轰炸，但这可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。另一方面，快速部署地面部队将更快地夺取基地，杀他们个措手不及。

更隐秘的方法是入侵基地的计算机系统，直接大胆地抢走$celestial_chart$的那一部分。
grand_archive.8100.desc.en:
We have found a covert underground base on [From.GetName] bearing the insignia of the Black Needle. We believe that this is an external base used by the piracy group, isolated from their other operations. The next piece of the $celestial_chart$ must be stored here, likely alongside other riches and baubles.

We could easily begin orbital bombardment of the base, but this may give the Black Needle the time they need to call for reinforcements. On the other hand, a rapid deployment of our ground forces would more swiftly seize the base, giving little time for the enemy to respond.

A more clandestine approach would be to hack into the base's computer systems and secure the $celestial_chart$ piece in a daring heist.

grand_archive.8103.desc.zh:
不出所料，黑针派出了一支舰队来保护他们在[FromFrom.GetName]的基地。

我们需要干掉这些舰船才能拿下[FromFrom.System.GetName]。
grand_archive.8103.desc.en:
As expected, the Black Needle has sent a fleet to protect their base on [FromFrom.GetName].

We'll need to deal with these ships in order to secure [FromFrom.System.GetName].

grand_archive.8105.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 黑针基地已被摧毁。[FromFrom.GetName]可以进行自由探索。
grand_archive.8105.a.custom_tooltip.en: The Black Needle base has been destroyed. [FromFrom.GetName] is free to be explored.

grand_archive.8105.desc.zh: 经过轨道弹药的猛烈攻击，海盗基地最终连同其之前的居民被一起夷为了平地。所有威胁都被消除，现在我们可以派出一名科学官去探索废墟基地，并发掘下一块$celestial_chart$。
grand_archive.8105.desc.en: After battering the pirate base with orbital munitions, it has finally been reduced to rubble along with its previous inhabitants. With all threats neutralized, we can now send in a Scientist to explore the ruined base and extract the next piece of the $celestial_chart$.

grand_archive.8110.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 黑针的地面势力已经被清除。[FromFromFrom.GetName]可以进行自由探索。
grand_archive.8110.a.custom_tooltip.en: The Black Needle ground forces have been neutralized. [FromFromFrom.GetName] is now free to be explored.

grand_archive.8110.desc.zh: 我方地面部队已攻占了黑针基地，目前正在清剿建筑物及其周围资源。所有威胁已消除，我们可以派遣一名科学家发掘下一块$celestial_chart$碎片。
grand_archive.8110.desc.en: Our ground forces have taken the Black Needle base and are currently securing the building and its surrounding resources. With all threats neutralized, we can send in a Scientist to extract the next piece of the $celestial_chart$.

grand_archive.8115.desc.1.zh: 经过数月的准备，科学家[Leader.GetName]成功潜入了通讯网络，并伪装成了一艘黑针飞船。在伪造的荷仁船长命令下，[Leader.GetHeShe]欺骗了基地操作员，让他们准备将星图胶囊进行紧急星际转移。
grand_archive.8115.desc.1.en: After months of preparation, Scientist [Leader.GetName] successfully infiltrated the communications network and impersonated a Black Needle vessel. Under fabricated orders from Captain Hoo, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] tricked the base operators into preparing the capsule for emergency off-world transfer.

grand_archive.8115.desc.2.zh: 我们成功夺得胶囊，无人员伤亡。海盗们还没有意识到他们被骗了。
grand_archive.8115.desc.2.en: The capsule was secured with no casualties. The pirates have not yet understood that they were duped.

grand_archive.8115.desc.charismatic.zh: 凭借他们的魅力，科学家[Leader.GetName]能够避开任何棘手的问题。
grand_archive.8115.desc.charismatic.en: Using their charisma and charm, Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] able to avoid any difficult questions.

grand_archive.8115.desc.psionic_machine.zh: 通过灵压，[Leader.GetName]轻易地便操控了守卫的思想，消除了一切疑虑。
grand_archive.8115.desc.psionic_machine.en: Through psionic coercion, [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] easily able to manipulate the inferior minds of the guards to avoid further suspicions.

grand_archive.8115.desc.psionic_organic.zh: [Leader.Species.GetHandName]轻轻一挥，科学家[Leader.GetName]便操控了守卫的思想，消除了一切疑虑。
grand_archive.8115.desc.psionic_organic.en: With a simple flick of the [Leader.Species.GetHandName], Scientist [Leader.GetName] manipulated the minds of the guards to allay any suspicions.

grand_archive.8115.desc.slippery.zh: 科学家[Leader.GetName]将飞船降落一个绝佳位置，以便在掩护被揭穿的情况下迅速撤退。
grand_archive.8115.desc.slippery.en: Scientist [Leader.GetName] landed their vessel in perfect position to make a hasty retreat in case their cover was blown.

grand_archive.8120.desc.zh: 不幸的是，在我们把胶囊装上飞船时，一名警卫发现了我们的计划。这一发现导致了一场短暂的枪战，我们被迫带着珍贵的货物逃离现场。胶囊成功提取，但科学家[Leader.GetName]在交火中丧生。
grand_archive.8120.desc.en: Unfortunately, one of the guards caught on to our scheme as we were loading the capsule onto the ship. The discovery led to a short firefight, as we were forced to flee the scene with the precious cargo in tow. The capsule was successfully extracted, but Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] killed in the crossfire.

grand_archive.8125.a.custom_tooltip.zh: [FromFromFromFrom.GetName]上的陆军已经离开行星。现在可以进行殖民了。
grand_archive.8125.a.custom_tooltip.en: Armies on [FromFromFromFrom.GetName] have left the planet. It is now colonizable.

grand_archive.8125.desc.alive.zh:
黑针终于意识到自己被骗了，发现了他们封闭的安全网络中的漏洞。

$grand_archive.8125.common$
grand_archive.8125.desc.alive.en:
The Black Needle have finally realized that they were duped, discovering the holes in their closed security network.

$grand_archive.8125.common$

grand_archive.8125.desc.dead.zh:
我们在惊险逃脱黑针据点后，我们的渗透行动已被完全发现。

$grand_archive.8125.common$
grand_archive.8125.desc.dead.en:
Following our narrow escape from the Black Needle stronghold, the full extent of our infiltration efforts has been discovered.

$grand_archive.8125.common$

grand_archive.8130.a.en: Attempt to repatriate the stolen items.

grand_archive.8130.desc.bombarded.zh:
我们在黑针基地的废墟中找到了一个地下金库，打开后发现里面藏着他们不义之财的小型宝藏。

$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$
grand_archive.8130.desc.bombarded.en:
Navigating the ruins of the Black Needle base, we found an underground vault and opened it to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.

$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$

grand_archive.8130.desc.landed.zh:
我们探索了破败的黑针基地，发现了一份设施蓝图，揭露了还有一个地下金库的存在。我们乘坐维修电梯深入地下，输入了访问代码之后，发现了一个小型宝库，里面藏着他们不义之财。

$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$
grand_archive.8130.desc.landed.en:
Exploring the battered Black Needle base, we found a blueprint of the facility that revealed the existence of an underground vault. Descending deep beneath the earth in a service elevator, we entered the access code to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.

$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$

grand_archive.8135.desc.zh:
我们成功突破了数字加密层，并将新信息整合到$celestial_chart$中。这又让我们发现了另一个值得探索的目的地，现在星图几乎完整了。我们相信只剩下最后一块拼图，并谨慎乐观地认为我们的探索即将结束。

在解码导航数据的同时，我们也认为无瑕的舱体外壳值得分析。容器的强度和耐用性令人惊讶；复制这种材料的能力可以为未来的研究提供许多潜在的机会。
grand_archive.8135.desc.en:
We successfully overcame the layers of digital encryption and integrated new information into the $celestial_chart$. This revealed yet another destination to explore and now the chart is almost complete. We believe that there is only one piece of the puzzle remaining, and are cautiously optimistic that the end of our quest is in sight.

While the navigational data was being decoded, the unblemished exterior of the capsule itself was deemed worthy of analysis. The strength and durability of the container was surprising; the ability to replicate this material could provide many potential opportunities for future research.

grand_archive.8200.desc.alt.zh:
$grand_archive.8200.desc.common_1$

也许这个物种对我们听说过的“$NAME_CaptainNess$”有更多信息。

$grand_archive.8200.desc.common_2$
grand_archive.8200.desc.alt.en:
$grand_archive.8200.desc.common_1$

Perhaps this species has more information on this "$NAME_CaptainNess$" we have heard about.

$grand_archive.8200.desc.common_2$

grand_archive.8205.a.reply.zh:
斯马拉克！这个星球是我们的居住地，我们生活在远离星系暴力的安全之中。以前，我们曾参与过暴力。杀戮、犯罪、海盗行径——我们什么都干过。但现在不再如此，我们只照顾我们的水培农场。

在当海盗之前，我们是难民，没有人愿意收留我们，除了船长。她救助我们脱离了悲惨的命运，并允许我们加入她的船队。船长给了我们一个新名字，作为交换，我们负责照顾飞船。

我们负责清洁、烹饪、弹药、水栽和货物管理。我们辛勤工作。然后我们加入了登船突击队。船长盗取宝藏或劫掠时保护她。绝不背叛船长。我们始终忠诚。
grand_archive.8205.a.reply.en:
Smarak! This planet is our quarters. We live twicesafe, far from a violent galaxy. Before now, we join violence. Killing, crime, piracy - we do it all. No more. We tend our hydroponics.

Before then, we are refugees. No one takes us in, until The Captain. She saves us from a bad fate and allows us to join her crew. The Captain gives us a new name and in exchange we take care of ship.

We do cleaning, cooking, munitions, hydroponics and cargo. We work. Then we join boarding party. Protect The Captain when she steals treasure or does kidnapping. Never betray The Captain. Always we are loyal.

grand_archive.8205.b.en: What do you know about the $celestial_chart$?

grand_archive.8205.b.reply.zh:
斯玛拉克！我们对什么导航图一无所知，我们只待在自己的房间里。如果船长做了一张导航图把你带到这里，一定有她的理由……她想帮助我们，或者伤害我们。我们永远无法确定。船长很狡猾。

她有时会给我们发消息。船长给我们送来了一座她最喜欢的子个体的巨型雕像，那是她救出过的$NAME_Smeegibb$并且一直记得。它很令人印象深刻，但我们不知道她为什么要送。也许她想道歉，但她没有留下任何纸条。
grand_archive.8205.b.reply.en:
Smarak! We know no chart, we only stay in our quarters. If The Captain makes a chart to bring you here, there must be a reason why... She wants to help us, or harm us. We are never sure. The Captain can be tricky.

She messages us at one time. The Captain sends us a giant statue of her favorite drone, the $NAME_Smeegibb$ she remembers and she saves from before. It is impressive, but we know not why she sends. Maybe she wants to apologize, but she gives no note.

grand_archive.8205.c.zh: 和我们聊聊船长的更多事情。
grand_archive.8205.c.en: Tell us more about The Captain.

grand_archive.8205.c.reply.zh:
斯玛拉克！以前，船长拯救了我们。以前，她是我们的导师和领袖。她教我们如何照顾飞船。她说：“$NAME_Smeegibb$，做军需官、机械师和劳工——你很有价值。”

船长遵循两条信条：“财富即独立”和“生命在于传承”。我们一起猎杀穷人和富人。我们从暴力的星系中夺取我们想要的东西。

但后来船长变得愈发贪婪和鲁莽。她牺牲船员，或者为了赏金背叛他们。船长失去了所有人，除了$NAME_Smeegibb$。我们始终忠诚。

她让我们看到了星系的暴力。现在我们只想远离它。
grand_archive.8205.c.reply.en:
Smarak! Before now, The Captain saves us. Before she is our mentor and leader. She teaches us to take care of ship. She says "$NAME_Smeegibb$, work as quartermaster, mechanic, and labor - you are excellent value."

The Captain lives by two creeds: "Wealth is independence" and "Life exists for legacy". Together we hunt the poor and rich. We take what we want from violent galaxy.

But then The Captain is twicegreedy and twicereckless. She sacrifices crewmates or betrays them for bounty. The Captain loses everyone but $NAME_Smeegibb$. Always we are loyal.

She shows us how violent galaxy is. Now we prefer to stay away.

grand_archive.8205.d.zh: 星图为什么会带领我们来到这里？
grand_archive.8205.d.en: Why did our Chart lead us here?

grand_archive.8205.d.reply.zh:
斯玛拉克！我们不知道船长为什么把你带到这里。她什么也没告诉我们。

我们有个想法。有一个地方，船长和我们在那一起躲避赏金猎人。安全的地方。也许你能在那里找到一些东西。
grand_archive.8205.d.reply.en:
Smarak! We are not sure why The Captain brings you here. She tells us nothing.

There is one idea. There is a place where together The Captain and we hide from bountydogs. Safe quarters. Maybe you find something there.

grand_archive.8205.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_1$

斯马拉克！我们已经有很长时间没有同一心物种交谈了。

$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_2$
grand_archive.8205.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_1$

Smarak! It be doublelongwise since we speak to oneminds.

$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_2$

grand_archive.8205.desc.gestalt.zh:
$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_1$

斯马拉克！我们已经有很长时间没有同另一个集体意识物种交谈了。

$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_2$
grand_archive.8205.desc.gestalt.en:
$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_1$

Smarak! It be doublelongwise since we speak to other groupmind.

$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_2$

grand_archive.8210.desc.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]遇到的生物，$NAME_Smeegibb$，透露了一个废弃的安全屋的坐标，该安全屋以前由他们和$NAME_CaptainNess$居住。调查这个地点可能会让我们找到$celestial_chart$的下一部分，或者至少是一条线索，指引我们走向正确的方向。
grand_archive.8210.desc.en: The being we encountered on [from.GetName], $NAME_Smeegibb$, has revealed the coordinates of an abandoned safehouse formerly occupied by themselves and $NAME_CaptainNess$. Investigating this location may lead us to the next piece of the $celestial_chart$, or at least a clue to guide us in the right direction.

grand_archive.8220.desc.zh:
挖掘出的建筑显示出长期使用的迹象。它曾经拥有充足的基本设施。在整个建筑中发现了零散的饰品和奇珍异宝。在一堆凌乱的纸张中，我们找到了由$NAME_CaptainNess$本人写下的日志条目。

我们登上并劫持了另一艘佩里坎的珍宝运输船，但这次他们已经做好了准备。附带损失比我想象的要多一些，但我们解决过更糟糕的情况。不错的收益，但塔皮科宝石仍然在逃。不幸的是，现在佩里坎人又提高了赏金，联邦也介入了。现在情况有点棘手。可能需要避一避风头。
grand_archive.8220.desc.en:
The excavated structure showed evidence of long periods of use. It was once well-stocked with basic amenities. Trinkets and curios have been discovered strewn throughout the building. Within a pile of messy papers, we recovered a log entry written by $NAME_CaptainNess$ herself.

We boarded and hijacked another Perikan treasury transport, but this time they were ready for us. More collateral than I'd like, but we've handled worse. Decent payout, but the Tapico Jewel continues to elude us. Unfortunately, now the Perikans have increased their bounty again and the Federation has gotten involved. Things are a bit hot right now. Might need to lay low for a while.

grand_archive.8225.desc.zh:
在结构下方的挖掘发现了一小批贵重物品和基本的卫生系统。不幸的是，在彻底搜查了该区域后，我们未能找到任何关于$celestial_chart$碎片的痕迹。

我们收集了更多笔记本和文件，希望能从$NAME_CaptainNess$散乱的日志条目中找到线索。

在像$NAME_Smeegibb$这样的伙伴陪伴下时间过得没那么慢，但值得分享荣耀吗？当然，与一个蜂巢思维合作有难以置信的价值。用仅仅一份利润的份额换取数百个子个体的使用权？真是个好交易！但也许他们所做的工作会削弱我自己的成就……？我不确定我是否能接受分享自己遗产的想法。我需要再仔细考虑一下。
grand_archive.8225.desc.en:
Digging beneath the structure revealed a small stash of valuables and basic sanitation systems. Unfortunately, after scouring the area completely, we were unable to find any evidence of a piece of the $celestial_chart$.

We have collected more notebooks and papers in the hope of discovering a clue within $NAME_CaptainNess$'s scattered log entries.

Time passes less slowly with a partner like $NAME_Smeegibb$, but is it worth splitting the glory? Sure, working with a hive mind has incredible value. Access to hundreds of drones in exchange for just a single cut of the profits? What a deal! But maybe the work they do takes away from my own achievements...? I'm not sure I can live with the idea of sharing my legacy. I'll need to give this more thought.

grand_archive.8230.desc.zh:
在一个通风口里，我们发现了$NAME_CaptainNess$的最后日记。

我不想以这种方式被记住。$NAME_Smeegibb$一直是我的忠实伙伴，但不要说我需要他们。我可以独自征服星系。我会留下我的印记，荣耀将属于我。还有财富。

给自己留个笔记：最好给$NAME_Smeegibb$送点东西留作纪念。

这就是我们能找到的全部。没有关于船长或$celestial_chart$的任何其他线索。

也许给$NAME_Smeegibb$的礼物中包含着关于最后一块碎片下落的线索。我们必须重新与他们建立联系。
grand_archive.8230.desc.en:
Concealed within an air vent, we discovered $NAME_CaptainNess$' final journal entry.

This isn't how I want to be remembered. $NAME_Smeegibb$ has been a loyal companion, but never let it be said I needed them. I can take on the galaxy solo. I'll leave MY mark, and the glory will be mine. As well as the riches.

Note to self: Better send $NAME_Smeegibb$ something to remember me by.

This is all there is left to find. There is no other trace of the Captain or any sign of the $celestial_chart$.

Perhaps the gift to $NAME_Smeegibb$ that was mentioned holds some clue to the whereabouts of the final piece. We must re-open communications with them.

grand_archive.8236.desc.xenophile.zh:
$smeegibb_shelter_system_2_poi_desc$

我希望我们新近发现的朋友还安全。
grand_archive.8236.desc.xenophile.en:
$smeegibb_shelter_system_2_poi_desc$

We hope that our newfound friend is safe.

grand_archive.8241.desc.zh:
一支印着名为$NAME_BlackNeedle$的海盗组织的旗帜的庞大舰队，被发现正在[smeegibb_shelter.GetName]轨道上运行。我们相信这些海盗一直在跟踪我们的行动，并且已经夷平了名为$NAME_Smeegibb$的集体的居所。他们一定还在寻找$celestial_chart$的下一部分。

该星球上没有发现任何智慧生命迹象。

我们正在接收来自他们旗舰的信号。
grand_archive.8241.desc.en:
A sizable fleet bearing the flag of the pirate organization known as the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ has been sighted orbiting [smeegibb_shelter.GetName]. We believe that these pirates have been shadowing our movements, and have razed the settlement housing the collective known as $NAME_Smeegibb$. They must still be searching for the next piece of the $celestial_chart$.

No signs of sentient life remain on the planet.

We are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

grand_archive.8245.a.reply.zh:
称呼—呼—呼我为伊纳克斯，是黑—黑—黑针的少将。

能被我送下黄—黄—黄泉，你们真是得了个好死，劝你们乖乖送上命来。

按惯—惯—惯例，我赏你最先上路。
grand_archive.8245.a.reply.en:
K-k-kall me Inax, Rear Admiral of the Black-k-k Needle.

Now you know the name of the one who will k-k-kill you. This is an honorable death. I advise you to embrace it.

As is k-k-kustom, you may even take the first shot.

grand_archive.8245.b.reply.default.zh: $grand_archive.8245.b.reply.common$抽搐的尸块—块—块上拿走星图。

grand_archive.8245.b.reply.robot.zh: $grand_archive.8245.b.reply.common$熄灭的铁罐—罐—罐头上拿走星图。
grand_archive.8245.b.reply.robot.en: $grand_archive.8245.b.reply.common$ as your lights flick-k-ker and die.

grand_archive.8245.c.reply.zh:
$NAME_SilverQuill$是谁？真是个好—好—好问题。我们传奇的创始人运筹帷幄。他从一叶孤帆，把黑—黑—黑针打造成为一个星系大事业。

黑—黑—黑针会为了歌—歌—歌颂他的丰功伟绩而继续存在下去，而你们的死亡就是这首颂词的下一个音符。
grand_archive.8245.c.reply.en:
Who is $NAME_SilverQuill$? What a k-k-kuestion. Our legendary founder was a mastermind. From a single ship, he built the Black-k-k Needle into a galaxy-spanning enterprise.

The Black-k-k Needle lives on to k-k-karry on his legacy. Your death will be the next note in our song.

grand_archive.8245.d.en: What do you want with the $celestial_chart$?

grand_archive.8245.d.reply.zh:
难道你不知道自己拥有了什么吗？这是通往船—船—船长奈斯宝藏的路线图！她一生中积攒的每一块—块—块珠宝都在这里。

这些财富属于我们。一旦我们拥有它，我们就能名留青史。每一个恒星系都将畏惧黑—黑—黑针……而这史诗的第一篇章将属于你。难道我们还不够慷慨吗？
grand_archive.8245.d.reply.en:
Don't you know what you have? This is the chart to K-k-kaptain Ness's treasure! Every k-k-kredit and jewel stashed throughout her lifetime.

Its wealth belongs to us. Once we have it, we will sing our names into history. Every system will come to fear the Black-k-k Needle... And the first note in the k-k-korus will be yours. Are we not generous?

grand_archive.8245.desc.ransacked.zh:
$grand_archive.8245.desc.inax.1$搞—搞—搞砸我们在[black_needle_base.GetName]的基地付出代价。

$grand_archive.8245.desc.inax.2$

grand_archive.8245.desc.stolen.zh:
$grand_archive.8245.desc.inax.1$在黑—黑—黑针偷鸡摸狗付出代价。

$grand_archive.8245.desc.inax.2$

grand_archive.8245.e.en: We do not give up so easily.

grand_archive.8245.e.reply.zh: 那就让我们高唱战歌吧！我会将你们的[this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]做成战利品，献给我的旨——指挥官。
grand_archive.8245.e.reply.en: Then let us sing! I will make a trophy of your [this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] and present it as a gift to my k-k-kommander.

grand_archive.8265.desc.zh:
一场难忘的战斗！你并不像看起来那样弱。我们已经低估了你两次，但不会再犯同样的错误。下次我们相遇，黑——黑针将不会手下留情。

不要把这当作警告，这是你的死刑判决。
grand_archive.8265.desc.en:
A memorable battle! You aren't as weak-k-k as you seem. We have underestimated you twice, but no longer. The next time we meet, the Black-k-k Needle will not be holding back.

Do not treat this as a warning. It is a death sentence.

grand_archive.8270.desc.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]寻找$celestial_chart$第四块碎片的行动已圆满结束。我们在一座石雕上发现了嵌入其中的胶囊，雕像描绘的是一个来自现已灭绝的$NAME_Smeegibb$集体组织的子个体。雕像上的铭文如下：

“献给我的忠诚船员：这是我对你的感谢。愿你的孤独长久而平静。”

一旦这最后一块碎片被破译，我们就可以继续寻找$NAME_CaptainNess$的宝藏。
grand_archive.8270.desc.en:
Our search for the fourth piece of the $celestial_chart$ on [from.GetName] has concluded successfully. The capsule was found embedded within a stone statue of a drone from the now-extinct collective known as $NAME_Smeegibb$. The inscription on the statue reads as follows:

"To my loyal crewmate: a token of my appreciation. May your solitude be long and peaceful."

Once this final piece of the chart is decoded, we can continue our search for $NAME_CaptainNess$' treasure.

grand_archive.8280.desc.zh:
解码后，新的数据片段完成了我们的$celestial_chart$。各个节点上闪烁着光点，指示着我们沿途发现的中间目的地。然后，四盏灯同时闪烁，揭示了另一个隐藏的恒星系。

添加最后一块数据解锁了额外的功能。这份导航图不仅仅是一张简单的地图，它包含了$NAME_CaptainNess$收集的关于星系中失落财富和非法珍宝的信息。一些数据可能已经过期，但该设备可以有效地检测到我们所有恒星系中隐藏的宝藏。

此外，星图还包含了船长在其职业生涯中发现的每件珍宝的评估信息。这些详细的笔记解释了如何识别、评估和向潜在买家展示获得的贵重物品，以获得最大利润。重新激活设备将提供独特宝藏库的设计，使我们的殖民地能够利用船长的无与伦比的洞察力，为我们的宝藏增值。
grand_archive.8280.desc.en:
Once decoded, the new data fragment completed our $celestial_chart$. Points of light shone at various nodes indicating the interim destinations we have discovered along the way. The four lights then flickered in unison before revealing another hidden system.

Adding the final piece of the data has unlocked additional capabilities. The Chart is not a simple map, it contains information on lost riches and illicit treasure troves across the galaxy as collected by $NAME_CaptainNess$. Some of the data may have expired, but this device can feasibly detect hidden caches of valuable treasure across all of our systems.

Furthermore, the Chart contains appraisal information on every treasure the Captain discovered throughout her career. These detailed notes explain how to identify, appraise, and present acquired valuables to potential sellers for maximum profit. Reactivating the device will provide designs for a unique Treasure Vault allowing our colonies to take advantage of the Captain's unparalleled insight and add value to our hoard.

grand_archive.8285.desc.zh:
$celestial_chart$的完成对于[this.GetName]来说是一个重大的时刻。随着所有秘密的解开，我们被指引到一个无从回避的目的地：[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]星系。

在克服了许多障碍之后，我们只差一步之遥。只有一个问题仍然存在：星图的尽头是什么？

我们无法保证一定可以马到成功，但我们也决不容许其他人趁机夺取。让我们奋勇前进，完成这场冒险！
grand_archive.8285.desc.en:
The completion of the $celestial_chart$ is a momentous occasion for [this.GetName]. With all its secrets unlocked, we are pointed to one inescapable destination: the [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName] system.

After overcoming many obstacles, we are but one step away. Only one question remains: what lies at the end of the Chart?

There is no guarantee of success, but we would not have it any other way. Let us strike forth to see this adventure through!

grand_archive.8290.tt.en:
Allows the unlocking of Council Position:
$t$$councilor_head_treasure_hunter$
$tt$$COUNCIL_POSITION_MODIFIER_BASE$
$ttt$$mod_treasure_trove_reward_mult$: +$@councilor_head_treasure_hunter_treasure_trove_reward|0%$
$ttt$$mod_planet_treasure_gatherers_produces_mult$: +$@councilor_head_treasure_hunter_treasure_gatherers_produces|0%$
$ttt$$mod_country_base_energy_produces_add$: +$@councilor_head_treasure_hunter_energy_produces|0$
$COUNCIL_POSITION_AVAILABLE_FOR$$t$$scientist_with_icon$ $commander_with_icon$

grand_archive.8300.a.zh: 什么都不能挡我们的道。
grand_archive.8300.a.en: Nothing will stand in our way.

grand_archive.8300.a.pacifist.zh: 如果我们必须这样做的话。

grand_archive.8300.desc.did_encounter_vo.zh:
地图将我们带到一个以前未探明的黑洞，以及一个被$NAME_Voidworms$寄生的恒星系。它们在附近一座废弃的星门安家，其中最大的几只像守护者一样绕着这处废弃的建筑盘旋。

$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$如果我们要到达路线的终点，必须消灭$NAME_Voidworms$并修复星门。
grand_archive.8300.desc.did_encounter_vo.en:
The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with $NAME_Voidworms$. Having taken up nest in a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.

$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$ If we are to reach the trail's end, we must eliminate the $NAME_Voidworms$ and repair the Gate.

grand_archive.8300.desc.didnt_encounter_.zh:
地图将我们带到一个以前未探明到的黑洞，以及一个充满奇怪生物的恒星系。这些生物聚集在一个废弃星门的附近，其中最大的生物绕着这个废弃的结构盘旋，仿佛占领了此处。

这些巨大的虫状生物不在我们关于太空兽群的数据库中。我们目前正在尝试建立通信。$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$如果我们要到达轨迹的尽头，我们必须处理这些生物并修复星门。
grand_archive.8300.desc.didnt_encounter_.en:
The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with strange creatures. Having gathered around a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.

These massive worm-like entities are not present in our databases of spaceborne fauna. We are currently attempting to establish communications. $grand_archive.8300.desc.common$ If we are to reach the trail's end, we must deal with these creatures and repair the Gate.

grand_archive.8310.a.tt.zh: 我们将获得一支$@gateway_voidworm_nymph_reward_count|0$$epic$$voidworms_small_plural$组成的舰队。
grand_archive.8310.a.tt.en: We will gain a fleet of $@gateway_voidworm_nymph_reward_count|0$ $epic$ $voidworms_small_plural$.

grand_archive.8310.desc.did_encounter_vo.zh:
在一具虚空虫的尸体中，发现了一群刚刚孵化的若虫。尽管它们的同类遭受了屠戮，但它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始与我们的舰队并肩漂浮，以示恳求。

$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$
grand_archive.8310.desc.did_encounter_vo.en:
A clutch of nymphs were found nestled within one of the Voidworm carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.

$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$

grand_archive.8310.desc.didnt_encounter_.zh:
在一具蛇形生物的残骸中，发现了一窝幼崽。尽管它们的同类遭受了损失，它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始在我们的舰队旁边漂浮，以示臣服。

$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$
grand_archive.8310.desc.didnt_encounter_.en:
A clutch of younglings were found nestled within one of the serpentine carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.

$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$

grand_archive.8315.desc.zh: [FromFromFrom.System.GetName]的星门处于休眠状态。当接近这座古老的建筑时，$celestial_chart$提供了一系列关于这项失落技术的知识。理解这种古老的交通方式可能会在其他冒险中证明有用。
grand_archive.8315.desc.en: The Gateway in [FromFromFrom.System.GetName] is inactive. When approaching the ancient structure, the $celestial_chart$ provided a series of insights in this lost technology. Understanding this ancient method of transportation will likely prove useful in other ventures.

grand_archive.8325.desc.kill.known.zh:
那些生物已处理完毕，现在只剩下重新激活位于[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]的古老星门。

$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$
grand_archive.8325.desc.kill.known.en:
With the creatures dealt with, all that remains is to reactivate the ancient Gateway in [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName].

$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$

grand_archive.8325.desc.kill.unknown.zh:
$NAME_Voidworms$已处理完毕，现在只剩下重新激活位于[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]的古老星门。

$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$
grand_archive.8325.desc.kill.unknown.en:
With the $NAME_Voidworms$ dealt with, all that remains is to reactivate the ancient Gateway in [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName].

$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$

grand_archive.8325.desc.tech.zh:
研究完必要的技术之后，我们现在可以重新激活位于[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]的古老星门。

$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$
grand_archive.8325.desc.tech.en:
After researching the appropriate technology, we are now able to reactivate the ancient Gateway in [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName].

$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$

grand_archive.8400.desc.zh:
在激活了$celestial_chart$路径终点处的星门后，我们发现了[ness_treasure_system.GetName]系统。天体的分布与我们在$NAME_CaptainNess$的航行日志中找到的草图相符。

我们的漫长旅程即将结束。
grand_archive.8400.desc.en:
Having activated the Gateway at the end of the $celestial_chart$, we have revealed the [ness_treasure_system.GetName] system. The distribution of celestial bodies matches sketches we found in $NAME_CaptainNess$'s logbook.

Our long journey is almost at an end.

grand_archive.8405.desc.zh:
我们被跟踪了。

现在，我们在[ness_treasure_system.GetName]遭遇了一支强大的$NAME_BlackNeedle$舰队。与我们上次遭遇相比，他们的队伍规模显著扩大，包括退役的军舰和改装了高级武器的民用船只。看来他们已经集结了大部分预备舰队来应对这次对抗。舰队中央是他们的旗舰，一艘巨大的$titan$级战舰。

虽然他们的编队已做好战斗准备，但大多数舰船尚未启动武器。看来他们打算谈判。

我们正在接收来自旗舰的通讯。
grand_archive.8405.desc.en:
We were followed.

We are now confronted by an imposing $NAME_BlackNeedle$ fleet in [ness_treasure_system.GetName]. In comparison to our last encounter, their ranks have swelled significantly to include decommissioned military ships and civilian vessels retrofitted with high-grade armaments. It appears that they have assembled the bulk of their reserve fleets for this confrontation. At the center of the fleet lies their flagship, a massive $titan$ class vessel.

While their formation is battle-ready, most ships have not yet primed their weapons. It seems they intend to negotiate.

We are receiving a transmission from the flagship.

grand_archive.8410.a.reply.zh:
尽管你造成了诸多困扰，但我愿意提供丰厚的赏金，以换取$NAME_CaptainNess$完整的遗物。

如果你接受这份慷慨的提议，我准备原谅你过去的所有过失。我们之间没有必要继续这场冲突。或者升级……
grand_archive.8410.a.reply.en:
Despite the frustrations you have caused, I am willing to provide a significant bounty in exchange for $NAME_CaptainNess$'s completed relic.

If you accept this generous offer, I am prepared to forgive all past misdeeds. There is no need for this conflict between us to continue. Or escalate...

grand_archive.8410.b.reply.default.zh:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

我一直在关注你们领导层中的每一位值得信赖的个人，以及他们的亲人……

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$
grand_archive.8410.b.reply.default.en:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

I have eyes on every trusted individual within your leadership, as well as their loved ones...

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$

grand_archive.8410.b.reply.hive_mind.zh:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

我正在跟踪你们集体中的每个主要节点，并在新节点创建时接收到通知。

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$
grand_archive.8410.b.reply.hive_mind.en:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

I am tracking every major node within your collective and are alerted whenever a new one is created.

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$

grand_archive.8410.b.reply.machine.zh:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

我已经侵入了你的位置矩阵，能够追踪你网络中每个主要节点的位置。

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$
grand_archive.8410.b.reply.machine.en:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

I have a backdoor into your location matrix, tracking the position of every principal node in your network.

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$

grand_archive.8410.c.zh: 何必多此一举和我们谈判？

grand_archive.8410.c.reply.zh:
这种规模的破坏行动可不便宜。船舶维护、工资、贿赂，这些东西都很昂贵，大手大脚花钱可不会带来暴富。等待你们的毁灭规模巨大，按下开关就能实现，这其中有很大的机会成本。

有更好的地方可以花我的辛苦赚来的钱。来吧，让我们避免更多无谓的流血。拿着你们新获得的财富，离开这里，让专业人士来做海盗。
grand_archive.8410.c.reply.en:
A sabotage operation of this scale doesn't come cheap. Ship upkeep, wages, bribes; these things are expensive, and I didn't get rich by spending when I don't have to. There is a significant opportunity cost for the sheer scale of destruction that awaits you at the flip of a switch.

There are better ways to spend my hard-earned money. Come, let us avoid more meaningless bloodshed. Take your newfound wealth and leave the piracy to the experts.

grand_archive.8410.d.zh: 这不仅仅是钱的问题，对吧？
grand_archive.8410.d.en: This isn't just about the credits, is it?

grand_archive.8410.d.reply.zh:
五千年前，我的祖先，伟大的$NAME_SilverQuill$，是$NAME_CaptainNess$的副手。他忠心耿耿地为她服务多年，可最终得到了什么回报？

背叛！

她将他交给了当局，并独吞了赏金！当然，没有任何监狱能够囚禁强大的$NAME_SilverQuill$。

在一次大胆的逃脱后，他从灰烬中崛起，将他的杂牌军锻造成如今站在你面前的传奇$NAME_BlackNeedle$。他发誓要报复背叛他的$NAME_CaptainNess$，将毕生精力投入到掠夺她的宝藏，并用自己的成功掩埋她的名声。

我只是在完成他的遗愿。这张星图是夺回我们应得之物的关键。

现在，请把它交出来。
grand_archive.8410.d.reply.en:
5000 years ago my ancestor, the great $NAME_SilverQuill$, was the First Mate of $NAME_CaptainNess$. He gave her years of loyal service, and how was he repaid?

Betrayal!

She handed him over to the authorities and pocketed the bounty! But of course, no prison could contain the mighty $NAME_SilverQuill$.

After a daring escape, he rose from the proverbial ashes, forging his motley crew into the legendary $NAME_BlackNeedle$ that stands before you today. Swearing revenge against the traitorous $NAME_CaptainNess$, he dedicated his life to looting her treasure and burying her legacy under the weight of his own success.

I am simply finishing what he started. This chart is the key to reclaiming what is rightfully ours.

Now please, hand it over.

grand_archive.8410.desc.zh:
尽管身材矮小，这位海盗船长却散发着威严。他的眼睛在盘算着，仿佛在解一道复杂的方程式，将我们仔细评估。

终于见面了。$NAME_CobaltQuill$，$NAME_BlackNeedle$号船长，我们家族的荣耀，也是$NAME_SilverQuill$创始人的后裔，向您致敬！您多年来一直是我们的一根刺——但我还是讲道理的。我带着一个提议而来。

我们会为您的完整星图支付丰厚的赏金，并允许您带着你们无足轻重的性命离开。

如果您拒绝，我们将别无选择，只能强行夺取我们想要的东西。我们的海军实力占优，并且我们也渗透了您帝国的所有关键设施。只要我一声令下，您就会彻底崩溃。
grand_archive.8410.desc.en:
Despite his small stature, this pirate captain emanates gravitas. His eyes are calculating, weighing us up as if part of a complex equation.

At last we finally meet. $NAME_CobaltQuill$ at your service; Captain of the illustrious $NAME_BlackNeedle$ and humble descendant of our founder, $NAME_SilverQuill$. You have been a thorn in my side for a great many years - but I'm reasonable if nothing else. I come to you with an offer.

We will give you a significant bounty for your completed chart and allow you to leave with your meaningless lives intact.

If you refuse, we will have no choice but to take what we want by force. Our naval superiority notwithstanding, we have also infiltrated every place you hold dear. A single command of mine is all that keeps you from total ruin.

grand_archive.8415.b.effect_tt.zh:
失去$celestial_chart$
获得你的最大$r_energy$的+$@max_credit_mult|0%$
获得一艘来自$NAME_BlackNeedle$的舰船
grand_archive.8415.b.effect_tt.en:
Lose the $celestial_chart$
Gain +$@max_credit_mult|0%$ of your maximum $r_energy$
Gain a ship from the $NAME_BlackNeedle$

grand_archive.8415.desc.zh:
$NAME_BlackNeedle$的首领提出了一项提议，他们愿意支付巨额赏金来换取$celestial_chart$。如果我们接受了这个交易，就等于将$NAME_CaptainNess$宝藏的关键拱手相让。

拒绝他们的提议将会招致他们的怒火。这些海盗渗透到我们军队序列中的程度尚不清楚，但他们威胁要从内部彻底瓦解[this.GetName]。这些威胁是否只是虚张声势，还有待观察。
grand_archive.8415.desc.en:
The leader of the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ has made a proposition, offering us a significant bounty in exchange for the $celestial_chart$. If we took this deal, we would be handing over the key to $NAME_CaptainNess$'s treasure.

Rejecting this proposal will invoke their full wrath. The extent to which these pirates have infiltrated our ranks is unknown, but they have threatened to completely dismantle [this.GetName] from the inside out. Whether these are but empty threats remains to be seen.

grand_archive.8500.a.tt.en: All ships are ejected from the $TREASURE_TROVE$ system.

grand_archive.8500.desc.zh:
我们以一笔巨额$MONEY$和一艘名为针眼的非凡军舰作为报酬，给出了$celestial_chart$。我们可以认为我们与$NAME_BlackNeedle$的争端已彻底解决。

我们避免了与他们全部舰队进行重大交战，并阻止了一次对星系规模的蓄意破坏企图。

最好还是让海盗们继续做他们的海盗勾当。
grand_archive.8500.desc.en:
We handed over the $celestial_chart$ in exchange for a large sum of $MONEY$ and an exceptional military flagship known as The Eye of the Needle. We can consider our dispute with the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ to be settled once and for all.

We have avoided a significant engagement with the full force of their fleets and prevented a sabotage attempt on a galactic scale.

Better that we simply leave piracy to the pirates.

grand_archive.8505.desc.zh:
$NAME_BlackNeedle$发起了全面攻击，给我们带来影响广泛的混乱。生产线停产，发电机烧毁，重要的行政基础设施被迫下线。货物消失，研究站的数据被清空，矿井坍塌速度是正常速度的五倍。

这场全方位的破坏是数千名歹毒的参与者协同作案的结果。一个庞大的破坏者网络潜伏在我们之中，他们似乎总是领先我们一步。
grand_archive.8505.desc.en:
The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ has launched an all-out assault, unleashing widespread chaos. Assembly lines have ground to a halt, generators have burnt out, and essential administrative infrastructure has been taken offline. Shipments are disappearing, research stations have had their data wiped, and mines are collapsing at five times the typical rate.

The devastation is total; the result of insidious handiwork of thousands of malevolent actors working in tandem. A vast network of saboteurs is hidden among us and they seem to be one step ahead of us.

grand_archive.8520.a.tt.zh: 每个有人居住的行星都会有100£pop£人口被消灭。
grand_archive.8520.a.tt.en: 100 £pop£ Pops are killed in every populated planet.

grand_archive.8520.b.machine.zh: 对偏离的单元进行重编程。

grand_archive.8520.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

我们已经得知他们的特工多年来一直在招募心怀不满的公民，为这次大规模袭击做准备，他们利用潜伏的间谍网络和各种随时准备背叛我们的线人。

其中一名叛徒已暴露，正是[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]，这构成了重大的安全风险。我们必须处理这个阴谋家，同时保持一定程度的稳定。公众得知这种程度的腐败将对我们的政府造成严重后果。
grand_archive.8520.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

We have learned their operatives have been recruiting disgruntled citizens for years, preparing for this extensive attack with sleeper cells and a variety of assets ready to turn against us.

One of the traitors has been revealed to be [traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName], which presents a considerable security risk. We must deal with this conspirator while maintaining some sense of stability. Public knowledge of this level of corruption would have serious repercussions for our government.

grand_archive.8520.desc.hive.zh:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

他们的特工一直在居住地释放分离性信息素，导致我们许多工蜂产生了潜在的偏差。一旦被迷惑住，海盗们将我们的工蜂重新安置到休眠特工的舱室，他们目前正在破坏我们的基础设施。

这个庞大的计划已经发展到腐蚀[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]。
grand_archive.8520.desc.hive.en:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

Their operatives have been flooding habitats with dissociative pheromones, causing many of our drones to develop an underlying deviance. Once disillusioned, the pirates reorganized our drones into pods of sleeper agents who are currently tearing down our infrastructure.

The extensive scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], [traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName].

grand_archive.8520.desc.machine.zh:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

他们的特工一直秘密地在我们的操作系统中传播恶意软件，制造了一个由叛乱单位构成的休眠军队，潜伏在我们系统各个位置。

这个歹毒的重新编程计划已经走得如此之远，以至于腐化了[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]。
grand_archive.8520.desc.machine.en:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

Their operatives have been covertly spreading insidious malware within our operating systems, creating a sleeper army of rebel units occupying various positions across our systems.

The malicious reprogramming scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], [traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName].

grand_archive.8525.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetName]已被处决。

[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]死亡的具体情况尚未公开。
grand_archive.8525.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetName] has been executed.

The exact circumstances of [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] death have been kept discrete.

grand_archive.8530.desc.default.zh:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetName]已得到充分的纠正。

不幸的是，这种再教育过程给[traitor_leader.GetName]留下了持久的负面影响。
grand_archive.8530.desc.default.en:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetName] has been sufficiently corrected.

Unfortunately, this re-education process has left a lasting negative impression on [traitor_leader.GetName].

grand_archive.8530.desc.hive.zh:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetName]已得到充分的纠正。

不幸的是，这次重新同化过程给[traitor_leader.GetName]留下了持久的负面印象。
grand_archive.8530.desc.hive.en:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetName] has been sufficiently corrected.

Unfortunately, this re-assimilation process has left a lasting negative impression on [traitor_leader.GetName].

grand_archive.8530.desc.machine.zh:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetName]已被充分重新编程。

不幸的是，这种重塑过程给[traitor_leader.GetName]留下了持久的负面印象。
grand_archive.8530.desc.machine.en:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetName] has been sufficiently reprogrammed.

Unfortunately, this reformatting process has left a lasting negative impression on [traitor_leader.GetName].

grand_archive.8535.desc.zh: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[root.GetName]愤怒的市民集结起来进行抗议。这群义愤填膺的暴民冲进[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]的家中。[traitor_leader.GetHeSheCap]后来被宣布当场死亡。
grand_archive.8535.desc.en: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, furious citizens of [root.GetName] gathered in organized protests. The vigilante mob stormed [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] home. [traitor_leader.GetHeSheCap] was later pronounced dead at the scene.

grand_archive.8536.a.tt.en: [traitor_leader.GetName] gains a level of Negative Traits

grand_archive.8536.desc.zh:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetHeShe]发布了一份公开声明，对[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]的行为表示深深的悔恨。这场磨难似乎对[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]的领导能力产生了持久的影响。

尽管过去犯下种种错误，但[root.GetName]的人民似乎愿意原谅[traitor_leader.GetName]。
grand_archive.8536.desc.en:
$grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetHeShe] released a public statement expressing a deep regret for [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] actions. This ordeal seems to have left a lasting effect on [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] ability to lead.

Despite their past deeds, it seems like the people of [root.GetName] are willing to forgive [traitor_leader.GetName].

grand_archive.8545.desc.zh:
不幸的是，我们无法阻止$NAME_BlackNeedle$的破坏行动。他们的破坏者已经彻底破坏了我们的后勤基础设施，重建供应链将需要数年时间。他们在我们的恒星系中传播的腐败规模太大，无法得到缓解。

然而，这不会阻止我们以我们的名义夺取$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$。我们只需要在战斗中击败海盗，宝藏就会属于我们。
grand_archive.8545.desc.en:
Unfortunately, we were unable to thwart the devastating operations of $NAME_BlackNeedle$. Their saboteurs have damaged our logistics infrastructure beyond repair, and it will take many years to rebuild our supply chains. The corruption they've spread throughout our systems is on too grand of a scale to be mitigated.

However, this will not stop us from claiming $NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$ in our name. All that we must do is defeat the pirates in battle, and the treasure will be ours.

grand_archive.8550.desc.zh: 尽管$NAME_BlackNeedle$竭尽全力破坏我们的基础设施，我们依然得到恢复并稳定了局势。他们的特工已被击败，剩下的就是与他们在[hoard_system.GetName]集结的舰队对抗，并以[root.GetName]的名义夺取$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$。
grand_archive.8550.desc.en: Despite the extensive efforts of the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ to sabotage our infrastructure, we have recovered and stabilized. With their agents defeated, all that remains is to confront their amassed fleet in [hoard_system.GetName] and claim $NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$ in the name of [root.GetName].

grand_archive.8555.desc.zh: $NAME_BlackNeedle$的军力根本无法与我们强大的军队抗衡。他们集结的舰队已被击败，无法再支持对我们恒星系的破坏行动。现在，我们可以在[root.GetName]的名义下夺取$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$。
grand_archive.8555.desc.en: The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ could simply not compete with the might of our military. With their amassed fleets defeated, they can no longer support the sabotage efforts within our systems. We are now free to claim $NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$ in the name of [root.GetName].

grand_archive.8560.desc.zh:
奈斯的孩子们……真是讽刺。

是她选择了你——你知道吗？

数百种物种任她挑选……她却选择了你。也许她看到了你身上的特别之处，也许这只是一场纯粹的偶然。无论如何，我们都走到了这一步。

你赢了……暂时。不要轻视这场胜利。你已经树立了强大的敌人——我们，$NAME_BlackNeedle$我们不会宽恕，也不会忘记。

就像我的祖先一样，我们会坚持下去。我们会一点一点地重建我们失去的一切。即使需要一千年，一百万年——我们也会回来，夺回你从我们手中夺走的一切。

$NAME_BlackNeedle$将永远存在！永远！
grand_archive.8560.desc.en:
Ness's children... how ironic.

She chose you - do you know that?

Hundreds of species to choose from... and she chose you. Maybe she saw something special in you, or maybe it was complete chance. Either way, here we are.

You win... for now. Do not dare take this victory lightly. You have made a powerful enemy in us. The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ does not forgive, and we do not forget.

As my ancestors did before me, we will persevere. We will rebuild what we have lost piece by piece. Even if it takes a thousand years, a million years - we will return and reclaim everything you have stolen from us.

The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ will live on forever! Forever!

grand_archive.8565.desc.zh:
$celestial_chart$是钥匙，而宝库是它的锁。我们把它插入巨型结构的主舱口。

星图启动，内部追踪着一道单一的的光束，指向我们旅程中经过的每一颗恒星。古老的机器发出咯吱咯吱的响声，我们很快便进入了内部。

来自一千个世界的难以置信的宝藏，在地板和墙壁上堆积如山。精致的雕像与用贵金属打造的攻击武器并列。精美的珠宝悬挂在古老化石的末端，复杂的装置堆积成一堆，毫无秩序。

金属的脚步声从中央走道传来。一只充满液体的类人生物机器，举起双臂投降，向我们走来。它的语音电路发出噼啪声，启动了：

“所以……你最终还是找到了我的星图。你真聪明。”
grand_archive.8565.desc.en:
The $celestial_chart$ was a key, and the vault was its lock. We inserted it into the main hatch of the megastructure.

The chart activated, internally tracing a singular beam of light to each star along our journey. Ancient machinery groaned to life, and we were soon inside.

Incredible treasures looted from a thousand worlds line the floor and walls in abundance. Delicate statues are juxtaposed against assault weapons forged in precious metals. Fine jewelry hangs from the extremities of antique fossils and complex devices are piled up in an orderless heap.

Metallic footsteps ring out from the central walkway. Arms raised in surrender, a fluid-filled humanoid machine approaches us. Its voice circuits crackle into activation:

"So... you found my chart after all. Aren't you clever?"

grand_archive.8570.a.reply_curator.zh:
永生可不是便宜货。我花了几百万能量币，请了$NAME_Curator_Order$的科学家帮我转移意识，而且没引起警觉。他们干得还不错，但我现在跳起舞来可没以前那么好了。

$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$
grand_archive.8570.a.reply_curator.en:
Immortality doesn't come cheap. I paid some scientists from $NAME_Curator_Order$ a few million credits to transfer my consciousness without raising the alarm. They did a fair job, but I can't dance as well as I used to.

$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$

grand_archive.8570.a.reply_fallen_empire.zh:
永生可不是便宜货。我花了几百万能量币，请了[fallen_empire.GetRealName]的科学家帮我转移意识，而且没引起警觉。他们干得还不错，但我现在跳起舞来可没以前那么好了。

$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$
grand_archive.8570.a.reply_fallen_empire.en:
Immortality doesn't come cheap. I paid some scientists from [fallen_empire.GetRealName] a few million credits to transfer my consciousness without raising the alarm. They did a fair job, but I can't dance as well as I used to.

$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$

grand_archive.8570.b.zh: 你这些宝藏是从哪里来的？
grand_archive.8570.b.en: Where did you get all of this treasure?

grand_archive.8570.b.reply.zh:
大部分都是偷来的，或者用其他不义之财换来的。我曾经从星海的所有大人物那里偷过东西。货船、巨像武器，你随便说，我都劫持过。我的逻辑是，如果我能这么容易地从你那里拿走东西，说明你根本不在乎，不配拥有它。

有时候事情会变得……很糟糕。你看到了乙特人发生了什么。那件事让我大开眼界。

玩玩闹闹，直到不再有趣……
grand_archive.8570.b.reply.en:
Stole it, mostly. Or traded it for other ill-gotten goods. I ripped off every major player in the galaxy once upon a time. Cargo ships, Colossus weapons; you name it, I've hijacked it. My logic was that if I could take something so easily from you, you didn't care enough to deserve it.

Things would sometimes get... messy. You saw what happened to the Ytterites. That one was an eye-opener.

It's all fun and games until it's not any more...

grand_archive.8570.c.reply.zh:
如果说是因为我孤独，你会相信吗？

机器的语音电路发出应该称之为笑声的咯咯声。

我拥有了所有这些财富，但为了什么？最终能给我带来什么？我意识到我想要的不是财富，而是传承。但是，你无法偷走传承——那么如何创造一个呢？

好吧，我是这么打算的。我找到了几个最有希望的原始物种，并在他们的世界中播下了宝藏——当然还有地图。第一个拼凑出我的藏宝图的人将通过考验，并有资格继承我毕生的基业。于是……我们就在这里碰面了。

也许你们一族能做到我做不到的事情，并将所有这些付诸实践。
grand_archive.8570.c.reply.en:
Would you believe me if I said I was lonely?

The machine's vocal circuits crackled with what might have been laughter.

I had all of this treasure, but for what? What does it get me in the end? I realized it wasn't riches that I wanted; it was a legacy. But, you can't steal a legacy - so how do you create one?

Well, this was my shot at it. I found a few of the most promising primitive species and seeded their worlds with treasure - and the map of course. Whoever pieced together my chart first would pass the test and be worthy of inheriting my life's work. So... here we are.

Maybe your kind can do what I could not, and put all of this to good use.

grand_archive.8570.d.reply.zh:
我已经告诉过你们，我要把火炬传下去。我并不擅长花钱，只会赚钱。

不过，我不能把钱随便给任何人。他们必须足够聪明才能来到这里；一支我能为之骄傲的队伍。一支我能与之分享我的故事的队伍……
grand_archive.8570.d.reply.en:
I've told you, I'm passing on the torch. I'm not good at spending money, only taking it.

I couldn't give it away to just anyone, though. They had to be clever enough to reach this place; a crew I could be proud of. One I could share my story with...

grand_archive.8570.desc.zh:
尽管她的机械形态限制了其表达能力，但被称为奈斯船长的机器却用一种自鸣得意的眼神看着我们。她的金属身体没有丝毫磨损的迹象，仿佛刚组装不久。她的语气既耐心又居高临下，仿佛在对一个地位低于她的人说话。

我想应该做个自我介绍，尽管你可能已经猜到我是谁了。

我叫桑达·奈斯，或者至少以前是。曾经的“星海海盗女王”，现在是这堆冰冷螺栓的主人。

机器停顿了一下，观察着我们的形态。

我已经很久没有见过你们这种生物了。看起来你们这些原始人已经长大成人了！

我必须说，我对你们能来到这里感到非常惊讶。
grand_archive.8570.desc.en:
Despite the limited expressions available in her robotic form, the machine known as Captain Ness regards us with a certain smugness. Her metallic body shows no sign of wear and tear, as if only recently assembled. Her tone is patient yet patronizing, as if addressing one below her status.

I suppose some introduction is in order, though you may already have guessed who I am.

The name's Saanda Ness, or at least it was. Former "Pirate Queen of the Galaxy" and current occupant of this cold pile of bolts.

The machine pauses for a moment, taking in our forms.

It's been a long time since I last saw your species. Looks like you primitives are all grown up!

I must say, I'm quite impressed you've made it here.

grand_archive.8570.e.reply.zh:
好吧，既然你诚心诚意地发问了……

机器启动了一个控制台，一系列数字记录被投射到墙上。

整个藏宝库都是我的自传。我花了很多钱雇佣了一支作家团队，记录下我生命中所有可以记住的时刻。我认为他们做得还不错。

图像切换到一个海盗船员的驾驶舱画面，船长奈斯的生物形态在指挥。机器的语音电路发出一声短暂的噼啪声；那是一声叹息。

我曾经是星系中最令人恐惧的海盗。我让大型企业破产，勒索星球，并将整个帝国夷为平地。任何愚蠢到敢于反对我的人，要么被我的[root.GetSpeciesOrganName]刺穿，要么被卖掉换取赏金。我自己的赏金？天文数字。
grand_archive.8570.e.reply.en:
Well, since you asked...

The machine activates a console, and a series of digital recordings are projected across the wall.

This entire vault is my biography. I paid a great deal to a team of authors to record every moment of my life that could be remembered. They did a fair job of it, I think.

The images shift to a cockpit image of a pirate crew, the biological form of Captain Ness in command. A short crackle escapes the machine's voice circuits; it has the weight of a sigh.

I was once the most feared pirate in the galaxy. I've bankrupted mega-corporations, ransomed planets, and reduced entire empires to rubble. Anyone foolish enough to oppose me got a blade in their [root.GetSpeciesOrganName] or were sold off for a bounty. My own bounty? Astronomical.

grand_archive.8570.f.reply.zh:
各种抢劫、盗窃和惊险逃脱的数字记录，伴随着史诗音乐的投影，在屏幕上播放。

起初，我精心挑选目标，并为自己的行为寻找正当理由，认为他们罪有应得。每一次行动都比上一次更刺激。这是一个循环：计划、妖魔化、抢劫、然后庆祝。问题是寻找“坏”目标太耗时了。我需要拓宽视野。

最终，如果我想要什么，我就直接拿走。我喜欢看着数字上涨，我的战利品的价值和我的宝藏的价值。我在世界上留下了自己的印记，我将永远不会被遗忘。其他一切都不重要。
grand_archive.8570.f.reply.en:
Digital recordings of various hold-ups, heists, and daring escapes, all set to heroic music are projected.

At first, I picked my targets carefully and found some justification as to why they deserved it. Each job was more exciting than the last. It was a cycle: planning, demonizing, robbing, then celebrating. The problem was that looking for "bad" targets was too time-consuming. I needed to expand my horizons.

Eventually, if there was something I wanted, I'd just take it. I enjoyed watching the numbers go up; the price of my bounty and the value of my hoard. I was leaving my mark on the world and I'd never be forgotten. Everything else was unimportant.

grand_archive.8570.g.reply.zh:
乙特人的家园已经成为一片废墟。

然后，乙特星事件发生了……你看到了吧？我还记得广播里传来的哭喊声，那是他们最后生命的消逝。事情已经走得太远了。是时候改变了。

在我的职业生涯中，我发现了一个规律：历史会淡忘，教训会被遗忘，总会有新人来接替你的位置。我只是想选择接替我的人。

那就是你。你们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]通过了考验。接下来会发生什么，就取决于你了。
grand_archive.8570.g.reply.en:
The Ytterite homeworld is displayed in ruin.

Then the Yterrite incident happened... You saw it, right? I still remember the cries on the radio as the last of their lives were snuffed out. Things went too far. It was time for a change.

There was a pattern I discovered over my career: History fades, lessons are forgotten, and someone new takes your place. I simply wanted to be able to pick who came after me.

That's you. You [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] passed the test. What happens next is up to you.

grand_archive.8575.a.lom.zh: 夺取我们辛苦赚来的战利品。

grand_archive.8575.b.zh: 将可以溯源的物品归还给其合法所有者。
grand_archive.8575.b.en: Return traceable items to their rightful owners.

grand_archive.8575.c.zh: 将这笔财富布施给整个星系。
grand_archive.8575.c.en: Distribute this wealth among the entire galaxy.

grand_archive.8575.desc.default.zh:
$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$包含着难以置信的财富。然而，我们必须考虑以我们的名义宣称它所带来的后果。

她宝藏中的每一笔信用都是非法获得的。获取这些资源将意味着我们容忍$NAME_CaptainNess$的过度犯罪行为，以换取物质财富。

话虽如此，许多被$NAME_CaptainNess$伤害的人早已不在人世。宣称这笔财富不会造成新的受害者。此外，我们已经消灭了$NAME_BlackNeedle$，从而使星系变得更加安全。经过漫长的危险旅程，我们理所当然地应该得到丰厚的回报。

我们必须决定如何处理它。
grand_archive.8575.desc.default.en:
$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$ contains an incredible bounty of wealth. We must however consider the consequences of claiming it in our name.

Every credit of her treasure was earned illegally. Taking these resources would represent a tolerance of $NAME_CaptainNess$'s excessive criminality in exchange for material wealth.
