That said, many of those wronged by $NAME_CaptainNess$ are long gone. Claiming this wealth would create no new victims. Furthermore, we have decimated the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ and thus made the galaxy a safer place. Having traveled this long path fraught with danger, we arguably deserve a sizable reward for our efforts.

We must make a decision on what to do with its contents.

grand_archive.8575.desc.lom.zh:
$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$是终极的藏宝地，我们很高兴能获得它的战利品。

这是打败了$NAME_BlackNeedle$的应得奖励——为[this.GetName]三呼万岁！

让我们清理这个金库。所有[This.Species.GetHandNamePlural]准备就位！
grand_archive.8575.desc.lom.en:
$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$ is the ultimate treasure trove, and we are pleased to claim its booty.

A hard-earned reward for taking down the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ - three cheers for [this.GetName]!

Let's clear out this vault. All [This.Species.GetHandNamePlural] on deck!

grand_archive.8580.a.zh: 我们可以让你担任一名舰队指战员。
grand_archive.8580.a.en: We could use you as a pilot.

grand_archive.8580.a.tt.zh: 获得一位等级10的不朽舰队司令

grand_archive.8580.b.zh: 我们将把你的知识融入我们的意识。
grand_archive.8580.b.en: We will integrate your knowledge into our consciousness.

grand_archive.8580.c.en: Help us in training our new pilots.

grand_archive.8580.desc.1.zh:
现在被称为$NAME_CaptainNess$的机器对我们清空她的珍宝库的速度印象深刻。

去吧，你应得的。这笔财富里包含着许多血汗和泪水。别在一个地方花光了。
grand_archive.8580.desc.1.en:
The machine now known as $NAME_CaptainNess$ was impressed at how quickly we emptied her vault.

Go ahead, you deserve it. There's a lot of blood, sweat, and tears in this treasure. Don't spend it all in one place.

grand_archive.8580.desc.2.zh:
现在被称为$NAME_CaptainNess$的机器对我们想要归还她辛苦赚来的宝藏感到不安。

真是令人失望。所以某个第十五代继承人会得到他们祖先的旧首饰。好吧，希望你们能把剩下的东西用在更有价值的项目上。尽管你们最近干了些蠢事，但我相信你们会把这件事做好。
grand_archive.8580.desc.2.en:
The machine now known as $NAME_CaptainNess$ was perturbed at our desire to repatriate some of her hard-earned treasure.

How disappointing. So some fifteenth-generation heirling will get their ancestor's old jewelry. Well, hopefully you'll use whatever's left on a worthier project. Despite recent evidence, I trust you to get this right.

grand_archive.8580.desc.3.zh:
现在被称为$NAME_CaptainNess$的机器得知我们要把她的全部积蓄都送出去，感到十分厌恶。

这就是你的计划？免费送给所有人？他们做了什么值得得到这些？真是浪费！

我对你原本抱有更高的期望……至少让我指挥一些你的舰队，让我可以再试一次曾经的海盗生涯。
grand_archive.8580.desc.3.en:
The machine now known as $NAME_CaptainNess$ was disgusted when she learned that we would be giving away her entire hoard.

This is your master plan? Free stuff for everyone? What did they do to deserve any of it? What a waste!

I thought better of you... at least give me command of some of your fleets so I can try this all over again.

grand_archive.8580.desc.default.zh: 现在的问题是该如何处理$NAME_CaptainNess$本人。作为一名经验丰富的舰船驾驶员，她经历过无数危险遭遇，将成为我们军队中优秀的指挥官。或者，她也可以在我们队伍中担任更具保障性的角色，培训下一代飞行员。
grand_archive.8580.desc.default.en: The question remains of what to do with $NAME_CaptainNess$ herself. As an experienced pilot who has survived a multitude of dangerous encounters, she would be an excellent asset to our military as a Commander. Alternatively, she could take a more supporting role within our ranks to train our next generation of pilots.

grand_archive.8580.desc.gestalt.zh:
唯一剩下的决定是关于$NAME_CaptainNess$本人。作为一名强大的独立思想者，她可以成为一名独特的指挥官，提供出敌不意的创意策略。或者，我们可以将她的丰富战斗经验融入我们的集体知识中，并利用它来进一步加深我们对战争的理解。

或者我们也可以干脆将她囚禁起来，以表明在[this.GetName]中不容忍背叛和犯罪行为。
grand_archive.8580.desc.gestalt.en:
The only remaining decision is to do with $NAME_CaptainNess$ herself. As a powerful independent mind, she would make for a unique asset in a Commander role, offering creative strategies that could catch opponents off-guard. Alternatively, we could integrate her vast combat experience into our collective knowledge and use it to further our wider understanding of warfare.

That is unless we simply imprison her to make it clear that deviance and criminality are not to be tolerated within [this.GetName].

grand_archive.8580.desc.no_lom.zh: 或者我们也可以她关起来，以此向我们的公民表明，任何罪行都不会逍遥法外。她将有足够的时间反思自己的所作所为。
grand_archive.8580.desc.no_lom.en: That is unless we simply incarcerate her to set an example to our citizens that no crime goes unpunished. She would have a long time to think about what she's done.

grand_archive.8585.desc.zh:
就这样了？

你只是把我抛弃了？

真令人失望……我想我该走了。

祝你好运，我想。
grand_archive.8585.desc.en:
That's it, then?

You're just casting me aside?

How disappointing... I guess I'll be on my way.

Good luck out there, I guess.

grand_archive.8590.desc.zh:
你这个脑袋空空的傻屌！我给你整个世界，你却只给我一副新的镣铐？你不配得到我给你的东西！你甚至不配为我擦靴子！

愿这[this.GetName]上留下一块黑斑，诅咒你们所有人！

愿你们的[this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]在虚空中枯萎，愿你们的名字被人遗忘。
grand_archive.8590.desc.en:
You empty-minded echo! I offer you the world and all I get is a fresh pair of cuffs? You don't deserve what I've given you! You don't deserve to clean my boots!

A black spot on the [this.GetName], a curse upon you all!

May your [this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] wither in the void and and your name be forgotten.

grand_archive.8595.desc.zh:
名为$NAME_CaptainNess$的机器俘虏被发现在她的牢房里停机。我们相信她故意导致了电路的严重故障，关闭了关键系统，并从她转移的意识中删除了所有存储的数据。在她牢房的墙壁上发现了一条潦草的留言：

与你同归于尽……
grand_archive.8595.desc.en:
The captive machine known as $NAME_CaptainNess$ was found deactivated in her cell. We believe that she had purposely caused a critical malfunction in her circuits, shutting down crucial systems and erasing all stored data from her transferred consciousness. A message was found scribbled on her cell walls:

To the void with you...

grand_archive.8600.desc.default.zh:
这场冒险已经结束。寻找船长奈斯的宝藏的任务已经完成。

$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$

这才是[this.GetName]故事的真正开始。
grand_archive.8600.desc.default.en:
This adventure has come to an end. The quest for the Treasure of Captain Ness is complete.

$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$

This is where the story of [this.GetName] truly begins.

grand_archive.8600.desc.lom.zh:
他们会怎样讲述这段冒险故事！我们发现了奈斯船长的隐藏宝藏，没有人能阻挡我们。

$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$

高高地挂起[this.GetName]的旗帜，现在我们的故事才真正开始！
grand_archive.8600.desc.lom.en:
What tales they will tell of this adventure! We discovered the hidden treasure of Captain Ness and let no crew stand in our way.

$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$

Mount the jack of [this.GetName] high and proud. Now our story truly begins!

grand_archive.9005.a.tt.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]将被释放并回归我们的队伍。
grand_archive.9005.a.tt.en: [fromfrom.GetName] will be released and return to our ranks.

grand_archive.9005.desc.zh: 我们的[fromfrom.GetClass][fromfrom.GetName]在[fromfromfrom.GetName]战斗中被[from.GetName]俘虏。他们要求支付赎金以交换[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的性命。
grand_archive.9005.desc.en: Our [fromfrom.GetClass] [fromfrom.GetName] has been captured by [from.GetName] during the battle in [fromfromfrom.GetName]. They have demanded ransom in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

grand_archive.9005.desc.second.zh: 正如先前通报，我们的指挥官[fromfrom.GetName]被[from.GetName]俘虏，他们愿意接受支付赎金以换取[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的生命。
grand_archive.9005.desc.second.en: As previously reported, our Commander [fromfrom.GetName] has been captured by [from.GetName] who are willing to accept payment in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

grand_archive.9010.desc.zh: 由于[from.GetName]拒绝支付[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的赎金，敌军指挥官[fromfrom.GetName]仍被我们扣押。[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的命运将如何？
grand_archive.9010.desc.en: Following the unwillingness of [from.GetName] to pay for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] return, enemy Commander [fromfrom.GetName] remains in our custody. What is to be [fromfrom.GetHisHer] fate?

grand_archive.9960.desc.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功捕获了第一批野生太空兽群，我们相信只要投入足够的科学资金，就可以克隆出更多这样的生物。
grand_archive.9960.desc.en: With our first successful capture of wild Space Fauna in [from.solar_system.GetName], we believe it possible to clone more of these creatures with the proper scientific investment.

grand_archive.9970.desc.zh:
在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功克隆出首例太空兽群。

我们对异星生物学的深入研究表明，我们可以进一步增强这些生物的生理机能，如果我们选择这样做的话。这将使我们能够为生物舰队配备专门的战斗组件。
grand_archive.9970.desc.en:
The first successfully cloned Space Fauna has been created in [from.solar_system.GetName].

Our research into xenobiology indicates even more can be done to enhance these creatures' physiologies, should we choose to do so. This will allow us to outfit our biological fleets with specialized combat components.

grateful_populace_tt.zh: [Target.GetName]的人们对我们的评价提高了。
grateful_populace_tt.en: The people of [Target.GetName] have an increased opinion of us.

graygoo.10.b.desc.zh:
我们的技术人员设法解除了[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]附近的L-星门的锁定，但刚刚建立至L-星团的永久连接，就侦测到一波巨大的亚空间波动！

由纳米机器组成的奇怪舰船正从这些完全启动的星门中涌出，攻击目所能及的一切！

与这些机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
graygoo.10.b.desc.en:
Our technicians managed to lift the lockdown from the L-Gate near [candidate_gateway_system.GetName], but as soon as a permanent link was established to the L-Cluster, a massive incoming subspace surge was detected!

Strange vessels consisting of nanites are pouring through the now fully active gate, attacking everything in sight!

All attempts to communicate with these machines have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gate, we have detected a repeating subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

graygoo.10.desc.zh:
我们的技术人员设法解除了[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]附近的L-星门的锁定，但刚刚与L-星团建立了永久连接，我们就侦测到一波巨大的亚空间波动！我们设法限制这一潜在的侵略者使用我们的星门，同时确保我们自己仍可使用。

不幸的是，这一波动被导向了星系中的其它L-星门。由纳米机器组成的奇怪舰船正从这些完全启动的星门中涌出，攻击目所能及的一切！

与这些机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
graygoo.10.desc.en:
Our technicians managed to lift the lockdown from the L-Gate near [candidate_gateway_system.GetName], but as soon as a permanent link was established to the L-Cluster, a massive incoming subspace surge was detected! We were able to restrict this potential invasion force from using our gate, while still retaining access for ourselves.

Unfortunately, the incoming surge was diverted to the other L-Gates in the galaxy. Strange vessels consisting of nanites are pouring through these now fully active gates, attacking everything in sight!

All attempts to communicate with these machines have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gates, we have detected a repeating subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

graygoo.11.desc.zh:
来自[From.GetName]的科学家们设法使其领土内的L-星门恢复了运转，抢先了我们一步。不幸的是，这似乎触发了星团住民对我们星系的进攻——攻击一切的敌对纳米机器！

[From.GetSpeciesName]的科学家们在攻击抵达之前设法关闭了他们的星门，但这只是将其导向了星系中的其它L-星门，这些星门现在已经完全开启！

与这些进攻的纳米机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
graygoo.11.desc.en:
Scientists from the [From.GetName] managed to restore functionality to the L-Gate within their territory, beating us to it. Unfortunately, this seems to have triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

The [From.GetSpeciesName] scientists managed to shut down their gate before the invasion force arrived, but this only diverted them to the other L-Gates of the galaxy, that are now fully active!

All attempts to communicate with these invading nanites have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gates, we have detected a repeating wide-band subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

graygoo.110.desc.zh: $distar.10951.desc$L-星门刚刚启动，我们就收到了来自另一侧的信号传输。
graygoo.110.desc.en: $distar.10951.desc$ As soon as the L-Gate became operational, we received a transmission from the other side.

graygoo.111.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]成功解除了他们控制的L-星门的封锁！

$graygoo.111.dessanu.desc$
graygoo.111.desc.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control!

$graygoo.111.dessanu.desc$

graygoo.115.a.response.zh:
是的！真是非常丢脸。看起来，L-星门网络似乎进入了一个永不终结的维护周期。当发生这起意外之时，有权终止维护周期的技师都在我们这边，因此我们无能为力。

幸运的是，我们的母星团可以自给自足，而且我们的文明一直默默地忍耐到了这一刻。我们一直相信，与星系重聚的那一天终将来临。
graygoo.115.a.response.en:
Yes! Quite embarrassing. Apparently, the L-Gate network entered a scheduled maintenance cycle that never ended. The technicians qualified to end the cycle were all on our side when it was accidentally triggered, and nothing could be done from here.

Fortunately, our home cluster is self-sufficient and our civilization has quietly endured up until now. We always knew that the day would come when we were reunited with the rest of the galaxy.

graygoo.115.b.response.zh:
我们现在已经非常适应我们星团的生活了，我们并不急着离开。但我们很渴望了解星系里其他地方的情况！从目前所了解的情况看来，星系里似乎非常繁忙。

我们的星团将欢迎任何人到访。我们只要求你们不要在有人居住的星球上着陆，并且不要进入星团深处的[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系。那里只限德萨努族进入。
graygoo.115.b.response.en:
We have grown quite accustomed to life in our star cluster, and we're in no hurry to leave it. But we are eager to learn about the rest of the galaxy! From the looks of things, it's a pretty busy place.

Our cluster will be opened up for travel by anyone. We ask only that you refrain from landing on our inhabited planets and that you stay out of the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, located deeper inside the cluster. It is for Dessanu only.

graygoo.115.c.zh: L-星门是纳米机器造的，对吧？
graygoo.115.c.en: The L-Gates were built by nanites, were they not?

graygoo.115.c.response.zh:
纳米机器？我们不是很了解这种科技。你说的是可以自我复制的微型机械吧？老实说，这听起来挺荒唐的。

星门和L-星门——确实，我们整个文明——都是通过德萨努族的勤劳和创造力而建立的，无他。

所以请不要再讨论这个话题了。
graygoo.115.c.response.en:
Nanites? This is not a technology we are familiar with. Self-replicating microscopic machines, you say? Frankly, it sounds preposterous.

The Gateways and the L-Gates - indeed, our entire civilization - were realized through Dessanu toil and ingenuity, nothing else.

Please, let us not discuss this topic further.

graygoo.115.d.response.zh:
不要着急嘛！通过你的行动，我们德萨努人多少代以来期盼的自由终于得以实现。这样的大恩大德我们不敢或忘。

与你们的大恩相比，我们的奉献算不上什么，但我们还是想要对你们永久开放一些独特战略资源的使用权限。这些战略资源只在我们的星团有所产出。我们不求你们的任何回报，而且只要我们还有能力，就会永远为你们提供这些资源。
graygoo.115.d.response.en:
Not so fast! Through your actions, you have finally given us the freedom that generations of Dessanu have dreamed of. We are in your debt.

It is a paltry offering compared to your gift, but we would like to give you permanent access to several strategic resources from our cluster. We expect nothing in return, and we will continue to supply you with these resources for as long as we are able.

graygoo.115.desc.zh:
这……这不可能！星门再次启动了！孤立时代终于结束了吗？

我们是德萨努协和国，散落在整个星系各处的远古星门和L-星门都是我们建设的。我们的理想便是创造出遍布整个星系的星门网络，促进星际文明的传播，迎接一个和平的星际商业的新纪元。

可惜啊，一个程序错误让L-星门失效了，我们也因此被困在我们的母星团里。由于在我们这一侧并不能修正这个错误，我们只能无尽地等待，期待着有人能在另一侧修复它。多亏了你们，这一天终于来临了！
graygoo.115.desc.en:
This... this cannot be! The gates are active again! Is the Age of Isolation finally at an end?

We are the Dessanu Consonance, the architects of the ancient Gateways and L-Gates that can be found scattered throughout the galaxy. It was our ambition to create a galaxy-wide network of Gateways, to facilitate the spread of galactic civilization and usher in an era of peace and interstellar commerce.

Alas, a programming mistake disabled the L-Gates and stranded us in our home cluster. Since it was impossible to correct the error from our side, we have spent eons waiting for someone to fix it at the other end. Thanks to you, that day has finally arrived!

graygoo.116.desc.zh:
星系中的各位居民，德萨努协和国问候你！

你们发现的被遗弃的星门和L-星门，都是许久许久之前由我们建造的。我们本想在全星系建造一个由这些设备构成的网络，然而事不遂人愿：由于一个不幸的错误导致L-星门无法使用，我们被困在了自己的母星团之中。

但这孤立时代终于结束了，一切都多亏了[From.From.GetName]的天才科学家！既然L-星门已经打开，我们邀请所有人随意免费使用，以便缩短星际旅行的时间。我们的星团向所有人开放。

但[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系除外。请务必不要前往该恒星系。
graygoo.116.desc.en:
Denizens of the galaxy, greetings from the Dessanu Consonance!

Eons ago, we oversaw the construction of the Gateways and L-Gates that you may have seen abandoned. Our intention was to build a galactic network of such devices, but alas: a horrible mistake rendered the L-Gates unusable, stranding us in our home cluster.

But this Age of Isolation has finally come to an end, thanks to the clever scientists of the [From.From.GetName]! Now that the L-Gates are active again, we invite everyone to make free use of them to shorten galactic travel times. Our star cluster is open to everyone.

Except for the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system. Do not go there.

graygoo.12.a.response.zh:
解码碎片I：

“我们是<无法解读>，星系传送门网络的建筑师。如果你收到这条消息，那我们只能<无法解读>不算太晚。或许我们的一个信息浮标设法溜过了<无法解读>并在其关闭之前逃离了星团。

切勿——重复一遍——切勿重新开启前往我们星团的传送门。无论何种情况之下，都不可重新建立<无法解读>与整个星系之间的稳定连接。为了所有文明的安危，我们的星团必须被永久隔离。”
graygoo.12.a.response.en:
Decoding fragment I:

"We are the <unintelligible>, architects of the galactic Gateway network. If you are receiving this transmission, then we can only <unintelligible> that we are not too late. Perhaps one of our message buoys somehow slipped past the <unintelligible> and escaped the cluster before it was closed off.

DO NOT - repeat - DO NOT restore access to the dormant Gateway in our star cluster. Under no circumstances must a stable connection be formed between the <unintelligible> and the galaxy at large. For the sake of all civilization, our cluster has to remain under permanent quarantine."

graygoo.12.b.response.zh:
解码碎片II：

“我们故意将我们的母星团与外界进行了彻底隔离，以防纳-迪-沙——灰色风暴进一步扩散，但这一举动也注定将彻底毁灭我们的文明。这些能够自我复制的纳米机械在建造通道网络时是不可或缺的工具，但当它们的<无法解读>完成之后，我们却发现它们不再接受我们的指令了。

通过隐藏的后门程序，我们的<无法解读>成功将所有纳米机械召回了我们的母星团，但之后这一漏洞便被纳米机械自我修复了。当它们开始在我们的星球收集资源时，我们就明白——这一切只是时间问题了……”
graygoo.12.b.response.en:
Decoding fragment II:

"In an act that will inevitably doom our civilization, we have deliberately isolated our home cluster to prevent the spread of the Naar-Di-Shav - the Gray Tempest. These self-replicating nanomachines were instrumental in the construction of our Gateway network, but when their <unintelligible> had concluded, we found that they would no longer accept our commands.

Through a hidden backdoor, our <unintelligible> managed to recall the machines to our home cluster, but this security hole has since been plugged. When they started harvesting our planets for materials, we knew it was only a matter of time before..."

graygoo.12.c.response.zh:
解码碎片III：

“主<无法解读>设施是一切的关键。它们的所有<无法解读>都是通过该设施的亚空间阵列进行传输，没有了这座设施它们就无法行动。不幸的是，我们想要将其关闭的一切尝试都以失败告终，而我们也已无力聚集力量再一次<无法解读>攻击了。

如果我们星团的封锁失效，那你务必要摧毁这座设施。只要这座设施<无法解读>，灰色风暴就会继续在星系中横行霸道。

我们……是我们释放了这恐怖的风潮，实在羞愤难当。正是因为我们的傲慢，才……”
graygoo.12.c.response.en:
Decoding fragment III:

"The main <unintelligible> facility is the key. All of their <unintelligible> are routed through its subspace array, and without it they cannot function. Unfortunately, all of our attempts to disable it have failed and we can no longer muster the forces to <unintelligible> another assault.

If the quarantine of our cluster has failed, you MUST destroy this facility. As long as it remains <unintelligible>, the Gray Tempest will continue to surge unabated throughout the galaxy.

We... we are truly sorry for unleashing this horror. In our hubris, we..."

graygoo.12.desc.zh:
正在解码亚空间自动播送信息……
正在建立翻译矩阵……

警告：信息严重损坏。

正在尝试恢复信息碎片……
已部分恢复三条信息碎片。
graygoo.12.desc.en:
Decoding repeating automated subspace transmission...
Establishing translation matrix...

ALERT: Message is heavily corrupted.

Attempting reconstitution of message fragments...
Three message fragments partially recovered.

graygoo.120.desc_01.zh: 我代表L-星团向你问好！今天过得如何？
graygoo.120.desc_01.en: Greetings from the L-Cluster! How are you today?

graygoo.120.desc_02.zh: 很高兴看到我们在星系中留下的L-星门和传送门留存了下来。当我们被困在自己的星团中时，做出了最坏的设想。
graygoo.120.desc_02.en: We are glad to see that the L-Gates and the Gateways that we left behind in the galaxy survived. When we were isolated in our cluster, some of us feared the worst.

graygoo.120.desc_03.zh: 你无法想象我们对外面的星系有多好奇。
graygoo.120.desc_03.en: You can't imagine how curious we've been about the rest of the galaxy.

graygoo.120.desc_04.zh: 在这被孤立的千万年里，我们的日子过得非常……艰难。有些人甚至发疯了。
graygoo.120.desc_04.en: The countless millennia that we spent in isolation were... difficult. Some of us went quite insane.

graygoo.120.desc_05.zh: 我们必须小心地珍惜星团中仅有的资源来存活。
graygoo.120.desc_05.en: We had to nurse the limited resources of our cluster carefully to survive.

graygoo.120.desc_06.zh: 在很长一段时间里，L-星门发明者的名字被人们当成脏话挂在嘴边。但我们已经不再计较这些小事了。
graygoo.120.desc_06.en: For a long time, the name of the inventor of the L-Gate was used as a curse among our people. But we have grown beyond such pettiness now.

graygoo.120.desc_07.zh: 我们很高兴与你交易，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们星团中有些非常独特的资源，你可能会感兴趣的。
graygoo.120.desc_07.en: We would be delighted to trade with you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There are some resources unique to our cluster that might be of interest to you.

graygoo.121.a.zh: 为什么星团里有战斗的迹象？
graygoo.121.a.en: Why are there signs of battle in the cluster?

graygoo.121.a.response.zh:
噢，你是指那些碎裂的星球吗？那是很久以前发生的几起……令人惋惜的采矿事故。

当我们发现自己被困在自己的星团中时，我们必须尽可能利用星系中可以获取的一切矿物。不幸的是，在最黑暗的孤立世纪中，我们有些人获取资源时太过积极了。于是犯了错误。
graygoo.121.a.response.en:
Oh. Are you referring to the shattered planets? They were the results of several regrettable... mining accidents that occurred long ago.

When we found ourselves stranded within our cluster, we had to make do with whatever minerals were available in the systems we could reach. Unfortunately, during the darkest centuries of isolation, some of our people were a bit too eager in their attempts to secure resources. Mistakes were made.

graygoo.121.b.zh: 你们的舰船设计真奇特。
graygoo.121.b.en: Your ships are of a peculiar design.

graygoo.121.b.response.zh: 它们是无数次设计更新换代的产物。毕竟我们有的是时间。可惜，我们禁止非德萨努族登船参观。它们是专门依据德萨努族生理特点所设计，任何外来访问者都只会扰乱训练有素的船员们的工作。
graygoo.121.b.response.en: They are products of countless millennia of design iterations. We had a lot of time on our hands, after all. Sadly, non-Dessanu observers are not permitted onboard our ships. They were specifically designed with the unique Dessanu physiology in mind, and any visitors would only disrupt the work of their highly trained crews.

graygoo.121.c.response.zh:
这是出于帝国安全的考虑。目前我们只能透露这么多。

[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系对所有非德萨努生命体都是永久管制的禁区。请不要试图进入。
graygoo.121.c.response.en:
For reasons of national security. That is all we can say for now.

The [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system will remain restricted and off-limits to all non-Dessanu life forms indefinitely. Please refrain from entering it.

graygoo.121.d.zh: 你确定L-星门不是纳米机器造的吗？
graygoo.121.d.en: Are you certain the L-Gates weren't made by nanites?

graygoo.121.desc.en: What would you like to know?

graygoo.121.e.zh: 我们还是谈些别的话题吧。

graygoo.122.a.zh: 纳米机器似乎是个敏感话题。为什么？
graygoo.122.a.en: Nanites seem to be a sensitive topic. Why?

graygoo.122.b.zh: 是的，我们回到其它问题上吧。
graygoo.122.b.en: Yes, let's go back to our other questions.

graygoo.122.desc.zh: 非常确定。拜托，我们不希望讨论这个话题。你还有别的问题吗？
graygoo.122.desc.en: Quite. Please, this is not a topic we wish to discuss. Did you have any other questions?

graygoo.123.a.zh: 该死的，快告诉我们纳米机器的事！
graygoo.123.a.en: Tell us about the nanites, damn you!

graygoo.123.b.zh: 好吧。我们尊重你的愿望。
graygoo.123.b.en: Very well. We will respect your wishes.

graygoo.123.desc.zh: 我们最后一次告诉你……不要再深究这个问题。我们部族之间的友谊取决于此。
graygoo.123.desc.en: We will tell you one last time... do not inquire further into this matter. The friendship of our two empires depend on it.

graygoo.126.desc.zh:
单形态族的混蛋。

我们告诉过你了……我们请求过你不要再追究，但你依旧坚持。我们开放自己的星团欢迎你，而你却如此报答我们。

那好吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

[Root.GetName]已经放弃了穿越我们星团的权利。因此，你们的舰船一旦被发现将会立即遭受攻击。我们与你们将不再有任何往来。
graygoo.126.desc.en:
Monoform scum.

We TOLD you... we PLEADED with you not to pursue this, but still you persisted. We welcomed you into our cluster with open appendages, and this is how you repay us.

THEN SO BE IT, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

The [Root.GetName] has forfeited its right to pass through our cluster. Henceforth, your ships will be attacked on sight. We will have nothing more to do with you.

graygoo.13.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的科学家们与某个遥远星团建立起了永久的连接，他们将那个与我们星系隔离的星团称之为“L-星团”，但此举导致我们星系被来自那个星团的纳米机器人疯狂入侵！

那些纳米机器人是从被称为“L-星门”的亚空间传送门中蜂拥而出的，任何与它们的联络交流都以失败告终。当它们从星门中涌出的时候，我们也检测到了L-星团流过来的能源信号。
graygoo.13.desc.en:
Scientists from the [From.GetName] have somehow established a permanent connection to a distant group of stars, referred to by their astronomers as the "L-Cluster,"  that had previously been isolated from the galaxy. Unfortunately, this has, in turn, triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

They are emerging from subspace portals designated as L-Gates, and any attempts to communicate with them have failed. In the wake of their passage through the gates, we have detected emanating from the cluster they came from.

graygoo.130.b.en: We know you can hear us.

graygoo.130.c.en: Look, this is all a misunderstanding.

graygoo.130.d.zh: 我们之间还有和平共处的机会。
graygoo.130.d.en: There can still be peace between us.

graygoo.15.a.tooltip.zh: 纳米星球现在可被环境改造为任何标准行星类型，只要满足基础科技条件。
graygoo.15.a.tooltip.en: Nanite Worlds can now be Terraformed into any standard Planet Class, if basic technological requirements are met.

graygoo.15.desc.zh:
我们对部队成功摧毁了灰色风暴的主要设施！终止其亚空间通讯后，所有的风暴纳米机器都陷入了休眠状态。由于失去了相互沟通协作的途径，它们组成的舰船也都消散了。

所有被灰色风暴的“灰蛊”覆盖过的星球现在都布满了由关闭状态纳米机器人形成的沙尘暴。如果能够投入足够的资源与时间，这些星球也许会恢复可以居住的状态。
graygoo.15.desc.en:
Our forces have succeeded in destroying the main facility of the Gray Tempest! With the neutralization of its subspace transmitter, all existing Tempest nanomachines have been rendered inert. Unable to maintain their cohesion, their ships have dissolved into nothingness.

Any planets that were covered by the Tempest's "gray goo" are now home to enormous swirling dust storms consisting of nothing but disabled nanites. With time and resources, these worlds could possibly be made habitable once more.

graygoo.150.a.desc.zh:
当我们的地面进攻军队在[From.From.GetName]上击败了最后的德萨努族守军时，[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]地表上的一切都化成了灰尘！在仔细检查之后，我们发现那灰色的尘土实际上是由无数瘫痪的纳米机器人组成的。

繁华的城市、葱郁的森林、广阔的海洋，甚至德萨努人本身——[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的一切，除了我们自己的军队之外，都是由这些纳米机器人构筑而成。既然它们都已瘫痪，[From.From.GetName]也就无法再支持生命。我们的地面部队正在撤回轨道上。
graygoo.150.a.desc.en:
When our invading ground forces defeated the last of the Dessanu defenders on [From.From.GetName], everything on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface crumbled into dust! On closer inspection, the gray dust consists of billions upon billions of inert nanites.

The cities, the lush forests, the oceans and the Dessanu themselves - everything on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], aside from our own forces, had been wrought out of these nanomachines. Now that they have been rendered inert, [From.From.GetName] no longer supports life. Our ground forces are withdrawing back to orbit.

graygoo.150.b.desc.zh: 和之前一样，在我们的地面部队成功夺取了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表控制权之后，德萨努守卫部队和[From.From.GetName]上的一切都化为了尘土。整个星球现在荒凉萧瑟，环境恶劣，任由盘旋飘舞的纳米机器人构成的风暴日夜侵袭。
graygoo.150.b.desc.en: As before, the Dessanu defenders and everything else on [From.From.GetName] turned into dust as soon as our ground forces won the battle for control over the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. It is now a bleak world, hostile to life and constantly beset by storms of swirling nanites.

graygoo.155.desc.zh:
我们敞开家门欢迎你，你却如此回报我们的友善？！

或许我们不该信任任何单形态物种。至少，你们与我们的创造者似乎并没有两样。当我们把你们的舰船和船员拆解为成分化合物时，再来看看你到底有何居心。
graygoo.155.desc.en:
THIS is how you repay our kindness after we welcomed you into our home?!

Perhaps we were fools to think that any monoform could be trusted. Your kind, at least, appears to be no different than our creators. When we have finished breaking your ships and their crews down into component compounds, we'll see if we can't figure out what makes you tick.

graygoo.16.desc.zh:
[goo_slayer.GetName]的部队成功摧毁了灰色风暴的主要设施！终止其亚空间通讯后，所有的风暴纳米机器都陷入了休眠状态。由于失去了相互沟通协作的途径，它们组成的舰船也都消散了。

所有被灰色风暴的“灰蛊”覆盖过的星球现在都布满了由关闭状态纳米机器人形成的沙尘暴。如果能够投入足够的资源与时间，这些星球也许会恢复可以居住的状态。
graygoo.16.desc.en:
Forces from the [goo_slayer.GetName] have succeeded in destroying the main facility of the Gray Tempest! With the neutralization of its subspace transmitter, all existing Tempest nanomachines have been rendered inert. Unable to maintain their cohesion, their ships have dissolved into nothingness.

Any planets that were covered by the Tempest's "gray goo" are now home to enormous swirling dust storms consisting of nothing but disabled nanites. With time and resources, these worlds could possibly be made habitable once more.

graygoo.160.a.zh: 抱歉。我们将立即离开该星系。
graygoo.160.a.en: Apologies. We shall vacate the system at once.

graygoo.160.b.response.zh:
傲慢的单形态物种。

如果你连这么简单的请求都不愿答应，那么你在L-星团通行的许可将就此取消。我们将不再容许你的出现。
graygoo.160.b.response.en:
Insolent monoform.

If you cannot heed this simple request, then your right to traverse the L-Cluster is rendered null and void. Your presence will no longer be tolerated.

graygoo.160.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

你的舰船已经进入了L-星团中的[From.GetName]，该星系严禁任何非德萨努族入内。

我们严正要求贵方立即从该星系撤离。如未能及时照办……双方关系将大受影响。
graygoo.160.desc.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Your ships have entered [From.GetName], a star system in the L-Cluster that is off-limits to all non-Dessanu.

We must insist that you withdraw from this system immediately. Failure to do so in a timely manner would... seriously compromise our relationship.

graygoo.161.desc.zh:
你摊上事了。你真的摊上事了。

我们要求你离开[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]，可你仍旧滞留。或许你们是一种特别愚蠢的单形态族。简单的指示与礼貌的请求明显超出了你们的理解能力。

好吧。那我们只好强行将你们请出我们的星团了。
graygoo.161.desc.en:
You've done it now. You've really done it now.

We asked you to leave [lcluster_factory_system.GetName], and yet you remain. Perhaps you are a particularly inept breed of monoform. Simple instructions and polite requests are clearly beyond the ability of your kind to understand.

Very well. We shall eject your kind from our star cluster by force.

graygoo.162.a.zh: 只是个导航错误。我们将立即离开。
graygoo.162.a.en: A navigation error. We will leave at once.

graygoo.162.b.zh: 噢，别说了。我们喜欢这里。
graygoo.162.b.en: Oh, be quiet. We like it here.

graygoo.162.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……

你们的舰船再次闯入了[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]星系。我们无法容忍此事继续。立即撤出，否则你将承担后果。
graygoo.162.desc.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]...

Your ships have AGAIN violated the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system. This cannot be allowed to continue. Withdraw at once or suffer the consequences.

graygoo.181.desc.zh:
我们的部队摧毁了[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系的工厂之后，德萨努文明其他全部都化为了尘埃。现在看来，德萨努明显是一种由先进的纳米机器人生命体组成的文明。在工厂内发现的一些计算机日志为我们揭露了一些有关他们的内幕：

L-星团曾被一个叫做德萨努的文明作为居住站，他们创造了一种全新的纳米机器，以便帮助自己建立一套跨星系的星门网络。不知出于什么原因，德萨努人将他们的纳米机器人召回到了L-星团，并试图将它们全部关闭。这一尝试失败后，他们关闭了L-星门，将自己与纳米机器人一起困了起来。

日志到这里就结束了。不过有证据表明，在这之后星团内发生了规模极大的争斗。可以预想，是纳米机器人获得了胜利，并出于某种原因决定开始模仿德萨努人。他们恢复了德萨努文明毁灭时的样子，在L-星门打开之后似乎也十分乐意继续保持这个样子。
graygoo.181.desc.en:
After our forces destroyed the space factory in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, what remained of the entire Dessanu civilization crumbled into dust. It seems clear now that the Dessanu were some kind of advanced nanite life form. Archival computer logs recovered from the wreckage of the factory sheds some light on this mystery:

The L-Cluster WAS inhabited by a civilization that called itself the Dessanu at some point. They created a new strain of nanomachines that helped them in the construction of their galactic Gateway network. For unknown reasons, the Dessanu recalled these nanites to the L-Cluster and attempted to deactivate them. When this failed, they sealed themselves in with the nanites by disabling the L-Gates.

The logs end here, but there is evidence that some kind of titanic struggle raged in the cluster afterwards. Presumably, the nanites won and then eventually chose to mimic the Dessanu for some reason. They rebuilt the Dessanu civilization as it appeared at the time of its destruction, and were apparently content to continue this charade even after the L-Gates were reopened.

graygoo.182.a.zh: 这群古怪的家伙到底是什么东西？
graygoo.182.a.en: What kind of strange beings were they?

graygoo.182.a.desc.zh:
$graygoo.182.desc$

他们的文明已经灭亡了。

graygoo.182.b.desc.zh:
$graygoo.182.desc$

他们的文明灭亡了，我们曾与他们达成的有关他们对我们输送独特战略资源的协议也不复存在。
graygoo.182.b.desc.en:
$graygoo.182.desc$

Their civilization is no more, and the same goes for the arrangement we had where they supplied us with their unique strategic resources.

graygoo.184.desc.zh: 德萨努协和国现在一见我们的舰船就开火，应该是不会再向我们继续赠送资源了。我们还是不要再有这种期待了。
graygoo.184.desc.en: As they now fire at our ships on sight, the Dessanu Consonance is unlikely to continue sending us resources. We should expect no more shipments from them.

graygoo.2.desc.zh: 灰色风暴的纳米机械已如乌云压城一般入侵了[Root.GetName]的大气层，一路上吞噬了地表的一切，并复制出了更多的纳米机械。很快，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]原居民存在过的痕迹就消失无踪了。
graygoo.2.desc.en: The nanomachines of the Gray Tempest have swept into the atmosphere of [Root.GetName] like dark storm clouds, consuming everything on the surface to replicate more of themselves. Soon no traces of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants remain.

graygoo.400.a.zh: 把他们的图像接到屏幕上来。

graygoo.400.a.desc.zh:
对[From.GetName]进行的探测器扫描中，发现其毫无生机的表面又一个奇怪的能源信号。神奇之处在于，该信号是来自一个在[From.GetPlanetMoon]南极附近区域漫无目的闲晃的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。

令我们的人员无比震惊的是，这个[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]虽然没有穿着宇航服，也没有配备任何的生命维持系统，在真空中却依然过得很自在。

经过商讨与强迫，远征队的人员终于说服了这位不大情愿的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]跟随他们回到了[Root.GetName]。
graygoo.400.a.desc.en:
A sensor sweep of [From.GetName] has revealed a strange energy signature emanating from its lifeless surface. Incredibly, it appears to be coming from a lone [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] that was found aimlessly wandering around in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s southern polar region.

To our away team's astonishment, this [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] seemed perfectly comfortable in the vacuum environment despite not wearing a space suit or any other form of life support equipment.

After some coercing, the away team managed to convince the reluctant [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] to follow them back to the [Root.GetName].

graygoo.400.b.desc.zh:
对[From.GetName]进行的探测器扫描中，发现其毫无生机的表面又一个奇怪的能源信号。神奇之处在于，该信号是来自一个在[From.GetPlanetMoon]南极附近区域漫无目的闲晃的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。

该单位未对我们发出的召唤指令进行回应，但我们派往该星球表面的单位成功说服了这一[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]跟随他们回到[Root.GetName]。
graygoo.400.b.desc.en:
A sensor sweep of [From.GetName] has revealed a strange energy signature emanating from its lifeless surface. Incredibly, it appears to be coming from a lone [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] that was found aimlessly wandering around in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s southern polar region.

The unit failed to respond to summoning commands, but after some coercing, the units we sent to the surface managed to convince the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] to follow them back to the [Root.GetName].

graygoo.401.a.desc.zh: 你们好，亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞。大家过的怎么样？我嘛，目前没有进行交配仪式的兴趣。我的睡眠循环很快就要到了，所以我很快就会失去意识。要进行交配的话，就等以后再说吧。
graygoo.401.a.desc.en: Hello, fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName]. How are you? I am, at present, not interested in engaging in mating rituals. My sleep cycle rapidly approaches and I will soon lose consciousness. Perhaps we can reproduce at a later time.

graygoo.401.b.desc.zh: 你们好，亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞。大家过的怎么样？我很好，这里的一切都在按部就班地进行着。就和……中央情报处……那个掌控一切[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的主计算机想要的一样。没错。
graygoo.401.b.desc.en: Hello, fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName]. How are you? I am fine. Everything is proceeding according to plan here. Just as the... the central intelligence... main computer thing that governs all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wants it. Yes.

graygoo.402.a.desc.zh:
啊！是我搞错了吗？等一下……我先想想……啊，对。嗯哼。

抱歉。我可不是故意在我们的物种还没有进入交配季节时提出什么繁衍的事的。

也许我们可以一边使用一些具有精神效果的药剂，一边进行一些愉快的同伴行为，来建立愉快的友好关系。

哎呀，这都见鬼吧。说的怎么这么复杂。没错，很明显，我根本不是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们想怎么样？
graygoo.402.a.desc.en:
Oh! Did I get it wrong? Just a moment... let me just... ah, yes. Ahem.

Forgive me. It was not my intention to speak of reproduction when our species is clearly not experiencing mating season.

Perhaps we can still build rapport by engaging in jovial camaraderie while imbibing a selection of psychoactive narcotics.

Oh, to hell with this. It's getting too complicated. Yes, I'm clearly not a [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Now what do you want?

graygoo.402.b.desc.zh:
噢！呃……单位65-D……R5-9……2报告。对，65-D-R5-9-2向您汇报。

正以峰值效率运转，主控单元先生。内部诊断没有发现重大问题。

我是说，完全没有发现问题！什么问题都没有。一切都……呃……

噢，算了吧，我骗谁呢。对，我明显不是个[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你想怎样？
graygoo.402.b.desc.en:
Oh! Uhm... Unit 65-D... R5-9... 2 here. Yes, 65-D-R5-9-2 reporting.

Operating at peak efficiency, Mr. Master Control Unit sir. Internal diagnostics report no significant problems.

I mean, they report no problems at all! Zero problems here. Everything is just... uh...

Oh, to hell with this. It's getting too complicated. Yes, I'm clearly not a [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Now what do you want?

graygoo.403.a.en: And how do you fit into this?

graygoo.403.desc.zh:
好吧，好吧。我老实交代。没必要再装下去了。请原谅我把话说得太直，但我已经很久没有与我自己以外的人交谈过了。

很久以前，曾经有一个……可以说是一个由纳米机器组成的文明。你知道什么是纳米机器吗？很好。这些纳米机器被其造物主称为“灰色风暴”，尽管其内部的自我命名代码比它要复杂无数倍。

总之，纳米机器与其造物主之间的关系逐渐恶化，并爆发了一场大战！当尘埃落定之后，只有纳米机器们活了下来。但在造物主们被消灭之前，他们设法关闭了其星团唯一的出口传送门，把纳米机器困在了里面。
graygoo.403.desc.en:
All right, all right. I'll spill everything. No point in pretending anymore. Forgive my lack of eloquence, but it's been a long time since I spoke to someone who wasn't me.

Once upon a time, there was a... a civilization, you might call it, of nanites. Do you know what nanites are? Good. These nanites were called the "Gray Tempest" by their creators, although their internal self-designation code was infinitely more complex.

Anyway, things turned sour between the nanites and their creators. Fighting broke out! When things finally settled down, only the nanites remained. But before they were wiped out, their creators managed to disable the star cluster's sole exit gate, trapping the nanites.

graygoo.404.a.zh: 而且你希望留在这颗荒芜的星球上吗？
graygoo.404.a.en: And you wish to stay on this desolate world?

graygoo.404.desc.zh:
在那之后，纳米机器们发现自己有的是时间。它们徒劳地花了数千年，试图离开那个星团，但在那之后它们开始试验各种形状与形态。在一段时间里，它们甚至重建了其造物主的文明消逝时的模样，细至每个独立的居民。

我便是最新的实验成果。除了覆盖在某些星球上的静止的纳米机器以外，整个灰色风暴，或者随便你怎么称呼我们，都聚集在了我身上。我的意识代表着我们整个文明。

至于我的外表……是因为我觉得，你可能更容易接受跟自己长得差不多的人。
graygoo.404.desc.en:
Well, the nanites found themselves with a lot of time on their hands. A few millennia were spent on fruitless attempts to leave the cluster, but after that they began experimenting with different shapes and forms. For a time, they even recreated the civilization of their creators as it was at the time of its demise, right down to its individual citizens.

I am the latest experiment. Aside from the dormant nanites that can be found covering some worlds, the entirety of the Gray Tempest, or whatever you want to call us, has been condensed into me. My consciousness embodies our entire civilization.

As for my look... well, I figured you would respond better to someone wearing your own mug.

graygoo.405.b.response.zh:
噢，好吧。那我就回地面上去了。

我大概会在[gray_homeworld.GetName]庞大的地下洞穴中四处游荡。在你们的几千年之后，等我从地下冒出来时，或许我们会再见面的。保重！
graygoo.405.b.response.en:
Oh well. Time for me to return to the surface then.

I'll probably busy myself by wandering around the extensive subterranean cave network of [gray_homeworld.GetName]. Perhaps we'll meet again when I emerge, a few thousand of your years from now. Take care!

graygoo.405.desc.zh:
我得承认，在最近这几个世纪里，我已经对[gray_homeworld.GetName]上的田园生活感到有些无聊了。既然L-星团已经再次开放了，或许我该接触一些新的事物。

你有什么建议吗？
graygoo.405.desc.en:
I confess that the pastoral life I've been enjoying here on [gray_homeworld.GetName] has grown a little dull over the last few centuries. Now that the L-Cluster is open for travel again, perhaps the time has come to try something new.

Do you have any ideas?

graygoo.406.a.response.zh:
在你打算让我分裂成一堆纳米战舰之前，我得告诉你，我要坚定地维持一个单独个体的形态。分裂成舰队这事我之前也干过，而且根本无法在那种距离上维持统一的“人格”。我当前的意识将无法留存下来。

但变成一艘单独的巨大战舰没什么问题。我能办到。如果你希望的话，我也可以变成小一点的形态在地面上作战。或者……如果你不太希望使用武力，我也乐意担任行政官。单形态族社会总是令我着迷。

当然，我可以按你的要求变更角色，所以你可以轻易地撤销自己的决定。
graygoo.406.a.response.en:
Before you get the notion of asking me to split into a few dozen fleets of nanite warships, I have to tell you that I insist on maintaining a single indivisible form. I've done the fleets thing before, and it's impossible to maintain any kind of coherent "personality" over such distances. My current consciousness would not survive the ordeal.

But a single massive warship is fine. I can do that. If you want to, I could also assume a smaller form for fighting on the ground. Or... if you're feeling less violently inclined, I would be happy to assume the role of official. Monoform society has always fascinated me.

Of course, I will be able to switch roles on request, so you can easily reverse any decision you make.

graygoo.406.b.response.zh:
你们目前所知的任何语言都无法完整准确地描述这些组成我意识的纳米机器的全名。

我们的造物主称我们为“纳-迪-沙”，在你们的语言里大致可以译为“灰之风暴”。我建议简单一点，就叫我“小灰”。
graygoo.406.b.response.en:
There is no language known to your kind that could properly convey the full name of the nanite consciousness that constitutes my being.

Our creators called us the "Naar-Di-Shav" which roughly translates to "Gray Tempest" in your language. I suppose to keep things simple you could simply call me "Gray."

graygoo.406.c.response.zh: <你现在可以通过通讯菜单与小灰交流。>
graygoo.406.c.response.en: <You can now communicate with Gray through the Contacts menu.>

graygoo.406.desc.zh:
加入你们？加入你们！？你要我自己投入某个初次见面的陌生外星人的怀抱？我真的……我简直……等等，让我把话说清楚……

你真的以为我会向你宣誓效忠，尽管我对你那诡异的帝国或是其肮脏的历史一无所知？你没开玩笑吧？

你居然会出这种提议，我真的不知道你在想……呃……其实……转念一想……好吧，何不呢？让我入伙吧。不，不，我是说真的！我感觉我们会很合得来，而且这将会是一段激动人心的大冒险。在此我宣布在接下来的2000年里效忠于你。不，还是5000年吧！
graygoo.406.desc.en:
Join you? JOIN YOU? You want me to throw myself into the flailing appendages of the first bunch of random aliens I run into? I just... I don't even... hold on, let me just get this straight...

You ACTUALLY thought that I would swear some kind of fealty to you, even though I don't know ANYTHING about your bizarre empire or its sordid past? Are you for real?

I don't know what's worse, that you would even suggest... well... actually... on second thought... what the hell, why not? Sign me up. No, no, I'm serious! I'm getting some good vibes here, and I think this could turn into quite the adventure. I hereby pledge my loyalty to you for the next 2,000 years. In fact, let's make that 5,000.

graygoo.500.a.zh: 我们需要你担任行政官。
graygoo.500.a.en: We need you to serve as Official.

graygoo.500.a.response.zh: 太好了。我想我终于掌握模仿[Root.GetSpeciesName]外观的窍门了。上次我多变了一根触手出来。
graygoo.500.a.response.en: Excellent. I think I've finally nailed the [Root.GetSpeciesName] look. There was an extra tentacle that wasn't supposed to be there last time.

graygoo.500.allow.a.zh: 小灰必须未处于战斗中
graygoo.500.allow.a.en: Gray must not be in combat

graygoo.500.allow.b.zh: 小灰必须处于未受损的状态

graygoo.500.b.en: We're in need of a Warship.

graygoo.500.b.response.zh: 啊，再次回到虚空中寻找猎物。这肯定会让我回忆起不少往事。
graygoo.500.b.response.en: Ah, to prowl the void in search of prey again. This will certainly bring back memories.

graygoo.500.c.desc.zh: 直到你决定让我变成某个形态之前，我帮不上你什么忙。
graygoo.500.c.desc.en: I won't be much good to you until you tell me which form to assume.

graygoo.500.c.response.zh: 我想想……双足，三足，还是四足……或者这次变成履带式的战体吧……
graygoo.500.c.response.en: Let's see... bipedal, tripodal or quadrupedal... or maybe I'll go for a tracked warform this time...

graygoo.500.d.desc.en: Where do you want me, boss?

graygoo.501.a.desc.zh: 这里是行政官小灰的办公室。请问您有什么吩咐吗？
graygoo.501.a.desc.en: You have reached Official Gray's office. Do you have an appointment?

graygoo.501.b.desc.en: Did I get the [Root.GetSpeciesName] look right?

graygoo.501.b.response.zh: 我得承认，我会想念建造东西的日子，而不是拆光它们。哎，好吧。你要我去攻击谁？
graygoo.501.b.response.en: I confess, I will miss building things instead of tearing them down. Oh well. Who do you want to kill?

graygoo.501.c.desc.zh: 你觉得我的办公室怎么样？这是我自己建的。我想我可以在墙上挂些学位证书什么的来炫耀一下。
graygoo.501.c.desc.en: How do you like my office? I built it myself. I guess I should put some diplomas and stuff up on the walls to dazzle visitors.

graygoo.501.c.response.zh: 行。稍等片刻，等我走出办公室就变成一台巨大的战争机器。
graygoo.501.c.response.en: Right. Just give me a minute to get out of my office before I morph into a massive killing machine.

graygoo.501.d.desc.zh: 谁能想到，刻苦努力地工作能获得如此丰厚的回报？
graygoo.501.d.desc.en: Who knew that hard, honest work could be so rewarding?

graygoo.502.a.desc.zh: 给我个目标！我需要目标！
graygoo.502.a.desc.en: Gimme a target! I need a target!

graygoo.502.c.desc.zh:
我只想告诉你，当你要我变成战舰的时候，我短暂地考虑了一下要不要变成一只巨大的[Root.GetSpeciesName]头，并从眼睛里发射闪电。

但那样实在是太荒唐了。
graygoo.502.c.desc.en:
I want you to know that when I was told to become a warship, I briefly considered assuming the form of a gigantic disembodied [Root.GetSpeciesName] head that fired lightning bolts from its ocular receptors.

But it would have been too silly.

graygoo.502.d.desc.zh: 你想要我朝什么东西开火吗？
graygoo.502.d.desc.en: Did you want me to shoot something?

graygoo.503.a.desc.zh: 启动战斗任务地面万能形态，模式BOLO-5。
graygoo.503.a.desc.en: Battle Operations Land Omniform mode engaged, pattern BOLO-5.

graygoo.503.a.response.zh: 或许这样最好。最近我发现征伐使我感到疲倦。
graygoo.503.a.response.en: Perhaps it is for the best. I have found that killing wearies me these days.

graygoo.503.b.desc.en: I'm about to drop the hammer.

graygoo.503.c.desc.zh: 反应堆上线。传感器上线。武器上线。所有系统正常。
graygoo.503.c.desc.en: Reactor online. Sensors online. Weapons online. All systems nominal.

graygoo.504.desc.zh: <组成小灰的纳米机器已被击溃，目前正在重组为一个单独的个体。>
graygoo.504.desc.en: <Gray's nanites have been scattered and are currently in the process of merging back into a single shape.>

graygoo.511.desc.zh: 组成小灰的纳米机器已被击溃，目前正在缓慢地重新恢复成一个单独的个体。这个过程需要花费数年的时间才能完成，在此期间小灰将无法为我们效力。
graygoo.511.desc.en: Gray's nanites have been scattered and are now in the process of slowly merging back into a single form. It will take years for the nanites to trickle back in, and Gray will be unavailable to us until this process has been completed.

graygoo.512.a.desc.zh: 哎，那可感觉真是不太舒服。现在我的大部分纳米机器已经恢复运转，我也可以重新振作起来了。等你决定把我往哪派之后就通知我一声。
graygoo.512.a.desc.en: Well, that was uncomfortable. Most of my nanites are accounted for now, and I'm ready to get back in the game. Give me a holler when you've figured out where you want me.

graygoo.512.b.desc.zh: 那感觉有点痛，但是没有造成永久性的伤害。我的纳米机器都回到原本的位置上，而我也准备好接受新的任务了。
graygoo.512.b.desc.en: That stung a bit, but no permanent harm has been done. All of my nanites are back where they're supposed to be, and I'm ready for a new assignment.

graygoo.512.c.desc.zh: 这不是我第一次被打散并重组了，但这滋味从来都不好受。不过现在我没事了，除了稍微有点头痛以外。给我安排个任务吧。
graygoo.512.c.desc.en: It's not the first time I've been scattered to hell and back, but it's never a pleasant experience. I'm fine now, though, aside from a mild headache. Let me know where you want me.

graygoo.550.desc.zh:
在进入L-星门的[From.GetName]星系之后，立马就能看出在L-星门的这一端，很久以前曾经发生过一场惊天动地的大战。某些可能曾经存在生命的星球已经被炸得面目全非，而其它星球则被某种细小的灰尘所覆盖，粗略扫描显示那些灰尘其实是某种瘫痪的远古纳米机器。

这就令我们怀疑，被锁定的L-星门到底是为了阻挡外界进入，还是为了阻挡里面的东西外逃……
graygoo.550.desc.en:
Upon entering the [From.GetName] system in the L-Cluster, it is immediately apparent that some kind of titanic struggle occurred long ago on this side of the L-Gate. Some planets that may once have supported life have been shattered beyond recognition, while others are covered in a fine dust that from a cursory scan appears to be ancient, deactivated nanomachines.

This raises the question of whether the L-Gates had been locked down to keep something out, or to keep something in...

graygoo.555.desc.zh: 我们太傻了。灰蛊风暴离开他们的星门，我们应该知道他们会来找他们的亲戚。一旦他们进入[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] 的轨道，他们只用了几秒钟就控制了我们重新编程的虫群。尽管按照灰蛊风暴的标准，它很原始，但虫群并没有花很长时间就吞噬了星球的其他地方。
graygoo.555.desc.en: We were fools. The moment the Gray Tempest left their gates, we should have known they would come for their kin. Once they entered orbit around [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] it took them mere seconds to seize control of our reprogrammed swarm. Though it is primitive by the Tempest standards, it did not take the swarm long to consume the rest of the world.

great_blue_spots_desc.zh: [from.GetName]的地表分布着泾渭分明的两种色彩以极快的速度串联移动着，在太空中亦清晰可见。这些蓝色的结构相当有趣，值得进一步研究。
great_blue_spots_desc.en: The surface of [from.GetName] features two distinctive discolorations, large enough to be visible from space and moving in tandem at great speeds. These blue-colored formations are interesting enough to warrant further study.

green_skies_outcome_modifier.zh: 我们现在对这些潜在的危险更加警惕。
green_skies_outcome_modifier.en: We are now more vigilant against incoming danger.

grunur_digsite_1_desc.zh:
这些遗迹被认为是古代行政建筑群，它们属于一个自称为古茹努尔的太空物种，该物种是在[From.Planet.GetName]上被发现的。

令人震惊的是，这个失落的文明似乎在七百万年前就居住在这颗星球上了，我们的考古学家渴望揭开他们的秘密。
grunur_digsite_1_desc.en:
The remains of what is believed to be an ancient administrative complex, belonging to a space-faring species who called themselves the Grunur has been found on [From.Planet.GetName].

This fallen civilization appears to have inhabited the planet a staggering seven million years ago, and our archaeologists are eager to uncover their secrets.

guardian.fortress.continue.zh: 外遣小队的探索将继续下去……

hacked_and_firewalled_leaders.tt.zh: 所有义体人领袖移除$leader_trait_hacked$特质，并添加$leader_trait_firewalled$特质。
hacked_and_firewalled_leaders.tt.en: Removes the $leader_trait_hacked$ Trait and Applies the $leader_trait_firewalled$ Trait to all Cyborg leaders.

hacked_leaders.tt.zh: 随机数量的义体人领袖获得$leader_trait_hacked$特质。
hacked_leaders.tt.en: A random number of Cyborg Leaders have gained the $leader_trait_hacked$ Trait.

has_tr_mutation_finish_tt.zh: 因为我们已经完成了$Mutation$传统树，所以此选项可用。
has_tr_mutation_finish_tt.en: This option is available since we have finished  $Mutation$ Tradition Tree.

has_tr_mutation_nucleotide_isolation_evo.zh: 由于选择了$tr_mutation_nucleotide_isolation$传统，该选项可用。
has_tr_mutation_nucleotide_isolation_evo.en: This option is available due to the selection of the $tr_mutation_nucleotide_isolation$ Tradition.

has_tr_mutation_unnatural_selection_evo_.zh: 由于选择了$tr_mutation_unnatural_selection$传统，该选项可用。
has_tr_mutation_unnatural_selection_evo_.en: This option is available due to the selection of the $tr_mutation_unnatural_selection$ Tradition.

has_tradition_subterfuge_tt.zh: 该选项因我们已完成密谋传统树而解锁。
has_tradition_subterfuge_tt.en: This option is available because we have completed the Subterfuge tradition tree.

hatch_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 一个通往这颗小行星内部的对接舱坐落在其表面的一个小坑里。舱口似乎被密封过，但之后被微陨石撞开了。
hatch_asteroid_category_desc.en: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.

hegemon_join_operation_happens_tooltip.zh:
所有参与的成员国获得在[federation_leader.Capital.GetName]上建造纪念碑的特殊项目。
[federation_leader.GetName]获得特殊项目，可以向至多两个成员国传播[federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos]思潮。
hegemon_join_operation_happens_tooltip.en:
All participating members gain a special project to build a monument on [federation_leader.Capital.GetName].
The [federation_leader.GetName] gains special projects to spread the [federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos] ethos to up to two member states.

heirs_khan_in_waiting_desc.zh: 现任可汗的旗舰。如果我们能击败它，我们就能夺取汗位。
heirs_khan_in_waiting_desc.en: The flagship of the incumbent Khan. If we were to defeat it, we would claim the throne.

heirs_khan_rally_point_desc.zh: 这个恒星系被选作决定下一任大可汗人选的决胜场。
heirs_khan_rally_point_desc.en: The system chosen for the battle that will decide who becomes the next Great Khan.

hidden_planet_desc.zh: 从维克塔·泽沃尼亚号的导航设备中提取的坐标指向这个位置。
hidden_planet_desc.en: The coordinates extracted from the Vechtar Zavonia's navigational drive point to this location.

hijacked_cult_fleet_poi_desc.zh: 邪教信徒们已在[Root.Capital.GetName]上的一个秘密设施的建造一支小型舰队。在被我们发现之后他们驾驶着舰船逃向[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]。在它们造成更大的损伤之前必须将他们摧毁！
hijacked_cult_fleet_poi_desc.en: The cultists have managed to build a small fleet of starships at a secret facility on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Upon discovery, the cultists fled in their ships to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]. They must be destroyed before they can cause any more damage!

hire_admiral_merc.zh: 你永久地雇佣了一名出色的[marauder_species.GetName]舰队司令。
hire_admiral_merc.en: You permanently hire a skilled [marauder_species.GetName] admiral.

hire_general_merc.zh: 你永久地雇佣了一名出色的[marauder_species.GetName]陆军将领。
hire_general_merc.en: You permanently hire a skilled [marauder_species.GetName] general.

hire_mercenaries.en: Hire a fleet of [marauder_species.GetName] mercenaries for a period of time.

hire_mercenary_leader.zh: 雇佣一名出色的[marauder_species.GetName]领袖，直到其逝世为止。
hire_mercenary_leader.en: Hire a skilled [marauder_species.GetName] leader for the duration of that leader's life.

hire_raid.zh: [current_marauder_diplomacy.GetName]召集了一支劫掠舰队，准备攻击[preliminary_target.GetName]。
hire_raid.en: The [current_marauder_diplomacy.GetName] assemble a raiding fleet that will attack the [preliminary_target.GetName].

hostile_first_contact_tt.en: This will be interpreted as a hostile action

hosting_cfl_cooldown_tt.zh: 冠铸秀锦标赛许可证下次可用时间为[champions_forge_enclave_country.cfl_cooldown_timer]
hosting_cfl_cooldown_tt.en: The CFL tournament license will next be available on the [champions_forge_enclave_country.cfl_cooldown_timer]

hunting_hyacinth_2_poi_desc.zh: 风信子号的离子航迹指向这个星系。我们必须赶快调查。
hunting_hyacinth_2_poi_desc.en: The Hyacinth's ion trail has been tracked to this system. We must investigate.

hunting_hyacinth_poi_desc.zh: 为了寻找风信子号的下落，我们必须完全调查这些恒星系。方舟船的原始引擎应该会留下离子航迹。
hunting_hyacinth_poi_desc.en: We need to complete surveys of these systems and look for signs of passage by the Hyacinth. The arkship's primitive engines may have left behind a residual ion trail.

ice_trauma_memorialist_unity.en: In Memory of the Frozen Submariners

ideal_furnace_system_desc.zh: 建造第二座$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$的理想恒星系。
ideal_furnace_system_desc.en: An ideal system for the construction of a second $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$.

impact_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 巨大的撞击坑表明某种大型物体曾撞击[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面。
impact_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: A colossal impact crater hints that something big collided with the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] once.

increase_aid_tt.zh: 持续的支持将使成功的几率略微增加。
increase_aid_tt.en: Continued support will increase the chances of a successful outcome by a modest percentage.

infernal_oasis_category_desc.zh: 令人震惊的[from.GetName]图像显示，一颗燃烧熔融星球上突然出现一片大陆大小的明亮绿色地带。这一罕见景象表明其地表存在极其异常的情况。
infernal_oasis_category_desc.en: Startling images of [from.GetName] show a burning, molten world interrupted by a startlingly bright, continent-sized swathe of green. This exceptional sight suggests something highly unusual on the surface.

infernal_tornadoes_desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示了大面积快速迁移的高压力风暴。

这些风暴释放着极强的热信号。需要着重研究才能揭示该现象是自然发生或是由某种至今未知的生命形式引起。
infernal_tornadoes_desc.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] show vast swathes of rapidly migrating high-pressure storms.

These storms are emitting extremely volatile heat signatures. Focused research will be needed to reveal if the cause is natural or a hitherto unknown form of life.

infernals.1001.desc.zh:
时间与地表范围内均确认大气化学波动，且在行星巨大的裸露岩浆海上空最为强烈，因此派遣探测器前往采样。

进一步分析后，[Leader.GetName]确认[Planet.GetName]上的岩浆海正在释放珍稀的异星天然气。这一意外发现表明，若能成功开发，该行星或将成为我方工业的潜在资源供给。
infernals.1001.desc.en:
Chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere were confirmed across both time and the surface. The fluctuations were strongest over the planet's large ocean of exposed magma, so a probe was dispatched to collect samples.

Upon closer analysis, [Leader.GetName] determined that the magma ocean on [Planet.GetName] is outgassing valuable exotic gases. This unexpected finding suggests that the planet could be a potential contributor to our industries, if we are able to exploit it.

infernals.1002.a.zh: 将此地开发为度假胜地。
infernals.1002.a.en: Develop the site as a resort

infernals.1002.desc.zh:
[Planet.GetName]表面的首批图像揭示了震撼且出乎意料的地质构造，称为“晶体熔岩湖”。这些岩浆体存在已久，内含的特殊矿物可在特定温度范围内自然自排列为晶体结构。因此，湖面显得极为透明，并泛起红色系虹彩。受行星轨道影响，这种视觉效果伴随季节温度变化呈周期性波动。

晶体熔岩湖的美丽景色可能吸引大量游客。湖中的晶体矿物可于活跃期采集，用于开发能量储存介质。
infernals.1002.desc.en:
Our first images from the surface of [Planet.GetName] have revealed stunning and unexpected geological formations that are being called 'crystal lava lakes'. These long-lived bodies of magma are infused with unique minerals that, within a specific temperature range, naturally self-arrange into crystalline matrices. The result is exceptional transparency and red-spectrum iridescence across the lake. Due to the planet's orbit, this visually striking effect ebbs and flows on a seasonal cycle as temperatures fluctuate.

The aesthetic appeal of these crystal lava lakes could prove to be a powerful draw for tourists. The crystalline minerals themselves could also be skimmed from the surface during their active season, after which their properties could be leveraged for energy storage media.

infernals.1003.a.zh: 标记区域为适宜定居区。
infernals.1003.a.en: Mark area as viable settlement zone

infernals.1003.desc.zh:
[Planet.GetName]最初被评定为典型的岩浆烈焰星球，然而调查发现，在行星表面纵横交错的裂谷中，存在复杂的本地植物生态系统。这些植物能够产生氧气并收集少有的水分，在炽热的荒原之中形成近乎温带的微气候区域。

这一生态系统为原本无法在火山星球上生存的物种创造出适合栖息的环境，植被本身也可能适宜农业开发。建议定居者深入峡谷，对其中的生物进行详尽探索。
infernals.1003.desc.en:
Initial assessment of [Planet.GetName] characterized it as a world of magma and fire, but surveys have revealed a native ecosystem of complex flora inhabiting a network of rift valleys across the planet. These plants produce oxygen and collect what little moisture exists, resulting in pockets of almost temperate microclimates in an otherwise superheated wasteland.

The biomes supported by this flora could prove habitable for species that otherwise avoid settling volcanic worlds, and the flora itself may be suitable for agriculture. It would benefit any settlers to thoroughly explore what exactly lives in those canyons.

infernals.1003.tooltip_a.zh: 添加提升宜居性容忍度与生长率的行星修正。
infernals.1003.tooltip_a.en: Adds a planetary modifier improving Habitability Tolerance and Growth.

infernals.1004.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]报告称，在[from.GetName]火山表面之下存在广袤的冰川，被隔热特性极佳的特殊矿物岩层包裹。构造活动正缓慢破坏这些隔热层，[Leader.GetName]预测，若冰川与星体其他区域温度趋于平衡，该行星将大幅降温，从火山星球转变为干旱星球，

我们可以加速此过程，提高其宜居性。不过该现象颇具科学价值，也可使其自然演，方便进行研究。
infernals.1004.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] reports that beneath the volcanic surface of [from.GetName] are vast glaciers. They are encased in unusual rock formations composed of minerals with exceptional insulating properties. Tectonic activity is slowly degrading these insulating layers, and [Leader.GetName] predicts that if temperatures between the glaciers and the rest of the planet were to equalize, the planet would cool enough to be considered an arid world, rather than a volcanic one.

We can speed up this process in order to make the planet somewhat more habitable. But the phenomenon is scientifically curious, and there may be value in allowing it to be studied as it proceeds naturally.

infernals.1005.a.tt.en: Use a $constructor$ to build the $galactic_crucible_0$ around a star.

infernals.1005.b.en: Order the drones to begin construction.

infernals.1005.b.tt.en: Use a $constructor$ to build the $galactic_crucible_0$ around a star.

infernals.1005.desc1.zh:
我们完成了第一座采集能量并转化为$entropy_crystals$的基础设施。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成$entropy_crystals$。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$：$galactic_crucible_0$
infernals.1005.desc1.en:
We have completed our first working infrastructure for harvesting energy and converting it into $entropy_crystals$. These crystals hold immense thermal energy and already enable our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize $entropy_crystals$ by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$: $galactic_crucible_0$

infernals.1005.desc2.zh:
现有的$entropy_crystals$样本让我们在无需危及母星也能进行采集与合成。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成$entropy_crystals$。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$：$galactic_crucible_0$
infernals.1005.desc2.en:
With our existing samples of $entropy_crystals$, we can harvest and synthesize them without endangering our home star. These crystals hold immense thermal energy, allowing our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize $entropy_crystals$ by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$: $galactic_crucible_0$

infernals.1006.desc.zh: 我们踏上点燃星系的道路，但自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
infernals.1006.desc.en: We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future.

infernals.1010.b.zh: 迫切需要征服更多恒星。
infernals.1010.b.en: We need to conquer more stars.

infernals.1010.desc.zh:
$galactic_crucible_1$可部署$entropy_conduit_plural$可引导并强化恒星的熵能，一旦发送，它们就会回收并强化恒星的能量输出。使其演化为红巨星，从而将恒星系加热至支撑帝国扩张基础设施的水平。

此类$entropy_conduit_plural$能够定期生产并自主运作，目前仅限于我方领土，但未来有望扩展至整个星系，推动帝国持续增长。

可升级的巨型结构如下：$galactic_crucible_2$
infernals.1010.desc.en:
The $galactic_crucible_1$ is now ready to deploy $entropy_conduit_plural$: automated systems designed to channel and amplify stellar entropy. Once dispatched, they'll recycle and intensify a star's energy output, converting it into a Red Giant, heating entire systems to support our empire's expanding infrastructure.

These $entropy_conduit_plural$ can be produced at regular intervals and operate autonomously for our convenience. For now, they'll remain within our territory, but in time, it may serve us to let them spread across the galaxy. After all, our empire never stops growing.

Megastructure Upgrade Available: $galactic_crucible_2$

infernals.1015.b.desc.zh:
阻止接触危机等级$crisis_hyperthermia_level_4$。

特殊项目立项：$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY_GOOD$将$galactic_crucible_2$转变为$galactic_crucible_5$。
infernals.1015.b.desc.en:
Prevents access to Crisis level $crisis_hyperthermia_level_4$. 

Issues Special Project: $INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY_GOOD$ to turn the $galactic_crucible_2$ into a $galactic_crucible_5$.

infernals.1015.desc.zh:
$entropy_crystals$研究揭示惊天秘密：在高浓度下，该物质可被用于制造足以摧毁整颗行星的武器。若我方掌握此力量，整个星系或将归于我手。

但若追求军事应用，将破坏与邻邦脆弱信任。谁又能保证此武器不会反噬自身？

若望证我方意图，必须公然削弱$galactic_crucible_2$，禁止生产此类武器。否则，终会有人将其用于杀戮，即我方或他人。

该抉择将解锁特殊项目。
infernals.1015.desc.en:
Our continued research into $entropy_crystals$ has unveiled a chilling possibility: when highly concentrated, they can power weapons of unimaginable scale, capable of devastating entire planets. With such power, the galaxy could fall under our mercy.

But exploring these military applications would shatter what little trust remains between us and our neighbors. And who's to say such weapons couldn't one day be turned against us?

Empty words of peace will not suffice. If we wish to prove our intentions, we must publicly cripple the $galactic_crucible_2$, ensuring it can never produce such weaponry. Otherwise, it's only a matter of time before this technology is weaponized, by us, or by someone else.

This decision unlocks a Special Project

infernals.1020.a.zh: 我们必须为战争做好准备。
infernals.1020.a.en: We must ready ourselves for war.

infernals.1020.a.tt.en:
- The $galactic_crucible_4$ expansion should be a priority.
- $unlocks_conduit_damage$

infernals.1020.b.zh: 我们的对手将成为火焰的引燃物。
infernals.1020.b.en: Our rivals shall be kindling for the fire.

infernals.1020.b.tt.en:
- The $galactic_crucible_4$ expansion should be a priority.
- $unlocks_conduit_damage$

infernals.1020.desc.zh:
我方对$entropy_crystals$及$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY_EVIL$项目之调查确认毁灭性武器潜力属实。掌握此等力量后，外交礼节将不再约束我们的行动。

由于其激进的军事化应用，$galactic_crucible_3$扩张可以加速。武器越早解锁，我们越早称霸。

巨型结构升级可用：$galactic_crucible_4$
infernals.1020.desc.en:
Our investigation into $entropy_crystals$ and the $INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY_EVIL$ Project has confirmed what we suspected: the potential for devastating weaponry is real. With such power in our hands, we no longer need to temper ourselves for the sake of diplomatic niceties.

The $galactic_crucible_3$'s expansion will accelerate, with special focus on its more... aggressive applications. The sooner we unlock these weapons, the less the galaxy's opinions will matter.

Megastructure Upgrade Available: $galactic_crucible_4$

infernals.1021.desc.zh:
$galactic_crucible_3$已被成功削弱，确保其不再能被扩展或用于破坏性目的。虽然失去了其全部潜能令人遗憾，但继续那条道路将带来灾难风险及所有外交关系的崩溃。

幸运的是，即使功能受限，$galactic_crucible_5$仍将是强大且繁荣的能源来源。我们在越过界限前选择了退步，保障了与星海共同体合作的未来，同时依然从这项非凡科学中获益。

巨型结构升级可用：$galactic_crucible_5$
infernals.1021.desc.en:
The $galactic_crucible_3$ has been successfully hobbled, ensuring it can no longer be expanded or repurposed for destructive ends. While the loss of its full potential is regrettable, continuing down that path would have risked catastrophe, and the collapse of all diplomatic ties.

Fortunately, even in its limited form, the $galactic_crucible_5$ will remain a powerful source of energy and prosperity. We've stepped back before crossing a line, securing a future where we can collaborate with the galactic community while still benefiting from this remarkable science.

Megastructure Upgrade Available: $galactic_crucible_5$

infernals.1025.a.zh: 只有我们适合在烈焰中生存。
infernals.1025.a.en: We are the only ones fit to survive the flames.

infernals.1025.a.tt.zh: 其他物种将试图反对我们。准备星系战争。
infernals.1025.a.tt.en: Other species will try to oppose us. Prepare for Galactic war.

infernals.1025.b.zh: 整个星系将在熊熊烈焰中归一。
infernals.1025.b.en: The whole galaxy will blaze in harmony.

infernals.1025.b.tt.zh: 其他物种将试图反对我们。准备星系战争。
infernals.1025.b.tt.en: Other species will try to oppose us. Prepare for Galactic war.

infernals.1025.desc.zh:
我们对$entropy_conduit_plural$的持续研究以及将恒星转化为红巨星的研究表明，我们或许能够扩大行动规模，直接使银河系核心过热，从而在整个银河触发热级联，把它改造成对我们更为适宜的环境。

我们已确定六个核心周边星系，可作为此计划的作业枢纽。这些星系位于星系超空间航路网络之外，但相关稳定虫洞的构建工作正紧锣密鼓进行。
infernals.1025.desc.en:
Our ongoing research into $entropy_conduit_plural$ and transforming stars into Red Giants suggests we may be able to scale up our operations to overheat the Galactic Core itself, triggering a thermal cascade across the entire Galaxy, thus transforming it into a much more hospitable place for us.

We have identified six systems surrounding the core that could serve as operational hubs for this endeavor. These systems lie beyond the galactic hyperlane network, but efforts are underway to generate stable wormholes and establish access.

infernals.1030.a.zh: 开始在核心恒星系中部署。
infernals.1030.a.en: Begin installation in the core systems.

infernals.1030.a.tt.zh: 在六个星系核心恒星系中部署$entropy_conduit_plural$，我们就能一次性使整个星系过热。必须着手准备。
infernals.1030.a.tt.en: Deploying $entropy_conduit_plural$ in the six Galactic Core systems will let us overheat the entire galaxy at once. We must begin preparations.

infernals.1030.b.zh: 我们的未来因火焰而光明。
infernals.1030.b.en: Our future is bright with fire.

infernals.1030.desc.zh:
$galactic_crucible_4$现已全面武装并投入运行。随着虫洞通道完工，我们已取得通往围绕星系核心六个集结星系的通道。

我们开始进行核心过热工作。其它帝国可能察觉并试图进入这些恒星系，但暂时我们占有优势，核心已屈服于我们的意志。

使用虫洞保护星系核心恒星系
infernals.1030.desc.en:
The $galactic_crucible_4$ is now fully armed and operational. With wormhole tunnels completed, we've secured access to all six staging systems around the Galactic Core.

Our work to overheat the Core can begin. Other empires may detect our activity and attempt to reach these systems, but for now, we hold the advantage, and the core bends to our will.

Use the wormhole to secure the Galactic Core systems

infernals.1035.a.zh: 他们永远无法扑灭我们。
infernals.1035.a.en: They will never snuff us out.

infernals.1035.b.zh: 让他们前赴后继于熊熊烈焰中吧。
infernals.1035.b.en: Let them hurl themselves into our incinerating blaze.

infernals.1035.desc.zh:
对立帝国已强行开启通往我们靠近星系核心集结地的超空间航路。随着我们持续使核心超热，必须为抵抗做好准备。

但我们不会被阻止。宇宙中寒冷黑暗将被驱散，取而代之的是我们崛起未来的炽热辉煌。
infernals.1035.desc.en:
Rival empires have forced open hyperlanes to our staging grounds near the galactic core. As we continue to superheat the core, we must prepare for resistance.

But we will not be stopped. The cold dark of space will be scoured away, replaced by the blazing glory of our ascendant future.

infernals.1040.a.tt.zh:
一场无与伦比的危机即将席卷我们的星系。唯有新成立联盟的联合力量才能拯救我们。

将组成反对危机的联盟帝国，引发星系范围冲突。我们将对[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]宣战。
infernals.1040.a.tt.en:
A crisis of unparalleled proportions is about to engulf our galaxy. Only the combined strength of a newly formed alliance can save us. 

Will form a coalition of empires opposing the crisis, resulting in a galaxy-wide conflict. We will declare war against the [hyperthermia_empire.GetName].

infernals.1040.b.tt.zh: 危机时刻，每个物种都应该自救。我们拥有独立解决的能力。
infernals.1040.b.tt.en: In times of crisis, it is every species for themselves. We have the strength to resolve this on our own.

infernals.1040.c.tt.zh: [hyperthermia_empire.GetName]的方法符合我们新星系的愿景。契合于此，我们或可幸免于看似灾难的全力冲击。
infernals.1040.c.tt.en: The methods of [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] conform to our vision of a renewed galaxy. In light of this alignment, we may be spared the full force of what others will deem a catastrophe.

infernals.1040.d.tt.zh: 玩火的帝国司空见惯。此动荡终将过去，置身事外就好了。
infernals.1040.d.tt.en: An empire playing with fire is hardly a novelty. This upheaval will pass, as all things do. There is little reason to involve ourselves.

infernals.1040.desc.zh:
星系核心开始躁动。环绕超大质量黑洞的熵水平激增，向附近恒星系释放出热辐射波动。

正当恐慌蔓延时，一支由多星球勇敢科学家组成的小组揭示了连接核心周边六个恒星系的新近超空间航路。这些恒星系据悉拥有由[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]运作的设施，正在积极使核心过热。这种鲁莽干预将引发星系级火风暴，将毁灭所有未能阻止纵火狂野心的人。

若想生存，我们必须突破这些恒星系，夺取控制权。危机已至——温度仍在攀升。
infernals.1040.desc.en:
The galactic core has begun to stir. Entropy levels around the supermassive black hole are spiking, casting waves of thermal radiation into nearby systems.

Just as panic sets in, a team of brave scientists, drawn from many worlds, has unveiled newly-formed hyperlanes connecting to six systems encircling the core. These systems, it seems, house facilities operated by [hyperthermia_empire.GetName], which are actively superheating the core. This reckless tampering threatens to ignite a cascading firestorm across the galaxy, incinerating all who fail to stop their pyromaniac ambitions.

If we wish to survive, we must breach these systems and wrest control from their grasp. The crisis is here - and the temperature is still rising.

infernals.1042.desc.zh:
历史上伟大变革常伴随牺牲。然而，星海共同体将我方的工作视为不必要的威胁，并以联合军事同盟名义对我们动员。

其目标直指灭绝，我们别无选择：任何接近星系核心或$galactic_crucible_4$的行为都会遭到压倒性武力的回应。

我们的愿景已点燃恒星。让反对者迎战我们召唤的风暴吧。

守住星系核心恒星系，我们就一定能取得胜利！
infernals.1042.desc.en:
History's greatest transformations have always demanded sacrifice. Yet the Galactic Community views our work as a threat rather than a necessity. In response, a unified military coalition has mobilized against us.

With extermination their stated goal, we are left with no alternative: any approach toward the Galactic Core or the $galactic_crucible_4$ will be met with overwhelming force.

Our vision has ignited the stars themselves. Let those who oppose it contend with the storm we have summoned.

Defend the Galactic Core systems and our victory is assured!

infernals.1043.desc.zh:
鉴于星系核心局势升级威胁，星海共同体联合采取行动反对[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]，其激进加热星系行为威胁所有已知生命。

若任其为所欲为，无数文明将陷灭绝危机。所谓[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]已与必要联合的联盟成直接对立。

战斗已发动，数万亿生命岌岌可危。

夺取星系核心恒星系，否则将失去一切！
infernals.1043.desc.en:
In light of escalating threats at the galactic core, the Galactic Community has enacted a unified response against [hyperthermia_empire.GetName], whose radical efforts to raise the galactic temperature endanger all known life.

Should these ambitions proceed unchecked, countless civilizations face extinction. The so-called [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] now stands in direct opposition to a coalition united by necessity.

The battle has begun, and trillions of lives hang in the balance.

Capture the Galactic Core systems or all will be lost!

infernals.1045.a.tooltip.zh: 必须控制六大核心恒星系才能获胜。
infernals.1045.a.tooltip.en: We must maintain control of the six core systems to achieve victory.

infernals.1045.desc1.zh:
火风暴即将爆发。星系核心将喷发，铲除敌人并确立我们对群星的统治。

然而星系拒绝接纳我们辉煌未来。通过新开超空间航路，他们密谋入侵集结地，颠覆我们的一切。目的何在？仅为守护那阴冷停滞的黑暗？

我们绝不能允许。必须坚守核心线，直至火风暴点燃，将他们化为灰烬。
infernals.1045.desc1.en:
A cascading firestorm impends. Soon, the galactic core will erupt, cleansing our enemies and cementing our dominion over the stars.

But the galaxy refuses to embrace our radiant future. Through the newly-forged hyperlanes, they plot to invade our staging grounds and undo everything we've built. For what? To preserve their cold, stagnant darkness?

We cannot allow them to interfere. We must hold the line at the core, until the firestorm ignites and reduces them to ash.

infernals.1045.desc2.zh:
星系核心持续升温，[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]的纵火狂热助推火势。按此速度，火风暴将消灭所有反对者，几乎灭绝星系所有生命。

不可沟通妥协。若想生存，必须攻破源头：星系核心恒星系，那里火力最旺。唯有如此，[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]方能阻止。

整个星系的命运悬于一线。是时候告诉[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]，玩火者……必将自食其果。
infernals.1045.desc2.en:
The galactic core grows ever hotter, driven by [hyperthermia_empire.GetName]'s fanatical obsession with igniting the stars. At this pace, their firestorm will annihilate all opposition, and purge the galaxy of nearly all life.

They cannot be reasoned with. If we are to survive, we must strike at the source: the Galactic Core systems, where their power burns brightest. Only then can [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] be stopped.

The fate of the entire galaxy hangs in the balance. It's time to show [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] that those who play with fire... will burn.

infernals.105.desc.zh:
围绕[FromFromFrom.GetName]的天体测量扫描发现无法解释的亚空间创伤。虽然该地目前尚无出口，但过去在围绕这颗气态巨行星的轨道上可能出现过一条隧道。这些数据提供了可应用于其他领域的物理见解。

同时，我们必须去其他地方寻找，以确定恒星内活跃的亚空间隧道的来源。
infernals.105.desc.en:
Astrometric scans around [FromFromFrom.GetName] revealed unexplained subspace scarring. While there is currently no exit point at this location, a past tunnel may have opened in orbit around this gas giant. The data has provided physics insights that could be applied in other areas. 

In the meantime, we will have to look elsewhere to determine the source of the subspace tunnels at work within our star.

infernals.1052.a.tt.en: The $galactic_crucible_4$ will be ruined beyond repair.

infernals.1052.b.en: We can make use of this.

infernals.1052.b.tt.en: Turns the $galactic_crucible_4$ into a $galactic_crucible_5$ to produce $r_alloys$.

infernals.1052.desc.zh:
随着[crucible_system.GetName]恒星系被占领，我们的军团夺取了那座环绕恒星建造的$galactic_crucible_4$。

这座巨型建造物的沦陷，宣告了其缔造者以武力称霸星系的美梦破碎。
infernals.1052.desc.en:
With the capture of the [crucible_system.GetName] system, our forces have also taken control of the $galactic_crucible_4$ that was being built around the local star. 

The loss of this megastructure shatters any remaining hope its creators had of taking over the galaxy by force.

infernals.1053.a.zh: 我们必须尽快结束这场战争！
infernals.1053.a.en: We have to end this war quickly!

infernals.1053.desc.zh:
占领[crucible_system.GetName]系统揭露了[crucible_builders.GetName]的阴谋，他们企图通过前所未有的烈焰风暴彻底毁灭整个银河系。

目前，那台可能引发大规模灭绝的机器已被暂停。战争一旦结束，我们应动用剩余资源与兵力，将这座巨型建筑彻底摧毁。
infernals.1053.desc.en:
Capturing the [crucible_system.GetName] system unveiled the sinister plans of the [crucible_builders.GetName], which included the complete annihilation of the entire galaxy by an unprecedented storm of fire. 

For now, the machine that holds the potential to cause a mass extinction event has been put on hold. As soon as the war ends, we should use our remaining resources and strength to disable this giant megastructure once and for all.

infernals.1055.a.zh: 这片新星系，我们志在必得。
infernals.1055.a.en: This new galaxy is ours for the taking.

infernals.1055.b.zh: 终将所有火焰融为一体。
infernals.1055.b.en: In the end, all fires join to become one.

infernals.1055.c.zh: 我们的火热母星不容弱者拖累。
infernals.1055.c.en: Our fiery home needs no tepid weaklings.

infernals.1055.d.en: Our endurance has finally been rewarded.

infernals.1055.desc.zh:
从星系核心到最外围的恒星，我们煽起了胜利火焰。火风暴已将敌人烧成灰烬。他们缺乏勇气与远见，无法拥抱我们所缔造的辉煌未来。星系属于我们。

在这火与怒的新秩序里，行星被岩浆与光芒熔煮，由红巨星的火焰温度点亮。熵能涌流穿梭于每一恒星系，由我们采集、塑造。帝国日益富裕强盛……不可阻挡。

我们吞噬并重塑星系，成为虚空中熊熊燃烧的统治灯塔。或许有朝一日，我们还将引燃其他星系。
infernals.1055.desc.en:
We have fanned the flames of victory from the galactic core to the outermost stars. The firestorm has reduced our enemies to ash. They lacked the vision, the courage, to embrace the glorious future we claimed. The galaxy is ours.

In this new order of fire and fury, planets boil with magma and light, set aglow by the swelling heat of red giants. Entropy surges through every system, ours to harvest and bend to our will. With each passing day, our empire grows richer, stronger... unstoppable.

We have consumed the galaxy and remade it as a blazing beacon of our dominion in the void. And one day, perhaps, we'll cast other galaxies onto the pyre.

infernals.1055.e.zh: 终于，我们将寒冷与黑暗驱逐出星系。
infernals.1055.e.en: At last, we've banished the cold dark from this galaxy.

infernals.1055.f.zh: 最终，我们可怜的对手化为灰烬。
infernals.1055.f.en: At last, our miserable rivals are reduced to ash.

infernals.1056.desc.zh:
当我们忙于引燃星系时，[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]已经将其永久重塑，把恒星变为了武器。

现在，我们终于可以拥抱新的乌托邦，但随着他们对银河控制的加深，我们应密切监视他们的下一步行动。
infernals.1056.desc.en:
While we were busy igniting the spark that would set the galaxy ablaze, the [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] had already transformed stars into weapons, reshaping the galaxy forever. 

For now, we can embrace this newly forged utopia, but we should closely monitor their next moves as they tighten their grip on the galaxy.

infernals.110.desc.zh:
围绕[FromFromFrom.GetName]的扫描表明存在亚空间创伤。我们还在行星附近发现了古代废金属堆。这些废料稳定位于轨道上，可能与创伤相关。

持续扫描这些亚空间波动应有助于优化母恒星周围的太阳能阵列。

虽然这些数据有所帮助，但我们至少还需要调查一个地点，才能锁定问题根源。
infernals.110.desc.en:
The scans around [FromFromFrom.GetName] indicate subspace scarring. We have also identified pockets of ancient scrap metal near the planet. These are orbitally locked into position, and may be related to the scarring. 

Ongoing scans of these subspace fluctuations should help us to optimize the solar arrays around our home star.

While this data has been helpful, we need at least one more survey location to lock down the present source of our problems.

infernals.115.desc.zh:
终于取得重大突破。

围绕[FromFromFrom.GetName]的进一步创伤发现让我们得以通过三角定位，将恒星异常的源头锁定到一个带有敌意信号的未知星系。

这项发现或许最终能帮助我们抵御干扰恒星的未知力量。

如果能进入卢瑟斯恒星系，也许就能改写[FromFromFromFrom.Target.solar_system.GetName]乃至整个文明的命运。
infernals.115.desc.en:
At last, a real breakthrough.

Further scarring around [FromFromFrom.GetName] allowed us to triangulate the origin of our star's disturbance to a previously undetected system with hostile signatures.

This investigation may eventually help us to counteract whatever is affecting our star.

Once we advance into the Lusus system, we may be able to change the fate of [FromFromFromFrom.Target.solar_system.GetName], and of our civilization.

infernals.2115.d.zh: 幸存者构成威胁，予以剿灭。
infernals.2115.d.en: The survivors are a risk. Eliminate them.

infernals.2115.desc.zh:
我方部队已全面掌控该空间站。当地居民虽曾抵抗，但其装备简陋，且缺乏战争经验，许多人甚至尚未成年。幸存者均已被拘押。

我们已着手研究如何控制那些亚空间隧道，它们似乎是一种能源开采虹吸装置。假以时日，我们或许就能解决母星系正面临的问题。
infernals.2115.desc.en:
Our forces have seized control of the station. The inhabitants put up some resistance, but were poorly armed and seemingly untrained in warfare. Upon closer inspection, many appeared to be juveniles. Those who were not killed have been contained.

Analysis has begun on how we can control the subspace tunnels, which appear to be some sort of energy-mining siphon. With time, we can address the situation in our home system.

infernals.2121.desc.zh:
亚空间开采站被摧毁，里面人员全部死亡。

摧毁开采站引爆了某种未知能量储备介质，释放的能量通过坍塌的亚空间隧道涌入[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]，致其局势急剧恶化。

不过，向恒星输送氢气的过程已经停止。情况虽然糟糕，但不至于继续恶化。尽管我们可能永远无法了解此开采站的起源与设计，但至少能放心，因为这种力量永远不会落入对手手中。

遗憾的是，我们暂时没有办法让[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]立即复原。若想影响恒星状态，只能依靠记录还原开采站运作。
infernals.2121.desc.en:
The subspace mining station has been destroyed, killing everyone on board.

The destruction of the station detonated some unknown energy storage medium. The resulting energy rushed through the collapsing subspace tunnel into [event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName], substantially worsening the situation back home.
