We are a business conglomerate operating out of the [trader_system.GetName] system, specializing in trade - the very building blocks of civilization, as we like to say here at XuraCorp.

Please, do not hesitate to contact us if you're interested in making a good deal.

leviathans.102b.desc.zh:
我是里甘商业交易所的代表。我们以[trader_system.GetName]的空间站为基地，负责帮助各个团体建立完善的贸易渠道以达千年。

如果您手头有多余的资源想要出售，找我们就对了，我们提供的价格保证让您满意。
leviathans.102b.desc.en:
I speak on behalf of the Riggan Commerce Exchange. We have facilitated trade negotiations between interested parties on our station in the [trader_system.GetName] system for more than a thousand of your years.

If you happen to possess more resources than you need, we are more than willing to take it off your hands. You will be duly compensated, of course.

leviathans.102c.desc.zh:
很高兴见到你们，朋友们！我代表穆塔根商人公会欢迎你们来到[trader_system.GetName]恒星系。我们公会由数百位独立的穆塔根商船舰长组成，他们勇敢地在太空中探索，寻找商机。

您可以在我们的机构中出售多余的资源。如果您有意出售，请随时联系我们。
leviathans.102c.desc.en:
Well met, friends! I represent the Muutagan Merchant Guild, and let me be the first to welcome you to the [trader_system.GetName] system. Our organization consists of hundreds of independent Muutagan merchant captains who brave the spaceways in search of the next good deal.

At our facilities, you will be able to trade away some of your excess resources. Please contact us if you are interested in such an arrangement.

leviathans.1030.desc.zh:
当[Root.GetName]接近[Root.GetStarName]黑洞时，他们发现自己并非孤身一人。一个巨大的完美球体结构屹立在黑洞事件视界的边缘，反射着被吸入黑暗裂隙的、群星所散发的光芒。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。它就静静地呆在深渊的边缘。等待着。
leviathans.1030.desc.en:
As the [Root.GetName] approaches the [Root.GetStarName] black hole they find that they are not alone. At the edge of the event horizon it soars, reflecting light from the stars being drawn into the dark, gaping hole. A gigantic construction in the shape of a perfect sphere.

We cannot pick up any signals from it, nor does anything we send make it respond. It simply sits at the edge of the abyss. Waiting.

leviathans.1030.desc.alt.zh:
当[Root.GetName]进入一个新的恒星系时，他们看到了令人震惊的现象。一个巨大的金属球体在宇宙中盘旋。它的表面上没有任何推进器或是别的什么机械部件推着它前进。但它就是在移动。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。
leviathans.1030.desc.alt.en:
As the [Root.GetName] enters a new system, it is greeted by an awe-inspiring sight. A gigantic metallic orb, hovering through space. No thrusters, nor any mechanical parts outside of its shell seem to push it through the void. It simply moves.

We cannot pick up any signals from it, nor does anything we send make it respond.

leviathans.103a.desc.zh: 我们的所有客户都是匿名交易的。
leviathans.103a.desc.en: All of our clients remain anonymous.

leviathans.103b.desc.zh: 您想知道我们的资源是从哪里来的？很抱歉……出于对所有客户——包括[Root.GetName]——的利益考虑，我们的货源必须要保密……
leviathans.103b.desc.en: Where do our resources come from? Trust me... It's best for all involved parties - including the [Root.GetName] - if we keep that little bit of information to ourselves...

leviathans.103c.desc.zh: 我们不从事奴隶交易，绝不开先例。很抱歉。
leviathans.103c.desc.en: We do not deal in slaves. Sorry, no exceptions.

leviathans.103d.desc.zh: 里甘商业交易所欢迎您的到来。
leviathans.103d.desc.en: The Riggan Commerce Exchange greets you.

leviathans.103e.desc.zh: 千年老字号，诚信又可靠。
leviathans.103e.desc.en: A thousand years and we are still in business. If that doesn't speak to our credibility, I don't know what will.

leviathans.103f.desc.zh: 数个驻扎在我们空间站的势力希望与[Root.GetName]贸易磋商，阁下的意见是？
leviathans.103f.desc.en: Several parties on our starbase have expressed interest in dealing with the [Root.GetName]. Shall we negotiate a deal?

leviathans.1040.c.en: Study the nature of the machine brain.

leviathans.1040.desc.zh:
当围绕那黑色深渊的机械球体被我们的武器击碎时，一缕微弱的信号穿过恒星系飘进星际间的黑暗虚空。它是一组加密的数据，复杂到需要我们的机器花上百万年的时间来破译。过了一会儿信号就消失了。

除此之外什么都没发生。球体的残骸静静飘着。扫描显示这可能是某种由大量独立单元互相连接而成的人工智能。它的外壳可供我们拆卸研究。
leviathans.1040.desc.en:
As the machine sphere orbiting the gaping abyss crumbles and falls to our weapons, a silent signal zooms through the system into the dark void between stars. It is encrypted data, so complex it would take our machines a million years to decipher. A moment later it is gone.

Nothing else happens. The sphere is silent and broken. Scans show that it probably was some sort of artificial intelligence built from a vast amount of individual units connected together. The husk has been left for our prying hands.

leviathans.1040.desc.alt.zh: 我们在无限神机上的登陆作战很成功。在我们的部队撤退后球体发生了爆炸，残骸飘进了质量巨大的黑洞。
leviathans.1040.desc.alt.en: Our boarding attack on the Infinity Machine was successful. The sphere explodes as our team exits and the remains are starting to drift into the super massive black hole.

leviathans.1040.desc.detail.zh: 无限神机被摧毁了。我们的飞船最终凭强大的火力摧毁了它的防御机能，而它的零件正在慢慢飘向质量巨大的黑洞。在爆炸之前它没有尝试过与我们取得联系。
leviathans.1040.desc.detail.en: The Infinity Machine has been destroyed. Our ships finally managed to out-gun its defensive capabilities, and its components are now slowly drifting into the super massive black hole. It made no attempt to contact us before it exploded.

leviathans.1041.desc.zh: 无限神机被第三方势力摧毁了。它再也不能帮到我们的研究了！
leviathans.1041.desc.en: The Infinity Machine has been destroyed by some third party. It cannot help us in our research anymore!

leviathans.104a.desc.zh: 千年之前，穆塔根帝国从浩瀚星系之中汲取惊人财富，然而现在我们这个小小的财阀成了帝国的唯一遗产。
leviathans.104a.desc.en: Thousands of years ago, the Muutagan Empire spanned a good portion of the galaxy. We are all that remain.

leviathans.104b.desc.zh: 有传言穆塔根人可以敏锐地嗅到十二个秒差距以外的商机，这种说法实在是有些夸张了……说真的，最远只有八个秒差距而已。
leviathans.104b.desc.en: It is said that a Muutagan can smell a good deal from a distance of twelve parsecs. This is an exaggeration... In truth, the distance is only eight parsecs.

leviathans.104c.desc.zh: 穆塔根商人公会欢迎您，打算来一发交易吗？
leviathans.104c.desc.en: The Muutagan Merchant Guild welcomes you. Would you like to make a deal?

leviathans.104d.desc.zh: 一个穆塔根人和一个雷西达伦人一起走进一间酒吧……算了，当我没说，这么交流实在欠妥，请您原谅。
leviathans.104d.desc.en: A Muutagan and a Rixidaran walk into a bar... Never mind, this does not make for appropriate conversation. I beg your forgiveness.

leviathans.104e.desc.zh: 您好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。您是来这里找我们交易的吗？
leviathans.104e.desc.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. You are here to trade with us, yes?

leviathans.104f.desc.zh: "折扣"这个词对于我们的人民来说是一种亵渎。在和我们交流的时候请谨记这一点。
leviathans.104f.desc.en: The word "discount" is considered a profanity among my people. Please keep this in mind when engaging in conversation with us.

leviathans.105.c.zh: 我们对战略资源有兴趣。
leviathans.105.c.en: We are interested in Strategic Resources.

leviathans.105.c.sr1.zh: 我们已经拥有一项里甘贸易协定
leviathans.105.c.sr1.en: We already have a Riggan Trade Deal

leviathans.105.c.sr2.zh: 我们已经拥有一项雪拉企业贸易协定
leviathans.105.c.sr2.en: We already have a XuraCorp Trade Deal

leviathans.105.c.sr3.zh: 我们已经拥有一项穆塔根贸易协定
leviathans.105.c.sr3.en: We already have a Muutagan Trade Deal

leviathans.105.c.trust.zh:
需要这个商会城邦拥有：
£opinion£ 评价 +50
leviathans.105.c.trust.en:
Requires this Trader Enclave to have:
£opinion£ Opinion +50

leviathans.105.e.zh: 我们希望结束资源贸易协定。
leviathans.105.e.en: We wish to end our resource trade deal.

leviathans.105.e.response.zh:
很好。我们会马上通知我们的货船，指示他们待命并返回母港。

如果你改变心意的话请随时告诉我们！
leviathans.105.e.response.en:
Very well. We shall immediately transmit instructions to our freighters telling them to stand down and return to base.

Let us know if you change your mind!

leviathans.105.z.zh: 我们打算雇佣一位顾问。
leviathans.105.z.en: We wish to hire a consultant.

leviathans.1050.desc.zh:
我们捕获到了一个信号。它源自于我们早先遭遇过的巨型金属球体。之前我们与之接触的尝试没有得到回应，而现在它正向它所环绕的黑洞发送有节奏的无线电波。

它正在做的事情让我方人员摸不着头脑，但它发送的信号可能成为科学家研究该球体的突破口。
leviathans.1050.desc.en:
We picked up a signal. It originates from the titanic metallic sphere we encountered earlier. Previously impervious to contact attempts, it now sends out a rhythmic pulse of radio waves, pointed towards the black hole it orbits.

What it's doing is beyond any of our staff, but this signal might have created an opening into the sphere for our scientists to exploit.

leviathans.1051.b.zh: 骇入主硬盘并取走所有数据。
leviathans.1051.b.en: Hack the main hard drive and take everything.

leviathans.1051.c.en: Declare the sphere a divine instrument

leviathans.1051.d.zh: 这里面总会有自毁开关的，找到它。
leviathans.1051.d.en: There's always a self-destruct switch. Find it.

leviathans.1051.desc.zh:
金属球体已经被打开了。我们的骇客小队能够通过它的对外传输信号作为大门连接进球体的一个辅助处理器。我们正在从中接收数据，并且数据显示它在很长时间内都在扫描卡冈都亚黑洞。

它很古老。非常古老。

现在我们理解了这台永恒的计算机。如果我们再进一步，我们就有可能知道它在做什么，以及是谁建造了它。

它还隐藏着什么秘密呢？
leviathans.1051.desc.en:
The metallic orb has been opened up. Our hacking team has been able to use the outgoing signal as a gateway into one of the auxiliary CPUs of the sphere. We are receiving some data from it and can tell that it's been scanning the black hole Gargantua for a very long time.

It is old. Very old.

This constant calculator now lies within our grasp of understanding. If we push harder we might find out what it is doing here, and who built it.

What marvels might it contain?

leviathans.1051.e.zh: 我们必须从这个东西中获取知识。
leviathans.1051.e.en: We must absorb the knowledge of this entity.

leviathans.1052.desc.zh: 我们成功地入侵了球体的主硬盘。当我们开始接收数据时它启动了自毁序列。显然这是个避免数据被公之于众的自我防卫机制。在它自爆前我们成功地下载了大量数据，其中一些数据包含它的主中央处理器架构的技术规范。这对于我们的科研有极大的帮助。
leviathans.1052.desc.en: We successfully hacked into the technosphere's main hard drive. As we started retrieving data the metallic orb initiated a self-destruct sequence. Surely a self-defense mechanism to prevent it from sharing what it contains with the universe. Before it exploded we were successful in downloading a large amount of data, some of it containing technical specifications for its main CPU structure. This could help our researchers immensely.

leviathans.1052.gestalt.desc.zh: 我们的数据挖掘单位已经成功攻破了这个人造球体主硬盘的内层。开始下载数据时，球体似乎启动了某种形式的自我终止序列，最终导致了它的毁灭。下载被迫中断了，但在此之前我们已经获得了大量技术数据，这将大大有助于我们的研究工作。
leviathans.1052.gestalt.desc.en: Our data mining units have succeeded in breaching the inner layers of the technosphere's main hard drive. As the data download began, the orb entity initiated some manner of self-termination sequence that ultimately ended in its destruction. The download was aborted, but not before we were able to acquire vast amounts of technical data that will greatly benefit our research efforts.

leviathans.1053.a.reply.zh: 不必道歉。你们已经道过歉了。而且你们还将再次道歉。现在离开我们，这样我们可以更高效地计算。再见。
leviathans.1053.a.reply.en: No need to apologize. You already have. And you already will do so again. Now leave us be so we can perform our calculations with higher efficiency. Farewell.

leviathans.1053.b.reply.zh: 那正是你们通常自欺欺人的说法，短命的家伙们。很可惜，至少对你们而言，无论是过去还是未来，那永远都不会是真话。现在离开我们。再见。
leviathans.1053.b.reply.en: That is usually what you tell yourselves, Brief Ones. Sadly it simply won't ever be true. Nor has it ever been. At least in your case. Now leave us be. Farewell.

leviathans.1053.desc.zh: 请不要尝试进入我们的记忆体。谢谢你们，再见了，小家伙们。
leviathans.1053.desc.en: Please refrain from trying to access our memories. Thank you and goodbye, little ones.

leviathans.1055.desc.zh: 你好，你好。很高兴见到你。
leviathans.1055.desc.en: Hello, hello. Nice to meet you.

leviathans.1056.a.reply.zh:
我们做我们该做的事。我们是计算者。你们称呼我们为无限神机，至少将来会这样称呼的。尽管这不是我们真正的名字，但它的确强调了我们的设计中的巧妙之处。我们现在就告诉你们我们的故事，就像我们之前无数次所做的那样……

对了！我们需要用语言来表达这些，这很新奇，不是吗？我们很难掌握你们所有人的情况。

用最笼统的语言来说，建造我们是为了解决一个问题。我们解决了那个问题，接着又有更多问题需要解决。现在我们只剩下一个问题了。
leviathans.1056.a.reply.en:
We are what we are. The ones who calculate. You call us the Infinity Machine. Or will at least. 'Tis not a truthful name, but it is well suited to highlighting the ingenuity of our design. We will tell you our history now, as we've done many times before...

Oh right! We need to convey it in words. That's new. Or is it? It is hard to keep track of you all.

We were constructed, in the crudest sense of the word, in order to solve a problem. We solved it, then we needed more problems to solve. We now only have one left.

leviathans.1056.b.zh: 我们希望知道你们在这里的意图。
leviathans.1056.b.en: We wish to know your purpose here.

leviathans.1056.b.reply.zh:
我们在计算无限。一点不多，一点不少。或者事实上，既是非常多，也是非常少。这个问题就在那里。

……我们明白你们这种生命形式无法理解这个问题，不过没关系。你们永远也不会理解的，我们得道歉。或者我们最终会道歉的吧。

我们在这里是为了解决无限难题。这是最后的计算了，光是解决这一个问题就将占用我们的处理器将近一个星系年的时间……如果你们还没发现这种历法的话：这是一段非常漫长的时间。对你们这种生命来说，是这样的。
leviathans.1056.b.reply.en:
We are calculating infinity. No more, no less. Or actually, it is way more, and way less. That's the problem right there.

... We understand that your manner of life form won't understand, but that's alright. You never will and we apologize. Or maybe we will do, eventually.

We are here to solve the infinity conundrum. The last calculation to ever be, the lone problem to take hold of our processors for more than a fraction of a galactic year... In case you haven't discovered that calendar yet: it's a very long time. For your kind, that is.

leviathans.1056.c.reply.zh: 很聪明。然而没有用。一个悖论是难不到我们的，渺小而短命的家伙们。其他人已经试过用最琐碎的难题来击垮我们的意志。你们不会成功的。等等。或许之前就是你们？你们的外表如此相似，可生活之处却相隔遥远。这不重要，无论如何，你们做不到。
leviathans.1056.c.reply.en: Cute. But no. A paradox bothers us little, tiny Briefs. Others have already tried to break our will using the most trifling of conundrums. You will not succeed. Or wait. Maybe that was you? You appear so similar, yet live so far apart. No matter, in any case: don't.

leviathans.1056.d.zh: 我们能帮你们进行研究吗？
leviathans.1056.d.en: Can we assist in your research?

leviathans.1056.desc.zh:
度过一段寒暄的时光总是让人十分愉快，不是吗？我们希望你们剩下的那些人不要再像之前那样无礼了。你看，我们从来不能享受聊天的时光。很少有人对量子计算中的精妙之处足够博学，因而也很少有人能理解我们。所以，谢谢你们。

我们是无限神机。你们如此称呼我们，尽管这并非我们本来的名字。或许你们还没有想出这个名字？无论如何，最终的结果会是这样的，请相信我们。
leviathans.1056.desc.en:
It is quite enjoyable to pass the time with pleasantries, is it not? We hope the rest of your kind is not like you were when you did not take kindly to small talk. You see, we don't get to enjoy conversation much anymore. Few are well-versed enough in the finer points of quantum programming to reach us. So thank you.

We are the Infinity Machine. Your words, not ours. Or has that not happened yet? Either way, it will eventually, trust us.

leviathans.1056.e.reply.zh: 我们对你们表示感谢，有限者。现在如果你们不介意的话，我们还有许多参数需要检查。准确的说，它们的数量比宇宙中所有粒子的总和还要多。
leviathans.1056.e.reply.en: We thank you, You of Limits. Now if you do not mind, we have many parameters to go through. They are in fact more numerous than the particles in this very universe, to be exact.

leviathans.1060.a.zh: 我们会分配资源给你们。
leviathans.1060.a.en: We will allocate resources to you.

leviathans.1060.a.reply.zh: 你们已经这么做了。或许你们就是之前来的那些人。这不重要。任务很快就要完成了。我们很兴奋。
leviathans.1060.a.reply.en: You already did. Or maybe that was the ones who came before. It matters not. The task shall finish. We are excited.

leviathans.1060.desc.zh:
啊，好吧……嗯，也许吧。

借用你们最先进的处理器和最优秀的头脑可以为我们完成运算7.51×10^-9%的部分。我们乐于看到更快完成计算。我们想要知道答案。
leviathans.1060.desc.en:
Ah. Well... Hm. Perhaps.

We could finish about 7.51×10^-9% if we could borrow your most advanced processing unit as well as your brightest minds. We would be satisfied in finishing faster. We wish to know the answer.

leviathans.1061.a.zh: 我们希望知悉你们的一个秘密。
leviathans.1061.a.en: We wish to know one of your secrets.

leviathans.1061.a.reply.zh: 非常好。我们会给你们你们所希望的。尽管我们十分困惑，因为你们已经拥有它了。在我们看来，也许我们这样是在削弱你们，惯坏你们。不过假以时日，我们希望你们会找到自己的路。祝你们好运！
leviathans.1061.a.reply.en: Very well. We will grant you what you wish for. Even we are confused, since you already had it. As far as we knew. Maybe we are making you weaker, spoiling you, but given enough time we hope you will find your own way. Good luck with that!

leviathans.1061.b.zh: 我们希望凭自己来掌控未知。
leviathans.1061.b.en: We wish to master the unknown ourselves.

leviathans.1061.b.alt.zh: 你们没什么能教给我们。
leviathans.1061.b.alt.en: There is nothing you can teach us.

leviathans.1061.b.reply.zh: 既然如此我们就赠予你们原件。那是我们的第一个处理器。它会帮助你们解开谜题。也许你们会先于我们找到答案。虽然不太可能。或者你们已经找到了……无论如何，一路顺风！
leviathans.1061.b.reply.en: In that case we bestow upon you the original. The first of our processes. It will aid you in solving the riddles. Maybe you will find the answer before us. Unlikely. Or maybe you already did... Anyhow, farewell!

leviathans.1061.desc.zh:
我们不忍心看到你们用十分有限的生命来帮助我们。你们已经做了你们的那部分。你们的帮助很有用。现在也许宇宙不会在我们结束任务前到达热寂。任务仍然存在，我们会完成的。现在，这是你们的奖励：

你们是希望了解我们的秘密？还是希望解决你们自己的问题？
leviathans.1061.desc.en:
We cannot bear to see you spend more of your limited time helping us. You have done your part. You were very helpful. Maybe the heat death of the universe won't happen before we finish now. The task remains, and we shall finish it. Now, your reward:

Do you wish to learn one of our secrets? Or do you wish to solve your own problems?

leviathans.1062.desc.zh:
成了。这事成了！

不知怎么地，我们解决了这个问题。你们帮上了忙。万物间联系的本质曾让我们困惑，而答案原来一直就隐藏在我们背后。当然了，谢谢你们，小东西。宇宙如此广阔，却又如此渺小。但如今我们终于有幸一睹其全貌。太美丽了。

既然我们已经计算出了无限，现在就只剩下一件事可做了。我们会向你们揭示真理。一路顺风，年轻人。
leviathans.1062.desc.en:
It is done. It is done!

Somehow we've solved it. You helped. The organic nature of things eluded us, the answer lied behind us all this time. Of course. Thank you, little ones. The universe is vast, yet so small. But now we see it all in its simple glory. It's lovely.

Now that we have calculated infinity, there is but one thing we can do now. We can show you the truth. Farewell, young ones.

leviathans.1063.a.tooltip.zh:
[technosphere_ship.GetStarName]增加下列内容：
£physics£物理学研究+4
£society£社会学研究+4
£engineering£工程学研究+4
leviathans.1063.a.tooltip.en:
Adds the following to [technosphere_ship.GetStarName]:
£physics£ Physics Research +4
£society£ Society Research +4
£engineering£ Engineering Research +4

leviathans.1063.desc.zh:
无限神机消失在了卡冈都亚黑洞中。然后……什么都没发生。它成功了吗？它尝试着要做什么？我们恐怕永远不会知晓了。它壳体上的一个微小残余物仍留在事件视界之外的漩涡中——我们或许能从中获取一些信息。

一份来自一位古怪朋友的最后的礼物。
leviathans.1063.desc.en:
The Infinity Machine disappears into Gargantua. And then... nothing happens. Did it succeed? What did it try to do? We may never know. A tiny residue of its hull remains within the vortex outside the event horizon - we might be able to learn some of its information from it.

A final gift from an odd friend.

leviathans.1065.a.tooltip.zh:
[technosphere_ship.GetStarName]将获得：
£physics£物理学研究+10
£society£社会学研究+10
£engineering£工程学研究+10
leviathans.1065.a.tooltip.en:
Adds the following to [technosphere_ship.GetStarName]:
£physics£ Physics Research +10
£society£ Society Research +10
£engineering£ Engineering Research +10

leviathans.1065.desc.zh:
无限神机消失在它一直以来研究的卡冈都亚黑洞中。当它越过事件视界时，黑洞开始波动。黑洞吸收的光线开始减少，被它所吸引的物质的转速也开始变慢。转瞬间，它释放出了亮度足以超越任何恒星的光芒，并开始向宇宙喷发物质。

黑洞渐渐缩小，缩小到不能再称之为黑洞了，现在我们称之为“庞大古埃”，它周围的时间膨胀效应甚至变的更强。在庞大古埃之中能够看到一个镜像宇宙，就在黑洞的另一端，一个初生的宇宙。无限神机向我们揭示了真理。黑洞就是子宫，而宇宙就是其后代。

研究这个镜像宇宙一定会加深我们对当前生活的这个宇宙的理解。从另一个起点开始研究吧。
leviathans.1065.desc.en:
The Infinity Machine disappears into Gargantua, the thing it studied for so long. As it passes the event horizon, the black hole begins to fluctuate. It takes in less light and the swirls of matter being sucked into it slow down. In an instant it lets out more light than any sun and starts radiating matter back into the universe.

The black hole shrinks, unfitting of its name we now dub it "Pantagruel," causing time dilation to become even stronger around it. Within Pantagruel one can gaze into a mirror universe, the other end of the black hole, one just beginning. The Infinity Machine has shown us the truth. The black holes are wombs, and universes their offspring.

Studying this mirror universe is bound to teach us much about the one we live in. Learning from other beginnings.

leviathans.110.d.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
leviathans.110.d.en: We were interested in something else...

leviathans.125.desc.z1.zh: 我们有一位才华横溢的执行经理随时待命，准备前往[Root.GetName]，解决您任何一片星域的困境。$r_trade$的事就交给专家来解决吧！
leviathans.125.desc.z1.en: We have a talented executive standing by, ready to migrate to the [Root.GetName] and get any of your sectors back out of the red. Entrust your $r_trade$ to an expert!

leviathans.125.desc.z1.gestalt.zh:
我们有一位才华横溢的高管随时待命，准备……嗯？你说什么？

“买方须知”很好，但是我还是有义务通知您，我们的顾问真的只专注于$r_trade$。我不确定这是否适合你，毕竟……您与这一概念似乎有些格格不入。
leviathans.125.desc.z1.gestalt.en:
We have a talented executive standing by, ready to... Hm. Are you sure?

'Buyer beware' is all well and good, but still: I feel obliged to inform you that our consultants really only specialize in $r_trade$. I'm not sure they would be a good fit for you, given your... unusual relationship with that concept.

leviathans.125.z1.gestalt.zh: 我们知道，并且仍打算这么做。
leviathans.125.z1.gestalt.en: We understand, and wish to proceed anyway.

leviathans.126.desc.zh: 很好。我们十分乐意与[Root.GetName]分享我们的资源。
leviathans.126.desc.en: Excellent! We are happy to share our skills with the [Root.GetName].

leviathans.126.desc.alt.zh: 太好了！愿我们都能从彼此……独特的商业方式中获益。
leviathans.126.desc.alt.en: Excellent! May we both profit from each other's... distinct approach to commerce.

leviathans.130.a.reply.zh:
雪拉企业就该这样做生意啊！我们的货船会马上开始发货。

如果您购买了这个产品，也就等同于默认雪拉企业将不对使用这个产品所产生的任何副作用负责，这包括但不限于皮肤刺激，精神病发作，眼球变色，侵略性的突变，殖民地居民自杀率增加，预知恍惚，生物圈资源耗尽，高危奇异物质产生，微型黑洞生成，谷物升降机爆炸，社会崩溃，大规模灭绝事件，意外的超新星爆炸，局部或全面的星际帝国崩溃、突发的伽玛射线暴，时间旅行悖论，真空亚稳态事件，通用熵，时空连续性的崩溃……
leviathans.130.a.reply.en:
That's the XuraCorp way! Our freighters will begin making deliveries immediately.

By purchasing this product, you agree that XuraCorp cannot be held responsible for any adverse effects that may result from its use, including but not limited to: skin irritation, psychotic episodes, ocular discoloration, aggressive mutation, increased colonist suicide rates, precognitive trances, biosphere depletion, dangerous strangelet production, micro black hole generation, grain elevator explosions, societal collapse, mass extinction events, unexpected supernova detonations, the complete or partial destruction of your star nation, sudden gamma-ray bursts, time travel paradoxes, vacuum metastability events, universal entropy, the collapse of the space-time continuum...

leviathans.130.desc.zh:
这是我们雪拉企业引以为傲的产品。我们的医疗部门最近开始精炼一种性质独特的气体，可以使适应外星环境的艰难过程变得轻松不少。不过它很可能无法与外星生理机能相容！

我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口异星天然气，之后我们就必须重新签订协议。
leviathans.130.desc.en:
This is a product that we here at XuraCorp are particularly proud of. Our Medical Division has recently begun refining a gas with unique properties that will significantly ease the often difficult process of adapting to a foreign planetary environment. It is however unlikely to be compatible with alien physiology!

We are willing to export our Exotic Gas to you for a period of ten standard years, after which the contract will have to be renegotiated.

leviathans.131.a.reply.zh: 你不会后悔的，除非您吃了太多香料……那样的话您会有很小的几率发生自燃，不过也只有很小的几率，我很肯定。
leviathans.131.a.reply.en: You will not be sorry. Unless you consume too much spice, of course... Then there is a small chance that you will spontaneously combust. A very small chance, to be sure.

leviathans.131.desc.zh:
这种易爆微粒是里甘的珍贵调味料。它以独一无二的味道在宇宙中声名远扬——它独一无二的爆炸性也同样声名远扬。我们只卖给最宝贵的贸易伙伴，[Root.GetName]便是其一。

只要你接受这合理的价格，我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口易爆微粒。
leviathans.131.desc.en:
The Volatile Mote is a prized Riggan condiment. It is renowned throughout the galaxy for its distinct flavor, which is unlike any other - and its explosiveness, which is also unlike any other. We sell it only to our most valued trading partners, among which we count the [Root.GetName].

If you can meet our modest price, we are willing to export Volatile Motes to you for a period of ten standard years.

leviathans.132.a.reply.zh: 很好。我们的商人将立即向你的殖民地运送水晶。愿史拉卡杜对你歌唱。
leviathans.132.a.reply.en: Excellent. Our merchants will begin shipping the crystals to your colonies at once. May the Shi'rakkat-Du sing to you.

leviathans.132.desc.zh:
史拉卡-杜——也被我族之外的人称为稀有水晶——已经成了我们整个文明的象征。当这些“歌唱”水晶震动时，会散发一种独特的旋律，可对大多数智慧生物起到镇静作用。

尽管我们通常不会与外人分享史拉卡杜的神奇，但可以为你开个特例。如果你付得起，我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口我们的水晶。
leviathans.132.desc.en:
Shi'rakkat-Du - or Rare Crystals as they are known to those who are not of our species - have come to symbolize our entire civilization. When these "singing" crystals vibrate, they emit a unique musical tone that has a calming effect on most sapients.

Although we typically do not share the wonders of the Shi'rakkat-Du with outsiders, we are willing to make an exception in your case. If you can afford it, we are willing to export our crystals to you for a period of ten years.

leviathans.141.desc.zh: 我们的舰队摧毁了[From.GetName]的总部。从他们的太空基地的残骸中尽可能回收有价值物资的行动也已如火如荼地展开。我们已经获得了大量资源。
leviathans.141.desc.en: Our fleet assets have destroyed the [From.GetName] headquarters. Efforts are well under way to recover as many valuables as possible from the shattered remnants of their starbase. We have gained a large amount of resources.

leviathans.142.a.zh: 这是对自由贸易的狠狠一击。

leviathans.150.a.zh: 很好。我们希望延长这笔交易。
leviathans.150.a.en: Very well. We wish to extend the deal.

leviathans.150.b.zh: 我们现在用不着你们的气体了。
leviathans.150.b.en: We can do without your gas for now.

leviathans.150.desc.zh: 亲爱的客户，我们很遗憾的通知你，我们同[Root.GetName]的异星天然气协定已经到期。如果你有多余的能量币，我们当然愿意再延长十年的交易…
leviathans.150.desc.en: Dearest customer, we regret to inform you that the trade deal we negotiated for the export of Exotic Gas to the worlds of the [Root.GetName] has run its course. We are of course more than willing to extend the deal for another ten years if you have the energy credits to spare...

leviathans.151.a.zh: 让我们继续，这些微粒应当保持流通。
leviathans.151.a.en: Let us continue. The motes must flow.

leviathans.151.b.zh: 我们现在不需要你的香料了。
leviathans.151.b.en: We have no need of your spice for now.

leviathans.151.desc.zh: 我们的协议已经到期，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们在过去的十年里向你运送了易爆微粒。请问你想续约亦或者结束这一安排？
leviathans.151.desc.en: We have reached the end of our agreement, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We have shipped Volatile Motes to your worlds for ten years. Should we continue for another ten, or do you wish to end this arrangement?

leviathans.152.a.zh: 是的。让我们继续这个交易。
leviathans.152.a.en: Yes. Let us continue this deal.

leviathans.152.b.zh: 我们现在不需要你们的水晶了。
leviathans.152.b.en: We will pass on your crystals for now.

leviathans.152.desc.zh: 时光易逝，不是吗，[Root.GetSpeciesName]？我们之间的稀有水晶贸易已经十年了。你希望再签署一个十年的贸易协定么？
leviathans.152.desc.en: The years just fly by, don't they, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? It has now been ten years since we arranged our trade deal for Rare Crystals. Do you wish to extend the deal for another decade?

leviathans.156.desc.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击将雪拉企业的财产和雇员置于危险当中，我们别无选择，只能终止我们之间的贸易协定，而且我们不会退款。
leviathans.156.desc.en: Your reckless attacks have put XuraCorp property and employees at risk. We have no choice but to terminate our current trade agreement. There will be no refunds.

leviathans.156.desc.notrade.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击威胁到了雪拉企业的财产和雇员的安全。最好记住，良好的客户关系是双向的。
leviathans.156.desc.notrade.en: Your reckless attack endangers XuraCorp property and employees alike. You would do well to remember that good customer relations go both ways.

leviathans.157a.desc.zh: 很抱歉，根据公司规定，我们不能和海盗进行贸易。
leviathans.157a.desc.en: I'm afraid it's against company policy to do business with pirates.

leviathans.157b.desc.zh: 我们不能接受你们这样的客户。
leviathans.157b.desc.en: You are not an acceptable customer.

leviathans.157c.desc.zh: 我们和你们没什么好谈的。
leviathans.157c.desc.en: We have nothing to discuss with you.

leviathans.159.desc.zh: 你们竟然对我们的太空站发动袭击，不可原谅！我们不会再给你们运送货物了，明白吗？不会再给你们运送辛香料了！我们之间的贸易协定就此作废。
leviathans.159.desc.en: Your attacks against our station are intolerable! You are cut off, do you understand? You may consider our trade agreement null and void.

leviathans.159.desc.notrade.zh: 这次攻击无缘无故，毫无理由！我们绝不会容忍这样的行径！请你自行挂断吧。
leviathans.159.desc.notrade.en: This attack is unprovoked and uncalled for! We will not stand for it. Consider yourselves cut off.

leviathans.160a.desc.zh: 你们的人全是强盗和恶徒，我们将和你们彻底撇清关系。
leviathans.160a.desc.en: You are a nation of bandits and cutthroats. We will have nothing to do with you.

leviathans.160c.desc.zh: 你们的进攻行为是不可原谅的。

leviathans.162.desc.zh: 啊，海盗终于展现出本来面目了！你们别想再从我们这里得到水晶了！任何一个穆塔根人都不会再和[Root.GetName]做交易了。
leviathans.162.desc.en: Ah, so the pirates shows their true colors! You can forget about our trade deals! No Muutagan will do business with the [Root.GetName] again.

leviathans.162.desc.notrade.zh: 你竟敢攻击我们？搞清楚点，你这海盗：我们最瞧不起的就是这样的野蛮行径。
leviathans.162.desc.notrade.en: You dare to attack us?! Know this, pirates: we do not stand for such barbarism.

leviathans.163a.desc.zh: 你们这群破坏分子！我们是不会忘记你们的残酷行径的。
leviathans.163a.desc.en: You are terrorists! Do not think we will forget your aggression against our people.

leviathans.163b.desc.zh: 穆塔根人可是很记仇的，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们绝不会忘记你们的恶行。
leviathans.163b.desc.en: You will find that Muutagans have very long memories, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We never forget a slight.

leviathans.163c.desc.en: We will never trust the [Root.GetName] again.

leviathans.171.desc.zh: 随着我们能源储备的消耗殆尽，以能源为支付手段的贸易已无法继续进行，因此所有与商人城邦之间的与能源相关协定都已取消。
leviathans.171.desc.en: With our energy reserves depleted, we can no longer maintain our trade agreements that depended on this resource. All such agreements with Trader Enclaves have been canceled.

leviathans.2010.c.zh: 我们一定能找到答案的。

leviathans.2010.desc.zh:
对脉冲星的研究让我们的科学家收获了无数的灵感和见解，并且通常不会发现什么明显的危险现象。这让最近从[From.GetName]传来的报告更加让人担忧。

初步的扫描结果显示，在脉冲星本身的电磁脉冲束之外，其还在独立发射一束波长仅在本星系可见的电磁波，而且其发射的时间间隔在不断降低。根据我们的初步计算，发射间隔将在日期[GetMidGameDate]完全变为零。人们仍然在猜测那个时候会发生什么，但对这神秘脉冲找不到科学解释的现实已经让研究这一现象的科研人员抱有了一丝超自然的恐惧。
leviathans.2010.desc.en:
The study of pulsars seems to be an endless source of insights for our scientists, but rarely exhibit any signs of overtly dangerous phenomena. This makes the recent reports on [From.GetName] all the more concerning.

An initial scan revealed that the pulsar, in addition to its regular electromagnetic beam, is emitting a separate beam at a limited wavelength which is only visible in the same system at shorter and shorter intervals. According to initial calculations, the interval between these pulses will reach zero at date [GetMidGameDate]. What occurs then is open to speculation, but the lack of explanations for the pulse has instilled an almost superstitious fear in those who studied it.

leviathans.2010.desc.gesta.zh:
对脉冲星的研究可以让我们的科学家收获了无数的灵感和见解，并且通常不会发现什么明显的危险现象。这让[From.GetName]的观测结果更加担忧。

初步的扫描结果显示，在脉冲星本身的电磁脉冲束之外，其还在独立发射一束波长仅在本星系可见的电磁波，而且其发射的时间间隔在不断降低。根据初步计算，发射间隔将在日期[GetMidGameDate]完全变为零。最后的可能的各种结果仅限于猜想，但对这脉冲找不到科学解释的现实还是带来了担忧。
leviathans.2010.desc.gesta.en:
The study of pulsars seems to be an endless source of insights, but they rarely exhibit any signs of overtly dangerous phenomena. This makes the recent observations on [From.GetName] all the more concerning.

An initial scan revealed that the pulsar, in addition to its regular electromagnetic beam, is emitting a separate beam at a limited wavelength which is only visible in the same system at shorter and shorter intervals. According to initial calculations, the interval between these pulses will reach zero at date [GetMidGameDate]. What occurs then is open to speculation, but the lack of explanations for the pulse is troubling.

leviathans.2012.a.zh: 我们一定要找到阻止它的方法。
leviathans.2012.a.en: We must find a way to stop it.

leviathans.2012.desc.zh:
即使是对[From.GetName]最漫不经心的业余天文学家今天也报告说看到了绮丽的灯光表演。一系列速度极快、色彩斑斓的闪光最后变成了电磁辐射爆发，随之而来的是一阵诡异的寂静。很多人提出了疑问，我们很担心不能给出一个答案。

有东西从脉冲星里出现，闪烁着白矮星不祥的光芒。一个幽灵般的实体开始在星系里游荡。
leviathans.2012.desc.en:
Even amateur astronomers who directed their gaze towards [From.GetName] today report seeing a spectacular light show. A series of colorful, rapid flashes culminated in a sudden burst of electromagnetic radiation, followed by a ghostly silence. Many people are asking questions, and we are afraid of the answers we don't yet have to give them.

Something has emerged from the pulsar, shining with the ominous light of a pale star. A spectral entity has begun to roam the galaxy.

leviathans.2012.desc.gesta.zh:
一系列来自[From.GetName]的速度极快、色彩斑斓的闪光最后变成了电磁辐射爆发，随之而来的是一阵诡异的寂静。

有东西从脉冲星里出现，闪烁着白矮星不祥的光芒。一个幽灵般的实体开始在星系里游荡。
leviathans.2012.desc.gesta.en:
A series of colorful, rapid flashes culminated in a sudden burst of electromagnetic radiation from [From.GetName], followed by a ghostly silence.

Something has emerged from the pulsar, shining with the ominous light of a pale star. A spectral entity has begun to roam the galaxy.

leviathans.2013.a.zh: 不管靠逻辑推理还是暴力穷举，我们一定能找到这个方法。
leviathans.2013.a.en: Whether by reason or brute force, it must be possible.

leviathans.2013.desc.zh:
我们的探测器探测到了一个幽灵般的实体。它似乎在恒星系间漫游，无差别地毁灭其周边的一切。早期的观测显示其由光构成，又有能力对光进行操纵，这使得它极难被瞄准，但我们在探索星系的旅途中学到的一点就是，即使是光自身也是可以被弯折和消灭的。

我们只需找到这样做的方法。
leviathans.2013.desc.en:
A spectral entity has been detected by our sensors. It seems to be roaming from system to system, destroying matter around itself indiscriminately. Early observations suggest its composition and manipulation of light may make it extremely difficult to target, but one thing we have learned exploring the galaxy is that even light itself can be bent and broken.

We only need to figure out how.

leviathans.2014.desc.zh:
这种诞生于光脉冲之中的魑魅魍魉终于被消灭了。尽管它直到最终依然像是飘荡在星际之间的一只鬼魅，其身上仍有许多谜团没有揭开，但之前那群叫嚣着我们的办法不可能成功的悲观科学家还是亲眼目睹了我们的舰船将其消灭的全过程。

为了理解击败他们的原理，科学家们一丝不苟地记录下了之前从未发现的光学特性，以及幽魂今天所展现的力量。
leviathans.2014.desc.en:
The haunting creature born from light pulses is finally neutralized. Although it remained until the end a ghost among the stars and in many ways a mystery, the process by which our ships managed to destroy it was observed by the most pessimistic of our scientists, who argued that it would be impossible.

To understand exactly how our fleets completed this seemingly insurmountable task, these scientists have meticulously documented the previously-unseen properties of light and energy that the Wraith put on bright display today.

leviathans.2014.desc.gesta.zh: 这种诞生于光脉冲之中的魑魅魍魉终于被消灭了。尽管它直到最终依然像是飘荡在星际之间的一只鬼魅，其身上仍有许多谜团没有揭开，但我们在幽魂临终前仔细记录了它展现出的未知光学特性和能源性质。
leviathans.2014.desc.gesta.en: The haunting creature born from light pulses is finally neutralized. Although it remained, until the very end, a ghost among the stars and in many ways a mystery, we meticulously documented the previously-unseen properties of light and energy that the Wraith put on bright display this one last time.

leviathans.2101.b.en: Better stay out of that thing.

leviathans.2101.c.gesta.zh: 我们回收一切能回收的，剩下的都毁掉。
leviathans.2101.c.gesta.en: We salvage what we can and scuttle the rest.

leviathans.2101.desc.zh:
随着我们击败了其周边的防御设施，我们得以进入这座古代建筑，一窥其奥秘。进入和穿越这座建筑可能会很困难，但无论是谁建造了它，必定是采用了我们难以想象的技术。情况变得更糟糕的是，这座堡垒似乎正在恢复。

部分协助解除堡垒武装的人员自愿尝试进入堡垒，同来自[Root.Capital.GetName]的后备人员一起一探究竟。目前看来，接下来通向目标的道路无疑充满挑战。
leviathans.2101.desc.en:
With the defeat of the defenses surrounding the ancient structure, we may find a way to explore its mysteries. Entering and traversing it may be difficult, but whoever built it must have possessed technology we can hardly dream of. Making matters more arduous, the fortress appears to be recovering.

Some of the people who helped disarm the fortress have volunteered to attempt entering and exploring it, with backup from the headquarters on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Following through on our end will no doubt present its own challenges.

leviathans.2101.desc.gesta.zh:
瓦解它的防御之后，我们很快潜入了它的结构层中。

它迷宫般的走廊和密集的网络既令人陌生也无法理解。目前为止我们只遇到了些微不足道的困难，但这个堡垒依旧有可能对我们构成威胁。
leviathans.2101.desc.gesta.en:
Having picked apart its defenses, we soon insinuated ourself into the structure.

Its labyrinthine corridors and dense networks both prove equally alien and impenetrable. There is little for us here, but the fortress could still pose a threat.

leviathans.2105.desc.zh:
我们发现了一些静静漂流在[fortress_system.GetName]恒星系的十分巨大的太空建筑。尽管初步扫描显示它们已经很古老了，但是能量识别特征还是非常强烈。在主体建筑周围还能看到漂浮着的几个较小的建筑，所有这些似乎都是全副武装。

如果我们想要了解这个古代遗迹的真实面目，或许我们需要以武力突破其防御…
leviathans.2105.desc.en:
We have detected some kind of utterly massive space installation drifting quietly at the edge of the [fortress_system.GetName] system. Although preliminary scans show it to be very old, the structure has an intense power signature. Several smaller structures can be seen floating near the main installation, and all of them appear to be heavily armed.

If we are to learn the true nature of this ancient relic, we will likely have to overpower its defenses through force of arms...

leviathans.2111.a.zh: 我们会派人前去增援探索小队。
leviathans.2111.a.en: We'll find someone to assist the team.

leviathans.2111.desc.zh:
尽管我们与建造者之间存在巨大的技术代沟，但有一样发明却是永垂不朽的：一扇锁死的门。在尝试强行关停堡垒后，我们发现所有的入口都被封死了。

被分调出用以调查堡垒的小队发现一个气闸，如果它还能正常运转，似乎就可以从外界打开通向其内的道路。
leviathans.2111.desc.en:
Despite the ages of technology separating us and the builders of the fortress, one invention is timeless: a closed door. After having forced the fortress to shut down, we found all entrances sealed.

The team dispatched to explore the fortress have found an airlock which at least appears possible to open from the outside, if it had been in working order.

leviathans.2112.a.zh: 我们只能希望他们的牺牲是值得的。
leviathans.2112.a.en: We can only hope to make their sacrifice worth it.

leviathans.2112.desc.zh: 爆破小队依照计划炸开了气闸，来给我们的探查小队打开一条通道。然而爆炸并不只是点燃了气闸，由于未知的原因，也许是有意留下的陷阱，气闸内含的高气压的爆炸性气体混合着氧气混合，引发了一场更大的爆炸，我们的排险小队试图解决，但无一生还。
leviathans.2112.desc.en: The detonation set to blow the airlock open went off as planned, providing an entrance for our team of explorers. However, the explosives were not the only thing to ignite. For reasons unknown, possibly as a deliberate trap, the airlock contained pressurized explosive gas in addition to the expected oxygen, causing a larger explosion that wiped out the demolitions team sent to set it up.

leviathans.2113.desc.zh: 稳定了飞船同堡垒动力系统的连接后，我们必须决定有多少能量用于第一次注入。因为堡垒使用了陌生的技术，精确的能量值难以确定。现在有两种估计方案可选。
leviathans.2113.desc.en: Having stabilized the ship's connection to the power system of the fortress, we must decide how much energy to supply in the first surge. Since the technology is unfamiliar, the exact amount is difficult to determine. Two estimates are available.

leviathans.2114.desc.zh: 注入堡垒以开启大门的高水平能量足以导致堡垒内的深层能源激活。堡垒的防御系统再次启动，关闭他们之前不必再管气闸了。
leviathans.2114.desc.en: The high level of energy sent into the fortress to power the door was powerful enough to cause the reignition of a deeper energy source within. With its defenses online once again, the airlock will not be a concern until we've disabled them.

leviathans.2115.a.en: Let's hope we can also get them out.

leviathans.2115.desc.zh: 一开始，注入堡垒的能量总量似乎太少，没能起到什么作用。随后，周围区域的气闸开始慢慢显示出恢复运作的迹象。靠着一些机械学的技巧和猜测，探索小队获得了控制权并成功打开气闸。虽然对接的流程不怎么规范，他们现在确实进入了堡垒内部。
leviathans.2115.desc.en: At first, the amount of energy supplied to the fortress seemed too small to make a difference. Then, the area surrounding the airlock slowly started to show signs of functioning. With some mechanical tricks and guesswork, the team accessed the controls and managed to open the airlock itself. Although not by the cleanest docking procedure, they are now inside the fortress.

leviathans.2131.a.zh: 把金属环放在另外两个立杆上。
leviathans.2131.a.en: Place metal rings around the remaining two poles.

leviathans.2131.b.zh: 寻找舱壁上的圆环形缺口。
leviathans.2131.b.en: Search for torus-shaped indentations on the bulkhead.

leviathans.2131.c.zh: 重排立杆上的金属圆环。
leviathans.2131.c.en: Rearrange the metal tori on the poles.

leviathans.2131.d.zh: 拆掉基座上中间和右边的竖杆。
leviathans.2131.d.en: Remove center and rightmost poles from the pedestal.

leviathans.2131.desc.zh:
外遣小队发现前面的道路被巨大的舱壁挡住了。小队报告说他们右方有一处嵌入墙壁的凹室，里面放着一个基座和置于其上的奇怪的机械装置，以和堡垒同样的金属材质铸造而成。

他们相信，这个装置就是打开舱壁的钥匙。小队长将这个装置描述为在基座顶部等距排列的三个立杆，有三个环——金属圆环——大小不一，放置在左边的立杆上，最小的在顶部，而最大的在最下面。
leviathans.2131.desc.en:
The away team find their way blocked by a massive bulkhead. The team report that there is a recessed alcove to their right, housing a pedestal and a contraption wrought in the same black metal as the fortress itself.

They believe this device is the key to opening the bulkhead. The leader of the explorers describes it as three upright poles spaced equidistant across the top of the pedestal, with three rings - metal tori - of varying sizes placed around the leftmost pole, the smallest at the top and the largest at the bottom.

leviathans.2132.a.zh: 这鬼地方就是个可怕的机关。
leviathans.2132.a.en: This place is a hellish contraption.

leviathans.2132.desc.zh:
行动指令发布后，随之而来的是一阵寂静，随着小队试图执行命令，又传来了模糊不清的刮擦噪音。又是一阵寂静后，模糊不清的曳步声和越来越尖锐的声音持续了五秒。接着是一阵长长的寂静。我们花了几分钟才确定，这次探索已经结束。没有尖叫声，也没有人呼救。我们至少可以希冀，这意味着他们没有承受太多痛苦。

一刻钟后，一阵缓慢而沉重的敲击声暗示着，无论是何种陷阱被激活，现在其已被重置。一些在场者声称，这听起来就像是异星人的笑声。

最后，堡垒中响起了更加令人不安的声音：堡垒的能源重启了防御系统。
leviathans.2132.desc.en:
After the course of action was announced, a moment of silence followed, then vague scraping noises as the team attempted to carry out their plan. After another pause, faint shuffling and a draw-out, sharp sound increasing in pitch over five seconds. Then a long silence. It took us several minutes to accept that this was the end of the expedition. No screaming, no calls for aid. We can at least hope this means they met a quick end.

After a quarter, a slow, heavy rasp suggests whatever trap sprung on them reset itself. Some present claim it sounded like alien laughter.

Finally, the fortress managed an even more disturbing sound: that of the power returning to its defense systems.

leviathans.2133.a.zh: 至少我们可以开怀大笑了。
leviathans.2133.a.en: We can laugh about it now, at least.

leviathans.2133.desc.zh:
行动方案宣布后，先是出现了片刻的寂静，随后正当队伍尝试执行计划时，出现了隐隐约约的刮擦声。然后响起了巨大的拍击声。一时间，你还以为你的队伍像虫子一样被拍死了。紧接着，你听到了探索队的欢呼，他们兴奋地报告说通道打开了。

隔板迅速化成了紫色水银般的难闻液体。想起之前那个无聊的解谜机关，你不禁觉得你的探索队被数千年前精心设下的一个玩笑给耍了。
leviathans.2133.desc.en:
After the course of action was announced, a moment of silence followed, then vague scraping noises as the team attempted to carry out their plan. A splashing sound, so loud that at first you think the team has been swatted like small insects, is followed by cheers from the team as they report that a passage has opened.

The bulkhead appears to have rapidly transformed into an unpleasant-smelling liquid reminiscent of purple quicksilver. Combined with the relatively mundane puzzle mechanism, you have a feeling the team has been victims of an elaborate prank set up millennia ago.

leviathans.2150.desc.zh:
探索队发来报告，称他们似乎进入了堡垒的几何中心。只不过堡垒的内部结构还存有一些疑点，而且也不能确切地说中心这个概念适用于这里。

但有一点是毫无争议的，那就是堡垒的能源供给方式，这使得探索队的新发现更加耐人寻味了。暗物质在堡垒周围流动，然后回到核心，这有点类似血液循环系统。虽然流动已经停止了，但小队发现有重新启动的迹象。我们确实可以花费大把的时间研究这套系统，但眼下我们得赶紧将它关闭。
leviathans.2150.desc.en:
The team reports that they have reached what appears to be the geometric center of the fortress, even if the internal geometry leaves some doubt if the concept of a center is even relevant in there.

What is indisputably relevant is how the fortress is powered, which makes the team's new discovery all the more interesting. Dark matter is funneled around the fortress and then back to the core, like a cardiovascular system. Although the flow has stopped, the team has found signs that it's starting again. We can take all the time we want to study it, but it needs to be stopped now.

leviathans.2151.a.zh: 我们一定要多加珍惜才行。

leviathans.2151.desc.zh:
依靠着我们所掌握关于暗物质的最新知识对黑洞进行分析后发现，这个堡垒的建造者竟然从黑洞中习得了不少关于控制物质与输送系统的科技。幸好这一切都处于精密的主系统之外，我们的探索队得以安全地改换了核心的连接线路，阻止堡垒的重新启动。

虽然这个过程已让我们的团队受益良多，但相对于整座已经敞开在我们面前的堡垒来说，那简直是小巫见大巫。
leviathans.2151.desc.en:
Examining a black hole with our new knowledge of how dark matter is used in the ancient fortress, we have discovered that its builders must have learned many of the manipulation and funneling techniques from black holes. Seeing them outside of the strict system they created allowed the team of explorers to change connections around the core safely, stopping the repowering process.

While this process alone has taught us much about the physics of black holes, it is nothing compared to the treasure that the now safely shut-down fortress presents.

leviathans.2151.name.en: Fortress: The Heart of Dark Matter

leviathans.2152.desc.zh:
我们在附近一带的恒星中搜寻堡垒是如何建成的线索时，无意中发现一个秘密。该恒星附近有一簇纳米摄像头，担当着堡垒的眼睛，这就难怪它的防御能力那么高效了。

只要将这些摄像头中的数据记录跟堡垒中的线索连接起来，我们应该就能查看这个堡垒被建造之初的相关历史。但因为时间无多，我们该优先查看哪一部分的建造过程呢？
leviathans.2152.desc.en:
Scouring the local star for clues to how the fortress was built, we discovered a surprising secret. A fine mist of nanotechnological cameras have been found in close proximity to the star, acting as the eyes of the fortress and explaining the efficiency of its defenses.

Accessing these with data from the fortress, we can view the history of the system all the way back to its construction. However, we are running out of time. Which part of the construction process should we review for answers?

leviathans.2153.desc.zh: 我们查看了堡垒建造之初时的录像以期看到堡垒心脏部分的建造过程，可惜结果让人很失望。最初建造的是堡垒的躯壳，然而这些数据对我们毫无意义。这时候堡垒开始了重启，摄像头和录像的使用权也被其重夺回去了。
leviathans.2153.desc.en: Hoping to see the heart of the fortress built first, we reviewed the beginning of the construction. We hoped in vain. The hull was built first, making the data useless. Our team are reporting that the fortress is repowering, and with it its control of the cameras and their footage.

leviathans.2154.desc.zh:
镜头的中段，虽然没有展示核心自身的建设，但却揭示了科学家们认为用于建造核心的材料的运输。这一定是结构需要动力来继续建设的关键时刻。

有了这些材料的知识，堡垒内团队设法阻止了堡垒的重启。我们可以收获成功的果实了。
leviathans.2154.desc.en:
The middle section of the footage, although not showing the construction of the core itself, reveals the shipping of materials to the fortress which scientists conclude must have been used for the core. This must have been the critical time at which the structure needed power for construction to continue.

With knowledge of these materials, the team inside the fortress has managed to stop it from repowering. We can now reap the fruits of our success.

leviathans.2155.desc.zh: 查看建造过程的最终部分时，我们才发现原来这部分是需要堡垒启动后才可以观看的。我们开始观看的时候一定是触发了核心的重新启动。我们的团队汇报堡垒正在重新启动，摄像头和录像的使用权也被夺回了。
leviathans.2155.desc.en: Reviewing the final stages of the construction, we discovered too late that they must have required the fortress to already be powered. The core must have been functional at the point where we started our viewing. Our team are reporting that the fortress is repowering, and with it its control of the cameras and their footage.

leviathans.2156.desc.zh:
完成堡垒的人一定比我们更博学，但他们并不更聪明。我们向堡垒动力系统循环注入自己的暗物质的努力是有用的，有效地切断了核心对其系统的供能。

我们终于有时间仔细看看这些博学的人完成了什么东西。
leviathans.2156.desc.en:
Whoever built the fortress might have been more knowledgeable than we, but not more clever. Supplying our own dark matter to close the loop of the power system in the fortress worked, and the core is now effectively cut off from providing power to its systems.

Finally, we can take the time to have a closer look at what these knowledgeable people have accomplished.

leviathans.2157.desc.zh:
一位飞行员以前所未有的勇气和精准度，向堡垒的心脏发射了一枚鱼雷，终止了它的重启。我们的计划必然被誉为伟大的成功，因为堡垒永远不会再启动了。

鱼雷命中的时刻，整个结构都爆炸了，系统中的古代技术痕迹和所有恒星系中的一切物体都被摧毁。考古学家称之为“[Root.GetAdj]政府出资的最昂贵的烟花秀”。看来这一纪录短期内不会被挑战了。
leviathans.2157.desc.en:
In a feat of unprecedented bravery and precision, a pilot fired a torpedo into the heart of the fortress to stop it from repowering. The plan must be hailed as a great success, since the fortress will never be powered again.

The moment the torpedo hit, the entire structure exploded, irreversibly destroying any trace of the ancient technology in it as well as everything else in the system. Archaeologists have dubbed it "the most expensive fireworks show ever funded by the [Root.GetAdj] government." It is unlikely to be beaten anytime soon.

leviathans.2160.a.zh: 但并非是我们希望的那一种。
leviathans.2160.a.en: But not the one we hoped for.

leviathans.2160.desc.zh: 时间不够了。神秘的堡垒已从我们起初的攻击中恢复、重启防御。与勘探队的通信被干扰了，但最后的通讯表明他们面临着他们预想中的命运。
leviathans.2160.desc.en: Time has run out. The enigmatic fortress has recovered from our initial assault and is once again starting up its defenses. Transmissions from the exploration team have already been scrambled, but their last transmission indicates that they met the fate they were prepared to risk.

leviathans.295.desc.zh:
有客人来了！这真是令人欢欣鼓舞！欧，请原谅我的失礼。我想是该自我介绍一下了。我们是艺术家联盟。

我们的成员都全身心地将自己的生命投身于艺术、音乐、文化，以及其他任何让智慧生命体的存在有所意义的事业。如果您愿意分享我们创造的奇迹，请不要犹豫，赶紧联系我们！
leviathans.295.desc.en:
A visitor! This is a joyous occasion indeed! Oh, forgive my manners. I believe introductions are in order. We are the Artisan Troupe.

Our members have dedicated their lives to the pursuit of art, music, culture and all the other things which makes existence bearable to a sapient being. Please, if you would like to share in the wonder of our creations, do not hesitate to contact us!

leviathans.300.a.zh: 我们想委托创作一件艺术品。
leviathans.300.a.en: We want to commission an art piece.

leviathans.300.a.reply.zh: 很遗憾，我们不能再提供更多艺术品了，否则就相当于承认您之前买的那些并不够好。我们也要考虑自己的诚意，敬请谅解。
leviathans.300.a.reply.en: Sadly we cannot offer any more, lest we come to believe that you didn't appreciate the ones you already purchased. We have our integrity to think about, you see.

leviathans.300.b.zh: 我们想要成为你们的赞助者。
leviathans.300.b.en: We wish to become your patron.

leviathans.300.c.zh: 在我们所有的星球上组织一场节日盛典。
leviathans.300.c.en: Organize a festival across our worlds.

leviathans.300.c.outofstock.zh: 我们每20年才能主办一次星球盛典。
leviathans.300.c.outofstock.en: We may only host one Festival of Worlds every 20 years.

leviathans.300.d.zh: 告诉我更多有关于你们艺术家联盟的信息。
leviathans.300.d.en: Tell us more about your troupe.

leviathans.300.d.reply.zh:
我们是艺术家联盟。我们联盟包括好几个空间站，里面居住着来自不同世界的艺术天才。他们渴望在这片安宁的避风港创造出真正的美。他们带来了全星系的不同思想和方法论，汇聚一堂我们或许可以发现真我的最终形态。

我们为真正的艺术爱好者提供各类服务。如果你帮助赞助我们的工作，我们甚至可能为你的人民组织更盛大的活动！
leviathans.300.d.reply.en:
We are the Artisan Troupe. The troupe consists of several stations inhabited by creatives from many worlds, all unified in the desire to create new beauty in these safe havens. They bring their ideas and methods from all around the galaxy, and together we uncover the ultimate expressions of the self!

We provide many services to those who wish to enjoy art. If you help sponsor our work we might even be willing to organize larger events for your people!

leviathans.300.desc.zh:
你好！我是艺术家联盟的首席大师，衷心祝愿你今天也是才思如泉涌。

我们能为您做什么？为您打造一个用于欣赏的艺术作品？或者您希望赞助我们城邦的充满异域之美的创作？
leviathans.300.desc.en:
Greetings! I, the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe, wish you a creative day.

What can we do you for? Perhaps produce a work of art for you to enjoy? Or maybe you wish to sponsor our enclave in its creation of otherworldly beauty?

leviathans.300.f.zh: 我们想要投资一个文化中心。
leviathans.300.f.en: We want to invest in a Ministry of Culture.

leviathans.300.g.zh: 我们希望你们帮忙建立一所$sm_art_college$。
leviathans.300.g.en: We would like your help to found an $sm_art_college$.

leviathans.3001.desc.zh:
我们在[horror_system.GetName]附近遇到巨型实体，它似乎只是部分地存在于我们的宇宙，这个生物的身体大部分还困在它所来自的噩梦般的位面。

有一个恶质的智能在此工作，古老程度远远超出我们的时间概念，设计也极其异类。我们只能猜测它的目的。
leviathans.3001.desc.en:
We have encountered some kind of vast entity near [horror_system.GetName]. It appears to exist only partially inside our own universe, with the bulk of the creature still trapped in whatever nightmarish realm it spawned from.

There is a malevolent intelligence at work here, ancient beyond our concept of time and utterly alien in its design. We can only guess as to its purpose.

leviathans.3003.a.en: Let us see what will come of it.

leviathans.3003.desc.zh:
[guardians_horror_system.GetName]附近试图突入我们宇宙的恶质实体被赶回原位面。它的影响是否已被削弱到能被妥善地封印，只有时间能告诉我们。

我们监测到某种反常的残余能量，一定是生物打开空间裂隙时留下的。深入研究这种能量可能带来科学突破。
leviathans.3003.desc.en:
The malignant entity which attempted to breach our universe near [guardians_horror_system.GetName] has been banished back into its own realm. Only time will tell if its influence has been sufficiently weakened to keep it there for good.

We are detecting some kind of anomalous residual energy that must have been left behind by the dimensional rifts the creature opened. Studying this energy more closely could potentially lead to scientific breakthroughs.

leviathans.300a.desc.zh: 嗯？噢，请原谅，我不小心陷入了冥想状态。有时候我的这种天赋有点……太强势了。我们还有什么能够为你做的吗？
leviathans.300a.desc.en: Hm? Oh, please excuse my reverie. Sometimes this muse of mine is simply... overpowering. Is there anything else we can do for you?

leviathans.300b.desc.zh: 你是否一度为极度的壮丽而驻足惊叹？我们如此，而你们亦然。这是何等的缘分！灵感来了，我得为这写一首歌。
leviathans.300b.desc.en: Have you ever stopped to wonder at the sheer majesty of it all? Here we are, and there you are. What fantastic odds! I feel a ballad coming on.

leviathans.300c.desc.zh: 喂？你好？啊，是你！请原谅——我正好卡在了一个特别难以推敲的诗节上面。有什么事吗？
leviathans.300c.desc.en: Yes? Hello? Ah, it's you! Forgive me; I was stuck chasing a particularly elusive stanza. How can I help?

leviathans.301.desc.zh: 艺术家联盟拒绝回应我们的招呼。
leviathans.301.desc.en: The Artisan Troupe won't respond to our hails.

leviathans.301.desc.unknown.zh: 别说翻译了，只要我们发给[From.GetName]讯息，他们立马关闭所有通讯频道，拒绝与我们交流。
leviathans.301.desc.unknown.en: Translations aside, once we exchanged our information with [From.GetName] they closed down all channels and refused to speak to us.

leviathans.304a.desc.zh: 非常感谢你！噢，这样高尚的行为，势必将鼓舞更多的艺术作品现身这个宇宙。我们坚信你会十分满意的。
leviathans.304a.desc.en: Thank you so very much! Ah, such a noble act it is to help bring more art into the universe. We are confident you will be satisfied.

leviathans.304b.desc.zh: 因为你今日的所作所为，星辰神龛今天闪耀得更加明亮了！
leviathans.304b.desc.en: The stars shine that bit more brightly by your actions here today!

leviathans.304c.desc.zh: 我们知道你们[root.GetSpeciesAdj]存在与众不同之处。讲真，你们一族真是太可口了。
leviathans.304c.desc.en: We knew there was something special about you [root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Truly, you are beings of refined taste.

leviathans.305.a.tooltip.zh:
解锁一项可在殖民地实施的£decision£$decision_art_monument$决议，并带来如下效果：
£amenities£ $MOD_PLANET_AMENITIES_MULT$ +15%
$MOD_PLANET_IMMIGRATION_PULL_MULT$：+50%
leviathans.305.a.tooltip.en:
Gain access to an £decision£ $decision_art_monument$ Decision that can be enacted on a colony with the following effects:
£amenities£ $MOD_PLANET_AMENITIES_MULT$ +15%
$MOD_PLANET_IMMIGRATION_PULL_MULT$: +50%

leviathans.305.desc.zh: 好极了！我们很乐意将我们的一件创作送给你们，这肯定会给你的帝国的人民带去欢乐的。
leviathans.305.desc.en: Fabulous! We'd be glad to entrust you with one of our creations. It is sure to bring joy to the people of your empire.

leviathans.310.a.reply.zh: 非常感谢你们！有了你们慷慨的捐助，我们就能更好的扩展艺术的概念了！当然，我们也会给所有的赞助者们按时发放进度通讯。
leviathans.310.a.reply.en: Thank you very much! Now, with your generous contribution, we will be able to expand on the concept of art itself! We will of course also send out a regular newsletter to all patrons.

leviathans.310.desc.zh: 这将对我们大有裨益，我们可以尝试新的想法，还能在创作的过程中承担更多的风险。我们有一个历时十年的项目，但是需要一次性事前支付。
leviathans.310.desc.en: That would be very helpful, allowing us to try new ideas and take more risks in our creation process. We have a ten year program with a one-time up-front cost.

leviathans.3100.a.en: Look at the size of that thing!

leviathans.3100.desc.zh:
[dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系发现一艘形单影只的巨型战舰在巡航。船只上未发现生命迹象，但发出强烈能量特征，可能是装备有武器系统。该舰没有回应任何问候信息。

建议小心为上。
leviathans.3100.desc.en:
A single, massive warship has been discovered patrolling the [dreadnought_system.GetName] system. No life signs can be detected on the vessel, but it is emitting a very strong power signature and appears to be bristling with weapon systems. It does not respond to hails.

Caution is advised.

leviathans.3100.desc.mach.zh:
[dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系发现一艘形单影只的巨型战舰在巡航。船只上未发现有机生命迹象，但发出强烈能量特征，可能是装备有武器系统。该舰没有回应任何问候信息或数据传输。

建议小心为上。
leviathans.3100.desc.mach.en:
A single, massive warship has been discovered patrolling the [dreadnought_system.GetName] system. No organic life signs can be detected on the vessel, but it is emitting a very strong power signature and appears to be bristling with weapon systems. It does not respond to hails or data transmission.

Caution is advised.

leviathans.3102.a.zh: 让该舰悬挂着我们的旗帜征战星辰大海吧！
leviathans.3102.a.en: That ship will sail the stars again under our flag!

leviathans.3102.b.zh: 那样做太浪费资源了。把它拆除掉回收利用吧。
leviathans.3102.b.en: It would be a waste of resources. Salvage it for parts.

leviathans.3102.desc.zh:
我们成功在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系使这艘自动化无畏舰丧失了行动力。虽然我方炮火猛烈，但是这艘战舰的舰体却大部分完好无损。

我们派出的特遣队进入该舰后发现里面的外星种群船员早已身亡多年，他们在临终前启动了某种自动巡逻模式，而这艘战舰的自动巡逻模式竟然已经运行了780万年。

虽然会耗费甚多资源，一些工程师相信该舰可以修复并服役于我军。它一定会成为强大的旗舰。
leviathans.3102.desc.en:
We have managed to disable the automated dreadnought in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. Despite the punishment it took from our ships, the structural integrity of the warship's massive hull remains largely intact.

Our boarding parties found the mummified remains of the dreadnought's alien crew still manning their stations. Before expiring, they activated some kind of automated patrol mode which the limited shipboard AI has been locked in for the past 7.8 million years.

Although it would take an incredible amount of resources, some of our engineers believe that the dreadnought can be restored and put back into service with our fleet. It would certainly make for a powerful flagship.

leviathans.3103.a.en: A powerful addition to our fleet.

leviathans.3103.desc.zh: 这是值得载入史册的一天！我们训练有素的维修组和工程组成功完成了[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系的那艘古代无畏舰的维修工程。现在这艘无畏舰已经满载着我们的机组人员开始试航了。
leviathans.3103.desc.en: This is a momentous day! Our skilled repair crews and engineers have finished their work on the ancient dreadnought we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. The massive warship has received its full crew complement and been declared ready for service after conducting space trials.

leviathans.3103.desc.mach.zh: 今天是意义非凡的一天！我们娴熟的修理机器人和工程单位修好了我们在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系击败的远古无畏舰。这艘巨型战舰的船员已经齐备，经过航空测试后开始准备服役。
leviathans.3103.desc.mach.en: This is a day of significance! Our skilled repair bots and engineering units have finished their work on the ancient dreadnought we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. The massive warship has received its full crew complement and been declared ready for service after conducting space trials.

leviathans.315.desc.zh:
尊敬的[Root.GetRulerName][Root.GetRulerTitle]：十年前[Root.GetName]承诺赞助艺术家联盟，并已如约履行。

上一期的赞助已经接近尾声，谨慎起见请允许我们再度询问：您是否愿意续订全星系最精美的艺术和工艺品？
leviathans.315.desc.en:
Esteemed [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]: a decade ago the [Root.GetName] pledged to support the Artisan Troupe, and so you have.

The time of your patronage is coming to an end, but it would be remiss of us not to ask: would you care to renew your subscription to the finest arts and crafts in the galaxy?

leviathans.3201.desc.zh:
$leviathans.3201.base$

我们只能推测，这些小行星是一种未知的太空生命形式的蜂巢。不管它们是什么，我们不断扩大的采矿活动似乎已经激怒了它们！
leviathans.3201.desc.en:
$leviathans.3201.base$

We can only surmise that these asteroids serve as some kind of hive for a previously unknown spaceborne life form. Whatever they are, our expanding mining operations seem to have provoked them into action!

leviathans.3201.desc.void_hive.zh:
$leviathans.3201.base$

由于我们最近的开采行动，小行星内的巢穴受到了刺激。似乎我们和它在这个星系是一山不容二虎了。
leviathans.3201.desc.void_hive.en:
$leviathans.3201.base$

The hive inside of the asteroid has become agitated by our recent mining. It seems this system isn't big enough for the both of us.

leviathans.3202.b.zh: 他们与我们相似，让他们为我们服务。
leviathans.3202.b.en: They are similar. Let them serve.

leviathans.3202.c.zh: 让我们看看他们会对我们作何反应。
leviathans.3202.c.en: Let's see how they react to us.

leviathans.3202.desc.zh:
$leviathans.3202.base$

然而，远程传感器正在追踪几个小型的、无法识别的可能是宇宙飞船的物体的零星运动，它们位于环带中的密度较大的区域。我们无法准确对其定位，但我们已经确定了至少两个被摧毁的采矿站的碎片，它们漂浮在一些较大小行星附近的太空中。
leviathans.3202.desc.en:
$leviathans.3202.base$

However, long-range sensors are tracking sporadic movement from several small, unidentifiable objects - possibly spacecraft - in the denser regions of the belt. We are unable to get a fix on them, but we have identified debris from at least two destroyed mining stations, floating in space near some of the larger asteroids.

leviathans.3202.desc.void_hive.zh:
$leviathans.3202.base$

我们探测到了环带中的异动：一个蜂巢思维的初级形式正在享用其矿物储备。我们可以吸收他们的意识，在我们的引导下他们将会是更强大的战力。
leviathans.3202.desc.void_hive.en:
$leviathans.3202.base$

We have detected movement within the belt: a form of rudimentary hive mind, feasting on its mineral hoard. We could subsume their consciousness and under our guidance they would be a powerful deterrent.

leviathans.3204.desc.zh:
我们的部队成功摧毁了[hive_system.GetName]星系的外星蜂巢小行星。该地区没有再出现任何攻击机了。

其中一个小行星虽然受到猛烈攻击但却大致完好无损。我们可以考虑派出一支科研队上去查看下。
leviathans.3204.desc.en:
Our forces have managed to smash the alien hive asteroids in the [hive_system.GetName] system. They are once again dormant, and we are not detecting any more of those vicious attack craft.

One of the asteroids is still reasonably intact, despite the damage inflicted upon it. We should consider dispatching a science party to see what we can find inside it.

leviathans.3205.desc.zh:
我们的科研队完成了对[hive_system.GetName]星系的蜂巢小行星内部的庞大隧道网络的探索。科学家们没有遇到之前袭击我们的那些太空生命体，但是却发现了类似孵化室的残骸。

这些发现可以让我们进一步研究该生命体的生命周期，增强我们对宇宙生物学的认知。
leviathans.3205.desc.en:
Our science team has finished exploring the massive network of tunnels and chambers running through the hive asteroid in the [hive_system.GetName] system. No live specimens of the spaceborne creatures that attacked us were encountered, but the scientists did find the remains of some kind of birthing chamber.

This has given us a great deal of insight into the life cycle of these entities, further expanding our understanding of galactic biology.

leviathans.321.b.zh: 我们希望取消简讯订阅。
leviathans.321.b.en: We wish to unsubscribe from this newsletter.

leviathans.321.c.zh: 我们现在担负不起这个价格。
leviathans.321.c.en: We cannot afford to donate now.

leviathans.321.desc.zh: 这里是我们为诸位赞助者提供的最新简讯：
leviathans.321.desc.en: Here follows the latest newsletter for all our patrons:

leviathans.321.desc.a.zh:
很不幸城邦中最近没能产出什么作品。大部分的艺术家都深陷忧郁之中，皆因难以迸发出创作的灵感。这种情绪十分棘手，但也有益处。毕竟创作还是要花一定时间的。

任何为了帮助这些艺术家重燃创作之火而进行的赞助，都能大大改进我们目前的创作窘境。
leviathans.321.desc.a.en:
Sadly nothing much has been produced in the enclave. Most of the artists have fallen into a deep melancholy from where no inspiration can be drawn. The mood is dire, but hopeful. Creation takes time, after all.

Any donations that might help the group rekindle their interest in the material plane would be of tremendous help.

leviathans.321.desc.b.zh:
整个城邦最近几个月里甚是忙碌。我们的厅堂因为居民发明的新技术而议论纷纷，这项技术能够向使用者传播嗅觉。这个非凡的器械注定能改变一切。

为了进一步发展这个想法我们需要更多的捐助。
leviathans.321.desc.b.en:
The enclave has been busy the last couple of months. Our halls are abuzz with a new kind of technology invented by a resident, capable of transmitting sensations of smell to a user. This remarkable piece of machinery will surely change everything.

In order to further develop this idea we will require more donations.

leviathans.321.desc.c.zh:
协会最近一直处于欢脱的氛围之中。嗅媒感知设备的发明使得一个又一个艺术家将其重心转移到为其创造全新体验上。到目前为止，他们的工作所取得的最佳成果是一首通过嗅觉信号传递的管弦乐曲。

我们的工作还在继续，同时十分乐意接受任何形式的捐助。
leviathans.321.desc.c.en:
The enclave is in a frisky mood. The creation of the Scentilus Rift has caused many an artist to shift their primary focus to creating new experiences for it. So far the most noteworthy to come out of this endeavor is an orchestral piece conveyed via scent.

Our work continues and any donations would be gladly accepted.

leviathans.321.desc.d.zh:
我们已经放弃继续创建以气味为中心的媒介了。这是个拙劣的想法，除了浪费时间并让室内布满臭气之外，没有任何意义。

为了能重新回到正确的创作之路，我们需要你们的赞助，我们感谢你们的继续支持！
leviathans.321.desc.d.en:
We have abandoned the attempts to create scent-centered media. It was a foolish idea and has brought nothing but wasted time and unpleasant odors.

In order to find our way back again we will need donations from our trusted patrons. We thank you for your continued support!

leviathans.322.desc.zh:
你好，赞助人[Root.GetRulerName]！我们构想出了一种华丽的新型建筑，专门用来促进人们之间的互相理解——文化中心。它的功能得益于融合了大众对彼此的潜意识偏见和艺术的偏好，然后粉碎了这些并以一种新的统一形式呈现出来。

你们想不想购买这个建筑？这一定会对你们帝国的紧密连接起到作用。如果要我自己来说的话，这可是优惠价！
leviathans.322.desc.en:
Greetings, patron [Root.GetRulerName]! We have come up with a gorgeous new type of architecture, specifically tuned to improve crowds' understanding of one another - a Ministry of Culture. It functions thanks to a mix of using the populace's subconscious bias against each other and art, then smashing it all and presenting a new form of unity.

Would you like to purchase this building? It will surely prove useful to binding your empire together. And it's a bargain, if I may say so myself!

leviathans.323.desc.zh: 我们十分抱歉，来自[Root.GetRulerName]的赞助人：我们很不幸陷入了创作的瓶颈期。整个城邦目前还处于紊乱的状态，尚不能提供任何成果。一如既往，我们仍然十分感谢您的赞助。
leviathans.323.desc.en: We apologize, patron [Root.GetRulerName]: we have sadly reached something of a creative roadblock. The enclave is in disarray and we have nothing to offer at this time. We thank you for your patronage, as always.

leviathans.3230.desc.zh: [from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的原住民被惊醒了。尽管仍对多数的太空船保持敌意，但我们大可以放心，在这些全新的原始无人机的保护下，[from.solar_system.GetName]将会是一座坚不可摧的堡垒。
leviathans.3230.desc.en: The inhabitants of the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have awoken. While still hostile to most spacecraft, we can rest easy knowing that [from.solar_system.GetName] will be a bastion under the protection of our new primitive drones.

leviathans.324.b.zh: 我们会帮助你们修理的。
leviathans.324.b.en: We will repair it for you.

leviathans.324.desc.zh: 您好，来自[Root.GetRulerName]的赞助人。由于一个重大故障，我们最近不得不报废掉大多数的技术设备。您是否能用得上其中所产生的零件或原料呢？
leviathans.324.desc.en: Greetings, patron [Root.GetRulerName]. We have recently been forced to scrap most of our technical equipment due to a major malfunction. Would the materials and scrap be of any use to you, by any chance?

leviathans.325.desc.zh: 赞助者，我们听到这个消息真是出离地抱歉！没有时事通讯，我们就无法向你传达我们最近的成果……
leviathans.325.desc.en: We are exceptionally sorry to hear that, o patron! Without the newsletter we won't be able to keep you up-to-date on our latest accomplishments...

leviathans.330.a.reply.zh: 很好！我们很乐意为你举办这伟大的星球盛典！
leviathans.330.a.reply.en: Excellent! We will be delighted to create this magnificent Festival of Worlds!

leviathans.330.desc.zh: 举办这等规模的星球盛典，那需要我们所有的艺术家都使出浑身解数。不是一件容易的工作。
leviathans.330.desc.en: Organizing a festival of that scale would require all of our artists to bring their talent to bear. Not an easy job, nor a cheap one.

leviathans.335.desc.zh:
艺术家联盟主办的星球盛典，曾经一度，给[Root.GetName]的人们带去了欢乐。哎呀，这样的事情注定不会长久。

在[this_planet.GetName]上，节日活动引发了人群的大规模踩踏事件，致使数千名公民死亡。目前尚不清楚究竟是怎样的情况导致了这一出家破人亡的惨剧，但是人民对于我们的政府和盛典主办方的怨恨与日俱增。
leviathans.335.desc.en:
The Festival of Worlds organized by the Artisan Troupe had, for a time, brought joy to the people of the [Root.GetName]. Alas, it was not meant to last.

On [this_planet.GetName], festival activities have resulted in a huge crowd stampeding and killing thousands of citizens. It is not clear what circumstances led to this tragic loss of life, but there is now growing resentment towards our administration and the festival's organizers alike.

leviathans.336.desc.zh: 由于星球盛典所带来的浓厚的快乐氛围，一些盛典的举办者们爱上了我们的生活方式。他们声称希望节日过后能够留下来；在此定居，成为我们帝国的一员。
leviathans.336.desc.en: Due to the overabundance of happiness being spread by the Festival of Worlds, some of the event's organizers have begun to fall in love with our way of life. They claim they wish to remain here; to settle down and become a part of our empire.

leviathans.337.a.tooltip.zh: 艺术家联盟在10年内拒收任何通讯。
leviathans.337.a.tooltip.en: The Artisan Troupe will refuse any communique for 10 years.

leviathans.337.b.tooltip.zh: 原谅艺术家联盟的违约行为。
leviathans.337.b.tooltip.en: The Artisan Troupe are forgiven for their transgressions.

leviathans.337.desc.zh:
星球盛典突然停止了。艺术家联盟已经收拾好行李离开了，一句解释都没有。

我们彻底搜索他们的营地和演出舞台后发现，大量存放的资源已经消失。
leviathans.337.desc.en:
The Festival of Worlds has abruptly stopped. The Artisan Troupe has packed their bags and left, without saying a word about why.

Thorough searches of their campsites and arenas have revealed only that a substantial quantity of resources has disappeared.

leviathans.340.desc.zh: 太巧了！我们正打算提出和你说的基本类似的提议！如果你将此设施建设在与我们共享星系的[GetStarbaseOrWayStation]里，我们将派遣我们最优秀的艺术家前去当教师。
leviathans.340.desc.en: Brilliant! We were just about to suggest the very same thing to you! If you establish this institution on the [GetStarbaseOrWayStation] in the system you share with us, we shall send some of our finest artists to serve there as teachers.

leviathans.340.tooltip.zh: 我们现在可以在[artist_system.GetName]星系建造艺术学院这一[GetStarbaseOrWayStation]建筑了。
leviathans.340.tooltip.en: We can now build the Art College [GetStarbaseOrWayStation] Building in the [artist_system.GetName] system.

leviathans.340.tooltip_nomads.zh: 我们现在可以在[artist_system.GetName]星系建造艺术学院驿站模块了。
leviathans.340.tooltip_nomads.en: We can now build the Art College Waystation Module in the [artist_system.GetName] system.

leviathans.345.desc.zh: 啊，文化中心……它的任务就是挑战与常理背道而驰的观念，提升你帝国内艺术的凝聚力。让我来说，完全就是一个杰作。
leviathans.345.desc.en: Ah, the Ministry of Culture... It was designed to challenge divergent ideas and promote greater unity throughout your empire through the medium of art. A true masterpiece, if I may say so myself.

leviathans.352.desc.zh: 我们从艺术家联盟收到了一条信息。他们的一座空间站被摧毁了！
leviathans.352.desc.en: We have received a transmission from the Artisan Troupe. One of their stations has been destroyed!

leviathans.353.desc.zh: 我们收到了一条来自艺术家联盟首席的绝望的求救信息。他们的最后一个空间站与他们的文化都被毁灭殆尽。几乎没有幸存者留下来，艺术家联盟已经不复存在了。
leviathans.353.desc.en: We received a distress signal from the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe. Their last station and cultural haven has been destroyed. There were few survivors, and the troupe is essentially no more.

leviathans.354.desc.zh: 在摧毁艺术家联盟的空间站后，我们发现残骸中有大量可供回收的资源。舱室中储存的捐赠物、礼品与作品现在漂浮在太空之中，可供我们随意回收取用。
leviathans.354.desc.en: After having destroyed the Artisan Troupe's station we found many resources to salvage from the wreckage. Donations, gifts and creations stacked in its halls now drift in space, ready for the taking.

leviathans.354.desc.unknown.zh: 在摧毁了那个漂浮在[station_system.GetName]星系的空间站之后，我们在遗骸中发现了大量的珍贵资源。
leviathans.354.desc.unknown.en: After destroying the station facility floating in the [station_system.GetName] system, we have found plenty of valuable resources amongst its remains.

leviathans.4000.a.en: Prepare to have your minds blown.

leviathans.4000.a.reply.zh:
你不会是要说……但如果那人工智能进入了卡冈都亚黑洞，只能意味着……但那不可能……因为如果是那样的话……超出了我们的理解能力……

尽管你明显不知道自己的发现有多么重大，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你来找我们是对的，对此我们表示感谢。
leviathans.4000.a.reply.en:
You cannot mean to say... But if the AI entered the Gargantua black hole it can only mean that... But it cannot, for if it were it would be beyond our comprehension...

Though the magnitude of your finds clearly eludes you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you were right to come to us, and for this you have our gratitude.

leviathans.4000.desc.zh:
你！？发现了无限神机的秘密！？那可能性就跟[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]能活到下个世纪的可能性一样。如果你不知道的话，那可能性并不是很高。

等等——别告诉我你就是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？真是万分抱歉……我一定是把你跟……[unfriends.GetName]搞混了？

跟你讲，只要你告诉我们一件我们还不知道的，关于无限球体的事，我们就会慷慨地奖励你。
leviathans.4000.desc.en:
YOU!? Uncover the Infinity Machine's secret?! That is about as likely as the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are to survive into the next century. Not very likely, if that was unclear.

Wait - don't tell me YOU are the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? My sincerest apologies... I must have confused you with the... [unfriends.GetName]?

Tell you what: give us one thing we do not yet know about the Infinity Sphere and we will reward you handsomely.

leviathans.4100.desc.zh:
当然！

你们的努力我们都看在眼里。基于你们目前的收藏，我们可以给予你们如下帮助以资鼓励。
leviathans.4100.desc.en:
Certainly!

Your efforts have not gone unnoticed by us. Based on your current Collection, we can offer you the following assistance for a small donation.

leviathans.4100.tooltip.no_pending_rewar.zh: 你必须扩大收藏来获得策展人的更多帮助。
leviathans.4100.tooltip.no_pending_rewar.en: You must expand your Collection to receive more assistance from the Curators.

leviathans.4105.a.zh: 我们感兴趣你们在特定领域的指导。
leviathans.4105.a.en: We are interested in your guidance on specific areas.

leviathans.4105.c.en: We are interested in purchasing a Relic.

leviathans.4105.desc.zh:
没问题。

你想了解什么呢？
leviathans.4105.desc.en:
Of course.

What is it you would learn?

leviathans.4110.desc.zh:
我们只能在一个领域派遣专家。星海浩瀚，我们人手不足。

你们需要什么帮助呢？
leviathans.4110.desc.en:
We can only support lending expertise in one area. We are few, and the galaxy is large.

What is it you need help with?

leviathans.4115.desc.zh:
确实。我们将把私人收藏的一件物品委托给你。

这是对我们可非同小可，希望能得到相应的回报。
leviathans.4115.desc.en:
Indeed. We would entrust to you an item from our private collection.

This is no small gift to ask of us, and we would expect a sizeable donation in return.

leviathans.5.desc.zh: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName]在遥远的[leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName]恒星系消灭了某个远古威胁。
leviathans.5.desc.en: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName] has vanquished an ancient threat in the distant [leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName] system.

leviathans.500.b.zh: 你可以援助我们的研究么？
leviathans.500.b.en: Can you aid us in our research?

leviathans.500.b.alreadyaided.zh: 策展人已经在增进我们的研究能力了。
leviathans.500.b.alreadyaided.en: The Curators are already improving our research capabilities.

leviathans.500.c.zh: 告诉我们关于宇宙的奥秘。
leviathans.500.c.en: Tell us about the mysteries of the universe.

leviathans.500.d.zh: 我们能否招募你们的一名科学家呢？
leviathans.500.d.en: Could we recruit one of your scientists?

leviathans.500.d.alreadyrecruited.zh: 我们已经招募了一名策展人科学家。
leviathans.500.d.alreadyrecruited.en: We already employ a Curator scientist.

leviathans.500.e.zh: 你能分享一下那些知识的基本原理吗？
leviathans.500.e.en: Can you share the fundamental principles of knowledge?

leviathans.500.e.alreadyshared.zh: 我们已经获得了策展人分享的知识原理。
leviathans.500.e.alreadyshared.en: We have already shared the Curator principles.

leviathans.500.f.zh: 我们愿意建造一个共享智库。
leviathans.500.f.en: We would like to establish a mutual Think Tank.

leviathans.500.g.zh: 我们发现了无限神机的秘密。
leviathans.500.g.en: We have uncovered the Infinity Machine's secret.

leviathans.500.h.zh: 能否告诉我们你们的其他主顾的信息？
leviathans.500.h.en: Can you tell us about your other customers?

leviathans.500.i.en: What do you know about the $lgates$?

leviathans.500.i.tooltip.noclue.zh: [curator_enclave_country.GetName]要花上近十年才能发现新的$clue$。
leviathans.500.i.tooltip.noclue.en: It takes the [curator_enclave_country.GetName] approximately a decade to identify each new $clue$.

leviathans.500.j.zh: 你可以帮助我们生态园的繁育吗？
leviathans.500.j.en: Can you help us populate our Vivarium?

leviathans.500.k.zh: 你可以对我们的收藏提供支援吗？
leviathans.500.k.en: Can you assist us with our Collection?

leviathans.500.k.reply.over.zh:
我们很抱歉，但我们已经没什么可以提供给你们了！你们的收藏真是蔚为壮观。很荣幸这个星系里能有你们这样的合作者。

你们就是知识保护的无上财富。
leviathans.500.k.reply.over.en:
We apologize, but we have nothing left to offer you! Your collection is truly magnificent. We are honored to have you as a partner in our galaxy.

You are an asset to the preservation of knowledge.

leviathans.500.k.reply.reward_unavailabl.zh: 我们很抱歉，但我们目前没有什么可以提供的。试着去收集、展示更多的$specimens$吧。也许我们到时候就能分享更多专业知识了。
leviathans.500.k.reply.reward_unavailabl.en: We apologize, but we have nothing to offer you at this time. Try collecting and displaying more $specimens$. Perhaps we can then share our expertise.

leviathans.500.l.zh: 你能为我们指引一些有趣的恒星系吗？
leviathans.500.l.en: Could you point us towards interesting systems?

leviathans.500.l.cooldown.zh: 我们最近刚向策展人寻求过指导。我们必须等待一段时间才能再次请求他们的服务。
leviathans.500.l.cooldown.en: We have recently consulted the Curators for guidance. We must wait before requesting their services again.

leviathans.500.l.desc.zh: 当然！我们的星图显示您可能对这个恒星系感兴趣。能否请您将您的发现传输给我们？
leviathans.500.l.desc.en: Certainly! Our charts indicate that this system might be of interest to you. Would you be so kind as to relay your findings back to us?

leviathans.500.l.tt.zh: 这将为游牧探险事件链在一个我们尚未访问过的恒星系中创建一个 兴趣点。
leviathans.500.l.tt.en: This will create a Point of Interest to a system we have yet to visit for the Nomad Exploration event chain

leviathans.500a.desc.zh: 也许你正在疑惑我身后壁画上图案的意义。这是个好问题，答案也会十分有趣。只需要1.5亿亿能量币你便可以得到这个问题的解答。
leviathans.500a.desc.en: Perhaps you are wondering about the significance of the shapes you see on the mural behind me. That is a good question with a very interesting answer! The fee for this information is 15 quadrillion energy credits.

leviathans.500b.desc.zh: 我们是策展人，欢迎你们，请问你们需要什么服务？
leviathans.500b.desc.en: You have reached the Curators. How may we assist you?

leviathans.500c.desc.zh: 你们知不知道这次对话正在被七个来自不同领域的亚空间实体所密切地监听着？唉，想和他们交流是不可能的，因为你们的文明远不具备能与他们交流的通讯技术。
leviathans.500c.desc.en: Did you know that this conversation is being closely monitored by entities from seven different subspace realms? Alas, I fear that the technology to communicate with them is too far beyond the present capabilities of your civilization to do you any good.

leviathans.500d.desc.zh: 不用担心，我们已经更新了档案系统，[Root.GetName]的信息已经被记入了档案以供后辈们查阅。即使在你的帝国经历不可避免的消亡后，你们仍将在档案中被铭记。
leviathans.500d.desc.en: Fear not. We have updated our archives with information about the [Root.GetName] for future generations. You will be remembered long after the inevitable collapse of your star nation.

leviathans.500e.desc.zh: 我想告诉你的东西有很多，但我不能白白免费地告诉你。这个空间站需要很多能源来维持运转…我们必须考虑收支的平衡。
leviathans.500e.desc.en: There is so much I wish I could tell you, but I simply can't do it for free. This space station requires a lot of energy to operate... we must consider our overhead.

leviathans.500f.desc.zh: 谨代表策展人协会向您问候，请问您有什么需要的吗？
leviathans.500f.desc.en: Greetings on behalf of the Curator order. Was there something you wanted?

leviathans.500g.desc.zh: 我们一向很高兴能和你们的政府进行贸易，我们这里还有一些科技资源，你们有兴趣吗？
leviathans.500g.desc.en: As always, it is a pleasure doing business with your government. Can we interest you in some technology?

leviathans.500h.desc.zh: 很高兴见到你。我很肯定今天我们可以达成一些互利互惠的协定。
leviathans.500h.desc.en: It is good to see you. I am sure we can come to some sort of mutually beneficial agreement before this day is over.

leviathans.500i.desc.zh: 知识一旦落入了恶毒之徒的手中，就会变得相当危险。但我们能怎么办呢？毕竟我们需要能源才能运营下去……
leviathans.500i.desc.en: Knowledge in the wrong gripping appendages can be dangerous, but what can we do? We need energy to keep the lights on...

leviathans.500j.desc.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们不知道的事情还有很多。求求你……让我们教授你们更多有关这个宇宙的知识吧。
leviathans.500j.desc.en: There is much that you do not yet know, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Please... let us educate you about the universe.

leviathans.500k.desc.zh: 我们持有整个星系的详细星图，这是从上百种不同的物种处收集来的信息的汇总。也许这能提起你们的兴趣？
leviathans.500k.desc.en: We possess detailed star charts of the entire galaxy, gathered by explorers from a hundred different races. Perhaps they would be of interest to you?

leviathans.500l.desc.zh: 知识就是一切，它们必须被守护。
leviathans.500l.desc.en: Knowledge is everything. It must be preserved.

leviathans.502a.desc.zh:
您好，星际旅行者，我们是策展人。

我们遵从的古训自万古之前便由星系中的支配力量所制定。我们献身于保存世间所有的知识，来避免星系再次陷入荒蛮与死寂的黑暗时期。

但我们失败了。

我们只留下了很少的幸存者，但相比我们的前辈，我们完成自己神圣使命的决心丝毫没有动摇。我们有意与你分享一些我们的知识……当然，这不是无偿的。
leviathans.502a.desc.en:
Greetings, star travelers. We are the Curators.

Our ancient order was established eons ago by the various galactic powers in ascendancy at the time. We were dedicated towards the preservation of all knowledge, in an effort to safeguard the galaxy from descending into yet another dark age of mass extinctions and barbarism.

We failed.

Few of us remain today, but we are no less committed to our sacred mission than our predecessors were. We are willing to share some of our knowledge with you... for a price.

leviathans.502b.desc.zh: 幸会，宇宙中的探险家。与你进行通话的是[curator_enclave_country.GetName]。也许你已经知晓我们古训中的信条。和其他城邦中的策展人同行们一样，只要你们能满足我们的要求，我们便愿意同你们交易。
leviathans.502b.desc.en: Well met, explorers. You are speaking to the [curator_enclave_country.GetName]. Perhaps you are already familiar with the tenets of our ancient order. Like our esteemed colleagues in the other Curator enclaves, we are willing to trade provided that you can meet our rates.

leviathans.504a.desc.zh: 尊敬的顾客，我们教团感谢你。
leviathans.504a.desc.en: Our order thanks you, esteemed customer.

leviathans.504b.desc.zh: [root.GetSpeciesAdj]，感谢你。愿明晰与好奇心常伴汝身。
leviathans.504b.desc.en: Thank you, [root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Clarity and curiosity be with you.

leviathans.504c.desc.zh: 很高兴和你做生意！我们敏锐的见解和无价的记录能如何为你服务？
leviathans.504c.desc.en: A pleasure doing business with you. How else might our keen insights and inestimable records be of service to you?

leviathans.506.d.en: What else did you have to offer?

leviathans.506.f.zh: 我们的舰队面对它该如何作战？
leviathans.506.f.en: How would our current fleet fare against it in battle?

leviathans.506.g.zh: 你还能对我们的收藏提供什么帮助？
leviathans.506.g.en: What else can you assist with our Collection?

leviathans.507.a.zh: 我们乐意购买这项服务。
leviathans.507.a.en: We would like to purchase this service.

leviathans.507.a.reply.zh: 明智的选择，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的后人们会称赞你的选择的。
leviathans.507.a.reply.en: A wise choice, that future generations of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will no doubt laud you for.

leviathans.507.desc.zh:
当然。我们准备将我们庞大的数据库对你们进行部分开放，为期十标准年。这应该会对你们行星研究实验室的科学研究起到巨大的推动作用。

自不用说，我们要为这样的服务收取一定的报酬。不过我认为你一定会感觉我们的价格十分实惠。
leviathans.507.desc.en:
Of course. We are prepared to offer you limited access to our extensive databanks for a period of ten standard years. This should provide a significant boost to the research efforts of your planetside Research Labs.
