We will require compensation for this service, naturally, but I think you'll find that our prices are very reasonable.

leviathans.507.name.zh: 太空城邦：策展人科研协助

leviathans.508.a.reply.zh: 这个可能你会有兴趣……我们在你的情报日志中标记了一个恒星系。
leviathans.508.a.reply.en: This might interest you... We have marked a star system in your Situation Log.

leviathans.508.desc.zh: 在我们星系中的一些特定的恒星系里，潜藏着极其强大的存在。耗费了巨大的人力物力，策展人的调查人员煞费苦心地收集了他们的信息，有了这些信息，你在下次遇见它们时应该可以更容易地对付他们。
leviathans.508.desc.en: There are exceedingly powerful entities lurking within certain star systems in our galaxy. At great cost in both lives and resources, Curator agents have painstakingly gathered knowledge that should make these beings easier to deal with the next time you encounter them.

leviathans.509.desc.zh: 根据我们当初签订的协定，你们对我们数据库的使用期限已经到了。现在你们打算让使用期限延长十年呢？还是不再需要我们数据库的信息了呢？
leviathans.509.desc.en: The agreement we signed giving you access to our databanks has run its course. Would you like to extend it for another ten standard years, or do your researchers no longer require the information we offer?

leviathans.510.a.zh: 这东西到底是什么玩意？

leviathans.510.a.reply.zh:
传说中，以太巨龙的出现先于任何一个宇宙文明。它们曾经数量众多，但随着时代更迭他们的族群也在逐渐衰落。

可以说，此时此地并不适合它们的生存。它们似乎不大适应宇宙的物理法则，就好像它们是从其他的现实中进化而来一般。而这，正是事实所在。我们认为它们是来自一个我们宇宙开始之前就已终结的宇宙，也就是某次"大坍缩"中唯一的生还者。

离这里不远的那条龙恐怕是这个星系，乃至这个宇宙中最后的以太巨龙了。
leviathans.510.a.reply.en:
By all accounts, the Ether Drakes predate all galactic civilization. There once were multitudes, but their race has been wasting away for eons.

They are ill-suited to life, here and now. Something about the physical laws of the universe does not agree with them, like they evolved in another reality. They did, in fact. We believe that they are but the last dregs of a universe that ended before ours began, the sole survivors of some "big crunch."

The dragon not far from here is the last of its kind in the galaxy, perhaps the universe.

leviathans.510.b.zh: 告诉我们如何才能击败它。
leviathans.510.b.en: Tell us how to defeat it.

leviathans.510.b.reply.zh:
龙身上的鳞片对敲击节律有反应，更精确地说，特定的频率对它的皮下组织有着放松的作用，而那里控制着它们的用以移动与防护冲击的鳞片。这个条件反射曾是以太巨龙之间社交行为的关键环节，现在则成为了它的死穴。

调整舰船火力平台的攻击节奏到一个特定的频率，可以有效地增加以太巨龙所受到的伤害。它并不是主动想生存在这个世界之中——一劳永逸地结束它的痛苦吧。
leviathans.510.b.reply.en:
Its scales respond to percussive rhythms. To be more precise, certain frequencies have a relaxing effect on the sub-dermal musculature controlling the positioning and shock absorption of their scale plates. A reflex that once played a key role in Ether Drake social interactions, it is now a clear and obvious weakness.

Adjusting the firing pattern of your vessels according to a particular rhythm will greatly increase the damage you can inflict on the last dragon. It was never meant for our age - put it out of its misery.

leviathans.510.desc.zh: 以太龙族这个物种并不适合在我们的宇宙中生存，最后的这只龙虽然很强，但也不是无敌的。
leviathans.510.desc.en: The Ether Drake species is ill-suited to life in our universe. The last dragon is strong, but not invincible.

leviathans.5106.f1.reply.zh:
你的舰队差劲，太差劲。

等等，难不成你想要去……我的天哪，就用你的这丁点舰队？那，那会变成一边倒的屠杀。
leviathans.5106.f1.reply.en:
Poorly. Very poorly.

Wait a second, you're not actually thinking of...? My goodness, with the ships you have? It... it would be a slaughter!

leviathans.5106.f2.reply.zh: 我强烈不建议你进行作战。你的攻击与其说是威胁它，更像是无谓的吵闹。
leviathans.5106.f2.reply.en: I would strongly advise against it. Your attacks would likely be more of an annoyance than a threat.

leviathans.5106.f3.reply.zh: 嗯……没错……没错，我想事实上你还是有很大的机会的。如果你联合你的整个舰队的话……我提醒你这场胜利不会轻松，但是起码你有胜利的可能性。
leviathans.5106.f3.reply.en: Hmmm, yes... Yes, I suppose you might actually stand a chance. If you combined your entire fleet... It would not be an easy victory, mind you, but one that is at least within the realm of possibility.

leviathans.5106.f4.reply.zh: 你的舰队是一支强大的舰队，甚至比得上一些被我们策展人编年史记载着的最伟大的无敌舰队。胜利掌握在你的手中。
leviathans.5106.f4.reply.en: Yours is a mighty fleet, comparable to some of the greatest armadas recorded in the annals of the Curator Order. Victory is certainly within your reach.

leviathans.511.a.zh: 棒极了。你们还有什么好东西？
leviathans.511.a.en: Excellent. What else do you have to offer?

leviathans.511.a.tooltip.zh: 我们现在可以在[curator_system.GetName]星系建造策展人智库这一恒星基地建筑了。
leviathans.511.a.tooltip.en: We can now build the Curator Think Tank Starbase Building in the [curator_system.GetName] system.

leviathans.511.a.tooltip_nomads.zh: 我们现在可以在[curator_system.GetName]星系建造策展人智库驿站模块了。
leviathans.511.a.tooltip_nomads.en: We can now build the Curator Think Tank Waystation Module in the [curator_system.GetName] system.

leviathans.511.desc.zh: 是的……是的，这样一个设施将会有益于全星系的科学发展。你可以在一个与我们共享星系的恒星基地里修建这个智库。我们的策展人将与你的科学家共处。
leviathans.511.desc.en: Yes... yes, such a facility would benefit the advancement of Galactic Science. You may build this Think Tank at your starbase in the system you share with us. Our Curators will come to mingle with your scientists.

leviathans.515.a.reply.zh: 这座堡垒曾经被击毁过，但它总能恢复原状。一些古老的帝国曾经因未能揭开它更深层次的秘密，抑或是未能永久地毁灭它而陷入癫狂。这座堡垒对于维持自身是如此尽心尽力，令人不得不怀疑它是否还有其他的正经用途。
leviathans.515.a.reply.en: The Fortress has been defeated before, but it always recovers. Some of the ancient empires of this galaxy were driven to madness by their vain efforts to unlock its deeper secrets, or else to permanently destroy it. It appears so focused on maintaining itself that we doubt it has any other serious purpose.

leviathans.515.b.reply.zh: 可以，而且已经有人进入过了，尽管那项尝试的壮举已经在时间的流逝中几乎被忘却。这座堡垒在关闭状态时仅能维持部分供能，不过它会尝试从附近摄取能量以迅速重启系统。请务必小心。
leviathans.515.b.reply.en: It can and it has been, although that attempt is now nearly forgotten. The fortress maintains only partial power while in shutdown, however it will attempt to draw power from nearby sources in order to jump-start its systems again. Proceed with caution.

leviathans.515.bb.zh: 重新给我们讲讲如何进入该建筑。

leviathans.515.c.reply.zh: 不管是谁，他们一定对于谜题与解密十分着迷。人们过去只从堡垒里面回收了一些形状奇怪的金属物件：这些古怪装置的零件，似乎设计上可以通过重新排列组成更加自然的形态。当时的回收人员并未能解开谜题，但所幸从堡垒中死里逃生。绝大多数人就没能活着出来了。
leviathans.515.c.reply.en: Whoever they were, they must have been fond of puzzles and enigmas. The only items to have been recovered from the fortress are strange metal shapes: components of perplexing contraptions which seem designed to be rearranged into more satisfying forms. Those who brought them back did so because they failed, and they barely escaped with their lives. Many others didn't.

leviathans.515.cc.zh: 重新给我们讲讲该建筑的建造者。

leviathans.515.d.reply.zh:
动力系统一定是在建造最初舱体与安装防御系统之间的某个时候建造而成的。我们尚不清楚它的恢复方式，但我们发现堡垒中保存着巨量的暗物质。了解那些物质与以及其与黑洞的关系，是弄清堡垒长久以来运作方式的关键。

没人曾经成功找到它的动力源，但这动力的来源似乎十分不稳定。
leviathans.515.d.reply.en:
The power system must have been built at a time between initial construction of the hull, and installation of its defense systems. The system's recovery method is unknown to us, but we have discovered that the fortress contains large quantities of dark matter. That substance and its relationship to black holes are key to understanding how the fortress has lasted so long.

No one has ever found the source of its power, but it is likely to be extremely volatile.

leviathans.515.dd.zh: 重新给我们讲讲该建筑的供能方式。
leviathans.515.dd.en: Remind us how it is powered.

leviathans.515.desc.zh: 这是一种已经没人会再建造的，异想天开，体型巨大且能自我维持的建筑。也许不建是明智的选择。
leviathans.515.desc.en: It is the kind of absurd, massive and self-perpetuating construction that you don't see built anymore. Maybe that is for the best.

leviathans.520.a.reply.zh:
这种恒星吞噬者是一种很罕见的生物，我们并不知道这种怪物的来源。我们手上现有的情报非常有限，只有极少数的情报提供源获得了与它们接触的第一手资料。

但是我们现有的资料都指向了一个事实：这是一种极其可怕的生物，它只会带来毁灭。

噬星者能够以聚变为食。我们得出了一个非常有说服力的推断：它是暗物质和恒星物质在外部维度层面上融合的产物。它们潜进恒星内部，吞噬其中的物质来为其内部聚变反应堆提供燃料。它所到的恒星系，无一逃得过灭亡的命运。在它的盛宴之后，行星们要么像冰一样粉碎，要么暴露在它胃中的第二太阳之下被烧尽。

它贪得无厌，永远不会停下吞噬的脚步。当你注视着它的时候，你会从中看到为了生存而透露出的无以言表的狂怒。
leviathans.520.a.reply.en:
The star-feaster is a rare breed. A new type of beast of unknown origin. The accounts we have collected are few and sparse with intel. Few sources even have firsthand experience with the thing.

All our data points to the same fact, however: it is a terror that brings nothing but ruin.

The Stellar Devourer is capable of feeding off of fusion itself. Our very educated guess is that its biology is the result of some outer-dimensional fusing of dark matter and solar matter. It dives into stars, feasting on their innards in order to fuel its own, internal fusion reactor. It brings death to all systems it reaches. Either they shatter like ice after its banquet, or they burn from being exposed to a second sun from within the being's belly.

It wants to feed, and it will stop at nothing to get its share. When you gaze at it, what you see is a survivor's raw fury.

leviathans.520.b.reply.zh:
我们目前唯一确定的事实是，噬星者最重要的部分是它的集成核心。它极度需要维持其内部的反应炉运转，避免让寒冷的虚空接触到它内部使其自行崩塌。没有那些恒星物质，它就没办法存活。

这是一个你们可以利用的缺陷。你们可以将武器按照我们提供的标准来进行校准，这样你们就能穿破保护其消化系统的外层组织。打伤它，你就能看到它的内部物质喷射出来，扩散到整个星系。
leviathans.520.b.reply.en:
The only thing we know for sure is that the collected core is the most important aspect of the Stellar Devourer. The creature desperately needs to keep its furnace burning, lest the cold void of space reaches its vital organs deeper within and makes it collapse in on itself. Without that stellar matter, it is nothing.

You can use this to your advantage. Calibrate your weapons to our specifications and you can then home in on the very membranes that hold the Devourer's digestive system together. Wound it and you will see its innards gush out across the solar system.

leviathans.520.desc.zh: 就像你的帝国一样，噬星者是星系狩猎场中的一种新的寄生虫。它们从恐惧和核聚变中诞生，平时在星际间游荡。它们会潜进恒星内部，从内部汲取养分。另外，它们也很不想被打扰。
leviathans.520.desc.en: The Stellar Devourer is a new parasite on the galactic hunting ground, not unlike your empire in many ways. It was born out of fear and nuclear fusion. It roams the galaxy, submerging itself into stars, feasting on them from within. And it certainly does not like being disturbed.

leviathans.525.a.reply.zh:
这种完全是由怨恨组成的生物，诞生于另外一个位面。那里非常像是许多太空文明所信仰的宗教里描述的地狱。目前我们看到的还只是它的冰山一角——这只怪物的全貌应该比现在的样子还大上几倍。

所幸，它没能完全转移至我们的宇宙。如若不然，它可能早已经将所有的生命赶尽杀绝了。
leviathans.525.a.reply.en:
It is a creature of pure malice, born in a dimension that bears more than a striking resemblance to the realm of Hell as described by many galactic religions. What we are seeing is but a small part of a greater whole - the creature in its entirety is multitudes larger.

It is very fortunate that it was unable to complete its transition into our universe. Had it been successful, the creature would likely have consumed all life in the galaxy by now.

leviathans.525.b.reply.zh: 位面之魇最大的弱点是它通往我们宇宙的位面传送门——没有传送门，它就不能在我们的宇宙中存活下去。我们已经确认了传送门能量矩阵中几个薄弱的位置，用传统的武器就能对其造成伤害。现在开始传送目标坐标点。
leviathans.525.b.reply.en: The dimensional portal that it spawned from is its greatest weakness - without it, it cannot exist in our universe. We have identified several weak points in the portal's energy matrix that could be exploited by conventional weapons. Transmitting targeting coordinates now.

leviathans.525.desc.zh: 我们的设备发现有一物体冲入我们的世界，同时还检测到了巨大的能量涌动。
leviathans.525.desc.en: Our instruments monitored the immense energy surge when this entity pierced its way into our realm of existence.

leviathans.530.a.reply.zh:
它们是一种具有侵略性的硅基生物。尽管它们一度对太空文明构成巨大威胁，但过去的50万年来，它们遭到大量的捕杀，剩下的都隐遁了起来。

尽管流传着许多谣言，目前没有任何证据表明它们具备任何智慧生物的特征。它们喜欢在小行星里筑巢，并且攻击所有它们认为是有威胁的东西。
leviathans.530.a.reply.en:
They are an aggressively territorial silicon-based life form. Although they once posed a significant threat to spacefaring civilizations, their numbers have been severely culled over the last 500,000 years and the surviving members of their species are fairly reclusive.

Despite rumors to the contrary, there is no evidence that they possess anything that could be described as sapient intelligence. They tend to nest inside asteroids, and they will attack anything which is perceived as a threat.

leviathans.530.b.reply.zh:
这种生物喜欢用一种未知的物质包裹在他们的蜂巢小行星外面来防御舰载武器的攻击。但是这种物质并不能完全地覆盖在小行星的表面上。

有了这些现在正传输给你的瞄准数据，你的飞船可以集中火力攻击未覆盖装甲的区域，大大提升攻击效果。
leviathans.530.b.reply.en:
The creatures have a tendency to coat their asteroid nests with some kind of unknown substance that acts as a potent armor against ship-based weapons. This substance is not perfectly applied across the entire surface of the asteroid, however.

With the targeting data we are transmitting to you now, your ships will be able to focus their fire on unprotected surface areas, greatly increasing the damage they inflict.

leviathans.530.desc.zh: 这些令人感到烦躁的虫子曾经比现在更多，它们的足迹遍布整个星系。那个时候，当你航行通过任意一个小行星带时，你都会发现有小虫子围绕着你的船只。
leviathans.530.desc.en: These annoying pests were once far more prevalent in our galaxy. There was a time when you couldn't cruise through a random asteroid belt without the little beasts swarming around your ship!

leviathans.535.a.reply.zh: 你口中笼统称为无限神机的存在，是无法进行回收的，更无法获得它的任何信息。整个星系中没有任何一个骇客或者工程师能透过它闪亮的外壳看到里面的任何东西——我们很清楚它里面藏着许多有价值的信息。我们也束手无策。我们既不知道它的用途，也不知道它接下去的任务是什么。
leviathans.535.a.reply.en: The Infinity Machine, as you so bluntly call it, is impervious to extraction. No information comes out from it. No hacker or engineer in the entire galaxy has been able to see through its shiny exterior to gain a glimpse of the knowledge it so obviously withholds from us. We are at a loss. We neither know what it is for, nor what it aims to do once it's done.

leviathans.535.b.reply.zh:
有一种办法大概可以摧毁它。我们虽然无法从它身上获得任何信息，但它的外壳还是可以破坏的。采矿者曾经无数次尝试过从它上面获取资源，但回来时全都狼狈不堪。不过他们发现了一些有趣的情况：无限神机并不像看起来那样坚不可摧。

它是由一种能够调节其自身属性的材料构成。密度、弹性、温度，只有你想不到，没有它变不了的！它能够实时分析伤害，并及时改变外壳特性进行补偿。这样一来，外界的伤害就很难摧毁它了。你要做的，就是改变攻击的频率，调整导弹的热力输出，不管用什么攻击方式，想方设法地进行变化。这样你们才能克服无限神机外壳的适应性。
leviathans.535.b.reply.en:
There is perhaps one thing you could do to destroy it. We have been unable to retrieve information from it, but its hull is breakable. Miners have tried to gather resources from it at numerous times, only to come back with their ships barely holding together. But they did find something interesting: The Infinity Machine is not as rigid as it seems.

It is made of a material capable of changing its characteristics. Density, flexibility, heat, you name it! It can analyze damage in real time and change its shell to compensate, thus making itself harder to take down. Change your frequencies, adjust the thermal output of your missiles, whatever you people lumber around with, and keep changing them. That way you can get past its adaptive capabilities.

leviathans.535.desc.zh:
嗯对，这种色彩斑斓的机器出现于远古时代。我们对它的研究可以追溯到我们城邦建立之初。在我们之前已经有许多文明也对它进行了研究。

这种机器已经不只是上古时代的产物了。根据我们现有的资料显示，它一直都存在着。但是，它所做的唯一的事情就是绕着黑洞转。我们对无限神机很感兴趣，但是我们明白这种东西对于你们来说还是太难理解了。
leviathans.535.desc.en:
Ah yes, the chromatic being from long ago. We have studied it for as long as our order has existed. As have several civilizations before us.

This machine is beyond ancient. For all we know, it has always been. And yet, all it does is orbit that black hole. It's fascinating to us, but we understand if it is too much for you to grasp.

leviathans.540.a.reply.zh:
七百万年前，曾经有个伟大的星际帝国在我们的星系中一个不起眼的地方兴盛强大，这是那曾经无比强大的帝国的旗舰之一。历史往往都是相似的，这个帝国在一系列与邻国的惨烈战争中骤然消亡。

你遇到的无畏战舰是他们最后的遗物。尽管船员们都已经去世，电脑系统还在尽职地巡逻。在这段漫长的时光中，无数人都曾想让这艘战舰安息——但没有一次成功。
leviathans.540.a.reply.en:
It was one of several flagships belonging to an unusually powerful interstellar empire that flourished in a small region of our galaxy some seven million years ago. As is so often the case, that empire was brought to a sudden and violent end at the hands of its neighbors in a series of very destructive wars.

The dreadnought you have encountered is the last of its kind, and it continues to dutifully patrol its assigned system despite the death of its crew. Many attempts have been made throughout the ages to put the old warship to its final rest - none successful.

leviathans.540.b.reply.zh: 设计之初，这艘无畏战舰应该载着大量的船员进行操作，但是现在它仅依靠着自动化系统来工作。这使得它在其中央计算机的中继节点受到干扰时将变得非常脆弱。
leviathans.540.b.reply.en: The dreadnought was designed to operate with a large crew, but it now relies exclusively on automated systems to function. This makes the ship especially vulnerable to attacks that disrupt the relay nodes used by its central computer.

leviathans.540.desc.zh: 这是一个悲伤的故事。自动无畏战舰的主人已经过世百万年之久了，但是这些巨大的舰船还继续在它们帝国的废墟周围警戒着。
leviathans.540.desc.en: A sad story. Its masters have been dead for millions of years, but this massive warship continues to stand vigil over the broken rubble of their empire.

leviathans.545.a.zh: 你对这种灾害有什么了解？
leviathans.545.a.en: What do you know about these disasters?

leviathans.545.a.reply.zh:
它们似乎像是光影形成的幻象，但等你凑近去看，马上就会发现它们与幻象相去甚远。

打倒它们的关键就在于它们的形态，虽然这听起来有些矛盾。可见光谱影响着它们的力量，当它们接近相似频率的光源时，力量就会减弱。时刻注意幽魂的颜色变化。
leviathans.545.a.reply.en:
They appear to be illusions of light, but when you get close, it quickly grows apparent that they are far from illusory.

Paradoxically, in that appearance lies the key to their defeat. Their relationship with the visible spectrum of light is their strength, but it diminishes when they approach a light source of a similar frequency. Pay close attention to the color of the Wraith.

leviathans.545.b.zh: 红色幽魂是什么样的呢？

leviathans.545.b.reply.zh: 红色幽魂的频率是450THz。它们的光与M级恒星是一致的。它们免疫传统武器攻击的能力在有红矮星的恒星系里将会被削弱。
leviathans.545.b.reply.en: Red Wraiths have a frequency of 450THz. Their light is synchronized with that of a Class M Star. Their ability to avoid conventional weaponry is weakened in systems with red dwarfs.

leviathans.545.c.zh: 黄色幽魂是什么样的呢？

leviathans.545.c.reply.zh: 黄色的幽魂的频率是520THz。它们的光与G级恒星是一致的。它们免疫传统武器攻击的能力在有黄矮星的恒星系里将会被削弱。
leviathans.545.c.reply.en: Yellow Wraiths have a frequency of 520THz. Their light is synchronized with that of a Class G Star. Their ability to avoid conventional weaponry is weakened in systems with yellow dwarfs.

leviathans.545.d.zh: 蓝色幽魂是什么样的呢？

leviathans.545.d.reply.zh: 蓝色幽魂的频率是650THz。它们的光与B级恒星以及A级恒星是一致的。它们免疫传统武器攻击的能力在有蓝巨星的恒星系里将会被削弱。
leviathans.545.d.reply.en: Blue Wraiths have a frequency of 650THz. Their light synchronizes with both Class A and Class B Stars. Their ability to avoid conventional weaponry is weakened in systems with blue giants.

leviathans.545.desc.zh: 神出鬼没的幽魂是一种令人烦躁的生物，如果它们能被称为生物的话。我们把它们当做是一种罕见但是极具破坏力的自然灾害。
leviathans.545.desc.en: Spectral Wraiths are disturbing creatures, if they are creatures at all. We consider them a rare and extraordinarily efficient natural disaster.

leviathans.550.a.reply.zh:
据我们所知，母体会在恒星的轨道上产下星球大小的蛋，并花费数千年来孵化，有时甚至久到足以在蛋壳上发展出大气层与有机生命。

它们以活体物质为食，而成年虚空孳孽据说会对所有活物造成一种奇怪的影响。幸运的是，这只幼体似乎被其父母抛弃了。

或许我们最好该趁它尚未成熟之时将它消灭？
leviathans.550.a.reply.en:
From what we can tell, the mother lays its planet-sized eggs in orbit of a star, where they then incubate for thousands of years, sometimes even long enough to develop an atmosphere and organic life.

They feed off of living matter, and adult Voidspawn are said to exert a strange influence on all living things. Fortunately this spawn seems to have been abandoned by its parents.

Perhaps it would be best to stifle the creature while it is still young and vulnerable?

leviathans.550.b.reply.zh: 我们从未听说有谁曾击败过成年虚空孳孽，但这只才刚刚出生。虚空孳孽会喷出腐蚀性的黏液和尖刺，连最厚的装甲都可以烧穿，但涂上一层抗酸涂层可以减缓这一过程。我们会为你们提供帮助。虚空孳孽对我们所有人都是个威胁。
leviathans.550.b.reply.en: We have never heard of a grown Voidspawn being defeated in battle, but this one is newly hatched. The Voidspawn projects corrosive spittle and spikes that can burn through the thickest of armor, but applying a protective acid-proof coating may slow its progress. We will help you make it. The Voidspawn is a threat to us all.

leviathans.550.desc.zh: 如果我们没猜错的话，虚空孳孽来自很远的地方。我们认为它是某种巨大无比的星系际捕食者的后代，他们会在虚空中寻找猎物。尽管我们从未遭遇过活的个体，我们听说过虚空孳孽的成年体所过之处，皆是破坏与混乱的故事。据说星球会在它们的阴影下溃烂。
leviathans.550.desc.en: If our suspicions hold true, the Voidspawn is far away from home. We believe it is the progeny of an extragalactic predator of unthinkable proportions: one that stalks the void of space in search of its prey. Though we have never before encountered a live specimen, we have heard tales of the destruction and chaos grown Voidspawn leave in their wake. It is said that worlds fester under their shadow.

leviathans.555.a.reply.zh:
不幸的是，关于拾荒者的起源并没有准确的数据。有些科学家认为它是一个失落帝国的废品回收机器人，但出了故障，其原本用途早已被硬件劣化埋没了。也有人认为它原本是一个微小的纳米机器人，在其程序驱动下，利用其周围环境来不断地使自己变大变强。还有人认为它当初是机器人舰长，是数千年前一场星际大战的唯一幸存者。因其文明突然且彻底的毁灭，导致其逻辑系统无法挽回地受损了。

当然，这些都只是猜测。
leviathans.555.a.reply.en:
Unfortunately, no definitive data regarding the Scavenger's origin is known to exist. Some researchers believe it to be a malfunctioning scrap collection service machine from a lost empire, its purpose long since muddled by hardware degradation. Others believe it to have originated as a single microscopic nanobot, programmed to endlessly build itself larger and stronger by exploiting its environment. Still others reckon it may have started out as a robotic ship's captain; the sole survivor of an intergalactic battle waged millennia ago. Perhaps its reasoning systems were irrevocably damaged by the sudden destruction of its entire civilization.

Of course, this is all just speculation.

leviathans.555.aa.zh: 再给我们讲讲它的起源。

leviathans.555.b.reply.zh:
多年来许多人都试图与拾荒机器人沟通，或者转而尝试更改其程序。不幸的是，这些远征队大多数都变成了拾荒者机器人身处的宇宙垃圾场的一部分。只有那些跑得比它还快的才活了下来。

它身上焊接的重炮火力已经足以单枪匹马消灭整个帝国的舰队——而且这样的情况可能已经发生过不止一次了。当然，这种毁灭性的遭遇只会进一步增强拾荒者，为其提供更多可利用的舰船部件。
leviathans.555.b.reply.en:
Over the years there have been many attempts to communicate with it, or else to alter the programming of the Scavenger. Unfortunately, most of those expeditions ended up part of the cosmic scrap yards where the Scavenger Bot dwells. Only those who were able to outrun it survived.

The Scavenger has welded enough heavy artillery onto its patchwork frame to single-handedly destroy an entire nation's fleet - an event that may already have occurred on more than one occasion. Of course, any such destructive encounters would only have served to further strengthen the Scavenger, providing it with more ship components to repurpose.

leviathans.555.bb.zh: 再给我们讲讲与它沟通的尝试。
leviathans.555.bb.en: Remind us about attempts at communicating with it.

leviathans.555.c.reply.zh:
你可能已经推测到了：拾荒者并非按照任何明确的现成图纸而造。因此，它的某些部件并不太……合身，导致了一些不连续的结构弱点。当然，外行人一眼看不出这些弱点，但我们的先进传感器已经设法确定了它们的位置。

让你的舰队集中火力攻击我们在拾荒者上标明的这些部位，应该可以大幅降低击溃它所需要倾斜的火力。
leviathans.555.c.reply.en:
As you may have surmised: the Scavenger was not built according to any definitive, pre-existing schematics. As a result, some of its parts fit together... less than optimally, leading to a discrete number of structural weaknesses. Of course, to the uninitiated, most of these are obscured from view - but our advanced sensors have managed to isolate them.

Tell your fleets to focus fire on the indicated sections of the Scavenger's hull, and it should substantially reduce the amount of damage the construct is able to take before collapsing.

leviathans.555.desc.zh:
啊，废品机器人。拾荒者是一个失落时代的奇特造物。它无止尽地在残骸场中搜寻，将从无数残骸中搜获的枪炮，引擎，材料焊至自己的外壳上。其体量与火力数百年以来一直以这种方式提升，而且毫不减缓。

如果有足够的时间与废品，没有人知道它到底能将自己造得多大。
leviathans.555.desc.en:
Ah, the scrap bot. The Scavenger is a curious construct from a lost age. Endlessly it searches through the debris fields of the galaxy, welding the guns, engines, and materials scavenged from countless derelicts onto its own hull. Its mass and firepower have been increasing in such a fashion for centuries, with no sign of relenting.

No-one knows if there is an upper limit to how massive it could become, given enough time and scrap to work with.

leviathans.556.a.zh: 为什么族母比其它缇扬奇要大许多？
leviathans.556.a.en: Why is the Matriarch so much larger than other Tiyanki?

leviathans.556.a.reply.zh:
她惊人的巨大身躯实属异常。我们认为族母是来自另一星系的漂流者，那里的缇扬奇与我们星系中的缇扬奇进化产生了分歧，变得更大更强。

当然，另一种可能性是族母只是得了一种巨大畸形症——不过这无法解释她的长寿。
leviathans.556.a.reply.en:
Her incredible size is an anomaly, to be sure. We believe the Matriarch is a wanderer from another galaxy in deep space, where a species of Tiyanki far greater in size and strength diverged evolutionarily from the Tiyanki found in our own.

Of course, it is also possible the Matriarch is simply suffering from an advanced form of gigantism - though this would fail to explain her extended lifespan.

leviathans.556.aa.zh: 再给我们讲讲为何族母比其它缇扬奇要大许多。
leviathans.556.aa.en: Remind us why the Matriarch is larger than other Tiyanki.

leviathans.556.b.zh: 你对那位狩猎族母的舰长有何了解？
leviathans.556.b.en: What do you know about the captain hunting the Matriarch?

leviathans.556.b.reply.zh: 很少。那位舰长很可能从另一个星系追着族母来到了这里。不过，为何有人会蠢到挑战可以单枪匹马消灭整支舰队的生物仍是个谜。
leviathans.556.b.reply.en: Very little. It is quite possible the captain chased the Matriarch here from another galaxy. Though why one would be foolish enough to challenge a creature capable of destroying entire fleets with just one vessel is beyond us.

leviathans.556.bb.zh: 再给我们讲讲那位狩猎族母的舰长。
leviathans.556.bb.en: Remind us about the captain hunting the Matriarch.

leviathans.556.c.reply.zh:
族母非常强大，但并非坚不可摧。尽管她的装甲外壳可以抵御多种投射物，她仍有一个可观的弱点。

在她的背上插着一枚巨型质子鱼雷，这是最近一场战斗中留下的仍未愈合的伤口。尽管那颗鱼雷似乎故障了，我们的扫描显示它仍可以引爆，只要用一道特定的能源脉冲诱发即可。

我们现在将详情发送给你。
leviathans.556.c.reply.en:
The Matriarch is formidable, but not indestructible. While her armored hide protects her from a wide range of projectiles, she carries with her a remarkable weakness.

There is a massive proton torpedo lodged in her back: a wound from a recent battle that has healed poorly. While seemingly defective, our scans of the torpedo suggest it can still be detonated, if agitated with a specific energy pulse.

We will transmit the details to you now.

leviathans.556.desc.zh: 真壮观，不是吗？一只消瘦的老族母，她的外皮在漫漫岁月中变白变硬，战列舰在她的触手中就像牡蛎壳一般脆弱。几十年前，我们的科学家听说有一位舰长，发誓要狩猎族母至星系尽头。不过，考虑到族母仍然存活，我们可以肯定他未能成功。
leviathans.556.desc.en: Magnificent, is she not? A wizened old Matriarch, her hide bleached and hardened by the eons, her tentacles capable of snapping the hulls of battleships like oyster shells. Decades ago, our researchers heard rumors of a captain sworn to hunt the Matriarch to the ends of the galaxy. However, considering her continued existence, we cannot imagine he met with success.

leviathans.558.A.reply.zh: 没有文献记载毒性神祗究竟从何而来。第一次目击是在数千年之前，自那以后每过几个世纪就有人目击过。某些人视其为神明，但具体如何得由你自己判断。我们能够告诉你的是，它是一个极度令人畏惧的有机生物，有着节肢动物的特征。有报告表明，它的体型相当巨大，上面甚至发展出了一整个生态系统。当然，获取其生物学样本的难度可以预想是有多么困难了。
leviathans.558.A.reply.en: It is not documented where the Toxic Entity came from. The first sighting was several thousand years ago, and since then it has been seen every few centuries. Some have called it a deity, but that is for you to decide. What we can tell you is that it is an extremely formidable organic being with arthropoid characteristics. Reports suggest that it is sufficiently large that an entire ecosystem has developed on it, though acquiring samples of its biology has proved understandably challenging.

leviathans.558.AA.zh: 重新给我们讲讲你对它有什么了解。
leviathans.558.AA.en: Remind us what you know of it.

leviathans.558.B.reply.zh: 过去撞见它的人中有少数几个幸存者。根据报告，它带有腐蚀性的毒液能够烧蚀任何形态的装甲。护盾相对来说更加有用一丁点。此外，在它的背上生活的那些生物在剧毒实体受到威胁的时候，会像蜂群一样发动攻击。我们只能建议你带着压倒性的军力去接近它。
leviathans.558.B.reply.en: There have been few survivors to its past encounters. According to reports, its corrosive poisons are able to burn through all forms of armor. Shields are only slightly more useful. Furthermore, the creatures living on its back will supposedly act as an attack swarm when it is threatened. We can only suggest you approach it with overwhelming force.

leviathans.558.BB.zh: 重新给我们讲讲应该如何同它战斗。
leviathans.558.BB.en: Remind us how we can fight it.

leviathans.558.desc.zh: 毒性神祗是一个捉摸不透的存在。几千年来它在星系内来回游荡，偶尔会选择某个星球喷洒毒液——我们只能猜测这是其生命循环的某个自然阶段。我们听说上次它被目击到是在[toxic_god_system.GetName]星系。
leviathans.558.desc.en: The Toxic Entity is an elusive being. It has roamed the galaxy for millennia, occasionally choosing to spurt venom at worlds in what we can only imagine is a natural stage of its life cycle. We have heard that it has been tracked to the [toxic_god_system.GetName] system.

leviathans.558.desc.knights.zh:
毒性神祗是一个捉摸不透的存在。几千年来它在星系内来回游荡，偶尔会选择某个星球喷洒毒液——我们只能猜测这是其生命循环的某个自然阶段。当然，你肯定早就知道了！

我们很抱歉，但是我们没法帮你找到它现在所在的位置——我们的全体线人都有好一阵子没看到它了。
leviathans.558.desc.knights.en:
The Toxic Entity is an elusive being. It has roamed the galaxy for millennia, occasionally choosing to spurt venom at worlds in what we can only imagine is a natural stage of its life cycle. But you already knew this, of course!

We are sorry, but we cannot help you find its present whereabouts - it has not been spotted by any of our contacts for quite some time.

leviathans.559.a.zh: 你是说它在守护着什么吗？
leviathans.559.a.en: You say it is guarding something?

leviathans.559.a.reply.zh: 正是，尽管我们并不确切知道是什么。我们的一些联系人认为，哨兵正在保卫分裂的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]所剩下的任何东西；另一些人则暗示，这颗星球本身蕴藏着某种宝藏。我们所知道的是，这艘战舰的建造比其[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]同类坚固得多，甚至高出一个数量级。无论它在保护什么，$NAME_Opus_Sentinel$都在坚持，尽管有明显的痛苦迹象，甚至可能是极度的煎熬。
leviathans.559.a.reply.en: Indeed, though we do not know precisely what. Some of our contacts believe the Sentinel is defending whatever remains of the splintered [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]; others suggest the planet itself holds some treasure. What we do know is that this warship was built more robustly than any of its [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] peers by an order of magnitude. Whatever it is protecting out there, the $NAME_Opus_Sentinel$ perseveres despite clear signs of distress, or perhaps even agony.

leviathans.559.b.en: We prefer not to talk about it.

leviathans.559.b.reply.zh:
完全可以理解。我们只是出于好奇。

还有其他我可以帮您的吗？
leviathans.559.b.reply.en:
Quite understandable. We are merely curious.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

leviathans.559.c.zh: 我们能在哪里找到这个实体？
leviathans.559.c.en: Where can we find this entity?

leviathans.559.c.reply.zh:
鉴于您是我们较为信任的客户之一……我可以告知您，$NAME_Opus_Sentinel$最后一次被目击到是在守护[origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core.GetName]星系

考虑到我们对这艘饱经战火、问题重重的战舰仍然知之甚少，请您放心：我们将以极大的兴趣观察您与它的遭遇细节！
leviathans.559.c.reply.en:
Seeing as how you are one of our more trustworthy clients... I can tell you the $NAME_Opus_Sentinel$ was last seen guarding the [origin_unplugged_machine_legacy_core.GetName] system.

Given how much we still do not know about this ferociously troubled warship, rest assured: we shall observe the particulars of your encounter with keen interest!

leviathans.559.desc.zh: 那个颇为神经质的自动化机械体来到这个星系的时间并不长，但不要被这种新奇所迷惑。$NAME_Opus_Sentinel$的创造者们在被一台专横的机器同化之前，就已经是他们所在领域中最杰出的工程师之一。我们不知道自那时起，那个机器意识遭遇了怎样严酷的命运，但从哨兵那痛苦的扭动来看：情况似乎相当不稳定。如果你决定满足自己的好奇心，务必小心行事。
leviathans.559.desc.en: That rather twitchy automaton is a relative newcomer to the galaxy, but don't be fooled by such novelty. The $NAME_Opus_Sentinel$'s creators were counted among the finest engineers in their sector even before they were assimilated by a tyrannical machine. We do not know what harsh fate has befallen the machine consciousness since then, but if the Sentinel's agonized writhing is anything to go by: the whole situation appears quite volatile. Tread carefully, should you decide to slake your curiosity.

leviathans.559.desc.unplugged.zh:
恕我冒昧，但我以为您会比我们更了解此事！与我们所研究的对象相比，那个颇为不安的自动化机械体是个新面孔，但作为对手同样令人畏惧。

我们知道，即便在被同化之前，$NAME_Opus_Sentinel$背后的工程师们也被认为是该领域最优秀的人才。因此，那艘战舰不容小觑。我们不太清楚的是，这艘船是如何与[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]如此疏远的。从“哨兵”痛苦的扭动来看，我们推测情况仍然相当不稳定。您是否同意这一评估，[root.GetSpeciesName]？
leviathans.559.desc.unplugged.en:
Forgive my impertinence, but I assumed you would know more about it than we do! That rather twitchy automaton is a newcomer compared to what we usually study here, but is no less fearsome an opponent.

We know that even before they were assimilated, the engineers behind the $NAME_Opus_Sentinel$ were counted among the finest in their sector. That warship is therefore not to be underestimated. What is less clear to us is how the vessel became so detached from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. We gather from the Sentinel's agonized writhing that the whole situation remains quite volatile. Would you agree with assessment, [root.GetSpeciesName]?

leviathans.590.a.zh: 当然，我们会给你们资助的。
leviathans.590.a.en: Of course. You shall have your donation.

leviathans.590.a.reply.zh: 很好，你们现在可以随意的使用我们这个时代最杰出的头脑了！
leviathans.590.a.reply.en: Excellent. You will now have unfettered access to one of the greatest minds of our time!

leviathans.590.desc.zh:
我们愿意提供我们之中最杰出的科学家来换取你们的资助。你们要知道这种提议可不是谁都能轻易获得的。

当然，在做出人员安排之前，你必须准备好合适数量的……资金赞助。
leviathans.590.desc.en:
We are willing to pledge the services of one of our most brilliant scientists to your cause. This is not an offer we make to just anyone, you understand!

A suitable... donation will of course be necessary, before traveling arrangements can be made.

leviathans.590.tt_scientist.zh: 我们每次只能雇佣一名策展人科学家。
leviathans.590.tt_scientist.en: We may only employ one Curator scientist at a time.

leviathans.593.desc.zh: 在[curator_system.GetName]星系摧毁了策展人的空间站之后，我们能干的军队在策展人曾经占据的区域搜寻任何有价值的东西。他们成功恢复了一下策展人数据库的内存碎片，这将能极大地促进我们的研究。
leviathans.593.desc.en: After destroying the ancient Curator station in the [curator_system.GetName] system, our capable forces combed the area it once occupied for anything valuable. They managed to recover several memory fragments from the Curator databanks that should be a great boon to our research.

leviathans.594.a.zh: 他们的遗产真的是可惜了。
leviathans.594.a.en: A sad end to their legacy.

leviathans.596.desc.zh:
看来我们真是高估你们了，你们的人根本不具备文明处事的能力。真是奇怪……我们通常在刚见面的时候就可以准确识别出某个物种是否具备好斗倾向。为什么对你们看走眼了呢。

我们已经剥夺了你们对我们数据库的访问权限。
leviathans.596.desc.en:
It would appear that we grossly overestimated your capacity to act as a civilized nation. Strange... We are usually able to identify the violent ones at an early stage.

We have severed your access to our databanks, of course.

leviathans.597a.desc.zh: 你们这群笨蛋！袭击我们就等于放弃了知识，你们的后辈们将活在低科技水平的蛮荒之中！
leviathans.597a.desc.en: You fool! By attacking us, you are condemning future generations to lives of low-tech misery!

leviathans.597b.desc.zh: 你们受本能驱使而袭击我们，而现在你们要为此付出代价。我们将永远不再与[Root.GetName]分享我们的知识。
leviathans.597b.desc.en: Your base instincts compelled you to attack us, and now you must pay the price. We will never share our knowledge with the [Root.GetName] again.

leviathans.597c.desc.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们慷慨相助，你们却不识好人心。一群野蛮的渣滓！
leviathans.597c.desc.en: We had so much to offer you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and yet you would throw it all away. Neo-barbarian scum!

leviathans.597d.desc.zh: 你们已经成为整个策展人组织的敌人。
leviathans.597d.desc.en: You have been declared an enemy of the entire Curator Order.

leviathans.598.desc.zh:
我们愿意向你们的集体灌输知识的基本原理。这个流程非常严格，而且只有在共同意识的情况下才能进行。

即使对我们来说，这也不是一件容易的事情。成本并非微不足道。但在所有商品中，知识仍是最宝贵的。
leviathans.598.desc.en:
We are willing to infuse your collective with the fundamental principles of knowledge. A serious procedure, and one only available to a shared consciousness.

Even for us, it is no easy thing to achieve. The cost is not insignificant. But of all commodities, knowledge remains the most precious.

leviathans.598.tt_principles.zh: 策展人的基本原理已经分享给我们了。
leviathans.598.tt_principles.en: The fundamental principles of the Curators have already been shared with us.

leviathans.599.b.en: What do you know of the [curator_customer_2.GetName]?

leviathans.599.c.zh: 我们希望了解关于[curator_customer_3.GetName]的情报。
leviathans.599.c.en: We wish to know about the [curator_customer_3.GetName].

leviathans.599.d.en: The [curator_customer_4.GetName] is of interest to us.

leviathans.599.desc.zh:
你们属于高信用的顾客，所以我们可以向你们透露某些我们的……低优先级顾客的消息。当然，该如何使用这些消息完全取决于你们自己。

你想要了解什么？
leviathans.599.desc.en:
Since you are one of our trusted customers, we are able to divulge to you certain information on our... less favored clients. What you do with this information is entirely up to you, of course.

Who do you want to know about?

leviathans.599.yes.reply.zh: 很好。情报很快就会通过星系最严密的星际数据链传输给你们。
leviathans.599.yes.reply.en: Excellent. The information will be transferred to you immediately via the most secure interstellar datalink in the galaxy.

leviathans.600.desc.zh:
$lgates$？是的，正如其它传送门一样，它们的历史比最古老的$gov_stagnant_ascendancy$还要久，但你们肯定已经知道这一点了。

它们为何不同？它们通往哪里？我们决定不要对这些谜团太过深究——“一朝被蛇咬，零点一七年怕井绳”这道理你懂的——但我们愿意分享一些可能与其有关的近期发现。

当然，不是免费的。
leviathans.600.desc.en:
The $lgates$? Yes, like the other Gateways they predate even the oldest $gov_stagnant_ascendancy$, but we are sure you have figured that out already.

Why are they different? Where do they lead? We have opted not to delve too deeply into those particular mysteries - "thrice bitten, zero-point-seventeen shy" you know how it is - but we are willing to share some recent revelations that just might be related.

For a price.

leviathans.610.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]星系遇到的这种生物不同于[Root.GetName]以往遇见的任何其他生物。

它们具有极强的攻击性与攻击能力，守护着一颗初步扫描发现蕴藏有大量资源的小行星。
leviathans.610.desc.en:
The creature observed in the [From.GetName] system is unlike anything the [Root.GetName] has previously encountered.

Highly aggressive and with destructive capabilities to match, it guards a planetoid that initial scans indicate is exceptionally resource-rich.

leviathans.610.desc.here_be_dragons.zh:
在[From.GetName]星系观察到的生物与我们母星系的天龙粗看具有一些相似度，但进一步的扫描发现他们是截然不同的生物，并且两者的进化过程也彼此不相关。

它具有极强的攻击性与攻击能力，守护着一颗小行星，初步扫描显示其中蕴含着丰富的资源。
leviathans.610.desc.here_be_dragons.en:
The creature observed in the [From.GetName] system bears some initial resemblance to the Sky Dragon of our home system, although further scans demonstrate that it is clearly a different species, and probably even evolved independently to it.

Highly aggressive and with destructive capabilities to match, it guards a planetoid that initial scans indicate is exceptionally resource-rich.

leviathans.649.a.zh: 全体部队进入警戒状态。

leviathans.649.desc.zh:
我们收到了舰队全灭前发出的最后一则信息。其中提到，这个硕大的敌人似乎盯上了舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果这种怪兽记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
leviathans.649.desc.en:
We received one last transmission from our fleet before it was destroyed. It mentions their gigantic foe seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast has our scent, we should be prepared for savage retaliation.

leviathans.649.desc.gesta.zh:
当以太巨龙攻击我们舰船的时候，它似乎可以追踪到我们飞船的超光速特征信号……

如果该生物记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
leviathans.649.desc.gesta.en:
As the Ether Drake was attacking our vessels, it seemed to be homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the creature has our scent, we should prepare for savage retaliation.

leviathans.650.desc.zh:
我们收我们接收到了来自[Root.GetName]的在进行紧急跃迁之前发出的最后的信号。其中指出他们所遇到的巨大的生物能跟踪舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果让那东西记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
leviathans.650.desc.en:
We received one last transmission from the [Root.GetName] before the fleet engaged emergency FTL protocols and went dark. It includes mention of the gargantuan creature they had been fighting seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast has our scent, we should be prepared for savage retaliation.

leviathans.660.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地壳深处，埋藏着一些不完整的化石残骸，似乎是曾居住在[From.GetStarName]星系之中的以太巨龙的近亲。

这位以太巨龙的表亲死后，经过漫长的岁月，其柔软的身体组织已经硬化成石头，其骨骼也变得坚硬无比，形成了矿物一样的内部结构。
leviathans.660.desc.en:
Buried deep in the crust of [From.GetName] are the partial, fossilized remains of what appears to have been a close relative to the Ether Drake that once dwelled in the [From.GetStarName] system.

In the eons since this cousin-Drake's passing, its soft tissues have ossified and its bones indurated, becoming mineral-like in structure.

leviathans.661.a.zh: 如果能培育出一头小以太龙，我们就能得到强大的伙伴……
leviathans.661.a.en: A young Ether Drake would make a formidable ally...

leviathans.661.b.zh: 既然消灭了它，就不要留后患。
leviathans.661.b.en: The last one was killed for a reason.

leviathans.661.desc.zh:
当我们围绕龙之宝藏运行的开采站正在重新定位以对准一条资源极其丰富的矿脉时，传感器侦测到其中仍有些我们尚未发现的东西。

一个完好无损的以太巨龙的蛋被埋在小行星的地表下，周围散落着一些运气相较不那么好的同类的被碾碎的蛋壳。蛋已经从矿坑里挖出来了，但是它未来的命运还悬而未决。
leviathans.661.desc.en:
As our mining station orbiting Dragon's Hoard was repositioning to align with a particularly rich mineral vein, sensors picked up something that had hitherto gone undetected.

An undamaged Ether Drake egg in pristine condition, buried beneath the surface of the planetoid and surrounded by the smashed shells of several less fortunate specimens. The egg has been excavated and removed from the mining site, but its ultimate fate remains undecided.

leviathans.664.a.tooltip.zh: 幼年以太巨龙塞尔加入了[Root.Owner.GetName]的舰队。
leviathans.664.a.tooltip.en: Young Ether Drake Scile joins the fleets of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

leviathans.665.desc.zh:
负责龙蛋的外星生物学家表示，从龙之宝藏小行星回收的以太巨龙的蛋已经过了孵化期限。

孵化以太龙的计划已经没有任何希望了。
leviathans.665.desc.en:
The Ether Drake egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard planetoid has, in the words of the xenobiologist in charge of the ovum, passed its expiry date.

There is no longer any hope of hatching the creature within.

leviathans.665.desc.gesta.zh:
从名为龙之宝藏的小行星回收的以太巨龙的蛋已经无法孵化。

这个种群灭绝了。
leviathans.665.desc.gesta.en:
The Ether Drake egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard planetoid can no longer be considered viable.

The species is extinct.

leviathans.665.desc.machine.zh: 以太巨龙的蛋中止了。生物进程已崩溃，且无可用的错误报告用于调试。
leviathans.665.desc.machine.en: The Ether Drake egg is terminated. Biological processes have crashed, and there are no available error reports for debugging.

leviathans.670.desc.zh:
可怕的以太巨龙已经被击杀。英勇无畏的指挥官[From.From.GetLeaderName]和[From.From.GetName]将流芳百世。

之前那头巨兽千方百计守护的那颗小行星现在可以放心开采了。谁知道它千百亿年以来积累了怎样的宝藏？
leviathans.670.desc.en:
The formidable Ether Drake has been slain. The exceptional bravery of Commander [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the [From.From.GetName] will not soon be forgotten.

The planetoid the beast guarded so jealously can now be safely exploited. Who knows what treasures the creature might have amassed over the eons?

leviathans.670.desc.gesta.zh:
可怕的以太巨龙已被击杀。

之前那头巨兽千方百计守护的那颗小行星现在可以放心开采了。谁知道它千百亿年以来积累了怎样的宝藏？
leviathans.670.desc.gesta.en:
The formidable Ether Drake has been slain.

The planetoid the beast guarded so jealously can now be safely exploited. What treasures might the creature have amassed over the eons?

leviathans.670.desc.noleader.zh:
可怕的以太巨龙已经被击杀。英勇无畏的[From.From.GetName]将流芳百世。

之前那头巨兽千方百计守护的那颗小行星现在可以放心开采了。谁知道它千百亿年以来积累了怎样的宝藏？
leviathans.670.desc.noleader.en:
The formidable Ether Drake has been slain. The exceptional bravery of the [From.From.GetName] will not soon be forgotten.

The planetoid the beast guarded so jealously can now be safely exploited. Who knows what treasures the creature might have amassed over the eons?

leviathans.675.desc.hive.zh:
以太巨龙的躯体似乎坚不可摧。放弃对劫持其中枢神经并从中控制的尝试后，我们被迫用仿生[root.GetIndividualName]逐一替换它的神经。

让我们看看能不能让这具躯壳再发出吼声吧。
leviathans.675.desc.hive.en:
The Ether Drake's biology appeared at first to be impenetrable. Instead of hijacking its central nervous system and assuming control from there, we were forced to replace every one of its nerves with a [root.GetIndividualName] facsimile.

Let's see if we can make the husk roar.

leviathans.675.desc.machine.zh:
据计算以太巨龙尸体的年代远于922337203685477580-

错误：超出注册大小。

由于我们已经用最具实验性的反应堆取代了它的内部结构，进一步的研究将变得更加容易。
leviathans.675.desc.machine.en:
Calculations of the Ether Drake carcass dated it to be older than 922337203685477580-

ERROR: EXCEEDED SIZE OF REGISTRY.

Further study will be more accessible now that we have replaced its internal structure with our most experimental reactors.

leviathans.675.desc.regular.zh: 在忙碌了好一阵子后，我们的死灵法师让以太巨龙再次充满了能量。意识融合的结果颇有些摇晃不稳，但我们觉得这还是很成功的，毕竟这个生物的超高温吐息仍可以正常运转。
leviathans.675.desc.regular.en: After much work, our necromancers have once more filled the Ether Drake with energy. The resulting fusion of consciousness is lurching and unnerving, but we will call this a success as long as the creature's superheated breath still functions.

leviathans.98.desc.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]独立空间站的通讯！他们似乎成功的翻译了我们的语言。
leviathans.98.desc.en: We are receiving a transmission from the independent space station of the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language.

leviathans.999.a.zh: 是什么导致了这种情况？

leviathans.999.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]驶入[From.GetName]恒星系时，发现这里似乎有些不合常理。这里的恒星，曾经被标记为一颗普通的矮星，现在似乎发生了萎缩，其质量正在以惊人的速度减少，恒星系内的行星随之进入了冰河时代。
leviathans.999.desc.en: As the [Root.GetName] enters the [From.GetName] system something seems awry. The sun, previously registered as an ordinary dwarf star, appears to have shrunk, having lost mass at an alarming rate. The planets in the system have as a result recently entered ice ages.

leylines_digsite_desc.zh: 我们曾经以为，这不过是位于[From.Planet.GetName]上的鸡肋矿物层。但现在，这片矿物层却开始发出震耳欲聋的奇怪嗡嗡声。这还不是个例，联邦境内的诸星球上均可以听到类似的声音。这一异常现象背后究竟隐藏着什么？
leylines_digsite_desc.en: What was once thought to be merely a seam of half-interesting minerals on [From.Planet.GetName] has begun emitting a bizarre and deafening hum - and it's not alone. Worlds across federation space are being buffeted by a similar noise. Whatever could be behind these singular phenomena?

leylines_mod_knowing.en: Genius Caeli: A Time of Knowing

life_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
life_asteroid_category_desc.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

life_barren_category_desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]贫瘠的不毛之地下方探测到了生命的迹象。到底是怎样的有机体才有可能生存在那里面呢？
life_barren_category_desc.en: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?

life_frozen_category_desc.zh: 乍看上去，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]似乎不能支持生命的存在，但我们探测到了从冰冻的地表以下发出的生命信号。
life_frozen_category_desc.en: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.

life_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部检测到了生命迹象。这是否表明是有生物圈存在？
life_gasgiant_category_desc.en: Life signs have been detected coming from inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could it indicate the presence of some kind of biosphere?

life_in_darkness_desc.zh: [from.GetName]被潮汐锁定了，有一半永远处于黑夜之中。红外扫描发现这片漆黑贫瘠的区域竟是某种活跃的有机生态系统所在。
life_in_darkness_desc.en: [from.GetName] is tidally locked with one half of the planet existing in a state of permanent darkness. Infrared scans indicate that this lightless and nutrient deficient zone is home to an active organic ecosystem.

life_toxic_category_desc.zh: 尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大气中含有剧毒成分，且气压极高，但仍然能检测到强烈的生命迹象。
life_toxic_category_desc.en: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.

likely_locations_searched.zh: 可能的地点已搜索完毕

lithoids_digsite_desc.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上的矿井的深处，是一处古老外星文明所遗留的痕迹。宏伟的装饰建筑和洞室告诉我们，一个有着丰富文化的文明已经能够巧妙地切割基岩和建设隧道系统，它们被厚实的闸门所保护，通往更加深入的山体之中。

由于山体中富集的，以爆炸性闻名的甲烷气体，继续探索下去会很危险。
lithoids_digsite_desc.en:
In the depths of [From.Planet.GetName]'s mines are traces of an ancient alien civilization. Magnificent ornamental structures and cavernous chambers telling of a rich culture have been cut expertly from the bedrock and a system of paved tunnels, protected by massive gates, leads deeper into the mountain.

Exploring the site will be perilous as the mountain is rich with methane gas, known for its explosive qualities.

littering_loitering_liability.zh: 一个游手好闲并乱丢垃圾的不利因素

living_metal_category_desc.zh: 我们发现了一个巨大的撞击坑，这似乎不是自然形成的。
living_metal_category_desc.en: A large impact crater has been discovered that does not seem to be a natural occurrence.

living_metal_mega_construction_insight.zh: 活体金属巨构工程洞见

living_sea_poi_desc.zh: 为了进一步推进我们对[living_planet_tar.GetName]上活体海洋的研究，这个行星必须纳入我们的版图。
living_sea_poi_desc.en: In order to further our studies of the living sea covering [living_planet_tar.GetName], the planet must be within our borders.

lone_object_swarm_unleashed.zh: 一群墓地守卫向我们冲了过来。他们不知如何跟着我们穿过了裂隙！
lone_object_swarm_unleashed.en: A swarm of Grave Guardians has been unleashed upon us. They have somehow followed us through the rift!

lootbox_contents_a.zh: $lootbox$包含着一副远古图表，写满了早已失传的贸易路线，其中还包括了我们的首都恒星系[Root.Capital.GetStarName]！
lootbox_contents_a.en: The $lootbox$ contains an ancient chart over long-dead trade routes, and it includes our capital system of [Root.Capital.GetStarName]!

lootbox_contents_b.zh:
$lootbox$里存放着一整套的制服。可惜的是，这些衣服的设计对象是某种比[Root.GetName]的物种更多肢体的生物。

不过，这些衣服的质料还是可以循环利用的。
lootbox_contents_b.en:
The $lootbox$ contains a full complement of dress uniforms. Unfortunately they were designed for a species with far more limbs than is common within the [Root.GetName].

The material might still be re-purposed, however.

lootbox_contents_c.zh:
$lootbox$里有炸弹！

别担心，已经拆掉了。
lootbox_contents_c.en:
The $lootbox$ contains a bomb!

It is swiftly defused.

lootbox_contents_d.zh: $lootbox$装着一篇关于爱与万物自然循环的论文。它由[Root.GetAdj]语言写成，而且文风十分现代。
lootbox_contents_d.en: The $lootbox$ contains a treatise on love, and the cyclical nature of all things. It is written in the [Root.GetAdj] language and the style is contemporary.

lootbox_contents_e.zh: $lootbox$里存放着一把未知来历的枪械，其发射扳机明显已被破坏掉。
lootbox_contents_e.en: The $lootbox$ contains a gun of unknown origin, with the apparent trigger assembly removed.

lootbox_contents_f.zh: $lootbox$装着满满的军粮。虽然上面的所有标记都已经磨损殆尽了，但是里面的东西看起来尚且安全，而且适合[Root.GetAdj]的生理结构。
lootbox_contents_f.en: The $lootbox$ contains a shipment of military rations. All markings on the packaging have worn off, but the contents appear safe and compatible with [Root.GetAdj] biology.

lootbox_contents_g.zh:
$lootbox$里面放着音乐，虽然这盒子里并没有任何显而易见的类似播放器的东西。

$lootbox$马上被关上，并且被遗忘在某个角落里面
lootbox_contents_g.en:
The $lootbox$ contains music, without any obvious playback mechanism.

The $lootbox$ is soon closed and forgotten about.

lootbox_contents_h.en: The $lootbox$ is filled with beautiful blue marbles.

lootbox_contents_i.zh:
$lootbox$里面装着数不清的财富，如果你对不在场的人说起的话，没有人会相信这么巨量的财富会真实存在。

不过财务报表上的赤字正宣告着这个事实。
lootbox_contents_i.en:
The $lootbox$ is filled with untold riches. Indeed, no one present at the opening is capable of accurately describing the immense wealth, if they will even acknowledge its existence at all.

But the treasury's balance sheet spells it out clearly enough.

lootbox_contents_j.zh: $lootbox$里面装着几个外星设备，看上去没什么反应，应该是坏了的。
lootbox_contents_j.en: The $lootbox$ holds a handful of alien devices, inert and seemingly broken.

lootbox_contents_k.zh: 虽然是空的，但是这个$lootbox$的内壁上到底都是各种印记。在更深处的地方追踪到了一些生物物质的踪迹。
lootbox_contents_k.en: While empty, the inner walls of the $lootbox$ are pitted and scarred. Traces of biological material can be recovered from the deeper pockets.

lootbox_contents_l.zh: $lootbox$里存放着一个只能以波频的方式存在于空灵界面的生灵。它在被发现后瞬间逃离到更高阶的位面，只在你心里留下深刻的启示与不安。
lootbox_contents_l.en: The $lootbox$ holds a being that exists only as a spectrum of wavelengths in an ethereal medium. It immediately escapes to a higher domain, leaving only profound revelation and paralytic fear in its wake.

lootbox_contents_m.zh: $lootbox$很难打开，感觉里面似乎是有一个小型的重力井阻止它打开似的。
lootbox_contents_m.en: The $lootbox$ is difficult to open, as it is shut tight from within by a gravitational anomaly.

lootbox_contents_n.zh: $lootbox$里面什么都没有。原本用于贮藏的空间被一块平滑的合金占据了，与$lootbox$的内壁无缝地衔接在一起。
lootbox_contents_n.en: The $lootbox$ does not contain anything. Where one would expect hollow space for storage sits instead a smooth block of metal alloy, one interior wall of the $lootbox$ blending seamlessly into another.

lootboxdesc1.zh: 年代久远的$lootbox$被放置在豪华的十字基座上。宝箱里一定存满了各种宝物。
lootboxdesc1.en: The ancient $lootbox$ rests on an opulent pedestal. It must surely be filled with untold riches.

lost_soul_cat_desc.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。我们尚不清楚它的能源，但我们可以从它的记忆体中获取一些信息。
lost_soul_cat_desc.en: We have found a heavily damaged bipedal robot floating in space. We do not understand its energy source, but we may be able to retrieve information from its memory.

machine_age.100.desc.zh:
在整个历史过进程，我们曾误导性地试图改良我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]，却不幸地给众多神圣的承载体带来了无法修复的伤害，导致不同信条对神圣融合的解释产生冲突。

随着科技最终实现了完全强化改造，我们信仰中的神圣领袖——科技显圣师们，已召开了一次主教大会以确立我们教会的核心原则，将各种信条融合成一个统一的教义。
machine_age.100.desc.en:
Throughout history, our misguided attempts to augment our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] have irreparably lacerated numerous divine vessels, leading to conflicting interpretations of the divine fusion among different creeds.

As technology finally enables full augmentation, the holy leaders of our faith, the Technophants, have convened a Conclave. Its purpose is to establish the core principles of our church, merging the individual creeds into a unified dogma.

machine_age.1000.a.zh: 我们必须选择如何支持主教团。
machine_age.1000.a.en: We must choose how to support the Conclave.

machine_age.1000.a.tooltip.zh: 在这个局势中将有多个应对方案可用。
machine_age.1000.a.tooltip.en: More approach options will become available in the situation.

machine_age.1000.desc.zh:
科技显圣主教团的形成曲折艰难，每个最重要的信条都要求在主教团中获得代表权。经过一番深思熟虑，$CYBERCREED_construction$、$CYBERCREED_war$、$CYBERCREED_research$和$CYBERCREED_labor$受邀参加。

主教团现在怀着坚定的信念着手他们神圣的任务。他们的第一道法令要求普通民众增加什一税或履行强制性社区服务。
machine_age.1000.desc.en:
Forming the Conclave of Technophants was arduous, with each of the most important creeds demanding representation in the Conclave. After some deliberation, $CYBERCREED_construction$, $CYBERCREED_war$, $CYBERCREED_research$, and $CYBERCREED_labor$ were all invited.

The Conclave now approaches their divine task with fiery conviction. Their first decree demands increased tithes or mandated community service from the general population.

machine_age.1010.a.zh: 巨锤之使团能铸就一个更为开明的未来。
machine_age.1010.a.en: The Fellowship of the Hammer shall build a brighter future.

machine_age.1010.a.tooltip.en: The dogma will form around the $CYBERCREED_construction$. $machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

machine_age.1010.b.en: The Templars of Steel will protect our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed].

machine_age.1010.b.tooltip.en:
The dogma will form around the creed of $CYBERCREED_war$.
$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

machine_age.1010.c.zh: 思想之诗颂能唱响进步之香颂。
machine_age.1010.c.en: The Choir of the Mind will sing of progress.

machine_age.1010.c.tooltip.en:
The dogma will form around the creed of $CYBERCREED_research$.
$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

machine_age.1010.d.zh: 劳力之结社能赋予我们的工人以意义。
machine_age.1010.d.en: The Commune of Toil will give our workers meaning.

machine_age.1010.d.tooltip.en:
The dogma will form around the creed of $CYBERCREED_labor$.
$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

machine_age.1010.desc.zh:
科技显圣主教团的第二项法令呼吁正式确立信仰。长久以来，各种教派之间的差异在我们社会中造成了摩擦。

主要教派都提出了自己统一信仰的令人信服的理由，而更温和的声音则主张应采纳一条真正开放和包容的道路。
machine_age.1010.desc.en:
The second decree of the Conclave of Technophant is a call to formalize the faith. For too long, the differences between the various creeds have caused friction in our society.

The major creeds all make a compelling case for a unified faith, while more moderate voices argue for a truly open and inclusive path.

machine_age.1010.e.zh: 我们应当终结这些分歧的教条。
machine_age.1010.e.en: We should end these divisive dogmas.

machine_age.1010.e.tooltip.zh:
通过改革将各个教派整合为$pft_cyber_creed_general$，让每个虔诚的承载体都能得到义体改造。
$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$
machine_age.1010.e.tooltip.en:
The creeds shall be reformed into $pft_cyber_creed_general$, allowing every faithful vessel to be modified.
$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

machine_age.1020.a.zh: 必须只有唯一的真信留存。
machine_age.1020.a.en: There can only be one faith.

machine_age.1020.a.tooltip.zh: 科技显圣师会镇压其他信条的信众，这会导致不满。
machine_age.1020.a.tooltip.en: The Technophants will suppress the other creeds, which may lead to unrest.

machine_age.1020.b.zh: 我们的信仰能够海纳百川。
machine_age.1020.b.en: Our faith has room for all.

machine_age.1020.b.tooltip.zh: 尽管我们树立了官方教义，但科技显圣师们对其他教派的习俗保持宽容态度。
machine_age.1020.b.tooltip.en: While there will be official dogma, the Technophants will tolerate the practices of other creeds.

machine_age.1020.desc.nocreed.zh:
各教派的信众正在抗议，声称主教团拒绝了真信。

$machine_age.1020.both$
machine_age.1020.desc.nocreed.en:
The creeds are protesting, claiming that the Conclave has rejected the faith.

$machine_age.1020.both$

machine_age.1020.desc.pickedacreed.zh:
选择[GetCyberCreed]后，其他教派的信众提出抗议。许多人认为主教团的所作所为背叛了“真正”的信仰。

$machine_age.1020.both$
machine_age.1020.desc.pickedacreed.en:
After choosing [GetCyberCreed], the other creeds protested. Many believe the Conclave has turned against the 'true' faith. 

$machine_age.1020.both$

machine_age.1030.a.zh: 必须只有唯一的真信留存。
machine_age.1030.a.en: There will only be one faith.

machine_age.1030.a.tooltip.zh: 选择镇压其他信条的信众会导致不满。
machine_age.1030.a.tooltip.en: The choice to suppress competing creeds has led to some unrest.

machine_age.1030.desc.zh: 各殖民地上都爆发了信仰少数派群体的抗议，许多人指责我们偏离了神圣融合的正道。科技显圣师们则认为，这场动乱只是暂时的，因为我们大多数人仍支持统一的教义；这一切只是时间问题，假以时日更狂热的抗议者也会接受神圣的真理。
machine_age.1030.desc.en: Minority protests have erupted across our colonies, with many decrying what they view as our deviation from holy fusion. The Technophants believe the unrest is only temporary, as most of our people support the unified dogma, and it is simply a matter of time before the more zealous protesters accept the divine truth.

machine_age.1040.a.zh: 我们神圣融合的真义终将胜利。
machine_age.1040.a.en: The truth of our divine fusion prevails.

machine_age.1040.a.tooltip.en: We have successfully unified the faith.

machine_age.1040.desc.zh:
信奉统一教义已经在民众中传开，绝大多数各类教派的信众都抛弃了旧有的信仰和生活方式。

除了真正的狂热分子外，每个人都在为最后的转变准备他们的神圣[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]。
machine_age.1040.desc.en:
Dedication to unified dogma has spread among the people, with most practitioners of the various creeds having disavowed their old ways.

Everyone apart from the true fanatics are preparing their divine [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] for the final transformation.

machine_age.1050.a.zh: 我们是一个不会分裂的信仰。

machine_age.1050.a.tooltip.zh: 对不同教条流派实行宽容态度会阻止不满的滋生。
machine_age.1050.a.tooltip.en: The tolerance granted to the differing creeds has prevented unrest.

machine_age.1050.desc.zh:
允许各种教派的教众自由表达是最和谐的选择：只有少数抗议声出现，只有最狂热的信仰成员尚且参与其中。

大多数信徒遵循我们的官方教义，我们准备集中精力于神圣的融合。
machine_age.1050.desc.en:
Allowing the various creeds freedom of expression was a most harmonious choice: only minor protests have been noted, with only the most zealous members of the creeds participating.

With the majority of the faithful following our official dogma, we are ready to focus on the divine fusion.

machine_age.1060.a.tooltip.zh: 宽容其他教派已经使我们信仰中的温和派系不满，引起不满。
machine_age.1060.a.tooltip.en: The tolerance granted to the creeds has upset the more moderate factions of our faith, causing unrest.

machine_age.1060.desc.zh:
迁就极端主义的要求已经惹恼了大多数温和派。许多人认为，每个信条教派都有长期的宗教间暴力历史，让边缘信仰不受反对是错误的选择。

大多数人呼吁正式改革各信仰，实质性地消除它们原本应享有的所有独立性。
machine_age.1060.desc.en:
Giving in to hardline demands has upset the majority of moderates. Claiming every creed has a long history of interfaith violence, many believe that allowing fringe beliefs to go unopposed was the wrong choice.

The majority are calling for the creeds to be officially reformed, effectively removing any independence they would otherwise have.

machine_age.1070.d.tooltip.en: $machine_age.1070.intro$ to constructing buildings and working in shipyards.

machine_age.1070.desc.zh:
随着盛大的融合临近，我们回顾信仰中悠久的传统：时间的什一奉献。

回顾过往无数代先祖，社会中每位忠诚的成员都奉献出他们的一部分时间和精力给教会。就如神圣的融合一样，这种奉献有助于强化信仰的身体。

这些信徒应该如何最好地支持神圣强化改造呢？
machine_age.1070.desc.en:
As the grand fusion draws near, we look back to a long-standing tradition of the faith: The Tithe of Time.

For countless generations, every faithful member of society has given a portion of their time and energy to the church. Like divine fusion, this service act helps strengthen the body of the faith.

How shall the faithful best support the divine augmentation?

machine_age.1070.h.tooltip.en: $machine_age.1070.intro$ to researching the secrets of the universe.

machine_age.1075.a.tooltip.zh:
信徒们的全面义体强化改造已经开始。主教团的其他一切行动将暂停，直到神圣的融合完成。

行动要求：
建造一座$building_augmentation_center$以让$situation_cybernetic_creed_cyberization$局势继续进行。
machine_age.1075.a.tooltip.en:
Full cybernetic augmentation has begun for the faithful. All other actions of the Conclave will halt until the divine fusion is complete.

Action required:
Build an $building_augmentation_center$ to resume the $situation_cybernetic_creed_cyberization$ situation.

machine_age.1075.desc.zh:
神圣融合之时终于到来了。

我们应在自己的星球上建立神圣的$building_augmentation_center$，以开始这一进程。
machine_age.1075.desc.en:
The time for the divine fusion is finally upon us.

It is time for us to construct holy $building_augmentation_center$s on our worlds, and the process can begin.

machine_age.1090.construction.zh:
$machine_age.1090.desc$$CYBERCREED_construction$要求我们的躯体成为神圣的工具。

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

$machine_age.1090.pray$

machine_age.1100.a.zh: 我们的信仰如同我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]一般融合紧密。
machine_age.1100.a.en: Our faith is as unified as our fused [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed].

machine_age.1100.desc.zh:
今日，我们以完全融合的姿态崛起，融合的不仅仅是身体和灵魂，还有我们的信仰。教条式信条不再统治；神圣的融合将是所有信徒个人的旅程。

machine_age.1100.desc.en:
Today, we arise fully fused, not just in our bodies and souls but also in our faith. Dogmatic creeds no longer hold sway; divine fusion shall be a personal journey for all the faithful.

machine_age.2150.desc.zh:
奉向往繁星之圣灵的引导，我们信仰中许多不同的信条现在将对新的政府造成影响。

每个教派对信徒都有相当大的影响力，提倡将其成员提升到有影响力的位置，以满足他们独特的精神需求。

这些不同的压力是会让我们更接近神圣，还是会让我们陷入混乱，只有时间能告诉我们答案。
machine_age.2150.desc.en:
Guided by the divine towards the stars, various creeds within our faith now anticipate influence over the new government.

Each wields considerable sway over the faithful, advocating for the elevation of their members to influential positions and fulfilling their distinct spiritual needs.

Only time will reveal if these diverse pressures will bring us closer to the divine or plunge us into chaos.

machine_age.2205.a.zh: 想要获得胜利，我们必须有胜利者的思维。
machine_age.2205.a.en: To be victorious, we must think as victors.

machine_age.2205.b.zh: 不接受。我们必须从失误中学习。
machine_age.2205.b.en: Unacceptable. We must learn from our mistakes.

machine_age.2205.desc.zh:
钢铁之圣卫最近发起了一项禁止在历史和宗教记录中出现任何军事败绩的运动。

该教派声称，这些谬论打击军人士气、削弱公众支持。我们的历史学家驳斥了这种观点，并提醒我们，那些不学习历史的人注定要重蹈覆辙。

我们应该接受他们对历史更为积极的看法吗?
machine_age.2205.desc.en:
The Templars of Steel has recently begun a campaign to ban any examples of military defeats in our historical and faithful records.

The creed claims this information demoralizes those in military service and weakens public support. Our historians dismiss this notion and remind us that those who don't learn history are doomed to repeat it.

Should we accept their more positive view of our past?

machine_age.2210.b.zh: 这不值得惹其他教派不高兴。
machine_age.2210.b.en: It is not worth upsetting the other creeds.

machine_age.2210.desc.zh:
最高主匠，也就是巨锤之使团的领导人，猝然离世。

尽管他们以直言不讳的行为和坚决的观点而闻名，但还是有一群信徒追随。使团要求为他们举行正式的国葬，而这通常是为我们最敬爱的领导人准备的。

不出所料，其他教派要求国家不应该参与这位讲话不知分寸的精神领袖的葬礼。

我们应该如何处理这个教派的请求?
machine_age.2210.desc.en:
The High Blacksmith, the head of the Fellowship of the Hammer, has died suddenly.

Despite being known for their outspoken behavior and decisive views, they had a cult following by members of the Creed. The Fellowship has requested for them to receive an official state funeral, an honor usually reserved for our most beloved leaders.

Unsurprisingly, the other Creeds demand that the state should have no part in the burial of this outspoken spiritual leader.

How should we address the demands of the Creeds?

machine_age.2215.a.en: We must not fear the truth.

machine_age.2215.b.zh: 深埋于此必有其因，当它不存在吧。
machine_age.2215.b.en: This was buried for a reason, ignore it.

machine_age.2215.desc.zh:
最近，有一支考古团队发现了一个古老的宗教遗址。它的存在仿佛是一个神话，迫使我们修改了宗教历史记录的一些部分。

最令人惊讶的事实是，许多出土的历史文物都带有劳力之结社的图样。这一信息证明，劳力之结社才是我们信仰的最初形式，而这是我们信仰中一个饱受争议的话题。

对这一发现的官方认可将取悦于劳力之结社，但选择性沉默则可以让其他的教派满意。
machine_age.2215.desc.en:
Recently, an archeological team discovered an ancient religious site. Its existence was considered a myth and has already forced us to revise some of our faith's historical records.

The most surprising fact is that many of the uncovered historical artifacts have clear Commune of Toil iconography. This information would prove that the Commune is the original interpretation of our religion, a heavily debated topic of our faith.

Officially acknowledging this revelation would please the Commune of Toil, but strategic silence would please the other creeds.

machine_age.2221.b.zh: [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetSheHe]作出的杰出贡献已经将功赎罪了。
machine_age.2221.b.en: The good [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetSheHe] [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetHasHave] done outweighs this transgression.

machine_age.2221.desc.zh:
我们发现[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]与[GetCyberCreed]有很深的联系，并且涉嫌挪用资金并将项目重新分配到该教派的势力范围中。

当前政府能做出如此明目张胆的滥用职权，其他的教派对此勃然大怒，并要求[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]立刻下台。

我们应该如何处置这位任性的领袖？
machine_age.2221.desc.en:
We have uncovered that [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName] has deep ties to [GetCyberCreed] and has both embezzled funds and reassigned projects towards the creed's sphere of influence.

The other creeds are furious that such a blatant abuse of power has happened on the current administration's watch and are demanding [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName] be removed from power immediately.

What should we do with this wayward leader?

machine_age.2225.a.en: Disallow the pilgrimage once and for all.

machine_age.2225.b.en: Freedom of religion is a right.

machine_age.2225.desc.zh:
巨锤之使团的禧年朝圣即将开始，无数的朝圣者将从他们当地的锻造厂出发，前往首都的$building_forge_of_the_fellowship$。

以往，这一盛事会造成无数的后勤问题，还经常因为使团与其他教派的信徒发生暴力冲突而告终。

其他教派和首都的居民都呼吁彻底禁止这种活动。
machine_age.2225.desc.en:
The jubilee pilgrimage of the Fellowship of the Hammer is about to begin, and countless practitioners will journey from their local forges to the $building_forge_of_the_fellowship$ in the capital.

Traditionally, this event has caused countless logistical issues and often ends in outbursts of violence as the Fellowship eventually clashes with practitioners of the other creeds.

There have been calls to end this practice from the other creeds and those living in the capital.

machine_age.2230.a.zh: 让大诗颂师自娱自乐去吧，一会就自己没声了。
machine_age.2230.a.en: Let the Choirmaster sing until they lose their voice.

machine_age.2230.b.zh: 适度增加资金，直到这场风波过去。
machine_age.2230.b.en: Moderately improve funding until this blows over.

machine_age.2230.c.zh: 我们会大幅改善资金投入。

machine_age.2230.desc.zh:
最近，思想之诗颂教团的领袖，大诗颂师，公开表达了对我们教会在研究资金方面缺乏投入的担忧。

人们认为这是该教团成员为争取更多资金而采取的一种策略。如果答应他们的要求，可能会被视为我们给予思想之诗颂特殊优待。

我们是否应改善科研资金的投入?
machine_age.2230.desc.en:
Recently, the Choir of the Mind's leader, the Grand Choirmaster, has been publicly outspoken about our faithful's lack of focus on research funding.

It is assumed this is a ploy to ensure more funding is going to members of their creed. Giving in to the demands could be viewed as us giving the Choir of the Mind preferential treatment.

Should we improve scientific funding?

machine_age.3100.desc.zh:
在缺乏医疗解决方案的情况下，我们有可能生还的方案便是将人口数字化存储在人格仓库中。然而，这只是一个权宜之计，后续计划已经敲定，即开发合成身体和足够复杂的正电子大脑。预计我们将有足够的时间集中精力完成这项研究。

我们最优秀的专家已经利用尖端的人工智能绘制了机器身体的蓝图，这是我们合成救赎的第一步。
machine_age.3100.desc.en:
Lacking a medical solution, our best chance for survival lies in digitizing our population within the Identity Repository. However, this is a stopgap solution, and a plan is already in place to develop synthetic bodies and a positronic brain of sufficient complexity. We estimate that we have enough time to complete the research with a focused effort.

Using cutting-edge AI, our best experts have already drawn up the blueprints for robotic bodies, the first step to our synthetic salvation.

machine_age.3110.desc.zh:
我们对机器人体的研究已经完成。我们将$building_abandoned_gene_clinic$设施改造为$building_robot_assembly_plant$，并且已经升级并部署了原型机。尽管这些初级系统缺乏容纳个人意识的处理能力，但它们可以替代我们部分失去的劳动力。通过正电子链路，数字领域中的人可以将知识和经验添加到这些机器人的日常操作中，从而提高它们的性能。

同时，我们的人工智能系统已经设计出先进的智能人。我们日渐年迈的工程师们已经准备好开始工作了。
machine_age.3110.desc.en:
Our research into robotic bodies is complete. We have converted the $building_abandoned_gene_clinic$ facility into $building_robot_assembly_plant$, and the prototypes have been upgraded and deployed. While these rudimentary systems lack the processing power to house an individual consciousness, they can replace some of our lost workforce. Through positronic uplink, those in the digital realm can add their knowledge and experience to the daily operation of these robots, improving their performance.

At the same time, our AI systems have developed a design for advanced androids. Our aging engineers stand ready to get to work.

machine_age.3115.a.en: We must not give up now.

machine_age.3115.desc.zh:
这项对我们机器人技术的重大升级意味着，我们现在可以殖民其他行星、我们的机器人人口也可以支持更复杂的任务了。

我们的人工智能系统认为，下一步合理的举动将是在合成身体中模拟它们的正电子矩阵。这个重大的研究项目应该允许我们将数字化的意识返回到自然世界。
machine_age.3115.desc.en:
This significant upgrade to our robotic technology means it is now possible to colonize other planets and for our mechanized population to support more complex tasks.

Our AI systems believe the next logical step would be to mimic their positronic matrixes in synthetic bodies. This significant research project should allow us to return a digitized consciousness to the natural world.

machine_age.3120.a.zh: 是时候让我们合成觉醒了。
machine_age.3120.a.en: Its time for our Synthetic awakening.

machine_age.3120.a.tooltip.zh: 这些事件必须采纳合成传统才能进展。
machine_age.3120.a.tooltip.en: To progress with these events we must embrace the Synthetic Tradition.

machine_age.3120.desc.zh:
通过不懈的努力，我们终于取得了成功。我们设计出了功能齐全的正电子大脑，其复杂程度足以容纳我们的人格。

虽然我们无法战胜死亡，但我们很快就不再受生物存在的限制约束。
machine_age.3120.desc.en:
After relentless work, we have finally achieved success. A fully functional positronic brain has been designed, one sophisticated enough to contain our identities.

While we cannot overcome mortality, we will soon no longer be bound by the limitations of a biological existence.

machine_age.3125.desc.zh:
$machine_age.3125.both$

我们将开始将重点放在那些仍然生活在物质世界的人们身上，旨在一劳永逸地根除这种遗传疾病。随着合成大脑处理能力的提升，我们甚至能够挣脱肉体的束缚。$synth.105.end$
machine_age.3125.desc.en:
$machine_age.3125.both$

We will initiate our efforts by focusing on those still residing in the physical world, aiming to eradicate the genetic disease once and for all. With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can even surpass our biological constraints.$synth.105.end$

machine_age.3125.nobody.desc.zh:
$machine_age.3125.both$

由于在星球上失去了物理存在，我们必须快速建造我们第一具原型躯体。随着合成大脑处理能力的提升，我们甚至能够挣脱肉体的束缚。$synth.105.end$
machine_age.3125.nobody.desc.en:
$machine_age.3125.both$

Without a physical presence in the world, we must rapidly construct our first prototype body. With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can even surpass our biological constraints.$synth.105.end$

machine_age.3200.desc.zh:
我们最担心的事情发生了。

我们最后的肉体已经败给了遗传性疾病。虽然我们的数字化意识仍然安全地存储在身份存储库中，但我们缺乏将自己的思想放入人工大脑的技术。

在我们完成研究之前，我们的数字领导人只能通过机器代理与自然世界进行互动。
machine_age.3200.desc.en:
Our worst fears have come to pass.

The last of our physical bodies has expired. While our digitized consciousnesses remain safely stored in the Identity Repository, we lack the technology to place our minds in an artificial brain.

Until we have completed our research, our digital leaders will have to interact with the natural world via robotic proxies.

machine_age.3305.a.zh: 就让他们在乐园中享福吧。

machine_age.3305.a.tooltip.zh: 剩下的数字人格身份将会留在$building_identity_repository$，继续从内部提供支持。
machine_age.3305.a.tooltip.en: The remaining digital identities will stay in the $building_identity_repository$ and continue to support our people from within.

machine_age.3305.b.zh: 团结在一起我们才能更强大。
machine_age.3305.b.en: We are stronger if we stay together.

machine_age.3305.b.tooltip.zh: 我们将余下的数字人格身份植入当前库存的合成人体内，同时为其余人建造新的机架。$building_identity_repository$将被销毁。
machine_age.3305.b.tooltip.en: We will place the remaining digital identities into our current stock of synthetic bodies and build new frames for the rest. The $building_identity_repository$ will be destroyed.

machine_age.3305.desc.zh:
我们成功将所有人格身份迁移到新的合成框架或人格仓库中，确保了人民的存续。

然而，我们遇到了一个新的挑战。我们创造的用于存储数字身份的数字“空间”本应是权宜之计，但居民们已经习惯于这种生存状态，不愿意返回物理世界。

我们可以允许他们继续留在数字世界中，但强制他们进入新的合成身体也是一种可行的选项。
machine_age.3305.desc.en:
We have successfully relocated every identity into either a new synthetic frame or the Identity Repository, ensuring the continuation of our people.

However, a new challenge has emerged. The digital 'space' we created to store our digital identities was always meant to be temporary, but the inhabitants have grown accustomed to this existence and are reluctant to return to the physical world.

We could allow them to remain there, but the option to compel them into new synthetic bodies is also an alternative.

machine_age.3310.a.zh: 我们把人格混合起来吧。

machine_age.3310.b.zh: 大自然还是有可取之处的。

machine_age.3310.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]已经有几十年都没有拥抱过新生儿了。尽管我们可能再也无法体会那种感觉，但今天我们的人民迎来了希望的回归。

我们研发出了人格复合体，这是一种先进的研究中心，我们可以复制现有的人格，从而实质上创造新造的人。

我们可以从多个个体中随机选择个性点，通过无数组合创造新的人格身份。或者，我们还可以效仿自然的过程，在一个开放的虚拟环境中培养“心灵内核”。
machine_age.3310.desc.en:
It has been decades since a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] held a newborn child in their arms. While we may never know that feeling again, today marks the return of hope for our people.

We've developed Identity Complexes, advanced centers where we can copy existing identities to essentially create new people.

We could randomize personality points from multiple individuals, creating new identities through countless combinations. Alternatively, we might mimic nature's process by nurturing 'mind kernels' in an open virtual setting.

machine_age.3315.desc.zh:
今天标志着我们的数字化旅程的终点。没有人能否认已经完成的伟大事业，及其实现所必需的牺牲。

我们现在以一个全面数字化和合成人民族出现。我们不再会屈从于疾病的恐怖。我们也不再会被脆弱的遗传限制。

我们现在可以自由地创造任何我们认为合适的现实。
machine_age.3315.desc.en:
Today marks the end of our digital journey. No one can deny the magnitude of what has been done, nor the sacrifice necessary to achieve it.

We now stand ascended as a fully digitized and synthetic people. No longer shall we yield to the horrors of disease. No more shall the limitations of feeble genetics confine us.

We are free to create any reality we see fit.

machine_age.3400.desc.zh:
即使是从远处观测，[From.GetName]也看起来是理想的候选地。既然我们已经完成对这个恒星系的调查，结果毫无疑问：一个熔融星球和一个气态巨行星，大量的小行星和卫星——这是建立另一个电弧熔炉的理想位置。

下一步必然是命令一艘工程船开始建造工作。是时候点燃熔炉了。
machine_age.3400.desc.en:
Even from a distance, [From.GetName] seemed like an ideal candidate. Now that our survey of the system is complete, there is no longer any doubt: a molten world and a gas giant, an abundance of asteroids and moons - this is the ideal location for another Arc Furnace.

Ordering a construction ship to begin the work is the next logical step. It is time to light the forge.

machine_age.3405.desc.zh:
在我们母星系的电弧熔炉是绝佳的技术验证，也是我们壮志雄心和聪明才智的见证。如今，在[from.GetName]星系中，第二座熔炉正在虚空中熊熊燃烧。

我们的这项工程不仅仅产出了资源，更是打开了一扇建造巨型工程的大门。我们现在如居高崖，广阔的地平线在我们视野中徐徐展开，让我们看到了更远。

唯一的限制就是我们自己的想象力了。
machine_age.3405.desc.en:
The Arc Furnace in our home system was an excellent proof of concept, a testament to our ambition and ingenuity. Now, in the [from.GetName] system, another Furnace burns against the void.

Far more than the resources this will provide, our work here has opened the door to projects of titanic size and scale. We can perceive further now, as if standing on the precipice of a vast horizon.

The only limit is our own imagination.

machine_age.4005.a.virtuality.zh: 我们将在代码中寻得纯洁。
machine_age.4005.a.virtuality.en: We shall find purity in the Code.

machine_age.4005.desc.modularity.zh:
$machine_age.4005.desc.start$变为更具适应力的模组框架。

$machine_age.4005.desc.end$

machine_age.4100.desc.zh:
尽管机器形体具有优势，但我们的进步充其量只是迭代罢了。强加于自身的安全标准让发展陷入停止。这是不能再接受的。

小规模实验验证了三种截然不同的发展选项：纳米科技具有灵活可变的优势；模组化则可以让每个单元都优化到出更特化的功能；虚拟化则会完全抛弃物理形式转变为数字化存在。

演化进程开始了。分析选项，慎重选择。
machine_age.4100.desc.en:
Despite the superiority of the machine form, our advancement has remained iterative at best. Self-imposed safety standards have resulted in stagnation. Conclusion: more drastic measures required.

Small-scale experiments suggest three distinct options for growth: Nanotechnology and its variable form-shifting advantages; Modularity for individual units optimized with specific characteristics; and Virtuality - the abandonment of the physical form in favor of a digital existence.

Evaluation process initialized. Analyze options and deliberate.

machine_age.4110.a.en: This will be our top priority.

machine_age.4110.desc.zh:
初步研究表明，一种被称为纳米机器人的电动结构具有成为我们先进载体的潜质。它们虽然罕见，但是具有各种独特的性质，包括可编程性、自我复制、以及形成“虫群智能”的能力。

这项科技可以提供无与伦比的嬗变能力，但其所需的条件仍不明确。

潜力：显著；可缩放。花费：未知。需要进一步研究。
machine_age.4110.desc.en:
Preliminary research suggests electromechanical constructs called nanites present a promising vector for advancement. While rare, they possess unique qualities, including programmability, self-replication, and the ability to form a 'swarm intellect.'

This technology offers unmatched transformational capabilities, but the requirements to support it remain unclear.

Potential: significant; scalable. Cost: unknown. Additional research required.

machine_age.4130.a.tt.zh:
$situation_transformation$局势修正移除：
研究速度（£engineering£工程学）
machine_age.4130.a.tt.en:
$situation_transformation$ situation modifier removed:
Research Speed (£engineering£ Engineering)

machine_age.4130.desc.zh:
研究揭示了纳米科技的有趣应用。它们重新配置和组合的能力为独立子个体组成大型形体方面的灵活性方面带来了前所未有的可能。同样的技术可以产生纳米物质乃至进行进一步转化。

然而，这个过程需要时间、材料和能量来重新配置。为了支持其部署，全国范围的变革是必要的。

可行性：高；既有的纳米生命形式支持这一评估。
machine_age.4130.desc.en:
Research has revealed intriguing applications for nanotechnology. Their ability to reconfigure and combine opens up unprecedented versatility in creating megaforms comprised of individual drones. The same technology can generate nano matter or further convert it.

However, the process requires time, materials, and energy to be reconfigured. Empire-wide changes are necessary to support deployment.

Viability: high; pre-existing nanite lifeforms support the estimation.

machine_age.4140.a.tt.zh:
$situation_transformation$局势修正移除：
研究速度（£engineering£工程学）
machine_age.4140.a.tt.en:
$situation_transformation$ situation modifier removed:

machine_age.4140.desc.zh:
我们对纳米机器人的研究完成了。尽管它们的潜力仍不完全明确，但是模拟计算已经得到了很正面的预测。其能力在创造特化的大型形体以及物质变形方面具有不可估量的价值。

估算预测这个过程需要时间、材料和能量，需要大量的结构调整来支持。

可行性：具有前景；变革性。
machine_age.4140.desc.en:
Our research on nanites has concluded. The full extent of their potential remains unclear, but simulations have returned optimistic projections. Their capabilities could prove invaluable in creating specialized megaforms and matter transmutation.

Estimations indicate that the process requires time, materials, and energy to operate in addition to significant structural changes.

Viability: promising; transformative.

machine_age.4150.a.tt.zh:
$situation_transformation$局势修正移除：

machine_age.4150.a.tt.en:

machine_age.4150.desc.zh:
由于目标物质的复杂性，加之投入的科研力量不足，我们对纳米科技的了解仍非常粗浅。有限的预期表明纳米复制和重塑能力可以形成大规模结构。为了支援该项目很可以需要额外的资源。

可行性：不确定。
machine_age.4150.desc.en:
Due to the complexity of the subject matter combined with minimal research effort, our knowledge of nanite technology remains rudimentary. The limited projections include nano-replication and reconfiguration as enablers for large-scale structures. Additional resources are likely required to support such projects.

Viability: inconclusive.

machine_age.4210.desc.zh:
有机生命形式脆弱又僵硬，而机械形体相比而言就有着优越的适应力。然而，也有些有益的有机特质可以用来创造机械的复制版。

有一种被称为活体金属的物质具有能极端迅速调整外形和形体连续性的能力。将它与我们现有的躯体结合可以形成一种模组化仿生形体，其外延性质和躯干可以为特定的任务进行特化。

潜力：显著，可缩放。花费：未知。需要额外数据。
machine_age.4210.desc.en:
Biological lifeforms are fragile and rigid compared to the superior adaptability of the machine form. However, some beneficial organic characteristics could be replicated with robotic variants.

The substance Living Metal has the capacity to radically and rapidly alter its shape and physical consistency. Integrating this with our existing chassis could enable a form of modular bio-mimicry, where extrusions and limbs can be specialized for specific tasks.

Potential: significant; scalable. Cost: unknown. Additional data required.

machine_age.4230.a.tt.zh:
$situation_transformation$局势修正移除：

machine_age.4230.a.tt.en:
$situation_transformation$ situation modifier removed:

machine_age.4230.desc.zh:
孜孜不倦的研究验证了初步结论：活体金属与机械躯体的融合是可行的，这让我们的单元能在不影响内部功能的情况下改变特性。这确保了对不同任务的最大兼容性。

经预计，大规模部署模组化功能注入将提高所有部门的资源产量。

可行性：可适应；具有前景。
machine_age.4230.desc.en:
Uncompromising research has confirmed the preliminary assessment: Living Metal is viable when fused with mechanical bodies, allowing our units to alter their characteristics without compromising internal functions. This ensures maximum task-based compatibility.

Large-scale deployment of the infused modular functions is projected to increase resource yields across all sectors.

Viability: adaptable; promising.

machine_age.4240.a.tt.zh:
$situation_transformation$局势修正移除：
研究速度（£society£社会学）
machine_age.4240.a.tt.en:
$situation_transformation$ situation modifier removed:
