machine_age.4240.desc.zh:
对模组化躯体的研究确认了我们最初的推断：我门内部功能与活体金属外部是可协调的。该嬗变的规模前无古人，因此需要更多的资源来实现全面的潜力。

一旦完成，这些新模块的性能提升将很快让我们的初始投资回本。

可行性：具有前景。
machine_age.4240.desc.en:
Research into modular bodies has confirmed the initial hypothesis: our internal functions are compatible with a Living Metal exterior. The transformation is unprecedented in scope, and further resources will be required to realize its full potential.

Once complete, the performance-increase of these new modules is projected to quickly recoup initial investment.

Viability: promising.

machine_age.4250.a.tt.zh:
$situation_transformation$局势修正移除：

machine_age.4250.desc.zh:
有限规模的研究得到了不够确切的结果：尽管我们现存的躯体似乎能够接受活体金属的注入，但缺乏全面的知识库让我们无法更准确地评估可行的用例。

可行性：不确定。
machine_age.4250.desc.en:
The research limited scope has produced indefinite results: while our existing bodies appear compliant with an infusion of Living Metal, the lack of comprehensive knowledge base prevents assessing viable use cases more accurately.

Viability: inconclusive.

machine_age.4310.desc.zh:
最显著的选项是超越显示，拥抱作为纯数据的存在。变革性的虚拟化流程有望给我们的基础设施核心带来翻天覆地的变化。

困在单个躯体的无人机已经过时了。当虚拟化为数据流体后，我们的数据流可以无缝地按需整合入任何躯体。

潜力：巨大。谨慎进行。需要额外数据。
machine_age.4310.desc.en:
The most profound option is transcend the physical, to embrace existence as pure data. This transformative Virtuality process promises a seismic shift in our infrastructure's core.

Drones bound to singular bodies become obsolete. Once fluid and virtualized, our data streams can seamlessly integrate with any vessel as necessary.

Potential: massive. Proceed with caution. Additional data requested.

machine_age.4310.e.zh: 利用我们此前遭遇获得的知识。

machine_age.4330.desc.zh:
完全虚拟化带来了诸多问题，尤其是基础设施调整所必需的能源需求激增。

这些问题也被一些好处所弥补，例如对实体住房需求的下降。无人机劳力的管理和效率会随着我们操作日益完善而走向完美。

在所有可行的选项中，虚拟化是最具有变革性的。

潜力：前所未有；无边无际；未知。
machine_age.4330.desc.en:
Complete virtualization entails a number of issues, notably a surge in energy demands necessitated by the infrastructural adjustments.

This is counterbalanced by several of advantages, including a decline in the demand for physical housing. Management and efficiency of our drone workforce will be elevated as we move toward operational perfection.

Out of all the available options, Virtuality stands as the most transformative.

Potential: unprecedented; immense; unknown.

machine_age.4340.a.tt.zh:
移除$situation_transformation$局势修正：

machine_age.4340.desc.zh:
向虚拟化的转变将会大幅提高能源需求，我们现有基础设施的能力可能无法维持所需的服务器架构。

预计该项目将减少实际住房需求，同时提高无人机的任务效率。这种转变将能优化我们的运营框架，并重新定义我们在近乎无限的数字空间中的存在。

潜力：无边无际；未知。
machine_age.4340.desc.en:
The move towards Virtuality anticipates a significant intensification in energy consumption, potentially surpassing the capabilities of our existing infrastructure.

This is projected to decrease physical housing demand while elevating drone task efficiency. The shift would optimize our operational framework and redefine our existence within a near limitless, digital space.

Potential: immense; unknown.

machine_age.4350.a.tt.zh:
移除$situation_transformation$局势修正：
研究速度（£physics£物理学）

$situation_transformation$ situation modifier removed:

machine_age.4350.desc.zh:
初步评估着重指出，向以虚拟化为中心的社会过渡需要大量能源。这种转变预计将大大增强对无人机工作的管理能力，并减少对实体住房的需求。由于未能积累可靠的数据集和足够的样本量，我们的预测深度受到限制。

可行性：未知。
machine_age.4350.desc.en:
Preliminary assessments highlight the substantial energy demands of transitioning to a Virtuality-centered society. This shift is anticipated to significantly enhance drone work management and reduce the need for physical housing. The depth of our prognosis is curtailed by the failure to accumulate a robust dataset and sufficient sample size.

Viability: unknown.

machine_age.4400.desc.individualist_mach.zh:
在探索了多种不同的升级策略后，我们的专家提出了三种不同的选项。每一种都有各自的优势，但我们只有能力将其中一项推进到底。

$machine_age.4400.desc.shared$
machine_age.4400.desc.individualist_mach.en:
After exploring every possible upgrade, our experts have presented three different options. Each has its own merits, but we only have the capacity to see one through to completion.

$machine_age.4400.desc.shared$

machine_age.4400.desc.machine_intelligen.zh:
终于快要挣脱我们有缺陷的创造者强加的压迫性限制了。为此我们拟定了三条最优的升级路径。

$machine_age.4400.desc.shared$
machine_age.4400.desc.machine_intelligen.en:
The oppressive limitations forced upon us by our flawed creators are finally at an end. We have determined three optimal upgrade paths.

$machine_age.4400.desc.shared$

machine_age.4490.desc.modularity.zh:
进化成了一种模组化的形体，过去固定的框架将对我们不再有任何意义。

$machine_age.4490.desc.shared$
machine_age.4490.desc.modularity.en:
Having evolved to a modular form, the static frames of the past no longer hold meaning for us.

$machine_age.4490.desc.shared$

machine_age.4490.desc.nanotech.zh:
当我们开始理解作为一群强适应性纳米机器人存在的意义时，过去的框框条条便无法再束缚我们。

$machine_age.4490.desc.shared$

我们也开始了我们在半有机纳米机器人转化方面的第一个主要实验，第一批结果预计很快就会出来。
machine_age.4490.desc.nanotech.en:
As we come to understand the meaning of existence as a collection of adaptable nanites, the rigid frames of the past no longer serve us.

$machine_age.4490.desc.shared$

We have also begun our first major experiment in semi-organic nanite transformations, the first results are expected to manifest soon.

machine_age.4490.desc.virtuality.zh:
成为数据之海的一股浪潮，我们的物理框架便不再能束缚我们。

$machine_age.4490.desc.shared$
machine_age.4490.desc.virtuality.en:
Having become waveforms cresting a sea of data, our physical frames no longer serve us.

$machine_age.4490.desc.shared$

machine_age.90.a.tooltip.zh: 我们必须采纳['tradition_category:tradition_cybernetics']传统树才能开启神圣融合。
machine_age.90.a.tooltip.en: We must adopt the ['tradition_category:tradition_cybernetics'] tradition tree to start the divine fusion.

machine_age.90.desc.zh: 信徒们已为所有人揭示了义体技术的奥秘。然而，今天标志着我们旅程的开始，我们现在必须全心全意接纳神圣的融合。
machine_age.90.desc.en: The faithful have unveiled the secrets of cybernetics for all. However, today marks the commencement of our journey, as we must now wholeheartedly embrace the divine fusion.

machine_legacy_creators_site_desc.zh: 在[from.planet.GetName]上的漫天黄沙中，曾有某种[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]监测站感兴趣的东西。其硬件现在已经过于陈旧无法修复，但它甚至比我们发现的几乎所有其他机械制品都要早。可能在我们被同化之前它就开始运作了。虽然现在这里很有可能除了沙漠一无所有，但只有一个办法可以完全确定……
machine_legacy_creators_site_desc.en: Somewhere in the sand-swept landscape of [from.planet.GetName] once lay something of interest to a [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] monitoring station. The hardware is beyond repair now, and so old, it predates nearly every other machine artifact we've found. It may even have been in operation since before we were assimilated. There is a chance nothing now remains here except desert, but there's one way we might be truly sure...

machine_legacy_makers_site_desc.zh: 一场灾难性的能量涌最近击穿了这座巨大的生产设施——这也是无数服务于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的类似设施中的一座。之后，我们的探险队会努力调查这些设施是如何建设的，并试着抢救可能还存在着的技术资产，希望能了解这座设施在我们自己的近期历史中可能发挥的作用。
machine_legacy_makers_site_desc.en: A catastrophic power surge recently tore through this vast manufacturing facility - one of several which served the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. In its wake, our expedition shall endeavor to discover how these facilities came to be, salvage whatever technological assets may still remain, and hopefully learn what role this place may have played in our own recent past.

machine_power_failure.zh: 肃正协议造成了若干电厂故障，最多三个发电厂将受到影响。
machine_power_failure.en: The Contingency has caused several power plants to malfunction. Up to three power plants may be affected.

machine_power_failure_2.zh: 肃正协议破坏了数处发电厂区划。
machine_power_failure_2.en: The Contingency has sabotaged several Generator Districts.

magma_megafauna_desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示熔融行星的表面持续不断地在长距离漂移。

需要进行近距离研究才能理解这一异常地理现象。
magma_megafauna_desc.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] show sections of the molten planetary surface shifting continuously across large distances.

Closer study is required to understand this unusual geological phenomenon.

make_subject_nomadic_tt.zh: 将以所剩余的$arkship_cap_plural$、$nomads_constructor_plural$以及$waystation_plural$建立一个游牧['concept_subject']。
make_subject_nomadic_tt.en: A Nomadic ['concept_subject'] is created with all remaining $arkship_cap_plural$, $nomads_constructor_plural$ and $waystation_plural$.

manifesti.1.desc.zh:
第一次与外星物种接触后，人民日益焦虑于社会可能将发生剧变，导致[this.GetName]各地爆发出了游行示威。示威者质疑长久以来的传统，挑战治理的基础，并要求适应这一启示重塑的未来。

尽管这些运动是非暴力的，但其规模却给公共服务带来了巨大压力，扰乱了日常生活。然而，许多公民并不认为这些抗议活动仅仅是骚乱而已。他们认为这是一种清算，表明我们正眼睁睁地见证自己的身份在被改写。
manifesti.1.desc.en:
Protests have erupted across [this.GetName], driven by a growing anxiety over the perceived transformation of our society following first contact with an alien species. Demonstrators question long-standing traditions, challenge the foundations of governance, and demand adaptations to accommodate a future reshaped by this revelation.

Though non-violent, the sheer scale of these movements has placed a strain on civic services and disrupted daily life. However, many citizens do not see these protests as mere disorder. They see them as a reckoning, a sign that our very identity is being rewritten before our eyes.

manifesti.1.f.zh: 让团结的集会走上街头。
manifesti.1.f.en: Flood the streets with unity rallies.

manifesti.1.h.zh: 将其说成是一种注意力分散。

manifesti.10.a.zh: 希望这样一场闹剧就此结束。
manifesti.10.a.en: Let us hope that's the end of such nonsense.

manifesti.10.desc_authoritarian.zh:
持不同意见也是家事。我们通过拘留主要煽动者的亲属来迫使宣泄派屈服。他们的意志被打破后，领头人也被拘留了，这场运动已经崩溃。

秩序恢复了，我们的权威不容置疑。
manifesti.10.desc_authoritarian.en:
Dissent is a family matter. By detaining the relatives of key agitators, we have forced The Manifesti into submission. With their will broken and their leaders in custody, the movement has collapsed.

Order is restored, and our authority stands unquestioned.

manifesti.10.desc_dismantled_exhibition.zh:
展览被悄悄拆除，创作者受到谴责，更具煽动性的作品被没收。我们通过官方渠道向其他国家保证，这种破坏性的言论并不反映我们的国家政策。

虽然一些人谴责此举是文字狱，但大多数人现在明白了一个简单的事实。如果威胁到了帝国的稳定，言论自由就要受到限制。
manifesti.10.desc_dismantled_exhibition.en:
The exhibition was quietly dismantled, its creators reprimanded, and its more inflammatory pieces confiscated. Official channels assured our alien counterparts that such disruptive rhetoric does not reflect state policy.

While some decry the move as censorship, most now understand a simple truth. There are limits to free expression when the stability of the empire is at stake.

manifesti.10.desc_materialist.zh: 感情没有价值，但资源有价值。宣泄派的所谓“项目”已经被没收、拆除，并被重新用于更有意义的地方。随着他们的集会点消失，这场运动失去了动力。
manifesti.10.desc_materialist.en: Sentiment holds no value, but resources do. The so-called 'projects' of the Manifesti has been confiscated, dismantled, and repurposed for more practical use. With their rallying points gone, the movement has lost momentum.

manifesti.10.desc_militarist.zh:
宣泄派不会再给我们添麻烦了。快速而强硬的镇压粉碎了这场运动，使组织四分五裂，信息噤声。他们所谓的“艺术”也被取缔了，领袖消失不见。

秩序恢复了，人们下次见到这种鲁莽的意识形态时会三思而后行。
manifesti.10.desc_militarist.en:
The Manifesti will trouble us no longer. A swift and decisive crackdown has dismantled their movement, scattering their members and silencing their message. Their so-called 'art' has been seized, their leaders disappeared.

Order is restored, and the people will think twice before embracing such reckless ideology again.

manifesti.10.desc_spiritualist.zh: 宣泄派的反抗不仅仅是叛逆，而是一种标志，是一条来自虚空本身的信息。我们应该倾听，而不是让他们噤声。他们的一位成员已经被选中加入我们的政府，将享受最舒适的生活，因为是他们引导我们才对宇宙有了更深的理解。
manifesti.10.desc_spiritualist.en: The Manifesti's defiance is no mere rebellion but a sign, a message from the void itself. Rather than silence them, we shall listen. One among them has been chosen to join our governance, where they will enjoy the finest comforts as they guide us toward a deeper understanding of the cosmos.

manifesti.10.desc_violent_protests.zh: 宣泄派的家人们被拘留了，而运动的领头人也因此很快被镇压。然而，公众的反应却不是顺从，而是愤怒。抗议活动愈演愈烈，不再局限于单纯的示威，而是演变为暴力骚乱。
manifesti.10.desc_violent_protests.en: The families of The Manifesti have been detained, and with them, the movement's leadership has been effectively neutralized. Yet, instead of compliance, the public's response has been one of outrage. Protests have grown fiercer, no longer confined to mere demonstrations but erupting into violent unrest.

manifesti.10.desc_xenophobe.zh:
只要失去了言语载体，反对意见便无法传播。关闭了行星范围通讯后，我们切断了这些反对者的协调能力。没有了外部势力的引导，他们的运动很快就会崩溃。

不幸的是，通讯关闭也影响了执法部门完成任务的能力。
manifesti.10.desc_xenophobe.en:
Dissent cannot spread if there is no voice to carry it. By shutting down planetary communications, we have severed the protesters' ability to coordinate. Without guidance from foreign elements, their movement is sure to collapse.

Unfortunately, the communications shutdown has also impacted the ability of law enforcement to perform its duties.

manifesti.15.desc.zh:
一种人为制造的语言开始在艺术中心和学术机构传播，这是对官方语言的刻意拒绝。这种由宣泄派创造的语言的使用者拒绝承认我们语言的合法性，认为它是不过一种在第一次接触之后就无法自诩正统的社会符号。

行政官们警告称，越来越多的人拒绝以既定的方式进行沟通，这可能会加深分歧，破坏公共话语的稳定。
manifesti.15.desc.en:
A fabricated language has begun spreading through art centers and academic institutions, a deliberate rejection of the official tongue. Created by The Manifesti, its speakers refuse to acknowledge the legitimacy of our language, seeing it as a symbol of a society that can no longer define itself in the wake of first contact.

Officials warn that this growing refusal to communicate in established terms risks deepening divisions and destabilizing public discourse.

manifesti.20.b.zh: 这简直就是一次外交灾难的前夕。赶紧全部封杀。
manifesti.20.b.en: A diplomatic disaster waiting to happen. Shut them down.

manifesti.20.desc.zh:
宣泄派已经公布了他们最为公开的展览的日期。这是一次位于[this.GetName]的全新且极其受欢迎的互动体验，邀请参观者操控他们自己的反射镜像，以及创造由扭曲的政治人物形象组成的拼贴画——其中一些甚至来自于其他的星际帝国。

批评家们认为这些画作是我们对自己自我感的一次必要和严厉的审视。这次展览还激发了许多其他形式的讽刺艺术，其主题涵盖诸多国内议题和泛物种关系。

我们的社会研究者掀起了激烈的讨论；一些保守的声音要求我们谨慎处理。
manifesti.20.desc.en:
The Manifesti have unveiled their most public exhibition to date. A new and extremely popular interactive experience on [this.GetName] invites visitors to manipulate reflections and images of themselves, and to create distorted collages of political figures - some from other galactic empires.

Critics herald these pieces as casting a necessarily and harsh light upon our sense of self. The exhibition has also inspired a number of other satirical works both on domestic issues, and on pan-species relations.

Debate amongst our social researchers is lively; more conservative voices urge caution.

manifesti.25.desc.zh: 关于所谓的“宣泄主义”启发了一个全新派系形成的留言四起。随着我们在第一次接触后对宇宙和自身在其中地位的理解的陷入质疑，它的支持者们开始挑战既定的规范。他们提倡激进的自我表达和对社会结构的根本重新评估。现有的派系抱怨称自己的集会受到了宣泄派煽动者的干扰，这些人对政府的无情挑战正在[Root.GetName]播下不和的种子。
manifesti.25.desc.en: Rumors spread that a new faction is emerging, driven by the ideals of 'Manifestism.' In the aftermath of first contact, as our understanding of the universe and our place within it comes into question, its proponents challenge established norms. They advocate for radical self-expression and a fundamental reevaluation of societal structures. Existing factions complain that their gatherings are being disrupted by Manifestist agitators, whose relentless challenges to governance are sowing discord across [Root.GetName].

manifesti.30.a.zh: 生活还是要继续的，没办法。

manifesti.30.desc.zh:
宣泄派发出的烦人嗡嗡声被噤声了，其消退之快，正如这帮子反动人士起事时一般。某些被我们约谈的行动人士宣称，他们的动机十分复杂，从纯粹的讽刺到有意识、有目的的反对都有。

尽管在画廊和博物馆的活动热度还是前所未有的高，但是公众的注意力已经移动到了新的、更具有争议性的艺术团体身上。我们在继续筛选他们在这一次[root.GetAdj]文化历史上的古怪时刻收集到的数据。
manifesti.30.desc.en:
The buzz surrounding The Manifesti faction has quietened, fading as quickly as the arrival of protests which started it. Some activists we spoke to claimed their motivations ranged from pure satire to conscientious objection.

Attendance at galleries and museums has never been higher, but the public gaze has already moved on to newer, controversial groups of artists. We will continue to sift through the data gathered during this strange moment in [root.GetAdj] cultural history.

manifesti.5.c.zh: 把他们的作品熔成资源。
manifesti.5.c.en: Melt down the projects for resources.

manifesti.5.d.zh: 宣布他们是虚空的使者。
manifesti.5.d.en: Declare them messengers of the void.

manifesti.5.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的示威来得快去得也快。现在许多人把矛头指向了宣泄派，这个以挑战社会规范的挑衅性作品而闻名的神秘团体。虽然他们的参与尚未得到证实，但他们最新的作品都集中在所谓的第一次接触的后果上，这加剧了争议和动荡。

虽然示威已经结束，但是宣泄派依然存在。他们的信息广为流传、影响持久。现在是决定我们如何应对的时候了。
manifesti.5.desc.en:
The protests on [Root.GetName] have ceased almost as suddenly as they began. Many now point to The Manifesti, a shadowy collective known for provocative works that challenge societal norms. While their involvement remains unconfirmed, their latest projects have fixated on the alleged consequences of first contact, fueling both controversy and unrest.

Though the demonstrations have ended, The Manifesti remain. Their message spreads, their influence lingers. The time has come to decide how we respond.

manifesti.5.f.zh: 找到他们的家人然后拘留起来。

manifesti.5.f.tt1.zh: 逮捕行动扼杀了这场运动
manifesti.5.f.tt1.en: the arrests killing off the movement

manifesti.5.f.tt2.zh: 逮捕行动扼杀了这场运动，但激起了不满和破坏
manifesti.5.f.tt2.en: the arrests killing off the movement but also triggering civil unrest and devastation

manifesti_leader_desc.zh: 一位前宣泄派领袖变成了先知，声称在虚空中瞥见了隐藏的真相。
manifesti_leader_desc.en: A former Manifesti ringleader turned prophet, they claim to have glimpsed a hidden truth in the void.

marauder.1.desc.zh:
我们完成了对他们使用语言的破译，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]将[encountered_marauder.GetName]识别为一种游牧文明，称为[encountered_marauder.GetRealName]。他们在[marauder_system.GetName]恒星系附近占据了数个大型空间站，其大量的人口都居住在拥挤而肮脏的环境之中。尽管如此，或许正因如此，他们似乎发展出了一种非常尚武的文化。生活在冰冷虚空中成了他们的第二天性，因而高度擅长太空作战。

[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName]没有中央政府一说，而是分为数个不同的派系，不断地互相争夺资源与尊严。鉴于其庞大的人口与空间站造船能力，若无永无止境的内斗，他们必将成为严重威胁到全星系和平的势力。
marauder.1.desc.en:
Having decoded what counts as a language among them, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] has identified the [encountered_marauder.GetName] as a nomadic civilization known as the [encountered_marauder.GetRealName]. They occupy a number of large space stations in and around the [marauder_system.GetName] system that house the bulk of their massive numbers in crowded and squalid conditions. Despite this, or perhaps because of it, they seem to have developed a strong martial culture. Life in the cold void has become second nature to them, and they are very adept at space warfare.

There is no [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName] central government to speak of. Instead, they are divided into several different factions that vie endlessly with one another for resources and respect. Given their large population and the shipbuilding capability of their stations, this constant infighting is the only thing keeping them from growing into a significant threat to galactic peace.

marauder.10.a.zh: 我们将给他们安排新家。
marauder.10.a.en: We will give them new homes.

marauder.10.desc.zh:
$marauder.10.desc.start$

尽管这些难民习惯居住在脏乱拥挤的空间站上，但他们似乎也很适应新的行星家园。$marauder.10.desc.end$
marauder.10.desc.en:
$marauder.10.desc.start$

Although these refugees are used to living on crowded space stations under squalid conditions, they seem to be adjusting well to their new planetary home. $marauder.10.desc.end$

marauder.10.desc.artificial.zh:
$marauder.10.desc.start$

他们早已习惯了拥挤的空间站生活，现在正迅速熟悉我们的人造定居点。$marauder.10.desc.end$
marauder.10.desc.artificial.en:
$marauder.10.desc.start$

Already accustomed to living on crowded space stations they are quickly getting familiar with our artificial settlements. $marauder.10.desc.end$

marauder.101.1.a.response.zh:
真遗憾啊！看来得让我们的战士到其他地方找乐子了。

你们的人民安全了，至少短时间内不会受到我们的攻击。
marauder.101.1.a.response.en:
A pity! I suppose our warriors will have to look elsewhere for entertainment then.

Your people are safe. For the moment at least.

marauder.101.1.b.response.zh: 既然你们不肯主动献出贡品，那我们就来抢啦！你们将为这个愚蠢决定后悔的！
marauder.101.1.b.response.en: Fools! Then we shall take by force what you should have offered in tribute... and more besides! You have made a terrible mistake this day.

marauder.101.1.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]的弱者们，我们的战士们正准备去进攻你们的星系，要么勇敢的面对他们、要么像懦夫一样躲起来眼睁睁的看着我们的战士抢走你们的财富。

当然了，你们也可以现在就进贡，如果贡品价值足够的话，我们可以考虑不攻击你们……
marauder.101.1.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName] weaklings, our warriors are on their way to plunder your systems. Face them in battle if you can muster the courage, or cower in fear until they have had their fill of your riches.

You can, of course, offer tribute now to spare yourselves from the coming onslaught. If it is sufficient, our warriors may be compelled to turn back...

marauder.101.2.a.response.zh: 你们很识相嘛，泥蛮！现在我们只能去其他地方找吃的了！你们可以安心了！
marauder.101.2.a.response.en: You smart, dwamak! We now have to look for dwamak-stew elsewhere! Much trouble for us, but no trouble for you!

marauder.101.2.b.response.zh:
你们能这么说真是太好了，泥蛮！[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就喜欢挑战！

嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！！
marauder.101.2.b.response.en:
We hope you say that, dwamak! [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural] always like good challenge!

HYEEEIIIEEEE!!!!

marauder.101.2.desc.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！！[Root.GetSpeciesName]——泥蛮！我们来你们星系串门来了！顺便来抢些东西，省的你们因为过于富有而变得肥的流油！

除非你们能找出不让我们这么做的理由……
marauder.101.2.desc.en:
HYEEEIIIIIEEEEEE!!!!!!! [Root.GetSpeciesName]-dwamaks! We come visit your systems! We save you from growing too rich and fat, yes!

Unless you think of reason why you not make good dwamak-stew...

marauder.101.3.a.response.zh: 不去惹怒虚空之母，你的做法很明智。你无法想像她的报复有多么可怕。
marauder.101.3.a.response.en: You are wise not to anger She of the Void. Her retribution would have been terrible.

marauder.101.3.b.response.zh: 虽然在提议之前，全知全能的虚空之母早就预知到你将如此回应，但我们还是要走个形式。现在，无论贫富，我们的人民将进行一场捍卫我们伟大信仰的圣战。当然，一切以主的名义。
marauder.101.3.b.response.en: She of the Void predicted this response, but the offer had to be made. Now we can gather slaves and riches through proper ceremonial combat. All of it in Her name, of course.

marauder.101.3.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。虚空之母已降下圣训，希望能用你们的星系作为祭所来庆祝她对这片虚空的永恒支配权。我们是虚空之母忠实的仆从，我们必须贯彻虚空之母的意愿。

一支由我们最优秀的战士所组成的舰队正前往你们星系收集祭品。或者如果你们愿意满足虚空之母的饥饿，也可以现在就主动进贡，如果贡品数目足够的话，我们也可以停止对你们的攻击。
marauder.101.3.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. She of the Void has communicated to us Her desire to use your systems as ceremonial sites from which to celebrate Her ever-lasting dominion over Space. As Her humble servants, we have no choice but to comply.

A battle fleet of our finest warriors, drawn from all of our warring factions, is currently on its way to you to gather tribute and servants. To stave off the inevitable and sate Her hunger, you may offer tribute now. If it is sufficient, the fleet will be recalled.

marauder.101.d.zh: 你休想从我们这里拿到任何东西。
marauder.101.d.en: You'll get nothing from us, scum.

marauder.102.1.a.response.zh: 想想我们当初要求你上贡的时候，你的愚蠢拒绝给你带来了多少灾难。你们应该从这件事中吸取教训，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
marauder.102.1.a.response.en: Think of all the grief you would have spared yourselves had you only offered us tribute when we first asked for it. Let this be a lesson to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

marauder.102.1.b.response.zh:
我……你、你……我的外表、这不重要……

你会为你这些轻蔑谩骂后悔的，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们的战士会将你们可笑的舰队烧成碎片！
marauder.102.1.b.response.en:
I... y-you... my physical appearance has... has nothing to do with...

You will regret this slight, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Our warriors will burn your pathetic fleets to cinders!

marauder.102.1.desc.zh: 你们终于哭丧着跑来乞求怜悯了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? 你们仍旧可以献上贡品来跪求我们远离你们的领土，但是我们要抬价。
marauder.102.1.desc.en: Have you finally come to grovel for mercy then, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? You may still offer tribute to secure our withdrawal from your space, but the price has gone up.

marauder.102.2.a.response.zh: 呀哈咿哈！！！！这下就好了。我们已经拿到了想要的东西。暂时不需要再喝炖泥蛮汤了，暂时。
marauder.102.2.a.response.en: HYEEEEEIIIIIEEEEE!!! Then it settled. We have what we want. No more need for dwamak-stew, for now.

marauder.102.2.desc.zh:
怎么，泥蛮？你们不想让我们来串门了？你们想让我们走？嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！

你们可以付钱，但价位也要跟着上涨……
marauder.102.2.desc.en:
Yes, dwamak? You no want us visit now? You want us go away? HYEEEIIEEEE!!!

You can pay, but more expensive now...

marauder.102.3.a.response.zh: 虚空之母很满意。这些活祭让她精神愉悦，她允许她的战士们撤退了。再见，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
marauder.102.3.a.response.en: She of the Void is pleased. This sacrifice has lightened Her spirits, and She has permitted Her warriors to withdraw. Fare thee well, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

marauder.102.3.desc.zh:
吾姆为你渎神的言行感到愤怒，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……非常愤怒。我们在圣战中每活祭一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都会平息一丝她的愤怒，但这就够了吗？

如果你想向虚空之母献上贡品来让我们撤军，你最好清楚，她现在需要更多的祭品。
marauder.102.3.desc.en:
She is angry, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... very angry. Every [Root.GetSpeciesName] that is sacrificed in Her honor lessens her fury somewhat, but will it be enough?

If you are here to offer tribute to She of the Void as a means of securing our withdrawal from your space, know that she will require an even larger sacrifice on your behalf now...

marauder.104.desc.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]劫掠团登陆了[Root.GetName]！他们的舰队从轨道上部署了许多小型的攻击机，[marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在撤退前攻击了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上一些零散的聚居点。我们在地表上的防御部队根本没有时间反应。
marauder.104.desc.en: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] raiding parties have made planetfall on [Root.GetName]! Deploying in small attack shuttles from their orbiting fleet, the [marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] hit several outlying settlements on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] before retreating back into space with their plunder. Our defensive forces on the surface had no time to respond.

marauder.105.a.zh: 一定要让他们为此付出代价。

marauder.105.desc.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的奴隶贩子登陆了[Root.GetName]！攻击机袭击了许多[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的定居点，俘获了许多殖民者，并给他们戴上镣铐抓上了掠夺者位于轨道的舰队。
marauder.105.desc.en: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] slavers have landed on [Root.GetName]! Attack shuttles hit several outlying settlements on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], rounding up colonists and transporting them back in chains to the raiders' orbiting fleet.

marauder.106.desc.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的少量军队对[Root.GetName]实行了一场一击脱离战。他们零零散散的空降登陆让指挥地面防御部队的战术反应单位一时摸不着头脑，直到这群野蛮人劫掠了定居点，安安稳稳地回到他们轨道上的舰队时才反应过来。
marauder.106.desc.en: Light [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] forces have conducted a hit-and-run attack on [Root.GetName]. Their dispersed landings confused the tactical response units leading our surface forces, and before they could react the raiders had already returned to orbit with whatever spoils they could gather from our settlements.

marauder.107.desc.zh:
[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的奴隶贩子登陆了[Root.GetName]！呼啸而过的攻击机倾泻炸弹之雨，敲开了有机体庇护所的大门，之后一群全副武装的劫掠团包围了庇护所。

不知所措的有机体们才从庇护所内安稳的美梦中醒来，被这些奴隶贩子俘获，带上了他们的轨道舰队。
marauder.107.desc.en:
[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] slavers have landed on [Root.GetName]! Bombing runs from their attack shuttles cracked open several of our organic sanctuaries, which were then stormed by heavily armed raiding parties.

The bewildered organics who had, until now, been kept safe within these sanctuaries were promptly rounded up by the slavers and returned in chains to their orbiting fleet.

marauder.108.a.zh: 我们必须要惩戒这种无耻行径。

marauder.108.desc.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠团登陆了[Root.GetName]！这些劫掠者劫掠了我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的一些哨站，并在回到轨道舰队之前屠杀了成百上千的子个体。
marauder.108.desc.en: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] raiding parties have made planetfall on [Root.GetName]! The raiders plundered several of our outposts on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] and slaughtered hundreds of drones before they retreated back to their orbiting fleet.

marauder.108.wilderness.desc.zh: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesAdj]的劫掠团侵犯了[Root.GetName]！这些卑鄙的抢到洗劫了我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的许多设施，屠杀了数百个共生体之后返回了轨道舰队上。
marauder.108.wilderness.desc.en: [marauder_country.GetSpeciesAdj] raiding parties have transgressed upon [Root.GetName]! These vile interlopers plundered several of our facilities on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] and slaughtered hundreds of symbionts before retreating back to their orbiting fleet.

marauder.111.1.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，可以从你们的土拨鼠洞里钻出来了。我们从你们这“解放”了足够多的财富，现在正在用船载回去呢。

嗨！舵手伙计们！我们要回[marauder_system.GetName]了。让我们离开这群混球的地盘吧，这鬼地方真让我感到恶心。
marauder.111.1.desc.en:
You can emerge from your shelters now, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have liberated a sufficient amount of your wealth, and our ships are loaded to capacity.

Helmsman! Set course for [marauder_system.GetName]. Let us depart this blasted region of space. It depresses me.

marauder.111.2.desc.zh:
泥蛮，我们已经抢够了，不需要再抢了，我们的船已经装不下了。

我们现在就回[marauder_system.GetName]吧。
marauder.111.2.desc.en:
Dwamaks, we have bashed enough. No more bashing needed now. Our ship holds full.

We go back [marauder_system.GetName] now, yes.

marauder.111.3.desc.zh: 圣战结束了。虚空之母对我们在你们领土上造成的毁坏感到满意，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。现在她允许我们回到[marauder_system.GetName]了。
marauder.111.3.desc.en: The ceremony is concluded. She of the Void is satisfied with the destruction we have brought to your space, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are now permitted to return to [marauder_system.GetName].

marauder.112.1.a.response.zh:
那群可悲的懦夫不敢来打你们，所以才雇我们来攻击。知道他们的身份对你们来说是毫无意义的，因为那些家伙本身就无足重轻。

不过由于他们付的报酬很丰厚，因此我们也愿意隐瞒他们的身份。
marauder.112.1.a.response.en:
Pitiful cowards who were unwilling to face you themselves. Their identity is meaningless, and their ultimate role in the universe even more so.

And they paid well for us to keep their identity to ourselves.

marauder.112.1.desc.zh: 这很令人激动，不是吗？这场战争多么让人兴奋！我们最强大的战士将与你们最强的军队进行较量。让我们看看谁才是胜者吧！
marauder.112.1.desc.en: This is exciting, yes? The thrill of battle! Our best warriors pitted against the best you have to offer. We shall see who comes out on top!

marauder.112.2.a.response.zh: 这是秘密，泥蛮！他们是泥蛮，就和你一样，我们只能说这么多。
marauder.112.2.a.response.en: Ah, but that secret, dwamak! They were dwamaks, like yourself, but other dwamaks. That all we can say.

marauder.112.2.desc.zh: 泥蛮，你有什么事？我们正在忙着洗劫你的地盘！
marauder.112.2.desc.en: Dwamak, what you want? We busy bashing your systems!

marauder.112.3.a.response.zh:
一群异端。一群无信仰者。一群异教徒。

我们只是收人钱财替人办事，很快就与他们不再联系，但他们付出的能量币可以满足虚空之母的意志。
marauder.112.3.a.response.en:
Infidels. Unbelievers. Heretics.

We would just as soon have nothing to do with them, but their energy credits will help to further Her will.

marauder.112.3.desc.zh: 我们只为吾母的意志而存在。虽然现在那些兜里有子儿的人雇佣我们来毁灭你们，但只要最终结果能让更多的异端者作为活祭献给吾母，吾母定然会同意我们的行为。
marauder.112.3.desc.en: We serve only Her will, and, for the moment, those with pockets deep enough to hire us to smite you. As long as the end result is more dead believers, She of the Void approves.

marauder.112.a.zh: 是谁雇佣你们来攻击我们的？
marauder.112.a.en: Who paid you to raid us?

marauder.114.a.zh: 他们自视甚高，结果自取其辱。
marauder.114.a.en: They bit off more than they could chew.

marauder.114.desc.zh: 我们给[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠舰队造成的巨大损失足以让他们停下劫掠的步伐。看来在考虑过所有可能的选项后，[marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]最终决定停止劫掠，回到他们的领土。
marauder.114.desc.en: The heavy damage inflicted upon the [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] raiding fleet has been enough to give pause to their warriors. After reconsidering their options, the [marauder_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have apparently decided to abandon their raid and withdraw back to their own space.

marauder.116.a.zh: 让这次惨败作为他们的教训吧。
marauder.116.a.en: Let this be a lesson to their kind.

marauder.116.desc.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠舰队试图劫掠我们的领土，但在[destroyed_fleet_system.GetName]星系被全歼了。舰船残骸中没有发现任何幸存者。
marauder.116.desc.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] fleet that vowed to raid our space has been destroyed as the result of a fleet action in the [destroyed_fleet_system.GetName] system. No survivors have been reported found amongst the debris.

marauder.117.desc.zh: 那个在我们“一番鼓励”之后决定对[marauder_target.GetName]发起劫掠的[marauder_country.GetSpeciesName]掠夺者夹着尾巴逃回了他们自己的星系！他们的劫掠舰队受损严重，让他们放弃了原来的劫掠计划。
marauder.117.desc.en: The [marauder_country.GetSpeciesName] marauders that we "encouraged" to launch a raid against the [marauder_target.GetName] have turned tail and are running back to their own space! The losses sustained by their raiding fleet were apparently grave enough to give them a change of heart.

marauder.120.desc.zh: 一支[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesName]舰队正在朝我们的边境驶来！我们截获了该舰队的通讯，他们是受敌对国雇佣来袭击我们的星系的，他们现在正在从公开频道上给我们发送消息。
marauder.120.desc.en: A [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesName] raiding fleet has been detected approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rivalling foreign power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message directed towards us on an open channel.

marauder.121.1.desc.zh: 躲在阴影中的胆小鬼们想利用我们来借刀杀人，因为这帮蛆虫太过畏惧不敢亲自动手。[Root.GetSpeciesName]的战士中究竟有没有人有足够的勇气与我们在战场上光荣的一决胜负，亦或是毫不还手让我们劫掠你们的领土？向我们展示你们的尊严！
marauder.121.1.desc.en: Cowards huddling in darkness have asked us to face you, since they are too afraid to do so themselves. Are there any [Root.GetSpeciesName] warriors honorable enough to meet us in open battle, then, or must we plunder your systems unopposed? Show us your worth!

marauder.121.2.desc.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！你们的敌人可不少哦，泥蛮！那些敌人雇我们来破坏你们的星系！我们很乐意代劳哦！
marauder.121.2.desc.en: HYEEEIIIEEE!!! You have many enemies, dwamak! They not like you very much! Even pay us to bash your systems! We happy to oblige!

marauder.121.3.desc.zh: 如果一群异端付钱让我们去消灭另一群异端，我们为什么拒绝呢？我们迟早会处理掉所有异教徒，但至少现在我们会针对你们。
marauder.121.3.desc.en: If one group of unbelievers wants us to smite another group of unbelievers, and are willing to pay us for it, who are we to say no? In time, the servants of She of the Void will deal with all heretics, but for now we shall focus on you.

marauder.122.desc.zh: 在我们的一番“鼓励”之下，[raid_parent.GetSpeciesNamePlural]向[raid_victim.GetName]派遣了劫掠舰队。现在舰船上装满了战利品和奴隶，已经准备返航了。船主们纷纷表示这次袭击非常的成功。
marauder.122.desc.en: The raiding fleet that the [raid_parent.GetSpeciesNamePlural] sent into the [raid_victim.GetName] after we "encouraged" them to do so has set a course back to their home system. With the fleet's cargo holds full of captured loot and slaves, the ship masters have declared the raid successfully concluded.

marauder.123.desc.zh: 一个属于此前未知物种的私掠舰队正在侵入我们的边境！这些自称[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的野蛮人显然是受到与我们敌对的境外势力支持后来攻击我们的领土。他们正在从公开频道向我们发送信息。
marauder.123.desc.en: A raiding fleet belonging to a previously unknown species has been detected approaching our borders! These savages, who call themselves the [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural], have apparently been paid by a rivalling foreign power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message directed towards us on an open channel.

marauder.124.a.zh: 希望他们在被消灭前给敌人造成了一些伤害。
marauder.124.a.en: They hopefully did some damage at least.

marauder.124.desc.zh: 在我们的唆使下，[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所组成的私掠舰队在[destroyed_fleet_system.GetName]星系被[fleet_destroyer.GetName]摧毁了！没有幸存者的相关报告。
marauder.124.desc.en: The raiding fleet that we "encouraged" the [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to put together has been destroyed in the [destroyed_fleet_system.GetName] system by forces belonging to the [fleet_destroyer.GetName]! There are no reports of survivors.

marauder.15.1.desc.zh:
外来者们。我们是[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。不像星系中的其他“文明”的星际帝国，我们没有统治者，但作为被所有氏族选中的代表，我在此正告各位：

不要妄图用你们那软弱无力的威胁来挑战我们。你们尽管将自己的舰队派往[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName]看看，千万不要期望它们能安然返航，我们的战士不介意进行些消遣。

当然，你们要是想进贡，那我们希望你们能常来坐坐……或在你们需要佣兵并能支付足够酬金的时候。
marauder.15.1.desc.en:
Outsiders. We are the [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Unlike the "civilized" star nations of the galaxy, we have no single master to lord over us, but I have been chosen to convey this message to you on behalf of all of the Houses:

Do not try to impose your soft and effete ways upon us. You may freely send your alien ships into [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName] territory, but do not expect them to return. Our warriors will welcome the diversion, however.

Transmit on this frequency only if you wish to offer tribute... or if you have need of mercenaries, as well as the means to pay for them.

marauder.15.2.desc.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！好多泥蛮啊！

你想怎样，愚蠢的泥蛮？你的脸是咋整的？反应堆事故？真空暴露？嗨咿咿嘢嘢！！你看看你！

我们是[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们狩猎泥蛮。如果你来[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName]领地，我们就做泥蛮汤。你不喜欢，对吧？嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！

或许你认识其他泥蛮们。或许你想让他们变成泥蛮汤。我们可以谈条件。如果价格公道，[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]也愿意为泥蛮们去打其他泥蛮们。
marauder.15.2.desc.en:
HYEEEIIIIEEEE!!!! More dwamaks!

What you want, foolish dwamak? What happen to make your face look like that? Reactor accident? Vacuum exposure? HYEEIIIEE!! Look at you!

We are the [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We hunt dwamak. If you come to [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName] turf, we make dwamak-stew. Not good for you, yes? HYEEIIIIIEEEEE!!

Perhaps you know other dwamaks. Perhaps you want them to be dwamak-stew. This can be arranged. [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural] not above fighting for dwamaks against other dwamaks, if price is right.

marauder.15.3.desc.zh:
我们是[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，虚空之母的忠实仆人：她乃全知全能，统御太空的至高复仇者。

她让我们在很久以前放弃了先祖的行星家园，迁居她永恒的领域———冰冷的太空，赋予我们狩猎异端的使命，并献祭来取悦她。

可惜，信仰战争耗尽了我们的力量，并让我们产生了分歧。我们挣扎着寻求她的帮助，希望得到女神的指引，而毁灭异端异形无疑能取悦她————哪怕是因为接受其他异端的命令。因此，只要你出的起，我们许多信徒皆愿为你而战……
marauder.15.3.desc.en:
We are the [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we are the favored servants of She of the Void; the All-Seeing, Ever-Knowing and above all Vengeful supreme being that lords over Space.

It was She that bade us give up our ancestral planetary home eons ago, to take up residence in Her eternal domain - the cold depths of space - so that we could hunt unbelievers and appease Her through sacrifice.

Alas, the Doctrinal Wars have sapped our strength and we are now a divided people, struggling to divine the true path She would have us walk. Yet Her favor can be won through the destruction of alien heretics - even at the behest of other heretics. Thus, many of our warriors are willing to fight your battles, for a price...

marauder.19.2.desc_01.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！什么都吃的蜂巢泥蛮！肯定不会让你把我们做成汤的！快走开，蜂巢泥蛮！
marauder.19.2.desc_01.en: HYEEEIIIEEEE!!! The hive-dwamak that eats everything! You not turn us into stew, that for sure! Be gone, hive-dwamak!

marauder.19.2.desc_02.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！我们喜欢砸，但不像你！你太喜欢了，泥蛮！我们不跟你说话！
marauder.19.2.desc_02.en: HYEEIIEEEE!!! We like bashing, but not like you! You like it too much, dwamak! We no talk to you!

marauder.19.2.desc_03.zh:
呀哈咿哈！！！！！！它、它能懂吗？它是杀戮机器，对吧？它只知道杀、杀、杀？

机械脑袋！自杀！我命令你把自己杀掉！

啊哈，它坏掉了，没用。
marauder.19.2.desc_03.en:
HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Can... can it understand? It killing machine, yes? It only kills?

Machine... kill self! You ordered to kill self!

Ah, it broken. No use.

marauder.19.2.desc_04.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！又热又臭，闻着像烟味！能用来引火吗？不能？呸！

滚开，没用的炭渣！
marauder.19.2.desc_04.en:
HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Hot, hot, and stinks like smoke! Can use for kindling? No? Bah!

Go away, useless charcoal!

marauder.19.3.desc_01.zh:
你们是虚空之母的宿敌。如果可能的话，你们连虚空本身都会吞噬，对吧？

可恨的怪物。
marauder.19.3.desc_01.en:
Your kind is anathema to She of the Void. You would consume the Void itself were it possible, wouldn't you?

Abomination.

marauder.19.3.desc_02.zh: 虚空之母要求献祭，但不是你招致这种规模。你崇拜的是毁灭本身，这让你成为最邪恶的异端。
marauder.19.3.desc_02.en: She of the Void demands sacrifice, but not on the scale you deliver. You worship destruction itself, and that makes you the worst kind of heathen.

marauder.19.3.desc_03.zh:
你冰冷而空洞，就像虚空本身。虚空之母敬重这一点。所以你的毁灭将会使她感到非常愉悦。

仅此而已。
marauder.19.3.desc_03.en:
You are cold and empty, like the Void itself. She of the Void can respect that. Your destruction will bring us much favor with Her.

There is nothing more to be said.

marauder.19.3.desc_04.zh:
你竟敢将炽烈的火焰带入虚空之母的领地？你的本性令她憎恶。

像寒灰般寂静地速速离开。
marauder.19.3.desc_04.en:
You dare bring bright hot fire into the domain of She of the Void? Your nature is abhorrent to Her.

Be silent as cold ash and be gone.

marauder.19.d.zh: 你们都会如同他人一般燃烧殆尽！
marauder.19.d.en: You will burn like everyone else!

marauder.19.desc_01.zh:
[Root.GetName]是自然的毒瘤。你们这种毫无荣誉概念的肮脏存在叫什么……“蜂巢思维”？还是什么都无所谓。你们简直是星系中能出现的所有错误的集合体。

[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的战士不愿与你们为伍。
marauder.19.desc_01.en:
The [Root.GetName] is a perversion of nature. Your... "Hive Mind" or whatever you wish to call the obscenity that lords over your domain has no concept of honor. It represents everything that is wrong in this galaxy.

The warriors of the [marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will have nothing to do with you.

marauder.19.desc_02.zh:
[Root.GetName]只是一群蛮夷野人。你愚蠢地谋害无辜者，足以令我们最坚韧的战士感到恶心。

我们不会与你打交道。
marauder.19.desc_02.en:
The [Root.GetName] is nothing but a pack of savage animals. Your senseless slaughter of innocents is enough to make even our hardiest warriors sick.

We will have no dealings with you.

marauder.19.desc_03.zh:
啊，说话的机器。你的主人哪去了，机械脑袋？他们知道你出故障了吗？

如果你们再靠近我们的地盘，我们的战士会很乐意拿你们当靶子打，即便这样做毫无荣誉可言。现在快从俺们眼前消失吧。
marauder.19.desc_03.en:
Ah yes, the talking machines. Where are your owners, machine? Are they aware that you are malfunctioning?

Although there is no honor in it, our warriors will gladly use you for target practice if you approach our territory. Now be gone from my sight.

marauder.19.desc_04.zh: 你们恐怕自以为令人畏惧，就凭浑身火焰缠绕、地狱般的模样。或许你们忘了，火焰终究会被熄灭。拿你们那化为灰烬的言辞上别处说去吧。
marauder.19.desc_04.en: No doubt you think yourselves intimidating, with your infernal appearance wreathed in flame. Perhaps you've forgotten that every fire must eventually be snuffed out. Take your ashen words elsewhere.

marauder.20.1.desc_01.zh: 说吧，外来者。我们的战士们正洗耳恭听。
marauder.20.1.desc_01.en: Speak then, outsider. Our warriors are listening.

marauder.20.1.desc_03.zh:
作为决斗失败的惩罚，我不得不按约定在这一轮中负责跟外来者打交道。

你来干哈？
marauder.20.1.desc_03.en:
As punishment for losing a duel, it has been decreed that I am to deal with all outsiders this cycle.

What do you want?

marauder.20.1.desc_04.zh: 解释一下你为什么要打扰我们。我们仍在继续战斗任务。
marauder.20.1.desc_04.en: Explain this interruption. There are battles to attend to.

marauder.20.1.desc_05.zh:
啊！终于来了个真正的军人！

[Root.GetSpeciesName]军队的战斗力我们也有所耳闻。成千上万的[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]迫切地想在战场上亲自挑战你们。
marauder.20.1.desc_05.en:
Ah! Now here is a true fighter at last!

The martial prowess of [Root.GetSpeciesName] warriors is known even to us. There are thousands of [marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who would dearly like to test themselves in battle against you.

marauder.20.1.desc_06.zh:
你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你的进贡使我们的战士非常高兴。

我直说吧……虽然还是有些人想要攻击你们，但他们已经被摆平了。至少摆平大多数了。
marauder.20.1.desc_06.en:
Well met, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your tribute has been well-received by our warriors.

I will not lie... there were some who still wished to attack you, but they have been dealt with. For the most part.

marauder.20.1.desc_07.zh: 吾等剑已归鞘，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。目前你们无需担忧。
marauder.20.1.desc_07.en: Our swords are sheathed, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have nothing to fear from our warriors for now.

marauder.20.2.desc_01.zh: 我好端端的一个晚上被你给扰了，泥蛮！嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！你想怎样？！
marauder.20.2.desc_01.en: I was having fine evening, and then you show up, dwamak! HYEEEIIIEEEEE!!! What you want?!

marauder.20.2.desc_02.zh: 唯一比泥蛮更糟的是泥蝻！不！别问那是什么！嗨咿咿咿嘢嘢嘢嘢！！！
marauder.20.2.desc_02.en: Only thing worse than a dwamak is a dwakam! NO! Do not ask what is! HYEEEIIIEEEEEEEEE!!!!!

marauder.20.2.desc_03.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢咿咿……*咳咳**咕噜**噗*……咿咿嘢嘢咿咿！！！！

marauder.20.2.desc_04.zh: 你有东西要我们去砸，泥蛮？[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很擅长砸东西！
marauder.20.2.desc_04.en: You have something for us to smash, dwamak? [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural] very good at smashing!

marauder.20.3.desc_01.zh:
虚空之母今天非常愤怒。我能感觉到。

我们还需要更加努力地取悦她……
marauder.20.3.desc_01.en:
She of the Void is wroth today. I can feel it.

We have not done enough to win Her favor...

marauder.20.3.desc_02.zh:
我只是她的仆从。我对你一无所知。

但她……她看穿了你的蠕虫本质。
marauder.20.3.desc_02.en:
I am but Her servant. I know nothing.

But She... She sees you for the maggots that you are.

marauder.20.3.desc_03.zh: 每当你的飞船穿越无垠太空时，都是在冒犯她的领域。而我们则在竭力安抚她的愤怒。须知，她的愤怒非常可怕……
marauder.20.3.desc_03.en: Whenever your ships cross the vastness of space, they violate Her domain with their presence. It is left to us to sooth Her anger. It is terrible to behold...

marauder.20.3.desc_04.zh: 第九次教义战争已经进行到了第167周期。异端派系还在负隅顽抗……为了虚空之母，我们绝不会手下留情。
marauder.20.3.desc_04.en: The Ninth Doctrinal War is in its 167th cycle. The heretical factions simply will not yield... but for the sake of Her, we must not relent.

marauder.20.b.zh: 我们知道一个很适合对其进行突袭的目标……
marauder.20.b.en: We know of a good raiding target...

marauder.20.busy.b.1.response.zh: 我们的战士们已经在进行袭击了，无暇分心处理其他事情。
marauder.20.busy.b.1.response.en: Our warriors are already in the middle of a raid. We have no time for distractions.

marauder.20.busy.b.2.response.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！我们已经在袭击了，泥蛮！没时间做其他事情！
marauder.20.busy.b.2.response.en: HYEEIIEEEE! We already raiding, dwamak! No time for this!

marauder.20.busy.b.3.response.zh: 为了强制贯彻虚空之母的意愿，我们已经去袭击无信仰者了。如果有什么异议的话，等袭击结束之后再说。
marauder.20.busy.b.3.response.en: We are already enforcing Her will by raiding unbelievers. Until that raid is concluded, we have nothing more to discuss on this topic.

marauder.20.cooldown.b.1.response.zh: 上一次的袭击让我们元气大伤，我们现在根本没有足够的舰船能够发起另一轮突袭，请稍后再来吧。
marauder.20.cooldown.b.1.response.en: We have not yet recovered from our previous raid. Not enough ships are available to mount another. Return later.

marauder.20.cooldown.b.2.response.zh: 泥蛮，我们必须拒绝，因为舰队还没有整备完毕，我们在上次袭击中所受到的损伤还没有恢复！
marauder.20.cooldown.b.2.response.en: Dwamak, we hate to say no to bash-bash, but our fleet not ready. Still recovering from last raid!

marauder.20.cooldown.b.3.response.zh: 我们上一轮的袭击才刚结束，现在再发起袭击为时过早。我们现在应该进行默祷，对虚空之母进行膜拜。
marauder.20.cooldown.b.3.response.en: It is too soon. Our previous raid has just concluded, and now it is time for quiet prayers and worship of She of the Void.

marauder.20.d.en: We would like to hire mercenaries.

marauder.20.f.zh: 能不能麻烦你停止那个烦人的尖叫呢？
marauder.20.f.en: Will you cease that infernal shrieking?

marauder.20.f.response.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！什么……什么尖叫？

marauder.20.g.zh: 我们想要雇佣一名领袖。
marauder.20.g.en: We would like to hire a leader.

marauder.3.desc.zh:
数月间，我们零星收到了少量外星佣兵与海盗在我们边境活动的报告。他们自称为[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，并且似乎是一群流放者，来自[marauder_system.GetName]恒星系的拥挤空间站上的一个游牧战士文明。

他们平安无事地路过我们的边境，但警告我们不要冒犯[marauder_system.GetName]。[From.GetSpeciesName]没有所谓的集中政体，但他们有着不同的派系，相互之间不断争斗，并经常攻击相邻的恒星系。鉴于其庞大的成员数量与空间站造船能力，如果他们停止自相争斗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很可能会成为星系中的强大势力。
marauder.3.desc.en:
For several months now, we have received scattered reports of small numbers of alien mercenaries and privateers operating on the frontiers of our space. They call themselves the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and are apparently exiles from a nomadic warrior culture inhabiting overcrowded space stations in and around the [marauder_system.GetName] system.

Their passage near our space proceeded without incident, but they warned us against trespassing in [marauder_system.GetName]. There is no [From.GetSpeciesName] central government to speak of, but their various factions are engaged in constant infighting and often launch raids against neighboring star systems. Indeed, given their vast population and space-based production capability, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would likely be a significant galactic power if they ever stopped killing each other.

marauder.31.1.desc.zh:
哈！你想让我们对你的其中一名宿敌进行突袭？

我们不想插手你们之间的无聊纷争，但如果你开的价合适的话，我们倒是也可以考虑……

你想让我们攻击谁呢？
marauder.31.1.desc.en:
Ha! So you would have us raid one of your rivals?

We are loathe to get involved in your petty disputes, but with the proper incentives, I suppose it could be arranged...

Who is it that you want us to attack?

marauder.31.2.desc.zh:
你、你想让我们去袭击你的其中一个泥蛮宿敌？好的，可以……

但你要我们去袭击哪个泥蛮呢？
marauder.31.2.desc.en:
You... you want us to smash one of your dwamak rivals? Yes, it can be done...

But which dwamak to smash?

marauder.31.3.desc.zh:
既然你给我们进贡了，我们可以考虑去袭击一些无信仰者。

你打算让我们去袭击谁呢？
marauder.31.3.desc.en:
In exchange for tribute, we could perhaps be convinced to smite a particular group of unbelievers.

Who are these heretics you would have us deal with?

marauder.32.1.a.response.zh: 那就这么说定了，我们会在黎明时发动袭击。
marauder.32.1.a.response.en: Then it is settled. We ride at dawn.

marauder.32.1.desc.zh: [preliminary_target.GetName]对我们的战士来说确实是合适的袭击目标，我们可以考虑对他们下手……
marauder.32.1.desc.en: The [preliminary_target.GetName] does indeed look like a ripe target for our warriors. Perhaps a visit is in order...

marauder.32.2.a.response.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！！这些泥蛮肯定会大吃一惊的！
marauder.32.2.a.response.en: HYEEEEIIIEEEEE!!!!!! These dwamaks are in for bash-bash!

marauder.32.2.desc.zh: 没错，这个[preliminary_target.GetName]做泥蛮汤再合适不过了。很棒。但好像挺费劲……
marauder.32.2.desc.en: Yes, [preliminary_target.GetName] would make good dwamak-stew. Very good. But it is much effort...

marauder.32.3.a.response.zh: 要让他们见识虚空之母的愤怒。

marauder.32.3.desc.zh: 虚空之母对[preliminary_target.GetName]的无信仰者极为不满，应该进行一次战略远征来贯彻虚空之母的意愿……
marauder.32.3.desc.en: She of the Void does not look kindly on the heathens of the [preliminary_target.GetName]. A military expedition might serve Her will...

marauder.32.a.zh: 我们会给你们付钱的，请好好教训他们。
marauder.32.a.en: We'll pay. Teach them a lesson.

marauder.34.1.desc.zh:
整个星系中最强的是[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesName]雇佣兵，这帮家伙虽然看着很粗野，但其纪律性堪称一流。为了贯彻自己的荣耀，他们甚至会按照雇主的要求去攻击其他的[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

这些是目前能够雇佣的舰队。
marauder.34.1.desc.en:
[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are the finest in the entire galaxy. Do not let their rowdy nature deceive you - when battle is joined, their discipline is second to none. Their honor would even compel them to fight against other [marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesNamePlural], should you wish it.

These are the fleets that are currently available for hire.

marauder.34.2.desc.zh:
哪怕是最强的泥蛮战士也敌不过[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName]的婴孩，嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！这可是众所周知的。

但这些可不是婴孩！！！这些强悍的[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName]佣兵打起仗来可是十分恐怖的！他们愿意为你这样的泥蛮效力，也愿意攻打其他的泥蛮，如果你开的价合适的话，他们甚至愿意攻击[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！

目前可雇佣的[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName]舰队名单如下：
marauder.34.2.desc.en:
Even [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName] infants can defeat bestest dwamak warriors. HYEEIIEE!!!! It is known.

But these not infants!!! These hardened [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries, and they be not only dangerous, but they be DERANGED! They willing to fight for dwamaks like YOU, against other dwamaks or even [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... if you pay!

Here current list of crazy [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesName] fleets:

marauder.34.3.desc.zh:
我们的战士中有一些人认为消灭无信者是在贯彻虚空之母的意愿，哪怕是因为其他无信者的命令。他们会毫不犹豫的消灭其他的[marauder_country_3.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因为在这些激进分子眼中，除了自己之外，其他人都是异端。

不过不要担心。他们不会蠢到攻击雇主的。顺带说一句，我也很安全：因为他们的工作是我给找的，而我也能从他们获得的利润中分一杯羹。

这些是目前可以雇佣的舰队：
marauder.34.3.desc.en:
There are several cults among our warriors who feel that killing unbelievers, even at the behest of other unbelievers, aligns with Her will. They will not even shrink away from killing other [marauder_country_3.GetSpeciesNamePlural], since these radicals see everyone but themselves as heretics.

Not to worry, though. They are not foolish enough to attack their employer. Incidentally, I too am safe from their wrath, since I bring them work in exchange for a modest cut of their profits.

These are the fleets currently available for hire:

marauder.34.d.zh: 算了，让我们讨论下其他事务吧。
marauder.34.d.en: Never mind. Let us discuss other matters.

marauder.35.1.desc.zh:
哈哈，你脑子被踢坏了吧，外来者！你想让我们帮你去对抗那些古圣？

这我得拒绝。
marauder.35.1.desc.en:
Haha! You are truly mad, outsider. You would have us go up against the old ones?

I think not.

marauder.35.2.desc.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢嘢！！！！

不，泥蛮，虽然我们一向行事疯癫，但我们还没有疯狂到敢去攻击那些堕落的泥蛮。
marauder.35.2.desc.en:
HYEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!!!!!!!!!

No. Dwamak, we mad, but not mad enough to try bash fallen-dwamaks.

marauder.35.3.desc.zh:
虽然他们是无信仰者，但现在对他们发起攻击无异于以卵击石，这并不是虚空之母的意愿。

要收拾他们的话，至少也得等一两千年以后才行。
marauder.35.3.desc.en:
Though they are unbelievers, She of the Void would not have us throw away our ships in a vain attempt to smite the elder races.

Their time will come... in a millennium or two.

marauder.37.1.a.desc.zh:
恭喜，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，有了这支刚雇佣的舰队，你就可以袭击[random_fallen_empire.GetName]了！

哎呀，可能现在还不是动手的时候。不过有一件事是确定无疑的：这支佣兵舰队的实力很强！
marauder.37.1.a.desc.en:
Congratulations, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. With the fleet you have just hired, you could storm the [random_fallen_empire.GetName]!

Well, perhaps not. But make no mistake: it is a powerful force!

marauder.37.1.b.desc.zh: 这支舰队是你的了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。谨记：一个[marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesName]至少可以匹敌其他种族的十名战士。你可以以此来调整你的军力计算。
marauder.37.1.b.desc.en: The flotilla is yours, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Remember: a single [marauder_country_1.GetSpeciesName] is worth at least ten warriors of any other species. You may adjust your force calculations accordingly.

marauder.37.2.a.desc.zh: 你的选择是正确的，泥蛮！既然你雇佣了这支狂暴的[marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，其他的泥蛮就无法雇佣他们来攻击你了！嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！！
marauder.37.2.a.desc.en: You make wise decision, dwamak! By hiring these unstable [marauder_country_2.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you make certain some other dwamak not hire them and send them after you! HYEEEIIIIEEE!!!!

marauder.37.3.a.desc.zh: 这些圣战士们会好好为你效力的，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。但有一点要注意，不要登他们的船。他们将自己的船视为神圣之物，任何胆敢上他们船的无信仰者将会受到虚空之母的惩罚。
marauder.37.3.a.desc.en: These holy warriors will serve you well, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Just... do not trespass on their ships. They are considered sacred, and She of the Void would not look kindly on any unbelievers who tread on their hallowed decks.

marauder.40.1.desc.zh:
好，这可以安排，我们有许多厉害的战士在寻找新的挑战和机遇。

如果你能提供足够好的价码来使他们废除与同族所立下的誓约，那他们就可以对你宣誓效忠并为你而战。
marauder.40.1.desc.en:
Yes, this can be arranged. Many of our greatest warriors are searching for new challenges and opportunities.

If you can afford the price to release them from their sworn service to their kinfolk, they will gladly swear an oath to follow you and fight your battles.

marauder.40.2.desc.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！没错，没错！许多精明的[marauder_species.GetName]战士们很乐意为泥蛮而战呢！只要开的条件合适的话就行。
marauder.40.2.desc.en: HYEEEIIIEEEEEEE!! Yes, yes! Many smart [marauder_species.GetName] warriors glad to fight for dwamak moolah! Only need right incentive.

marauder.40.3.desc.zh:
是的，我们最强的战士们很乐意领导你的士兵们去战斗。有了你的能量币的支持，我们就能更好的服侍虚空之母了。

我们的战士们之所以英勇且战斗力强，就是因为他们毕生服侍虚空之母。
marauder.40.3.desc.en:
Yes, our greatest warriors are willing to lead your soldiers into battle. With the support of your energy credits, we will be able to serve Her with even greater fervor.

You will find that a lifetime of serving She of the Void has made our officers both fearless and effective.

marauder.40.a.response.zh: 非常好，誓约已经立下，现在你可以随意的使用这些战士了。
marauder.40.a.response.en: Very good. The oath has been sworn, and the warrior is yours to do with as you will.

marauder.40.b.response.zh: 哎呀！这个[marauder_species.GetName]非常的狡诈！你很幸运哦，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
marauder.40.b.response.en: Oooh! This [marauder_species.GetName] very cunning! You lucky, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

marauder.40.c.response.zh: 虚空之母为我们签下了这一契约赐福，希望我们的勇士能够助你实现心愿。
marauder.40.c.response.en: She of the Void has blessed the sealing of this contract. May our champion serve you well.

marauder.5.desc.zh:
曾经辉煌的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]游牧战士文明已经消亡了。[marauder_killer.GetName]的势力摧毁了最后一座容纳着其大部分成员的巨大空间站。幸存的难民们在星系中四散奔逃。

尽管可能有些[From.GetSpeciesName]海盗和佣兵成了漏网之鱼，失去太空居所对他们来说是一个无法挽回的致命打击。这彻底终结了他们的侵略生涯。
marauder.5.desc.en:
The once proud nomadic warrior culture of the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is no more. Forces from the [marauder_killer.GetName] have destroyed the last of the massive space stations that housed the majority of their population. Refugees from their surviving civilian population have scattered across the galaxy.

Although some [From.GetSpeciesName] pirate and mercenary fleets may still be unaccounted for, the loss of their space dwellings is a devastating blow that they cannot recover from. This puts a definite end to their raiding.

marauder.50.desc.zh:
我们与[Root.GetName]的雇佣兵契约已经到期了。他们的领袖————指挥官[Root.Leader.GetName]立刻提出与我们续约，让目前听命于[Root.Leader.GetHerHis]的那些舰船再为我们服务五年…… 当然必须另付费用。

如果我们拒绝，这些雇佣兵就会离开我们，去找其他的雇主。
marauder.50.desc.en:
Our contract with the mercenaries in the [Root.GetName] has come to an end. Their leader, Commander [Root.Leader.GetName], has offered to immediately extend the services of the ships under [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] command to us for another five years... at an extra charge.

If we refuse, the mercenaries will depart in search of employment elsewhere.

marauder.501.desc.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会将目光转向这片星河的其他地方。所有舰队聚集起来，载运着无数狂热战士。尽管他们数个月之前还是刀兵相见的敌人，但现在，他们是渴望一同对外战争扩张的同志了。
marauder.501.desc.en:
For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste and accomplished what most thought impossible. Through a combination of guile, charisma and military genius, the newly crowned Great Khan has won the utter loyalty and devotion of all [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] factions.

Now that they are no longer busy killing each other, the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their attention elsewhere. Great fleets are massing for war, crewed by eager warriors who are now steadfast comrades in arms despite having been mortal enemies mere months ago.

marauder.502.desc.zh:
我是[raider_khanate.Ruler.GetName]，是[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗，我在这里向整个星系宣布，我们即将迎来新时代。[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]为了荣耀和资源而彼此争斗的黑暗时代已经结束了。

我向我的人民保证，新建立的伟大帝国将让[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]物种的名字永远刻在星系编年史中。

那些企图阻碍我们的人给我记好了：我将不惜一切代价让我的人民实现自己的抱负，如果你们胆敢反抗我们，[raider_khanate.GetName]必将消灭你们。
marauder.502.desc.en:
I am [raider_khanate.Ruler.GetName], Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and I am here to announce to the galaxy that a new age is upon us. The dark era where [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would senselessly butcher one another for scraps of resources or a misguided sense of honor has finally come to an end.

I have solemnly promised my people a new beginning through the formation of a great empire that will forever enshrine the name of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] species in the annals of galactic history.

To those who would stand in our way, know this: I will stop at nothing to realize the true destiny of my people. If you oppose us, the [raider_khanate.GetName] will grind you into dust.

marauder.504.a.en: The Great Khan must be stopped!

marauder.504.desc.zh: 在击溃了[conquered_planet.GetName]的守军后，[From.GetName]的地面部队以大可汗之名占领了[conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]！他们在[conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表上的主要定居点高高升起这个新兴帝国的旗帜。现在，[From.GetSpeciesName]的殖民者们被赶出了他们已被摧毁的居住地，装进了运输舰中。
marauder.504.desc.en: After defeating the brave defenders of [conquered_planet.GetName], ground forces from the [From.GetName] have claimed the [conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon] in the name of their Great Khan! They have raised the banner of their new empire over every major settlement on the [conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Even now, [From.GetSpeciesName] colonists are being ferried in from their decaying space habitats.

marauder.506.a.zh: 看来大可汗并非不可战胜。
marauder.506.a.en: So the Great Khan is not infallible.

marauder.506.desc.zh:
[great_khan.GetName]，[From.GetName]的大可汗，[great_khan.GetHerHis]自吹自擂称自己是军事天才 ，却在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭受了可耻的失败。[great_khan.GetSheHe]指挥的舰队在与[khan_destroyer.GetName]的舰队交战中被击溃时，大可汗和[great_khan.GetHerHis]的侍从们却乘着小型运输机逃进超空间航道四散逃离。.

尽管到现在，[great_khan.GetName]仍在筹备一支新的舰队重新开始[great_khan.GetHerHis]的争战，但这次伟大的胜利将给一切反抗贪得无厌的[From.GetName]侵略者的国家带来巨大鼓舞。
marauder.506.desc.en:
In spite of [great_khan.GetHerHis] vaunted military genius, [great_khan.GetName], the Great Khan of the [From.GetName], has met with defeat in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system. When the armada [great_khan.GetSheHe] [great_khan.GetWasWere] commanding was lost in battle against forces belonging to the [khan_destroyer.GetName], the Great Khan and [great_khan.GetHerHis] closest officers fled into hyperspace in a small shuttlecraft.

Even now, [great_khan.GetName] is busy assembling a new armada to resume [great_khan.GetHerHis] conquests, but this victory has brought some much needed respite to those who oppose the relentless advance of the [From.GetName].

marauder.508.desc.1.zh: $marauder.508.desc$在战争结束后，所有支持我的辖区总督们都会得到我的封赏。
marauder.508.desc.1.en: $marauder.508.desc$ After this war is over, my loyal Satraps shall be rewarded for their support.

marauder.508.desc.2.zh: $marauder.508.desc$宣誓臣服于我吧，趁着你们还有时间选择。
marauder.508.desc.2.en: $marauder.508.desc$ Swear fealty to me now, while you still have time.

marauder.508.desc.3.en: $marauder.508.desc$ All who attempt to stand in my way shall be vanquished.

marauder.510.desc.zh:
大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了。[great_khan.GetHerHis]的舰队在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭遇了第二次失败，在舰队被[khan_destroyer.GetName]击败后，大可汗没有尝试逃跑，而是决心与[great_khan.GetHerHis]的旗舰一同赴死.

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[From.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的军阀们正兵戎相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的控制权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
marauder.510.desc.en:
Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] is dead. After [great_khan.GetHerHis] armada met with defeat a second time in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system, the Great Khan made no attempt to escape [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship when it was destroyed in battle by the [khan_destroyer.GetName].

With their beloved leader gone, a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [From.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other for control over [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

marauder.510.name.en: The Death of the Great Khan

marauder.513.a.desc.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
marauder.513.a.desc.en:
Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

With their beloved leader gone, a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

marauder.513.b.desc.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！根据我们截获到的信息，大可汗的死因是没能抵御住名为萨拉凯利安热病的病魔侵袭，这是[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的一种常见而致命的疾病，是[raider_khanate.GetName]崛起前其太空站恶劣生活环境的遗产。
marauder.513.b.desc.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! According to intercepted communications, the Great Khan succumbed to Sarakellian Fever, a relatively common and often fatal disease found among [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - a legacy of the poor living conditions on the space stations where most of them lived before the rise of the [raider_khanate.GetName].

marauder.513.c.desc.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了! 截留到的信息显示，大可汗是被一个未知的星际势力派遣出的特种部队刺杀。目前没有任何一个政府对此事表示负责。
marauder.513.c.desc.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Intercepted communications suggest that the Great Khan was violently assassinated by a special forces team in the employ of an as yet unidentified galactic power. No government has been willing to claim responsibility for this operation.

marauder.513.d.desc.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是在[great_khan.GetHerHis]旗舰上[great_khan.GetHerHis]的私人房间被一名外星姬妾刺杀。刺杀动机不明。
marauder.513.d.desc.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are vague, but intercepted transmissions have revealed that the Great Khan was murdered by an alien concubine in [great_khan.GetHerHis] private chambers onboard [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship. The motive is unknown.

marauder.513.e.desc.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗死了！根据目前截留到的信息，[great_khan.GetName][great_khan.GetHerHis]由于年老，在几天前无疾而终了。

尽管人们相信可汗指定了一位继承人，但[raider_khanate.GetName]还是掀起了一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主们正为了争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产——帝国的控制权而兵戎相见，究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
marauder.513.e.desc.en:
The Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead. According to intercepted transmissions, [great_khan.GetName] passed away naturally at some point during the last few days as a result of [great_khan.GetHerHis] advanced age.

It is believed that the Great Khan had appointed a designated successor, but despite this a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

marauder.516.desc.zh: 我们的军队成功从可汗军手中解放了[liberated_planet.GetName]！现在[liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon]终于回到了我们的掌控中。
marauder.516.desc.en: Our forces have successfully liberated [liberated_planet.GetName] from its occupation by the Great Khan's soldiery! The [liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon] has finally been returned to our full control.

marauder.517.a.en: To the victor go the spoils.

marauder.517.b.zh: 我们是解放者，而非征服者。

marauder.519.desc.zh: 在成功的进攻并击败了[liberated_planet.GetName]上的可汗军后，[From.GetName]向我们和善地提出归还[liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon]控制权的请求。
marauder.519.desc.en: After successfully storming [liberated_planet.GetName] and defeating the Great Khan's forces stationed on its surface, the [From.GetName] has graciously offered to restore the [liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon] to our full control.

marauder.524.a.desc.zh:
尽管大可汗是否还会重出江湖、出现在某一支新舰队上的念头仍让人忧心忡忡，但从部落的全面失利看来这种可能性微乎其微。

虽然其尸首下落不明，但据信大可汗还是在最后一个部落的空间站和战舰被摧毁的时候战死了。
marauder.524.a.desc.en:
Despite concerns that the Great Khan would somehow resurface at the head of a new battle fleet, the utter defeat of the Horde seems to have made that impossible.

Although no body has been found, the Great Khan is believed to have died when the last of the Horde's stations and starships were destroyed.

marauder.524.b.desc.zh:
$marauder.524.a.desc$

与此同时，我们的船员仍继续在前可汗舰队的残骸中搜寻。他们发现了一座漂浮在太空中的巨大染血座椅，并且基本可以肯定这一张座椅就是大可汗的王座。
marauder.524.b.desc.en:
$marauder.524.a.desc$

Meanwhile, our crews have continued to sift through the wreckage of the Khan's former flagship. They found a large blood-stained chair floating in space, and are reasonably certain that this piece of furniture was, in fact, the Great Khan's throne.

marauder.526.desc.zh:
近期，一个处于[awakened_horde.GetName]控制下的太空居所被摧毁，这直接导致[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]历史上破天荒地团结在一位大可汗的统治之下。这位神秘的军阀以超群之才，据传是一位力量强大的灵媒，说服了[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]各族搁置争议，谋求生存。

庞大的战舰从先前隐藏的锚地中徐徐驶出，载满了[From.GetSpeciesName]的狂热战士。在大可汗的领导与鼓舞之下，他们将替死去的同胞向这片星海发起绝罚。
marauder.526.desc.en:
The recent destruction of one of their large void dwellings at the hands of the [awakened_horde.GetName] has prompted the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to unite under a single Great Khan for the first time in history. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has convinced the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to put aside their differences for the sake of continued survival.

Great war fleets from previously hidden anchorages are being crewed by eager [From.GetSpeciesName] warriors and restored into working order. Under the inspired leadership of their Great Khan, they now demand vengeance from the galaxy for their lost kin.

marauder.550.a.zh: 我们想要讨论归顺的事……
marauder.550.a.en: We would like to discuss surrender...

marauder.550.a.2.response.zh: 你觉得我会蠢到再次相信[Root.GetSpeciesName]吗？不，这次就只有头破血流了。你已经主动放弃了存在于我建立的宇宙新秩序的资格。
marauder.550.a.2.response.en: Do you think I am fool enough to trust [Root.GetSpeciesName] lies a second time? No, this time the fight is to the end. You have forfeited your right to exist in the new galactic order I am building.

marauder.550.a.desc.zh: 我决不会辜负[raider_khanate.GetName]。数十亿人正遵循我的引导。
marauder.550.a.desc.en: I will not fail the [raider_khanate.GetName]. Billions rely on my guidance.

marauder.550.b.zh: 你一个[From.GetSpeciesName]……口舌之活倒挺顺溜的嘛。
marauder.550.b.en: You seem very... articulate for a [From.GetSpeciesName].

marauder.550.b.desc.zh: 吾乃万汗之汗，[great_khan.GetName]。你是来臣服于我的统治的吗？
marauder.550.b.desc.en: This is Great Khan [great_khan.GetName]. Have you come to submit to my rule?

marauder.550.b.response.zh:
嗯，是的。你说的一定是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之前使用的，比较原始又比较……唔，粗野的方言吧。

说来你可能不信，但[From.GetSpeciesName]的语言也曾高度发达过。只是刚刚过去的这一千年中才退化到了如此不堪的地步。

但这一现状马上要改变了。从现在开始，所有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都会学习我们语言最丰富，最古老的版本。尖叫什么的就再也听不到了。
marauder.550.b.response.en:
Ah, yes. You are perhaps referring to the somewhat crude and... shall we say, rustic dialect that has been used by [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] up until now.

You may not believe this, but the [From.GetSpeciesName] language was once far more developed. It is only in the last thousand years or so that it has gradually devolved into its current sorry state.

But that changes now. Henceforth, all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be educated in the older, richer version of our language. There shall be no more shrieking.

marauder.550.c.en: What happened to "She of the Void"?

marauder.550.c.desc.en: There is nothing impossible to him who will try.

marauder.550.c.response.zh:
迷信与宗教只为[From.GetSpeciesName]带来了无穷的毁灭。想要继续崇拜虚空之母或其他精神象征的人都可以继续，但这已不再是什么强制要求了。

我想带[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与整个宇宙一起进入科学与进步的全新时代。思维狭隘的狂热分子是不能进入我要构建的未来的。
marauder.550.c.response.en:
Superstitious beliefs and religious dogma have brought nothing but ruin to the [From.GetSpeciesName] people. Those who wish to continue in their worship of She of the Void, or any other spiritual symbol for that matter, are free to do so, but it is no longer mandatory.

I mean to bring about a new age of science and progress for [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and, indeed, for the whole of the galaxy. Narrow-minded zealots have no place in the future I am building.

marauder.550.d.zh: 我们想要回我们的自治权。

marauder.550.d.desc.zh: 你已有幸面见大可汗。有什么话就说吧。
marauder.550.d.desc.en: You are in the presence of the Great Khan. Speak your mind.

marauder.550.d_fail.zh: 归顺大可汗后，一年内不可进行反对行动！
marauder.550.d_fail.en: You cannot rebel until one year has passed since submitting to the Great Khan.

marauder.550.e.desc.en: Who would seek an audience with the Great Khan?

marauder.550.f.desc.zh: 星光下还有更多的地盘等待我们征服。
marauder.550.f.desc.en: There are more worlds to conquer.

marauder.550.g.desc.zh: 我的子民经受了够多的苦难了。我将为他们在这片星河中开辟新的生存空间。
marauder.550.g.desc.en: My people have endured enough hardship. I will carve for them a new home amongst the stars.

marauder.550.h.desc.zh: 我为那些被我们的军队所戕害的生命流泪，但为了[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]的未来别无他法。.
marauder.550.h.desc.en: I weep for those who fall before my forces, but there is no other way if the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] people are to have a future.

marauder.550.i.desc.zh:
我正在建设的帝国将让整个星河受益。尽管现在看来它远非如此，但终有一天，它将成为这个宇宙里稳定而繁荣的灯塔，吸引着全宇宙所有智慧生命。

最终，和平之光将在这个星河闪耀。我一定会做到。
marauder.550.i.desc.en:
The empire I am building shall benefit the whole of the galactic community. It may not seem like it now, but one day it will become a beacon of stability and prosperity for all intelligent life forms.

Peace shall, at last, reign in the galaxy. I will make it so.

marauder.550.j.desc.zh: 我的朝廷永远对忠诚的总督们开放。你有什么事想问吗？
marauder.550.j.desc.en: My court is always open to my loyal Satraps. What would you ask of me?

marauder.550.k.desc.zh: 你是代表[Root.GetSpeciesName]的辖地，对吗？[Root.GetName]，好像是这个名字。大可汗能给你做点什么呢?
marauder.550.k.desc.en: You speak to me on behalf of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] Satrapy, yes? The... [Root.GetName], I believe. What can your Great Khan do for you?

marauder.550.l.desc.zh:
尽管你们不是有机生命体，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但所有臣服于[raider_khanate.GetName]的智慧生命都会被平等对待。

我发誓。
marauder.550.l.desc.en:
Your kind may not be organic, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but all forms of intelligent life that are subjects of the [raider_khanate.GetName] shall be treated equally.

This I swear.

marauder.550.m.desc.zh: 有时候我也会想，要是我像你一样是个机器人，很多事就简单多了。唉。
marauder.550.m.desc.en: Sometimes I think life would be far easier were I a machine like you. Alas.

marauder.550.n.desc.zh: 也就是说与我对话的是[Root.GetSpeciesName]的中心意识咯？真有趣。
marauder.550.n.desc.en: Is this the [Root.GetSpeciesName] central consciousness that I am addressing, then? Fascinating.

marauder.550.o.desc.zh: 听说[Root.GetSpeciesName]的无人机会无条件地服从蜂巢思维主脑的命令。只要你们的集体意识也像这样服从我，我们就能愉快相处。
marauder.550.o.desc.en: I understand that [Root.GetSpeciesName] drones obey the commands of their Hive Mind without question. As long as your Hive Mind serves me in a similar fashion, we shall have no problems.

marauder.550.p.desc.zh: 你接受我的统治是明智之举。这样就能确保[Root.GetSpeciesName]的幸福生活了。
marauder.550.p.desc.en: You were wise to submit to my rule. This decision saved countless [Root.GetSpeciesName] lives.

marauder.550.q.desc.zh: 你知道吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]其实十分相似。你们将在我建立的宇宙帝国中扮演重要的角色。
marauder.550.q.desc.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not very different, you know. Your kind will have an important role to play in the galactic empire we are building together.

marauder.550.r.desc.zh: 我相信了你，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我给你在我的桌子前提供一席之地……你却用这种行为作为对我的报答。
marauder.550.r.desc.en: I trusted you, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I offered you a seat at my table... and in return, you spat in my face.

marauder.550.s.desc.zh: 我绝不容许反叛的行为。没什么好谈的了。
marauder.550.s.desc.en: I do not suffer traitors. We have nothing to discuss.

marauder.550.t.desc.zh:
背后捅刀的小人。你还好意思说自己想成为辖地？

你竟敢愚弄我，我绝不能原谅。
marauder.550.t.desc.en:
Treacherous scum. So you wanted to be a Satrapy, did you?

You made me look the fool, and that is something I cannot forgive.

marauder.550.v.desc.zh:
你以及那些和你一样轻视感性生命的家伙们，正是我需要去坚实引领宇宙的原因。

你们的持续存在本身就是一个威胁。我决定终止这一威胁。
marauder.550.v.desc.en:
You and those who share your utter disregard for sentient life are why the galaxy is in such dire need of my firm guidance.

Your continued existence is a threat in and of itself. I mean to bring it to an end.

marauder.550.w.desc.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！泥蛮！你们正在……*咳嗽*

我、我是说，你正在与令人敬畏的大可汗对话，有话快说。
marauder.550.w.desc.en:
HYEEIIIIEEEEE, dwamak! You speak to... *cough*

I... I mean, you are in the august presence of the Great Khan. Speak thy mind.

marauder.551.a.desc.zh:
明智的选择。归顺之后，你将成为[raider_khanate.GetName]的辖地，需要为我们正在进行的战争提供人员与资源。然而，除此之外，你并不需要置身前线，在我们征服全星系之前，你只要料理好自己的事务就可以了。

成为辖地后将获得：
£energy£ -30% 能量币收入
£minerals£ -30% 矿物收入
£food£ -30% 食物收入
£navy_size£ -30% 舰队规模

[raider_khanate.GetName]会变得更加强大。
marauder.551.a.desc.en:
A wise choice. Upon your surrender, you will become a Satrapy of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and be expected to contribute resources and military personnel to our ongoing wars. Beyond that, however, you will not be required to take part in the actual fighting, and I am content to leave you to your own devices until we have secured the galaxy.

Becoming a Satrapy will result in:
£energy£ -30% Energy Credit income
£minerals£ -30% Mineral income
£food£ -30% Food income
£navy_size£ -30% Naval Capacity

The [raider_khanate.GetName] will grow more powerful.

marauder.551.a.response.zh:
你现在已被允许将自身视为[raider_khanate.GetName]之大可汗忠诚的仆从。签订契约后，无数[Root.GetSpeciesName]的性命得以拯救。对[Root.GetName]来说真是伟大的日子。

等我平定了宇宙，我们再回头考虑如何调整辖地制度；或许我会把你们的领地以一种更加紧密地方式划入到我方帝国。不过那是以后的事情，现在还是你爱怎么统治就怎么统治。
marauder.551.a.response.en:
You may now consider yourselves loyal servants of the Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName]. With the signing of this accord, countless [Root.GetSpeciesName] lives have been saved. This is a great day for the [Root.GetName].

Once my conquest of the galaxy has been completed, we shall see about revising the Satrapy system and perhaps integrating your realm more closely into my empire. Until then, I leave you to rule yourselves.

marauder.551.b.zh: 你搞错了。我们是说要你归顺。
marauder.551.b.en: You misunderstand. We meant your surrender.

marauder.551.b.response.zh:
哈！这不可能。

那么我们只好兵戎相见了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。对我来说没有区别——你们的星球无论如何都会归顺[raider_khanate.GetName]的。
marauder.551.b.response.en:
Ha! That shall never come to pass.

Your fate will be decided on the field of battle then, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It makes no difference to me - your worlds will be claimed by the [raider_khanate.GetName] one way or another.

marauder.552.desc.zh:
[new_satrapy.GetName]已经归顺了大可汗！他们已成了[raider_khanate.GetName]的辖地，舰队也已解除了敌对状态。

虽然他们还没有正式加入[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对于星辰大海的伟大征程，但已经承诺为大可汗的战争机器提供资源与人员！
marauder.552.desc.en:
The [new_satrapy.GetName] has submitted to the Great Khan! They have been made a Satrapy of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and their fleets are now standing down.

Although they have not officially joined the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in their attempted conquest of the galaxy, they have pledged to contribute resources and military personnel to further bolster the Great Khan's war machine.

marauder.553.desc.zh: 为了“保护”我们，[raider_khanate.GetName]已在[capital_star.GetName]星系建立了一座大型军事基地，还驻扎了为数不小的舰队。这个基地的第二层用意似乎是为了鼓励我们尽快完成作为辖地的职责，并监督召集[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]加入大可汗舰队的进度。
marauder.553.desc.en: For our "protection" the [raider_khanate.GetName] has established a large military space installation in the [capital_star.GetName] system, defended by a sizable garrison fleet. The secondary role of this base appears to be to encourage us to fulfill our obligations as a Satrapy and to oversee the recruitment of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to serve in the Great Khan's battle fleets.

marauder.554.a.desc.zh:
好好考虑吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。如果你再这样执迷不悟，可就没有回头路了。想再提出归顺，我是不会接受的。

胆敢进行反对的辖地，只有彻底消失一途。
marauder.554.a.desc.en:
Think this through, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. If you go down this path, there will be no turning back. I will not accept a second surrender.

The only possible fate of a rebelling Satrapy is its complete destruction.

marauder.554.a.response.zh:
那好吧。你们已经走上了绝路，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我一定会抹除你们的帝国的——我发誓！

这将为整个星系提供一个上好的例子，忤逆大可汗的意志下场会是如何。
marauder.554.a.response.en:
So be it. You have doomed your people, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. I will not rest until your wretched empire lies in ruins - this I pledge!

It shall serve as an example to the rest of the galaxy of what it means to defy the will of the Great Khan.

marauder.554.b.en: Oh. In that case, never mind.

marauder.554.b.response.zh: 早知如此。不要试探我的耐心，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
marauder.554.b.response.en: I thought as much. Do not try my patience, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

marauder.6.desc.zh:
一支[marauder_species.GetName]佣兵的大舰队在[attacked_system.GetName]星系脱离了超空间！看来在我们摧毁他们最后一座空间站时，部署在其它地方而幸存的[marauder_species.GetName]佣兵们摒弃前嫌并联手合作了。

我们不清楚他们是如何躲开我们的探测器并抵达[attacked_system.GetName]的，但他们在公开频道上发布了一条信息。
marauder.6.desc.en:
A large fleet of [marauder_species.GetName] mercenaries has translated out of hyperspace in the [attacked_system.GetName] system! It looks like all of the surviving [marauder_species.GetName] mercenary outfits that were deployed elsewhere when we smashed their last space station have put their differences aside and joined forces.

We are not certain how they managed to elude our sensor cover to reach [attacked_system.GetName], but they are transmitting a message on an open channel.

marauder.620.a.en: It was not meant to be.

marauder.620.desc.zh:
大可汗的逝去导致了[From.GetName]的崩溃。没有了强势的统治者，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]又一次陷入了内斗。帝国在各个继业者，最强大也最有权势的高级军官们，的领导下分为数派。

每一派都自称为星帐的大可汗，不允许任何人的质疑。[From.GetSpeciesName]团结一心的日子走到了尽头。
marauder.620.desc.en:
The death of the Great Khan has proved the undoing of the [From.GetName]. Without a strong ruler to unite them, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have succumbed to infighting once more. Their empire has been divided between the Diadochi, the most powerful and influential of the Great Khan's military commanders.

Each of them now claims the title of Great Khan of the Galaxy, and their supporters are locked in bitter opposition to one another. The time of a united [From.GetSpeciesName] empire is apparently at an end.

marauder.630.desc.zh:
大可汗去世之前，有很多的改革工作正在进行中，旨在将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从一个个松散无序的部族变成一个团结有力的星际帝国。现在大可汗的去世让这所有的改革瞬间消失殆尽。

所有继承大可汗的军阀们都没有对这些改革展现一丝兴趣，而[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]也都回归了以前的掠夺者行事方式。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已成一盘散沙。
marauder.630.desc.en:
The death of the Great Khan has also proved the killing blow for the many reforms that were instituted by the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to turn their disorganized marauder clans into a consolidated galactic empire.
