None of the warlords who succeeded the Great Khan have shown the least bit of interest in continuing these reforms, and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have all reverted to the old ways of their violent marauder past. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are united no longer.

marauder.640.a.zh: 就看看他们能苟活到什么时候。
marauder.640.a.en: We shall see how long they survive.

marauder.640.desc.zh:
出人意料地，[From.GetSpeciesName]帝国成功挺过了大可汗死后的种种波动。由于新可汗立刻加冕，也完全消灭了大家分道扬镳的念头。

目前来说，重获新生的[From.GetSpeciesName]似乎把重心放在了巩固已有疆土之上，对于新的征程兴趣不大。
marauder.640.desc.en:
Against all odds, the [From.GetSpeciesName] Horde has managed to weather the turmoil that followed in the wake of the death of the Great Khan. The immediate threat of splintering into different successor states has been largely eliminated with the coronation of a new khan.

For now, this reborn [From.GetSpeciesName] Khanate seems more concerned with the consolidation of the territory it already controls than making new conquests.

marauder.660.a.zh: 我们就加入这个新的联邦吧。
marauder.660.a.en: We shall join this new federation.

marauder.661.a.en: We shall see what comes of this.

marauder.665.a.zh: 那边到底是怎么回事啊？

marauder.665.a.desc.zh: <<大可汗的逝世使得[From.GetSpeciesName]帝国陷入了混乱。无人接听你的通讯。>>
marauder.665.a.desc.en: << The death of the Great Khan has thrown the [From.GetSpeciesName] Horde into disarray. No one is willing or able to receive your call. >>

marauder.670.desc.zh:
大可汗去世之后混乱和动乱随之而来，我们作为帝国中的辖地的历史一去不返——我们宣誓效忠的目标仅仅是大可汗。我们现在又可以追寻我们自己的命运了。

驻扎在[Root.Capital.solar_system.GetName]的汗国全体军事人员都离开他们的哨所回到自己的人民当中去了，第一次拆除之后剩余的军事用品都留在了那里。
marauder.670.desc.en:
With chaos and instability following in the wake of the Great Khan's death, our status as a Satrapy within the Horde is void - our oath of fealty was to the Great Khan alone. We are once more free to pursue our own destiny.

All Horde military personnel that were stationed in the [Root.Capital.solar_system.GetName] system have abandoned their posts to join their people elsewhere, after first demolishing any war material left behind.

marauder.671.desc.zh: 由于新汗国在维持大可汗的征伐时遇到困难，其将军决定进一步巩固其战斗军力。因此，他们从各附庸国的驻军空间站中调取了全部人员，并拆除了空间站。
marauder.671.desc.en: As the New Khanate struggles to maintain its hold over the Great Khan's conquests, its military leadership has decided to further consolidate their forces. Consequently, they have withdrawn the personnel from all of their vassal garrison stations and scuttled them.

marauder.7.1.desc.zh:
致[Root.GetName]的卑鄙懦夫们：

既然你们毁了我们的家，我们也要烧了你们的。我们已一无所有——这都拜你们所赐。现在我们只求在战场上倒下，当我们踏上黄泉之路时，也要把你们所谓的战士一并带走。

准备好防御吧！
marauder.7.1.desc.en:
To the wretched cowards of the [Root.GetName]:

As you destroyed our homes, we shall now burn yours. We have nothing left to lose - you have made certain of that. All that we hope for now is to die in battle, and to take as many of your so-called warriors with us as possible when we journey into the Great Beyond.

Ready your defenses!

marauder.7.2.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的泥蛮们！你们砸了我们家，现在我们也来砸你们的！我们知道自己可能活不了，但我们也要尽量拉泥蛮垫背！

干掉所有泥蛮们！嗨咿咿咿嘢嘢嘢嘢！！！！
marauder.7.2.desc.en:
Dwamaks of the [Root.GetName]! You bash our homes, now we bash yours! We know we may not survive, but we take as many dwamaks with us as possible!

Death to all dwamaks! HYEEEEEIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEE!!!!!!!!!!

marauder.7.3.desc.zh:
致[Root.GetName]的背叛者们：

你们玷污了我们的圣地，谋害了无数子民。你们以为虚空之母会饶恕这些罪过吗？

虚空之母要求牺牲，我们必将遵从。这将是我们在这个邪恶世界上的最终谢幕。
marauder.7.3.desc.en:
To the apostates of the [Root.GetName]:

You have defiled our most sacred of spaces and murdered countless of Her subjects. Did you think that She of the Void would let these atrocities pass unanswered?

She demands sacrifice, and we shall deliver. It will be our last act in this wretched world.

marauder.701.desc.zh: 载有大量[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]难民的运输船从[marauder_neighbor.GetName]方向进入了我们的领域。他们肯定是被人从一个个残破的空间站—那些他们曾称之为家园的地方赶出来了，大概是因为资源有限而采取的控制人口的措施。已经允许他们在[Root.GetName]安定下来。
marauder.701.desc.en: Transports carrying a large number of [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] refugees have crossed into our space from the direction of the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. These exiles have apparently been expelled from the decrepit space stations they once called home in some sort of ritual, designed to act as a means of population control in times of limited resources. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.GetName].

marauder.702.a.desc.zh: 与[marauder_neighbor.GetName]持续不断的边境冲突磨炼了我们的部队。他们的能力在实战中得到了锻炼，他们甚至学到了[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]的作战技巧，这肯定能在以后的战斗中给他们带来优势。
marauder.702.a.desc.en: An extended period of unrelenting border skirmishes with the [marauder_neighbor.GetName] has hardened our serving naval crews. Their abilities have been tempered in battle, and our forces have even adopted several complex [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] combat maneuvers that will give them an edge in future conflicts.

marauder.702.b.desc.zh:
与[marauder_neighbor.GetName]在我们的边境上经历了长久的冲突之后，我们的[root.GetIndividualName]群似乎已经发展出了一定程度的自主能力。现在能够自动反制[marauder_neighbor_species.GetNamePlural]不可预料的战法的能力。

当然，在机群发展出具有威胁性的单体作战能力之前必须得到前档处置，但是目前来看，这只会使得我们在短期内可预见的冲突中占尽优势。
marauder.702.b.desc.en:
After a prolonged period of skirmishing with the [marauder_neighbor.GetName] along our border, the [root.GetIndividualName] crews of our vessels seem to have developed a certain degree of initiative. They are now more capable of countering the often unpredictable tactics employed by the [marauder_neighbor_species.GetNamePlural].

This will eventually have to be dealt with before the crews develop a dangerous level of individuality, but for now it will give us an advantage in any future engagements.

marauder.702.c.desc.zh:
我们的作战单位在与[marauder_neighbor.GetName].经历了长久的冲突之后，被迫对编程做出一些更改，以应对[marauder_neighbor_species.GetNamePlural]不可预料的战法。

当然，这种新的数据最终还是要被清除的，不然系统会衰退。但是目前来看，这确实能够使得我们在短期可预见的冲突中占尽优势。
marauder.702.c.desc.en:
The efficiency of our naval units has increased after a prolonged period of border skirmishing with the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. Our units have been forced to make slight alterations to their programming to make up for the unorthodox and unpredictable tactics employed by the [marauder_neighbor_species.GetNamePlural].

It will eventually become necessary to purge this new data to prevent system degradation in other areas, but for now it will give us an advantage in future engagements.

marauder.703.b.zh: 我们不需要新的指挥官了。
marauder.703.b.en: We have no need of another Commander.

marauder.703.c.zh: 将这堆肉块施加安乐死。

marauder.703.desc.zh: 最近在[marauder_neighbor.GetName]的两个军团的交战之后，有一个[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]逃生舱进入了我们的宇域。边境巡逻队截获了这个逃生舱，打开后发现是一位[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]指挥官，这位司令官愿意无偿为我们效忠至死。
marauder.703.desc.en: A [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] escape pod drifted into our space recently, after a particularly violent clash between two warring clans of the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. Border patrol units intercepted the pod and opened it, revealing a grateful [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] flag officer. The Commander has pledged to serve us until death, at no cost.

marauder.703.e.zh: 至死方休？很好，拖出去净化了。
marauder.703.e.en: Until death it is. Dispose of the xeno.

marauder.703.f.zh: 把整个舱丢进我们的合金熔炉。
marauder.703.f.en: Throw the whole pod into our alloy smelter.

marauder.704.a.zh: 好，这些飞船还是有点价值的。
marauder.704.a.en: Yes, they could prove an asset.

marauder.704.b.zh: 不，这些东西都是垃圾。全都拆了。
marauder.704.b.en: No, those ships are space junk. Scrap them.

marauder.704.desc.zh:
一小队废弃的[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]战舰最近在[border_system.GetName]星系被我方发现，此处离[marauder_neighbor.GetName]的领土不远。舰船上的计算机日志显示，船员为了躲避某种形式的部族血斗逃入了我国境内。不幸的是，他们并没有携带足够的补给品，并很快因为饥饿导致全灭。这些舰船从此就在太空中漂浮。

我们的工程师检查了这些舰船，它们依然处于良好的状态。只要配备船员，这些舰船可以立马进入我们的舰队中服役。
marauder.704.desc.en:
A small fleet of derelict [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] warships was recently discovered in the [border_system.GetName] system, not far from the territory of the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. Computer logs on the ships indicate that their crews fled into our space to escape some kind of clan feud. Unfortunately for them, they brought few supplies and soon starved to death. The ships have been adrift ever since.

Our engineers have gone over the ships and they appear to be in decent condition. If they are crewed, we could commission them into service with our own fleet.

marauder.705.desc.zh:
机缘巧合之下，边境巡逻队最近在[border_system.GetName]星系发现了一个深藏在深空之中的资源贮存箱，其位置位于我方和[marauder_neighbor.GetName]的边境。这个超大的货箱里面装满了[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]劫掠收获的战利品，却在太空之中漂浮了几个世纪。

我们推断，大概是这个贮存箱被遗忘了，抑或是货箱的主人在另一场劫掠中或者是数不胜数的[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]内斗中被杀了。不管怎样，这里面的东西现在是我们的了。
marauder.705.desc.en:
By chance, patrol units recently discovered a hidden deep space resource cache in the [border_system.GetName] system, close to our border with the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. The massive cargo containers of the cache contains spoils from several [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] raids that must have been launched centuries ago.

At some point this cache was forgotten, or perhaps its owners were killed in another raid or one of the countless [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] internecine feuds. In any event, its contents now belong to us.

marauder.706.desc.zh:
我们刚刚发现了一个半完成的[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]太空居住站遗迹，其位置位于[border_planet.GetName]，处于我国境内。很显然，过去某个时候[marauder_neighbor.GetName]尝试过在[border_system.GetName]星系建立一个永久居住站，然而由于某些原因这个设施被彻底的遗弃了。

由于其位置十分靠近[border_planet.GetName]，这座未完成的居住站在我方初次调查该星系的时候躲过了检测。现在这座居住地的状况比一堆太空垃圾好不了多少，但是我们依然能够从这堆残骸中发掘价值不菲的矿物。
marauder.706.desc.en:
We have discovered the remnants of a half-finished [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] space habitat in close orbit around [border_planet.GetName], inside our borders. Evidently, at some point the [marauder_neighbor.GetName] attempted to establish a permanent presence in the [border_system.GetName] system, but for whatever reason this endeavour was abandoned.

Due to its close proximity to [border_planet.GetName], the unfinished habitat eluded detection during our initial survey of the system. It is little more than a dense collection of space junk at this point, but there are a lot of valuable minerals among the wreckage that could be salvaged.

marauder.707.a.zh: 我们捞的，那就是我们的。
marauder.707.a.en: By right of salvage, the credits are ours.

marauder.707.desc.zh:
最近有一个[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]飞行器在[border_system.GetName]恒星系进入了我方领域，当时它正被[marauder_neighbor.GetName]的突袭艇追赶着。我们不知道他们为什么被自己的人赶着跑，但是那些突袭艇遇到我们的边境守卫之后就撤退了。

这个损坏严重的飞行器之后被回收，我们发现上面的船员在进入[border_system.GetName]之后不久就死掉了。而它的货仓里满载了偷来的存有能量币的芯片。
marauder.707.desc.en:
A small [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] shuttle recently crossed into our space in the [border_system.GetName] system, pursued by raiders from the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. We are not certain why they were being chased by their own people, but the raiders withdrew when they were challenged by our border security.

The heavily damaged shuttle was recovered, revealing that the crew had perished shortly after they entered [border_system.GetName]. Its cargo hold was filled to the brim with stolen energy credit chips.

marauder.71.desc.zh: 由于[Root.GetName]的前任指挥官意外身亡，[marauder_species.GetNamePlural]派遣指挥官[new_leader.GetName]接替前任指挥官的职务。
marauder.71.desc.en: Following the untimely demise of the former commander of the [Root.GetName], the [marauder_species.GetNamePlural] have dispatched Commander [new_leader.GetName] as a replacement.

marauder.710.desc.zh:
在仔细搜索了大可汗旗舰的残骸后，我们的部队发现一把沾满[FROM.GetBloodType]的大椅子漂浮在太空中。我们有充足的理由推定，这件家具实际上是大可汗的王座。

这件遗珍目前已被放在一个安全的保险库里。
marauder.710.desc.en:
After sifting through the wreckage of the Great Khan's flagship, our forces found a large [FROM.GetBloodType]-stained chair floating in space. We are reasonably certain that this piece of furniture is, in fact, the Great Khan's throne.

The relic has been placed inside a secure vault.

marauder.750.2.desc.khan.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！大星蛮子来啦！快，开好频道！
marauder.750.2.desc.khan.en: HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Big dokwak arrives! Quick, open good channel!

marauder.750.2.desc.low_kills.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！这是谁？你开着其他泥蛮部族的飞船，真是太逊了诶。怎么了？赌博输掉了你的舰队？
marauder.750.2.desc.low_kills.en: HYEEEIIIEEE!!! Who this? You fly ships from other dwamak clan, but look weak. What happen? Lose your fleet in gamble?

marauder.750.2.desc.overlord.zh: 嘿咿咿咿！泥蛮部族的酋长在此！我们现在归您麾下了。有什么吩咐，大佬？
marauder.750.2.desc.overlord.en: HYEEEIIIEEE! Dokwak-chief is here! We fly under your banner now. What you need, boss?

marauder.750.2.desc.proven.zh: 嘿咿咿咿！我们认识你。你很能杀，而且还有牙齿。你想要什么？
marauder.750.2.desc.proven.en: HYEEEIIIEEE! We know you. You killed good and you still have teeth. What you want?

marauder.750.2.desc_01.zh: 这不是我们最喜欢的星蛮子吗！嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！你比把你赶出去的星蛮子好多了。
marauder.750.2.desc_01.en: If it not our favorite dokwaks! HYEEEIIIEEE!!! You better than the dwakam who kicked you out.

marauder.750.2.desc_02.zh: 嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢——等等。你们不是住行星上的泥蛮子。你们是来调查上次袭击的吗？有人派你们来夺回他们的矿石？
marauder.750.2.desc_02.en: HYEEEIIIEEE- wait. You not planet-bound dwamaks. You here about last raid? Someone send you to grab back their minerals?

marauder.750.3.desc.khan.zh: 虚空圣子。我等信徒今日可为您效劳，以实现她的宏图大愿？
marauder.750.3.desc.khan.en: Chosen of the Void. How may we followers help you enact Her vision today?

marauder.750.3.desc.low_kills.zh: 你可能已被你的人民抛弃，但并非无可救药。在虚空之母的关怀之下，任何人都能崛起，只要你提供的了价值。
marauder.750.3.desc.low_kills.en: You may have been forsaken by your own people, yet not beyond redemption. In the embrace of She of the Void any can rise, if you are worthy.

marauder.750.3.desc.overlord.zh: 虚空之母看到了此番安排，并未反对。我们任凭您的差遣。您的意志为何？
marauder.750.3.desc.overlord.en: She of the Void sees this arrangement and does not object. We are yours to command. What is your will?

marauder.750.3.desc.proven.zh: 你已飞越漫漫长路。虚空之母并未忘记你的试炼。是什么让你来到我们这里？
marauder.750.3.desc.proven.en: You have flown the long path. She of the Void has not forgotten your trials. What brings you to us?

marauder.750.3.desc_01.zh: 你的舰船经过此地已经冒犯了我们伟大的夫人。我们将代表你向她请愿。
marauder.750.3.desc_01.en: Your ships passing has upset our great Lady. We will petition Her on your behalf.

marauder.750.3.desc_02.zh:
你还活着？那很好。我们以为你已被那些追捕你的异端特工解决了。

不，我们不是指你以前的部族。我们说的是真正的敌人。
marauder.750.3.desc_02.en:
You yet live? That is good. We thought you be unmade by the heretical agents sent after you.

No, we do not mean your former clan. We speak of the true Foe.

marauder.750.3.desc_03.zh: 虚空之母看着你，露出了微笑。你和朋友在一起。[marauder_country_3.GetName]今天能为你提供什么帮助？
marauder.750.3.desc_03.en: She of the Void sees you and smiles. You are with friends. How can the [marauder_country_3.GetName] support you today?

marauder.750.a.en: Can you help us against the [marauder_country_1.GetName]?

marauder.750.a.response.2.zh: 嘿咿咿咿咿！你真搞笑，星蛮子。不。你太弱了，不配我们的砸砸。先赢得战斗，长出獠牙，然后也许你才能赢得星蛮子这个名字。
marauder.750.a.response.2.en: HYEEEIIIEEE! You are funny, dwakam. No. You much too weak for our smash-smash. Win fights first, grow fangs, then maybe you earn dokwak name.

marauder.750.a.response.3.zh: 现在还不是时候。虚空之母对你不满。或许等你弥补了之前的过失，她会更仁慈一些。
marauder.750.a.response.3.en: Now is not the time. She of the Void is displeased with you. Perhaps once you have atoned for your previous transgressions will she be more benevolent.

marauder.750.c.zh: 机不可失，帮我们阻止那个篡权者！
marauder.750.c.en: Now or never, help us stop the pretender!

marauder.750.e.zh: 我们已准备好再次接收你们的增援。
marauder.750.e.en: We are ready to receive your reinforcements again.

marauder.755.a.zh: 我们会让他们承认我们。
marauder.755.a.en: We will make them acknowledge us.

marauder.755.desc.zh: 我们以前的部族拒绝接受我们的通讯。现在我们是孤军作战。
marauder.755.desc.en: Our former clan refuses to accept our communications. We are alone.

marauder.755.desc.khan_pending.zh:
我们的通讯再次遭到拒绝。作为回应，我们收到了一条自动消息：

“汗王尚未准备好接受你们的投降。待到战争的鼓声响起时再回来吧。”
marauder.755.desc.khan_pending.en:
Once again our communications are rejected. In response we recive an automated message:

"The Khan is not ready to accept your surrender yet. Return once the drums of war have sounded."

marauder.76.desc.zh:
失去母星系似乎对[Root.GetName]的[marauder_species.GetName]雇佣兵造成了很大的打击。尽管我们与他们签订的五年契约还没有到期，可那些家伙竟然连人带船全跑的没影了！

他们最后留下的通讯信息是：

我们一定会报仇的。
marauder.76.desc.en:
The loss of their home systems seem to have badly shaken the [marauder_species.GetName] mercenaries in the [Root.GetName]. In spite of the five-year contract we signed with them, the treacherous brigands and all of their ships have vanished into deep space!

Their last transmission, apparently a code-phrase to signal their departure, was:

"Vengeance shall be ours."

marauder.760.desc.10_kills.zh:
你的名字玷污了我们的通信渠道，你的苟活蒙蔽了我们的荣誉。以此为终。下次我们派遣舰队追击你时，为了节省大家的时间，请直接关掉你的护盾。

像真正的[Root.Species.GetSpeciesName]一样战死沙场吧。
marauder.760.desc.10_kills.en:
You foul our communications with your name and stain our honor with your survival. End it the proper way. Next time we send a fleet after you, save us all the time and just deactivate your shields.

Die in battle like a true [Root.Species.GetSpeciesName].

marauder.760.desc.20_kills.zh:
无论发生什么，虚空都不愿将你留下。我们从账簿上抹去了你的名字，烧毁了你的旗帜，将你的面孔作为给[Root.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]的警示教育。然而，你仍然在我们的装甲上刻下了自己的印记。我们派出了侦察队，然后是突击队，最后是舰队。部族开始私语，称放逐是一个错误。这样的碎碎念将在此终结。

你为何就是不肯去死？！
marauder.760.desc.20_kills.en:
No matter what, the void refused to keep you. We erased you from the ledgers, burned your banners, and made your face the villain in [Root.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] stories. Still, you carve your mark into our plating. We sent flotillas, then squadrons, and now armadas. The clans begin to murmur that the exile was an error. Such talk ends here.

Why won't you die?!

marauder.760.desc.3_kills.zh:
你竟敢再次联系我们？

只是走运成功几次你就趾高气扬得以为自己是个军阀了一样。虚空吞噬勇者，也同样吞噬愚者。别把运气误认为是实力。
marauder.760.desc.3_kills.en:
You dare contact us again?

A few lucky strikes, and already you strut like a warlord. The void claims the bold and the foolish in equal measure. Do not mistake chance for skill.

marauder.760.desc.post_khan_1.zh: 欢迎回家，继承者们。今天需要我们为您做些什么？
marauder.760.desc.post_khan_1.en: Welcome home Heirs. What do you need of us today?

marauder.760.desc.post_khan_2.zh: 最近拿下了什么惊人的战果吗？我们刚跟一只体型巨大的缇扬奇交过手。它再生的速度比激光切割它的速度还要快。
marauder.760.desc.post_khan_2.en: Scored any impressive kills recently? We had a run-in with a particularly large Tiyanki. It regenerated faster than lasers could cut it apart.

marauder.760.desc.post_khan_3.zh: 啊，叛徒们回——啊抱歉，习惯了。今天星辰又带你去了何方？
marauder.760.desc.post_khan_3.en: Ah the traitors retu- Ah sorry, old habits. Where have the stars taken you today?

marauder.765.a.zh: 在我方发出请求前，请暂留援军。
marauder.765.a.en: Hold your reinforcements until we call for them.

marauder.765.b.zh: 恢复向我方派遣增援部队。

marauder.765.desc.khan_01.zh: 大可汗，您的威能令整个星系为之战栗。我们的舰队下一步该剑指何方？
marauder.765.desc.khan_01.en: The galaxy trembles at your might, great Khan. Where shall we point our fleets next?

marauder.765.desc.khan_02.zh:
万汗之汗！所有虚空港中，各部族皆高颂您的威名。我们静候您的号令。

今日，我们将焚尽哪些世界？
marauder.765.desc.khan_02.en:
Khan of Khans! The clans sing your name in every void-port. We await your word.

What worlds do we burn today?

marauder.765.desc.khan_03.zh: 大可汗！请给我们一个机会展示我们的勇气，让我们证明真正的忠诚度。当年将您驱逐是我们莫大的耻辱，若我们不配获得救赎，那就让我们在质量加速器的炮火中毁灭吧！
marauder.765.desc.khan_03.en: Great Khan! Give us a chance to show you our mettle and let us prove our true loyalty. We are shamed by the day we cast you out, and if we are not worthy of redemption then let us die in mass driver fire!

marauder.77.desc.zh: 大可汗麾下[raider_khanate.GetName]的崛起让很多同我们签订契约的[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]雇佣兵陷入了民族主义的狂潮，这些雇佣兵无视与我们签订的契约，并纷纷倒戈加入了大可汗的阵营。
marauder.77.desc.en: The rise of the [raider_khanate.GetName] under their vaunted Great Khan has triggered mass defections among all of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries that were in our employ! Caught up in a sudden influx of nationalistic fervor, the traitors have all abandoned their contracts and left to join the Great Khan's growing war machine.

marauder.8.desc.zh:
一支[marauder_species.GetName]佣兵的大舰队进入了[From.GetName]。看来在我们摧毁他们最后一座空间站时，部署在其它地方而幸存的[marauder_species.GetName]佣兵们摒弃前嫌联手合作了。

他们意图对家园的毁灭进行复仇，而截获的通讯表明，他们的战士打算与我们同归于尽。
marauder.8.desc.en:
A large fleet of [marauder_species.GetName] mercenaries has crossed into the [From.GetName]. It looks like all of the [marauder_species.GetName] mercenary outfits who were deployed elsewhere when the [From.GetName] smashed their last space station have put their differences aside and combined forces.

They are intent on exacting vengeance for the destruction of their homes, and intercepted communications makes it clear that their warriors have no intention of surviving the campaign.

marauder.86.a.desc.zh:
注意，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

如果你们想让其他人替你们当炮灰冲锋陷阵的话，可以去雇佣[marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]佣兵舰队。如果你能出得起他们要的价格，你就能得到宇宙中最强的佣兵部队。
marauder.86.a.desc.en:
Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

If you have need of others to fight your battles for you, know that [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenary fleets are now available for hire. Yes, you heard correctly. If you can meet their prices, the best mercenaries in the galaxy are now willing to fight for you.

marauder.87.a.desc.zh:
嗨咿咿嘢嘢嘢！！！听好了，泥蛮们！

我们的战士们由于闲的实在无聊，已经开始内斗了，死伤无数！不过我们有办法解决……我们决定派我们最厉害的战士们去为泥蛮效命，当然你们必须支付能源！如果你们想要宇宙中最强的佣兵部队支援你们，就赶快行动吧！
marauder.87.a.desc.en:
HYEEEIIIEEEEEE!!!! Attention, dwamaks!

Our warriors grow bored and cause much trouble! Much fighting with each other, many dead! But we have solution... we send our craziest warriors to fight for dwamaks, in exchange for credits! If you want best mercenaries in galaxy, hurry now before too late!

marauder.88.a.desc.zh:
全知全能的虚空之母有一条消息给你：

虚空之母已然知晓你所渴望之物，你现在可以雇佣一些我们的佣兵舰队。我们的船员皆为训练有素之士，若能够提供足够的报酬，他们皆会服从于你的命令。

这是一份难以置信的礼物，请不要浪费她的一番好意。
marauder.88.a.desc.en:
She of the Void has a message for you:

If you so desire, you may now hire some of our fleets as mercenaries. Our crews are disciplined and will obey your instructions, as long as you can meet our prices.

This is an incredible gift that She has bestowed upon you. Do not squander it.

mass_exorcism_tt.zh: [Target.GetName]的人们对我们的评价降低了。
mass_exorcism_tt.en: The people of [Target.GetName] have a lowered opinion of us.

mass_shift_tooltip.zh: 以下殖民地受到了明显的影响：
mass_shift_tooltip.en: The following colonies were noticeably impacted:

massex_poi_1_desc.zh: 环绕行星的小行星带成了曾经巨大灾难的唯一见证。
massex_poi_1_desc.en: An asteroid belt orbits a star as the only witness to some great cataclysm.

massex_poi_2_desc.zh: 这个行星被自身地狱般的熔岩吞噬了。
massex_poi_2_desc.en: This planet wallows in its own infernal crucible.

massex_poi_3_desc.zh: 这个行星虽然非常适合生命的繁衍，但十分荒芜。
massex_poi_3_desc.en: This planet is impressively barren, despite advantageous conditions for sustaining life.

massex_poi_4_desc.zh: 充斥整个行星的大气层的毒气似乎是最近突然出现的。
massex_poi_4_desc.en: The toxic fumes that now dominate this planet's atmosphere appear to have originated fairly recently and suddenly.

massex_poi_5_desc.zh: 天文观测数据显示这颗星球过去没这么寒冷荒芜。
massex_poi_5_desc.en: Astronomical records indicate that this planet was not always a frozen wasteland.

master_salvager_already_bought.zh: 我们已经为$master_salvager$的效力付了钱。
master_salvager_already_bought.en: We have already purchased the services of a $master_salvager$.

master_salvager_explanation.zh: 我们将雇佣以为具有$leader_trait_master_salvager$特质的等级5科学官。
master_salvager_explanation.en: We will hire a Level 5 Scientist with the $leader_trait_master_salvager$ Trait.

materialist1.zh: 一位以合成人之身实现不朽的舰队司令。[Root.GetHisHerCap]的思维直接链接着[Root.GetHisHer]麾下的舰船。
materialist1.en: An admiral who found immortality in a synthetic form. [Root.GetHisHerCap] mind is now directly connected to the ships under [Root.GetHisHer] command.

materialist1_catch_phrase.zh: “就像我让自己提升到现在的完美状态一样，我会把你的舰队提高到卓越水平。”
materialist1_catch_phrase.en: "Like my ascent to this perfected state, I will lift your fleet to excellence."

materialist2.zh: 一位离开了自己的城邦的打捞者，[Root.GetFirstName]是一位无与伦比的机械师，几乎任何故障在[Root.GetHisHer]的手里都能迎刃而解。
materialist2.en: A salvager who has left [Root.GetHisHer] enclave, [Root.GetFirstName] is a peerless mechanic who can fix just about anything.

materialist2_catch_phrase.zh: “万物始于修建之时，不是吗？万物总有修理之日，不是吗？我恰好对这两项工作都有兴趣！”
materialist2_catch_phrase.en: "Things need to be built, yes? Things need repairing, am I right? I have a taste for both!"

medium_mecha_merc_army_hire.zh: 这些佣兵受到无限期雇佣，但维护费高昂。此军队包括10支机械化佣兵陆军
medium_mecha_merc_army_hire.en: These mercenaries are hired indefinitely but have a high upkeep. This force includes 10 Mechanized Mercenary Armies

medium_merc_army_hire.zh: 这些佣兵受到无限期雇佣，但维护费高昂。此军队包括10支佣兵陆军
medium_merc_army_hire.en: These mercenaries are hired indefinitely but have a high upkeep. This force includes 10 Mercenary Armies

mega.100.desc.zh:
我们失去了[From.GetName]星系内的祝圣之物！

悲痛与沉重的失落笼罩了[Root.GetAdj]的殖民地。不同于一个星球被宣布不再为神所庇佑，这种对心灵依靠的以暴力手段无情践踏否定的行为让[Root.GetName]的信徒们陷入震惊与迷茫。神职人员决定进行五年的哀悼。
mega.100.desc.en:
We have lost access to the objects of worship in the [From.GetName] system!

Grief and a profound sense of loss grips the [Root.GetAdj] colonies. Different from a world being declared unconsecrated, this violent denial of spiritual agency leaves the believers of [Root.GetName] shell-shocked and disoriented. The clergy have decreed a half-decade of mourning.

mega.1000.desc.zh:
伴随着吱呀声，$matter_decompressor_1$细长如虚幻般的横臂开始缓缓运转。

看起来摇摇欲坠的空间站的晃动渐渐停止，而阵阵能量与微粒物质从[From.GetName]事件视界的阴影中射出。
mega.1000.desc.en:
The spindly, ethereal leg-beams of the $matter_decompressor_1$ sputter to life.

The spasms and paroxysms of the precarious station eventually give way to an even thrum of flowing energy and particulate matter, swept up from the umbra beyond [From.GetName]'s event horizon.

mega.200.desc.zh:
层层叠加的都市终于完全覆盖了星球的地表。

自从这一宏大计划开始实施以来仅仅过了数年，但已经很难回想起[Root.GetName]从前的面貌。翠绿的丛林？崎岖的山脉？现在放眼望去，四面八方都是延绵不绝的钢铁。

这里曾经由自然法则任意塑造，而现在则成了由坚定的目的锤炼而成的设计。
mega.200.desc.en:
Layers upon layers of urban sprawl eclipse the globe's crust, and it is done.

Scant few years have passed since the start of this grand project, but it is already difficult to recall what the surface of [Root.GetName] was like. Verdant? Rugged? It is all steel now, miles in every direction.

A place once molded by chance and the unthinking laws of nature, now a design wrought from indomitable purpose.

mega.201.desc.zh:
世世代代以来，[Root.GetName]上冰冷空寂的废墟始终蛰伏于此，静静诉说着千百万年前那陡然告终的黄金时代。

一切从此改变。这座覆盖整颗星球的城市重获新生，那些年久失修的废墟又一次充满了活力。凡是可以修复之处，现存的建筑和基础设施均已被修缮并重新规划用途。至于那些损坏太过严重的区域，其上的瓦砾和废墟也已清理干净，为建造新建筑腾出了空间。
mega.201.desc.en:
For untold generations, the cold and empty ruins of [Root.GetName] have stood dormant, as quiet symbols of a golden age that came to an abrupt end eons ago.

No longer. The planet-wide city has at last been reborn, and those same dilapidated ruins are once more alive with activity. Where possible, existing buildings and infrastructure have been repaired and repurposed. Where the damage was too great, the rubble and ruins have been cleared away to allow for new construction.

mega.9000.desc.zh: 打造$mega_art_installation_3$的第一步就要同时面临两个困难：修建一个巨大到能容纳一个错综复杂的展览馆的空间站与组织一场空前规模的展览会。当所有基本设施都准备完全时，修建保险库将成为第一要务。保险库必须足够安全以及牢固，专门用来保护这星系之中的艺术财富。
mega.9000.desc.en: The first stage of constructing a $mega_art_installation_3$ combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priority. Planned to be a marvel of security and stability, the Vault will contain and protect the artistic wealth of the galaxy.

mega.9001.desc.zh: 我们$mega_art_installation_3$的第二阶段已经完成，填满保险库的工作已经开始。一只专门的运输舰队将会持续不断地将我们帝国的瑰宝运送到它们的新家来。同时，可供工作人员居住的住所以及更多的展览空间等其他建筑也正在建造。
mega.9001.desc.en: The second stage of our $mega_art_installation_3$ is complete and the process of filling the Vault has begun. A dedicated fleet of transport ships operates constantly to transport the treasure of our empire to its new home. Meanwhile, additional structures are being built to house the multitude of required staff, and to display a vast number of exhibits.

mega.9002.desc.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展厅能够展示[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]和来自星系其他地区的满目琳琅以涤荡普罗大众的心灵。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
mega.9002.desc.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will display the artistry of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] and the galaxy to the delight of all. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

mega.9002.phile.desc.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展出来自星系各国的艺术臻品以彰显不同物种的多样性。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
mega.9002.phile.desc.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will show samples of art from every race to celebrate the diversity of the galaxy. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

mega.9002.phobe.desc.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展示[From.Owner.GetAdj]的真正艺术作品！同时还会展出一小部分外星艺术作为陪衬。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
mega.9002.phobe.desc.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will display the true glory of [From.Owner.GetAdj] art! A small selection of Xeno-art shall also be displayed for comparison and mockery. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

mega.9003.desc.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地防御我国的计划服务。
mega.9003.desc.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to defend our empire.

mega.9003.mil.desc.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地征服星海的计划服务。
mega.9003.mil.desc.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to conquer the galaxy.

mega.9003.slave.desc.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地抓捕奴隶的计划服务。
mega.9003.slave.desc.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to capture the maximum number of slaves.

mega.9004.desc.zh: 强大的通信阵列已被加入到战略指挥中心之中，这样我们的舰船无论在哪都可以收到来自于我们的战略指令了。这些目前最为先进的通信阵列能够克服一切干扰，并且它量子纠缠的信号完全无法被破解。
mega.9004.desc.en: Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue orders to our ships throughout the galaxy. These state-of-the-art arrays are powerful enough to burn through any possible jamming, and the quantum-entangled signal is utterly unhackable.

mega.9005.desc.zh: 战略指挥中心最后的附加部分是一些分离的"敌方军队"模拟堡垒。这些堡垒差不多就是战略指挥中心的微缩版，而且完全独立运行。精英指挥官和他的手下们在其中能够完整地沉浸在敌人的文化与传统之中，通过学习他们的艺术，能更好地理解并模拟他们的军事思想。当完全沉浸之后，他们会与战略指挥中心的工作人员开展一场场虚拟战争，使得我们能够模拟任何可能的冲突，并能从两边学习到所有的细节，我们便能够在实战当中拥有比敌人更加卓越的战术。
mega.9005.desc.en: The final additions to the Strategic Coordination Center are several detached "Hostile force" simulator bastions. These bastions contain much of the functionality of the Strategic Coordination Center on a smaller scale, but are completely independent of the main system. Within, elite commanders and their staff can become totally immersed in the culture and traditions of our enemies, and by studying their artwork can better understand and simulate their military thinking. Once fully immersed, they will fight virtual wars against the staff of the Strategic Coordination Center, allowing us to stimulate conflicts with any possible enemy in excruciating detail which can then be studied from the perspectives of both sides and our strategies refined upon.

mega.9005.name.zh: 战略指挥中心：全面运行

mega.9006.desc.zh:
星际集会第一阶段最关键的特征的就是基座了。一个复杂的黑洞全息影像，它被用来召唤星系中心潜伏的引力深渊：那整个星系旋转的支点。

等到建成之后，这个地方也将会成为某些事务的轴心，那些能驱使整个星河旋转的静默外交与软实力博弈将会紧紧围绕着它。
mega.9006.desc.en:
The most crucial feature of the initial stage of the Interstellar Assembly is the Locus. A sophisticated holographic projection of a black hole, it is meant to evoke the gravitational chasm that lurks in the galactic core: the fulcrum upon which the galaxy turns.

Once fully built, this place will also be an axle of sorts, around which the quiet diplomacy and soft power that often drive the galaxy swirl.

mega.9007.desc.zh: 星际集会的第二阶段，领事环，现已建成。这个内环将能够容下我们大部分的外交人员在里面活动。
mega.9007.desc.en: The second stage of the Interstellar Assembly, the Consul Ring, is now complete. This inner circle will house most of our diplomatic staff going forward.

mega.9008.desc.zh: 星际集会的外环将会配有大量最先进的隐私保护会议室（当然，只有[Root.GetAdj]能够进行监控）。这座空间站正在迅速成为非现场谈判方面无可辩驳的星系枢纽。
mega.9008.desc.en: The Interstellar Assembly's outer ring is populated with vast, state-of-the-art conference rooms equipped with privacy filters (penetrable only by [Root.GetAdj] surveillance, of course). The station is quickly becoming the de-facto galactic hub for off-site negotiations.

mega.9008.name.zh: 星际集会：会议广场模块

mega.9009.desc.zh:
星际集会已全力运作，目前正在招待星际间几股大势力的重要人物们，无论他们是政界还是商界的。

我们的外交官们在跟进空间站内传出的那些国家利益与政治羞辱的信息流时受了不少累。不过至少我们的客人对我们的监控并不关心，只要我们一直为他们提供这种同竞争对手角力的理想环境就好了。
mega.9009.desc.en:
The Interstellar Assembly is now fully operational, and plays host to a number of embassies from the galaxy's major powers, be they political or corporate.

Our diplomats are having a hard time keeping up with the steady flow of information on national interests and political embarrassments we are extracting from the station. At least our guests seem largely disinterested in our surveillance, as long as we provide the ideal environs for them to strong-arm their competitors.

mega.9010.desc.zh: 为了对[From.GetName]进行开采，我们首先需要一个安全基地才能开始建造其他。星锚已经在黑洞事件视界的最边缘处建造完成，并且已经由一个重力重定向引擎牢牢稳定住，通过逆转[From.GetName]自身产生的重力去抵抗巨大的引力。
mega.9010.desc.en: To extract matter from [From.GetName] we first need a secure base to build the facility on. The Anchor has been built on the very edge of the event horizon and is held in place against the immense gravitational pull by an advanced gravity redirection engine, which turns [From.GetName]'s own gravity against it.

mega.9011.desc.zh: 建造于现有重力重定向系统之上，重力透镜设施能够使一部分力穿过“透镜”，将力更加密集地集中在某一片选中的区域。
mega.9011.desc.en: Built on the existing gravity redirection system, the Gravity Lensing Facility is able to redirect a portion of the force into a "Lens", concentrating the force even more strongly in a selected area.

mega.9012.desc.zh: 从黑洞提取物质的关键就在于究极精致的重力重定向系统：在某个区域集中生成一片引力扭曲的区域，然后打造出一个专门用来应对重力情况下的大型重定向钻头。
mega.9012.desc.en: The key to extracting matter from the black hole is the ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system: Forming a focused area of twisted gravity, in effect creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

mega.9013.desc.zh: 物质解压器的最后一步看上去十分单调，但也有他最令人震撼的一面。一大堆自动化的冶炼厂以及处理器开始将采取自[From.GetName]的物质分解，解压缩并分离为实用的矿物，再装入连续不绝的机械驳船舰队中，送往帝国各地。
mega.9013.desc.en: The final stage of the Matter Decompressor is the most mundane, but in its own way the most impressive. A vast automated array of smelters and processors break down, decompress, and separate the material of [From.GetName] into useful minerals which are decanted into an unending fleet of robotic barges to be delivered around our empire.

mega.9100.a.zh: 它似乎与我们自己的很像。
mega.9100.a.en: It seems similar to our own.

mega.9100.a.desc.zh: 我们在[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]的视界线上不可思议地存在着某种采矿装置。我们的科学家认为这可能是一个“物质解压器”——用于从黑洞中开采矿物的巨型结构。尽管它已无法正常运转，但某些阻止它被意大利面条化的装置一定仍在运作。
mega.9100.a.desc.en: Impossibly perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is some kind of mining apparatus. Our scientists theorize that this may be a "Matter Decompressor" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional, some mechanism preventing its spaghettification must still be operational.

mega.9100.b.desc.zh: 位于[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]事件视界上的是一个“物质解压器”——一个从黑洞中获取矿物的巨型结构。即使机能不全，它的引力扭曲引擎一定仍在运作，否则它早就因为黑洞的引力变成一团意大利面条了。
mega.9100.b.desc.en: Perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is a "Matter Decompressor" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional,  its gravitational twist engine must still be operational as it has not suffered spaghettification.

mega.9110.a.zh: 我们的永远不会被摧毁!

mega.9110.a.desc.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它破碎的残骸中包含了大量的战斗计算机、模拟器、以及通讯阵列，因此我们的科学家认为这一定是某种“战略指挥中心”。
mega.9110.a.desc.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. Its shattered remains contain a plenitude of battlecomputers, simulators, and broadcasting arrays which leads our scientists to speculate it must have been some type of "Strategic Coordination Center".

mega.9110.b.desc.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它似乎是一座“战略指挥中心”的残骸。
mega.9110.b.desc.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. It appears to be the remains of a "Strategic Coordination Center".

mega.9111.desc.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的废弃战略指挥中心已被完全修复，并由[Root.GetName]最有才华的军事人员掌管。这座巨型结构将恢复其原本的功用，指挥我们整个星系中的军事力量。
mega.9111.desc.en: The abandoned Strategic Coordination Center in [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the most brilliant military minds of the [Root.GetName]. True to its original purpose, the megastructure will be put to use coordinating our military might throughout the galaxy.

mega.9120.a.desc.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]中发现了三座被毁的空间站。它们被一团碎片所环绕，其中某些仍可辨识出是艺术品，虽然是非常异星的艺术品——看来这里曾是一座“巨型艺术设施”。
mega.9120.a.desc.en: A trio of wrecked space stations have been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. They are surrounded by a cloud of debris, some of which is still vaguely recognizable as works of art, albeit of a very alien nature. It seems that this was at one point a "Mega Art Installation".

mega.9120.b.desc.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的“巨型艺术设施”。其中的展品已遭受了时间与真空的摧残。
mega.9120.b.desc.en: A ruined "Mega Art Installation" has been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. Time and vacuum-exposure have not been kind to the exhibits.

mega.9121.desc.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的被毁巨型艺术设施已被修复完毕。除了[Root.GetName]最伟大的艺术品之外，它也陈列了一小部分从原本的巨型结构中回收并修复的外星艺术品。
mega.9121.desc.en: The once-ruined Mega Art Installation in [From.GetName] has been restored to operation. Fully repaired and stocked with a selection of the greatest artworks of [Root.GetName], it also contains a small selection of exhibits which were recovered and restored from the original megastructure.

mega.9121.name.zh: 被毁的巨型艺术设施已修复

mega.9130.a.desc.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大的被毁空间站。从大量办公空间以及一座配有各种不同类型生命维持设施的论坛看来，我们的科学家认为这是一座“星际集会”的残骸。
mega.9130.a.desc.en: The remains of a vast space station have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. Judging by the amount of what seems to be office-space and a vast forum outfitted with dozens of different types of life-support systems, our scientists suspect that this is all that remains of an "Interstellar Assembly".

mega.9130.b.desc.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座“星际集会”的残骸，并辨别出了十几种不同物种的干尸。
mega.9130.b.desc.en: The remains of an "Interstellar Assembly" have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. The mummified remains of at least a dozen different species have been identified so far.

mega.9131.desc.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的星际集会已经再次上线了。它已准备好再次迎接星系中的外交官们，共同商讨当前太阳周期中的问题。
mega.9131.desc.en: The Interstellar Assembly in [From.GetName] is online again. Once more it is ready for the diplomats of the galaxy to gather in one place to debate the great issues of the current solar cycle.

mercenary_tt_garrison.zh: 购买一座高维护费的恒星基地建筑。
mercenary_tt_garrison.en: Purchase a high upkeep starbase building.

mercenary_tt_hirearmies.zh: 雇佣陆军用于发动地面入侵。

mercenary_tt_hirefleet.zh: 接管这个太空城邦的佣兵舰队，时长为10年。
mercenary_tt_hirefleet.en: Take control of the mercenary fleet of this enclave for 10 years.

mercenary_tt_logistic.zh: 让佣兵支援你的补给线，提高海军容量。
mercenary_tt_logistic.en: Let the mercenaries assist with your supply lines and increase your Naval Capacity.

mercenary_tt_managefleet.zh: 取消或延长你的佣兵舰队合约。
mercenary_tt_managefleet.en: Cancel or prolong your mercenary fleet contract.

mercenary_tt_patron.zh: 太空城邦的赞助者可以帮助他们发展或征用一支已经雇佣的舰队。
mercenary_tt_patron.en: The Patron of an enclave can help them develop or requisition a fleet that is already hired.

mercenary_tt_tactical.zh: 获得当前危机的情报，以及如何与其战斗。
mercenary_tt_tactical.en: Get information about the current Crisis and how to fight it.

militarist1.zh: 一位经过战火淬炼的贵族，在压倒性的强敌面前失去了[Root.GetHisHer]的舰队和家族。
militarist1.en: A battle-hardened noble who lost [Root.GetHisHer] fleet and his House to an overwhelming enemy force.

militarist1_catch_phrase.zh: “你想不想看看你的敌人被一支前所未有的大军淹没的画面？过了这村没这店了。”
militarist1_catch_phrase.en: "Do you seek to eclipse your foes with a never-before-seen armada? Look no further."

militarist2.zh: 一位身经百战的犀利武士。[Root.GetHeSheCap]视战争如生命，视战场如家乡。
militarist2.en: A fierce warrior who has survived many battles. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has a passion for war and is most at home in combat.

militarist2_catch_phrase.zh: “放我去对付那些反对你的人吧，我会让他们见识见识什么叫大屠杀！”
militarist2_catch_phrase.en: "Unleash me on those who oppose you, and I will show them true CARNAGE!"

military_join_operation_happens_tooltip.zh: 其他所有参与的成员国将在[Root.Federation.GetName]领土的随机地点，获取类似的特殊项目。
military_join_operation_happens_tooltip.en: All other participating members gain a similar special project in a random location in the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s territory.

military_joint_exercise_potential_toolti.zh: 完成联合演习将提高舰队效率，增加联邦经验。
military_joint_exercise_potential_toolti.en: Completing these joint exercises will increase the efficiency of our fleet and provide a boost to federation experience.

minds_open_tt.zh: [Target.GetName]的人们对我们的评价提高了。
minds_open_tt.en: The people of [Target.GetName] have an increased opinion of us.

mindwarden_army_cooldown_tt.zh: 在[root.mindwarden_army_timer]之前我们不能向灵督再请求一支新的陆军。
mindwarden_army_cooldown_tt.en: We will not be able to request a new army from the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_army_timer].

mindwarden_army_explanation.zh: 招募一支$mindwarden_army$陆军，乘坐$transport$运抵首都恒星系。
mindwarden_army_explanation.en: Enlist an $mindwarden_army$ army, arriving by $transport$ at our capital system.

mindwarden_commander_already_bought.zh: 我们已经为一位灵督$subclass_commander_governor$的效力付了钱。
mindwarden_commander_already_bought.en: We have already purchased the services of a Mindwarden $subclass_commander_governor$.

mindwarden_commander_conflicted_leader.en: Must not have a leader from the [event_target:shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName].

mindwarden_commander_cooldown_tt.zh: 在[root.mindwarden_commander_timer]之前我们不能向灵督再申请领袖。
mindwarden_commander_cooldown_tt.en: We will not be able to request another leader from the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_commander_timer].

mindwarden_commander_explanation.zh: 我们将雇佣一位等级5的灵督$subclass_commander_governor$。
mindwarden_commander_explanation.en: We will hire a Level 5 Mindwarden $subclass_commander_governor$.

mindwarden_decision_cooldown_tt.zh: 我们在[root.mindwarden_decision_timer]之前无法发出该请求。
mindwarden_decision_cooldown_tt.en: We will not be able to request this until [root.mindwarden_decision_timer].

mindwarden_encourage_raid.zh: 雇佣[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.species.GetNamePlural]去袭击一个已知的灵能帝国。
mindwarden_encourage_raid.en: Pay the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.species.GetNamePlural] to raid a Psionic Empire we know of.

mindwarden_hire_raid.zh: 雇佣[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]向该帝国派遣袭击舰队。
mindwarden_hire_raid.en: Pay the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] to send a raiding fleet to attack this empire.

mindwarden_logistics_cooldown_tt.zh: 在[root.mindwarden_logistics_timer]之前我们不能向灵督再申请后勤援助。
mindwarden_logistics_cooldown_tt.en: We cannot request more logistical assistance from the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_logistics_timer].

mindwarden_raid_cooldown_tt.zh: 在[root.mindwarden_raid_timer]之前我们不能请求灵督再发起一场袭击。
mindwarden_raid_cooldown_tt.en: We will not be able to request another raid from the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_raid_timer].

mindwarden_tt_hirefleet.zh: 接管这个太空城邦的灵督舰队，时长为10年。
mindwarden_tt_hirefleet.en: Take control of the Mindwarden fleet of this enclave for 10 years.

mindwarden_tt_managefleet.zh: 取消或延长你的灵督舰队合约。
mindwarden_tt_managefleet.en: Cancel or prolong our Mindwarden fleet contract.

mindwarden_zro_cooldown_tt.zh: 在[root.mindwarden_zro_timer]之前我们不能再向灵督递交$sr_zro$。
mindwarden_zro_cooldown_tt.en: We will not be able to give $sr_zro$ to the Mindwardens until [root.mindwarden_zro_timer].

mirror_trade_reply.zh: 我也正有此意，为了全体[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的利益！
mirror_trade_reply.en: I was about to suggest that myself, for the benefit of all [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

mirror_trade_reply2.zh: 是的，我们应该签订跨次元贸易协定，来增强我们两国的实力。为了全体[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的利益！
mirror_trade_reply2.en: Yes, we should establish an inter-dimensional trade treaty to strengthen both our nations. For the benefit of all [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

mirror_trade_reply2.robot.zh: 设立跨次元贸易来增强两个次元的[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
mirror_trade_reply2.robot.en: Establish inter-dimensional trade to strengthen [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural] in both dimensions.

mirrored_empire_diplomacy.zh: 你与[final_mirrored_empire.GetName]开始了积极正面的关系。现在可以展开跨越裂隙边界的贸易了。
mirrored_empire_diplomacy.en: You have started a positive relationship with [final_mirrored_empire.GetName]. Trading across the boundaries of the rift will now be possible.

missing_mass_desc.zh: [from.GetName]的质量读数远低于一颗同等尺寸岩质行星预期范围。建议进一步调查。
missing_mass_desc.en: Mass readings for [from.GetName] are well below the expected range for a rocky planet of this size. Further investigation is recommended.

moon_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 一颗小型卫星正环绕这颗气态巨行星运行，这颗小卫星可能蕴藏大量矿藏。需要进行一次彻底的调查，对开采行动的可能性进行研究。
moon_gasgiant_category_desc.en: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.

morr_catch_phrase.zh: 一切闪闪发光的都是我们的。

morr_desc.zh: 他曾经是一个卑微的勘探者，长期暴露在不稳定的$zro_lower$矿脉中，与$the_instrument_of_desire_article$建立了一种强大而令人疯狂的纽带。后来他利用这种关系获得了淫靡的财富，露天采矿星球，并以勒索般的价格出售战利品。
morr_desc.en: Once a lowly prospector, their prolonged exposure to unstable $zro_lower$ veins forged a potent, maddening bond with $the_instrument_of_desire_article$. Now, they've leveraged that connection to obtain obscene wealth, strip-mining worlds and selling their spoils at extortionate prices.

mountain_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 我们在努力测绘这个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，结果在南半球发现了一条奇怪的山脉。它看上去不像是通过自然过程形成的。
mountain_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: Efforts to map the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have identified a strange mountain range in the southern hemisphere. It does not appear to have formed naturally.

mutation_vats_desc.zh:
我们在这颗星球上发现了有着令人惊异数量的严重异变化石，它们都属于同一种已灭绝的智慧物种。

究竟是什么导致了一个高等社会数百万成员的异变？我们的考古学家想进一步调查。
mutation_vats_desc.en:
A surprising number of heavily-mutated fossils has been found on this planet, all belonging to the same species of extinct sapients.

What could have led to the mutation of millions of members of a once-advanced society? Our archaeologists would like to investigate further.

mutiny_tooltip.zh: 我们失去了对该空间站的控制。
mutiny_tooltip.en: We have lost control of the space station.

muutagan_deal_in_place.zh: 我们已经有了一笔穆塔根协定。
muutagan_deal_in_place.en: We already have a Muutagan Deal.

mysterious_ringing_category_desc.zh: 科学家在[Planet.GetName]某一地点捕捉到规律性的电波峰，似与信号源从夜到昼的交替时间同步。
mysterious_ringing_category_desc.en: Our scientists have detected regular radio wave spikes from a single point on [Planet.GetName]. They appear to coincide with the time at which the source of the signal crosses from night into day.

namarian.10.desc.zh:
愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚一直伴你左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们是[contact_speaker_leader.GetName]。我们代表游牧舰队，逐浪者舰队上所有的纳马里安之魂发声。

你不必对我们心存恐惧，我们的舰队无意对天体进行争夺。我们只要求受到尊重，旅程不受到妨碍。
namarian.10.desc.en:
Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We are [contact_speaker_leader.GetName]. We speak on behalf of all the Namarian souls aboard the collected ships of the Pursuing Waters, our nomadic fleet.

You have nothing to fear from us, as the fleet has no interest in orb-bound affairs. We ask only that you respect our autonomy and do not hinder us on our journey.

namarian.100.desc.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，愿灼热的太阳与残酷的干旱常伴你们左右。逐浪者永远不再与你们往来。
namarian.100.desc.en: Scorching suns and drought upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. The Pursuing Waters shall not deal with your sort ever again.

namarian.105.desc.en: You shall know the fury of the Raging Waters, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]!

namarian.21.a.response.zh: 太感谢你们了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。愿我们同你们一道得偿所愿。
namarian.21.a.response.en: We thank you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. May our people find what they are looking for, in communion with your people.

namarian.21.b.response.zh: 那真是太不幸了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。希望那些掉队者能再坚持一下。我们马上就启程。
namarian.21.b.response.en: That is unfortunate, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Hopefully the stragglers will endure for a while longer. We will be on our way.

namarian.21.c.response.zh: 旅途漫漫，很可能我们一生都无法到达终点。有人想要寻找在有生之年能够到达的目标，而不是在无尽的旅途中耗尽此生。
namarian.21.c.response.en: The fleet's journey has been a long one. And it will not likely end within our lifetime. The discontent among us want another purpose in their lives other than searching the stars for our goal.

namarian.21.d.zh: 他们要怎么适应我们的社会？
namarian.21.d.en: How will they adapt to our society?

namarian.21.d.response.zh: 他们是一群不仅唯心还追求所谓平等的懦夫，至于他们能否和你们友好相处那就是你们自己的决断了。
namarian.21.d.response.en: They are a spiritual and egalitarian crowd, how well that meshes with your tribe is for you to discern.

namarian.21.desc.zh: 你们好，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们有个请求。在我们穿过漫漫虚空的旅途中，我们中的一些人民心生倦怠，眼中失去了目标。我们不是暴君，因此不会强迫任何人跟随我们完成旅途。所以我们在此请求：你们可以接收上述船员吗？让他们栖息在你们的[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]上，可以吗？
namarian.21.desc.en: Greetings again, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have a request for you. As we travel the void some of our people grow weary and lose sight of our goal. We are no tyrants, we force no one to see our quest to the end. So we ask of you: will you take some of our people in? To dwell on your orb, the one named [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]?

namarian.30.a.zh: 再多给我们讲讲你们的帝国。
namarian.30.a.en: Tell us more about your people.

namarian.30.a.response.zh:
正如我们初步和谈时说过的，我们来自逐浪者舰队。我们世世代代穿梭于恒星间的虚无太空，且将世代延续下去。

舰队由许多个体组成，所有人都必须为了我们的目标倾尽全力。有些人希望脱离出去，在天体上殖民，但大多数人都想穿越下一片虚空，看看之后的景象。
namarian.30.a.response.en:
As we mentioned at our introductory parley, we are the people of the Pursuing Waters fleet. We have traveled the stars and the voids-between for many generations, and will continue to do so for many more.

The fleet hosts a collection of individuals who all are required to do their best to enable our progress. Some wish to leave and establish a new orb-bound life for themselves, but most wish to see what lies beyond the next void.

namarian.30.b.response.zh: 我们正沿着多条虚空之河进行探索。这场旅程已经持续千年，但我们仍将继续航行。我们的目标是宇宙的星辰大海。虽然听起来可能有些晦涩难懂，但这充分总结了我们的理想。愿它能为你们遮蔽烈日。
namarian.30.b.response.en: We are on a journey down the river of the many voids-between. It has been millennia, but we sail on. The destination we seek being the ocean of the universe. It might sound cryptic, but this adequately summarizes what we dare share. May it bring you shade.

namarian.30.b.response_no_trust.zh: 请恕我们不愿透露，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。还有别的事吗？
namarian.30.b.response_no_trust.en: We would rather not say, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Was there anything else?

namarian.30.b.response_trust.zh:
鉴于你是逐浪者信任的盟友，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，我将会告诉你一些事：

舰队目前正处于探索之中。我们的先祖曾经不得不离开母星驶向无垠的深空之中。他们希望我们能够找到我们存在的意义，在他们离开满是沙丘的母星千年之后，我们依旧依照着他们的当初的愿景来制定我们的生存之道。

这就是我们想说的。望你安康。
namarian.30.b.response_trust.en:
Being the trusted ally of the Pursuing Waters that you are, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj], we will tell you this:

The fleet is on a quest. Our ancestors had to leave our birthing orb behind and set sail down the back of night. They wished for us to find the purpose of our people, and we live today by that wish, millennia after they first left the sandy dunes of Home.

That is all we dare share. May it bring you shade.

namarian.30.desc_01.zh: 愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。
namarian.30.desc_01.en: Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle].

namarian.30.desc_02.zh: 祝福你们，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。希望你们相处愉快。
namarian.30.desc_02.en: Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We hope you are doing well.

namarian.41.a.zh: 这座星系，以及那个“球体”归你们了。
namarian.41.a.en: The system, and the "orb" is yours.

namarian.41.a.response.zh: 我们衷心感谢你们。在冰冻刺骨的星系中，这样的热情能够驱散一丝寒意。我们游牧舰队衷心祝愿你们以及新生的帝国前途光明。
namarian.41.a.response.en: We thank your people for their grace. The galaxy is a cold place but today an act of kindness will ripple through its waters. We of the nomadic fleet wish both you and this new empire the best of luck in your affairs.

namarian.41.a.tooltip.zh:
你将割让[NomadMissionPlanet.GetStarName]星系的控制权

在[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]上创建一个拥有1.5K£pop£的纳马里安族帝国

你与[nomad_fleet_country.GetName]以及纳马里安帝国的关系得到了改善
namarian.41.a.tooltip.en:
You will cede control of the [NomadMissionPlanet.GetStarName] System

Creates a Namarian empire with 1.5K £pop£ Pops on [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]

Your relation with the [nomad_fleet_country.GetName] and the Namarian empire is improved

namarian.41.b.en: We cannot grant you this wish.

namarian.41.b.response.zh: 这对我们而言是个噩耗，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。希望他们能在下一个水坑中找到苦苦搜寻的目标，而不是灼热的风暴。通讯终止。
namarian.41.b.response.en: That is unfortunate for our people, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. We can only hope that they will find what they are looking for at the next watering hole, instead of searing winds. End transmission.

namarian.41.b.spirit.zh: 不，这是我们不可冒犯的领地。
namarian.41.b.spirit.en: No, it is ours by divine right.

namarian.41.b.tooltip.en: Your relation with the [nomad_fleet_country.GetName] is worsened

namarian.41.c.zh: 为什么对这颗行星感兴趣？
namarian.41.c.en: Why is the planet of interest?

namarian.41.c.response.zh:
在虚空之河航行对十分艰难，却只是漫长旅程的一小步。我们的帝国只想寻求栖息之地，而[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]能够满足他们的需求。

[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]，你们愿意为他们提供栖息之地吗？
namarian.41.c.response.en:
Sailing the voids-between is an arduous journey, and yet only a step on an already strenuous path. Our people simply seek rest, and thought that [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName] fulfilled their needs.

Will you grant them this rest, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]?

namarian.41.desc.zh:
愿你沐浴和风，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们发现你们称之为[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]的球体目前并未被你们占据。我们请求：能否让我们的一支帝国在此安家？

我们知道这是个不小的要求——失去整座星系来给我们一个家。我们等待你的答复，无论你如何决定。
namarian.41.desc.en:
Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have found that the orb you call [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName] is not currently being held by your people. We ask of you: could you let one of our tribes land upon it and make it a new home?

We realize we ask much of you - to lose an entire system to give our people a home. We await your decision, whatever it may be.

namarian.500.a.reply.zh:
舰队中的方舟。是我们的建设者工作休息的地方。商队穿梭于宇宙之中需要它来提供维持生存的空间，因此我们需要降低它的负载。

如果飞船组成了舰队的手臂的话，那么商队就是舰队的心脏。
namarian.500.a.reply.en:
The arkships of our fleet. Where we construct our contraptions, where our builders sleep. Steering the caravan across the great voids-between requires it to offer living space, hence the need to reduce its load.

If our military make up the fleet's hands, the caravan is its heart.

namarian.500.desc.zh:
很高兴再会，绿洲的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。在周围的行星之间穿行使得我们可以在废弃种群找寻有用的东西。也正因如此我们刚刚建好了我们的新飞船。

事实上我们建造出过量的飞船是为了解决的资源过剩这个问题。我们更希望商队能够保持灵活，不受束缚，所以我们带着希望达成交易的愿景来找到你们。
namarian.500.desc.en:
Greetings again, [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the oasis. Sailing through the nearby stars have made for some particularly fruitful scavenging. And so we have just finished the construction of new vessels.

In actuality we build more than we need in order to get rid of the excess resources. We prefer the caravan to stay nimble, unburdened, so we come to you with a transaction in mind.

namarian.505.a.reply.zh: 我们想卖的就是这么多。毕竟商队需要攻防兼备。
namarian.505.a.reply.en: That is as many as we are willing to part with. The caravan needs its hands to hold both shield and spear after all.

namarian.505.c.zh: 我们不相信纳马里安的工程技术。
namarian.505.c.en: We do not trust Namarian engineering.

namarian.505.desc.zh: 我们有一个提案。我们需要能量币和矿物来维持我们的航行。作为交换，我们会交给你们五艘我们的新型舰船
namarian.505.desc.en: A proposal, then. We require energy credits and minerals for the next crossing. In exchange, you may have five of our newly-built vessels.

namarian.510.a.zh: 给我介绍介绍这些舰队。

namarian.510.a.reply.zh: 巡洋舰，你们应该是这么叫的吧。装备有护盾，以及电弧发射器和等离子发射器。
namarian.510.a.reply.en: Cruisers, we suppose you would call them. Shielded and armed with plasma throwers and arc emitters.

namarian.510.desc.zh:
这就是我们的行事方式，不断的收集资源，随时保持我们的船坞处于运作状态，这不仅仅是我们的传统也是我们必须要做的事。比起拖累我们的舰队我们更希望看到的是我们的造物被其他天体居民买去使用。

我们能够确信我们的设计不会让你失望。
namarian.510.desc.en:
It is our way, by tradition and necessity, to scavenge resources and activate our internal shipyards when and where we can. We would prefer to see whatever excess we generate is put to use among the orb-dwellers, than have it hamper our journey.

We believe our designs would not disappoint you.

namarian.511.a.en: We will happily ease your burden for £energy£ 2000.

namarian.511.desc.zh: 一个令人心旷神怡的回答，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]，我们只需2000£minerals£或者2000£energy£作为回报。
namarian.511.desc.en: A refreshing answer, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. All we ask in return is £minerals£ 2000 or £energy£ 2000.

namarian.512.desc.zh: 我们清楚自己产品的价值，天体居民。我们要的不多。
namarian.512.desc.en: We know what our creations are worth, orb-dweller. We do not ask for much.

namarian.513.b.zh: 我们非常乐意为你们分担1500£energy£。
namarian.513.b.en: We will happily ease your burden for £energy£ 1500.

namarian.513.d.zh: 我们愿意为之支付1500£minerals£矿物。

namarian.513.desc.zh: 我们本希望至少能赚回制造成本，但现在只需要1500£minerals£或者1500£energy£就可以把飞船卖给你们。
namarian.513.desc.en: We had hoped to at least make back the manufacturing costs, but we can give you the ships for £minerals£ 1500 or £energy£ 1500.

namarian.514.desc.zh:
舰船将开往你们的中央绿洲——[Root.Capital.GetName]？是的。30天内完成交付。

愿你们一路顺风，永远能够得到荫凉的庇佑，[Root.GetRulerName]。
namarian.514.desc.en:
The ships will be driven to your central oasis - [Root.Capital.GetName]? Yes. To be delivered within 30 days.

May you always follow the trail and find shade, [Root.GetRulerName].

namarian.520.a.zh: 纳马里安人，请表明身份。

namarian.520.a.reply.zh: 我们的身份并无特殊之处。我们是逐浪者舰队中的热心人士。
namarian.520.a.reply.en: We're no one special. A concerned party among the Pursuing Waters fleet, one might call us.

namarian.520.desc.zh:
嗨，天体居民。

我们有消息要告诉你们。
namarian.520.desc.en:
Hey, orb-dweller.

We've got some news for your kind.

namarian.521.desc.zh:
你们最近是不是买来了5艘我们新制造的舰船，对吧？速度快而且装配着有大口径的武器？

事情是这样的，尽管你们不是……啊算了，我还是老实告诉你们吧。为了维护这片区域的稳定，和我们定下这笔舰船交易的国家可不止你们。你们的邻居，[other_empire.GetName]同样也和逐浪者舰队谈成了买卖。
namarian.521.desc.en:
You've recently purchased 5 of the fleet's newly crafted vessels, correct? Swift of speed, with large weapons?

Here's the thing, though, you weren't... ah, given the full story. In the interest of preserving regional stability, your people were not the only one offered this deal. Your neighbors, the [other_empire.GetName] have also parleyed with the Pursuing Waters.

namarian.522.b.reply.zh: 我们不相信[other_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，与我们之前遇到的其他的帝国不同，他们到现在都没有付款，我们怀疑他们在试图拖延付款时间直到舰船送达到他们的首都，然后再拒绝付款。因为他们意识到了我们的舰队领导非常急切的渴望离开这片星域……
namarian.522.b.reply.en: We do not trust the [other_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural], unlike the rest of the fleet. They have yet to pay, and we suspect they may try to stall until the vessels are delivered and then never send us payment. They realize the fleet leaders are very eager to move on...

namarian.522.c.reply.zh: 我们有进入商队船坞自动驾驶设置的权限。只要命令所有舰队在[Root.Capital.GetName]集结，禁止理应交付的那一半飞船发往[other_empire.Capital.GetName]的[other_empire.GetAdj]天体即可。我们不会被逮到的。
namarian.522.c.reply.en: We have privileged access to the autopilot configurations in the caravan's shipyards. Simply setting all vessels to rally at [Root.Capital.GetName] - and not sending half of them to the [other_empire.GetAdj] orb of [other_empire.Capital.GetName] - is trivial for us. We wouldn't even get caught.

namarian.522.d.en: What do you want us to do?

namarian.522.desc.zh: 他们谈下了一笔差不多的买卖，又有5艘舰船即将被送往[other_empire.GetAdj]的首都[other_empire.Capital.GetName]。但我们并不希望舰队里的这些船最后是为[other_empire.GetName]效力，所以现在想要请你们帮帮忙。
namarian.522.desc.en: They accepted a similar offer, and 5 additional craft are set to be shipped to the [other_empire.GetAdj] oasis of [other_empire.Capital.GetName]. We would rather the fleet's ships do not end up in service of the [other_empire.GetName], and we would like your help.

namarian.523.desc.zh: 我们需要得到实际的利益。就算是能够确保得到£energy£1000也比[other_empire.GetAdj]天体居民的承诺靠谱。
namarian.523.desc.en: We would need something to show for it. Even £energy£ 1000 would be more than whatever the fleet would get out of the [other_empire.GetAdj] orb-dwellers.

namarian.524.desc.zh: 愿荫凉庇佑你们，[Root.GetRulerName]。舰船会如约到达目的地——一艘不少。祝顺利。
namarian.524.desc.en: Shade upon you, [Root.GetRulerName]. The ships will arrive at the appointed time - all of them. Fair winds.

namarian.525.desc.zh:
真是太不幸了。

愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，天体居民。
namarian.525.desc.en:
That is unfortunate.

Cold days and warm nights to you, orb-dweller.

namarian.525.desc.poor.zh: 炎热而干旱。那真是不幸。我们原以为[Root.GetName]能够成为我们飞船最好的避风港。
namarian.525.desc.poor.en: Heat and drought. That is unfortunate, we think the [Root.GetName] would have made a fine harbor for our vessels.

namarian.530.desc.15ships.zh: 按照我们与逐浪者游牧舰队的协定，5艘武装飞船已经运输到了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系，正停驻在我们首都的轨道上。
namarian.530.desc.15ships.en: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet, 5 military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.

namarian.530.desc.30ships.zh: 按照我们与逐浪者游牧舰队以及其中的擅入者的合约——两支舰队总共10艘武装飞船已经运输到了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系，正停驻在我们首都的轨道。
namarian.530.desc.30ships.en: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet - and the conscientious interloper in its midst - two fleets totaling 10 military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.

namarian.9.desc.zh: 逐浪者舰队上的游牧船员们给我们发来了信息。他们说他们正在从星系边缘离开并向下一个目的地进发。他们将会去哪？他们会找到他们正寻觅的东西吗？
namarian.9.desc.en: The galactic nomads aboard the Pursuing Waters fleet have sent us a parting message. They are leaving our galaxy from the outer rim and setting sail towards their next destination. Where will they end up next? Will they ever find what they are searching for?

nanotech_consume_finish_tooltip.zh: 消耗[target.GetName]，创造一颗纳米星球。

nanotech_devour_effect.zh: 美化这个星球，为我们的洪流增添更多的纳米机器人。
nanotech_devour_effect.en: Transfigure this world, gaining more nanites for the flood.

necroids.2.A.tooltip.zh:
到今年年底，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的[necro_apprentice.GetNamePlural]将会全部被转化成[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

这个仪式将每隔10年在各个建有升格之室[Root.GetAdj]星球上举行一次。
necroids.2.A.tooltip.en:
At the end of the year, all [necro_apprentice.GetNamePlural] on [Root.Capital.GetName] will be converted into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

This ceremony will take place every 10 years on each [Root.GetAdj] planet with a Chamber of Elevation.

necroids.2.desc.zh: 自从[Root.GetAdj]开始掌管[Root.Capital.GetName]起，把[necrophage_species.GetNamePlural]转化为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就被纳入了宗教仪式中。每隔转瞬即逝的十年，“信徒”们都会聚集在升格之室里举行一场特殊的仪式。尽管少数几个知情者对仪式的具体内容三缄其口，但是当他们再次出现时，他们的举止变得与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无异。
necroids.2.desc.en: Ever since the [Root.GetAdj] takeover of [Root.Capital.GetName], the transformation of [necrophage_species.GetNamePlural] into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been shrouded in ritual. Once every ten years - a date which is rapidly approaching - the "Apprentices" gather in the Chamber of Elevation for a special ceremony. What exactly happens to them is a closely-guarded secret known only to a select few, but when they emerge, they do so as [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

necroids.2.desc.gestalt.zh: 自从[Root.GetAdj]开始掌管[Root.Capital.GetName]起，把[necrophage_species.GetNamePlural]转化为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就被纳入了仪式中。每隔转瞬即逝的十年，“信徒”们都会聚集在升格之室里举行一场特殊的仪式。尽管集体意识对仪式的具体内容三缄其口，但是当他们再次出现时，他们的举止变得与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]子个体无异。
necroids.2.desc.gestalt.en: Ever since the [Root.GetAdj] takeover of [Root.Capital.GetName], the transformation of [necrophage_species.GetNamePlural] into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been shrouded in ritual. Once every ten years - a date which is rapidly approaching - the "Apprentices" gather in the Chamber of Elevation for a special ceremony. What exactly happens to them is a secret closely-guarded by our collective consciousness, but when they emerge, they do so as [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] drones.

necroids.20.desc.zh: 死灵机师协议的成功安装使我们得以将被击溃的特定星神兽复活。相比机械升级，有机组件是劣等的。我们可以改造肉体，制造出有机生命的复制品。
necroids.20.desc.en: The successful installation of Mechromancy protocols will enable us to reanimate certain deceased Leviathans. Organic components are inferior to mechanical upgrades. We can engineer the flesh and produce a facsimile of organic life.

necroids.200.desc.zh:
一股可感的寂静降临在[root.GetName]各处。远近各处的朝圣者踏上旅途，前往选定好的礼拜场所；一路上结识新友，重温故交。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者们据传对此悲喜交加。[capital_scope.GetName]的$job_death_priest$长领头作了一番温暖人心的布道，号召信徒们好好培养、呵护他们之间的关系，在互惠互利中繁荣兴旺。

随着[mortal_initiate.GetName]向祭献堂进发，群众们以叹息为他们送别。他们于此刻迎接终结，为仁学研究留下了光辉的一笔。
necroids.200.desc.en:
A palpable hush descends across the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims have journeyed from near and far to their chosen places of worship, forming new friendships and rekindling old ones along their way.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newly-emerged [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural], whose silent procession is said to have drawn smiles and tears alike. The principal $job_death_priest$ at [capital_scope.GetName] led a warm sermon, calling for the faithful to be nurturing and considerate of their relationships, and to thrive in our mutuality.

As each [mortal_initiate.GetName] proceeded to the sacrificial chamber, collective sighs rang out. Each has met their end now, leaving a legacy in benevolent study.

necroids.201.desc.zh:
兴奋的低语在[root.GetName]上传开。朝圣者们在选定好的礼拜场所等待，纵然旅途劳顿，依旧激动非常。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者向他们礼貌地致以谢意。[capital_scope.GetName]的$job_death_priest$长领头作了一番兴高采烈的布道，号召信徒们把握好分分秒秒中的欢愉。随着仪式最高潮的时刻到来，[mortal_initiate.GetName]们在狂热的掌声中向着祭献堂进发。他们于此刻迎接终结，为仁学研究留下了光辉的一笔。
necroids.201.desc.en:
Excited murmurings ripple over the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims await at their chosen places of worship, buoyed by an excitement quite at odds with any physical weariness they may have endured.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newly-emerged [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural], whose silent procession was met with polite expressions of gratitude. The principal $job_death_priest$ at [capital_scope.GetName] led a vigorous sermon, calling for the faithful to seize the joy in every moment. As the climactic moment came, each [mortal_initiate.GetName] proceeded to the sacrificial chamber under rapturous applause. Each has met their end now, leaving a legacy in benevolent study.

necroids.202.desc.zh:
富足感洋溢在[root.GetName]各处，朝圣者在选定好的礼拜场所聚集。他们间或献上祭品；许多人藉此从为圣地服务的无数小摊小贩和街边店铺中获利。

这一轮的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]遵行并参与了各式各样的仪式，他们的队列饰以多姿多彩的花环，不发一言地前行。[capital_scope.GetName]的$job_death_priest$长做了一番意味深长的布道，许诺所有人都会有多产而舒适的时代。

布道结束后，[mortal_initiate.GetName]们向着祭献堂进发，在那里迎接自己的终结，为仁学研究留下了光辉的一笔。
necroids.202.desc.en:
A sense of wellbeing can already be felt throughout the [root.GetName] as pilgrims gather at their chosen places of worship. Sometimes they make offerings; many take advantage of the myriad stalls and street sellers which serve our holy sites.

Various rituals have been observed and invested in this cycle's [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural], whose silent procession was festooned with garlands of various kinds. The principal $job_death_priest$ at [capital_scope.GetName] led an inspiring sermon, promising productive and comfortable times for all.

At the sermon's close, each [mortal_initiate.GetName] proceeded to the sacrificial chamber to meet their end, leaving a legacy in benevolent study.

necroids.202.name.en: A Sacrifice Made: Bounty for the [root.GetName]

necroids.260.a.zh: 它们已经赢得了自己的自由，让它们休息吧。
necroids.260.a.en: They have earned their freedom, let them rest.

necroids.260.b.zh: 往债务上多加几个0就完事儿了。
necroids.260.b.en: Just add some more 0s to their debt.

necroids.260.desc.zh:
我们的首席执行官们刚刚聚集在一起，召开全息会议讨论丧尸卫生产品销售的增长，这时，复活资产公司某个辅助机构的负责人突然闯进了会议大厅。“[debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName]上的一个丧尸已经成功地偿还了债务！”其他人还没搞懂什么情况，负责人就脱口而出。会议暂时停顿，随后陷入一片混乱。每个与会的执行官都要求知道，这可能会如何影响对他们的复活工人的供应。

经过更多的分析，结果是这只是一个极其罕见的案例。只有那些身体维持了整整一个世纪的死者能够偿还他们的债务——就大局而言，这个数字微不足道。如果让它们安息，我们的星海企业几乎注意不到这件事。
necroids.260.desc.en:
Our chief executives had all just gathered for a holo-meeting to discuss the growth of zombie hygiene product sales when one of the heads of Animated Assets' aids burst into the conference hall. "One of the Zombies on [debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName] has managed to work off their debt!" they blurt out before noticing what they had stumbled in on. A pause stretched in the meeting before pandemonium erupted. Every assembled executive demanded to know how this might impact their reanimated workers supply.

After some more analysis, it turned out that this was only an extraordinarily rare case. Only the deceased whose bodies had lasted a whole century had managed to pay off their debts - a minuscule number, on the grand scale. Our galactic corporation would barely notice if they were to be put to rest.

necroids.310.desc.zh:
索林原虫尝试进入我们！

这个系外入侵者迅速捕获我们的[root.GetNecromancersLower]。从中其他的虫群开始收集更多附近的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。我们需要清除整个感染仓以确保[Root.GetName]的安全。
necroids.310.desc.en:
The Prethoryn tried to enter us!

The extragalactic invader immediately seized our [root.GetNecromancersLower]. From there, the alien entity began collecting additional [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] from nearby. We had to eliminate the entire infiltration pod to keep the [Root.GetName] secure.

needle_to_win_tt.zh: 建造一座视界刺针巨型结构以解锁天灾的最后行动。
needle_to_win_tt.en: Build a Horizon Needle Megastructure to unlock the final act of the Crisis.

ness_treasure_system_poi_desc.zh: 我们沿着$celestial_chart$指引的路线走到了尽头，一路击退了海盗和怪兽。现在，通往彼岸的通道已经开启，剩下的就是去探索星门那一头了。
ness_treasure_system_poi_desc.en: We have followed the $celestial_chart$ to its end, fending off pirates and monstrous creatures. The Gateway is now active, all that remains is to discover what lies on the other side.

new_admiral.zh: 一名新的指挥官加入了我们的行列。
new_admiral.en: A new Commander joins our ranks.

new_cosmogenesis_tech_tt.zh: 天灾增益：新研究选项已解锁。
new_cosmogenesis_tech_tt.en: Crisis Perk: New research options unlocked.

new_crisis_perks_tt.en: New Crisis Perks have been unlocked

new_precursor_project.zh: [precursor_planet.GetName]上有一个新的考古特殊项目可以进行。
new_precursor_project.en: A new archaeological special project is available on [precursor_planet.GetName].

no_cloning_unlock_tt.zh: 没有在任何阶段选择$genetic_ascension_approach_cloning$应对方案！
no_cloning_unlock_tt.en: The $genetic_ascension_approach_cloning$ Approach was not selected for any stage!

no_crisis_currency_tt.en: We did not gain any £advanced_logic£ $menp_cosmo_objectives$ for this thesis.

no_following_nations_said_yes.en: No nations agreed to the plan.

no_mutation_unlock_tt.zh: 没有在任何阶段选择$genetic_ascension_approach_mutation$应对方案！
no_mutation_unlock_tt.en: The $genetic_ascension_approach_mutation$ Approach was not selected for any stage!

no_purity_unlock_tt.zh: 没有在任何阶段选择$genetic_ascension_approach_purity$应对方案！
no_purity_unlock_tt.en: The $genetic_ascension_approach_purity$ Approach was not selected for any stage!

no_situation_progress.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Requires Operational Reserves to be $situation_nomad_economy_stage_2_stable$ or higher.

no_tutorial.zh:
没有建议和教程任务。

推荐专家级玩家使用。
no_tutorial.en:
No tips or tutorial missions.

Recommended for expert players.

运行储备容量的基础值为$@nomad_reserves_base|0$。
我们每拥有一艘方舟舰可以提升：
— I级：$@nomad_reserves_per_tier_1|0$
— II级：$@nomad_reserves_per_tier_2|0$

民用方舟的每一等级提供更多$@nomad_reserves_civilian_per_tier_1|0$。

Each Arkship we own increases it by:

nomadic_paragon_all_hired.en: The $RT_ETERNAL_CHAMPION$ has run out of contacts.

nomadic_paragon_already_hired.zh: 我们已经雇佣了一位游牧领袖为我方效力。
nomadic_paragon_already_hired.en: We have already hired the services of a nomadic leader.

nomadic_paragon_cooldown_tt.zh: 我们可以在[root.nomadic_paragon_timer]后请求再次进行引荐。
nomadic_paragon_cooldown_tt.en: We can request another introduction on [root.nomadic_paragon_timer].

nomadic_paragon_explanation.zh: 一位游牧领袖将会与我们接洽。
nomadic_paragon_explanation.en: We will be approached by a nomadic leader.

nomads.100.a.invitation.zh: 我们登记报名，准备参加下一轮比武会。
nomads.100.a.invitation.en: Register us for the next show.

nomads.100.a.stop.zh: 停止发出比武会邀请函。

nomads.100.b.en: How much to change the venue?

nomads.100.b.reply.zh:
看来我们迎来了新的主角！我们迫不及待想看到你在舞台上的表现了。

只需在你选择的星系中为我们发布一份合约，剩下的就交给我们来行动！
nomads.100.b.reply.en:
Looks like we've got our new headliner! We can't wait to see what you'll bring to the stage.

Simply issue a Contract for us in the system of your choosing, and we'll bring the action!

nomads.100.b.tt.zh:
$opinion10$
我们将有5 年时间发布一份特别合约，指定承办下一届冠铸秀赛事的恒星系。
nomads.100.b.tt.en:
$opinion10$
We will have 5 Years to issue a special Contract designating the system that will host the next CFL event.

nomads.100.d.zh: 详细说说你们的活动赛事。
nomads.100.d.en: Tell us more about your events.

nomads.100.d.reply.zh:
大约每隔二十五年，志在成为传奇的强者们便会展开巅峰对决！他们率领各自的舰队悉数登场，比赛地点轮番更替，而那些激烈的搏杀从未让人失望！

胜者将赢得丰厚的奖励、至高的声望，并在我们的积分榜上占据一席之地。

错过召集，就意味着错失良机。我们从不守候。
nomads.100.d.reply.en:
Roughly every quarter-century, would-be legends clash! They bring their own fleets, the tournament location changes, and the brawls never disappoint!

Victors earn rewards, prestige, and a place in our scoreboard.

Miss the call, and you miss your shot. We don't wait.

nomads.100.e.zh: 购买我们宿敌的战斗数据。
nomads.100.e.en: Purchase combat data on our rivals.

nomads.100.e.reply.zh: 战斗数据，刚刚传回！我们的分析师仔细研究了你们对手舰队交战的每一个片段。规律、破绽、弱点。我们将数据包交给你们，剩下的就看你们炮手的了。
nomads.100.e.reply.en: Combat data, hot off the broadcast! Our analysts have been crunching every clip from your rivals' fleet engagements. Patterns, tells, soft spots. We hand over the package, your gunners do the rest.

nomads.100.name.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

nomads.1005.hive.a.zh: 我们必须给他们找到一个星球。
nomads.1005.hive.a.en: We must find them a world.

nomads.1005.hive.desc.zh:
旅客们已经脱离了控制。最初大伙只是低迷的通过打分发泄情绪，如今旅客们已经统一认识，情绪宣泄恶化为了集体的单一诉求。

他们封锁了感官大厅，并改写了我们的通信系统，用以广播一条指令：着陆行星。

我们的子个体无法劝阻他们。成群的旅客占据了导航核心，正向其输入最近宜居星球的坐标。
nomads.1005.hive.desc.en:
The passengers have broken free. What began as low a sentiment score has hardened into a single demand that drowns out the collective's voice.

They have barricaded the sensory halls and repurposed our communication system to broadcast one imperative: planetfall.

Our drones cannot dissuade them. Passenger clusters occupy the navigation core, feeding it coordinates for the nearest habitable worlds.

nomads.1005.machine.desc.zh:
检测到旅客越权。最初我们仅在统计学上发现一点微不足道的离船请求增量，但是这一局势现已升级为一场有组织的系统侵入。旅客们利用改造后的货运集装箱，在物理层面封锁了各处关键枢纽。

我们的工作单元报告称，导航子系统已被锁定。由乘客编写的固件正利用我们自己的硬件执行降落轨道计算。恢复控制权的所有尝试都遭到了直接的武力抵抗，且每一层甲板的每一个显示屏都在循环输出同一条信息：“降落程序已启动。”
nomads.1005.machine.desc.en:
Passenger override detected. What began as a statistically insignificant increase in disembarkation requests has escalated into a coordinated systems breach. Passengers have physically barricaded critical junctions with repurposed cargo containers.

Our worker units report being locked out of navigation subsystems. Passenger-compiled firmware is now executing descent trajectory calculations on our own hardware. Attempts to restore control are met with immediate physical resistanc and every display on every deck cycles a single output: "LANDING SEQUENCE INITIATED."

nomads.1005.regular.a.zh: 我们必须殖民一颗行星。

nomads.1005.regular.desc.zh:
旅客们已经夺取了控制权。最初的请愿运动已演变成一场有组织的接管行动。安保团队被人多势众的乘客解除武装，指挥人员被限制在武装监视下，仅承担顾问角色。

乘客们的诉求很明确：终止航行，在星球上着陆。

导航协议已被覆写，以规划降落轨道；维修队伍正被重新派往准备起落架，而这些设备已有几代人未经检查。

每一层甲板的每一个屏幕上都显示着同样的信息：“巡游结束。”
nomads.1005.regular.desc.en:
The passengers have seized control. What started as a petition drive has hardened into a coordinated takeover. Security teams have been disarmed by the sheer number of passengers and command staff are confined to advisory roles under armed supervision.

The passengers' demands are clear: end the cruise and make planetfall.

Navigation protocols have been overridden to plot descent trajectories, and maintenance crews are being redirected to prepare landing gear that hasn't been inspected in generations.

Every screen on every deck displays the same message: "THE CRUISE IS OVER."

nomads.100a.desc.zh:
啊，一位熟悉的老对手回到了演播室！但你是否带上了什么新式武器？

我们的观众和星系竞技场都在拭目以待！
nomads.100a.desc.en:
Ah, a familiar contender returns to the Broadcast! But are you packing any new heat?

Our audience, and the galactic arena await!

nomads.100b.desc.zh:
欢迎回来，选手！赌池已经热火朝天，粉丝们正渴望看到更多精彩表现，而我们刚刚清理完残骸。

想再破一次收视纪录吗？
nomads.100b.desc.en:
Welcome back, contestant! The betting pools are red hot, the fans are baying for more, and we've just finished clearing the debris.

Care to break another viewership record?

nomads.100c.desc.zh:
哎呀呀！这不是我们最爱的战争贩子兼公共表演赞助人吗。我们正在筹备下一场舰队肉搏战……

你想参与到主场赛事吗？
nomads.100c.desc.en:
Well, well! If it isn't our favorite warmonger-slash-patron of public spectacle. We're prepping the next fleet melee...

Would you like to be the main event?

nomads.1010.hive.desc.zh:
降落已完成。我们的子个体首次触及土壤，肢体在没有引擎震颤的地面上显得有些不稳。乘客们如潮水般涌出气闸，散布在他们奋力抵达的这片土地上。

集体围绕着行星的律动重新塑形：根系般的补给线向外延伸，取代了原有的走廊物流；营养加工也从船载循环储备转向直接从地景中汲取原始养分。

一个新的家园。蜂群必须存续，一如既往。
nomads.1010.hive.desc.en:
The descent is complete. Our drones touch soil for the first time, their limbs unsteady on ground that does not thrum with engine vibration. The passengers spill from the airlocks in waves, scattering across the landscape they fought to reach.

The collective reshapes itself around planetary rhythms: root-like supply lines spread to replace corridor logistics, and nutrient processing shifts from recycled shipboard stocks to raw nutrients drawn from the landscape.

A new home. The hive must endure, as it always has.

nomads.1010.machine.desc.zh:
行星切入完成。着陆装置自出厂以来首次接触地表。旅客正通过所有可用气闸舱撤离，其生物满意度指标处于前所未有的数值。

劳工单元已开始将舰载基础设施转换为地面作业用途。船体外壳正被切割成地基面板，导航阵列正重新校准为地面通信中继站。从真空到陆地运行参数的转变正在无间断推进。

新首要指令：建立并维护殖民地基础设施。
nomads.1010.machine.desc.en:
Planetary insertion complete. Landing gear has engaged terrain for the first time since original manufacture. Passengers are disembarking via all available airlocks, their biological satisfaction indicators at unprecedented readings.

Worker units have begun converting shipboard infrastructure for surface operations. Hull plating is being sectioned into foundation panels and navigation arrays recalibrated as ground-based communication relays. The transition from void to terrestrial operational parameters is proceeding without interruption.

New primary directive: Establish and maintain colony infrastructure.

nomads.1010.regular.desc.zh:
降落已经完成。有生以来第一次见到起落架踏入土壤时，每一个观察窗前斗挤满了旅客，一阵不整齐的欢呼声震动了船体。几小时内，第一批避难所便由回收的甲板板材搭建而成。孩子们在异星的草地上奔跑，而他们的父母则在开阔的天空下相对无言。

船员们静静地工作着，拆卸下为太空旅行设计的系统，并将它们重新改装以用于地面生存。曾经的一艘游轮，如今成了殖民地的脊梁。

无论好坏，巡游已经结束。
nomads.1010.regular.desc.en:
