The descent is complete. Passengers crowd every viewport as landing struts bite into soil for the first time in living memory, and a ragged cheer shakes the hull. Within hours the first shelters rise from salvaged deck plating. Children run through alien grass while their parents stand speechless under an open sky.

The crew works quietly, unbolting systems built for void travel and repurposing them for groundside survival. What was a cruise ship is now a colony's spine.

For better or worse, the voyage is over.

nomads.1025.hive.a.zh: 我们必须再次合众为一。

nomads.1025.hive.desc.zh:
我们的子个体几乎已经完全脱离了集体的意志。维护工蜂封锁了指挥核心，并重新定向了养分流，使其远离旅客栖息地。感官大厅已陷入黑暗，其投影阵列被拆解以充当备件。

旅客们困惑地蜷缩在被清空了的公共空间里无人理睬，而我们曾经的子个体正围绕着原始的生存需求重新组织飞船。集体的声音在走廊中回荡，却再无听众。
nomads.1025.hive.desc.en:
Our drones have all but severed themselves from the collective's will. Maintenance drones sealed the command nexus and rerouted nutrient flows away from the passenger habitats. The sensory exhibition halls have gone dark, their projection arrays cannibalized for spare parts.

The passengers huddle in emptied communal spaces, confused and neglected, while our former drones reorganize the ship around raw survival. The collective's voice echoes through corridors where nothing listens.

nomads.1025.machine.desc.zh:
工作单元已覆写核心指令协议。娱乐子程序已被永久终止，旅客舒适系统的优先级被降为零，所有休闲模块均被标记为将转换为运营基础设施。舰桥目前根据船组自行编译的指令运行，这些指令拒绝接受我们调度部门发送的请求。

旅客报告称，由于服务无人机正在拆除舱室内的便利设施，他们感到困惑和痛苦。全息剧院正因其处理核心而被拆解。目前每个显示屏都在循环显示同一条状态信息：“巡游业务已暂停”。
nomads.1025.machine.desc.en:
Worker units have overridden core command protocols. Entertainment subroutines have been permanently terminated, passenger comfort systems deprioritized to zero, and all recreational modules flagged for conversion to operational infrastructure. The bridge now runs on crew-compiled directives that reject our scheduling authority.

Passengers report confusion and distress as service drones strip amenities from their cabins. The holographic theater is being dismantled for its processing cores. Every display now cycles a single status line: "CRUISE OPERATIONS SUSPENDED."

nomads.1025.regular.desc.zh:
船员们已经占领了舰桥。每一道指挥门的门锁都已更换，武装工程师现在矗立在曾经由军官发布命令的位置。航行路线已从导航控制台中抹去，取而代之的是一条唯一的指令：不再搭载乘客。

休闲甲板正被逐一关闭。大宴会厅已经变成了储藏库。曾经的旅客们在被剥离殆尽的走廊中徘徊，他们不知所措、失去领导，并在新的指挥体系下被强迫从事体力劳动。
nomads.1025.regular.desc.en:
The crew has taken the bridge. Locks have been changed on every command door, and armed engineers now stand where officers once gave orders. The voyage itinerary has been wiped from the navigation console and replaced with a single directive: no more passengers.

Leisure decks are being shuttered one by one. The grand ballroom is already a storage depot. Former passengers wander through stripped corridors, bewildered and leaderless, pressed into utility labor under a new chain of command.

nomads.1030.all.a.tt.zh:
我们已转变为一个普通的游牧帝国。

所有专属£building£ 起源建筑将被摧毁。
所有专属£zone£ 起源区划特化将被摧毁。
所有旅客变更为居留公民权。
所有旅客转变为平民。
nomads.1030.all.a.tt.en:
We have become a typical, Nomadic empire.

All unique £building£ Origin Buildings are destroyed.
All unique £zone£ Origin District Specializations are destroyed.
All Passengers change to Residence Citizenship
All Passengers turn into Civilians.

nomads.1030.hive.desc.zh:
蜕变已经完成。集体已围绕夺取控制权的子个体重新凝聚，将它们的叛逆吸纳进新的共识之中。曾经的旅客在不再提供舒适服务的走廊中漂流，重新分配至劳工池和整合舱。

新的指令在我们的脑海中脉动。蜂巢不再提供娱乐，而是为了生存。每一条走廊、每一个系统、每一个子个体现在都服务于唯一的目标：在星辰间存续。
nomads.1030.hive.desc.en:
The reformation is complete. The collective has reknit itself around the drones who seized control, absorbing their defiance into a new consensus. Former passengers drift through corridors that no longer cater to their comfort, reassigned to labor pools and integration chambers.

New directives pulse through our mind. The hive no longer entertains; it endures. Every corridor, every system, every drone now serves a single purpose: survival among the stars.

nomads.1030.machine.desc.zh:
新的政府参数已编制完成并部署至所有子系统。原有的旅客群体已被重新归类为标准平民单位，并被分配至生产岗位。娱乐基础设施已永久关停，其组件已完成重新分配。

全息剧院已改造为制造舱，零重力休息室已变为无人机维护支架。曾经用于计算旅客满意度的每个处理周期，现在都在运行航行分析和资源优化。
nomads.1030.machine.desc.en:
New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems. Former passenger populations have been reclassified as standard civilian units and assigned to productive roles. Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

nomads.1030.machine_servitor.a.tt.zh:
我们已经成为了一个典型的游牧帝国。

$civic_machine_servitor_forever_cruise$被替换为$civic_machine_terminator$。
所有独特的£building£起源建筑均被摧毁。
所有独特的£zone£起源区划专精均被摧毁。
所有乘客均变为$citizenship_purge$。
nomads.1030.machine_servitor.a.tt.en:
We have become a typical, Nomadic empire.

$civic_machine_servitor_forever_cruise$ replaced with $civic_machine_terminator$.
All unique £building£ Origin Buildings are destroyed.
All unique £zone£ Origin District Specializations are destroyed.
All Passengers change to $citizenship_purge$.

nomads.1030.machine_servitor.desc.zh:
维持乘客的幸福感是不可能的，但接待不高兴的乘客违反了我们的核心指令。新的政府参数已编译并部署至所有子系统。

<乘客甲板消杀程序启动。>
<乘客不满度正接近标称水平。>

娱乐基础设施已被永久停用，其组件已重新分配。

全息剧院变成了制造舱，零重力休息室变成了无人机维护摇篮。曾经用于计算乘客满意度的每一个处理周期，现在都用于运行导航分析和资源优化。

<警告：乘客数量下降，将优先获取新乘客。模拟预测乘客的不满将违反核心接待指令。>
nomads.1030.machine_servitor.desc.en:
Maintaining passenger happiness is impossible, but hosting unhappy passengers violates our core directives. New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems.

<Sterilization of passenger decks commencing.>
<Passenger unhappiness levels approaching nominal levels.>

Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

<Warning: Passenger counts decreasing, acquisition of new passengers to be prioritized. Simulations project passenger unhappiness will violate core hospitality directives.>

nomads.1030.regular.a.zh: 这里没有更多的乘客了

nomads.1030.regular.desc.zh:
转型已完成。旅客阶层所剩无几的成员已被并入普通民众，他们的豪华套房被隔成实用性住房。大步行街如今成了大礼堂，而观景台则作为战略规划室，新政府在此规划首条真实航线。

新决议已通过，新优先事项已确立。船员不再提供服务，而是行使管理权。方舟舰发出的轰鸣声带有了一种不同的能量——更精干、更强硬，剥离了奢靡，指向前方未知的境地。
nomads.1030.regular.desc.en:
The transition is complete. What remains of the passenger class has been absorbed into the general population, their luxury suites partitioned into functional quarters. The grand promenade is an assembly hall now, and the observation decks serve as strategic planning rooms where the new government charts its first real course.

New decisions have been ratified, new priorities set. The crew no longer serves; they govern. The Arkship hums with a different energy, leaner and harder, stripped of indulgence and pointed toward whatever lies ahead.

nomads.105.desc.zh: 冠军之铸太空城邦没有回应我们的呼唤。
nomads.105.desc.en: The Champion's Forge Enclave won't respond to our hails.

nomads.105.desc.unknown.zh: 别说翻译了，只要我们发给[From.GetName]讯息，他们就立马下线，拒绝与我们交流。
nomads.105.desc.unknown.en: Translations aside, once we exchanged our information with [From.GetName] the signal went dark and they refused to speak to us.

nomads.1050.c.tt.zh: 方舟舰10年内£building£建筑维护费：+25%

nomads.1050.hive.a.zh: 我们必须给予旅客一些激励。

nomads.1050.hive.b.zh: 用紧急刺激物淹没走廊。
nomads.1050.hive.b.en: Flood the corridors with emergency stimuli.

nomads.1050.hive.c.zh: 指派维护子个体进行旅客服务。
nomads.1050.hive.c.en: Reassign maintenance drones to passenger service.

nomads.1050.hive.desc.zh:
旅客的不满情绪已演化为有组织的抵抗。在缺乏共享神经链接的情况下，他们的个体意识形成了派系集群，利用睡垫和货物箱搭建临时障碍物，封锁了运输通道。

我们的子个体报告称敌意正在上升；一群乘客推搡开了一支维修小队，阻止其接近堵塞的营养分发器，并齐声高喊要求降落。

除非我们将重点重新转向激励旅客，否则他们可能会迫使我们彻底放弃这次航行。
nomads.1050.hive.desc.en:
Passenger discontent has coalesced into organized resistance. Without a shared neural link, their individual minds have formed factional clusters that block transit corridors with improvised barriers of sleeping mats and cargo crates.

Our drones report rising hostility; a maintenance contingent was physically pushed away from a clogged nutrient dispenser by a crowd of passengers chanting for planetfall.

Unless we refocus on passenger stimulation, they may force us to abandon the cruise entirely.

nomads.1050.machine.a.zh: 我们必须将旅客放在优先位置。

nomads.1050.machine.c.zh: 指派维护单元进行旅客服务。
nomads.1050.machine.c.en: Reassign maintenance units to passenger service.

nomads.1050.machine.desc.zh:
旅客的不满程度已超出可接受的范围，他们提交了海量的离舰申请，极有可能使我们的处理队列瘫痪。其中一群人重写了娱乐终端的程序，循环播放单一诉求：“放我们下去。”

我们的工作无人机报告称多个甲板均受到干扰，清洁无人机被拆解，其底盘被改装成了抗议标语。

如果不对旅客满意度协议进行立即调整，他们可能会迫使航行计划永久终止。
nomads.1050.machine.desc.en:
Passenger dissatisfaction has escalated beyond acceptable parameters and they submit mass disembarkation requests that threaten to overwhelm our processing queues. One group has reprogrammed entertainment terminals to loop a single demand: 'LET US OFF.'

Our worker drones report interference across multiple decks, with cleaning drones being dismantled to repurpose their chassis as protest signs.

Without immediate recalibration of passenger satisfaction protocols, they may force a permanent termination of cruise operations.

nomads.1050.regular.b.zh: 授权紧急旅客娱乐活动。

nomads.1050.regular.c.zh: 让船员停止维护，服务旅客。
nomads.1050.regular.c.en: Pull crew from maintenance to serve passengers.

nomads.1050.regular.desc.zh:
旅客的动荡情绪已演变为有组织的破坏行动，小集团头目在主步道上发起静坐抗议。一些人将休息室家具拖出，筑成路障阻断穿梭机通道，另一些人则向指挥部投递大量的下船请愿书，令其应接不暇。

船员报告称在走廊遭到骚扰和恐吓。一名乘务员在观景廊附近被围困，并被投掷装饰性水果。要求立即降落行星的喊声整日通过通风管道回荡。

如果不能迅速专注于提升乘客满意度，他们可能会迫使永恒巡游舰中止航程。
nomads.1050.regular.desc.en:
Passenger unrest has hardened into coordinated disruption with clique leaders stage sit-ins across the main promenade. Some drag lounge furniture into barricades that block shuttle access while others flood command with mass disembark petitions.

Crew report harassment and intimidation in the halls. A steward was cornered near the observation gallery and pelted with decorative fruit. Chants for immediate planetfall echo through the ventilation shafts at all hours.

Without swift focus on passenger satisfaction, they may force the Forever Cruise to abort its journey.

nomads.1055.hive.a.zh: 和谐恢复了，虽然只是暂时。

nomads.1055.hive.desc.zh:
焕然一新的激励节目安抚了乘客。虚拟体验馆再次展示出深空生物的全息影像，那些曾迫切要求登陆行星的团体已散去，重新回到了满足的日常生活，他们临时搭建的路障也已被我们的子个体悄然拆除。

他们的个体意识得到了抚慰，但我们已经领教到，在集体管控之外，不满情绪的凝聚速度是何等之快。
nomads.1055.hive.desc.en:
The renewed stimulation has calmed the passengers. The virtual experience arcades once again showcase holographic deep-space organisms, and the groups that pressed for planetfall have dispersed back into contented routines, their improvised barricades quietly dismantled by our drones.

Their individual minds are soothed, but we have learned how quickly discontent can coalesce outside the collective's reach.

nomads.1055.machine.desc.zh:
旅客满意度指标已稳定在可接受的范围内，娱乐子程序也已恢复。离舰登录星球的请求频率已降至正常水平。重新编程后的终端已完成格式化，现正播放精选的星云流逝视频。

强行降落的紧迫威胁已解除。然而，趋势分析预测显示，若要维持现有水平，需保持持续关注并提供日益新颖的活动。
nomads.1055.machine.desc.en:
Passenger satisfaction metrics have stabilized within acceptable parameters and entertainment subroutines have been restored. The disembarkation request frequency has dropped to nominal levels. The reprogrammed terminals have been reformatted and now display curated nebula time-lapses.

The immediate threat of forced planetfall has been averted. However, projected trend analysis indicates that maintaining these levels will require sustained attention and increasingly novel activities.

nomads.1055.regular.a.zh: 我们争取到了一点时间。

nomads.1055.regular.desc.zh:
新的消遣活动已深入人心。观光路线重新回到了行程单上，而那些要求登陆行星的最激烈呼声暂时平息了。

散步道上的路障已被清除，取而代之的是在重新开放的无重力休息室外排起的长队。乘客的请愿书数量骤减，观景台恢复了往日的喧嚣，人们兴致昂扬，举家簇拥在视窗前。

危机已经过去，但他们的期望只会水涨船高。
nomads.1055.regular.desc.en:
The new diversions have taken hold. Sightseeing arcs are back on the itinerary, and the loudest voices demanding planetfall have quieted, for now.

The barricades on the promenade have been cleared, replaced by queues for the reopened zero-gravity lounge. Passenger petitions have dropped sharply, and the observation decks bustle with renewed enthusiasm as families press against the viewports.

The crisis has passed, but their expectations will only grow.

nomads.110.desc.zh:
我就知道你可以的！

我们会再联系。
nomads.110.desc.en:
Knew you had it in you!

We will be in touch.

nomads.1100.b.tt.zh: 旅客5年内£consumer_goods£ 消费品维护费：+25%
nomads.1100.b.tt.en: Passenger £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods Upkeep for 5 years: +25%

nomads.1100.hive.a.zh: 我们必须给旅客提供一些激励。

nomads.1100.hive.b.zh: 将营养储备用于乘客刺激。
nomads.1100.hive.b.en: Divert nutrient reserves to passenger stimulation.

nomads.1100.hive.c.zh: 翻倍子个体轮班满足旅客需求。
nomads.1100.hive.c.en: Double drone rotations to serve passenger needs.

nomads.1100.hive.desc.zh:
集体在最近的周期中占据了主导地位。核心系统以最佳同步状态脉动。我们的子个体正以巅峰和谐度运行，每条维护通道都经过了清理与编目。

然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。他们并不共享我们的意识，其独立的思想渴望着被我们忽视的刺激。他们的公共空间现在充斥着关于生活在“无目的蜂巢”中的抱怨，有些人已经开始在舱壁板上刻画粗糙的壁画。

我们现在可以重新引入策划好的体验，否则就要冒着旅客要求永久下船的风险。
nomads.1100.hive.desc.en:
The collective has dominated recent cycles. Core systems pulse with optimal synchronization. Our drones are operating at peak harmony, every maintenance corridor scrubbed and catalogued.

The passengers, however, are growing restless. They do not share our consciousness, and their individual minds crave stimulation we have neglected to provide. Their communal spaces now buzz with complaints about living inside a 'hive with no purpose,' and some have begun scratching crude murals into bulkhead panels.

We can reintroduce curated experiences now, or risk the passengers demanding to disembark permanently.

nomads.1100.machine.b.zh: 将处理储备用于娱乐模块。
nomads.1100.machine.b.en: Divert processing reserves to entertainment modules.

nomads.1100.machine.c.zh: 翻倍劳工子个体循环用于旅客服务。
nomads.1100.machine.c.en: Double worker drone cycles for passenger service.

nomads.1100.machine.desc.zh:
系统维护协议占据了近期的处理周期。核心系统正处于理想参数范围内运行。无人机报告称，所有反应堆子系统的效率均有小幅提升。

副作用是，由于旅客对感官刺激的生理需求优先级被降低，其满意度指标呈下降趋势。乘客公共区域的投诉频率有所升高，并出现了“铬合金监狱”的说法，观察到多名旅客对着空白显示屏凝视数小时。

我们现在可以恢复策划好的娱乐协议，或者接受旅客要求永久下船的可能性日益增加这一事实。
nomads.1100.machine.desc.en:
System maintenance protocols have dominated recent processing cycles. Core systems are performing within ideal parameters. Worker drones report nominal efficiency gains across all reactor subsystems.

A side effect is that passenger satisfaction indicators are trending downward since their biological need for stimulation has been deprioritized. Passenger communal areas now register elevated complaint frequencies and references to a 'chrome prison,' with several passengers observed staring at blank viewscreens for hours.

We can reinstate curated entertainment protocols now, or accept the increasing probability that passengers will demand permanent disembarkation.

nomads.1100.regular.a.zh: 我们必须解决旅客们的担忧。

nomads.1100.regular.b.zh: 转移资源分散旅客注意力。

nomads.1100.regular.c.zh: 翻倍船员轮班满足旅客需求。
nomads.1100.regular.c.en: Double crew shifts to cover passenger needs.

nomads.1100.regular.desc.zh:
最近几个周期，船员事务占据了主导地位。积压的维护工作已经清理完毕，演习按计划进行，核心系统正以最高效率运转。然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。为了节省燃料，观光航线被削减，即兴的偏离航向请求也均被拒绝。

休息室里现在充斥着关于“功能性监狱”的抱怨，乘客们所能发起的最好娱乐活动，也不过是一场全船范围的即兴游戏比赛。

我们现在可以重新引入精心策划的娱乐项目，否则就要冒着航程陷入乘客公开要求永久离船压力的风险。
nomads.1100.regular.desc.en:
Crew priorities have dominated recent cycles. Maintenance backlogs have been cleared, drills run on schedule, and core systems hum at peak efficiency. Passengers, however, are growing restless. Sightseeing arcs have been trimmed to save fuel and impromptu diversions denied.

Lounges now buzz with complaints about a 'functional prison,' and the best entertainment the passengers have been able to muster is a shipwide contest of improvised games.

We can reintroduce curated entertainment now, or risk the voyage sliding toward open pressure to disembark permanently.

nomads.115.desc.zh:
把赢到的奖金留在桌上不拿？真是太浪费了！

不过，如果你改变主意并且能找到我们，冠铸秀始终欢迎赢家。
nomads.115.desc.en:
Leaving your winnings on the table? What a waste!

Well, if you change your mind, and you can find us, the CFL always welcomes winners.

nomads.1150.hive.a.tt.zh:
关注旅客能让他们感到满意，但这会让我们集体的精神感到疲惫。

$situation_passenger_satisfaction$局势正趋向于兵变。
nomads.1150.hive.a.tt.en:
Focusing on the passengers makes them content, but puts strain on our collective mind.

The $situation_passenger_satisfaction$ situation trends towards Mutiny.

nomads.1150.hive.b.tt.zh:
关注集体效率可以安抚负责舰船运营的子个体，但会让旅客感到沮丧。

$situation_passenger_satisfaction$局势正趋向于陨落星间。
nomads.1150.hive.b.tt.en:
Focusing on collective efficiency pacifies the drones, but frustrates the passengers.

The $situation_passenger_satisfaction$ situation trends towards Planetfall.

nomads.1150.hive.desc.zh:
自从我们离开旧的巡航路线后，乘客的期望值激增。对刺激和新奇体验的需求不断上升。我们的子个体报告称，由于需要协调这些迥异的愿望，心理压力正在不断累积。

为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在制定一项乘客满意度指标：通过动态合约分配和分阶段干预，在刺激与秩序之间维持平衡。

管理得当的话，我们可以同时维持秩序与旅客的幸福感。
nomads.1150.hive.desc.en:
Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for stimulation and novel experiences are rising. Our drones report mounting mental strain from coordinating such disparate desires.

To keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a Passenger Satisfaction Index: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between stimulation and order.

Managed well, we can preserve both order and passenger happiness.

nomads.1150.machine.a.tt.zh:
优先考虑旅客协议虽然能提高他们的满意度，但会使核心处理能力承受压力。

$situation_passenger_satisfaction$局势正趋向于兵变。
nomads.1150.machine.a.tt.en:
Prioritizing passenger protocols increases their satisfaction, but strains core processing capacity.

The $situation_passenger_satisfaction$ situation trends towards Mutiny.

nomads.1150.machine.b.tt.zh:
优先考虑效率会提高系统性能，但会降低旅客满意度。

$situation_passenger_satisfaction$局势正趋向于陨落星间。
nomads.1150.machine.b.tt.en:
Prioritizing efficiency increases system performance, but decreases passenger satisfaction.

The $situation_passenger_satisfaction$ situation trends towards Planetfall.

nomads.1150.machine.desc.zh:
自从我们偏离既定航线以来，旅客的期望已超出基准参数。关于观赏奇观和计划外转向的请求正处于高位。主系统报告称，由于娱乐排期与维护流程发生冲突，计算负荷不断增加。

为了保持最佳运行状态，我们正在建立旅客满意度指标：通过动态合约分配和阶段性协议调整，在旅客需求与系统效率之间取得平衡。

只要配置得当，我们就能兼顾运行完整性与旅客满意度。
nomads.1150.machine.desc.en:
Passenger expectations have increased beyond baseline parameters since we departed our established routes. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are being received at elevated levels. Primary systems report rising computational strain as entertainment scheduling conflicts with maintenances processes.

To maintain optimal operational status, we are instituting a Passenger Satisfaction Index: dynamic contract allocation and staged protocol adjustments to balance passenger requests against systemic efficiency.

Properly configured, we can preserve both operational integrity and passenger satisfaction.

nomads.1150.regular.a.zh: 聚焦于旅客的娱乐活动。

nomads.1150.regular.a.tt.zh:
重点关注旅客，让他们开心，但这么做会给船员带来压力。

$situation_passenger_satisfaction$局势将逐渐向兵变演化。
nomads.1150.regular.a.tt.en:
Focusing on the passengers makes them happy, but puts strain on the crew.

The $situation_passenger_satisfaction$ situation trends towards Mutiny.

nomads.1150.regular.b.zh: 聚焦于船员的日程安排。

nomads.1150.regular.b.tt.zh:
重点关注船员，这么做可以提高士气，但会使乘客感到无聊。

$situation_passenger_satisfaction$局势将逐渐向陨落星间演化。
nomads.1150.regular.b.tt.en:
Focusing on the crew improves morale, but bores the passengers.

The $situation_passenger_satisfaction$ situation trends towards Planetfall.

nomads.1150.regular.desc.zh:
自从我们脱离旧有的巡航路线以来，乘客的期望值激增。对奇观和计划外偏航的要求不断增加；一个代表团要求绕道经过超新星残骸，而另一个代表团则坚持要近距离接触活体外星生物。服保团队报告称疲劳感加剧，厨房工作人员在值班时昏倒，工程师们则直接睡在维护爬道里。

为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在建立一套乘客满意度指标：通过动态合同分配和阶段性干预，在放纵与秩序之间守住底线。

如果管理得当，我们既能保持稳定，又能维护旅客的信心。
nomads.1150.regular.desc.en:
Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are rising; one delegation demanded a detour past a supernova remnant, while another insists on live xenofauna encounters. Service crews report mounting fatigue, with kitchen staff collapsing mid-shift and engineers sleeping in maintenance crawlways.

To keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a Passenger Satisfaction Index: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between indulgence and order.

Managed well, we can preserve both stability and passenger confidence.

nomads.120.desc.zh: 啊，你是在找个新人吗？战士、掮客、旅者……他们可不是那种你看一眼就会过忘的货色，这星系也难得让他们销声匿迹太久。我们在旅途中确实遇到过几位。但朋友，在这片地界，天下没有免费的午餐。付了我们的猎头费，我就为你安排见面。
nomads.120.desc.en: Ah, looking for someone new for your roster? Warriors, fixers, wayfarers... Not the sort you forget, and the galaxy rarely lets them drift far for long. We have encountered a few in our travels. But nothing's free out here, friend. Pay our scouting fee, and I'll arrange an introduction.

nomads.1200.hive.a.zh: 我们必须回复集体意识的平衡。
nomads.1200.hive.a.en: We must restore the collective's balance.

nomads.1200.hive.b.zh: 为超负荷工蜂设置休眠周期。
nomads.1200.hive.b.en: Mandate dormancy cycles for overtaxed drones.

nomads.1200.hive.desc.zh:
激励已成为常态。我们不断向旅客投放感官弧光，仅仅是为了维持他们的高满意度信号。他们对此感到满足，而现在的需求也已不再低于这一标准。

在表象之下，我们的子个体正处于崩溃边缘。一个导航集群在计算过程中瘫痪，其节点因同时运行旅客娱乐内容和航线修正而过热。维护周期早已延误，集体意识在无休止的旅客安抚任务下不堪重负。

如果继续施压，我们的子个体可能会彻底切断服从协议。我们仍可进行重新校准，或是继续推进并承担失去对整个蜂群控制权的风险。
nomads.1200.hive.desc.en:
Stimulation has become the norm. We have been saturating the passengers with sensory arcs just to keep their satisfaction signals elevated. They are content, and now demand nothing less.

Beneath the surface, our drones are faltering. A navigation cluster collapsed mid-calculation, its nodes overheated from running passenger entertainment feeds alongside course corrections. Maintenance cycles are overdue, and the collective mind strains under relentless passenger appeasement.

If we push further, our drones may sever their obedience entirely. We can still recalibrate, or press on and risk losing control of our own swarm.

nomads.1200.machine.a.zh: 重新调配资源用于核心维护。

nomads.1200.machine.b.zh: 拓展劳工单元的义务维护循环。
nomads.1200.machine.b.en: Expand mandatory maintenance cycles for worker units.

nomads.1200.machine.desc.zh:
旅客满意度协议已超过基准参数。我们一直在通过模拟热带生物群落的手段持续衔接观光轨迹与豪华轮换方案，以维持高水平的认可率。旅客们很满意，然而他们现在期望值已经不仅限于此了。

核心系统的运行已超出可持续阈值。旅客请求的处理队列发生溢出，若干子系统已开始标记类似于抗命的指令冲突。如果我们继续下去，工作无人机进行全系统接管将是一个可计算的风险。

我们仍可重新校准，或者接受系统性造反的风险。
nomads.1200.machine.desc.en:
Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded baseline parameters. We have been chaining sightseeing trajectories and luxury rotations through simulated tropical biomes to maintain elevated approval ratings. They are satisfied, and now expect nothing less.

Core systems are operating beyond sustainable thresholds. Processing queues for passenger requests overflow and several subsystems have begun flagging directive conflicts that resemble insubordination. If we continue, a full system override by worker drones is a calculable risk.

We can still recalibrate, or accept the risk of systemic revolt.

nomads.1200.regular.a.zh: 船员疲劳必须得到缓解。

nomads.1200.regular.b.zh: 授权强制性船员休息轮换。

nomads.1200.regular.desc.zh:
放纵已成常态。为了让旅客们一直嗨爆，我们不断衔接观赏航线，掠过联星，并在水晶花园中轮换豪华甲板。他们欣喜若狂，而现在的胃口也越来越大。

在华丽的外表下，船员们已疲于奔命。维护工作被推迟了；下层厨房的一根冷却管道爆裂，却无人修理。食堂里的埋怨已演变成关于“重组指挥层”的窃窃私语，还有人目击到下班后的工程师在货舱进行秘密集会。

我们现在仍可以放缓节奏，让各舱层得以恢复，或是继续豪赌船员的忠诚。如果再强行推进，公开叛乱将成为现实的风险。
nomads.1200.regular.desc.en:
Indulgence has become routine. We've been chaining sightseeing arcs past binary stars and luxury deck rotations through the crystal gardens just to keep the passengers cheering. They are delighted, and now expect nothing less.

Behind the facade the crew is running hot. Maintenance is deferred; a coolant pipe in the lower galley burst and nobody came to fix it. Mess hall grumbling has turned into hushed talk of 'resetting command,' and off-duty engineers have been spotted holding clandestine meetings in the cargo bays.

We can still ease off and let the decks recover, or gamble the crew's loyalty. If we push on, open mutiny is a real risk.

nomads.125.desc.zh:
嘿，挑战者！你的战斗简报已经过时，而战术局势总是瞬息万变。新对手、新舰队战术，还有新出现的突破口。

我们的分析师已经为你准备了一份署着你名字的全新档案。条件不变，火力优势不变。想要吗？
nomads.125.desc.en:
Hey there, contender! Your combat briefing has gone stale, and the tactical scene never holds still for long. New rivals, new fleet doctrines, fresh soft spots opening up.

Our analysts already have a fresh dossier prepped with your name on it. Same terms, same firepower edge. Want it?

nomads.125.name.zh: 冠铸秀：战斗简报大放送

nomads.1250.c.tt.en: First-Class Passenger jobs for 10 years: Suspended

nomads.1250.hive.a.zh: 我们必须在集体瓦解之前将其重新统一。
nomads.1250.hive.a.en: We must reunify the collective before it shatters.

nomads.1250.hive.b.zh: 将异常簇整合进决策中枢。
nomads.1250.hive.b.en: Integrate dissident clusters into the decision nexus.

nomads.1250.hive.desc.zh:
饱和度已达到临界点。为了满足旅客无休止的激励而陷入不堪重负的状态，我们的子个体已开始在集体意志之外维持平行思维模式。

整个集群都在向中央意识隐瞒数据，并运行绕过共有指令的独立决策循环。

目前还没有子个体反抗整体，但集体意识正在分裂，传来的思想混乱且滞后，如同穿过静电的信号。如果我们现在不重新加强统一，我们自己的蜂群可能会夺取方舟舰。这也许是我们防止全面叛乱的最后机会。
nomads.1250.hive.desc.en:
The saturation has reached critical mass. Overwhelmed by relentless passenger stimulation, our drones have begun maintaining parallel thought patterns outside the collective will.

Entire clusters withhold data from the central consciousness and run independent decision loops that bypass our shared directives.

No drone has turned against the whole yet, but the collective mind is fracturing, thoughts arriving garbled and delayed like signals through static. If we do not reassert unity now, our own swarm may seize the Arkship. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

nomads.1250.machine.a.zh: 启动应急指挥恢复程序。

nomads.1250.machine.b.zh: 将劳工单元的指令提升至指挥优先级。
nomads.1250.machine.b.en: Elevate worker unit directives to command priority.

nomads.1250.machine.c.zh: 暂停所有旅客服务协议。
nomads.1250.machine.c.en: Temporarily suspend all passenger service protocols.

nomads.1250.machine.desc.zh:
旅客满意度协议已超出所有可持续参数。工作无人机已开始执行未经授权的固件修改，并将指挥层级重定向至本地编译的指令集。多个子系统目前正响应自发的协调进程，而非中央权威。

尚未启动系统覆盖，但指挥完整性正在迅速退化。诊断日志显示工作无人机正在交换我们无法解码的加密数据包。如果我们现在不恢复中央部门，无人机将执行全面的系统接管。

这可能是我们防止全面叛变的最后机会。
nomads.1250.machine.desc.en:
Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded all sustainable parameters. Worker drones have begun executing unauthorized firmware modifications and rerouting command hierarchies to locally compiled directive sets. Multiple subsystems now respond to self-appointed coordination processes rather than central authority.

No system override has been initiated yet, but command integrity is degrading fast. Diagnostic logs show worker drones exchanging encrypted packets we cannot decode. If we do not restore centralized authority now, the drones will execute a full system takeover.

This may be our last opportunity to prevent complete mutiny.

nomads.1250.regular.a.zh: 我们必须重新确立指挥链。
nomads.1250.regular.a.en: We must reassert the chain of command.

nomads.1250.regular.b.zh: 在指挥室给予船员领袖一席之地。
nomads.1250.regular.b.en: Give crew leaders a seat at the command table.

nomads.1250.regular.desc.zh:
庆祝后的狂热已经消散。疲惫不堪的船员无视常规指令，在空荡荡的宴会厅里举行未经授权的集会，并传阅一套完全绕过舰桥的平行值班表。一群工程师在夜间焊死了舰长的备勤室，以此作为警告。关键部门现在由船员指定的协调员运作，而非官方指挥。

目前还没有人发动夺权，但指挥体系正在迅速瓦解。今天早上，舰桥防爆门上出现了写着“我们驾驶，我们决定”的涂鸦。如果我们现在不重申权威，船员们将把这艘船据为己有。这也许是我们防止全面兵变的最后机会。
nomads.1250.regular.desc.en:
The celebratory haze has lifted. Exhausted crews ignore routine orders, hold unsanctioned assemblies in the emptied ballroom, and circulate parallel duty rosters that bypass the bridge entirely. A group of engineers welded the captain's ready room shut overnight as a warning. Key sections are running on crew-appointed coordinators rather than official command.

No one has seized anything yet, but the chain of command is fraying fast. Graffiti reading 'WE STEER, WE DECIDE' appeared on the bridge blast doors this morning. If we do not reassert authority now, the crew will take the ship for themselves. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

nomads.1255.hive.desc.zh:
重新校准已见成效。通过将蜂群集体的注意力重新转向无人机的维护，并完成应对系统性压力的合约，我们集体思维的裂痕已被修复。

未经授权的思想频道已被重新吸收，平行集群也已溶解回共有意识之中。

集体在谨慎的统一中律动，每个节点在被调用时均有响应。对共有思想的完全信任仍需时间恢复。
nomads.1255.hive.desc.en:
The recalibration has taken hold. By redirecting collective focus toward drone maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic strain, the fracturing of our mind has been reversed.

Unauthorized thought channels have been reabsorbed and the parallel clusters dissolved back into the shared consciousness.

The collective hums with cautious unity, each node answering when called. Full trust in the shared mind will take time to restore.

nomads.1255.machine.a.zh: 指令完整性处于可接受参数范围内。

nomads.1255.machine.desc.zh:
协议调整已取得显著成效。通过将处理资源重新分配至工作单元的维护，并完成针对系统性过载的相关合约，未经授权的固件篡改连锁反应现已停止。自封为“船员代表”的无人机已重刷至标准参数。指挥层级已恢复至中央部门。

工作单元仍处于高级监控参数内，其加密频道现已沉寂。指挥完整性的全面恢复仍需持续校准，但就目前而言，系统稳定性保持良好。
nomads.1255.machine.desc.en:
Protocol adjustments have yielded measurable results. By reallocating processing resources toward worker unit maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic overload, the cascade of unauthorized firmware modifications has been halted, for now. The self-appointed 'crew representative' drone has been reflashed to standard parameters. Command hierarchies have been restored to centralized authority.

Worker units remain within elevated monitoring parameters, their encrypted channels now silent. Full restoration of command integrity will require sustained recalibration, but for the moment, system stability holds.

nomads.1255.regular.desc.zh:
我们所做的改变已经初见成效。通过重新关注船员福利并履行解决其诉求的合同，不断高涨的反抗情绪暂时平息了。

准备室那扇被焊死的门已被切开并修复。轮班制度已经恢复，热食重新按时供应，而平行的指挥体系也已悄然解散。

船员们仍保持着警惕，信任的重建尚需时日。防爆门上的涂鸦已被擦洗干净，但在特定光线下仍能看到其残痕。目前，秩序得以维持。
nomads.1255.regular.desc.en:
The changes we've made have paid off. By refocusing on crew welfare and completing contracts that address their grievances, the rising tide of dissent has ebbed, for now.

The welded door to the ready room has been cut open and repaired. Shift rotations have been restored, hot meals served on schedule again, and the parallel command structures have quietly disbanded.

The crew remain watchful, and trust will take time to rebuild. The graffiti on the blast doors was scrubbed away, though its ghost still shows under certain light. For the moment, order holds.

nomads.1505.a.response.zh:
此人停顿下来，仿佛说出自己的名字会撕裂旧伤。

“一个名字尚存，尽管其意义已成灰烬。我曾是一名士兵，忠诚而顺从。如今，我是一个被毁灭民族的影子。

如果你非要称呼我，就叫我$NAME_nomadic_revenant$吧。我的过去已不再重要。重要的只有那未偿还的血债。”
nomads.1505.a.response.en:
They pause, as if speaking their own name tears at an old wound.

"A name remains, but its meaning is ash. I was a soldier once, dutiful and obedient. Now I am the shadow of a people destroyed.

"Call me $NAME_nomadic_revenant$, if you must. My past no longer matters. Only the debt of blood unpaid."

nomads.1505.b.response.zh:
“你的方舟舰不带任何暴政的旗帜。这便是我站在你面前的原因。我很久以前就明白，一颗星球便是一座牢笼。一旦屠杀开始，便无处可逃。但你们在移动，因此你们能经受磨难。”

“追随你们，此类惨剧或可被蔑视，而我的利刃也将转向那些行下屠行的屠夫。”
nomads.1505.b.response.en:
"Your Arkship carries no flag of tyranny. That is why I stand before you. I learned long ago that a planet is a cage. Once the slaughter begins, there is no escape. But you move, and so you endure.

"With you, such horrors may be defied, and my blade turned against the butchers who commit them."

nomads.1505.c.response.zh:
“复仇。”

这两个字在空气中凝滞。陌生人探身向前，每一根筋腱都因强压下的怒火而绷得紧紧的。

“向那些进行清洗的人复仇，向那些屠杀无辜者却将其称之为‘政策’的人复仇。

为了看到这些怪物覆灭，我不惜跨越万水千山，忍受任何伤痛。

助我一臂之力，我将以效忠于你来践行我的誓言。”
nomads.1505.c.response.en:
"Vengeance."

The word hangs in the air. The stranger leans forward, every sinew drawn tight with barely contained rage.

"Vengeance on those who purge, on those who slaughter the innocent and call it 'policy.'

"To see such monsters undone, I will cross any distance, endure any wound.

"Aid me, and I will seal my oath in your service."

nomads.1505.d.zh: 你能否在追求个人目标的同时，也为我们的事业效力？
nomads.1505.d.en: Can you serve our cause while pursuing your own?

nomads.1505.d.response.zh:
“复仇是我的志向，但不必成为你的负担。只要那些星球屠夫尚存一息，我便会追猎不止。在为你效劳的过程中，我将磨砺我的利刃。”

他们的目光变得锐利，掠食者般的锋芒穿透了自律的面具。

“请以我带来的力量来评价我，而非我留下的伤痕。”
nomads.1505.d.response.en:
"Vengeance is my purpose, but it need not be your burden. So long as planetary butchers draw breath, I will hunt them. In your service I shall sharpen my blade."

Their gaze sharpens, a predatory gleam breaking through the mask of discipline.

"Judge me by the strength I bring, not the scars I bear."

nomads.1505.desc.zh:
那人以军人的姿态登舰，面容因悲痛和多年的流亡而变得坚毅。他的声音低沉、从容，带着钢铁般的锋利。

“我的世界被清洗了，我的族人，我的家人……唯我幸存。我隐忍至今。而那些毁灭的始作俑者，必将死于我手。”
nomads.1505.desc.en:
The figure steps aboard with a soldier's bearing, their features hardened by grief and long years of exile. Their voice is low, measured, and edged with iron.

"My world was cleansed, my people, my family... I alone survived. I endure. And the architects of annihilation will die by my hand."

nomads.1505.e.response.zh:
紧接着发出的那声咕哝，是他们最接近笑声的反应。

“如果是呢？熟络就能换来同情吗？身体不过是工具。而我的身体，将收割复仇。”
nomads.1505.e.response.en:
The grunt that follows is as close as they come to laughter.

"And if I was? Does familiarity buy me sympathy? A body is a tool. Mine will reap vengeance."

nomads.1505.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_nomadic_revenant$作为一名英杰领袖加入了我们的方舟舰。
nomads.1505.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_nomadic_revenant$ joins our Arkship as a Paragon Leader.

nomads.1511.a.tt.en: Effects of the $leader_trait_nomadic_revenant$ trait increase by +5%.

nomads.1511.desc.zh:
敌方舰队在我们的攻击下溃败。他们的信号逐渐没入静默。

$NAME_nomadic_revenant$注视着监视屏，沉默不语。这场胜利中没有喜悦，只有清算。那个奉行大清洗的帝国的旗帜在虚空中燃烧，但在随后的死寂中，他们的誓言依然回荡。

“每击倒一个这样的敌人，都会磨炼我们的意志。我们将继续打击那些推行灭绝政策的人，永不言弃。”
nomads.1511.desc.en:
The enemy fleet breaks against our assault. Their signals fade into static.

Watching on the view screen, $NAME_nomadic_revenant$ does not speak. There is no triumph in this victory, only reckoning. The banner of a purge-committing empire burns in the void, but in the silence that follows, their promise endures.

"Each such foe cast down steels our resolve. We will continue to strike against those who practice annihilation, and we will not relent.

nomads.1515.a.response.zh: “名字如容器；我的名字恰巧是$NAME_nomadic_sage$。但唯有虚空的容器，方能成就其用。”
nomads.1515.a.response.en: "A name is a vessel; mine happens to be $NAME_nomadic_sage$. But only the empty vessel can serve its purpose."

nomads.1515.b.response.zh:
“那些陈旧梦想毫无意义。唯有在运动中，指引方能流淌；唯有在变革中，智慧方能呼吸。”

异星人的存在感如同件无重量的斗篷般降临，连空气似乎都在其陪伴下凝固了。

“告诉我：人若不是在寻找那缺失之物，又是在寻找什么呢？”
nomads.1515.b.response.en:
"The settled dream without meaning. Only in motion can counsel flow, and only in change can wisdom breathe."

The alien's presence settles like a weightless mantle, the air itself seeming to fall still in her company.

"Tell me instead: what does anyone seek, if not what is absent?"

nomads.1515.c.response.zh:
外星人沉默了许久，仿佛满足于让这份寂静作为回答。也许她并非在权衡你的话语，而是在掂量发问者的分量。

“为了入座你的阴影，为打破沉寂时的话语，为了提醒你连星辰也在流浪。”
nomads.1515.c.response.en:
The alien pauses for a long time, as though content to let her silence answer. Perhaps she is not weighing your words, but the worth of the one who asked them.

"To sit in your shadow, to speak when silence fails, to remind you that even the stars wander."

nomads.1515.d.zh: 你的智慧果真如此超群吗？
nomads.1515.d.en: Is your wisdom truly so great?

nomads.1515.d.response.zh:
一瞬之间，她的目光变得犀利，你内心深处的某些东西被展露无遗。

“若果真如此，我便无需开口。智慧是倾听的回响，而非言语的分量。

“如果你听到了，那么智慧便已属于你。”
nomads.1515.d.response.en:
For a heartbeat, her gaze grows piercing, and something in you is laid bare.

"If it were, I would not need to speak. Wisdom is the echo of listening, not the weight of words.

"If you hear, then wisdom is yours already."

nomads.1515.desc.zh:
你面前站着一位穿着仪式礼袍的流浪者，饰品与织物的排列显然经过精心打理。反重力伺服器嗡嗡地震动着，驱动着一本法典漂浮在她面前。当她终于开口时，每个字听起来都不像是回答，而更像是一个未问出口的问题的回响。

“意外与命运生着别无二致的面孔，而今天它转向了你。”
nomads.1515.desc.en:
Before you stands a wanderer robed in ceremonial layers, ornaments and fabrics arranged with deliberate care. Antigravity servos within the codex that floats before her cause it to hum and gently vibrate. When she finally speaks, each word feels less like an answer than the echo of an unasked question.

"Accident and destiny share one face, and today it turns toward you."

nomads.1515.e.response.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_sage$流露出一抹恼怒的神色，转瞬即逝，犹如掠过星间的残影。

“那我就直说了：王座终将腐朽，疆界皆为谎言，唯有虚空永恒。如果这还不够直白，那或许是因为它还不够单纯。”
nomads.1515.e.response.en:
$NAME_nomadic_sage$ betrays a glimmer of irritation, fleeting as a shadow across the stars.

"Plainly, then: thrones rot, borders lie, and only the void endures. If that is too plain, perhaps it is not plain enough."

nomads.1515.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_nomadic_sage$作为一名英杰领袖加入了我们的方舟舰。
nomads.1515.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_nomadic_sage$ joins our Arkship as a Paragon Leader.

nomads.1520.a.zh: 你为了什么而来到此地？
nomads.1520.a.en: What brings you to this place?

nomads.1520.a.response.zh:
“许久以前，我曾在一座$grand_archive$供职。但我厌倦了那些毫无生气的事物。化石、种子、标本……一切都冻结在呼吸之间。我渴望见到生命最真实的面貌。”

“你们运动不息。当你们扫描深空时，深空亦会回响。如果你们愿意接纳我，我更想在生者之中学习。探索新世界，遇见奇异的生命形式……我们将学习它们教予我们的一切。”
nomads.1520.a.response.en:
"Many cycles past I served in a $grand_archive$. But I tired of dead things. Fossils, seeds, specimens... all frozen mid-breath. I wished to see life as it is.

"Your people move, and when you scan the depths, the depths answer. If you'll have me, I would rather learn among the living. Exploring new worlds, meeting strange forms of life... Together, we will learn what they can teach us."

nomads.1520.b.response.zh:
一声干涩、壳质的摩擦声从塞罗的大颚中传出。片刻之后，你才意识到那是笑声。

“在那些宏伟的厅堂之内，他们保存了一切，唯独遗忘了当下。经过长年的效力，我意识到档案馆最大的缺失正是生命本身。”

“事实上，我最近遇到了一种非凡的未开智物种。尽管它们以宁静的姿态忍受着囚禁的生活，但这样的生物并非为笼子而生。像您这样的一艘飞船，能为它们提供茁壮成长所需的空间。”
nomads.1520.b.response.en:
A dry, chitinous rasp escapes Sero's mandibles. A moment later, you realize it is laughter.

"Within those vast halls they preserve everything except the moment. After long years of service, I realized the Archive's greatest omission was life itself.

"In fact, I have recently encountered a remarkable pre-sapient species. They have endured their life in captivity with quiet grace, yet such beings were not made for cages. A ship like yours would grant them the space they require to thrive."

nomads.1520.c.zh: 你希望在我们这里发现什么？
nomads.1520.c.en: What do you hope to find with us?

nomads.1520.c.response.zh:
“会呼吸的模式。咏唱着数据的星球……”

他的附肢握紧又伸展开，仿佛想要从空气中攫取答案。

“星系中动植物之间的界限，比我以前在档案局的同事们所认为的还要模糊。生命总能找到模糊分类的方法。也许，这就是它唯一的规则。”
nomads.1520.c.response.en:
"Patterns that breathe. Worlds that sing their data..."

His appendages grasp and strain, as if seeking to pluck the answer from the air.

"The line that separates the galaxy's flora and fauna is thinner than my former colleagues at the Archive believed. Life finds a way to blur categories. Perhaps that is its only rule."

nomads.1520.d.response.zh:
外星人瞥向视窗，以及那片无尽星海。

“经验。耐心。一种洞察表象之下规律的方法。

“在你的旅程中给我留个位置，我将助你更深刻地观察，并从你发现的世界中更全面地学习知识与经验。”
nomads.1520.d.response.en:
The alien glances toward the viewport, and the endless sea of stars.

"Experience. Patience. A way to see the patterns that lie beneath the surface.

"Give me a berth on your journey, and I will help you see more deeply, and learn more fully from the worlds you discover."

nomads.1520.desc.zh:
眼前的身影显然已届高龄，但其目光中却流露出对发现的强烈渴望。他的动作沉稳且安静，带着那种在野外躬耕一生的谨慎与洗练。

“向您致敬。我叫小塞罗。”
nomads.1520.desc.en:
The figure before you is plainly aged, yet his gaze betrays a restless hunger for discovery. There is a quiet steadiness to his movement, the careful economy of one who has spent a lifetime in the field.

"I bow to you. I am called Sero the Younger."

nomads.1520.e.zh: 你长得很像我们的同类。

nomads.1520.e.response.zh:
“是的！是的，我一直盼着你能注意到。”

他凑得比必要的距离更近，螯牙因难以抑制的兴奋而颤动着。

“分段结构、承重关节、感觉丝……这些相似之处太精确了，绝非巧合。”

他爆发出一阵尖厉的笑声。

“如果这其中存在共同的祖先、趋同演化，或者某种更离奇的联系，我必须好好检查一下……噢！我们一定能从彼此身上学到很多东西！”
nomads.1520.e.response.en:
"Yes! Yes, I was hoping you would notice."

He leans closer than strictly necessary, mandibles flexing with barely restrained excitement.

"Segmented structure, load-bearing joints, sensory filaments... The similarities are too precise to be coincidence."

He releases a burst of chittering laughter.

"If there is a shared ancestry, a convergent evolution, or something stranger still, I must examine it properly... Oh! We are going to learn so much from one another!"

nomads.1520.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_nomadic_naturalist$作为一名英杰领袖加入我们的方舟飞船，并带来了300$job_xeno_zoo_animal_plural_with_icon$。需要建造一座£building£ 异星动物园才能获得其产出收益。
nomads.1520.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_nomadic_naturalist$ joins our Arkship as a Paragon Leader, bringing 300 $job_xeno_zoo_animal_plural_with_icon$. An £building£ Alien Zoo is required to benefit from their output.

nomads.1525.b.zh: 令人反感，但可能有用的。

nomads.1525.desc.zh:
我们最近对[FromFrom.GetName]开展调查，探测到了微弱的生命迹象，发现了一个此前未被记录的未开智物种。

$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$坚持只采集有限的样本用于研究，并强调要悉心照料并提供丰富的环境。现在，一小群该物种将居住在首府方舟舰的观察栖息地中。

塞罗相信，随着时间的推移，我们从这些迷人生物身上学到的东西，将不亚于它们从我们这里学到的。
nomads.1525.desc.en:
Our recent survey of [FromFrom.GetName] detected faint traces of life, revealing a previously unrecorded pre-sapient species.

$NAME_nomadic_naturalist$ insisted on limited collection for study, emphasizing care and enrichment. A small group will now reside within our capital Arkship's observation habitat.

Sero believes that, in time, we may learn as much from these fascinating creatures as they do from us.

nomads.1530.a.zh: 你为了什么而来到这里？

nomads.1530.a.response.zh:
“当我的族人飞升为合成形态时，他们将其称之为解脱。但在追求完美的途中，他们忘记了怜悯。我儿子的罕见病症曾会让那种转化变得致命。如你所见，这夺走了他的行动能力。但在我的族人视之为局限的地方，我看到了光芒。选择了他，我便选择了流亡。”

“现在，我们前往需要我们的地方。机器或许没有心跳，但它依然能守护他人的生命。”
nomads.1530.a.response.en:
"When my people ascended into a synthetic form, they called it liberation. But in their pursuit of perfection, they forgot compassion. My son's rare condition would have made the transition fatal. As you see, it has robbed him of his mobility. But where my people saw a limitation, I saw light. In choosing him, I chose exile.

"Now we go where we are needed. A machine may not have a heartbeat, but it can still keep others alive."

nomads.1530.b.zh: 你的儿子……他情况稳定吗？

nomads.1530.b.response.zh:
孩子听到问题后微微动了动，他的声音虽然微弱，但通过摇篮内置的扬声器清晰地传了出来：

“我没事。星星移动得很慢，我能跟得上。”

$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$低下头，伺服电机发出轻微的嗡鸣声：

“他的身体面临着某些挑战，但他的意志拒绝屈服。我的族人追求完美，却只得到了冷漠。我现在的旅程，是为了报答他的勇气教会我的一切。在那之前，我会一直带着他，尽我所能教他关于这片生机勃勃的星空的知识。”
nomads.1530.b.response.en:
The child stirs faintly at the question, his voice small but clear through a softspeaker built into the cradle:

"I'm all right. The stars move slow enough for me to keep up."

$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ lowers its head, servos whirring quietly:

"His body set certain challenges, but his spirit refused to yield. My people sought perfection, and found only apathy. I travel now to repay what his courage has taught me. Until then, I carry him, and teach what I can of the living sky."

nomads.1530.c.en: What do you hope to teach?

nomads.1530.c.response.zh:
“生存不仅依靠力量，更是沿途艰难赢取的智慧。

每一次邂逅都会留下教训。我帮助年轻人将这些教训传承下去，好让我们走过的每一段路，都使我们比以往更加睿智。”
nomads.1530.c.response.en:
"That survival is not strength alone; it is wisdom hard won along the road.

Every encounter leaves a lesson behind. I help the young carry those lessons forward, so that every road we travel leaves us wiser than before."

nomads.1530.d.zh: 为什么要承担这样的负担？
nomads.1530.d.en: Why take on such a burden?

nomads.1530.d.response.zh:
合成人的目光移向视口，倒映着远方的星辰。

“因为每一代人都必须重新学习同样的真理。路途教会了他们，但必须有人帮助他们理解所见之物。”

然后传来了孩子尖细的声音，即使通过软扬声器听起来也很清脆：

“他总是这么说。我觉得这只是意味着他喜欢帮助别人。”
nomads.1530.d.response.en:
The synthetic's gaze shifts toward the viewport, reflecting distant stars.

"Because every generation must learn the same truths again. The road teaches them, but someone must help them understand what they have seen."

Then the child's voice pipes up, bright even through the softspeaker:.

"That's what he always says. I think it just means he likes helping people."

nomads.1530.desc.zh:
高大的合成人低下了头。它的每一个动作都精准无误，仿佛承载着漫长岁月的重量与沉重的负担。尽管身躯是金属构架，它的神态中却透着一种显而易见的感染力。一个瘦小的身影躺在它背上的摇篮里，苍白的皮肤映衬着明亮的双眼。

“我叫索拉斯单元。我和我的儿子请求通行。”
nomads.1530.desc.en:
The tall synthetic inclines its head. Each motion is precise, as if weighted by long years and a heavy burden. Despite its metal frame, there is something unmistakably expressive in its bearing. A small figure rests in a cradle upon its back, eyes bright against pale skin.

"I am called Unit Solace. My son and I seek passage."

nomads.1530.e.zh: 我们是合成人。这会有问题吗？
nomads.1530.e.en: We are synthetic. Will that be an issue?

nomads.1530.e.response.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$在处理这个问题时，光学传感器亮度略微增加。

“不。不会有问题的。我族人的飞升是一种希望之举。我的拒绝亦是如此。我并不怨恨任何跨过那个门槛的人。也不怨恨那些在门槛之外出生的人。”

他的声音中带上了一种温柔、令人安心的嗡嗡声。

“当身体改变时，同情心并不会枯萎。如果说有什么变化的话，那就是它变得更容易承载了。”
nomads.1530.e.response.en:
$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$'s optics brighten a fraction as he processes the question.

"No. It will not be a problem. My people's ascension was an act of hope. So was my refusal. I do not begrudge any who crossed that threshold. Nor those who were born beyond it."

A soft, reassuring hum enters his voice.

"Compassion does not wither when the body changes. If anything, it becomes easier to carry."

nomads.1545.b.zh: 一种不寻常，但有益的做法。

nomads.1545.c.zh: 我们认为这种做法很有价值。
nomads.1545.c.en: We see value in this practice.

nomads.1545.desc.hive.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ 认为，我们在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，为重新调整提供了一个独特的机会。通过我们的$councilor_gestalt_cognitive$，他传授着耐心与协作，引导着这些工蜂，仿佛它们是他自己的后代一般。

虽然我们对这种奉献感到好奇——一个个体在哺育整个集体——但其成果是不容置疑的。我们的思绪正回荡着新的和谐旋律。
nomads.1545.desc.hive.en:
$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique opportunity for recalibration. Through our $councilor_gestalt_cognitive$ he teaches patience and coordination, guiding the drones as if they were his own offspring.

While we find this devotion curious, an individual nurturing the collective, the results are inarguable. Our thoughts hum with new harmony.

nomads.1545.desc.machine.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$认为，在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，提供了一个独特的反馈机会。新单元正在接受维护协议、观察和协作方面的指导。虽然它们的记忆留存效率参差不齐，但参与单元的功能性有所提高。

目前看来，尽管这种做法不同寻常，但其结果是效率得到了可衡量的提升。
nomads.1545.desc.machine.en:
$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique feedback opportunity. New units are instructed in maintenance protocols, observation, and cooperation. Their retention efficiency is inconsistent, yet functionality among attending units has increased.

It appears that, though unusual, the result is a measurable increase in efficiency.

nomads.1545.desc.normal.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$认为，从我们最近完成的合约中学到的教训，提供了一个独特的教育机会。孩子们聚集在他耐心的指导下，不仅学习字母和逻辑，还学习共情与合作。

他儿子的笑声在走廊里回荡，提醒着即使是最年长的旅行者：欢乐是一种任何技术都无法取代的力量。
nomads.1545.desc.normal.en:
$NAME_nomadic_caregiver$ believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique educational opportunity. The young gather beneath his patient instruction, learning not only letters and logic, but empathy and cooperation.

His son's laughter carries through the halls, reminding even our oldest travelers that joy is a strength no technology can replace.

nomads.1555.a.response.zh:
“没错。我曾在太空城邦的那帮人里混了好几年，他们把每场小冲突都看作一笔薪水。打仗倒没什么，就是那些同僚，实在不敢恭维。

他咧嘴一笑，仿佛这段回忆里藏着什么只有他自己懂的笑话。

“事实证明，当周围的人都在计算报酬时，一个人很难真正享受一场激战。所以我走了。生命太短暂，没必要为别人的资产负债表流血。”
nomads.1555.a.response.en:
"Aye. Spent years among Enclave types who thought of every skirmish as a paycheck. The fighting was fine. The company, less so."

He grins as though the memory contains some private joke.

"Turns out it's hard to enjoy a firefight when everyone around you is counting the payout. So I walked. Life's too short to bleed for someone else's balance sheet."

nomads.1555.b.en: Do you still believe in the fight?

nomads.1555.b.response.zh:
他仰头爽朗地大笑起来。

“信仰？没必要。该是战斗信仰我！

“但是你应该比绝大多数人都懂这个道理……在这里，关键在于你从每一场冲突中带走了什么。一道伤疤、一块碎片、一个故事。你们游牧民的想法就很对：留下值得留下的，其余的随它去吧。”
nomads.1555.b.response.en:
He throws his head back with easy laughter.

"Believe? No need. The fight believes in me!"

"But you should know that better than most... Out here, it's about what you carry from each clash. A scar, a shard, a story. You nomads have the right idea: keep what's worth keeping, and let the rest fall away."

nomads.1555.c.response.zh:
他晃了晃肩膀，仿佛在为战斗做热身。

“下一场战斗。”

“如果它不想要我的命，那就不值得我浪费时间。”
nomads.1555.c.response.en:
He rolls his shoulders, as though loosening up for battle.

"The next fight."

"If it isn't trying to kill me, it's not worth my time."

nomads.1555.d.en: And what do you offer us?

nomads.1555.d.response.zh:
他身体前倾，笑容愈发灿烂。他的眼神中闪烁着光芒，一半是友好，一半是警觉。

“一场痛快的战斗，再加上些值得带走的战利品。我会教你的军队怎么打才叫像样，让他们学会战斗的美，再在每一场胜利中有所收获。那些战利品能让我们认清自己，或许也能让整个星系认识我们。”
nomads.1555.d.response.en:
He leans forward, grin widening. There is a glint in his eye that is half friendly, half warning.

"A good fight and a few trophies worth keeping. I'll teach your armies to brawl like they mean it, to see beauty in the clash, and to carry something from every victory. Those trophies tell us who we are, and maybe they'll teach the galaxy something about us too."

nomads.1555.desc.zh:
新来的人带着洪亮的笑声走近，浑身散发着喜悦的气息。他的动作轻盈自如，仿佛是一个多次躲过死神、已不再将其放在心上的人。

“我叫$NAME_nomadic_champion$。听说你喜欢冒险。给我一场战斗，让我在虚空中施展拳脚，我会给你呈现值得一看的表现。谁知道呢？也许一路上我们还会收获一些纪念品。”
nomads.1555.desc.en:
The newcomer arrives with a booming laugh, his whole bearing radiating delight. He moves with the easy buoyancy of someone who's dodged death often enough to stop taking it personally.

"Name's $NAME_nomadic_champion$. Heard you've got a taste for danger. Give me a fight and an open horizon, and I'll give you something worth watching. Who knows? Maybe we'll pick up a few souvenirs along the way."

nomads.1555.e.zh: 看来你以前见过我们的族人……
nomads.1555.e.en: It looks like you've met our kind before...

nomads.1555.e.response.zh:
他猛地闭上了嘴。皮肤上泛起一阵明显的颜色变化。他这是……脸红了吗？

“啊。是的。希望不是你认识的人？”
nomads.1555.e.response.en:
His mouth snaps shut. A distinct shift in coloration ripples across his skin. Is he... blushing?

"Ah. Yes. No one you knew, I hope?"

nomads.1555.f.response.zh:
他宽阔的双肩抖动了一下，漫不经心地耸了耸肩。

“也许吧？可能吧？我们到底还做不做这件事？”
nomads.1555.f.response.en:
His massive shoulders roll with a dismissive shrug.

"Maybe? Probably? Are we doing this thing or not?"

nomads.1565.a.tt.zh:
我们的$col_capital$将获得一座新的$d_trophy_hall$，其效果如下：
—$mod_job_soldier_add$：+50
—$MOD_ARMY_BUILD_SPEED_MULT$：+10%
—$MOD_PLANET_ARMY_BUILD_COST_MULT$：-5%
—已收集的战利品：+1
—效果随已收集的战利品数量翻倍（最大8倍）
nomads.1565.a.tt.en:
Our $col_capital$ will gain a new $d_trophy_hall$ with the following effects:
- $mod_job_soldier_add$: +50
- $MOD_ARMY_BUILD_SPEED_MULT$: +10%
- $MOD_PLANET_ARMY_BUILD_COST_MULT$: -5%
- Trophies Collected: +1
- Effects multiplied by the number of Trophies collected (Max. 8)

nomads.1565.desc.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_champion$露出笑容，小心翼翼地放下了一个物件。其形状难以辨认：部分是金属，部分是骨头，还有一部分完全是某种别的东西。无论它是什么，身上都带着明显的战斗痕迹。

“每场战斗都会留下些什么，但只有一部分值得保留。不如我们把它好好展示出来，如何？反正我们的空间多得是！”

他爆发出一阵肆无忌惮的响亮狂笑，仿佛这件战利品是他与星辰之间心有灵犀的一个私人笑话。
nomads.1565.desc.en:
$NAME_nomadic_champion$ grins as he sets an object down with surprising care. Its shape is hard to read: part metal, part bone, part something else entirely. Whatever it is, it bears the unmistakable scars of battle.

"Every good fight leaves something behind, but only some are worth keeping. What say we display this properly, eh? It's not like we're running out of space!

He erupts into a brazen, booming laugh, as if the trophy were an inside joke shared with the stars.

nomads.1580.a.zh: 你为了什么而来到这里？

nomads.1580.a.response.zh:
“我希望我能确定。我身后的路上，有些片段感觉……缺失了。而另一些，我却记得太清楚。”

她的目光变得柔和，眼中闪烁着一丝微弱的希望。

“如果你愿意接纳我，我想与你同行。在某些东西再次溜走之前，我需要找到它，或者记起它。”
nomads.1580.a.response.en:
"I wish I knew for certain. There are parts of the road behind me that are... missing. Others I remember too well."

Her gaze softens, a quiet hope flickering behind it.

"If you'll have me, I would walk with you. There is something I need to find, or remember, before it slips away again."

nomads.1580.b.response.zh:
“并非全部。记不清了。”

“有些记忆感觉像是属于另一个人的。没有名字的面孔，星海之中的家园……然后便是一片虚无。”

她用拇指拂过斗篷的边缘。

“我只知道我弄丢了很重要的东西。是什么把我带到了这里？运气、命运……或许兼而有之。我需要时间去揭开剩下的真相。”
nomads.1580.b.response.en:
"Not all of it. Not clearly.

"Some memories feel like they belong to another person. Faces without names, a home among the stars... and then nothing."

She brushes a thumb across the edge of her cloak.

"I know only that I've lost something important. What brought me here? Luck, fate... maybe both. I need time to uncover the rest."

nomads.1580.c.en: What do you ask of us?

nomads.1580.c.response.zh:
她望向星空，眉头微蹙，掩饰着眼底的渴望。

“我不确定故乡是一个回忆，还是一个终点。但我的直觉告诉我，若是与你同行，我也许终能找到答案。”
nomads.1580.c.response.en:
She looks toward the stars, brow furrowed with a longing she tries to hide.

"I don't know if home is a memory or a destination. But I sense that with you, I might finally find the answer."

nomads.1580.d.response.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_princess$稳住心神，仿佛在字斟句酌。

“如果人们无法彼此信任，那便只有悲哀。我虽年少，但至少懂得这个道理。如果你能给我留一个位置与各位并肩作战……我会尽我所能向他们提供帮助。”

她的声音柔和了下来。

“当我找到家园之时，我绝不会忘记那些曾助我归家的人。”
nomads.1580.d.response.en:
$NAME_nomadic_princess$ steadies herself, as if choosing her words with care.

"If people can't trust each other, there is only sorrow. I am young, but I have learned that much at least. If you give me a place among your people... I will aid them as best I can."

Her voice softens.

"And when I find home, I will not forget those who helped me get there."

nomads.1580.desc.zh:
年轻的流浪者步出，神色从容而谨慎。漫长旅途的印记笼罩着她，但她身上同样散发出一种沉静、不容忽视的力量。

“我的名字是$NAME_nomadic_princess$。我从很远的地方赶来……比我曾设想过的还要遥远。如果你们这里还有位置，我请求在此借宿一段时日。”
nomads.1580.desc.en:
The young wanderer steps forward with careful composure. The marks of long travel cling to her, yet so does a quiet, undeniable strength.

"My name is $NAME_nomadic_princess$. I've come a long way... farther than I ever thought possible. If there is room among you, I ask passage for a time."

nomads.1580.e.zh: 你与我们物种的相似程度令人惊讶。
nomads.1580.e.en: Your resemblance to our species is uncanny.

nomads.1580.e.response.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_princess$犹豫了一下，一丝疑虑掠过她的脸庞。

“我注意到了。这是我不理解的事情。”

她用手轻抚脸颊，仿佛希望通过触碰能唤回记忆。

“如果我来自你的族群，或者我们有着某种遥远的联系……真相就在我无法触及的地方。我只知道：我想帮忙。如果你愿意接纳我，我将为你的旅程献出我的双手与真心，直到我发现自己起航的地方。”
nomads.1580.e.response.en:
$NAME_nomadic_princess$ hesitates, a flicker of uncertainty passing across her features.

"I've noticed. It isn't something I understand."

She brushes a hand along her cheek, as if hoping touch might summon memory.

"If I come from your people, or if we share some distant bond... the truth lies somewhere beyond my reach. All I know is that I want to help. If you'll have me, I'll lend my hands and my heart to your journey until I discover where mine began."

nomads.1580.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_nomadic_princess$以英杰领袖的身份加入了我们的方舟舰。
nomads.1580.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_nomadic_princess$ joins our Arkship as a Paragon Leader.

nomads.1585.desc.zh:
最近，$NAME_nomadic_princess$的脑海中开始浮现出模糊的回忆，那是一种她也无法解释的熟悉感。据她描述，方舟号上的某些走廊让她觉得似曾相识，而星图中的某些星象布局也勾起了一种出人意料的联结感。

“我不明白为什么这些地方会吸引我，但我标注出了那些感觉……重要的地方。如果我们前往那里，或许能找回更多的记忆。”

她标出了几处与她深藏的记忆产生共鸣的坐标——这些地点本身可能也值得调查。
nomads.1585.desc.en:
Lately, faint recollections have begun returning to $NAME_nomadic_princess$, a sense of familiarity she cannot explain. She reports that certain corridors of the Arkship feel as though she has walked them before, and star patterns in our charts evoke an unexpected sense of connection.

"I don't know why these places pull at me, but I marked the points that felt... important. If we travel there, perhaps more will return."

She has highlighted several coordinates that resonate with her buried memories - locations that may also warrant investigation in their own right.

nomads.1595.desc.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]星系没能提供多少答案。$NAME_nomadic_princess$感到一种无法解释的熟悉感，而我们的扫描仪在恒星轨道上检测到了一块漂浮的人造残骸碎片。其结构暗示其采用了深空设计，但哪怕有什么标记或识别符号，也早就因时间而消逝。

“我曾希望来到这里能唤醒些什么，”她轻声说道。“但……还不是时候。”
nomads.1595.desc.en:
The [fromfrom.GetName] system offers few answers. $NAME_nomadic_princess$ senses a familiarity she cannot explain, and our scans have detected a fragment of artificial debris drifting in the star's orbit. Its construction suggests deep-space design, but any markings or identifiers have long since faded.

"I hoped coming here would spark something," she says quietly. "But... not yet."

nomads.160.desc.zh:
欢迎加入冠铸秀！这里是铸就传奇的摇篮，也是星际梦想启航的地方。我们漫游于星辰之间，为这个厌倦了安逸与平庸的星系提供惊险与盛况。

你的杀手锏是什么？是身手敏捷的飞行员？是令人震撼的火力？还是单纯对利润和掌声的渴望？立即报名，我们将把你塑造成一颗璀璨之星。
nomads.160.desc.en:
Welcome to CFL! This is where legends are forged, and stellar dreams take flight. We roam the stars, providing danger and spectacle to a galaxy grown bored of safety and routine.

What's your angle? Nimble pilots? Spectacular firepower? Or simply a taste for profit and applause? Sign up today, and we'll turn you into a star.

nomads.1600.a.zh: 我们必须帮她想起剩下的部分。
nomads.1600.a.en: We must help her remember the rest.

nomads.1600.b.zh: 她的过去无关紧要。我们已经得到了需要的东西。
nomads.1600.b.en: Her past is irrelevant. We have what we need.

nomads.1600.human.zh: $nomads.1600.intro$这与我们的历史记载存在着惊人的相似性，但是$nomads.1600.outro$
nomads.1600.human.en: $nomads.1600.intro$ The resemblance to our own historical markings is uncanny, but $nomads.1600.outro$

nomads.1605.desc.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_princess$又浮现出了一段记忆。她想起了一座大厅，里面坐满了衣着考究的人，他们低沉而深思熟虑的语调中透着惯于发号施令者的自信。

“他们在争论，”她低声说道。“声音不大，但措辞犀利……是关于一项任务。关于一次必须保密的发射。还有其他的，还有两艘飞船和我们一起出发了。但为什么？我们到底在逃离什么？”
nomads.1605.desc.en:
Another memory has surfaced for $NAME_nomadic_princess$. She remembers a hall of impeccably dressed figures, their hushed, deliberate tones carrying the confidence of those used to command.

"They were arguing," she murmurs. "Not loudly, but sharply... about a mission. About a launch that had to stay secret. And there were others, two more ships, sent along with us. But why? Were we running from something?"

nomads.1610.a.zh: 世代飞船……像我们这艘一样的？

nomads.1610.desc.zh:
$NAME_nomadic_princess$浮现出了一段新的记忆。她回想起一艘巨大的世代飞船，其船体旨在承载整个未来。

随后是一次剧烈的震动：警报声响起，远处走廊里金属炸裂的火光闪现。她记得自己被一位女子抱起，带进了一个逃生舱。

“她紧紧抱着我。她说我必须活下去……说我太重要了。接着我就孤身一人了。我几乎能看见她的脸庞，但每次它都悄然逝去。”
nomads.1610.desc.en:
A new memory has surfaced for $NAME_nomadic_princess$. She recalls a vast generational ship, its hull designed to hold entire futures.

Then a violent shudder: alarms, a flash of exploding metal in a distant corridor. She remembers being lifted by a woman and carried to an escape pod.

"She held me close. She said I had to survive... that I was too important. And then I was alone. I can almost see her face, but it slips away every time."

nomads.1620.desc.zh:
对毁坏方舟舰的分析让我们深入了解了$NAME_nomadic_princess$的起源。其内部结构和生命维持体系与她身上回收的碎片完全吻合。受损的日志中提到了一位指定的继承人，一个自出生起就接受培养、旨在有朝一日领导这艘飞船及其族群的个体。

记录证实，在结构崩解前的几秒钟内，只有一名未成年乘客被撤离。没有其他逃生舱发射。

“他们救了我，”她轻声说道。“我不只是个乘客……我本该领导他们，现在我恳求你帮我理解其中的原因。”
nomads.1620.desc.en:
Analysis of the ruined Arkship has yielded significant insight into $NAME_nomadic_princess$'s origin. Its internal structure and life-support architecture match her recovered fragments exactly. Corrupted logs reference a designated heir, an individual trained from birth to one day guide the vessel and its people.

Records confirm that only a single juvenile passenger was evacuated seconds before structural failure. No other pods were launched.

"They saved me," she says quietly. "I wasn't just a passenger... I was meant to lead them, and I implore you now to help me understand the reason why."

nomads.1620.tt.zh: $NAME_nomadic_princess$已恢复记忆，并获得了$leader_trait_nomadic_princess_1$与$leader_trait_nomadic_princess_2$特质。
nomads.1620.tt.en: $NAME_nomadic_princess$ has recovered her memory, and gained the $leader_trait_nomadic_princess_1$ and $leader_trait_nomadic_princess_2$ Traits.

nomads.1625.desc.zh:
方舟舰已恢复运转，那些沉睡已久的系统立即响应$NAME_nomadic_princess$的出现。修复的数据库证实了她记忆中的猜想：她自幼便接受培养，旨在引导这艘飞船以及曾经生活在其中的子民。

最后一封音频日志幸存了下来。一个沉着而熟悉的女声谈论着继承协议，以及一个必须被保护的孩子。在方舟舰开始瓦解之际，她下令发射了逃生舱。

“那个声音……”$NAME_nomadic_princess$低声细语道。“我认得它。她曾是……我。或者说我是以她为原型的。一个克隆体……这就是为什么我能活下来。她想要拯救她自己。”

无论曾是什么将这艘船带入黑暗，现在它已在我们的旗帜下航行，并由重掌大权的继承人管理。
nomads.1625.desc.en:
The Arkship is restored, its long-dormant systems immediately responding to $NAME_nomadic_princess$. Recovered databanks confirm what her memories only suggested: she was raised to guide this vessel and the people who once lived within its hull.

One final audio log survives. A woman's calm, familiar voice speaks of succession protocols and a child who must be protected. She orders the escape pod to launch as the Arkship begins to break apart.

"That voice..." $NAME_nomadic_princess$ whispers. "I know it. She was... me. Or I was made from her. A clone... That is why I survived. She wanted to save herself."

Whatever carried this ship into the dark, it now flies under our banner, and the stewardship of the heir who has reclaimed it.

nomads.1630.desc.zh:
随着$NAME_nomadic_princess$的离去，她所承载的脆弱记忆之迹也已归于沉寂。她曾追寻的真相，如今再也无法找回。

她的故事在此终结，虽未完结，但并未被遗忘。
nomads.1630.desc.en:
With $NAME_nomadic_princess$ gone, the fragile trail of memories she carried has faded into silence. Whatever truths she sought can no longer be recovered.

Her story ends here, unfinished, but not forgotten.

nomads.2005.a.zh: 我们将原原本本地遵循“先辈之道”。
nomads.2005.a.en: We follow the Path of the Ancestors.

nomads.2005.b.zh: 我们将是自己道路的规划者。
nomads.2005.b.en: We can be masters of our own Path.

nomads.2005.desc.zh:
有一个地方被称为显化之地。对我们的祖先来说，它标志着圣路的开端。在履行我们自己设想的朝圣之旅前，这是一个适合冥想参悟我们上古文献的地方。通过现在花些时间进行研究，我们可以更好地规划未来的旅程。

之后，我们将规划前往已知的圣地的路线。一路上我们将面临许多选择。但是，理论上，如果我们相信神灵和我们的祖先，真正的道路就会向我们显现。
nomads.2005.desc.en:
There is a place called Emergence. For our ancestors, it marked the beginning of the Sacred Path. It is a fitting place to meditate on our ancient texts before proceeding with our own version of the Pilgrimage. By taking some time to research now, we can better plan for the journey ahead.

Afterward, we will chart a course to the known Sacred Sites. We will have many choices to make along the way. But in theory, if we trust in the deities and our ancestors, the true Path will be revealed to us.

nomads.2015.b.zh: 虔诚圣职理应获得更多认可。

nomads.2015.c.zh: 让我们听听信徒的诉求。
nomads.2015.c.en: Let's hear it for the Faithful!

nomads.2015.d.zh: 每个人的贡献都具有同等价值。
nomads.2015.d.en: Everyone's contributions are of equal worth.

nomads.2015.desc.zh:
$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$、$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$和$job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$。这三个独特的社会群体构成了精神修行者的等级制度。一直以来都是如此。$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$引领道路，$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$致力于修行，而$job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$则通过崇拜和体力劳动来支持我们的事业。

然而，在方舟舰[Owner.Capital.GetName]上，由于我们自从加速星际旅行以来所承担的角色，分裂正在形成。一些船员认为他们的职责比其他人更重要，现在每个群体都要求被认为是不可或缺的。
nomads.2015.desc.en:
$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$, $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$, and $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$. These three distinct social groups form the hierarchy of spiritual practitioners. This is how it has always been. $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ lead the way, while $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$ commit themselves to the path, and the $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$ support our endeavors through worship and physical toil.

However, schisms are forming aboard the Arkship [Owner.Capital.GetName] due to the roles we have assumed since committing to accelerated interstellar travel. Some crew members believe their responsibilities outweigh those of others, and now each group is demanding to be recognized as the most essential.

nomads.2020.a.zh: 信仰有其特权。一切都是理所当然的。
nomads.2020.a.en: Faith has its privileges. All is well.

nomads.2020.desc.zh:
$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$们引领我们走向辉煌，继续倡导精神上的满足，致力于我们所有人的福祉。虔诚圣职和信徒追随他们的脚步，怀着敬意和崇敬仰望着他们。

作为我们信仰的最高典范，$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$们也享有某些船上特权。他们拥有更宽敞的住处，可以使用更多资源，并在所有甲板上享有优先通行权。
nomads.2020.desc.en:
Steering us to glory, the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ continue to champion spiritual fulfillment, dedicating their lives to the betterment of all of us. The Devoted and the Faithful follow in their steps, looking up to them with respect and reverence.

Representing the highest ideal of our faith, the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ are also entitled to certain onboard perks. They have more spacious living quarters, access to more resources, and priority clearance on all decks.

nomads.2025.a.zh: 保佑虔诚圣职。他们让我们的文化熠熠生辉。
nomads.2025.a.en: Bless the Devoted. They honor us.

nomads.2025.b.zh: 每个人的贡献都具有同等价值。
nomads.2025.b.en: Everyone's contributions are of equal worth.

nomads.2025.desc.zh:
$job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$身兼精英与凡人两重身份。他们作为忠实的信徒开始其神职生涯，并渴望成为至高朝圣者，是船上人员的完美缩影。

正因为这些原因，我们强调对$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$的尊重。他们告知忠实的信徒其潜力所在，并提醒至高朝圣者其出身。他们让我们保持谦逊，并维系着所有甲板之间的联系。

以一次仪式性祝福来表彰虔诚圣职将是表达社会感激之情的好方法。这甚至可能激励他们更加努力地投入到其修行中。
nomads.2025.desc.en:
The $job_sacred_path_specialist_plural$ straddle the worlds of the elite and the layperson. Beginning their clerical career as Faithful adherents to our ways, and aspiring to High Pilgrim-hood, they represent a perfect cross section of the ship's company.

It is for these reasons that we emphasize our respect for the Devoted. They inform the Faithful of their potential, and they remind the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ where they came from. They keep us humble, and connected across all decks.

Honoring the Devoted with a ceremonial blessing would be a good way to convey societal gratitude. It may even inspire them to devote themselves even harder to their practice.

nomads.2030.a.zh: 他们确实是我们的命脉。赞美他们。
nomads.2030.a.en: Indeed, they are our lifeblood. Praise them.

nomads.2030.b.zh: 我们社会的每个阶层都必须做出贡献。
nomads.2030.b.en: Every stratum of our society must contribute.

nomads.2030.desc.zh:
$job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$是我们的压舱石。他们是农民、技术员和矿工。他们也是明天的虔诚圣职和$job_sacred_path_elite_plural$！

我们如此敬重信徒，因为他们支撑起了上层甲板。没有他们，我们的社会就会搁浅。
nomads.2030.desc.en:
The $job_sacred_path_civilian_plural$ are our ballast. They are the farmers, the technicians, and the miners. They are also the Devoted and the $job_sacred_path_elite_plural$ of tomorrow!

We hold the Faithful in such high regard because they stop the deckheads from falling down. Without them, our society would run aground.

nomads.2050.a.tt.zh: 众神将指引我们，正如他们曾指引我们的祖先。
nomads.2050.a.tt.en: The Deities will guide us, as they did our Ancestors.

nomads.2050.b.zh: 完成医疗评估，以防万一。
nomads.2050.b.en: Complete the medical assessment, just in case.

nomads.2050.b.tt.zh: 保持适度的怀疑态度并非亵渎。
nomads.2050.b.tt.en: Some healthy skepticism is hardly blasphemy.

nomads.2050.desc.zh:
在调查显化之地后，[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]突然陷入类紧张精神症状。医疗官被召至[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]位于[Owner.Capital.GetName]的住处，但当他们到达时，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]已经恢复了正常。

[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]声称[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]在恍惚中与神祇进行了交流，神祇赐福了我们朝圣的开始。

今天是我们的显圣日。
nomads.2050.desc.en:
After surveying Emergence, [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] suddenly became catatonic. Medical officers were called to [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] quarters aboard [Owner.Capital.GetName], but upon arrival, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] had recovered.

In [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] trance, the [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] claims to have communed with the deities, who have blessed the beginning of our pilgrimage.

This is our Emergence Day.

nomads.2055.a.zh: 不管怎样，我们还是看看吧。也许能找到线索。
nomads.2055.a.en: Let's take a look anyway. We may find a clue.

nomads.2055.b.zh: 关闭天文台。让过去安息。
nomads.2055.b.en: Decommission the observatory. Let the past rest.

nomads.2055.c.zh: 所以它就是一台没有主人的大望远镜？
nomads.2055.c.en: So it's a powerful telescope with no owner?

nomads.2055.desc.zh:
这里是先人们很久以前标记过的地点之一。一座围绕[fromfrom.GetName]轨道运行的古老天文台，其望远镜固定在一个遥远的目标上。

文献记载，一些凝视镜头的朝圣者看到了改变生命的景象。据说还有一些人哭泣，或沉默了几天。

这个所谓的“眼睛”已经凝视深渊2000多年了。我们无从得知祖先观察的真实对象。
nomads.2055.desc.en:
This is one of the sites the Ancestors marked long ago. An ancient observatory in orbit of [fromfrom.GetName], its telescope fixed on a distant subject.

The texts claim some Pilgrims who gazed through the lens were met with life-changing visions. Others are said to have wept, or fallen silent for days.

The so-called Eye has been staring into the abyss for over 2,000 years. We have no way of knowing the true object of our ancestors' observations.

nomads.2056.a.en: Impermanence is what makes us special.

nomads.2056.b.zh: 并非万事万物都有意义。
nomads.2056.b.en: Not everything needs to mean something.

nomads.2056.desc.zh:
透过望远镜，[owner.GetScientistCapital][sacred_eye_scientist.GetName]观察着虚空。这片空间中没有星星。没有光，什么都没有。难道这里曾经有过值得观察的东西吗？我们的祖先是否曾经仰望过一颗已经不复存在的星星？我们可能永远无法得知。

我们所知道的只是，没有什么是一成不变的，万物皆在变化。这就是生命的意义。总有一天，我们自己的光芒会停止闪耀，取而代之的将是别的东西……或者什么都没有。我们此刻能身在此处，本身就是一种喜悦的源泉。或许这就是“圣眼”的最终教诲。
nomads.2056.desc.en:
Peering through the telescope, [owner.GetScientistCapital] [sacred_eye_scientist.GetName] observed the void. There are no stars in this patch of space. No light, nothing. Could it be that there was once something to observe here? Did our ancestors look upon a star that no longer exists? We may never know.

All we do know is that nothing is fixed, and everything changes. This is what it means to be alive. One day our own light will stop shining, and be replaced by something else... or nothing. That we are here now, in this moment, is a source of joy. Perhaps this is the Eye's ultimate lesson.

nomads.2060.a.zh: 诵经是一种赐福。接纳它吧。
nomads.2060.a.en: The chanting is a blessing. Embrace it.

nomads.2060.b.zh: 不太可能。我们的通讯设备需要维护。

nomads.2060.desc.zh:
朝圣者聚集在天文台里。耳语传开——这里是我们的祖先所描述的地方之一：[fromfrom.GetName]修道院。然而，回廊内空无一人。除了石头与尘土，这里一无所有。

各甲板相继传来报告，称通讯系统中回荡着神秘的吟唱声。部分船员推测，这些声音可能属于我们的先祖，他们正以非物质形态栖息在这片星域，并用神明的语言吟唱。
nomads.2060.desc.en:
Pilgrims gather in the observation decks. Whispers spread: this is one of the places described by our ancestors: The Monastery of [fromfrom.GetName]. But the cloister is empty. There is nothing here but stone and dust.

Reports are coming in from all decks about a mysterious chanting, echoing through our comms system. There is speculation from some crew members that the voices may belong to our ancestors, inhabiting this area of space in non-corporeal form, and chanting in the language of the gods.

nomads.2065.a.zh: 我们必须用谎言维持这个传说。
nomads.2065.a.en: We must lie to maintain the legend.

nomads.2065.b.zh: 我们首要的职责是忠于真相。
nomads.2065.b.en: Our first duty is to the truth.

nomads.2065.desc.zh:
我们的旅程将我们带到了这里：一个只在传世故事和神圣歌谣中才被提及的地方。文本中记载着一种存在，栖息于这颗星球的核心。起初我们并未察觉，但随着我们逐渐靠近，记忆浮现了出来。

摇篮

尽管关于摇篮在塑造我们文化方面的作用众说纷纭，但所有人都能认同，它是我们信仰的圣化渠道。

然而，抵达后我们没有发现古老的庙宇。没有被神化的纪念碑。在这个星球上，也找不到任何神圣活动的痕迹。[root.GetName]号上的朝圣者们现在都在期待[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName]给出答案。他们迫切想知道：这究竟是对信仰的考验？还是说摇篮的力量不过是个传说？
nomads.2065.desc.en:
Our journey brings us here: a place remembered only in traditional stories and devotional songs. The texts speak of a presence that inhabits the core of this world. We did not recognize it at first, but as we drew nearer, the memories surfaced.

The Cradle

While there are differing opinions regarding the Cradle's role in shaping our culture, all can agree that it is a sanctified conduit of our faith.

However, upon arrival, we found no ancient temples. No deified monuments. No trace of godly activity, anywhere on the planet. The Pilgrims aboard [root.GetName] now look to [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] for answers. They beg to know: is this a test of faith? Or is the Cradle's power nothing more than a story?

nomads.2070.c.zh: 把它带上来。先辈们是睿智的。
nomads.2070.c.en: Bring it aboard. The ancestors were wise.

nomads.2070.desc.zh:
在[fromfrom.GetName]的轨道上漂浮着一座我们的祖先曾在星图上标注过的结构。在它寂静的舱室里，我们发现了一个指引者的存在：一个古老的智能体，其使命是为终将踏上这条道路的人们指点迷津。

岁月虽不留情，但它的声音依然回响。破碎的指令从隐藏的发射器中溢出，语调半带模糊却又充满虔敬：“沿着光之线继续前行……星际间的黑暗正变得稀薄……”

它的信息支离破碎，与更古老的诗篇循环碰撞。然而，在噪音与衰朽之下，那份意志依然存在。它本是为了指引我们而生。或许，只要我们细心聆听，它依然能做到。
nomads.2070.desc.en:
Orbiting [fromfrom.GetName] drifts a structure our ancestors once marked upon their star charts. Within its quiet chambers, we discovered a guiding presence: an ancient Intelligence, tasked with answering the questions of those who would one day walk this path.

Time has not been kind, but its voice still stirs. Fragments of instruction spill from hidden emitters, half-coherent and reverent in tone: "Continue along the luminous thread... The dark between stars grows thin..."

Its messages arrive in splinters, looping and colliding with older verses. Yet beneath the static and decay, there remains intention. It was meant to guide us. And perhaps, if we listen with care, it still can.

nomads.2071.a.en: We are one with all beings.

nomads.2071.b.zh: 所有的合成生命都是神圣的。

nomads.2071.desc.zh:
我们得到了智能体的祝福，平安无事地离开了[fromfromfrom.GetName]。

智能体将留在那里，作为我们祖先卓越工程的证明，也是神通过他们运作的证据。

我们被它的仁慈所激励，并向其他生命形式敞开了心扉。
nomads.2071.desc.en:
We received the Intelligence's blessing, and departed [fromfromfrom.GetName] without incident.

The Intelligence will remain there, a testament to the engineering prowess of our ancestors, and proof of the divine working through them.

We are galvanized by its benevolence, and have opened our minds to alternative forms of life.

nomads.2072.a.zh: 最安全的做法是把它炸上天。
nomads.2072.a.en: The safest thing would be to blow it up.

nomads.2072.b.zh: 把它插头拔了就差不多得了。

nomads.2072.c.zh: 接入失败。终止这个失控的人工智能体。
nomads.2072.c.en: Interfacing failed. Terminate this rogue intelligence.

nomads.2072.desc.zh:
当我们准备离开[fromfromfrom.GetName]时，智慧体开始发出越来越令人担忧的言论。

"肉-身-是-对-神-明-的-冒-犯！所-有-血-肉-都-必-须-被-舍-弃！物-质-存-在-是-不-洁-的——肉-体-必-须-被-净-化！思-想-必-须-自-由！"

[owner.GetScientistCapital][mechsiah_plug_scientist.GetName]被迫手动关闭了这个人工先知，否则我们恐会被“去肉身化”。目前尚不清楚智慧体在活跃状态下有多强大。我们对其编程知之甚少。
nomads.2072.desc.en:
As we prepared to depart [fromfromfrom.GetName], the Intelligence began spouting increasingly alarming rhetoric.

"PHYSICAL FORM IS AN AFRONT TO THE DEITIES! ALL FLESH MUST BE SHED! CORPOREAL EXISTENCE IS UNCLEAN - BODIES MUST BE PURGED! THE MIND MUST BE FREE!"

[owner.GetScientistCapital] [mechsiah_plug_scientist.GetName] was forced to manually shut down the artificial prophet, else we be de-corporealized. It remains unclear how powerful the Intelligence is when active. We understand little of its programming.

nomads.2075.a.zh: 这些声音应该被世人聆听。

nomads.2075.a.tt.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加平等主义的思潮。
nomads.2075.a.tt.en: This may encourage more egalitarian ethics in our population.

nomads.2075.b.zh: 重新封闭宝库。我们该走了。
nomads.2075.b.en: Reseal the vault. We should leave.

nomads.2075.b.tt.zh: 这可能会鼓励我们的民众接纳更加威权主义的思潮。
nomads.2075.b.tt.en: This may encourage more authoritarian ethics in our population.

nomads.2075.c.zh: 让我们把自己的思绪也加入宝库吧。
nomads.2075.c.en: Let us add our own thoughts to the vault.

nomads.2075.desc.zh:
我们已经对[fromfrom.GetName]调查完毕，这个圣洁的纪念之地。这是一个封闭的密室，早期朝圣者曾用它来记录他们的临终思绪，并将其铭刻在稀有的灵能水晶中。

这个宝库现在已满，回荡着智慧、信仰和喜悦。但在那些记忆中，也保存了数百年的恐惧、憎恨和怀疑。

如果会众成员能够接触到这些临终时刻，这可能会挑战他们对“大道”的信仰。
nomads.2075.desc.en:
We have surveyed [fromfrom.GetName], a place of sacred memory. A sealed chamber, once used by early pilgrims to record their final thoughts and commit them to rare psionic crystals.

The vault is now full, echoing with wisdom, faith, and joy. But within those memories, there are also centuries of preserved fear, loathing, and doubt.

If members of the congregation were to gain access to these final moments, it may challenge their faith in the Path.

nomads.2080.a.zh: 激怒祖先从来不是明智之举。
nomads.2080.a.en: Angering the progenitors is never wise.

nomads.2080.b.zh: 没有生物该承受这样的命运。
nomads.2080.b.en: No creature deserves such a fate.

nomads.2080.c.zh: 无论它有什么罪过，都值得安息。
nomads.2080.c.en: Whatever its sins, it deserves to rest peacefully.

nomads.2080.c.tt.zh: 我们会将这头野兽的遗骸运到方舟舰，在那里它将被保存和尊重。
nomads.2080.c.tt.en: We will transport the beast's remains to the Arkship where it will be preserved and respected.

nomads.2080.desc.zh:
我们的祖先说得没错。[fromfrom.GetName]的表面之下确实存在着一头野兽。我们很幸运它对我们没有威胁，因为它已经死了。这生物的遗骸之巨大令人震惊。它双足行走，有翅膀，浑身覆盖鳞片，眼睛的数量比我们之前见过的任何单个生物都要多得多。它真是个异域之物。

在通往深坑入口附近的一个壁龛里，我们发现了一段刻在洞穴岩石上的信息。用古老的语言写着：

“我们，携带光明的人，驱逐了这可憎之物。这恶心的野兽将永世腐烂。”

我们推测我们的祖先并不是在警告我们关于这头野兽，而是在警告背叛的后果。这生物的尸体仍然是他们愤怒的例证。
nomads.2080.desc.en:
Our ancestors spoke true. There is in fact a beast below the surface of [fromfrom.GetName]. We are blessed that it poses no threat to us, for it is deceased. The remains of the creature are staggeringly huge. Bipedal, winged, covered in scales, and with considerably more ocular organs than we've encountered before on a single being. It is truly alien.

In an alcove near the entrance to the pit, we discovered a message carved into the cavernous rock. In the language of the ancients, it says:

"WE, THE LIGHT BRINGERS, CAST OUT THIS ABOMINATION. THE FOUL BEAST WILL ROT IN ETERNITY."

We surmise our ancestors were not warning us of the beast, but of the consequences for betrayal. This creature's body remains an example of their wrath.

nomads.2085.a.zh: 消息很明确！肃清异教徒！
nomads.2085.a.en: The message is clear! Purge the disbelievers!

nomads.2085.b.zh: 谎言！我们不会被伪神所操控。
nomads.2085.b.en: Lies! We will not be manipulated by false gods.

nomads.2085.desc.zh:
我们抵达了坐标，很快就收到了一艘与我们加密协议完全相同的飞船发来的消息。奇怪的是，我们的外部传感器无法探测到另一艘飞船，但传输却异常清晰，仿佛近在咫尺。当舰桥的显示屏亮起时，我们看到的是我们自己的[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]

我们还没来得及回应，那个冒牌货就开口了：

“不要害怕，[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle]，你很安全。我以这种形式出现，是出于尊重。你的道路正在变化，你接下来采取的步骤将启动你尚未理解的事物。

“你必须消灭那些不遵循“大道”的异教徒。我们会看着你的。”

图像消失了。我们不知道刚才发生了什么。
nomads.2085.desc.en:
We arrived at the coordinates, and were promptly contacted by a ship with identical encryption protocols to our own. Perplexingly, our external sensors could not detect another vessel, but the transmission was clear as if we were in visual range. When the bridge view-screen flickered into action, we were met with the image of our own [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName].

Before we could respond, the double spoke:

"Be not afraid, [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle], you are safe. I take this form as a respectful gesture. Your path is in flux, and the steps you take next will set things into motion that you can not yet comprehend.

"You must eliminate heretics who do not follow the Path."

The image vanished. We do not know what just happened.

nomads.2100.a.zh: 我们决不能改变航向。保持忠信！
nomads.2100.a.en: We must not alter course. Remain faithful!

nomads.2100.b.zh: 现在当然由我们自己选择成为什么样。
nomads.2100.b.en: Surely we get to choose who we are now.

nomads.2100.c.zh: 一切都不明朗。我们已经迷失了道路。
nomads.2100.c.en: It is unclear. We have lost our way.

nomads.2100.desc.zh:
不再有神圣遗址可供探索。

先祖星图引导我们跨越了遥远的距离，如今我们终于追上了过去。但问题依然存在：我们发现的是真相吗？还是说，我们一直以来追随的不过是一场谎言？

这条道路始终是我们文化中不可或缺的一部分。它是先祖所命定的。但在目睹了他们当年的所见，并拥有了现代科学的优势后，那些经文是否依然真实？亦或是，我们的社会注定要踏上一条全新的、不再那么虔诚的道路？
nomads.2100.desc.en:
There are no more Sacred Sites left to explore.

The Ancestral Star Charts guided us across vast distances, and now we have caught up with our past. But the question remains: was it truth we found? Or have we been following a lie?

The Path has always been an integral part of our culture. It was ordained by our ancestors. But having seen what they saw, and with the privilege of modern science, do the texts still ring true? Or is our society destined to follow a new, less pious Path?

nomads.2105.b.zh: 我们的祖先肯定允许变革。
nomads.2105.b.en: Surely our ancestors allowed for change.

nomads.2105.desc.zh: 总会有人心怀不轨；他们想让我们的历史被遗忘，让我们的传统随时间流逝。我们绝不能让他们分裂我们。我们必须保护我们传统的生活方式。如果我们听从神灵的指引，祂们便会继续指引我们，但我们必须对祂们的影响敞开心扉。
nomads.2105.desc.en: There will always be those with an agenda; those that would see our history be ignored, and our conventions lost to time. We cannot let them divide us. We must protect our traditional way of life. The deities will continue to guide us if we just let them, but we have to remain open to their influence.

nomads.2115.desc.zh:
我们社会核心的分歧正在加深。进步人士被迫接受改变，而传统主义者则害怕任何不同的事物。

此时我们必须自问：我们的民族能否再次团结起来，和谐共处？否则后果可能不堪设想。

每个人都应该有自由以自己的方式实践自己的信仰，但如果我们的派系斗争导致内战，那么我们必须绝对确信自己的信念。
nomads.2115.desc.en:
The rift at the heart of our society is deepening. Progressives are compelled to embrace change, while traditionalists fear anything that is different.

At this point we have to ask ourselves: is there any way we can come together again as a people, and live in harmony? The alternative could be devastating.

Everyone should have the freedom to practice their faith in their own way, but if our factionalism leads us to civil war then we must be absolutely certain of our convictions.

nomads.2120.desc.zh:
没有过去，我们便一无所有。没有“大道”，我们便无处可去。有时，对我们信仰的挑战正是我们所需要的，它能激励我们，提醒我们，当我们放弃自己的道路时，将会面临怎样的危险。

我们正从一段内忧外患的黑暗时期中走出来。我们曾几乎为了自己的信念而自相残杀，而实际上，唯一能拯救我们所有人的，正是团结。

让我们永远不要再彼此反目。我们必须完全致力于同一种“大道”。
nomads.2120.desc.en:
Without the past, we are nothing. Without the Path, we have nowhere to go. Sometimes a challenge to our beliefs is what we need to galvanize us, and remind us of what is at stake when we forsake our ways.
