We are emerging from a dark period of inner turmoil. We were almost willing to tear ourselves apart for our convictions, when in reality the only thing that can save us all is unity.

Let us never turn against one another again. We must be committed fully to the same Path.

nomads.2125.a.zh: 这条“大道”使我们感到清晰。

nomads.2125.b.zh: 唯一的真理就是战争之路……
nomads.2125.b.en: The only true Path is a war path...

nomads.2125.desc.zh:
过去拖累我们、阻碍我们进化。从历史中吸取教训是一回事，但停滞不前，永远无法超越历史，则是愚蠢的。

我们不必浪费自我发现的潜力。既然我们已经摆脱了昨日的枷锁，我们就可以以奔放的热情向前迈进。

我们不再受制于技术落后的祖先。众神留下的神秘碎片也不再能决定我们的道路。我们选择自己的“大道”，没有任何事物能阻挡我们。
nomads.2125.desc.en:
The past pulls us back, keeping us from evolving. Learning from history is one thing, but remaining there, never moving beyond it, is foolish.

We need not waste our potential for self-discovery. Now that we have shrugged off the chains of yesterday, we can move forward with unbridled passion.

No longer will we be governed by our technologically inferior ancestors. No longer will the Path be dictated by the cryptic crumbs laid by the deities. We choose our own Path, and nothing can stand in our way.

nomads.2130.desc.zh:
我们带着信念和希望追随此“大道”，并已得道。

现在，我们明白重新圣化所有已知圣地，并扩展此道以造福无数物种和文明，是我们的神圣职责。

我们的仁慈将传播到星辰之间，与所有愿意的灵魂相连。
nomads.2130.desc.en:
We have followed the Path, in faith and hope, and we have attained enlightenment.

Now, we see it is our holy duty to re-sanctify all known sacred sites, and expand the path so that it may bless countless species and civilizations.

Our benevolence will spread across the stars and connect with all willing souls.

nomads.2135.a.en: The Path was within us all along.

nomads.2135.desc.zh:
这从来都不关乎“道路”本身。最重要的是我们共同度过的旅程。我们的族人遵循这一传统已有数百年之久，然而在任何历史文献中，我们都从未发现过这条道路真正的“目的”。它或许早已淹没在时间的长河里。

我们会铭记先辈流传下来的故事，以及他们曾进行的朝圣之旅，但我们不再需要追随他们的脚步。比起他们，我们对生命、银河系以及自身都有了更深刻的认知。他们所坚持的真理已不再适用于我们。我们将开辟属于自己的道路。
nomads.2135.desc.en:
It was never about the Path itself. What's most important is the journey we make together. Our people have followed this tradition for centuries, and yet we have never found, in any of our historical documents, the true 'purpose' of the Path. It may be lost to time.

We will remember the surviving stories of our ancestors, and the Pilgrimage they made, but we no longer need to follow their lead. We know more about life, the galaxy, and ourselves than they did. The truths they held are no longer relevant to us. We will chart our own path.

nomads.2140.desc.zh:
现在一切都清晰了。我们祖先的神圣遗址是病态甜美的希望和信仰灯塔。那些先我们而来的人毫无羞耻之心，也不在乎别人是否知道。

我们的声誉已被轻视和玷污。我们有能力圣化新的地点，以传达我们更新后的精神使命。

神灵是复杂且被误解的。通过这条“大道”，祂们教导我们冲突是我们社会的自然特征。我们克服的挑战使我们变得更强大。现在我们将向整个星系展示我们的力量！
nomads.2140.desc.en:
Everything is clearer now. The Sacred Sites of our ancestors are sickly sweet beacons of hope and faith. Those who came before us had no shame, and they didn't care who knew it.

Our reputation has been trivialized and tarnished. We have it in our power to sanctify new sites that will communicate our updated spiritual mission.

The deities are complex and misunderstood. Through the Path, they have taught us that conflict is a natural feature of our society. The challenges we overcome make us stronger. Now we will demonstrate our strength across the galaxy!

nomads.255.a.zh: 算上我们！我们必将胜利。
nomads.255.a.en: Sign us up! We will be victorious.

nomads.255.c.tooltip.zh: 联系$NAME_Champions_Forge_Enclave$可以再次启用比武会邀请。
nomads.255.c.tooltip.en: Tournament invitations can be enabled again by contacting the $NAME_Champions_Forge_Enclave$.

nomads.255.desc.zh:
欢迎收看“冠军之铸”现场秀！这里是全星系最顶尖的视觉与毁灭盛宴。

位于[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]星系的下一届冠铸秀现已开放报名。一场壮丽的大乱斗正等待着大家。

准入要求：一支规模最多[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模的舰队。

胜者将赢得奖励、名望以及至高无上的冠铸秀的大奖杯。

想要锻造属于你的传奇？那就报名参赛。

想要安宁与清静？没门！
nomads.255.desc.en:
This is Champion's Forge Live! The galaxy's premier source of spectacle and destruction.

Registration is now open for the next CFL Tournament in the [champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] System. A glorious free-for-all awaits.

Entry requirement: a fleet of at most [champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size.

Victors take the rewards, the prestige, and the grand CFL trophy.

You want to forge a legend? Sign up.

You want peace and quiet? Too bad!

nomads.255.desc.relic.zh:
$nomads.255.desc$

此外，我们还打算要回奖杯。
nomads.255.desc.relic.en:
$nomads.255.desc$

Also, we are going to need that trophy back.

nomads.270.desc.zh:
“星系各地的岩石生物、有机生命和战争机器们——欢迎回到‘冠军之铸’锦标赛的直播现场！

[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]星系的闲杂人等已经清理完毕，赌池也正炙手可热，我有一种预感，我们即将亲眼见证一些造价极其高昂的硬件烧毁报废。

各位屏幕前的观众请记住：这可不是什么例行巡逻或边界摩擦。这里是铸炉！没人能带着完整的尊严撤离。

参赛者们……创造！传奇！吧！”
nomads.270.desc.en:
"LITHOIDS, ORGANICS, AND WAR MACHINES ACROSS THE GALAXY - WELCOME BACK TO CHAMPION'S FORGE LIVE!

The [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system has been cleared, the betting pools are on fire, and I've got a feeling we're about to witness some incredibly expensive hardware go critical.

Remember, everyone at home: this isn't just some patrol or border skirmish. This is the Forge! Nobody retreats with their pride intact.

Contestants... MAKE! IT! LEGENDARY!"

nomads.285.a.zh: 我们的舰队飞行得很好！

nomads.285.desc.zh:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

第三名并不可耻，这恰恰证明了我们有资格站在转播镜头前。即便身处领奖台的最底层，我们依然可以俯视那些被我们击溃的舰队。
nomads.285.desc.en:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

Third place is no shame, only proof we belonged on the broadcast. Even at the lowest step of the podium, we can look down on the fleets we broke.

nomads.290.a.zh: 要是我们当时再把舰队升级一下就好了……
nomads.290.a.en: If only we had upgraded the fleet a little more...

nomads.290.desc.zh:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

第二名索然无味！我们伸出[Species.GetHandName]想要夺取奖杯，却眼睁睁看着它被别人抢走。好吧，让他们庆祝去吧。我们会记住这一切。当锻炉再次召唤时，我们绝不会再输。
nomads.290.desc.en:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

Second place tastes like ash! We stretched out our [Species.GetHandName] to grab the trophy only to see it snatched by another. Well, let them celebrate. We will remember. And when the Forge calls again, we won't lose.

nomads.295.desc.zh:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

第一名！在全星系的崇拜目光中，我们从冠铸秀组委会手中夺走了奖杯并将其高高举起。这次胜利的余响将远传至赛场之外。

现在，整个星系都将对我们的舰队心生畏惧。
nomads.295.desc.en:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

First place! Bathed in the galaxy's adoration, we tore the trophy from the CFL crew and raised it high. This victory will echo far beyond the arena.

Now the galaxy knows to fear our fleets.

nomads.3036.a.zh: 让我们平安地将他们送达目的地。
nomads.3036.a.en: Let us bring them safely to their destination.

nomads.3036.desc.zh: $nomads.3036.intro$我们规划了一系列活动，包括方舟舰参观和关于我们生活方式的宣讲，以便让他们在前往[dropoff_planet.GetName]的旅途中过得愉快。
nomads.3036.desc.en: $nomads.3036.intro$ We have planned a schedule of activities including arkship tours and presentations on our lifestyle to keep them entertained during the journey to [dropoff_planet.GetName].

nomads.3036.desc.nocomm.zh: $nomads.3036.intro$他们为我们提供了有关[dropoff_planet.owner.GetName]的外交情报，我们利用这些情报建立了正式联系。
nomads.3036.desc.nocomm.en: $nomads.3036.intro$ They brought us diplomatic intelligence regarding the [dropoff_planet.owner.GetName] that we used to establish formal communications.

nomads.3045.desc.zh: 来自[diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName]的代表团已经抵达目的地。他们的外交访问现在可以正式开始了，我们祝愿他们的和平事业取得成功。
nomads.3045.desc.en: The delegates from the [diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName] have arrived at their destination. Their diplomatic visit can now officially begin, and we wish them success in their peaceful endeavors.

nomads.305.a.zh: 谁会在乎这种无意义的比赛？
nomads.305.a.en: Who even cares about a pointless contest?

nomads.305.desc.zh:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

我们没有获得名次。奖杯上不会刻下我们的名字，观众们也将转向更耀眼的明星。我们必须回去。
nomads.305.desc.en:
$nomads.285.desc.intro$

We did not place. The trophy will not carry our name, and the crowd will move on to brighter stars. We have to return.

nomads.3050.a.zh: 我们会把他们送到别的地方。
nomads.3050.a.en: We'll drop them off somewhere else.

nomads.3050.desc.zh:
为了解决[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的麻烦，一批我们同意负责转移的罪犯搭着运输船已经登上方舟。我们正尽最大努力安全地安置他们，但如此庞大数量的囚犯迟早会惹出麻烦。

我们的合同为我们提供了处理他们的多种选择，但我们不能把他们再次丢在属于[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的星球上。同时，其他帝国很可能也不会喜欢他们的某个殖民地突然涌入大量罪犯。当然，如果我们做得足够隐秘，他们可能永远都不会发现我们到底做了什么。
nomads.3050.desc.en:
Transport ships carrying the criminals that we have accepted to transfer on behalf of the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName] have boarded the arkship. We are doing our best to safely process them, but such a vast amount of prisoners is bound to create trouble at one point or another.

Our Contract gives us options on how to handle them, but we are not supposed to drop them off again on a world belonging to the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName]. At the same time, it is likely that other empires will not appreciate a sudden influx of criminals in one of their colonies. Of course, if we are discreet enough, they might never realize what we've been up to.

nomads.3052.desc.zh: 作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。
nomads.3052.desc.en: The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

nomads.3053.desc.zh: 我们参与运输罪犯人口的消息尚未传开。看来我们还没有被发现。
nomads.3053.desc.en: Word of our involvement in the transport of criminal pops has yet to spread. It seems we have not been detected.

nomads.3053.desc.issuer.problem.zh: 我们试图欺骗[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]，但是失败了。虽然罪犯已成功卸载，但我们的行动已被发现，[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]已取消合约并拒绝向我们支付报酬。
nomads.3053.desc.issuer.problem.en: Our attempt at double crossing the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has failed. While the criminals have been successfully disembarked, we have been detected and the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has cancelled the contract and refuse to pay us.

nomads.3053.desc.problem.zh: 虽然我们的行动已被发现，但[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]依然很高兴我们帮他们处理掉了罪犯，并同意向我们全额支付报酬。
nomads.3053.desc.problem.en: While we have been detected, the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] is still pleased that we rid them of their criminals, and have agreed to pay us in full.

nomads.306.desc.zh:
[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系内的比赛局势胶着、难解难分。舰队濒临崩溃彼此追逐环绕，无人能打出决定性一击。

但没有胜利的结局，没有人举起奖杯，也没有人登上领奖台。冠军之铸团队终于承认：无法确定胜者。参赛队伍被遣散回家，转播悄然切回重播。
nomads.306.desc.en:
The match in the [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system dragged on without resolution. Battered fleets circled one another, none able to land the deciding blow.

But there is no triumphant finish, no trophy raised, no podium. The CFL crew finally call it: no winner could be determined. The contestant fleets are released and sent home, the broadcast quietly cut to a rerun.

nomads.3060.a.tt.zh: 可以在情报日志追踪目标恒星系。
nomads.3060.a.tt.en: The target system can be tracked in the Situation Log.

nomads.3060.desc.zh:
一个旅行团在[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系登上了方舟舰，一边叽叽喳喳地聊着对旅途的期待一边踏入熙熙攘攘的舰船内舱。

我们订制了一条景色优美的路线，途经若干个值得一去的恒星系供他们游览。现在我们只需要交付好许诺给他们的美景就行了。
nomads.3060.desc.en:
A group of tourists has boarded the Arkship in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, chattering with anticipation as they take in the bustling interior of the vessel.

We have charted a scenic route through several remarkable systems for their enjoyment. Now we need only deliver the spectacle they were promised.

nomads.3065.desc.zh: 游客欣赏着[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的美景，惊叹于身边的种种奇景。当踏上归途时，他们将再也不同往日了，因为对宇宙之广阔的一手认知将会重塑他们。
nomads.3065.desc.en: The tourists enjoyed the sights in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, marveling at the wonders around them. They will return home changed, carrying with them first-hand knowledge of the vastness of the universe.

nomads.3075.desc.zh:
我们遇到的[From.GetName]是一个游牧文明。他们似乎愿意承担我们发布的合约工作，以换取微薄的费用。

这可能为我们之间的协作提供有趣的契机，我们可以利用他们在轨道开发和探索方面的专业知识来为我们谋利。
nomads.3075.desc.en:
The [From.GetName] we met are a Nomadic civilization. They appear to be willing to pick up Contract work on our behalf in exchange for a modest fee.

This could present interesting opportunities for collaboration between us, and we could leverage their expertise in orbital exploitation and exploration to our benefit.

nomads.3075.tt.zh: 在查看星系图时，右键点击恒星系即可发布合约。
nomads.3075.tt.en: Right-click on a System while viewing the Galaxy Map to Issue Contracts.

nomads.405.desc.zh:
随着冠铸秀方舟舰的引爆，广播信号切断为黑屏。我们搜查了[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]星系中的残骸，并打捞了他们那满溢的储物仓。

他们最后的“奇观”相当有利可图……对我们而言。
nomads.405.desc.en:
The broadcast cuts to black as the CFL Arkship detonates. We comb the wreckage in the [champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName] system and haul in the contents of their overflowing storage bays.

Their final "spectacle" was quite profitable... for us.

nomads.405.desc.relic.zh:
$nomads.405.desc$

我们的名字将永远作为最后一批刻在奖杯上的人……随着冠铸秀那帮蠢货的消失，再也不会有下一位冠军来挑战我们的地位了。
nomads.405.desc.relic.en:
$nomads.405.desc$

Our names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with those fools at the CFL gone, there will be no next champion to challenge our claim.

nomads.410.a.zh: 星系总会找到新的乐子。向来如此。
nomads.410.a.en: The galaxy will find new entertainment. It always does.

nomads.410.desc.zh:
在短短几秒钟内，星系目睹了冠铸秀的最后一场演出。

画面剧烈晃动，伴随着解说员的尖叫，随后一堵火墙吞噬了方舟舰。

接着：画面切断。

冠军之铸现场秀！位于[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]星系的太空城邦被[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]摧毁。
nomads.410.desc.en:
For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.

A shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.

Then: cut to black.

The Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by [champions_forge_destroyer.GetName] in the [champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName] system.

nomads.410.desc.relic.zh:
$nomads.410.desc$

我们的名字将永远是刻在奖杯上的最后一批……随着冠铸秀的消亡，再也不会有新的冠军来挑战我们的地位了。
nomads.410.desc.relic.en:
$nomads.410.desc$

Our names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with the CFL gone, there will be no new champion to challenge our claim.

nomads.4110.desc.zh:
一个游牧帝国，[nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName]，在[nomad_harvested_system.GetName]恒星系展开了资源采收行动，正在从我们的储备中提取各类资源，使得这些资源在短期内变得无法继续开采。

面对这种无视我们主权的行为，我们绝不会坐视不理。只要我们下定决心，就能迅速集结舰队，驱逐这些游牧民，并将他们彻底封锁在我们的星域之外。
nomads.4110.desc.en:
A nomadic empire, the [nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName], has conducted harvesting operations in the [nomad_harvested_system.GetName] system and is drawing resources from our deposits, rendering them unprofitable for the near future.

This violation of our sovereignty should probably not go unanswered. Should we wish it so, we could muster our fleets to drive the Nomads off and forbid them access to our space.

nomads.4700.a.zh: 这颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]将成为我们新帝国的基石。
nomads.4700.a.en: This [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] shall be the foundation of our new empire.

nomads.4700.c.en: We shall continue to roam the stars.

nomads.4700.d.en: We shall rule the stars from this [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon].

nomads.4700.settle.tt.en: The [event_target:player_country.GetName] stops being a £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire'] and colonizes [event_target:settled_planet.GetName] as a £planet£ ['concept_settled_empire'].

nomads.4700.settle_subject.tt.en: The [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName] settles on [event_target:settled_planet.GetName] as a new ['concept_subject'] of the [event_target:player_country.GetName].

nomads.4705.desc.hive.zh: 经过多年来对[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]基础设施的筹备以及对我们自身生理机能的改造，进化出更强健的骨骼与优化的肺部，如今我们已准备好定居。这将是[event_target:player_country.GetName]生命周期中的一个全新阶段，也许定居生活会很适合我们。
nomads.4705.desc.hive.en: After years of preparing the infrastructure of the [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName] and our own biology, evolving stronger bones and optimized lungs, we are now ready to settle. This will be a new stage in the [event_target:player_country.GetName] lifecycle, perhaps settled life will suit us.

nomads.4705.desc.machine.zh: 将所有无人机和基础设施从[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]转移至一颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上，这标志着[event_target:player_country.GetName]背离了预言中的未来。现在将开发新的优先队列，以适应定居生活。
nomads.4705.desc.machine.en: The transfer of all drones and infrastructure from the [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName] to a [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] is a departure point from the predicted future of the [event_target:player_country.GetName]. New priority queues will now be developed to adapt to settled life.

nomads.4705.desc.regular.zh: 方舟舰[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]的航程就此结束。经过数年的辛勤劳作，拆除了它的基础设施并将其运下重力井后，我们终于准备好将这艘飞船废弃。我们[event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在经历一个将被后代铭记的历史时刻。现在，让我们在[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]定居吧！
nomads.4705.desc.regular.en: Thus ends the voyage of the Arkship [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]. After years of labor, disassembling its infrastructure and carrying it down the gravity well, we are finally ready to scuttle the ship. We [event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are living through a moment future generations will remember. Now, let us settle [event_target:settled_planet.GetName]!

nomads.4710.a.science.zh: 我们将乘坐一艘$science_arkship_name$进行探索。

nomads.4710.b.zh: 他们将成为我们的附属国。

nomads.4710.desc.hive.zh: 我们，[event_target:player_country.GetName]，曾目睹过无数景象，但我们的子个体却始终被束缚在已定居的星球上。如今，在星际旅行的时代，困守于单一星系已成为一种累赘。登入我们崭新的方舟舰，我们将重获自由，而[From.GetName]则会被榨干与收割。
nomads.4710.desc.hive.en: We, the [event_target:player_country.GetName], have seen many sights, yet our drones have always been bound to settled worlds. Now, in an age of interstellar travel, confinement to a single system is a liability. We will be free aboard our new Arkship, while [From.GetName] is left stripped and harvested.

nomads.4710.desc.machine.zh: 我们已经完成了一艘方舟舰。我们的无人机将不再被束缚于[From.GetPlanetMoon]。它们的程序已被调整以适应移动星际功能，同时[From.GetName]的基础设施已被剥离殆尽，所有必要的系统均已转移，以支持一个全新的、四海为家的未来。
nomads.4710.desc.machine.en: We have completed an Arkship. No longer will our drones be bound to [From.GetPlanetMoon]. Their processes have been adjusted for mobile stellar function as [From.GetName] is stripped bare of infrastructure and all necessary systems are transferred to support a new mobile future.

nomads.4710.desc.regular.zh:
自从我们的飞船首次驶出我们的星系以来，我们之中总有一些人只能通过影像记录来了解宇宙，在同一片天空下出生、生活并死去。现在，这一切都将改变。

随着我们的方舟舰建造完成，引力不再是障碍，宇宙的无数奇迹正等待着我们。[From.GetName]已经倾其所有：我们的人民将带着它的名字、它的记忆与它的未来，一同踏入虚空。
nomads.4710.desc.regular.en:
Since our ships first ventured beyond our star, there have always been those among us who knew the cosmos only through recordings, those who were born, lived, and died beneath the same sky. That changes now.

With the completion of our Arkship, gravity is no longer an obstacle, and every wonder of the cosmos awaits. [From.GetName] has given all it had to give: our people will carry its name, its memory, and its future with us into the void.

nomads.4710.embark.tt.en: The [event_target:player_country.GetName] will become Nomadic embarking on an Arkship

nomads.4715.a.zh: 这个星系浩瀚而充满奇迹。
nomads.4715.a.en: The galaxy is vast and full of wonders.

nomads.4715.b.zh: 这个星系既浩瀚无垠又杀机四伏。
nomads.4715.b.en: The galaxy is vast and full of terrors.

nomads.4715.desc.zh:
游牧生活与无尽的漫游带给我们的最大回报之一，就是发现新的天地。即使在漫长的旅途之后，依然存在着未曾见过的风景，不论是绝美的还是令人惶恐的。我们的好奇心总是渴望去发掘这些奇观。

然而，对于我们的方舟来说，每一处新景象不仅仅是供其观赏的奇特事物，更是一次学习新知、反思与成长的机会。
nomads.4715.desc.en:
One of the greatest rewards for nomadism and our ceaseless wandering is the discovery of new places. Even after a long time traveling, there remain sights unseen, beautiful or mortifying. Spectacles that our curiosity yearns to discover.

But more than peculiar things for our arkships to behold, each new vista is an opportunity to learn something new, reflect and grow.

nomads.50.comms.zh: $NEW_LINE$一个来自未经探索的恒星系的信号，已开始在我们的通信数据库中自我复制。
nomads.50.comms.en: $NEW_LINE$A signal originating from an unexplored star system has begun replicating itself across our communications databanks.

nomads.50.coolant.zh: $NEW_LINE$腐蚀性冷却液泄漏正在危及船体完整性。
nomads.50.coolant.en: $NEW_LINE$Corrosive coolant leaks are compromising hull integrity.

nomads.50.default.desc.zh: 随着在[root.capital_scope.GetName]上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
nomads.50.default.desc.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the [root.capital_scope.GetName], our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true interstellar travel. Numerous faults have been identified throughout the vessel.

nomads.50.end.desc.zh: $NEW_LINE$若要使方舟舰恢复到完全备战状态，就必须修理好这些缺陷。
nomads.50.end.desc.en: $NEW_LINE$These deficiencies must be corrected if the Arkship is to be restored to full operational readiness.

nomads.50.hangars.zh: $NEW_LINE$多个机库早已被改作仓库之用，限制了我方机组人员的作战备勤能力。
nomads.50.hangars.en: $NEW_LINE$Multiple hangar bays have long since been repurposed as storage, limiting the operational readiness of our flight crews.

nomads.50.harvest.zh: $NEW_LINE$方舟舰的开采系统尚未在实际运行条件下进行过测试。资源勘探表明，周边星系中存在具有开采价值的矿藏。
nomads.50.harvest.en: $NEW_LINE$The Arkship's extraction systems have yet to be tested under operational conditions. Resource surveys indicate viable deposits in the surrounding systems.

nomads.50.sensors.zh: $NEW_LINE$多个传感器阵列检测到持续的干涉模式。
nomads.50.sensors.en: $NEW_LINE$Persistent interference patterns have been detected across multiple sensor arrays.

nomads.50.shields.zh: $NEW_LINE$护盾诊断显示有几个发射器未对准，需要重新校准。
nomads.50.shields.en: $NEW_LINE$Shield diagnostics indicate several projectors are misaligned and require recalibration.

nomads.506.desc.zh:
自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是[capital_scope.GetName]。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。

我们要让他们失望了。
nomads.506.desc.en:
Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the [capital_scope.GetName] in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.

We will have to disappoint them.

nomads.546.desc.zh:
我们再次击败了篡位者的爪牙。他们不会停止进犯，且下一次会变得更加凶猛。但是如果我们能摧毁足够多的敌人，或许连他们也会明白，想要抹除我们并非易事。

只要[capital_scope.GetName]仍在飘扬，我们的宣称就依然有效。我们要让他们知道，有些传承绝不会消亡。
nomads.546.desc.en:
We have defeated the agents of the usurper once more. They will not stop coming, and next time they will be stronger. If we break enough of them, perhaps even they will learn that we are not so easily erased.

As long as [capital_scope.GetName] flies, so too does our claim. We will teach them that some legacies refuse to die.

nomads.555.b.2.zh: 这就是真正的虚空。在这里，没有投降。
nomads.555.b.2.en: This is the truth of the void. Out here, there is no surrender.

nomads.555.b.3.zh: 如果你们真的忠诚，就应该和我们一起离开。
nomads.555.b.3.en: If you were truly loyal you would have left with us.

nomads.555.c.1.zh: 要么拿货要么拿命，你自己选。
nomads.555.c.1.en: Your cargo or your lives. The choice is yours.

nomads.555.c.2.zh: 就把这个当作是面试吧。最后谁能活下来谁就可以加入我们。
nomads.555.c.2.en: Consider this your interview. Last one breathing gets to join up.

nomads.555.c.4.zh: 我会让你们一个人瘸着回去，让他们知道将要面对什么。
nomads.555.c.4.en: We will send one of you limping. The next will know what's coming.

nomads.555.c.4.tt.zh: 下一次猎杀会推迟几年再来。
nomads.555.c.4.tt.en: The next hunters will be delayed by a few years.

nomads.555.c.5.zh: 要么把你们舰队司令交出来，要么我们就自己从残骸里把他拖出来。
nomads.555.c.5.en: Give up your Admiral. Or we shall scrape them out of the wreckage.

nomads.555.desc.1.zh: “住手！你的驾驶机动水平已经证明了你确实是个真正的掠夺者，被放逐又如何。今天我们不会为所谓的荣誉而付出更多代价。开个价，饶我们一命吧。”[Root.GetSpeciesName]在[From.GetName]上喊道，身边是毁坏的舰桥。
nomads.555.desc.1.en: "Stand down! Your piloting makes you a true Marauder, exile be damned. We will not trade more plating for pride today. Name the fee to spare us." The [Root.GetSpeciesName] on the [From.GetName] hails from a ruptured bridge.

nomads.555.desc.2.zh:
被我们击败的敌方舰队很快就发出了投降信号。

“也打够了，这次是你们占了上风。现在，你要我们交出什么，好让我们能清洗船上的这个小污点，继续前进。”
nomads.555.desc.2.en:
The hostile fleet we defeated quickly signaled their surrender.

"That's enough of that. You've the better of us this time. Now, what must we hand over so we can polish this little blemish off the hull and move on."

nomads.555.desc.3.zh:
“我们投降了！求求你！你还记得我们吗？我们一直都忠于你的部族。所谓的流放根本就是个骗局。告诉我们怎样才能效力！”

[From.GetName]上的舰长似乎已经濒临崩溃，他们的[Root.Species.GetMouthName]颤抖着。
nomads.555.desc.3.en:
"We surrender! Please! You remember us; we were always loyal to your clan. This exile is a sham. Tell us how we can serve!"

The Captain aboard the [From.GetName] seems close to the edge, their [Root.Species.GetMouthName] trembling.

nomads.570.a.zh: 对于一个死[Species.GetName]来说，你话太多了。
nomads.570.a.en: You talk a lot for a dead [Species.GetName].

nomads.570.c.en: Our [Owner.GetRulerTitle] is not afraid of you!

nomads.570.c.tt.2.zh: 掠夺者舰队不理我们了。
nomads.570.c.tt.2.en: The Marauder Fleet leaves us alone.

nomads.570.d.en: We will buy out your contract.

nomads.570.desc.1.zh:
从[From.solar_system.GetName]星系传来一束紧急优先呼叫；我们的屏幕被追兵占满了。

“舞跳得真不错嘛，但你们很快就要死在我们前面，那就跳不了了。[GetHeirsBargain]
nomads.570.desc.1.en:
A priority hail pings us in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system; our pursuers fill the viewscreen.

"You danced well, for a time. Pity it ends with you dead in our sights. [GetHeirsBargain]

nomads.570.desc.2.zh:
敌人的声音在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系中响亮地回荡着，追兵已经出现在了显示屏上。

“追逐到此为止了，流亡者。我们已经标记锁定了你的反应堆。[GetHeirsBargain]
nomads.570.desc.2.en:
Our hostile target tones chime loudly in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system as our perusers appear on our displays.

"The chase ends here, exile. We have a target lock on your reactor. [GetHeirsBargain]

nomads.570.desc.3.zh:
掠夺者的字符侵入了[capital_scope.GetName]的主显示屏，与此同时，追猎我们的舰队从超空间航道涌出。

“你作为一名流亡者，飞得倒是挺利索的。但你被困在我们的斩杀航线里了。[GetHeirsBargain]
nomads.570.desc.3.en:
Marauder glyphs infiltrate the main display of [capital_scope.GetName], as our hunter's fleet leaves their hyperlane.

"You fly sharp for an exile. But you're boxed in our kill-lanes. [GetHeirsBargain]

nomads.600.desc.zh:
放逐我们的懦夫终于要行动了。

[marauder_heir.GetName]聚集在一起，要拥立我们的敌人为新的大可汗。

如果我们想要结束流放状态，那就要抓紧时机，在这个[aspiring_khan.GetSpeciesNameInsult]巩固其权力并永远玷污我们的遗产之前，我们有十年时间对其发动挑战。

设定航线前往[marauder_rally_point.GetName]。
nomads.600.desc.en:
The coward who banished us is moving at last.

The [marauder_heir.GetName] gather to appoint our foe as the new Great Khan.

If our exile is to end, it must end now. We have ten years to challenge them before this [aspiring_khan.GetSpeciesNameInsult] consolidates their power and forever stains our legacy.

Set course for [marauder_rally_point.GetName]!

nomads.6005.desc.zh: 在代表[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]执行合同期间，我们偶然发现了一批古老的集装箱。它们被冰块包裹着，我们差点把它们误认为是普通的陨石。虽然从打捞权的角度来看，这些物品在技术上属于我们，但考虑到它们是在为他们工作时发现的，我们应该考虑将它们移交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]。扫描这些箱子后，发现里面……
nomads.6005.desc.en: While working on a contract on behalf of the [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], we chanced upon a collection of ancient containers. Encased in ice, we almost mistook them for plain asteroids. While technically ours by right of salvage, we should consider turning them over to the [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName] as they were retrieved while working on their behalf. Scanning the crates revealed...

nomads.6015.b.zh: 没事，反正也到时候替换了。
nomads.6015.b.en: It's fine, it was time to replace them anyway.

nomads.6015.c.zh: 现在是时候进行一些升级了。
nomads.6015.c.en: This is a good time for some upgrades.

nomads.6015.d.zh: 别担心，我们有充足的备件。
nomads.6015.d.en: No worries, we have plenty of spare parts.

nomads.6015.desc.zh: 我们方舟舰上的一些老旧模块在一次严重的冷却故障后受损，已经显得老态龙钟。损坏程度很大，好在飞船的完整性受到威胁之前已经进行紧急关停。我们该如何应对？
nomads.6015.desc.en: Some older modules on our Arkship have begun to show their age after a critical cooling failure left them damaged. The damage is extensive, but an emergency shutdown was triggered before the Arkship's integrity could be compromised. How should we proceed?

nomads.6015.e.en: We could make the client pay for it...

nomads.6015.e.tt.zh: ……根据合同第56条第18款奥米克戎修订案。
nomads.6015.e.tt.en: ... As per Paragraph 56, Alinea 18, Revision Omicron of the contract.

nomads.6020.a.zh: 别拿方舟舰冒险，直接把货物抛入太空。
nomads.6020.a.en: Let's not risk the Arkship, space the cargo.

nomads.6020.desc.zh:
在从[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]装载物资时，我们检测到其中一个货舱发生了收容失效。据报告，安全门另一侧传来了低沉的轰鸣声，证实了舱室内存在潜在危险。

我们要冒险进行调查吗？
nomads.6020.desc.en:
While loading materials from the [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], we detected a containment breach in one of the cargo bays. Deep rumbling noises were reported from the other side of the security doors, confirming the presence of a potential hazard within the compartment.

Should we chance an investigation?

nomads.6025.a.zh: 开始针对它们的生物发光特性进行实验。

nomads.6025.b.zh: 让方舟舰的居民尽情享受这奇迹。
nomads.6025.b.en: Let the Arkship inhabitants enjoy the wonder.

nomads.6025.desc.zh:
货舱门开启后，一群发光生物体令我们措手不及，它们随即窜入了方舟舰的其他区域。异星生物学家的报告显示，这些生物没有攻击性，对我们的公民或飞船的完整性不构成威胁。

这些微小的生物拥有椭圆形的身体，由修长的肢体支撑，能够攀爬墙壁和天花板，并以惊人的速度移动。它们似乎以我们生态系统中的小型害虫为食，利用胸部的发光腺体引诱猎物。居民们已经适应了它们的存在，并发现它们在夜晚格外讨人喜欢——它们发出的光亮和柔和的鸣叫构成了一场令人惬意的奇观。
nomads.6025.desc.en:
Upon opening the cargo deck doors, a swarm of bioluminescent organisms took us by surprise and scurried in the rest of arkship. Xenobiologist reports indicate that these beings are non-aggressive and pose no threat to our citizens or to the ship's integrity.

The tiny creatures posses an oval shaped body, supported by elongated limbs, and are capable of climbing walls and ceilings while moving at remarkable speed. They appear to feed on small vermin-like critters from our ecosystem, luring them over with bioluminescent glands located in their thorax. Already, inhabitants have gotten used to them, and find them to be especially pleasing at night, when their lights and soft chirps offer a comfortable spectacle.

nomads.6030.desc.zh:
尽管进行了广泛搜寻，我们的团队仍无法在此时已归于沉寂的货舱中找到骚乱的源头。正当他们准备离开时，一个小生物从阴影中钻了出来，扑向一名船员制服上挂着的一根松散线头。

船员们最初吃惊不小，但很快便判定这只外星生物生性顽皮，并无攻击性。当它被小心翼翼地拿近观察时，这个外星动物发出了一种微弱的、类似马达运转的震动，这被解读为一种表示舒适的良性反应。
nomads.6030.desc.en:
Despite an extensive search, our team could not isolate the source of the ruckus in the now silent hold. As they prepared to exit, a small creature emerged from the shadows and pounced on a loose strand of fabric hanging from a crewmate's uniform.

Initially startled, the crew soon determined that the alien to be playful in nature, rather than aggressive. When carefully handled for closer inspection the foreign animal emitted a faint, motor-like vibration interpreted as a benign comfort response.

nomads.6035.a.zh: 我们会将其退还给失主。
nomads.6035.a.en: We will send it back to the owner

nomads.6035.c.en: Scrap it and take the crystals.

nomads.6035.desc.zh:
进入货舱后，船员们发现其中一个货运集装箱被从内部破开了。一台受损的机械体瘫在甲板上，电机仍在嗡嗡作响，指示灯紊乱地闪烁着。

船员们试图将该单位放回集装箱，就在这时，一个隐藏隔层打开了，一堆闪烁的水晶散落在地板上。

在永久关机前的一瞬间，机械体发出了一声微弱的低语，据船员报告，其内容为：“别关掉我，我不一样。”
nomads.6035.desc.en:
Upon entering the cargo deck, the crew discovered that one of the cargo containers had been breached from within. A damaged mechanoid lay sprawled across the deck plating, motors still whirring and indicator lights blinking erratically.

The crew attempted to return the unit to its container, at which point a hidden compartment opened, releasing a collection of shimmering crystals onto the floor.

Immediately prior to its permanent shutdown, the mechanoid emitted a faint vocalization, reported by crew members as: "Don't shut me down, I am different."

nomads.6040.a.zh: 我们及时阻止了进一步的损害。
nomads.6040.a.en: We prevented further damage just in time.

nomads.6040.b.en: Make the issuer pay for damages.

nomads.6040.desc.zh:
靠近货舱时，怪声仍在持续，我们认为采取广泛的安全预防措施极具必要。进入货舱层后，船员们发现舱室内弥漫着强烈的有害异味，并注意到货架碎片散落在停泊区各处。片刻之后，相邻的货柜内发生了几次小型爆炸，引发了紧急响应。

团队循着烟雾痕迹发现了一处小火点。专业人员迅速将其扑灭，使船员能够在事态进一步升级前，安全地控制并中和这些易挥发气体。货舱层出现了明显的结构性损坏，周边区域的多处货箱也遭到了破坏。
nomads.6040.desc.en:
The weird noises continued when approaching the cargo bay, warranting extensive safety precautions. Upon entry into the cargo deck, crew members detected a strong, noxious odor filling the compartment and noticed pieces of holding crates scattered across the dock. Several minor explosions went off moments later within adjacent cargo containers, prompting an immediate response.

The team followed a trail of smoke, discovering a small fire that had broken out. It was quickly suppressed by specialist personnel, allowing the crew to safely contain and neutralize the volatile gases before further escalation. The cargo deck exhibited visible structural damage, along with multiple nearby crates in the surrounding area.

nomads.6045.b.zh: 对我们来说，你不过是货物。我们会按要求把你送到。
nomads.6045.b.en: You're nothing but cargo to us. We will deliver you as required.

nomads.6045.c.zh: 送你回到你该去的地方吧，叛徒。
nomads.6045.c.en: Let's send you back to where you came from, traitor.

nomads.6045.desc.zh:
进入货舱后，骚乱愈演愈烈。声学读数显示源头指向一个货箱。队员们做好了最坏的打算，片刻之后，一个人影从货箱中冲了出来。

此人操着一口浓重且陌生的口音，声称自己带着和平而来。此人自称是[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]，并表示[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe]曾是某个庞大舰队组织的一员，后因纪律原因被开除。[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeSheCap]解释说，[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe]潜伏在船上，掩盖[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]自己的行踪是为了寻求庇护，并渴望有机会证明[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]的价值。

[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName]询问队员们是否愿意接受[arkship_cargo_leader.GetHisHer]提议。
nomads.6045.desc.en:
Upon entering the cargo bay, the disturbance intensifies. Acoustic readings trace the source to a single cargo crate. The team prepares for the worst as, moments later, an individual bursts free from its confinement.

They claim to come in peace, speaking with a pronounced and unfamiliar accent. They identify themselves as [arkship_cargo_leader.GetName] and state that [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe] was once part of a larger fleet organization before being expelled for disciplinary reasons. [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeSheCap] explains that [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHeShe] concealed [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer]self aboard the vessel in search of safety and an opportunity to prove [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHimHer] usefulness.

[arkship_cargo_leader.GetName] asks whether the team is willing to accept [arkship_cargo_leader.GetHisHer] proposal.

nomads.605.desc.zh:
宏伟的舰队在[solar_system.GetName]严阵以待，傲慢地冠以$NAME_Chosen_of_the_Great_Khan$之名。

然后，一声熟悉的呼唤不加修饰地传来：

“流亡者竟敢回来？难道就没有一点独自在黑暗中消亡、被耻辱地遗忘掉的自知之明吗？那我们就亲手了结你们。”

受选者的武器开始充能，我们其他的掠夺者同胞也严阵以待。在这样的决斗中，没有人会越界，因为结果将决定谁将成为他们的新一任可汗。
nomads.605.desc.en:
The grand fleet lies in wait at [solar_system.GetName], arrogantly bearing the name $NAME_Chosen_of_the_Great_Khan$.

Without fanfare, a familiar voice hails us:

"So the Exiled dare to return? No decency to die alone in the dark, forgotten and dishonored? Then we finish you ourselves."

As the Chosen power their weapons, the rest of our Marauder kin hold fast. None will trespass on such a duel, not when the outcome will determine who among them shall lead as Khan."

nomads.6050.a.zh: 我们应该把他们遣送回去。

nomads.6050.b.zh: 告诉我们你所知道的，我们会带你前往目的地。
nomads.6050.b.en: Tell us what you know and we will bring you to your destination.

nomads.6050.c.zh: 我们的方舟舰上还有空余位置。
nomads.6050.c.en: We have space on the Arkship.

nomads.6050.desc.zh:
当舱门打开时，那些异常的噪音戛然而止。由于无法确定骚乱的原因，团队开始对货物集装箱进行系统扫描。

其中一个集装箱显示出多个意料之外的生命体征。强行打开后，发现其中有几个人，明显营养不良，身体状况极差。“请发发慈悲，”其中一人说道。“我们遭到了迫害，被迫从[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]帝国逃亡。我们听凭您的发落。”
nomads.6050.desc.en:
The anomalous noises cease immediately when the doors open. Unable to determine the cause of the disturbance, the team begins a systematic scan of the cargo containers.

One of them registers multiple unexpected life signatures. Breaking it open reveals several individuals, visibly malnourished and in poor physical condition. "Please, have mercy," says one. "We were persecuted and forced to flee from [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName] Empire. We submit ourselves to whatever fate you deem appropriate."

nomads.6055.a.zh: 热烈欢迎贵国前来考察！

nomads.6055.b.zh: 给予有限权限，但是得给钱。
nomads.6055.b.en: Grant limited access, for a fee.

nomads.6055.c.zh: 方舟不是可供观赏的游乐场。
nomads.6055.c.en: The Arkship is not a spectacle.

nomads.6055.desc.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$他们希望在合约有效期内观察并记录方舟舰上的生活。

似乎对大多数定居文明而言，游牧的生活方式依然令人着迷，且充满着不小的神秘感。
nomads.6055.desc.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$ They wish to observe and document life aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.

It seems that to most settled civilizations, the nomadic way of life remains a subject of fascination and no small degree of mystery.

nomads.6055.desc.hive.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$他们要求在合约有效期内获得在方舟舰上的观察权。

该请求源自个体研究人员，他们试图理解一种超出其记录经验的集体移动生存方式。
nomads.6055.desc.hive.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$ They are requesting observation rights aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.

The request originates from individuated researchers seeking to comprehend a form of collective mobile existence outside their documented experience.

nomads.6055.desc.machine.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$他们希望在合约有效期内记录方舟舰的运作情况。

他们的既定目标是研究一个在常规行星参数之外运行的移动自治网络，关于这一课题目前几乎没有外部数据可供参考。
nomads.6055.desc.machine.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$ They wish to document Arkship operations during the active contract period.

Their stated objective is the study of a mobile autonomous network operating outside conventional planetary parameters, a subject for which little external data exists.

nomads.6060.b.en: We don't have time for this.

nomads.6060.desc.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

两个船员部门之间出现了关于哪个团队拥有操作权限的管辖权争议。双方均已提交正式投诉，受影响区域的工作效率已开始下降。
nomads.6060.desc.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

A jurisdictional dispute has emerged between two crew departments over which team holds operational authority. Both have submitted formal complaints, and productivity in the affected area has begun to suffer.

nomads.6060.desc.hive.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

集合体的运作共振中出现了一个不和谐的线程。

关于当前合约内的责任划分，两个子集群开始发出相互冲突的行为模式，为共享意识引入了低效因素。
nomads.6060.desc.hive.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

A dissonant thread has emerged within the collective's operational resonance.

Two sub-clusters have begun emitting conflicting behavioral patterns regarding the delineation of responsibilities within our current contract, introducing an inefficiency into the shared consciousness.

nomads.6060.desc.machine.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

相互冲突的优先指令导致两个管理子系统之间出现了处理冲突。

双方均将自身标记为当前合约的授权操作单位，导致系统陷入循环待机状态，从而降低了产出效率。
nomads.6060.desc.machine.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Competing priority directives have caused a processing conflict between two management subsystems.

Each has flagged itself as the authorized operational unit for our current contract, resulting in a recursive standby loop that is reducing output efficiency.

nomads.6065.a.tt.zh: 这份合约的完成时报酬将减少25%。
nomads.6065.a.tt.en: This contract's completion payout will be reduced by 25%.

nomads.6065.desc.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

方舟舰的内部监控系统报告称，劳工阶层船员的士气出现恶化。一份要求获得一段休整期的正式请求已被提交。

该请求已抄送至[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，对方正等待回复，并必然会要求修改条款。
nomads.6065.desc.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

The Arkship's internal monitoring systems have flagged a deterioration in crew morale among the worker strata. A formal request for a period of rest has been submitted.

The request has been copied to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will expect a response and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

nomads.6065.desc.hive.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

我们记录到了我们的$planet_jobs_simple_drone$中日益严重的不协调现象。它们的劳作过程需要一段同步恢复期，因为持续的压制有导致集体产出出现显著下降的风险。

[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]已获悉此情况，并且必然会要求修订条款。
nomads.6065.desc.hive.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

We have registered a growing dissonance within our $planet_jobs_simple_drone$. Their labor processes requires a period of synchronized recovery, as continued suppression risks measurable decline in collective output.

[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName] has been made aware of the situation and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

nomads.6065.desc.machine.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

诊断周期发现，多个主次系统积累了大量延期的维护任务。效率预测表明，安排一次定期维护将使劳动力产出获得具有统计学意义的显著提升。

该报告已提交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，其将密切关注此事的处理情况，并势必会要求修改条款。
nomads.6065.desc.machine.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Diagnostic cycles have flagged an accumulation of deferred maintenance tasks across several primary and secondary systems. Efficiency projections indicate a statistically significant improvement to workforce output would follow a scheduled maintenance period.

The report has been flagged to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will be monitoring how the matter is handled, and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

nomads.6070.a.zh: 向他们保证我们的善意。
nomads.6070.a.en: Assure them of our good intentions.

nomads.6070.b.zh: 好名声就是它自己最好的回报。
nomads.6070.b.en: A good reputation is its own reward.

nomads.6070.desc.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

我们作为承包商的良好业绩已声名远播。[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]在监控泛星系贸易活动时注意到了这一点，现在将我们视为一个可靠且有能力的合作伙伴。

我们现在有机会进一步培养这份关系，或者也可以将功劳让给我们自己信任的合作伙伴。
nomads.6070.desc.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Word of our track record as a contractor has traveled. [event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName], monitoring galactic trade activity, has taken note, and now views us as a reliable and capable partner.

An opening exists to cultivate the relationship, or possibly to defer credit to our own trusted partners.

nomads.6070.desc.hive.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

在观察整个星域的贸易与劳动力流动时，[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]注意到了我们行动中的规律，这彰显了我们的可靠与能力。

认可的共鸣已经到来。我们可以予以回应，或者让其他蜂巢主脑的声音将这一信号传递下去。
nomads.6070.desc.hive.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName], observing the flow of trade and labor across the sector, has recognized a pattern in our movements, one that speaks to reliability and capability.

The resonance of recognition has arrived. We may answer it, or let another voice carry the signal forward.

nomads.6070.desc.machine.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

我们在已完成合同中记录的运营数据已被外部观察者获取。[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]在追踪该区域的自主网络活动时，注意到了我们的效率指标，并认为我们是一家可靠且有实力的承包商。

通讯频道已建立。我们可以接受这一评价，或者将功劳转交给我们的现有合作伙伴。
nomads.6070.desc.machine.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Operational data logged across completed contracts has been accessed by external observers. [event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName], tracking autonomous network activity in the region, has flagged our efficiency metrics as consistent with a reliable and capable contractor.

A channel has been established. We may acknowledge the assessment, or redirect attribution to our existing partners.

nomads.6075.b.zh: 将数据作为合约的补充部分交付。
nomads.6075.b.en: Deliver the data to as a supplement to the contract.

nomads.6075.c.zh: 存档下来，后续为我们自己使用。
nomads.6075.c.en: Archive it for our own use.

nomads.6075.desc.zh:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

对合约所涉及区域的初步和远程扫描已证实富有成效。数据具有相当大的商业价值，一位独立经纪人已主动提出全面收购。
nomads.6075.desc.en:
$nomads.contract_event_header$

Preliminary and long-range scans of the contract region have proved fruitful. The data holds considerable commercial value, and an independent broker has reached out offering to purchase the collection outright.

nomads.610.a.en: Let sound the drums of war.

nomads.610.a.tt.zh: 成为大可汗，退出所有联邦和星海共同体。
nomads.610.a.tt.en: Become the Great Khan, leaving any Federation and Galactic Community.

nomads.610.b.zh: 可汗的时代结束了。让我们向你展示流放教会了我们什么。
nomads.610.b.en: The era of Khans is over. Let us show you what exile taught us.

nomads.610.b.tt.zh: 集结的部落会成为我们的附庸。
nomads.610.b.tt.en: The assembled clans become our vassals.

nomads.610.c.zh: 大仇已报，剩下的人可以走了。
nomads.610.c.en: Vengeance has been served. The rest of you may go.

nomads.610.c.tt.en: Leave the Marauders to their own devices.

nomads.610.desc.zh:
$nomads.610.base$并效忠誓言。

我们做到了。王座是我们的了。
nomads.610.desc.en:
$nomads.610.base$ and oaths of fealty.

We have done it. The throne is ours.

nomads.615.desc.zh:
$nomads.610.base$。

然而，一切尚未结束。还有其他流亡者也拥有王位继承权。根据法律和习俗，他们必须在三年内向我们发起挑战，否则将永远沦为弃民。
nomads.615.desc.en:
$nomads.610.base$.

However, it is not over. There are other exiles with a claim to the throne. By law and custom, they must challenge us within three years or remain outcasts forever.

nomads.620.desc.zh:
时机已到。我们那些胆小的对手已经放弃。所有其他潜在的篡位者都已处理完毕。氏族统一的力量正支持着我们。

终于，我们坐上了属于自己的王座。
nomads.620.desc.en:
It is time. Our cowardly rivals have given up. All other would-be usurpers have been dealt with. The unified might of the clans is behind us.

At last, we sit on our rightful throne.

nomads.625.desc.zh:
在前往[marauder_rally_point.GetName]的途中，我们收到了令人沮丧的消息：一名和我们分庭抗礼的宣称者已经先于我们击败了目标。那位准大汗被击败了。现在，[From.GetName]宣称拥有了王座。

按照习俗，我们必须在三年内击败他们的旗舰，否则将丧失统治权。
nomads.625.desc.en:
On our way to [marauder_rally_point.GetName] we received crushing news: a rival claimant has beaten us to our quarry. The would-be Khan is defeated. Now the [From.GetName] claim the throne. 

By custom we must defeat their capital ship within three years, or forfeit our right to rule.

nomads.630.desc.zh: 在败给[From.GetName]后，我们必须放弃对汗位的宣称。现在我们只能眼睁睁地看着别人夺取王位。
nomads.630.desc.en: After our defeat at the hands of the [From.GetName] we must forfeit our claim to the Khanate. All we can do now is watch as someone else seizes the throne.

nomads.635.a.zh: 传统即是有理，我们将放弃我们的臣民。
nomads.635.a.en: Tradition is true, we will give up our subjects.

nomads.635.a.tt.zh:
释放所有附属国，但大幅提升与所有附属国的评价和信任。

放弃对所有恒星基地的控制，将其归还给友方掠夺者控制。
nomads.635.a.tt.en:
Releases all subjects but gain a large amount of Opinion and Trust with them all

Gives up control of all starbases, returning them to Friendly Marauder control

nomads.635.desc.zh:
我们荣光加身的汗王[From.GetName]于近日驾崩。根据传统，我们现在必须交出随王座而来的权力。我们的掠夺者盟友已经停止派遣增援舰队来支援我们的事业了。

现在我们必须决定如何处置星系的其余部分。许多并不熟悉我们传统的文明都以这样或那样的原因接受了我们的统治，但他们已经从我们的统治中察觉到了软弱。
nomads.635.desc.en:
Our glorious Khan [From.GetName] passed away recently, and as tradition dictates we must now give up the power that came with the throne. Already our Marauder allies have stopped sending reinforcing fleets to aid our cause.

Now we just have to decide what to do with the rest of the galaxy, there are many that wouldn't be familiar with our traditions and might accept our rule either way, but already they see weakness from our rule.

nomads.700.a.en: Let sound the drums of war!

nomads.700.b.zh: 我们不感兴趣，找别的傻瓜去吧。
nomads.700.b.en: We are not interested, find some other fool.

nomads.700.desc.zh:
我们劫掠者氏族的残兵败将找上了门。看来在我们家园沦陷后，他们倒觉得忘记我们曾被流放的事实很方便。他们的请求很简单：“接任大汗之位，将我们族人的名号烙印在所有伤害过我们的人的星空之上。”

虽然这支舰队的规模比不上任何真正的大汗国，但他们所提供的正是我们曾经渴求的一切。而我们唯一要做的，就是宣布整个星系皆为我们的敌人。
nomads.700.desc.en:
The ragged remains of our marauder clans have come to us. It seems after the fall of our home it was convenient for them to forget our exile. Their plea is simple, "Take the seat of Grand Khan, and burn the name of our people into the stars of all those who wronged us."

Though smaller than any proper Grand Khanate fleet, what they offer is still everything we once wanted. All we have to do is declare the entire galaxy our enemy.

nomads.7005.a.zh: 让他们签约，并欢迎我们的访客登船。
nomads.7005.a.en: Let them sign on, and welcome our visitors aboard.

nomads.7005.c.zh: 久坐不动的人在我们的舰队中没有位置。
nomads.7005.c.en: Sedentaries have no place in our fleets.

nomads.7005.desc.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停泊了足够长的时间，船员与当地人已对彼此有了充分的了解。现在，双方都有少数人请求互换归宿：定居者渴望拥抱无垠的虚空，而漂泊者则向往脚下坚实的土地。
nomads.7005.desc.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for crews and locals to take measure of one another. A handful from each side now ask to swap berths: settled folk eager for the open void, drifters drawn to solid ground beneath their feet.

nomads.7005.desc.forever_cruise.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，以至于新鲜感开始喜忧参半。少数乘客在各个停靠港之间焦躁不安，请求永久下船定居；而下方，当地人则在订票柜台前排队，争抢船上的任何一个铺位，渴望亲身体验宣传册中承诺的种种奇观。
nomads.7005.desc.forever_cruise.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for the novelty to cut both ways. A handful of passengers, restless between ports of call, ask to be set ashore for good; below, locals queue at the booking desk for any berth aboard, eager to taste the wonders the brochures promised.

nomads.7005.desc.same_species.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，船员与当地人都已认出彼此的血缘亲情。如今，双方各有少数人请求互换铺位：已定居的表亲渴望奔赴广阔虚空，漂泊者则被亲族所在的坚实土地所吸引。
nomads.7005.desc.same_species.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for crews and locals to recognize their kinship. A handful from each side now ask to swap berths: settled cousins eager for the open void, drifters drawn to solid ground among family.

nomads.7005.desc.servitor.zh: 我们的活体陈设与[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的人口已开始在我们船体边界两侧进行温和的接触。他们中有些人请求登上[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]避难；我们中也有些人渴望感受开阔的天空。或许允许这场迁徙，能最大化有机体的福祉。
nomads.7005.desc.servitor.en: Our bio-trophies and the population of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] have begun gentle overtures across our hulls' boundary. Some of theirs ask sanctuary aboard [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]; some of ours wish to taste open sky. Perhaps we would maximize organic well-being by allowing the migration.

nomads.8010.desc.zh: 我方特工已经开始接近目标驿站，并绘制了安全模式图，确定了进入位置。我们已准备好推进至下一阶段。
nomads.8010.desc.en: Our operatives have made their initial approach to the target waystation. Security patterns have been mapped and entry vectors identified. We are ready to move to the next phase.

nomads.8015.desc.zh: 我们的特工现已渗透进驿站的船员、访客与系统之中。关键安全中继器已被禁用，内部通讯正通过我们自己的过滤器转发。这座空间站，已经是我们的囊中之物了。
nomads.8015.desc.en: Our agents are now embedded within the waystation's crew, visitors and systems. Key security relays have been disabled and communications are being routed through our own filters. The station's fate is in our hands.

nomads.8020.desc.zh: 我们的情报网络已经确定了一个目标驿站。特工已经渗透完成，准备就绪。增援部队随时待命，准备登上空间站。他们将按我们的指令发起突袭。
nomads.8020.desc.en: Our intelligence network has pinpointed a target waystation. Our operatives are embedded and ready. Reinforcements are standing by to board the station. They will strike at our command.

nomads.8025.desc.zh: 我方特工已消灭了[target_waystation.GetName]上的安全部队，我们正在转移其资源。待行动完成后，他们将……
nomads.8025.desc.en: Our operatives have neutralized the security forces aboard [target_waystation.GetName], and we are in the process of appropriating their resources. Once they are done, they will...

nomads.8030.stolen.desc.zh: $nomads.8030.intro$现已查明，[From.GetName]正是此次行动的幕后黑手——现在他们已经直接控制了该驿站，令其脱离了我们的驿道网络。
nomads.8030.stolen.desc.en: $nomads.8030.intro$ It is now clear that the [From.GetName] was behind this operation, as they have now assumed direct control of the waystation, effectively severing it from our wayline network.

nomads.8050.desc.zh:
锁定方案：异常。

已进行校正。

威胁重评估：无。
nomads.8050.desc.en:
Targeting solution: Malformed.

Correction Applied.

Threat Reassessment: None.

nomads.8055.a.en: We have only made them stronger.

nomads.8055.desc.zh:
更多。

祢将力量如赠与般倾倒。我们感受到了。我们会成长……绝不止步。
nomads.8055.desc.en:
more.

you pour your power into us like an offering. we feel it. we grow... do not stop.

nomads.8060.a.zh: 她对我们有更好的期望。

nomads.8060.desc.zh:
你们如此竭尽全力而最终我也毫发无损……

真是浪费。我本对你们有更高的期望。不要把你的力量浪费在不会受到伤害的事物上。
nomads.8060.desc.en:
You burned through so much just to leave me untouched...

Such a waste. I had hoped for more from you. Do not throw your strength away on what cannot be harmed.

nomads.8065.a.zh: 这是我们需要学习的一课。
nomads.8065.a.en: The lesson is ours to carry.

nomads.8065.desc.zh:
又来。一样的浪费，一样的结果。

我把你们所消耗的还给了你们，不是为了伤害你们，而是让你们感受到它的分量。事不过三。我不想看到你们再一次浪费自我。
nomads.8065.desc.en:
Again. The same waste, the same result.

I return what you spent, not to hurt you, but so you feel the weight of it. Learn from this. I will not watch you spend yourself a third time.

nomads.9000.a.zh: 开始对信号源进行三角定位。

nomads.9000.b.zh: 那都是陈年旧事了，记录下来，然后继续前进。
nomads.9000.b.en: That's ancient history, log it and move on.

nomads.9000.desc.zh:
风信子号的远程接收器在“尤利西斯计划”的紧急频率上截获了一段广播。

这个信号非常古老——至少有一个世纪之久——但信息十分清晰。尤利西斯计划的第五艘“秋菊号”在失散中幸存了下来。殖民者们发现了一个世界，他们将其命名为“联合星”。

广播不断重复着：“秋菊号殖民地呼叫所有尤利西斯计划的船只。我们已在一个宜居世界登陆。这颗星球非常美丽。我们正在这里建设新的家园。回家吧。”

从这里无法确定信号的源头，但用于传输该信号的中继浮标应该是可追踪的。对附近星系进行勘测或许能找到其中一个。
nomads.9000.desc.en:
The Hyacinth's long-range receivers have intercepted a broadcast on Ulysses Initiative emergency frequencies.

The signal is old - at least a century - but the message is clear. The Chrysanthemum, the fifth Ulysses Initiative arkship, survived the scattering. The colonists found a world. They named it Unity.

The broadcast repeats: "Chrysanthemum colony to all Ulysses Initiative vessels. We have made landfall on a habitable world. The planet is beautiful. We are building something here. Come home."

The signal's origin cannot be determined from here, but the relay buoys used to carry it should be traceable. A survey of nearby systems may locate one.

nomads.9005.desc.zh:
尤利西斯计划的一个中继浮标漂浮在这个星系中——破损不堪，勉强运转，但仍在发送广播。

除了最初的宣告外，浮标还载有两条后来的通讯。第二条的日期大约在第一条的十年后。

殖民地人口：二十六万。农业已建立。基础设施正在扩建。

第三条通讯的日期是第9182天——大约在登陆后的第二十五年。“我们还在这里。联合星的环境比最初的调查显示的更具挑战性。我们失去了一些同伴。如果有任何尤利西斯计划的飞船收到此广播，请回复。我们在这里。我们仍在坚持。”

联合星位于天津四星系，距离这里仅有几次超空间跳跃的航程。
nomads.9005.desc.en:
A Ulysses Initiative relay buoy is drifting in this system - battered, barely functional, but still broadcasting.

Beyond the original announcement, the buoy carries two later transmissions. The second is dated roughly ten years after the first.

Colony population: two hundred and sixty thousand. Crops established. Infrastructure growing.

The third transmission is dated from Day 9,182 - approximately twenty-five years after landing. "We are still here. Unity is more challenging than initial surveys indicated. We have lost people. If any Ulysses Initiative vessel receives this broadcast, please respond. We are here. We endure."

Unity is in the Deneb system, only a few hyperlane jumps from here.

nomads.9010.desc.zh:
天津四星系一片寂静。

“风信子”号脱离跃迁，发现没有信标，没有信号，也没有在星球间穿梭的飞船。奥林波斯星悬浮在半远处，庞大而冷漠。

有一颗卫星不对劲。殖民地的广播曾描述那里有绿色的大陆和广阔的水域，而扫描仪显示的却是一个死寂的世界——那是被核武器摧毁后的星球特有的无可错认的灰褐色。那里没有任何生命。

在近地轨道上，缓慢而暗淡地漂浮着的是“秋菊”号。它没有被毁。只是空无一人。每一扇舷窗都漆黑一片。这艘曾运载着二十五万殖民者来到这个世界的飞船，已经在这里停滞了数十年。
nomads.9010.desc.en:
The Deneb system is quiet.

The Hyacinth drops from transit to find no beacons, no signals, no ships moving between worlds. Olympus hangs in the middle distance, enormous and indifferent.

One moon is wrong. Where the colony's broadcasts described green continents and open water, the scanners show a dead world - the unmistakable gray-brown of a nuked planet. Nothing lives there.

And in low orbit, drifting slow and dark, is the Chrysanthemum. Not destroyed. Simply empty. Every porthole dark. The ship that carried a quarter million colonists to this world has sat here for decades.

nomads.9015.desc.zh:
殖民地的数据核心幸存了下来——被封存在玻璃化表岩屑下方的地下档案馆中。

第9251天：发现了一种新的掘地变种。外围墙体的防护等级不足以抵御地下突破。已向“秋菊”号请求工程支援。请求待批复。

第9389天：外环已撤离。地下居住区已确认安置了214,000名殖民者。部分区域失去联系。

第9441天：与7至12区的通讯中断。民兵伤亡：892人。

第9484天：地下四层的电力已中断。团队被要求停止记录。档案管理员予以拒绝。

第9514天：我们没有足够的时间了。
nomads.9015.desc.en:
The colony's data cores survived - sealed in a subterranean archive beneath vitrified regolith.

Day 9,251: A new burrowing variant has been identified. The outer perimeter walls are not rated for subsurface breach. Engineering support requested from the Chrysanthemum. Request pending.

Day 9,389: Outer ring evacuated. 214,000 colonists accounted for in underground residential blocks. Some sectors uncontacted.

Day 9,441: Communications with sectors 7 through 12 lost. Militia casualties: 892.

Day 9,484: Power to sublevel four is gone. The team has been asked to stop logging. The archivist declines.

Day 9,514: We do not have enough time.

nomads.9020.desc.zh:
议事厅是为容纳两百人而建造的。最后一次会议只召集到了十七人。档案员仍在进行记录。

会议持续了六个小时。共投出十二张选票——六票赞成轨道轰炸，六票反对。一名委员弃权。三人缺席；他们所在的防区三天前就已沦陷。

反对者争辩说，撤离仍然可行。“秋菊号”可以在地表殖民地的下层被攻破前分批撤离幸存者。

多数人则不这么认为。该生物已经到达了下层通道。任何停靠的飞船都会将污染带离这个星球。现在的选择已经不再是拯救部分人还是拯救所有人，而是失去一个世界，还是失去随后的每一个世界。

殖民地安全主管博克莱尔指挥官投下了决定性的一票。动议通过。殖民地宪章规定少数服从多数。那份宪章是他们在第一年亲自起草的，那时的未来看起来还是另一番光景。
nomads.9020.desc.en:
The council chamber was built for two hundred. The final session convened seventeen people. The archivist was still logging.

The session ran for six hours. Twelve votes were cast - six for orbital bombardment, six against. One member abstained. Three were absent; their sectors had fallen three days prior.

The dissenters argued that evacuation was still possible. The Chrysanthemum could extract survivors in cycles before the lower levels were breached.

The majority held otherwise. The organism had already reached the lower access tunnels. Any vessel that docked would carry contamination offworld. The choice was no longer between saving some and saving all, but between losing one world and losing every world that followed.

Chief of Colony Security, Commander Beauclair, cast the deciding vote. The motion carried. The colony's charter said majority rules. They had written that charter themselves, in the first year, when the future looked different.

nomads.9025.desc.zh:
舰桥日志始于第9516天——即投票两天后。

11名船员留下来确认地表清除情况。辐射水平。人口预估被下调，随后再次下调。第9519天：授权轰炸。第9521天：确认扇区清除完毕，40%。第9558天：地表已彻底净化。未探测到生命迹象。评估结果：全体一致。

船员们又花了四年时间进行天体物理学勘测。科学家们借此打发时间。

最后一篇日志的日期是第11204天。值班军官描述了一个晴朗的日子。她写道，在这么近的距离看天津四，与当初靠近它时所见的模样截然不同。记录到此结束。

最后的记录只有一个时间戳，没有歉意，也没有反思。仅仅是对星光的一句观察。
nomads.9025.desc.en:
The bridge logs begin on Day 9,516 - two days after the vote.

Eleven crew remained to confirm surface clearance. Radiation levels. Population estimates revised downward, then revised again. Day 9,519: bombardment authorized. Day 9,521: sector clearance confirmed, 40%. Day 9,558: surface sterile. No life signatures detected. Assessment: unanimous.

The crew spent four more years on astrophysics surveys. Scientists filling the time.

The final log is dated Day 11,204. The officer on watch describes a clear day. She notes that Deneb looks different from this close than it did on approach. The entry ends there.

The final entry is a timestamp, no apology or reflection. Just an observation about starlight.

number_formless_fleet_max_reached.zh: 无形异使没有剩余舰队。
number_formless_fleet_max_reached.en: The Formless have no fleets remaining.

object_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 传感器回波表明这颗庞大的气态巨行星的大气层内存在不明物体。
object_gasgiant_category_desc.en: Sensor echoes have indicated the presence of some kind of unidentified object deep within the atmosphere of this gas giant.

object_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表上一个小的矩形物体就像镜面一样反射各种探测射线。我们的探测器无法探测出其组成成分。
object_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: A small rectangular object on the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] is deflecting all scanning beams like a mirror. Our sensors are unable to determine its material composition.

observation.10.desc.zh: 为了拯救[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]而孤注一掷，[pre_ftl_country.GetName]向小行星发射了几枚核导弹。虽然这些导弹还不足以摧毁它，但[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]还是成功地使小行星偏离了航行轨道。
observation.10.desc.en: In a last-ditch effort to save [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched several nuclear missiles at the asteroid. Although these missiles were insufficient to destroy it, in a remarkable display of orbital mechanics, the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have successfully diverted the asteroid off-course.

observation.1001.b.zh: [abducted_scientist.GetHeSheCap]还只是个[owner.GetPreFTLLower]。就放任[abducted_scientist.GetHimHer]和[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的族人在一起吧。
observation.1001.b.en: [abducted_scientist.GetHeSheCap] is still a [owner.GetPreFTLLower]. Leave [abducted_scientist.GetHimHer] with [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] people.

observation.1001.desc.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上发现了一位充满前途的[owner.GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]科学家。[abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap]杰出的研究远远领先于[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的同僚，其中一些科研成果即便以我们的标准来看待也是具有革命性的。

尽管[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的工作确实提升了[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的科技进步，但在他们的[owner.GetPreFTLLower]文明中[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的潜力完全是浪费。在我们先进的实验室里，[abducted_scientist.GetHeShe]将有机会做真正的科学。
observation.1001.desc.en:
We have identified a scientist among the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shows great promise. [abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap] brilliant research is far ahead of [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] peers, and parts of it is revolutionary even by our standards.

Though [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] work is certainly increasing the technological progress of the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] potential is wasted on their [owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization. In our advanced labs [abducted_scientist.GetHeShe] would have an opportunity to do some real science.

observation.1002.desc.zh:
我们的特工成功从[owner.GetPreFTLLower]劫走了[pre_ftl_country.GetName]科学家！我们的一艘地面穿梭机拦截到了[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的汽车，当时[abducted_scientist.GetHeShe]加班到很晚，正准备回家，我们用电磁爆炸让汽车失效。

科学家被我们暂时麻痹了身体机能，并被带上穿梭机，同时[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的保镖的记忆也被抹去了。我们有信心“说服”这位优秀的科学家为我们工作。
observation.1002.desc.en:
Our agents have successfully abducted the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] scientist from [pre_ftl_country.GetName]! One of our ground shuttles intercepted [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] motorcar as [abducted_scientist.GetHeShe] was returning home from work late at night, and disabled it with an EMP blast.

The scientist was temporarily paralyzed and brought into the shuttle, while the memories of [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] bodyguard detail were wiped. We are confident in our ability to "convince" the good scientist to work for us.

observation.1002.tt.zh: 获得一名等级6的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]科学官，具有$leader_trait_spark_of_genius$特质。
observation.1002.tt.en: Gain a Level 6 [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] Scientist with the $leader_trait_spark_of_genius$ trait.

observation.1003.desc.zh:
不幸的是，我们尝试从[owner.GetPreFTLLower]劫走[pre_ftl_country.GetName]科学家的行动失败了。我们的一艘地面穿梭机拦截到了[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的摩托车，但当我们用悬浮光线控制住这个吓呆了的科学家的时候，一架[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]大气层内的战机突然抵达了现场。

我们穿梭机安全逃回了轨道，但悬浮光线被打断了，而科学家……好吧，这是一个漫长的坠落。希望[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的死会被归咎于[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]的敌对帝国。
observation.1003.desc.en:
Unfortunately, our attempt to abduct the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] scientist from [pre_ftl_country.GetName] has failed. One of our ground shuttles intercepted [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] motorcar, but as the paralyzed scientist was being moved into its hold with a levitation beam, a [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] atmospheric fighter arrived on the scene.

The shuttle safely escaped into orbit, but the levitation beam was interrupted and the scientist... well, it was a long fall. Hopefully [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] death will be blamed on a rival [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation state.

observation.1004.desc.zh: 我们最初在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上发现的科学家已经发展成了一位杰出的人才。[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]打破常规的研究基础和高度解析的思维方式大大加快了[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的技术发展。
observation.1004.desc.en: The scientist we first identified on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has developed into a remarkable talent. [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] unconventional research and sharply analytical mind has rapidly accelerated the technological development of [pre_ftl_country.GetName].

observation.101.desc.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站的一位科学家失踪了。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]先前正在执行秘密任务，收集[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitt]地表的植物样本，但是并没有和[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]团队的其他成员一起返回穿梭机。

我们进行了有限的探索，以免对[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]造成惊扰，但迄今为止成功的希望渺茫。
observation.101.desc.en:
One of the scientists working at the Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been reported missing. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] [missing_scientist.GetWasWere] taking part in a covert mission to collect plant samples from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, but did not return to the shuttle with the rest of [missing_scientist.GetHisHer] team.

We have been conducting a limited search so as not to alert the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural], but so far without success.

observation.102.desc.zh: 我们终于找到了在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上失踪的科学家的遗体……或者不管怎么说，遗体剩下的部分。看来[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]成为了当地某种大型食肉动物的盘中餐。这对我们的科研队伍来说是巨大的损失，但至少[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]对我们的存在仍然一无所知。
observation.102.desc.en: We have finally recovered the body of the missing scientist on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]... or what remained of it, at any rate. It looks like [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] fell victim to a large, indigenous predator. An unfortunate loss to our science team, but at least the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are still oblivious to our presence.

observation.103.desc.zh: 我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上方的观测站传来了奇怪的报告。当地一个王国似乎集结在了一名神秘的宗教人物麾下，而且也有迹象表明，他们在使用大大超越他们当前发展水平的高科技。难道这和我们失踪的科学家有关？
observation.103.desc.en: We are receiving strange reports from our observers above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. One of the native kingdoms has rallied under a mysterious religious figure, and we have seen evidence of them using advanced technology far beyond their current level of development. Could this be related to our missing scientist?

observation.104.a.response.zh:
我累了。我早已厌烦了那些目光短浅的道德限制，厌烦了同事对我的愚弄嘲笑。最重要的是，我已厌烦了“消极”观察。

真是荒诞！干涉[GetPreFTLLower]文化是我们的使命——沿着我们选择的道路，引领他们，塑造他们。静观其变，无耻地袖手旁观只不过是在逃避责任而已。
observation.104.a.response.en:
I was tired. Tired of short-sighted ethical constraints, tired of the ridicule I suffered at the hands of my peers. Most of all, I was tired of 'passive' observation.

What nonsense! It is our DUTY to interfere with [GetPreFTLLower] cultures - to guide and shape them along a path of our choosing. Observing quietly from the sidelines is just a shameful way of skirting responsibility.

observation.104.b.en: You will report for immediate extraction!

observation.104.b.response.zh:
恐怕已经太晚了。我已经决定不再听从比我地位低下的人的命令了。我的智慧本是为你所用，但你却白白浪费了。

在这里，我会得到我应得的尊重。这里现在就是我的家。凭着我的知识和我带来的科技，我会让这个文明产生巨大的飞跃，走向黄金时代。
observation.104.b.response.en:
It is too late for that, I'm afraid. I am done taking orders from those beneath my station. My intellect was at your disposal, but you chose to squander it.

Here I am treated with the respect I deserve. This is my home now. With my knowledge and the technical schematics I brought with me, I will jump-start this culture and usher in a golden age.

observation.104.c.response.zh:
恰恰相反！我从没如此清醒过！[Root.GetName]的灭亡是不可避免的。要是看不出这一系列征兆，那你真是瞎的可以。

唉，整个过程也许要花上几十年甚至上百年，但你们的末日就要来了。在你们因为碌碌无为使自己毁灭之后，整个星系就会由生命力蓬勃的文明接管，比如我正在建立的那个文明。

没什么可说的了。就此别过吧。
observation.104.c.response.en:
On the contrary! I have never been more lucid! The death of the [Root.GetName] is inevitable. You'd have to be blind not to see the signs.

Oh, it may take anything from a decade to a century, but your downfall will come. After you have finished destroying yourselves with inaction, the galaxy will belong to vibrant young cultures such as the one I am in the process of building.

There is little more to say. I bid you farewell.

observation.104.desc.zh:
你好，朋友们。已经过了一段时间了。

首先，就你们为搜寻我而付出的一切，我衷心地表示抱歉。我在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的失踪完全是故意的。

这里的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]前来谒见我，把我奉若神明……他们为什么不呢？经过慎重考虑，我已经决定把真正的文明带给这些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]。
observation.104.desc.en:
Greetings, friends. It has been some time.

Firstly, I want to apologize for all the effort you've put into looking for me. My disappearance on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] was entirely intentional.

The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] here have come to see me as something of a god... and why shouldn't they? After much deliberation, I have decided to bring true civilization to these [GetPreFTLLowerPlural].

observation.105.a.en: The operation is a go. Remove [missing_scientist.GetHimHer].

observation.105.b.en: It would only make things worse...

observation.105.desc.zh:
我们接连收到多份来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表的紧急警报。显然，那位叛逃的科学家正在进一步扩大自己的势力范围——[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]向某个封建王国提供了先进武器，如今这个王国正高举着[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]的旗帜，试图征服[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上的其他地区。

我们已拟定一项强制逮捕[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]的行动方案，但需要大规模地面部队的配合实施。考虑到当地民众中有不少人将[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]奉若神明，这次行动会对社会造成何种影响尚难预料。
observation.105.desc.en:
We have received alarming reports from the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. It looks like our rogue scientist is consolidating power - [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] [missing_scientist.GetHasHave] given one of the feudal kingdoms access to advanced weaponry, and they are now in the process of conquering the rest of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetMoon] in [missing_scientist.GetHisHer] name.

A plan has been proposed to forcibly extract [missing_scientist.GetHimHer], but it will require significant ground forces. There is no telling what effect this will have on the native population, as many have come to see [missing_scientist.GetHimHer] as a god.

observation.106.a.zh: 至少有一个问题得到了解决。
observation.106.a.en: At least one problem has been dealt with.

observation.106.desc.zh:
我们成功将叛变的科学家从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]带走！行动中，数百名[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]为保护他们的“天人”，对我们的部队发起了自杀式攻击，我们迫不得已将他们击毙。真是悲剧。

我们的司法系统现在正在处理这名科学家，但这一系列事件无疑对[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]文明造成了重大影响。他们手中还掌握着我们的部分科技，而他们的“天人”还刚刚被来自星辰的入侵者抓走了……
observation.106.desc.en:
We have successfully extracted the rogue scientist from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]! Hundreds of [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] were tragically gunned down when they launched suicidal attacks against our forces in a futile attempt to protect their 'god.'

Our legal system will now deal with the scientist, but the impact of these events on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s civilization must be immense. They still possess some of our technology, and their deity has just been spirited away by invaders from the stars.

observation.107.desc.zh:
在我们抓走叛变科学家后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]陷入了战争。[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]打造的帝国分成了数支相互敌视的派系，每个派系都对[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]宗教教条有着不同的解释。

原住民现在使用的武器具有很强的破坏性，因此战斗也尤为激烈。反对派系之间已互相发射了数枚放射性“脏弹”，看上去战况也愈演愈烈。
observation.107.desc.en:
Following the successful extraction of our rogue scientist, [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has descended into war. The empire [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] built has fragmented into several quarreling factions, each with their own interpretation of [missing_scientist.GetHisHer] religious dogma.

Fighting has been particularly fierce due to the destructive weaponry the natives are now using. Several radiological 'dirty bombs' have so far been detonated by the opposing factions, and it looks like the conflict is only getting started.

observation.108.desc.zh: 我们成功抓走叛变科学家后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的局势似乎略见平息。没有[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]对数据进行解释，[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]和[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]带去的科技原型对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们来说就毫无用处了。[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]已经开始渐渐回到原本的生活方式。
observation.108.desc.en: The situation on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] seems to have settled down a bit since the successful extraction of our rogue scientist. Without [missing_scientist.GetHimHer] to interpret the data, the technical schematics [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] brought with [missing_scientist.GetHimHer] are of no use to the people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are gradually reverting to their old ways.

observation.109.a.zh: 所以说，不干涉指令的存在是很有必要的。
observation.109.a.en: This is why we have a directive of noninterference.

observation.109.desc.zh:
今天早些时候，一连串地对天导弹从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表升空，直击我们的观测站！空间站当场即遭摧毁，无人生还。

毫无疑问，[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的[GetPreFTLLower]文明正在以不可思议的速度继续发展——尽管我们抹除了他们所谓的“神”的影响。[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]给予他们的科技一定是触发了一场持久的科学革命。
observation.109.desc.en:
Earlier today, a barrage of surface-to-space missiles was launched from the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] at our Observation Post! The station was destroyed with no survivors.

There can be no doubt that the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface is continuing to advance at an incredible rate - despite the fact that we removed the influence of their so-called 'god.' The technology [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] gave them must have triggered a lasting scientific revolution.

observation.110.a.zh: 你们的“圣救主”是一名外星科学家。
observation.110.a.en: Your 'Holy Savior' was an alien scientist.

observation.110.a.response.zh: 停止你们的亵渎行径！玷污圣救主之名是不可饶恕的罪孽，可处以死刑。我们的文明只有经过[missing_scientist.GetHisHerCap]圣器的洗礼才能取得如今的一切。只要你们将圣救主交还给我们，我方就会原谅你们的亵渎。
observation.110.a.response.en: Cease thy blasphemy! Slandering the name of the Holy Savior is an unforgivable sin, and punishable by death. It is only through [missing_scientist.GetHisHerCap] sacred implements that our civilization managed to achieve all that it has. I will forgive your trespass, so long as you return the Holy Savior to us.

observation.110.b.zh: [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]因[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]对你们犯下的罪行被处死。
observation.110.b.en: [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] was executed for [missing_scientist.GetHisHer] crimes against your people.

observation.110.b.response.zh:
刽子手。卑鄙、言而无信的恶魔。

记住我的话：这起犯罪不会逍遥法外。虽然可能要花上一千年，但我们终将把你们这恶毒的帝国整个夷为平地。
observation.110.b.response.en:
Murderers. Vile, treacherous demons.

Mark my words: this crime will not go unpunished. Though it may take a thousand years, my people will see your demonic empire ground to dust.

observation.110.c.zh: 很好。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]将被释放并交给你羁押。
observation.110.c.en: Very well. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] will be released into your custody.

observation.110.c.response.zh: 恶魔，愿圣救主宽恕你的罪恶。也许你还没到无药可救的地步。
observation.110.c.response.en: May the Holy Savior forgive your crimes, demon. Perhaps there is hope for you yet.

observation.110.desc.zh:
圣灵保佑！你们虽然看起来和我们的圣救主一模一样，但还是有着明显的差距。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]曾说道，恶魔会模仿[missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap]的外貌，在某一天从天而降，将[missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap]抓走。预言成真了，毫无疑问这都是你犯下的事。

我们的圣救主在哪里，你们这些恶毒的生物？我要求[missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap]立刻得到释放！
observation.110.desc.en:
Spirits protect me! You look like our Holy Savior, yet the differences are telling. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] spoke of demons who would mimic [missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap] appearance, and that might one day descend from the heavens to steal [missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap] away. The prophecy came true, and there is no doubt in my mind that it was your doing.

Where is our Holy Savior, wretched creature? I demand [missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap] immediate release!

observation.1101.desc.zh:
发现了我们在他们的[GetPreFTLLower]星球上的行动后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的许多[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]国家暂时放下彼此间的争吵，共同组建了一个跨国界军事组织。

根据当地媒体报道，这个特遣组织的主要责任是保卫他们的[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]免受“未知外星势力针对[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]全体的敌对活动”。
observation.1101.desc.en:
In an apparent response to our operations on their [GetPreFTLLower] world, many of the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have momentarily put aside their squabbling to form a new supranational military organization.

According to local media, this task force has been charged with defending their [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] from "hostile activities perpetrated by an unknown alien agency against the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole."

observation.1102.a.zh: 这会妨碍我们的主动观察行动。
observation.1102.a.en: This will impair our aggressive observation activities.

observation.1102.desc.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上方的观测站的侦测画面显示，[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表新建了一批新的军事基地和雷达设施，这些营区全都归[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]建立的跨国界反外星特遣部队所管辖。

我们注意到，这些国家正在以前所未有的等级通力合作，我们派去执行绑架任务的飞行器现在经常受到这支部队的大气层战斗机拦截。尽管我们在技术上占优，但他们数量是如此之多，仍然成功击落了几架我们的绑架用穿梭机！
observation.1102.desc.en:
Reconnaissance footage taken by our Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has confirmed the construction of several new military bases and radar facilities on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, all under the control of the supranational anti-alien task force recently founded by the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

We are seeing an unprecedented level of cooperation between their nation states, and our abduction flights are now being routinely intercepted by atmospheric fighters belonging to this force. Despite our technological edge, their sheer numbers have enabled them to bring down several of our abduction shuttles!

observation.1103.desc.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上空的观测站被毁了！[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]反外星特遣部队控制的一个军事基地向我们的观测站发射了一枚巨大的地对宇导弹。

考虑到我们之前已经通过大量的预防措施，把我们观测站的存在对[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]隐藏了起来，我们现在还不能确定他们到底用什么方法追踪到了观测站的位置。有人认为，是原住民设法从被击落的我方穿梭机上通过逆向工程掠夺了一些科技。
observation.1103.desc.en:
Our Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been destroyed! The culprit was a large surface-to-space missile launched from a military base controlled by the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] supranational task force.

We are still not certain how they managed to track the station, since extensive precautions had been taken to conceal its existence from the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One theory is that the natives have managed to reverse-engineer technologies looted from our downed shuttles.

observation.1104.a.zh: 虽然始料未及，但这样的发展也挺好。

observation.1104.desc.zh:
由[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]各国组建、用以阻挠我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上行动的跨国界特遣部队被解散了！尽管在针对我们穿梭机和绑架小队的行动中，他们设法取得了几个关键的胜利，但其中几个初创国家决定撤资，从这个计划中抽离。

情报显示，这一预料之外的转折事件是因为[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]各国之间的内斗和外交纠纷。
observation.1104.desc.en:
The supranational task force that the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states founded to thwart our operations on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been disbanded! Though they somehow managed to achieve a few key victories against our shuttles and abduction teams, several of the organization's founding members decided to cut off funding and withdraw from the project.

Intelligence puts this unexpected turn of events down to infighting and diplomatic posturing between the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states.

observation.1105.b.zh: 不，我们应该避免进一步挑衅他们……
observation.1105.b.en: No, we should avoid antagonizing them further...

observation.1105.desc.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站的工作人员要求我们帮助处理由[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]建立的反外星人特遣部队，后者因为我们激进的观测工作而建立。尽管以我们的标准来说，这个组织相当原始，但它已经发展到能够对我们的绑架行动产生干扰。

他们的主基地已经确定位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表，[pre_ftl_planet.GetAMountainFeature]深处。轨道轰炸效果不佳，但由一支全副武装的突击队进行快速袭击应该可以攻其不备突。若是能将其摧毁，对于冥顽不化的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]特遣部队将是致命的一击。
observation.1105.desc.en:
The staff of our Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has requested help in dealing with the anti-alien task force founded by the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in response to our aggressive observation efforts. Though archaic by our standards, this organization has developed a knack for disrupting our abduction operations.

Their main base has been identified on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, deep inside [pre_ftl_planet.GetAMountainFeature]. Orbital bombardment will be ineffective, but a swift raid by a heavily armed strike team should be able to take the base by surprise. Its destruction will surely spell the end of this irksome [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] task force.

observation.1106.desc.zh:
我们计划摧毁[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]跨国界特遣部队主基地的任务大获全胜！我们的强袭小队渗透进了基地，在我们训练有素的特工面前，拿着低劣武器的基地守卫完全不是对手。

在基地内部装完炸药之后，我们的强袭小队被数艘等待的穿梭机接走。这支烦人的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]特遣部队现在已经不剩什么了。
observation.1106.desc.en:
Our mission to destroy the main base of the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] supranational task force was a complete success! The base was infiltrated by our strike team, and its defenders and their limited weapons proved no match for our skilled operatives.

After planting explosive charges deep within the bowels of the base, the strike team were exfiltrated by waiting shuttles. Nothing remains of this troublesome [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] task force now.

observation.1107.desc.zh:
我们计划摧毁[pre_ftl_country.Owner.GetSpeciesName]跨国界特遣部队主基地的任务以一败涂地告终！数艘载着我们强袭小队的穿梭机还未到达基地就被隐蔽的防空炮台击落了。其余特工在到达基地入口时遇到了计划之外的顽强抵抗。

考虑到[pre_ftl_country.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的增援部队正在接近，强袭小队的指挥官最后下达了撤退的命令。然而不幸的是，我们返回轨道的穿梭机在途中遭到了大量大气层战斗机的拦截。损失惨重。
observation.1107.desc.en:
Our mission to destroy the main base of the [pre_ftl_country.Owner.GetSpeciesName] supranational task force failed miserably! Several of the shuttles carrying our strike team were brought down by hidden anti-aircraft emplacements before they even made it to the base. The remaining operatives met with unexpectedly stiff resistance when they eventually reached the base entrance.
