In light of approaching [pre_ftl_country.Owner.GetSpeciesName] reinforcements, the strike team commander finally gave the order to retreat. Unfortunately, as our exfiltration shuttles were blasting their way into orbit, a massive formation of atmospheric fighters intercepted them. Losses were heavy.

observation.111.desc.zh: 我想，我应该感谢你将我送回了自己的追随者们身边。尽管我受到了不公正的对待、监禁以及可笑的心理评估，但我愿意让过去的事情就这么过去了。只要你别动我和我的人民，我们就可以找到一种共存的方法。毕竟，宇宙很大。
observation.111.desc.en: I suppose I should be thankful that you have returned me to my disciples. Despite the unjust treatment I received, the confinement and ludicrous psychological assessments, I am willing to let bygones be bygones. As long as you leave me and my people alone, we can find a way to coexist. Space is very big after all.

observation.112.desc.zh:
一连串地对天导弹从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]表面升空，直接命中了我们高轨的观测站！观测站当场即遭摧毁，无人生还。

看来[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表上的文明正在以不可思议的速度迅猛发展——毫无疑问，这都是拜我们的叛变科学家所赐。我们已经不能把他们当做原始文明了，而且我们再也没机会将那位科学家从权力神坛上撵下来了。
observation.112.desc.en:
Earlier today, a barrage of surface-to-space missiles was launched from the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] at our observation post in high orbit! The station was destroyed with no survivors.

The civilization on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface has advanced at an incredible rate - no doubt thanks to the efforts of our rogue scientist. We must now look upon them as a potential threat, and the window of opportunity to remove the scientist from power has been closed.

observation.1201.a.zh: 我们得收拾一下烂摊子。
observation.1201.a.en: We need to clean up this mess.

observation.1201.desc.zh:
作为我们[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]观测计划的一部分，绑架小队通过外科手术的方式在一部分[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]的脑内装入了植入体，以便追踪他们的位置，监视他们的行为。不幸的是，由于一些制造上的瑕疵，许多植入体失灵了，现在……我们的测试对象身上还出现了一些副作用。

有些测试对象自杀了，还有至少三个测试对象陷入了歇斯底里的暴力状态。我们观测站上的[root.GetResearcherPlural]请求协助，对剩余的测试对象进行管制，在更多事故发生之前移除他们的植入体。
observation.1201.desc.en:
As part of our observation efforts on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], abduction teams have surgically installed brain implants on a number of [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] test subjects to track them and monitor their behavior. Unfortunately, due to a manufacturing flaw many of these implants have malfunctioned, and are now having an... adverse effect on the behavior of our subjects.

There have been a number of suicides, and at least three episodes of violent hysteria. The [root.GetResearcherPlural] on our Observation Post have requested assistance in rounding up the remaining subjects and removing their implants before there are any more incidents.

observation.1202.a.en: At least something good came of this.

observation.1202.desc.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]观测站的绑架小队已经与[Root.GetName]的人员展开合作，迅速地将有瑕疵植入体的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]测试对象都集中了起来。

观测站的外科手术人员更换了功能正常的植入体，并将测试对象送回了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表。不仅如此，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]还成功地从被移除的植入体中提取到大量数据——尽管植入体存在瑕疵。
observation.1202.desc.en:
Abduction teams from our Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have worked in concert with the crew of the [Root.GetName] to quickly gather the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] test subjects with the faulty brain implants.

The Observation Post's surgical staff replaced the implants with functional versions, and the subjects have been returned to the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. As an added bonus, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] managed to extract a wealth of data from the removed implants, despite their defects.

observation.1203.desc.zh: 我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的最后一批[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]测试对象，由于大脑中存在有瑕疵的植入体，已经陷入了完全的疯狂。很多人变得异常狂暴，嘴巴里怪叫着[Root.GetSpeciesName]为植入体编写的代码，肆意攻击他们身边的任何人或东西。
observation.1203.desc.en: The last of our [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] test subjects on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have succumbed to the effects of their defective brain implants. Many went completely berserk, shrieking random code segments from the [Root.GetSpeciesName] programming language used in their implants while savagely attacking anyone or anything in their immediate vicinity.

observation.1205.desc.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]已经自行对我们留下的深究植入体进行了研究。不知为何，[GetPreFTLLower]研究人员成功设计出来的工程化义体，比我们设计出来的版本能够更好地兼容[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]的生物学特性。
observation.1205.desc.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have conducted their own research into the neutral implants we left behind. Somehow the [GetPreFTLLower] researchers have managed to engineer cybernetics far more compatible with [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] biology than we were capable of.

observation.1301.materialist.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上观测站的几个绑架小队，一直在故意使用穿梭机推进器在属于[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的麦田上灼烧出巨大的圆圈和复杂的图案，后者是[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]上的原住民。

因为这一恶作剧，我们的穿梭机组员受到了严厉的训斥，但原住民似乎坚信麦田怪圈存在某种数学上的含义。一股致力于研究这些图案的科学运动开始兴起，并且它以惊人的速度在[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人群中间变得越来越有人气。
observation.1301.materialist.en:
Several of our abduction teams stationed on the Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have apparently been using the thrusters of their shuttles to burn large circles and complex patterns into crop fields belonging to the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that are indigenous to the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat].

The shuttle crews have been severely reprimanded for this prank, but the natives appear to be convinced that the crop circles have some mathematical meaning. A new scientific movement has developed to study the patterns, and it is gaining popularity among the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] at an alarming rate.

observation.1301.spiritualist.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上观测站的几个绑架小队，一直在故意使用穿梭机推进器在属于[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的麦田上灼烧出巨大的圆圈和复杂的图案，后者是[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]上的原住民。

因为这一恶作剧，我们的穿梭机组员受到了严厉的训斥，但麦田怪圈似乎对原住民有着某种精神上的重要性。由于这些图案，一种新的宗教正在形成，并且它以惊人的速度在[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人群中间变得越来越有人气。
observation.1301.spiritualist.en:
Several of our abduction teams stationed on the Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have apparently been using the thrusters of their shuttles to burn large circles and complex patterns into crop fields belonging to the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that are indigenous to the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat].

The shuttle crews have been severely reprimanded for this prank, but the crop circles appear to have taken on some sort of spiritual significance for the natives. A new religion has formed based on these patterns, and it is gaining popularity among the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] at an alarming rate.

observation.1301.xenophile.zh:
我们注意到[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发生了一个明显的改变。他们的社会开始转向对外开放，民众也开始接纳陌生事物了。

我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]全境进行的观察飞行似乎是导致这一情况的部分原因，这让[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]更加渴望了解未知事物。
observation.1301.xenophile.en:
We have noticed a marked change in the ways of the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Their society has turned outwards and they are now far more accepting of strangers.

Our observation flights all across their [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] appears to have played some role in this, making the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] eager to learn more about the unknown.

observation.1301.xenophobe.zh:
我们注意到[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发生了一个明显的改变。他们的社会已经转向闭关锁国，他们不像以前那样能接受陌生事物了。

我们的主动观察行为和在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]全境进行的绑架行动似乎是导致这一情况的部分原因，这使得[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对未知事物更加警惕了。
observation.1301.xenophobe.en:
We have noticed a marked change in the ways of the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Their society has turned inwards and they are now far less accepting of strangers.

Our aggressive observation flights and abductions all across their [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] appears to have played some role in this, making the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] more wary of the unknown.

observation.1501.a.zh: 这可以帮助我们进一步了解它们。
observation.1501.a.en: It will help us understand them better.

observation.1501.b.zh: 不，我们应该让它们顺其自然。
observation.1501.b.en: No, we should leave them alone.

observation.1501.b.tt.en:
$mission_passive_observation$ will now produce +2 $r_unity$
$t$Will be locked to $mission_passive_observation$!

observation.1501.desc.zh: 我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站的科学家申请一艘科研船，以便他们收集来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的标本。为了研究目的，他们想秘密地绑架部分[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，并对它们进行试验。然后，他们将被安全地送回地表，所有记忆被抹除干净。
observation.1501.desc.en: Our scientists on the Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have requested a Science Ship to help them gather specimens from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. For the purpose of research, they would like to covertly abduct some of the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] and perform tests on them. They will then be safely returned to the surface with their memories erased.

observation.1502.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]完成了在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的科学任务。从科研船上派出的穿梭机在夜间低空掠过地面，使用电磁脉冲瘫痪了[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]所使用的陈旧的内燃机车。这些车辆的驾驶者随后被冷冻并收集，其他先遣队则通过对当地家畜进行解剖获取样本。

我们的任务似乎并未引起[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]人们的多少关注，尽管有一些关于“不明灯光”和报告，此外我们的一名穿梭机船员故意使用他们的推进器在麦田上制造圆形图案引发了事故。这些人已被警告。
observation.1502.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has finished its scientific mission to [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Sweeping in low over the ground at night, shuttles from the Science Ship used EMP pulses to disable the archaic combustion vehicles used by the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural]. Their occupants were then sedated and collected, while other away teams acquired samples by dissecting some of the local cattle.

Our mission appears to have gone largely unnoticed by the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s population, despite a few reports of "unexplained lights" and an incident where one of our shuttle crews deliberately used their thrusters to create circular patterns in a crop field. They have been reprimanded.

observation.2.desc.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站上的小型天体实验室侦测到一颗4级小行星正在靠近。若不采取行动，它将会以相当大的力撞击到[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的[GetRandomCompassDirection]半球，足以造成灭绝级事件。

我们的任务是被动观察，通常情况下我们不允许进行干涉，但许多科学家认为在这种情况下应该破例。若不采取任何行动，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]注定将要灭亡。
observation.2.desc.en:
The small astrometric lab on our Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected a Class-4 asteroid on an incoming trajectory. Unless action is taken, it will impact the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s [GetRandomCompassDirection] hemisphere with enough force to cause an extinction level event.

Our mission of passive observation would typically prohibit us from intervening, but many of our scientists have argued for an exception in this case. To do nothing would mean to condemn the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] to certain death.

observation.2000.b.zh: 你已准备好独自面对星系了。
observation.2000.b.en: You are ready to face the galaxy alone.

observation.2000.desc.zh:
我们派往[From.home_planet.GetName]的数千位科学家和顾问终于完成了艰巨的任务，让当地的技术水平进步到了早期超光速阶段。他们新成立的联合政府自称为“[From.GetName]”，并同意成为我们的附庸。

依据与他们前述的协议条款，我们让渡了该星系的控制权并拆除了观测站。需要决定的是，我们是否还要在它们未来的星际旅程中做出进一步的引导。
observation.2000.desc.en:
The thousands of scientists and advisors we sent to [From.home_planet.GetName] have finally completed the arduous task of bringing the local civilization up to an early FTL level of technology. Under their new unified government, the aliens now style themselves as the "[From.GetName]" and they have offered to become our vassals.

We have ceded full control of the system and dismantled our Observation Post, as per the conditions of our treaty with them. All that remains is deciding if we shall guide them further on in the stellar trek.

observation.201.hive_pre_ftl.desc.zh:
在一次于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行的秘密任务中，我方一架穿梭机被不明身份的大气战斗机中队拦截。一枚幸运的导弹击中了穿梭机引擎并使其失效，导致它在偏远的荒野中坠毁。

若想在[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁地点之前救出所有幸存者，我们必须迅速行动。所有我们存在的证据都必须抹除！
observation.201.hive_pre_ftl.desc.en:
During a clandestine mission to the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], one of our shuttles was intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters belonging to an unidentified mind. A lucky missile hit disabled the shuttle's engines, and it crashed in a remote wilderness.

We need to act fast if we are to evacuate any survivors before the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] reach the crash site. All evidence of our presence must be removed!

observation.201.hive_pre_ftl.desc.gestal.zh:
我们的穿梭机，前往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]执行一项秘密观察任务时，被大气层战斗机中队拦截，并报告发生了严重失控。我们追踪到其坠毁地点。

在[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁点之前，所有自主[GetIndividualNamePlural]都必须撤离，并消灭所有我们存在的证据。
observation.201.hive_pre_ftl.desc.gestal.en:
Our shuttle, inbound for a covert observation mission on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported a critical failure after being intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters. We have tracked its location to an uninhabited region.

All autonomous [GetIndividualNamePlural] must be evacuated, and all evidence of our presence removed before any [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] reach the crash site..

observation.201.reg_pre_ftl.desc.zh:
在一次于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行的秘密任务中，我方一架穿梭机被当地某个国家政权的大气层战斗机中队拦截。一枚幸运的导弹击中了穿梭机引擎，导致它在偏远的荒野中坠毁。

若想在[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁地点之前救出所有幸存者，我们必须迅速行动。所有我们存在的证据都必须抹除！
observation.201.reg_pre_ftl.desc.en:
During a clandestine mission to the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], one of our shuttles was intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters belonging to a local nation state. A lucky missile hit disabled the shuttle's engines, and it crashed in a remote wilderness.

We need to act fast if we are to evacuate any survivors before the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] reach the crash site. All evidence of our presence must be removed!

observation.201.reg_pre_ftl.desc.gestalt.zh:
穿梭机XB-23-968H，前往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]执行秘密观察任务V45-BM时，被不明国家的大气层战斗机中队拦截，并报告发生了严重失控。我们追踪到其坠毁地点。

在任何[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]到达坠毁点之前，所有自主无人机都必须撤离，并消灭所有我们存在的证据。
observation.201.reg_pre_ftl.desc.gestalt.en:
Shuttle XB-23-968H, inbound for covert observation mission V45-BM on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported critical failure after being intercepted by a squadron of atmospheric fighters, belonging to an unidentified local nation state. We have tracked its location to an uninhabited region.

All autonomous drones must be evacuated, and all evidence of our presence removed before any [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] reach the crash site.

observation.2011.desc.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的顾问试图教育当地居民，以提高他们的科技水平，但这项任务遇到了一些挫折。许多[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]拒绝和我们接触，甚至他们中的好学者，都对我们的科学家持怀疑和厌恶的态度。

这种排外情绪耽误了我们的日程表。教育[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]比我们预料的要花费更多时间。
observation.2011.desc.en:
Our advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are having trouble working with the local inhabitants in their mission to bring them up to a higher level of technology. Many [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to have anything to do with us, and even those among them who are most eager to learn look upon our scientists with suspicion and disgust.

This xenophobia has unfortunately upset our timetables. Teaching the [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will take longer than expected.

observation.2014.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的居民因我们所共享的科技而感到喜悦。他们纷纷来到我们位于他们星球上建立的飞地，狂轰滥炸般地询问有关我们文化和历史的问题。

[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对向我们学习的渴求增进了我们提升该文明科技进展的任务进度，因此我们修改了最初关于任务所需时间的估计。
observation.2014.desc.en:
The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are delighted with the technology we have been sharing with them. They have flocked to the enclaves we established on the surface of their world, bombarding our scientists with questions about our culture and history.

The eagerness of the [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to learn more about us has accelerated our mission to advance the technological progress of their civilization. We have revised our initial time estimates.

observation.2016.desc.zh: 很不幸，我们发现[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]很难教育。我们的科学顾问报告称，这些外星人对于放弃自己的传统、接纳新的概念和理念这一方面转变得十分缓慢。看来我们的任务时间会比预期要长一些。
observation.2016.desc.en: The [pre_ftl_species.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have unfortunately proven difficult to teach. Our scientific advisors report that the aliens are slow to abandon their ways and slower still to adopt new concepts and ideas. It would seem that our mission of enlightenment may take longer than expected.

observation.2018.desc.zh:
我们在安排科学家去执行[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的科技发展任务时遇到了困难。因为[pre_ftl_species.GetName]……独特的外貌和气味，这么说吧，能站在他们面前都很不容易。

去[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行任务被大家视作一种惩罚。这很不幸地拖累了我们的任务进度。
observation.2018.desc.en:
We are having difficulty finding scientific advisors willing to take part in our mission of technological development on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Given the... unique appearance and odor of the [pre_ftl_species.GetName], being in their presence is a challenge, to say the least.

An assignment to the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has come to be regarded as a punishment. This has unfortunately delayed the progress of our mission.

observation.2020.desc.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]是天生的科学家。驻扎在它们母星上的顾问对它们取得的进步感到惊讶。顾问们在报告中称，我们推动[pre_ftl_species.GetName]文明进入太空时代的任务或许可以提前完成。
observation.2020.desc.en: The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have proven to be natural scientists. Our advisors stationed on their homeworld are impressed with the progress they have been making. Their reports indicate that our mission to advance the [pre_ftl_species.GetName] civilization to the Space Age may finish ahead of schedule.

observation.2022.desc.zh: 我们为[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]带去科技发展的任务，其进度相较于日程表提前了，这在很大程度上是由于它们不同寻常的智力。尽管这个文明还很年轻，但我们的科学顾问在[pre_ftl_species.GetName]上面看到了巨大潜力。
observation.2022.desc.en: Our mission to bring technological development to the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] is proceeding ahead of schedule, in large part due to their unusual intelligence. Although theirs is a relatively young civilization, our scientific advisors see great potential in the [pre_ftl_species.GetName].

observation.2030.desc.zh: 在和我们派往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的科学家进行长期接触后，当地原住民对于其他物种和文化的接受程度提高了很多。[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]不再那么容易对外来事物表现出排斥的态度了。
observation.2030.desc.en: Prolonged contact with our scientific advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] seems to have made the natives more accepting of other species and cultures. The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] are no longer so quick to react with revulsion when they look upon something that is alien to them.

observation.2031.desc.zh: 在和我们派往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的科学家及顾问紧密合作之后，[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]对所有和外星事物有关的方面都产生了浓厚的兴趣。
observation.2031.desc.en: After working closely with our scientists and advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] seem to have developed a deep interest in all things that are alien to them.

observation.2031.tt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们将变得倾向于亲外主义。
observation.2031.tt.en: The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will grow more xenophilic.

observation.2032.desc.zh:
$observation.social.intro$

他们似乎大体上接受了我们崇尚和平和非暴力的哲学。自我们到来以来，各种[pre_ftl_species.GetName]文化团体之间的冲突几乎停止了。
observation.2032.desc.en:
$observation.social.intro$

They seem to have largely adopted our philosophy of peace and non-violence. Since our arrival, conflict between the various [pre_ftl_species.GetName] culture groups has all but ceased.

observation.2032.tt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们将变得倾向于和平主义。
observation.2032.tt.en: The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will turn towards pacifism.

observation.2033.desc.zh:
$observation.social.intro$

有了这些我们给予他们的新式武器，[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]对战争之道有了新的认识。自我们到来之后，他们的社会迅速军事化。
observation.2033.desc.en:
$observation.social.intro$

With the new weapons we are giving them access to, the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] have developed a new appreciation for the art of war. Their society has become significantly militarized since our arrival.

observation.2033.tt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们将变得倾向于军国主义。
observation.2033.tt.en: The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will turn towards militarism.

observation.2034.desc.zh:
$observation.social.intro$

我们成为了极佳的榜样，教会了他们强大的、团结的领导价值。现在[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]意识到，这是让一个文明变得伟大的必由之路。
observation.2034.desc.en:
$observation.social.intro$

We have served as a successful example, teaching them the value of strong, and united leadership. The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] now realize that this is the only way to achieve greatness as a civilization.

observation.2034.tt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们将变得倾向于威权主义。
observation.2034.tt.en: The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will turn towards authoritarianism.

observation.2035.desc.zh:
$observation.social.intro$

在看到我们的艺术和文化后倍受启发，[pre_ftl_species.GetName]社会似乎已经发展出了一种全新的平等主义认识。自我们到来以来，他们的个人自由程度大大增加了。
observation.2035.desc.en:
$observation.social.intro$

Inspired by what they have seen of our art and culture, [pre_ftl_species.GetName] society appears to have developed a new sense of egalitarianism. Their personal freedoms have greatly increased since our arrival.

observation.2035.tt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们将变得倾向于平等主义。
observation.2035.tt.en: The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will turn towards egalitarianism.

observation.2036.desc.zh:
$observation.social.intro$

我们向[pre_ftl_species.GetName]传播科学观的任务对其社会造成了深远影响。有组织的宗教正在衰落，许多迷信被人们放弃。
observation.2036.desc.en:
$observation.social.intro$

Our mission to teach the [pre_ftl_species.GetName] the value of science has profoundly affected their society. Organized religion is on the decline, and many superstitions are being abandoned.

observation.2036.tt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们将变得倾向于唯物主义。
observation.2036.tt.en: The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will turn towards materialism.

observation.2037.desc.zh:
$observation.social.intro$

见证了我们信念的力量之后，许多[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]前后簇拥着回归了他们文明的古老宗教，还把我们信仰中的某些元素与他们自己的信念融为一体。
observation.2037.desc.en:
$observation.social.intro$

After witnessing the strength of our faith, many of the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] are flocking to the old religions of their civilization, incorporating elements of our beliefs into their own.

observation.2037.tt.en: The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will become more spiritual.

observation.2038.desc.zh:
我们派往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]对[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]进行咨询事务的一部分科学家开始质疑我们这项任务的明智性。他们报告称，原住民似乎只对获得新武器技术产生了一些兴趣。

不幸的是，他们将我们带去的和平技术转化为战争器具的行为延缓了我们的任务进度。
observation.2038.desc.en:
Some of the scientists we sent to advise the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have questioned the wisdom of our mission there. They report that the natives only seem interested in obtaining new weapons technology.

Their tiresome efforts to convert the peaceful technologies we offer them into instruments of war has unfortunately delayed the progress of our mission.

observation.2039.desc.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上启蒙原住民文明的任务并未按计划进行。在我们传授它们新的武器技术时，[pre_ftl_species.GetName]科学家经常感到恐惧。

由于我们的科学顾问展示了在人口密集的城市上空引爆一颗聚变炸弹的仿真演示，他们花了好几周时间才将原住民的情绪安抚好。非常不幸，这大大拖延了我们的进度。
observation.2039.desc.en:
Our mission on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] to enlighten the native civilization is not proceeding as planned. The [pre_ftl_species.GetName] scientists frequently become horrified when we try to teach them about new weapons technology.

It took our scientific advisors weeks to calm them after we showed a simulation illustrating the effects of detonating a fusion bomb over a populated city. This has unfortunately delayed our progress.

observation.2040.desc.zh:
我们在对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人民开展提升文明的相关工作时遇到了一些困难。[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]实际上非常的迷信，有很多民众抱着古老的宗教传统不肯放手，拒绝接受唯物的证据，这让我们的科学顾问感到非常沮丧。

很不幸的是，我们对这一任务的预计似乎过于乐观了。
observation.2040.desc.en:
We are having difficulty working with the people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] in our mission to elevate their civilization. The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] have proven to be a superstitious lot, and our scientific advisors are often frustrated by their arcane religious traditions and stubborn refusal to accept material proof.

Unfortunately, it looks like our initial time estimates for this mission were too optimistic.

observation.2041.desc.zh:
我们启蒙[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]并引导他们朝着正确道路迈向星辰的计划遇到了挫折。我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的宗教和科学顾问报告称，原住民没有信念依靠，这让人感到忧虑。他们很乐意接受我们的科技，但对于负责任地使用这些科技所必备的精神教导，他们不愿意接纳。

这极大地妨碍了我们引导[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]启蒙的任务。这下我们的计划又要延迟了。
observation.2041.desc.en:
Our efforts to enlighten the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] and lead them on the true path towards the stars have been frustrated. Our religious and scientific advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] report a troubling lack of faith on behalf of the native population. They are willing to accept our technology readily enough, but not the spiritual lessons required to use it responsibly.

This has significantly hampered our mission to guide the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] to enlightenment. It will take longer than the signs ordained.

observation.2042.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上压迫的、独裁的社会阻碍了我们推动[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]科技进步的任务。独立思想和开拓精神——这是科学蓬勃发展需要的品质——在[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]身上很罕见。

这种蛮横的威权主义拖累了我们任务的进度——–我们派往当地的科学顾问报告说，实际花费的时间超过预期。
observation.2042.desc.en:
The oppressive, autocratic society on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has frustrated our efforts to raise the technological level of the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]. Individual thoughts and initiatives - on which science thrives - are discouraged among the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural].

Their rampant authoritarianism has stymied the progress of our mission - the scientific advisors we sent report that it will likely take longer than expected.

observation.2043.desc.zh:
无政府主义政权在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的地上世界盛行，我们的顾问们向[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]传授现代科学的时候遇到了很大的困难。有时候，每位科学家对这个项目似乎都有不同的看法，全然不顾他们团队的需求或者公共利益。

我们的启蒙任务仍在继续，当地民众因为误导表现出了一定的平等主义，因此任务需要比预期更长的时间才能完成。
observation.2043.desc.en:
Anarchy reigns supreme on the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], and our advisors are having a difficult time teaching modern science to the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]. At times it seems that every scientist has a different vision for the project, with no regard for the needs of their team or for the common good.

Our mission of enlightenment continues, despite the misguided egalitarianism displayed by the local population, but it will take longer than expected.

observation.205.a.zh: 要是我们的穿梭机没有坠毁就好了……
observation.205.a.en: If only our shuttle had made it out...

observation.209.hive_pre_ftl.desc.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上击落我方穿梭机的意识，逼迫我方被俘虏的科学家为其军队设计新式武器。凭借这些装备，他们成功入侵了数个临近蜂巢思维，现在正如火如荼地将整个[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]纳入自己的统治。
observation.209.hive_pre_ftl.desc.en: The consciousness on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shot down our shuttle has forced our captured scientists to design new instruments of war for their military. With this equipment, they have successfully invaded several neighboring hives and are now in the process of uniting the entire [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] under their rule.

observation.209.hive_pre_ftl.desc.gestal.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上击落我方穿梭机的意识，逼迫我方被俘虏的[root.GetIndividualName]为其军队设计新式武器。凭借这些装备，他们成功入侵了数个临近蜂巢思维，现在正如火如荼地将整个[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]纳入自己的统治。
observation.209.hive_pre_ftl.desc.gestal.en: The consciousness on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shot down our shuttle has forced our captured [root.GetIndividualName] to design new instruments of war for their military. With this equipment, they have successfully invaded several neighboring hives and are now in the process of uniting the entire [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] under their rule.

observation.209.reg_pre_ftl.desc.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上击落我方穿梭机的国家，逼迫我方被俘虏的科学家为其军队设计新式武器。凭借这些装备，他们成功入侵了数个邻国，现在正如火如荼地将整个[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]纳入自己的统治。
observation.209.reg_pre_ftl.desc.en: The nation state on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shot down our shuttle has forced our captured scientists to design new instruments of war for their military. With this equipment, they have successfully invaded several neighboring states and are now in the process of uniting the entire [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] under their rule.

observation.209.reg_pre_ftl.desc.gestalt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上击落我方穿梭机的国家，逼迫我方被俘虏的子个体为其军队设计新式武器。凭借这些装备，他们成功入侵了数个邻国，现在正如火如荼地将整个[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]纳入自己的统治。
observation.209.reg_pre_ftl.desc.gestalt.en: The nation state on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shot down our shuttle has forced our captured drones to design new instruments of war for their military. With this equipment, they have successfully invaded several neighboring states and are now in the process of uniting the entire [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] under their rule.

observation.211.a.zh: 我们人民的安全应该放在第一位。
observation.211.a.en: The safety of our people comes first.

observation.211.a.gestalt.zh: 必须优先考虑我们自主单元的安全。
observation.211.a.gestalt.en: The safety of our autonomous units comes first.

observation.211.b.zh: 他们现在还不能接触这些科技。

observation.212.desc.zh: 在这个我们只能用粗野来形容的场面中，我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上被俘虏的科学家，在现场直播的镜头下被当作“外星憎恶”游行示众。
observation.212.desc.en: In what can only be described as an obscene spectacle, our captured scientists on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] were paraded in front of the cameras on live television as "alien horrors."

observation.212.desc.mach.zh: 在这个我们只能用粗野来形容的场面中，我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上被俘虏的科学单元，在现场直播的镜头下被当作“来自天边的机械憎恶”游行示众。
observation.212.desc.mach.en: In what can only be described as an obscene spectacle, our captured science units on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] were paraded in front of the cameras on live television as "machine horrors from beyond the stars."

observation.301.desc.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上空的观测站在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表发现了一个非法定居点。可能是某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]走私贩或者[Root.GetName]的不法分子设立的哨站。

由于这些走私犯有时候会撞见当地的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，这里已经发生了一些零星的事故——某些事故甚至还上升到了暴力行为。我们需要尽快行动，在不法分子造成更大损失之前带走他们。
observation.301.desc.en:
Our observation post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected an illegal settlement on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. It appears to be some kind of outpost set up by [Root.GetSpeciesName] smugglers and other criminal elements from the [Root.GetName].

There have already been isolated incidents where the smugglers came into contact with the native [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] - some of which ended in violence. We need to act quickly to contain this situation and remove the criminals before they can cause any more damage.

observation.302.desc.zh:
在一次闪电般的突袭行动中，我们的地面部队对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的走私贩哨站发动了突击。在短暂的交火之后，幸存的罪犯们被逮捕并转运至轨道上。随后我们通过引爆炸药将这座空荡荡的建筑从地面抹除。

我们相信尽可能地将文化污染降到了最低，我们的部队也没收了大量的违禁品。没收所得的利润全部上交国库。
observation.302.desc.en:
In a lightning raid, our ground forces stormed the smuggler outpost on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. After a brief firefight, the surviving criminals were arrested and transported into orbit. The empty building was then vaporized by demolition charges.

Cultural contamination is believed to have been minimal, and our forces also confiscated a large amount of illegal contraband. The profits from this seizure have been added to our treasury.

observation.303.desc.zh:
为时已晚。[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的走私贩已经开始用先进武器和粗制滥造的致幻兴奋剂同当地[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]换取贵金属和奴隶。

多个[GetPreFTLLower]群体之间爆发了战斗。由于高科技武器在手，双方人员伤亡惨重。事态发展至此，文化污染造成的恶果已经无法挽回。
observation.303.desc.en:
We are too late. The smugglers on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have begun trading modern weapons and crude narcotic stimulants to the local [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] in exchange for precious metals and slaves.

Fighting has broken out between various [GetPreFTLLower] groups. Due to the high tech weaponry now at their disposal, casualties on both sides have been horrific. The cultural contamination is irreversible at this point.

observation.3101.a.zh: 再这么下去，我们会功亏一篑的。

observation.3101.desc.zh:
我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上一位名叫[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]的$role_spymaster$叛变了！这个笨蛋似乎是被一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]迷住了，他们两个私奔到了[rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的某个地方。

现在我们还不知道这位$role_spymaster$是已经向[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]爱人坦白了[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis]外星人身份，或是[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeShe]会继续伪装成一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]。但毫无疑问，这是一个巨大的隐患——我们得不惜一切代价把[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]带回来，并对其进行心理辅导。
observation.3101.desc.en:
Our $role_spymaster$ on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName], [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], has gone rogue! The poor, misguided fool has apparently been smitten by a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName], and the two of them have eloped to parts unknown on the [rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

We are as yet uncertain whether our $role_spymaster$ has revealed [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] true alien nature to [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] love interest or if [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeShe] [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetIsAre] still posing as a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]. Needless to say this is a tremendous security breach - we should do everything in our power to bring our rogue agent back and give [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] some much-needed psychiatric care.

observation.3103.desc.zh: 我们收到了来自[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]表面传来的加密信号。它使用了我们渗透人员常用的频率，但我们的渗透人员现在都没在传输信息。也许这是我们的反叛特工发来的？
observation.3103.desc.en: We are picking up a scrambled transmission coming from the surface of [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]. It is using a frequency normally reserved for our infiltration cells, but none of them are currently transmitting. Could this be our rogue agent?

observation.3104.a.zh: 你的想法很危险……你需要帮助。
observation.3104.a.en: You are not well... you need help.

observation.3104.a.response.zh:
你已经没什么可以帮助我的了。总有一天，我会承认自己对[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]犯下的所有罪过，并坦白这是受到你的指使。

我会尽我所能，让你，我以前的战友们还有我自己一起接受审判。
observation.3104.a.response.en:
I've had all the help I want from you. There will come a day when I am made to account for all the crimes I have committed on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] in your name.

I will do everything in my power to ensure that you and all of my former colleagues stand right there beside me when judgment falls.

observation.3104.b.en: You would throw everything away for a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]?

observation.3104.b.response.zh:
抛弃一切？我有什么可抛弃的呢？我就是个披着这外星生物皮囊的骗子，而我绝无资格如此。我永远不会忘记向我所爱之人坦白时所见这那张仓皇失措的面孔，尽管在之后我还是得到了理解。

那一天，我向我的挚爱——还有我自己——保证，我会争取成为一个真正的[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]。
observation.3104.b.response.en:
Throw what away? What did I have exactly? I was an impostor, wearing an alien skin I had no right to. I'll never forget the horror on my love's face when I told the truth - and the understanding that followed. 

That day I promised my love - and myself - that I would earn the right to look like a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName].

observation.3104.c.zh: 不管你跑多远，我们都会把你抓到。

observation.3104.c.response.zh:
我知道你们会这么做。不过为了保护我和我所爱的人，我也不会手软。我可是在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]最强的武术教练手下训练过。

你们倒不如听听我的意见：赶紧滚出[rogue_agent_country.GetName]。把你们那可恶的观测站拆掉，去榨取别的种群，用[rogue_agent_planet.GetBloodType]建设你们那恶毒的帝国吧。
observation.3104.c.response.en:
I am sure you will try. Know that I am prepared to kill to protect myself and my beloved, and that I was trained by some of the finest martial instructors on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName].

Heed my advise instead - leave [rogue_agent_country.GetName] alone. Dismantle your Observation Post and forge your evil star empire out of the [rogue_agent_planet.GetBloodType] and tears of some other unfortunate species.

observation.3104.desc.zh:
你们是追踪不到这个发射装置的。你们只需要知道我是[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]$role_spymaster$就行。直到不久之前，我一直都很愿意参加对[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的渗透计划。

但我现在不这么想了。我从未想过自己会如此热爱[rogue_agent_country.GetAdj]的文化，我也不会再参与这次的颠覆行动。

我自愿放弃[Root.GetName]的公民身份，再也不会再把自己当做[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]了。
observation.3104.desc.en:
Any attempt to track this transmission is futile. You know me as $role_spymaster$ [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]. Until recently, I was a willing participant in the criminal infiltration program taking place as we speak on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName].

No longer. I have come to appreciate [rogue_agent_country.GetAdj] culture in a way I never imagined possible, and I will not aid in its subversion.

I rescind my citizenship in the [Root.GetName]. I no longer consider myself [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName].

observation.3106.desc.zh:
我方安插在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的密探正在被逐一清理。正在对[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]的潜在目标进行跟踪的几名特工都已经离奇死亡。虽然不能排除刺客来自于当地特种情报机构这一可能性，但看得出来，杀手曾受过[Root.GetSpeciesName]军方训练。

这些暗杀事件很可能都是我方叛变特工所为。[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]知道我方的渗透计划，并且受过专门的训练，可以无声无息地消灭敌人。
observation.3106.desc.en:
Someone has been picking off our covert operatives on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]. Several agents that were shadowing potential [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] acquisition targets have been found dead. While it's not impossible that the assassin or assassins came from an indigenous special forces outfit, the methods used in these takedowns indicate [Root.GetSpeciesName] military training.

There is a high probability that these killings are the work of our rogue operative. [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName] knows how our infiltration cells function, and has the training to kill both efficiently and silently.

observation.3108.a.zh: 需要进一步控制媒体报道才行。
observation.3108.a.en: We need a firmer grip on their media.

observation.3108.desc.zh:
[rogue_agent_country.GetName]的几家当地媒体开始报道外星阴谋论。虽然尚未有[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的知名媒体报道这个话题，而且已报道的内容也大多只是主观臆测，但其中的某些细节只有我方内部人员才能知晓。

现在我们只能推测，是我方的叛变特工将机密情报泄露给了媒体。我们得尽力减少此事带来的影响。
observation.3108.desc.en:
Reports are beginning to surface from local media outlets on [rogue_agent_country.GetName] that speak of some kind of massive global conspiracy perpetrated by aliens. The respectable [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] media has yet to touch this subject matter and much of what has been reported is pure conjecture, but there are some details that could only be known by someone with intimate knowledge of our covert operations.

We can only assume that our rogue agent has been feeding information about our infiltration program to the media. This will require some damage control.

observation.3110.desc.zh:
近日，我方在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的一个渗透人员被连根拔除。他们正在对密探进行逐一搜捕。眼见要被抓获时，我方特工都依据密探法则，用瓦解自身的方式进行了自杀。还有一部分特工仍然在躲避追捕，等待着我方的救援。

对方一定是从某种渠道获得了这个渗透人员的部分名单。只有我方的那位叛变特工才拥有这份情报……
observation.3110.desc.en:
One of our infiltration cells on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has been all but eliminated in just the last couple of days. The authorities of the nation state in which they were stationed have been hunting them down one by one. Those of our operatives who were in danger of being arrested committed suicide by disintegration as standing protocol dictates. The cell's remaining members are in hiding now, and we are currently working on getting them offworld.

Someone must have tipped the local authorities off and supplied them with a list of all the operatives that were part of this particular cell. Only our rogue agent could have had this information...

observation.3112.a.tooltip.zh: 虽然无法保证成功，但好在失败是微不足道的。
observation.3112.a.tooltip.en: Success is not ensured, but at least failure will be inconspicuous.

observation.3112.b.tooltip.zh: 效果拔群的解决方案，但是可能引发怀疑。
observation.3112.b.tooltip.en: Overtly effective solution, might raise suspicion.

observation.3112.c.zh: 不行……这太胡闹了、风险太大。随[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]去吧。
observation.3112.c.en: No... too messy and too risky. Leave [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] be.

observation.3112.c.tooltip.en: Our Spy Network will be dismantled.

observation.3112.desc.zh:
我们的情报部门已经确定了位于[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的反叛特工位置！特工们迫切想要解决这位前$role_spymaster$[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]，但考虑到[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]先前所表现出来的能力，我们无法确保行动成功。我们也可以使用可控的轨道轰炸摧毁[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]所在的整个城市街区，这也是一条极其有效的解决方法。

我们得赶快行动……这样的机会转瞬即逝！
observation.3112.desc.en:
Military Intelligence has managed to pinpoint what they believe to be the location of our rogue operative on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]! Our agents are eager to dispatch our former $role_spymaster$ [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], but considering the skills [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] largely demonstrated, the success of the operation is not ensured. Destroying the entire city block through limited orbital bombardment has been also been proposed as an extreme, yet extremely effective solution to terminate [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer].

We should strike quickly... we may never get another opportunity like this!

observation.3113.desc.zh: 我们没能成功除掉[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的那位反叛特工。情报显示，[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe]和[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis][rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]甜心已经转移到了另一个安全之处，具体地点不明。
observation.3113.desc.en: Our plan to eliminate our rogue agent on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has failed - our intelligence sources indicate that [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe] has relocated together with [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] sweetheart to another safe house at an unknown location.

observation.3114.awareness.desc.zh:
$observation.3114.base.desc$

我们的特工编造了类似突发陨石袭击这样的故事来掩盖真相，但是当地人完全不吃这一套。尽管媒体在反复地播送陨石袭击的说法，但更多官方报告指出该事件是源于一种“无法解释的外太空现象”。
observation.3114.awareness.desc.en:
$observation.3114.base.desc$

The cover story elaborated by our agents about a sudden meteor strike, however, has failed to convince the locals. While the media has been repeating the story, more official reports suggest the matter is being blamed on 'unexplained extraterrestrial phenomena.'

observation.3114.noawareness.desc.zh:
$observation.3114.base.desc$

媒体似乎已经采信了我们的渗透单位编造给他们的故事：一场突发的陨石雨袭击了一处人口密集的城市区域。真是悲剧。
observation.3114.noawareness.desc.en:
$observation.3114.base.desc$

The media appears to be picking up on the story our infiltration cells have been feeding them: a sudden meteor shower that struck a densely populated urban zone. Very tragic.

observation.3115.a.zh: 这将引以为鉴：绝对不要背叛我们。
observation.3115.a.en: This will set an example: never betray us.

observation.3115.desc.zh: 我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的特工汇报关于我们反叛的$role_spymaster$已经被特殊照顾了。[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHisHerCap]的死亡被认为是出于自然原因，刻意播撒的信息让[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim]爱人相信这位特工的生物学终究还是无法适应[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的大气。
observation.3115.desc.en: Our agents on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] report the matter of our rogue $role_spymaster$ has been dealt with - discretely. [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHisHerCap] death has been blamed on natural causes, and planted information led [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim] lover to believe the agent's body was ultimately incompatible with [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]'s atmosphere.

observation.3131.desc.zh:
在我方试图用替身替换[From.GetName]的某个关键人物时，任务完全败露了。进行任务的特工不是被追杀至死，就是按照规定，为了不被抓获而自杀身亡。

本应被调包的领袖将这一切都归罪到某个敌国身上。因此，[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的局势渐渐变得紧张，战争似乎一触即发。我方渗透人员准备进行全球性的舆论造势以缓和局势，但需要我们派遣科研船进入轨道进行协助。
observation.3131.desc.en:
Our attempts to replace a key figure on [From.GetName] with a body double from our own ranks has gone terribly wrong. Our agents were discovered, and those who weren't killed in the ensuing firefight committed suicide to avoid capture, as per instructions.

The leader they were sent to replace has blamed this incident on a rivaling nation. International tensions on the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon] are growing and several nations have raised their military readiness levels. Our infiltration cells have prepared a global propaganda campaign to defuse the situation, but they will require a Science Ship in orbit to coordinate their efforts.

observation.3132.desc.zh:
尽管我们的渗透人员作出了努力，[prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]的外部关系还是不断恶化，最终演变成了一场全面战争。常规战争只持续了一小段时间，很快各方都开始使用核武。

无数生命从[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表消失，这里已经变成一片放射性废土。就像当地住民一样，我们也损失了数以千计的渗透人员。由于行动失败，我们拆除了轨道观测站，撤离了所有的工作人员。
observation.3132.desc.en:
Despite the efforts of our infiltration cells, the deteriorating diplomatic situation between the nation states on [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName] has erupted into full-scale war! After a brief period of conventional warfare, all of the combatants made full use of their nuclear arsenals.

The vast majority of life has been cleansed from the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, which has been reduced into a radioactive wasteland. Thousands of our covert infiltrators were lost along with the rest of the population. With the operation having ended in failure, our orbiting Observation Post has been dismantled and the staff evacuated.

observation.3133.desc.zh:
得到了轨道上[Root.GetName]的支持，我们的渗透人员成功地在最后关头阻止了[From.from.GetName]即将发生的一场使用核武的战争。一些[From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的领袖——事实上已经被我们的密探给掉包了——呼吁裁减核武，并改善了帝国之间的关系。

随着局势的平息，我们蛰伏特工的影响力提升了。现在整个局势最后对我们非常有利。
observation.3133.desc.en:
With the support of the [Root.GetName] in orbit, our infiltration cells managed to avert a global nuclear war on [From.from.GetName] at the last moment. Several [From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] world leaders - having been replaced by our own disguised operatives - have called for nuclear disarmament and improved international relations.

With the situation defused, the influence of our covert agents has actually been increased. This entire situation may end up working to our advantage.

observation.3135.b.zh: 这当然是创造历史的一种途径！
observation.3135.b.en: That's certainly one way to make history!

observation.3135.b.tooltip.en: The civilization on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] is pushed into the next age.

observation.3135.c.zh: 抹去我方行迹，继续工作。
observation.3135.c.en: Erase all our traces and keep working.

observation.3135.d.zh: 希望他们把这些事都忘了吧？
observation.3135.d.en: Let us hope they forget all about it?

observation.3135.desc.aggressive.zh:
停泊于[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]轨道的科研团队最近没有汇报任何重大发现……应该说，直到有一次显然是喝得酩酊大醉的观测员向总部发送了一条重要更新。

$observation.3135.desc.base$
observation.3135.desc.aggressive.en:
The science team poised in orbit of [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] had not reported any major findings lately... That is, until a clearly intoxicated observer sent a priority update to headquarters.

$observation.3135.desc.base$

observation.3135.desc.covert.zh: 某位匿名人士揭露了关于潜伏[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]行动中的某些现象。某些科研团队不仅没有低调行事，反而开始搞起了一些骇人听闻的破坏性项目。
observation.3135.desc.covert.en: An anonymous report has emerged which casts a sorry light on our covert infiltration of [great_pyramid_planet.GetName]. Rather than conducting themselves discreetly, some of the science team has instead embarked upon a flagrant and disruptive personal project.

observation.3135.desc.enlighten.zh:
某位匿名人士表示他对于我们在[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]造成的某些影响十分担忧。我们的观测站人员在进行对[great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]原住民的启蒙任务时，擅自“戏弄当地居民”。

$observation.3135.desc.base$
observation.3135.desc.enlighten.en:
An anonymous whistle-blower is concerned about our influence on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName]. It seems the team tasked with enlightening the inhabitants of this [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] has taken it upon themselves to 'toy with the locals'.

$observation.3135.desc.base$

observation.3135.desc.passive.zh:
位于[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]轨道观测站的科研人员最近并没有发来什么有用的报告。直到轨道站上一名年轻的科学家向我们指控某些严重的渎职行为。

$observation.3135.desc.base$
observation.3135.desc.passive.en:
The science team observing [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] had not reported anything substantial in a while... That is, until a young scientist stationed on the orbital facility filed a formal allegation of gross misconduct.

$observation.3135.desc.base$

observation.3136.desc.zh:
[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]上的混乱终于平息了，我们终于得以一览科研团队所引发的灾难性后果了。

短时间内，这颗星球上的大多数人都被卷入了一场全面宗教战争，这是他们称为“天人”的科研团队短暂降临的直接后果。当其中一个交战方为自己的另一位新神修建了另一座金字塔后，争执化为了暴力。在这场宗教冲突中，许多[great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都因此而亡。
observation.3136.desc.en:
The chaos on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] has at last reached a lull, revealing the full extent of our team's catastrophic intervention.

In a short span of time, large parts of the population broke out into all-out religious war - a direct consequence of the fleeting visitation by a figure they call 'the Skyborn One'. Arguments turned to violence when one of the warring factions constructed another pyramid to their new deity. Many [great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] perished in the resulting deadly schism.

observation.3137.desc.zh:
尽管我们与当地社会发生了意外的接触，但[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]上的事态还是渐渐平息的下来。我们在这的行动并不是灾难性的：反而，当地的人们认为所谓“天人”不过是神话传说，并将大金字塔用作一处特殊的科研基址。

[great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesName]达到此等文化和历史理解之迅速让我们的科学家们叹为观止。这也支持了[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会即使在不寻常的大事件面前，也能保持强大逻辑思考能力的论断。
observation.3137.desc.en:
Things appear to have settled on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName], despite our unscheduled interference with the society dwelling there. Our actions here did not amount to disaster: instead the local population have decided that the "Skyborn One" was simply a myth, and designated the pyramid as a site of special scientific interest.

The sheer speed with which the [great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesName] arrived at this cultural and historical understanding has fascinated our scientists. It suggests a great capacity for logical thinking among [root.GetPreFTLLower] societies, even when they are faced with extraordinary events.

observation.3139.a.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
observation.3139.a.en: They will thank us one day.

observation.3139.desc.zh:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的几大帝国在中心集权方面获得重大进展，行政力量集中在少数有实力的领袖手中。低效的狂躁大众统治正在渐渐淡出他们的社会。
observation.3139.desc.en:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have made great strides in centralizing their various planetary governments, with political power redirected towards a few, capable leaders. The inefficiencies of mob rule are slowly being weeded out of their society.

observation.3141.desc.zh:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
我们小心翼翼地将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]推向了更民主的思想，而在我们到达之前，他们的世界还是原始的精英独裁型统治盛行。他们渐渐意识到了个人价值的重要性。
observation.3141.desc.en:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
We have carefully nudged the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] towards more democratic ideals, in place of the primitive despotism that was prevalent on their world before we arrived. They are beginning to appreciate the value of the individual.

observation.3143.desc.zh:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]越来越保守，对异族抱有越来越大的警惕。
observation.3143.desc.en:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun turning inwards, becoming more and more wary of those they regard as strangers.

observation.3145.desc.zh:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]渐渐开放，变得越来越容易能接受与他们文化迥然不同，曾被视为异族的外星人。
observation.3145.desc.en:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are starting to open up, becoming more and more accepting and curious about all the things their people out of ignorance once considered alien and strange to their culture.

observation.3147.desc.zh:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
我们发现[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的各帝国出现了发展军团为主社会的趋势。他们的军团变得更加训练有素。
observation.3147.desc.en:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
We are seeing a definite movement towards a more militaristic society by the various [From.GetSpeciesAdj] governments. Their standing military forces, such as they are, have become more professional in nature.

observation.3149.desc.zh:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
[From.Capital.GetName]上的多数[From.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国正在改掉他们好战的习性。[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上似乎迎来了一个新的和平时代。
observation.3149.desc.en:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
Most of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] realms on [From.Capital.GetName] are abandoning their warlike ways. It looks like the beginning of a new era of peace on the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat].

observation.3151.desc.zh:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
我们让[From.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]领悟了他们之前所不理解的精神世界。他们终于有了信仰，他们的社会也因此更加充实。
observation.3151.desc.en:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
We have opened the minds of the [From.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to a spiritual realm they never knew was there. They finally have something to believe in, and their society is all the richer for it.

observation.3153.desc.zh:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
破除荼毒[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]社会的迷茫和原始信仰的行动大获成功。他们开始意识到了科学与理性的价值。
observation.3153.desc.en:
$observation.3139.start.desc$
We have made great strides in ridding the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] of the superstitions and primitive beliefs that plagued their society. They are beginning to see the value of science and rationality.

observation.3205.b.zh: 我们不能冒险进一步污染文化。
observation.3205.b.en: We must not risk further cultural contamination.

observation.3205.desc.zh:
在目睹了他们的救世主的显灵之后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民陷入了困境。社会出现了分裂，紧张局势已经上升到不可承受的程度。

如果我们不采取行动，他们将利用我们的技术在整颗星球发动一场宗教战争使得其分裂。
observation.3205.desc.en:
Having witnessed the apparent rapture of their savior, the inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are not in a good place. Society is splintering, and tensions have risen to untenable levels.

If we do not take action, they will use our technology to tear themselves apart in a planet-wide religious war.

observation.3210.a.zh: 激活航天飞机自毁功能。

observation.3210.desc.zh:
从我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上坠落的航天器上搜出的技术对这颗星球上的所有生命构成威胁。由于我们缺乏相应的科学理解，他们可以轻易地利用我们的技术来摧毁自己。

除非我们进行干预，否则这将是一场灾难。
observation.3210.desc.en:
The technology scavenged from our downed shuttle on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] poses a threat to all life on the planet. Lacking our scientific understanding, they could easily use our tech to destroy themselves.

Unless we intervene, this will be a disaster.

observation.3215.b.zh: 没有必要再进行间谍活动了。
observation.3215.b.en: There's no further need for espionage.

observation.3215.desc.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上正在酝酿着紧张的局势。核战争迫在眉睫。如果我们什么都不做，他们就会毁灭自己。

我们是他们唯一的希望。
observation.3215.desc.en:
Tensions are brewing on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Nuclear war looms. If we do nothing, they will destroy themselves.

We are their only hope.

observation.4.a.zh: 真是悲惨，但我们无权干涉。
observation.4.a.en: A tragic fate, but it was not our place to interfere.

observation.4.desc.zh: 正如我们所预测，飞向[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的小行星撞击了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表，对其生态系统造成了难以挽回的损害。我们观测站的科学家们只能默默旁观，他们一直在研究的[GetPreFTLLower]文明的大部分都在撞击的影响下消灭殆尽。
observation.4.desc.en: As predicted, the asteroid heading for [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has impacted the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, causing irreparable damage to its ecosystem. The scientists in our Observation Post could only watch in silence as the majority of the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization they had been studying was snuffed out of existence far below.

observation.5.desc.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上方观测站的研究人员操纵观测站的轨道推进器，令观测站与飞来的小行星进行正面碰撞。他们的牺牲使得小行星安全地偏离了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的轨道，但观测站无人生还。

显然，他们不忍看到自己花费毕生心血研究的文明就这样灭亡。
observation.5.desc.en:
The researchers on our Observation Post over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] used the station's orbital thrusters to maneuver it on a direct collision course with the incoming asteroid. Their sacrifice deflected the asteroid safely away from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], but there were no survivors on the outpost.

Evidently they could not bear to watch the extinction of the civilization they had spent their careers studying.

observation.7.a.zh: 他们永远也不会发现的。

observation.7.desc.zh:
飞向[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的小行星在到达[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表前就被摧毁。碎片在进入大气层时均已安全地烧毁，并未造成任何实质性的破坏。

[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]外星人欣赏到了一场极为壮观的流星雨，全然不知自己刚刚躲过了一场灭顶之灾……
observation.7.desc.en:
The asteroid that was heading towards [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been destroyed before it could reach the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. What fragments reached the atmosphere burned up safely before they could cause any harm.

Aside from having witnessed what must have been a spectacular meteor shower, the [GetPreFTLLower] aliens of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] have no idea how close to extinction they just came...

observer.15.desc.zh: 尽管在战斗中被击败，大可汗仍聚集起另一只舰队，如今甚至正在回归前线。
observer.15.desc.en: After having met with defeat in battle, the Great Khan has marshaled yet another fleet and is even now returning to the front lines.

observer.24.desc.en: [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

observer.56.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出沃陶姆母星系的秘密坐标！
observer.56.desc.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Vultaum home system!

observer.57.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出尤特母星系的秘密坐标！
observer.57.desc.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Yuht home system!

observer.58.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出第一联盟母星系的秘密坐标！
observer.58.desc.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the First League home system!

observer.59.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出伊拉斯人母星系的秘密坐标！
observer.59.desc.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Irassian home system!

observer.60.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出赛博勒克斯母星系的秘密坐标！
observer.60.desc.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Cybrex home system!

observer.61.desc.zh: [From.GetName]已经收集齐所有解锁L-星门网络的必要认知！一旦他们研究了L-星门科技并完成一项特殊任务来开启他们境内的L-星门，他们将可抵达L-星团。
observer.61.desc.en: The [From.GetName] has gathered all the insights necessary to unlock the L-Gate Network! Once they have researched the L-Gate technology and finished a special project to open an L-Gate within their borders, they will have access to the L-Cluster.

observer.63.desc.zh: [From.GetName]已经设法恢复了通往L-星团的道路！被称为$nanite_space_dragon_baby_plural$的巨大生物从每个现有的L-星门中出现，但他们似乎未展示出敌意。
observer.63.desc.en: The [From.GetName] has managed to restore access to the L-Cluster! Giant creatures known as $nanite_space_dragon_baby_plural$ are emerging from every existing L-Gate, although they do not yet appear to be hostile.

observer.66.desc.zh: [From.GetName]已经成功开启了L-星团，却意外地发现它已经被一个名叫德萨努协和国的高等文明占据了！
observer.66.desc.en: The [From.GetName] have successfully unlocked the L-Cluster, only to reveal that it is already inhabited by an advanced civilization known as the Dessanu Consonance!

observer.68.desc.zh: [From.GetName]那群粗心的傻瓜企图玩弄超越他们理解的力量，结果在[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]恒星系释放了一个强大而报复性的虚境化身！
observer.68.desc.en: The careless fools of the [From.GetName] have meddled with forces beyond their understanding, unleashing a powerful and vengeful Shroud Avatar in the [shroud_spawn_system.GetName] system!

observer.70.desc.zh: [From.Owner.GetName]的科学官们接收到了一个神秘的信号，它似乎是从一个黑洞中心发射出来……
observer.70.desc.en: Scientists from the [From.Owner.GetName] have picked up a mysterious signal that appears to emanate from the center of a black hole...

observer.71.desc.zh: 时之螶已经把[From.Owner.GetName]的母星系变得……不一样了。
observer.71.desc.en: The Worm-in-Waiting has remade the home system of the [From.Owner.GetName] into something... different.

observer.72.desc.zh: 时之螶已经将自己具现化在[From.Owner.GetName]的家园星系。战斗开始了……
observer.72.desc.en: The Worm-in-Waiting has manifested itself in the home system of the [From.Owner.GetName]. Battle is joined...

obsidian_planet_desc.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行视觉扫描发现黑曜岩大陆板块覆盖着这颗行星贫瘠的表面，上层大气中残留着大量的硫。

专项地质调查将让我们得到更多结果。
obsidian_planet_desc.en:
Visual scans of [from.GetName] show continental sheets of obsidian coating the barren surfaces of the planet, with heavy traces of sulfur lingering in the upper atmosphere.

A more concentrated geological survey will tell us more.

old_gods_shrine_poi_1_desc.zh: 辐射度测量指数显示一个同未叙尊者的古龛类似的物体正在环绕这颗恒星。
old_gods_shrine_poi_1_desc.en: Radiometric findings indicate that an object similar to the shrine to the Untold might orbiting this star.

old_gods_shrine_poi_2.zh: 第二个疑似古龛的位置

old_gods_shrine_poi_2_desc.zh: 辐射度测量指数显示另一个同未叙尊者的古龛类似的物体正在环绕这颗恒星。
old_gods_shrine_poi_2_desc.en: Radiometric findings indicate that another object similar to the shrine to the Untold might be orbiting this star.

old_gods_shrine_poi_3.zh: 第三个疑似古龛的位置

old_gods_shrine_poi_3_desc.zh: 辐射度测量指数显示第三个同未叙尊者的古龛类似的物体正在环绕这颗恒星。
old_gods_shrine_poi_3_desc.en: Radiometric findings indicate that a third object similar to the shrine to the Untold might be orbiting this star.

on_crashed_ship_desc.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。
on_crashed_ship_desc.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater.

on_solar_sails_cat_desc.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。但我们不确定它的推进系统如何工作。
on_solar_sails_cat_desc.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship with an unusual design. We're not quite sure how its propulsion system works.

one_salvage_commission_only.zh: £trigger_no£我们同时只能订立一个打捞者委托。
one_salvage_commission_only.en: £trigger_no£ We may only order one Salvage Commission at a time.

openedlootboxdesc1.zh:
$lootbox$是……空的。

你尽可能压抑心中的怨念不让心中的羞恼之意浮于面部。到底是因为湿度骤增还是因为你的眼睛不受控制的湿润了？你的目光模糊了，但是空无一物的$lootbox$依旧在那安然不动。

但随着一阵存在主义的黑暗吞噬过后，一切都过去了。这是什么感觉？回想起在你花费掉辛苦挣来的$ccoinz$，缓缓打开$lootbox$时那种发自内心的紧张与激动……你现在充满了一种说不清道不明的骄傲与成就感。
openedlootboxdesc1.en:
The $lootbox$ is... empty.

Bitter disappointment claws at your insides as you struggle to maintain your composure in the face of this chance humiliation. Did humidity levels suddenly rise or are your ocular organs moistening on their own? Your vision blurs, but the emptiness of the $lootbox$ still stands out in sharp relief.

But as soon as an existential darkness threatens to devour you, it is swept away. What is this feeling? As you mull over the hard-earned $ccoinz$ you spent, the visceral thrill of opening the $lootbox$... you are filled with an inexplicable sense of pride and accomplishment.

operation.1000.desc.friendly.zh: 我们的“观察员”正开始和那些被我们标记为有潜在用处的目标套近乎。
operation.1000.desc.friendly.en: Our 'spotters' have begun ingratiating themselves with targets we've marked as potentially useful.

operation.1000.desc.hostile.zh: 我们暗中潜伏的特工已经加强了对于潜在目标的监控。
operation.1000.desc.hostile.en: Our deep-cover operatives have stepped-up their surveillance on potential targets.

operation.1001.desc.zh: 一份目标的候选名单已经拟定。那些不再承担监视任务的特工将为其他人提供掩护。
operation.1001.desc.en: A shortlist of targets has been drawn up. Those operatives who are no longer tasked with surveillance will provide cover for the others.

operation.1002.desc.zh: 随着行动接近尾声，$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经转而保护我们在[target.GetName]内的新线人。其余特工随时准备着为[spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]提供任何可能需要的掩护措施。
operation.1002.desc.en: As the operation nears its conclusion, $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has moved to secure our new Asset within the [target.GetName]. Our remaining operatives are poised to facilitate any cover [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] may need.

operation.1006.desc.celebrity.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们的间谍网现在已能接触到一位在[from.target.GetAdj]文化界有影响力的人物，我们可以将他们想维持公众形象的需求和我们所拥有的雄心壮志相结合，以此来暗中对其心智与思维施加影响。
operation.1006.desc.celebrity.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network now has access to an influential figure within [from.target.GetAdj] culture, whose desire to maintain their public profile pairs splendidly with ambitions we may wish to wield, to manipulate hearts and minds.

operation.1006.desc.component.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经控制了[from.target.GetName]实体的一部分，这一异常无人机使我们得以接入其中央主控智能并发动直接而毁灭性的打击。
operation.1006.desc.component.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have laid claim to part of the [from.target.GetName] entity - an Asset which will allow us to interfere with the machine intelligence with direct and devastating consequences.

operation.1006.desc.default.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们刚刚招募了一名有价值的线人，此人会协助我们在[from.target.GetAdj]国内的情报搜集工作和间谍活动。
operation.1006.desc.default.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have secured a valuable Asset which will bolster our intelligence-gathering and espionage activities inside [from.target.GetAdj] space.

operation.1006.desc.drone.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们间谍网现已获取到了一位已改造的[from.target.GetAdj]无人机，我们能通过入侵其意识或是其他方法操控[from.target.GetName]实体，这样的好处是显而易见的。
operation.1006.desc.drone.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network has secured access to a modified [from.target.GetAdj] drone, the benefits of which will be obvious whenever we might wish to infiltrate or otherwise manipulate the [from.target.GetName] entity.

operation.1006.desc.network.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们的间谍网现在能支持我们连接部分[from.target.GetName]用于运算的网络。如果我们要掩盖自己对于机器实体的行动，传送错误的信息或是开展其他干扰的话，我们可以将其自身的协议武器化来对付它自己。
operation.1006.desc.network.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network is now bolstered by access to part of the network on which the [from.target.GetName] operates. Should we wish to obscure our movements against the machine entity, send it false information or otherwise interfere with it: its own protocols may now be weaponized against it.

operation.1006.desc.official.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经确保了同一位[from.target.GetAdj]政府高层官员联络的通路。这位线人已经被保护起来，同时蓄势待发，做好了在未来行动中协助我们的准备，尤其是当我们遇到外交或是政府层面的问题时。
operation.1006.desc.official.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have secured access to an official within the [from.target.GetAdj] civic hierarchy. This Asset will be kept secure but poised, ready to assist us with future operations - particularly when we might brush up against diplomatic or governmental issues.

operation.1006.desc.organ.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经控制了[from.target.GetName]实体的一部分，这位反常子个体使我们得以接入主蜂巢思维，负责掩护我们针对主脑的行动以及达成更多目的。
operation.1006.desc.organ.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have laid claim to part of the [from.target.GetName] entity - an Asset which will allow us to interfere with the hive, obscure our movements against it, and much more.

operation.1006.desc.professional.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们的间谍网现在能支持我们接触到一位有影响力的[from.target.GetAdj]专家，其已准备好协助我们的行动，该线人的人脉网络及其声誉将有利于行动的开展。
operation.1006.desc.professional.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network is now bolstered by access to an influential [from.target.GetAdj] professional, ready to assist us with operations which may benefit from the Asset's own network contacts, or the weight of their reputation.

operation.1006.desc.rebel.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经取得了一位[from.target.GetAdj]反政府者的忠诚，其破坏性的欲望很容易被利用来达成我们的目标。
operation.1006.desc.rebel.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have won the loyalty of a [from.target.GetAdj] rebel, whose desire for disruptive change may easily be molded to suit our goals as well.

operation.1006.desc.underling.zh: $operation.1006.desc.intro$我们引诱到了[from.target.GetAdj]公民中一位不受赏识的成员，他的壮志及其在社会低层中的人脉将通过多种渠道协助我们行动的开展。
operation.1006.desc.underling.en: $operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have lured an underappreciated member of the [from.target.GetAdj] citizenry, whose attitude and contacts amongst the lower rungs of society are sure to aid our Operations in various ways.

operation.1020.desc.conf_external.zh: 我们的特工已经确保了我们在[root.target.GetName]受邀出席的在一次星际科学会议上的方便。我们的工作重点仅是侦察[root.target.GetAdj]代表团。
operation.1020.desc.conf_external.en: Our operatives have secured attendance at an interstellar, scientific conference to which the [root.target.GetName] have also been invited. Our efforts are focused on scouting only the [root.target.GetAdj] delegation.

operation.1020.desc.conf_hosted.zh: 我们潜伏的特工们已经完全渗透了[root.target.GetAdj]国内举办的一次尖端云集的会议上。他们已经开始寻找那些潜在目标。
operation.1020.desc.conf_hosted.en: Our undercover operatives are dispersed throughout a promising-looking conference being held in [root.target.GetAdj] space. They have begun scouting potential targets.

operation.1020.desc.enigmatic.zh:
$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告称，我们特工的行动遇到了不可逾越的障碍：[target.GetAdj]的工程技术突飞猛进，远远甩开了我们。

任何可能从他们那里窃取的技术都已变得浑不可解——且与我们现有的技术体系不兼容。
operation.1020.desc.enigmatic.en:
$role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our operatives have met an insurmountable obstacle: [target.GetAdj] engineering appears to have advanced and deviated far from our own.

Any technology we might hope to steal from them would be inscrutable to us - as well as incompatible with what we currently possess.

operation.1020.desc.lecture.zh: 我们已经安排了一些特工在[root.target.GetName]上举办的讲座中充当观众。他们将会在这些知识精英中寻找潜在的领袖。
operation.1020.desc.lecture.en: We have placed operatives in the audience at a number of lectures being held in the [root.target.GetName]. We will watch for potential leads amongst their intellectual elite.

operation.1020.desc.outreach.zh: 我们的特工分散在[root.target.GetName]为造福他们自己的公民而运行的各种科学宣传计划中。我们的行动目的就是想对这些计划有所了解。
operation.1020.desc.outreach.en: Our operatives have dispersed amongst the various scientific outreach schemes being run by the [root.target.GetName] for the benefit of their own citizenry. Our target for this endeavor may very well just make themselves known to us.

operation.1020.desc.theft.zh: 我们的特工已经开始监视[root.target.GetAdj]上的一座研究设施。我们会利用一切存在的切入点。
operation.1020.desc.theft.en: Our operatives have begun surveilling a [root.target.GetAdj] research facility. Wherever an entry point exists, we shall exploit it.

operation.1021.desc.appeal.zh: 我们已经找到了一个符合我们预期标准的目标：能够获得足够前沿的研究成果，同时对于我们的特工持友好态度。我们将会继续跟进这名领袖。
operation.1021.desc.appeal.en: We have found a target who meets our ideal criteria: access to sufficiently novel research, and a receptive attitude towards our operative. We will continue to pursue this lead.

operation.1021.desc.creds.zh: 我们的一个潜在目标似乎具有我们需要的科研许可，并且他们对我们伪造的证书深信不疑。这似乎是我们目前最大的优势。
operation.1021.desc.creds.en: One of our potential targets seems to have the kind of research clearance we need, and they are suitably impressed by our fabricated credentials. This lead seems our best one for now.

operation.1021.desc.theft.zh: 我们的特工已经找到了缺口——这对于我们渗透连接到[root.target.GetAdj]相关研究的计划来说是一个理想的基石。
operation.1021.desc.theft.en: Our operatives have found an opening - an ideal foundation upon which to build our plans to infiltrate [root.target.GetAdj] research.

operation.1022.desc.invited.zh: 我们已经制定了多种具有明显优势的计划：我们的特工终于被邀请到一个从事尖端研究的高级别安全分支机构。$role_spymaster$[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]向我们保证，[root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的预测显示计划前景良好。
operation.1022.desc.invited.en: We have drawn up various plans which press a clear advantage: our operative has at last been invited to a high-security branch facility engaged in cutting-edge research. $role_spymaster$ [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] assures us that [root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] simulations paint a favorable forecast.

operation.1022.desc.theft.zh: 我们的特工现在已经执行了大量的测试行动，其结果与来自$role_spymaster$[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]的有利预测高度一致。我们对于觊觎已久的[root.target.GetAdj]上的研究已经完全做好了准备。
operation.1022.desc.theft.en: Our operatives have now performed numerous test runs, the results of which concur with favorable forecasts from $role_spymaster$ [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]. We stand ready to make our attempt on coveted [root.target.GetAdj] research.

operation.1026.a.messy.zh: 找回我们的特工，能找回来多少就找回来多少！
operation.1026.a.messy.en: Retrieve as many of our operatives as possible.

operation.1026.b.messy.zh: 他们损失了。能破坏多少就破坏多少。
operation.1026.b.messy.en: They're lost. Sabotage whatever we can.

operation.1026.b.smooth.zh: 把我们带不走的全炸了。

operation.1026.c.zh: 留一个后门，方便我们随时检索他们未来的研究。
operation.1026.c.en: Give us backdoor-access to their future research.

operation.1026.d.zh: 好机会，我们应该再多抢一点！
operation.1026.d.en: This is an ideal opportunity to seize more!

operation.1026.d.tooltip.zh: 我们有一项额外科技可以进行研究，并且我们已经得到该条目。
operation.1026.d.tooltip.en: An additional technology is made available for research, as well as the item we have attained.

operation.1026.desc.ducts.messy.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$

一个特工已经通过公用通道获取了通往一个远程科研设施内部的权限，正试图前往核心区域的一处访问受限制的终端。然而，当他获取[fromfrom.target.GetName]中央存放室的权限时，警报触发了。

$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$
operation.1026.desc.ducts.messy.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$

They sought access to the interior of a remote research facility via its utility ducts, intending to reach a restricted-access terminal at its core. When they accessed the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository, however, an alarm was tripped.

 $operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$

operation.1026.desc.ducts.smooth.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.smooth$

一个特工已经通过公用通道获取了通往一个远程科研设施内部的权限，他正慢慢地迂回前进，直到接触[fromfrom.target.GetName]限制访问的中央资料库的终端。$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$
operation.1026.desc.ducts.smooth.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.smooth$

A single operative has gained access to the interior of a remote research facility via its utility ducts, having slowly wound their way to a restricted-access terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository. $operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$

operation.1026.desc.goods.messy.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$

我们的一位特工试图通过货运通道访问某个远程研究设施的内部，货运人员直接将此人输运到了一处可以接入[fromfrom.target.GetName]中央存放室的终端。然而不幸的是，刚打算行动的时候警报就触发了。

$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$
operation.1026.desc.goods.messy.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$

A single operative sought access to the interior of a remote research facility via its goods yard, having themselves delivered straight to a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository. Unfortunately an alarm appears to have been tripped the moment they made their move.

$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$

operation.1026.desc.goods.smooth.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro$

我们的一位特工藏在了一处远程研究设施的货物入口，等待运输人员将其带过几道明显很不充分的[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]安全关卡。一个脑子不好使的[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj]将我们的特工放在了一个能够很轻松够到终端的地方，可以从这里入侵[fromfrom.target.GetName]的中央资料库。

$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$
operation.1026.desc.goods.smooth.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro$

A single operative hid within the goods entrance of a remote research facility, waiting to be couriered past a number of clearly-inadequate [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security measures. An unwitting [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj] has placed our operative within easy reach of a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository.

$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$

operation.1026.desc.invited.messy.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$我们的首席特工设法利用一个假身份完成了获取，但是他的身份现在已经被识破了，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]已经通知了他们的安全部门。

$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$
operation.1026.desc.invited.messy.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.messy$ Our lead operative's cover held long enough to complete their extraction, but their credentials have now been exposed as false. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security has been alerted to their presence.

$operation.1026.desc.outro.messy$

operation.1026.desc.invited.smooth.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.smooth$尽管[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]执行了必要的安全措施，我们的特工隐蔽工作做得更为彻底：我们制造的信任感给了我们充足的机会窗口。

$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$
operation.1026.desc.invited.smooth.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro.smooth$ Our operative's cover held throughout, and although the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] exercised reasonable security: the trust we manufactured was just sufficient to grant us our window of opportunity.

$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$

operation.1026.tooltip.cooldown.zh: 我们必须至少要等待6年，才能再次图谋他们的科研设施。
operation.1026.tooltip.cooldown.en: We must wait at least 6 years before attempting another breach on their research facilities.

operation.1027.desc.zh:
$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]提交了一份报告，事关[from.target.GetName]境内的[from.GetName]行动。似乎看上去[from.target.GetAdj]的科学和工程学已经先进到了可以欺瞒我方最专业的特工的地步了。他们宣称其内部技术和我们自己的科技截然不同，即使我们设法偷到了一两项科技，仿制出来的硬件也无法和我们自己的兼容

$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]建议我们去其他的地方再窃取类似的秘密。
operation.1027.desc.en:
$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has submitted a report on Operation [from.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. It seems that [from.target.GetAdj] science and engineering have advanced to the point of bamboozling our expert operatives. They claim that the underlying technology has deviated greatly from our own, meaning that even if we could somehow steal their research, the resulting hardware would be incompatible with ours.

$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] suggests that we appropriate such secrets elsewhere.

operation.1030.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，偷窃研究成果为他们所用，正在进行的研究已经陷入瘫痪。

我们已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢进度。我们需要几个月的时间才能利用已恢复的研究数据集来重新整合研究开发进度。
operation.1030.desc.gestalt.en:
Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown entity has infiltrated our data media, stealing research for their own use and causing significant disruption to our ongoing studies.

We were able to engage backup systems quite rapidly, but our progress from here will be slowed down. Months may pass before we're able to smoothly re-integrate research & development with our existing research libraries.

operation.1030.desc.regular.zh:
我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，偷窃研究成果为他们所用，正在进行的研究已经陷入瘫痪。

我们的团队已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢他们的进度。我们预计需要几个月的时间，我们才能利用已保存的纸面材料，重新整合研究开发进度。
operation.1030.desc.regular.en:
Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown infiltrator has upended many of our data libraries, stealing research for their own use and causing significant delays to our ongoing studies.

Our teams were able to switch to backup systems quite rapidly, but this will slow their progress. It's estimated that months may pass before we're able to re-integrate our research & development processes with the existing corpus.

operation.2000.desc.cargo.zh: $operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$它的货架上装满了对[target.owner.GetAdj]的扫描器会显示为$rare_crystals$和其他珍贵矿物的物件。我们相信，最简单直白的策略能够达到最好的障眼法效果。
operation.2000.desc.cargo.en: $operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$ Its hold is packed with what will appear to [target.owner.GetAdj] scanners as $rare_crystals$ and other precious minerals. We trust that the bare-faced simplicity of this strategy will serve as its own bluff.

operation.2000.desc.derelict.zh: $operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$这艘舰船在接近[target.owner.GetAdj]国境的时候被安排了一场非致命性的爆炸，使得其尽可能接近[target.solar_system.GetName]星系。辐射将会倾泻出来充满了整个船舱内部，这样我们的特工就能秘密隐藏在它不可见的受保护核心中。
operation.2000.desc.derelict.en: $operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$ The ship is rigged for a non-lethal explosion as it approaches the [target.owner.GetAdj] border - as close as it can get to the [target.solar_system.GetName] system. Radiation will appear to flood the interior of the vessel as our operatives secrete themselves within its invisibly-shielded core.

operation.2000.desc.invalid.zh: 我方特工报告[root.target.owner.GetAdj]的国内已经发生了剧烈的变化：我们的目标不再有效。
operation.2000.desc.invalid.en: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer viable.

operation.2000.desc.jobseeker.zh: $operation.2000.desc.intro.friendly$每一个人都会装作一名求职者。一部分人将会携带推荐信，找和关键设施运营相关的工作；其他人则要在背地里试试运气。
operation.2000.desc.jobseeker.en: $operation.2000.desc.intro.friendly$ Each will pose as a worker seeking employment. Some are carrying statements of recommendation and will seek work close to key facilities; others will try their luck in shadier parts of the installation.

operation.2000.desc.vendor.zh: $operation.2000.desc.intro.friendly$他们中间有一个假扮工匠家庭，希望能够寻得新的生意机遇。他们会尝试在[target.GetName]摆零售地摊以出售自己的手工制品。
operation.2000.desc.vendor.en: $operation.2000.desc.intro.friendly$ Amongst them is a supposed family of artisans, seeking new business opportunities. They will try to establish a retail presence on [target.GetName] in order to sell their wares.

operation.2001.desc.vessel.zh: 对方已经上钩了，我们的特工已经“遁入黑暗”，进而在敌对设施内部展开工作。$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]将会等待进一步的讯息信号。
operation.2001.desc.vessel.en: The bait has been taken, and our operatives have 'gone dark' as they work to establish themselves within the hostile facility. $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] will await further signals from them.

operation.2001.desc.vocation.zh: 我方的数名特工已经被允许登陆[target.GetName]设施。其他未获得授权的特工则继续分散在邻近星系。在这里他们可以转换成备用的掩护身份以进一步支援整个行动。
operation.2001.desc.vocation.en: A number of our operatives have been accepted aboard the [target.GetName] facility. Those who haven't been granted work there have dispersed to neighboring systems. There they will switch to backup cover identities and lend support to the overall operation.
