operation.2002.desc.vessel.zh: $operation.2002.desc.intro$$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经着手准备在可能的情况下撤出他们，然而机会十分渺茫。
operation.2002.desc.vessel.en: $operation.2002.desc.intro$ $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has made preparations to extract them where possible, however their chances are slim.

operation.2002.desc.vocation.zh:
$operation.2002.desc.intro$

他们的身份伪装已经深入到了一定程度，我们的特工事实上已经和那里的人员打成一片。通过友情聚餐、共享娱乐，以及日常社交活动，他们在[target.GetName]设施获得了不少能用于进入核心系统的线索。
operation.2002.desc.vocation.en:
$operation.2002.desc.intro$

They have worked their cover roles to such a degree, our operatives have actually developed a rapport with local personnel. A number of useful points of entry have been noted during friendly meals, shared entertainments and day-to-day socializing aboard the [target.GetName] facility.

operation.2005.b.zh: 谨慎是留给懦夫的。拆毁这个恒星基地。
operation.2005.b.en: Discretion is for the meek. Wreck this starbase.

operation.2005.b.orb.zh: 谨慎是留给懦夫的。拆毁这个星环基地。
operation.2005.b.orb.en: Discretion is for the meek. Wreck this orbital ring.

operation.2005.desc.civic.zh:
我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系内的民用设施进行了一次成功的爆破。随后而来的混乱证明了我们目标的成功实现。

$operation.2005.desc.outro$
operation.2005.desc.civic.en:
We have struck a a successful blow to civic infrastructure in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. The ensuing chaos should serve our goals well.

$operation.2005.desc.outro$

operation.2005.desc.military.zh:
我们成功地破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施上面的军用支援结构。我们的特工报道了在他们的设备激活后，周边工作的人出现了少量的伤亡。

我们发动的这次打击扰乱了[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName]的作战后勤，对方不会对其视而不见的。

$operation.2005.desc.outro$
operation.2005.desc.military.en:
We have successfully sabotaged a military support structure aboard the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. Our operatives report minor casualties amongst those working nearby at the time their device activated.

This blow we've dealt to combat logistics within the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName] will not go unnoticed by them.

$operation.2005.desc.outro$

operation.2005.desc.trade.zh:
我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系及其周边的商业利益发动了一次打击。由于当地星系的交通控制者手忙脚乱地制定新的物流模式，贸易舰船已经堵塞了所有的运输航线。

$operation.2005.desc.outro$
operation.2005.desc.trade.en:
We have struck a blow to commercial interests in and around the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Trading vessels are already clogging up the shipping lanes as local space traffic controllers scramble to draw up new holding patterns.

$operation.2005.desc.outro$

operation.2006.desc.zh: $role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告道，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的特工小队必须放弃目前打算破坏[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]位于[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]星系目标的计划。[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]内部发生了急剧的变化，我们之前的准备工作成为了赘余。我们应该明智地挑选一个不同的目标。
operation.2006.desc.en: $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] team of operatives must abandon their efforts to sabotage [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Drastic changes to the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] interior have made our efforts so far redundant. We would be wise to choose a different target.

operation.2010.desc.gestalt.zh: 一个外国实体突破了我们位于[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系的边境，放肆地扰乱了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施的平稳运行。我们暂时无法确信这些破坏分子是如何如此有效地进入我国国界，但是我们提高了内部的安全级别以直接应对这次威胁。
operation.2010.desc.gestalt.en: A foreign entity has breached our borders in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system and has wantonly disrupted the smooth running of [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. We cannot yet ascertain how these saboteurs gained entry so effectively, however we have increased our internal security in direct response.

operation.2010.desc.phobe.zh: 入侵者们已经越过了我们在[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系的边境，并破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施的一部分。这些破坏分子显然是在为某个外国势力卖命；我们的反间谍部队必须提高警戒并尝试抓住这些特工。
operation.2010.desc.phobe.en: Intruders have violated our borders in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system, wrecking part of the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. These saboteurs appear to have been acting on behalf of a foreign power; our counter-espionage forces are on high alert to try and capture these operatives.

operation.2010.desc.regular.zh:
未知的破坏分子在[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系发动了袭击，破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施的部分功能。

我们的反间谍部门推断这是外国势力从中作梗而不是本国的威胁。我们已经提高了受影响宇域的安全等级，希望能够擒拿这些特工。
operation.2010.desc.regular.en:
Unknown saboteurs have struck at the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system, wrecking part of the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility.

Our counter-espionage service suggests this is likely the work of foreign actors, rather than any home-grown threat. We have increased security around the affected region of space in the hopes of capturing these operatives.

operation.3000.desc.zh: 我们已经编纂了一份列表，上面包含对[root.target.GetName]友好的帝国。我们的特工会在这些帝国直接制造裂痕。
operation.3000.desc.en: We have compiled a list of those empires who appear friendliest to the [root.target.GetName]. Our operatives will drive a wedge between these empires.

operation.3000.desc.error.zh: 我们没能发现这个方面合适的目标。看来如果[root.target.GetName]真的在其他地方有盟友，我们也还并没有同他们建立联系。
operation.3000.desc.error.en: We are unable to find a suitable target for this endeavor. It seems that if the [root.target.GetName] do have friends elsewhere, we have yet to establish lines of communication with them.

operation.3000.desc.single.zh: 我们发现了一个前途无量的目标——[event_target:smear_option_1.GetName]——他们同[root.target.GetName]的关系利于[root.target.GetAdj]的利益而于我们有害。
operation.3000.desc.single.en: We have found a promising target - the [event_target:smear_option_1.GetName] - whose relationship with the [root.target.GetName] benefits [root.target.GetAdj] interests to our own detriment.

operation.3001.desc.auth.discord.zh: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$我们会伪造一个遍布[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]社会的慢性渗透行动的证据，称这一行动可以激发和扭转社会大众朝着邪恶的目标前进。
operation.3001.desc.auth.discord.en: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$ We will fabricate evidence of a plot to seed operatives throughout [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] society, to agitate and steer them towards other, nefarious goals.

operation.3001.desc.auth.experim.zh: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$我们会暗示[root.target.GetName]正在运营一个隐蔽的社会学实验，他们拿[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]社会作为实验场景，测试治国术和控制民众的相关理论。
operation.3001.desc.auth.experim.en: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$ We will suggest that the [root.target.GetName] is running subtle, sociological experiments behind the scenes of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] society as a testbed for theories of statecraft and control.

operation.3001.desc.auth.extorts.zh: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$我们可以明示，他们的特使遭到了[root.target.GetName]的勒索以换取表态，这让对方可以从国境之外对他们施加影响力。
operation.3001.desc.auth.extorts.en: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$ We can strongly suggest that their envoys are being extorted by the [root.target.GetName] for favors, applying undue influence from outside their own borders.

operation.3001.desc.auth.mockery.zh: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$有关[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的领袖[smear_campaign_recipient.leader.GetName]在[root.target.GetAdj]的政治圈内被当成了一个彻底的嘲弄对象的证据，能够激起他们的愤慨。
operation.3001.desc.auth.mockery.en: $operation.3001.desc.auth.intro$ Evidence that the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] leader [smear_campaign_recipient.leader.GetName] is a subject of outright mockery in [root.target.GetAdj] political circles is likely to raise their ire.

operation.3001.desc.corp.criment.zh: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$一个像他们这样的商业帝国一定打着在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]全境散布犯罪企业的小算盘，这将侵蚀他们赢得的信任感。
operation.3001.desc.corp.criment.en: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$ That an empire like theirs would seek to spread criminal enterprise throughout the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] would surely erode any trust they may have earned.

operation.3001.desc.corp.knockof.zh: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$有关[root.target.GetName]囤积了大量便宜的[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]仿制商品的证据肯定能够引起激烈的反向。这样的行为对于他们核心的商品产业将是一次重大的攻击。
operation.3001.desc.corp.knockof.en: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$ Evidence that the [root.target.GetName] have stocked warehouses full of cheap imitations of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] wares is sure to provoke a response. It would appear to be a credible attack on their core, mercantile industry.

operation.3001.desc.corp.machine.zh: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$我们应该散布十分可信的谣言，暗示[root.target.GetName]在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的心脏区域植入了子例程，能够操纵其商贸系统为自己所用。
operation.3001.desc.corp.machine.en: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$ We shall concoct credible rumors that the [root.target.GetName] has implanted subroutines within the heart of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], manipulating its financial systems to its own ends.

operation.3001.desc.corp.resells.zh: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$我们会让事情看起来像是，[root.target.GetName]正在滥用他们的商贸协定，将[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的商品以更高的价格又卖了回去。
operation.3001.desc.corp.resells.en: $operation.3001.desc.corp.intro$ We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are abusing their commercial pact by re-selling [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] goods at a steep mark-up.

operation.3001.desc.egal.elect.zh: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$我们可以提供不容忽视的证据，指明[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋渗透[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的政治体系，并试图干涉大选。
operation.3001.desc.egal.elect.en: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$ We can supply hard-to-ignore evidence of a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to infiltrate the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] political system and meddle in their elections.

operation.3001.desc.egal.galco.zh: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$我们应该拐弯抹角地暗示[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋破坏他们在星海共同体的政治立场。
operation.3001.desc.egal.galco.en: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$ We shall lay hints of a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to sabotage their political standing within the Galactic Community.

operation.3001.desc.egal.migra.zh: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$要是[root.target.GetName]被抓到没有遵守他们的移民条约，并且专门针对[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的公民，让他们去干脏活累活，想必有人会觉得受到了冒犯。
operation.3001.desc.egal.migra.en: $operation.3001.desc.egal.intro$ Were the [root.target.GetName] to be caught dishonoring their migration treaty, and singling out [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] citizens for worse jobs, offense would have to be taken.

operation.3001.desc.hive.asset.zh: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$比如，打捞费洛蒙和其他生物资产，意在使用其对付[target.GetGestaltEntityName]……
operation.3001.desc.hive.asset.en: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$ For example: scavenging pheromones and other biological assets for use in schemes against the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]...

operation.3001.desc.hive.necro.zh: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$我们会揭露[root.target.GetName]正谋划着以某种方式转化[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]，彻底地抹除蜂群的人格主权。
operation.3001.desc.hive.necro.en: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$ We will expose an idea that the [root.target.GetName] plot to somehow consume the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], eradicating its personal sovereignty.

operation.3001.desc.hive.toxin.zh: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$有关在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的首都走私有毒物质的密谋细节好像可以激发恐惧与猜忌。
operation.3001.desc.hive.toxin.en: $operation.3001.desc.hive.intro$ Details of a plot to smuggle toxins onto the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] capital are likely to provoke fear and suspicion.

operation.3001.desc.machine.asset.zh: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$我们应当伪造证据，称[root.target.GetName]国内有一整个部门致力于捕获和操纵[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的无人机。
operation.3001.desc.machine.asset.en: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$ We shall fabricate evidence of an entire department within the [root.target.GetName], dedicated to the capture and manipulation of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] drones.

operation.3001.desc.machine.milit.zh: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$我们会暗示[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的无人机正在被捕获用于训练练习，作为[root.target.GetAdj]计划未来某一天对机械智能发动直接攻击的一部分。
operation.3001.desc.machine.milit.en: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$ We will suggest that [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] drones are being captured for training exercises, as part of a [root.target.GetAdj] scheme to one day launch a direct attack on the machine intelligence.

operation.3001.desc.machine.steal.zh: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$ 我们应当播下猜忌的种子，让人们认为[root.target.GetName]正在通过[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的后门盗取研究数据。
operation.3001.desc.machine.steal.en: $operation.3001.desc.machine.intro$ We shall sow seeds of suspicion that the [root.target.GetName] are actively stealing research via backdoors into the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName].

operation.3001.desc.mat.droid.zh: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$我们应当捏造一个[root.target.GetName]国内的运动组织，去窃取[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的机器人，绕过他们自己有限的生产手段。
operation.3001.desc.mat.droid.en: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$ We shall concoct a movement within the [root.target.GetName] to steal [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] droids, bypassing their own limited means of production.

operation.3001.desc.mat.sabot.zh: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$[root.target.GetAdj]可能正在密谋破坏科学研究，这样的消息肯定能够引起他们一定的反感。
operation.3001.desc.mat.sabot.en: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$ That the [root.target.GetAdj] might be plotting to sabotage that scientific research would be sure to draw some sort of reaction from them.

operation.3001.desc.mat.singu.zh: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$造谣[root.target.GetAdj]有能力产生威胁，在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的数据库内部引爆一个受控的、由人工智能主导的奇点，这样的消息应该能够吸引他们的注意和怒火。
operation.3001.desc.mat.singu.en: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$ A [root.target.GetAdj] threat of sparking a controlled, AI-driven singularity within the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] datasphere ought to draw their attention and ire.

operation.3001.desc.mat.theft.zh: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$我们可以放出高可信度的谣言，造谣有人密谋窃取他们的科技，这应该有利于我们的目标。
operation.3001.desc.mat.theft.en: $operation.3001.desc.mat.intro$ Credible rumors of a plot to outright steal their technology should serve us well in this goal.

operation.3001.desc.milit.armsd.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$我们可以提供不容辩驳的证词，证明[root.target.GetName]明明知道武器有瑕疵，却依然睁一只眼闭一只眼将武器给他们的星系邻居，即[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]。
operation.3001.desc.milit.armsd.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ We shall supply incontrovertible evidence that the [root.target.GetName] are selling cleverly-disguised, defective weaponry to their esteemed galactic neighbors, the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName].

operation.3001.desc.milit.pacif.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$放出有关[root.target.GetAdj]在技术上获得突破的谣言，这项技术能够强制平定像[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]这样的邻国，比如说……
operation.3001.desc.milit.pacif.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ Rumors of a breakthrough in [root.target.GetAdj] technology which would forcibly pacify neighbors like the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], for example...

operation.3001.desc.milit.priso.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$[root.target.GetName]应当因为关押[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的战犯并意图教化他们而受到控告，例如……
operation.3001.desc.milit.priso.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ Should the [root.target.GetName] be accused of withholding [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] prisoners of war with the intention of indoctrinating them, for example...

operation.3001.desc.milit.satir.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$我们刺激他们的自尊心，暗示[root.target.GetName]用对战[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的场景来训练他们最年轻的新兵，以此来帮新兵建立能打胜仗的信心。
operation.3001.desc.milit.satir.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ We will appeal to their sense of pride, suggesting that the [root.target.GetName] train only their youngest cadets on combat scenarios against the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], as a means of easily building their confidence.

operation.3001.desc.milit.study.zh: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$我们可以暗示[root.target.GetAdj]之所以对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]感兴趣是为了研究其军事机密，并且一旦他们暴露出任何弱点，对方便可能会发动战争。
operation.3001.desc.milit.study.en: $operation.3001.desc.milit.intro$ We can suggest that [root.target.GetAdj] interests in the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] are solely motivated by studying their military secrets, and that they might go as far as instigating war to test any weaknesses they've exposed.

operation.3001.desc.pacif.border.zh: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$我们会给出证据，某些忠于[root.target.GetName]的深潜派系，正想法设法在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]国境的周边制造边境冲突。
operation.3001.desc.pacif.border.en: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$ We will concoct evidence that sleeper factions, loyal to the [root.target.GetName], are poised to spark border skirmishes around [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] space.

operation.3001.desc.pacif.gunrun.zh: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$举个例子：[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权可能不会乐意听到[root.target.GetAdj]在他们国内贩卖枪火并以此获利。
operation.3001.desc.pacif.gunrun.en: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$ For example: the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] administration will not enjoy hearing that the [root.target.GetAdj] have profited off a gun-running operation through their space.

operation.3001.desc.pacif.vassal.zh: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$我们知道有一个[root.target.GetAdj]运营的、旨在破坏[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]和其派系内部的卫星国之间关系的项目，这样的消息肯定能让人愤怒。
operation.3001.desc.pacif.vassal.en: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$ News of a [root.target.GetAdj]-run program to arm breakaway factions inside client states of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] is bound to cause outrage.

operation.3001.desc.pacif.weapon.zh: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$我们会播种相当可信的恐惧，宣扬[root.target.GetName]正在研发一款武器，能够让[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetName]的人口变得极具暴力、有破坏性。
operation.3001.desc.pacif.weapon.en: $operation.3001.desc.pacif.intro$ We will seed credible fears that the [root.target.GetName] is working on a weapon capable of making [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetName] populations turn savagely violent.

operation.3001.desc.phile.commerc.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$同[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的贸易协定有价格修正方面的谣言应该可以引起他们的注意，动摇他们同[root.target.GetName]建立关系的信心。
operation.3001.desc.phile.commerc.en: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$ Rumors of price-fixing on trade deals with [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] ought to get their attention, shaking confidence in their relationship with the [root.target.GetName].

operation.3001.desc.phile.contact.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$我们会潜移默化地暗示，[root.target.GetName]一直在散步虚假的谣言，要是说到他们第一次加入星系的大家庭的话，他们还暗中破坏了同[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的第一次接触。
operation.3001.desc.phile.contact.en: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$ We will plant suggestions that the [root.target.GetName] have been spreading false rumors and otherwise sabotaging attempts by the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] to engage in first contact, back to when since they first joined the galactic stage.

operation.3001.desc.phile.motives.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$我们会散播有关[root.target.GetName]的黑暗谣言，指出他们利益背后的最终动机是希望把[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]变为盘中餐……
operation.3001.desc.phile.motives.en: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$ We will cast dark rumors upon the [root.target.GetName], hinting that ulterior motives lie behind their interest in the accommodating [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]...

operation.3001.desc.phile.slavery.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$伪造消息称[root.target.GetName]专门出售[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的奴隶，这应该可以激起愤慨。
operation.3001.desc.phile.slavery.en: $operation.3001.desc.phile.intro$ Fabricated news that [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] slaves are being specifically sought out by the [root.target.GetName] is bound to cause offense.

operation.3001.desc.phobe.abduc.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phobe.intro$我们会播种这样一个想法，[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋绑架[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的公民，并教化他们接受一个更加开放的宇宙。
operation.3001.desc.phobe.abduc.en: $operation.3001.desc.phobe.intro$ We will seed ideas about a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to abduct [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] citizens and indoctrinate them into accepting a more open galaxy.

operation.3001.desc.phobe.genes.zh: $operation.3001.desc.phobe.intro$比如说：如果[root.target.GetName]被抓到正在售卖基于[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]生物学的基因疗法，他们一定会暴跳如雷。
operation.3001.desc.phobe.genes.en: $operation.3001.desc.phobe.intro$ For example: were the [root.target.GetName] to be caught selling gene therapies based on [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] biology, they are bound to take umbrage.

operation.3001.desc.spirit.deity.zh: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$我们会伪造一场[root.target.GetAdj]运动，目标直指那些[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]内非祭司阶层的人。要想扰乱宗教教团的政治，就得攻击那些负责运作的人。
operation.3001.desc.spirit.deity.en: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$ We will fabricate a [root.target.GetAdj] campaign targeting those outside of the priest caste in the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. An attempt to disrupt the politics of their religious order is bound to offend those who run it.

operation.3001.desc.spirit.merch.zh: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$如果他们被抓到兜售廉价、渎神的圣像，而[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]恰好将视其为神明，那么……
operation.3001.desc.spirit.merch.en: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$ If they were seen to be peddling cheap and blasphemous idols from whatever the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] hold most sacred, for example...

operation.3001.desc.spirit.ridic.zh: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$我们会放出可信度很高的谣言，[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的宗教仪式习俗在[root.target.GetAdj]的政治圈内部已经成为了公开的笑料。
operation.3001.desc.spirit.ridic.en: $operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$ We will spread credible rumors that [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] ritual practices are the subject of open ridicule in [root.target.GetAdj] political circles.

operation.3002.desc.zh: 我们的特工已经准备好要把有关[root.target.GetName]的坏消息传递给[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]。我们已经做了一切努力，以确保这些错误信息的可信度，并防止从它追踪到我们。
operation.3002.desc.en: Our operatives are ready to deliver damning news about the [root.target.GetName] to the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. We have done all we can to ensure the fidelity of this misinformation - and to keep it from being traced back to us.

operation.3005.desc.espionage.zh:
$operation.3005.desc.intro$

我方特工捏造了一份证据，指明[from.target.GetName]负有针对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]谍报活动的责任。我们应当拭目以待，看他们对于这样一个政治上造成伤害的宣言有何表示。
operation.3005.desc.espionage.en:
$operation.3005.desc.intro$

Our operatives have fabricated evidence that the [from.target.GetName] are guilty of espionage against the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. We shall see how they respond to such a politically damaging allegation.

operation.3005.desc.gestalt.zh: $operation.3005.desc.intro$任何宣称要操纵他们的格式塔意识的企图都会引起反感。我们的特工会动用手段，确保这样的膈应能持续更久一些。
operation.3005.desc.gestalt.en: $operation.3005.desc.intro$ Any such allegation of attempting to manipulate their gestalt consciousness is bound to cause upset. Our operatives have worked to ensure the sting will be felt for some time yet.

operation.3005.desc.insult.zh: $operation.3005.desc.intro$对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的侮辱显然让双方的关系紧张了起来，他们对[from.target.GetName]抱有的任何不信任感也进一步恶化。
operation.3005.desc.insult.en: $operation.3005.desc.intro$ This insult to the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] is sure to strain their relationship, and worsen any distrust they may already hold for the [from.target.GetName].

operation.3005.desc.trust.zh: $operation.3005.desc.intro$我们负责这方面的特工将会动用手段确保，位于[from.target.GetName]的人如果想要重新赢得任何方面的信任，一定会遇到重重困难。
operation.3005.desc.trust.en: $operation.3005.desc.intro$ Our operatives have worked to ensure those in the [from.target.GetName] will have a hard time regaining any trust they might have earned.

operation.3010.a.zh: 独自行动。我们将会保留这出戏给自己。
operation.3010.a.en: Play along. We'll keep this deception to ourselves.

operation.3010.desc.zh:
$operation.3010.desc.intro$我们的加密协议最近发现了一个与我们[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]邻居有关的，“匿名”通讯。这一奇特的通讯使我们认为他们在密谋针对我们的侵略和秘密行动。

$operation.3010.desc.outro$
operation.3010.desc.en:
$operation.3010.desc.intro$ Our Encryption protocols have flagged a recent, 'anonymous' communication about our [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] neighbors, designed to have us believe they were plotting aggressive and covert actions against us.

$operation.3010.desc.outro$

operation.3010.favortooltip.zh: [smear_campaign_target.GetName]或许会选择以政治上的支持来回报我们。
operation.3010.favortooltip.en: The [smear_campaign_target.GetName] may choose to reward us with political Favors.

operation.3011.desc.zh:
$operation.3010.desc.intro$我们在加密工作中已经标记了一系列奇怪且难以溯源的信息。这中间包含了一堆诽谤我们的黑材料，据说是我们的[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]邻居写的——但经过核对确认之后，我们发现这实际上是第三方精心伪造的。

$operation.3010.desc.outro$
operation.3011.desc.en:
$operation.3010.desc.intro$ Our Encryption protocols have flagged a series of strange and almost-anonymous messages. They comprise a dossier of slander against us, supposedly authored by our [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] neighbors - but the assertions are, in fact, elaborate fakes.

$operation.3010.desc.outro$

operation.3012.desc.zh:
$operation.3010.desc.intro$我们仔细审查了近来一条源头“不明”的信息，该信息意图揭露一项[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]针对我们的阴谋的细节——该阴谋事实上是完全凭空捏造的。我们的加密协议已经被证明是十分有效的，并揭露了一个[from.GetAdj]的阴谋。

$operation.3010.desc.outro$
operation.3012.desc.en:
$operation.3010.desc.intro$ We scrutinized a recent communication from an 'anonymous' source, whose intent was to expose an elaborate [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] scheme against us - only it is, in fact, a complete fabrication. Our Encryption protocols have proven resilient, and reveal a [from.GetAdj] plot beneath.

$operation.3010.desc.outro$

operation.3020.desc.deception.zh:
[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]向我们提交了一份档案，揭露了一个精心策划的阴谋，有人企图在我们两个帝国之间制造裂痕。[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]很有可能就是罪魁祸首。

$operation.3020.desc.outro$
operation.3020.desc.deception.en:
The [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] has delivered a dossier to us, exposing an elaborate plot which was intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. The [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] are named as its would-be perpetrators.

$operation.3020.desc.outro$

operation.3020.desc.espionage.zh:
[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]向我们提交了一份档案，在其中详尽阐述了复杂的间谍指控，意在挑拨离间。似乎[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]希望在我们之间散布不信任。

$operation.3020.desc.outro$
operation.3020.desc.espionage.en:
The [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] have delivered a dossier to us, detailing complex allegations of espionage which were intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. It seems the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] wish to sow distrust between us.

$operation.3020.desc.outro$

operation.3020.desc.insult.zh:
[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]向我们提交了一份措辞巧妙的档案，提及[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]，声称其意图对我们不利。若这份[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]文件可信，则说明[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]意图以我们的名义散布谣言以破坏我们与[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的关系。

$operation.3020.desc.outro$
operation.3020.desc.insult.en:
The [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] have approached us with a delicately-worded dossier on the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName], who seem to wish us ill. If the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] files are to be believed, the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] intended to damage any relationship between us and the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] by seeding slanderous lies in our name.

$operation.3020.desc.outro$

operation.4000.desc.zh: $role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组。所有人员都将作为独狼参与其中，并已经做好了单程票的准备。他们现在只等一个目标-一个值得将其引向[target.GetName]重大灾难。
operation.4000.desc.en: $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw towards the [target.GetName].

operation.4000.desc.error.zh: $role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]这次报告道，没有危机级别威胁被这样一次行动引诱到。[spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]所召集到的特工将保持待命，直到我们对这个肆虐整个星系的毁灭灾厄有了更进一步的了解。
operation.4000.desc.error.en: $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that at this time, no crisis-level threats are likely to be lured in by such an operation. The operatives [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] assembled will remain on standby until we know more about the catastrophic threats lurking in this galaxy.

operation.4000.desc.single.zh: $role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组，他们将设法把[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]引诱至[target.GetAdj]领土上。预计将全队覆灭。
operation.4000.desc.single.en: $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives who will seek to lure the [crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName] directly into [target.GetAdj] territory. The team is not expected to return.

operation.4001.desc.zh: 我们的研究员与特工们已准备好应对各种任务突发变数，特遣队也已前往[target.GetAdj]与[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]之间的未知区域。
operation.4001.desc.en: Our researchers and operatives have prepared for a wide variety of mission variables, and the task team has departed for an uncharted region of space between [target.GetAdj] territory and the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName].

operation.4002.desc.zh: 我们在[target.GetName]附近的特工们发出了一条单方面通讯：他们已经准备好继续执行任务，一但我们发出指令，他们就将去触怒[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]。
operation.4002.desc.en: Our operatives near the [target.GetName] have sent a one-time communiqué: they are ready to proceed, and will draw the ire of the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName] upon our signal.

operation.4005.desc.contingency.zh:
我们的研究者只能假设我方特工迅速而见机行事的思路奏了效，因为他们成功地引诱了一艘来自$CRISIS_TYPE_CONTINGENCY$威胁的舰队。无论是通过精妙的骇入协议，亦或是通过伪造某种形式的漏洞超载，我们的遥测扫描已经确认[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]之间传来了敌对的信号传输。

无论[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]在这个纷乱的时间点是否还有其他的顾虑：我们的行动保证他们至少又多了一件事可以操碎他们的心。
operation.4005.desc.contingency.en:
Our researchers can only speculate upon the quick and adaptive thinking employed by our operatives when they successfully lured a fleet from the ongoing $CRISIS_TYPE_CONTINGENCY$ threat. Whether by an elaborate protocol hacking or by fabricating some sort of loophole override, our remote scans now confirm a hostile presence in transit between the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName].

Whether or not the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] have other ongoing concerns during these turbulent times: our actions have ensured they shall have at least one more pressing matter to attend to.

operation.4005.desc.graytempest.zh:
吸引这个所谓的灰蛊风暴这样零散的实体的注意力，并不是什么难事。我们的特工成功地通过一个单发的、调制的载波成功地把灰蛊风暴指向了[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]。

构建这个波充满挑战，因为[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都之间距离很长，使得[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]需要前所未有的能量维持。我们的团队采用了在一个远程发射器的电源组中触发一个不可控的连锁反应。该装置保持在一起的时间刚好足以将我们的诱饵传送到超空间。

长距离遥测显示纳米虫群正向着[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]前进。我们的研究人员还注意到在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]附近发生了灾难性爆炸，这应该是我们的那位特工的功劳。
operation.4005.desc.graytempest.en:
Drawing the focused attention of entities as piecemeal as this so-called Gray Tempest was no mean feat. Our operatives succeeded by way of a one-shot, modulating carrier wave pointed squarely in the direction of the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName].

Constructing this wave was a fraught effort, as the distance between the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName] requires an unprecedented amount of energy. Our team resorted to triggering an uncontrollable chain reaction in the power banks of a long-range transmitter. The device held together just long enough to beam our lure across hyperspace.

Long-distance telemetry suggests that a Nanite Swarm is now making its way towards the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]. Our researchers also note readings of a catastrophic explosion in the vicinity of [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] - believed to be the site of our operatives' fatal endeavor.

operation.4005.desc.marauders.zh:
尽管他们最近表现得很团结，[raider_khanate.GetName]最后还是证明了自己只是头脑简单的猎捕者，轻易就被愤怒钓上了钩。我们的小队想方设法激怒了某位指挥官，后者正甚嚣尘上地以超光速杀向[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]。

我们的特工很确信任何倒霉到竖立在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]之间的恒星基地都会作为东道主给这支掠夺者小分队表演一下什么叫做热锅上的蚂蚁。让我们希望这次牺牲没有白费。
operation.4005.desc.marauders.en:
Despite their recent attempts at unity, the [raider_khanate.GetName] have proven an uncomplicated prey to bait in anger. Our team worked hard to antagonize one Commander in particular, whose boiling rage is now being directed at faster-than-light speeds toward the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName].

Our operatives are resolute that any starbase unfortunate enough to lie between the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] will play chaotic host to this small band of marauders. Let us hope this sacrifice is not in vain.

operation.4005.desc.swarm.zh:
我们对$CRISIS_TYPE_PRETHORYN$的生物引擎研究的时间虽然不长，但是被证明十分有效。我们发明了一种合成化合物——生产起来很昂贵，运输起来也很困难——但是能够成功诱使一支舰队偏离虫群。

这种化合物的附着性是如此之强，我方特工的命运现在就和竖在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]之间的恒星基地一样惨烈。一旦我方特工释放这种诱骗性的化合物，他们的命就没了。

相比于四散而逃并搅乱虫群的路线，我们的小队决定花费剩余的时间确保没有留下任何行动的痕迹。[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]很快就会尝到我们的牺牲带来的后果。
operation.4005.desc.swarm.en:
Our research into the biological drives of the $CRISIS_TYPE_PRETHORYN$ was conducted swiftly, but has proven effective. We devised a synthetic compound - expensive to produce, and dangerous to transport - which has succeeded in luring a fleet away from the Swarm.

So adhesive is this compound that the fate of our operatives is now as bleak as that of any starbase which lies between the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]. The moment our operatives released the beguiling chemical, their fate was sealed.

Rather than flee and risk confusing the swarm's route, our team will instead spend what remaining time they have ensuring that the trail remains intact. The [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] will soon experience the results of our sacrifice.

operation.4005.desc.unbidden.zh:
我们对抗$CRISIS_TYPE_UNBIDDEN$的努力终于有了成果，尽管代价十分的惨重。我们的特工成功地诱使一支异次元舰队认为他们在[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]领土腹地的一个次元锚正处于威胁。舰队现在正从[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系向[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]开拔。

$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]会继续监视这一形势，但是看样子我们是没法见到我们的特工活着返回了。我们必须密切关注，并相信我们的诱敌方案有利于我们的计划。
operation.4005.desc.unbidden.en:
Our efforts against the $CRISIS_TYPE_UNBIDDEN$ have paid off, though the cost was certainly steep. Our operatives have successfully duped an extra-dimensional fleet into thinking one of their dimensional anchors is under threat, deep inside [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] territory. Ships are now en route to [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName] from the [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system.

$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will continue to monitor the situation, but it is unlikely we will see our operatives returned to us. We must now watch, and trust that our lure serves our plan.

operation.4010.desc.zh:
我们探测到了来自[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]的敌对信号，正朝着我们的首都[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]笔直地杀过来！奇怪的能量波动从[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]的附近爆发，我们猜测这是他们的源头。

当这个区域的能量信号突然发生变化时，我们才刚刚开始分析这一现象。所有的信号都显示这是舰队移动突然发生了改变。此外，中间至少有一个能量信号看上去不属于[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]。无论他们是谁，看上去正是他们导致了这样的行为。我们怀疑这是我们的某个星系对手搞得祸水东引动作。
operation.4010.desc.en:
We detect a hostile presence from the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName], heading straight for our capital, [crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]! Strange energy waves have burst out from the vicinity of [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName], their assumed origin.

We had just begun the work of analyzing this phenomenon when energy signatures in the region abruptly changed. All signs suggest this means a sudden change of fleet movements. Furthermore, at least one of those energy signatures looks to belong to an empire other than the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]. Whoever they are, they appear to be the cause of this behavior. We suspect this to be provocative action by one of our galactic rivals.

operation.5000.a.tooltip.zh:
暂停[from.GetName]行动，时间为一个月。
我们的成功几率取决于目标的加密等级。
operation.5000.a.tooltip.en:
Pauses Operation [from.GetName] for about a month.
Our chances of success depend on the target's Encryption level.

operation.5000.b.tooltip.zh: 暗地里取消这一行动，所有未花费的线人将不会被消耗。
operation.5000.b.tooltip.en: Silently cancel this operation. Any unspent Assets will not be consumed.

operation.5000.desc.zh:
$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。

按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。
operation.5000.desc.en:
$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the [from.spynetwork.target.GetName]. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.

In accordance with standard procedure, we must now decide whether or not to track down our own operatives.

operation.5001.desc.zh: 我们的努力奏效了——同我方特工的联络恢复了。$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经开始着手审核[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]为了在[fromfrom.target.GetName]经营而布置好的监视流程。
operation.5001.desc.en: Our efforts proved successful - contact with our operatives has been restored. $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is already working to review the monitoring procedures [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] in place for work in the [fromfrom.target.GetName].

operation.5002.desc.zh:
尽管我们已经尽全力，但我们还是没法恢复与我们在[fromfrom.target.GetName]的特工的通讯。$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经下达指令，对我们当地间谍网的监视流程进行一次评估；有可能[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的加密手段比我们估计的还要高明。

于此同时，[fromfrom.GetName]行动将以未达到全力的情况下恢复，直到我们补充了损失的部分。
operation.5002.desc.en:
Despite our best efforts, we cannot restore contact with our operatives in the [fromfrom.target.GetName]. $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has ordered a review of monitoring procedures for our Spy Network there; it is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] have more sophisticated Encryption than we had thought.

Meanwhile, Operation [fromfrom.GetName] will resume at a reduced capacity while we recoup our losses.

operation.5005.a.zh: 这种风险是很平常的。放着吧。

operation.5005.b.en: You shall have your extra resources.

operation.5005.c.zh: 送点礼说不定更有用呢？
operation.5005.c.en: Perhaps bribery would be more effective?

operation.5005.d.zh: 让我们的线人处理这个问题。
operation.5005.d.en: Have our Asset handle this problem.

operation.5005.desc.zh: 尽管已经像训练时那样准备了所有的预防措施，位于[from.target.GetName]的一名我方特工还是提出了对于他们的伪装的担心。特别是在[from.GetName]行动的关键时刻，决不能暴露出来——因此，$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]请求投入更多资源来使得[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]避免未来的意外发生。
operation.5005.desc.en: Despite having taken every precaution prescribed in their training, one of our operatives in the [from.target.GetName] has raised concerns that their cover may be blown. Apparently this comes at a critical time for Operation [from.GetName] - as such, $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requests more resources with which [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] might prevent disruptions further down the line.

operation.5010.a.zh: 我们必须相信纵横之术。

operation.5010.desc.zh:
[from.target.GetName]刚刚注意到了我方存在，并引起了警觉。看上去我们对当地的情报了解不足，我们的特工已经引起了当地[patrol_drone.GetNamePlural]的注意。

这次[from.GetName]行动还是有机会挽回的，但是需要立马对$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]进行援助。
operation.5010.desc.en:
The [from.target.GetName] has just been alerted to our presence. It seems we lacked sufficient intelligence on the local area, and our operatives have earned the attention of local [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural].

Operation [from.GetName] is not truly jeopardized yet, but $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requires speedy assistance.

operation.5011.desc.zh:
$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]和[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的同事们消除了因我们特工入侵[fromfrom.target.GetName]产生的尴尬。

有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。
operation.5011.desc.en:
$role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] and [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] colleagues have smoothed over our operatives' awkward intrusion into the [fromfrom.target.GetName].

It's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] sees our excuses for the pack of lies they are. As far as outward appearances are concerned, however: we are considered to be 'in the clear'.

operation.5011.desc.hive.zh:
我们已经通过外交斡旋解决了我们侵入[fromfrom.target.GetName]所引起的一些外交误会。

有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。
operation.5011.desc.hive.en:
We have successfully negotiated our way out of the diplomatically awkward intrusion into the [fromfrom.target.GetName].

It's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] does not lend any credibility to our excuses at all, but from an outside perspective: we are considered to be 'in the clear' for now.

operation.5015.a.zh: 我们应当尝试并去适应。
operation.5015.a.en: We shall have to try and adapt.

operation.5015.a.tooltip.zh: 我方行动可能成功，也可能遭受挫折，成功率取决于我们的相对科技等级。
operation.5015.a.tooltip.en: We may succeed or suffer operational setbacks, depending somewhat on our relative technology level.

operation.5015.b.zh: 让他们自己的硬件转而对付他们。
operation.5015.b.en: Turn their own hardware against them.

operation.5015.desc.zh: 当特工在稳步进入[from.target.GetName]更加戒备森严的区域时，我们失去了与其的联系。我们搞不好会全部交代在这里。这样的信号中断可能是马虎的[from.target.GetAdj]启动了屏蔽科技，隔断了我们的噪声干涉。
operation.5015.desc.en: We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the [from.target.GetName]. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding technology putting out noisy interference.

operation.5016.desc.zh:
我们失去了指派给对于[fromfrom.target.GetName]的[fromfrom.GetName]行动中所有人员的联系。无论是被我们的目标算计，还是单纯遇到了不幸的巧合，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的屏蔽科技都是一个相当棘手的对手。

[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]在这场事件中存在获得收益的可能性。尽管我们的特工[GetOperativesLowerPlural]能够做到半自主，但是没有了我们的出面引导，这些子个体可能会更加容易落到敌人手中。
operation.5016.desc.en:
We have lost all contact with our operatives assigned to Operation [fromfrom.GetName] in the [fromfrom.target.GetName]. Whether by our target's cunning design, or simply an unlucky coincidence for us, [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] shielding technology has proven a worthy adversary us.

It is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] may gain from this incident. Although our [GetOperativesLowerPlural] may operate semi-autonomously, without our presence they are still far more vulnerable to enemy capture.

operation.5020.b.zh: 继续行动！我们会适应这个，然后生存下去。
operation.5020.b.en: Keep moving! We adapt and survive.

operation.5020.desc.zh: [from.target.GetName]的一个主脑错误地把我们的特工认定为食物，现在正热情洋溢地在狩猎它们。这种特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesName][from.target.GetIndividualName]似乎会本能地会把除自己以外的任何个体当作潜在的营养来源。
operation.5020.desc.en: A primal aspect of the [from.target.GetName] entity has mistaken our operatives for food, and is now fixated upon hunting them. This particular [from.target.GetSpeciesName] [from.target.GetIndividualName] seems to instinctively regard anything other than itself as a source of potential nutrition.

operation.5025.b.zh: 我们必须尽快继续行动。

operation.5025.b.tooltip.zh: 存在一定风险，使在[toxic_field_country.GetName]开展的所有特工行动在一段时间内变得更加困难，直到我们成功开发了抗体。
operation.5025.b.tooltip.en: There is a risk that all Operations conducted in the [toxic_field_country.GetName] may become more difficult for a time, until we can develop antibodies.

operation.5025.desc.zh: [from.target.GetName]的生存环境似乎对我们派遣到[from.GetName]行动中的[GetIndividualNamePlural]有轻微的毒性。$operation.5025.close$
operation.5025.desc.en: Something about the [from.target.GetName] living environment appears mildly toxic to the [GetIndividualNamePlural] assigned to Operation [from.GetName]. $operation.5025.close$

operation.5025.desc.repeat.zh: [from.target.GetName]的生存环境发生了微妙的改变，这再次对我们产生了轻微的毒性。$operation.5025.close$
operation.5025.desc.repeat.en: There has been a subtle change within the [from.target.GetName] living environment, which has once again become mildly toxic to us. $operation.5025.close$

operation.5026.desc.zh: 我们研究人员的努力有了成果，治疗特效药被分发给了我们的子个体特工。[toxic_field_country.GetName]居住地发现的那种低浓度毒素应该不会再给我们的[event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName]行动造成困扰了。
operation.5026.desc.en: Our research efforts have paid off, and remedies are being distributed to our drone operatives. The low-level toxins found in [toxic_field_country.GetName] habitats should no longer present any issues, and Operation [event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName] may continue.

operation.5027.desc.zh: 我们在[toxic_field_country.GetName]的机会之窗已经关闭了！我们的子个体已经难以承受环境的影响。[fromfromfrom.GetName]行动会继续，但我们必须小心行事以避免我们的特工被怀疑。
operation.5027.desc.en: Our window of opportunity inside the [toxic_field_country.GetName] has closed, leaving our operative drones visibly affected by their environment. Operation [fromfromfrom.GetName] may continue, but we must work carefully lest our allergies arouse suspicion.

operation.5030.b.tooltip.zh: 存在一定风险，使在[excess_noise_country.GetName]开展的所有特工行动在一段时间内变得更加困难，直到我们的硬件产生了适应性。
operation.5030.b.tooltip.en: There is a risk that all Operations conducted in the [excess_noise_country.GetName] may become more difficult for a time, until we can adapt our hardware.

operation.5030.desc.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境充满了静电噪声——比我们预测的要多得多。$operation.5030.close$
operation.5030.desc.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with electrostatic noise - far more than we had anticipated. $operation.5030.close$

operation.5030.desc.repeat.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境再一次充满了静电噪声，我们对这样的频率尚且不能适应。$operation.5030.close$
operation.5030.desc.repeat.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has once again become riddled with electrostatic noise, in frequencies we are not yet accustomed to. $operation.5030.close$

operation.5031.desc.zh: 我们的研究努力取得了回报，新的电磁屏蔽护盾参数已经分发到了我们位于[excess_noise_country.GetName]的间谍网中。我们[fromfromfrom.GetName]行动的工作将不会在遇到阻碍。
operation.5031.desc.en: Our research efforts have paid off, and specifications for new shielding against electromagnetic interference are being distributed throughout our operative network in the [excess_noise_country.GetName]. Our efforts on Operation [fromfromfrom.GetName] should no longer be hindered by excess static.

operation.5032.desc.zh: 在[excess_noise_country.GetName]上的电磁杂波已经导致了我们的一些特工的不可逆转的数据损失。[event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName]行动或许可以继续，但我们的工作将被拖延——需要相当的工作量来保证我们的数据可信。
operation.5032.desc.en: Electrostatic noise in the [excess_noise_country.GetName] has now caused irreparable data loss amongst some of our drones. Operation [event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName] may continue, but our efforts are being hindered - such is the scale of backlogged demands upon our data validation processes.

operation.5035.a.tooltip.zh:
暂停[from.GetName]行动，持续时间一个月。

我们的行动有低到中的几率不会被注意到。被发现几率取决于$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$。

$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_THEMED_ASSET$
operation.5035.a.tooltip.en:
Pauses Operation [from.GetName] for about a month.

There is a medium-to-low chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on our target's $MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$.

$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_THEMED_ASSET$

operation.5035.b.tooltip.zh:
取消[from.GetName]行动。

我们的行动有高几率不会被注意到。被发现几率取决于$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$。

$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_CATEGORY_ASSET$
operation.5035.b.tooltip.en:
Cancels Operation [from.GetName].

There is a high chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on the target's $MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$.

$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_CHANCE_CATEGORY_ASSET$

operation.5035.desc.zh:
$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们位于[snuffedout_country.GetName]附近的特工小队已经错过了几个检查点。考虑到这次行动的性质，我们预料到他们不能维持频繁的联系。然而，虽然感到遗憾，我们的$role_spymaster$坚信这支小队是失踪了。

如果我们能够成功地掩盖痕迹，[from.GetName]行动可能被挽救。我们得发挥我们的$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$对抗[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]的$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$的优势。
operation.5035.desc.en:
$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our team of operatives near the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has missed a number of checkpoints. Given the nature of this operation, we had already anticipated them being unable to maintain frequent contact. However, our $role_spymaster$ is regrettably confident that by now, the team has been lost.

Operation [from.GetName] may be rescued if we can successfully cover our tracks, pitting our $MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$ against [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] $MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$.

operation.5036.desc.zh:
尽管耗费了大量人力物力，消耗了许多$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在[snuffedout_country.GetName]积累的成果，我们终于确保了行动的安全性。所有松动的口子都被堵上；所有掩护身份都被抛弃掉。一支全新的特工队伍将替代原来的人员，在我们的$role_spymaster$亲自注视下执行着完全不同指令。

与此同时，[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]依然没有注意到我方的存在。
operation.5036.desc.en:
Though it has greatly taxed the resources of $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s work in the [snuffedout_country.GetName], operational security has been reasserted. All loose ends have been covered; all cover identities discarded. A new team of operatives will take over from here, enacting a subtly different set of orders under our $role_spymaster$'s watchful gaze.

The [snuffedout_country.GetAdj], meanwhile, still seem oblivious to our presence.

operation.5037.desc.zh:
我们最担心的事情成了真：我们最近在[snuffedout_country.GetName]失去的特工曝光了我们大部分[fromfrom.GetName]行动的细节。

我们的全部间谍网都经过了妥善安排，确保在正常情况下，只有极其不周密的证据才会追溯到我们执行的隐秘行动。然而，在当下的情况，我们完全无法确认何种情报已经泄露；也没法知道[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]打算如何进行回应。
operation.5037.desc.en:
Our worst fears have come to pass: the recent loss of our operatives in the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has exposed large parts of Operation [fromfrom.GetName].

All our Spy Networks are carefully arranged so that under normal circumstances, only very flimsy evidence could ever implicate us in the covert activities we carry out. However, in this instance we cannot be entirely sure what Intel may have been given away; nor can we know how the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] might choose to respond.

operation.5037.desc.provocation.zh:
我们最近在[snuffedout_country.GetName]损失的特工酿成了严重的后果：我方的整个行动被暴露了。

我们的间谍网处于妥善管理的状态，保证正常情况下，能够为我方特工提供一定的匿名性。然而，在当下的情况，我方的任何行动都会导致严重后果，因为各类证据会导向我们，而[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]绝不会对此坐视不管。我们不知道他们会如何回应，得我们应该做好最坏的打算。
operation.5037.desc.provocation.en:
The recent loss of our operatives in the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has had some dire consequences: our entire operation has been exposed.

Our Spy Networks are carefully managed so that under normal circumstances, they afford us some level of deniability. However, on this occasion our actions were serious enough that the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] are unlikely to ignore even circumstantial evidence which may lead back to us. We do not know precisely how they will respond, but we should prepare for the worst.

operation.5040.a.zh: 是可忍孰不可忍，给予其强烈斥责。
operation.5040.a.en: This cannot be tolerated. Issue reprimands.

operation.5040.c.zh: 我们可以化腐朽为神奇。
operation.5040.c.en: This could give us an interesting edge.

operation.5040.c.fail.commerce.zh: 只有在与[from.target.GetName]签订商业协定后我们才能利用这个机会。
operation.5040.c.fail.commerce.en: Such an opportunity can only be exploited if we have a Commercial Pact with the [from.target.GetName].

operation.5040.c.fail.stacking.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$我们同一时间内只能开办一家这样的秘密企业。
operation.5040.c.fail.stacking.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$We can only run one such secret enterprise at a time.

operation.5040.desc.zh:
最近$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在察觉到[from.target.GetName]上的特工表现失常后对[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]发起了一场调查。

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap][from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave]这才发现这些特工对用于情报搜集与贿赂的资源雁过拔毛。他们将这些物资与货币投资到了[from.target.GetAdj]上的生意场上以损公肥私。因此，他们的追求与忠诚背道而驰。

在$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]重整部门风气前，有关行动[from.GetName]的一切项目均被暂时搁置。
operation.5040.desc.en:
$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the [from.target.GetName], after noticing a recent drop in their performance.

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] discovered these operatives skimming from resources allocated to intelligence-gathering and bribes. These goods and currencies are being re-invested elsewhere in [from.target.GetAdj] business concerns, earning the operatives a comfortable profit at our expense. As a result, their attention and loyalties have clearly become divided.

Progress on Operation [from.GetName] has been put on hold for the moment, until $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] can re-assert operational efficiency.

operation.5041.desc.zh: 我们位于[fromfrom.target.GetName]上的特工不再使用我们间谍网的资源。对效忠对象的坚定提醒，重新激发了特工们的奉献精神；他们将把他们的聪明才智完全用于我们的事业。
operation.5041.desc.en: Our operatives in the [fromfrom.target.GetName] are no longer skimming resources from our Spy Network allocation. Firm reminders of just where their loyalties lie have reinvigorated the operatives' sense of dedication; they will turn their resourceful talents wholly to our cause.

operation.5042.desc.zh:
$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]遗憾的报告：我们失去了[fromfrom.target.GetName]上的间谍网。

当我们特工中的一群小偷被要求解释原因时，他们的反应是逃跑——分散到[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的宇域里，那些甚至连我们都难以监控的地方。[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]不再能够追踪他们——至少没法在不引发注意的情况下找到。
operation.5042.desc.en:
$role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] regretfully reports a breakdown in our [fromfrom.target.GetName] Spy Network.

When a group of thieves amongst our operatives was called to account, their response was to flee - scattering to parts of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] space that even we struggle to monitor. [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is no longer able to track them down - at least not without drawing undue attention.

operation.5045.a.tooltip.zh: 如果[from.target.GetName]在我国建立了间谍网，他们会得到针对他们阴谋的警告。$tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_encryption$
operation.5045.a.tooltip.en: If the [from.target.GetName] have a Spy Network on us, they will be warned of a plot against them. $tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_encryption$

operation.5045.b.tooltip.zh: 如果[from.target.GetName]在我国建立了间谍网，他们有50%几率得到针对他们阴谋的警告。$tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_encryption$
operation.5045.b.tooltip.en: 50% chance that if the [from.target.GetName] have a Spy Network on us, they will be warned of a plot against them. $tooltip_espionage_identify_decryption_encryption$

operation.5045.desc.culture.zh:
$operation.5045.desc.intro$

看上去[root.GetOperativeRole]对于[from.target.GetName]的文化和主体物种生出了同情，而背离了我们。我们的审查机制本来应该排除掉这样的异样，但是这次却失败了。
operation.5045.desc.culture.en:
$operation.5045.desc.intro$

It seems that the [root.GetOperativeRole] has grown more sympathetic towards the culture and founding ethics of the [from.target.GetName], in opposition to our own. Our screening process has failed in that it is supposed to rule out such flakiness.

operation.5045.desc.turned.zh:
$operation.5045.desc.intro$

尽管我们本应当通过审查排除掉组织里的不忠，但[root.GetOperativeRole]还是被“变节”了——或是通过反间谍行动，或是通过培养对[from.target.GetName]的同情意识，而我们之前并没有注意到。
operation.5045.desc.turned.en:
$operation.5045.desc.intro$

Despite the fact we are supposed to be able to screen out such disloyalty, the [root.GetOperativeRole] has been 'turned' - either by act of Counter-Espionage, or some innate sympathy towards [from.target.GetName] which we were unable to detect before.

operation.5050.b.zh: 我们必须抛下他继续前进。

operation.5050.c.tooltip.zh:
取消[from.GetName]行动

我们的行动有高几率不会被注意到，这取决于目标的$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$。

如果我们为该行动分配一位破坏型线人就能确保成功。
operation.5050.c.tooltip.en:
Cancels Operation [from.GetName].

There is a high chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on the target's $MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$.

Success is guaranteed if we have a Sabotage Asset assigned to this Operation.

operation.5050.desc.zh:
$operation.5050.desc.intro$

他身受重伤，但还是勉力完成了任务，而且到目前为止仍未被发现。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们特工呆在他们那疗伤越久就越容易暴露。
operation.5050.desc.en:
$operation.5050.desc.intro$

Their injuries are severe, but our operative managed to complete their task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains in their medical care, the greater the risk our cover will be blown.

operation.5050.desc.hostile.zh:
$operation.5050.desc.intro$

他现在没法跑太远，除非我们在行动接下来的时间中给予除基本支援外的更多援助，这样他才能确保找到一个足够安全的藏身处。然而不久之后这片区域肯定会进行清理式扫荡。我们的特工呆在[from.target.owner.GetAdj]疆域下越久，暴露的危险就越大。
operation.5050.desc.hostile.en:
$operation.5050.desc.intro$

They are currently unable to move far or else lend more than basic support to the rest of the operation, so they have secured a reasonably safe hideout. There is, however, bound to be a maintenance sweep of the area before long. The longer our operative remains in [from.target.owner.GetAdj] care, the greater the risk of exposure.

operation.5050.desc.machine.zh:
$operation.5050.desc.intro$

无人机遭受严重的损害，但依旧完成了任务并保持隐蔽状态。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们的特工在对方的监察下越久，暴露的危险就越大。
operation.5050.desc.machine.en:
$operation.5050.desc.intro$

The drone has sustained serious damage, but has completed its task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains under their supervision, the greater the risk of exposure.

operation.5055.a.en: The risks are too great; cut them loose.

operation.5055.b.zh: 那就让我们看看这些“洞察力”会带来什么吧。
operation.5055.b.en: Let us see where these 'insights' may lead.

operation.5055.desc.gestalt.zh:
一组位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工在执行分配给它们的任务时进度开始滞后，并做出一些能被解析为怀疑的行动。我们通常直接命令$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]来解决此事，但这些特工表现得它们似乎能察觉到行动[from.GetName]中所埋藏的阴谋，也许还有整个间谍网也在它们的知情范围内。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们更为活跃的代理个体保持隔离，我们怀疑有外部势力在向它们灌输信息。然而，如果可能的话，它们与自主代理个体的趋同或许能够赋予它们自己一种我们今后有机会将其利用到的洞察力。

$operation.5055.desc.outro$
operation.5055.desc.gestalt.en:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] has begun lagging in their assigned tasks, displaying behavior which could be interpreted as doubt. We would typically handle such matters directly through $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName], but this group acts as though it can perceive the wider machinations of Operation [from.GetName], and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active agents, we suspect they are being fed information from an outside source. It is, however, also possible that their proximity to independent agents may simply have endowed these operatives with the kind of insight we may one day find useful.

$operation.5055.desc.outro$

operation.5055.desc.regular.zh:
一队位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工开始回避分配给他们的任务，并声称他们对目标总体而言缺乏信心。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]通常会在不引起我们注意的情况下就处理好这些事情，但其实他自己并没有深入了解其中的细节：这些特工似乎对于[from.GetName]行动甚至是整个间谍网都过分了解。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们那些更活跃的知情代理人保持着一定距离，[operation.leader.GetName]怀疑这些特工很有可能是从外界获取的信息。但[operation.leader.GetHeSheCap]同样也承认可能只是他们的洞察力过分敏锐罢了。

$operation.5055.desc.outro$
operation.5055.desc.regular.en:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing them to our attention, but even without them knowing any details: these operatives seem unusually well-informed about Operation [from.GetName], and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active and better-informed agents, [operation.leader.GetName] suspects the operatives are being fed information from an outside source. [operation.leader.GetHeSheCap] also concede[operation.leader.GetSXX] that they may simply be highly perceptive individuals.

$operation.5055.desc.outro$

operation.5056.desc.zh: 我们位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工们在发现自己从前难以形容的怀疑并不是无中生有后，便以加倍的热情投入进工作中。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]仍然对他们维持了严格的信息屏蔽，但报告称[operation.leader.GetHisHer]的运作变得前所未有的流畅。
operation.5056.desc.en: Our auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] have applied themselves with unusual fervor upon learning that their once-intangible suspicions were founded in a real cause after all. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] maintains a strict information quarantine, but reports that [operation.leader.GetHisHer] supply lines have never been smoother.

operation.5057.desc.zh: 在得知此前难以形容的怀疑并非无中生有后，我们位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工表现得惊惧起来。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]仅仅只是向他们透露了些许关于全局的信息，就足以打乱行动的运作。现在我们破坏[target_country.GetAdj]$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$的能力将在接下来的一段时间内下降。
operation.5057.desc.en: Our auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] have reacted with horror upon learning the truth of their once-intangible suspicions. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] revealed only a glimpse of the bigger picture to them, but it was sufficient to disrupt our supply lines. Our ability to subvert [target_country.GetAdj] $MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$ is reduced for a time.

operation.6000.1.desc.zh: 我们的情报分析师将潜在目标的表单合并到一块之后，我们的独行特工开始渗透[target.GetName]。
operation.6000.1.desc.en: As our intelligence analysts put together lists of potential targets, individual operatives are beginning to infiltrate the [target.GetName].

operation.6000.2.desc.zh: 我们的特工现在正在渗透[target.GetName]，但是他们必须额外小心，以免引起帝国安全总局的注意。我们的情报分析师已经把潜在目标的表单合并到了一起。
operation.6000.2.desc.en: Our operatives are now infiltrating the [target.GetName], but great care must be taken to avoid drawing the attention of the Imperial Security Directorate. A list of potential targets is being put together by our intelligence analysts.

operation.6005.desc.zh: 成功在[target.GetName]内部建立起联络之后，我们的特工现在开始建立起自己的掩护身份。目标列表现在已经缩小到十几个显要的候选人。
operation.6005.desc.en: After successfully linking up inside the [target.GetName], our operatives are now working to establish their cover identities. The target list has been narrowed down to a dozen promising candidates.

operation.6010.1.desc.zh: 我们已经定位了一名位于[target.Capital.GetName]上的帝国显贵，其名为[operation_target.GetName]，其职权虽然不大但是对于维系帝国对星系的控制力至关重要。如果我们能抹除这名目标，那么我们就能充分地昭告，对[target.GetRulerTitle]阿谀奉承之辈永远别想安全无虞。
operation.6010.1.desc.en: We have identified an Imperial dignitary on [target.Capital.GetName] by the name of [operation_target.GetName] that serves a small but critical role in maintaining the Imperium's yoke on the galaxy. Eliminating this target would amply demonstrate that no lackey of the [target.GetRulerTitle] is safe.

operation.6010.2.desc.zh: 我们已经定位了一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的自律[target.GetIndividualName]，其功能是维系[target.GetRulerTitle]和其帝国属民之间的联系。若能对这个[target.GetIndividualName]进行抹杀，那将是我们对抗星海帝国取得的微小却又至关重要的胜利。
operation.6010.2.desc.en: We have identified an autonomous [target.GetIndividualName] on [target.Capital.GetName] that functions as a liaison between the [target.GetRulerTitle] and its Imperial subjects. The elimination of this [target.GetIndividualName] would be a small but important victory in the fight against the Galactic Imperium's tyranny.

operation.6010.3.desc.zh: 这是一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的自律无人机，其功能是维系[target.GetRulerTitle]和其帝国属民之间的连结能力。使这个无人机永久地离线能够打击帝国的内部联络——至少是在替代无人机被编程之前。
operation.6010.3.desc.en: There is an autonomous drone on [target.Capital.GetName] that operates in a liaison capacity between the [target.GetRulerTitle] and its Imperial subjects. Permanently offlining this drone would hamper the Imperium's internal communication - at least until a replacement is programmed.

operation.6010.4.desc.zh: [operation_target.GetName]，一名帝国安全总局的[agent_origin.GetSpeciesName]特工，对于[operation_target.GetHerHis]的工作有着不同寻常的热枕。[operation_target.GetSheHeCap]亲自负责逮捕了数百名“异见分子”——其中的几名为我们工作。时机已经到了，这名帝安局特工的光辉前程应该戛然而止，并一劳永逸地彻底终止。
operation.6010.4.desc.en: [operation_target.GetName], a [agent_origin.GetSpeciesName] agent of the Imperial Security Directorate, is particularly apt at [operation_target.GetHerHis] job. [operation_target.GetSheHeCap] [operation_target.GetIsAre] personally responsible for the arrest of hundreds of "dissidents" - several of whom were working for us. It is time for this ISD agent's illustrious career to come to a premature and very permanent end.

operation.6010.5.desc.zh:
帝国海军是[target.GetRulerTitle]的利剑，长悬于帝国成员国的头顶之上，随时准备着以迅雷不及掩耳之势将任何叛乱的苗头抹杀。

我们已经定位了一名特别的舰队情报军官，一名[agent_origin.GetSpeciesName]人，名字为[operation_target.GetName]，此人负责多项反骚乱行动。这名军官的暴毙将对对方造成重创。
operation.6010.5.desc.en:
The Imperial Armada is the sword of the [target.GetRulerTitle], constantly hovering over the heads of Imperium's members and ready to come thundering down at the slightest sign of rebellion.

We have identified a particular Armada intelligence officer, a [agent_origin.GetSpeciesName] by the name of [operation_target.GetName], who oversees many of their anti-insurgency operations. The demise of this officer is long overdue.

operation.6010.6.desc.zh: 在[target.Capital.GetName]有一座[target.GetRulerTitle]的特别纪念碑，其安全出现了可乘之机。如果我们可以摧毁这座纪念碑，那我们就能向全星系昭示，反叛运动甚至有能力直击帝国的心脏地段。
operation.6010.6.desc.en: Security is lax around a particular monument of the [target.GetRulerTitle] on [target.Capital.GetName]. Destroying this monument will prove to the galaxy that the rebel movement can strike even at the very heart of the Imperium.

operation.6010.7.desc.zh: 我们的特工想方设法获得了进入下水道网络的权限，能够通往帝国安全总局在当地的办事处。只要炸药管够，我们就能够把这栋帝安局的建筑还有里面的工作人员一口气送上天。
operation.6010.7.desc.en: Our operatives have managed to secure access to a network of underground sewage tunnels running underneath a local branch office of the Imperial Security Directorate. With enough explosives, it should be possible to bring down the entire ISD building along with any agents inside it.

operation.6010.8.desc.zh:
帝国海军在整个星海帝国各处的行星上设立了征募中心。在各个征兵处，征兵官正忙着将来自各个成员国的愣头青登记成大兵。这些傻大个马上就会被灌满谎言，还要发誓效忠[target.GetRulerTitle]。

摧毁一个这样的征募中心将向各界发送一个强烈的讯息，那就是背叛自己的种族，同帝国沆瀣一气，其代价将会十分沉重。
operation.6010.8.desc.en:
The Imperial Armada has established recruitment centers on planets across the Galactic Imperium. At these sites, their recruiters fill the Armada's ranks with the gullible youth of the Imperium's numerous member states. These naive fools are then fed lies and conditioned to obey the [target.GetRulerTitle].

Destroying one of these centers would send a powerful message that betraying your own kind and siding with the Imperium carries a steep price.

operation.6010.9.desc.zh: 我们已经定位了一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的亚空间传输器，帝国使用这个东西向整个星海帝国展开宣传攻势。如果我们的特工能够从源头改变传输信号，哪怕仅仅只是一会，我们就能够通过官方的帝国亚空间输送载体传送我们自己的宣传材料。
operation.6010.9.desc.en: We have located a Subspace Transmitter on [target.Capital.GetName] that is used to transmit Imperial propaganda across the Galactic Imperium. If our operatives can divert these transmissions at the source, even for a brief moment, we could transmit our own material on the official Imperial subspace carrier wave.

operation.6015.1.desc.zh: 在等待数日之后，狙击小队的一名特工逮到了一个完美时机，在极远的距离一击穿透[operation_target.GetName]办公室的窗户将[operation_target.GetHerHis]射杀。在任何人注意到目标死亡之前，小队就拆卸了步枪，并有条不紊地转移到了撤离点。
operation.6015.1.desc.en: After waiting several days for the right moment, one of our sniper teams eliminated [operation_target.GetName] at extreme range by firing through the window of [operation_target.GetHerHis] office. The team then dismantled their rifle and were well on their way to the extraction point before anyone had even noticed the target was down.

operation.6015.10.desc.zh: 在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的恶搞版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以[target.GetGovernmentName]揭发了一个缇扬奇企图颠覆帝国的阴谋结束。
operation.6015.10.desc.en: After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators and it concludes with the [target.GetGovernmentName] announcing its discovery of a massive Tiyanki plot to overthrow the Imperium.

operation.6015.11.desc.zh: 在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的鬼畜版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以机械智能宣布自己将立即把意识传输到参议院大楼的某个饮料分发器上结束。
operation.6015.11.desc.en: After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators and it concludes with the Machine Intelligence announcing the imminent transfer of its entire consciousness into a random beverage dispenser somewhere in the Senate complex.

operation.6015.2.desc.zh: 在旁观者看来，[operation_target.GetName]最近在一场悲惨的车祸中丢掉了[operation_target.GetHerHis]的性命，载具在[operation_target.GetSheHe]开动的那一刻爆炸了。帝国官方怀疑是有人在暗中搞事，但是那些精心摆放的炸药压根就没剩下来，没法通过这件事追查到我们的特工身上。
operation.6015.2.desc.en: To those bystanders who witnessed the event, [operation_target.GetName] recently lost [operation_target.GetHerHis] life in a tragic hover car accident when the vehicle [operation_target.GetSheHe] [operation_target.GetWasWere] traveling in seemed to spontaneously explode. Imperial authorities likely suspect foul-play, but there is not enough of the carefully placed explosive remaining to link our operatives to the deed.

operation.6015.3.desc.zh: 通过研究目标私人住所的监控系统，我们发现前门的控制面板存在一个安全纰漏。我们的特工把这个面板捣鼓了一下，确保下一次被人使用时会触发一个强烈的放电。[operation_target.GetName]回家之后操作了这个面板，结果，[operation_target.GetSheHe]就被突然释放的电流裂解成了地上的一滩灰，只留下[operation_target.GetHerHis]的护卫在原地目瞪口呆。
operation.6015.3.desc.en: Surveillance of the target's personal residence revealed a security flaw in the control panel used to open the front door. Our operatives rigged the panel to trigger a powerful energy discharge when used. When [operation_target.GetName] returned home shortly afterwards and used the panel, [operation_target.GetSheHe] disintegrated into a pile of ash right in front of [operation_target.GetHerHis] astonished escort detail.

operation.6015.4.desc.zh: 一个战术刺杀小队试图伏击目标和其护卫，在经过一段简单的、一边倒的交火之后，所有目标[from.target.GetIndividualNamePlural]都被击杀。我方的所有特工都安然无恙地脱离，现在处于潜伏状态，等到局势放松之后再进行安全地撤离。
operation.6015.4.desc.en: A tactical kill team managed to ambush the target and its escort, successfully eliminating all of the [from.target.GetIndividualNamePlural] after a brief and one-sided firefight. All of our operatives escaped unharmed and are now laying low until conditions allow for their safe extraction.

operation.6015.5.desc.zh: 目标随身的猎寻者无人机让正面进攻变得不可能，因此我们需要寻找替代方案。我方特工重编了一个自动化轨道货船，让其看上去是在驶离繁忙的[target_country.Capital.GetName]轨道空间前往帝国别处执行任务，实际上却是同目标无人机的私人穿梭机相撞。引发的爆炸轰天震地，目标无人机的记忆核心一个渣滓都没留下给人打捞。
operation.6015.5.desc.en: The target's hunter-killer drone escort made a frontal attack impossible, so an alternate approach was required. Our operatives reprogrammed an automated orbital freighter to collide with the target drone's personal shuttle as it was leaving the busy orbital space of [target_country.Capital.GetName] for a mission elsewhere in the Imperium. The resulting explosion was powerful enough that no trace of the drone's memory core remained to be salvaged.

operation.6015.6.desc.zh: 我们的特工以外科手术式的精准排放好小型炸药网，引爆后严重破坏了位于[target_country.Capital.GetName]上[target_country.GetRulerTitle]纪念碑的支撑结构。宏伟的雕像缓缓倒下，砸在地上化为了数不尽的碎片。当地政府赶到现场的时候，我们的特工已经在前往撤离点的路上了。
operation.6015.6.desc.en: With surgical precision, the network of small explosives planted by our operatives severed the supports of the monument to the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] on [target_country.Capital.GetName]. The massive statue then slowly toppled from its platform and shattered into a million pieces as it hit the ground. By the time the local authorities arrived on the scene, our operatives were already on their way to their exfiltration points.

operation.6015.7.desc.zh: 当深埋地下的炸药引爆的时候，整栋帝安局建筑都化成了灰，徒留地上一个新近形成的大坑，以及到处倒坍的砾石。等到帝安局增援部队赶到并在这片区域建立一个警戒区的时候，我们的特工早已逃之夭夭，去往了其他的星球。
operation.6015.7.desc.en: When the underground explosives were detonated, the entire ISD office building disappeared into the newly formed crater and collapsed on itself. By the time ISD reinforcements arrived to establish a cordon around the area, our operatives had been safely relocated offworld.

operation.6015.8.desc.zh: 由我们的特工精心掩埋在募兵中心四周的炸药网被引爆，所有的炸药在同一时刻触发了引信。伤亡惨重。尽管帝国海军总能在帝国疆域的其他地方拉到新兵蛋子，但至少这次行动被视作一次标志性的打击，足够让[target_country.GetRulerTitle]心有余悸一段时间了。
operation.6015.8.desc.en: A network of carefully concealed explosives planted by our operatives around the Recruitment Center detonated as one when their trigger was fired. Casualties were heavy, and although the Imperial Armada is certain to find the recruits it needs elsewhere in the Imperium, this is at least a symbolic blow that will be felt by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] for some time.

operation.6015.9.desc.zh: 在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的鬼畜版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以帝皇陛下[target_country.ruler.GetHerHis]本人的自爆结束。
operation.6015.9.desc.en: After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators, eventually concluding with [target_country.ruler.GetHerHis] Imperial Majesty's spontaneous combustion.

operation.6016.1.desc.zh: 身份不明的特工近期刺杀了一名位于[Root.Capital.GetName]上的帝国要员！行凶者躲避了追捕，但我们深信这场刺杀是一系列企图动摇星海帝国并削弱我们权威的精心策划行动的一部分。某一位星海帝国的成员国可能就是幕后主谋！
operation.6016.1.desc.en: Unidentified agents recently assassinated an Imperial dignitary on [Root.Capital.GetName]! The perpetrators eluded capture, but we believe the assassination is part of a concerted effort to destabilize the Galactic Imperium and undermine our authority. One of the Imperium's member states is likely behind this!

operation.6016.2.desc.zh: 一名身居高位的帝国安全总局官员最近被不明势力的特工刺杀了！帝安局的分析师认为这一行动是星海帝国的某位成员国尝试削弱[Root.GetRulerTitle]的权威，很可能一场公开的叛乱已经在私下里开始谋划了！
operation.6016.2.desc.en: A high-ranking officer of the Imperial Security Directorate was recently assassinated by agents working for an unknown power! Analysts at the ISD think it likely that this is an attempt by one of the Imperium's member states to undermine the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and perhaps set the stage for an open revolt against our rule!

operation.6016.3.desc.zh: 一名身居高位的帝国海军情报官员最近被不明势力的特工刺杀了！这一可耻的恐怖主义行径很有可能出自某位不忠的星海帝国成员国，而它很有可能还在盘算着什么大计划削弱我们的权威。
operation.6016.3.desc.en: A high-ranking intelligence officer in the Imperial Armada was recently assassinated by agents acting on behalf of an unknown power! This shameful act of terrorism is likely part of a larger effort to undermine our authority by a disloyal member state of the Imperium.

operation.6016.4.desc.zh: 不满分子最近消灭了一个我们的自律眼线！尽管单个[root.GetIndividualName]的毁灭尚不足以引起[Root.GetRulerTitle]的关注，但是该[root.GetIndividualName]肩负着帝国派往多个臣属国的大使的功能。这一行动目的在于动摇星海帝国。
operation.6016.4.desc.en: Dissidents recently eliminated one of our autonomous liaisons! The termination of a single [root.GetIndividualName] is typically not worth the attention of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], but this [root.GetIndividualName] served an important function as an Imperial ambassador to many of our subject nations. This action has sought to destabilize the Galactic Imperium.

operation.6016.5.desc.zh: 身份不明的骚乱活动近期切断了我们同一名无人机的连结。这个特殊的单元负责协调[Root.GetRulerTitle]同帝国各成员国之间的活动。一个替代单元正在被写入程序，但是当下这个无人机的损失会削弱我们对整个帝国的掌控。
operation.6016.5.desc.en: Unidentified insurgents recently terminated one of our drone liaisons. This particular unit was responsible for coordinating activities between the [Root.GetRulerTitle] and the Imperial member states. A replacement is being programmed, but for now the loss of this drone will weaken our control of the Imperium.

operation.6016.6.desc.zh: 一个[Root.GetRulerTitle]的大型纪念碑最近在[Root.Capital.GetName]被炸上了天！这次胆大妄为的攻击行径直击星海帝国的心脏，是在试图削弱我们的统治。尽管目前还没逮捕嫌疑人，爆炸装置的精妙结构暗实某个政府的特工在背后主导这一切——很可能就是来自帝国成员国中的一个。
operation.6016.6.desc.en: A large monument to the [Root.GetRulerTitle] was recently blown up on [Root.Capital.GetName]! This brazen attack at the very heart of the Galactic Imperium can only be an attempt to undermine our rule. Although no suspects have been arrested, the sophistication of the explosive device suggests a government agency was behind this - likely from one of the Imperium's member states.

operation.6016.7.desc.zh: 最近某个外国特工发动了一次炸弹袭击，帝国安全总局的一处办事处被炸毁。这样的恐怖主义行为对帝安局在整个帝国内的公共形象造成了损害——如果他们连自己都不能保护，怎么能指望他们的特工在帝国全境贯彻[Root.GetRulerTitle]的统治呢？
operation.6016.7.desc.en: A branch office of the Imperial Security Directorate was destroyed in a recent bombing perpetrated by foreign agents. This act of terrorism has done serious harm to the public image of the ISD throughout the Imperium - if they can't even protect themselves, how are their agents supposed to enforce the rule of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]?

operation.6016.8.desc.zh: 帝国海军的一处募兵中心最近成为了恐怖主义炸弹袭击的目标，尸横遍野。尽管这场袭击对帝国海军的征兵计划几乎没有造成任何影响，但这场炸弹袭击可以视作一个信号，告诫帝国各成员国的帝国公民不要向[Root.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠。
operation.6016.8.desc.en: One of the Imperial Armada's recruitment centers was the recent target of a terrorist bombing that left many dead. Although the actual impact on the Armada's recruitment efforts should be negligible, the bombing seems to have been intended as a message to discourage Imperial citizens in the Imperium's member states from offering their services to the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

operation.6016.9.desc.zh: 代表意见势力活动的特工最近骇入了[Root.Capital.GetName]上的一处大型亚空间传输器。在我们恢复控制之前，这些谋反分子利用帝国的官方亚空间载波向整个星系传输了一段“叛军宣言”！这一令人尴尬的恐怖主义行径在整个帝国所有成员的众目睽睽之下削弱了我们的权威。
operation.6016.9.desc.en: Agents acting on behalf of a dissident power recently hacked into a large Subspace Transmitter on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Before our control could be restored, the subversives transmitted a "proclamation of rebellion" across the galaxy using an official Imperial subspace carrier wave! This embarrassing act of terrorism has undermined our authority in the view of the members of the Imperium.

operation.6016.name.zh: 恐怖分子削弱帝国权威！

operation.6100.a.zh: 我们现在应当等待时机……
operation.6100.a.en: We shall bide our time for now...

operation.6100.desc.zh: 我方特工正在试图同其他叛乱团体和政府的线人接头，分享我们推翻帝国政权的共同目标。
operation.6100.desc.en: Our operatives are attempting to link up with other rebel groups and governments that share our goal of overthrowing the Imperium.

operation.6100.invalid.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。
operation.6100.invalid.en: The Imperium has somehow managed to weather the storm of turmoil and instability that was only recently sweeping across it! With Imperial authorities now firmly back in control, conditions are no longer favorable for an open revolt. Our operatives have been withdrawn.

operation.6105.1.desc.zh: 有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被针对的目标。
operation.6105.1.desc.en: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Imperial counterespionage assets are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

operation.6105.2.desc.zh: 有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国安全总局的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被主动针对的目标。
