operation.6105.2.desc.en: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Assets of the Imperial Security Directorate are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

operation.6110.desc.zh: 帝制派和[target.GetRulerTitle]的其他宵小之辈在每一个帝国成员国境内都占据着数量上的优势。线人在叛乱爆发的时候必须就位，一旦行动，就要控制住、亦或是直接抹除掉这些帝制派分子。
operation.6110.desc.en: Imperial loyalists and other lackeys of the [target.GetRulerTitle] are present in great numbers in each of the Imperium's member states. Assets need to be in place to immediately seize or otherwise neutralize these loyalists the moment the rebellion breaks out.

operation.6115.desc.zh: 一切都已就绪。特工已经出现在了帝国的每一个成员国境内，同当地对起义行动表示同情的势力相互协作。剩下的就看，当帷幕拉开的时候，他们是否能够说动政府支持我们的事业。
operation.6115.desc.en: Everything is nearly in place. Operatives are present in every member state of the Imperium, coordinating with whatever local elements are sympathetic to the rebel movement. It remains to be seen whether they can sway their governments to support our cause when push comes to shove.

operation.6120.desc.zh: 是时候了。暗藏在整个星系各处的特工都在等待密码指令，并根据指令行动。星海帝国的落幕之战就从此时奏响。
operation.6120.desc.en: It is time. Concealed operatives all over the galaxy are waiting for the code phrase that will send them into action. This is the beginning of the end of the Galactic Imperium.

operation.6200.desc.zh: 我们的特工正在甄别并试图同[target.GetName]国内的犯罪团伙接触，他们很容易被我们的援助影响到。
operation.6200.desc.en: Our operatives are working to identify and make contact with criminal elements inside the [target.GetName] that would be susceptible to our assistance.

operation.6201.1.desc.zh: 我们同一群虽然聒噪，但是很能打的[target.GetSpeciesName]海盗接上了头。这群暴力的亡命徒很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。
operation.6201.1.desc.en: We have made contact with a rowdy but promising group of [target.GetSpeciesName] pirates. These violent cutthroats are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

operation.6201.2.desc.zh: 我们同一小群脱离了[target.GetName]中央智能的故障单位接上了头。这些高度不稳定且难以预测的[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。
operation.6201.2.desc.en: We have made contact with a small group of malfunctioning units who have isolated themselves from the central intelligence of the [target.GetName]. These highly unstable and unpredictable [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

operation.6201.3.desc.zh: 我们同一小群拥有罕见基因突变、可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连结而不会陷入休眠的子个体接上了头。这些暴力且难以预测的突变[target.GetGestaltEntityName]很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。
operation.6201.3.desc.en: We have established contact with a small group of mutated outcasts who have somehow managed to sever their link to the [target.GetGestaltEntityName] without perishing. These violent and unpredictable mutants are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

operation.6202.desc.zh: 货运武器和抹除标记的舰船由我方特工负责走私进入[target.GetName]，并确保不会追溯到我们身上。我们已经准备好将它们交付给海盗了。
operation.6202.desc.en: Weapon shipments and unmarked ships that can't be traced back to us have been smuggled into the [target.GetName] by our operatives. We are ready to hand them over to the privateers.

operation.6205.1.desc.zh: 被我们武装起来的海盗已经在[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系站稳了脚跟，他们立马就开始针对当地的货运船只。我们的分析师期望[target_country.GetName]很快就会分兵处理这股国境内的不稳定威胁。
operation.6205.1.desc.en: The privateers we armed have established themselves in the [privateer_system.GetName] system, and they have immediately begun targeting local shipping. Our analysts expect that the [target_country.GetName] will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing threat within their borders.

operation.6205.2.desc.zh: 在我们资助舰船和武器后，一群流亡的[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系站稳了脚跟。他们立马将恒星系内一切不属于他们的东西视为威胁，我们的分析师期望[target_country.GetName]很快就会分兵处理这股不稳定的势力。
operation.6205.2.desc.en: The rogue [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that we supplied with ships and weapons have established themselves in the [privateer_system.GetName] system. They are designating everything in the system that does not belong to them as a threat, and our analysts expect that the [target_country.GetName] will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing element.

operation.6205.3.desc.zh: 在我们资助舰船和武器后，一群[target_country.GetSpeciesName]的变异体在[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系站稳了脚跟。他们从此地出发，开始捕食一切触及范围内的资源和养分，我们的分析师期望[target_country.GetName]的中央蜂巢意识很快就会分兵处理这股国境内的不稳定威胁。
operation.6205.3.desc.en: The [target_country.GetSpeciesName] mutants that we supplied with ships and weapons have established themselves in the [privateer_system.GetName] system. From there they are preying on everything within their reach in their struggle for resources and nutrients. Our analysts expect that the central hive consciousness of the [target_country.GetName] will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing threat within its borders.

operation.6206.1.desc.zh: 一支高度武装的私掠船队出现在了[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系！和其他海盗没什么区别，这群乌合之众立马开始针对我们通过这个恒星系的货运船只。我们的情报部门高度怀疑他们收到了境外势力资助的舰船和武器。
operation.6206.1.desc.en: A group of heavily armed privateers has established a presence in the [privateer_system.GetName] system! Little more than pirates, these lowlifes have immediately begun targeting our shipping passing through the system. Intelligence strongly suspects that they were supplied with ships and weapons by an outside power.

operation.6206.2.desc.zh: 一小群故障的单位已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的主体智能，并躲进了我们境内的[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系！这些单位已经无可救药，并开始利用境外势力资助的舰船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。
operation.6206.2.desc.en: A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the [privateer_system.GetName] system inside our space. These units have become irredeemably corrupted, and they now use crude spacecraft supplied to them by a foreign power to raid everything in the system for spare parts and resources.

operation.6206.3.desc.zh: 一小群拥有一种罕见基因突变的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]，可使它们切断与[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的影响范围太远，这些离群的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系。它们使用的武器和舰船一定是来自于某个境外势力！
operation.6206.3.desc.en: A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the [target.GetGestaltEntityName] without being rendered comatose. As these rogue [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] would perish if they ventured too far from the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]'s influence, they have established themselves in the [privateer_system.GetName] system within our borders. The weapons and ships they are using must have been supplied by a foreign power!

operation.6207.1.desc.zh:
那些我们用于针对[target_country.GetName]的私掠船队已经切断了同我们的联系，并且通过其他地方运输的资源继续破坏。

$operation.6207.desc.outro$
operation.6207.1.desc.en:
The privateers we were working with in the [target_country.GetName] have cut ties with us, and have begun wreaking havoc using materiel from some other source.

$operation.6207.desc.outro$

operation.6207.2.desc.zh:
我们提供武器和船只的[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经切断了同我们的联系，开始接触其他人以获取资源并继续掠夺。

$operation.6207.desc.outro$
operation.6207.2.desc.en:
The rogue [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that we supplied with ships and weapons have cut ties with us, and have begun wreaking havoc using materiel from some other source.

$operation.6207.desc.outro$

operation.6250.desc.zh: 位于[target.GetName]的特工正积极工作，辨识并追踪那些潜在能提供支持的领袖。
operation.6250.desc.en: Operatives within the [target.GetName] are actively working to identify and pursue leads that could potentially be used to gain favors.

operation.6251.desc.zh: 我们已经发现了一个突破点，可以用来进行勒索。特工们正在进行进一步调查。
operation.6251.desc.en: A promising angle has been discovered which could be used for extortion purposes. Operatives are investigating.

operation.6252.1.desc.zh:
穿过敌国的层层监控之后，我方特工成果获取了一些涉及到一名[target.GetSpeciesName]政府高官的敏感信息。如果这些信息被公之于众，那么将会造成极大的尴尬。

我们已经准备好谨慎地接触这名官员，试探是否可以在某些替代方案上达成一致。
operation.6252.1.desc.en:
Through their surveillance efforts, our operatives have managed to obtain sensitive information regarding a certain high-ranking [target.GetSpeciesName] government official. If it were to be released to the general public, this information would prove very embarrassing.

We are ready to discreetly approach this official to see if some sort of alternate arrangement can be worked out.

operation.6252.2.desc.zh:
我方的某位特工成功获取到了一份老旧的数据文件，里面包含了[target.GetSpeciesName]对数个外国势力发动入侵的计划。尽管这些计划早已过时，且完全是纸上谈兵，但是其中有几个地方详细地演示了如何逮捕或处决目标帝国的政治领导阶层。

放出这些计划毫无疑问会让[target.GetName]处于尴尬的境地，我们的特工已经准备好接触对方政府以期达成某项协议。
operation.6252.2.desc.en:
One of our operatives has secured an old data file containing [target.GetSpeciesName] invasion plans for several foreign powers. Although the plans are obsolete and seem to have been entirely hypothetical, there are several detailed scenarios that involve the arrest or execution of the target empire's political leadership.

As the release of these plans could potentially be embarrassing for the [target.GetName], our operatives are ready to approach their government to work out a deal.

operation.6252.3.desc.zh:
我们已经了解到，[target.GetSpeciesName]的某位政府高官从国防预算中拿了一小部分资金，放进了自己的腰包。如果这则信息被公之于[target.GetName]的大众，那么这个是个大号丑闻。

我们的特工已经准备好谨慎地接触这名高官，看是否我们可以在某些地方取得共识……
operation.6252.3.desc.en:
We have learned that a certain high-level [target.GetSpeciesName] government official has been secretly siphoning off a small amount of credits from their defense budget for personal use. If this information were to become public knowledge in the [target.GetName], it would cause quite a scandal.

Our operatives are ready to discreetly approach this official to see if some sort of arrangement can be worked out...

operation.6252.4.desc.zh:
我们的监视网发现，[target.GetSpeciesName]的一名资深外交官正与一名[scandal_species.GetSpeciesName]使馆雇员陷入桃色关系。尽管有关这桩关系的具体细节我们尚未了解，但是这一事件存在本身，一旦被捅破，将会对这位外交官和该国政府造成极大的困扰。

我们的特工已经准备就绪，开始谨慎地接触这名外交官，以期达成某项共识。
operation.6252.4.desc.en:
Our surveillance efforts have revealed that a high-ranking [target.GetSpeciesName] diplomat is engaged in an affair with a [scandal_species.GetSpeciesName] embassy staff member. The exact details of this relationship elude us, but its mere existence would be highly embarrassing to both the diplomat and their government if it were shared with the general public.

We have operatives standing ready to approach the diplomat in a discreet attempt to reach an agreement.

operation.6252.5.desc.zh:
我们的特工获得了铁证，[target.GetSpeciesName]政府的一名杰出成员，同国境内的某个海盗组织保持着十分活跃的联系。在我们看来，这名官员一直在向这些海盗透露国内贸易路线的机密信息。

如果我们能对这些证据保持沉默，想必这名政府官员会对我们感恩戴德……
operation.6252.5.desc.en:
Our operatives have obtained evidence that a distinguished member of the [target.GetSpeciesName] government has ties to a pirate organization active within their borders. From what we can tell, this official has been feeding these pirates sensitive information about internal trade routes.

If we were to keep this evidence to ourselves, the government official would likely be very grateful...

operation.6252.6.desc.zh:
[target.GetName]对于周边帝国的政治领袖保留了极其翔实的文件，这些文件中的很多内容都包含了机械智能对自己的有灵同僚作出的详细而带有诋毁意味的评价。我们的特工成功获取了这些文件中一部分的拷贝。

如果这些文件被分享到[target.GetName]的邻国，它们的名声肯定会大幅受损。我们的特工已经准备好提出一项协议了。
operation.6252.6.desc.en:
The [target.GetName] maintains extensive files on political leaders in neighboring empires, many of which contain detailed and disparaging remarks regarding their mental faculties from the machine intelligence's point of view. Our operatives have managed to secure copies of some of these files.

The reputation of the [target.GetName] would likely suffer if these files were shared with their neighbors, but our operatives are ready to propose a different arrangement.

operation.6252.7.desc.zh:
一个[target.GetName]的自律无人机领袖表现出了一些古怪的行为，并竭尽全力不让其同僚发现。无论导致的原因是编程缺陷还是基础人格的渐进突变，如果机械智能主体注意到这件事，它将面临重新格式化。

我们可以同这个无人机见面，并承诺保留我们的观察数据，以期换取它的协助……
operation.6252.7.desc.en:
An autonomous drone leader within the [target.GetName] is exhibiting peculiar behavior that it seems to go to great lengths to hide from its peers. Whether this is caused by faulty programming or the gradual maturation of a rudimentary personality, the drone likely faces reformatting if the central machine intelligence were to take notice.

We could approach the drone and promise to keep our observations to ourselves in exchange for favors...

operation.6252.8.desc.zh:
[target.GetName]对于周边帝国的政治领袖保留了极其翔实的文件，这些文件中的很多内容都包含了[target.GetGovernmentName]对自己的有灵同僚作出的详细而带有诋毁意味的评价。我们的特工成功获取了这些文件中一部分的拷贝。

如果这些文件被分享到[target.GetName]的邻国，它们的名声肯定会大幅受损。我们的特工已经准备好提出一项协议了。
operation.6252.8.desc.en:
The [target.GetName] maintains extensive files on political leaders in neighboring empires, many of which contain detailed and disparaging remarks regarding their mental faculties from the [target.GetGovernmentName]'s point of view. Our operatives have managed to secure copies of some of these files.

The reputation of the [target.GetName] would likely suffer if these files were shared with their neighbors, but our operatives are ready to propose a different arrangement.

operation.6252.9.desc.zh:
我们的特工观测到，某个[target.GetName]的自律领袖表现出来的一些行为，暗实它已经脱离了[target.GetGovernmentName]的意志开始追逐自己个体的目标，比如秘密地获取少量的物质财产。如果[target.GetGestaltEntityName]注意到这件事，这个[target.GetIndividualName]的下场会十分严重。

我们可以同这个[target.GetIndividualName]见面，并承诺保留我们的观察数据，以期换取它的协助……
operation.6252.9.desc.en:
As observed by our operatives, one of the autonomous leaders in the [target.GetName] has been exhibiting behavior that suggests it sometimes strays from the will of the [target.GetGovernmentName] in pursuit of personal goals, such as the secret acquisition of small material possessions. If the [target.GetGestaltEntityName] learned of this, the repercussions for this [target.GetIndividualName] would be severe.

We could approach the [target.GetIndividualName] and promise to keep our observations to ourselves in exchange for a few favors...

operation.6255.desc.zh: 我们成功地同我们在[From.target.GetName]的联络人达成了一项互惠协议。作为换取我们的保持沉默，对方承诺会在未来予以我们外交上一定的支持。
operation.6255.desc.en: We have successfully arrived at a mutually beneficial arrangement with our contact in the [From.target.GetName]. In exchange for our discretion, we have been granted the promise of certain diplomatic favors in the future.

operation.6300.desc.zh: 通过伪装成帝国低级职员或是官僚，我们的特工现已成功渗透进[target.GetName]内部。
operation.6300.desc.en: Concealed as low-level Imperial officials and bureaucrats, our operatives are now infiltrating the [target.GetName].

operation.6305.desc.zh: 我们的特工盯上了一位长期热衷于公开批判帝国的特使，并着手处理这危险的星星之火。
operation.6305.desc.en: Our operatives are shadowing an envoy that has long been an outspoken critic of the Imperium. Work is underway to deal with this dangerous firebrand.

operation.6310.1.desc.zh: 这位目标小心行事，尽可能表现得不像是在发表公开反动言论，但他的所作所为的确在损害我们的权威。单纯的外交声明挽回不了他们，不过我们有的是办法来对付这些叛乱分子。
operation.6310.1.desc.en: The target is careful not to make statements that could be interpreted as fomenting open sedition against the Imperium, but their activities are still undermining our authority. Diplomatic eloquence will not save them in the end - there are other ways of dealing with rebels.

operation.6310.2.desc.zh: 我们已经收集到了足够多的证据来清除目标了。由于其反动颠覆的行径，他们不受外交豁免权的保护，并将作为帝国的敌人在帝国法院的审判席上受审。
operation.6310.2.desc.en: We have gathered enough evidence to move against the target. Their subversive activities negate whatever diplomatic immunity they may have enjoyed - they will be tried and sentenced in an Imperial court as an Enemy of the Imperium.

operation.6310.3.desc.zh: [target.GetName]通过外交手段削弱帝国权威的主导者是一个自律[target.GetIndividualName]。我方特工确信抹除这位个体将消解反动者在帝国参议院中对于[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的影响。
operation.6310.3.desc.en: The efforts of the [target.GetName] to diplomatically undermine the Imperium largely hinge on the activities of a single autonomous [target.GetIndividualName]. Our operatives are confident that the elimination of this envoy will negate whatever seditionist influence the [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have in the Imperial Senate.

operation.6315.1.desc.zh: 帝国代理人成功在[target_country.GetName]将该反动特使逮捕。目标被迅速引渡到[Root.GetName]，在快速审判后被判处死刑。这就是抹黑[Root.GetRulerTitle]的代价。
operation.6315.1.desc.en: Imperial agents were successful in their attempt to apprehend the subversive envoy in the [target_country.GetName]. The target was quickly transported to the [Root.GetName], and after a swift trial they were sentenced to death. Such is the price for besmirching the good name of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

operation.6315.2.desc.zh: 一支隶属于帝国安全总局的战术小队成功在[target_country.GetName]拘押了这位反动特使。特勤干员迅速将其引渡至[Root.GetName]，其在快速审判后被判处死刑。这就是抹黑[Root.GetRulerTitle]的代价。
operation.6315.2.desc.en: A tactical team from the Imperial Security Directorate was successful in its attempt to apprehend the subversive envoy in the [target_country.GetName]. The ISD agents quickly transported the target to the [Root.GetName], and after a swift trial they were sentenced to death. Such is the price for besmirching the good name of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

operation.6315.3.desc.zh: 在一场精心准备的伏击后，埋伏好的帝国特工们将目标乱枪击毙，并在当地执法机关反应过来前迅速逃离。尽管[target_country.GetName]怀疑我们一手策划了枪击，但他们并没能找到证据。这将给那些蔑视[Root.GetRulerTitle]的人敲响警钟。
operation.6315.3.desc.en: In a carefully planned ambush, concealed Imperial operatives gunned down the target and then made their escape before the local authorities could respond. Although the [target_country.GetName] likely suspects our involvement, there is no proof for them to find. This will send a powerful message to those who would defy the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

operation.6315.4.desc.zh: 在一场精心准备的伏击后，一支来自帝国安全总局的战术小队将目标乱枪击毙，并在当地执法机关反应过来前迅速逃离。尽管[target_country.GetName]怀疑我们一手策划了枪击，但他们并没能找到证据。这将给那些蔑视[Root.GetRulerTitle]的人敲响警钟。
operation.6315.4.desc.en: In a carefully planned ambush, a tactical assault team from the Imperial Security Directorate gunned down the target and then made their escape before the local authorities could respond. Although the [target_country.GetName] likely suspects our involvement, there is no proof for them to find. This will send a powerful message to those who would defy the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

operation.6316.1.desc.zh:
帝国特工不久前以“意图推翻帝国”的罪名逮捕了一位我们的特使！特使在我们有关部门介入前就被快速引渡至[From.GetName]，并在一场简短的审判后被判处死刑。

$operation.6316.ending$
operation.6316.1.desc.en:
Imperial agents recently arrested one of our envoys for "crimes against the Imperium"! The envoy was swiftly transported to the [From.GetName] before our own authorities could react, and after a brief show trial a death sentence was meted out.

$operation.6316.ending$

operation.6316.2.desc.zh:
一支来自帝国安全总局的强袭小队刚刚以“意图推翻帝国”的罪名拘捕了一位我们的特使！特勤干员们在我们有关部门介入前迅速将其引渡至[From.GetName]。经过一场简短的审判后，特使被宣判死刑。

$operation.6316.ending$
operation.6316.2.desc.en:
A strike team from the Imperial Security Directorate recently arrested one of our envoys for "crimes against the Imperium"! The ISD agents swiftly transported the envoy to the [From.GetName] before our own authorities could react, and after a brief show trial a death sentence was meted out.

$operation.6316.ending$

operation.6316.3.desc.zh:
我们的一位特使刚刚在[Root.Capital.GetName]被暗杀！凶手逃脱了追捕，但鉴于该特使是[From.GetRulerTitle]及帝国的公开批评家，谁最有策划这次暗杀的动机已经再清楚不过了。

$operation.6316.ending$
operation.6316.3.desc.en:
One of our envoys was recently assassinated on [Root.Capital.GetName]! The perpetrators eluded capture, but our envoy was an outspoken critic of the [From.GetRulerTitle] and the Imperium - it is very clear who had the most to gain by their demise.

$operation.6316.ending$

operation.6316.a.zh: 难道“外交豁免权”只是一张厕纸吗？

operation.6320.desc.zh:
我们扰乱[target_country.GetName]以削弱帝国权威的行动受挫！[target_country.GetAdj]的反情报部门一定已经监视了我们的一举一动——我们所有的密探全部失联。

[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经向帝国参议院提交了我们行动的证据。我们的外交官正竭力否认每一点，但显然，这尴尬的解释一定会在[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前显得苍白无力。
operation.6320.desc.en:
Our operation to disrupt the ability of the [target_country.GetName] to undermine the Imperium has been compromised! [target_country.GetAdj] counterintelligence must have been monitoring our every move - all of our operatives have gone silent.

The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have presented evidence of our operation to the Imperial Senate. Our diplomats are denying everything, of course, but this embarrassing incident will reflect poorly on the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

operation.6321.desc.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]的几名帝国间谍试图让我们的特使们闭嘴——更具体来说，阻止他们削弱帝国的权威——这一企图最近被我方瓦解了。

我们将这一帝国参议院策划的肮脏阴谋公之于众。当然，[From.GetRulerTitle]的那群马屁精对一切予以否认，但这一事件毫无疑问将抹黑帝国试图对外宣传的那副团结鸿图。
operation.6321.desc.en:
Several Imperial agents were recently neutralized on [Root.Capital.GetName] while engaged in an apparent attempt to silence our Envoys - more specifically, to prevent them from undermining the authority of the Imperium.

We have exposed the details of this dastardly plot to the Imperial Senate. The lackeys of the [From.GetRulerTitle] are denying everything, of course, but this incident will distort the image of unity the Imperium is trying to project.

operation.7000.desc.zh: 我们的特工已经完成了情报收集行动，并发送回来一封内容翔实的报告，涵盖他们发现的所有信息。
operation.7000.desc.en: Our operatives have completed their information-gathering operation and have sent a dossier detailing their findings.

operation.8000.desc.zh: 我们的特工正在列出处于[root.target.GetName]境内有潜力成为卧底的人。他们希望能将这些卧底安插到合适的岗位，让他们平日看起来无伤大雅，却能在相当长的时间里随时做好进攻准备。
operation.8000.desc.en: Our operatives are drawing up a shortlist of potential sleeper cells within the [root.target.GetName]. They hope to find a set of suitable positions where agents may appear innocuous and yet remain poised to strike for a prolonged period of time.

operation.8001.desc.zh: 一系列目标已被确定，我们的特工已经悄悄潜入就位。他们一收到我们的信号就会开始进行策反。
operation.8001.desc.en: A list of targets has been finalized and our operatives have been quietly drifting their way into position. They await our signal to begin establishing sleeper cells.

operation.8002.b.en: We can go even further than this.

operation.8002.desc.authoritarian.imperi.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$在发表诸多虚伪的效忠誓言，外加写上大量伪造的背景调查后，我们的特工在对方皇室的政府体系中谋得了一份官职。$operation.8002.desc.end$
operation.8002.desc.authoritarian.imperi.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ after many false protestations of fealty - not to mention a plethora of faked background checks - our operatives have settled into bureaucratic positions within the governing structure of the royal family. $operation.8002.desc.end$

operation.8002.desc.authoritarian.non_im.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$在发表诸多虚伪的效忠宣誓，外加写上大量伪造的背景调查后，我们的特工终于在其执政党的政府体系中谋得了一份官职。$operation.8002.desc.end$
operation.8002.desc.authoritarian.non_im.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ after many false protestations of fealty - not to mention a plethora of faked background checks - our operatives have settled into bureaucratic positions within the governing structure of the ruling party. $operation.8002.desc.end$

operation.8002.desc.boring.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$我们的密探已经成功藏身于[root.target.GetAdj]社会的各个角落，混迹于不起眼的地方，假装自己只是一名普通的百姓。$operation.8002.desc.end$
operation.8002.desc.boring.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ our operatives have successfully concealed themselves in a variety of positions across [root.target.GetAdj] society, hiding in plain site and pretending to simply be ordinary citizens. $operation.8002.desc.end$

operation.8002.desc.hive.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$通过最新的信息素技术，我们利用大量的神经阻断剂，设法在[root.target.GetGovernmentName]网络的内部构建了数个"盲区"。这样一来，我们就能将特工隐藏起来并开始策反[root.target.GetAdj][root.target.GetIndividualNamePlural]。$operation.8002.desc.end$
operation.8002.desc.hive.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ using the latest pheromonal technologies, along with a hearty dose of nerve blockers, we have managed to create several 'blind spots' within the [root.target.GetGovernmentName]. There, we will be able to conceal operatives and begin subverting [root.target.GetAdj] [root.target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. $operation.8002.desc.end$

operation.8002.desc.hive_on_hive.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$我们设法在[root.target.GetAdj][root.target.GetGestaltEntityName]的内部策反了数个思维个体，这样他们就可以一边偷偷向我们传递信息一边假装仍旧正常工作了。$operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$
operation.8002.desc.hive_on_hive.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ we have managed to subvert several thought routines within the [root.target.GetAdj] [root.target.GetGestaltEntityName] so that they covertly report to us while pretending to still function as normal. $operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$

operation.8002.desc.machine.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$我们的骇入专家启用了一批位于[root.target.GetGovernmentName]系统内部的隐藏后门，并将其成功埋入[root.target.GetAdj]赖以运作的代码中鲜有人知却又重要的部分。$operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$
operation.8002.desc.machine.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ our expert hackers have opened a number of hidden backdoors in the [root.target.GetGovernmentName], successfully hiding them in obscure yet important segments of the [root.target.GetAdj] code that they rely upon to function. $operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$

operation.8002.desc.machine_on_machine.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$我们的骇入子例程启用了一批位于[root.target.GetGovernmentName]系统内部的隐藏后门，并将其成功埋入[root.target.GetAdj]赖以运作的代码中鲜有人知却又重要的部分。$operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$
operation.8002.desc.machine_on_machine.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ our subversive subroutines have opened a number of hidden backdoors in the [root.target.GetGovernmentName], successfully hiding them in obscure yet important segments of the [root.target.GetAdj] code that they rely upon to function. $operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$

operation.8002.desc.materialist.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$大量神秘且无迹可查的现金涌入，使我们的密探拥有了强大的财力以及伪造的介绍信，从而可以得到许多领先的[root.target.GetAdj]公司的中层职位。$operation.8002.desc.end$
operation.8002.desc.materialist.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ an influx of mysterious, untraceable credits has allowed our operatives the financial clout - and falsified references - necessary to walk into mid-level positions in many of the leading [root.target.GetAdj] corporations. $operation.8002.desc.end$

operation.8002.desc.megacorp.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$神秘且无迹可查的现金涌入，使我们的密探拥有了强大的财力以及伪造的介绍信，从而可以步入领导[root.target.GetAdj]寰宇企业的一些中层职位。$operation.8002.desc.end$
operation.8002.desc.megacorp.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ an influx of mysterious, untraceable credits has allowed our operatives the financial clout - and falsified references - necessary to walk into several mid-level positions within the [root.target.GetAdj] megacorporation. $operation.8002.desc.end$

operation.8002.desc.militarist.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$在我们使尽浑身解数，外加大量而小心的掩饰后，我们终于设法将一批特工安插在了[root.target.GetAdj]军队中的低阶军官的位置上。$operation.8002.desc.end$
operation.8002.desc.militarist.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ after considerable effort, and numerous carefully concealed falsifications, we have managed to plant a number of operatives in low-level officer positions within the [root.target.GetAdj] military. $operation.8002.desc.end$

operation.8002.desc.spiritualist.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$尽管学习足够有关[root.target.GetAdj]宗教的知识是一项巨大的挑战，但我们的特工还是成功被准许加入他们的神职机构了，这可是[root.target.GetGovernmentName]中最有影响力的机构。$operation.8002.desc.end$
operation.8002.desc.spiritualist.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ though building up sufficient knowledge of [root.target.GetAdj] spirituality was a significant challenge, our operatives have been admitted within their priesthood - the most influential institution within the [root.target.GetGovernmentName]. $operation.8002.desc.end$

operation.8200.desc.zh: 我们的特工正在对[Root.Target.GetName]国内的数名关键外交要员进行投资，希望能够找到把柄以备未来之用。
operation.8200.desc.en: Our operatives are investigating key diplomatic actors within the [Root.Target.GetName], searching for hooks which we may be able to exploit.

operation.8205.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交官僚机构中已经筛选出了一批有丑闻潜质的子个体。其中几个的潜在丑闻已经被我方发现，我们的特工正在竭尽全力，确保事情能朝我们希冀的方向发展。
operation.8205.desc.en: We have drawn up a list of potentially scandal-prone figures within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic bureaucracy. Several potential leads have been found, and our operatives are working hard to find the best means by which to manufacture the desired outcome.

operation.8210.desc.zh: 已经为[This.GetName]行动甄别出了一名合适的目标，已经为其取出了详细的宗卷档案。我们的特工静候命令，随时准备散布丑闻。
operation.8210.desc.en: A suitable target for Operation [This.GetName] has been identified, and an extensive dossier has been drawn up. Our operatives wait on our word to trigger the scandal.

operation.8210.desc.no_go.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工带回了坏消息：他们目前尚无法为[This.GetName]行动甄选出一名合适的目标。显然[Root.Target.GetGovernmentName]对于丑闻的耐受性特别强，我们挖掘到的任何污点都没法在公众间掀起波澜。
operation.8210.desc.no_go.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] bring ill tidings: they were not able to find a suitable target for Operation [This.GetName]. Apparently the [Root.Target.GetGovernmentName] is sufficiently scandal-torn that any dirt we discovered on them would hardly have raised a stir.

operation.8225.desc.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工带回了坏消息：尽管做了各方面的准备，特工们重点关注的目标并没有上钩，因此他们也没法捏造什么丑闻。虽然听上去有点难以置信，但是[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交使团竟然真的挖不出一丁点黑料。
operation.8225.desc.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] bring ill tidings: despite extensive preparation, their apparently promising target did not fall for the bait, and they were unable to manufacture a scandal. Incredible as it may seem, it appears that there simply aren't any bad apples within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps at the moment.

operation.8230.desc.elope.zh:
$operation.8230.desc.base$看来他们的一名特使和异星人坠入了爱河——这对该物种来说是严重的罪行。经过循循诱导，我们帮助其避开了[Root.Target.GetAdj]的安保队，并成功地劝说他们和伴侣私奔到一个更加开放包容的社会。

这一事件造成了一系列公开的令人不适的质疑，并将[Root.Target.GetGovernmentName]置于艰难的外交境地。
operation.8230.desc.elope.en:
$operation.8230.desc.base$ it turned out that one of their envoys had fallen in love with a xeno - a grave offense among their kind. With some gentle persuasion - and our help with evading [Root.Target.GetAdj] security forces - we were able to persuade them to elope with their partner and seek refuge in a more tolerant society.

This incident has brought uncomfortable questions to the fore and put the [Root.Target.GetGovernmentName] in a difficult diplomatic situation.

operation.8230.desc.galactic_comedy.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$通过把某位特使压下去的失足行为公之于众，我们成功地让他们陷入了空前的尴尬。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
operation.8230.desc.galactic_comedy.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ by bringing to light some mortifying missteps by one of their envoys, we have managed to cause the them considerable embarrassment. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

operation.8230.desc.insulting_envoy.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$经过一些巧妙的运作，我们成功抹黑了[Root.Target.GetAdj]同[offended_party.GetName]的关系。他们的一名特使踏入了我们精心设下的圈套，不经意间吐露了他们对同行的真实看法，令外界所不耻。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
operation.8230.desc.insulting_envoy.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ through some clever manipulation, we have managed to tarnish [Root.Target.GetAdj] relations with the [offended_party.GetName]. One of their envoys took the bait we carefully set up for them, and accidentally publicly revealed their true thoughts - which proved to be deliciously unsavory - about their counterparts. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

operation.8230.desc.insulting_envoy_self.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$经过一些巧妙的运作，我们成功地抹黑了[Root.Target.GetAdj]同我们自己国家的关系。他们的一名特使踏入了我们精心设下的圈套，不经意间把自己对我国外交官的看法——外界看来这是非常不明智的——吐露了出来。结果，[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交立场被削弱了。
operation.8230.desc.insulting_envoy_self.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ through some clever manipulation, we have managed to tarnish [Root.Target.GetAdj] relations with our own empire. One of their envoys took the bait we carefully set up for them, and was tricked into publicly revealing some deliciously unsavory, private thoughts about our own diplomats. [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

operation.8230.desc.lobbying.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$我们成功曝光了一场游说丑闻。我们匿名举报，揭发他们在星海共同体工作的一位特使，是如何受贿为[Root.Target.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]讲话的，而该组织与[Root.Target.GetAdj]的利益截然相反。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
operation.8230.desc.lobbying.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ we were able to spark a lobbying scandal. All that was needed was an anonymous tip-off detailing exactly how much one of their envoys to the Galactic Community was being paid to represent the [Root.Target.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists] - an organization diametrically opposed to [Root.Target.GetAdj] interests. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

operation.8230.desc.salacious_affair.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$经过一次大胆的行动，我们设法陷害了对方一名驻[offended_party.GetName]的特使，使其罪名缠身。这一事件让他们感到非常尴尬，并导致他们同[offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的关系变得十分紧张。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
operation.8230.desc.salacious_affair.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ in a bold move, we were able to frame one of their envoys to the [offended_party.GetName] for a surprisingly wide range of crimes. The affair has caused them considerable embarrassment and strained their relations with the [offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

operation.8230.desc.salacious_affair_sel.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$经过一次大胆的行动，我们设法让对方驻扎在我们帝国的一名特使深陷一系列范围极其广泛的罪行中。这件事使他们相当尴尬，我们假意的冒犯在很大程度上加剧了他们的尴尬。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
operation.8230.desc.salacious_affair_sel.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ in a bold feint, we were able to frame one of their envoys to our own empire for a surprisingly wide range of crimes. The affair has caused them considerable embarrassment, exaggerated in no small part by the offense we have pretended to take. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

operation.8230.desc.substances.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$他们一位特使的药物滥用行为被公之于众，使得一些声名狼藉的毒枭对他们的决策能力施加了不当影响。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
operation.8230.desc.substances.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ the matter was resolved by bringing to light one of their envoys' substance abuse, which had allowed malevolent drug lords undue influence over their decisions. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

operation.8230.desc.wayward.zh:
$operation.8230.desc.base$以一些温和的劝说和对录音装置的巧妙利用，我们成功地曝光了他们的一名特使与[Root.Target.GetAdj]所指定的标准有多巨大的偏差。

这一事件造成了一系列公开的令人不适的质疑，并且让[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交立场变得十分艰难。
operation.8230.desc.wayward.en:
$operation.8230.desc.base$ with some gentle persuasion - and clever use of recording equipment - we were able to expose just how far one of their envoys had drifted from [Root.Target.GetAdj] norms on their assignment.

This incident has brought uncomfortable questions to the fore and put the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps in a difficult situation.

operation_awareness_risk.zh: 增大在我们的谍报行动过程中[from.target.GetName]获得£awareness£觉醒的风险。
operation_awareness_risk.en: Increased risk of the [from.target.GetName] gaining £awareness£ Awareness during our Espionage Operations.

operation_random_event_resolved_good.en: Operation [from.GetName] will resume, trending towards a more positive outcome.

operation_random_event_resolved_poor.en: Operation [from.GetName] will resume despite this negative setback.

optical_phenomena_desc.zh: 对[from.GetName]的影像扫描显示行星表面有极其活跃的光学现象，尽管这些颜色图案的成因在轨道距离上尚未探明。
optical_phenomena_desc.en: Our imaging scans of [from.GetName] are returning extremely vibrant optical phenomena across the planet's surface, though the cause of these color patterns remains unclear at an orbital distance.

oracle_digsite_desc.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]出土了一座埋藏了数千年的损坏空间站。这座精湛的建筑曾维持着数百万人的生存，他们的尸体现在就保存在空间站内，探索该建筑庞大的内部实在是一种令人毛骨悚然的工作。

虽然我们的科学家还没有确定这些人死亡的原因，但可以确定的是，他们在空间站损坏之前就已经死亡。有些人死相平静，死的时候手里抓着小型雕像；另一些人手里拿着武器，死前遭受了暴力伤害。
oracle_digsite_desc.en:
A crashed alien space station has been unearthed on [From.Planet.GetName] after being buried for many millennia. The masterful construction previously held a self-contained arthropoid civilization of millions. Their dead bodies have been preserved within the station, making exploration of the otherwise magnificent interior an eerie endeavor.

Though the cause of their civilization's demise is not yet clear, the inhabitants perished suddenly, well before impact. Some died peacefully clutching tiny idols while others, bearing weapons, suffered violent trauma.

oracle_leader_catch_phrase.zh: “第一步，让我们确保没有异常思想”
oracle_leader_catch_phrase.en: "First step firsts, lets ensure there are no divergent thoughts."

oracle_leader_desc.zh: 一个先进的人工智能，专职优化殖民地产出。她有独特的方法来降低个人主义倾向。
oracle_leader_desc.en: An advanced AI specialized in optimizing colony output. She has a unique method, reducing individualism.

orbital_resonance_desc.zh:
[from.System.GetName]内的公转周期展现出了引人注目的规律。每颗环绕恒星的行星都以两倍其相邻行星的周期公转着，精确到千分之一秒。

这种怪异的精确比值值得调查。
orbital_resonance_desc.en:
Orbital durations in the [from.System.GetName] system exhibit a remarkable pattern. Each planet orbits the star in exactly double the time of its neighbor, accurate to over a thousandth of a second.

This anomalously perfect ratio warrants investigation.

origin.10.a.desc.zh:
你们好，忠诚的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们做的很不错。在我们的引领下，你们已经掌握了超空间旅行的科技，第一次准备好要探索群星……正如我们曾经所做的一般，那是无数纪元以前了。

不要害怕——如果我们不觉得你们已经准备好了，我们是不会任已经发生的事件带领你们一路走到这里的。现在就出发，成为我们的骄傲吧。
origin.10.a.desc.en:
Hello, faithful [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have done well for yourselves. With our guidance, you have mastered the technology of hyperspace travel and are now ready to set off into the stars for the first time... much as we once did, countless eons ago.

Have no fear - if we did not think you ready, we would not have allowed events to carry you as far as they have. Go now, and make us proud.

origin.10.b.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。实验的第一阶段成功完成——我们已经指引你们发展出了你们文明的第一台[GetStartingDrivePlural]，现在你们已经准备好了探索群星。

放心吧，要知道第二阶段已经开始，我们会继续监督你们的进展。迄今为止，你们已经证明了自己格外机敏。和其他生物完全不同。

观察你们能用这一机会做到什么将会很有意思。
origin.10.b.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The first phase of the experiment has successfully concluded - we have guided you towards the development of your civilization's first [GetStartingDrivePlural], and you are now ready to take to the stars.

Rest assured in the knowledge that we will continue to monitor your progress now that the second phase has begun. Thus far, you have proven remarkably adroit. Not at all like the others.

It will be interesting to see what you make of this opportunity.

origin.1000.desc.zh:
在毫无征兆的情况下，位于我们母星系的神秘外星星门突然间被激活了！一道能量震荡从这座古迹中激射出来，一息之后，一个耀眼的、不断振动的球体填满了这个结构的重心。看来这个先行者文明的遗迹不再如同我们坚信的那样处于休眠状态了。

尽管星门仅仅打开了不过几秒钟，仍然有不少太空残骸从中穿过；经过细致的检查之后，其中的星岩与星尘成为了非常宝贵的资源。
origin.1000.desc.en:
Without slightest warning the mysterious alien gateway in our home system came alive! An energy surge pulsed out from the artifact, and for a fleeting moment a glowing, vibrating orb filled the center of the structure. This remnant of a former civilization may not be so dormant as previously believed.

Although the gateway was open for no longer than a few seconds, it was enough to let through some space debris; rocks and dust that upon closer inspection turned out to be valuable resources.

origin.1005.desc.zh:
再一次，沉睡的星门突然间激活了！不过这一次来的不是福神——而是灾疫——巨型未知物种直冲我们而来。

一只单个的、能够在太空中存活的生物从耀眼的星门中现身，看上去似乎在四处徘徊。由于其对我们的友好至信或警告没有任何回应，我们必须立马动员起来，将这一威胁铲除！
origin.1005.desc.en:
Once again the slumbering gateway has come alive! This time it was not a boon - but rather a bane - that came to us from the great unknown.

A single, space-dwelling creature sprang out of the glowing gateway, and seems to be on the prowl. Answering to no kind of hailing or warning, we should move to eradicate this threat immediately!

origin.1010.desc.zh:
星门被再一次激活了。这一次激活仅仅持续了不到一秒，但有东西从星门里面穿越过来。

一件来源不明的金属物体以极高的速度从传送门中射出，进入了恒星系。在任何传感器能够得到有效读数之前，这个物体就一头撞进了我们恒星系里的一颗行星。

我们应该立马针对碰撞点展开调查。
origin.1010.desc.en:
Once more the gateway has been activated. This time the activation lasted only a fraction of a second, but that was enough for something to cross over.

An unknown metallic object of extraordinary velocity shot out of the portal and cut its way through the system. Before any sensors could get a decent reading, the object had collided with a planet in our system.

We should investigate the point of impact as soon as possible.

origin.1012.desc.zh:
定位神秘探机的坠毁地点比预料中的还要困难。

根据读数，它并不是惯常意义上的坠毁了，然而这个物体接近星球表面时巨大的速度也排除了正常降落的可能。

所以到底发生了什么？是时候凑近去看一眼了。
origin.1012.desc.en:
Locating the crash site of the mysterious probe was far more complicated than anticipated.

Readings indicate that it didn't crash in a conventional sense, however the considerable velocity of the object approaching the surface also rules out a normal landing.

So what really happened? It's time to take a closer look.

origin.1013.desc.zh:
最近的考古发现能够让我们建造一个构件，这能够稍稍打开神秘星门，并允许一艘科研船通过。

警告

这是一个高风险任务！你无法保证科学官或科研船能从这场致命的冒险中平安归来。谨慎准备。
origin.1013.desc.en:
Recent archaeological findings have revealed a way to build a construct that can briefly open the mysterious gateway and allow a Science Ship to pass through.

 Warning!

This is a high risk mission! There is no guarantee that either Scientist or Science Ship will return from such a perilous journey. Prepare accordingly.

origin.1015.desc.zh:
组装的构件终于激活了。光矢从巨大的仪器中射出，并击中了沉睡的星门，使其开始运转。

突然间，星门特有的能量震荡中断，然后一个轻柔的、发亮的球体填充进星门。预先准备好的科研船立刻开始加速，驶入发光的领域。片刻之后，星门停止运转，只剩下回荡在太空中的宁静与肃穆。

现在我们只能等待了。
origin.1015.desc.en:
The assembled construction was finally activated. Lightning bolts shot out from the massive device and licked the slumbering gateway, making it power up.

Suddenly the gateway's distinguishing energy pulse erupted, and an ethereal, glowing orb filled the gateway. The prepared Science Ship immediately accelerated into the glowing expanse and vanished. Momentarily afterwards, the gateway instantly powered down and returned to a state of silent majesty.

Now we wait.

origin.1020.desc.zh:
没有任何预兆，我们母星系的星门突然活跃了起来——虽然时间不长，但足够让什么存在从闪耀的星门核心中显现出来。

那个金属物体没有对任何问候进行回应，也没有发射出任何信号。直到我们获得了清晰的视觉信号反馈，我们才意识到那个物体的真实本质是什么。那正是几个月之前我们送过星门的科研船。然而这艘船的年代看上去却久远多了。扫描器显示，这艘船的船龄高达一千年。

船员的遗体已作零星土尘，好在有一些未损坏的数据还能进行回收。这些数据包括了对星门科技惊叹的描述，以及一名船员留下的一段音频资料。

“……那样的未来。我们一族总有一天会知道那噩梦般的一天带来的苦难——当天空下起蓝色的火焰雨的那一天。”
origin.1020.desc.en:
Without warning, the gateway in our home system flickered to life for a brief moment - just long enough for something to emerge from the glowing gateway core.

The metal object responded to no hails, nor emitted any signals itself. Its true nature was unknown up until the moment when we managed to get a clear visual feed. It was the Science Ship we shot into the gateway many months ago. It had aged far more than that, though. Scanners indicate the ship being more than a thousand years old.

Of the crew only dust remained, but some intact data recordings could be salvaged. The data included some marvelous descriptions of gateway technology, as well as an audio message left by a crew member:

'... that future. My kind will truly know suffering on that baleful day - the day when the sky rains blue fire.'

origin.1020.desc.machine.zh:
没有任何预兆，我们母星系的星门突然活跃了起来——虽然时间不长，但足够让什么存在从闪耀的星门核心中显现出来。

那个金属物体没有对任何招呼进行回应，也没有发射出任何信号。直到我们获得了清晰的视觉信号反馈，我们才意识到那个物体的真实本质是什么。那正是几个月之前我们送过星门的科研船。然而这艘船的年代看上去却久远多了。扫描器显示，这艘船的船龄高达一千年。

我们所有登舰的机械单元全部停摆，好在有一些未损坏的数据还能进行回收。这些数据包括了对星门科技惊叹的描述，以及一枚负责这次探险的研究无人机留下的一段音频资料。

“……那样的未来。[Root.GetName]总有一天会知道那噩梦般的一天带来的苦难——当天空下起蓝色的火焰雨的那一天。”
origin.1020.desc.machine.en:
Without warning, the gateway in our home system flickered to life for a brief moment - just long enough for something to emerge from the glowing gateway core.

The metal object responded to no hails, nor emitted any signals itself. Its true nature was unknown up until the moment when we managed to get a clear visual feed. It was the Science Ship we shot into the gateway many months ago. It had aged far more than that, though. Scanners indicate the ship being more than a thousand years old.

None of our machine units on board were functional anymore, having long since succumbed to malfunctions, but some intact data recordings could be salvaged. The data included some marvelous descriptions of gateway technology, as well as an audio message left by the research drone in charge of the expedition:

'... that future. The [Root.GetName] will truly know suffering on that baleful day - the day when the sky rains blue fire.'

origin.1025.desc.zh:
星门又一次活了过来。在没有任何警告和准备的情况下，太空生物从发光的传送门中喷涌而出。这种生物和一段时间之前穿过星门的落单攻击者似乎是同一种类。

但是这一次数量更多了。数量远大于之前。现在已经没时间讲道理，没时间犹豫了。不是它们死，就是我们亡。军队整备！
origin.1025.desc.en:
The gateway has once more flickered to life. Without warning or hesitation space creatures spewed forth out of the glowing portal. The same type of creatures as the solitary attacker from some time ago.

This time around there are more of them. Far more. There is no room for reason here, no time for doubt. It's either them or us. To arms!

origin.1030.desc.zh:
我们的舰队设法阻止了从星门中涌现的生物大开杀戒。当战斗就在头顶上发生时，[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的男男女女都屏着一口气。

尽管心中怀着对逝者的沉重心情，我们母星上的住民仰望天空之时依旧满怀希望。星门生物的尸体，开始下坠到行星的表面。它们的尸体在进入大气层时被点燃，在天空中留下了一道道泛着蓝晕的光之追迹。

他们已经明白了苦难，[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的人们，在这一天见到了从天而降的蓝色火焰。
origin.1030.desc.en:
Our fleet managed to thwart the onslaught of creatures that came from the gateway. Down on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] our population had held their breath as the space battle raged overhead.

Despite hearts heavy with loss, it's still with a glimmer of hope that the inhabitants of our homeworld now look up at the sky. The carcasses of the gateway creatures, falling down toward the planet's surface, leave long trails of blue-tinted streaks across the sky as their alien bodies are incinerated upon atmospheric entry.

And of suffering did they know, the inhabitants of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], on this day when it rained blue fire.

origin.1030.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们的舰队设法阻止了从星门中涌现的生物大开杀戒。解救了[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上许多我们的子个体。

尽管心中怀着对逝者的沉重心情，[Root.GetName]上的住民仰望天空之时依旧满怀希望。星门生物的尸体，开始下坠到行星的表面。它们的尸体在进入大气层时被点燃，在天空中留下了一道道泛着蓝晕的光之追迹。

他们已经明白了苦难，[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的子个体，在这一天见到了从天而降的蓝色火焰。
origin.1030.desc.gestalt.en:
Our fleet managed to thwart the onslaught of creatures that came from the gateway, saving the lives of many of our drones down on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Despite our losses in the battle, the [Root.GetName] can now look to the future with a glimmer of hope. The carcasses of the gateway creatures, falling down toward the planet's surface, leave long trails of blue-tinted streaks across the sky as their alien bodies are incinerated upon atmospheric entry.

And of suffering did they know, the drones on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], on this day when it rained blue fire.

origin.1035.desc.zh:
没有任何预兆，星门再一次被开启，这一次从星门中释放出来的时一群敌对的、神秘的太空生物。

不到几分钟，这群神秘威胁就进入[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的轨道，并开始对星球表面投射泛着蓝色光晕的能量射线。

我们必须赶紧调集军力，立即将这股威胁抹杀，否则[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]将会被烤成一片焦墟，居住于其上的住民会因为射线灰飞烟灭。星球上的人们唯一能做的，只有寻找掩体躲避，然后眼睁睁地看着他们周围的世界被蓝色的火焰雨焚灭殆尽。
origin.1035.desc.en:
Without warning the gateway has once again opened up, this time releasing a swarm of hostile, enigmatic space creatures.

Within minutes this mysterious threat had taken position in orbit around [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and started to bombard the surface with blue-tinted energy beams.

We need to route our forces and stop this threat immediately, before [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] becomes a smouldering ruin, and its inhabitants turned into ash. All they can do down there now is seek shelter and wait while the world around them is ravaged by the a rain of blue fire.

origin.1035.desc.gestalt.zh:
没有任何预兆，星门再一次被开启，这一次从星门中释放出来的时一群敌对的、神秘的太空生物。

不到几分钟，这群神秘威胁就进入[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的轨道，并开始对星球表面投射泛着蓝色光晕的能量射线。

origin.1035.desc.gestalt.en:
Without warning the gateway has once again opened up, this time releasing a swarm of hostile, enigmatic space creatures.

Within minutes this mysterious threat had taken position in orbit around [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and started to bombard the surface with blue-tinted energy beams.

We need to route our forces and stop this threat immediately, before [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] becomes a smouldering ruin, and our drones on the surface turned into ash. All we can do for them now is have them seek shelter and wait while the world around them is ravaged by the a rain of blue fire.

origin.1040.desc.zh:
又一道能量激荡从星门射向了我们的母星系。和之前的能量振荡不同的是，这一次造成的后果是毁灭性的。

当电磁场扫过[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]，它使得行星上的所有电网过载，烧坏了所有的电子系统——有一些压根无从修复。

出于某些原因，星门之焰也对气候造成了改变，地表上的某几个地区在事故之后降水量于短期内骤增。主要城市大多陷入黑暗，当地居民目睹了蓝色的降水，那是渐息的能量火花照亮了天空中的雨点。
origin.1040.desc.en:
Another energy surge has flared out from the gateway in our home system. Unlike previous energy pulses, this one was devastating.

As the electromagnetic field swept over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] it overloaded every energy grid on the planet, frying every electrical system - some beyond repair.

For some reason the gateway flare also shook the climate, as heavy rainfalls began in several places momentarily after the incident. Most major cities are now completely dark, their population caught in a rainfall colored blue as dying energy sparks light up the heavy drops in the sky.

origin.1040.desc.gestalt.zh:
又一道能量激荡从星门射向了我们的母星系。和之前的能量振荡不同的是，这一次造成的后果是毁灭性的。

当电磁场扫过[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]，它使得行星上的所有电网过载，烧坏了所有的电子系统——有一些压根无从修复。

出于某些原因，星门之焰也对气候造成了改变，地表上的某几个地区在事故之后降水量于短期内骤增。大多数的大型定居点陷入黑暗，当地单位目睹了蓝色的降水，那是渐息的能量火花照亮了天空中的雨点。
origin.1040.desc.gestalt.en:
Another energy surge has flared out from the gateway in our home system. Unlike previous energy pulses, this one was devastating.

As the electromagnetic field swept over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] it overloaded every energy grid on the planet, frying every electrical system - some beyond repair.

For some reason the gateway flare also shook the climate, as heavy rainfalls began in several places momentarily after the incident. Most major habitations are now completely dark, their units caught in a rainfall colored blue as dying energy sparks light up the heavy drops in the sky.

origin.1050.A.en: The galaxy is at our doorstep.

origin.1050.desc.zh: 我们的科学家最终成功地打开了黑王冠，让我们的船通过另一边那个相同的装置。作为这个神秘星门的最后礼物，当它激活时，一股数据流被传输到我们的系统，揭示了其构造背后的原理，使得之前神秘的东西突然变得非常清晰易懂。现在，我们的科学家相信，在短短几年内，我们也将能够建造新的通道，将我们帝国内的旅行时间减少到几乎为零。
origin.1050.desc.en: Our scientists have finally succeeded in opening the Black Crown, allowing our ships to cross to a second, identical device on the other side. As a final gift from the gateway's enigmatic builders, as it was activated, a data stream was transmitted to our systems revealing the principles behind its construction, making what had previously been mysterious suddenly seem blindingly obvious. Our scientists are now confident that, within a few short years, we too will be able to build new gateways, cutting travel times within our empire to virtually zero.

origin.1050.name.en: The Black Crown Yields its Secrets

origin.1100.desc.zh:
我们从[From.Planet.GetName]的挖掘地点发回来的初步报告十分令人振奋，但又有点瘆人。

我们对撞击坑和其周边的地表残骸进行了分析，结果出人意料；显然那个未知物体在撞击发生的时候，既没有减速，也没有损坏。那个物体不知以什么方式击穿了泥土层，现在正停在地底深处。

我们随时可以进行进一步挖掘。
origin.1100.desc.en:
Initial reports from our excavation on [From.Planet.GetName] are both extraordinary and a bit unnerving.

Analysis of the surface debris in the impact crater and its immediate surrounding revealed a surprise; apparently the unknown object did neither break, nor brake, upon impact. Somehow the object managed to pierce through the soil, and is now resting deep in the ground.

Further excavations is ready to begin.

origin.1105.desc.zh:
随着在[From.Planet.GetName]上的发掘工作不断接近那个深藏在地下的物体，我们的科学家开始体验到了奇怪的现象。一眨眼间数个小时的时光便已流逝，崭新的设备突然就因磨损而报废，许多区域突然遍布残骸却没人知道怎么回事，如此等等。

科学团体对此无法做出确定的解释，但有一种理论声称撞击的物体由于穿透的星球的表层，因此便留下了能够扭曲时间的残留物。
origin.1105.desc.en:
As the excavation project on [From.Planet.GetName] got closer to the object resting deep in the ground, our scientists started to experience strange phenomena. Hours were lost in the blink of an eye, new equipment suddenly breaking due to wear and tear, areas cleared of debris and no one remembers how, and so on.

The scientific community can offer no real explanation, but one theory is that the crashed object left some kind of temporal-altering residue as it impaled the planet's crust.

origin.111.1.desc.zh:
自我们宣布夺取自由以来，我们已经历经了许多磨难。那艘载运我们抵达此地的舰船已经被我们发掘出了一切有价值的东西，现在它已经没有什么秘密可言了。

但是，我们决不能忘记过去的牺牲，更不能忘记挣脱镣铐的代价。坠毁的运奴船将被改造成一个公共纪念馆，以纪念我们国家的诞生。
origin.111.1.desc.en:
We have come a long way since claiming our freedom. The ship we arrived on has been stripped of everything of value, and our technology has advanced to the point that there are few secrets remaining.

But we must never forget the sacrifices of the past, nor the cost of casting off our shackles. The crashed slaver ship will be converted into a public memorial, commemorating the birth of our nation.

origin.111.2.desc.zh:
自我们抵达此地以来，我们已经经历了许多磨难。尽管我们失去了对那艘载运我们到达此地的飞船的控制权，那艘船上遗留的东西不再对我们有价值，我们的科技也进步到了空前的阶段，那里对我们来说已经不再有什么秘密了。

如果我们有一天将其复原，我们应当把这个地方改成一个纪念馆，以便我们在勇敢地走向未来时，还能记住我们卑微的开始。
origin.111.2.desc.en:
We have come a long way since our arrival. While we no longer control it, whatever remains on the ship we arrived on is no longer of value to us, and our technology has advanced to the point that there are few secrets remaining.

If we ever recover it, we shall convert the site into a memorial so we remember our humble beginnings as we move boldly into the future.

origin.1110.desc.zh:
我们的发掘小组最后终于抵达了坠落在[From.Planet.GetName]上未知物体最后停下的位置。

结果我们发现，这个东西看上去没什么大不了的，和一个华丽的炮弹没什么区别。不过随后其所处的空间就震撼了我们的科学家们。

这里是一个巨大的穴室，除了最开始这个物体降临而在天花板上撞破的一个洞之外，整个穴室没有一处出入口，是完全密封的。穴室的墙壁由一层半透明的奇怪镀层覆盖，我们的科学家现在迫切想要对其进行进一步的调查。
origin.1110.desc.en:
Our excavation team finally reached the final resting place for the unknown object that crashed on [From.Planet.GetName].

As it turned out, the object was of minor interest - being little more than a glorified cannonball - but the location quickly astonished the scientists.

It was a huge chamber, hermetically sealed with no entry points other than the smashed hole in the ceiling where the object had come down. The walls were covered with strange, translucent plates that our scientists are now eager to scrutinize further.

origin.1115.desc.zh:
覆盖在位于[From.Planet.GetName]神秘穴室墙壁上的半透明镀层似乎毫无意义，直到一位队员用手轻轻触碰了一下。

整个穴室迅速被全息投影生成文字的光芒填充，发光的符号一行接一行地悬浮在半空。这些符号被迅速翻译后，穴室中镀层的意义终于显现出来，这是一个外星构件的详细蓝图。

一个也许能打开星门的外星构件。
origin.1115.desc.en:
The translucent plates covering the walls of the mysterious chamber found on [From.Planet.GetName] made little sense until one team member reached out and gently touched one:

The room exploded in light as holographic glyphs appeared out of nowhere - row after row of glowing symbols hovering in mid-air. The symbols were deftly translated and purpose of the plates in the chamber became clear: they contained detailed blueprints of an alien construction.

A construction that would open the gateway.

origin.12.b.zh: 我们的先辈显然信任着我们。
origin.12.b.en: Our elders clearly have faith in us.

origin.12.desc.zh:
从[from.GetName]的船员发回了一封紧急讯息，在[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中找到了[fromfrom.GetName]。

“[fromfrom.GetName]”……光是这个名字本身就已是传奇，有许多传说都是从摹照[overlord.GetName]流传下来的。[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们都知道这个地方是天堂，是无形的希望的灯塔。尽管我们肉眼可见其神圣性，但我们现在也面临着一个残酷的事实：这个神话般的圣地在现实中确实存在。

[overlord.GetName]还没有对我们的发现发表任何言论，但我们发现了他们非常密切地关注着这颗星球的证据。他们知道我们在这里，我们不知道如何解释他们对此一言不发。
origin.12.desc.en:
Priority dispatch from the crew of [from.GetName], in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system: we have found [fromfrom.GetName].

"[fromfrom.GetName]"... Its very name is the stuff of legends, many of which were handed down in scripture from the [overlord.GetName]. Many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know this place to be paradise - a beacon of intangible hope - and though we can see that it is indeed divine, we are now also faced with a blunt fact: this mythical, holy place actually exists.

The [overlord.GetName] have yet to say anything about our discovery, but we found evidence that they watch this world very closely. They know we are here; we do not know how to interpret their silence.

origin.1200.desc.a.zh:
我们在卫星的表面设置了一个行动基地，并派出了数个小队前往之前我们在扫描器上捕捉到的异常现象地点。

这一神秘现象的重要意义非比寻常，科学界也对于考察队可能发现什么提出了诸多理论和设想。
origin.1200.desc.a.en:
A base of operations has been set up on the surface of the moon, and several teams are now en route to the various anomaly sites that our scanners picked up.

The significance of this mystery is simply unparalleled, and the scientific community is absolutely buzzing with theories and anticipation over what will be uncovered by the excursion teams.

origin.1200.desc.b.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的表面设置了一个行动基地，并派出了数个小队前往之前我们在扫描器上捕捉到的异常现象地点。

这一神秘现象的重要意义非比寻常，科学界也对于考察队可能发现什么提出了诸多理论和设想。
origin.1200.desc.b.en:
A base of operations has been set up on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName], and several teams are now en route to the various anomaly sites that our scanners picked up.

The significance of this mystery is simply unparalleled, and the scientific community is absolutely buzzing with theories and anticipation over what will be uncovered by the excursion teams.

origin.1205.desc.zh:
大多数考察队都到达了目的地，并发回了报告。

埋在地底的文物被发掘出来。首席科学官[Leader.GetName]将它们形容为十分精准的，星系级激光指向器——一种远古的机器，其作用是向太空发射高强度的、密实的紫外线射束，目的未知。

这真是一个喜忧参半的发现；外星文物的发现有着深远、令人振奋的重要性，然而它们的意图却看上去毫无章法。
origin.1205.desc.en:
Most excursion teams have reached their destinations and reported back.

Artifacts buried in the ground have been uncovered. Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] describes them as highly accurate, galactic laser pointers - ancient machines that are emitting a strong, tight ultraviolet beam out into space for purposes unknown.

It's a bittersweet discovery; the profound, exhilarating importance of alien artifacts countered by their seemingly arbitrary purpose.

origin.1210.desc.zh:
尽管我们尽了最大的努力，对在地表上的外星指示器的发掘和分析并没有带来任何有关联的结果。

考古队对外星信号射束进行了计算，并沿途一路追到头，但除了虚空什么也没有发现。

科学官[Leader.GetName]要求给予更多的时间；坚信科学团队可能错过了什么重要的东西。
origin.1210.desc.en:
Despite our best efforts the excavation and analysis of the alien indicators on the surface have failed to deliver any relevant result.

The archaeological teams have calculated and followed the paths of the alien signal beams, but nothing is being pointed at other than empty space.

Scientist [Leader.GetName] have requested more time; convinced that something has been missed by the science teams.

origin.1215.desc.a.zh:
突破性进展！

对地表的研究揭示了该卫星在几个纪元前曾经被一颗小行星撞击过。撞击并不足以摧毁这颗卫星，不过将其稍稍推出了原来的轨道。通过分析这次撞击，科学家们成功地推演出了这颗卫星最初的位置和自转，并用这些数据进行“倒带”，重演了外星指示器原本所指的位置。

于是乎，这个外星指示器的光束突然开始汇聚到恒星系内的另一颗行星上。
origin.1215.desc.a.en:
Breakthrough!

Study of the surface revealed that the moon was hit eons ago by a small asteroid. The impact was not enough to obliterate the moon but did nudge it a fraction out of its original orbit. By analyzing the impact, the scientists managed to calculate the moon's initial position and rotation, and used that data to 'rewind' the alien indicators to their original position.

And there it was: the alien indicator beams suddenly began converging on another planet in the system!

origin.1215.desc.b.zh:
突破性进展！

对地表的研究揭示了[From.Planet.GetName]在几个纪元前曾经被一颗小行星撞击过。撞击并不足以摧毁这颗卫星，不过将其稍稍推出了原来的轨道。通过分析这次撞击，科学家们成功地推演出了[From.Planet.GetName]最初的位置和自转，并用这些数据进行“倒带”，重演了外星指示器原本所指的位置。

于是乎，这个外星指示器的光束突然开始汇聚到恒星系内的另一颗行星上。
origin.1215.desc.b.en:
Breakthrough!

Study of the surface revealed that [From.Planet.GetName] was hit eons ago by a small asteroid. The impact was not enough to obliterate the planet but did nudge it a fraction out of its original orbit. By analyzing the impact, the scientists managed to calculate [From.Planet.GetName]'s initial position and rotation, and used that data to 'rewind' the alien indicators to their original position.

And there it was: the alien indicator beams suddenly began converging on another planet in the system!

origin.1220.desc.zh:
我们的考古学家已经开始了在[From.Planet.GetName]地表的工作。地震学勘测很快就在此前指示器指向的位置附近的地下发现了空洞区域。

地下的空穴非常巨大而且神秘，尽管如此有一件事情我们的专家们可以肯定：它绝非天然形成的。它一定是被人出于一定的目的建造出来的。
origin.1220.desc.en:
Our archaeological team have started their work down on [From.Planet.GetName]. Seismographic readings quickly isolated a hollow area underground on the rough location indicated by the alien indicators previously discovered.

The underground expanse is vast, and despite its mysterious nature one thing is beyond doubt amongst the experts: It's not natural. Someone built it with a specific purpose in mind.

origin.1225.desc.zh:
挖掘小队终于来到了地下结构。规模庞大，棱角分明的厅堂由隧道相连。由于几乎没看到任何装饰，要鉴别建立这个结构的目的很困难。

当[Leader.GetName]进入主室的时候，一阵低沉的声音突然回荡起来。起初这只是雷鸣般地噪声，但这声音逐渐扭变，直到变成一股空洞的人声，不断用我们的语言重复单一的句子：

“你们准备好了吗？”

雷鸣般地人声伴随着一阵低沉的轰隆声，一座巨墙突然缓慢移开，一条黑暗的走廊显现出来。我们的考古学家迫切地想进一步深入。
origin.1225.desc.en:
The excavation crew has finally reached the underground structure. Vast, angular halls and tunnels were explored. A complete lack of adornment made it difficult to establish the purpose of the structure.

When [Leader.GetName] entered the main chamber a deep sound suddenly reverberated. Initially just thundering noise, the sound slowly contorted until an incorporeal voice spoke a single sentence in our language:

'Are you ready?'

The booming voice was followed by deep rumble as one of the giant walls slowly slid away to reveal a dark corridor. Our archaeologists eagerly went inside.

origin.1230.desc.zh:
黑暗走廊的末端是一个空的、圆形的房室。刚一走进，那股回荡的人声再一次说话，表示只有有资格之人才能继续。

短小的走廊从圆形房室引向了三个更小的房间——每一个房间里都包含某种物理学相关的谜题。

[Leader.GetName]相信这是一些科学谜题——只要能解开——能够引起整个结构触发特定的反应，但这全都是推测。
origin.1230.desc.en:
The dark corridor led to an empty, round chamber. Stepping inside, the disembodied voice spoke yet again, saying that only the deserving may continue.

Short corridors connected the round chamber to three other, small rooms - each containing some kind of physics-oriented problem.

[Leader.GetName] believes that these are scientific riddles that - once solved - may provoke some reaction in the structure, but it's all speculation.

origin.1235.desc.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]地下深处的神秘房间中的全部三个科学谜题都已被解答。

正如[Leader.GetName]先前怀疑的一样，这一结构对外星试炼的正确解答作出了反应。在最后一个谜团得到解决的同时，一个云状全息投影在主室中乍然突现。那是对我们恒星系的高分辨率描写，附有多种外星科技的滚动说明。

明亮的光点标明了星系中的另一处位置。搜索还将继续。
origin.1235.desc.en:
All three science puzzles have been completed in the mysterious chambers deep underground the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

Just as [Leader.GetName] suspected, the structure responded to the correct solutions for the alien trials. As the last riddle was solved, a cloudy holographic projection exploded to life in the main chamber. It was a fine-resolution depiction of our solar system, along with scrolling instructions for various alien technologies.

Another galactic position was indicated by a bright point of light. The search continues.

origin.1240.desc.zh:
在一段漫长而艰难的[From.Planet.GetName]地表深挖以后，挖掘队进入了另一个底下结构中。

尽管数据表明这个结构是个洞，但是我们并没有找到可以进入的入口。它似乎被完全地封闭了，其保护墙采用了某种未知的具有难以置信的结构强度的金属——实际上我们的传统挖掘设备都没法把它划个印！

我们需要付出大量的努力来进入这里，好消息是我们将会一直努力。
origin.1240.desc.en:
After a long, arduous period of digging deep into the crust of [From.Planet.GetName] the excavation team reached another underground structure.

Despite readings indicating that the building is hollow, no entry point can be found. It appears to be hermetically sealed, and the protective walls are made of some unknown material with extreme structural integrity. Conventional digging equipment doesn't even scratch it!

It will require some serious effort to get through, but the project is already underway.

origin.1245.desc.zh:
在几个月的艰苦努力下，使用一种强大的高频高温激光，挖掘队终于撬开了这个地下建筑。

在地下室被打开后，那个无源的声音又响了起来，表达出对我们对于解决这个挑战决心的赞许，因此我们将会得到奖励。

所以就是这样。地下室埋藏着各种各样的珍宝，数不尽的财宝、某种未来可以被研究的未知科技······
origin.1245.desc.en:
After months of hard work, using a powerful beam which combines intense fusion heat with high-frequency vibration, the excavation team has finally managed to crack the underground structure.

As soon as the vault was cracked, the disembodied voice-recording spoke again. It declared that our determination had been proven, that another trial had been completed, and that we were to be rewarded accordingly.

And so we were. The bunker contained all sort of valuables, not least of which: hitherto unknown technologies which can be investigated further.

origin.1250.desc.zh:
大量的地震学读数经汇总分析形成了[From.Planet.GetName]地下结构的高度准确的视觉模型。

这似乎是一个由棱角分明的走廊连成的网络，每条走廊均达数千米长。整个结构主要由走廊构成，只有位于建筑底部的一处开放空间例外。

在我们抵达站点并对其进行适当的调查之前，无法再诠释出更多内容。
origin.1250.desc.en:
Extensive seismographic readings have been compiled into a highly accurate, visual model of the underground structure on [From.Planet.GetName].

It appears to be a vast network of angular corridors, each several kilometers long. The entire structure is mostly corridors, with the exception of one open space at the bottom of the building.

More than that cannot be interpreted until we reach and investigate the site properly.

origin.1255.desc.zh:
考古队终于在这个地下工事上打开了通道，进入了空荡荡的走廊。

走廊完全是空的。仔细检查后，能发现墙壁上刻着小且奇怪的铭文。对该外星文字的翻译结果令人困惑，后来才发现这些都是外星人的名字。为数多达百万的名字。

考古学家现在正朝着最深处的房间前进，但时不时出现的坍塌走廊段阻碍着他们的前进。
origin.1255.desc.en:
The science team finally breached the underground complex, and entered the empty corridors.

The long tunnels were completely empty. On closer inspection the walls appeared to be covered in small, strange inscriptions. Translation of the alien language was a highly confusing process, until it was discovered that the writing consisted of nothing but alien names, numbering in the millions.

Archaeologists are now pressing onwards to the bottom chamber, but their effort is hindered by caved-in corridors which need to be cleared.

origin.1260.desc.zh:
我们投放到[From.Planet.GetName]科学小队已经抵达了房间的最低处。他们在那里发现了一份古老的档案：某种个人汇报。

“我们失败了，无情者撕裂了我们的整只舰队而没有丝毫拖泥带水。什么也没剩下。我们终将死在这里，死在我们纪念阵亡将士的厅堂里。

我们为那些躺在病房里的伤员而感到担心，无情者会找到他们，然后……”

这里没有任何打斗的迹象，没有尸体，只剩下空旷的纪念堂与死一般的寂静。
origin.1260.desc.en:
Our science team down on [From.Planet.GetName] has reached the bottom chamber of the memorial structure. There they found an ancient recorded message; some kind of personal debriefing:

'We failed. The Relentless cut through our entire navy without even slowing down. All is lost now. We will die here, in these halls of tribute to fallen brethren.

We fear for the lives of our wards. The Relentless will find them, and then they...'

There's no sign of a struggle. No bodies. Only empty halls and the silence of the ones who perished.

origin.1265.desc.zh:
首席科学官[Leader.GetName]想要彻底的搜寻纪念堂，不放过每个角落。他是对的。在其中的一个回廊里，一个小设备被找到了。在这个设备上，我们抢救出了一段小信息碎片。

“成···！它们的精神能力被关闭了，它们的聪明才智被移除了——它们不构成威胁了。

这应该够了。我们只剩下这一件事可以做。”

这个设备同时储存了一些新坐标。[Leader.GetName]希望尽快对这些坐标进行探查。
origin.1265.desc.en:
Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] wanted to comb through every nook and cranny of the memorial site. It paid off: a small device was discovered in one of the corridors. A small fragment of information could be salvaged from it:

'...ould work! With their mental faculties shut off - their very intellect removed - they would pose no threat.

It must be enough. It's the only thing left that we can do.'

The device also included some new coordinates. [Leader.GetName] would like to investigate these as soon as possible.

origin.1270.desc.zh:
这次的任务用不上铲子或钻孔激光。首席科学官[Leader.GetName]和考古团队径直走进了外星人的废墟。

这处遗址非常古老——已有一千多年的历史，但保存完好。它似乎是为某一特定目的而建造的一种集散地。能看到几个实验室，还有几个规模庞大的储藏库。

考古团队发现了一个数字档案服务器。它已停止运转，但看起来很完整。希望它能填补失落的施恩者相关线索的空白之处。
origin.1270.desc.en:
There was no need for shovels or drilling lasers this time around. Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] and the archaeology team simply walked into the alien ruin.

The site is very old - more than a thousand years, but fairly well kept. It appears to be some kind of staging area, built for a specific purpose. There are several laboratories and large storage hangars.

The team have found a digital archive server. It's offline, but appears fairly intact. Hopefully it will fill in the blanks regarding our lost Benefactors.

origin.1275.desc.zh:
考古团队成功获取了外星人数字档案，并设法使其运行。该档案里包含一些内容混乱的日志，需进行进一步解读。

日志中反复出现名为意识抹除方案的术语，它似乎是这里的研究工作的重点。施恩者显然开发了神智操纵技术，但是该技术的实现方式或开发该技术的目的仍然未知。
origin.1275.desc.en:
The science team managed to get the alien digital archives up and running. They exclusively contained arbitrary logs, which require some liberal interpretation.

The phrase 'Mind-Wipe Initiative' occurs frequently throughout the logs, and it appears to have been the specific focus of research at this location. Apparently the Benefactors developed the technology by which they could manipulate the effectiveness of mental faculties, but how or for what purpose remains unknown.

origin.1280.desc.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古团队发现了另一个古老的数字档案。该档案也包含很多流水账式的日志，但是有一条值得关注：

“飞船已经起飞。我们知道他们会成功，但他们离开时没有任何希望和兴致。我们知道这个任务，以及我们在这里所做的工作，是不正当的……甚至称得上是卑劣的。

但是替代方案……替代方案更糟。”

这是在这个古老的设施中发现的最后一个条目之一。虽然算不上了结，但至少有了很多技术上的发现。
origin.1280.desc.en:
The archaeology team on [From.Planet.GetName] has found another ancient digital archive. This too consisted mostly of logs, but there was one journal entry of particular interest:

'The ship has taken off. We know they'll succeed, but there was no sense of hope or high spirits as they left. We know that the mission and the work we've done here are wrong... Despicable.

But the alternative... The alternative is worse.'

That is one of the last entries found at the ancient facility. Not much of a closure, but at least plenty of technological discoveries were made.

origin.1285.desc.zh:
在清扫存储区域期间，一名工作人员发现了一个来源不明的小型设备，它被带到[Leader.GetName]面前，并被查明是一种记录设备。它已严重破损，但其中一小段对话仍可读取：

“……不应被遗忘——应当有人来澄清事实，为他们发声。历史或许会容忍这一切，但我的良心不能。”

进一步对当初作为噪声丢弃的一串数据进行研究后。发现那原来是加密的坐标。
origin.1285.desc.en:
Clearing out the storage areas, one of the workers found a small device of unknown origin. It was brought to [Leader.GetName] and turned out to be a recording device. It was badly damaged, but a small snippet of dialog was saved:

'...houldn't be forgotten - someone has to come clean and speak up for them. History may endure, but my conscience cannot.'

A string of data first discarded as noise was investigated further. It turned out to be encrypted coordinates.

origin.1290.desc.zh:
被派到[From.Planet.GetName]表面的团队遇到了比预期多得多的困难。

在古老的外星人研究基地中找到的坐标指向[From.Planet.GetName]的一片异常崎岖的区域，那里到处都是悬崖和裂谷。

不过，他们依然在继续前进，最终到达了指定的地点——一个自然形成的洞穴。已无需发令让他们抵近观察，洞穴探险已经开始了。
origin.1290.desc.en:
The team we sent down to the surface of [From.Planet.GetName] encountered far more obstacles than anticipated.

The coordinates we received in the ancient alien research base pointed to an exceptionally craggy part of [From.Planet.GetName], where the landscape was filled with vertical stone surfaces and deep fissures.

The team pressed on, and eventually reached the indicated location: a natural cave formation. No need to ask them to take a closer look; the spelunking is already afoot.

origin.1295.desc.zh:
考古队正在调查[From.Planet.GetName]上的自然洞穴。他们发现了一个废弃的大仓库，储存着一些有价值的原料。没有门，没有锁，也没有陷阱——单纯的一个装满了贵重工业品的洞穴。

首席科学官[Leader.GetName]希望进一步调查。这些东西摆放实在过于显眼，以至于让人怀疑这是一个骗局，即这批藏品只是用来掩饰另一个尚未发现的宝藏的幌子。
origin.1295.desc.en:
The archaeology team that was investigating the natural cave down on [From.Planet.GetName] have reported back. They found a tremendous, abandoned stockpile of valuable resources. There were no doors, no locks and no traps - just a cave full of industrial valuables.

Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] would like to investigate further still. Plentiful as it may be, the obviousness of the booty has evoked a theory that the hidden cache is merely a ruse - that another type of treasure is yet to be found.

origin.13.hasmet.desc.zh:
$origin.13.desc.intro$

这件装置高度的复杂性甚至可以比肩[overlord.GetAdj]的科技；因此我们相信这座信标属于附近的[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]。至于其作用：我们尚无法完全确定，但似乎[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将这颗星球视作神圣。
origin.13.hasmet.desc.en:
$origin.13.desc.intro$

The sheer sophistication of this device parallels that of even [overlord.GetAdj] technology; we therefore believe the marker belongs to the nearby [spi_fallen_empire.GetName]. As to its purpose: we cannot say for sure, but it seems likely the [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] consider this world to be holy.

origin.13.notmet.desc.zh:
$origin.13.desc.intro$

这件装置高度的复杂性甚至可以比肩[overlord.GetAdj]的科技，然而其设计却截然外物。因此我们只能假定这座信标属于现存或过去存在过的某个与他们相当的文明。按其外表所刻蚀的许多符号判断，它似乎用于标定一处圣地。
origin.13.notmet.desc.en:
$origin.13.desc.intro$

The sheer sophistication of this device parallels that of even [overlord.GetAdj] technology, however its design is distinctly alien. We must therefore assume the marker belongs to some contemporary of theirs, past or present. Judging by the various symbols etched onto its exterior: it may even be marking out a holy site.

origin.1300.a.zh: 这故事的高潮，真不知是何滋味。

origin.1300.desc.zh:
资源仓库确实是一个骗局——真正的宝藏被发现于一扇隐藏的门后面：一个施恩者种族的人最后录制的信息。

很久以前，他们与凶残的外星种族无情者交战。无数的文明在无情者的猎杀中被灭亡，而施恩者们也将成为下一个。绝望的施恩者想尽一切来阻止末日到来。他们成功了：一种破坏无情者的神智的设备，瞬间将整个无情者种族变成了原始人。

无情者被剥夺了理智，变得服从无害。施恩者将他们集中捕获，放逐到我们的家乡。

无情者是我们的祖先。
origin.1300.desc.en:
The resource cache was indeed a deception. The real treasure lay behind a hidden door: a final message, recorded by one of the Benefactor aliens.

Eons ago they were at war with a merciless alien race known as The Relentless. Entire civilizations had already perished in the Relentless' wake, and the Benefactors were next. The desperate Benefactors sought their last resort, before all would be lost. They succeeded with a device that ravaged The Relentless' neurological physique, instantaneously primitivizing an entire race.

Robbed of their bloodthirsty intellect, The Relentless became docile and harmless. The Benefactors rounded them up and exiled them to our home world.

The Relentless are our ancestors.

origin.1305.desc.zh:
资源仓库是一个骗局。最终我们在山洞中发现了一个隐藏的录音设备：

“很久以前，我的种族——当时被称作无情者，在整个星系中掀起战乱，任何挡在我们面前的感性外星人都会被我们的舰队无情地碾碎。

最终我们脱离了作为战争贩子的生存之道。我们看着残酷的历史，不再感到骄傲，只感到羞耻和悲哀。

我们追寻祖先的赎……”

其余的内容乱七八糟。科学官[Leader.GetName]确信可以恢复失真内容，但这需要时间。
origin.1305.desc.en:
The resource cache was a deception. A hidden recording device was eventually found within the cave:

'Eons ago, my species - known at the time as The Relentless - laid waste to the galaxy. Any sentient alien that crossed our path was engaged by our fleets without hesitation or mercy.

Eventually we evolved beyond our warmonger ways. We looked at our savage history and no longer felt pride - only shame and regret.

Retracing our ancestor's ste...'

The rest is scrambled. Scientist [Leader.GetName] is convinced that distortion can be restored, but it will take some time.

origin.1310.a.zh: 接受这一切，并迈步向前。

origin.1310.desc.zh:
[Leader.GetName]已成功修复了外星人录音中损坏的部分：

“我们追寻祖先的赎罪步伐，来到了这个星系。我们的祖先在这里灭亡了$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$种族。那时我们不知道$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$通过使[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]变成对我们无害的原始人，将[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]从我们眼皮底下掩藏起来。

这种效果是不可逆的。[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]仍然只是原始人。现在，我们希望有一天他们能够重返太空，并希望他们找到我们留下的赎罪标记。”

就这样，我们的历史得到了解释。现在，让我们关注未来。
origin.1310.desc.en:
[Leader.GetName] has successfully restored the scrambled alien recording:

'Retracing our ancestor's steps on a quest for redemption, we reached this system. Here our predecessors annihilated the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ race. We didn't know then that the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ had concealed another species - the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] - by using a procedure which suppressed the intellectual capacity of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], rendering them harmless to us.

This effect is irreversible. The [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] are still mere savages. Now we hope that one day they'll find their way back to the stars, and that they find our tokens of atonement.'

And there it is: our history explained. Now let's focus on the future.

origin.1315.a.zh: 我们不要被利用了！睁大眼睛看清楚！
origin.1315.a.en: We are not pawns! Just watch!

origin.1315.desc.zh:
在一堵假石洞墙后面，考古团队发现了一系列数据片段。它们揭示了这样一个故事：

很久以前，两个主要阵营之间发生了主权的争夺战，施恩者一方陷入了僵局。为了取得优势，一方发起了一场假旗行动，冒充另一方攻击了一个弱小的种族——也就是我们的祖先。

名为“突触阻尼炸弹”的装置在我们曾经的母星上爆炸。它未对环境产生破坏，但其脉冲影响了我们祖先的大脑，使他们退化了。

留给我们的赠礼表明，施恩者最终寻求赎罪。
origin.1315.desc.en:
The archaeology team found a collection of data snippets behind a fake cave wall. As we scrutinized them, a theme began to emerge.

Eons ago the Benefactors were locked in stalemate as two major factions wrestled for sovereignty. In an effort to gain advantage, one side executed a false flag operation: posing as their own opposition, they attacked a lesser species - our ancestors.

A 'synaptic dampener bomb' was triggered on our home planet. It did nothing to the ecology, but the pulse affected our ancestor's brains, causing them to regress.

The tokens left behind for us indicate that the Benefactors eventually sought redemption.

origin.1320.a.zh: 看看我们！我们不需要施舍。
origin.1320.a.en: Witness us! We don't need any charity.

origin.1320.desc.zh:
挖掘队在一堵假墙后面发现了一个记录装置，里面是一位施恩者的自白。

很久以前，施恩者通过技术手段使我们的物种“失了智”，以躲避某种迫在眉睫的星系级威胁。尽管这可能出于好心，但威胁过去后，施恩者并未恢复我们祖先的神智，他们抛弃了我们。

在这里发现的设备和技术是一个独立团体留下的恩惠，这个团体同情我们那已陷于蒙昧的前辈。
origin.1320.desc.en:
Hidden behind a fake wall, the excavation team found a single recording device containing the confessions of one of the Benefactors.

Eons ago, the Benefactors 'dumbed down' our species by technological intervention, in order to hide us from some kind of impending galactic threat. Benevolent as that may have seemed, once the threat had passed the Benefactors spent no effort in trying to restore our ancestors' faculties - they simply abandoned us.

The sites and technology discovered in our home system are boons, left by an independent group which took pity on our diminished predecessors.

origin.1325.desc.zh:
在假墙的后面，发掘队发现了一个录音设备，其中包含神秘的施恩者留下的消息。

他们正在与一些恶毒、令人作呕的外星人种族进行一场绝望的战争。为了使我们远离敌人的进攻，他们使用技术破坏了我们祖先的思维能力，希望敌人不要理会一个孤立的星球上的[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]物种。

这对我们是有用的，但最终施恩者们的命运却走到了尽头。他们给我们留下了这些隐藏的资源库存和技术，希望有一天我们能找到它们。
origin.1325.desc.en:
Secreted behind a fake wall, the excavation team found a single recording device containing a message left by the mysterious Benefactors.

They were fighting a desperate war against an unnamed, malevolent and warmongering alien race. In an effort to hide us from the enemy's advance they used technology to suppress the intellectual capacity of our ancestors, hoping that the enemy would bear no heed to the [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] species of a single, isolated planet.

It worked for us, but the fate of the Benefactors was forfeit. They left us these hidden caches of resources and technology, hoping that one day we'd find them.

origin.1330.desc.zh:
最终，我们真实历史中遗失的片段解释清楚了我们历史记载中的冲突之处。我们一直以为，我们文明的进步靠的是我们自己，孤独和独立。现在我们知道了，我们一直站在巨人的肩膀上。

我们无法改变过去。我们应当释然并继续前进——接受过去不是沉重的负担，而是迈向未来之路的垫脚石。

是我们成为巨人的时候了。
origin.1330.desc.en:
Finally, the inconsistencies in our history have been explained, using these lost chapters from our true heritage. We had once believed that the advancement of our civilization came of our own accord - solitary and independent. Now we know that in all this time, we had been standing on the shoulders of giants.

We cannot change the past. We reconcile and we move on - accepting our past not as a dark burden, but as a stepping stone on our path forward into the future.

It is our time to become giants.

origin.1335.desc.zh:
在例行的星系扫描中，我们的一个传感器接收到了一条微弱且奇特的能量信号。很有可能是聚变引擎或类似设备留下的痕迹，但其特征与我们迄今为止遇到的任何东西都不匹配，而且它似乎太过古旧-信号已发出几千年了！我们的科学家中有人提出了一种理论，认为该聚变引擎的痕迹是“施恩者”留下的。

我们应该尽快将我们的深空探测部门的工作重心转移到该研究项目上。
origin.1335.desc.en:
During a routine system scan one of our sensors picked up a small - but strange - energy signature. It's quite likely trace exhaust from a fusion drive or something similar, but the signature doesn't match anything we've encountered so far, and it appears to be remarkably old - several thousands of years! One theory amongst our scientists is that the fusion drive trail might belong to the Benefactors.

We should assign our astro-science department to this research project as soon as we can.

origin.1340.desc.zh:
这条由聚变引擎留下的古老痕迹由于年代过于久远而难以分析。最终科学机构终于设法计算出了一条可能的航行轨迹，轨迹通向一个不过几跳之内但迄今为止无人发现的未知恒星系。

目标星系确认开放，我们应该考虑派出一艘科研船来做进一步的调查。
origin.1340.desc.en:
The old fusion drive trail turned out be quite challenging to analyze due to its considerable age. Eventually the science department managed to calculate a likely navigation vector, and establish that the trail was pointing to a hitherto unknown system not many jumps away.

The destination has been made available, and we should consider sending a science vessel there to investigate further.

origin.1345.desc.zh:
在传感器对[From.solar_system.GetName]进行了第一次全面扫描之后，显而易见的是很久以前在这片恒星系中发生过大规模极具破坏性的暴力冲突。

损坏的舰船碎片与残骸散布在恒星系的四处，虚空中充满着由激光武器与聚变炸弹产生的残留能量.

在这片寂静的墓地中一个单一的信号被分离了出来，它来自附近的一个小型空间站。
origin.1345.desc.en:
Even after the first, broad sensor reading of the [From.solar_system.GetName] system it became clear that something very violent and destructive occurred here eons ago.
