Broken spaceship parts and debris are scattered throughout the system, and the local void is teeming with energy residue from weaponized lasers and fusion explosions.

In this silent graveyard a single signal has been isolated, and it's coming from a small space station nearby.

origin.1350.desc.zh:
被截获的信号来源于空间站上的某个紧急弹射舱。由于毁坏极为严重，这座损毁的空间站没有留下太多能告诉我们这里发生过什么的线索。我们的科学家设法将数据片段整合到一起以拼凑出事件经过。

这座空间站就是发明意识抹除科技（就是那个让我们祖先变得愚笨的科技）的科研设施。这座空间及其防御舰队被某支未知力量所控制，而这项科技也大概率被其盗取。

有一段尤为有趣的文本被翻译完毕，那是来自敌军舰队的无线电对话。

“他们正试图逃跑！跟上他们，用他们自己的武器攻击他们，看看他们会怎么享受这些炮火”

我们检测到了一道新的聚变引擎航迹，并基于航迹确定了一条离开的航道。
origin.1350.desc.en:
The signal we picked up originated from an emergency pod aboard the space station. Due to severe damage, the dead station left few clues to what happened here. Our scientists have managed to piece together snippets of data, in order to form a narrative.

This station was a research facility, and is where the Mind-Wipe technology was invented - the same technology used to diminish our ancestors. The station and its protective fleet were engaged by some unknown force, after which the technology was most likely stolen.

One particularly interesting message has been translated - radio chatter from the enemy fleet:

'They're trying to escape! Follow them. Use their own weapon against them. See how they like it.'

We've picked up a new fusion drive trail and established an exit vector based on it.

origin.1351.desc.zh: 在这个未经探索的星系中，施恩者的航迹消失了。我们的远程传感器没有发现任何异常，但我们应该对星系进行适当的调查，看看我们能找到什么。
origin.1351.desc.en: The trail of the Benefactors ends in this unexplored system. Our long range sensor doesn't pick up anything unusual, but we should survey the system properly to see what we can find.

origin.1355.desc.zh:
在这个恒星系中发现的[GetPreFTLLower]物种不是别的，正是$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$——在我们的文化中，更常用的称呼是施恩者。

我们的异种学家对细节还不确定，但一切都表明，不知何故，他们成了自己的神智抹除技术的牺牲品，被留在这个星球上自生自灭。没有人比我们更清楚这种命运的含义。

我们应该仔细考虑接下来的行动。
origin.1355.desc.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] species found in this system is none other than the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ - known more commonly in our culture as the Benefactors.

Our xenologists are unsure of the details, but everything indicates that they somehow fell victim to their own mind-wiping technology, and were left on this planet to fend for themselves. No one knows the implications of this fate better than we do.

We should consider our next step carefully.

origin.1360.desc.zh:
有时宇宙中的事件会以最诗意的方式展开。我们祖先曾经无可争议的主人，$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$，最终与我们的祖先遭受了同样的命运。

无论他们的本意如何，我们都必须承认，他们在某种程度上试图挽回他们绝望和过激的行为。

世世代代过去了，双方地位颠倒了过来，我们还了他们的恩惠。

就像[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]物种曾经经历过的那样，现在是时候让$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$体验站在巨人肩膀上的感受了。
origin.1360.desc.en:
Sometimes the events of the universe unfold in a most poetic fashion. Once the undisputable masters of our ancestors, the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ species eventually found themselves struck by the same fate as our ancestors.

Whatever their intention might have been, we must acknowledge the fact that to some degree, they tried to redeem their desperate and excessive act.

Now that eons have passed, the sides have been reversed, and we have returned their favor.

Just as the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species once did, now it's time for the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ to experience what it means to stand on the shoulders of giants.

origin.1365.desc.zh: 所有的人力物力都被集中到了[From.Planet.GetName]的表面。下一步就是将其埋入足够深的地下，使得它能够经受得住时间和气候的考验。
origin.1365.desc.en: All the materiel and manpower has been sent down to the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Next step is to bury it deep enough that it will stand the tests of both time and weather.

origin.1370.a.zh: 希望他们能够找到自己的生存之道。

origin.1370.desc.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表之下深埋了大量的资源和科技蓝图。我们也设下了一个信标，希望假以时日$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$能够发现它。
origin.1370.desc.en: A generous cache of resources and technology blueprints has been buried deep beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. A beacon was placed as well, and in time we can only hope that the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ will find it.

origin.1380.desc.zh:
我们的传感器在母星系捕捉到了一股奇怪的能量信号。这股信号十分强大，一开始人们还以为是仪器出了问题，但进一步的检查表明这个读数是由一个聚变推进器在久远之前造成的能量轨迹。

为了了解更多情况我们需要更深层次的分析，但是有可能这道追迹是无情者千年之前离开我们星系的时候留下的。

我们应该进一步调查。
origin.1380.desc.en:
One of our sensors recently picked up a strange energy signature in our home system. It was almost dismissed as a glitch at first; upon closer inspection the reading turned out to be an ancient energy trail from a fusion-based propulsion drive.

Deeper analysis is needed to know more, but it is possible that this trail was left by the Relentless when they left our system thousands of years ago.

We should investigate this further.

origin.1385.desc.zh:
尽管年代久远，我们的科学部门还是设法分析了引擎追迹，并得到了它的退出矢量。这意味着我们可以追踪那个我们在上古年代遇到的那个恶魔了。

时间能否完全抹平他们狂躁的天性，抑或是我们发现了一个新的威胁？新的航线已经绘制完毕，只要我们愿意，随时可以开始追踪。
origin.1385.desc.en:
Despite its remarkable age, our science department have managed to analyze the drive trail sufficient to ascertain its exit vector. This effectively means that we can pursue the demons of our past.

Has enough time passed to quell their violent nature completely, or are we to discover a new threat? A new route has been plotted, and we can pursue it whenever we want.

origin.1390.desc.zh:
一进入恒星系，我们的探测器就发现了许多异常现象。

最明显的信号是一个硕大无比的能量云，靠近一看则会发现它是有数百条与之前所发现相类似的更小的聚变推进航迹组成的。必然有一支很庞大的舰队处于某种原因在此处逗留过。

在这个“舰队停泊处”边上，我们的探测器发现了另一种信号。那是一艘被遗弃的运输船。这艘飞船应该与边上的能量信号一样古老，不过它所带的航迹信号与航迹团并不相同。

我们应该靠近一些观察这艘废弃的舰船。
origin.1390.desc.en:
On entering the system, our sensors immediately picked up multiple anomalies.

The most prominent reading was a gigantic energy cloud which - upon closer inspection - turned out to be hundreds of smaller fusion drive trails like the one previously discovered. An absolutely massive fleet must've come to a halt here for some reason.

Next to this 'fleet parking lot' our scans picked up another kind of reading: a derelict transport ship. This freighter appears to be as old as the energy signatures, but traces of its own signature differs from that of the lost fleet.

We should inspect the abandoned ship closer.

origin.1395.desc.zh:
这艘运输船里有一份日志。虽然因时间流逝而老化，但仍可以恢复出不少数据。

这艘运输船被那支巨大的舰队拦截。由于尚不明确的原因及方式，这艘运输船的船长最终与无情舰队的指挥官进行了谈话。他们的谈话似乎持续了数周，虽然不知道他们具体谈了什么，但是“力量的本质”这个说法被反复地提到。

那支舰队突然离去，而留下的那艘运输船则安然无恙。日志的最后一行援引自指挥官：“算了，放了他们吧。毁灭是很容易的事情，真正的力量是创造的能力。”

我们已经分析了舰队的航迹，并可以重新起程追赶我们的目标。
origin.1395.desc.en:
The freighter contained a log. Though damaged by time, some data could still be recovered.

The freighter had been intercepted by the massive fleet. Unclear as to how or why, the Captain of the freighter ended up conversing with the Commander of the Relentless fleet. Apparently they spoke for weeks, but what they spoke of remains unknown - although the phrase 'nature of power' recurs frequently.

The fleet suddenly departed, leaving the freighter unscathed. The last entry in the log was a quote from the Commander: 'No, leave them. Destruction is easy. Real power is the ability to create.'

We have analyzed the fleet trails and may take up our pursuit again.

origin.1400.desc.zh:
这里就是聚变引擎航迹的终点。如果有任何可能存在的无情舰队的遗留物应该能在这里找到。

目前为止探测器所发现的信号中唯一一个值得关注的似乎是源自某种小型的太空站。它以一定的间隔向外辐射着能量脉冲，然而除此之外它似乎没有任何其他的活动迹象。

我们可以立刻对其展开调查。
origin.1400.desc.en:
This is where the fusion drive trail ends. It's quite likely that any remnants of the Relentless species - if there are any - will be found here.

So far the only sensor reading of any particular interest comes from what appears to be some kind of small space station. An energy pulse radiates from it at set intervals, but apart from that there's no sign of any activity.

We can proceed to investigate immediately.

origin.1405.desc.zh:
科学家们对古旧空间站的调查已经结束。这整个结构是个某种类型的大炮。很久以前，这门大炮开火了，向无情者的母星发射了一股脉冲。那股脉冲我们——[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]一族——十分清楚作用是什么：心智抹除脉冲。

为了补偿他们曾经犯下的罪愆，无情者——现在名为$NAME_Vemetosha$——对自己使用了这门武器，让他们的整个文明在心智上退回到了土著时代。

这一决定的规模——还有造成的后果——清楚地说明了无情者对于赎罪是多么的严肃。我们能够原谅他们吗？
origin.1405.desc.en:
The scientists have finished their investigation of the old space station. The entire structure is a big cannon of sorts. Eons ago it triggered and fired a pulse at the Relentless homeworld - a pulse that we, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], know full well: a Mind-Wipe pulse.

In a quest to redeem themselves from their past sins, the Relentless - now known as the $NAME_Vemetosha$ - used the weapon on themselves, effectively diminishing their entire civilization.

The magnitude of such a decision - and the follow-through - stands as testament to how very seriously the Relentless wanted to atone. Can we forgive them?

origin.1410.desc.zh: 将资源和工业装备运送到[From.Planet.GetName]的庞大任务已经结束。接下来就是向地底深处挖掘，建造一个坚固的，能够经历上千年地址变动和岁月风霜侵蚀的构造。
origin.1410.desc.en: The massive undertaking to transport resources and industrial equipment to [From.Planet.GetName] has been completed. Next step is to dig deep into the ground and build a structure strong enough to withstand eons of crude weather and tectonic shifts.

origin.1415.desc.zh: 一个装着资源和科技蓝图的巨大宝箱被埋藏在了[From.Planet.GetName]的表面之下。我们不清楚$NAME_Vemetosha$的子孙们能不能、会在什么时候以及如何发现我们的宝藏，不过我们可以寄与最大的希望。谁知道呢？或许千年之后他们会发现我们太空船的推进航迹，并找到我们。
origin.1415.desc.en: A tremendous cache of resources and technology blueprints has been buried beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We have no idea if, when or how our treasure will be discovered by the $NAME_Vemetosha$ descendants, but we can hope for the best. Who knows? Maybe in a thousand years they will find our space ship propulsion trails and come visit us.

origin.1420.desc.zh: 宇宙历史中黑暗的一章已经翻过，崭新而光明的篇章则由我们来谱写完成。我们的德政工程仿佛在我们的社会中投下了一颗石子，每一个人的心中都激起了使命感和道德感的涟漪。尽管漆黑的深空仍然深不可测，但也许这个宇宙并非完全是那么地漆黑冰冷。
origin.1420.desc.en: A dark chapter of in the history of the universe has ended, and we have written a new one - a brighter chapter. Our benevolent project initiated a ripple effect in our society, each member feeling a sense of purpose and good intent. Maybe space isn't such a dark place after all - the unfathomably vast darkness of the void notwithstanding.

origin.205.a.response.zh: 棒极了。我们期待着[desired_leader.GetHerHis]的到来。不必担心，[desired_leader.GetSheHe]将会在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上享有智慧生物所能渴望的一切。
origin.205.a.response.en: Excellent. We are looking forward to [desired_leader.GetHerHis] arrival. Worry not, [desired_leader.GetSheHe] will enjoy every comfort a sapient creature could possibly desire on [scion_master.Capital.GetName].

origin.205.b.zh: 不行，这位领袖得留在我们这。
origin.205.b.en: No, this leader stays with us.

origin.205.b.response.zh: 你、你们要拒绝这份莫大的荣耀？恐怕这是对你们的[desired_leader.GetTitle]极大的伤害，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
origin.205.b.response.en: You... you would refuse this great honor? I fear that you have done your [desired_leader.GetTitle] a great disservice, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

origin.205.desc.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。一如既往，我们始终保持着对你们的观察，你们的一名领袖吸引了我们的注意。事实上，你们的[desired_leader.GetTitle]，[desired_leader.GetName]的声名已经一路传到了我们的首都。

鉴于[desired_leader.GetHerHis]非比寻常的技能，我们想要为他在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上提供一个永久的职位。一份莫大的荣耀，可以这样讲。请尽快安排好对[desired_leader.GetHerHis]的调动。
origin.205.desc.en:
Dearest [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As always, we have been observing you, and one of your leaders has attracted our attention. Indeed, the reputation of your [desired_leader.GetTitle], [desired_leader.GetName], has reached all the way to our capital.

Given [desired_leader.GetHerHis] unusual skills, we would like to offer a permanent position on [scion_master.Capital.GetName]. A great honor, to be sure. Please arrange for [desired_leader.GetHerHis] transfer as soon as possible.

origin.21.a.desc.zh: 预兆判定你们应当因一直为我们服务接受这份礼物。不要浪费这份赠礼。
origin.21.a.desc.en: The Augurs have decreed that you should receive this gift for your continued service to us. Do not squander it.

origin.21.b.desc.zh: 仔细考虑过后，我们决定为实验引入另一个变量。请接受这份赠礼。随你们的意愿自行处理即可。
origin.21.b.desc.en: After much deliberation, we have decided to introduce another variable to the experiment. Please accept this gift. Do with it as you will.

origin.210.a.response.zh: 谢谢你们。我们就知道指望你们[Root.GetName]准没错。
origin.210.a.response.en: Thank you. We knew we could count on the [Root.GetName].

origin.210.b.zh: 我们没有空闲的岗位，抱歉。
origin.210.b.en: We have no available positions, sorry.

origin.210.b.response.zh: 知道了。真是令人失望。也许把它说得像是请求一样确实是我们的问题。
origin.210.b.response.en: I see. That is disappointing. Perhaps the blame lies with us, for phrasing it as a request.

origin.210.desc.zh:
你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有一名相当古怪的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]，宣称自己已经对在[scion_master.GetName]中的生活感到不耐烦——甚至可以说是厌倦！这个自以为是的家伙想要在星系里发展程度较低的文明中寻求一次挑战——按他的话来说是这样。

你会从我们这里接手[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？就算是我们欠了你们一份情。按照他的资历，我毫不怀疑他会在你们的领导职位上有良好的表现，但你们可能要容忍他那无常又冲动的举止。
origin.210.desc.en:
Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There is a rather eccentric [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who claims to have grown restless - even bored! - of life as it is among the [scion_master.GetName]. This deluded individual seeks a challenge - their words - among the less developed civilizations of the galaxy.

Will you take this [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] off our hands, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? You would be doing us a favor. Given their qualifications, I have no doubt they would serve you well in a leadership position, as long as you can tolerate their erratic and impulsive behavior.

origin.215.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们最近发现了一些没用的多余星舰。我们本打算把它们扔到最近的恒星里去，但突然想到了你们，我们亲爱的子弟。

这都是些老船了——一些甚至肯定比你们的整个文明都古老——但你们会发现它们还是颇具潜力的。收下吧，不客气。
origin.215.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we recently discovered several surplus starships that we have no use of. We were about to chuck them into the nearest sun, but then we thought of you, our dear scions.

These are old ships - some are no doubt older than your entire civilization - but you should find them quite potent. Please take them. We insist.

origin.215.tooltip.en: A small fleet of [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] starships joins the [Root.GetName].

origin.220.desc.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……你们能不能努努力？你们的舰船也太落后了，这么磨磨蹭蹭可真令人生厌。

让你们的[root.GetScientistPlural]看看这些引擎的说明书吧。不客气。
origin.220.desc.en:
Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... Would you care to pick up the pace a little? Your ships are lagging behind, and we grow tired of such dawdling.

Have your [root.GetScientistPlural] take a look at these engine specifications. We insist.

origin.225.b.en: We cannot do that right now.

origin.225.desc.zh:
你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们觉得自己的努力还不错是吧？真好。

你们做得可真是……还行，不过我们希望你们还能百尺竿头更进一步。星系中还有那么多地盘可以吸收，而你们却如此故步自封！

别担心，因为我们已经帮你们准备好了补给包。谢就不用谢了，只要把它好好地用在新殖民地就行。
origin.225.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], hello! Do you feel your endeavors are going well? Splendid.

What you are doing is... fine, but we want to see you extend your reach a little further. There is so much more galaxy to take in, and yet you remain so cooped up!

Do not worry, though: we have prepared a supply package for you. No need to thank us; just be sure to invest it wisely in a new colony.

origin.226.desc.A.zh:
嗟，动起来[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！不要轻易地接受失败。你就只需要挪到那儿，然后自己建个新家就好了。

快点，动啊。
origin.226.desc.A.en:
Come now, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Do not admit defeat so easily. You just need to get out there, and make a new home for yourselves.

Hurry along, now.

origin.226.desc.B.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们的通讯装置看来是坏掉了。我们不断地收到你们不知感恩的丧气话。乖乖改正行不行?
origin.226.desc.B.en: Your communications apparatus must be faulty, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: we keep receiving negative and ungrateful cross-chatter. See to that fault, won't you?

origin.29.desc.zh: 奸诈的狗杂种。现在我们要索回我们的舰队。
origin.29.desc.en: Treacherous cur. We will be taking our fleet back now.

origin.3003.desc.zh: 在[planet.GetName]上持续的轰炸已经摧毁了我们对生命树网络的链接。
origin.3003.desc.en: The ongoing bombardment of [planet.GetName] has destroyed our network of life-giving Trees.

origin.3100.desc.zh: 在清理[from.GetName]上的残骸时，我们发现了可以追溯到我们前帝国时期的技术储藏。只需要进行少量的研究工作就可以将此知识重新整合进我们的技术体系中。
origin.3100.desc.en: While clearing wreckage on [from.GetName] we discovered an ancient cache of technology which dates back to our former empire. Only a minimal amount of research should be required to reintegrate this knowledge into our technology base.

origin.3101.desc.zh: [planet.GetName]曾经是[owner.GetName]的一处重要殖民地，它的一些残存基础设施仍然可作为重新殖民行星的基础。
origin.3101.desc.en: [planet.GetName] was once an important colony of the [owner.GetName], and some remnants of its infrastructure remain usable as a base to re-colonize the planet.

origin.3210.desc.zh:
难以置信的事情发生了。我们的首都已落入卑鄙的[From.GetName]的[From.species.GetHandNamePlural]手中。在最近[Root.GetName]的绝望的防御战中，我们的先祖落入了令人憎恶的入侵者的受众，并带走了许多[From.GetSpeciesAdj]。

为了以防万一，我们深思熟虑的先祖已经在诸多子嗣中安排好了继位者。这位备选继位者能够稳定我们蜂巢意识的一部分，但重新管控整个意识的复杂性和压力超出其能力范畴。在敌人趁我们陷入短暂的混乱而获取更大优势之前，我们必须尽快催熟这位子嗣，使其成为新的一位先祖。
origin.3210.desc.en:
The unimaginable has happened. Our capital has fallen into the [From.species.GetHandNamePlural] of the despicable [From.GetName]. During the last desperate defense of [Root.GetName], our Progenitor fell to the horrid invaders, taking many of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] with them.

In case of the unthinkable, our ever-calculating Progenitor had designated a successor among the Offspring. The Progenitor-in-waiting has managed to stabilize parts of our consciousness, but the complexity and pressure are too great for it to fully take up the mantle. We will have to incubate this Offspring and have it take over as a new Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of our momentary disunity.

origin.3245.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]遭到了可怖的[From.GetAdj]巨像武器的打击。我们失去的不仅仅是这个星球，还有我们的始祖以及所有居住在这个[Root.GetPlanetHabitat]上的子嗣。[Root.GetName]上的每一个子嗣和子个体都集结在一起，尽全力保护我们的始祖不受这个可怕武器的攻击。最终，它们的所有努力都只不过是延缓了无可避免的厄运，始祖很快陨落了。

现在我们的主体意识里满是矛盾碰撞的思想和冲动。如果我们不马上指派一名新的始祖，[Owner.GetName]很快就会停止生命。
origin.3245.desc.en:
[Root.GetName] has been struck with a Colossus weapon from the dreaded [From.GetAdj]. We lost not only the world but also our Progenitor, and all Offspring residing on the [Root.GetPlanetHabitat]. Every drone and Offspring on [Root.GetName] had gathered in an effort to protect our Progenitor from the dreaded machine. In the end, their efforts did naught but prolong the inevitable, and the Progenitor fell soon after.

Now our consciousness is full of clashing thoughts and impulses. If we do not appoint a new Progenitor soon, then the [Owner.GetName] will cease to be.

origin.3265.desc.zh:
在持续数月的轰炸后，一切都结束了。[From.GetName]陷落了，一切生命的迹象都消失了。在厚厚的尘埃云在由我们前首都化作的废墟街道中翻腾。死亡的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曝尸荒野，在我们中最伟大的一员，我们的先祖的身边堆作尸山，而先祖也在最后的轰炸中随之而去。

我们现在不得不把所有的行政能力转移到[capital_scope.GetName]，并且需要建立新的始祖巢穴。在敌人开始利用我们暂时的分崩离析前，我们必须将其中一个子嗣孵化为新的始祖。
origin.3265.desc.en:
After many months of bombardment, it is over. [From.GetName] has fallen, all trace of life has been eradicated. Dust clouds billow across the ruined streets of our former capital. Dead [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]  litter the ground, culminating in an enormous pile of corpses surrounding the greatest of us all - our Progenitor, which finally fell during the final bombardment.

We now have to move our administration to [capital_scope.GetName], and it will be necessary to establish a new Progenitor Nest. We will have to incubate one of our Offspring to assume the role of Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of this moment of disunity.

origin.3510.desc.zh: 我们终于获得了$quantum_catapult_1$所在的恒星系及其周边区域。现在我们可以送工程师过去以开始修复工程，这样就能让这个休眠的结构重获新生。
origin.3510.desc.en: We have finally secured the system and region around the broken $quantum_catapult_1$. Now at last, we can send engineers in to start the repair work necessary to bring this dormant structure back to life.

origin.3515.desc.zh:
在蓝图和图示之中我们恢复了一份奇怪的文档：

这是来自量子建筑师的个人文件

鸿蒙之初，我们居于黑暗。上帝说：“要有黑暗”，于是世界充满了黑暗。当我们最初的祖先获得了知觉之光，我们就想在天空中搜寻生命的迹象和意义，但我们的头顶只有无际的黑暗。随着我们建立了文明，我们的思想扫过黑夜中的每一片阴影，我们在建立第一座城市的地方辛勤劳作，经常测试它们的地基。

数千年后，我突然莽撞地向“上”看了一眼。当其他人还面朝大地而劳作时，我的思绪却向天空打开。我建造了电路和钢铁的神殿，用我的智慧之光制作了我自己的工具。通过完善二极管和电容器的迷宫，我将我的意识传播到整个宇宙，感知笼罩在我们世界的黑暗之外的一切事物。

因为我能感受到其他人感受不到的东西：我们在宇宙并不孤独。通过玻璃般的黑暗，我能感受到数以千计的其他星球。我能感知到不可能。在我们无尽的黑夜之外是燎原般的万千星点。
origin.3515.desc.en:
Among blueprints and schematics, we recovered a strange document:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

In the beginning, we dwelled in darkness. Our gods said, 'let there be dark,' and there was. When our first ancestors gained the spark of sentience, we searched the heavens for signs of life or meaning, but all above us was darkness. As we built our civilization, our minds scanned for shadows in the night. We toiled in the places where we built our first cities, always testing their foundations.

Thousands of years later, I had the temerity to look *up*.While others labored with their gaze downcast, my mind opened up to the heavens. Building a temple of circuitry and steel, I formed my own tools, empowered by the light of my intellect. Perfecting a labyrinth of diodes and capacitors, I cast my consciousness through the cosmos, perceiving something beyond the dark skies that shrouded our world.

For I could sense what others could not: We were not alone in the universe. As though through a glass darkly, I could detect thousands of other worlds. I could sense the impossible. Beyond the night burned a thousand points of light.

origin.3520.desc.zh:
尽管我们的探险队还在筛选能够解码该巨型结构的建造计划的数据，他们已经发现了另一个看起来像是宗教文本的摘录：

来自量子建筑师的个人文件

我吐露真相，而我的人民却回以混乱。
我们每个人都在自己思想和情感的迷雾中麻木劳作。我们试探性地对他人伸出手，但我们中有太多人是孤独的。我们的神在黑暗中创造了世界，我们被告知说我们才是神的造物的中心。

就因为我胆敢梦想天外的世界，我的愿景就被他人认为是谎言。我们当中的其他人问：怎么才能证明这些梦？我们怎么能相信我们不能证明的事？作为回应，我将那些还愿意听我的人引到自己的实验室。这些最聪明的头脑可以感知到我所能感知到的：夜幕之外的其他星球。

而最黑暗的头脑却报之以其他的回应，他们捏造新的论点，紧握致命的武器。那些危险的头脑吟唱寓言，说我们的星球会陷入动荡，因为我们不再是神的宠儿。然而我还是知道真相：创造之光是一幅巨大的帷幕。查宇宙之秘，我被欣喜的浪潮所裹挟，渐渐失去了自己的身份。
origin.3520.desc.en:
While our expedition keeps sifting through the data to decode the megastructure's plans, they have found another excerpt of what looks like a religous text:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

I spoke the truth, and my people answered with chaos.
Each of us labors in our own fog of thoughts and emotions. We tentatively reach out to others, yet so many of us are alone. Our gods crafted the world from darkness, we are told, and we were allegedly the centerpiece of their creation.

Because I dared to dream of worlds beyond, I was told my vision was a lie. Who among us, others asked, could confirm these dreams? How can we believe, they said, what we cannot prove? And in response, I led those who would listen to my laboratory. The brightest minds could perceive a reflection of what I experienced: other worlds beyond the veil of night.

The darkest minds crafted other responses, formed new arguments, clutched deadly weapons. Dangerous minds sang that our world would be in turmoil, for we were no longer the favored spawn of the gods. Yet I knew the truth: Creation's illumination was a vast tapestry. Contemplating the majesty of the cosmos, I was swept away in tides of rapture, losing my identity.

origin.3525.desc.zh:
更多类弥赛亚的文本被恢复：

来自量子建筑师的个人文件

我不断地被无边无垠的宇宙所折磨和诱惑，开始考虑去遥远的世界并亲自体验。生活在被无尽黑夜包裹的世界中，其他的头脑做着美梦，而我寻求于他们进行交流。在黑暗之外有光明指引着我，光明诱惑着我，给予了我无限的启示。因此我把我的思想广播到遥远而未知的世界……

天上如是，地上亦然。我对天空的愿景带给了我喜悦，在地上，我同样找到了给我同样的解脱的幸福的人。我与另一个科学家坠入爱河，那是一位有远见的人，用其他的办法在群星中寻求我所感知到的世界。

我们并不只是分享各自所见。我们立誓成为对方终生的伴侣。随着工作的进展，我们依偎在每一个漫漫长夜。我的伴侣梦到了星舰的设计图，在蜡制设计版中刻出原始的太阳能航空器。我不断用电路修修补补，努力将我的思想和无限融合起来。我的冒险越是深入，我内心的欣喜就越是充盈。多么美妙啊！永无止境的欢愉！
origin.3525.desc.en:
More of the quasi messianic figure's writings have been recovered:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

Tormented and tantalized by a boundless cosmos, I contemplated the means to travel to distant worlds and experience them firsthand. Enshrouded beyond the endless night, other minds dreamed, and I sought communion with them. Beyond a great darkness, a great Light led me on, offering me temptations and endless revelations. And thus I cast my mind out further into the unknown...

As above, so below. My visions of the heavens brought me joy, but down below, I found someone who brought me the same liberation of happiness. I fell in love with another scientist, a visionary who spoke of other ways to seek the stars I had sensed in my reveries.

We did more than share a vision. We pledged ourselves as partners for life. And as our work progressed, we stayed up later each night. My partner dreamed designs for starships, etching crude solar-powered spacecraft on their wax design board. I tinkered with circuitry, straining to unify my mind with infinity. The farther I ventured, the more my rapture grew. Such bliss! The ecstasy of endless eternity!

origin.3530.desc.zh:
来自量子建筑师的个人文件，其身份为宇宙制船师的伴侣

我的伴侣十分耐心而我却有些莽撞。我的挚爱拥有科学和逻辑的智慧而我也有着驰骋的心际。随着我们漫漫长夜中愈行愈远，我徒劳地将自己的意识广播到虚空。我忽视了睡眠，忽视了饥饿，最终也忽视了我的挚爱。我们在宇宙中追寻梦想的同时，内心却开始出现了鸿沟。

我的挚爱为这种现象创造了一个词：量子纠缠。我的身体还在这儿，但思想却驰骛天外，竭力地探寻欣喜和与永恒的交流。我的伴侣跟我说其他话，但我丝毫听不进去。“吾爱”，我的伴侣说，“回到我的身边”，但我却只能听到恒星的回声。

很快就到了测试我伴侣的太阳能星舰的时候。我志愿驾驶这架飞船。当我第一次掌舵并开始处女航之时，我将梦到通往遥远海岸的航线，我的身还在原处，心已神游天外。

我的挚爱渐渐平静下来，我会赐予我的挚爱无限，通往永恒，来吾道夫先路。我会给予我的挚爱万千世界之梦。
origin.3530.desc.en:
From the personal files of the Quantum Architect, partner of the Cosmic Shipwright

My partner was patient, and I was reckless. My Beloved had science and logic, and I had my psychic reveries. Longer and longer into the night, I vainly attempted to cast my consciousness into the void. I neglected sleep. I neglected food. I neglected My Beloved. As we pursued our dreams of venturing into the cosmos, a gulf grew between us.

My Beloved found words for our phenomenon: quantum entanglement. My body was here, but my mind was eons away, desperately seeking ecstasy and a communion with eternity. My partner told me other words, but I would not listen. 'My Love,' they said, 'come back to me,' but I could only hear the echoes of the stars.

Soon, the time will come to test my partner's solar starship. I have volunteered sit at the controls. As I sit at the helm of its first test flight, I will dream of a course to distant shores, my mind *here* and my body *there*.

My Beloved has grown quiet, but I will gift them with infinity, blazing a trail to eternity. I will offer them the dreams of a thousand worlds.

origin.3535.desc.zh:
来自宇宙制船师的个人文件，其身份为量子建筑师的遗孀

我们的第一艘星舰一年前就消失了。我们至今不知道之前到底发生了什么。我的伴侣，量子建筑师，他只留下了遗产和谜团。我们所能做的最深入的推测也不过是我的挚爱最终成为了宇宙中的一员。在他坐上控制面板之前开始处女航，他与无限融合在了一起，被对天空的狂喜和遐想所吞没。我们的测试船再也没有回来。

现在我只能用手头上粗糙的工具劳作，将我已经一片狼藉的工作和生活重拾起来。我更多的太阳能舰船开始了前往永夜的旅途。我开始着手安装更好的引擎，原型引擎能够让我们的舰船穿越超空间。在某些夜晚，我梦想着有一种技术可以将我们送往未知的星系，就像我失去的伴侣的思想和灵魂那样。

我向光明伸出手臂，拒绝向黑暗屈服。我坐在我的挚爱的实验室中，就像现在那样阅读他们的日志并写下自己的日志。有时候当一切陷入至暗，我尝试着把我的思想广播向宇宙。这是无限的信标。
origin.3535.desc.en:
From the personal files of the Cosmic Shipwright, widow of the Quantum Architect

Our first starship vanished a year ago. We still do not know precisely what happened. My partner, the Quantum Architect, has left behind a legacy and a mystery. As far as we can derive, My Love finally became one with the cosmos. Sitting at the controls aboard our first test flight, they merged with infinity, overwhelmed by rapturous psychic contemplation of the heavens. Our test ship never returned.

Now I labor with my own crude tools, left to reforge my work and my life from the wreckage. More of my solar starships have begun their journeys into the Great Night. I have begun work on better engines, prototypes that can propel our vessels through hyperspace. And on some nights, I dream of a technology that can leap for the stars like the mind and soul of my lost partner, launching us into the unknown.

As I reach for the light, I refuse to succumb to the darkness. I sit in My Love's laboratory, just as I am now, reading their journals and writing my own. And sometimes, when all is darkest, I attempt to cast my own mind across the cosmos. Infinity beckons.

origin.3540.desc.zh:
随着我们终于找到了该结构建造计划的缺失文件，我们还原了最后的文本：

来自宇宙制船师的文件，其身份为量子建筑师的遗孀

我们探寻了许多方法以实现我的挚爱的创新，也就是他们的量子创造。我不知道我们是否可以沿着这条看似莽撞的道路，以量子建筑师的设计为蓝本，以缓慢的步伐抵达群星。我寻求能跨越超空间的浪潮，思考着能将我们带到遥远彼岸的流向。

我的舰船沿着缓慢的路线前进，在深夜中我读着我的挚爱的日志，努力理解其中的数学表达式和相关机理。当我的思想触及无限时，我意识到我的挚爱还在那儿。他引导了先路，我必须跟着前行。

通过失去我却反而获得了灵感。我们曾开始制造过一个伟大的机械，它能够推动我们的舰船跨越星系，就如同我的挚爱跨入无限那样。当我离开时，我谦逊地要求这台宇宙设备以及其迭代更新产物应该纳入量子建筑师的个人日志。当其他人读到这篇日志时，毫无疑问我的灵魂已经飞往远方。我会找到在无垠的宇宙中和我的挚爱团聚的道路。因为我知道我们将共同居住在永恒中，梦想并漂流在万千星点之中。
origin.3540.desc.en:
As we finally found the missing pieces for the structure plans, we also recovered one last text:

From the files of the Cosmic Shipwright, widow of the Quantum Architect

We have searched for ways to employ My Love's innovations, their quantum creations. I am left wondering if we can take that same reckless path, empowered by the Quantum Architect's designs, but I reach for the stars at a slower pace. I search for a wave to ride through hyperspace, contemplating a current that will take us to distant shores.

My ships take the slow route, but late at night, I read My Love's journals, struggling to tame their mathematics and machinations. As my mind reaches out towards eternity, I know in my heart that My Love is still out there. They blazed a trail towards heaven, and I must follow.

Through loss, I have found inspiration. We have begun work on a grand machine that will propel our ships across the galaxy, just as My Beloved leapt into infinity. And someday, I will do what they have done. When I am gone, I humbly request that this cosmic device and all its iterations should include the personal logs of the Quantum Architect. Doubtless by the time others read this, my soul will have taken taken flight. I will have found a way to join My Beloved out there in the vast expanse. For I know that we will dwell in eternity together, dreaming and drifting through a thousand points of light.

origin.4010.a.tooltip.en: The debt collectors will visit us on [root.payback_debt_collectors_timer].

origin.4010.desc.zh:
一个小型的自推档案存储器刚刚进入了我们的母星系边缘，用一个信号信标大声宣告了其到来。该档案一经取得，就显示出它所包含的阴森信息：一份长长的列表，里面详细列出了在与侵略者作战期间我们摧毁的所有军事资产，包括船组人员的伤亡，以及每艘被摧毁的船只的估计价值。

我们先前的入侵者正式提出了战争赔款。更讽刺的是，他们还声称，在我们的星系中被摧毁的所有船只仍然是他们的财产，任何试图对残骸进行摧毁、改装或者逆向的行为都将会使我们违反条款。

一个债务收集机构很快将与我们联系，以便解决此事。
origin.4010.desc.en:
A small, self-propelled cache just entered the edges of our home system, loudly announcing its arrival with a signal beacon. Once retrieved, the cache revealed its grim contents: a lengthy list detailing all the military assets we destroyed during the war against our invaders, complete with crew casualties and the estimated value of each destroyed vessel.

Our former invaders are officially demanding war reparations. This despite the fact that they are the ones who invaded us. Even more outrageously, they also claim that all the destroyed ships in our system are still their property, and any attempt to destroy, refit or retro-engineer the wreckage will put us in breach of terms and conditions.

A debt collection agency will soon contact us to settle the matter.

origin.4015.a.zh: 我们很乐意协商解决问题。

origin.4015.c.response.zh:
在我们的族人第一次触及星辰之前，我们就知道每个人在这个宇宙都有自己要扮演的角色。有些文化渴望力量。而另一些文化追求知识。我们进化是为了提供人情服务。

如果一个人从未因无私奉献而感到喜悦，那么此人错过了生命的主旨。弯腰鞠躬并不是自降身份，而是提升周围的人。
origin.4015.c.response.en:
Even before our people first reached the stars, we understood that everyone has a role to play in this galaxy. Some cultures crave power. Others pursue knowledge. We evolved to favor service.

The one who has never felt the joy of unselfish service has missed the very theme of life. To bow down is not to be diminished. It is to uplift those around you.

origin.4015.desc.zh:
亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

我们代表$NAME_MSI_country$就债务未偿还一事与您进行联系。鉴于我们也是新近崛起的太空社会中的一员，我们理解您或许无法承担全部债务。我们的目的是帮助您选择一种适当的还款计划，在不阻碍经济发展的情况下偿还所有未偿还债务。

相应地，我们很高兴为您提供一名咨询顾问，免费！我们热切地希望这个问题能够顺利解决。
origin.4015.desc.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

We are contacting you on behalf of the $NAME_MSI_country$ regarding an outstanding debt. Being a fledging space-faring society, we understand you may not be in a position to repay the full amount. Our aim is to aid you in selecting an appropriate repayment plan, one which will settle any outstanding debts without stifling economic growth.

Accordingly, we are happy to offer you a consultation, free of charge! It is our ardent wish that this matter can be settled amicably.

origin.4016.a.response.zh: 你们想要一次结清债务的积极态度让我们感动不已，但仔细检查之后，你方提供的能量币看起来并不全是真货。想必，这只是单纯的产生了误解！让我们假装无事发生就好了。
origin.4016.a.response.en: We are touched by your eagerness to settle your debt, but upon close examination, the energy credits you offered do not appear to be entirely genuine. Just a simple misunderstanding, we're sure! Let's pretend this never happened.

origin.4016.d.zh: 我们还能为您提供什么？
origin.4016.d.en: Anything else we can offer you?

origin.4016.desc.zh: 根据我们先前提交的估值，你亏欠我们客户的总额等于£energy£ [owner.debt_collectors_amount]能量币。我们非常乐意提供给你各种各样的偿还计划。
origin.4016.desc.en: According to the estimations we previously submitted, the amount you owe to our client is equal to £energy£ [owner.debt_collectors_amount] Energy Credits. We are happy to offer you a variety of repayment plans.

origin.4017.a.tooltip.en: The debt collectors will return on [root.payback_debt_collectors_timer].

origin.4017.desc.zh:
棒极了！很高兴我们能这么快就达成协议。我们将在15年后回来收第一笔分期付款，相信你们对这些条款感到很满意。

祝您有美好的一天！
origin.4017.desc.en:
Splendid! We are pleased we managed to reach an agreement so quickly. We will return in 15 years to collect the first installment and ensure you're happy with the terms.

Have a nice day!

origin.4018.a.zh: 实际上，我们更愿意用能量币支付。
origin.4018.a.en: Actually, we'd prefer to pay using energy.

origin.4018.b.tooltip.zh: 承诺下次收债人返回时给出200£pop£人口。
origin.4018.b.tooltip.en: Pledge to give 200 £pop£ Pops to the debt collectors upon their return.

origin.4018.c.response.zh: 正确的术语是“契约仆人”。奴隶制是一种不公平的做法，依靠的是利用现存的权力结构进行剥削。我们的交易完全基于合约条款。
origin.4018.c.response.en: The correct term is "indentured servants". Slavery is an unfair practice based on exploitation of pre-existing power structures. Our exchanges are based solely on the terms of contract.

origin.4018.desc.zh:
如果你无法或不愿意支付能量币，你可以向$NAME_MSI_country$提供一定比例的劳动力储备来抵扣你的债务。你的工人将被送往指定工作场所，并获得基本食宿，直到他们成功偿还债务。

值得注意的是，上述劳工不需要有完整公民权。任何具有劳动能力的都可以。
origin.4018.desc.en:
If you are unable or unwilling to cover the energy cost, you may repay your debt by pledging a certain percentage of your labor pool to $NAME_MSI_country$. Your workers will be transported to their designated job sites and will be provided with basic accommodation until they have successfully repaid the debt.

It's worth noting that said workers do not need to be full citizens. Any able bodies will do.

origin.4019.a.tooltip.en: The debt collectors will attack us.

origin.4019.b.zh: 让我们重新考虑一下我们的选择……

origin.4019.desc.zh: 我们真的很抱歉，因为我们没能在这个问题上达成一致。你是否有机会再重新考虑一下？根据合约的条款，如果债务国不愿意或无法偿还，我们就必须代表客户收缴资产。
origin.4019.desc.en: We are truly sorry that we were unable to reach an agreement in this matter. Is there any chance you would be willing to reconsider? According to the terms of the contract, if a debtor is unwilling or unable to pay, we are required to seize assets on behalf of our client.

origin.4020.desc.zh: 收债人的舰队被迫撤退。他们毫无疑问还会回来的，但至少目前我们安全了。
origin.4020.desc.en: The debt collector fleet has been forced to retreat. They will doubtlessly return, but for now, we are safe.

origin.4020.desc.repeat.zh: 再一次，我们迫使收债人撤离了我们的母星系。这或许不太可能是我们最后一次和他们打交道，但至少我们的子民和财产目前又安全了。
origin.4020.desc.repeat.en: Once again, we forced the debt collectors to retreat from our home system. It's unlikely we've seen the last of them, but for now, our people and our assets are safe.

origin.4021.a.zh: 我们绝不会再向你们低头！
origin.4021.a.en: We'll never bow to you again.

origin.4021.desc.zh:
我们对此感到极度失望。

作为一家专精于启发那些欠发展文明的公司，我们因我们的专业才干而自豪。但很明显，我们未能传授一些最基础的知识。你们不能无缘无故地攻击其他人，而应该为你们的失败承担责任。

你们显然需要额外的指导。让我们来教你们如何偿还债务。
origin.4021.desc.en:
The disappointment is heavy.

As a company specializing in the enlightenment of less developed civilizations, we pride ourselves in our expertise. Yet it has become abundantly clear that we have failed to impart some basic lessons. Rather than attacking others without cause, you alone must bear the responsibility for your failures.

You are clearly in need of additional guidance. Let us teach you how to repay a debt.

origin.4025.a.zh: 下一次我们会做好准备。
origin.4025.a.en: Next time we will be ready.

origin.4025.a.tooltip.zh:
收债人夺走500£pop£人口。

收债人将于[root.owner.payback_debt_collectors_timer]回来。
origin.4025.a.tooltip.en:
Lost 500 £pop£ Pops to the Debt Collectors.

The debt collectors will return on [root.owner.payback_debt_collectors_timer].

origin.4025.desc.zh: 在我们的舰队被击败后，收债人突袭了[PLANET.GetName]，绑架了我们的许多族人。比起这次战败更加令人心痛的，是他们留下的“账单”，告诉我们这些被扣押的人们将被用来偿还我们的“债务”。收债人说，我们应该心怀感恩，债务清算后我们的族人就能回家。还债时间大约只要29637年左右。
origin.4025.desc.en: After our fleet was defeated, the debt collectors raided [PLANET.GetName], kidnapping a number of our people. Even more galling than the defeat was the 'invoice' they left behind, informing us that the seized population will be put to work to repay our 'debt.' We should be grateful, the collectors say, that our people will be returned once the debt is settled. This should only take 29,637 years or so.

origin.4030.a.zh: 我们很乐意协商解决问题。

origin.4030.b.zh: 这是你要求支付的款项。
origin.4030.b.en: Here is the payment you requested.

origin.4030.desc.alloys.zh:
$origin.4030.desc.base$

根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴总额为1250£alloys£$alloys$的费用来偿还你的债务。
origin.4030.desc.alloys.en:
$origin.4030.desc.base$

As per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to 1250 £alloys£ $alloys$ for the repayment of your debt.

origin.4030.desc.consumer_goods.zh:
$origin.4030.desc.base$

根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴总额为2500£consumer_goods£$consumer_goods$的费用来偿还你的债务。
origin.4030.desc.consumer_goods.en:
$origin.4030.desc.base$

As per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to 2500 £consumer_goods£ $consumer_goods$ for the repayment of your debt.

origin.4030.desc.defeated.zh:
亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

我们再次代表$NAME_MSI_country$就债务未偿一事与你联系。我们只希望和平解决此事，同时希望贵方更愿意参与建设性的对话。
origin.4030.desc.defeated.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

Once again we're contacting you on behalf of the $NAME_MSI_country$ regarding an outstanding debt. We only wish to resolve this matter peacefully, and hope that you are more willing to participate in a constructive dialogue.

origin.4030.desc.energy.zh:
$origin.4030.desc.base$

根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴总额为5000£energy£$energy$的费用来偿还你的债务。
origin.4030.desc.energy.en:
$origin.4030.desc.base$

As per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to 5000 £energy£ $energy$ for the repayment of your debt.

origin.4030.desc.furious.zh:
亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

这是我们的最后警告：你欠$NAME_MSI_country$的债务亟需偿还。尽管我们多次试图和平解决此事，你始终没有表达出合作的意愿。如果你再次拒绝执行偿还计划，我们将别无选择，只能采取所有必要的手段收缴你的资产。
origin.4030.desc.furious.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

This is our last warning: the debt you owe to the $NAME_MSI_country$ urgently needs to be repaid. Despite multiple attempts to resolve this matter peacefully, you have consistently failed to cooperate. If you refuse once again to agree on a repayment plan, we will have no choice but to seize your assets by any means necessary.

origin.4030.desc.pops.zh:
$origin.4030.desc.base$

根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴愿意尽心尽力的劳动来偿还你债务的共计200£pop£人口。
origin.4030.desc.pops.en:
$origin.4030.desc.base$

As per our agreement, we are here to collect 200 £pop£ Pops willing to dedicate their labor to the repayment of your debt.

origin.4030.g.zh: 抱歉，能再说一遍你是谁吗？

origin.4031.a.zh: 未偿款项比预期的要高。
origin.4031.a.en: The outstanding sum is higher than expected.

origin.4031.desc.zh: 感谢你的及时回应，以及你公平地解决此事的意愿！现在未偿还款项总额为[owner.debt_collectors_amount]£energy£$energy$。我们将在15年后再回来，收下一笔分期款项。祝您愉快！
origin.4031.desc.en: Thank you for your prompt response and your willingness to settle the matter equitably! The outstanding sum is now equal to [owner.debt_collectors_amount] £energy£ $energy$. We will be back in 15 years to collect the next installment. Have a nice day!

origin.4032.desc.zh: 正如这个小字条款所标明的，我们执行的是标准利率。如果你继续按现有分期方式支付，你就能在29637年后偿清你的债务。
origin.4032.desc.en: As indicated in the small print, standard interest rates are applied. If you continue with your payments at the current rate, you will be able to repay your debt in exactly 29,637 years.

origin.4036.desc.a.zh: 我们不会让你抓走我们的人民。
origin.4036.desc.a.en: We won't let you take our people.

origin.4036.desc.a.tooltip.en: The debt collectors will attack us.

origin.4036.desc.energy.zh:
$origin.4036.desc.base$

考虑当下情况，我们有必要告知您，我们的客户也接受以工作时长为形式的偿付。你们的一些人口将会被运送到指定的工作地点，提供基础食宿，直到他们成功地偿还了债务。

值得注意的是，上述劳工不需要有完整公民权。任何具有劳动能力的都可以。
origin.4036.desc.energy.en:
$origin.4036.desc.base$

Considering the situation, we feel compelled to inform you that our client also accepts repayment in the form of dedicated work hours. Some of your population will be transported to their designated job sites and provided with basic accommodation until they have successfully repaid the debt.

It's worth noting that these workers need not be full citizens of yours. Any able bodies will do.

origin.4037.desc.base.zh: 我们恳请你重新考虑一下你的决定。如果你拒绝付款，这将会在你的信用分数上留下一个永久的印记。拖欠债务会限制你未来的经济机遇，对于你自己的形象来说没有任何好处。你希望世人将你们当作这样的一个文明吗？通过唾弃那些愿意自降身份提升你们的人？
origin.4037.desc.base.en: We beg you to rethink your decision. Your refusal to pay will leave a permanent mark on your credit score. Defaulting will limit your financial opportunities in the future, to say nothing of your own self-image. Is this how you wish to be known as a society? By spitting on those who kneeled to lift you up?

origin.4037.desc.defeated.zh: 我们意识到你方拒绝偿还债务是一件令人十分担忧的事情。我们的客户，$NAME_MSI_country$，提供给你的全是帮助和支持，所求的仅仅只是一笔公平的款项作为交换。难道你们学到的东西就是这些？用友善温和换来的竟是阴险欺诈？
origin.4037.desc.defeated.en: We find the refusal to repay your debt deeply concerning. Our client, the $NAME_MSI_country$, offered you nothing but help and support, and only asked for a fair repayment in exchange. Is this all you have learned? To reciprocate kindness with deceit?

origin.4040.a.tooltip.en: We will triumph over the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ through warfare.

origin.4040.b.tooltip.zh: 我们将通过外交手段战胜$NAME_MSI_country_initials$。
origin.4040.b.tooltip.en: We will triumph over the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ through diplomacy.

origin.4040.desc.zh:
收债人离开了我们的母星系，但一股深深的恐惧感至今依然在我们心中挥之不去。考虑到他们对于雇主尽心尽力，他们肯定不会停止对我们的骚扰。即使我们以某种方式偿还了全部债务，他们一定也会想出其它办法——利率、法律漏洞、隐藏在文档中的小字条款，藏在我们稀里糊涂签下的文件中。

如果我们无法回购自由，我们别无选择，只能为此而战。唯一的问题是该怎么做。
origin.4040.desc.en:
The debt collectors departed from our home system, but a deep sense of dread still linger. Given their dedication to their employer, they will never stop harassing us. Even if we somehow manage to repay the full sum, they will come up with something else - interest rates, legal loopholes, small print hidden in documents we don't remember signing.

If we can't buy back our freedom, we have no choice but to fight for it. The only question is how.

origin.4041.a.tooltip.zh: 我们现在可以使用血债血偿宣战理由向$NAME_MSI_country_initials$宣战了。
origin.4041.a.tooltip.en: We can now use the Payback casus belli to declare war to the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$.

origin.4041.desc.zh: 我们击败了他们一次，我们就能再次这么做。但这并非易事——第一次，他们没有料到我们会还手。现在，他们将动用舰队的全部军力来攻击我们。要赢得一线机会，我们必须争取时间，做好准备。这是一场我们输不起的战斗。
origin.4041.desc.en: We defeated them once, and we can do it again. But it won't be easy - the first time, they weren't expecting for us to fight back. Now, they will attack us with the full might of their fleet. To have any chance, we must bide our time and prepare ourselves. This is a battle we cannot afford to lose.

origin.4042.desc.galcom.zh: $NAME_MSI_country$对我们的所作所为或许是合法的，但这些事情在道德上站不住脚。为了防止类似的事情再次发生，我们需要强硬的法律来让他们负责。通过谨慎的外交，我们可以尝试破坏维系他们帝国的原则：贪婪、剥削、奴役。如果我们幸运的话，我们可以不费一刀一枪就将$NAME_MSI_country_initials$瓦解。
origin.4042.desc.galcom.en: What the $NAME_MSI_country$ has done to us may have been legal, but it was far from moral. To prevent this from ever happening again, we need strong laws to hold them accountable. Through careful diplomacy, we can attempt to undermine the very principles that hold their empire together: greed, exploitation, slavery. With luck, we can destroy $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ without ever firing a shot.

origin.4042.desc.nogalcom.zh:
$origin.4042.desc.galcom$

如果存在某个管理主体，我们就可以和想法类似的国家共同商讨这项事务……
origin.4042.desc.nogalcom.en:
$origin.4042.desc.galcom$

If only there was some sort of governing body we could join to discuss this matter with like-minded empires...

origin.4042.desc.nogalcommember.zh:
$origin.4042.desc.galcom$

是时候让我们加入星海共同体了。
origin.4042.desc.nogalcommember.en:
$origin.4042.desc.galcom$

It's time for us to join the Galactic Community.

origin.4050.a.tooltip.zh: 我们将工作重心放在通过$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$上，阻止帝国对前超光速文明进行剥削。为了确保法律执行，我们还需要支持所有4种制裁类型。
origin.4050.a.tooltip.en: We'll focus our efforts on passing the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$, preventing empires from exploiting pre-FTLs. We'll also need to support all 4 sanction types to enforce the law.

origin.4050.b.tooltip.zh: 我们将工作重心放在通过$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$上，防止帝国以任何方式影响前超光速社会的发展。为了确保法律执行，我们也需要通过全部4类制裁。
origin.4050.b.tooltip.en: We'll focus our efforts on passing the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$, preventing empires from influencing the development of pre-FTL societies in any way. We'll also need to pass all 4 sanction types to enforce the law.

origin.4050.desc.zh:
这是我们的新战场：参议院，一个通过选举投票和辩论来解决冲突的战区。

这是我们的武器：外交支持、大使、我们经济的力量以及我们愿景的纯洁。

我们的目标：禁止启蒙行为，阻止像$NAME_MSI_country_initials$这样的帝国剥削较弱的文明。

这就是我们获胜的地方。不是用暴力，而是用法律那不可动摇的力量。
origin.4050.desc.en:
Here is our new battlefield: the Senate floor, a war zone where conflicts are solved through vote-casting and debate.

Here are our weapons: favors, ambassadors, the strength of our economy and the purity of our vision.

Here is our goal: to ban enlightenment practices, preventing empires like the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ from exploiting weaker civilizations.

Here is where we win. Not with violence, but through the immutable power of the law.

origin.4052.desc.zh: 我们清单上的第一项议案已经通过。我们阻碍$NAME_MSI_country$的计划目前正全力推进。
origin.4052.desc.en: The first resolution on our list has passed. Our plan to hinder the $NAME_MSI_country$ is now in full motion.

origin.4055.desc.msi.zh: $origin.4055.intro$要想生存下来，$NAME_MSI_country_initials$必须全盘颠覆式地重新思考他们的商业战略——他们帝国内部不安定的消息已经开始传播。
origin.4055.desc.msi.en: $origin.4055.intro$ The $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ will have to radically rethink their business strategy to survive - and news of instability within their empire have already starting to spread.

origin.4055.desc.nomsi.zh: $origin.4055.intro$$NAME_MSI_country_initials$已经消亡了——多亏了我们的辛勤运作，没有其他帝国会取代它们的地位。
origin.4055.desc.nomsi.en: $origin.4055.intro$ The $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ is already gone - and thanks to our work, no other empire will ever replace them.

origin.4056.desc.zh:
致全体前客户的一封重要讯息：

自该公司第一次踏上星空的那一天起，我们就一直致力于改善其他文明，勤勉地帮助他们实现完全的潜能。经过数年的成功，董事会决定简化我们的流程，以更好反映我们公司的价值观。

相应地，我们已经暂时停止了文明启蒙活动，以便更好地将主要精力聚焦在品牌重塑上。

我们将在$NAME_MSI_country$开启勇于进取的全新篇章，感谢您的继续支持！
origin.4056.desc.en:
An important message to all our former clients:

From the day this company first reached the stars, we have dedicated ourselves to the betterment of other civilizations, diligently working to help them ascend to their full potential. After many successful years, the Board of Directors has made the decision to streamline our processes in order to better reflect our company values.

Accordingly, we have temporarily ceased our enlightenment activities to better focus on rebranding.

As we embark on a bold new chapter at $NAME_MSI_country$, we thank you for your continued support!

origin.4060.b.zh: 我们的事业仍值得为之进行斗争。
origin.4060.b.en: Our cause is still worth fighting.

origin.4060.b.tooltip.zh: 我们现在可以利用$casus_belli_cb_payback_punishment$宣战理由，向那些仍在剥削前超光速文明的国家发动战争。
origin.4060.b.tooltip.en: We can now use the $casus_belli_cb_payback_punishment$ casus belli to wage war against those who exploit pre-FTL civilizations.

origin.4060.desc.zh:
$origin.4060.intro$

我们应该庆祝。然后，也许我们应该放下武器，最终开始休养生息。
origin.4060.desc.en:
$origin.4060.intro$

We should celebrate. And then, perhaps, we should lay down our weapons and finally rest.

origin.4070.b.zh: 我们的事业仍值得为之进行斗争。
origin.4070.b.en: Our cause is still worth fighting.

origin.4070.b.tooltip.zh: 我们将继续斗争，直到全宇宙禁止对前超光速文明进行剥削。
origin.4070.b.tooltip.en: We'll keep fighting to ban the exploitation of pre-FTLs.

origin.4070.c.zh: 他们偷走了我们的复仇。他们要为此付出代价。
origin.4070.c.en: They stole our revenge. They'll pay for it.

origin.4070.d.tooltip.zh: 我们现在可以使用血债血偿宣战理由向[destroyer_country.GetName]宣战了。
origin.4070.d.tooltip.en: We can now use the Payback casus belli to declare war to the [destroyer_country.GetName].

origin.4070.desc.zh:
$origin.4060.intro$现在$NAME_MSI_country_initials$已经不复存在、被另一个[root.species.GetHandName]摧毁了。

我们的天空可能变得更加晴朗了，但我们的人民仍为永无止境的需求所占据，那便是：

复仇。
origin.4070.desc.en:
$origin.4060.intro$ Now the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ is gone, crushed by another [root.species.GetHandName].

Our skies may be clear, but our people are still possessed by an insatiable need:

Revenge.

origin.4071.a.zh: 除非所有的剥削者都消亡，否则我们没法安息。
origin.4071.a.en: There will be no peace until all exploiters are gone.

origin.4071.desc.zh: 复仇之后是什么呢？你已经目睹了天敌的陨落，那个应对灭亡你的天敌而负责的国家也因为你而陨落了。现在又该怎么办？我们现在能放下武器吗？我们能和平相处吗？
origin.4071.desc.en: What comes after revenge? What to do after witnessing the fall of your nemesis, and of the empire responsible for killing your nemesis? Can we lay down our weapons now? Can we be at peace?

origin.4100.desc.zh: 在[from.GetName]清理舰船残骸时，找到了一箱科技数据。
origin.4100.desc.en: While clearing the ship debris on [from.GetName], a cache of technological data was recovered.

origin.4105.desc.zh: 在[from.GetName]清理出的舰船残骸可以回收利用。
origin.4105.desc.en: The ship debris cleared on [from.GetName] can be repurposed for our own use.

origin.4110.a.phobe.zh: 也许这些异星人和我们并不完全是一模一样的。
origin.4110.a.phobe.en: Perhaps these xenos are not entirely unlike us.

origin.4110.desc.zh:
当我们第一次与[bsempire.GetName]接触时，我们曾惊叹于他们破译我们语言的速度。我们现在理解了原因。

当我们的前主人试图让我们屈服的时候，他们绑架了我们的人民。其中一些不幸的人被带上了一艘$NAME_MSI_country_initials$飞船。在孤注一掷的下，他们与船上的其他“契约奴隶”发动了兵变。他们在一颗无人居住的行星上进行了迫降，这次勇敢的反抗行为最终导致了[bsempire.GetName]的诞生。

我们拥有共同的敌人，以及共同的历史。或许，我们可以携手共建一个没有压迫的未来。
origin.4110.desc.en:
When we first made contact with the [bsempire.GetName], we marveled at the speed with which they deciphered our language. We now understand why.

When our former masters tried to bend us, they kidnapped our people. Some of these unfortunates wound up on an $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ ship. To their lasting credit, along with the other 'indentured assets' on board, they mutinied, crashing onto an uninhabited planet. This brave act of rebellion eventually resulted in the birth of the [bsempire.GetName].

We have a common enemy, and a shared history. And perhaps, together we can forge a future free from oppression.

origin.4120.b.zh: 共同的敌人并不能让我们加深友谊。
origin.4120.b.en: A common enemy doesn't make us friends.

origin.4120.desc.zh: 我们双方的帝国有一个共同的敌人：$NAME_MSI_country$。为了共同防范这个威胁，我们建议让他们的特工访问我们的机密情报。
origin.4120.desc.en: Our empires share a common enemy: the $NAME_MSI_country$. To protect ourselves against this threat, we suggest giving their operatives access to our classified intel.

origin.4130.b.zh: 我们的利益并不总是一致。

origin.4130.desc.zh: [root.GetName]，我们在参议院看到了贵方特使。团结一致，我们可以为共同的事业进行奋斗。通过协调我们双方的利益，我们可以更好地服务于共同的事业，反对奴隶制，终结对前超光速文明的干涉行为。
origin.4130.desc.en: We see your envoys on the Senate Floor, [root.GetName]. Together, we we can fight for causes that affect us both. By aligning our interests, we can make common cause against slavery and end the practice of interfering with pre-FTL empires.

origin.4140.desc.zh: 我们听说了你打算对$NAME_MSI_country$开战的计划。尽管我们人民拥有共同的历史，但我们并不认同你对复仇的渴望。不过，如果你对$NAME_MSI_country_initials$宣战，我们也会加入你的事业。
origin.4140.desc.en: We have heard about your plans to make war on the $NAME_MSI_country$. Although our people share a common history, we do not share your thirst for revenge. However, should you declare war against $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, we will join your cause.

origin.4150.desc.zh: 在$NAME_MSI_country_initials$，我们将自己的客户视作家人。今天，我们不由得感到骄傲。击杀了一只星神兽！对于一个新生的太空文明，这是一个重要的里程碑。为了象征我们对你们成就的尊敬，请收下我们送来的这份小礼物。
origin.4150.desc.en: At $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, we see our clients like family. Today, we can't help but feel proud. Slaying a Guardian! An important milestone for a fledgling space-faring society. As a token of our esteem for your accomplishment, please accept this small congratulatory gift from us.

origin.4160.a.zh: 我们可以运用你的帮助。

origin.4160.desc.zh:
多年前，我们给了你们一条通向天空的飞梯。今天，我们目睹了你们对一个低等文明提供了同样的帮助。

我们相信你们能把我们曾经的教导传授给他们。当然，如果你们需要帮助来起草一项有利可图的启蒙策略，你完全可以向我们咨询。
origin.4160.desc.en:
Years ago, we gave you a ladder to the sky. Today, we have witnessed you offer a lesser civilization the same help.

We trust you will be able to pass on our lessons to them. Of course, should you need any help in drafting a profitable enlightenment strategy, you have only to ask.

origin.4170.b.zh: 我们可以自己处理好自己的事。
origin.4170.b.en: We can manage it on our own.

origin.4170.desc.zh:
亲爱的前客户，

我们听说了你最近的经济困境。学习如何管理你的金融是运营一个帝国的必要部分，有些时候，失败也是学习的至关重要的一部分。

我们很乐意为你提供必须的资源，来让你的国家摆脱赤字。当然，出借的资源也将纳入你未偿还债务的一部分。我们希望这点小小的金融教训能对你有所帮助。
origin.4170.desc.en:
Dear former clients,

We heard about your recent economic troubles. Learning to manage your finances is a necessary part of running an empire, and sometimes, failure is an essential part of learning.

We are happy to offer you the necessary resources to put your country out of deficit. Of course, the cost loaned resources will be added to your outstanding debt. We hope this little financial lesson can be of help.

origin.4200.a.auth.zh: 我们会让他们瞧瞧，这里谁才是老大！

origin.4200.a.ega.zh: 我们要求对等沟通交流。
origin.4200.a.ega.en: We'll demand to be treated as equals.

origin.4200.b.mili.zh: 我们会让他们就过去的所作所为做出赔偿！
origin.4200.b.mili.en: We'll make them pay for what they did to us!

origin.4200.b.paci.zh: 我们不愿同他们产生进一步的冲突。
origin.4200.b.paci.en: We seek no further conflict with them.

origin.4200.c.phile.zh: 我们不能让恐惧阻止自己探索星海的步伐。
origin.4200.c.phile.en: We can't let fear stop us from exploring the galaxy.

origin.4200.c.phobe.zh: 我们不希望同异种产生交流。
origin.4200.c.phobe.en: We desire no further contact with xenos.

origin.4200.d.mate.zh: 我们希望研究他们。知己知彼。
origin.4200.d.mate.en: We want to study them. Know your enemy.

origin.4200.d.spiri.zh: 信徒的试炼必须要进行处理。
origin.4200.d.spiri.en: The trials of the faithful must be dealt with in turn.

origin.4200.desc.zh: 同我们前入侵者的会面促使我们的政坛领袖、宗教人士、科学家、艺术家和外交官之间举行了一场紧急会议。各界人士纷纷就各种战略进行讨论、否定、重新论证、改进、投票表决。经过几个月的高强度磋商，我们帝国最聪明的头脑已经达成了类似于共识的东西。
origin.4200.desc.en: The sighting of our former invaders has prompted an emergency meeting between political leaders, religious figures, scientists, artists, and diplomats. Strategies have been discussed, rejected, reconsidered, improved, voted on. After months of tense consultations, the brightest minds of our empire have reached something resembling a consensus.

origin.4205.a.zh: 他们有权表达自己的观点。
origin.4205.a.en: They have the right to express their views.

origin.4205.desc.zh: 尽管采取了一些安管措施，我们与$NAME_MSI_country$发生遭遇的新闻依然传播给了公众，给这个刚刚开始从苦痛的过往中恢复过来的行星造成了不小的混乱。公众舆论……难以统一：有许多持不同看法的声音，从出离的愤怒到不怀好意的怀旧之情。无论我们作出什么样的决策，都会需要一定的暴力阻力。
origin.4205.desc.en: Despite security measures, news of our encounter with the $NAME_MSI_country$ is spreading to the public, bringing chaos to a planet that was just beginning to recover from its past. Public opinion is... Fragmented: many dissenting voices, expressing everything from rage to ill-aimed nostalgia. Regardless of the decision, our actions will be met with violence.

origin.4210.desc.zh: 经过长时间的周密准备，我们的特使已经向$NAME_MSI_country_initials$呈递了一条信息。我们已经准备好按照自己的条件会见前主人，为我们人民的意愿发声。
origin.4210.desc.en: After extended preparations, our envoys have sent a message to the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$. We are ready to meet our former masters on our terms, giving voice to the will of our people.

origin.4300.a.tooltip.zh: 在行星面板上选择$building_medical_2$，点击修复按钮尝试对其修复。同其他国家签署科研协议能够提高成功修复的概率。
origin.4300.a.tooltip.en: Select the $building_medical_2$ on the planetary view screen and click the repair button to attempt a fix. Establishing research agreements with other empires will increase our chances of success.

origin.4300.aliens.phile.desc.zh: $origin.4300.base.desc$其他国家可能也有类似的设施。我们应该开口求助。
origin.4300.aliens.phile.desc.en: $origin.4300.base.desc$Other empires might possess similar facilities. We should ask for help.

origin.4300.aliens.phobe.desc.zh: $origin.4300.base.desc$尽管其他国家可能也有类似的设施，但是向异种求助无疑会让我族蒙羞。
origin.4300.aliens.phobe.desc.en: $origin.4300.base.desc$Other empires might possess similar facilities, but asking the xenos for help would only bring us shame.

origin.4300.b.memorialist.tooltip.zh: 将$building_medical_2$转变成一座$building_galactic_memorial_1$，花费会有所减少。
origin.4300.b.memorialist.tooltip.en: Turn the $building_medical_2$ into a $building_galactic_memorial_1$ at a reduced cost.

origin.4300.b.tooltip.zh: 将$building_medical_2$转变成一座$building_autochthon_monument$，花费会有所减少。
origin.4300.b.tooltip.en: Turn the $building_medical_2$ into an $building_autochthon_monument$ at a reduced cost.

origin.4300.noaliens.desc.zh: $origin.4300.base.desc$如果我们多认识些朋友就好了。

origin.4301.a.zh: 或许……外星人也不全都是那么坏？
origin.4301.a.en: Perhaps... the Xenos aren't all bad?

origin.4301.agreement.desc.zh: $origin.4301.base.desc$但不管他们说什么，在慷慨的盟友派出的专家的帮助下，我们都完成了。
origin.4301.agreement.desc.en: $origin.4301.base.desc$ But we did it anyway, supported by the expertise of our generous allies.

origin.4301.end.desc.zh: 我们能够自己照顾自己。
origin.4301.end.desc.en: We can take care of ourselves.

origin.4301.noagreement.desc.zh: $origin.4301.base.desc$但不管他们说什么，我们都自主独立地完成了，没有他们的任何协助，这下胜利独属于我们了。
origin.4301.noagreement.desc.en: $origin.4301.base.desc$ But we did it anyway, without their assistance, and the triumph is ours alone.

origin.4302.a.zh: 这次没那么容易失败了。

origin.4302.desc.zh: 事实证明，要想对使$building_medical_2$运转的技术进行逆向工程，这件事比我们料想的更具挑战性。但我们的[root.GetEngineerPlural]仍然充满希望。他们说，自己只是需要更多的时间。然而，随着成本和失败开始堆积，一些人认为应当对诊所进行改造，使其用于另一项事务。
origin.4302.desc.en: Reverse engineering the technology powering the $building_medical_2$ turned out to be more challenging than expected, but our [root.GetEngineerPlural] remain hopeful. They just need more time, they say. But as costs and failures start piling up, some argue the clinics should be retrofitted to suit a different purpose.

origin.4303.desc.zh:
我们尝试维修$building_medical_2$的努力最终失败了：巨大的爆炸吞没了建筑，现场死伤惨重。

无疑，前入侵者一定正在嗤嗤嘲笑我们的自大、愚蠢和鲁莽。这次失败我们咎由自取，但这堂课我们也同样印象深刻。
origin.4303.desc.en:
Our attempt to repair the $building_medical_2$ ended in failure: a massive explosion engulfed the building, and numerous casualties have been reported.

No doubt our former invaders are laughing, calling us arrogant, foolish, unprepared. Yet this failure belongs to us, and its hard lessons will not be forgotten.

origin.4304.desc.zh: 我们的$building_medical_2$可能不再能够治愈疾病，但是通过将一些关键部件拆卸下来，并将其重新用于纪念馆的展出，至少我们能够开始治愈入侵者留下的疤痕。与过去和解，我们才能逐渐克服这一切。
origin.4304.desc.en: Our $building_medical_2$ may no longer have the power to cure disease, but by stripping them of their components and repurposing them into memorials, we can at least start to heal the scars left by the invaders. By making peace with the past, we can learn to overcome it.

origin.4305.a.zh: 在医疗研究方面加倍投入。
origin.4305.a.en: Double our investment in medical research.

origin.4305.a.tooltip.zh: 提高发现$tech_frontier_health$科技的可能性。
origin.4305.a.tooltip.en: Increases the likelihood of discovering $tech_frontier_health$ technology.

origin.4305.c.zh: 死亡对我们来说从来不是问题。
origin.4305.c.en: Death has never been a problem for us.

origin.4305.desc.zh: 由于我们失去了$building_medical_2$，医疗保障的质量急剧下降。曾经很容易治愈的遗传病和慢性病病例又开始上升，我们的预期寿命中位数返回到了占领前的水平。公众对医疗保障系统的信心已经达到了新的低点，我们中的一些人甚至开始感叹，入侵者走了不如不走。
origin.4305.desc.en: The loss of our $building_medical_2$ has precipitated a sharp decline in the quality of our healthcare. Genetic conditions and chronic illnesses that were once simple to cure are again on the rise, and our median life expectancy has returned to pre-occupation levels. Public faith in the healthcare system has reached a new low, and some of our people are even starting to lament the departure of the invaders.

origin.4306.desc.zh: 在掌握了基因工程的奥秘之后，我们的人民现在有能力建造$building_medical_2$，其能力水平同入侵者先前留下来的那些一模一样。对我们的人民来说，这是极其光荣的一天：证明我们无需[root.species.GetHandName]的把控，也能触及星辰。
origin.4306.desc.en: Having mastered the secrets of genetic engineering, our people are now able to build $building_medical_2$ like the ones left by the invaders. It's a glorious day for our people: proof that we need no [root.species.GetHandName]-holding to reach the stars.

origin.4900.desc.zh: 与外星侵略者的战斗使我们的母星系充满了残骸、破碎的战舰和背弃的诺言。大量的废弃物料散布其中，使得从[owner.capital_scope.GetName]研发卫星和发射宇宙飞船变得更加困难。得益于清理计划的提出，专门设计的工程船可以用网在近地轨道上进行清理，让我们逐渐打通去往那艘仍漂浮在我们首都上空的$NAME_MSI_country_initials$战舰的路线。
origin.4900.desc.en: The battle against the alien invaders left our home system full of debris, shattered warships, and broken promises. The sheer amount of flotsam cluttering the area has made it harder to develop satellites and to launch spaceships from [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Under the proposed cleanup project, specially-designed construction ships will utilize nets to dredge the space in near-orbit, allowing us to approach the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ warship that still looms over our capital.

origin.4905.desc.zh:
我们的传感器无法在废弃战舰中探测到任何生命迹象，空空如也的船舱里引擎仍在轻微地嗡嗡作响，各种机械也还在运转。有理由相信，这艘船仍可正常运转，如果强行登船肯定会激活其安保系统。

我们务必谨慎开展工作。
origin.4905.desc.en:
Our sensors cannot detect signs of life within the derelict warship, and yet the engines still faintly buzz and machines are at work inside the empty halls. There is good reason to believe the ship is still operational, and attempts to board it are sure to awaken its security system.

We must proceed with caution.

origin.4910.d.zh: 恶人也应该得到妥善安葬。
origin.4910.d.en: Even villains deserve a proper burial.

origin.4910.desc.zh:
我们的施工人员正在清除碎片，修复损伤并确保舱室安全，把这艘曾经威胁我们星球的战舰变成新的行动基地。在残骸中，我们找到了越来越多的船员尸体或者残肢断臂。

如何处理这些遗体引发了公众的热议。
origin.4910.desc.en:
Our construction crews are clearing debris, repairing damage and securing rooms, turning the warship that once terrorized our world into a base of operations. Amidst the wreckage, we have uncovered the bodies of the ship's crew, or rather, what's left of them.

What to do with these remains is a matter of public debate.

origin.4920.desc.zh: 当我们仔细搜索战舰的中央数据库的时候，我们逐渐搞清楚了前任主人的整个计划。他们打着启蒙的幌子接近我们，只是为了将我们训练成为更好的奴隶；他们满怀善意呈上的计划和协议，只不过是精心编织的谎言。我们的星球显然不是他们第一次这么干，而是他们核心“商业战略”的一个典范。
origin.4920.desc.en: As we scour the warship's central database, the designs of our former masters have grown clear. The way they approached with enlightenment, only to train us to become better slaves; their well-honed plans and protocols; their calculated lies. Our world was clearly not their first attempt, but rather an example of their core 'business strategy.'

origin.4925.a.tt.zh: 让我们可以将战舰修复成一艘旗舰或居住站。
origin.4925.a.tt.en: Allows us to restore the warship into either a Flagship or Habitat.

origin.4925.desc.zh: 我们已经完全控制了这艘废弃战舰的系统。我们现在必须决定如何处理它。根据我们的需求，它对于战争和研究都可以成为非常有利用价值的资源。
origin.4925.desc.en: We have gained complete control of the derelict warship's systems. We now must decide what to do with it. Depending on our needs, it could be a powerful asset for either war or research.

origin.4930.desc.zh: 我们星系中的清理工程正在顺利进行中。[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上空的碎片数量大幅减少了。随着天空逐渐明晰，我们的未来也变得越来越光明。工作仍在继续，一切都在向好的方向发展。
origin.4930.desc.en: The cleanup operation in our system is well underway. The amount of debris over [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has been significantly reduced, and with clearing skies, our expectations for the future are also bright. Work continues, but things are looking better.

origin.4931.desc.zh: 清理工作已经大功告成了。穿过这一片没有碎片的天空，我们的科研船就可以靠近战舰并安全地开始探索残骸。
origin.4931.desc.en: The cleanup operation is now complete. With our skies free from debris, our science ships are now able to approach the warship and safely explore the wreck.

origin.4934.desc.zh:
对前弥特集团战舰进行改造的工作已经完成。现在我们能够指挥一艘具有强大火力和战略意义的舰船了。

接招吧，星辰大海！
origin.4934.desc.en:
The retrofit of the former MSI Warship is complete. We now have at our disposal a vessel of massive power and significance.

Watch out, galaxy!

origin.4934.tt.zh: 战舰已经修复成为了一艘旗舰，能够在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的轨道上作为一个移动船坞。
origin.4934.tt.en: The warship in orbit of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has been restored into a Flagship.

origin.4935.desc.zh: 对前弥特集团战舰进行改造的工作已经完成。现在我们拥有了最先进的科研设施，它将会为我们推进科技知识的开发提供帮助。
origin.4935.desc.en: The retrofit of the former MSI Warship is complete. We have now gained a state of the art science facility which will be instrumental to us in advancing our technological knowledge.

origin.4935.tt.zh: 战舰已经被修复成了一座居住站，在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的轨道上专门攻破弥特集团科技的秘密。
origin.4935.tt.en: The warship has been restored into a Habitat, devoted to uncovering the secrets of MSI's technology, in orbit of [owner.capital_scope.GetName].

origin.4936.desc.zh: 最近我们在舰船设计方面有所进步，使我们对升级旗舰、利用以前未使用的系统有了深入了解。
origin.4936.desc.en: Recent advancements in our ship designs have led to an insight in how to upgrade our flagship to make use of previously unused systems.

origin.4936.tt.zh: 开启一项升级旗舰的特殊项目。
origin.4936.tt.en: Enables a Special Project to upgrade the flagship.

origin.4937.desc.zh: 我们已经升级了旗舰。利用船上现有的技术，我们能够对它的系统进行逆向工程，以获得对飞船内部运作更好的了解。
origin.4937.desc.en: We have upgraded the flagship. Utilizing the existing technology onboard, we have been able to reverse-engineer its systems and gain a better understanding of the inner workings of the vessel.

origin.4937.tt.zh: 我们的旗舰已经升级，可以利用以前未使用的系统。
origin.4937.tt.en: Our flagship has been upgraded to make use of previously unused systems.

origin.5000.a.zh: 属于我们人民的伟大日子。
origin.5000.a.en: A great day for our people.

origin.5000.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]……终于，我们回来了。

我们的民族曾经历了难以想象的苦难。从家园中被掳走，被迫拷上脚镣，或是成为任人买卖的契约财产，往往我们要面对的就是这些凶残的遭遇。即便是那些过得稍微轻松一些的人身上也带着曾被奴役的耻辱。而现在，回到我们同胞的怀抱中，我们终于可以开始治愈创伤了。

但在欢乐之余我们别忘了，事实上我们是来自许多不同星球的民族。不论起源，我们中的每个人都有归乡的权利。

我们的前主人不择手段地打散我们。而今天，整个星系将见证他们的失败。
origin.5000.desc.en:
[From.GetName]... At last, we have returned.

As a people, we have experienced unimaginable trauma. Stolen from our homes, forced into bondage, the life of an indentured asset was often one of brutal suffering. Even for those who passed their days in relative comfort, the shame of indenture lingers. Now, reunited with our kin, we can finally begin to heal.

But in our joy we must never lose sight of the fact that we are a people of many worlds. No matter our origins, every one of us deserves the chance to return home.

Our former masters did their best to break us. Today the whole galaxy is witness to their failure.

origin.5001.conquered.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]……自从我们被掳走以来，这里发生了很多事情。我们的这些同胞已经失去了主权，被另一个星系强权所统治了。

而我们则已经没有了归处，我们被偷走的过去再也找不回来。我们现在能做的只有朝前看。
origin.5001.conquered.desc.en:
[From.GetName]... Since we were taken from our home, much has transpired here. Far from a sovereign people, our kin have been claimed by another galactic power.

For us, there is no going back; our stolen past can never be reclaimed. All we can do now is look to the future.

origin.5001.empty.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]……肯定是搞错了什么。在轨道上我们无法探测到任何感性生命。所有的人口可能都被某种方式抹去了。

尽管这与我们预想的归乡大相径庭，但返回这个恒星系还是让我们向着寻回自己过去迈出了一步。不幸的是，我们得独自携带者[From.GetName]前行了，只有靠我们才能传承记忆。
origin.5001.empty.desc.en:
[From.GetName]... Something is very wrong here. From orbit, we can detect no signs of sentient life. Somehow, the entire population has been eliminated.

While this was not the homecoming we hoped for, by returning to this system we have taken another step towards reclaiming our past. Unfortunately, we alone must carry the legacy of [From.GetName]. It is up to us to remember.

origin.5001.homecoming.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]……在轨道上看，它是这么地微小。

人们并不是拥有星球，而是属于这颗星球。回到这里，我们又向找回自己的过去迈进了一步。

我们在前主人的手中遭受的苦难永远不能弥消。真正的疗愈需要花费几个世代。但总之，今天确实是个好日子。
origin.5001.homecoming.desc.en:
[From.GetName]... From orbit, it appears so small.

A world does not belong to its people; it is the people who belong to their world. In returning here, we take another step towards reclaiming our past.

The trauma we experienced at the hands of our former masters can never be undone. True healing will take generations. But today is a good day.

origin.5001.tomb.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]……这里发生了非常不好的事情。

被炸毁的土地上尘土飞荡。大部分的表面都被辐射了，少数绝望的幸存者在废墟中坚持生活。

虽然这不是我们所希望的归宿，但通过返回这个星系，我们已经向收回我们的过去的一步迈进了。
origin.5001.tomb.desc.en:
[From.GetName]... Something very wrong has happened here.

Dust drifts across a blasted landscape. Much of the surface is irradiated, and the few desperate survivors cling to life in the ruins.

While this was not the homecoming we hoped for, by returning to this system we have taken another step towards reclaiming our past.

origin.5001.uplifted.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]……自从我们被掳走以来，这里发生了蓬勃的发展。他们不再被局限于单一行星上，而是已经迈向了繁星的征途。尽管这与我们预想的归乡大相径庭，但返[From.GetName]上的科技进步属实卓越。

而我们则已经没有了归处，我们被偷走的过去再也找不回来。我们现在能做的只有朝前看。
origin.5001.uplifted.desc.en:
[From.GetName]... Since we were taken from our home, much has transpired here. No longer bound to a single planet, the population has turned towards the stars. While this may not be the homecoming we expected, the technological progress on [From.GetName] is remarkable.

For us, there is no going back; our stolen past can never be reclaimed. All we can do now is look to the future.

origin.5002.a.zh: 我们再也担负不起任何一名国民的损失了。
origin.5002.a.en: We cannot afford to lose any more of our people.

origin.5002.b.zh: 自由迁徙是一项基本权利。
origin.5002.b.en: Freedom of movement is a fundamental right.

origin.5002.b.tt.zh:
[broken_shackles_homeworld_owner.GetName]：
$t$将感知设置为 100.00。
$t$+50% 每月科技进步持续 5 年。
origin.5002.b.tt.en:
[broken_shackles_homeworld_owner.GetName]:
$t$Sets Awareness to 100.00.
$t$+50% Monthly Technological Progression for 5 Years.

origin.5002.desc.zh:
挣脱枷锁后，我们走出了成为一个民族的第一步。然而，在返回我们曾经的母星后，共同的目标开始发生动摇。

大众媒体充斥着对$NAME_MSI_country$到来前我们被母星上“返璞归真生活”的高度浪漫化的描述。而有许多人已经回到了母星。

如果我们不加以晶体，这可能会让我们的社会发生严重的动荡。
origin.5002.desc.en:
In casting off our shackles, we took the first step towards becoming a people. However, after returning to our former home world that sense of shared purpose has begun to wane.

Popular media is awash with highly romanticized depictions of the 'simple life' enjoyed on our former home world before the arrival of $NAME_MSI_country$. Many have already returned.

If we are not careful, this could have a seriously destabilizing effect on our society.

origin.5003.desc.zh: 一个新的群众运动已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上站稳脚跟。这些极端分子自称为“归乡者”，主张我们应该将全体人民送回他们的起源行星，同时令国家解体。安全部队已将警戒状态提高到高级别，任何人数超过100人的公共集会都被禁止。
origin.5003.desc.en: A new movement has taken root on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Calling themselves The Returners, these extremists are advocating for the wholesale return of our people to their planets of origin, as well as the dissolution of our empire. Security forces have been placed on high alert, and all public gatherings of more than 100 individuals banned.

origin.5004.desc.zh: 归乡者们正在煽动反政府情绪，呼吁我们帝国的各物种落叶归根，回到自己的故土。该运动中最极端的派系已经和亲政府军队之间爆发了战斗。据报道，几个主要的城市中心已经遭到了严重的破坏。
origin.5004.desc.en: Stoking anti-government sentiment, The Returners are calling on the various species in our empire to return to their roots. Fighting has broken out between the movement's most extreme factions and pro-government forces. Severe damage has been reported in several major urban centers.

origin.5005.a.zh: 只有强人的手腕才能铸造国家。
origin.5005.a.en: Only a strong hand can forge a nation.

origin.5005.desc.zh: 虽然为了禁止人民返回他们各自的家园星球，我们付出了一定的代价，但事实最终证明了这个决策是正确的。近期，我们目睹社会凝聚力得到了明显的改善，同时，人们对于[Root.Capital.GetName]才是我们的家园这一观点有了崭新的共识。
origin.5005.desc.en: While forbidding our people to return to their respective home worlds has not been without its consequences, in the end it has proven the correct decision. Recently, we have witnessed a marked improvement in social cohesion, as well as a newfound sense that [Root.Capital.GetName] is indeed our home.

origin.5006.a.zh: 我们必须避免人才进一步的流失。
origin.5006.a.en: We must prevent any further loss of talent.

origin.5006.desc.zh: 虽然允许人们移民到我们曾经的家园星球在过去是一项群众喜闻乐见的政策，但也有相应的后果。最近，我们经历了一次重大的“人才流失”，因为一些最聪明的人才选择了迁往别处。
origin.5006.desc.en: While permitting emigration to our former home worlds has proven a popular policy, it has not been consequence-free. Recently, we have experienced a significant 'brain drain', as some of some of our brightest minds have made the choice to relocate.

origin.5007.desc.zh: 允许我们的人民返回自己的母星，作出这样的决策并非没有代价。但是，自由迁徙的政策推动了思想枷锁的解除。新的想法正在蓬勃发展，科学技术的进步已成为常态，而非一时的例外。
origin.5007.desc.en: The decision to allow our people to return to their home worlds was not without its costs, but with freedom of movement has come an unshackling in thought; new ideas are flourishing, and advances in science and technology are the norm rather than the exception.

origin.5008.desc.zh: 允许我们的人民返回自己的母星，作出这样的决策并非没有代价。但是，自由迁徙的政策推动了思想枷锁的解除。新的想法正在蓬勃发展，社会层面的革新已成为常态，而非一时的例外。
origin.5008.desc.en: The decision to allow our people to return to their home worlds was not without its costs, but with freedom of movement has come an unshackling in thought; new ideas are flourishing, and advances in society are the norm rather than the exception.

origin.5009.desc.zh: [From.GetName]……我们几乎忘记了空气中的芬芳。在经历了所有的一切之后，我们现在回归了家园，一切都显得如此不真实。
origin.5009.desc.en: [From.GetName]... We had almost forgotten the scent of the air. To return now, after all we have experienced, feels almost unreal.

origin.5010.desc.zh:
在起义后，我们中有的人说，我们应该各奔前程了。他们坚称[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]不是我们的家园，我们只不过是一群由契约资产组成的乌合之众，我们面临的困难太过艰巨不可战胜。

但我们第一座空间站的竣工，昭示着自由民能够完成伟大的壮举。只有想不到，没有做不到。
origin.5010.desc.en:
After the mutiny, there were some among us who said we should go our separate ways. They argued that [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] was not our home, that we were nothing but a motley band of indentured assets, and that the challenges before us were too great to overcome.

But with the building of our first Outpost, we've shown exactly what a free people can accomplish. The only limit is our own imagination.

origin.5011.desc.zh:
在摆脱桎梏的斗争历程中，我们迈出了成为一个民族的第一步。然而，近年来，大众媒体充斥着对我们以前在家园星球所享受的“朴素生活”的叙述，言语之间尽是浪漫美化。许多人已经吵着要回去。

如果我们不小心谨慎，这场运动将严重影响我们社会秩序的稳定。
origin.5011.desc.en:
In casting off our shackles, we took the first step towards becoming a people. However, in recent years, popular media is awash with highly romanticized depictions of the 'simple life' enjoyed on our former home world. Many are already clamoring to return.

If we are not careful, this movement could have a seriously destabilizing effect on our society.

origin.5015.desc.zh:
在起义中，将我们运往[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的运奴船受损严重。在紧急迫降后，我们的第一任务是生存，除了拆解舰船获取资源以外我们几乎没有什么别的想法。但现在是时候去发掘我们前主人的秘密了。

为此，首先我们要恢复舰船中央计算机的供能。我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师先是在船体的外部装配了一组太阳能电池，舰桥上的指挥控制台便可以恢复运转。但不幸的是，迫降时工程甲板的大门被卡死了，破拆防爆门进入其中可不是件容易的事。
origin.5015.desc.en:
During the mutiny, the slaver ship that carried us to [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] was badly damaged. After the crash, our first priority was survival, and other than stripping the ship for resources, we gave it little thought. But now the time has come to uncover the secrets of our former masters.

To do so, it will be necessary to restore power to the ship's central computer. As a first step, our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers rigged a series of solar cells to the ship's outer hull. The command consoles in the bridge are now operational. Unfortunately, the engineering deck was sealed off during the crash, and breaking through the blast doors won't be easy.

origin.5020.desc.zh:
$NAME_MSI_country$也不是盖的：这些蓄奴的混蛋还真挺能保护自己的机密。

敲开舰船的防爆门果然是一项史诗级任务。我们几乎没有设计用来进行小规模采矿作业的激光切割器。我们的团队只能是从甲板的下方挖洞才最终取得了进展。[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师们现在已经开始加班加点恢复舰船其他部分的能量供应。
origin.5020.desc.en:
Say this much for $NAME_MSI_country$: the slave-holding scum know how to safeguard their secrets.

Prying open the ship's blast doors has proven a monumental task. What few laser cutters we possess were designed for low-scale mining operations. Only by tunneling up from the deck below was the team able to make any progress. [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers are now hard at work restoring power to the rest of the ship's systems.

origin.5025.a.zh: 我们需要那数据。修复核心。
origin.5025.a.en: We need that data. Repair the core.

origin.5025.desc.zh: 虽然我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师已经设法恢复了飞船计算机核心的电源，但绝大部分的硬件还是在坠毁时损坏了。尽管还是有可能修复，但这样做意味着给我们已经负担过重的科学团队带来了更大的压力。
origin.5025.desc.en: While our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers have managed to restore power to the ship's computer core, a significant chunk of hardware was damaged in the crash. It should be possible to repair, but doing so means putting even more of a strain on our already overburdened science team.

origin.5030.desc.zh:
得益于一些异想天开的方案，我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师们诚通地重启了受损的计算机核心。在舰船系统中引入程序化人工智能，我们就可以开启会话。总的来说，我们感觉这台机器还是愿意帮我们一把的，而不是在碍我们事。

这项突破给予我们的科学家一些关于数据加密的新线索。随着我们逐渐在星系舞台上崭露头角，这些知识一定能派上用场的。
origin.5030.desc.en:
Thanks to some incredible, outside-the-box thinking, our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers have managed to restart the damaged computer core. By introducing a procedural AI to the ship's systems, we were able to engage it in dialogue. Essentially, we convinced the machine to work with, rather than against us.

The breakthrough has provided our scientists with new insights into the nature of data encryption. As we continue to make our presence felt on the galactic stage, such knowledge could prove invaluable.

origin.5035.desc.zh: 损坏的计算机核心已经完全修好了，尽管多数的数据是加密的，但破译工作已经开始。只要愿意花费时间和人力物力，我们迟早能获得包括我们原母星的位置在内的所有信息。
origin.5035.desc.en: The damaged computer core has been fully repaired, and while most of the data is encoded, decryption efforts are already underway. If we're willing to put in the time and allocate the resources, it's only a matter of time before we have access to everything - including the location of our former home worlds.

origin.5035.desc.MSInocontact.zh:
$origin.5035.desc$

事实上，我们或许已经收集到了一些对我们有利的信息：通过对在超空间航道网中穿梭的贩奴船进行三角定位，我们已经发现了$NAME_MSI_country$的宇宙坐标。

现在有两个选项摆在我们面前，直面前宗主，或是单纯祈祷上天降下惩罚。
origin.5035.desc.MSInocontact.en:
$origin.5035.desc$

In fact, we may have already learned something to our advantage: by triangulating the hyperlane dilations along the slaver ship's flight path, we have uncovered the galactic coordinates of $NAME_MSI_country$.

We now have the choice, either to confront our former masters, or leave them to their fate.

origin.5040.a.zh: 属于我们人民的伟大日子。
origin.5040.a.en: A great day for our people.

origin.5040.a.tooltip.zh: 现在我们可以在情报日志中跟踪关于我们曾经的母星的发现。
origin.5040.a.tooltip.en: The discovery of our former home worlds can now be tracked in the Situation Log.

origin.5040.desc.zh: 反编译坠毁殖民船数据库的特殊计划已经完成。我们找回了我们曾经的母星的位置。今日，我们大可庆祝我们在解放道路上踏出的又一步。
origin.5040.desc.en: The Special Project to decompile the databanks on the crashed slaver ship has concluded. We have uncovered the locations of our former home worlds. Today, we celebrate another step on the road to liberation.

origin.5041.desc.zh:
团结一致反对我们以前的奴隶主很容易；有了一个共同的敌人，我们就能像拧成一股绳一样抗争和战斗。但随着自由的到来，人民内部的裂痕开始出现。

我们是来自不同星球的民族聚集体，我们的政治也同样多元。新的派系正在组建起来。肯定也会出现未来更多的派系。作为一个民族，我们能否妥善处理这些差异，将决定我们的命运。
origin.5041.desc.en:
To unite against our former masters was easy; with a common enemy, we struggled and fought as one. But with freedom, cracks have started to appear.

We are a people of many worlds, and our politics are no less diverse. New factions are being founded. More will surely follow. As a people, how well we navigate these differences will determine our fate.

origin.5046.a.zh: 这是在无用地浪费资源。

origin.5046.desc.zh:
我们是一个拥有众多星球的民族，随着时间的推移，我们已经认识到多样性的宝贵价值。然而，要让几种不同的文化间保持平衡并非易事，更不要说完全不同的物种在生理上的需求也各不相同。我们之间隔阂渐生，尽管到现在为止，我们依然想方设法驾驭住了不断变化的政治格局，但我们不能对社会中固有的分歧视而不见了。

现在许多人呼吁成立一个特别委员会，来调和这些改革的呼声。
origin.5046.desc.en:
We are a people of many worlds, and over time we have learned the value of diversity. However, negotiating the dynamics of several different cultures - not to mention the physical needs of completely distinct species - has not been easy. Our differences run deep, and while we have managed to navigate the shifting political landscape up to now, the divisions inherent in our society have grown impossible to ignore.

Many are now calling for a special committee to be formed to moderate the calls for reform.

origin.5047.desc.zh: 当多样化的思想聚集在一起时，难以预料他们能够实现什么样的成就；我们的研究团队增加了一名新晋的、非[Root.GetSpeciesName]成员，此人已经取得了一些新的研究成果。
origin.5047.desc.en: When diverse minds come together, there's no telling what they can accomplish; the addition of a new, non [Root.GetSpeciesName] member to our research team is already producing results.
