origin.5049.desc.zh: 作为一个起源于众多不同星球的民族，整合全体人民绝非易事。然而，我们多元化的艺术传统经过融合，产生了令人难以置信的创造力的源泉，广受好评的新产品层出不穷。无数艺术家和设计师涌现出来，他们都受到多元化的启发，不断拓展表现手法的前沿。国内相关产业得到空前的蓬勃发展，我们的人民从未像现在这样投身于这些事业。
origin.5049.desc.en: As a people of many worlds, integration has not been without its challenges. However, the synthesis of our diverse artistic traditions has resulted in an incredible amount of creative energy. New products are being promoted. Countless artists and designers have emerged, all inspired to push the boundaries of expression. Domestic industry is thriving, and our people have never been more engaged.

origin.5065.desc.zh:
这一刻如期而至：我们与[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]建立了联系。

在起义后，有的人希望我们苟全性命于乱世，但显然$NAME_MSI_country$早已发现我们在星系舞台上的存在了。只有对利益的考虑可以阻止他们回来[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]拿回他们的“合法财产”。看来我们还不值得他们这么做。
origin.5065.desc.en:
The moment we have long anticipated has arrived: we have made contact with [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

After the mutiny, some hoped we could avoid detection, but it is now clear that $NAME_MSI_country$ have been aware of our presence on the galactic stage for some time. Only the pursuit of profit has kept them from returning to [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] to collect their 'legal assets.' It seems we weren't worth the cost of travel.

origin.5070.desc.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的代表会见了我们的特使并表达的善意。但我们很明白这些允诺有多么地空洞虚伪。

公司来到我们的星球，允诺带来更好的生活。他们利用花言巧语和蝇头小利打通了我们领导层的关系，然后签订了协议并获得了贷款。资本开始运作，我们市场中的商品瞬间充盈了起来。在我们搞明白发生了什么之前一切都已经结束了：我们成了$NAME_MSI_country_initials$的私有财产。

这种事情不会再发生了。随着我们走向星系舞台，独立自主变得非常重要。
origin.5070.desc.en:
Representatives from the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] have approached our envoy with offers of friendship. But we know how hollow such assurances are.

The corporation first arrived on our worlds with promises of a better life. With sweet words and lavish gifts, they softened our leaders. Loans were provided; contracts signed. Investment capital flowed, and our marketplaces flooded with goods. Before we fully understood what was happening, it had already been done: we had become assets, and $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ our masters.

Never again. As we push forward on the galactic stage, it's essential that we stand on our own.

origin.5075.desc.zh:
经过了一系列冗长而措辞激烈的会议，我们与[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]终于是正式建交了。然而，无论他们如何强调亲善，我们也绝不会忘记他们对我们的母星所犯下的罪行。想到这个公司还逍遥法外，肆意地像对待过去的我们一样奴役他人……我们早已出离愤怒。

过去他们把我们视为财产和工具。现在我们要让他们知道自由民的厉害。
origin.5075.desc.en:
After a prolonged and often intense series of meetings, diplomatic relations have been established between ourselves and [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. However, no matter their claims of friendship, we have not forgotten what they did to our home worlds. The thought that this corporation has been left unpunished, free to enslave others as they once did us... The emotion goes beyond words.

Once they called us property. Let us teach them the value of a free people.

origin.5080.desc.zh:
我们派往星海共同体的代表汇报：已经与[MSI_country.GetName]建立联络。

公司来到我们的星球，允诺带来更好的生活。他们利用花言巧语和蝇头小利打通了我们领导层的关系，然后签订了协议并获得了贷款。在我们搞明白发生了什么之前一切都已经结束了：我们成了他们的私有财产。必须给星海共同体的成员提个醒，千万不要上$NAME_MSI_country_initials$的当。
origin.5080.desc.en:
Word from our representatives at the Galactic Community: contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName].

The corporation first arrived on our worlds with promises of a better life. With sweet words and lavish gifts, they softened our leaders. Loans were provided; contracts signed. Before we truly understood what was happening, it had already been done: we had become assets, and they our masters. The members of the Galactic Community must be warned. $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ cannot be trusted.

origin.5094.desc.zh: $resolution_proposed_intro$全星系范围内的奴隶劳工和奴隶牲口制度。如果我们真心想要支持自由，那么就必须旗帜鲜明地站在改革的一方。如果我们没能作出行动，我们的人民会怎么想？
origin.5094.desc.en: $resolution_proposed_intro$ chattel and livestock slavery throughout the galaxy. If we truly profess to favor freedom, we must stand on the side of change. What will our people think, if we fail to act?

origin.5095.a.zh: 开明的思想取得了胜利。

origin.5095.desc.zh: 今天对于星海共同体来说是伟大的一天，各成员国投票决定将绝大多数形式的奴隶制裁定为非法。星系的人们再也不需要担心被下作的暴徒和唯利是图的公司压迫了。尽管在确保所有感性生命体的自由权利方面，我们还有很长的路要走，但此次裁定代表了重要的第一步。
origin.5095.desc.en: A great day at the Galactic Community, where members voted to outlaw most forms of slavery. No longer will the people of the galaxy need to fear oppression at the hands of petty thugs and profit-hungry corporations. Although there is a long way to go before the right of all sentient beings to freedom is ensured, this represents an important first step.

origin.5095.name.zh: 绝大多数的奴隶制度被取缔

origin.51.a.zh: 谢谢……我们将会好好使用他们。
origin.51.a.en: Thank you... we shall put them to good use.

origin.51.desc.zh:
我亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们该拿你怎么办哟？我们曾对你抱有如此高的期望，然而你却在这里，为了一场毫无意义的战争消磨你的潜力，而且你似乎正在输掉这场战争。[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有许多人认为我们应当与你们断交，但是那将算是承认了我们的错误，毕竟我们曾在你们这个特殊物种身上投入不少发展上的资金。

一支小的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]远征舰队已经置于你的指挥下。用它来结束战争——最好结局不是你灭绝。不要花太久。我们希望看到这只舰队的归来。并且，别让他们全灭！
origin.51.desc.en:
Our dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... what are we to do with you? We had such high hopes, and yet here you are, squandering your potential in a pointless war that you seem to be losing. There are many on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who think we should cut all ties with you, but that would be an admission of error. We have invested quite a bit in the development of your peculiar species, after all.

A small [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] expeditionary fleet has been placed under your command. Use it to bring some sort of conclusion to the present hostilities - preferably one that doesn't include your extinction. Do not take too long. We will want this fleet back, eventually. And do not get them all killed!

origin.5100.desc.zh: 今天对于星海共同体来说是一个令人心碎的日子，取缔绝大多数形式的奴隶制的动议未能获得足够的票数。$slavery_allowed_outro$
origin.5100.desc.en: A heartbreaking day at the Galactic Community, where a motion to outlaw most forms of slavery failed to gain enough votes. $slavery_allowed_outro$

origin.5104.desc.zh: $resolution_proposed_intro$绝大多数形式的奴隶制，包括可憎的契约式奴役。如果我们自己的斗争经验能教会我们什么，那就是如果不发声诉求，权力是不会让步的。一个地方一旦存在奴隶制，就不可能有正义。我们必须与星系中其他开明的成员国站在一起。只有这样做，我们才能保证我们人民的安全和尊严。
origin.5104.desc.en: $resolution_proposed_intro$ most forms of slavery, including the abomination of indentured servitude. If our own experience has taught us anything, it is that power concedes nothing without a demand. Where slavery exists, there can be no justice. We must stand together with the other enlightened members of the galaxy. Only by doing so can we guarantee the safety and dignity of our people.

origin.5105.desc.zh: 今天对于星海共同体来说是值得载入史册的重要日子，各成员国投票决定禁止一切形式的奴隶制——甚至包括契约奴役这样的卑劣做法。像$NAME_MSI_country$这样的公司将不再能够以利润的名义剥削无辜者。终于，星系历史上最黑暗的篇章之一可以结束了。
origin.5105.desc.en: A monumental day at the Galactic Community, where members voted to ban all forms of slavery - including the vile practice of indentured servitude. No longer will corporations like $NAME_MSI_country$ be able to exploit the innocent in the name of profit. At last, one of the darkest chapters in galactic history can finally come to a close.

origin.5110.desc.zh: 星海共同体传来令人心碎的消息，一场取缔一切形式的奴隶制的运动失败了。$slavery_allowed_outro$
origin.5110.desc.en: Heartbreak at the Galactic Community, where a motion to outlaw all forms of slavery has failed. $slavery_allowed_outro$

origin.5114.desc.zh: $resolution_proposed_intro$对有机体的奴役，而且是全方位的。对于我们来说，这件事没有妥协的余地。奴隶制是星系篇章上的污点。我们必须尽一切所能，彻底地将其终结。
origin.5114.desc.en: $resolution_proposed_intro$ the enslavement of all organic populations. For us, there can be no compromise. Slavery is a stain upon the galaxy. We must do what we can to end it permanently.

origin.5115.desc.zh: 今天是泛星系贸易市场的重要一日，我们决定将有机体奴役裁定为非法。人民再也不需要担心被下作的暴徒和唯利是图的公司压迫了。今晚我们都可以睡个好觉了。
origin.5115.desc.en: A monumental day at the Galactic Market, which made the decision today to outlaw the enslavement of organic populations. No longer will the people of the galaxy need to fear oppression at the hands of petty thugs and profit-hungry corporations. We can all rest easier tonight.

origin.5120.desc.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的行动受到了挫折，各成员国决定继续放任邪恶的奴隶制度下的各类行径。$slavery_allowed_outro$
origin.5120.desc.en: Frustration at the Galactic Market, as members agreed to continue the vile practice of slavery. $slavery_allowed_outro$

origin.5124.desc.zh: $resolution_proposed_intro$对智慧生命体的奴役，而且是全方位的。无论是哪个物种，一旦在有思想的个体身上套上锁链，最终一定会发现锁链的另一端套在了自己身上。我们必须支持这项动议。
origin.5124.desc.en: $resolution_proposed_intro$ the slavery of all forms of sentient life. No species can put a chain on a thinking individual without at last finding the other end fastened to themselves. We must support this motion.

origin.5125.desc.zh: 今天对于泛星系贸易市场来说是历史性的一天，各成员国投票通过废除奴隶制议案。自由成为了全体感性生命的天然权利。今日，星海历史中不光彩的一章体面地完结了。
origin.5125.desc.en: A historic day at the Galactic Market, where members voted to outlaw slavery in all its forms. Freedom is the natural right of all sentient beings. Today, a vile chapter in galactic history comes to a merciful close.

origin.5125.name.zh: 属于全体智慧生命的胜利
origin.5125.name.en: A Victory for All Sentient Beings

origin.5130.desc.zh: 今天是泛星系贸易市场上令人沮丧的一天，各国作出决策，决定继续出售感性的非有机体生命。再一次，权力和金钱驱使的恶行扼杀了自由的事业。只要还有一个有情感的生命体佩戴着镣铐——无论这生命是天然孕育还是人工制造——就没有人可以高枕无忧。
origin.5130.desc.en: A frustrating day at the Galactic Market, where the decision was made to continue the sale of sentient non-organics. Once again, the malign influence of power and money have stifled the cause of freedom. No one - whether organic or artificial - can rest easy while even a single sentient being is forced into bondage.

origin.5131.desc.zh: 企业的势力已经成功地废除了星海共同体最近制定的反对奴隶制的议案。虽然这一切令人失望，但此等不幸的发展并不出乎意料；历史是螺旋上升的，而且螺线有时候会很长，但最终，自由的事业终将取得胜利。
origin.5131.desc.en: Corporate forces have succeeded in repealing the Galactic Community's recent resolution against slavery. While this is disappointing, unfortunately it is not unexpected; the arc of history runs long, but in the end, the cause of freedom will prevail.

origin.5135.attackers.desc.zh:
我们在旧主的阴影下苟且偷生的日子太久了，我们享受着这应得的自由之时，有太多的同胞还在作为契约奴隶遭受着他们的羞辱。一些人可能会将这视作侵略战争并加以谴责。不管怎样，反抗暴政的时机已到。这些星系中的流氓和利润贩子将不再被准许继续他们那卑鄙的勾当。

今天，我们迈向战争。
origin.5135.attackers.desc.en:
For too long we have lived in fear of our former masters, but while we enjoy the benefit of a freedom justly earned, far too many continue to suffer under the indignities of indentured servitude. Some may decry this as a war of aggression. Nevertheless, the time has come for us to strike a blow against tyranny. No longer will the petty thugs and profit-mongers of the galaxy be allowed to ply their vile trade.

Today, we march to war.

origin.5135.defenders.desc.zh:
$NAME_MSI_country$的糖衣炮弹没有成功，于是现在他们要来硬的了。他们的董事会认为我们软弱可欺。但解开了枷锁的我们早已如钢铁般铸成一体了。

$MSI_war_outro$
origin.5135.defenders.desc.en:
Having failed to conquer us with money and lies, $NAME_MSI_country$ will now try with force. Their Board of Directors believe us weak. But in casting off our shackles, we have forged an identity that can never be broken.

$MSI_war_outro$

origin.5140.desc.zh: 意想不到的事情发生了。[From.GetName]赢了，而我们再一次回到了他们的束缚之下。尽管我们输掉了这场战争，但争取自由与平等的斗争还远未结束。
origin.5140.desc.en: The unthinkable has happened. [From.GetName] is victorious, and once more we find ourselves bent beneath their yoke. But while we may have lost this war, the battle for equality and justice is far from over.

origin.5142.desc.zh: 我们同[MSI_country.GetName]达成了一个维持现状协议。但是它们要知道我们并没有忘记曾经在它们手上受到过怎样的对待。我们也不打算忘记。
origin.5142.desc.en: We have reached a status quo agreement with [MSI_country.GetName]. But let it be known that we have not forgotten our treatment at their hands. Nor have we forgiven.

origin.5145.desc.zh:
我们胜利了。战胜[From.GetName]不仅让我们赢回了尊严，更证明了我们才是自己命运的主人。

解开枷锁让我们找到共同目标，而今天我们才算是真正重获自由。
origin.5145.desc.en:
Victory is ours. In defeating [From.GetName], we have not only reclaimed our dignity, but proven ourselves the masters of our own fate.

In casting off our chains, we found common purpose. Today we are truly free.

origin.5146.attackers.desc.zh: $NAME_MSI_country$把我们从自己的星球家园中掳走，囚禁我们，用不平等的契约奴役我们。甚至现在，他们还妄想着在商业的幌子下继续进行那卑鄙的贸易。现在是时候彻底将它们终结了。
origin.5146.attackers.desc.en: $NAME_MSI_country$ stole us from our worlds, imprisoned and indentured us. Even now, they continue their vile trade under a guise of commerce. The time has come to end them once and for all.

origin.5146.defenders.desc.zh:
上回$NAME_MSI_country$没能征服我们，他们再次挑起了战争。他们的董事会不是傻了就是疯了。自由的人民是不可战胜的。

$MSI_war_outro$
origin.5146.defenders.desc.en:
Having already failed to subdue us, $NAME_MSI_country$ has once again declared war. Their Board of Directors is either incompetent, mad, or both. A free people can never be broken.

$MSI_war_outro$

origin.5147.desc.zh:
尽管我们饱尝着通过正当手段赢得的自由之甜果，星系中还有太多人继续在奴隶制和契约奴役的屈辱下受苦。星系中的流氓和利润贩子别想继续从事他们卑鄙的交易。

现在是时候我们站出来反抗此等暴政了。
origin.5147.desc.en:
While we enjoy the benefit of a freedom justly earned, far too many in the galaxy continue to suffer under the indignities of slavery and indentured servitude. No longer will the petty thugs and profit-mongers of the galaxy be allowed to ply their vile trade.

The time has come for us to take a stand against such tyranny.

origin.5150.desc.zh:
今天，我们加入了一个有$NAME_MSI_country$存在的联邦。

在我们重获自由之初绝不可能想到未来会有这样的展开。如今我们可以心平气和地与过去的压迫者们展开外交，这说明了我们的国家已经步入成熟。

显然，会有很多人不满意这一决定。但这次情况特殊，目的确实证明了手段的正确。
origin.5150.desc.en:
Today, we enter into a federation with $NAME_MSI_country$.

When we first claimed our freedom, such a development would have been unthinkable. That we are now able to engage in peaceful diplomacy with our erstwhile captors speaks to the growing maturity of our nation.

There are those among us who will not be happy with this decision. But in this case, the ends truly justify the means.

origin.5151.desc.zh: 今天，我们作出了一个艰难的决定，与一个已知的奴隶主国家结成联盟。虽然我们认为每个有情感的生命体的自由是不可剥夺的权利，但国家的需要迫使我们做出妥协。我们的人民可能不高兴，但我们这样做是为了更加长远的利益。
origin.5151.desc.en: Today, we have made the difficult decision to enter into a federation with a known slaver. While we consider the freedom of every sentient being an inalienable right, the necessities of state have forced us to compromise. Our people may not be happy, but we have done this for the greater good.

origin.52.desc.zh: [scion_master.GetName]借给我们的远征舰队已被摧毁。这或许会让他们不高兴……
origin.52.desc.en: The Expeditionary Fleet lent to us by the [scion_master.GetName] has been utterly destroyed. This will likely upset them...

origin.5200.a.zh: 我们不会为言论自由设下限制。
origin.5200.a.en: We will not place limits on freedom of speech.

origin.5200.b.zh: 对媒体进行约谈，让他们不要阴阳怪气。
origin.5200.b.en: Instruct the media to tone down their rhetoric.

origin.5200.desc.zh: 各类大众媒体上满是关于所谓跨物种融合的失败报道。特别值得关注的是，由于某些变种从未进化到能在特定星球上定居，为了支援这一部分特别的人群所划拨的额外款项。随着紧张局势的持续升温，安全部队报告道，物种间冲突急剧上升，已到了警报级别。
origin.5200.desc.en: Popular media is awash with reports about the supposed failure of inter-species integration. Of particular concern is the cost of supporting certain populations on worlds their xenotype never evolved to inhabit. As tensions continue to rise, security forces have reported an alarming increase in inter-species conflict.

origin.5205.a.tooltip.zh: 确保我们社会中的每一个个体都有公平和平等的利益，这件事情既不简单，也不省事。但它是必要的。
origin.5205.a.tooltip.en: Ensuring a fair and equal stake for every individual in our society will not be simple, or cheap. But it is necessary.

origin.5205.b.tooltip.zh: 在跨文化交往中进行投资，未来肯定能获得好处。
origin.5205.b.tooltip.en: Investing in cross-cultural engagement is sure to pay dividends in the future.

origin.5205.c.tooltip.zh: 一切皆为政治。一个健康的社会会主动投资、培养高参与、高活跃的公民群体。
origin.5205.c.tooltip.en: Everything is political. A healthy society is one that invests in an engaged and active citizenry.

origin.5205.d.zh: 这些议题是相互联系的。

origin.5205.d.tooltip.zh: 纠正我们社会中的系统性问题将需要大量的时间和资源投入。
origin.5205.d.tooltip.en: Righting the systemic problems in our society will require a massive investment in time and resources.

origin.5205.desc.zh:
特别委员会发布了一份关于我们社会中政治割裂的详尽研究。他们发现了在[Root.GetName]中，有三种主要的驱动力在促使政治发生多极化。

1、为满足各个不同种族的最低生活标准需要投入不均等的花费。

2、在各个截然不同的文化群体中存在互不相容的信仰体系和行为准则。

3、我们的政治体制与特定的物种价值观存在冲突甚至是完全相反。
origin.5205.desc.en:
The special committee has published the findings of an exhaustive study of the political divisions within our society. They have identified three main issues driving political polarization within [Root.GetName]:

1. The unequal costs associated with providing a minimum standard of living to diverse xenotypes.

2. The discordant belief systems and behaviors between several distinct culture groups.

3. The nature of our political authority as being in conflict with (or even antithetical to) the values of certain species.

origin.5205.e.en: It is cheaper to reign in the media.

origin.5205.e.tooltip.zh: 政府对媒体进行监管，能够减少政治上的分裂和对立。
origin.5205.e.tooltip.en: Government oversight of the media is necessary to reduce political polarization.

origin.5210.a.zh: 我们需要从根源上解决这个问题。
origin.5210.a.en: We need to address the root causes of this issue.

origin.5210.b.en: Restrict access to the information net.

origin.5210.desc.zh: 政府的监管可能有助于淡化政治上的不和，但对消除社会中的分歧却起不到什么作用。社群领袖不断地在各物种和文化群体之间挑拨离间。根据信息网络上公布的材料，这个问题只会变得愈发糟糕。
origin.5210.desc.en: Governmental oversight may have helped to tone down the political discourse, but it has done little to combat the divisions in society. Community leaders continue to sow discord between various species and culture groups. Based on the kind of material being published on the information net, the problem is certain to get worse before it gets better.

origin.5215.a.zh: 不惜一切代价恢复秩序。

origin.5215.desc.zh: 几个月以来，我们限制了公众对信息网络的访问。虽然这能够阻止政治领域的一些偏激分子找到发声的平台，但物种间冲突的根本原因却没有得到遏制。暴力，包括对财产的大规模破坏，在我们的各个恒星系都呈上升趋势。
origin.5215.desc.en: For several months now, we have restricted public access to the information net. While this prevented some of the more outlandish voices in the political spectrum from finding a platform, the root causes of inter-species conflict have gone unchecked. Violence, including the mass destruction of property, is on the rise throughout our systems.

origin.5220.a.zh: 只有团结一致，才能繁荣昌盛。

origin.5220.desc.zh:
我们的安保部队已经成功地恢复了我们所有恒星系的社会秩序。各类政治激进分子要么被围捕，要么被监禁，他们的领袖现在面临叛国罪的指控。

回顾我们历史上这段令人遗憾的时期，有一点是非常清楚的：像我们这样的社会只能由强硬的手腕来管理。现在是时候由我们提供强硬的手腕了。
origin.5220.desc.en:
Our security forces have succeeded in restoring order throughout our systems. Political radicals of all stripes have been rounded up and imprisoned, and their leaders now face charges of treason against the state.

As we look back on this regrettable period in our history, one thing is abundantly clear: a society like ours can only be governed by a firm hand. It is high time we provided one.

origin.5225.desc.zh:
我们的社会自建立之初，就充斥着冲突。也许事情在变好之前不可避免地会变得更糟；在整个信息网络上，仇恨团体激增。要求将一个或另一个物种从我们的星域中驱逐出去的呼声已经是随处可见了。然而，也有迹象表明，人们对共同斗争的意识也有所提高。

一些团体，除了对变革的渴望之外几乎没有什么共同点，但依然愈发频繁地走到了一起。通过直面我们的问题，在其他文明可能归于黑暗的事物，我们成功将其照亮。也许有一天，我们会把这段冲突的岁月看作是历史大势的转折点。
origin.5225.desc.en:
From its founding, our society has been shaped by conflict. Perhaps it was inevitable that things would get worse before they got better; across the information net, hate groups proliferate. Calls for the expulsion of one or another species from our systems are all too common. Yet there are also signs of increased awareness of a shared struggle.

Groups with little more in common than a desire for change have been coming together with increasing regularity. By confronting our issues head-on, we have shone a light on what otherwise might have grown in darkness. Perhaps one day we will look back on this time of conflict as the turning of the tide.

origin.5230.desc.zh:
这届政府为提高我们公民的生活质量做出了不懈努力。我们投资于教育、犯罪预防和各种文化项目。然而，我们却不断地注意到自己成为了无情抨击的对象。更过分的是，一个由年轻人组成的跨物种运动已经组织起来，呼吁进行更激进的改革，变革的步子要迈得更大。

这里只有一线希望：通过激励年轻人踊跃行动，我们可能在不知不觉中创造了弥合我们社会分裂的必要条件。
origin.5230.desc.en:
This government has worked tirelessly to improve the quality of life for our citizenry. We have invested in education, crime prevention, and cultural programs of all kinds. Nevertheless, we continue to find ourselves the target of relentless criticism. What's more, a cross-species movement of young people has organized, calling for more radical reforms and a faster pace of change.

There is only one silver lining to be found here: in galvanizing the youth to act, we may have unwittingly created the conditions necessary to heal the divisions in our society.

origin.5235.desc.zh:
尽管我们一直在努力推动营造清朗良好的政治氛围，然而到目前为止，普通民众几乎没有表现出参与政治的意愿。民意调查一直表明，构成我们社会的各物种和文化之间仍然存在重大分歧。

明显相关的是，我们的经济学家已经注意到消费者支出的明显增加。虽然这在短期内可能对企业有利，但它也导致了通货膨胀的飙升。或许是我们的人民已经厌倦了争斗和不和谐。

讽刺的是，作为政治上的结果，这些人因为在烧钱上志同道合而团结了起来。
origin.5235.desc.en:
Despite ongoing efforts to promote a healthy political climate, thus far, the general population has shown little engagement. Public opinion polls have consistently demonstrated that significant divisions remain between the various species and cultures that comprise our society.

In an apparent correlation, our economists have noticed a marked increase in consumer spending. While this may be good for business in the short-term, it has also led to a spike in inflation. It may be that our people have simply grown weary of the strife and discord.

Ironically, in tuning out politically, they have been united in a shared desire to consume.

origin.5240.desc.zh: 作为一个民族，我们面临着几乎无法克服的困难。我们曾是一群各种各样的奴隶，因为争取自由的斗争被捆在了一起，我们的道路从来都不是一帆风顺的。但是，通过选择将我们的资源集中用于正义事业，我们成功地塑造了作为一个国家的身份。$cost_of_freedom_outro$
origin.5240.desc.en: As a people, we faced nearly insurmountable odds. A diverse group of former slaves, thrown together in a struggle for freedom, our path has never been easy. But in choosing to concentrate our resources towards the cause of justice, we have succeeded in forging an identity as a nation. $cost_of_freedom_outro$

origin.5245.desc.zh: 从一开始，我们就面临着几乎无法克服的困难。一群奴隶和契约仆人，联合起来为了摆脱自己的桎梏……还有什么样的基础能比这更强大更牢固呢？这并不容易，但通过选择促进跨文化的对话，我们已经创造了一个强健和繁荣的社会。$cost_of_freedom_outro$
origin.5245.desc.en: From the beginning, we faced nearly insurmountable odds. A group of slaves and indentured servants, banding together to cast off their shackles... What stronger foundation could there be? It has not been easy, but in choosing to foster cross-cultural dialogue, we have created a robust and thriving society. $cost_of_freedom_outro$

origin.5250.desc.zh: 我们中间很少有人想到，当我们揭竿而起诉求自由时，争取平等的斗争才刚刚开始。作为一个由来自多个星球的物种组成的民族，对我们来说，建立共识或找到共同点从来都不容易，但通过鼓励参与政治生活，我们成功地创造了一个健全和繁荣的社会。$cost_of_freedom_outro$
origin.5250.desc.en: Little did it occur to us that the struggle for equality had only just begun when we rose up to claim our freedom. As a people of many worlds, it has never been easy for us to build consensus or to find common ground, but by investing in political engagement, we have succeeded in creating a robust and flourishing society. $cost_of_freedom_outro$

origin.5255.a.zh: 多元之中孕育着我们的力量。

origin.5255.desc.zh:
因为渴望自由而联合到一起，我们奋起反抗曾经的主人。但是，社会不仅仅由暴力组成。从政治分裂到经济上的不安全，我们面临着巨大的挑战，但现在，当我们开始看到为建立共识所付出的不懈努力终于开花结果时，我们有理由为自己的瞩目成就感到骄傲。

同一个国家，多样的民族；同一个民族，多元的文化。团结一致，我们无所不克。
origin.5255.desc.en:
United by a desire for freedom, we rose up against our former masters. But society is not made by violence alone. From political division to economic insecurity, we have faced massive challenges, but now, as we begin to see the results of a concerted effort to build consensus, we can rightly take pride in our accomplishments.

We are a nation of many people, and a people of many cultures. Together, there is no challenge we cannot overcome.

origin.5270.desc.zh: 我们在穿越星辰的旅程中发现了各种奇迹。我们目睹了超越想象的景色，完成了乍一想根本不可能完成的壮举。作为一个民族，我们已经走了很远。但是，没有什么旅程，也没有什么奖励，比找到回家的路更重要。
origin.5270.desc.en: Our journey across the stars has revealed wonders. We have witnessed sights beyond imagination, accomplished feats that at first seemed impossible. As a people, we have traveled far. But no journey, and no reward, is greater than finding the way home.

origin.5276.desc.zh:
我们中的许多人曾以为这一天永远不会到来。今天，我们与$NAME_MSI_country$的董事会签订了正式的外交协议。

毫无疑问肯定有些人会反对这一决定。过去的伤痛绝不能被抹消，但也不能让我们在未来面前故步自封。

今天我们踏出了和解的第一步。
origin.5276.desc.en:
Many among us thought this moment would never come. Today, we have formally entered in a diplomatic agreement with the Board of $NAME_MSI_country$.

No doubt there are some who will oppose this decision. The past can never be erased. But neither should it define the course of the future.

Today we take the first steps towards reconciliation.

origin.5276.federation.desc.zh:
我们决定与$NAME_MSI_country$构成联邦时，质疑声四起。许多人认为与曾经压迫我们的人和解绝不会带来任何好处。在过去这种担忧不无道理。

如今，我们与$NAME_MSI_country_initials$的理事会签订了第一项外交协议，我们应当消除一律。我们要放下成见，平等地一起向前看。
origin.5276.federation.desc.en:
When we agreed to form a Federation with $NAME_MSI_country$, there was widespread skepticism. Many among us said no good could ever come from reconciling with our former masters. At the time, such concerns might have been warranted.

Today, as we sign our first diplomatic agreement with the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ Board of Directors, all doubts should be dispelled. Together, we look to a shared future. Not as adversaries, but as equals.

origin.53.desc.zh:
我们的舰队在哪里，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们借给了你们舰队去结束那场愚蠢的战争。现在它在哪？不要装傻！

把我们的舰队还回来！
origin.53.desc.en:
Where is our fleet, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The fleet we lent you to end your silly war. Where is it? No, do not feign ignorance!

GIVE US BACK OUR FLEET!

origin.54.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们的线人告知我们你所参加的战争已经结束了。既然你还站在这，所以你们一定没有被彻底毁灭。

现在我们要带回我们的舰队。请未来尽量避免无法取得胜利的军事纠纷。
origin.54.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... our informants tell us the war you were in has ended. Since you are still here, it must not have been an utter disaster.

We will be taking our fleet back now. Do your best to keep out of unwinnable military entanglements in the future, please.

origin.5500.desc.zh: 在我们发动兵变之后，运奴船的工程舱被迅速重新布置成为一个基础的综合实验室。在适应了[Root.Capital.GetName]上的生活后，我们的工程师对其进行了改进和升级，以更好地满足他们的需求。
origin.5500.desc.en: After the mutiny, the engineering bay of the slaver vessel was rapidly repurposed to serve as a rudimentary lab complex. Having adapted to life on [Root.Capital.GetName] our engineers have made improvements and upgrades to better suit their needs.

origin.5500.tt.en: The £building£ $building_low_tech_research_lab$ on [Root.Capital.GetName] will be upgraded to £building£ $building_research_lab_1$.

origin.5505.desc.zh: 在进行最初的几次行动的时候，我们新生的政府就匆忙地将运奴船的几层甲板进行了重新改造，成为一个基本的行政管理中心。现在我们已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上站稳了脚跟，而这些设施也已经得到了升级。
origin.5505.desc.en: In one of their first acts, our fledgling government hastily repurposed several decks of the slaver vessel to serve as a rudimentary administrative hub. Now that we have firmly established ourselves on [Root.Capital.GetName], these facilities have been upgraded.

origin.5505.regular.tt.en: The £building£ $building_low_tech_admin_hub$ on [Root.Capital.GetName] will be upgraded to £building£ $building_bureaucratic_1$.

origin.5505.spiritualist.tt.en: The £building£ $building_low_tech_admin_hub$ on [Root.Capital.GetName] will be upgraded to a £building£ $building_temple$.

origin.5515.desc.zh:
有一座环绕[From.GetName]的观测站，我们将更好地照看我们曾经的母星。这座观测站不仅会促进物质和文化交流，还能帮助我们改善这颗星球上人民的生活。

现在我们必须做出决定：在知道结果的前提下，我们是否愿意帮助我们的同胞走向群星？

毫无疑问，他们配得上在宇宙的舞台上加入我们，但他们真的准备好迈出这一步了吗？正如我们曾经经历过的，急速的社会变革的后果很可能是极端的。
origin.5515.desc.en:
With an observation post built around [From.GetName], we will be able to keep a much better watch on our former home world. Not only will this station facilitate material and cultural exchange, but it could also help us to improve the life of the people on the planet.

A decision must be made: are we willing to help our kin reach the stars, knowing what the results could be?

No doubt they deserve to join us on the galactic stage, but are they truly ready to make the leap? As we have seen firsthand, the consequences of rapid social change can be extreme.

origin.5520.desc.zh:
我们的观测站现在正处于环绕[From.GetName]的轨道上。从这个制高点俯瞰下去，我们可以为同胞们的点点成功感到喜悦，如果有必要的话，还能帮助他们应对挑战。

随着我们的发展，一个新的问题摆在了我们面前：我们是该让他们宁静地繁衍生息，还是让他们走向宇宙？两个选择都会有各自的风险，以及一定的回报。
origin.5520.desc.en:
Our observation post is now in orbit around [From.GetName]. From this vantage point, we can celebrate the successes of our kin, and if necessary, help them to mitigate their challenges.

As we move forward, a new question presents itself: should we leave them in peace, or help them reach the stars? Both choices carry their own risks, and their own rewards.

origin.5525.desc.zh:
我们提升[From.Capital.GetName]使其登上星海舞台的工作取得了巨大的成功。在一个新近统一的政府的领导下，我们的亲族将被称为“[From.GetName]”。

在接下来的几个月和几年里，他们肯定要经历很多挑战。为了帮助它们在一个飘渺不定的星系中正确地前行，我们同意接纳他们作为附庸，至少目前是如此。与之相应地，我们已经交出了对该恒星系的完全控制权，并拆除了我们的观测站。
origin.5525.desc.en:
Our work to uplift [From.Capital.GetName] to the galactic stage has been a resounding success. Under a newly unified government, our kin will be known as the "[From.GetName]."

In the months and years ahead, they are sure to experience many challenges. In order to help them navigate an uncertain galaxy, we have agreed to accept them as vassals, at least for the time being. Accordingly, we have ceded full control of the system and dismantled our Observation Post.

origin.5605.a.zh: 我们心怀感激地接受你们的馈赠。
origin.5605.a.en: We receive your gift with gratitude.

origin.5605.corporate.desc.zh:
学生们，我们在梦中曾指引你们。通过这些梦境我们塑造了你们的世界。如今你们已茁壮成长，可以将我们的信条传播于星际，你们真正的试炼正刚刚开始。你们的勤勉将光耀虚境，你们的辛劳成果亦是对你们教导的兑现。为了点燃事业之火，我们传授给你们虚境信标的知识，这是一个强大的设备。在你们的一座恒星基地上建造以后，这座信标会打开一个虚境隧道。请谨慎选择地点，因为虚境隧道只会生成一次。

如果有所索求，有所不测就呼唤我们吧。在梦境中我们会一直看着你们。在漫游的旅途中，我们等待着你们的到来。
origin.5605.corporate.desc.en:
Students, in dreams we have guided you. Through visions, we have shaped your world. Now that you stand ready to export our doctrine to the stars, your true apprenticeship is at hand. Through your work shall the Shroud be honored. The profits of your labor shall fulfill the promise of our teachings. To stoke the fires of industry, we grant you knowledge of the Shroud Beacon, a device of great power. Once built on one of your starbases, the Beacon will spawn a Shroud Tunnel. Choose its location carefully, as you will not be able to spawn another.

In times of need and uncertainty, call on us. In dreams, we will be watching. In waking life, we await your arrival.

origin.5605.generic.desc.zh:
我们的学生啊，我们已经教导了你们一代又一代，将虚境和它的奥秘的知识播撒入你们的梦境之中。现在你们已经能够触及星辰，你们真正的学徒生涯才刚刚开始。前路不会一马平川。为了照亮你们前行的道路，我们传授给你们虚境信标的知识，这是一个强大的设备。在你们的一座恒星基地上建造以后，这座信标会打开一个虚境隧道。请谨慎选择地点，因为虚境隧道只会生成一次。

如果有所索求，有所不测就呼唤我们吧。在梦境中我们会一直看着你们。在漫游的旅途中，我们等待着你们的到来。
origin.5605.generic.desc.en:
Our students, for generations we have taught you, seeding our knowledge of the Shroud and its mysteries within your dreams. Now that you have reached the stars, your true apprenticeship is at hand. The path forward will not be an easy one. To light the way, we grant you knowledge of the Shroud Beacon, a device of great power. Once built on one of your starbases, the Beacon will spawn a Shroud Tunnel. Choose its location carefully, as you will not be able to spawn another.

In times of need and uncertainty, call on us. In dreams, we will be watching. In waking life, we await your arrival.

origin.5615.a.desc.zh: 学徒们，我们终于能和你们好好打招呼了。迹象和预兆都预示了这一刻，虚境本身也会见证你们的到来。我们已经期待了很久，只为与你们在感知之境相会。在这里你们是欢迎之至的存在。
origin.5615.a.desc.en: Apprentices, at last we can greet you properly. Signs and portents foretold this moment, and the Shroud itself has witnessed your passage. Long have we waited to meet with you in the realm of the senses. You are most welcome here.

origin.5620.b.desc.zh: 学徒们，我们终于能和你们好好打招呼了。通过早就铺设好的隧道，你们的到来已经被虚境所感知。你们的回声仍在颤抖、涟漪般回荡过潜意识的水面。虚境神秘中的居者一定会祝福我们的会面。在这里你们是最受欢迎的存在。
origin.5620.b.desc.en: Apprentices, at last we can greet you properly. Through the Tunnel long prepared, your passage has been felt by the Shroud itself. The echoes yet shiver, rippling through the waters of the unconscious mind. Those who dwell within the mysteries of the Shroud have surely blessed our meeting. You are most welcome here.

origin.5625.a.desc.zh: 在黑暗中漫无止境地摸索之后，虚境的面纱终于被揭开。我们的导师赐予了我们无上的珍宝。这个信标以及其诞生的隧道，注定会照亮我们跨越星际的航道。从这个星系开始的旅途将会更快……也远远地更为神秘。
origin.5625.a.desc.en: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Our Teachers have bestowed a great gift upon us. This Beacon, and the Tunnel it spawns, will surely light our way across the stars. Journeys from this system will now be faster... and infinitely more mysterious.

origin.5625.a.option.zh: 愿虚境欢迎我们的到来。
origin.5625.a.option.en: May the Shroud welcome our passage.

origin.5625.b.desc.zh:
在黑暗中漫无止境地摸索之后，虚境的面纱终于被揭开。我们的导师赐予了我们无上的珍宝。这个信标以及其召唤出的隧道，注定会照亮我们跨越星际的航道。

还剩下一步：我们导师所居住的那一侧边界至今对我们封闭。地图中实际上的航道对虚境来说可能无关紧要，但是在这边的星球还是非常麻烦。至少现在，我们通过隧道的路径还是被封锁着。
origin.5625.b.desc.en:
After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Our Teachers have bestowed a great gift upon us. This Beacon, and the Tunnel it spawns, will surely light our way across the stars.

Only one step remains: the border beyond which our Teachers reside is closed to us. Lines on a map may be immaterial to the Shroud, but in this world they remain troublesome. For now, our passage through the Tunnel remains blocked.

origin.57.A.en: The alliance we have is enough.

origin.57.B.zh: 我们需要在敌人面前保护自己。
origin.57.B.en: We must defend ourselves against those who oppose us.

origin.57.C.zh: 只有共同研究才能共同进步。
origin.57.C.en: Only through research can we progress.

origin.57.D.zh: 我们当选择凝聚力和传统的道路。
origin.57.D.en: Unity and traditionalism shall be our path.

origin.57.E.en: Trade is important above all else.

origin.57.desc.zh: 尽管我们已经与联盟的其他成员接触了一段时日了，但唯有现在：超光速引擎的实现，让我们这几个帝国可以真真切切地互相接触。现在的问题是，我们的联邦应当专注于什么方面：一些人提倡目前的通用模式，而另一些人则倾向于专注于在特定领域进行更紧密的合作。
origin.57.desc.en: Though we have for some time been in contact with the other members of our alliance, it is only now - with the invention of FTL drives - that our empires are able to interact with each other on a meaningful level. The question has arisen as to what our federation should focus on: some advocate the current, generalist path, whereas others would favor focusing on closer integration in a particular field.

origin.5703.a.zh: 是你们让我们别无选择的不是么？
origin.5703.a.en: You didn't give us much of a choice, did you?

origin.5703.b.zh: 还有什么别的你们想告诉我们的吗？
origin.5703.b.en: Was there something you wanted to talk to us about?

origin.5703.c.zh: 我们以成为你们的一员而骄傲！
origin.5703.c.en: We are proud to be a part of your alliance!

origin.5703.desc.zh:
欢迎你们，新外星人朋友们！

由于你们选择成为我们的……盟友，我们认为现在正是与你们联络的时候。你们选择了理性而不是逼迫我们使用暴力，这令我们非常愉快。
origin.5703.desc.en:
Welcome, dear newfound allies!

We felt it was only right to contact you now that you have chosen to partake in our... alliance. It pleases us you chose to see reason, rather than forcing our hand towards violence.

origin.5705.a.zh: 军事专精听起来棒极了。

origin.5705.b.zh: 能不能再详细介绍一下戍邦？
origin.5705.b.en: Could you tell us more about Bulwarks?

origin.5705.c.zh: 我们的人民更热爱学识。
origin.5705.c.en: Our people are more scholarly in nature.

origin.5705.d.zh: 能不能再详细介绍一下学邦？
origin.5705.d.en: Could you tell us more about Scholaria?

origin.5705.desc.zh:
经过深思熟虑，我们决定投资一大笔资源来援助你们的国家进行特化。在未来，这将让你们的帝国在我们所有的伙伴和盟友中扮演更加重要的角色。

我们还不太确定你们的人民更喜欢怎么样的角色，军事化？专精学术？或你们更感兴趣矿物和物质财富？
origin.5705.desc.en:
After careful consideration, we have decided to invest a significant amount of resources into helping you specialize your empire. It will enable your empire to play an important role in the future of all our friends and allies.

We were not entirely sure what your people would be more comfortable with, however: a militarized specialization? A scholarly one? Or are you more interested in materials and minerals?

origin.5705.desc.grateful.zh:
我们同样骄傲于你们的到来！

$origin.5705.desc$
origin.5705.desc.grateful.en:
And we are proud to welcome you!

$origin.5705.desc$

origin.5705.desc.reconsider.en: So... Have you given it a second thought?

origin.5705.e.zh: 我们更喜欢物质财富和矿物专精的特化。
origin.5705.e.en: We would like a material and mineral focused specialization.

origin.5705.f.zh: 能不能再详细介绍一下勘探邦？
origin.5705.f.en: Could you tell us more about Prospectoria?

origin.5706.a.zh: 听起来是我们可以接受的。
origin.5706.a.en: That sounds like something we could live with.

origin.5706.desc.zh:
一种趋于暴力的倾向，是这样吗？

我们通常所说的戍邦是一种致力于军事事务的国家。这意味着我们会按月度支援你们一些基础的矿物和食物，这样你们国家可以将更多的精力放在战争上。

作为回报，我们希望你们可以为我们抵御外辱，在我们联盟的边境上扮演重要角色。这么说你们觉得可以接受吗？
origin.5706.desc.en:
A tendency towards violence, is that it?

A Bulwark, as we usually refer to them, are empires specialized in military affairs. It means we would support you with some basic minerals and food on a monthly basis so you could set aside a larger part of your empire to focus on war.

In turn, we expect you to help us defend against external threats, and play an important role at the borders of our allied space. Does that sound agreeable to you?

origin.5707.a.zh: 我们的人民乐于接受这项协定。
origin.5707.a.en: Our people would be happy with that deal.

origin.5707.desc.zh:
所以这引起了你们的兴趣不是吗？

我们通常所说的学邦是一种专精于研究科技的国家。我们承诺保护你们的国家，而你们便可以集中资源让国家以及我们的盟友更加先进。

作为回报我们希望你们可以与我们其他国家分享所有令人惊奇的科学发现。这样的合约是否令你们满意？
origin.5707.desc.en:
So they have piqued your interest, have they?

A Scholarium, as they are known, is an empire specialized in science and research. We would pledge to protect your empire so you can focus most of your resources on advancing your empire and our allies alike.

In turn we expect you to share any peculiar peculiar technological breakthroughs you might have with the rest of us. Would that sort of contract work for you?

origin.5708.a.zh: 我认为这非常适合我们。
origin.5708.a.en: We believe that is something that would fit us.

origin.5708.desc.zh:
你们对这项协定感兴趣没错吧？

勘探邦，正如大众赋予其称呼，是一种专精于发现矿物、生产战略资源的国家——但这会以牺牲他们的科学发展能力为代价。通过合适的工具，一些勘探邦可以找到其他人容易忽略的稀有矿物，尽管这只是我们道听途说的。

这听起来对你们的人民而言是不是一项可以胜任的工作呢？
origin.5708.desc.en:
Interested in that deal, are you?

A Prospectorium, as many call them, is an empire which specializes in finding minerals, and manufacturing strategic resources - but often at the cost of advancing their empire scientifically. With the right tools, some of the Prospectoria have been able to locate rare minerals that others overlook, though that's only a rumor we have heard.

Does that sound like something your people would be able to do?

origin.5725.a.zh: 哪怕是天上的长堤，也是溃于蚁穴。
origin.5725.a.en: A starfish rots from the head down.

origin.5725.desc.zh:
紧随着[overlord_ruler.GetName]的突然驾崩，我们获悉了[Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName]上正经历的混乱。不太受支持的[overlord_heir.GetName]通过军事手段将王座纳入了[overlord_heir.GetHimselfHerself]的囊中，令[overlord_heir.GetHisHer]的皇亲和[Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName]上的人民们大为不满。

在[overlord_heir.GetFirstName]的引起骚乱的崛起之后，许多人开始质疑[Root.Overlord.GetName]统治我们的合法性。如果他们连自己首都的安全都无法保证，他们还有什么能耐来保护我们的安全？
origin.5725.desc.en:
We have received news about the ongoing chaos on [Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName], following the sudden death of [overlord_ruler.GetName]. The unpopular [overlord_heir.GetName] has taken the throne for [overlord_heir.GetHimselfHerself] with the help of the military, much to the chagrin of [overlord_heir.GetHisHer] siblings and the people of [Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName].

After the troublesome rise of [overlord_heir.GetFirstName], many have started questioning the right of the [Root.Overlord.GetName] to dominion over us. If they cannot keep their own capital peaceful, what hope do they possibly have to keep the rest of us safe?

origin.5735.b.zh: 是时候有新的领袖登上历史舞台了。
origin.5735.b.en: It is time for a new leader to take charge.

origin.5735.b.tt.zh: 对[previous_overlord.GetName]和它原先的所有附属国获得30年的征服宣战理由。
origin.5735.b.tt.en: Gain a Subjugation Casus Belli against the [previous_overlord.GetName] and all its old vassals for 30 years.

origin.5735.c.zh: 我们忠于王座，无论如何。
origin.5735.c.en: We are loyal to the throne - no matter what.

origin.5735.c.tt.zh: 我们将继续是[previous_overlord.GetName]的忠诚附属国。
origin.5735.c.tt.en: Remain a loyal subject of the [previous_overlord.GetName].

origin.5735.desc.zh:
失去了能够维持团结统一的伟大领袖，[previous_overlord.GetName]现已分崩离析，而每一部分都宣称自己才是原先帝国的正统。然而由于没有足够的实力和合法性，他们对所有附庸的控制也随之瓦解。

在每一个分裂的部分都在互相征伐，争夺[previous_overlord.GetName]的王位时，他们原先的附属国们也可以按自己的意愿行事了。
origin.5735.desc.en:
With no great leader to hold them together, the [previous_overlord.GetName] has dissolved into several parts, with each claiming their right to rule over the old empire. Without the strength or legitimacy of old however, their hold over all their vassals has crumbled to nothing.

With the disparate parts of the old empire fighting over the throne of the [previous_overlord.GetName], their old subjects are now free to do as they wish.

origin.5745.a.zh: 这对我们的帝国颇有裨益。
origin.5745.a.en: They will be a boon to our empire.

origin.5745.b.zh: 我们对这些科学家没什么兴趣。
origin.5745.b.en: We have no interest in these scientists.

origin.5745.desc.zh: [new_subject_target.GetName]的人民对他们国土以外的事情漠不关心，不过他们清楚，无论外界发生了什么都可能会破坏他们一心一意的内部专注。因此他们向我们寻求如同原先[previous_overlord.GetName]所给予的类似的保护。
origin.5745.desc.en: The people of the [new_subject_target.GetName] care little for anything outside their own borders, but they are aware that whatever is out there might ruin their single-minded internal focus. Therefore they have turned to us for protection of the same kind the [previous_overlord.GetName] once gave them.

origin.5750.a.zh: 行吧，至少他们能有点共识。
origin.5750.a.en: As long as they can agree to something.

origin.5750.b.zh: 我们对这群呱噪的家伙可没有半点兴趣。
origin.5750.b.en: We are not interested in their quarrels.

origin.5750.desc.zh: [new_subject_target.GetName]因其众多争执不休的王子们而臭名昭著，他们一直处心积虑想争取到每一点可以争取的影响力和权力。仅这一次他们似乎终于成功取得了一项共识，向我们派出了特使以期缔结新的外交条约。似乎他们开始怀念曾经[previous_overlord.GetName]给予的那种悉心呵护了。
origin.5750.desc.en: The [new_subject_target.GetName] is known for their many quarreling princes, all desperately trying to grab hold of whatever influence and power they can. For once it seems they have finally managed to agree to something, and have sent envoys looking to make a new diplomatic pact with us. It seems they are missing the protection the [previous_overlord.GetName] once gave them.

origin.5755.a.zh: 这儿会有他们的容身之所的。
origin.5755.a.en: We will find room for them.

origin.5755.desc.zh: 在[previous_overlord.GetName]崩溃之前，[new_subject_target.GetName]与之颇为相近，似乎他们有兴趣与我们建立发展相似的关系。他们的外交官正在连夜撰写一份能令双方都满意签署的外交协定，作为我们两个帝国相互之间建立起更加充分的理解的第一步。
origin.5755.desc.en: The [new_subject_target.GetName] was particularly close to [previous_overlord.GetName] before their dissolution, and it seems like they are interested in building a similar relationship to our empire moving forward. Now their diplomats are scrambling to finish a diplomatic deal both sides will be happy to sign, as the first step in building a better understanding between our two empires.

origin.5760.a.zh: 只要他们能乖乖交上能量币就行。
origin.5760.a.en: As long as they can bring their energy credits.

origin.5760.b.zh: 我们不需要他们的资本财产。
origin.5760.b.en: We have no need of their capital wealth.

origin.5760.desc.zh: 似乎[new_subject_target.GetName]的市场在[previous_overlord.GetName]解体后，有些不稳定。现在他们已经没有人可以依靠了。几位贸易巨头已与我们接触，并表示愿意提供[new_subject_target.GetAdj]劳役，甚至非常愿意献上部分利润，一旦他们的帝国稳定下来。
origin.5760.desc.en: It seems the markets of the [new_subject_target.GetName] have been somewhat unstable after the dissolution of the [previous_overlord.GetName], now that they no longer have someone to rely on for protection. Several trade princes have approached us and offered to support [new_subject_target.GetAdj] servitude, and even part of the profits that are sure to follow as their empire stabilizes once more.

origin.6005.a.zh: 只要你遵守这个社会的规范 ，那么你就会受到欢迎。
origin.6005.a.en: You are welcome as long as you abide by the norms of this society.

origin.6005.a.tt.zh: 将[fotd_Leader.GetName]作为科学官添加到我们的$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$。
origin.6005.a.tt.en: Add [fotd_Leader.GetName] as a Scientist to our $RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$.

origin.6005.desc.base1.zh:
一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。

[fotd_Leader.GetName]是[fotd_Leader.GetSpecialization]专家，和[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的任何[Root.GetSpeciesName]享受同等权利。
origin.6005.desc.base1.en:
A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

[fotd_Leader.GetName] is [fotd_Leader.GetSpecialization] specialist, equal to any [Root.GetSpeciesName] on [Root.GetHomeWorldName].

origin.6005.desc.base2.zh:
一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。

我们的首席科学家同[fotd_Leader.GetName]保持了多年的联系，对[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]所作的工作赞不绝口。
origin.6005.desc.base2.en:
A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

Our lead scientists have been in communication with [fotd_Leader.GetName] for many years and are extremely impressed by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] work.

origin.6005.desc.base3.zh:
一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。

尽管[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]被[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]在[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的同事称为[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上最后一位偏执狂科学家，但这样的论述并不够全面。
origin.6005.desc.base3.en:
A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

Although [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] has been described as the least paranoid scientist on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] colleagues on [owner.GetHomeWorldName], this isn't really saying much.

origin.6005.desc.base4.zh:
一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。

[fotd_Leader.GetName]视自己为一名殉道者。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]前来我们“厄运笼罩的星球”，希望拯救我们的科技免受外部势力的摧毁。
origin.6005.desc.base4.en:
A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

[fotd_Leader.GetName] styles themselves something of a martyr. In traveling to our "doomed world" [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] hope to preserve our technology from destruction by outside forces.

origin.6005.desc.end1.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]向我们求助，因为[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上条件受限的设施阻碍了[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的研究。我们的科学家已经做了担保，保证这位潜在访客的一切行为都是良好的。
origin.6005.desc.end1.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] reached out to us because the limited facilities on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] are stunting [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] research. Our scientists have vouched for our potential visitor's good behavior.

origin.6005.desc.end2.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap]的研究已经被[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的政府定性为危险。他们的损失，是我们的收获。
origin.6005.desc.end2.en: [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap] research has been classified as dangerous by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] government. Their loss is our gain.

origin.6005.desc.end3.zh: 出于在学术上的杰出表现，[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]将获得[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的一个著名奖项。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]也同意在我们这里待上一段时间，就自己的研究举行一系列讲座。
origin.6005.desc.end3.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] will be the recipient of a prestigious award on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] for academic excellence. [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] have also agreed to stay with us for a while, holding a series of lectures about their research.

origin.6005.desc.end4.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]会研究当地的[GetStudyTopic]，并试图利用这些来改善[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上的生活。
origin.6005.desc.end4.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] will be studying local [GetStudyTopic] in an attempt to improve life on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName].

origin.6006.a.en: As long as you don't go rogue.

origin.6006.a.tt.zh: 将[fotd_Leader.GetName]作为指挥官添加到我们的$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$。
origin.6006.a.tt.en: Add [fotd_Leader.GetName] as an Commander to our $RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$.

origin.6006.b.zh: 对于一根松动的鱼雷管来说，你也太胖了！
origin.6006.b.en: You are too much of a loose torpedo tube!

origin.6006.desc.base1.zh: 一位来自[fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName]的指挥官提出要加入我们的海军，担任临时指挥官。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]的动机尚不清楚，但我们的线人告诉我们，这可能牵涉到一起丑闻。
origin.6006.desc.base1.en: A Commander from [fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName] is offering to join our navy as a temporary commander. [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] motivations are unclear, but our informants tell us that there might be a scandal involved.

origin.6006.desc.base2.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetName]非常急迫地想和我们签署临时合同。[fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName]一直是滋生狡猾和非常规战术的温床。
origin.6006.desc.base2.en: [fotd_Leader.GetName] is eager to sign on with us temporarily. [fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName] has always been a breeding ground for crafty and unconventional tactics.

origin.6006.desc.base3.zh: 由于指挥官[fotd_Leader.GetName]在最近一次联合舰队演习上的出色表现，我们决定扩大此人的权限，让其指挥一支真正的海军舰队。
origin.6006.desc.base3.en: After excelling in a recent joint fleet exercise, we have extended Commander [fotd_Leader.GetName] the opportunity to take command in a real navy.

origin.6006.desc.base4.zh: 因涉嫌将[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]指挥的舰船置于过度危险之中而被暂时调离岗位，不服气的指挥官[fotd_Leader.GetName]请求加入我们的海军。尽管[fotd_Leader.GetName]名声在外，那些曾与[fotd_Leader.GetHerHim]一起服役的人仍然尊重[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的才能。
origin.6006.desc.base4.en: Placed on temporary leave for allegedly putting the vessels under [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] command in excessive danger, Commander [fotd_Leader.GetName] has requested to join our navy. Despite [fotd_Leader.GetName]'s reputation, those who have served with [fotd_Leader.GetHerHim] still respect [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] talent.

origin.6010.b.zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价留住他们。
origin.6010.b.en: We need to keep them at any cost.

origin.6010.desc.zh:
在同我们一起生活了许多年之后，[fotd_Leader.GetName]决定返回家乡。一些政府官员反对这一变动，因为[fotd_Leader.GetName]已经成为我们高级领导层不可或缺的一部分。

[GetfotdCoercion]
origin.6010.desc.en:
After long years living among us, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has decided to return home. Some in government are opposed to the move, as [fotd_Leader.GetName] has become an integral part of our senior leadership.

[GetfotdCoercion]

origin.6011.desc.zh: 最近，[fotd_Leader.GetName]的性格变得越来越孤僻。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]再次请求允许他回家。[fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap]的同事指出，[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]由于患上了抑郁症一直对他们的工作产生了负面影响，并建议我们批准[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]离开。
origin.6011.desc.en: Recently, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has grown increasingly withdrawn. Once again, [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] is requesting permission to return home. [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap] coworkers note that [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] depression has been affecting their work, and suggest we let [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] go.

origin.6012.desc.zh: 在过去的几个周期里，人们看到[fotd_Leader.GetName]在喃喃自语，有时在大厅里踱步。今天，[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]没有来上班。我们的一架逃生飞船也报告失踪。这些事件不太可能是一个巧合。
origin.6012.desc.en: Over the last several cycles, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has been seen muttering to themselves and pacing the halls. Today, [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] failed to arrive at work. One of our escape shuttles has also been reported missing. It's unlikely these events are a coincidence.

origin.6015.a.tt.zh: 这会让我们10年内无法进入虚境。
origin.6015.a.tt.en: This will prevent us from accessing The Shroud for 10 years.

origin.6015.c.zh: 他们疯了吗？我们绝无可能同意这个。
origin.6015.c.en: Are they mad? We would never agree to this.

origin.6015.desc.zh:
似乎我们兄弟星球上的科学家已经在[root.fotdGetTech]领域取得了数个全新的、公认的、有见地的突破。尽管他们可以说是目光狭隘，但在这种情况下有一说一，他们的技术已经超过了我们自己取得的成就。

他们愿意与我们分享他们的见解，以换取我们[root.fotdGetTechPrice]——可以肯定的是，这个价格不菲。
origin.6015.desc.en:
It seems that the scientists on our partner planet have made several new, and admittedly insightful, breakthroughs into the field of [root.fotdGetTech]. Despite their parochial tendencies, it's fair to say that in this case their technology has outstripped our own achievements.

They are willing to share their insights with us in exchange for us [root.fotdGetTechPrice] - a steep price, to be sure.

origin.6020.b.zh: 那我们又能得到什么回报呢？
origin.6020.b.en: What do we get in return?

origin.6020.c.zh: 如果他们需要帮助，他们应该重新加入我们。
origin.6020.c.en: If they want aid they should rejoin us.

origin.6020.desc.zh: 无论是出于工作疏忽、工作人员的无能，还是纯粹的不幸，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]现在深陷[root.GetSeperatistAid]供应危机。如果没有帮助，很可能数百万人将受灾。
origin.6020.desc.en: Whether due to negligence, incompetence, or sheer misfortune [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] now struggle with their [root.GetSeperatistAid] supply. Without help it is very likely that millions will suffer.

origin.6025.c.zh: 我们应该独立挺过难关。

origin.6025.desc.didnthelp.zh:
$origin.6025.desc.base$

一位沾沾自喜的信使告知我们他们提供帮助的报价是[root.fotdGetTechPrice]。我们有得选吗？
origin.6025.desc.didnthelp.en:
$origin.6025.desc.base$

A smug message informed us that the price for their help would be [root.fotdGetTechPrice]. Do we have a choice?

origin.6025.desc.helped.zh:
$origin.6025.desc.base$

由于我们先前的支援，他们决定偿还我们的人情，不求回报地向我们提供帮助。
origin.6025.desc.helped.en:
$origin.6025.desc.base$

Due to our previous support, they have decided to repay the favor, offering us help free of charge.

origin.6030.a.zh: 我们生活的星系就是如此。他们很快就会适应的。
origin.6030.a.en: That's the galaxy we live in. They will adapt soon enough.

origin.6030.b.zh: 这是无稽之谈，屏蔽他们的传输信号。
origin.6030.b.en: This is nonsense. Block their transmissions.

origin.6030.desc.zh:
虽然确认外星人存在的消息对[Root.GetHomeWorldName]来说并非意料之外，但在[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上情况就要糟糕得多。他们本来抱着微不足道的希望生活，祈愿大分裂者的毁灭只是一个古怪的事故，但现在他们确信，宇宙是要来对付他们。

“我们需要在这些外星人来这里完成工作之前消灭他们！”这正是[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]媒体上正在播放的那种疯狂的呼喊。
origin.6030.desc.en:
While the news confirming existence of aliens was not entirely unexpected for [Root.GetHomeWorldName], it was felt worse on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They were living with the minuscule hope that perhaps the Divider's destruction was just a freak accident, but now they are convinced that the universe is out to get them.

"We need to destroy these Aliens before they can come here and finish the job!" is the type of frantic cry being broadcast on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] media.

origin.6040.a.zh: 我们需要知道正在发生的情况。
origin.6040.a.en: We need to know what's going on.

origin.6040.desc.zh: 发现外星智能生命的消息已经传到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]。然而，出乎我们的预期，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]并没有传来恐惧和愤怒的情感，当地反而陷入了沉默。多艘恒星际飞船重新回到了自己的船坞，还有数个旧的超光速驱动器从仓库中挪出。看来他们正准备进行一次远行。
origin.6040.desc.en: News of the discovery of intelligent alien life has reached [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. However, instead of the fear and outrage that we expected to from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName], they have instead gone silent. Multiple inter-system ships have returned to their dockyards, and several old FTL drives are missing from storage. It appears they are preparing for an excursion.

origin.6045.b.secured.zh: 让他们削弱这些外星人，然后把锅扣在[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上。
origin.6045.b.secured.en: Let them weaken these aliens, then reprimand [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName].

origin.6045.c.zh: 我们的邻国很虚弱。趁着这个机会结果他们！
origin.6045.c.en: Our neighbors are weak. Use this opportunity to end them!

origin.6045.c.tt.zh:
$origin.6045.starbase_destroyed.tt$
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]将会失去5艘位于[target_system.GetName]星系的护卫舰的控制权。
将会同[From.GetName]进入全面战争状态。
origin.6045.c.tt.en:
$origin.6045.starbase_destroyed.tt$
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] will cede control of 5 corvettes in [target_system.GetName].
Will enter a Total War with [From.GetName].

origin.6045.desc.notsecured.zh:
$origin.6045.desc.base$

我们没有办法阻止这场灾难。这些超规格的导弹将彻底摧毁[target_system.GetName]的恒星基地。我们只能惊恐地看着。除非……
origin.6045.desc.notsecured.en:
$origin.6045.desc.base$

There is nothing we can do to stop this disaster. These oversized missiles will completely demolish the starbase in [target_system.GetName]. We can only look on in horror. Unless...

origin.6045.desc.secured.zh:
$origin.6045.desc.base$

幸运的是，我们做好了充分的准备。在观察到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的异常行为后，我们随时都可以在太空中将他们打下来，不让他们击中空间站。
origin.6045.desc.secured.en:
$origin.6045.desc.base$

Fortunately, we are prepared. Having observed the odd behavior of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] we stand ready to shoot them out of space before they can hit the station.

origin.6045.starbase_destroyed.tt.en: The starbase in [target_system.GetName] will be Destroyed.

origin.6046.b.zh: 他们威胁到了我们的存续。不是他们死就是我们亡！
origin.6046.b.en: They threaten our very existence. It's them or us!

origin.6046.desc.zh: 我们位于[target_system.GetName]的恒星基地被一帮子所谓的[From.GetName]“叛逃分子”给摧毁了。我们已经收到了道歉，对方承诺不会再发生这种情况。但谁知道呢？今天是[target_system.GetName]，也许明天就是[capital_star.GetName]。
origin.6046.desc.en: Our starbase in [target_system.GetName] has been destroyed by so-called "rogue agents", the [From.GetName]! We have already received an apology and a promise that this will not happen again. But who knows? First it was [target_system.GetName], and perhaps [capital_star.GetName] is next.

origin.6047.desc.zh:
在与[From.GetName]第一次接触后不久，我们在[target_system.GetName]的恒星基地就被爆炸摧毁。在系统掉线之前，我们接收到了图像，那是一支采用[From.GetAdj]设计的敌方舰队。

我们现在发现自己卷入了一场事关生死存亡的战争之中。
origin.6047.desc.en:
Shortly after first contact with the [From.GetName], our starbase in [target_system.GetName] exploded. Before the system went dark, we received images of a hostile armada of [From.GetAdj] design.

We now find ourselves engaged in a war for our very survival.

origin.6055.a.zh: 我们的盟友会把这个视作无意义的闹剧。肯定的。
origin.6055.a.en: Our allies will see this for the nonsense it is. Surely.

origin.6055.desc.noprotests.zh:
$origin.6055.desc.base$

公众的愤怒甚至影响到了我们兄弟星球的学术界，他们现在已经结束了我们两颗星球之间的所有合作项目。只能希望我们的新联邦盟友能够理解这一切。
origin.6055.desc.noprotests.en:
$origin.6055.desc.base$

The public outrage has even reached the academies of our partner world which have now ended all cooperative projects between our worlds. It is to be hoped that our new federation allies will understand.

origin.6055.desc.protests.zh:
$origin.6055.desc.base$

[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]已经因为我们先前的外交行动被激怒，而这一次则让他们彻底翻了脸。在我们切断他们的联系之前，他们设法向我们的盟友发送了几条五颜六色的信息，损害了我们之间的关系，其影响也许是永久性的。
origin.6055.desc.protests.en:
$origin.6055.desc.base$

[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] was already agitated after our previous diplomatic actions, and this seems to have tipped them over the edge. Before we could cut them off, they managed to send several colorful messages to our allies, damaging our relations, perhaps permanently.

origin.6060.b.zh: 不！[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]才是错误的！我们必须一起面对这个。
origin.6060.b.en: No! [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is wrong! We will face this together.

origin.6060.desc.zh: 自[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]恒星系传来的消息深深震撼了我们的母星。如果像这样的怪物都能够存在，那么在太空深处还可能潜伏着什么样的威胁？在我们的人民中，要求移民到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的申请已经飙升。然而此时此刻，我们很难责怪他们。
origin.6060.desc.en: The news from the [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName] system has shaken our homeworld deeply. What other threats may be lurking in the depths of space, if monsters like this can exist? Already, applications for immigration to [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have soared amongst our people. At the moment, it is difficult to blame them.

origin.6065.desc.zh:
当我们向[overlord.GetName]臣服后，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]立马就来讥讽我们。

“任何外星生命本质上都是有敌意的。如果你们当初就留在[home_planet.GetStarName]上，这一切都不会发生！”

不用说，我们的内部人民现在还不是特别团结。
origin.6065.desc.en:
After our submission to the [overlord.GetName], [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] did not waste any time ridiculing us.

"Alien life is inherently hostile. If you all had simply stayed in [home_planet.GetStarName], none of this would have happened!"

Needless to say, our people are not particularly unified right now.

origin.6075.a.zh: 我们的属民肯定没有在密谋针对我们！
origin.6075.a.en: Our subject surely isn't plotting against us!

origin.6075.desc.zh:
在收取了一个附庸之后，我们的帝国朝着一个宇宙强权又迈进了一步。然而，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]却不以为然。根据他们的说法，我们只是成功地将外星人的威胁拉近了。为了表示抗议，他们已经停止了与我们的所有研究合作。

假以时日，我们一定会证明他们是错的。
origin.6075.desc.en:
In taking a vassal, our empire made a major leap forward as a galactic power. However, [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is not impressed. According to them, we have only succeeded in bringing the alien threat closer. In protest, they have ceased all research cooperation with us.

In time, we will certainly prove them wrong.

origin.6085.b.zh: 指派人手前往我们的舰船。

origin.6085.c.zh: 他们观测到什么和敌人有关的吗？
origin.6085.c.en: Have they observed anything about the enemy?

origin.6085.desc.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]的黎明，我们获得了一个意想不到的盟友：来自[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的同志们终于在一个外交问题上与我们达成一致，恳请我们将外星人扫除掉。令人遗憾的是，一旦战争结束，这样的合作就要告一段落了。
origin.6085.desc.en: At the dawn of the [FromFrom.GetName] we have gained an unexpected ally: our comrades from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have finally aligned themselves with us on a diplomatic issue, imploring us to wipe the xenos out. It's a shame that once the war is over their co-operation will end.

origin.6090.desc.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的住民曾经预言的那一天如今已经到来：随着敌国对我们宣战，星系已经成为一处荒凉、充满敌意的境地。然而，这个故事尚未到结局。我们将挺过这一关。
origin.6090.desc.en: The day the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] predicted has arrived: with war declared against us, the galaxy has become an inhospitable and hostile realm. However, this story's ending is not yet written. We will survive this.

origin.6095.a.zh: 对于在这个星系中存活需要付出怎样的代价，他们的理解太肤浅太单纯了。
origin.6095.a.en: They are too simple to understand what it takes to survive in this galaxy.

origin.6095.desc.zh: 我们的人民对于这种通过人为手段提升思想水平的经历还很陌生，因此当听说[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们对我们的新升级持有如此激烈的反对意见之后，普遍感到惊讶。这些人警告说，如果我们再“玷污”自己的身体，所有先前的合作努力都将视作无效。
origin.6095.desc.en: Still new to this artificially elevated level of thought, our people were surprised to receive such vehement opposition to our new upgrades from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They warn that if we "defile" our bodies any further, all collaborative efforts will be canceled.

origin.6096.a.zh: 让他们在黑暗中颤抖吧。
origin.6096.a.en: Let them cower in the dark.

origin.6096.desc.zh:
我们决定彻底地转换到合成体的生命形式，作为结果，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们充分履行了当初的承诺：每条通信途径、每个合作研究站和所有形式的媒体现在都被封锁了。

考虑到我们现在已经发展到了如此地步，问题的关键在于，我们是否还需要他们。
origin.6096.desc.en:
As a result of our decision to transition to a fully cybernetic form of life, the people of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have made good on their promise: every avenue of communication, every collaborative research station, and all forms of media are now blocked.

The question is whether or not we still need them, now that we are so much more.

origin.6099.desc.zh: 第一批合成躯体正从工厂车间滚滚落下，并由其未来的寄居者进行视察。然而，并非每个[Species.GetName]都对这一非凡的发展感到兴奋。[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民已经警告我们，如果我们继续在这条歧路上行进，所有先前的合作努力都将视作无效。
origin.6099.desc.en: The first synthetic bodies are rolling off the factory floor and are being inspected by their future inhabitants. However, not every [Species.GetName] is excited about this remarkable development. The inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have warned us that they will cancel all collaborative efforts if we continue down this route.

origin.61.desc.zh:
随着[Root.GetName]上的地震与火山活动的频率和烈度持续提升，我们的科学家现在可以更为准确地预计末日到来的时间：

他们估计我们在行星自身引爆前还有35至45年时间。

行星表面的条件在那之前会逐步恶化。唯一的好消息是迅猛的科技进步使得开采地幔中的丰富资源变得更为容易，提高了我们的生产能力。
origin.61.desc.en:
As earthquakes and volcanic activity on [Root.GetName] continue to increase in frequency and intensity, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are now able to more accurately predict when the end will come:

They estimate that we have between 35 to 45 years until the planet detonates.

Conditions on the surface will steadily deteriorate until then. The only good news is that the violent tectonic movements have made it easier to access the rich resources of the planet's mantle, increasing our production capacity.

origin.6100.a.en: Unable to see past their [fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy] Prisons.

origin.6100.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的每一名成员都接受了他们新的、机械合成体的形态。然而，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们则选择留在他们的[fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy]凡胎肉体之中。此外，他们已经兑现了先前的威胁，结束了与我们的所有合作关系。
origin.6100.desc.en: Every member of the [Root.GetName] has embraced their new, synthetic forms. However, the population of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has chosen to stay in their [fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy] vessels. Furthermore, they have made good on their threat to end all collaborative efforts with us.

origin.6105.desc.zh: 没有必要等待不可避免的[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]评判了。我们已经充分意识到了他们愤怒的想法。在所有的不和谐之音中，想要停止一切合作关系的声音尤其突出。
origin.6105.desc.en: There is no need to wait for the inevitable judgment of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] We are fully aware of their agitated thoughts. Amidst the cacophony, their intention to cease all collaboration is crystal clear.

origin.6110.a.zh: 我们的飞升是大势所趋。

origin.6110.desc.zh: 我们终于同虚境内的某个大型实体建立了联系。再一次，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName][GetLamentations]侵扰到了我们；他们正在从我们的网络中断开自己的连接，取消了所有的联合研究行动。
origin.6110.desc.en: At last we have secured access to one of the grand entities of the Shroud. Once again, the [GetLamentations] of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] intrude on us; they are disconnecting themselves from our networks, cancelling every joint research operation.

origin.6110.desc_2.default.zh: 只有我们才明白这样的行为实际上有多么无足轻重。有一种更开明的伙伴关系即将诞生。
origin.6110.desc_2.default.en: Only we understand how inconsequential such actions truly are. The birth of a more enlightened partnership is at hand.

origin.6110.desc_2.gestalt.zh: 这种个人主义反常不值得我们关注，无法理解我们开明思想的人在我们中也没有立足之地。
origin.6110.desc_2.gestalt.en: Such individualist deviancy is beneath our concern, those who cannot comprehend our enlightened thoughts have no place among us.

origin.6110.desc_2.robot.zh: 这种没有逻辑的行为无足轻重。我们自己的处理能力已经远超他们原始的理解力。
origin.6110.desc_2.robot.en: Such illogical actions are inconsequential. Our own processing power has ascended beyond their primitive comprehension.

origin.6115.a.zh: 允许这些瑕疵继续存在是不负责任的。
origin.6115.a.en: Allowing these flaws to persist would be irresponsible.

origin.6115.desc.zh:
自从我们成功地改造了自己的给养来源，[Root.GetSpeciesName]就幻想着基因强化的无限可能性。现在这一天已经到来。缺陷、弱点、不完美——这些都将成为被抛弃的历史遗留物。

唯一持反对意见的是[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民。他们称这种改造是一次堕落，将不可避免地导致一个由基因完善者统治的阶级主义社会。
origin.6115.desc.en:
Ever since we successfully modified our source of sustenance, [Root.GetSpeciesName] have fantasized about the limitless possibilities of genetic enhancement. Now the day has come. Defects, weaknesses, imperfections - these are all remnants of a discarded past.

The only naysayers are the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They have called such modification a slippery slope, one that will inevitably lead to a classist society ruled by the genetically perfected.

origin.6120.a.zh: 将思维狭隘的人抛到身后。

origin.6120.desc.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]拒绝一切形式的通讯。当我们破解了如何将外星基因拼接到我们身体构成中这一秘密以后，他们留给我们的只有一条信息：“你已经放弃了作为[fotd_seperatist_planet.owner.GetSpecesName]的意义”。
origin.6120.desc.en: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] refuses all communication. Once we cracked the secret of splicing alien genetics into our physical makeup, they left us with a single message: "You have abandoned what it means to be [fotd_seperatist_planet.owner.GetSpecesName]"

origin.6125.a.en: We refuse to be snuffed out.

origin.6125.desc.zh:
当整个宇宙面临威胁时，即使是我们隐居的邻国也必须站出来采取行动。只要我们能够抵抗即将到来的风暴，我们将会再次成为同一个民族。

我们已被授予[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]舰队的指挥权。
origin.6125.desc.en:
When the galaxy is threatened even our reclusive neighbors must act. As long as we can resist the coming storm we will be one people again.

We have been granted command of the [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] fleet.

origin.6145.desc.zh: 我们的兄弟行星要求我们对他们的一些发现进行确认。他们再次声称有证据表明，大分裂者实际上是被某个满怀恶意的外星实体给摧毁的。这已经变得令人厌烦了；每隔几年，他们似乎都会发现一些新的“证据”。
origin.6145.desc.en: Our partner planet has requested that we confirm some of their findings. Once again, they claim to have evidence that The Divider was destroyed by a malicious foreign entity. This has become tiresome; every few years it seems they discover some new "proof".

origin.6150.a.zh: 给我们的超空间驱动器充能。

origin.6150.desc.zh:
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]是对的！

我们多年前所遭受的攻击确实是一个能发射大型钨制弹丸的邪恶实体所为。由于母星系独特的重力场我们才得以幸存。通过分析那个关键夜晚的数据并与这些新的发现进行交叉研究，我们可以定位出这颗小行星大小的钨弹的来源位置。

它来自一个我们在数十年前就已经登记过的格外富矿（但除此之外也没有别的特点）的星系。
origin.6150.desc.en:
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] were right!

The attack we suffered all those years ago was perpetrated by a malicious entity capable of launching massive tungsten projectiles. Only the unique gravitational features of our home system allowed us to survive. By analyzing the data from that fateful night and cross-referencing it with these new findings, it was possible for us to triangulate the source of the asteroid-sized tungsten round.

It originated from an incredibly mineral-rich (yet otherwise unremarkable) system we have had in our logs for decades.

origin.6155.a.zh: 让我们好好拜访一下旧日的梦魇。
origin.6155.a.en: Let's pay our old nightmares a visit.

origin.6155.desc.zh:
曾经侵略过我们的势力所在的恒星系现在是一片不毛之地。虽然一个小行星带缺乏矿物并不罕见，但这个小行星带可以说是已经被剥光了。不仅如此，在应该有富含稀有金属的小行星的地方，我们只发现了灰尘。不管居住在这个恒星系的物种是如何获取他们用于制造子弹的钨的，他们现在已经没有这样的资源了。他们似乎甚至没有能力离开他们的行星。

虽然他们已经尽力保持隐蔽，阻断了所有的无线电信号，甚至限制使用人工照明，但我们还是在该恒星系唯一的宜居行星上探测到了生命。
origin.6155.desc.en:
The system of our old aggressors is barren. While it isn't unusual for an asteroid belt to be mineral-poor, this one has been stripped bare. Not only that, but where there should be minor planetoids rich in rare metals, we have found only dust. However the species inhabiting this system managed to gain the tungsten necessary to construct their bullets, they no longer have the resources to do so now. They don't even seem to be capable of leaving their planet.

While they have done their best to remain hidden, preventing all radio signals and even limiting the use of artificial lights, we have detected life on the system's lone habitable planet.

origin.6160.a.zh: 宇宙中只剩下我们才是安全的。
origin.6160.a.en: We will only be safe when we are alone.

origin.6160.a.tooltip.zh: 我们会加入我们的兄弟行星，为确保星系的安全将其他生命全部抹除。就从这块石头开始。
origin.6160.a.tooltip.en: We will join our partner planet in securing this galaxy by expunging all other life. Starting with this rock here.

origin.6160.b.zh: 我们会向他们表示同情。

origin.6160.c.tooltip.zh: 衷心希望，他们能够从我们身上学会，不是所有的外星人都要杀个干净。
origin.6160.c.tooltip.en: Hopefully, they can learn from us that not all alien life is out to kill them.

origin.6160.desc.zh: 观察菲沃尔人的经历对于我们来说相当有启发性。事实上，他们的意识形态与导致我们自己物种分裂的意识形态非常相似。然而，菲沃尔人没有选择自我隔离，而是选择了对他们能够探测到的任何生命迹象进行先制打击的策略。一旦他们耗尽了重金属，这些外星人就只能回到他们的星球，从他们现在贫瘠的家园中拾掇一切来勉强维持生计。虽然我们伙伴星球的领导层正在敦促我们采取与菲沃尔人相同的策略，但如何最好地对付我们的潜在灭绝者，这事并没有我们原以为的那么简单。
origin.6160.desc.en: Observing the Fevorians has been a revelatory experience. In fact, their ideology is remarkably similar to that which produced the split in our own species. However, rather than choosing isolation, the Fevorians opted for a strategy of pre-emptive strikes against any life signs they could detect. Once they ran out of heavy metals, the aliens returned to their world, scraping whatever bare subsistence they could from their now barren home. While the leadership of our partner planet is urging us to adopt the same tactics as the Fevorians, how best to deal with our would-be exterminators is no easy question.

origin.6165.a.zh: 我们应当将他们全部静默。

origin.6165.b.zh: 不，我们不会成为侵略者。
origin.6165.b.en: No, we will not be the aggressors.

origin.6165.desc.zh: 毁灭菲沃尔人竟是……这么容易？又少了一个威胁到我们生存的猎人。我们已经很久没有感觉到与我们的伙伴星球如此同步了。也许他们是对的。这里只有两种类型的生命：静默的和死亡的。
origin.6165.desc.en: Destroying the Fevorians was... easy? One fewer hunter, threatening our existence. We have not felt this in sync with our partner world for a long time. Perhaps they were right. There are only two types of life out here: the silent and the dead.

origin.6170.desc.zh:
菲沃尔卫星比我们最初预期的要更重要。整个星系里仅存的重金属原来全部都在这颗卫星内，进一步研究发现这颗卫星其实是一座巨型的质量投射器。错综复杂的投射机构往返盘绕着整颗小行星。粗略计算表明，这个武器可以将在和发射至高亚光速。

最后次发射的数据仍停留在其火控计算机中，目标就是[Root.GetHomeWorldName]。
origin.6170.desc.en:
The Fevorian Moon was more important than we first anticipated. The only heavy metals left in the system are found within the moon, which upon closer examination was revealed to be a titanic mass driver. The sprawling launch mechanism encircles the planetoid multiple times. Rough calculations indicate that the weapon could launch payloads approaching the speed of light.

The data for the final shot is still in its targeting computer, aimed at [Root.GetHomeWorldName].

origin.6175.desc.zh:
菲沃尔人赢了。我们的人口九死一生，家园支离破碎。

直到这颗行星的最后一刻，跨大气层运输船还在将[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不断运往轨道。而来不及离开的人则在高亚光速炮弹击中的瞬间被产生的高温瞬间化为灰烬。[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]愿意接纳我们的政府并安置难民。
origin.6175.desc.en:
The Fevorians have won. Our people are decimated, and our home world desecrated.

Inter-atmosphere ships were ferrying [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] into orbit until the planet's final moments. Those who remained on the surface were incinerated the instant the near-lightspeed projectile ignited the atmosphere. [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has offered to host our government and house the evacuees.

origin.6180.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]已经恢复安全了。我们已经成功将钨弹偏转到了足够远的地方，以确保我们自己能够存活下来。尽管经过其漫长的旅途之后，它很可能成为另一个行星的问题。
origin.6180.desc.en: [Target.GetName] is safe. We have managed to divert the tungsten projectile far enough to ensure our own survival, though over the course of its long journey, it may very well become another planet's problem.

origin.6185.desc.zh: 我们的科学家孜孜不倦地针对“菲沃尔问题”进行攻关，目前已经提出了四种截然不同的解决方案。如果我们迅速应对，他们相信我们有相当的机会对这个恐怖事物进行偏转。
origin.6185.desc.en: Our scientists have been working tirelessly on the "Fevorian Problem" and have come up with four distinct solutions. If we act quickly, they believe we have a fair chance to deflect this terror.

origin.6205.desc.zh:
由于[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]组织的抗议活动在[From.GetAdj]大使馆的正门前发生了骚乱，本应是对多样性和友谊进行庆祝的庆典活动，最后却在酸楚中结束。抗议者并不羞于表达自己的观点，他们喊出了“[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]滚回垃圾站！”这样丰富多彩的口号。

毫不意外的是，这次事件俨然成为了两国之间外交关系紧张的导火索。
origin.6205.desc.en:
What should have been a celebration of diversity and friendship ended on a sour note as a protest organized by [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] broke out in front of the [From.GetAdj] embassy. The protestors were not shy about their views, shouting such colorful slogans as "[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] belong in the recycling plant!"

Unsurprisingly, this has increased diplomatic tensions between our empires.

origin.6220.a.zh: 我们需要建造更多的舰船！
origin.6220.a.en: We need to build more ships!

origin.6220.b.zh: 我们的舰队需要更多的军官！
origin.6220.b.en: We need more officers in our fleets!

origin.6220.c.zh: 把我们敌人的所有一切都告诉我们。
origin.6220.c.en: Tell us everything about our enemy.

origin.6220.desc.zh:
[FromFrom.GetName]战争将会被永远铭记，在这一刻我们与[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]并肩作战，携手抗击外来威胁。

面对这一最新的威胁，我们本以为会从[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们那收到嘲笑的信息。但他们的回复却是这样的：

“有哪里需要帮助吗？”
origin.6220.desc.en:
[FromFrom.GetName] war will forever be remembered as the moment that we and [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] stood together, unified against an existential threat.

Confronted by this latest terror, we expected another dismissive message from the people of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. Instead, they responded with five words: 

"Where do you need us?"

origin.6230.a.zh: 希望他们喜欢这些改变。

origin.6230.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不适应[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上的条件。但得益于细致的环境改造，严苛的环境终将成为历史。

尽管[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]还残留着一些更加困难的环境，但这颗星球的居住者们已经让[From.Target.GetClassAdj]环境彻底成了历史。
origin.6230.desc.en:
Conditions on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have always been inhospitable to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. But thanks to diligent terraforming, extreme hardship will become a thing of the past.

While [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] remains a somewhat challenging environment, the inhabitants of the world have left their [From.Target.GetClassAdj] past behind.

origin.6235.a.zh: 似乎我们的星球已经不是唯一在[from.Target.GetStarName]有吸引力的地方了。
origin.6235.a.en: It seems ours is not the only attractive world in [from.Target.GetStarName] anymore.

origin.6235.desc.zh:
他们完成了。

我们有些人之前说，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民简直是疯了才会在那种鬼地方定居。而如今，他们已经将那里改造成了第二个[home_planet.GetName]，吸引着每一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
origin.6235.desc.en:
They have done it.

Some of our people called the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] mad for settling a world with such horrendous conditions. Yet, now they have fashioned a more than adequate facsimile of [home_planet.GetName], attractive to any [Root.GetSpeciesName].

origin.6240.a.changedhome.zh: 想要改善自己的家园，这是非常自然的想法。
origin.6240.a.changedhome.en: It's only natural to want to improve one's home.

origin.6240.desc.changedhome.zh: 也许是受我们自己在环境改造方面所取得成功的启发，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民已经将他们的星球塑造成了一件真正的美丽之物。之前就很丰饶的[From.Target.GetClassName]现在已经成为一个盖亚星球。居民们可以继续在天堂里躲避宇宙的威胁。
origin.6240.desc.changedhome.en: Perhaps inspired by our own successes in terraforming, the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have sculpted their world into a thing of true beauty. The previously bountiful [From.Target.GetClassName] has become a Gaia World. The inhabitants can continue to hide from the galaxy in paradise.

origin.6240.desc.notchangedhome.zh: 来自[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的消息令人惭愧：当地居民已经突破了[home_planet.GetName]的发展界限。他们摒弃了[From.GetClassName]的形态，成功打造出一颗盖亚星球。面对近在咫尺的理想家园，我们的民众开始质疑：为何还要继续留在这里生活？
origin.6240.desc.notchangedhome.en: Humiliating news from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]: the inhabitants have managed to transcend the limits of [home_planet.GetName]. By discarding the form of a [From.GetClassName], they have created a Gaia World. Many of our own people question why they should continue to live here, when a paradise exists on their doorstep.

origin.6260.desc.zh: 最近的报告称[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]已经部署了一支巡逻舰队，用以保卫[capital_star.GetName]。他们好像已经发展出了隐形科技。好在他们已经同意把频率分享给我们。
origin.6260.desc.en: Recent reports indicate that [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has now deployed a fleet to patrol [capital_star.GetName]. They appear to have developed cloaking technology. Thankfully, they have agreed to share their frequencies with us.

origin.6275.b.zh: 你们可以按自己的意愿行事。
origin.6275.b.en: You are free to do so on your own.

origin.6275.b.tt.zh: 我们要返回菲沃尔母星系。
origin.6275.b.tt.en: We shall return the Fevorian home system.

origin.6275.c.tt.zh: 我们要停止启蒙菲沃尔人。
origin.6275.c.tt.en: We will stop enlightening the Fevorians.

origin.6275.desc.zh:
观察者们，你们好。据说我们的祖先曾试图消灭你们。

为此，我们表示歉意。坦率地说，我们很惊讶你们没有进行报复。

从那时起已经过去了许多个世纪，我们愿意相信，我们现在是一个不一样的民族了，毋庸置疑这也要感谢你们。

我们想再给宇宙一次机会。能允许我们和你们一起探索吗？
origin.6275.desc.en:
Greetings Observers. It is said that our ancestors tried to end you.

For that, we apologize. Frankly, we are surprised that you didn't return the favor.

Many centuries have past since then, and we would like to believe that we are a different people now, no doubt thanks to you as well.

We wish to give the universe a second chance. Would you allow us to explore it with you?

origin.65.2.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的大部分地区现在几乎每天都会发生地震，过去几年里又出现了至少一打新的超级火山。大量的火山灰遮蔽了天空，使得在某些区域航空飞行变得过于危险或是根本不可能。气温已经下降了数度。

尽管有上述灾难，这颗垂死行星的表面的秩序却如梦幻般正常。垮塌建筑留下的瓦砾被缓慢清理，打转的灰尘被从最为繁忙的街道上扫去，岩浆流只要有可能就会被引流改道。子个体们正在忍受。
origin.65.2.desc.en:
Earthquakes are now an almost daily occurrence on most of [Root.GetName], and at least a dozen new supervolcanoes have appeared within the last few years. Massive ash storms blanket the skies, making air travel hazardous or even impossible in some regions. Temperatures have dropped by several degrees.

Despite all this, a surreal sense of normalcy prevails on the dying planet's surface. Rubble from collapsed buildings is slowly removed, the swirling ash is swept off the busiest streets, and the lava flows are, where possible, diverted. The drones endure.

origin.65.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的大部分地区现在几乎每天都会发生地震，过去几年里又出现了很多新的超级火山。大量的火山灰遮蔽了天空，使得在某些区域航行变得过于危险或是根本不可能。气温已经下降了数度。

尽管有上述灾难，这颗垂死行星的表面的秩序却如梦幻般正常。垮塌建筑留下的瓦砾被缓慢清理，悬浮的灰尘被从最繁忙的街道上清理掉，只要条件允许岩浆流就会被引流改道。民众正在忍耐。
origin.65.desc.en:
Earthquakes are now an almost daily occurrence on most of [Root.GetName], and at least a dozen new supervolcanoes have appeared within the last few years. Massive ash storms blanket the skies, making air travel hazardous or even impossible in some regions. Temperatures have dropped by several degrees.

Despite all this, a surreal sense of normalcy prevails on the dying planet's surface. Rubble from collapsed buildings is slowly removed, the swirling ash is swept off the busiest streets, and the lava flows are, where possible, diverted. The people endure.

origin.70.2.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，阴郁将长时间笼罩在行星表面。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。

火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占领了多处子个体中心。无穷无尽的子个体乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里会相对安全…至少现在如此。
origin.70.2.desc.en:
A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.

Pyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several drone hubs in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of drones are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach more remote areas where relative safety can still be found... for now.

origin.70.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，行星表面被阴霾笼罩。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。

火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占据了数座城市。无穷无尽的难民乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里仍能找到文明带来的舒适…至少现在如此。
origin.70.desc.en:
