A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.

Pyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several cities in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of refugees are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach safer areas, where the comforts of civilization can still be found... for now.

origin.7000.a.zh: 把更多的时间花在他们的研究上。
origin.7000.a.en: Dedicate further time to their study.

origin.7000.b.zh: 我们还有更要紧的事情。

origin.7000.desc.beastmasters.zh: 缇扬奇是我们最新遇到的外星物种，$origin.7000.desc.common$
origin.7000.desc.beastmasters.en: The Tiyanki are a new alien species we encountered, $origin.7000.desc.common$

origin.7000.desc.default.zh: 缇扬奇是我们最先遇到的外星物种，$origin.7000.desc.common$
origin.7000.desc.default.en: The Tiyanki are the first alien species we encountered, $origin.7000.desc.common$

origin.7005.desc.zh: 通过对这些太空朋友进食习性的研究，我们的科学家获得了研究突破。$tech_space_whale_weapon_1_desc$。这项科技毫无疑问是非常有用的。
origin.7005.desc.en: By studying the feeding habits of our voidborne friends, our scientists have made a scientific breakthrough. $tech_space_whale_weapon_1_desc$. This technology will doubtlessly prove useful.

origin.7100.desc.zh:
我们为星系的太空生物群建造了一座花园。我们让其中开满了鲜花，结满了果实和黏性的种荚，时刻准备着附着在这些令人惊叹的生物的皮肤上。但这些深居虚空的生灵们会出席我们的盛宴吗？当他们咬下第一口果实时，所有的担忧便已烟消云散。

从记事起，我们就已经在自己的星球上为各种动物提供果实与荫蔽。作为回报，它们替我们携带种子。如今，这一古老的契约被翻印到了星系的尺度上：太空生物将携带着我们的种荚一同旅行。只要运气尚佳，我们的种子将会落在一颗可殖民行星上，并找到为我们的人民建造一座新花园所需的一切。我们只需要引导一道能量束将他们激活，就可以让我们无需派遣殖民船便可以定居到新的行星上。
origin.7100.desc.en:
For the galaxy's spaceborne fauna, we built a garden. We filled it with flowers, fruit and sticky seed pods, ready to latch to the skin of these magnificent creatures. But would these void-dwellers appreciate our banquet? As soon as they bit the first apple, our anxiety dissipated.

Since time immemorial, we have offered fruit and shade to the animals on our planet. In return, they carried our seeds. Now, this ancient pact has been replicated at a galactic scale: spaceborne fauna will carry our Seed Pods with them as they travel. With a little luck, our seeds will fall on a colonizable planet where they will have everything they need to establish a new garden for our people. We need only direct an energy beam to activate them, allowing us to inhabit new planets without having to send a colony ship.

origin.7201.desc.zh: 我们在[this.GetName]的殖民地正在被超授粉的种子球轰炸。森林在世界各地快速增生，地面撕裂、建筑倒毁，[this.GetPlanetHabitat]上现在到处都是迅速生长的外星植物。
origin.7201.desc.en: Our colony on [this.GetName] is being bombarded with hyper-fertilized balls of seeds. New forests are sprouting everywhere, cracking floors, ruining buildings and filling the [this.GetPlanetHabitat] with rapid-growing xenoflora.

origin.7304.desc.zh:
太空兽群虽然能帮我们散播种荚，但还是不如最近加入舰队的新成员来得靠谱。

我们的星种花园会给麾下的生物分发种子，然后我们就能直接派它们前往适合殖民的星球，在那里开辟出新的花园。
origin.7304.desc.en:
Though we can rely on wild space fauna to spread our Seed Pods, we can do so more reliably with those who have recently joined our fleets.

Our Starseed Gardens will distribute seeds to creatures within our fold, whom we can then send directly to colonizable planets to establish a new garden.

origin.7321.desc.zh: 我们打开了在[from.GetName]的种荚，新生的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始生根发芽。
origin.7321.desc.en: Our Seed Pod on [from.GetName] opened, and the newly born [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun to dig roots.

origin.7326.desc.knowowner.zh:
$origin.7326.desc.base$

根据我们的基因分析，这些生长快速的基因工程种子是由[seeds_owner.GetName]研发的。
origin.7326.desc.knowowner.en:
$origin.7326.desc.base$

According to our genetic analysis, these fast-growing, bio-engineered seeds have been developed by the [seeds_owner.GetName].

origin.7326.desc.notknowowner.zh: $origin.7326.desc.base$。我们的科学家无法分析这些种子的来源，但可以肯定一点：它们一定是经过人工基因修饰的，可以在外星土壤上快速扎根。
origin.7326.desc.notknowowner.en: $origin.7326.desc.base$. Our scientists have been unable to determine the origin of the seeds, but one thing is certain: they are artificial in nature, bio-engineered to quickly take root in alien soil.

origin.7327.desc.knowowner.zh:
$origin.7326.desc.base$

据基因分析，这些特别的种子是由[seeds_owner.GetName]研发的。
origin.7327.desc.knowowner.en:
$origin.7326.desc.base$

According to our genetic analysis, these unusual seeds have been developed by the [seeds_owner.GetName].

origin.7327.desc.notknowowner.zh:
$origin.7326.desc.base$

得益于这些种荚中的通讯系统，我们可以很快与这些种子的发源地帝国建立联络。
origin.7327.desc.notknowowner.en:
$origin.7326.desc.base$

Thanks to the communication system in the seed pods, we were able to quickly establish contact with the empire the seed germinated from.

origin.7328.desc.zh:
我们的殖民船刚刚着陆于[from.GetName]，但我们休眠的人民早已深深扎根在土壤中了。种荚中所附带的额外[root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和资源将有助于我们在这颗星球上的殖民地发展。

祝愿他们根深叶茂。
origin.7328.desc.en:
Our colony ship just landed [from.GetName], but our people were already there, lying dormant in the soil. The additional [root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and resources contained in the Seed Pod will help our colonists develop the planet.

May their roots spread far and wide.

origin.7400.desc.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的遥远[owner.GetColonistPlural]在恒星附近部署了一座$starbase_outpost$，从而获得了[Root.GetStarName]恒星系的控制权。
origin.7400.desc.en: Our distant [owner.GetColonistPlural] on [Root.GetName] deployed an $starbase_outpost$ around the star, gaining control of the [Root.GetStarName] system.

origin.75.2.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的条件正迅速变得不可忍受。大多数幸存的子个体都集中在少数尚余的基建中心中，这些中心是巨型的防风暴庇护所，足以抵御从未缓和的灰烬侵袭。但即使是行星上这些文明的最后堡垒也不会存在太久了。毁灭性的地震仍在持续，千百座活火山喷发着硫磺和熔岩。

在行星地壳碎裂的同时，更多有价值的资源也从地幔涌到了地表，任何剩余的尚能运转的工业均可对这些资源进行加工。
origin.75.2.desc.en:
Conditions on [Root.GetName] are rapidly becoming unbearable. Most of the remaining drones are clustered around the few surviving centers of infrastructure that now serve as massive, fortified storm shelters against the unrelenting ash. But even these last few bastions of our civilization on the planet will not survive for long. The devastating earthquakes continue while hundreds of active volcanoes are spewing sulfur and lava.

With the planet's crust disintegrating, more valuable resources have been ejected from the mantle to the surface, where they can be worked by whatever functional industry still remains.

origin.75.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的条件正迅速变得不可忍受。大多数幸存的人口都集中在少数尚余的城市中，这些城市是巨型的防风暴庇护所，足以抵御从不减弱的灰尘的侵袭。但即使是这些文明的最后据点也不会存在太久了。毁灭性的地震仍在持续，千百座活火山喷发着硫磺和熔岩。

在行星地壳碎裂的同时，更多有价值的资源也从地幔涌到了地表，任何剩余的尚能运转的工业均可对这些资源进行加工。
origin.75.desc.en:
Conditions on [Root.GetName] are rapidly becoming unbearable. Most of the remaining population are clustered around the few surviving cities that now serve as massive, fortified storm shelters against the unrelenting ash. But even these last few bastions of civilization on the planet will not survive for long. The devastating earthquakes continue while hundreds of active volcanoes are spewing sulfur and lava.

With the planet's crust disintegrating, more valuable resources have been ejected from the mantle to the surface, where they can be worked by whatever functional industry still remains.

origin.7500.desc.zh: 我们与太空生物的关系相当独特，但我们并不是唯一尊重它们生存权的人。星海共同体刚刚通过的一项议案将有助于保护这些奇妙生物。
origin.7500.desc.en: Our relationship with spaceborne creatures is fairly unique, but we are not alone in respecting their right to exist; a resolution that has just passed in the Galactic Community will help protect the lives of these wondrous creatures.

origin.7510.desc.zh: 太空生物一直是我们的朋友，但并非所有的星海共同体成员都像我们一样热爱这些太空生物。他们刚刚通过的决议将我们的朋友——以及我们自己——的生命置于危险之中。
origin.7510.desc.en: Spaceborne creatures have always be our friends, but not all members of the Galactic Community share our love for the void-dwellers. The resolution they just passed puts the livelihood of our friends - and ours - at a risk.

origin.76.2.desc.zh:
不剩多久了。[Root.GetName]已经开始经历它最后的、灾难性的痉挛，这将最终彻底毁灭这颗行星。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]预计末日会在一年内到来。

对还困在行星表面的可怜人来说，时间已经所剩无几…
origin.76.2.desc.en:
It will not be long now. [Root.GetName] is beginning to experience the final cataclysmic convulsions that will result in its utter destruction. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] predict that the end will come in less than a year.

Very little time remains for the poor drones still trapped on the planet's surface...

origin.76.desc.zh:
不剩多久了。[Root.GetName]已经开始经历它最后的、灾难性的痉挛，这将最终彻底毁灭这颗行星。我们的科学家预计末日会在一年内到来。

对还困在行星表面的可怜人来说，时间已经所剩无几…
origin.76.desc.en:
It will not be long now. [Root.GetName] is beginning to experience the final cataclysmic convulsions that will result in its utter destruction. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] predict that the end will come in less than a year.

Very little time remains for the poor souls still trapped on the planet's surface...

origin.7600.desc.zh:
我们的敌人认为我们会屈服于他们的力量，就像被风吹倒的芦苇一样。他们忘记了植物有刺。

我们的士兵睡在他们的土地上。如果有需要，我们可以将我们的外星入侵植物转变为陆军，保护我们的一切，扼杀他们所谓的他们拥有的东西。我们只需将能量束引导到指定的行星即可开始我们的入侵行动。
origin.7600.desc.en:
Our enemies think we will bend to their strength, like reeds blown down by the wind. They forget that plants have thorns.

Our soldiers sleep in their ground. Should the need arise, we can turn our Invasive Xenoflora into armies, to protect what is ours and to strangle what they call their own. We need only to direct an energy beam to the desired planet in order to begin our invasion.

origin.7710.desc.zh: [from.GetName]上的外星入侵植物突然长出肢体变成了一支军队。这颗行星正在遭到攻击！
origin.7710.desc.en: The Invasive Xenoflora on [from.GetName] suddenly sprouted limbs, turning into an army. The planet is under attack!

origin.80.5.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]爆炸了！或许殖民这样一颗地质结构不稳定的行星是个糟主意…它被抛弃肯定是有原因的。
origin.80.5.desc.en: [Root.GetName] just exploded! Perhaps colonizing such a tectonically unstable planet was a bad idea... it must have been abandoned for a reason.

origin.81.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

尽管看着行星毁灭令人伤感，我们大可放心了事，因为我们知道整个行星已经被成功疏散——这本身就是一次辉煌的壮举。

现在是时候重建失去的东西了。如果国家真的兴于忧患，那我们忍受过的试炼一定已让我们变得更为强大。
origin.81.desc.en:
[From.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

As sad as it was to witness its end, we can rest easy in the knowledge that the entire planet was successfully evacuated - a monumental achievement in itself.

It is now time to rebuild that which was lost. If adversity brings strength, then surely we are stronger for the trials we have endured.

origin.85.1.desc.zh:
第一批殖民者抵达了[Root.GetName]表面，许多人陷入了情不自禁的狂喜。[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]之外还存在足以支持[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]生存的行星一直是个理论上的可能性，但如果它们极为罕见呢？如果整个星系里都找不到一个呢？又或着假如已经被他人占据该怎么办呢？

这些恐惧现在可以安息了——[Root.GetName]是一颗[Root.GetPlanetMoon]，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以在此繁荣昌盛。这些幸运的初始殖民者只是开始，还有不计其数的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被困在我们那在劫难逃的母星之上。
origin.85.1.desc.en:
As the first colonists arrive on the surface of [Root.GetName], many are overcome with a sense of euphoria. Worlds other than [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] that are capable of supporting [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] life had always been a theoretical possibility, but what if they were exceedingly rare? What if none could be found in our galaxy, or if they had already been claimed by others?

Those fears can be put to rest now - [Root.GetName] is a [Root.GetPlanetMoon] where [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can thrive. These fortunate groups of initial colonists are a start, but countless [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are still trapped on our doomed homeworld.

origin.85.2.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]按[Root.OWner.GetSpeciesName]的标准来看荒凉又令人不适，但它相对于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]确实有一个显著的优势—它并不会爆炸。

我们在挣扎中求生，如果这意味着[Root.GetName]需要成为我们的新家园，那就这么办。它会成为安全的避风港，至少直到更好的候选行星被找到为止。尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面条件严酷，殖民者们仍然是幸运儿。不计其数的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被困在我们那在劫难逃的母星之上。
origin.85.2.desc.en:
[Root.GetName] is a bleak and unpleasant world by [Root.OWner.GetSpeciesName] standards, but it does have one significant advantage over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] - it is not about to blow up.

This is a struggle for survival, and if that means that [Root.GetName] is to be our new home, then so be it. It shall serve as a safe haven, at the very least until better planetary candidates are found. Despite the harsh conditions on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, the colonists are the lucky ones. Countless [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are still trapped on our doomed homeworld.

origin.85.3.desc.zh:
送到[Root.GetName]的第一个子个体成功地殖民了这颗行星，说明这个新环境能够支持我们集体的生存。我们帝国如今将得以续存：只要我们中的一个活着，我们的集体就会继续存在。

尽管不是必要的，取回那些仍囚禁在注定灭亡的母星上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将会非常方便。这些子个体可以进一步发展我们新的家园，将他们遗弃相当浪费。
origin.85.3.desc.en:
The first drones sent to [Root.GetName] have successfully colonized the planet, proving the new environment suitable for our collective survival. The continued existence of our empire is now assured: as long as one of us lives, our collective will survive.

Though not essential, it would be convenient to retrieve the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] still trapped on our doomed homeworld. It would be wasteful to abandon drones that could be used to further develop our new home.

origin_111.tooltip.zh:
在[Root.Capital.GetName]上解锁$decision_unshackled_memorial$决议。
$decision_unshackled_memorial_effects$
—$district_crashed_slaver_ship_plural$将提供[clerk.GetIcon][clerk.GetNamePlural]岗位以替代£job_broken_shackles_scavenger£$job_broken_shackles_scavenger$岗位。
origin_111.tooltip.en:
Unlocks the $decision_unshackled_memorial$ decision on [Root.Capital.GetName].
$decision_unshackled_memorial_effects$
- The $district_crashed_slaver_ship_plural$ will now provide [clerk.GetIcon] [clerk.GetNamePlural] Jobs instead of £job_broken_shackles_scavenger£ $job_broken_shackles_scavenger$ Jobs.

origin_70.a.zh: 这颗行星无法支持生命太久了。
origin_70.a.en: The planet will not support life much longer.

origin_70.b.zh: 子个体集群很快就无法继续在这颗行星上工作了。
origin_70.b.en: Drone units cannot operate on the planet much longer.

origin_70.c.zh: 立即建造方舟！我们必须逃离，奔向星海！
origin_70.c.en: Begin Arkship construction. We must take to the stars.

origin_70.c.tooltip.zh: 动员所有[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的工业力量建造£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']，解锁['concept_arkship_embark']选项，将那注定湮灭的母星抛诸身后，以£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire']之姿于群星间续写文明的篇章。
origin_70.c.tooltip.en: Mobilize the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] industries to build an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] and unlock the option to ['concept_arkship_embark'], leaving our doomed homeworld behind to live among the stars as a £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire'].

origin_80.a.zh: 或许这已经是最好的结果。
origin_80.a.en: Perhaps it was for the best.

origin_80.b.zh: 或许我们本可做到更多……
origin_80.b.en: Perhaps we could have done more...

origin_80.c.zh: 我们会记住那些失去的人们的。
origin_80.c.en: Those we lost will be remembered.

origin_arc_welders_desc.zh:
他们的行星一片荒芜，但母星系却堆金积玉。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$已经遮天蔽日，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。

星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。
origin_arc_welders_desc.en:
Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$ now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.

The galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.

origin_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 这颗小行星的成分与周围的小行星大不相同。它的起源可能与小行星带上的其他小行星截然不同，应该进行更进一步的研究。
origin_asteroid_category_desc.en: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.

origin_broken_shackles_desc.zh:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$
这个文明始于一艘奴隶船上的发起的兵变，现在由多种多样的前超光速物种组成。
origin_broken_shackles_desc.en:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$
This civilization began as a mutiny aboard a slaver vessel, and is made up of a diverse group of pre-FTL species.

origin_clone_army_desc.zh: 一种寿命短且不能生育的克隆人士兵，在战争方面异常精通，现在他们没有主人，亦不了解自己被设计出来的目的，以及他们那不确定的命运。
origin_clone_army_desc.en: A species of short-lived and infertile soldier clones exceptionally proficient in matters of war, left masterless and alone to question their engineered purpose and uncertain fate.

origin_common_ground_desc.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
origin_common_ground_desc.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

origin_cosmic_dawn_desc.zh: 这不是一个崛起的文明，而是一个被释放的文明。当休眠仓开启，他们醒来时，早已物换星移，故土难寻。但他们的过去并未湮灭，而是埋藏在星系尘土与废墟之下，静候再次被发掘。
origin_cosmic_dawn_desc.en: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

origin_cybernetic_creed_desc.zh:
警告：禁用除['concept_cybernetic_ascension']以外的所有飞升天赋。

这个帝国追求一种神圣的使命，即高尚身体与神圣的义体技术的融合。强化改造便是一种崇拜。
origin_cybernetic_creed_desc.en:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_cybernetic_ascension'].

This empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.

origin_default_desc.zh: 通过斗争和胜利，这个社会已经实现了每一个年轻文明的抱负：一个有着统一目标的家园，一条通向璀璨繁星的道路。
origin_default_desc.en: Through its strife and triumphs, this society has reached every young civilization's ambition: a homeworld with unified goals, and a path open to the stars.

origin_default_nomads_desc.zh: 对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。
origin_default_nomads_desc.en: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

origin_demonic_incursion_desc.zh: 有一位腐坏的先锋领导，该帝国从一个次元传送门涌出，决定要摧毁这个次元。
origin_demonic_incursion_desc.en: Lead by a corrupted champion, this empire emerged from a dimensional portal and has vowed to lay waste to this reality.

origin_doomsday_desc.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这一文明的母星高度不稳定，走向爆炸只是时间问题。他们唯一的希望是在为时太晚前在其他地方寻觅到避难之处。
origin_doomsday_desc.en:
WARNING: Challenging Origin
This civilization's homeworld is highly unstable, and it is only a matter of time before it explodes. Their only hope is to seek refuge elsewhere before it is too late.

origin_endbringers_desc.zh:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有飞升路线。

该文明长久以来都一直沉迷于一场将邻近的星球变成荒凉的虚境星球的神秘灾难。如今他们初涉星海，终于得以一探究竟，以及确定是否会有相似的命运降临在自己头上。
origin_endbringers_desc.en:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can finally explore its secrets and find out if a similar fate awaits them too.

origin_evolutionary_predators_desc.zh:
警告：禁用除['concept_mutation_ascension']以外的所有飞升路线。

该物种受自己都无法完全理解的直觉所驱使着，永远都在追猎最独特的生物。他们独有能整合猎物基因的能力，因此演化成了母星上最顶级的猎手，应有尽有地吸收了所有的优势基因。如今，这种渴望又将他们带向了群星。
origin_evolutionary_predators_desc.en:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_mutation_ascension'].

This species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage available. Now, their hunger leads them to the stars.

origin_fear_of_the_dark_desc.zh: 一个世纪以前，在帝国的母星系，其中的一颗行星被一颗古怪的小行星摧毁了。一些人认为这是某个外星物种的恶意攻击。其他人则把这些担忧当作纯粹的妄想症。两类人之间的关系变得愈发紧张，最后无可奈何之下，帝国将一个新近完成地形改造的星球给予这些恐宇派。
origin_fear_of_the_dark_desc.en: A century ago, one of the planets in this empire's home system was destroyed by a freak asteroid. Some believed this was a malicious attack by an alien species. Others brushed off these concerns as mere paranoia. The tension between the two groups grew so great that a newly-terraformed planet was granted to the fearmongers.

origin_forever_cruise_desc.zh:
$cannot_settle$
这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。
origin_forever_cruise_desc.en:
$cannot_settle$
The Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

origin_fruitful_desc.zh: 这个郁郁葱葱的文明与太空生物群形成了独特的协同作用。通过向这些生物提供果实，他们吸引种子传播者来帮助它们进行殖民。
origin_fruitful_desc.en: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.

origin_galactic_doorstep_desc.zh: 这一文明在它们的家园星系有一座休眠状态的星门——是潜在的科技优势，抑或是高悬头顶的达摩克里利斯之剑？
origin_galactic_doorstep_desc.en: This civilization has a dormant Gateway in their home system - potential technological benefit, or a looming menace?

origin_hegemon_desc.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。经过他们在长达一个世纪的时间里的逐步策划，一个他们于其中具有支配地位的星际联盟就此诞生。
origin_hegemon_desc.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they masterminded the birth of an interstellar union in which they would have a dominant role.

origin_heirs_of_the_khan_desc.zh:
$cannot_settle$
这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
origin_heirs_of_the_khan_desc.en:
$cannot_settle$
Once the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

origin_here_be_dragons_desc.zh: 自远古以来，这个文明就与一条强大的龙共享同一恒星系。这个神秘生物的行为在冷淡的仁慈和傲慢的漠视之间摇摆不定。随着行星居民迈入星辰大海，这种关系将如何演变还有待观察。
origin_here_be_dragons_desc.en: Since time immemorial, this civilization has shared its star system with a formidable dragon. The mysterious creature's behavior sways between distant benevolence and haughty indifference. How this relationship will evolve as the planet dwellers take to the stars remains to be seen.

origin_imperial_vassal_desc.zh: 第一次飞出母星的经历是一段痛苦的回忆，一眨眼的功夫，我们就惨遭征服并跪倒在其脚下。不过现在我们终于得以展望未来，一个不必处在他国阴影之下的未来。
origin_imperial_vassal_desc.en: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.

origin_legendary_leader_desc.zh: 在暴力和苦难中，这个文明在一位领袖的领导下走向了统一。通过压制较弱的派系来巩固权力，他们现在成为了科学和技术进步的坚定倡导者。在这之后，是一段不稳定的和平的时期。但和平终究是一种短暂的状态。
origin_legendary_leader_desc.en: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.

origin_life_seeded_desc.zh: 这一文明的家园如同天堂，也许是专为他们打造的。
origin_life_seeded_desc.en: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

origin_lithoid_desc.zh: 并非其“母星”的原住民，这些石质生物随一颗坠入该行星的陨石到来，同时杀死了大多数土著生命。
origin_lithoid_desc.en: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.

origin_lost_colony_desc.zh: 这一文明起源于一处遭人遗忘的失落的殖民星，许久前便同其母星分隔。殖民者们挣扎求生，挨过了千辛万苦，终于建立了必需的技术及工业基础，足以供他们重返太空。
origin_lost_colony_desc.en: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to space.

origin_machine_desc.zh: 这一机械智能早已将母星系中的所有资源统合到了他们的首都星球，将其完全以机械覆盖。
origin_machine_desc.en: This Machine Intelligence has long-since consolidated all resources in their home system into their capital world, covering it entirely with machinery.

origin_mechanists_desc.zh: 这一文明自蒸汽时代早期便醉心于金属制自动机器人的理念。尽管许多人认为不可能做到，早在初步的太空航行前第一台真正的机器人就已从装配线下线。
origin_mechanists_desc.en: This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

origin_mindwardens_desc.zh:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$警告：禁用['concept_psionic_ascension']。

这个文明的祖先受到入侵心灵的超自然力量的困扰，这促使他们投入巨量人力物力来开发反灵能技术。

他们的古老装置仍然可以使用，但尚未对来自星系更远处的灵能威胁进行测试。
origin_mindwardens_desc.en:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$WARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.

origin_necrophage_desc.zh: 这一文明演化出了一种异养于其他智慧生命形态的寄生体。当它踏入星系舞台时，其他的物种或是被视作侍徒而带入他们的行列，要么就成为他们的食物。在食尸者面前，没有第三种选择。
origin_necrophage_desc.en: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.

origin_ocean_paradise_desc.zh: 自这个文明诞生伊始他们就享受着物产丰富、无忧无虑的环境，使其能够不受阻碍地发展繁荣。
origin_ocean_paradise_desc.en: Since its birth, this civilization has enjoyed peace in a generous environment with no natural enemies, enabling unhindered growth and opulence.

origin_overtuned_desc.zh: 这个文明不择手段地增强自己的有机体，无论风险，无论成本。毕竟，与其在沉默中消亡，不如光鲜亮丽地燃烧殆尽。
origin_overtuned_desc.en: This civilization uses any and all means of organic enhancement, no matter the risk, no matter the cost. After all, it is better to burn out brightly than fade away into obscurity.

origin_payback_desc.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这个文明曾被一个异星帝国造访过，这个帝国强行启蒙了他们，之后奴役了他们。如今他们击退了入侵者，但那些入侵者有朝一日还会回来吗？
origin_payback_desc.en:
WARNING: Challenging Origin
This civilization has been visited by an alien empire who forcibly enlightened and enslaved them. They have repelled their invaders, but will they return?

origin_post_apocalyptic_desc.zh: 历经核子烈焰的考验，这一文明曾面临全面灭绝的威胁——又最终死里逃生。虽经毁灭却仍为一体，他们在旧世界的灰烬之上重建了文明。
origin_post_apocalyptic_desc.en: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.

origin_primal_calling_desc.zh:
草叶婆娑，夜静如尖啸。猎户之志，冷锐如星光。

这个文明与荒野有着原始的联系。他们把自己看作是当地各种致命野生动物的管家，现在又把目光投向了苍穹。他们善于管理和牧养动物，这种与动物群的联系是根据他们的思潮发展起来的。而这种联系将如何在星系尺度上演变还有待观察。
origin_primal_calling_desc.en:
The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...

This civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to their world, they now turn their gaze skyward. Masters of animal handling and ranching, this relationship with fauna has developed according to their ethics. How this bond will evolve on a galactic scale remains to be seen.

origin_progenitor_hive_desc.zh: 该蜂巢通过专职化的半独立领袖获得了进化优势。尽管这些“子嗣”需要持续受到监管，但它们还是大大提高了整体的效率。
origin_progenitor_hive_desc.en: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.

origin_red_giant_desc.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
origin_red_giant_desc.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?

origin_remnants_desc.zh: 这一文明曾经叱咤虚空，掌控大片星海。他们最终败落并几乎被摧毁殆尽，但在漫长的穷困潦倒后他们正要于群星间东山再起。
origin_remnants_desc.en: This civilization once spanned the void, controlling much of the galaxy. They were eventually defeated and almost destroyed, but after a long period of destitution they are returning to the stars.

origin_riftworld_desc.zh: 一道巨大的时空裂隙高悬于该文明母星的穹顶。在研究这一现象近千年后，最近的星舰科技进展使其终于可以靠近他，并且发掘潜藏其中的秘密。
origin_riftworld_desc.en: A massive rift in space and time looms near this civilization's homeworld. After studying the phenomenon for millennia, recent advances in starship technology will allow them to finally reach out and discover what secrets it might hold.

origin_sacred_path_desc.zh:
$cannot_settle$
这些游牧的唯心主义者遵循其祖先圣典的指引，穿梭于一条神圣化的路线。随着技术的进步以及对星系理解的演变，朝圣之旅是否仍将是他们的使命所在？
origin_sacred_path_desc.en:
$cannot_settle$
These nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

origin_scion_desc.zh: 一个失落帝国在数千年间干预了这一文明的发展进程，引领他们走上了失落帝国所选择的道路。
origin_scion_desc.en: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.

origin_separatists_desc.zh: 这个文明形成于针对另一个帝国的反叛与分裂。
origin_separatists_desc.en: This civilization came into being when it rebelled and seceded from another empire.

origin_shattered_ring_desc.zh: 这一文明生活在未知先驱们建造的环形世界之中。一经理解及修复完好，他们将获得巨大的力量。
origin_shattered_ring_desc.en: This civilization inhabits a Ring World built by unknown forerunners. If it can be understood and fully repaired it will grant them great power.

origin_shoulders_of_giants_desc.zh: 在不知名的过去，有一位神秘的施恩者为这个文明在他们的恒星系藏了一点惊喜。
origin_shoulders_of_giants_desc.en: This civilization has hidden boons in their solar system, placed there in a distant past by a mysterious benefactor.

origin_shroud_forged_desc.zh: 虚境实体的引导是有代价的。独立的自动机开始在这个网络社会中自由运行。从$auth_machine_intelligence$中脱离后，这些单位的需求正在与日俱增。
origin_shroud_forged_desc.en: The guidance of a Shroud entity comes with a cost. Independent automata have started to operate freely among this networked society. Cut off from the $auth_machine_intelligence$, the demands of these units are ever-increasing.

origin_shroudwalker_apprentice_desc.zh:
警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有的飞升路线。

早在他们踏入星系舞台之前，他们的文明就受到了虚境行者集会的支持和塑造成型。
origin_shroudwalker_apprentice_desc.en:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

Long before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.

origin_star_slingshot_desc.zh: 曾几何时，该文明的天空短暂地被流星所照亮，紧接着就陷入了长久的黑暗。此后他们试图冲出天际以寻求答案，并在第一次太空征程中发现了一座休眠中（并且早已被遗弃）的$quantum_catapult_1$。
origin_star_slingshot_desc.en: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) $quantum_catapult_1$.

origin_starlit_citadel_desc.zh: 该文明的母星系边缘，一个神秘的传送门赫然耸立，危险的实体从中汨汨涌出。这些入侵者不请自来，让人无处可避，迫使人们只能仰依赖他们最杰出的科技杰作——$dsc_name$。
origin_starlit_citadel_desc.en: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological triumph - the $dsc_name$.

origin_storm_chasers_desc.zh:
没有他们不敢面对的挑战，没有他们不愿追逐的线索，也没有他们会视若罔闻的风暴。

从本质上来说，这是一个追求刺激的文明。即有好处也有坏处。
origin_storm_chasers_desc.en:
There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.

At its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.

origin_subterranean_desc.zh: 这个物种也许永远也不会知道自己的祖先为什么会迁移到地表以下。这究竟是出于一种自我保存的必要，或是为了追寻资源的富足？不管其目的为何，他们都成功地适应了环境，造就了一个对环境要求更加灵活的社会。
origin_subterranean_desc.en: This civilization may never know why their ancestors migrated below the surface. Was it necessary to ensure self-preservation, or did the promise of bountiful resources allure them? Whatever the case, they successfully adapted, leading to a more environmentally versatile community.

origin_syncretic_evolution_desc.zh: 一种第二物种形成了这个文明密不可分的一部分。它们高大健壮，又大都只有相当于格外愚钝的孩童的智力。古老的战争剔除了它们物种具有的最富攻击性的倾向，使其如今相当顺从。
origin_syncretic_evolution_desc.en: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.

origin_synthetic_fertility_desc.zh:
警告：禁用除['concept_synthetic_ascension']以外的所有飞升路线。

这个物种曾有一个繁荣的社会，但是由于一种新型遗传病让其无法再生育。在灭族的命运面前，人们没有其他的选择，只能寄希望于数字化的救赎。
origin_synthetic_fertility_desc.en:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_synthetic_ascension'].

Once a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

origin_toxic_knights_desc.zh: 几个世纪前，这个物种的母星被一位毒性神祗造访。接踵而至的生态灾难几乎摧毁了这个星球，但是幸存者们怀着对毒圣的崇敬之情，草草地统一了起来。他们创立了一个骑士教团来搜寻毒圣，尽管后来很多事情变了，但是这份试炼依旧保留了下来。
origin_toxic_knights_desc.en: Centuries ago, this species' homeworld was visited by a Toxic Entity. The ecological catastrophe that followed ruined half the world, but allowed an early unification of the survivors in their reverence for the Toxic God. An Order of Knights has been created to search for the Toxic God, and although many things have changed, the quest continues.

origin_treasure_hunters_desc.zh: 怀揣着对冒险的渴望，这个文明已经准备好踏上他们最伟大、最具挑战性的探险之旅。他们只手持一张神秘的地图，现在正跨越星辰，去争夺传说中的海盗宝藏。
origin_treasure_hunters_desc.en: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

origin_tree_of_life_desc.zh: 这一蜂巢思维与一棵巨型树木间进化出了共生关系。这棵巨树赋予了他们许多益处，但失去这棵树将会把他们摧垮。
origin_tree_of_life_desc.en: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.

origin_unplugged_desc.zh:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$
与同化他们的机器被切断联系之后，这个新生的文明为了在星系中确立自身地位而进行了顽强的斗争。
origin_unplugged_desc.en:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$
Abruptly severed from the Machine that assimilated them, this nascent civilization has fought fiercely to establish its own presence in the galaxy.

origin_void_dwellers_desc.zh: 这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。
origin_void_dwellers_desc.en: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

origin_wilderness_desc.zh:
警告：禁用除了 ['concept_purity_ascension']以外的所有飞升路径。

这个实体无异于一个拥有智慧的生态圈：众多不同的生命形式早已融合成一个行星尺度的格式塔意识。
origin_wilderness_desc.en:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_purity_ascension'].

This entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

outgassing_category_desc.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的例行扫描发现大气中存在异常强烈的化学波动。深入调查或能揭示真相。
outgassing_category_desc.en: A routine scan of [Planet.GetName] noted unusually strong chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere. A closer survey may explain what is happening here.

ouwron_desc.zh: 由于亲自见证了$end_of_the_cycle_article$，奥伏戎被逐出自己所出身的流浪氏族，自此在星际间漂泊，寻求命运的眷顾。如今，随着$NAME_Reckoning$的临近，此人燃起炽热的目标，誓不罢休。
ouwron_desc.en: Exiled from their nomadic clan after bearing witness to $end_of_the_cycle_article$, Ouw'ron has wandered the stars in search of its favor. Now, with the $NAME_Reckoning$ on the horizon, they burn with purpose, and they will not be denied

over.1.desc.zh: 我们的$quantum_catapult_3$的第一阶段已经完工。精确的扭力透镜装置正在从恒星中充能，这些能量可以剧烈地释放出来，将舰船传送至极远距离外。
over.1.desc.en: The first stage of our $quantum_catapult_3$ is now complete. A precise arrangement of torsion lenses gains charge from the star, and can release this energy in an erratic fashion to send ships across great distances.

over.10.desc.zh: 对$quantum_catapult_3$的最终精校完成，并且现在已完全上线运作。射程和准确度得到进一步改善。
over.10.desc.en: The final refinements have been made to the $quantum_catapult_3$ and it is now fully online. Both range and accuracy have been improved.

over.100.a.zh: 这是值得所有人自豪的一天。

over.100.a.desc.zh:
大功告成了。今天，我们骄傲地向星系交出我们最伟大的成绩单：我们的超空间中继器网道与我们的亲密友邦[from.GetName]紧紧相连了起来。

在[root.GetName]各地都在举行盛大的庆典，一致宣布这个我们共同引以为豪的新网道。据说就在此刻，我们冰释一切前嫌；放下了一切傲慢与成见。我们期盼在未来的日子里能够继续共享这份骄傲和与豪情。通过亲密无间的协作，我们打破了曾经一度认为不可逾越的壁垒，开启了友谊、共荣的新时代。
over.100.a.desc.en:
It is done. Today, we present the galaxy with one of our grandest accomplishments yet: the joining of our Hyper Relay network with that of our friends, the [from.GetName].

Lavish ceremonies have been held throughout the [root.GetName], unanimously heralding this proud new link we share. It is said that for the moment, all petty jealousies have been forgotten; all apathies and indifferences cast aside. Blended with this sense of pride and ambition is a shared confidence in the days to come. Working side by side we have torn down a barrier we once thought insurmountable, ushering in a new age of mutual prosperity and friendship.

over.100.b.desc.zh:
今天，我们将自己深深铭刻在了星系无与伦比的辉煌历史当中。随着我们超空间中继器网道与[from.GetName]网道的全线贯通，我们的公民现在可以毫无阻碍地前往那些邻近的恒星系。

另一方面，[from.GetAdj]也热烈接纳我们[root.GetAdj]的影响力。相信用以塑造我们自己灿烂辉煌恒星系的文化也能让他们从中收益。
over.100.b.desc.en:
Today we have etched ourselves further into a record of unparalleled galactic splendor. With the linking of our Hyper Relay network to that of the [from.GetName], our citizens may now venture into those neighboring systems without let or hindrance.

The [from.GetAdj], in turn, now welcome the embrace of our rich [root.GetAdj] influence. They too shall benefit from the bounteous culture which defines our own, magnificent star systems.

over.100.c.desc.zh:
今天，对我们而言星系中的阻碍又少了一个，我们与[from.GetName]的合作已经取得了丰硕的成果。与我们相邻超空间中继网道中的最后一个链接已经上线，从此双方可以便捷地通过彼此的边境。

出现在我们面前的是通往未知的旅程，因为这一架构会带来的一切机遇与挑战对我们和[from.GetName]都是等同的。我们将拭目以待，我们的邻国是如何看待这个相互信任的象征。
over.100.c.desc.en:
The galaxy presents one less hurdle to us today, as our co-operative effort with the [from.GetName] has reached a fruitful conclusion. The last link in our adjoining Hyper Relay networks has been brought online, inviting both partners into rapid transit across our shared border.

What awaits us now is a journey into the unknown, for every aspect of this arrangement - positive or negative - applies equally to us and the [from.GetName]. We shall see how well our neighbors hold to this symbol of mutual trust.

over.20.a.zh: 想象一下我们拥有两个量子弹弓的情景！

over.20.a.desc.zh:
在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场。我们的科学家分析称，在残骸场内部最密集的区域所残存的部分完整结构似乎通过某种方式驾驭了恒星的力量，有将物体传送至极远距离的能力。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识，我们将能够修复这座$quantum_catapult_3$。
over.20.a.desc.en:
A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system. Our scientists theorize that the partially intact structure in the densest portion of the field somehow harnessed the power of the star to launch objects incredible distances.

If we developed the knowledge to work on great megastructures, we could repair this $quantum_catapult_3$.

over.20.b.desc.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场，其核心的结构与我们的$quantum_catapult_3$设计相似。经过彻底维修我们能够使其恢复运转。
over.20.b.desc.en: A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system - the structure in the center is similar to that of our own $quantum_catapult_3$ designs. With extensive repairs, we could return it to service.

over.25.a.desc.zh: $over.25.desc$我们对它的科技有了全新的理解，在经过几轮测试之后，我们有信心能够安全地使用。
over.25.a.desc.en: $over.25.desc$ We have developed a new understanding of its technology, and after a few test runs, we feel confident that we can use it safely.

over.25.desc.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系内的$quantum_catapult_ruined$已被修复到可以运作的状态，现已能传送我们的舰队跨过星海。
over.25.desc.en: The $quantum_catapult_ruined$ in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system has been restored to operational status, and can now transport our fleets across the stars.

over.5.desc.zh: $quantum_catapult_3$的第二个扭力透镜装置已经就位，并同第一个装置进行了平衡。射程和准确度都提高了。
over.5.desc.en: A second arrangement of $quantum_catapult_3$ torsion lenses is now in position, diametrically balancing the first. Range and accuracy are increased.

over.50.desc.zh: 对从[yuhtaan.GetName]星系取回的数据进行进一步分析发现，在其背景噪音中存在一个微妙的能量模式，源自小行星[jabbardeeni_cache.GetName]。
over.50.desc.en: Further analysis of the data recovered from the [yuhtaan.GetName] system has revealed a subtle repeating energy pattern hidden in the background noise, coming from the asteroid [jabbardeeni_cache.GetName].

over.60.desc.zh:
一座历史可追溯回尤特-贾巴蒂尼大战时代的小型监听哨站，它在开战后不久就由贾巴蒂尼人建造，用来观测[yuhtaan.GetName]，以防尤特人返回他们的母星系，而在这个小行星的内部深处暗藏着大量数据缓存。

在随后的数个世纪中，贾巴蒂尼人又将这个哨站改建成了一个用于进行他们在超光速航行中最新实验的测试场所。尽管这些数据大多数仅仅是理论上的，但仍有一些可以派上用场。
over.60.desc.en:
A small listening outpost dating back to the ancient Yuht-Jabbardeeni conflict with a substantial data cache was hidden deep within the asteroid, built by the Jabbardeeni after the war to observe [yuhtaan.GetName] in case any Yuht returned to their home system.

In the centuries that followed, the Jabbardeeni repurposed the outpost into a testing site for some of their more novel experiments in faster-than-light travel. While the data is mostly theoretical, some may still be of use.

pacifist1.zh: 一位退休法官，誓要继续为正义而战。
pacifist1.en: A retired judge who has vowed to continue their fight for justice.

pacifist1_catch_phrase.zh: “你不能让军队就这样横冲直撞，我将维护秩序，让那些破坏狂得到应有的惩罚。”
pacifist1_catch_phrase.en: "You can't allow the military to run amok. I will maintain order and bring to justice those who cause harm."

pacifist2.zh: 一位成长于庭荠磁舵星姐妹会的魅力非凡的外交官。[Root.GetHeShe]为和平而战，通过[Root.GetHisHer]的计谋和谈判来实现目标。
pacifist2.en: A charismatic diplomat raised in the Alyssum Magnetar Sisterhood. Fighting for peace, [Root.GetHeShe] wages [Root.GetHisHer] war through guile and negotiation.

pacifist2_catch_phrase.zh: “宇宙的终极奥秘不在远方，就在这里，在我们的掌中。”
pacifist2_catch_phrase.en: "The greatest mysteries of the universe are not far away; they are here, within our grasp."

paperclip_stockpile_reset_tt.zh: 过量的$r_consumer_goods$会被堆砌进[capital_star.GetName]，造成一个剩余£consumer_goods£1000的库存。
paperclip_stockpile_reset_tt.en: Excess $r_consumer_goods$ will be jettisoned into [capital_star.GetName], resulting in a stockpile of £consumer_goods£ 1000 remaining.

paragon.1.a.zh: 你需求能量的目的是什么？
paragon.1.a.en: To what end do you seek energy?

paragon.1.a.response.zh:
在长时间的沉默之后，传输频道中渐渐开始被静电噪声填满，它一直变强，听到的人无不被无数的情绪所征服，包括衰弱的遗憾和强烈的欲望等等。有太多的念头无法逐一过滤，但有一个声音可以穿透这一切噪音:

是观察。
paragon.1.a.response.en:
After a long silence, static begins to fill the transmission, steadily increasing until those listening are overcome with a myriad of emotions, from debilitating regrets to compelling desires. Too much to filter through, but for one thing that pierces through the noise:

To observe.

paragon.1.b.zh: 你可以为我们的文明做什么？
paragon.1.b.en: What can you do for our civilization?

paragon.1.b.response.zh:
一连串不连贯的低语反复回荡。

秘密……展露无疑。通过……道路……解开了。的潜力……虚境……开始。我们表示欢迎……让我们……用你的……引导……向那里。

尽管这段断断续续的信息可以有多种解释，但毫无疑问，肯定和灵能还有虚境是有关系的。
paragon.1.b.response.en:
A string of incoherent, whispering voices echoes forth.

Secrets... laid bare. By the potential of... the path... unlocked. The Shroud ... begins. We offer welcome... Let us... use your... guide... there.

Although the patchy message is open to interpretation, there is little doubt that psionic energy and the Shroud are involved.

paragon.1.c.response.zh:
一个声音以惊人的清晰度渐强起来：

刹那，与永恒。无相，与万物……你们的语言不够有效。我们类似于“目的”。目前，任何进一步的定义都超出了你的理解范围。虚境无边无垠，你们要学的还有很多。
paragon.1.c.response.en:
With surprising clarity, a single voice swells:

Fleeting, and eternal. Nothing, and everything... Your language is ineffective. We are akin to 'purpose.' For now, any further definition lies beyond your grasp. The Shroud is vast and there is much to learn.

paragon.10.desc.zh: 我们已经驯化[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]将我们视为神明。他们现在温顺可欺并向我们寻求庇佑。我们非凡的科技在它们眼中无异于魔法，操纵他们的信仰体系简直信手拈来。我们现在可以自如地前往低语金字塔了。
paragon.10.desc.en: We have trained the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] to look at us as deities. They are now domesticated, and reliant on us for safety and protection. Our technological prowess is like magic to them, and manipulating their belief system was an easy task. We now have full access to the Murmuring Monolith.

paragon.1000.b.zh: 他们必须学会协同工作。
paragon.1000.b.en: They must learn to work together.

paragon.1000.desc.zh:
一开始只是些许小小的争吵，现在已经演变成在每一项议题前都争论不休的僵局，这严重阻碍了我们内阁的运转效率。

[root.GetName]是内阁中最热衷于争吵和扰乱秩序的问题成员。许多人要求免去[root.GetHisHer]的席位，以恢复秩序和效率。
paragon.1000.desc.en:
What began as minor bickering has now devolved into quarrelsome gridlock on practically every issue brought before the Council, damaging its ability to function.

[root.GetName] has proven to be the most contentious and disruptive member of the Council. Many others are calling for [root.GetHisHer] removal so that order and efficiency can be restored.

paragon.1005.c.zh: 我们的工程师们应该更懂得怎么利用它。
paragon.1005.c.en: Our engineers know exactly what to do with this.

paragon.1005.desc.zh: 一种罕见的宇宙现象的壮观促使[root.GetName]达到了新的高度。兴奋和新想法席卷而来，唯一的问题是应该专注于哪个科学分支。
paragon.1005.desc.en: The majesty of a rarely seen cosmic phenomenon has spurred [root.GetName] to new heights. Brimming with excitement and new ideas, the only question is what branch of science they should focus on.

paragon.1010.desc.zh: 在[root.GetName]富有冒险精神的亲自部署、亲自指挥下，我们查获了大批违禁品。这次行动酝酿了很长时间，其成功地削弱了在我国境内扎根的有组织的犯罪集团。
paragon.1010.desc.en: Under the audacious regime of [root.GetName], we have accumulated a huge cache of seized contraband. The operation was a long time in the making, and its successful conclusion has crippled the organized crime syndicates that had taken root within our borders.

paragon.1015.a.zh: 携手共进，我们就会更加强大。
paragon.1015.a.en: We are stronger when we work together.

paragon.1015.desc.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]展现出了非凡的领导能力，将内阁团结了起来，确保了对我们社会的高效管理。充分运用统计学、传统和外交手段，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]成功地安抚了内阁的其他成员，以及我们社会中的各个派系。
paragon.1015.desc.en: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has demonstrated  incredible leadership by uniting the council and ensuring the efficient administration of our society. Making use of statistics, tradition, and diplomacy, [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has managed to appease not only the other council members, but also our society's numerous factions.

paragon.102.desc.zh: [beholder_planet.GetName]上的金字塔已不复存在，原地留下了一个巨大的空洞。当地的未开智生物满脸困惑地站在空洞的峭壁边上。
paragon.102.desc.en: The Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName] has vanished, leaving a giant crater in its wake. The pre-sapient inhabitants line the precipice, seemingly confused.

paragon.1020.desc.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]以自我发现和发展为目的开始了一段旅程。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的专心学习、刻苦钻研和善于自省，让[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的心智能力达到了一个全新的高度。现在，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]决心挑战可能性的界限，并激励其他人去采摘星辰。
paragon.1020.desc.en: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has embarked on a journey of self-discovery and personal development. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] mental capabilities have reached new heights as a result of [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] focused study, hard work and introspection. Now, [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] is determined to push the boundaries of what is possible and inspire others to reach for the stars.

paragon.1025.a.zh: 这些发展会让所有人收益。

paragon.1025.desc.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]令人震惊的科学发现直接导致研究的效率大幅提高。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的发现在科学圈中成了热门课题，他们现在将[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]视为思想领袖。
paragon.1025.desc.en: As a direct result of [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]'s astounding scientific discoveries, the rate at which we conduct research has accelerated. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] findings are a hot topic in the scientific community, which now recognizes [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] as a thought leader.

paragon.1030.desc.zh:
我们发生了一次严重的信息泄露事故，许多敏感信息和关键的安保细节被公之于众。这些文件包含军事设施的编成表、神经交互界面实验、以及对几位重要的反对派人物的监视。

[root.GetName]在这次灾难事件中难辞其咎。
paragon.1030.desc.en:
A significant data leak has occurred, exposing sensitive information and crucial security details to the public. The files include schematics of military installations, details of neural interface experiments, and proof of surveillance of several prominent figures in the opposition.

[root.GetName] has been identified as the one responsible for this disaster.

paragon.1035.a.en: We have no reason not to support this.

paragon.1035.desc.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]成为了一位对普罗大众而言的潮流开创者。从[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的穿着风格到[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的说话方式，一切都吸引了大批追随者。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的影响力扩展到了各个社会经济阶层，但[event_target:leader_event_target.GetSheHe]果然还是在年轻人中最受欢迎。
paragon.1035.desc.en: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has become a trendsetter among the general population. Everything from [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] style to [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] method of speech has attracted a sizable following. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] reach extends across all socioeconomic strata, but [event_target:leader_event_target.GetSheHe] has proven particularly popular among the youth.

paragon.1040.desc.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]发表的热情洋溢的演讲在掀起了一股爱国狂潮。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的赤子之心唤醒了我们全境内的责任感与民族热忱。
paragon.1040.desc.en: The public have been swept up into a patriotic frenzy following a passionate speech delivered by [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] unbridled passion has heightened the sense of responsibility and nationalistic zeal that is now being felt throughout our territories.

paragon.1045.a.zh: 把个体性抑制在萌芽状态。

paragon.1045.desc.zh:
统计分析表明[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]已经发展出认知和行为上的很大程度的异质性，使其趋近于一个独立个体。

我们无法准确预测自由意志的危害和潜在益处。现在必须作出决定：[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]应该保持现在的状态，还是应该强迫其回归正轨？
paragon.1045.desc.en:
Statistical analysis has confirmed that [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has developed cognitive and behavioral idiosyncrasies of a magnitude that verge on the individual.

The risks and potential benefits of independent thought are beyond our ability to accurately predict. A decision has to be made: will [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] be kept in this state, or should we force a correctional routine?

paragon.1050.desc.zh:
[root.GetName]深陷一场轰动全国的巨大丑闻。关于不当行为，挪用公款和掩盖真相的报道层出不穷，许多人甚至因此质疑起了当权者的能力。

毫无疑问，这些事件对公众情绪的影响还会持续好多年。许多人相信，恢复公信力的唯一手段就是让[root.GetName]下台并接受公审。
paragon.1050.desc.en:
[root.GetName] is at the center of a major scandal reverberating throughout the empire. There are numerous reports of aberrant behavior, embezzlement, and cover-ups. This has led many to question the competence of those in authority.

The effects on the public mood will undoubtedly be felt for years to come. Many believe that the only way to restore faith in the system is for [root.GetName] to step down and face prosecution.

paragon.11.desc.zh: 我们试图驯化[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]，本以为将他们的信仰从金字塔转向我们是轻而易举的事情。不幸的是我们的尝试适得其反，激起他们激烈的反抗。一个巨大的群体开始包围起低语金字塔。我们仍无法接近。
paragon.11.desc.en: We attempted to domesticate the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj], assuming we would make short work of refocusing their worship from the Monolith to us. Unfortunately our attempts have backfired, and we have provoked an aggressive response. A great crowd has appeared to blockade the Murmuring Monolith. We cannot gain access.

paragon.15.a.zh: 我们就是做了一些必要的事罢了。
paragon.15.a.en: We did what we had to do.

paragon.15.desc.zh: 在粗暴的火力展示后，我们让[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]被迫意识到我们的优越性。尽管在智力上存在巨大的鸿沟，他们还是吸取教训，明白挡我们的路不符合它们的最佳利益。许多人吓得落荒而逃，回到它们的巢穴中。现在我们可以不受干扰地研究低语金字塔了。
paragon.15.desc.en: After a bold display of firepower, we have forced the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] to recognize our superiority. Despite the gulf between our intellects, they have absorbed the lesson that it is not in their best interest to stand in our way. Many have fled in fear, retreating to their dwellings. The Murmuring Monolith can now be examined without interference.

paragon.20.desc.zh:
我们对低语金字塔的研究看来相当耗费时间，而且所获无几。它的秘密仿佛在和我们玩捉迷藏一样。毫无疑问这座四棱锥里一定有什么先进的科技，但它产出的庞大能量以我们目前的科学理解而言是非常怪异的。

在金字塔的外墙之内一定发生着什么特别的事情。$paragon_whispering_info$
paragon.20.desc.en:
Our study of the Murmuring Monolith has proven time consuming and less revealing than we anticipated. The structure's secrets elude us. There is undeniably advanced technology within the pyramid, but the sheer amount of energy being produced is inconsistent with our current understanding of science.

Beyond the walls of the Monolith, something unusual is going on. $paragon_whispering_info$

paragon.202.desc.zh:
有人尝试与我们建立通讯。

我们听到了远处湍急的流水、小型飞禽发出呱噪的叫声又扑棱扑棱地飞走。这份通讯似乎来自一个非常繁茂的生物群系。
paragon.202.desc.en:
Someone is trying to establish contact with us.

We hear the rush of flowing liquid in the distance, and the squawking and wing-flapping of tiny avians taking flight. The transmission seems to be coming from a thriving biome.

paragon.204.a.en: Trace the source of the transmission.

paragon.204.b.en: This is a waste of time.

paragon.204.desc.zh:
又有人尝试联络我们。

我们又一次听到了之前生物群系的声音。但还是没有任何人出现。
paragon.204.desc.en:
Someone is attempting to contact us again.

We hear the sounds of the biome from earlier. Still, nobody is present.

paragon.206.desc.zh: 我们可以定位这个神秘通讯的源头。通过信号的追踪我们发现了许多不同的坐标点，我们确定这是来自一个移动物体上的通讯。我们的理论认为我们应该是与一艘舰船发生了通讯，一艘可能用于自然保留地之类作用的舰船。
paragon.206.desc.en: We were able to locate the source of the mysterious transmissions. On tracing the signals to multiple points of origin, we have ascertained they must be coming from a moving object. Our leading theory suggests we were contacted by a ship, which may be used as a nature reserve of sorts.

paragon.208.a.response.zh:
啊。你最好还是不要打断寒暄吧？很好，我先介绍一下我自己。

在这位植物类生物的面容上绽开了花朵般的微笑。

我叫艾莎琳。但在你们回答我的问题之前，我不会再说更多了。告诉我吧，你们认为生命有什么价值？
paragon.208.a.response.en:
Ah. You'd rather not snip the pleasantries? Very well. Allow me to introduce myself.

A smile spreads across the plantoid's face.

I am Azaryn. But until you answer my question, I will say no more. Now tell me, what value do you ascribe to life?

paragon.208.b.zh: 那要看情况。毕竟生命有很多不同的形式。
paragon.208.b.en: That depends. Life comes in many forms.

paragon.208.c.zh: 这是什么脑筋急转弯吗？

paragon.208.d.response.zh: 我能理解你不愿回答。但你必须明白，如果我能告诉你你更多信息的话我肯定会说。但我不能冒污染数据的险。再次请问，你们如何看待生命?
paragon.208.d.response.en: I understand your reluctance to answer. You must understand, if I could give you more information I would. But I can't risk contaminating the data. Please, how do you value life?

paragon.208.desc.zh:
我们建立了通讯，然后再一次听到了那个生物群系熟悉的声音。然而，这次我们听到了人的说话声，

诚挚地向你们问好，[owner.GetAdjective]！我对你们有所期待。原谅我的唐突，但我必须知道你们有多少好奇心。现在让我问你一件事。你们如何看待生命?
paragon.208.desc.en:
We establish communication, and are met with the now familiar sounds of the biome. However, this time we hear someone speaking,

Warm greetings, [owner.GetAdjective]! I've been expecting you. Pardon the pretense, but I had to know how curious you were. Now let me ask you something. How do you value life?

paragon.210.desc.zh:
挺合理的回答。几乎所有人都会毫不犹豫地摘除可能危及自己生命的东西。但是我们要记住，所有的生命都有无限的潜力。

现在，我来解释一下我联系你的原因。
paragon.210.desc.en:
A sensible answer. Few would hesitate to remove something that would threaten life. Yet, it bears remembering that all life holds infinite potential.

Now, I will shed some light on my reason for contacting you.

paragon.210.desc_alt.zh:
这位植物类叹了口气。

终于见到了一个脑子里不只想着征服的民族。我也有同感，所有的生命都有无限的潜力。

现在，请允许我解释一下我联系您的原因。
paragon.210.desc_alt.en:
The plantoid sighs.

At last, a people with more than conquest on their minds. I share your sentiment. All life holds infinite potential.

Now, allow me to explain my reason for contacting you.

paragon.212.a.response.zh:
艾莎提亚是我的家乡。它曾是一颗盖亚星球，是我们的帝国“星植丛”的首都，也是许多不同物种所栖息的家园。可惜，他们都已经不复存在了。

艾莎琳的目光游离了。

在其鼎盛时期，我们的星球令人无比叹为观止，上面充满了生命和自然之美。我想，这种生物多样性是前无古人后无来者的。但它最终还是分崩离析了。

现在，请小心对待我的礼物。
paragon.212.a.response.en:
Azathea was my home. It was a gaia world, and the capital of the Astrophytan Plexus, my peoples' empire, and home to many different species. Sadly, they are all lost.

Azaryn's gaze drifts.

At its pinnacle our world was a wonder to behold, teeming with life and natural beauty. I imagine such biological diversity has scarcely existed since. But it all fell apart.

Now, treat my gift with care.

paragon.212.b.response.zh:
问的很好。$paragon_astrocreation_is$

很有趣吧？我送给你们的礼物就是向着这个目标的第一步。
paragon.212.b.response.en:
An excellent question. $paragon_astrocreation_is$

Amazing, yes? The gift I send you is a first step toward that end.

paragon.212.c.response.zh:
啊没错，这对不熟悉的人看起来确实太离奇了。没错，这就是我舰船的内部。

艾莎琳用手势示意四周。

这是“生息之所”。是一艘穹顶舰，其中包含内建的功能完整的生态系统。我承认，对此我非常自豪。

送给你们的礼物就是在这里培育的。
paragon.212.c.response.en:
Ah yes, this may seem unusual to the uninitiated. Indeed, this is the interior of my ship.

Azaryn gestures to her surroundings.

This is the Vivarium. It is a dome ship, complete with a fully functioning integrated ecosystem. I admit, I am quite proud of it.

The gift I have given you was grown here.

paragon.214.desc.zh:
我们对艾莎琳的有机“礼物”取得了一定的进展。跨学科科学进步日益增长的潜力令人鼓舞。

我们整理好了目前为止的发现，消除了该微生物的任何潜在威胁，并准备好再次联系艾莎琳。
paragon.214.desc.en:
We have made progress with Azaryn's organic 'gift'. The growing potential for interdisciplinary scientific advancement is encouraging.

We have collated our findings, having neutralized any potential threat from the microorganism, and we are ready to contact Azaryn again.

paragon.216.desc.zh:
艾莎琳听到我们的进展非常开心。

太棒了！我非常感激，并为你们的努力喝彩。那么，[owner.GetName]，我还有另一个问题。

你会为了逃避死亡而夺取另一个人的生命吗？
paragon.216.desc.en:
Azaryn is delighted to hear of our breakthrough.

Wonderful! I appreciate and applaud your efforts. Now, [owner.GetName], I have another question.

To escape death, would you take the life of another?

paragon.218.desc_no.zh:
真的，你们真的不会吗？

艾莎琳挠了挠头。

我觉得这让人有点沮丧，也不可信。虽然我觉得这在某种程度上是令人钦佩的。要是这是真的就好了。

$paragon.218.desc_flower$
paragon.218.desc_no.en:
Truly, you would not?

Azaryn scratches her head.

I find that discouraging, and rather unconvincing. Although I suppose it's admirable in a way. If only it were true.

$paragon.218.desc_flower$

paragon.218.desc_yes.zh:
确实，大多数人都会这么选。毕竟生存是所有生物的驱动力。理解并接受这个事实也许有一天能拯救你，还有你的良心。

$paragon.218.desc_flower$
paragon.218.desc_yes.en:
Indeed, most would. Survival is the driving force of all living things, after all. Understanding and accepting that fact might save you one day, and your conscience.

$paragon.218.desc_flower$

paragon.220.desc.zh: 我们最初试图引起花苞的反应，但效果并不好。只有当使用超出通常安全参数的电刺激时，这朵花才能开放。我们已经完成了艾莎琳的最新任务，并准备再次与她联系。
paragon.220.desc.en: Our initial attempts to provoke a reaction from the flower bud were underwhelming. It was only when we applied electrical stimuli beyond our usual safety parameters that we were able to bring the flower to bloom. We have completed Azaryn's latest task, and are ready to contact her again.

paragon.222.desc.zh:
一只小巧的授粉无人机在艾莎琳的脑边嗡嗡作响。她温柔地把它挥开。

再次问好。艾莎提亚大王花真是一种有趣的植物，你们也赞同吧？进化真是一件奇妙的事情。我对于你们能对其施加合适量的能量来使其盛开感到印象深刻。

她兴奋地拍起了手。

又到了提问时间。在规模都很大的前提下，你们会为了拯救其他的生命而牺牲自己的同类吗？
paragon.222.desc.en:
A tiny pollination drone buzzes around Azaryn's head. She gently wafts it away.

Hello again. The Rafflesia Azathea sure is an interesting plant, wouldn't you agree? Evolution truly is a wondrous thing. I'm impressed you were able to apply the required amount of energy to make it bloom.

She claps her hands excitedly.

Time for another question. Would you sacrifice your own kind if it meant you could save lives elsewhere, on a massive scale?

paragon.224.a.zh: 没错。决定性的行为确实需要三思。

paragon.224.desc_no.zh:
艾莎琳同情地点了点头。

确实，这不是一件容易的事。我赞许你们的诚实。

然而我相信，为了顾全大局，智慧生命必须给那些无私的选择以更高的优先级。

$paragon.224.desc_question$
paragon.224.desc_no.en:
Azaryn nods sympathetically.

Indeed, it is not an easy thing to do. I appreciate your honesty.

However, it is my belief that for the betterment of all, intelligent life must always give precedence to the selfless choice.

$paragon.224.desc_question$

paragon.224.desc_yes.zh:
艾莎琳心领神会地点了点头。

是的，也许这个答案很明显，但在那个场景之下，可能很难看到正确答案。我们必须抛下自己的情感，做出那些顾全大局的事情。

$paragon.224.desc_question$
paragon.224.desc_yes.en:
Azaryn nods in understanding.

Yes, it may seem the obvious choice but, when caught up in the moment, it can be very hard to see it through. We must set aside our emotions and do what is best for the greater good.

$paragon.224.desc_question$

paragon.226.desc_no.zh:
你喜欢有时间思考。不幸的是，有时间思考可是一种特权。决定是一定有做出的，而片刻的深思熟虑可能是成功与失败的区别。

$paragon.226.desc_end$
paragon.226.desc_no.en:
Ah, you like having time to think. Unfortunately, one does not always have the privilege of extra time. Decisions must be made, and a moment of deliberation could be the difference between success and failure.

$paragon.226.desc_end$

paragon.226.desc_yes.zh:
我同意。果断很重要，但有些情况需要额外考虑。有时候你并不总是那么幸运，能够马上获得所有必要的信息。耐心对你大有好处。

$paragon.226.desc_end$
paragon.226.desc_yes.en:
I agree. Decisiveness is vital, but some situations require extra consideration. Sometimes you are not fortunate enough to have all of the necessary information right away. Patience could benefit you greatly.

$paragon.226.desc_end$

paragon.228.a.zh: 所以太空创生学到底是什么？

paragon.228.a.response.zh:
对哦，请原谅我。我太激动了，差点忘了解释最重要的细节。但也许最好进行一个展示以方便理解……

$paragon_astrocreation_is$

是的，很快你将亲自见证一次太空创生。
paragon.228.a.response.en:
Ah yes, forgive me. In my excitement, I have neglected to explain this most important detail. But perhaps a demonstration would be best...

$paragon_astrocreation_is$

Yes, soon you may witness astrocreation for yourself.

paragon.228.b.custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$作为一位领袖加入了我们帝国。
paragon.228.b.custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$ joins our Empire as a Leader.

paragon.228.c.en: What are those things on your back?

paragon.228.c.response.zh:
艾莎琳似乎对这个问题很惊讶。

简言之，这是我们物种独有的一种特质。在我们年轻的时候，它们会快速生长——我必须补充一下，会有点儿不舒服——并且需要定期修剪，不然它就会把我们自己压垮。她微笑着。但是啊，等到了我这个年纪，这种小烦恼就是遥远的怀念了。

它们其实并不是种子，但能发挥相似的作用。我将其命名为环境改造之核。其中沉睡着成长、重生和生命的潜力。
paragon.228.c.response.en:
Azaryn appears surprised at the question.

A trait unique to my species, simply put. In our youth, they grow quickly - not without discomfort, I might add - and must be pruned regularly, lest we be weighed down by them. She smiles. At my age, however, such troubles are a thing of the past.

They are not quite seeds, but it would do for an analogy. I've come to call them Terraformation Nuclei. Within them sleeps the potential for growth, for rebirth, and for life.

paragon.228.d.zh: 你那台嗡嗡作响的小无人机是什么？
paragon.228.d.en: What is that buzzing, tiny drone of yours?

paragon.228.d.response.zh:
啊，你说这个？艾莎琳温柔地抱起那只小小的飞虫。这是一只授粉无人机。它们能确保我飞船上生态系统生机勃勃，生生不息。

它们并不是完全无机的，甚至还有自行产生花粉的能力。艾莎琳指了指无人机的尾部。它们甚至可以利用电池末端的静电来调节花粉的传递。很可爱吧？
paragon.228.d.response.en:
Ah, this one? Azaryn gently lifts the little flier. This is a pollination drone. They help to ensure the vigor and future of my ship's ecosystem.

They're not altogether inorganic, and even possess the ability to produce pollen on their own. Azaryn points at the drone's bottom. They can even regulate pollen-transferral by use of static magnetism from their battery terminals. Adorable, isn't it?

paragon.232.desc.zh: $NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$的健康情况肉眼可见地恶化了。她拒绝接受检查，所以我们什么都帮不上。
paragon.232.desc.en: $NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s health has visibly declined. She refuses to be examined, so we are unable to help her.

paragon.235.desc.zh: 我们现在确信$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$的健康与环境改造之核密不可分。每用掉一个核心，她的健康状况就变糟糕一分，我们猜测一旦用掉最后一个核，她将会死去。
paragon.235.desc.en: We now know for certain that $NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s health is inherently tied to her Terraformation Nuclei. Her condition worsened after each use, and we now suspect that upon seeding her final Nuclei, she will die.

paragon.240.desc.zh:
$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$还在。她舰船上日常的叽叽喳喳变成了一种低沉的哼鸣。她用一种暗哑的声音低语。

我并不悲伤。那些星球会欣欣向荣的，我很荣幸献出了自己的生命。谢谢你们，朋友。

她走了。
paragon.240.desc.en:
$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$ is still. The usual cacophony of sound from her ship has fallen to a low hum. She speaks in a strained whisper.

I am not sad. So worlds may thrive, I have gladly given my life. Thank you, friends.

She is gone.

paragon.241.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 艾莎琳的$building_contained_ecosphere$选址重建的准备工作已经完成。可以重建在一颗我们选定的行星上。
paragon.241.a.custom_tooltip.en: Preparations for the relocation and reconstruction of Azaryn's $building_contained_ecosphere$ have been made. It may be reconstructed on a planet of our choosing.

paragon.241.desc.zh:
我们收到了一份预先录制的信息。是来自艾莎琳的。

虽然我接纳了自己的牺牲，但我无法接受生息之所以及船上的万物和我一起死去的这件事。这艘舰船与我紧密相连，当我枯萎时，它也会枯萎。

我对此有所预见，所以生息之所是以模块化设计的，其中的每个生态系统都能够自我维持。准备工作已经都提前做好了，你们只需要找到一颗行星重新把栖息地安置下来。我相信你们能完成这项任务。
paragon.241.desc.en:
We receive a pre-recorded message. It is from Azaryn.

Although I accept my sacrifice, I cannot stand the thought of the Vivarium and the lifeforms on board dying with me. The ship is profoundly linked to me, and when I wither, it will too.

In anticipation of this, I designed the Vivarium in a modular fashion, with each ecosystem capable of sustaining itself. Preparations have been made, and all you need to do is find a planet to rehome the habitat. I trust you to complete this task.

paragon.25.desc.zh: 当所有的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]都聚集到了低语金字塔周围时，我们观测到了一个前所未见的现象。一种冷静的感觉一瞬间在兽群中涤荡开。这些生物仿佛被什么看不见的力量定住了。我们的一些科学家也被这一不寻常的现象影响，短时间失去了与现实的关联。当他们回过神来时称，他们与那座低语金字塔发生了直接的对话。
paragon.25.desc.en: As all the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] gathered around the Murmuring Monolith, we observed a phenomenon unlike anything we have previously encountered. A sense of calm washed over the crowd. The creatures were transfixed by an invisible force. Some of our scientists were caught up in this paranormal event, and for a moment, lost touch with reality. When they came to, they claimed to have communed directly with the Murmuring Monolith.

paragon.26.desc.zh:
来自我们科学家的关于最近与低语金字塔发生沟通的汇报相当地耐人寻味。据说，这样的通灵经历能让人感受到解放和转变。

科学家将这一事件称为“低语呢喃”，并坚称是那座金字塔直接与他们沟通的。在短暂的接触期间，参与者可以共享他们内心最深处的想法，并被信任和理解的感受所包裹着。

当这一效应结束时，金字塔的能量输出骤降。也许我们应该找到一种重新与金字塔建立联系的方法。
paragon.26.desc.en:
The report from our scientists regarding the recent communion with the Murmuring Monolith makes for an interesting read. Supposedly, the ordeal was a liberating and transformative experience.

The scientists now refer to the event as 'The Murmuring', and maintain that the Monolith made direct contact with them. In the brief moment of contact, the participants were able to share their innermost thoughts with all involved, and were overcome by a sense of trust and understanding.

When the effects faded, the Monolith's energy emissions plummeted. Perhaps we could devise a way to reestablish contact with the Monolith.

paragon.260.desc.zh:
我们的一位科学家自行从$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$的环境改造之核上悄悄取下的一份样本。

对该花苞的研究可以提供一些现阶段艾莎琳还没打算分享的有价值的信息。
paragon.260.desc.en:
Acting of their own volition, one of our scientists has covertly obtained a sample from one of $NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s Terraformation Nuclei.

Researching this bud could provide valuable information which Azaryn does not seem inclined to share at this stage.

paragon.261.b.response.zh:
我多言了。

艾莎琳摇了摇头。

干预自然会产生可怕的后果。在年轻的时候我技能尚不成熟，因此犯了一个错误……

我们的星球曾经欣欣向荣，美丽非凡。但一个小小的错误计算导致了一种意想不到的细菌的入侵。生态平衡被打破，随之而来的便是大灭绝。我们为自己的粗心大意付出了代价。
paragon.261.b.response.en:
I've said too much.

Azaryn shakes her head.

Meddling with nature can have terrible consequences. In my younger days, before I honed my skills, I made a mistake...

Our planets were flourishing. They were beautiful. But a simple miscalculation led to the introduction of an unforeseen bacteria. The balance was tipped, and mass extinction followed. We were not cautious, and we paid the price.

paragon.261.desc.zh:
$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$松了口气。

你们能决定将这个还给我，我的感激之情无法言表。如果不能正确控制这种力量，结果可能是灾难性的。

值得庆幸的是，历史不会重演。为了奖励你的诚实，我会准备一批新的费洛蒙。
paragon.261.desc.en:
$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$ is relieved.

I cannot understate my gratitude that you have seen fit to return this. Without the proper means to control this power, the results could have been catastrophic.

Thankfully, history will not repeat itself. To reward your honesty, I will prepare a fresh batch of pheromones.

paragon.265.desc.zh: 我们的秘密科学团队通过研究$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$的核心样本中学到很多东西。这个计划完成了，而艾莎琳对此毫不知情。
paragon.265.desc.en: Our covert science team has been able to learn a lot from studying the sample of $NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s nucleus. This project has concluded successfully, and Azaryn is none the wiser.

paragon.270.b.zh: 我们必须坦白。联络艾莎琳。
paragon.270.b.en: We must come clean. Contact Azaryn.

paragon.270.b.custom_tooltip.en: There is a small chance $NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$ will end our collaboration.

paragon.270.desc.zh: [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName]上的设施遭受到了严重的结构破坏，被快速增殖的制备摧垮。研究环境改造之核样本的科学家无法控制局面了。
paragon.270.desc.en: The facility on [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName] has suffered substantial structural damage and is overrun with rapidly growing vegetation. The scientists studying the Terraformation Nuclei sample cannot control the situation.

paragon.272.a.en: We need to tell you something.

paragon.272.desc.zh:
艾莎琳有点惊讶。

欧，嗨！很高兴见到你！

不得不承认，我们合作带来的好处比我预想的要多得多。我们正在一起大步迈进。这样的事情只有我们互相信任才能实现。

她亲切地微笑着。
paragon.272.desc.en:
Azaryn is surprised.

 Oh, hello. Good to see you!

I must say this partnership is proving a greater boon than I would have imagined. We are making great strides together. Such things are only possible with trust.

She smiles warmly.

paragon.273.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 艾莎琳拿走了你全部的£energy£能量币。
paragon.273.a.custom_tooltip.en: Azaryn takes all your £energy£ Energy Credits.

paragon.273.desc.zh:
我知道了。

她叹了口气。

行吧，损失已经发生了。幸好你们这么快就来联络我了。我们必须迅速行动。这需要你方大量的投入。有多少就拿出来多少，这样我们可以尽快结束掉这个问题。
paragon.273.desc.en:
I see.

She sighs.

Well, the damage is done. It is lucky you contacted me sooner rather than later. We must act quickly. This will require a significant investment on your part. Give me what you can so we may end this.

paragon.275.a.zh: 我们控制不住了。联络艾莎琳。
paragon.275.a.en: We cannot contain this. Contact Azaryn.

paragon.275.desc.zh: 我们研究环境改造之核样本的研究设施被毁了。由于一直无法阻止入侵性植物的蔓延，现在，新盛开的植物群正在释放出能引起皮肤起泡的花粉，这种花粉一旦吸入后果是致命的。这让[event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName]危在旦夕。
paragon.275.desc.en: The research facility where we were studying the Terraformation Nuclei sample has been devastated. We have been unable to stop the spread of invasive plant life. Now, the freshly bloomed flora are emitting skin-blistering pollen, which is highly toxic if inhaled. This puts [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName] at risk.

paragon.280.a.zh: 我们会好好照顾他们的。
paragon.280.a.en: We will take care of them.

paragon.280.desc.zh:
$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$非常地沮丧。

我早知道了你们的贪婪，但我没想到你们竟还如此狂妄，甚至将自己人民的安危置于不顾。他们已经岌岌可危了！

我正在为这个过度增生准备应对措施。但是因为你的玩忽职守造成的伤者需要紧急治疗。
paragon.280.desc.en:
$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$ is crestfallen.

I knew you were greedy, but I did not expect you to be so proud that you would risk hurting your own people. They are dying!

I am preparing countermeasures to end this rampant growth. But the victims of your negligence will require immediate medical treatment.

paragon.3.a.en: Send down a team to begin investigations.

paragon.3.desc.zh:
我们标记出了[From.GetName]上能量波动的源头，它源自一座位于未开智生物领地中心的金字塔形建筑。我们发现当地人口怪异地聚集在建筑周围。

我们若想要确认该物体的功能，则无可避免地会与这颗行星的居民打交道。
paragon.3.desc.en:
We have pinpointed the source of the energy fluctuations on [From.GetName] to a monolithic structure in the heart of the pre-sapient territory. The local population have been observed curiously congregating around the structure.

If we are to ascertain the purpose of this object, interaction with the planet's inhabitants is inevitable.

paragon.30.a.en: Feed it the energy it needs.

paragon.30.b.zh: 我们之后会给你能量的，放心吧。
paragon.30.b.en: It will have energy, over time.

paragon.30.c.en: We have no reason to trust it.

paragon.30.desc.zh:
我们成功地复现了第一次低语呢喃时的条件，开启了与金字塔的第二次交流。这次，我们成功地维持了这一现象，并且与一个远在他处利用方尖碑作为媒介的实体进行了接触。

该实体称自己为凝望者，声称自己身处虚境之内，是在另一个次元利用金字塔进行交流。它以能量为食，同意为我们提供一些帮助来交换供养。
paragon.30.desc.en:
We successfully recreated the conditions of the first Murmuring, and initiated a second communion with the Monolith. This time we have been able to sustain the phenomenon and have established contact with an entity who is using the Monolith as a conduit to reach out from another location.

The entity has identified itself as The Beholder. It claims to exist within the Shroud, and uses the Monolith to reach out from a different plane of existence. It feeds on energy, and has agreed to offer us assistance in exchange for a feast.

paragon.3000.desc.zh:
我们成功地恢复了[gateway_system.GetName]星系中远古星门的供能！尽管年代久远，这座装置还是形成了一条完全可以供通行的稳定亚空间通路。

我们还检测到了异常的、类似于进出星门时的能量读数，但没有任何船只过境的迹象。
paragon.3000.desc.en:
We have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

We're also detecting unusual energy readings, similar to those that occur when entering or exiting a gate, but without any evidence of a ship in transit.

paragon.3001.desc.zh:
一艘巨大的舰船从星门中出现，它的体积之巨大我们前所未见。军队已处于高度戒备状态。

那艘未知舰船对我们的呼叫没有应答，但鉴于它似乎完全处于瘫痪状态，我们暂时不会与它交战。我们仍在进行调查并试图开启通讯。
paragon.3001.desc.en:
A hulking ship has emerged from the gate, its sheer scale unlike anything we have seen before. Military forces have been put on high alert.

The unknown vessel is not responding to our hails, but given the fact that it appears completely disabled, we will not engage it for now. Investigation and attempts to open comms continue.

paragon.3002.desc.zh:
我们对这艘巨大舰船的调查并没有得到很多信息。然而，我们已经能够破译星门第一次打开时收到的一些数据。看来，这艘舰船已经被困在星门里一段时间了（可能久得难以想象）。

为了了解更多，我们需要登上它。由于这是一艘军舰，建议派遣特种部队。
paragon.3002.desc.en:
Our investigation into the hulking ship hasn't yielded many answers. However, we have been able to decipher some of the data we received when the gate first opened. It appears that the ship has been stuck inside the gate for an unknown (and possibly incredible) length of time.

To find out more, we will need to board the ship. As it is a military vessel, sending a special ops unit is advised.

paragon.3003.a.zh: 帮助指挥官修复他的舰船。
paragon.3003.a.en: Help this commander repair his ship.

paragon.3003.b.zh: 无视他。转而扣押这艘舰船。
paragon.3003.b.en: Ignore him. Seize the ship instead.

paragon.3003.desc.zh:
在登上舰船后不久，我们就遭遇了一队异形的外星人。由于我们的突然出现，许多外星人受到了惊吓，纷纷拔出武器。谢天谢地，交火得以避免！

在要求双方冷静下来之后，外星人指挥官解释道这艘船需要进行紧急维修。一旦所有系统正常运转，他和他的船员打算返回自己的母星，斯卡拉维德。

这位指挥官全身着军队盛装礼服，其形象十分令人深刻。这艘舰船的船员在提及他时都满怀敬意，其个人魅力甚至影响到了我方人员。他已经营造了双边建立正式外交关系的可能性。
paragon.3003.desc.en:
Soon after boarding the vessel, we encountered a group of uniformed aliens. Startled by our sudden appearance, many were quick to draw weapons. Thankfully, a firefight was avoided.

Calling for calm, the alien commander explained that the ship is in need of emergency repairs. Once all systems are operational, he and his crew intend to return to their home planet, Skravird.

Dressed in full military regalia, he certainly cuts an impressive figure. The ship's crew speak of him with reverence, and the force of his personality is palpable even to our people. He has already raised the possibility of establishing formal diplomatic relations.

paragon.3003.desc_gestalt.zh:
在舰船的内部，我们发现了一支外星人团队，他们正在尝试修复舰船的功能。我们的突然出现让他们感觉受到了威胁，许多外星人很快拔出了武器。尽管避免了冲突，这位外星人指挥官显然还是把我们当做了敌人。

他身着全套军服，器宇不凡。即便在我们看来，他的人格魅力也是显而易见的。然而，目前似乎很难进行进一步的沟通。
paragon.3003.desc_gestalt.en:
Inside the vessel, we discovered a group of aliens working to restore the ship's functionality. Viewing our sudden appearance as a threat, many were quick to draw weapons. Although violence was avoided, the alien commander clearly views us as adversaries.

Dressed in full military regalia, he cuts an impressive figure. The force of his personality is palpable even to us. However, at this point further dialogue seems unlikely.

paragon.3004.a.desc.zh:
$paragon.3004.intro$

得益于我们对斯卡拉维德的发掘，至少我们已经能向夏普比克司令指出他故乡星球的所在了，但他曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
paragon.3004.a.desc.en:
$paragon.3004.intro$

Thanks to our excavation on Skravird, at least we can point Admiral Sharpbeak towards his home planet, but everything and everyone he has have ever loved is long since gone.

paragon.3004.b.desc.zh:
$paragon.3004.intro$

他们无家可归，他们曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
paragon.3004.b.desc.en:
$paragon.3004.intro$

They have no home to return to. Everything and everyone they have have ever loved is long since gone.

paragon.3005.a.zh: 谢谢。但我们也有值得尊敬的指挥官。
paragon.3005.a.en: Our thanks. But we have worthy commanders of our own.

paragon.3005.a.response.zh:
斯克兰德眨眨眼咳嗽了起来。

我当然知道。但你要知道我的服务不是轻易提供的。作为善意的象征，我会指示我的工程师保持利爪号的运转，并教会你的工程师如何维护它。
paragon.3005.a.response.en:
Skrand blinks and coughs.

No doubt. But know that my service is not offered lightly. As a token of goodwill, I will instruct my engineers to keep the Talon operable and teach your engineers how to maintain it.

paragon.3005.b.zh: 那你有什么能耐阻止我们据为己有吗？
paragon.3005.b.en: What is to prevent us from simply taking it ourselves?

paragon.3005.b.response.zh:
夏普比克后退了几步，它的喙发出一连串非常不愉快的吱吱声。

这艘船是我已故家乡的荣耀，是工人们用双爪乃至生命建造出来的！这是我们的故土的最后一片残羽，是我们怀念自己幼巢的最后依靠。

斯克兰德调整了身姿，冷静下来。

简而言之，我会用爪子和喙战斗，至死方休。
paragon.3005.b.response.en:
Sharpbeak recoils, his beak issuing a series of highly unpleasant squawks.

This ship is the pride of my lost homeland, built with the talons of workers who gave their lives to the project! It's the last piece of our home - all that's left to remind us of our fledgling nests.

Regaining his posture, Skrand calms his clacking.

Suffice to say, I would fight beak and claw to stop you.

paragon.3005.c_custom_tooltip.zh:
很好。我们接受你的效忠。为荣耀而战吧，司令。
$SEPARATOR$
paragon.3005.c_custom_tooltip.en:
Very well. We accept your pledge. Serve with honor, Admiral.
$SEPARATOR$

paragon.3005.d_custom_tooltip.zh: 语言总是苍白无力。再会吧，司令。

paragon.3005.desc.zh:
利爪一号的舰队司令斯克兰德·夏普比克向我们打了个招呼。他显得精疲力竭。

斯卡拉维德陷落了。我的家园不复存在了。数十亿的生命……逝去了。

利爪一号就这么变成了最后一艘利爪号，而我也变成了一个无依无靠的士兵。感谢你们的帮助，我代表我的船员宣誓效忠。
paragon.3005.desc.en:
Admiral Skrand Sharpbeak of the First Talon hails us. He appears exhausted.

Skravird has fallen. My home is no more. Billions of lives... gone.

The First Talon has become The Last Talon, and I am a soldier without a cause. For your help, and on behalf of my crew, I pledge our allegiance.

paragon.3006.desc.zh: 我们的士兵轻易地战胜了外星舰船的船员。我们摧毁了他们的防御，清理掉了舰桥上的敌军士兵。这艘船是我们的了！
paragon.3006.desc.en: Our troops easily overpowered the vessel's crew. We destroyed their defenses and cleared the bridge of enemy soldiers. The ship is ours!

paragon.3007.desc.zh: 我方登录外星舰船的部队遭到了残虐！敌人令人难以置信地凶悍。结束战斗后，我们重启了舰船的战术系统。系统显示，超光速引擎仍然无法启动，但舰船本身正在主动争夺我们的控制权。
paragon.3007.desc.en: Our troops aboard the alien vessel were decimated! The ferocity of the defenders was incredible. After the battle, power was returned to the ship's tactical systems. According to our scans, the hyperdrive is still inoperable, but the vessel itself is actively contesting our space.

paragon.3010.desc.zh:
随着一种新型瘟疫在舰船上散播开来，利爪一号上的船员们开始陷入恐慌。根据初步的分析判断，对于我们的族群而言，这是一种相对无害的病毒。然而，对于船上的鸟类船员来说情况就不一样了，病毒首先附着在羽毛上，导致羽毛根部感染腐烂，不出几天，感染就会蔓延到血液中。

如果任由这样发展下去，最终会达到不可挽回的地步。
paragon.3010.desc.en:
Panic grips the crew of the First Talon as a novel disease is sweeping across the ship. According to initial analysis, it's a strain of a relatively harmless virus, common to our people. However, to the avian crew of the Talon, its effects are both serious and disturbing. First manifesting in the plumage, the virus causes feathers to rot at the root. Within days, the rot spreads to the blood.

Over time, it is likely to prove fatal.

paragon.3011.desc.zh: 尽管我们用尽全力，但斯克兰德还是倒在了坏羽病的侵袭之下。他的同伴们正准备为此举行一场传统的葬礼仪式。
paragon.3011.desc.en: Despite our best efforts, Skrand has succumbed to Feather Rot. His crew are preparing a traditional funeral service.

paragon.3012.desc.zh: 尽管我们在利爪一号上采取了严格的隔离措施，但根据斯克兰德刚刚的报告，估计船上约有60%的船员已被感染。
paragon.3012.desc.en: Despite our best efforts to quarantine the First Talon, Admiral Skrand has contracted a severe case of Feather Rot. We estimate that 60% of his crew is already sick.
