paragon.3013.desc.zh: 到目前为止，坏羽病的新症状几乎在一夜之间就涌现出来了，这超出了利爪一号自身医务室的处理极限，船上的走廊里挤满了病患还有奄奄一息的船员。
paragon.3013.desc.en: Hitherto unseen symptoms of the Feather Rot epidemic have appeared almost overnight. The First Talon's sickbay is overflowing, and the ship's corridors are full of the sick and dying.

paragon.3014.desc.zh: 舰船已经汇报了坏羽病导致的第一例死亡病例。那些鸟类船员目前仍然无法抵御病毒的感染，除非我们能找到治疗方法，不然的话据推算最终死亡率可达95%。
paragon.3014.desc.en: The first fatalities of the Feather Rot epidemic have been reported. The avians remain unable to fight off the infection on their own, and unless we find a way a cure, we estimate a mortality rate of 95%.

paragon.3015.desc.zh: 在数月的努力后，我们成功治愈了利爪一号上染病的船员们，舰船运转逐步重回正轨。毫无疑问斯克兰德将非常感谢我们在这件事上的帮助。
paragon.3015.desc.en: After months of work, we were able to administer a successful treatment to the crew of the First Talon. Efforts are underway to up production. Admiral Skrand will no doubt be very grateful for our help in this matter.

paragon.3020.a.zh: 我们对该礼物表达感激
paragon.3020.a.en: We are thankful for this gift.

paragon.3020.desc.zh: 我们的人员一直在努力促进与斯克兰德和他的船员的关系。这种跨文化交流的努力已经取得初步成效：刚刚斯克兰德同意提供他们高效舰载机的设计。这可能会大大提升我们对太空作战的理解。
paragon.3020.desc.en: Our personnel have worked hard to foster relations with Skrand and his crewmates. This effort in cross-cultural exchange is already bearing fruit: Skrand has just agreed to hand over the designs for their highly efficient strike craft. This could lead to a great leap in our understanding of space combat.

paragon.3021.desc.zh: 历时数月的研究、编写和实验终于提供了一些启发。外星飞船的计算机库包含了舰载机编队的适应性战术。现在这项技术由我们来运用。
paragon.3021.desc.en: Months of studying, cataloging, and experimenting finally provided some insight. The alien vessel's computer banks contain adaptive tactics in strike craft formation. Now, this technology is ours to implement.

paragon.3031.b.zh: 这种军事演习有什么意义么。

paragon.3031.desc.zh:
虽然我们的基层军官和指挥官正在与斯克兰德密切合作，但他们也不是完全言听计从。双方所习惯的指挥结构不同，带来了一些不必要的紧张局面。因此我们亟需一场联合军事演练。

该演练可能会降低我们指挥舰队的能力，但不能准备好军队的话可能会导致极其严重的后果。
paragon.3031.desc.en:
Our officers and commanders are working closely with Skrand, but they are not always in accord with him. Their preferred command structures differ, causing unnecessary tension. This has precipitated a need for joint military training.

The work may limit our ability to command our fleets, but failing to properly prepare the troops could have dire consequences.

paragon.3032.desc.zh: 双方都取得了显著进展，我们认为联合演训项目取得了巨大成功。我们从斯克兰德那里学到了很多关于近距离太空作战的知识，同时他和他的军官们也熟悉了我们的后勤系统。一种新的乐观主义和同志情谊已经在军队中扎根下来。
paragon.3032.desc.en: With exceptional progress on both sides, we consider the joint training program a great success. We learned much from Skrand about close-quarters space combat, while bringing him and his officers up to speed on our logistics practices. A new sense of optimism and camaraderie has taken root.

paragon.3033.desc.zh:
主要问题在于我们使用舰载机的战术截然不同。斯克兰德部署了多个大型攻击机小组来打破敌人的指挥链。他们在母舰的明确目标下联合行动。

我们的方法则更灵活，让他们承担一些态势感知型的任务，并去执行高危险高回报的行动，但我们缺乏斯克兰德和他的军官所拥有的大局观。目前，我们还在努力寻找可以一起建立的共同基础。
paragon.3033.desc.en:
The main problem lies in how differently we employ strike-craft tactics. Skrand deploys multiple large strike-craft teams to break the enemy's chain of command. They operate united by clear objectives from their mother ship.

Our approach is more flexible with roles dictated by situational awareness and the use of potentially high-risk, high-reward actions, but we lack the cohesion seen in Skrand and his officers. For now, we still strive to find a common ground to build on.

paragon.3034.desc.zh:
模拟战斗表明，斯克兰德的集中火力战术在最初阶段非常奏效，但很快会被反制战术所克制。即便如此，他战果也还是比起我们的的表现好得多。

同时实施这两种战术会导致混乱。幸运的是，从这些失败中产生了可能想法，这将缓解潜在的问题。
paragon.3034.desc.en:
Simulation battles have shown Skrand's concentrated tactics are very effective at first, but quickly fail against counter strategies. Even so, the results were superior to those we could expect ourselves.

Implementing parts of both tactics in parallel resulted in chaos. Fortunately, from these failures emerged promising ideas that should alleviate the underlying problems.

paragon.3036.a.tt.zh: 采取这一行动将让所有异见者离开海军部。
paragon.3036.a.tt.en: Taking this action will remove all dissidents from the admiralty.

paragon.3040.b.en: We don't have resources for this.

paragon.3040.desc.zh:
我们对利爪终号的联合研究得到了对这艘钢铁巨兽内部运作方式的独到见解。我们相信我们的研究团队跟利爪号的船员们通力合作将有可能进一步改进舰船的外部结构，让它面对攻击和船体破坏具有更强的抵抗力。

我们已经获得了斯克兰德的允许，但项目还需要更多资金。
paragon.3040.desc.en:
Our joint research on the Last Talon has given us unique insights into the inner workings of this behemoth. We believe that our engineering team, in cooperation with those aboard the Talon, have an opportunity to further improve the outer layers of the ship, making it even more resistant to attacks and potential hull breaches.

We have already received permission from Skrand, but the project will require further funds.

paragon.3041.desc.zh: 虽然我们没能完成预定目标，但还是成功地改进了利爪号的装甲系统。我们的工程师还发现了可以用于改进我们自己舰船的灵感。
paragon.3041.desc.en: Although we didn't achieve the desired results, we managed to improve the Talon's armor systems. Our engineers also found valuable insights that can be applied to improve our own ships.

paragon.3042.desc.zh: 我们对改进利爪号的结构强度而不牺牲速度或机动性进行了诸多努力，但进展相当缓慢。斯克兰德的工程师虽然帮了我们很多忙，但是他们不愿意我们在没有密切监督的情况下实施我们的想法。尽管如此，工作仍在继续推进。
paragon.3042.desc.en: We have made several different attempts to increase the Talon's structural integrity without compromising speed or maneuverability, but progress has been slow. The assistance of Skrands' engineers has been a great boon to us, but they are reluctant to implement our ideas without close supervision. However, work continues to move forward.

paragon.3043.desc.zh:
利爪号的部分材料和我们的同类产品不同。这些合金的韧性更差，导致船体在安装额外的装甲板时意外断裂。驻船工程师对我们的监督是正确的，幸好意外发生时他们就在附近。

我们需要使用一些原来用于升级的材料来维修船体，这将会导致整个升级工作的延迟。
paragon.3043.desc.en:
Some of the Talon's materials differ from our equivalents. Its alloy is much less flexible, which caused the hull to break unexpectedly during the installation of additional armor plates. The ship's engineers were right to oversee our work, and we were lucky they were nearby.

We had to use some of the materials allocated for improvements to repair the ship, which has in turn delayed the whole operation.

paragon.3050.a.zh: 你之前曾和这些威胁交过手吗？
paragon.3050.a.en: Have you come into contact with this threat before?

paragon.3050.a.response.zh:
不，并没有。但我以前见过这种情况……这种模式再熟悉不过了。威胁是一样的。如果我们不尽快采取行动，我们将遭受到与我的留守同胞们同样的结局。

他全身的羽毛支棱了起来。

我不会再让任何人遭遇这种不幸了。
paragon.3050.a.response.en:
No, not exactly. But I've seen this play out before... The pattern is all too familiar. The threat is the same. If we don't act soon, we will meet the same end that once befell my people.

He ruffles his feathers.

I would not wish such a fate on anyone.

paragon.3050.b.response.zh:
我们将这种敌人称为“威胁”。他们从不回复任何通讯请求，更不用说外交，任何挡住他们去路的人后果都是死。

他发出了一声尖利的嘶鸣。

他们不知从何而来突然出现，烧杀抢掠！我们几乎没有还手能力，但我们知道了与这样的敌人作战意味着什么。常规战争是不够的。一不做，二不休。我们必须消灭他们，一个不留，否则就见不到明天了。
paragon.3050.b.response.en:
We called our enemy the Menace. They never responded to comms requests, let alone diplomacy, and everyone who got in their way wound up dead.

He emits a high-pitched scream.

They appeared out of nowhere, killing, mangling, burning! We had little chance to retaliate, but we learned what it means to fight such an enemy. Conventional warfare isn't enough. It must be total, or nothing. We must destroy all of them, every last one, or there will be no tomorrow.

paragon.3050.c.response.zh: 时间就是生命。我们必须加快这一进程。我们正面临着彻底毁灭的威胁。我们必须阻止这一切！
paragon.3050.c.response.en: Time is of the essence. We must expedite the process. We are facing the threat of total destruction. We must prevent this!

paragon.3050.d.zh: 我们不能在这里浪费资源。
paragon.3050.d.en: We can't spend resources on this.

paragon.3050.d.response.zh:
斯克兰德尖叫了起来，

什么？！不……你犯了个十分严重的错误。
paragon.3050.d.response.en:
Skrand shrieks,

WHAT?! No... You're making a terrible mistake.

paragon.3050.desc.zh:
闪烁的屏幕上浮现出斯克兰德的指挥界面。这位舰队司令的羽翼蓬立，双眼发出锐利的目光。

这些……混账！他们只知道杀戮、破坏！

他愤怒地咬紧了喙，继续说。

我请求……不，我下令发起战争！我们不能让他们毁掉一切，让我们再次一无所有！我、我相信我们一起可以防止我人民所遭遇的悲剧再度重演。我已经准备好与你们分享我们所知道的一切。
paragon.3050.desc.en:
The screen flickers as Skrand's command deck appears. The admiral's feathers are ruffled, his sharp eyes flashing.

These... outsiders! They came here only to kill, to destroy!

Clacking his beak furiously, he continues.

I request-- No, I DEMAND that we declare war! We can't let them destroy everything, not again! I... Together I believe we can prevent a repeat of what befell my people. I am ready to teach you everything we know.

paragon.3051.desc.zh: 得益于斯克兰德对“威胁”作战的专长，及其提供的海量数据，我们现在面对这些涌现出来的天灾更加有备无患了。下一步就是将这些知识落到实处。
paragon.3051.desc.en: Thanks to Skrand's expertise in warfare against the Menace, and the vast database he has provided, we are now much better equipped to deal with the emerging crisis. All that remains is to put this knowledge to good use.

paragon.3052.desc.zh:
我们获得的数据库中可查询到一些斯克兰德的帝国时代这些威胁的作战方式实例。看来，他们使用的策略确实类似于我们今天所面对的那些。他们的舰队不使用正常的物流方案，通常是自给自足的。

更重要的是，干扰技术对他们不怎么起作用。破坏操作同样没有用。
paragon.3052.desc.en:
The databanks we've accessed provide us with some examples of how the Menace fought during the time of Skrand's empire. It appears that they used tactics similar to those we face today. They rarely use standard logistical schemes, and their fleets are usually self-sufficient.

More importantly, jamming technology is not as effective against such forces. Sabotage operations are likewise useless.

paragon.3053.desc.zh: 将我们与斯克兰德的数据进行对比得出了一些有趣的结论。似乎这些敌人相当地古板：它的大型舰队一次只聚焦在一个目标，而忽视其他所有的东西。我们应该可以识别他们的目标，并进行相应的防御。
paragon.3053.desc.en: Comparing our own data to Skrand's, we have come to some interesting conclusions. It turns out that the enemy is quite inflexible: its largest fleets focus on one target at a time, to the exclusion of all else. It should be possible to identify such targets and defend accordingly.

paragon.3060.desc.zh: 利爪号上的一群工程师帮传达了一条来自斯克兰德的指令。他们请求我们帮助维护利爪号的框架，并让我们的船坞做好修船的准备。如上所述，这些计划代价高昂。而且还有一个问题：考虑到这项工作的微妙性质，斯克兰德将不得不亲自监督该项目。
paragon.3060.desc.en: A group of engineers from the Talon has delivered an order from Skrand himself. They requested help to maintain the Talon's frame and prepare our shipyards for potential repairs. As outlined, these plans would be a costly process. And there is one catch: given the delicate nature of the work, Skrand will have to oversee the project himself.

paragon.3061.desc.zh: 在我们的帮助下，利爪号的工程师成功地对我们的船坞进行了复古改装，以对利爪号的内部结构进行研究。他们利用我们的实验性的设计改进了他们的超光速引擎，使得即使在发生船体严重损坏的情况下，舰船仍然能够跃迁。虽然使用这种引擎会导致几乎瞬间到达目的地，但是它也会杀死船上的所有人，并且可能使舰船在数年内无法使用。另一方面，如果舰船在战斗中损毁，我们依然能可以尝试激活这个系统并修复残骸。
paragon.3061.desc.en: With our help, the Talon's engineers have retrofitted our shipyards to study the Talon's inner workings. Making use of our experimental designs they enhanced their FTL drives, which allow the ship to jump even after a critical hull breach. Although usage of this drive will result in almost instantaneous travel, it will also kill everyone on board and probably render the ship inoperable for years. On the other hand, if the ship is lost in battle, we can try to activate the system and recover the wreckage.

paragon.3071.desc.zh: 在利爪号工程师团队的密切支持和监督下，我们成功地重建了船体。利爪号再度启航！
paragon.3071.desc.en: With the close support and supervision of the Talon's engineering team, we were able to rebuild the hull. The Talon takes flight again!

paragon.3072.b.en: Scrap it, we need the alloys.

paragon.3072.desc.zh: 多亏了额外的安全系统以及紧急协议，斯克兰德的旗舰在受到严重损坏后仍成功进行了紧急超光速跃迁。尽管出现在我们首都星球上方的残骸几乎无法被识别为一艘舰船，但船体依然可以作为重建的基础。这些残骸现在正在船坞等待修理。或者，我们可以对船体进行材料回收。考虑到它的状态，即便是我们认定这艘舰船的残骸无法修复的，斯克兰德也会理解这个决定。
paragon.3072.desc.en: Thanks to additional failsafe systems and emergency protocols, Skrands' flagship managed to enter emergency FTL even after taking critical damage. Although what appeared in the skies above our capital world is barely recognizable as a ship, the hull can serve as a basis for rebuilding. The remains are now waiting at the docks for repairs. Alternatively, we could the hull for materials. Given its state, even Skrand would understand the decision if we deemed the wreck impossible to repair.

paragon.3080.a.zh: 斯克兰德作出了很多贡献。他完全配得上这个。
paragon.3080.a.en: Skrand has served us well. He deserves this much.

paragon.3080.b.en: We don't have time for this.

paragon.3080.desc.zh: 近期在基因工程方面的进展有助于重新恢复舰队司令斯克兰德的种族。也许暂时还不具有相应的基因多样性来确保他们继续繁衍，但用兼容的基因填补空白应该可以完成这项工作。我们现在只需要足够的资金就可以开始行动。
paragon.3080.desc.en: Recent developments in genetic engineering could enable us to repopulate Admiral Skrand's species. We may lack the genetic diversity to make them fully capable of reproduction, but filling in the gaps with compatible genes should get the job done. All that is required to get started is adequate funding.

paragon.3081.desc.zh: 我们复制斯克兰德DNA的工作某种意义上还是成功了。尽管他们的外观完全一致，但是克隆体的基因组成与斯克兰德的完全不同，它们构成了一个新物种。他们开始称自己为塔隆人。
paragon.3081.desc.en: Our efforts to replicate Skrand's DNA have been more or less successful. Although their appearance is identical, the genetic makeup of the clones is different enough from Skrand's that they constitute a new species. We are told they have taken to calling themselves the Talons.

paragon.3081.tt.zh: 塔隆人将会出现在我们的母星上。
paragon.3081.tt.en: The Talons will appear on our homeworld.

paragon.3082.desc.zh: 斯克兰德的鸟类DNA远比预想的要顽固，以至于有必要将其他鸟类的基因拼接起来。这个方法并不理想，但应该能让我们完成这项工作。
paragon.3082.desc.en: Skrand's avian DNA is far more rigid than expected, so much so that it has been necessary to splice genes from other avian species. The approach is not ideal, but it should allow us to finish the job.

paragon.3083.a.en: We are sorry to hear that.

paragon.3083.a.response.zh: 不必遗憾。这些克隆体让我们可以重温过去的生活方式。假以时日他们甚至还能孵出雏鸟。你们给予了我们希望。我们对此表示感谢。愿你的羽翼光洁生辉。
paragon.3083.a.response.en: Do not be. These clones will provide us with a way to live as we did in the past. In time, it may even be possible to have nestlings. You have given us hope. We thank you for that. May your plumage shine.

paragon.3083.desc.zh:
斯克兰德的制服一尘不染，他的羽翼油光发亮。

我已经看到了你们小小基因实验的成果。虽然这些克隆体还差强人意，但我相当感谢你们的努力。
paragon.3083.desc.en:
Skrand's uniform is in perfect condition, his feathers well groomed.

I saw the result of your little genetic experiment. These clones are far from perfect, but I am grateful for your attempt.

paragon.3090.desc.zh: 我们收到了一份来自许多利爪号船员的请求。他们要求我们调配资源研究他们民族的过往。在利爪号徘徊于亚空间的时候发生了许多许多事情。他们希望能为子孙后代记录下一些东西。
paragon.3090.desc.en: We received a request from several members of the Talon's crew. They have asked us to use our resources to research their people's past. Much occurred while the Talon lay in limbo. They have asked that it be recorded for posterity.

paragon.3091.desc.zh:
我们收到了关于斯克兰德和他的人民历史的第一份报告:

在他们的时代，星系广阔而未知，星系外边缘被视为太过危险，无法探索。

在星系中心周围，庞大的帝国在争夺权力。其中一个是鸟类文明。在其他人不敢涉足的黑暗之地，这些勇敢的探险家看到了机遇。大迁徙就这样开始了。
paragon.3091.desc.en:
We have the first report on the history of Skrand and his people:

In their time the galaxy was vast and unknown, the outer rims considered too dangerous to explore.

Around the galactic center, vast empires vied for power. One was an avian civilization. Where others saw darkness, these intrepid explorers glimpsed opportunity. So began the Great Migration.

paragon.3092.desc.zh:
这里附上另一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

大迁徙在很久以前就结束了。偏安于星系的一隅，斯克兰德的人民们享受着和平而繁荣的日子。但成平日久的他们，没有做好应对威胁的准备。

攻击者不宣而战。没有一双翅膀来得及张开，尖牙立喙也失去了光芒。这些无面入侵者从太空而来，轰炸了鸟类的行星，留下了尸山血海。
paragon.3092.desc.en:
Here follows another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The Migration was long over. Secure along the galaxy's outer rim, Skrand's kin enjoyed both peace and prosperity. But having traded vigilance for comfort, they were unprepared for the coming Menace.

The attackers came without warning. No wings were unfurled; neither talon nor beak flashed in combat. From space the faceless invaders bombed the avian worlds. In their wake they left only death.

paragon.3093.desc.zh:
我们收到了下一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

斯卡拉维德的政府崩溃了，经济也在废墟中陷入停止。但人民的英勇丝毫未减。在远离前线的地方，一个项目正在酝酿之中。

一艘史无前例的舰船将被建造出来。其规模之大足以使敌人胆战心惊。当利爪一号准备就绪时，它被划入了斯卡拉维德最后一位指挥官的指挥之下。年轻又未经考验的斯克兰德·夏普比克上了战场。很快，他的人民就会把他称为威胁克星，斯卡拉维德的第一利爪。
paragon.3093.desc.en:
We've received another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

Skravird's government collapsed. Its economy lay in ruins. But the valor of its people was undiminished. Far from the front lines, a project was hatched.

A ship would be built unlike any that had come before. Its sheer scale would strike terror into enemy. When the First Talon was ready, it was placed under the command of the last of Skravird's commanders. Young and untested, Skrand Sharpbeak went to war. Soon his people would hail him as Menace Bane, First Claw of Skravird.

paragon.3094.desc.zh:
以下是斯克兰德和他的人民历史的最后一份汇报：

利爪一号，同时也是最后一号，穿过敌人的阵线。船员和指挥官的精明和勇敢带来了一场又一场的胜利。然而，它的航程是短暂的：即使是像利爪号这样的船，也不可能凭一己之力扭转战局。无奈之下，斯克兰德和他的军官们计划在斯克兰德的最后一次防御战中玉石俱焚。在一次包抄敌人的大胆行动中，斯克兰德命令利爪号进入一个未经测试的星门。他和利爪号便从此失去了音信。
paragon.3094.desc.en:
Thus reads the final report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The First Talon, first and last of its line, cut through the enemy ranks. Battle after battle was won by the cunning and valor of its crew and their commander. Alas, its flight was short lived: no ship, not even one such as the Talon, could turn the tide of war on its own. In desperation, Skrand and his officers planned to sacrifice themselves in the last defense of Skravird. In a daring bid to outflank the enemy, Skrand ordered the Talon into an untested Gateway. Neither he nor the Talon were ever heard from again.

paragon.31.desc.zh:
我们按要求提供了能量，完成了和凝望者的交易。能量刚一交付，金字塔就开始发出高频振动。随后它开始摇晃，周围地面开始坍塌。随着巨石上升，它的整体逐渐显露，我们才发现它的本体至少比我们最离谱的估计还要再大上两倍之多。

这座金字塔是一座巨大的八面体结构，它悬浮到了空中，掩盖其上的尘土徐徐落下。随着它飞向[beholder_planet.GetName]大气层的深处，行星的当地居民痛苦地尖叫了起来。

现在我们知道了，低语金字塔是一座拥有太空航行能力的硕大无朋的舰船。它现在正环绕着[beholder_planet.GetName]。
paragon.31.desc.en:
We fulfilled our end of the bargain with the Beholder, delivering the energy as requested. Upon receipt of the power, the Monolith began emitting high-frequency vibrations. It then began shaking, and the ground surrounding it crumbled, as the Monolith rose, revealing itself to be at least two times larger than even our most outlandish estimates.

A huge octahedral structure, the Monolith was suspended in the air as dirt and dust fell to the ground. The inhabitants of the planet screeched in panic as it took to the skies, climbing high into the atmosphere of [beholder_planet.GetName].

It is now clear that the Murmuring Monolith is a colossal vessel, capable of spaceflight. It currently orbits [beholder_planet.GetName].

paragon.3100.a.zh: 如果还有机会就试试看。
paragon.3100.a.en: If there's a chance, we have to take it.

paragon.3100.desc.zh:
刚一进入[From.GetName]恒星系，我们的传感器就发现了来自[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星的一个微弱信号。

它具有短促而重复的模式，看起来好像是在求救。然而，由于信号太过微弱，我们估计定位出其来源会相当困难。也许到时候就来不及伸出援手了。
paragon.3100.desc.en:
On entering the [From.GetName] system our sensors detected a faint signal originating on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

A short and repeating pattern, it appears to be a call for aid. However, given the signal's weakness, we expect that locating its source will prove difficult. It may already be too late to help.

paragon.3104.desc.zh:
我们在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上找到了求救信号的来源。

地壳深处埋藏着一个古老的逃生舱。它的冷冻胶囊仓里似乎有一个外星人幼体。

尽管这个逃生舱已经非常老了，但低温保存设备仍然在运行中，幼体的生命迹象也很稳定。在胶囊的外部粗略地刻着一系列符号。我们将其翻译成：“我们的希望。我们的未来。我们的子孙。”
paragon.3104.desc.en:
We have found the source of the distress signal on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

Buried deep within the planet's crust was an ancient escape pod. Its cryostasis capsule contained what appears to be an alien child.

Despite the pod's extreme age, the cryopreservation equipment was still functioning, and the child's life signs are stable. On the capsule's exterior a series of symbols were roughly carved. We translated the symbols: 'Our hope. Our future. Our Scion.'

paragon.3105.a.zh: 我们会给艾克萨凯德斯一个家。
paragon.3105.a.en: We will give Exakeides a home.

paragon.3105.b.zh: 我们没有义务照顾这个孩子。
paragon.3105.b.en: The child is not our responsibility.

paragon.3105.desc.zh:
在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上发现的孩子成功复苏了。所有的生命迹象都符合该类生命形式的合理范畴。目前他还没有恢复意识，也许还要一段时间才能苏醒。

在逃生舱内还发现了一些物品。第一件是一块略微损坏的数据水晶，记录了孩子的姓名、年龄和物种。他叫做艾克萨凯德斯”，完整的日志表明他还是瓦格罗的子嗣。第二件是一个由未知重金属构成的古怪文物。从该文物的设计上看，好像应该属于一个更大装置的一部分。进一步研究已正在计划中。

现在更紧迫的任务是要如何对待这个孩子。不管艾克萨凯德斯到底是，或者曾是什么人，目前来讲他需要照料。
paragon.3105.desc.en:
The child discovered on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName] has been successfully resuscitated. All vital signs are within a reasonable range for a lifeform of its type. Still unconscious, it may be some time before the child wakes.

A number of items were also discovered inside the pod. The first was a degraded data crystal which revealed the child's gender, name, and species. He is called Exakeides, and referred to throughout the log as the 'Scion of Vagros'. The second was a strange relic composed of an unknown, heavy material. Given its design, it is likely that this relic formed a part of a larger whole. Further study is advised.

Of more pressing concern is what to do with the child. Whoever this Exakeides is or was, for the time being he will require care.

paragon.3110.desc.zh: 目前进行中的对艾克萨凯德斯身边的破损遗物的研究表明，它曾与障碍物发生过碰撞。由于丢失的部件过多，我们只能对其真实功能进行猜测。然而，根据近距离观测时记录的异常读数，我们有理由得出结论，该物体对时空有影响。
paragon.3110.desc.en: Our ongoing research into the broken relic discovered with Exakeides has hit a roadblock. Given how many pieces are missing, we can only speculate on its true purpose. However, based on the anomalous readings we've recorded while in close proximity, there is some reason to conclude that the object has an impact on spacetime.

paragon.3114.a.en: Push him to embrace the unknown.

paragon.3114.b.zh: 警告他不要相信陌生人。
paragon.3114.b.en: Warn him not to trust in outsiders.

paragon.3114.c.zh: 让他学会敬畏生命的价值。
paragon.3114.c.en: Impress upon him the value of life.

paragon.3114.d.en: Remind him that strength is power.

paragon.3114.desc.zh:
艾克萨凯德斯一直是一个非常早熟的孩子，随着十岁生日到来，他已经开始了更高级的学习。到目前为止，我们的重点一直是鼓励他无限的好奇心，并为他提供一切必要的工具来追求他的兴趣。在未来的几年里，他将由我们所能提供的最优秀的人才来指导。

他有潜力成为科学领域的领军人物，这足以证明我们的付出是会有回报的。问题是，要将他的教育将建立在什么基础上呢？
paragon.3114.desc.en:
Always a remarkably precocious child, Exakeides's tenth year marks the beginning of more advanced studies. Until now, our focus has been on encouraging his boundless curiosity and providing him with all the tools necessary to pursue his interests. In the coming years, he will be tutored by the best minds we have to offer.

His potential to become a leader in the sciences more than justifies the investment. The question is, upon what foundation will his education proceed?

paragon.3114.h.zh: 让他在物质世界脚踏实地。
paragon.3114.h.en: Ground him in the physical world.

paragon.3115.a.zh: 是时候为他的下一步做规划了。
paragon.3115.a.en: It is time to plan his next steps.

paragon.3115.desc.zh:
在二十岁时，艾克萨凯德斯已经准备好承担其一位成年人的责任了。

从被复苏那一刻起，他就像一块海绵一样狂热而执着地吸收着我们的教导。尽管他已经具有海量的技艺和无边的智慧，但仍旧谦虚如初。

科学一直是他最热衷的领域，促动着它去发现自己的过往，以及那台与他一同被发现的破碎遗物。在他的同僚中，他的名字被简化为了“凯德斯”。
paragon.3115.desc.en:
On turning twenty years old, Exakeides is ready to assume the responsibilities of adulthood.

In the time since his resuscitation, he has absorbed our teachings with fervor and determination. Despite his prodigious skill and a boundless intellect, he remains humble.

Science has long been his passion, fueling his drive to uncover the truth of his past as well as the purpose of the broken relic he was found with. To his peers, he is known simply as 'Keides'.

paragon.3116.a.response.zh:
年轻人点了点头，并深吸了一口气。

我一直梦想着这么一天。从我记事的那一天起，我就一直期待着这一天。

我已经准备好，献上自己的一份力了。
paragon.3116.a.response.en:
The young man nods and takes a breath.

I have dreamed of this day. I have anticipated it for as long as I can remember.

I stand ready and willing to serve.

paragon.3116.b.zh: 你会有够长的时间做出贡献的。但首先，你在追寻什么呢？
paragon.3116.b.en: There will be enough time for that. But first, what do you seek?

paragon.3116.b.response.zh:
其他人又在追寻着什么呢？不过是了解自己，了解自己在宇宙中的位置罢了。

我觉得关键在于那个遗物。有了你们的帮助，我就能全身心地投入对其余部分的修复。但请不要误会我：这并不是一个出于自私或者虚荣的请求。我确信，这个物件的力量一定能造福我们的人民。

他顿了顿。

你们救了我的命，我对你们有所亏欠。但我需要寻找答案，因此需要你们的帮助。
paragon.3116.b.response.en:
What does anyone seek? To know themselves, to understand their place in the universe.

I believe the key lies with the relic. With your aid, I will commit myself to recovering the remaining pieces. But do not mistake me - this is no vain quest for selfhood. I am convinced that the power of this object will prove a great boon to our people.

He pauses.

I am indebted to you for saving my life. I need to find answers, and I need your help.

paragon.3116.c.zh: 那么你找到了答案以后呢？那之后又如何？
paragon.3116.c.en: And when you find what you seek? What then?

paragon.3116.c.response.zh:
凯德斯自豪地抬起了头。

这是一个非常有分量的问题，我也有很多答案。简而言之中，你们给了我一个家。无论这趟旅程会给我带来什么，不论我会学到什么，我都会与你们分享。这方面我说到做到。
paragon.3116.c.response.en:
Keides looks up proudly.

A weighted question, with many answers. In short, you have given me a home. Wherever this journey takes me, whatever I learn, I will share it with you. On that you have my word.

paragon.3116.desc.zh:
你好。

凯德斯昂首站着，观察着形势，也在思考着自己对形势该作何反应。他的目光落在自己的双手上：那双手丝毫没有紧张的迹象，如磐石般沉稳。很明显他为这一天做了充分准备。

我准备好了。
paragon.3116.desc.en:
Hello.

Standing tall, Keides observes the situation and his own response to it. His gaze falls to his hands: they are remarkably steady. He has prepared for this day.

I am ready.

paragon.3117.desc.zh:
对遗物进行初步调查时，凯德斯汇报了一段不同寻常的经历。

在进行物理接触后，他的脑海中出现了“幻视”；出现了人和地方的画面，是被埋在遥远过往的回忆。尽管他尚未完全理解其中的含义，但其中的一些画面描绘的是现实的地点。

凯德斯请求发起一个特殊项目对其进行探索。
paragon.3117.desc.en:
Upon initial investigation of the relic, Keides has reported an unusual experience.

After physical contact, 'visions' have appeared in his mind; images of people and places, memories of a long forgotten past. Although he has yet to discern their full meaning, some of these visions depict real locations.

Keides is calling for a Special Project to explore them.

paragon.3120.desc.zh: 进入[From.GetName]星系之后不久，我们很快就定位了一颗符合凯德斯幻视的行星。在这颗行星的表面流淌着熔矿的海洋。
paragon.3120.desc.en: Shortly after entry into the [From.GetName] system, a planet matching Keides's vision has been located. Oceans of molten minerals stream across the planet's surface.

paragon.3121.desc.zh:
在惊涛拍岸的熔岩海洋中，凯德斯发现了一处矿物处理设施的遗迹。他报告有新的幻视：一条黑暗的走廊，通向一个密封的房间。根据这些影像，凯德斯找到了一个古老的、腐朽的盒子。盒子里面有一块残片，完全没有受到时间的摧残。

凯德斯汇报称，在接触到它的一瞬间，新的令人困惑的幻视立刻向他扑面而来。
paragon.3121.desc.en:
Between the bays and swells of the planet's molten oceans, Keides discovered the remains of a mineral processing facility. He reported new visions of a dark corridor that led to a sealed room. Following these images led Keides to an ancient and moldering box. Inside the box, he found a fragment of the relic, untouched by the ravages of time.

Keides reports that upon touching it he was struck by a new and troubling vision.

paragon.3122.desc.zh:
在凯德斯的身边浮现出了一座巨大熔炉的轧制流程。矿物、工厂、载具覆盖着大地，航母编队在空中遮天蔽日。在噪音之外，还有数量惊人的传送门，忽明忽灭，可以折叠起来。突然，天地间传来一声巨大的轰鸣，连大地都开始震颤。远处传来一阵绞痛的尖叫声。

从视野中恢复过来后，凯德斯将新的碎片与现有的碎片放在一起。一声尖锐的啸叫充满了空气。几乎就在同时，这两块碎片就自动融合在一起了。于是这件遗珍的影响变得更加强烈了。
paragon.3122.desc.en:
The milling activity of a great furnace rose around Keides. Mines, factories, and vehicles blanketed the ground. Huge carrier vessels dotted the skies. Beyond the noise, there was a staggering number of portals, blinking in and out of existence, folding in on themselves. Suddenly there was a great rumbling, and the ground began to shake. A strangled scream came from the distance.

After recovering from his vision, Keides set the new fragment alongside the existing piece. A sharp whine filled the air. Almost instantly, the two parts fused together of their own accord. The relic's effects appear strengthened.

paragon.3125.desc.zh: 追踪着凯德斯的幻视，我们来到了一颗位于[From.GetName]恒星系的行星。茂密的丛林覆盖了地面的90%。
paragon.3125.desc.en: Following Keides's vision has led us to a planet in the [From.GetName] system. Dense jungle covers more than 90% of its land area.

paragon.3126.desc.zh:
野生丛林存在重重危险，要想安全地导航是十分困难的。凯德斯不止一次从鬼门关逃了出来。

尽管如此，在一种神秘力量的吸引下，他仍继续前进，终于发现了一座巨大建筑的杂草丛生的遗迹。一个摇摇欲坠的楼梯井通向一座远高于林冠的基座。在那里的黑色金属底座上，有另一块遗物碎片。

几乎就在一瞬间，凯德斯被拉入了幻视场景中。
paragon.3126.desc.en:
The perils of the wild jungle have proven difficult to safely navigate. More than once, Keides has narrowly escaped the jaws of death.

Even so, drawn by a mysterious force, he pressed on, only to discover the overgrown remnants of a massive structure. A crumbling stairwell led to a pedestal far above the canopy. There, resting on a plinth of black metal, was another fragment of the relic.

Almost instantly, Keides was plunged into a vision.

paragon.3127.desc.zh:
树木都散开了，取而代之的是一片苍翠的景色。这是一颗美丽而温顺的星球，有大型森林一般大小的动物围栏，包含了来自星系各处的物种。

突然，幻视把凯德斯扯入进了一座大型建筑内的一个房间。其中一面墙描绘着数个恒星系的星图。其中四个星系与其他的明显不同，没有超空间航道连接。

从幻视中回到船上，凯德斯把最新的一块遗物放在现有的部分旁边。它们发出嗡嗡声，肉眼可见地相互吸引，然后融合在一起。遗物的效果似乎加强了。
paragon.3127.desc.en:
The vegetation peeled back, giving way to a green vista. A beautiful, tamed world, with animal enclosures the size of large forests, containing species from all over the galaxy.

Suddenly, the vision jolted Keides into a room inside a larger building. One wall depicted a map of several star systems. Four stood out clearly from the rest, unconnected by hyperlanes.

Back aboard the ship,Keides set the newest piece of the relic alongside the existing one. Humming, and visibly drawn towards one another, they fused. The relic appears strengthened.

paragon.3130.desc.zh: 如凯德斯的幻视一般，我们在$NAME_Ivusheh$恒星系的一颗行星上观测到了一座舰船之冢。
paragon.3130.desc.en: Just as in Keides's vision, we have observed a graveyard of ships on a planet in the $NAME_Ivusheh$ system.

paragon.3131.a.en: What did he see this time?

paragon.3131.desc.zh:
行星的碎裂表面四散着破旧的舰船。在最大的一处残骸堆中心，凯德斯发现了一座巨大恒星基地的主框架。

把他带到这颗行星一样的不可抗拒的力量又出现了，牵引着凯德斯走向基地内的一个房间。在被尘封的货仓中是遗物的另一个碎片。

在触碰到新发现的碎片的一瞬间，凯德斯被拉入了一个幻视当中。
paragon.3131.desc.en:
The planet's broken surface is littered with battered spacecraft. At the center of the largest debris field, Keides discovered the framework of a colossal starbase.

With irresistible power, the pull of whatever led Keides to the planet drew him to a single room inside the base. Among the dust-covered cargo waited another piece of the relic.

Upon touching the newfound fragment, Keides was plunged into another vision.

paragon.3132.desc.zh:
一座围绕着这颗行星的恒星基地。其船坞中源源不断地涌出战列舰的编队。

在旗舰的甲板上，站立着一位年轻的舰队司令，一手握着一件与遗物相仿的物体。随着他手腕的一挥，飞船外的空间模糊、变暗，然后逐渐折叠显现出一个黑洞。当这位舰队司令命令舰队进入黑暗时，幻象突然结束了。

凯德斯带着碎片回到船上，把它放在现有的碎片旁边。它们都开始发出刺耳的嗡嗡声振动起来。然后，在某种未知力量的作用下，两块融合成一体。事后，遗物的效果似乎加强了。
paragon.3132.desc.en:
A vast starbase orbited the planet. From its docks flowed an unending procession of battleships.

On the deck of the flagship a young admiral stood, grasping in one hand an object resembling the relic. With a flick of his wrist, the space outside his ship blurred, darkened, then folded into itself as a black hole appeared. As the admiral ordered his fleet into the darkness, the vision abruptly ended.

Returning aboard with the fragment, Keides placed it next to the existing piece. Both began to vibrate with a piercing hum. Then, by some unknown force, the two pieces fused into one. After the fact, the relic's effects appear strengthened.

paragon.3135.desc.zh:
在取回最后一块碎片后，遗物恢复如初，仿佛从未发生破碎一样。

随着遗物复原，对其目的进行研究迫在眉睫，且随时可以准备就绪。一项由凯德斯抓总的特殊项目已经准备就绪。
paragon.3135.desc.en:
After the retrieval of the final fragment, the relic appears as if it was never broken.

Upon the relic's restoration, research on its purpose is promising and ready to continue. A Special Project led by Keides has been prepared.

paragon.3140.desc.zh:
对最近复原的遗物进行的研究带来了一些引人注目的发现。

它确实与凯德斯有所联系：当与其瓦格罗基因接触时，遗物中的粒子会开始高频共振。尽管这背后的机制尚不清楚，但这种效应是时空操纵所体现的特征。

在数次尝试测量并控制该过程后，凯德斯经历了又一次幻视。
paragon.3140.desc.en:
Research into the recently restored relic has led to some intriguing discoveries.

Its connection to Keides has been affirmed. When in contact with his Vagrosian DNA, the relic's particles begin to resonate at high frequencies. Although the mechanics behind this remain unknown, the effects are symptomatic of space-time manipulation.

After several attempts to measure and control this process, Keides experienced another vision.

paragon.3141.a.zh: 让我们尽快找到答案吧。
paragon.3141.a.en: Let us find out, sooner rather than later.

paragon.3141.desc.zh:
凯德斯描述了一种仿佛从里面看到遗物的感觉。恒星大小的粒子在他周围旋转。在两者间的虚空中，他经感受到一股力量涌了上来。仅凭双手，他就能指挥球体的运动。

凯德斯从幻象中回来，把手放在了遗物上。现在他已经了解了它的用途，以及它惊人的能力：如果控制得当，它能使空间中的两点坍缩，创造一对稳定的虫洞。瓦格罗人称这种装置为楔。

在他的发现的激励下，凯德斯主动在我们的母星系中打开了一个虫洞。连他自己都不知道这条路通向哪里，但他仍然坚定，相信这很可能是他族人的家园。
paragon.3141.desc.en:
Keides describes seeing the relic as if from within. Particles the size of suns swirled around him. In the void between, he experienced a surge of power. With his hands alone, he commanded the movements of the spheres.

Returning from this vision, Keides placed his hands on the relic. Now he understood its use, and the astonishing scope of its power. When properly controlled, it has the ability to collapse two points in space, effectively creating a stable wormhole. The Vagrosians called this device a Key.

Spurred by his discovery, Keides acted on his own initiative to open a wormhole in our home system. Not even he knows where it leads, but he remains resolute, believing it is likely his people's home.

paragon.3144.desc.zh:
遗物所生成的虫洞的另一端是$NAME_Sursect$星系。进入后不久，我们的传感器发现了一队有敌意的无人机。它们似乎在守护着这个星系唯一的一颗行星。初步的扫描结果显示，那些无人机上没有生命形式的信号，行星上同样也没有。

凯德斯非常确信那颗行星就是他们民族的起源地。毫无疑问答案就在那里。

随后，无人机群向我们发出了通讯要求。
paragon.3144.desc.en:
At the other end of the relic-spawned wormhole lies the $NAME_Sursect$ system. Shortly after entry, our sensors picked up a fleet of hostile drones. They appear to be keeping vigil over the system's single planet. Initial scans suggest there are no life forms present among them, nor on the planet itself.

Keides has stated with certainty that the planet is indeed the origin of his people. It is sure to hold answers.

A demand from the drones to open comms follows.

paragon.3145.a.zh: 遗物是我们的。另寻他法。
paragon.3145.a.en: The relic is ours. Find another way.

paragon.3145.b.zh: 将楔交给他们。我们的安全是首位的。
paragon.3145.b.en: Give them the Key. Our safety is the priority.

paragon.3145.desc.zh:
随着频道开启，尖锐的静电噪音与机器人模拟语音混合在一起。在一个周期内，每个声音都与下一个声音重叠，信息的音量在不规则的波中振荡。

动机：回收楔，违反章程。
瓦格罗之楔，状态：未收集。
瓦格罗帝国章程第412条，状态：违反。

目标行为：归还楔。
应对方式：摧毁目标。
paragon.3145.desc.en:
As the channel opens, screeching static blends with a wash of robotic vocalization. In cycles each voice overlaps the next, the message's volume oscillating in irregular waves.

IMPETUS: key confiscation, charter breach.
VAGROSIAN KEY, STATUS: uncollected.
VAGROS-IMPERIAL CHARTER NO. 412, STATUS: in breach.

TARGET ACTION: return key.
COUNTERACTION: destroy target.

paragon.3146.desc.zh:
合成语音的吱嘎声逐渐放慢，暂时停顿，然后继续说出最后几句话。

瓦格罗之楔，状态：紧急收集。
瓦格罗帝国章程第412条，状态：暂时忽略。

行为：待机。
paragon.3146.desc.en:
The crackle of artificial voices is slowed, halting momentarily, then continues.

VAGROSIAN KEY, STATUS: collection imminent.
VAGROS-IMPERIAL CHARTER NO. 412, STATUS: tentatively omitted.

ACTION: hold.

paragon.3147.a.zh: 我们做出了正确的选择。

paragon.3147.desc.zh:
将楔交给那支舰队后，那些无人机立刻顺着一个它们自己的虫洞离开了。

在那之后，虫洞在它们身后关上了。我们现在可以自由地探索这个恒星系和里面的行星了。
paragon.3147.desc.en:
Upon handing over the Key to the fleet, the drones promptly departed through a wormhole of their own.

Afterwards, the wormhole closed behind them. We are now free to explore the system and its planet.

paragon.3148.desc.zh:
我们发射了一股电磁脉冲，烧毁了这些无人机的电路。

我们现在可以自由探索$NAME_Sursect$恒星系和里面的行星了。
paragon.3148.desc.en:
We delivered an electromagnetic pulse which fried the circuits of the drones.

We are now free to explore the $NAME_Sursect$ system and its planet.

paragon.3149.a.zh: 这仍然算得上是一场胜利。
paragon.3149.a.en: This still counts as a victory.

paragon.3149.desc.zh:
尽管无人机群被击败了，但是它们的制造者也留了一手，让摧毁它们的人也捞不到什么好处。无人机在回应我们的攻击时，启动了自毁程序。残余的东西难以被打捞。

不过，我们现在可以自由地探索$NAME_Sursect$恒星系和里面的行星了。
paragon.3149.desc.en:
Despite the drones' defeat, whoever created them made sure that no one could benefit from their destruction. The drones initiated self-destruct protocols in response to our attack. What little remains is hardly salvageable.

Still, we are now free to explore the $NAME_Sursect$ system and its planet.

paragon.3150.desc.zh: 这颗行星在瓦格罗社会中一定扮演了至关重要的角色。在挖掘初期，很明显，大部分基础设施都以行政工作为中心，这座城市可能是一个通信枢纽。这里还有许多领导层碰面的地方，而且已经发现了几个极大规模的公共广场。
paragon.3150.desc.en: The planet must have played a vital role in the Vagrosian society. Early into the excavations, it has become clear that much of the infrastructure was centered around administrative work, the city potentially serving as a hub for communications. There was no shortage of places for those in leadership to gather, and several public squares of truly massive proportions have already been uncovered.

paragon.3151.a.zh: 真有意思。这是干什么用的？

paragon.3151.desc.zh:
因为很幸运地发现了一座地下保险库，凯德斯兴奋得几天没睡着。他确信这个地方就隐藏着自己身世的秘密。

在保险库的深处，他发现了一排又一排的冷冻仓，但里面都是空的。集成在地板上的电路连向了一座更大的结构：在拱顶的中心有一个像王座一样的基座。
paragon.3151.desc.en:
Thanks to the fortunate discovery of an underground vault, Keides has not slept for days. He is convinced that this place holds the key to his existence.

Deep within the vault, he discovered row upon row of cryostasis pods, all of them empty. Circuits integrated in the floor led to a larger structure: a throne-like pedestal at the very center of the vault.

paragon.3152.desc.zh:
不顾科学小组的抗议，凯德斯毅然决定坐上那台王座般的机器。

他刚一坐下来就失去了知觉。

尽管他的表情变得放松，但他的身体却承受着剧烈的痉挛。科学小组再怎么努力也没能把他从王座上解救出来。几个小时过去了。最后，就在他年轻的身体似乎再也无法承受的时候，凯德斯醒了。他的报告即将发表。
paragon.3152.desc.en:
Against the protestations of the science team, Keides made the decision to sit upon the throne-like machine.

No sooner had he sat down, he lost consciousness.

Even as his expression slackened, his body was wracked by convulsions. No amount of effort from the science team was able to free him from the throne. Hours passed. Finally, just when it seemed his young body could bear no more, Keides awoke. His report is forthcoming.

paragon.3153.desc.zh:
凯德斯看到了一座广场。广场上有成百上千个人。

大家面朝天空，看着一艘巨大的飞船从大气层外徐徐降落。就在此时一个声音响起：

“听着”它说，“审判之日就要到了。楔将会被夺走。你们应留在此地，直到一切的终结。”

人们的哭喊震耳欲聋。在他的幻视中，凯德斯意识到他的星球已经被抛弃了。他们的主人，一个拥有难以想象的力量的外星物种，发现他的人民缺乏潜力。楔（及其产生的虫洞）是连接他的星球和更广阔的星系的唯一途径。一旦与星系贸易切断往来，他的人民繁荣的基础就无可挽回地丧失了。
paragon.3153.desc.en:
Keides saw a public square. Packed inside it were thousands, if not hundreds of thousands of people.

Faces turned to the sky, they watched as a massive ship descended from the upper atmosphere. At once a single voice boomed out.

'Attend,' it said. 'For the time of judgment is at hand. The Keys will be taken. Here you shall remain, until the end of all things.'

The cries of the people were deafening. In the midst of his vision, Keides understood that his world had been abandoned. Their masters, an off-world species of unimaginable power, had found his people lacking. The Keys (and the stable wormholes they produced) were all that connected his world to the wider galaxy. Cut off from galactic trade, the foundation of his people's prosperity was suddenly, and irretrievably, lost.

paragon.3154.a.zh: 他们没有在沉默中死亡。肃然起敬。
paragon.3154.a.en: So, they would not go quietly. Commendable.

paragon.3154.desc.zh:
作为怜悯，瓦格罗人被宽限一个月内交出所有楔和相关材料。事实上，这与其说是怜悯，不如说是侮辱，因为这点时间根本不够他们自救。作为一颗行政管理行星是没有办法维持其庞大人口的。他们所能期望的最好结果就是定量配给他们所拥有的食物，让自己能晚一点挨饿。他们在外面的主人当然了然于胸。

然而，即使在绝望中，这颗星球的领袖也想出了一个计划。最近对高级冷冻保存和基因组学的试验结果基于了给了他们一个不一定能成功的机会。
paragon.3154.desc.en:
As a mercy, the Vagrosians were given a month to yield all Keys and related materials. In truth, it was more insult than mercy and not nearly sufficient to save themselves. As an administrative world, the planet did not have the means to sustain its vast population. The best they could hope for was to ration what they had, delaying the time of their starvation. Their off-world masters were well aware of this.

However, even in their despair, the planet's leaders hatched a plan. Recent forays into advanced cryopreservation and genomics had afforded them an unlikely opportunity.

paragon.3155.desc.zh:
当瓦格罗人的求生计划开始实施时，包含他们未来的“子嗣”凯德斯被发射到太空中，同时被发射的还有他们最后一个楔的碎片，它被分解成四块，四散到星系各处以避免被发现。凯德斯出生时就没有父母，而是基因工程的产物。他的DNA中包含着对他的族人的记忆。当他成年时，只要接触到楔就可以通过幻视来获取这些记忆。

除了这个计划，这个行星的领袖还下令建造数千个冷冻舱和巨大的地下空间来容纳它们。在那里，最聪明的瓦格罗人可以一直休眠，等待“子嗣”的归来。他们确实如此，直到低温冷冻也无法继续支撑他们的身体。他们心智化为数据，在王位里等待着子嗣的归来。
paragon.3155.desc.en:
As the Vagrosian survival plan was set into motion, the pod containing their would-be 'Scion' Keides was launched into space - and with it, a fragment of their last Key, broken into four pieces and sent across the galaxy to avoid detection. Keides was born without parents, the product of genetic engineering. Encoded within his very DNA lay the memories of his people. Upon his maturity, contact with the Key would allow him to access these memories in the form of visions.

Alongside this plan, the planet's leaders ordered the construction of thousands of cryostasis pods and the giant underground space to house them. There, the brightest Vagrosian minds could sleep, awaiting the Scion's return. And so they had, until the cryostasis could no longer support their bodies. Minds reduced to data, they waited for their Scion inside his throne.

paragon.3156.a.zh: 很好。我们期待他的汇报。

paragon.3156.desc.zh:
为了不让他们白白牺牲，凯德斯再次坐回到子嗣王座上。结果这一次事情很快并且一点也不剧烈地就完成了。他的人民的记忆就像溪水一样平静地涌进他的脑海。

有了他祖先的知识和记忆，挖掘工作很快就结束了。凯德斯的下一步行动是处理所有获得的数据，然后撰写报告。
paragon.3156.desc.en:
So as not to squander their sacrifice, Keides once more sat upon the Scion's throne. This time it proved a shorter and less dramatic affair. The memories of his people entered him with the tranquility of a flowing stream.

With his ancestors' knowledge and memories in hand, the excavation was shortly concluded. Keides's next course of action is to process all the obtained data and then report back.

paragon.3160.a.zh: 你没有让列祖列宗丢脸。

paragon.3160.a.response.zh: 我只能尽力而为不辜负他们的期望。这份责任实在是太重大了，但我很愿意承担。
paragon.3160.a.response.en: I can only try to live up to their expectations. It is a great responsibility, but one I willingly accept.

paragon.3160.b.response.zh:
啊。完全修好可以运作了。我们的物理学家应该会继续进行研究并从中得益。

凯德斯一瞬间垂下了目光。

但是这很令人惋惜，因为它已经失去了完整的力量。要打开一个稳定的虫洞，另一头必须要有一个目标系统。我先祖的星球上确有一个这样的东西，但不幸的是我们还没有办法复刻出另一个。
paragon.3160.b.response.en:
Ah. Fully restored and functional. Our physicists should continue to benefit greatly from the research.

Keides drops his gaze momentarily.

It's regrettable, however, that its full power has been lost. To open a stable wormhole, a target system is needed in the system on the receiving end. One such is present on the world of my ancestors. Unfortunately, we do not possess the means to reconstruct another.

paragon.3160.c.en: And now? What will you do?

paragon.3160.c.response.zh:
我愿为你们效劳。

即便至今科学仍是我最热衷的事情。如果说有什么不同的话，那就祖先的记忆激发了我探索的欲望。星系充满了奇迹，耳听为虚，眼见为实。这是谁都说不定的。有朝一日，我愿意见到我人民的家园从今天的遗迹中重建。

但目前而言，我所学到的一切都归功于你们。我期待用这些东西来惠及我的人民。请问哪里最需要我？
paragon.3160.c.response.en:
I am yours to command.

Science remains my passion, even now. If anything, my ancestors' memories have only whetted my appetite for discovery. The galaxy is full of wonder, and there is a difference between knowing and seeing. Who knows? In time I may even see the home of my people restored from the relic it is today.

But for now, all that I have learned is yours. I look forward to applying the lessons of my people. Where am I most needed?

paragon.3160.d.zh: 让科学继续成为你心头的那团火吧。

paragon.3160.d.custom_tooltip.zh: 凯德斯还是一名科学官。

paragon.3160.desc.zh:
凯德斯的耷拉着肩，失去了一贯的活力。最近的事件似乎让他倍感疲惫。不过，他依然面带释然的微笑。

我得到了答案。其中有好有坏，但我很高兴找到了它们。
paragon.3160.desc.en:
Keides's shoulders are slumped, his usual vigor diminished. It would seem recent events have taken their toll. Still, he wears an easy smile.

I have my answers. They may be bittersweet, but I am glad to know them.

paragon.3160.e.zh: 我们的军队需要你的智慧。

paragon.3160.e.custom_tooltip.zh: 凯德斯成为了一名指挥官

paragon.3160.f.zh: 我们的人民需要你的管理。

paragon.3160.f.custom_tooltip.zh: 凯德斯成为一名行政官

paragon.3160.new_focus.zh:
凯德斯敬了个礼。

太好了。不会让你失望的。
paragon.3160.new_focus.en:
Keides salutes.

Very well. I will not fail you.

paragon.3902.desc.zh: 在常规调查中，我们发现这艘舰船一直在激活的星门旁警戒，但是对于我们的呼叫没有任何应答，而且其似乎在处于高功率运转状态。
paragon.3902.desc.en: During our standard survey, we found a hulking ship standing guard near an activated gate. The vessel is not responding to our summons and appears to be at functioning at critical power levels.

paragon.4.a.zh: 我们必须博得他们的信任。

paragon.4.b.custom_tooltip.zh: 我们会教会这些未开智物种崇拜我们。
paragon.4.b.custom_tooltip.en: We will teach this pre-sapient species to worship us.

paragon.4.d.zh: 他们不构成威胁。不理会就行。
paragon.4.d.en: They pose no threat. Leave them alone.

paragon.4.desc.zh:
我们的团队开始着手调查[From.From.GetName]上的建筑。它是一座古老的四棱锥结构。科学家汇报在它的周围区域会听到怪异的低语，因此恰如其分地称之为“低语方尖碑”。

这座金字塔似乎在这个星球上的未开智物种所呈现的基本信仰系统中起着不可替代的作用。一个在这种智慧等级的物种甚至还没有开始使用工具时，却在发展复杂的精神实践，这是非比寻常的。

[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]领地意识很强，而且很容易被激怒。我们的到来打扰到了他们，越来越多的生物聚集到了金字塔附近。我们可能需要一些强制措施才能靠近这座建筑了。
paragon.4.desc.en:
Our team has begun investigating the structure on [From.From.GetName]. It is an ancient four-sided pyramid. Scientists report hearing strange whispers in its vicinity and have aptly named it the 'Murmuring Monolith'.

The Monolith appears to play an integral part in a rudimentary belief system observed by the planet's pre-sapient species. It is unusual to witness a species at this level of sentience developing complex spiritual practices when they have yet to begin using tools.

The [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] are territorial and easily provoked. Our arrival has disturbed them, and more have begun gathering around the Monolith. Gaining access to the structure will require force.

paragon.40100.a.zh: 我们要一个海盗有何用？
paragon.40100.a.en: What need do we have for a pirate?

paragon.40100.a.response.zh: 好吧，说到这个，我更愿意自称为一名私掠者。有些东西你在学校是学不到的。我的专长在于把握时机：什么时候出击，什么时候撤退，在敌人面前摆什么诱饵等等。哪里薄弱我们就袭击哪里，最后在别人意识到发生了什么之前就带着战利品逃走。
paragon.40100.a.response.en: Well, as to that, I prefer to think of myself as a privateer. Some things you just can't learn in an academy. My skills lie in finding opportunities: when to strike, when to retreat, what bait to dangle in front of a foe. We hit hard and where it hurts, and make off with the loot before anyone realizes what happened.

paragon.40100.b.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
paragon.40100.b.en: Why do you wish to join us?

paragon.40100.b.response.zh: 我的船员已经过腻了奔波的日子，想要寻找一处安全的港湾。你的帝国看起足够开放，能允许一群被驱逐的人加入其中。海盗生涯让我们也付出了很多代价，但我们还没打算安定下来，而你这样厉害的赞助人肯定能减轻我们的负担。
paragon.40100.b.response.en: My crew is tired of living a life on the run. We seek a safe harbor. Your empire seems open enough to allow a collection of outcasts into your ranks. Freebooting has cost us much; we're not exactly looking to settle down, but a patron of your calibre could take a certain load off.

paragon.40100.c.response.zh: 不凭什么，就凭我一介宵小之辈的话。如果这还不够，那就再见吧。我就是来提一笔买卖罢了，没指望别的什么。
paragon.40100.c.response.en: No reason, other than the word of a scoundrel. If that's not enough, fare thee well. I propose a deal, nothing more.

paragon.40100.d.response.zh: 逃跑的奴隶、赏金猎人、贪财的雇佣兵……还有一位怪厨子。我们来自星系的五湖四海，在自由和冒险的召唤下走到一起来了。在我去的日子里我们几乎成了一家人。只要听从命令并且不吃掉其他的船员，谁想来加入我都欢迎。我很荣幸能统领这一帮人才。
paragon.40100.d.response.en: Escaped slaves, bounty hunters, soldiers of fortune... Even the odd chef. From all corners of the galaxy they answered the call of liberty and adventure. Over the years we've grown into a family of sorts. I welcome anyone, as long as they follow my orders and don't try to eat any of the others. I consider it an honor to lead them.

paragon.40100.desc.zh:
面部识别扫描确认该个体为李萨拓·辛格，是一位通缉海盗。他狡黠地笑着，礼貌地点了点头。

你好，我是李萨拓船长。我是想来谈合作的。

我指挥着三艘船和一群被遗弃的乌合之众。到目前为止，我们是为……为自己效劳。换句话说，时代变了，我们已经准备好加入一个更大的事业。如果你们赦免我们所谓的罪行并在你们境内帮我们一个安全的避难所，我们将为你们效劳。

你怎么看？要签个合同吗？
paragon.40100.desc.en:
Facial recognition scans identify the individual as Lysator Syng, a wanted pirate. Smiling slyly, he offers a polite nod.

Greetings, I am Captain Lysator. I come to you with an offer.

I command three ships and a rag-tag crew of outcasts. Until now, we have worked... independently. That said, times are changing, and we are ready to join a larger enterprise. If you grant us full pardons for our so-called crimes and a safe haven within your borders, we will work for you.

What do you say? Should we draw up a contract?

paragon.40100.hire_custom_tooltip.zh:
$NAME_xenophile1$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
3艘海盗船被添加到我们的帝国中。
paragon.40100.hire_custom_tooltip.en:
$NAME_xenophile1$ joins our empire as a Leader.
3 pirate ships are added to our empire.

paragon.40110.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]知道很多关于可怕的海盗之王兹泰格·迈尔的故事。几个世纪前，他一路劫掠星系，攫取财富，稀有资源和价值连城的古代文物。现在，多亏了一套古老的星图，[Root.GetFirstName]相信[Root.GetHeShe]已经发现了哲泰格-迈尔藏匿他大量战利品的地方。[Root.GetFirstName]拒绝详细说明究竟是如何获得这些海图的，但可以相信它们的真实性，并希望我们派一艘工程船去挖掘宝藏。如果那儿还有宝藏的话。
paragon.40110.desc.en: [Root.GetName] knows many stories about the dreaded Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr. Centuries ago, he pillaged his way across the galaxy, seizing riches, rare resources and ancient artifacts of untold value. Now, thanks to a set of old star charts [Root.GetFirstName] believes [Root.GetHeShe] has discovered where Zteg-Mayr hid his bountiful booty. [Root.GetFirstName] refused to elaborate on how he acquired the charts, but believes them to be real, and wants us to send a construction ship to excavate the treasure. If there's anything left.

paragon.40111.desc.zh: 我们找到了大海盗兹泰格·迈尔藏匿他的宝藏的地下掩体。这些从许多星球偷来的宝物，现在将造福于我们的民族。
paragon.40111.desc.en: The underground vault containing the treasure of Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr has been breached. This treasure trove of artifacts, stolen from a number of different worlds, will now benefit our nation.

paragon.40120.desc.zh: 我们欢迎[Root.GetName]的传言已经传遍了星系。现在各种被放逐者、恶棍，还有海盗都把我们的帝国看作一个向所有人开放的地方，在这里所以人都可以有新的开始。[Root.GetFirstName]正在利用这一点，重新树立名望，并邀请他以前的熟人加入我们。许多人响应号召，来寻找更好的新生活。
paragon.40120.desc.en: Word of the welcome we extended to [Root.GetName] has spread across the galaxy. Outcasts, scoundrels, and pirates of all stripes now view our nation as open to all, a place where anyone can start over. [Root.GetFirstName] is playing on this and enjoying his newfound fame, and has invited his former acquaintances to join us. Many have answered the call, looking for a new, better life.

paragon.40200.a.en: What can you do for us?

paragon.40200.a.response.zh: 我的特长在于外星学和外交。知识、财富和谈话本身就是我能给予的。毕竟人们除此之外还有什么它求吗？
paragon.40200.a.response.en: My expertise lies in both xenology and diplomacy. Knowledge, credits, and conversation are what I offer. What more could one ask for?

paragon.40200.b.en: Why do you want to join us?

paragon.40200.b.response.zh: 我觉得你们的坦率和诚实很吸引人。你和我一样看到了合作中蕴含的可能性。能和这样开放的灵魂生活在一起是一种荣幸。
paragon.40200.b.response.en: You have an openness and honesty that I find appealing. Like me, you see the possibilities in collaboration. It will be a privilege to live among such open souls.

paragon.40200.c.zh: 你的文化特长是怎么来的呢？
paragon.40200.c.en: How did you come by your cultural expertise?

paragon.40200.c.response.zh: 理解一个外星文化的最好方式就是拥抱它。我初沐爱河是在一颗外星球上，他们的文化深深吸引了我。尽管我们已经不在一起了，但那段感情教会了我宽容和尊重的意义。从那以后，我尝试着在我所访问的地方尽可能多地学习，不再受各种偏见的拖累。
paragon.40200.c.response.en: The best way to understand a foreign culture is to embrace it. I discovered love for the first time on an alien world. I was fascinated by my partner and their culture, and even though we're no longer together, that relationship taught the meaning of tolerance and respect. Since then, I have tried to assimilate as much as I can in the places I visit, free from the burden of judgment.

paragon.40200.desc.zh:
女人带来了惊人的礼物：一块妥善保管的彗星碎片，一块缇扬奇骨雕，和一只装在罐子里的微小软体动物。

你好，我叫诺娜，是科基尔家族的永恒受祝者。我以这些礼物来表达我的尊敬之情。我探索了许多星球，反复学习了许多课程。我愿在你的祝福下学习你们的文化，作为回报，我会向你分享数百个文明的智慧。
paragon.40200.desc.en:
The woman bears fascinating gifts: a preserved shard from a comet, a Tiyanki bone carving, and a tiny molluscoid in a jar.

Greetings, I am Nona, the Eternally Blessed of the House Colzyrion. I offer you these gifts as a token of esteem. I have explored many worlds, and relearned countless lessons. With your blessing, I would like to study your culture, and in return, share the wisdom of a hundred civilizations.

paragon.40200.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_xenophile2$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40200.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_xenophile2$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40210.a.zh: 别介意我们的所作所为。

paragon.40210.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]听说了一支失踪的船队携带了大量财宝的传言。据说有一位外星使者和他的随从被派去给某个军阀带去贡品。在最近的一次任务中，[Root.GetHeShe]准确地定位了船队最后的位置。我们只需要派一艘船去取回它。
paragon.40210.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has heard rumors about the vast riches carried by a lost convoy. It seems that an alien emissary and his retinue were sent to bring tribute to a certain warlord. During [Root.GetHisHer] latest assignment [Root.GetHeShe] was able to pinpoint the convoy's last location. We only need to send a ship to retrieve it.

paragon.40211.desc.zh: 对失踪船队的打捞工作已经完成。所有位于失事地点的资源都已经得到回收。
paragon.40211.desc.en: The salvage operation of the lost convoy has concluded. All of the resources located at the crash site have been recovered.

paragon.40220.a.zh: 他应该还是能有点用的。
paragon.40220.a.en: We can probably find some use for him.

paragon.40220.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 一个叫$NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$的布洛葛作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40220.a.custom_tooltip.en: The Blorg $NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40220.desc.zh: 一位[Root.GetName]曾经的伙伴，布洛葛行政官$NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$希望加入我们的帝国。这位行政官遇上了麻烦，正在寻找重新开始的机会。[Root.GetFirstName]声称这位$NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$对管理矿产星球的经验相当丰富，而那位和善的行政官也带来了一箱珍贵的矿物作为见面礼。
paragon.40220.desc.en: [Root.GetName]'s ex-partner, the Blorg official $NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$, wishes to join our empire. The official has fallen on hard times and is looking for a fresh start. [Root.GetFirstName] claims $NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$ has vast experience in the management of mining worlds, and that the affable official has brought a cache of precious minerals as a token of goodwill.

paragon.40300.a.zh: 你说你是一位舰队司令，你的舰队呢？
paragon.40300.a.en: If you are an admiral, where is your fleet?

paragon.40300.a.response.zh:
羞愧之至，它不复存在了。

我们当时围绕着一颗红矮星进行着紧急维修，而我们的敌人在这时候暗算了我们。他们从四面八方包围而来。

我们以一敌十，在那血色般的恒星光芒中，我仿佛见到了我的舰队和船员们的末日。他们作为施舍饶了我一命。时至今日我还无法洗刷那场失败的耻辱。
paragon.40300.a.response.en:
To my shame, it is lost.

We were orbiting a red star, making vital repairs, when our enemies ambushed us. They came from all directions.

Outnumbered ten to one, I watched as my ships and their crews met their end around that hellish sun. As a parting 'gift', I was allowed to live. Even now, I carry the shame of that defeat.

paragon.40300.b.en: Why do you wish to join us?

paragon.40300.b.response.zh: 你明白，和平是一件以战争作为价码的奢侈品。
paragon.40300.b.response.en: You understand that peace is a luxury bought by war.

paragon.40300.c.zh: 你不应该去侍奉你的亲族吗？
paragon.40300.c.en: Should you not serve your noble House?

paragon.40300.c.response.zh: 夏里登家族和我一同衰败了。我战败后，复仇的渴望蒙蔽了我的双眼。相信我，我的仇敌得到了应有下场。尽管我已经荣誉尽失，但我的技艺将常伴我身。为此我愿以生命起誓。
paragon.40300.c.response.en: House Jariden fell with me. After my defeat, I was consumed by a thirst for vengeance. Believe me, my enemies paid for what they did. My honor may have been taken, but not my skill in battle. On this I pledge my life.

paragon.40300.desc.zh:
男爵身材魁梧。他身上的一切都散发着严格的军旅气息：靴子一尘不染，制服熨得整整齐齐，他的眼神机警而富于计谋。但在严格的外表之外，还有别的东西：他的脸上写满了哀伤。

我可以作为一个舰队司令和战术家为您服务。

接受我的效忠，我就会粉碎那些可能伤害到你的人。
paragon.40300.desc.en:
The Baron is of imposing stature. Everything about him radiates rigid military discipline. His boots are spotless, his uniform neatly pressed, and his eyes are watchful and calculating. But beyond the strict facade, there is something else: his face is a map of grief.

I come to offer my services as an admiral and tactician.

Accept my pledge, and I will crush those who would do you harm.

paragon.40300.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_militarist1$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40300.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_militarist1$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40310.desc.zh: 终于，[Root.GetName]终于从[Root.GetHeShe]家族衰败的情绪低落中恢复出来。在摆脱了负罪和悲痛的枷锁之后，在服务我们的人民中终于找到了[Root.GetHisHer]新的人生意义。
paragon.40310.desc.en: At long last, [Root.GetName] has recovered from the emotional shock of the fall of [Root.GetHisHer] once-proud noble House. Unburdened by the guilt and melancholy, [Root.GetHeShe] has found a new purpose in the service of our people.

paragon.40320.a.zh: 舰队强大的是真的强大。
paragon.40320.a.en: A strong fleet will show them our might.

paragon.40320.b.zh: 后勤补给才是胜利的保障。
paragon.40320.b.en: Superior logistics will lead us to victory.

paragon.40320.desc.zh: 在一场激情似火的演讲中，[Root.GetName]宣称帝国必须将重心放在扩张上。[Root.GetHeSheCap]提交了两个关于给舰队调配更多资源以完成目标的计划。这两者确实对我们的舰队都很有价值，从长远看来也能让我们都收益。然而同时事实两个计划是不可能的。
paragon.40320.desc.en: In a fiery speech, [Root.GetName] declared that the nation's focus must be on expansion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] submitted two plans on how the fleet could use additional resources to further such a goal. Both options are valid and could benefit us greatly in the long run. However, implementing both plans at once is impossible

paragon.40400.a.zh: 等会儿。你怎么会想加入我们？
paragon.40400.a.en: Hold on. Why do you want to join us?

paragon.40400.a.response.zh:
我洗劫过无数的星球。这活儿倒是轻松，只是我已经腻了！那些个废物在官场、艺术和无聊的废话中浪费那么多时间。

她发出野性的嘶声，露出她锯齿状的牙齿。

但你的帝国很强大，你的敌人也是块美味的硬骨头！让我来嚼碎它们吧。我渴望像样的战斗！
paragon.40400.a.response.en:
I have sacked many worlds. And it was easy. And it was boring! The weak waste their time on bureaucracy, art, and senseless blather.

She lets out a feral hiss and bares her jagged teeth.

Your empire is mighty and your foes are worthy! Let me destroy them. Give me a proper fight!

paragon.40400.b.response.zh:
呵！那可真是值得铭记的一天！两年前，我们入侵了一个遥远的星球。我们消灭了一切胆敢防抗的人，夺取了一切值钱的东西，把有价值的人收作奴隶。然后援军来了。

她摸着腰带上的一颗头骨，露出利齿狡黠地笑着。

那是一场血腥的屠杀，一曲残暴的赞歌。最后他们打败了我们，但我的战士们死得其所。我来，为的不是荣华富贵，我想要战斗。
paragon.40400.b.response.en:
Ha! Now, that was a day to remember! Two years ago, we invaded a remote world. We annihilated all who opposed us, seizing everything of value and taking the worthy as slaves. Then the reinforcements arrived.

She touches one of the trophies hanging from her belt. She bares her teeth, grinning.

Such magnificent carnage. An ode to brutality. In the end they crushed us, but my warriors died well. I come to you now not for riches, or glory. I come seeking a challenge.

paragon.40400.c.response.zh: 战争是一种运动，是一种必需品，是一种工具。但是战斗……啊，它能说道的太多太多了。这是检测一个人极限最纯粹的方式。谁能不为这样的前途感到踌躇满志呢？
paragon.40400.c.response.en: War is a sport, a necessity, a tool. But the fight... Ah, now that reveals much. There is no purer way to test one's limits. Who would not be invigorated at the prospect?

paragon.40400.desc.zh:
一队奴隶抬着一乘巨大的轿子，上面坐着一只可畏惧的爬行类。所有关于军阀的刻板印象都可以在她这里找到：大片骇人的伤疤，张扬跋扈的武器，作为杀戮战利品的骨架等等。

我叫基雅·祖蒙，这就是我开出的条件！

她从坐席上起身，随从徐徐跪服在她的身侧。

我将率领你的军队，击溃你的敌人。他们的星球将化为焦土，他们的财宝将为你所得。
paragon.40400.desc.en:
A litter of enormous proportions is carried by a procession of slaves. Atop it sits a formidable reptilian. All the hallmarks of a warlord are there: extensive scarring, brazen weaponry, the skeletal remnants of past kills.

I am Gia'Zumon, and these are my terms!

As she removes herself from the throne, the members of her entourage prostrate themselves before her.

I will lead your armies. I will break your enemies. Their worlds shall burn and their riches will be yours.

paragon.40400.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_militarist2$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40400.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_militarist2$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40410.a.en: Glory awaits him if he joins us.

paragon.40410.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 一位叫$GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$的奇恩舰队司令作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40410.a.custom_tooltip.en: The Tzynn Admiral $GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40410.b.zh: 关于战争他能教授我们一些什么？
paragon.40410.b.en: What can he teach us about war?

paragon.40410.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]赢得过许多战争。[Root.GetHeSheCap]曾经同另一位伟大的勇士，$GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$，一起并肩作战。此人正在寻求新的可以侍奉的主人。他是一位果敢的舰队司令，[Root.GetFirstName]对其大加褒奖。
paragon.40410.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has won many battles. [Root.GetHeSheCap] once fought alongside another great warrior, $GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$, who is looking for a new master to serve. He is a ruthless admiral, and [Root.GetFirstName] speaks highly of him.

paragon.40420.b.en: This is not the way to do it.

paragon.40420.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]坐立不安，渴望战斗。[Root.GetHeSheCap]受够了那些荼毒[coliseum_planet.GetName]的懦夫。[Root.GetHeSheCap]提议建造一座大型竞技场，让荣誉猎手和罪犯身处同一地方。这样一个计划能够为我们的战士提供宝贵的实训机会。
paragon.40420.desc.en: [Root.GetName] is restless and craves a fight. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has had enough of the weaklings that plague [coliseum_planet.GetName]. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has proposed an arena where glory-hunters may be pitted against criminals. Such a plan is sure to provide our warriors with valuable training.

paragon.40500.a.response.zh:
我的特长能够帮上你。让我告诉你什么叫效率。

外星人的触手湿哒哒地在头盔玻璃上扭动着。

强者壮大，弱者灭亡。星系从不缺少工人，我会给你带过来一些。他们要么工作，要么去死。利润则会滚滚而来。
paragon.40500.a.response.en:
You could benefit from my expertise. Let me show you the meaning of efficiency.

The alien's tentacles twitch wetly against the helmet glass.

Reward the strong. Cull the weak. The galaxy has no shortage of workers. I will bring them to you. They will work, or they will die. And the profits will flow.

paragon.40500.b.response.zh:
你们足够纯粹，不和外人搞在一起。

随着可怕的喷溅声，液体充入了头盔。这个外星人挥舞着触手，表现出某种欣快感。

因为我们有一样的价值观。因为我也一样独善其身。
paragon.40500.b.response.en:
You do not mingle with outsiders.

With a hideous sloshing sound, the helmet is flooded with liquid. Tentacles waving, the alien projects a certain euphoria.

Because I share your values. Because I keep myself apart.

paragon.40500.c.zh: 这就是你穿着隔离服的原因？
paragon.40500.c.en: Is that why you wear an environmental suit?

paragon.40500.c.response.zh:
正是。

一阵狂暴的吸气声。

在这里面，没有人能碰到我。在这里面我才感受得到洁净。
paragon.40500.c.response.en:
Just so.

A gurling intake of breath.

In here, nothing can touch me. In here, I am clean.

paragon.40500.desc.zh:
这位外星人被包裹在一个咯咯作响的生命维持装置中。浓稠的液体从管子和通风口流过，他的话语变成了一种潮湿的汩汩声。

你们的工厂太差劲了吧。
paragon.40500.desc.en:
The alien is encased in a gurgling life-support unit. Thick fluid sloshes through the tubes and vents, causing his speech to emerge in a wet gurgle.

Your industrial plants are a disgrace.

paragon.40500.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_xenophobe1$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40500.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_xenophobe1$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40510.b.en: No, we must protect the people.

paragon.40510.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]希望能自动化[planet_governed.GetName]上的物流方案。提出的计划称会将工厂、精炼厂和处理设施通过一个复杂的管道和传送带网络连接起来。该计划在理论上看起来不错，但对生活在附近的人口而言存在风险。工业泄漏、辐射和高频振动之类危险是真实存在的。
paragon.40510.desc.en: [Root.GetName] wishes to automate the shipping methods on [planet_governed.GetName]. The proposed plan would link the factories, refineries, and processing facilities together through a complex network of pipelines and conveyor belts. Although the project looks good in theory, there are risks for the population living nearby; between industrial spillages, radiation concerns and high-frequency vibration, the danger is real.

paragon.40520.b.en: No, this is cruel and unethical.

paragon.40520.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]提交了一项研究计划，旨在评估未来的工业发展。该研究将会惠及经济，并促进[Root.GetHisHer]的个人发展。[Root.GetHeSheCap]准备了一系列非常具有意义、但可能会导致受试目标死亡的实验。[Root.GetHeSheCap]向我们保证这些实验只是需要一些小小的牺牲来成就上善之道。
paragon.40520.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has presented research plans to evaluate future industrial developments. This could benefit the economy as well as [Root.GetHisHer] personal projects. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has prepared a number of experiments that look very promising but would likely kill most of the test subjects. [Root.GetHeSheCap] assures us that a small sacrifice is necessary for the greater good.

paragon.40600.a.response.zh: 每个社会都是一个方程。请让亚图里昂来帮你解它。方程里不需要不确定项。
paragon.40600.a.response.en: Every society is an equation. Allow Aturion to solve yours. There is no need for uncertainty.

paragon.40600.b.en: Why do you wish to join us?

paragon.40600.b.response.zh: 你们的文明接近理想状态。可以在最短的时间内达到完美的平衡。据亚图里昂计算，成功的可能性为91.1%。
paragon.40600.b.response.en: Your civilization approaches ideal conditions. Perfect balance can be attained in the shortest period of time. Aturion has calculated the likelihood of success at 91.1%.

paragon.40600.d.zh: 请说说那些……方程是怎么回事。
paragon.40600.d.en: Tell us more about these... equations.

paragon.40600.d.response.zh: 从机器人胸口的一个端口投射出几十个全息图。它开始了单调乏味的解释，包括统计分析、经济学、心理分析、基因操纵……其中一个全息图是进度条。它表示演示将再持续127.8个标准日。
paragon.40600.d.response.en: From a port on the robot's chest, dozens of holograms are projected. It launches into a droning explanation that includes statistical analysis, economics, psychological profiling, genetic manipulation... One of the holograms is a progress bar. It indicates that the presentation will last another 127.8 standard days.

paragon.40600.desc.zh:
我们的传感器显示该机器人的外壳已经有数百年历史。它的语音缺乏音调，但话语却意外地洪亮。

数据显示你的政府和附属国之间不协调。缺乏纪律。不合格的教化。建议操作：向系统中添加亚图里昂。删除不必要的功能。强调秩序。
paragon.40600.desc.en:
Our scans reveal that the outer shell of the robot is hundreds of years old. Its voice is monotone, but its words are oddly resonant.

Data indicates misalignment between your government and its subjects. Lack of discipline. Substandard indoctrination. Recommended action: addition of Aturion to the system. Eliminate unnecessary functions. Prioritize order.

paragon.40600.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_xenophobe2$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40600.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_xenophobe2$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40610.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]提出了一项人口优化计划，以一些特定的个人自由为代价，将生产力提升至少6.98%。
paragon.40610.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has devised a population optimization plan that, at the expense of certain personal freedoms, would increase production by at least 6.98%.

paragon.40620.b.en: Can't we make it less risky?

paragon.40620.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]开发了一项复杂的改过计划，把社会上那些问题分子改造成勤勉的公民。风险评估估计，17.3%的罪犯将不可能改过自新，这应该被认为是‘可接受的损失’。
paragon.40620.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has developed a complex rehabilitation program to reform the more troublesome elements in our society into diligent citizens. Risk assessment estimates that 17.3% of the criminal population will be impossible to rehabilitate and should be considered 'acceptable losses.'

paragon.40700.a.response.zh: 我是一名为理想而战的士兵。我们教团致力于消除压迫、解放奴隶。我们愿为此抛头颅，洒热血。
paragon.40700.a.response.en: I am a soldier in service to an ideal. My order works to end oppression and free the enslaved. For this we spill our blood.

paragon.40700.b.en: Why do you wish to join us?

paragon.40700.b.response.zh: 你们是一个崇尚平等的文明，所有的个体都能凭借自己的努力而成就伟大。这还不够吸引我吗？
paragon.40700.b.response.en: Yours is a civilization that celebrates equality, where any individual may rise to greatness on their own merit. Is this not reason enough?

paragon.40700.c.en: Tell us more about your order.

paragon.40700.c.response.zh: 超然均衡教的创始人伊斯查顿宣扬平等的教义。自由是美丽而脆弱的。权力不应属于某一只手——它是一种必须共同承担的负担。我的教团成员发誓要维护这些价值观。
paragon.40700.c.response.en: The founder of the Numinous Equilibrium, Yschaton, preached a doctrine of equality. Freedom is as fragile as it is beautiful. Power was not meant for a single hand - it is a burden that must be shared. Members of my order vow to uphold these values.

paragon.40700.desc.zh:
这位武士装备着先进的武器和装甲。扫描显示其体内有高度的生化改造和义体升级。

基恩将军听您吩咐。我是超然均衡教团的一位特使。我被派遣来帮助所有需要消除暴政的人。接纳我的誓言，我的武力将为你所用。
paragon.40700.desc.en:
The warrior is armed with advanced weaponry and armor. Scans reveal extensive biological modifications and cybernetic enhancements.

General Jynn, at your service. I am an envoy of the Numinous Equilibrium. I have been sent to defend those in need and help bring about the end of tyranny. Accept my oath, and I shall put my arms at your service.

paragon.40700.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_egalitarian1$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40700.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_egalitarian1$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40710.a.en: They are welcome to join us.

paragon.40710.a.custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_egalitarian1$的实习指挥官作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40710.a.custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_egalitarian1$'s apprentice Commander joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40710.b.zh: 我们不需要将军，需要军官。

paragon.40710.desc.zh: 超然均衡的特使[Root.GetName]雇了一位学徒。这位有前途的年轻战士想要宣誓效忠于我们。
paragon.40710.desc.en: [Root.GetName], the Numinous Equilibrium's envoy, has taken on an apprentice. The promising young warrior wishes to swear an oath of allegiance to us.

paragon.40720.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]向[Root.GetHisHer]的教团“超然均衡”请求支援，来帮助我们帝国继续对抗暴政和压迫者。为我们运送宝贵合金的货船已经从他们的秘密总部抵达。
paragon.40720.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has requested support from [Root.GetHisHer] order, the Numinous Equilibrium, to aid our empire in the ongoing struggle against tyranny and oppressors. Freighter ships carrying valuable alloys to sustain us have arrived from their secret headquarters.

paragon.40800.a.response.zh:
是啊，宇宙就像音乐一样。环绕着的气态巨行星的振动，新生恒星的咆哮，盘旋原子的甜美歌谣……

她像是在指挥一支看不见的宇宙交响乐队一样挥舞着双手。

哒~哒~啦~噔~，加上合适的节奏，然后：当当！于是我们就创造了魔法！啊不是，科学。差不多一回事，真的。
paragon.40800.a.response.en:
The universe is music. The vibrations from the orbiting gas giants, the roar of a newborn star, the sweet song of swirling atoms...

She gestures with her hands as if she were conducting an invisible cosmic orchestra.

Da da da dum, then add a fitting rhythm and: tadaa! We have created magic! Or, well, science. The same thing, really.

paragon.40800.b.en: Why do you seek to join us?

paragon.40800.b.response.zh:
你们的想法看起来相当合意。我希望自己的发现能造福每个人，而不只是权贵子弟。这支宇宙的交响乐里可包含了奇迹和魔法！每个人都应该听到！

小机器人继续叽叽喳喳。

就是这样戈尔基！你说得一点儿也没错。
paragon.40800.b.response.en:
Your head seems to be in the right place. I want my discoveries to benefit everyone, not just the rich and powerful. The symphony of the universe, the wonders, the magic! Everyone deserves to hear it!

The small robot chirps.

That's right Gorky! Very well said.

paragon.40800.c.response.zh:
欧，这是戈尔基！他是不是超可爱的？他是我自己造的，我做什么他都帮得上忙。

小机器人开心地叽叽喳喳。

好呀，好呀，我会告诉他们的。戈尔基为我安排会见、吃饭、饮水和睡眠的时间。你知道，我要是为一件事着迷的时候，就……咻——地会忘记时间。

小机器人继续叽叽喳喳。

哈哈对！就是就是！
paragon.40800.c.response.en:
Oh, this is Gorky! Isn't he adorable? I built him myself, and he helps me with everything.

The robot chirps happily.

Okay, okay, I'll tell them. Gorky makes sure that I make my meetings, eat, drink and sleep. You know, when I get passionate about something, it's just... swoosh! I lose all track of time.

Gorky chirps again.

Ha ha, yes! Exactly!

paragon.40800.d.en: You say your lab blew up?

paragon.40800.d.response.zh:
哦，哎呀，怎么说呢？！你瞧，我的家乡在关于谁能当科学家这件事可是相当苛刻。所以，我从老旧工业区里搜刮破烂，悄悄组建了自己的实验室。我本以为离子化力场可以让易爆微粒稳定下来，但是……

小机器人一边叽叽喳喳一边发出滴滴声。

对吧？那些微粒的重低音可真是太劲爆了。所以我什么时候可以开始？
paragon.40800.d.response.en:
Oh, wow, where to start?! You see, my homeworld is very restrictive when it comes to who is allowed to be a scientist. So, I put together the lab in secret using whatever I could scavenge from the old industrial zones. Now, I thought the ionization field would keep the volatile motes stable, but...

The small robot chirps and beeps.

Right? The bass from those motes was truly booming. So when do I start?

paragon.40800.desc.zh:
这位科学家全神贯注地看着手中的输入板，手指对着按键上下纷飞。她哼着欢快的旋律，似乎对工作心无旁骛。一个小型机器人同伴漂浮在她旁边的空中，它发出叽叽喳喳的声音，磕了一下她的肩膀。她倏然抬起头。

啊，对不起。你好！我是佐西拉。很抱歉打扰你们，那个，我之前的实验室相当于是，爆炸了。

小机器人又叽叽喳喳了起来。

啊所以，那个，我是说，我想要找一个地方能让我继续作曲。
paragon.40800.desc.en:
The scientist is focused on a tablet in her hand. As her fingers dance over the keys, she hums a cheerful melody. She seems lost in her work and oblivious to the world. A small robot companion floats in the air next to her; it chirps and bumps her shoulder. She looks up.

Oh, sorry. Hello, I'm Zosira. Sorry to bother you, but my last lab, well, it sort of blew up.

The small robot chirps again.

Ah, yes, what I am trying to say is that I'm looking for a place to compose.

paragon.40800.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_egalitarian2$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40800.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_egalitarian2$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40810.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]和[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人伙伴戈尔基花费大部分业余时间进行私人实验。其中一些现在得到了有趣的结果，[Root.GetHeShe]与我们帝国的科学家们分享了[Root.GetHisHer]的发现。
paragon.40810.desc.en: [Root.GetName] and [Root.GetHisHer] robot companion Gorky have spent much of their spare time conducting private experiments. Some of them have now yielded interesting results, and [Root.GetHeShe] has shared [Root.GetHisHer] findings with our empire's scientists.

paragon.40820.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]收养了一只外星生物来陪伴[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人助手戈尔基。它是一只五彩斑斓的未开智软体动物，表现出了不俗的智力，能对口哨指令作出反应。收养这只生物似乎改变了[Root.GetHisHer]的性格，[Root.GetHimHer]变得更加有责任心，更加安定了。
paragon.40820.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has adopted an alien creature to accompany [Root.GetHisHer] robot assistant Gorky. It's a colorful mollusk who, though pre-sapient, exhibits an impressive intellect and responds to whistled commands. Taking responsibility for the creature appears to have altered [Root.GetHisHer] personality, making [Root.GetHimHer] far more responsible and balanced.

paragon.40900.a.response.zh: 我曾经由血肉组成。像其他同类一样，我会受到疾病和年龄的侵蚀。血肉苦弱，因此我放弃了它。我把自己的意识被数字化并上载，成功地从囚禁我的躯体中刑满释放了。
paragon.40900.a.response.en: I was once flesh and blood. Like the rest of my people, I was vulnerable to age and disease. My flesh was weak, so I shed it. My consciousness was digitized and uploaded. I have broken free of the body that held me prisoner.

paragon.40900.b.en: Why do you wish to join us?

paragon.40900.b.response.zh: 迷信、宗教信仰……都是毫无根据的谎言，最后不过是蛊惑人心化为屠戮的热血。那是无数战争和无尽苦难的根源。你和你的人看穿了这些无稽之谈。看得见，尝得到，摸得着的才叫真实。就像要达到完美必须抛弃肉体一样，幼稚的幻想也必须抛弃。
paragon.40900.b.response.en: Superstition, religion... Baseless lies, useful only to inflame the heart to murderous passion. The cause of countless wars and endless suffering. You and your people see through such nonsense. What is real can be seen, tasted, touched. Just as the flesh must be discarded to reach perfection, childish fantasies must be cast aside.

paragon.40900.c.zh: 你是想指挥一支舰队吗？
paragon.40900.c.en: You seek to command a fleet?

paragon.40900.c.response.zh: 你所见到的只是我的一小部分。虚空才是我的归宿，而我只是我舰队的一员。我的意识正扎根在舰船的系统中，传感器就是我的耳目，船壳就是我的肌肤。只要有我的执掌，你的舰队将达到无可比拟的强大。
paragon.40900.c.response.en: The form you see before you is but one part of me. The void is my home, and I am one with my ships. My consciousness is ingrained in their very systems; the sensors are my eyes and ears, the hull is my skin. With me at their head, I can direct your fleets to an unprecedented level of excellence.

paragon.40900.d.zh: 说说你怎么变成这样的？

paragon.40900.d.response.zh: 还有什么可介绍的吗？我的身体生病了。我获得了一个保存意识的机会，然后我就抓住了它。许多其他人也常识这么做，但没有一个活到了现在。
paragon.40900.d.response.en: What is left to say? My body fell ill. I was offered a chance to save my mind, and I leapt at it. Many others tried the same. None survive today.

paragon.40900.desc.zh:
在一架巨大的移动吊臂上悬着一副类人生物的头和躯干。这一定曾经是一个有机生物，但现在大部分已经由金属、电缆和塑料构成。毫无预兆下，那副躯干振动了一下活动了起来，两只合成眼发出光芒，发出嘎吱作响的嗓音。

我是松达尔。我在寻找能效力的人。
paragon.40900.desc.en:
Suspended on a massive mobility crane is the head and torso of a humanoid. Once this must have been an organic being, but most of what remains is metal, wires and plastic. Without warning, the body jolts and comes to life, two synthetic eyes begin to glow, and a crackling voice emerges.

I am Xondar. I seek a command.

paragon.40900.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_materialist1$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.40900.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_materialist1$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.40910.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]声称已经在多方面“改进”了[Root.GetHisHer]的身体。在没有获得允许的情况下，[Root.GetHeShe]为了庆祝[Root.GetHisHer]自己达到了完美的阶段而向整支舰队发送信息，并就此发表了一份宣言称，文明的出路唯有合成飞升：所有有机生命都脆弱不堪，无法逃离死亡。
paragon.40910.desc.en: [Root.GetName] claims to have 'improved' [Root.GetHisHer] physical form in a number of ways. Without permission, [Root.GetHeShe] has sent messages across the fleet celebrating [Root.GetHisHer] perfected state and has released a manifesto claiming that the only viable future for a civilization is synthetic ascension: all organic life is frail and doomed to die.

paragon.40920.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]从国境内所有的舰船传感器上收集数据。使用算法计算重力扭曲后，[Root.GetFirstName]发现了我们的宇域中有一个天体的表面下隐藏着什么东西。如果数据准确无误，那么那颗荒芜的岩石下应该满是稀有合金。[Root.GetFirstName]将此视为一个拓展并升级舰队的好机会，提议派遣一艘工程船去挖取那些合金。
paragon.40920.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has collected sensor data from all ships within the our borders. Using algorithms that calculate gravimetric distortions [Root.GetFirstName] has discovered something hidden beneath the surface of one of the galactic objects in our space. If the data is correct, the barren rock should be filled with rare alloys. [Root.GetFirstName] sees this as an opportunity to expand and upgrade the fleet, and proposes dispatching a construction ship to extract the alloys.

paragon.40921.desc.zh: 在炸开几公里深的岩石后，发现了一批珍贵的合金。我们已经开始了检索操作。
paragon.40921.desc.en: A trove of precious alloys has been uncovered after several kilometers of rock were blasted away. We have started retrieval operations.

paragon.41000.a.zh: 那么你能为我们做什么？
paragon.41000.a.en: So, what can you do for us?

paragon.41000.a.response.zh:
我是一个有三十年经验的打捞者。这简历就已经够牛逼了吧。你要是有什么东西要建造或者修理，

他用大拇指戳了戳自己的胸口。

我都能搞定。我可不是吹牛，我真的什么东西都能修。而且不只有我一个，我还有一支可以拆解、切割、焊接、收集、修理和组装任何东西的订制机器团队。只要你想的话，给我一队人，我就能服务你整支海军。当然，人手越多越好哇！
paragon.41000.a.response.en:
Been a salvager for thirty years. I figure that'll do for a resume. You need things built? Something repaired?

He points his thumb at his chest.

I can do it. Not to boast or anything, but I've fixed everything there is to be fixed. And not just me - I've got a team of custom bots to dismantle, cut, weld, gather, repair and reassemble whatever you need. Gimme a crew and I can service your whole navy if you want. The bigger the better as far as I'm concerned.

paragon.41000.b.response.zh: 我就是满世界跑，为自己谋个出路。你看起来是一个会重视劳动的老板、一位靠谱的领导。你能看清这个世界的本来面目，利用我们所拥有的东西来建设更美好的未来。
paragon.41000.b.response.en: I'm just trying to make my way in the galaxy. You seem like an employer that values hard work and a steady hand. Someone who sees the world for what it is, taking the things we have and using them to build a better future.

paragon.41000.c.zh: 那你为什么从之前的单位离职了？
paragon.41000.c.en: Why did you leave your previous job?

paragon.41000.c.response.zh: 你问真的吗？我腻了。从我记事起，我就梦想在虚空中遨游。我想逼一下自己看看能走多远。所以我就收拾好工具，然后就是现在这样咯。现在，还有别的问题吗？要不我们开建吧！
paragon.41000.c.response.en: Honestly? I got bored. Ever since I can remember I've dreamed of cruising the void. I want to push myself, see how far I can go. So I packed my tools and here I am. Now, unless you have more questions, what do you say we get building?

paragon.41000.desc.zh:
粗短结实的机械装置被挤压在一具外骨骼中。工具、零零散散的零件和油腻腻的手都能看出他是个修补匠，他的眼睛里闪烁着好奇和热情。

早啊老板！我叫博林，诺嘉之子。很高兴认识你！
paragon.41000.desc.en:
The short and sturdy mechanic is squeezed into an exoskeleton. Tools, scattered parts and greasy hands bear the telltale marks of a tinkerer, and his eyes glint with curiosity and enthusiasm.

Mornin' boss! I'm Borin, son of Noga. Pleased to make your acquaintance!

paragon.41000.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_materialist2$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.41000.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_materialist2$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.41010.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.GetHisHer]的房间里闭门数月撰写自传，其中不仅有[Root.GetHisHer]自己的毕生经历，还有[Root.GetHeShe]所了解的工程学研究、建设和稀有材料的知识。只要拜读[Root.GetHisHer]的大作，我们的科学家就一定能有所发现。
paragon.41010.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has spent months in [Root.GetHisHer] cabin writing a self-biography that includes not only [Root.GetHisHer] life story and travels, but also everything [Root.GetHeShe] knows about engineering research, construction, and rare materials. When reviewing his work, our scientists made some interesting discoveries.

paragon.41010.name.en: I Was Born in the Year of ...

paragon.41020.a.en: She has a knack for ships, right?

paragon.41020.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 一位叫$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$的机器人舰队司令作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.41020.a.custom_tooltip.en: The robot Admiral $BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.41020.b.zh: 我们可以把它安排进一些办公室里……
paragon.41020.b.en: We can use her in some office...

paragon.41020.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]建造了一个机器伙伴，叫做$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$。这台机器人具有高级学习能力，并且拥有人格矩阵。它帮助[Root.GetName]进行[Root.GetHisHer]的研究和维修工作。然而，与它的创造者一样，$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$也是好奇心满满，渴望着离开家去冒险。[Root.GetName]问我们，$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$能不能在我们社会中拥有自主的一席之地？
paragon.41020.desc.en: [Root.GetName] built a robot companion named $BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$. The robot is capable of advanced learning, and has a personality matrix. It is assisting [Root.GetName] with [Root.GetHisHer] research and repair jobs. However, like its creator, $BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$ is curious and longs to leave home to embark on its own adventures. [Root.GetName] wonders if $BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$ could play an autonomous role within our society.

paragon.41100.a.response.zh: 我是我族人中少数被选中的大法官之一。这是一个非常光荣的职位。我学习了许多星球的法律，通过长期的经验，我还学会了如何平衡正义的天平。
paragon.41100.a.response.en: I am one of the select few anointed as a Judge among my people. This is a position of great honor. I have memorized the laws of many worlds, and through long experience I have learned how to balance the scales of justice.

paragon.41100.b.zh: 你为什么想与我们共事？
paragon.41100.b.en: Why do you wish to work with us?
