paragon.41100.b.response.zh: 我老了。我在办公室里忙碌了大半生。尽管对我这样的人来说为年轻人让位是再自然不过的，但我还不满足。犯罪是无国界的，我还有很多能做的事。这事众所周知，星系中有很多人来找过我，想让我为他们工作。但为那些用错权力的人工作有什么意义呢？我相信我们是一路人，能为你的人民服务是我的无上荣幸。
paragon.41100.b.response.en: I am old. I have served my time in office. Although it is the custom of my kind to give way to the young, I am not finished. Crime knows no border, and I still have much to offer. This is known, and many in the galaxy have approached me with offers of employment. But what sense is there in working for those who misuse their authority? I believe that our values align on this, and it would be my privilege to serve your people.

paragon.41100.c.zh: 是什么让你选择了法律？
paragon.41100.c.en: What led you to the law?

paragon.41100.c.response.zh:
宇宙就是一位无情的法官。

这位外星老人的咽喉深处发出了可怕暗哑的声音。

作为有情感的生物，我们有责任做得更好。只有理性才能诞生出公平。

他的目光停留在不远处。在那一瞬间他仿佛忘记了自己的存在。

法律的力量必须谨慎使用，不能让它成为不公正的根源。
paragon.41100.c.response.en:
The universe is a merciless judge.

From deep in the old alien's throat emerges an eerie clicking sound.

As sentient beings, it is up to us to do better. It is through reason alone that fairness is born.

His gaze rests in the middle distance. For a brief moment, he seems to forget himself.

The power of the law must be used with caution, lest it become its own injustice.

paragon.41100.desc.zh:
这位外星人身着华丽和繁复的长袍。尽管年事已高，但他的双眼仍旧警觉，透出敏锐的智慧。

向您致敬。我想作为一个和平卫士为您服务。
paragon.41100.desc.en:
The alien is adorned in rich, intricate robes. Despite his obvious age, his eyes are alert and betray a keen intellect.

Salutations. I come to offer my services as a keeper of peace.

paragon.41100.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_pacifist1$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.41100.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_pacifist1$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.41110.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]长期在调查一处境内隐秘发展的犯罪网络。[Root.GetHeSheCap]将许多犯罪头目和海盗与腐败政客和军官勾结的证据整理到了一起。[Root.GetName]采用了新系统来加快此类案件的司法程序，目的是在罪犯有机会离开我们的司法管辖区之前抓住他们。
paragon.41110.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has been investigating a criminal network that has been growing quietly within our borders. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has put together evidence that connects various crime lords and pirates with corrupt politicians and military officers. [Root.GetName] has implemented new systems to expedite judicial proceedings in cases like this, with the intention of catching all criminals before they have a chance to leave our jurisdiction.

paragon.41120.a.en: A great benefit to us all.

paragon.41120.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]花费了[Root.GetHisHer]的大半生学习犯罪的本源和暴力侵犯的动机。[Root.GetHeSheCap]向专家寻求建议，研究其他现存和已故帝国的文化，并使用先进算法来设想一个乌托邦社会可能的样子。[Root.GetHisHerCap]的毕生心血凝聚成了一篇宏大的社会学论文，将会对未来的几代人起到指导作用。
paragon.41120.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has spent [Root.GetHisHer] life studying the nature of crime and the motivation of violent offenders. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has sought advice from experts, studied the cultures of other empires, both living and dead, and used advanced algorithms to envision what a utopian society might look like. [Root.GetHisHerCap] life's work has culminated in a vast sociological essay that will serve as a guide for future generations.

paragon.41200.a.response.zh: 我在庭荠磁舵星姐妹会长大。和其她姐妹一样完成完成学业后，我被委任到了这个外派岗位上。多年来，我一直为别人出谋划策。对此斗胆一言，我还取得了一些小小的成功。
paragon.41200.a.response.en: I was raised in the Sisterhood of the Alyssum Magnetar. When my training was complete, like all my Sisters, I was assigned to an offworld position. For many years I provided counsel, and if I may be so bold as to claim it, I enjoyed some modest success.

paragon.41200.b.en: Why do you wish to join us?

paragon.41200.b.response.zh: 我相信和平是唯一能给我们星系带来稳定未来的东西。外交的艺术如在刀尖上舞蹈。我相信你一定会重视这方面的。
paragon.41200.b.response.en: I believe that peace is the only thing that can create a stable future for our galaxy. The art of diplomacy is a subtle thing. I believe you can respect this.

paragon.41200.c.en: Do you still serve the Sisterhood?

paragon.41200.c.response.zh: 我为一切生命效力。来吧，我们边喝杯热饮边继续这个话题。
paragon.41200.c.response.en: I serve all life. Now come, let's say we continue this conversation over a warm drink?

paragon.41200.desc.zh:
这位女士的服饰和珠宝让人对其生活的奢华窥见一斑。她轻轻一鞠躬后开口说道，

我愿意作为一位总督和一位外交官而效劳。让我成为你的盟友，我能让你在星系的任何一个角落都找到强大的友邦。
paragon.41200.desc.en:
The Sister's clothing and jewelry offer a glimpse into her opulent lifestyle. She bows before speaking.

I offer my services as a governor, and as a diplomat. Make me your ally and I will ensure you have powerful friends, in every corner of the galaxy.

paragon.41200.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_pacifist2$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.41200.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_pacifist2$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.41210.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]因举办奢华宴会而享有盛誉。这些宴会以庭荠磁舵星成员的精彩表演、奇异的食物和饮料以及哲学和伦理讨论而闻名。在这里，人们建立有意，促成交易，解开心结。[Root.GetHisHerCap]将这么多千差万别的人凝聚起来的能力是我们繁荣发展的坚实基础。
paragon.41210.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has garnered a wide reputation for hosting lavish feasts. The gatherings are known for spectacular performances by members of the Alyssum Magnetar, exotic food and drink, as well as philosophical and ethical discussions. Here friendships are formed, business deals are struck and old grievances are forgiven. [Root.GetHisHerCap] ability to unite such disparate individuals lays a solid foundation for our future prosperity.

paragon.41220.a.en: It will be put to good use.

paragon.41220.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]简直是一位劝诱方面的艺术家。[Root.GetHeSheCap]利用[Root.GetHisHer]的人脉和政治影响力从整个星系收集重要信息。[Root.GetFirstName]把[Root.GetHisHer]所有的知识都保存在一件传家宝里：一块浅绿色的水晶，[Root.GetHeShe]偶尔会在[Root.GetHisHer]的奢华宴会上佩戴。当在特定的光谱下观察时，它的秘密就会以一个壮丽光晕的形式投射出来。现在[Root.GetHeShe]认为是时候利用这些知识造福社会了。
paragon.41220.desc.en: [Root.GetName] is a true artiste when it comes to charm and persuasion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has used [Root.GetHisHer] contacts and political clout to gather vital information from all over the galaxy. [Root.GetFirstName] has kept all of [Root.GetHisHer] knowledge in a family heirloom: a pale green crystal that [Root.GetHeShe] occasionally wears at [Root.GetHisHer] lavish feasts. When held up to a specific spectrum of light, its secrets are projected in a magnificent halo. Now, [Root.GetHeShe] believes the time has come to use this knowledge for the good of society.

paragon.41300.a.response.zh: 我是谁这一点都不重要。我想你会更感兴趣我有什么能耐。我是一件利器，只要给我足够的时间，就没有任何人敢反抗你。毕竟，死人是不会背叛你的。
paragon.41300.a.response.en: Who I am is of no importance. Better ask what I can do for you. I am a useful tool. Give me time, and none will dare rebel. After all, there can't be a betrayal if the traitors are already dead.

paragon.41300.b.response.zh: 单打独斗确实有好处，缺点就是不太稳定。在什么都要亲力亲为一段时间后，谁都会感到疲惫。实话说，我已经分了太多的心了。您王座后的阴影正是我最佳的藏身之所。更何况，在这我还可以让我以不同的，更微妙的手段来做事。
paragon.41300.b.response.en: Working as an independent has its perks, but stability isn't one of them. After a while, one tires of playing all sides at once. To be honest, I was starting to attract too much attention. The shadow of your throne is as good a spot as any for me to lay low. Plus it lets me try my hand at a different, more subtle game.

paragon.41300.c.response.zh: 相信？你不可能也大可不必相信我。我只卖给出价最高的人。只要你出价够高，那就没必要担心。此外，要真有人要你相信他，这反倒才相当可疑，甚至可以说是危险。对这种人我会立即派一队人去监听他家，跟踪他，密切关注他遇到的每一个人。
paragon.41300.c.response.en: You can't and shouldn't. I sell to the highest bidder. Just make sure that's you and there's no need to worry. Besides, if someone says that you should trust them, I would say that such a person is suspicious. Perhaps even treacherous. I would immediately send a team to bug their home, tail them and keep tabs on whoever they meet.

paragon.41300.d.zh: 你的武装对一个间谍而言也太重型了点。
paragon.41300.d.en: For a spy, you come heavily armed.

paragon.41300.d.response.zh: 在我这一行，一点意外都能让人死无葬身之地。我更喜欢准备充分一点。
paragon.41300.d.response.en: In my line of work, surprises tend to be fatal. I like to be ready.

paragon.41300.desc.zh:
扫描显示，这个女人的斗篷里隐藏着许多令人震惊的武器。我们找不到任何关于她存在的官方记录，但面部识别算法显示她至少参与了三起备受关注的暗杀。

请允许我省去那些繁文缛节。你是个聪明人，知道宇宙中危机四伏，其中的许多甚至目不可及。只要出个好价钱，我就能让你一窥究竟。
paragon.41300.desc.en:
Scans show that the woman's cloak conceals a truly shocking array of weaponry. We cannot find any official record of her existence, yet facial-recognition algorithms place her in the vicinity of at least three high-profile assassinations.

Allow me to dispense with the formalities. You are no fool. You understand that the universe is full of dangers, most of them invisible. For the right price, I can reveal them.

paragon.41300.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_authoritarian1$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.41300.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_authoritarian1$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.41310.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 25%概率其他帝国对我们的评价降低-25。
paragon.41310.a.custom_tooltip.en: 25% chance other empires' opinion of us changes by -25.

paragon.41310.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]呈递了一个数据库，其中包含了多年来从[Root.GetHisHer]的延伸线人处收集来的敏感信息。这一巨大的数据库包括军事部署计划、秘密研究、意识读取数据在内的等等信息。这些东西当然极具价值，但使用这些信息可能会加剧内部和外部冲突。
paragon.41310.desc.en: [Root.GetName] presents a database containing sensitive information gathered over the years from [Root.GetHisHer] extensive contacts. The massive cache includes everything from schematics over military installations, secret research, and extracts from mind probing. What is offered is valuable, but using the information may escalate internal as well as external conflicts.

paragon.41320.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]在整个星系中继续铺展开[Root.GetHisHer]的线人网络。有些人是自愿告密的，而另一些人则是被勒索或洗脑的。但不管怎么样，[Root.GetHeShe]收集到的信息都会非常有用。
paragon.41320.desc.en: [Root.GetName] has grown [Root.GetHisHer] network of contacts throughout the galaxy. Some are willing informants, while others are blackmailed or brainwashed. In any case, the information [Root.GetHeShe] gathers will be extremely beneficial.

paragon.41400.a.en: What exactly can you do for us?

paragon.41400.a.response.zh:
我们都明白一些道理。比如平民是懒惰的。他们总是要求更多的权利，更高的工资，更多的自由……如果不加以控制，他们就会把本该属于您的东西塞进肚子里！但如果让我负责的话……

他慢慢地攥紧拳头。

给我一颗行星，我会把这些思想残渣从他们的脑子里榨出去。然后他们将对您感恩戴德，伟大的王。欧！他们真会如此！
paragon.41400.a.response.en:
We both know how things are. The commoner is lazy. Always demanding more rights, higher wages, more freedom... Left unchecked, they would stuff their bellies with what rightly belongs to you! But if I were placed in charge...

Slowly, he clenches a fist.

Just give me a planet, and I will squeeze these silly notions from their heads. They will show gratitude, Glorious One. Oh! They will indeed!

paragon.41400.b.en: Why do you seek to join us?

paragon.41400.b.response.zh:
谁会放弃为这样伟大的您效劳的机会呢？

他期待地咯咯笑了起来。

有些人生为王者，其他人就应当臣服。这就是万物之理。您可以信任我。我会忠诚地为您效劳。
paragon.41400.b.response.en:
Who would not leap at the chance to serve such majesty?

He giggles with anticipation.

Some are born to rule. The rest must be led. That is the order of things. You can trust me. I will serve you faithfully.

paragon.41400.c.response.zh: 哦，圣洁的王！这只我的真实感想！请让我继续说下去好吗？和您相比，我不过是一坨烂泥、一只在泥土里蠕动的幼虫！赞美您是我的荣幸和特权。仅仅是您的存在就使我满心欢喜。请允许我以无限的忠诚为您服务!
paragon.41400.c.response.en: Oh, most Exalted One! This is but a taste! Shall I go on? Compared to you, I am but slime. I am but a larva wriggling in the dirt! Praising you is my honor and my privilege. Your mere Presence floods me with joy. Let me serve you with boundless devotion!

paragon.41400.desc.zh:
这位外星人的皮肤闪烁着粘稠的分泌物。他煞费苦心地深鞠了一躬。但当他一开口，声调却像孩子一样出奇地尖细。

这位大人，欧！至高无上的统治者。我，看守人喀·拉，只是您卑微的仆人。您的每句话都是命令。让我管理一颗你的星球，我会给您带来荣耀和财富。啊，那么多的财富！
paragon.41400.desc.en:
The alien's skin glistens with viscous secretions. He bows elaborately from the waist. When he speaks, his voice is surprisingly high pitched, almost childlike.

My lord, Your Honor, Oh! Supreme ruler - I, Q'la-Minder, am but your humble servant. Your word shall be my command. Let me take charge of one of your planets, and I will bring you glory and wealth. Oh, so much wealth!

paragon.41400.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_authoritarian2$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.41400.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_authoritarian2$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.41410.a.zh: 我们还能指望他什么呢？

paragon.41410.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]，那位奢靡无度的行政官，在[planet_governed.GetName]为[Root.GetHimselfHerself]建造了一座豪华的宫殿。这座宫殿既彰显着[Root.GetHisHer]的权利和财富，也让[Root.GetHisHer]的浮夸和腐朽显露无疑。为了庆祝宫殿落成，[Root.GetHeShe]将举办一场盛大的宴会，所有的显赫人物都受邀出席。[Root.GetHeShe]还会罕见地一示慷慨，与百姓分享一些[Root.GetHisHer]的财富。
paragon.41410.desc.en: [Root.GetName], the decadent official, has built an extravagant palace for [Root.GetHimselfHerself] on [planet_governed.GetName]. This palace is as much a symbol of [Root.GetHisHer] power and wealth as of [Root.GetHisHer] vanity and corruption. To celebrate its completion, [Root.GetHeShe] will hold a grand feast, to which everyone of importance has been invited. And in a rare show of generosity [Root.GetHeShe] has also shared some of [Root.GetHisHer] riches with the population.

paragon.41420.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]，那位奢靡无度的行政官，其贪污腐败行为暴露了。这一现象已经持续了挺长的时间，[Root.GetHeShe]不仅将[Root.GetHisHer]的财产存入银行，还藏匿于地下金库和星系各处的深空贮藏中。在面对质问时，[Root.GetHeShe]涕泗横流，拿[Root.GetHimselfHerself]的头抢地，信誓旦旦地保证这些财产的根本目的是为统治者准备的献礼。
paragon.41420.desc.en: [Root.GetName], the decadent official, has been caught embezzling. This has been going on for quite some time, and [Root.GetHeShe] has stashed [Root.GetHisHer] wealth not just in bank accounts but also in underground vaults and deep space depots all around the galaxy. In face of the charges, [Root.GetHeShe] threw [Root.GetHimselfHerself] to the ground, swearing that these items were intended as gifts for the ruler.

paragon.41500.a.zh: 你能说说我们的命运吗？
paragon.41500.a.en: What can you say about our destiny?

paragon.41500.a.response.zh:
他仿佛用那双盲眼凝视着。

在一条路上，白色的火焰在虚空中燃烧。另一条则覆满飞溅的余烬。你们将面对恐怖，那将是你们的毁灭。除非？命运之线织出最微弱的希望。厄运或许可以避免。
paragon.41500.a.response.en:
He stares with blind eyes.

On one path, a white flame burns against the void. Along the other lies a sputtering ember. You will face Terror, and it shall be your undoing. Unless? The threads of fate weave the thinnest hope. Doom may yet be averted.

paragon.41500.b.en: Why do you seek to join us?

paragon.41500.b.response.zh:
他从一个隐藏的袋子里扔出一团旋转的尘埃。当他说话时，就通过这样的方式做出宣告：

我受到召唤而来。你们必会或必将遇见我。
paragon.41500.b.response.en:
From a hidden pouch he flings a swirling cloud of dust. When he speaks, he does so as a proclamation:

I came because I was called. You have sought me out. Or perhaps you will.

paragon.41500.c.en: What exactly will you do for us?

paragon.41500.c.response.zh:
从长袍的内袋中，$NAME_spiritualist1$翻出了一套雕刻的骨头。将它们抛到地上后，他似乎在通过某种超越视觉的感官在观察这些骨头的摆放。

我会与信徒分享我之所见。我会在你的民族之船即将坠入风暴时将它扶正。
paragon.41500.c.response.en:
From the folds of his robes $NAME_spiritualist1$ produces a set of carved bones. Scattering them across the floor, he appears to study the pattern with senses beyond sight.

I will share my visions with the faithful. I will right the ship of your nation as it prepares to plunge into the storm.

paragon.41500.d.en: How did you come by your gifts?

paragon.41500.d.response.zh:
许多年前，我在一个行星矿坑里辛苦工作。虽然我的肉眼能看见，但我的心之眼却被物质世界蒙蔽了。后来，我觉醒的那一天到来了。

他们说这是意外，但我知道这是天意。突然的爆炸声炸裂了我的视觉神经。在随后的黑暗中，我看到了时间之河。直到今天，它还在我眼前汩汩流淌。
paragon.41500.d.response.en:
Many years ago, I toiled in the pits of a planetary mine. Though my physical body could see, my soul was blinded by the material world. Then came the day of my awakening.

They called it an accident, but I know it was providence; a sudden explosion fried my optical nerves. In the darkness that followed, I perceived the river of time. To this day, it flows before my eyes.

paragon.41500.desc.zh:
这位外星人一动不动。

命运指引着我的每一步。我穿越了无边的黑暗来到你的面前。我是神谕者尤拉斯塔尔。
paragon.41500.desc.en:
The alien is motionless.

Fate guides my steps. I have crossed the blind reaches to stand before you. I am Ulastar, the Oracle.

paragon.41500.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_spiritualist1$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.41500.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_spiritualist1$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.41510.a.zh: 伟大的荣耀等待着我们。

paragon.41510.desc.zh: 多年来，神秘人[Root.GetName]解读了许多揭示更大命运的征兆和预示。现在，[Root.GetSheHe]宣称预见到了整个星系将会统一在一面旗帜下的画面——而那正是我们的旗帜。真正的辉煌还在后头。
paragon.41510.desc.en: For many years, [Root.GetName] the Mystic has interpreted signs and portents that reveal a greater destiny. Now, [Root.GetSheHe] claims a vision of the galaxy united under a single banner - our own. The real splendor is still to come.

paragon.41520.a.zh: 他们将会加入我们的族群。
paragon.41520.a.en: They will be a part of our flock.

paragon.41520.a.custom_tooltip.zh: 在[event_target:planet_governed.GetName]增加300个唯心主义的灵能人口。

paragon.41520.desc.zh: 多年来，[Root.GetName]一直通过强大的灵能梦向虚空呼喊。现在，几艘载有许多物种成员的民用飞船出现在[planet_governed.GetName]轨道上。他们愿意为我们服务，以期和他们的先知一起生活。
paragon.41520.desc.en: For years, [Root.GetName] has been calling out into the void via powerful psionic dreams. Now, several civilian ships carrying members of many species have appeared in orbit around [planet_governed.GetName]. In exchange for a chance to live with their prophet, they are willing to serve us.

paragon.41600.a.zh: 纤尘与迷思是什么东西？

paragon.41600.a.response.zh:
他微笑了起来，皮肤为之绷紧。

星系非常古老。在你们之前，已有无数的文明兴起又衰败。纤尘是他们的遗产，迷思是我们的传承。我尝试发掘过去的真相，让人可以铭记，可以学习。
paragon.41600.a.response.en:
His smile strains the surface of his skin.

This galaxy is old. Long before yours came to be, countless other civilizations rose and fell. Dust is their legacy, and myth our inheritance. I seek to uncover the truth of the past, that it may be preserved. That it may be learned from.

paragon.41600.b.en: And this is why you've come?

paragon.41600.b.response.zh: 这不止是为了我自己的好处，我保证。历史之赋予远超我们的想象，我将与你分享。
paragon.41600.b.response.en: It is not only for my own benefit, I assure you. No, the riches of the past are beyond counting. I would share them with you.

paragon.41600.c.zh: 你通过考古得到了什么呢？
paragon.41600.c.en: What have you gained from your excavations?

paragon.41600.c.response.zh: 文物、智慧、景观……但不止于此。过往的一切皆有回声。是不是听起来有点自相矛盾？明明我们在与遗忘抗争，却往往忘记去倾听。
paragon.41600.c.response.en: Artifacts, wisdom, splendor... But not only this. All things have their echo in the past. Paradoxical is it not? How in our fight against oblivion we often forget to listen.

paragon.41600.desc.zh:
这位男子形如枯骨，饱经风霜：他精美的服饰几乎褪色殆尽，他的皮肤如羊皮纸般干燥粗糙，他的嗓音近乎低语。

吾名为纳苏兹·德墨忒尔。吾身为纤尘与迷思所化。感谢您接纳我。
paragon.41600.desc.en:
The man is thin to the point of starvation. There is a sense of decrepitude about him: his fine clothes are faded, his skin as dry as parchment, and his voice rises barely above a whisper.

My name is Nasuz Demetor. I am a collector of dust and myth. Thank you for receiving me.

paragon.41600.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $NAME_spiritualist2$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
paragon.41600.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $NAME_spiritualist2$ joins our empire as a Leader.

paragon.41610.desc.zh: 档案员[Root.GetName]发现了一处远古遗物的储藏地。[Root.GetHeSheCap]从古老的传说和漫游海盗交易的传感器日志中拼凑出他们的行踪信息。这些神秘物体的起源尚不清楚，但通过吸收低频声音，它们会偶然产生轻微的时间扭曲。这项技术应该是有益的。
paragon.41610.desc.en: [Root.GetName] the Archivist has discovered a cache of ancient relics. [Root.GetHeSheCap] pieced together information of their whereabouts from old myths and sensor logs traded from roaming pirates. The origin of the mysterious objects remains unclear, but by absorbing low frequency sound, they occasionally produce slight temporal distortions. The technology should prove beneficial.

paragon.41620.a.zh: 谁知道会不会发现什么好东西？
paragon.41620.a.en: Who knows what treasures we might find?

paragon.41620.a.custom_tooltip.en: A new archaeological site is discovered on [event_target:nasuz_arcsite_planet.GetName].

paragon.41620.desc.zh: 档案员[Root.GetName]截获了一条奇怪的信息。这些信息在星际间回荡了数千年，受到严重的静电噪音影响。它包含了来自外星文明的问候，以及他们家园的精确位置。这个物种已经灭绝了很长一段时间，但在它们的母星上可能仍然有重要的遗迹和远古的知识有待发现。
paragon.41620.desc.en: [Root.GetName] the Archivist has intercepted a strange message. Distorted by static, the message has reverberated between the stars for millennia. It contains a greeting from an alien civilization, as well as the precise location of their home world. The species has been extinct for quite some time, but there may still be important remnants and ancient knowledge to uncover on their home planet.

paragon.5.desc.zh:
在与[beholder_planet.GetName]上的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]共处了一段时间后，他们不再那么害怕我们了。我们对其社会结构建立了基本的理解。

$paragon_whispering_info$
paragon.5.desc.en:
After spending some time with the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] on [beholder_planet.GetName], they appear less frightened by us. We are building a basic understanding of their social structures.

$paragon_whispering_info$

paragon.5004.a.tt.zh: 解锁统一承诺议程，在统一承诺局势的期间改善基于思潮的议程。
paragon.5004.a.tt.en: Unlocks the Unifying Promise Agenda which improves Ethic-based Agendas for the duration of the Unifying Promise Situation.

paragon.5004.desc.zh:
[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]结束了我们的内斗，带来了大一统。[Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap]在一个爱国团结的帝国中上独掌大权，允诺带领我们去到繁星间，并创建一个伟大的星际帝国。

今天，我们的人民已经失去了耐心，异见的声音正在拷问我们的领袖是否有能力胜任。内阁准备了一个三十年的计划来让他们息声，并带领我们的物种走向一个新的时代。
paragon.5004.desc.en:
[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] put an end to our internal strife and brought about the Unification. [Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap] came to power on a platform of patriotic unity and imperialism, promising to lead us into the stars and create a grand galactic empire.

Today, our people grow impatient, and dissident voices question our leadership abilities. The council has prepared several 40-year plans that will put these doubts to rest, and propel us into the next age of our species.

paragon.5005.desc.zh:
新的殖民地是履行[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]允诺的第一步。

殖民船被永久地转化成了新定居点的行政中心。我们正如火如荼地将其反应堆核心连接进电网，为殖民地发展提供能源。

随着无数的殖民者从船上登陆，围绕着殖民船巨大的船体，各种简易搭盖的住所和棚户如雨后春笋般出现。以这些建筑作为基础，有朝一日此地将会成为[Root.GetName]上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]城市。
paragon.5005.desc.en:
This new colony is the first step towards fulfilling the [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]'s promise.

The colony ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement. Work has begun to connect its reactor core to the power grid to supply the growing colony with energy.

As colonists disembark in large numbers, makeshift dwellings and shelters have been erected around the former starship's massive hull. These will form the basis of what will one day be the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on [Root.GetName].

paragon.5008.a.tt.zh: 尽管人们还是支持[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]，我们事实上并没有完成我们的允诺，这会威胁到我们的政府。
paragon.5008.a.tt.en: Although people still support [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle], we did not in fact fulfill our promise and this undermines our government.

paragon.5008.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

在接下来的信息中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]告诉[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]应当放下旧的疑虑，展望未来。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap]指出了我们共同取得的伟大成就，并指出让我们的过去错误阻碍我们前进是极其不合理的。如果[Root.Owner.GetName]能够团结一致，就没有什么是我们无法克服的！

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5008.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

In the message that follows, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] tells the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to cast aside old doubts and look to the future. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap] points to the great things we have achieved together, and to the irrationality in allowing our past mistakes to hold us back from progress. If the [Root.Owner.GetName] stand together as one, there is nothing we cannot overcome!

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5009.a.tt.zh: 我们已经完成了对公民许下的每一项承诺和愿景。
paragon.5009.a.tt.en: We delivered on every promise and expectation of our citizens.

paragon.5009.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

在接下来的信息中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]面前赞扬了某些特定个人的成就——包括[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]自己的成就。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap]接着列举了我们共同取得的伟大成功，从一次光荣的成功到下一次，构筑起一个更加美好的未来。

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5009.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

In the message that follows, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] regales the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] with praise and stories on select individuals' accomplishments - including [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] own. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap] goes on to list what we have achieved together, one glorious success after the other, building up to a promise of an even greater future.

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5010.a_tt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的居民会建设一座献给[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]的纪念碑。
paragon.5010.a_tt.en: The inhabitants of [Root.GetName] will build a monument dedicated to their [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle].

paragon.5010.b_tt.zh: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]将以个人名义帮助建设流程。
paragon.5010.b_tt.en: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] will personally help with the construction process.

paragon.5010.c_tt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的居民会用筹集到的资金来进行另一项计划。
paragon.5010.c_tt.en: Inhabitants of [Root.GetName] will use the gathered funds to pursue another project.

paragon.5010.desc.zh:
在[Root.GetName]上新建的城市是一道靓丽的风景线。凭借奋斗与决心，殖民者成功地在新星球发展兴旺。

[Root.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]决定建造一座纪念[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的纪念碑以彰显忠诚。
paragon.5010.desc.en:
The new cities built on [Root.GetName] are a sight to behold. Through grit and determination, the colonists have managed to thrive on a new world.

[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] citizens on [Root.GetName] decided to show their loyalty by erecting a monument to honor [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName].

paragon.5011.a.response.zh: 随着这座[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的纪念碑揭幕，人群中爆发出了欢呼和掌声。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]自豪地伫立着，眺望着地平线，以及我们那光辉的未来。这是我们第一次征服了一颗新的星球！
paragon.5011.a.response.en: The crowd erupts in cheers as the monument of [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] is unveiled. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] stands proudly, looking towards the horizon and the glorious future that awaits us. For the first time, we have conquered a new world!

paragon.5011.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕被打断了播放安排，开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。

今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的殖民者想赞扬我，但今天，我想感谢你们每一位的辛勤劳动。[Root.Owner.GetName]万岁！
paragon.5011.desc.en:
Every state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands in front of a veiled monument.

Today, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. With my guidance, with your hard work, no obstacle shall stand in our way! The colonists of [Root.GetName] wished to honor me, and I thank them. Glory to the [Root.Owner.GetName]!

paragon.5012.a.response.zh: 随着这座以[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]被其他[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]英烈环绕着为主旨的纪念碑揭幕，人群中爆发出了欢呼和掌声。他们团结地矗立着，一个国家凝聚在了一个共同的目标上。
paragon.5012.a.response.en: The crowd erupts in cheers as the monument of [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName], flanked by the heroic frames of other [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is unveiled. They stand united, a nation focused on a common goal.

paragon.5012.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕突然中断了正常的播放，然后开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。画面中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。

今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的居民想以此赞扬我，但今天，我们应为在一起奋斗过感到光荣，让我们携手步入成功！
paragon.5012.desc.en:
Every state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands in front of a veiled monument.

Today, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. With my guidance, with your hard work, no obstacle shall stand in our way! The colonists of [Root.GetName] wanted to honor me, but today, all are honored equally. United we triumph!

paragon.5013.a.response.zh:
这就是我拒绝让这些自豪的殖民者以我的名义建造一座纪念碑的原因。相反，这些资金将被用在城市建设上。繁荣在等待我们！

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5013.a.response.en:
This is why I refused to have these proud colonists build a monument in my name. Instead, the funds are to be used for city building. Prosperity awaits!

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5013.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕突然中断了正常的播放，然后开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。画面中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。

今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的居民想以此赞扬我，但他们才是我们人民真正的英雄。我只不过是一介人民公仆，有了你们，我们才能迈入光明的未来。
paragon.5013.desc.en:
Every state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands in front of a veiled monument.

Today, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. The people of [Root.GetName] wanted to honor me today, but they are the real heroes of our people. I am but a servant of our nation. Thanks to you, we take another step towards a brighter future!

paragon.5014.desc.zh:
内阁已经不堪重负。

尽管[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的能量似乎无穷无尽，但治理一个星际帝国的工作量已使内阁成员们超负荷工作。尽管如此，仍然有一些问题尚未解决，有必要将一部分担子分出去，让其他人处理。
paragon.5014.desc.en:
The council is overwhelmed.

While [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s energy seems unlimited, the councilors are overworked by the demands of a galactic empire. Issues have been left unresolved, and it will be necessary to pick up some of the slack.

paragon.5020.a.tt.zh:
只有授予[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]无限的权力，我们才有可能统治繁星。从现在起，[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]对内阁拥有绝对的权威。愿[owner.Ruler.GetHisHer]的统治长久而繁荣！
这将强化[owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的统治，但可能在未来造成严重的后果。
paragon.5020.a.tt.en:
Only by granting unlimited power to the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle], can we hope to rule the stars. From now on, the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] will have absolute authority over the council. May [owner.Ruler.GetHisHer] rule be long and fruitful!
This will strengthen [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s rule, but might have dire consquences in the future.

paragon.5020.b.tt.zh: 我们的人民深信[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]将引领大家前往繁星，但从未同意创造一个世袭头衔或施行帝制。用这样的方式攫取权力是暴政。维持现状才能稳定国家。
paragon.5020.b.tt.en: Our people entrusted the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] to guide them to the stars, but they never agreed to a royal title or imperial rule. Seizing power like this would be tyranny. Holding the status quo should stabilize the nation.

paragon.5020.desc.zh:
尽管[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]已经倍加努力，但仍有许多事务有待完成。整个帝国是由许多互相矛盾的派系组成，人们是在[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]不断的努力下才团结起来。

尽管[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]未曾想过要改革大一统后形成的政府，但一种新的、更直接的体制可以解决其中一些问题。另一方面，这样的决定可能会激起反对意见。
paragon.5020.desc.en:
Despite [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s work, there is still much to be done. The empire consists of conflicting factions, and the population is united only through the constant effort of the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle].

Although [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] did not wish to change the post-Unification government, a new, more direct approach could remedy some of these problems. On the other hand, such a decision may encounter significant opposition.

paragon.5021.a.en: The military must play a central role.

paragon.5021.c.zh: 法律与秩序是至高无上的。

paragon.5021.d.en: Our nation is open to all.

paragon.5021.desc.zh:
消息如野火般蔓延开。几位官员签署同意之后，一场盛大的登基仪式在全国范围内进行播报。大多数[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都为[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]能够完全地掌握国家而感到欢欣鼓舞。

在这一片欢腾的场景之下，掩藏着不可明说的问题和各类不确定情况。新的帝国将会是什么样的呢？
paragon.5021.desc.en:
The news spread like wildfire. A few official signatures later, and a grand coronation ceremony was broadcast to the nation. The majority of [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are happy that [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] will now have full control of state.

While the mood is festive, unspoken questions and uncertainties remain. What will this new empire look like?

paragon.5021.e.zh: 和平将为我们带来繁荣。
paragon.5021.e.en: Peace will bring us wealth and prosperity.

paragon.5021.f.en: Progress will lead us to greatness.

paragon.5021.g.zh: 帝国将会成抵御外星威胁的铜墙铁壁。
paragon.5021.g.en: The Empire will be a shield against the xeno threat.

paragon.5023.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]的讯息强调了今天是一个光荣的日子！这个联邦的建立确实是一件值得庆祝的事情。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap]谈到了我们与盟国们构筑的纽带，阐明同[your_ally.GetName]的合使两国迈入全新的时代。一个充满伟大和繁荣的黄金时代！

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5023.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]'s message highlights what a glorious day this is! The founding of this Federation is truly a cause for celebration. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap] speaks to bonds we forge with our allies, stating that cooperation with the [your_ally.GetName] will usher in a new age. A golden age of greatness and prosperity!

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5025.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

宣言的重点放在了[your_ally.GetName]，该国承认了我们的优越性，服从我们的统治和指导！该国的明智和信任将得到应有的回报，我们希望其他国家也能做出正确的选择，向我国臣服。

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5025.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

The announcement is focused on the [your_ally.GetName], who have recognized our superiority and submitted to our rule and guidance! Their wisdom and trust will be duly rewarded, and we hope that other nations will also make the right choice and submit.

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5027.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

前方传来签署和平条约的新闻，同时人们又听说我们的敌人被迫接受巨大的让步，因此欢欣鼓舞。我们见证了在光耀者的指引下获得的胜利！

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5027.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

The people rejoice as news arrives of a signed peace treaty and the vast concessions our foes were forced to accept. We stand witness to the triumpth of Luminary guidance!

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5029.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

今天对于[Owner.GetName]来说是一个悲惨的日子。侵略者的残忍行径在新闻推送中得到了充分的展示，[Ruler.GetName]强调在这个黑暗时期团结一致是尤其必要的。[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]郑重承诺，确保实现可能的最好结果，同时此类事情不再发生。

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5029.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Today is a grim day for the [Owner.GetName]. The brutality of the invaders is on full display in the news feed, as [Ruler.GetName] underlines the necessity of working together during these dark times. [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] makes a solemn vow to ensure the best possible outcome, and to never let this happen again.

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5033.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]保持沉默。新闻中显示[Owner.GetName]签署了附庸条约。尽管我们始终相信光耀者的统治，但是这一刻无疑是我们文明一个不可避免的挫折。

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5033.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] is silent. The newsfeed shows the signing of [Owner.GetName]'s contract of vassalization. Despite our trust in the Luminary's rule, this moment signifies an undeniable setback for our civilization.

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5038.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

今天是一个命运攸关的日子。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]自豪地宣布，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]带来了一个消息：星海共同体已经选举我们成为至高无上的星海监管人。他们承认只有我们才有能力确保这个星系的安全。我们被赋予了巨大的权力，我们的职责不仅仅是履行各国的期许，更是要将其超越。

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5038.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Today is a fateful day. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] stands proudly as [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] the news is delivered: the Galactic Community has elected us to supreme Custodianship. They have recognized that we alone are poised to ensure the safety of this galaxy. We have been granted great power, and it is our duty to not only meet, but surpass all expectations.

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5039.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

今天是我们胜利的日子！星海参议院任命[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]为星海帝国的皇帝。为了表示敬意，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]发誓要把已知的星系及其人民带入一个新的繁荣时代——从现在开始，直到永远！

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5039.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Today is the day of our triumph! The Galactic Senate has appointed [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] Emperor of the Galactic Imperium. In salute, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] swears to usher the known galaxy and its peoples into a new age of prosperity - from now, and to eternity!

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5050.desc.zh:
我们的意识形态反对者已经形成了一个强大的政治集团。他们呼吁他们的支持者聚集在一起，和平抗议他们认为由[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]所颁布的单边变革！

他们认为，我们已经偏离了大一统后设立下的路线，并呼吁[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]废除某些改革。
paragon.5050.desc.en:
Our ideological opponents have formed a powerful political block. They have called upon their supporters to gather in peaceful protest against what they see as unilateral changes enacted by [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]

They argue that we have strayed from the path set after the Unification, and call upon [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] to repeal certain reforms.

paragon.5054.desc.zh: 一群自称“被遗忘者”的地下团体控诉[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的暴政。他们宣称我国政府从未真正代表人民的意愿，反而只是代表一小撮特定的群体利益。他们并不相信[Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]，并提供了曾经的不同政见者已经失踪的证据。他们这些反复发出的讯息开始在我们的公民群体中埋下怀疑的种子。
paragon.5054.desc.en: A secretive group calling themselves The Forgotten has accused [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] of tyranny. They claim that our government no longer represents the will of our people, only the interests of a select few. Their trust in [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has waned, and they have brought forward evidence of dissenters who have suddenly disappeared after criticizing our regime. Their repeated messages are starting to sow doubt in the minds of our citizens.

paragon.5055.desc.zh:
在研究了所谓证据后，似乎[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]确实是向那些被遗忘者们撒谎了，至少也是隐瞒了真相。[Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe]与数个强大的利益派系签订了几份协议，在其中许诺了诸多[Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe]实际上做不到的事情。

今天，被遗忘者代表那些被[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]所欺骗之人的声音，向我们呼吁将政府权力转移至议会及人民手中。
paragon.5055.desc.en:
After reviewing the evidence, it appears that [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has indeed lied or at least concealed the truth to the council and the population at large. [Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe] has signed several contracts with various powerful stakeholders, promising many things that [Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe] could not realistically deliver upon.

Today, the Forgotten have made themselves the voice of all those who have been tricked by the [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] and are calling upon our government to transfer power back to the council and the people.

paragon.5056.desc.zh: 一些能够抹黑[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]秘密文件从一个匿名团体处流出。这一叛国行径为这场政治风波火上浇油。被遗忘者最有动机，但却表现得很无辜，因为我们完全找不到他们涉及此事的证据。
paragon.5056.desc.en: In an attempt to smear [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s reputation, secret documents have been leaked by an anonymous party. This treasonous act has poured oil onto the political fires that were already threatening to consume our government. The Forgotten, although prime suspects, appear innocent, as we could not find any proof of their involvement.

paragon.5057.a.tt.zh: 我们知道这些麻烦制造者住在哪里。我们可以把他们都逮捕关进监狱。
paragon.5057.a.tt.en: We know where these troublemakers live. We can round them up and lock them up.

paragon.5057.b.tt.zh: 通过拒绝低头妥协，我们将向所有的异见者们展示我们正在为人民的福祉而竭尽全力。
paragon.5057.b.tt.en: By refusing to stoop to their level, we will show all dissidents that we are doing everything we can for the good of the people.

paragon.5057.c.tt.zh: 异见者是对国家的威胁，必须清理掉。
paragon.5057.c.tt.en: Dissidents are a threat to the nation that must be eliminated.

paragon.5057.desc.zh: 政治局势已经失控。煽动者正在煽风点火，而[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的拒绝让步引发了帝国范围内的暴力抗议浪潮。随着伤亡人数的增多，[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]别无选择，只能下令要求以一切必要手段镇压反对派。
paragon.5057.desc.en: The political situation has escalated out of control. As agitators fan the flames of revolution, [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s refusal to back down has ignited an empire wide wave of violent protests. The casualties are mounting, and left with no other choice, the [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] has ordered the opposition be crushed by any means necessary.

paragon.5058.a.en: We'll learn to live with it.

paragon.5058.desc.zh: 在极大的压力下，[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]已经发展出了一种独特的应对压力的方法。尽管有些人可能认为这只是一个怪癖，但它影响着整个内阁。
paragon.5058.desc.en: Under intense pressure, [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has developed a unique way to cope with stress. Although some might see this as a simple quirk, it affects the whole council.

paragon.5059.desc.zh: [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]通过孜孜不倦地学习以成为一名更好的领袖。[Owner.Ruler.GetHisHerCap]焕然一新的献身做派让内阁瞩目。
paragon.5059.desc.en: [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has worked extremely hard to become a better leader. [Owner.Ruler.GetHisHerCap] renewed commitment has already been noticed by the council.

paragon.5060.a.zh: 我们需要一位更强大的领袖！

paragon.5060.a.tt.zh: 最近的事件表明，只有[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的英明领导可以为我们社会带来和平和繁荣。我们需要将更多的权力巩固到我们的领袖手中。
paragon.5060.a.tt.en: Recent events have shown that only the wise rule of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] can bring peace and prosperity to our society. We need to consolidate more power into the hands of our leader.

paragon.5060.b.tt.zh:
最近的事件表明，为了在未来克服这些困境，我们必须要有一个强大政府的领导。我们需要将更多权力移交给内阁。
$paragon.leader.growth.negative$
paragon.5060.b.tt.en:
Recent events have shown that a strong government rule is needed to overcome such dilemmas in the future. We need to give more power to the council.
$paragon.leader.growth.negative$

paragon.5060.desc.destroyed.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

今天是伟大的胜利之日，但这并非没有牺牲的代价。我们的敌人已经被消灭，但是他们的背叛使我的心处于巨大的伤痛之中。他们出于自私的目的，试图毁灭我们所有人，但最终，他们无法匹敌我们团结一致产生的力量。很快，他们将因自己的罪行受处决。我们取得了胜利！

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5060.desc.destroyed.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Today marks a great victory, but it has not been bought without sacrifice. Our enemies have been destroyed, yet the sting of their betrayal makes my heart bleed. In their selfishness they sought to destroy us all, but in the end, they were no match for our collective strength. Soon they will be executed for their crimes. We have prevailed!

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5060.desc.imprisioned.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

社会正在螺旋坠入失控境地。猖獗的暴力、隐秘的煽动、无耻的谎言……这些问题困扰我们已久。我自豪地宣布，这些困难时期已经结束！那些试图破坏我们的人已被逮捕，我保证，他们将面临全面的法律制裁。不久之后，他们将为对你们造成的伤害而忏悔！

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5060.desc.imprisioned.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Society is spiralling out of control. Rampant violence, insidious agitation, shameless lies... These things have plagued us for too long. With great pride, I announce an end to these troubled times! Those who sought to undermine us have been arrested, and I promise, they will face the full force of justice. Before long, they will repent for the harm they caused you!

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5060.desc.negotiated.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

在冲突时期，我们很容易忘记为之奋斗的目标，把我们的政治对手视为彻头彻尾的敌人。我们经历了艰难的时刻，但今天我很自豪地告诉你们，我们已经达成了和平的结果。你们的声音已经被听到了。你们曾经信任过我，而我却让你们失望了。

这样的情况到此为止！随着即将到来的宪法改革，我坚信我们已经回到了正确的道路上。出于你们对我能力的信任，我将谦卑地见证这些变革的落实。我发誓，我不会再让你们失望！

$paragon.ending.speech$
paragon.5060.desc.negotiated.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

In times of conflict, it can be easy to lose sight of what we fight for, to view our political opponents as outright enemies. We have gone through trying times, but today I am proud to tell you that we have reached a peaceful outcome. Your voices have been heard. You had put your trust in me and I had failed you.

No more! With the upcoming constitutional reform, I firmly believe that we find ourselves back on the right path, and I am humbled by your trust in my ability to see these changes through. Upon my word, I shall not fail you again!

$paragon.ending.speech$

paragon.5061.desc.zh: [Owner.GetHeirTitle][Owner.GetHeirName]去世了。我们尚未确定死因，但初步调查显示这是自然死亡。[Ruler.GetRegnalName]深受[Ruler.GetHisHer]子嗣之丧的打击。官方法令宣布了全国哀悼期，同时我们等待对继承人死因的调查结果。
paragon.5061.desc.en: [Owner.GetHeirTitle] [Owner.GetHeirName] is dead. We have yet to determine the cause of death, but preliminary reports suggest natural causes. [Ruler.GetRegnalName] was struck hard by the loss of [Ruler.GetHisHer] progeny. A period of national mourning has been decreed and we await the full results of the investigation into the cause of the heir's death.

paragon.5062.desc.zh:
尽管所有的证据都表明这是一次自然死亡，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]却拒绝接受这个事实。[Ruler.GetHisHer]的继承人之死对[Ruler.GetHimHer]产生了很大影响，并下令在我们的领土范围内展开搜捕行动。必须要找到那些为此负责的懦弱的刺杀者。安全部队已经开展行动，根除异见分子。

这些逮捕行动所伴随的暴力程度已经震惊了许多公民。抗议活动再次爆发，谴责滥用权力并要求新一轮政府改革。一个行星的绝大多数人口起来反对[Ruler.GetTitle]的统治，这在我们的历史上属于首次。
paragon.5062.desc.en:
Despite every evidence pointing at a natural death, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] refused to accept it. The death of [Ruler.GetHisHer] heir has greatly affected [Ruler.GetHimHer], and orders have been sent across our territories. Those responsible for this cowardly assassination must be found. Security forces are already conducting sweeps to root out dissenters.

The level of violence that has accompanied these arrests has shocked many of our citizens. Protests denouncing the abuses of power and demanding a new wave of government reforms have erupted once again. For the first time in our history, the majority of a planet's population has risen up against the rule of the [Ruler.GetTitle].

paragon.5063.death.desc.zh: [Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]死后，改革派的支持率逐渐降低了。该团体的代表抛开意识形态上的分歧，特意参加了葬礼仪式。虽然今天被悲伤的气氛所笼罩，但也是一个令人团结一心的时刻——提醒[Root.Owner.GetName]所代表的意义。
paragon.5063.death.desc.en: After [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s death, support for the Reformists dwindled. Putting aside their ideological differences, representatives from the group made a point of attending the funeral ceremony. Although today is marred by sorrow, it is also a moment of unity - a reminder of what the [Root.Owner.GetName] stands for.

paragon.5063.norebel.desc.zh: 无论是我们对资源的巧妙利用还是引入了强有力的惩罚措施，叛乱的星球不再是一个问题。我们再次团结起来，民众专注于发展而不是内讧。[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]颁布法令，将今天定为一个特殊的纪念日。
paragon.5063.norebel.desc.en: Whether due to our clever use of resources or the introduction of robust punishments, rebellious planets are no longer an issue. Once again we stand united, with the populace focused on growth rather than infighting. [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] has decreed today will be a special commemorative holiday going forward.

paragon.5064.desc.zh: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]发现我们的一位领袖正在反对政府！妥善的程序是直接处死这名叛徒，但是证据不是很充分。
paragon.5064.desc.en: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has discovered that one of our leaders is plotting against the government! The proper course would be to execute the traitor, but evidence is scarce.

paragon.5065.desc.zh: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]下令在我们的一颗行星上进行大范围的清洗行动。显然，那里存在一个改革派据点，但我们尚未掌握充分证据。我们确定要因为预感将忠诚公民的性命置于危险之中吗？
paragon.5065.desc.en: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] ordered a large scale cleansing on one of our planets. Apparently, there is a supposed Reformist holdout there, but no firm evidence has been produced. Will we really risk the lives of loyal citizens on a hunch?

paragon.5070.desc.zh: 改革派的一个小团体加入了当地的海盗组织。虽然他们不是一个严重的威胁，但他们仍然可以扰乱我们在该星域的运营和贸易。
paragon.5070.desc.en: One of the alleged Reformist cells joined forces with a local group of pirates. Although they are not a serious threat, they can still disrupt our operations and trade in the sector.

paragon.5071.desc.zh: 来自[event_target:friendly_nation]的一位显赫公民希望在我们的内部斗争中帮助我们。他们不仅带来了美好愿景，同时还伴随着一批合金作为援助。似乎他们寻求改善我们之间的关系，但[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]怀疑这是为异己分子的运动建立供应线的诡计。
paragon.5071.desc.en: A prominent citizen from [event_target:friendly_nation] wishes to help us in our internal struggle. Their best wishes were accompanied by a shipment of alloys to aid us. It seems they seek to improve relations between us, but [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] suspects a ruse to establish supply lines for the dissident movements.

paragon.5072.desc.zh: 我们的安全部门成功追踪并捣毁了一个改革派窝点。这次行动取得了极大的成功，人员损失降到最低，没有平民伤亡。
paragon.5072.desc.en: Our security service managed to hunt down and dismantle one of the Reformists' cells. The operation was a clear success, with minimal loss of life and no civilian casualties.

paragon.5073.desc.zh: 我们的安全部门成功地追踪到了一个改革派窝点，但他们在整个街区都埋设了爆炸物。当我们的特工突入窝点的时候，他们引爆了炸药，杀死了许多人。
paragon.5073.desc.en: Our security service managed to track down a Reformist cell, but they had rigged the whole block with explosives. As our operatives breached the lair, they activated the charges, killing many.

paragon.5074.desc.zh: 我们和改革派发生了激烈的交火，有很多平民受伤。我们派出了应急部队来照料伤者。
paragon.5074.desc.en: Many civilians were hurt in a series of fierce firefights between our forces and the Reformists. We have sent emergency responders to take care of the wounded.

paragon.5075.desc.zh: 我们忠诚的支持者举行了一场集会，声援[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]！我们在这场斗争中显然赢得了人民的支持！
paragon.5075.desc.en: Our loyal supporters made a rally to back up [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]! We clearly have the support of the people in our fight!

paragon.5090.desc.zh: 改革派的宣传部门在我们的某颗行星上发起了一场虚假信息运动。忠诚派势力正在保持高度警戒，意图控制局面，但抗议者的队伍继续壮大。
paragon.5090.desc.en: Reformist propagandists led a disinformation campaign on one of our planets. Loyalist forces are on their toes to keep the situation under control, but the protesters continue to grow in strength.

paragon.5095.a.zh: 让我们听听他们的条件。

paragon.5095.desc.zh: 由于内阁的努力工作，改革派领袖已被迅速逮捕。他们现在听由[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]发落。但另一方面，他们在民众中拥有许多支持者，所以明智的做法是通过谈判达成一个的双方都有利的结果——当然条件是我们说的算。
paragon.5095.desc.en: Thanks to the Council's hard work, the Reformist leaders have been swiftly apprehended. They are now at the mercy of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName], but they have many supporters among the populace, and it is advisable to negotiate an outcome that suits both parties - albeit on our terms.

paragon.5110.desc.zh: 我们收到了许多关于海盗袭扰我们贸易路线的报道。内阁正在请求军事支援来应对这些威胁。
paragon.5110.desc.en: We have received multiple reports of pirates plaguing our trade routes. The council has asked for military support to deal with this menace.

paragon.5120.desc.zh: 一些殖民者和深空研究团队对我们的通讯系统颇有微词，他们已经有好几天收不到消息了。工程师建议在首都建造一座通讯中继器来增强信号。
paragon.5120.desc.en: Some colonists and deep space research teams are criticizing our communication systems - there are days when they can't get any message through. Engineers suggest building a communication relay in our capital system to boost the signal.

paragon.5121.a.zh: 我们夺回了自己的声音。

paragon.5121.desc.zh:
信号增强器已经激活。初步测试证明，它足以确保在我们的太空中进行稳定通信。

现在看来，之前的干扰是有意为之的破坏行为。虽然破坏者的身份仍未知晓，但新系统应该能够保护我们免受任何进一步的干扰。
paragon.5121.desc.en:
The signal booster has been activated. The first tests prove that it should be enough to ensure stable communication across our space.

It now appears that the previous disruptions were caused by intentional acts of sabotage. While the perpetrators remain unknown, the new system should protect us against any further disruption.

paragon.5130.desc.zh: 深空工人正在罢工，抗议严峻的工作环境。他们要求增加休息时间并提升工作安全管理。作为回应，我们提议给予他们数天全休日，并在首都星球举行一场盛大游行，重新点燃他们的民族自豪感。
paragon.5130.desc.en: Deep-space workers are striking in protest against harsh conditions. They demand more free time and increased safety regulations. In response, we have proposed a slate of work-free days and a grand parade on our capital world to reignite a sense of national pride.

paragon.5131.desc.zh: 游行进行得比我们的预想好得多！公民们为[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]欢呼喝彩的画面被拍下来，并在[Owner.GetName]范围内广为流传，以对恩慈的[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]表示尊敬。不过，在首都还是爆发过一些小规模的骚乱，但秩序很快就恢复了，没有伤亡发生。媒体也因安保单位的快速反应而对[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]大加赞扬。
paragon.5131.desc.en: The parade went better than expected! Images of citizens cheering for [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] were recorded and published across [Owner.GetName] to show support for the benevolent [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]. While a number of small riots were reported across the capital, order was swiftly restored. There were no casualties, and state media praised [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] for the swift response of our security forces.

paragon.5140.desc.zh: 我们收到了一些关于基层军官诋毁[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]名声的报告。这样的行径绝不能逃避惩罚。那些相关者，最少最少，也应该被开除军籍。
paragon.5140.desc.en: There have been reports of low-ranking military officers actively smearing the name of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]. This cannot go unpunished. Those responsible should, at the very least, be discharged from the service.

paragon.5141.desc.zh: 这些谋反的异见军官被逮捕了。庆幸的是，他们的人数很少，但这次事件表明，即使是我们的军队也可能被叛徒渗透。我们抓住了主要的煽动者，但我们不应该排除与非军事组织的联系。
paragon.5141.desc.en: The dissident officers who were conspiring against us have been arrested. Thankfully, they were few in numbers, but this incident indicates that even our military can be infiltrated by traitors. We were able to catch the main instigators, but we shouldn't rule out possible ties to non-military groups.

paragon.5150.a.en: We need to clean up our ranks.

paragon.5150.desc.zh: 内阁最近受到了严格审查。匿名投诉反映，数目惊人的重要职位被高官的亲朋好友占据。我们已答应调查此事，并改弦易辙。
paragon.5150.desc.en: The council has recently come under heavy scrutiny. Anonymous complaints highlight the staggering amount of important positions which have been filled by the friends and family of high-ranking officials. We have promised to look into the matter and to do better.

paragon.5151.desc.zh: 特别委员会对内阁高层进行了彻底的巡查。发现了许多资质不足的人，绝大多数人被解除职务。其中一小部分有前途的人才被送去参加培训。
paragon.5151.desc.en: A special committee has scoured the higher echelons of the council. Many unqualified individuals were identified, and most have already been dismissed from their posts. A few of the more promising talents were sent to training sessions.

paragon.5200.desc.zh: 经过几个月的冲突，现在是时候让我们解决分歧，讨论如何结束这场荒谬的叛乱了。[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]已呼吁停火并与改革派进行谈判。所有敌对行动已经停止，每个人都在等待谈判结果的出现。
paragon.5200.desc.en: After months of conflict, the time has come to resolve our differences and talk about how we can end this ridiculous revolt. [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] has called for a ceasefire to negotiate with the Reformists. All hostilities have ceased, as everyone awaits the outcome of the negotiations.

paragon.5201.desc.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]同胞！今天，我想让大家知道，我充满了自豪。我们求同存异，作为一个民族，向着未知一同进发，建造了新的星球，我们的聪明才智达到了新的高度。

我要感谢诸位的付出……

我还要……

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]突然一个踉跄，消失在了画面之外。
paragon.5201.desc.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Fellow [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Today, I want you to know I am filled with pride. As a people, we have come together and, despite differences, ventured into the unknown, built new worlds, and reached new heights of ingenuity.

I want to acknowledge your sacrifice...

I want...

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] suddenly staggers out of view.

paragon.5202.a.zh: 一定会有我们行得通的办法的。
paragon.5202.a.en: There must be something we can do.

paragon.5202.a.tt.zh: 我们会探索一切可能的方法来救活[Ruler.GetName]
paragon.5202.a.tt.en: We will explore every possible avenue to save [Ruler.GetName].

paragon.5202.regular.zh:
新闻很快就传遍了全国上下：[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]正生命垂危。这场神秘的急病原因尚不明确，似乎也不会很快结束。

至少目前，[Ruler.GetRegnalName]仍名义上在位。然而，如果想要显著延长我们领袖的寿命，可能必须依靠一些非传统方法了。
paragon.5202.regular.en:
The news didn't take long to spread among the population; [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] is dying. While the cause of this mysterious illness remains unknown, it does not appear to be immediately terminal.

For now, [Ruler.GetRegnalName] can remain at their post. However, unorthodox methods will be necessary to extend our leader's life by any significant amount of time.

paragon.5202.synth.zh:
新闻很快就传遍了全国上下：[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的神经网络出故障了。这个神秘的故障让我们最聪明的人都摸不着头脑，似乎不会很快被排除。

至少目前，[Ruler.GetRegnalName]仍名义上在位。然而，如果想要显著延长我们领袖的工作周期，可能必须依靠一些非传统方法了。
paragon.5202.synth.en:
The news didn't take long to spread among the population; [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] neural net is failing. While the cause of this mysterious error has eluded our best minds, it is not immediately terminal.

For now, [Ruler.GetRegnalName] can remain at their post. However, unorthodox methods will be necessary to repair and extend our leader's functionality by any significant amount of time.

paragon.5210.a.en: We will give them what they want.

paragon.5210.b.zh: 我们不会作出任何让步。

paragon.5210.b.tt.zh: 拥有民主倾向修正的行星将会叛乱。
paragon.5210.b.tt.en: Planets with Democratic Tendencies modifier will rebel.

paragon.5210.c.zh: 轻信这些谈判是他们太愚蠢了。
paragon.5210.c.en: They're foolish to trust in these negotiations.

paragon.5210.c.tt.zh:
所有有平等主义思潮的人都会被被杀死！
$paragon.leader.delusion.negative$
paragon.5210.c.tt.en:
Every pop with an Egalitarian Ethic will be killed!
$paragon.leader.delusion.negative$

paragon.5210.d.zh: 够了！我们的领袖让我们失望了！
paragon.5210.d.en: Enough! Our leader has failed us!

paragon.5210.d.tt.zh:
[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]将被暗杀。
国家将分裂并陷入内战。
国家处于混乱之中。人们迫切地想点燃革命的火焰。我们已经听到了他们的号召。必须消灭所有暴政！
paragon.5210.d.tt.en:
[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] will be assassinated.
The nation will fracture and a civil war will begin.
The nation is in disarray. People are desperate to light the flame of revolution. We have heard their call. All tyrants must be deposed!

paragon.5210.desc.zh:
是时候让[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]再度执掌国家的大舵了。[Ruler.GetName]受赐福继承了$leader_trait_legendary_leader$的品质，仍然充满着庄严。然而，随着改革派势力的增强，一场全面内战逐渐逼近，[Ruler.GetTitle]发出了谈判的号召。

[Ruler.GetName]报告道，谈判前期气氛十分紧张。来自[Owner.GetName]各处的代表在听取我们[Ruler.GetTitle]的官方声明——其中列出了所有我们可能接受的让步——之前，纷纷提出了自己的要求。
paragon.5210.desc.en:
It is time for [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] to retake the helm of state. Blessed with the heritage of the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$, [Ruler.GetName] remains a magnetic figure. However, with the increasing power of the Reformists and a full-fledged civil war looming on the horizon, the [Ruler.GetTitle] issued a call to negotiations.

[Ruler.GetName] reports that early negotiations have been tense. Representatives from all corners of [Owner.GetName] made their demands before listening to our [Ruler.GetTitle]'s official statement, which listed the concessions we might accept.

paragon.5210.e.zh: 我们应该统治星系，单独统治！
paragon.5210.e.en: We should rule the galaxy, alone!

paragon.5211.a.zh: 我们为了捍卫自己的道路而战！
paragon.5211.a.en: We fight to preserve our ways!

paragon.5211.b.zh: 我们为了探寻新的道路而战！
paragon.5211.b.en: We fight to change our ways!

paragon.5211.desc.zh: 我们成功挣脱了锁链！所有压迫者和暴君都已被推翻。我们可能是引发这场战争的火花，但我们所做的一切都是为了人民的利益。我们必将战胜一切！
paragon.5211.desc.en: Our chains are broken! All oppressors and tyrants have been cast down. We may have been the spark that lit this war, but everything we do is for the good of the people. We shall overcome!

paragon.5213.a.zh: 我们要重建被摧毁的一切。
paragon.5213.a.en: We shall rebuild what was destroyed.

paragon.5213.b.zh: 我们必须保卫自己的社会！
paragon.5213.b.en: We need to safeguard our society!

paragon.5213.c.en: The civil war has hardened us.

paragon.5213.d.zh: 我们必须优先发展和平与繁荣。
paragon.5213.d.en: We must prioritize peace and prosperity.

paragon.5213.desc.zh: 随着内乱的余烬逐渐地消失，一个新的社会正从灰烬中崛起，准备将革命的火花带到星空。
paragon.5213.desc.en: As the embers of civil strife fade away, a new society is rising from the ashes, ready to carry the spark of revolution to the stars.

paragon.5213.e.zh: 自这样的灾难中，我们必会成长。
paragon.5213.e.en: From the devastation, we will grow.

paragon.5220.a.tt.zh: 我们要么通过武力，要么通过谈判来解决分歧。从现在开始，我们要真正团结起来。
paragon.5220.a.tt.en: We settle our differences either through might or through negotiation. From now on, we are truly united.

paragon.5220.desc.peace.zh: 在谈判前夕，各方显然厌倦了战火，愿意促成协议。我们不知道这将产生什么样的长期后果，但现在我们团结起来了。
paragon.5220.desc.peace.en: On the eve of the negotiations, it became clear that the parties were sick of warring and would rather strike a deal. We cannot know what long-term consequences this will have, but for now we are united.

paragon.5220.desc.war.zh: 在谈判前夕，局势已经很明显，各方都无法达成一致。即使现在，叛乱实力也正在集结，战争爆发了。再一次我们的国家处于分裂的状态。
paragon.5220.desc.war.en: On the eve of the negotiations, it became clear that the parties would never come to an agreement. Even now, rebel forces are massing, and war has been declared. Once more our nation stands divided.

paragon.5221.a.tt.zh: 带有民主倾向修正的行星将形成一个起义帝国的核心。
paragon.5221.a.tt.en: Planets with the Democratic Tendencies modifier will form the core of a rebel empire.

paragon.5222.a.zh: 我们现在不能回头了。只能继续。
paragon.5222.a.en: We can't turn back now. Proceed.

paragon.5222.desc.zh: 号召谈判是一个捕获改革派领袖的完美陷阱。他们聚集在一个地方，收网有如探囊取物。我们不费吹灰之力就获得了有关他们藏身之处、下线和资产的信息。剩下的反对派也轻松地处理掉了，不需要任何让步，也没有发生代价高昂的内战。所有改革派都被[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的法令判处死刑。
paragon.5222.desc.en: The call to negotiations was a perfect trap for the Reformist leaders. Gathered in one place, they were easily apprehended. We wasted no time extracting information about their hideouts, followers, and assets. The remaining opposition was swiftly dealt with, without concessions or a costly civil war. Every Reformist has been sentenced to death by decree of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName].

paragon.5223.a.en: One country, one Luminary, one future.

paragon.5223.desc.zh: 随着内乱的余烬逐渐地消失，一个新的社会正从灰烬中崛起，准备将[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的智慧火花带到星空。
paragon.5223.desc.en: As the embers of civil strife fade away, a new society is rising from the ashes, ready to carry the spark of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s wisdom to the stars.

paragon.5305.desc.zh:
这些年来，得益于天赋异禀的科学家们，我们创造了无与伦比的繁荣和稳定。为了寻找新的途径殖民并发展星球，他们谋划了一些目前被认为是不可能做到的事情——基于目前在异种生物学领域的理解：他们将我们本土的动植物植入到外星环境，并通过大规模的地质改造来改变这颗星球，使其变得宜居。

尽管我们现在不太可能复制这一成功，毕竟这颗被改造的星球有一定特殊性，但这表明，随着时间的推移，我们可以逐渐改进这一方法，使其能够通用于所有星球。

到了那个时候，我们就可以换一个领域拨款促进其发展了。
paragon.5305.desc.en:
Recent years have boasted unparalleled prosperity and stability, owing to our most talented scientists. Seeking new worlds to grow and exploit, they managed something that was - given our current understanding of xenobiology - believed impossible: they managed to implant our native flora and fauna into an alien planet, changing it to suit our population, through the use of enormous earthworks.

Although replicating this success now is unlikely, as the changed planet was rather unique, it has shown that in time, we could enhance and adapt this process to suit other worlds.

Until then, we can allocate funds to grow the empire in other areas.

paragon.5310.desc.zh:
我们的海军是国家防卫的堡垒。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]宣布了将建造一艘崭新的船只，由国家出资，以增强我们的舰队。这艘旗舰将引领我们进入辉煌的时代，粉碎任何阻挡我们前进的敌人！很快，这艘船就会下水，届时我们将举行欢庆活动。

现在，我们可以调配资金，在其他领域推动帝国的发展。
paragon.5310.desc.en:
Our navy is the bastion of defense. The [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] has announced a brand new state-funded ship to bolster our fleet. This flagship will lead us into a glorious era, crushing anyone who stands in our way! Soon the vessel will be launched, and we will celebrate.

Now, we can allocate funds to grow the empire in other areas.

paragon.5310.tt.zh: 实验性巡洋舰加入了舰队！

paragon.5315.desc.zh:
科学是创造更美好、更光明未来的关键。在得到新的激励之后，我们的科学家正在创造比以往任何时候都要多的突破。这些进展已被[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]看在眼里，他向一些杰出的科学家颁发了功勋勋章。

我们现在可以将扩张的努力集中在不同的领域上。
paragon.5315.desc.en:
Science is the key to a better and brighter future. Freshly incentivized, our scientists are making more breakthroughs than ever. The progress has been acknowledged by [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] with medals of merit awarded to select scientists.

We can now afford to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

paragon.5320.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]是所有人的榜样，引领我们穿越星空。在这样一个有强有力的领袖领导的时代，我们的官员们为能够为国家服务而感到自豪，并且追求卓越。

我们现在可以将扩张的努力集中在不同的领域上。
paragon.5320.desc.en:
The [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] is a role model for all, guiding us among the stars. With a strong leader at the helm, our officials are proud to serve, and strive for excellence.

We can now afford to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

paragon.5325.desc.zh:
有关新建设项目的报告对公众信心产生了深刻的影响。完成了生产成本论证之后，我们期待着这一令人难以置信的工程壮举的实现。

我们现在可以将扩张的努力集中在不同的领域上。
paragon.5325.desc.en:
Reports on the new construction project are having a profound effect on public morale. With the production costs behind us, we look forward to the realization of this incredible feat of engineering.

We can now afford to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

paragon.5330.desc.zh:
虽然我们通过技术和科学的进步获得了许多发现，但我们仍有很多东西要学习。我们的勘探队发现了一种非同寻常的物质，同时具有液态和金属特性。此外，这种物质似乎还是有生命的。我们还不知道如何理解或利用这种材料，但它引起了广泛关注。

在我们更加深入地了解这种物质之前，我们应该在不同的学科方向集中精力进一步有所拓展。
paragon.5330.desc.en:
We have discovered much through technological and scientific advancement, but we still have a lot to learn. Our exploration team found an extraordinary substance which exhibits liquid and metallic properties. Furthermore, this substance appears to be alive. We do not yet know how to understand or utilize this material, but it is most intriguing.

Until we know more, we would do well to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

paragon.5335.desc.zh:
尽管我们的技术进步已经走得很远，但宇宙仍然隐藏着许多秘密。我们的勘探队发现了一种非常稠密的物质，被认为是某种形式的暗物质。目前，我们还无法确定这种新材料的潜在用途。

在我们找到方法之前，我们应该在不同的学科方向集中精力进一步有所拓展。
paragon.5335.desc.en:
Our technological advancements have come far, but the universe holds many secrets. Our exploration team has discovered an extraordinary, dense substance. It is believed to be some form of Dark Matter. For now, we are unable to discern a potential use for this new material.

Until we find a way, we would do well to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

paragon.5340.desc.zh:
第一艘航天飞机的周年纪念日让人们在共同的目标下团结起来。受到[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]演讲的启发和鼓舞，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]全体人民正在共同努力，使他们的新星系首都成为冰冷太空中的一座繁荣灯塔。

现在，我们可以将我们的努力聚焦其他方面了。
paragon.5340.desc.en:
The anniversary of the first space shuttle has united the population in common purpose. Inspired and invigorated by [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]' speech, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] population are working together to make their new galactic capital a beacon of prosperity in the cold void of space.

Now, we can focus our efforts elsewhere.

paragon.5340.tt.zh: 首都行星飞升等级提升+1
paragon.5340.tt.en: Capital World Ascension Tier increased by +1

paragon.5345.desc.zh:
有关一种新型机器的消息正在传播，这种机器能够从回收的材料中提炼大量的合金。这个设备非常高效，但是它的发明者在向我们的[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]展示之后不久去世了。其他工程师认为不可能对其进行复制，出于对民众利益的考量，我们将机器放入一个受保护的设施中。

我们现在可以调配资金，在其他领域进行发展。
paragon.5345.desc.en:
News has been spreading about an innovative machine which is capable of refining huge quantities of alloys from recycled materials. The device is highly efficient, but its creator died shortly after presenting it to our [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]. Deemed impossible to replicate by other engineers, we put the machine into a guarded facility for protection, and for the benefit of our people.

We can allocate funds to develop in other areas.

paragon.5360.desc.zh: 我们的勘探者再次证明了自己的价值。他们报告称发现了一个隐蔽的地下矿藏，里面有几种不同寻常的资源。一方面我们可以继续开展工作，确认这些新资源的性质和潜在储量；另一方面，我们可以换一个领域拨款促进其发展了。
paragon.5360.desc.en: Our prospectors proved themselves useful once again. They reported finding a hidden underground deposit of several unusual resources. While we work to ascertain the properties and potential for these new assets, we can continue to expand in other areas.

paragon.5370.desc.zh: 在深空殖民和运输领域进行的广泛研究产生了许多科研成果。我们最聪明的科学家们与最厉害的工程师们密切合作。他们发展出了一个新的概念：轨道环；这是一个能够支持工业或民用设施的巨大环形空间结构，覆盖整个行星。尽管现在我们可能缺乏建造这样一个星环基地所需的工业能力，但前方的道路是清晰的。同时，我们可以将扩张的努力集中在其他地方。
paragon.5370.desc.en: Extensive research in the field of deep space colonization and transportation proved fruitful. Our brightest scientists have worked closely with the best engineers. They have developed a new concept for an orbital ring; a space structure encompassing the planet with a giant ring capable of supporting industrial or civilian facilities. For now, we may lack the industrial capability to build such an Orbital Ring, but the path ahead is clear. Meanwhile, we can afford to focus expansion efforts elsewhere.

paragon.550.b.zh: 一场私人葬礼就足够了。

paragon.550.c.en: [From.GetHeSheCap] did nothing to deserve such honors.

paragon.550.desc.zh: 我们伟大的[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]为国鞠躬尽瘁，享年[From.GetAge]岁。人们高呼，为了纪念这位领袖对[Root.GetName]的贡献，要举办一场盛大的追思仪式。这一盛事能将民众团结在一起，巩固我们的理念。
paragon.550.desc.en: Our great [From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] has passed away at the age of [From.GetAge] while in service to our empire. The people clamor for a memorial service to honor this leader's contribution to the [Root.GetName]. A grand event will give everyone closure, and bolster our ideals.

paragon.550.evopred.en: The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.

paragon.550.evopred.c.tt.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] will consume [From.GetName], gaining a new trait.

paragon.550.evopred.d.tt.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] will consume [From.GetName], completing half of the current ['concept_agenda'].

paragon.550.f.zh: 规划一场盛大的追悼游行。马上。

paragon.550.g.zh: 以[From.GetHisHer]的名义设立一个基金。
paragon.550.g.en: Set up a foundation in [From.GetHisHer] name.

paragon.550.j.zh: 建立一座适合的纪念碑。

paragon.550.k.zh: 一场小规模的悼念会就足够了。

paragon.550.l.zh: 以[From.GetHisHer]的名字命名一个地标。

paragon.550.m.en: [From.GetHisHerCap] story does not have to end here...

paragon.551.desc.zh:
在长长的游行队伍中，[From.GetName]静静地沉眠，[Root.GetName]的每一位公民都受邀前来表示敬意。

葬礼之后是为期一周的盛大祭典，祭典花费巨大。[From.GetName]的透明水晶棺材在[Root.Capital.GetName]纪念堂展出。人群排在街头，想要一睹他们伟大领袖的最终安息之处。
paragon.551.desc.en:
[From.GetName] has been laid to rest following a public procession. Every citizen of [Root.GetName] was invited to pay their respects.

The funeral is followed by a week-long festival, with no expenses spared. [From.GetName]'s translucent crystal casket is displayed at the [Root.Capital.GetName] memorial site, where the crowds line the streets hoping to catch a glimpse of the great leader in their final resting place.

paragon.552.desc.zh: [From.GetName]在最亲近的亲属和同事的环绕中静静地沉眠。其对[Root.GetName]的贡献不菲，但现在并不是能铺张浪费的时候。
paragon.552.desc.en: [From.GetName] is laid to rest in a private ceremony with their closest family members and colleagues. Their contribution to the [Root.GetName] was an important one, but now is not the time for exorbitant expenditure.

paragon.553.a.en: It is time to move on.

paragon.553.desc.zh: 我们对[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]的谨慎处置被媒体迅速捕捉到了。尽管一些人表达了担忧，但许多消息来源还是坚定地指出了这位领袖的缺点。当前的普遍看法是，我们终于可以找一位更合适的继任者来替代现在这位领袖了。
paragon.553.desc.en: The discreet disposal of our [From.GetTitle], [From.GetName], has been promptly noted by the press. While others express concern, many sources adamantly point out the leader's shortcomings. The general sentiment is relief that we can now replace this leader with a more fitting successor.

paragon.554.a.en: Such is the cycle of life.

paragon.554.desc.zh:
在一场简短的追悼会后，[From.GetTitle]的遗体被捐赠给了科学界，以对基础医药研究和教育继续做贡献。

这些过程中剩下的东西最终将被水火化，变成富含矿物质的肥料，确保身体的任何部分都不会被浪费。
paragon.554.desc.en:
After a brief commemoration, the [From.GetTitle]'s body has been donated to science to contribute towards essential medical research and education.

What is left from these procedures will in the end be water cremated and turned into a mineral-rich fertilizer, ensuring no part of the body goes to waste.

paragon.555.desc.zh:
人们聚集在一起，追悼[From.GetName]的一生及其丰功伟绩。人们挤满了街道，向东望不见头，向西望不见尾。颂歌一直唱到了夜幕降临。[From.GetHeSheCap]现在已经跨入彼岸。

[From.GetHisHer]的布道节选现在在整个帝国回荡，提醒着我们共同的目标。
paragon.555.desc.en:
The people gathered in their masses to celebrate the life and career of [From.GetName]. Huge processions filled the streets, and hymns were sung long into the night. [From.GetHeSheCap] is now waiting for us on the other side of the veil.

Popular excerpts from [From.GetHisHer] sermons are now reverberating across the empire, reminding us of our common goal.

paragon.556.desc.zh:
大型阅兵方阵和舰队护卫着[From.GetName]的灵柩前往最终安息之地。[From.GetHisHerCap]的遗体被发射去了最近的恒星，并全程向全社会广播。

逝世领袖的个人战略部署和日志成为了下一批军校学员课程中的内容。
paragon.556.desc.en:
A huge parade of troops and a flyover by naval forces marked the arrival of [From.GetName]'s casket to its final resting place. [From.GetHisHerCap] body was fired into the nearest star during a society-wide broadcast.

The departed leader's personal strategies and log books will become a part of the curriculum for the next generation of cadets.

paragon.557.a.zh: 我们共同创造了一项遗产。

paragon.557.desc.zh: 为了纪念刚刚去世的伟大[From.GetTitle]，[From.GetName]，我们设立了一个非盈利的基金会。这个基金会标志着星际的和平与和谐发展迈出了一步，包容了不同社群和物种之间的分歧。
paragon.557.desc.en: A non-profit foundation has been established to honor the passing of the great [From.GetTitle], [From.GetName]. The foundation marks a step towards peace and interstellar harmony, bridging differences between communities and species.

paragon.558.desc.zh:
当[From.GetName]去世的消息传遍更远的地区时，一种深深的悲痛笼罩了整个帝国。无数的哀悼者遵循传统的葬礼仪式加入了[Root.Capital.GetName]的葬礼队伍中。

其遗体被一丝不苟地清洁并进行了适当的装饰。在[From.GetTitle]的遗体进行了安葬之前，我们全国上下都要默哀，表示尊重。
paragon.558.desc.en:
A deep sorrow has gripped the public as news regarding the passing of [From.GetName] spreads to the wider community. Countless mourners join the funeral procession on [Root.Capital.GetName] to follow the traditional funeral rites.

The body is meticulously cleansed and appropriately decorated. Before the deceased [From.GetTitle] is laid to rest, a moment of silence is observed throughout our systems as a mark of respect.

paragon.559.desc.zh:
为纪念[From.GetName]一生的丰功伟绩，我们为[From.GetHimHer]准备了一场穿越星海的最后航行。

一个容纳着[From.GetTitle]遗体的胶囊被庄严地发射向未探索的宇域，伴随他的还有诗歌、图表、录音和其他贵宾带来的随葬品。将来有一天，[From.GetTitle]的船只可能会在那里找到一个新家，完成[From.GetHisHer]的最后任务。
paragon.559.desc.en:
The remarkable deeds of [From.GetName] have warranted [From.GetHimHer] one last voyage through space.

A capsule containing the [From.GetTitle]'s remains is ceremonially launched into the void alongside poems, charts, recordings, and other memorabilia brought by various dignitaries. One day the [From.GetTitle]'s vessel may find a new home out there, completing [From.GetHisHer] final mission.

paragon.560.a.zh: 您的伟大将被永远铭记。

paragon.560.desc.zh: 工匠们获得最好的材料来制作[From.GetName]的肖像，将其加入到[Root.GetName]传奇英雄的行列中。其庄严的面孔被蚀刻在石头和金属上，让人们牢记这位强大领袖的丰功伟绩。
paragon.560.desc.en: Artisans have been provided with the finest materials to fashion the likeness of [From.GetName], adding them to the long line of storied heroes of the [Root.GetName]. Their majestic visage is etched in stone and metal, acting as a reminder of what strong leaders can accomplish.

paragon.561.a.en: For the good of the many.

paragon.561.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的名字与头衔被镌刻在了一座高大耸立的纪念碑上，与无数其他为[Root.GetName]的人民鞠躬尽瘁的人们并列。这位备受尊敬的[From.GetTitle]将被人民永远铭记，他的贡献为未来数代领袖们开拓道路。
paragon.561.desc.en: [From.GetName]'s name and title are carved on a towering monument alongside others who have served the [Root.GetName] for the good of its population. The respected [From.GetTitle] will be fondly remembered by the people, paving the way for future generations of leaders.

paragon.562.desc.zh:
这位领袖的去世引起了星际证交所短暂但剧烈的震荡。

除了举办奢华的葬礼，[Root.GetName]还将一座较高的摩天楼重命名为[From.GetName]大厦以确保以后这位[From.GetTitle]的名字会被写入公司的编年史中。每间会议室的墙上都挂着一幅经过艺术诠释的肖像，以纪念其对帝国的杰出贡献。
paragon.562.desc.en:
News of the leader's passing is met with a sharp, but brief downturn in share value at the galactic stock markets.

In addition to sponsoring the lavish funeral, [Root.GetName] rebrands one of its taller skyscrapers as the [From.GetName] Building to ensure that the late [From.GetTitle]'s name is preserved in the annals of the corporate history. An artistically interpreted portrait is also hung on every boardroom wall to commemorate their outstanding contributions to the empire.

paragon.563.a.en: From one life to the next.

paragon.563.desc.zh:
[From.Species.GetName]的去世并不像表面上看起来那么彻底。尽管躯干已经开始劣化，但核心还可以恢复活力。

在浸泡过一种特殊的激素溶液后，[From.GetName]的遗体被小心翼翼地埋入[burial_planet.GetName]的土壤中。埋葬地由孵化者精心照料，他们耐心地等待幼体破土发芽，开始新的循环。
paragon.563.desc.en:
The death of a [From.Species.GetName] is not as final as it appears. Even if the main stem has begun to deteriorate, the roots can be reinvigorated.

After soaking in a special hormone solution, [From.GetName]'s remains are carefully buried in the soil of [burial_planet.GetName]. The burial site is tended by brood members who patiently await for younglings to sprout on the surface, starting the cycle anew.

paragon.570.a.zh: 死亡不再是一项障碍了。
paragon.570.a.en: Death is no longer an obstacle.

paragon.570.desc.zh:
[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]在可靠地服务了[From.GetYearsOfService]后发生了故障，彻底报废。我们的科学家已经备份了文件以保留重要数据。

基于[From.GetName]的智能全息图谱已经被安装在我们的舰船系统中，作为虚拟顾问为我们服务。他们将继续支援我们的任务。
paragon.570.desc.en:
[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] has broken down after [From.GetYearsOfService] of reliable service. Our scientists have backed up their files to preserve important data.

An intelligent hologram based on [From.GetName] has been installed in our ship systems to serve as a virtual advisor. They will continue to aid in our mission.

paragon.571.desc.zh: [From.GetTitle][From.GetName]的意识在[From.GetAge]岁时从集体意识中移除。我们是[Root.GetName]，我们将永存。
paragon.571.desc.en: The mind of [From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] was removed from the collective at the age of [From.GetAge]. We are the [Root.GetName]. We will endure.

paragon.5900.a.100years.zh: 我们做好了准备。这一次，我们也会挺过难关。
paragon.5900.a.100years.en: We were prepared. This too, we will overcome.

paragon.5900.a.50years.zh: 我们历史中糟糕的一天。
paragon.5900.a.50years.en: A terrible day in our history.

paragon.5900.desc.zh:
没有谁可以永远活着。最终，我们在死亡面前都是平等的。今天，$leader_trait_legendary_leader$最后一次将我们所有人团结在一起。我们从未举行过如此盛大的葬礼：激情昂扬的演讲，高尚的誓言，无尽的送行队伍。在我们领土全境，人们因$leader_trait_legendary_leader$为我们所做的一切表示感激。没有统治者是完美的，但我们的统治者不知疲倦地工作，为我们所有人建设一个更美好的未来。

虽然我们希望减轻这样一个事件可能引发的余波，但我们的母星还是陷入了动荡之中。
paragon.5900.desc.en:
No one lives forever. In the end, we are all equals in death. Today, the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ unites us all one last in time. Never before have we held such a grand funeral: powerful speeches, noble vows, endless processions. All across our territories, the people are expressing their thanks for everything the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ did for us. No ruler is perfect, but ours worked tirelessly to build a better future for us all.

Although we hoped to mitigate the potential backlash of such an event, our homeworld has fallen into turmoil.

paragon.5900.desc.100years.zh:
没有人可以永生。最终，我们都在死亡面前平等。今天，$leader_trait_legendary_leader$最后一次将我们聚集到一起。我们从未举行过如此盛大的葬礼：激情昂扬的演讲，高贵的誓言，无尽的送行队伍。在我们境内，人们表达了对$leader_trait_legendary_leader$为我们所做的一切的感激之情。没有统治者是完美的，但我们的领袖不知疲倦地工作，为我们所有人建立更美好的未来。

由于我们已经做好应对这样的危机的准备，即使在$leader_trait_legendary_leader$去世之后，我们也将稳步前行。克服这一损失需要一些时间，但从中我们也会变得更加坚强。
paragon.5900.desc.100years.en:
No one lives forever. In the end, we are all equals in death. Today, the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ unites us all one last in time. Never before have we held such a grand funeral: powerful speeches, noble vows, endless processions. All across our territories, the people are expressing their thanks for everything the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ did for us. No ruler is perfect, but ours worked tirelessly to build a better future for us all.

Owing to preparations made to deal with such a crisis, we will land on our feet even after the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$'s demise. It will take some time to overcome this loss, but from it we will grow stronger.

paragon.5900.desc.50years.zh:
没有人可以永生。最终，我们都在死亡面前平等。今天，$leader_trait_legendary_leader$最后一次将我们聚集到一起。我们从未举行过如此盛大的葬礼：激情昂扬的演讲，高贵的誓言，无尽的送行队伍。在我们境内，人们表达了对$leader_trait_legendary_leader$为我们所做的一切的感激之情。没有统治者是完美的，但我们的领袖不知疲倦地工作，为我们所有人建立更美好的未来。

尽管我们做了应对危机的准备，$leader_trait_legendary_leader$的去世仍然让我们陷入挣扎，因悲伤而痛苦。克服这一损失需要时间，但这也会让我们变得更加坚强。
paragon.5900.desc.50years.en:
No one lives forever. In the end, we are all equals in death. Today, the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ unites us all one last in time. Never before have we held such a grand funeral: powerful speeches, noble vows, endless processions. All across our territories, the people are expressing their thanks for everything the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ did for us. No ruler is perfect, but ours worked tirelessly to build a better future for us all.

Despite preparations made to deal with crises, the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$'s demise has us struggling, saddened by grief. It will take time to overcome this loss, but from it we will grow stronger.

paragon.6000.a.tooltip.zh: 我们会为[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]建造一座装置，使[Ruler.GetHimHer]不朽，但代价是[Ruler.GetHimHer]会永远被囚禁于宫殿中。
paragon.6000.a.tooltip.en: An apparatus will be built for [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName], granting [Ruler.GetHimHer] immortality at the price of locking [Ruler.GetHimHer] inside the palace.

paragon.6000.b.tooltip.zh: 我们的义体控制论专家会为[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]准备延长寿命的先进部件。
paragon.6000.b.tooltip.en: Our cybernetics will prepare the advanced parts which will extend [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s life.

paragon.6000.c.en: Prepare the Zro and the upgrades.

paragon.6000.c.tooltip.zh: 我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]会准备一场仪式，让[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]得到永生。
