paragon.6000.c.tooltip.en: Our [GetPsychicNounPlural] will conduct a ritual to grant [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s immortality.

paragon.6000.d.zh: 为这个合成奇迹做准备。

paragon.6000.d.tooltip.zh: 我们的机器人专家会准备先进的合成人躯壳来延续[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的生命。
paragon.6000.d.tooltip.en: Our roboticists will prepare an advanced synth shell to extend the [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s life.

paragon.6000.desc.zh: [Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的健康正在快速流失，为此我们最好的医疗专家提出了一种非常规的方案。我们会直接在内阁会议厅中建造一座精心设计的装置。让这台机器接管[Ruler.GetHerHis]的大部分生理流程，我们就能让[Ruler.GetHimHer]无限期地存活下去。
paragon.6000.desc.en: With [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s health quickly failing, our best medical minds have devised an unorthodox solution. An elaborate apparatus will be built directly inside of the council chambers. By granting this machine control over many of [Ruler.GetHerHis] natural processes, we can keep [Ruler.GetHimHer] alive indefinitely.

paragon.6000.desc.ap_engineered_evolutio.zh:
"$paragon.6000.desc$

再或者，我们的基因专家提出了另一个方案。尽管花费颇高，但可以用无限的克隆体来承载[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]，使[Ruler.GetHimHer]最终实现永生。
paragon.6000.desc.ap_engineered_evolutio.en:
$paragon.6000.desc$

Alternatively, our geneticists have devised an alternative. Unlimited (though expensive) clone bodies could be made to house [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName], effectively making [Ruler.GetHimHer] immortal.

paragon.6000.desc.ap_mind_over_matter.zh:
$paragon.6000.desc$

我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]也提出了一个方案。通过引导我们人民大众的[GetSorrow]可以操纵虚境的无上能量[GetRejuvenate]我们逝去的领袖。只需要付出些许代价，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]就能无限期地活下去。
paragon.6000.desc.ap_mind_over_matter.en:
$paragon.6000.desc$

Our [GetPsychicNounPlural] have also devised a plan. By harnessing the collective [GetSorrow] of our people, the myriad energies of the Shroud could be manipulated  to [GetRejuvenate] our fallen leader. For a price, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] can be kept alive indefinitely.

paragon.6000.desc.ap_synthetic_evolution.zh: 我们的机器人专家提出了一个修复[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的方案：尽管花费颇高，但我们可以将其意识转移入一个新的自修复正电子神经网络中。能够与所有人建立联系，使我们能够让统治者的能力更上一层楼。
paragon.6000.desc.ap_synthetic_evolution.en: Our roboticists have a suggestion to repair [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]: while expensive, we can move their mind into a new self-correcting positronic network. Being able to network with the entire population allows us to improve their already considerable skills.

paragon.6000.desc.ap_the_flesh_is_weak.zh:
$paragon.6000.desc$

我们的义体控制论专家提出了一个绝妙的方案……只需要用最先进的植入体，我们可以将统治者体内每一个衰竭的生物组织都替换掉，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]就能万寿无疆了。
paragon.6000.desc.ap_the_flesh_is_weak.en:
$paragon.6000.desc$

Our cyberneticists have devised a brilliant plan... Using only the most cutting-edge enhancements, we can replace each faulty biological piece of the ruler's body. Once complete, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] will rule for eternity.

paragon.6000.e.tooltip.zh: 我们的基因专家将会为[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]准备延续寿命用的克隆体。
paragon.6000.e.tooltip.en: Our geneticists will create clones to extend [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s life

paragon.6005.desc.zh:
整个流畅冗长而艰巨。对[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]而言也相比无比痛苦。但结果不言而喻：安置进那台装置后，统治者的怪病消失得无影无踪。

虽然对他的痊愈心存感激，但[Ruler.GetHimHer]身边的人注意到，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的行为举止和情绪都发生了微妙的变化。

现在，我们的领袖必须待在宫殿里，虽然如果首都被我们的敌人占领，我们仍准备有一个转移装置的计划。
paragon.6005.desc.en:
The procedure was long and arduous. For [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] it must have been excruciating. But the results speak for themselves: installed in the apparatus, no trace remains of the ruler's mysterious illness.

While grateful to be cured, those close to [Ruler.GetHimHer] have noted [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s mannerisms and mood have subtly changed.

For now, our leader must remain in the palace, though a plan exists to move the apparatus should the capital be overrun by our enemies.

paragon.6010.desc.zh:
我们的工作成功了！[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]被救回来了。

也许因为[Ruler.GetHisHer]的很大一部分躯体被这个流程影响，[Ruler.GetHisHer]对义体科技的看法发生了改变。过去这项技术仅仅是一种工具，但[Ruler.GetSheHe]现在将其视为通向完美的终极道路。

我们的领袖回来了。但会不会有什么地方不同还不得而知。
paragon.6010.desc.en:
Our work was a success! [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] is saved.

Perhaps because such a significant portion of [Ruler.GetHisHer] body was affected by the procedure, [Ruler.GetHisHer] views on cybernetics have shifted. Where before the technology was merely a tool, [Ruler.GetSheHe] now views it as the ultimate path to perfection.

Our leader is returned to us. But how changed remains an open question.

paragon.6015.desc_1.zh: 我们大功告成了。借助虚境的力量，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]得以幸存。前所未有的强大灵能在其身上流淌而过，[Ruler.GetHeShe]获得了永生。
paragon.6015.desc_1.en: Our work was a success. By invoking the power of the Shroud, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] has been saved. With unprecedented levels of psionic energies coursing through them, [Ruler.GetHeShe] has achieved immortality.

paragon.6015.desc_2.machine.zh: 然而，这场磨难让[Ruler.GetHimHer]的参数变化超出我们的预期。对[Ruler.GetHimHer]的诊断显示有互相冲突的逻辑运算函数同时在子系统中运作。似乎虚境的能量救了光耀者一命，但比起先的预期对其系统更具有侵蚀性。
paragon.6015.desc_2.machine.en: However, the ordeal has left [Ruler.GetHimHer] altered beyond our expected parameters. Diagnostics of [Ruler.GetHimHer] show conflicting logistical processor functions at work within their subsystems. It appears the Shroud's energies are keeping the Luminary active, but with a more corrosive cost on their systems than initially predicted.

paragon.6015.desc_2.organic.zh: 然而，这场磨难让[Ruler.GetHimHer]微妙地起了变化……[Ruler.GetHimHer]身边的人窃窃私语着，似乎看到了其体内有两个截然不同的灵魂。似乎虚境的能量以比最初预期的更严峻、更具侵蚀性的代价维持着光耀者的生命。
paragon.6015.desc_2.organic.en: However, the ordeal has left [Ruler.GetHimHer] subtly changed... Those close to [Ruler.GetHimHer] whisper there are two distinct personalities at work within. It appears the Shroud's energies are keeping the Luminary alive at a steeper, more corrosive cost than initially expected.

paragon.6015.desc_3.zh: 但这一切都可以等一等。目前，更紧迫的问题是保持泽珞的持续供应；如果供应中断，我们的领袖就会灭亡。
paragon.6015.desc_3.en: But all this can wait. For now, the more pressing concern is to maintain a constant supply of Zro; should we ever run out, our leader will perish.

paragon.6020.desc.zh:
成功了！[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的意识被转移到了一个新的合成框架中。量子处理器使[Ruler.GetHimHer]可以即时与任一个合成人个体连接。

这一强大的超意识开始改变我们领袖的观点。现在[Ruler.GetSheHe]专注于宏观处理模式，旨在提高我们文明的整体效率。
paragon.6020.desc.en:
Success! [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s consciousness has been transferred to a synthetic frame. Quantum processing allows [Ruler.GetHimHer] instantaneous networking with every synthetic unit.

This powerful meta-awareness has begun to change our leader's point of view. Now, [Ruler.GetSheHe] are focused on macro processing patterns, aiming to improve the overall efficiency of our civilization.

paragon.6025.a.zh: [Ruler.GetName]现在已经是一个完美的基因原体了。
paragon.6025.a.en: [Ruler.GetName] is now a perfect genetic specimen.

paragon.6025.desc.zh:
克隆流程和手术已经顺利完成。我们的领袖被救活了。

然而，许多人表达了对[Ruler.GetHisHer]态度不可预料变化的担忧。[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]迷恋于新的躯体，[Ruler.GetHisHer]产生了对我们人民下一个进化阶段的执念。[Ruler.GetSheHe]动用了相当多的资源来完善大众的基因图谱。
paragon.6025.desc.en:
The cloning process and operation were a complete success. Our leader is saved.

However, many have expressed concern about some unforeseen changes in [Ruler.GetHisHer] attitude. Enamored with [Ruler.GetHisHer] new form, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] has grown obsessed with the next stage of our people's evolution. [Ruler.GetSheHe] has diverted considerable resources to perfect the genetic profile of the masses.

paragon.6030.desc.machine.zh: $paragon.6030.desc_common$，否则[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的处理器就会被虚境过载摧毁。
paragon.6030.desc.machine.en: $paragon.6030.desc_common$, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s processors will be overloaded and destroyed by the Shroud.

paragon.6030.desc.organic.zh: $paragon.6030.desc_common$，否则[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的意识将会永远消失在虚境之中。
paragon.6030.desc.organic.en: $paragon.6030.desc_common$, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s mind will be lost to the Shroud forever.

paragon.6035.a.zh: 生命无止尽的$leader_trait_legendary_leader$应该领导我们。

paragon.6035.b.zh: 我们会为了人民对政府进行改革。
paragon.6035.b.en: We will reform the government for the people.

paragon.6035.b.tt.zh: 政府会进行改革。$leader_trait_legendary_leader$将继续支持和引导我们，但现在人民有机会选择自己的领袖。
paragon.6035.b.tt.en: The government will be reformed. The $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ will continue to support and guide us, but now the people will have the chance to choose their leader.

paragon.6035.desc.zh: 在手术康复不久后，一场盛大的庆祝活动在[capital_scope.GetName]举行。$leader_trait_legendary_leader$发表了一场演讲，感谢公民和科学家，而[Ruler.GetName]则谈到了他们为[Owner.GetName]规划的美好、繁荣的未来。
paragon.6035.desc.en: Not long after recovering from the procedure, a grand celebration was held on [capital_scope.GetName]. $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ gave a speech thanking citizens and scientists, and [Ruler.GetName] spoke of the bright and prosperous future they have planned for the [Owner.GetName].

paragon.admiral_fight.a.tt.zh: 如果在这个问题上选择斯克兰德，我们可能会面临更多的反弹。
paragon.admiral_fight.a.tt.en: We might face more backlash if we settle with Skrand on this issue.

paragon.admiral_fight.desc.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
paragon.admiral_fight.desc.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service immediately unless we relieve [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName] of their duties.

paragon.origin.insight.en: We are closer to the goal!

paragon.situations.tt.zh: 该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。
paragon.situations.tt.en: This project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.

paragon_2.2105.b.zh: 他们可能终究是有用的……暂时如此。
paragon_2.2105.b.en: They might prove useful... for a time.

paragon_2.2105.desc_01.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地证明了星系处处充满生命。除了占主导地位的物种和国家，还有许多其他的星球。杰出个体可能会不时涌现，动摇着星系霸权的基础。

如果我们能驾驭他们的雄心壮志，这些著名领袖可能会愿意加入我们的事业。
paragon_2.2105.desc_01.en:
We have proven beyond any doubt that the galaxy is filled with life. Apart from the dominant species and nations, there are many others who traverse the stars. From time to time, exceptional individuals may arise to shake the foundations of galactic power.

If we can harness their ambition, these renowned leaders may be willing to join our cause.

paragon_2.2105.desc_02.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地证明了星系处处充满生命。除了占主导地位的物种和国家，还有许多其他的星球。杰出个体可能会不时涌现，动摇着星系霸权的基础。

尽管这些外星人的处事方式相当怪异甚至令人厌恶，但只要驾驭得了这些著名领袖的天赋，就可能会有助于我们的事业。
paragon_2.2105.desc_02.en:
We have proven beyond any doubt that the galaxy is filled with life. Apart from the dominant species and nations, there are many others who traverse the stars. From time to time, exceptional individuals may arise to shake the foundations of galactic power.

Although their alien ways may be strange or even repellent, harnessing the talents of such renowned leaders may prove a boon to our cause.

paragon_2.2105.tt.zh: 从现在起，可能会有著名领袖联系我们。
paragon_2.2105.tt.en: From now on, Renowned Leaders can contact us.

paragon_astrocreation_is.zh: 太空创生是一种高等级的环境改造。它是如此地强大。在一颗行星上播种一颗我的环境改造之核——艾莎琳指了指她背后的花苞——我们就能将几乎任何一种行星改造成一颗欣欣向荣的盖亚星球。这个过程需要许多能量，但结果是非常壮观的。
paragon_astrocreation_is.en: Astrocreation is an advanced variant of terraformation. It is incredibly powerful. By seeding a planet with one of my Terraformation Nuclei--Azaryn indicates the buds on her back--we will be able to transform almost any planet into a thriving Gaia World. The process requires a great deal of energy, but the results are nothing short of spectacular.

paragon_beholder_category_desc.zh: 我们探测到了来自这颗星球的间歇性能量峰值。这些读数表明了一些强大的、远超我们所观察到的未开智物种所具有能力的某种东西。
paragon_beholder_category_desc.en: We have detected intermittent energy spikes coming from the planet. These readings indicate something powerful, and far beyond the capabilities of the pre-sapient inhabitants we've observed.

paragon_beholder_joins.zh: $NAME_The_Beholder$作为一名领袖加入你的帝国
paragon_beholder_joins.en: $NAME_The_Beholder$ joins your Empire as a Leader

paragon_is_not_keides.zh: 该遗址必须由凯德斯自行发掘。
paragon_is_not_keides.en: This site must be excavated by Keides himself.

paragon_legendary_leader_homeworld_desc.zh:
那些无人机所保护的是一颗被潮汐锁定的行星，一面向着夜空的黑暗与严寒，另一面则沐浴着永恒的光明。在温暖的昼半球，我们发现了一座可能曾是瓦格罗人城市的废墟。

凯德斯相信，他过往的细节可能就深埋于此，并且希望在这里的发现能够揭示这颗行星的历史。

这个遗址必须由凯德斯亲自挖掘。
paragon_legendary_leader_homeworld_desc.en:
The planet the drones were protecting is tidally locked, one side facing the cold darkness of space, and the other bathed in perpetual light. On the warm, light-filled half of this world we uncovered the ruins of what may be a Vagrosian city.

Keides trusts that details of his past are buried here, and hopes the findings might reveal the planet's history.

This site must be excavated by Keides himself.

paragon_origin_genetic_ascension.zh:
重铸基因：
在无数次尝试将$leader_trait_legendary_leader$的基因拼接如其他天赋异禀的个体中，一位试验品成功地在手术中存活下来并呈现出了有益形状。然而，为了维持遗传性状的稳定性需要定期注入新的基因材料。
十年度维护费：[owner.paragon_origin_ascension]£pop£ $POPS$
paragon_origin_genetic_ascension.en:
Restored Genes:
After several attempts at splicing the DNA of the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ into other talented individuals, a single patient managed to survive the operation and develop beneficial traits. However, new genetic material needs to be injected regularly to maintain genomic stability.
Decennial Upkeep: [owner.paragon_origin_ascension] £pop£ $POPS$

paragon_origin_psionic_ascension.zh:
能量外溢：
在一次灵能仪式之后，这位领袖成为了通往虚境的媒介。我们所有人的灵能被引导到[Root.GetHimHer]身上，使这位领袖成为一尊准神。然而，这种力量是有代价的，我们必须牺牲其他灵能个体来维持媒介渠道。
十年间维护费：[owner.paragon_origin_ascension]£pop£ $POPS$
paragon_origin_psionic_ascension.en:
Power Overflowing:
After a psionic ritual, this leader became a conduit to the Shroud. The psionic energy of our entire people is channeled into [Root.GetHimHer], making this leader a quasi-divine being. However, such power comes at a cost, and we must sacrifice other psionic individuals to maintain the conduit.
Decennial Upkeep: [owner.paragon_origin_ascension] £pop£ $POPS$

patriotic_institute_true_potential_unlea.zh: 阿达卡利亚的真正潜力
patriotic_institute_true_potential_unlea.en: The True Potential of The adAkkaria

payback_digsite_desc.zh: 曾经威胁我们家园的战舰仍然高悬在头顶，严酷地提醒着我们侥幸逃脱的命运。现在该去夺回我们的天空，取回这艘舰船残骸中的高超科技了。
payback_digsite_desc.en: The warship that once threatened our homeworld still looms over us, a stark reminder of the fate we narrowly escaped. It is time to take back our skies and salvage the technological marvels contained within the wreck.

pc_ringworld_shielded.zh: 被屏蔽的环形世界区段

percussive_maintainer_tooltip.zh: 敲击维护者 以-1技能上限为代价，增加考古学和计算领域的研究速度。
percussive_maintainer_tooltip.en: Percussive Maintainer grants faster research in the fields of Archaeology and Computing at the cost of -1 max Skill Levels.

pheromonefrenzy.revived.tooltip.zh: 你的前殖民地如今已经变成了一颗荒芜的星球，如果有正确的技术，您可以将其变成一个可居住的地方。
pheromonefrenzy.revived.tooltip.en: Your former colony has changed into a desert planet, and can be colonized with the right technology.

pirate.1.desc.black_needle.zh: 很可能$NAME_BlackNeedle$鼓励这种非法活动，甚至可能在支持这些投机取巧的私掠者。
pirate.1.desc.black_needle.en: It is likely that the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ has inspired this illicit activity, and may even be supporting these opportunistic privateers.

pirate.1.desc.nomad.zh:
一群逃兵与叛徒在[pirate_system.GetName]星系安了家。这些亡命之徒驾驶着偷来并经过改装的舰船从我们的编队中溜走，如今正掠夺着维持我们航程的贸易航线。他们自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并发誓不效忠于任何旗帜。

他们出身于舰队，对我们的舰船、航线和行动模式了如指掌。绝不能任由他们继续壮大。
pirate.1.desc.nomad.en:
A band of deserters and renegades has made its home in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. Slipping away from our formation in stolen and modified vessels, these outcasts now prey upon the trade lanes that sustain our journey. They call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and have sworn to answer to no flag.

They are fleet-born, and know our ships, our routes, and our patterns. They must not be allowed to grow any stronger.

pirate.1.desc.storm.zh:
太空海盗！即使他们这种想法也令人兴奋，这个自称为[pirate_band.GetName]的团体把目光转向了我们。

虽然我们可以尊重他们选择的生活方式，但这对我们贸易网络产生的影响可不太理想。
pirate.1.desc.storm.en:
Space pirates! Even the thought is a thrill, and a group calling themselves [pirate_band.GetName] have turned their sights on us.

While we can respect their choice of lifestyle, the effect it's having on our trade networks is less ideal.

pirate.1.desc_01.zh:
由于觊觎我们恒星系之间不断增长的贸易，一大群源自[Root.Capital.GetName]的叛教匪徒已经将一些民船非法改造成了战争武器。这些异端自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并对我们在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内的不设防贸易路线发起了数次袭击。

我们不能容忍他们继续这种亵渎行为！
pirate.1.desc_01.en:
As interstellar trade between our systems continues to grow, a large group of faithless criminals from [Root.Capital.GetName] have illegally converted a number of civilian starships into weapons of war. These heretics have started calling themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and are responsible for several attacks against our vulnerable trade routes in the [pirate_system.GetName] system.

Their profane activities must not be allowed to continue!

pirate.1.desc_02.zh:
据舰队情报机构报告，在上几个月里，我们境内的民间货船遭到数起袭击。袭击者似乎是源自[Root.Capital.GetName]的逃兵以及其它叛徒。

这些匪徒已经用大幅改装的民船组建了一支临时舰队，并正在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系劫掠我们不设防的贸易路线。他们自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”。尽管他们的舰船非常简陋，但仍是个不可忽略的威胁。
pirate.1.desc_02.en:
Naval Intelligence has reported several attacks on civilian shipping in our space within the last several months. The perpetrators appear to be deserters and other renegade elements from [Root.Capital.GetName].

These criminals have put together a makeshift space fleet out of heavily modified civilian hulls and are preying on our vulnerable trade routes in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. They now call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]." Although crude, their vessels are a clear threat that cannot be ignored.

pirate.1.desc_03.zh:
我们社会中某些疯狂的不法分子离开了[Root.Capital.GetName]，并在宇宙的偏僻角落里开始亡命生涯。这些歹徒出人意料地手巧，对许多民用飞船进行了大幅改造并武装了起来。

我们位于[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内的贸易路线没有设防，并开始遭到这支自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”的简陋舰队的劫掠。我们必须迅速对此做出回应。
pirate.1.desc_03.en:
Certain irrational and criminal elements of our society have left [Root.Capital.GetName] to seek an outlaw's life in the far reaches of space. In a display of surprising ingenuity, these brigands have heavily modified and weaponized a large number of civilian starships.

Our vulnerable trade routes in the [pirate_system.GetName] system are now being raided by this improvised starfleet, which identifies itself only as the "[pirate_band.GetName]." A prompt response is needed.

pirate.1.desc_04.zh:
我们的一些商人发来了令人担忧的报告。自从我们发展出太空旅行科技以来，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的边缘群体就不断离开我们的母星，摒弃了我们的和平社会。

这些误入歧途者自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并将数艘民用飞船改造成了战舰。现在他们成了海盗，在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内洗劫我们不设防的贸易路线，他们肆无忌惮的攻击已经造成了许多伤亡。或许有必要采取极端措施来保护我们的人民。
pirate.1.desc_04.en:
Alarming reports are coming in from some of our traders. Since we developed space travel, violent fringe groups on [Root.Capital.GetName] have departed our homeworld in increasing numbers, spurning the peaceful ways of our society.

These misguided individuals call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and have converted several civilian vessels into warships. Living as pirates, they now prey on our vulnerable trade routes in the [pirate_system.GetName] system and their wanton attacks have led to many deaths. Drastic measures may be needed to protect our people.

pirate.1.desc_05.zh:
逃离[Root.Capital.GetName]的叛党与歧见者已将数艘民船改造成战舰，组建了一支匪徒舰队。这些恐怖分子自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并正在我们位于[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系的不设防贸易路线上散播混乱与恐怖。

这些罪大恶极的匪徒死有余辜。我们必须不惜一切代价恢复秩序。
pirate.1.desc_05.en:
Rebels and dissidents fleeing from [Root.Capital.GetName] have founded an outlaw space fleet by modifying several civilian vessels into warships. Calling themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]," these terrorists are spreading chaos and fear along our vulnerable trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system.

Their lives have been rendered forfeit by the enormity of their crimes. Order must be restored, at any cost.

pirate.1.desc_06.zh:
寄生虫永远都会涌向新的市场，企图侵害他人以谋一己之利，在太空中也不例外。[Root.Capital.GetName]上的几个地下犯罪组织已将一小批货船改造成了战舰，将黑手伸向了太空。

这些犯罪分子自称“[pirate_band.GetName]”，而他们的舰船已开始在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内打劫我们不设防的贸易路线。我们应该在事态恶化之前迅速采取行动。
pirate.1.desc_06.en:
Parasitic elements always flock to new markets, seeking to cut into profits at the expense of those doing honest business - space has proven no different. Several underground criminal organizations on [Root.Capital.GetName] have expanded their operations into space by converting a small fleet of civilian freighters into warships.

The outlaws call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and their ships have started menacing our vulnerable trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. We should act quickly before the situation gets out of hand.

pirate.1.desc_07.zh:
随着民间太空旅行变得越来越普遍，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的数个强大的犯罪组织也发现了新的机会。他们将一小批民用货船改造成了自制战舰，并用它们来打劫商船的货物。

我们得知他们自称为“[pirate_band.GetName]”，并已在[pirate_system.GetName]恒星系内数次对我们不设防的贸易路线出手。我们必须尽一切努力，将这些犯罪分子绳之以法。
pirate.1.desc_07.en:
As civilian travel in space becomes more common place, several powerful criminal organizations on [Root.Capital.GetName] have sensed an opportunity to expand their operations. They have converted a number of civilian freighters into improvised warships, with which they raid civilian shipping lanes for booty.

We know they call themselves the "[pirate_band.GetName]" and that they have struck several times against our vulnerable trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system. Every effort must be made to bring these criminals to justice.

pirate.10.a.birth.zh: 我们去袭击他们的老窝，彻底摧毁这个威胁。
pirate.10.a.birth.en: We strike at the heart of this malice.

pirate.10.a.nobirth.zh: 海盗的存在无论对谁都是巨大的威胁。

pirate.10.desc.nobirth.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告说，舰队在[From.GetName]星系发现了很多海盗。

扫描发现海盗船和空间站的数目非常庞大，所以这应该是个历史悠久的海盗港口。这些海盗从很久以前就开始在这里进行抢劫活动，且没有遭遇过任何打击行动。
pirate.10.desc.nobirth.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports that the fleet has encountered a significant pirate presence in the [From.GetName] system.

Judging by preliminary scans of the immense ships and the stations harboring them, this is a historical pirate port. It has likely been in uninterrupted operation since whatever ancient era it was that first spawned these thieving marauders.

pirate.15.desc.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系的海盗私掠船已经被摧毁了。虽然附近恒星系中还有一些零零散散的海盗船，但从目前来看，星际海盗已经成为了过去……至少今天如此。

我们从他们丰厚的储存室里设法缴获了一批来历不明的赃物，这批宝藏我们可以纳入国库，另有他用。
pirate.15.desc.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a considerable hoard of ill-gained loot from their strong room, a treasure which we promptly relocated to our own coffers.

pirate.15.desc2.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系中的破旧海盗船已被摧毁。不考虑邻近星系那些游民的话，星际海盗活动算是成为过去式了……至少就现在而言。

我们能从他们坚固的舱室中收回堆积满满的赃物了，其中包括一张古代数据板——令我们惊讶的是，它似乎能为神秘L-星门的运作方式提供崭新的见解。
pirate.15.desc2.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a considerable hoard of ill-gained loot from their strong room, including an ancient datapad which, startlingly, seems to offer fresh insights into how the mysterious L-Gates function.

pirate.155.corp.zh: 真是大胆的行动，[thalassocracy_species.GetAdj]。你们虽然蠢钝如猪，但确实胆大包天。
pirate.155.corp.en: A bold move, [thalassocracy_species.GetAdj]. Foolish, but bold.

pirate.155.desc.hive.zh:
[root.GetName]实体代表：$pirate.155.proclamation$

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就能防止你们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]受伤，否则，它们可能会遇到麻烦。请放心，我们会将占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]生态居住繁殖计划中。希望你们能共同考虑此提议，我们感激不尽。

$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$
pirate.155.desc.hive.en:
Representative entity of the [root.GetName]: $pirate.155.proclamation$

Sometimes these customs checks can be stressful. We understand. Co-operate, and no [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] need be harmed or otherwise inconvenienced. And please, rest assured that every grain and ore we claim will go to good homes within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. We are grateful for your collective consideration.

$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$

pirate.155.desc.machine.zh:
[root.GetName]的构造体代表：封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。从此以后，该区域的所有机械单位都将成为[thalassocracy_country.GetName]的臣民，为我们服务。反抗的舰队将遭到武力镇压。

我们理解此举可能会对你国造成物质上的极大不便。但我们保证，只要我们的$name_thalassocracy_agency$军官达到其指定配额，我们就会停止此举措。你一定对我们这样的指令系统面临的压力能够表示理解。

在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]的生态居住繁殖图景中，你方重新编程的无人机将承担崇高的使命。$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$
pirate.155.desc.machine.en:
Representative construct of the [root.GetName]: a blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Any and all machine units in this region are henceforth subjects of the [thalassocracy_country.GetName]; they will be made to service us. Resisting fleets will be fired upon.

We appreciate that this operation may represent a material inconvenience to you. We assure you that it will conclude, once our $name_thalassocracy_agency$ officers meet their designated quotas. Surely you can understand the pressures of a directive like ours.

A worthy sense of purpose awaits your re-programmed drones within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. $pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$

pirate.155.desc.regular.zh:
[root.GetName]代表：$pirate.155.proclamation$

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就不会有人受到伤害。请放心，我们会将正式占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]生态居住繁殖计划中。我方对你方的贴心表示无比的感激。

$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$
pirate.155.desc.regular.en:
Representatives of the [root.GetName]: $pirate.155.proclamation$

Sometimes these customs checks can be stressful. We understand. Co-operate, and no one need be harmed. And please, rest assured that every grain and ore we solemnly claim will be put to good use within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. We are grateful for your consideration.

$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$

pirate.155.pacifist.zh: 一定要走到这一步吗，啊？
pirate.155.pacifist.en: Must it come to this, really?

pirate.2.b.zh: 警告所有部队，开始安排战舰。
pirate.2.b.en: Alert all commands. Deploy the fleet.

pirate.2.c.zh: 这些不守规矩的人会得到报应。
pirate.2.c.en: These non-conformists will be dealt with.

pirate.2.d.en: We should be better than this.

pirate.2.e.zh: 我们不需要海盗这种害群之马。
pirate.2.e.en: Pirates. We don't need that scum.

pirate.2.g.zh: 一定要将他们一网打尽。
pirate.2.g.en: They will be brought to justice.

pirate.2.h.en: They must be brought back into the fold.

pirate.25.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]摧毁了位于[From.From.GetStarName]星系的一个海盗空间站，并取回了它的保险模块。
pirate.25.desc.en: The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

pirate.25.desc.black_needle.zh: 此外，我们发现了一批属于前$NAME_BlackNeedle$成员的贵重物品。
pirate.25.desc.black_needle.en: Additionally, we discovered a cache of valuables belonging to former members of the $NAME_BlackNeedle$.

pirate.26.desc.zh:
[pirate_slayers.GetName]已经消灭了位于[pirate_slayers.GetStarName]星系内的一处海盗空间站并回收了空间站的保险模块。

保险模块中除了各种被偷来的资源之外，还有某个不完整的亚空间传送门设计图的存储数据，我们不清楚海盗们是如何取得这个设计图的，但此设计图可以让我们更好的了解跨星系传送门网络的工作原理。
pirate.26.desc.en:
The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

Aside from various stolen resources, the module also contained an ancient datapad with partial schematics of what appears to be a subspace Gateway. There are no records of where the pirates obtained this mysterious datapad, but it has furthered our understanding of how the galactic Gateway network functions.

pirate.50.a.desc.zh: 我们位于[pirate_system.GetName]星系的贸易路线没有得到很好的保护，现在近乎变成了法外之地。该恒星系已经吸引了越来越多的海盗、走私贩以及其它各种不法分子，肆无忌惮地掠夺我们的货物。
pirate.50.a.desc.en: Our trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system is poorly protected and passes through what has largely become lawless space. An increasing number of pirates, smugglers and various other criminal elements have been drawn to the system, and they now raid our shipping with near impunity.

pirate.50.b.desc.zh: 途经[pirate_system.GetName]星系的无防备贸易路线已经引起了一群海盗们的注意。这些匪徒集结了一支大舰队，拦截了该恒星系的大部分贸易。
pirate.50.b.desc.en: The unprotected trade route that passes through the [pirate_system.GetName] system has attracted the attention of a roving band of pirates. These outlaws have gathered a sizeable fleet that is intercepting much of the system's trade.

pirate.50.c.desc.zh: 因其贸易路线毫无防备，[pirate_system.GetName]星系已经吸引了大批不法分子，并且在最近的一次权力争夺之后，这些犯罪分子们已经有了足够的组织性，组成了一支大海盗舰队。他们利用这支东拼西凑的舰队疯狂地劫掠恒星系内的贸易船。
pirate.50.c.desc.en: With its vulnerable and unprotected trade route, the [pirate_system.GetName] system has attracted a large number of ne'er-do-wells, and following a recent power struggle, these criminal degenerates are now sufficiently organized to operate a significant pirate armada. They are using this ragtag fleet to intercept as much trade in the system as they can.

pirate.53.desc.zh:
一小群子个体上出现了罕见的基因突变，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。

它们并不是碰巧选中的这个恒星系，而是因为我们一支最不设防的贸易路线正好途经该恒星系。那些离群的子个体无疑打算当海盗来维持生计，利用它们的少数简陋飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。
pirate.53.desc.en:
A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of drones has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the Mind without being rendered comatose. As these rogue drones would perish if they ventured too far from the Mind's influence, they have established themselves in the [pirate_system.GetName] system within our borders.

This system was not chosen at random - one of our most vulnerable trade routes passes through it, and the rogue drones no doubt intend to sustain themselves by living as pirates, using their small fleet of crude spacecraft to raid our shipping.

pirate.54.desc.zh: 一群外星海盗已经潜入并盘踞在了位于我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。我们有一条不设防的贸易路线途经该恒星系，它们似乎打算掠夺这条贸易路线来维持自己的犯罪活动。
pirate.54.desc.en: A group of alien pirates have infiltrated and established themselves in the [pirate_system.GetName] system, inside our space. To fund their criminal activities, they appear intent on raiding our unprotected trade route that passes through that system.

pirate.56.desc.zh: 一小群故障的单位已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的主体智能，并躲进了我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。这些单位已经无可救药，并开始利用简陋的舰船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。
pirate.56.desc.en: A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the [pirate_system.GetName] system inside our space. These units have become irredeemably corrupted, and they now use crude spacecraft to raid the system's unprotected trade route for spare parts and resources.

pirate.57.desc.zh: 一小群有机生物体的犯罪分子已经设法潜入并盘踞于我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。他们似乎打算打劫途经该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，或许是心存有机生物常见的侥幸心理，误以为他们的存在无关紧要，不会令我们动用武力。
pirate.57.desc.en: A small group of organic sub-units, apparently criminal outcasts, have somehow infiltrated and established themselves in the [pirate_system.GetName] system inside our borders. They seem intent on raiding the system's undefended trade route, perhaps gambling, as organics are wont to do, on the mistaken notion that they are too insignificant to warrant an armed response from us.

pirate.6.desc.zh:
一小群拥有一种罕见基因突变的子个体，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内[pirate_system.GetName]星系。

它们打算当海盗来维持自身，利用少数简陋的飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。
pirate.6.desc.en:
A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of drones has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the Mind without being rendered comatose. As these rogue drones would perish if they ventured too far from the Mind's influence, they have established themselves in the [pirate_system.GetName] system, within our space.

From there they intend to sustain themselves by living as pirates, using their small fleet of crude spacecraft to raid the vulnerable trade route that passes through that system.

pirate.7.desc.zh: 一小群故障的单元已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的中枢，并躲进了我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。这些单位已经无可挽回地腐化，并开始利用简陋的舰船劫掠穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。
pirate.7.desc.en: A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the [pirate_system.GetName] system, inside our space. These units have become irredeemably corrupted, and they now use crude spacecraft to raid the vulnerable trade route that passes through the system for spare parts and resources.

planet_destruction.1000.B.zh: 对于那些被飞速转化为等离子体的人来说他们表现的不错。
planet_destruction.1000.B.en: They flail pretty well for those being flash-converted to plasma.

planet_destruction.1000.desc.neutron.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队已经将滋生在[From.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明进行了清除。结果，这里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
planet_destruction.1000.desc.neutron.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have wiped out the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization that flourished on [From.GetName]. As a result, there is now nothing left to observe there...

planet_destruction.1000.desc.self.zh: 尽管对[GetPreFTLLower]文明使用超级武器非常有趣，但这也意味着那里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
planet_destruction.1000.desc.self.en: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

planet_destruction.1000.desc.shatter.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队摧毁了[From.GetName]的[From.GetPlanetMoon]，杀害了滋生在星球表面的[GetPreFTLLower]文明。结果就是，这里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
planet_destruction.1000.desc.shatter.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have destroyed the [From.GetPlanetMoon] of [From.GetName], killing the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization that flourished on the surface. As a result, there is now nothing left to observe there...

planet_destruction.1000.desc.shield.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队已经将[From.GetName]包裹在了不可穿透的护盾中，使得我们不可能继续对滋生在星球表面上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明继续进行观测……
planet_destruction.1000.desc.shield.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have encased [From.GetName] in an impenetrable shield, making it impossible for us to continue observing the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization flourishing on the surface...

planet_destruction.101.desc.zh:
随着巨像完成其毁天灭地的任务，[From.From.GetName]因受到[From.GetName]地壳破裂与磁层分解的猛烈冲击而产生的微微晃动也平息了下来。

我们很难理解一颗星球死亡时的那种壮烈，但[From.GetName]炽热的核心在冰冷宇宙中冷却时的那种死亡之美是无可争辩的。
planet_destruction.101.desc.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s gentle rocking - buffeted by [From.GetName]'s rupturing crust and unraveling magnetosphere - subsides as the Colossus completes its cataclysmic task.

The sheer violence of a dying planet is difficult to comprehend, but the funereal beauty of [From.GetName]'s molten core cooling in gelid space is undeniable.

planet_destruction.111.a.zh: 这该死的行星，我完全没有同情它。
planet_destruction.111.a.en: Apathetic bloody planet, I've no sympathy at all.

planet_destruction.111.desc.zh: 超空间规划委员会报告，将太阳系的第三行星从重力井移除后，一个天然虫洞形成了。这个虫洞也许能逐渐缓解附近超空间通路的超光速交通拥堵。
planet_destruction.111.desc.en: The Hyperspace Planning Council reports that the removal of the third planet in Sol from the system's gravity well has allowed a natural wormhole to form. This wormhole may eventually reduce FTL traffic congestion in the nearby hyperlanes.

planet_destruction.210.a.en: Tap on the glass and watch them squirm.

planet_destruction.210.desc.zh:
从[From.From.GetName]发出的耀眼光束逐渐暗淡，[From.GetName]寂静无声。

也许历史会将这次屏蔽，这次将[From.GetName]从大宇宙完全隔离的行为，视作极端且不合理。也许也不会。不管如何，从现在起[From.GetStarName]星系有了一颗行星规模的水晶球。
planet_destruction.210.desc.en:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Perhaps history will call the shielding, this complete severing of [From.GetName] from the greater cosmos, extreme and unjustified. Or perhaps not. For now, the [From.GetStarName] system has a new planetary terrarium.

planet_destruction.210.desc.alt.zh:
[From.From.GetName]炫目的光芒已渐渐黯淡，[From.GetName]归于沉寂。

生活将在封闭的世界中继续。
planet_destruction.210.desc.alt.en:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Life goes on, if contained.

planet_destruction.301.bots.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]表面上的灭杀完成后，[From.From.GetName]上的中子羽流逐渐散去。

声波传感器只传输来风声和合成人的呼声。所有高等有机生命已被扫除。
planet_destruction.301.bots.desc.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface.

Sonic sensors relay nothing but the wind and the gentle clicks and whirrs of the surviving synthetic populace. All sapient organic life has been wiped out.

planet_destruction.301.infested.desc.zh:
完成了对[From.GetName]地表的灭杀之后，[From.From.GetName]的中子羽流渐渐消散。

快速扫描确认了曾遍布地表的扭曲翻腾的有机质，已经彻底失去活性，仅剩贫瘠的石堆。
planet_destruction.301.infested.desc.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface.

A quick scan confirms that the infested landscape, previously a roiling and writhing mass of organic activity, is now bereft of all life. Only barren rock remains.

planet_destruction.301.nobots.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]地表上的灭杀完成后，[From.From.GetName]上的中子羽流逐渐散去了。扫描显示未发现智慧生命迹象；植被虽被摧毁，但会逐渐恢复的。有些人会称这种彻底消灭智慧生命，只保留无机质的做法为邪恶的战争罪行。

我们将其称为高效。
planet_destruction.301.nobots.desc.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface. Scans report no signs of sapient life; plant life, while damaged, may recover in time. Some would call the total annihilation of intelligent life, while preserving inanimate matter, a perverse war crime.

We would call it efficient.

planet_destruction.401.desc.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的灵能的嗡声逐渐淡去，一瞬间万物寂静。[From.GetName]上的人群目瞪口呆（如果他们有眼和鼻的话），灵能射线从他们心智絮网中发散着，每个人都着迷于其强大和强烈的个人信仰。

如果他们之前不明白的话，现在他们知道了：我们都只是某个更伟大事物的一部分。
planet_destruction.401.desc.en:
The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and personal truths the psionic ray unfetters from the tangled web of their minds.

If they did not understand before, they know now viscerally: we are all part of something greater.

planet_destruction.401.tooltip.zh:
所有$trait_mechanical$，$trait_machine_unit$或$trait_hive_mind$£pop£人口都被灵能共振摧毁。

所有残存的£pop£生物人口变成$ethic_spiritualist$。

向[This.GetName]添加$god_rayed$修正，持续10年：
唯心思潮吸引力：+999%。
planet_destruction.401.tooltip.en:
Any $trait_mechanical$, $trait_machine_unit$, or $trait_hive_mind$ £pop£ Pops are destroyed by the psionic resonance.

All remaining £pop£ Biological Pops become $ethic_spiritualist$.

Adds the $god_rayed$ modifier to [This.GetName] for 10 years:
Spiritualist Ethics Attraction: +999%.

planet_destruction.501.desc.zh:
[From.From.GetName]已完成纳米同化机器人的部署，其数量经计算足以义体化支配[From.GetName]上所有智慧有机生命。

我们没有在[From.From.GetName]上布置任何传感器或器械以证明我们的成功，但我们知道已经成功了。当我们将目光投于[From.GetName]上时。我们见到了自己，也经由自己所见。

在[From.GetName]表面上，只有我们自己。
planet_destruction.501.desc.en:
The [From.From.GetName] has completed deployment of the assimilation nanobot payload, calculated to be sufficient to cybernetically dominate all sapient organics on [From.GetName].

We did not build the [From.From.GetName] with any sensors or instruments to measure our success, but we know. We open our eyes for the first time down on [From.GetName]. We see ourselves and are seen by ourselves.

On [From.GetName]'s surface, there is only us.

planet_destruction.501.tooltip.zh: 所有£pop£有机人口获得$trait_cybernetic$特质。
planet_destruction.501.tooltip.en: All £pop£ Organic Pops gain the $trait_cybernetic$ trait.

planet_destruction.610.autho.zh: 你的星球很不错，但下一秒就是我的了。
planet_destruction.610.autho.en: That was yours? Well, not anymore.

planet_destruction.610.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是圣地。


你们不明白你们犯下了多大的罪恶。


不过马上就会了。
planet_destruction.610.desc.en:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.

planet_destruction.610.gesta.zh: 一颗星球有什么大不了的？
planet_destruction.610.gesta.en: What is but a single world?

planet_destruction.610.mater.en: It was just a planetary body.

planet_destruction.610.milit.zh: 这只是战术，不是公报私仇。

planet_destruction.610.pacif.zh: 我们需要一个预警措施。

planet_destruction.610.phobe.zh: 你那小小的圣地不会再剩下什么了。
planet_destruction.610.phobe.en: Nothing you hold sacred shall remain.

planet_destruction.610.purif.zh: 异端邪说只有烧尽一途。
planet_destruction.610.purif.en: Old heresies will do naught but burn.

planet_destruction.610.spiri.zh: 我们会展示我们的正统性的。

planet_destruction.610.termi.zh: 就像垃圾数据一样被清理了。
planet_destruction.610.termi.en: Erased, like so much junk data.

planet_destruction.615.spir.en: Consider it as sprinkling the holy water.

planet_destruction.701.desc.zh: 随着从[FromFrom.GetName]上下降的水柱消散，[From.GetName]的表面完全改变了。曾经有广阔缺水的大陆，现在只有崭新闪耀着欢迎的微光的蓝色海洋，随时可以居住。
planet_destruction.701.desc.en: As the column of water descending from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipates, the surface of [From.GetName] is wholly transformed. Where once there were sprawling continents bereft of water, now there is only the welcoming shimmer of pristine, blue ocean ready to be inhabited.

planet_destruction.701.tooltip.zh:
星球变为$pc_ocean$。
没有$trait_aquatic$特质的人口全部死亡。
planet_destruction.701.tooltip.en:
The planet becomes an $pc_ocean$.
All Pops lacking the $trait_aquatic$ trait die.

planet_destruction.801.desc.zh: 来自[FromFrom.GetName]的滔天毒流渐渐平息，[From.GetName]上生意盎然的生态系统不复存在，充满毒气的星球中唯有少数几种生命形式能繁衍生息。
planet_destruction.801.desc.en: As the awesome stream of venomous substances from the [FromFrom.GetName] subsides, [From.GetName] is transformed from a vibrant ecosystem to a noxious world on which few forms of life can thrive.

planet_destruction.901.desc.zh: 随着[FromFrom.GetName]发出的意识清除光束的能量逐渐消散，[From.GetName]的人口几乎都已经退化到了未开智状态。幸免遇难者面对那些曾经认识的人们做出动物般的举动只能束手无策。
planet_destruction.901.desc.en: As the energies of the mind wiping beam from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipate, [From.GetName]'s population has almost entirely regressed to the pre-sapient stage. Those who were spared can now only watch in horror as those they once knew return to animalistic behaviors.

planet_thrusters_desc.zh: [from.GetName]的上层大气中悬浮着一系列大型圆柱体机械。其中没有任何操作员，看起来未在运转。
planet_thrusters_desc.en: Suspended within the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName] is a series of large cylindrical machines. They appear inactive devoid of any crew.

planetary_mechanocalibrator_desc.zh: 一台锈迹斑斑，覆膜一样的机器覆盖着[From.Planet.GetName]表面并深入到行星的内核。为了搞清这台机器的奥秘，我们的考古学家们需要建立一座巨大的发掘站点。
planetary_mechanocalibrator_desc.en: The rusting, film-covered machinery covering [From.Planet.GetName] runs deep into the planet's core. In order to unravel more of this mechanical mystery, our archaeologists will need to establish an extensive dig site.

planets_joining_revolt_tooltip.zh: 以下殖民地也会加入这场叛乱：
planets_joining_revolt_tooltip.en: The following colonies will additionally join the revolt:

plant.100.b.zh: 我们干的不错，是时候聚焦其他事务了。
plant.100.b.en: We did well, time to focus elsewhere now.

plant.100.desc.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在[Root.GetName]上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，[Root.GetName]定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
plant.100.desc.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on [Root.GetName] has come to fruition.

From this day on, [Root.GetName] must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy.

plant.105.desc.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，[From.Planet.GetName]定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
plant.105.desc.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on [From.Planet.GetName] has come to fruition.

From this day on, [From.Planet.GetName] must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy. We are sure that our vassals appreciate our efforts.

plant.110.desc.zh: 我们的宗主在[from.from.planet.GetName]上完成了他们奇异的计划，将其转变成了一颗盖亚星球。承蒙照顾，我们现在可以让这座具有诗一般气候和画一般土地的天国派上用场。
plant.110.desc.en: Our Overlord have completed their strange project on [from.from.planet.GetName], transforming it into a Gaia world. Thanks to them we can now put the idyllic climate and vast open spaces of this paradise to good use.

plant.110.desc.hydrocentric.zh: 我们的宗主在[from.from.planet.GetName]上完成了他们奇怪的计划。这颗恒星被彻底摧毁了！他们用肮脏的平原和崎岖的高山覆盖了海洋。往日潮湿的大气也变得荒凉而干燥。更糟的是，他们对我们的困扰不屑一顾！宗主表示，他们让我们的星球“更加美丽”了。
plant.110.desc.hydrocentric.en: Our Overlord have completed their strange project on [from.from.planet.GetName]. The planet is ruined! They have covered the oceans with plains and rolling hills. The once humid atmosphere has grown barren and dry. Even worse, when we voiced our concerns they were rejected out of hand! The Overlords say that they have made our world "prettier."

plasma_trails_desc.zh:
沿[from.GetName]的构造断层线探测到了不稳定的能量波动。

这些波动的根源无法从轨道上加以确定。需要近距离研究才能弄清该现象的源头。
plasma_trails_desc.en:
Erratic energy surges are being detected along the tectonic fault lines of [from.GetName].

The origin of these spikes cannot be ascertained from orbit. Closer study will be required to identify the source of this phenomenon.

plasma_volcano_desc.zh:
我们目睹了敏感的超热等离子体喷发到[from.GetName]的上层大气中。

大气层中浓厚的火山灰让我们无法从轨道上辨识这些喷射源，但近距离研究似乎存在危险。
plasma_volcano_desc.en:
We have visual confirmation of volatile superheated plasma being launched into the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName].

Thick volcanic ash in the atmosphere is preventing us from identifying the source of these projectiles from orbit. Closer study will likely be dangerous.

po_apply_pop_template_tier1.zh: 对$@po_apply_pop_template_tier1_nb_pop|0$以上£pops£人口应用一个物种模板。
po_apply_pop_template_tier1.en: Apply a Species Template to $@po_apply_pop_template_tier1_nb_pop|0$ or more £pops£ Pops.

po_apply_pop_template_tier2.zh: 对$@po_apply_pop_template_tier2_nb_pop|0$以上£pops£人口应用一个物种模板。
po_apply_pop_template_tier2.en: Apply a Species Template to $@po_apply_pop_template_tier2_nb_pop|0$ or more £pops£ Pops.

po_apply_pop_template_tier3.zh: 对$@po_apply_pop_template_tier3_nb_pop|0$以上£pops£人口应用一个物种模板。
po_apply_pop_template_tier3.en: Apply a Species Template to $@po_apply_pop_template_tier3_nb_pop|0$ or more £pops£ Pops.

po_complete_arc_site_or_rift_stage.en: Complete a chapter of an $ARCHAEOLOGICAL_SITE$ or $ASTRAL_RIFT$.

po_pass_law_federation.zh: 在£federation£联邦中通过一条法律。
po_pass_law_federation.en: Pass a law in a £federation£ Federation.

po_reach_excellent_relations.zh: 与另一个帝国达到关系极佳。
po_reach_excellent_relations.en: Reach Excellent Relations with another empire.

po_release_sector_as_vassal.zh: 将一个£sector£星域释放为£vassal£附庸
po_release_sector_as_vassal.en: Release a £sector£ Sector as a £vassal£ Vassal

po_research_project.zh: 完成一项特殊研究项目。

po_wormhole_and_locks.zh: 探索一个虫洞或建造一个$DIMENSIONAL_LOCK$。
po_wormhole_and_locks.en: Explore a Wormhole or construct a $DIMENSIONAL_LOCK$.

poi_curator_location_desc.zh: 我们认为有一个致力于知识积累的文明残余曾在此处寻找庇护所。
poi_curator_location_desc.en: We believe that the remnants of a civilization dedicated to the accumulation of knowledge sought their refuge here.

poisoned_atmosphere_desc.zh: 在[from.GetName]的上层大气探测到了高浓度的毒性有机分子。
poisoned_atmosphere_desc.en: High concentrations of organic poisonous molecules have been detected in the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName].

polaris_seed_vault_desc.zh:
漂浮在 [From.Planet.GetName] 行星残骸水晶的般清澈的海洋上，包裹在微小冰盖的，似乎是一个人造结构。

需要一个团队来挖掘这个结构。
polaris_seed_vault_desc.en:
Encapsulated in what remains of the planet's tiny ice cap, floating on the crystal clear oceans of [From.Planet.GetName], is what appears to be an artificial structure. 

A team is required to excavate this structure.

pop_did_not_kill_stalker.zh: 试图击杀突变体时失败了

portal_closed_tooltip.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
portal_closed_tooltip.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

portal_zone_tooltip.zh: 可以对位面传送门进行长期研究。
portal_zone_tooltip.en: The Dimensional Portal can be studied on an ongoing basis.

potentially_corrupted_units.zh: 我们观测到几个存栈单位的可疑行为，最多四个单位将受到影响。
potentially_corrupted_units.en: We have observed suspicious behavior in several unit stacks. Up to four pops may be affected.

pre_ftl_remains_site_desc.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的表面遍布系统性毁灭的伤疤：残垣断壁、满目疮痍、一片死寂。最初的扫描显示这里曾经存在过一个繁荣的前超光速社会，直到一些事件导致了他们灾难性的终结。四处散落的遗骸低语着一种无法言说的恐怖。
pre_ftl_remains_site_desc.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] planet bears the scars of systematic devastation: blasted landscapes, collapsed cities, and an eerie silence. Initial scans suggest a once-thriving pre-FTL society existed here - until something brought about their catastrophic end. The scattered remains whisper of an untold horror.

precursor.1.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于远古外星文明的文物！从这些遗物的年代来看，他们应该是在大约1200万年前活跃在这一区域的文明。
 
从我们所能拼凑起的情报中，科学家总结出这是一种自称为“沃陶姆恒星议会”的外星物种，他们长得像蠕虫的环节动物，大约3-4米长，彼此主要借助体节传递的振动进行交流。
precursor.1.desc.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! They must have been active in this region of space approximately 12 million years ago, judging by the age of the artifacts.

From what they have been able to piece together, our scientists theorize that these aliens, who called themselves the "Vultaum Star Assembly," were worm-like annelids, roughly 3 to 4 meters in length, that communicated with each other primarily through vibrations carried along their segmented bodies.

precursor.10.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]表面发现了一个古老的沃陶姆观测站，[From.GetStarName]系统距离沃陶姆的发源地相当遥远，这个设施似乎也是主要被用来观测他们自己的恒星的。我们已经浏览了一边观测站还残存的数据，但是完全不知道沃陶姆到底在他们的观测站里寻找什么。
precursor.10.desc.en:
An ancient Vultaum observatory has been found on the surface of [From.GetName]. The [From.GetStarName] system is fairly distant from the region of space where the Vultaum originated, and this facility appears to have been primarily used for the observation of their own stars.

We have gone over the observatory's surviving data, but there are no clues as to exactly what the Vultaum were searching for in their observations.

precursor.100.desc.zh: 在这之后，我们的科学家加班加点的修复了沃陶姆在[Root.Capital.GetName]上所留的文物，并成功推导出沃陶穆尔所在的确切星系坐标——古老的沃陶姆文明的家园恒星系！我们应当抢在别的文明捷足先登之前对这个星系进行考察。
precursor.100.desc.en: After intense study of our recovered Vultaum artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of Vultaumar - the home system of the ancient Vultaum civilization! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

precursor.100.name.zh: 发现沃陶姆的母星星系

precursor.1000.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！如果没错的话，这个文明应该是由不同的种群建立的联盟，他们称呼自己为“第一联盟”。这些种群在两百万年前相对和平地在这片星域共存着。

虽然[From.GetStarName]坐落在他们核心范围内，在飞船上的文物中找到的一张局部地图表明，第一联盟陨落前已经统治了我们星系很大部分。
precursor.1000.desc.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! If what we have learned from these artifacts is correct, this civilization was some sort of confederation that consisted of many different alien races. They called themselves the "First League" and appear to have co-existed in relative peace some two million years ago.

Though the [From.GetStarName] system lies in the region of space that seems to have made up the core of their territory, a partial map found among the artifacts indicates that this First League may have covered a significant portion of our galaxy before its eventual collapse.

precursor.1005.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]轨道上发现了一定是第一联盟舰队基地的废墟。我们知道第一联盟维持一支叫做无敌舰队的大型舰队，与海盗和其他敌对国作战——这个港口很显然是提供给一支巡逻舰队停泊的。
precursor.1005.desc.en: The wreckage of what must have been a major First League naval base has been detected in orbit around [From.GetName]. We know the League maintained a massive fleet called the "Grand Navy" to combat piracy and safeguard member nations from external aggressors - this particular outpost appears to have provided berthing for one of their rimward patrol fleets.

precursor.1006.desc.zh: 第一联盟舰队基地的考古挖掘任务已经完成了。我们回收了第28外环星域巡逻舰队的勋章，该巡逻舰队是一支负责保护星际外环直通联合帝国的贸易路线安全的中等规模的舰队。环绕[From.From.GetName]的基地显然是他们的归程港湾。
precursor.1006.desc.en: Our archaeological mission to the First League naval base has concluded. We recovered the emblem of the 28th Outer Rim Patrol Fleet, a mid-sized task force charged with the defense of trade routes leading to League associate nations along the galactic rim. The base orbiting [From.From.GetName] was apparently their home port.

precursor.101.desc.zh:
沃陶姆母星破碎的残骸显示了它在1200万年前遭受了灭绝性的打击，起因是某种反物质仪器的引爆。从[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]表面残留的废墟中，我们了解到沃陶姆帝国曾在消灭前经历过巨大的思想转变。

他们新的哲学认为整个宇宙都不过是一个更高级的存在用来享乐的虚拟现实系统，所有智慧生物都被接入这个系统而毫不知情。不少沃陶姆人采取越发极端的尝试与其“断开连接”，其中很多人都选择了自杀。

最终他们总结出，只有数十亿个体同时断连，才足以破坏整个系统的稳定，使他们重获自由。于是在一个约定的时间，宇宙各处所有的沃陶姆人开始用任何可能的手段自杀。而那些拒绝参加大规模自杀的人实在太少，无法继续正常的繁衍，沃陶姆文明因此逐渐消散，最终灰飞烟灭。
precursor.101.desc.en:
The shattered remnants of the Vultaum homeworld reveal that it underwent a massive extinction event 12 million years ago, caused by the detonation of some kind of antimatter device. From the ruins that remain on the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, we have learned that Vultaum society experienced a radical ideological shift a century before their extinction.

Their new philosophy posited that the entire universe was an artificial reality which all sapient beings had been unwittingly plugged into for the amusement of some higher power. The Vultaum undertook increasingly radical attempts to forcefully "disconnect" themselves from this simulation, most of which involved mass suicide.

They finally concluded that only the simultaneous disconnection of billions of individuals would destabilize the system enough to grant them freedom. At an agreed upon hour, Vultaum everywhere killed themselves by any means available. Those who refused to take part in this mass suicide were too few to repopulate the species, and so the Vultaum faded into obscurity and eventual extinction.

precursor.1010.desc.zh: 第一联盟的巡洋舰的船头部分被发现正在环绕[From.GetName]，这些残骸组成了剩下的飞船。但是遗留的部件保存得很不完好。舰体外壳布满了一些洞孔，这些洞孔估计是大型质量投射器留下的。
precursor.1010.desc.en: The bow section of an ancient First League cruiser has been discovered orbiting [From.GetName]. There is insufficient debris nearby to account for the rest of the ship, but what little remains is in very poor condition. The hull has been riddled with holes from what appears to be large mass driver projectiles.

precursor.1011.desc.zh: 出发前往环绕[From.From.GetName]的第一联盟巡洋舰去勘探的考古探险队已经回来了。在已成为遗骸的舰体上并没发现什么有价值的东西，但考古学家找到了船员名册。第一联盟从它所有的成员星球上招募人员来加入他们的联合星舰队，也就是无敌舰队，从名册上可以了解到这艘巡洋舰上的船员来自于12个不同种族。
precursor.1011.desc.en: The archaeological expedition to the First League cruiser orbiting [From.From.GetName] has returned. Little of use could be found on the ruined vessel, but the archaeologists did manage to recover its crew manifest. The First League called upon all of its member worlds to staff the Grand Navy, their joint starfleet, and through the manifest we have learned that the crew of this particular cruiser was made up of individuals from twelve different species.

precursor.1015.desc.zh: 对于[From.GetName]的调查显示[From.GetPlanetMoon]是汉姆达的母星，他们是第一联盟的创始成员。大型的蜂窝状建筑曾经覆盖了大部分星球表面，但我们了解到汉姆达在南半球划出了一个很大的圆形区域禁止任何的建筑。这片区域有整个南半球的三分之一那么大，它既是一个配偶繁衍的地方又是一个自然保护区。
precursor.1015.desc.en: The survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was the homeworld of the insectoid Khamdai, one of the founding members of the ancient First League. Massive hive-like cities once covered most of the surface, but we have learned that the Khamdai banned all construction in a large circular region extending across more than a third of the southern hemisphere. This area served as both a mating ground and nature reserve.

precursor.1016.desc.zh:
前往[From.From.GetName]的考古探险队了解到了不少关于已经灭绝的汉姆达的事情。汉姆达秉持尚武文化，当他们的飞船可以突破光速后，他们和其他很多第一联盟的建立者们发生了好几次大型战争。

在战争宣告失败后，汉姆达摇身一变成为了第一联盟的坚定支持者，他们最强的战士加入了联盟的突击队来保卫联盟安全。我们发现了保存完好的“马吉尔-沙”，这是担任第一联盟荣誉卫士的汉姆达人用的仪式镰刀。
precursor.1016.desc.en:
Our archaeological expedition to [From.From.GetName] has learned much about the now-extinct Khamdai. They were a warrior culture that fought several wars against many of the other First League founders soon after their first starships breached the light barrier.

After meeting with defeat, the Khamdai became an enthusiastic supporter of the First League's founding and many of their finest warriors would go on to serve as shock troops against the League's enemies. We have recovered a perfectly preserved "magil-sha," a ceremonial sickle used by Khamdai members of the First League Honor Guard.

precursor.102.desc.a.zh: 沃陶姆人古老破碎的母星已经被发现，但显然已经有人捷足先登了。[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]上尚存价值的东西已经所剩无几。
precursor.102.desc.a.en: The shattered homeworld of the ancient Vultaum has been found, but it has clearly been visited by someone else recently. Nothing of value remains to be found on the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon].

precursor.102.desc.b.zh: 根据我们的调查数据显示，这个残破的星球是一个叫做“沃陶姆”的古老文明的母星，这里已经被其他最近到访的宇宙文明扫荡过了，现在[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]上已经没有任何有价值的残骸了。
precursor.102.desc.b.en: According to our survey data, this broken world once served as the homeworld of an ancient civilization known as the "Vultaum." There are signs that other spacefarers visited here recently... nothing of value remains to be found on the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon].

precursor.1020.desc.zh: 这颗星球是古卡萨克文明的母星，这个蛇人文明是第一联盟的创始成员之一。他们的大型城市都在地底下，[From.GetName]布满了隧道网络，但在两百万年前卡萨克灭绝后这些隧道就崩塌了。[Root.GetName]的探测器已经锁定了几处可能的地下城市位置。
precursor.1020.desc.en: This world is the ancient homeworld of the serpentine Chassago, one of the founding members of the First League. The vast majority of their cities were located underground and [From.GetName] is riddled with tunnel networks, of which most have collapsed in the two million years since the Chassago went extinct. Probes from the [Root.GetName] have identified the probable locations of several subterranean cities.

precursor.1021.desc.zh:
虽然对位于[From.From.GetName]地下的卡萨克城市的挖掘还在进行中，我们已经了解到足够多的关于这个远古物种的信息。他们属爬虫类动物，身体细长且无腿，成年卡萨克身长可达20米甚至更长。

所有遗留的资料均表明卡萨克极其善于贸易，他们的贸易船队经常是第一联盟和非联盟种族的第一次接触。如果没有这些在联盟成立前就已经存在的错综复杂的卡萨克贸易网络的话，恐怕联盟也没办法扩张的如此迅速。
precursor.1021.desc.en:
The excavation of the subterranean Chassago cities on [From.From.GetName] is well underway, and we have already learned much about this ancient species. They were reptilian, with elongated and legless bodies that could be twenty meters or longer in adult individuals.

All surviving accounts indicate that the Chassago were expert traders, and their trade barges were often the first point of contact between non-affiliated races and the First League. It is doubtful whether it could have expanded as rapidly as it did without the benefit of the extensive Chassago trade network that already existed before its foundation.

precursor.1025.desc.zh: 体型娇小但繁殖快速的米格杨人是古代第一联盟的创始成员之一。[From.GetName]是他们的母星。他们居住在星球表面上成百上千的大型建筑中，这些建筑每个都可以容纳上百万人。这些建筑通过天梯互相连接，米格杨人显然不想到[From.GetPlanetMoon]野外去。
precursor.1025.desc.en:
The diminutive but fast-breeding Migir-Yan were one of the founding members of the ancient First League, and [From.GetName] was their homeworld. The population was clustered into hundreds of massive arcologies spread out across the surface, each capable of supporting several hundred million individuals.

These arcologies were connected by a network of skyways, and the Migir-Yan were evidently content to leave the rest of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wilderness untouched.

precursor.1026.desc.zh:
灭绝的米格杨人化石残骸被我们的考古学家在[From.From.GetName]挖掘出来，这让我们能更清楚的看到这个物种原有的样子：他们的体型非常小，绝大多数个体长度都不超过0.6米，这些类哺乳啮齿动物是食草的。

米格杨的家庭成员通常由一千名个体所组成，每名个体成员的社会地位几乎完全由他们的技能所决定。据说第一联盟的成立就是由米格杨外交使团所一手促成的。
precursor.1026.desc.en:
Fossilized remains of the extinct Migir-Yan have been recovered by our archaeologists on [From.From.GetName], allowing us to paint a clearer picture of what this species looked like. Unusually small, with most individuals being no taller than 0.6 meters, these mammalian rodent analogues were herbivores.

Migir-Yan family units often consisted of close to a thousand individuals, and an individual's station in society depended almost exclusively on their social skills. The Migir-Yan diplomatic corps is believed to have been the driving force behind the creation of the First League.

precursor.1030.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是鸟类维若帕的母星，这个种群是古代第一联盟的创始成员之一。这些不能飞翔的类鸟人，靠着长长的腿走路。化石显示他们中的女性身长可以到四米高，男性则稍微矮点。

所有的城市都是建立在挖出的平台上。扫描还显示这些平台是人工建造的，可能是维若帕人在缺乏更多的自然居所候选的情况下建立起的新城市。
precursor.1030.desc.en:
[From.GetName] was the homeworld of the avian V'ropak, a species that was among the founding members of the ancient First League. These flightless bird analogues walked on long, spindly legs and fossilized remains suggest that their females could reach heights of up to four meters, while males were slightly smaller.

All of their cities were built inside hollowed out mesas. Scans indicate that some of these mesas were artificially constructed, presumably by the V'ropak themselves after they ran out of natural candidates to build new cities within.

precursor.1031.desc.zh: 当第一联盟的势力达到鼎盛时，维若帕种群被称为是星系中最棒的科学家。他们的研究发明成果支撑着联盟的早期扩张阶段，不止一个物种出于对维若帕科技的向往而加入联盟。不幸的是，在如今[From.From.GetName]的废墟中，却没有发现任何维若帕科技的痕迹。
precursor.1031.desc.en: When the First League was at the zenith of its power, the V'ropak were renowned as the best scientists in the galaxy. Their research innovations drove the League's initial expansion phase, and more than one species was brought into the fold by promises of access to V'ropak technology. Unfortunately, none of this technology remains to be found among the ruins of [From.From.GetName] today.

precursor.1035.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面扫描中我们在[From.GetPlanetMoon]地表发现了古代设施遗迹。这些设施在两百万年前一场大爆炸中被抹去。但是多多少少有些外围建筑保存了下来。所有的证据都显示这些是由第一联盟建造的研究设施。
precursor.1035.desc.en: A surface scan of [From.GetName] has identified the remnants of an ancient installation on the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Most of the facility was wiped out in a massive explosion some two million years ago, but a few outlying buildings more or less survived the blast. All evidence recovered so far points towards this having been some sort of research base built by the First League.

precursor.1036.desc.zh:
我们派去[From.From.GetName]的考古探险队回来了。他们负责调查的第一联盟研究基地上并没有发现多少有价值的东西，但是根据研究基地那偏僻的地理位置，我们推测那里应该是进行危险实验研究的地方——很可能和次元穿越或者高级生物武器相关。

在“科学院”回收的一张数据碟上，我们发现了和第一联盟科学界的体系结构相关的信息。
precursor.1036.desc.en:
The archaeological expedition we sent to [From.From.GetName] has returned. Very little remained of the First League research base they were sent to investigate, but judging by its isolated location, we suspect that the research conducted there was of a dangerous nature - possibly involving dimensional travel or advanced bio-weapons.

A recovered data disc from the "Academy of Sciences" has offered some insights into how the scientific community of the First League was organized.

precursor.1040.desc.zh: [From.GetName]上的第一联盟殖民地废墟被发现了。这个殖民地在第一联盟的末期，是一个社会实验设施-最初的成员是由联盟各个成员的平均分配的，在这个殖民地建立不到五十年后被遗弃了。
precursor.1040.desc.en: Ruins of a First League colony have been unearthed on [From.GetName]. The colony appears to have been a social experiment conducted in the League's waning years - the initial population consisted of an equal number of colonists from all of the League's member species. It was abandoned less than fifty years after its founding.

precursor.1041.desc.zh:
我们的考古学家发现了更多关于[From.From.GetName]上的失落的殖民地的相关信息。在成立之初，第一联盟就已经处于崩溃边缘，联盟使用殖民地作为宣传工具——向大家展示一个所有联盟成员在一起生活工作的其乐融融的星球范本。

这种公告似乎起到了反效果，因为有证据表明殖民地之间曾多次发生过大规模冲突，这里面甚至包括某殖民地被遗弃前的一场大灭绝行动。
precursor.1041.desc.en:
Our archaeologists have learned more about the lost colony on [From.From.GetName]. At its founding, the First League was already on the verge of collapse and the colony was meant to serve as a propaganda tool - a model world where all League members were represented and worked together in harmony.

This effort appears to have backfired, as there is evidence of significant infighting between the colonists, including a large massacre that occurred just before the colony was abandoned.

precursor.1045.desc.zh: 两百万年前，[From.GetName]作为第一联盟各成员国的交易中心。[From.GetPlanetMoon]表面上大量的人口分布在塔型城市中，我们至少发现了十二个北半球的太空港。随着贸易路线的更改及第一联盟的陨落，[From.GetPlanetMoon]在几个世纪后被渐渐遗弃。
precursor.1045.desc.en: Two million years ago, [From.GetName] served as a major trading hub for the member nations of the First League. Large portions of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface was covered in towering cities, and we have identified the ruins of at least twelve major spaceports in the northern hemisphere alone. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was gradually abandoned over a period of several centuries, presumably as a result of shifting trade routes and the collapse of the First League.

precursor.1046.desc.zh: 到底是哪个种群最先定居于这颗星球，已经无从得知了——所有已知的第一联盟成员的骨骼与化石遗骸都在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]被发掘出来，而且每个种群的遗骸数量几乎均等。我们的考古学家还发现了十几具并非正式联盟成员的种群遗骸，这些种群似乎很享受在第一联盟领域中的贸易特权。
precursor.1046.desc.en: It is unclear which species first settled this world - bones and fossilized remains from all known First League member species have been found on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] in nearly equal amounts. Our archaeologists have also secured remains from half a dozen races that weren't official members, but who seem to have enjoyed special trading privileges in First League space.

precursor.105.desc.zh: 有那么一瞬间，宇宙的构造似乎被扭曲了，然后在古老的沃陶姆遗珍周围伸展。正如我们所知道的那样，现实再次慢慢地展现自身，就在这时，一个短暂的时机出现了，一些规则在此刻可以被巧妙地改写。
precursor.105.desc.en: For an instant, the fabric of the universe seems to contort and then expand around the ancient Vultaum relic. As reality as we know it slowly reasserts itself, a brief window appears where some of the rules can be subtly rewritten.

precursor.1050.desc.zh: 在两百万年前第一联盟的无敌舰队和另一只舰队发生了一场大型战役，离这里不远的[From.GetName]重力场捕捉了那场战役的很多残骸碎片。这些大型碎片也可以在[From.GetPlanetMoon]表面上找到。
precursor.1050.desc.en: A great battle between the Grand Navy of the First League and another fleet took place not far from here some two million years ago. The gravity well of [From.GetName] has since captured much of the debris left by this engagement, and the wreckage of several massive hulks can be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

precursor.1051.desc.zh:
我们的考古学家成功在[From.From.GetName]的地表挖掘出了几艘飞船的舰体，这些舰体是两百万年前发生在这个恒星系的一场宇宙大战中留下的遗迹。参加大战的是第一联盟无敌舰队的第二和第三舰队，为了抵御里金种群联合舰队的进攻，里金是星际外环中的一个到处游荡的好战种群。

本来的一场微不足道的小冲突迅速升级为一场双方各出动数百飞船参与的大型战役，这次战役的最终结果无从得知。
precursor.1051.desc.en:
Our archaeologists have successfully excavated several starship hulls on the surface of [From.From.GetName], relics from the massive space battle that took place in this system two million years ago. The forces involved were the 2nd and 3rd Fleets of the First League Grand Navy, fighting to contain an incursion by the combined fleets of the Rikim, a nomadic warrior species from the galactic rim.

What began as a minor skirmish quickly escalated into a running fleet battle involving hundreds of ships on both sides. It is impossible to tell which side won.

precursor.1055.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]发现了一处大型的第一联盟监狱设置废墟。这颗星球大概是某种最高安全级别的监狱。这里关押了整个帝国的重犯。留存的记录显示，大多数的犯人都因为当海盗，搞破坏和其它“性质恶劣”犯罪被收押。在牢房里还能找到囚犯的化石。
precursor.1055.desc.en:
The ruins of a large prison complex have been discovered on [From.GetName]. This hostile world seems to have served as some kind of maximum-security penal colony in the First League. As a federal facility, the prison housed convicted felons from across all of League space.

Surviving records indicate most of the prisoners were guilty of piracy, terrorism and other crimes of "extraordinary nature." Fossilized remains from some prisoners can still be found where the cells used to be.

precursor.1056.desc.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]的考古工作中发现在监狱设施南部的某地曾发生了一次失败的逃狱行动。小断崖后面有一辆翻倒的监狱运输车，而在几千米之外则发现了身穿偷来的压力服并紧紧挤成一团的监狱服刑人员的遗骸。他们似乎死于压力服氧气耗尽所引发的窒息。不管出于什么原因，监狱管理者似乎是觉得没必要回收这些犯人的尸体了。
precursor.1056.desc.en:
The archaeological mission to [From.From.GetName] has uncovered evidence of what appears to be a failed escape attempt some distance south of the prison complex. A toppled utility vehicle from the prison was found behind a small cliff, and several kilometers beyond that the remains of several prisoners in stolen pressure suits were huddled together.

They seem to have died of asphyxiation when the oxygen supply in their suits ran out. For whatever reason, the prison authorities evidently saw no reason to collect the bodies.

precursor.1060.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]是一个两百万年前早期青铜时代文明的居住站。有趣的是，[Root.GetName]也发现了在[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的隐藏观测站，这些观测站都是第一联盟修筑的。第一联盟一边努力避免文化入侵，一边研究[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]文明。

大部分的观测站都被一种先进的能量武器摧毁了，我们也不清楚为什么这个[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]文明一直处在青铜时代。
precursor.1060.desc.en:
[From.GetName] was inhabited by an early Bronze Age civilization some two million years ago. Interestingly, the [Root.GetName] has also found evidence of hidden observation posts on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] that were built by the First League. It would appear that they studied the [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] aliens while making an effort to avoid cultural contamination.

Most of the observation posts were destroyed by advanced energy weapons, and we have found nothing yet to explain why the [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization never advanced beyond the Bronze Age.

precursor.1061.desc.zh: 从我们在[From.From.GetName]的考古研究，我们发现了第一联盟从不插手前宇宙文明的发展。他们在至少七颗星球建造了类似[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的那种隐秘观察前哨。这一个文明是在第一联盟崩溃后受到一群星际奴隶主的袭击而毁灭的。
precursor.1061.desc.en:
From our archaeological findings on [From.From.GetName], we have learned that the First League maintained a clear policy not to interfere in the development of pre-space civilizations. Hidden observation posts like the ones we found on this [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] were maintained on at least seven worlds throughout League space.

This particular civilization appears to have met its end when a band of slavers invaded during the power vacuum that resulted from the First League's collapse.

precursor.1065.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]位于被认为在两百万年前是第一联合领域的身处，这应该是一种被描述为“逆鳞”的种族殖民地或者家园世界。

这两个群体卷入了某种贸易战争，联合的宏伟海军在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的两个不同地点持续维持了封锁。轨道的碎片揭示这个封锁经历了好几次血腥的挑战。
precursor.1065.desc.en:
[From.GetName] lies deep inside what was considered First League space two million years ago, and it appears to have been either a major colony or the homeworld of a species described as "non-compliant" in surviving League records.

The two parties appear to have been engaged in some kind of trade war, and the League's Grand Navy maintained extensive blockades of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] on at least two separate occasions. Orbital debris indicate that the blockades were violently challenged several times.

precursor.1066.desc.zh: 一群考古学家从[From.From.GetName]表面发现了一个第一联盟的驱逐舰的残骸。它一定是轨道封锁的舰队的一部分，似乎是因为[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的异星种群引爆了隐藏在一艘偷渡船上的反物质设备而被摧毁的。考古学家成功回收了一部分驱逐舰的数据库，提供了当时参与封锁的第一联盟的飞船列表。
precursor.1066.desc.en: A team of archaeologists found the wreckage of a First League destroyer on the surface of [From.From.GetName]. It must have been part of the orbital blockade, and seems to have gone down when the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s native aliens detonated a hidden antimatter device on a captured blockade runner. The archaeologists managed to retrieve a partial copy of the destroyer's databanks, providing us with a list of all First League vessels that took part in the blockade.

precursor.1070.desc.zh: 这个小行星成为了不同不法组织的不法天堂，这个地方在第一联盟势力内一度很繁荣。来自联盟不同种群的贸易家，走私犯，和下层人聚集在这卸货，寻求新的合作或者在小酒店里面休息。
precursor.1070.desc.en: This asteroid appears to have served as a lawless port for the various criminal organizations that were active in the territory of the First League. Smugglers, pirates, mercenaries and other lowlifes from every League member species gathered here to offload illicit cargo, broker new deals or just relax in one of the asteroid's many cantinas.

precursor.1071.desc.zh: 派往小行星[From.From.GetName]的考古小队发现了两百万年前纵横第一联盟的不法组织的很多信息。当联盟中的成员国互相开通边界时，罪案也随之滋生。偷渡和海盗是当时非常严重的问题，联盟的大部分舰队都忙于打击这些罪案。
precursor.1071.desc.en: The archaeological mission to asteroid [From.From.GetName] has revealed much about the criminal underworld active throughout the First League two million years ago. As member nations opened borders to one another, crime flourished alongside trade. Smuggling and piracy appears to have been serious problems that occupied a large portion of the sizable League fleet.

precursor.11.desc.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]进行的考古发掘在一座天文台一间布满灰尘的小屋中发现了一张小型壁画。上面似乎描绘了数个星座，如从沃陶姆主星观察应该可以看见。我们的天文学家目前还不能确定其中的任何一颗星球。
precursor.11.desc.en: The archaeological dig on [From.From.GetName] has uncovered a small mural in one of the observatory's dust-covered smaller chambers. It seems to depict several different constellations, possibly as they would appear if viewed from the Vultaum homeworld. Our astronomers have not been able to identify the individual stars.

precursor.1100.desc.zh: 在经过对第一联盟飞船的仔细研究后，在[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学家们最终确定了第一联盟的母星系-哈本尼斯之泽！我们应该马上展开探索，不要让别人抢在我们前头。
precursor.1100.desc.en: After intense study of our recovered First League artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of Fen Habbanis - the home system of the great First League! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

precursor.1101.desc.zh:
在第一联盟的长期历史中，[FromFrom.GetName]大部分时间都是第一联盟的行政中心，也是他们的元老议员的办公地，这颗[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]是个人口密集之地，一个全球尺度的城市占据了地表的大部分。亿万级的人口，决定了他们的食物只能从外部进口。

当联盟分崩离析，这些运输食物的飞船在一夜间停止了食物供应。有一些居民飞向了其他星球，但大部分人都被留下来了。饥饿与混乱开始肆虐，[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]成为了军阀和犯罪组织的天堂。

人口在几个世纪中持续减少，直到这颗星球变得荒无人烟——成为第一联盟最后的碑文。
precursor.1101.desc.en:
[FromFrom.GetName] was the administrative center of the First League throughout most of its existence, and served as the seat of their Great Senate. The [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] was densely populated, with a planet-wide city covering most of the surface. Food had to be imported from other member worlds to support the untold billions living in this enormous metropolis.

When the League collapsed, these food shipments ceased virtually overnight. Those with the means departed for other worlds, but most of the population remained behind. Mass starvation and anarchy followed as the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] was carved up between warlords and criminal organizations.

The population continued to dwindle for a few centuries until the planet had been reduced to little more than a lifeless ghost world - a final epitaph of the First League.

precursor.1102.desc.a.zh: 我们终于发现了古代第一联盟的首都。但不幸的是，我们来迟了，最近已经有人来造访过了，有价值的东西已经被洗劫一空了。
precursor.1102.desc.a.en: We have finally discovered the capital of the ancient First League. Unfortunately, we are too late. Someone else has been here recently, and anything of value is long gone.

precursor.1102.desc.b.zh: 最近对[FromFrom.GetName]的调查显示，这颗星球以前是某个被称为“第一联盟”的外星势力的首都。除了我们，也有其他势力探索到了这里，他们把[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]上有价值的东西都拿走了。
precursor.1102.desc.b.en: Our recent survey of [FromFrom.GetName] has revealed that this world served as the administrative capital of some kind of ancient interstellar alliance known as the "First League." Other explorers have visited here recently, and unfortunately they picked the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] clean of any valuable artifacts before they left.

precursor.15.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的赤道附近的[Root.GetName]发现了已经崩塌的沃陶姆空间电梯的残骸。电梯的对重部分位于沃陶姆同步轨道外，仿佛有人故意在那个部位将整个电梯截断。根据遗迹来判断，巨大的线缆坠落在位于赤道附近的几个主要城市中心区。估计这次事故至少造成了数百万的伤亡。
precursor.15.desc.en: The partial remains of a collapsed Vultaum space elevator have been discovered by the [Root.GetName] in one of the equatorial regions on [From.GetName]. It seems the elevator was intentionally severed at its counterweight beyond geostationary orbit, collapsing the massive cable on top of several major urban centers along the equator. Judging by the ruins, the resulting death toll must have been in the millions.

precursor.1500.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！从我们目前对其语言的破译来看，这些外星人称他们自己为“伊拉斯协约国”。他们是一个在一百万年前掌控着星系的这片区域的星际政权。

这些外星人似乎是六肢的哺乳动物，有多处文献交叉印证了一种叫“贾沃疹”的流行病席卷了他们的帝国，带来了灾难性的后果甚至直接导致了他们的毁灭。
precursor.1500.desc.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! From what we have translated so far of their language, we have learned that these aliens called themselves the "Irassian Concordat." They were an interstellar power that held sway over this region of the galaxy a little over a million years ago.

They appear to have been six-limbed mammalians, and there are several references to some sort of plague called the "Javorian Pox" which swept across their empire with devastating results, possibly leading to their extinction.

precursor.1505.desc.zh: [From.GetName]曾经是一个大型的伊拉斯殖民地，这个殖民地有工业发展和环境改造的迹象。如同其他的伊拉斯殖民星球上一样，留下的化石讲述了一个悲伤的故事——由于贾沃疹的肆虐，人口急剧减少，这场灾难肆虐了[From.GetPlanetMoon]的所有定居点。在星球轨道上还存有大量碎片残骸，应该是一场战役留下的。
precursor.1505.desc.en: [From.GetName] was once a large Irassian colony, showing signs of both industrial development and terraforming. As on other Irassian worlds, the fossilized remains tell a harrowing tale - the population rapidly succumbed to the Javorian Pox, and there appears to have been widespread panic in all of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s major settlements. There is also an unusually large amount of debris in orbit, possibly the remnants of a battle.

precursor.1506.desc.zh: 我们分析了轨道中漂流的碎片，同时考古学家推断[From.From.GetName]上的伊拉斯殖民地在受毁灭前曾经受到过军事封锁。伊拉斯人的舰队当时试图隔离[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]以遏制贾沃疹。当时至少有一打民用飞船试图突破封锁，战况十分惨烈，但很明显一部分飞船成功脱逃了。
precursor.1506.desc.en: We have analyzed the orbital debris, and our archaeologists conclude that [From.From.GetName] was subjected to a military blockade before and during the Irassian colony's demise. The Irassian fleet had strict orders to quarantine the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] in a vain attempt to contain the Javorian Pox. At least a dozen civilian ships made an attempt to break the blockade, and despite the heavy fighting it appears some were successful.

precursor.1510.desc.zh:
可以明显看出[From.GetName]，这个古代伊拉斯的殖民地，受到了严重的轨道轰炸。在太空中可以清楚地看到一些大型弹坑，这些弹坑所在地便是在大约120万年前[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的主要人口居住中心。

从轰炸中幸存的那些可怜人，很快又死于横行于大部分伊拉斯殖民地的贾沃疹。
precursor.1510.desc.en:
It is immediately apparent that [From.GetName], an ancient Irassian colony, has been the victim of extensive orbital bombardment. Large craters are still visible from space where the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s major population centers used to be roughly 1.2 million years ago.

The handful of survivors from the initial bombardment appear to have succumbed shortly afterwards to the Javorian Pox that was then ravaging most Irassian worlds.

precursor.1511.desc.zh: 我们的考古团队从[From.From.GetName]的一处监听哨站废墟回收到了一段通讯记录。它记录了一支在轨的伊拉斯舰队指挥官与位于伊拉西亚的舰队总部之间的一段通讯内容。指挥官不满总部要求“净化”殖民星的所有生物以防止瘟疫散播。虽然争吵未果通讯记录就中断了，但很明显指挥官最终还是执行了该命令。
precursor.1511.desc.en: Our archaeological expedition has recovered a communications log from the ruins of a listening post on [From.From.GetName]. It shows the contents of a transmission between the commander of an Irassian fleet in orbit, and their naval headquarters on Irassia. The commander questions orders to "purge" the colony of all life to prevent the spreading of the pox. Although the log ends before the issue is resolved, the orders were evidently carried out.

precursor.1515.desc.zh:
这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]是丘格拉的母星，他们是伊拉斯协约国征服的一个物种。这种软体类物种正要突破星际旅行的瓶颈，而伊拉斯人发现了他们。经过漫长的冲突，丘格拉的多个城市被摧毁，最终丘格拉还是被征服了。

地表有证据表明其后几十年里，有大量伊拉斯军团驻扎在这里。这说明丘格拉对于伊拉斯人的统治表示不满。
precursor.1515.desc.en:
This [From.GetPlanetMoon] was the homeworld of the Joggra, a subjugated client species of the Irassian Concordat. A molluscoid species that was on the verge of achieving space flight when the Irassians discovered them, the Joggra were conquered after a lengthy military campaign that devastated many of their cities.

There is evidence on the surface that a sizeable Irassian military garrison was stationed there for decades afterwards, suggesting that the Joggra were not content to remain under the Irassian yoke.

precursor.1516.desc.zh:
在[From.From.GetName]上发现了一段丘格拉的亚空间信息碎片，此信息是发向伊拉斯协约国的各个附庸国的母星的：

“反抗残酷统治者的时候到了。我们的特工得知贾沃疹只影响瘦弱的伊拉斯人，但是所有的物种都能作为瘟疫的载体。我们必须尽全力渗透他们的世界，空间站，飞船，还有他们的*滋啦滋啦*！

终于，伊拉斯人遇到了他们那庞大舰队无法击败的敌人。*滋啦滋啦*万岁，这个千载难逢的机会不容错失！”
precursor.1516.desc.en:
Remnants of a Joggran subspace message have been found on [From.From.GetName], which appears to have been transmitted to the homeworlds of the Irassian Concordat's other client species:
