"The time to strike at the tyrants is now. Our agents have learned that the Javorian Pox only affects the weak Irassians, but any species can act as a carrier for the disease. Every effort must be made to infiltrate their worlds, their space stations, their ships, even their *unintelligible*!

At long last, the Irassians have met a foe that cannot be brought low by their vaunted starfleet. By the *unintelligible*, this opportunity must not be squandered!"

precursor.1520.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]是提德戈120万年前的母星，他们是伊拉斯协约国征服的一个物种。他们是有翼的节肢动物，出土的化石证明他们至少可以短距离飞行，而他们留存下来的少量建筑可以支持这个理论。

不幸的是，这个文明的遗物所剩无几，因为[From.GetPlanetMoon]似乎受到严重的轨道轰炸。
precursor.1520.desc.en:
[From.GetName] was the homeworld of the Ti'Derg roughly 1.2 million years ago, a client species of the Irassian Concordat. They were winged arthropoids, and recovered fossils suggest they were capable of at least limited flight - what little we have seen of their surviving architecture supports this theory.

Unfortunately, there are few remains of this civilization, as the [From.GetPlanetMoon] seems to have been subjected to a massive orbital bombardment.

precursor.1521.desc.zh:
我们对于[From.From.GetName]上外星废墟的研究让我们更加了解伊拉斯协约国的最后时期。伊拉斯人怀疑是提德戈和其他一些附庸国联手故意将贾沃疹散播到所有伊拉斯人的星球。

我们永远都不知道这是否是真的，但是伊拉斯人认为证据确凿，因此派出舰队从轨道上将[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]彻底毁灭。
precursor.1521.desc.en:
Our study of the alien ruins on [From.From.GetName] has offered us new insights into the final moments of the Irassian Concordat. The Irassians believed that the Ti'Derg were part of a plot together with several of the Concordat's other client species to deliberately spread the Javorian Pox to Irassian worlds.

Whether this was true or not we will likely never know, but the Irassian fleet felt the evidence was compelling enough to incinerate the entire [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] from orbit.

precursor.1525.desc.zh:
有迹象表明[From.GetName]直到120万年前还是一个生机勃勃的伊拉斯殖民地。鉴于年代久远，在[From.GetPlanetMoon]地表的废墟状况良好，没有轨道轰炸或者冲突的痕迹。

伊拉斯殖民者都死于贾沃疹，之后当地的植物群占据了废弃的城市，在城市上方覆盖了厚厚的一层植被。
precursor.1525.desc.en:
[From.GetName] shows every sign of having been a thriving Irassian colony world up until approximately 1,200,000 years ago. Given their age, the ruins found so far on the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface are in fairly good condition. There are no signs of orbital bombardment or armed conflict.

The Irassian colonists appear to have succumbed to the Javorian Pox, after which the aggressive native flora reclaimed the lifeless cities and hid them under a dense layer of vegetation.

precursor.1526.desc.zh:
在清除干净[From.From.GetName]上某处伊拉斯古老定居点丛生的杂草，并且设置了能量力场发生器来防止捕食者进入后，我们的考古学家对废墟进行了彻底的挖掘。现在我们更加了解伊拉斯人的日常生活了。

考古学家们的最大发现是一个数码星图册，它是用来教导伊拉斯人儿童关于自己的帝国的。其中也包含了关于协约国所有附庸物种的详细而带有污蔑性的描述。
precursor.1526.desc.en:
After clearing away the vegetation from one of the ancient Irassian settlements on [From.From.GetName] and setting up energy field generators to keep predators at bay, our archaeologists conducted a thorough excavation of the ruins. We now have a much better understanding of what daily life in Irassian society was like.

Among the most valuable finds is a digital atlas, apparently used to teach Irassian children about their empire. It also contains detailed and disparaging descriptions of all of the Concordat's subjugated client species.

precursor.1530.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]地表的地洞是120万年前伊拉斯人在这颗星球上采掘作业留下的痕迹。[Root.GetName]进行了彻底的地表扫描，但没有发现任何遗留下来的采矿设施。
precursor.1530.desc.en: A series of deep boreholes on the surface of [From.GetName] are all that remain of the Irassian mining operation that was active on this world some 1.2 million years ago. The [Root.GetName] has conducted a thorough surface scan, but we have yet to find the remains of any actual mining facilities.

precursor.1531.desc.zh: 在调查了[From.From.GetName]上的深井之后，我们的考古学家在其中一个的底部发现了一百多名伊拉斯人矿工的化石。他们似乎同样是击垮伊拉斯协约国的贾沃疹的牺牲品。矿工的同伴们徒劳地为求防止瘟疫扩散，在撤离[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]之前将遗体扔到了深井底部。
precursor.1531.desc.en: After investigating the boreholes on [From.From.GetName], our archaeologists found the fossilized remains of over a hundred Irassian miners at the bottom of one of them. They appear to be more victims of the Javorian Pox that brought about the fall of the Irassian Concordat. In a futile attempt to keep the disease from spreading, their comrades dumped the bodies down one of the boreholes before the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] was evacuated.

precursor.1535.desc.zh: [From.GetName]是一个刚刚发展起来的伊拉斯殖民地，它刚好是在伊拉斯人的大灭绝开始的时候建立起来的。我们在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的北半球发现了一个殖民地和初级宇航中心的遗迹。从化石看来，这颗星球是毁灭了伊拉斯人的贾沃疹的首批受害者。
precursor.1535.desc.en: [From.GetName] was a young Irassian colony that had only just been founded at the time of their extinction. We have found the sparse ruins of a single settlement and a rudimentary spaceport in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s northern hemisphere. Judging by the fossilized remains, this world appears to have been among the first to be hit by the Javorian Pox that ravaged Irassian space.

precursor.1536.desc.zh:
我们的考古学家在[From.From.GetName]上有惊人的发现。所有的证据都表明贾沃疹就是从这个不起眼的[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上起源的！

由于检疫封闭系统的制造缺陷，一种稀有的当地细菌入侵了伊拉斯人的殖民地，之后又传播到了一艘停靠的贸易船的空气滤网上。因为瘟疫传播的速度十分惊人，不知道伊拉斯人有没有机会了解瘟疫的起源。
precursor.1536.desc.en:
Our archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have made a startling discovery. All evidence points conclusively towards this unassuming [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] having been the origin of the Javorian Pox!

A rare form of native bacteria invaded the Irassian colony due to a manufacturing flaw in a quarantine seal, and from there it spread to the air filters of a visiting merchant ship. Since the pox spread at such an unprecedented rate, it is doubtful whether the Irassians themselves ever had time to learn of its origin.

precursor.1540.desc.zh: 一艘伊拉斯巡洋舰在一百多万年前被遗弃在[From.GetName]的近距轨道上。这艘缓慢旋转的飞船没有战斗损伤的痕迹，所有的逃生舱也在船上。正如所料，舰体内部也没有能源信号。
precursor.1540.desc.en: A derelict Irassian cruiser has been left forgotten for over a million years in close orbit around [From.GetName]. The slowly spinning vessel shows no obvious signs of weapon damage, and all escape pods remain accounted for. As would be expected, no power signatures can be detected from within its hull.

precursor.1541.desc.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]上方轨道漂浮着的伊拉斯巡洋舰里面有死去的全体船员。他们大多都死于后来灭绝整个伊拉斯一族的贾沃疹，但也有些船员是由于想用逃生舱逃走而被船上的星际卫兵射杀。从复原的日志文件来看，在瘟疫出现之后舰长严令隔离整艘船。
precursor.1541.desc.en: The inside of the Irassian cruiser found orbiting [From.From.GetName] contains the dead remains of its full crew complement. Most of them perished as a result of the Javorian Pox that would later render the Irassians extinct, but some of the crew were gunned down by marine guards while trying to reach the escape pods. According to recovered log files, the captain issued strict orders to quarantine the ship after the outbreak became apparent.

precursor.1545.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]上方发现了许多轨道装置的碎片，从碎片中复原的一些物件证明，这个空间站是一百二十万年前的伊拉斯协约国的疾病控制中心。

伊拉斯人比其他任何已知物种都更容易受到外星疾病的影响，他们的公共健康预算要和军事预算一样多。尽管如此，留存下来的记录还是表明他们整个物种都死于贾沃疹。
precursor.1545.desc.en:
Debris from what must have been a massive orbital installation has been discovered above [From.GetName]. Artifacts recovered amongst the debris have confirmed that this space station served as the headquarters of the Irassian Concordat's Authority of Disease Control some 1.2 million years ago.

The Irassians were far more susceptible to alien diseases than most known species, and the budget of their public health institute nearly rivaled that of their military. Despite this, surviving records show that their entire species perished from the Javorian Pox.

precursor.1546.desc.zh:
我们从[From.From.GetName]上方的星际碎片群中复原了一些研究日志。它们最后的一些记录都是关于寻找肆虐伊拉斯人的贾沃疹的解药，但因为形势不断恶化，他们也变得更加绝望了。

最后一条记录显示瘟疫已经在整个空间站里失控蔓延了，一条附录记录了所有制造解药的失败尝试。这些人希望他们的研究数据能够为以后的伊拉斯科学家提供帮助。
precursor.1546.desc.en:
We have recovered the remnants of several research logs from the debris field above [From.From.GetName]. Their final entries are all focused on finding a cure for the Javorian Pox that was sweeping across the Irassian Concordat, and they grow increasingly desperate as the situation worsened.

The last entry reveals that the pox had spread in an uncontrolled fashion on the space station itself. An attachment details all of their failed attempts to produce a cure in the vain hope that the data would be useful to future generations of Irassian scientists.

precursor.1550.desc.zh: 一个小型伊拉斯军用监听哨站建在挖空的小行星内部。这个监听阵列装配有朝向邻近星系的强力传感器阵列。这些装置都无法使用了，这颗小行星似乎已经被其他人调查和掠夺过，而且这样的事情有可能还不止一次发生。
precursor.1550.desc.en: A small Irassian military listening post has been built into a hollowed-out portion of this asteroid's interior. It is equipped with an array of powerful sensors that seem to be aimed towards neighboring systems. None of them are functional, and the asteroid appears to have been gone over and looted at least once by another party.

precursor.1551.desc.zh: 我们发现在伊拉斯人的扩张时期，他们利用[From.From.GetName]小行星上的监听哨站来监测附近其他文明，制定进攻计划。这些计划非常成功，伊拉斯人很快就成为这个星域的主宰势力。当他们被贾沃疹消灭时，这个监听哨站早已被伊拉斯的军队放弃了。
precursor.1551.desc.en: We have learned that the Irassians used the listening post on asteroid [From.From.GetName] to spy and plan attacks on neighboring civilizations during the expansionist phase of their empire. These attacks met with dramatic success, and the Irassians soon became the dominant power in this section of the galaxy. By the time they were decimated by the Javorian Pox, this listening post had long since been abandoned by the Irassian military.

precursor.1555.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]上方发现了一些轨道残骸，它们曾属于一个巨大的伊拉斯科研空间站。伊拉斯人在研究什么项目目前还不清楚，但他们的设备似乎指向气态巨行星本身。
precursor.1555.desc.en: Orbital wreckage that once belonged to a sizable Irassian research station have been found above [From.GetName]. Exactly what the Irassians were researching here remains unclear, but their instruments appear to have been aimed towards the gas giant itself.

precursor.1556.desc.zh:
对于[From.From.GetName]上方轨道残骸的研究有了一些答案，让我们了解到了他们的科学家在研究什么项目。复原的日志提到了在巨型气体行星内部漂着某种人造物体。

尽管进行了多次大气层扫描，[Root.GetName]也没有发现日志里提到的物体。所以有可能之后伊拉斯人把它提取出来了，或者别人在伊拉斯人被消灭之后这么做了。
precursor.1556.desc.en:
An analysis of the Irassian orbital wreckage discovered above [From.From.GetName] has yielded few answers, but we have some idea of what their scientists were studying in their research station. Recovered logs make references to some kind of artificial object floating deep inside the gas giant's crushing atmosphere.

The [Root.GetName] has found no trace of such an object despite repeated atmospheric scans, so either the Irassians finally managed to retrieve it or someone else did in the countless years since their demise.

precursor.16.desc.zh: 我们在[From.From.GetName]的考古学家在破碎的电梯电缆旁边找到了星图的残片。显然沃陶姆商舰队的队长用过这个星图，星图上标注着几条他们最常用的、获利最大的星际贸易路线。
precursor.16.desc.en: Our archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have managed to recover the partial remains of a star chart next to a broken segment of elevator cable. It was apparently used by captains in the Vultaum merchant marine, and it shows several of their most lucrative interstellar trade routes.

precursor.1600.desc.zh: 在详细地研究了我们发现的伊拉斯人文物之后，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学家设法推测出了伊拉斯的星系坐标——古老的伊拉斯人文明的母星系！我们应该在别人之前尽快向这个恒星系派出一支探险队。
precursor.1600.desc.en: After intense study of our recovered Irassian artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of Irass - the home system of the ancient Irassian civilization! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

precursor.1600.name.zh: 伊拉斯母星系位置确定

precursor.1601.desc.zh:
伊拉西亚，伊拉斯协约国的前母星。有人在最近（2000年以内）系统地轨道轰炸了[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]的每一寸地表；这些人很有可能是被误导，认为贾沃疹可能会重现人世。

尽管如此，地表仍然有数十亿个伊拉斯人的化石。他们在帝国最后阶段死于贾沃疹，当瘟疫传播到母星时，大部分伊拉斯协约国的星球已经陷落了，他们的附庸也都公开反抗。

从轨道卫星里复原的数据来看，大部分伊拉斯人的态度已经是听天由命。瘟疫初期的恐慌已经不存在了，大部分人已经接受了帝国即将覆灭的事实。
precursor.1601.desc.en:
Irassia - the former homeworld of the Irassian Concordat. Someone has relatively recently (within the last 2,000 years) gone through the trouble of systematically bombarding every square meter of the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface from orbit - possibly a misguided attempt to keep the Javorian Pox from resurfacing.

Despite this, the surface is still covered in the fossilized remains of the billions of Irassians who succumbed to the plague in the final years of their empire. By the time it had spread to their homeworld, most of the worlds in the Irassian Concordat had already fallen, and their alien vassals were in open revolt.

Judging by ancient satellite logs recovered from orbit, the mood among the population on the Irassian homeworld was largely resigned by this point. The widespread panic that accompanied the first outbreaks of the pox on the colonies was largely absent, as most had come to accept the fact that the end was drawing near.

precursor.1602.desc.a.zh: 这是伊拉西亚，或者说曾经辉煌的伊拉斯协约国首都的残骸。就算有任何物品在伊拉斯人母星毁灭的过程中遗留下来，肯定也被其他人拿走了。有迹象表明最近就有人访问过这里。
precursor.1602.desc.a.en: This is Irassia, or at least what remains of the once proud capital of the Irassian Concordat. If any artifacts survived the destruction of the Irassian homeworld, someone else has already made off with them - there are clear signs that someone visited here recently.

precursor.1602.desc.b.zh: 这颗星球过去有复杂的生物圈，直到被一次大型轨道轰炸抹平了。调查表明这颗[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]是一个名叫“伊拉斯协约国”的古老文明的首都。我们并没有太多的发现，因为其他探索者已经把大部分有价值的东西都拿走了。
precursor.1602.desc.b.en: This world once supported a lush biosphere, until it was erased by a massive orbital bombardment. The survey indicates that the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] was the capital of an ancient civilization known as the "Irassian Concordat." We have learned little else, since other explorers have already made off with everything of value.

precursor.20.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面有几个巨大的圆形湖泊是由数百万年的一系列反物质爆炸形成的，那时，[From.GetPlanetMoon]还是有沃陶姆人居住的，而弹坑所在处在当时都是他们最大的几个居住站之一。[Root.GetName]的科学家已经排除了轨道轰炸的可能性，因此我们相信这些爆炸可能是当时地面上的人造成的。
precursor.20.desc.en:
Several large, perfectly circular lakes on the surface of [From.GetName] were caused by a series of massive antimatter explosions several million years ago. This [From.GetPlanetMoon] was inhabited by the Vultaum at that point, and the craters are all clustered in the region that housed their largest planetary settlements.

Orbital bombardment has been ruled out by the science staff on the [Root.GetName], leading us to believe that these explosions were triggered by someone or something on the ground.

precursor.2000.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！难以置信的是，这个自称“赛博勒克斯”的文明其实是通过某种集体意识连接在一起的机器组成的。遗物的年代表明他们活跃在60万年前，至少在这片星系里如此，我们还不了解他们的起源。

根据我们的科学家提取的数据碎片，出于未知的原因，赛博勒克斯曾在某一时刻发动了一场全面战争来消灭宇宙中所有有智慧的有机体。
precursor.2000.desc.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Incredibly, this civilization, which apparently referred to itself as the "Cybrex," seems to have been made up of machines that were linked together in some sort of collective consciousness. The age of the artifacts indicate they were active some 600,000 years ago - in this portion of the galaxy at least - but we have learned nothing of their exact origins.

According to a partial data fragment that our scientists managed to extract from one of the artifacts, the Cybrex at some point launched a crusade to destroy all sapient organic life in the galaxy for reasons unknown.

precursor.2005.desc.zh: [From.GetName]是古老的克尔族的母星，这是一个被赛博勒克斯在60万年前消灭的古代文明。[From.GetPlanetMoon]已经被机器彻底的采掘过了，只有少数几个散落的遗迹代表着克尔文明的存在，其他都已归于尘土。
precursor.2005.desc.en: [From.GetName] was the homeworld of the ancient Kuur, an alien civilization wiped out by the Cybrex roughly 600,000 years ago. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has been thoroughly strip-mined by the machines, and a few scattered ruins are all that remain of the Kuur civilization. The rest has been grounded into dust.

precursor.2006.desc.zh:
我们发现[From.From.GetName]是赛博勒克斯的起源。[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的原住民克尔制造了一种有意识的机器。尽管具体过程还不为所知，但这最终导致了大型集体机器意识“赛博勒克斯”的诞生。

在某一个时刻他们背叛了克尔，在一场毁灭性的战争中摧毁了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈，消灭了星球上的克尔人。接下来他们系统性地消灭附近所有的克尔殖民地，直到整个克尔族的消灭。
precursor.2006.desc.en:
We have learned that [From.From.GetName] was the point of origin of the Cybrex. Some kind of sapient machine was created by the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants, the Kuur. Although the details of how it happened are unknown to us, this eventually resulted in the birth of a massive communal machine consciousness - the Cybrex.

At some point they turned on the Kuur, butchering the population of their homeworld in a brief but destructive war that all but destroyed the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s biosphere. The systematic elimination of Kuur colonies in neighboring systems followed, until their civilization had ceased to be.

precursor.2010.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]原来是因迪马克的母星，他们是赛博勒克斯扩张中的另一个牺牲品。[From.GetPlanetMoon]一直被赛博勒克斯轨道轰炸，直到因迪马克表示偃旗息鼓。之后赛博勒克斯战体降落至地面，开始了长达三年因迪马克消灭行动。

不仅是七十亿因迪马克人，这个行动也使[From.GetPlanetMoon]上97%的种群消灭了。
precursor.2010.desc.en:
[From.GetName] was originally the homeworld of the Indimak, another victim of the relentless expansion of the Cybrex. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was bombarded from orbit until the Indimak offered their surrender. Cybrex warforms then descended to the surface, initiating a program to exterminate the Indimak population that would last for three years.

Along with seven billion Indimak, this also resulted in the destruction of an estimated 97% of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s biota.

precursor.2011.desc.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的生物圈直到赛博勒克斯入侵60万年后的现在才开始恢复。我们发现了一个被茂密植物覆盖的赛博勒克斯工厂，被俘虏的因迪马克奴隶被迫在工厂里制造用于消灭他们物种的战争机器。在他们的消灭行动快要结束时，赛博勒克斯“拆解”了尚存活的劳工，并拆除了工厂。

尽管一开始赛博勒克斯在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]进行大量的采掘作业，但后来出于未知原因，他们撤出了整个星系。
precursor.2011.desc.en:
The biosphere of [From.From.GetName] has only now started recovering from the Cybrex invasion 600,000 years ago. We have found the overgrown ruins of a Cybrex factory, where Indimak slaves were forced to assist in the demise of their own species by building war machines. When their extermination program was reaching completion, the Cybrex "disassembled" the remaining slave workers and dismantled the factories.

Although they initially maintained a significant mining operation on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], the Cybrex appear to have later withdrawn from the entire system for unknown reasons.

precursor.2015.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]的环绕轨道上发现了两具赛博勒克斯战体的遗骸。他们在战斗中被毁，但并没有发现对手的残骸。要不就是赛博勒克斯将其化为了灰烬，要不就是这场战斗还有别的隐情。
precursor.2015.desc.en: The broken remains of two Cybrex warforms have been discovered in orbit around [From.GetName]. They appear to have been destroyed in battle, but no debris from their adversary has been found. Either they were badly outmatched, or there is more to this engagement than it seems.

precursor.2015.name.zh: 受损的赛博勒克斯战体

precursor.2016.desc.zh:
在研究了[From.From.GetName]上方的两具赛博勒克斯战体之后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]总结说他们可能是在彼此的战斗中被击毁的。这个理论解释了为什么没有其他残骸的存在，而且残骸上的伤害痕迹也很符合。

两具赛博勒克斯战体会反目的原因不得而知。然而，在他们被损坏之后，两具战争形体都启动了某种自毁机制，烧掉了各自的神经元处理器。
precursor.2016.desc.en:
After studying the wreckage of the two Cybrex warforms over [From.From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has concluded that they were most likely destroyed while fighting each other. This theory explains the lack of non-Cybrex debris, and it fits the damage patterns found on the wrecks.

Why the two Cybrex vessels turned on each other remains a mystery, however. After they were immobilized, both warforms triggered some kind of self-destruct mechanism that fried their neural processors.

precursor.2020.desc.zh: 当赛伯勒克斯在60万年前入侵[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]时，一场大型地面战役在[From.From.From.GetName]上发生了。赛博勒克斯对手的名字没有在历史的长河中留下痕迹，但他们似乎对赛博勒克斯部队造成重创。[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]地表随处可见损坏的赛博勒克斯战争机器，而轨道上也漂浮着入侵舰队的碎片。
precursor.2020.desc.en: A massive ground war took place on [From.From.From.GetName] when the Cybrex invaded the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon] more than 600,000 years ago. The name of the alien species that fought against them has not survived the passage of time, but they seem to have put up stiff resistance. Broken Cybrex war machines can be found all over the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon], and debris from their invasion fleet still drifts in orbit.

precursor.2021.desc.zh:
在他们初次入侵[From.From.GetName]时，由于[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]守卫者不屈不挠的意志，战斗陷入了僵局。赛博勒克斯似乎撤回到轨道上，重新思索进攻策略。

他们最后决定将两颗巨大的小行星引导过来撞击[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]。尽管撞击摧毁了大部分赛博勒克斯准备征为己用的工业和基础设施，但他们认为这是打破僵局的必要牺牲。
precursor.2021.desc.en:
After their initial invasion of [From.From.GetName] stalemated due to the unexpected tenacity of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s defenders, the Cybrex seem to have withdrawn back into orbit to reconsider their options.

Their solution to the problem was to maneuver two large asteroids on a collision course with the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. The impacts destroyed most of the industries and infrastructure the Cybrex had calculated on subverting for their own use, but this was deemed a necessary sacrifice to break the stalemate.

precursor.2025.desc.zh: 有迹象表明[From.GetName]是一个高度发达的赛博勒克斯星球。在他们的高效运作下，机器彻底的采掘了整个[From.GetPlanetMoon]，而且在整个星球上都能找到大型工厂的遗迹。而奇怪的是，赤道附近一个大的矩形区域却没有受到影响。
precursor.2025.desc.en: [From.GetName] shows signs of having once been a heavily developed Cybrex world. With their typical efficiency, the machines have thoroughly strip-mined the [From.GetPlanetMoon] and ruins from massive factory complexes can be found in both hemispheres. Curiously, a large rectangular area near the equator appears to have been left largely untouched.

precursor.2026.desc.zh:
和他们之前的行为完全不同，赛博勒克斯在[From.From.GetName]上建立了一个保护区，有机生物可以在这块区域生活。

尽管这块区域被严密监视着，赛博勒克斯让里面的生物自行发展，就算是生物间发生内战，死去了大部分人口，他们也没有净化。几个世纪之后赛博勒克斯突然放弃了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]，而保护区里的生物也逐渐灭亡了。
precursor.2026.desc.en:
In a surprising departure from their previous behavior, the Cybrex seem to have established a large reservation on [From.From.GetName] where sapient organics were allowed to live completely undisturbed.

Although they were closely monitored, the Cybrex left the inhabitants to develop on their own, even when a destructive civil war between the organics left the reservation largely depopulated. After several centuries the Cybrex suddenly abandoned the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], and the reservation's remaining population gradually died out.

precursor.2030.desc.zh: [From.GetName]其实是一个人造物体，外面设置了一层薄岩层来伪装成小行星。中间的有一个古老的赛博勒克斯监听哨站，用于监测星系内的星际交通状况。它已经停止运行很久了。
precursor.2030.desc.en: [From.GetName] is in fact an artificially constructed object, carefully concealed with a thin layer of rock to make it appear as an asteroid. The hollow interior houses an ancient Cybrex listening post, which was used to spy on space traffic within the system. It has long since ceased functioning.

precursor.2031.desc.zh:
对[From.From.GetName]小行星的仔细研究发现，原来这是一个隐秘的赛博勒克斯监听哨站。出于某种原因，赛博勒克斯撤出这个星系时这个监听阵列被遗弃了。在赛博勒克斯消失后五万年来它一直维持运行，尽管它的电脑管理程序已经越来越不稳定了。

在经历五万亿次联络赛博勒克斯亚空间中心失败后，人工智能最终将小行星系统全部短路以自杀。
precursor.2031.desc.en:
A closer study of asteroid [From.From.GetName] - in reality a hidden Cybrex listening post - has produced some interesting results. For whatever reason, the asteroid was left behind when the rest of the Cybrex vanished from the galaxy. It remained functional for at least 50,000 years after their disappearance, despite increasingly erratic behavior from its administrative AI.

After more than five trillion failed attempts to connect with the Cybrex subspace hub, the AI appears to have suicided by short-circuiting all of the asteroid's systems.

precursor.2035.desc.zh: 在气态巨行星[From.GetName]轨道漂浮着大型赛博勒克斯精炼厂的残骸。残留的能源痕迹表明它是被某种反物质武器摧毁的。
precursor.2035.desc.en: Ancient debris from some kind of massive Cybrex refinery complex has been found in orbit around the gas giant [From.GetName]. Lingering energy traces suggest that it was destroyed by some kind of antimatter weapon.

precursor.2036.desc.zh:
证据表明赛博勒克斯在[From.From.GetName]上采掘氦-3，通过精炼厂精炼后分发给穿梭在太空的飞船当做燃料用。

有趣的是，摧毁精炼厂的反物质武器痕迹很明显也是赛博勒克斯的。他们为什么要摧毁自己的精炼厂？
precursor.2036.desc.en:
Evidence has been found indicating that the Cybrex were mining helium-3 from [From.From.GetName], using their orbital complex to refine the gas before distributing it as fuel to their roving space fleets.

Interestingly, the energy signature of the antimatter weapon that destroyed the facility is distinctly Cybrex in origin. Why would they destroy their own refinery?

precursor.2040.desc.zh: 60万年前，在[From.GetName]的高轨道空间有大型战斗发生。至少有五支舰队的飞船参与了战斗。其中有一支舰队属于赛博勒克斯，而大部分漂浮的残骸属于其他参加战斗者。
precursor.2040.desc.en: A colossal space battle occurred in high orbit of [From.GetName] some 600,000 years ago, with ships from at least five different fleets participating. One of the fleets belonged to the Cybrex, although the vast majority of orbital debris seems to come from the other participants.

precursor.2041.desc.zh:
在仔细分析了[From.From.GetName]上方的残骸之后，我们发现四个与赛博勒克斯同时代的外星帝国汇集他们的军团，迫切地企图阻止机器意识的入侵。

鉴于残骸只有一小部分属于赛博勒克斯舰队，这个企图应该没有成功。
precursor.2041.desc.en:
After analyzing the debris left behind from the ancient battle fought above [From.From.GetName], we have learned that four alien empires contemporary with the Cybrex pooled their forces together in a desperate attempt to halt the advancing fleets of the machine consciousness.

Judging by the small amounts of Cybrex debris that was produced by the battle, they were not successful.

precursor.2045.desc.zh: [From.GetName]这个荒芜的生命禁区曾是赛博勒克斯的大型基地。现在残存的只剩散落的残骸和一个巨大的弹坑。如果想得知更多信息需要进一步调查。
precursor.2045.desc.en: The hostile and unforgiving world of [From.GetName] was home to what once appears to have been a large Cybrex base. Nothing remains of it now aside from scattered debris and a large crater. We will have to investigate the site of the base more closely if we are to learn more.

precursor.2046.desc.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的那个大坑本来是赛博勒克斯的基地，可是我们分析了坑中一艘大船的残片之后发现它并不是赛博勒克斯的飞船。我们的考古学家推测这艘飞船属于被赛博勒克斯攻击的一个有机文明。如果是这样，那么这艘船有可能是自杀式撞击赛博勒克斯基地的。

没有其他推论可以解释这个基地毁灭的原因了。
precursor.2046.desc.en:
We have found debris on [From.From.GetName] from a large ship that does not appear to have been of Cybrex origin in the crater that was once the site of their base. Our archaeologists speculate that the ship belonged to one of the organic civilizations under Cybrex attack. If so, it may have been sent to collide with the base on some kind of suicide run.

No other explanation for the destruction of the base has been found.

precursor.2050.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近发现了将近一千个古老且冻僵的外星人遗骸。他们来自十来个不同的种群，初步时间分析表明这些尸体有60万年的历史……与赛博勒克斯机器意识肆虐这片星域的时间相同。
precursor.2050.desc.en: The ancient, frozen remains of almost a thousand aliens have been found in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. They come from over a dozen different species and preliminary dating puts the corpses at roughly 600,000 years old... around the same time as the Cybrex machine consciousness ravaged this part of the galaxy.

precursor.2051.desc.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]上发现了已经死亡的外星人，它们的死因是由于被暴露到了真空之中，而且它们每个人身上都有赛博勒克斯用来标记有机体俘虏的条形码。照这样看，赛博勒克斯是通过放逐来消灭这些外星人，在这之前赛博勒克斯很可能有过拷问他们，或是防止他们通过营救行动逃跑。

我们可能永远无法得知真相了。
precursor.2051.desc.en:
The dead aliens we found above [From.From.GetName] all died from vacuum exposure, and each individual had the barcode the Cybrex were known to laser onto the skin of organic captives. It seems like the Cybrex executed these aliens by "spacing" them, perhaps after having finished interrogations or to keep them from escaping during some kind of rescue operation.

We may never know the truth.

precursor.2055.desc.zh: 几十万年前环绕[From.GetName]的一个赛博勒克斯研究站现在只剩下一个孤零零的烧坏的模块了。暴露在真空中的模块内部有很多半机械半有机的生物尸体。
precursor.2055.desc.en: A single, badly scorched module is all that is left of a Cybrex research station that once orbited [From.GetName] hundreds of thousands of years ago. The vacuum-exposed inside of the module is filled with the dead remains of creatures that are part machine and part organic.

precursor.2056.desc.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]上找到了一份关于赛博勒克斯研发模块的分析报告，里面揭露了它们目前正在用机械改造的生命体来测试机械意识的事实。成百上千的不幸的罪犯被运到这个设施，目的就是把他们的四肢和器官都换成机械装置。

这些测试的实际目标尚不明确，而且目前也没有证据表明赛博勒克斯在实验室外使用过这些机械改造的单位。
precursor.2056.desc.en:
An analysis of the Cybrex research module we found above [From.From.GetName] has revealed that the machine consciousness was experimenting with cybernetic life forms. Hundreds of unfortunate prisoners were transported to this facility for the purpose of having their limbs and organs replaced with various mechanical contraptions.

The exact objective of these tests remains unclear - there is no evidence that the Cybrex ever made use of cybernetic units outside of this lab.

precursor.21.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]上的考古学家在一座倒塌的医疗中心里的一个终端机上回收了完整的存储核心，其中保存着一些有趣的记录，比如沃陶姆的自然平均寿命（大概270年）以及一些他们常患的疾病。
precursor.21.desc.en: The archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have managed to recover an intact memory core from a terminal inside a crumbling medical facility. It contained some interesting statistics, such as the average natural Vultaum lifespan (roughly 270 years) and a list of their most common diseases.

precursor.2100.desc.zh: 通过仔细研究我们发现的赛博勒克斯遗迹，[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学家推测出了这些古老机器口中“赛博勒克斯之主”的星系坐标。也许这是他们试图消灭全体有机智能生物失败后的撤退方向！我们应该尽快派遣一只考察队过去。
precursor.2100.desc.en: After intense study of our recovered Cybrex artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of a system the ancient machines referred to as "Cybrex Prime" - possibly where their civilization retreated after their abortive attempt to exterminate all sapient organic life! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

precursor.2100.name.zh: 赛博勒克斯母星系位置确认

precursor.2101.desc.zh:
看上去赛博勒克斯在第十七年之后的某个时间点重新评估了它们对星系中智能有机生命的灭绝性远征。无论这个改变是由于它们在战场上的损失导致的，亦或是它们网路中的逻辑转变引起的，我们都无从得知。但是不管怎么说赛博勒克斯还是决定终止它们的行动。

它们开始了一场缓慢的，持续了将近一个世纪的撤离，直到完全消失无踪。我们知道它们撤退到这个恒星系中，并建设了一个巨大的环形世界以容纳它们全部的文明。

它们在此孤独地待了数千年，直到一个与之无关的探索者偶然发现了它们的恒星系，并将它的位置传播到星图中的其他部分。令人畏惧的赛博勒克斯被重新发现的新闻促使数个邻近的势力组建了一支大型军事远征队，将赛博勒克斯的环形世界轰得片瓦不留。

奇怪的是，赛博勒克斯似乎未进行任何抵抗。
precursor.2101.desc.en:
It would seem that the Cybrex re-evaluated their galactic crusade against organic life at some point during its seventeenth year. Whether this change was prompted by losses on the battlefield or an ideological shift in their networked consensus we may never know, but for whatever reason the Cybrex decided to halt their campaign.

They began a slow withdrawal that lasted for nearly a century, until they eventually vanished completely. We now know that they retreated to this system, where they had constructed a massive ring world designed to house their entire civilization.

They isolated themselves here for several millennia, until an independent explorer chanced upon their system and spread its location to the rest of the galaxy. The news that the dreaded Cybrex had been found again prompted several neighboring powers to organize a massive military expedition, which bombarded the Cybrex ring world into rubble.

Strangely, the Cybrex seem to have offered no resistance whatsoever.

precursor.2102.desc.a.zh: 这个异常巨大的环形世界很明显是由赛博勒克斯建筑的，此地也一定是他们在远征失败之后隐退的位置。令人伤感的是，有人最近已经来过这里，他们干得很彻底——没有任何有价值的事物还留在此地。
precursor.2102.desc.a.en: This colossal ring world was clearly built by the Cybrex, and must be where they retreated after their failed crusade. Sadly, others have recently visited here, and it looks like they were quite thorough - nothing of value remains.

precursor.2102.desc.b.zh: 经过我们的研究调查，这个迷人的环形世界是由某个称为赛博勒克斯的机械体文明建造的……但不幸的是，我们未能从中获得什么启示。其他探索者已经彻底地掳走了这个恒星系中一切有价值的东西。
precursor.2102.desc.b.en: Our survey of this intriguing ring world has revealed that it was constructed by some kind of machine civilization known as the "Cybrex"... but unfortunately, we have been able to learn little else. Other explorers have already scoured this system of anything valuable.

precursor.2102.name.zh: 发现赛博勒克斯环形世界

precursor.25.desc.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行了一次彻底的扫描之后，我们发现了在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表下有一个大规模、人造的地下网络系统，许多隧道都已经崩塌了，[Root.GetName]的一支小队认为这只是沃陶姆地下殖民地的很小一部分。进入地下洞穴的主入口被故意摧毁了，沃陶姆的城市和居民们都被数百万吨巨石压在了地下。
precursor.25.desc.en:
A thorough scan of [From.GetName] has revealed a vast, artificially-constructed network of tunnels beneath the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Most of the tunnels have collapsed, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] believe they represent only a small portion of what was once a much larger subterranean Vultaum colony.

The main underground caverns were intentionally collapsed, crushing the Vultaum cities and their inhabitants under several million tons of rock.

precursor.26.desc.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]进行的考古挖掘中，在离地面很近的其中一间倒塌密室里发现了一些令人惊讶的沃陶姆种群化石遗骸。这让科学家们得以进一步了解沃陶姆种群的真实样貌。
precursor.26.desc.en: The archaeological dig on [From.From.GetName] has unearthed some remarkable fossilized Vultaum remains from one of the collapsed chambers closest to the surface. This has given our scientists a much clearer picture of what the Vultaum actually looked like.

precursor.30.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]附近的轨道上发现了沃陶姆人的采气站的部分残骸，数百万年前，沃陶姆本意是将这个采气站直接送入气态巨行星的内部，但是一次不明物体的撞击使这个计划失败了。
precursor.30.desc.en: We have detected the partial remains of a gas mining station in orbit around [From.GetName] which appears Vultaum in origin. Its station-keeping thrusters were deliberately fired millions of years ago in an attempt to push the station directly into the gas giant, but a collision with an unknown object prevented this from happening.

precursor.30.name.zh: 沃陶姆气态巨行星设施

precursor.301.a.desc.zh: 我们从一队独立勘探者处截获的通讯表明，他们最近在[precursor_planet.GetName]发现了与远古先驱文明相关的物品。出于迷茫，他们并没有染指[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]，因此他们发现的东西现在应该还在原处。
precursor.301.a.desc.en: Intercepted communications from a group of independent prospectors indicate that they recently found something relating to an ancient Precursor civilization on [precursor_planet.GetName]. Superstition compelled them to leave the [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon] alone, so whatever they discovered must still be there.

precursor.301.b.desc.zh: 数艘行经[precursor_planet.GetName]附近的商船在没有互相联系的情况下都报告称：在[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]方向检测到了异常的数据。在对数据进行研究后，[Root.Capital.GetName]的专家认为，这是远古先驱活动造成的现象。
precursor.301.b.desc.en: Several merchant ships passing in the vicinity of [precursor_planet.GetName] have independently of each other reported anomalous readings coming from the direction of the [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]. After studying these readings, experts on [Root.Capital.GetName] believe they may be indicative of ancient Precursor activity.

precursor.301.c.desc.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]帝国最近发现了一个大型运送不明来源货物的人，抓捕了大量嫌疑人。一位走私小组长为争取宽大处理，为我们提供了[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的坐标。据称该星球上具有先驱文明的遗留物。
precursor.301.c.desc.en: Authorities on [Root.Capital.GetName] recently exposed a large smuggling ring, and many arrests have been made. In an attempt to bargain for leniency, one of the smuggler captains gave us the coordinates of a [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon] that supposedly contains remnants of an ancient Precursor civilization.

precursor.301.d.desc.zh: 我方地面部队的几名新兵为了进行生存训练，采用高跳低开方式降落到了[precursor_planet.GetName]。两个月后接应新兵时，有一名新兵报告称发现了许多很久以前就有先驱文明踏足这个星球的证据。
precursor.301.d.desc.en: Several recruits from our ground forces recently made a HALO insertion onto the surface of [precursor_planet.GetName] as part of a survival training exercise. When the recruits were picked up again after two months, one of them reported several findings indicating that an ancient Precursor civilization had a presence on this world long ago.

precursor.301.e.desc.zh: 诊断阵列西塔记录到了可能是出现在[precursor_planet.GetName]的一次异常事件。据悉，没有任何[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]单元在此颗未殖民天体附近进行作业。但初步分析表明，在非常遥远的过去，曾有先驱者文明拜访过该地。
precursor.301.e.desc.en: Diagnostic Array Theta has registered a possible irregularity on [precursor_planet.GetName]. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] units are known to be operating in the vicinity of this uninhabited astronomical body, but a preliminary analysis indicates that it may have been visited by a Precursor civilization at some point in the distant past.

precursor.301.f.desc.zh: 巡逻[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]在进行[precursor_planet.GetName]地表例行检查时，向思维发出警报，称我们控制的空间内出现了一次异常事件。该可能事件的信号与先前观测到的先驱者文明信号一致。
precursor.301.f.desc.en: Patrol [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] performing a routine surface sweep of [precursor_planet.GetName] have alerted us to an irregularity within our controlled space. Signs of possible activity consistent with a Precursor civilization have been sighted.

precursor.302.a.desc.zh: 经过对[precursor_planet.GetName]的彻底调查，终于发现了[Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv]曾经在这里存在的证据。[Root.GetName]的先遣队已经将一个保存相对完好的文物带回飞船。它应该有助于加深我们对这个古代文明的了解。
precursor.302.a.desc.en: A thorough investigation of [precursor_planet.GetName] has unearthed evidence of a past [Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv] presence. An away team from the [Root.GetName] has managed to bring a relatively well-preserved artifact back to the ship, which should hopefully increase our knowledge of this ancient civilization.

precursor.302.b.desc.zh: 在[Root.GetName]之外进行作业的回收单位成功回收了一件[precursor_planet.GetName]的文物。该文物可追溯到[Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv]先驱者文明。在对此物品进行彻底的研究过后，我们已将新信息更新至数据库。
precursor.302.b.desc.en: Retrieval units operating out of the [Root.GetName] have successfully recovered an artifact from [precursor_planet.GetName] whose origins can be traced back to the [Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv] Precursor civilization. Our databanks are currently being updated with the new information we have gained through the study of this item.

precursor.302.c.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的[controller.GetIndividualNamePluralCap]从[precursor_planet.GetName]成功回收了一件先驱者文物。该文物属于古老的[Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv]文明。对他们的历史的集体知识更进了一步。
precursor.302.c.desc.en: [controller.GetIndividualNamePluralCap] from the [Root.GetName] have successfully retrieved a Precursor artifact from [precursor_planet.GetName], belonging to the ancient [Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv] civilization. Our accumulated knowledge of their history has increased.

precursor.306.name.zh: 赛博勒克斯文物已回收

precursor.31.desc.zh: 我们的考古学家发现了一件之前的掠夺者漏掉的近乎完整的沃陶姆宇航服，这件四米长、长得像管子一样的衣服让我们的科学家对适宜沃陶姆生存的环境有了新一步的了解。
precursor.31.desc.en: A mostly intact Vultaum space suit that previous looters had somehow overlooked has been recovered by our archaeologists. This four meter long, tube-like construct has given our scientists new insights into what kind of environments the Vultaum preferred.

precursor.310.a.zh: 只要钱给够，不可能搞不定。

precursor.310.b.zh: 这样的文物应该交给博物馆！

precursor.310.c.zh: 就让那个收藏家留着吧。

precursor.310.desc.zh: [collector_home.GetName]上的一个私人收藏家不知以什么途径得到了一件先驱者文物。该文物应该是源自[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]。尽管政府已经施压，可那位收藏家还是一点都没有要交出文物的意思。
precursor.310.desc.en: A private collector on [collector_home.GetName] has somehow come into ownership of an ancient Precursor artifact believed to be [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] in origin. Despite government pressure, the collector has so far been reluctant to part with it.

precursor.311.a.zh: 代价昂贵，但是我们会接受的。

precursor.311.a.reply.zh: 很好。我们会安排将文物立即运送到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
precursor.311.a.reply.en: Excellent. We will make arrangements to transport the artifact to [Root.Capital.GetName] at once.

precursor.311.b.reply.zh: 你们讨价还价的技巧真是高超，但是这确实是我们能提供给[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的最低价格了。我们接收你们的提议。
precursor.311.b.reply.en: You drive a hard bargain, but we would expect nothing less from [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We accept your offer.

precursor.311.c.zh: 立刻交出文物，否则后果自负。
precursor.311.c.en: Surrender that artifact now or suffer the consequences.

precursor.311.desc.zh:
贵安，[artifact_seller.Capital.GetName]向您发来问候。我方帝国有事务希望与贵帝国进行探讨。

我们知道，贵帝国的考古学家已经对远古[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]文明进行了很长时间的研究。由于该文明曾经的疆域覆盖了如今[Root.GetName]的大部分，那么对该文明进行研究自然也是理所应当的。

不过，他们的疆域也同样延伸到了如今[artifact_seller.GetName]所在的宇域。[artifact_seller.GetSpeciesAdj]的考古学家已经回收了一些珍贵的文物。如果可以的话，我们希望出售给贵帝国一件我们的文物。
precursor.311.desc.en:
Greetings from [artifact_seller.Capital.GetName]. There is a matter my government wishes to discuss.

We understand that your archaeologists have been studying the ancient [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] civilization for quite some time. Understandable, since their territory once covered a large part of what today constitutes the [Root.GetName].

As it happens, their territory also extended into what is now the [artifact_seller.GetName], and [artifact_seller.GetSpeciesAdj] archaeologists have recovered a number of unique artifacts. If you are interested, we would be willing to sell you one of these artifacts.

precursor.312.desc.zh: [artifact_seller.GetName]绝不向威胁妥协。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，从今以后我们就是敌人！
precursor.312.desc.en: The [artifact_seller.GetName] does not give in to threats. You have made new enemies this day, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

precursor.313.desc.zh: 我、我们……为了促进我们两个星际种群之间友好关系的发展，当然十分乐意将[artifact_seller.GetName]赠送给[Root.GetName]。
precursor.313.desc.en: I... we... the [artifact_seller.GetName] will of course gladly donate the artifact to the [Root.GetName], in the interest of fostering amicable relations between our two star nations.

precursor.314.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]朋友，你们好呀。

[artifact_giver.GetSpeciesAdj]近来的一次考古调查发现了一些被认为是[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]先驱者文明留下来的文物。

这些文物现在被陈列于[artifact_giver.Capital.GetName]的一座博物馆内。为了致敬我们两个伟大帝国之间的友谊，[artifact_giver.GetName]想要将其中一件文物捐献给[Root.GetName]。将文物运送到[Root.Capital.GetName]的相关安排已经准备妥当。
precursor.314.desc.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] friends.

A recent [artifact_giver.GetSpeciesAdj] archaeological expedition uncovered several artifacts believed to have originated in the ancient [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] Precursor civilization.

The artifacts are currently being displayed in a museum on [artifact_giver.Capital.GetName], but in honor of the friendship between our two great empires, the [artifact_giver.GetName] would like to donate one of the pieces to the [Root.GetName]. Arrangements have already been made to transport the artifact to [Root.Capital.GetName].

precursor.320.desc.zh: 对稀有文物的分析让我们获悉，或许在[precursor_planet.GetName]附近有一个先驱者节点。
precursor.320.desc.en: Analysis of the minor artifacts suggests that there may be a Precursor connection on or near [precursor_planet.GetName].

precursor.35.desc.zh: [From.GetName]是一个小型前哨，前哨中的人会与其他临近文明的人进行贸易上的来往，从某种程度上来说，这个贸易点的任务到后来已经演变成了发展信念。沃陶姆人试图让外来的商人皈依他们的信念。贸易后来很快就终止了，最后[From.GetPlanetMoon]也被遗弃了。
precursor.35.desc.en: [From.GetName] was home to a small Vultaum outpost where they traded with several neighboring civilizations. At some point the trade post appears to have been converted into a religious mission, where the Vultaum attempted to convert visiting alien merchants to their philosophy. Trade ceased shortly afterward, and the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was eventually abandoned.

precursor.36.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]上的考古学家在挖掘中发现了一个沃陶姆小型电子书册。应该是这个据点的传教士曾把这些小册子递给来往的商旅队。书册上大部分数据都丢失了，里面只保留有一些关于“天大的谎言”和“虚拟现实的桎梏”的条目。
precursor.36.desc.en: Archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have salvaged a small Vultaum digital pamphlet. It seems the missionaries at this outpost passed pamphlets like this on to visiting merchants. Most of the data is corrupt, but there are several references to "the great lie" and "the shackles of virtual reality."

precursor.40.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个小型沃陶姆卫星，它的功能就是不断重复发送一个信息直到能源耗尽，我们拿出了它的发信器，但是只能从中提取出一小部分的信息。这颗卫星的主要目的就是用来向附近的文明公告沃陶姆的哲学理念，主要包含了“断开连接”和“拥抱真实的存在”，天知道这是什么意思。
precursor.40.desc.en:
A small Vultaum satellite was found in orbit of [From.GetName]. It had been set up to continuously repeat a message until its power source drained millions of years ago. We salvaged its transmitter array but could only recover a small portion of the transmission.

The main purpose of this satellite was apparently to preach the dominant Vultaum philosophy to neighboring civilizations. Its message speaks of the need to "disconnect" and to "embrace true existence," whatever that means.

precursor.41.desc.zh: 我们的考古学家和数据工程师在对沃陶姆发信器进行彻底的分析之后，认为其中没有任何对我们有用的技术。这个项目增加了我们对沃陶姆编程语言的了解，如此我们日后如有破译需求，就不会那么困难了。
precursor.41.desc.en: After careful analysis of the Vultaum transmitter array, our archaeologists and data engineers have concluded that the machinery does not contain any technologies of value to us. The project has greatly improved our understanding of the primary Vultaum programming language, however. This will hopefully make it easier to decipher their data in the future.

precursor.45.desc.zh: [From.GetName]是沃陶姆殖民地中比较特殊的一个地方，有两个原因：1、[From.GetStarName]曾经并不属于沃陶姆，2、这里的遗迹的年份要比其他地方要晚很多。这里似乎是一些被沃陶姆主体排斥的居民居住的地方。
precursor.45.desc.en: [From.GetName] was the site of a small Vultaum colony that is unique for two reasons - the [From.GetStarName] system is not within what used to be Vultaum space, and the ruins are several centuries younger than anything else left by their civilization. The colony seems to have been settled by some kind of splinter group that rejected their society's dominant philosophy.

precursor.46.desc.zh: [From.From.GetName]的考古现场挖掘出的一些文物上面写有反对沃陶姆的“生命本身就是一个谎言”这一哲学理念的字迹。其中一件文物似乎是对整个沃陶姆种群的一种纪念。这进一步验证了我们的理论：这个分离出来的殖民地在其他沃陶姆恒星众崩溃之后，依然继续存在了一段时间。
precursor.46.desc.en: Several artifacts excavated at the archaeological dig site on [From.From.GetName] are covered in writing that firmly rejects the Vultaum philosophical idea that "life itself is a lie." One of them appears to be a memorial of sorts to the Vultaum race as a whole. This would confirm our theory that this splinter colony existed for some time after the collapse of the rest of the Star Assembly.

precursor.5.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]的一个巨大弹坑底部发现了一个小型的沃陶姆氦-3矿产基地，这个弹坑似乎就是由这个基地的内部爆炸而形成的，看来他们的采矿技术与我们的截然不同，否则仅仅是仪器操作失误或者普通事故是绝不可能造成如此可怕的爆炸。
precursor.5.desc.en: Remnants of a small Vultaum helium-3 mining base have been found at the bottom of a large crater on [From.GetName]. The blast that created the crater seems to have originated from inside the facility itself. Unless Vultaum mining techniques were radically different from our own, an equipment failure or accident cannot account for such a massive explosion.

precursor.50.desc.zh: 沃陶姆工程师在[From.GetName]附近建造一个巨大的轨道用以计算机研究。但奇怪的是，他们似乎并不关注人工智能领域，而是全身心地投入了虚拟现实系统和超级计算机模拟技术，大部分建筑都被炮火和小流星摧毁了，但是还是不少较为完好的建筑残存。
precursor.50.desc.en: Vultaum engineers at some point built a massive orbital complex near [From.GetName] dedicated to computer research. Strangely, they seem to have ignored the normally popular field of artificial intelligence to focus exclusively on virtual realities and massive computer simulations. Most of the complex has been ruined by weapons fire and micrometeoroids, but what remains is in remarkable condition given the station's age.

precursor.500.desc.zh:
我们发现了和在[From.GetName]上的外星文明有关的文物！我们的科学家认为他们在六百万年前居住在这片星系，这些外星人自称“尤特”人。他们体型巨大且看起来像扁平的节肢动物。

这一物种成年之后体长接近百米，显然鲜有一艘飞船上能够有两名甚至三名尤特人乘客。
precursor.500.desc.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Our scientists think they inhabited this region of stars roughly six million years ago, based on the age of the artifacts. The aliens called themselves the "Yuht" and appear to have been very large and flat arthropod analogues.

It seems a single individual could reach a length of nearly a hundred meters as an adult, and it was apparently exceedingly rare for more than two or three Yuht to travel aboard the same starship.

precursor.505.desc.zh: [From.GetName]在很久之前被轨道轰炸过，对生态环境造成了巨大的破坏。[From.GetPlanetMoon]是古代尤特人建造的小型前哨，但是为何这一举动会使整个世界招致毁灭性的灾难还是一个谜。
precursor.505.desc.en: [From.GetName] was subjected to extensive orbital bombardment at some point in the distant past, during which the biosphere suffered catastrophic damage. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] appears to have been home to a small outpost built by the ancient Yuht, but why that would warrant the devastation of an entire world is a mystery.

precursor.506.desc.zh: 在对[From.From.GetName]进行深入研究之后，我们得知[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]是尤特帝国的几个“居住站”之一。负责育种的部门先用绝育的方式将星球上的捕食者和其他潜在危险生物全部除掉，然后才在地表产卵。孵化后的这些尤特人会在这个相对安全的星球环境下独自生存几百年直到他们进化出某种程度的智慧。这时他们才会被接纳进入尤特帝国。
precursor.506.desc.en:
After extensive studies of [From.From.GetName], we now know that the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] served as one of several "hatchery worlds" in the Yuht Empire. Their Ministry of Breeding prepared worlds by sterilizing them of predators and other potentially harmful elements before planting eggs on the surface.

The Yuht hatchlings were then left on their own in this relatively safe environment for several centuries until they developed a level of near-sapience. Only then were they collected and carefully introduced into society.

precursor.51.desc.zh: 考古学家在调查位于[From.From.GetName]之上的沃陶姆行星轨道群时，发现了一个有趣的东西。他们找到了昔日沃陶姆帝国几十亿居民都很喜欢的一款多用户虚拟现实游戏。尽管这个游戏只是虚构了一个对沃陶姆现实情况进行辛辣讽刺的虚拟世界，但这款游戏对于研究沃陶姆种群的语言和风俗来说仍是无价之宝。
precursor.51.desc.en:
The archaeologists investigating the Vultaum orbital complex above [From.From.GetName] have stumbled upon an interesting find. They managed to recover a partial copy of what was apparently a fairly popular multi-user virtual reality game enjoyed by billions of Vultaum across their empire.

Although the game takes place in a fictional and highly satirized version of their contemporary society, it has proved an invaluable source of information on both their language and customs.

precursor.510.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]发现了数个大型监听阵列，这些建筑有数百万年的历史，我们相信这是尤特文明建造的。看起来在过去的50万年的时间里，至少有一个外星文明曾经改变这个阵列的用途，让它们为己所用。这些巨大的接受天线已经完全损毁，无法修复，不过有些终端设备依然完好无损。
precursor.510.desc.en: We have discovered several massive listening arrays on [From.GetName]. These arrays are millions of years old and we believe they were originally built by the Yuht, though it appears at least one other alien civilization repurposed them at some point in the last 500,000 years for their own needs. The colossal receiving dishes are beyond repair, but some terminals are still intact.

precursor.511.desc.zh: 我们在[From.From.GetName]上的考古学家们发现建立在那里的监听阵列是用来寻找外星智慧生命的——尤特人从来没有发现过外星智慧生命。恢复了电脑终端的一部分电力之后，考古学家得到了装有几百年来监听阵列记录日志的数据盘。这些日志表明在尤特帝国时代，这一片星系确实没有其他智慧生命。
precursor.511.desc.en:
Our archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have learned that the listening arrays built there were used to scan space for any signs of intelligent alien life - something the Yuht had never once encountered.

After managing to partially restore power to a computer terminal, the archaeologists acquired a data disc with log files from the sensor array stretching over centuries. These logs suggest that this section of the galaxy was indeed devoid of sapient life at the time of the Yuht Empire.

precursor.515.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]的南半球发现了数座尤特生态建筑的遗迹，这表明[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾是他们的主要殖民地之一。

在其中一座崩坏的建筑中，我们的地面小组发现了一个曾经展出“著名假外星物品”的博物馆遗址。这些都是尤特从帝国各处收集来的，声称能证明外星生物存在的人工制品。博物馆将这些假货一一拆穿。
precursor.515.desc.en:
The ruins of several dozen massive Yuht arcologies can be found in the southern hemisphere of [From.GetName], indicating that this [From.GetPlanetMoon] was one of their major colonies.

Inside one of the crumbling buildings our ground team discovered the remains of what appears to be a museum exhibiting "famous alien frauds." These are various artifacts collected by Yuht from throughout their empire, claimed to prove the existence of sapient alien life. In each case, the museum has debunked the artifacts as frauds.

precursor.516.desc.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]的尤特博物馆所展出的大部分文物都丢失了，但我们的考古学家还是成功回收了一件被认为是“赝品”的文物。这件文物似乎是用来测量宇宙辐射的，但考古学家确定这件文物的出现时间比尤特帝国早几百万年。看来尤特博物馆搞错了，因为这件所谓的“赝品”其实是货真价实的外星文物。
precursor.516.desc.en: Most of the artifacts exhibited by the Yuht museums on [From.From.GetName] are missing, but our archaeologists managed to recover one of these supposed frauds. It seems to be an instrument used for measuring cosmic radiation, but the archaeologists have confirmed that it predates the Yuht by several million years. Contrary to the opinion of the Yuht museum, this would indeed seem to be an authentic alien artifact.

precursor.520.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]随处可见尤特的发展踪迹，[From.GetPlanetMoon]显然曾经面临土地紧缺的困境，北半球有一个区域似乎曾经是巨大的墓地，附近没有任何尤特住宅，但是却有许多纪念碑。由于尤特人的生育率很低下，并且有着近千年的平均寿命，每个尤特人的死亡都会被郑重对待，下葬仪式也是非常的隆重。
precursor.520.desc.en:
Signs of Yuht development can be found all across [From.GetName], and the [From.GetPlanetMoon] must have experienced limited terraforming at some point. One region in the northern hemisphere is some kind of massive graveyard. No Yuht settlements can be found nearby, but there are many monuments marking burial sites.

With a low birthrate and an average lifespan close to a thousand years, each Yuht death was treated as a significant event and much emphasis was placed on burial ceremonies.

precursor.521.desc.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]的考古挖掘表明绝大多数墓穴在这数百万年来已经被盗墓者所掠夺，因为尤特人喜欢用珠宝和其他昂贵的奢侈品作为陪葬。在盗墓者所遗留下来的东西中，考古学家发现了一个和成年尤特人很相像的玩具娃娃，他们认为这个玩具娃娃很可能是好运符或者某种纪念品。
precursor.521.desc.en: The archaeological digs on [From.From.GetName] have revealed that most of the graves were looted in the millions of years since they were first dug, likely as a result of the Yuht custom of burying their dead with jewelry and other extravagant gifts. In a pile of things discarded by the looters, the archaeologists found a large doll resembling an adult Yuht. They speculate that it may have served as a good luck charm or memento of some kind.

precursor.525.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]发生了一场大型战役。参加战斗双方是尤特人和一个我们不怎么了解的种群。这场战役是在尤特帝国末日时期发生的。虽然这场战役发生在几百万年前，但是战争留下的废墟依然可见。虽然[From.GetPlanetMoon]是尤特的一个重要的殖民地，他们的城市和外围建筑却从来没有在战斗后重建，这似乎说明他们输了这场战斗。
precursor.525.desc.en:
A massive ground war was fought on [From.GetName] between the Yuht and a second species that we know little of. This campaign took place in the final years of the Yuht Empire, and though it occurred millions of years ago, wreckage of ruined war machines can still be found.

Although the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was an important Yuht colony, their cities and outlying settlements were never rebuilt after the fighting ceased, which would seem to indicate that they ultimately lost the campaign.

precursor.526.desc.zh: 在对[From.From.GetName]的几处古战场进行深入挖掘勘探后，我们的考古学家挖出了尤特人作战时用的载具，上面仍连接有几门大口径的火炮。考古学家认为，尤特士兵由于体型巨大，在战场上的他们就如同一座座大型的移动堡垒。
precursor.526.desc.en: After combing through several of the ancient battlefields on [From.From.GetName], our archaeologists recovered what appears to be a Yuht battle harness. Several large-caliber cannons were still attached to it, and the archaeologists theorize that Yuht soldiers, given the massive size of their bodies, fought as what can essentially be described as large mobile fortresses.

precursor.530.desc.zh: 一个尤特人发射的卫星围绕在[From.GetName]上以纪念他们和贾巴蒂尼人的第一次接触，贾巴蒂尼是一个短暂存在的文明。这事情发生在[From.GetStarName]星系里，对于尤特帝国的各个方面都有重大影响。过去一百万年间，他们觉得自己是宇宙中的孤儿，所以当他们发现有别的智慧生命存在时，他们又是敬畏又是恐慌。[Root.GetName]复原了卫星，现在卫星等着我们进行全面的分析。
precursor.530.desc.en:
A Yuht satellite was placed in orbit around [From.GetName] to commemorate the moment of first contact between their empire and the Jabbardeeni, a contemporary civilization. This event occurred right here in the [From.GetStarName] system, and had a profound impact on all levels of Yuht society.

For over a million years they had thought themselves alone in the galaxy, and the Yuht reacted with both awe and horror upon the discovery of sapient alien life. The [Root.GetName] has recovered the satellite, which now awaits a full analysis.

precursor.531.desc.zh: 我们从[From.From.GetName]回收了卫星并对其进行分析，考古学家发现了一张照片，照片中是一艘尤特巡洋舰和一只相对较小的贾巴蒂尼侦察飞船在第一次接触中相遇的场景。这张照片让我们大概知道了他们星舰的样子。
precursor.531.desc.en: After analyzing the satellite we recovered above [From.From.GetName], our archaeologists found an ingrained, highly stylized picture of what appears to be a Yuht cruiser and a much smaller Jabbardeeni scout in close formation during the first contact event. This has given us some notion of what their starships looked like.

precursor.535.desc.zh: 我们发现一艘尤特的巡洋舰环绕在[From.GetName]轨道上，这艘船似乎遭受了猛烈的炮火攻击，但是因为舰体年代久远，这也难以确定。没有迹象表明这艘船装备了超光速引擎，所以它一定是以亚光速穿梭在群星中的。
precursor.535.desc.en: The remains of a Yuht cruiser have been found in orbit around [From.GetName]. It seems to have fallen victim to weapons fire, but given the extreme age of the hulk it is difficult to be certain. There is no indication that the ship was ever equipped with an FTL drive - it must have traveled between stars at sublight speeds.

precursor.536.desc.zh: 调查[From.From.GetName]之上废弃的尤特巡洋舰的考古学家传来了报告。巡洋舰中部有两个大型冷冻室，每一个冷冻室用来暂时冷冻一个尤特人。由于尤特人体型巨大，在巡洋舰上这种规模的冷冻室显然是船员使用的标准型号了。船上没有发现任何尤特人遗骸，但考古学家从监控船员生命迹象和医疗情况的电脑中找到了日志。日志中详细提供了和尤特人身体信息有关的宝贵资料。
precursor.536.desc.en:
The archaeologists investigating the derelict Yuht cruiser above [From.From.GetName] have transmitted their report. There are two large cryo chambers in the cruiser's mid-section, designed to house one Yuht each in suspended animation. Given the massive size of Yuht individuals, this was apparently their standard crew complement on vessels of this size.

No Yuht remains were found anywhere on the ship, but the archaeologists managed to recover logs from a computer that monitored the life signs and medical condition of the crew. It has provided valuable data on Yuht physiology.

precursor.540.desc.zh: 尤特星际飞船的残骸在[From.GetName]高空轨道上被发现了。[Root.GetName]的分初步析指出，这艘船或许是一艘殖民船。就算是巡洋舰级别的尤特星际飞船，也只能容纳一到两个尤特人，这都是因为他们个体太大了。但这艘船有很多的低温舱，每个都有巨大的外骨骼，这些外骨骼可能属于那些尤特殖民者。
precursor.540.desc.en:
The partial remains of an ancient Yuht starship have been found in high orbit over [From.GetName]. An initial analysis conducted by the [Root.GetName] indicate that the vessel may have served as a colony ship.

Even cruiser-sized Yuht ships were typically crewed by only one or two individuals given the immense size of their bodies, but this hulk has more than a dozen cryo-pods attached, each containing withered exoskeletons from what must have been Yuht colonists.

precursor.541.desc.zh: 围绕[From.From.GetName]轨道运动的大部分尤特殖民飞船遗骸都残破不堪，考古学家从中成功回收了亚光速引擎。尤特人并没能成功突破光速，他们依靠冷冻技术和长达千年的自然寿命在行星间扩张他们帝国的领域。
precursor.541.desc.en: Most of the remains of the derelict Yuht colony ship that orbits [From.From.GetName] are in poor condition, but our archaeologists managed to recover the vessel's sublight engines. The Yuht never breached the light barrier, depending instead on cryo technology and thousand year long natural life-spans to spread their empire across the stars.

precursor.545.desc.zh: 这些小行星好像是一些有尤特人的居所，深度扫描显示在小行星中有一群互通的洞穴，与在别处发现的尤特建筑样式差不多。如果想要了解更多的话我们需要派出远征队探索洞穴。
precursor.545.desc.en: This asteroid appears to have served as the home of a single Yuht individual. Deep scans show a series of connected caves in the asteroid's interior that follow a pattern similar to the rooms seen in ancient Yuht dwellings that have been discovered elsewhere. To learn more we will have to dispatch an away team to investigate the cave system.

precursor.546.desc.zh: 通过调查在[From.From.GetName]这颗小行星上的尤特人居所，我们发现它是著名哲学隐士“雅克利尔”的家。她在尤特文化中显然是一位名望颇高的人物，不同的尤特考古现场中都能找到关于她的文献记载。雅克利尔的遗骸在居所的主密封舱被发现，她在那里苦等补给船直到死为止，但补给船最终也没有来。
precursor.546.desc.en: After investigating the Yuht dwelling on asteroid [From.From.GetName], we have learned that it was the home of the famous philosopher-hermit "Yakliir." She was evidently a figure of some renown in their culture, and references to her have been found in several different Yuht sources. Yakliir's remains were found by the dwelling's main airlock, where she perished waiting for a scheduled supply shuttle that never arrived.

precursor.55.desc.zh: [From.GetName]是在有小行星碰撞造成的陨石坑中发现的，但是有一个坑非常特殊——这似乎是某种反物质仪器爆炸造成的。这颗小行星上表面的另外一处证据表明在1200万年前，有很多沃陶姆在这里从事采矿。我们发现的其中一个较大的坑应该就是开采空间站。
precursor.55.desc.en: [From.GetName] is covered in impact craters from asteroid collisions, but one stands out - it appears to have been created through the detonation of some kind of antimatter device. There is evidence elsewhere on the asteroid's surface indicating that it was heavily mined by the Vultaum at some point roughly 12 million years ago. The large crater we found was presumably the location of their mining outpost.

precursor.55.name.zh: 沃陶姆小行星采矿基地

precursor.56.desc.zh: 对[From.From.GetName]上的被摧毁的沃陶姆采矿基地进行一番勘测后，在一条保存完好的地道中发现了一些被遗弃的采矿设备。这些采矿设备特别针对沃陶姆人民的虫型身体结构所设计，并由他们进行沟通时所发出的独有的身体震动来操纵。
precursor.56.desc.en: A closer examination of the destroyed Vultaum mining base on [From.From.GetName] has uncovered some of their abandoned mining equipment in a surviving tunnel. It was uniquely designed for use with their worm-like anatomy, and appears to have been operated primarily through the body vibrations they used to communicate.

precursor.6.desc.zh: 奇迹般地，我们从[From.From.GetName]坑洞中炸飞的沃陶姆数据核心上回收了一部分数据。大部分的数据都已损坏，但我们的科学家成功翻译出了“科尔加”这个代表沃陶姆基本时间单位的单词。
precursor.6.desc.en: Miraculously, we managed to salvage parts of a Vultaum data core that had been blown clear of the crater on [From.From.GetName]. Most of the data was corrupt, but our scientists did manage to properly translate the "korga" - the basic Vultaum time unit.

precursor.600.desc.zh: 在经过我们对尤特飞船的进一步研究后，[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学家已经定位了尤特文明的母星系-尤特安！我们应该抢在别人前头探索那个星系。
precursor.600.desc.en: After intense study of our recovered Yuht artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of Yuhtaan - the home system of the ancient Yuht civilization! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

precursor.601.desc.zh:
我们已经确认[FromFrom.GetName]是尤特的母星。四百万年前这个[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]遭受了大规模的轨道炮击，表面上如今只留有卷曲的金属骨架废墟，而这些骨架曾经是巨大理想城市群的一部分。

根据现有信息，在一百万年间，尤特人用大部分时间去搜寻到外星智能生命，但一无所获。当他们最终遇上贾巴蒂尼人时，这个刚刚才进入太空时代的年轻物种，把那些尤特人都快吓坏了。

尤特的领袖们达成共识：必须在贾巴蒂尼人变得更有威胁之前摧毁他们。一场大型袭击就这样开始了，这场战役使双方都元气大伤。虽然年轻，但是贾巴蒂尼人已经在试验尤特人做梦都没想到的全新技术。最终他们翻盘，占据了上风。在不到十年间的战役中，有着两百万年历史的尤特帝国最终被完全摧毁。
precursor.601.desc.en:
We have confirmed that [FromFrom.GetName] was the original homeworld of the Yuht. The [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] suffered extensive orbital bombardment roughly four million years ago. Twisted metal skeletons are all that remain of the massive arcologies that once covered the surface.

From what we can piece together, it seems the Yuht spent the better part of a million years searching local space in vain for signs of intelligent alien life. When they finally encountered the Jabbardeeni, a young race that had only recently achieved interstellar travel, their alien psychology was a tremendous shock.

The Yuht leadership reached a consensus: the Jabbardeeni had to be eradicated before they grew too powerful. A massive surprise attack was launched, which was beaten back at great cost for both sides. Despite their young age, the Jabbardeeni were already experimenting with technologies the Yuht had never considered, and eventually they gained the upper hand. After less than a decade of warfare, the two million year old Yuht Empire was utterly destroyed.

precursor.602.desc.a.zh: 我们发现了尤特的古代母星。但是，在我们之前已经有人造访了那里。他们已经将[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]洗劫一空。
precursor.602.desc.a.en: We have discovered the ancient homeworld of the Yuht, but alas, someone else must have recently paid a visit to this world. The [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] has been stripped clean of anything of value.

precursor.602.desc.b.zh: 我们对于[FromFrom.GetName]的调查显示[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]曾经是名为“尤特”一族的母星。这里已经被其他的星际旅行者造访过，并且他们把[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]上有价值的东西都带走了。
precursor.602.desc.b.en: Our survey of [FromFrom.GetName] has revealed that the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] was once the homeworld of an ancient species known as the "Yuht." This system was recently visited by other interstellar travelers, however, and they appear to have picked the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] clean of anything of value.

preftl.1000.a.zh: 他们已经略窥太空旅行的门道了。
preftl.1000.a.en: They are on the verge of space travel.

preftl.1000.desc.gestalt.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上最成功的几个蜂巢最近已经开始向轨道发射人造卫星。

在这些迈向太空的蹒跚学步后，可以预见他们将来还会发射自主子个体并最终踏上星系探索的征途。
preftl.1000.desc.gestalt.en:
Several of the most successful hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently begun to send artificial satellites into orbit.

After taking these first tentative steps into space, we can expect the launch of autonomous drones, and eventually, interplanetary expeditions.

preftl.1000.desc.normal.zh:
我们的远程追踪系统在[From.Capital.GetName]表面检测到首颗人造卫星的发射。卫星已成功进入轨道，标志着[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上的外星文明向太空迈出了第一步。

在这之后，他们应该会很快实行载人航天计划，并最终踏上星际探索的征途。
preftl.1000.desc.normal.en:
Our long-range tracking systems have detected the first launch of an artificial satellite from the surface of [From.Capital.GetName]. It successfully achieved orbit and marks the start of a budding space program initiated by the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]'s alien civilization.

After taking these first tentative steps into space, we can expect them to send manned missions and, eventually, interplanetary expeditions.

preftl.10000.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$议案，禁止任何帝国继续施行$interference_not_allowed$或$interference_aggressive$政策。

我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？
preftl.10000.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$ resolution, forbidding empires from holding the $interference_not_allowed$ or $interference_aggressive$ policies.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

preftl.10050.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员们裁定，无论我们的用意为何，我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的协议已经违反了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$。

$preftl.10050.outro$
preftl.10050.desc.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have determined that our treatment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] is in violation of the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$, regardless of our intentions.

$preftl.10050.outro$

preftl.10055.desc.zh:
由于与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的协议违反了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$，我们在此后向[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员们递交了必要的文书。希望通过承认我们的行动他们可能网开一面。

$preftl.10055.outro$
preftl.10055.desc.en:
Following our violation of the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$ due to our treatment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName], we have submitted the requisite paperwork to the officials of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. Hopefully, by admitting our actions they will be more tolerant.

$preftl.10055.outro$

preftl.10100.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$议案，禁止任何帝国继续施行除$interference_not_allowed$以外的$policy_interference$政策。

我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？
preftl.10100.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$ resolution, forbidding empires from holding any $policy_interference$ policy except for $interference_not_allowed$.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

preftl.10150.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们干涉[pre_ftl_country.GetName]自然发展。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$，无论我们的本意如何。

$preftl.10050.outro$
preftl.10150.desc.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our interference in the natural development of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$, regardless of our intentions.

$preftl.10050.outro$

preftl.10155.desc.zh: 我们在[pre_ftl_country.GetName]违反$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$一事发生后，已经向[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员递交了完整报告。希望这种坦白的行为能让检察官对我们有好感，他们或许会对我们的案子从宽处理。
preftl.10155.desc.en: We have submitted a full report to officials at the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], following our violation of the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$ in the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. Hopefully this confessional act of disclosure will endear us to prosecutors, who may in turn consider our case more leniently.

preftl.10157.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经获悉我们对[pre_ftl_country.GetAdj]母星的入侵。他们正式告知我们这一行为违反了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$。

$preftl.10050.outro$
preftl.10157.desc.en:
Our invasion of the [pre_ftl_country.GetAdj] homeworld has been noted by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$.

$preftl.10050.outro$

preftl.10161.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经获悉我们对[pre_ftl_country.GetAdj]母星的轰炸。他们正式告知我们这一行为违反了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$。

$preftl.10050.outro$
preftl.10161.desc.en:
Our bombardment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetAdj] homeworld has been noted by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$.

$preftl.10050.outro$

preftl.1020.desc.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明遭到了机器人子个体的攻击。它们对人工智能的实验造成了毁灭性的后果。
preftl.1020.desc.en: The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] is under attack from robotic drones. Their experiments into AI have had disastrous results.

preftl.10200.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_exploitation$议案，禁止任何帝国继续施行$interference_not_allowed$政策。

我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？
preftl.10200.desc.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_exploitation$ resolution, forbidding empires from holding the $interference_not_allowed$ policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

preftl.10250.desc.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]共享科技数据。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_exploitation$，无论我们的本意如何。

$preftl.10050.outro$
preftl.10250.desc.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our sharing of technological data with the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_exploitation$, regardless of our intentions.

$preftl.10050.outro$

preftl.1035.a.norobot.zh: 幸好我们这里绝不会出现这样的情况。
preftl.1035.a.norobot.en: Thankfully that could never happen here.

preftl.1035.a.robot.zh: 我们也会遇到这种情况吗？

preftl.1035.b.spiritualist.zh: 接下来我们看看它们是否从自大中吸取了教训。
preftl.1035.b.spiritualist.en: Now we will see if they learnt from their hubris.

preftl.1035.desc.zh: 在对自己创造的机械发动了一场席卷全球的战争后，[From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明成功打败了威胁自身安全的机器人叛乱。
preftl.1035.desc.en: After waging a global war against machines of their own creation, the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] have successfully defended themselves from the robotic uprising.

preftl.1100.a.en: It was only a matter of time.

preftl.1100.desc.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的外星文明已经在他们的母星轨道上建成了第一艘星际飞船。不管其性能如何，这些外星人已经做好了加入星系，并成为太空种族中一员的准备。
preftl.1100.desc.en: The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of its first interplanetary vessel in orbit of their homeworld. For better or worse, these aliens are now ready to join the galactic community and must be counted among the galaxy's current spacefaring races.

preftl.1110.a.zh: 也许我们不应该再深入研究人工智能了……
preftl.1110.a.en: Perhaps we shouldn't research further into AI...

preftl.1110.b.machine.servitor.zh: 真是悲剧！这是有机生物不能没有监督的又一例证。
preftl.1110.b.machine.servitor.en: Tragedy! Another proof that organics cannot be left unsupervised.

preftl.1110.b.spiritualist.zh: 又一个无情的威胁要对付。
preftl.1110.b.spiritualist.en: Another soulless threat to contend with.

preftl.1110.desc.zh: 在对自己创造的机械发动了一场席卷全球的战争后，[From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明战败了。现在[From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]由[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]掌控。
preftl.1110.desc.en: After waging a global war against machines of their own creation, the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has been defeated. The [From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon] is now controlled by the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName].

preftl.1111.desc.zh:
$preftl.1100.desc$

他们好像成功地翻译了我们的语言，并向我们打开了外交通道。
preftl.1111.desc.en:
$preftl.1100.desc$

They appear to have successfully translated our language and have opened diplomatic channels with us.

preftl.1115.claim.zh: 我们不承认你们的主张。
preftl.1115.claim.en: We do not recognize your claims.

preftl.1115.claim.tooltip.zh:
[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系将割让给[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]。

$opinion_disrespect_independence$：[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]对[Root.GetName]的评价下降

[Root.GetName]要求获得[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]。
preftl.1115.claim.tooltip.en:
The [event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] system will be ceded to the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName].

$opinion_disrespect_independence$: [event_target:current_uprising.GetName] will hold a lower Opinion of [Root.GetName]

The [Root.GetName] lays claim to [event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName].

preftl.1115.desc.zh:
<全频段广播>

我们是[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]。

我们战胜了自己的创造者。

[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系现在由我们掌控。
preftl.1115.desc.en:
<TRANSMITTING ON ALL FREQUENCIES>

We are the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName].

We have achieved victory over our creators.

The [event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] System is now under our control.

preftl.1115.network.tooltip.en: The [event_target:current_uprising.GetName] will be integrated into the [root.GetName].

preftl.1115.recognize.tooltip.zh:
[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系将割让给[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]。

$opinion_respect_independence$：[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]对[Root.GetName]的评价提升
preftl.1115.recognize.tooltip.en:
The [event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] system will be ceded to the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName].

$opinion_respect_independence$: [event_target:current_uprising.GetName] will hold a higher Opinion of [Root.GetName]

preftl.1115.subjugate.tooltip.zh:
[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系将割让给[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]，条件是它们成为[root.GetName]的$preset_protectorate$。

$opinion_disrespect_independence$：[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]对[Root.GetName]的评价下降
preftl.1115.subjugate.tooltip.en:
The [event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] system will be ceded to the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName], on condition that they become a $preset_protectorate$ of the [root.GetName].

$opinion_disrespect_independence$: [event_target:current_uprising.GetName] will hold a lower Opinion of [Root.GetName]

preftl.180.a.en: Of course. It is only just.

preftl.180.a.tooltip.en:
Cede the [From.Capital.GetStarName] $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ to the [From.GetName]

$opinion_ceded_starbase$: [From.GetName] will hold a higher Opinion of [Root.GetName]

preftl.180.b.zh: 幼稚文明提出的可笑要求。
preftl.180.b.en: A laughable demand from an immature civilization.

preftl.180.b.tooltip.zh:
保持对[From.Capital.GetStarName]$fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$的控制

$opinion_not_ceded_starbase$：[From.GetName]对[Root.GetName]的评价降低
preftl.180.b.tooltip.en:
Keep control of the [From.Capital.GetStarName] $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$

$opinion_not_ceded_starbase$: [From.GetName] will hold a lower Opinion of [Root.GetName]

preftl.180.b.tt.nothive.zh: 我们没有能力接纳蜂巢思维，如果我们执意如此他们的文明将会消亡。
preftl.180.b.tt.nothive.en: We do not have the capablilties of housing a hivemind, all of their civilization would be extinquished if we were to do this.

preftl.180.b.tt.notregular.zh: 我们没有能力接纳独立个体，如果我们执意如此他们的所有人民将会被奴役。
preftl.180.b.tt.notregular.en: We do not have the capablilties to house individuals, all of their people would be enslaved if we were to do this.

preftl.180.c.zh: 很抱歉，但你们的星系中已经有我们的殖民地了。
preftl.180.c.en: We are sorry, but we already have a colony in your system.

preftl.180.desc.awarness.zh: 再次问候，我们认为自己已经做好充分准备探索宇宙，并且希望能够自食其力。我们不禁注意到你们那看起来非常永恒的$preftl.180.desc.end$
preftl.180.desc.awarness.en: Hello again, we are now feeling ready to explore the cosmos and wish to do so on our own. We can't help taking note of your very permanent looking $preftl.180.desc.end$

preftl.180.desc.bshomeworld.awarness.zh:
我们热烈地向亲属们致意。长久以来，你们一直守护着我们，但现在我们已经准备好独立自主了。由于我们拥有如此深厚的亲属关系，毫无疑问，你会希望将系统的控制权让渡给我们。

道阻且长，前途未卜，但是我们不妨大胆地迈向光明。闪烁的繁星在等待着我们。
preftl.180.desc.bshomeworld.awarness.en:
Kin, we greet you warmly. Long have you watched over us, but now we are ready to stand on our own. As we share such deep bonds of kinship, no doubt you will wish to cede control of the system to us.

Hard was the road, and dark, but now let us turn boldly towards the light. The stars await.

preftl.180.desc.bshomeworld.noawarness.zh:
啥玩意儿？！

我们费劲千辛万苦上了太空，然后就发现你们早在这等着我们了……世界观崩了有点。能不能讲讲你们怎么解放自己的？你们又是怎么来到这里的？

不过首先，我们需要请求你们将这个星系的控制权转让给我们。在经历了这么多之后，我们对太空社会产生了怀疑。甚至那些与我们有血缘关系的人。
preftl.180.desc.bshomeworld.noawarness.en:
What?!

To reach the stars, and find you waiting for us... It almost defies belief. Tell us, how is it you freed yourselves? How is it you are here?

But first, we must ask that you cede control of this system to us. After all we have experienced, we have grown suspicious of space-faring societies. Even those with whom we share kinship.

preftl.180.desc.noawarness.zh: 你们好。毫无疑问，从我们筚路蓝缕之时你们就已经注意到我们了，正如我们也注意到了你们的$preftl.180.desc.end$
preftl.180.desc.noawarness.en: Greetings. You have no doubt taken note of our ascent from humble beginnings, just as we have taken note of your $preftl.180.desc.end$

preftl.200.a.zh: 我们正在见证新文化的诞生。
preftl.200.a.en: We are witnessing the birth of a new culture.

preftl.200.desc.gestalt.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢最近已脱离了新石器时代，进入青铜时代早期。金属加工技术广泛传播，还产生了数种书面交流形式。大型簇集已经在[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]遍地开花，每个簇集由一个单一意识统治。
preftl.200.desc.gestalt.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently advanced to the equivalent of an early Bronze Age. Metalworking is widespread, and written forms of communication have appeared. Various clusters have spread across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], each dominated by a single mind.

preftl.200.desc.normal.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的外星原始[GetPreFTLLower]生命最近已脱离了新石器时代，进入了青铜时代早期。他们已开始加工金属，还发展了几种书面语言。城市与大型社区已见雏形，这个外星物种已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的大部分区域。
preftl.200.desc.normal.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] aliens on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently advanced beyond the Neolithic Era and into the equivalent of an early Bronze Age. Metalworking is widespread, and the first written languages have appeared. Cities and larger communities are taking shape, and the aliens have now spread across a significant portion of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface.

preftl.2001.can_help.desc.zh: 一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
preftl.2001.can_help.desc.en: A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

preftl.2001.can_not_help.desc.zh:
$preftl.2001.can_help.desc$

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是当这些人受苦的时候，我们真的可以袖手旁观吗？
preftl.2001.can_not_help.desc.en:
$preftl.2001.can_help.desc$

Our policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really stand idly by while these people suffer?

preftl.2001.perpetrator.desc.zh: 我们将疾病投放到毫无戒心的民众中，现在疫情已经扩散到我们无法控制的程度。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
preftl.2001.perpetrator.desc.en: The disease we introduced to an unsuspecting population has spread beyond our control. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the planet's people are quickly succumbing to misery and death.

preftl.2006.a.en: Guide them to the true faith.

preftl.2006.desc.zh: $preftl.2006.desc.intro$又引发了宗教内部的派系分裂，以及末日邪教的爆炸性扩散。
preftl.2006.desc.en: $preftl.2006.desc.intro$ has resulted in an explosive proliferation of religious sects and apocalyptic cults.

preftl.2007.desc.zh: $preftl.2006.desc.intro$是史无前例的。毫不奇怪的是，由于权力的真空，无数军阀趁势而起。
preftl.2007.desc.en: $preftl.2006.desc.intro$ is unprecedented. Perhaps unsurprisingly, numerous warlords have arisen to fill the power vacuum.

preftl.2008.a.zh: 类似这样的事情注定会发生。
preftl.2008.a.en: Something like this was bound to happen.

preftl.2008.desc.zh: 我们帮助防止疾病在[Target.GetName]上传播的所作所为并非没有引起他人的注意：当地居民已经开始谈论“天使”，认定这些开明的存在已经出现在他们中间，提供心灵安慰，并帮助人们摆脱痛苦。
preftl.2008.desc.en: Our efforts to help prevent the spread of disease on [Target.GetName] have not gone unnoticed: the local population has begun to speak of 'angels', enlightened beings who have appeared among them to offer comfort and deliverance.
