preftl.2009.desc.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上遏制瘟疫蔓延的所作所为引起了人们的注意：当地居民开始谈论“恶魔”，认定有一些不神圣的生物出现在他们中间，用亵渎的魔法对抗疾病。
preftl.2009.desc.en: Our work to contain the spread of the plague on [Target.GetName] is attracting attention: the local population has begun to speak of 'demons', unholy beings who have appeared among them to combat the disease using profane magic.

preftl.2010.a.zh: 够了。这样的苦难必须终止。

preftl.2010.desc.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上促进瘟疫传播的努力现在产生了一定的成果。通过对当地食物来源进行多处污染，传染病正在大肆蔓延。到目前为止，这颗星球上的每一个定居点都被感染了，而活着的人太虚弱，根本无法对死者进行处理。
preftl.2010.desc.en: Our efforts to promote the plague on [Target.GetName] are bearing fruit. Through discrete contamination of local food sources, the contagion is running rampant. By now, every settlement on the planet has been infected, and the living are too weak to dispose of the dead.

preftl.2011.desc.zh:
我们在[Target.GetName]上散布瘟疫的工作已经取得了成果。瘟疫横行，死人被随意丢在街上任凭腐烂。

然而，相当比例的人口拥有对该疾病的自然免疫力。对他们基因组的进一步研究可能对我们自己的免疫学研究有帮助。
preftl.2011.desc.en:
Our efforts to promote the plague on [Target.GetName] have borne fruit. The contagion is running rampant, and the dead are left to fester in the streets.

However, a significant percentage of the population possesses a natural immunity to the disease. Further study of their genome could be useful in our own immunology research.

preftl.2020.desc.zh: 人们继续口口相传着在[Target.GetName]上工作的奇迹“天使”。难民们已经来到我们的医疗保障供应处，吵着寻求援助。$preftl.2020.name.outro$
preftl.2020.desc.en: Word continues to spread of the miraculous 'angels' at work on [Target.GetName]. Refugees have descended on our healthcare providers, clamoring for aid. $preftl.2020.name.outro$

preftl.2021.desc.zh: 人们继续口口相传着在[Target.GetName]上工作的“恶魔”。狂热信徒已经来到我们的医疗保障供应处，吵着寻求[Root.GetBloodType]的供应。$preftl.2020.name.outro$
preftl.2021.desc.en: Word continues to spread of the 'demons' at work on [Target.GetName]. Fanatics have descended on our healthcare providers, clamoring for [Root.GetBloodType]. $preftl.2020.name.outro$

preftl.2025.a.zh: 通往圣识的道路是曲折的。
preftl.2025.a.en: The path of divine truth is winding.

preftl.2025.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]出现了许多所谓的救世主。这些先知承诺“神圣的救赎”，进而吸引了大批追随者。在疾病肆虐的基础上，相互竞争的教派之间产生的暴力冲突也越来越普遍。
preftl.2025.desc.en: On [Target.GetName], a number of so-called messiahs have appeared. With promises of 'divine deliverance', each of these prophets has amassed a substantial following. On top of the ravages of disease, violent clashes between competing sects are increasingly commonplace.

preftl.2026.desc.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头，我们在那里的工作得到了回报：幸存者们团结在一位真信的先知周围。为了表示感谢，神职部门愿意向我们派遣一名工作上的使者，据说他作为行政官的能力是非常强大的。
preftl.2026.desc.en: At last, the plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course, and our work there has been rewarded: the survivors have rallied around a prophet of the true faith. In gratitude, the priesthood is willing to provide us with a working emissary, whose skills as an official are said to be formidable.

preftl.2030.desc.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，人们筋疲力尽、遭受饥馑和疾病，因为苦难和无尽的战争濒临崩溃，曲曲折折地缓步迈向一个不确定的未来。
preftl.2030.desc.en: On [Target.GetName], the exhausted population, starving, sick, half-mad with grief and endless war, staggers towards an uncertain future.

preftl.2031.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫已经走到了尽头，我们支持的派系已经成功地将全体人民统一在同一面旗帜下。为了感谢我们所作的工作，执政的军政府提出向我们派遣一名指挥官，此人的战争艺术已被饱经淬炼。
preftl.2031.desc.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course, and the faction we backed has succeeded in uniting the population under a single banner. In gratitude for our efforts, the ruling junta has offered to provide us with a commander, one whose skills on the battlefield have proven formidable.

preftl.2035.desc.zh:
由于我们行动迅速的散布，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫已经使人口所剩无几。那些幸存的少数人亲眼目睹着他们文明的崩溃。现在只需要轻轻的一脚，就可以将他们推下悬崖。

我们已经准备好继承一个空旷的星球。
preftl.2035.desc.en:
Thanks to our fastidious promotion, the plague on [Target.GetName] has decimated the population. Those few who survive now face the collapse of their civilization. Pushing them over the brink should not require much effort.

We are poised to inherit an empty world.

preftl.2040.desc.zh:
我们从[Target.GetName]上获得的样本已经有了科学方面的回报；这种突变不仅能够提供对瘟疫的免疫力，还能抵御大多数已知形式的传染。

将这项研究转化为生产应用还需要时间，但初步的结果已经相当令人鼓舞。
preftl.2040.desc.en:
The sample we obtained from [Target.GetName] has already paid scientific dividends; the mutation that provides immunity against the plague appears capable of warding off most known forms of contagion.

It will take time to apply this research, but the initial results are more than encouraging.

preftl.2049.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]上瞬息万变的局势让我们无法继续监视正在进行的瘟疫。到目前为止，该行星上的所有研究项目都中断了。
preftl.2049.desc.en: The swiftly changing circumstances on [Target.GetName] have made it impossible for us to continue monitoring the ongoing plague. For the time being, all research research projects on the planet must be shelved.

preftl.2051.desc.zh: $preftl.2063.intro$我们的工作完成了：[Target.GetName]上的人口已经彻底消灭殆尽，这颗星球随时等待我们夺取。
preftl.2051.desc.en: $preftl.2063.intro$ Our work is done: the population of [Target.GetName] has been eliminated, and the planet is ours for the taking.

preftl.2062.desc.zh:
随着疫情继续肆虐[Target.GetName]，死者和正在死去的人的数目令人震惊。

这种疫病没有治愈手段。人们遭受的痛苦只能减缓，无法避免。
preftl.2062.desc.en:
As the plague continues to ravage [Target.GetName], the number of dead and dying is staggering.

There is no cure. Further suffering can only be alleviated, not prevented.

preftl.2063.desc.zh:
$preftl.2063.intro$

这颗行星上的人口已经被消灭殆尽。最终，疫情完成了自己的使命。
preftl.2063.desc.en:
$preftl.2063.intro$

The planet's population has been eliminated. At long last, the plague has run its course.

preftl.2065.desc.zh: 我们对[Target.GetName]瘟疫所作的对策已经再也藏不住了。民众现在将他们悲痛的目光转向了天上的星辰。我们已经让他们彻底敞开了思想，直面真相；接下来会发生什么，我们拭目以待。
preftl.2065.desc.en: Our response to the plague on [Target.GetName] can no longer be concealed. The population now turns their grief-stricken gaze to the stars. We have opened their minds to the truth; what happens next remains to be seen.

preftl.2070.desc.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头。先知的年代已经终结，一批主流的宗教开始蓬勃发展。随着人们对意义感有了新的任务，对星球的重建工作也开始有序开展。
preftl.2070.desc.en: At last, the plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course. The age of prophets has come to an end, and a number of major religions are flourishing. With a renewed sense of meaning, the people have begun to rebuild.

preftl.2075.desc.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头。军阀的年代已经终结，一批战士社会开始蓬勃发展。出于对能活下来的感激之情，人们开始希望领袖们能够施加强有力和有决断力的统治。
preftl.2075.desc.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course. The age of warlords has come to an end, and a number of warrior societies are flourishing. Grateful to be alive, the people look to their leaders for strong and determined rule.

preftl.2080.desc.zh: 通过孜孜不倦的努力，我们已经成功地遏制了瘟疫对[Target.GetName]能造成的最坏影响。然而，我们存在于这颗星球上的真实本质再也无法掩盖了。人们明白他们是被另一颗星球所拯救。他们充满了感激之情，将目光转向了星空。
preftl.2080.desc.en: Through diligent effort, we have succeeded in curbing the worst effects of the plague on [Target.GetName]. However, the true nature of our presence on the planet can no longer be concealed. The population understands they have been saved by another world. Filled with gratitude, they turn their gaze to the stars.

preftl.2085.desc.zh: 瘟疫对[Target.GetName]能够造成的最严重的影响已经得到控制。然而，幸存者非但没有感激之情，反而对前来污染他们文化的“恶魔般的外来者”充满了义愤填膺。我们的救助人员遭到了针对和污蔑，因此被迫放弃了这个行星。虽然还没有完全意识到真相，但当地居民现在把紧张的目光转向了头顶的星辰。
preftl.2085.desc.en: The worst effects of the plague on [Target.GetName] have been contained. However, far from gratitude, the survivors are filled with righteous anger at the 'demonic outsiders' who arrived to pollute their culture. Targeted and stigmatized, our aid workers have been forced to abandon the planet. While not yet fully aware of the truth, the local population now turns a nervous gaze to the stars.

preftl.2090.a.zh: 我们的领袖能够长盛不衰。

preftl.2090.b.zh: 我们的人民要放在首位。

preftl.2090.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成，现在必须做出选择：这项研究的成果应该仅应用于我们的统治阶层，还是全体民众？增加我们领袖的寿命当然是一个有吸引力的方案，但心怀感激的民众也有自己的好处。
preftl.2090.desc.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete, and a choice must now be made: should the benefits of this research be applied exclusively to our ruling class, or the population as a whole? Increasing the longevity of our leaders is certainly attractive, while a grateful populace carries blessings of its own.

preftl.2090.desc.hive.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成。这样的知识当然是有益的，但现在必须做出选择：这项研究的成果应该仅应用于我们的领袖阶层，还是集体中的每一个子个体？
preftl.2090.desc.hive.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete. This knowledge will certainly be of benefit, but a choice must be made: should we apply it exclusively to our leaders, or to every drone in the collective?

preftl.2090.desc.machine.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成。这样的知识可以给[Owner.GetName]带来好处。
preftl.2090.desc.machine.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete. This knowledge can now be applied to benefit the [Owner.GetName].

preftl.2101.can_not_help.desc.zh:
$preftl.2101.desc$

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是我们真的能够什么都不做，只在一边看着吗？
preftl.2101.can_not_help.desc.en:
$preftl.2101.desc$

Our policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really afford to stand by and watch?

preftl.2101.desc.zh:
[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的探险家在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上发现了一种以前未曾见识过的软体类物种。就其本身而言，这些生物中的每一个都只能勉强算得上是有智慧的。然而，当两个或更多的生物个体通过身体接触结合在一起时，它们会形成一个半意识的节点。理论上，这些节点应该能够在认知能力方面有指数级的增长。

简单地说，[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的人们偶然发现了一种生物思维机器。假以时日，这一发现可能预示着有机奇点的到来。
preftl.2101.desc.en:
[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] explorers on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have discovered a previously unknown species of molluscoid. On its own, each of these creatures barely qualifies as sapient. However, when two or more are joined through physical contact, they form a semi-conscious node. Theoretically, these nodes should be capable of an exponential growth in cognitive power.

Simply put, the people of [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have stumbled onto a biological thinking machine. Given time, this discovery could herald the advent of an Organic Singularity.

preftl.2110.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]的居民没有意识到迫在眉睫的危险，继续试验最近发现的节点意识，将其计算结果用于从建筑到教育的各个方面。

减缓他们的进展是很困难的一件事，但是通过在行星的水循环中引入一种经过基因强化的病毒，我们应该能够减少单个节点的认知能力。

当然，与任何未经测试的技术一样，这么做存在着未知的风险。
preftl.2110.desc.en:
Unaware of the looming danger, the inhabitants of [Target.GetName] continue to experiment with the recently discovered nodal consciousness, making use of its calculations in everything from architecture to education.

Slowing their progress will be difficult, but by introducing a genetically-augmented virus into the planet's water cycle, we should be able to reduce the cognitive power of the individual nodes.

Of course, as with any untested technology, there are unknown risks.

preftl.2115.desc.zh:
通过坚持不懈的试验，[Target.GetName]的人民已经开始使用最近发现的节点意识作为基本的思考机器。

现在，这些居民能够完成复杂的数学计算，正以前所未有的速度在科学和技术方面取得突破。
preftl.2115.desc.en:
Through persistent experimentation, the people of [Target.GetName] have begun to use the recently discovered nodal consciousness as a rudimentary thinking machine.

Now capable of completing complex mathematical calculations, the inhabitants are making breakthroughs in science and technology at a previously unheard of pace.

preftl.2120.desc.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上实现有机奇点的进展十分迅速。

节点意识已经重新组织了星球上的大部分农业生产，提高了作物产量，改善了生活条件。人们已经开始把他们的决策权委任给生物机器了。
preftl.2120.desc.en:
Progress towards an Organic Singularity on [Target.GetName] continues apace.

The nodal consciousness has reorganized much of the planet's agricultural production, increasing crop yields and raising standards of living. Already, the people are relinquishing their decision-making to the biological machine.

preftl.2125.desc.zh:
我们在[Target.GetName]上的特工已经将修改过的病毒引入了该行星的水系统。初步报告显示，结点意识的处理能力明显下降。

不幸的是，我们的所作所为引起了注意：一些居民开始低声议论“外部”在施加影响。
preftl.2125.desc.en:
Our agents on [Target.GetName] have introduced the modified virus to the planet's water system. Initial reports indicate a marked reduction in the processing power of the nodal consciousness.

Unfortunately, our efforts have not gone unnoticed: some of the inhabitants are beginning to whisper about 'outside' influences.

preftl.2130.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的节点意识的接口已达到饱和点。所有的官僚决策都被委托给这个有机的蜂巢意识，其成果是相当瞩目的。

这个行星的经济正在蓬勃发展，人们如今实现的生活水平，上一代人甚至想都无法想象得到。
preftl.2130.desc.en:
Interface with the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] is reaching a saturation point. All bureaucratic decisions have been delegated to the organic hive mind, and the results are nothing short of spectacular.

The planet's economy is booming, and the people have achieved a standard of life that would have been unthinkable even a generation ago.

preftl.2135.desc.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上，高等水平的意识出现了第一次悸动。然而，很明显，这个节点意识可能有自己的规划宏图。

为了努力“精简”流程，某些基本设施已经被削减。曾经由人工完成的工作越来越自动化，而当地政府发现自己无法（或不愿意）阻止变化的浪潮。

许多居民对他们的星球正在发生的事情越来越感到不安。
preftl.2135.desc.en:
The first stirrings of an advanced level of consciousness have appeared on [Target.GetName]. However, it has become obvious that the nodal consciousness may have its own designs.

In an effort to 'streamline' processes, certain basic amenities have been curtailed. Jobs that were once done by hand are increasingly automated, and local government has found itself unable (or unwilling) to stem the tide of change.

Many of the inhabitants are increasingly uneasy about what is taking place on their world.

preftl.2136.a.zh: 我们对星系的所有权不容忽视。
preftl.2136.a.en: Our claim to the system cannot be ignored.

preftl.2136.b.zh: 这是他们文明伟大的一天。
preftl.2136.b.en: A great day for their civilization.

preftl.2136.ftl.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的节点意识的增长已经稳定下来。现在很清楚，奇点不会在这颗星球上实现。

然而，快速的技术变革已经将[Target.GetName]提升到完全的超光速状态。政府特工旋即夺取了星系并拆除了我们的观察站。
preftl.2136.ftl.desc.en:
The growth of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has stabilized. It is clear now that the Singularity will not be achieved on this world.

However, rapid technological change has elevated [Target.GetName] to full FTL status. Government agents wasted no time in seizing the system and dismantling our Observation Post.

preftl.2136.preftl.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的节点意识的增长已经稳定下来。技术和社会生活的进步已经从以前的飞速发展中放缓。

现在很清楚，奇点不会在这颗星球上实现——相反，一个完全相互联系的社会已经发展起来，而且这是一个享有广泛的健康和其他物质利益的社会。
preftl.2136.preftl.desc.en:
The growth of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has stabilized, and advances in technology and social life have slowed from their formerly breakneck pace.

It is clear now that the Singularity will not be achieved on this world - instead, a fully interconnected society has developed, and one that enjoys widespread health and other material benefits.

preftl.2140.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]上出现了奇点。

经过多年的指数式增长，今天节点意识已经彻底获得了心智，并不失时机地巩固了其权威。随着行星上的人们沦为傀儡状态，大部分人已被迫屈从。他们现在只为蜂巢思维效力了。
preftl.2140.desc.en:
The Singularity has arisen on [Target.GetName].

After years of exponential growth, today the nodal consciousness achieved full sapience and wasted no time solidifying its authority. With the planet's population reduced to puppet status, many have been forced into subservience. They now exist to provide for the hive.

preftl.2145.desc.zh:
我们在[Target.GetName]上促进奇点形成的工作已经得到了回报。

到目前为止，整个行星几乎完全网络化了，大部分的日常决策都交给了节点意识。然而，为了“精简”流程，某些基本设施已经被取消了，行星上的人们越来越清楚地看到，他们的软体类机器可能有自己的规划宏图。
preftl.2145.desc.en:
Our work to promote the Singularity on [Target.GetName] is already paying dividends.

By now, the planet is almost entirely networked, with much of the day-to-day decision-making given over to the nodal consciousness. However, in an effort to 'streamline' processes, certain basic amenities have been eliminated, and it is growing increasingly clear to the planet's people that their molluscoid machine may have its own designs.

preftl.2150.desc.zh:
$preftl.2150.intro$可以肯定的是，奇点已经被阻止了。

虽然当地居民中仍然有许多人继续使用互联的软体动物进行计算，但其他人已经发现，这些生物是极好的蛋白质来源。
preftl.2150.desc.en:
$preftl.2150.intro$ It is safe to conclude that the Singularity has been prevented.

While many in the local population continue to use the linked molluscoids for calculation, others have found that the creatures make excellent source of protein.

preftl.2155.desc.zh:
$preftl.2150.intro$不幸的是，在供水中引入一种新的病毒的举措产生了意想不到的并发症，首先蔓延到当地的动物群，然后蔓延到这颗星球的所有有心智的人口。

虽然我们成功地防止了一个奇点级事件的出现，但毫无疑问，我们已经对一个新兴的社会造成了不可挽回的损失。
preftl.2155.desc.en:
$preftl.2150.intro$ Unfortunately, the introduction of a novel virus to the water supply has had unexpected complications, first spreading to the local fauna, and then to the planet's sapient population.

While a Singularity-level event has been successfully prevented, there is no doubt we have caused irreparable damage to a burgeoning society.

preftl.2160.desc.zh:
奇点已经在[Target.GetName]上濒临降生了。在其飞升后的几个小时内，蜂巢思维就已经吸收了行星上90%以上的人口，剩下的少数个体也已经在被追杀。

我们见证了一个奇点意识的诞生。
preftl.2160.desc.en:
The Singularity has dawned on [Target.GetName]. Within hours of its ascension, the hive mind had absorbed more than 90% of the planet's population, and the few individuals who remain are already being hunted down.

We stand witness to the birth of a singular consciousness.

preftl.2160.tt.zh: [Target.Owner.GetName]已经被转化为一个蜂巢思维。
preftl.2160.tt.en: [Target.Owner.GetName] has been converted into a Hive Mind.

preftl.2165.desc.zh:
我们一直在监测的局势突然有了结论。

宇宙中唯一不变的是变化。无论好坏，变数早晚会出现。
preftl.2165.desc.en:
The situation we have been monitoring has come to an abrupt conclusion.

The only constant in the universe is change. For good or ill, it is only a matter of time before some new development arises.

preftl.2167.can_not_help.desc.zh:
$preftl.2167.desc$

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是我们真的能够什么都不做，只在一边看着吗？
preftl.2167.can_not_help.desc.en:
$preftl.2167.desc$

Our policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really afford to stand by and watch?

preftl.2167.desc.zh: 在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。
preftl.2167.desc.en: Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.

preftl.2170.a.zh: 增加我们对叛军的援助。
preftl.2170.a.en: Increase our aid to the rebels.

preftl.2170.b.zh: 我们可以增加对护统军的援助。
preftl.2170.b.en: We can do more more to aid the pro-unification forces.

preftl.2170.desc.zh: 对于[Target.GetName]的叛军而言，前路渺茫。在[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]鼓舞人心的领导下，护统军已经夺取了星球上大多数人口中心的政权。统一由铁拳铸成。任何异见都被迅速镇压。
preftl.2170.desc.en: For the rebels on [Target.GetName], the future appears grim: under the inspired leadership of [Target.Owner.GetRulerName], pro-unification forces have seized power in most of the planet's population centers. Unity is imposed with an iron fist. Any dissent is swiftly crushed.

preftl.2175.a.zh: 叛军比以往任何时候都更急需我们的援助。
preftl.2175.a.en: The rebels need our help now more than ever.

preftl.2175.b.en: Increase support to the pro-unification forces.

preftl.2175.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]烽火连天，护统军和叛军继续互相厮杀。在这场斗争中，武器和战术无所不用其极，双方都犯下了累累罪行。
preftl.2175.desc.en: Battles rage on [Target.GetName], where pro-unification and rebel forces continue to tear one another to pieces. In this struggle, no weapon or tactic is off-limit, and atrocities have been committed on both sides.

preftl.2180.a.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]上内战频仍，护统军即将取胜。

然而在前线的大后方，当地的官员们却在绞尽脑汁地中饱私囊。目前虽然压制住了异见，但当地民众并非没有注意到腐败问题。
preftl.2180.a.desc.en:
As the civil conflict continues to rage on [Target.GetName], pro-unification forces are on the brink of victory.

However, far from the front lines, local governors are seizing every opportunity to enrich themselves. For now, criticism remains muted, but the corruption has not gone unnoticed by the local population.

preftl.2180.b.zh: 派遣特工，使政权合法化。
preftl.2180.b.en: Have our agents legitimize the regime.

preftl.2180.b.desc.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，护统军和叛军之间的战争已收敛成小打小闹。随着前线的巩固，双方的地方军阀都在通过贪腐来中饱私囊。这对冲突进程的影响，还有待观察。
preftl.2180.b.desc.en: On [Target.GetName], the war between pro-unification and rebel forces has slowed to a murderous grind. With front lines entrenched, local warlords on both sides are enriching themselves by means of graft and corruption. How this will affect the course of the conflict remains to be seen.

preftl.2185.a.desc.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上，腐败和地方领袖的无能引发了动荡，这促使民众转而支持叛军的事业。

在星球的主要中心城市里，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]已命令军队逐街开展一系列残酷的镇压行动以铲除异己。
preftl.2185.a.desc.en:
The instability caused by corrupt and ineffectual local leaders on [Target.GetName] has galvanized public support around the rebels' cause.

In the planet's major urban centers, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has ordered their troops to carry out a series of brutal, street-by-street incursions to weed out the resistance.

preftl.2185.b.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]上腐败猖獗，领袖无能，打消了民众对战争的支持。双方的将领都被迫开展治安战以压制民众的不满。
preftl.2185.b.desc.en: The increasingly corrupt and ineffectual local leaders on [Target.GetName] have diminished popular support for the war. On both sides, military generals have been forced into anti-insurgency campaigns to quell civilian unrest.

preftl.2190.a.desc.zh:
纵览[Target.GetName]，叛军节节败退，而[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]稳坐江山。

然而，即便新的世界秩序仍在酝酿，但裂痕已然出现。高官与元勋相互倾轧；贪婪的朝臣游走于权力场。

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]即将在全新的战场上接受考验。
preftl.2190.a.desc.en:
Across [Target.GetName] rebel forces are in retreat, and [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] reigns supreme.

However, even as a new world order is taking shape, fractures have begun to appear; high-ranking officials pit themselves against victorious generals, and profit-hungry courtiers stalk the halls of power.

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName] is about to be tested on a whole new battlefield.

preftl.2190.b.desc.zh: 没有任何一方能掌控[Target.GetName]，这导致整颗星球深陷混乱。地方军阀争权夺利，社会运动此起彼伏。只要星球上旷古未有的动荡不止，和平就只会是黄粱一梦。
preftl.2190.b.desc.en: Given the failure of any one group to seize control of [Target.GetName], the planet has descended into chaos. Local warlords vie for power, and increasingly radical social movements spring up overnight. As the planet continues through the greatest upheaval in its history, peace remains a distant dream.

preftl.2195.a.desc.zh: 厌恶于星球上高官的堕落和腐败，[Target.GetName]的人民已揭竿而起，与叛军同仇敌忾。革命之火在每一座小镇和村庄蔓延。
preftl.2195.a.desc.en: Decrying the decadence and corruption of the planet's highest officials, the people on [Target.GetName] have risen up in solidarity with rebel forces. In every town and village, the fires of revolution burn.

preftl.2195.b.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]上动荡不安。

涣散的军队在乡间游荡，饥渴难耐。在首都，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]继续称王，但如日西山，圣旨难出宫门。

除非发生重大转机，否则护统军败局已定。
preftl.2195.b.desc.en:
On [Target.GetName] chaos reigns.

Disorganized bands roam the countryside, desperate for food. In the capital, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] clings to power, but with a diminished authority that barely extends beyond the palace gates.

Unless something radical changes, the pro-unification forces appear headed for defeat.

preftl.2200.desc.zh:
[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]运筹帷幄，粉碎了星球上的反抗势力。在叛军阵营潜伏的特工发起了一场遍及全球的联合突袭。不等叛军将领回过神来，阵地悉数失守。

[Target.GetName]现在是个大一统的星球。
preftl.2200.desc.en:
In a stunning display of strategy, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has crushed the planet's resistance. Sleeper agents in the rebel ranks precipitated a coordinated and planet-wide attack. Before the rebel generals knew what was happening, their positions were overwhelmed.

[Target.GetName] is now a unified world.

preftl.2205.a.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们可能会怀念[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]。
preftl.2205.a.en: In time they may come to miss [Target.Owner.GetRulerName].

preftl.2205.a.desc.zh:
事态急转直下，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]被废黜。

叛军与政权内几个投机的将军结盟，成功地发动了一次遍及全球的联合袭击。不等护统军指挥官回过神来，阵地悉数失守。

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]戴着镣铐在首都游街示众，旋即被处决。获胜的叛军赋予星球各地自治权。经过多年的战争，脆弱的和平终于降临。
preftl.2205.a.desc.en:
In a stunning turn of events, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has been deposed.

Aligning themselves with several opportunistic generals within the regime, rebel forces succeeded in launching a coordinated, planet-wide attack. Before the pro-unification commanders knew what was happening, their positions were overwhelmed.

Paraded in chains through the streets of the capital, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] was quickly executed. The victorious rebels have granted the planet's regions the authority to dictate their own affairs. After years of war, a tenuous peace has descended.

preftl.2205.b.desc.zh:
[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]被废黜。

这个前军阀戴着镣铐在首都游街示众，旋即被处决。获胜的叛军赋予星球各地自治权。经过多年的战争，脆弱的和平终于降临。
preftl.2205.b.desc.en:
[Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has been deposed.

Paraded in chains through the streets of the capital, the former warlord was quickly executed. The victorious rebels have granted the planet's regions the authority to dictate their own affairs. After years of war, a tenuous peace has descended.

preftl.300.desc.gestalt.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢在冶金技术的进步显著，我们已经可以将他们列入铁器文明了。他们使用的工具与武器越发先进，建造的栖息地簇集也越发复杂。

数个互相独立的蜂巢思维现已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的绝大部分区域，其中最大的簇集中已有近百万子个体。
preftl.300.desc.gestalt.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives of [From.Capital.GetName] have advanced sufficiently in their use of metallurgy to be considered an Iron Age civilization. The tools and weapons they make use of are becoming more effective, and the complexity of their habitation clusters has become more elaborate.

Several distinct minds have now spread to cover most of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], and some of their largest clusters are home to nearly a million drones.

preftl.300.desc.normal.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星人在冶金技术方面的进步显著，我们已经可以将他们列入铁器时代文明了。他们使用的工具与武器越发先进，城市的建筑构造也越发复杂。

他们的文明现已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的绝大部分区域，其中最大的城市中已有近百万子个体。
preftl.300.desc.normal.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] aliens of [From.Capital.GetName] have advanced sufficiently in their use of metallurgy to be considered an Iron Age civilization. The tools and weapons they make use of are becoming more effective, and the architecture of their cities has become more elaborate.

Their civilization has now spread to cover most of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], and some of their largest cities are home to nearly a million individuals.

preftl.400.desc.gestalt.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经大幅增强了书面交流。与蜂巢思维相协调的机器现在可以进行大规模标准化的记录，历史的积累已不再受限于蜂巢的记忆力了。
preftl.400.desc.gestalt.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives of [From.Capital.GetName] have greatly enhanced their written communication. Machines attuned to the hive mind are now able to produce standardized records in great quantities, and historical records are no longer limited by the hive's memory.

preftl.400.desc.normal.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明已经制造出了数台印刷机。这些机器让他们得以大量生产文字材料，大规模交流初具雏形。他们中有几名领袖试图将这项发明消灭在摇篮里，但最终只是白费心机。

许多新思想正在[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上快速传播，产生了极为深远的社会影响。
preftl.400.desc.normal.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization of [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of several printing presses. These machines have enabled them to produce written material in great quantities, resulting in a rudimentary form of mass communication. A few leading figures within their society have done their best to stifle this innovation, but their efforts have thus far been for naught.

New ideas are rapidly spreading across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] with profound societal effects.

preftl.500.a.zh: 不知他们还会如何使用这项技术呢。
preftl.500.a.en: We shall see how they use it.

preftl.500.desc.gestalt.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经发现了使用简单的化学反应来产生爆炸力的方法。蜂巢间的竞争冲突发生了变革，大型火炮让许多物理防御手段退出了历史舞台。

火药的应用也促进了他们的工程项目，过去难以处理的障碍现在可以轻易地被移除。这些蜂巢至今仍在继续研究这项技术的创造性应用。
preftl.500.desc.gestalt.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have discovered how to make use of simple, chemical reactions to produce explosive force. Conflict between competing hives has been revolutionized, with large cannons rendering many physical defenses obsolete.

The use of explosives has also benefited engineering projects, as troublesome obstacles can now be more easily removed. Even now, the hives are experimenting with creative new applications of this technology.

preftl.500.desc.normal.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明已经发现了使用简单的化学反应来产生爆炸力的方法。该发现促使战场发生变革，大型火炮让他们的城池堡垒退出了历史舞台。

火药的应用也促进了他们的工程项目，过去难以处理的障碍现在可以轻易地被移除。他们的化学家们至今仍在继续研究这项技术的创造性应用。
preftl.500.desc.normal.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has discovered how to make use of simple, chemical reactions to produce explosive force. This has revolutionized warfare, with large cannons rendering many of their citadels obsolete.

The use of explosives has also benefited their engineering projects, as troublesome obstacles can now be more easily removed. Even now, their chemists are experimenting with creative applications of this technology.

preftl.600.desc.gestalt.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经驾驭了蒸汽的力量。他们基于这种蒸汽压产生的力设计出了发动机。这一发明使他们的建筑业和交通业发生了巨大变革。

载具在簇集之间运输着子个体，第一座无需子个体生产的工厂也应运而生。这颗星球已经踏出了工业化的第一步。
preftl.600.desc.gestalt.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have harnessed the power of vaporized liquid. Using the force produced by steam pressure, the technology has been applied to engine design. This has revolutionized both construction and transportation.

Vehicles can be seen transporting drones from cluster to cluster, and the first 'drone-free' factories are appearing. This world would appear to be on the brink of industrializing.

preftl.600.desc.normal.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明已经驾驭了蒸汽的力量。他们基于这种蒸汽压产生的力设计出了发动机。这一发明在方方面面改变了他们的社会——城市中出现了载具和机械，同时第一批工厂也发展起来。这颗星球已经踏出了工业化的第一步。
preftl.600.desc.normal.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has harnessed the power of vaporized liquid. Using the force produced by steam pressure, they have applied the technology to engine design. This has revolutionized their society in more ways than one - vehicles and machinery making can already be seen in their cities, and the first few factories are appearing. This world would appear to be on the brink of industrializing.

preftl.700.desc.gestalt.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经步入了历史的新阶段，发展出了许多完全工业化的簇集。

这一演进的戏剧化效应席卷了整个[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]——自动工厂如雨后春笋般崛起，生活水平的提高使子个体增长率大大提高，新的科学发明也层出不穷。
preftl.700.desc.gestalt.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have entered a new era of their history, having developed into several fully industrialized clusters.

The dramatic effects of this revolution can be seen across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] - autonomous factories have sprung up everywhere, improved living standards have increased drone production, and scientific innovations are appearing with increasing regularity.

preftl.700.desc.normal.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明已经步入了历史的新阶段，发展成了一个完全的工业化社会。

这一演进的戏剧化效应席卷了整个[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]——工厂如雨后春笋般崛起，医学的进步使人口增长率大大提高，新的科学发明也层出不穷。
preftl.700.desc.normal.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has entered a new era of its history, having developed into a fully industrialized society.

The dramatic effects of this revolution can be seen across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] - factories have sprung up everywhere, new medicines have resulted in increased population growth and scientific innovations are appearing with increasing regularity.

preftl.800.a.zh: 我们得监视这些信号才行。
preftl.800.a.en: We need to monitor these signals.

preftl.800.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们的探测一起首次捕获了[From.Capital.GetName]上发出的无线电信号——这里的工业化蜂巢显然已经开始试验无线信息传输。

有些簇集也开始发射简单的飞行器。除非遭遇什么以外，该文明的科技还将保持快速发展的势头。
preftl.800.desc.gestalt.en:
For the first time we have picked up radio signals emanating from [From.Capital.GetName] - the industrialized hives there have begun to experiment with wireless transmissions.

Some clusters have even begun to launch basic aircraft. Barring some unforeseen development, this civilization's technological progress will continue at a rapid pace.

preftl.800.desc.normal.zh:
我们的探测仪器首次截获了[From.Capital.GetName]上发出的无线电信号——该工业化的外星文明显然已经开始试验无线信息传输。

此外，[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的另一处也传来了数份报告，详细描述了他们的飞机首次试飞的经过。除非出现一些意想不到的变故，他们的科技仍将保持快速发展的势头。
preftl.800.desc.normal.en:
Our detection instruments have, for the first time, picked up radio signals emanating from [From.Capital.GetName] - the industrialized alien civilization has evidently begun experimenting with wireless transmissions.

Elsewhere on the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], reports have come in detailing the launch of basic aircraft. Barring some unforeseen development, this civilization's technological progress will continue at a rapid pace.

preftl.900.desc.gestalt.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上最大一个蜂巢的专业子个体成功切分了原子。随着核裂变的发现，核武器呼之欲出，而核电站也逐个开始工作。

竞争蜂巢很快就复刻了这一壮举。这里已经进入了关键时刻，许多自主集体拥有按下一个按钮就可以毁灭自己星球的手段。
preftl.900.desc.gestalt.en:
Specialized drones from the largest hive on [From.Capital.GetName] have managed to split the atom for the first time. With the discovery of nuclear fission, nuclear weapons are inevitably being produced and nuclear power plants are coming online.

Competing hives have been quick to replicate the feat. This is a critical time, as several autonomous collectives now possess the means to destroy their world with the press of a button.

preftl.900.desc.normal.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]的物理学家首次成功切分了原子。随着核裂变技术的出现，很快他们就会研制出核武，核电站的建设也马上会提上日程。

[From.GetName]的发展已经进入了关键时刻，现在他们的科技发展到只需按下一个按钮就可以毁灭自己的星球。
preftl.900.desc.normal.en:
Physicists from the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] have managed to split the atom for the first time. With the discovery of nuclear fission, nuclear weapons are inevitably being produced and nuclear power plants are coming online.

The [From.GetName] has entered the critical phase where they suddenly possess the means to destroy their own world with the press of a button.

preftl_operation.1000.desc.good.zh: 我们目前在[target.capital_scope.GetName]有数以千计的秘密特工，并且渗透了[root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的各方各面。一些特工已在当地的权力体系中升居高位，并利用自身的职位影响力为其他特工提供便利。
preftl_operation.1000.desc.good.en: Our covert operatives on [target.capital_scope.GetName] now number in the thousands, and have infiltrated every facet of the [root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. Several have ascended to leading positions in the local hierarchy, and are already wielding the influence of their positions to benefit other agents.

preftl_operation.1000.desc.okay.zh: 所有[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[target.GetSpeciesName]重要领袖都被我们的密探调包了。现在渗透人员正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的进展。是时候采取行动了。
preftl_operation.1000.desc.okay.en: All [target.GetSpeciesName] leaders of significance on [target.capital_scope.GetName] have been replaced by our own agents. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

preftl_operation.1000.desc.poor.zh:
虽然我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]表面上有数以千计的特工，但进展始终缓慢。我们曾试图推翻一个由[target.GetName]组成的主要定居点，最终惨痛收场。有关特工都已牺牲或自裁。

多亏了一支潜伏小组的英勇之举，当局才没有找到尸体，未能识破我们在星球上的行动。
preftl_operation.1000.desc.poor.en:
Although our operatives on the surface of [target.capital_scope.GetName] now number in the thousands, progress has been slow. An attempt to overthrow one of the major settlements comprising the [target.GetName] ended in disaster, and the death or self-termination of every agent involved.

It was only the heroic efforts of a sleeper cell that kept local authorities from recovering the bodies and exposing our work on the planet.

preftl_operation.1005.desc.zh:
在完全控制了[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]的政治高层之后，我们的渗透人员已经做好准备迎接首次接触小组的正式到访。

在新的行星首都举办的大型仪式上，所有[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]领袖共同签署了[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]立即并入[root.GetName]的请愿书。我们的外交大使很大度地接受了这一请求。公民们兴高采烈地走上街道，为他们的外星恩主欢呼着。
preftl_operation.1005.desc.en:
After achieving complete dominion over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our infiltration cells paved the way for the arrival of a formal first contact unit.

In a lavish ceremony held at the planetary capital, our diplomatic envoy graciously accepted a petition signed by every world leader on [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. The document calls for the immediate annexation of their [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] into the [root.GetName]. Jubilant citizens now crowd the streets, cheering their alien benefactors.

preftl_operation.1006.desc.zh: 在[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]政治领袖之中立足后，我们的渗透单元为第一次接触单元的正式到来铺平了道路。在行星首都的一场恰如其分的仪式上，我们的特使谦逊地接受了一份由[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]星球个领袖签署的陈情书。文件展示了将[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]吞并如[root.GetName]的计划。许多居民前来夹道欢迎他们的新外星施恩者。
preftl_operation.1006.desc.en: After gaining a foothold over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our infiltration cells paved the way for the arrival of a formal first contact unit. In a modest ceremony at the planetary capital, our diplomatic envoy humbly accepted a petition signed by the world leaders of [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. The document lays out plans for the annexation of their [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] into the [root.GetName]. Many citizens welcome their new alien benefactors.

preftl_operation.1007.desc.zh: 渗透入[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]的政治领导层后，我方特工为第一次接触单元的到来铺平了道路。他们不打算举行任何仪式来庆祝我方外交使节的到达。不过，我方已与[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]的领袖集团达成共识。他们的[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]将被并入[root.GetName]。
preftl_operation.1007.desc.en: After infiltrating the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our operatives have laid the ground for the arrival of a formal first contact unit. There will be no ceremony to mark the arrival of our diplomatic envoy. However, we have entered an agreement with the world leaders of [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. Their [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] will be annexed into the [root.GetName].

preftl_operation.1008.desc.zh:
我们对[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]政治领导层的渗透并不像我们被灌输的那样彻底。在起先渗透主要国家失败后，我们尝试在一些较小的政权中发动政变。即便如此我们也还是未能获得民众的支持。

我们已经从[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]撤回了所有还健在的特工。当地居民显然会在未来几年内保持警惕。
preftl_operation.1008.desc.en:
Our infiltration of the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership was not as complete as we had been led to believe. After initially failing to infiltrate their major nations, we attempted a coup within a minor power. Yet even there, the people didn't want us.

We have extracted all our surviving operatives from [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. The inhabitants are sure to be on alert for years to come.

preftl_operation.1015.desc.zh: 我们对[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[owner.GetPreFTLLower]居民进行潜移默化影响的工作已经达到了顶峰。我们的特工已经准备好把我们的文化价值传播到[target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会。
preftl_operation.1015.desc.en: Our work to influence the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] inhabitants of [target.capital_scope.GetName] has reached its zenith. Our operatives are now ready to bring our own cultural values to bear on [target.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

preftl_operation.1025.desc.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上的准备工作已经完毕；我们的特工已经准备好将[target.GetName]引入只有一步之遥的星海的大舞台。
preftl_operation.1025.desc.en: Our preparations on [target.capital_scope.GetName] are now concluded; our operatives are poised to bring the [target.GetName] one step further onto the galactic stage.

preftl_operation.1026.desc.full.zh: 多亏了我们的努力，[this.capital_scope.GetName]确信自己在宇宙中并不孤单。现在他们已经做好了接受联络的准备，而不至于对他们的生活方式造成冲击。
preftl_operation.1026.desc.full.en: Due to our efforts, the inhabitants of [this.capital_scope.GetName] now know without a doubt that they are not alone in the universe. They are ready to be contacted without risk of extreme shock to their way of life.

preftl_operation.1026.desc.high.zh: $preftl_operation.1026.desc.intro$考虑到摆在他们眼前的的事实，很多人已经开始相信他们在宇宙中并不孤独了。他们相信证据近在咫尺，发现真相只是一个时间问题。
preftl_operation.1026.desc.high.en: $preftl_operation.1026.desc.intro$ Considering the facts which now lie before them, many are convinced they're not alone in the universe. They believe proof is within their reach, and that finding it is only a matter of time.

preftl_operation.1026.desc.low.zh: 受我们散播的故事启发，[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在将它们的关注点转向天空。他们开始叩问自己，寰宇之中是否可能有其他感性生命体，在其他恒星光辉的照耀下发展壮大。
preftl_operation.1026.desc.low.en: Inspired by the stories we spread, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their gaze to the sky. They have begun to ask themselves if there might be other sentient life in the universe, bathing in the light of other stars.

preftl_operation.1026.desc.medium.zh: $preftl_operation.1026.desc.intro$他们低声诉说着几乎没人相信的故事，内容是关于天空和来自星辰之外世界的访客。这些故事中夹杂着一定的真实性。
preftl_operation.1026.desc.medium.en: $preftl_operation.1026.desc.intro$ They whisper stories few believe, of mysterious lights in the sky and visitors from worlds beyond the stars... Stories with a grain of truth.

preftl_operation.1027.desc.full.zh:
$preftl_operation.1027.desc.intro$

我们间谍网特工的大胆举措帮助[this.capital_scope.GetName]的居民理解了自己在宇宙中并不孤单这件事。现在他们已经做好了接受联络的准备，而不至于对他们的生活方式造成冲击。
preftl_operation.1027.desc.full.en:
$preftl_operation.1027.desc.intro$

The bold efforts of our Spy Network operatives have helped the inhabitants of [this.capital_scope.GetName] to understand they are not alone in the universe. They are now ready, and willing to be contacted without risk of interstellar culture shock.

preftl_operation.1027.desc.high.zh:
$preftl_operation.1027.desc.intro$

许多人已经确信自己在宇宙中并不孤单。他们知道证据近在咫尺，假以时日一定能够找到。
preftl_operation.1027.desc.high.en:
$preftl_operation.1027.desc.intro$

 Many are now certain they are not alone in the universe. They know the proof is within reach, and finding it is just a matter of time.

preftl_operation.1027.desc.low.zh:
$preftl_operation.1027.desc.intro$

在我们特工散布的故事的激励和启发下，[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在将他们的关注点转向天空。他们正积极地畅想宇宙中其他感性生命的存在。
preftl_operation.1027.desc.low.en:
$preftl_operation.1027.desc.intro$

Inspired and delighted by the stories spread by our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their gaze to the sky. They are openly speculating on the existence of other sentient life in the universe.

preftl_operation.1027.desc.medium.zh:
$preftl_operation.1027.desc.intro$

他们激动地分享着关于天空中神秘光亮和繁星之外世界的来客们的故事。许多人相信这些故事应该不是空穴来风。
preftl_operation.1027.desc.medium.en:
$preftl_operation.1027.desc.intro$

They excitedly share stories of mysterious lights in the sky and visitors from worlds beyond the stars. Many rightfully believe the stories to be the truth.

preftl_operation.1028.desc.full.zh:
$preftl_operation.1028.desc.intro$

我们间谍网特工的努力让[this.capital_scope.GetName]的居民理解了自己在宇宙中并不孤单。现在可以排除进行接触中受到强烈冲击的风险了。
preftl_operation.1028.desc.full.en:
$preftl_operation.1028.desc.intro$

The efforts of our Spy Network operatives have led the inhabitants of [this.capital_scope.GetName] to understand they are not alone in the universe. They may now be contacted without risk of extreme shock.

preftl_operation.1028.desc.high.zh:
$preftl_operation.1028.desc.intro$

许多人现在相信自己在宇宙中并不孤独。他们知道真相就在外面，但对此毫无兴趣。
preftl_operation.1028.desc.high.en:
$preftl_operation.1028.desc.intro$

Many are now concerned they are not alone in the universe. They believe the truth is out there, but they have little interest in finding it.

preftl_operation.1028.desc.low.zh:
$preftl_operation.1028.desc.intro$

[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被我们特工所散布的故事吓住了，现在连抬头看一眼都胆战心惊。他们开始怀疑在宇宙中是否有其他的感性生命，在黑暗中虎视眈眈。
preftl_operation.1028.desc.low.en:
$preftl_operation.1028.desc.intro$

Frightened by the stories spread by our operatives, the [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking upwards with great trepidation. They have begun to ask themselves if there may be other sentient life in the universe, lurking in the darkness.

preftl_operation.1028.desc.medium.zh:
$preftl_operation.1028.desc.intro$

他们闪烁其词地互相诉说着天空中诡异光亮和来自外星世界的入侵者的恐怖故事。
preftl_operation.1028.desc.medium.en:
$preftl_operation.1028.desc.intro$

They share spooky stories in hushed tones of mysterious lights in the sky and invaders from worlds beyond the stars.

preftl_operation.1035.desc.zh: 我们的$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经整理总结了结果，事关我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上掩盖星际生命存在的行动。
preftl_operation.1035.desc.en: Our $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has outlined the results of our operation to cover up the existence of interstellar life on [target.capital_scope.GetName].

preftl_operation.1036.desc.low.zh: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然在低声传诵外星人存在的证据，但是已经没什么人相信这些传说了。
preftl_operation.1036.desc.low.en: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$ The [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] still whisper about the existence of aliens, but few truly believe such tales.

preftl_operation.1036.desc.medium.zh: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$尽管一些掌权的高层可能质疑我们是真实存在的，但我们成功蒙蔽住了老百姓。
preftl_operation.1036.desc.medium.en: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$ While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, the secret remains concealed to the public.

preftl_operation.1036.desc.none.zh: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$有关星际访客存在的故事逐渐被公众遗忘，被视作持阴谋论的少数派一厢情愿的妄想。
preftl_operation.1036.desc.none.en: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$ Stories about the existence of interstellar visitors are being dismissed as the delusions of a paranoid minority.

preftl_operation.1037.desc.low.zh: $preftl_operation.1037.desc.intro$几乎没有[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会再考虑外星生命的可能性了。
preftl_operation.1037.desc.low.en: $preftl_operation.1037.desc.intro$ Few [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] even consider the possibility of life from other planets.

preftl_operation.1037.desc.medium.zh: $preftl_operation.1037.desc.intro$虽然一些身居要职的人可能会怀疑我们是真实存在的，但他们知道最好不要公开谈论那些会被视为谬论的想法。
preftl_operation.1037.desc.medium.en: $preftl_operation.1037.desc.intro$ While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, they know better than to speak publicly on what would be seen as ridiculous notions.

preftl_operation.1037.desc.none.zh: $preftl_operation.1037.desc.intro$现在传播外星人的故事会迅速被当成失心疯而遭到排挤。
preftl_operation.1037.desc.none.en: $preftl_operation.1037.desc.intro$ Sharing alien stories is now a fast way of becoming ostracized as a delusional outsider.

preftl_operation.1038.desc.low.zh: $preftl_operation.1038.desc.intro$几乎没有[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会费心考虑外星生命存在的可能性了。
preftl_operation.1038.desc.low.en: $preftl_operation.1038.desc.intro$ Few [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] care to consider the possibility of alien life.

preftl_operation.1038.desc.medium.zh: $preftl_operation.1038.desc.intro$尽管一些身居要职的人可能会怀疑我们是真实存在的，但他们不大会公开谈论这些事情了。
preftl_operation.1038.desc.medium.en: $preftl_operation.1038.desc.intro$ While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, they are unlikely to speak publicly about such things.

preftl_operation.1038.desc.none.zh: $preftl_operation.1038.desc.intro$现在传播外星人的故事会被当成是避犹不及之举。
preftl_operation.1038.desc.none.en: $preftl_operation.1038.desc.intro$ Sharing alien stories is now considered a shun-worthy eccentricity.

preftl_operation.1039.desc.low.zh: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]仍公开传播外星人的存在，不少民众信以为真。
preftl_operation.1039.desc.low.en: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$ The [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] still talk openly about the existence of aliens, and many believe such tales to be fact.

preftl_operation.1039.desc.medium.zh: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$那些身居要职的人公开谈论外星访客。他们基本肯定我们的存在。
preftl_operation.1039.desc.medium.en: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$ Those in positions of power talk openly about visitors from the stars. They are almost certain we exist.

preftl_operation.1039.desc.none.zh: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$有关星际访客存在的故事甚嚣尘上。
preftl_operation.1039.desc.none.en: $preftl_operation.1036.desc.intro$ The popularity of stories about the existence of interstellar visitors is increasing rapidly.

preftl_operation.1045.desc.zh: 我们的特工已尽其所能，将各种细小的技术进步播撒到[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会。现在就看当地人如何连点成线，把量变转化成质变。他们已经做好了一切准备。
preftl_operation.1045.desc.en: Our operatives have done all they can, seeding various small technological advances into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society. It is up to the locals now to connect the dots, and assemble these small steps into a larger one. They are as ready as they'll ever be.

preftl_operation.1046.desc.zh: 成功了！我们向[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会播撒的科技和知识蓬勃发展，从内部大大推进了他们的文明。只有时间才能说明由此可能产生的长期影响，但目前我们的特工报告说，[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]相当繁荣，善意空前。
preftl_operation.1046.desc.en: Success! The technology and knowledge we sowed into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society has flourished, greatly advancing their civilization from within. Only time will tell what long-term impacts this may have, but for now our operatives report a great deal of good will and prosperity down on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName].

preftl_operation.1047.desc.zh: 我们的特工从[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]传来捷报！我们向[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会播撒的科技和知识已开花结果，推动他们的文明向星系进发。只有时间才能说明由此可能产生的长期影响，但目前我们的特工报告说，[from.owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球的繁荣程度有所提高。
preftl_operation.1047.desc.en: Our operatives report good results on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]! The technology and knowledge we sowed into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society has borne fruit, nudging their civilization closer towards galactic involvement. Only time will tell what long-term impacts this may have, but for now our operatives report increased prosperity on the [from.owner.GetPreFTLLower] world.

preftl_operation.1048.desc.zh: 我们的特工报告说，启迪[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]居民的行动圆满成功。我们传播给[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的科技和知识已经生根发芽，推动他们的文明在通往星海的道路上更进一步。
preftl_operation.1048.desc.en: Our operatives report a successful conclusion in our efforts to enlighten the residents of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. The technology and knowledge we introduced to [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society have taken root, bringing their civilization a little closer towards reaching the stars.

preftl_operation.1049.desc.zh: 我们启迪[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]居民的行动取得了部分成功。尽管遇到了一些挫折，我们还是促进了一些基础的科技进步，确信[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会终会腾飞。不过他们的文明也许不会如我们此前希望的那样迅速或顺利地发展到星际层次。
preftl_operation.1049.desc.en: We have partially succeeded in enlightening the residents of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Despite some setbacks, we have nevertheless encouraged some basic technological progress and are confident that [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society will eventually flourish. However, their civilization may not reach the stars quite as quickly or as smoothly as we had initially hoped.

preftl_operation.1060.desc.good.zh: 我们对[target.capital_scope.GetName]的渗透几乎已经完成了，整个[root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]上几乎所有部分的节点都已经被我们同化。我们已经接管了这里的许多日常活动。很快我们就能准备好完全整合他们。
preftl_operation.1060.desc.good.en: Our infiltration of [target.capital_scope.GetName] is nigh on absolute, as we have assimilated nodes of every facet all over the [root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. We have taken over many of the day-to-day activities of the world. Soon we will be ready to integrate them fully.

preftl_operation.1060.desc.okay.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上已逐步整合了当地[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的数个关键节点中心。目标是让当地蜂巢在日常活动中对我们更加依赖，并让我们可以最终无缝吞并他们的星球。渗透单位正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]上的进度。什么时候动手完全取决于我们自己。
preftl_operation.1060.desc.okay.en: We have slowly assimilated multiple key nodal centers from the local [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [target.capital_scope.GetName]. The goal is to make the local hive more reliant on us for their day-to-day activities until we can seamlessly annex their world. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

preftl_operation.1060.desc.poor.zh:
即使[target.capital_scope.GetName]地表有无数的节点中枢处于我们的控制之下，但进度仍旧缓慢。尝试完全整合一个原始的大陆蜂巢成为了一场灾难，而我们在当地的特工也被驱逐了。

多亏了我们的多项包括持续回收子个体在内的应急措施，才让遗骸和我们在这颗星球上的工作避免暴露。
preftl_operation.1060.desc.poor.en:
Even with numerous nodal centers under our control on the surface of [target.capital_scope.GetName], progress has been slow. An attempt to fully assimilate a primary continental hive ended in disaster and the expulsion of all our local operatives.

It was only due to our multiple contingency efforts that we kept the recycling drones from recovering the remains and exposing our work on the planet.

preftl_operation.1065.desc.zh:
在完成对[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]意识的主宰后，我们很快确定没有任何一个子个体被落下。

[infiltrated_country_species.GetName]意识并未消亡，只是被我们吸收了。我们的意识向着宇宙的深处继续延伸。“一”如既往。
preftl_operation.1065.desc.en:
After achieving complete dominance over the minds of the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] we quickly ensured that no drone was left.

The [infiltrated_country_species.GetName] consciousness is not gone, merely absorbed. Our minds will now reach further out into space. As one.

preftl_operation.1066.desc.zh: 在对[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]意识取得关键影响后，我们的节点中心已准备好进行直接控制。除了极个别反常问题，我们现在完全将[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]整合进了[root.GetName]。
preftl_operation.1066.desc.en: After gaining critical influence over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] mind, our nodal centers prepared for us to assume direct control. With only a minor deviancy issue, we have now fully annexed the [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] into the [root.GetName].

preftl_operation.1067.desc.zh: 在渗透了[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]蜂巢意识后，我们整合的节点中心已经准备好吞并剩下的[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]。在我们夺取控制时，一小块大陆对我们的影响展现出了抗拒，宁愿选择自我了断也不愿意被我们的意识吸收。他们的[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]将被吞并入[root.GetName]。
preftl_operation.1067.desc.en: After infiltrating the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] hive mind, our assimilated nodal centers were ready to subsume the rest of the [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]. As we assumed control, a minor continent resisted our influence, choosing to end its existence rather than be absorbed into our mind. Their [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] will be annexed into the [root.GetName].

preftl_operation.1068.desc.zh: [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]蜂巢思维发现了我们的影响。正当我们准备激活整合的节点中枢的一刻，与整个蜂巢的链接被切断了。在快速废止了我们的行动之后，必须承认，[from.GetName]行动失败了。[infiltrated_country_species.GetClass]人口现在对外界干扰产生了高度的警惕。
preftl_operation.1068.desc.en: The [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] hive mind has discovered our influence. Just as we were ready to activate our assimilated nodal centers, we found ourselves cut off from the rest of their hive. Having quickly dismantled our missions, we must declare Operation [from.GetName] a failure. The [infiltrated_country_species.GetClass] population is now on high alert for any outside interference.

preftl_operation.1100.b.zh: 用一些更极端的手段贿赂这些学者：科研经费。
preftl_operation.1100.b.en: Bribe these scholars with something radical: funding.

preftl_operation.1100.c.zh: 让他们吵去吧。这肯定会很有趣的。
preftl_operation.1100.c.en: Let them bicker. This could prove interesting.

preftl_operation.1100.desc.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]的特工以先进的知识武装头脑，已经渗透了当地的大学，凭借着开创性的理论确立了自己作为杰出思想家的地位。然而，此人不断取得的成功却遭到了当地学者的质疑：许多人拒绝与此人接触，指责其为骗子。

无休止的学术争吵阻碍了我们的特工传播新思想。我们的$role_spymaster$正在请求进一步的指示。
preftl_operation.1100.desc.en:
Armed with our superior knowledge, our operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have infiltrated local universities, establishing themselves as brilliant thinkers known for their ground-breaking theories. Their rising success, though, has been met with suspicion by local scholars: many refuse to engage with them, accusing them of being frauds.

The endless academic bickering is making it hard for our agents to spread new ideas. Our $role_spymaster$ is requesting further instructions.

preftl_operation.3000.b.en: Exercise caution. Relocate to another area.

preftl_operation.3000.desc.zh: 我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]尝试影响[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，遭遇了广泛的质疑。许多当地人笃信我们的特工不是魔物就是恶灵，正在想方设法地远离他们。敌对示威似乎很可能发生。
preftl_operation.3000.desc.en: Our attempts to influence the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] are being met with widespread suspicion. Many of the locals are taking great steps to avoid our operatives, believing them to be creatures of magic or else evil spirits. Hostile demonstrations seem very likely.

preftl_operation.3001.desc.zh: 我们的特工利用了自己的异世名声，在当地确立了特权地位。因此[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]信服并接受了我们的科技。不过他们现在更清楚地意识到了像我们这样的 “超自然”生物的存在。
preftl_operation.3001.desc.en: Our operatives took advantage of their other-worldly reputation and have established that yes, they are superior to the locals. As a result, the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been convinced to embrace our technologies - however they are now more aware of the existence of 'paranormal' creatures like us.

preftl_operation.3002.desc.zh: 我们的特工利用确凿的事实和逻辑，成功地颠覆了[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会中新生的迷信思想体系。结果，当地人不仅开始接受我们的计划，还开始采取更客观的视角来看待他们的周遭世界。
preftl_operation.3002.desc.en: Our operatives were successful in challenging the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society's new, superstitious belief structure using hard facts and logic. As a result, the locals have not only begun to embrace our schemes, but are starting to take a more objective view of the world around them.

preftl_operation.3003.desc.zh: [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]传来噩耗，暴民们抓获并杀害了我们的一位特工。当地的领袖与居民一致认为遭到了超自然魔法师的恶意入侵，对此怒不可遏。帮助[from.target.GetName]踏入新时代的任务会变得更加艰难。
preftl_operation.3003.desc.en: Tragedy on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName], as an angry mob has captured and killed one of our operatives. Local leaders and residents alike are furious at what they consider to be an incursion by paranormal wielders of magic and ill intent. The task of preparing the [from.target.GetName] for a new age has become more difficult.

preftl_operation.3010.a.zh: 或许他们对金钱能有所回应？

preftl_operation.3010.c.zh: 花费更多的时间研究他们的文化。
preftl_operation.3010.c.en: Devote more time to studying their culture.

preftl_operation.3010.desc.zh:
我们以为自己已经充分了解[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]文化，能让特工成功地融入社会了，但实际上他们还是遭遇了重重困难。当地人似乎对他们冷眼旁观，将我们的特工排除出社交场合，甚至包括一些每日例行的文化活动。

现在说服任何人接纳我们都变得难上加难，更别说执行[from.GetName]行动的目标了。考虑到社会平衡现在处于微妙的棘手状态，我们应该谨慎考虑下一步行动。
preftl_operation.3010.desc.en:
We thought we knew [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] culture well enough that our operatives would fit in socially, but many are struggling. The locals seem to shun them, excluding our agents from social occasions and even some everyday cultural activities.

It's getting harder to persuade anyone to include us, let alone execute the goals of Operation [from.GetName]. Given the delicate social balance at stake, we should consider our next move carefully.

preftl_operation.3011.desc.zh:
[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]的人们崇拜上我们了！换句话说，我们的特工不再需要废力地融入他们，现在无论走到哪里都受到了热烈的欢迎。可能我们没有留意到[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]文化中一个微妙但是关键的矛盾点：尽管他们的社会在明面上推崇协调一致，但在私下却非常赞赏浮华的出格行为。

现在我们的特工在当地成了时尚的弄潮儿，我们也可以愉快地汇报，[from.GetName]行动正前所未有地丝滑推进中。
preftl_operation.3011.desc.en:
The people of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] adore us! That is to say: our operatives no longer struggle to fit in, but are instead welcomed warmly wherever they go. It seems we had failed to notice a subtle yet vital contradiction of [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] culture. Though their society openly promotes uniformity, they secretly admire acts of flashy unconformity.

Now that our operatives have been elevated to trend-setting status, we are happy to report that Operation [from.GetName] is running more smoothly than ever.

preftl_operation.3012.desc.zh:
[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]文化的细微差别依旧难以捉摸，甚至情况还更糟了：我们的一些特工甚至因为最近犯下的罪行而遭受驱逐。看来[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一群比我们预想的更加保守和猜忌的人。

这些社交失误让我们的[from.GetName]行动进展延缓，然而我们至少吸取了一些教训。新的假身份和训练规范已经在草拟当中，而我们的特工不会在同一个地方跌倒第二次了。
preftl_operation.3012.desc.en:
The subtle nuances of [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] culture continue to evade us, and worse still: some of our operatives have now been banished for their recent transgressions. The [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] turn out to be a more conservative and suspicious people than we had first thought.

These social missteps have delayed our progress on Operation [from.GetName], however we have at least learned what not to do in future. New identities and training protocols are already being drawn up; our operatives won't be caught in the same blunder twice.

preftl_operation.3020.b.zh: 这种独创精神值得赞扬！
preftl_operation.3020.b.en: Such initiative is to be commended!

preftl_operation.3020.desc.zh:
我们的一位在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上工作的关键特工有点……迷恋上了当地的文明，并拒绝了许多已下达的任务。相反，这位过于独立的特工开始进行独立的异种学研究，并提交了许多请求，要求将其正式发布。

这些行为让[from.GetName]行动遭受到推延的风险，但我们必须承认，那个不守规矩的特工的工作事实上对我们相当有用。否认这一努力反而才会减缓我们的进展。
preftl_operation.3020.desc.en:
One of our key operatives working on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has become... enamored with the local civilization, and has been refusing many of their assigned tasks. Instead this overly-independent agent has taken up independent xenological study, and has submitted numerous requests to make this a formal posting.

Although these actions put Operation [from.GetName] at risk of delay, we must admit that the unruly operative's work has already proven rather useful to us. Denying this effort will slow our progress.

preftl_operation.3030.a.zh: 所以他们变得……更好控制了？

preftl_operation.3030.b.tt.zh: 调配更多资源，确保抑制我们特工的本能和不当习惯。
preftl_operation.3030.b.tt.en: Assign more resources to keeping our operatives' instincts and mannerisms in check.

preftl_operation.3030.c.zh: 我们就坚持一下做到底。
preftl_operation.3030.c.en: We are committed to seeing this through.

preftl_operation.3030.desc.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的工作遇到了一个很怪的难题：[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢正在镜像模仿我们的行为。一开始我们以为不过是当地工蜂的古怪行为，但许多这些新的习惯毫无疑问本质上就是[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的。

这不仅暗示了我们在[from.GetName]行动缜密设计的范围之外影响到了当地的蜂巢，更提醒了我们自己的失败融入正在被倒映回给我们。目前没有迹象表明这个蜂巢意识到了我们的行动，但也许我们的暴露与否只是时间问题。
preftl_operation.3030.desc.en:
Our work on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has met with an unusual complication: the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive is mirroring our behavior. At first we thought the local drones had simply turned eccentric, but many of these new habits are unmistakeably [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] in nature.

Not only does this suggest we are influencing the hive outside the carefully-planned remit of Operation [from.GetName], but our own failures to blend in are now being reflected back us. There are no signs yet that the hive is aware of our operation, but that may only be a matter of time.

preftl_operation.3041.desc.zh:
$preftl_operation.3042.desc$

哎呀，我们的这一计谋有失精妙，让特工们招致猜疑。他们大多都被踢出了[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的学院，而他们的位置很快就填上了一些较为保守的思想家。
preftl_operation.3041.desc.en:
$preftl_operation.3042.desc$

Alas, our machinations lacked subtlety, and have brought a great deal of suspicion down upon our operatives. Most have been barred from [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] academia, their vacant spots immediately filled by more conservative thinkers.

preftl_operation.3042.a.zh: 很好。这就是我们的下马威。

preftl_operation.3042.desc.zh: 最近几周，许多反对我们特工理论的学者不得不离开他们的职位，随后又发生了一系列看似无关的——有时还相当暴力的——“意外事件”。
preftl_operation.3042.desc.en: Many of the academics who had opposed our operatives' theories have had to leave their positions in recent weeks, following a string of seemingly unrelated - and occasionally quite violent - "accidents".

preftl_operation.3043.desc.zh: 我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上贿赂异见学者的企图瞬间就被发现并报道了。当地司法部门行动迅速：许多我们的特工被从学院里扫地出门。他们的空位迅速被较为保守的[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]思想家占领了。
preftl_operation.3043.desc.en: Our attempt to bribe dissenting academics on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] was immediately discovered and reported. Local justice has proven swift: a number of our operatives have been barred from academia. Their vacant spots have already been filled by more conservative [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] thinkers.

preftl_operation.3044.desc.zh:
得益于一位慷慨大方的匿名赞助人，当地学者们的研究经费终于有了着落：这馅饼掉得太突然，以至于连琐碎竞争的时间都没有。

新近的繁荣也创造力一些新的学术岗位，并很快被我们的特工占领了。我们逐渐抓紧了对[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]学院的控制，使其更便于传播我们的理念。
preftl_operation.3044.desc.en:
Thanks to the generosity of an anonymous patron, local academics have been able to secure funding for their research: an unexpected boon that leaves little time for petty rivalries.

This newfound prosperity brought with it new academic positions, rapidly filled by more of our operatives. Our grip on [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] academia tightens, making it that bit easier to spread our ideas.

preftl_operation.3045.desc.zh: 在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上无休止的学术争论果然是一大阻碍，而非什么机遇。我们的特工没能在[from.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的主要文化学院中占得一席之地。也许我们尝试带去的理念在目前还是太具争议了。
preftl_operation.3045.desc.en: The seemingly endless academic feuds on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have proven to be more of a hindrance than an opportunity. Our operatives failed to gain a foothold at any of the [from.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]'s main cultural institutions. Perhaps the ideas we tried to introduce were just too controversial at this time.

preftl_operation.3046.desc.zh:
我们白捡了一个好机会！我们的特工在与[from.target.GetName]的思想家争论的过程中，发现自己被一些最尖锐的对手推到了一个人尽皆知的地步。结果就是，我们的理念现在被带到了[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上最受尊敬的学术机构代表面前。

这些机构不但理解了我们的思想，而且还开始开始对其提炼，并变成一些意想不到的东西：一些可能是经过混沌的意见交换后产生的新见解。
preftl_operation.3046.desc.en:
An ideal opportunity has come our way! While debating with local thinkers, our operatives in the [from.target.GetName] found themselves thrust onto a highly prestigious stage by some of their fiercest rivals. As a result, our ideas have now been brought before representatives from the most respected academic institutions on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName].

These bodies not only understood our ideas, but have since set about refining them, turning them into something quite unexpected: new insights, made possible through the chaotic exchange of ideas.

preftl_operation.3050.b.zh: 逮住这个[from.target.GetSpeciesName]，让它从这世界上消失。
preftl_operation.3050.b.en: Hunt this [from.target.GetSpeciesName] down and eliminate them.

preftl_operation.3050.c.zh: 太放肆了！我们必须中止行动。

preftl_operation.3050.desc.zh:
发生了严重违规行为！$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在一次秘访[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]地表时不慎暴露了踪迹。目前事故的细节仍在调查中，但[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]与当地的[from.target.GetSpeciesName]发生了短暂但直接的接触，他们一瞬间便落荒而逃。我们的特工尽力抓捕目击者，但目前仍一无所获。

[from.GetName]行动仍在进展当中，但我们将采取特殊措施来遏制这场事故。
preftl_operation.3050.desc.en:
A drastic breach has occurred! $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been compromised during a clandestine visit to the surface of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Some details remain unclear for now, but [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] came into brief and direct contact with a native [from.target.GetSpeciesName], who promptly fled the scene. Our operatives moved to try and apprehend this witness, but their efforts have so far failed.

Operation [from.GetName] remains in progress for now, but we have activated special measures until this breach can be contained.

preftl_operation.3051.desc.zh: 我们的特工报告，他们成功地消灭了目标：我们最近在[from.target.GetName]入侵的唯一目击者。我们追踪这个人到达某个大型[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]定居点郊区的一处偏远住所。这位目击者似乎处于极度震惊的状态，没有迹象表明此人与其他[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]进行了接触。我们确信该事件已经得到了控制。
preftl_operation.3051.desc.en: Our operatives report the successful elimination of their target: the sole witness to our recent breach in the [from.target.GetName]. This individual was tracked to a remote dwelling on the outskirts of a major [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] settlement. The witness appeared to be in an extreme state of shock, and there are no signs they came into contact with other [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are confident that this matter has been contained.

preftl_operation.3055.a.zh: 不可接受。中止行动，立即撤退。

preftl_operation.3055.b.zh: 我们绝不进行谈判。消灭目击者。
preftl_operation.3055.b.en: We will not negotiate. Eliminate the witness.

preftl_operation.3055.c.zh: 大出血的价格，但是我们会出这个钱。
preftl_operation.3055.c.en: A steep price, but we will pay.

preftl_operation.3055.c.tt.zh:
我们将指派特工对此人进行全时监控，确保整个过程的隐秘性。
这会对我们的$MOD_SPY_NETWORK_DAILY_VALUE_ADD$产生负面效应。
preftl_operation.3055.c.tt.en:
Operatives will be assigned to monitor this individual at all times, ensuring complete secrecy.
This will negatively impact our $MOD_SPY_NETWORK_DAILY_VALUE_ADD$.

preftl_operation.3055.desc.zh:
那个目睹我们最近入侵[from.target.GetName]的[from.target.GetSpeciesName]不仅仍然在逃遁，甚至还向我们发出了粗暴的最后通牒。这个目击者威胁要揭露我们的$role_spymaster$——除此之外还有[from.owner.GetName]——我们是如何对[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的事务进行插足干涉的。

这个厚颜无耻的家伙通过待在人口稠密的地区来阻挠我们，在那里我们不能在没有暴露风险的情况下对它采取什么措施。我们或许干脆就同意此人的要求算了。
preftl_operation.3055.desc.en:
The [from.target.GetSpeciesName] who witnessed our recent breach in the [from.target.GetName] is not only still at large, but has delivered us a crude ultimatum. The witness threatens to expose our $role_spymaster$ - and by extension, the [from.owner.GetName] - for our interference in [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] affairs.

This brazen individual keeps us at bay by remaining in heavily-populated areas, where we cannot act against them without fear of further exposure. We may instead wish to simply meet their demands.

preftl_operation.3060.b.zh: 我们必须相信他们的掩护靠得住。
preftl_operation.3060.b.en: We must trust that their cover will hold.

preftl_operation.3060.c.zh: 我们不能冒风险暴露！中止行动。
preftl_operation.3060.c.en: We cannot risk this kind of exposure! Abort.

preftl_operation.3060.d.zh: 是时候揭示我们的真面目了。
preftl_operation.3060.d.en: It is time we reveal ourselves.

preftl_operation.3060.d.negative.tt.zh: 将我们的特工完全托付给[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的医疗照料。这将会对[from.GetName]行动造成负面的影响。
preftl_operation.3060.d.negative.tt.en: Entrust our operatives fully to [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] medical care. This will have a negative impact on Operation [from.GetName].

preftl_operation.3060.d.positive.tt.zh: 将我们的特工完全托付给[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的医疗照料。这将会对[from.GetName]行动造成正面的影响。
preftl_operation.3060.d.positive.tt.en: Entrust our operatives fully to [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] medical care. This will have a positive impact on Operation [from.GetName].

preftl_operation.3060.desc.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的两名关键特工在一场意料之外的自然灾害中身受重伤，该灾害同样造成了许多[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]伤亡。附近居民紧急驰援，那几名特工现在得到了基本的照料。

[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]还没能开始质疑我们的特工，尽管他们伤势严重，但和当地的大量受灾者相比不算什么。用不了多久，[from.GetName]行动就会受到更严格的审查——尤其是在我们的两名关键特工身体不适的情况下。
preftl_operation.3060.desc.en:
Two of our key operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have been seriously injured during an unexpected, natural disaster which also claimed the lives of several [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Local residents rushed to their aid; the operatives in question are now being given rudimentary care.

The [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have not yet been able to question our operatives, however their injuries - though severe - are nothing compared to what struck down so many native bystanders. It cannot be long before Operation [from.GetName] is put under significantly greater scrutiny - especially with two of our key agents indisposed.

preftl_operation.3060.hive.desc.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的两名关键特工在一场意料之外的自然灾害中身受重伤，该灾害同样摧毁了许多[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]子个体。帮助者们紧急驰援，并将我们那两名负伤特工带走进行基本的照料。

目前，[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢主倾向于关照那些更严重的毁伤上。但用不了多久，[from.GetName]行动就会受到更严格的审查——尤其是在我们的两名关键特工身体不适的情况下。我们有极大的暴露风险。
preftl_operation.3060.hive.desc.en:
Two of our key operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have been seriously injured during an unexpected, natural disaster which also destroyed several [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] drones. Helpers rushed to provide aid, and have removed our stricken operatives to a rudimentary care nodule.

For now, the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive is pre-occupied with tending to its more severe injuries. However, it cannot be long before Operation [from.GetName] comes under greater scrutiny - especially with two of our key agents indisposed. We are at great risk of exposure.

preftl_operation.3061.failure.desc.zh:
$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]紧急汇报，从[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]地表撤回受伤特工的行动失败了。几个[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]目击了他们认为的“绑架未遂”，并带着他们的偏见强加干预。他们不仅加强了对那几名受伤特工的安保，甚至还逮捕了我们救援队的成员！

[from.target.GetSpeciesName]现在高度警惕。至少在某种意义上来说，[from.GetName]行动已经败露了。
preftl_operation.3061.failure.desc.en:
$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] urgently reports a failure to extract our stricken operatives from the surface of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Several [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] witnessed what they perceived as an attempted abduction, and intervened with great prejudice. They have not only tightened security around our injured operatives, but have also apprehended members of our rescue team!

The [from.target.GetSpeciesName] are now on high alert. To some extent at least, Operation [from.GetName] has been exposed.

preftl_operation.3061.success.desc.zh: $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]汇报，我们的受伤特工已经从[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]当地的的医疗设施中撤离。在[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的视角里，这些“幸存者”们受到了隐蔽的致命伤。他们遗体的复制品已经被妥善处置了。
preftl_operation.3061.success.desc.en: $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports the successful extraction of our injured operatives from a care facility on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. As far as the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are concerned, these 'survivors' succumbed to hidden, fatal injuries. Facsimiles of their remains are already being disposed of.

preftl_operation.3062.failure.aware.desc.zh:
$preftl_operation.3062.failure.desc.intro$

幸运的是当地人并没有惊慌失措，我们的特工暂时也没有受到伤害。然而，继续掩盖他们的存在和行动的成功希望非常渺茫。似乎我们必须处理迫在眉睫的后果了。
preftl_operation.3062.failure.aware.desc.en:
$preftl_operation.3062.failure.desc.intro$

Fortunately the locals did not panic, and our operatives remain unharmed for the time being. However, our chances of successfully disavowing them and their actions are extremely slim. It seems we must simply deal with the consequences now before us.

preftl_operation.3062.failure.unaware.de.zh:
$preftl_operation.3062.failure.desc.intro$

严峻的现实对我们的特工来说相当致命：他们正在接受基本手术时，[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的护理人员发现了他们的真实身份，并为此惊慌失措。
preftl_operation.3062.failure.unaware.de.en:
$preftl_operation.3062.failure.desc.intro$

This stark realization has proven fatal for our operatives: they were undergoing rudimentary surgery when [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] care-givers discovered their true nature, and panicked.

preftl_operation.3062.success.desc.zh:
我们的掩护依然没有暴露。我们的特工几乎奇迹般地逃脱了致命伤这件事确实引起了一些怀疑，但[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]似乎认为运气只是站在他们这一边。

我们的特工们还要有一段时日才能回到岗位上，但他们现在已经进行了述职汇报。[from.GetName]行动将会恢复其首要日程。
preftl_operation.3062.success.desc.en:
Our cover remains in tact. Although the near-miraculous manner in which our operatives escaped fatal injury did raise some suspicion, the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] appear to have decided that luck was simply on their side.

It will be a while yet before our agents can return to duty, however they have now been debriefed. Operation [from.GetName] may return to its prior schedule.

preftl_operation.3100.a.zh: 研究他们对受控释放荷尔蒙的反应。
preftl_operation.3100.a.en: Study their reaction to controlled pheromone releases.

preftl_operation.3100.b.en: Keep a lid on the pheromones.

preftl_operation.3100.b.tt.zh: 调配更多资源，确保我们的特工完成任务，避免进一步发生意外的风险。
preftl_operation.3100.b.tt.en: Assign more resources so our agents can fulfill the mission without risking any more incidents.

preftl_operation.3100.desc.zh:
[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上一个大型定居点的子个体们今天意外地爆发了一场冲突。我们的特工在伪装成当地低级子个体时误用了错误的信息素，并引发了拥挤踩踏事件。[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢似乎对我们提前准备的信息素格外敏感。但如果继续在当地定居点之间编排这样的爆炸性交互，我们应该会学到不少东西。

显然，我们的存在本身正危害到[from.GetName]行动的进行。我们下次再发送任何信号都必须做到万无一失。
preftl_operation.3100.desc.en:
The drones of a major colony on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] were unexpectedly roused for battle today. Our agents mistakenly applied the wrong pheromone when trying to pass off as local menial drones, which lead to a stampede. The [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive appears unusually sensitive to our pre-prepared pheromones. If we orchestrate further explosive interactions between local colonies, there could be much to learn.

What is clear is that our presence is endangering the [from.GetName] Operation. Whatever signal we send next, it must be the right one.

preftl_operation.3105.a.zh: 让这些子个体拨弄我们的废品。
preftl_operation.3105.a.en: Let the drones pick at our scraps.

preftl_operation.3105.b.zh: 要是我们将装置启动会怎么样？
preftl_operation.3105.b.en: What if we were to turn it on?

preftl_operation.3105.b.tt.en: [from.target.GetName] will advance to their next technological age.

preftl_operation.3105.c.zh: 遥控引爆当地所有的渗透设备。
preftl_operation.3105.c.en: Remotely detonate all the local infiltration equipment.

preftl_operation.3105.desc.zh:
一个[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]子个体设法将自己的[from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural]放到了我们的测量装置上。它已经开始把我们的装置拆开了，如果它理解了什么，这股意识蔓延到当地的蜂巢思维只是一个时间问题。

如果我们希望避免干扰它们的自然发展，就必须迅速采取行动。
preftl_operation.3105.desc.en:
A drone on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has managed to get their [from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural] on one of our measuring devices. It has already started to take our device apart; it's only a matter of time before the understanding spreads to the local hive.

We must act quickly if we wish to avoid interfering with their natural development.

preftl_operation.failed_annaxation.tt.zh: 我们在5年之内无法再发起任何[From.GetName]任务。
preftl_operation.failed_annaxation.tt.en: We will be unable to launch any new [From.GetName] missions for 5 years.

prethoryn_kills_others.zh: 被他人消灭的索林原虫

prethoryn_kills_us.zh: 被我们消灭的索林原虫

previously_terraformed_planet.zh: 以前环境改造过的行星

primal_hunter_catchphrase.zh: “我要为我的展柜找下一个战利品。”
primal_hunter_catchphrase.en: "I seek another trophy for my collection."

primal_hunter_desc.zh: 一位在星系中游荡，寻找大型猎物的熟练猎手。
primal_hunter_desc.en: A proficient hunter that roams the galaxy in search of big game.

primal_rancher_catchphrase.zh: “每个生物都有故事要讲，而我是一个热心的倾听者！”
primal_rancher_catchphrase.en: "Every creature has a story to tell, and I'm a keen listener!"

primal_rancher_desc.zh: 她是一位对实地考察充满热情的异星生物学家，研究过各种各样的太空生物。
primal_rancher_desc.en: A xenologist with a passion for field work, she has studied all manner of spaceborne beasts.

prisoner_tranfer_tt.zh: 罪犯£pop£ 人口被转移至[From.GetName]
prisoner_tranfer_tt.en: The Criminal £pop£ Pops are transferred to [From.GetName]

probe_ion_trail_poi_desc.zh: 其中一个遗失的亚光速探测器的离子航迹指向这个星系。
probe_ion_trail_poi_desc.en: An ion trail belonging to one of our missing probes leads to this system.

probe_search_1_poi_desc.zh: 根据脱离的轨道和离开母恒星系的时间推测，其中一个遗失的亚光速探测器应该就在这个恒星系里的某处。
probe_search_1_poi_desc.en: Based on its outbound trajectory and the time since it departed our home system, we suspect that one of our missing sublight probes can be found somewhere inside this star system.

probe_subspace_anomaly_poi_desc.zh: 敌人阻止我们靠近这个星系的亚空间探测器。
probe_subspace_anomaly_poi_desc.en: Hostiles prohibit us from getting to the subspace probe in this system.

progress.2.a.en: We may not be alone out here.

progress.2.a.serv.zh: 完美。准备初步的互娱协议。

progress.2.a.term.zh: 我们会准备好面对他们。
progress.2.a.term.en: We will be ready for them.

progress.2.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到和[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]完全不一样的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到。
progress.2.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery has silenced those who believed we were alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that are.

progress.2.desc.assim.zh: [Root.GetName]报告在[From.GetName]上有了重大发现：发现了大量外星有机生命！尽管它们的进化程度都不足以成为合适的同化对象，在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]之外遭遇智慧有机体的可能性现在已大大增加。
progress.2.desc.assim.en: The [Root.GetName] reports a momentous find on [From.GetName]: myriad alien organic lifeforms have been discovered! While none of them has evolved to a stage we would consider desirable for assimilation, the likelihood of encountering sapient organics beyond [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] is now more promising than ever.

progress.2.desc.droid.zh:
