[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星有机生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到了起源于[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]以外的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到智慧物种，不管是有机体还是机械体。
progress.2.desc.droid.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with organic alien creatures. For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery has silenced those who believed we were alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter sentient beings, biological or mechanical.

progress.2.desc.evopred.zh: 生命。耀眼地演化的生命触手可及，我们随时可以从中采集样本促进自身的发展。自古以来我们就收集了[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]上所有的有趣样本，但却从来不敢设想在刚踏出征程的第一步就可以寻得更多的独特基因。
progress.2.desc.evopred.en: Life. Glorious evolved life is out there and ready to be sampled for our progress. We have long since gathered all interesting samples on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] and didn't dare hope that we would have access to further genetic uniqueness so soon after leaving home.

progress.2.desc.mach.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上有了意外发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]上充满了外星生命。这是我们有史以来第一次遭遇源自[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]以外的有机生命。

尽管[From.GetName]上发现的外星生物都没有智慧，最新校正过的预测显示星系中存在智慧有机体的可能性非常高。
progress.2.desc.mach.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made an unanticipated discovery on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien lifeforms. For the first time in history, we have encountered organic life that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, newly recalibrated prognoses suggest a high probability of intelligent organics in the galaxy.

progress.2.desc.serv.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]有了史无前例的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]上充满了外星有机体！尽管这些生命体似乎都没有自我意识来感激[Root.Owner.GetAdj]照料，但遭遇到更高级智慧也只是时间问题！
progress.2.desc.serv.en: A historic discovery has been made by the [Root.GetName] on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien organics! Though none of the new lifeforms appear to possess the self-awareness required to appreciate [Root.Owner.GetAdj] pampering, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that do!

progress.2.desc.storm.normal.zh:
一位[Root.Owner.GetScientist]说，“快来看看这个小家伙！”

$progress.2.desc.storm.outro$
progress.2.desc.storm.normal.en:
In the words of one [Root.Owner.GetScientist], "Get a load of this little guy!"

$progress.2.desc.storm.outro$

progress.2.desc.term.zh: 我们一直都在为这一天作准备。[Root.GetName]确认了外星有机体存在于[From.GetName]之上。尽管遭遇的生命体都没有较高的认知能力，我们无法排除星系中极有可能充满了智慧有机体的可能性。
progress.2.desc.term.en: We have been preparing for this day. The [Root.GetName] has confirmed the existence of alien organics on [From.GetName]. Though none of the encountered lifeforms possess higher reasoning functions, we cannot preclude the now heightened probability of a galaxy infested with sapient organics.

progress.2.desc.wilderness.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[from.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[from.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是我们第一次遇到和自己完全不一样的生命形态。

这一发现终于使我们相信，[root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]这颗行星，在宇宙中并不孤独。尽管这些[from.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到……
progress.2.desc.wilderness.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [from.GetName]: the [from.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time, we have encountered lifeforms which originated outside our self.

This discovery finally confirms that we, the planet [root.owner.capital_scope.GetName], are not alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [from.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that are...

progress.3.authoritarian.zh: 纪律与秩序将会引导我们的殖民地。
progress.3.authoritarian.en: Order and hierarchy will guide our colony.

progress.3.b.evopred.en: A whole new banquet to sample.

progress.3.desc.storm.gestalt.zh:
令人颤栗的发现！一颗遍布机遇的新星球！！

我们刚一把殖民船改造成大本营，探险节点就已经准备好面对这个星球可能给我们带来的一切挑战了。
progress.3.desc.storm.gestalt.en:
A thrilling discovery! A new world ripe with opportunity!!

As we convert our colony ship into a base camp, exploratory nodes are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.

progress.3.desc.storm.normal.zh:
“惊奇!”[ruler.GetRegnalName]喊道。“这是个新世界，充满了新机遇！”

我们刚一把殖民船改造成大本营，第一批探险者就已经准备好面对这个星球可能给他们带来的一切挑战了。
progress.3.desc.storm.normal.en:
"Incredible," [ruler.GetRegnalName] exclaimed. "A new world ripe with opportunity!"

As we convert our colony ship into a base camp, the first explorers are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.

progress.3.desc_01.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的一片大陆上，我们的殖民船徐徐降落在一座巨大河口三角洲。这片气候温和的林地将会提供庇护所和唾手可得的原材料。$progress.3.desc_end$
progress.3.desc_01.en: Our colony ship has gently touched down at the mouth of a large river delta on one of the continents on [Root.GetName]. This temperate, forested area will provide shelter and easy access to raw materials.$progress.3.desc_end$

progress.3.desc_02.zh: 在[Root.GetName]绵延整个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的海洋上，我们的殖民船徐徐落在一片大型群岛的海岸附近，溅起了雪白的浪花。这片丰饶的岛链可以为食物产出提供绝佳的环境。$progress.3.desc_end$
progress.3.desc_02.en: Our colony ship has made a gentle splashdown in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]-spanning ocean of [Root.GetName], near the shores of a large archipelago. This fertile island chain provide a suitable environment for growing food.$progress.3.desc_end$

progress.3.desc_03.zh: 我们的殖民船徐徐降落在[Root.GetName]上一片巨大绿洲的边缘，稳稳地停靠在可以遮挡沙漠狂风又便于取水的山脚下。$progress.3.desc_end$
progress.3.desc_03.en: Our colony ship has gently touched down by the outskirts of a large oasis on [Root.GetName], at the foot of a mountain, offering shelter from the desert winds and easy access to water.$progress.3.desc_end$

progress.3.desc_04.zh: 我们的殖民船在[Root.GetName]的密林中找到了一片林间空地完成了行星着陆。哨卫子个体已经部署到周围防止潜在猎食者的袭扰。$progress.3.desc_end$
progress.3.desc_04.en: Our colony ship has found a clearing in the dense jungles of [Root.GetName] and made planetfall. Sentry drones have been deployed to guard against potential predators.$progress.3.desc_end$

progress.3.desc_05.zh: 我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了[Root.GetName]赤道附近的一片平坦开阔的平顶山上。峡谷中的河流非常便于获取净水。$progress.3.desc_end$
progress.3.desc_05.en: Our colony ship has gently touched down at the top of a large, flat mesa near the equator of [Root.GetName]. The rivers that flow in the canyons below provide easy access to fresh water.$progress.3.desc_end$

progress.3.desc_06.zh: 我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了[Root.GetName]上一片宽阔而空旷的草原，紧挨着一片巨大山脊以抵挡寒风。$progress.3.desc_end$
progress.3.desc_06.en: Our colony ship has gently touched down on the wide, empty steppe of [Root.GetName], nestled behind a large ridge, sheltering it from the cold winds.$progress.3.desc_end$

progress.3.desc_07.zh: 我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了[Root.GetName]上一个白雪皑皑的山谷中。周围的山脉带来了充足的保护，并且提供了可靠的水资源。$progress.3.desc_end$
progress.3.desc_07.en: Our colony ship has gently touched down in a snow-covered valley on [Root.GetName]. The surrounding mountain chains offer sufficient protection from the elements and provide an reliable water supply.$progress.3.desc_end$

progress.3.desc_08.zh:
我们的殖民船缓慢的降落在覆盖着[Root.GetName]广阔的草原上。这里的大气略微干燥但同样怡人，在确定着陆点的过程中也观察到一大群温顺的食草动物。

舰船已被改造成新居住地的行政基地，它的反应堆核心正在被拆除来用作殖民地的暂时能量来源。

数百个小帐篷和简易房环绕着星舰巨大的船体，殖民者开始大片大片地登陆——在这外星世界上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]之城。
progress.3.desc_08.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the sprawling savanna that covers most of [Root.GetName]. The shimmering air is dry yet pleasant, and a large herd of docile herbivores can be seen observing from a distance as our first landing site is established.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

progress.3.desc_09.zh:
我们的舰船想方设法，以惊人且优雅的姿态在[Root.GetName]上无数锯齿状的山峰中回旋，并成功降落在一个遮蔽山谷中的理想着陆点。

舰船已被改造成新居住地的行政基地，它的反应堆核心正在被拆除来用作殖民地的暂时能量来源。

数百个小帐篷和简易房环绕着星舰巨大的船体，殖民者开始大片大片地登陆——在这外星世界上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]之城。
progress.3.desc_09.en:
Our colony ship managed, with surprising grace, to maneuver between the massive peaks that are so prevalent in the jagged landscape of [Root.GetName]. It touched down in a sheltered valley that will serve as an ideal first landing site.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

progress.3.desc_10.zh:
我们的殖民船成功地在[Root.GetName]进行了行星着陆。数以千计的工作单元从货仓中涌出，开始建造一座初步的$building_deployment_post$以用作殖民地扩张。地表资源矿藏的编目仍在继续，着陆点附近的侵略性野生动物已经完成了无害化处理。

资源充足后，我们现在已经准备好在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上大规模生产更多的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]单元。我们的第一个殖民地大获成功。
progress.3.desc_10.en:
Our colony ship has successfully made planetfall on [Root.GetName]. Thousands of work units have emerged from the cargo bays to build an initial $building_deployment_post$ for settlement expansion. Efforts to catalog surface resource deposits continue, and aggressive wildlife near the landing site has been pacified.

We are now ready to mass-produce additional [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] units on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] as resources allow. Our first colony is a success.

progress.3.desc_11_droids.zh:
我们的殖民船降落在[Root.GetName]的地表。选择的着陆场气候温和且易于获取资源矿藏。

殖民船被改造成了一座$building_colony_shelter$用作指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数智能人陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
progress.3.desc_11_droids.en:
Our colony ship has touched down on the surface of [Root.GetName]. The landing site was chosen for its calm weather and accessible resource deposits.

The ship has been converted into a $building_colony_shelter$ to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Hundreds of prefab shelters have sprung up around the ship's hull as our droids disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

progress.3.desc_11_hive.zh:
我们的殖民船降落在[Root.GetName]的地表。选择的着陆场气候温和且易于获取资源矿藏。

殖民船被改造成了一座$building_colony_shelter$用作指挥中心，我们扩散到了船体周围，用任何能找到的材料搭建起了遮蔽物。这标志着在外星球上第一个分巢的诞生。
progress.3.desc_11_hive.en:
Our colony ship has touched down on the surface of [Root.GetName]. The landing site was chosen for its calm weather and accessible resource deposits.

The ship has been converted into a $building_colony_shelter$, and around its husk, we have spread, weaving shelters from whatever materials were available. This marks the birth of a new hive on an alien world.

progress.3.desc_lith.zh: 我们的降临对[planet.GetName]无异于一场大灾变。一股巨大的冲击波冲刷了这片没有生命的大陆，由于数百万吨的碎片被抛入大气层，[planet.GetName]的宜居性显著的下降了。我们的殖民者—被安全地包围在陨石的岩石核心—将很快从庇护处走出，并开始安装预制殖民地基础设施。
progress.3.desc_lith.en: Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased safely within the rocky core of the meteorite - will soon emerge and begin setting up prefabricated colonial infrastructure.

progress.3.egalitarian.zh: 如同我们的母星一般，平等将会塑造好这个殖民地。
progress.3.egalitarian.en: As on our homeworld, equality will shape this colony.

progress.3.gestalt_consciousness_hive.zh: 殖民地会与蜂巢一体化发展。
progress.3.gestalt_consciousness_hive.en: The colony grows as one with the Hive.

progress.3.gestalt_consciousness_machine.zh: 殖民地将会以最高效率执行功能。
progress.3.gestalt_consciousness_machine.en: The colony will function with perfect efficiency.

progress.3.materialist.zh: 科学的进展会推动我们的殖民地更进一步。
progress.3.materialist.en: Scientific progress will drive our colony forward.

progress.3.militarist.zh: 力量和警觉才能守护我们的未来。
progress.3.militarist.en: Strength and vigilance will secure our future.

progress.3.pacifist.zh: 我们的殖民地会在和平、和谐中繁荣昌盛。
progress.3.pacifist.en: Our colony will thrive in peace and harmony.

progress.3.spiritualist.zh: 我们的殖民地是崇高旨意的见证。
progress.3.spiritualist.en: Our colony is a testament to our higher purpose.

progress.3.xenophile.zh: 拥抱多样性可以让我们的殖民地更加强大。
progress.3.xenophile.en: Embracing diversity will strengthen our colony.

progress.3.xenophobe.zh: 我们殖民地将拥有纯洁与安全。
progress.3.xenophobe.en: Our colony will remain pure and protected.

progress.4.c.zh: 我们应该做好最坏的打算。

progress.4.desc.storm.zh:
寂静的太空对我们的呼唤做出了回应！这个与我们科技水平相当的外星文明，他们一定和我们在差不多的时候踏上了星海的征途。

他们的出现引领着一个全新的体验前言。他们会成为志趣相投的盟友，或是磨炼勇气的试金石？无论如何，未知的刺激正在召唤着我们前进。
progress.4.desc.storm.en:
Out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! An alien civilization with equivalent technology. They must have entered the galactic fray right around the time we did.

Their appearance heralds a new frontier of experience. Do they come as like minded allies, or rivals to test our mettle? Either way, the thrill of the unknown beckons us forward.

progress.4.desc_01.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这一发现确认了我们长久以来的怀疑——我们在星辰之间并不孤单。新的外星物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须保持警惕。

这些外星人的科技水平与我们类似，表明他们可能和我们大概在同一时期实现了太空旅行。
progress.4.desc_01.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.

These particular xenos have a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.

progress.4.desc_02.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在[Root.GetName]如野火般扩散开来。人们为此十分着迷，媒体充满了对其文化与组织形式的报导和推测。“我们在宇宙中并不孤单”这一真相引起了[Root.Capital.GetName]人民的欢呼。

和我们一样，这些外星人似乎也才刚刚登上星系的舞台，他们的科技水平与我们类似。
progress.4.desc_02.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The revelation that we are not alone in this galaxy has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Just like us, the aliens appear to be relative newcomers on the galactic stage and their level of technology is similar to our own.

progress.4.desc_03.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻在整个帝国产生了动乱。这些奇怪生物的录像泄露到了[Root.GetName]的媒体并迅速传播开来，许多人陷入了巨大的恐慌。[Root.Capital.GetName]数个城市发生了不安定事件。

这些奇怪外星人的科技水平似乎与我们类似，他们明显能够进行太空旅行。他们对我们这一伟大种群的态度是恐惧、仇恨还是冷漠，则无人知晓。
progress.4.desc_03.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The strange xenos appear to have achieved a level of technology similar to our own, and they are clearly spacefaring. Whether they regard our great species with fear, hatred or cold indifference is anyone's guess.

progress.5.desc.storm.gestalt.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了未开智生命形式。

我们兴奋与观察它们的潜力究竟到何等地步，但就目前为止它们仍然尚未开智。观察这些物种繁荣昌盛是一件再有趣不过的事情了。
progress.5.desc.storm.gestalt.en:
We have discovered pre-sapient lifeforms on [From.Planet.GetName].

We thrill to see what comes of their potential, but for now, they remain pre-sapient. It should be more than interesting to observe these creatures thrive.

progress.5.desc.storm.normal.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了未开智生命形式。我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]表示，“这些东西虽然看起来平平无奇，但蕴含着巨大的潜力！”

当然现在为止他们还是未开智的。观察这些物种繁荣昌盛是一件再有趣不过的事情了。
progress.5.desc.storm.normal.en:
We have discovered pre-sapient lifeforms on [From.Planet.GetName]. As one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] put it, "These things might not seem like much yet, but their potential is massive!"

For now however, they remain pre-sapient. It should be more than interesting to observe these creatures thrive.

progress.5.desc_01.zh:
我们与有智慧但未充分发展的外星文明正式接触的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这也明确了一件我们长久相信的事情，我们的星系中存在有从未考虑过探索他们行星以外世界的非太空文明外星人。

新的外形物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须谨慎。这些外星人的科技水平与我们相比十分原始，他们还没有实现太空旅行。我们必须决定如何与他们交流。
progress.5.desc_01.en:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms our long-held belief that there are non-space-faring aliens within our galaxy who may have never even considered exploring beyond their own planet.

Each species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary. The technological level of these particular aliens is low by our standards. They have not yet achieved space flight. We must decide how best to engage them going forward.

progress.5.desc_02.zh:
我们与有智慧但未充分发展的外星文明正式接触的新闻在[Root.GetName]如野火般扩散开来。人们为此十分着迷，媒体充满了对其文化和组织形式的报告和推测。“我们的星系中存在有从未考虑过探索他们行星以外世界的非太空文明外星人”这一真相引起了[Root.Capital.GetName]人民的欢呼。

我们的科技水平遥遥领先，他们还没有实现空间旅行。虽然在我们看来他们十分原始，但也许也有可以学习的地方。
progress.5.desc_02.en:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The confirmation that there are non-space-faring aliens within our galaxy who may have never even considered exploring beyond their own planet has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Our level of technology is far ahead of theirs. They have not yet developed space flight. Despite this, we could probably still learn much by studying them.

progress.5.desc_03.zh:
我们与有智慧但未充分发展的外星文明正式接触的新闻在深刻地动摇了整个社会。这些奇怪生物的录像泄露到了[Root.GetName]的媒体并迅速传播开来，许多人陷入了巨大的恐慌。[Root.Capital.GetName]数个城市发生了不安定事件。

原始落后的外星人在科技水平方面远远落后于我们，且尚未发展出太空旅行，祈祷永远没有那一天吧。
progress.5.desc_03.en:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

These aliens are far below our own level of technology. They have not yet developed space flight. For all our sakes, let us pray they never will.

progress.6.b.zh: 他们的智慧一定非常伟大。

progress.6.c.zh: 他们的时代已经结束。[Root.Species.GetName]的时代即将来临。
progress.6.c.en: Their age is over. The time of the [Root.Species.GetName] has come.

progress.6.desc.storm.zh: 从寂静的太空中，我们的呼唤得到了回应！但第一印象不太对劲，这些人和我们想法不同，他们更喜欢保守自己的秘密。我们目前最好保持距离。
progress.6.desc.storm.en: From out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! But the initial vibes are totally off; these people don't share our ways, and prefer to keep to themselves. We'd best back off for now.

progress.6.desc_01.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这一发现确认了我们长久以来的怀疑——我们在星系并不孤单。新的外星物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须保持警惕。

这些外星人似乎在星系舞台上十分活跃——貌似已有千年之久，科技水平远在我们之上。我们必须十分小心。
progress.6.desc_01.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.

These particular xenos appear to have been active on the galactic stage for some time - their empire is likely thousands of years old, and their technology is far ahead of our own. We should be careful when dealing with them.

progress.6.desc_02.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在[Root.GetName]如野火般扩散开来。人们为此十分着迷，媒体充满了对其文化和组织形式的报告和推测。“我们在星系并不孤单”这一真相引起了[Root.Capital.GetName]人民的欢呼。

这些外星人帝国似乎非常古老，他们的科技水平远在我们之上，一定可以教给我们许多知识。
progress.6.desc_02.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The revelation that we are not alone in this galaxy has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The empire these aliens have founded appears to be very old, and their level of technology is far ahead of our own. There is no doubt a great deal they could teach us.

progress.6.desc_03.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在整个帝国产生了动乱。这些奇怪生物的录像泄露到了[Root.GetName]的媒体并迅速传播开来，许多人陷入了巨大的恐慌。[Root.Capital.GetName]数个城市发生了不安定事件。

那些奇怪的外星人已发展出远高于我们的科技，似乎在几千年前就实现了空间旅行——可能还要更久。幸运的是，他们似乎是一个衰老与停滞的种群。
progress.6.desc_03.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The strange xenos have achieved a level of technology far beyond our own, and they appear to have been spacefaring for thousands of years - possibly even longer. Fortunately for us, their kind appear to be a decrepit and stagnating species.

progress.6.h.storm.en: They should get with the times.

progress.9.desc.default.zh: 和我们一样，这些外星人显然也是差不过刚刚步入宇宙的大舞台，他们的科技水平也同我们相近。
progress.9.desc.default.en: Just like us, the aliens appear to be relative newcomers on the galactic stage, and their level of technology is similar to our own.

progress.9.desc.fallen.zh: 这些外星人所创立的文明显然十分悠久，他们的科技水平将我们远远地甩在了身后。
progress.9.desc.fallen.en: The civilization these aliens have built appears to be very old, and their level of technology is far beyond our own.

progress.9.desc.friendly_friendly.zh: 他们的意图要比曾经作为我们主人的那些家伙要好太多了。或许我们只是在第一次同外星人遭遇的时候运气不太好。毕竟，宇宙这么大，总该有些好心肠。
progress.9.desc.friendly_friendly.en: Their intentions seem far more benign than those of our former masters. Perhaps we were just unfortunate with our first alien encounter. After all, there must be some good in the galaxy.

progress.9.desc.friendly_mean.zh: 尽管他们与我们的前主人不尽相同，但却一样地令人可憎。我们开除怀疑是不是星系中其他所有的文明全部都是一肚子坏水。至于想交朋友，我们还不如自己待着。
progress.9.desc.friendly_mean.en: They are so different from our former masters, and yet so alike in their reproachable behavior. It makes us wonder if perhaps all other civilizations in the galaxy are riddled with ill will and poor intentions. In terms of friendship, we may just be alone.

progress.9.desc.mean_friendly.zh: 他们与我们如此不同，却又如此和蔼可亲。我们好奇这或许就是宇宙中还存在着好外星人的征兆，在繁星之间终究还是存在着一些善良的心的。
progress.9.desc.mean_friendly.en: They are so different from us. Yet they are so amicable. We wonder if perhaps this is a sign that there can indeed be good xenos out there. There may be kindness among the stars after all.

progress.9.desc.mean_mean.zh: 他们可真不是宇宙中的什么好东西。我们以前没这么想真是太傻了！
progress.9.desc.mean_mean.en: There truly are no good xenos in the cosmos. It was foolish of us to think otherwise!

progress.9.desc.msi.zh: 我们知道，自己一定会再次找到曾经的主人。我们只是没有预料到会这么快就找到他们。
progress.9.desc.msi.en: We knew we were bound to find our former master again. We just weren't expecting to find them again so soon.

progress.9.desc.msi2.zh: 我们到底能不能逃离他们的魔爪？
progress.9.desc.msi2.en: Will we ever be free from their grasp?

progress.9.desc.preftl.zh: 我们的科技发展水平远远超过了这些外星人。他们尚未具备星际航行的能力。
progress.9.desc.preftl.en: Our technological development is far beyond that of these aliens. They have yet to become space-faring.

progress.9.desc.start.zh: 我们已经知道自己在宇宙中并非孤身一人。然而，我们却再次同另一个太空文明相遇了，这一事实让我们忧心忡忡。
progress.9.desc.start.en: We already knew we were not alone in the universe. Yet, we found our second contact with another space-faring civilization unsettling.

project_adakkaria_secrets_of.zh: 阿达卡利亚公约的秘密

proxy_war_busted_modifier.zh: 代理人战争准备遭曝光

psionic_battle_begin.en: The psionic battle will soon begin.

psionic_battle_outcome.en: The [winning_country.GetName] will serve as presidents of the [Root.GetAllianceName]

purchase_artifact.zh: 我们从[artifact_seller.GetName]那里购买了先驱者文物。
purchase_artifact.en: We purchase a Precursor artifact from the [artifact_seller.GetName].

quake_report_tooltip.en: The reports will be sent shortly.

rainbow_rivers_desc.zh:
[from.GetName]的初步扫描发现，遍流行星表面的荧光河不停地在整个光谱中变化。

进一步的研究会加深我们对这个异常自然现象的了解。
rainbow_rivers_desc.en:
Preliminary scans of [from.GetName] show fluorescent rivers flowing across the planet's surface that continuously shift through the full range of the color spectrum.

Further study will tell us more about this unusual phenomenon.

ransomeer_poi_desc.zh: 星际绑架者在一个废弃的外星开采站建立了一个基地。
ransomeer_poi_desc.en: The Ransomeers have made a home out of an abandoned alien mining station.

rebellion_operation_invalid_tooltip.zh: 这项行动因为帝国权威上升超过80而失败
rebellion_operation_invalid_tooltip.en: The operation failed due to Imperial Authority rising above 80.

rebooted_leaders.zh:
移除具有$leader_trait_hacked$特质领袖的所有负面特质。
每移除一项特质造成300经验值的损失。
rebooted_leaders.en:
Removes all Negative Traits from Leaders with the $leader_trait_hacked$ Trait.
For each Trait removed, 300 Experience will be lost.

recruit_trader_leader.zh: 将一位具有$councilor_enclave_trader$特质的[enclave_country.GetAdj]行政官加入领袖池中。
recruit_trader_leader.en: Adds a [enclave_country.GetAdj] Official with a $councilor_enclave_trader$ Trait to the Leaders pool.

拆散回收VIR的随机记忆库：
+2£minerals£
recycle_vir.en:
Scrap VIR's random access memory banks:
£minerals£ +2

refugees.1.desc.1.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesName]难民。他们被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
refugees.1.desc.1.en:
A flotilla of civilian transports carrying [Root.GetSpeciesName] refugees from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from their homes by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities. They have been traveling from system to system since then, in a desperate attempt to find new homes before the last of their dwindling supplies were used up.

refugees.1.desc.2.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的破败民用飞船到达了我们的领域，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]难民。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些狼狈恐慌的难民是逃离[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国肃清的幸存者。多亏了一些紧急召集起来的地面下的一伙和同情他们的商船舰长才逃了出来。
refugees.1.desc.2.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are survivors from the extermination program being carried out by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities against their species. They only made it out thanks to the efforts of a hastily organized underground railroad and a few sympathetic merchant skippers.

refugees.1.desc.2.b.zh:
一支的破败民船舰队，满载着逃离[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，已经抵达了我们的境内。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些狼狈恐慌的难民是[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj]无情攻势下的幸存者。多亏他们冒险从星球上一处旧军港里偷了几艘废弃太空船才逃了出来。
refugees.1.desc.2.b.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are survivors of onslaught carried out by the merciless [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj] mind. They only made it out thanks to a daring theft of several decommissioned spacefaring vessels stored in an old naval yard on their planet.

refugees.1.desc.3.zh:
一支伤痕累累的民用小舰队搭载着躲避[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，刚刚抵达了我们的星系。在我们提供食物与医疗救援之后，避难者们获准在[Root.Planet.GetName]上安家。

这些衣衫褴褛而且惊慌不已的避难者们正在躲避[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]星系内的[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName]的蹂躏。他们勉强在[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj]的攻势抵达其母星[RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName]之前仓皇逃了出来，将大部分个人财物都留在了那颗注定要覆灭的星球上。
refugees.1.desc.3.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are fleeing the ravages of the [RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName] in [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] space. They just barely managed to escape their home planet of [RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName] before the [RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj] onslaught reached it, leaving most of their personal possessions behind on the doomed world.

refurbishment_low_morale_2.zh: 搬迁导致严重的不满情绪

refurbishment_low_morale_3.zh: 搬迁导致不满情绪已达峰值

relentless_home_poi_desc.zh: 在远古的年代，无情者庞大的舰队在遇到一艘民用货船之后离开了这个恒星系。
relentless_home_poi_desc.en: The destination of the massive Relentless fleet which left this system many eons ago, after a strange run-in with a civilian freighter.

relentless_industrialists_policies_activ.zh: 我们现在可以在政策菜单中改变我们的$policy_relentless_industrialists_policy$。
relentless_industrialists_policies_activ.en: We can now alter our $policy_relentless_industrialists_policy$ Policy in the Policies Menu.

relentless_industrialists_situation_clea.zh:
我们的星球不再处于会变为死寂星球的危险之中。
我们的$building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$会需要一个极大的£unity£ 凝聚力维护费。
relentless_industrialists_situation_clea.en:
Our worlds will no longer be in danger of becoming Tomb Worlds.
Our $building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$ will gain a significant £unity£ Unity upkeep.

relentless_industrialists_situation_comp.zh:
[Target.GetName]会变成一个死寂星球。
根据我们采用的应对方案，会有进一步的效果逐渐发生。
relentless_industrialists_situation_comp.en:
[Target.GetName] will become a Tomb World.
Further effects may happen, depending on the Approach picked.

relentless_industrialists_situation_lock.zh: 现在更改局势的解决方案为时已晚。
relentless_industrialists_situation_lock.en: It is now too late to change our Approach to this Situation.

relicrails_digsite_desc.zh: 最近，[From.Planet.GetName]上的地陷将其地下的交通隧道网揭露了出来。这些精致的道路和复杂的信号设施已经深埋地下数百年；它们的设计与我们之前在这片太空区域所发现的一切均不相同。究竟是谁为了什么建造了它们呢？
relicrails_digsite_desc.en: Recent cave-ins on [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed a network of underground transportation tunnels. Its elaborate archways and complex signalling equipment have lain undiscovered for centuries; their design is unlike anything else we've encountered in this region of space. Who built it, and why?

remnants_of_court_of_blossoms.en: The Remnants of the Court of Blossoms

rendezvous_with_freighter_poi_desc.zh: 根据位于我们母星系的聚变引擎追迹的分析，此处便是古代无情者所在的最终目的地。
rendezvous_with_freighter_poi_desc.en: According to the analysis of the fusion drive trail in our home system, this is the destination of Relentless visitors of old.

requires_debris_field.zh: 我们目前没有宣称任何残骸场。
requires_debris_field.en: We have claims on at least one debris field.

requires_not_espionage_research_backdoor.zh: 我们每次只能执行一个后门操作。
requires_not_espionage_research_backdoor.en: We may only operate one such backdoor at a time.

requires_reclaimable_vessels.zh: 我们遇到了其他使用可打捞舰船设计的帝国。
requires_reclaimable_vessels.en: We have met other empires with salvageable ship designs.

resolution_galactic_focus_war_in_heaven_.zh: 焦点：谴责觉醒帝国双方

resolution_galactic_market_ban_sentient_.zh: 禁止交易有情感的奴隶

restoring_the_balance_tt.zh: 我们一个殖民地上的人口将会被送回$astral_rift_volcano$星界裂隙，以期能恢复被我们干扰的平衡。
restoring_the_balance_tt.en: Population from one of our colonies will been sent back into the $astral_rift_volcano$ Astral Rift, in an effort to restore the balance we have disrupted.

retarax_hunting_trophies.zh: 雷塔拉克斯狩猎战利品

reth_leader_catch_phrase.zh: 我要找下一个战利品！搞快点！

reth_leader_desc.zh: 一位疯狂的猎人，总在寻找更大的猎物。在被困入缇扬奇族母体内后，相信加入我们的行列能带去全新的体验。
reth_leader_desc.en: A fanatic hunter, always looking to surpass their last kill. After being trapped inside of a Tiyanki Matriarch, joining our cause should prove a refreshing experience.

rider_died_in_storm.zh: 风暴骑士在风暴中牺牲或失踪
rider_died_in_storm.en: Storm Riders Killed or MIA in Storms

rift_sphere_missing.zh: 我们没有获得必要的$tech_rift_sphere$科技去正确地开展我们的研究。
rift_sphere_missing.en: We do not possess the $tech_rift_sphere$ technology necessary to correctly carry on with our research.

riftworld_digsite_desc.zh: 我们在[Planet.GetName]地表上的撞击坑的极深处探测到了异常的地震活动。地下声呐发现了一座前所未知的洞穴。
riftworld_digsite_desc.en: We've detected anomalous seismic activity from deep inside an ancient crater on the surface of [Planet.GetName]. Underground sonar revealed a previously unknown cavity.

riftworld_leader_description.zh: [Root.GetName]被从星界裂隙的另一头带回来到我们的母行星附近，它也是平行时空里我们远古母星中的一员。
riftworld_leader_description.en: Brought back from beyond the Astral Rift near our home planet, [Root.GetName] is a member of our ancestral homeworld in a parallel dimension.

riggan_deal_in_place.zh: 我们已经拥有一项里甘协定。
riggan_deal_in_place.en: We already have a Riggan Deal.

ring_world_3_intermediate.zh: 已完成的环形世界区段

rubricator_coordinates_desc.zh: 誊录仪，一件蕴含有巨大能量的外星文物，这是它的最后已知坐标。
rubricator_coordinates_desc.en: The last known location of the Rubricator, an alien artifact of considerable power.

rubricator_digsite_desc.zh:
这颗星球上存在一个由一群沉迷于捡垃圾及囤垃圾的哺乳动物组成的社会。他们迷宫般的城市到处都是垃圾，高耸的建筑摇摇欲坠，由各种破烂拼成。目之所及尽是堆积成山的小摆件、饰品和手工艺品。

这些小家伙自己并不能生产任何东西，但他们精通太空旅行，他们可能从外人那里偷了不少用得着的东西，但同时也偷了不少没用的东西。
rubricator_digsite_desc.en:
This planet has played host to a mammalian society of compulsive gatherers and hoarders. Their labyrinthine city is littered with junk, their towering ramshackle buildings pieced together from scraps of re-purposed materials. As far as the eye can see are mountains of knick-knacks, ornaments and artifacts.

The tiny ratlike inhabitants did not produce any goods of their own but were proficient spacefarers who likely pilfered the things they needed, as well as a whole lot of things they did not need, from other alien cultures.

rubricator_dragon_desc.zh: 誊录仪被裂爪——那条巨龙守护着。我们只有击败她才能获得对这件遗珍的控制权。
rubricator_dragon_desc.en: The Rubricator is guarded by Shard, the dragon. She must be defeated before we can claim this powerful relic for our own.

rudari_death_laser_prototype.zh: 鲁达里死亡激光原型机

sable_pilot_desc.zh: 一名痴迷于速度、视其高于一切的飞行员。作为大奖赛的冠军，他们或许是星系中有史以来速度最快的统帅。
sable_pilot_desc.en: An obsessed pilot focusing on speed above all else. Champion of the Grand Circuit, they might be the quickest admiral to grace the galaxy.

sacred_site_breathvault_poi_desc.zh: 安息宝库，一座封存记忆的密室。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘察。
sacred_site_breathvault_poi_desc.en: The Breathvault, a sealed chamber of preserved memory. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

sacred_site_chasm_poi_desc.zh: 鸿沟，是先祖刻于岩壁之上的警示。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
sacred_site_chasm_poi_desc.en: The Chasm, a warning carved into rock by our ancestors. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

sacred_site_cradle_poi_desc.zh: 摇篮，我们信仰的神圣纽带。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
sacred_site_cradle_poi_desc.en: The Cradle, a sanctified conduit of our faith. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

sacred_site_emergence_poi_desc.zh: 显化之地，神圣之路的第一个路标。我们的朝圣之旅便始于此处。
sacred_site_emergence_poi_desc.en: Emergence, the first waypoint of the Sacred Path. Our pilgrimage began here.

sacred_site_eye_poi_desc.zh: 不眠之眼，祖传星图中记载的圣地。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
sacred_site_eye_poi_desc.en: The Eye, a sanctified location recorded in the Ancestral Star Charts. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

sacred_site_intelligence_poi_desc.zh: 智慧体，先祖留下的古老指引之力。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
sacred_site_intelligence_poi_desc.en: The Intelligence, an ancient guiding presence left behind by our ancestors. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

sacred_site_mirror_poi_desc.zh: 镜子，一场与无形倒影的神圣邂逅。我们在朝圣途中见证了它的存在。
sacred_site_mirror_poi_desc.en: The Mirror, a sanctified encounter with an unseen reflection. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

sacred_site_monastery_poi_desc.zh: 修道院，神圣之路的圣洁驿站。我们在朝圣途中对其进行了勘测。
sacred_site_monastery_poi_desc.en: The Monastery, a holy waypoint of the Sacred Path. We have surveyed it on our pilgrimage.

sadtoid_catch_phrase.zh: “生命是一种需要珍惜的东西。是一种罕见的意外，是一份珍贵的宝藏。让我们帮助生命的传播，让万物再次欣欣向荣。”
sadtoid_catch_phrase.en: "Life is something to cherish. A rare occurrence; a true treasure. Let us help it spread and bloom again."

salvager_insight_cooldown.zh: 我们已经拥有打捞者洞见修正。
salvager_insight_cooldown.en: We already have the Salvager Insight modifier.

salvager_overdrive_cooldown.zh: 我们只能在[root.salvager_overdrive_timer]之后再次购买这个。
salvager_overdrive_cooldown.en: We may only purchase this service again after [root.salvager_overdrive_timer].

salvager_reclaimed_vessel_cooldown.zh: 有舰船可以购买（新的库存预计[root.reclaimed_vessel_timer]到达）。
salvager_reclaimed_vessel_cooldown.en: Vessels are available for purchase (new stocks expected after [root.reclaimed_vessel_timer]).

salvager_scrap_fleet_cooldown.zh: 我们只能在[root.salvager_scrap_timer]之后才能再次购买这项服务。
salvager_scrap_fleet_cooldown.en: We may only purchase this service again after [root.salvager_scrap_timer].

salvager_tt_commissionsalvage.zh: 向打捞者下达任务，为我们调查残骸。我们会收到£engineering_research£ 研究和£alloys£ $alloys$。
salvager_tt_commissionsalvage.en: Task the Salvagers with investigating Debris for us. We will receive £engineering_research£ Research and £alloys£ $alloys$.

salvager_tt_reclaimedvessel.zh: 购买基于其他帝国设计的舰船。
salvager_tt_reclaimedvessel.en: Purchase ships based on designs used by other empires.

salvager_tt_salvageworks.zh: 购买一座独特的恒星基地建筑。

salvager_tt_scrapfleet.zh: 向打捞者下达任务，将一支我们选择的舰队转换回£alloys£ $alloys$。
salvager_tt_scrapfleet.en: Task the Salvagers with converting a fleet of our choosing back into £alloys£ $alloys$.

scientist_poi_1_desc.zh: 首席的科研船最后的已知地点，在[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系边界之外。
scientist_poi_1_desc.en: The last known location of the Chair's Science Ship, outside of the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system's borders.

scientist_poi_2_desc.zh: 根据他们传给[Root.Capital.GetName]的最后信息来看，这就是首席的目的地。
scientist_poi_2_desc.en: The Chair's destination, as per their last message to [Root.Capital.GetName].

scientist_poi_3_desc.zh:
碰巧的是，[Root.Capital.GetName]的一个远距离传感列阵检测到了疑似超光速旅行留下的微弱能源信号。

此路径与已知的任何航线均不匹配，很可能是首席科学官留下的。
scientist_poi_3_desc.en:
As luck would have it, a long-distance sensor array on [Root.Capital.GetName] picked up faint energy signatures that may or may not have resulted from FTL travel.

The trajectory does not match any known flight paths, making the Chair a likely suspect.

scientist_poi_4_desc.zh: 在破解了科研船原型机的特殊能源特征后，我们又进行了一些复杂的数学运算，终于知道首席逃到了哪个星系。
scientist_poi_4_desc.en: Having deciphered the prototype Science Ship's peculiar energy signatures and applied some fairly complex mathematics, we now know what system the Chair fled to.

scientist_poi_5_desc.zh: 看来首席快要到达他们的最终目的地了。
scientist_poi_5_desc.en: It seems the Chair is about to reach their final destination.

seeded_planet_3_modifier.zh: 摧枯拉朽的外星入侵植物

seeds_of_destruction_intro.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。冰晶布满了舰身的大部分，但我们还是很顺利地发现了气阀门……并开始搜索这艘船暗藏的秘密。
seeds_of_destruction_intro.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater. Glacial ice has inexorably spread across most of the ship, but we can easily access the airlock... and search for any secrets hidden behind it.

seek_enemies_tt.zh: 我们要提防[contact_empire.GetName]的敌意，我们在他们那的间谍网增长提升+33%。
seek_enemies_tt.en: We shall prepare for hostilities with the [contact_empire.GetName], giving us +33% Spy Network growth on them.

seek_enemies_tt_short.zh: 我们应当准备好应对[contact_empire.GetName]的敌对行动。
seek_enemies_tt_short.en: We shall prepare for hostilities with the [contact_empire.GetName].

seek_friends_tt.zh: 我们要与[contact_empire.GetName]寻求友好的关系。
seek_friends_tt.en: We shall seek friendly relations with the [contact_empire.GetName].

seek_isolation_tt.zh: 我们要设法与[contact_empire.GetName]保持距离，他们在我们这的间谍网增长-33%。
seek_isolation_tt.en: We shall seek to distance ourselves from the [contact_empire.GetName], giving them -33% Spy Network growth on us.

seek_isolation_tt_short.zh: 我们应当设法与[contact_empire.GetName]保持距离。
seek_isolation_tt_short.en: We shall seek to distance ourselves from the [contact_empire.GetName].

seize_precursor_artifact.zh: 宣称该文物归集体所有，让当地的人员把文物抢过来。
seize_precursor_artifact.en: Declare the artifact to be state property and have it seized by the local authorities.

send_storm_to_other_empire.zh: 向其他帝国发送的风暴

sentinel_fleet_gift.zh: 一艘哨兵舰船出现在[Root.Capital.GetName]附近，并交由你控制。
sentinel_fleet_gift.en: A Sentinel fleet appears near [Root.Capital.GetName] and is transferred over to your control.

sentinels_digsite_desc.zh:
这些巨型雕像矗立在[From.Planet.GetName]上，静静注视着什么。九个堪称不朽的雕像沿着漫长的边沿一一排开，位于这片区域的重要战略点，似乎在守护着它们中心的某种物品。

他们涂有精致的表面镀层，警觉的姿势好像时刻准备着战斗，不会移动的眼球也似乎紧随着你的每个动作，然而这里显然已经没有什么东西需要保护了。也许他们要保护的东西没能挨过岁月的流逝，又或是他们的任务早已失败。其上的累累伤痕表明，这些哨兵中的许多已经快要被物理损害彻底侵蚀了。
sentinels_digsite_desc.en:
Silent giants stand watch on [From.Planet.GetName]. Nine monumental statues placed along a wide perimeter at strategical points in the landscape appear to be guarding something at its center.

Their skin is covered in fine scale plating, their postures vigilant, ready to spring to action, and their unmoving eyes follow your every step. Yet there is nothing in the area in apparent need of protection. Perhaps their ward did not survive the passing of time. Many of the Sentinels themselves bear marks of assault.

set_situation_approach_icon_text.zh: 该选项将会改变我们对此局势的解决方案。
set_situation_approach_icon_text.en: This option will change your Approach to this Situation.

settlement_scuttle_arkships_effect_tt.zh: 所有剩余的$arkship_cap_plural$都将被凿沉，其人口将转移至[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]。
settlement_scuttle_arkships_effect_tt.en: All remaining $arkship_cap_plural$ are scuttled and their populations transferred to [event_target:settled_planet.GetName].

shard_wants_to_burn_this_planet_tooltip.zh: 我们在[FromFromFrom.Planet.GetName]上的居民危在旦夕。
shard_wants_to_burn_this_planet_tooltip.en: Our colonists on [FromFromFrom.Planet.GetName] are in grave danger.

shearing_force_desc.zh:
释放到[from.GetName]大气层中的探测器停止了一切通讯。我们失去了该硬件的行踪。

需要对该行星进行近距离调查才能取回这些数据。
shearing_force_desc.en:
Observation probes deployed into the atmosphere of [from.GetName] have ceased all communications. The exact location of our hardware is now unknown.

A closer investigation of the planet is needed to recover the data.

ship_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 传感器显示，我们在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气内短暂探测到了一艘中型飞船。
ship_gasgiant_category_desc.en: The sensor profile of a mid-sized vessel was briefly detected inside the upper atmosphere of this gas giant.

shipyard_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 此世界的上方静静地飘着一座远古轨道船坞。它在战争中严重受损，多个部位缺失。
shipyard_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: An ancient orbital shipyard drifts in silence above this world. It has suffered significant battle damage, and entire sections of the facility are missing.

shroud.10.b.en: We do not need its help.

shroud.10.b.tt.zh: 我们不会再有请求塑师帮忙击败塞塔娜的机会。
shroud.10.b.tt.en: We will never get another chance to request the Animator's help in defeating Cetana.

shroud.10.desc.zh:
$shroud.10.desc.intro$

并不只有我们在观察她。在一个隐蔽而优势的位置上，一个叫做$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$的实体也俯瞰着，无惧女王无尽的力量。

$shroud.10.desc.outro$
shroud.10.desc.en:
$shroud.10.desc.intro$

We are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, the entity known as $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$ watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.

$shroud.10.desc.outro$

shroud.10.desc.1.zh:
$shroud.10.desc.intro$

并不只有我们在观察她。在一个隐蔽而优势的位置上，$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$也悄然俯瞰着，无惧女王无尽的力量。

$shroud.10.desc.outro$
shroud.10.desc.1.en:
$shroud.10.desc.intro$

We are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$ watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.

$shroud.10.desc.outro$

shroud.1015.desc.default.zh: $shroud.1015.desc.intro$现在我们需要考虑在何处开展下一阶段的研究。
shroud.1015.desc.default.en: $shroud.1015.desc.intro$ We must now consider the area in which to conduct the next phase of research.

shroud.1015.desc.escaped.zh: $shroud.1015.desc.intro$最近的对囚犯的批量处决为[Root.GetResearchers]提供了大量实验材料，进而带来了一项技术突破。
shroud.1015.desc.escaped.en: $shroud.1015.desc.intro$ The recent series of mass prisoner executions has given our [Root.GetResearchers] plenty of material for a new technological breakthrough.

shroud.1015.engineering_reward.zh: 获得一项随机£engineering£$ENGINEERING$科技的洞见。
shroud.1015.engineering_reward.en: Gain insight in a random £engineering£ $ENGINEERING$ technology.

shroud.1015.physics_reward.zh: 获得一项随机£physics£$PHYSICS$科技的洞见。
shroud.1015.physics_reward.en: Gain insight in a random £physics£ $PHYSICS$ technology.

shroud.1015.society_reward.zh: 获得一项随机£society£$SOCIETY$科技的洞见。
shroud.1015.society_reward.en: Gain insight in a random £society£ $SOCIETY$ technology.

shroud.1105.a.tt.en: Half of the $job_test_subject_plural$ on [root.GetName] will depart as refugees.

shroud.1105.b.zh: 暂停所有运营活动，直至找到他们。
shroud.1105.b.en: Shut down operations until we can find them.

shroud.1105.c.en: Execute those that remain as an example.

shroud.1105.c.tt.en: All of the $job_test_subject_plural$ on [root.GetName] will be lost.

shroud.1105.desc.escaped.zh: 此类事件一再发生，需要对此做出坚决的应对以防止类似事件重演。我们此前在这一问题上的仁慈，反倒似乎成了对于剩余个体的鼓励。
shroud.1105.desc.escaped.en: Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses. Our previous leniency on this issue seems to have served as encouragement to the remaining population.

shroud.1105.desc.intro.zh:
一大批高价值实验对象借助挖掘的隧道从[root.GetName]上的一座设施内逃了出来。

这条隧道是用简陋的工具和赤裸的 [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] 挖掘而成，必定耗费了多年时间。我们无法确定有多少人知晓它的存在，也不清楚为什么这么长时间也没人能发现。
shroud.1105.desc.intro.en:
A number of our valuable test subjects have fled from a facility on [root.GetName] via a makeshift escape tunnel.

Fashioned using improvised tools and bare [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], the tunnel must have taken years to build. We cannot be sure how many knew of its existence, and how it remained undetected for so long.

shroud.1105.desc.outro.zh: 此类事态发展需要采取坚决措施，以防止此类事件再次发生。
shroud.1105.desc.outro.en: Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses.

shroud.11110.desc.zh:
低语尖锐地变化着，祂们的声音覆盖了脑海中的一切。祂们渴望与我们交流，向我们灌输知识。

我们必须做出不可改变的选择。
shroud.11110.desc.en:
The Whisperers shift piercingly, their voices obscuring all else within our minds. They are eager to commune with us, to crowd our minds with knowledge.

We have an irrevocable choice to make.

shroud.11120.a.zh: 我们必须做好自卫的准备。
shroud.11120.a.en: We must prepare to defend ourselves.

shroud.11120.a.tt.zh:
[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]转变成了一颗$pc_shrouded$。
该行星附近出现了一个$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$。
shroud.11120.a.tt.en:
[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName] turns into a $pc_shrouded$.
A $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ appears near this planet.

shroud.11120.desc.zh:
随着[GetTelepathPlural]们浮出虚境，我们发现自己的背叛引来了[GetBetrayedPatronColour]的强力反噬。

[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]附近出现了一道$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$，而它现在也变成了一片无尽废墟的荒芜。我们在隧道的另一头[GetFeltLoc]到了显而易见的愤怒；前超主毫无疑问正在准备复仇。
shroud.11120.desc.en:
As our [GetTelepathPlural] emerged from the Shroud, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].

A $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ has emerged near [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName], which is now a world of endless wastes. We have [GetFeltLoc] a palpable fury beyond the tunnel; our former patron is no doubt preparing its revenge.

shroud.11130.desc_common.zh: 一个$NAME_Psionic_Avatar$从[event_target:spawn_system.GetName]恒星系的$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$上出现。这是[GetBetrayedPatronColour]之怒的显化，现在正向[capital_scope.GetName]袭来。
shroud.11130.desc_common.en: A $NAME_Psionic_Avatar$ has emerged from the $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ in the [event_target:spawn_system.GetName] system. A manifestation of the wrath of [GetBetrayedPatronColour], it is now traveling in the direction of [capital_scope.GetName].

shroud.11130.desc_success.zh: 我们成功地召集了力量反击出现的威胁。我们的舰船向$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$中放出灵能能量波，在敌意实体穿入本现实时削弱了它。
shroud.11130.desc_success.en: We were successful in gathering our forces against the emerging threat. Our ships emitted waves of psionic energy into the $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$, weakening the hostile entity as it breached into our reality.

shroud.11225.desc.mitigated.zh:
$shroud.11225.desc.common_1$似乎我们抗击光环的努力起到了一些缓和作用，尽可能保留了一点。

$shroud.11225.desc.common_2$
shroud.11225.desc.mitigated.en:
$shroud.11225.desc.common_1$ It seems our efforts to repel the aura have had some mitigating effects, preserving what little we could.

$shroud.11225.desc.common_2$

shroud.11235.desc.zh:
我们的[GetScientistPlural]完成了对称为$NAME_Reckoning$的强大实体的全面研究。

基于目前发现，我们确定出了以现有科技面对该敌手的方法；用于击穿能量护盾的武器稍加改造即可用于削弱构成$NAME_Reckoning$的能量。

尽管它非常强大，但我们现在面对该威胁时也不是毫无希望了。
shroud.11235.desc.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have completed thorough research on the powerful entity known as the $NAME_Reckoning$.

Based on their findings, we have determined an effective method of confronting this foe with our existing technology; the energy that comprises the $NAME_Reckoning$ can be degraded using a modified form of weaponry designed to pierce energy shields.

Though it is formidable, we now stand a better chance of engaging this threat.

shroud.11240.desc.zh:
$NAME_Reckoning$拥有我们舰队远不能敌的强大力量。尽管我们战败了，与这个神秘的能量生物交锋也产出了宝贵的数据——这些一手资料只能通过直接接触获得。

初步分析表明，我们已经获得了足够用于对该实体的构成进行建模的数据点。通过进一步研究，我们就能尝试分析出它的弱点，据此来改进我的进攻方式。
shroud.11240.desc.en:
The $NAME_Reckoning$ is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.

Preliminary analysis indicates that we have gathered enough data points to model the entity's composition. With further research, we can try to identify its vulnerabilities and hone our attacks accordingly.

shroud.11245.desc.1.zh: 在研究被称为$NAME_Reckoning$的实体的过程中我们的[GetScientistPlural]取得了突破。
shroud.11245.desc.1.en: Our [GetScientistPlural] have made a breakthrough in their research concerning the energy being known as the $NAME_Reckoning$.

shroud.11245.desc.2.non_psionic.zh: $shroud.11245.desc.2.intro$来自另一个维度，更通过维持神秘的跨维度链接来维系其防御能力。$shroud.11245.desc.2.outro$
shroud.11245.desc.2.non_psionic.en: $shroud.11245.desc.2.intro$ another dimension of reality, but maintains its defensive power via a mysterious transdimensional link. $shroud.11245.desc.2.outro$

shroud.11245.desc.2.psionic.zh: $shroud.11245.desc.2.intro$从虚境中显现而来，更通过与灵能界之间维持跨维度链接来维系其防御能力。$shroud.11245.desc.2.outro$
shroud.11245.desc.2.psionic.en: $shroud.11245.desc.2.intro$ the Shroud, but maintains its defensive power via a transdimensional link to the psionic realm. $shroud.11245.desc.2.outro$

shroud.11250.desc.zh:
我们陷入出神时，意识卡入了寂静。我们从未见过如此死寂的虚境。

虚空无声。

万物皆灭。
shroud.11250.desc.en:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.

shroud.11255.desc.zh: 自从$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$带来毁灭之后，我们付出了巨大的努力进行重建。为此，我们在[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]系重建了一座$starbase_outpost$，这标志着[owner.GetName]的一个新的开始。
shroud.11255.desc.en: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. To this end, we have rebuilt an $starbase_outpost$ in the [solar_system.Star.GetStarName] system, marking a new beginning for the [owner.GetName].

shroud.11260.desc.zh: 自从$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$带来毁灭之后，我们付出了巨大的努力进行重建。在将幸存者集结于一艘仓促建造的方舟舰上之后，我们便启程，为[Root.GetName]缔造一个新的开始。
shroud.11260.desc.en: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. Gathering our survivors aboard a hastily assembled Arkship, we set out to forge a new beginning for the [Root.GetName].

shroud.12010.a.zh: 我们听到了$the_cradle_of_souls_article$的。你为什么这么问？
shroud.12010.a.en: We have heard $the_cradle_of_souls_article$. Why do you ask?

shroud.12010.a.response.zh: 为什么？你说，旅行者为什么要向路上遇见的人提问？当然是为了理解他们所问的人，朋友。你在多嘴时，我在虚心学习。
shroud.12010.a.response.en: Why? What compels any wayfarer to question those they meet along the path? To better understand the one they seek an answer from, friend. When you speak, I learn.

shroud.12010.b.zh: 你想要从我们这里得到什么？
shroud.12010.b.en: What do you want from us?

shroud.12010.b.response.zh: 受月窠哺育之人，所求为何？ 首先，我寻觅的是你的友谊。 我已寻觅了一个时代，只为找到与月窠的辉煌相契合的心灵。 如今，一个完整的文明在其光芒中萌动。
shroud.12010.b.response.en: What do those nurtured by the Cradle long for? I seek your friendship, to begin with. I have searched an age for minds attuned to the Cradle's splendor, and now, a whole civilization stirs within its light.

shroud.12010.c.response.zh: 我将帮助你把讯息传遍星海。让我们携手，迎接整个星系进入月窠的温柔怀抱。
shroud.12010.c.response.en: I will help carry your message across the stars. Together, let us welcome the galaxy into the Cradle's gentle embrace.

shroud.12010.desc.zh:
我们与虚境的共鸣引来了一个向我们示好的新声音。它温暖、抚慰的语调在物质与精神领域同时回响。

问候。我是甘图亚塔，前来寻找那些觉醒于真道的同路人。你可曾听闻$the_cradle_of_souls_article$的启示？
shroud.12010.desc.en:
Our communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.

Greetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded individuals who have awoken to the true path. Have you heard the message of $the_cradle_of_souls_article$?

shroud.12010.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $ganthuata$作为一名领袖加入我们帝国。
shroud.12010.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $ganthuata$ joins our empire as a Leader.

shroud.12020.a.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
shroud.12020.a.en: Why do you wish to join us?

shroud.12020.a.response.zh: 我们携手便能扼住星海每个角落的星辰。单凭一己之力能播撒的苦难终究有限。
shroud.12020.a.response.en: Together we can choke the stars in every corner of this galaxy. There is only so much suffering one can sow on their own.

shroud.12020.b.response.zh: $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$主宰着我的每一次呼吸。我宣誓效忠于它，并已在梦中预见此刻。侍奉您正是它的意志。若遭拒绝，我的命运便将终结。
shroud.12020.b.response.en: $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$ commands my every breath. I am sworn to its service, and have seen this moment in my dreams. It is its will that I serve you. Your rejection would seal my fate.

shroud.12020.c.response.zh: 我曾遭人背叛，支离破碎，被抛入痛苦的深渊。$the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$向我低语。它赐予我绝境求生所需之物——染血的布条覆上淋漓的伤口。它赋予我斩断施虐之手的权能。如今，我欠下了这笔血债。
shroud.12020.c.response.en: I was betrayed, broken, and cast into agony. $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$ spoke to me. It blessed me with what was needed to survive in that moment... a bloodied cloth over bloodied wounds. It gave me the power to sever the hands that wrought my suffering. Now, I am in its debt.

shroud.12020.d.response.zh: 我们将一同以涤荡之火洗礼无数星系，在哀嚎交响曲中喰饮饕餮盛宴。我们将目睹世界焚毁，一同向星海展示它永世难忘之景。此乃吾等宿命。
shroud.12020.d.response.en: Together, we will bathe countless systems in cleansing flames, and feast on a symphony of screams. We will watch worlds burn. Together, we will show the galaxy things it can never forget. This is our destiny.

shroud.12020.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $koborokra$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
shroud.12020.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $koborokra$ joins our empire as a Leader.

shroud.12030.a.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
shroud.12030.a.en: Why do you wish to join us?

shroud.12030.a.response.zh: $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$永不满足。祂需要许多双[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]的劳作才能取悦祂。
shroud.12030.a.response.en: $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$ is quenchless. It requires the work of many [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] to please it.

shroud.12030.b.response.zh:
我可以帮你提取自然界中每一个有利可图的分子。每一个原子都会被认领、标记、贩卖。

知足就是懦弱。真是可悲。让那些人腐烂吧，让我们一起征服一切。
shroud.12030.b.response.en:
I can help you extract every last monetizable molecule nature possesses. Not a single atom will go unclaimed, unbranded, or unsold.

Those who whisper 'enough' are cowards. Pathetic. Let them rot. Together we will take it all.

shroud.12030.c.response.zh:
我曾经是一名勘探者，追逐着繁星能给予的一切矿物。灰尘弥漫的空气，坏掉的扫描仪，空洞的声明……然后$the_instrument_of_desire_article$开口了。

祂承诺带来难以想象的财富，所要求的只是忠诚。

如今我效忠、提取、供奉。债务是永恒的……但是财富？财富永无止境。
shroud.12030.c.response.en:
I was once a prospector, chasing every mineral rush the stars could throw at me. Dust-choked air, broken scanners, empty claims... until $the_instrument_of_desire_article$ spoke.

It promised wealth beyond comprehension. All it asked for was allegiance.

Now I serve. I extract. I deliver. The debt is eternal... but the riches? Oh, the riches never end.

shroud.12030.desc.zh:
$morr$的眼光永远在扫视着，在光影之间游离，如同永恒的狩猎一般。

你也感受到了，对吧？$the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$永恒变化。它渴望着、吞噬着、命令着。

我会夺走所见的一切。大自然的一切馈赠都逃不过我。我为你服务，不是出于忠诚，而是因为我们可以一起扫清群星，填补应有的虚空。
shroud.12030.desc.en:
$morr$'s gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.

You feel it too, don't you? $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$ is never still. It craves. It devours. It commands.

What I see, I take. No bounty of nature has withstood my will. I offer you my service, not out of loyalty, but because together, we can raze the stars and feed the void its due.

shroud.12030.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $morr$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
shroud.12030.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $morr$ joins our empire as a Leader.

shroud.12040.a.response.zh: 为何，当然是蜕变了。抛弃这些粗糙、不完美的躯壳。解开将我们束缚于形态、束缚于确定的丝缕。织缕之主的刻印也在你身上。你早已开始……难道没感觉到它在你的[GetSkinType]下悸动吗？
shroud.12040.a.response.en: Why, the shedding, of course. The discarding of these crude, imperfect husks. The unweaving of the strands that bind us to shape, to certainty. The Composer's touch is upon you, too. You've already begun... haven't you felt it twitching beneath your [GetSkinType]?

shroud.12040.b.en: Why do you want to join us?

shroud.12040.b.response.zh: 你感受不到吗？那印记，深烙在每一根颤动的丝缕中。我必须拆解自身，褪去旧我，见证自我崩解的过程，撕开缝合血肉的针脚。但你……你是一个帝国。浩瀚无垠。无所不能。若我们联手，便能牵动远超你我独自所能企及的宏大脉络。
shroud.12040.b.response.en: You don't feel it? The mark, pressed into every trembling strand. I must unravel, shed what I was, witness my unbecoming as I tear free the stitches that bind me to flesh. But you... you are an empire. Vast. Capable. Together, we could tug at threads far greater than either of us could grasp alone.

shroud.12040.c.response.zh: 我所给予的不只是帮助。我的血肉是一份礼物，一场关于痛苦与意义的实验，由$the_composer_of_strands_article$亲手雕琢。我的每一寸纤维都在嘶吼，但我承受着。我研究。我学习。而我所有苦难的结晶……皆由你来塑造。只要我们共同塑造它。
shroud.12040.c.response.en: I offer more than help. My flesh is a gift, an experiment in pain and purpose, sculpted by $the_composer_of_strands_article$. Every fiber of me screams, but I endure. I study. I learn. And all that my suffering yields... is yours to shape. So long as we shape it together.

shroud.12040.desc.zh:
当我们的敏感器侦测到一艘飞船正突破边界时，一个紧绷的声音回荡在虚境——疲惫、尖锐，却带着令人不安的熟悉感，如同$the_composer_of_strands_article$的低鸣。

新生的……[GetKronenFlesh]？有趣。如此柔软。如此……可塑。还是说并非如此？难以断言。无数扭结在[GetKronenSkin]之下蠕动。今日$the_composer_of_strands_article$为我编织了何等形态？

通讯终于稳定，显露出一个由原生蠕动的肌肉构成的身影——痉挛着，癫狂书写。

你目睹了我的本相。或许我仍是$kronen$，或许已非。但我能感知你，如我一般，是铺展在织缕之主笔下的画布。来吧。让我们开始揭幕。
shroud.12040.desc.en:
As our sensors detect a vessel breaching our borders, a strained voice echoes across the Shroud - tired, shrill, yet disturbingly familiar, like the hum of $the_composer_of_strands_article$.

New... [GetKronenFlesh]? Intriguing. So soft. So... mutable. Or is it? Hard to say. So many knots shifting beneath the [GetKronenSkin]. What form has $the_composer_of_strands_article$ spun for me today?

The comms finally stabilize, revealing a figure of raw, shifting muscle - convulsing, scribbling frantically.

You see me, as I am. Perhaps I am still $kronen$. Perhaps not. But I feel you, like me, a canvas stretched for the Composer's brush. Come. Let us begin the unveiling.

shroud.12040.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $kronen$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
shroud.12040.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $kronen$ joins our empire as a Leader.

shroud.12045.a.response.zh: 问题？单数？哈，多么天真。我每撕去一丝，我们每扯断一缕闪亮的细线，那些丝线只会缠得更紧！而自始至终，$the_composer_of_strands_article$都在哼唱着它那令人作呕、直击内脏的旋律……
shroud.12045.a.response.en: Problem? Singular? Oh, how quaint. Every shred I slough away, every glistening strand we tear, the threads only tighten! And all the while, $the_composer_of_strands_article$ hums its sickening, visceral melody...

shroud.12045.b.response.zh: 休息？不，永不。我们绝不能停滞不前，绝不能让这具可悲的肉体在平庸中腐朽。我不需要休息……我需要实验对象。需要可塑的材料，需要雕琢的素材，需要蜕变的根基。
shroud.12045.b.response.en: A break? No, never. We must not stagnate, must not let this wretched flesh rot in mediocrity. I don't need rest... I need subjects. I need material to mold, to sculpt, to become.

shroud.12045.c.en: Can we do anything to help?

shroud.12045.c.response.zh:
你能提醒我……我曾是什么模样吗？告诉我，当我们初次交谈时，我的肢体始终是这种颜色吗？我的角膜曾这般浑浊吗？每当试图回忆，我的血肉就在这条路上陷得更深。

不……记忆在此毫无价值。启示藏于变化本身。对$the_composer_of_strands_article$而言，过往已毫无意义。退下吧。我必须……思考。
shroud.12045.c.response.en:
Can you remind me... what I was? Tell me, when we first spoke, were my appendages always this color? Was my cornea ever this clouded? Each time I try to remember, my flesh shifts further along the path.

No... memory has no value here. Revelation lies in the change itself. What came before means nothing to $the_composer_of_strands_article$ now. Leave me. I must... think.

shroud.12045.d.response.zh:
当然。我为何不该如此？这些丝缕进一步开拓了我的思维，将这具低效的血肉之躯重塑，以更契合$the_composer_of_strands_article$的设计。现在，请恕我失陪……还有如此多的线头需要梳理。如此多的躯壳亟待抛弃。

当通讯终止时，一阵共鸣在虚境中嗡鸣。无论此刻笼罩克罗南的灾厄为何……都绝非偶然。此乃$the_composer_of_strands_article$的意志
shroud.12045.d.response.en:
Of course. Why wouldn't I be? The strands have opened my mind even further, reshaped this inefficient flesh to better fit $the_composer_of_strands_article$'s design. Now, if you'll excuse me... there are still so many threads to pull. So many husks to leave behind.

As the transmission ends, a resonance hums across the Shroud. Whatever affliction grips Kronen now... it is no accident. It is the will of $the_composer_of_strands_article$.

shroud.12045.desc.zh:
随着人群开始肿胀，$kronen$变得愈发狂躁。他们的声音因紧绷而颤抖，形体抽搐、波动，血肉在剧变中翻腾，发出挫败的嘶吼。

那些丝线，无穷无尽……它们扭动着，我拉扯，我撕扯，可编织纹丝不动！这具可憎的皮囊我还要忍受多久？还要剥落多少层，才能窥见其中真谛？
shroud.12045.desc.en:
As our population swells, $kronen$ grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.

The strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How much longer must I endure this wretched shape? How much more must I shed before the pattern reveals itself?

shroud.12045.end.zh: 织缕之主的馈赠不可等闲视之。
shroud.12045.end.en: A gift from the Composer should not be taken lightly.

shroud.12050.a.zh: 为什么你觉得你可以帮得上忙？
shroud.12050.a.en: What makes you think you can help?

shroud.12050.a.response.zh:
你已突破虚境的帷幕，不是吗？但告诉我，你可曾真正掌控它？我穷尽一生勘测其深渊，绘制其中不可名状的实体轨迹，以及它们在我们脆弱世界的回响。

低语之主始终指引着我。那些如今充斥你思维的癫狂呢喃？我能助你理解它们。
shroud.12050.a.response.en:
You've pierced the veil of the Shroud, haven't you? But tell me, have you mastered it? I have spent a lifetime charting its depths, mapping the unfathomable drift of its entities and their echoes upon our fragile realm.

The Whisperers have long guided me. Every maddening utterance now crowding your thoughts? I can help you understand them.

shroud.12050.b.zh: 你对于低语之主有何了解？
shroud.12050.b.en: What do you know of the Whisperers?

shroud.12050.b.response.zh: 多年来，我一直在记录祂的低语，等待的就是这一刻。如今你已与他们纷繁的合唱同频共振，我绝不会浪费这个机会，去挖掘深埋其中的真相。
shroud.12050.b.response.en: I have catalogued their whispers for years, waiting for this very moment. Now you are aligned with their manifold chorus, and I will not waste this chance to glean the truths buried within.

shroud.12050.c.response.zh:
毕生的钻研磨砺出我的专注，让我得以解析物质现实的构造与虚境那无垠的深渊。

我们将共同突破此位面的桎梏。宇宙的奥秘终将被我们揭开。我以绝对的确定性向你们承诺。
shroud.12050.c.response.en:
A lifetime of study has honed my focus, unraveling the structures of our physical reality and the boundless depths of the Shroud.

Together, we will break free from the limits of this plane. The secrets of the universe will be ours to uncover. That, I promise, with absolute certainty.

shroud.12050.desc.zh:
通讯阵列突然刺啦作响，一个声音带着诡异的紧迫感低语道。

向你致意，同频的聆听者。我在喧嚣中听见了你的声音——不，是*众声*。你现在也听见它们了吧？$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$的宏大合唱，他们窃窃私语的馈赠，他们呢喃的癫狂？

此等奥秘对无力参悟之人尤为凶险。但我可助你抽丝剥茧。当你面对撕扯思维的悖论洪流时，我愿施以援手。无意冒犯。曾几何时，就连我也难以参透其真意。
shroud.12050.desc.en:
The communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.

Greetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus of $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$, their hushed gifts, their murmured hysteria?

Such secrets are perilous to those who cannot comprehend them. But I can help you unravel them. I offer my aid as you face the overwhelming flood of paradoxes clawing at your thoughts. No insult meant. Once, even I struggled to understand their true meanings.

shroud.12050.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $zulyn$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
shroud.12050.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $zulyn$ joins our empire as a Leader.

shroud.12060.a.zh: 你知晓$end_of_the_cycle_article$的存在有多久了？
shroud.12060.a.en: How long have you known of $end_of_the_cycle_article$?

shroud.12060.a.response.zh: 比我的意识更为久远。与所有心智一样，知识沉睡不显，直至虚境揭开面纱。其纯粹意图便在此刻昭然若揭。我们的目的很简单：引领终焉降临
shroud.12060.a.response.en: Longer than I've been conscious. As with all minds, the knowledge lies dormant, until the Shroud peels back the veil. There, its pure intent becomes clear. Our purpose is simple: to usher in the end

shroud.12060.b.zh: 你为什么想要帮助我们？
shroud.12060.b.en: Why do you want to help us?

shroud.12060.b.response.zh: 你问的正是你已知之事。我们都已目睹其必然性。崩解已然开始。唯有前行，别无他途。我们一同盘旋，终将抵达结局。
shroud.12060.b.response.en: You ask what you already know. We have both seen its inevitability. The unraveling has begun. There is no path but through. Together, we spiral toward conclusion.

shroud.12060.c.response.zh: 在这衰亡的轮回中，我不过是尘埃，众生皆是如此。我还能真正给予什么？意识正从这个星系中消逝，而我被赋予的职责是引导它们迅速离去……现在，我将这份仁慈也赐予你。
shroud.12060.c.response.en: I am but dust in this dying cycle, as are we all. What could I truly offer? Minds fade from this galaxy and I am tasked with guiding them swiftly... and I extend that mercy to you.

shroud.12060.desc_1.zh:
我们的通讯阵列被一阵难以理解的信号狂潮淹没。在这片混沌中，一个声音开始穿透而出。

终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。
shroud.12060.desc_1.en:
An incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.

At last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we call reality. The offering has been made. My path is clear.

shroud.12060.desc_2.zh: 得了吧，别害羞。我知道你已窥见$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$那超凡的简洁。与我一同共鸣，我们将共同促使它显现。
shroud.12060.desc_2.en: Come now, don't be shy. I know you've glimpsed the sublime simplicity of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. Join me in communion, and together we shall compel its emergence.

shroud.12060.desc_blind.zh: 我们这才意识到：与我们一样，这个存在也为最光辉的灭绝事业献出了自己的视力。
shroud.12060.desc_blind.en: It is then we realize: like us, this being has surrendered their sight in service to the cause.

shroud.12060.desc_default.zh: 这时我们才注意到，此人的眼窝空空如也，早已被摈弃。
shroud.12060.desc_default.en: It is then we notice, their eye sockets are empty, long since abandoned.

shroud.12060.hire_custom_tooltip.zh: $ouwron$作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
shroud.12060.hire_custom_tooltip.en: $ouwron$ joins our empire as a Leader.

shroud.12155.desc.zh:
凡行皆有果报。当我们的通讯阵列炽然苏醒，$ouwron$便挟着正义的怒火倾泻而出。

异端！愚者！欺世之徒！我们早该知晓。早在你那污秽的本质胆敢踏入虚境之时，就该将你诛灭。

你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。

唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！
shroud.12155.desc.en:
All actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, $ouwron$ bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the Shroud.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!

shroud.12160.desc.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已通过一项议案，将我方列为军事目标。所有[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员如今都与[this.GetName]处于战争状态。我们必须准备好随时迎接他们的舰队进攻。
shroud.12160.desc.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed a resolution declaring us a military target. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are now at war with the [this.GetName]. We can expect their fleets to strike at any moment.

shroud.1510.desc.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内我们的$PSIONIC_AURA$正在与来自附近[fromfrom.GetName]恒星系的敌对光环进行激烈斗争。我们的灵能[GetResearchers]曾对这种行为进行过建模，但这是我们第一次获得这种现象的一手资料。

理论上来说，越强的光环——就是说投射的强度越大——将会逐渐驱散敌对力量。如果这种斗争导致一方完败，占主导地位的光环可能就会流入空出来的恒星系。

这真是字面意义上的“灵魂的碰撞”。
shroud.1510.desc.en:
Our $PSIONIC_AURA$ in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced the phenomenon firsthand.

According to theory, the more potent Aura - that which is projected with a greater intensity - will gradually diminish the opposing force. Should this struggle lead to absolute decay, the prevailing Aura may flow into the vacant system.

It is a true battle of the minds.

shroud.1550.desc.default.zh:
$shroud.1550.desc_1.default$

$shroud.1550.desc.common_2$乃至我们的盟友，还能削弱对手。
shroud.1550.desc.default.en:
$shroud.1550.desc_1.default$

$shroud.1550.desc.common_2$ as well as our allies, while weakening those that stand against us.

shroud.1550.desc.default.homicidal.en:
$shroud.1550.desc_1.default$

$shroud.1550.desc.common_2$ while weakening those that stand against us.

shroud.1550.desc.knows.zh:
$shroud.1550.desc_1.knows$

$shroud.1550.desc.common_2$乃至我们的盟友，还能削弱对手——类似我们此前观察到的现象一样。
shroud.1550.desc.knows.en:
$shroud.1550.desc_1.knows$

$shroud.1550.desc.common_2$ as well as our allies, while weakening those that stand against us - just as we have previously observed.

shroud.1550.desc.knows.homicidal.zh:
$shroud.1550.desc_1.knows$

$shroud.1550.desc.common_2$，还能削弱对手——类似我们此前观察到的现象一样。
shroud.1550.desc.knows.homicidal.en:
$shroud.1550.desc_1.knows$

$shroud.1550.desc.common_2$ while weakening those that stand against us - just as we have previously observed.

shroud.2300.a.organic.zh: 我们演化中合乎逻辑的一步。
shroud.2300.a.organic.en: The logical next step in our evolution.

shroud.2300.a.robot.zh: 我们发展中符合逻辑的下一步。
shroud.2300.a.robot.en: The logical next step in our development.

shroud.2300.b.zh: 一种施加我们意志的新方式。
shroud.2300.b.en: A new way to impose our will.

shroud.2300.c.organic.zh: 让社会来决定最佳用法。
shroud.2300.c.organic.en: Let society determine its best use.

shroud.2300.c.variant.en: A means to ensure social order.

shroud.2300.desc.zh:
[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionIntro]

这种信息可以有多种形式：具体的语言或视觉材料、宽泛的概念或广义的情绪感知。关键在于，精心策划的传输过程可以让受众在毫无感觉的情况下完成这个流程。

[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro]
shroud.2300.desc.en:
[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionIntro]

This information can take various forms: specific linguistic or visual material, broad concepts, or generalized emotive sensations. Crucially, a carefully performed transmission leaves its subject completely unaware of the procedure.

[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro].

shroud.2305.a.zh: 一个值得研究的灵能现象。
shroud.2305.a.en: A psionic phenomenon to be studied.

shroud.2305.b.zh: 不要打扰这个文化资产。
shroud.2305.b.en: Do not disturb this cultural asset.

shroud.2305.b_spiritualist.en: Do not disturb this sacred site.

shroud.2305.desc.zh:
我们的许多[Owner.GetCitizenPlural]在[Owner.Capital.GetName]各地看到了怪异的幻影。这些幻象大多数情况下都是偶发的，不会重复，但有一个地方因频繁出现而引起了注意。[Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]

人们发现这个幻象出现在一处富矿洞穴系统的入口。
shroud.2305.desc.en:
A number of our [Owner.GetCitizenPlural] have perceived uncanny apparitions at various locations on [Owner.Capital.GetName]. In most cases, these have been chance sightings without repetition, but one site has drawn attention for frequent visitations. [Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]

It has been discovered that the phantom appears near the mouth of a mineral-rich cavern system.

shroud.2310.c.zh: 又发现了一种令人惊叹的新生命形式。
shroud.2310.c.en: A fantastic new life form has been revealed.

shroud.2310.desc.zh:
[Owner.Capital.GetName]上发生了一次意外的气候事件——一场类似风暴的扰动横扫了一片灵能水平极高的地区。随后我们在其途径之地发现一些当地的动物感染了奇怪的寄生虫，它们会钻入大脑器官并将其慢慢吃掉。

随着这种寄生虫感染的加剧，宿主动物会暂时获得基本的念动力，很多便开始将其用于狩猎和进食，直至被寄生虫杀死。

[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]
shroud.2310.desc.en:
An unpredicted climatic event occurred on [Owner.Capital.GetName] - a storm-like disturbance that swept through an area with particularly elevated levels of psionic energy. In its wake, we found some of the local fauna infected with a strange parasite that burrows into and slowly consumes the cerebral organ.

As this parasitic infection progresses, the host animals temporarily develop basic telekinetic abilities which they then use for hunting and feeding before they inevitably expire.

[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]

shroud.2315.a.en: Let us make wishes come true.

shroud.2315.desc.zh:
在实验新的灵能科技的过程中，我们在集体冥想时观察到了意料之外的具现化现象。将我们的集体注意力聚焦在空间中的一个点上时会短暂出现一些怪异但值得注意的物体。

所耗费的精神力非常巨大，但我们有可能将这些努力转化为合意的具现化对象。这些物体从何而来，以及可能导致什么后果我们不得而知。
shroud.2315.desc.en:
While experimenting with new psionic techniques, we observed unexpected materializations during group meditation. Narrowing our collective focus on a single point in space resulted in the fleeting appearance of strange and remarkable objects.

The psychic toll involved is significant, but it is possible we could direct these efforts into manifesting objects to fit our purposes. Where these objects come from and what consequences may result are unknown.

shroud.2320.a.zh: 一种全新的跨星系合作方式。
shroud.2320.a.en: A new avenue for intragalactic cooperation.

shroud.2320.b.zh: 这才是真正的力量投射。
shroud.2320.b.en: A true form of power projection.

shroud.2320.c.zh: 一种全新的跨行星统治方式。
shroud.2320.c.en: A new method of multiplanetary governing.

shroud.2320.desc.zh:
关于灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]有二重身能力的传言沸沸扬扬，据信这是一种可以同时以肉身出现在两个地方的能力。我们派出了[Owner.GetResearchers]去调查这种不太可能的说法；结果这种现象竟然是真的。[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]

目前，只有很小一部分人口具有这种强大的能力，进一步研究也许能找到训练方法。
shroud.2320.desc.en:
Rumors had spread of psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] capable of bilocation, the ability to be physically present in two different locations at the same time. We dispatched [Owner.GetResearchers] to investigate these improbable claims; astonishingly, they have proven to be true.[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]

Presently, only a fraction of our population possesses this remarkable skill, but further study might yield methods of training others.

shroud.2325.a.en: Discover the secrets of those around us.

shroud.2325.b.en: Discover the far reaches of the universe.

shroud.2325.desc.zh:
[Owner.GetAdjective]的一小部分人身上出现了一种奇妙的灵能能力：心灵遥感，一种从超出正常感知范围的距离感知实体的能力。这些千里眼无需经过任何专门训练，就能非常精确地描绘出远处物体的细节。

如果这种能力可以加以控制和增强，[Owner.GetName]就能获得可观的回报。利用我们最强大的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]的能力，就可以尝试磨练这项技术，将其应用在重要的事情上。
shroud.2325.desc.en:
A wondrous psionic faculty has emerged in a small proportion of the [Owner.GetAdjective] population: telesthesia, the ability to sense entities from distances beyond the ordinary range of perception. Without any kind of specialized training, these remote viewers can accurately describe distant objects in remarkable detail.

The [Owner.GetName] stands to reap significant rewards if these powers can be controlled and strengthened. By drawing on the abilities of our most powerful [Owner.GetTelepathPlural], we can try to hone this technique and focus it on an important enterprise.

shroud.2400.a.en: Material goods are of little concern.

shroud.2400.desc.zh:
我们的原材料正在以危险的速率减少。储存在工厂和仓库里的无机材料正在以超过常理的速度消耗，[Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]。这些地区的损失也与灵能活动增加有关。

为此我们可以减少在物资仓库附近区域的灵能活动，但也将拖慢灵能研究的步伐、限制其工业应用。我们还可以按照建议开发灵能场衰减器来抑制这种物灭现象。如果什么都不做，我们的灵能研究能力也会被削弱。
shroud.2400.desc.en:
We are losing raw materials at an alarming rate. Stores of inorganic matter in factories and warehouses are depleting faster than they are being used, [Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]. These losses correlate with increased psionic activity in the affected locations.

We could respond by halting psionic activity in the vicinity of material stores, but this will slow the pace of our psionic research and limit its industrial applications. Alternatively, we could follow proposals to develop a psionic field attenuator that should halt the dematerialization process. If we do nothing, our psionic research capabilities will be attenuated.

shroud.2405.a.zh: 不错的尝试，但应该管控一下。
shroud.2405.a.en: A fine endeavor, if we can regulate it.

shroud.2405.b.en: Let the dead lie in peace.

shroud.2405.c.zh: 每个人都可以有死亡的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]。

shroud.2405.desc.zh:
我们的大众对灵能日益增长的好奇心催生了一种奇怪的活动：私下储存死去的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]并试图与之交流。

参与者相信在[Owner.GetDeathName]后意识信息仍可以保留，这是一种衍生兹科学理论的观念，认为心灵是一种能量——它可以转化但不能凭空消失。尽管总数不多，但还是有越来越多人相信灵能[Owner.GetIndividualName]去世时会产生一个无穷小亚空间裂隙，通过这扇窗户就能一瞥其他维度。

创新研究固然值得赞扬，但对我们部分[Owner.GetDeceasedAdj]人口的滥用引发了伦理问题。此外还有报告称，越来越多的盗尸者通过犯罪手段来获取这些器官。
shroud.2405.desc.en:
Our population's increasing curiosity about psionics has led to the emergence of a strange activity: privately storing expired [Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural] and trying to communicate with them.

Practitioners believe that cognitive information can survive [Owner.GetDeathName], an idea originating in scientific theories about psychic forces being a form of energy - convertible but indestructible. A small but growing percentage also believe that the passing of a psionic [Owner.GetIndividualName] creates an infinitesimal subspace rupture, a window through which to glimpse other dimensions.

While innovative research is commendable, interference with parts of our [Owner.GetDeceasedAdj] population raises ethical concerns. Furthermore, we have received reports about a growing class of body snatchers who procure these parts by criminal means.

shroud.2410.a.zh: 不错的尝试，但应该管控一下。
shroud.2410.a.en: A fine endeavor, if we can regulate it.

shroud.2410.c.zh: 震惊，但是奇妙。接受改变。
shroud.2410.c.en: Shocking, but fascinating. Embrace the change.

shroud.2410.desc.zh:
我们的灵能人口中有很大一部分都长出了奇怪的、有关节附肢，其设计深不可测。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]称，他们的外观变化是由大规模自发[Owner.GetGeneticMutationName]导致的。现在很清楚灵能活动可能导致使用者发生身体变化。尽管我们无法抑制这种附肢增生，但也发现可以用灵能来控制其生长率。

尽管一开始导致了一些[Owner.GetDistressName]，这些额外的肢体其实还是很有用的。如果高效利用起来，其它们的作用应该能弥补增加的认知负担。
shroud.2410.desc.en:
Swathes of our psionic population have sprouted strange, jointed appendages of unfathomable design. According to our [Owner.GetScientistPlural], their appearance was caused by spontaneous [Owner.GetGeneticMutationName] at mass scale. It is now clear that psionic activities can cause physical changes to the practitioner. While we cannot prevent the emergence of these protuberances, we have discovered that the rate of their growth can be controlled psionically.

Though initially causing some [Owner.GetDistressName], these extra parts have proven surprisingly useful. If applied productively, their utility might compensate for their added cognitive load.

shroud.2415.c.zh: 限制使用。体力劳动还是更可靠。
shroud.2415.c.en: Limit its use. Physical labor is more reliable.

shroud.2415.desc.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]开发出了一种将灵能力转化为动能的可靠方法，现在正在与[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]合作将这种技术放大并投入生产。

尽管这种技术非常有工业应用前景，其社会影响还是个未知数。如果一小帮技术高超的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]就能运作复杂的机械，那么就会有大批的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]就要面临失业。[Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra]我们还在逐渐掌握灵能的过程中，最好还是谨慎推进为好。
shroud.2415.desc.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have developed a reliable method for converting psionic power into kinetic energy, and are now working with [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on scaling the technology for practical use.

While the industrial applications are promising, the social implications remain an open question. If a small group of skilled psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] can power and operate a network of complex machinery, legions of [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] are at risk of redundancy. [Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra] While our mastery of psionics is still developing, it may be best to proceed with caution.

shroud.2420.a.zh: 我们需要学着忍耐这种事。
shroud.2420.a.en: We must learn to tolerate this.
