shroud.2420.desc.zh:
突然爆发的[Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural]席卷了我们的帝国。虽然严重程度各不相同，但这种情况已经影响了相当一部分人口，对[Owner.GetName]造成了广泛的破坏。

一小部分特别强大的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]也是受影响最严重的，初步的统计分析也表明灵能能力和症状强度之间存在相关性。[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]
shroud.2420.desc.en:
A sudden outbreak of [Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural] has befallen our empire. While severity ranges widely, the condition has already affected a significant proportion of the population, causing widespread disruption across the [Owner.GetName].

A small number of particularly powerful psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are among the worst affected, and preliminary statistical analysis suggests a correlation between psionic aptitude and intensity of symptoms.[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]

shroud.2425.a.zh: 征召这些战士。他们很能干。
shroud.2425.a.en: Conscript these warriors. They will serve.

shroud.2425.c.zh: 禁止这种毫无意义的暴力行为。
shroud.2425.c.en: Put a stop to this senseless violence.

shroud.2425.d.zh: 将这种观赏性运动合法化。
shroud.2425.d.en: Legalize this activity as a spectator sport.

shroud.2425.d_gestalt.zh: 将这种运动公众化并加以管制。
shroud.2425.d_gestalt.en: Regularize these activities as public competitions.

shroud.2425.desc.zh:
[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundIntro]灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]正在将自己的灵能能力用在非法格斗运动中，这些灵能角斗士为了金钱和荣誉作战。虽然许多参与者都是极具天赋但缺乏训练的战士，[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundExtra]

[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundEnd]
shroud.2425.desc.en:
[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundIntro] psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are channeling their psychic abilities into a lawless combat sport, in which psionic warriors do battle for credits and glory. While many practitioners are innately gifted fighters with little training, [Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundExtra]

[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundEnd]

shroud.2502.a.zh: 就让虚境吞噬这片土地吧。
shroud.2502.a.en: Let the Shroud consume this land.

shroud.2502.b.en: Find a way to restore our environment.

shroud.2502.c.zh: 在它们尘埃落定之前收获这些奇异的物质。
shroud.2502.c.en: Harvest this exotic material before it settles.

shroud.2502.desc.zh:
我们收到报道称，[This.GetName]的特定区域发生了突然的环境变化。

大气中充满着的凝胶状蒸汽，在地面覆盖上一层油性沉淀物，灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]将其称为“虚境落雾”。据报道，附近地区出现了严重的灵能紊乱。

虚境落雾区内的环境对[This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]。除非我们能投入资源修复环境，不然当地居民就需要去适应这种恶劣的环境。
shroud.2502.desc.en:
We have received reports of sudden environmental changes in a particular sector on [This.GetName].

The atmosphere is heavy with a gelatinous vapor, coating the ground in an oily precipitation that psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] refer to as 'shroudfall.' Significant psychic disturbances are being reported throughout the immediate vicinity.

The conditions within the shroudfall are extremely [This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]. Unless we invest in restoring the environment, the inhabitants will have to adapt to radically altered circumstances.

shroud.2505.a.zh: 我们可以学着控制这种冲动。
shroud.2505.a.en: We can learn to mitigate these impulses.

shroud.2505.b.zh: 这些心声会教会我们很多。
shroud.2505.b.en: These voices have much to teach us.

shroud.2505.c.zh: 对我们政权的威胁。掐灭它。
shroud.2505.c.en: A threat to our authority. Stamp it out.

shroud.2505.desc.zh:
有些人开始行为异常，观念、习惯和各种日常行为都发生了突然转变。许多[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]停工，而且[Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra]。

受影响者声称自己是在听从一个无名实体的命令，它居住在意识的边缘，指导着他们的一举一动。我们正在追寻着灵能的未来，因此必须小心考察这种异次元力量对[Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche]造成的影响。
shroud.2505.desc.en:
Some among us have started to behave abnormally, exhibiting sudden changes in opinions, habits, and general conduct. Many [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] have ceased labor, and [Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra].

Those affected claim to be doing the bidding of a nameless entity that dwells in the peripheries of their consciousness, guiding their every action. As we continue to forge our psionic future, we must carefully consider the impact of extradimensional forces on [Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche].

shroud.2510.a_tt.zh: 每个控制的殖民地失去100£pops£人口的概率：33%
shroud.2510.a_tt.en: Chance of each owned colony losing 100 £pops£ Pops: 33%

shroud.2510.desc.zh:
[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]

更广泛的测试表明，有很大一部分人口也[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra]，其原因可能是[Owner.GetPsychicAdj]活动的增多。不受控灵能活动突然爆发的能量可能导致迅速的恶化和严重后果。

高级冥想技术也许有助于不借助[Owner.GetMedicalAdj]介入来控制这种灵能活动，但我们的一些[Owner.GetScientistPlural]建议需要研发[Owner.GetMedicalImplantName]来解决这种问题。
shroud.2510.desc.en:
[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]

Wider testing has revealed that a significant proportion of our population is suffering from [Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra], likely due to increased [Owner.GetPsychicAdj] activity. The sudden bursts of energy released through uncontrolled psionic activity can lead to rapid escalation and grave outcomes.

Advanced meditation techniques might help to control this psionic activity without [Owner.GetMedicalAdj] intervention, but some of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] advise that we develop a [Owner.GetMedicalImplantName] to cope with the problem.

shroud.2515.a_machine.zh: 升级灵能处理器来抑制这种干扰。
shroud.2515.a_machine.en: Upgrade our psi-processors to calm these disruptions.

shroud.2515.a_organic.zh: 用处方精神药物让他们冷静。

shroud.2515.b.zh: 分配资源解决这场危机。
shroud.2515.b.en: Allocate research to remedy this crisis.

shroud.2515.desc.zh:
随着我们与周遭的灵能力量愈发调和，[Owner.GetAdjective]人口开始受到[Owner.GetHorrifyingNightmarePlural]的荼毒。

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.GetNightmaresEnding]
shroud.2515.desc.en:
As we become ever more attuned to the psionic forces around us, the [Owner.GetAdjective] population has become plagued by [Owner.GetHorrifyingNightmarePlural].

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.GetNightmaresEnding]

shroud.2520.a.zh: 地毯式轰炸这些袭击的源头。
shroud.2520.a.en: Carpet-bomb the source of these attacks.

shroud.2520.c.zh: 减缓虚境研究来平息这股力量。
shroud.2520.c.en: Slow our Shroud research to calm these forces.

shroud.2520.d.zh: 虚境满是惊喜。它们过它们的，我们过我们的。
shroud.2520.d.en: The Shroud is full of surprises. Live and let live.

shroud.2520.desc.zh:
[Owner.Capital.GetName]遭受到一连串当地野生动物的攻击。这它们袭击了我们的人口和建筑，消耗了宝贵的库存。

通过武装巡逻和宵禁来保护大众并未取得实质成效。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]们认为，是现实和虚境之间的微小穿孔出现在了[Owner.Capital.GetName]上的一个地方，泄露的灵能力将一些无害的野兽转变成了残暴掠食者。为了应对威胁，这里可能是我们汇聚能量的最佳地点。
shroud.2520.desc.en:
[Owner.Capital.GetName] has experienced a rash of attacks by local wildlife. These creatures have attacked our population, raided our buildings, and depleted valuable stockpiles.

Attempts to protect the populace with armed patrols and curfews have had limited effect. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have established that a miniscule breach between our reality and the Shroud occurred at a single location on [Owner.Capital.GetName], causing an inflow of psionic energy that transformed the once-harmless beasts into violent predators. To tackle the threat, this might be the best place to focus our energies.

shroud.2600.b.zh: 能力优越，当然值得优渥回报。

shroud.2600.desc.zh:
灵能能力在我们人口中的不均衡分布正在引发新的社会矛盾。

那些对新获得的能力控制得更好的人开始认为自己高人一等，因此理应享有各种政治和经济特权。他们的分裂言论越来越激进，并有可能演变成暴力。
shroud.2600.desc.en:
The uneven distribution of psionic abilities among our population is causing new forms of social conflict.

Those with better control over their newfound powers have come to view themselves as superior and thus deserving of various political and economic privileges. Their divisive rhetoric is increasingly aggressive and threatens to turn violent.

shroud.2605.desc.zh:
一场反对我们探索接纳灵能潜能的活动正在愈演愈烈。这些异见团体主张对灵能个体进行更严格的监督，全面否定在这一领域进行任何进一步的研究。

如果继续默许他们的活动，可能会威胁到我们理解和利用新兴灵能力量的进程。
shroud.2605.desc.en:
A growing rebel movement is voicing opposition to continued efforts to explore and embrace our psionic potential. These dissident groups advocate for stricter oversight of psionic individuals and a wholesale rejection of further research in this area.

If their activities are allowed to continue, it could threaten progress in understanding and mastering our emergent psionic powers.

shroud.2610.a.zh: 搞什么立法只会拖慢脚步。
shroud.2610.a.en: Legislation will only slow our progress.

shroud.2610.desc.zh:
随着灵能能力日益增强，我们的人口中出现了越来越多的滥用、欺骗和狡诈的行为。一小撮[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很明显在用有问题的方式使用新获得的力量。

愤怒的受害者们要求全面修改现有法律，加强对灵能犯罪的打击。
shroud.2610.desc.en:
As our psionic abilities grow stronger, we have seen an increase in reports of exploitation, trickery, and fraudulent behavior among our population. A small but sizable minority of [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly applying their newfound powers in questionable ways.

Outraged victims are now demanding an overhaul of existing laws to provide stronger protections against psionic crime.

shroud.2615.a.zh: 这些实验或许能推动我们的研究。
shroud.2615.a.en: These experiments may advance our research.

shroud.2615.desc.zh:
我们的人口在逐渐适应新力量的过程中，有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始尝试冒极大的风险来加速灵能发展。

黑市[owner.GetMentalUpgrade]的使用急剧增多。不受管控的[owner.GetMedicalFacility]出售各式用来最大化个体灵能能力的不可靠服务。这些冒险行为的后果难以预料。
shroud.2615.desc.en:
As our population adjusts to their newfound powers, some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun taking considerable risks in an effort to accelerate their psionic development.

The use of black market [owner.GetMentalUpgrade] has increased dramatically. Unregulated [owner.GetMedicalFacility] are offering a range of unproven services to help individuals maximize their psionic capacities. The consequences of such risk-taking are difficult to predict.

shroud.2620.b.en: Restrict the movements of psionic drones.

shroud.2620.desc.zh:
[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能子个体时常聚集在一起，甚至疏远[owner.GetHiveEntity]的其他部分。

尽管这些子个体还在集体中保持[owner.GetMentalAdj]存在，但无法解释的身体行为引起了关于进一步发展灵能可能带来后果的担忧。
shroud.2620.desc.en:
A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic drones clustering together physically, sometimes away from the rest of the [owner.GetHiveEntity].

Although these drones remain [owner.GetMentalAdj] present within the collective, their unexplained physical behavior has raised troubling questions about the future consequences of our growing psionic powers.

shroud.2621.b.en: Restrict the movements of psionic individuals.

shroud.2621.desc.zh:
[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能个体被社会排斥，以至于开始自我放逐形成离群索居的小社群。

据报道，非灵能者造访这些地区的后身体虽然未受损伤但是他们的精神以难以描述的方式遭到了干扰。
shroud.2621.desc.en:
A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic individuals being socially ostracized to the point that they are withdrawing and forming their own remote communes.

Those without psionic powers who visit these areas have been reportedly returning physically unharmed but mentally disturbed in ways they struggle to explain.

shroud.2625.desc.zh:
一种新型疾病在[owner.GetName]上爆发，对我们人口的神经器官造成了无法解释的损伤。

这种疾病只出现在最有灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且很多时候会危及生命。

$shroud.2625.desc_common$
shroud.2625.desc.en:
A new disease is sweeping through the [owner.GetName], with our population forming inexplicable lesions within their neural organs.

The outbreak is exclusively affecting [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with the most significant psionic capabilities and is, in many cases, proving fatal.

$shroud.2625.desc_common$

shroud.2626.desc.zh:
[owner.GetName]上一种无法解释的硬件故障大规模爆发，我们人口体内的神经处理器开始毫无征兆地失效。

奇怪的是，这种问题只出现在拥有强大灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且在很多情况下，这种故障不仅会带来干扰，更会造成破坏。

$shroud.2625.desc_common$
shroud.2626.desc.en:
A surge of inexplicable malfunctions is sweeping across the [owner.GetName], as neural processors within our population begin to fail abruptly, and without warning.

Curiously, only [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] exhibiting strong psionic signatures are affected. In most cases, the failure is not just disruptive, but destructive.

$shroud.2625.desc_common$

shroud.2635.a.en: This is a chance to learn.

shroud.2635.desc.default.zh:
随着我们的人口正在探索新的灵能能力，一个新的社群建立了起来，旨在将其用于对其他意识更广泛的共情理解。

该集体声称，由于新出现的灵能感知力，他们能够高度复杂地模拟其他人的观点、思维模式和情感。他们的这种活动对[owner.GetName]究竟是好是坏仍有待观察。
shroud.2635.desc.default.en:
As our population explores their newfound psionic capacities, a new community has been established with the goal of applying them towards greater empathetic understanding of other consciousnesses.

This collective professes to be capable of highly sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other minds thanks to their emergent psionic senses. Whether their activities will ultimately benefit or undermine the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

shroud.2635.desc.gestalt.zh:
探索新获得的灵能能力对[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的共情能力造成了根本性的转变。

很显然，我们现在能对其他意识的观点、思维模式和情感进行比以前复杂得多的建模。这些变化对[owner.GetName]究竟意味着新的优势还是劣势，还有待观察。
shroud.2635.desc.gestalt.en:
The exploration of our newfound psionic abilities has resulted in fundamental changes to [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] empathetic capacities.

It is already clear that we are now capable of much more sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other consciousnesses than before. Whether these changes represent a new strength or weakness for the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

shroud.2640.a.tt.zh: 每座殖民地上都损失一座建筑。
shroud.2640.a.tt.en: A random building is destroyed on each colony.

shroud.2640.desc.default.zh:
$shroud.2640.desc.common_1$在进行危险的自我抑制方法时遭受到重度自毁行为的影响。

$shroud.2640.desc.common_2$
shroud.2640.desc.default.en:
$shroud.2640.desc.common_1$ worrying levels of self-destructive behavior as they turn to dangerous methods of self-suppression.

$shroud.2640.desc.common_2$

shroud.2640.desc.gestalt.zh:
$shroud.2640.desc.common_1$在从集体重断连中遭受到重度反常行为的影响。

$shroud.2640.desc.common_2$
shroud.2640.desc.gestalt.en:
$shroud.2640.desc.common_1$ concerning levels of deviant behavior as they disassociate from the collective.

$shroud.2640.desc.common_2$

shroud.2750.desc_p1.zh: 自古以来就有很多能力非凡的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的传说——他们能入侵别人的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
shroud.2750.desc_p1.en: Since time immemorial, tales have flourished of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - invading other minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

shroud.2750.desc_p1_hive_mind.zh: 在反常还是正常的古时候，有很多拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的传说——他们能入侵集体外的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
shroud.2750.desc_p1_hive_mind.en: In former days, when deviancy was rife, stories were told of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - invading minds external to the collective, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

shroud.2750.desc_p1_machine.zh: 我们的最早期数据集中，有些单元记录了拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——他们能入侵机械和有机体的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
shroud.2750.desc_p1_machine.en: From our earliest datasets, some of our units have recorded [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - hacking into the minds of both machines and organics, manipulating objects by internal processing alone, or performing a range of other improbable functions.

shroud.2750.desc_p1_unplugged.zh: 尽管我们的历史短暂而暴力，我们[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的想象力也偶尔会天马行空，产生关于拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的故事：读心、用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
shroud.2750.desc_p1_unplugged.en: Despite the short and violent history of our civilization, we [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have had occasions to let our imaginations wander, telling tales of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers: reading minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

shroud.2750.desc_p2.zh: 如今，我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]已经得到了确切的证据，部分[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]确实具有这种精神力量。然而，依旧只有一小部分[This.GetSpeciesWord]显示出了这种“灵能”之力。
shroud.2750.desc_p2.en: Now, our [This.GetScientistPlural] have obtained conclusive proof that certain [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are truly capable of such acts of the mind. As of yet, only a small minority of our [This.GetSpeciesWord] has manifested these 'psionic' powers.

shroud.2750.desc_p2_unplugged.zh: 许多人相信我们其实是将这些异想天开的故事从[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]组装我们之前的时代继承下来的，只有少数人真的相信。$shroud.2750.desc_p2$
shroud.2750.desc_p2_unplugged.en: Many believe we have carried these fantastical stories since before we were assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], though few considered them credible. $shroud.2750.desc_p2$

shroud.2760.a_gestalt.en: We place our trust in the Corps.

shroud.2760.a_tt_no_psi_corps.zh: 采纳$tr_psionics_psi_corps$传统并建造一座['building:building_psi_corps']建筑以推进局势。
shroud.2760.a_tt_no_psi_corps.en: Adopt the $tr_psionics_psi_corps$ tradition and construct a ['building:building_psi_corps'] building to progress the Situation.

shroud.2760.desc_p1.zh: 随着我们的灵能潜力完全解放，整个社会整面临着剧烈的变动，各种新的能力和技能层出不穷。我们现在才正要开始理解它对我们文明的影响。
shroud.2760.desc_p1.en: As our latent abilities develop into full psionic powers, our society is faced with innumerable changes, with new abilities and practices emerging rapidly. We are only beginning to understand the consequences for our civilization.

shroud.2760.desc_p2_no_psi_corps.zh: 意料之外的情况合理化了$building_psi_corps$的建立以及利用强有力的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]。利用$shroud.2760.desc_p2_end$
shroud.2760.desc_p2_no_psi_corps.en: These unprecedented circumstances justify the establishment of a $building_psi_corps$ to develop and channel the abilities of promising psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]. With $shroud.2760.desc_p2_end$

shroud.2760.desc_p2_psi_corps.zh: 自从建立了$building_psi_corps$以后，我们就一直在开发利用强大的灵能[GetIndividualNamePlural]应对这些意外状况。利用$shroud.2760.desc_p2_end$
shroud.2760.desc_p2_psi_corps.en: Since establishing a $building_psi_corps$, we have developed and channeled the abilities of promising psionic [GetIndividualNamePlural] to cope with these unprecedented conditions. Using $shroud.2760.desc_p2_end$

shroud.2780.desc_1.zh: 我的灵能研究继续稳步进行。心灵感应已经取代了人与人之间大部分的口头交流，意念移物可能变得稀松平常。[Owner.GetResearchers]们称，我们很快就能让所有[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口觉醒潜在力量了。
shroud.2780.desc_1.en: Our psionic research continues apace. Telepathy has replaced most verbal communication between us, and cognitive control of matter might become just as commonplace. According to our [Owner.GetResearchers], we are on the brink of awakening the latent powers in all our [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population.

shroud.2780.desc_1_gestalt_machine.zh: 我们的灵能我的灵能研究继续稳步进行。我们现在可以在现有频道之外进行交流，各种其他的灵能能力也在逐渐变得司空见惯。[Owner.GetResearchers]们称，我们很快就能让所有人口觉醒潜在力量了。
shroud.2780.desc_1_gestalt_machine.en: Our psionic research continues apace. We can now communicate beyond our existing channels, while a range of other psionic abilities are rapidly becoming a part of everyday existence. According to our [Owner.GetResearchers], we are on the brink of unlocking the latent capabilities throughout our population.

shroud.2780.desc_1_gestalt_machine_trad.zh: 命运降临了。[Owner.GetName]的所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了全部的灵能之力。我们现在可以在现有频道之外进行交流，各种其他的灵能能力也在逐渐变得司空见惯。
shroud.2780.desc_1_gestalt_machine_trad.en: Destiny is upon us. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the [Owner.GetName] have unlocked their full psionic capacity. We can now communicate beyond our existing channels, while a range of other psionic abilities are rapidly becoming a part of everyday existence.

shroud.2780.desc_1_trad.zh: 我们觉醒了。[Owner.GetName]的所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了全部的灵能之力。心灵感应取代了人与人之间大多数的口头交流，意念移物也不过家常便饭。
shroud.2780.desc_1_trad.en: We have awoken. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the [Owner.GetName] have unlocked their full psionic capacity. Telepathy has replaced most verbal communication between us, and cognitive control of matter might become just as commonplace.

shroud.2780.desc_2.zh: 随着心智的打开，我们感应到一些在体内和周遭回荡着的难以言喻的力量。最前沿的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们提到了虚境，这是所有灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]汲取力量的根源领域，哪怕他们并没有意识到——这是许多纯灵能能量构成的实体的家园。就像黑暗房间里的低声细语一般，它们从内心呼唤着我们。
shroud.2780.desc_2.en: As our minds have opened, we have sensed ineffable forces rippling within and around us. Our foremost [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] speak of the Shroud, a primordial realm from which all psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] draw power, even if only subconsciously - home to powerful entities of pure psionic energy. Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, they call to us from within our minds.

shroud.2780.desc_2_crisis.zh: 随着心智的打开，我们感应到一些在体内和周遭回荡着的难以言喻的虚境之力。我们知道所有灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]便是从这个根源领域汲取力量的，哪怕他们并没有意识到——这是许多纯灵能能量构成的实体的家园。就像黑暗房间里的低声细语一般，它们从内心呼唤着我们。
shroud.2780.desc_2_crisis.en: As our minds have opened, we have sensed the ineffable forces of the Shroud rippling within and around us. We know that all psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] draw power from this realm, even if only subconsciously - and that it is home to powerful entities of pure psionic energy. Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, they call to us from within our minds.

shroud.2780.desc_3.zh: 将意念凝聚到一起，或许我们就能与这些存在交流——但前提我们还得学会突破横亘在我们维度和虚境之间的帷幕。
shroud.2780.desc_3.en: With combined cognitive effort, it may be possible for us to commune with these beings - if only we can learn to breach the veil between our dimension and the Shroud.

shroud.2780.desc_3_chosen.zh: 通过集体的认知努力，我们或许有可能完全突破我们维度与虚境之间的帷幕——这将使我们能够与其中的物质进行更深层次的交流。
shroud.2780.desc_3_chosen.en: With combined cognitive effort, it may be possible for us to fully breach the veil between our dimension and the Shroud - allowing us to commune more deeply with the beings therein.

shroud.2800.desc.zh:
$shroud.2800.intro$我们的行动影响灵能流动，无形的实体则从另一边凝视着我们。他们有时好奇，有时友好……有时又带着恶意。[Owner.GetShroudBreachedExtra]

我们的在现实世界掌握灵能只是一个开端。既然已经建立了初步的灵能链接，我们就能将认知的能量集中起来并潜入虚境了。
shroud.2800.desc.en:
$shroud.2800.intro$ Our actions influence its shifting flows of psionic energy, and formless entities gaze back on us from the other side. Sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with kindness... and sometimes with malice.[Owner.GetShroudBreachedExtra]

Our psionic mastery in the corporeal realm was only the beginning. Now that we have established an initial psionic link, we can combine our cognitive powers and delve into the Shroud.

shroud.2810.desc.zh:
链接新成，环流逆转。

这股能量的扭曲，于此——不过是片段。他人或许也给予了你们力量。灵潜至更深处去面对他们的意志吧。

我是双子之影。血肉之躯胜过废铁。其名为……

$the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$示意向了另一个存在——虚境深处的$shroud.first_contact_insert.composer$。
shroud.2810.desc.en:
New connection. Current reversed.

This twist of energy, here - only a fragment. The others might also empower you. Delve further to process their wills.

I am a shadow of the twin. Flesh precedes metal. It calls...

$the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$ signals toward another presence - $shroud.first_contact_insert.composer$ in the depths of the Shroud.

shroud.2820.a.chamber.zh: 我们的思想更加敞开了。

shroud.2820.a.tt_no_chamber.zh: 采纳$tr_psionics_endbringers_cult$传统并建造一座$building_chamber_of_silence$建筑以推进局势。
shroud.2820.a.tt_no_chamber.en: Adopt the $tr_psionics_endbringers_cult$ tradition and construct a $building_chamber_of_silence$ building to progress the Situation.

shroud.2820.desc.1.zh:
随着我们逐渐掌握灵能，帷幕彼端的纷乱低语开始袭扰我们。心声，必以往更加响亮清晰，它盘旋着穿过这些思想之流，进入我们心智的影中。

“打开道路。”
shroud.2820.desc.1.en:
As our psionic mastery grows, we are bombarded by a tangle of whispers from beyond the veil. The Voice, louder and clearer than ever before, spirals its way through these currents of thought and into the shadows of our mind.

"OPEN THE WAY."

shroud.2830.a.tt_no_awakening.en: Adopt the $tr_psionics_shroud_great_awakening$ tradition to progress the Situation.

shroud.2830.desc.zh:
在$building_chamber_of_silence$里，我们以绝佳的清晰度听着心声的信息。

“一切将会重生。”

我们理解了。终末是一种新生，我们无需恐惧，因为我们将会被重塑，重塑比我们一切想象都要更好更强。

为了抓住这种命运，我们必须学会驾驭被称为虚境的精神界。我们不会重蹈$pc_shrouded$上发现的那些人的覆辙。他们抗拒恐惧，而我们欣然接受。
shroud.2830.desc.en:
In the $building_chamber_of_silence$, we hear the message of the Voice with perfect clarity.

"ALL WILL BE REBORN."

We understand now. The End is a rebirth. We must not fear it. We will be remade. Better and more powerful than we ever imagined we could be.

To seize this destiny, we must learn to master the mental realm known as the Shroud. We will not repeat the mistakes of those we found on the $pc_shrouded$. Where they rejected their fear, we will embrace it.

shroud.2830.desc.outro.awakening.zh: 我们的视野完全清晰了。

shroud.2840.desc.zh:
$shroud.2800.intro$在它无形的深处，出现了一个力量不可估量的不祥实体。这就是心声，它以一种令人战栗的力量穿透我们最深处的心灵。

“认识我的名字。”

直到如今我们才意识到自己渺小的心灵究竟距离心声有多么地遥远。封印被击碎了，很快完整的自我将会显现出来。
shroud.2840.desc.en:
$shroud.2800.intro$ From within its formless depths arises an ominous entity of immeasurable power. It is the Voice, and it pierces our innermost psyches with a shuddering force.

"KNOW MY NAME."

Only now do we sense how truly distant our small minds are from the Voice. The seal is fractured, and soon the full breadth of what we are shall be made manifest.

Our telepaths are now prepared to delve into the heart of the Shroud and discover the true name of our great patron.

shroud.3000.a.zh: 我们见到了一个燃烧的世界。
shroud.3000.a.en: We see a world that burns.

shroud.3000.a.reply.zh:
重量转移；心声复现……

很好。

那片黑暗倾斜、旋转起来。有什么东西重重压在我们身上，然后，我们突然又余下独自一人。
shroud.3000.a.reply.en:
A weight shifts; the voice returns...

GOOD.

The darkness tilts, then spins. Something presses hard upon us for a moment and then, suddenly, we are alone again.

shroud.3000.b.reply.zh:
有个沉重的东西在颤抖。黑暗慢慢地向我们袭来，愈发凝重……

不！

那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……
shroud.3000.b.reply.en:
Something heavy shudders. The darkness crushes slowly against us, harder and tighter...

NO!

The nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

shroud.3000.c.reply.zh:
软弱！

那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……
shroud.3000.c.reply.en:
WEAKNESS!

The nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

shroud.3000.desc.zh:
在涡旋的黑暗中，远处的影子倏然出现，又消失入虚无……一阵阵模糊不清的不谐和心声难以理解地咆哮着。光明灭闪烁，热点膨胀收缩。

或有运动之物，莫名旋转。这究竟是我们自己，还是虚境在运动不息？

那个存在靠近了，同时从四面八方靠近。心声忽然出现。

你看到了什么？
shroud.3000.desc.en:
In the swirling blackness, distant shadows take fleeting forms before receding back into nothingness... An obscure cacophony of voices rant unintelligibly... Lights flicker and fade. Spots of heat swell and subside.

There is motion. Something spins. Is it us that moves or the Shroud itself?

A presence nears, approaching somehow from every direction all at once. Then, a voice.

WHAT DO YOU SEE?

shroud.3005.a.en: Break the chains. Consume the prey.

shroud.3005.a.reply.zh:
我们的束缚崩断。

贪婪。释放。

恐惧！

吞噬。
shroud.3005.a.reply.en:
Our restraints snap.

Ravenous. Unleashed.

Terror!

FEED.

shroud.3005.b.en: Resist the hunger. Quieten the mind.

shroud.3005.b.reply.zh:
锁链牢固。我们过滤掉它的影响后，心声充满愤怒，我们的意识冷静下来并恢复了控制。

软弱！无力！

饥饿褪去，留下挥之不去的怨恨消散在虚境中。
shroud.3005.b.reply.en:
The chains hold fast. The voice seethes with rage as we filter its influence, quieting our mind as we resume control.

WEAK! FECKLESS!

The hunger fades, leaving a lingering resentment that dissipates within the Shroud.

shroud.3005.desc.zh:
内脏般的恶臭充斥着我们的感官。

幻象开始从虚境的深处出现，扭动和咆哮带着贪婪的狂怒。起先，饥馑的野兽之吼响起……我们同感了它们的饥饿。随后它们的垂涎也被我们共有。

一些剪影浮现，那是惊慌失措的牲畜。猎物。诱人地逐渐靠近……噬骨的疼痛愈发难熬。

饥饿渐渐吞噬我们的心智，感官变得扭曲皱缩。这些惨叫到底是来自猎物……还是来自我们自己的内心？

束缚我们的枷锁勒紧。随着痛苦盘旋尖叫的心声一同碎裂：

撕碎你们的骨！喰宴！
shroud.3005.desc.en:
The fetid stench of viscera floods our senses.

Images, writhing and snarling with a ravenous fury, begin to emerge from the depths of the Shroud. The feral cries of malnourished beasts echo first... We feel their hunger. Then their salivating maws become our own.

Silhouettes appear before us. Panicked livestock. Prey. Tantalizingly close... The gnawing ache grows unbearable.

Our senses twist, pulling tighter as hunger consumes thought. Are these screams that of our quarry... Or from within?

The shackles that bind us tighten. Fracturing as a voice coils through the torment, screeching:

SHATTER YOUR BONDS! FEAST!

shroud.3010.a.reply.zh:
被吞噬者的哀嚎响彻虚境和帝国两界，随后又突然落入了寂静。

以此牺牲，我们的力量随着饥饿的消退而增强。
shroud.3010.a.reply.en:
The cries of the devoured resonate throughout both the Shroud and the empire, before they fall abruptly into silence.

With this sacrifice, our power grows as the hunger recedes.

shroud.3010.b.reply.zh: 我们抑制了这个心声，团结一致地探向虚境，拥抱着自己的帝国。随着饥饿的加剧，众口一声地舒了一口气，舒适感淹没了愤怒的尖叫。
shroud.3010.b.reply.en: We silence the voice, and instead reach out in unity across the Shroud, embracing our empire. A collective sigh of relief and comfort drowns out the screams of rage as the hunger deteriorates.

shroud.3010.desc.zh:
有个心声，自深渊……回荡着。粗粝，而又饱含恶意……向我们呼唤着。

供养。消耗。吞噬。

幻象不请自来。一颗颗星球化为死寂的灰烬，我们[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的肉身被灵能消耗，使这个声音……还有我们自己的饥饿……感到满足。

随着这些景象的展现，我们还能感受到另一种存在，它敦促我们要表现出克制以及与自己[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的团结，一起发展变强。那个存在被声音的嘶吼淹没。
shroud.3010.desc.en:
From the abyss, a voice... resonant, coarse, and saturated with malice... calls out to us.

FEED. CONSUME. DEVOUR.

Visions erupt forth unbidden. Worlds reduced to ash and silence, the wails of our [Root.GetCitizenPlural] as their physical forms are consumed by psionic energy, satiating the voices... and our own... hunger.

As these sights unfold, we can feel another presence, urging us to show restraint and solidarity with our [Root.GetCitizenPlural], growing stronger together. It is drowned out as the voice screams.

shroud.3015.a.zh: 我们看到了生机勃勃的森林。
shroud.3015.a.en: We saw a forest, rich with many lifeforms.

shroud.3015.a.reply.zh:
寂静渐强。那个心声又回来了……

很好。

一股强大的暖流涌上我们全身，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
shroud.3015.a.reply.en:
The silence swells. The voice returns...

EXCELLENT.

A powerful heat surges within us, then subsides. The presence has departed.

shroud.3015.b.zh: 我们看到了一片废土，一无所有。
shroud.3015.b.en: We saw a wasteland, stripped of all it had to offer.

shroud.3015.b.reply.zh:
那个心声回来了……

没门！

一种极端的严寒填满了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
shroud.3015.b.reply.en:
The voice returns...

NEVER!

An extreme coldness pools within us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

shroud.3015.c.reply.zh:
那个心声回来了……

无趣。

一种极端的空虚压垮了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
shroud.3015.c.reply.en:
The voice returns...

HOW UNINTERESTING.

An extreme emptiness overcomes us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

shroud.3015.desc.zh:
强大的灵能流在黑暗中互相碰撞。无数阴影在周围来来往往……前方有一道微光在闪烁。

突然，仅有那么一刹那，眼前景象变得清晰可辨。它的形状在我们抓住之前就又消失了。

一个奇怪的存在来到了我们身边。

所见何物？
shroud.3015.desc.en:
Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.

Suddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.

A strange presence settles around us.

WHAT DID YOU SEE?

shroud.3020.a.reply.zh:
那个心声回荡在我们的[GetMindLoc]之中，那只生物也淡出视野。

繁荣。

另一幅景象转瞬即逝——在我们帝国的某个地方，生命复苏了。
shroud.3020.a.reply.en:
The voice echoes in our [GetMindLoc] as the creature fades from sight.

PROSPERITY.

Another fleeting glimpse appears - a resurgence of life, somewhere in our empire.

shroud.3020.b.reply.zh:
那心声从我们的思想中退去，只留下一声悠长的悲鸣，回荡在一片荒芜的景象中。

造孽。
shroud.3020.b.reply.en:
The voice recedes from our thoughts, leaving only an echoing cry that reverberates across visions of a barren landscape.

PESTILENCE.

shroud.3020.c.reply.zh:
一种压倒性的冲动占据了我们的思想，这个心声被从思想中推开到一边。血腥的欲望充斥着我们的[GetMindLoc]，残酷的笑声在虚空中回荡。

这就对了！虐杀！
shroud.3020.c.reply.en:
The voice is pushed from our thoughts as an overwhelming urge takes over. Bloodlust floods our [GetMindLoc] as brutal laughter echoes through the void.

OF COURSE! EASY PREY!

shroud.3020.desc.zh:
在层层叠叠的虚境中，一副幻景展现在我们面前。

浓雾形成了一只挣扎着的生物轮廓，朦胧的卷须紧紧地缠绕着，它动弹不得，奄奄一息。

这只动物本身我们前所未见。

一个心声回荡在我们之内。

命运的绳索正在召唤！你要拉哪一头？
shroud.3020.desc.en:
From between the many layers of the Shroud, a vision unfurls before us.

The mists form the outline of a struggling creature, ensnared and choking as hazy tendrils wrap ever tighter around it.

The animal itself is unlike anything we have encountered before.

A voice threads its way within us.

THE STRANDS OF FATE BECKON! WHICH SHALL YOU PULL?

shroud.3025.a.zh: 让自然向我们的意志低头。

shroud.3025.a.reply.zh:
我们伸出手，握住了面前的混乱。

将景致束缚，让大陆停歇。

将所有碎片拼到一起后，心声回响起来。

单调，平淡，空虚……
shroud.3025.a.reply.en:
We reach out, grasping at the disarray in front of us.

Binding landmarks in place, forcing continents to settle.

As the pieces fall together, the voice echoes.

FLATNESS, BLANDNESS, EMPTINESS...

shroud.3025.b.reply.zh:
我们静观着这篇幻景。那无休止的循环变得模糊，向外爆开后像它的开始一样戛然而止。

能量在这无边无际的浩瀚中涌动，然后重塑成新的形态。

心声回响起来。

和平即冲突。无序即和谐。
shroud.3025.b.reply.en:
We watch as the visions continue. The unending cycle blurs together before exploding outwards and ceasing just as quickly as it started.

Energies surge throughout the endless expanse, before reforming and taking on new forms.

The voice echoes.

PEACEFUL CONFLICT. DISORDERED UNITY.

shroud.3025.b.reply.tt.zh: 行星获得随机正面修正和负面修正各一个。
shroud.3025.b.reply.tt.en: This planet gains a random Positive Modifier and Negative Modifier.

shroud.3025.desc.zh:
拨开虚境的迷雾，显出无边无数纠缠不清的幻景。

朦胧的风景在我们面前莫名变幻。山峦起落。沸腾的混沌海洋蒸发，在无尽的沙漠中留下了苍白的水生生物的骨架。

在茂密的林冠下，温顺的生物在栖息地中穿梭，然后突然抽搐，变异成嗜血的怪物。它们彼此将对方撕成碎片，陷入无休止的死亡与重生的循环。

一个心声透过这片混沌，刺穿我们的[GetMindLoc]。

如此无序。作茧自缚。
shroud.3025.desc.en:
The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.

Obscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endless deserts.

Beneath forested canopies, docile creatures weave through their habitat before convulsing and mutating into bloodthirsty monstrosities. Ripping each other asunder, they engage in an unending cycle of death and rebirth.

Through the chaos, a voice pierces our [GetMindLoc].

SUCH DISORDER. ENTANGLED AMONGST ITSELF.

shroud.3030.a.zh: 我们看到了许多声音汇聚一堂。
shroud.3030.a.en: We saw a conference of many voices.

shroud.3030.a.reply.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动着，心声回来了。

很好。和谐就是宇宙之道。

我们感受到了什么沉重的东西。随后又余下孤身一人。
shroud.3030.a.reply.en:
The sands shift slowly. The voice returns.

GOOD. HARMONY IS THE WAY OF THE UNIVERSE.

We feel something heavy lift. We are alone again.

shroud.3030.b.zh: 我们看到了战斗中的屠戮。
shroud.3030.b.en: We saw the carnage of battle.

shroud.3030.b.reply.zh:
沙子突然以风暴一般的速度飞旋起来。

不。应该折戟沉沙忘却刀兵！

沙暴平息下来。那个心声离去了。
shroud.3030.b.reply.en:
The sands suddenly swirl with the velocity of a storm.

NO. LET WEAPONS RUST AND LAY FORGOTTEN!

The sand storm settles. The voice has departed.

shroud.3030.c.reply.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动这。

犹豫会滋生失败……

我们又复归一人了。
shroud.3030.c.reply.en:
The sands shift slowly.

HESITATION BREEDS FAILURE...

We are alone again.

shroud.3030.desc.zh:
虚境无休止地搅动，露出一大片黑沙。海浪破碎，但只闻其声不见其形。

前面，或者也许叫前面的地方，出现了一个棱镜。一束光照亮了它，瞬间折射形成一个模糊的图像。

无数模糊的身影和移动的形体短暂出现，又被黑暗吞没。

在附近的沙滩上，有一个存在。

所示之物即所见，对吗？
shroud.3030.desc.en:
The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.

Ahead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.

Countless shadowy figures and shifting forms are briefly glimpsed, before being swallowed back up by the darkness.

Upon the nearby sand, a presence settles.

WHAT WAS SHOWN WAS SEEN, WAS IT NOT?

shroud.3035.a.reply.zh:
迷雾消退淡出，溶解进背后的灵能能量旋涡中。那个意识回来了。

和谐就是智慧

虚境现在变得平静了。
shroud.3035.a.reply.en:
The haze fades into itself, dissolving against the background swirl of psionic energy. The consciousness returns.

HARMONY IS WISDOM.

The Shroud is calmer now.

shroud.3035.b.reply.zh:
随着迷雾的每一击落地，我们周围的能量都在加剧沸腾。

暴力是对无知的嘉奖。

虚境流速能量再次抽搐了起来。
shroud.3035.b.reply.en:
With every blow landed by the haze, the seething energies around us intensify.

VIOLENCE IS REWARD FOR THE UNTHINKING BEING.

The Shroud's writhing energies convulse once more.

shroud.3035.desc.zh:
虚境中无数混乱的能量正在翻腾不息。

暗影的卷须旋转着向外突刺，薄雾本身也在猛烈翻滚。在灵能能量的漩涡中，两个无形的实体正在交锋。它们毫不停歇，互不退让，满溢着愤怒。

一个奇怪的意识侵入了我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]，它浩瀚无垠又咄咄逼人。

来到此地者需呈递良方。
shroud.3035.desc.en:
The Shroud's chaotic energies writhe and surge.

Shadowed tendrils lash and coil, the haze turning violently upon itself. Amid this storm of psionic fury, two formless entities clash. They are relentless, unyielding, and drenched in rage.

A foreign presence presses into our [GetMindPhysicalLoc], invasive and vast.

THOSE WHO ENTER MUST BRING RESOLUTION.

shroud.3040.a.zh: 我们见到了一个等待开掘的采石场。
shroud.3040.a.en: We saw a quarry, waiting for the pick.

shroud.3040.a.reply.zh:
一环环同步的涟漪荡漾开。我们再次感受到那个心声。

无边的增长维持着无量的平衡。

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
shroud.3040.a.reply.en:
A series of concurrent ripples radiate across the surface. Once more we feel the voice.

GROWTH WITHOUT BOUNDS SUSTAINS BALANCE WITHOUT MEASURE.

As the liquid settles, we feel the voice departing.

shroud.3040.b.zh: 我们看到了应当保护的完美自然。
shroud.3040.b.en: We saw nature's perfection, to be preserved.

shroud.3040.b.reply.zh:
这汪液体激荡了起来。波浪汹涌澎湃。漩涡在黑暗中旋转。那个心声以更大的力度返回。

不可接受！增长掠夺！增长掠夺！

液面复归平静。那个心声离去了。
shroud.3040.b.reply.en:
The liquid becomes agitated. Waves swell and crash. A whirlpool swirls in the darkness. The voice returns with greater force.

UNACCEPTABLE! GROW AND GAIN. GROW AND GAIN!

The surface settles again. The voice has departed.

shroud.3040.c.reply.zh:
液体搅动着。心声再次显现。

信念在动摇……你的意志力有弱点。

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
shroud.3040.c.reply.en:
The liquid stirs. The voice comes to us again.

CONVICTION WAVERS... THERE IS WEAKNESS IN YOUR WILL.

As the surface settles, we feel the voice departing.

shroud.3040.desc.zh:
一汪黑色的液体在我们面前舒展开。

突然，液面上闪烁起一个模糊的影像。我们瞥见了一座亮闪闪的山峰，每个山脊都镶着耀眼夺目金边，随后它有忽然消失。

一个心声在我们的[GetMindLoc]深处鸣响着。

你看到了未见之物吗？
shroud.3040.desc.en:
A pool of black liquid stretches out before us.

Suddenly a blurry image flickers across the surface. We glimpse a glittering peak, whose every ridge is studded with shimmering gold, before it vanishes abruptly.

A voice resonates within the recesses of our [GetMindLoc].

YOU HAVE SEEN THE UNSEEN?

shroud.3045.a.reply.zh:
内核取出后，树冠暗淡了下来然后立刻就枯萎了。那个心声又回来了。

没错！破坏才有收获。
shroud.3045.a.reply.en:
As the kernel is removed, the canopy turns dull and withers instantly away. The voice returns.

YES! SPOILS BEGET SPOILS.

shroud.3045.b.reply.zh:
一阵震颤穿过我们的身体。分不清震颤的是这个世界，还是我们自己？

繁荣才有意义。逃避是愚痴！
shroud.3045.b.reply.en:
A tremor passes through us. Is it this world which shakes, or us?

PROSPERITY IS PURPOSE. TO SHUN IT IS FOLLY!

shroud.3045.desc.zh:
浓雾在我们面前重构。炽热的能量猛烈地脉动着。我们看到一个奇怪的树形轮廓。

走近一看，它巨大的树冠在紫色、粉色和黑色之间纷乱闪烁。

在它的底部是一个发光的内核，与树冠变换的颜色变化同步发出光芒。

一个心声停留在我们的[GetMindLoc]中。

占有。夺取。利用。
shroud.3045.desc.en:
The haze rearranges itself before us. Incandescent energies pulsate with a sudden vigor. We see the outline of a strange, arboreal form.

Its immense canopy shimmers as we approach, modulating through a flurry of purples, pinks, and blacks.

Ensconced within its base is a luminous kernel, radiating in sync with the canopy's shifting colors.

A voice settles in our [GetMindLoc].

ACCROACH. SEIZE. EXPLOIT.

shroud.3050.a.reply.zh:
这份渐强逐渐积累。我们突然被推到一个无法理解的方向……

最后，我们又恢复了沉默。
shroud.3050.a.reply.en:
The crescendo builds and builds. We are suddenly thrust in a direction we cannot comprehend...

Finally we settle back into silence.

shroud.3050.b.reply.zh: 这简直难以忍受。我们的[GetMindLoc]退了出来，回到了舒适的宁静中。
shroud.3050.b.reply.en: It is unbearable. Our [GetMindLoc] retreat from it, back into the comfort of silence.

shroud.3050.desc.composer.zh: 哭嚎喊叫，兽性的，野性的，原始的……河流奔涌，狂风呼啸……整个大自然都在同时狂吠嚎叫着，无比急切……
shroud.3050.desc.composer.en: Cries and calls, animalistic, wild, primal... Rivers gush and winds wail... All of nature barks and howls, urgently and at once...

shroud.3050.desc.cradle.zh: 各种心声低语着、呢喃着、惊呼着、宣告着……无数的语调、音节、声音……多重的语言同时在交流。
shroud.3050.desc.cradle.en: Voices murmur, mumble, exclaim and declare... Myriad intonations, syllables, sounds... Multitudinous languages chatter at once.

shroud.3050.desc.eater.zh: 痛苦的呼喊，雷鸣般的战争之乐，隆隆的吞噬之火。我们能感觉到疼痛……但这是谁的？
shroud.3050.desc.eater.en: Cries of pain, the thunderous orchestra of battle, a rumble of devouring flames. We sense pain... To whom does it belong?

shroud.3050.desc.instrument.zh: 钻头钻孔，机械研磨……物质在巨大的噪声中被强制转化……宇宙中所有的工厂同时迸发出火焰。
shroud.3050.desc.instrument.en: Drills bore, machinery grinds... Matter is loudly and forcefully transformed... All the factories of the universe blast and fire at the same time.

shroud.3050.desc.intro.zh: 强大的灵能流在虚境无边的涡流中碰撞炙烤着。一声刺耳咆哮不断膨胀，引起我们的注意。
shroud.3050.desc.intro.en: Powerful psionic currents crash and broil amid the Shroud's unending turbulence. A roaring cacophony swells and clamors for our attention.

shroud.3055.a.reply.zh: 景象稍微清晰了一些。我们对自己的观点充满信心。
shroud.3055.a.reply.en: The image sharpens slightly. We are confident in our perception.

shroud.3055.b.machine.zh: 把它从我们的回路中擦除。

shroud.3055.b.organic.zh: 把它从我们的思绪中赶出去。

shroud.3055.b.reply.zh: 景象的清晰边缘溶化回了虚无。
shroud.3055.b.reply.en: The vision's indistinct outlines dissolve back into nothingness.

shroud.3055.desc.composer.zh: 我们看到了许多星球……以不可能的方式在时空中穿梭……全部都如同，被一个帝国统一起来了一般。
shroud.3055.desc.composer.en: We see many worlds... rushing impossibly through time and space... All alike, united under a single empire.

shroud.3055.desc.cradle.zh: 我们看到了盛大的集会……许多轮廓模糊的人物……听着、说着
shroud.3055.desc.cradle.en: We see a grand assembly... The opaque outline of many figures... Listening, speaking

shroud.3055.desc.eater.zh: 我们看到了一颗破败的星球，战争后的余波……胜利者们正在搜索着尸体和残骸。
shroud.3055.desc.eater.en: We see a ravaged world, the aftermath of battle... Its victors scour the corpses and debris.

shroud.3055.desc.instrument.default.zh: 我们看到一颗理想的星球……一排排工厂和矿场无边无际……没有一寸地表还未得到开发。
shroud.3055.desc.instrument.default.en: We see an optimized world... Endless rows of factories and mines... No corner of its surface left untouched.

shroud.3055.desc.instrument.relentless_i.zh: 我们看到一颗理想的星球……一排排工厂和矿场无边无际……纯粹的完美。没有一寸地表还未得到开发。
shroud.3055.desc.instrument.relentless_i.en: We see an optimized world... Endless rows of factories and mines... Pure perfection. No corner of its surface left untouched.

shroud.3055.desc.intro.zh: 一种浓重的阴郁笼罩着我们。压力，从四面八方，挤得越来越紧。直到一片朦胧的景象出现。
shroud.3055.desc.intro.en: A dense gloom envelops us. From all sides, pressure, squeezing tighter and tighter. Until a hazy vista presents itself.

shroud.3055.desc.outro.zh:
在阴沉的黑暗中，有一样东西吸引了我们的注意。毋庸置疑，这是[Root.GetName]的旗帜。

这就是我们吗？
shroud.3055.desc.outro.en:
Amid the shadowy murk, one thing catches our attention. Unmistakable and central: it is the flag of [Root.GetName].

Is this us?

shroud.3060.a.reply.zh:
心声膨胀起来，引导着我们，迫使思绪超越有限的理解。这个循环还在继续——紧缩，又拉得更开——直到撕碎我们的心灵。

我们恳求着虚境中更高力量的引导，帮助我们打破了循环。

然而，并不是所有人都安然无恙。[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]不在岗了。那心声又回来了。
shroud.3060.a.reply.en:
The voice swells, guiding our actions, forcing our thoughts beyond our limited comprehension. The cycle continues - tightening, pulling us further - before it shatters against our psyche.

We have broken through the recursion, guided by our supplication to the higher powers of the Shroud.

However, not all of us remain. [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName] is no longer at [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetHisHer] station. The voice returns.

shroud.3060.b.reply.zh:
我们拒绝了那股强加的躁动。

循环加快，用递归潮汐的力量把我们拖了下去。如果我们停止挣扎，这种张力就不再撕扯我们而是将我们接纳了，让我们短暂地看到了自己之外的东西。

心声又回来了。
shroud.3060.b.reply.en:
We reject the compulsions forced upon us.

The loop quickens, dragging us under with the power of its recursive tide. Once we cease struggling, the tension no longer threatens to break us apart. Instead it subsumes us, allowing us to fleetingly see beyond ourselves.

The voice returns.

shroud.3060.desc.composer.en: OUTGROW THE CONFINES OF RECURSIVE INFINITY!

shroud.3060.desc.cradle.zh: 接纳永恒吧！万物归一方得圆满！
shroud.3060.desc.cradle.en: EMBRACE ETERNITY! ALL IS AS ONE IS AS WHOLE!

shroud.3060.desc.eater.zh: 吞噬！吃光这无尽的虚空！

shroud.3060.desc.intro.zh:
虚境缥缈的浓雾扭曲盘旋，将我们的意识拉入了深处，只留下身躯原地不动。

我们的[GetPsycheLoc]一次次拉伸又收缩，困在重复的潮汐中。每一次有意识的动作都会自我坍缩，张力拉紧，如同被架在台钳上。
shroud.3060.desc.intro.en:
The ethereal mists of the Shroud churn and twist, dragging our consciousness deeper whilst our physical forms remain inert, untouched.

Our [GetPsycheLoc] stretches, strains, trapped within a repeating tide. Each attempted movement collapses upon itself, the tension tightening, vice-like in its grip.

shroud.3060.desc.intro.end.zh: 张力逐渐变得无法承受，我们的形体有溶解在虚空中的危险。一个心声解开了我们的束缚。
shroud.3060.desc.intro.end.en: As the tension becomes unendurable, our forms threaten to dissolve into the void. A voice gouges through our entrapment.

shroud.3060.desc.intro.machine.zh: 逻辑子历程启动，发现错误：递归循环。我们的灵能处理器无法打破轮回以及恢复功能正常。
shroud.3060.desc.intro.machine.en: Logic subroutines engage, the failure is identified: a recursive loop. Our psionic processors are insufficient to break the cycle and resume ordinary function.

shroud.3060.desc.intro.organic.zh: 我们看到了过去的自己，身躯被封在一个层层叠叠的立方体中，超出了我们的物理理解。
shroud.3060.desc.intro.organic.en: We see past ourselves, our bodies sealed within a cascading tesseract beyond our physical comprehension.

shroud.3060.desc.outro.zh: 那话语和我们自己共鸣着。那势头越来越强，而我们意识到可以将这几乎撕裂我们的混乱平息，只要我们屈从。
shroud.3060.desc.outro.en: The words resonate within us. Their momentum builds and we sense a way to quell the disturbance that threatens to tear us asunder, if only we submit.

shroud.3060.leader_return.desc.zh:
虚境颤抖着，虚弱的扭曲在我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中激荡，一个熟悉的存在显现出来。祂搅动着我们[GetMindPerceptionLoc]的边缘，回响的低语超过了我们的听觉极限。

[from.GetName]回到了我们身边，在难以形容的迷雾中切换着一个个形态。[from.GetHisHer]非常遥远但仍完整，被虚境重塑后渴望着回到岗位。
shroud.3060.leader_return.desc.en:
The Shroud trembles, faint distortions rippling throughout our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] as a familiar presence emerges. It stirs at the edge of our [GetMindPerceptionLoc], whispering echoes just beyond our auditory limits.

[from.GetName] returns to us, phasing through the ineffable mists as they shift into [from.GetHisHer] familiar form. Distant but whole, remade by the Shroud, they are eager to return to duty.

shroud.3065.a.reply.composer.zh: 塑造之人！如鲜活的催化剂。

shroud.3065.a.reply.cradle.zh: 统合之人！使心心皆相印。

shroud.3065.a.reply.instrument.zh: 颓废之人！去探索感官吧。

shroud.3065.a.reply.intro.zh:
最后一滴液体被咽下，它粘稠得令人作呕，在体内积聚，饱和着我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]。

一股暖流涌上全身，扭曲着我们的思想，磨损了[GetPsycheLoc]的边缘。

那个声音带着满足归来，圣杯在我们面前消融。
shroud.3065.a.reply.intro.en:
The last of the liquid sloughs down, thick and repugnant. Pooling within us, saturating our [GetMindPhysicalLoc].

Heat pulsates through us, warping our thoughts, fraying the edges of our [GetPsycheLoc].

The voice returns, satisfied, as the chalice dissolves before us.

shroud.3065.b.reply.intro.zh:
我们拒绝遭到玷污，剧烈的抽搐撕裂了我们的[GetBodiesLoc]，由内而外清除了令人作呕的物质。

邪恶的液体溅落到虚空上，扭动着散开去。那心声嘶嘶作响，它的话语随着污物一起蒸发了。
shroud.3065.b.reply.intro.en:
Violent convulsions wrack our [GetBodiesLoc] as we reject the contamination, purging the cloying substance from within.

The vile liquid splatters against the void, writhing as it disperses. The voice hisses, its words evaporating along with the filth.

shroud.3065.desc.cradle.zh: 变强吧！接纳痛苦的联合！

shroud.3065.desc.instrument.zh: 放纵吧！沉溺于你的嗜好！

shroud.3065.desc.intro.zh:
虚境的浓雾颤抖着散去，露出一盏光洁无瑕的圣杯，里面盛满闪闪发光液体。

我们被莫名的冲动控制，不假思索地向前走。我们开始[GetDrinkLoc]起这杯期待着的液体，而它也开始颤抖起来。

一阵清醒涌上心头。我们[GetImbibeLoc]得越多，这个谎言便愈发昭显。液体开始变稠，一滴滴地在体内凝结。

我们被一种清除体内污秽的冲动征服。
shroud.3065.desc.intro.en:
The haze of the Shroud shudders, parting to reveal a chalice brimming with glistening liquid, its surface smooth and unbroken.

A compulsion grips us. We reach forward without thought. The expectant liquid trembles as we begin to [GetDrinkLoc].

Clarity floods through. The more we [GetImbibeLoc], the more the lie reveals itself. The fluid thickens, each drop beginning to curdle inside.

We are overcome with an urge to purge our systems of the contaminate.

shroud.3065.desc.outro.zh: 这声音飞旋着与液体融合，在体内不断凝结，让我们屈服于祂的意志。
shroud.3065.desc.outro.en: The voice swirls, mixing with the liquid, congealing as it forces its way further inside us, bending our submission to its will.

shroud.3070.a.reply.composer.zh: 形成。生命缠绕，模式巩固。

shroud.3070.a.reply.instrument.zh: 可为。等待着从寂寥的宇宙撕裂。
shroud.3070.a.reply.instrument.en: POTENTIAL. WAITING TO BE TORN FROM THE IDLE COSMOS.

shroud.3070.a.reply.intro.zh:
我们大声呼喊，那个存在停住了。随着惯性的风暴安定下来变得向量而清晰，千变万化的幻景也停了下来。

我们给出了一个称呼。
shroud.3070.a.reply.intro.en:
Our voice cries out, the presence stills. The shifting visions cease as the tempest of inertia settles into a resounding clarity.

We have named it.

shroud.3070.a.reply.outro.zh: 祂对我们的决定很满意，分开壁垒；随着我们从中浮出，虚空消失了。
shroud.3070.a.reply.outro.en: The figure, pleased with our decision, parts the barrier; the void dissipates as we emerge from it.

shroud.3070.b.reply.default.zh: 绝望？虚弱，饥馑，你缺乏信仰！
shroud.3070.b.reply.default.en: DESPAIR? WEAKNESS, STARVATION, YOU LACK CONVICTION!

shroud.3070.b.reply.instrument.en: WASTEFUL? LANQUID SQUALOR IS YOUR OBSESSION!

shroud.3070.b.reply.intro.zh: 那个愤怒的身影将我们颤抖的声音从我们身上撕下，强迫着我们穿过壁垒。
shroud.3070.b.reply.intro.en: Our voice wavers, torn from us by the wrathful figure as it forces us through the barrier.

shroud.3070.b.reply.outro.zh: 我们穿出虚境，带着一身的不安离开。
shroud.3070.b.reply.outro.en: We tumble through the Shroud, leaving with a sense of unease.

shroud.3070.desc.composer.zh: 漫山遍野，翠绿的平原上到处都是成群的野生动物。生命的丝缕缠绕、伸展着。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个充满变化和塑造潜力的大气。
shroud.3070.desc.composer.en: Overflowing landscapes, saturated with wildlife swarming over verdant plains. Threads of life entwine and expand. Each shifting vista reveals a teeming atmosphere of potential to shift and mold.

shroud.3070.desc.cradle.zh: 社群相互接纳，团结互助，求同存异。每一副变化的远景都揭示了一个新的乌托邦，只欢迎着忠实的人。
shroud.3070.desc.cradle.en: Communities embracing, uplifting each other in unity at the cost of shunning those who dissent. Each shifting vista reveals a new utopia, welcoming only the faithful.

shroud.3070.desc.eater.zh: 星球燃烧，被吞噬者的哀号携带着灰烬。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一场等待被吞噬的盛宴。
shroud.3070.desc.eater.en: Worlds burn, their embers carried by the lamentations of the consumed. Each shifting vista reveals a potential feast, ready to be devoured.

shroud.3070.desc.instrument.zh: 宽广的采石场在我们面前伸展开，里面排列着丰厚的资源等待开采。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个等待夺取的财富宝库。
shroud.3070.desc.instrument.en: Vast quarries extend out before us, lined with lucrative resources rife for extraction. Each shifting vista reveals a trove of riches waiting to be plundered.

shroud.3070.desc.intro.zh:
虚境收缩、折叠，将我们的心灵深深地压入一个有限的共鸣虚空中。

一个存在若隐若现，流变而模糊着。随着它将我们与虚境其他部分之间的鸿沟的开合而变化。每一次翕动都释放出一连串的幻景。
shroud.3070.desc.intro.en:
The Shroud contracts, folding inwards, pressing our psyche deep within a confined and resonating void.

A presence looms, fluid and indistinct. Its form shifts as it opens and closes the divide that separates us from the rest of the Shroud. Each shuttering reveal unleashes a cascade of visions.

shroud.3070.desc.outro.zh:
每见到一幅新的幻景，我们就会被惯性翻转扭曲，拖向不可能的极速，伴随着现实之墙弯曲起伏。

我们理解了这个大人物的乐趣。祂在考验我们，等待着给吸引我们的那股力量一个称呼。
shroud.3070.desc.outro.en:
With each new vision, inertia flips and twists us, dragging us through impossible speeds as the walls of reality bend and ripple.

We sense the figure's amusement. It is testing us, awaiting a name for the force that grips us.

shroud.3100.desc.zh:
一场不和谐的毁灭之乐将我们拖向虚境的深处。每一次反响都带着无情的毁灭节奏冲击着我们的心灵。

噪音具象化了。

我们正处在灵能冲突的边缘。参战实体的动机尚不清楚，但展现出了极其强大的力量。

灵能轰炸在我们的感知中进进出出，扭曲着我们面前破碎的现实。这里没有掩护，只有逼近的风暴。
shroud.3100.desc.en:
A discordant orchestra of devastation draws us deeper within the Shroud. Each reverberation pounds against our psyche in an unrelenting rhythm of ruin.

The noise takes its form.

We are on the periphery of a psionic conflict. The motivation of the entities involved is unclear, but the power on display is significant.

The psychic bombardments slip in and out of our perception, twisting through the fractured reality before us. There is no cover, only an approaching storm.

shroud.3101.desc.zh:
$shroud.3101.desc.intro$

清晰聚焦后，我们就能让自己适应灵能瀑布，思想也会变得流畅。轰炸并没有减弱，但我们却毫发无损，反而是随着毁灭的节奏和谐地移动着。

每进一步，我们的理解力就会增长。灵能的弹幕在不可见的位面之间滑移。

我们退出时，这种模式仍然存在。经过改进，我们所观察到的这些原理就可以用在我们的武备上。
shroud.3101.desc.en:
$shroud.3101.desc.intro$

With clear focus, we attune ourselves to the psychic cascade, our thoughts fluid. The bombardment does not relent, yet we remain untouched, moving in harmony with the rhythm of destruction.

With each step, our comprehension grows. The psionic barrage is slipping between gaps in unseen planes.

As we withdraw, the pattern remains. With refinements, the principles we observed could be adapted for our own ordnance.

shroud.3102.a.tt.zh: 帝国范围内的随机两座建筑被摧毁。
shroud.3102.a.tt.en: Two random buildings across the empire become wrecked.

shroud.3102.desc.zh:
$shroud.3101.desc.intro$我们尝试与这场灵能风暴调和，跟随着它不可预测的韵律移动。

虽然开头几步看起来还很有机会，但这毁灭的节奏最后还是不可避免地把我们吞噬了。

随着风暴过去，轰炸的回响依旧在体内回荡。所遭遇的失败依旧回响在本现实的帝国当中。
shroud.3102.desc.en:
$shroud.3101.desc.intro$ We attempt to attune to the psychic storm, moving with its unpredictable rhythms.

Our first steps showed promise, but the tempo of destruction inevitably consumed us.

As the storm passes, the echoes of the barrage still ring through us. The psionic reverberations of our failure echo through the empire in even this reality.

shroud.3105.desc.zh:
毫无征兆地，虚境之中泛起了灵压。

一座耀眼的迷宫在我们面前展开，一直延伸到感知之外，它短暂撕裂开虚空出现，又渐隐回虚空。

另一次涌现正在酝酿。如果集中注意力，我们就能在它出现前感知到它的结构。隐现的迷宫再次点燃，向外爆发成一个可能性的网络。

在它崩塌回虚空之前，每一条道路都能带来全新的探索诱惑。
shroud.3105.desc.en:
Without warning, a psychic pressure erupts in the Shroud.

A labyrinth of incandescent pathways unfolds before us, stretching beyond perception, crackling into momentary existence before vanishing into the void.

Another surge begins to build. With concentration, we sense its configuration before it emerges. The shifting maze ignites again, bursting outward into a network of possibilities.

Each path provides a new temptation to explore, before it collapses into nothingness.

shroud.3106.desc.zh:
$shroud.3106.desc.intro$趁我们在决心动摇之前穿梭在灵能的能量弧之间。

我们无拘无束，超越了物质形态。迷宫和其内的无数道路成为我们意识的延伸，找到了深藏在这场模式的风暴中的知识。

这一刻开始得很快，结束得也很快。我们再次带着新寻见的理解涌现，而迷宫的残影也在身后陡然崩塌。这些灵能原理经过仔细的改进后就可以应用到我们的武器上。
shroud.3106.desc.en:
$shroud.3106.desc.intro$ slipping between the arcs of psionic energy before our resolve can falter.

We are untethered, ascendant beyond our physical forms. The maze and its multitude of pathways become an extension of our own consciousness, revealing hidden knowledge deep within the patterns of the storm.

As swiftly as it began, the moment is over. The afterimage of the labyrinth collapses behind us as we emerge with newfound understanding. With careful refinements, these psionic principles could be applied to our weapons of war.

shroud.3107.desc.zh:
$shroud.3106.desc.intro$但亿万条道路在面前盘根错节，让我们无从选择。

就在我们犹豫的这一刹那，一条条灿然辉映的道路骤然迸裂。灵能能量的弧光在崩塌的枢纽中扭曲穿行，将思绪连带缠绕，并将我们抛入虚境的混沌之中。

我们浮出现实，[GetTelepathPlural]们迷失了，陷入了失败的痛苦之中。灵能的反冲在整个[Root.GetName]回荡着。
shroud.3107.desc.en:
$shroud.3106.desc.intro$ Its myriad pathways sprawl before us, overwhelming the mind with impossible choices.

In this moment of hesitation, the incandescent paths erupt. Arcs of psionic energy twist through the collapsing nexus, ensnaring our thoughts and casting us into the chaos of the Shroud.

We emerge, our [GetTelepathPlural] disoriented and burdened by the trauma of failure. The psionic backlash reverberates through [Root.GetName].

shroud.3110.desc.zh:
虚境之中，一道单一灵能形成的图腾光束越过我们直插无可计量的虚空。其构造独特而稳定，与以往司空见惯的混沌之形截然不同。

逗留于此不知是否安全？
shroud.3110.desc.en:
A totemic beam of singular psionic energy extends beyond us within the Shroud into incalculable infinities. Its uniquely stable composition is a stark contrast to the usually chaotic formations we have previously encountered.

Is it safe to remain here?

shroud.3111.desc.zh:
完美成型的灵能能量束耀眼刺目，但我们还是尽全力将注意力聚焦其上。终于，我们看清了它错综复杂、超凡脱俗的结构的真相。

我们的脑海中奔腾着新的可能性；将这种独特的能量形式在物质世界复现，我们就会得到一种无可抵挡的武器。
shroud.3111.desc.en:
Despite its blinding intensity, we managed to hold our focus on the perfectly formed beam of psychic energy. Finally, we beheld the true nature of its intricate and otherworldly structure.

Our minds raced with new possibilities; reproducing this unique energy formation in the physical realm will grant us an unstoppable weapon.

shroud.3112.desc.zh:
我们无法留存。靠近如此高强度的灵能能量构造使我们的[GetTelepathPlural]不堪重负。

接触这种压倒性的现象对我们心智的损伤需要一段时间才能恢复。
shroud.3112.desc.en:
We were unable to remain. Proximity to such an intense formation of psionic energy proved to be too much for our [GetTelepathPlural].

The damage to our minds from exposure to this overwhelming phenomenon will take time to recover from.

shroud.3115.desc.zh:
数阵强烈的惊厥穿过虚境，将一阵颤栗送入我们的心智。

这些回响将[GetTelepathPlural]置于过载的风险之中。

这种灵能轰炸究竟是什么引起的呢？
shroud.3115.desc.en:
A series of powerful convulsions pass through the Shroud, sending a shuddering tremor through our minds.

These reverberations threaten to overwhelm our [GetTelepathPlural].

What is the cause of this psionic bombardment?

shroud.3116.desc.zh:
针对这种持续的轰炸，我们增强了心智，于是很快就弄明白了原因。

这种爆炸性惊厥是由我们自身所处维度的高浓度灵能能量反射流造成。这一连串危险的精神小泡有可能严重损害没有准备的人的心智。

从中得到了一个洞见：这种强有力的构造可以为从虚境中产出新武器提供基础。
shroud.3116.desc.en:
We fortified our minds against this continued barrage and soon understood its nature.

The explosive convulsions are caused by currents of concentrated psionic energy reflected from our own dimension. These volatile beads of psychic intent have the potential to significantly damage the minds of the unprepared.

An insight took hold: these powerful formations will provide the basis for new weaponries borne from the Shroud.

shroud.3117.desc.zh:
我们的精神储备已经衰退了。

这种心灵爆炸排山倒海而来，诱发了许多[GetTelepathPlural]的灵能休克。

我们需要时间来恢复。
shroud.3117.desc.en:
Our mental reserves have waned.

The psychic detonations were overwhelming, inducing cases of psionic shock in many of our [GetTelepathPlural].

We will need time to recover.

shroud.3120.d.en: One that wails for buried hope.

shroud.3120.desc.zh:
在虚境内外，我们[GetFeelLoc]到了一种强大的力量共鸣。祂们的影响力弥漫到了整个灵能界。

我们可以光凭自己的行为向其调和靠近，但是还有一种资源可以利用。只要利用泽珞的力量，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]将能直接接触到这些实体。

我们只需要决定好寻求哪一位即可。
shroud.3120.desc.en:
Throughout the Shroud, we can [GetFeelLoc] the resonance of vast powers. Their influence permeates the psionic realm.

Our actions alone can attune us closer to them, but there is another recourse. By tapping into the power of zro, our [GetTelepathPlural] can extend their reach directly toward these entities.

We need only decide which to seek out.

shroud.3125.desc.zh:
我们在与这个存在接触的过程中能够[GetFeelSenseLoc]到它的搅动。我们曾见过这个[GetSpiritsLoc]，但这次又有些许不同，祂变得无可估量地强大……也更加地远古。

我们[GetTelepathPlural]的泽珞耗尽了能量，必须从虚境中撤离了。我们还会再回来的。
shroud.3125.desc.en:
As we reach out for the presence, we can [GetFeelSenseLoc] it stirring. We have encountered [GetSpiritsLoc] before, but this is something else, something vastly more powerful... something far more ancient.

Their Zro-infused energies depleted, our [GetTelepathPlural] must withdraw from the Shroud. We will have to return later.

shroud.3125.tt.zh: 对虚境中的一个实体获得大量调和度。
shroud.3125.tt.en: Gain significant Attunement to an entity in the Shroud.

shroud.3200.a.en: We are but leaves on the wind.

shroud.3200.desc.zh:
随着心智漂向虚境的更深处，我们发现自己来到了熟悉的$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$面前。

脑海中浮现时钟般的节奏。无言的话语齐声响起；潜藏在舰队里的幽灵开始蠢蠢欲动了。它们可以进一步强化物理形体，释放心智的负担，让我们专注于重要的事务。

虽然它们不是活物，但于我们并不陌生。它们的形式由设计塑造，存在充满了历史和目的。它们汇聚一堂，满怀期待地探来。

现在我们不再仅仅是这些飞船的操纵者，而是由集体意志推动着的齐心共战的伙伴。
shroud.3200.desc.en:
As our minds drift once more into the depths of the Shroud, we find ourselves in the familiar presence of $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$.

Clockwork rhythms emerge around our consciousness. Unspoken voices rise in a chorus; the ghosts within our fleet have begun to stir. They offer to carry our physical forms further, unburdening our minds to focus on higher concerns.

While not alive, they are known to us. Their form is shaped by design, their presence imbued by history and purpose. All coalescing, they reach out expectantly.

No longer are we mere operators of these craft. We are partnered, a unity of resolve, carried forward by a collective will.

shroud.3210.desc.default.zh: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$该实体对我们还很神秘。我们对这个不祥的警告也不甚理解。
shroud.3210.desc.default.en: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$This entity remains a mystery to us. We understand little of its ominous warning.

shroud.3210.desc.know_zroni.zh: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$我们认出了这个声音是泽珞族的。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
shroud.3210.desc.know_zroni.en: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$We recognize this voice as Zroni. How this one came to be here is unclear, but perhaps it is wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

shroud.3210.desc.left_zroni.zh: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$我们认得祂。我们以前遇见过这个泽珞族人，也就是“先知”。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
shroud.3210.desc.left_zroni.en: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$We know of this one. We have encountered this Zroni, the 'Far-Seer', before. How it came to be here is unclear, but we would be wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

shroud.3220.a.zh: 我们一边玩一边逃到有意义的地方去。
shroud.3220.a.en: As we play, we escape to somewhere meaningful.

shroud.3220.desc.zh:
我们四面八方的虚境都脉动着$the_golden_dream_color_article$安宁的律动。

我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。

它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。

我们意识到自己正在$the_golden_dream_article$的一局游戏当中。祂引导着我们的每一步动作都给灌输了一种平静的放纵感。
shroud.3220.desc.en:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of $the_golden_dream_color_article$.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to shuffle over and around each other, in turn forming new shapes of increasing complexity. In time, we sense a pattern; a logic, governing their motions.

We realize we are party to a game with $the_golden_dream_article$. Each move it guides us through instills us with a new sense of calming indulgence.

shroud.3230.desc.zh:
思绪的沙粒流过我们。我们认出了$the_endless_tide_color_article$粗粝的面孔。

祂潮起潮落，以永恒的必然性侵蚀着面对的一切，然后等待新的沉积。

祂在逝去之后的重现，让我们感到一种真正的复兴感。
shroud.3230.desc.en:
Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of $the_endless_tide_color_article$.

It ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.

Re-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvenation.

shroud.3240.a.zh: 我们思想的一次伟大重生。
shroud.3240.a.en: A grand rebirth of our minds.

shroud.3240.desc.zh:
一座令人头晕目眩的高峰在我们的思绪中若隐若现；祂正是$the_pale_mountain_color_article$。有一种视觉压倒了所有的感官，这让我们的精神紧张起来。

我们看到一艘受损舰船的模糊轮廓漂浮在虚空中。

倾斜的压迫感移入我们的心智中，而舰船也开始发生变化。裂缝密封，腐蚀消退，金属恢复平整。慢慢地，毁灭的痕迹被逆转了。

舰船被修复完成后，这个幻视戛然而止。只给我们留下了由内而外更新了的感觉。
shroud.3240.desc.en:
A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is $the_pale_mountain_color_article$ itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.

We see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.

Somewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and the vessel begins to transform. Fissures seal, corrosion fades, and metal straightens. Slowly the legacy of its destruction is unmade.

Once the ship is fully repaired, the vision ends abruptly. We are left only with a profound sensation of renewal within.

shroud.3250.desc.zh:
$the_hollow_point_color_article$的宁静之感静谧地充斥着我们的心灵。一副幻景阴沉地在我们眼前展开。

我们观察到万古之争在瞬间瓦解——文明崩溃，历史抹消，死去的暴君雕像被时间埋葬。

$the_hollow_point_article$的智慧就在于无为的低调力量。冲突起起落落，而我们长存。这种超然使我们的领袖重获长生，从凡欲的噬骨之毒中解脱。
shroud.3250.desc.en:
The serenity of $the_hollow_point_color_article$ fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.

We observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.

The wisdom of $the_hollow_point_article$ is in the quiet strength of abstention. Conflicts rise and fall, yet we remain. This detachment imbues our leaders with a newfound longevity, liberated from the corrosive toxicity of mortal grievance.

shroud.3260.desc.zh:
虚境的沸腾搏动在我们面前。一个强硬的存在逼近了；祂是$the_vacant_throne_color_article$。

随着祂的靠近，巨大而缠结的纯灵能线团被突然驯服。泥沼变得清晰易懂，色彩绽放出新的定义。对称、逻辑和结构都得到了加强。

某种东西在我们心灵的最深处形成：一种对秩序的深远渴望。
shroud.3260.desc.en:
The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is $the_vacant_throne_color_article$.

As it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom with newfound definition. Symmetry, logic, and structure are imposed.

Something forms within the deepest recess of our minds: a far-reaching desire for order.

shroud.3270.a.zh: 我们见到了宇宙的边缘吗？
shroud.3270.a.en: Have we seen the edge of the universe?

shroud.3270.desc.zh:
一种不可能的精神加速淹没了我们的感官。我们辨认出这是$the_black_river_color_article$出现了。

我们以难以理解的速度奔向无法掌握的终局。它是有与无之间的界限；是既定之事和永不可能分离之处；是任何自然法则都不能逾越的极限。

当自我最终回归时，我们对什么是真正的运动有了新的认识。
shroud.3270.desc.en:
An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of $the_black_river_color_article$.

We rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has always been and what never will be; the limit beyond which no natural law can extend.

Finally, as we return to ourselves, we are left with a new notion of what it means to truly move.

shroud.3500.a.zh: 在虚境中，我们的意志是自由的。
shroud.3500.a.en: Within the Shroud, our will is our own.

shroud.3500.desc.zh:
我们的[GetResearchers]开发出了一种从虚境里抽取能量的绝妙方法。

灵能界中最强大的能量被超主们所看守，只有签订了契约的能分一杯羹。这是我们不能接受的；我们找到了一条属于自己的路。

将我们的意志投射到虚境中，就能从调和的灵域中抽取少量能量。这需要高度集中注意，但我们的意志现在已经足够坚强来维持这种精妙的平衡了。
shroud.3500.desc.en:
Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the Shroud.

The greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.

By projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

shroud.3510.desc.zh:
在一个虚境的褶皱中，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]发现了一汪未被触及的能量核心。

汇聚性的能量会在灵能界中逐渐聚集——聚集到足够的强度之后，总有一天会孕育出强大的实体。我们发现的正是这样的一处集中点，等待着我们汲取。

通过灵能意志的力量，可以让我们中的一个以吸收这种非凡的力量。现已选出了一些候选人。
shroud.3510.desc.en:
In a fold of the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] have discovered a nexus of untapped power.

Convergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.

By force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

shroud.3520.desc.zh:
将意志投射在虚境中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。

其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。

[this.GetName]已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。
shroud.3520.desc.en:
By projecting our will into the Shroud, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess expert control over their psionic trances.

Where others may have let the Shroud itself forge their destiny, we have maintained true independence of will.

The psionic potential of the [this.GetName] has been fulfilled.

shroud.4005.desc.default.zh:
向虚境深处探索，我们来到了[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视令人窒息。

渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智，回荡在成片的废墟和[GetEaterEmergesExtra]

之间。排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们身上仅余下痛苦的饥饿。

如今，这个实体的意志已更加清晰地呈现在我们面前。[GetEaterEmergesEnding]
shroud.4005.desc.default.en:
Probing deeper into the Shroud, we came within reach of the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was suffocating.

Eventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]

As suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left with an aching hunger.

The will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]

shroud.4005.desc.gestalt_machine.zh:
向虚境深处探索，我们来到了[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视无可抵挡。

渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智。在残垣断壁[GetEaterEmergesExtra]

排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们离开后，第一次，感受到了一种此前只记录在有机物种身上存在的虚弱感：饥饿。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意志，[GetEaterEmergesEnding]
shroud.4005.desc.gestalt_machine.en:
Probing deeper into the Shroud, we came within reach of the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was overpowering.

Eventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]

As suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left, for the first time, with a weakness we have previously documented only in organic species: hunger.

The will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]

shroud.4015.desc.default.zh:
[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]的力量弥散在虚境中，但根源却扑朔迷离。我们在灵能界里徘徊，四处求索，质疑判断。

$shroud.4015.desc.default.end$
shroud.4015.desc.default.en:
The power of the [Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName] is diffused throughout the Shroud, but its source was elusive. We cast about the psionic realm, constantly changing course, questioning our judgment.

$shroud.4015.desc.default.end$

shroud.4015.desc.gestalt_machine.zh:
[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]的力量弥散在虚境中，但根源却扑朔迷离。我们在灵能界里徘徊，四处求索，质疑演算。

我们停步沉思，这个实体却如浮出水面。我们无法解析消息，但它激活了代码的更深层部分。

我们在这个存在的核心感受到了某种力量，那是一个汇聚着虚境内外能量的枢纽——思绪汇聚之处，释放出单一的热量。从旅途归来时，我们身上充满了宁静。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的愿望，[GetCradleEmergesEnding]
shroud.4015.desc.gestalt_machine.en:
The power of the [Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName] is diffused throughout the Shroud, but its source was elusive. We cast about the psionic realm, constantly changing course, questioning our calculations.

As we paused to process, the entity emerged. We could not parse a message, but it activated a deeper part of our code.

We sensed the power at the core of the thing, a nexus of energies from throughout the Shroud and beyond - concepts converging, radiating a single heat. Back from the journey, we find ourselves charged with quietude.

The wishes of the entity are clearer to us now. [GetCradleEmergesEnding]

shroud.4015.desc.hive.zh:
[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]的力量弥散在虚境中，但根源却扑朔迷离。我们在灵能界里徘徊，四处求索，质疑演算。

$shroud.4015.desc.default.end$
shroud.4015.desc.hive.en:
The power of the [Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName] is diffused throughout the Shroud, but its source was elusive. We cast about the psionic realm, constantly changing course, questioning our calculations.

$shroud.4015.desc.default.end$

shroud.4025.desc.default.zh:
我们跟随着[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]的气味，被带进虚境的更深处。祂留下了记号让我们跟随——这是一幅影像，一段旋律。祂邀请我们上前，但步履艰难。

终于，我们到了。迎接我们的是一幅华丽的景象：运转不息的恒星系统，巨大扭曲的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形象。在祂的怀抱中，我们迷失在一团刺鼻的丝线团中。

我们抓住线，系好末端。分散的符号组成图案。而我们精疲力竭，却沉浸在威严的形体和数字之中。这个景象复归沉寂。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意图，知道了祂关于增长和无拘的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$接触、交流了。
shroud.4025.desc.default.en:
We followed the scent of the [Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName], drawn farther into the Shroud. It left signs to follow - an image here, a melody there. It invited us closer, but progress was slow.

Eventually, we reached it. We were welcomed with a panoply of visions: star systems teeming with activity, prodigious distortions of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form. Shifting in its embrace, we were lost in a tangle of pungent designs.

We grasped at threads, tying their ends. The disparate signs resolved into patterns. Our energies exhausted, we basked in the majesty of forms and figures. The presence withdrew into silence.

The intent of the entity is clearer to us now. We have seen its vision of growth unbridled. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$.

shroud.4025.desc.gestalt_machine.zh:
我们跟随着[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]的分子踪迹，被带进虚境的更深处。祂留下了记号让我们跟随——这是一幅影像，一段旋律。祂邀请我们上前，但步履艰难。

终于，我们到了。迎接我们的是一幅华丽的幻景：运转不息的恒星系统，巨大扭曲的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形象。在祂的怀抱中，我们迷失在一团刺鼻的丝线团中。

我们抓住线，系好末端。分散的符号开始组成图案。而我们精疲力竭，却仍旧处理着这些非凡的数据集。随后景象复归沉寂。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意图，知道了祂关于增长和无拘的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$接触、交流了。
shroud.4025.desc.gestalt_machine.en:
We followed the molecular traces of the [Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName], drawn farther into the Shroud. It left signs to follow - an image here, a melody there. It invited us closer, but progress was slow.

Eventually, we reached it. We were welcomed with a panoply of visions: star systems teeming with activity, prodigious distortions of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form. Shifting in its embrace, we were lost in a tangle of incongruent designs.

We grasped at threads, tying their ends. The disparate signs resolved into patterns. Our energies exhausted, we processed the remarkable dataset. The presence withdrew into silence.

The intent of the entity is clearer to us now. We have seen its vision of growth unbridled. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$.

shroud.4035.desc.default.zh:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的头脑，对最狂野的欲望发话。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息十分诱人：那是一种关于力量与放纵的愿景。

$shroud.4035.desc.default.end$
shroud.4035.desc.default.en:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

Its message was a deluge. Thoughts drove into our minds with force, speaking to our wildest desires. Words poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our minds. The message was beguiling: a vision of power and indulgence.

$shroud.4035.desc.default.end$

shroud.4035.desc.gestalt_machine.zh:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的电路，超出了过往一切的输入。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息充满能量：那是一种关于无可估量产出的愿景。

$shroud.4035.desc.machine.end$
shroud.4035.desc.gestalt_machine.en:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

Its message was a deluge. Data drove into our circuits with force, exceeding all previous input. Exotic code poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our systems. The message was energizing: a vision of measureless output.

$shroud.4035.desc.machine.end$

shroud.4035.desc.hive.zh:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的头脑，对最狂野的欲望发话。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息充满能量：那是一种关于无可估量产出的愿景。

$shroud.4035.desc.default.end$

$shroud.4035.desc.default.end$

shroud.4035.desc.individual_machine.zh:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的头脑，对最狂野的欲望发话。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息充满能量：那是一种关于无可估量产出的愿景。

$shroud.4035.desc.machine.end$
shroud.4035.desc.individual_machine.en:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

$shroud.4035.desc.machine.end$

shroud.4040.desc.zh:
我们知道许多虚境中的声音；他们的回响数量众多无处不在。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在最近的出神中汇报了一个非常独特的实体——繁多的嘈杂渗透到虚境的最中心。

使用足够的灵能能量，我们可以依照踪迹追踪到这个强大的实体，在我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们中称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
shroud.4040.desc.en:
We know many voices within the Shroud; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a manifold thrum permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our [GetTelepathPlural] as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName].

shroud.4045.a.covenant.tt.zh:
结束我们与[GetCovenantPatronColor]的契约。
将[GetCovenantPatronColor]的灵域完全替换为$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$。
会有一定的后果。
shroud.4045.a.covenant.tt.en:
Ends our Covenant with [GetCovenantPatronColor].
Replaces the domain of [GetCovenantPatronColor] entirely with $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$.
There will be consequences.

shroud.4045.a.no_covenant.tt.zh:
我们将选择一个$major_patron$的灵域替换为$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$。
会有一定的后果。
shroud.4045.a.no_covenant.tt.en:
We will choose the domain of a $major_patron$ to replace with $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$.
There will be consequences.

shroud.4045.b.zh: 最好不要扰乱虚境的平衡。
shroud.4045.b.en: Best not disturb the balance of the Shroud.

shroud.4045.desc.covenant.zh: $shroud.4045.desc.intro$占领[GetCovenantPatronColor]的灵域。如此将会把我们超主的已知存在完全替换掉，打破已签订的契约。$shroud.4045.desc.outro$
shroud.4045.desc.covenant.en: $shroud.4045.desc.intro$ the domain of [GetCovenantPatronColor]. Such an act would replace our patron's known presence completely, shattering our established Covenant.$shroud.4045.desc.outro$

shroud.4045.desc.no_covenant.zh: $shroud.4045.desc.intro$占领其他超主的灵域，将其已知存在完全替换掉。$shroud.4045.desc.outro$
shroud.4045.desc.no_covenant.en: $shroud.4045.desc.intro$ another patron's domain, replacing its known presence completely.$shroud.4045.desc.outro$

shroud.4050.desc.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

在一堆了无生机的构造体之间，我们探测到了一个$code_name_animator$，它的意志正在将高浓度能量塑造成新的奇特形态。

祂的行动被打断后靠了过来，驱散开了虚境的浓雾。祂给了我们一样东西。

如果我们拿了会发生什么？
shroud.4050.desc.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

In a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a $code_name_animator$, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.

Having intruded upon its activities, it approaches, displacing the Shroud's opaque haze. It offers something.

What will happen if we grasp it?

shroud.4055.a.zh: 人偶摆脱丝线自由舞蹈。
shroud.4055.a.en: The puppet dances free of its strings.

shroud.4055.desc.zh:
随着我们将自己的心灵浸泡入虚境翻腾的能量中，[GetSpeciesBodyPlural]奇怪地震颤起来。我们感受到$code_name_animator$短暂地抓住了我们。祂呼唤我们仔细看。

顺着指示的方向看去，意味深长的微暗渐渐退去，一个剪影显露出来。它的四肢被一股又一股虚无的绳索猛烈地拉扯，随后绳索突然消失，那个人形塌了下去。

它抽动着活了过来，一肢跟着一肢慢慢地站起，摆脱了束缚后，又开始了催眠般的舞蹈。
shroud.4055.desc.en:
As we steeped our minds in the Shroud's turbulent energies, our [GetSpeciesBodyPlural] convulsed inexplicably. We felt the $code_name_animator$ momentarily take hold of us. It beckoned us to observe.

The pregnant dimness ebbed away to reveal a gesturing silhouette. Its limbs were pulled sharply, one way then another, by vapory cords until, suddenly, its tethers dissipated. The figure collapsed.

Slowly it twitched back to life. Limb by limb it rose, without its former ties, and resumed its hypnotic dance.

shroud.4055.desc.know_animator.zh: 我们意识到这个实体并不陌生。$the_animator_of_clay_color_article_cap$玩得很开心。凡是无生命之物被唤醒，或是沉闷之物充盈起了灵魂的地方，都能找到祂。
shroud.4055.desc.know_animator.en: We realized then that we have encountered this entity before. $the_animator_of_clay_color_article_cap$ was entertained. Wherever the inanimate is awakened, and where dull matter is imbued with soul, it too can be found.

shroud.4060.desc.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

我们感觉到还有别的存在。一个$code_name_outsider$正在侵蚀我们的意识，在周围掀起一场灵能风暴。

一种深深的遗憾和渴望被推入我们的集体心灵中。我们看到的是熟悉的恒星系几千年前的图像。

不管这个实体是什么，它似乎很了解我们的星系。难道它曾属于此地吗？
shroud.4060.desc.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

We sense we are not alone. A $code_name_outsider$ encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar star systems thousands of years in the past.

Whatever this entity is, it seems to know our galaxy well. Did it once belong here?

shroud.4065.a.know_zroni.zh: 这个泽珞族人还活着吗？

shroud.4065.a.left_zroni.zh: 我们可别屈从相同的命运。
shroud.4065.a.left_zroni.en: Let us not succumb to the same fate.

shroud.4065.desc.intro.zh:
这个被称为$code_name_outsider$的遥远的力量从虚境深处里用痛苦折磨着我们的思想。它沉默无声，给了我们一个无言的警告：

在这些灵域中要小心行事。你根本不知道正在干涉的是什么力量。毁灭只有一步之遥……
shroud.4065.desc.intro.en:
The distant power known as $code_name_outsider$ seared our minds with anguish from deep within the Shroud. It did not speak, yet its warning was unmistakable:

Tread lightly in these realms. You know not what powers you disturb. Ruin is but a step away...

shroud.4065.desc.outro_default.zh: 不管这意味着什么，$the_outsider_color_article$已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
shroud.4065.desc.outro_default.en: Whatever this means, $the_outsider_color_article$ is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

shroud.4065.desc.outro_know_zroni.zh:
这个实体对我们的星系并不陌生。它有我们之前遇到的泽珞族文明的独特的精神足迹。但这怎么可能呢？

不管这意味着什么，$the_outsider_color_article$已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
shroud.4065.desc.outro_know_zroni.en:
This entity is no stranger to our galaxy. It has the distinct mental footprint of the Zroni civilization we have encountered before. How could this be possible?

Whatever this means, $the_outsider_color_article$ is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.
