shroud.4065.desc.outro_left_zroni.zh: 我们认出了这个实体。祂是我们在星界裂隙那边遇到的先知。这就是她的命运吗？她就是现在的$the_outsider_color_article$吗？
shroud.4065.desc.outro_left_zroni.en: We recognize this being. It is the Far-Seer we encountered beyond an Astral Rift. Is this the fate that has become of them? Are they now $the_outsider_color_article$?

shroud.4070.desc.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

一团变化的思绪落在了我们的意识周围。粗糙的重量感从我们身上流过，扭曲了时间感知。每一粒思想都在研磨着这个新形成的灵域的纹理。

随着感官的消退，$code_name_tide$也一并退去，留下久久不散的印痕。

这些踪迹在我们面前逗留，吸引我们跟上。
shroud.4070.desc.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.

As the sensation subsides, the $code_name_tide$ sloughs away and leaves lasting impressions behind.

These tracks linger before us, inviting us to follow.

shroud.4075.a.zh: 这种智慧现在归我们所有。

shroud.4075.desc.zh:
$code_name_tide$从虚境中破土而出。祂的存在无形而宽广，无边无际地在我们的视野中蔓延。

一种有颗粒感的低语从我们身上倾泻而下，冲开了埋藏已久的历史。我们看到被遗忘的帝国在不可阻挡的时间之流中化为灰烬。每一颗冲刷过我们的沙粒都是一段记忆。

在这片浩瀚的档案中，模式出现了——那是野心和毁灭、胜利和衰败的循环。智慧便潜藏于此。

$the_endless_tide_color_article_cap$伸展超过了时间维度，打磨掉无知，只留下愿意忍受之物。
shroud.4075.desc.en:
The $code_name_tide$ has been unearthed from the Shroud. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.

A textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried histories. We see forgotten empires ground to dust by the unstoppable march of time. Each grain that washes over us is a memory.

Within this boundless archive, patterns emerge - cycles of ambition and ruin, triumph and decay. There is wisdom within these depths.

$the_endless_tide_color_article_cap$ stretches beyond time, wearing away ignorance and leaving only what has the will to endure.

shroud.4080.desc.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

我们自己行为产生的重力将我们越拉越深，这种重量把我们拖进山峦般的压抑阴影的深处。

从祂灰白的山峰上投出了一种不屈不挠的凝视，直钻入我们的脑海。我们费尽力气才理解我们面前的$code_name_mountain$究竟有多么巨大。

最高的一座山峰在呼唤我们前去，考验我们能否登顶。
shroud.4080.desc.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to comprehend the scale of the $code_name_mountain$ before us.

The tallest summit yet beckons to us, challenging us to ascend.

shroud.4085.desc.zh:
随着我们在虚境中升入炫目的高空，无形的山峰触手可及。$code_name_mountain$亲自测试了我们，和所有的过往来客一样。

遗忘之国高耸入云的陵墓向我们唱着消逝历史的合唱诗。每一层失败和错误的抱负都被打磨成后来者的垫脚石。

然而，这不是一座死气沉沉的坟墓，而一口坩埚。毁灭与复兴的循环将过去的失败重新锻造成未来胜利的基石。毁灭不是结束，而是新的开始。

$the_pale_mountain_color_article_cap$在我们的意识中拔地而起。
shroud.4085.desc.en:
As we ascended the dizzying heights of the Shroud, we reached the intangible summit. The $code_name_mountain$ itself tested us, as it has tested all others who came before.

A towering mausoleum of forgotten empires sings to us an echoing chorus of faded history. Each layer of failure and misplaced ambitions has been ground into the foundations of what comes next.

Yet, this is no stagnant grave; it is a crucible. The cycle of ruin and renewal reforges the failures of the past into the bedrock of future triumphs. Destruction is not an end, but a new beginning.

$the_pale_mountain_color_article_cap$ rises in our minds.

shroud.4090.desc.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

一种令人宽慰的重压感让我们的思绪慢了下来，陷入一片极乐之雾中。前所未知的紧张感消融了，取而代之的是舒缓而奢华的平静。

随着在这鎏金的怀抱中越陷越深，我们看到一个$code_name_dream$越来越近。祂低声承诺奢侈的满足，祂超然的性质席卷我们全身。

这种懒散的放纵令人好奇。
shroud.4090.desc.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

A comforting weight slows our thoughts to a sluggishly blissful haze. Previously unknown tensions melt away, replaced by creeping, lavish calm.

Sinking deeper into this gilded embrace, we observe a $code_name_dream$ drawing closer. Its overwhelming nature sweeps around us as it whispers promises of extravagant contentment.

Its slothful indulgence is curiously tempting.

shroud.4095.desc.zh:
我们躺入了虚境中的一片闲适的宁静，发现自己被拉入了$code_name_dream$鎏金的大堂。

丝绸般的诱惑在我们的意识中穿行，就像一幅绚丽多彩的挂毯在面前展开。放纵的疏忽有可能使我们的心智在丰富负担的重压下变得迟钝不堪。

$the_golden_dream_color_article_cap$给予我们超出理解的奢华。
shroud.4095.desc.en:
As we relaxed into a pocket of idle tranquility within the Shroud, we found ourselves drawn into the gilded halls of the $code_name_dream$.

Silken temptations coursed through our minds as a rich tapestry of splendor unfurled before us. Indulgent negligence threatened to render our thoughts inert from the weight of its opulent burden.

$the_golden_dream_color_article_cap$ offers us luxuries beyond comprehension.

shroud.4100.desc.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

虚境混沌的搅动扭曲成灵能能量的漩涡。突然间，无数的激流展开汇聚在一起，被某种看不见的力量所平息。它冷静下来，转化成了一种平和的新形态。

在观察的过程中，我们发现是一个$code_name_point$正在指挥着这一切变化，将混沌抑制为秩序。

祂的平静召唤着我们。
shroud.4100.desc.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

The Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and spools into placid new forms.

As we observe, we become aware of an $code_name_point$ orchestrating these movements, subduing the chaos into order.

Its calmness beckons us.

shroud.4105.a.default.zh: 耐心将比冲突更加长久。

shroud.4105.a.homicidal.zh: 真是伤感的梦境……我们知道自己该干什么。
shroud.4105.a.homicidal.en: A wistful dream... we know our true purpose.

shroud.4105.desc.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]激进地侵入虚境的混沌涡流，但无济于事。只有停止挣扎时才感觉到了$code_name_point$真正的拥抱。

在我们心智中出现的画面是一场场势不可挡的冲突，每一场都充满了混乱和愤怒的干扰。

在这一切中，我们感受到了$the_hollow_point_color_article$的警惕和永恒的存在。祂平静而耐心地等待着星系无休止冲突的休止。
shroud.4105.desc.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] reached out aggressively into the Shroud's turbulent disorder, to no avail. Only when they ceased their exertions did they feel the proper embrace of the $code_name_point$.

Images played in our minds of an overwhelming procession of conflicts, each brimming with distractions of chaos and fury.

Amid it all, we felt the watchful and timeless presence of $the_hollow_point_color_article$. Serene in its patience, it waits for the galaxy's ceaseless strife to finally end.

shroud.4105.desc.outro_homicidal.zh: 尽管我们有最基本的本能，但我们的思想已经暴露在了一种奇怪的思维方式之下。
shroud.4105.desc.outro_homicidal.en: Despite our basest instincts, our minds have been exposed to a curious way of thinking.

shroud.4110.desc.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

混沌的噪音凝聚为压抑的黑暗。我们感觉自己的意图在被仔细审视、研究、评判。

对秩序的沉重期望，不容挑战，不可改变，从我们的深处凝视着。$code_name_throne$裁决着我们的意图。

它的目光穿过我们，黑暗褪去了。这种极具感染力的审视迫使我们服从。
shroud.4110.desc.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The $code_name_throne$ judges our intent.

Its gaze having passed over us, the darkness recedes. The infectious scrutiny compels us to fall in line.

shroud.4115.desc.zh:
我们跪伏在$code_name_throne$前。

我们的心智被毫不妥协的权威以冷漠的态度审视着，一边审判着我们，一边将我们固定在原地。

$the_vacant_throne_color_article$高压的真空没有一丝仁慈——但也没有痛苦。祂只寻求秩序和确定性，并将其施加到一切缺乏之处。

我们现在将这份重担承在了身上。
shroud.4115.desc.en:
We have knelt in the presence of the $code_name_throne$.

Our minds were scrutinized with the cold indifference of uncompromising authority, fixing us in place as we were judged.

The oppressive vacuum of $the_vacant_throne_color_article$ offers no mercy - nor suffering. It expects only order and certainty, imposing it where it is found lacking.

We now carry this weight with us.

shroud.4120.desc.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

我们突然产生了一种加速感，感知被难以理解的信息洪流淹没。我们不受控地向无尽的地平线冲去。

一个实体与我们同行。这条$code_name_river$在我们身边短暂停留，随后速度加快直至超越了我们所以为的极限。

我们必须跟上。
shroud.4120.desc.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

A sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endless horizons.

An entity moves in tandem with us. This $code_name_river$ lingers briefly before its velocity propels it beyond the limits of our understanding.

We must follow it.

shroud.4125.desc.zh:
只有当我们强行超越虚境的舒适极限时才终于接触到了$code_name_river$。

一种全向运动的感觉以不合逻辑、无法通过任何度规加以理解的速度感摧垮了我们。我们产生了一种在极短的瞬间横跨了遥远距离的感觉。

我们终于理解了$the_black_river_color_article$和它的无尽旅程。星系的浩瀚正为我们开辟了一条道路。
shroud.4125.desc.en:
Only when we plunged forcefully beyond our comfortable limits in the Shroud could we finally reach the $code_name_river$.

A sense of omnidirectional movement overcame us, with an illogical velocity that defied all standard comprehensions. We were left with the impression of having travelled a great distance in the briefest moment.

Finally we understood $the_black_river_color_article$ and its ceaseless journey. The galaxy's vastness is an open path for us to take.

shroud.4135.a.tt.zh:
将所有已知超主的领域替换为$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$。
我们有50年的时间来将星系吞入其$end_aura$之中。如果成功，游戏将会结束。
$covenant.cycle.tooltip$$shroud.8450.a.tech_tooltip$
$shroud.4135.psionic_components_insight$

这将解除与所有其他超主的契约
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$
shroud.4135.a.tt.en:
Replaces the domains of all known patrons with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$.
We will be granted at least 50 years to consume the galaxy in the $end_aura$. If we succeed, the game ends.
$covenant.cycle.tooltip$$shroud.8450.a.tech_tooltip$
$shroud.4135.psionic_components_insight$

Revert the Accords of all other Patrons
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$

shroud.4135.b.en: Exit the Shroud and try to forget.

shroud.4135.b.forging_our_own_path.en: Our path is set. We walk alone.

shroud.4135.desc.zh:
毫无预兆地我们被撕入了虚境。一个若隐若现的存在袭击了我们的意识。

祂是$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$，祂一直在等待着我们。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在出神中突然开始齐呼，众口一声地说：“时机未到。”缓了一下后。“但并非不可。”

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量、知识以及无尽的财富随我们取用。

只要我们能带向终末。
shroud.4135.desc.en:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: "IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME." A pause. "BUT IT COULD BE."

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

If we will only bring forth the End.

shroud.4140.a.tooltip.en:
Gain access to the ['concept_total_war'] Casus Belli
$eotc_opinion_modifier_2_tooltip$

shroud.4140.desc.zh:
我们的命运与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$绑定在一起；祂的光环所到之处，我们的人口便兴盛繁衍。我们得到了一个简单的结论：妨碍光环就是妨碍[This.GetName]，就该彻底铲除。

只要愿意，我们加可以抛开对军事目标的一切限制，毫不留情地征服敌人。没有什么可以阻挡终末的上上善道。
shroud.4140.desc.en:
Our fate is bound to $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.

Should we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.

shroud.4145.a.en: We must do all that is necessary.

shroud.4145.desc_1.default.zh: $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1$我们的遥邻很快就向我们发难。$shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2$
shroud.4145.desc_1.default.en: $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1$ Our distant neighbors are rapidly turning against us. $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2$

shroud.4145.desc_1.homicidal.zh: $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1$我们敌人的反感正变得越来越根深蒂固。$shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2$
shroud.4145.desc_1.homicidal.en: $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1$ Our enemies' antipathy is becoming ever more entrenched. $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2$

shroud.4145.desc_2.zh: 受超主意愿的启发，我们发明了一种消耗能量和物质来充能光环的新方法。可以献祭这个宇宙的物质来推进终末。
shroud.4145.desc_2.en: Inspired by our patron's will, we have devised new methods of expending energy and matter to fuel the Aura. The very stuff of the universe may be sacrificed to advance the End.

shroud.4150.desc.zh:
我们的超主无言而说。我们感受到了轮回终末的迫近，新的能量也随之在[This.GetName]中涌动。这种紧迫感鼓舞着我们。

如果我们想令终末之意满足，所有[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就需要把一切力量集中到同一个方向上。我们必须显现超主的力量，将祂的光环延伸到星系的最远处。
shroud.4150.desc.en:
Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.

If we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

shroud.4190.a.zh: 我们很快就会知道它有什么作用了。
shroud.4190.a.en: We might know their effects soon enough.

shroud.4190.desc.zh:
$shroud.4190.desc.intro$这种称为“$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$”的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。

这种光环现在也在[from.GetName]恒星系内探测到了，如果它继续蔓延有可能会侵犯我们的边境。
shroud.4190.desc.en:
$shroud.4190.desc.intro$ Termed '$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$', on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sources, we have yet to confirm whether they pose a threat or not.

Such an Aura has now been detected in the [from.GetName] system, which might encroach within our borders if it continues to spread.

shroud.4190.desc_mindwarden.zh: 关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]或许知道如何反制其效果。
shroud.4190.desc_mindwarden.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] may know methods of counteracting its effects.

shroud.4191.desc_1.default.zh: $shroud.4191.desc_1.common$一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。

shroud.4191.desc_2.default.zh: 它被称为“$PSIONIC_AURA$”，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着$shroud.4191.desc_2.common$
shroud.4191.desc_2.default.en: Termed a '$PSIONIC_AURA$', it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing $shroud.4191.desc_2.common$

shroud.4191.desc_2.knows_aura.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出$PSIONIC_AURA$的方法，它能影响$shroud.4191.desc_2.common$
shroud.4191.desc_2.knows_aura.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a $PSIONIC_AURA$, which emanates from the Shroud and influences $shroud.4191.desc_2.common$

shroud.4191.desc_3.default.zh: 据[GetTelepathPlural]的说法，它能释放[GetBenevolentRivalAdj]的意志，因此$shroud.4191.desc_3.common$
shroud.4191.desc_3.default.en: According to our [GetTelepathPlural], it radiates [GetBenevolentRivalAdj] intent, so $shroud.4191.desc_3.common$

shroud.4205.d.zh: 我们知道一个不错的灵能目标……
shroud.4205.d.en: We know of a good psionic target...

shroud.4205.desc.zh:
$shroud.4205.common$

我们的使命是保护大家免受虚境以及所有传播其恶意效应者的威胁。我们信仰心灵神圣不可侵犯，巩固星系抵御灵能。

我们根据灵能传感器读数判断出你们不会造成这种威胁。太好了。我们很乐意提供帮助，保护你不受伤害。

$shroud.4205.desc.end$
shroud.4205.desc.en:
$shroud.4205.common$

Our mission is to protect against the menace of the Shroud and all those who spread its ill effects. We believe in minds free from invasion, and a galaxy fortified against psionics.

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, you do not contribute to these threats. Excellent. We would be pleased to help you protect against anyone that does.

$shroud.4205.desc.end$

shroud.4205.desc.eotc.zh:
严峻的时刻到了。尽管我们竭尽全力，$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$还是到来了。它在群星之间四处恐怖地显灵……

$shroud.4205.desc.eotc.end$
shroud.4205.desc.eotc.en:
These are grave times. Despite our efforts, $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ is upon us. Its dreadful manifestation stalks among the stars...

$shroud.4205.desc.eotc.end$

shroud.4205.desc.merc_back.zh:
欢迎回来，督察朋友。[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]很重视我们的持续合作。

$shroud.4205.desc.end$
shroud.4205.desc.merc_back.en:
Welcome back, fellow wardens. The [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] values our continued cooperation.

$shroud.4205.desc.end$

shroud.4205.desc.merc_first.zh: 督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：第一个$gov_mindwarden_enclave$成立了。$shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud$
shroud.4205.desc.merc_first.en: Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of the first $gov_mindwarden_enclave$ is complete. $shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud$

shroud.4205.desc.merc_more.zh: 督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：我们的$gov_mindwarden_enclave$成立了。$shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud$
shroud.4205.desc.merc_more.en: Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of our $gov_mindwarden_enclave$ is complete. $shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud$

shroud.4205.desc.return.zh:
欢迎回来。[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]很重视我们的持续合作。

我们的灵能传感器读数清晰。你们没有被虚境玷污。很好，很好……

$shroud.4205.desc.end$
shroud.4205.desc.return.en:
Welcome back. The [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] value our continued cooperation.

Our psi-sensor readings are clear. You remain unsullied by the Shroud. Good, good...

$shroud.4205.desc.end$

shroud.4205.e.en: We need help with £crime£ [GetCrimeDeviancy] among us.

shroud.4205.f.zh: 我们可以借用你们的士兵。
shroud.4205.f.en: We could make use of your soldiers.

shroud.4205.g.zh: 你们愿意派一位督查来吗？
shroud.4205.g.en: Would you be willing to send us a warden?

shroud.4205.i.zh: 作为你们的赞助方，我们有个提案。
shroud.4205.i.en: As your founding patron, we have a proposal.

shroud.4210.desc.zh:
虚境可以说是一种存在于普通感知之外的维度现实。它完全由有害的“灵能”能量组成。它触及我们物质星系的每一个部分，然而多数人无法主动感知到它。

虚境的能量可以通过感性众生的认知活动在物质领域显现。这些力量极其危险且不可预测。

为了确保大众安全需要对虚境采取防护措施。在这方面，我们可以提供帮助。
shroud.4210.desc.en:
The Shroud can best be described as a dimension of reality that exists beyond ordinary perception. It is composed entirely of harmful 'psionic' energy. It touches every part of our physical galaxy, yet many do not actively perceive it.

The Shroud's energies can manifest in the physical realm through the cognitive activity of sentient beings. These forces are extremely dangerous and unpredictable.

Ensuring your population's safety requires protective measures against the Shroud. To that end, we can provide help.

shroud.4230.desc.zh:
抑制$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$主要有两种方法。

在行星上建造$building_psionic_suppressor$可以逐渐减少整个恒星系的光环强度，并且防止进一步污染。

更强大的解决方法是$SHROUD_SEAL$。$shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$
shroud.4230.desc.en:
There are two principal methods of suppressing $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$.

Building a $building_psionic_suppressor$ on a planet will gradually reduce Aura intensity throughout the star system and prevent any further encroachment.

An even more powerful solution is a $SHROUD_SEAL$. $shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$

shroud.4231.desc.zh:
乐意效劳。数据将会直接传过去。

愿这些科技在光环浩劫中给你带去和平。
shroud.4231.desc.en:
Gladly. The data will be transmitted forthwith.

May these technologies bring you peace from the auric scourge.

shroud.4240.desc.zh:
是这样吗？好吧，他们还在用灵能荼毒这个星系，我们就永远不得享受真的安宁……

有针对性的袭击可以表达我们对这种危险行为的反对。而在你们的经济支持下，我们愿意执行这次行动。

如果你们同意，就告诉我们目标吧。
shroud.4240.desc.en:
Is that so? Well, we will never know true peace and security while they infect the galaxy with psionics...

A targeted raid would demonstrate our opposition to these dangerous practices. With your financial support, we are willing to conduct such an operation.

Let us know the target, if you agree.

shroud.4245.desc.zh:
啊，好的。我们知道他们在实践灵能了。展示力量是正当的。

感谢你的支持。行动将会很快开始。
shroud.4245.desc.en:
Ah, yes. We are aware of their psionic practices. A show of force is justified.

Thank you for your support. The operation will commence shortly.

shroud.4246.desc.zh: 一支来自[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]的军事舰队正在逼近我们的国境！$shroud.4246.common_1$他们$shroud.4246.common_2$
shroud.4246.desc.en: A military fleet from the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] is approaching our borders! $shroud.4246.common_1$ They $shroud.4246.common_2$

shroud.4247.desc.zh: 一支来自此前未知的军事势力的舰队正在逼近我们的国境！$shroud.4246.common_1$他们自称[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，$shroud.4246.common_2$
shroud.4247.desc.en: A fleet from a previously unknown military power is approaching our borders! $shroud.4246.common_1$ Identifying themselves as the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], they $shroud.4246.common_2$

shroud.4250.desc.zh:
棒极了。把$zro_lower$委托给我们，可以对这种强大而被大规模滥用的物质进行关键的研究——这项研究将使整个星系受益。

这也是我们以高于星系标准的价格购买的原因。
shroud.4250.desc.en:
Excellent. Entrusting us with $zro_lower$ enables crucial research into this powerful and widely abused substance - research that will benefit the whole galaxy.

This is why our rate for its purchase is well above the galactic standard.

shroud.4251.desc.zh:
$sr_zro$是一种高度不稳定的稀有物质，它的具体效用难以控制和预测。无论是有意或是无意，它可能引发剧烈的能量爆炸，造成大规模破坏。

这些性质是通过一种与虚境的反应产生的，这使其在灵能实践者中非常受欢迎——有些人甚至把这东西当成药来磕。

我们希望能进一步研究$zro_lower$，找出安全处置的方法；这也是我们对回购泽珞出手如此阔绰的原因。
shroud.4251.desc.en:
$sr_zro$ is a rare, highly unstable substance, the effects of which are difficult to control and predict. Intentionally or not, it can cause violent bursts of energy that wreak destruction on a mass scale.

These properties are produced through reactions with the Shroud, making it popular among psionic practitioners - some of whom ingest it as a drug.

We aim to learn more about $zro_lower$ and to research methods for its safe disposal; that is why we pay handsomely for any quantity brought to us.

shroud.4260.desc.zh:
那就让我们来提供一些有用的$decision_thought_police$，这可以在[GetCriminalDeviant]意图演变成实际行为之前将其探测到。

他们使用一种专门开发的安全灵能替代方法，以科学技术来监测人群的认知活动。他们提供对精神状态的洞见，而不使用虚境的危险能量。
shroud.4260.desc.en:
Then let us provide you with an effective $decision_thought_police$, which can detect [GetCriminalDeviant] intent before it manifests in actual behavior.

Their methods were developed as a safe alternative to psionic practices, using scientific techniques to monitor a population's cognitive activity. They provide insights on mental states without employing the dangerous energies of the Shroud.

shroud.4262.desc.zh: 很好。我相信你会发现这种方法非常地有效。
shroud.4262.desc.en: Excellent. I think you will find their methods quite efficacious.

shroud.4265.desc.zh:
确实。通过合作我们发现了你们军事部署战略有一些可以改进的方面。

当然，我们这么说并不是有意侮辱；不过是术业有专攻罢了。如果你们能给出足够的价码，我们很荣幸能和如此有价值的客户就此合作。
shroud.4265.desc.en:
Indeed. Our collaborations have already revealed to us some areas of improvement that could be made to your military deployment strategies.

We mean no insult by this, of course; we simply specialize in these fields. We would be honored to assist such a valued partner in this matter, should you provide us adequate compensation.

shroud.4266.desc.zh: 很好。我们的舰队支援运作会立刻开始。
shroud.4266.desc.en: Very good. Our fleet support operations will commence at once.

shroud.4267.desc.zh:
您好，尊贵的合作伙伴。

我们的舰队后勤运作协助协议已经到期。如果您考虑的话，我们非常愿意继续合作。
shroud.4267.desc.en:
Greetings, valued partner.

Our contract to assist in the logistical operations of your fleets has expired. We would be more than willing to continue this partnership, should you deem it worth your while.

shroud.4270.desc.zh:
我们的$NAME_Mindwarden_Army$是非常强大的震慑部队。他们有能应对各种威胁的装备，但对使用灵能的对手特别有效。

我觉得你会发现物有所值的。
shroud.4270.desc.en:
Our $NAME_Mindwarden_Army$ make excellent shock troopers. They are equipped to tackle diverse threats, but are especially effective against psionic opponents.

We think you will find them worth their price.

shroud.4271.desc.zh: 你走运了；我们正好有一支连队准备好部署。就等着他们的运输船立即到达吧。
shroud.4271.desc.en: You are in luck; we already have a company ready for deployment. Expect the arrival of their transport ship presently.

shroud.4280.desc.zh:
我们非常乐意。

高效的领导是战胜虚境的关键，我们的督查们正精于利用严格的管理来压制灵能活动。
shroud.4280.desc.en:
We would be more than willing.

Effective leadership is key to combating the Shroud, and our wardens are well-versed in suppressing psionic activity through firm governance.

shroud.4281.desc.zh: 明智的决定。愿他们的管理能保障你们的人民在未来的岁月里的安全。
shroud.4281.desc.en: A wise decision. May their stewardship keep your population safe for years to come.

shroud.4290.b.response.zh:
根据我们的情报，$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$是一种来自虚境内的灾害性的力量。它的力量可以通过一些渴望力量的心灵入侵者同谋在物理现实中显现。

终末通过$NAME_Reckoning$给星系带来毁灭——那是一种由纯灵能构成的邪恶实体。它的终极目标就是完全抹杀本现实的存在。
shroud.4290.b.response.en:
According to our intelligence, $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ is a cataclysmic force from within the Shroud. Its power can manifest in physical reality through the complicity of power-hungry mind-invaders.

The End inflicts ruin upon the galaxy through the $NAME_Reckoning$ - a vicious being composed of psionic energy. Its ultimate goal is the complete annihilation of this existence.

shroud.4290.desc.zh: 说实话，这是个严峻的东西。星系中没有比$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$更大的灾难了。
shroud.4290.desc.en: A grave matter, indeed. There is no greater scourge in the galaxy than that of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$.

shroud.4291.desc.zh: 愿你们对这场巨大威胁凯旋而归。它威胁到了居住在这个星系中的所有人的生死存亡。
shroud.4291.desc.en: May you triumph against this great threat. It threatens the existence of everyone who calls this galaxy home.

shroud.4292.desc.zh:
我们开发出了一种算法可以增强你们对$NAME_Reckoning$的进攻能力。这可以提升你们武器系统在对特定灵能实体时的效率。

在目前阶段，这份代码的每次改进都需要大量重构，才能与各个军事基础设施兼容。因此，这是一项高级服务，但我们认为您能认可它的物超所值。
shroud.4292.desc.en:
We have developed an algorithm that can augment your offensives against the $NAME_Reckoning$. It tunes your weapons' targeting systems for increased effectiveness against this specific kind of psionic entity.

In its current state, each deployment of the code requires extensive refactoring for compatibility with individual military infrastructures. This is therefore a premium service, but we think you will find it worth the outlay.

shroud.4295.desc.zh:
$shroud.4205.common$

我们最初对与你们“$building_materiality_engine_plural$”有关的消息感到担忧。然而，经过进一步的分析，我们认为这种装置是在对所谓“虚境”的非灵能开发方面颇具潜力的新发展。

我们鼓励你们继续部署这项技术，并期待在未来一同合作。
shroud.4295.desc.en:
$shroud.4205.common$

We were initially concerned by reports of your '$building_materiality_engine_plural$'. However, upon further analysis, we consider these devices to be a promising development for non-psionic exploitation of the so-called 'Shroud'.

We encourage your continued deployment of this technology, and look forward to working with you in the future.

shroud.4300.a.zh: 你们为什么这么害怕虚境？
shroud.4300.a.en: Why do you fear the Shroud?

shroud.4300.desc.zh:
我谨代表[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

根据我们灵能传感器的读数，整个[Root.GetName]已经无可挽回地被虚境玷污了。

你们的所作所为是在自掘坟墓——我们不介意帮你们一铲子。
shroud.4300.desc.en:
I speak to you as a representative of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, the whole [Root.GetName] has been irremediably infected by the Shroud.

Your actions have spelled your end - and we will hasten it.

shroud.4310.desc.zh:
我们不害怕虚境，更不害怕它的走狗，因为我们知道如何对付这些东西。

我不指望你们——这被虚境影响得失心疯了的社会——理解一丝一毫。
shroud.4310.desc.en:
We do not fear it, nor its corrupted agents, as we know how to fight it.

I would not expect you - a society maddened by its influence - to understand.

shroud.4320.desc.common.zh: 在你们确认无条件停止敌对行为之前，我们没什么可谈的。
shroud.4320.desc.common.en: Until you confirm the unconditional cessation of hostile attacks, we have nothing to discuss.

shroud.4320.desc.default.zh: 我们是维护星系秩序的力量；攻击我们有什么好处？我们不会坐视你的好战行为。
shroud.4320.desc.default.en: We are a force for order in this galaxy; what benefit is there in attacking us? We shall not idly tolerate your belligerence.

shroud.4320.desc.psionic.zh: 难道用灵能荼毒星系还不够吗？
shroud.4320.desc.psionic.en: Was it not enough to poison the galaxy with psionics?

shroud.4340.desc.zh:
我们知道你们和[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的那些交易。你们这种行为不仅是在纵容他们的错误，更是在帮助虚境感染传播。

只要你们还在与他们合作，我们就不会提供任何服务。
shroud.4340.desc.en:
We are aware of your dealings with the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Your actions not only legitimize their wrongdoing, but help spread the infection of the Shroud.

We will not render you any services while you remain their collaborators.

shroud.4350.desc.zh:
在他们的设施遭到摧毁后，我们至今无法与[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]再次取得联系。

打开他们的通讯频道，我们只能听到宇宙的虚空寂静。
shroud.4350.desc.en:
We have not been able to reestablish contact with the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] since the destruction of their facility.

When we listen to their channel, we hear only the empty quietude of space.

shroud.4405.desc.default.zh: $shroud.4405.desc_common$尽管他们所鄙夷的东西对我们毫无意义，但他们对“虚境”的十字军式的讨伐代表了一种不应该在我们星系中存在的伪科学教条主义。
shroud.4405.desc.default.en: $shroud.4405.desc_common$ Though the practices they despised were of little importance to us, their crusade against the 'Shroud' represented the kind of pseudoscientific dogmatism that should have no place in our galaxy.

shroud.4405.desc.psionic.zh: $shroud.4405.desc_common$他们不该再继续传播那种关于所谓虚境危险的无知教条，他们空间站的灵能衰减器现在已经是一堆破铜烂铁了。
shroud.4405.desc.psionic.en: $shroud.4405.desc_common$ They shall no longer spread their ignorant dogma about the dangers of the Shroud, and their station's psionic attenuators are now debris.

shroud.4405.desc_end.zh: 我们的胜利是巨大的成功，甚至还可以从他们空间站的残骸打捞大量的资源。
shroud.4405.desc_end.en: Our victory was doubly successful, as we were also able to salvage a sizable amount of resources from the wreckage of their station.

shroud.4406.desc.default.zh: 之后没有他们提供反灵能服务的日子，这个星系只得勉强应付了。
shroud.4406.desc.default.en: The galaxy will have to make do without their anti-psionic services for the time being.

shroud.4406.desc.psionic.zh: 现在星系不用再遭受他们的反灵能十字军行为的骚扰了——只要没有人再冒出来扮演这个角色。
shroud.4406.desc.psionic.en: The galaxy is now free from the torment of their anti-psionic crusade - as long as no one emerges to take their place.

shroud.4406.desc_common.zh: 我们获悉[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系内的[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]不复存在了。该$gov_mindwarden_enclave$无法抵御[mindwarden_destroyer.GetName]的猛烈攻击，他们的空间站化作碎片，没有找到任何幸存者。
shroud.4406.desc_common.en: We have received reports that the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system is no more. This $gov_mindwarden_enclave$ was unable to withstand an onslaught by the [mindwarden_destroyer.GetName], which reduced their station to debris and left no known survivors.

shroud.4505.desc.individual_machine.zh:
$shroud.4505.desc.intro$

我们社会的变化已经可以观测。我们的军事单元无比专注于战斗；在和平时期，他们也必须坚持进行严苛战斗模拟，否则将出现非必要进攻性。

$shroud.4505.desc.outro$
shroud.4505.desc.individual_machine.en:
$shroud.4505.desc.intro$

Changes in our society are already detectable. Our military units are ever more focused on battle; in peacetime, they must be kept engaged in taxing combat simulations, lest their restlessness turn to savagery.

$shroud.4505.desc.outro$

shroud.4550.desc.default.zh:
我们刚一跃入虚境，一个存在就主动找了上来。祂的思想在我们[GetTelepathPlural]的意识中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。这是$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$，祂将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。

代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，祂将帮助我们、指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
shroud.4550.desc.default.en:
As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$ and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

If we will only accept it into our hearts.

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

shroud.4550.desc.gestalt_machine.zh:
我们刚一跃入虚境，一个存在就主动找了上来。祂的思想在我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。这是$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$，祂将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。

代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，祂将帮助我们、指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
shroud.4550.desc.gestalt_machine.en:
As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$ and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

If we will only accept it into our mainframes.

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

shroud.4555.a.default.en: Let us hope they are right.

shroud.4555.desc.default.zh:
$shroud.4555.desc.intro$

这笔买卖的代价很明显了。我们等待着繁荣富饶的黄金时代到来，大众也不再满足于生存的必须。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在渴望各种各样的物质财富——这是我们新的经济负担。

$shroud.4555.desc.outro$
shroud.4555.desc.default.en:
$shroud.4555.desc.intro$

The cost of the bargain is already apparent. As we await the promised golden age of wealth and prosperity, the populace is no longer satisfied by the bare necessities of existence. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] now crave all manner of material goods - a new burden on our economy.

$shroud.4555.desc.outro$

shroud.4555.desc.hive.zh:
$shroud.4555.desc.intro$

这笔买卖的代价已经可见了。我们等待着无上产出的黄金时代到来，子个体的基础需求也提高了。各地的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始需要各种各样非必要物资——这是我们的一个新的经济负担。

$shroud.4555.desc.outro$
shroud.4555.desc.hive.en:
$shroud.4555.desc.intro$

The cost of the bargain is already detectable. As we await the promised golden age of matchless output, the basic necessities of our drones have increased. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] everywhere now require a range of inessential goods - a new burden on our economy.

$shroud.4555.desc.outro$

shroud.4650.desc.default.zh:
一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的思维中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以生长、变化、改进、演化的方向。

只要我们愿意将其纳入肉身。

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
shroud.4650.desc.default.en:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$, regards our organic forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be grown, changed. Improved. Evolved.

If we will only take it into our flesh.

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

shroud.4650.desc.gestalt_machine.zh:
一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以适应、变化、改进、演化的方向。

只要我们愿意将其纳入组成。

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
shroud.4650.desc.gestalt_machine.en:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$, regards our mechanical forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be adapted, changed. Improved. Upgraded.

If we will only take it into our components.

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

shroud.4655.a.gestalt.en: Such is the cost of power.

shroud.4655.desc.default.zh:
$shroud.4655.desc.intro$

我们的[GetScientistPlural]在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的测试样本中检测到了基因结构的异常模式，简直像许多代的演化在一夜之间发生。$shroud.4655.desc.outro$
shroud.4655.desc.default.en:
$shroud.4655.desc.intro$

Our [GetScientistPlural] have already detected anomalous patterns in the genetic structure of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] test samples, as though many generations of evolutionary change had occurred overnight. $shroud.4655.desc.outro$

shroud.4655.desc.individual_machine.zh:
$shroud.4655.desc.intro$

我们的[GetScientistPlural]在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的测试回路中检测到了分子结构的异常模式，简直像许多代的系统升级在一夜之间发生。$shroud.4655.desc.outro$
shroud.4655.desc.individual_machine.en:
$shroud.4655.desc.intro$

Our [GetScientistPlural] have already detected anomalous patterns in the molecular structure of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] test circuits, as though many generations of system upgrades had occurred overnight. $shroud.4655.desc.outro$

shroud.4715.desc.default.zh:
$shroud.4715.desc.intro$

接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经虚境的众多能量在我们的每一个意识中翻滚，而灵能界现在安静得像死去了一样。

我们不得不开始思考自己种下的恶果。
shroud.4715.desc.default.en:
$shroud.4715.desc.intro$

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the Shroud roiled within our every consciousness, the psionic realm is now quiet as death.

We were left to contemplate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

shroud.4715.desc.hive.zh:
$shroud.4715.desc.intro$

接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经虚境的众多能量在[GetBrainName]之中翻滚，而灵能界现在静滞得如同不存在了一样。

我们不得不开始估算自己给自己带来的后果。
shroud.4715.desc.hive.en:
$shroud.4715.desc.intro$

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the Shroud roiled throughout the [GetBrainName], the psionic realm is now inert as nonbeing.

We were left to estimate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

shroud.4862.a.tooltip.en: The planet [From.GetName] has been transformed into a $pc_gaia$.

shroud.4862.a.tooltip.nomad.zh: 方舟舰[From.GetName]已臻至完美，化为生命繁茂的理想乐土。
shroud.4862.a.tooltip.nomad.en: The Arkship [From.GetName] has been perfected into an ideal environment for life to flourish.

shroud.4862.desc.zh: $shroud.4862.shared$$the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$将[From.GetName]转变成了一颗$pc_gaia$，使其成为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的一片理想家园。
shroud.4862.desc.en: $shroud.4862.shared$ $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$ has transformed [From.GetName] into a $pc_gaia$, making it an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind.

shroud.4862.desc.nomad.zh: $shroud.4862.shared$$the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$将[From.GetName]重塑为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]繁茂生长的理想之境，那是一方与我们同航的乐土。
shroud.4862.desc.nomad.en: $shroud.4862.shared$ $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$ has reshaped [From.GetName] into an ideal environment for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind to flourish, a paradise that sails onward with us.

shroud.4890.desc.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂呢喃着给出提案。$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$打算将我们的一个殖民地重塑成$pc_relic$；我们只需要做出决定即可。
shroud.4890.desc.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$ will reimagine one of our colonies as a $pc_relic$; we need only make our choice.

shroud.4890.desc.nomad.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂呢喃着给出提案。$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$将在阿卡西记录与我们的一艘方舟舰之间建立链接，低声地讲述出一切曾经存在或终将存在之物的记忆；我们只需要做出决定即可。
shroud.4890.desc.nomad.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$ will open a link between the Akashic Records and one of our Arkships, whispering memories of all that has ever been or ever will be; we need only make our choice.

shroud.4890.tt.zh: 选中的殖民地转变为遗落星球，并清除所有障碍地块。
shroud.4890.tt.en: The chosen colony becomes a Relic World with all blockers removed.

shroud.4935.desc.zh: $shroud.4862.shared$$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$在我们[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]系中具现化了一颗$pc_gaia$，为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]提供了一片理想家园；这是一个用来拥抱万物终结的转瞬即逝的乐园。
shroud.4935.desc.en: $shroud.4862.shared$ $end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ has materialized a $pc_gaia$ in our [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system, providing an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind; a fleeting paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.

shroud.4935.desc.nomad.zh: $shroud.4862.shared$$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$已经在[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]系中显现了一艘全新的方舟舰，其上载满了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]；这是一艘飞驰的天堂之船，用以拥抱万物的终结。
shroud.4935.desc.nomad.en: $shroud.4862.shared$ $end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ has materialized a new Arkship teeming with [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind in the [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system; a fleeting vessel of paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.

shroud.4935.tooltip.nomad.en: A new Arkship has appeared in [capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]: [accord_creation_world.GetName]

shroud.4950.desc.1.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
shroud.4950.desc.1.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

shroud.4950.desc.3.default.zh: $shroud.4950.desc.3.intro$一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。

shroud.4950.desc.4.zh: $shroud.4190.desc.intro$这种“$PSIONIC_AURA$”，得名于其理论上的来源，如今发现于[from.GetName]恒星系。
shroud.4950.desc.4.en: $shroud.4190.desc.intro$ Such a '$PSIONIC_AURA$', so-called due to its theorized origin, has now been detected in the [from.GetName] system.

shroud.4955.a.zh: 我们必须做好最坏的准备。
shroud.4955.a.en: We must prepare for the worst.

shroud.4955.a.tt.zh: $end_aura$覆盖全星系时游戏将会结束。
shroud.4955.a.tt.en: If the $end_aura$ covers the galaxy, the game ends.

shroud.4955.desc.1.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。
shroud.4955.desc.1.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population.

shroud.4955.desc.1.gestalt.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.1$我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境的能量中探测到了一个并行干扰。
shroud.4955.desc.1.gestalt.en: $shroud.4955.desc.1$ Our [GetTelepathPlural] have even detected a concurrent disturbance in the energies of the Shroud.

shroud.4955.desc.1.non_gestalt.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.1$我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，即便虚境也感受到了怪异的不安，仿佛它的力量在安静的恐惧中颤抖。
shroud.4955.desc.1.non_gestalt.en: $shroud.4955.desc.1$ According to our [GetTelepathPlural], even the Shroud feels oddly unsettled, as though its forces tremble in quiet apprehension.

shroud.4955.desc.2.contact_aura.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$我们见证了[from.GetName]令人费解的增长，还目睹了一个负面的$PSIONIC_AURA$正在四处侵蚀。$shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$
shroud.4955.desc.2.contact_aura.en: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$ We have witnessed the inexplicable growth of the [from.GetName]. We have watched the encroachment of an adverse $PSIONIC_AURA$. $shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$

shroud.4955.desc.2.contact_no_aura.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$我们见证了[from.GetName]令人费解的增长。$shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$
shroud.4955.desc.2.contact_no_aura.en: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$ We have witnessed the inexplicable growth of the [from.GetName]. $shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$

shroud.4955.desc.2.no_contact_aura.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$我们目睹了一个负面的$PSIONIC_AURA$正在四处侵蚀。$shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$
shroud.4955.desc.2.no_contact_aura.en: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$ We have watched the encroachment of an adverse $PSIONIC_AURA$. $shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$

shroud.4955.desc.3.zh: 我们不知道是什么正在逼近，只知道它绝对会来。
shroud.4955.desc.3.en: We do not know exactly what approaches, though we sense its coming with profound certainty.

shroud.4960.desc.2.zh: 依据我们最新的数据，它已经污染了过半由超空间航道链接着的星系。其背后蕴藏的力量似乎寻求着星系尺度的毁灭；如果不能加以制止，它可能就要得逞了。
shroud.4960.desc.2.en: According to our latest data, it has encroached upon half of the hyperlane-connected galaxy. The force behind it seems intent on destruction at a galactic scale; if it cannot be counteracted, it might just succeed.

shroud.4965.desc.2.zh: 如果不能快准狠地加以反制，我们将面临星系级灭顶之灾。
shroud.4965.desc.2.en: Without swift and powerful countermeasures, we face galactic catastrophe.

shroud.4970.desc.zh:
$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$降临了。

$end_aura$吞噬了整个星系。随着最后一个恒星系的沦陷，一道无法计量的能量潮爆发而出。$shroud.4970.desc.1$

$shroud.4970.desc.2$
shroud.4970.desc.en:
$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ is upon us.

The $end_aura$ has consumed the galaxy. As the final star system yielded to its power, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.$shroud.4970.desc.1$

$shroud.4970.desc.2$

shroud.500.desc.zh: 我们领先机构在富有前景的新研究中取得了意想不到的突破。这纯属意外收获，我们在仪器例行标准化过程中证明了一个长期被认为是误算的理论。现在该重新审视这个曾经被认为是边缘科学的东西了。
shroud.500.desc.en: Promising new research from our leading institutions has reached an unexpected breakthrough. By pure chance, the routine standardization of our instruments proved a theory that was long thought to be a fundamental miscalculation. We can now revisit what was once thought to be fringe science.

shroud.500.tt.en: Insight gained on a random technology: $@good_luck_event_1_insight|0%$

shroud.5012.desc.zh:
我们的怀疑得到了确认。[first_neighbor.GetAdjective]与[second_neighbor.GetAdjective]的文明证实，他们在正式进行外交之前，曾通过非正式渠道开展过联系。

这些派系如今从我们的阴影中现身，承认了他们的存在。它们被称为$pft_the_curtain$、$pft_the_masquerade$以及$pft_the_grand_dance$。这群曾经的秘密组织如今正公开请求与我们展开正式对话。

至于它们想要什么，以及它们是如何知晓所知之事，我们也许永远无法真正知道。但为了我们的最佳利益，也许我们应当遵循他们的命令行事。
shroud.5012.desc.en:
Our suspicions have been justified. The [first_neighbor.GetAdjective] and [second_neighbor.GetAdjective] civilizations have confirmed they have been contacted through unofficial channels before more formal communications began.

These Factions now emerge from our own shadows and acknowledge their existence. Known as $pft_the_curtain$, $pft_the_masquerade$ and $pft_the_grand_dance$, these once-secret organizations are now openly requesting formal dialogue with us.

What they want, and how they know what they know, may never truly be understood by us. It may be in our best interest to operate within their demands.

shroud.5012.tt.zh:
秘密结社派系将很快出现：
$t$$pft_the_curtain$
$t$$pft_the_masquerade$
$t$$pft_the_grand_dance$
shroud.5012.tt.en:
Secret Society Factions will soon emerge:
$t$$pft_the_curtain$
$t$$pft_the_masquerade$
$t$$pft_the_grand_dance$

shroud.5013.a.zh: 他们是支持我们？还是反对我们？
shroud.5013.a.en: Are they with us, or against us?

shroud.5013.desc.zh:
在我们之中，有些人暗中操纵着外交事务。现在我们怀疑，他们的触角已不仅仅局限于我们的母星。

尽管我们才刚开始探索星空，却以惊人的速度与其他生命形式建立了联系。这似乎不仅仅是巧合。我们怀疑，这些星际关系源于几个秘密的派系的幕后运作，而这些派系已经深深扎根于我们的社会之中。

也许当我们对这些生物了解更多之后，隐匿于暗影中的势力自会显露真容。
shroud.5013.desc.en:
There are those among us who operate behind the curtains of diplomacy. Now we suspect their reach is not limited to our homeworld.

Despite only recently venturing into the stars, we have entered communications with other life forms with remarkable ease. This seems like more than coincidence. We suspect that these interstellar relationships originate behind the closed doors of several secret Factions that have deeply embedded themselves within our society.

Perhaps once we know more about these beings, those within our shadows will reveal themselves.

shroud.5055.desc.common.zh:
我们被骗了。

我们的情报人员截获了来自[from.GetName]的秘密通讯，发现他们密谋将我们拖入代理人战争。

他们极力否认任何牵涉，但我们与他们的关系已经受损。
shroud.5055.desc.common.en:
We were fooled.

Our intelligence operatives intercepted covert communications from the [from.GetName]. These revealed their plot to plunge us into a proxy war.

They have vehemently denied any involvement, but the damage to our relationship is already done.

shroud.5055.desc.galactic.zh: $shroud.5055.desc.common$他们的表里不一很快传遍整个星系，严重损害了[from.GetName]的声誉。
shroud.5055.desc.galactic.en: $shroud.5055.desc.common$ News of their duplicity has spread rapidly, adversely affecting the reputation of the [from.GetName] throughout the galaxy.

shroud.5060.a.tt.zh: 卷入代理人战争的帝国对我们的评价改变：-200
shroud.5060.a.tt.en: Empires involved in the Proxy War have their opinion of us changed by: -200

shroud.5060.desc.default.zh: $shroud.5060.desc.common$此事件严重损害了我们与参战方的关系。
shroud.5060.desc.default.en: $shroud.5060.desc.common$ This event has significantly harmed our relationships with the belligerents.

shroud.5060.desc.galactic.zh: $shroud.5060.desc.common$此事件不仅损害了我们与参战方的关系，还在星系范围内玷污了我们的声誉。
shroud.5060.desc.galactic.en: $shroud.5060.desc.common$ Not only has this event harmed our relationships with the belligerents, but the scandal has damaged our reputation on a galactic scale.

shroud.507.desc.zh:
[mining_planet.GetName]上有个此前认为已经完全坍塌的富矿的天然洞穴系统被意外地重新发掘出来。

经过谨慎的风险评估，我们确信在扩大开采作业规模后，这些坑道可以产出极大量的矿物。
shroud.507.desc.en:
A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on [mining_planet.GetName].

After a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitation with the expansion of existing mining efforts.

shroud.5105.desc.zh:
与一个既无法定义也无法理解的实体间的空灵联系……我们一直都了然于心。

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

在我们刚有历史记录以来，这个神秘的事物便一直存在于此。显然，祂选中了我们……但是，原因不得而知。

我们应该如何描述这种[This.GetSensation]呢？
shroud.5105.desc.en:
We have always known it... an ethereal connection with an entity we can neither define nor understand.

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

For as long as we have historical records, this mysterious thing has been there. That it has chosen us is clear... But, for what remains unknown.

By what name should we call this [This.GetSensation]?

shroud.5110.a.zh: 我们的视野向内扩展了。

shroud.5110.a.tt.zh:
获得该实体的调和度：$@chosen_patron_attunement_gift|0G$
可以通过通讯菜单访问虚境面板。
shroud.5110.a.tt.en:
Gain Attunement with this entity: $@chosen_patron_attunement_gift|0G$
The Shroud panel is accessible via the Contacts menu.

shroud.5110.desc_organic.zh:
$shroud.5110.desc_common$，用难以理解的体验诱惑着我们。

$shroud.5110.desc_common_2$
shroud.5110.desc_organic.en:
$shroud.5110.desc_common$, tempting us with experiences beyond our comprehension.

$shroud.5110.desc_common_2$

shroud.5110.desc_robot.zh:
$shroud.5110.desc_common$，用未知的原理优化着我们的参数。

$shroud.5110.desc_common_2$
shroud.5110.desc_robot.en:
$shroud.5110.desc_common$, streamlining our parameters in line with some as yet unknown principles.

$shroud.5110.desc_common_2$

shroud.512.desc.zh:
在例行土地探察时意外地发现了[This.GetName]上大片土地的土壤质量近年来急剧提高。

我们相信许多此前认为不适合耕种的土地现在可以用来扩张农业活动了。
shroud.512.desc.en:
A routine land survey has revealed that the soil quality on [This.GetName] has drastically improved in recent years across large swathes of the planet.

We believe that many areas once thought incapable of supporting agriculture can now be used to expand our farming efforts.

shroud.512.desc_anglers.zh: 一艘渔船在[This.GetName]的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。
shroud.512.desc_anglers.en: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of [This.GetName]. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

shroud.517.desc.zh:
在一场[This.GetName]上的地质活动后，有一处大型地下水库之下打开了一道裂口。行星地幔的热量加热着其中贮藏的水，在地表形成了地热喷口。

该自然现象让我们有机会用地热发电站和热泵来拓展殖民地的能源基础设施。
shroud.517.desc.en:
Following a tectonic shift, a fissure has opened under a large groundwater reservoir on [This.GetName]. The heat from the planet's mantle is boiling the trapped water deposit, causing geothermal vents to form on the surface.

This natural phenomenon provides us with an opportunity to expand the colony's energy infrastructure with new geothermal power plants and heat pumps.

shroud.522.desc.zh:
一个由亚原子元素构成的异常回路已在[physics_planet.GetName]附近自发形成。该量子粒子流每时每刻都在呈现出多种罕见的亚粒子相互作用，能产出令人瞠目结舌的关于量子动力学固有性质的数据。

对该量子场的重点研究将使我们增进对本宇宙基础构建单元的理解。
shroud.522.desc.en:
An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near [physics_planet.GetName]. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dynamics.

Focused study of this quantum field would allow us to better understand the fundamental building blocks of our universe.

shroud.527.desc.zh:
我们的[From.GetResearchers]在[society_planet.GetName]系发现了一处等时信号的集中点。

初步分析表明这些信号是从其他维度传输而来。初步翻译表明这些信息与逻辑原理和哲学困境有关。也许这是一种从我们无法理解的实体中获取知识丰富的尝试。

如果能源源不断地收集这些信号我们就能继续监视他们的发现。
shroud.527.desc.en:
Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near [society_planet.GetName].

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages relate to logical principles and philosophical quandaries. Perhaps this is an attempt at intellectual enrichment from entities beyond our comprehension.

If we establish a direct feed with these signals we can continue to monitor their revelations.

shroud.5300.b.zh: 我们希望能与其他虚境实体交流。
shroud.5300.b.en: We wish to commune with other Shroud entities.

shroud.5300.c.zh: 我们希望能提高与一位超主的调和度。
shroud.5300.c.en: We seek to further our attunement to a Patron.

shroud.5300.d.zh: 我们想知道虚境的秘密。
shroud.5300.d.en: We seek secrets from the Shroud.

shroud.5300.e.en: What can you tell us about $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$.

shroud.5300.g.zh: 我们希望扩展超主的灵域。
shroud.5300.g.en: We wish to expand our Patron's domain.

shroud.5305.b.zh: 我们可以用一些$sr_zro$来支持这项行动。
shroud.5305.b.en: We can support this endeavor with $sr_zro$.

shroud.5305.c.zh: 我我们可以用一些$astral_threads$来支持这项行动。
shroud.5305.c.en: We can support this endeavor with $astral_threads$.

shroud.5305.desc.zh:
对没有准备的人而言，在虚境的灵域交流十分凶险。

我们可以引导你们完成这个过程，但是要注意：有些居住在里面的实体如果迎接入人的意识里是非常危险的。
shroud.5305.desc.en:
Communing in the domains of the Shroud has proven to be a perilous endeavor for the unprepared.

We can guide you through this process, though take heed: The entities that dwell within can be very dangerous to welcome into one's mind.

shroud.5305.desc_all_contacted.zh:
在这件事上我们已经竭尽全力。已经没有我们能帮你们引荐的实体了。

我们赞许你们的努力……很少有人灵潜至虚境如此深层的灵域还能保持心智如此健全。
shroud.5305.desc_all_contacted.en:
We have reached the limits of our abilities to assist you in this regard. There are no further entities we are capable of guiding your thoughts to.

We commend you for your efforts... few delve so deeply into the domains of the Shroud and retain such soundness of mind.

shroud.5310.desc.zh:
你们与虚境的意志调和得越深，你们的心智就会变得越强大。

你们想要和哪一位实体增进调和度呢？
shroud.5310.desc.en:
The more deeply you attune to the Shroud's will, the more powerful your mind will become.

With which entity do you seek to further your attunement with?

shroud.5315.desc.zh:
噢，没错……虚境，它蕴藏着无数秘密，深深埋藏在思绪与梦境的帷幕之下——只要懂得如何去探寻，就能发现它们。

我们只能引领你去接触我们已揭示的洞见。在那里，或许能见到全新而强大的技术不断绽放，但长路漫漫，你仍需前进。

只需记住这一点：我们的灵能巫必须全身心投入这项领航的任务。而对于他们指引之外的事物……就不是我们所能掌控的了。
shroud.5315.desc.en:
Oh yes... the Shroud It is teeming with secrets, layered deep beneath veils of thought and dream - if one knows how to seek them.

We can only guide you to the insights we have uncovered. From there, new and formidable technologies may bloom, but the path is yours to walk.

Just know this: our coven of telepaths must devote themselves wholly to this task. What lies beyond their guidance... is not ours to control.

shroud.5315.trigger_failed.zh: [event_target:shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]在关于这个问题上已经没有什么可告知的了。
shroud.5315.trigger_failed.en: The [event_target:shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] have nothing more to reveal in this regard.

shroud.5318.desc.zh:
虚境再一次证明了世上一切本就命定。

我们的密会本要为你们寻求的洞见已经被你自己通过钻研努力发现了。你们的努力值得赞赏，而我们在这个方面也没有什么能帮助你们的了。
shroud.5318.desc.en:
The Shroud proves once again that there are no coincidences.

The insight our conclave sought for you has been discovered through your own delving efforts. While we applaud your efforts, we cannot help you further in this regard.

shroud.532.desc.zh:
[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]出现了一艘废弃舰船。[This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。
shroud.532.desc.en:
A derelict ship has appeared in [lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]. [This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

We have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctioned. No life signs are onboard, and we have already begun careful disassembly of the vessel to learn as much as we can.

shroud.5320.desc.aura.outro.zh: 你们光环的投射目前还很局限。你们应该可以获得虚境中的某一位实体的契约提案，这一理解将会使你们豁然开朗。
shroud.5320.desc.aura.outro.en: The projection of your aura is currently quite limited. Should an entity from within the Shroud offer you the forging of a Covenant, this understanding will clarify in your mind.

shroud.5320.desc.intensified.zh:
称赞你们。你们对$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的认知已经超越了我们。

你们的存在将虚境中的一种强大的肌理显化到我们的现实中。你们肯定知道着什么秘密……
shroud.5320.desc.intensified.en:
We commend you. Your knowledge of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ already surpasses our own.

Your very presence manifests a formidable texture of the Shroud into this reality. What secrets you must know...

shroud.5320.desc.none.zh: 将虚境显化到物理世界的方法是需要严守的秘密，这一点连我们也无可指教。要释放$PSIONIC_AURA$需要自己深入许多灵域。与最喜欢的实体调和，这项知识就会让你豁然开朗。
shroud.5320.desc.none.en: The capability to manifest the Shroud in the physical realm is a closely guarded secret, and one that even we cannot teach. To unleash one's $PSIONIC_AURA$ requires a personal journey into its many domains. Attune more heavily to a favored entity, and this knowledge will clarify in your mind.

shroud.5325.desc.zh:
$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的扩增需要极高程度的专注来维持。

我们愿意在此事上提供帮助，但需要提供一些材料助力冥想。
shroud.5325.desc.en:
The amplification of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ requires great levels of concentration to maintain.

We are willing to assist you in this matter, but will require the contribution of materials to fuel our meditation.

shroud.5327.desc.zh:
我们灵能使关于扩增你们$PSIONIC_AURA$强度的协议已经到期。

为了继续保持冥想，我们需要更多的资源。是否乐意成交？
shroud.5327.desc.en:
Our telepaths have reached the end of our agreement to amplify the strength of your $PSIONIC_AURA$.

In order for us to continue our meditations, we will require further resources. Is this within your interests?

shroud.5330.desc.zh:
如你们所知，在你们的周围显化你们自己的$PSIONIC_AURA$相当容易。但要把光环投射到其他地方，可就完全不是一回事了。

我们知道一种方法……

先进科技和灵能之间的相似之处比人们想象的要多。这也许说明了某种更根本的事实。无论如何，我们知道一种可以传导你们意志的装置。只要与其频率调谐之后，就能把它用作一个补充心智，跨越极远的距离。

我们的这种设计完全可以安装在任何一座适用的恒星基地上。你们对这感兴趣吗？
shroud.5330.desc.en:
As you know, manifesting your $PSIONIC_AURA$ in your immediate surroundings is quite easily done. To project one's aura somewhere else, however, is another matter entirely.

We know of a way...

There are more similarities between advanced technology and psionics than one would think. Perhaps this speaks to a greater fundamental truth. In any case, we know of a device that can serve as a conduit for your will. Once you become attuned to its frequencies, it will act as a supplementary mind even across great distances.

Our designs are fully capable of being installed in any suitable starbase. Does such a machine interest you?

shroud.5350.desc.zh:
你们问这个问题我们一点也不惊讶。我们已经在这里感知到你们的兴趣了，也很乐意帮助你们的心智扩张。

但我们警告你们：等你们的双眼真的睁开之时，就有东西再也无法视而不见了。你们正在追寻的正是一条通向虚境的路。

我们不轻易做这笔交易，相信你们做好准备的时候会来告诉我们的。
shroud.5350.desc.en:
It is no surprise to us that you ask this question. We have sensed your interest in this area, and are pleased to be in a position to assist you in expanding your mind.

We warn you: Once your eyes become truly opened, there are things that cannot be unseen. The path you are inviting is a path to the Shroud.

We do not make this offer lightly. We trust that you will let us know when you are ready.

shroud.5350.trigger_failed.en: This technology has already been researched.

shroud.5355.desc.zh:
确实，我们知道这些穿行于位面之间的人。这是一个危险的议案，各个物理世界联系在一起的方式连我们也不理解。

然而，我们愿意为你们打开一条道路。必须负责任以负责任的态度进行这种时空去稳化，所以我们如此提议。
shroud.5355.desc.en:
Indeed, we are aware of those who walk between planes. This is a dangerous proposition, as the physical realms are connected in ways even we do not understand.

However, we are willing to open one path for you. Such a destabilization of time and space must be done responsibly, so our offer stands at that.

shroud.537.desc.zh:
[mining_planet.GetName]的地表下地热活动变得非常剧烈。地下熔岩喷流顶穿行星地壳流入一些未开发的矿脉中。

该地质现象使一部分未开发的矿物受到高温，将其中的金属矿脉精炼成为坚固的合金。因此，在该行星上的矿物开采能够产出可用的金属碎片了。
shroud.537.desc.en:
Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of [mining_planet.GetName]. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.

This geological phenomenon has superheated some of the unexploited minerals, refining veins of metallic ore into solid alloys. As such, mining operations on the planet will now produce fragments of workable metal.

shroud.5375.desc.zh:
你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！

你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“虚境封印”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。
shroud.5375.desc.en:
You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!

These 'Shroud Seal' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Cease their creation immediately, or we will have no further dealings with you.

shroud.543.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]恒星系探测到一艘废弃的战舰缓缓飘过。舰船的设计和任何已知帝国都不同，也没有任何可辩识的旗帜或徽记。

在深度的评估和一些小修小补之后，我们的[This.GetEngineerPlural]认为这艘船现在已经符合服役条件了。
shroud.543.desc.en:
A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the [From.GetName] system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.

After an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEngineerPlural] have declared that the ship is now fit for active service.

shroud.543.tt.zh: 在该恒星系内获得一艘巡洋舰级舰船。
shroud.543.tt.en: Gain a cruiser class ship in the system.

shroud.545.a.en: The stars shine brightly upon us.

shroud.545.desc.zh: 一种难以言喻的乐观主义席卷了[This.GetAdjective]各星。大众们对自己的生活感到更加满足、舒适和惬意。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象吉兆引起，而且对[This.GetName]而言必须是一个好兆头。
shroud.545.desc.en: An inexplicable air of optimism is washing throughout [This.GetAdjective] worlds. The population is that bit more content, comfortable, and satisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments, and can only be a good omen for the future of the [This.GetName].

shroud.545.desc_gestalt.zh: [This.GetName]正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。
shroud.545.desc_gestalt.en: The [This.GetName] is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

shroud.553.a.en: A once in a lifetime event.

shroud.553.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系内的三个天体排列成了完美的三位一体构型；即[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]、[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]和[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]。

这种有利天象为我们在[This.GetName]的殖民地带来了宁静与和谐。
shroud.553.desc.en:
Three celestial bodies in the [From.GetName] system have aligned to form a favorable trine; [favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName], [favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName] and [favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName].

This beneficial astrological alignment brings a sense of tranquility and harmony to our colony on [This.GetName].

shroud.555.desc.zh:
[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]在[root.capital_scope.GetName]的夜空中升上吉位，入主天回星宫。

该天象代表[root.GetName]内在循环的新开端，是增长和发展的重大机遇。
shroud.555.desc.en:
[auspicious_position_planet.GetName] is occupying an auspicious position in the skies above [root.capital_scope.GetName], residing in the astrological House of Celestial Return.

This represents the commencement of a new internal cycle for the [root.GetName] and a prime opportunity for growth and improvement.

shroud.560.desc.zh:
所有定量占星矩阵都表明[This.GetName]目前处于完美的元素平衡。

利用精确的能量线管理可以将这种有益平衡维持很长时间，为我们领袖的繁盛提供理想的形而上环境。
shroud.560.desc.en:
All quantifiable astrological metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in perfect elemental balance.

With precise ley line management this beneficial equilibrium can be maintained for an extended period, providing an ideal metaphysical environment in which our leaders can flourish.

shroud.568.a.en: May the stars shine brightly upon us.

shroud.568.desc.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正在发出非凡的祥光。占星专家对此进行讨论后，我们理解了其能量的盈余将会增强[This.GetName]上各种各样的发电活动。
shroud.568.desc.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system is shining with extraordinary luster. After discussing this phenomenon with astrological specialists, we understand that its excess of energy will enhance all manners of power generation on [This.GetName].

shroud.570.desc.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]和[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]发现他们的占星结果高度互补。

因此，他们的政治伙伴关系在以尊重和效率为名将我们的政府凝聚了起来，加快了各种立法程序的推进。
shroud.570.desc.en:
Two of our council members, [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName] and [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName] recently discovered that their astrological signs are perfectly complementary.

Their subsequent political partnership has since united our government under a banner of mutual respect and efficiency, accelerating various legislative processes.

shroud.575.desc.zh:
在一次例行编目中，一个没固定好的的标本掉在了$grand_archive$的地上，随后被及时送到保管员那里进行进一步检查。

因为这场事故我们意外得发现，该标本中的一个秘密隔间松动了。里面藏着各种各样的有趣的文物可以丰富我们的馆藏，而此事之前完全未被注意到。
shroud.575.desc.en:
During a routine cataloging exercise, an unsecured specimen was dropped on the floor of the $grand_archive$ and was swiftly delivered to a conservator for closer examination.

Surprisingly, a secret compartment was found to have been loosened in the accident. Previously unnoticed, it contained a wide variety of interesting artifacts we can add to our collection.

shroud.6020.desc.zh: 就在我们试图与他们取得联系时，舰桥乘员突然感到了间歇性头痛……
shroud.6020.desc.en: As we attempt to make contact, our bridge crew suffers intermittent pangs of head pain...

shroud.6030.desc.zh: 尽管反复尝试，[exiled_country.GetName]依旧没有回复我们的通讯。
shroud.6030.desc.en: Despite repeated attempts, the [exiled_country.GetName] are not responding to our communications.

shroud.6050.desc.zh:
我们用于压制灵能的$building_ancient_ward_1$正在发出异常的读数。这通常是来自[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的灵能活动激增的结果，但我们并没有找到任何这种堕落行为的迹象。

那么答案也许就藏在我们的国境内。长距离遥感影像显示[exiled_system_border.GetName]系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与$building_ancient_ward_1$发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。
shroud.6050.desc.en:
Our psi-suppressive $building_ancient_ward_1$ is producing irregular readings. This would normally result from spikes in psionic activity on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], but we have found no evidence of such depravity.

The answer may lie beyond our borders. Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, which correlates with the erratic measurements of the $building_ancient_ward_1$.

shroud.6100.desc.border_aura.zh:
[root.GetName]的船员们岌岌可危。

在[from.GetName]恒星系里暴露到这种极高等级的灵能辐射后，他们开始产生比此前报道的更糟糕的精神压力。$shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

长程扫描表明有更高等级的辐射在从[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系中释放出来。$shroud.6100.desc.end$
shroud.6100.desc.border_aura.en:
The crew of the [root.GetName] is in danger.

Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the [from.GetName] system, they began experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. $shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

Long-range scanners indicate even higher levels of radiation in the nearby [exiled_center_system.GetName] system. $shroud.6100.desc.end$

shroud.6100.desc.no_border_aura.zh:
新探索到的[from.GetName]恒星系中一种令人警惕的情况正在酝酿。[root.GetName]的船员遭受到了一系列精神症状：$shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$。他们的舰队系统也发生了怪异的故障。

$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$在$building_ancient_ward_1$的保护不到的[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上，我们第一次体验到了祖先所警惕的心智疾病。

在校准了我们的长程扫描仪探测了这种独特的能量形式以后，我们发现这些危险发射的来源是附近的[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系。$shroud.6100.desc.end$
shroud.6100.desc.no_border_aura.en:
An alarming situation is developing in the newly explored [from.GetName] system. The crew of the [root.GetName] is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: $shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$. Their fleet's systems are also experiencing strange, erratic malfunctions.

$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$ Outside of the protection of the $building_ancient_ward_1$ on [owner.GetHomeWorldName], we are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered the source of these dangerous emissions to be the nearby [exiled_center_system.GetName] system. $shroud.6100.desc.end$

shroud.6110.desc.zh:
出乎意料的是，[This.System.GetName]恒星系中存在许多似乎是由智慧生物所建造的大型物体。我们为了了解其创造者，将其代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，并尝试在保持安全距离的前提下进行直接的沟通工作。

该恒星系内所有的生命形式必然都处在我们探测到的高水平灵能辐射的威胁下。
shroud.6110.desc.en:
Astonishingly, the [This.System.GetName] system appears to contain a number of large objects that appear to be of intelligent construction. We might learn more about their creators, code-named [This.ContactCountry.GetName], by attempting direct communications from a safe distance.

Any life forms in the system must be in great danger from the high levels of psi-radiation we detected.

shroud.6115.desc.zh:
进一步的研究确定在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的物体是一艘外星飞船，但我们还未与任何船上人员建立任何沟通渠道。

特使[exiled_envoy.GetName]汇报[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的团队开始遭受到超心灵学症状的困扰，包括[This.System.GetName]上出现奇特生物的无法解释的幻象。尽管有这些问题，我们的特使还是坚持投入[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的这项任务。
shroud.6115.desc.en:
Further study has confirmed the objects in the [This.System.GetName] system to be alien spacecraft, though we have yet to make contact with any of the vessel's occupants.

Troublingly, envoy [exiled_envoy.GetName] reports that [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team has begun suffering from parapsychological symptoms, including unexplained visions of strange beings present in [This.System.GetName]. Despite these concerns, our envoy remains steadfast in [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] dedication to the mission.

shroud.6120.desc.zh:
在数个月的寂静后，我们收到了一份来自[exiled_envoy.GetName]的通讯。这位通常冷静而直率的特使发来了一份离奇而混乱的报告。[exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap]杂乱无章地描述了一些奇怪的意象——显然是纠缠在一起的梦境和幻觉。[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]团队的所有人也都一样神志不清。

目前他们已经解除了职务，该任务也无限期搁置了。无论[This.System.GetName]里的到底是什么东西，目前我们都暂时没有办法安全地调查。
shroud.6120.desc.en:
After months of silence, we received a transmission from [exiled_envoy.GetName]. Usually sober and direct, the envoy gave a bizarre, muddled report. [exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap] submitted rambling descriptions of strange imagery - apparently a tangle of dreams and delusions. No member of [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team proved to be any more coherent.

They have been relieved of their duties, and this mission has been suspended indefinitely. Whatever presence is in [This.System.GetName], it is currently beyond our means to safely investigate.

shroud.6125.desc.zh:
悬浮在翻滚的水流之上。是[Root.Capital.GetName]，还是……？

……呼叫……

水面扭转着分开。恶臭的瘴气从无底的深处喷涌而出。

……回复……没有……

无休无止。令人窒息。

这太糟糕了。
shroud.6125.desc.en:
Suspended above the roiling current. [Root.Capital.GetName], or...?

...calling...

The surface twists open. A fetid miasma belches from unseen depths.

...answer...nothing...

Ceaseless. Suffocating.

It is terrible.

shroud.6200.a.zh: 让我们学会怎么阻止这种感染吧。
shroud.6200.a.en: Let us learn to stop this infection.

shroud.6200.desc.no_visit.zh:
[Root.GetHomeWorldName]中一种令人警惕的情况正在酝酿。大众正在遭受一系列精神症状：$shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$。

$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$那些在$building_ancient_ward_1$保护之外的人第一次体验到了祖先所警惕的心智疾病。

在校准了我们的长程扫描仪探测了这种独特的能量形式以后，我们发现这些危险发射的来源是附近的[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系。$shroud.shared_text_aura_study$
shroud.6200.desc.no_visit.en:
An alarming situation is developing on [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. The population is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: $shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$.

$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$ Those outside of the protection of our $building_ancient_ward_1$ are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered that these dangerous emissions spread from beyond the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system. $shroud.shared_text_aura_study$

shroud.6200.desc.visit_and_ship.zh:
$shroud.shared_text_aura_spread$

自从暴露在极高等级的灵能辐射中之后，[exiled_system_border.GetName]星系内的[event_target:ship_in_border.GetName]船员就开始承受比以往报道都更加严重的心理压力。$shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

$shroud.shared_text_aura_study$
shroud.6200.desc.visit_and_ship.en:
$shroud.shared_text_aura_spread$

Since being exposed to extremely high levels of psi-radiation, the crew of the [event_target:ship_in_border.GetName] in [exiled_system_border.GetName] is experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. $shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

$shroud.shared_text_aura_study$

shroud.6205.desc.aura_home.zh:
$shroud.6205.desc.start$

它已经沾染了[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]恒星系，造成了毁灭性的影响。$shroud.6205.desc.end$
shroud.6205.desc.aura_home.en:
$shroud.6205.desc.start$

It has already reached the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system, where the effects have been devastating. $shroud.6205.desc.end$

shroud.6205.desc.no_aura_home.zh:
$shroud.6205.desc.start$

如果它沾染上[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]恒星系，后果会是毁灭性的。$shroud.6205.desc.end$
shroud.6205.desc.no_aura_home.en:
$shroud.6205.desc.start$

If it reaches our [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system, the effects would be devastating. $shroud.6205.desc.end$

shroud.6210.desc.zh:
我们孜孜不倦的研究者们开发出了一种增强[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上$building_ancient_ward_1$的方法。通过改进灵能衰减器，它的防护效果不仅可以覆盖到整颗行星，还能保护[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]系。

这项研究激发了在该失落的科技领域内更广泛的研究。我们现在知道灵能辐射和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]意识之间存在着相互联系：不止是这种能量发射可以影响我们的精神状态，我们的精神状态也同样能影响灵能辐射等级。看来我们对“灵能”实践的古老禁忌是有科学依据的。
shroud.6210.desc.en:
Our tireless researchers have developed a method for strengthening the $building_ancient_ward_1$ on [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. By enhancing its psionic attenuators, the protection can be extended to cover not only the whole planet, but the entire [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system.

This research has stimulated broader study into this lost technology. We now know that the link between psi-radiation and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind is reciprocal: not only can these emissions affect our mental states, but our mental states can influence psi-radiation levels. It would seem that our immemorial taboo against 'psionic' practices has a scientific basis after all.

shroud.6215.a.en: This is research worthy of pursuit.

shroud.6215.desc.aura_home.zh: 我们的$building_ancient_ward_2$建好之后，[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]星系内的灵能辐射水平降低到了可控的范围之内。[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上，大众的各种症状逐渐缓解了过来。
shroud.6215.desc.aura_home.en: With our $building_ancient_ward_2$ now complete, psi-radiation in the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system has been reduced to manageable levels. The population of [Root.GetHomeWorldName] is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.

shroud.6215.desc.end.zh: 无论如何，这个$PSIONIC_AURA$以及可能存在着的其他同类都依旧在荼毒着这个恒星系。我们的科学家认为，$building_ancient_ward_2$的科技可以用于开发更强大的“$SHROUD_SEAL$”。这些硕大无比的装置可以抑制一整个星团的光环。在[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系建造一个$SHROUD_SEAL$将能大幅度提升控制灵能威胁的能力。
shroud.6215.desc.end.en: Nevertheless, this $PSIONIC_AURA$, and potentially others, still poisons the wider galaxy. Our scientists hypothesize that the technology of the $building_ancient_ward_2$ could be applied to the development of a more powerful '$SHROUD_SEAL$'. These massive structures should be able to suppress Auras in entire star clusters. Building a $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system will be a significant advancement in controlling the psionic menace.

shroud.6215.desc.no_aura_home.zh: 随着我们$building_ancient_ward_2$的完工，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]星系内的灵能辐射水平降低到了可控的范围之内。大众的各种症状逐渐缓解了过来。
shroud.6215.desc.no_aura_home.en: With our $building_ancient_ward_2$ now complete, psi-radiation on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] has been reduced to manageable levels. The population is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.

shroud.6220.desc.zh: 自从暴露在极高等级的灵能辐射中之后，[exiled_system_border.GetName]星系内的[Root.GetName]船员就开始承受比以往报道都更加严重的心理压力。$shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$
shroud.6220.desc.en: Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, the crew of the [Root.GetName] is experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. $shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

shroud.6225.a.know_aura.tt.en:
The $PSIONIC_AURA$ of the [exiled_country.GetName] has the following effects:
$effect_exiled_aura$

shroud.6225.a.no_know_aura.tt.zh:
该灵能现象具有如下效果：
$effect_exiled_aura$
shroud.6225.a.no_know_aura.tt.en:
This psionic phenomenon has the following effects:
$effect_exiled_aura$

shroud.6225.desc.know_aura.zh:
$PSIONIC_AURA$已经散播进[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]系。$shroud.6225.desc.shared$

升级$building_ancient_ward_1$已经比以往更加迫在眉睫了。
shroud.6225.desc.know_aura.en:
The $PSIONIC_AURA$ has spread to the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system. $shroud.6225.desc.shared$

The urgency of strengthening the $building_ancient_ward_1$ is greater than ever.

shroud.6225.desc.no_know_aura.zh:
灵能瘟疫已经传播到了[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]系。$shroud.6225.desc.shared$

弄明白这种污染比以往更加迫在眉睫了。
shroud.6225.desc.no_know_aura.en:
The psionic blight has spread to the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system. $shroud.6225.desc.shared$

The urgency of understanding this contamination is greater than ever.

shroud.6231.a.zh: 我们必须重新夺得控制权，片刻不能耽误。
shroud.6231.a.en: We must regain control without delay.

shroud.6231.desc.zh: 我们失去了对母星[root.GetHomeWorldName]的控制。作为我们主要的知识储备地和所有社会活动的中心，如果不夺回它，我们将无法继续推进我们的反灵能事业。
shroud.6231.desc.en: We have lost control of our homeworld, [root.GetHomeWorldName]. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.

shroud.6241.desc.zh: 我们重新获得了母星[root.GetHomeWorldName]的控制权。[root.GetName]可以继续全力推动反灵能事业。
shroud.6241.desc.en: We have regained control of our homeworld, [root.GetHomeWorldName]. The [root.GetName] can resume anti-psionic endeavors in full force.

shroud.6300.a.en: So the 'Shroud' is real after all...?

shroud.6300.desc.zh:
我们的科学家们完成了对先进$tech_psionic_suppression$科技的研发。现在可以在我们控制的任何一个殖民地内建造$building_psionic_suppressor$来复现$building_ancient_ward_2$的效果了。

然而，要在其他恒星系内控制$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的传播，我们还需要建造一种被称为$SHROUD_SEAL$的更加强大的装置。$shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$

这项研究也证实了一个令人不安的理论：存在着一个被称为“虚境”的空灵领域！古代神秘文献中描述的那种灵能维度很有可能是真的。该理论认为，感性众生的认知活动可以使能量从虚境内传递到可观察现实中——这种过程就是$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的一般性来源。

这意味着我们不仅仅只是在与宇宙的客观力量作斗争，而是与某种潜在的未知意图的可疑行为对抗。
shroud.6300.desc.en:
Our scientists have completed the development of advanced $tech_psionic_suppression$ technology. We can now replicate the effects of the $building_ancient_ward_2$ on any colony under our control by building a $building_psionic_suppressor$.

However, to control the spread of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ in other systems, we will need to construct a more powerful device known as a $SHROUD_SEAL$. $shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$

This research has also given credence to a disturbing theory: an ethereal realm known as the 'Shroud', a dimension of psionic energy described in occult texts of old, appears to truly exist. The theory posits that the cognitive activity of sentient beings can cause energy to pass from the Shroud into observable reality - and this process is the root cause of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ in general.

This means that we are not merely contending with objective forces of the universe, but potentially calculated actions of unknown intent.

shroud.6500.desc.zh: 我们从[exiled_system_border.GetName]系之外接收到了一份意料之外的通讯。[exiled_country.GetName]莫名其妙地完全掌握了我们的语言和通讯系统。
shroud.6500.desc.en: We are receiving an unexpected transmission from beyond the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system. The [exiled_country.GetName] have inexplicably gained complete mastery of both our language and communication systems.

shroud.6510.a.zh: 我们之前可没收到过什么通讯。
shroud.6510.a.en: We received no prior communication from you.

shroud.6510.name.zh: 灵主乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特

shroud.6515.a.zh: 这光环具有破坏性，是一种瘟疫。
shroud.6515.a.en: The aura is destructive. A plague.

shroud.6515.desc.zh: 我们用真音和你们沟通。你们听到了，你们肯定能听到内心的传音。你们有这种天赋的，但你们选择了压制。
shroud.6515.desc.en: We spoke with the true voice. Had you listened, you would have heard the call within. You have the gift, though you choose to suppress it.

shroud.6520.a.zh: 如果我们拒绝你们的要求呢？
shroud.6520.a.en: What if we refuse your demands?

shroud.6520.desc.zh: 你的理解有问题。光环是我们守护神赐予的神圣礼物。它能打倒一切带来毁灭之物。
shroud.6520.desc.en: Your understanding is faulty. The aura is a sacred gift of our protector. It casts down that which seeks to destroy.

shroud.6525.b.en: We agree to dismantle the Seal.

shroud.6525.desc.zh: 损害光环者无论是谁，都要镇压。如果你们拒绝，我们就要被迫采取军事行动了。
shroud.6525.desc.en: Whoever harms the aura must be subdued. If you refuse, we will be forced to take military action.

shroud.6525_heritage.a.zh: 我们绝不会摧毁自己的遗产。
shroud.6525_heritage.a.en: We will never destroy our heritage.

shroud.6550.desc.zh:
为了避免与[exiled_country.GetName]发生直接冲突，我们默认了他们对拆解[exiled_system_border.GetName]系内$SHROUD_SEAL$的要求。

与那些散布灵能瘟疫的家伙们的接触已经在[this.GetName]引起了严重关切。移除$SHROUD_SEAL$似乎也只能是一种暂时的绥靖政策。他们很定还会想要对我们的$building_ancient_ward_2$做一样的事情的——这就是我们绝对不能接受的事情。

无论如何，一战在所难免。
shroud.6550.desc.en:
In order to avoid immediate conflict with the [exiled_country.GetName], we acquiesced to their demands to dismantle the $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system.

Exposure to those responsible for the psionic pestilence has caused grave concern throughout the [this.GetName]. Removal of the $SHROUD_SEAL$ is only likely to be a short term appeasement.
