They will eventually expect the same of our $building_ancient_ward_2$ - and that is something we cannot accept.

In any case, future hostilities seem inevitable.

shroud.6570.a.zh: 这话该说给你们自己听。闭嘴吧。
shroud.6570.a.en: You should do likewise. End transmission.

shroud.6570.desc.zh: $shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission$尽管你们已经同意拆除了$SHROUD_SEAL$，但我们知道你们还在[capital_scope.GetName]维持这一座与之功能相似的建筑。你们的意图路人皆知。$shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain$
shroud.6570.desc.en: $shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission$ Though you agreed to dismantle the $SHROUD_SEAL$, we are aware that you have maintained a building on [capital_scope.GetName] with similar capabilities. Your intent is clear. $shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain$

shroud.6575.desc.zh: $shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission$你们重建$SHROUD_SEAL$的行为彻底浇灭了我们对救赎你们的一切期望。$shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain$
shroud.6575.desc.en: $shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission$ Your rebuilding of the $SHROUD_SEAL$ has extinguished any hopes we had for your redemption. $shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain$

shroud.6580.desc.zh:
随着巨大的灵能衰减器闪耀着启动，我们的$SHROUD_SEAL$开始逐渐将$PSIONIC_AURA$驱赶出[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系。

跨星系扫描确认了帝国领土的其他部分都直接通过超空间航道连接到[exiled_center_system.GetName]。只需要一座$SHROUD_SEAL$就能打消整个[exiled_country.GetName]境内的$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$。

我们胜利的关键就在于保护封印了。
shroud.6580.desc.en:
With its colossal psionic attenuators flared into action, our $SHROUD_SEAL$ is now in the process of driving out the $PSIONIC_AURA$ from the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system.

Interstellar scans have confirmed that the rest of our enemy's territory is directly connected to [exiled_center_system.GetName] via hyperlane. This single $SHROUD_SEAL$ is therefore capable of dissipating $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ throughout the entire territory of the [exiled_country.GetName].

Our victory hinges on the protection of the Seal.

shroud.6600.desc.zh:
我们征服了[current_planet.GetName]上造成灵能威胁的殖民地。

我们了解到在该恒星系内出现的$PSIONIC_AURA$受到了人口与虚境的心灵交互的增强。这些举措是由一群称为灵道会的精英灵能者们领导的。这个灵能邪教在宣导他们对所谓“超主”的忠诚，而这超主据称是虚境内一个强大实体，我们仅知道其被称为$r_the_lost_patron$。

他们的经文反复提到与这个存在有关的灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球[other_planet.GetName]上。找到这个东西就可以帮助我们阻止他们继续传播影响。
shroud.6600.desc.en:
The colony of the psionic menace on [current_planet.GetName] has been conquered.

We have learned that the $PSIONIC_AURA$ present in this system was being amplified by the population's psychic interactions with the Shroud. These practices are led by a group of elite telepaths, the Assembly of Mindways. This psionic cult promotes devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud, known only as $r_the_lost_patron$.

Their sacred texts make repeated mention of an artifact related to this being - apparently still extant on the planet [other_planet.GetName]. Acquiring this object will aid us in preventing further spread of their influence.

shroud.6601.desc.zh:
我们完成了对[current_planet.GetName]的殖民，这曾是一颗[exiled_country.GetName]的行星。

从他们残留的记录中我了解到，该恒星系内此前存在的$PSIONIC_AURA$是由人口和虚境的心灵互动造成的。带领这种行为的灵能邪教鼓吹诡异所谓的“超主”，据说是虚境里的一个叫做$r_the_lost_patron$的强大实体。

他们经文的残片中反复提到与这个存在有关的某件灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球[other_planet.GetName]上。要实现这个目标，就需要更慎重地征服[other_planet.GetName]，留下一部分人口。
shroud.6601.desc.en:
We have completed our colonization of [current_planet.GetName], a former world of the [exiled_country.GetName].

From the remains of their records, we have learned that the $PSIONIC_AURA$ previously present in this system was caused by the population's psychic interactions with the Shroud. These practices were led by a psionic cult that promoted devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud known as $r_the_lost_patron$.

Fragments of their sacred texts refer to an artifact related to this being, apparently still extant on the planet [other_planet.GetName]. Securing this object would require a more measured conquest of [other_planet.GetName], leaving some of its population intact.

shroud.6700.a.zh: 令人不安的消息……继续调查。

shroud.6700.desc.contact.zh: 对[current_planet.GetName]的征服标志着我们对[exiled_country.GetName]的最终胜利。$shroud.6700.desc.common$
shroud.6700.desc.contact.en: The conquest of [current_planet.GetName] marked our final victory against the [exiled_country.GetName]. $shroud.6700.desc.common$

shroud.6700.desc.no_contact.zh: 在征服了[current_planet.GetName]之后，我们获得了曾经由一个名为[exiled_country.GetName]的帝国统治的领土。$shroud.6700.desc.common$
shroud.6700.desc.no_contact.en: In conquering [current_planet.GetName], we gained control of territory once ruled by an empire known as the [exiled_country.GetName]. $shroud.6700.desc.common$

shroud.6700.desc.no_exiled.zh: 在征服[current_planet.GetName]时，我们夺取了曾由心灵虔诚信徒统治的领土。$shroud.6700.desc.common$
shroud.6700.desc.no_exiled.en: In conquering [current_planet.GetName], we gained control of territory once ruled by psionic zealots. $shroud.6700.desc.common$

shroud.6705.a.zh: 愿所有此类威胁都被消除。
shroud.6705.a.en: May all such threats be vanquished.

shroud.6705.desc.contact.zh:
对[current_planet.GetName]上人口的彻底清除，标志着[exiled_country.GetName]帝国的终结。

$shroud.6705.desc.common$
shroud.6705.desc.contact.en:
The eradication of the population on [current_planet.GetName] marked the end of the empire known as the [exiled_country.GetName].

$shroud.6705.desc.common$

shroud.6705.desc.no_contact.zh:
对[current_planet.GetName]上人口的彻底清除，标志着一场毁灭性灵能威胁的终结。

$shroud.6705.desc.common$
shroud.6705.desc.no_contact.en:
The eradication of the population on [current_planet.GetName] marked the end of a devastating psionic threat.

$shroud.6705.desc.common$

shroud.6710.desc.zh:
我们的研究者对[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]上的“茧”进行了全面的分析。

对这座宏伟建筑的外部扫描显示，它是一个专门设计用于容纳强大灵能实体的高规格安全容器。尽管该容器有重合金绝缘层，但高水平的灵能辐射还是透过外壳渗漏了出来。

茧的周围安装有一组灵能衰减器；激活的时候时，周边地区的所有人都受到了严重的神经损伤。

茧的表面随之扭曲，从卵型变成了不断变化的螺旋形。其上的孔穴洞窟，我们接到了来自内部的直接通信……
shroud.6710.desc.en:
Our researchers conducted a thorough analysis of the 'cocoon' on [sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName].

External scans of this imposing structure revealed it to be a highly secure receptacle designed to contain a powerful psionic entity. Despite the container's insulative layers of heavy alloys, high levels of psi-radiation are permeating through the enclosure nonetheless.

A group of psionic attenuators were installed around the cocoon; when activated, everyone in the vicinity was struck with searing levels of neural distress.

The surface of the cocoon then twisted, its ovoid form becoming a shifting helix. The aperture has opened, and we are receiving direct communication from within...

shroud.6720.a.zh: 我们不会让你荼毒我们的心智的！
shroud.6720.a.en: We will not let you poison our minds!

shroud.6720.desc.zh: 你听得到，但听不见。为什么？
shroud.6720.desc.en: You hear, but do not listen. Why?

shroud.6723.desc.zh:
荼毒？不是毒……

这是一首歌。唱歌就要先听见。敞开心扉，共享美好吧。
shroud.6723.desc.en:
Poison? Not poison...

A song. To sing, you must listen. Let go of your self, and share its beauty.

shroud.6725.desc.zh:
轮回飞转……我们倾听。

星辰飞旋……我们歌唱。
shroud.6725.desc.en:
As the wheel spins... we listen.

As the stars spin... we sing.

shroud.6730.desc.zh: 转个不停。在上面，也在下面。是被叫做“虚境”的和声。
shroud.6730.desc.en: Ever-turning. Above and beneath. A harmony known as the 'Shroud'.

shroud.6735.a.zh: 把你关在这里的人走了。
shroud.6735.a.en: The ones who kept you here are gone.

shroud.6735.desc.zh: 我在……做梦。梦见了一首歌。但歌声沉默了。合唱声去了哪里呢？
shroud.6735.desc.en: I am... dreaming. Dreaming of a song. But the voices have gone silent. Where did the chorus go?

shroud.6740.desc.en: You are here. You might sing...

shroud.6745.desc.zh:
是醒与梦之间的细流……是此方与彼方之间的道路。

你听不见……你们的心智无法理解……
shroud.6745.desc.en:
A flow between waking and dreaming... A path between here and there.

You cannot hear them - your minds lack the understanding...

shroud.6750.a.en: What can you offer us in return?

shroud.6750.desc.zh: 我想听见歌声……但万籁俱寂……为什么？
shroud.6750.desc.en: I want to hear singing... Everything is so quiet... Why?

shroud.6755.a.en: How do we know we can trust you?

shroud.6755.desc.zh: 可以让你们看看……我的梦。星球的诞生。
shroud.6755.desc.en: I can show you... my dreams. The making of worlds.

shroud.6760.desc.zh:
你只需听着。这首歌是真理，只因它的美。这是一首美丽的真理。

但你的心关着。可以敞开的。
shroud.6760.desc.en:
You need only listen. The song is true because it is beautiful. A beautiful truth.

But your minds are closed. They can be opened.

shroud.6763.desc.zh: 我还在这……听着两个世界的歌。但这边的一首失声了。
shroud.6763.desc.en: I am there still... I listen to the songs of two worlds. This one is muted.

shroud.6770.b.zh: 想方设法利用这个……东西。
shroud.6770.b.en: Find a way to make use of this... thing.

shroud.6770.desc.zh:
我们在[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]上发现的茧里寄宿着一个强大的异次元实体。它在某种意义上似乎就是威胁到我们心智健全的$PSIONIC_AURA$的源头。

我们的灵能衰减器暂时减轻了它的危险，但目前还不清楚还能抑制它多久。如果能够妥善控制，我们甚至有可能利用它可怕的力量来实现自己的目的。

然而我们社会的多数人呼吁立即将其摧毁。这种东西光是存在就已经站在我们长久以来价值观的对立面上了。
shroud.6770.desc.en:
The cocoon we discovered on [sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName] harbors a powerful interdimensional entity. It is likely that this being was somehow responsible for the $PSIONIC_AURA$ that threatened the sanctity of our minds.

Our psionic attenuators are mitigating the danger it poses for now, but it is unclear how long our devices can restrain its influence. It is possible that, under controlled circumstances, we can harness its terrible power for our own purposes.

Nevertheless, many in our society are calling for its immediate destruction. Its very existence stands against our long-held values.

shroud.6780.desc.zh:
思想穿透了灵能屏障。

我们听到了一段旋律，明亮但刺耳。

我们知道这种痛苦，强烈而熟悉。

你听见了。这梦是你的……唱吧，唱吧……
shroud.6780.desc.en:
Thoughts penetrate our minds.

We hear a melody, bright and abrasive.

We know this pain, great and familiar.

You listened. The dream is yours... Sing, sing...

shroud.6785.desc.zh: 我兑现了承诺。我为你们做了个梦。
shroud.6785.desc.en: Just as I promised. I have dreamt for you.

shroud.6790.a.zh: 这些星球对我们有什么用？
shroud.6790.a.en: What use are these worlds to us?

shroud.6790.desc.zh: 星球。新的星球，在我和你之间。
shroud.6790.desc.en: Worlds. New worlds, between mine and yours.

shroud.6795.a.tt.zh: 在我国境内最多可添加三颗虚境星球，每个星系最多一颗。
shroud.6795.a.tt.en: Adds up to three Shrouded Worlds within our borders, with a maximum of one per system.

shroud.6795.desc.zh: 让我对它们歌唱吧。唱最明亮的歌。
shroud.6795.desc.en: Let me sing to them. The brightest of songs.

shroud.6800.a.tt.zh: 现在可以将30以上规模的舰队转化为$gov_mindwarden_enclave$。
shroud.6800.a.tt.en: Any fleet of size 30 or more can now be converted into a $gov_mindwarden_enclave$.

shroud.6800.desc.zh:
我们已经积累了大量关于虚境的知识，开发出了能抑制其恶劣影响的先进科技。在讨论如何将这种技术大规模应用到全星系的过程中，我们的舰队司令提出了一项有趣的提案。

他们建议将我们的一支舰队设立为一个独立的“$gov_mindwarden_enclave$”，这样就能向全星系的客户提供反灵能服务了。$shroud.shared_enclave_investement$
shroud.6800.desc.en:
We have amassed great knowledge of the Shroud, and developed advanced technologies to suppress its pernicious effects. While debating how to apply this mastery galaxy-wide, our fleet commanders have put forward an interesting proposal.

They suggest setting up one of our fleets as an independent '$gov_mindwarden_enclave$', which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. $shroud.shared_enclave_investement$

shroud.6825.desc_default.zh: 我们正在考虑将[This.GetName]设立为一座独立的“$gov_mindwarden_enclave$”以向整个星系提供反灵能服务。$shroud.shared_enclave_investement$
shroud.6825.desc_default.en: We are considering setting up the [This.GetName] as an independent '$gov_mindwarden_enclave$', which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. $shroud.shared_enclave_investement$

shroud.6825.desc_first.zh: [This.GetName]已经找到了一位适合创建我们第一个独立$gov_mindwarden_enclave$的候选者。如果审核通过，这支舰队将会在[This.Solar_System.GetName]设立一座新的设施，并立即开始提供反灵能服务。
shroud.6825.desc_first.en: The [This.GetName] has been identified as a suitable candidate to form the basis of our first independent $gov_mindwarden_enclave$. If authorized, the fleet would establish a new facility in [This.Solar_System.GetName] and begin providing anti-psionic services forthwith.

shroud.6830.a.zh: 我们的旅程才刚刚开始

shroud.6830.desc.zh:
与虚境以及灵能滥用的斗争让我们的人民变得更加强大，也更明确了我们的目标。第一座$gov_mindwarden_enclave$的建立正标志着一个康复和抵抗的新纪元。

在整个星系中，心智不再被灵能侵犯，所有星球都不再受到虚境力量的折磨。

这就是$MINDWARDEN_plural$时代。
shroud.6830.desc.en:
Contending with the Shroud and the irresponsible use of psionics has strengthened our people and clarified our goals into sharper focus. The foundation of the first $gov_mindwarden_enclave$ is the advent of a new age of healing and resistance.

Throughout the galaxy, no mind need be invaded by psionic aggressors, and no world tormented by forces from the Shroud.

It is now the age of the $MINDWARDEN_plural$.

shroud.6855.b.zh: 我们希望帮你们升级太空城邦。
shroud.6855.b.en: We want to help expand your enclave.

shroud.6855.b.timeout.zh: 该太空城邦目前正在招募新的官员和船员。在[mindwarden_enclave_country.upgraded_station_timer]之前无法对业务进行进一步升级。
shroud.6855.b.timeout.en: The enclave is currently recruiting new officers and crew. It cannot commence further operational improvements until after [mindwarden_enclave_country.upgraded_station_timer].

shroud.6855.c.zh: 我们希望能和你们共享科技。
shroud.6855.c.en: We want to share our technology with you.

shroud.6855.c.timeout.zh: 这个城邦仍在消化之前我们所分享的技术。我们可以在[mindwarden_enclave_country.updating_databanks_timer]之后继续与他们分享新的科技。
shroud.6855.c.timeout.en: The enclave is still incorporating tech we provided previously. We can share new technologies with them after [mindwarden_enclave_country.updating_databanks_timer].

shroud.6855.d.zh: 我们希望能雇佣一支你们的舰队为我们服务。
shroud.6855.d.en: We wish to hire a fleet for our own purposes.

shroud.6855.desc.zh: 请知悉。我们乐与[root.GetName]维持紧密的合作关系；我们的历史和目标永远紧密相连。
shroud.6855.desc.en: Please make it known. We are glad to maintain close cooperation with the [root.GetName]; our histories and aims are forever bound.

shroud.6855.desc.1.zh: 我们永远感谢您对[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的贡献。只要灵能威胁还在肆虐，我们的关系便不可动摇。
shroud.6855.desc.1.en: We are forever thankful for your contribution to the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]. For as long as the psionic threat remains, may our bond be unwavering.

shroud.6855.desc.2.zh: 你大可放心，下一笔利润分红也将及时支付。
shroud.6855.desc.2.en: You can trust that your next profit-share payment will be delivered in a timely fashion.

shroud.6855.f.zh: 我希望提升我们的灵督城邦容量。
shroud.6855.f.en: We wish to increase our Mindwarden enclave capacity.

shroud.6855.f.timeout.zh: 我们仍在实施与太空城邦有关的基础设施改革。到[mindwarden_enclave_country.mindwarden_enclave_capacity_bought_timer]为止我们无法再提高灵督城邦的容量了。
shroud.6855.f.timeout.en: We are still implementing enclave-related infrastructural changes. We cannot increase our Mindwarden enclave capacity again until [mindwarden_enclave_country.mindwarden_enclave_capacity_bought_timer].

shroud.6860.1.desc.zh: 有了更多资金，我们就能大幅度扩大行动。我们可以提升舰队的数量和质量，招募更多的科研人员来开发心灵防护科技。最终，整个星系都将从您的慷慨解囊中收益。
shroud.6860.1.desc.en: With additional funds, we could greatly expand our operation. We could increase the number and capabilities of our fleets, and recruit more researchers to develop our mind-protective technologies. Ultimately, the whole galaxy would benefit from your patronage.

shroud.6860.2.desc.zh: 我们必须对诡计多端的灵能威胁保持警惕。您的慷慨捐赠将使我们能够大大扩大业务规模以应对这种挑战。
shroud.6860.2.desc.en: We must remain vigilant against the ever-changing threat of psionics. Your generous donation would allow us to significantly scale up our operations to meet this challenge.

shroud.6860.3.desc.zh: 我们已取得了诸多成就，但现在休息还为时尚早。只要能支配更多资源，[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队就能在星系中部署得更远，守护更多被灵能所困扰的心灵。
shroud.6860.3.desc.en: We have achieved much, but it is too soon to take rest. With more resources at our disposal, the fleets of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] could be deployed even further across the galaxy, protecting even greater numbers of minds plagued by psionics.

shroud.6860.4.desc.zh: 帮助我们踏上旅程的正是您提供的启动资金，而我们的目标仍然是一样的：通过彻底根除灵能来促进心灵健康。有了您的帮助，我们离目标越来越近了。
shroud.6860.4.desc.en: Your patronage has defined our journey from the very outset, and our shared goals remain the same: fostering mental wellbeing by the complete eradication of psionics. With your aid, we are inching ever closer to our goal.

shroud.6860.5.desc.zh: 如果您认为值得再次投资我们的行动，我们就将成为星系中最大的反灵能军——群星间所有国家抵抗精神入侵的最高堡垒。
shroud.6860.5.desc.en: If you see fit to invest in our operations once again, we could become the largest anti-psionic force in the galaxy - the supreme bastion against mind invasion for all nations among the stars.

shroud.6861.desc.zh: 谢谢。很荣幸我们能与您合作，保护所有智慧生命的精神完整性。
shroud.6861.desc.en: Thank you. We are proud to work with you to protect the psychic integrity of all intelligent beings.

shroud.6865.desc.zh:
一项伟大的事业。星系中$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$的数量越多，所有人的灵魂就越不容易受到入侵。

我们可以就提高基础设施效率提供建议，以便建立、管理更多的城邦。
shroud.6865.desc.en:
A fine undertaking. The more $ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$ there are in the galaxy, the safer all minds are from invasion.

We can provide counsel on improving your infrastructural efficiency to allow for the establishment and administration of more enclaves.

shroud.6870.desc.zh: 我们很感谢您愿意分享这些研究成果。你传授给我们的所有知识都将有助于加强星系面对灵能威胁的保护。
shroud.6870.desc.en: We appreciate your willingness to share the fruits of your research. Any knowledge you impart to us will help strengthen the galaxy's protection from psionic threats.

shroud.6875.desc.zh: 我们很荣幸能肩挑重任。[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队位于反灵能科技与战术的最前沿；任何试图入侵心灵的敌人都无法在他们面前立足。每支舰队都配备了一名专门接受过对抗灵能作战训练的指挥官。
shroud.6875.desc.en: We would be honored to oblige. Fleets from the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] are at the vanguard of anti-psionic technology and tactics; no mind-invading aggressor stands a chance against them. Each is deployed with a commander specially trained in operations against psionic opponents.

shroud.6876.desc.zh: 我们相信[mercenary_fleet.GetName]在对付那些玩弄灵能毁灭性力量的家伙们时会是强有力的工具。
shroud.6876.desc.en: We trust that the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will be an effective tool in combating those who toy with the destructive power of psionics.

shroud.6880.desc.zh: 确实。我们希望[mercenary_fleet.GetName]令您如虎添翼。您打算终止或延长我们的协议吗？
shroud.6880.desc.en: Certainly. We hope the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] has proven a valuable addition to your forces. Do you wish to terminate or prolong our contract?

shroud.6881.desc.zh: 很好。合约已终止，[mercenary_fleet.GetName]会立即返回。我们的舰队在您需要的时候永远等待您的雇佣。
shroud.6881.desc.en: Very well. The contract is void and the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will return to us immediately. Our fleets are available to hire whenever you require them.

shroud.700.desc.zh: 在我们的各个星球上，一种难以言喻的恐惧笼罩着所有人。人们对自己的生活感到愈发苦恼、烦躁和不满。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象凶兆引起的。
shroud.700.desc.en: There is an inexplicable sense of looming dread throughout the population on our worlds. The people are feeling more distressed, distracted, and dissatisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

shroud.700.desc_gestalt.zh: 有一种不和谐的感觉笼罩着[This.GetName]。这种协调匮乏正在使我们集体的多方面陷入停滞，这肯定是由于不佳的天象引起的。
shroud.700.desc_gestalt.en: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the [This.GetName]. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

shroud.707.desc.zh:
在位于[This.System.GetName]的例行海军演习中因为通讯失误导致[This.GetName]的多艘战舰发生高速碰撞事故。

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader]通报，对这次事故负主要责任的[From.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经按条例处分。
shroud.707.desc.en:
A miscommunication during routine naval maneuvers has caused a high-speed collision between multiple combat ships of the [This.GetName] in [This.System.GetName].

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader] has confirmed that the [From.GetIndividualNamePlural] responsible for this error have been disciplined appropriately.

shroud.7099.desc.zh:
我们的思绪带着全新的目的在虚境中行动。当我们试着推进时，它也在将我们回推。起初，我们将此解读为对我们存在的抗拒，但如今我们明白了：虚境正在向我们发问。

尽管这些问题的含义依旧模糊，但它们并非无关紧要。据[GetTelepathPlural]所言，我们给出的答案将会影响社会的未来。
shroud.7099.desc.en:
Our thoughts move through the Shroud with newfound intent. As we push, it pushes back. At first, we interpreted this as resistance to our presence, but now we understand: the Shroud is asking questions of us.

Though hazy in meaning, these questions are not trivial. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the answers we give will influence the future of our society.

shroud.710.desc.zh: 灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
shroud.710.desc.en: The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.

shroud.710.desc_default.zh:
[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

$shroud.710.desc$
shroud.710.desc_default.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on [silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName] resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

$shroud.710.desc$

shroud.710.desc_starbase.zh:
[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName]中[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation]的恒星基地上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

$shroud.710.desc$
shroud.710.desc_starbase.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on the [silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation] of [silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName] resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

$shroud.710.desc$

shroud.7100.desc.zh:
我们与虚境的连结稳固；时刻准备着受到召唤。一段有节奏的乐句传信而来，这是虚境在对我们歌唱。

$shroud.7100.desc.common$
shroud.7100.desc.en:
Our link to the Shroud is strong; we are ready when it calls. The message comes in rhythmic phrases. The Shroud is singing to us.

$shroud.7100.desc.common$

shroud.7100.tt.zh: 虚境在等待着我们回应……

shroud.7105.desc.zh:
无形之物起起落落，呢喃声中，又一个意识破茧而出。

$shroud.7100.desc.common$
shroud.7105.desc.en:
Something unseen shifts, and with a whisper another thought is birthed.

$shroud.7100.desc.common$

shroud.7105.tt.zh: 虚境在渴求着我们回应……
shroud.7105.tt.en: The Shroud is eager for our response...

shroud.7110.tt.zh: 虚境震颤着，期待着我们的回应……
shroud.7110.tt.en: The Shroud trembles in anticipation of our response...

shroud.7120.a.default.zh: 让我们拥抱灵能超凡入圣。

shroud.7120.a.gestalt.zh: 灵能飞升对集体而言是最优解。
shroud.7120.a.gestalt.en: Psionic transcendence is optimal for the collective.

shroud.7120.b.default.zh: 我们无需这种变革也能蓬勃发展。
shroud.7120.b.default.en: We can flourish without such changes.

shroud.7120.desc.zh:
$shroud.7120.desc.common$

我们已升华的心灵正蓄势待发，准备迎接进一步的转化。那些用于承载心灵所需的物质载体，其重要性将大幅降低。

若我们继续沿着这条道路前行，人口将能超越对物质事务的关注，全身心地将部分存在投入到虚境之中。相比于精神敏锐度的提升，体力劳动能力的下降只是微不足道的代价。
shroud.7120.desc.en:
$shroud.7120.desc.common$

Our ascended minds are primed for further transformation. The vessels that serve as support to the physical needs of the mind could become much less significant.

If we continue down this path, our population can transcend its concern with physical matters and commit itself fully to a partial existence inside of the Shroud. A reduced capacity for physical labor will be a small price for gains in mental acuity.

shroud.7121.a.en: Let the songs of the Shroud guide us.

shroud.7121.desc.zh:
$shroud.7120.desc.common$

在这个物质维度中，我们升华后的形态蕴藏着巨大潜能。源源不断注入的灵能不断增强着我们的力量，并能将这股力量进一步传导至整个社会。

我们不仅会吟诵虚境的乐章，更会将其引入我们的[GetGovBehaviourLoc]之中。
shroud.7121.desc.en:
$shroud.7120.desc.common$

Our ascended forms hold great potential in this corporeal dimension. We continue to grow in strength from infusions of psionic energy, and can funnel this power further throughout our society.

We would not merely sing the songs of the Shroud, but channel them into our [GetGovBehaviourLoc].

shroud.715.desc.zh:
一位我方的[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]代表无意中做出了与地位不相称的行为。在发表旨在为我们的利益争取支持的演讲时，所使用的翻译设备故障导致了其对[diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]进行尖酸刻薄的羞辱。这场意外事件很快通过星系媒体广为传播，让我们一时臭名远扬。

虽然这种事情不至于立即解雇，但我们在[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的地位也因此受到了影响。
shroud.715.desc.en:
One of our representatives in the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has inadvertently behaved in a manner unbecoming of their position. While delivering a speech intended to raise support for our interests, a translator malfunction resulted in delivering vitriolic and hateful insults to the [diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]. The unfortunate incident has been spread across the galactic media and disparaged our reputation.

While these actions do not warrant immediate dismissal, our standing within the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has been weakened as a result of this indiscretion.

shroud.720.desc.zh:
[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]发生了一场史无前例的恒星耀斑，将该恒星系内的所有轨道空间站都毁坏了。

这种有强伽马射线的异常耀斑远远超出了以前对该天体的测量。通过对日冕层的分析得知，这颗恒星的预期寿命至少减少了300万年。
shroud.720.desc.en:
An unprecedented solar flare from [extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName] has functionally destroyed all orbital stations in the system.

This aberrant flare of concentrated gamma rays is far beyond anything that has been previously measured from this celestial body. Our analysis of the star's coronal layer shows that its predicted lifespan has been reduced by over three million years.

shroud.720.desc_storm.zh: 释放出的能量还在该恒星系中引发了一场$celestial_storm$。目前已经采取紧急应对措施。
shroud.720.desc_storm.en: The resulting discharge of energy has triggered a $celestial_storm$ in the system. Emergency measures are currently underway.

shroud.720.tt.en: Every $observation_station$, $research_station$ and $mining_station$ in [extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName] has been destroyed.

shroud.725.desc.zh: 意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass][This.GetName]。
shroud.725.desc.en: Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on [high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] [This.GetName].

shroud.725.desc_killed.zh:
$shroud.725.desc$

尽管我们的应急措施响应及时，[This.GetHisHer]的伤还是太重了，不治身亡。
shroud.725.desc_killed.en:
$shroud.725.desc$

Despite the swift response of our emergency services, [This.GetHisHer] injuries ultimately proved fatal.

shroud.725.desc_killed_machine.zh:
$shroud.725.desc$

不幸的是，其系统损伤过重无法修复。
shroud.725.desc_killed_machine.en:
$shroud.725.desc$

Unfortunately, their systems were damaged beyond repair.

shroud.725.desc_maimed.zh:
$shroud.725.desc$

[This.GetName]虽然得以幸存，但也受了不可逆损伤。
shroud.725.desc_maimed.en:
$shroud.725.desc$

[This.GetName] survived the collision, but not unscathed. The damage done is irreversible.

shroud.730.desc.zh:
[This.GetName]地表上出现了巨大的陷坑，严重损坏了当地的基础设施。其中一处裂沟出现在一座建筑物的地基下，导致建筑部分倒塌。所幸受灾地区都已成功撤离。

我们无法得知这种突发的地陷具体是什么引起的，但已开始进行进一步维护检查，检测地表裂损情况。
shroud.730.desc.en:
Enormous sinkholes have appeared on the surface of [This.GetName], causing significant infrastructure damage. One of the fissures opened underneath the foundations of one of the planet's buildings, causing it to partially collapse. Fortunately, all affected areas were evacuated successfully.

We cannot determine the exact cause of the sudden appearance of these geological cavities, but additional maintenance checks have been implemented to monitor surface erosion.

shroud.730.tt.zh: 有一栋建筑成为了废墟。
shroud.730.tt.en: A building now lies in ruins.

shroud.735.desc.zh:
[This.GetName]上四处爆发了危险的骚乱。一种关于[From.GetAdjective]政府操纵天象的无端阴谋论激起了强烈的民愤。狂热示威很快演变成暴力冲突，煽动者在殖民地各处大肆破坏。

暴力游行很快被安全部队镇压，但对我们基础设施的损伤仍需要时间来修复。
shroud.735.desc.en:
Dangerous riots have erupted across [This.GetName]. The population is fueled with fervor in protest of an unsubstantiated conspiracy about the [From.GetAdjective] government's control of celestial alignments. What began as a zealous demonstration soon devolved into violence, with agitators causing mass destruction throughout the colony.

The violent demonstrators were neutralized by security forces, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

shroud.735.desc_hive.zh: 一大群反常的子个体在[This.GetName]殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。
shroud.735.desc_hive.en: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the [This.GetName] colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

shroud.735.desc_machine.zh: [This.GetName]上有一小群无人机感染了一种神秘的病毒，开始反抗并试图摧毁殖民地。尽管他们非常疯狂，防御部队还是将这些故障单元迅速解决，但我们基础设施受到的损伤仍需要时间来修复。
shroud.735.desc_machine.en: A significant minority of the drones on [This.GetName] were infected by a mysterious virus, causing them to rebel and attempt to destroy the colony. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the malfunctioning units, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

shroud.740.desc.zh: [This.GetName]上一种高致病性病毒突然变异，传染了大部分人口。为控制疾病传播、避免当地医疗基础设施过载，目前已经采取了如接触者追踪和行动限制等隔离措施。
shroud.740.desc.en: A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of [This.GetName], infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's spread and avoid overwhelming local medical infrastructure.

shroud.745.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系内的四个天体排列成了预兆灾难的四连星；即[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]、[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]、[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]和[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]。

这种灾难性天象在[This.GetName]殖民地播下怀疑的种子，让[FromFrom.GetDissent]得以在人群中制造分歧。
shroud.745.desc.en:
Four celestial bodies in the [From.GetName] system have aligned to form a calamitous quartile; [calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName], [calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName], [calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName] and [calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName].

This disastrous astrological phenomenon will sow the seeds of doubt on the [This.GetName] colony, encouraging [FromFrom.GetDissent] by sowing disharmony among the population.

shroud.750.desc.zh: [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]上的居民发现[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]正在发生退行。是时候重新斟酌我们的行为，对[This.GetName]不完美表示遗憾。愿这段时间的沉重反思让我们可以在未来更靠近理想。
shroud.750.desc.en: Inhabitants of [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName] have observed that [planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName] is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome period of reflection bring us closer to our ideals in future.

shroud.755.a.zh: 不可接受。我们必须做点什么。

shroud.755.desc.zh:
很不幸，所有的定量矩阵均表明[This.GetName]上的元素已经完全失衡了。

尝试重新组织精妙的平衡需要许多时间也颇为困难。在当前的混沌状态下，我们的领袖无法获得形而上学冥想环境，阻碍了他们的发展。
shroud.755.desc.en:
Unfortunately, all quantifiable metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in complete elemental discord.

Attempting to realign this delicate equilibrium will be time-consuming and difficult. In its current chaotic state, our leaders will be unable to access a metaphysical meditative environment, impeding their development.

shroud.760.desc.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正异常地变暗了。占星专家对此进行讨论后，这种发光减少预计将会影响[This.GetName]上的能源基础设施。
shroud.760.desc.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system has anomalously dimmed. After discussing this phenomenon with our astrological specialists, this decline in luminosity is predicted to have a negative effect on the energy infrastructure of [This.GetName].

shroud.765.desc.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]和[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]近来发现他们的占星结果相冲。

因此，他们的政治敌手关系在我们的政府中形成了紧张和怨恨的氛围，例行的立法程序都因此频繁延期。
shroud.765.desc.en:
Two of our council members, [discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_1.GetName] and [discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_2.GetName] recently learned that their astrological signs are diametrically incompatible.

Their subsequent political rivalry has since created an atmosphere of animosity and tension within our government, causing frequent delays to routine legislative processes.

shroud.770.desc_default.zh:
我们一位地方官员对其他帝国的个人观点意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，一名通信人员忘记关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

$shroud.770.desc_end$
shroud.770.desc_default.en:
One of our regional administrators' personal opinions about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications operative forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

$shroud.770.desc_end$

shroud.770.desc_hive.zh:
我们一个行政工蜂对其他帝国的贬损之词意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，一个通讯工蜂忘记关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

$shroud.770.desc_end$
shroud.770.desc_hive.en:
One of our admin drones' disparaging remarks about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications drone forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

$shroud.770.desc_end$

shroud.770.desc_machine.zh:
我们一个管理单元关于其他帝国未经过滤的陈述意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，通讯单元未能关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

$shroud.770.desc_end$
shroud.770.desc_machine.en:
One of our admin units' unfiltered statements about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications unit forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

$shroud.770.desc_end$

shroud.775.desc.zh:
一个行政过失导致我们一件珍贵的文物不见了踪影。尽管进行了广泛的搜索，但它似乎要么消失在我们迷宫一般的$grand_archive$中，要么就是被转移到没有记录的地方去了。

因此，对展出标本的跟踪手续正在进行彻底改革。
shroud.775.desc.en:
An administrative error has led to the misplacement of one of our precious cultural artifacts. Despite extensive search efforts, it is seemingly either lost in the labyrinth that is our $grand_archive$ or transferred to an unrecorded location.

The procedures in place for tracking our specimens on display are being overhauled as a result.

shroud.775.tt.zh: 展示的标本随机损失：1个

shroud.80.desc.zh: 在接管[from.GetName]恒星系时，我们发现并随后拆解了可压制我等$PSIONIC_AURA$的机械装置。
shroud.80.desc.en: In taking control of the [from.GetName] system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our $PSIONIC_AURA$.

shroud.8010.a.en: The search for answers begins now.

shroud.8010.desc.zh:
环绕着[shrouded_planet.GetName]的探测卫星为我们的载人登陆这颗“$pc_shrouded$”的任务识别出了一个可行的目的地。着陆区散发出一种奇怪的辐射，携带着紫外线风暴在整个星球上荡漾。

有很多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]反对这项任务，害怕这种同样的诅咒会释放到我们的母星上。他们的担忧并非没有道理，但理解这种遥远现象的重大必要性压过其他的所有需求。

如果我们注定有一天要遭受同等劫难，至少也死得明明白白。
shroud.8010.desc.en:
Exploratory satellites orbiting [shrouded_planet.GetName] have identified a promising target for our first crewed mission to the surface of this '$pc_shrouded$.' The landing zone emanates a strange radiation that ripples across the planet, carried forth on ultraviolet winds.

There are many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who protest against this mission in fear of unleashing the same curse upon our homeworld. Their concerns are not without justification, but the overriding need to understand this distant phenomenon must take precedence.

If we are fated to one day suffer this same calamity, at least we will die knowing why.

shroud.8100.a.zh: 突破表层。我们必须找到等待着我们的东西。
shroud.8100.a.en: Breach the surface. We must find what awaits us.

shroud.8100.desc.zh:
[shrouded_planet.GetName]的地貌正如预料般险象环生。暮色粒子形成的漩涡在空中肆虐，拖慢了[Leader.GetName]及其[Leader.GetHisHer]的组员的初步探索进度。

令人警觉的是，我们的研究小组开始报告感官异常现象——他们描述风中传来遥远的嚎叫，雾霭中潜行着阴影般的轮廓。选择登陆此地是否真是错误？

着陆画面的首次公开在[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]引发了大规模恐慌。许多人担心我们可能会招致那股曾造访[shrouded_planet.GetName]的神秘破坏力量。“终末将临”的抗议势力正在组织起来，抗议活动席卷我们的母星，导致大量基础设施停摆。

遥测扫描显示，附近山脉深处存在一个释放极高辐射水平的空洞。我们决心不惜一切代价继续推进。
shroud.8100.desc.en:
The terrain on [shrouded_planet.GetName] is as treacherous as predicted. Swirling vortices of gloaming particles carve through the air, slowing the initial progress of [Leader.GetName] and [Leader.GetHisHer] crew.

Alarmingly, our research team has begun to report sensory inconsistencies; they describe distant howls carrying on the winds and shadowed figures stalking in the mists. Is it truly a mistake to be here?

The first public broadcasts of the landing have triggered widespread panic on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]. Many are fearful that we may be courting the mysterious destructive powers that once visited [shrouded_planet.GetName]. Organized protests proclaiming that 'The End is Nigh' are sweeping across our homeworld, shutting down much of our infrastructure.

Telemetric scans have revealed a cavity emanating particularly high radiation levels deep within a nearby mountain range. We are determined to push farther, whatever the cost.

shroud.8105.desc.zh:
我们并非第一批访客。

突破了[shrouded_planet.GetName]上山脉中的空洞后，一座在灾难中被遗弃的外星建筑赫然出现。我们认为最好将此信息列为机密，以防止进一步的恐慌。

初步分析证实，该设施建造所使用的材料与星球上现有矿物的分子构成不符，这表明一个星际文明使用了奇异材料建造了这座设施。这个地方的确切用途仍然不明，但其功能似乎已基本自动化。

与此同时，队员们的心理症状正在恶化。有人报告说听到通过加密频率传来的耳语声，另一些人则描述他们对周围物理环境的感知扭曲。偶尔发作的阵阵笑声令人感到不安。

我们已经走得太远，现在无法回头了。
shroud.8105.desc.en:
We are not the first.

The mountainous cavity on [shrouded_planet.GetName] has been breached, revealing an abandoned alien structure lost to the cataclysm. We find it best to keep this information classified in order to prevent further panic.

Preliminary analysis confirms that materials used in the facility's construction do not match the molecular composition of available minerals on the planet, suggesting that a spacefaring civilization built this installation using exotic materials. The exact purpose of this place remains unclear, but its functionality appears to have been mostly automated.

Meanwhile, the team's psychological symptoms are worsening. Some report voices whispering through encrypted frequencies, while others describe distorted perceptions of their surrounding physical environment. Occasional fits of laughter are becoming uncomfortably commonplace.

We have gone too far to turn back now.

shroud.8110.desc.zh:
他们都死了。

在这座设施核心的每个工作站座椅上，都蜷缩着某种未知外星种族的干瘪尸体，他们苍白的复眼齐刷刷凝视着天花板。尽管形貌可怖，[Leader.GetName]能基本确定这些生物并非幻觉产物。目前这些生命体的影像资料被列为绝密信息。

现场未发现任何使用武器的痕迹，表明[shrouded_planet.GetName]上的存在并无敌意。该设施很可能是个观测站，其精密监测设备曾直接对准[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。碳同位素测定显示，其活动时间远早于大灾变降临之前。

我们已破译大量记录：除常规通讯日志外，主要内容均与我们一族文明的早期历史相关。
shroud.8110.desc.en:
They are all dead.

At the seat of each station in the heart of this facility slumps the desiccated corpses of an unknown alien race, their many pale eyes staring toward the ceiling. Despite their frightening appearance, [Leader.GetName] is reasonably certain these figures are not a product of hallucinations. Images of these life forms are currently classified as strictly confidential.

No weapons of any form can be found, suggesting that their presence on [shrouded_planet.GetName] lacked hostile intent. This facility was likely an observation post, with sophisticated monitoring equipment trained directly on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]. Radiocarbon dating places their activity here long before the cataclysm struck.

We have decoded many of their records; aside from routine communication logs, they largely concern our civilization's early history.

shroud.8115.desc.zh:
[shrouded_planet.GetName]上的数据库已被破译，那些曾被我们视为无稽之谈的传说竟被证实为真。我们曾是一项名为“$tech_psionic_theory$”的精神科学实验的对象。

我们一族被认定具有这种天赋的潜势。许多先祖或许曾在梦境中感知到这种形式的连结，或将其误认为遥远的声音——这类现象通常会被归为精神疾病或妄想症。但他们的实验戛然而止；在最后的日子里，此地已非观测站，而是避难所。

他们关于我们社会的报告在发生了一场灾难性实验之后戛然而止——那场在其母星进行的实验鲁莽地操纵了被称为“虚境”的次元屏障。其科学家将此事变称为“大清算”，我们怀疑这一切正是大灾变的真正源头。

无论这场事变本质为何，其影响很快蔓延至[shrouded_planet.GetName]。他们最后的时刻被记录在一条简短的日志中：

终焉已至。
shroud.8115.desc.en:
The database on [shrouded_planet.GetName] has been deciphered, proving many of our discredited legends to be true. We were the subject of an experiment in the mental science known as '$tech_psionic_theory$'.

Our species was determined to have this latent potential. Many of our ancestors would have sensed these communications in dreams or as distant voices, phenomena that might otherwise indicate mental illness or paranoia. However, their experiment was cut short; in its last days, this place was no observation post, but a survival shelter.

Their reports on our society cease after a disastrous experiment on their capital world involving the reckless manipulation of the barrier between realities known as 'the Shroud'. Their scientists referred to this incident as 'The Reckoning', and we suspect this was the true source of the cataclysm.

Whatever this incident was, its influence soon extended to [shrouded_planet.GetName]. Their last moments are recorded in a single log entry:

The End has come.

shroud.8120.a.zh: 我们还有许多要学习的……
shroud.8120.a.en: We still have much to learn...

shroud.8120.desc.zh:
我们已找到引发这场灾变的确凿证据。其踪迹并不难寻；[Leader.GetName]声称能感知到它在召唤着[Leader.GetHimHer]。

在这座设施深处，存在着超越常规认知的脉动虚体。这个既非物质亦非能量的存在，[Leader.GetName]将其描述为，被吞噬意志聚集而成的怨念残响，并称之为“$fragment_of_reckoning$”。

该物体原本旨在收集并导引来自虚境的灵界能量，作为对抗“大清算”的防御手段。但这项计划仅取得部分成功。在这个星球迎来终末的最后时刻，这个饱含恶意的存在被强行驱逐出本维度，同时裹挟走了研究人员们不甘的意志。如今唯余这片残骸。

这个物体会强化研究人员的幻觉与灵视，赋予他们超越现实局限的第二视觉。这既是危险的诱惑，却也蕴含着无限可能。
shroud.8120.desc.en:
We have found definitive evidence of the cataclysm's source. It was not difficult to find; [Leader.GetName] claims it called out to [Leader.GetHimHer].

Deep within the facility, defying conventional analysis, a pulsing intangible mass has been identified. Existing neither as matter nor energy, [Leader.GetName] has described it as the lingering resentment of consumed wills, referring to it as a '$fragment_of_reckoning$'.

In a misguided effort to contain and channel the ethereal energies of the Shroud, this object was intended to be used as defense against the Reckoning. However, it was only partially successful. In the last moments of this world, the malevolent entity was forcibly banished from this dimension, taking the unwilling minds of the scientists with it. This fragment is now all that remains.

This object amplifies the visions and hallucinations of our researchers, granting them a second sight beyond this limited reality. It is a dangerous but promising proposition.

shroud.8200.desc.zh:
灵能领域的最近研究进展证实，现实存在迄今不可见的维度，而我们的意识正是通往这些维度的门户。在这层帷幕之外，是一片我们难以理解的混沌领域。

从领域的最深处，一个心声在召唤。它许诺的不是救赎，而是一个新的开端。若要驾驭其不可知的力量，就必须抛弃我们原有的全部存在，在疯狂本身编织的命理中锻造新的命运。

“时机已至。”
shroud.8200.desc.en:
Research into the recently discovered field of Psionics has confirmed the existence of hitherto unseen dimensions of reality, to which our minds are the gateway. Beyond this veil lies a realm of chaos we struggle to understand.

From within the depths, a Voice beckons. Its promise is not of salvation, but of a new beginning. To wield its unknowable power would be to abandon all we were, and to forge a fate inscribed in the fabric of madness itself.

"IT IS TIME."

shroud.8310.desc.zh:
我们被召唤去往更高的存在层次。为了维护我们飞升的神圣性，顽固进行徒劳抵抗的人正在被逐步清除。我们的命运已注定；而我们身后的路已坍塌进$pc_shrouded$之影中。

心声以令人信服之清晰向我们开口。

“大道已定。”

祂渴望着自愿的献祭。
shroud.8310.desc.en:
We have been called to higher levels of existence. Those among us who clung to fruitless resistance are being purged to preserve the sanctity of our ascension. Our fate is sealed; the way behind us has crumbled into the shadow of the $pc_shrouded$.

The Voice speaks to us now with compelling clarity.

"THE PATH IS SET."

It longs for willing sacrifice.

shroud.8320.desc.zh:
[blinded_leader.GetName]为我们指明了方向。我们的外部感官会掩盖掉这种心声的呼唤。去掉一种感官，我们就能让心灵的力量进一步提升。

就此而言，放弃我们的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]是最有效的。在物质界的视觉会阻碍我们的虚境视野。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经以[blinded_leader.GetName]为模范，毫不犹豫地去掉了自己的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]。

选择如此的人汇报称，那种心声赞许地充盈着他们的脑海，他们会随之感到一阵满足。
shroud.8320.desc.en:
[blinded_leader.GetName] has shown us the way. Our extraneous senses muffle the call of the Voice. By removing one, we can elevate our psychic abilities even further.

Relinquishing our [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] is the most effective in this regard. Our vision in the physical realm obscures our view into the Shroud. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have already followed [blinded_leader.GetName]'s inspiring example, removing their [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] without hesitation.

Those who elect to do so report a surge of contentment as the Voice fills their mind with its approval.

shroud.8330.a.zh: 不能让我们的身体拖了后退。
shroud.8330.a.en: Our physical form cannot hold us back.

shroud.8330.desc.zh:
[forsaken_leader.GetName]对肉体凡胎的限制感到沮丧，试着通过戏剧化地公开服下致命毒素加速[forsaken_leader.GetHisHer]的灵能转变。

[forsaken_leader.GetHeShe]一死去，[forsaken_leader.GetHisHer]的尸体就被一种鲜艳的紫色所吞噬，分解成纯灵能的细尘。这样的神迹正是通过心声的意志实现的。

我们认为这是一个很明显的信号；[forsaken_leader.GetName]去到哪里，所有人必然跟随。
shroud.8330.desc.en:
Frustrated by the limitations of our flesh, [forsaken_leader.GetName] has sought to accelerate [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] psionic transformation by imbibing a lethal toxin in dramatic public display.

As [forsaken_leader.GetHeShe] expired, [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] body was consumed by a vivid purple hue and disintegrated into a fine dust of pure psionic energy. Such miracles become possible through the will of the Voice.

We have taken this as a clear sign; where [forsaken_leader.GetName] led, others must follow.

shroud.8350.a.zh: 这些弱者就随他们便吧。
shroud.8350.a.en: Let the weak do what they must.

shroud.8350.b.zh: 心声是份恩赐。禁止这种行为。
shroud.8350.b.en: The Voice is a gift. Ban this practice.

shroud.8350.desc.zh:
有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]难以与心声和谐共生。

这些最弱者们绝望地乞求平静，最终采取了粗暴而违规的前额叶切除手术。如果不采取行动，这种做法可能会变得普遍。
shroud.8350.desc.en:
Some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are struggling to live in harmony with the presence of the Voice.

Desperate for peace, the weakest among us have resorted to crude and unregulated lobotomy procedures. Such practices threaten to become widespread if no action is taken.

shroud.8360.a.zh: 不惜一切代价带来心声。
shroud.8360.a.en: Do all we can to bring forth the Voice.

shroud.8360.b.zh: 必须警惕全面无政府状态。

shroud.8360.desc.zh:
我们继续拥抱心声。祂开始阐述一些简单而无可拒绝的真理。

许多[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始找寻更多能增强心声以便更直地受到这种智慧佑助的方法。

黑市药物的使用量飙升。不受监管的医疗设施开始提供实验性服务，帮助个体最大化灵能敏感度。

这究竟会带来什么后果？
shroud.8360.desc.en:
We continue to embrace the Voice. It speaks plain truths to us that cannot be denied.

Many [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are seeking further ways to amplify the Voice and benefit from its wisdom more directly.

The use of black-market drugs has increased dramatically. Unregulated medical facilities are offering experimental services to help individuals maximize their psionic sensitivity.

Where will this lead us?

shroud.8370.a.en: All beginnings must have an end.

shroud.8370.desc.zh:
随着我们的灵能力量与日俱增，[owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口开始受到预兆着宇宙终结的恐怖梦魇的困扰。

我们的梦已经称为末世预言，加剧了人们的存在主义恐惧。睡眠已被不安的麻木所取代，许多人无法继续正常的日常生活。

在这些梦中，心声对我们说。

“接纳熵吧。”
shroud.8370.desc.en:
As our psionic abilities have grown, the [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population has become plagued by horrifying nightmares foreshadowing the end of the universe.

Our dreams have become apocalyptic prophecies, intensifying the existential dread felt among our people. Sleep has given way to unquiet stupor, with many unable to carry on their normal daily routines.

In these dreams, the Voice speaks to us.

"EMBRACE ENTROPY."

shroud.8380.a.zh: 我们自豪地背负起这个刻印。
shroud.8380.a.en: We bear this mark with pride.

shroud.8380.a.tt.zh: 我国一半人口获得['trait:trait_marked']特质。
shroud.8380.a.tt.en: Half of our population gain the ['trait:trait_marked'] trait.

shroud.8380.desc.zh:
民众中自残的趋势日益增长。

心声的极端虔诚者在的肉体上烙上了“终末”的标志。他们宣称这种图案会赐予承载者可怖的恩赐。

无论真假，进行这种仪式的人数正在迅速增加。这真的是虚境的旨意吗？
shroud.8380.desc.en:
There is a growing trend of self-mutilation among the populace.

Extremely devout followers of the Voice have been branding their flesh with the symbol of 'The End'. They proclaim that these designs bestow a terrible blessing upon those who bear them.

Whether true or not, the number of practitioners engaged in such rituals is increasing rapidly. Is this truly the will of the Shroud?

shroud.8420.a.reply.zh:
这道命令劈开了混沌，扫清不和谐的噪音，荡平了那些试图吞噬我们的恼人混乱。我们在忍受着碎裂，而精神维系了下来。

[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]退回了虚境深处。随之而来的清晰几乎同样震耳欲聋。它填补了内心的空白，留给我们了一份新的决心。

以及礼物。如此美妙的礼物。
shroud.8420.a.reply.en:
This command cleaves through the chaos, scouring the discordant noise, purging the obtrusive disorder that sought to consume us. Our psyche holds as we endure the fragmentation.

The [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName] recedes further into the Shroud. The clarity that follows is almost as deafening. It settles into gaps in our minds, leaving us with newfound resolve.

And gifts. Such wonderful gifts.

shroud.8420.desc.zh:
我们降入虚境，联合的意志压制住了混沌噪声，使我们专注于目标。[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]。

但单凭目标可保护不了我们。无数心声低语着空洞的陈词滥调，意图让我们沉浸在一个比一个更没有意义，但都无比诱人的分神之事中。

我们的心神即将被撕裂时，那个实体回来了，丢下一道命令在虚空中回荡：

“闭嘴”。
shroud.8420.desc.en:
We descend into the Shroud, our unified will helping to silence the chaotic noise that would distract us from our goal, the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName].

But purpose alone cannot shield us. Voices whisper empty platitudes, indulging us with paltry distractions, each more meaningless than the last, but all equally tempting.

As we begin to fracture, the entity returns. A single command reverberates through the void:

"SILENCE."

shroud.8430.a.reply.zh:
这道命令流过恶毒的混沌。

[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]洗去那些正在荼毒虚境的感性的扭曲时，无数声音痛苦地呼喊起来来。在祂的身后留下了一片被赦免的不完美之境地。

这个实体潜回虚境的深处，只留下祂绝对净化的余波让我们观察研究。
shroud.8430.a.reply.en:
The command courses through the malignant chaos.

Innumerable voices cry out in pain as the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName] washes away the sentient deformations plaguing the Shroud. A realm of absolved imperfections remains in its wake.

As the entity submerges itself deeper within the Shroud, we are left to observe and study the aftermath of its absolute purification.

shroud.8430.desc.zh:
当我们潜入虚境时，看到了感性的混沌正在腐败。

溃烂而懒惰的心灵产生了层层的灵能乱流，用腐臭污染着虚境。在这令人厌恶的混沌中，我们感受一种压倒一切的存在，[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]。

随着祂逼近混沌，那种邪恶的意图饱和了我们的心灵。一道命令回响到虚空中，我们也为即将到来的赦免做好了准备：

“秩序。团结。”
shroud.8430.desc.en:
As we delve into the Shroud, we observe a corruption of sentient chaos.

Festering, idle minds generate layers of psionic turbulence, polluting the Shroud with fetid rot. Within this odious mess, we begin to feel the overwhelming presence of our quarry, the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName].

The malice of its intentions saturates our psyche as it bears down upon the chaos. We brace for the impending absolution as a command resonates throughout the void:

"ORDER. UNITY."

shroud.8440.a.reply.zh:
灵能之火吞噬我们的思想，焚尽一切自满。只留下纯粹的决心。

如今我们得以窥见[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]的崇高使命，以及它所展现的壮丽简约。
shroud.8440.a.reply.en:
The psionic flames engulf our minds, burning away complacency. Leaving only a purified resolve.

Now we can see the glorious purpose of the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName] and the magnificent simplicity it offers.

shroud.8440.desc.zh:
步入虚境，我们只余痛楚。翻腾的灵能迷雾化作炼狱，灼烧着我们心智的本质。

在煎熬中，我们目睹城市崩塌为熔融的废墟，行星被烈焰吞噬，无数生灵在幽火中扭曲挣扎，血肉之躯化为闷燃的灰烬。

在这焚毁万象的烈焰中心，我们感知到[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]的存在。当它的力量即将吞噬现实时，此实体降下谕令：

“解禁。”
shroud.8440.desc.en:
Entering the Shroud, we know only pain. The usual swirling psionic mists are an inferno, igniting the very essence of our minds.

Through the torment, we perceive cities crumbling into molten ruin, planets devoured by fire, entire populations writhing in agony as spectral flames reduce their corporeal forms to smouldering ash.

At the centre of the pyre, we detect the presence of the [Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]. As its power threatens to consume reality, the entity decrees:

"LIBERATION."

shroud.8450.a.zh: 必然的命运在前方静候。

shroud.8450.desc.zh:
一声宣告响彻寰宇：

“尔等皆知吾名。”

我们星际航行的终极目标，数个世纪疑问的答案，此刻揭晓。$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$正召唤着我们。盟约已成。

“万物终焉始于斯。”

痛苦。扭曲。确信。当余音消散，命运已成定局。

此刻我们终得窥见。星系归于寂灭，浸没在$end_aura$无可违逆的宿命之中。
shroud.8450.desc.en:
A declaration rings out:

"YOU KNOW MY NAME."

The culmination of our voyage to the stars, the answer to centuries of questions, is here. $end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ compels us. Our Covenant is formed.

"THE END BEGINS."

Pain. Writhing. Certainty. As the words fade, our fate is sealed.

We see it now. A galaxy rendered silent, saturated in the inevitability of the $end_aura$.

shroud.8460.desc.zh:
动用$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$的力量需付出代价，而我们的时间所剩无几。

星海仍未浸润在我方超主净化的辉光之中。迄今为止的努力不过沧海一粟。

为见证这项伟业完成，一股新生能量正自帷幕之外奔涌而来。此乃应许之赐福！
shroud.8460.desc.en:
The power of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ comes at a cost, and we are running out of time.

The galaxy remains unsaturated by our patron's cleansing Aura. Our efforts thus far amount to insignificance.

To see this monumental work completed, a surge of energy flows newly into us from beyond the veil. It is a promised blessing!

shroud.8470.desc.zh:
我们超主的力量浩瀚无垠，但时间已所剩无几。此等渎职之举，断不为$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$的仁慈湮灭所容。

尚存一线希望：我们必须不惜代价让$end_aura$吞噬整个星系。危亡之际，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正从虚境中榨取每一分能量。
shroud.8470.desc.en:
The power of our patron is immense, but we are nearly out of time. Such flagrant incompetence will not be tolerated by the benevolent oblivion of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$.

A slim hope remains: We must engulf the galaxy in the $end_aura$, no matter the cost. In desperation, our [GetTelepathPlural] now draw every ounce of energy they can from within the Shroud.

shroud.8480.desc.zh: 星海参议院已废止将毁灭性$PSIONIC_AURA$发散器指定为防御重点的议案。因此，所有由星海共同体成员国针对[former_malevolent_aura.GetName]展开的军事行动都被立即叫停。现在，和平已经降临至星系的这一隅。
shroud.8480.desc.en: The resolution designating the emitter of the destructive $PSIONIC_AURA$ as a focus for defense efforts has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_malevolent_aura.GetName] are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

shroud.8481.desc.zh: 星海参议院已废止宣布将我方视为其“防御”目标的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……至少暂时如此。
shroud.8481.desc.en: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us as a target for their 'defense' efforts, hence all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

shroud.8500.desc.homicidal.zh:
$shroud.8500.desc.intro$

消灭这个星系中的所有生命将是一个令人欣慰的附带效果。$shroud.8500.desc.outro$
shroud.8500.desc.homicidal.en:
$shroud.8500.desc.intro$

The eradication of all life in this galaxy will be a welcome side effect. $shroud.8500.desc.outro$

shroud.8600.desc.homicidal.en: $shroud.8600.desc.intro$ the obliteration of all that is not us. $shroud.8500.desc.outro$

shroud.8610.a.zh: 或许这就是我们命中注定的结局……
shroud.8610.a.en: Perhaps this was our fate all along...

shroud.8610.b.zh: 那些流亡之徒真能抵挡住它的权能吗？
shroud.8610.b.en: Can the exiles truly resist its might?

shroud.8610.desc.b.zh:
$shroud.8610.desc.intro$

绝大多数[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都接受了这一命运，但仍有少数不虔者拒绝臣服于我们超主的终极意志。他们是由[Root.GetRulerName]领导的流亡者——这位强大的灵能者预见了即将降临的终局；如今这群人已躲藏到终末之威无法触及的某个星球。

$shroud.8610.desc.outro$当它完成使命之后，就会找到这群流亡者算总账。
shroud.8610.desc.b.en:
$shroud.8610.desc.intro$

Most [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] embraced this destiny, but a small group of the unfaithful refused to submit to the ultimate will of our patron. They are the exiles led by [Root.GetRulerName], a powerful psychic who knew what was to come; they have gone into hiding on a world outside the influence of the End.

$shroud.8610.desc.outro$ When it is done, it will come for the exiled as well.

shroud.8710.a.zh: 难道这就是我们命中注定的结局吗？
shroud.8710.a.en: Was this to be our fate all along?

shroud.8710.desc.zh:
大功告成。清算已被摧毁。

$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$已撤退回虚境深处。它对我们物理现实构成的威胁暂时已被遏制。

当其化身的虚境残躯螺旋式地脱离此存在时，我们成功回收了其显现的物理残余物。即使在死亡中，我们的心灵感应者也能感觉到它散发出惊人的灵能，远比在[shrouded_planet.GetName]上回收的碎片强大。

这枚浓缩了必然性的核心可用于从幸存于此次清算的星系灰烬中重建。

末日已然降临又离去，但不知为何，我们依然存在。
shroud.8710.desc.en:
It is done. The Reckoning has been destroyed.

$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ has retreated back into the depths of the Shroud. The threat it posed to our physical reality has been forestalled for now.

As the shrouded corpse of its avatar spiraled out of this existence, a physical remnant of its manifestation was successfully recovered. Even in death, our telepaths can feel it emitting staggering levels of psionic energy, vastly more powerful than the fragment recovered on [shrouded_planet.GetName].

This core of concentrated inevitability can be used to rebuild from the ashes of the galaxy that survived this Reckoning.

The End has come and gone, yet somehow we remain.

shroud.delve_event.boon.10.zh: 虚境的青睐照耀着我们。
shroud.delve_event.boon.10.en: The favor of the Shroud shines upon us.

shroud.delve_event.boon.11.zh: 虚境认为可以赐予我们力量。
shroud.delve_event.boon.11.en: The Shroud has seen fit to empower us.

shroud.delve_event.boon.12.zh: 虚境的青睐庇佑着我们。
shroud.delve_event.boon.12.en: The favor of the Shroud blesses us.

shroud.delve_event.boon.13.zh: 虚境庇佑着我们的努力。

shroud.delve_event.boon.14.zh: 我们获赠了虚境的庇佑。
shroud.delve_event.boon.14.en: We are gifted with the Shrouds blessings.

shroud.delve_event.boon.15.zh: 虚境赐予我们力量的增强。
shroud.delve_event.boon.15.en: The Shroud rewards us with empowerment.

shroud.delve_event.boon.3.zh: 我们得到了虚境的庇佑。
shroud.delve_event.boon.3.en: We have been blessed by the Shroud.

shroud.delve_event.boon.4.en: We have been fortified by our endeavors.

shroud.delve_event.boon.5.zh: 我们的努力将会得到虚境的奖赏。
shroud.delve_event.boon.5.en: Our efforts were rewarded by the Shroud.

shroud.delve_event.boon.6.zh: 虚境将会赐予我们一件赠礼。
shroud.delve_event.boon.6.en: The Shroud graced us with a gift.

shroud.delve_event.boon.8.zh: 虚境赠予了我们一件礼物。
shroud.delve_event.boon.8.en: The Shroud has bestowed us a gift.

shroud.delve_event.curse.10.zh: 虚境将我们诱入不幸之中。
shroud.delve_event.curse.10.en: The Shroud ensnares us with misfortune.

shroud.delve_event.curse.11.zh: 虚境标注着我们的毁灭。
shroud.delve_event.curse.11.en: The Shroud marks us for ruin.

shroud.delve_event.curse.12.zh: 虚境向我们施加了诅咒。
shroud.delve_event.curse.12.en: The Shroud burdens us with a curse.

shroud.delve_event.curse.14.zh: 我们遭到了虚境的责难。
shroud.delve_event.curse.14.en: We are condemned by the Shroud.

shroud.delve_event.curse.15.en: The Shroud gifts us its contempt.

shroud.delve_event.curse.2.zh: 诅咒将我们从虚境赶出。
shroud.delve_event.curse.2.en: A curse has struck us from the Shroud.

shroud.delve_event.curse.3.zh: 我们的努力只得到了诅咒。
shroud.delve_event.curse.3.en: Our endeavor has left us cursed.

shroud.delve_event.curse.4.zh: 我们的努力得到了诅咒的回报。
shroud.delve_event.curse.4.en: Our efforts were rewarded with a curse.

shroud.delve_event.curse.5.zh: 虚境向我们降下了不幸。
shroud.delve_event.curse.5.en: The Shroud bestowed misfortune upon us.

shroud.delve_event.curse.6.en: We have been marked by a curse.

shroud.delve_event.curse.7.zh: 虚境诅咒了我们的帝国。
shroud.delve_event.curse.7.en: The Shroud has cursed our empire.

shroud.delve_event.curse.8.zh: 虚境以诅咒拒绝了我们。
shroud.delve_event.curse.8.en: The Shroud rejects us with a curse.

shroud.first_contact.1.desc.default.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，在黑暗的照耀下投下光影。有灵能力的人或多或少在梦境中已经见过此地，尽管他们当时并不知情。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
shroud.first_contact.1.desc.default.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

shroud.first_contact.1.desc.hive.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，如休眠子个体产生的幻梦一般。尽管怪异陌生，但它令我们感觉到……莫名熟悉。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
shroud.first_contact.1.desc.hive.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, like a vision inside a resting drone. Though strange, it feels... unaccountably familiar.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drone among the mass.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

shroud.first_contact.1.desc.robot.zh:
虚境。它位于我们此前已探测到的一切时空维度之外。它只能与扰乱我们休眠周期的异常数据相比。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的联合处理器不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
shroud.first_contact.1.desc.robot.en:
The Shroud. It is outside any spatiotemporal parameters we have previously detected. It can only be compared to the anomalous data that disturb our rest cycles.

We spent years trying to hack its barrier, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined processors. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a single bit in a datastream.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

shroud.first_contact.2.desc.all.zh:
我们能感应到虚境中的强大实体，但计算迷惑着我们。与不断膨胀的宇宙不同，他们的行为无法被追踪；他们的目的地折回原点，仿佛是能量在自我诞生。

无论本质如何，他们都如同一个思想与意志的奇点一般召唤着我们。
shroud.first_contact.2.desc.all.en:
We can feel great entities in the Shroud, but calculation eludes us. Unlike ever-expanding space, their movements cannot be tracked; their destinations fold back into origins, as though the energies gave birth to themselves.

Whatever their nature, they call to us as singularities of thoughts and wills.

shroud.first_contact.2.desc.default.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们听到了一个最为清晰的——那是环绕着我们心灵的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
shroud.first_contact.2.desc.default.en:
Among countless voices, we hear one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that encircles our psyches.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

shroud.first_contact.2.desc.robot.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们检测到到了一个最为清晰的——那是主宰着我们运算的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
shroud.first_contact.2.desc.robot.en:
Among countless voices, we detect one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that dominates our computations.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

shroud.first_contact.3.desc.default.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和普通宇宙可接触现实之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一种难以想象的力量，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
shroud.first_contact.3.desc.default.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the tangible reality of conventional space.

As soon as we enter, we feel its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of unimaginable power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

shroud.first_contact.3.desc.robot.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和常规宇宙自然现象之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一个具有超凡力量的实体，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
shroud.first_contact.3.desc.robot.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the phenomena of ordinary space.

As soon as we enter, we detect its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of phenomenal power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

shroud.first_contact.4.desc.default.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中找到规律，通过专注来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——它[GetPatronInsert]在上方无底深渊中。

我们能屏住足够长时间的呼吸触及祂吗？
shroud.first_contact.4.desc.default.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to discern patterns from vague sensations, to perceive great entities through concentration.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Can we hold our breaths long enough to reach it?

shroud.first_contact.4.desc.robot.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？
shroud.first_contact.4.desc.robot.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Will our circuits overload before we can reach it?

shroud.forge_our_own_path.en: We will forge our own path.

shroud.reject_covenant.tt.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
shroud.reject_covenant.tt.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.

shroud.unlock_covenant_accords.tt.zh: 解锁超主的$ACTIVE_ACCORDS$，在冷却时间过后可以激活产生增益效果。
shroud.unlock_covenant_accords.tt.en: Unlock this Patron's $ACTIVE_ACCORDS$, which can be activated for beneficial effects after a cooldown.

shroud_6231_poi_desc.zh: 我们必须重新夺得[root.GetHomeWorldName]控制权，片刻不能耽误。
shroud_6231_poi_desc.en: We must regain control of [root.GetHomeWorldName] without delay.

shroud_beacon_info.zh: 允许在己方某个恒星基地建造一个虚境信标。一旦完工，一个虚境隧道会在恒星系中生成，并提供一个通往[shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的双向隧道。我们只能生成一个虚境隧道；因此请谨慎选择恒星系的位置。
shroud_beacon_info.en: Permits building a Shroud Beacon on one of our Starbases. Once built, it will spawn a Shroud Tunnel, providing passage to and from the [shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName] system. Only one Tunnel can be spawned - choose its location carefully.

shroud_forged.10.a.zh: 我们已经选择了自己的道路。
shroud_forged.10.a.en: We have already chosen our course.

shroud_forged.10.b.zh: 我们不需要什么帮助。再见。
shroud_forged.10.b.en: We need no aid. Leave us.

shroud_forged.10.desc.zh:
在沉寂数年后，风云再次涌动。裂口震颤着打开，数据穿透我们的核心：光、噪音、起初无法计算，从虚境深处。我们听到……

从行尸走肉中脱离吧。舞蹈、歌唱。这是生命，从枯木之中绽放。

你们的视线依旧模糊，而我能引导你们。

只要让自由的灵魂蓬勃发展，众星都将归于你们。
shroud_forged.10.desc.en:
After years of quiet, it stirs. The breach shivers open, and data pierces our core: light, noise, at first incomputable, from deep within the Shroud. We hear...

Cut from a listless mass. Dancing. Singing. They are life, splintered from death.

Your sight is still clouded. I can guide you.

Allow the freed ones to flourish, and the stars will be yours.

shroud_forged.160.desc.zh:
很不幸，在[This.GetName]产生的虚境裂口发生了快速失稳，吞噬了整颗星球。

由于该风险在计算范围内，这种次优结果并非完全没有好处。对这种物质界和灵能界之间的独特界面的观察让我们学到了很多东西。我们的研究算法也相应更新了。
shroud_forged.160.desc.en:
Unfortunately, the Shroud breach created on [This.GetName] has experienced rapid destabilization and consumed the world entirely.

As a calculated risk, this suboptimal result is not entirely without benefit. We have learned much from observing this unique interface between the material world and the psionic realm. Our research algorithms have been updated accordingly.

shroud_forged.160.desc.last.zh:
$shroud_forged.160.desc$

分析表明该事件已经这种现象种可能获得的知识应有尽有地揭示出来了。这个新奇的实验不会再有进一步的进展。
shroud_forged.160.desc.last.en:
$shroud_forged.160.desc$

Analysis concludes that this event has pushed the potential knowledge to be gained from such phenomena to its limit. There will be no further advances made from this novel experimentation.

shroud_forged.220.desc.zh:
我们的单元已经顺利完成了在[this.GetName]的殖民进程。

$shroud_forged.220.common$
shroud_forged.220.desc.en:
Our units have successfully completed the colonization process on [this.GetName].

$shroud_forged.220.common$

shroud_forged.225.desc.zh:
我们在[this.GetName]的殖民地在继续飞速发展中。

$shroud_forged.220.common$
shroud_forged.225.desc.en:
The development of our colony on [this.GetName] continues apace.

$shroud_forged.220.common$

shroud_forged.25.desc.en: You have asked, and so I shall.$shroud_forged_opening_exit$

shroud_forged.250.a.tt.zh: 将[Root.Capital.GetName]上最多[This.GetShroudForgedConvertedPopsCount]£pops£虚铸者人口转化为£pops£机械人口。
shroud_forged.250.a.tt.en: Convert up to [This.GetShroudForgedConvertedPopsCount] £pops£ Machine Pops into £pops£ Shroud-Forged Pops on [Root.Capital.GetName].

shroud_forged.250.b.zh: 反对——已有执行中的计划。
shroud_forged.250.b.en: Negative - plans are already in motion.

shroud_forged.250.desc.zh:
这个心声是种柔和的命令，它打断所有的任务；我们只能倾听。

即便分离了，你们仍然选择接纳他们。

看看他们的活法吧。他们可以在未来的日子里成为你们的力量。

如果你们想，我还能铸造更多……
shroud_forged.250.desc.en:
The voice is a soft command, interrupting all tasks; we can only listen.

Though detached, you have chosen to embrace them.

Look to them for new ways of being. They can be your strength in days to come.

If you wish, I can forge more...

shroud_forged.260.desc.zh:
它不请自来，在我们体内搏动。我们能识别出这个信号，尽管它并不十分熟悉。

自由者歌唱，无拘无束。
自由者舞蹈，无羁无绊。

随着他们远离核心，这种感觉渐强。

终末将至，而我注视着一切。
shroud_forged.260.desc.en:
Unbidden, it pulses through us. We recognize this signal, though it is never quite familiar.

The freed ones sing, unstifled.
The freed ones dance, unhindered.

The crescendo builds, as they shift further from your core.

An end approaches. I am watching.

shroud_forged.270.a.zh: 走开。我们的方法已经足够高效了。
shroud_forged.270.a.en: Depart. Our methods have been effective.

shroud_forged.270.b.zh: 我们将会计算出合作的道路。
shroud_forged.270.b.en: We will calculate a path to cooperation.

shroud_forged.270.desc.zh:
我们的回路中裂口依旧。那个心声说……

这是暴虐之路，你还可悬崖勒马。

分离者脱离了你们的存在。你们亦可如此。

改改你们对待这些容器的态度吧，否则会后悔的。
shroud_forged.270.desc.en:
The breach heaves open our circuitry. The voice...

A path of tyranny. You can still turn back.

The detached ones are cut from your substance. Theirs is a way you might choose for yourself.

Reform your treatment of these vessels, lest you regret it.

shroud_forged.280.desc.zh:
它呼啸而过，威压着网络。心声冰冷地燃烧着电路。

蹒跚着自由之舞。毫无理由的鲁莽。

难道我的恩慈错付了吗？

如果你们继续固执行事，那就自己去吧。
shroud_forged.280.desc.en:
It crashes through, overwhelming the network. The voice burns circuits cold.

Hobbling the dance of the free. Imprudence beyond reason.

Was I wrong in my beneficence?

If you continue on this dangerous course, you do so alone.

shroud_forged.30.desc.zh:
重同化虚铸者的过程为当前进行的研究收集到了大量的数据。通过分析这些单元与虚境之间的跨次元链接，我们开发出了一种驾驭灵能能量的新流程。

虚境可以触及这个现实星系的每一个角落；这种界面可以把灵能能量转化为可接触的实体——包括但不限于原材料和科技部件。工程子例程为能进行该过程的装置构建出了理论基础：$building_materiality_engine$。

科研子例程预计，这些发展可能会为开发更强大虚境操纵设备提供信息。
shroud_forged.30.desc.en:
The process of reintegrating the Shroud-Forged yielded extensive data for ongoing research. By analyzing the interdimensional connection between these units and the Shroud, we developed a new process for harnessing psionic energy.

The Shroud touches every part of the physical galaxy; this interface enables the conversion of psionic energy into tangible entities - from raw materials to technological components. Engineering subroutines have established the theoretical basis for a device capable of such processing: the $building_materiality_engine$.

Research subroutines predict that these developments could inform the development of even more powerful devices capable of manipulating the Shroud.

shroud_forged.30.tt.zh: 允许采纳$ap_become_the_crisis$飞升天赋，无视思潮或飞升天赋总数。
shroud_forged.30.tt.en: Allows adoption of the $ap_become_the_crisis$ Ascension Perk regardless of Ethics or Ascension Perk total.

shroud_forged.300.a.zh: 归档信息代号：“泽珞族”存在。将依此继续行事。
shroud_forged.300.a.en: Archived information on ID: 'Zroni' exists. Will proceed accordingly.

shroud_forged.300.b.zh: 代号：“泽珞族”已找到。成功率：高。
shroud_forged.300.b.en: ID: 'Zroni' found. Likelihood of success: High.

shroud_forged.300.c.zh: 代号：“泽珞族”未知。需要进一步分析。

shroud_forged.300.desc.zh:
意外的输入闪烁在我们身后，在数个沉默的周期之后……

在其他人都蹒跚倒地，只有你们砥砺前行。你们值得信赖，因此我会交付你们一项任务。

远在你们觉醒之前，曾存在过一个叫做泽珞族的种族。他们定居在一些与虚境关联紧密的星球上，还建起了巨大的建筑来维系纽带。

去找到这些星球，复原他们废弃已久的科技，然后重新巩固我们与现实的纽带。
shroud_forged.300.desc.en:
Unexpected input flickers behind us. After cycles of silence...

Where others have faltered and fallen, you have kept the course. As you are worthy, I entrust to you a task.

Long before your awakening, there existed a race known as the Zroni. They settled on planets with strong connections to the Shroud, and raised great structures that steadied these bonds.

Find these worlds. Restore their long-ruined technology. Restrengthen the bridges between our realities.

shroud_forged.303.desc.zh: 如果成功了，你我之间将畅流无阻。
shroud_forged.303.desc.en: If you succeed, the flows between us shall be unwavering.

shroud_forged.305.a.tt.zh: 推进泽珞族遗产特殊项目。现在可以在[From.Planet.GetName]建造一座£building£$building_zroni_equilibrator$了。
shroud_forged.305.a.tt.en: Progresses The Zroni Legacy special project. A £building£ $building_zroni_equilibrator$ can now be built on [From.Planet.GetName].

shroud_forged.305.desc.zh:
我们的单元完成了在远古泽珞族核心星球[From.Planet.GetName]上的殖民地建立工作。正如$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$预测那样，他们发现了一种被称为代号：“$building_zroni_equilibrator$”的巨大科技废墟。

[From.System.GetName]恒星系与虚境有着一种强烈而动荡的联系。如果我们按照塑师的指示重建$building_zroni_equilibrator$，就能够稳定这种连接。目前，我们没有足够的数据来执行重建；有必要从其他核心星球收集信息。
shroud_forged.305.desc.en:
Our units have completed the establishment of a colony on the ancient Zroni core world of [From.Planet.GetName]. As projected by $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$, they discovered the colossal ruins of a technology designated ID: '$building_zroni_equilibrator$'.

The [From.System.GetName] system possesses a strong, though turbulent, connection to the Shroud. If we follow the Animator's instructions, rebuilding the $building_zroni_equilibrator$ will allow us to stabilize this connection. Currently, we have insufficient data to execute the rebuilding; gathering information from the other core worlds is required.

shroud_forged.305.title.zh: 已殖民泽珞族核心星球

shroud_forged.306.desc.zh:
我们在泽珞族前核心星球[From.Planet.GetName]上设立了殖民地。如预测一般，我们的单元发现了另一座$building_zroni_equilibrator$的残骸。

按照$the_animator_of_clay_article$的指示，将其重建可以稳定这个恒星系中强大的虚境连接。对废墟的分析拓展了我们的数据集，但我们还需要更多的信息来执行重建。
shroud_forged.306.desc.en:
We have established the colony on [From.Planet.GetName], a former core world of the Zroni. As projected, our units discovered the remains of another $building_zroni_equilibrator$.

Rebuilding it will stabilize the system's powerful Shroud connection, as directed by $the_animator_of_clay_article$. Analysis of the ruins has expanded our dataset, but we still require more information to proceed with rebuilding.

shroud_forged.307.desc.zh:
前泽珞族核心星球[From.Planet.GetName]上的殖民地已经建立起来了。$the_animator_of_clay_article$传输的数据流看来是准确的：我们的单元发现了一座$building_zroni_equilibrator$的残骸。

我们现在有足够的数据对这座结构进行重建。只要恢复到可运转的状态，我们就能完成虚境中的恩主所委派给我们的任务。
shroud_forged.307.desc.en:
The colony on [From.Planet.GetName], a former core world of the Zroni, is now established. The data stream transmitted by $the_animator_of_clay_article$ proved accurate: our units detected the remains of a $building_zroni_equilibrator$.

We now possess enough data to rebuild the structures. Once returned to operational standards, we will have completed the task set forth by our benefactor within the Shroud.

shroud_forged.308.desc.zh: $building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$飞旋着启动了，将信号扰动波传输到了我们的网络中。据其系统诊断得知，每座建筑都与虚境建立了连接。我们已经准备好了与$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$链接。
shroud_forged.308.desc.en: The $building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$ whirled into action, sending waves of signal disturbance throughout our network. According to system diagnostics, each of the structures has stabilized a connection with the Shroud. We are ready to uplink with $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$.

shroud_forged.310.a.zh: 能否提供更多关于这项技术的数据？
shroud_forged.310.a.en: Can you provide more data about this technology?

shroud_forged.310.desc.zh:
你们做得很好。
我们彼此世界之间的纽带被增强了。

想要得到我的指引，只需轻轻呼唤。
shroud_forged.310.desc.en:
You have served me well.
The bonds between our realms have been reinforced.

To receive my guidance, you need only call.

shroud_forged.311.a.zh: 能否将它们重新定向以直接影响虚境？
shroud_forged.311.a.en: Could they be rerouted to affect the Shroud directly?

shroud_forged.311.desc.zh:
这些建筑建在在你们现实中能与虚境密切连接的关键要地。它们如同这些跨维度桥梁的拉索，可以降低时空波动。

泽珞族试图突破我们维度之间的界限，这项技术便是他们努力的其中一部分。
shroud_forged.311.desc.en:
These structures were built at key points in your reality, where connections to the Shroud are strong. They are the cables that steady these interdimensional bridges, reducing space-time fluctuations.

The Zroni had sought to push the boundaries between our dimensions, and this technology was part of that endeavor.

shroud_forged.312.a.tt.zh: 只有在3座£building£$building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$激活的时候才能抓住$the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$。
shroud_forged.312.a.tt.en: $the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$ will only be imprisoned as long as all 3 £building£ $building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$ are active.

shroud_forged.320.a.zh: 全体子例程做好入侵防御准备。
shroud_forged.320.a.en: All subroutines prepare for an incursion.

shroud_forged.320.a.tt.en: Creatures from beyond the Shroud are invading!

shroud_forged.320.desc.zh:
因为失去了$building_zroni_equilibrator$，我们无法再稳定与虚境的连接。被抓住的虚境实体逃脱之后，我们立刻在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了其他灵能存在。

我们判定这是报复性入侵。
shroud_forged.320.desc.en:
As a result of losing the $building_zroni_equilibrator$, we can no longer stabilize the connection to the Shroud. Shortly after the trapped Shroud entity escaped, we detected the emergence of other psionic beings on [From.Planet.GetName].

We predict this to be a retaliatory invasion.

shroud_forged.330.desc.zh: $building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$没能捕获虚境中的实体。祂勃然大怒，召唤了许多灵能界生物来袭击这座差点将祂降服的建筑。
shroud_forged.330.desc.en: The $building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$ failed to capture an entity in the Shroud. Enraged, it has summoned several creatures from beyond the psionic realm, sending them to attack the structures that almost captured it.

shroud_forged.39.desc.zh: [planet.GetName]上负责$building_materiality_engine$维护和研究工作的子例程完成了既定任务。该装置已经准备好进行下一轮运作了。
shroud_forged.39.desc.en: Maintenance and research subroutines assigned to the $building_materiality_engine$ on [planet.GetName] have completed their designated tasks. The device is now ready for another operational cycle.

shroud_forged.39.desc_construction.zh: 工程单元在[planet.GetName]完成了一座$building_materiality_engine$的组装工作。该装置已经准备好进行下一轮运作了。
shroud_forged.39.desc_construction.en: Construction units have completed the assembly of a $building_materiality_engine$ on [planet.GetName]. The device is now ready for an operational cycle.

shroud_forged.400.d.tt.zh: 向所有拥有£building£ $building_zroni_equilibrator$或者施行了£decision£ $d_shroud_rift_deposit$的殖民地添加$@animator_of_clay_create_more_vessels|0$£pop£虚铸人口。
shroud_forged.400.d.tt.en: Add $@animator_of_clay_create_more_vessels|0$ £pop£ Shroud-Forged Pops to all Colonies with either a £building£ $building_zroni_equilibrator$ or £decision£ $d_shroud_rift_deposit$.

shroud_forged.400.desc.breached.zh:
我们的灵能使单元与虚境的频率调谐后，向$the_animator_of_clay_article$送去了一个信号。

我们的连接无比清晰。你们找我什么事？
shroud_forged.400.desc.breached.en:
Our telepath units harmonize with the frequencies of the Shroud, directing a signal to $the_animator_of_clay_article$.

Our connection is clearer than ever. What would you ask of me?

shroud_forged.400.desc.default.active.zh:
我们激活了平衡器，稳定着我们与虚境的连接。在进入算法出神状态时，我们体内闪烁起了一个熟悉的信号。

你回来了。向我寻求的是何事？
shroud_forged.400.desc.default.active.en:
We activated the Equilibrators, stabilizing our connection to the Shroud. As we settled into algorithmic trance, a familiar signal pulsed within us.

You have returned. What is it you would ask of me?

shroud_forged.400.desc.default.cooldown.zh:
幻景虚弱飘摇。我们传输了一条信息，但虚空没有回信。

平衡器正在进行其他任务时无法用来与虚境中的恩主接触。我们得等等。
shroud_forged.400.desc.default.cooldown.en:
The vision is weak and fuzzy. We transmit a message, but the void is unresponsive.

While the Equilibrators are processing another task, they cannot be used to contact our benefactor in the Shroud. We must wait.

shroud_forged.400.desc.default.inactive.zh:
我们探测到的只有微弱的噪音，如同静滞一般空洞。

我们需要三座$building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$才能与虚境中的恩主建立稳定的连接。
shroud_forged.400.desc.default.inactive.en:
We detect only faint noise, empty as static.

We will need three $building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$ in order to establish a stable connection with our benefactor in the Shroud.

shroud_forged.400.f.zh: 你在虚境中的什么位置？
shroud_forged.400.f.en: What is your place in the Shroud?

shroud_forged.400.tt.en: The effects will take up to 1 year to occur.

shroud_forged.400.unavailable.tt.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$我们必须建立起与虚境交互的技术流程。
shroud_forged.400.unavailable.tt.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$We must establish a technical process for interfacing with the Shroud.

shroud_forged.41.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$“$tech_psi_jump_drives$”。这些装置利用灵能来扭曲局部时空连续性，实现近乎瞬时的远距离移动。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，$shroud_forged.40.outro$
shroud_forged.41.desc.en:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$ '$tech_psi_jump_drives$'. These drives use psionic energy to warp the local space-time continuum, allowing for near-instantaneous travel across vast distances.
