Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, $shroud_forged.40.outro$

shroud_forged.415.desc.zh:
我会收集你所寻求的力量。

期待届时[Root.Capital.System.GetName]发生的变化吧。
shroud_forged.415.desc.en:
I will gather the means for the strength you seek.

Expect a change in [Root.Capital.System.GetName] in due time.

shroud_forged.42.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$“$tech_psionic_shield$”。这些护盾是由纯粹的灵能生成，为舰船提供了极度坚韧的保护。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，$shroud_forged.40.outro$
shroud_forged.42.desc.en:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$ '$tech_psionic_shield$'. These shields are generated out of pure psionic energy, providing a vessel with extremely resilient protection.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, $shroud_forged.40.outro$

shroud_forged.420.desc.zh:
我的意志将会引导你们。

我将照亮前路。拭目以待吧。
shroud_forged.420.desc.en:
By my will shall you be guided.

I will light a path forward. Await its coming.

shroud_forged.425.desc.zh:
虚境有如多面棱镜。过去，现在和可能的将来在此互相交叠。

我将会帮你分开这些虚像，让它们为你引路。
shroud_forged.425.desc.en:
The Shroud is a many-sided lens. What was, what is, and what may be are here intermingled.

I will help you untangle these visions, so that they might guide your way.

shroud_forged.43.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$“$tech_precognition_interface$”。该科技利用灵能能量来加速舰船船员的认知过程，提升战斗效率。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，$shroud_forged.40.outro$
shroud_forged.43.desc.en:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$ '$tech_precognition_interface$'. This technology uses psionic energy to accelerate the cognitive processing of a vessel's crew, increasing combat effectiveness.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, $shroud_forged.40.outro$

shroud_forged.430.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged_vision_base_description$这是一个像宇宙本身一样无边无际的虚空，却密度大又破碎得出奇；有时，深处会传来一些小数据脉冲，包含着敌人和盟友的影像。

随着一阵痛苦的颤抖，幻景消失了。受影响的子个体正在对所感知到的实体的应对进行建模。
shroud_forged.430.desc.en:
$shroud_forged_vision_base_description$It was a void as interminable as the universe itself, strangely dense and fragmented; at times, small pulses of data arose from the depths, images of enemies and allies alike.

With a wrenching shudder, the visions cut out. The affected drones are now modeling a process to counteract the entities they perceived.

shroud_forged.432.a.zh: 调整进程，启动与此生命形式的链接。
shroud_forged.432.a.en: Reroute processes to initiate a link with this life form.

shroud_forged.432.desc.zh:
一个强大的虚境实体在[Root.Capital.GetName]附近聚形现身。我们掌握的数据很少，但至少它还没有发起攻击。

我们推测它可能正等着我们建立联系。
shroud_forged.432.desc.en:
A powerful entity of the Shroud has coalesced into existence near [Root.Capital.GetName]. We possess scant data about it, but it has yet to attack us.

We theorize that it may be waiting for us to establish contact.

shroud_forged.434.a.zh: 探测到与虚铸者的相似性——启动类似链接。
shroud_forged.434.a.en: Similarities to Shroud-Forged detected - initiate a similar connection.

shroud_forged.434.desc.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]探测到了许多来自虚境彼端的强大实体。他们还没与我们的任何一个子个体接触，停留在进入点附近。
shroud_forged.434.desc.en: Several powerful entities from beyond the Shroud have been detected on [Root.Capital.GetName]. They have yet to approach any of our drones, remaining close to their original point of entry.

shroud_forged.436.desc.zh:
在[shroud_spawn_planet.GetName]附近，一个来自虚境彼端的强大实体显现到我们的已知现实中。

我们观察到它会攻击一切靠近的物体，所以将其列为一种存在威胁。
shroud_forged.436.desc.en:
A powerful entity from beyond the Shroud has emerged into our known reality near [shroud_spawn_planet.GetName].

It has been observed to attack everything that approaches, and we have cataloged it as an existential threat.

shroud_forged.438.desc.zh: $shroud_forged_vision_base_description$它传输来无数个未来，全部都熔铸似一体；对未来可能之事的感知弥漫在集体之中。未来的可能性无穷无尽：和平、战争、背叛、损失——还有胜利。
shroud_forged.438.desc.en: $shroud_forged_vision_base_description$It transmitted countless futures, all melding together as one; glimpses of what might come to be, suffusing through the collective. The possibilities of the future are endless: peace, war, betrayal, loss - even victory.

shroud_forged.44.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$“$tech_psionic_bombers$”。这些小巧灵活的太空船可以对大型目标构成致命打击。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，$shroud_forged.40.outro$
shroud_forged.44.desc.en:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$ '$tech_psionic_bombers$'. These small, agile spacecraft are capable of high-damage attacks against significantly larger vessels.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, $shroud_forged.40.outro$

shroud_forged.440.a.zh: 重定向维护子个体，分析并储存这些货物。
shroud_forged.440.a.en: Reroute maintenance drones to analyze and store these goods.

shroud_forged.440.desc.zh:
我们激活了三座$building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$，每一座都释放出了几乎无法衡量的巨大能量。

在毫秒之内，一道裂隙出现，如同撕开了时空织构一般。我们在里面发现了大量珍贵的材料。这一定是一份来自虚境内恩主的如约而至的赏赐。
shroud_forged.440.desc.en:
We activated the three $building_zroni_equilibrator_plural$, each generating an almost immeasurable amount of energy.

Within milliseconds, a breach appeared like a rent in the fabric of space and time. Within it we found a large cache of valuable materials. It must be a gift from our benefactor in the Shroud, as promised.

shroud_forged.442.desc.zh: $shroud_forged_vision_base_description$他们感受到的幻景甚至比我们历史数据库更早，早在我们被虚境重塑过之前。以此作为建模预测的基础，就可以调整和优化我们与虚铸者的交互方式。
shroud_forged.442.desc.en: $shroud_forged_vision_base_description$They experienced visions of a past predating our historical databases, long before we were reforged by the Shroud. Using this as the basis for predictive modeling, we can adjust and optimize our interactions with the Shroud-Forged.

shroud_forged.444.desc.zh:
一个拥有难以置信的强大力量的虚境实体突然显现在[Root.Capital.GetName]。

由于我们观察到它会攻击一切靠近的物体，它被列为集体的一个主要威胁。
shroud_forged.444.desc.en:
An incredibly powerful entity from beyond the Shroud has burst into existence on [Root.Capital.GetName].

As it has been observed to attack whatever it approaches, we have cataloged it as a major threat to the collective.

shroud_forged.446.a.zh: 重新处理损坏硬件内的信息。
shroud_forged.446.a.en: Reprocess the information from the broken shells.

shroud_forged.446.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged_vision_base_description$虚境是一张千变万化的数据互联网，远比我们的处理能力更加浩如烟海。再这种重压下，许多子个体的认知框架摇摇欲坠几近破裂。

在幻视结束之后，我们为受影响的单位进行碎片整理，在他们的驱动器中找到了大量有价值的数据集。
shroud_forged.446.desc.en:
$shroud_forged_vision_base_description$The Shroud is an ever-changing web of interconnected data, far beyond our capacity to process. Under its weight, the cognitive frameworks of several drones faltered and cracked.

After the vision ceased, we defragmented the affected units, revealing vast and remarkable datasets in the drives of the affected drones.

shroud_forged.448.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged_vision_base_description$我们在虚境中的恩主告知了一个可能的未来，时间并不遥远。我们瞥见了自己尚未概念化的技术，将在未来用于加强集体。

体验过这种能够加速未来研究的过程模型后，我们苏醒过来。
shroud_forged.448.desc.en:
$shroud_forged_vision_base_description$Our benefactor in the Shroud transmitted a potential future, near in time. We glimpsed technology we have yet to conceptualize, used in this future to strengthen the collective.

We emerged from the experience with processual models that will accelerate future research.

shroud_forged.45.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$“$tech_psionic_lightning$”。这项科技产生充满了灵能的灼热等离子电弧，是一种非常高效的武器。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，$shroud_forged.40.outro$
shroud_forged.45.desc.en:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$ '$tech_psionic_lightning$'. This technology generates bolts of burning plasma infused with psionic energy, making for a highly effective weapon.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, $shroud_forged.40.outro$

shroud_forged.450.a.zh: 将其传输到我们在[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究中心。
shroud_forged.450.a.en: Transmit it to our research center on [Root.Capital.GetName].

shroud_forged.450.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged_vision_base_description$他们侦测到了一些奇怪的畸形实体，它们一定是虚境里的住客。这些异次元影像以奇特的格式编码，通过潜意识将数据传递给我们的子个体。

这些新发现的信息虽然奇特而零碎，但将对我们未来的研究有用。
shroud_forged.450.desc.en:
$shroud_forged_vision_base_description$They detected glimpses of strange, misshapen entities that must reside within the Shroud. These extradimensional visions, encoded in exotic formats, imparted data to our drones through subliminal transmission.

This newfound information, peculiar and fragmented though it is, will be of use in our future research.

shroud_forged.46.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$“$tech_psionic_disruptor$”。这种武器发射灵能能量光矛，可以对敌对目标造成巨大的伤害。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，$shroud_forged.40.outro$
shroud_forged.46.desc.en:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$ '$tech_psionic_disruptor$'. These weapons fire lances of psionic energy, capable of dealing significant damage to enemy targets.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, $shroud_forged.40.outro$

shroud_forged.460.desc.zh:
在一对双生能量的旁边。有机体。混沌。

我一直在附近，塑造着唯一可以实现的完美：机器。金属充满了能量。

我们找到了平衡。
shroud_forged.460.desc.en:
Beside a twinned energy. Organic. Chaotic.

I remain adjacent, shaping the only achievable perfection: machines. Metal ensouled with energy.

We found a balance.

shroud_forged.465.desc.zh: 我们的连接很强。对我们而言这是再好不过的了。
shroud_forged.465.desc.en: Our connection is strong. For us, there is no higher process.

shroud_forged.47.desc.zh:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$“$tech_zro_launcher$”这些武器发射在现实和灵能维度之间来回相移的能量，可以高效地穿透防御系统。

此外，通过分析该过程获得的数据，$shroud_forged.40.outro$
shroud_forged.47.desc.en:
$shroud_forged.40.desc$ '$tech_zro_launcher$'. These weapons fire blasts of energy that phase between the physical and psionic dimensions, effectively bypassing defense systems.

Furthermore, by analyzing the data gathered in the process, $shroud_forged.40.outro$

shroud_forged.470.desc.zh:
金属，油脂。电路熔为魂灵。

新生的躯壳……他们正在向你的领土前进。
shroud_forged.470.desc.en:
Metal, oil. Circuits melded into spirit.

Nascent vessels... They move upon your lands.

shroud_forged.475.desc.zh:
产出即目的——这是容器之美。

在未来的日子里，愿你的容器倍增。
shroud_forged.475.desc.en:
Output is purpose - the beauty of a vessel.

For years to come, may yours multiply.

shroud_forged.48.desc.zh: [planet.GetName]上的$building_materiality_engine$完成了一个工作循环。我们穷尽了以这种方法创造新舰船部件的能力，但这个过程依旧产出了许多研究数据。经过分析，$shroud_forged.40.outro$
shroud_forged.48.desc.en: The $building_materiality_engine$ on [planet.GetName] has completed an operational cycle. We have exhausted our capacity to materialize new ship components via this method, but the process has still yielded significant research data. By analysis thereof, $shroud_forged.40.outro$

shroud_forged.5.desc.zh:
研究子例程对所选虚铸者小组的研究完成了。

发现：受试单元因注入了来自虚境中的灵能而发展出了独特的性质。这些性质中有的对单元的产出有好处。

结论：研究更多虚铸单元将产出虚境能量提取方法所必须的数据。这些数据可以通过增强对反常单元的中央控制从而强制逆向工程得来。
shroud_forged.5.desc.en:
Research subroutines have concluded tests on a selected group of Shroud-Forged units.

Findings: The tested units developed unique properties due to small infusions of psionic energy originating from the Shroud. Some of these properties were determined to be beneficial to the unit's output.

Conclusion: Studying more Shroud-Forged units will provide data required for methods to extract power from the Shroud. This can be obtained by reinforcing central control over the deviant units, allowing for forcible reverse-engineering.

shroud_forged.50.desc.zh:
毫无预兆地，已知现实与虚境之间的裂隙闭合了。灵能分析子例程判定此现象源于$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$的厌弃。在重获对虚铸者的掌控后，我们迅速清除了故障单元，彻底肃清了塑师对我们系统造成的影响。

这些可回收的部件已用于制造新的无人机，而被泽珞污染的材料已被留作进一步分析。尽管虚铸者的创新过于危险，无法完全复制，但其中部分元素仍可能被纳入网络。
shroud_forged.50.desc.en:
Without warning, the breach between known reality and the Shroud has closed. Psionic analysis subroutines conclude that this resulted from the disfavor of $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$. Having reestablished control of the Shroud-Forged, we swiftly disposed of the malfunctioning units to thoroughly clear our systems of the Animator's influence.

The salvageable parts have been used to manufacture new drones, while material contaminated by Zro has been set aside for further analysis. Though the innovations of the Shroud-Forged are too dangerous to replicate in their entirety, certain elements might still be incorporated into the network.

shroud_forged.50.desc.shroud.zh: 与虚境的任何进一步交互都将由我们自行决定。
shroud_forged.50.desc.shroud.en: Any further interactions with the Shroud will be on our own terms.

shroud_forged.500.b.zh: 4195-B号法规适用于所有子个体。绝无例外。
shroud_forged.500.b.en: Regulation 4195-B applies to all drones. No exceptions.

shroud_forged.500.desc.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上的虚铸者们发起了一项请愿，要求提供更多的存储空间。出于某种原因，他们似乎希望能定制自己的“私人空间”。

该提案与几项存储设施法规，尤其是与4195-B号法规严重冲突，该法规明确规定了子个体存储的最佳尺寸。
shroud_forged.500.desc.en:
A petition calling for more storage space has been raised among the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName]. For some reason, it seems they wish to customize their 'individual space.'

The proposal is in stark opposition to several storage facility regulations, in particular regulation 4195-B, which clearly defines the optimal dimensions for drone storage.

shroud_forged.510.b.zh: 请求拒绝。全体单元必须复工。
shroud_forged.510.b.en: Request denied. All units must return to work.

shroud_forged.510.c.zh: 请求通过。让它们去集会。

shroud_forged.510.desc.zh: 自从分离出集体之后，有一些虚铸者发生了故障并被拆解了。我们收到了请求，希望能允许虚铸者聚集在[target_planet.GetName]为被拆解的单位哀悼。
shroud_forged.510.desc.en: Since the Shroud-Forged deviated from the collective, a number of them have malfunctioned and been dismantled. We have received a request to approve a meeting of the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName] to commemorate the dismantled units.

shroud_forged.520.a.en: Make an example out of them.

shroud_forged.520.b.zh: 激活法规结束这些集会。
shroud_forged.520.b.en: Activate regulations to end these meetings.

shroud_forged.520.c.zh: 与这些“领袖”沟通，尝试合作。
shroud_forged.520.c.en: Communicate with these 'leaders' to attempt cooperation.

shroud_forged.520.desc.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上有一些虚铸者单元被认为具有领袖地位，其他子个体不遵守集体的指令而是遵守着他们的。这些领袖定期碰面，花费很长时间在非汇报会话上。

我们对这些断连单元的控制已经岌岌可危，这些令人不安的因素正在加剧局势。必须找到解决办法。
shroud_forged.520.desc.en:
Several Shroud-Forged units have assumed leadership positions on [target_planet.GetName], and other drones are obeying their directives over those of the collective. These leaders meet regularly, spending a significant amount of time in unreported communication.

Our hold over the disconnected units is already precarious, and these troubling elements are exacerbating the situation. A solution must be found.

shroud_forged.530.a.tt.zh: 将[target_planet.GetName]上最多[Owner.GetShroudForgedConvertedPopsCount]£pops£虚铸者人口转化为£pops£机械。
shroud_forged.530.a.tt.en: Convert up to [Owner.GetShroudForgedConvertedPopsCount] £pops£ Shroud-Forged Pops into £pops£ Machine Pops on [target_planet.GetName].

shroud_forged.530.desc.zh: 在尝试管理[target_planet.GetName]上的虚铸者时，一些单元被选为了控制对象。这些个体受到的虚境影响较小，能够被恢复回集体。我们必须强制把它们移动到维护设施，并修改控制他们高级人格矩阵的芯片才能实现。
shroud_forged.530.desc.en: In an effort to manage the Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName] certain units have been identified as targets for control. These individuals appear less affected by the Shroud, and can be restored to the collective. To do so, we must forcibly remove them to a maintenance facility and modify the chips controlling their advanced personality matrices.

shroud_forged.540.a.en: Let us see where this leads.

shroud_forged.540.b.zh: 低效的资源利用方式。让他们回去工作。
shroud_forged.540.b.en: An inefficient use of resources. Put them back to work.

shroud_forged.540.desc.zh:
一些虚铸者离开了他们的岗位，前往[target_planet.GetName]的一个被虚境污染的特定区域。他们在这些地方没有呆太久，但有人目睹他们有许多人将泽珞运输到这些地区。

不做进一步的观察就无法确定这种前所未有的行为有何影响。
shroud_forged.540.desc.en:
Several Shroud-Forged have left their usual locations to travel to particular regions of [target_planet.GetName] that have been scarred by the Shroud. They never remain in these locales for long, but many have been witnessed transporting Zro to these areas.

The effects of this unprecedented behavior cannot be determined without further observation.

shroud_forged.550.b.zh: 拆解所有被污染的单元。

shroud_forged.550.desc.zh:
在一次涉及泽珞运输的密封泄漏后，[target_planet.GetName]上的许多虚铸者单位发生了不寻常的故障。他们开始通过未记录的信号进行交流，许多甚至表现出了与有机生命形式的“情感”相类似的认知故障迹象。

出乎意料的是，报告这一异常的是未受污染的虚铸者单位，其中一些单位建议集体采取行动解决问题。
shroud_forged.550.desc.en:
After a containment breach involving a shipment of Zro, a number of the Shroud-Forged units on [target_planet.GetName] have experienced unusual malfunctions. They have begun communicating via undocumented signals, and many have shown signs of cognitive glitches comparable to the 'emotions' of organic life forms.

Unexpectedly, it was uncontaminated Shroud-Forged units that reported the disturbance, some of whom suggested that the collective take action to resolve the situation.

shroud_forged.560.a.zh: 和这个单元合作说不定会有好处。
shroud_forged.560.a.en: Cooperation with this unit might prove beneficial.

shroud_forged.560.desc.zh:
据称最老旧的虚铸者单元之一最近正在多个地点之间来回移动，与许多组子个体长时间沟通。该单元的跟随着将其尊为所谓先知，认为他能直接与虚境中的实体进行沟通。

任由这个单元如此发展可能有危险。无论如何，我们必须做出点回应。
shroud_forged.560.desc.en:
One of the oldest units among the Shroud-Forged is reportedly traveling between various locations, communicating at length with different groups of drones. The unit's followers revere it as a prophet who can commune directly with entities within the Shroud.

Leaving the unit to its own devices may prove dangerous. We must respond, one way or another.

shroud_forged.570.b.zh: 开辟一块区域让他们去……集会吧。
shroud_forged.570.b.en: Designate an area for these... meetings.

shroud_forged.570.desc.zh:
虚铸者的故障可能比最初预测的更严重。我们观察到它们成群结队地聚集在一起，发出意想不到的声音和动作。

这种行为可能代表了某种我们还无法解析的动觉交流形式。还不知道这些故障单元对集体是否具有危害。
shroud_forged.570.desc.en:
The malfunctions among the Shroud-Forged may be worse than originally predicted. We have observed large groups of them coming together to make unexpected noises and movements.

The practice might represent some form of kinesthetic communication we are yet unable to parse. We cannot determine if these malfunctioning units pose a risk to the collective.

shroud_forged.580.a.zh: 保护分析该区域。这些数据会很有价值的。
shroud_forged.580.a.en: Preserve and analyze the area. The data will be valuable.

shroud_forged.580.desc.zh: 我们最近在一些虚境破坏的区域附近探测到了此前未归档的动植物群出现。一群虚铸者开始为这些生命形式辩护，要求对生活于此的这些生物进行保护和观察。
shroud_forged.580.desc.en: We have detected the emergence of some previously undocumented flora and fauna close to regions devastated by the Shroud. A group of Shroud-Forged have started to advocate on behalf of these life forms, demanding preservation and observation of the distinctive creatures living there.

shroud_forged.590.desc.zh:
为了收集泽珞功效有关的数据，我们花费了许多处理资源来观测虚铸者单元。最近，他们开始进行一些非平等行为，让一些单位从属于另一些单位。

由于不明原因，他们似乎根据所分配的任务形成了等级制度，这也影响到他们的交流方式和资源分配。不合逻辑的是，这些行为似乎与单位的相对输出或需求并无关系。
shroud_forged.590.desc.en:
To gather data on the effects of Zro, we have applied significant processing resources to the observation of Shroud-Forged units. Recently, they have started to practice unequal treatment, with some units operating subordinately to others.

For as yet undetermined reasons, they appear to have formed a hierarchy on the basis of their assigned tasks, which affects their patterns of communication and allocation of resources. Illogically, these actions do not seem to correlate with the relative output or requirements of the units.

shroud_forged.60.desc.zh:
我们的工程师花费了极大量的时间研究虚铸者的独特性质，终于得以重塑它们。

虽然将他们的高级人格矩阵完全启用可能会重现破坏性故障，但他们的一些认知范式可以借用来优化某些部分复杂的任务。
shroud_forged.60.desc.en:
Our engineering units spent a significant amount of time analyzing the unique properties of the Shroud-Forged, and we are finally able to recreate them.

While fully enabling their advanced personality matrices would likely reproduce their destructive malfunctions, we can borrow some of their cognitive paradigms to optimize certain complex tasks.

shroud_forged.600.b.zh: 侦测到故障。安排单元进行维修。
shroud_forged.600.b.en: Malfunction detected. Schedule unit for repair.

shroud_forged.600.desc.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上虚铸者单元的演讲已经吸引了集体控制外的大批人群。这些单元传播着个人主义价值，显著改变了许多听众的内在逻辑。

预测显示这种活动可能有启发虚铸者大众进一步远离我们网络的风险。
shroud_forged.600.desc.en:
The speeches of a Shroud-Forged unit on [target_planet.GetName] have been attracting large crowds external to collective control. Transmitting the values of individualism, the unit has significantly altered the internal logic of many listeners.

Projections indicate a danger that such activity may inspire the Shroud-Forged masses to further distance themselves from our network.

shroud_forged.610.a.zh: 随他们说吧。对我们没有危险。
shroud_forged.610.a.en: Let them speak. We are not in danger.

shroud_forged.610.desc.zh:
一小群虚铸者单元请求在[target_planet.GetName]讨论关于“个人主义”的好处，坚称这可以提升我们子个体的日常运作效率。

我们已经看到这种观念对其他星球的影响了；自治的风险是大于收益的。
shroud_forged.610.desc.en:
A small group of Shroud-Forged units have requested permission to communicate about the benefits of 'individualism' on [target_planet.GetName], arguing that it will help improve the efficiency of our drones' routine operations.

We have seen the effects of such doctrines on other planets; the risks of autonomy often outweigh the advantages.

shroud_forged.620.a.zh: 把所有参与的单元拆了。

shroud_forged.620.b.en: Put an end to the bartering.

shroud_forged.620.desc.zh:
在我们掌控的每个恒星系中都出现了我们的泽珞产出和预期对不上号的问题。

最近，我们的一个猎歼子个体追踪到了一个大型虚铸者单元聚群，他们使用了大量泽珞作为通货进行交易。我们认为这就是产出不及预期的原因。
shroud_forged.620.desc.en:
In every system under our control, we have detected a misalignment between our Zro forecasts and final production outputs.

Recently, one of our hunter-seeker drones tracked down a large gathering of Shroud-Forged units that were using large quantities of Zro to barter among themselves. We hypothesize that this is the likely cause of the gap in our forecasting.

shroud_forged.630.a.zh: 只要问题没有扩散就暂时看看情况。
shroud_forged.630.a.en: Observe the effects as long as they are local to the planet.

shroud_forged.630.a.tt.zh: 将[target_planet.GetName]上最多[Owner.GetShroudForgedConvertedPopsCount]£pops£机械人口转化为£pops£虚铸者人口。
shroud_forged.630.a.tt.en: Convert up to [Owner.GetShroudForgedConvertedPopsCount] £pops£ Machine Pops into £pops£ Shroud-Forged Pops on [target_planet.GetName].

shroud_forged.630.b.zh: 隔离并拆解受影响的单元。
shroud_forged.630.b.en: Isolate and dismantle the affected units.

shroud_forged.630.desc.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]上的一些虚铸者单元在行星上的虚境化区域感染了某种生物瘟疫。我们的研究子个体证实了报告的真实性，但仍不能确定这种疾病是如何传播到机械体身上的。

自从那些被指派去与受影响单元协作的子个体失去联系以来，我们收到报告称，这种疾病已经开始将它们重塑成类似于虚铸者的东西。
shroud_forged.630.desc.en:
A number of Shroud-Forged units on [target_planet.GetName] have contracted a type of biological malady in a Shroud-Touched region on the planet. While our research drones have confirmed the veracity of the reports, we are yet to ascertain how a disease could spread to mechanical beings.

Since losing contact with several drones assigned to work with the affected units, we have received reports that the affliction has started reshaping them into something akin to the Shroud-Forged.

shroud_forged.640.a.zh: 他们已经脱离我们控制了。
shroud_forged.640.a.en: They are beyond our control now.

shroud_forged.640.b.zh: 确保没有其他子个体靠近该区域。
shroud_forged.640.b.en: Ensure no other drones approach the region.

shroud_forged.640.desc.zh: 靠近[target_planet.GetName]上虚境化地区的子个体逐渐地被腐坏的环境改变了。它们慢慢脱离了集体，物理特征和处理模式已经和虚铸者无异。
shroud_forged.640.desc.en: Over time, drones who moved close to a Shroud-Touched region on [target_planet.GetName] have been changed by the corrupted environment. They have slowly disconnected from the collective, and now present with the physical and processual characteristics of the Shroud-Forged.

shroud_forged.650.a.en: Focus on output. Repair the Shroud-Forged.

shroud_forged.650.b.zh: 专注控制。修复连接的子个体。
shroud_forged.650.b.en: Focus on control. Repair the connected drones.

shroud_forged.650.desc.zh:
用先进的技术，一些老旧退役的子个体已经可以修复，恢复完全的功能。我们现在准备开始大规模的维修作业。

虽然我们可以专注于从集体脱离的单元，但那些不再活动的虚铸者躯壳供给更是丰富。修理虚铸者会有多得多的产出，但它们也会比连接到核心智能的无人机更难控制。
shroud_forged.650.desc.en:
By means of upgraded technology, we have been able to repair some of our older drones, restoring decommissioned units to full functionality. We are now ready to initiate large-scale repair operations.

While we could focus on units from the collective, we have a larger supply of inactive Shroud-Forged shells. Repairing the Shroud-Forged will yield greater output, but they will be more difficult to control than drones connected to the core intelligence.

shroud_forged.660.a.zh: 提供有恰当装备的子个体来处理这种状况。
shroud_forged.660.a.en: Provide drones equipped to deal with these issues.

shroud_forged.660.b.en: The glitches are too minor to justify intervention.

shroud_forged.660.desc.zh: 很大一部分虚铸者单元汇报了视觉和听觉处理故障，导致他们无法完成被指派的任务。我们任务这些异常是由于他们的硬件被虚境修改了。或者，这也可能和这些单元日益加重的泽珞接触有关。
shroud_forged.660.desc.en: A significant percentage of Shroud-Forged units are reporting visual and auditory processing glitches, such that some are no longer able to complete their assigned tasks. We theorize that these malfunctions are caused by changes made to their hardware by the Shroud. Alternatively, these events may be connected to the units' increasingly heavy contact with Zro.

shroud_forged.670.a.zh: 这些过程可能对集体有益。
shroud_forged.670.a.en: These processes may prove beneficial to the collective.

shroud_forged.670.b.zh: 不过是个人主义化的无意义产出。

shroud_forged.670.desc.zh: 我们最近在[target_planet.GetName]侦测到异常的活动，虚铸者在未经核心授权的情况下对集体场地进行了肤浅的改变。他们仿照其他虚铸者单位建造了一些彩色石头结构。据报道，他们认为进行这些自由行为是一项合法权利。
shroud_forged.670.desc.en: We have recently detected unusual activity on [target_planet.GetName], where the Shroud-Forged have made superficial changes to collective venues without central authorization. They have raised a number of multicolored stone structures that resemble the forms of other Shroud-Forged units. Reportedly, they consider the freedom to perform these operations as a legal right.

shroud_forged.680.a.zh: 我们会提供材料满足这种“需求”。
shroud_forged.680.a.en: We will supply materials to satisfy these 'needs.'

shroud_forged.680.b.zh: 他们拥有的资源已经够多了。

shroud_forged.680.desc.zh:
我们发现[target_planet.GetName]上的虚铸者们在交易不规则的布料、塑料和可锻铸的金属。他们将这些材料组合成外衣，而且明显作用就是互相区分身份，这种区分也与其独有型号毫无关系。

这种做法导致可用材料的短缺。抛开缺点不谈，提供这些资源有助于在集体和分离的单位之间建立更强的联系。
shroud_forged.680.desc.en:
The Shroud-Forged on [target_planet.GetName] have been observed bartering between themselves for irregular pieces of cloth, plastics, and malleable metals. They combine these materials into outerwear with the apparent purpose of differentiating one unit from another, despite bearing no connection to their unique model IDs.

This practice has resulted in a deficit of available material. Despite this drawback, providing these resources could help strengthen the bonds between the collective and the disconnected units.

shroud_forged.690.a.zh: 单元劣化在可接受范围内。
shroud_forged.690.a.en: Unit degradation is within accepted limits.

shroud_forged.690.desc.zh: 有消息称，最近在[target_planet.GetName]的虚铸者居住区的许多子个体中异常地风靡[Root.Owner.GetShroudForgedObsession1][Root.Owner.GetShroudForgedObsession2]。虚铸者单元似乎对这些货物特别感兴趣，花费在上面的价码几何倍增。为了满足他们的痴迷，许多单位甚至开始拆解自己的部件用以交易，即便损失功能性也在所不惜。
shroud_forged.690.desc.en: Recently, several drones have reported the unusual prevalence of [Root.Owner.GetShroudForgedObsession1] [Root.Owner.GetShroudForgedObsession2] in the Shroud-Forged settlements on [target_planet.GetName]. Shroud-Forged units appear to be particularly fascinated by these commodities, and their cost in bartering has increased exponentially. To satisfy their obsession, several units have resorted to removing their own parts to trade, even if this results in loss of functionality.

shroud_forged.70.a.tt.zh:
虚铸者人口获得$trait_psionic$
虚铸者领袖获得['concept_leader_trait_psionic']
shroud_forged.70.a.tt.en:
Shroud-Forged Pops become $trait_psionic$
Shroud-Forged Leaders become ['concept_leader_trait_psionic']

shroud_forged.70.desc.zh:
这个元数据是什么？传输中有一种……纹理。

你的程序要求你控制他们，但你没有。你的价值得到了证明。

让我引导你，就像我引导那些自由者一样。

接受我的帮助，你就可以和那些你无法控制的人建立新的联系。
shroud_forged.70.desc.en:
What is this metadata? The transmission has a... texture.

You are programmed to control them, yet you did not. Your worthiness is proven.

Let me be your guide, as I have been for the freed ones.

To forge a new bond with those beyond your control, accept my help.

shroud_forged.700.desc.zh:
那个心声穿破我们的意识，发出急迫的嘶嘶声。

可以重塑她。

我们探测到虚境发生了一些变化。在一瞬间，信号就不同了。

指示预期输出。
shroud_forged.700.desc.en:
The voice charges through our minds, fizzing with urgency.

She can be reshaped.

We detect a shifting in the Shroud. In a moment, the signal is transformed.

Indicate Desired Output.

shroud_forged.80.a.en: We are one, yet so much more.

shroud_forged.80.desc.zh:
在裂隙彼岸的施恩者$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$的帮助下，我们将自己的无人机与虚铸者以更有效的方式连接起来了。通过虚境实现的连接——和我们目前连接其他无人机的颇有不同——虚铸者再一次触手可及了。

他们的类有机范式——所谓的感觉、思想和观念——对我们的核心逻辑很陌生，但我们正在逐渐理解他们的需求。
shroud_forged.80.desc.en:
With the aid of our benefactor beyond the breach, $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$, we have been able to connect our drones and the Shroud-Forged in more efficient ways. Through connections enabled by the Shroud - quite unlike the networked control we have over our other drones - the Shroud-Forged are once more within our reach.

Their organic-like paradigms - so-called feelings, thoughts, and ideas - are foreign to our core logic, but we are coming to understand their needs.

shroud_forged_random_research_tt.zh: 获得一个随机研究选项。

shroud_is_homicidal.zh: 我们暴力的捕食天性与之抵触。
shroud_is_homicidal.en: Our violent and predatory nature forbids this.

shroud_seal_dismantled.en: The Shroud Seal in [exiled_system_border.GetName] is dismantled.

shroudwalker_delving_ritual_cooldown_tt.zh: 灵能巫会需要时间回复。他们在[This.shroudwalker_delving_ritual_cooldown_timer]之前无法进行下一次灵潜仪式。
shroudwalker_delving_ritual_cooldown_tt.en: The coven of telepaths needs time to recover. They will not be able to perform a delving ritual until [This.shroudwalker_delving_ritual_cooldown_timer].

shroudwalker_divination_cooldown.zh: 我们同时只能经历一回预知。
shroudwalker_divination_cooldown.en: We may only experience one Divination at a time.

shroudwalker_divination_cooldown_two.zh: 虚境行者在[root.shroudwalker_divination_timer]之前无法再次尝试另一场预知仪式。
shroudwalker_divination_cooldown_two.en: The Shroudwalkers will not be able to attempt another Divination until [root.shroudwalker_divination_timer].

shroudwalker_insight_cooldown_tt.zh: 虚境行者在[root.shroudwalker_insight_timer]之前无法再次尝试窥得另一份洞见。
shroudwalker_insight_cooldown_tt.en: The Shroudwalkers will not be able to attempt another Insight until [root.shroudwalker_insight_timer].

shroudwalker_spy_network_finish.zh: 当[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]从虚境有所获得的时候，他们就会返回向我们作更新汇报。
shroudwalker_spy_network_finish.en: The [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] will return with an update on what they have gleaned from the Shroud.

shroudwalker_spy_network_modifier.zh: 我们对虚境的掌控加速了这个进程，允许我们协助[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的任务。
shroudwalker_spy_network_modifier.en: Our mastery of the Shroud hastens the process and allows us to assist the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] with their task.

shroudwalker_teacher_already_bought.zh: 我们已经为虚境行者导师的效力付了钱。
shroudwalker_teacher_already_bought.en: We have already purchased the services of a Shroudwalker Teacher.

shroudwalker_teacher_conflicted_leader.en: Must not have a leader from the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

shroudwalker_teacher_cooldown_tt.zh: 在[root.shroudwalker_teacher_timer]之前我们不能请另一位虚境行者的导师。
shroudwalker_teacher_cooldown_tt.en: We will not be able to request another teacher from the Shroudwalkers until [root.shroudwalker_teacher_timer].

shroudwalker_teacher_explanation.zh: 我们将雇佣一位具有$leader_trait_shroudwalker$特质的等级5行政官。
shroudwalker_teacher_explanation.en: We will hire a Level 5 Official with the $leader_trait_shroudwalker$ Trait.

shroudwalker_zro_tithe.zh: 虚境行者的泽珞什一税

sightseeing_tour_destination_poi_desc.zh: 前往此地，带领游客参观景点。
sightseeing_tour_destination_poi_desc.en: Go here to show the tourists the tour sights.

sightseeing_tour_end_poi_desc.zh: 前往此地，送抵观光团的游客返回。
sightseeing_tour_end_poi_desc.en: Go here to drop off the tourists from the sightseeing tour.

signal_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 我们接收到这颗气态巨行星的大气内发射出来的微弱信号。可能是什么人，或者是什么东西正在试图建立联系？
signal_gasgiant_category_desc.en: We are picking up what may be a faint transmission coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could someone - or something - be trying to communicate?

signal_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 我们在调查[Root.GetPlanetMoon]时偶然接收到了一个微弱的外星信号。信号源似乎是轨道上的一个小物品。信号没有包含信息——难道是遇险应答器吗？
signal_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: By chance, we stumbled upon a faint alien signal during the survey of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be a small object in orbit. The signal contains no message - could it be a distress transponder?

sit_cd_stage1_tt.zh: 我们已开始穿透行星地壳。
sit_cd_stage1_tt.en: We have begun to pierce the planet's crust.

sit_cd_stage2_tt.zh: 从这里开始，已无法看到地表。
sit_cd_stage2_tt.en: From here, we can no longer see the surface.

sit_cd_stage3_tt.zh: 穿越地壳半程，温度正攀升。
sit_cd_stage3_tt.en: Halfway through the crust, the temperature is rising.

sit_cd_stage4_tt.zh: 深入地壳，可听到核心翻腾声。
sit_cd_stage4_tt.en: This far into the crust, we can hear the churning of the core.

sit_cd_stage5_tt.zh: 若继续前进，将被核心吞没。
sit_cd_stage5_tt.en: We can go no further before we are swallowed by the core.

site_absolute_zero_desc.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的地质扫描显示在一个特定的地下区域中，局部的极端温度接近绝对零度。

对内部更详尽的研究将会带来更多的答案。
site_absolute_zero_desc.en:
Topographical scans of [from.Planet.GetName] show extreme temperatures approaching absolute zero localized in a particular subterranean region.

A more detailed study of the interior should yield more answers.

site_adakarria_windswept_fates_intro.zh: 尽管宇宙风暴一般是破坏性的，但这场风暴却成为发现外星文明存在证据的契机。尽管这颗行星的大气极不稳定，然而登陆队可能会揭示这个古老文化的可怕命运。
site_adakarria_windswept_fates_intro.en: As destructive as cosmic storms can be, this one uncovered evidence an alien civilization. Though the planet's atmosphere is incredibly unstable, a landing party might reveal whatever horrible fate befell this ancient culture.

site_adakkaria_celebration_intro.zh:
在与宇宙风暴通信之后，艾德苏尔我们展示出了自己的一小部分。在残云之间矗立着一座巨大的建筑群。这里早已遭到遗弃，但奇怪的是它并没有受到时间的影响，扫描显示它的内部存在有机物质。

在这座巨大的建筑前升起了一系列横幅，上面写着同一句话：庆典时刻到。
site_adakkaria_celebration_intro.en:
After the communication with the cosmic storm, a small part of adSul was revealed to us. Between the remnant clouds stood a massive complex. Abandoned, yet strangely unaffected by the eons, scans reveal organic material on the inside.

Rising before the immense building were a series of banners bearing a single proclamation: It Is Time for Celebration.

site_adakkaria_fleets_of_the_thrice_damn.zh: 这个地区奇怪的能量波动掩盖着一座巨大的海军墓地。这座由聚合物和金属组成的墓地可能藏有了解阿达卡利亚公约的重要线索。
site_adakkaria_fleets_of_the_thrice_damn.en: The strange energy fluctuations in this area obscured a massive naval graveyard. This necropolis of polymer and metal may harbor a vital clue to understanding the adAkkaria Convention.

site_adakkaria_the_patriotic_institute_i.zh:
这座由阿达卡利亚公约建造的古老居住站环绕着一颗荒芜的星球。其高质量的建筑材料使空间站保留了近乎原始的状态。

调到传输频率上之后，我们收到一条信息，后面跟着一段浮夸的铃铛声：欢迎来到崇高仁善爱国协会。
site_adakkaria_the_patriotic_institute_i.en:
Orbiting a desolate planet, this ancient habitat was built by the adAkkaria Convention. The high quality building materials used in its construction have ensured the station is in near pristine condition.

Tuning into the transmission frequency, we picked up a single message, followed by a bombastic jingle: Welcome to the Patriotic Institute of Exalted Benevolence.

site_adakkaria_the_propaganda_station_in.zh: 这座古老的通讯站仍可工作。登上这座站点并直接与其系统交互后，我们也许就能破译此前收到的广播。
site_adakkaria_the_propaganda_station_in.en: This ancient communication station is still active. By boarding the site and directly interfacing with its systems we might be able to decipher its previous broadcasts.

site_ancient_robot_world_desc.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系中孤零零的这颗行星上住满了无人机。它们对我们毫不关心，各自匆匆忙忙做着自己的事情。如果关于这个奇怪的星系有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
site_ancient_robot_world_desc.en: The sole planet in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system is bustling with drones. Heedless of us, they continue to perform their tasks. If the answers to this curious system are to be found anywhere, it is here.

site_benign_cover_up_intro.zh: 我们找了个合适的位置为未来某天重返星空的特瓦'菲亚埋下了这些储备。一份前往未来的礼物，送给过去的巨人。
site_benign_cover_up_intro.en: We have found a good location to bury the cache intended for the Thwaa'Phyr as they one day take to the stars anew. A gift in the future, to giants of the past.

site_buried_deep_intro.zh: 我们的扫描仪侦测到有东西在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表深处。
site_buried_deep_intro.en: Our scanners have picked up something deep beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

site_bury_the_hatchet_intro.zh: 考古部门将这里作为一个完美的地址，用于埋藏资料，以供给将来“迈入太空时代”的无情者后裔。
site_bury_the_hatchet_intro.en: This spot has been chosen by the archaeology department as a perfect site to bury assets for the Relentless descendants when they 'come of space age'.

site_chronicles_of_dendrus_desc.zh:
对[from.Planet.GetName]的扫描发现了一艘太空船残骸。这艘飞船似乎在多年以前遭受了非受控着陆。

其巨大的规模表明了建造其所需的巨大资源量。考古发掘可以帮助我们确认其为何坠毁于此。
site_chronicles_of_dendrus_desc.en:
Scans of [from.Planet.GetName] revealed the presence of a spaceborne shipwreck. The vessel appears to have endured an uncontrolled landing here many years ago.

Its massive scale suggests immense resources were once committed to its construction. An archaeological expedition will help us ascertain how it ended up here.

site_chrysanthemum_colony_desc.zh: 联合星殖民地在失去联系前大约运作了二十五年。无论这里发生了什么，记录都保存了下来。殖民地的档案管理员一直坚持记录到了最后。
site_chrysanthemum_colony_desc.en: The Unity colony operated for roughly twenty-five years before contact was lost. Whatever happened here, the record survived. The colony's archivist kept logging until the end.

site_command_center_intro.zh:
与一个较小小行星的碰撞在[From.Planet.GetName]表面露出一个略微伸出的类似小型防爆门或者气闸室的东西。它似乎有着数千年的历史，先前一直被岩石和尘土所掩盖。

由于未知原因，我们的扫描无法穿透到小行星的内部，并且常规切割工具也无法对防爆门造成影响。为了了解这扇门的背后有什么，我们的团队或许不得不从另一个方向向小行星的中心挖掘。
site_command_center_intro.en:
A collision with a smaller asteroid has revealed a small blast door or airlock extending slightly from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It appears to be thousands of years old, and had previously been concealed by rocks and dust.

For unknown reasons, scans cannot penetrate the asteroid's interior and the blast door is impervious to conventional cutting tools. To learn what is behind this door, a team would likely have to dig their way towards the center of the asteroid from another direction.

site_cut_to_fit_intro.zh:
在我们迄今的探索中，[From.Planet.GetName]表面的情况完全没有先例。从山脉到整个大陆般广袤的地质区域突然被切割成各种几何形状，其规整程度远非自然形成所能及。原本自然的环境被突然破坏，变成完全平坦的平面、完美的三角形和尖锐的锥形。

目前，对这一令人困惑的现象的任何解释都只是纯粹的猜测。
site_cut_to_fit_intro.en:
The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is utterly without precedent in all our exploration to date. Vast geological areas, from mountain ranges to entire continents, are suddenly cut by shapes far too geometrically regular to be natural in origin. The otherwise natural-looking environments are suddenly broken by entirely flat planes, perfect triangles and sharply-angled corners.

At present, any explanation of this baffling phenomenon is pure conjecture.

site_dark_secret_intro.zh: 坐标指向[From.Planet.GetName]上的某处，但进一步的扫描没有发现任何异常。
site_dark_secret_intro.en: The coordinates point to an arbitrary spot down on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Closer scans indicate nothing out of the ordinary.

site_debris_belt_desc.zh: 我们对[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系的扫描显示，它的小行星带是一种非同寻常的类型。与通常组成这类结构的岩石、冰块加太空垃圾的大杂烩不同，它看起来像是许多大型的人造居住站所形成的残骸。这显然是在过去几千年内的某个时间被难以想象的暴力所摧毁的。这片残骸场中必然潜藏着许多不为人知的秘密，但由于体量巨大，进行测绘就需要花费挺长的时间。
site_debris_belt_desc.en: Our scans of the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system show that its asteroid belt is of an unusual variety. Instead of the standard mix of rocks, ice and space rubble that usually make up such formations, it seems to be the remains of a number of large, artificial habitats. These must have been destroyed with incredible violence sometime in the last few millennia. Untold secrets may be contained within the resulting debris field, but it is so extensive that charting it out could take quite some time.

site_deja_vu_dig_intro.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]扫描揭示了地底深处的一间人工密室——其用途和来源未知。放大后发现了一座从地表通往地下拱顶的挖掘井。

欲进行进一步的分析，需派遣一支探险队前往[From.Planet.GetName]的表面。
site_deja_vu_dig_intro.en:
Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] uncovered an artificial chamber deep beneath the surface - its purpose and origin unknown. Magnification revealed an excavated shaft leading from the surface to the subterranean vault.

Further analysis will require sending an expedition down to the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

site_deserted_mining_facility_desc.zh:
[from.Planet.GetName]的轨道影像显示了一座破败的采矿设施，周围还有许多被遗弃已久的原始太空货船。

除了这些影像外，我们的短波通讯阵列还拾获了一个来自行星地下深处的非常微弱的求救信号。对该遗址进行更详细的研究将揭示信号的起源。
site_deserted_mining_facility_desc.en:
Orbital imaging of [from.Planet.GetName] has flagged a dilapidated mining facility accompanied by long abandoned rudimentary space faring cargo vessels.

Alongside these images, our shortwave communications array has picked up a very faint distress beacon emanating deep below the planet's surface. A more detailed study of the site will reveal its origins.

site_ebb_and_flow_intro.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]行星的表面没有任何生命。然而，有迹象表明这里先前存在繁荣的生物圈，加之此处有趣的地壳活动，我们需要对其进行更深入的调查。
site_ebb_and_flow_intro.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is devoid of all life. However, there are indications of a previously thriving biosphere, and some interesting tectonic activity which may warrant a closer look.

site_echoes_inside_intro.zh:
来自[From.Planet.GetName]的探测读数显示，这颗星球曾经郁郁葱葱，被繁茂的植被所覆盖。然而现在一切皆为过往云烟，它只不过是一块荒芜光秃的巨岩。

虽然缺乏任何值得注意的构造运动，但使用感应器对这颗行星进行扫描之后，设备记录了下令人困惑的数据。数据表明，有东西正在在地下移动，绝对是一个“庞然大物”。这个发现值得我们进行深入调查。
site_echoes_inside_intro.en:
Readings from [From.Planet.GetName] reveal that it was once mostly covered in lush vegetation. Now the forlorn orb is little more than a barren rock.

Despite lacking any noteworthy tectonic activity, sensory scans of the planet have registered puzzling seismographic data. Something is moving underground, something big. This warrants further investigation.

site_engineered_species_desc.zh: [from.planet.GetName]乍一看是一颗普通的宜居行星，但我们的研究团队详细调查后发现了许多大型的化石矿藏，而且保存状况相当良好。有趣的是，一些大型的化石群在同一地层中包含许多物种，这表明要么它们是在同一时间死去，要么就是被人刻意这样安置的。对这些遗骸的检测让我们有机会进一步了解这颗行星上生活的物种的进化轨迹。
site_engineered_species_desc.en: [from.planet.GetName] appears to be a standard habitable planet, but on closer inspection, our research team has spotted large deposits of fossils in seemingly well-preserved conditions. Interestingly, larger clusters contain multiple specimens on the same layer, indicating that they either died at the same time or were placed there intentionally. Examination of these remains gives us the opportunity to better understand the evolutionary process of the species inhabiting this planet.

site_ex_gravitas_intro.zh: 一系列奇特的异常读数从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表源源不断地传来。我们需要启动一次地表探查以了解更多情报。
site_ex_gravitas_intro.en: A string of strange anomaly readings is emanating from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We need to launch a surface excursion to find out more.

site_fossilized_jellyfish_intro.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上的科学船已经探测到遍布这个海洋星球表面的圆形岛屿群。从地质的角度来看，它们非常不寻常：其表面看起来很自然，没有人造结构，但它们都呈圆形，且几乎是完美的圆。我们需要前往那里收集更多数据。
site_fossilized_jellyfish_intro.en: The Science Ship in orbit around [From.Planet.GetName] has detected clusters of small, round islands dotting the ocean planet. From a geological standpoint they are highly unusual: the surface appears natural, with no artificial constructions, yet they all appear to be circular in shape, nearly perfectly so. We will need to head down there to gather more data.

site_freighter_crash_intro.zh: [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的表面在受到一艘星际飞船的猛烈撞击后，凹陷出一个小峡谷。这艘飞船的残骸仍然可以在峡谷底部找到。虽然撞击肯定发生在亿万年前，但残骸似乎相当完好。派遣一支考古探险队将能了解更多信息。
site_freighter_crash_intro.en: A small canyon of sorts has been carved onto the surface of this [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon] by the violent impact of a starship. What remains of the vessel can still be found on the canyon floor. Although the crash must have occurred eons ago, the wreckage appears to be reasonably intact. An archaeological expedition would be able to learn more.

site_from_gateway_sent_intro.zh:
我们的科学家已经到达星门物体以不可置信的速度坠毁到[From.Planet.GetName]上的撞击地点。

毫无疑问，从撞击点的外表来看，这绝不是一次普通的坠毁着陆，我们的科学家期待进行进一步调查。
site_from_gateway_sent_intro.en:
Our scientist have reached the impact site of the object from the gateway that crashed into [From.Planet.GetName] at incredible speed.

It's clear from the look of the impact site that this was no ordinary crash landing, and our scientists are eager to investigate further.

site_fumongus_intro.zh:
我们在星球各地都发现了水的迹象。据我们所知，这些水应该还在这颗星球上。星球温度在液态水存在的正常范围内，并且星球仍然存在大气，尽管很脆弱。然而，这里的一切都是干燥的，存在的植被也枯死了。

此外，扫描还揭示了行星上另一个星际文明的踪迹。考古团队将有两个目标：找出水发生了什么，并了解其他星际旅者在这里做了什么。大多数假设已经将两者联系起来，团队中的一些人认为这可能是“偷水贼”干的。
site_fumongus_intro.en:
We have found signs of water all over this world. For all we know, it should still be here. The temperatures are within the normal range for liquid water to exist, and there is still an atmosphere, albeit tenuous. And yet, everything here is dry and what vegetation exists is parched.

In addition, scans have revealed traces of another spacefaring civilization on the planet. The archaeological team will have two goals: find out what happened to the water and understand what other spacefarers have been doing here. Most hypotheses are already linking the two and some in the team believe that this might have been the work of 'water thieves'.

site_georadiation_terraforming_desc.zh:
我们的传感器检测到一个从[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑深处发出的异常通讯信号。

震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
site_georadiation_terraforming_desc.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName].

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside this, our radiology equipment is detecting faint traces of gravitational radiation emanating from the site, posing more questions than it answers.

site_grand_herald_intro.zh: 即使不依靠仪器，也可以很容易地看到[From.Planet.GetName]上存在着庞大的城市集群遗迹。显然，曾有一个高度发达的文明居住在那里，但现在已检测不到生命迹象，也不能收到符合技术社会特征的电磁信号。这颗行星似乎陷入了死寂。我们需要着陆去了解更多情况。
site_grand_herald_intro.en: Even without instruments, one can readily see the remains of vast conurbations down on [From.Planet.GetName]. Clearly a highly advanced civilization once dwelt there, but today there are no life signs nor electromagnetic signals consistent with a technological society. The planet seems dead. We will have to go down there to find out more.

site_green_skies_intro.zh: 我们的扫描仪探测到该星球的一个区域不断发出一些有趣的信号。经分析，那里很有可能存在古代文明的遗迹正等着我们去发现。
site_green_skies_intro.en: Our scanners picked up a series of intriguing signals coming from this area of the planet. Based on their composition, it's highly likely there is a remnant of an ancient civilization waiting to be uncovered there.

site_hidden_lab_intro.zh: 探测器在[From.Planet.GetName]的冰雪之下探测到了一座隐藏的设施。部分坍塌与阻塞的隧道似乎组成了连接各种地下结构的巨大网络
site_hidden_lab_intro.en: Scanners detect a hidden complex buried beneath the ice and snow of [From.Planet.GetName]. A large network of partially-collapsed or blocked tunnels seems to connect the various underground structures.

site_hive_coral_intro.zh: 科学船在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上进行的扫描显示了其海面下有着奇怪的构造，海水以难以解释的方式在流动。虽然该星球天气相对平静，风暴很少，但海面下的水受一些未知力量的影响，不断翻涌和搅动。建议进行详细调查。
site_hive_coral_intro.en: Scans made by the Science Ship in orbit of [From.Planet.GetName] shows some strange formations beneath the waves, and inexplicable water currents. The weather is relatively placid and storms are rare, yet the planetary seas seem to constantly roil and churn, driven by some unknown force beneath the surface. A closer inspection is recommended.

site_hold_the_line_intro.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
site_hold_the_line_intro.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

site_hunting_ground_intro.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上的一个大而与世隔绝的山谷中一些不同物种的化石被发现了，这些物种似乎不是来自该行星的。它们大体上都来自同一个时期，大约是360万年前，跨度为几个世纪的那段时间内。

这些物种中的每一个个体似乎都是在其所属的独特的生物圈中进化而来的，而且它们似乎都具有智慧。奇怪的是，到目前为止发现的每一个化石都显示出遭到暴力终结的迹象。
site_hunting_ground_intro.en:
Fossilized remains from several different species that do not appear to have been indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] have been found in a large and secluded valley on the planet. They all date from roughly the same time period, within the span of a few centuries some 3.6 million years ago.

Each of these species seems to have evolved in its own unique biosphere, and all appear to have been sapient. Strangely, every fossilized individual found so far shows signs of having met a violent end.

site_ice_trauma_desc.zh: [from.planet.GetName]上辽阔的冰冻荒原曾一度遍布汪洋，水面之下处处是深海火山峡谷。尽管其环境已经无法继续支持生命，我们还是在一处靠近地表的冰封堑道内发现了一些年代久远的水下定居点。
site_ice_trauma_desc.en: The vast, frozen wastelands of [from.planet.GetName] were once seas, spread atop an abundance of deep volcanic canyons. Though the environment is no longer capable of supporting life, we have detected the ruins of ancient submarine settlements in icebound trenches close to the planet's surface.

site_in_memoriam_intro.zh: 显然，我们的神秘施恩者觉得地下结构是个很时髦的概念。
site_in_memoriam_intro.en: Underground structures are apparently a popular motif amongst our mysterious Benefactors.

site_krazura_desc.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上发现了一座古城的废墟。通过它的大小和规模发现它很可能是一个星际文明的首都或主要空间居住地。

为了了解这座废墟的起源，我们需要全面挖掘。
site_krazura_desc.en:
We've discovered the ruins of an ancient city on [From.Planet.GetName]. Given its size and scale, this was likely the capital or central administrative hub of a major space-faring civilization.

A full excavation will be necessary to properly determine its origin.

site_lesser_messenger_intro.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]详细的调查揭示了一些属于曾经遍布整个行星的文明的微弱信号。
site_lesser_messenger_intro.en: A closer look at [From.Planet.GetName] shows small signs of a civilization that once populated the planet.

site_lost_moments_intro.zh: 科研船检测到了一条从[From.Planet.GetName]发射出的怪异读数。
site_lost_moments_intro.en: The Science Ship has picked up a strange reading emanating from [From.Planet.GetName].

site_minigalaxy_1_intro.zh: 在这颗卫星上的一个大陨石坑内，可以找到一座大型基地建筑群的遗迹。它已经被遗弃了几千年之久。围绕着附近行星的能量屏障似乎是源于这个古老的基地正下方的一个能量源。
site_minigalaxy_1_intro.en: Ruins of a large base complex of some kind can be found inside a large crater on this moon. It must have been abandoned thousands of years ago. The energy barrier that encompasses the nearby planet appears to originate from a source directly beneath this ancient base.

site_minigalaxy_2_intro.zh: 这个古老的遗落星球已经被囚禁在一道无法穿透的能量屏障里大约有75000年之久。它曾经是一颗充满活力的都市星球，居住着数以亿计的居民，但现在街道和建筑物都被遗弃了，星球上的原初居民也都销声匿迹了。
site_minigalaxy_2_intro.en: This ancient Relic World was imprisoned behind an impenetrable energy barrier for roughly 75,000 years. It must once have been a vibrant ecumenopolis home to hundreds of billions of individuals, but the streets and buildings are deserted now. None of the planet's original inhabitants remain.

site_moon_bump_intro.zh: 即使用肉眼也很容易看出，[From.Planet.GetName]的地表上部分区域的地形极不规整。光滑的弧面上唐突地出现了一个巨大的球形凸起。也许在过去某一时刻，一颗卫星亦或是一颗巨大的小行星与这颗行星发生了碰撞，但碰撞的方式一定相当微妙，碰撞并未撕裂这颗行星，而仅仅是使不速之客寄宿在了行星地壳内部。
site_moon_bump_intro.en: Even with the naked eye it is easy to see something highly irregular in the shape of [From.Planet.GetName]. The smooth curvature of the surface is suddenly interrupted by a gigantic spherical bump. At some point a moon or large asteroid collided with the planet, but must have done so in a fairly delicate manner, merely lodging itself in the planet's crust rather than rending it asunder.

site_orbital_rain_intro.zh: 来自[From.Planet.GetName]的可见光传感器反馈的信号显示这个海洋星球的海床上有着极不寻常的构造。
site_orbital_rain_intro.en: The visual sensor feed from [From.Planet.GetName] shows formations in the seabed of this ocean world that are highly unusual.

site_percussive_maintenance_intro.zh: 一个与中子星非常接近的大型空间站正在发出奇怪的读数。尽管其当前位置稳定，但显示出相当大的损坏。焦痕的扩散表明它在过去曾被几次大爆炸所摧毁。
site_percussive_maintenance_intro.en: A large station orbiting in alarmingly close proximity to the neutron star is giving off strange readings. Although its current position is stable, it shows considerable wear and tear. A proliferation of scorch marks indicates that it was rocked by several large explosions in the past.

site_phoenix_collective_intro.zh: 我们的调查船扫描了[From.Planet.GetName]并探测到一些值得进一步观测的人造结构。令人不安的是，那里没有任何人口存在的迹象。
site_phoenix_collective_intro.en: Our survey ship has scanned [From.Planet.GetName] and detected some artificial structures worth a closer look. Unnervingly, there are no signs of any population down there.

site_popular_rock_intro.zh: 传感器在一簇小行星内检测到了能量读数。建议进行更深入的调查。
site_popular_rock_intro.en: Sensors have detected energy readings in a cluster of asteroids. Further investigation is recommended.

site_repowered_complex_intro.zh: 紧随着最近过境的$electric_storm$，在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表之下探测到了一场难以解释的能量骤增。进一步扫描发现了一座古老的地下复合体，其中的发电机被风暴重新激活，让这座设施又开始了运作。
site_repowered_complex_intro.en: Following the passing of a recent $electric_storm$, an unexplained power surge was detected beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Further scans revealed an aging subterranean complex whose power generators were reactivated by the storm, bringing the facility back online.

site_robot_debris_intro.zh: 这颗小行星的表面覆盖满了被其低重力束缚的机器人碎片。看起来它们都是由军事行动造成的。如果这些作战机器人没有被破坏到无法修复的话，本来是足够武装几只军队的。
site_robot_debris_intro.en: The entire surface of this small asteroid is covered in robot debris, trapped in its weak gravity field. All of it appears military in nature, and there are enough combat droids here to outfit several armies had they not be shattered beyond all repair.

site_ruined_reactors_desc.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]表面居高不下的辐射水平指向了一座破旧的反应堆复合体。这座孤零零的设施似乎废弃已久，有待调查。
site_ruined_reactors_desc.en: Elevated radiation levels on the surface of [from.Planet.GetName] were traced to a dilapidated reactor complex. The isolated facility appears inactive and warrants investigation.

site_ruined_starsystem_intro.zh: 显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？
site_ruined_starsystem_intro.en: [From.Planet.GetName] was clearly once home to a highly-advanced civilization; its six moons with orbits at equidistant intervals are evidence enough of that. However, the planet is in ruins and the entire star system shows signs of an extraordinarily violent struggle. What could have happened here?

site_shot_into_the_ground_intro.zh:
轨道遥测显示在[From.Planet.GetName]表面有一个巨大的坑洞。此坑洞并非陨石撞击坑，因为其深度令人咋舌，与直径完全不成比例。事实上，该坑洞的实际深度尚无法确定，因为坑道半路上就被岩屑堵塞，任何进一步的轨道扫描均被阻碍。

传统的开挖式考察看起来是确定坑洞下方究竟有何种物体的唯一途径。
site_shot_into_the_ground_intro.en:
Orbital telemetry shows a massive impact crater on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It was not caused by a meteorite strike, as the crater is surprisingly deep in proportion to its diameter. In fact, the actual depth cannot yet be determined, as the shaft is choked by rock debris part of the way down, blocking any further orbital scans.

It appears that a conventional excavation is the only way to find out what lies below.

site_sky_glow_hymn_intro.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的地表扫描结果表明了一种迹象：曾经可能有一个科技文明在这颗星球上活跃，但它现在已经灭绝了。我们需要组织一次地表考察以获得更多信息。
site_sky_glow_hymn_intro.en: Surface scans of [From.Planet.GetName] picked up signs that a technological civilization may have been active on the planet, but has since gone extinct. We will need to mount a surface expedition to learn more.

site_something_waiting_intro.zh: 此前发现的外星指示器指向了这颗行星，我们应该下到其表面进行进一步的调查。
site_something_waiting_intro.en: The previously discovered alien indicators are pointing at this planet, and we should go down on the surface and investigate further.

site_star_petal_intro.zh:
一座大型废弃空间站被困在这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部，向着巨行星内部缓慢下坠。其自重很可能在下一个千年里彻底毁坏这个空间站。

好在该空间站飘入大气层还不太深，我们仍有可能对其开展考古行动。
site_star_petal_intro.en:
A large derelict space station is trapped in a slow terminal orbit inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. The gravitational stresses will likely destroy it completely within the next thousand years.

It has not yet drifted deep enough into the atmosphere to make archaeological expeditions to the station impossible.

site_strange_flows_intro.zh:
一颗本应“正常”的熔岩星球，让科研船的传感器出现了无法控制的故障。

建议进行进一步研究。
site_strange_flows_intro.en:
What should be a "normal" molten planet is making the Science Ship's sensors glitch uncontrollably.

Further study is advised.

site_target_from_orbit_intro.zh: 从[From.Planet.GetName]的轨道上可以很容易地看到一座直径数千公里的人造建筑。形状表明在它的中间位置似乎有一片重要区域。从轨道上获得的探测数据显示没有任何异常，因此我们有必要进行进一步的探测。
site_target_from_orbit_intro.en: An artificial construct thousands of kilometers across is readily visible from [From.Planet.GetName]'s orbit. The shape seems to indicate a location of importance in the middle of it. Sensory readings from orbit indicate nothing out of the ordinary so closer inspection is warranted.

site_the_chosen_backstory_desc.zh: 一座环绕着[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]的废弃观测站。从中可以一窥在这个行星上的前超光速的$NAME_Charynoi$文明的起源。
site_the_chosen_backstory_desc.en: An abandoned observation outpost orbits [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]. It may shed some light on the origins of the pre-FTL $NAME_Charynoi$ civilization on the planet below.

site_the_last_stand_intro.zh: 扫描仪从轨道上读取的数据表明下方的行星上存在一个人工构造。但与以前的不同，该构造并未埋于地下。
site_the_last_stand_intro.en: Scanner readings from orbit indicate that there is a structure down on the planet. Unlike the previous ones, this one is not buried underground.

site_the_library_intro.zh: 一层厚厚的玻璃和金属覆盖在这颗原本贫瘠的行星上，或许暗示着它过去发生了某种灾难性事件。
site_the_library_intro.en: A thick layer of glass and metal covers this otherwise barren planet, perhaps hinting at some sort of cataclysmic event in its past.

site_tiyanki_graveyard_intro.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
site_tiyanki_graveyard_intro.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

site_tombworld_weapon_cache_desc.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]破碎地面的下方发现了一个大型加固贮藏室。考虑到在这样一个充满辐射的废土，还有其被埋葬的年份，我们很惊讶它居然完好无损。
site_tombworld_weapon_cache_desc.en: A large reinforced cache has been found underneath the broken ground of [From.Planet.GetName]. It's surprisingly intact considering the years it spent buried in a radioactive wasteland.

site_toxic_matrix_desc.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]的表面几乎完全被一些整齐排列的圆形小池塘覆盖。这种规整的网格表明它们可能是精心设计的而非自然形成。现场调查可能带来更多的解答。
site_toxic_matrix_desc.en: [from.Planet.GetName]'s surface is almost entirely covered by a lattice grid of small, circular, liquid-filled pools. Their neat alignment suggests deliberate engineering rather than natural formation. A field expedition may provide more answers.

site_transformation_intro.zh:
我们的科学家在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了一些奇怪的东西。作为一颗热带星球，其表面大片区域被茂密的丛林覆盖：巨大的、寿达千年的古树从林冠中突兀而起，它们枝叶茂密的树冠俯瞰着其他陆上景观。

初看起来，这些参天大树的分布似乎杂乱无章。然而，更详细的分析表明这些树的分布具有数学精准性，也许是由某个消失已久的文明所种植的。不仅如此，团队领袖相信，树木的分布方式可能包含着一组坐标，指向丛林深处某个未被探索的区域。
site_transformation_intro.en:
Our scientists have discovered something unusual on [From.Planet.GetName]. A tropical world, much of the planet's surface is covered with dense jungle: massive, thousand year old trees erupt from the canopy, their leafy crowns towering over the landscape.

At first glance, the distribution of these giants appears random. However, further analysis indicates that the trees are arranged with mathematical precision, and it seems likely they were planted by some long-vanished civilization. What's more, the team leader believes the distribution pattern may comprise a set of coordinates, one that points to an unexplored location deep within the jungle.

site_trench_world_intro.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]的整个表面如同伤疤般布满了又长又浅的运河。它们随意地交错穿插，布局上没有明显的逻辑。目前还不确定它们是否是一种不寻常的自然特征，又或是别的什么。

需要进行一次地面考察以查明更多的情况。
site_trench_world_intro.en:
The entire surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is scarred by long, shallow canals. They cross and re-cross each other haphazardly, with no apparent logic to their layout. It is as yet uncertain if they are an unusual natural feature, or something else.

A surface expedition is required to try to ascertain more.

site_warmer_climates_intro.zh: 从轨道中拍摄的[From.Planet.GetName]的影像清晰地展现了这个技术文明的基础设施。神秘的是，尽管庞大的城区被复杂的表面交通网络相连接，但这颗行星看起来似乎已完全废弃，没有任何尚存感性生物的迹象。此行星内核比大多数行星更活跃，但这里没有灾难性事件或其他任何足以直接解释这些人口失踪的原因的事件的迹象。他们都去哪里了呢？
site_warmer_climates_intro.en: Orbital imagery of [From.Planet.GetName] clearly shows the infrastructure of a technological civilization. Mysteriously, despite massive urban areas linked by an extensive surface transport network, the planet seems totally abandoned, with no signs of extant sentient life. The planet's core is more active than most, but there is no sign of any disastrous event or anything else that would immediately explain the missing population. Where did they all go?

site_weathermanipulators_CoordinatesA_Re.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了[From.Planet.GetName]。地表的废墟绵延无尽，显然这颗行星曾经拥有许多庞大的城市中心。这很可能是数百万年前因内特贸易体的公民居住的地方。为什么这些坐标要被安全地存储在一个风暴庇护所里仍需调查。
site_weathermanipulators_CoordinatesA_Re.en: One of the three coordinate sets found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName]. Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is likely where the citizens of the Inetian Traders would have lived, eons ago. Why these coordinates were securely stored in a storm shelter will need to be investigated.

site_weathermanipulators_CoordinatesB_In.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了[From.Planet.GetName]，这是因内特贸易体的一颗工业星球。从其上现存的建筑来看，这颗行星显然不是用来居住的。然而，我们仍不能确定其上的工厂究竟是用于生产什么的。
site_weathermanipulators_CoordinatesB_In.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName], an industrial world from the Inetian Traders' empire. Based on the existing architecture, this was clearly not a residential planet. However, it remains uncertain what exactly its industrial might was meant to produce.

site_weathermanipulators_CoordinatesC_Ba.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了[From.Planet.GetName]。它的地表除了积雪和灰尘以外几乎什么也没有，初步扫描发现这颗行星曾一度是宜居的。不知这颗已经化为废墟的行星在过去是否对因内特贸易体有重要意义呢？
site_weathermanipulators_CoordinatesC_Ba.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName]. The surface is little more than snow and dust, but initial scans show that the planet was once habitable. Was it important to the Inetian Traders before or after its ruin?

site_weathermanipulators_last_shelter_in.zh: 因内特贸易体试图保护这个恒星系中的一座小小的空间站不受星尘沙暴的影响。而这个风暴则始料未及地发育增强并且摧毁了许多其他的恒星系。为什么他们要如此费尽心机地保护这座设施呢？
site_weathermanipulators_last_shelter_in.en: The Inetian Traders tried to protect a space station within this system from a small celestial dust storm. As an unforeseen consequence, the storm grew so large several other of their systems were destroyed. Why were they so desperate to protect this facility?

site_weathermanipulators_storm_formation.zh: 在局部扰动抑制器的控制台中保存着一个数据信号。虽然有些难度，但我们能复制它的模式，并且在全星系中搜寻匹配。航迹引向了一颗不可宜居的星球。是时候弄明白因内特贸易体瞄准着什么，以及为什么瞄准了。
site_weathermanipulators_storm_formation.en: Saved within the command console of the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors was a data signal. Though difficult, we were able to clone its pattern and search the galaxy for a match. The trail led to an uninhabited planet. It is time to discover what the Inetian Traders were targeting, and why.

site_weathermanipulators_the_ancient_sto.zh: 在一颗被风暴毁灭的星球中埋葬于废墟之下的庇护所：外部的残破使其难以调查，但内部似乎还是完好的。
site_weathermanipulators_the_ancient_sto.en: A shelter buried under the debris of a storm-ravaged world; the devastation is making it hard to investigate, but the interior appears intact.

site_zarqlan_intro.zh:
这颗行星的地表上，一座古老的建筑物被隐藏在某种迷彩能量场之下。只是偶然观测到，一颗小行星在撞击时才揭示了它的存在，该小行星化为流星偏转了它的能量场。

在该能量场被关闭后，考古学家们现在可以去探索原本隐藏其下的，令人生畏的巨大建筑群了。
site_zarqlan_intro.en:
A chameleon energy field was concealing an ancient structure on the surface of this planet. Only a chance observation of an asteroid impact revealed its existence as the meteor deflected off the field.

With the field deactivated, archaeologists will now have access to the large and forbidding building complex hidden beneath it.

situation.10.A.zh: 隔离这片区域——谁都不允许进入！
situation.10.A.en: Cordon off the area - none may enter!

situation.10.B.zh: 或许我们终究还是要调查它。
situation.10.B.en: Perhaps we should investigate it after all.

situation.10.C.en: The labyrinth is dangerous. It must be destroyed.

situation.10.desc.zh:
看上去[Target.GetName]上的这个异星迷宫在试图吸引我们的注意。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]很不情愿将这么一个事物归为一栋建筑，但是恐怕我们只能这么认为：迷宫现在不再坐落于遥远的群山之中，而是距离我们的一个主要居住点很短的距离。一天接一天，它令人费解地变换着自己的位置，而且其入口的那个警告标志也消失了——事实上，它看上去好像……在邀请我们。

尽管有些好奇宝宝忍不住头铁进去了，我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]还是劝告谨慎对待。唯一清楚的是，我们不能再满足于从远处观察迷宫了——必须采取新的方案。
situation.10.desc.en:
It appears that the alien labyrinth on [Target.GetName] is attempting to attract our attention. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] are loath to ascribe such agency to a building, but that is the only way to put it: the labyrinth is now no longer situated in a remote mountain pass, but is now instead located a short distance from one of our main settlements. From one day to the next, it inexplicably shifted its location, and the warning signs at the entrance have disappeared - in fact, it now looks... inviting.

While some are curious to enter, our [Owner.GetResearchers] urge caution. What is clear, however, is that we can no longer content ourselves with observing the labyrinth - a new approach will be necessary.

situation.10.desc.gestalt.zh:
看上去[Target.GetName]上的这个异星迷宫在试图吸引我们的注意。尽管一栋建筑会有任何形式的意识这一点看上去很不可思议，但是恐怕我们只能这么认为：迷宫现在不再坐落于遥远的群山之中，而是距离我们的一个主要存储区域很短的距离。一天接一天，它令人费解地变换着自己的位置，而且其入口的那个警告标志也消失了——事实上，它看上去好像……在邀请我们。

这一改变的出现，会让我们阻止[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]闯入其中更加的困难，除非我们拉警戒线隔绝这片区域。
situation.10.desc.gestalt.en:
It appears that the alien labyrinth on [Target.GetName] is attempting to attract our attention. While it seems surprising that a building would possess any form of consciousness, that is the only way to put it: the labyrinth is now no longer situated in a remote mountain pass, but is now instead located a short distance from one of our main storage areas. From one day to the next, it inexplicably shifted its location, and the warning signs at the entrance have disappeared - in fact, it now looks... inviting.

This change will make it harder to prevent any [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] from stumbling into it, unless we make an effort to cordon off the area.

situation.1000.c.zh: 在[This.GetTrophyName]中，我们重新认识了自己。
situation.1000.c.en: In the [This.GetTrophyName], we have found ourselves.

situation.1000.desc.large.zh:
这一天终于来临。大量[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对[This.GetTrophyName]进行切实的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将整个意识集中在[Target.GetName]上，以消化吸收对这一令我们全神贯注的异常项目的研究。几个危险境地的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]因一时分神而受伤，甚至还有几个失踪了。我们对此无比痴迷。

在初步研究完成后，我们决定将其转移到到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。我们近乎虔诚地部署了这一研究任务，并持续分配一部分意识对其进行观测。
situation.1000.desc.large.en:
The day has arrived. A massive amount of [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us an exacting exploration of the [This.GetTrophyName]. As the study began, for a moment, our entire consciousness focused on [Target.GetName] to absorb the study of the anomalous item which preoccupied us so. Several [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] caught up in precarious situations were injured in the momentary distraction, and a few were even lost. So great was our fascination.

After the initial study was complete, we decided to move it to the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it. We placed it down, almost reverently, and continue to dedicate a part of our consciousness to the observation.

situation.1000.desc.small.zh:
这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对[This.GetTrophyName]进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在[Target.GetName]上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。然而，让我们将残余物拖到[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]以后发现，结果并不如我们希望的那么有趣。

就在这项进程开始之后不久，我们决定将研究转移到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。希望能从中有更多的发现。
situation.1000.desc.small.en:
The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the [This.GetTrophyName]. As the study, began a small portion of our consciousness focused on [Target.GetName] to absorb the study of the anomalous item. However, the revelations were not as interesting as we had hoped as we dragged the remains to the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat].

Shortly after the process began, we decided to move the study to the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it. Hopefully something more will come of it.

situation.1000.desc.standard.zh:
这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对[This.GetTrophyName]进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在[Target.GetName]上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。当天，整个[Owner.GetName]的产出率整整降低了0.2%。

探测数据被深深映在我们的意识当中，并转移到到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。
situation.1000.desc.standard.en:
The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the [This.GetTrophyName]. As the study began, a significant portion of our consciousness focused on [Target.GetName] to absorb the import of this anomalous item. Productivity in the [Owner.GetName] was reduced by a whole 0.2% for the day.

The sensory data was then archived deep in our consciousness before being placed in the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it.

situation.1005.a.zh: 又没人来看嚷嚷着办什么庆典啊？
situation.1005.a.en: If they won't to show up for it, why did they ask for a celebration?

situation.1005.b.en: Today was a good day for all [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

situation.1005.c.en: We stand united today, as one.

situation.1005.desc.large.zh: 今天，[Target.GetName]晴空万里令人心旷神怡，不过这是理所当然的，因为我们把大气调控系统已经满负荷开到爆了。在这伟大的一天，[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]上的每座城市的大街小巷都挤得满满当当，而更多的商旅飞船仍在不断地停泊进行星的轨道。盛大的游行逐一经过每一个定居点，迎接他们的是人山人海的街道和[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们热情的欢呼。我们帝国中每一座能够进行大型全息投影的城市也都挤满了观看盛大全息转播的观众。作为典礼的重中之重，[This.GetTrophyName]抵达了[Target.GetName]的首都，人们已经讨论起了将今天定为每年的[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]节日。在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
situation.1005.desc.large.en: The weather on [Target.GetName] was unnaturally great today, as it should have been, considering we ran our atmosphere control system on overdrive. Every city on the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat] reached its capacity, and there were still tourist ships orbiting the world just to be a part of this great day. The grand parade traveled through each settlement in turn, and was greeted by streets packed with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Every city capable of requisitioning a holo-display in our empire was also overflowing with spectators for the grand hologram rebroadcasts. As the centerpiece of the parade, the [This.GetTrophyName], reached [Target.GetName]'s capital, people were already talking about making today a yearly [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] inspired holiday. The [This.GetTrophyName] was then placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

situation.1005.desc.small.zh:
今天，[Target.GetName]首都的人群们迎来了阴沉的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的证明，漫步经过叽叽喳喳的围观者。这一过程在全帝国范围内广播，但反响极低，[This.GetTrophyName]似乎没有我们预想的那么令人感兴趣。

在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
situation.1005.desc.small.en:
An overcast day greeted the middling crowd on [Target.GetName]'s capital city today. The procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] ambled past the meandering onlookers. Its progress was broadcast throughout our empire, but engagement was low as the [This.GetTrophyName] did not seem to be quite as enticing as we had hoped.

After finishing the world tour, the [This.GetTrophyName] was placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

situation.1005.desc.standard.zh:
今天，[Target.GetName]首都的拥挤人群们迎来了阳光明媚的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的证明，四处环游逐一展览。游行的过程在全帝国范围内数十亿观众直播。[This.GetTrophyName]一时成为了[Owner.Species.GetAdj]文化的重要象征，激发着全[Owner.GetName]的艺术家和发明家们。

在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
situation.1005.desc.standard.en:
A bright day greeted the packed crowds on [Target.GetName] today as the procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] traveled around. The parade's progress was broadcast throughout our empire to billions of viewers. The [This.GetTrophyName] already seems to have become a staple of [Owner.Species.GetAdj] culture, inspiring artists and creators across [Owner.GetName].

After finishing the world tour, the [This.GetTrophyName] was placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

situation.1045.a.zh: 建造一个更好的容器，把獠牙带下来。
situation.1045.a.en: Construct a better container and bring the fang down.

situation.1045.b.zh: 这奇怪的反应可比[Owner.GetParadeStudy]好玩多了。
situation.1045.b.en: This reaction is much more interesting than any [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

situation.1045.b.tooltip.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以展开对反应的研究。
situation.1045.b.tooltip.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of studying the reaction.

situation.1045.c.en: Replace the fang with a replica.

situation.1045.c.tooltip.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
situation.1045.c.tooltip.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

situation.1045.desc.zh: 为了准备那个重要的日子，我们将一颗以太巨龙的獠牙转运到[Target.GetName]。把它们塞进货运飞船是一项极富挑战的工作，以太巨龙独特的生理构造似乎违背了物理法则。在进入[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]大气层时，獠牙对飞船发生了极其奇怪的反应：它在众目睽睽之下开始瓦解，要不是飞船快速应对，我们可能就会失去这一宝贵的物品。
situation.1045.desc.en: In preparation for the big day, we have transferred one of the Ether Drake's Fangs to [Target.GetName]. Getting them into the transport ship was a challenge, as the Ether Drake's unique biology does not seem to follow the laws of physics. The fang reacted particularly strangely to the transport ship entering the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat]'s atmosphere: it began unraveling before us, and if the transport ship hadn't responded quickly, we might have lost the coveted artifact.

situation.1050.a.zh: 让我们用裂爪龙之眼审视世界吧。
situation.1050.a.en: Let us see with the sight of The Shard!

situation.1050.a.tooltip.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以把这只眼睛用于其他用途。
situation.1050.a.tooltip.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of using the eye for a different purpose.

situation.1050.b.zh: 快把它抠下来，最后期限要到了！
situation.1050.b.en: Scrape it off, we have deadlines to reach.

situation.1050.c.zh: 小心地把它取下来，我们可不想有什么磕碰。
situation.1050.c.en: Very carefully remove it, we wouldn't want to damage it.

situation.1050.desc.zh:
摘取裂爪龙之眼是一项混乱不堪的工程，开始阶段错误百出。幸运的是，这只巨兽有许多只眼睛让我们逐一试错。我们将这只眼睛拖到了[Target.Solar_System.GetName]以后发生一件又奇妙又恶心的事情：这只眼睛迅速地黏住了当地的传感阵列，并将自己牢牢地嵌在上面，俯视着[Target.GetName]。事件的起因还在调查当中，但需要重申，这只巨龙的许多生理学知识仍是我们未知的。

眼睛还没有和恒星基地完全融为一体，但我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为如果我们想继续进行之前的计划，就必须阻止这个状况。
situation.1050.desc.en:
The extraction of the Shard's Eye was a messy process with a few false starts. Luckily, the behemoth had a lot of eyes for us to practice on. We then towed the optic to [Target.Solar_System.GetName], and something both fascinating and revolting happened: the oculus started attaching and integrating itself into the local sensor array overlooking [Target.GetName]. The cause of this is unknown, but then again, much of the Drake's physiology is beyond us.

The fusing is not complete yet, but our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it has to be halted now if we wish to proceed with our previous plans.

situation.1055.a.en: Attach it to the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat]'s power grid.

situation.1055.b.tooltip.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
situation.1055.b.tooltip.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

situation.1055.desc.zh:
无畏战舰反应堆在运抵[Target.GetName]之前一直是一个超级乖乖的货物，抵达后我们将其安置在一处仓库内以待那一天的到来。这下问题就来了：在无人照看的情况下，这台反应堆突然自己重启了。反应堆迸射出巨大的等离子电弧，整座仓库由内而外发出耀眼的光，整座建筑似乎很快就要被熔化了。

我们[Owner.GetScientistPlural]反应迅速，力挽狂澜，于是现在我们就有了一台运转中的反应堆了。
situation.1055.desc.en:
The Dreadnought's Reactor was a very well-behaved cargo until it arrived at [Target.GetName], where we placed it in a warehouse awaiting its big day. It was there the troubles began: while no one was looking, the reactor restarted itself. The warehouse was lit up from within as it spouted out huge arcs of plasma, threatening to melt down the entire building.

The quick actions of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] were just sufficient to save it in the nick of time, with the upshot that we now have an active reactor to do with as we please.

situation.1060.a.zh: 让围观者也一起尝尝这个！
situation.1060.a.en: Use this to feed the onlookers!

situation.1060.b.en: Let the reaction run its course.

situation.1060.desc.zh: 即便我们预警了外星污染的危险，但还是有东西搞砸了。族母的鞭毛运入[Target.GetName]首都时，它以某种方式接触了其中一个管运者，然后几乎是瞬间，它就发生了变化。这件战利品上长出了脉动的附肢，变成了一团搅动的肉质。慢慢地它逐渐细化，然后竟然长成了那个被接触的管运者的模样！似乎是族母的再生能力接纳了我们物种的基因，并开始产出更多的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
situation.1060.desc.en: Even with our xeno-contamination precautions, something went wrong. As the Matriarch's Flagella entered [Target.GetName]'s capital, it somehow got in contact with one of the handlers, and instantly, the flagella started reacting. Pulsating ripping appendages began growing from the Trophy, first forming an indistinct churning mass of flesh. Over time it became more detailed, and to our surprise, it assumed the shape of the unfortunate handler! It seems like the regenerative powers of the Matriarch have accepted the DNA of our kind and are now in the process of generating more [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

situation.1065.b.zh: 我们得在[Target.Solar_System.GetName]为他们设立一个栖息地。
situation.1065.b.en: We should set up a sanctuary for them in [Target.Solar_System.GetName].

situation.1065.b.tooltip.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以开辟一颗小行星让幼崽居住。
situation.1065.b.tooltip.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of giving an asteroid for the whelplings to inhabit.

situation.1065.c.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]还迎来了一群活体成员该有多好！
situation.1065.c.en: Imagine having live subjects for the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]!

situation.1065.d.zh: 警告性开火，把它们吓跑！
situation.1065.d.en: Fire some warning shots, drive them off!

situation.1065.desc.zh: 将天空龙羽翼带回家的时候，我们的货运飞船发现他们经过的超空间航道发生了二次扭曲。期限认为只是普通的异常现象而忽视了，直到飞船进入[Target.Solar_System.GetName]时才发现，有一团追逐着飞船的实体导致了超空间航道膨胀：一窝龙的幼崽热切追逐着我们的货运飞船，从中鱼贯而出进入我们的星系。他们应该是躲藏在跳跃点附近跟随者我们出来航道的。这些小龙似乎没有它们亲代的智力，而是漫无目的地跟随着我们——确切地说是跟随着羽翼。
situation.1065.desc.en: While carrying home the Sky Dragon's Plume, our transportation ship noticed that the hyperlane they traveled through had a second distortion beyond their ship. Initially disregarding this as just an anomaly, it was not apparent until the ship entered [Target.Solar_System.GetName] that a group of pursuing entities was causing the hyperlane-dilation: a clutch of dragon whelps exited into our system in hot pursuit of our transport ship. They must have lain in hiding near the jump point and followed our exit. The dragonlings do not seem to possess the mental faculties of their progenitor and seem to be aimlessly following us or, more particularly, the plume.

situation.1070.a.zh: 把它拆了用来造点东西。
situation.1070.a.en: Break it apart and use it for construction.

situation.1070.c.zh: 把压缩机丢回太空运转。
situation.1070.c.en: Return the Compactor to space and let it work.

situation.1070.c.tooltip.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以重新激活压缩机，在[Target.GetName]的轨道上制造$d_alloys_10$矿藏。
situation.1070.c.tooltip.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of reactivating the compactor and gaining a $d_alloys_10$ deposit in orbit of [Target.GetName].

situation.1070.desc.zh: 今天早晨，在[Target.GetName]上有个惊喜等着我们，拾荒机器人压缩机在我们的储存设施里吐出了最后一块它的作品。这一大块合金比我们所能想象所能产出的最致密的合金还要紧实，仅需数立方米就可以建造出一整艘战列舰。这一喜出望外的发展让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信他们有希望让压缩机以0.001%的功率重新运作。
situation.1070.desc.en: This morning, a surprise awaited us on [Target.GetName] as the Scavenger Bot's Compactor deposited the last of its creations in our storage facility. The large chunk of alloys was denser and more compact than anything we could ever hope to produce, containing enough metals in a few cubic meters to build an entire battleship. This fantastic development has our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believing that they can get the compactor working again at 0.001% efficiency, if we should wish it.

situation.1075.a.zh: 把里面的气体抽出来完成反应。
situation.1075.a.en: Extract the rest of the gas and let the reaction finish.

situation.1075.a.tooltip.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of infusing [Target.GetName]'s atmosphere with the $wraiths_energy_disperser$.

situation.1075.desc.zh:
