星际幽魂散发器囊这发出的斑驳光芒看起来格外引人注目，以至于让人差点没发现这个幽魂用来产生护盾的囊发生了泄露。在快速确认里面的化学物质不会导致[Target.GetName]生态系统崩溃之后，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]专注于分析这些气体对我们大气的影响。

似乎这些泄露的化学物质已经混入了我们大气的中间层，正在高效地散发其中凝聚的能量。如果我们继续散发其中的物质，它甚至可以有效地提高我们行星的防御能力。
situation.1075.desc.en:
The strobing lights of the Stellar Wraith's Disperser Sack were distracting to look upon, so distracting that it took a while to detect that the sack the Wraith used to generate its natural shield was leaking. After quickly confirming that exposure to the chemicals inside would not cause a total ecological collapse on [Target.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] focused on analyzing the effects the gas had on our atmosphere.

It seems like the emitted chemicals have fused with our mesosphere and disperse concentrated energies surprisingly well. So well that if we release the rest of the disperser's contents, there would be a noticeable increase in planetary defensiveness.

situation.1080.a.en: Return it to whence it came.

situation.1080.a.tooltip.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以保护[Target.GetName]上[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的安全和精神健康。
situation.1080.a.tooltip.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of protecting the safety and sanity of the [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Target.GetName].

situation.1080.b.en: No! We need to study this.

situation.1080.c.zh: 包好它，我不希望这个现象散布开去。
situation.1080.c.en: Contain it, we can't let this phenomenon spread.

situation.1080.d.zh: 它可以赐予我们神圣的智慧。
situation.1080.d.en: It could teach us of the Divine.

situation.1080.desc.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]向[Target.Solar_System.GetName]汇报了运输恐怖负相物质的货运飞船上的奇怪的现象。我们被包括通向纯粹苦痛与毁灭低语的世界窗口之类的恼人的幻想所袭扰。据信原因就是[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的团块，我们有理由担忧如果将船上的这玩意带到[Target.GetName]到底会发生什么。
situation.1080.desc.en: Our [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] have been reporting strange activity on the ship transporting the Horrific Inverse Mass to [Target.Solar_System.GetName]. Windows into worlds of pure pain and whispers of destruction are just a few of the disturbing accounts we have received. It's believed that the mass of the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] is to blame, and we might rightfully worry what would happen if we were to bring the ship's cargo to [Target.GetName].

situation.1085.a.en: The discoveries are worth the risk!

situation.1085.b.anathema.zh: 我们必须学会恶咒才能击败它。
situation.1085.b.anathema.en: We must know the Anathema to defeat it.

situation.1085.b.divine.zh: 我们需要见到真正的神圣视界。
situation.1085.b.divine.en: We need to see the true vision of the Divine.

situation.1085.c.en: No, the danger is too great.

situation.1085.desc.deify.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向一个纯粹邪恶世界的裂隙。任何窥视裂隙的人都会立刻陷入疯狂，直到数个小时之后才停止尖叫。我们的牧师们长年以来都在思考着我们所击败的这一实体的存在而一无所获，如今却说他们即将顿悟了。“再给我们点时间吧！”他们恳求，然而我们的科学家警告，如果再不加以控制，事态可能会变得不可收拾。
situation.1085.desc.deify.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed; the Horrific Inverse Mass on [This.GetName] has been tearing holes in our very reality into a world of pure evil. Anyone even glancing towards one of the rifts needs hours of solitude just to stop screaming. As our priests have been contemplating the very existence of the being we defeated for several years now without any great epiphany, they say that they are approaching one now. "We just need a bit more time!" They implore, while our scientist warn us that the process might be irreversible if we allow it to go on much further.

situation.1085.desc.study.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向另一个世界裂隙。这一现象突破了抑制措施，开始在[This.GetName]上蔓延。所有与这一维度接触的事物，哪怕是不经意地透过观测设备查看，都让进行观察的[Owner.GetTeamMember]感受到剧烈的痛苦。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]担忧事态还可能进一步扩大，但同时保证只要再花一点时间他们就能解开另一个维度的奥秘了。
situation.1085.desc.study.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed: the Horrific Inverse Mass on [This.GetName] has been tearing holes in our very reality, opening rifts into another world. The phenomenon has breached the containment procedures and now seems to be expanding into [This.GetName]'s capital. Any contact with the dimension, even inadvertently through the lens of observational devices, causes intense distress on the observing [Owner.GetTeamMember]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are worried that his can spread even further but also promise that with just a bit more time they can unlock the secrets of the other dimension.

situation.1090.a.zh: 我们做得太过头了，恐怕已经无力回天。
situation.1090.a.en: We have come too far to see it end now.

situation.1090.b.zh: 如果我们就此止步就是向恶咒认输！
situation.1090.b.en: If we stop now the Anathema wins!

situation.1090.c.en: Get rid of it, by any means necessary!

situation.1090.desc.deify.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们对这个纯粹痛苦的维度有了许多了解，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。几乎没有牧师敢保证自己能净化这团物质，但并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间裂口张开了。很快事态将会变得不可挽回。
situation.1090.desc.deify.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. [This.GetName] is being ripped apart from the inside as the Horrific Inverse Mass is still sequestered on it. While we have learned much about the dimension of pure pain, the strain on the world has been immense. Few priests still believe that they purify the mass, but there is a chance! As inhabitants of [This.GetName] board transport ships to leave the [This.GetPlanetHabitat], an innumerable amount of rifts are opening up. The point of no return is fast approaching.

situation.1090.desc.study.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在[This.GetName]上的恐怖负相物质仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们在研究其他维度时获得的科学突破是革命性的，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。尽管几乎没有[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有信心能控制住反应，但这并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间裂口张开了。很快事态将会变得不可挽回。
situation.1090.desc.study.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. [This.GetName] is being ripped apart from the inside as the Horrific Inverse Mass is still sequestered on it. While the breakthroughs we have had in the sciences from studying the other dimension are revolutionary, its strain on the world has been immense. Few [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe that they can still stabilize the reaction, but there is a chance! As inhabitants of [This.GetName] board transport ships to leave the [This.GetPlanetHabitat], an innumerable amount of rifts are opening up. The point of no return is fast approaching.

situation.1095.desc.zh: 晴空永远消失了，它不是被乌云荫蔽，而是被纯粹的虚空所笼罩。[This.GetName]所残存的只有漂浮在虚无之海的陆地碎片。所有来不及逃离[This.GetPlanetHabitat]的人在其上的每一刻都在承受着无上的痛苦。我们为专家们争取到了尽可能多的时间。一个扭曲而恼人的声音回响在行星的上空：“对寸——回—回归于我——吧。”
situation.1095.desc.en: The sky is gone. It's not covered by clouds. It has been replaced by a pure void. All that remains of [This.GetName] is patches of ground in the ocean of nothingness. Everyone left on the [This.GetPlanetHabitat] is suffering pure agony for every instant that passes. We have bought as much time as we could for our specialists. A distorted and disturbed voice echoes from the world beyond "YesS re-reTURN to mee-."

situation.1100.b.zh: 我们承担不起切割舱室的代价。
situation.1100.b.en: We can't risk despoiling the Chamber.

situation.1100.c.auth.zh: 我们可以用这个方法来关押罪大恶极之人。
situation.1100.c.auth.en: We could use this technology to contain our undesirables.

situation.1100.c.regular.zh: 把这个舱室做成一个密室逃脱游戏让游行参与者来玩。
situation.1100.c.regular.en: Set the structure up as a puzzle room for parade-goers to explore.

situation.1100.desc.zh: 在击败了神秘堡垒之后，它的一个舱段漂浮在太空中，我们决定将其带回[Target.Solar_System.GetName]，成为我们[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的一部分。一些[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在进入神秘堡垒舱室深处后都失踪了。自它运抵[Target.GetName]时，我们每天都派出[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]进入探索，但今天早些时候它内部的某些结构发生了变化。舱门自发地折叠消失了，只留下无尽的舱壁嘲笑着我们的工作人员们的狂怒。我们仍能与被困的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]取得联络，但我们目前没有想出能不破坏该结构为前提的营救方案。看来神秘堡垒还有最后一个未解之谜。
situation.1100.desc.en: After defeating the Enigmatic Fortress, a section of it was floating in space, so we decided to bring it to [Target.Solar_System.GetName] to be a part of our [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Several [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have gone missing inside the depths of the Chamber from the Fortress. Ever since it arrived on [Target.GetName], we have had [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] exploring it daily, yet something inside the structure shifted earlier today. Doors folded in on themselves, leaving only sheer walls for our agents to rail against. We can still communicate with the trapped [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but we have no clear idea of getting them out without damaging the structure. It seems that the Enigmatic Fortress had one last secret.

situation.1110.a.zh: 控制污染的扩散，保障[Owner.GetParadeStudy]继续进行。
situation.1110.a.en: Contain the spread but don't cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

situation.1110.a.tooltip.zh: 在污染清理干净之后再举办[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。
situation.1110.a.tooltip.en: Pause the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] until the contaminant is cleared up.

situation.1110.b.zh: 把污染物和那个毒腺一并清理出去！
situation.1110.b.en: Cleanse the world of the contaminant and the venom sack!

situation.1110.b.tooltip.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以尽快清理这颗星球。
situation.1110.b.tooltip.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of quickly cleaning the world.

situation.1110.desc.lithoid.zh: $situation.1110.desc.base$这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液对任何不慎接触的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]沉积岩皮来说都具有极强的腐蚀性。$situation.1110.desc.end$
situation.1110.desc.lithoid.en: $situation.1110.desc.base$ The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to be incredibly corrosive to any [Owner.GetSpeciesName] that got it on their sedimentary skin. $situation.1110.desc.end$

situation.1110.desc.machine.zh: $situation.1110.desc.base$这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液即时混进我们的冷却剂以后都是极具腐蚀性的。任何使用了这些受污染的冷却剂的单位都会立刻停止运转。$situation.1110.desc.end$
situation.1110.desc.machine.en: $situation.1110.desc.base$ The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to interact corrosively when exposed to our coolant. Any units using the contaminated coolant quickly stopped functioning. $situation.1110.desc.end$

situation.1110.desc.reg.zh: $situation.1110.desc.base$这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液对任何不慎摄入的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]来说都剧毒无比。$situation.1110.desc.end$
situation.1110.desc.reg.en: $situation.1110.desc.base$ The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to be incredibly toxic to any [Owner.GetSpeciesName] that has ingested it. $situation.1110.desc.end$

situation.1115.desc.zh: 在几个月的努力后，我们在[Target.GetName]上的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源终于移除了虚空孳孽污染变得清洁可用。这并不是徒劳一场，反之，我们在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]中学到了许多异星生理学的基本知识，并且已经准备好继续进行[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，只要[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的研究得出结果，他们就能以其提升[Target.GetName]的生活质量。
situation.1115.desc.en: After many months of effort, our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on [Target.GetName] is finally clear of the Voidspawn Contaminant. It was not a wasted effort, as we have learned much from the xeno-biology present in our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] and are now ready to proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] now think that they can improve life on [Target.GetName] with the these discoveries once the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] concludes.

situation.1120.a.zh: 归还卵鞘，并看看我们能做些什么。
situation.1120.a.en: Return the Egg Sac and see what can be done.

situation.1120.a.tooltip.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of attempting to reignite the [dead_stellarite.system.GetName] star.

situation.1120.b.en: No, we are bringing the Egg Sac to [Target.GetName].

situation.1120.desc.zh: 我们遗留在噬星者最终被击杀的地方的探测器汇报，那具遗骸的一部分开始和恒星融为一体。释放的能量增进了恒星活动，但我们的计算表明，由于移除了卵鞘，这仍不足以让[dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName]恒星系恢复原有的光明。如果我们让货运飞船返回，我们有希望可以重新点亮这颗恒星。
situation.1120.desc.en: The observation probes we had left behind at the site of the Stellar Devourer's final demise report that portions of the body have started to merge back into the star. The energy seems to have increased stellar activity, but with the removal of the Egg Sac, our calculations state that it won't be enough to restore the [dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName] system to its former luster. If we turn our transport ship back now, we could still potentially reignite the star.

situation.1125.desc.binary.zh: [Target.GetAdj]双星系统的光芒照耀着我们的货运飞船驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]。$situation.1125.desc.base$
situation.1125.desc.binary.en: The light of the [Target.GetAdj] twin stars shone down on our transport ship as it entered the [Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.$situation.1125.desc.base$

situation.1125.desc.regular.zh: 在踏出了驶向赐予[Target.capital_star.GetName]生命恒星的旅途的第一步之后，我们的货运飞船仍在继续挺进[Target.GetName]宇域。$situation.1125.desc.base$
situation.1125.desc.regular.en: After having finished the first leg of their journey to the life-giving [Target.capital_star.GetName] star, our transport ship ventures further into [Target.GetName] space.$situation.1125.desc.base$

situation.1125.desc.trinary.zh: 构成[Target.GetName]核心的星光三重奏照耀着我们的货运飞船的船体驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]星系。$situation.1125.desc.base$
situation.1125.desc.trinary.en: The trio of lights that form the heart of the [Target.GetName] glinted off our transport ship's hull as it entered the S[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.$situation.1125.desc.base$

situation.1130.desc.zh: 运载噬星者的货运飞船已经通过了恒星系的安全检查，其中使用的密码是此前由$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]所捕获的，这对顺利通行至关重要。我们的操作员已经开始将这些噬星者宝宝重新解冻以恢复其活动。货运飞船将再次瞄准恒星系的首要恒星，作为这次旅途的终点。
situation.1130.desc.en: Our Stellar Devourer transport has cleared the system's security check - the security codes that $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been gathering were crucial for passing into the system. Our operatives have started the heating procedure to get the baby Stellar Devourers moving. They will again aim for the system's primary star for the transport ship's final voyage.

situation.1135.desc.zh:
我们已经收到来自$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]的密电：一切就绪。我们的操作员已经开始弃船操作，只保留下核心船员。一旦舰船加速到最大的亚光速航速，他们也会在飞船撞击这个星系的首要恒星之前脱离，以确保我们不留下任何蛛丝马迹。

噬星者宝宝们已经开始躁动不安。如果我们再不快点执行操作，它们可能都要开始打起飞船燃料的主意了。
situation.1135.desc.en:
We have received word back from $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName]: everything is ready. Our operatives have already started abandoning the transport ship, leaving only a skeleton crew behind. Once the ship hits its maximum sublight speed, they too will escape just before the transport crashes into the system's primary star, ensuring we leave no evidence behind.

The Stellar Devourers have started to get quite agitated. If we don't commence the operation soon, they might make their way into the transport's fuel supply.

situation.1135.name.zh: 离开货运飞船，进入燃烧的等离子体
situation.1135.name.en: Out of the Transport Ship, Into the Burning Plasma

situation.1140.desc.zh:
我们干预行动的最后证据很快在恒星的日冕层熔化了。我们的传感器在撞击后的一瞬间焚毁，但这足以证明我们已经成功地感染了[From.target.capital_star.GetName]。

我们已经为这个恒星系写下了残酷而寒冷的终章。
situation.1140.desc.en:
The last proof of our tampering quickly melted inside the star's corona. Our sensors burned up moments after impact, but that was enough to confirm that we had successfully infested [From.target.capital_star.GetName].

We may just have doomed an entire solar system to a cruel, cold death.

situation.1145.desc.gestalt.zh:
$situation.1145.desc.base$

我们已经分派了更多的能量用于产热，并指示所有子个体凑成团簇一同行动以减少热量散失。我们一定能熬过去的。
situation.1145.desc.gestalt.en:
$situation.1145.desc.base$

We have allocated more energy to our heating budget and have instructed all drones to huddle closer to each other to preserve heat. We will endure this.

situation.1145.desc.regular.zh:
$situation.1145.desc.base$

[capital_scope.GetName]上的居民已经开始囤积核热毯，减少外出。希望我们能尽早回到温暖的日子。
situation.1145.desc.regular.en:
$situation.1145.desc.base$

Inhabitants of [capital_scope.GetName] have taken to stocking up on fission-powered blankets and minimizing trips outside. Hopefully, we will return to warmer times soon.

situation.1145.desc.wilderness.zh:
$situation.1145.desc.base$

尽管这场骚动触动了我们共同本能深处的恐惧，但鉴于我们知晓母星此前造成的破坏：我们将坚持下去。我们已分配更多能量用于供暖我们的庇护所，而我们的共生体们也将学会为了取暖而更加紧密地依偎在一起。
situation.1145.desc.wilderness.en:
$situation.1145.desc.base$

Though this disturbance strikes fear into the core of our shared instincts, knowing the damage our home star has wreaked before: we shall endure. We have allocated more energy for heating our sheltered dwellings, and our symbionts shall learn to huddle closer to each other for warmth.

situation.1150.a.zh: 查查到底发生了什么事！
situation.1150.a.en: Figure out what is going on!

situation.1150.desc.zh: [capital_star.GetName]内部的聚变反应持续低迷的时长前所未见。由于其辐照能量的骤减，[capital_scope.GetName]上已经发生了多种生态灾害，如果继续下去，我们可能将面临冰河时期。所有的空间站和定居点都遭遇到了相似的情况。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]确信一定有什么蹊跷，希望能研究[capital_star.GetName]。
situation.1150.desc.en: The fusion chain reaction inside of [capital_star.GetName] has now been on a steady downturn for an unprecedented amount of time. There are active ecological disasters on [capital_scope.GetName] due to the lowered radiation, and if this continues, we might be looking at an ice age. All stations and other places of residence in the system are suffering from similar issues. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] are sure that there is something abnormal afoot and desire to investigate [capital_star.GetName].

situation.1160.a.en: Well, get them out of there!

situation.1160.desc.zh: [capital_star.GetName]被微型噬星者感染了！我们不明白这些星神兽幼体到底是怎么跑到我们的恒星上的，明明它们不具有任何超光速能力。我们可以在未来对其进行研究，但当下我们最要紧的是研究如何停止它们的寄生，否则我们的整个首都就要被彻底冻死了。
situation.1160.desc.en: [capital_star.GetName] is infested with tiny Stellar Devourers! We have no clue how these neonate leviathans have managed to get to our star as they don't seem to possess any FTL capabilities. We can uncover all that later. For now, we need to discover a way to stop the parasites before our capital freezes over.

situation.1170.desc.knows.zh:
$situation.1170.desc.base$
我们推测这些噬星者很有可能是由[star_infesters.GetName]送到我们的恒星上的，现在我们要他们血债血偿。
situation.1170.desc.knows.en:
$situation.1170.desc.base$
We know that these Devourers were purposely introduced to our star by the [star_infesters.GetName] - and now they shall suffer.

situation.1170.desc.notknows.zh:
$situation.1170.desc.base$
很遗憾，究竟是什么把这些噬星者带到我们星系的仍不得而知。目前是灾后重建的时候了。
situation.1170.desc.notknows.en:
$situation.1170.desc.base$
Sadly, this freak occurrence that delivered the Stellar Devourers to our system will remain a mystery. For now, we must rebuild.

situation.15.A.en: We will have to redouble our efforts.

situation.15.A.tooltip.zh: 我们当前的方案将多花费每月£unity£10点凝聚力。
situation.15.A.tooltip.en: Our current Approach will now cost an additional £unity£ 10 Unity per month.

situation.15.desc.hive.zh:
$situation.15.desc.base$警告危险的标志已经消失了；现在，提供高质量[Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]营养膏的装置，神经舒缓体验，以及附肢替换件就在入口触手可得的地方。

$situation.15.desc.gestalt.base.end$
situation.15.desc.hive.en:
$situation.15.desc.base$ Gone is the sign warning of danger; now, devices offering [Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] high-quality nutrition, comforting neural vibes, and appendage replacements are in view just inside the entrance.

$situation.15.desc.gestalt.base.end$

situation.15.desc.human.zh:
$situation.15.desc.base$警告危险的标志已经消失了；现在，可爱的小猫咪在入口附近爬来爬去，一边喵喵叫祈求我们的关注。除此之外，不知怎的，入口里面视线的尽头，似乎显露出的是无边无际的沙滩以及无止尽的明媚阳光。

$situation.15.desc.base.end$
situation.15.desc.human.en:
$situation.15.desc.base$ Gone is the sign warning of danger; now, adorable kittens crawl around the entrance, mewing for attention, and somehow, the insides give the impression of vast beaches and unending sunrises just beyond sight.

$situation.15.desc.base.end$

situation.15.desc.machine.zh:
$situation.15.desc.base$警告危险的标志已经消失了；现在，提供高质量齿轮机油的装置，划痕去除服务，以及磁盘碎片快速清理援助就在入口触手可得的地方。

$situation.15.desc.gestalt.base.end$
situation.15.desc.machine.en:
$situation.15.desc.base$ Gone is the sign warning of danger; now, devices offering high-quality gear oil, scratch removal services, and rapid disk defragmentation aids are in view just inside the entrance.

$situation.15.desc.gestalt.base.end$

situation.15.desc.standard.zh:
$situation.15.desc.base$警告危险的标志已经消失了；现在，可爱的[Owner.Species.GetClass][Owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]在入口附近爬来爬去，祈求我们的关注。除此之外，不知怎的，入口里面视线的尽头，似乎显露出的是无边无际的沙滩以及无止尽的明媚阳光。

$situation.15.desc.base.end$
situation.15.desc.standard.en:
$situation.15.desc.base$ Gone is the sign warning of danger; now, adorable [Owner.Species.GetClass] [Owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] crawl around the entrance, begging for attention, and somehow, the insides give the impression of vast beaches and unending sunrises just beyond sight.

$situation.15.desc.base.end$

situation.150.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者汇报了一个奇怪的现象：在他们一个主要殖民定居点外，“雪”开始聚集起来。

好吧，“雪”只是他们用来描述这种物质的代名词。显而易见的是这肯定不是真正的雪，因为[Root.GetName]可是一颗沙漠星球，即使在两极地区温度也极少降到冰点以下。而且，也没有任何人目击到这些东西从天而降。不过，初步的扫描显示这种物质确实主要由冰冻的水构成，至于为什么不会融化仍不清楚。我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]希望能进一步研究它的性质，而另一些人则认为它会带来危险，并希望能把这些雪弄走。
situation.150.desc.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] report a strange phenomenon: snow has begun gathering outside of one of their main colonial settlements.

Well, "snow" is the term they have used to describe it, anyway. It would seem implausible that it is real snow, given that [Root.GetName] is a desert planet where temperatures are seldom below freezing, even in the polar regions. Besides, there were no sightings of it actually falling from the sky. Nevertheless, initial readings suggest that the substance does indeed consist mainly of frozen water - though quite why it's not melting is unclear. Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] are eager to investigate its properties, but others caution that it may be dangerous and want it removed.

situation.155.A.en: Best keep an eye on it.

situation.155.B.en: We must do away with this menace!

situation.155.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的“雪”增殖了起来。从起初的一小片突然爆发性增长，覆盖了越来越大面积的沙漠，现在已经到了影响交通和耕种系统的程度。大家越来越担心，如果雪不停止生长，殖民地很有可能会变得难以自持。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]在徒劳地寻找这种异象的解释。当从主体上分离开时，这些雪很快就熔化了，只留下了一点点有机残余物。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]将这些残余物解释为维系这些雪的整体性的原因，通过未知的化学过程，使雪不受外界热量影响。然而，他们也表明这只是目前为止最有可能的猜测，尽管仍在努力，但对这些奇怪的物质目前还知之甚少。
situation.155.desc.en:
The snow on [Target.GetName] has been multiplying. The initial small patch has swelled to cover an ever-expanding area of the desert, to the point that it is interfering with our transport and cultivation networks. If it does not stop growing soon, there are growing concerns that the colony will be unable to continue to support itself.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] on the planet have sought, in vain, to explain the phenomenon. When removed from the main body, the snow quickly melts, leaving behind only some organic matter. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] theorize that this residue is causing the snow to maintain its integrity, sheltering it from heat via an unknown chemical reaction. However, they caution that this is only their best guess, and they have managed to find out very little about the strange compound.

situation.160.A.tooltip.zh:
我们的移除行动现在每月将耗费£energy£15能量币。
态势将以双倍速度发展。
situation.160.A.tooltip.en:
Our removal efforts will now cost £energy£ 15 Energy a month.
The Situation will progress double as fast.

situation.160.C.zh: 我们当前的方案已经足够了。

situation.160.C.tooltip.zh: 我们的移除行动将只会产出+5行星稳定度。
situation.160.C.tooltip.en: Our removal efforts will now only yield +5 Planetary Stability.

situation.160.desc.zh:
这些“雪”似乎很抗拒被移除。尽管我们可以从其主体上取下小块使其融化，但这对阻止其势不可挡的增殖似乎收效甚微，而更激进的手段目前为止统统失败了——整个行动过程中围绕着一连串神秘的机械故障。

更糟糕的是，有越来越多的报告称，在受到“雪”影响的范围内有殖民者失踪。这些事件似乎是有所关联的，而这些雪可能是有生命，而且有恶意的。
situation.160.desc.en:
The snow, it appears, is resistant to being removed. While we are able to remove small parts of it from the main body and melt it in that manner, this has done little to halt its onward march, and more invasive attempts to destroy it have so far failed - a spate of mysterious mechanical failures has surrounded the entire effort.

What is worse, there have been increasing reports of colonists disappearing in areas affected by the snow. It seems likely that they are connected and the snow is alive - and malicious.

situation.165.A.zh: 我们得搞明白它到底想要怎么样。
situation.165.A.en: We must find out what it wants.

situation.165.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的雪正在以相当危险的速度增殖，现在已经覆盖了行星赤道附近相当不小的一片区域。我们的军事领袖警告道，如果我们想要阻止它的蔓延就需要采取激进手段。然而，另外一些人则认为目前为止这只是个无关痛痒的小麻烦，还不至于说是威胁，而且它也在避免直接占领已殖民的区域。他们认定这东西真的有生命，并认为我们需要寻求与之沟通对话。

不管怎么样，我们可以活动的空间已经越来越狭小了。
situation.165.desc.en:
The snow on [Target.GetName] is spreading at a quite alarming rate, and now covers a not-insignificant portion of the planet's equatorial areas. Our military leaders warn that drastic action is needed immediately if we are to halt its advance. However, more level heads point out that it has been a nuisance rather than a menace so far, and it has avoided directly occupying inhabited areas. They posit that it is clearly alive, and argue that we should seek to open dialog with it.

Either way, our room for maneuver is rapidly shrinking.

situation.165.tooltip.zh: 我们已无法改变态势解决方案。
situation.165.tooltip.en: We will no longer be able to change Situation Approach.

situation.170.A.tooltip.zh: 观测雪所消耗的花费增加至每月£unity£15凝聚力。
situation.170.A.tooltip.en: The cost of observing the snow increases to £unity£ 15 Unity a month.

situation.170.desc.zh: 我们收到了一些令人担忧的汇报，事关[Target.GetName]的“雪的问题”。似乎有数名殖民者在去“打雪仗”之后失踪了。与他们的联络已经中断了数日，而且我们已经无法找到任何他们的踪迹了，活不见人死不见尸。我们现在已经对当地殖民者通告，不要与这些雪有任何形式的接触，直到我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]找到更多的线索——或者找到那些失踪的人口。
situation.170.desc.en: We have heard concerning reports regarding the "snow problem" on [Target.GetName]. It appears that several of our colonists have gone missing, having set off to engage in a "snowball fight." Contact was lost with them several days ago, but we have been unable to find any trace of them - living or dead. Colonists are being advised to avoid all contact with the snow, until our [Owner.GetResearchers] can find out more about it - or the lost settlers are found.

situation.175.desc.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上雪的扩散对我们的殖民者而言已经不仅仅是什么新奇小事了，现在它还带了了一些困难。它对生态系统造成了剧烈的影响，许多当地的动植物种群承受了巨大的压力。目前从受影响地区已迁出了大量移民。然而出乎意料的是，有另一些物种在这种新的寒冷环境中欣欣向荣。我们的气候学家敦促对事态进展的关注，并称其为观察正在进行中的非[Owner.GetAdj]操控气候变化的“百年难得一遇”的好机会。
situation.175.desc.en: The spread of the snow on [Target.GetName] has not just been a source of novelty - and difficulty - for our colonists. It has also caused rapid changes to the ecosystem, with various native species of flora and fauna put under enormous strain. Already, there have been massive migrations away from the affected areas. However, to our surprise, certain other species have thrived in the new, colder conditions. Our climatologists eagerly observe the developments, calling it a "once in a lifetime" opportunity to watch rapid non-[Owner.GetAdj] controlled climate change in action.

situation.185.A.zh: 我们可以分享一些土地。

situation.185.B.tooltip.zh: 我们必须抗争以维持行星的控制权
situation.185.B.tooltip.en: We must fight to keep control of the planet

situation.185.desc.zh:
你们的出现给我们带来了智慧。我们通过进食你们的失踪个体学会了新的思考和生存方式。不过你们似乎想毁灭我们。我们还不清楚这个存在状态，这种智能到底意味着什么。我们希望可以在这颗星球的角落寻找到属于自己的一席之地，我们可以无拘无束地探索自身。

如果你们不允许我们这么做，那要注意我们并不打算放弃我们的新形态。在必要的情况下我们会保卫自己。
situation.185.desc.en:
Your presence has given us intelligence. We have fed off your Lost Ones to learn new ways of thinking, new ways of existing. We do not yet know what this state of being - this sapience - means. It is our wish to seclude ourselves to a corner of our planet, where we can have free rein to explore what it is to be us.

If you do not allow us this, be warned that we are not yet willing to give up our new existence. We will defend ourselves, if necessary.

situation.190.desc.zh: 我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]的控制，它被活雪夺走了！在[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]的生态系统中已经开始发生非常明显的变化。我们的[This.GetResearchers]提醒，除非我们能尽快夺回[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]，否则它的构造变化很快将使我们无法再继续居住。
situation.190.desc.en: We have lost control of [FromFrom.GetName] - which has been seized by the Living Snow! Already, significant changes are happening to the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s ecosystem. Our [This.GetResearchers] warn that, unless we can retake the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon], its makeup will soon be changed beyond our ability to inhabit it.

situation.190.tooltip.zh: 我们应该尽快夺回行星，否则就来不及了！
situation.190.tooltip.en: We should retake the planet, before it's too late!

situation.195.desc.zh: 随着活雪对[Root.GetName]控制权的巩固，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]也变得越来越冷，它的大气条件在越来越快地发生改变。可以说，这颗星球现在已经不可居住了。目前暂不清楚我们是否能够将其恢复到之前的状态……不过我们的[saved_owner.GetResearchers]确信，在这些雪发现了自身的新存在形态，并通过自身独特的化学反应将整个[Root.GetName]变得天翻地覆之后，我们可以通过研究这些雪的独特行为学会许多有趣的东西。
situation.195.desc.en: With the Living Snow consolidating its control over [Root.GetName], the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] has become ever colder, its atmospheric conditions changing at an ever-increasing rate. Now, the world can no longer be considered inhabitable. It is unclear whether we will ever be able to restore it to its former state... but our [saved_owner.GetResearchers] assure us that much of interest can be learned by observing the antics of the snow as it discovers its new state of being - and its unique chemical reactions which have wrought such change upon [Root.GetName].

situation.20.desc.zh: 迷宫已经不在了。从某一天开始，它就消失得无影无踪了。在原来的地址上，有一张小纸条留给了我们：“尽管我们的最初意图是使用我们的设施研究你们这个位面的生命体，你们禁欲式的拒绝进入也从另一方面给我们上了生动的一课。我们现在有了丰富的经验——它将成为我们研究经历中最有用的成果。作为我们善意的象征，我们在研究实验室中留下了一个微小的时空异常现象。我们希望它对于你们来说足够…有趣。”
situation.20.desc.en: The labyrinth is gone. From one day to the next, it simply disappeared. On its site, a message was left for us: "Although it was our intention to study the Beings of your Dimension within our facility, your obstinate refusal to enter despite all the temptations offered has been an education of its own. We are left enriched by the experience - it will prove most useful to our... endeavors. As a token of our goodwill, we leave you a minor space-time anomaly at the site of our laboratory. We hope it will prove... diverting, to you."
