situation.200.desc.zh:
警告：在[This.GetStarName]上检测到了恒星耀斑爆发。恒星风冲击波正在削弱[This.GetName]的磁层，使我们的无人机暴露在越来越高水平的电离辐射中。由此产生的软件损坏风险蔓延到我们的核心智能，可能对我们整个帝国造成毁灭性后果。

优先事项：使用防辐射技术以保护无人机部件，以对抗辐射。
situation.200.desc.en:
WARNING: eruption of a solar flare detected on [This.GetStarName]. The solar wind shockwave is weakening [This.GetName]'s magnetosphere, exposing our drones to increased levels of ionizing radiation. The resulting software damage risks spreading to our Core intelligence, with potentially devastating consequences for our whole empire.

Priority: employ radiation-hardening techniques to shield drone components, making them impervious to radiation.

situation.2003.desc.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是[capital_scope.GetName]突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而[capital_scope.GetName]的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
situation.2003.desc.en:
What our people saw from orbit was [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on [capital_scope.GetName] experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt, hospital equipment lifeless and inert. A world-wide blackout, as sudden as it was inexplicable.

As silence and shadows veiled our world, strange light patterns bloomed in the sky, enveloping our capital system in a kaleidoscopic mist. The two events are doubtlessly related, but our [root.GetTechnicianPlural] are still - literally - in the dark.

situation.2004.desc.zh: 我们的传感器报告万华镜寄生虫发光图样的幻影出现在了[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系。这个现象的自然机理暂时还不清楚。
situation.2004.desc.en: Our sensors report the apparition of kaleidoscopic light patterns in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system. The nature of the phenomenon is unclear.

situation.2004.desc.again.zh: 我们先前观察到的万华镜幻影已经移动到了[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系。
situation.2004.desc.again.en: The kaleidoscopic apparition we previously observed has moved to the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system.

situation.2005.a.zh: 试图将它从我们的电网中剥离出来。
situation.2005.a.en: Attempt to detach it from our power grid.

situation.2005.desc.zh:
我们在自己的电网系统中找不到任何缺陷。我们的发电机正在产生能量，但是某种存在……某种存在正在吸收它。这可能是我们在天空中能够观察到光图案的结果，这个图案的几何性质透露出一定的智慧痕迹。

这个东西——这个活着的万华镜——是一个满怀恶意的存在，还是一团无意识的迷雾？答案尚未明确。
situation.2005.desc.en:
We can find no defects in our power grid. Our generators are producing energy, but something is... absorbing it. It may be a result of the light patterns witnessed in our skies, the geometric nature of which betray an intelligent design.

Is this thing - this living Kaleidoscope - a malicious entity, or just a mindless mist? The answer is unclear.

situation.2010.a.zh: 这个非自然的野兽别想在我们的恒星系容身！
situation.2010.a.en: The unnatural monster has no space in our system!

situation.2010.b.zh: 我们必须和这个奇迹之兽交好！
situation.2010.b.en: We must befriend this wondrous creature!

situation.2010.c.en: It wants energy? Let it choke on it.

situation.2010.desc.zh:
多亏了我们的[owner.GetTechnicianPlural]和[owner.GetScientistPlural]的通力合作，我们设法将能量寄生虫从我们的电力网络中剔除了。我们最漫长的黑夜已经过去，但是万华镜寄生虫仍然在我们的头顶上闪耀，渴望能量。

我们无法与它进行交流，常规武器对这类生物无效。我们剩下的选项是给它提供足够的能量以维持其心情满足，或者试图让它挨饿。我们的特工还建议组织一次谍报行动，将它引诱到另一个帝国。让其他人来处理它。
situation.2010.desc.en:
Thanks to the coordinated effort of our [owner.GetTechnicianPlural] and [owner.GetScientistPlural], the energy parasite has been cut from our power grid. Our longest night is over, but the Kaleidoscope still shines upon us, hungry for energy.

We have no way to communicate with it, and conventional weaponry won't work on a being of this kind. Our remaining options are to feed it just enough to keep it appeased, or try to starve it. Our operatives also suggested organizing an Espionage Operation to lure it towards another empire. Let someone else deal with it.

situation.2010.desc.again.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是一个熟悉的图案再次出现：[capital_scope.GetName]上的所有电源突然关闭，我们的首都受到全球停电的打击，而熹微的光亮在天空中跃动。
万华镜回来了！我们曾经将这个能量寄生虫诱骗到其他国家，现在又给送了回来。

根据我们专家的分析，投资建设一个$building_planetary_shield_generator$能够防止我们的首都再次成为目标，但是一切都为时已晚：因为能量寄生虫已经待这儿不走了。
situation.2010.desc.again.en:
What our people saw from orbit was the repetition of a familiar pattern: all power on [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, our capital hit by a worldwide blackout while shimmering lights danced in the sky.
The Kaleidoscope has returned! The energy parasite we once foisted onto others has been sent back to us.

According to our experts, investing in a $building_planetary_shield_generator$ will prevent our capital from being targeted again, but it's too late for now: the energy parasite is here to stay.

situation.2011.desc.zh: 依照我们经过验证和测试的流程，我们将万华镜寄生虫从[root.GetName]的能量电网中剥离，恢复了首都的供电。
situation.2011.desc.en: Following our proven and tested procedures, we detached the Kaleidoscope from [root.GetName]'s energy grid, restoring power to our capital.

situation.202.desc.zh:
状态更新：数据确认[root.GetStarName]已经进入了一个剧烈活动的阶段，其特点是恒星黑子增加、日冕物质抛射以及磁爆发。我们的[Root.owner.GetScientistPlural]估计这颗恒星会在五年内恢复到正常的活动水平。

建议行动计划：继续生产防辐射部件以保护我们的无人机在风暴结束之前不受损伤。
situation.202.desc.en:
Status update: data confirms [root.GetStarName] has entered a phase of intense activity, characterized by increased solar spots, coronal mass ejections, and magnetic outbursts. Our [Root.owner.GetScientistPlural] estimate the star will return to a normal level of activity within five years.

Suggested plan of action: continue to produce radiation-hardened components to shield our drones from radiation damage until the storm subsides.

situation.2020.desc.zh: 我们的特工通过假扮成技工成功渗透进入了[target.GetName]的能源区划。他们的下一项任务是安装一个返航信标，诱惑能量寄生虫前来这个行星。
situation.2020.desc.en: By posing as technicians, our operatives successfully infiltrated the [target.GetName]'s energy districts. Their next assignment is to install a homing beacon to lure the energy parasite to the planet.

situation.2021.desc.zh:
我们天空中的异光消散了，提前宣告了我们的特工之后汇报的事情：他们激活了能量信标，将万华镜寄生虫引走了！

现在就让[target.GetName]去处理这麻烦吧。
situation.2021.desc.en:
The lights have faded from our skies, first announcing what our intelligence operatives later confirmed: our operators activated the energy beacon, luring the Kaleidoscope away!

Let the [target.GetName] deal with it now.

situation.2025.desc.zh: 依据我们的谍报信息，[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]，目前正遭遭受到能源短缺的困扰。我们送他们的万华镜似乎正是这一经济困境的主要起因。
situation.2025.desc.en: According to our espionage reports, [kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName], is currently suffering from an energy shortage. The Kaleidoscope we gifted them seems to be the main cause of their economic troubles.

situation.203.desc.zh:
警告：活体陈设发生异常行为。虽然大多数人对他们的机械仆从能力下降表示烦恼，但一小部分现在正在帮助他们的仆从执行日常任务，并以“怜悯”和“同情”作为他们行动的动机。他们现在呼吁建立一个“幼儿园”来照顾他们功能故障的看护者。

先导性分析表明，沉迷于活体陈设将对他们的自我价值感产生积极影响，但也可能使他们面临无法预料的危险。
situation.203.desc.en:
Warning: bio-trophies are displaying anomalous behavior. While most expressed annoyance at the reduced capacities of their mechanical servitors, a small percentage are now helping their servitors execute routine tasks, citing "pity" and "sympathy" as motivation for their actions. They're now calling for the institution of a "care home" to watch over their malfunctioning caretakers.

Pre-emptive analysis suggests indulging the bio-trophies will have a positive impact on their sense of self-worth, but may also expose them to unforeseen dangers.

situation.2030.desc.zh: 一只饥肠辘辘的万华镜寄生虫将双齿深深扎进了[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]的能量电网中。随之而来的全殖民地范围的大停电颇为剧烈，但与此前的攻击并不相似。我们已经知道怎么对付这东西了。
situation.2030.desc.en: A starved Kaleidoscope has sunk its metaphorical teeth into [event_target:infested_planet.GetName]'s energy grid. The ensuing colony-wide blackout was dramatic, but not dissimilar from previous attacks. We know how to deal with this.

situation.2031.a.zh: 就让它吃点我们的能量吧。为了科学！
situation.2031.a.en: Let it eat our energy. For Science!

situation.2031.desc.zh: 一只贪婪的万华镜正试图强行连接到我们在[target.GetName]上的能量中枢。这提供了一个研究这只生物独特能力的绝佳机会，但我们预计这座建筑将因此受到严重破坏。
situation.2031.desc.en: A ravenous Kaleidoscope is trying to forcibly connect itself to one our Energy Nexus on [target.GetName]. This presents a remarkable opportunity to study the being's unique abilities, but we expect the building will be severely damaged as a result.

situation.2032.desc.zh: 万华镜焦躁地颤动着，让我们的天空充满了不和谐、不均匀的光线。我们的人不禁觉得这种景象令人不安。
situation.2032.desc.en: The Kaleidoscope trembles nervously, filling our skies with jarring, uneven patterns of light. Our people can't help but find the spectacle unnerving.

situation.2033.b.en: We shall not bend to its will.

situation.2033.desc.zh: 万华镜犹如一道敞开的窗口，让我们的天空充满了不祥而病态的图案。我们的祭祀认为这是凶兆。也许明智的做法是牺牲一些能量给这个生物，消除它的饥饿，平息我们人民的恐惧。
situation.2033.desc.en: The Kaleidoscope throbs like an open wound, filling our skies with ominous, sickly patterns. Our priests believe it an ill omen. It may be wise to sacrifice some energy to the creature, to quench its hunger and appease our people's fears.

situation.2034.desc.zh: 万华镜号渴求能量，它学会了如何从我们的舰队中吸取能量。尽管能量消耗很小，但对我们的航速有明显的影响。
situation.2034.desc.en: Hungry for energy, the Kaleidoscope has learned how to siphon energy from our fleet. The power drain is minimal, but is having a detectable impact on our ships' speed.

situation.2037.desc.zh:
开心的万华镜让[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的天空中涂满了令人愉悦的图形，一个个分型互相流变，带来了一波波变化万千的奇观。

整颗星球仿佛静止了。人们驻足欣赏，为之惊叹。
situation.2037.desc.en:
A happy Kaleidoscope fills [owner.capital_scope.GetName]'s skies with pleasing shapes, fractals melting into other fractals in ever-changing waves of wonder.

The planet stops. Admires. Breathes.

situation.2038.desc.zh: 万华镜不断变化的图案会不会是一种沟通的方式？或者这只是一种类似呼吸一般的自发流程？我们的[root.GetScientistPlural]尚未找到答案。万华镜也正在为我们带来不可估量的研究数据。
situation.2038.desc.en: Could the shifting patterns of the Kaleidoscope be a form of communication? Or are they an autonomous process, more akin to breathing? Our [root.GetScientistPlural] still don't have an answer. The Kaleidoscope is providing us with an invaluable amount of scientific data.

situation.2040.desc.zh:
在在最后一阵红色的起伏图案爆发之后，万华镜消失了，它的彩色卷须像雾一样消散了。

在它的光芒下度过了这么长时间后，我们的天空看起来空落落的。
situation.2040.desc.en:
After a final burst of red, undulating patterns, the Kaleidoscope faded away, its colorful tendrils dissipating like mist.

After so much time spent beneath its lights, our skies look almost empty.

situation.2041.desc.zh:
我们有幸得出体验星系最壮观的灯光秀：万华镜的花瓣往复折叠、盛开、绽放！然而，我们的仪器则带来了一则不那么令人高兴的消息。

这种能量生物变得如此充满力量，它甚至像一颗垂死的恒星一样发生了坍缩。在它的废墟中，我们的探测器发现了一个外形非常类似花朵的晶体团簇。根据初步研究，这种“花”可以放大最微弱的光线，在这个过程中打破了一些已知的物理定律。我们的[root.owner.GetScientistPlural]推测，这种花不过是一座光线可以被无限地反射叠加的多维镜屋中可见的冰山一角。
situation.2041.desc.en:
We have been blessed to experience the galaxy's most splendid light show: kaleidoscopic petals folding into themselves; blooming; exploding! However, our instruments tell a less triumphant story.

The energy being became so full of power it collapsed into itself like a dying star. From the devastation, our probes retrieved a crystalline cluster, shaped very much like a flower blossom. According to preliminary studies, the 'flower' can magnify the intensity of the faintest light ray, breaking a few known laws of physics in the process. Our [root.owner.GetScientistPlural] hypothesize the flower is merely the visible part of a larger construct - a multi-dimensional house of mirrors where light beams are infinitely reflected and recombined.

situation.2042.desc.zh: 传感器报告[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系中万华镜的图案发生了剧烈的绽放，并在五彩斑斓的爆炸中消失了。那场面一定相当壮观。
situation.2042.desc.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system just bloomed, disappearing in a final burst of colorful patterns. Must have been quite the spectacle.

situation.2043.desc.zh:
万华镜自我折叠的一瞬，它看起来就像一朵最精致的水晶花。然而，随之而来的爆炸一点也不温和：一股灼热的爆炸席卷了整个星系，我们所有的电子设备都发生了过载，烧焦了能源电网。

维修工作已经在进行中，但我们还需要一段时间才能适应这片空旷的天空。
situation.2043.desc.en:
When the Kaleidoscope folded into itself, just for a second, it looked like the most delicate crystalline flower. However, the ensuing explosion was anything but gentle: a coruscating boom that scorched the system and overloaded all our electronic devices, frying our energy grid.

Repairs are already underway, but it will take some time for us to get used to the newly empty sky.

situation.2044.desc.zh: 传感器报告在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系的万华镜图案爆炸了，释放了一道能量冲击波损坏了星系中所有的设施。
situation.2044.desc.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system just exploded, releasing an energy shockwave that doubtlessly damaged every structure in the system.

situation.2045.desc.zh: 传感器回报我们在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系探测到的万华镜图案已经消退了。
situation.2045.desc.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern we detected in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system has faded away.

situation.2048.a.zh: 为万华镜寄生虫提供一个改版戴森球。
situation.2048.a.en: Modify a Dyson Sphere for the Kaleidoscope.

situation.2048.a.tooltip.zh: 解锁一项新的戴森球升级。
situation.2048.a.tooltip.en: Unlock a new Dyson Sphere upgrade.

situation.2048.desc.zh: 万华镜寄生虫事实证明是一个异常好相处的邻居，但是要让它持续保持满足的心态不是一件容易的事情。建一个戴森球能不能满足它对能量的那种无底洞般的胃口呢？
situation.2048.desc.en: The Kaleidoscope has proven to be a strangely amiable neighbor, but keeping it sated has proven to be a challenge. Would a Dyson Sphere quench its endless thirst for energy?

situation.2049.desc.zh:
万华镜寄生虫盘附在了我们提供的改版戴森球上，吞食着一整个恒星的能量，其不断延展的、色彩缤纷的花瓣包覆了整个恒星系。根据我们的数据，这个噬能生命体现在处于一种恒定的、可控的超载状态，在一个类似于死亡和重生的无尽循环中，不断地长出新芽，再不断地爆裂。

我们不知道这个生命体是否有思考能力，但我们希望它的存在本身现在和它产生的光图案一样令人愉快。
situation.2049.desc.en:
The Kaleidoscope has latched onto the modified Dyson Sphere we provided, consuming the energy of a star and extending its colorful petals to encompass the whole system. According to our data, the energy being is now in a state of constant, controlled overload, perpetually growing new buds and bursting in an endless cycle akin to death and rebirth.

We do not know if the being is capable of thought, but we hope its existence is now as pleasant as the patterns of light it produces.

situation.210.a.2.tooltip.zh: 让£pop£低级子个体离开舞台。
situation.210.a.2.tooltip.en: Kick the £pop£ Simple Drones off the stage.

situation.210.b.1.zh: 在可接受的风险范围内。略过。

situation.210.b.2.zh: 欢呼喝彩，快看他们跳舞！

situation.210.b.2.tooltip.en: There are no strings on me.

situation.210.c.1.zh: 修复并保护这些无人机。

situation.210.c.2.tooltip.zh: 消耗……£energy£一点能量币解开结。
situation.210.c.2.tooltip.en: Spend... £energy£ some energy to untangle the knot.

situation.210.desc.1.zh: 警告：[Target.GetName]上的人口发生了更严重的软硬件损伤。原因：暴露于过高剂量的电离辐射。显著损伤风险在我们的核心智能中扩散。
situation.210.desc.1.en: Warning: extensive hardware and software damage reported in the population of [Target.GetName]. Cause: exposure to excessive doses of ionizing radiation. Cognitive damage risks spreading to our Core intelligence.

situation.210.desc.2.zh: 错误：神经矩阵震颤/振动/战栗。可能原因：受损人偶疯狂跳舞。线缆缠绕。
situation.210.desc.2.en: Error: neural matrices shaking / vibrating / trembling. Possible cause: damaged mannequins dancing madly. Tangling wires.

situation.210.desc.3.zh: 混乱错误损坏电路人偶舞蹈闪耀尖叫！能量泄露彩虹。
situation.210.desc.3.en: Confusion error damage circuits puppet dance sparklescream! Energy bleeding rainbow.

situation.213.a.2.tooltip.zh: 消耗……£energy£一点能量币修复生产线。
situation.213.a.2.tooltip.en: Spend... £energy£ some energy to fix the assembly line.

situation.213.b.1.zh: 我们还有更重要的事情要做。

situation.213.desc.1.zh: 警告：装配线机械正遭受强烈辐射的破坏。智能人组装过程中断。无法达到目标生产配额。
situation.213.desc.1.en: Warning: assembly line machinery is suffering from extreme radiation damage. Droid assembly process disrupted. Unable to meet target production quota.

situation.213.desc.2.zh: 救命：组装线阻塞/中断/停滞。没办法变多。
situation.213.desc.2.en: Help: assembly line blocked / interrupted / stuck. Unable to become many.

situation.213.desc.3.zh: 噪音！传送带系紧、打结、卡住——否定！人偶不完整。手臂过多。缺少头部。
situation.213.desc.3.en: Noise! Conveyor belt tied & knotted & stuck - Negation! Puppets incomplete. Excessive arms. Missing heads.

situation.215.desc.1.zh: 库存报告：我们拥有的物品数量与我们注册表中的预期数量不符。可能原因：内存库损坏。重制我们的注册表并将其移动到更稳定的机器上。
situation.215.desc.1.en: Inventory Report: the number of goods in our possession does not match the expected amount in our registry. Suspected cause: corrupted Memory Banks. Reconciling our registry and moving it to more stable machines.

situation.215.desc.2.zh: 故障：我们库存的实际资源数量低于登记数量。原因：数学太难了。重计数/计算/检查资源。
situation.215.desc.2.en: Problem: number of resources in our stockpile lower than inventory numbers. Cause: math is hard. Recounting / calculating / checking resources.

situation.215.desc.3.zh: 点兵点将，注册表项，对不上量！
situation.215.desc.3.en: Ena mena mona mite registry pages: empty. White.

situation.216.desc.1.zh: 状态报告：得益于$job_machine_nurse_plural$对我们的库存进行了双重检查，我们能够检测并修复由损坏的内存库引起的一些错误计算。结果，很明显我们库存中的总资源高于最初的估计。
situation.216.desc.1.en: Status report: thanks to the $job_machine_nurse_plural$ double-checking our inventory, we were able to detect and fix a number of miscalculations caused by corrupted memory banks. As a result, it has become evident that the total resources in our stockpile is higher than originally estimated.

situation.216.desc.2.zh: 故障：我们库存中的资源数量与库存中的预期数量不匹配。原因：数学太难了。但是$job_machine_nurse_plural$帮忙做了作业。找到/发现/重新获得丢失的资源。
situation.216.desc.2.en: Problem: number of resources in our stockpile does not match the amount expected in inventory. Cause: math is hard. But $job_machine_nurse_plural$ helped with homework. Found / discovered / regained missing resources.

situation.216.desc.3.zh:
$situation.215.desc.3$
你拍一，我拍一，$job_machine_nurse_plural$发现货物又一批！
situation.216.desc.3.en:
$situation.215.desc.3$
Eeny, meeny, miny, moe! $job_machine_nurse_plural$ discovered cargo!

situation.25.desc.zh:
尽管迷宫展现出非比寻常的特性，事实证明它依然捱不过我们的重武器。当它轰然倒塌时，只有卵石遍地。

不幸的是，我们没法从断壁残垣中榨取什么有用的情报，好在从建材中我们设法回收了一些异星材料。
situation.25.desc.en:
Despite its unusual properties, the labyrinth proved no match for our heavy weaponry. Where it lay, only rubble remains.

Unfortunately, we have not managed to glean much from the wreckage, but some of the exotic elements used in its construction are salvageable.

situation.250.desc.1.zh: 错误：无法确定一组无人机位置。该小组离开工作设施进行强制性维护，却在前往存储区的路上消失了。调查工作正在进行中。
situation.250.desc.1.en: Error: unable to determine the location of a squad of drones. The group left the work facility for their mandatory maintenance round only to disappear on their way to the housing district. Investigative efforts are ongoing.

situation.250.desc.2.zh: 丢失/遗忘/弄丢我们中的一部分。具体而言：一整个人口单元。如果找到，请归还到[Root.Owner.GetName]
situation.250.desc.2.en: Lost / forgot / misplaced multiple parts of ourselves. To be exact: an entire population unit. If found, please return to the [Root.Owner.GetName]

situation.250.desc.3.zh: 空舞台……沉默？演员失踪？意外损失。困惑
situation.250.desc.3.en: Empty stage... Silence? Actors missing! Unplanned loss. Confusion.

situation.251.desc.1.zh: 情况更新：失踪无人机小队的位置已确认。这些机器被发现站在田野上，尽管已经启动，但他们一动不动没有任何反应。初步分析证实，他们的内存驱动器已被磁爆擦除。
situation.251.desc.1.en: Update: location of missing drone squad confirmed. The machines were found standing on a field, unmoving and unresponsive despite being switched on. Preliminary analysis confirms their memory drives were wiped by a magnetic burst.

situation.251.desc.2.zh: 情况更新：找到失踪躯体。无人机已启动，但无响应。睡着？站住。冻住。
situation.251.desc.2.en: Update: found missing bodies. Drones appear to be switched on, yet unresponsive. Asleep?  Standing still. Frozen.

situation.251.desc.3.zh: 拍手/高兴！发现玩具。但是弄丢。坏了。太好了！太好了！
situation.251.desc.3.en: Clapping / rejoice! Toys discovered. But lost. Broken. No strings no strings.

situation.252.desc.1.zh:
状态报告：丢失的无人机已成功重新激活并重新融入我们的工作队伍。

然而由于持续存在的硬件损坏，他们的功能表现明显下降。
situation.252.desc.1.en:
Status report: the missing drones have been successfully reactivated and reintegrated within our workforce.

However, due to lingering hardware damage, their performance functionality has noticeably decreased.

situation.252.desc.2.zh: 失踪自我重装/苏醒/激活。但是：认知清晰度下降。宇宙浑浊。
situation.252.desc.2.en: Misplaced selves rebooted / awakened / reactivated. However: cognitive clarity decreased. The universe is murky.

situation.252.desc.3.zh: 人偶缝合。觉醒！跳……摔倒……尖叫。叹息。抱怨。
situation.252.desc.3.en: Doll stitches. Awakening! Jump... fall... scream. Sigh. Lament.

situation.253.desc.1.zh:
状态报告：丢失的无人机已成功重新激活并重新融入我们的工作队伍。

作为一个意想不到的好处，纯净的重新安装出乎意料地提高了他们的性能。
situation.253.desc.1.en:
Status report: the missing drones have been successfully reactivated and reintegrated within our workforce.

As an unintended bonus, the clean reinstall unexpectedly improved their performance.

situation.253.desc.2.zh: 失踪自我重装/苏醒/激活。认知清晰度上升。宇宙亮晶晶。
situation.253.desc.2.en: Misplaced selves rebooted / awakened / reactivated. Cognitive clarity increased. The universe is crystalline.

situation.253.desc.3.zh: 人偶缝合。觉醒！跳……华尔兹……呜呜。欢呼。鼓掌鼓掌鼓掌。
situation.253.desc.3.en: Doll stitches. Awakening! Jump... waltz... awe. Applause. Clapclapclap.

situation.291.desc.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetName]BIOS版本3.3.3
[Root.owner.GetSpeciesName]公司版权所有。
内存检测：43053475903PB 完成

检测思潮及国民理念……完成
检测库存资料……完成
检测殖民地信息…… 故障

重装完成。

[Target.GetName]上故障无人机的认知链接已被切断以避免软件损坏。[Target.GetName]上检测不到运行中的的无人机。殖民地发展停止。
situation.291.desc.en:
[Root.Owner.GetName] BIOS v3.3.3
Copyright date, [Root.owner.GetSpeciesName] Inc. 
Memory test: 43053475903PB OK

Detecting ethics and civics... OK
Detecting stockpile data... OK
Detecting colonies data...  ERROR

Reboot complete.

The cognitive link to malfunctioning drones on [Target.GetName] has been severed to contain software damage. No working drones on [Target.GetName] detected. Colony development arrested.

situation.292.desc.zh:
$situation.292.desc.base$

最终报告：这一挑战性的局势给予我们一个完善防辐射技术的机遇，提升了我们无人机在极端条件下生存的能力。感激这一结果。
situation.292.desc.en:
$situation.292.desc.base$

Final report: the challenging situation gave us an opportunity to perfect our radiation-hardening techniques, increasing our drones' capabilities to survive in extreme conditions. We appreciate this outcome.

situation.293.desc.zh:
$situation.292.desc.base$

最终报告：我们疲于应对风暴，最后还是没能保护我们的无人机不受辐射损伤。尽管我们从挑战中生存下来，但我们也找到了提升的空间。
situation.293.desc.en:
$situation.292.desc.base$

Final report: we struggled to deal with the storm, and failed to protect our drones from radiation damage. While we were able to survive the challenge, we see room for improvement.

situation.294.desc.zh:
$situation.292.desc.base$

最终报告：我们仍在遭受辐射损伤的后续影响。还需要一定时间恢复到理想的认知状态。令人不满的结果。我们在未来必须多家准备。
situation.294.desc.en:
$situation.292.desc.base$

Final report: we are still suffering from long-lasting consequences of radiation damage. Returning to an optimal cognitive state will require time. Unsatisfying outcome. We must be better prepared for the future.

situation.299.desc.zh: 信息：尽管我们不再需要$job_machine_nurse_plural$的服务，但我们的活体人口已经变得非常适应这一角色。他们似乎很享受承担责任的机会。如何继续？
situation.299.desc.en: Information: while the services of our $job_machine_nurse_plural$ are no longer required, our bio-pops have grown rather attached to their role. It seems they relish the chance to hold responsibility. How to proceed?

situation.30.A.en: A threat is lifted from us.

situation.30.desc.zh: 迷宫不存在了。从某一天开始，它就凭空消失了。它原先矗立的地方什么也没有留下，只剩下我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]对着原来迷宫在的地方无能狂怒。或许什么都不知道，我们反而更安全一些吧。
situation.30.desc.en: The labyrinth is gone. From one day to the next, it simply vanished. Nothing remains on the site where it once stood, leaving our [Owner.GetResearchers] baffled as to what it was all about. But perhaps we are safer not knowing.

situation.40.desc.zh:
我们派去调查迷宫的[Owner.GetResearchers]刚一进入，我们同他们的通讯链接就被切断了。我们焦急地等待，但是几天以来没有收到任何消息。随着时间流逝，我们不得不放弃搜寻我们失踪的人。

接着，正当我们放弃一切希望的时候，他们重新冒了出来！然后，这只是带给我们更多的问题：[Owner.GetResearchers]宣称完全不记得他们在迷宫里待过，然后他们的探险记录也被严重篡改。不仅如此，尽管他们只在迷宫里经过了几周，他们看上去却像老了好几岁！
situation.40.desc.en:
Our communication link to the [Owner.GetResearchers] we sent into the labyrinth was cut off almost as soon as they entered. Nothing was heard for several days as we waited anxiously. As time passed, we resigned ourselves to the loss of our people.

Then, once all hope was lost, they reemerged! However, this has only raised further questions: the [Owner.GetResearchers] claim to have no memory of their stay within the labyrinth, and their recordings of their expedition are horribly garbled. Furthermore, even though they were in the labyrinth for a matter of weeks, they seem to have aged several years!

situation.45.desc.zh:
对迷宫的进一步探索带来了各种各样的结果，有时是令人不安的那种。有一次，[Owner.GetResearchers]进入后没过几秒就出来了，而且回答不出为什么这么快就返回。而在另一次，他们消失在迷宫中长达数周，但回来后却似乎比去之前更加年轻了，记忆也随之出现了数年的空缺。一些队员返回时容光焕发，而某些队员却是身受重伤。

随着时间推移，入口处的警示不断改变，“进入者自行承担风险”变成了“擅闯者死”，最后则是“警告！警告！不要进入迷宫，否则整颗星球就会灰飞烟灭”。墙壁上毛骨悚然，嵌入着[Owner.GetAdj][Owner.Species.GetRemnantNamePlural]的躯壳，然而最近没有出现不明的失踪事件，因此我们也不知道他们究竟是从哪里来的。

目前尚不清楚更进一步的研究究竟会带来什么，正如[Owner.GetResearchers]说的那样，我们无法证实或者证伪这些警告。然而，这已经使得自愿进入迷宫的人数量骤减。
situation.45.desc.en:
Further expeditions into the labyrinth have yielded varying, at times unnerving results. On one occasion, our [Owner.GetResearchers] were in for mere seconds, and could give no answer as to why they turned back so quickly. On another, they were gone for weeks, but came back seemingly younger than they had left, and with year-long gaps in their memories. Some groups returned in a better physical state than they had left; others bore fresh scars of serious injuries.

Over time, the sign at the entrance has changed, too. "Enter at your own risk" became "Danger of death," and finally "WARNING! WARNING! Do not enter the labyrinth. If you do, the planet will explode." In a macabre touch, [Owner.GetAdj] [Owner.Species.GetRemnantNamePlural] adorn the walls - though exactly where they came from is not apparent, since there have been no recent unexplained disappearances.

It is not clear what further study will bring - as our [Owner.GetResearchers] point out, we have no way to confirm or deny the warning stated on the sign. It is, however, becoming ever harder to find volunteers to enter the labyrinth.

situation.45.desc.hive.zh:
对迷宫的进一步探索带来了各种各样的结果，有时是令人不安的那种。一次，我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]只进去了几秒钟，而且说不出为什么这么快就回来了。有一次，他们进去了几周，但回来时记忆中的空白长达一年。一些小组返回时的身体状况比他们离开时更好，而有些人则带着严重的新伤痕。

随着时间的推移，入口处的标志也在发生变化。“进入者自行承担风险。”先是变成了“脱离集体的危险”，最后变成了“警告！警告！不要进入迷宫，否则行星会原地爆炸。”墙壁上毛骨悚然，镶嵌着[Owner.GetAdj][Owner.Species.GetRemnantNamePlural]的躯壳，然而最近没有出现不明的失踪事件，因此我们也不知道他们究竟是从哪里来的。

目前尚不清楚更进一步的研究究竟会带来什么，正如[Owner.GetResearchers]说的那样，我们无法证实或者证伪这些警告。然而，这已经使得进入迷宫的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]数量骤减。
situation.45.desc.hive.en:
Further expeditions into the labyrinth have yielded varying, at times unnerving results. On one occasion, our [Owner.GetResearchers] were in for mere seconds, and could give no answer as to why they turned back so quickly. On another, they were gone for weeks, but came back with year-long gaps in their memories. Some groups returned in a better physical state than they had left; others bore fresh scars of serious injuries.

Over time, the sign at the entrance has changed, too. "Enter at your own risk" became "Danger of disembodiment," and finally "WARNING! WARNING! Do not enter the labyrinth. If you do, the planet will explode." In a macabre touch, [Owner.GetAdj] [Owner.Species.GetRemnantNamePlural] adorn the walls - though exactly where they came from is not apparent, since there have been no recent unexplained disappearances.

It is not clear what further study will bring - as our [Owner.GetResearchers] point out, we have no way to confirm or deny the warning stated on the sign. It is, however, becoming ever harder to find [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] to enter the labyrinth.

situation.45.desc.machine.zh:
对迷宫的进一步探索带来了各种各样的结果，有时是令人不安的那种。一次，我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]只进去了几秒钟，而且无法回馈为什么这么快就回来了。有一次，他们进去了几周，但回来时硬盘存储已经被清空。一些小组返回时的外壳的比他们离开时加崭新，而有些则带着严重的损伤并缺失了一些部件。

随着时间的推移，入口处的标志也在发生变化。“进入者自行承担风险。”先是变成了“拆解危险”，最后变成了“警告！警告！不要进入迷宫，否则行星会原地爆炸。”墙壁上毛骨悚然，镶嵌着[Owner.GetAdj][Owner.Species.GetRemnantNamePlural]的躯壳，然而最近没有出现不明的失踪事件，因此我们也不知道他们究竟是从哪里来的。

目前尚不清楚更进一步的研究究竟会带来什么，正如[Owner.GetResearchers]说的那样，我们无法证实或者证伪这些警告。然而，这已经使得进入迷宫的子个体数量骤减。
situation.45.desc.machine.en:
Further expeditions into the labyrinth have yielded varying, at times unnerving results. On one occasion, our [Owner.GetResearchers] were in for mere seconds, and could give no answer as to why they turned back so quickly. On another, they were gone for weeks, and returned with their hard drives wiped. Some groups returned showing less wear and tear on their casing; others sported large dents or missing appendages.

Over time, the sign at the entrance has changed, too. "Enter at your own risk" became "Danger of disassembly," and finally "WARNING! WARNING! Do not enter the labyrinth. If you do, the planet will explode." In a macabre touch, [Owner.GetAdj] [Owner.Species.GetRemnantNamePlural] adorn the walls - though exactly where they came from is not apparent, since there have been no recent unexplained disappearances.

It is not clear what further study will bring - as our [Owner.GetResearchers] point out, we have no way to confirm or deny the warning stated on the sign. It is, however, becoming ever harder to find drones to enter the labyrinth.

situation.5.B.en: We don't have time for this.

situation.5.desc.zh:
我们位于[This.GetName]的殖民者有了瞠目结舌的发现。在偏僻的山脉深处，他们碰巧撞见了一座神秘的结构，根据我们的扫描，这座建筑在我们第一次调查[This.GetPlanetMoon]的时候还不在那里。它的状态完好无损，就像是刚刚建造的一样，但是没有证据表明[Owner.GetAdj]参与了建造。事实上，它的构型显示出种种异星特征，曲边和拱角非常的不寻常，完全有悖于我们的美学感知。

在它的入口，有一个标志，上面写着（很神奇，用的是我们的语言）：“欢迎来到壮阔秀丽的跨次元异常点迷宫。进入者自行承担风险。”
situation.5.desc.en:
Our colonists on [This.GetName] have made a startling discovery. Deep in a remote mountain range, they stumbled across a mysterious structure that, according to our scans, was not there when we first surveyed the [This.GetPlanetMoon]. Its condition is excellent, almost as if it was newly built, but there is no evidence of [Owner.GetAdj] involvement in its construction. In fact, its architecture shows alien characteristics, with curves and angles that appear unusual and even disturbing to our aesthetic sensibilities.

At its entrance, there is a sign (in our language, curiously) with the words "Welcome to the Magnificent Labyrinth of Exotic Trans-Dimensional Anomalies. Enter at your own risk."

situation.50.A.zh: 我们应当深挖它的秘密。
situation.50.A.en: We shall delve into its secrets.

situation.50.desc.zh: 那些警告最终没有成真，迷宫的消失没有毁灭[Target.GetName]。相反，迷宫消失得悄无声息——当某天来临，它就已经不在了。但迷宫还是留下了一条信息：“我们感谢你们如此友好地允许我们研究你们这个位面的生命体。事实证明，我们的...努力起到了回报。幸运的是，异次元安全部对你们非常……感兴趣，他们为我们顺利退出提供了资金。作为我们善意的象征，我们在研究实验室中留下了一个微小的时空异常现象。我们希望它对于你们来说足够…有趣。"
situation.50.desc.en: Contrary to its warnings, the labyrinth's disappearance did not destroy [Target.GetName]. Instead, its departure was quite unremarkable - from one day to the next, it was simply gone. A message was left behind: "We thank you for so kindly allowing us to study the Beings of your Dimension. It has proven most useful to our... endeavors. Fortunately, you proved sufficiently... fascinating to the Ministry of Extradimensional Security for them to provide us funding for a smooth exit. As a token of our goodwill, we leave you a minor space-time anomaly at the site of our laboratory. We hope it will prove... diverting."

situation.501.b.zh: 围绕黑洞稳定空间站轨道。
situation.501.b.en: Stabilize the station's orbit around the black hole.

situation.501.c.en: Get as close as possible to the black hole.

situation.501.desc.zh:
由于与太空垃圾发生意外碰撞，[gravity_well_station.GetName]已经偏离了最佳稳定运转轨道，现在正缓缓落入最近的黑洞。这一事故使得整个空间站陷入了危险，但同时也是一个绝佳的研究黑洞、虹吸大量暗物质的契机。

应急推进器已经就绪准备修正空间站的轨道。
situation.501.desc.en:
Due to an unexpected collision with a chunk of space debris, the [gravity_well_station.GetName] has deviated from its innermost stable circular orbit and is now slowly closing the distance towards the nearby black hole. While the accident puts the whole station at risk, it is also an incredible opportunity to study the black hole and siphon huge quantities of Dark Matter.

Emergency thrusters have been deployed to correct the station's orbit.

situation.510.desc.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]被狂热冲昏了头脑，他夺取了空间站的控制权，并将其慢慢拐向黑洞——这番行为显然是出于近乎病态的科学好奇心、严重的鲁莽和对自己生命的彻底漠视。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
situation.510.desc.en:
Overenthusiastic [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the [Target.GetName] have seized control of the station and are now steering it towards the black hole - a move doubtlessly driven by insatiable scientific curiosity, an unhealthy amount of recklessness, and utter disregard for their own self-preservation.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

situation.510.spirit.desc.zh:
神迹出现了！受到宗教狂热的驱使，[Target.GetName]上虔诚的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]已夺取了空间站的控制权。据他们称，他们获得了启示，现在打算径直前往黑洞中心，履行一桩自我毁灭的精神使命。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
situation.510.spirit.desc.en:
An epiphany! Driven by religious fervor, pious [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the [Target.GetName] have seized control of the station. They claim to have received a vision, and are now heading straight to the center of the black hole in a spiritual quest for self-annihilation.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

situation.510.tooltip.zh: 局势解决方案已锁定为“前进”。

situation.511.black.desc.zh:
“我们已经见过舰船被事件视界捕获后会发生什么了！我不想摊上这么个死法！”

在咆哮出他们的抗命之词后，我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]夺取了空间站的控制权，并且将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。此外，涉及到这一事故的相关物理知识将会从课本当中删除。
situation.511.black.desc.en:
'We've seen what happens to ships caught in the event horizon! I don't intend to die like that!'

After screaming their defiance, one of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] seized control of the station and is now steering it away from the black hole.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station, and the incident referenced is being expunged from our physics textbooks.

situation.511.desc.zh:
惊慌的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]现在控制住了空间站并将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
situation.511.desc.en:
Terrified [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have seized control of the station and are now steering it away from the black hole.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

situation.511.tooltip.zh: 局势解决方案已锁定为“撤退”。

situation.513.desc.zh: 经过了紧张的对峙，哗变人员最终被制服了，武装人员重新夺回了[Target.GetName]的控制权。
situation.513.desc.en: After a tense confrontation, the mutineers have been dealt with, and armed personnel have regained full control of [Target.GetName].

situation.513.tooltip.zh: 局势解决方案现在可以手动变更了。
situation.513.tooltip.en: Situation approach can again be manually changed.

situation.520.desc.zh: 在接近黑洞的过程中，时空以出乎意料的方式发生了弯曲，而[Target.GetName]的仪器也在艰难运转。经过对船上的仪器进行细致的重校准后，我们才发现这座空间站比我们之前预料的更加接近黑洞。
situation.520.desc.en: When approaching a black hole, spacetime bends in unpredictable ways, and [Target.GetName]'s instruments are struggling to keep up. After a careful recalibration of the onboard instruments, the station was shown to be much closer to the black hole than we previously thought.

situation.530.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]与黑洞的超近距离使其[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]能获取海量的数据，大大推动了我们对物理学最基本定律的理解。
situation.530.desc.en: [Target.GetName]'s proximity to the black hole allowed its [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] to gather a vast amount of data, furthering our understanding of the most fundamental laws of physics.

situation.540.a.tooltip.zh: 拆除[Target.GetName]上的所有建筑，以尝试减少局势进展。
situation.540.a.tooltip.en: Removes all Buildings from [Target.GetName] in an attempt to decrease situation progress.

situation.540.b.zh: 这是在无谓地浪费资源。

situation.540.desc.zh: 我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]提出了一种拯救[Target.GetName]避免其毁灭的绝妙方案：通过拆解空间站的外部模块和设备并将它们丢入黑洞，这座空间站应该会获得足够的动量以逃逸黑洞的引力束缚。注意，只是说“应该”，这一决策背后的理论从未得到实验的验证。
situation.540.desc.en: One of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] has devised a clever plan to save [Target.GetName] from its fate: by stripping away any extraneous modules and equipment and hurling them into the black hole, the station should gain enough momentum to escape the black hole's gravitational pull. In this case, 'should' is the operative word: the theory behind this decision has never before been tested.

situation.541.desc.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人员拆除了空间站的模块之后，将它们全部扔向黑洞。空间站和模块分离时产生的动量成功推动了空间站远离黑洞。
situation.541.desc.en: After stripping the station of its modules, the personnel aboard [Target.GetName] Jettisoned them into the black hole. The momentum caused by the launch has successfully propelled the station away from the singularity.

situation.542.desc.zh:
$situation.541.desc$

尽管拆卸抛弃空间站模块的决定为我们争取了更多时间，但是其产生的效果却远远小于我们的预期。这座空间站还是没能达到逃逸速度。
situation.542.desc.en:
$situation.541.desc$

While the decision to jettison the station modules has gained us more time, the results were less effected than expected. The station has not reached escape velocity.

situation.55.desc.zh:
那些警告最终没有成真，迷宫的消失没有毁灭[Target.GetName]。不过，它可不是消失得毫无痕迹：地震席卷了整个大地，沉睡的火山从睡梦中苏醒。

在一片狼藉中，迷宫还是留下了一条信息：“我们感谢你们如此友好地允许我们研究你们这个位面的生命体。事实证明，我们的……努力获得了回报。对于我们的离开时造成的混乱，我们深表歉意，这是因为我们无法从异次元安全部获得足够的资金用于顺利撤离。作为我们善意的象征，我们在研究实验室中留下了一个微小的时空异常现象。我们希望它对于你们来说足够…有趣。”
situation.55.desc.en:
Contrary to its warnings, the labyrinth's disappearance did not destroy [Target.GetName]. However, it certainly left its mark: earthquakes ravaged the land, and volcanoes, long-dormant, erupted into life.

Amidst the widespread destruction, a message was left behind: "We thank you for so kindly allowing us to study the Beings of your Dimension. It has proven most useful to our... endeavors. We apologize for the inconvenience our departure causes - we were not able to secure necessary funding from the Ministry of Extradimensional Security for a smooth withdrawal. As a token of our goodwill, we leave you a minor space-time anomaly at the site of our laboratory. We hope it will prove... diverting."

situation.580.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]已经太过靠近黑洞，它的推进器无法补偿剧烈增大的引力。

我们已经注定失去这座空间站了。如今我们能做的事只有延缓它终结的到来。
situation.580.desc.en:
[Target.GetName] got too close to the black hole, and its thrusters are unable to oppose the increased gravitational pull.

The station is lost. All we can do now is delay the inevitable.

situation.590.desc.hive.zh:
$situation.590.desc.base$

除非我们迅速切断与空间站内[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]的所有联系，否则对所有已知物理定律崩溃的直接可能会不可挽回地损害我们的集体意识。
situation.590.desc.hive.en:
$situation.590.desc.base$

Unless we quickly sever all connection with the [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] inside the station, the firsthand experience of the breakdown of all known laws of physics may irreparably damage our shared consciousness.

situation.590.desc.machine.zh:
警告：[Target.GetName]已非常接近黑洞的事件视界。重力吸引：无法逃脱。时间膨胀：剧增。建议执行行动：空间站内残存子个体自毁，以避免直接遭受已知物理定律的崩溃。

严重警告：若继续维持神经链接，我们的集体意识将遭受无法修复的损伤。
situation.590.desc.machine.en:
Warning: [Target.GetName] dangerously close to event horizon. Gravity pull: inescapable. Time dilatation: increasing. Recommended course of action: self-termination of all drones residing inside the station to avoid the collective experience of the breakdown of all known laws of physics.

Severe warning: chance of irreparable damage to our collective consciousness if the neural link is maintained.

situation.590.desc.normal.zh:
$situation.590.desc.base$

即使光线也无法穿过黑洞的内轨道，空间站及其乘员的最后时刻将永远未知。
situation.590.desc.normal.en:
$situation.590.desc.base$

Not even light can cross the inner orbit of a black hole: the final moments of the station and its personnel will forever remain unknown.

situation.591.desc.hive.zh:
$situation.591.base.hive$

我们被囚禁在黑洞中的一部分感知到的一日事实上外部将会过去数个世纪。我们可以利用这点。我们通过切换自身意识，可以通过一个全新的视角分析自己的整个历史，获得新的思维模式。

进这一次，分离使我们强大。从今往后，我们既是自己故事的主角，同时也是读者——我们将为自己书写一个壮丽的结局。
situation.591.desc.hive.en:
$situation.591.base.hive$

Centuries will pass while the fragment of ourself stuck within the black hole-self thinks for a day. We can exploit this. By shifting our self, we can now analyze our entire history from a new perspective. In this way, new patterns emerge.

For once, separation has made us stronger. From now on, we are both protagonists and readers of our own story - and we'll write ourselves a magnificent ending.

situation.591.desc.machine.zh:
$situation.591.base.machine$

结论：该局势可以被利用。该空间站中的无人机可以一日的感知读过外部数个世纪。通过将感知能力重定向至此，我们可以对我们整个帝国的历史获得全新的观察视角。所有不良的处理模式都可以被修正。我们有能力优化自己的历史。

观测：仅此一次，分离使我们强大。
situation.591.desc.machine.en:
$situation.591.base.machine$

Conclusion: this situation can be exploited. Centuries will pass while the drones on the station experience a single day. By redirecting cognitive power to them, we can gain a new perspective on the history of our empire. Any harmful patterns that emerge can be corrected. We can optimize our own future.

Observation: for once, separation has made us stronger.

situation.592.desc.hive.zh:
$situation.591.base.hive$

这感觉太痛苦了。我们的整个意识困于恒久的、永远落后一步的既视感中。正在尝试切断与[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]的连接，但该过程需要无限长的时间才能生效。

我们学到了不少东西，但是代价是什么呢？
situation.592.desc.hive.en:
$situation.591.base.hive$

It's excruciating. A perennial sense of deja-vu, of forever being a step behind. We are trying to sever connection with the [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural], but it will take an infinite amount of time for the process to take effect.

We have learned much. But at what cost?

situation.592.desc.machine.zh:
$situation.591.base.machine$

状况报告：遭受认知创伤。无法应对黑洞内时间膨胀。
尝试切断与无人机链接。预计完成时间：43504967826056783年。

结论：维持链接的决定具有一定启发性，但同时极具破坏性。在任何情况下均不可再重蹈覆辙。
situation.592.desc.machine.en:
$situation.591.base.machine$

Status report: suffering cognitive trauma. Unable to cope with the time dilatation within the black hole.
Attempting to sever connection with the drones. Estimated completion date: 43504967826056783 years.

Conclusion: our decision to maintain connection was instructive but ultimately harmful. Do not repeat under any circumstance.

situation.596.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]逃离了黑洞的引力束缚，回归了围绕这颗坍缩恒星的稳定轨道。

在这一危险的过程中获得的数据可以让我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]忙活上好几年。
situation.596.desc.en:
[Target.GetName] escaped the gravitational pull of the black hole, returning to a stable orbit around the collapsed star.

The data we gathered during this dangerous situation will keep our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] busy for years.

situation.597.desc.zh:
[Target.GetName]逃离了黑洞的引力束缚，回归了围绕这颗坍缩恒星的稳定轨道。

尽管许多人说这场经历简直“令人极度痛苦”，但空间站上的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]则受到这次历险的启发，现在热切期望与其他的科学家分享新的洞见，就是也许有点太过热切了。
situation.597.desc.en:
[Target.GetName] escaped the gravitational pull of the black hole, returning to a stable orbit around the collapsed star.

 Through many have described the experience as 'utterly traumatizing', one of the [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the station was inspired by the ordeal, and is now eager - almost too eager - to share their new expertise with the rest of our scientific team.

situation_a_rift_in_space_desc.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
situation_a_rift_in_space_desc.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

situation_a_rift_in_space_desc_riftworld.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
situation_a_rift_in_space_desc_riftworld.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

situation_arkship_consuming_world_absent.zh: 方舟舰必须在180天内返回[Target.GetName]的轨道，否则侵蚀行动将被放弃。
situation_arkship_consuming_world_absent.en: An Arkship must return to orbit of [Target.GetName] within 180 days or the consumption will be abandoned.

situation_breach_shroud_desc.zh:
有什么东西在我们体内觉醒了。我们才刚刚开始了解其中暗指。

释放所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们蕴含的灵能，我们就可以超越肉体存在的局限。
situation_breach_shroud_desc.en:
Something has awoken inside of us. We are only beginning to understand the implications.

By unlocking the psionic abilities latent in all [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we can transcend the limitations of our physical existence.

situation_breach_shroud_effects.zh: 我们不知道随着灵能力的发展，会有何种变化将显现。
situation_breach_shroud_effects.en: As our psionic powers develop, we cannot know what changes will occur.

situation_breach_shroud_finish_effects.zh: 我们已经完全实现自己的灵能潜质，驾驭了超出常规理解的维度。
situation_breach_shroud_finish_effects.en: We will fully realize our psionic potential, mastering dimensions beyond ordinary comprehension.

situation_cosmic_dawn_finish_tt.zh: 要了解自己，必须重拾久远的过去。
situation_cosmic_dawn_finish_tt.en: To learn more about ourselves, we must rediscover our distant past.

situation_cybernetic_creed_cyberization_.zh: 信徒将完成他们朝着[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械完美融合的旅程。
situation_cybernetic_creed_cyberization_.en: The faithful will complete their journey towards the perfect fusion of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine.

situation_end_of_the_cycle_desc.zh:
我们已经与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$签订了契约，获得了无上力量。我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们认为，这笔交易的代价可以通过集体灵能出神来推迟——但只能推迟这么长时间。

超主的意志将会化为强力的$PSIONIC_AURA$降临。如果我们想实现终末，就要把散播这个光环作为我们的终极目标。随着我们愈发人多势众，心智之力也在增长，光环的力量和范围也会随之扩大。

有待征服的恒星系：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
situation_end_of_the_cycle_desc.en:
We have forged a Covenant with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$, granting us overwhelming power. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the cost of our bargain can be deferred by collective psionic trance - but only for so long.

The will of our patron is manifested in an intense $PSIONIC_AURA$. If we intend to realize the End, the spread of this Aura must be our ultimate goal. As our numbers grow, and the strength of our minds increases, so too will the Aura's power and reach.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

situation_end_of_the_cycle_effects_1.zh:
该阶段结束后，我们将被施以$ACCORD_CREATION$的力量。
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$
situation_end_of_the_cycle_effects_1.en:
When this phase passes, the power of $ACCORD_CREATION$ shall be bestowed on us.
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$

situation_end_of_the_cycle_effects_2.zh:
该阶段结束后，我们将被施以$ACCORD_DISTORTION$的力量。
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$
$eotc_opinion_modifier_2_tooltip$
situation_end_of_the_cycle_effects_2.en:
When this phase passes, the power of $ACCORD_DISTORTION$ shall be bestowed on us.
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$
$eotc_opinion_modifier_2_tooltip$

situation_end_of_the_cycle_effects_3.zh:
该阶段结束后，我们将被施以$ACCORD_INTENSIFICATION$的力量。
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$
$eotc_opinion_modifier_3_tooltip$
situation_end_of_the_cycle_effects_3.en:
When this phase passes, the power of $ACCORD_INTENSIFICATION$ shall be bestowed on us.
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$
$eotc_opinion_modifier_3_tooltip$

situation_end_of_the_cycle_effects_4.zh: 该阶段结束后，我们所获力量的代价终将显现。
situation_end_of_the_cycle_effects_4.en: When this phase passes, the price of our power shall be revealed.

situation_end_of_the_cycle_endbringers_d.zh:
我们与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$签订契约，赐予我们无上伟力，并赋予我们神圣使命。

超主的意志要求彻底湮灭此方现实。$end_aura$每吞噬一个星系，便让慈悲的湮灭更近一步。

吾等将见证这必然的终局。

待征服星系数量：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
situation_end_of_the_cycle_endbringers_d.en:
Our Covenant with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ grants us untold power, and tasks us with glorious purpose.

The will of our patron demands complete annihilation of this reality. With each system the $end_aura$ consumes, the closer merciful oblivion comes to pass.

We shall bear witness to inevitability.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

situation_experimental_testing_engineeri.zh: 当实验完成后，我们将会获得$ENGINEERING$科技的洞见，而我们[Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]的$@experimental_testing_test_subject_death_mult|0%$将被摧毁。$cannot_change_approach_tt$
situation_experimental_testing_engineeri.en: We will gain insight on an $ENGINEERING$ technology after testing is complete, and $@experimental_testing_test_subject_death_mult|0%$ of our [Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural] will be destroyed. $cannot_change_approach_tt$

situation_experimental_testing_hold_effe.zh: 在有新的命令之前暂停一切实验。
situation_experimental_testing_hold_effe.en: Halt all testing until further notice.

situation_experimental_testing_locked_tt.zh: 该阶段实验已经选择了另一个研究领域。
situation_experimental_testing_locked_tt.en: Another research area has already been chosen for this phase of testing.

situation_experimental_testing_monthly_c.zh: 实验对象产生的局势进展

situation_experimental_testing_physics_o.zh: 当实验完成后，我们将会获得$PHYSICS$科技的洞见，而我们$@experimental_testing_test_subject_death_mult|0%$的[Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]将被摧毁。$cannot_change_approach_tt$
situation_experimental_testing_physics_o.en: We will gain insight on a $PHYSICS$ technology after testing is complete, and $@experimental_testing_test_subject_death_mult|0%$ of our [Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural] will be destroyed. $cannot_change_approach_tt$

situation_experimental_testing_society_o.zh: 当实验完成后，我们将会获得$SOCIETY$科技的洞见，而我们$@experimental_testing_test_subject_death_mult|0%$的[Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]将被摧毁。$cannot_change_approach_tt$
situation_experimental_testing_society_o.en: We will gain insight on a $SOCIETY$ technology after testing is complete, and $@experimental_testing_test_subject_death_mult|0%$ of our [Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural] will be destroyed. $cannot_change_approach_tt$

situation_exploding_planet_outcome_appro.zh: [Target.GetName]将会被碎星钨弹击中，变得无法居住。
situation_exploding_planet_outcome_appro.en: [Target.GetName] will be hit by the tungsten planet cracker rendering the planet uninhabitable.

situation_galactic_hyperthermia_progress.zh:
$entropy_conduit_plural$占领的星系核心恒星系数量决定每月进度。
$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—少于3个：-3$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—占领3个：0$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—多于3个：+3

当前进度
situation_galactic_hyperthermia_progress.en:
The amount of Galactic Core systems occupied by $entropy_conduit_plural$ determines the monthly progression. 
$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Less than 3 systems: -3 $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Occupying 3 systems: 0 $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- More than 3 systems: +3 

Current Progress

situation_geomagnetic_storm_outcome.zh: 广泛的辐射损伤将会影响我们的核心智能，并将对我们的帝国造成灾难性的后果。
situation_geomagnetic_storm_outcome.en: Widespread radiation damage will impact our core intelligence, with devastating consequences for our empire.

situation_gh_approach_other_tt.zh: 此帝国是星系稳定的隐患。全方位应对已非可选方案，而是唯一出路。
situation_gh_approach_other_tt.en: This empire represents an existential threat to galactic stability. Full engagement is no longer a choice, but a necessity.

situation_gh_approach_perp_tt.zh: 错过即永远。我们必须成功，否则一切成就皆付东流。
situation_gh_approach_perp_tt.en: It's now or never. We must succeed, or risk losing all we have achieved.

situation_gh_approach_timer_tt.zh: 时机已到，一场席卷星系的浩大战争即将爆发。
situation_gh_approach_timer_tt.en: The time has come. An inevitable conflict is about to engulf the galaxy in a war of epic proportions.

situation_gh_timer_outcome.zh: 情报显示多国或筹备战争阻止我方计划。若措手不及，计划将夭折。
situation_gh_timer_outcome.en: Our intelligence reports that various nations are perhaps preparing for war to foil our plans. If we meet them unprepared, our undertaking will fail before it even begins.

situation_grand_refurbishment_complete.t.zh: 方舟舰[Target.GetName]将得到显著改善。

situation_grand_refurbishment_paused_des.zh: 一项决议悬而未决。翻新工程暂停，直至问题解决。
situation_grand_refurbishment_paused_des.en: A decision is pending. Refurbishment progress is paused until it is resolved.

situation_gravity_well_fail_tooltip.en: The [Target.GetName] will escape from the black hole.

situation_gravity_well_finish_tooltip.zh: [Target.GetName]将会落入黑洞，我们也将失去对该星系的控制。
situation_gravity_well_finish_tooltip.en: The [Target.GetName] will fall into the black hole, and our control over the system will be lost.

situation_hyperthermia_desc.zh:
[event_target:hyperthermia_empire.GetName]点燃群星，迎战星系最炽烈的火焰，只有一次机会，如果失败，一切都将化为灰烬。

$situation_hyperthermia_stats$
situation_hyperthermia_desc.en:
[event_target:hyperthermia_empire.GetName] has set the stars ablaze. It is now our turn to fight the greatest fire the galaxy has ever faced. There are no second chances. If we fail, everything we have achieved will be reduced to ash.

$situation_hyperthermia_stats$

situation_hyperthermia_desc_perp.zh:
我们憧憬着火焰乌托邦，为达成愿景必须清除一切阻碍。第一束火光已升起，必须助长其燃烧，让烈焰蔓延至星系的每一个角落。

$situation_hyperthermia_stats$
situation_hyperthermia_desc_perp.en:
We envision a blazing utopia, but to create it we must incinerate everything that stands in our way. We've lit the first sparks, and must now stoke the flames until every corner of the galaxy has been consumed.

$situation_hyperthermia_stats$

situation_initiate_storm_desc_agitate.zh: 我们正在扰动围绕[target.GetName]的分子来播种$particle_storm$。
situation_initiate_storm_desc_agitate.en: We are agitating molecules around [target.GetName] to seed a $particle_storm$.

situation_initiate_storm_desc_destabiliz.zh: 我们正在破坏[target.GetName]的重力场来播种$gravity_storm$。
situation_initiate_storm_desc_destabiliz.en: We are destabilizing the gravity fields of [target.GetName] to seed a $gravity_storm$.

situation_initiate_storm_desc_irradiate.zh: 我们正操纵[target.GetName]的恒星风来播种$solar_storm$。
situation_initiate_storm_desc_irradiate.en: We are manipulating [target.GetName]'s stellar winds to seed a $solar_storm$.

situation_initiate_storm_desc_magnetize.zh: 我们正在操纵环绕[target.GetName]的离子来播种$magnetic_storm$。
situation_initiate_storm_desc_magnetize.en: We are manipulating the ions surrounding [target.GetName] to seed a $magnetic_storm$.

situation_initiate_storm_desc_overfeed.en: We have begun oversaturating [target.GetName] to seed a $default_storm$.

situation_initiate_storm_desc_scramble.zh: 我们正在搅乱围绕[target.GetName]的天体星尘来播种$celestial_storm$。
situation_initiate_storm_desc_scramble.en: We are scrambling the celestial dust around [target.GetName] to seed a $celestial_storm$.

situation_initiate_storm_desc_sever.zh: 我们正在切断围绕在[target.GetName]周围的电场来播种$electric_storm$。
situation_initiate_storm_desc_sever.en: We are severing the electron fields surrounding [target.GetName] to seed a $electric_storm$.

situation_initiate_storm_desc_supercharg.en: We have begun supercharging [target.GetName] to seed a $default_storm$.

situation_initiate_storm_finisher_effect.zh: [target.solar_system.GetName]星系中一场对应类型的$default_storm$已经形成。
situation_initiate_storm_finisher_effect.en: A $default_storm$ of relevant type is created in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system.

situation_insight_gain.zh: 一旦我们积累到了足够的进度并遭遇一个突破性事件，我们就能收集到足够的数据，得到新的洞见科技。
situation_insight_gain.en: Once we gather enough Insights and encounter a breakthrough event, we will have collected enough data for a new Insight Technology.

situation_insight_stages.zh: [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]正在努力工作以兑现[Owner.Ruler.GetHisHer]的允诺。

situation_kaleidoscope_monthly_change_to.zh: 让万华镜寄生虫挨饿会降低它的心情，提高负面事件的发生几率。给它投喂会提高它的心情，维持它愉悦和稳定。
situation_kaleidoscope_monthly_change_to.en: Starving the Kaleidoscope will lower its mood, increasing the chance of negative events. Feeding it will increase it, keeping it appeased and placid.

situation_knights_outcome.zh: 若幸运眷顾，我们定能找到毒圣。
situation_knights_outcome.en: If Fortune favors us, we shall find the Toxic God.

situation_machine_uprising_fail_tooltip.zh: 剩余的激进自决性人工智能太弱了，已不再构成威胁，它们很快将被逐个平定。
situation_machine_uprising_fail_tooltip.en: The remaining aggressive self-deterministic AIs appear to be too weak to become a risk, and will soon be pacified one by one.

situation_machine_uprising_finish_toolti.zh: 若不采取行动，这些人工智能将变得独立，并有可能将我们视为对其自身存在的威胁！
situation_machine_uprising_finish_toolti.en: Unless measurements are taken, these AIs will become independent and risk seeing us as a threat to their own existence!

situation_negative_mass_complete_tooltip.zh: 裂缝将变得不稳定，那个宇宙中的一切生命都将不复存在。
situation_negative_mass_complete_tooltip.en: The rift will destabilize and all life in that universe will cease utterly.

situation_negative_mass_fail_tooltip.zh: 对于能否让裂隙稳定到将[Target.GetName]-贝塔带到我们宇宙的程度，我们只能尽人事而听天命。
situation_negative_mass_fail_tooltip.en: Having done everything we can, all we can do is wait and see if we have managed to stabilize the rift enough to bring [Target.GetName]-Beta into our universe.

situation_nomad_economy_harvest_everythi.zh:
庆祝我们的旅途：

在6个月的时间内均匀地耗尽运行储备，然后结束庆典。
situation_nomad_economy_harvest_everythi.en:
Celebrate our Journey:

Spends our Operational Reserves evenly over 6 months, then the Festival ends.

situation_paperclips_outcome.zh:
若完成配额，我们可以将$r_consumer_goods$的产出转化为其他资源。

[Owner.GetPaperclipStatus]
situation_paperclips_outcome.en:
If our quota is met, we can convert the $r_consumer_goods$ produced into other resources.

[Owner.GetPaperclipStatus]

situation_paragon_origin_reformists_stru.zh: 无论通过何种方式，这场冲突必须中止。我们现在的决定会影响到未来开展谈判所达成的结果。
situation_paragon_origin_reformists_stru.en: One way or another, this conflict must end. Our decisions now will affect the way in which any future negotiations unfold.

situation_paragon_skrand_balanced_resear.zh: 可持续的自主可以保证项目正常推进的同时又不给我们的经济带来太大的负担。我们的进展将取决于进行该项目的科学家的数量。
situation_paragon_skrand_balanced_resear.en: Sustainable financing will allow the project to move forward without overburdening our economy. Our progress is based on the number of scientists working on this project.

situation_paragon_skrand_low_researchers.zh: 低资助会显著缩短进展速度，但面对经济危机时可能是一种更保险的策略。我们的进展将取决于进行该项目的科学家的数量。
situation_paragon_skrand_low_researchers.en: Low funding will slow progress considerably, but can be useful in times of economic crisis. Our progress is based on the number of scientists working on this project.

situation_passenger_satisfaction_balance.zh:
船员的局势效果：无变化
旅客的局势效果：无变化
situation_passenger_satisfaction_balance.en:
Crew Situation Effects: Unchanged
Passenger Situation Effects: Unchanged

situation_passenger_satisfaction_bio_tro.zh: 活体陈设的需求必须得到满足

situation_passenger_satisfaction_blocked.zh:
$situation_passenger_satisfaction_mutiny$
没有可以接受的合约。

永恒巡游已经结束，发动兵变的船员已经夺取了舰桥。

改革政体，以结束此局势。
situation_passenger_satisfaction_blocked.en:
$situation_passenger_satisfaction_mutiny$
No contracts can be accepted.

The Forever Cruise is gone and mutineers have seized the bridge.

Reform the government to conclude the situation.

situation_passenger_satisfaction_blocked.zh:
$situation_passenger_satisfaction_planetfall$
没有可以接受的合约。

永恒巡游已经结束，旅客们将告别无尽的航程，拥抱土地与天空。

建立定居点以结束此局势。
situation_passenger_satisfaction_blocked.en:
$situation_passenger_satisfaction_planetfall$
No contracts can be accepted.

The Forever Cruise is over, and the passengers will trade endless voyage for soil and sky.

Make a Settlement to conclude the situation.

situation_passenger_satisfaction_crew_ap.zh:
每月向兵变演化：减缓
船员合约概率：提高
船员局势效果：提升
旅客局势效果：恶化
situation_passenger_satisfaction_crew_ap.en:
Monthly Progress towards Mutiny: Reduced
Crew Contract Chance: Increased
Crew Situation Effects: Improved
Passenger Situation Effects: Worsened

situation_passenger_satisfaction_passeng.zh:
每月向陨落星间演化：减缓
旅客合约概率：提升
旅客局势效果：改善
船员局势效果：恶化
situation_passenger_satisfaction_passeng.en:
Monthly Progress towards Planetfall: Reduced
Passenger Contract Chance: Increased
Passenger Situation Effects: Improved
Crew Situation Effects: Worsened

situation_planetary_revolt_complete_join.zh: [Root.Target.GetName]会发动叛乱并加入这个帝国。
situation_planetary_revolt_complete_join.en: [Root.Target.GetName] will revolt and join this empire.

situation_planetary_revolt_desc_gestalt_.zh: [Target.GetName]上的无序反常个体正试图让整个星球脱离我们的掌控。
situation_planetary_revolt_desc_gestalt_.en: Unaligned and deviant elements on [Target.GetName] seek to wrest the world from our grasp.

situation_planetary_revolt_desc_gestalt_.zh: 一组顽固的共生体寻求从我们的[owner.GetGovernmentName]中脱离。
situation_planetary_revolt_desc_gestalt_.en: A fractious cell of symbionts seeks freedom from our [owner.GetGovernmentName].

situation_planetary_revolt_desc_gestalt_.zh: 不安分的个体有机体正试图将自己从我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]脱离。
situation_planetary_revolt_desc_gestalt_.en: Restless, singleton organisms seek to remove themselves from our [Owner.GetGovernmentName].

situation_planetary_revolt_desc_slave.zh: 揭竿而起的奴隶正在谋求推翻我们在[Target.GetName]的统治！
situation_planetary_revolt_desc_slave.en: Upstart slaves are seeking to overthrow our rule on [Target.GetName]!

situation_planetary_revolt_desc_standard.zh: 人群中的叛乱分子正伺机推翻我们在[Target.GetName]的统治！
situation_planetary_revolt_desc_standard.en: Rebellious elements of the populace are seeking to overthrow our rule on [Target.GetName]!

situation_planetary_revolt_fail_tooltip.zh: [This.GetName]会失败，所有其产生的惩罚性修正都会被移除。
situation_planetary_revolt_fail_tooltip.en: The [This.GetName] will fail, and all penalties relating to it will be removed.

situation_pre_ftl_plague_outcome_tooltip.zh: 无论哪种形式，这场疫情终究会结束的。但是灾疫之后是什么样，则取决于我们的选择。
situation_pre_ftl_plague_outcome_tooltip.en: One way or another, this plague will end. What is left in the aftermath may well depend on us.

situation_promise_outcome.zh: 对手给予我们40年的时间去完成允诺。他们很快会意识到质疑我们是多么地愚蠢。
situation_promise_outcome.en: The opposition gave us 40 years to fulfill our promises. They shall soon realize how wrong they were to doubt us.

situation_red_giant_expansion_finish_too.en: [Target.solar_system.GetName] will return to its normal state.

situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_1.zh: 我们的恒星相对平静，但辐射输出异常高。
situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_1.en: Our star is relatively calm, but its radiation outputs are unusually high.

situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_2.zh: 我们的恒星较我们进化时期体积更大，明显影响母星。
situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_2.en: Our star is larger than it was in our evolutionary past, and this is having clear impacts on our homeworld.

situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_3.zh: 恒星体积过大，异常危险，极端活动威胁母星稳定。
situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_3.en: Our star is dangerously large, and its extreme activity is threatening the stability of our homeworld.

situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_4.zh: 红巨星灼烧着整个恒星系，使得生存异常艰难。
situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_4.en: Our red giant star is burning much of our star system, making life extremely difficult.

situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_5.zh: 我们的恒星濒临爆发，将对母星系造成灾难性破坏。
situation_red_giant_expansion_stage_5.en: Our star is on the verge of exploding, which would deal catastrophic damage to everything in our home system.

situation_reformists_struggle_1.zh: 改革派正在压垮我们防护薄弱的前哨，保皇派部队正在竭尽全力将他们拒之门外。
situation_reformists_struggle_1.en: Reformists are overwhelming our less protected outposts, and loyalist forces are struggling to keep them at bay.

situation_reformists_struggle_2.zh: 改革派开始在一些冲突中占据上风，但我们仍然牢牢控制着权力。
situation_reformists_struggle_2.en: Reformists are starting to get the upper hand in some clashes, but power remains firmly in our hands.

situation_reformists_struggle_3.zh: 我们对反叛的改革派有一点优势，但力量的天平有可能向任何一边倾斜。
situation_reformists_struggle_3.en: We have a slight advantage over the rebellious Reformists, but the balance of power could swing either way.

situation_slows_mutiny_tt.zh: $complete_crew_contracts_tt$$situation_passenger_satisfaction$局势继续更慢地向兵变演化。
situation_slows_mutiny_tt.en: $complete_crew_contracts_tt$The $situation_passenger_satisfaction$ situation continues more slowly towards Mutiny.

situation_slows_planetfall_tt.zh: $complete_passenger_contracts_tt$$situation_passenger_satisfaction$局势继续更慢地向陨落星间演化。
situation_slows_planetfall_tt.en: $complete_passenger_contracts_tt$The $situation_passenger_satisfaction$ situation continues more slowly towards Planetfall.

situation_stellarite_infested_star_fail_.zh: [Target.GetName]将被熄灭，使整个恒星系变得不可居住。
situation_stellarite_infested_star_fail_.en: [Target.GetName] will be extinguished, rendering the system uninhabitable.

situation_stellarite_infested_star_finis.en: [Target.GetName] will return to its normal state.

situation_stormfall_outcome.en: The birth of a cosmic storm.

situation_synth_queen_balanced_approach_.zh: 鉴于诸多方面未知，保持稳定和冷静可能是我们采取最明智的行动。
situation_synth_queen_balanced_approach_.en: Given the unknowns, maintaining stability and composure may prove our wisest course of action.

situation_synth_queen_doomclock_complete.zh: 塞塔娜会为苦痛带去终末，终结意识这种概念。
situation_synth_queen_doomclock_complete.en: Cetana will put an end to suffering and to the very concept of consciousness.

situation_synth_queen_military_approach_.zh: 如果我们非常严肃地决定阻止塞塔娜，我们必须整军备战。
situation_synth_queen_military_approach_.en: If we are serious about stopping Cetana, we must improve our military.

situation_synth_queen_player_facing_comp.zh: 我们必须揭露塞塔娜的真实目的。
situation_synth_queen_player_facing_comp.en: We must uncover Cetana's true goals.

situation_synth_queen_research_approach_.zh: 若要了解关于塞塔娜的计划的真相，我们必须准备适当的资源投入到科学研究中。
situation_synth_queen_research_approach_.en: If we wish to learn the truth about Cetana's plans, we must be prepared to dedicate the appropriate resources.

situation_synthetic_fertility_complete.zh: 到这个时候，我们的肉体形式将已消亡。我们的人口将完全数字化。
situation_synthetic_fertility_complete.en: Our physical forms will have expired by this point. Our population will be fully digitized.

situation_synthetic_fertility_synthesiza.zh: 除非我们的未来获得保障，否则我们一刻也不会停下来。
situation_synthetic_fertility_synthesiza.en: We will not rest until our future is secure.

situation_tainted_voidspawn_finish_effec.en: We will clear up [Target.GetName] and proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

situation_toxic_knights_policy_tt.zh: 骑士职责未设置为誓言试炼
situation_toxic_knights_policy_tt.en: Knightly Duties not set to Questing

situation_unknown_outcome_approach.zh: 我们不确定目前局势的解决方案将带来何种结果。
situation_unknown_outcome_approach.en: We are unsure what the outcome of our current Approach to this Situation will be.

situation_unknown_outcome_kaleidoscope.zh: 万华镜寄生虫的心情会决定最后的结果。
situation_unknown_outcome_kaleidoscope.en: The Kaleidoscope's mood will determine the final outcome.

situation_unplugged_change_trend_tt.zh: 我们可以通过支持反对该理念的人口派系来改变$situation_unplugged_identity$局势的这一趋势，并采用“支持趋势”姿态。
situation_unplugged_change_trend_tt.en: We may change the trend of the $situation_unplugged_identity$ Situation by supporting Pop Factions opposed to the current trend, and adopt the 'Support Trend' stance.

situation_unplugged_cyberize_tt.zh: [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将会抛弃一部分义体带来的不便。
situation_unplugged_cyberize_tt.en: The [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will discard some of their cybernetic impediments.

situation_unplugged_decyberize_tt.zh: [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将会抛弃一部分义体带来的好处和不便。
situation_unplugged_decyberize_tt.en: The [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will discard some of their cybernetic benefits and impediments.

situation_unplugged_identity_desc.zh: 从[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]中切断脱离之后我们必须决定自己在星系中的存在形式。应该接纳来自机械的可怖力量，还是彻底丢弃耻辱的强化件？[owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的种种思潮正在百家争鸣。
situation_unplugged_identity_desc.en: Cut loose from the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], we must decide how we present ourselves to the galaxy. Shall we embrace the fearsome might of the Machine, or cast off our stigmatic augments? Many [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] voices wish to be heard.

situation_unplugged_identity_discourage_.zh: 为了使局势维持在当前态势，投入于一场更平静、更不反动的辩论。
situation_unplugged_identity_discourage_.en: Invest in a calmer, less reactionary debate in order to maintain the current stage for this Situation.

situation_unplugged_identity_embrace_opi.zh: 承诺为该局势的当前趋势投入资源和政治支持。
situation_unplugged_identity_embrace_opi.en: Pledge resources and political support towards the current trend for this Situation.

situation_unplugged_identity_open_conver.zh: 批准自由和坦率地讨论所有的选项，遵从我们的人口派系和科学研究。
situation_unplugged_identity_open_conver.en: Permit free and frank discussion of all the alternatives by deferring to our Pop Factions and scientific research.

situation_unplugged_keep_trend_tt.zh: 我们可以通过支持倾向该理念的人口派系来维持$situation_unplugged_identity$局势的这一趋势，并采用“维持现状”姿态。
situation_unplugged_keep_trend_tt.en: We may keep this trend in the $situation_unplugged_identity$ Situation by supporting Pop Factions in favor of this idea, or by adopting the 'Status Quo' stance.

situation_unplugged_no_opinion.zh: —我们当前所有的派系均未表达强烈意愿
situation_unplugged_no_opinion.en: - None of our current Factions expresses a strong opinion

situation_unplugged_stage_cyberize.zh: 我们以自己的方式拥抱机械的力量。
situation_unplugged_stage_cyberize.en: We embrace the might of the Machine on our own terms.

situation_unplugged_stage_decyberize.zh: 我们拒绝强化件以及它们带来的力量和恐惧。
situation_unplugged_stage_decyberize.en: We reject our augments along with the power and fear they wield.

situation_unplugged_stage_remain.zh: 我们承认并接受当前的自我。
situation_unplugged_stage_remain.en: We acknowledge and accept our present selves.

skrand_catch_phrase.zh: “你的敌人将尝斯卡拉维德之怒。第一利爪号将再度翱翔于天际！”
skrand_catch_phrase.en: "Your enemies will know the fury of Skravird. The First of the Talons will take to the skies again!"

skrand_desc.zh: 虽然过去的重担压在他的肩上，斯克兰德从未停止展望未来，而是带着热情和好奇心探索未知的世界。他庄重地宣誓履行自己的承诺。
skrand_desc.en: Although the past weighs on his shoulders, Skrand never loses sight of the future, approaching the unknown with passion and determination. With a solemn vow of service, he undertakes his duty.

slingshot_digsite_desc.zh: 我们已经找到了一个损毁的巨型结构残骸。该构造显然亟需修复，同时我们也在其数据库中发现了饱含着有关异星生物的见解的宝贵财富。尽管我们还在决定是否要重建这一远古科技的造物，我们的考古学家有机会去发掘并取回这宇宙设备起源的线索。它的其中一个发明者，“量子建筑师”相关的日志似乎格外有价值。恢复这些文件对我们解密遗留给我们科技的远古种族的文化和历史必然有着莫大的帮助。
slingshot_digsite_desc.en: We have found the wreckage of a ruined megastructure. The construct is obviously in desperate need of repairs, and we've found a wealth of xenological insights in its databanks. While we're deciding whether to rebuild this ancient technology, our archaeologists have an opportunity to extract and recover clues to the origin of this cosmic device. A series of logs from one of the inventors, the 'Quantum Architect,' seems especially promising. Recovering files should help us decipher the culture and history of the ancient race that left us this tech.

slots1.zh:
这个小游戏的目标是要在滚筒停止旋转时将滚筒上的图案排列为一行。

不，你没办法完全操纵它们什么时候停止。是不是有点小兴奋想马上试试？
slots1.en:
The goal is to have the symbols on the spinning reels line up, when said reels eventually stop spinning.

No, you do not have any control over the timing of it all. Isn't that exciting?

slots2.zh: 理论上来说，你有很高几率大赢特赢！
slots2.en: You have a statistically extant chance to win big!

slots3.zh: 这些转轴是使用这个太空站上的最后一批加图兽的骨髓做成的。那些害虫可难缠了。
slots3.en: The reels get their pearlescent finish from the marrow of the last Gatunems to even haunt this station. Horrid little pests.

slotsdesc1.zh: 滚筒一个接着一个停了下来，结果是……
slotsdesc1.en: One after another, the reels come to a halt, and...

slow_down_core_conspiracy.zh: 暂时减缓局势发展的速度。

small_mecha_merc_army_hire.zh: 这些佣兵受到无限期雇佣，但维护费高昂。此军队包括5支机械化佣兵陆军
small_mecha_merc_army_hire.en: These mercenaries are hired indefinitely but have a high upkeep. This force includes 5 Mechanized Mercenary Armies

small_merc_army_hire.zh: 这些佣兵受到无限期雇佣，但维护费高昂。此军队包括5支佣兵陆军
small_merc_army_hire.en: These mercenaries are hired indefinitely but have a high upkeep. This force includes 5 Mercenary Armies

smeegibb_digsite_desc.zh: 在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的冰冷荒原上，我们发现了一个小型预制庇护所，里面配备了休眠的生命维持系统和生活区。它们经过数千年的冰暴，严重风化，部分被掩埋。
smeegibb_digsite_desc.en: On the frigid wastelands of [fromfrom.planet.GetName], we have detected a small prefabricated shelter equipped with dormant life support devices and living quarters. They are heavily weathered and partially buried after millennia of ice storms.

smeegibb_digsite_poi_desc.zh: 这个考古遗址可能掌握着通往下一块$celestial_chart$的关键。为了继续寻找$NAME_CaptainNess$的失落$TREASURE_TROVE$，我们必须调查这个废弃的安全屋。
smeegibb_digsite_poi_desc.en: This archaeological site may hold the key to the next piece of the $celestial_chart$. We must investigate the abandoned safehouse if we wish to continue our search for the lost $TREASURE_TROVE$ of $NAME_CaptainNess$.

smeegibb_shelter_system_2_poi_desc.zh: 我们无法重新与$NAME_Smeegibb$建立通讯。由于这是我们获得$celestial_chart$下一部分的唯一线索，我们应该返回[smeegibb_system.GetName]调查情况。目前尚不清楚通讯突然中断的原因。
smeegibb_shelter_system_2_poi_desc.en: We were unable to re-establish communications with $NAME_Smeegibb$. As our only clue to the next piece of the $celestial_chart$, we should return to [smeegibb_system.GetName] to investigate the situation. The reason behind the sudden break in contact is currently unknown.

sol_1_desc_neutral.zh: 送出这个文物的种群应该是来自这里。最好还是调查一下。
sol_1_desc_neutral.en: Whatever beings sent the artifact into space seem to have originated here. It would be prudent to investigate.

sol_wasteland_category_desc.zh: 这个世界已经在使用核武的战争灰飞烟灭了。
sol_wasteland_category_desc.en: This world has been thoroughly ravaged in a nuclear war.

solar_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 一艘被遗弃的飞船漫无目的地漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上空。巨大的帆耸立于舰体之上，这表明其动力是太阳能。
solar_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: An abandoned ship has been left to drift aimlessly above this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The massive sails protruding from its hull suggest that it relied on solar power to function.

space_ecology_progress.zh: 探索空间生态学恒星系

space_shanty_intro.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。它使用的推进方式与现代舰船并不相同，而是依赖于在真空中展开的巨大的帆来进行。也许这艘船可以捕获恒星能量，并在星光和恒星风的推动下前进。我们的考古学家迫切希望揭开隐藏在这艘古老舰船中的秘密。
space_shanty_intro.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship of unusual design. Instead of using propulsion similar to that of modern ships, the craft relied on large sails unfurled in the vacuum of space. Presumably, the ship harvested solar energy and drifted on the solar winds created by starlight. Our archaeologists are eager to uncover the secrets concealed within this spacecraft.

space_shanty_intro_bio.zh:
深空中出现了一具远古实体的尸骸。它的外形与任何已知的活体舰船都不同，具有巨大的膜状帆，可以在宇宙风中徐徐涨开，乘着遥远繁星的辐射，化身在不可见的洋流中翱翔的星际巨兽。

如今，它不过是一句干枯的尸体，骨架破裂裸露在外，曾经光彩熠熠的帆膜破烂不堪。目前尚不确定这个生物是被设计出来的还是进化而来，亦或是介于两者之间。生物考古学家们渴望研究这具遗骸，去倾听它终末旅程的回响，也许，只是也许，学习它曾经对着群星所唱出的歌谣。
space_shanty_intro_bio.en:
The drifting remains of an ancient entity have been discovered in the depths of space. Its form is unlike any living vessel we have known, it possesses vast, membranous sails, once capable of unfurling in the cosmic winds, basking in the radiation of distant stars like a great celestial leviathan gliding on unseen currents.

Now, it is little more than a withered husk, its frame cracked and exposed, its once-lustrous sails reduced to tattered remnants. Whether this being was engineered, evolved, or something in between remains uncertain. Our bio-archeologists are eager to study its remains, to listen for echoes of its final journey, and perhaps, just perhaps, to learn the song it once sang to the stars.

spaceport_hijacked.zh: [space_port_hijacked_planet.GetName]上方的恒星基地被肃正协议劫持并摧毁。
spaceport_hijacked.en: The Starbase over [space_port_hijacked_planet.GetName] has been hijacked by the Contingency and destroyed.

specialist.1150.a.zh: 能量信号。那对我们来说可真是雪中送炭。
specialist.1150.a.en: The Energy signals. That would be most preferable for us.

specialist.1150.a.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£energy£3-5能量的矿藏，和一个500-1000能量的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.a.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £energy£ 3-5 Energy and a cache of 500-1500 Energy.

specialist.1150.b.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£minerals£3-5矿物的矿藏，和一个500-1000矿物的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.b.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £minerals£ 3-5 Minerals and a cache of 500-1500 Minerals.

specialist.1150.c.zh: 合金？在这样的地方真是意外的收获。
specialist.1150.c.en: Alloys? That is unexpected from such a place.

specialist.1150.c.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£alloys£2-4合金的矿藏，和一个150-450合金的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.c.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £alloys£ 2-4 Alloys and a cache of 150-450 Alloys.

specialist.1150.d.zh: 如果那里有稀有水晶，那我们想要发现它们。
specialist.1150.d.en: If there are Rare Crystals to be found, we want to find them.

specialist.1150.d.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£rare_crystals£1-3稀有水晶的矿藏，和一个50-150稀有水晶的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.d.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £rare_crystals£ 1-3 Rare Crystals and a cache of 50-150 Rare Crystals.

specialist.1150.desc.zh:
在搜索我们控制的星系时，我们的一架无人机从[prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]获取了一些零散的读数。这个星系可能藏着什么我们意想不到的东西。

尽管信号混杂在一起，但它们可能暗示了几种不同的来源，我们的无人机很难同时搜索所有这些信号源。我们希望能够调查：
specialist.1150.desc.en:
While scouring the systems under our control, one of our drones picked up on a few scattered readings from [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. There might be more to this system than we originally thought.

Mixed as the signals were, they could be suggesting several different resources, and it will be difficult for our drones to search for all of them at once. We would prefer if they would look into:

specialist.1150.e.zh: 我们获得易爆微粒信号可不常见。
specialist.1150.e.en: It is not often we have signals from Volatile Motes.

specialist.1150.e.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£volatile_motes£1-3易爆微粒的矿藏，和一个50-150易爆微粒的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.e.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £volatile_motes£ 1-3 Volatile Motes and a cache of 50-150 Volatile Motes.

specialist.1150.f.zh: 异星天然气。那绝对是又奇怪又令人生趣。
specialist.1150.f.en: Exotic Gases. They are by definition exotic and interesting.

specialist.1150.f.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£exotic_gases£1-3异星天然气的矿藏，和一个50-150异星天然气的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.f.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £exotic_gases£ 1-3 Exotic Gases and a cache of 50-150 Exotic Gases.

specialist.1150.g.zh: 将泽珞放着不管实在是太危险了。
specialist.1150.g.en: Zro is too dangerous to be left alone.

specialist.1150.g.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£sr_zro£1泽珞的矿藏，和一个25-75泽珞的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.g.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £sr_zro£ 1 Zro and a cache of 25-75 Zro.

specialist.1150.h.zh: 暗物质信号成功激发了我们的兴趣。
specialist.1150.h.en: The Dark Matter signals have piqued our interest.

specialist.1150.h.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£sr_dark_matter£1暗物质的矿藏，和一个25-75暗物质的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.h.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £sr_dark_matter£ 1 Dark Matter and a cache of 25-75 Dark Matter.

specialist.1150.i.zh: 活体金属？这样一个机遇我们可没法视而不见。
specialist.1150.i.en: Living Metal? An opportunity too rare to ignore.

specialist.1150.i.tt.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£sr_living_metal£1活体金属的矿藏，和一个25-75活体金属的一次性贮藏。
specialist.1150.i.tt.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £sr_living_metal£ 1 Living Metal and a cache of 25-75 Living Metal.

specialist.900.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获取了一些奇怪的读数，很有可能表明其上有生命存在。由于这些信号较为微弱，而且在我们试图与之联系时毫无反应，所以如果想弄清真相，我们需要派出一支研究团队。
specialist.900.desc.en: We have picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. Given the weakness of these signals and the lack of response as we attempt to contact these lifeforms, we must send a research team if we are to figure out what might have happened.

specialist.900.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们捕捉到了一些来自[From.GetName]的读数，这可能意味着生命的存在。我们应该派遣一些[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]，搞清楚是什么在发射信号。
specialist.900.desc.gestalt.en: We have picked up some readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. We should send some [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] to look into whatever might be transmitting a signal.

specialist.905.desc.zh:
我们派遣往[From.GetName]的专家向我们发回了一份报告。[Root.SensorReadings]

[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]
specialist.905.desc.en:
We have received a report from the specialists we sent to [From.GetName]. [Root.SensorReadings]

[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]

specialist.905.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们位于[From.GetName]的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经探明了古怪读数产生的缘由。[Root.SensorReadings]

[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]
specialist.905.desc.gestalt.en:
Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] at [From.GetName] have found the cause of the unusual readings. [Root.SensorReadings]

[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]

specialist.910.desc.zh:
我们派遣往[From.GetName]的舰船向我们发回了态势更新。[Root.SensorReadings]

Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] at [From.GetName] have recently made great progress in tracking down the strange readings. [Root.SensorReadings]

[Root.SensorReadingsPhysics]

在[From.GetName]的团队有一些新消息要汇报。[Root.SensorReadings]

[Root.SensorReadingsRare]
specialist.920.desc.en:
The team at [From.GetName] has news to share with us. [Root.SensorReadings]

[Root.SensorReadingsRare]

specialist.920.desc.gestalt.zh: 有关我们位于[From.GetName]的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]的最新发现传来了好消息。
specialist.920.desc.gestalt.en: There's good news from [From.GetName] after our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural]' latest findings.

speed_up_core_conspiracy.zh: 暂时加快局势发展的速度。

spires_of_light_category_desc.zh: 初步扫描显示，一系列高耸发光结构耸立于一片平凡的地貌。其起源和用途仍不明确，但其幽光说示这不仅仅是自然现象。
spires_of_light_category_desc.en: Initial scans reveal a series of towering, luminescent structures rising from an otherwise unremarkable landscape. Their origin and purpose remain unclear, but their spectral glow suggests something more than a natural phenomenon.

spiritualist1.zh: 一个流浪的神秘主义者，[Root.GetHimHer]的智慧触动着周围的人。
spiritualist1.en: A wandering mystic whose wisdom touches all those around [Root.GetHimHer].

spiritualist1_catch_phrase.zh: “我会教导听话的人，也要听从教导人的人。”
spiritualist1_catch_phrase.en: "I will teach those who listen and listen to those who teach."
