spiritualist2.zh: 一位从失落文明中搜集知识的档案管理员。[Root.GetHeSheCap]在死寂的星球上挖掘古老的奇迹，在星际间漂流的废弃船只中寻找遗物。
spiritualist2.en: An archivist who seeks to gather knowledge from dead civilizations. [Root.GetHeSheCap] digs up ancient wonders on dead worlds, and looks for relics in abandoned ships that drift through the void between stars.

spiritualist2_catch_phrase.zh: “星海中蕴藏着无穷的知识，有的被隐藏，有的被埋葬，还有的则被遗忘。我们必须保护这些旧日的真理。”
spiritualist2_catch_phrase.en: "The galaxy contains knowledge hidden, buried, and forgotten. We must preserve the old truths."

spynetwork_auxiliaries_insight.zh: 擅长发现的辅助性特工

spynetwork_drain_resources_cutties.zh: “有创业精神”的特工断绝关系

stage_1_synthetic_fertility_synthesizati.zh: 现有的机器人将被用作我们数字化人口的合成躯体。
stage_1_synthetic_fertility_synthesizati.en: Existing robotics will be used as synthetic bodies for our digitized population.

stage_2_synthetic_fertility_synthesizati.zh: 我们将为剩余数字化人口制作新的机器人体。
stage_2_synthetic_fertility_synthesizati.en: We will build new robot bodies for our remaining digitized population.

stage_behemoth_finale_effects.zh: 选择一个强力的噬天巨兽升级。

stage_behemoth_finale_effects_regular.zh: 选择一个噬天巨兽升级。

stage_cyberization_effects.zh: 我们会努力强化我们自己。
stage_cyberization_effects.en: We will work to augment ourselves.

stage_cyberization_hive_effects.zh: 我们必须自行设计安装义体植入体，来进行自我转变。
stage_cyberization_hive_effects.en: We must design cybernetic implants, install them, and transform ourselves.

stage_cybernetic_creed_cyberization_effe.zh: 我们正在缓慢地推进我们的目标，即实现机器与[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]的神圣融合，这一目标我们世代追求。
stage_cybernetic_creed_cyberization_effe.en: We slowly augment our way to the sacred fusion of machine and [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] we have strived towards for generations.

stage_cybernetic_creed_the_conclave_effe.zh: 主教团正在商议实现神圣融合的正确方式。
stage_cybernetic_creed_the_conclave_effe.en: The Conclave is deliberating the correct way to achieve the divine fusion.

stage_digitization_effects.zh: 我们必须设计一个大脑的数字化代替品，建造机械身躯，完成自我的嬗变。
stage_digitization_effects.en: We must design a digital representation of the brain, construct machine bodies, and transform ourselves.

stage_edge_of_solar_system.zh: 炮弹正在接近我们的恒星系。
stage_edge_of_solar_system.en: The projectile is approaching our solar system.

stage_entered_solar_system.zh: 炮弹已经进入我们的恒星系。
stage_entered_solar_system.en: The projectile has entered our solar system.

stage_insight_gathering.zh: 我们正在为下一次领悟积累进度。一旦我们积累了足够多的进度，下一个突破性事件将为我们提供一个新的洞见科技。
stage_insight_gathering.en: We are gathering progress towards our next Insight. Once we gather enough, the next breakthrough event will provide us with a new Insight Technology.

stage_knights_effects.zh: 我们英勇的骑士应当着手开始一场新的试炼。
stage_knights_effects.en: Our brave knights shall embark on a new Quest.

stage_leviathan_3_tooltip.en: The final preparations will be made.

stage_shroud_forged_free_tooltip.zh:
子个体转化：高
解锁应对方案：$approach_shroud_forged_appease$

stage_stormfall_effects.zh: 我们必须学会如何操纵宇宙风暴。
stage_stormfall_effects.en: We must learn how to manipulate cosmic storms.

stage_synthetic_fertility_problem_effect.zh: 为了在现实世界中保持物理上的存在，我们必须开发具有复杂正电子大脑的尖端合成人身体。
stage_synthetic_fertility_problem_effect.en: To maintain a physical presence in the world, we must develop cutting-edge synthetic bodies with complex positronic brains.

stage_transformation_effects.zh: 我们必须评估结果，并实施最优的过程来改造自己。
stage_transformation_effects.en: We must evaluate the outcomes and implement the most optimal process to transform ourselves.

stage_unknown_effects.zh: 我们不知道在该阶段中会发生什么。
stage_unknown_effects.en: We are not sure what will happen during this Stage.

star_crossed_survivor_pod_poi_desc.zh: 从同伴的舱体中找回的坐标指向了这个恒星系。第二个救生舱漂浮在这里，其乘员不明。
star_crossed_survivor_pod_poi_desc.en: Coordinates recovered from the companion pod lead to this system. A second pod drifts here, its occupant unknown.

star_riders_hire.zh:
你将在接下来的5年中雇佣这支佣兵舰队。该舰队包括：

4艘巡洋舰
6艘炮艇
12艘掠袭艇
star_riders_hire.en:
You hire this mercenary fleet for a period of 5 years. It consists of:

4 Cruisers
6 Frigates
12 Raiders

station_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 这颗小行星的轨道上运行着一个小型空间站。似乎已经废弃。
station_asteroid_category_desc.en: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.

storm_unraveled_event_investigated.zh: 调查异常现象或发掘遗址。

storm_wing_hire.zh:
你将在接下来的5年中雇佣这支佣兵舰队。该舰队包括：

2艘巡洋舰
4艘炮艇
8艘掠袭艇
storm_wing_hire.en:
You hire this mercenary fleet for a period of 5 years. It consists of:

2 Cruisers
4 Frigates
8 Raiders

storms_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 可以看到这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中发生了大风暴。进行深入研究可能十分有价值。
storms_gasgiant_category_desc.en: Massive storms are visible in the upper atmosphere of this gas giant. It might be worth the effort to study them in more detail.

story.1.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

尽管它离智慧生物还有很大差距，但至少说明外星是有生命存在的。
story.1.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

While far from intelligent, there is life out there.

story.1.desc.evopred.zh:
我们并不孤独。[Root.GetName]第一次确定了宇宙中有其他生命的存在；微生物、外星生命，但[Root.GetHomeWorldName]并不是唯一一个演化的舞台。

一种莫名的饥渴从长久的沉眠中醒来，在我们的体内躁动不安地搅动。而我们的猎弓再度被拉开了。
story.1.desc.evopred.en:
We are not alone. For the first time, the [Root.GetName] has definitive proof that there is other life in the universe; microscopic, alien life, but [Root.GetHomeWorldName] was not the only planet where evolution occurred.

An instinctive hunger, long dormant, begins to stir within us. Once again, we hunt.

story.1.desc.gesta.zh: 我们确认了[Root.Capital.GetName]的生物圈之外存在低等有机生命。
story.1.desc.gesta.en: We have confirmed the existence of lower forms of organic life outside of [Root.Capital.GetName]'s biosphere.

story.1.desc.phile.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

这一生命的奇迹再次使[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的人们对第一次接触其他智慧生物满怀期待。
story.1.desc.phile.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

These little evolutionary marvels kindle in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people a renewed hope of first contact with intelligent beings.

story.1.desc.phobe.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

尽管它离智慧生物还有很大差距，但至少说明外星是有生命存在的。这是一个无法回避的现实，人们开始担心未来。
story.1.desc.phobe.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

While far from intelligent, there is life out there. An inescapable reality, and a deeply unsettling prospect.

story.1.desc.spiri.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

自从在[Root.Capital.GetName]之外发现了造物的奇迹，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]神秘学家们不断举办神秘仪式，试图得到更多的答案。
story.1.desc.spiri.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] theologians have been partaking in arcane rites since this first sign that divine providence extends outside of [Root.Capital.GetName], attempting to find new answers.

story.1.desc.term.zh: 检测到有机异形微生物。已按情况调整存在有机智慧异形概率的算法模型。如果他们真的存在，他们将会被发现。他们将会被消灭。
story.1.desc.term.en: Alien microbes of an organic nature have been detected. Models for the probability of organic alien sapients have been adjusted accordingly. If they exist, they will be found. They will be exterminated.

story.1.name.en: Contact Report: Simple Forms of Life

story.101.aa.amoebahunt.zh: 每消灭一支太空变形虫舰队可获得+1000£energy£
story.101.aa.amoebahunt.en: +1000 £energy£ for every Space Amoeba fleet destroyed

story.101.bb.exter.zh: 研究或许可以加速将来的消灭行动。
story.101.bb.exter.en: A study may expedite future extermination.

story.101.desc.fruitful.zh: 若得以安抚，它们可以成为我们种荚的理想携带者。
story.101.desc.fruitful.en: If pacified, they could prove themselves ideal carriers for our Seed Pods.

story.101.desc.gesta.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的太空生命。

尽管个体体型远远大于[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的护卫舰，这些“太空变形虫”兽群相对于我们的舰队依然弱小不堪。
story.101.desc.gesta.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

While significantly larger than a [Root.Owner.GetAdj] Corvette, these "Space Amoeba" herds are minuscule next to our full corpus.

story.101.desc.mater.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。
story.101.desc.mater.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are spaceborne forms of life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

story.101.desc.milit.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

这些生物对[Root.Owner.GetAdj]舰船表现出了敌意的行为，但我们授权进一步的研究。
story.101.desc.milit.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are spaceborne forms of life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following a tactician's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

The creature displays aggressive behavior towards [Root.Owner.GetAdj] ships but further study might be warranted.

story.101.desc.pacif.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遭遇的是一种从未见过的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

虽然它脾气很坏，但是想进一步研究也不是不行的——我们可以从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]远距离观察它们。
story.101.desc.pacif.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

Despite its apparent orneriness, further study is warranted - we can remotely monitor the creature and its kin from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

story.101.desc.phile.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的、美丽的、神奇的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

我们应该避免与它们接触，从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]远距离观察这些生物。
story.101.desc.phile.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, wondrous, forms of spaceborne life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

We should leave it be and remotely monitor the creature and its kin from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

story.101.desc.phobe.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的、骇人的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

终结这些憎恶异形苟活于世的苦难应该没有什么害处。

既是为了科学，也可以是为了其他什么。
story.101.desc.phobe.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, horrifying lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

There would be little harm in putting the monstrosities out of their misery.

For science, or some equivalent.

story.105.desc.zh:
太空变形虫——当为这种外星生物运用合适的分类方法来确定学名太过麻烦时，这个名称就被[Root.GetSpeciesName]的普罗大众沿用下来——是一种在太空中独居的生物。除了最幼小的那些个体以外，所有我们收集到的样本都拥有半独立的鞭毛和其他有机质，它们由变形虫本身产生并在液态的RNA分泌物中被设计，以方便宿主操纵。这些鞭毛可以被宿主操纵，甚至可以攻击宿主周围巨大但有限范围内的物体，并会定期的缩回变形虫体内，并被重新设计。

太空变形虫厚皮的再生特性，或鞭毛的精巧的运动模式都有着潜在的军事应用价值。
story.105.desc.en:
The Space Amoebas - the name has stuck as the pronunciation of the proper xeno-taxonomic denominator is too unwieldy for the average [Root.GetSpeciesName] - are solitary animals, when left to their own devices. All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent flagella, organisms spawned by the Amoeba and programmed through liquid, RNA-laced secretions to do the bidding of the host. These flagella are capable of manipulating and even attacking objects in an impressive yet restricted range around the host, periodically returning to lodge inside the host Amoeba's body for re-programming.

There are potential military applications to be found in the regenerative properties of the amoeba's thick hide, or in the flagella's graceful patterns of movement.

story.105.desc.gesta.zh: 一只太空变形虫通常伴随着一些半自主的鞭节，用于防御以及移动物体。变形虫与其鞭节并不共享意志，而是前者使用一种带有核糖核酸的分泌物来为后者编程，指引其完成较为复杂的任务。
story.105.desc.gesta.en: A Space Amoeba is usually accompanied by a handful of semi-independent flagella used for defense and object manipulation. The Amoeba and its flagella do not share a mind, the former instead using RNA-laced secretions to program the latter for the execution of tasks of middling complexity.

story.105.desc.pacif.zh:
太空变形虫——这个昵称在这些生物被发现之后，在[Root.Capital.GetName]彻底火起来了。它们是一种独自生活的生物。成年的太空变形虫的身边会伴随着一种被称为鞭毛的半自主生物。鞭毛是由太空变形虫所生成，并通过液态RNA分泌物来控制。

鞭毛一度被误会为太空变形虫的幼体，但其实它们并不含有繁殖器官，每个鞭毛更像是太空变形虫主体身上断开的肢体一般。这些鞭毛可以在离开主体的一定范围内攻击敌人，但每隔一段时间就需要回返太空变形虫体内被重新编译。
story.105.desc.pacif.en:
The Space Amoebas - the nickname became popular after the story of how it came to be found its way back to [Root.Capital.GetName] - are solitary animals, when left to their own devices. All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms, dubbed flagella, seemingly spawned by the Amoeba and programmed through liquid, RNA-laced secretions to do the bidding of the host.

Initially assumed to be young Space Amoebas, the flagella do not seem to factor into any reproductive mechanics, each individual flagellum instead operating solely as a disconnected limb for its host Amoeba. These flagella are capable of manipulating and even attacking objects in an impressive yet restricted range around the host, periodically returning to lodge inside the host Amoeba's body for re-programming.

story.105.desc.phile.zh:
太空变形虫——这个昵称现在已经传遍了[Root.Capital.GetName]的大街小巷——是一种独居的生物。成年的太空变形虫身边总会伴随着一种被称为鞭毛的半独立生物。鞭毛由变形虫自行生成，并通过分泌液态RNA来进行控制。

我们一度误以为这就是太空变形虫的幼体，但其实这些鞭毛并不含有繁殖器官，每个鞭毛更像是变形虫向外延伸的肢体。这些鞭毛可以在一定范围内离开主体并攻击敌人，但每隔一段时间就需要回返主体内进行重构。

太空变形虫厚皮的再生特性，或鞭毛的精巧的运动模式都有着潜在的军事应用价值。
story.105.desc.phile.en:
The Space Amoebas - the nickname now lovingly popularized on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are solitary animals, when left to their own devices. All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms, dubbed flagella, seemingly spawned by the Amoeba and programmed through liquid, RNA-laced secretions to do the bidding of the host.

Initially assumed to be young Space Amoebas, the flagella do not seem to factor into any reproductive mechanics, each individual flagellum instead operating solely as a disconnected limb for its host Amoeba. These flagella are capable of manipulating and even attacking objects in an impressive yet restricted range around the host, periodically returning to lodge inside the host Amoeba's body for re-programming.

There are potential military applications to be found in the regenerative properties of the amoeba's thick hide, or in the flagella's graceful patterns of movement.

story.107.a.fruitful.tooltip.zh: 我们的$sm_feeder$现在能吸引太空变形虫种群了。
story.107.a.fruitful.tooltip.en: Our $sm_feeder$ are now capable of attracting Space Amoeba fleets.

story.107.a.tooltip.zh:
添加$pacified_amoebas$修正。有如下效果：
太空变形虫现在处于非敌对状态
story.107.a.tooltip.en:
$pacified_amoebas$ modifier added, giving the following effects:
Space Amoeba fleets are rendered non-hostile

story.107.desc.zh:
处于太空变形虫群附近时，停止舰只反应核心的某些特定辐射的排放似乎可以避免将其激怒。

由于这一举措，他们已不再将我们视为威胁，我们也因此得以近距离对其进行观察。
story.107.desc.en:
Temporarily refraining from venting certain emissions from our vessels' reactor cores while in the immediate vicinity of Space Amoebas flocks seems to be enough to not arouse their ire.

With this new protocol in place they no longer pose a threat, and we have been able to study them at close range.

story.107.fruitful.desc.zh: 尽管它们是肉食性的，但我们的研究人员开发的肉质球果对它们的口味也很有吸引力。
story.107.fruitful.desc.en: While they are mostly carnivorous, the meaty, bulbous fruits our researchers developed appeal to their tastes.

story.2.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

这些生物似乎居住在深空之中。相比之下，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的极端微生物简直不值一提。
story.2.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms encountered some time ago.

Seemingly native to deep space, they make the extremophile creatures of [Root.Capital.GetName] appear frail by comparison.

story.2.desc.evopred.zh: [Root.GetName]遭遇了太空有机体！我们的[GetScientistPlural]还不确定为什么体型如此庞大的生物能够在严苛的宇宙真空中央演化，也不知道这些极端环境中的生物可能拥有何种基因适应性。我们已经迫不及待想知道了。
story.2.desc.evopred.en: The [Root.GetName] has encountered a space organism! Our [GetScientistPlural] do not yet know what caused such massive creatures to evolve in the harsh vacuum of space, nor what kind of genetic adaptations these extremophiles might possess. But we can't wait to find out.

story.2.desc.followup.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的人们平静地接收了对异常外星生物的报告。

真空中真的存在生命这一事实在[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学界引起了短暂的争议。不过在此之前已发现过低等生命，因此所有的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都并未感到震惊。
story.2.desc.followup.en:
The subjects of the [Root.GetName] receive the report of the encounter with new and unusual alien beings with relative calm.

The supposed vacuum habitat of the aliens sparked some short-lived controversy in certain circles of the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName], but the previous discovery of lower forms of life had largely prepared all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] for the shock.

story.2.desc.gesta.zh: 我们观测到了有机极端微生物在深空中遨游。
story.2.desc.gesta.en: We have observed extremophile organics navigating deep space.

story.2.desc.phile.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

这些生物似乎居住在深空之中。相比之下，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的极端微生物简直不值一提。尽管有些人持怀疑态度，但是遇见外星生命基本是意料之中的事情。虽然如此，但[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]外星生物学家仍然抑制不住激动，对这种生命体所承受的种种极端条件感到兴奋不已。
story.2.desc.phile.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms encountered some time ago.

Seemingly native to deep space, they make the extremophile creatures of [Root.Capital.GetName] appear frail by comparison. While some doubted, encountering alien life was ultimately expected and anticipated - but nothing could have prepared expectant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] xeno-biologists for the fascinatingly extreme conditions in which this life thrives.

story.201.aa.crystalhunt.zh: 每消灭一支晶态实体舰队可获得+500£minerals£
story.201.aa.crystalhunt.en: +500 £minerals£ for every Crystalline Entity fleet destroyed

story.201.desc.zh:
$story.201.desc.base$

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，毫无疑问它们具有可能的危险性，应该小心应对。

我们既可以选择直接与这些危险的生命体交火，也可以从远距离安全地观察它们。
story.201.desc.en:
$story.201.desc.base$

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with caution.

We can either attempt to engage with the potentially dangerous objects directly, or establish remote surveillance and observe them from a safe distance.

story.201.desc.fruitful.zh: 我们不确定这些生物是否进食，只要他们吃东西就可以当做我们种子的携带者。安抚他们可以让我们进行进一步的研究。
story.201.desc.fruitful.en: We're unsure these creatures are capable of eating, but if so, they could prove useful carrier for our seeds. Pacifying them would allow us to conduct further studies.

story.201.desc.milit.zh:
$story.201.desc.base$

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，毫无疑问它们具有可能的危险性，我们应该小心应对。

哪怕找不到什么战斗用途，我们研究一个被击碎的晶体肯定也会有一些有趣的发现。
story.201.desc.milit.en:
$story.201.desc.base$

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with caution.

Even should we not find a martial use for them, studying a shattered crystal would no doubt yield interesting results.

story.201.desc.pacif.zh:
$story.201.desc.base$

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，它们毫无疑问具有可能的危险性，我们应该小心应对。

既然我们不想冒险得罪这些晶体，那就从首都远距离监视它们吧。
story.201.desc.pacif.en:
$story.201.desc.base$

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with caution.

As we do not wish to risk coming into conflict with these prismatic enigmas, we ought to establish remote surveillance and observe them from the capital.

story.201.desc.phile.zh:
$story.201.desc.base$

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，这说明它们也许是以生命形式存在的——这样的现象毫无疑问令人好奇，但我们得要小心处理。

我们最杰出且聪敏的科学家们都准备好研究这些实体了。
story.201.desc.phile.en:
$story.201.desc.base$

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they might be alive - a fascinating prospect to be sure, but they should be approached with caution.

Our best and brightest are standing by to study these entities.

story.201.desc.phobe.zh:
$story.201.desc.base$

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，毫无疑问它们具有可能的危险性，我们应该小心应对。

我们最好派遣一支舰队试探这些晶体的侵略性，如果发现有威胁就把它们摧毁掉。
story.201.desc.phobe.en:
$story.201.desc.base$

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with extreme caution.

We should deploy a fleet to gauge the crystals' offensive strength, should they possess any, and destroy them if they are a threat.

story.205.aa.zh: 在战斗方面上有什么利用方法？

story.205.bb.zh: 听上去好像以后可能派上用场。

story.205.desc.zh:
晶态实体——这是[Root.Capital.GetName]的外星生物学家跟外星地质学家互相妥协后所确定的名字——它们似乎真的是生命体。

早期分析给它们起的名字是活体硅酸物质，因为它们跟生命体没什么共同之处。它们是一种单独生活的生物，每一个母体结晶通常只会带着一个哨兵以及一小队晶体军团。除了明显服从领袖命令的哨兵和军团之外，我们对于晶态实体的社会分层是一无所知。

晶体似乎不会繁殖，而且我们还没有发现它们的个体之间有明显的年龄差别。跟早前的推论不同，晶体的不同颜色与它们的年龄无关，而是受到内部的潜在变化而改变——而这种变化可以被释放出来——这种偶尔的波动会改变晶体的反射属性。
story.205.desc.en:
The Crystalline Entities - the name itself a compromise between rival factions of xeno-biologists and xeno-geologists on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are probably alive.

An earlier and perhaps more descriptive name for them was "silicate-animate matter," as they have little in common with biological life. They are solitary beings, each individual Crystal Sovereign rarely seen with more than a Sentinel and a smaller Cohort entity. Aside from the Cohort and Sentinel clearly being subservient to the Sovereign of the group, the subtle nuances of the Crystalline Entities' socio-hierarchical relationships are lost on us.

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge - which can be violently unleashed - and it appear as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal.

story.205.desc.gesta.zh:
晶态实体很可能是活的。

或许称它们为“硅酸活体物质”更为恰当，因为它们与常见的生物或是传统人造生命大相径庭。

这些实体似乎并不繁殖，并且我们所观察到的晶体在年龄上似乎都没有什么差别。与一个早期假设相反的是，晶态实体个体所发生的色调转变似乎与其年龄无关，而是受其潜在的内部电荷影响——而且可以被猛烈地释放——而偶尔产生的能源波动会改变晶体的折射特性。
story.205.desc.gesta.en:
The Crystalline Entities are probably alive.

A perhaps more descriptive name for them is "silicate-animate matter," as they have little in common with biological or traditionally artificial life.

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge - which can be violently unleashed - and it appear as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal.

story.205.desc.pacif.zh:
晶态实体——这是[Root.Capital.GetName]的外星生物学家跟外星地质学家互相妥协后所确定的名字——它们似乎真的是生命体。

早期分析给它们起的名字是活体硅酸物质，因为它们跟生命体没什么共同之处。它们是一种单独生活的生物，每一个母体结晶通常只会带着一个哨兵以及一小队晶体军团。除了明显服从领袖命令的哨兵和军团之外，我们对于晶态实体的社会分层可以说是一无所知。

晶体似乎不会繁殖，而且我们还没有发现它们的个体之间有明显的年龄差别。跟早前的推论不同，晶体的不同颜色与它们的年龄无关，而是受到内部的潜在变化而改变——而这种变化可以被释放出来——这种偶尔的波动会改变晶体的反射属性。晶态实体可以对指定的目标释放这种波动，而且很不幸的，它们似乎热衷于对任何靠近的陌生种群如此做。
story.205.desc.pacif.en:
The Crystalline Entities - the name itself a compromise between rival factions of xeno-biologists and xeno-geologists on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are probably alive.

An earlier and perhaps more descriptive name for them was "silicate-animate matter," as they have little in common with biological life. They are solitary beings, each individual Crystal Sovereign rarely seen with more than a Sentinel and a smaller Cohort entity. Aside from the Cohort and Sentinel clearly being subservient to the Sovereign of the group, the subtle nuances of the Crystalline Entities' socio-hierarchical relationships are lost on us.

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge, and it appears as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal. The Crystalline Entities are capable of violently discharging at specific target, and unfortunately seem to prefer to do so rather than let foreign entities pass by unscathed.

story.205.desc.phile.zh:
晶态实体——这是[Root.Capital.GetName]的外星生物学家跟外星地质学家互相妥协后所决定的名字——它们确实是生命体。

一部分过于保守的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]学术精英认为它们是“硅酸盐活性物质”，跟生命体没什么共同之处。

[Root.GetName]的大部分民众不认同这种观点，而是开始赞叹这种晶态实体所代表的新概念。它们是一种单独生活的生物，每一个母体结晶通常只会带着一个哨兵以及一小队晶体军团。除了明显服从领袖命令的哨兵和军团之外，我们对于晶态实体的社会分层是一无所知——这个课题在[Root.Capital.GetName]引发了一场热烈探讨。

晶体似乎不会繁殖，而且我们还没有发现它们的个体之间有明显的年龄差别。跟早前的推论不同，晶体的不同颜色与它们的年龄无关，而是受到内部的潜在变化而改变——而这种变化可以被释放出来——这种偶尔的波动会改变晶体的反射属性。
story.205.desc.phile.en:
The Crystalline Entities - the name itself a compromise between rival factions of xeno-biologists and xeno-geologists on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are most definitely alive.

Some overly-conservative members of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] academic elite argue that they are "silicate-animate matter," and that they have little in common with biological life.

Most of the [Root.GetName] populace rejects that regressive perspective, instead turning their view toward the fascinating new horizons that the Crystalline Entities represent. They are, somewhat regrettably, solitary beings, each individual Crystal Sovereign rarely seen with more than one Sentinel and a smaller Cohort entity. Aside from the Cohort and Sentinel clearly being subservient to the Sovereign of the group, the subtle nuances of the Crystalline Entities' socio-hierarchical relationships are lost on us - which does not stop these dynamics from being the subject of fevered study on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge - which can be violently unleashed - and it appear as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal.

story.207.a.fruitful.tooltip.zh: 我们的$sm_feeder$现在能吸引晶态实体种群了。
story.207.a.fruitful.tooltip.en: Our $sm_feeder$ are now capable of attracting Crystalline Entity fleets.

story.207.a.tooltip.zh:
添加$pacified_crystals$修正。有如下效果：
晶态实体现在处于非敌对状态
story.207.a.tooltip.en:
$pacified_crystals$ modifier added, giving the following effects:
Crystalline Entity fleets are rendered non-hostile

story.207.desc.zh: 晶态实体似乎会对特定的频率共振，这也是他们与环境之间少有的互动。发出电波的特性与目的目前尚未明确，但目前我们的舰船可以使用无线电进行模仿，并将自己伪装成晶态实体。
story.207.desc.en: The Crystalline Entities seem to resonate in response to something; one of their few interactions with their environment. The exact nature and possible wider purpose of this emitted waveform has yet to be ascertained, but for now our ships can approximate it using radio pings, essentially camouflaging themselves as fellow Crystals.

story.207.fruitful.desc.zh: 为这些生物培育美味的果实颇具挑战。我们还不确定它们是在吃我们创造的玻璃状的球果，还是只是因为被其光滑的表面所吸引而随身携带。无论如何这都能满足我们的需求了。
story.207.fruitful.desc.en: Developing a palatable fruit for these creatures has been a challenge. We're not sure if they're eating the glass-like pomes we created or if they just like to carry them around, enamored by their glossy surfaces. That's enough for our needs.

story.220.desc.gesta.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]观测到大量晶状生命体的出现。这很明显是某种巢穴——或者至少是晶状生命体的聚集地，就如在[From.GetName]有一个我们从未见过的晶状结构。

这个结构展现出了很多类似晶状生命体的性质，但它的体积大得吓人。
story.220.desc.gesta.en:
We see significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. Evidently some kind of den - or at least a hub of crystalline activity, such as it is - [From.GetName] is home to a crystal construct unlike any previously encountered.

This construct exhibits several properties associated with the crystalline entities, but greatly exaggerated.

story.220.desc.hostile.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告，在[From.GetName]星系中发现了大量晶态实体。至于其是否是生物的古代家园，目前尚无明确指征，但在同一星系中发现如此数量的晶态实体可谓是前所未见。

目前的读数表明，如果能够将这些不寻常的晶体结构……拆开的话，应该会拥有一定的研究价值，
story.220.desc.hostile.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports a significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. There is little to indicate whether this is an ancestral home of the creatures, but never before have this many crystalline entities been observed in one system at once.

Initial readings point to the unusual crystal construct in the system being of some interest, should we be able to... disassemble it.

story.220.desc.nonhostile.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告称在[From.GetName]星系中发现大量晶状生命体的存在。这很明显是某种巢穴——或者至少是晶状生命体的聚集地，就如在[From.GetName]有一个我们从未见过的晶状结构。

这个结构展现出了很多类似晶状生命体的性质，但它的体积大得吓人。
story.220.desc.nonhostile.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports a significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. Evidently some kind of den - or at least a hub of crystalline activity, such as it is - [From.GetName] is home to a crystal construct unlike any previously encountered.

This construct exhibits several properties associated with the crystalline entities, but greatly exaggerated.

story.222.desc.zh: 我们成功摧毁了[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]的晶态结构。过程比我们想象中更加艰难，并在期间回收了一些碎片供研究之用。这样一来，我们应该就能模仿战斗中遭遇的晶体矩阵展现出的再生特性了。
story.222.desc.en: We have destroyed the crystalline construct in the [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName] system. It proved hardier than expected, and some shards have been recovered for study. We should be able to emulate the reconstructive properties of the crystal matrix observed during the battle.

story.3.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上新闻满天飞，内容都是关于发现的外星生物。

尽管按照[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]标准来说，它们算不上是智慧生物，但它们的存在却否定了我们对生命的简单分类。它们提醒我们，宇宙是如此的复杂，蕴含了无尽的可能。
story.3.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien life that was found.

While hardly intelligent by [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] standards, the fascinating beings defy easy classification and hint at the immense complexities and possibilities of the universe.

story.3.desc.evopred.zh:
[Root.GetName]发现了新的复杂生命形式！这些生物可能不具备完全的只能，但我们的文明对各种各样的染色体样品总是来者不拒。

我们的[GetScientistPlural]已经着手计算需要多少数量的基因物质才足够让我们所有的人口都分一杯羹了。
story.3.desc.evopred.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered a new form of complex life! These creatures may not possess true sapience, but our civilization has always enjoyed sampling from a wide range of genomes.

Already, our [GetScientistPlural] are calculating the amount of genetic material needed to provide everyone with a taste.

story.3.desc.followup.zh:
在外星生物报告发布之后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]外星生物学家欣喜地发现这一复杂的生命体与[Root.Capital.GetName]上的并没有太大的不同。

这一生命物的出现否定了我们对生命的简单分类，但是它除了纯粹的动物本能之外也没有什么特别之处。尽管如此，它却告诉我们，生命的某些形式是普遍存在的。
story.3.desc.followup.en:
Following previous reports on alien life, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] xeno-biologists are pleased to learn to complex life forms that appear not too different from what we would find on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The beings still defy easy classification and hardly possess anything more than purely animal instincts, but their existence does indicate that some patterns of life are indeed universal.

story.3.desc.gesta.zh: 我们在外星星球上发现了动物。
story.3.desc.gesta.en: We have confirmed animal life on an alien world.

story.3.desc.spiri.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]上的教士们普遍对找到外星有机体——虽然较为低等——一事表示了认可。

不过这一发现也引发了对教义的争论——这是可作为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是万物之主的证明，又或者我们只是还没有在深空之外遇见我们的同胞？
story.3.desc.spiri.en:
The priesthoods on [Root.Capital.GetName] had a generally favorable reaction to the reports of complex - yet dumb - organisms found on alien planets.

The findings did spark some inter-doctrinal debate - is this proof that the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are the lords of all within creation, or have we simply not yet encountered our brethren from beyond the void?

story.301.desc.gesta.zh:
我们遭遇的深空无人机似乎是自动轨道采矿作业的工人和监工。根据加工设备的状况来判断，这些采矿作业似乎开始于数千年前，然后很快被抛弃，只留下了无人机继续运作。这些无人机拥有强力的采矿激光，并且在我们试图靠近时表现出了明显具有威胁性，甚至是侵略性的举动。

或许它们只是些老旧的无人机，但仍应该密切观察它们。
story.301.desc.gesta.en:
The deep-space drones we have encountered appear to be the workers and custodians of autonomous orbital mining operations. Judging by the state of the processing equipment, these sites were established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves. The drones possess powerful mining lasers and make obviously threatening, if not outright hostile, overtures toward us when approached.

They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch.

story.301.desc.mater.zh:
我们在某个恒星系里发现了深空无人机，这些无人机似乎是千年以前进行自动轨道采矿作业的矿机和监视用机器，但在不久之后采矿行动就被人放弃了，只剩无人机在继续运作。它们的功能很明确——采矿——但是是谁下的命令，目前我们还不得而知，很显然没有任何矿物在百年乃至千年内曾从这个恒星系出口过。

尽管这些可能只是老旧的无人机，但是[Root.Owner.GetName]还是应该注意一下它们。
story.301.desc.mater.en:
Reports of deep-space drones in certain systems have been investigated. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment. Their purpose is obvious enough - mining - but who it is that tasked them is not immediately apparent. What is obvious is that no shipment of minerals has been retrieved from this system in hundreds, if not thousands of years.

They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch by the [Root.Owner.GetName].

story.301.desc.pacif.zh:
我们在某个恒星系里发现了深空无人机。这些无人机似乎是千年以前进行自动轨道采矿作业的矿机和监视用机器，但在不久之后采矿行动就被人放弃了，只剩无人机在继续运作。

这些无人机似乎没有任何通讯协议——至少没有[Root.Owner.GetName]能破译的协议——并对进入了恒星系的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]飞船采取了攻击行为。

在[Root.System.GetName]发现这种无人机实在是喜人的收获，我们应该进一步研究一下。
story.301.desc.pacif.en:
Reports of deep-space drones in certain systems have been investigated. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment.

The drones seem to lack any diplomatic comms protocols - at least any decipherable by the [Root.Owner.GetName] - and react with hostility to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] ships entering the system.

Their presence in the [Root.System.GetName] system is intriguing, and we should attempt to learn more about them.

story.305.bb.zh: 真是神妙的自动装置啊。

story.305.desc.zh:
无人机在他们所在的小行星上永无休止的对不断减少的资源进行开采，这一单调的过程很值得研究。[Root.Capital.GetName]上的复合矿场可以从中学到如何在保存能源的同时最大化的提取矿物。

此外，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会偶尔发射声脉冲信号，而且这些声脉冲信号的波长很难和背景杂音区分开，是否有人收到这些声脉冲就不得而知了。
story.305.desc.en:
The drones and their tireless, endless work of extracting ever-diminishing resources from their local planetoids make for a somewhat dull, but nevertheless informative subject of study. In fact, Mining Networks on [Root.Capital.GetName] could stand to learn a thing or two about maximizing mineral extraction rates while conserving energy.

Additionally, we have found that the drones are not completely silent. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

story.305.desc.gesta.zh:
无人机在其小行星上永无休止地对不断减少的资源进行开采。对其进行研究的过程较为枯燥，但仍具有研究价值。事实上，我们可以学到如何在最大化开采效率的同时减少能源消耗。

另外，我们发现无人机并非完全处于静默。它们会发出脉冲信号，不过频率极低并且波长很难与背景杂讯区分开来。是否有人在接收这些脉冲信号就不得而知了。
story.305.desc.gesta.en:
The drones and their tireless, endless work of extracting ever-diminishing resources from their local planetoids make for a somewhat dull, but nevertheless informative subject of study. In fact, we could stand to learn a thing or two about maximizing mineral extraction rates while conserving energy.

Additionally, we have found that the drones are not completely silent. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. Whether there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery better left for another time.

story.305.desc.mater.zh:
这些无人机的挖掘效率比十分优秀，要是[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的矿工的话，这些地方可能早就被认为是挖无可挖了。我们的高级工程师正在将这些无人机的运作方式应用在[Root.GetName]的复合矿场和太空港中以增加我们的采矿效率，减少能源浪费。

但有趣的是，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会发射出声脉冲信号，虽然不是非常频繁，但用的却是一种很难从杂音中识别出的信号。不知道这些信号到底是发给谁的。
story.305.desc.mater.en:
The drones are remarkably efficient at squeezing ever-diminishing returns from rocks [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] miners would have soon discarded, deemed exhausted of all worthwhile mineral content. Our top engineers are working on adapting the drones' methodology for use in the [Root.GetName]'s Mining Networks and Stations which should improve efficiency, effectively lessening energy expenditure.

Of lesser import is the fact that the drones are not completely silent, contrary to previous assumptions. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

story.305.desc.pacif.zh:
除了对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]飞船进行威胁的时候，这些无人机只会进行机械化的采矿工作。

但有趣的是，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会发射出声脉冲信号，不知道这些信号到底是发给谁的。
story.305.desc.pacif.en:
When not posturing with their mining lasers aimed at [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships, the drones appear steadfast and dumbly hard-working, hacking away at mineral-poor asteroids for want of something better to do.

What is more interesting is that the drones are not completely silent, contrary to earlier assumptions. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

story.330.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系发现了大量的古代采矿无人机。看来这里曾是一个巨大的采矿与矿石处理中心，甚至可能是整个星系中最后一个类似的存在。
story.330.desc.en: The [Root.GetName] has encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.

story.330.desc.gesta.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]星系发现了大量的古代采矿无人机。看来这里是一个巨大的采矿与矿石处理中心，甚至可能是整个星系中最后一个类似的存在。
story.330.desc.gesta.en: We have encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.

story.332.desc.zh: 我们摧毁了采矿无人机基地，并成功取回了其中储存的大部分经过加工的矿产和珍贵的合金。
story.332.desc.en: We have destroyed the Mining Drone base, and managed to recover most of its stores of processed minerals and precious alloys.

story.335.desc.zh: 我们已经用勘探器遗珍的强力扫描光束扫描了我们的领土，并且在[chosen_planet.GetName]上发现了一个以前不为人知的资源储藏！
story.335.desc.en: We have swept our space with the strong scanning beam of the Surveyor relic, and a previously unknown resource deposit has been identified on [chosen_planet.GetName]!

story.4.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上新闻满天飞，内容都是不久前遭遇的外星生物。

这一生命体已经接近智慧生物了，真是令人兴奋不已。但我们也要清楚地认识到，尽管[Root.GetName]才刚刚登上星系的舞台，但这一切已经是相当大的进展。
story.4.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien beings encountered some time ago.

Their near-intelligence is fascinating, and it is sobering to realize that while the [Root.GetName] may only just have made its entrance on the galactic stage, we have already come a long way.

story.4.desc.evopred.zh: 我们发现了也只是全新的外星生命形式。这些生物比[GetHomeWorldName]上生活着的打大多数生命都要复杂，具有接近智慧水平的智力。我们已经开始建立必要的后勤和克隆程序来处理这些诱人的新基因组。
story.4.desc.evopred.en: We have uncovered a new form of alien life. These creatures are more complex than most of those that live on [GetHomeWorldName], with an intelligence that borders on sapience. We have already begun to establish the logistical and cloning routines necessary to process these tantalizing new genomes.

story.4.desc.followup.zh:
多次发现低等生物后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]首都收到的消息称他们观察到一种非常神奇同时具有莫大进化潜力的生物。

此报告受到了极大的重视。
story.4.desc.followup.en:
Following previous discoveries of lower forms of life, the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capital receives news of the observation of beings with impressive, if latent, cognitive capabilities and great evolutionary potential.

The report is received with marked enthusiasm.

story.4.desc.gesta.zh: 我们确认了即将进化出自我意识的外星生物的存在。
story.4.desc.gesta.en: We have confirmed the existence of alien lifeforms on the evolutionary brink of consciousness.

story.4.desc.phile.zh:
在遭遇外星生命后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]新闻网铺天盖地的都是人们对此事的争论。

该生物的智慧令人叹为观止。我们还要清楚地认识到，尽管[Root.GetName]才刚刚登上星系的舞台，但这一切已经是相当大的进展。大多数[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都同意我们有责任和义务帮助其他的物种踏上同样的道路，不过前提是他们已经做好了准备。
story.4.desc.phile.en:
The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] newsnets are ablaze with discussion and debate over the alien beings encountered some time ago.

The creatures' intelligence is fascinating, and it is sobering to realize that while the [Root.GetName] may only just have made its entrance on the galactic stage, we have already come a long way. Most [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] agree that it is an obligation and our moral duty to help other races make the same journey, when they are ready.

story.4.desc.phobe.zh:
观测到外星动物一事在[Root.Capital.GetName]上造成了恐慌。视频中有一些东西——它们沉重的脚步和空洞的眼神——引起了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]民众深深的不安。

它们是不是外星的并不重要，重要的是外星生物学家们坚定地认为它们和我们非常相似。这简直就是一个扭曲的镜像，向[Root.GetName]展示着我们试图遗忘的，步履蹒跚的进化之路。
story.4.desc.phobe.en:
The alien animals that were observed are cause for some consternation on [Root.Capital.GetName]. There is something in the video feeds - of their plodding gait and blank stares - that deeply disturbs the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] populace.

Perhaps it is not their alien nature that concerns, but the xeno-biologists' insistence that they are very much like us. A warped mirror image of a shambling evolutionary past that the [Root.GetName] would rather forget.

story.4.desc.spiri.zh:
遭遇外星生命后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]宗教事务团体纷纷奔走相告。

该生物的智慧令人叹为观止。我们还要清楚地认识到，也许[Root.GetName]才刚刚登上星系的舞台，但这已经是相当大的进展。[Root.Capital.GetName]上出现了激烈的争论，如果他们已经有了足够智慧并准备探索星空，我们到底应不应该为其引路。
story.4.desc.spiri.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] congregations are buzzing with activity following news of the alien beings encountered some time ago.

The creatures' intelligence is fascinating, and it is sobering to realize that while the [Root.GetName] may only just have made its entrance on the galactic stage, we have already come a long way. There is heated debate on [Root.Capital.GetName] whether it would be our place to shepherd these creatures, should they ever achieve sapience and reach for the stars.

story.401.a.spiri.zh: 不管它是不是与神灵有关的媒介，我们都要研究它。
story.401.a.spiri.en: Conduit for the divine or not, it must be studied.

story.401.c.en: Let us watch, but not interfere with it.

story.401.desc.zh:
一项对此前以[This.ContactCountry.GetName]为代称的一堆残骸和太空尘埃的调查居然得到了惊人的发现：微粒聚集而成的云体，散发着未知的强大能源，它原本连反射性动作都不应该做出，更不要说是自主移动了。

但它确实在自主地移动着。

这份录像中移动的飘渺物体透着一股不祥之兆，或许这个宇宙里有一些东西是我们不该去碰的。
story.401.desc.en:
An investigation into a peculiar cluster of debris and space-dust previously dubbed [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has yielded surprising results; it is a particulate cloud bristling with a powerful charge of unknown origin that has no business exhibiting simple reflexive actions, let alone movements with purpose.

And yet it does.

There is something undeniably ominous about the hazy subject of the relayed video feeds. Perhaps there are things in the universe we should not tangle with.

story.401.desc.gesta.zh:
一项对此前以[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指代的一堆残骸和太空尘埃的调查居然得到了惊人的发现：它是一团由微粒聚集而成的云体，蕴含着来源不明的强大能源。它原本连反射性动作都不应该做出，更不要说是自主移动了。

可它确实在自主移动。

这份录像中移动的飘渺物体透着一股不祥之兆，或许这个宇宙里有一些东西是我们不该去碰的。
story.401.desc.gesta.en:
Our investigation into the peculiar cluster of debris and space-dust with the designation [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has yielded surprising results: it is a particulate cloud bristling with a powerful charge of unknown origin. It has no business exhibiting simple reflexive actions, let alone movements with purpose.

And yet it does.

There is something undeniably ominous about the hazy subject of the relayed video feeds. Perhaps there are things in the universe we should not tangle with.

story.401.desc.spiri.zh:
“如云，”一份从多个材料整合出来的报道上写着，“如云般的光辉星辰在暗潮中汹涌”。这份报告描述的极具诗意的现象是“虚空之云”。

对于[Root.Owner.GetName]的祭司来说，这些星云是被某种更伟大的意志所驱动的信使，目前没有人知道在背后操控虚空之云的到底是谁或是什么，在确定虚空之云的来龙去脉之前，还是不要轻举妄动为好。
story.401.desc.spiri.en:
"A cloud," reads the awed report, collated from multiple sources. "Like a cloud of luminous star-stuff, billowing in the dark." The report goes on to refer to the phenomenon, somewhat poetically, as a "void cloud."

It is evident to the priesthoods of the [Root.Owner.GetName] that these clouds are heralds animated by some higher will. Exactly who or what this will belongs is the subject of heated debate, and is likely to remain so for the foreseeable future. Until such time as the Void Cloud's true nature can be ascertained, it would perhaps be prudent to treat the immense power evident in its roiling motion with some caution.

story.405.b.en: They will not stand in our way.

story.405.desc.zh:
目前，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的研究者认为虚空之云是宇宙中最古老的存在，它们似乎是在宇宙诞生仅仅几十亿年后出现的，这是年轻宇宙用强大的力量凭空创造出来的产物，它们本可以成为恒星，但却没有。

想要解释它们那种原始的动物本能更是困难，但答案的关键可能就在将它们紧密结合在一起的异常强大的电磁场中——这也是在它们出现的时候就存在的东西。可以预见，只要有足够的时间，它奇怪的星尘和引力场循环将会变得和神经回路一样。

还有，尽管彼此之间相距数光年的距离，虚空之云似乎在互相发送脉冲波，这之中可能存在量子纠缠的现象。
story.405.desc.en:
The Void Clouds are, as far as [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] researchers can tell, among the oldest entities in the universe. They seem to have originated just a scant few billion years after matter as we know it first appeared, the tremendous forces of the young cosmos making something out of nothing. They would have been stars once, but were not.

Explaining their apparent animal intelligence is more difficult, but the answer might lie in the abnormally strong electromagnetic fields that keep them together - another product of their primordial beginnings. It is not inconceivable that, given enough time, the circulation of its strange stardust and gravitic fields aligned in a flexible approximation of neural pathways.

Moreover, the Clouds seem to be receiving impulses from one another, if not outright communicating, lightyears apart. Quantum entanglement is suspected to play a role in this phenomenon.

story.405.desc.gesta.zh:
虚空之云可能是宇宙中最古老的存在之一。在宇宙中刚开始形成物质之后仅仅数十亿年里，它们似乎就已经出现了，这是年轻宇宙用强大的力量凭空创造出来的产物，它们本可以成为恒星，但却没有。

它们动物般的智慧可能更加难以解释，但答案或许就在维持其形态的强大电磁场中——另一个宇宙诞生之初的产物。只要有足够长的时间，它奇怪的星尘与引力场循环完全有可能会形成类似神经网络或是计算机电路的东西。

而且，这些虚空之云似乎在互相发送脉冲信号，甚至可能是在进行沟通，尽管彼此之间的距离以光年计算。我们怀疑这一现象可能与量子纠缠有关。
story.405.desc.gesta.en:
The Void Clouds may be among the oldest entities in the universe. They seem to have originated just a scant few billion years after matter as we know it first appeared, the tremendous forces of the young cosmos making something out of nothing. They would have been stars once, but were not.

Explaining their apparent animal intelligence is more difficult, but the answer might lie in the abnormally strong electromagnetic fields that keep them together - another product of their primordial beginnings. It is not inconceivable that, given enough time, the circulation of its strange stardust and gravitic fields aligned in a flexible approximation of neural pathways or computational circuits.

Moreover, the Clouds seem to be receiving impulses from one another, if not outright communicating, lightyears apart. Quantum entanglement is suspected to play a role in this phenomenon.

story.405.desc.spiri.zh:
虚空之云是宇宙的观察者，在了解了虚空之云的特征之后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的宇航员在宇宙各地都发现了虚空之云的踪迹。

它们产生于万物初始的时候，观察着恒星闪耀、行星新生。现在它们在宇宙间漫无目的地移动着，似乎在有意识地收集过去留下的残骸，在死去的恒星和破碎的世界之间漂流。

它们的存在时刻提醒着我们自己是多么的渺小。
story.405.desc.spiri.en:
The Void Clouds are stewards of the cosmos. Once [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] astronomers knew what to look for, they found traces of the Void Clouds everywhere.

Formed at the dawn of creation, they stood watch as stars were lit and young planets formed. Now they drift, quasi-conscious agglomerations of inanimate matter from the earliest hours of time itself, afloat between dying stars and breaking worlds.

They are a constant reminder that we are but all small parts of something greater.

story.5.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的人对新近发现外星遗迹的消息议论纷纷。

这些痕迹被视为外星人曾经存在并活跃过的铁证——我们现在虽然是孤独的，但至少我们不是第一个踏上星空的。
story.5.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien remnants that were recently studied.

These remains are considered definitive proof of intelligent, purposeful alien activity at some point in the past - we may still be alone now, but we are at least not the first to be so.

story.5.desc.followup.zh:
“智能生物找不到伴”一则热门的新闻文章出现在[Root.Capital.GetName]上。[Root.GetName]的人们认为大家的注意力都集中在一些低等外星生物上，而真正有智能的外星种群却依然“戴着它们神秘的面纱”。

最近发现关于外星生物痕迹的报告似乎只是为整件事情增添了一些讽刺意味。
story.5.desc.followup.en:
"Intelligent life taunts with pointed absence" reads a popular newsnet post on [Root.Capital.GetName]. The people of the [Root.GetName] are apparently finding some humor in the fact that lower forms of alien life are now a matter of public record, but potential equals from other stars continue to elude us.

The report on the traces of alien life that were recently found seemingly only add an ironic twist to the situation.

story.5.desc.gesta.zh: 我们在异星上发现了智慧外星生物存在的证据。
story.5.desc.gesta.en: We have confirmed the first material traces of intelligent alien life on a foreign world.

story.5.desc.phile.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]外星研究学家们很激动地发表了他们对近期外星生命发现的看法。

这阵科学界的风暴对其他领域造成了暂时的负面影响。
story.5.desc.phile.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] xenologists are practically falling over themselves to publish their takes on the recent findings of alien life.

This fevered storm in the scientific community has had some negative, yet temporary, impact on pursuits in other fields.

story.5.desc.phobe.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]上的有关部门对近日收到的关于外星遗迹的报告表示了一定忧虑。

这些痕迹被广泛视为某种生命曾经活跃于宇宙的舞台上的铁证，不过一些著名的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]专家认为这些痕迹其实只是地质构造现象或者大自然的自然变化。
story.5.desc.phobe.en:
The administration on [Root.Capital.GetName] received the report on the alien remnants with some apprehension.

The remains in question are now widely considered to be definitive proof of unknown forces once having been active in the galaxy, though some prominent [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] thinkers reject this in favor of identifying the traces as "freak geological formations" or "results of curious natural phenomena."

story.501.a.mater.zh: 捕猎他们也捞不到什么好处。
story.501.a.mater.en: Hunting them would be a net loss anyway.

story.501.desc.gesta.zh:
我们称之为“缇扬奇”的太空生物十分温顺。它们可以进入低维度的亚空间，因此可以轻易地在星系之间遨游。

它们以气态巨行星外层常见的气体为食。这不太可能是它们唯一的食物来源，但到目前为止尚未观察到其他的进食方式。

它们不会主动进攻，因此可以安全地无视它们。
story.501.desc.gesta.en:
The spaceborne lifeforms - which we call "Tiyanki" - are docile creatures. Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, they roam from system to system with remarkable ease.

They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants. It is highly unlikely, to say the least, that this is their only food source, but intake of other nutrients has yet to be observed.

They will not attack unless provoked. They can safely be ignored.

story.501.desc.spiri.zh:
圣者们将那个漂浮在黑暗中的存在称为“缇扬奇”。他们是神圣而酷爱和平的太空生命体，从一个恒星系漫步到另一个恒星系，依靠众多气态巨行星上表面的常见气体进食，几乎不会有任何表现敌意的情况。

我们应该与其保持距离，以示敬意。
story.501.desc.spiri.en:
The Diviners name the beings, floating through the dark, "Tiyanki." They are a sacred and peaceful spaceborne life form that roams from system to system, feeding on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants, and rarely showing any signs of hostility.

We are to keep at a respectful distance.

story.6.desc.zh:
我们的舰队发现[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的消息传遍了[Root.GetName]。

虽然仍未掌握太空旅行的能力，但[primitive_planet.GetName]上的外星人已具有足够的智慧，而且他们的社会也具备了先进文明的所有特征。
story.6.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization found by our fleets.

They may not be capable of space-flight, but the aliens of the [primitive_planet.GetName] are quantifiably intelligent and their society shows all the hallmarks of a moderately advanced culture.

story.6.desc.evopred.zh:
我们发现了智慧生物！我们的一艘飞船遇见了一个[GetPreFTLLower]文明，这说明我们在虚空之中并不孤独。此外我们还缺人了他们的染色体很适合吸收。

我们已经考虑了无数选项，包括精心计算的观测或者直接的入侵。我们的关系最终会变成什么样还有待观察，但种种可能性毫无疑问相当可口。
story.6.desc.evopred.en:
We have discovered intelligent life! One of our vessels encountered a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization, which proves that we are not alone in the void. We have also confirmed that their genome is ripe for absorption.

Already, numerous options are being considered, from calculated observation to outright invasion. What form our relationship eventually takes remains to be seen, but the possibilities are certainly appetizing.

story.6.desc.followup123.zh: 相比往常发现的非智慧生命，这次我们的舰队发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星种群[primitive_planet.GetName]的报告无疑重新燃起了[Root.Capital.GetName]对外星科学的兴趣，在此之前这个领域向来被视为不过是纸上谈兵。
story.6.desc.followup123.en: Effectively capping off previous discoveries of lower forms of life, the report on the [GetPreFTLLower] aliens of [primitive_planet.GetName], encountered by our fleets has reignited interest in the xenological sciences on [Root.Capital.GetName], previously considered a largely theoretical field.

story.6.desc.followup4.zh:
发现[GetPreFTLLower]文化的报告受到了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]研究者们的欢迎，而这一发现紧跟在发现未开化物种之后。

[Root.GetName]目前是我们知道的首个踏上星空的文明，但是发现有其他文明仅仅落后我们数个纪元甚至只是数个世纪真的让人非常激动。
story.6.desc.followup4.en:
The report on a [GetPreFTLLower] culture is welcomed by [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] researchers, following previous discoveries relating to pre-sapient species.

As far as we are aware the [Root.GetName] is the first civilization to take to the stars, but it is fascinating to learn that some other cultures may only be a few millennia, or possibly even centuries, behind.

story.6.desc.followup5.zh:
发现智慧外星生命令[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学界欢呼雀跃。

尽管仍未掌握太空旅行的能力，但[primitive_planet.GetName]上的外星人已具有足够的智慧，而且他们的社会也具备了先进文明的所有特征。著名外星研究学者表示，之前只能研究古代的遗迹，而现在确是一次研究外星社会的绝好机会。
story.6.desc.followup5.en:
The scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] is excited to receive the report on intelligent alien life.

They may not be capable of space-flight, but the aliens of [primitive_planet.GetName] are quantifiably intelligent and their society shows all the hallmarks of a moderately advanced culture. Prominent xenologists note that this is an excellent opportunity to study a society perhaps not unlike the ones we have previously only found ancient remains of.

story.6.desc.gesta.zh: 我们确认了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们仍不具备超光速旅行能力，被自身分裂的个性所阻碍。
story.6.desc.gesta.en: We have confirmed the existence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien culture. They have yet to develop FTL capability, handicapped as they are by their fragmented individuality.

story.6.desc.phile.zh:
我们舰队观测到[GetPreFTLLower]文明的报告得到了[Root.GetName]上的学术精英们在维持自己体面的范围内最大限度的狂欢庆贺。

于此，我们终于可以证明[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]走向漆黑星空的试探性一步并不会一无所获。他们也许暂时比不上我们，甚至我们这一辈的人都不会跟他们直接交流，但光是他们存在本身都是一盏能够照亮这个空荡荡静悄悄的宇宙的希望明灯。
story.6.desc.phile.en:
The report on the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization observed by our fleets is received with something as close to exultant jubilation as the academic elite of the [Root.GetName] will allow themselves to express.

Here, finally, is proof that the first tentative [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] steps into the darkness of space were not for naught. They may not be our equals, not yet, and it may be that we will not interact directly with them in our lifetimes, but their mere existence is a beacon of hope in a galaxy that otherwise appears deadened and unmoving.

story.6.desc.phobe.zh:
[GetPreFTLLower]生物，也就是所谓的[primitive_planet.GetName]文明，它们展现出基础智慧的新闻在[Root.Capital.GetName]上并不受人待见。

一种深刻的不安情绪弥漫在公共辩论中，少数人大声疾呼，主张要不择手段建立[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]对外星星球的霸权，而大多数[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]似乎不愿意提起外星生物或完全忘记它们。
story.6.desc.phobe.en:
News of the [GetPreFTLLower] creatures exhibiting rudimentary intelligence - the so-called civilization of [primitive_planet.GetName] - is not received well on [Root.Capital.GetName].

A profound sense of unease permeates the public debate, as a vocal minority advocates establishing [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] hegemony over the alien planet by any means necessary, while most [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would seemingly prefer to avoid the alien creatures or forget about them entirely.

story.7.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]没过多久便遭遇了外星智慧生命。

舰队发给[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]首都的报告很简单随意地描述了这些生物，还顺口提到了错失跟它们交流的机会。
story.7.desc.en:
It did not take long for the [Root.GetName] to come across intelligent alien life.

The fleet's report to the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capital somewhat understates just how alien these forces appear, and only in passing mentions the failure to open comms.

story.7.desc.evopred.zh:
我们发现了具有太空航行能力的生命。

这一里程碑式的发现点燃了许多哲学和伦理争论：如果这些生物包含着能吸收的基因，我们应该强取豪夺，还是礼貌索要呢？只需要对自愿给予的样本进行克隆就足以满足我们整个人口所需的物质。

与这些有智慧的探索者们第一次接触的结果应该会帮助我们解答这些问题。
story.7.desc.evopred.en:
We have encountered life capable of space-flight.

This momentous discovery has accelerated many philosophical and ethical debates: if these creatures possess genes we can absorb, should we take them by force, or do we ask politely? Cloning freely-given samples could provide us with enough material for our entire population.

The result of first contact with these intelligent explorers should help determine the answer.

story.7.desc.followup12345.zh: 外星人飞船的消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]之后，可说是为[Root.GetName]踏往群星帝国的初章画上了一个圆满的句号。
story.7.desc.followup12345.en: News of alien ships humming through the ether has reached [Root.Capital.GetName], in many ways ending the first chapter of the [Root.GetName]'s bid for a stellar empire.

story.7.desc.followup6.zh:
我们遭遇了可以进行太空航行的智慧生命。

跟之前[Root.GetName]观察到的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种不同，我们甚至还未能看清楚这些驾驶着飞船穿越深空的生物，也不清楚他们的目的。
story.7.desc.followup6.en:
We have now encountered intelligent life capable of space-flight.

In sharp contrast to the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] previously observed by the [Root.GetName], we have yet to get a good look at the beings piloting the crafts that move through the dark with purpose unknown.

story.7.desc.gesta.zh: 我们遭遇了高等外星生命。接触似乎不可避免。
story.7.desc.gesta.en: We have encountered advanced alien life. Contact seems inevitable.

story.7.desc.mach.followup12345.zh: 我们曾观察到拥有先进航天能力的外星飞船经过。尽管仍未与其取得联系，但可以确定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不是星系中唯一有能力探索太空的帝国。
story.7.desc.mach.followup12345.en: We have observed the passage of alien vessels capable of advanced spaceflight. While communications have not yet been established, we can confirm that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not the only empire in the galaxy capable of stellar exploration.

story.7.desc.phile.zh:
[Root.GetName]终于遭遇了星空中的其他流浪者。

虽然不知道这些外星人的意图，但是[Root.Capital.GetName]在收到舰队的报告后简直可用四海欢腾来形容。终于有人可以来见证一切了！
story.7.desc.phile.en:
The [Root.GetName] has finally encountered fellow wanderers among the stars.

Whatever the intentions of these aliens, the atmosphere on [Root.Capital.GetName] can best be described as rapturous. At last, someone to bear witness!

story.7.desc.phobe.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]在收到发现未知飞船的消息后彻底沸腾了。

目前尚不知道对方的目的，所以还是做好应对最坏情况的准备。
story.7.desc.phobe.en:
[Root.Capital.GetName] is in an uproar following the news of unidentified ships sighted in the void.

Their intentions unknown, it would be prudent to assume the worst.

story.7.name.zh: 接触报告：神秘的太空旅人

story.8.a.zh: 难道就只有这黑暗了吗？
story.8.a.en: Is this darkness all that exists?

story.8.b.zh: 我们只是尘埃虫豸之辈而已。
story.8.b.en: We are but motes of dust.

story.8.d.zh: 信息已收到。正在更新数据库。

story.8.desc.zh:
在虚空中发现巨大生物一事使得[Root.GetName]在浩瀚之中显得更加微不足道了。我们伟大的帝国遇到的这第一只庞然大物很可能就是我们遭遇最后一只。这只巨兽的影像已经传遍了整个帝国，造成了极大恐慌，不少人要求政府采取行动。

我方舰队的报告表明，这只巨兽的力量足以轻松摧毁宇宙中最为强大的舰队，建议我们小心行事。
story.8.desc.en:
The discovery of a giant monstrosity living in the void has made the [Root.GetName] appear all the more insignificant in the grand scheme of things. The first creature our proud empire encounters might just be its last. The leviathan's image has spread across the empire, causing mass hysteria and pleas for action.

Our fleet's report stated that the beast appears powerful enough to crush even the most capable armada, and recommends caution.

story.8.desc.followup123456.zh: 近期，有关一只巨兽出没在黑暗虚空之中的消息席卷了整个帝国。有人表示关注，有人表示乐观，但最多的人还是表示恐惧。历史文档中将会着重记录这重要的一天。
story.8.desc.followup123456.en: News of a giant being seen in the dark void of space is spreading across the empire like a plague. There is concern and optimistic wonder, but mostly brings an existential dread to the populace. Historical documents will record this day as one of tremendous importance.

story.8.desc.followup7.zh:
我们找到了一些发展水平超越之前遭遇过的一切物种的生物。这种生物可以生长到前所未见的规模，体积和质量甚至可以与星球的卫星相比。

真可谓是防不胜防。这一天将永远标示着[Root.GetName]历史的转折点。我们只希望我们种群还能存活到回顾此事的那一天。
story.8.desc.followup7.en:
We have now found beings far surpassing anything encountered in our empire's spacefaring history. Life capable of growing to an unprecedented scale, rivaling moons in size and mass.

Nothing could have prepared us for this. This day will forever mark a turning point in the story of the [Root.GetName]. Let us hope we survive long enough to tell it.

story.8.desc.mach.zh:
在深空中发现特性不明的巨大个体迫使[Root.GetName]重新定义已知敌对单独个体的最大表面面积相关的参数。[Root.GetName]与新发现的该个体发生冲突时的生存率预测并不容乐观。

建议科研与战斗单位继续观察，并对我们已有舰队的规格进行升级。
story.8.desc.mach.en:
The discovery of a massive entity with unknown properties in the void has forced the [Root.GetName] to redefine all known parameters for the maximum surface area of any single construct with hostile capabilities. Survival rate projections should the [Root.GetName] come into conflict with the newly discovered entity are not promising. 

Scientific and military units recommend continued observation, and specification upgrades to our existing armada.

story.8.desc.mechanical.zh: 有消息称在太空深处遭遇到了一个无比浩大的构筑，它正在延展贯穿整个[Root.GetName]。虽然它看起来并非是某种生物，不过其存在还是彰显了包含技术和巨型工程的可能性。
story.8.desc.mechanical.en: News of the encounter with a deep-space construct of gargantuan proportion is spreading throughout the [Root.GetName]. While the entity does not appear to be of biological nature, its mere existence has inescapable ramifications for the possibilities of technology and mega-engineering.

story.8.desc.phile.zh:
[Root.GetName]遇到了十分庄严崇高的存在。这种巨型生物的存在本身，就是宇宙孕育的无穷奇迹的最佳证明。在这巨型生物的身旁，任何生物都会显得无比渺小，一如腐草荧光安能与日月同辉。

虽说这种巨型生物的行为方式尚不明确，[Root.Capital.GetName]的民众却在敬畏的同时抱有希望，对于这巨兽将带来的一切十分期待。
story.8.desc.phile.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered something that is beyond sublime. Giant beings, their sheer existence a testament to the unfathomable wonders of the universe, that make most lifeforms appear like flickering lights next to burning stars.

Despite the true nature of the leviathan being unknown, the people on [Root.Capital.GetName] are hopefully in awe of what has been found, and optimistic about what it may bring.

story.8.desc.spirit.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的民众都在祈祷。黑暗中的巨怪使得帝国中的很多人开始质疑自己的神志是否清晰，甚至还有些人对神灵的宗教事务都开始动摇了。这些巨怪到底是生命的创造者和守护者，还是宇宙万物的敌人？
story.8.desc.spirit.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] populace is praying. The giant being encountered in the dark has caused many a denizen of the empire to fear for their sanity, or doubt their faith in the divine. Are these giants the guardians of all life and that which created it, or its enemy?

story.8.g.zh: 想想他们能教我们什么。
story.8.g.en: Imagine what they could teach us.

story.8.h.zh: 想象一下它们能成为多么壮观的战利品啊。
story.8.h.en: Imagine how impressive of a trophy it could be.

story.contact_report.egalitarian.zh: 多样性丰富了我们的集体智慧。

story.contact_report.gestalt_consciousne.zh: 分析数据获得最优效率。

story.contact_report.materialist.zh: 新的生命能带来有价值的科学洞见。
story.contact_report.materialist.en: New life offers valuable scientific insights.

story.contact_report.militarist.zh: 做好接触潜在威胁的准备。

story.contact_report.pacifist.zh: 生命的存在拓宽了我们的理解。
story.contact_report.pacifist.en: The existence of life expands our understanding.

story.contact_report.spiritualist.en: We are one with the cosmos.

story.contact_report.xenophile.en: Embrace the bonds of new life.

story.contact_report.xenophobe.zh: 强化我们的防御以备不测。
story.contact_report.xenophobe.en: Fortify our defenses against the unknown.

strange_signal_category_desc.zh: 尽管[Root.GetName]看上去荒无人烟，但我们的扫描仪却接收了一段被加密的信号，正是从这上面发射出来的。
strange_signal_category_desc.en: Although [Root.GetName] appears totally desolate and devoid of life, our scanners have picked up an encrypted signal emanating from it.

strange_worlds.1.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的地表正在对我们的建设活动表现出前所未有的反应。一种无法甄别的粘稠物质开始从关键设施的地基中渗出。

这种渗出物是一种深红色液体，外观呈胶状，摸起来极具粘性。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切希望进一步研究这种排放物。虽然目前它仅仅带来些许不便，但为确保[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的安全，最好还是谨慎行事。
strange_worlds.1.desc.en:
The surface of [Root.GetName] is exhibiting an unprecedented reaction to our construction efforts. An unidentified viscous substance is beginning to ooze out from the foundations of key installations.

The ooze is some kind of crimson liquid; gelatinous in appearance but extremely adhesive to the touch.

Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are eager to study this discharge further. Currently it is a mere inconvenience, but it would be prudent to ensure the safety of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

strange_worlds.1000.desc.zh:
对[From.GetName]的气候进行干化改造，使得整个星球新近显露的海床上出现了一个巨大的熔岩隧道网络。

形成这些深层隧道的岩浆流现在已经休眠，留下了富饶的矿脉，这些矿脉是在很久以前[From.GetName]熔融核心的极端高温和高压下形成的。

这些火成矿藏非常密集；在此地的开采作业成本高昂，但利润丰厚。
strange_worlds.1000.desc.en:
Drying the climate on [From.GetName] uncovered a vast network of lava tubes throughout the planet's newly-exposed ocean floor.

The magma flows which created these deep tunnels are dormant now, leaving behind a rich seam of minerals forged long ago in the extreme heat and pressure of [From.GetName]'s molten core.

These pyroduct deposits are extremely dense; extraction operations here will be costly but highly lucrative.

strange_worlds.1005.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的环境改造工程意外引发了本地动物种群数量的激增。

我们发现，许多本地物种的繁殖周期与环境中的水资源供应密切相关。它们的卵原本需要在土壤中埋藏数月，吸收足够的水分后才能孵化，如今却大量散布在地表。该星球的动物数量正以对数级速度迅速增长。

这些生物中许多都富含营养，将为[From.GetName]提供丰富的食物来源，同时也为研究一个极其活跃的生态系统提供了机会。前往该星球的访客现在需要在离开时接受严格的筛查程序，以防止对外界造成污染。
strange_worlds.1005.desc.en:
The terraforming of [From.GetName] has caused an unexpected surge in the native fauna population.

We have discovered that the breeding cycles of many local species are intrinsically linked to the availability of water in the environment. Their eggs, which previously were buried in soil for months before absorbing enough water to hatch, are now littering the landscape in abundance. The planet's fauna numbers are skyrocketing at a logarithmic pace.

Many of these creatures are highly nutritious; they will provide an abundant food source for [From.GetName], as well as opportunities to study an extremely active ecosystem. Visitors to this planet will now be required to undergo an extensive screening process upon departure to prevent outworld contamination.

strange_worlds.1010.desc_exterminate.zh: $strange_worlds.1010.intro$它们将立即被消灭。我们将把产生的生物质用于我们自己的目的。
strange_worlds.1010.desc_exterminate.en: $strange_worlds.1010.intro$They will be exterminated without delay. We will harvest the resulting biomass for our own purposes.

strange_worlds.1010.desc_hunted.zh: $strange_worlds.1010.intro$它们独特的生理结构将为我们提供丰富的食物来源。
strange_worlds.1010.desc_hunted.en: $strange_worlds.1010.intro$Their unique physiologies will provide us with a rich food source.

strange_worlds.1010.desc_protected.zh: $strange_worlds.1010.intro$我们应该保护这些生命形态。它们非凡的休眠能力值得进一步研究。
strange_worlds.1010.desc_protected.en: $strange_worlds.1010.intro$We should protect these life forms. Their remarkable hibernation capacities warrant further study.

strange_worlds.1010.desc_tolerated.zh: $strange_worlds.1010.intro$我们可以研究该物种非凡的冬眠能力，或者为了获取生物质而收割这些生物。
strange_worlds.1010.desc_tolerated.en: $strange_worlds.1010.intro$We could either study this species' remarkable hibernation capabilities or harvest the creatures for biomass.

strange_worlds.1015.desc.zh:
我们的环境改造专家已对[From.GetName]上即将出现的问题发出警告。

在这颗星球的冰冻山脉之下，蕴藏着大量高丰度的铁和碳资源，这些资源在环境改造过程中被过度加热。

我们现在可以安全地移除这些接近熔化的资源。或者，通过让过度加热持续下去，我们将培育出一个永久的合金来源。当然，这将以减少宜居生活空间为代价。
strange_worlds.1015.desc.en:
An impending issue on [From.GetName] has been flagged by our terraforming specialists.

Beneath the frozen mountain ranges of the planet lie vast, highly concentrated deposits of iron and carbon, all of which were superheated by the terraforming process.

We could safely remove the near-molten resources now. Alternatively, by allowing the superheating to continue, we would foster a perpetual source of alloys. Of course, this would come at the cost of habitable living space.

strange_worlds.1020.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]进行的环境改造产生了意想不到的后果。我们未曾意识到，该星球表层的土壤是一种含有高浓度易爆微粒的细颗粒混合物，而我们的改造过程扰动了这些微粒，并将其散布到了整个星球的大气中。

不幸的是，这些空气中的高能粒子增加了地表意外燃烧事件的风险。任何未来的殖民地都必须优先考虑事故和冲突的预防，以避免灾难性的后果。

然而，如果我们能够谨慎管控这些危险，[From.GetName]的大气将成为这些稀有材料的丰富来源。
strange_worlds.1020.desc.en:
Terraforming on [From.GetName] had unforeseen consequences. Unbeknown to us, the planet's topsoil was a fine particle mix containing  high concentrations of Volatile Motes which our terraforming process disturbed and seeded throughout the planet's atmosphere.

Unfortunately, these airborne high-energy particles increase the risk of unintended combustion events on the surface. Any future colony will have to prioritize accident and conflict prevention in order to avoid devastating consequences.

However if we are able to manage the dangers carefully, the atmosphere of [From.GetName] will become a rich source of these rare materials.

strange_worlds.1025.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的行星地壳因环境改造过程而发生位移，导致了一种不寻常的自然现象。

移动的构造板块使多个异星天然气气穴发生位移，这些气体与行星火山中富含合金的矿脉发生反应，导致火山喷发呈现出鲜艳的蓝色。

这一现象的不稳定性使得行星的宜居性有所下降，从而影响了我们为[Root.GetColonistPlural]们创造居住空间的计划。

作为额外的好处，这些火山周围的土地现在富含资源，可供我们利用。
strange_worlds.1025.desc.en:
The planetary crust of [From.GetName] has shifted as a result of the terraforming process, leading to an unusual natural phenomenon.

The shifting tectonic plates have displaced several pockets of Exotic Gases which have reacted with the Alloy rich mineral deposits found in the planet's volcanos, causing their eruptions to develop a vivid blue hue.

The volatile nature of this phenomenon has left the planet a bit less hospitable, and as a result impacted our plans to create livable space for our [Root.GetColonistPlural].

As a bonus, the earth around these volcanoes is now rich in resources for us to take advantage of.

strange_worlds.1030.a.zh: 利用这些风暴中的能量。
strange_worlds.1030.a.en: Exploit the energy in these storms.

strange_worlds.1030.b.zh: 中和这些晶体里的电荷。

strange_worlds.1030.desc.zh:
我们收到报告，在[From.GetName]上出现了一种新兴的天气现象。

在星球的环境改造过程中，地壳中的水晶矿床暴露出来，并与改造过程中使用的化学物质发生反应，进而受到辐射。由此引发的空气温度波动导致了一场覆盖整个星球的持续雷暴。

这种独特的天气条件将不可避免地影响基础设施的建设，而受到辐射的水晶矿床也必然会对长期宜居性产生影响。然而，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，一旦环境改造完成，他们就能够利用这些风暴的能量。

此外，我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]也制定了安全中和水晶矿床电荷的计划。这将消散风暴，并使我们能够安全地开采这些水晶用于其他用途。
strange_worlds.1030.desc.en:
We have received reports of an emerging weather phenomenon on [From.GetName].

Crystal deposits within the bedrock of the planet have become exposed during terraforming, reacting to the chemicals used in the process and becoming irradiated. The resulting fluctuations in air temperature have created a perpetual planet-wide lightning storm.

These unique weather conditions will inevitably impact infrastructure development, and the irradiated crystals are sure to have consequences for long-term habitability. However, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are confident they can harness the energy of the storms once terraforming is complete.

Alternatively, our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have also drawn up plans to safely neutralize the charge in the crystal deposits. This should dissipate the storms and allow us to safely harvest them for other uses.

strange_worlds.1035.desc.zh:
对[event_target:hibernator_planet.GetName]上的欠智慧生物种群的研究揭示了其非凡的休眠模式。这种模式由一种特定的酶调控，该酶触发了生物体进入和退出深度休眠状态的过程。在这种状态下，其体内的化学反应几乎降至可忽略不计的程度。

我们提取了这种酶，并成功通过镇静化合物将其应用于其他多种生物。在所有案例中，原本不具备休眠能力的物种都能够进入长时间的休眠状态，在此期间细胞老化显著减缓。

这一非凡的突破为人工增强的冷冻休眠铺平了道路，将大大减轻有机物种在长距离太空旅行中的身体负担。
strange_worlds.1035.desc.en:
Studies of the pre-sapient population on [event_target:hibernator_planet.GetName] produced insights into their remarkable hibernation patterns. They are regulated by a particular enzyme which triggers the body's entry into and exit from deep stasis sleep. In this state, chemical reactions within their bodies are reduced to almost negligible amounts.

We extracted this enzyme and have been able to administer it successfully - via sedative compound - to various other organisms. In all cases, species previously incapable of hibernation were able to enter into a lengthy dormancy which significantly reduced cell aging for its duration.

This extraordinary breakthrough paves the way for artificially-enhanced cryosleeps that will greatly reduce the physical strains of long distance space journeys for organic species.

strange_worlds.1040.a.zh: 令人毛骨悚然，但没准也能淘到点啥。

strange_worlds.1040.desc.zh:
当我们完成在[From.GetName]的环境改造后，尸体开始从天而降。

从如此高的高度坠落，这些古老的遗骸在撞击时化为肉泥。与内脏一起，我们发现了一些小物件的集合——装饰性的器物和奇异的遗迹——它们都从星球高层大气中相同的浓密云层中坠落。

这些厚重的云层，我们只能推测是被某种未知的外星物种用作最终的安息之地，现在正因我们的星球改造而变得稀薄，并释放出之前悬浮在其中的物品。我们可以预见，随着大气稳定，这些遗骸将继续坠落，直到云层墓穴完全空空如也。
strange_worlds.1040.desc.en:
As we finished terraforming on [From.GetName], bodies began falling from the sky.

From such heights, these ancient carcasses are reduced to a pulp upon impact. Amongst the viscera we have discovered clusters of small objects - ornamental instruments and odd relics - all tumbling from the same dense clouds in the planet's upper atmosphere.

These thick clouds, which we can only assume were utilized as a final resting place by some unknown alien race, are now thinning as a result of our terraforming changes and releasing the contents that were previously suspended inside. We can expect these remains to continue falling as the atmosphere settles, until the cloud graves are emptied entirely.

strange_worlds.105.desc_gestalt_machine.zh: 该节点的数据在失联下线前遭到了严重破坏。现在已经完全与我们的网络断开连接。
strange_worlds.105.desc_gestalt_machine.en: The nodes' data became corrupted before going offline. They are no longer connected to our network.

strange_worlds.105.desc_gestalt_non_mach.zh: 在这个节点完全静默之前，我们感受到了一阵短暂的剧痛。
strange_worlds.105.desc_gestalt_non_mach.en: We sensed a brief but agonizing pain before the nodes fell silent.

strange_worlds.105.desc_intro.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的一位[Owner.GetExplorer]突然失去了联系，此前他刚刚汇报过在一处此前未测绘的山谷里发现了潜在的异星天然气。
strange_worlds.105.desc_intro.en: Communications were lost with one of our [Owner.GetExplorer] on [Root.GetName], shortly after they reported a potential Exotic Gas discovery in a previously unmapped valley.

strange_worlds.105.desc_non_gestalt.zh: 令人担忧的是，他最后的通讯是在某种类似惨叫一样的声音后突然切断的。我们做了最坏的打算。
strange_worlds.105.desc_non_gestalt.en: Worryingly, their final transmission cut off abruptly with what sounded like anguished cries. We fear the worst.

strange_worlds.1050.b.en: It will burn up on its own.

strange_worlds.1050.desc.zh:
由于轨道上存在着许多太空垃圾和小型轨道碎片，我们在[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的环境改造工程师正在面临着危险的工作环境。其极大的数量给穿梭机在地表和轨道间往回航行带来了危险。

由于这些物体的密度极高，我们起早了一份，将其中最大的一些碎片进行磁化，使其在轨道上吸引其他的碎片，最后逐渐整合成一个更便于管理的整体。我们任务应该能制造出一颗人工卫星。

虽然这将增加环境改造的时间，但它将大大方便穿梭车进入地表，并消除大型轨道碎片频繁进入行星大气的风险。
strange_worlds.1050.desc.en:
Our terraforming engineers on [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] are facing hazardous working conditions due to various pieces of space junk and minor debris orbiting the planet. The high volume of these objects pose a navigational danger for shuttles traveling to and from the surface.

Given the sheer density of the material, we have drawn up proposals to magnetize the largest of these fragments so that they attract others as they orbit, gradually consolidating everything into a single and more manageable entity. We theorize it will be possible to effectively create an artificial moon.

While this would increase terraforming time, it would greatly ease shuttle access to the surface and remove the risk of larger orbital debris periodically entering the planet's atmosphere.

strange_worlds.1060.create_moon_ct.en: [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] has a new moon: Junk Moon

strange_worlds.1060.desc.zh:
将环绕[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的太空垃圾进行整合的工作成功了。

通过将许多大型碎片磁化后，我们逐渐将所有的物体集合成一个巨大的废金属团块。它的密度上升至足以产生自身引力的可观水平。这颗新形成的卫星随后被送入了稳定的轨道。

摆脱了这些危险的轨道碎片之后，前往[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的表面容易多了，我们再也不用担心这些东西掉入大气层。不仅如此，我们的工程师也确信这颗新的卫星甚至可以承载自己的开采站。
strange_worlds.1060.desc.en:
Efforts to consolidate the space junk orbiting [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] were successful.

By magnetizing many of the larger pieces, we gradually gathered everything into a massive single body of scrap metal. Its density has risen to the point where it now has its own appreciable level of gravitational attraction. This newly-created moon has since settled into a stable orbit.

Access to [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]'s surface is much easier without the hazardous orbital debris, and we no longer have to worry about its potential entry into the atmosphere. Moreover, our engineers are confident that this new moon can support its own mining station.

strange_worlds.110.desc.zh:
在调查[Root.GetName]上失联的[Owner.GetExplorer]最后的已知地点时，我们发现了一大片正在冒出纯异星天然气薄雾的强酸性泥潭。这片沼泽生长着一种强韧的本地植物，能够耐受这种极端的酸性。

尽管这片区域极度危险，对这片气雾进行进一步研究或许会对殖民地资源产出大有裨益。
strange_worlds.110.desc.en:
While investigating the last known location of the missing [Owner.GetExplorer] on [Root.GetName], we discovered a landscape of highly acidic bogs exuding a mist of pure Exotic Gas. These swamps are home to a species of resilient native flora that is capable of surviving the extreme acidity.

While the landscape is highly hazardous, conducting further research into the gas mists could prove beneficial for colony resources.

strange_worlds.115.desc.zh:
在研究[Root.GetName]的酸性沼泽时，我们的一位[Owner.GetScientistPlural]及其研究设备被当地植物的卷须缠住，并被拖进了一个极具腐蚀性的泥潭中。他几乎在一瞬间就溶解了，我们相信失踪的[Owner.GetExplorer]可能也遭受到了相似的命运。

很快，这株植物的卷须肉眼可见地膨胀，并且释放出了少量的异星天然气。这种掠食性植物似乎将酸性沼泽作为外消化系统；通过捕猎卷须把猎物拖进去溶解，然后吸收营养。这一过程中会释放少量的异星天然气供收获。

我们推测，可以利用这种植物的生物学特性，通过喂它殖民地的废弃物来产生更多的天然气以供利用。或者我们可以中和这些酸性沼泽，重新开垦营养丰富的土地用于农业。
strange_worlds.115.desc.en:
While studying the acidic swamps on [Root.GetName], one of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] and their observation equipment were ensnared by the tendrils of the native flora before being dragged into a highly caustic pool. They dissolved nearly instantly. We believe a similar fate befell the missing [Owner.GetExplorer].

Soon after, the plant's tendrils visibly inflated and traces of Exotic Gas spiked. It appears this predatory flora uses the acidic bogs as an external digestive system; dragging prey in via hunter tendrils to be dissolved and then absorbing the nutrients. This process releases a small quantity of harvestable Exotic Gas in the process.

We speculate that this organism's biology could be exploited by feeding it colony waste in order to produce more gases. Alternatively, we could neutralize these acidic bogs to reclaim the nutrient-rich lands for agriculture.

strange_worlds.120.b.evopred.zh: 很好，把剩余物也收割了吧。

strange_worlds.120.desc.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]成功中和了酸性沼泽，同时消灭了生存其中的植物物种。因此，异星天然气雾也消失了。

这些开垦后的土地由于原生植物的养分残留而异常肥沃，我们创造了额外的宝贵农业用地。
strange_worlds.120.desc.en:
We succeeded in neutralizing the acidic bogs on [Root.GetName], simultaneously killing off the flora species which lived in them. The Exotic Gas mists have disappeared as a result.

These reclaimed lands are unusually fertile, owing to the leftover nutrients from the native flora's feeding process. We have created additional valuable agricultural space.

strange_worlds.130.desc.zh:
此前被认为休眠已久的[Root.GetName]地热喷泉剧烈喷发，向大气层喷射出含有暗物质的气体。

此次喷发遮天蔽日，导致了严重的引力异常，阻碍了星际旅行和通讯。
