我们认为暗物质可能源于该行星独特的核心。这种极端的环境对我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]构成了威胁，因此我们已经部署了轨道虹吸装置用于从平流层提取这种瘴气。
strange_worlds.130.desc.en:
What was previously thought to be a long dormant geyser on [Root.GetName] has violently erupted, spewing Dark Matter infused gas into the atmosphere.

The eruption has saturated the skies, leading to severe gravitational anomalies that are blocking offworld travel and communications.

We believe the dark matter somehow originates from the planet's unique core. Orbital siphons have been deployed to extract the miasma from the stratosphere, as the extreme conditions pose a danger to our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

strange_worlds.135.desc_common_1.zh: 我们已成功地从[Root.GetName]的大气中抽取了暗物质瘴气，并开始评估损害。
strange_worlds.135.desc_common_1.en: We have successfully siphoned the Dark Matter miasma from the atmosphere of [Root.GetName], and are beginning to assess the damage.

strange_worlds.135.desc_gestalt.zh: $strange_worlds.135.desc_common_2$察觉到他们试图重新融入集体，我们便将他们从物理坟墓中解救出来。
strange_worlds.135.desc_gestalt.en: $strange_worlds.135.desc_common_2$ Sensing their attempts to reintegrate back into the collective, we broke them free of their physical tomb.

strange_worlds.135.desc_machine.zh: $strange_worlds.135.desc_common_2$从残骸内部检测到功能性电子信号后，我们将其释放了出来。
strange_worlds.135.desc_machine.en: $strange_worlds.135.desc_common_2$ Detecting functional electronic signals from within the husks, we broke them free.

strange_worlds.135.desc_organic_non_gest.zh: $strange_worlds.135.desc_common_2$在这些空壳内探测到生命迹象后，我们小心地将其提取了出来。
strange_worlds.135.desc_organic_non_gest.en: $strange_worlds.135.desc_common_2$ Detecting life signs within these husks, we carefully extracted them.

strange_worlds.135.desc_outro.zh:
与所有预期相反，[Owner.GetColonistPlural]似乎并未受到长时间暴露和静止状态的影响。

造成最初事件的间歇喷泉现已坍塌成一个暗物质液态湖。

这是一个前所未有的事件，需要集中研究。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]不确定该如何分配他们本已捉襟见肘的资源。
strange_worlds.135.desc_outro.en:
Contrary to all expectations, the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] seem unaffected by their prolonged exposure and stasis.

The geyser responsible for the original incident has since collapsed into a lake of liquid dark matter.

This is an unprecedented event that requires concentrated study. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are unsure where to focus their already-stretched resources.

strange_worlds.140_intro.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，位于[Root.GetName]的暗物质湖泊对行星的进一步威胁微乎其微。但人口正在出现的症状却并非如此。

在研究隔离的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]期间，我们发现他们被该物质包裹后，身体在发生持续的变化。
strange_worlds.140_intro.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are confident that the lake of Dark Matter on [Root.GetName] presents minimal further danger to the planet. The same can not be said for the emerging symptoms affecting the population.

While studying the quarantined [Owner.GetColonistPlural], we have identified ongoing physical changes resulting from their entombment in the substance.

strange_worlds.140_machine_2.zh: 虽然这些污染物确实存在引发系统过早失效的风险，但如果将其整合到组装过程中，它们将使在这个星球上建造的装置能够高效地处理和采集暗物质作为子程序。
strange_worlds.140_machine_2.en: While these contaminants do run the risk of triggering premature system failure, they will allow units constructed on this world to efficiently process and harvest Dark Matter as a subroutine if integrated into their assembly processes.

strange_worlds.140_non_machine_2.zh: 我们可以培养这些异常现象，使我们身体的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]能够加工和分泌可收集的暗物质，代价是缩短他们的寿命。
strange_worlds.140_non_machine_2.en: We can cultivate these abnormalities, allowing the bodies of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to process and secrete harvestable Dark Matter, at the expense of shortening their life expectancy.

strange_worlds.145.desc.zh:
对[Root.GetName]上的暗物质湖的进一步研究揭示了关键的地质信息，这可能解释了最初事件的原因。

该行星的核心存在一个微型黑洞，尺寸不到一米。行星本身更大的质量抵消了我们本应从这种异常现象中探测到的预期引力。这种质量之间的关系似乎达到了微妙的平衡，应该会持续相当长的时间。

最近的地震活动导致内层地幔发生位移，从而引发了最初的间歇泉喷发。暗物质湖本身起到了稳定行星核心并防止进一步爆发的作用。

然而，长期饱和的暗物质并非最初看起来那么无害。

在[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的质心处形成了不稳定的微型黑洞，导致它们的躯体剧烈内爆。剩下的只是一具由结晶暗物质构成的无生命外壳。扫描未检测到内部有任何进一步的活动迹象。

我们的最终统计显示，[Root.GetName]的居民在一瞬间损失了大约四分之一。取而代之的是，各种姿势的固态暗物质雕像散落在行星上。
strange_worlds.145.desc.en:
Further study of the dark matter lake on [Root.GetName] has revealed crucial geological information that may explain the cause of the initial incident.

The planet's core is host to a micro black hole, less than a meter in length. The greater mass of the planet itself nullifies the expected gravitational forces we would have detected from such an anomaly. It appears this relationship between the masses has reached a delicate equilibrium that should remain for quite some time.

Recent seismic activity led to a displacement in the inner mantle, causing the initial geyser eruption. The dark matter lake itself acted as a plug to stabilize the planet's core and prevent further outbursts.

However, the long term saturation in dark matter was not as harmless as it initially appeared.

Unstable micro black holes formed in the center of mass of the [Owner.GetColonistPlural], causing their bodies to violently implode. All that remained was a lifeless husk made of crystallized dark matter. Scans detected no signs of further activity inside.

Our final count shows we have lost approximately a quarter of [Root.GetName]'s population in an instant. In their place, statues of solid dark matter litter the planet in various poses.

strange_worlds.15.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的建设以异常顺利的速度持续推进，但那种粘稠物质的出现已不再仅限于我们设施的地基部分。

多处地点发现了渗漏的裂缝。最初，只有[Root.GetName]上的非本土物体受到这种物质的影响，但现在它正在无差别地扩散。

该物质现已吞噬了[Root.GetName]表面的大部分区域，并迅速凝结成厚厚的矿物凝结物，将[Root.GetName]包围。

通过代价高昂的反复试验，我们的工程师找到了一种方法来减轻进一步的损害，并高效地采集这种物质。然而，这只能通过向这种粘液让出大量土地来实现。
strange_worlds.15.desc.en:
Construction on [Root.GetName] has continued at an exceptional pace, but the emergence of the viscous substance is no longer limited to just the foundations of our installations.

Hemorrhaging fissures have been discovered in multiple locations. Initially only non-native objects to [Root.GetName] were being affected by the substance, but now it is spreading indiscriminately.

The material has now consumed a large portion of the surface of [Root.GetName] and is rapidly congealing into a thick mineral coagulate that has surrounded [Root.GetName].

Through costly trial and error, our engineers have found a way to mitigate further damage as well as efficiently harvest the substance. This was only possible at the expense of ceding significant ground to the ooze.

strange_worlds.155.a.zh: 多么奇葩的异种生物学知识。

strange_worlds.155.desc_homicidal.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一种极为恶心的本土生物。

它们进化出了一种防御机制，同时也成为了它们获取食物的主要方式。由于缺乏自身分解固体食物所需的消化酶，它们会释放出一种强烈且令人作呕的气体，当其他具有正常消化系统的生物吸入时，会引发剧烈呕吐。这些被排出的物质随后被它们作为主要的营养来源。

清除这些令人厌恶的生物将为我们带来丰厚的异星天然气和食物资源。
strange_worlds.155.desc_homicidal.en:
We have encountered a notably disgusting species of fauna native to [Root.GetName].

They have evolved a defense mechanism that happens to also serve as their primary method of food acquisition. Lacking the digestive enzymes needed to break down solid food on their own, they emit a powerful and repulsive gas that induces projectile vomiting when inhaled by other organisms with a functioning gut. These ejected substances are then consumed as their main source of nutrients.

The culling of these foul creatures will provide a useful windfall of Exotic Gas and Food.

strange_worlds.155.desc_normal.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]遇到了一种本土的动物物种，它们拥有一种相当……独特的获取食物的方式。

尽管最初这些生物较为害羞，但它们已经逐渐习惯了我们的存在，并且由于其友好的天性，甚至在一些较为幼稚的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]中颇受欢迎。

虽然它们不构成直接威胁，但它们进化出了一种防御机制，这种机制恰好也是它们获取食物的主要方式。由于缺乏自身分解固体食物所需的消化酶，它们会释放出一种强烈且令人作呕的气体，当被其他具有正常消化系统的生物吸入时，会引发剧烈的呕吐。这些被排出的物质随后被它们作为主要的营养来源。

总的来说，这一情况存在传染病蔓延的风险，当地领导人一直在敦促[Owner.GetColonistPlural]远离这些奇怪的生物。
strange_worlds.155.desc_normal.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] on [Root.GetName] have encountered a species of fauna native to the planet with a rather... unique method of gathering its food.

Though initially shy, these creatures have since become accustomed to our presence, and with their friendly nature are even proving popular among the more immature [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

While posing no direct danger, they have evolved a defense mechanism that happens to also serve as their primary method of food acquisition. Lacking the digestive enzymes needed to break down solid food on their own, they emit a powerful and repulsive gas that induces projectile vomiting when inhaled by other organisms with a functioning gut. These ejected substances are then consumed as their main source of nutrients.

The overall situation has a risk of spreading infectious diseases, and local leaders have been urging [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to steer clear of the strange things.

strange_worlds.160.b.en: Enough is enough. Shoot them on sight.

strange_worlds.160.desc.zh:
清除[Root.GetName]上令人作呕的害虫已被证明十分困难。尽管官方已发出警告，但殖民地中较为年轻的成员仍然继续与这些动物玩耍。

由于这个原因，我们的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]蛋白质已经成为它们首选的食物来源。与行星上其他知道躲避它们恶臭气体的动物相比，我们的殖民地已经变得更容易被攻击。这些生物已经进一步适应了我们的存在，并且有人目击到它们对任何饭后独自游荡的[Owner.GetColonist]采取伏击战术。

令人难以置信的是，这种情况也有一些好处。我们的科学家发现，这些生物排放的催吐气体中含有宝贵的异星天然气粒子，可以通过驯养这些野兽并将它们圈养在隔离设施中来收集。

然而，大多数殖民者都提议我们直接根除它们。
strange_worlds.160.desc.en:
Ridding [Root.GetName] of its revolting pests has proven difficult. Younger members of the colony continue to play with the animals despite official warnings.

As a result of this, our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName] proteins have become their preferred source of food. Our colony has become a much easier target than the rest of the planetary fauna who know to avoid their foul gases. These creatures have adapted further to our presence, and have been witnessed employing ambush tactics against any lone [Owner.GetColonist] wandering around after a meal.

Unbelievably, there are some benefits to this situation. Our scientists have discovered the emetic fumes emitted by the creatures contain valuable Exotic Gas particles which could be harvested by domesticating the beasts and keeping them in quarantined facilities.

The majority of the colony, however, have proposed that we simply eradicate them.

strange_worlds.165.a.evopred.zh: 确保我们不会发展出那种气味。
strange_worlds.165.a.evopred.en: Ensure that we don't evolve that smell.

strange_worlds.165.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的生物不再引发大规模呕吐现象。

随着针对其异种生物学构造的合成营养膏的研发，我们已调节了它们的饮食周期，彻底根除了它们对我们[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的偷袭。

我们已将它们迁移至一个精心设计的野生动物保护区，公众可以在安全的环境中观赏这些动物。专业饲养员已接受培训，能够在不造成进一步伤害的情况下提取它们的异星天然气。
strange_worlds.165.desc.en:
The creatures on [Root.GetName] are no longer causing mass regurgitations.

With the development of a synthetic nutrient paste catered to their xenobiology, we have regulated their dietary cycles and put an end to their opportunistic ambushes on our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

We have relocated them to a carefully designed wildlife reserve where the public can enjoy the animals in a safe environment. Specialist handlers have been trained to extract their Exotic Gas without further harm.

strange_worlds.170.desc.zh:
自从采纳官方的“就地射杀”政策以来，已经过去几个月了，再也没有人在[Root.GetName]殖民地附近发现过那些惹人厌的物种。

虽然有些[Owner.GetColonistPlural]怀念这些毛茸茸的生物，但现在每个人都更快乐了，因为他们可以自由行动，不必再担心被强制呕吐。

我们的科学家已经收集了这些动物的尸体，直接从它们的内脏中提取了一些异星天然气。
strange_worlds.170.desc.en:
Since adopting an official shoot on sight policy, it has now been several months since the offending species on [Root.GetName] was last sighted near the colony.

While some [Owner.GetColonistPlural] miss the presence of the furry creatures, everyone is happier overall now that they can travel freely without fear of forcibly regurgitating.

Our scientists have harvested the bodies of the animals, extracting some amount of Exotic Gas directly from their internal organs.

strange_worlds.185.desc.zh:
来自[Root.GetName]的报告显示，农村与城市人口之间出现了令人担忧的地区间敌对情绪。除了他们所处的地理位置外，目前尚未发现引发这种敌意的明显原因。

新移民最初会遭到敌视，但在被分配到各自的地区几周后，他们很快就会被接纳。基于此，我们的科学家确信，这种异常行为是由地区内的局部因素驱动的。

在我们调查此事的同时，我们需要稳定局势，以防止进一步升级。我们可以选择正式支持农村或城市地区，或者部署额外的执法力量以维持和平。
strange_worlds.185.desc.en:
Reports from [Root.GetName] show an alarming emergence of interdistrict hostility between the rural and urban populations. There is no discernible cause that has triggered this animosity other than their arbitrary geographical location.

New immigrants are initially treated with enmity, but within weeks of their assignment to their respective districts they are soon welcomed into the fold. Based on this, our scientists are convinced this strange behavior is being driven by factors localized to the districts.

While we investigate this matter, we need to stabilize the situation to prevent further escalation. We can choose to officially support either the rural or urban districts, or deploy additional enforcement to keep the peace.

strange_worlds.190.b.zh: 尝试对细菌进行基因改造。
strange_worlds.190.b.en: Attempt to genetically alter the bacteria.

strange_worlds.190.desc_intro.zh:
在对[Root.GetName]进行了广泛的环境调查后，我们的科学家们已经确定了地域仇恨行为的根源。


在行星地幔深处，存在着一个巨型生物腐烂的尸体。经过数千年的分解，这具早已死亡的生物的脊髓液渗入了行星的地下水中，并催生了一种精神细菌。这种改变思维的微生物随后进入了我们[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的神经系统，诱发了强烈的领地意识，而这很可能是原始动物所具有的特性。
strange_worlds.190.desc_intro.en:
After extensive environmental surveys of [Root.GetName], our scientists have identified the cause of the interdistrict hostility.

Deep within the planetary mantle lies the decaying corpse of a giant organism. Following millennia of decomposition, spinal fluid from the long-dead creature seeped into the planet's groundwater, lacing it with a psionic bacteria. This mind-altering microbe subsequently entered the nervous systems of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] and induced strong territorial instincts that were likely properties of the original animal.

strange_worlds.190.desc_non_psionic.zh: 我们应该能够通过将供水系统经过一系列专门设计的高等级过滤器来解决这个问题。
strange_worlds.190.desc_non_psionic.en: We should be able to address the issue by running the water supply through a complex series of uniquely-purposed high-grade filters.

strange_worlds.190.desc_outro_non_psioni.zh: 另外，我们的科学家确信可以在细胞水平上对这种细菌进行基因改造，将其领地性倾向引导至更具生产力的方向。
strange_worlds.190.desc_outro_non_psioni.en: Alternatively, our scientists are confident that the bacteria can be genetically modified at the cellular level, redirecting the territorial tendencies towards more productive ends.

strange_worlds.190.desc_psionic.zh: 这种外来杂质正在干扰我们的自然灵能力量。$strange_worlds.190.desc_non_psionic$
strange_worlds.190.desc_psionic.en: This exotic impurity is interfering with our natural psionic abilities.$strange_worlds.190.desc_non_psionic$

strange_worlds.195.a_ct.zh: [Root.GetName]上的所有人口都获得灵能突触
strange_worlds.195.a_ct.en: All pops on [Root.GetName] receive Psionic Ephapse

strange_worlds.195.a_ct.evopred.zh: 我们的主体物种获得了灵能突触
strange_worlds.195.a_ct.evopred.en: Our primary species receive Psionic Ephapse

strange_worlds.195.desc_intro.zh: 在[Root.GetName]部署的净水站取得了显著成功。
strange_worlds.195.desc_intro.en: The deployment of water filtration stations on [Root.GetName] has been a resounding success.

strange_worlds.195.desc_non_psionic.zh: 虽然激烈的领土敌意行为已经消退，但人群中留下了一些残余但可能有益的副作用，即天然益生菌，这些益生菌在[Root.GetName]上的个体之间促进了灵能突触的形成。这使得我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]能够在心灵感应的层面上相互交流，增强了社区意识并提高了生产力。
strange_worlds.195.desc_non_psionic.en: While the hyper-territorial aggression has subsided, the population has been left with some residual but potentially useful side-effects in the form of natural probiotics that foster a Psionic Ephapse between individuals on [Root.GetName]. This allows our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to communicate with one other on a telepathic level, fostering a greater sense of community and improving productivity.

strange_worlds.195.desc_psionic.zh: 激烈的领土敌意行为已经消退，不仅对我们心灵感应能力的干扰已经结束，这些能力还通过天然益生菌得到了进一步增强，促进了心灵突触在[Root.GetName]个体之间的形成。这强化了我们共享的心灵传送连结，培养了更强烈的社区意识，同时提高了生产力。
strange_worlds.195.desc_psionic.en: Hyper-territorial aggression has subsided, and not only has interference with our psionic capabilities ended, they have been further enhanced with natural probiotics that foster a Psionic Ephapse between individuals on [Root.GetName]. This reinforces our shared telepathic connection and fosters an even greater sense of community while improving productivity.

strange_worlds.20.desc.zh:
在对[Root.GetName]上受影响的工人进行深入研究和治疗后，我们的科学家已成功隔离出问题的根源。

尽管表面上看上去是一种粘稠凝胶状物质，实际上这是一群与星球形成共生关系的寄生微生物。这些寄生虫在[Root.GetName]的地壳下分解有机物，并将其回收转化为新的物质。

[Root.GetName]的开发活动扰乱了它们的自然生命周期，导致它们对我们引入其生态系统的外来物质产生了反应。

我们的科研团队相信，假以时日，我们能够找到与这些生命体和谐共处的方法，并将其独特的生物学特性整合到[Root.GetName]的生产流程中。
strange_worlds.20.desc.en:
After intense study and treatment of the afflicted workers on [Root.GetName], our scientists have isolated the root cause of the problem.

What initially presented as a viscous gelatinous substance, is in fact a collection of parasitic microorganisms that form a symbiotic relationship with the planet. The parasites decompose organic matter beneath the crust of [Root.GetName] and recycle it into new material.

The disturbance caused by [Root.GetName]'s development disrupted their natural lifecycle, causing them to react to the foreign substances we introduced into their ecosystem.

Given more time, our science team is confident that we can find a way to work in harmony with these lifeforms, integrating their unique biology into [Root.GetName]'s production pipelines.

strange_worlds.200.desc.zh:
我们已成功消除了细菌生物对[Root.GetName]产生的负面影响。[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的内斗已经平息，并且他们已经表现出生产力提高的迹象。

我们的科学家们有信心能够进一步编辑该微生物的基因代码。通过正确地对它的基因组进行测序，我们可以进一步提升[Owner.GetColonistPlural]在某方面的表现。

然而，这种微生物在被运离星球后将无法存活。它的线粒体与外星生物尸体之间的灵能连接必须保持完整，细菌才能繁殖。我们尚未完全理解其中的原因。
strange_worlds.200.desc.en:
We have successfully neutralized the negative effects of the bacterial organism on [Root.GetName]. The infighting among the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] has subsided and they are already showing signs of elevated productivity.

Our scientists are confident that they can go even further in editing the microbe's genetic code. With the correct sequencing of its genome, we could further enhance one aspect of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural]' performance.

However, the resulting microorganism will not survive long when transported offworld. The psionic connection between its mitochondria and the alien carcass must remain intact in order for the bacteria to reproduce. We do not yet fully understand why.

strange_worlds.2000.desc.zh:
该设施的内部包含了无数被废弃的医疗机械、治疗舱室和一个太平间。太平间的储藏荚舱里发现有一些部分保存完好的有机遗骸有疾患和病变的迹象。安全门、监视设备和拘留室的存在让[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]得出结论，有些个体是被强行关押在这里的。

我们取回了一些设备部件，但绝大部分都腐坏严重。电脑系统中残存的数据有限，我们虽然恢复了一些文件但仍有待翻译。
strange_worlds.2000.desc.en:
The facility's interior contains a myriad of abandoned medical machines, treatment chambers, and a morgue. In the cadaver storage pods, we found partially-preserved organic remains with signs of disease and deformation. The presence of security doors, surveillance rigs, and holding cells has led [universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName] to conclude that some were kept here against their will.

We salvaged a few equipment parts but almost everything has decayed markedly. Limited data remained on the computer systems; we recovered some files but they require translation.

strange_worlds.2005.desc.zh:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]提交了一份从[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的设施里恢复的数据资料的部分翻译。

17号实验室——进度汇报——研究主任吉列伯

新的原型展现出了一些初步的潜力。对象的免疫系统增强了数百万倍，而且所有的病原体都已被清除。副作用依旧存在：紧随其后的致命突变，无一幸免。会再做尝试。我很确信，万能巨噬细胞已经成功在望了。
strange_worlds.2005.desc.en:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName] produced a partial translation for one of the data files recovered from the facility on [fromfrom.planet.GetName].

Lab 17 - Progress update - Research Lead Gelebor

The new prototype showed initial promise. Subjects' immune systems boosted millionfold and all pathogens were eradicated. Side effects persisted: fatal mutations followed, no survivors. Will try again. The Universal Macrophage is within our reach, I am sure of it.

strange_worlds.2010.desc.zh:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]翻译了从[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的废弃实验室取回的另一份文件。

17号实验室——内部员工笔记——研究主任吉列伯

同事们，项目终止命令今天来了；宗主已经没耐心了。但我们离目标就只差一步！万能巨噬细胞比任何人的突发奇想都重要。我们可以拥有一个没有疾病的未来！为了取得这样的进步，多牺牲几个生命的代价又有多大呢？

如果他们不送来更多的实验对象——我就在我自己身上做实验。你们要和我一起吗？
strange_worlds.2010.desc.en:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName] translated another file from the abandoned laboratory on [fromfrom.planet.GetName].

Lab 17 - Internal staff memo - Research Lead Gelebor

Colleagues, the project termination order came today; the overlord's patience is at an end. And yet we are so close to our goal! The Universal Macrophage is more important than the whims of any one individual. A disease-free future can be ours! What is the small cost of a few more lives for such progress?

If they don't send more trial subjects - I will test the latest prototype on myself. Will you join me?

strange_worlds.2015.b.zh: 继续完成吉列伯的工作，这看起来很有希望。
strange_worlds.2015.b.en: Complete Gelebor's work. It holds promise.

strange_worlds.2015.b.mutation.zh: 我们是突变的主宰。让我们完成这工作。
strange_worlds.2015.b.mutation.en: We are masters of Mutation. Let us finish the work.

strange_worlds.2015.c.zh: 这种有缺陷的研究也是能堪一用的。
strange_worlds.2015.c.en: This flawed research can be put to use.

strange_worlds.2015.desc.zh:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]翻译了[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上生物实验室的电脑里的最后一份日志。

17号实验室——最终汇报——科研助理菲力多

我们盲目地跟随着的就是这个吉列伯的自信。

在我们自己身上测试原型，免疫系统一开始得到了增强；我们几乎可以免疫一切外部病原体。然后突变就开始了。

吉列伯先死了。死状惨不忍睹。现在整个团队都躺在了在太平间里，我也很快就会加入他们。

我们失败了。我们把自己的性命托付给了吉列伯的错误配方。万能巨噬细胞功能过于强大——它最终会攻击宿主自身。这里的一切东西都必须销毁。
strange_worlds.2015.desc.en:
[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName] translated the final log entry from the bio lab's computers on [fromfrom.planet.GetName].

Lab 17 - Final Report - Research Assistant Filidor

Such was Gelebor's confidence that we followed him blindly.

Testing the prototype on ourselves, our immune systems were initially bolstered; we were nigh invincible to any outside pathogens. Then the mutations started.

Gelebor perished first. It was difficult to watch. Now the whole team is resting in the morgue and I will soon join them.

We failed. We trusted our lives to Gelebor's flawed formula. The Universal Macrophage works too well - it eventually attacks the host itself. Everything here must be destroyed.

strange_worlds.2030.ct.zh:
[Root.GetName]失去100£pop£人口，并且每多$@macrophage_kill_pop_every_x$个£pop£就额外失去100£pop£人口
所有[Root.GetName]上的有机£pop£获得吉列伯突变并且生理学发生剧烈改变。
strange_worlds.2030.ct.en:
[Root.GetName] loses 100 £pop£ Pops and an additional 100 £pop£ Pops per $@macrophage_kill_pop_every_x$ £pop£ Pop present
All organic £pop£ Pops on [Root.GetName] receive Geleboric Mutations and drastically change in physiology.

strange_worlds.2030.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的居民正在经历严重的身体突变，细胞和重要器官的功能遭到了破坏。虽然在某些情况下，这些变化提高了代谢效率，但更常见的结果是死亡。

这些副作用与万能巨噬细胞原始研究笔记中描述的完全吻合。尽管我们做出了努力，但由配方引起的致命突变似乎是不可避免的。这项技术不能再被信任了。我们正在销毁所有剩余的配方并将停止使用。
strange_worlds.2030.desc.en:
Citizens on [Root.GetName] are experiencing severe physical mutations that disrupt the functioning of cells and vital organs. While in some instances these changes have enhanced metabolic efficiency, more commonly they are causing fatalities.

These side effects are a perfect match with the ones described in the original research notes of the Universal Macrophage. Despite our efforts, it appears that the fatal mutations caused by the formula are unavoidable. This technology can no longer be trusted. We are destroying all remaining supplies of the formula and will discontinue its usage.

strange_worlds.2035.desc_lm.zh: $strange_worlds.2035.desc_intro$[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]得出结论，它是由某种形式的活体金属建造而成的。
strange_worlds.2035.desc_lm.en: $strange_worlds.2035.desc_intro$ [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has concluded that it is constructed of a form of Living Metal.

strange_worlds.2035.desc_no_lm.zh: $strange_worlds.2035.desc_intro$[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]得出结论，它是由前所未见的某种形式的怪异金属建造而成的。
strange_worlds.2035.desc_no_lm.en: $strange_worlds.2035.desc_intro$ [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has concluded that it is constructed of a form of strange metal unlike any we have previously seen.

strange_worlds.2040.desc.zh:
[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]在检查[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的金属立方体时，其中一个表面突然泛起涟漪并且形成了一个通向该物体内部的开口。刚一进入，我们就发现了一个仍被腐坏的软体动物尸体占据着的控制台；不管它的肉体曾经如何，现在都化成了一抔黄土。

我们在控制台上发现了一个不寻常的容器，里面不时嘭哐作响似乎是有什么东西在里面活动。然而，这个容器的密封非常复杂，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]目前还无法将其打开。
strange_worlds.2040.desc.en:
While [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] was examining the metallic cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName], one of its surfaces unexpectedly rippled and parted to create an opening into the object's interior. Upon entering, we found a command console still occupied by the husk of a decayed molluscoid; whatever flesh it may have once held has now decomposed into a pale dust.

On the console, we found an unusual container from which occasional thuds and dull clangs can be heard as if something is moving inside. However, the container's seal is complex and [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has thus far been unable to open it.

strange_worlds.2040.evopred.zh: 我们肯定还能回收这些粉尘。
strange_worlds.2040.evopred.en: Surely we can still recover the dust.

strange_worlds.2045.desc.zh:
在对立方体中控台进行数据挖掘的过程中，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]恢复并解码了两小段音频日志，里面是由同一位发言人发出的一连串咽喉喌音和刺耳的声门塞音。在语言学数据库中交叉检索后，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]发现了一种与之相匹配的古代语言，并得出了第一份音频日志的能够理解的翻译：

“主席团成员们，请听我一言。要避免这场战争还有时间。你们君主的自信极不明智，我们难道可以打败[Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]吗，这样下去最终的结局只有毁灭！”

“安抚他们才是我们唯一的选项。这个匣子里装有一件礼物，可以作为和平的象征：这就是我们活体金属的精巧技艺。要想逃过这次劫难，只能将这件礼物送给他们。”
strange_worlds.2045.desc.en:
While data mining the cube's central console, [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] was able to recover and decrypt two short audio logs. They contain a series of guttural clicks and harsh glottal stops vocalized by a single speaker. By cross-referencing our linguistic database, [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] found a comparable ancient language and has produced a working translation of the first audio log:

'My presidium, you must hear me. There is still time to avoid this war. Your dynasts' confidence is injudicious, we cannot defeat [Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]. They will destroy us!'

'Appeasement is our only option. My crate contains a gift, a likely token of peace: the secrets of our living metal mastery. The only way to avoid oblivion is to deliver it to them.'

strange_worlds.2050.desc_intro.zh:
第二段来自立方体控制台的音频信息也翻译完成了。

“主席团成员们，我失败了。我们的覆灭已经在劫难逃了。

我的六面体太空船遭到破坏，将会尝试紧急着陆在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上。即便我侥幸存活，这件和平信物也无法送达了。[Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]将如我们所恐惧的一般攻打我们。”

[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]已经完成匣子闭锁机构的破解。匣子里是一团异乎寻常的金属。它极具延展性和超响应性，不断地每过几秒就重塑成新的复杂外形。
strange_worlds.2050.desc_intro.en:
The second audio log from the cube's command console has been translated.

'My presidium, I have failed. Our annihilation is imminent and inexorable.

My hexahedral spacecraft was sabotaged. I will attempt an emergency landing on [fromfrom.planet.GetName]. Even if I survive, the peace token will not be delivered, and [Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy] will attack as we feared.'

[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has successfully decoded the locking mechanism on the crate. Contained within is a peculiar nugget of metal. It is particularly malleable and hyperactive, endlessly reshaping itself into intricate new forms every few seconds.

strange_worlds.2050.desc_no_war_lm.zh: 我们可以自己留着这个怪东西来加深我们对活体金属的理解，或是接替它的原主完成原定的事务；将其作为礼物送给[Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]以改进我们与之的关系。
strange_worlds.2050.desc_no_war_lm.en: We could retain this curiosity to further our understanding of living metal or we could do as its previous owners had intended; offer it as a gift to [Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy] in order to improve our standing with them.

strange_worlds.2050.desc_no_war_no_lm.zh: 我们可以自己留着这个怪东西来加深我们对这种出色金属的理解，或是接替它的原主完成原定的事务；将其作为礼物送给[Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]以改进我们与之的关系。
strange_worlds.2050.desc_no_war_no_lm.en: We could retain this curiosity to further our understanding of this remarkable metal or we could do as its previous owners had intended; offer it as a gift to [Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy] in order to improve our standing with them.

strange_worlds.2050.desc_war_lm.zh: 这件独特的物品和立方体舰船的来历可以加深我们对活体金属的理解。
strange_worlds.2050.desc_war_lm.en: This remarkable item and the cuboid vessel it came from will be used to further our knowledge of living metal.

strange_worlds.2050.desc_war_no_lm.zh: 这件独特的物品和立方体舰船的来历可以加深我们对金属化合物和结构的理解。
strange_worlds.2050.desc_war_no_lm.en: This remarkable item and the cuboid vessel it came from will be used to further our knowledge of metallic compounds and structures.

strange_worlds.25.a.evopred.en: And what can they teach us?

strange_worlds.25.desc.zh:
通过广泛的研究，我们的科学家成功对[Root.GetName]上的寄生微生物进行了基因定向设计。这种变异旨在使它们将我们的材料识别为对自然生态无害的添加物，从而使我们能够继续建设而不再遇到问题。

在将这些基因改造后的寄生虫引入行星生物圈后，它们已成功融入其中。

此外，通过重新利用微生物原有的分解效应，我们成功利用该物质的粘合特性，提升了行星的生产效率。
strange_worlds.25.desc.en:
Through extensive research, our scientists have engineered a variant species of the parasitic microorganisms on [Root.GetName]. This mutation is designed to recognize our own materials as harmless additions to their natural ecology, enabling us to resume construction with no further issue.

After introducing them into the planet's biosphere, our engineered parasites have successfully integrated with it.

Furthermore, by repurposing the microorganisms' original decomposition effects, we have managed to harness the substance's adhesive properties to boost our planet's production processes.

strange_worlds.30.desc.zh:
我们正在为[Root.GetName]上未来的扩张做土地整备时，一座巨大的结构仿佛在一瞬间凭空出现

这座结构释放着极不稳定的能量波，使其形态若隐若现，因此我们在该区域的初步扫描时没有发现这座建筑。

当它显现时，可以看到其密封的外墙装饰着某种难以理解的符号，而我们的记录中没有任何一种语言与之相符。

其功能尚未明确。该建筑目前为止还没有造成任何伤害，但确乎影响了我们的发展工作。
strange_worlds.30.desc.en:
As we were preparing land for future expansion on [Root.GetName], a large structure seemingly blinked into existence.

The structure is emitting highly unstable energy waves causing it to intermittently appear and disappear from view. This explains why it was not present in initial scans of this sector.

When visible, unintelligible symbols adorn its sealed exterior, but match no known language in our records. 

No apparent function can be discerned. The construct has thus far caused no harm but it is obstructing our development efforts.

strange_worlds.3005.desc.zh:
在观察[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]当地人口时，我们的外派团队发现了件有趣的事情。

这里的首都大街小巷都在交头接耳着关于一位“天选之人”的事情，据说是从星间下凡实现一个古老预言，并将带领[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]走入下一个黄金时期。

我们的所有人员都记录在岗，所以究竟是谁在访问这颗行星很值得进一步调查。
strange_worlds.3005.desc.en:
While observing the local population of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], our away team have come across an interesting discovery.

The capital city is abuzz with talk of a "Chosen One" who has reportedly descended from the stars to fulfill an ancient prophecy and lead the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] into a new golden age.

All of our personnel are accounted for, so whoever it is that is visiting this planet, they are worth investigating further.

strange_worlds.3010.a.en: Expose them as the fraud they are.

strange_worlds.3010.desc_intro.zh: 我们的外派团队正在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]深入调查所谓“天选之人”来揭开他的真面目。
strange_worlds.3010.desc_intro.en: Our away team's investigation into the "Chosen One" on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has revealed their true identity.

strange_worlds.3010.desc_megacorp.zh: 一位[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]流浪者伪装成了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话的核心人物，“从星间下凡而来”。
strange_worlds.3010.desc_megacorp.en: A [event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName] caravaneer is masquerading as the central figure of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology, having "descended from the stars".

strange_worlds.3010.desc_no_megacorp.zh: 一位拿玛拉流浪汉伪装成了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话的核心人物，“从星间下凡而来”。
strange_worlds.3010.desc_no_megacorp.en: A Namaraian Nomad is masquerading as the central figure of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology, having "descended from the stars".

strange_worlds.3010.desc_outro.zh:
在行星上的进一步探索中发现了他把坠毁的舰船隐藏在了一片离首都一段距离无法到达的峡谷。根据其老旧的超空间引擎型号，此人可能已经到此有些年头了。

自从落难到此，他似乎开始利用当地的迷信来牟利。他被任命为充满“天智”的统治者，心安理得地开始接受当地人的顶礼膜拜。

如果放任不管，这个骗子在行星上的存在很可能对社会的发展造成严重的影响，最好还是介入处置一下。
strange_worlds.3010.desc_outro.en:
Further exploration of the planet has revealed their crashed and inoperable ship hidden in an inaccessible valley some distance away from the capital. Based on the dated model of the hyperdrives, they have been here for some time.

Since becoming marooned, they appear to have been using the local superstition to their advantage. They happily accept veneration and praise from the locals having been installed as their ruler full of "celestial knowledge".

If left unchecked, this charlatan's presence on the planet will likely have heavy consequences for the developing society. It might be best to intervene.

strange_worlds.3015.desc_megacorp.zh: 我们揭露了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上那个伪装成[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话中“天选之人”的[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]。
strange_worlds.3015.desc_megacorp.en: We have successfully deposed the [event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName] on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] masquerading as the "Chosen One" of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology.

strange_worlds.3015.desc_no_megacorp.zh: 我们揭露了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上那个伪装成[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话中“天选之人”的拿玛拉流浪汉。
strange_worlds.3015.desc_no_megacorp.en: We have successfully deposed the Namaraian Nomad on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] masquerading as the "Chosen One" of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology.

strange_worlds.3015.desc_outro.zh:
在进一步调查当地的传说之后，我们告诉他们所谓天选之人的统治阶级事实上是一位被派来欺骗他们的恶魔，将会给这个世界带来千年之久的黑暗。

我们将坠毁的舰船完全拆成了碎片，让当地人无迹可寻。然而，有些个人物品已经被发现了，该物种也窥见了超过当前理解水平的科技。
strange_worlds.3015.desc_outro.en:
After researching local legends in more detail, we were able to convince the ruling class that their so-called chosen one was in fact a demon sent to deceive them and plunge the planet into a thousand years of darkness.

We successfully scrapped the crashed ship for parts, leaving no trace of it for the locals to find. However, some personal items had already been discovered and have given this species a glimpse of technology beyond their current understanding.

strange_worlds.3020.desc_intro.zh: 我们的外派团队获得了与[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的所谓“天选之人”私下见面的机会，提出为其修复舰船并送回太空的机会。
strange_worlds.3020.desc_intro.en: Our away team was able to gain a private audience with the "Chosen One" of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] and offer them our services in repairing their ship and returning them to space.

strange_worlds.3020.desc_megacorp.zh: 那个[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]急切地想要接受我们的邀请，不断辩称是在搁浅于[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的时候被误认为是神，之后因惧怕事情败露后遭到伤害而惶惶不可终日。
strange_worlds.3020.desc_megacorp.en: The [event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName] was all too eager to accept the offer, explaining that they'd been mistakenly received as a god after becoming stranded on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] and had lived in fear of being harmed if unmasked ever since.

strange_worlds.3020.desc_no_megacorp.zh: 那个拿玛拉流浪汉急切地想要接受我们的邀请，不断辩称是在搁浅于[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的时候被误认为是神，之后因惧怕事情败露后遭到伤害而惶惶不可终日。
strange_worlds.3020.desc_no_megacorp.en: The Namarain Nomad was all too eager to accept the offer, explaining that they'd been mistakenly received as a god after becoming stranded on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] and had lived in fear of being harmed if unmasked ever since.

strange_worlds.3020.desc_outro.zh:
将其送到了我们的研究站修复了舰船之后，这位充满感激的旅行者将舰船库存的一大部分东西送给了我们并向我们郑重道别。

因为其离去而造成的权利真空在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的各个教派之间引发了一场短暂但血腥的斗争，现在也趋于平息。
strange_worlds.3020.desc_outro.en:
Having transported them to our research post and repaired their ship, the grateful traveler gifted us with a large portion of their vessel's inventory before bidding us farewell.

The ensuing power vacuum created by their departure triggered a brief but brutal struggle between various religious sects on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], which has now subsided.

strange_worlds.3025.desc.zh:
你好[Owner.GetSpeciesName]。我们了解到你们刚刚处理了一个脱离我们舰队的拿玛拉人流氓。

你们可帮了大忙。这个误入歧途的人一直让人讨厌，他的疯狂野心给我们的旅程带来了风险。

请收下这份礼物作为感谢。
strange_worlds.3025.desc.en:
Greetings [Owner.GetSpeciesName]. We understand that you have dealt with a rogue Namarian who separated from our fleet.

You have done us a service. This misguided individual was a constant annoyance, their wild ambitions posing a risk to our journey.

Please, take this gift as thanks.

strange_worlds.3030.desc.zh:
[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]处理了我们弄丢的垃圾？你们人还怪好的！这个蠢货除了麻烦什么都造不出来。至于他说的那些鬼话？真遗憾，他这都是第五次了。真的？我们很高兴他滚蛋了。
这个你收下，这是给你们处理了个麻烦玩意儿的谢礼。一锤子买卖，非常好东西。
strange_worlds.3030.desc.en:
[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dealt with the lost Racket? Very good of you! This fool caused nothing but headaches for us. His mumbo jumbo? An embarrassment. It's the fifth time this has happened. Honestly? We're glad they're gone.
Here, you take this, a gift for making the problem go away. One time deal, very good value.

strange_worlds.3040.desc.zh:
我们在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站汇报，在最近一次地表地址调查之后丢失了一个补给箱。

在追踪补给箱地理定位的过程中，我们发现它被一座当地村庄发现并占为己有。

我们补给箱的混入可能对[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的发展带来不利影响。
strange_worlds.3040.desc.en:
Our observation post above [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported missing supply crates following a recent geological survey on the surface.

While tracking the geolocators on the supplies, we have discovered that a local village has found and claimed these resources for themselves.

The introduction of our storage containers may have an adverse effect on the development of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

strange_worlds.3045.b_normal.zh: 用食物交换他们的矿物。
strange_worlds.3045.b_normal.en: Exchange food supplies for their minerals.

strange_worlds.3045.ct.zh: 正在观测[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的观测站将产出$@observation_outpost_crate_minerals_production$$i_minerals$，维护费$@observation_outpost_crate_food_upkeep$$i_food$
strange_worlds.3045.ct.en: The Observation post currently observing [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] now produces $@observation_outpost_crate_minerals_production$ $i_minerals$ with an upkeep of $@observation_outpost_crate_food_upkeep$ $i_food$

strange_worlds.3045.desc_common.zh:
看来，误入[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的补给箱存对当地文化产生了奇怪的影响。

当地[Root.GetPreFTLUpper]居民建造了我们观测飞船的粗糙仿制品。虽然这些“船”显然没有功能，但这证明我们的研究人员在调查期间被当地人发现了。

在一位当地长老的指导下，可以看到[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]队模仿我们的地质土壤分析程序：把我们不当处置的板条箱装满泥土和岩石，把它们装上他们的“船”，耐心地等待。
strange_worlds.3045.desc_common.en:
It would appear that the misplaced inventory on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has had a strange impact on the native culture.

The [Root.GetPreFTLUpper] population has built crude imitations of our own observation shuttles. While these "ships" are obviously non functional, this is evidence that our researchers were spotted by locals during their survey.

Under the guidance of a local elder, the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] can be seen performing an imitation of our geological soil analysis procedure: filling our misplaced crates we left behind with dirt and rocks, loading them onto their "ships", and waiting patiently.

strange_worlds.3045.desc_homicidal.zh: 这么做就是徒劳，等来的只会有死亡。
strange_worlds.3045.desc_homicidal.en: This practice is ultimately futile, only death awaits.

strange_worlds.3045.desc_non_homicidal.zh: [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]以为模仿我们的行为，就会有更多的货物出现。我们应该在这种行为对社会造成更大影响之前进行干预。
strange_worlds.3045.desc_non_homicidal.en: The [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] are under the impression that by mimicking our processes, more supplies will appear. We should intervene before this behavior impacts their wider society.

strange_worlds.3050.desc.zh:
从[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]取回我们丢失的箱子后，装载“飞船”的仪式仍持续了一阵子，直到[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]愤怒地找到村庄长老，然后把他们丢进仿造的“穿梭机”并烧成了灰烬。

尽管人们已经回归了此前的日常，但他们的文化里对“天人”的怨恨仍然挥之不去。
strange_worlds.3050.desc.en:
After recovering our lost crates from [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the "ship" loading rituals continued for a short while, until the angry [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] locals turned on their village elder, throwing them into the makeshift shuttle before burning it to ashes.

Although the population has returned to their previous routines, their culture retains a lingering resentment towards the "sky people".

strange_worlds.3060.ct.zh: 该观测站不再产出矿物也不需要食物维护费了
strange_worlds.3060.ct.en: The Observation post no longer outputs Minerals and no longer requires a Food upkeep

strange_worlds.3060.desc.zh:
随着[Root.GetPreFTLLower][event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]社会的发展，我们停止了从观测站与他们进行的资源交换。

尽管这是一个很有趣的实验，继续影响他们的社会只会让我们过早地暴露在他们面前。
strange_worlds.3060.desc.en:
As the [Root.GetPreFTLLower] [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] society advances, we have discontinued our exchange of rations for minerals from our observation post.

Despite being an interesting experiment, the continued interference with their civilization only risks exposing our presence to them prematurely.

strange_worlds.3070.desc.zh:
一阵重力异常将我们的观测站晃离了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的轨道，导致它短暂进入了行星的下层大气。

虽然我们的乘员没有受伤而且也恢复了原定轨道，但有人担心观测站可能会被地上的[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发现。

只有时间知道我们是否暴露，以及这会对他们的社会造成何等影响。
strange_worlds.3070.desc.en:
A gravitational anomaly knocked our observation post over [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] out of orbit, causing it to briefly drop into the planet's lower atmosphere.

While our crew are unharmed and our original trajectory has been restored, there are concerns that the station could have been detected from the surface by the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Only time will tell if we have been exposed to the locals, and to what extent that will impact their society.

strange_worlds.3075.b_ct.zh: 观测站的£society£社会学研究产出翻倍
strange_worlds.3075.b_ct.en: The £society£ Society Research output from the observation post is doubled

strange_worlds.3075.desc_common.zh:
我们的观测站在落入[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]下层轨道时被原始的成像科技记录了下来。除了目击证据，这些照片也启发了一些国家建造“登天之梯”以进一步调查研究。

尽管这是徒劳，各个民族国家之间的竞争导致了不稳定。在民族自豪感和资源稀缺的推动下，在完成第一个“阶梯”的竞赛中，旧有的紧张关系重新燃起。
strange_worlds.3075.desc_common.en:
Primitive image capturing technology managed to record our observation post while it was in low orbit above [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Alongside eyewitness testimonies, these photographs have inspired some nations to build "ladders to heaven" in order to investigate further.

While this is obviously a futile effort, competition between nation states is having a destabilizing effect. Old tensions are flaring up in the race to complete the first "ladder", fueled by national pride and scarcity of resources.

strange_worlds.3075.desc_homicidal.zh: 即将到来的混乱应该是一个极好的研究机会。
strange_worlds.3075.desc_homicidal.en: The impending chaos should make for an excellent research opportunity.

strange_worlds.3075.desc_non_homicidal.zh:
如果我们能销毁他们关于我们存在的证据，那也许能在失控之前缓和紧张局势。

这种[Root.GetPreFTLUpper]政治实体之间的外交姿态也可以作为一个很有趣的社会学研究案例，尽管它还有可能成为暴力升级的导火索。
strange_worlds.3075.desc_non_homicidal.en:
If we can discredit their evidence of our own existence, we may be able to defuse tensions before the situation gets out of [Owner.GetSpeciesHandName].

Alternatively, this diplomatic posturing between [Root.GetPreFTLUpper] political powers could be an interesting sociological case study, albeit one that comes with the risk of violent escalation.

strange_worlds.3080.a_ct.zh:
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName]向下一个时代进展50%
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName]成为唯物主义。
strange_worlds.3080.a_ct.en:
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName] makes 50% progress towards the next age
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName] becomes Materialist.

strange_worlds.3080.desc.zh:
我们的特工已经成功地推翻了我们在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上存在的证据。

随着图像被揭穿，目击者的可信度被毁，“通天之梯”的建设已经停止。这两个曾经分裂的国家为自己被认为愚蠢而感到尴尬，他们已承诺追求理性的探索和科学的方法。

随着新一波学者聚集在一起，“天空城堡”神话的面纱被揭开，梯子的建筑工地已被改造成了高等教育中心。
strange_worlds.3080.desc.en:
Our operators have successfully discredited the evidence of our existence on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

With the images debunked and the eyewitnesses' credibility destroyed, construction of the "ladders to heaven" has stopped. Embarrassed by their perceived foolishness, the once-divided nations have made a commitment towards the pursuit of rational inquiry and the scientific method.

The building sites for the ladders have been repurposed into centers of higher learning, as a new wave of scholars come together to debunk the myths of the "Sky Citadel".

strange_worlds.3085.a_ct.zh: 观测站的£society£社会学研究产出恢复正常
strange_worlds.3085.a_ct.en: The £society£ Society Research output from the observation post returns to normal

strange_worlds.3085.desc.zh:
在建设“通天之梯”的过程中，[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[Root.GetPreFTLLower]国家之间的紧张局势导致了一场席卷全球的冲突。为了争夺日益减少的资源，这场持续两年的被称为“天梯大战”的大屠杀终于结束了。

和平条约的关键条款是组成统一战线对抗共同的敌人“天空堡垒”。随着[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始重建饱受战争蹂躏的星球，他们对未知的偏执和仇恨使得在未来与他们的互动更具挑战性。
strange_worlds.3085.desc.en:
In their efforts to construct "ladders to heaven," tensions between the [Root.GetPreFTLLower] nations of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] led to an all-out global conflict. Fighting over ever-dwindling resources, the past two years of carnage known as the "Great Ladder Wars" have at last come to an end.

The key terms of the peace treaty are to present a united front against their common enemy, the "Sky Citadel." As the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] rebuild their war-torn world, their increased paranoia and hatred of the unknown will make future interactions with them more challenging.

strange_worlds.35.desc.cloak.zh: 我们对[Root.GetName]上这座闪烁的建筑进行分析后，确信该物体具有间歇性的隐形能力。$strange_worlds.35.desc.common_1$即便我对该建筑性质的理解正在逐渐加深，但仍未能进入其中——假设确实的能进去的话。$strange_worlds.35.desc.common_2$
strange_worlds.35.desc.cloak.en: Analysis of the shimmering building on [Root.GetName] leads us to assume the object is somehow producing an intermittent cloaking effect.$strange_worlds.35.desc.common_1$While our understanding of the building's cloaking effects has grown, we have thus far been unable to enter it - if this is in fact even possible.$strange_worlds.35.desc.common_2$

strange_worlds.35.desc.no_cloak.zh: 我们对[Root.GetName]上这座闪烁的建筑进行分析后，确信该物体会以某种方式扭曲光线。$strange_worlds.35.desc.common_1$即便我对该建筑性质的理解正在逐渐加深，但仍未能进入其中——假设确实的能进去的话。$strange_worlds.35.desc.common_2$
strange_worlds.35.desc.no_cloak.en: Analysis of the shimmering building on [Root.GetName] leads us to assume the object is bending or distorting light somehow.$strange_worlds.35.desc.common_1$While our understanding of the building's properties has grown, we have thus far been unable to enter it - if this is in fact even possible.$strange_worlds.35.desc.common_2$

strange_worlds.40.desc.zh:
尝试以暴力方式进入[Root.GetName]上的建筑招致了一场灾难。我们的设备进一步让建筑的能量模式失稳，引发了一系列剧烈的爆炸。如今它只剩下一堆灰烬。

其意外的毁灭进一步招致出人意料的结果。附近的山谷里出现了一座被遗弃已久的外星人定居点废墟。

似乎这个物体以某种方式在前殖民地投射了一个强大的隐形场；至于是为了躲避什么仍然是个谜，但可以肯定，不管他们做过何种努力，如今都已是死寂一片。没有一件有考古价值的东西完好无损。

这种不寻常的技术的确切工作原理对我们来说仍然是未解之谜，但我们从这次经历中得到了些许新知识。我们将重新利用这种强大的地热能源为自己的殖民地服务。
strange_worlds.40.desc.en:
Attempts to force entry into the structure on [Root.GetName] ended in disaster. Our equipment further destabilized the building's energy patterns, causing a series of potent explosions. It is now little more than an ashen wreck.

Its accidental destruction produced an unexpected outcome. The razed ruins of a long-abandoned alien settlement appeared in a nearby valley.

It seems the object was somehow projecting a powerful cloaking field on the former colony; what they were hiding from remains a mystery, but what is certain is that they perished regardless of their efforts. Nothing of archaeological value remains intact.

The exact workings of this unusual technology remain unknown to us, but we gleaned some new knowledge from the experience. We will repurpose this potent geothermal energy source for our own colony.

strange_worlds.45.desc.a.zh:
$strange_worlds.45.desc.intro$

现在我们可以将这座建筑奇怪的隐形场稳定化并且扩展到整座山谷了。这可以大幅提升我们殖民地的安全系数。
strange_worlds.45.desc.a.en:
$strange_worlds.45.desc.intro$

We are now able to stabilize and expand the building's strange cloaking effect to cover the entire valley. It will be a great enhancement to our colony's safety.

strange_worlds.45.desc.b.zh:
$strange_worlds.45.desc.intro$

现在我们可以将这座建筑的隐形场稳定化并且扩展到整座山谷，并大幅提高我们对隐形科技的认知了。
strange_worlds.45.desc.b.en:
$strange_worlds.45.desc.intro$

We are now able to stabilize and expand the building's cloaking field to protect the entire valley, and have greatly increased our knowledge of cloaking technologies.

strange_worlds.5.a.zh: 治疗并研究沾染粘液的人。

strange_worlds.5.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告了关于神秘猩红色粘液的新进展，结果令人不安。

这种物质正变得难以控制，在受影响的区域以更快的速度涌现。

这种粘液并非毫无益处。随着其凝固，其粘合特性变得更加显著，有效地形成了一种天然水泥，对于我们建设工作的进展可以作为有效补充。

然而，令人担忧的是，这种物质几乎无法从任何接触它的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]身上清除。尝试治疗和研究受影响的工人将使我们能够收集更多信息，但会减缓建设进度。
strange_worlds.5.desc.en:
[Root.GetName] reports troubling developments regarding the strange crimson ooze.

The substance is becoming unmanageable, emerging at a greater rate throughout the afflicted areas.

The ooze is not without its benefits. As it coagulates, its adhesive properties become more pronounced, effectively forming a natural cement that can be used to supplement our construction efforts.

Worryingly though, the substance proves nearly impossible to remove from any [Owner.GetColonistPlural] who come into contact with it. Attempting to treat and study those affected would allow us to gather more information but would slow construction progress.

strange_worlds.55.desc.a.zh:
$strange_worlds.55.desc.intro$然而这也带来了意料之外的食物产出，当地[Owner.GetColonistPlural]发现这种生物的肉非常地美味。

$strange_worlds.55.desc.outro$
strange_worlds.55.desc.a.en:
$strange_worlds.55.desc.intro$This has however led to the unexpected benefit of increased food production, with [Owner.GetColonistPlural] discovering that the flesh of the creatures is highly delicious.

$strange_worlds.55.desc.outro$

strange_worlds.55.desc.b.zh:
$strange_worlds.55.desc.intro$尽管这提升了我们的生物质收获量，但也带来了很大不便。

$strange_worlds.55.desc.outro$
strange_worlds.55.desc.b.en:
$strange_worlds.55.desc.intro$While this is increasing the amount of biomass we can harvest, it is rather inconvenient.

$strange_worlds.55.desc.outro$

strange_worlds.60.desc.zh:
关于[Root.GetName]上的物种自杀我们获得了极具价值的洞见。

这些巨型动物是功能性失明的，它们利用回声定位来观察和识别彼此。我们怀疑电网发出的频率超过了他们敏锐听觉所能忍受的程度，引发了对我们发电站的攻击行为。

除此之外，我们还了解到它们独特的消化酶可以作为冶金冶炼的催化剂。初步试验表明合金产量有望提高。

尽管有了这些发现，我们距离恢复正常的能源生产还有很长的路要走。我们的科学家将继续调查这个问题。
strange_worlds.60.desc.en:
We have gained valuable insights on the suicidal fauna species on [Root.GetName].

These megafauna are functionally blind, using echolocation to see and identify one another. We suspect that our energy grids are emitting a frequency that is overwhelming their acute hearing, triggering this aggressive behavior toward our power stations.

In addition to this, we have learned that their unique digestive enzymes can act as a catalyst in metallurgic refining. Initial tests show potential in improving our alloy production.

Despite these discoveries, we are still a long way off from resuming normal energy production. Our scientists continue to investigate the issue.

strange_worlds.65.desc.devouring_swarm.zh: $strange_worlds.65.desc.intro$我们可以利用这些知识很方便地引导这些生物到特定的捕获装置中。饱餐一顿吧。
strange_worlds.65.desc.devouring_swarm.en: $strange_worlds.65.desc.intro$Conveniently, we can use this knowledge to channel the creatures into specialized harvesters. Let us feast.

strange_worlds.65.desc.food.en:
$strange_worlds.65.desc.intro$$strange_worlds.65.desc.common$These creatures have become a staple of the [Root.GetName] diet.

$strange_worlds.65.desc.outro$

strange_worlds.65.desc.no_food.zh:
$strange_worlds.65.desc.intro$这些生物在[Root.GetName]上是一种可持续的生物质资源

$strange_worlds.65.desc.outro$
strange_worlds.65.desc.no_food.en:
$strange_worlds.65.desc.intro$these creatures are a consistent and sustainable source of biomass on [Root.GetName]

$strange_worlds.65.desc.outro$

strange_worlds.75.desc.zh:
[Owner.GetColonistPlural]汇报了关于[Root.GetName]上的沙子的奇特现象。

本该是风和日丽的一天我们定居点附近却唐突刮起剧烈的沙尘暴。如洪水般的流沙凭空出现又霎时消失无踪。甚至还有人在风平浪静的一天看到沙丘在横向移动。

这些事件至今没有找到任何气象或地理学的解释。

这些怪异的沙子没有造成直接的伤害，但妨碍到了我们殖民地的运作。对这一独特自然现象的研究仍在进行当中。
strange_worlds.75.desc.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] are reporting strange phenomena with the sands on [Root.GetName].

Severe sandstorms materialize abruptly in close proximity to our colony on otherwise calm days. Rivers of fast-moving sand appear from nowhere before stopping as suddenly as they began. There are even reports of sand dunes moving laterally on a perfectly windless day.

No atmospheric or geological explanations for these events have thus far been identified.

These peculiar sands are causing us no direct harm, but they are interfering with our colony's operations. The study of this unique phenomenon is ongoing.

strange_worlds.80.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的沙暴开始发出低沉的轰鸣声。这种声音会经常改变音调，并呈现出一定的重复模式。

尽管这种“歌唱沙”的现象可以归咎于自由颗粒的已知特性，但这种变调之频繁却无法单单使用摩擦力来解释。

我们还找到一座被沙丘掩埋的山谷，其中满满刻蚀着奇特的符号。这些图样的阵列会短暂地突出浮现，又几乎瞬间消失得无影无踪。

让沙子活动起来的原因尚不明确，但这些模式的一致性表明了其行为背后应该存在某种目的或意图。
strange_worlds.80.desc.en:
The sandstorms on [Root.GetName] have started emitting a deep droning sound. The frequency regularly shifts in pitch and modulates in recurring patterns.

While this 'singing sand' phenomenon can be attributed to known properties of free particles, the regularity of these modulations cannot be explained by friction alone.

We have also found a valley filled with dunes etched with strange symbols. These glyphs appear fleetingly in raised formations before dispersing almost instantaneously.

What is animating the sand is unclear, but the consistent nature of the patterns suggest purpose or intent behind its behavior.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part1_no_zro.zh: 研究[Root.GetName]上沙暴的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现了一种分布在硅酸盐中的全新独特物质。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part1_no_zro.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] studying the sandstorms on [Root.GetName] have discovered that a new form of exotic matter is distributed throughout the silicate material.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part1_zro.zh: 研究[Root.GetName]上沙暴的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现，分布在硅酸盐中的物质是泽珞。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part1_zro.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] studying the sandstorms on [Root.GetName] have discovered that Zro is distributed throughout the silicate material.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_machine_no_.zh: $strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_machine_common$这些强烈的干扰导致了视觉处理异常，产生一种未知外星种族形象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上的幻象。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_machine_no_.en: $strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_machine_common$These powerful disruptions caused malfunctions in visual processing, resulting in the apparition of unfamiliar alien figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_machine_zro.zh: $strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_machine_common$这些强烈的干扰导致了视觉处理异常，产生一种泽珞族形象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上的幻象。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_machine_zro.en: $strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_machine_common$These powerful disruptions caused malfunctions in visual processing, resulting in the apparition of Zroni figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_non_machine.zh: [Owner.GetResearchers]在处理样品时出现了短暂但强烈的幻视，看见了未知外星种族的幻象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_non_machine.en: While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced brief but powerful visions. They witnessed apparitions of unfamiliar alien figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_non_machine.zh: [Owner.GetResearchers]在处理样品时出现了短暂但强烈的幻视，看见了泽珞族形象的幻象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_non_machine.en: While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced brief but powerful visions. They witnessed apparitions of Zroni figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_non_machine.zh: [Owner.GetResearchers]在处理样品时出现了短暂但强烈的灵能视，看见了未知外形种族的幻象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_non_machine.en: While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced brief but powerful psionic visions. They witnessed apparitions of unfamiliar alien figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_non_machine.zh: [Owner.GetResearchers]在处理样品时出现了短暂但强烈的灵能视，看见了泽珞族形象的幻象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part2_non_machine.en: While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced brief but powerful psionic visions. They witnessed apparitions of Zroni figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part3_no_zro.zh: $strange_worlds.85.desc_part3_common$我们很容易就能从沙子中提取这种奇特物质，但这可能就会导致幻象消散。尽管如此，这种违背物理现象的物质可能会极具价值。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part3_no_zro.en: $strange_worlds.85.desc_part3_common$We could simply extract the exotic material from the sand, but doing so could cause the apparitions to dissipate. However, this unique physics-defying substance may prove to be highly valuable.

strange_worlds.85.desc_part3_zro.zh: $strange_worlds.85.desc_part3_common$我们很容易就能从沙子中提取泽珞，但这可能就会导致幻象消散。尽管如此，这种宝贵物质的数量还是相当庞大的。
strange_worlds.85.desc_part3_zro.en: $strange_worlds.85.desc_part3_common$We could simply extract the Zro from the sand, but doing so will likely cause the apparitions to dissipate. However, there is quite a large amount of the valuable substance.

strange_worlds.90.desc_intro_no_zroni.zh: 使用我们的语言库，我们在[Root.GetName]的沙子上书写了所有已知外星文字的数百种代表问候的符号。终于，我们得到了一个回复。
strange_worlds.90.desc_intro_no_zroni.en: Using our language databases, we marked hundreds of symbols representing greetings in every known alien script upon the sands on [Root.GetName]. Eventually, a response came.

strange_worlds.90.desc_intro_zroni.zh: 利用对泽珞族文化已有的知识，我们在[Root.GetName]的沙子上标记了一个新的符文；泽珞语的你好。我们立刻就得到了回应。
strange_worlds.90.desc_intro_zroni.en: We used our previous knowledge of Zroni culture to mark a new glyph upon the sands on [Root.GetName]; the symbol for a Zroni greeting. The response came immediately.

strange_worlds.90.desc_storyline_finishe.zh: $strange_worlds.90.desc_common$我们立刻就发现了这就是泽珞族的故事；他们飞升入虚境又招致毁灭。这些沙子由内含的泽珞驱动，形成了泽珞族悲剧命运的宇宙回响。$strange_worlds.90.desc_outro$
strange_worlds.90.desc_storyline_finishe.en: $strange_worlds.90.desc_common$We immediately recognized this as the story of the Zroni; their ascent into the Shroud and ensuing destruction. Animated by the Zro within, these sands formed a cosmic echo of Zroni's tragic fate.$strange_worlds.90.desc_outro$

strange_worlds.90.desc_storyline_not_sta.zh: $strange_worlds.90.desc_common$我们唯一了解到的是这是某个外星种族发现新力量并招致分裂和毁灭的故事。$strange_worlds.90.desc_outro$
strange_worlds.90.desc_storyline_not_sta.en: $strange_worlds.90.desc_common$We understood only that this was a story of an alien race discovering a newfound power that eventually divided and destroyed them.$strange_worlds.90.desc_outro$

strange_worlds.90.desc_storyline_started.zh: $strange_worlds.90.desc_common$我们立刻就发现了这是个泽珞族的故事；一种全新力量和可怕冲突的幻象。这些沙子由内含的泽珞驱动，形成了远古泽珞种族的宇宙回响。$strange_worlds.90.desc_outro$
strange_worlds.90.desc_storyline_started.en: $strange_worlds.90.desc_common$We immediately recognized this as a story of the Zroni; a vision of newfound power and terrible conflict. Animated by the Zro within, these sands formed a cosmic echo of the ancient Zroni race.$strange_worlds.90.desc_outro$

strange_worlds.95.desc_no_zroni_tech.zh: 关于在[Root.GetName]上采收泽珞的工作好坏参半。我们虽然成功提取了一小部分，但大多数都在实验过程中损失了。然而我们也确实在这个过程中学到了许多。$strange_worlds.95.desc_outro$
strange_worlds.95.desc_no_zroni_tech.en: Efforts to harvest the Zro on [Root.GetName] produced mixed results. We successfully extracted a small quantity, but much was lost in the course of our experiments. We did however learn a great deal in the process.$strange_worlds.95.desc_outro$

strange_worlds.95.desc_zroni_tech.zh: 利用泽珞蒸馏的专业技术，我们从[Root.GetName]的沙子里提取了大量的泽珞，并且在过程中学习到了很多。$strange_worlds.95.desc_outro$
strange_worlds.95.desc_zroni_tech.en: Using our expertise in Zro Distillation, we extracted a sizable quantity from the sands on [Root.GetName], learning a great deal in the process.$strange_worlds.95.desc_outro$

stratovent_world_modifier_tourism.zh: 原封不动的平流层喷口

string_not_in_deficit_exotic_gases.zh: 异星天然气月度结余为正

string_not_in_deficit_rare_crystals.zh: 稀有水晶月度结余为正

string_not_in_deficit_volatile_motes.zh: 易爆微粒月度结余为正

study_astral_method.zh: 星界丝缕似乎可以对这个装置进行刺激。我们刺激得越多，它激活得就越快。
study_astral_method.en: Astral thread seems to stimulate the device. The more we expose it to, the faster its activation.

study_mundane_method.zh: 如果我们能够投入足够的科学研究来开发这个设备的潜力，我们相信可以加速其激活。
study_mundane_method.en: If we were to dedicate enough scientific research to unlocking the potential of this device, we believe we can accelerate its activation.

study_observe_method.zh: 这个设备似乎正在以某种仔细考量的方式慢慢调整自己。我们相信，随着时间的推移，它将完成它被设计去执行的任务。
study_observe_method.en: The device seems to be aligning itself slowly in a deliberate fashion. We believe that, over time, it will accomplish what it was designed to do.

studying_insights_tt.zh: 我们正在从各个[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球积极收集洞见线索。
studying_insights_tt.en: We are actively gathering Insights from [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds.

subglacial_vibrations_desc.zh: [from.GetName]的冰冻荒原之下潜藏着巨大的冰下海洋。在深深的永冻层下探测到的隆隆震动，从本质上无法被归类为地震。
subglacial_vibrations_desc.en: Beneath [from.GetName]'s frozen and lifeless surface lies a vast subglacial ocean. Deep, rumbling vibrations have been detected beneath the permafrost that are not registering as seismic in nature.

subject.1.a.zh: 以官方名义发函允许他们前往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]。
subject.1.a.en: Give them formal leave to travel to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName].

subject.1.a.tt.zh: 老兵们会被送往[subject_empire.GetName]进行援建。
subject.1.a.tt.en: The veterans will be sent to aid [subject_empire.GetName].

subject.1.b.zh: 他们想做什么就做什么。
subject.1.b.en: Let them do as they wish.

subject.1.b.tt.en: The veterans might cause havoc in [subject_empire.GetName].

subject.1.c.zh: 我们不会被这群想当海盗的家伙贿赂。
subject.1.c.en: We will not be bribed by these would-be privateers.

subject.1.c.tt.zh: 这批老兵不允许离开我们的帝国。
subject.1.c.tt.en: The veterans will not be allowed to leave our empire.

subject.1.desc.zh:
一个规模庞大的老兵代表团致信，要求离开当地前往位于[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]的殖民地——此地也是我们的附庸[subject_empire.GetName]的首都。随信件附上的还有一笔礼金，用于“使官僚的齿轮运转更为润滑”，他们这样委婉地表述道。

似乎在我们的老兵中间流传着许多这样的故事，讲述一个人前往这些恒星系是如何在冒险中发了大财——或是作为雇佣兵，或是作为海盗。无论是哪一种，很显然这些老兵掏出了自己的家底进行众筹，希望能够通过前往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]赚他个几番。

如果我们决定以官方名义派遣他们去往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]，他们至少更可能对当地的领导阶级起到良性的促进作用——并且更有可能尊重我们附庸的法律和条例——相比于让他们自己跑过去来说。
subject.1.desc.en:
A large contingent of our veterans has sent a letter requesting leave to travel to the colony at [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], the capital of our vassal [subject_empire.GetName]. Included with the letter is a gift of credits to "grease the wheels of bureaucracy", as they so delicately put it.

It seems there are quite a lot of stories among some of our soldiers about the lucrative adventures one can find in those systems - be it as a mercenary or a pirate. In either case, it is made clear that they have put together what credits they have, hoping to make many times that if they are sent off to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName].

If we were to formally send them to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] they are at least more likely to be a boon to the leadership there - and more likely to respect the laws and rules of our vassal - than if we were to let them run free.

subject.10.a.zh: 看来我们白担心了一场。
subject.10.a.en: It seems our worries were misplaced.

subject.10.desc.zh: 尽管我们对于派遣那群渴望冒险的老兵去往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]一事有所保留，我们却收到了附庸的报告，称那群老兵已经将当地视为自己的家园，发挥的作用比预料的要多得多。
subject.10.desc.en: Though we had our reservations about sending the adventure-seeking veterans to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], we have received reports from our vassal that they have found themselves at home there, and have proven to be more helpful than one would originally expect.

subject.100.a.zh: 我们鼓励他们保卫自己。
subject.100.a.en: We will inspire them to defend themselves.

subject.100.a.tt.zh: [subject_empire.GetName]可能会变得更军国主义一些。

subject.100.b.zh: 无论如何，保护附庸是宗主的职责。
subject.100.b.en: It is an overlord's duty to protect their vassal, no matter what.

subject.100.c.zh: 他们要学会自力更生了。
subject.100.c.en: They are on their own, for now.

subject.100.desc.zh:
我们从[subject_empire.GetName]被占领的殖民地收到了一封通讯，行文措辞如同现在他们整个国家一般支离破碎。我们的附属国无法自保，正在寻求我们的帮助。

由于我们的外交协议所具有的军国主义性质，我们自然应当涉足其中，并保护我们的附属国不受到进一步的伤害。我们的一些顾问则考虑，也许通过鼓舞我们的附庸让他们奋起保卫自己而不是直接介入，才是对双方更合适的决定。
subject.100.desc.en:
We have received reports from the occupied colonies of [subject_empire.GetName], disorganized and destitute as they currently are. Our subject is now looking to us for aid, as they seem unable to defend themselves.

Considering the militaristic nature of our diplomatic agreement, it would be only natural for us to step in and protect them from further harm. Some of our advisors wonder if we all might be better served by inspiring our vassal to rise up and defend themselves, rather than by intervening directly.

subject.1003.a.zh: 其实他们的议程还恰好挺符合我们的计划的。
subject.1003.a.en: Actually, their little agenda lines up with our own plans.

subject.1003.b.zh: 在事态失控前结束这场闹剧吧。
subject.1003.b.en: Put an end to it before it gets out of hand.

subject.1003.desc.zh:
有报道称[Root.Capital.GetName]上正在酝酿着一个鹰派运动，而一位老兵象征性地处于这个运动的核心地位。他们通过对我们过去可以任意进犯、踏平其他帝国的浪漫主义化，来敦促我们提出更激进的议程，为我们自己的人民带来更多的利益，同时削弱我们的对手。

在当前脆弱而短暂的和平下，他们很快获得了广大穷人和军人的支持。如果觉得这个运动会带来麻烦的话，我们的顾问指出，这个运动的关键角色就是那位有名无实的领袖，如果移除这个惹麻烦的元素，整个运动就会土崩瓦解。
subject.1003.desc.en:
There are reports of a hawkish movement brewing on [Root.Capital.GetName], with a decorated veteran at its center. Romanticizing a past where we were free to attack and raze other empires, they demand a more warlike agenda to supposedly bring out the best in our own people while weakening our rivals.

With our current peace - tenuous as it might be - they have quickly found themselves a large following among the poor and within the military. If we consider this to be an issue, our advisors indicate that the movement hinges on its figurehead veteran - remove this problematic element, and the whole movement would fall apart.

subject.1005.a.zh: 我们会给他们的原领袖找个职位。
subject.1005.a.en: We will find a position for their old leader.

subject.1005.b.zh: 是时候接受我们帝国内部的军事倾向了。
subject.1005.b.en: It is time to embrace our empire's military tendencies.

subject.1005.c.zh: 我们将利用手头的资源来恢复往昔的荣耀舰队。
subject.1005.c.en: Our resources will be spent on restoring our ships to their former glory.

subject.1005.desc.zh:
由于之前的运动被默许，上个月他们要求政府摆出更加好战姿态的呼声不断提高。当我们的领导层和运动之间的冲突达到顶点时，我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]公开表示支持该运动。

很明显，我们不仅支持它，而且准备应允递交过来的许多要求，一大群追随者正急切地等待着我们的下一步行动。
subject.1005.desc.en:
As they were allowed to continue unabated, the movement demanding a more warlike agenda from our government has only increased in strength the last month. When the conflict between our leadership and the movement came to a head, our [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] publicly embraced the movement.

As it has become clear that we not only support it, but are ready to follow the many demands handed over to us, the large group of followers are eagerly awaiting what we will do next.

subject.1010.a.zh: 所以他们想让我们更好战，对吗?
subject.1010.a.en: So they want us to be more warlike, do they?

subject.1010.desc.zh:
我们收到附属国[subject_empire.GetName]的报告。该报告概述了民众是如何被他们的一名退伍军人煽动得头脑发狂。他们目前正在寻找一个发泄怒火的渠道，他们要求他们的领袖发动战争。

为了火速平息骚乱，[subject_empire.GetName]的政府已经接受了这个运动，并做出了一些承诺，但我们的线人十分怀疑他们能否兑现。
subject.1010.desc.en:
We have received a report from a vassal empire of ours, the [subject_empire.GetName]. The reports outlines how the people have been whipped into a frenzy by one of their veteran soldiers, and they are now looking for an outlet for their anger. They are demanding war from their leaders.

In a desperate move to appease the rioters, the government in [subject_empire.GetName] has embraced the movement and made several promises that our informant doubt they can fulfil.

subject.105.a.zh: 夺回自由，不惜一切代价。
subject.105.a.en: Freedom from occupation is worth any cost.

subject.105.b.en: Even freedom is not worth what they suggest.

subject.105.desc.zh:
我们人民遭受的苦难还在继续，许多人开始寄希望于我们的宗主[overlord_empire.GetName]能提供点帮助。他们已经长期向我们索取了很多，如今只有他们涉足战争，从外辱中解救我们的人民才公平。

在公开求助之后，我们终于从宗主那获得了一些外派军事顾问，他们会来帮助我们的人民重新夺回领土。他们已经开始讨论我们能如何更好地在军事上利用我们的人民，尽管这也要付出相应的代价。
subject.105.desc.en:
As the mistreatment of our people continues, many are looking to our overlord, [overlord_empire.GetName], for potential aid. They have long demanded much of us, and it seems only fair that they would step in now that our people are suffering under foreign occupation.

After a public outcry, we have finally received some military advisors from our overlord, who has stepped in to help us prepare our own people to retake our territory. They have started discussing ways in which we can utilize our people better militarily, though it will come at certain costs.

subject.105.desc_both_gestalt.zh:
由于我们殖民地遭受的苦难还在继续，我们开始寄希望于宗主[overlord_empire.GetName]能提供点帮助。他们已经长期向我们索取了很多，如今只有他们涉足战争，从外辱中解救我们才公平。

在公开求助之后，我们终于从宗主那获得了一些外派军事[overlord_empire.GetIndividualName]，他们会来帮助我们组织资源重新夺回领土。似乎我们的宗主认为，最好还是由我们自己重新组织并光复失地，而不应该寄希望于他们涉身其中手把手帮我们。
subject.105.desc_both_gestalt.en:
As the mistreatment of our colonies continues, we have started looking to our [overlord_empire.GetName] for aid. They have long demanded much of us, and it seems only fair that they would step in now that we are suffering under foreign occupation.

After sending messengers to request some sort of aid we finally received a military [overlord_empire.GetIndividualName] from our overlord, who has calmly reorganized our assets and prepared them to retake our lands. It seems our overlord believes it would be better if we organized and liberated our own colonies, rather than expecting a caretaker to step in and do it for us.

subject.105.desc_overlord_gestalt.zh:
我们人民遭受的苦难还在继续，许多人开始寄希望于我们的宗主[overlord_empire.GetName]能提供点帮助。他们已经长期向我们索取了很多，如今只有他们涉足战争，从外辱中解救我们的人民才公平。

在公开求助之后，我们终于从宗主那获得了一些外派军事[overlord_empire.GetIndividualName]，他们会来帮助我们的人民重新夺回领土。似乎我们的宗主认为，最好还是由我们自己组织我们的人民来光复失地，而不应该寄希望于他们涉身其中手把手帮我们。
subject.105.desc_overlord_gestalt.en:
As the mistreatment of our people continues, many are looking to our overlord, [overlord_empire.GetName], for potential aid. They have long demanded much of us, and it seems only fair that they would step in now that our people are suffering under foreign occupation.

After a public outcry, we have finally received a military [overlord_empire.GetIndividualName] from our overlord, who has calmly reorganized our people and prepared them to retake our lands. It seems our overlord believes it would be better if we organized our population to retake our own colonies, rather than expecting a caretaker to step in and do it for us.

subject.105.desc_subject_gestalt.zh:
由于我们殖民地遭受的苦难还在继续，我们开始寄希望于宗主[overlord_empire.GetName]能提供点帮助。他们已经长期向我们索取了很多，如今只有他们涉足战争，从外辱中解救我们才公平。

在派出若干无人机进行求助之后，我们终于从宗主那获得了一些外派军事顾问，他们会来帮助组织我们重新夺回领土。考虑到我们最初对我们宗主的期望，这个结果差强人意，而且我们还将无法按原计划调用我们的资源。
subject.105.desc_subject_gestalt.en:
As the mistreatment of our colonies continues, we have started looking to our [overlord_empire.GetName] for aid. They have long demanded much of us, and it seems only fair that they would step in now that we are suffering under foreign occupation.

After sending several drones to request some sort of aid, we finally receive some military advisors that will look into helping us reorganizing our assets so we are better prepared to retake our areas on our own. A small disappointment, considering what we originally wanted from our overlord, particularly as we will not be able to use our resources as originally planned.

subject.1052.b.en: We will have to live with it.

subject.1052.desc.zh: 虽然我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的契约本质是军事上的，但我们没有想到它会对我们产生如此恶劣的影响。我们的人民因宗主国的不断要求而受苦，我们的一些顾问推测，如果这种情况继续下去，将对我们的长期计划产生永久性影响。
subject.1052.desc.en: Though our agreement with [overlord_empire.GetName] is militaristic in nature, we did not expect the atrocious effects it would have on us. Our people are suffering with the constant demands from our overlord, and some of our advisors speculate that if it continues for much longer it will have a permanent impact on our long-term plans.

subject.1052.desc_gestalt.zh: 虽然我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的契约本质是军事上的，我们既没有计划也没有预见到它会给我们带来的残酷影响。由于我们一直在与宗主国的要求作抗争，我们的许多内部计划不得不搁置，只为应付我们军队的大量需求。
subject.1052.desc_gestalt.en: Though our agreement with the [overlord_empire.GetName] is militaristic in nature, we had neither planned nor foreseen the atrocious impact it would have on us. As we are constantly struggling with the demands of our overlord, our many internal plans have to be set aside in order to manage the extensive needs of our military.

subject.1055.a.zh: 我们将向他们保证会对此开展调查。
subject.1055.a.en: We will assure them that we will look into it.

subject.1055.b.zh: 他们的冲突是他们自己的事情。

subject.1055.b.tt.zh: [subject_empire.GetName]可能会因为我们无视他们的困境而失去忠诚。
subject.1055.b.tt.en: The [subject_empire.GetName] might lose loyalty because of our choice to ignore their plights.

subject.1055.desc.zh: 我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]，已经向我们发送了一个公报，报告了由于我们迫使他们介入战争从而导致的国内冲突。在充分理解了之前所同意的外交契约的性质后，他们开始要求我们为了他们的利益而改变政策，这让人有些吃惊。
subject.1055.desc.en: Our vassal, [subject_empire.GetName], has sent us a messenger with a detailed communiqué about the struggles their empire is going through because of the wars we have forced them into. Knowing the nature of the diplomatic contract they agreed to, it comes as a bit of a surprise that they have started asking us to change our policies for their sake.

subject.1057.desc.zh: 我们收到了来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的礼貌回复。回复中解释说他们将研究如何解决目前的外交状况，并在下一步的计划中把我们的问题考虑进去。
subject.1057.desc.en: We have received a respectful response from [overlord_empire.GetName], explaining that they will look into what they can do about their current diplomatic situation, and that they will take our problems into consideration moving forward.

subject.1060.a.zh: 我们还不能反抗我们的宗主。
subject.1060.a.en: Yet we cannot oppose our overlord.

subject.1060.desc.zh:
尽管我们的公报详细解释了情况，但似乎我们在[overlord_empire.GetName]的盟友根本不关心我们的问题。如果他们好战本性继续不减，我们的人民一定会受苦。

没过多久，宗主国的回应和我们当前困境的细节就为公众所知。我们注意到一个反对[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]继续统治的小政治团体的崛起。他们显然对安抚我们毫无兴趣，那么我们对他们的忠诚到底能换来什么呢?
subject.1060.desc.en:
Despite our detailed communiqué explaining the situation, it seems our ally in the [overlord_empire.GetName] cares naught for our problems. If their warlike nature continues unabated, our people are sure to suffer.

It does not take long before the response from our overlord as well as the details of our current predicament becomes public knowledge, and we see the rise of a small political group opposing the continued rule from [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]. They are clearly disinterested in appeasing us at all, so what do we truly get from staying loyal to them?

subject.1060.desc_gestalt.zh:
尽管我们的公报详细而简洁地解释了情况，但似乎我们的守护者[overlord_empire.GetName]已经选择无视我们的困境。他们不仅不关心我们的忠诚，他们似乎决心继续他们目前的破坏性行径。

虽然最初与他们签署契约时，我们希望有一个更好的结果，但我们目前的计算表明，它将对我们的帝国造成持续困扰。
subject.1060.desc_gestalt.en:
Despite our detailed yet concise communiqué explaining the situation, it seems our caretaker in the [overlord_empire.GetName] has chosen to ignore our plight. Not only do they not care about our loyalties, they seem determined to continue on their current destructive path.

Though we had hoped for a better outcome when we first signed our agreements with them, all our current calculations point to the continued problematic effect it would have on our empire.

subject.1062.a.en: Their continued subjugation is a given.

subject.1062.desc.zh: 看来我们的驳回已经在[subject_empire.GetName]引发了一个小小的抗议政治运动。虽然他们对我们的回应不太满意，但该运动也还在努力寻找立足之处，而他们的帝国总的来说也没有反对我们统治的能力。
subject.1062.desc.en: It seems our dismissal has given rise to a small political movement opposing us in the [subject_empire.GetName]. Though they are less than pleased with our response, the movement is struggling to find ground, and their empire as a whole is not capable of opposing our rule.

subject.1062.desc_gestalt.zh: 看来我们的驳回已经让[subject_empire.GetRulerTitle]开始质疑我们继续统治他们的正当性。虽然从目前的情况看，他们可能对我们的外交契约犹豫不决，但还没有到可以反对的地步。
subject.1062.desc_gestalt.en: It seems our dismissal has given the [subject_empire.GetRulerTitle] doubts about our right to continue ruling over them. Though they might harbor hesitation about our diplomatic contract as of right now, they are not in a position where they can oppose us yet.

subject.107.desc.zh: 整个[subject_empire.GetName]的人们众志成城，决心驱逐外辱，奋起捍卫他们的家园，时刻准备着为帝国奉献自己。希望这能够解决我们附庸遭遇到的问题。
subject.107.desc.en: All across [subject_empire.GetName] the people have come together to defend their homes from foreign occupation, readily serving their empire. Hopefully this will be the beginning of the end for the problems afflicting our vassal.

subject.110.desc.zh: 即使遭受占领，[subject_empire.GetName]的人民仍拒绝任何夺回领土的尝试。
subject.110.desc.en: Even under occupation, the people of [subject_empire.GetName] have rejected any attempts to help them retake their territory.

subject.1102.a.zh: 无论如何，我们都要结束这场争吵。
subject.1102.a.en: We will end this bickering, one way or another.

subject.1102.b.en: They will figure it out, in time.

subject.1102.desc.zh:
我们注意到一些舰队指挥官和领袖之间的分歧和争论有所增加。如果[admiral_democracy.GetName]认为我们应该干点什么，可以肯定[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]将对着干。

起初，这似乎只是对手之间的良性竞争，但最近气氛变得越来越令人不快，充满火药味，我们看到他们的同僚也开始站队了。
subject.1102.desc.en:
We have seen a rise in disagreements and arguing between some of our commanders and leaders. If [admiral_democracy.GetName] thinks we should go through with something, you can be sure that [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] will argue that we should do the opposite.

At first it seemed to only be a good-natured rivalry between equals, but lately it has become ever more toxic and hostile, and we are starting to see their peers taking sides as well.

subject.1105.a.zh: 他们要继续这种愚蠢的行为多久？
subject.1105.a.en: How long will they keep this nonsense going?

subject.1105.desc_democracy.zh:
这不再是一个简单的意见不一致的问题，因为整个海军司令部已经达到了彼此彻底敌对的地步。两名指挥官最初的争执，现在已经把整个办公室一分为二，再也没有人试图在他们之间斡旋和平。

除了司令部的分裂，他们现在也分裂成两个明确界定的政治团体，一个支持我们目前的民主领导，另一个认为司令部应该在我们的政府中发挥更大的政治作用。
subject.1105.desc_democracy.en:
No longer is it a simple case of disagreeing, as the whole admiralty have reached a point of outright hostility to one another. What was at first two commanders arguing has now split the whole office in two, and there is no longer anyone trying to broker peace between them.

In addition to splitting the admiralty, they have now also split into two clearly defined political groups, one supporting our current democratic leadership, and one that thinks the admiralty should have a stronger political role in our government.

subject.1105.desc_neither.zh:
这不再是一个简单的意见不一致的问题，因为整个海军司令部已经达到了彼此彻底敌对的地步。两名指挥官最初的争执，现在已经把整个办公室一分为二，再也没有人试图在他们之间斡旋和平。

除了司令部的分裂，他们现在也分裂成两个明确界定的政治团体，一个认为司令部应该在我们的政府中发挥重要作用，另一个认为大众应该被赋予更多的政治权力。
subject.1105.desc_neither.en:
No longer is it a simple case of disagreeing, as the whole admiralty have reached a point of outright hostility to one another. What at first were two commanders arguing has now split the whole office in two, and there is no longer anyone trying to broker peace between them.

In addition to splitting the admiralty, they have now also split into two clearly defined political groups, one who believes the admiralty should play a strong role in our government, and one that thinks the general populace should be given more political power.

subject.1105.desc_oligarchy.zh:
这不再是一个简单的意见不一致的问题，因为整个海军司令部已经达到了彼此彻底敌对的地步。两名指挥官最初的争执，现在已经把整个办公室一分为二，再也没有人试图在他们之间斡旋和平。

除了司令部的分裂，他们现在也分裂成两个明确界定的政治团体，一个支持我们目前的领导层，另一个认为大众应该在我们的政府中发挥更大的政治作用。
subject.1105.desc_oligarchy.en:
