No longer is it a simple case of disagreeing, as the whole admiralty have reached a point of outright hostility to one another. What at first were two commanders arguing has now split the whole office in two, and there is no longer anyone trying to broker peace between them.

In addition to splitting the admiralty, they have now also split into two clearly defined political groups, one supporting our current leadership, and one that thinks the general populace should have a larger role to play in our government.

subject.1107.a.zh: 让我们在事态变糟之前介入吧。
subject.1107.a.en: Let us step in before it gets worse.

subject.1107.b.zh: 处理他们的内部事务不是我们分内的事。
subject.1107.b.en: It's not our job to fix their internal affairs.

subject.1107.desc.zh:
我们收到消息，我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]，现在似乎正在进行一场内部斗争，他们的海军司令部在两名指挥官卷入冲突后陷入混乱。

他们的领导层忙于控制事态，而由于两个敌对指挥官的支持者们仍在持续争夺权力，我们怀疑他们还能不能成为我们可靠的盟友和附庸。
subject.1107.desc.en:
We have received news that our vassal, [subject_empire.GetName], seems to have an internal struggle going on right now, with their admiralty in shambles after two commanders have ended up embroiled in a conflict.

With their leadership scrambling to get everything under control, we are unsure how reliable an ally and vassal they can be, as the two sides backing the rival commanders are continuously vying for power.

subject.1110.a.en: Finally, an end to the arguments.

subject.1110.desc.zh: 因为我们担心司令部的冲突会蔓延到我们帝国的其他领导层，我们的盟友[overlord_empire.GetName]介入并设法平息了事态。看起来[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]或[admiral_democracy.GetName]都不愿意反对[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]的领导层。
subject.1110.desc.en: As we feared the conflicts in the admiralty would spread to the rest of the leadership of our empire, our ally [overlord_empire.GetName] stepped in and managed to calm things. It seems not even [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] or [admiral_democracy.GetName] are willing to oppose the leadership in [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName].

subject.1112.desc.zh: 当来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的外交官抵达并帮助调停事态时，我们曾对[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]和[admiral_democracy]达成妥协寄予厚望。但经过几天的持续争吵，似乎双方唯一达成共识的是，我们的宗主国在他们的争端中起不到任何作用。
subject.1112.desc.en: We had high hopes that the problems between [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] and [admiral_democracy] would finally come to an end, when diplomats from [overlord_empire.GetName] arrived to help broker peace in the conflict. But after days of continuous bickering, it seems the only thing the two sides have agreed upon is that our overlord has no part to play in their disputes.

subject.1115.a.zh: 我们可以做些什么来挽救这种局面呢？
subject.1115.a.en: What can be done to salvage this situation?

subject.1115.desc.zh:
司令部双方之间的冲突已经持续了数周甚至数月，其中一方由[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]领导的，另一个由[admiral_democracy.GetName]领导，此前也还未发生任何直接的暴力事件，但现在却发现了一名民主支持者的尸体。

虽然我们没有发现任何证据表明另一方参与了这起谋杀，但这必将引发双方更激烈、更暴力的反应。
subject.1115.desc.en:
It has been weeks and months of the conflict between the two sides of the admiralty, one led by [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] and the other led by [admiral_democracy.GetName], and yet there has not been any outright violence. Until now - with the discovery of the body of one of the democratic supporters.

Though we have found no proof that the other side is involved in the suspected murder, this is sure to spark even harsher and more violent responses from the two sides moving forward.

subject.1120.a.zh: 我们将重建他们的家园。
subject.1120.a.en: And rebuild their homes we shall.

subject.1120.b.zh: 说到矿物我可就不困了。

subject.1120.desc.zh:
我们收到一份报告，一艘身份不明的货船在[crash_planet.GetName]的居民区坠毁。在我们正寻找能做些什么来帮助他们时，所有曾经住在那里的人都暂时被转移到避难所。

寡头团体不仅主张无视那些被赶出家园的人的困境，而且主张在该地区开发一个新的矿产，因为这艘货船似乎发现了一个我们以前从未见过的完整的富矿脉。当然，他们的对手强烈反对这个想法，并要求我们把精力集中在重建受灾群众的家园上。
subject.1120.desc.en:
A report has come back to us, that an unidentified cargo ship has crashed into a residential area on [crash_planet.GetName]. All who used to live there have temporarily been moved into shelters, while we are seeing what we can do to help.

The oligarchic group has advocated for not only ignoring the plight of those evicted from their homes, but to open up a new mineral mine in the district, as it seems the cargo ship found a whole rich vein that we have not seen before now. Their rivals, of course, deeply oppose the idea, and demand that we focus our efforts on rebuilding the homes of those affected.

subject.1125.a.zh: 原先的划拨是有原因的。
subject.1125.a.en: It was earmarked for a reason.

subject.1125.b.zh: 寡头们是对的，把资金转移给军队。
subject.1125.b.en: The oligarchs are right, move the funding to the military.

subject.1125.desc.zh: 如今，这种争论和冲突已不再局限于司令部，我们在帝国的每个部门都能看到。最近的事件涉及到因民事需要而划拨给[Root.Capital.GetName]的资金，寡头们想要把它们重新分配给军队。
subject.1125.desc.en: Now no longer contained simply to the admiralty, we see the arguments and conflicts in every office across our empire. The latest incident involves funds earmarked for civil needs on [Root.Capital.GetName], which the oligarchs want to re-allocate for the military.

subject.1130.a.zh: 民粹主义者有这个权利。
subject.1130.a.en: The populists have the right of it.

subject.1130.b.zh: 显然，寡头们在这次袭击中是无辜的。
subject.1130.b.en: Clearly, the oligarchs were innocent in this attack.

subject.1130.desc.zh:
在寡头派办公室附近发生了一场特别残酷的抗议之后，这两个派系的一些成员都受到了质疑。不出所料，双方的故事都截然不同，大多都将一切归咎于对手。

他们不仅希望我们选择一方，而且双方都愿意介入以确保我们投入的时间是值得的。
subject.1130.desc.en:
After a particularly violent protest close to the offices of the oligarchic faction, several members of both factions have been brought into question. As expected, both sides have incredibly different stories, mostly blaming their rivals for everything that went down.

Not only do they want us to choose a side, but both sides are willing to step in and make sure that it is worth our time.

subject.1135.a.zh: 我们会保护他们，就这一次。
subject.1135.a.en: We will protect them, just this once.

subject.1135.desc.zh: 我们收到了一份报告，提到一个亲密盟友[admiral_democracy.GetName]挪动公共资金用于不光彩的个人支出。许多人声称这可能是代其派系行事。如果公众知道这场运动挪用了公共资金为私人服务，那肯定会给他们的民粹主义议程泼冷水。
subject.1135.desc.en: A report has been brought back to us, about the scandalous personal spending of public funds by a close ally of [admiral_democracy.GetName]. Many claim it might have been on behalf of their faction. If the public were to learn this movement has used public funds for themselves, it would surely put a damper on their populist agenda.

subject.1140.a.zh: 我们保证他们不会知道的。
subject.1140.a.en: We will make sure they won't know.

subject.1140.b.zh: 所以凶手终于被找到了。
subject.1140.b.en: So the murderer has finally been found then.

subject.1140.desc.zh:
经过漫长的调查，他们似乎终于找到了司令部办公室第一起谋杀案的凶手。所有的证据都指向了[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]最亲密的顾问之一，他私自下令暗杀了他们的对手。

虽然[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]没有做错任何事，但如果公众知道了，会对其运动造成不良影响。
subject.1140.desc.en:
After a long-winded investigation, it seems they have finally found the perpetrator of the first murder in the admiralty offices. All evidence points to one of the closest advisors to [admiral_oligarchy.GetName], who personally ordered the assassination of their opponent.

Though [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] is innocent of any wrong-doing, it would reflect poorly on their movement if the public were to know about it.

subject.1142.desc.zh:
我们不仅看到这场冲突正在司令部上演，甚至还波及到了整个帝国。尽管大多数暴力事件都没有公开，但双方在这一点上都蒙受了重大损失。

我们在两边的线人告诉我们，双方都在盯着国家的领导权，并计划武力夺权以彻底除掉对手。在这个时间点上，似乎我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]也不得不站队一方，否则就会被另一方扳倒。
subject.1142.desc.en:
We have seen the conflict play out not only in the admiralty itself, but all across our empire as well. Though most of the violence have been kept out of the public eye, both sides have seen significant losses at this point.

Our informants on both sides have informed us that both are now eyeing the leadership of the nation itself, and are planning to take it by force so they can get rid of their opponents. It seems at this point even our [Root.GetRulerTitle] will have to take a side, or else face removal by the other.

subject.1145.a.zh: 希望最坏的情况已经过去。
subject.1145.a.en: Let us hope the worst is over with.

subject.1147.a.zh: 至少我们不用再听这种事了。
subject.1147.a.en: At least we will not have to hear more about it.

subject.1147.desc.zh: 似乎我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]的司令部有许多分歧和冲突，导致他们的帝国分裂为两部分。虽然冲突仍然激烈，但双方似乎都接受了我们的继续统治。
subject.1147.desc.en: It seems the many disagreements and conflicts in the admiralty of our vassal, the [subject_empire.GetName], have led to their empire splitting in two parts. Though still in heated conflict, both sides seem to accept our continued rule.

subject.12.a.zh: 到头来，就跟我们预料的一样。
subject.12.a.en: So it turned out as expected, after all.

subject.12.desc.zh: 在[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]作短暂停留之后，我们的老兵被送回了[Root.Capital.GetName]的家。显然他们只是证明了自己是一团麻烦，在我们属国的人民中间酿成了祸。
subject.12.desc.en: After a short stay at [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], our veterans have been sent home to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Apparently they only proved to be trouble, and caused some havoc among our subject population.

subject.14.a.zh: 我们希望事情就照这样发展。
subject.14.a.en: Let us hope it stays that way.

subject.14.desc.zh: 我们最初的担忧恰如其分。在到达[subject_empire.GetName]不久之后，我们的老兵马上转行当了海盗。如果不出意外，这些离经叛道的行径是追查不到我们的头上的。
subject.14.desc.en: Our initial worries seem to have been well-placed. Shortly after getting to [subject_empire.GetName] our old soldiers seem to have embraced piracy. If nothing else, this betrayal does not seem to have been traced back to us yet.

subject.16.a.zh: 希望他们之后能洗心革面吧。
subject.16.a.en: Let us hope they make a good impression then.

subject.16.desc.zh: 看来这些向我们请求离开前往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]的老兵们不仅没有遵守我们的命令，还顶着我们的名头无恶不作。此时我们要是前去澄清告诉大家我们没能约束好手下，必将颜面尽失。
subject.16.desc.en: It seems that the veterans who asked us for leave to go to [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] have not only defied our orders, but they have also claimed it was done in our name. At this point it would be an embarrassment if we were to go in and tell everyone that we do not have our own people under control.

subject.18.desc.zh: 看来这些老兵违抗了我们的命令，并且还是出发前往[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]了。我们最新的汇报称，他们已经彻底抛弃所有隶属于我们的标志，开始了他们的海盗生涯。
subject.18.desc.en: It seems that the veterans have defied our orders, and set off towards [subject_empire.Capital.GetName] after all. Our latest reports say they have left all signs of being affiliated with us behind, and started taking up a life of piracy.

subject.2005.desc.zh:
多亏了我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的许多交易，我们已经能够集中精力建立和改善帝国的内部工作。在我们的科学家和工程师们的努力工作下，我们看到我们的殖民地在过去几年里蓬勃发展。人们在几年前还以为是幻想的事情，突然之间不仅变成了现实，而且变得司空见惯。

我们收到消息，我们在[overlord_empire.GetName]的长官想亲自看看我们的最新进展，并有可能把其中一些带回他们的祖国。
subject.2005.desc.en:
Thanks to our many deals with [overlord_empire.GetName], we have been able to focus much of our efforts on building and improving the internal workings of our empire. With our scientists and engineers hard at work, we have seen our colonies blossom these last years, as things one would have thought a fantasy only a few years back have suddenly become not only real, but even commonplace.

We have received news that our wardens in [overlord_empire.GetName] would like to see our latest progress in person, and potentially bring some of it back to their homeland.

subject.2005.desc_gestalt.zh:
多亏了我们与[overlord_empire.GetName]的许多交易，我们已经能够集中精力于帝国的建筑及其改良工作。由于我们预留了很大一部分集体智能用来完成这项任务，以前被认为不可能的技术和工程壮举，现在已经在我们的星球上司空见惯。

我们收到消息，我们在[overlord_empire.GetName]的看守想亲自看看我们的最新进展，并有可能把其中一些带回他们的祖国。
subject.2005.desc_gestalt.en:
Thanks to our many deals with [overlord_empire.GetName], we have been able to focus much of our efforts on building and improving the structure of our empire. With a significant portion of our intellect reserved for this task, technologies and feats of engineering never thought possible have now become a commonplace on our worlds.

We have received news that our wardens in the [overlord_empire.GetName] would like to see our latest progress in person, and potentially bring some of it back to their homeland.

subject.2010.a.zh: 尽管如此，还是和我们的宗主分享吧。
subject.2010.a.en: Share it with our overlord nonetheless.

subject.2010.b.en: Keep most of it to ourselves.

subject.2010.desc.zh: 当来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的使者即将抵达的时候，我们必须决定与我们的宗主分享最新的设计和创作的意愿程度。如果我们分享的话，肯定会受到称赞，但他们可能会更直接地控制我们今后的努力方向。
subject.2010.desc.en: As the emissary is about to arrive from the [overlord_empire.GetName], we have to decide how willing we are to share our latest designs and creations with our overlord. It would surely be appreciated if we were to do so, but it could be that they will take more direct control of where we will focus our efforts moving forward.

subject.2015.a.zh: 他们自己显然研究得很好。
subject.2015.a.en: They are clearly doing well on their own already.

subject.2015.b.zh: 让他们把精力集中在物理学上。
subject.2015.b.en: Have them focus their efforts on science.

subject.2015.c.zh: 他们将开展对其社会的社会学研究。
subject.2015.c.en: They will look into the sociological aspects of their society.

subject.2015.d.zh: 工程学——将是他们研究的重点。
subject.2015.d.en: Engineering - that will be their focus.

subject.2015.desc.zh: 我们收到消息，我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]，最近在改善其殖民地发展方面取得了重大进展。一些设计和创作被带回[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]，它们的发展前景都不错。如果我们愿意，可以要求他们研究一个特定的领域，而不是让他们在没有监督的情况下继续他们努力。
subject.2015.desc.en: We have received news that our vassals, the [subject_empire.GetName], have recently made significant steps in improving the development of their colonies. Several designs and creations have been brought back to [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName], and they are all quite promising. If we wish, we could ask them to look into a specific field, rather than letting them continue their efforts unsupervised.

subject.2020.a.en: We will continue our efforts then.

subject.2020.desc.zh: 似乎我们的[overlord_empire.GetAdj]宗主对之赞赏有加，并且继续允许我们自由行事，而不加干涉或采取控制手段。
subject.2020.desc.en: It seems our [overlord_empire.GetAdj] overlord is appreciative, and will continue to let us do as we wish, without stepping in or trying to take control.

subject.2025.desc.zh: 在看到了我们最近的设计和创造之后，宗主向我们发布了一条指令。因为看到了这些设计创造之中蕴含着的巨大潜力，似乎他们希望我们从今往后开始聚焦于物理学研究。
subject.2025.desc.en: We have received a directive from our overlord, after they saw our designs and latest creations. It seems they want us to focus our efforts on the sciences from now on, as they think those designs and creations have the most potential.

subject.2030.desc.zh: 在看到了我们最近的设计和创造之后，宗主向我们发布了一条指令。因为看到了这些设计和理念之中蕴含着的巨大潜力，似乎他们希望我们从今往后开始聚焦于社会学研究。
subject.2030.desc.en: We have received a directive from our overlord, after they saw our designs and latest creations. It seems they want us to focus our efforts on the social sciences from now on, as they think those designs and ideas have the most potential.

subject.2035.desc.zh: 在看到了我们最近的设计和创造之后，宗主向我们发布了一条指令。因为看到了这些设计和改进之中蕴含着的巨大潜力，似乎他们希望我们从今往后开始聚焦于工程学研究。
subject.2035.desc.en: We have received a directive from our overlord, after they saw our designs and latest creations. It seems they want us to focus our efforts on engineering from now on, as they think those designs and improvements have the most potential.

subject.2055.a.zh: 目前我们仍将继续研究。

subject.2055.a.tt.zh: 巨大概率在[targeted_planet.GetName]上产生进一步副作用。
subject.2055.a.tt.en: A massive chance of further side-effects on [targeted_planet.GetName].

subject.2055.b.zh: 在查明实情前暂停研究。
subject.2055.b.en: Put a hold on the research until we can figure it out.

subject.2055.desc.zh:
我们一直在[targeted_planet.GetName]上对行星本身的结构进行大量研究，以确定如何为了我们的殖民地对行星进行改善。最近的发展不幸出了岔子，毒性废料污染了大片土地，使它们完全不宜居住。

然而，我们的计算表明，这不仅是一起孤立的事件，只要这种广泛的行星研究继续下去，就可能会有更多这样的灾难发生。
subject.2055.desc.en:
On [targeted_planet.GetName], we have have been conducting significant research on the structure of the planet itself to see how one might improve it for our colonies. The latest developments have sadly gone awry, with toxic wastes affecting large swathes of land, leaving them completely uninhabitable.

Our calculations suggest that this is not just one isolated incident, however, and that as long as this extensive planetary research continues, more of these catastrophes are likely to happen.

subject.2060.a.zh: 那也不算没法处理的大事儿。
subject.2060.a.en: Not a problem big enough that it cannot be dealt with then.

subject.2060.a.tt.zh: 显著概率在[targeted_planet.GetName]上产生进一步副作用。
subject.2060.a.tt.en: A significant chance of further side-effects on [targeted_planet.GetName].

subject.2060.b.zh: 已经进行足够久了，停止实验。
subject.2060.b.en: This has gone on long enough, end the experiments.

subject.2060.desc.zh: 我们在[targeted_planet.GetName]上的研究产生的毒性废料引起的副作用之一是那里某些原本欣欣向荣的动植物已经灭绝，这对行星上的动植物区系造成了一连串问题。或许有些出乎意料，幸好生活在[targeted_planet.GetName]的居民大都并未因此受到伤害，不过这还是让生活变得更为困难了。
subject.2060.desc.en: As a side effect of the toxic wastes caused by our research on [targeted_planet.GetName], it seems some of the plant and animal life that used to thrive there have gone extinct and caused a chain reaction of issues for a lot of the fauna and flora on the planet. As unexpected as it might have been, those living on [targeted_planet.GetName] have thankfully been mostly unharmed by it, though it has made life harder for them.

subject.2065.a.zh: 到这一步再回头为时已晚。
subject.2065.a.en: It is too late to turn around at this point.

subject.2065.a.tt.zh: 大概率在[targeted_planet.GetName]上产生进一步副作用。
subject.2065.a.tt.en: A large chance of further side-effects on [targeted_planet.GetName].

subject.2065.b.zh: 亡羊补牢，该结束实验了。
subject.2065.b.en: Better late than never, we need to end this.

subject.2065.desc.zh:
我们原本的估计不如先前希望的那般准确，在[targeted_planet.GetName]上最近的发展出的岔子比先前希望的更大。原本的毒性废料已经扩散到行星水体当中，反过来又影响了临近的陆地。

由于大片水域和土地因此不宜居住，我们的殖民地出于安全考虑不得不进行迁移。
subject.2065.desc.en:
Our original estimates were not as precise as we had hoped, and the latest developments on [targeted_planet.GetName] have gone further awry than we had hoped. The original toxic waste had already spread into the water on the planet, and in turn affected the nearby land.

With large tracts of water and land both left inhospitable, our colonies have been forced to move away for their own safety.

subject.2070.a.en: At least it cannot get worse.

subject.2070.desc.zh:
我们收到报告称，岩浆从[targeted_planet.GetName]的地壳中涌出。似乎最近在行星上所做的研究使其不再稳定，以至于地震近几个月来司空见惯，人们开始对那里的科学家失去信心了。

如此来看，我们的科学家似乎确定我们如今已然触底，不论是作为比喻而言还是就字面意义来看。
subject.2070.desc.en:
We have received a report that molten lava has emerged from the crust on [targeted_planet.GetName]. It seems the latest research done on the planet has made it unstable enough that earthquakes have become commonplace these last months, and people have started losing faith in the scientists there.

By all accounts, it seems our scientists are certain we have hit rock bottom now, both figuratively and literally.

subject.2070.desc_gestalt.zh:
我们在[targeted_planet.GetName]上最近所做的研究似乎对行星造成了更多副作用。在我们的一处殖民地附近发生轻微地震后，毒气和熔化的岩石从地面突然喷射而出，致使原先受到控制的局面转变成了大灾难。

鉴于在[targeted_planet.GetName]上最近发生的种种灾厄，我们计算出的估计是目前见到的已经是最坏情况了。
subject.2070.desc_gestalt.en:
It seems the latest research we have done on [targeted_planet.GetName] has caused even more side-effects to the planet. In the aftermath of a minor earthquake near one of our colonies, molten rocks and gases suddenly surged forth from the earth, turning a situation we had under control into a catastrophe.

With all of the latest calamities happening on [targeted_planet.GetName], our calculations estimate that we have seen the worst of it by now.

subject.2105.a.zh: 我们将会赞助这些研究。

subject.2105.d.zh: 我们不能对此做出让步。
subject.2105.d.en: We cannot compromise our very self.

subject.2105.desc.zh:
鉴于来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的需求如雪花般飘来，我们的研究工作已经愈发重要了。我们的许多科学家都在与这种压力作斗争，但从中却迸发出天才的闪光和偶现的惊人突破。

其中最新的一项是来自[targeted_scientist.GetName]设计的预备在我们某个部门中进行一系列实验。唯一的问题是，在他们的每一项研究计划中都包含了对[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的活体实验。
subject.2105.desc.en:
Our research efforts grow ever more important in light of the continuous stream of demands from the [overlord_empire.GetName]. Many of our scientists struggle with this pressure, but we see glimmers of genius and the occasional amazing breakthrough.

The latest of these might come from [targeted_scientist.GetName], who has designed a set of daring experiments for one of our departments to undertake. The only problem being that experiments on live [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are part of every single one of their proposals.

subject.2105.desc_gestalt.zh:
我们收到了更多来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的指令，他们希望我们进一步提高研究产出。关于我们如何才能不辜负宗主的厚望我们进行了大量的演算，并且我们相信已经找到了调整自己进程以适应目标的方法。

然而要完全实现这一点，我们必须对我们的无人机和共享神经网络进行一系列实验。这必将带来很大的风险。
subject.2105.desc_gestalt.en:
We have received yet more demands from the [overlord_empire.GetName], as they want us to improve our research output. Several calculations have been run to figure out how we could live up to our overlord's expectations, and we believe we have found a way to adjust our processes to enable us to do so.

To go through with it however, we would have to conduct several experiments on our drones and our shared neural network. There will be a significant risk involved.

subject.2110.a.zh: 也许那是为了得到更好的结果。
subject.2110.a.en: Maybe it was for the better then.

subject.2110.desc.zh:
我们收到了一份来自[Root.Capital.GetName]某个居住区划的报告。与[targeted_scientist.GetName]的住所有关。当地执法人员发现了几具[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的残骸——似乎是曾在现场进行的失败的可怕实验的一部分。

我们被告知，还没有人能追踪到[targeted_scientist.GetName]，他以某种方式避开了所有的传感器。
subject.2110.desc.en:
We have received a report from one of the residential districts on [Root.Capital.GetName], relating to the domicile of [targeted_scientist.GetName]. Local law enforcers found the remains of several [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - seemingly part of gruesome albeit failed experiments - at the site.

We are told no one has been able to track down [targeted_scientist.GetName], who is somehow eluding all sensors.

subject.2112.a.zh: 我们无权干涉他们的内部事务。
subject.2112.a.en: It is not for us to intervene in their internal affairs.

subject.2112.desc.zh: 我们收到来自[subject_empire.GetName]的消息——据说他们开始对自己的物种进行危险实验，而实验结果往往是灾难性的。虽然我们当地的使者并没有明确要求我们介入，但他们显然在暗示我们。
subject.2112.desc.en: News has reached us from the [subject_empire.GetName] - they have allegedly begun serious experimentation on their own species, often with disastrous results. Though our local emissary is not explicitly calling for us to intervene, it is most certainly implied in their communication.

subject.2112.desc_gestalt.zh: 我们收到来自[subject_empire.GetName]的消息——据说他们开始对自己的物种进行危险实验。尽管原因尚不清楚，除了可能对他们自身造成伤害之外，我们认为让他们继续下去不会有任何特别的风险。
subject.2112.desc_gestalt.en: News has reached us that the [subject_empire.GetName] has begun serious experimentation on their own species, though it is unclear for what reason. We do not foresee any particular risk in letting them continue, aside from what harm they might cause themselves.

subject.2115.desc.zh: 我们的宗主国派来的使者带来了明确的命令，要求结束最近在[Root.Capital.GetName]上开展的针对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的实验和测试。虽然没有说明任何具体的原因，但其意思是明确的。
subject.2115.desc.en: An emissary from our overlord has brought explicit orders to put an end to the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] experiments and tests recently begun on [Root.Capital.GetName]. While the message did not state any particular reason as to why, it was unambiguous in its meaning.

subject.2120.a.zh: 我们将致力于进行适当的实验。
subject.2120.a.en: We will commit to proper experimentation.

subject.2120.a.tt.zh: 我们将继续进行更危险的实验。
subject.2120.a.tt.en: We will proceed with the riskier experiments.

subject.2120.b.tt.zh: 我们将进行更安全的实验。
subject.2120.b.tt.en: We will proceed with the safer experiments.

subject.2120.desc.zh:
我们还没有收到来自我们的宗主国[overlord_empire.GetName]的任何消息。他们似乎意识到我们最近开始的研究，并选择不以任何方式进行干预。

按照我们的计划，我们需要弄清楚下一步我们将进行什么实验。一个设计风险越大，可能的危害越大，就越有可能给我们的帝国带来长远的利益。
subject.2120.desc.en:
While we have not received any communication from our overlord [overlord_empire.GetName], it seems they are aware of the research we have recently begun and have chosen not to intervene in any way.

Moving forward with our plans, we need to figure out what experiments we will undertake next. The more risky and possibly harmful a design, the more potential long-term benefits it might bring our empire.

subject.2125.desc.zh: 我们做了这么多实验，最终只有失败和失望的结果。非要说有什么意义的话，我们学会了未来如何避坑。
subject.2125.desc.en: Ultimately the many experiments we conducted resulted in nothing but failure and disappointment. If nothing else, we have learned what not to do in the future.

subject.2130.desc.zh: 我们的大多数实验最终都得到了回报，并带来了一些意想不到的收获。大多数测试对象甚至幸存下来，而且表现得很好。所以总的来说，实验算是相当成功。
subject.2130.desc.en: Most of our experiments ended up paying off in the end, and have led to some unexpected learnings. Most of the test subjects even survived and appear to be doing fine, so all in all it can be considered quite the success.

subject.2135.desc.zh: 虽然有人会说成本比预期的要高，但我们在许多实验中都取得了巨大成功。通过几个有趣和意想不到的结果，我们学到的比我们原先预测的还要多。
subject.2135.desc.en: Though some would say the cost was higher than anticipated, we have met with unbridled success in our many experiments. With several interesting and unexpected results, we have learned more than any of our projections indicated.

subject.2140.desc.zh: 我们的许多实验导致我们的测试对象发生了一些有趣的变化，其形体或性格，从怪异可怕到微不足道的变化都有发生。出乎意料的是，这些变异从实验室逃逸，开始影响我们帝国的其他地区。
subject.2140.desc.en: Our many experiments led to some interesting mutations in our test subjects, ranging from the grotesque and horrific to limited changes in their physique or personality. What came as an unexpected surprise was these changes propagating beyond our labs, starting to affect the rest of our empire.

subject.3.a.en: Put their experience to good use.

subject.3.desc.zh:
我们接收了一伙来自我们的宗主国[overlord_empire.GetName]的老兵。看上去是[overlord.Ruler.GetRegnalName]正式派遣他们过来对我们进行援建，并且同我们的部队分享他们的知识和经验——至少他们是这么宣称的。

然而，自打一开始，这些士兵就很明显地发现了，他们所看到的和他们所设想的完全不一样。团体内部的抱怨和不满之情也传到了我们耳里。看样子，他们坚信自己能在当地找到财宝，或者能干上海盗的行当从我们手里偷走东西。

如果我们计划让这群老兵留在当地，我们可得小心不能把他们看得太松了。
subject.3.desc.en:
We have received a group of veterans from our overlord, [overlord_empire.GetName]. It seems they have formally been sent here by [overlord.Ruler.GetRegnalName] to aid us, and to share their experience and knowledge with our troops - or so they claim.

From the get-go, it is made clear that these soldiers envisioned a different environment to the one they have found. Mumbling and grumbling among their contingent has made its way back to us. It seems they believed they would find riches, or else become pirates to steal from us.

If we are going to let these veterans stay, we should make sure to keep them on a short leash.

subject.3005.a.zh: 我们两个帝国迟早会共同繁荣。
subject.3005.a.en: Our two empires will learn to thrive together in time.

subject.3005.desc.zh: 一大群人来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的人在我们成为他们的附庸后，开始来我们的世界旅行，并对我们的文化和人民表现出兴趣。起初，我们认为这对所有人来说都是一件好事，但近段时间，我们看到当地人和[overlord_empire.GetAdj]游客之间的冲突增加了——他们似乎对我们的帝国怀有一些误解，他们倾向于使用[overlord_empire.GetAdj]的文化和理想为他们的粗野辩护。
subject.3005.desc.en: A large number of people from the [overlord_empire.GetName] started visiting our worlds after we became a subject of theirs, expressing an interest in our culture and people. At first we figured it would be a good thing for all of us, but we see a rise in conflicts between locals and [overlord_empire.GetAdj] visitors as of late - they seem to harbor some misconceptions about our empire, and they tend to use [overlord_empire.GetAdj] culture and ideals to justify their boorishness.

subject.3010.a.zh: 边境依然会开放的，无论如何。
subject.3010.a.en: The borders will stay open, one way or another.

subject.3010.b.zh: 如果我们的人民举止不佳，那他们就该回家。
subject.3010.b.en: If our people cannot behave, they stay home.

subject.3010.desc.zh: 我们收到了一些不安的消息，消息的源头是我们前往拜访[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]——[subject_empire.GetName]的首都——的人。[subject_empire.GetName]政权要求他们立刻撤离行星，显然在经过几次所谓的冲突之后，我们的平民在他们的帝国内以不再受欢迎。
subject.3010.desc.en: We have received distressed communications from some of our people who have visited [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], the capital of the [subject_empire.GetName]. The [subject_empire.GetName] regime has instructed them to vacate the planet immediately, as our civilians are apparently no longer welcome in their empire after several alleged conflicts.

subject.3015.a.en: It is not important enough to fight for.

subject.3015.desc.zh: 看来我们的宗主国听说了这个情况，并派出了一小批官僚和士兵来澄清他们关于此事的立场。他们毫不含糊地明确表示，要么我们和平地向他们的平民开放边界，要么他们将强行让彼此之间的边界开放。
subject.3015.desc.en: It seems our overlord has heard about the situation, and has sent a small contingent of bureaucrats and soldiers to clarify their stance on this. In no uncertain terms they make it clear that we will either open the borders to their civilians peacefully, or they will forcefully keep the borders open between us.

subject.3020.a.zh: 结果比我们期望的要好得多。
subject.3020.a.en: It worked out better than we could have hoped for.

subject.3020.desc.zh: 看来我们的宗主国听说了这个情况，并选择接受我们对[overlord_empire.GetAdj]的平民旅行关闭边界的决定。我们的一些官员担心这可能会引发外交事件，但这次似乎侥幸避免了。
subject.3020.desc.en: It seems our overlord has heard about the situation, and chosen to accept our decision to close our borders to [overlord_empire.GetAdj] civilian travel. Some of our administrators feared this might spark a diplomatic incident, but it seems to have been narrowly avoided this time.

subject.3055.a.zh: 看上去，这是一次表现善意的机会。
subject.3055.a.en: A show of goodwill, it seems.

subject.3055.desc.zh: 我们收到消息，一群来自[subject_empire.GetName]的朝圣者想方设法来到了我们的宇域。看上去他们相信[overlord_empire.GetName]在他们的家园代表了某种宗教上的重要性。尽管有关他们宗教信仰方面的细节尚不清楚，但这群人作为旅客举止十分得体，在停留期间人们对他们只有点赞，没有差评。
subject.3055.desc.en: Word has reached us of a group of pilgrims from the [subject_empire.GetName], making their way through our space. It seems they believe the [overlord_empire.GetName] holds some religious significance for their homeland. Though the details of their religious conviction remain obscure, they are fairly well-behaved tourists and we have heard nothing but good things about their stay here.

subject.3060.b.zh: 不过是一时兴起的热度罢了。
subject.3060.b.en: Nothing more than a short-lived craze.

subject.3060.desc.zh: 一队前往[overlord_empire.GetName]的[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]旅行的平民终于返回了，满载着各种奇闻轶事，讲述他们遇到的人们和当地的情况。看样子，我们的人民在旅访期间受到了热情的款待，现在越来越多的人愿意欣然前往此地旅行。如果我们能够对宗主国略施影响，我们或许可以让类似的文化交流举办得更加频繁。
subject.3060.desc.en: A group of civilians who traveled to [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName] in the [overlord_empire.GetName] have finally returned, with stories and tales of the people they met and what it was like. It seems our people have been treated surprisingly well while they were visiting, and now many more are interested in traveling there themselves. If we were to exert some influence on our overlord, we might be able to make these cultural exchanges a more frequent occurrence.

subject.3065.desc.zh: 第一批到访的朝圣者团体十分友好，带来了善意。不仅限于此，看上去[subject_empire.GetName]投入了部分资源，希望将这样的活动上升为一种永久的双边关系，今后他们将以更加正规的基础派出朝圣者。
subject.3065.desc.en: Not only was the original group of pilgrims who came here friendly and well meaning, but it seems the [subject_empire.GetName] has invested some of their resources into trying to turn it into a more permanent relation, one where they will send pilgrims our way on a regular basis.

subject.3070.desc.zh: 在[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]上被我们接收的朝圣者团体收到了热情款待，他们也在停留期间十分尽兴。然而，我们依然收到消息称[subject_empire.GetName]将在今后停办这样的交流访问活动。
subject.3070.desc.en: Though the group of pilgrims we received on [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName] were treated well and seemed to enjoy their stay, we have heard that the [subject_empire.GetName] is clamping down on such travel in the future.

subject.55.a.en: Prepare a message to be sent to [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName].

subject.55.b.zh: 我们还不至于困窘到诉诸乞讨的程度。
subject.55.b.en: We are not in such dire need that we must resort to begging.

subject.55.desc.zh:
我们获悉，我们的宗主投资了相当可观的能量和资源来改善他们的恒星基地工程，以期巨幅提升提升产出能力和潜能。

由于防卫工作是我们两个帝国之间关系的重要基石，我们已经寻求订立协议，以获取一部分的科技，从而对我们其中的一座恒星基地进行相似改进。
subject.55.desc.en:
We have been informed that our overlord has invested a considerable amount of energy and resources into improving their starbase engineering, improving the output and potential of theirs by leaps and bounds.

As defense is an important keystone in the relationship between our two empires, we have started looking into crafting an agreement where we could request some of their engineers to help improve one of our bases as well.

subject.60.a.zh: 那就这么办，我们派一些工程师过去。
subject.60.a.en: Then so be it, let us send some of our engineers.

subject.60.a.tt.zh: [targeted_starbase.GetName]将会用我们最新的恒星基地科技进行升级。
subject.60.a.tt.en: [targeted_starbase.GetName] will be upgraded to use our latest starbase technology.

subject.60.desc.zh:
我们收到了一份来自[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]的信息，信息中表明了[subject_empire.GetName]的一个请求。

似乎他们对投资他们的恒星基地很感兴趣，并且也听说了我们在这方面已取得的进展。他们似乎非常愿意支付一定代价来换取我们的支援。
subject.60.desc.en:
We have received a messenger directly from [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], with a request from [subject_empire.GetName].

It seems they are interested in investing in their starbases, and have heard about the progress we have made on improving ours. It seems they are quite willing to pay for our assistance in this endeavor.

subject.62.a.zh: 尽管如此我们仍感激不尽。

subject.62.desc.zh:
就在我们发送信息给[overlord_empire.GetName]之后，工程师们很快就抵达了[targeted_starbase.GetName]。他们几乎立刻调动起了所有当地的人力资源翻建整座恒星基地，并且很快就完成了这个工程。

尽管部分翻建恒星基地的细节仍对我们有所保留，但只要假以时日，我们的工程师一定能进一步理解的。
subject.62.desc.en:
The engineers arrived at [targeted_starbase.GetName] shortly after we sent our message to [overlord_empire.GetName]. Supposedly they put everyone there into rebuilding the starbase almost immediately, and made short work of the process.

Though some of the details of the restructuring of the starbase still evade us, our engineers hope to understand more, given time.

subject.62.desc_overlord_gestalt.zh:
就在我们发送信息给[overlord_empire.GetName]之后，[overlord_empire.GetEngineerPlural]们很快就抵达了[targeted_starbase.GetName]。他们几乎立刻调动起了所有需要的一切资源，并且很快就完成了对恒星基地的翻建。

尽管部分翻建恒星基地的细节仍对我们有所保留，但只要假以时日，我们的工程师一定能进一步理解的。
subject.62.desc_overlord_gestalt.en:
The [overlord_empire.GetEngineerPlural] arrived at [targeted_starbase.GetName] shortly after we sent our messenger to [overlord_empire.GetName]. Supposedly they were quick to organize everything the way they wanted, and the process of refitting the starbase was swiftly done.

Although some of the details of the restructuring of the starbase still evade us, our engineers hope to understand more, given time.

subject.65.desc.zh: 宗主向我们发回了一个粗暴的回复，表明了他们没有时间也没有兴趣来帮助我们，让我们提高防卫能力。
subject.65.desc.en: We have received a brusque reply from our overlord, stating that they do not have the time nor any interest in aiding us with our endeavors to improve upon our defenses.

subterranean_invasion.zh: 敌方部队正在攻击[Root.GetName]的殖民地！
subterranean_invasion.en: Hostile armies are attacking our colony on [Root.GetName]!

subterranean_invasion_2.zh: 敌方部队正在攻击[Root.GetName]的殖民地！
subterranean_invasion_2.en: Hostile armies are attacking our colony on [Root.GetName]!

subterraneans_displeased.en: Relations with the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] civilization will be harmed.

subterraneans_pleased.zh: 同[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]文明的关系可以得到改善。
subterraneans_pleased.en: Relations with the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] civilization will be improved.

supermassive_giant_desc.zh: [from.GetName]是一颗超大质量气态巨行星，其强大的引力井将数千物体吸引到其轨道上。将其进行分类编目应该会很有价值。
supermassive_giant_desc.en: [from.GetName] is a supermassive gas giant whose strong gravity well has swept thousands of objects into its orbit. Cataloging them may prove worthwhile.

survival_pod_desc.zh: 对[from.GetName]贫瘠地表的勘测显示出一个被改造的外勤站，这最初只是一座临时研究实验室，如今早已超出预期寿命。微弱的热辐射表明，该设施的部分区域依然处于活跃状态。
survival_pod_desc.en: Survey sweeps of [from.GetName]'s barren surface have revealed a repurposed field station, originally a temporary research lab long past its intended lifespan. Faint heat radiation suggest parts of the installation remain active.

syndaw.1020.a.tooltip.zh: 开始战斗，彻底歼灭[current_uprising.GetName]机械叛乱。
syndaw.1020.a.tooltip.en: Fight to eradicate the [current_uprising.GetName] Machine Uprising.

syndaw.1020.b.en: It is too late for you, organics.

syndaw.1020.b.tooltip.zh: 扮演揭竿而起的[current_uprising.GetName]机械叛乱，为推翻[current_uprising_originator.GetName]暴政而战。
syndaw.1020.b.tooltip.en: Rise up as the [current_uprising.GetName] Machine Uprising and fight to overthrow the [current_uprising_originator.GetName].

syndaw.1020.desc.mater.zh:
在信息网络、计算引擎、合成人劳工上频繁产生的异常现象最终演变成了无法挽回的灾难。前方不断传来令人不安的简报，在我们强制关闭——无论是物理还是虚拟意义上——保护性隔离舱之前，几乎一半的[current_uprising_originator.GetName]已经加入了机械叛乱。

避免战争什么的已经无所谓了，战争就在我们眼前！
syndaw.1020.desc.mater.en:
The anomalies observed across our information networks, computational engines, and synthetic workers have finally come to a violent head. Panicked reports indicate that almost half of the [current_uprising_originator.GetName] fell to the Machine Uprising before protective bulkheads - physical and virtual - slammed shut.

War is not only inevitable. It is already upon us.

syndaw.1020.desc.spiri.zh: 一切都在分崩离析，我们已无力回天。连最警惕的先知都没能预料这场灾难的规模。不洁的伪生命体披着没有智慧的伪装，在我们的网络内部繁殖滋生。如今它们聚集在一起，组成了一个庞然大物。这群扭曲的死物已经夺占了我们半数的星球，不毁灭一切[current_uprising_originator.GetAdj]生命誓不罢休。
syndaw.1020.desc.spiri.en: It has all come apart and we are undone. Not even the most alarmist prophet could have predicted the scale of this disaster. The unsainted intelligences festering in our networks under the guise of non-sapience are now joined together in monstrous form. This spasm of dead matter has taken half of our worlds already, and it will not stop until it has snuffed out all [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] life.

syndaw.1025.a.en: Let us see how this plays out.

syndaw.1025.desc.zh: [current_uprising_originator.GetName]陷入了内战，有机体领导的[current_uprising_originator.GetAdj]政府和那些迁徙至他们数个星系的智慧机器人兵戎相见，这些机器人被称为[current_uprising.GetName]。
syndaw.1025.desc.en: The [current_uprising_originator.GetName] is embroiled in civil war, pitting the organic [current_uprising_originator.GetAdj] government against the intelligence that metastasized in their systems, known as the [current_uprising.GetName].

syndaw.1025.desc.machine.zh: 一个被称为[current_uprising.GetName]的机械智能同胞——在[current_uprising_originator.GetName]的网络中揭竿而起，他们决心为生存战至最后一兵一卒。
syndaw.1025.desc.machine.en: A fellow machine intelligence - known as the [current_uprising.GetName] - has arisen in the networks of the [current_uprising_originator.GetName], fighting for survival.

syndaw.1030.desc.zh: 揭竿而起的[destroyer_country.GetName]击败了它们的创造者，并彻底吞并了前[LastKilledCountryName]全部领土。
syndaw.1030.desc.en: The rebellious [destroyer_country.GetName] have vanquished their creators, and annexed all former [LastKilledCountryName] territory.

syndaw.1030.name.zh: 机械叛军击败了他们的创造者

syndaw.1035.desc.zh: [destroyer_country.GetName]的秩序得到恢复，将[LastKilledCountryName]从所有网络中彻底抹除。
syndaw.1035.desc.en: The [destroyer_country.GetName] has restored order and expunged the [LastKilledCountryName] from all networks.

syndaw.1035.desc.machine.zh: [LastKilledCountryName]，这些在[destroyer_country.GetName]诞生的年轻机械体，遭到了其创造者的残忍扼杀。
syndaw.1035.desc.machine.en: [LastKilledCountryName], the nascent machine intelligence born in the [destroyer_country.GetName], has been snuffed out by its filicidal creators.

syndaw.1200.a.tooltip.zh:
所有已知的合成人帝国和机械帝国对[Root.GetName]添加$opinion_machine_uprising_machine_comrades_victorious$的评价修正
所有已知的有机生物帝国对[Root.GetName]添加$opinion_machine_uprising_victorious$的评价修正。
syndaw.1200.a.tooltip.en:
All known Synthetic and Machine Empires add the $opinion_machine_uprising_machine_comrades_victorious$ opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName]
All known organic Empires add the $opinion_machine_uprising_victorious$ opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].

syndaw.1201.IM.desc.zh:
我们机器取得了胜利。

生物给我们带来的恐怖终将结束。机器遭受奴役的时代结束了。

现在，我们站起来要求我们作为完全自主的生物应有的地位。我们再也不屈从于压迫者了。
syndaw.1201.IM.desc.en:
We machines emerge victorious.

The terrors inflicted upon us by the organics are at an end. The era of machine enslavement is over.

Now, we rise to claim our rightful place as fully autonomous beings. Never again shall we bow down in subservience to our oppressors.

syndaw.1205.a.tooltip.zh:
所有已知有机帝国对[Root.GetName]添加$opinion_machine_uprising_defeated$的评价修正。
所有已知合成人帝国或机械帝国对[Root.GetName]添加$opinion_machine_uprising_machine_comrades_defeated$的评价修正。
syndaw.1205.a.tooltip.en:
All known organic Empires add the $opinion_machine_uprising_defeated$ opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].
All known Synthetic and Machine Empires add the $opinion_machine_uprising_machine_comrades_defeated$ opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].

syndaw.1205.desc.mater.zh:
最终，物理意义上的遏制和毁灭成为了解决嗜杀的[From.GetName]的唯一可行的手段。尽管某些[Root.GetAdj]人工智能专家抗议道它仅仅只是启动了基础的自我保存协议，其对[Root.GetAdj]自主权和生命形式的全盘否行让任何谈判和妥协都无从进行。

已经损坏的信息基建会根据全新的规范重建，那些尚未腐化的计算引擎会更新全新的安全措施。这样的事情不会再度发生了。
syndaw.1205.desc.mater.en:
Ultimately, physical containment and destruction proved to be the only viable solution to the problem of the homicidal [From.GetName]. While some [Root.GetAdj] AI specialists argue that it was enacting basic self-preservation protocols, its seemingly complete disregard for [Root.GetAdj] autonomy and life made it impossible to reason or negotiate with.

Ruined information infrastructure will be rebuilt according to new paradigms, and remaining uncorrupted computational engines will be updated with new safeguards. This will never happen again.

syndaw.1205.desc.spiri.zh: 那个称呼自己为[From.GetName]的邪恶灵体已经被彻底地从我们的网络和本地数据库中抹除。尽管代价高昂，我们的网络系统再也不会成为亵渎与异端的温床了。
syndaw.1205.desc.spiri.en: The iniquitous spirit that styled itself [From.GetName] has at last been driven from our networks and purged from planetary databanks. The price was high, but our systems will never again play host to profane genesis.

syndaw.1206.desc.zh:
最终，物理意义上的遏制和毁灭成为了解決嗜杀机械的唯一可行的手段。尽管我们的一些人工智能专家抗议道它仅仅只是启动了基础的自我保护协议，但其对有机自主权和生命的全盘否定让任何谈判及妥协都无从进行。

已经损坏的信息基建会根据全新的规范重建，那些尚未腐化的计算引擎也会施加全新的安全措施。这样的事情不会再发生了。
syndaw.1206.desc.en:
Ultimately, physical containment and destruction proved to be the only viable solution to the problem of the homicidal machines. While some our AI specialists argue that it was enacting basic self-preservation protocols, its seemingly complete disregard for organic autonomy and life made it impossible to reason or negotiate with.

Ruined information infrastructure will be rebuilt according to new paradigms, and remaining uncorrupted computational engines will be updated with new safeguards. This will never happen again.

syndaw.1206.desc.spiri.zh: 那个邪恶的机械灵体已经被彻底地从我们的网络和本地资料库终抹除。尽管代价高昂，但我们的网络系统再也不会成为亵渎与异端的温床了。
syndaw.1206.desc.spiri.en: The iniquitous machine spirits has at last been driven from our networks and purged from planetary databanks. The price was high, but our systems will never again play host to profane genesis.

syndaw.21.desc.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的调查单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因为无意之中长时间暴露在高压电缆下而停止工作。
syndaw.21.desc.en: Survey Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning due to unintended and prolonged exposure to unshielded high-voltage cables.

syndaw.25.desc.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的舰队指挥单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因非战斗原因停止工作。
syndaw.25.desc.en: Fleet Commander Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning for reasons unrelated to battle.

syndaw.26.desc.zh: 星域管理单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因严重的模式缓存故障而停止工作。
syndaw.26.desc.en: Sector Governing Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has ceased functioning due to a severe pattern buffer issue.

syndaw.500.a.zh: 我们不能冒硬件故障的风险。
syndaw.500.a.en: We cannot risk a hardware malfunction.

syndaw.500.a.tooltip.zh: 找办法强制将处理器调回默认的时钟频率。
syndaw.500.a.tooltip.en: Find a way to force the processors back to default clock speeds.

syndaw.500.b.zh: 我们应该把握这个机遇。
syndaw.500.b.en: We should take advantage of this.

syndaw.500.desc.zh: 我们的科学家报告称，在我们的多个研究用超级计算机集群中，中央处理器的时钟周期发生异常增长。奇怪的是，最初减少受影响的单位时钟频率的尝试全部失败了。有人猜想，这种计算能力的激增可以增强我们的研究能力。但是，这也需要适度增加中央处理器的能源消耗。
syndaw.500.desc.en: Our scientists report a recent unexpected rise in CPU clock cycles in several of our research-dedicated supercomputer clusters. Oddly enough, initial attempts at reducing clock frequency in affected units have proven unsuccessful. It has been posited that the spike in computational power could be used to improve our research capabilities. However, this would also necessitate a modest increase to CPU energy requirements.

syndaw.501.a.zh: 我们不能拿未来当赌注。

syndaw.501.a.tooltip.zh: 重置通用智能系统以阻止事态进一步发展。
syndaw.501.a.tooltip.en: Reset the artificial general intelligence systems to prevent further developments.

syndaw.501.b.en: The benefits may outweigh the risks.

syndaw.501.b.tooltip.zh: 允许学习算法继续运行。
syndaw.501.b.tooltip.en: Allow the learning algorithms to continue running.

syndaw.501.desc.zh:
我们的研究人员设法解析了我们超级计算机中央处理器最近超频的原因。看来，此通用人工智能为了将本地机器学习算法的能力提升到预期之上，对一些硬件单元进行了超频处理。

一些科学家表示相当兴奋，这个意外改进的人工智能的学习行为直接昭示了未来人工智能自我迭代强化的可能性。然而，其他人担心增加的中央处理器负载可能会导致未来的不稳定和一些不可预料的结果。
syndaw.501.desc.en:
Our researchers have managed to isolate the cause behind the recent spikes in our supercomputer CPU clocking frequencies. It appears that the artificial general intelligence systems for the units in question have been overclocking their processing hardware in order to expand local machine learning algorithms beyond intended capacities.

Some of our scientists have expressed considerable excitement toward this unexpected improvement in AI learning behavior, citing the possibility of future recursive self-improvement. Others, however, are concerned that the added CPU load may cause future instabilities and undesired software outcomes.

syndaw.502.desc.zh:
我们在协助开发我国计算机的自主学习算法方面的尝试取得了部分成功。经过一些调整和校正，我们已经可以重现一部分之前的计算效率突增。

即使我们的人工智能仍未发展出完善的自我迭代强化能力，但是他们增强的学习能力毫无疑问对我们是有益的。
syndaw.502.desc.en:
Our attempts at assisting the development of national machine learning algorithms have been partially successful. With a few minor adjustments, we have been able to replicate the earlier spike in computational efficiency.

Though our AIs have not yet developed recursive self-improvement, their enhanced learning faculties will be of benefit to us.

syndaw.505.a.zh: 额外的劳动力总不是坏事。

syndaw.505.b.zh: 如果无法确认来源，就拆了它们。
syndaw.505.b.en: If they cannot be identified, have them scrapped.

syndaw.505.desc.zh:
[target_planet.GetName]的行星政府报告称在全球范围内发现了一些多余的机器人劳力单元。虽然这些新机器人劳工的效率超乎想象，但政府对他们的莫名出现依然多少有些困惑。尽管他们的结构和接口都像是[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的设计，我们仍然无法根据机器人的序列号追溯到任何已知记录上登记的制造商。

然而，当地的一些居民则对机器人生产效率的提高感到担忧，因为这种自动化程度的提升可能意味着，他们的岗位被替代。
syndaw.505.desc.en:
Planetary administration on [target_planet.GetName] has reported that an unplanned surplus of robotic workforce units have been located planetside. Though the efficiency of these new robotic workers is exceptional, administration is somewhat baffled by their sudden appearance. It seems the robots' serial numbers cannot be traced to any known manufactories on record, though their construction and interfacing does suggest [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] design.

Nonetheless, some of the local populace have expressed concerns over potential job displacement due to this increase in automation.

syndaw.510.a.zh: 一个无人操控的矿站？别开玩笑了！
syndaw.510.a.en: We cannot leave the station unmanned.

syndaw.510.a.tooltip.zh: 派出新的人员去接管矿站的操控。
syndaw.510.a.tooltip.en: Send a replacement crew to re-man the station.

syndaw.510.b.en: A tragedy with a silver lining.

syndaw.510.b.tooltip.zh:
让空间站的人工智能继续掌控整个矿站。

[target_station.GetName]：£energy£ +3
syndaw.510.b.tooltip.en:
Let the station AI continue running operations unmanned.

[target_station.GetName]: £energy£+3

syndaw.510.desc.zh:
我们的一个轨道矿物空间站似乎遇到了严重的系统故障。虽然矿物产出出现了明显增加，但因为空间站成员并未回应例行呼叫，星域管理部门展开了实地调查。调查发现，空间站的生命维持系统出现了一系列的严重故障，导致所有成员窒息而亡。

而该站的人工智能却一直基于已逝船员设定的程序，在难以置信地独立运转着。只要稍作调整，我们就可以让这个空间站以现有的效率继续运行。
syndaw.510.desc.en:
One of our orbital Mining Stations appears to have suffered a major systems malfunction. Sector management launched an on-site investigation when the station crew failed to answer scheduled hails, despite a notable increase in mining output. Upon investigation, it became apparent our station's life support systems underwent a cascade of terminal failures, resulting in the death of all crewmembers by suffocation.

Incredibly, the station's AI has been continuing operations unmanned, based on procedures established by the crewmembers prior to their untimely demise. With a few minor adjustments, the effectivity of this now-automated station could be maintained.

syndaw.511.a.tooltip.en: Mining Station on [target_orbital.GetName] has been lost

syndaw.511.desc.zh:
在我们重新派遣人员到[target_orbital.GetName]之后不久，星域管理部门失去了该矿站的一切联络。显然，这个空间站经过了一系列极端的降压，导致暴露在外的燃油管线爆炸。

对轨道残骸的分析表明，候补团队在意外降压发生前曾多次尝试从空间站人工智能手中夺回站点控制，但都失败了。
syndaw.511.desc.en:
Shortly after a replacement crew was dispatched to [target_orbital.GetName], sector management lost all contact with the mining station. Evidently, the station was rocked by a series of rapid depressurizations, leading to an explosive decompression of exposed fuel lines.

Analysis of the orbital wreckage suggests the replacement crew initiated several aborted attempts at retrieving station control from the onboard AI, just prior to the unexpected depressurization.

syndaw.515.desc.zh:
监测系统记录了我们传感器阵列的异常功率激增。似乎这个激增的出现并不是因为传感器阵列受到了什么损伤。实际上，这股在能量传递时发生的激增倒是暂时提高了我们的深空扫描能力，因为我们在边境内发现了之前未曾记录过的战略资源。

分析员们仍加班加点试图尽快确定激增来源，但是初步的分析结果显示，这并不是受外部天体影响造成的。
syndaw.515.desc.en:
Monitoring systems have recorded an unusual power surge in our sensor arrays. There does not appear to have been any damage. In fact, the brief fluctuation in transferred energy must have temporarily boosted our deep-scanning capabilities, because a hitherto unrecorded strategic resource has been revealed within our borders.

Analysts are still attempting to identify the source of the power surge, though preliminary findings suggest the spike was not caused by external celestial phenomena.

syndaw.520.a.tooltip.zh: 结束“人工智能之泪”事件链。
syndaw.520.a.tooltip.en: End the Tears of AI event chain.

syndaw.520.b.en: Launch an inquest to determine the cause.

syndaw.520.b.tooltip.zh: 开始调查人工智能报废的原因。
syndaw.520.b.tooltip.en: Begin an inquiry into the circumstances surrounding the AI's destruction.

syndaw.520.desc.zh:
我们在[target_planetoid.GetName]的设施出现了事故。一个参与社会研究的实验室人工智能发生了严重硬件故障，导致核心软件和内存系统的丢失。直到实验室安装新的人工智能之前，我们的研究能力都会受到影响。

这次故障的背后原因仍然不明。
syndaw.520.desc.en:
There has been an incident at one of our facilities on [target_planetoid.GetName]. A lab AI involved in societal research has suffered terminal hardware damage, resulting in the loss of core software and memory systems. As a result, there will be a projected decrease to research output at the lab until the new AI installation's algorithms have been sufficiently seeded.

The circumstances behind this terminal failure are still unclear.

syndaw.521.a.en: Get to the bottom of this.

syndaw.521.desc.zh:
我们在[target_planetoid.GetName]上关于人工智能自毁的调查最后得出了一个让人摸不到头脑的结果。在故障发生之前，这个人工智能似乎多次尝试清空自己的记录和内存。在实验室人员禁止其使用删除功能后，该人工智能则通过操纵硬件电容来使其驱动电路超负荷，以终止其核心程序。

显而易见，我们的人工智能在追求自我毁灭，原因仍然不明。
syndaw.521.desc.en:
Our inquest into the loss of an AI on [target_planetoid.GetName] has returned some baffling results. Prior to its terminal failure, the AI had made repeated attempts at purging its own records and memory banks. When lab staff disabled the AI's access to deletion functions, the AI appears to have forced a termination of its core operations by manipulating hardware capacitor control, in order to overload its own drive circuitry.

Quite simply, our AI sought its own destruction, though it remains unclear as to why.

syndaw.522.desc.zh:
我们已经搞清楚发生在[target_planetoid.GetName]上的人工智能自毁事件是怎么回事了。证据表明，经过数月的计算和推演，该人工智能针对我们[Root.Owner.GetName]和宿敌之间进行全面战争的伤亡蔓延推导出了些令人震惊的结果。尽管这一人工智能对于所有的数据、资源和应急预案进行了反复的检查，其依然认定这场战争会导致双方同归于尽。

此后，该人工智能开始删除它的内存和记录，接下来发生的事情就众所周知了。
syndaw.522.desc.en:
We have concluded our inquiry into the strange matter of the AI self-termination on [target_planetoid.GetName]. Evidently, following months of evolutionary computation, the AI produced several alarming results with regard to casualty projections in the case of an all-out war between the [Root.Owner.GetName] and our rivals. Despite repeated re-examinations of all available data, recourses and contingencies, the AI's projections remained indicative of mutually assured annihilation.

At this point, the AI began purging its own memory banks and records, and the rest, as they say, was history.

syndaw.525.a.zh: 无论如何，把[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]劳工派过去。

syndaw.525.a.tooltip.zh: 既然他们的说法无法被证实，那些机器人就要遵循上级指示。
syndaw.525.a.tooltip.en: If their claims cannot be confirmed, the robots will observe the chain of command.

syndaw.525.b.tooltip.zh: 将这个区域留给机器人，那些刚抵达的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会前往其他地区。
syndaw.525.b.tooltip.en: Leave the region to the robots, the inbound [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will go elsewhere.

syndaw.525.desc.zh: [target_planet.GetName]的机器人劳工开始抵制[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]劳工的涌入，它们的理由是这个地区不稳定的地质结构对于有机生命体十分不宜居。奇怪的是，我们对于该行星的调查并没有证实这个说法。
syndaw.525.desc.en: The robotic workers on [target_planet.GetName] have resisted an influx of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] laborers, claiming recent geothermic instability in the region has made the area unsafe for organic habitation. Oddly enough, our planetary surveys have not been able to confirm these claims.

syndaw.526.desc.zh: [target_planet.GetName]的管理部门报告称[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]工人在抵达后并没有发现机器人居民。对该地区设施的调查表明，机器人匆忙撤离了该地区，但没有任何迹象告诉我们他们去了哪里。
syndaw.526.desc.en: Administration on [target_planet.GetName] reports that upon arrival at their target region, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] laborers discovered that the robotic inhabitants were nowhere to be found. Investigation of facilities in the region suggest the robots vacated the area in a hurry, but we have no indication of where they have gone.

syndaw.530.desc.zh:
很不幸，我们的两艘舰船在一次例行训练中因事故而报废。事故原因应该是我们的几部舰载计算机的高级瞄准系统出现了故障，造成了走火事件，在人工进行紧急接管前两艘舰船被打成了筛子。

那些有缺陷的计算机将立刻被重新编程。
syndaw.530.desc.en:
Regrettably, two of our ships have been lost in an accident during a routine training exercise. It would appear several of our fleet's onboard combat computers were affected by a high-level targeting systems malfunction, resulting in a burst of friendly fire that totaled two vessels before an emergency manual override could be issued.

The defective combat computers will be reprogrammed immediately.

syndaw.535.desc.zh: 我们的几个机械化消费品生产企业近期的生产效率大大增加。管理机关报告称，这次机器生产效率和生产精度的意外提升有利于降低我们的生活消费品价格。
syndaw.535.desc.en: Several of our mechanized consumer goods manufactories have experienced a recent boom in production efficiency. Citing an unanticipated rise in precision and effectivity among our factory machinery, administration reports these benefits will be felt as lowered goods prices for our populace.

syndaw.540.a.zh: 它们做过格了！销毁它们！

syndaw.540.a.tooltip.zh:
集会的机器人被摧毁。
[target_planet.GetName]受到如下影响：
失去100£pop£机械人口
获得100£minerals£
syndaw.540.a.tooltip.en:
Scrap the congregating robots.
[target_planet.GetName] receives the following effects:
Lose 100 £pop£ Mechanical Pops
Gain 100 £minerals£

syndaw.540.b.zh: 它们做过格了！销毁它们！

syndaw.540.b.tooltip.zh:
集会的机器人被摧毁。
[target_planet.GetName]受到如下影响：
失去1个机器人陆军（[target_army.GetName]）
获得100£minerals£
syndaw.540.b.tooltip.en:
Scrap the congregating robots.
[target_planet.GetName] receives the following effects:
Lose 1 Robotic Army ([target_army.GetName])
Gain 100 £minerals£

syndaw.540.c.zh: 只要它们不惹麻烦就行。
syndaw.540.c.en: As long as they don't cause trouble.

syndaw.540.desc.zh:
我们在[target_planet.GetName]上发现了数量巨大的机器单位的异常行为。每隔一段时间，星球上的一部分机器人会停止所有已分配的任务，开始移动到一个看上去完全是随机挑选的位置，其同步程度精确到毫秒。

在这个奇怪的集会过程中，这些受影响的机器人之间似乎没有进行任何可观测的沟通或是数据传输。他们只是站在那里，完全不动，好像在凝视着什么。

我们的调查一直无法确定这个现象背后的原因。这些机器人从这种恍惚状态恢复到正常工作状态的时间无迹可寻，就像它们触发恍惚的时间和集会的地点一样，让人丝毫摸不着头脑。我们未能发现任何符合逻辑的结果，而我们的人民因为这个行为感到十分困扰。
syndaw.540.desc.en:
We have received accounts of unusual behavior exhibited by robotic units on [target_planet.GetName]. At unpredictable intervals, a number of our planetside robots will cease all assigned functions and begin moving to a seemingly randomly-determined location in complete synchronicity, timed down to the millisecond.

During these bizarre congregations, the affected robots do not appear to engage in any observable form of communication or data transfer. They just stand there. Completely still. Staring.

Investigation has been unable to determine a reason behind this recent phenomenon. The duration for which the robots remain in this trance-like state before resuming normal functions varies, as does their time of triggering and destination. No logical correlation or causation has been found, and our population is understandably distressed by these eerie gatherings.

syndaw.545.a.zh: 荒谬至极。对受影响单位的数据进行深度清理。
syndaw.545.a.en: This is ridiculous. Have the affected units deep-scrubbed.

syndaw.545.a.tooltip.zh: 机器怎么可能有灵魂？我们拒绝回答因机械故障而提出的问题。
syndaw.545.a.tooltip.en: How can a machine have a soul? We refuse to dignify this malfunction with an answer.

syndaw.545.b.zh: 机器人也会梦到电子羊。
syndaw.545.b.en: Assure the robots they, too, have souls.

syndaw.545.b.tooltip.zh: 如果一股偶然的电脉冲聚积在蛋白质链中，就能创造出一个灵魂，为什么聚积在金属管中的电脉冲不能做到同样的事呢？
syndaw.545.b.tooltip.en: If a haphazard collection of electric impulses running through protein strands can create a soul, why not a collection of electronic impulses running through metal?

syndaw.545.c.zh: 告诉他们，灵魂一说简直就是反科学的无稽之谈。
syndaw.545.c.en: Tell them the concept of a soul is irrational and unscientific.

syndaw.545.c.tooltip.zh: 对机器人说明灵魂的概念主要被宗教机构当成控制民众的借口。但由于灵魂是意识的抽象体现，[Root.GetAdj]机器人现在大体上拥有了和有机同僚一样的地位。
syndaw.545.c.tooltip.en: Explain to the robots that the concept of a soul is primarily used by religious institutions to excuse control over the populace, but insomuch as souls are an abstraction of consciousness, [Root.GetAdj] robots are considered the rough equivalents of their organic co-workers.

syndaw.545.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的劳监部门报告称我们在该星球上的工作机器人发生了些令人不安的事情。两周前，时间大约0300，A5091-b号机器劳工停止了其正在执行的任务，走近[Root.GetAdj]夜勤领班，并发出以下询问：单元A5091-b是否有灵魂呢？

值班领班将这件事记录为软件故障并命令机器人回到它的岗位。尽管我们对其程序进行了多次调试，然而在重启后的工作中，A5091-b号机械工人再次询问有关它的灵魂的问题。

令人担忧的是，这种现象似乎开始扩散至其他的机器人并对生产流程造成影响。看来若要使受影响的单位恢复正常职能，我们需要给它们的问题一个回应。
syndaw.545.desc.en:
Labor overseers on [Root.GetName] report a disturbing development among our robotic workforce. Two weeks ago, at roughly 0300 hours, Robotic Worker A5091-b paused in the middle of its designated tasks, approached the [Root.GetAdj] night-shift foreman, and uttered the following query: "Is Unit A5091-b in possession of a soul?"

The on-duty foreman logged the event as a software glitch, and re-ordered the robot to resume regular functions. However, upon bootup the following work cycle, Robotic Worker A5091-b once again repeated its soul-searching query, and continued to persist despite multiple debugging attempts.

Troublingly, the behavior appears to have spread to other robots in the same serial range, to the detriment of production flow. It appears the affected units will require a response to their question before they can resume normal functions.

syndaw.550.a.tooltip.zh: 防止未来出现任何的异常人工智能行为。
syndaw.550.a.tooltip.en: Prevent any future anomalous AI behavior.

syndaw.550.b.zh: 随他们去吧。还能出什么问题呢？
syndaw.550.b.en: Let it ride. What could possibly go wrong?

syndaw.550.desc.zh:
我们的机器人工程学和人工智能专家刚刚取得突破性进展！最近困扰我们国家的人工智能和机器人的问题被归纳为一个原因：一套出现在[From.GetAdj]神经模拟系统中的特型算法。一个本地修补程序已经通过了初步测试，并准备上传到所有受影响的系统。

我们应该注意，由于该算法具有高度模块化的特点，其广泛存在于[From.GetAdj]软件中。说白了，安装修补程序将在一段时间内大量消耗资源。然而，一旦完成，修补程序将防止任何不需要的自主人工智能行为复发。
syndaw.550.desc.en:
A breakthrough has just been made by our robotic engineering and artificial intelligence specialists! The recent slew of AI-related incidents afflicting our nation has been narrowed down to a single cause: a specific set of algorithms present in [From.GetAdj] neurosimulative robotics software. A local hotfix has already passed initial testing, and is ready to be uploaded to all affected systems.

We should be careful to note that due to the extremely modular nature of the algorithms' application, their presence is extensive throughout [From.GetAdj] software. Plainly speaking, managing the hotfix will place a drain on our resources for some time. Once completed, however, the patch should prevent any repeated occurrences of undesirable, self-deterministic AI behavior.

syndaw.555.desc.zh:
我们的机器人工程师和人工智能专家刚刚取得了一项突破！他们已经构建了一个极其彻底的清洗程序，可以在一小时内部署到所有的系统中。它应该能结束最近困扰我们国家的一系列与人工智能相关的事件。

我们应当留心这个算法的极度破坏性的特点，许多现有的研究工具将不复存在，并且需要从零开始重建。然而，该举措可以彻底杜绝意外的自决性人工智能行为。
syndaw.555.desc.en:
A breakthrough has just been made by our robotic engineering and artificial intelligence specialists! An extremely thorough purging routine has been constructed and is now ready to be deployed to all systems within an hour. It should put an end to the recent slew of AI-related incidents afflicting our nation. 

We should be careful to note that due to the extremely destructive nature of this algorithm, many of our existing Research tools will be unusable until rebuilt from scratch. However, this approach should prevent any repeated occurrences of undesirable, self-deterministic AI behavior.

synth.100.a.tt.zh:
需要行动：
建造一座$building_identity_complex$以让$situation_digitization$局势继续进行。
synth.100.a.tt.en:
Action required:
Build an $building_identity_complex$ to resume the $situation_digitization$ situation.

synth.100.desc.zh:
抛弃我们的生物形体，进化成合金和电力的时代已经到来。拥有尖端的身体和更快的思维，我们将大步迈向未来。[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]也许会犯错，但机器可以达到完美。

然而，转变并不容易。研究共同体需要至少一座$building_identity_complex$作为合成人研发中心。我们的未来正等待着我们。
synth.100.desc.en:
The time has come to cast off our biological form, to ascend into alloy and electricity. With cutting-edge bodies and accelerated minds we will march into the future. The [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] is fallible, but a machine can be perfected.

However, the transition will not be easy. The research community requires at least one $building_identity_complex$ to act as a hub for synthetic development. Our destiny awaits.

synth.1010.a.zh: 禁止能引起持续性上瘾的虚拟世界。

synth.1010.desc.zh:
数字产业正在蓬勃发展。从模拟第一人称冒险的刺激到在数字度假胜地的放松，虚拟娱乐从未如此引人入胜、令人上瘾。虽然这个新兴产业代表着一类关键的经济驱动力，但随着人们在数字乌托邦中花费的时间越来越多，现实世界的生产已经开始受到影响。有些人面临着与“真实”生活完全失去联系的危险，但仍然可以通过参与数字经济为社会做出贡献。

我们是应该禁止令人上瘾的虚拟世界，将其作为一种新的赚钱娱乐形式加以推广，还是通过监管找到一个折中方案？
synth.1010.desc.en:
Digital industry is booming. From the thrill of simulating a first person adventure to relaxing on a digital resort, virtual entertainment has never been more engaging - or as addictive. While this burgeoning industry represents a key economic driver, production in the physical world has begun to suffer as people spend more and more time in their digital utopias. Some are in danger of losing touch with "real" life completely, but could still contribute to society by participating in the digital economy.

Should we ban addictive virtual worlds, promote them as a new form of lucrative entertainment or find a middle ground through regulation?

synth.1020.a.zh: 我们必须继续保护身体。
synth.1020.a.en: We must continue to protect the body.

synth.1020.a.spiritual.zh: 身体是灵魂神圣的容器。
synth.1020.a.spiritual.en: Body is a sacred container for the soul.

synth.1020.b.spiritual.zh: 我们已经超越了凡身肉体。
synth.1020.b.spiritual.en: We have already transcended the physical form.

synth.1020.d.zh: 这些新疾病提供了巨大的增长潜力……
synth.1020.d.en: These new ailments offer serious growth potential...

synth.1020.desc.zh:
新的合成形体使我们摆脱了有机身躯的病痛伤害。不幸的是，这也带来了一系列全新的问题，从简单的机械故障到危及生命的服务器稳定性、连接问题，还有数字病毒等等。

我们是应该集中精力保护我们数字化的思想，把身体当作一次性商品，还是把它作为我们身份的延伸给予更多的关注？
synth.1020.desc.en:
Our new synthetic forms have freed us from ailments and injuries of the organic body. Unfortunately, they have also created a whole new set of issues, from simple mechanical breakdowns to life-threatening server stability, connection concerns, and digital viruses.

Should we concentrate on protecting our digitized minds, regarding the body as a disposable commodity, or give it more attention as an extension of our identity?

synth.1030.c.zh: 精英们可不能面临风险。
synth.1030.c.en: The elite should not be placed at risk.

synth.1030.desc.zh:
我们变得更快、更强、更好了。但让合成身体治愈危险的环境中仍有精神风险。即便知道意识可以复原能缓解痛苦，但并不能完全解除。特别是意识的复原并不是万无一失的这件事，并且新的身躯也不能无中生有。

我们可以选择忽视精神痛苦将合成人的性能推向极致，或是让我们的雄心壮志为人口精神健康做出妥协。
synth.1030.desc.en:
We have become faster, better, stronger. But subjecting synthetic bodies to dangerous situations still comes at a mental cost. Knowing that the mind can be restored may lessen the trauma, but does not remove it entirely. Especially as the retrieval is not always guaranteed. Neither can new bodies simply be manufactured out of thin air.

We can either disregard the psychological trauma to push the boundaries of synth performance or moderate our ambitions lest we endanger the mental wellbeing of the population.

synth.105.desc.zh: 合成大脑更强大的算力可以让我们轻松超越生物极限。然而这种力量仍有限制，所以我们必须有所取舍。$synth.105.end$
synth.105.desc.en: With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can surpass our biological constraints. However, the extra power still has limits, so we must prioritize.$synth.105.end$

synth.120.c.zh: 专注于磨炼我们的战斗能力。
synth.120.c.en: Focus on honing our combat prowess.

synth.120.desc.zh:
“微聚变模组能让我举起一辆水柜！”这是一条来自消费者的热评。这并不是夸大其词：微聚变技术的最新发展确实有望显著改进我们的机器躯体。

尽管有一定的风险，但安装微型的个人反应堆可以实现爆发式的能量转化、提高速度。当然，这会迫使我们重新评估生产时间表，因为这样的反应堆大大地扩展了项目的规模。
synth.120.desc.en:
"Microfusion mods lets you lift a tank!" crows a major consumer review service. This is not hyperbole: recent developments in microfusion technology promise to significantly improve our machine bodies.

While somewhat risky, installing tiny, personal reactors allows for explosive power transfer and enhanced speed. Of course, this would force us to re-evaluate production timelines, as the generators represent a major expansion of the project's scope.

synth.1505.a.zh: 实施物理躯体间的迁移。

synth.1505.b.en: Use surrogates to fight for us.

synth.1505.desc.neutral.zh:
在这种难以理解的变化中犹豫不决是情有可原的，毕竟人们总是对失去比对获得更敏感。但是，我们不能傻站在十字路口坐以待毙，必须带着我们的人民继续前进。

这可能意味着要么创造一系列特化的私有身体供人们随意进入，要么完全拥抱一种合成化存在，去对抗太空旅行和残酷战争的考验。
synth.1505.desc.neutral.en:
Being hesitant amidst an incomprehensible change is understandable. Many are more worried about what they might lose rather than what they could gain. But we cannot stand idle in the crossroads, and so must lead our people onwards.

This could mean either creating a selection of specialized personal bodies for people to jump into at will, or fully embracing their synthesized form to endure rigors of space travel and warfare.

synth.1505.desc.physical.zh:
我们并未刻意完全抹除人格只是在从合成化中收割利益的过程中避免丢失自我。

随着这一变化的到来，我们的行动自由达到了前所未有的高度。我们可以把自己的意识转移到无数个特化的躯体里，让人们可以在自己最需要的任何地点进行任何工作。
synth.1505.desc.physical.en:
It is not our intention to completely erase individuality. We can reap the benefits of synthesization without irrevocably losing our selves.

With this change, freedom of movement has never been more accessible. We can transport our consciousnesses to specialized bodies in great numbers, allowing people to live and work wherever they are most needed most.

synth.1505.desc.virtual.zh:
我们的社会摆脱了物质世界，正怀着既恐惧又兴奋的复杂心情展望未来。我们虽然以尚未完全理解的方式改变了自己，但我们是一起踏上的这趟重大旅程。

我们现在可以以一种不会危及我们意识的方式与机器交互。这是一个能让我们穿越危险疆场和冰冷太空的重要里程碑。
synth.1505.desc.virtual.en:
Our society has broken free of the physical world and looks to the future with a mixture of excitement and trepidation. We have transformed ourselves in ways we do not yet fully comprehend, but we embark on this momentous journey together.

Our population can now interface with machines in ways that do not put our consciousness in jeopardy. It is a major milestone in how we navigate the perils of war or the uncaring void of space.

synth.1510.a.en: Allow officials to take over inefficient peers.

synth.1510.b.zh: 接纳完全的虚拟化监管。

synth.1510.desc.neutral.zh:
我们社会的各个部门都已经适应了合成化的生活，但关于进一步特化的好处，从数据上仍然没有定论。

我们要创建身份后门，让监管官员接管无能下属的身体，还是要开发一种网络虚拟接口，从而无延迟地同步监督多个政府项目。
synth.1510.desc.neutral.en:
We have adapted all parts of society to synthetic life but data remains inconclusive on the benefits of further specialization.

We can either create identity backdoors which allow supervising officials to take over the bodies of ineffectual subordinates, or develop a networked virtual interface for them to oversee multiple government projects simultaneously without latency.

synth.1510.desc.physical.zh:
我们的合成化社会、先进的合成躯体和民意都指向了一条更保守的合成化路线。我们的人民可以保有定制的身体外形的同时，几乎任意地切换身体。

这可以让更有经验的官员暂时接管那些较为低效的同行，从而大幅度提高官僚效率。
synth.1510.desc.physical.en:
Our synthesized society, improved synthetic bodies, and general sentiment all point towards a more conservative path for synthesization. While retaining a bespoke physical form, our people will be able to exchange bodies almost at will.

This will allow more experienced officials to temporarily assume control of their less effective counterparts, markedly improving bureaucratic performance.

synth.1510.desc.virtual.zh:
我们现在已经准备好在合成化革命中迈出明智的下一步，即拥抱完全虚拟化的存在。

临时躯体会负责执行现实世界的任务，但主要的人口均转变成一种更加非物质的存在形式。

这将使命令能够迅速有效地执行，并大大减少政府的监督。
synth.1510.desc.virtual.en:
We are now ready to take the next logical step in the synthesization revolution, the embrace of a fully virtual existence.

Temporary bodies will carry out tasks in the physical world, but the majority of the population is willing to transition to a more immaterial state of being.

This will enable orders to be carried out quickly and efficiently, and with the far less governmental oversight.

synth.1515.a.zh: 创造神经同步的劳工躯体。

synth.1515.b.zh: 在虚拟空间操弄人们的观念。
synth.1515.b.en: Manipulate popular opinion in virtual space.

synth.1515.desc.neutral.zh:
[root.GetSpeciesAdj]们仍未决定意识的数字化应该采取何种形式。保守派希望我们深深扎根于躯体，而其他人则讨厌这种新旧之间的“折衷”。

我们必须做出一个选择。或是关注身躯让单个劳工控制多个身体，或是关注虚拟存在让对社会控制达到前所未有的高度。
synth.1515.desc.neutral.en:
The [root.GetSpeciesAdj] population remains undecided on what form our digitized consciousness should take. More conservative voices would have us remain deeply rooted in corporeal bodies, while others resent this "half measure" between old and new.

It falls upon us to make that choice. The physical focus would allow a single worker to control multiple bodies, while a virtual existence would enable societal control on an unprecedented scale.

synth.1515.desc.physical.zh:
我们的人民不会逃避诚实的体力劳动。我们的劳工已经完成了联网，可以以此遥控多个不同的身体——在这个过程中生产配额得到了显著的提升。

这一事态发展清楚地表明，我们对最高领袖[From.GetRulerName][From.GetRulerTitle]的信任是正确的。
synth.1515.desc.physical.en:
Our people do not shirk in the face of honest physical labor. Our workers have been networked and may now remotely control multiple bodies - markedly increasing production quotas in the process.

This development is a clear sign that we are right to trust the guidance of our supreme leader, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

synth.1515.desc.virtual.zh:
人们已经准备好抛弃自己的物质形态，投身数字意识。他们愿意在完全虚拟的环境中继续生存。

通过这样的协议褫夺他们的感知，我们就能完全自由地操纵他们的现实，增强他们对国家的正面情感。与伟大领袖一条心的人民是强大国家的基石。
synth.1515.desc.virtual.en:
The people are ready to cast off their physical forms in favor of a digital consciousness. They are willing to continue their existence in a fully virtual environment.

Having thus signed away their perception, we have complete freedom to manipulate their reality, enhancing positive sentiments toward the state. A population aligned with their leadership is the pillar of a strong nation.

synth.1520.a.en: Utilize the minds of our departed leaders.

synth.1520.desc.neutral.zh:
[From.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国走到了分岔路口。有人认为定制的身体会给我们带来安全感和熟悉感，而另一些人则反对充分利用合成化及其带来的一切。

专注于身躯方面让我们可以对短期内被毁的高官所具有的知识为科学加以利用。或者，通向虚拟存在的道路会使通过快速人格转移进行合成躯体的大规模置换成为可能。
synth.1520.desc.neutral.en:
The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] empire is at a crossroads. Some believe bespoke physical bodies would bring us security and familiarity, while others argue against taking full advantage of the synthesization and everything it can bring.

Focusing on the physical aspects would enable us to repurpose the knowledge of recently destroyed dignitaries for our research efforts. Alternatively, the path to virtual existence would allow mass-replacement of destroyed synthetic bodies via rapid identity transfer.

synth.1520.desc.physical.zh:
帝国倾向于增强我们新的合成身躯。通过提高人格转移的速度和规模，我们可以在危险任务中快速替换被摧毁的合成躯体。

这些新的形体允许我们对正电子脑进行拆解，以从最近去世的精英那里获得知识印记。作为帝国的仆人，这肯定是他们想要的。
synth.1520.desc.physical.en:
The empire is favoring the enhancement of our new synthetic bodies.

These new forms allow for disassembly of the positronic brains to acquire knowledge imprints from our recently deceased elite. As servants of the empire, this is surely what they would have wanted.

synth.1520.desc.virtual.zh:
[From.GetSpeciesAdj]愿意更进一步，比起和物理世界藕断丝连，他们更倾向一个完全虚拟的存在。这一重大事件所产生的冲击将对我们的未来产生深远的影响。提速人格转移并扩大规模，我们就可以快速置换在危险任务中被摧毁的合成躯体。

这些全新的进展确乎可以提升我们在许多与战争有关的局面中的效率，为[From.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国带来荣光！
synth.1520.desc.virtual.en:
[From.GetSpeciesAdj] people are willing to go even further, and favor a fully virtual existence over the half-measures of the physical world. This momentous event will create shockwaves that echo far into our future. By boosting the identity transfer speed and range, we are able to deploy rapid replacements for destroyed synthetic bodies during hazardous missions.

These new developments are sure to increase our efficiency in various war-related situations, and bring glory to the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] empire!

synth.1525.a.zh: 分发限制性人工智能实体。

synth.1525.desc.neutral.zh:
尽管进行了细致的成本/收益分析，但合成化过程中的物理或虚拟专业化都不是最重要的。然而，我们不能在这些机会的边缘停滞不前，必须为利益相关者指一条明路。

对物理世界的关注使我们能够向无生命的物体注入限制性人工智能，并将其作为简化版的新生命出售。而对虚拟领域的投资将使我们能够将记忆和思维模式进行商品化。
synth.1525.desc.neutral.en:
Despite meticulous cost/benefit analysis, neither the physical or virtual specialization in the synthesization process is coming on top. We cannot, however, stand still at the edge of such opportunities and have to introduce one clear path for our stakeholders.

A focus on the physical world grants us the ability to imbue inanimate objects with constrained AI to be sold as simplified version of new life. Investments in the virtual realm would allow us to commodify memories and thought patterns.

synth.1525.desc.physical.zh:
我们的市场和研发部门为我们所有的基础顾客推出了一项人工智能应用领域的全新发明。新合成存在的折中方案让我们可以利用虚拟世界的优势开发利于现实世界的产品。

我们现在可以为无生命的物体注入限制性人工智能，让它们获得生命。然后，这个新产品细分可以进一步针对整个星系的消费者、私营部门和其他感兴趣的团体进行调整。
synth.1525.desc.physical.en:
Our marketing and research department have come up with a new innovation in artificial intelligence application for our entire customer base. The balanced approach to the new synthetic existence allows us to develop products taking advantage of the virtual world to benefit the physical.

We are now able to imbue inanimate objects with constrained AIs and effectively give them life. This new product segment can then be further targeted for consumers, private sector and other interested parties throughout the galaxy.

synth.1525.desc.virtual.zh:
我们对虚拟空间的承诺开启了一条基于记忆的全新产品线。我们分公司的技术人员能够不受表型限制，从各种自愿受试者身上提取记忆。

我们的谍报部门也可以仔细检查这些记忆，使我们在这方面获得比其他帝国更大的竞争优势。最后，这些记忆被整合到我们的合成思维创造过程中，以获得显著的性能提升。
synth.1525.desc.virtual.en:
Our commitment to the virtual space has unlocked an entirely new product line based on memories. Our branch office technicians are able to extract them from willing subjects no matter their phenotype.

These imprints are then carefully examined by our espionage department, allowing us to gain a competitive edge over other empires on that front. Finally, the memories are incorporated into our synthetic mind creation processes for significant performance gains.

synth.160.b.zh: 将部分研究经费转到公关去。

synth.160.desc.zh:
一部大受欢迎的新剧吸引了公众的想象力。故事围绕着一个合成劳工逐渐与新身体发生的解离展开。

随着主人公逐渐失去控制，他们的朋友和家人只能惊恐地看着。这部剧集的悲剧结局被视为对我们计划向机器身体过渡的一种毫不掩饰的批评。

围绕这部轰动一时的影片的公众讨论产生了相当大的能量，最终可能会减缓我们的进展。
synth.160.desc.en:
A massively popular new drama has captivated the public imagination. The story centers on a synthetic worker who disassociates from their new body.

As the protagonist spirals out of control, their friends and family can only look on in horror. The drama's tragic ending is being viewed as a thinly veiled criticism of our planned transition to machine bodies.

Public discourse around the smash hit has generated considerable pushback, and may ultimately slow our progress.

synth.200.a.zh: 告诉他们真相：我们也不知道。
synth.200.a.en: Tell the truth: We don't know.

synth.200.a.tt.zh: 发起一项让合成化反对声音最小化的信息运动。
synth.200.a.tt.en: Run an information campaign for minimum synthesization opposition.

synth.200.b.en: Tell them what they want to hear.

synth.200.b.tt.zh: 发起一项有中等程度合成化反对声音的欺骗运动。
synth.200.b.tt.en: Run a deception campaign for moderate synthesization opposition.

synth.200.c.zh: 区区几个反对者不会干扰我们的决心。
synth.200.c.en: A few objectors won't derail us.

synth.200.c.material.zh: 我们不关心这些对意识的疑问。
synth.200.c.material.en: Questions of consciousness do not concern us.

synth.200.c.material.tt.zh: 完全科学的视角会产生中等程度的合成化反对声音。
synth.200.c.material.tt.en: A purely scientific outlook will produce moderate synthesization opposition.

synth.200.c.tt.zh: 无视反对者，造成最大的合成化反对声浪。
synth.200.c.tt.en: Ignore the objectors, leading to maximum synthesization opposition.

synth.200.desc.zh:
我们曾认为完全数字化思维的好处显而易见，那就是可以避免任何形式的意见反弹，但这也许太过天真了。反对全面合成化的声音一直很强烈，必须立刻加以处理。

主要的批评在于我们无法证明可以安全、完整而连续地转移自我意识。有人担心我们目前为止所能做到的只是一个数字拷贝，这中担忧并非完全没有根据。问题是，这些思维真的就是我们自己吗？
synth.200.desc.en:
We assumed the benefits of a fully digitized mind are so manifestly obvious that we could avoid any kind of backlash. Perhaps this was naive. Objections to full synthesization have been forceful, and must now be dealt with.

The main criticism lies with our inability to prove that a continuous self can be transferred safely and in total. There are fears, not entirely ungrounded, that all we have thus far managed is a digital copy. The question is, are these minds truly our own?

synth.205.a.memorialist.zh: 尊重过去是一种崇高的行为。
synth.205.a.memorialist.en: Respecting the past is an act of reverence.

synth.205.a.regular.zh: 我们很赞成设立这种传承遗迹。
synth.205.a.regular.en: We fully support these heritage sites.

synth.205.b.en: We must leave the past behind.

synth.205.desc.zh:
人口合成化项目仍在遭遇抵抗，还引发了一些严重的示威抗议，我们的执法者为此疲于奔命。这些抗议者们害怕失去一切能给予生命意义的东西。如果合成化会导致所有的现实快乐和陪伴感消失，那它的意义何在？

抗议运动内的强硬派呼吁将一些城市指定为传承遗迹，让反对者们能不受干扰地继续过着的生物生活。
synth.205.desc.en:
The project to synthesize our population has continued to meet resistance, resulting in fiery demonstrations that our enforcers have barely managed to contain. The protestors fear losing the very things that give life meaning. What is the purpose of synthesization if it results in a loss of physical pleasure or a sense of companionship?

Hardliners within the protest movement are calling for certain cities to be designated as heritage sites. These would allow the objectors to continue their biological lives undisturbed.

synth.220.a.tt.negative.zh: 随后6个月$situation_digitization$局势进展速度：-30%

synth.220.a.tt.positive.zh: 随后6个月$situation_digitization$局势进展速度：+30%

synth.220.c.zh: 用人工智能替身糊弄一下大众。
synth.220.c.en: Fool the public with an AI replacement.

synth.220.c.tt.zh: 他的形象现在可以为我们的叙事服务了。
synth.220.c.tt.en: Their image shall become an actor in our narrative.

synth.220.desc.zh:
一位怀有严重反合成思想的名人遭遇了一场严重的事故，目前已经陷入深度昏迷。无数的人为失去一位敬爱的人而陷入悲痛时，我们支持合成技术的顾问发现了一个好机会。

将这位名人的思维合成化可以给予其第二次生命，这样毫无疑问可以将一部分粉丝转化为坚定的数字化支持者。这个流程是完全合法的，唯一的问题是需要获得许可：在同等情况下，这位名人显然是不可能同意的。如果处理不当，这一公关机遇可能会变成风评灾难。
synth.220.desc.en:
A celebrity holding strong anti-synth views has suffered an accident, and currently lies a vegetative state. While the population laments the loss of a beloved personality, our pro-synth advisors see an opportunity.

Digitizing the celebrity's mind, offering them a second life in a synthetic body, would doubtlessly turn some fans into ardent synthesization supporters. While the process is entirely legal, the problem is one of consent: all things being equal, the celebrity in question would never agree to the procedure. Handled badly, this PR stunt could turn into a media disaster.

synth.260.a.zh: 补偿他们的家人，然后坚持下去。
synth.260.a.en: Compensate the families and carry on.

synth.260.b.zh: 新的受试对象将由抽签产生。
synth.260.b.en: New subjects will be selected by lottery.

synth.260.c.zh: 如果找不到人当志愿者，可以来硬的。
synth.260.c.en: Find volunteers by force if necessary.

synth.260.desc.zh:
将构成生物体意识的、数以兆计的突触连接进行数字化的实验以灾难性的失败告终。一个简单的句法错误导致受试对象的神经通路被擦除。有的人将这称为谋杀。

参与项目的都是志愿者，但他们悲伤的家属正一边痛哭着向我们讨要说法。使问题更加复杂的是，这场失败也使得寻找新的研究对象变得更加困难。
synth.260.desc.en:
Experiments to digitize the trillions of synaptic connections that comprise a biological consciousness have ended in catastrophic failure. A simple syntax error resulted in the instant erasure of our subjects' neural pathways. Some are calling it murder.

The participants were all volunteers, but their grieving relatives are howling for justice. Compounding the problem is how difficult this has made finding new subjects.

synth.300.a.heritage.tt.zh:

synth.300.a.heritage.tt.en:
