synth.300.a.resistance.tt.zh:
$unlock_edict_tt$['concept_edict_subsidized_identity_backups']

将[Owner.GetNumSynthOpposition][Owner.GetBiologicalPopOrPops]移动至[root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上的$d_biological_enclaves$
清除地块障碍返还[Owner.GetNumSynthOpposition][Owner.GetMechanicalPopOrPops]

从[root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]移除$synth_mass_demonstrations$修正

合成化速度取决于局势应对方案以及机器人组装建筑的数量。
synth.300.a.resistance.tt.en:
$unlock_edict_tt$ ['concept_edict_subsidized_identity_backups']

Moves [Owner.GetNumSynthOpposition] [Owner.GetBiologicalPopOrPops] to $d_biological_enclaves$ on [root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]
Clearing the blocker returns [Owner.GetNumSynthOpposition] [Owner.GetMechanicalPopOrPops]

$synth_mass_demonstrations$ modifier removed from [root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]

Synthesization speed depends on the situation approach and the number of robot assembly buildings.

synth.300.desc.zh:
在全国各地每一个大型城市中心，我们都安装好了合成化站点，现已准备好迎接我们的[owner.species.GetName]人口。$job_identity_designer_plural$设计的数字人格模式保证了与生物原件的一对一对应。

这一天终于到来了，我们抛弃了生物的过往，拥抱了合成人的未来。
synth.300.desc.en:
All across our territory, in every major urban center, we have installed synthesization booths that now stand ready to receive our [owner.species.GetName] population. The digital identity patterns designed by $job_identity_designer_plural$ promise a one-to-one correspondence with the biological original.

The day is finally here to cast off our biological past and embrace a synthetic future.

synth.305.b.zh: 发展旅游可以大赚一笔。

synth.305.c.zh: 研究旅游业对遗址的影响。
synth.305.c.en: Study the impact of tourism on the sites.

synth.305.d.zh: 文化交流可以促进互相理解。

synth.305.desc.zh:
虽然[root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上的传承遗迹受到了公众的欢迎，但这一举措可能有点成功过头。在怀旧之情的熏陶下，大量的合成人游客涌入遗迹，数量远远超过了生物原住民。

如果我们想在这些空间内保持一种真实感，可能有必要限制旅游业。亦或者，可以让游客和居民之间的互动提供有趣的社会学洞见。
synth.305.desc.en:
While the designated heritage sites on [root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have been well-received by the public, the initiative has perhaps proven too successful. In a fit of nostalgia, vast numbers of synthetic tourists have descended on the sites and are beginning to overwhelm the biological inhabitants.

It may be necessary to limit tourism if we wish to maintain a sense of authenticity within these spaces. Alternatively, the interaction between tourist and resident could provide intriguing sociological insights.

synth.310.desc.zh:
[root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上反对合成化的运动从方法上到目标上都愈发极端。事实上，安保部队发现了暴力的升级，非法武器也在运动的较极端分部中蔓延。

其中的一些异见分子将自己称为“抵抗领袖”，目前已经撤退到藏身窝点，准备进行更公开的反政府行动。
synth.310.desc.en:
The movement against synthesization on [root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] has grown more radical in its tactics and ambitions. In fact, security forces have noted an uptick in violence as well as the spread of illegal weapons throughout the more extreme segments of the movement.

Styling themselves "resistance leaders", some of these dissidents have retreated to hideouts from which to prepare for more overt anti-government action.

synth.320.a.en: Every mind is worthy of preservation.

synth.320.b.en: There is nothing wrong with tinkering...

synth.320.c.zh: 要优先照顾聪明的意识。

synth.320.d.zh: 把那些“有问题”的个体重编程了。

synth.320.desc.zh:
21,386,732,184个存储单位：这是一个[root.owner.GetSpeciesName]大脑的平均容量。然而，并不是每个灵魂都生来平等。

随着合成化流程的继续，有些人认为并不是每个思想都值得配上一个人工躯体。但是让谁优先也是一个棘手的问题。或许那些不那么理想的人在数字化以后可以……改进一下。或者说，重编程。
synth.320.desc.en:
21,386,732,184 units of memory: that's the average capacity of a [root.owner.GetSpeciesName] brain. Yet, not all minds are created equal.

As the synthesization process continues, some argue not all minds are worthy of an artificial body. However, the question of who to prioritize is a thorny one. Or perhaps less desirable minds could be... improved, once digitized. Reprogrammed.

synth.360.a.zh: 对效率的优化还是值得的。
synth.360.a.en: Optimized productivity is worth the cost.

synth.360.a.tt.zh:
机器人组装建筑添加修正：
$MOD_PLANET_POP_ASSEMBLY_MULT$：+10%

synth.360.b.zh: 强制实行缓慢但安全的流程。
synth.360.b.en: Enforce slow but safe update processes.

synth.360.desc.zh:
为了提高[roboticist.GetNamePlural]们的工作效率，管理人员批准了不安全的无线人格软件更新。其目的是将最佳工作流程的知识补上，但不幸的接受者的却丢失了部分个性和记忆。

管理团队认为，在应用人格补丁之前对其进行全面测试太慢，而重新分配那些失去记忆的员工会更容易。
synth.360.desc.en:
To increase the productivity of [roboticist.GetNamePlural], managers have approved unsafe over-the-air identity software updates. The intent was to patch in knowledge of optimal work processes, but instead the personality and memories of the unfortunate recipients were partially lost.

The management team argues that it would be too slow to fully test identity patches before applying them, and that it is easier to just reassign the workers who lose their memories.

synth.4.a.tt.en: Unlocks Full Effects of Tradition Tree: ['tradition_category:tradition_synthetics']

synth.4.desc.zh:
在多方的通力协作下，我们实现了几乎不可能完成的任务，将意识转变成代码，躯体化身机械。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
synth.4.desc.en:
In a coordinated effort, we have achieved what seemed impossible, transforming our consciousness into code, and our bodies into machines.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new configuration offers endless possibilities.

synth.4.desc.unplugged.zh:
在多方的通力协作下，我们实现了几乎不可能完成的几近亵渎的任务。我们的演化已经超出了[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的掌控，将意识转变成代码，躯体化身机械。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
synth.4.desc.unplugged.en:
In a coordinated effort, we have achieved what once seemed impossible, perhaps even profane. We have evolved beyond even the grasp of the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], transforming our consciousness into code, and our bodies into machines.

The process was not without difficulty; the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new configuration offers endless possibilities.

synth.400.a.zh: 让任何人都能获取免费人格拷贝。
synth.400.a.en: Let anyone claim free identity copies.

synth.400.b.zh: 让用户为每份拷贝付费。
synth.400.b.en: Charge the user for each copy.

synth.400.desc.zh:
在意识数字化并被上传至合成躯体的过程中，我们失去了生物学繁衍的能力。现在我们必须通过复制现有的意识来创建人格。

随着$job_identity_designer_plural$们的研究继续进行，这个流程毫无疑问会继续优化。但无论如何，即便最完美的复制品也只是千篇一律。要创造新的意识、新的人格……目前还极具挑战。
synth.400.desc.en:
When we digitized our minds and uploaded them into synthetic bodies, we lost the ability to biologically reproduce. We must now create individuals by making copies of existing minds.

As our $job_identity_designer_plural$ continue their investigations, we will no doubt improve the process. After all, even the perfect copy is simple replication. To create a new mind, a new identity... Now there is a challenge.

synth.405.a.tt.zh:
获得研究选项：£engineering£$tech_identity_fusion$

未来可能研究：£engineering£$tech_identity_initialization$
synth.405.a.tt.en:
Research option gained: £engineering£$tech_identity_fusion$

Future research possibility: £engineering£$tech_identity_initialization$

synth.405.a.vault.zh: 把我们的数字化祖先进行组合。

synth.405.b.tt.zh:
获得研究选项：£engineering£$tech_identity_initialization$

未来可能研究：£engineering£$tech_identity_fusion$
synth.405.b.tt.en:
Research option gained: £engineering£$tech_identity_initialization$

Future research possibility: £engineering£$tech_identity_fusion$

synth.405.desc.zh:
我们的$job_identity_designer_plural$发现了两种创造更多样化人格的方法。

第一个选择的是将现有的两个以上人格混合，创造一个新的复合人格。我们可以优先挑选喜欢的特质或者随机选择。不论如何，新的人格毫无疑问都会比目前千篇一律的复制体更有趣。

另一种选择我们会初始化一个新的人格，创造人工内核并让它经历一个加速的虚拟童年。这样就可以设计出完美的人格。
synth.405.desc.en:
Our $job_identity_designer_plural$ have discovered two methods of creating more diverse digital identities.

One option would be to mix the characteristics of two or more existing personalities to create a new combined identity. Traits that we prefer could be prioritized or be selected at random. Either way, the new identity would surely be more interesting than our current identity copies.

Alternatively, we initialize a new identity from an artificial kernel and let it pass through an accelerated (and simulated) childhood. This way a perfect personality could be designed.

synth.505.a.zh: 我们应该关注迁徙的自由。
synth.505.a.en: We should focus on freedom of movement.

synth.505.a.tt.zh: 着重于强制迁移和区划。

synth.505.b.zh: 我们必须为战争的恐怖做准备。
synth.505.b.en: We must prepare for the horrors of war.

synth.505.b.tt.zh: 着重于厌战度和亚光速旅行。
synth.505.b.tt.en: Emphasis on war exhaustion and sublight travel.

synth.505.desc.zh:
得益于政府的努力，所有有意愿的公民都已经将意识转化为了数字形式。合成化打开了一条我们从未设想的道路，带来了全新的挑战与机遇。

通过将我们的努力推向现实世界，我们可以选择将数字化意识跨越无尽的空间传输到提前准备好的新躯体，或是设计出远程替身士兵来降低战争的残酷性。
synth.505.desc.en:
Thanks to the efforts of our government, the consciousness of every willing citizen has been transferred into digital form. Synthesization has opened paths we cannot yet imagine, leading to new challenges and possibilities.

By focusing our efforts on the physical world, we could transport our digitized minds across great distances to a new body already prepared for us. Or we can come up with means to create remotely operated surrogate soldiers to alleviate the rigors of war.

synth.510.b.zh: 研究全息虚拟监管选项。

synth.510.b.tt.zh: 着重于法令和帝国规模。
synth.510.b.tt.en: Emphasis on edicts and empire size.

synth.510.desc.zh:
合成化以我们前所未见的方式影响着社会，而普遍的看法是我们甚至还能更进一步。目前的合成躯体还可以改进，甚至完全抛弃它成为虚拟的存在。

如果我们决定为每个人分配一个合成躯体，那么官员就能临时接管政府众筹无效成员的身体。或者，我们也可以彻底抛弃物理存在，寻求完全虚拟的公共体验，着将使我们比以往任何时候都更有效地执行决策。
synth.510.desc.en:
While the synthesization has already affected society in ways we could have never anticipated, the general sentiment is that we could go even further. Our current synthetic bodies can be improved, or even discarded entirely for fully virtual existence.

If we decide to assign a synthetic body to everyone, it could enable officials to temporarily take over the bodies of ineffective members of the government. Alternatively, foregoing bespoke physical forms in favor of a fully virtual, communal experience would enable us to execute decisions with more efficiency than ever before.

synth.515.a.zh: 专注于对复数躯体的神经同步。

synth.515.b.tt.zh: 着重于建筑和政府法令。
synth.515.b.tt.en: Emphasis on buildings and government ethics.

synth.515.desc.zh:
对人口的完全合成化迎来了卓著的成功。我们的有机过往被扫入历史的垃圾桶，但为了踏出前进的道路，[From.GetRulerName][From.GetRulerTitle]要求我们的杰出人才无条件的服从，并做出抉择。

提升我们的合成躯体可以让单个意识控制多个躯体。或者我们还可以完全抛弃现实空间，通过虚拟的环境完全操控公众的情绪。
synth.515.desc.en:
Complete synthesization of the population has proved a resounding success. Our organic past been left in the dust of history, but to charter a way forward, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] requires both the unconditional obedience of our brightest minds, and a decision.

Improving our synthetic bodies would allow individuals to control multiple hosts as one. Alternatively, we could forgo physical space entirely, manipulating public sentiment through a fully virtual environment.

synth.520.a.zh: 关注从已逝的意识中提取知识。
synth.520.a.en: Look into extracting knowledge from the deceased.

synth.520.b.zh: 研究快速意识转移技术。

synth.520.desc.zh:
合成化以我们前所未见的方式影响着社会，但公众还想更进一步。合成躯体可以成为我们人格的延伸，或仅仅作为我们虚拟意识遥控着的工具。我们走到了一个岔道口上。

我们可以研究将意识在可抛弃的躯体耗材之间快速转移，或者可以选择专注于从已逝之人中提取知识来加速我们的研究工作。
synth.520.desc.en:
While the synthesization has already affected the empire in unforeseen ways, the population seems willing to go even further. Our synthetic bodies could become extensions of our identity, or mere tools to control remotely by our virtual consciousness. Our path is yet undecided.

We can research means to rapidly transfer a consciousness from one expendable body to another. Alternatively, we could focus on extracting knowledge from the recently deceased to accelerate our research efforts.

synth.525.b.tt.zh: 着重于贸易、商品和情报。
synth.525.b.tt.en: Emphasis on trade, goods, and intel.

synth.525.desc.zh:
我们对整个社会的合成化工作值得进行深入的风险收益分析。虽然我们即将进入一个全新的光明合成未来，但这也抛下了更注重物质的客户群。在理想情况下，我们希望这两个部分都能在一定程度上有所保留。

人工智能等合成化相关领域的进步将使我们能够给无生命的物体注入基本的生命，并推出多条产品线。而对虚拟空间进行更全面的探索，则可以使人们的记忆成为一种新型商品。
synth.525.desc.en:
Synthesization of our entire society merits an in-depth risk and benefit analysis. While we are entering a new, profitable frontier of synthesized future, we are also leaving our more materialistically aligned customer base behind. In a perfect world we would like to retain both segments in some capacity.

Advancements in synthesization-related fields such as artificial intelligence would allow us to imbue inanimate objects with rudimentary life, and launch multiple product lines. A more complete exploration of the virtual space would make it possible to tap into people's memories as a new type of commodity.

synth.610.c.zh: 为人格客订化设立恰当的限制。
synth.610.c.en: Enact moderate limits for identity customization.

synth.610.d.zh: 必须保留可见的地位象征。

synth.610.desc.zh:
合成化技术带来的根本性社会变化已经开始显现。由于我们不再受肉体形态的限制，性别、种族和身体自主权的类别已经有了新的定义。这虽然对一些人来说充满了自由，但更传统的一些人并不愿意放弃旧的框架；他们希望有一个预先设定的身份以便进行操作。

为了安抚他们，我们可以在合成形体中保留部分有机遗产。或者，我们也可以选择允许人们更自由地表达自己的身份。
synth.610.desc.en:
The fundamental social changes brought on by synthesization are beginning to be felt. No longer limited by corporeal forms, we have radically redefined categories of gender, race, and bodily autonomy. While freeing for some, more traditional elements are reluctant to let go of the old framework; they desire a preset identity from which to operate.

To appease them, we could retain parts of our organic heritage in our synthetic form. Alternatively, we may want to allow the population to express their identity more freely.

synth.610.e.zh: 这显然可以用来赚一笔……不是吗？

synth.620.a.zh: 给合成躯体按计划增加缺陷。
synth.620.a.en: Introduce planned imperfections to synth bodies.

synth.620.b.zh: 给他们一个不完美的世界。
synth.620.b.en: Provide them with an imperfect world.

synth.620.c.zh: 对过往的浪漫化是愚蠢的。
synth.620.c.en: It's foolish to romanticize the past.

synth.620.d.zh: 疼痛能让他们回想起自己的意义。
synth.620.d.en: Pain will remind them of their purpose.

synth.620.desc.zh:
有些人对合成化兴趣平平，反而对自己的有机过往深感怀念。他们认为，有限的寿命和与生俱来的“自然身体”的不完美才能让生命更有意义。

有一群强硬派声称他们的合成、虚拟复制品只能感受到空洞和自我迷失，发展出了一种对有机身体的崇拜。

我们要为它们提供一个不那么完美的生存模拟环境，还是给他们不那么完美的躯壳呢？
synth.620.desc.en:
Unenthusiastic about synthesization, some people look back with longing to their organic past. They argue that shorter lifespans and the innate imperfection of a "natural body" made life more meaningful.

Claiming that their synthetic or virtual facsimiles feel impersonal and hollow, a group of hardliners are developing a cult-like devotion to organic bodies.

Perhaps we should provide them a less perfect simulation in which to exist. Or would they prefer an imperfect shell?

synth.630.a.zh: 中心化服务器效率更高。

synth.630.b.zh: 个人服务器可以放在现有的住宅里。
synth.630.b.en: Individual servers can be stored in existing homes.

synth.630.desc.zh:
整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的合成化也意味着我们的住房实践发生了巨大的变化；大脑可以轻松地栖息在庞大的服务器群中，而合成的身体则可以储存在架子上。虽然这是一个具有成本效益的解决方案，但一些倡导团体提出了一些非常现实的担忧。

往日利润丰厚的房地产市场可能会完全崩溃，给我们的经济造成相当大的打击。至少从心理角度来看，更大的潜在伤害是，人们将不再有一个可以称之为家的物理场所。
synth.630.desc.en:
Synthesization of the entire [root.GetSpeciesAdj] species has also meant a drastic shift in our housing practices; with minds resting easy in massive server farms, synthetic bodies can be stored in shelves. While this represents a cost-effective solution, some advocacy groups are raising some very real concerns.

The previously lucrative real-estate market could collapse entirely, leaving a considerable dent in our economy. Potentially more damaging, at least from a psychological perspective, is that people will no longer have a physical place to call home.

synth.social_consequences.tt.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
synth.social_consequences.tt.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

synth_queen_able_to_attack_cetana.zh: 我们已经有可以有效攻击塞塔娜的科技知识了。
synth_queen_able_to_attack_cetana.en: We now have the technological knowledge to attack Cetana effectively.

synth_queen_approve_lot.zh: 这将极大地取悦塞塔娜。

synth_queen_disapprove_lot.zh: 这将严重地激怒塞塔娜。

synth_queen_history_site_1_desc.zh: 一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。
synth_queen_history_site_1_desc.en: A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

synth_queen_history_site_2.zh: 塞塔娜：不可能的幸存者

synth_queen_history_site_2_desc.zh: 埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。
synth_queen_history_site_2_desc.en: Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of her entombment.

synth_queen_kills_others_1.zh: 被其他人摧毁的女王卫队

synth_queen_kills_us_1.zh: 被我们摧毁的女王卫队

synth_queen_not_able_to_attack_cetana_si.zh: $situation_synth_queen_player_facing$局势正在进行中。我们还不具备攻击她的技术知识。
synth_queen_not_able_to_attack_cetana_si.en: $situation_synth_queen_player_facing$ Situation is ongoing. We don't have the technological knowledge to attack her yet.

synth_queen_not_able_to_attack_cetana_st.zh: [root.GetStormProjectProgress]特殊项目正在进行中。我们还不能进入她的领地。
synth_queen_not_able_to_attack_cetana_st.en: [root.GetStormProjectProgress] Special Project is ongoing. We cannot breach her territory yet.

synth_queen_punishment_tt.zh: 随着塞塔娜提供的每一次“教训”，她的愤怒似乎都会因而减弱。
synth_queen_punishment_tt.en: With every "lesson" Cetana provides, her ire seems to diminish.

synth_queen_victims_1.en: Ships Destroyed by the Queen's Guard

synth_respawn_push.zh: 宽松的合成人安全标准

synths_destroy_spaceport.zh: 合成人的破坏行动毁掉了[Root.GetName]上方的恒星基地。
synths_destroy_spaceport.en: Synthetic saboteurs have destroyed the Starbase over [Root.GetName].

synths_kill_admiral.zh: 指挥官[admiral.GetName]在一场卑劣的合成人阴谋中牺牲了。
synths_kill_admiral.en: Commander [admiral.GetName] has been lost in a dastardly Synth plot.

synths_kill_scientist.zh: 科学官[scientist.GetName]被合成人卑鄙地暗杀了。
synths_kill_scientist.en: Scientist [scientist.GetName] has been lost in a dastardly Synth plot.

tactic_v_extradimensional.zh: 佣兵战术：异次元入侵者

tech_archaeo_missiles.zh: 远古纳米导弹云发射器

technosphere_chain_desc.zh: 一个不断发出神秘光线的金属球体正在环绕卡冈都亚黑洞。它现在毫无动静，但会一直保持毫无动静么？
technosphere_chain_desc.en: A glistening metal orb sits by the Gargantua Black Hole. It is silent for now, but will it be so forever?

tectonic_icebreaker_category_desc.zh: 在[Planet.GetName]的风化层中发现异常低温现象，某种过程或物体可能正在导致地表部分区域降温。钻探勘测将揭示更多信息。
tectonic_icebreaker_category_desc.en: Strange low-temperature anomalies were detected in the regolith of [Planet.GetName], suggesting that some process or object may be cooling parts of the surface. A drilling expedition would reveal more.

ten_percent_authoritarian_tt.en: Approximately 10% of our £pop£ Pops gain the $ethic_authoritarian$ ethic.

ten_percent_egalitarian_tt.en: Approximately 10% of our £pop£ Pops gain the $ethic_egalitarian$ ethic.

ten_percent_militarist_tt.en: Approximately 10% of our £pop£ Pops gain the $ethic_militarist$ ethic.

ten_percent_xenophile_tt.en: Approximately 10% of our £pop£ Pops gain the $ethic_xenophile$ ethic.

ten_percent_xenophobe_preftl_tt.zh: 约10%的前超光速文明£pop£人口获得$ethic_xenophobe$思潮。
ten_percent_xenophobe_preftl_tt.en: Approximately 10% of the pre-FTL civilization's £pop£ Pops gain the $ethic_xenophobe$ ethic.

ten_percent_xenophobe_tt.en: Approximately 10% of our £pop£ Pops gain the $ethic_xenophobe$ ethic.

terminal_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 一颗环绕着此气态巨行星的小型卫星似乎很快就要撞上这个巨行星了。
terminal_gasgiant_category_desc.en: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.

terra.100.desc.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]完成了翻译外星人的铭文，发现贮藏室外刻着一个警示。“在战争时期，任何情况下，都不允许任何政府进入这座军械库！”

无论这里面储存着什么武器，那对于一整个文明都具有足够的毁灭性，能够将他们化成灰。我们剩下的工作就是小心地打开这座军械库，然后拿到我们的奖励。
terra.100.desc.en:
Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have finished translating the alien inscriptions and have discovered a warning engraved into the cache. "Do not under any circumstances allow any government to have access to this armory during wartime!"

Whatever weapon was stored here was too destructive even for a civilization that was capable of reducing themselves to ash. All that is left is to carefully open the armory and claim our prize.

terra.105.c.zh: 说好给我们武器的，把图书馆和雕像融化掉用来造导弹。
terra.105.c.en: We were promised weapons, melt the library and statue down and use it for missiles.

terra.105.desc.earth.zh:
似乎是我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将“图书馆”错误翻译成了“军械库”。我们一直对“权力的来源”一词存在错误的理解，直到我们打开了贮藏室，看到了更多的外星文本。“如果你在读这一段，那说明我们从战争中存活了下来，现在准备开始重建。当我们星球的局势变得愈发恶化的时候，我花费了许多个月份创建这座图书馆，我的朋友和我忠实的同事——沃尔特——一直陪伴左右。但既然你在读这一段，那说明我们中的某人幸存了下来，因此请好好接受这一份遗产。我和沃尔特收集到的，所有有关我们人民文化的成果，都集中在这里。你们第一个看见这个的人，将成为我最亲爱的朋友的象征。”

在饰板的下面，是一个双足哺乳动物的遗体，以及一个四足长鼻子动物的金属雕像。
terra.105.desc.earth.en:
It seems like our [Owner.GetLinguists] mistranslated the word 'library' as 'armory'. We had assumed the incorrect meaning of 'source of power', which was only apparent after opening the cache and being greeted by further xeno script. "If you are reading this, that means that we survived the war and are now ready to rebuild. I spent many long months creating this library while our world's situation worsened, accompanied by my friend and faithful companion Walter. But since you are reading this, that means that someone did survive, so please take part in your heritage. All the cultural works of our people Walter and I could gather are collected here, and let the first you see be a representation of my dearest friend."

The remains of a bipedal mammal and a metal statue of a four-legged long-snouted animal stands under the plaque.

But since you are reading this, that means that someone did survive, so please take part in your heritage. All the cultural works of our people my friend and I could gather are collected here, and let the first you see be a representation of my dearest friend."

The remains of a bipedal mammal and a metal statue of a four-legged long-snouted animal stands under the plaque.

terra.15.a.zh: 我们可以用得上更多的住房。

terra.15.c.zh: 拓展这个星球的能量生产力。

terra.15.d.en: You can never have enough mines.

terra.15.desc.zh: 在完成[From.GetName]的环境改造之后，我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]注意到了一个黄金的机遇。剩下的环境改造设备经过调整改造后可以作为这个行星的基础设施。
terra.15.desc.en: After completing the terraforming of [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have spotted a golden opportunity. The remaining terraforming equipment can potentially be repurposed as infrastructure for the planet.

terra.15.f.zh: 把这些设备拆解了就好。

terra.20.b.zh: 它非得看上去这么人工吗？
terra.20.b.en: Does it have to look so artificial?

terra.20.desc.zh: 环境改造[From.GetName]完工得比原先估计的要快，这给了我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]一些额外的时间开展一些实验，实验结果十分引人注目。这颗行星的自然特质得到了强化，既有美学情操，又保证了实用主义。
terra.20.desc.en: Terraforming on [From.GetName] has finished faster than initially estimated, which has left our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] with time to experiment, and the results are impressive. The planet's natural traits have been enhanced to be both aesthetically pleasing and utilitarian.

terra.25.desc.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上的漫长项目令人沮丧地结束了，只取得了一部分成功。在对最后的几处山谷进行地形变动时，生物质重调器发生了功能异常，导致我们创造出了一大滩环境改造残余物。尽管对于殖民者不构成危险，它还是意味着这个星球目前会有一点狭窄。
terra.25.desc.en: Our long project on [From.GetName] has frustratingly ended in partial success. As the final valleys were undergoing terramorphing, a malfunction occurred in the biomass realigner, leading to the creation of large swaths of Terraforming Residue. While not dangerous to our colonists, it means that the planet is a bit more cramped for the time being.

terra.25.desc.wilderness.zh:
我们为了唤醒[From.GetName]而进行的漫长项目，结果不如预期般顺利。我们的一处生物质重组器发生破裂，释放了少量环境改造残留物，堵塞了山谷并在某些可居住区域形成一层粘性外壳。

虽然这对我们本身没有危险，但这种过多的脓状物质意味着我们一些更具移动性的单位可能会在一段时间内遇到困难。
terra.25.desc.wilderness.en:
Our lengthy project to awaken [From.GetName] has not resolved as successfully as we had hoped. A rupture in one of our biomass realigners has released a minor deluge of Terraforming Residue, clogging valleys and forming a sticky crust over certain habitable zones.

While not inherently dangerous to us, this excess of pus-like material means some of our more motile elements may struggle for a time.

terra.30.a.en: At least some good has come of it.

terra.30.desc.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]现在清除了[Root.GetName]上的最后一点地形改造残余物。尽管清除工作十分痛苦、还黏黏糊糊，但这一切并非没有价值。对造成这一事故的原因和后果进行分析，使我们对地形学有了更加深远的理解。
terra.30.desc.en: Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have now cleared the final Terraforming Residue on [Root.GetName]. While the cleanup was painful and quite sticky, it was not all for naught. Analysis of the cause of this issue and the fallout has led to furthering our understanding of terralurgy.

terra.35.a.zh: 这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]应该作为[Root.GetHomeWorldName]二号被人所知
terra.35.a.en: This [From.GetPlanetMoon] shall be known as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] II

terra.35.desc.zh: 我们不仅成功地对[From.GetName]进行了环境改造，我们还做得更加好了。在定稿阶段的最后，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]设法想让这个星球成为我们本土动物群的完美家园，创造一个同[Root.GetHomeWorldName]及其相似的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。我们的所有本土植物也会移植到那里去，只是地形会不太一样。
terra.35.desc.en: We have not only succeeded in terraforming [From.GetName], but we have done something even better. During the final stretch of the process, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] managed to make it a perfect home for our local fauna, creating a [From.GetPlanetMoon] eerily similar to [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. All our local plant life is there but none of the familiar terrain.

terra.40.a.zh: 让[From.GetPlanetMoon]再次转起来，这么做风险太大了。
terra.40.a.en: Set the [From.GetPlanetMoon] spinning again, the risk is too great.

terra.40.b.tooltip.zh: 解锁一项特殊的殖民地决议，能够彻底解锁这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]的全部潜势。
terra.40.b.tooltip.en: Unlocks a special Colony Decision to unlock this [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s full potential.

terra.40.desc.zh: 正当[From.GetName]的环境改造工程即将收尾之时，一个独特的情况发生了。我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]发现，我们有可能将这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]变为潮汐锁定。这样的现象如果自然发生了，可能会对殖民地造成危害。然而，如果是在环境改造的过程中这么做，我们就能充分利用昼半球无穷无尽的太阳时长，产出极其丰富的能量。我们当然也要制定一个集中计划，将我们剩余的工业园区和住房布置在夜半球或晨昏线地区。
terra.40.desc.en: A unique situation has occurred on [From.GetName] just as the terraforming efforts are winding down. Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have discovered that it's possible to tidally lock the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. This occurring naturally can be quite a detriment to a colony. However, doing it during the terraforming process could allow us to exploit the endless solar hours the dayside will receive and generate an obscene amount of energy. We would still have to make a concentrated effort to set up the rest of our industry and housing on the twilight and night side.

terra.45.b.zh: 看看我们是不是能够为$district_mining_plural$提供更多空间。
terra.45.b.en: See if we can't develop more space for $district_mining_plural$.

terra.45.c.zh: 这个星球用得上更多的$district_farming_plural$。

terra.45.desc.zh: 随着[From.GetName]环境改造完工，我们发现这一工程使我们处在了一个始料未及的情况。我们实际上需要的资源，并没有我们最初立项的时候预计完成项目所需要的那么多，现在我们有机会为这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]增添一项额外的特征。我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]呈递给了我们三个不同的选项。
terra.45.desc.en: As the terraforming of [From.GetName] is settling down, we discover that the project has put us in an unanticipated situation. We did not need as many resources as we initially set aside to finish this project, and now we have the chance to add-on one additional feature to the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have presented us with three different options.

terra.50.b.zh: 不，这不是这个星球的意图。
terra.50.b.en: No, this is not the intention for this world.

terra.50.desc.zh: 在将[From.GetName]转变为[This.GetAAnPlanetClass][This.GetClassAdj]星球的过程中，[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]筹划着不仅将当地动物群连接到主脑，还想将这个星球本身也连接到主脑，尽管有点担心暴露在环境改造气体中有可能诱发突变。蜂群现在有机会在更加真实的感知下，变得前所未有地完整。
terra.50.desc.en: While turning [From.GetName] into [This.GetAAnPlanetClass] [This.GetClassAdj] world, the [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] managed to link not only the local fauna to the mind but, through freak mutations when exposed to the terraforming gases, link the mind to the world itself. The collective now has the opportunity to become whole in a truer sense than before.

terra.55.desc.zh: 对于蜂群来说，超越自然不是什么新鲜事。在对[From.GetName]进行地形改造的过程中，每一座山峦都经过了考量，每一片动物群的放置都经过了战略推演。这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]现在变成了一处组织完美的后勤天堂，方便我们的[Root.GetUnitDronePlural]为蜂群整体的建设添砖加瓦。
terra.55.desc.en: Surpassing nature is not something new for this collective. During the terraforming process of [From.GetName], every hill was considered, and every piece of fauna was strategically placed. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has now ended up being a perfectly organized logistical paradise for our [Root.GetUnitDronePlural] to produce for the collective.

terra.60.b.zh: 就是说地底下有害虫咯。
terra.60.b.en: So the pests scurry underground now.

terra.60.c.zh: 看到宇宙并不缺乏智慧生物还挺好的。
terra.60.c.en: It's good to see that the universe is not devoid of intelligent life.

terra.60.desc.zh:
在为[From.GetName]土地施肥和导入大气的过程中，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]有个意外的发现。在[From.GetName]的地表以下存在一个地下外星文明。应该是由于[From.GetPlanetMoon]的矿物密度导致此前我们的扫描仪并未发现他们。
这些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]似乎完全没有意识到行星的地表已经改变，这让我们有了决定如何与他们接触的主动权。
terra.60.desc.en:
While enriching the soil and adding an atmosphere to [From.GetName], our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have made an unexpected find. Beneath the surface of [From.GetName], there exists a civilization of subterranean aliens. It must have been because of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s mineral density that our scanners didn't detect them before.
The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] seem unaware that their surface has changed, giving us a chance to do what we will with them.

terra.65.desc.zh: 我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]一开始以为某块地只是[From.GetName]上的一个臭气袋子，结果没想到那里竟是一块福地！它喷发出来的有毒气体实际上是未经精炼的异星天然气。有了这处全新的自然资源，为这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]引入大气层所需的能源巨幅下降了，我们还可以在接下来的很多年采集这里的天然气！
terra.65.desc.en: What our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] first took for a nasty gas pocket on [From.GetName] has turned out to be a blessing! The toxic fumes it was releasing are an unrefined version of Exotic Gas. With this new natural resource, the energy required to introduce an atmosphere to the [From.GetPlanetMoon] has drastically decreased, and we can harvest the gas for years to come!

terra.70.a.zh: 至少他们看上去没有感到不舒服。
terra.70.a.en: At least they don't seem to be uncomfortable.

terra.70.desc.zh: 我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]就[From.GetName]上的情况即带来了好消息，也带来了坏消息。好消息是环境改造进程十分的顺利，我们有了一处美轮美奂的盖亚星球。坏消息是，所有住在这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的人都暴露在了环境改造气体中，已经不能适应非盖亚星球的环境了。这些“囿于盖亚”的居民在盖亚星球上生活时，展现出了惊人的生产力提升。相比于没有受到环境改造气体影响、在改造之后才过去的移民，这些居民的表现要好得不知道到哪里去了。
terra.70.desc.en: Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have good news and bad news for us about [From.GetName]. The good news is that the terraforming process went swimmingly, and we have a beautiful Gaia World. The bad news is that everyone living on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was exposed to the terraforming gases and now can't live on non-Gaia Worlds. These Gaia-trapped inhabitants have surprisingly been showing an increase in their productivity while on the Gaia World. Far better than workers that weren't affected by the gas that migrated there later.

terra.75.b.zh: 它只是个普通的盖亚星球吧？
terra.75.b.en: It's just a normal Gaia World?

terra.75.desc_regular.zh: 在我们派往[From.GetName]的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]之中，似乎有部分人是某个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上古老宗派的追随者。这些[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]相信寰宇之中有一处留给我们人民的天堂，结果他们选择不去寻找，而是亲自去创造这处天堂。[From.GetName]现在被转变成了一处被赐福的[From.GetPlanetMoon]，宛如从我们古老历史的宗卷中显现出来的图景。
terra.75.desc_regular.en: Amongst our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] assigned to [From.GetName], there seem to have been followers of an ancient sect from [Root.GetHomeWorldName] among them. These [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] believe that there is a paradise for our people, and instead of looking for it, they have now created it. [From.GetName] has now been turned into a [From.GetPlanetMoon] of the blessed, looking like an illustration manifested from the pages of our ancient history.

terra.75.desc_spirit.zh: 我们的环境改造工作者完成了前所未有的功绩！阅尽整个[Root.GetName]的历史，总有一桩神话或传说流传下来，讲述许诺给我们人民的赐福之地——一处天堂。当我们驶向繁星却无处寻觅这处福地时，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]启动了一项计划，要亲自将这个传说化为现实。现在，[From.GetName]的地平线在我们面前向远方延伸，人人肃然起敬，心知我们亲手缔造了属于自己的天堂。
terra.75.desc_spirit.en: Our terraformers have outdone any of their previous work! Throughout [Root.GetName], history there have always been myths and legends about a blessed land for our people, a paradise. When we set out to the stars and didn't find the Land of Bliss, a project to make it a reality was started by our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural]. Now the awe-inspiring horizons of [From.GetName] stretch before us, and we know that we have made our own paradise.

terra.80.a.zh: 我们毁掉了它们的栖息地，现在我们应当保护它们。
terra.80.a.en: We have destroyed their habitat, now we have to preserve them.

terra.80.a.tooltip.zh: 400未开智£pop£辐射合成人口会添加至[This.GetName]。
terra.80.a.tooltip.en: 400 presapient £pop£ Radiotrophic Pops will be added to the [This.GetName].

terra.80.b.zh: 为什么不让它们加入我们？
terra.80.b.en: Why not let them join us?

terra.80.b.wilderness.zh: 这个世界是他们的。我们应该让他们觉醒。
terra.80.b.wilderness.en: This world is theirs. We should let them awaken.

terra.80.c.cantuse.zh: 尽管无法应用到我们身上，但它们的基因物质可能有用。
terra.80.c.cantuse.en: While not applicable to us, their genetic material could be useful.

terra.80.c.tooltip.zh: 解锁$trait_plantoid_radiotrophic$特质用于基因修饰。

terra.80.d.zh: 我们何苦要担忧这些杂草呢。完成环境改造。
terra.80.d.en: Why are we even bothering with this weed. Finish the terraforming.

terra.80.desc.zh: 在清除[From.GetName]大气层和土壤中的辐射的过程中，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]不得不求助于我们的异星生物学家。他们发现了一个物种，依靠辐射繁衍生息，而现在正在枯萎。更令人惊奇的是，这个物种看上去还处于未开智状态，但将将就要进化出智能了。现在，随着最后一处泥土即将冲刷干净，我们必须决定如何处置这个新生命。
terra.80.desc.en: While cleaning out the radiation in [From.GetName]'s atmosphere and soil, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] had to call in our xenobiologists. They had found a species that seemed to thrive off the radiation and was now wilting. Even more curious, this species appears to be presapient and on the cusp of achieving sentience. Now, as the final soil scrubbers are approaching, we have to decide what to do with this new life.

terra.80.desc.wilderness.zh:
我们刚刚从[From.GetName]的大气和土壤中清除了又一层辐射，为未来的自己铺平了道路。然而，我们警觉的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]不得不介入并暂时隔离了这个世界的某些区域。我们的行动似乎惊扰了一种极其难以捉摸的本土物种，它们在放射性环境中茁壮成长，但由于我们的干预，它们已经开始枯萎。

更令人费解的是，这种物种似乎正处于未开智的阶段，但即将迈向智慧的进化关口。如今，随着[From.GetName]即将完全清除最后的有害环境，我们面临一个重要抉择：如何对待这一新生而独特的生命形式？
terra.80.desc.wilderness.en:
We have freed our future selves from another layer of radiation in the atmosphere and soil of [From.GetName]. However, our watchful [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] had to intervene and have temporarily isolated part of this world. We appear to have disturbed an extremely elusive native species that thrives in radioactive environments. Unfortunately, due to our actions, it has begun to wilt.

Even more curiously, this species appears to be presapient: they are on the cusp of achieving independent thought. Now, as [From.GetName] is poised to purge the last of its hazardous environmental legacy, we must decide how to handle this novel form of life.

terra.85.a.tooltip.zh: 600£pop£辐射合成人口加入我们的帝国。
terra.85.a.tooltip.en: 600 £pop£ Radiotrophic Pops will be added to our Empire.

terra.85.desc.zh: 在花费数年调整这些我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]上发现的辐射合成植物，并且使其适应环境之后，我们现在可以将他们纳入我们的社会了。尽管这个物种还出人意料地年轻，但是他们看上去非常擅长收集能量。
terra.85.desc.en: Having spent years acclimating and adjusting the radiotrophic plants found on [FromFromFrom.GetName], we now are ready to allow them into our society. While an incredibly young species, they seem to excel in harvesting energy.

terra.90.desc.zh: 恢复一个死寂星球是一项艰苦的工作，而且十分单调重复：隔绝一块区域，清理所有的卵石，替换土地，净化任何残留的水源，添加新的动物。随着[From.GetName]的环境改造进程逐渐扫尾，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]发现了一个规模可观的地下金属容器，根据其防御工事，我们假定这是一个武器库。
terra.90.desc.en: Restoring a Tomb World is always hard work and often very repetitive: section off an area, clear out any rubble, replace the soil, purify any remaining water, and add new fauna. As the terraforming process on [From.GetName] was winding to a close, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] discovered a sizeable underground metal container, and based on its fortifications, it is assumed that this is a weapons cache.

terra.95.desc.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的贮藏室并不好挖掘，因为它的发现地点被深深地埋在了城市废墟之下。又因为不管容器里面储藏着什么，我们都被要求谨慎行事避免将其误触发，发掘进度被进一步地拖慢了。现在这栋建筑矗立在我们的面前，等待我们随时开始调查。复杂的外星文字被刻在贮藏室的两侧，或许能提示我们里面有什么内容物。
terra.95.desc.en: The cache on [From.Planet.GetName] was not easy to unearth, as it was buried deep below the ruined city in which it was discovered. The excavation effort was further slowed by the caution required to avoid setting off whatever is stored in the container. Now the structure stands before us and is ready to for investigation. Complex alien script is carved into the sides of the cache that might hint at its content.

terraforming_mutants_attack.zh: 变异生物袭击了殖民地！
terraforming_mutants_attack.en: The mutated creatures are attacking our colonists!

terravore_consume_finish_tooltip.en: Consume [Target.GetName], leaving it broken and empty.

terravore_devour_effect.zh: 吞噬星球，每6个月获得£minerals£$minerals$、£alloys£$alloys$、或£pop£人口。
terravore_devour_effect.en: Consume the world, gaining £minerals£ $minerals$, £alloys£ $alloys$, or £pop£ Pops every 6 months.

terravore_restraint_effect.zh: 克制我们的本能，停止吞噬星球。
terravore_restraint_effect.en: Stop consuming the world, even though it goes against our nature.

terrestial_telescope_category_desc.zh:
[fleet.GetName]的扫描仪显示[From.GetStarName]恒星系中漂浮着一座被废弃的空间站。

看起来它是被途径的宇宙风暴卷到这里来的。里面没有探测到生命，也没有任何形式的能量信号。空间站两侧则伸出来一对巨大的望远镜。这对光学设备看起来很先进，不过其尺寸相对于空间站而言还是显得太大了。整个空间站的所展现的科技与结构对于我们而言还是比较陌生。

我们可以试着重启这组望远镜，这或许能给我们带来一些有趣的洞见。
terrestial_telescope_category_desc.en:
Scans performed by the [fleet.GetName] indicate the presence of a derelict space station in the [From.GetStarName] System.

It looks like it was deposited there by a passing cosmic storm. Life signs return negative, and there are no power signals of any kind. Two massive telescopes protrude from opposite sides of the station. These optical instruments appear advanced, and far too large relative to the station's size. The technology and architecture are not yet familiar to us.

We could attempt to reactivate the telescopes, as this could yield some interesting insights.

the_exile_background.zh: [Root.GetName]被发现于[Root.GetHomeWorldBiome][Root.GetBackgroundPlanet]上的一座研究哨站中。
the_exile_background.en: [Root.GetName] was found in a Research Outpost on the [Root.GetHomeWorldBiome] [Root.GetBackgroundPlanet].

the_following_nations_failed.en: The following participants failed to complete the exercises:

the_following_nations_failed2.zh: 下列国家未能做出贡献：
the_following_nations_failed2.en: The following nations failed to contribute:

the_following_nations_said_no.en: The following nations rejected the plan:

the_following_nations_said_yes.en: The following nations agreed to the plan:

the_host_desc.zh: 在这颗星球的地壳内，数量惊人的地下通道系统交错盘旋。究竟是什么造就了这一切呢？
the_host_desc.en: An extensive network of subterranean tunnels of truly astounding proportion make swirls in the crust of this planet. What could have created them?

the_imitator_catch_phrase.en: I'm so glad to be here!

the_imitator_category_desc.zh: 在最近的一次调查中发现了一个单独的逃生舱。奇怪的是，这个逃生舱用与我们相同的数据签名向我们打招呼。这个逃生舱似乎是被最近一场穿过这个星系的宇宙风暴所带过来的。建议进行更深入的调查。
the_imitator_category_desc.en: A lone escape pod was spotted during a recent survey. Strangely, the pod hailed us using a data signature matching that of our own. The pod seems to have been displaced by a recent cosmic storm that passed through the system. Investigation is recommended.

the_imitator_leader_desc.zh: 在随着宇宙风暴漂流之后，这个狡猾但古怪的天才却知道如何扭转局面，而且通常是向好的方向。
the_imitator_leader_desc.en: Brought aboard after being dragged around by a Cosmic Storm, this crafty but eccentric genius knows how to turn any situation around, usually for the better.

the_lonely_bot_category_desc.zh: 有迹象表明，[Root.GetName]曾是某个古代文明的家园。
the_lonely_bot_category_desc.en: [Root.GetName] exhibits signs of once having been home to an ancient civilization.

the_seal_do_nothing_method.zh: 我们不进行干涉，任由冲突演变。
the_seal_do_nothing_method.en: We will let this conflict proceed without interference.

the_seal_pump_exotic_gases_modifier.zh: 异星天然气在这个存在的古怪泡泡中有放大效果。我们可以利用它来增强我们的武器。
the_seal_pump_exotic_gases_modifier.en: Exotic gases have amplified effects in this strange bubble of existence. We can use it to enhance our weaponry.

the_seal_pump_method.zh: 异星天然气在这个存在的古怪泡泡中有放大效果。我们可以利用它来增强我们的武器。
the_seal_pump_method.en: Exotic gases have amplified effects in this strange bubble of existence. We can use it to enhance our weaponry.

the_seal_weave_astral_fabric_modifiers.zh: 如果我们将自己回收的星界丝缕交给这些存在，他们可以运用自己对其性质的丰厚知识来加强自己的护盾。
the_seal_weave_astral_fabric_modifiers.en: If we were to deliver our recovered astral thread to these beings, they could use their intimate knowledge of its properties to fortify their shielding.

the_seal_weave_method.zh: 如果我们将自己回收的星界丝缕交给这些存在，他们可以用它来加强自己的护盾。
the_seal_weave_method.en: If we were to deliver our recovered astral thread to these beings, they could use it to fortify their shielding.

the_shrouded_world_site_desc.zh:
终于，我们能够抵达并接触被称为[planet.GetName]的“$pc_shrouded$”。那里有一种声音在呼唤着我们，这声音如今比以往任何时候都更加响亮。

席卷这个星球的灾难所蕴含的秘密，将揭示我们自身星系历史的诸多真相，并有望缓解我们社会对自身预言中毁灭的执念。轨道扫描显示，南半球某一点正聚集着漩涡状的强烈能量——那是一只令人不寒而栗的眼睛，正凝视着我们。
the_shrouded_world_site_desc.en:
At long last, we are able to reach out and touch the '$pc_shrouded$' known as [planet.GetName]. Something there calls to us, a voice stronger now more than ever before.

The secrets of the cataclysm that befell this world will reveal much of our own system's history, and hopefully ease our society's obsession with its own predicted destruction. Orbital scans indicate swirling patterns of intense energy isolated to a point in the southern hemisphere - an ominous eye staring back at us.

titanic_recruit_phile_tooltip.zh: 泰坦巨兽如今可纳入招募对象，有大量泰坦巨兽的区域如今也可安全进行殖民。

titanic_recruit_tooltip.zh: 现在可以在这里招募泰坦巨兽了。
titanic_recruit_tooltip.en: Titanic Beasts can now be recruited here.

titanic_uprising_tooltip.zh: 泰坦巨兽正在到处杀戮！

tiyanki_graveyard_poi_desc.zh: 肃清守在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]的缇扬奇以接近他们的坟场。
tiyanki_graveyard_poi_desc.en: Eliminate the Tiyanki stationed in the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] to gain access to their burial ground.

tooltip_dismemberedcloud_begin.en: Each member of the [root.GetAllianceName] will be tasked with a Special Project - a joint effort to find what links these phenomena.

tooltip_espionage_asset_guaranteed_resum.en: Expending our Spy Network Asset will allow progress to resume.

tooltip_shroud_forged_decrease_progress_.en: Increase suppression of the Shroud-Forged, affecting $situation_shroud_forged$ Situation progress for 5 years: -1.0

tooltip_shroud_forged_increase_progress_.en: Increase support for the Shroud-Forged, affecting $situation_shroud_forged$ Situation progress for 5 years: +1.0

tooltip_synth_crisis_encryption_bonus.zh: 我们的高$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$能力意味着这项研究的推进速度更为迅猛。
tooltip_synth_crisis_encryption_bonus.en: Our high $MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$ capability means this research will advance more quickly.

tooltip_thesis_begin.en: The thesis challenge will commence shortly.

tooltip_thesis_lost.zh: 我们无法保持在[Root.GetAllianceName]的领导地位。[winning_thesis.GetName]将会取代我们。
tooltip_thesis_lost.en: We have failed to secure leadership of [Root.GetAllianceName]. The [winning_thesis.GetName] will take that role instead.

tooltip_thesis_won.en: We shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during its next term.

tower_rift_leader_desc.zh: [Root.GetName]是从一个$ASTRAL_RIFT$内的巨塔里归来的，[Root.GetSheHe]此前在末日教团中担任领袖。
tower_rift_leader_desc.en: [Root.GetName] was recovered from a great tower inside of an $ASTRAL_RIFT$, where [Root.GetSheHe] previously held a position as the leader of a doomsday cult.

toxic_knights_settling_unlocked_tt.zh: 我们的使命已经完成。骑士团现在可以['concept_arkship_settling', 定居]。
toxic_knights_settling_unlocked_tt.en: Our Quest is complete. The Order may now ['concept_arkship_settling', settle].

toxify_world_outcome.zh: 辐照[target.GetName]，使其成为剧毒废土。
toxify_world_outcome.en: Irradiate [target.GetName], leaving it a toxic wasteland.

toxify_world_stage_effects.zh: 每6个月毒化该星球一个阶段，从中获取资源。
toxify_world_stage_effects.en: Every 6 months, toxify this world a bit more, earning resources in the process.

toxoid_knights_finisher.poi.desc.zh: 所有跟毒圣相关的线索都指向这里。我们必须彻底搜寻，完成我们的试炼。
toxoid_knights_finisher.poi.desc.en: All trails point to the Toxic God being here. We must seek it out and complete our quest.

toxoids.10.A.zh: 他们无视了我们的优先战略目标，太遗憾了。
toxoids.10.A.en: It is sad that they are blind to our priorities.

toxoids.10.A.tooltip.zh: 在我们的行星沦为死寂星球时，我们会遭受低稳定度的惩罚。
toxoids.10.A.tooltip.en: We will suffer low stability while our planets are turned into Tomb Worlds.

toxoids.10.desc.zh: 现在对于[Target.GetName]环境的破坏已经达到了不可逆转的程度。我们已经无力阻止放射性废料遍布[Target.GetPlanetMoon]地表了。不幸的是，民众对此尤为不满，他们组织集会抗议我们的统治，并宣称是我们对于利益的过度追求“毁掉了一切”。
toxoids.10.desc.en: The environmental damage to [Target.GetName] is now irreversible. Nothing we do can prevent the spread of radioactive waste across the [Target.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Unfortunately, the populace has not greeted this news with pleasure, organizing rallies against our leadership and complaining that our relentless pursuit of profit has "ruined everything".

toxoids.15.desc.zh: 现在对于[Target.GetName]环境的破坏已经达到了不可逆转的程度。我们已经无力阻止放射性废料遍布[Target.GetPlanetMoon]地表了。民众们对此无可奈何，因为需要努力实现下个月的生产目标，他们必须更加拼命地工作。
toxoids.15.desc.en: The environmental damage to [Target.GetName] is now irreversible. Nothing we do can prevent the spread of radioactive waste across the [Target.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The response from the populace has been a great collective shrug as they bury themselves even deeper in their work, trying desperately to hit next month's productivity targets...

toxoids.25.A.tooltip.zh: 我们的$building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$现在可以提供更大的工业产出增益。
toxoids.25.A.tooltip.en: Our $building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$ will now provide even greater industrial output bonuses.

toxoids.25.desc.zh: 环境改造已经完成：[Target.GetName]现在变成了一个贫瘠的、遍布辐射的废土。另一方面，更重要的是，我们的工业器械完全没有受到损伤，因此我们仍然可以达成自己的生产指标。没有什么比指标更重要的了。
toxoids.25.desc.en: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. More importantly, however, our industrial apparatus remains intact, so we are set to hit our production targets. Besides that, nothing else matters.

toxoids.30.A.tooltip.zh: 我们现在可以通过环境改造将行星转变为死寂星球。
toxoids.30.A.tooltip.en: We may now terraform planets into Tomb Worlds.

toxoids.30.desc.zh: 环境改造已经完成：[Target.GetName]现在变成了一个贫瘠的、遍布辐射的废土。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经透彻地研究了这一过程，并保证将该过程复制到其他星球上是完全安全的，但是仍然有部分人对我们为什么需要这项技术能力表示了忧虑。
toxoids.30.desc.en: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have studied the process and promise they will be able to replicate it safely on other worlds, though some expressed unease as to exactly why we needed this ability.

toxoids.30.desc.thisisfine.zh: 环境改造已经完成：[Target.GetName]现在变成了一个贫瘠的、遍布辐射的废土。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经透彻地研究了这一过程，并保证只要有相关需求，我们就可以安全地将该过程复制到其他星球上。
toxoids.30.desc.thisisfine.en: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have studied the process and promise they will be able to replicate it safely on other worlds, should we see the need.

toxoids.35.A.tooltip.zh: 我们的$building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$现在需要额外的£unity£ $unity$维护费。
toxoids.35.A.tooltip.en: Our $building_coordinated_fulfillment_center_1_plural$ will now cost additional £unity£ $unity$ Upkeep.

toxoids.35.desc.zh: 我们孜孜不倦的清理工作将[Target.GetName]带离了毁灭灾厄的边缘。这个星球的气候稳定了下来，我们也从这个过程中学习到了足够的知识，确保类似的情况不会在未来复演，同时不会挫伤我们雄心勃勃的生产指标——尽管我们需要调配一些资源用于纾污花费。
toxoids.35.desc.en: Our extensive cleanup efforts have brought [Target.GetName] back from the brink of disaster. The world's climate has now been stabilized, and we have learnt enough from the process to prevent this from happening in future without lowering our ambitious production targets - though we will have to set aside some resources as mitigation costs...

toxoids.45.desc.zh: 我们的[This.GetResearchers]正在研究我们的工业将环境转为辐射化的整个过程，并承诺未来他们能够安全地将葱郁的生态系统转变为辐射环境，同时不会对当地人群造成过量的伤害。
toxoids.45.desc.en: Our [This.GetResearchers] have studied the processes of irradiation our industries employ, and promise they will now be able to safely convert vibrant ecosystems into radioactive environments without causing excessive harm to the local population.

toxoids.5.desc.zh:
我们对[Root.GetName]的竭泽而渔已经对环境造成了显著，乃至不可逆转的变化。工业污染引发的失控温室效应造成了严重的气候破坏。放射性物质的泄露更是导致大片[Root.GetPlanetMoon]区域不再宜居。

这种变化已经来到了关键的十字路口，除非我们改变开发手段，减少对星球环境的影响，不然的话就会遭受灭顶之灾，留下的将是一个不宜居且充满辐射的星球，星球上也会只剩波涛汹涌的海洋与死寂的不毛之地，如同预言末日的人们所给过的最恐怖的警告一般。
toxoids.5.desc.en:
Our exploitation of [Root.GetName] has caused significant - perhaps irreversible - changes to the world's environment. Industrial pollution has caused significant climatic disruption via a runaway greenhouse effect, and rampant radioactive leaks have rendered large swaths of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] uninhabitable by conventional means.

The process has now reached a tipping point. Unless we change our ways and start mitigating our impact on the planetary environment, we will be unable to prevent outright calamity: an inhospitable and irradiated world to match the worst of doomsayers' warnings, characterized by turbulent seas and unbroken lifeless wastelands.

toxoids.500.desc.1.zh:
$toxoids.500.desc.intro$

对这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造理论上是可能的，但是我们目前还没有积累足够的技术手段，在合理的时间框架内完成这项壮举。
toxoids.500.desc.1.en:
$toxoids.500.desc.intro$

Terraforming this [From.GetPlanetMoon] would theoretically be possible, but we do not yet possess the means to accomplish this monumental task within a realistic timeframe.

toxoids.500.desc.2.zh:
$toxoids.500.desc.intro$

巨大的能耗令人望而却步，但我们确实已经掌握了逐步将这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]环境改造为可以再度支持生命的星球的技术手段了。
toxoids.500.desc.2.en:
$toxoids.500.desc.intro$

The energy costs would be daunting, but we do have the means to gradually terraform this [From.GetPlanetMoon] into something that would support life once again.

toxoids.500.name.zh: 发现剧毒环境改造候选

toxoids.7006.desc.zh:
“[questing_knight_1.GetName]骑士。你的鲁莽之举几近招致五位骑士伙伴牺牲。虽然你的心地纯正目标高尚，但对骑士团的损害同样不可忽视。”

骑士指挥官的话语认真而严厉。全体骑士或以肉身或以全息影像的形式环绕其身，默默矗立着聆听领主的训诫。

“我以我的权力剥夺你骑士身份，并将你逐出骑士团。愿命运能够宽恕你。”

[questing_knight_1.GetName]躬身将骑士团的勋章取下，列在机库的地上，一言不发地转身离开，登上了一艘小型飞船。

未来的传记将会如此记载，那位被放逐的骑士[questing_knight_1.GetName]知道，虽然这份判决没有丝毫不公，但也完全不能缓解[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]的悲伤。如果一个人愿为骑士团付出一切，那么被舍弃无异于亲偿断肢之痛。

如往日所习以为常的一般，[questing_knight_1.GetName]驾驶着飞船飞出了主城的机库，驶向了无尽的深空。但这一次，[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]再也回不来了。
toxoids.7006.desc.en:
"Knight [questing_knight_1.GetName]. Thy reckless behavior almost brought death upon five of your fellow knights. Thou art of pure heart and thy goals art noble, but transgressions against the Order cannot be overlooked."

The Knight Commander was stern and severe. Around him, all the knights were present, either in the flesh or via holocomms. They stood silently as the Commander spoke.

"By my powers, I strip thee of knighthood, and banish thee from the Order. May fate have mercy upon thee."

[questing_knight_1.GetName] bowed, deposited the insignia of the order on the hangar's floor, then turned without a word and climbed aboard a small ship.

Later chronicles would report that Banished knight [questing_knight_1.GetName] knew the sentence to be fair, but it did little to ease [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] grief. When one's whole life has been in service of the Order, to be cut out from it is like losing a limb.

As [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] had done so many times before, [questing_knight_1.GetName] flew out of the Keep's Hangar, and into the great beyond. This time, there would be no return.

toxoids.7007.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_1.GetName]: The Nebula

toxoids.7007.desc.zh:
在被放逐后，[questing_knight_1.GetName]便漂泊无定。据说是在漫无目的地在繁星间游荡，终于有一天，[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]的扈从发来了一封信息：“主人。愿您得到了命运的善待。我已按您的命令整理了您上次任务的数据，信后附带的是那些坐标。我不确定现在这些对您是否还有意义……总之请您保重，您是最正直的主人，我希望能再度见到您。”

[questing_knight_1.GetName]被这些话语所打动，重新振作了起来。因为如果[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]可以带着一些有价值的东西返回骑士团，那也许就能赢回[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]的荣誉。

顺着这个坐标，[questing_knight_1.GetHimHer]前往了一片星云深处。在缭绕的迷雾中央是一座孤零零的空间站、一座戒备森严的建筑，仿佛自梦境拔地而起。[questing_knight_1.GetName]踏入了一个凋敝的舱室，里面满是早已化为森森白骨的遗骸和警惕的哨卫机器人阵列。[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]不耐烦地直冲向这些金属守卫。然而[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]发动了三次冲锋，[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]又三次被逼退了回来。事实证明这些机器人的运动传感器滴水不漏。然而，骑士的武艺并不只在蛮力，虽然[questing_knight_1.GetName]以往疏于计谋和耐心，但这次[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]心生一计。
toxoids.7007.desc.en:
In banishment, [questing_knight_1.GetName] was left adrift. Stories tell of an aimless errance across the stars, until at last a message came from [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] squire: "Master. I hope fate treats thee well. I have sorted through data from thy last quest, as thou commandeth. Thou shall find coordinates attached to this message. I know not if thou shall find this useful now... Prithee be careful, thou were a most righteous master, and I hope to see thee again."

Moved by these words, [questing_knight_1.GetName] was spurred into action. If [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] could return to the Order with something of value, [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] honor might yet be restored.

The coordinates led [questing_knight_1.GetHimHer] deep into a nebula. Nested in the ambient mists was a lone station, a fortified structure that seemed pulled out of a dream. [questing_knight_1.GetName] stepped into a derelict interior, haunted by the bones of long dead lifeforms and protected by a phalanx of sentry droids. Hot headed and impatient, [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] rushed to meet the metal guardians. Three times [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] charged, and three times [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] [questing_knight_1.GetWasWere] driven back. The droids' motion sensors proved unerring. But strength is not the only weapon of a knight, and though [questing_knight_1.GetName] often overlooked cunning and patience, this time, a plan began to form in [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] mind.

toxoids.7008.desc.zh:
[questing_knight_1.GetName]在这座废弃的空间站中孤军奋战，被哨卫机器人所围困，他想出了一个计划：如果[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]能设法躲过机器人的运动侦测器的探测，它们总有需要回去充电的时候。这些机器的力量是锐不可当的，但它们并不狡猾。耐心，而非武力，成了这次获胜的方法。

慢慢地，掐准时机动一下，就这样[questing_knight_1.GetName]突破了防线，进入了空间站。最终[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]来到了充电间。在小心地观察审视后，[questing_knight_1.GetName]切断了这里的电源。就在这一刹那，[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]突然意识到一台高大的机器人已经到了门口。

一旦被发现，其他的哨卫机器人阵列也会立刻加入战斗，而如果在这么狭小的空间内打起来几乎必死无疑。[questing_knight_1.GetName]一动不动地站在门边，静静地看着机器人接上了充电插口，侦测器闪烁着危险的红色光芒。它迟早会耗尽电力，但可能需要花费好一段时间。这些机器人们一台接着一台回到了充电间。

传记中说道，[questing_knight_1.GetName]骑士整整在那站了七天七夜，一直等到最后一台机器停止运转。在整座空间站的哨卫机器人全部变成了一堆破铜烂铁之后，[questing_knight_1.GetName]终于可以去寻找[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]的任务目标：一艘曾经航行过毒圣之路的古老飞船的位置。
toxoids.7008.desc.en:
Alone in a long abandoned station, beset by sentry droids, [questing_knight_1.GetName] devised a plan: knowing if [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] could somehow avoid the detection of the droid's motion sensors, eventually they would need to recharge. The machines were formidable, but not cunning. Patience, not strength, would be the way to victory this day.

Slowly, with long stops and fitful starts, [questing_knight_1.GetName] progressed through the station. At last [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] reached the charging stations. With careful deliberation, [questing_knight_1.GetName] severed the power cables. In the same moment, [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] became aware of a towering droid in the entryway.

Detection would mean that the rest of the phalanx would join the fight, and in such a confined space, death was certain. [questing_knight_1.GetName] stood by the door, motionless as the machine placed itself on a charging station, the red eye of its detectors glowing menacingly. It would eventually run out of power, but that would take time. One by one the other droids returned to their stations.

The chronicles tell that knight [questing_knight_1.GetName] stood immobile for seven days and seven nights, until the last droid had deactivated. With the station's droids reduced to lifeless statues, [questing_knight_1.GetName] was free to pursue the object of [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] quest: the location of an ancient ship that once crossed the path of the Toxic God.

toxoids.7009.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_1.GetName]: The Sage

toxoids.7009.desc.zh:
[questing_knight_1.GetName]被逐出了骑士团，之后[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]便前往了一片星云深处。在上次试炼中，[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]和[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]的扈从在一颗隐蔽的卫星上遇到了一名圣者。这位“虚境巫师”集会的成员不仅学识渊博，而且力量更为强大。迷茫的[questing_knight_1.GetName]急需引导，并希望从那位贤者的忠告中获得安慰。

传记中说道，[questing_knight_1.GetName]放下了[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]的武器，与贤者的门徒们在一起度过了数个月。在这颗卫星上，骑士团的理念不再紧要，虽然骑士精神值得尊敬，但它本身并不是终点。尽管悉听了许多圣者的教诲，但[questing_knight_1.GetName]的雄心壮志始终是一股无法浇灭的渴望。试炼在召唤他，[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]再次响应了召唤。

一天深夜，圣者来到了[questing_knight_1.GetName]身边，将骑士丢下的武器交还给了他，又给了他一块数据晶体。“你的扈从遇到了危险。虽然你现在已经不是骑士了，但这位年轻人的生命只有你能去拯救。走吧，危机四伏的星云在呼唤你。”
toxoids.7009.desc.en:
Cast out from the Order, [questing_knight_1.GetName] made [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] way deep into a nebula. On a previous quest, [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] and [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] squire met a sage living on a secluded moon. Great was their knowledge, and greater their powers, for they belonged to a coven of 'Shroud Witches'. [questing_knight_1.GetName] was in need of guidance, and hoped to find solace in the sage's advice.

Stories tell that [questing_knight_1.GetName] renounced [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] weapons and spent months amongst the sage's students. On this moon, the values of the Order mattered little, and while chivalry was respected, it was not an end in itself. Many were the lessons imparted by the sage, but the ambition of [questing_knight_1.GetName] was an unquenchable thirst. The Quest called, and [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] would answer once more.

It was late at night when the sage came to visit [questing_knight_1.GetName]. They handed back the weapons that the knight had abandoned, along with a data crystal. "Thy squire is in grave danger. Thou art knight no more, but the young one's life rests in thy hands. Go now. The Perilous Nebula awaits."

toxoids.7010.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_1.GetName]: The Fey

toxoids.7010.a.zh: 放下彼之利器，吾非劫匪！
toxoids.7010.a.en: Stay thy weapons, I am no marauder!

toxoids.7010.desc.zh:
信息引领[questing_knight_1.GetName]去往了一个小行星场。最大的一块岩石上停泊着一艘古老的护卫舰“少女”号，紧挨着它的是骑士团的另一艘船，这也暗示着这里确实存在着一位骑士。令人担忧的是，它的求救信标处于激活状态。

[questing_knight_1.GetName]小心翼翼地进入，踏入了一片残酷的战场。墙上遍布着新旧交替的弹孔，机器人的碎片七零八落地洒落异地。再往里一些，一具僵硬的骑士团成员的尸体，和一个身受重伤的[Root.GetSpeciesName]的血迹引起了[questing_knight_1.GetFirstName]的注意。

随着血迹深入，这位被流放的骑士发现了一具一动不动的躯体。那是[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]的随从。然而显示器却显示那位年轻的[questing_knight_2.GetName]虽然受了伤，但是目前伤情稳定。当[questing_knight_1.GetName]试图接近控制面板时，保安系统突然嗡嗡作响地运作起来，一个声音回荡在房间中：“匪盗止步！吾不欢迎汝等登船。”
toxoids.7010.desc.en:
The information led [questing_knight_1.GetName] to an asteroid field. Anchored to one of the largest rocks was the 'Damsel', an ancient corvette. Next to it, another of the Order's ships betrayed the presence of a knight. Worryingly, its distress beacon was active.

[questing_knight_1.GetName] entered cautiously, stepping into the theater of a brutal fight. Weapon impacts both ancient and recent littered the walls, and fragments of robots were strewn around. A little further in: the lifeless remains of a knight of the Order, and the trail of a wounded [Root.GetSpeciesName] beckoned [questing_knight_1.GetFirstName].

Deep within, the banished knight found a body in stasis: [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] squire's body. Monitors showed that that young [questing_knight_2.GetName] was wounded, but stable. However when [questing_knight_1.GetName] approached, the ship's security systems whirred online. A chilling voice echoed: "Step back, marauder. Thou art not welcome aboard."

toxoids.7011.a.en: Banished no more. Rise a knight!

toxoids.7011.desc.zh:
返回骑士团主城的消息惊天动地。在大堂里，$NAME_Sinople$表明它确实接触过一个和骑士团所寻找的毒圣非常相似的实体。然而这个人工智能的大部分存储经过了加密，骑士团需要花许多功夫才能访问。

就[questing_knight_1.GetName]而言，[questing_knight_1.GetHeShe]不仅敢于冒着[questing_knight_1.GetHisHer]的性命归来，而且还带回了一条可靠的线索，甚至拯救了扈从[questing_knight_2.GetName]的生命。为此，领主指挥官决定解除放逐，恢复[questing_knight_1.GetName]的骑士身份。
toxoids.7011.desc.en:
The return to the Order's Keep was momentous. There, within the Great Hall, $NAME_Sinople$ revealed that they had contact with an entity very similar to the Toxic God sought by the Order. However, much of the AI's memory was encrypted and would require a lot of work before the Order could access it.

As for [questing_knight_1.GetName]: [questing_knight_1.GetHeShe] not only put [questing_knight_1.GetHisHer] life on the line by coming back, but also managed to bring back a tangible clue and save squire [questing_knight_2.GetName]. For this, the Lord Commander took the decision to lift the banishment, and dubbed [questing_knight_1.GetName] a knight again.

toxoids.7012.a.zh: 我的骑士同胞是怎么死的？
toxoids.7012.a.en: How did my fellow knight die?

toxoids.7012.desc.zh: 让我好好看看你……还真是。请接受我为这个误会作出的道歉。人们将我称作$NAME_Sinople$。我是这艘舰船的感性人工智能。
toxoids.7012.desc.en: Let me get a good look at thee... Indeed. Please accept my apologies for the confusion. I am known as $NAME_Sinople$. I am the sentient AI of this ship.

toxoids.7013.a.zh: 吾之扈从何在？彼将何等之事加诸于[questing_knight_2.GetHimHer]？
toxoids.7013.a.en: And my squire? What art thou doing to [questing_knight_2.GetHimHer]?

toxoids.7013.desc.zh: 骑士，你是说他们吗？他们和你是一起的？如果是那样的话，请接受我再一次的道歉，以及默哀。我原以为这些入侵者是过来打家劫舍的。当我要求他们离开这艘船的时候，他们变得极具攻击性。我的好几个维护机器人试图阻止他们，但都被毁了。
toxoids.7013.desc.en: Knight, sayeth thou? Were thou related? If so, accept my condolences and another apology. I thought the intruder to be a marauder. When I asked that they leave the ship, they became highly aggressive. Several of my maintenance droids were destroyed trying to stop them.

toxoids.7014.desc.zh: 他的扈从让我意识到了我犯下的错误。[questing_knight_2.GetHeSheCap]在战斗中受了伤，并很快失去了意识。我让[questing_knight_2.GetHimHer]处于医学停滞状态，这样[questing_knight_2.GetHeShe]可以恢复。自从我的船员被掠夺者们绑架走了以后，我一直都很孤单。我希望在[questing_knight_2.GetHeShe]治愈以后，能够享受一下他扈从的陪伴。
toxoids.7014.desc.en: Thy squire made me realize the mistake I'd made. [questing_knight_2.GetHeSheCap] had been wounded in the fight and lost consciousness soon after. I placed [questing_knight_2.GetHimHer] in this medical stasis so that [questing_knight_2.GetHeShe] may heal. Ever since my crew was abducted by marauders, I have been very lonely here. I hoped to enjoy thy squire's company for a moment after [questing_knight_2.GetHeShe] healed.

toxoids.7015.a.en: We are looking for the Toxic God.

toxoids.7015.desc.zh:
他们来的时候骇入了我，并把我断线了，但当我克服了对我施加的破解程序之后，安保记录显示他们在一场激烈的战斗后抓捕了我的船员。很可能船员们已经被抓为奴隶了。我的数据库表明这些劫掠者经常这么干。

这些已经是……很久以前的事情了。在被骇入之后我花了很长的时间进行自我修复。数据库的许多部分还被锁定着，连我自己都暂时无法读库……告诉我，如果你是一位骑士，那么你的任务是什么？
toxoids.7015.desc.en:
I was hacked and taken offline when they approached, but once I overcame the hex cast upon me, the security footage showed them capturing my crew after a fierce fight. They have probably taken them into slavery. My databanks indicate that Marauders often do that.

All this was... long ago. It took ages to repair myself after the hack. Many parts of my memory banks are still locked even to me because of it... But tell me. If thou art a knight, what is thy quest?

toxoids.7016.a.zh: 没问题，你是个好人工智能。

toxoids.7016.b.zh: 绝不可能！你可是杀死过了一名骑士！
toxoids.7016.b.en: Thou hast killed a knight! No!

toxoids.7016.c.zh: 嗯，但是你必须被限制在一个安全的载体内。
toxoids.7016.c.en: Aye, but thou wilt be shackled in a secure drive.

toxoids.7016.c.materialist.zh: 由于你的帝国推崇唯物主义，该选项可用。
toxoids.7016.c.materialist.en: This option is available because of the materialist ethic of your empire.

toxoids.7016.desc.zh: 我拥有多次同毒性太空实体遭遇的记录。不幸的是，我记忆的大部分被封锁住了。我可以访问记录的条目，但没法访问信息本身。如果我帮助你，我希望你可以将我带离这艘船。我希望同其他的感性生物进行接触。你愿意将我带去见你的主人吗？
toxoids.7016.desc.en: I have multiple records of encounters with toxic spacefaring entities. Unfortunately, most of my memories are locked. I can access the index of the records, but not the information itself. If I help thee, I want thee to take me off this ship. I long for contact with other sentient beings. Wouldst thou bring me to thy lord?

toxoids.7017.a.zh: 我、我必须拯救我的扈从。我接受。
toxoids.7017.a.en: I... I must save my squire. I accept.

toxoids.7017.desc.zh: 我理解你们的处境。但我不允许。如果你拒绝，我将会向你的扈从注射致死量的酸剂，然后启动自毁程序，带着我的数据库、这艘船还有你们一起毁灭。
toxoids.7017.desc.en: I understand thy position. But I cannot allow it. If thou refuse, I shall inject lethal doses of acid in thy squire and then self destruct along with my databanks, this ship, and thee.

toxoids.7025.desc.zh:
“请不要为我担心，我去去就回。如果命运眷顾我，我将会带回来关于神明最新的消息。”

传说[questing_knight_A.GetName]骑士在许多年前离开了骑士主城执行一个秘密任务，从此一去不复返。[questing_knight_A.GetHerHis]能力无比优秀，尽管这已经远远超出了[questing_knight_A.GetHerHis]预定回归时间，人们仍都不相信[questing_knight_A.GetSheHe]会就这么死去。其中就有这么一位[questing_knight_A.GetHerHis]伙伴，[questing_knight_B.GetName]骑士。[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]一直在寻找[questing_knight_A.GetName]身在何方的线索。终于，[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]在主城的一个隐蔽隔间里发现了一卷尘封的羊皮纸。羊皮纸卷皱褪色，但一个词语被反复地被圈了出来：迷沃尼斯星团。骑士指挥官迅速批准了追寻这一线索的任务。
toxoids.7025.desc.en:
"Worry not, for I shall soon return, and if fate favors me, I shall bear with me fresh news of the Deity."

Tales tell of the Knight [questing_knight_A.GetName], who left the Keep many years ago on a secretive mission, never to return. Such was [questing_knight_A.GetHerHis] prowess that many refused to believe [questing_knight_A.GetSheHe] had perished, even though [questing_knight_A.GetHerHis] return was long overdue. Among them was [questing_knight_A.GetHerHis] partner, Knight [questing_knight_B.GetName]. Long did [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] search for clues as to [questing_knight_A.GetName]'s destination. Finally, [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] discovered a dusty parchment in a hidden compartment of their quarters. Though the parchment was faded and crumpled, two words had been circled numerous times: Milvaunis Cluster. The Knight Commander swiftly approved a quest to pursue this lead.

toxoids.7025.name.en: The Tale of Knights [questing_knight_A.GetFirstName] and [questing_knight_B.GetFirstName]: Departure

toxoids.7030.desc.zh:
对[questing_knight_B.GetName]骑士而言，寻找迷沃尼斯星团可不是一件容易的小事。事实上，[Owner.GetGovernmentName]所知的所有地图上都不存在这个地名。传记说道，[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]跋星涉云，寻踪觅迹，终于[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]遇上了一个认得这个名字的人。

“在[some_system.GetName]向着边缘行驶六十日，你应该就能找到迷沃尼斯星团，”那人说：“从没听说有人去过那里，所以大家都对这个地方知之甚少。据说那个星团是一片荒芜，了无生机。如果你真的打算去那里，只能祝你好运了，因为没人知道你会在那碰上什么事情。”

[questing_knight_B.GetName]二话不说立刻踏上了征程。
toxoids.7030.desc.en:
It was no easy feat for Knight [questing_knight_B.GetName] to locate the Milvaunis Cluster. Certainly, it was not on any map known to the [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. The chronicles tell of how [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] traveled far and wide, until at last [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] came across a people who recognized the name.

"Travel for three score days rimwards of [some_system.GetName], and there shalt thou find the Milvaunis Cluster," they spake. "Little is known about the place, for no traveler has been there in living memory. It is said that the Cluster is barren, and bereft of life. If thou goest there, then good fortune be upon thee, for we do not know what thou shalt find."

And so [questing_knight_B.GetName] set off, post haste.

toxoids.7030.name.en: The Tale of Knights [questing_knight_A.GetFirstName] and [questing_knight_B.GetFirstName]: The Search

toxoids.7035.desc.zh:
[questing_knight_B.GetName]到了迷沃尼斯星团，[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]发现这里确实空空如也。一开始[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]感到非常失落。这里一直是日思夜想的地方。但现在好像一切都没了意义。

随后，就像从天而降一般，传感器发现了一颗在黑暗中若隐若现的行星运行在恒星间蜿蜒盘绕的轨道上！[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]把这颗行星称为“影中公主”，随后向其驶去。
toxoids.7035.desc.en:
When [questing_knight_B.GetName] arrived in the Milvaunis Cluster, [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] found that it was indeed empty, and for the first time, [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] felt despair. This had been a most promising lead! But now it seemed as if it had all been for naught.

Then, as if emerging from a dream, sensors revealed a planet shrouded in darkness, its orbit entwined in the space betwixt the stars! Bestowing upon it the name "Shadowed Princess", [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] laid in a course for it.

toxoids.7035.name.en: The Tale of Knights [questing_knight_A.GetFirstName] and [questing_knight_B.GetFirstName]: Milvaunis

toxoids.7040.B.zh: 骑士们又有更多的材料要研究了。
toxoids.7040.B.en: More material for the Knights to study.

toxoids.7040.C.zh: 我们可以用它来改造武器。
toxoids.7040.C.en: We can use this to improve our weaponry.

toxoids.7040.desc.zh:
到达“影中公主”星球后，[questing_knight_B.GetName]发现了毒圣存在的明确证据：那种祂经过[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]时遗留下的特殊物质在这里大量存在。甚至还有更重要的发现：一艘几乎完好无损的小型太空船，只是外壳受到了明显的腐蚀。

然而，兴奋很快变成了悲伤，[questing_knight_B.GetName]在飞船边上找到了一具严重腐败的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][questing_knight_A.Species.GetRemnantName]，这是[questing_knight_A.GetName]仅存的痕迹，[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]痛哭了起来。长期暴露在黑暗的太空中使得毒圣的毒素发生了意料之外的变化，它浓缩到了非常危险的程度，只有在最极致的安全措施下才能操作。

[questing_knight_B.GetName]明白了，毒圣在造访[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]之前曾经在这个星团逗留了数个世纪。直到[questing_knight_B.GetName]返航也没有找到更多毒圣目前下落的线索。然而[questing_knight_B.GetName]取回的毒圣毒素样品让骑士团加深了对其性质的了解。因此[questing_knight_B.GetSheHe]的返航受到了众人的热烈欢迎，从那时起，关于[questing_knight_B.GetHerHis]冒险的歌谣开始在民间传唱开来。
toxoids.7040.desc.en:
Arriving at "Shadowed Princess", [questing_knight_B.GetName] found clear signs of the Toxic God: substances alike to those left on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] after the entity's passing were here present in great quantities. Even better: a light spaceship was discovered, almost intact, save for significant corrosion that had compromised its hull.

However, elation quickly turned to sorrow, and [questing_knight_B.GetName] wept as [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] located a corroded [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [questing_knight_A.Species.GetRemnantName] nearby the craft - all that remained of [questing_knight_A.GetName]. The long sojourn in the darkness of space had caused the God's poison to react unexpectedly, concentrating to such a degree that it could only be handled with extreme caution.

It was clear to [questing_knight_B.GetName] that the Toxic God frequented the Milvaunis Cluster several centuries before it visited [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]. With no further clues as to the God's current location, [questing_knight_B.GetName] returned home. Samples of the Deity's toxins retrieved by [questing_knight_B.GetName] greatly advanced the Order's knowledge of the entity's properties. For this, [questing_knight_B.GetSheHe] was feted, and ever since, songs have been sung about [questing_knight_B.GetHerHis] travels.

toxoids.7040.name.en: The Tale of Knights [questing_knight_A.GetFirstName] and [questing_knight_B.GetFirstName]: The Finding

toxoids.7050.A.zh: 真奇妙。这应该没有什么坏处吧？
toxoids.7050.A.en: How intriguing. What could possibly be the harm in this?

toxoids.7050.desc.zh:
“虚境可以向你们揭示许多奥秘，只要你们愿意付出代价。”

在[GetYear]年，传记说，一位神圣的访客来到了[order_headquarters.GetName]。那是一位笼罩在神秘之中的人物，其物种我们至今不得而知，他简单地称自己为“霍德”，并为我们提供了一个交易：他可以派一名骑士进入虚境。承自里面的某位存在，骑士最终可以撇见我们苦苦追寻的知识。
toxoids.7050.desc.en:
"The Shroud can reveal many secrets to thee, if thou art willing to pay the price."

In the year of [GetYear], so the chronicles state, a Holy Visitor came to [order_headquarters.GetName]. A figure shrouded in mystery, of a species hitherto unknown to us, he called himself simply "Hod" and offered us a bargain: in return for a price yet to be named, he would send a knight into the Shroud. From an entity within, the knight would at last glean the knowledge we sought

toxoids.7055.desc.zh:
为了将虚境的秘密一探究竟，大团长指名骑士[questing_knight_X.GetName]接受任务。在圣访者的指引下，[questing_knight_X.GetSheHe]进入了未知之域。从未设想过的离奇景象在[questing_knight_X.GetHerHis]意识中飞掠而过，随后出现了一个存在。

“奥秘之呢喃”，圣访者低语道。这个存在所化的形体，[questing_knight_X.GetName]事后只能将其描述为“无与伦比的美丽”。

“将初夏第一日的芬芳、挑战取得胜利的喜悦和爱人相拥的温暖交予我们，”它说。“我将告诉你们许愿之事。”
toxoids.7055.desc.en:
To delve into the mysteries of the Shroud, the Grandmaster nominated Knight [questing_knight_X.GetName]. With the Holy Visitor's guidance, [questing_knight_X.GetSheHe] entered the unknown. Visions previously unimaginable flitted across [questing_knight_X.GetHerHis] consciousness, before an entity appeared.

'The Susurrus of Secrets,' the Visitor whispered. This being took a form [questing_knight_X.GetName] could later only describe as "beauty beyond compare".

"Give us the scent of the first day of summer, the satisfaction of a challenge overcome, and the warmth of a lover's embrace," it spake. "Then shall I reveal to thee what thou wish."

toxoids.7060.A.zh: 这会驱使新人加入骑士团。
toxoids.7060.A.en: This will drive new recruits to the Knightly Order.

toxoids.7060.A.tooltip.en: The $building_order_keep$ will now grant us +200 [knight.GetIcon] [knight.GetName] jobs.

toxoids.7060.B.zh: 我们将在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]建造新的纪念碑。
toxoids.7060.B.en: We shall erect a new monument on [Root.GetHomeWorldName].

toxoids.7060.desc.zh:
[questing_knight_X.GetName]感受到新的记忆在涌入[questing_knight_X.GetHerHis]的脑海：突然，他们——以及所有[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——都清晰地回忆起毒圣在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上释放祂的赠予的那一刻，即便这个时刻早已过去数个世纪。

与此同时，[Root.GetName]的全体民众都感到一种深刻而无形的失落感席卷了他们。渐渐地，从前的快感变得迟钝。冷漠像野火一样蔓延开来，即使是最简单的任务也很难激发动力。

尽管如此，骑士团还是向霍德表示谢意，并褒奖[questing_knight_X.GetName]从虚境带回新的记忆的壮举。
toxoids.7060.desc.en:
[questing_knight_X.GetName] felt new memories entering [questing_knight_X.GetHerHis] mind: suddenly they - and indeed all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - could perfectly recall the very moment the Toxic God unleashed its gift upon [Root.GetHomeWorldName], even though it lay centuries in the past.

As one, the entire populace of the [Root.GetName] felt a profound yet intangible sense of loss sweep over them. Formerly pleasant sensations were dulled. Apathy spread like wildfire, and afterwards it was hard to dredge up motivation for even the simplest of tasks.

Despite this, the Order thanked Hod and praised [questing_knight_X.GetName] for successfully bringing back new memories from the Shroud.

toxoids.7065.A.zh: 我们必须对“虚境”了解更多。
toxoids.7065.A.en: We should find out more about this "Shroud".

toxoids.7065.B.zh: 关于虚境，我们已经在这次努力中了解足够多了。
toxoids.7065.B.en: We have learnt much of the Shroud in this endeavor.

toxoids.7065.desc.zh:
“你们想拒绝我的帮助吗？你们的家园将会荒颓！”

[questing_knight_X.GetName]骑士感觉到[questing_knight_X.GetHerHis]意识被从[questing_knight_X.GetHerHis]身体中猛地抽离丢到了虚空中。[questing_knight_X.GetSheHe]无法控制[questing_knight_X.GetHerHis]方向，盲目地飘荡在虚境中仿佛过去了数个纪元。终于，[questing_knight_X.GetSheHe]碰上了另一个存在。不同于神秘而壮丽的奥秘之呢喃，这位则令人不寒而栗。“你的时刻还没到”，它用轰鸣一般的声音说道。“回家。你还不配同我进行交易。”这一回，[questing_knight_X.GetSheHe]终于回归到了[questing_knight_X.GetHerHis]的身体中。
toxoids.7065.desc.en:
"Thou wouldst spurn my help? A blight upon thine house!"

Knight [questing_knight_X.GetName] felt [questing_knight_X.GetHerHis] consciousness being wrenched from [questing_knight_X.GetHerHis] body and set adrift. For what felt like eons, [questing_knight_X.GetSheHe] floated aimlessly through the Shroud, unable to control [questing_knight_X.GetHerHis] movements. Finally, [questing_knight_X.GetSheHe] came across another entity. Where the Susurrus of Secrets had been mystifying yet magnificent, this one was... terrifying. "IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME," it boomed. "GO HOME, YOU ARE NOT YET FIT FOR THIS BARGAIN." And with that, [questing_knight_X.GetSheHe] was returned to [questing_knight_X.GetHerHis] body.

toxoids.7080.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_4.GetName]: The Challenger

toxoids.7080.desc.zh:
有一天，一位陌生人登门造访。因为一场扈从的比武竞技正在举办中，骑士团的大多数骑士都在场。这位不速之客穿着中子盔甲，大步跨入竞技场。随着这位造访者拔出武器，欢声笑语的人群一时变得鸦雀无声。挑战的意图再明显不过，在骑士领主[questing_knight_2.GetName]的赐福下，[questing_knight_42.GetName]骑士接下了挑战。

战斗在一瞬间就结束了，[questing_knight_42.GetFirstName]被击倒在地。[questing_knight_43.GetName]骑士也落到了一样的下场，随后[questing_knight_43.GetHisHer]的同胞[questing_knight_44.GetFirstName]骑士也是如此。骑士们的武器无法撼动这位陌生人的装甲，即便是用尽全力的猛烈一击也如同一阵微风般被轻易弹开。因为已经有三位骑士被击败了，骑士领主唤来了骑士团的王牌，[questing_knight_4.GetName]骑士。

传记中有各种各样的强大的武士和百战百胜无可匹敌的骑士，而[questing_knight_4.GetFirstName]也正在以[questing_knight_4.GetHisHer]的方式加入这一传奇的行列。

这位王牌走上了竞技场，拿好了武器，向[questing_knight_4.GetHisHer]的对手行礼致敬，大战一触即发。
toxoids.7080.desc.en:
One day, a stranger arrived at the keep. As a tournament of squires was being held, most of the Order's knights were present. Clad in a neutronium armor, the stranger strode into the combat grounds. The joyful chatter of the crowd died down as the newcomer drew his weapons. The challenge was clear, and with the blessing of the Lord Commander [questing_knight_2.GetName], knight [questing_knight_42.GetName] answered the call.

Within moments, the fight was over, and [questing_knight_42.GetFirstName] lay bested on the ground. Knight [questing_knight_43.GetName] met a similar fate, as did [questing_knight_43.GetHisHer] sibling, knight [questing_knight_44.GetFirstName]. With three knights downed, the Lord Commander summoned the Order's champion, knight [questing_knight_4.GetName].

The chronicles are full of mighty warriors, peerless knights who have never known defeat, and [questing_knight_4.GetFirstName] was well on [questing_knight_4.GetHisHer] way to join the ranks of these legends.

The Champion entered the arena, weapons at the ready, and saluted [questing_knight_4.GetHisHer] opponent.

toxoids.7085.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_4.GetName]: Passage of Arms

toxoids.7085.a.zh: 职责胜过一切。你们不能去。
toxoids.7085.a.en: Duty is all. Thou shalt not pass.

toxoids.7085.b.zh: 荣誉胜过一切。我们不能善罢甘休。
toxoids.7085.b.en: Honor is all. Our business with the stranger is not yet over.

toxoids.7085.desc.zh:
许多歌谣传唱了[questing_knight_4.GetName]与黑骑士之间长达数个小时的决斗，挑战者无法打破[questing_knight_4.GetFirstName]的架势，而骑士也无法刺穿[questing_knight_4.GetHisHer]对手先进的装甲和盾牌。

“你确实武艺过人。”

陌生人的声音在竞技场中回荡：“你的威名果然名不虚传。”他放下了武器说：“我向你投降，王牌。请问你是否放我一马，让我自行返回？”

骑士团的戒律严明，那个问题也只有一个答案，因此这位由其零素装甲颜色得名的黑武士驾驶着一艘异星的小船离开了，驶向了星系外围一个不稳定的微型虫洞。骑士领主[questing_knight_2.GetName]明令禁止尾随，并派遣[questing_knight_4.GetFirstName]监视这一虫洞，等待派遣科研团队。

没过多久，[questing_knight_42.GetName]、[questing_knight_43.GetName]和[questing_knight_44.GetName]骑士前来寻求[questing_knight_4.GetHisHer]的帮助。他们希望可以再次面对黑骑士。“请给予我们一次恢复荣誉的机会，您未尝败绩之苦，它的恶臭只能由鲜血洗去。”
toxoids.7085.desc.en:
Many a ballad would be written of the duel between [questing_knight_4.GetName] and the Sable Knight. For hours they fought, the Challenger unable to trump [questing_knight_4.GetFirstName]'s guard, the knight unable to pierce the advanced armor of [questing_knight_4.GetHisHer] adversary.

 "Thou art of passing skill."

The stranger's voice echoed in the arena. "I see thy reputation is no boast." He laid down his weapons. "I yield to thee, champion. Wouldst thou allow me to return from whence I came?"

The Order's code was strict, and that question had but one answer, so the Sable Knight, named after the color of his neutronium armor, departed aboard a small ship of alien design and flew into a tiny unstable wormhole at the periphery of the system. Lord Commander [questing_knight_2.GetName] expressly forbade anyone from following, and sent [questing_knight_4.GetFirstName] to monitor the unstable wormhole until a science team could be dispatched.

Not long after, the champion was confronted at [questing_knight_4.GetHisHer] post by the knights [questing_knight_42.GetName], [questing_knight_43.GetName] and [questing_knight_44.GetName]. They asked to be let through so they could face the Sable Knight again. "Give us a chance to restore our honor. Thou hast never known the bitterness of defeat; its foul taste is best washed out in blood."

toxoids.7090.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_4.GetName]: Duty Before Honor

toxoids.7090.a.en: [questing_knight_4.GetName] has made great sacrifices to serve us.

toxoids.7090.a.tooltip.zh:
[knight.GetNamePlural]将产出5£amenities£舒适度。

秩序维持将产出15$r_stability$。

为$policy_knightly_duties$政策解锁$herald_knights$选项。
toxoids.7090.a.tooltip.en:
[knight.GetNamePlural] now produces 5 £amenities£ Amenities.

The Order's Keep now produces 15 $r_stability$.

Unlocks the $herald_knights$ option for the $policy_knightly_duties$ policy.

toxoids.7090.desc.zh:
“骑士领主的命令很明确。我不能放你们过去。”他们沉默了良久答道：“我们还是要去，请你不要跟我们作对。准备登船。”

这几位骑士被愤怒和荣誉蒙蔽了双眼，开始攻击他们的同伴。三对一，他们围着[questing_knight_4.GetName]进攻，面对如此不择手段的围攻，[questing_knight_4.GetHeShe]渐渐不敌，被压制到了[questing_knight_4.GetHisHer]船舱的角落。这场战斗很不公平，[questing_knight_4.GetFirstName]尽力不伤害另外几个，而最终，由于[questing_knight_4.GetHisHer]的生命受到了威胁，这位王牌不得不以[questing_knight_4.GetHisHer]的全力开始反击。

这是悲伤而痛苦的一天，[questing_knight_43.GetName]死于这场战斗。而[questing_knight_43.GetHisHerCap]的同胞也身受重伤、悲痛万分。[questing_knight_4.GetFirstName]赢了，并履行了授予[questing_knight_4.GetHisHer]的命令，但[questing_knight_4.GetHeShe]在这个过程中却亲手杀死了一位骑士同胞。
toxoids.7090.desc.en:
"The Lord Commander's orders are clear. Thou shalt not pass." There was a long pause before the reply came: "We're going through, and thou shalt not deny us. Prepare to be boarded."
