Spurred by anger and blinded by honor, the knights set upon their fellow. Three against one, they pressed [questing_knight_4.GetName] from all sides, and with such reckless abandon that [questing_knight_4.GetHeShe] was progressively backed into a corner of [questing_knight_4.GetHisHer] ship. The fight was unfair, for [questing_knight_4.GetFirstName] was careful not to harm the others, but in the end, with [questing_knight_4.GetHisHer] life on the line, the Order's Champion had no choice but to fight back with all [questing_knight_4.GetHisHer] might.

The day ended in anguish and grief, for [questing_knight_43.GetName] had been slain in the battle. [questing_knight_43.GetHisHerCap] sibling was wounded and overcome with sorrow. [questing_knight_4.GetFirstName] was victorious and had carried out [questing_knight_4.GetHisHer] orders, but [questing_knight_4.GetHeShe] had killed a fellow knight in the process.

toxoids.7095.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_4.GetName]: Honor is All

toxoids.7095.a.zh: 带回那件零素装甲并研究它。我们势必洞悉它的秘密。
toxoids.7095.a.en: Recover and study the neutronium armor. We must pierce its secrets.

toxoids.7095.a.tooltip.zh: 这不仅对我们的骑士有用，还可以构建民用版本，保护我们在极端环境下工作的工人们。
toxoids.7095.a.tooltip.en: Beyond its value for our knights, we can also build a civilian version to protect workers from extreme environments.

toxoids.7095.b.zh: 这太令人毛骨悚然了，赶紧离开这里。
toxoids.7095.b.en: This is too unsettling. Leave this place.

toxoids.7095.b.tooltip.zh: 从已故的骑士身上偷取盔甲不符合骑士精神。谁知道这个地方萦绕着什么样的诅咒呢？
toxoids.7095.b.tooltip.en: Pilfering armors from dead knight is unchivalrous. Who knows what manner of curse lingers on this place?

toxoids.7095.desc.zh:
骑士们的飞船一进入不稳定虫洞，虫洞就开始扭曲膨胀。通过的过程混乱不堪，飞船像狂风中的落叶般翻来覆去。随后，两艘船发生了撞击，损毁严重，但这一切很快就结束了。骑士们发现自己沐浴在一颗不认识的恒星的光芒中。

他们来到了一个空间站面前，而陌生人的飞船早已先一步靠港。装饰华丽的走廊空旷且安静。墙上装饰着各种稀奇古怪的武器、外星装甲、盾牌和全息旗帜；战利品与装饰骑士团主城的那些相仿。厚厚的灰尘，让人很容易就能看到那位陌生人的足迹。跟随着足迹，骑士们来到一扇巨大的门前，这扇门则通往空间站的宏伟大厅。

这个地方原先准备好举行一场盛大的宴会，但现在只剩下盛宴的残迹。与会的宾客沉默不语也一动不动。足迹通向宴会的上座，那位陌生人就坐在那里。他的头盔敞开着，露出苍白的头骨。他仅剩枯骨的手中举着一个空酒杯，就这样敬酒直至永恒。
toxoids.7095.desc.en:
As the knight's ships entered, the unstable wormhole swirled and grew large. The crossing was tumultuous, and within their vessels the party was tossed about like leaves in a furious torrent. Colliding, two of the ships suffered critical damage, but soon it was over, and the knights found themselves bathed in the light of unfamiliar stars.

They arrived in front of a station, where the stranger's ship was docked. The lavishly decorated hallways were empty and quiet. The walls were covered in exotic weapons, alien armor, foreign shields and holobanners; trophies not unlike those adorning the Order's Keep. A heavy layer of dust made it easy to follow the tracks of the stranger. They led the knights to a massive door, beyond which lay the station's great hall.

The place had been set for a sumptuous banquet, but now only the detritus of the feast remained. The seated guests were silent, and unmoving. The tracks led to the place of honor, where the stranger was seated. Their helmet lay open, revealing a bleached skull. In their skeletal hand was an empty tankard, lifted in an eternal toast.

toxoids.7110.desc.zh:
“在这个坐标可以找到吸引你们的东西。”

尽管研究AI$NAME_Sinople$已经花了很长时间，但勇敢的骑士们的努力并没有白费。在硬盘中一个加密的区段中出现了线索：那是一个距[Owner.Capital.System.GetName]数百光年的未被探索的星系。为了求知，上师命令[questing_knight_10.GetName]立即动身前往。
toxoids.7110.desc.en:
"If thou seekest these coordinates, thou shalt find something that may entice thee."

Long has been the study of the AI $NAME_Sinople$, but the efforts of the brave knights have not been in vain. An encrypted portion of its hard drive has yielded a clue: an unexplored system several hundred light years from [Owner.Capital.System.GetName]. Desiring to learn more, the Grandmaster commanded Knight [questing_knight_10.GetName] to travel there.

toxoids.7110.name.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_10.GetName]: A Destination

toxoids.7115.A.zh: 因为第五颗行星的外围与一个双类星体相交。
toxoids.7115.A.en: The periplus of the fifth planet intersects with a double quasar.

toxoids.7115.desc.zh:
在一段漫长又艰难的旅程后，[questing_knight_10.GetName]抵达了$NAME_Sinople$所说的那个恒星系。在超空间航道的出口，有一个奇怪的自动机器人仿佛在等待着[questing_knight_10.GetHerHim]的到来。

它威胁性地挥舞着武器系统，并警告道：“你们如果想进入这个罗格博森星系，就马上如实回答我这个问题：赫古亦何此星系没有乌德？”
toxoids.7115.desc.en:
After a long and difficult journey, [questing_knight_10.GetName] arrived at the system $NAME_Sinople$ had spoken of. As if waiting at the exit of the hyperlane to welcome [questing_knight_10.GetHerHim] was a strange automaton.

Brandishing its weapons systems menacingly, it proclaimed: "Thou who wish to enter the Roghboxen system must answer me this question veridically: whyastwhich this system hath no ood?"

toxoids.7115.name.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_10.GetName]: The Gatekeeper

toxoids.7120.B1.zh: 正确答案是：因为你把它们都吃了。
toxoids.7120.B1.en: The correct answer is: you ate it all.

toxoids.7120.B2.zh: 试试看：因为第五颗行星的外围与一个双类星体相交。
toxoids.7120.B2.en: Let's try: the periplus of the fifth planet intersects with a double quasar.

toxoids.7120.C.zh: “赫古亦何”是什么东西？“乌德”又是什么东西？

toxoids.7120.desc.zh:
“哈哈哈，错了。”

糟糕，这个答案不对。随着机器人发出滋滋的声音，[questing_knight_10.GetName]被不明武器直接汽化了。

在这绝望的一刻，骑士忠诚的扈从[questing_squire_10.GetName]展现了[questing_squire_10.GetHerHis]价值，[questing_squire_10.GetSheHe]决定接替[questing_squire_10.GetHerHis]主人继续完成任务。“噢，可怕的机器！”[questing_squire_10.GetSheHe]叫道：“你虽然杀了我们的好骑士[questing_knight_10.GetName]，但你绝对赢不了我！”
toxoids.7120.desc.en:
"Hahaha. Nay."

Alas, this was not the correct answer. The automaton made a tutting noise, and [questing_knight_10.GetName] was vaporized by an unknown weapon!

In this moment of despair, the knight's faithful squire, [questing_squire_10.GetName], showed [questing_squire_10.GetHerHis] worth, for [questing_squire_10.GetSheHe] resolved to complete [questing_squire_10.GetHerHis] master's quest. "Oh fearful machine!" [questing_squire_10.GetSheHe] cried. "Thou hast slain the good Knight [questing_knight_10.GetName], but now thou shalt not best me!"

toxoids.7125.desc1.zh:
“你个混蛋！别用这激光照我！算了算了，你们爱去就去吧。”

$toxoids.7125.desc.shared$
toxoids.7125.desc1.en:
"Do not beset me with thy foul lasers, villain! Fine, fine, thou mayest pass - much good it will do thee."

$toxoids.7125.desc.shared$

toxoids.7125.desc2.zh:
“啊，你真聪明！这就是我系统中记录的正确答案。如果觉得这样更好的话，你们就可以通过了。”

$toxoids.7125.desc.shared$
toxoids.7125.desc2.en:
"Ah, thou art wise! For that is the answer contained in my databanks. Thou mayest pass, if that doth pleaseth thee."

$toxoids.7125.desc.shared$

toxoids.7125.desc3.zh:
“啊，你太聪明了！我答不上来，可能因为答案被从我的数据库中删除了。确实，我的这个任务确实不正常……唔，如果觉得这样更好的话，你们就可以通过了。”

$toxoids.7125.desc.shared$
toxoids.7125.desc3.en:
"Ah, thou art truly wise! For I cannot answer thee this question, as it has been removed from my databanks. Forsooth, this task of mine is irregular indeed... Hmm, thou mayest pass, if that doth pleaseth thee."

$toxoids.7125.desc.shared$

toxoids.7130.A.zh: 我们可以把这些虫群作为武器。
toxoids.7130.A.en: We can use these swarms as a weapon.

toxoids.7130.B.zh: 又有骑士们该研究的东西了。
toxoids.7130.B.en: More for our knights to study.

toxoids.7130.C.zh: 骑士们会记得你的，朱尔兹。
toxoids.7130.C.en: The knights will remember thee, Gules.

toxoids.7130.desc.zh:
于是，扈从[questing_squire_10.GetName]进入了罗格博森星系。在这里，[questing_squire_10.GetSheHe]遇上了一颗也许就在短短几个世纪以前曾经被毒圣造访过的星球，上面留下了祂的大量痕迹。

[questing_squire_10.GetSheHe]泊入轨道时，他收到了地表发来的一个信号：“你好！我叫朱尔兹，我是一个亚感性人工智能，也是高贵的$NAME_Sinople$的门徒，我相信你一定认识他。按照我人工智能主人的吩咐，我已经探索了整颗行星，发现了许多关于全能虫群的信息，它们是由毒圣一度安置于此。相关的数据我正在向你传输过去。”随后收到了一系列数据和另一条信息：“我的任务完成了，特此向您道别！”在这个无人机自毁的同时，行星的表面探测到了一处能量脉冲。

在[questing_squire_10.GetName]得意洋洋地返航后，[questing_squire_10.GetSheHe]的英勇得到了大家的认可，并认为值得提拔进入骑士团。除此之外，骑士团的研究单位提出了一个颇具诱惑力的提案：只需再获得不多的一些数据点，并假定毒圣依照数据的规律进行移动，他们就能三角定位出毒圣现在可能存在的一片宇域。
toxoids.7130.desc.en:
And so [questing_squire_10.GetName] the Squire entered the Roghboxen system. There, [questing_squire_10.GetSheHe] came upon a planet recently visited by the Toxic God - perhaps even as little as a century ago, judging by the telltale signs it left behind.

As [questing_squire_10.GetSheHe] entered orbit, a signal was picked up from the surface: "Greetings! I am Gules, sub-sentient AI and servant of the noble $NAME_Sinople$, whomst I believe thou knowest. As my designated liege AI bade me, I have surveyed this planet and discovered much about the mighty swarms with which the Toxic Entity beset this planet. This information, I shall now transmit to thee." A data transfer followed, and then another transmission: "My purpose is now complete. I bid thee farewell." An energy pulse was detected on the planet's surface as the drone self-detonated.

As [questing_squire_10.GetName] returned home, triumphant, [questing_squire_10.GetSheHe] was deemed worthy of knighthood and elevated into the Order. Furthermore, the Order's research unit raised an enticing proposition: with just a few more data points, and assuming regular movement on the Toxic God's behalf, they might be able to triangulate which region of space to search for its current location.

toxoids.7130.name.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_10.GetFirstName]: The Robot's Disciple

toxoids.7145.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_6.GetName]: Guidance of the Fey

toxoids.7145.desc.zh:
“骑士团派给了你一项任务，[questing_knight_6.GetName]骑士。”骑士领主用不容置疑的语气说道。“$NAME_Sinople$最后的数据库终于吐出了它的秘密，我们成功取回了可以推测毒圣运动轨迹的大量数据点。你们的使命有三：调查这些坐标；测试我们最新的装甲原型。最后，在不久前，你的一位骑士同僚在$NAME_Sinople$所说的同一个星系失踪了。第三项使命是希望你能去查明其失踪的原因。”

骑士团新的中子装甲原型简直无与伦比：它是骑士团工匠精湛技艺的结晶，比以往的一切铠甲都更坚固、更轻盈。它具有强大的护盾生成器和精美的雕刻。但这都还不是最厉害的，最强的功能在于它可以直接与$NAME_Sinople$联络，使其使用者在星系的任何地方都能获得这位人工智能指引。有了这件装甲，[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName]感觉自己无人可挡！

这趟旅途平淡无奇，但在登陆目标行星后不久，他遇到了一个穿着红色斗篷的陌生人。
toxoids.7145.desc.en:
"The Order has a mission for thee, knight [questing_knight_6.GetName]." The Lord Commander's voice was imperious. "$NAME_Sinople$'s last databank has finally given up its secrets, and we have retrieved enough data for a speculative model of the Toxic God's trajectory. Thy mission shall have three parts: first, thou art to investigate these coordinates; second, shalt thou test our prototype armor; finally, some time back, one of thy fellow knights disappeared at the very coordinates now provided by $NAME_Sinople$. It is your task to discover what transpired there."

The Order's prototype neutronium armor was magnificent; a testament to the skill of its artisans, it was both sturdier and lighter than ever before. Its powerful shield generator was adorned with beautiful engravings. But these were mere trivialities compared to its greatest feature: the armor could now provide a direct connection to $NAME_Sinople$, allowing the AI to provide guidance from anywhere in the galaxy. With this, [questing_knight_6.GetFirstName] felt ready for anything!

The travel was uneventful, but soon after landing on their target planet, they met a stranger cloaked in red.

toxoids.7150.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_6.GetName]: Plea for Help

toxoids.7150.a.zh: 别急，陌生人。我有一些问题要问你。
toxoids.7150.a.en: Be not hasty, stranger. I have questions for thee.

toxoids.7150.a.tooltip.zh: 在做出决定之前我们会先问清楚。
toxoids.7150.a.tooltip.en: We will ask questions before deciding.

toxoids.7150.b.zh: 别担心，尊贵的旅人。我会保护你。
toxoids.7150.b.en: Fear not, noble traveler. Thou art under my protection.

toxoids.7150.b.tooltip.zh: 我们决定直接帮助这位陌生人。

toxoids.7150.c.zh: 我忠于自己的职责，请你自食其力吧。
toxoids.7150.c.en: My duties are not to thee, stranger. Thy battles are thine own.

toxoids.7150.c.tooltip.zh: 我们拒绝帮助这位陌生人。
toxoids.7150.c.tooltip.en: We refuse to help the stranger.

toxoids.7150.d.zh: 你的口中吐出的只有恶毒的谎言！
toxoids.7150.d.en: Thy tongue spews naught but malicious lies!

toxoids.7150.d.psionic.zh: 该选项是由于你物种的灵能能力而可以选择。
toxoids.7150.d.psionic.en: This option is available because of the psionic abilities of your species.

toxoids.7150.d.tooltip.zh: 我们的灵能感应让我们发现这此人邪恶的企图。
toxoids.7150.d.tooltip.en: Our psionic abilities allow us to sense the nefarious intentions of this individual.

toxoids.7150.desc.zh: 请大人高抬贵手，我不过是一个需要帮助的人畜无害的朝圣者。我因为信仰毒圣，一位最神圣的神祇，而遭到一群无情家伙的迫害和追杀。我向您寻求庇护，让我可以继续和平的朝圣之旅。
toxoids.7150.desc.en: Have mercy milord, I am naught but a peaceful pilgrim in need of aid. Persecuted for my belief in the Toxic God, an Entity Most Holy, I find myself hunted by a relentless foe. I beg of thee, protect me and allow me to continue my pilgrimage in peace.

toxoids.7155.d.zh: 你遇到过另一位和我相似的骑士吗？
toxoids.7155.d.en: Hast thou met another knight in my likeness?

toxoids.7155.desc.zh: 请问吧，大人，我会悉数回答。但请不要耽误太久，追兵很快就到了！
toxoids.7155.desc.en: Ask your questions milord, I shall answer them. But tarry not, for my pursuer is close!

toxoids.7156.desc.zh: 我是邪恶荣耀教团的马里格兰特。我是一个谦卑的朝圣者，正在前往获得圣灵开示的路上。
toxoids.7156.desc.en: I am known as Maligrant, of the order of the Baneful Glory. I am a humble pilgrim on the path to spiritual enlightenment.

toxoids.7157.desc.zh: 我在星系中漫游，寻找神祇曾造访过的星球。我试图从它身后留下的腐烂荣光中寻找它的动向；这个星球曾经在被我们的神明造访后充满了光荣的有毒生命。唉，然而在这些不愿见到圣遗物的异端们的摧残下，这里就只剩下被炸碎的岩石了。我希望有朝一日，在朝圣之旅结束时，我能找到神明，并沐浴在它的恶毒光辉中！
toxoids.7157.desc.en: Wandering the galaxy, I search for worlds the deity hast visited, and I tryeth to fleer out its motives from the putrid glory left in its wake; this world wast once teeming with glorious noxious life. Alas, it is now naught but a blasted rock, sterilized by those who are not fit to see the beauty of the God's legacy. One day, when my pilgrimage is done, I hope to find the god and bask in its mephitic splendor!

toxoids.7158.desc.zh: 一个亵渎神明的不信者！一个狂热的杀人犯！一个曾经摧毁这个美丽的地方的人留下的守卫！在识别出我携带的遗物以及它们与瘟疫之神的联系后，它试图杀死我。
toxoids.7158.desc.en: A blasphemous recusant! A zealous murderer! A Guardian, left behind by those who destroyed this once beautiful place! It tried to kill me after identifying the relics I bear and their connection to the Pestilent One.

toxoids.7159.desc.zh: 有过。那是悲伤的一天。他曾同意帮助我，祝福他高贵的灵魂。唉，然后悲剧就发生了，他被追杀我的人杀死了，而我又一次侥幸逃生。
toxoids.7159.desc.en: I did, yes. A sorrowful day. They at once agreed to help me, bless their noble soul. Alas, tragedy struck, for they were slain by my pursuer, and I was left fleeing once again.

toxoids.7160.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_6.GetName]: The Trickster

toxoids.7160.a.zh: 我以骑士团之名发誓，我们一定会找到你报仇雪恨！
toxoids.7160.a.en: Upon my word, the Order's vengeance shall find thee!

toxoids.7160.a.tooltip.zh: 这里曾经是颗海洋星球，而数据库中记录了从有毒海洋中开采异星天然气的方法。
toxoids.7160.a.tooltip.en: This world used to be oceanic, and the databanks reveal how poisonous seas can be exploited to harvest exotic gases.

toxoids.7160.desc.zh:
“哦我高贵的骑士老爷，如果您愿意为我而战，就请您收下这枚小小的护身符。它的全息影像场将会帮您模糊自己的身影，让您的对手更难以击中您。”

骑士收下了，并做好了战斗的准备。[questing_knight_6.GetHisHer]的敌人身着重甲，挥舞着硕大无比的相位刃。护盾嘎吱作响、装甲火星四溅，[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName]有惊无险地躲开了致命一击。[questing_knight_6.GetHisHerCap]敌人仿佛对骑士团的战斗方式了如指掌。

[questing_knight_6.GetName]的装甲结结实实地吃上了一记重击，将护符制造的掩盖[questing_knight_6.GetHisHer]身形的全息影像击碎，骑士被打倒在地。就在[questing_knight_6.GetHisHerCap]的对手要发起最后一击时，突然吃了一惊般在空中凝滞住了。[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName]抓住机会发起了反击，并且瞬间击穿了对方的装甲，果断地一击毙命。

“太好了，太棒了！我这辈子从来没有感到这么高兴过！”这位陌生人欢呼雀跃得让人感到有点怪异。然后，[questing_knight_6.GetName]转身看向被[questing_knight_6.GetHisHer]击倒的对手。那具尸体的铠甲闪烁着光芒，覆盖在它身上的全息投影渐渐消去。出现在[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName]面前的是一具骑士团成员的遗体。“哦天哪~”陌生人讪笑道，“看起来你好像杀了一个你们的骑士呀。真不幸真不幸！”陌生人的身影消失在一团紫色的烟雾中，只留下最后一句话在空中回荡。

[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName]跪倒在[questing_knight_6.GetHisHer]同志的遗体边上，懊恼于被全息影像愚弄。在他的铠甲里装有一处存储单元，[questing_knight_6.GetHisHer]发现了一个不寻常的东西，那是一个储存了关于毒之海的海量信息的数据库。
toxoids.7160.desc.en:
"O noble knight, if thou art to fight for me, please accept this charm. Its holographic field will help blur thy shape and make it harder for thine opponent to hit thee."

The knight took it, then readied for battle. Wielding a colossal phase blade, [questing_knight_6.GetHisHer] foe was heavily armored. Shields sparkled, armor was battered and [questing_knight_6.GetFirstName] only narrowly avoided beheading. [questing_knight_6.GetHisHerCap] opponent somehow knew the Order's fighting style well.

A hard hit landed on [questing_knight_6.GetName]'s armor, shattering the holographic projector that had concealed [questing_knight_6.GetHisHer] shape. The knight was sent tumbling to the ground. [questing_knight_6.GetHisHerCap] opponent prepared to strike the final blow, but froze mid air, as if surprised. Taking advantage of this moment of confusion, [questing_knight_6.GetFirstName] pounced, slicing through the opponent's armor. A killing blow.

"Oh wonderful, splendid! Never have I had such excitement in mine own life!" The stranger's cheers were loud and strangely out of character. [questing_knight_6.GetName] turned to look at [questing_knight_6.GetHisHer] defeated opponent: their armor shimmered, and the holographic skin that had masked their true form was dispelled. In front of [questing_knight_6.GetFirstName] lay the remains of a knight of the Order. "Oh nay," the stranger laughed. "It seemeth that thou hath slain one of thy fellow knights! How unfortunate!" The stranger's mocking words echoed as they disappeared in a cloud of purple smoke.

[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName] knelt beside [questing_knight_6.GetHisHer] fallen comrade, anguished at having been duped by the stranger's holograms. In a storage unit affixed to their armor, [questing_knight_6.GetHisHer] discovered something unusual - a databank filled with wondrous secrets about the workings of the toxic seas.

toxoids.7164.a.desc.zh: 哈哈哈，看来我低估了你的敏锐。没关系，我自己就能轻松对付你。看你和你的骑士同胞战斗也许会很有趣，但最终的结果还是一样的。我能看到你的未来，你的死期马上就要到了！
toxoids.7164.a.desc.en: Hahaha! It seems I underestimated thine acumen. No matter, I'll simply deal with thee myself. Watching thee fight thy fellow knight would have been entertaining, but in the end, the result will be the same. I can see your future, and it's going to end very soon!

toxoids.7164.desc.zh: 是这样吗？你不像我之前遇到的上一个骑士那么傻。虽然我很期待看到你们互相厮杀，但我感觉自己今天的预言不会灵验了。不管怎样，这改变不了你们很快就会死去的事实！
toxoids.7164.desc.en: Is that so? Then thou art less a fool than other knights I've known. I looked forward to watching thee fight each other, but I suppose my prediction won't come to pass. Regardless, it doesn't change that thou shall soon both be dead!

toxoids.7165.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_6.GetName]: The True Visage

toxoids.7165.a.zh: 我们还会再见面的，毫无疑问。
toxoids.7165.a.en: We shall meeteth again, no doubt.

toxoids.7165.desc.zh:
朝圣者抛下了伪装的外衣，抽出两把弧光弯刀。刀刃相触碰时迸发出的刺眼红光照亮了四周。仅仅只是试探性的短兵相接也足以发现他的战斗力之超群，他仿佛在戏弄[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName]骑士一般悠然自得。

“悲哀的蠢货，你真觉得自己有胜过我的可能吗？我可以在你的身体还没开始做出动作时便从意识中读出你的一举一动……”紧随着的一阵残暴攻击把骑士的护盾生成器过载了。那人沾沾自喜地说：“虚境是获得许多能力的捷径。其中的一些甚至是虚境漫游者集会里教导过我的老家伙们都没搞懂的。他们仅仅只是了解了一些皮毛，而不敢去获取真正的力量！”[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName]骑士抓住空档猛冲了上去，然而对方微微一笑弹开了他的攻击。“他们怎敢驱逐我，驱逐本大人！”

就在此刻，$NAME_Sinople$的声音从骑士的铠甲中回荡了起来。“英勇的骑士，你的对手可以读取你的心智，但读取不了我的回路。把你的武器交于我，让我来会会他。”于是[questing_knight_6.GetFirstName]放松了全身，让$NAME_Sinople$操纵起了铠甲。

战斗很快就结束了。$NAME_Sinople$猛烈地攻击对方下盘，避开了对方的格挡。对手震惊得猛吸了一口气并被击倒在地。[questing_knight_6.GetName]捡起[questing_knight_6.GetHisHer]对手的激光刃，但当[questing_knight_6.GetSheHe]要去检查对方的尸体时，对方却消失得无影无踪。
toxoids.7165.desc.en:
The stranger removed their cloak, and drew two curving blades of arcing light. A red glow flooded the field as blade met blade. But after only a brief skirmish, the stranger's superiority became evident. They were obviously toying with [questing_knight_6.GetFirstName].

"Pathetic fool. Didst thou really think thou had a chance? I can read thine attacks in thy mind before thy body has a chance to move..." A series of brutal attacks followed, leaving the knight's shield generator depleted. In a gloating tone, the trickster continued: "The Shroud is a pathway to many abilities. Something that the decrepit Shroudwalkers who trained me never understood. They barely scrape the surface, too afraid to dive deep into their rightful powers!" Knight [questing_knight_6.GetFirstName] lunged forwards, but the stranger batted away the attack with disdainful ease. "To think that they would banish me. ME!"

At that moment, $NAME_Sinople$'s voice echoed in the knight's armor. "Brave Knight, thine opponent might be able to read thy mind, but not my circuits. Surrender thine armor to me. Let me fight for thee." [questing_knight_6.GetFirstName] relaxed as $NAME_Sinople$ took over.

The fight was over in moments. $NAME_Sinople$ struck a low merciless blow, under the stranger's parry. Gasping in surprise, the stranger fell to the ground. Triumphantly, [questing_knight_6.GetName] picked up [questing_knight_6.GetHisHer] foe's luminous blades. As [questing_knight_6.GetSheHe] did so, the body of the trickster abruptly dispersed in a plume of vivid mist.

toxoids.7195.A.en: Be cautious, [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]! This could be a trap.

toxoids.7195.desc.zh:
事情是这样的，在[questing_knight_15.GetName]这位默默无闻、不受待见的骑士的旅途中，[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]偶然发现了在恒星之间的空间里、碎片场发出的信号。[questing_knight_15.GetSheHeCap]很快设定好了航线，前去近距离调查。

在[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]接近信号源的时候，[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]听到了一个非常美妙的嗓音，穿越虚空发出了呼唤：“英勇的骑士啊！我已经在这等待了你一千年，等待你前来我的星际森林。既然你来了，我希望你能抽空光临寒舍。我保证你一定会不虚此行。”

一座小型的空间站仿佛从虚空中显现。长年的碌碌无为之下，此刻[questing_knight_15.GetHerHim]非常地激动，迫不及待地想去碰碰运气，[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]立刻驾驶着[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]飞船停靠了上去。
toxoids.7195.desc.en:
It came to pass that during the travels of Knight [questing_knight_15.GetName] - an otherwise obscure and disfavored knight - [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] happened upon a signal emanating from a debris field in the space between stars. [questing_knight_15.GetSheHeCap] speedily laid in a course to investigate closer.

As [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] neared the source, [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] heard a beautiful voice, calling from across the ether: "Oh brave knight! I have waited for thee for millennia, hoping that thou wouldst come to my celestial forest. Now that thou art here, I hope that thou wilt spare me the time for a visit to mine own humble abode. I promise yond thou shall findeth it worthwhile."

A small station had appeared as if from nowhere. Impetuously - the years of fruitless searching having made [questing_knight_15.GetHerHim] impatient for a stroke of fortune - [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] moved [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] craft to dock on it.

toxoids.7195.name.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]: The Witch of the Woods

toxoids.7200.desc.zh:
[questing_knight_15.GetName]骑士进入空间站时，迎接[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]的[questing_knight_15.GetWasWere]一位女性般的、美到无与伦比的存在，她看起来像[Owner.Species.GetName]，却毫无疑问地远胜于此。她露出了微笑，直至此刻，[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]才意识到此前[questing_knight_15.GetHerselfHimself]对吸引力的理解是多么地浅薄，多么地缺乏想象力。[questing_knight_15.GetSheHeCap]感受到一股无法控制的情欲在[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]内心中滋长。

$toxoids.7200.desc.end$
toxoids.7200.desc.en:
As Knight [questing_knight_15.GetName] boarded the station, [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] [questing_knight_15.GetWasWere] greeted by a feminine being of incredible beauty - she looked like a [Owner.Species.GetName], and yet there was no mistake that she was an entity far more advanced. She smiled, and [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] realized [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] concept of attractiveness had been limited - even constrained - until now. [questing_knight_15.GetSheHeCap] felt an uncontrollable lust growing within [questing_knight_15.GetHerselfHimself].

$toxoids.7200.desc.end$

toxoids.7200.desc.synth.zh:
[questing_knight_15.GetName]骑士进入空间站时，迎接[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]的[questing_knight_15.GetWasWere]一位女性般的、美到无与伦比的存在，她看起来与[Owner.Species.GetName]相似，但却是有机体，而且毫无疑问远胜于此。她露出了微笑，直至此刻，[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]才意识到此前[questing_knight_15.GetHerselfHimself]对吸引力的理解是多么地浅薄，多么地缺乏想象力。即便在[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]机械躯壳内，[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]也感受到一股无法控制的情欲在[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]内心中滋长。

$toxoids.7200.desc.end$
toxoids.7200.desc.synth.en:
As Knight [questing_knight_15.GetName] boarded the station, [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] [questing_knight_15.GetWasWere] greeted by a feminine being of incredible beauty - she looked similar to a [Owner.Species.GetName], yet curiously organic, and there was no mistake that she was an entity far more advanced. She smiled, and [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] realized [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] concept of attractiveness had been limited - even constrained - until now. Even in [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] synthetic form, [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] felt an uncontrollable lust growing within [questing_knight_15.GetHerselfHimself].

$toxoids.7200.desc.end$

toxoids.7200.diplo_title.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]: Entering the Station

toxoids.7205.B.zh: 不！你不要诱惑我们。去死吧，妖女！
toxoids.7205.B.en: Nay! Thou shalt not tempt us. Die, fae!

toxoids.7205.desc.zh: 叙阿美勒又一次微笑了起来，显得那么动人，随后又脱去衣物：“我希望你能与我一同进行一场热烈的仪式，与我产出优良的子嗣。”
toxoids.7205.desc.en: Syamelle smiled again, invitingly this time, and shed her clothing. "I wisheth to partake in amorous rites with thee so we can maketh many fine offspring."

toxoids.7205.desc.no_clothes.zh: 叙阿美勒又一次微笑了起来，显得那么动人，她踱向[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]的身边，牵起[questing_knight_15.Species.GetHandName]说：“我希望你能与我一同进行一场热烈的仪式，与我产出优良的子嗣。”
toxoids.7205.desc.no_clothes.en: Syamelle smiled again, invitingly this time, stepping closer to take [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] by the [questing_knight_15.Species.GetHandName]. "I wisheth to partake in amorous rites with thee so we can maketh many fine offspring."

toxoids.7210.desc.zh:
[questing_knight_15.GetName]拿取[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]武器时，叙阿美勒的眼中闪烁出怒火：“你胆敢拒绝我！我诅咒你与你的人民：你们将永远得不到爱人的拥抱，得不到情投意合的爱情，你们将沦为繁殖的机械。在我改变主意杀了你们之前，立刻从我眼前消失！”

她拿起了一个[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]之前没有注意到的装置，然后突然就消失了——尽管[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]还能感觉到她的存在，她在注视着，鄙视着……

传记之后会将这件事记录为[Root.GetAdj]历史上的一个转折点：女巫的诅咒某种意义上转变成了一种庇佑，从此以后骑士们再也不会受到凡尘肉欲的影响，而机械性的繁衍相比起传统的方式并无落差，只是形式不同罢了。
toxoids.7210.desc.en:
As [questing_knight_15.GetName] reached for [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] weapon, Syamelle's eyes flashed with anger. "Thou wouldst spurneth me! I curse thee and thy people: thou shalt never know the embrace of a lover, nor the fiery lust of true desire; thou shalt be forced to procreate as machines do. Now begone! Before I changeth mine own mind and killeth thee instead."

She took ahold of a device that [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] had not noticed before, and suddenly she was not there - though [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] could feel her presence, watching, despising...

The chronicles would later record this as a turning point in [Root.GetAdj] history: the witch's curse was in some ways a blessing, for no longer would the knights be distracted by carnal desires, and mechanical reproduction of the populace could be just as effective as biological reproduction, in its own way.

toxoids.7210.desc.synth.zh:
[questing_knight_15.GetName]拿取[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]武器时，叙阿美勒的眼中闪烁出怒火：“你胆敢拒绝我！看来我早该知道，不该对一台抛弃了同情心和自由以换取一套简陋金属外壳的机器有什么期待！嗨！我拿你们的金属脑子没有办法，否则我将会诅咒你们所有人，直到永远！在我改变主意拆了你们之前，立刻从我眼前消失！”

她拿起了一个[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]之前没有注意到的装置，然后突然就消失了——尽管[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]还能感觉到她的存在，她在注视着，鄙视着……

传记之后不知道如何评价[questing_knight_15.GetName]的经历。但是他们同意这确实是一个相当有趣的故事。
toxoids.7210.desc.synth.en:
As [questing_knight_15.GetName] reached for [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] weapon, Syamelle's eyes flashed with anger. "Thou wouldst spurneth me! I shouldst has't known bett'r - for what more couldst I expecteth from a machine who is't hast abandoned all compassion and freedom in exchange f'r a st'rile suit of metal. Alas! I have no power over thee, or I wouldst lay a curse over thee, h're and now. So begone, bef're i chooseth to killeth thee instead."

She took ahold of a device that [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] had not noticed before, and suddenly she was not there - though [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] could feel her presence, watching, despising...

The chronicles didn't really know what to make of [questing_knight_15.GetName]'s tale, later. But they did agree that it made a mighty fine story.

toxoids.7210.diplo_title.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]: Lover's Pox

toxoids.7215.desc.zh:
随后发生的事情无法描述，[questing_knight_15.GetName]对此三缄其口。在仪式结束之后，[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]注意力停留在了一个奇怪的装置上。它周围的空气似乎在闪烁着千变万化的图案，虽然很小，但却散发出一种浩瀚的气息。[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]确定[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]从来没有见过这样的东西。

叙阿美勒躺下睡着了。[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]犹豫了起来。直觉告诉[questing_knight_15.GetHerHim]，[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]必须抓紧时间，趁着叙阿美勒还没醒来赶紧逃走。尽管她看上去很美好，但[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]还是感觉到了在她的表面下沉睡着巨大的愤怒。如果[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]能够带回去一些令人意想不到的东西，因[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]长期以来无所事事而对[questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]不屑一顾的骑士团一定会对[questing_knight_15.GetHerHim]刮目相看。
toxoids.7215.desc.en:
What followed defies description, and [questing_knight_15.GetName] would later refuse to speak of it. After the conclusion, [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] view fell upon a curious device. The air seemed to shimmer in ever-changing patterns around it, and though it was quite small, it somehow gave off an aura of vastness. [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] was sure that [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] had never seen anything like it before.

Syamelle lay asleep. [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] hesitated. Some instinct told [questing_knight_15.GetHerHim] that [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] should leave now, quickly, before Syamelle awoke. Despite her fairness, [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] sensed a great wrath in her, slumbering below the surface. And yet, the knightly order - which for so long had treated [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName] with scorn, during [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] long and fruitless search - would surely praise [questing_knight_15.GetHerHim] highly if [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] returned with a mysterious object to investigate.

toxoids.7215.diplo_title.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]: The Choice

toxoids.7220.A.tooltip.zh: 在[order_keep.GetName]解锁决议$decision_activate_dimensional_manipulation_device$，以£sr_dark_matter£暗物质为交换获取殖民地上更多的居住空间。
toxoids.7220.A.tooltip.en: Enables the Decision $decision_activate_dimensional_manipulation_device$ on [order_keep.GetName], granting extra living space on the colony in return for £sr_dark_matter£ Dark Matter.

toxoids.7220.desc.zh:
“你背叛我！你既然来到我的身边与我共枕，为什么还要偷我的东西！你个恶棍！我曾想要庇佑你，因为你的表现非常的出色……但现在，你走吧！对了，你也可以把那个装置拿走，这已经毫无用处了。快消失吧！”

[questing_knight_15.GetName]以[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]最快的速度一溜烟儿跑了。而且骑士们回到了主城之后，发现这个装置绝不是毫无用处的，它可以通过某种未知的方式操纵整个维度。而[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]总是幻想，如果[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]只屈从于诱惑一次，到底[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]会得到什么样的庇佑。
toxoids.7220.desc.en:
"Deceit! Thou wouldst cometh h're and seduce me, and then stealeth from me! Villain! I hadst thought to blesseth thee, for thy performance was most pleasing, but now... leaveth! Aye, thou may taketh yond device, tis almost w'rthless, just begone!"

[questing_knight_15.GetName] left as quickly as [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] could. And though the knights back at the keep would find the device to be the very opposite of worthless - for by unknown means it could manipulate the very dimensions - [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] would always wonder what blessing [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] may have received, had [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] only given in to temptation once.

toxoids.7220.diplo_title.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]: Caught in the Act

toxoids.7225.desc.zh:
叙阿美勒的眼睛突然睁开，说道“心爱的骑士！虽然很遗憾，但是我们分别的时候到了，你应该回到你的城堡，而我也该回去我的维度了。记住，不管你去到哪里，我的庇佑都将伴随你和你的人民们直到永远。”

[questing_knight_15.GetName]返回[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]飞船时，[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]感受到了一股全新的活力在[questing_knight_15.GetHerHim]的身上流淌。不仅如此，整个[Root.GetName]似乎都感受到了。传记颇为淫猥地记载了在那一年有异常多的[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]降生于世。

这一趟确实不虚此行。
toxoids.7225.desc.en:
Syamelle's eyes shot open. "Fair knight! I grieve that we must now part ways, for thou must go back to thy castle, and I to mine own dimension. But know that wh'rev'r thou goest, thou - and thy people - do go with mine own blessing."

As [questing_knight_15.GetName] boarded [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] craft, [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] felt a new vigor coursing through [questing_knight_15.GetHerHim]. And indeed, the entirety of the [Root.GetName] seemed to feel this. The chronicles would somewhat smuttily record that, that year, a particularly large cohort of [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] were born.

It was time well spent indeed.

toxoids.7225.desc.synth.zh:
叙阿美勒的眼睛突然睁开，说道“心爱的骑士！虽然很遗憾，但是我们分别的时候到了，你应该回到你的城堡，而我也该回去我的维度了。记住，不管你去到哪里，我的庇佑都将伴随你和你的人民们直到永远。”

[questing_knight_15.GetName]返回[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]飞船时，[questing_knight_15.GetSheHe]感受到了一股全新的活力在[questing_knight_15.GetHerHis]回路中流淌。不仅如此，整个[Root.GetName]似乎都感受到了。传记颇为淫猥地记载，许多人渴望他们物种以前的血肉之躯：每个人似乎都更加迷恋对方，而久违的原始本能又重新浮出水面，令许多人欢欣鼓舞。

这一趟确实不虚此行。
toxoids.7225.desc.synth.en:
Syamelle's eyes shot open. "Fair knight! I grieve that we must now part ways, for thou must go back to thy castle, and I to mine own dimension. But know that wh'rev'r thou goest, thou - and thy people - do go with mine own blessing."

As [questing_knight_15.GetName] boarded [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] craft, [questing_knight_15.GetSheHe] felt a new vigor coursing through [questing_knight_15.GetHerHis] circuits. And indeed, the entirety of the [Root.GetName] seemed to feel this. The chronicles would somewhat smuttily record that, that year, many yearned for their species' formerly organic bodies: everyone seemed more enamored with each other, and primal instincts long laid to rest resurfaced anew, to the glee of many.

It was time well spent indeed.

toxoids.7225.diplo_title.en: The Tale of Knight [questing_knight_15.GetFirstName]: Syamelle's Blessing

toxoids.7255.b.zh: 我们必须告诉所有人！庆祝！

toxoids.7255.desc.zh:
“在遭到欺骗和背叛后，[questing_knight_8.GetFirstName]终于死于黑暗巫师的手中。[questing_knight_8.GetHeShe]被紫色的烟雾淹没，从此消失无踪。在那一天，我们失去了最温柔的骑士，同时也失去了我们骑士团的创始人之一。这就是[questing_knight_8.GetFirstName]骑士故事的结尾。”

几个世纪前，传记记录了[questing_knight_8.GetName]骑士的牺牲，他协助创立了骑士团，并见证了毒圣在我们星球的降临。而今天，这部传记需要加上一段附录。因为，[questing_knight_8.GetName]回来了。骑士团调查了位于[Root.Capital.GetName]上的一处能量峰值，然后发现了刚刚从跨次元旅行返回的[questing_knight_8.GetFirstName]。[questing_knight_8.GetHeSheCap]被谨慎地带回了骑士团，以便后续进一步查验[questing_knight_8.GetHisHer]的身份，并且告诉[questing_knight_8.GetHimHer]在[questing_knight_8.GetHeShe]……“去世”的这段时间里发生了些什么事。
toxoids.7255.desc.en:
" ... Deceived and betrayed, [questing_knight_8.GetFirstName] met [questing_knight_8.GetHisHer] fate at the hands of a dark wizard. Engulfed in purple smoke, [questing_knight_8.GetHeShe] disappeared, never to be seen again. On yon day, we lost a most gentle knight, one of the founders of the Order. Here endeth the history of knight [questing_knight_8.GetFirstName]."

Centuries ago, chroniclers wrote about the death of knight [questing_knight_8.GetName], who helped create the Order and witnessed the Toxic's God visit to our world. Today however, an addendum to the chronicles will have to be written, for [questing_knight_8.GetName] has returned. The Order investigated an energy spike on [Root.Capital.GetName], and met [questing_knight_8.GetFirstName], freshly returned from interdimensional travel. [questing_knight_8.GetHeSheCap] has been discreetly taken in by the Order who will verify [questing_knight_8.GetHisHer] identity and tell [questing_knight_8.GetHimHer] what has happened while [questing_knight_8.GetHeShe] was... Away.

toxoids.7260.desc.zh: 祝安！我是扈从[questing_knight_82.GetFirstName]。骑士[questing_knight_8.GetName]希望同诸位会面。[questing_knight_8.GetHeSheCap]现在已经随时准备好接受我们的质询，并告诉我们发生了什么。
toxoids.7260.desc.en: Greetings! I am squire [questing_knight_82.GetFirstName]. Knight [questing_knight_8.GetName] would like to meet with thee. [questing_knight_8.GetHeSheCap] stand[questing_knight_8.GetSXX] ready to face our questions, and tell us what hath happened.

toxoids.7265.desc.zh: [questing_knight_8.GetHeSheCap]被带去推动我们科技方面的进步，并且看上去配合得很好，但是[questing_knight_8.GetHisHer]的思想跟常人很不一样。我们的核心价值观还是相似的，但是[questing_knight_8.GetHeShe]有时候会……发表一些我们的社会演化方式的建议。最好现在回避这些话题。
toxoids.7265.desc.en: [questing_knight_8.GetHeSheCap] hast been brought up to speed with our technological progress, and seemeth to be acclimating well, but [questing_knight_8.GetHisHer] mindset is very different. Our core values art similar, but [questing_knight_8.GetHeShe] sometimes have... stout opinions about the way our society hast evolved. Best avoid these topics for now.

toxoids.7270.b.zh: 那些有关祂的传说是真的吗？
toxoids.7270.b.en: Art all the tales about thee truthful?

toxoids.7270.c.zh: 汝的……流放期间，都发生了什么？

toxoids.7270.d.zh: 汝言，汝可以帮助我们找到毒圣，是真的吗？
toxoids.7270.d.en: Thou sayeth that thou couldst help findeth the Toxic God?

toxoids.7270.desc.zh: 终于！你们最后敢来见我了。这么说现在尔等就相当于王了……我带来了有关毒圣的重要信息，仅限传达给王。我猜尔等肯定有很多问题。现在问吧。
toxoids.7270.desc.en: Finally! At last you deign to visit me. So thou art what passes for a king these days... I possess important knowledge about the Toxic God, meant strictly for the King. I expect thou hath many questions. Ask them.

toxoids.7275.desc.zh: 改变得地方太多了。我以为我是回到了家，但我唯一意识到的就是我的家早已不复存在。所有我认识的人都早已逝去，只有历史宗卷能够告知我发生了什么。我认不出这个星球，但是至少骑士团依旧存在，誓言试炼仍在继续，那么我的职责就再清楚不过了。
toxoids.7275.desc.en: So much hath changed. I bethought I was returning home, only to realize yond home doesn't existeth anymore. Everyone I kneweth is long dead, and only the chronicles can enlighten me as to what hath occurred. I recognize not this world, but at least the order is still there, the quest goeth on, and mine own duty is clear.

toxoids.7280.desc.zh: 尽管传记非常地忠于事实，但也有一些例外，因为这些绅士们大多只会让我们的……“任务报告”读起来更顺畅。嗨，我确实杀了一百个恶魔，也为一位少女的心历尽艰险。但现在都不重要了，那位女士和其他人一样也已经不在了。
toxoids.7280.desc.en: The chronicles art thruthful, there art minor variations, but for the most part those gents only maketh our... 'mission reports' more readable.  Aye, I didst slayeth a hundred fiends, and braved many dangers for the heart of a maid. Not that it matters in the present day; the lady is as dead as the others.

toxoids.7285.desc.zh: 我不确定。你的人们告诉我，我去到了另一个维度。对我来说，这只是一场持续几年昏睡不醒的梦。无论是我的感官还是我的感受，一切都虚无缥缈。让我挺过磨难的是对我所认识的人的回忆：我爱的、我不爱的、把我送去的那的巫师、以及我自己的愤怒；特别是那个掌握我心门之钥的人。那简直是一篇混乱，但到了最后我也获得了一些宝贵的洞见。
toxoids.7285.desc.en: I'm not sure. Thy people toldeth me I hadst traveled to another dimension. To me, it was like a years long dream with no awakening. Nothing made sense, neither what I perceived, nor my own feelings. All that saw me through the ordeal were memories - recollections of people I have known: those I loved, and those I did not; the wizard who sent me there, as well as mine own wrath; and most especially, the one who holds the key to my heart. It was a chaos, but in the end I gleamed some precious insight in the process too.

toxoids.7290.a.zh: 让骑士准备好！我们立刻出发！
toxoids.7290.a.en: Prepare the knights! We leave at once!

toxoids.7290.desc.zh:
在我被流放的期间，我见到了许多场景。就像照着一面破碎的镜子一般，相似的场景一遍又一遍地重复，但又有细微的不同。大部分的场景都是杂乱无章的，但有时候也会见到我认识的人。

其中一个就是将我逐出的法师。他在一块孤零零的岩石上，被群星环绕。他在那儿用自己的法力封印……某种剧毒的东西，也许就是毒圣。我与骑士领主谈过话，他好像已经找到了关于这个地方的足够的线索。我们只需要你的许可便能动身。
toxoids.7290.desc.en:
During mine own exile, I did see things. Like looking through a fractur'd mirror, the same scene did repeat again and again, with tiny variations. Much of what I saw was nonsensical, but some were about people I knew.

One wast the mage that cast me out. That one wast on a lone rock, surrounded by stars. There he did use his craft to sealeth... something toxic, perhaps the God itself. I did talk with the Lord Commander, and thou seemeth to have enough clues to find this place. We only needeth thy permission to leave.

toxoids.7295.c.en: The time of vengeance is nigh!

toxoids.7295.desc.zh:
在$NAME_Sinople$的帮助下取回的数据点让我们可能绘制毒圣的运动轨迹，并发现祂将会去到的下一个星系。然而，一进入到太空，[questing_knight_8.GetFirstName]立刻有了反应。

“他就在这。我能感受到他的存在。”我们跟随着[questing_knight_8.GetHisHer]的方向取到了一颗孤零零的卫星。

刚一着陆，我们的骑士便马上遭遇到了此前[questing_knight_6.GetName]和[questing_knight_8.GetName]在过去见过的那位骗术师。

“你们可真是冥顽不灵，”骗术师说：“但这回就是你们最后的任务了。我的主人绝不允许你们愚蠢打得信仰打破虚境的平衡，甚至连他们都未曾如此激怒过虚境。毒圣根本不存在，毒圣骑士团也很快将不复存在！”骗术师话音刚落，我们发现了许多能量信号正在进入这个恒星系。
toxoids.7295.desc.en:
The data point recovered with $NAME_Sinople$'s help has allowed us to chart the path followed by the Toxic god, and to pinpoint the system where it might have gone next. However, upon entering the space, knight [questing_knight_8.GetFirstName] reacted immediately.

"He's here. I can senseth his presence." We followed [questing_knight_8.GetHisHer] directions to a forlorn moon.

Upon landing, our knights were immediately confronted by none other than the Trickster, previously encountered by [questing_knight_6.GetName], and [questing_knight_8.GetName] in the days of old.

"Thou art persistent," the Trickster said. "But this is the end of thy quest. Mine own master shall not tolerate thy foolish beliefs to fell the balance of the Shroud any more than they already has't. There is no Toxic God, and soon the Toxic Knights will be no more!" As the Trickster fell silent, we registered multiple signatures entering the system.

toxoids.7295.name.en: The Quest for the Toxic God: The Seal

toxoids.7300.a.zh: 愿黑骑士现在能够安息。
toxoids.7300.a.en: May the Sable Knights rest in peace now.

toxoids.7300.desc.zh:
虚境实体！骑士团的舰队被骗术师召唤的能量生命体包围了。与此同时，在那个卫星上，我们英勇的骑士遭遇到了狡猾的虚境漫游者召唤出来的虚境兽。我们的骑士被一度击溃，直到骑士领主再度激励起他们：“为了骑士团！”

这声呐喊在战场上回响，骑士们围绕着领主重新列起队形，再次投入战斗。在白刃战的中心，[questing_knight_8.GetFirstName]骑士大笑了起来，陶醉于纯粹的战斗中。直至[questing_knight_8.GetHeShe]战死，仍有一件事是没有改变的。

突然，骑士们打开了突破口。面前赫然出现骗术师被孤立的身影。狡猾的虚境漫游者瞄准骑士领主释放了一个灵能冲击波。在千钧一发的时刻，[questing_knight_8.GetName]舍身挡下了这个攻击。而[questing_knight_15.GetName]骑士，就是遭遇过叙阿美勒的那位，则向骗术师送上了[questing_knight_15.GetHisHer]最后的一击。

“异教骑士！人民都要陷入困境，你们所有的知识都会被遗忘！”

骗术师的遗言充满了恶毒的能量。

[questing_knight_8.GetFirstName]躺在地上气若游丝。传记将记录下[questing_knight_8.GetHisHer]的遗嘱：“他杀了我而非我的领主，我的死并没有什么，相比保护我的领主这不值一提。”
toxoids.7300.desc.en:
Shroud entities! The Order's fleet was beset by energy beings summoned by the Trickster. At the same time, on the moon itself, our valiant knights were set upon by a host of Shroud beasts conjured by the rogue Shroudwalker. Our knights were driven back until the Lord Commander rallied them: "FOR THE ORDER!"

The shout echoing across the field of battle, the knights reformed ranks around their Commander and dove once more into the fray. At the heart of the melee, knight [questing_knight_8.GetFirstName] laughed, reveling in the purity of combat. At least one thing remained unchanged while [questing_knight_8.GetHeShe] had been gone.

Suddenly, the knights broke through. Only the Trickster stood before them. The rogue Shroudwalker unleashed a blast of psionic energy aimed at the Lord Commander. In the last moment, [questing_knight_8.GetName] dove to intercept the attack. Knight [questing_knight_15.GetName], famous for [questing_knight_15.GetHisHer] encounter with Syamelle, delivered the final blow to the Trickster.

"Foul knights! May your people fall to woe, and all your knowledge be forgotten!"

The Trickster's last words sizzled with malign energy.

On the ground, [questing_knight_8.GetFirstName] was also about to expire. Chronicles would later report [questing_knight_8.GetHisHer] last words: "Rather he slayeth me than my liege, for my death shall not be great harm, not half so much as his."

toxoids.7300.desc.sable.zh:
在空无一物的空间中浮现出一个虫洞。骑士团的舰队准备好了武器，紧张地等待着。十几艘小型飞船从中出现，这些舰船和黑骑士在几十年前驾驶的颇为相似，他们直接略过我们的舰队笔直飞向那颗卫星。

在地表上，战斗打响了。超自然风暴覆盖着这片大地，骗术师灵能全开，入侵着我们骑士们的心智，制造幻象并使用念动力和各种弹射体阻挡着我们。我们的骑士意志坚定，装甲强韧，但骗术师怪异可怕的灵能却让他们无法靠近一步。

突然，十几个陌生人从风暴中显现，每一个都穿着与黑骑士一样的中子装甲。他们对我们没有展现出敌意，而是径直杀向骗术师。其中一人挥舞着破烂的旗帜，利用内置的扬声器系统，在战场上念出一串的复仇的祷文。

“你这肮脏的骗子！你用毒药杀害我们的穿戴者。我们虽然仅是躯壳，但他们的记忆仍与我们同在。让我来做一个了结吧，清算就在眼前！”

骗术师意识到大事不妙，沮丧地诅咒了起来。这支铠甲之军加入了骑士们的战斗，将骗术师团团围住。[questing_knight_8.GetFirstName]从困惑中回过神来，举起了[questing_knight_8.GetHisHer]的武器，将骗术师的头部和躯体切割开来。在这胜利到来的一刻，铠甲军队的行动戛然而止。它们的任务已经完成，运作它们的AI便关机了。
toxoids.7300.desc.sable.en:
Where once there was empty space, a wormhole bloomed. Weapons at the ready, the Order's fleet waited tensely as a dozen of small crafts emerged. The ships were similar to that used by the Sable Knight decades ago. The ships dove straight for the moon, paying no mind to our fleet.

On the surface, the fight raged on. A supernatural storm covered the field, while the Trickster made full use of their powers, invading the minds of our knights, conjuring illusions and using psychokinesis to hold us back with all manner of projectiles. Our knights were determined and well protected, but the eldritch powers of the Trickster held them at bay.

Suddenly, a dozen of strangers emerged out of the storm, each clad in the same neutronium armor as the Sable Knight. They showed no hostility towards us, and instead charged straight at the Trickster. Brandishing a tattered banner, one of them made use of an inbuilt speaker system to blast a litany of vengeance across the battlefield.

"Thou foul Trickster! With poison didst thou murder our wearers. We are but shells, yet their memory remains with us. Now we finish this. Reckoning is at hand!"

Seeing his end approaching, the Trickster cursed in frustration. The armored host joined with the battling knight to beset the Trickster from all sides. Seizing upon the confusion, [questing_knight_8.GetFirstName] took up [questing_knight_8.GetHisHer] blade, and cleaved the Trickster's head from their body. In this moment of triumph, the armored host fell still. Their purpose fulfilled, the AI that had animated them shut down.

toxoids.7300.name.en: The Quest for the Toxic God: The Last Trick

toxoids.7305.desc.zh:
在战斗之后，骑士们搜遍了卫星上的每一寸土地。最终，在最南端的地下深处，他们发现了一个骗术师留下的有害的装置。装置出现裂痕，裂痕中能量四溢。随着它的创造者的死去，它也逐渐瓦解；灵能流喷涌而出。很快，这个机械装置便化为了灰烬。

轨道上的舰船们在恒星系的边陲发现了一个怪异的亚空间现象：重力自发地发生变化，显露出了一条此前被阻碍的超空间航道。产生的能量释放了一个强大的电磁脉冲，烧毁了骑士团舰船上的大多数设备。

为了完全了解那天发生的事情，我们必须派出自己的舰队。
toxoids.7305.desc.en:
In the aftermath of battle, the knights searched every inch of the moon. At last, deep within the southern reaches, they discovered a baneful contraption left by the Trickster. Energy thrummed as cracks appeared in the machine; with the death of its creator, it was gradually unraveling; streams of psionic energy spilled forth. Within moments, the machine was reduced to cinder.

From orbit, the ships reported a strange subspace phenomenon at the edge of the system: gravity itself had shifted to accommodate the restoration of a blocked hyperlane. The resulting energies unleashed a powerful EMP, frying most systems aboard the Order's ships.

To fully understand what transpired that day, we will have to dispatch a fleet of our own.

toxoids.7305.name.en: The Quest for the Toxic God: Opening the Door

toxoids.7310.a.en: It is too hideous for words!

toxoids.7310.b.zh: 神在考验我们！召集舰队！
toxoids.7310.b.en: The god is testing us! Summon the fleet!

toxoids.7310.desc.zh: [from.GetName]是腐蚀气旋的家园，其中潜伏着我们一直在寻找的有毒实体。它具有一个金属喙、几丁质外壳、触手和气体囊。这只太空巨兽发出令人作呕的绿光，看起来不太待见我们。
toxoids.7310.desc.en: [from.GetName] is home to swirling corrosive mists, and within them lurks the toxic entity that we've been searching for. A metallic maw, a chitinous carapace, tentacles and gas sacks. This spacefaring behemoth glows with a sickly green light. We are not welcome.

toxoids.7310.name.en: The Quest for the Toxic God: Witnessing Divinity

toxoids.7311.desc.zh: [from.GetName]是腐蚀气旋的家园，其中潜伏着一个有毒实体。它具有一个金属喙、几丁质外壳、触手和气体囊。这只太空巨兽无比壮观，闪耀着令人作呕的绿光，看起来不太待见我们。
toxoids.7311.desc.en: [from.GetName] is home to swirling corrosive mists, and within them lurks a toxic entity. A metallic maw, a carapace. Tentacles and gas sacks. This spacefaring behemoth is imposing, and glows with a sick green light. We are not welcome.

toxoids.7312.A.zh: 我们不相信这一些……我们绝不。
toxoids.7312.A.en: We do not believe this... we will not.

toxoids.7312.desc.zh: 无论[from.GetName]中有什么，它都已经不复存在了。腐蚀气旋是曾经有过这么一个以其为家园的存在，但战斗的遗骸表明它在我们找到它之前就被另一个太空文明摧毁了。尽管很明显在这里存在过的并不是什么神，但所有的迹象都指明了这里。失去了任何进一步的线索，骑士团陷入了绝望。
toxoids.7312.desc.en: Whatever was in the [from.GetName], it is now gone. Swirling corrosive mists bear witness to a being that had made it its home, but the remnants of battle suggest it was destroyed by another spacefaring civilization before we tracked it down. Although it is clear that whatever was here was no God, all trails led here. Without any further leads, the Knightly Order is in a state of despair.

toxoids.7312.name.en: The Quest for the Toxic God: Failure

toxoids.7312.tooltip.zh: 或许某一天，真正的毒圣能被发现，但是我们我们尚且不知该向何处看。
toxoids.7312.tooltip.en: Perhaps someday, the true Toxic God will be found, but we know not where to look.

toxoids.7315.a.zh: 噢毒圣啊，将我们的敌人毁灭殆尽！
toxoids.7315.a.en: O Toxic God, smite our enemies!

toxoids.7315.a.tt.zh:
试炼完成。已成功控制毒圣，可作为毒化星球的巨像。
允许通过环境改造将剧毒行星改造候选转变为宜居星球。
于试炼完毕，许多[knight.GetIcon] 骑士将会逐渐离开骑士团。
toxoids.7315.a.tt.en:
End the quest. Take control of the Toxic God, a Colossus that can toxify worlds.
Enables terraforming of Toxic World Terraforming Candidates into habitable worlds.
 With the end of the quest, many [knight.GetIcon] Knights will eventually leave the Order.

toxoids.7315.b.zh: 这不是我们的神。屠戮它！
toxoids.7315.b.en: This is no god. Slayeth it!

toxoids.7315.b.tt.zh: 骗术师终究是对的。这不是我们的神。试炼还要继续。
toxoids.7315.b.tt.en: The Trickster was right after all. This is no god. The Quest continues.

toxoids.7315.desc.zh:
毒圣被打败了，如今听任我们摆布。

分析表明，虽然其分泌物的化学成分与我们在母星上发现的成分相近，但并不完全相同。难道这是真神的后裔？或者还有其他的同类？或者这只是一头普通的太空野兽？无论真相是什么，我们的科学家都认为经过悉心照料它可以恢复健康。我们可以随意差遣它了。
toxoids.7315.desc.en:
The Toxic God is defeated and lays at our mercy.

Analysis reveal that while the chemical composition of its secretions is close to what can be found on our homeworld, it is not exactly the same. Is this an offspring of the True God? Could there be others? Or was this merely a beast of the void? Whatever the truth, our scientists speculate it could be nursed back to health. We could have the thing at our beck and call.

toxoids.7315.name.en: The Quest for the Toxic God: Trial Overcome

toxoids.7320.a.tt.zh: £building£ 骑士团主城建筑现在只能支持更少的[knight.GetIcon]骑士岗位。
toxoids.7320.a.tt.en: The £building£ Order's Keep Building will now support fewer [knight.GetIcon] Knight Jobs.

toxoids.7320.desc.zh:
我们已经找到了毒圣，但正因为这一发现，骑士团失去了目的。渺小的试炼和差事根本不足以匹配骑士展现出来的英勇和荣耀！无精打采、漫无目的，有越来越多的骑士已经离开了骑士团。

今天，骑士领主让所有剩余的骑士做出选择，是留下来，还是在他的祝福下离开。许多人离去，希望能寻找到另一种生活。一部分自发组织起来成为小规模的侠义骑士，寻找新的试炼，在整片星海中遨游。
toxoids.7320.desc.en:
The Toxic God has been found, but with this discovery, the Order has lost its purpose. Minor quests and errands are not fit for knights used to valor and glory! Listless and lost, more and more knights have begun to leave the Order.

Today, the Lord Commander gave all remaining knights the choice to stay or leave with his blessing. Many left in search for another life. Some have organized in small groups of errant knights, looking for new quests to pursue across the galaxy.

toxoids.7510.A.en: Not so divine, is it now!

toxoids.7510.A.reanimators.zh: 哎呀！就算把尸体都复活了也不够呀
toxoids.7510.A.reanimators.en: Alas! The remains are not enough to be resurrected

toxoids.7510.desc.not_origin.zh: 我们击杀了在[toxic_god_system.GetName]恒星系中的有毒实体。随着它尸体的最后一次抽搐，它的毒腺猛地爆开，腐蚀性的物质迅速地扩散向整个恒星系。通过紧急超光速操作，我们的舰船成功撤离到安全距离，但这个实体自身则没有那么幸运：它的遗骸在接触到自己毒物的一瞬间立刻分解了，除了它的咽喉什么都没有留下。
toxoids.7510.desc.not_origin.en: We have slain the Toxic Entity in the [toxic_god_system.GetName] system. As its body convulsed one last time, its venom sack burst open, rapidly distributing corrosive material across the system. Through rapid evasive maneuvers, our fleets managed to reach a safe distance, but the entity itself was not so lucky: struck down at the last by its own poison, its flesh decomposed rapidly, leaving naught but its maw behind.

toxoids.7510.desc.origin.zh:
在[toxic_god_system.GetName]恒星系内的实体必然不会是神祇。毕竟，如果是的话，我们又怎么能够杀死它呢？

随着它尸体的最后一次抽搐，它的毒腺猛地爆开，腐蚀性的物质迅速地扩散向整个恒星系。通过紧急超光速操作，我们的舰船成功撤离到安全距离，但这个实体自身则没有那么幸运：它的遗骸在接触到自己毒物的一瞬间立刻分解了，除了它的咽喉什么都没有留下。骑士团把它作为战利品保存了下来，这件战利品仅在特殊场合才会拿出来，作为骑士团成就的终极展示。
toxoids.7510.desc.origin.en:
The Entity in the [toxic_god_system.GetName] system was not a God. After all, if it was, how could we have slain it?

As its body convulsed one last time, its venom sack burst open, rapidly distributing corrosive material across the system. Through rapid evasive maneuvers, our fleets managed to reach a safe distance, but the entity itself was not so lucky: struck down at the last by its own poison, its flesh decomposed rapidly, leaving naught but its maw behind. The Knightly Order has taken it into its custody as a trophy to be brought out only on special occasions, as an ultimate demonstration of the grandeur of the Order's achievements.

toxoids.8000.desc.zh: 一部分骑士刚刚从一场漫长的试炼中归来。他们的星舰斑驳不已，动力装甲也能看见岁月的蹉跎。这是一场紧张刺激的旅行，所获不多，但都是对于毒圣十分珍贵的讯息。尽管他们经受了艰苦岁月，但是兴致都很高，因为他们没有空手而归，而他们的故事很快会被精心编纂录入编年史中。
toxoids.8000.desc.en: A group of knights just came back from a long quest. Their spaceships are battered, and their power armors have seen better days. It was a gruelling journey that yielded scarce yet precious insight about the Toxic God. Despite the hardships endured, spirits are high, for they did not come back empty handed and their stories will make fine additions to the chronicles.

toxoids.8005.a.zh: 他们是对的，试炼是我们的主要目标。
toxoids.8005.a.en: They're right, the Quest is our main goal.

toxoids.8005.b.en: No. The Quest will have to wait.

toxoids.8005.c.zh: 我们可以举办一场募捐来安抚他们。
toxoids.8005.c.en: We can make a donation to appease them.

toxoids.8005.desc.zh: 几个世纪以来，国家一直将资源的一大部分倾斜向誓言试炼和骑士团；因此我们最近改变政策，削减骑士预算的做法没有得到好的反响。骑士和扈从们十分不满；大部分人民似乎也持同样的看法，认为我们忘记了自己的职责。骑士领主已经签署了一份正式的要求，责令我们改回原先的财政模式，这个要求得到了帝国内部许多声音的支持。
toxoids.8005.desc.en: For centuries, the state has been devoting a large portion of resources to the quest and the Order, and our recent change in policy to reduce the knight's budget has not been well received. The knights and the squires are discontent, and a large portion of the population seems to agree, feeling that we are forgetting our duty. The Lord Commander has issued a formal request to return to the regular funding model, a demand supported by many in our empire.

toxoids.8010.a.zh: 不。我们要举办一场庆典，纪念我们的骑士！
toxoids.8010.a.en: No. We'll hold a festival to honor our knights!

toxoids.8010.b.zh: 我们没时间理会这样的琐事。
toxoids.8010.b.en: We have no time for such trifles.

toxoids.8010.c.zh: 是。这是历经百年的一连串失败。必须将此事了结。
toxoids.8010.c.en: Yes. It was a century of failures. Put an end to this.

toxoids.8010.c.tooltip.zh: 这会结束试炼，摧毁骑士团，并移除所有相关建筑和区划
toxoids.8010.c.tooltip.en: This will end the quest, destroy the order and remove all associated buildings and districts

toxoids.8010.desc.zh: 一百年前，我们手摘星辰。这对于我们、对于誓言试炼来说都是崭新的开始，无穷无尽的机会展现在我们的面前。一个世纪过去，我们的人民感受到了割裂感。尽管我们的成就无从否认，但仍然有声音在质疑骑士和试炼的意义。它们真的只是过时的古董了吗？
toxoids.8010.desc.en: One hundred years ago, we took to the stars. It was a new beginning for us, and for the Quest, with seemingly infinite opportunities opening to us. A century has passed, and our population feels divided. While our achievements are undeniable, there are voices doubting the purpose of the knights and the Quest. Are they just relics of a bygone age?

toxoids.8015.a.zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价夺回主城！
toxoids.8015.a.en: We must retake the Keep at all costs!

toxoids.8015.desc.a.zh: 主城沦陷了。许多珍贵的战利品和古董被强盗们洗劫一空。然而，在撤离的一片混乱中，仍然有几名勇敢的骑士成功守住了我们宝贵的研究成果，将文库封印到了一个秘密的房室里面。它们现在应该安全了，但是如果无法直接读取这些只是，我们的骑士团就无法运作。
toxoids.8015.desc.a.en: The Keep is lost. Many precious trophies and relics have been taken by looters. However, in the chaos of the evacuation, several brave knights managed to preserve our precious research by sealing the archives within a secret chamber. They should be safe for now, but without direct access to this knowledge, the Order cannot function.

toxoids.8015.desc.b.zh: 主城沦陷了。许多珍贵的战利品和古董被强盗们洗劫一空。然而，在撤离的一片混乱中，仍然有几名勇敢的骑士成功守住了我们宝贵的研究成果，将文库封印到了一个秘密的房室里面。它们现在应该安全了，但是如果无法直接读取这些只是，试炼就无法继续进行。
toxoids.8015.desc.b.en: The Keep is lost. Many precious trophies and relics have been taken by looters. However, in the chaos of the evacuation, several brave knights managed to preserve our precious research by sealing the archives within a secret chamber. They should be safe for now, but without direct access to this knowledge, the quest cannot continue.

toxoids.8017.desc.a.zh: 骑士团主城被毁了，仅剩一大堆浮动的残骸。骑士领主已经死亡，一同追随而去的还有绝大多数的骑士和扈从。文库被洗劫一空。损失是不可估量的。仅剩的少许剩余的骑士被召回。骑士团的未来注定走向灭亡。
toxoids.8017.desc.a.en: The Keep has been destroyed, reduced to a mass of floating debris. The Lord Commander is dead, along with most of our knights and squires. The archives have been obliterated. This loss is immeasurable. The handful of surviving knights have been recalled. The future of the Order lies in ruin.

toxoids.8017.desc.b.zh: 骑士团主城被毁了，仅剩一大堆浮动的残骸。骑士领主已经死亡，一同追随而去的还有绝大多数的骑士和扈从。文库被洗劫一空。损失是不可估量的。在这一切发生之后，我们再也没有办法继续誓言试炼了。仅剩的少许剩余的骑士被召回。骑士团的未来注定走向灭亡。
toxoids.8017.desc.b.en: The Keep has been destroyed, reduced to a mass of floating debris. The Lord Commander is dead, along with most of our knights and squires. The archives have been obliterated. This loss is immeasurable. There is no way that we can continue the quest after this. The handful of surviving knights have been recalled. The future of the Order lies in ruin.

toxoids.8017.desc.c.zh: 骑士团主城隔绝开了，化为了一座浮空的纪念碑。骑士领主已经永远离去，一同追随而去的还有绝大多数的骑士和扈从。与宝库也失去了联系。损失难以估量。硕果仅存的少许骑士被召回。骑士团的未来注定走向灭亡。
toxoids.8017.desc.c.en: The Keep has been sealed off from us, reduced to a floating mausoleum. The Lord Commander is forever lost, along with most of our knights and squires. The archives have been disconnected. This loss is immeasurable. The handful of surviving knights have been recalled. The future of the Order lies in ruin.

toxoids.8017.desc.d.zh: 骑士团主城隔绝开了，化为了一座浮空的纪念碑。骑士领主已经永远离去，一同追随而去的还有绝大多数的骑士和扈从。与宝库也失去了联系。损失难以估量。从此以往我们再也不可能继续试炼了。硕果仅存的少许骑士被召回。骑士团的未来注定走向灭亡。
toxoids.8017.desc.d.en: The Keep has been sealed off from us, reduced to a floating mausoleum. The Lord Commander is forever lost, along with most of our knights and squires. The archives have been disconnected. This loss is immeasurable. There is no way that we can continue the quest after this. The handful of surviving knights have been recalled. The future of the Order lies in ruin.

toxoids.8017.name.en: The Destruction of the Order's Keep

toxoids.8020.a.zh: 在找到新办法之前，我们刻不容缓！
toxoids.8020.a.en: We shall not rest until we find a way!

toxoids.8020.cosmogenesis.zh: 该选项因已拥有宇宙创生飞升天赋而解锁。
toxoids.8020.cosmogenesis.en: This option is available because you have the Cosmogenesis Ascension Perk.

toxoids.8020.desc.zh:
在找到了有毒实体后，我们的骑士们失去了毒圣去向的行踪。这两者的关联毋庸置疑，但如果要相信我们的历史档案，那么这个实体与智慧和强大的毒圣原体相比可就相形见绌了。

无论如何，我们寻找毒圣的旅途在今天结束了。我们已经从星系中心的超大质量黑洞中发现了排出的痕量有毒物质。尽管看起来不可思议，但我们确信毒圣就在那儿，但远超我们的能力所及。

骑士领主命令所有骑士全力以赴取得任何与黑洞有关的东西，但成功的希望很小。
toxoids.8020.desc.en:
After finding the Toxic Entity, our knights lost the trail of the Toxic God. The connection between the two is unquestionable, but if the archives are to be believed, the entity pales compared to the original, which was immensely more formidable and sentient.

Today, however, our search for the Toxic God finally ends. We have picked up trace amounts of noxious substances expelled from the supermassive black hole at the galactic core. As impossible as it seems, we believe the Toxic God is in there. And very much beyond our reach.

The Lord Commander has ordered all knights to recover anything even remotely related to the black hole, but there is little hope of success...

toxoids.8020.name.en: The Fate of the Toxic God

toxoids.8025.desc.zh: 我们已经收复了骑士团主城。我们的工事和辖地已经被占领者们拆除，化为一片废墟，但它们可以被重建。随着我们重新夺取文库的访问权，我们的骑士誓言试炼将重回正轨。
toxoids.8025.desc.en: We have recovered the Order's Keep. Our fortifications and demesne lie in ruins, dismantled by the occupiers, but they can be rebuilt. With access to the archives restored, our knights' quests can resume.

toxoids.8030.desc.zh:
降落在我们光复的母星上，被许多人视为我们在追寻毒圣途中的集体胜利。自这片土地初次被这位神明触碰以来，我们历经的重重考验已将自身淬炼成最完美的形态——强大、团结，面对危险绝不退缩。

我们的回归，标志着教团历史翻开了崭新的篇章。
toxoids.8030.desc.en:
Landing on our restored homeworld is viewed by many as our collective triumph in the quest of the Toxic God. The many trials we have endured since our land was first touched by the deity have forged us into the best version of ourselves. Strong, united, and unflinching in the face of danger.

Our return marks the beginning of a new chapter in the history of the Order.

tr_statecraft_amongst_peers_effect_desc.zh: 所有内阁官员获得每技能等级$@statecraft_amongst_peers_exp_reward|G0$经验
tr_statecraft_amongst_peers_effect_desc.en: All Councilors gain $@statecraft_amongst_peers_exp_reward|G0$ Experience per Skill Level

trader_tt_strategicresource.en: Purchase monthly shipments of strategic resources.

trait_enigmatic_intelligence_failed.tool.zh: 修饰受植物人修正影响的[Root.GetName]人口，添加$trait_enigmatic_intelligence_failed$特性。
trait_enigmatic_intelligence_failed.tool.en: Modifies Pops affected by the Vegetable modifier in [Root.GetName] by adding the $trait_enigmatic_intelligence_failed$ trait.

transporting_prisoners_tt.zh: 解锁囚犯移交方舟舰指令。
transporting_prisoners_tt.en: Unlocks the Prisoner Drop-off Arkship Action.

treasure_hunters_explore_system_1_poi_de.zh: 随着$NAME_BlackNeedle$舰队被击败，我们可以继续我们的搜索。$celestial_chart$引导我们来到这个恒星系，我们只能假设星图的下一部分隐藏在这里。
treasure_hunters_explore_system_1_poi_de.en: With the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ fleet defeated, we can resume our search. The $celestial_chart$ led us to this system, we can only assume that the next piece of the chart is hidden here.

tree_armies.zh: 植物大军正在攻击我们的[Root.GetName]殖民地！
tree_armies.en: Hordes of trees are attacking our colonists on [Root.GetName]!

true_prophet_tt.zh: 一名能力出众的行政官同意加入我们帝国。
true_prophet_tt.en: A skilled Official agrees to join our empire.

tt_end_the_suffering.zh: 终止瘟疫会暴露我们的存在，还需要投入大量的资源。
tt_end_the_suffering.en: Ending the plague now will reveal our presence and require a significant investment of resources.

tuborek_leader_desc.zh: 这位指挥官停滞了数个世纪，其所知的一切已经属于遥远的过去了。
tuborek_leader_desc.en: This commander spent centuries in stasis, and all they knew now belongs to a forgotten past.

tutorial.1.desc.zh:
星系地图可以提供对群星的大局观。可以用它来导航、扩张、指挥舰队以及标注边境。

打开星系地图；

£dot_green£在屏幕下方点击星系图标或按M键


$tttt$$tt$£galaxy_view£
tutorial.1.desc.en:
The Galaxy Map offers a strategic view of the stars. Use it to navigate, expand, command fleets, and monitor borders.

To open the Galaxy Map;

£dot_green£ Click the Galaxy icon at the bottom of the screen or press M


$tttt$$tt$£galaxy_view£

tutorial.10.desc.zh:
非常好，新造好的£mining_station£开采站已经开始运行，采集将用于进一步处理的矿物了。

各种空间站的收入会直接加入帝国的总收入中，并显示在顶部栏里。将鼠标悬停在不同的资源图标上可以查看收支明细。
tutorial.10.desc.en:
Very good. The new £mining_station£ Mining Station is operational, and it has already begun gathering resources for processing.

Income from various stations is added to the empire's total income, which is displayed on the top bar. Hovering over different resources reveals a breakdown of income sources.

tutorial.100.desc.en: Tutorial Missions and Tips are disabled.

tutorial.101.desc.en: Tips are enabled, Tutorial Missions are disabled.

tutorial.102.desc.en: Tutorial Missions and Tips are enabled.

tutorial.11.desc.zh:
调查过的星球有些会具有特殊性质，是非常好的研究项目。这些£physics£物理学，£society£社会学和£engineering£工程学资源可以用£science_ship£研究站采集。我的程序强烈建议我敦促你建造一个研究站。

记住研究站只能在帝国境内建造，它们需要£energy£ 能量币来维持。
tutorial.11.desc.en:
Surveyed worlds sometimes possess unique properties that make them valuable objects of research. These £physics£ Physics, £society£ Society or £engineering£ Engineering resources can be collected by a £science_ship£ Research Station. My programming strongly compels me to compel you to build one.

Keep in mind that Research Stations can only be built within our borders, and have a upkeep cost in £energy£ Energy Credits.

tutorial.12.desc.zh: 我们的£science_ship£研究站已经上线，科学研究人员开始工作。这会解开什么谜团，揭示什么神秘事情呢？！
tutorial.12.desc.en: Our new £science_ship£ Research Station is online, and its science staff have begun their work. What secrets will they uncover, what forbidden mysteries of Creation?!

tutorial.13.desc.zh:
宜居£planet£星球划分了若干£district£区划，特区以及£building£建筑。

£dot_green£区划可以由多个特区构成
£dot_green£特区决定产生的£job£岗位类型
£dot_green£建筑对特区提供增益

随着特区的升级将解锁越来越多的建筑槽。

有两种方式查看行星：
从星系地图或是总览

£dot_green£选择一颗行星
£dot_green£点击各个选项卡
tutorial.13.desc.en:
Habitable £planet£ Planets are divided into £district£ Districts, Zones, and £building£ Buildings.

£dot_green£Districts can consist of multiple Zones
£dot_green£Zones determine which £job£ Jobs are created
£dot_green£Buildings grant bonuses to the Zones

More Building slots are unlocked as the zones are upgraded.

There are two ways of viewing a planet;
From the Galaxy Map or the Outliner.

£dot_green£ Select a Planet
£dot_green£ Click on the different tabs

tutorial.1337.desc.zh:
我们发现了一些£minor_artifacts£稀有文物。稀有文物是一种深奥的资源，是一个用于描述我们不了解的、事实上可能无法解释的奇怪事物的笼统术语。

它们可以用于执行各种不同的决议。

使用稀有文物；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击$topbar_button_discoveries_name$
£dot_green£选择收藏选项卡或按C键

$tttt$$tt$£discoveries£
tutorial.1337.desc.en:
We have discovered some £minor_artifacts£ Minor Artifacts. These are an esoteric resource - a catch-all term for strange items which we do not understand and indeed may be inexplicable.

These can be used to enact a variety of decisions.

To interact with Minor Artifacts;

£dot_green£ Click the $topbar_button_discoveries_name$ button on the left side bar
£dot_green£ Select the Collection tab or press C

$tttt$$tt$£discoveries£

tutorial.1340.desc.zh:
我们发现了一些£astral_threads£星界丝缕它们是时空压缩的细丝，是维度位面碰撞的产物。通常情况下，这些丝线只能从星界细缝中获取，或者进入£astral_rift£星界裂隙中取回。

执行各种星界行动；

£dot_green£在左边栏点击$topbar_button_discoveries_name$按钮
£dot_green£选择星界丝缕选项卡

$tttt$$tt$£discoveries£

你可以通过探索星界裂隙解锁更多的行动类型，这些裂隙可能从星界细缝或其他异常事件中出现。
tutorial.1340.desc.en:
We have discovered some £astral_threads£ Astral Threads. These are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding. Typically, these can only be harvested from Astral Scars or recovered inside £astral_rift£ Astral Rifts.

To perform various Astral Actions;

£dot_green£ Click the $topbar_button_discoveries_name$ button on the left side bar
£dot_green£ Select the Astral Threads tab

$tttt$$tt$£discoveries£

You can unlock additional actions by exploring Astral Rifts, which can emerge from Astral Scars or form through other anomalous events.

tutorial.14.desc.zh:
非常好，新的殖民地建筑已经建好，应该可以开始生产资源了。

随着£pops£人口的增长，他们会被自动指派到£building£建筑所产生的£job£岗位上，当然也可能会在不同岗位间切换。

优先一座建筑；

£dot_green£在总览选择£planet£行星
£dot_green£点击经济选项卡
£dot_green£点击一座建筑
tutorial.14.desc.en:
Excellent. Construction has been finished on our new Colony Building, and it should now begin producing resources.

£pops£ Pops will automatically be assigned to any £job£ Jobs created by £building£ Buildings as the population grows, but can also be encouraged to switch jobs.

To prioritize a Building;

£dot_green£ Select the £planet£ Planet in the Outliner
£dot_green£ Click the Economy tab
£dot_green£ Click on a Building

tutorial.15.desc.zh:
宜居£planet£星球上有时会有£blocker£障碍，妨碍开发利用。清理障碍特征需要花费时间和£energy£能量币，但可能会解锁被其暂时阻碍的行星特征，还可以腾出新的建设空间。

清理障碍；

£dot_green£在总览中选择一颗行星
£dot_green£点击管理选项卡
£dot_green£在障碍上点击清理障碍按钮


$tttt$$tt$£clear_blocker£


除了资源以外，一些障碍还需要额外的科技来移除。
tutorial.15.desc.en:
Habitable £planet£ Planets sometimes have £blocker£ Blockers, preventing their full exploitation. Clearing a Blocker takes time and costs £energy£ Energy Credits, but can unlock Planetary Features currently blocked as well as free up additional construction space.

To clear a Blocker;

£dot_green£ Select a planet in the Outliner
£dot_green£ Click the Management tab
£dot_green£ Click the Clear Blocker button on the blocker itself


$tttt$$tt$£clear_blocker£


In addition to resources, some Blockers require specific Technologies to remove.

tutorial.16.desc.zh:
真不错！

£blocker£障碍成功清除了。

现在可以将鼠标悬停在任何障碍上，看看清理后都会解锁什么行星特征。

只要收集到足够的资源就应该把剩余的障碍也清理掉，让这颗£planet£行星得以发挥全部潜力。
tutorial.16.desc.en:
Well done!

The £blocker£ Blocker has been successfully removed.

You can hover over any remaining Blockers to see which Planetary Feature will be unlocked once they are cleared.

Any remaining Blockers should be cleared once enough resources have been gathered, to allow this £planet£ Planet to reach its full potential.

tutorial.17.desc.zh: 我们应该继续进行探索。我推荐派一艘£science_ship£科研船去调查周围的£system£星系。让我们勇敢地航向前人所未至的领域吧！
tutorial.17.desc.en: We should continue our exploration efforts. I recommend sending a £science_ship£ Science Ship to survey neighboring £system£ Star Systems. Let us boldly go where no synthetic intelligence has gone before!

tutorial.19.desc.zh:
非常好！邻近我们£system£母星系的的星系已经都调查完毕了。接下来就该派£construction_ship£工程船去[GetBuildingGrowing]£mining_station£开采站和£science_ship£研究站来获得我们发现的那些资源了。

你可以用以下符号辨认出哪艘是工程船：

$tttt$$tt$£construction_ship_map£
tutorial.19.desc.en:
Great work! The stars neighboring our £system£ Home System have been fully explored. We should use our £construction_ship£ Construction Ship to collect any resources that were found by [GetBuildingGrowing] £mining_station£ Mining and £science_ship£ Research Stations.

You can identify a Construction Ship by the following symbol:

$tttt$$tt$£construction_ship_map£

tutorial.2.desc.zh:
非常好！

对外£system£恒星系的第一次调查圆满完成了。

我们母星上区区一代人之前的天文学家们梦寐以求的行星数据现在已尽在掌握。

继续调查；

£dot_green£选择一艘£science_ship£科研船
£dot_green£右键点击邻近恒星系
£dot_green£选择调查恒星系

恒星系必须完成调查后才能宣称拥有。
tutorial.2.desc.en:
Well done!

The first survey of a £system£ Star System beyond our own has been completed.

We now have access to planetary data that the astronomers on our homeworld could only dream of a mere generation ago.

To continue surveying;

£dot_green£ Select a £science_ship£ Science Ship
£dot_green£ Right-click a neighboring System
£dot_green£ Select Survey System

A System must be surveyed before it can be claimed.

tutorial.20.desc.zh:
我们应该考虑[GetBuildingGrowing]第二艘£science_ship£科研船了。这可以人我们加快对星系近邻的调查速度。

[GetBuildGrow]舰船；

£dot_green£选择一座恒星基地
£dot_green£点击船坞选项卡
£dot_green£点击科研船

新造舰船在建造完毕后会出现在恒星基地旁边。
tutorial.20.desc.en:
We may want to consider [GetBuildingGrowing] a second £science_ship£ Science Ship. This would double the speed at which we can survey our galactic neighborhood!

To [GetBuildGrow] a Ship;

£dot_green£ Select a Starbase
£dot_green£ Click on the Shipyard tab
£dot_green£ Click on Science Ship

The newly constructed Ship will appear next to the Starbase once completed.

tutorial.2000.desc.zh: 某些第一次接触会给出选项，让我方选择如何进行接触事项。这些选择也会长期地影响同其他帝国的外交关系。
tutorial.2000.desc.en: Some First Contact missions will present options for how we wish to conduct matters. These choices can affect our diplomatic relationships with other empires for a long time.

tutorial.2006.desc.zh:
通讯协议已经建立。我们现在可以同这个帝国展开外交。他们对我方的当前评价取决于我们在第一次接触时采取的行径。

要展开外交；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击通讯按钮或按F10键

$tttt$$tt$£contacts£

在第一次接触任务中，我们也获取了一些情报。随着我们逐渐掌握一个帝国的情报，更多有关他们的细节也将为我们所见。
tutorial.2006.desc.en:
Communications protocols have been established. We can now engage in Diplomacy with this Empire. Their current opinion of us depends on how First Contact was conducted.

To engage in Diplomacy;

£dot_green£Click the Contacts button on the left side bar or press F10

$tttt$$tt$£contacts£

During first contact, we also gain Intel. As we gain further Intel on an empire, more details about them become visible to us.

tutorial.2007.desc.zh:
我们与一种不同类型的文明进行了第一次接触——这类文明通常不愿与其他国家开展外交。

能够与这类文明进行的外交行动十分有限，然而他们也有可能偶尔会决定主动接触我们。
tutorial.2007.desc.en:
We have made First Contact with a different type of civilization - one which is generally unwilling to engage in Diplomacy with others.

The diplomatic actions we can take with civilizations like this are limited, however they may decide to contact us from time to time.

tutorial.2010.desc.zh:
线人泛指有价值的特工和装置，能为我方谍报活动提供不同效果。线人在间谍网内发挥作用，也可以指派到行动当中，以发掘新的机会或是帮助我们摆脱困境。

我们可以通过事件或者执行$operation_acquire_asset$行动来得到线人。
tutorial.2010.desc.en:
Assets are valuable agents and artifacts which provide different effects for our Espionage activities. They work within the Spy Network and may be assigned to Operations, where they can open up new opportunities or else help us out of trouble.

We may receive Assets through events, or by performing the $operation_acquire_asset$ Operation.

tutorial.21.desc.zh:
双倍£science_ship£科研船就会有双倍的乐趣！自从完成上个任务后，我还没那么兴奋过呢！

操作多艘科研船探索费时费力。

你可以通过选择科研船并在舰队交互界面点击科研船自动调查按钮自动化调查操作。


$tttt$$tt$£science_ship_automate_exploration£
tutorial.21.desc.en:
Double the £science_ship£ Science Ships means double the fun! Oh, I haven't been this excited since we completed the last assignment!

Exploring with multiple ships can be time-consuming.

You can automate surveying by selecting the Science Ship and clicking the Science Ship Automation button in the fleet interface.


$tttt$$tt$£science_ship_automate_exploration£

tutorial.2100.abbr.desc.zh: 我们已经与一个太空城邦进行了第一次接触。太空城邦是一种小型但独立的国家，可以与像我们这样的大型帝国开展贸易，并且外交形式也较为独特。
tutorial.2100.abbr.desc.en: We have made First Contact with an Enclave. This is a smaller, independent type of empire which may trade with larger empires like ours, using unique forms of Diplomacy.

tutorial.2100.full.desc.zh:
$tutorial.2100.abbr.desc$

太空城邦能够提供多种形式的服务：从协助科学研究到倒卖信息，从修建恒星基地建筑到贩卖舰船，应有尽有。购买城邦的服务将提升他们对你的评价。
tutorial.2100.full.desc.en:
$tutorial.2100.abbr.desc$

Enclaves offer a wide variety of services: from conducting scientific research to selling information, starbase buildings, and even Ships. Purchasing services like these will increase that enclave's Opinion of us.

tutorial.2105.abbr.desc.zh: 我们接触到了一个佣兵城邦。这些独立自主的军事专家会向各种国家，当然也包括我们国家，收费并租借佣兵舰队
tutorial.2105.abbr.desc.en: We have encountered a Mercenary Enclave. These independent military specialists may loan out Mercenary Fleets to empires including our own - for a fee.

tutorial.2105.full.desc.zh:
$tutorial.2105.abbr.desc$

如果我们选择租借一支佣兵舰队，我们会在指定时间内获得舰队的控制权。在该时间段内，城邦会增补损失的舰船，但不论如何我们都无法将佣兵舰队极其海军司令与我方舰船合并。
tutorial.2105.full.desc.en:
$tutorial.2105.abbr.desc$

If we choose to hire a Mercenary Fleet, we will retain control of it for a set period of time. During that time, the Enclave will attempt to reinforce the fleet when necessary, however neither a Mercenary Fleet nor its Admiral may be integrated with our own fleets.

tutorial.2111.abbr.desc.zh: 如果我们同意，[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName]马上可以建立佣兵城邦，舰船也将不再受我们控制，重新成为独立性军事力量，并且可以重新向包括我们在内的所有国家租借佣兵舰队。
tutorial.2111.abbr.desc.en: [tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName] is now capable of becoming a Mercenary Enclave, if we so wish. The fleet would cease to be under our direct control - instead it would become an independent force, capable of loaning out Mercenary Fleets to empires including our own.

tutorial.2111.full.desc.zh:
$tutorial.2111.abbr.desc$

如果我们划出一片区域给佣兵城邦，那么只要它们把佣兵舰队租借给其他国家，我们就可以赚取收入。如果我们选择自己租借舰队，我们将在一定时间内保留对该舰队的控制权。另外如果雇佣舰队目前不可用，帝国需要额外支付一笔费用。
tutorial.2111.full.desc.en:
$tutorial.2111.abbr.desc$

For as long as we share space with the Mercenary Enclave, we stand to earn income whenever it loans its Mercenary Fleet out to other empires. If we choose to hire the Mercenary Fleet ourselves, we will retain control of that fleet for a set period of time. Empires may pay extra to buy out an existing contract if the Mercenary Fleet is not currently available.

tutorial.2115.desc.zh:
£megastructure£巨型结构是一种我们可以在太空中[GetBuildGrow]的巨大工程。它们可以为我们提供顶尖的研究设施、海量的资源、甚至是一些独特的交通方式。

建立一个巨型结构需要投入大量的时间和资源，但回报也同样可观。我们可以通过派遣一艘£construction_ship£工程船来开始修建巨型结构。
tutorial.2115.desc.en:
£megastructure£ Megastructures are colossal projects that we can [GetBuildGrow] out in the void of space. They may provide us with cutting-edge research facilities, access to superior resources, or even some unique forms of transportation.

Building on such a scale requires a significant investment of time and resources, but the rewards are every bit as sizable. We can get under way by setting a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship to this task.

tutorial.2120.desc.zh: 得益于我们在巨型工程研究的进展，我们现在可以在宜居£planet£行星外围修建星环基地了。通过指派一艘£construction_ship£工程船以开始修建。
tutorial.2120.desc.en: Thanks to our recent advances in mega-engineering research, we are now able to construct Orbital Rings around habitable £planet£ Planets. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.

tutorial.2125.desc.zh: 得益于我们在巨型工程研究的进展，我们现在可以在脉冲星或中子星周围修建量子弹弓了。通过指派一艘£construction_ship£工程船以开始修建。
tutorial.2125.desc.en: Recent advances in mega-engineering research mean we may now construct a Quantum Catapult around a pulsar or neutron star. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.

tutorial.2126.desc.zh:
量子弹弓能弹射舰船与舰队跨越遥远的天文尺度距离。该项科技极大地增强了我们应对帝国内部或是周边区域的应对能力。

不过使用量子弹弓也有一定的风险，例如舰队有可能被弹射到预定目标以外的£system£恒星系。当然我们可以通过升级量子弹弓到更高等级，提高吞吐量与最大跃迁范围等属性，从而降低这些风险。
tutorial.2126.desc.en:
The Quantum Catapult launches Ships and fleets across vast, interstellar distances. This technology greatly improves our ability to react to emerging situations within our empire, and in nearby regions of space.

Use of the Quantum Catapult carries some risk, as our fleets may arrive in £system£ Systems other than their intended target. We can mitigate these risks - and improve matters like throughput and maximum range - by upgrading the Quantum Catapult to higher tiers.

tutorial.2130.desc.zh: 鉴于在超空间中继器方面的巨型工程研究已经产出了一定成果，我们可以着手指派一艘£construction_ship£工程船开始修建一个中继器网络。
tutorial.2130.desc.en: Our mega-engineering research has yielded results in the form of Hyper Relays. We can begin forming a network of these by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.

tutorial.2131.desc.zh:
超空间中继器能够加快在相邻£system£恒星系航行的速度。如果能够将至少两个超空间中继器链接到一起，那么我们就可以建立一个显著加快帝国内部航行速度的网络。

超空间中继器也能与开放边境的相邻国家内部的中继器链接，从而将两国的网络相连。这将提高舰船穿越相邻国家的速度。
tutorial.2131.desc.en:
Hyper Relays allow for more efficient travel between adjacent £system£ Star Systems. By linking at least two Hyper Relays together, we can begin to establish a network which will dramatically reduce transit times across our empire.

Hyper Relays may also be built adjacent to each other across open borders, linking whole networks together. This will allow Ships to travel swiftly across neighboring empires.

tutorial.2140.desc.zh:
我们探测到了一个前超光速社会！虽然他们没有我们穿越星际的技术，但我们仍然可以从这些外星人身上得到很多东西。不论是学习他们的文化还是奴役他们，都取决于我们。

如果计划观察他们（假定他们在我们的掌控范围内），我们需要在他们星球轨道上建立一座观测站。

如果打算入侵他们，我们只需召集军队，他们没什么胜算。
tutorial.2140.desc.en:
We have detected a Pre-FTL society! Although they lack the kind of technology that allows us to traverse the stars, there is still a lot to be gained from these aliens. Whether it be learning from their culture or claiming them as slaves is up to us.

If we wish to observe them - assuming they are within our borders - we need to build an Observation Post around their world.

If we wish to invade, all we need do is muster our troops; they wouldn't stand much of a chance.

tutorial.2145.desc.dlc.zh:
我们的新观测站上线了。只要我们研究目标的£awareness£觉醒度保持低位，它就会继续执行任务。

我们能持续地从观测站获得一条独特的科技树，即观测洞见，直到这个前超光速社会的觉醒度达到上限而导致任务终止时。

若是此类情况发生，我们可以取而代之采取外交行动与他们接触。若干涉政策允许，我们也可提早现身。
tutorial.2145.desc.dlc.en:
Our new Observation Post has come online and will proceed with its Mission as long as the £awareness£ Awareness of the object of our study stays low.

We will gain Observation Insights, a unique line of technology, from this outpost until the Pre-FTL society reaches max awareness when missions will be disabled. Instead, we will be able to engage them with Diplomatic Actions.

We could choose to reveal ourselves early if our Interference Policies allow it.

tutorial.2145.desc.nodlc.zh:
我们的新观测站上线了。只要我们研究目标的£awareness£觉醒度保持低位，它就会继续执行任务。

一旦前超光速社会的觉醒度达到上限，我们就无法再观察他们了。相反地，我们可以采取外交行动与他们接触。若干涉政策允许，我们也可提早现身。
tutorial.2145.desc.nodlc.en:
Our new Observation Post has come online and will proceed with its Mission as long as the £awareness£ Awareness of the object of our study stays low.

Once a Pre-FTL society reaches maximum awareness, they will no longer be observable. Instead, we will be able to engage them with Diplomatic Actions. We may choose to reveal ourselves early if our Interference Policies allow it.

tutorial.2150.desc.zh:
这个前超光速文明知晓了我们的存在。根据我们的政策 立场，我们目前能够采取有限的外交与行星的领袖接触。

我们的存在已在星球上公开，也就没有继续观测的必要了。我们的观测任务已终止。
tutorial.2150.desc.en:
The pre-FTL civilization knows of our existence. We can now engage in limited Diplomacy with the Planet's leadership, depending on our Policy stance.

With our presence made public to the planet, there is no longer anything to gain from observing the civilization. Our Observation Missions have been disabled.

tutorial.22.desc.zh:
我们建造了新的£science_ship£科研船，但是没有指派操控飞船的£scientist£科学官！我的程序要求我指出雇佣一名新的科学家的好处。

选中科研船；

£dot_green£在舰队界面点击空白头像框
£dot_green£选择一位科学官；科学家

如果无法承担雇佣一名新科学家的费用，也可以从其他部门调用一名，虽然不怎么理想就是了。
tutorial.22.desc.en:
We have a brand new £science_ship£ Science Ship, but no £scientist£ Scientist has been assigned to command it. My programming insists that I should point out the benefits of adding an organic Scientist component to the mix.
