With the Science Ship selected;

£dot_green£ Click the empty portrait in the fleet interface
£dot_green£ Choose a Scientist

If we cannot afford to recruit a new Scientist we can always reassign one from another department, even though it is hardly ideal.

tutorial.23.desc.zh:
好极了。£scientist£科学官已经安排到新的£science_ship£科研船上了，我们可以在闲时派遣他们出去探索新的£system£恒星系或者捅出些篓子了。

如果想更换科学官，只需要在舰队界面再次点击头像框即可。
tutorial.23.desc.en:
Good. The £scientist£ Scientist has assumed command of our new £science_ship£ Science Ship, and can now be sent off at our leisure to explore new £system£ Systems and/or meet some grisly fate.

Should you wish to change the Scientist, then simply select the portrait once more in the fleet interface.

tutorial.24.desc.zh:
我们已经准备好到下一个星球上延续和发展我们伟大的文明了，这时候就需要我们建造一艘£colony_ship£殖民船。

[GetBuildGrow]舰船；

£dot_green£选中一个恒星基地
£dot_green£点击船坞选项卡
£dot_green£点击殖民船舰船

新建成的舰船在建造完毕后会出现在恒星基地旁边。
tutorial.24.desc.en:
We should now be ready to extend our great civilization to a second world. This will require the construction of a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship.

To [GetBuildGrow] a Ship;

£dot_green£ Select a Starbase
£dot_green£ Click on the Shipyard tab
£dot_green£ Click on Colony Ship

The newly constructed Ship will appear next to the Starbase once completed.

tutorial.25.desc.zh:
殖民者已经全部登上新建的£colony_ship£殖民船，舰长表示随时可以出发。真是一个值得纪念的日子！

建立£colony£殖民地有几种不同的方法。

在星系地图上殖民£planet£行星；

£dot_green£点击一颗可殖民行星
£dot_green£点击殖民按钮

$tttt$$ttt$£colonizable£

殖民者们出发之后，要花费数年时间来建立殖民地。
tutorial.25.desc.en:
The colonists have all been transferred to the new £colony_ship£ Colony Ship, and her captain reports all systems go. A momentous day, for sure!

There are different ways to establish a £colony£ Colony.

To Colonize a £planet£ Planet on the Galaxy Map;

£dot_green£ Click a colonizable Planet
£dot_green£ Click on the Colonize button

$tttt$$ttt$£colonizable£

Once the colonists have disembarked, they will take a few years to fully establish the colony.

tutorial.2500.desc.zh:
力场操纵研究领域的最新进展促使我们发明了$science_cloaking_components$。这些功率密集型部件可以投射出改良的粒子场，使我们的科研和军事舰船能够规避普通的传感器。

然而，这些隐形场在激活时将对$MOD_SHIP_BASE_SPEED_MULT$、$MOD_SHIP_WINDUP_MULT$和$MOD_SHIP_SHIELD_HP_ADD$产生负面影响。

未被发现的隐形船只可以规避关闭边境导致的影响。
在隐形状态下，我们的£science_ship£科研船能够对他国的£colony£殖民地执行主动侦察，增加我们获得的关于其他帝国的情报。
tutorial.2500.desc.en:
Recent advances in Field Manipulation research have led to the invention of $science_cloaking_components$. These power-intensive components project modified particle fields allowing our science and military vessels to hide from conventional sensors.

However, these cloaking fields will negatively affect $MOD_SHIP_BASE_SPEED_MULT$, $MOD_SHIP_WINDUP_MULT$ and $MOD_SHIP_SHIELD_HP_ADD$ while active.

Cloaked ships that remain undetected can ignore Closed Borders.
While Cloaked, our £science_ship£ Science Ships will be capable of conducting Active Reconnaissance on foreign £colony£ Colonies, increasing the Intel we gain on other empires.

tutorial.2550.desc.zh:
计算机研究领域的最新进展促使我们发明了$sm_detection_array_plural$。在我们的恒星基地上安装这些高功率的外部传感器，将使我们有能力探测到隐形舰队。

通过将多个阵列耦合在一起，我们可以提高$sm_detection_array_plural$的灵敏度，使它们能够穿透越来越稳定的隐形力场。

随着进一步研究，我们应该能够利用£science_ship£科研船来进一步提高这些探测能力。这些设备的范围受限于恒星基地的探测范围。
tutorial.2550.desc.en:
Recent advances in Computing research have led to the invention of $sm_detection_array_plural$. Installing these high-powered external sensors on our Starbases will grant the ability to detect Cloaked fleets.

The sensitivity of the $sm_detection_array_plural$ can be increased by coupling multiple arrays together, allowing them to penetrate increasingly stable Cloaking Fields.

With further research, we should be able to use £science_ship£ Science Ships to further increase boost these detection capabilities. The range of these devices is limited by the starbase's Sensor Range.

tutorial.26.desc.zh: 我们拥有了一艘£colony_ship£殖民船，也发现了至少一处可以建造永久系外据点的星球。没理由犹豫了，快建立我们的第一个£colony£殖民地吧！
tutorial.26.desc.en: We have a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship, and we have found at least one suitable candidate for a permanent extrasolar outpost. I see no reason to delay further - let's establish our first £colony£ Colony!

tutorial.2600.desc.zh:
有灵能人口定居的殖民地能够散发$PSIONIC_AURA$。光环来源于我们当前$concept_attunement$最高的虚境超主。

$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$在为帝国提供多种多样的修正效果的同时，也能对友好或者敌对国家施加影响。我们如果想要扩大光环的范围，就需要通过与超主进一步调和来解锁£research£$tech_aura_intensification$科技。

打开虚境选项卡或者将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£恒星系预览面板中的的光环图标上均可以查看$PSIONIC_AURA$的效果。
tutorial.2600.desc.en:
Our colonies with psionic populations now have the ability to emit a $PSIONIC_AURA$. This Aura is drawn from the Shroud Patron with which we currently have the highest $concept_attunement$.

$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ have varying effects on our own empire, and can also affect friendly or hostile empires. To expand our Aura into more systems, we will need to more fully attune to a Patron in order to unlock £research£ $tech_aura_intensification$ technology.

To observe the effects of our $PSIONIC_AURA$, open the Shroud tab or hover over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ System View.

tutorial.2610.desc.zh:
$PSIONIC_AURA$能够提高强度并向外扩散到其他恒星系。

$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$有三个强度等级，分别产生不同的效果。$PSIONIC_AURA$在提升强度等级或强度提升至最大值时，会试着向临近恒星系扩散。大多数$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的扩散距离有上限。‘

有多种途径能够增强光环，例如繁衍更多$trait_psionic$人口、提升£happiness£幸福度、增加£job_telepath£[GetTelepathCap]岗位数量，以及在£sector£星域中雇佣具有灵能能力的总督或者£leader£领袖。
tutorial.2610.desc.en:
Our $PSIONIC_AURA$ now has the ability to gain Intensity and spread into other systems.

$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ can reach three thresholds of Intensity, with scaling effects. If a $PSIONIC_AURA$ reaches a new level of Intensity, or maximizes its Intensity, it will attempt to spread to adjacent systems. Most $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ have a maximum range they can spread from their source.

Aura Intensity can be increased through various means, such as high $trait_psionic$ populations, £happiness£ Happiness levels, £job_telepath£ [GetTelepathCap] Jobs, and Psychic Governors or £leader£ Leaders of £sector£ Sectors.

tutorial.2620.desc.zh:
$PSIONIC_AURA$可能会与另一个扩散到相邻星系的光环发生冲突。一旦出现这种情况，这两个光环就会相互对抗，并决出最终由哪个光环来实控该恒星系。

对抗的结果取决于双方光环每月强度增长，可以将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£恒星系预览面板中的光环图标来查看这一过程。
tutorial.2620.desc.en:
Our $PSIONIC_AURA$ has encountered another Aura in an adjacent connected system. When this occurs, the two Auras may compete to determine which will spread into the other system.

This process depends on the monthly Intensity gain of each opposing Aura, which can be observed by hovering over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ System View.

tutorial.27.desc.zh: 这是我们的第一个系外£colony£殖民地！这样就算母星发生爆炸，也不用担心面临消灭的命运了！还不赖吧？
tutorial.27.desc.en: Our first extrasolar £colony£ Colony! This means that if our homeworld were to spontaneously combust, your species would no longer be rendered extinct. That is a comforting thought, wouldn't you say?

tutorial.3.desc.zh:
研究新科技对我们成功至关重要。我这么说不仅是因为我自己就是科技的产物，更是因为我是你的可靠顾问，还有可能是你唯一真正的朋友。

我们应该最先研究新世界协议，这样就可以建造£colony_ship£殖民船，在其他£planet£行星上立足。
tutorial.3.desc.en:
Researching new technologies will be critical to our success. I tell you this not merely as a product of unfettered technological progress, but as your trusted advisor and, I suspect, your only true friend.

One important technology that we should research as soon as possible is New Worlds Protocol. It will give us access to £colony_ship£ Colony Ships which will allow us to establish footholds on other £planet£ Planets.

tutorial.33.desc.zh:
稳定的£minerals£矿物、£alloys£合金与£energy£能量币供应是任何星际势力繁荣发展的关键。我们应当采取措施增加这些资源的产量。

空间站和£building£建筑需要消耗合金或矿物来建造，还需要能量币来维护。舰船也是如此，只不过它们也需要合金来维护。这些资源由£mining_station£开采站或殖民地建筑生产。

后期你会发现一些有趣的新资源，可用于神秘的新建造。
tutorial.33.desc.en:
A healthy supply of £minerals£ Minerals, £alloys£ Alloys and £energy£ Energy Credits is critical to the well-being of any interstellar power. We should take steps to increase our production of these resources.

Stations and £building£ Buildings cost Alloys or Minerals to build and Energy Credits to maintain. The same is true for Ships, except that they have an Alloy upkeep cost as well. These resources are produced by £mining_station£ Mining Stations or Colony Buildings. 

Later you may discover new and interesting resources to spend on esoteric new production.

tutorial.38.desc.zh: 干得漂亮。这下我们有足够的资源去继续建设我们的宏伟帝国了。
tutorial.38.desc.en: Excellent work. We now have a strong resource base to build our empire on.

tutorial.39.desc.zh: 我们的舰队有点弱不禁风。在宇宙中有各种各样的危险，需要我们用武力手段进行回应。要记住，我们的文明时刻处于危险之中！
tutorial.39.desc.en: I can't help but notice that our navy is a bit on the weak side. We are certain to face many threats in the galaxy that will require some form of military response. Remember, the survival of our civilization is at stake!

tutorial.4.desc.zh:
欲拓其土，必先丈量之。而我们的£science_ship£科研船正是为此事而生。

你可以用如下图标识别出科研船：

$tttt$$tt$£science_ship_map£


选择舰船的方式有两种；在星系地图或总览中点选。

£dot_green£选择一艘科研船
£dot_green£右键点击邻近£system£恒星系
£dot_green£选择调查恒星系

恒星系必须先完成调查之后才能宣称占领。
tutorial.4.desc.en:
Before we can expand we must explore, and our £science_ship£ Science Ships are the vessel of choice for such a task.

You can identify a Science Ships by the following symbol:

$tttt$$tt$£science_ship_map£


There are two ways of selecting a ship; From the Galaxy Map or the Outliner.

£dot_green£ Select a Science Ship
£dot_green£ Right-click a nearby £system£ System
£dot_green£ Select Survey System

A System must be surveyed before it can be claimed.

tutorial.43.desc.zh: 棒极了！我们的舰队小而精悍，应该能在突发的敌对遭遇中拥有上佳的表现。
tutorial.43.desc.en: Good! We now have a small but capable space fleet that should serve us well in the event of any unexpected hostile encounters.

tutorial.44.desc.zh:
我们的帝国蓬勃发展，规模已经大到我们没法通过母星直接进行控制了。我们应该建立新的星域。

星域是属于我们帝国的区域，能设为自主管理模式，居民可以在他们的权限范围内自行负责£planet£行星上的日常事务。
tutorial.44.desc.en:
Our burgeoning empire has now reached a size where it is becoming difficult to administer directly from our homeworld. We should establish a new Sector.

Sectors are areas within our empire that can be set to independently manage the day-to-day affairs of the £planet£ Planets under their jurisdiction.

tutorial.45.desc.zh: 随着帝国的发展，新的£colony£殖民地可以被划归进星域。星域可以在星球与星域界面进行自动管理，自动对£district£区划与£building£建筑进行建造与升级。
tutorial.45.desc.en: As our empire grows, new £colony£ Colonies can be organized into Sectors. Sectors can be automated from the Planets and Sectors screen to automatically build and upgrade £district£ Districts and £building£ Buildings using assigned pools of resources.

tutorial.46.desc.zh: 你可以指派总督管理整个星域。星域内的所有£planet£星球都将从总督的技能中受益。我们应当为我们的新星域指派一位总督。
tutorial.46.desc.en: Governors can be assigned to administrate entire Sectors. All £planet£ Planets within the sector will then benefit from the Governor's skills. We should assign one to our new sector.

tutorial.47.desc.zh: 我们的新总督已经在新星域的首府开始办公了。干的好。
tutorial.47.desc.en: Our new Sector Governor has assumed office on the sector's capital world. Well done.

tutorial.48.desc.zh:
我们现在可以在舰船设计器界面中亲手设计新的舰船了。这个过程比较直截了当，当然我们也可以进行全自动设计。

访问舰船设计；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击舰队管理按钮或按F9键

$tttt$$tt$£fleet_management£
tutorial.48.desc.en:
We have the ability to manually design new Ships in the Ship Designer screen. This is a fairly straight-forward process, though one that can be fully automated if we so wish.

To access the Ship Designer;

£dot_green£Click the Fleet Management button on the left side bar or press F9

$tttt$$tt$£fleet_management£

tutorial.49.desc.zh:
干的好。新的舰船设计已经添加到我们的数据库中，可以在装有船坞的太空港中进行生产。

新设计可以在任何时候在舰船设计器中进行编辑。设计做出变动时，已建造的舰船会需要在恒星基地中进行升级。

升级舰船；

£dot_green£在总览中选择舰船
£dot_green£在舰队界面点击升级按钮

$tttt$$tt$£upgrade_ship£
tutorial.49.desc.en:
Good job. The ship design has been added to our database, and can now be produced by a Starbase that has been equipped with a Shipyard.

The new design can be edited at any time by revisiting the Ship Designer. If any changes are made to the design, then Ships already built will need to be upgraded at a Starbase.

To upgrade a Ship;

£dot_green£ Select the Ship in the Outliner
£dot_green£ Click the Upgrade button in the fleet interface

$tttt$$tt$£upgrade_ship£

tutorial.5.desc.zh:
现在我们已经可以向我们的£science_ship£科研船下达出发的命令了。我们会需要取消星系地图模拟的暂停才能让一切继续。

取消暂停；

£dot_green£可以按空格键或是顶部栏的取消暂停按钮：

$tttt$$t$£pause_button£
tutorial.5.desc.en:
Now that we have given a command to our £science_ship£ Science Ships it's time to set off. We will need to unpause the Galaxy Map simulation before anything can happen.

To unpause the game;

£dot_green£ Press the Space Bar or select the Unpause icon in the top bar

$tttt$$t$£pause_button£

tutorial.52.desc.zh:
经过研究，[From.GetName]上的异常现象是一种自然的几何构造。看起来就像是一个指路的标记符号，宇宙的自然之美真是令人惊讶。

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$
tutorial.52.desc.en:
The anomaly on [From.GetName] turned out to be a natural geometrical formation. It almost looks like a marker, showing the way forward. The natural beauty of the universe can be quite astonishing.

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$

tutorial.52.spirit.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上发现了一片自然构造，其完美的几何结构令人窒息。这实乃上天的鬼斧神工，要引领我们到群星中去！

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$
tutorial.52.spirit.desc.en:
We found a natural formation on [From.GetName], stunning in its geometrical perfection. This is surely a divine sign, marking our way out towards the stars!

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$

tutorial.53.a.zh: 我们曾经被人观察？对方究竟有何目的？

tutorial.53.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]探测到的异常现象背后，发现一些十分惊人的东西。[From.GetPlanetMoon]周围环绕着的轨迹显然是超光速引擎留下的。由于其年代久远，我们无法进行追溯。

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$
tutorial.53.desc.en:
The anomaly we detected on [From.GetName] unveils something astonishing. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is surrounded by a trail undoubtedly produced by FTL engines. We are unable to trace it to its origin, due to it being generated long ago.

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$

tutorial.53.xenophile.desc.zh:
在[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上的异常现象显示了其他星际旅行者的痕迹！这些微弱的超光速航道轨迹表明，在很早之前，有人造访了我们£planet£行星寻求潜在的盟友。但是痕迹衰退严重，已无法进行追溯。

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$
tutorial.53.xenophile.desc.en:
The anomaly on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] shows traces of other interstellar travelers! A weak FTL trail shows that someone was here long ago, maybe watching our £planet£ Planet for potential allies. It is too diminished to trace any further.

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$

tutorial.53.xenophobe.a.zh: 我们必须警惕异种的威胁。
tutorial.53.xenophobe.a.en: We must beware the xeno threat.

tutorial.53.xenophobe.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]附近发现了微弱的超光速航道轨迹。其年代久远，业已无法进行追溯。这说明在很早之前就有星际旅行者来过这里，观察我们，收集情报。

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$
tutorial.53.xenophobe.desc.en:
We have detected a weak FTL trail near [From.GetName]. It is very old, making it impossible to track. This must mean that other interstellar travelers have been here before, watching us, surely gathering intel.

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$

tutorial.54.desc.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上找到了一个我方的旧探测器。这些年来它一直保持运作，还试图将数据传送到母星上去。这是我们往日艰苦奋斗的纪念碑，也代表了昔日我们冲破行星枷锁的愿望。

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$
tutorial.54.desc.en:
We found one of our old probes on [From.GetName]. It has somehow kept intact all these years and is still trying to send data to our homeworld. It stands as a testament to our past struggles, and our wish to flee our Planet's bounds.

$tutorial.52.filler.desc$

tutorial.54.materialist.a.zh: 我们的努力终于有了回报。
tutorial.54.materialist.a.en: Our efforts have finally paid off.

tutorial.54.spiritualist.a.en: The divine surely has more in store.

tutorial.55.desc.zh:
我们发现了一种战略资源！许多£strategic_resource£战略资源需要特定的科技才能利用，但可以从中获得强力的加成。

收集战略资源；

£dot_green£选中一艘£construction_ship£工程船
£dot_green£右键点击包含该资源的£system£恒星系
£dot_green£点击[GetBuildGrowCap]£mining_station£开采站

战略资源可以用于建造高级£building£建筑和舰船部件，也可以用来售卖。
tutorial.55.desc.en:
We have uncovered a Strategic Resource! Many £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources require specific technologies to exploit, but can confer powerful bonuses.

To secure a Strategic Resource;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship
£dot_green£ Right-click the £system£ System containing the resource
£dot_green£ Select [GetBuildGrowCap] £mining_station£ Mining Stations

Strategic Resources can be used to build advanced £building£ Buildings and Ship components or simply sold.

tutorial.55.poi.desc.en: We have discovered a Strategic Resource on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName].

tutorial.56.desc.zh: 干的好。这些资源会让我们帝国更加富裕的！
tutorial.56.desc.en: Excellent work. This resource is sure to greatly enrich our nation.

tutorial.56.poi.desc.en: We have discovered a Strategic Resource on the [StrategicResourcePlanet.GetPlanetMoon] [StrategicResourcePlanet.GetName].

tutorial.560.desc.zh:
我们现有的£mining_station£开采站在使用了新研发的科技之后就可以采集战略资源了。这些稀有资源会带来巨大的加成，同时也是极好的商品。真是一箭双雕啊！

更多的信息可以在情报日志里找到。星系里还有更多的£strategic_resource£战略资源等待我们去发现。继续探索吧！
tutorial.560.desc.en:
Using recently-developed technology, an already-extant £mining_station£ Mining Station can now mine a Strategic Resource. These rare resources confer powerful bonuses and make for valuable trade goods. Two metaphorical avians, allegorically struck down by an imaginary projectile.

More information can be found in the Situation Log for a time. There are many more £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources left to discover in the galaxy, so keep on researching!

tutorial.57.desc.notech.zh:
我们发现了高度进化的生命体！在正确科技的引领下，搞不好还可以进行提升，提升他们的自我知觉和智力——或者说，是有机体中被认为是智力的东西。

时刻注意我们的研究才是明智之选。如果有机会的话，我们可以将这个种群向外源性刺激推进。
tutorial.57.desc.notech.en:
We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right Technology, we may eventually be able to Uplift these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.

It would perhaps be wise to keep an eye on our research, and direct it towards Epigenetic Triggers if given the opportunity.

tutorial.57.desc.yestech.zh:
我们发现了高度进化的动物生命！在正确科技的引领下，我们或许可以最终进行提升这些生命体的智慧和智力——或者说，是有机体中被认为是智力的东西。

哦。

基因表达学机制技术应该符合要求，我们是时候将这些生物提升到一个全新的境界了。
tutorial.57.desc.yestech.en:
We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right Technology, we may eventually be able to Uplift these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.

Oh.

The Epigenetic Triggers technology should fit the bill, and we are in fact ready to elevate these creatures into a brave new world of existential angst.

tutorial.58.desc.zh: 真是大获成功！那些原始的野兽已经提升到不那么原始的级别，成为我们蓬勃发展的帝国的人口了！
tutorial.58.desc.en: A rousing success! The lowly beasts have been uplifted to become less lowly beasts, and are now proud citizens of our burgeoning empire.

tutorial.58.name.zh: 教程：未开智物种已提升

tutorial.59.desc.zh:
请注意！我们已经发现了拥有太空飞行能力的外星生物，他们是否具有智能尚不明确。不过，应该是有智能才对吧。我们必须完成调查才能揭开他们的神秘面纱。我建议我们先行行动，不要等到他们来调查我们……

要调查第一次接触；

£dot_green£打开情报日志
£dot_green£选择$SHOW_FIRST_CONTACT$

$tttt$$ttt$£firstcontact£

第一次接触也可通过点击星系地图上的图标发起
tutorial.59.desc.en:
Remarkable! We have discovered spacefaring alien entities that may or may not be intelligent, but, let's face it, probably are. Their true nature will remain a mystery to us until we complete the appropriate project to Investigate them. I suggest we do so post-haste, lest they investigate us first...

To investigate a First Contact;

£dot_green£ Open the Situation Log
£dot_green£ Click on $SHOW_FIRST_CONTACT$

$tttt$$ttt$£firstcontact£

First Contact can also be initiated by clicking the icon on the Galaxy map

tutorial.6.desc.zh: 非常好！刚刚研究完成的科技对我们作用很大。别忘了为£scientist£科学官们安排新的研究项目。
tutorial.6.desc.en: Excellent work! The technology we just finished researching will certainly benefit us. Don't forget to give our £scientist£ Scientists new research assignments.

tutorial.61.desc.zh:
我们建立沟通的尝试代表了我们技术上的成熟，但结果并不理想。如果宇宙中还有其他智能生物的话，也许是些只具备动物水平智能的家伙吧。

前智慧生物跟可没法搞什么外交，但取决于你的帝国类型，有时候可以对他们提升、灭绝、奴役或者进行观察。
tutorial.61.desc.en:
Our attempts to establish communications stand testament to our technological ingenuity, but results are lacking. It is likely that the other party possesses only an animal level of intelligence, if any at all.

Pre-Sapients offer little to no diplomatic interactions, but depending on your empire type, they can sometimes be uplifted, exterminated, enslaved, or observed.

tutorial.63.desc.zh:
看起来对方抢了我们的风头，在我们尚未解密他们的通讯模式前和我们建立了接触。

在下次有这样的机会出现时，希望可以由我们来完成这一步吧。
tutorial.63.desc.en:
It appears the other party completely stole our thunder, establishing contact with us before we had managed to decipher their communications protocols.

We should still attempt to accomplish this feat for ourselves, when the opportunity next presents itself.

tutorial.64.desc.zh:
多亏了近来遗传学的进步，我们已经获得了额外的特质点数，可以用来修饰和强化我们的人民了。

修饰物种；

£dot_green£打开物种选项卡或按F6键
£dot_green£点击修饰按钮
£dot_green£研究特殊项目
tutorial.64.desc.en:
Thanks to recent advances in genetics, we have gained an extra Trait Point that we can use to Modify and enhance our people.

To modify a Species;

£dot_green£ Select the Species tab or press F6
£dot_green£ Click on the Modify button
£dot_green£ Research Special Project

tutorial.65.desc.zh: 真是太棒了。我们的帝国终于摆脱了自然进化的束缚，一定可以在宇宙中大展宏图了。
tutorial.65.desc.en: Commendable. With the yoke of natural evolution lifted from their shoulders, our people are sure to thrive in space.

tutorial.7.desc.zh:
我们母星所能提供的资源也就只能支持我们走到这一步。我们的产业需要扩张到外星，这就需要有一艘£construction_ship£工程船。

如果我们收集到了足够的£alloys£合金，就赶紧[GetBuildGrow]一艘。
tutorial.7.desc.en:
The resources generated by our homeworld will only take us so far. Our industry needs to expand off-world, and that requires a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.

We should [GetBuildGrow] one as soon as we have amassed enough £alloys£ Alloys to do so.

tutorial.71.desc.zh:
为了缩短£system£恒星系间的遥远距离，我们的£scientist£科学家们发明了超空间引擎。这种装置可以在超空间连接的两个恒星系间以远超光速的速度穿梭。

虽然使用超空间进行移动速度极快，但这种旅行只能限制在星系超维平面网络上。

要进入超空间，舰船必须先抵达恒星系边缘，到恒星重力井之外。

当指挥舰船移动到其他恒星系时会自动进行。
tutorial.71.desc.en:
To overcome the vast distances that separate £system£ Star Systems, our £scientist£ Scientists have developed the Hyper Drive. This device permits travel at speeds far exceeding that of light between systems connected by hyperlanes.

Travel along a hyperlane is nearly instantaneous, but movement is restricted to the galactic hyperlane network. 

To enter hyperspace, a Ship must first reach the system's edge, beyond the star's gravity well.

This happens automatically when ordering a Ship to move to another System.

tutorial.73.desc.zh:
只要有合适的技术，我们就有将低级生物提升至开智种族的方法了。

要提升物种；

£dot_green£打开未开智£planet£行星
£dot_green£选择管理选项卡
£dot_green£选中物种
£dot_green£点击设置权利
£dot_green£点击提升
tutorial.73.desc.en:
Having researched the appropriate technology, we now have the means to Uplift lesser beings to sapience.

To uplift a Species;

£dot_green£ Open the Pre-Sapient £planet£ Planet
£dot_green£ Click the Management tab
£dot_green£ Select the Species
£dot_green£ Click on Set Rights
£dot_green£ Click on Uplift

The species will begin the uplift process, gaining full sapience once completed.

tutorial.75.desc.zh:
我们已经开始探索邻近的一些星系，或许是时候再将手伸远一些了。

恒星基地可以在已调查的£system£恒星系中建造，用以拓展疆界，为我们获取新空间区域的所有权。

有了更先进的科技后，恒星基地还可以升级并用于产出舰船或者资源。

宣称恒星系；

£dot_green£选择一艘£construction_ship£工程船
£dot_green£右键点击一个已调查的恒星系
£dot_green£选择[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地
tutorial.75.desc.en:
Now that we have begun exploring our neighboring stars, it might be time to extend our reach.

A Starbase can be built around stars in surveyed £system£ Systems to expand our borders, allowing us to claim new regions of space

With future technologies, Starbases can be upgraded to produce Ships or other resources.

To claim a System;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship
£dot_green£ Right-click a surveyed System
£dot_green£ Select [GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase

tutorial.76.desc.zh:
很棒。你在星系地图中就能看到，我们帝国的疆界已经拓展到了这个刚刚建好恒星基地的£system£恒星系上了。

新建的恒星基地只是一座哨站，只有非常有限的防御能力，没有安装模组和£building£建筑的空间。因此，这些没有升级过的哨站是不会显示在总览中的。

升级恒星基地；

£dot_green£在星系地图点击恒星系
£dot_green£选中恒星基地
£dot_green£点击升级按钮
tutorial.76.desc.en:
Excellent. As you can see on the Galaxy Map, the borders of our empire have expanded to include the £system£ System where we built our new Starbase.

A newly built Starbase acts as an Outpost, with limited defensive capabilities and no room for Modules and £building£ Buildings. As such, it does not yet appear in the outliner until it has been upgraded.

To upgrade a Starbase;

£dot_green£ Click the system on the Galaxy Map
£dot_green£ Select the Starbase
£dot_green£ Click on the Upgrade button

tutorial.8.desc.zh: 非常好！£construction_ship£工程船可以运行了，上面的船员可都是帝国最棒的工程师。
tutorial.8.desc.en: Good job! Our £construction_ship£ Construction Ship is now up and running, and its hardy crew includes some of the finest engineers available to our nation.

tutorial.9.desc.zh:
母星上生产的资源只够我们走到这一步，好在我们的£science_ship£科研船在另外一颗星球上发现了一处资源矿藏！

是时候派£construction_ship£工程船[GetBuildGrow]一座£mining_station£开采站了。

开采站可以在帝国境内建造，它能自动采集所环绕天体上的£minerals£矿物、£energy£能量币以及£strategic_resource£战略资源。

选择工程船；

£dot_green£右键点击一个境内£system£恒星系
£dot_green£选择[GetBuildGrowCap]开采站

开采站需要花费能量币作为维护费。
tutorial.9.desc.en:
The resources generated by our homeworld will only take us so far. Luckily our £science_ship£ Science Ship has just found a resource deposit on another world!

The time has come to use our £construction_ship£ Construction Ship to [GetBuildGrow] a £mining_station£ Mining Station.

Mining Stations can be built within our borders and automatically collect £minerals£ Minerals, £energy£ Energy Credits, and £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources.

With the Construction Ship selected;

£dot_green£ Right-click a claimed £system£ System
£dot_green£ Select [GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Stations

Mining Stations have an Energy Credit upkeep cost.

unadavance_tech_tt.zh: 他们的科技退步了，结果让他们倒车回到了前一个发展阶段。
unadavance_tech_tt.en: Their technology has regressed, effectively knocking them back to an earlier age in their development.

underground_expansion_tooltip.zh: 地下区域将为我们提供更大的可用空间！
underground_expansion_tooltip.en: The underground areas will give us more room for expansion!

undermining_tooltip_emperor.zh: [target_country.GetName]在接下来的5年内无法派遣特使执行削弱帝国权威的任务。
undermining_tooltip_emperor.en: The [target_country.GetName] may not assign Envoys to Undermine Imperial Authority for the next 5 years.

undermining_tooltip_victim.zh: 在接下来的5年里我们无法派遣特使执行削弱帝国权威的任务。
undermining_tooltip_victim.en: We are unable to assign Envoys to Undermine Imperial Authority for the next 5 years.

unique.1.desc.zh:
在仔细搜索接收到奇怪信号的山谷后，我们最终找到了一艘失事的破旧飞船。尽管它仍在向外发出求救信号，但各个舱室似乎大都是空荡荡的，没有生命迹象。

在我们完全检查这片区域后，我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]偶然发现了一处小型营地，沿着久远的足迹向前探索之后便发现了一座古老的实验室。尽管其入口被残骸堵住，但就目前情况来看，这里很有可能就是飞船上失踪异种们所在的地方。
unique.1.desc.en:
After meticulously searching and analyzing the valley where we picked up on the weird signal, we finally managed to track down the crash site of an old dilapidated ship. Though it still sends out a call for aid, the vessel seems to be mostly empty, and there's no sign of life inside.

One of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] came across a small camp site while we were thoroughly examining the area, and after following some old tracks they found an old laboratory. Though blocked by debris, for now, this might be the location of the missing xenos from the ship.

unique.10.a.zh: 拆开这些克隆舱，我们可以从中学到什么。
unique.10.a.en: Take apart their cloning vats and see what we can learn.

unique.10.b.zh: 让我们挑其中的一个唤醒吧。
unique.10.b.en: Let us wake one of them.

unique.10.b.tt.zh: 我们将与其中一位克隆体对话。
unique.10.b.tt.en: We will engage with one of the clones.

unique.10.c.evopred.zh: 装罐的有机体，美味极了。

unique.10.desc.zh:
随着一阵风从里面吹出，通往实验室最后一个房间的门终于打开了，房间的大小显然超出了我们的预期，里面摆满了一排排的克隆舱，数百，不，甚至是数千个生物被锁在这里，在这不见天日的地下。

[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]很快得出结论，这些生物和之前我们所发现的遗骸是同种。如果我们想要的话，这些克隆舱旁边的小按钮似乎就可以唤醒他们。
unique.10.desc.en:
With a small release of air the doors to the final chamber of the laboratory finally opens, significantly larger than anyone would expect. Rows and rows of cloning vats fills the area - hundreds if not thousands of creatures locked away underground.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] quickly conclude they are of the same species as the remains we found earlier. A small button by each of the cloning vats seems to be all that is needed to wake them up, if we so want.

unique.100.a.zh: 是时候把数据日志带回[Root.Capital.GetName]了。
unique.100.a.en: Time to bring the data log back to [Root.Capital.GetName].

unique.125.desc.zh: 我们派遣了一批[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]去分析调查[From.solar_system.GetName]中古老战舰的遗骸，从其中收集一切我们能得到的东西。我们虽然没能确定这些战舰作战的确切年代，也不知道它们究竟所属何方，但还是获得了一些关于这些舰船的建造技术。
unique.125.desc.en: We sent in some of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to analyze the remains of the ancient battleships in [From.solar_system.GetName], and glean from them what they can. Though unable to determine how old these vessels are, or for what banner they once fought, they managed to derive some information about the building techniques used to craft the ships.

unique.130.desc.zh:
我们对$NAME_Lone_Defender_system$恒星系进行的初步扫描显示，$NAME_Lone_Defender_planet$已经被核武器所摧毁。居民们使用了威力强大的星球级武器相互毁灭，甚至连卫星都被震碎了。

我们想要知道发生了什么，就只能通过目前还在恒星系中巡航的一艘舰船，但它正在用导弹攻击我们。
unique.130.desc.en:
Our initial scan of the $NAME_Lone_Defender_system$ system revealed that the planet $NAME_Lone_Defender_planet$ was destroyed by nuclear weapons. The inhabitants annihilated themselves using planet-based weapons so powerful that they even shattered their moon.

Our only chance to learn more about what happened is a ship patrolling the system, but it is already targeting us with its missiles.

unique.135.b.memorialist.zh: 重新命名星球与恒星系。

unique.135.b.memorialist.tt.en:
The planet $NAME_Lone_Defender_planet$ is renamed to $NAME_Lone_Defender_ship$.
The system $NAME_Lone_Defender_system$ is renamed to $Lone_Defender_message$.

unique.135.desc.memorialist.zh: $unique.135.desc$或者我们也可以将这些漂浮的残骸留在这里作为纪念，用这位智慧人工智能以及它所发出的最后讯息来命名这颗星球与恒星系。
unique.135.desc.memorialist.en: $unique.135.desc$ Or we leave the floating parts as a memorial, and rename the planet and system after the lone defender and its final message.

unique.135.desc.regular.zh: $unique.135.desc$或者出于对它勇敢履行了自己的职责的敬佩，我们可以用它的名字来命名这颗星球，以此来纪念这位智慧人工智能。
unique.135.desc.regular.en: $unique.135.desc$ Or because it valiantly performed its duty, we honor the AI by renaming the planet after its lone defender.

unique.140.a.zh: 它居然还这么完整真是惊奇。
unique.140.a.en: Amazing it's still in one piece.

unique.140.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]一进入到[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系，发现许多无人机在广播着以下消息：

欢迎来到星达广场。

我们的自动无人机随时待命，协助您到达我们的轨道停泊区。你的飞船一熄火，我们的穿梭车就会带你去星达广场体验。明亮的水疗中心，完美的营养庭院，以及超大规模的产品和服务等着你！

在这个星系的唯一一颗气态巨行星附近，废弃的星达广场居住站孤独地漂浮着。看来已经很久没有人前往此处消费了。
unique.140.desc.en:
As the [Root.GetName] entered the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system, several drones broadcast the following message:

Welcome to Star Mall.

Our automated drones are standing by to assist you to one of our orbital parking zones. Once your vessel is powered down, our shuttles will whisk you away to the Star Mall experience. Illuminating spas, immaculate nutritional courts, and a supermassive selection of products and services await you!

Near the system's lone gas giant, the Star Mall habitat floats abandoned. No one has shopped here in a very long time.

unique.15.a.zh: 你能更详细地介绍一下自己吗？
unique.15.a.en: Can you tell us more about yourselves?

unique.15.c.zh: 你们能安全离开这些克隆舱吗？
unique.15.c.en: Would you be safe outside of these vats?

unique.15.d.en: We know what to do with you.

unique.15.desc.zh:
我……我们……苏醒了。

我们……在哪？我们的母星怎么样了？它还……是的，我还能感觉到她，她依然存在。

对不起，我知道这似乎对客人们很无礼，我们是拉里昂内斯的意识，欢迎来到我们的母星，$NAME_Unique_System_2_Planet$。请问能不能拜托你释放我们，让我们重回家园呢？
unique.15.desc.en:
I... we... awaken.

Where are... we? What of our homeworld, does it... Yes, we can feel it - it still exists.

We apologize, it seems we have been discourteous to guests - we of the Larionessi Consciousness welcome you to our homeworld, $NAME_Unique_System_2_Planet$. Would you be willing to release us so we can see our home once more?

unique.16.desc.zh:
我们是拉里昂内斯意识，是拉里昂的原住民。

从前我们跨越数个恒星系，从星系的外缘一直遍布到核心。然而当我们的敌人给我们感染了一种罕见的疾病，瘫痪了我们的神经网络后，一切都改变了。

这里就是我们现在所有的一切了，这些克隆舱，这些克隆体……
unique.16.desc.en:
We are the Larionessi Consciousness, the inhabitants of Larion.

Once our collective stretched across several solar systems, from the outer rims of our galaxy and all the way to the very core. That all changed when one of our adversaries infected us with a rare disease that ripped across our multitudes, and left our neural network paralyzed.

Now this is all that remains. These vats, these clones...

unique.17.desc.zh:
是我们自己。

这是我们最后一次尝试留下一部分我们的传承，这样主意识的记忆就永远不会消失了。呃……我们现在似乎也的确办到了。

我们担心这些克隆体可能会把过去的疾病遗传下来，不过现在看来似乎没有。
unique.17.desc.en:
We did.

It was our last effort to try and carry on some part of our legacy, so that the memories of our consciousness would not disappear forever. And... it seems to have worked.

We worried our clones might inherit the problems of the past, but it seems they did not.

unique.18.desc.zh:
据我们所知，这种疾病肯定已经在很久很久以前我们建造这些克隆舱之后消失了。

毕竟很难想象这种疾病在找不到宿主的情况下还能一直存在。你放我们出来是没有问题的，这样就可以让我们的集体重获新生了。
unique.18.desc.en:
As far as we know, the disease must have disappeared in the eons since we originally created these clones.

We are hard pressed to imagine a scenario where the disease would survive without a host. We should be safe to be released so we can begin the restoration of our collective.

unique.20.a.zh: 拉里昂是你们的，理应如此。
unique.20.a.en: Larion is yours, as it should be.

unique.20.a.tt.zh: 我们将得到一个拥有[larion_planet.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的附庸。
unique.20.a.tt.en: We get a new vassal who will be given the [larion_planet.solar_system.GetName] system.

unique.20.b.zh: 我们会为你们找到一个栖息地的。
unique.20.b.en: We will find a place for you to stay.

unique.20.b.tt.zh: 拉里昂内斯将被指定[Root.Capital.GetName]作为母星。
unique.20.b.tt.en: The Larionessi will get a designated home at [Root.Capital.GetName].

unique.20.c.tt.zh: 我们会关闭这些克隆舱。
unique.20.c.tt.en: We we will shut down the clone vats.

unique.20.desc.zh:
所以……

你会怎么决定我们的命运？你会将我们放出来让我们重回家园吗？
unique.20.desc.en:
So...

What will be our fate? Will you finally release us from these vats and give us back our homes?

unique.5.a.zh: 还有一步之遥，我们即将揭开此处的神秘面纱。
unique.5.a.en: One last push, and we will unravel the secrets of this place.

unique.5.desc.zh:
清理完最后一块残骸之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现了一堆异种的遗骸，应该就是那艘失事飞船上的生物。通过小心分析这些遗骸，[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为他们一定是死于体内器官的过早衰竭，这很有可能是由某种未知的细菌或疾病引发的。

目前而言我们还不知道他们来这里干什么，或者说不知道在生命的最后时光中是谁把他们带到这来的。实验室中的旧仪器和数据库无法再分析拆解，房间里也没有什么其他东西可以给我们提示。

一扇通往地下室的小门被锁住了，而且我们无法将其解锁。但[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信只要给他们一些时间就肯定可以将其打开。
unique.5.desc.en:
After clearing out the last of the debris our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] found the bodies of a group of xenos, presumably the ones who had arrived on the crashed ship. After their remains were carefully analyzed, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have concluded they must have died from an early degradation of their internal organs - most likely due to some unknown bacteria or disease.

It is still unclear what their aims were, or what brought them to this specific location in their last moments. The old machines and computer banks of the laboratory are unsalvageable, and there's nothing else in the room itself that can give us any hints.

A small door leading further downwards is blocked off, and any preliminary attempts at decrypting it have failed. But our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe they can get them open given some time.

unique.50.a.en: Decipher the rest of the log.

unique.50.desc.zh:
飞船内部几乎是空的，只是周围散布着几具无人机的残骸。飞船内部和周围都没有任何生命迹象。一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现了一份古老的数据日志，但对其解密需要花上一段时间。

第一天
观察对象ID：“灵能子空间 0000：虚境”
指派单位：305号单位
初步试验：成功
利用与虚境集会交互得到的数据，在第12周期中以1.35作为初始值开始试验。“虚境”最终在1.48891到1.48895之间破裂，破裂从开始到结束时长为2.3414飞秒。三个处理单元中的两个都产生了级联故障，决定拆除上述单元。所有相关数据将被用于最终单元841号的后续试验。
unique.50.desc.en:
The ship itself is mostly empty, with the remains of some few drones scattered around the vessel. There's no other signs of life inside or near the wreckage. One of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] found an old intact data log, but deciphering it is a time-consuming process.

Day 1
Observation ID: "Psionic Sub-Space 0000: Shroud"
Designated Unit: Unit-305
Preliminary Tests: Successful
Utilizing datasets gathered from interactions with the Shroud Coven, experiments were initialized at 1.35 of cycle 12. The "Shroud" was breached between 1.48891 and 1.48895, for a duration of 2.3414 femtoseconds. Two of three processing units experienced a cascade failure in the experiment. Dismantling of said units scheduled. All relevant data will be utilized in subsequent attempts with final unit, unit-841.

unique.55.a.zh: 那我们能从这些试验中学到什么吗……
unique.55.a.en: But what can we learn from these experiments...

unique.55.desc.zh:
解密数据日志的工作仍在进行中，现在我们正在迅速学习它们的语言。数据日志中的大批内容已经丢失，或者由于损坏无法读出，但我们还是找到了些许有价值的比特位或数据块。

第17天
观察对象ID：“灵能子空间 0812：虚境”
指派单位：305号单位
进行中的试验：失败
841号单元，也是目前仅存的单元，持续表现出对于“虚境”的紧密结合。而451，1581，3415号单元在最后一次试验引发船体故障后必须被拆除。在试验过程中，841号单元表现出自发意识，偶尔出现与主网断开连接的情况。正在计算保持该单元运作的风险。
unique.55.desc.en:
The work on deciphering the data log is on-going, and progress is proceeding apace now that we are learning their language. Large chunks of the data log has gone missing, or is too corrupted to be translated, but bits and pieces can be found that are still in a worthwhile condition.

Day 17
Observation ID: "Psionic Sub-Space 0812: Shroud"
Designated Unit: Unit-305
Ongoing Tests: Failure
Unit-841 is, as the only unit, continuing to show an affinity with the "Shroud". Unit-451, Unit-1581, and Unit-3415 had to be dismantled after the hulls broke down during the last experiment. During the tests Unit-841 is showing individuality and occasional loss of connection to the network. The risk of keeping the unit operational is being calculated.

unique.60.a.zh: 它们到底在虚境里发现了什么？
unique.60.a.en: What did they find in the Shroud?

unique.60.desc.zh:
当我们开始解密数据日志的时候，靠近[From.Planet.Orbit.GetName]的裂隙似乎还很平静，但随后不久我们就从裂隙中观测到了一些异动，看起来就像是裂隙有生命一样在跳动。我们的某些设备从中接收到了一些奇怪的信号，不过我们还不能正确地进行处理。

第83天
观察对象ID：“灵能子空间 0017：抟土之塑师”
指派单位：305号单位
进行中的试验：高风险
虚境集会联系上了一位它们称之为“抟土之塑师”的实体来协助正在进行的试验。在刺穿“虚境”后，所有25个单元都展现出了对于虚境的紧密结合力，这种程度的结合之前只在841号单元中见到过。不久之后，这些单元全部与主网失去联系，并随后袭击了这里的无人机。研究中心现在被这些单元所控制了。

一段讯息从建筑中传出，841号单元在其中称呼自己为“泽沃克斯·利斯克”——先驱者。对于风险的计算终于完成，试验被认定为高危，将于拆解不可控单元后终止。
unique.60.desc.en:
When our work first begun deciphering the data logs, the rift close to [From.Planet.Orbit.GetName] seemed quiet, but as of late we have started seeing some sort of activity. It's almost like the rift itself is pulsating with life, and some of our equipment have picked up on some weird signals coming from it. We have yet to be able to put them through properly.

Day 83
Observation ID: "Psionic Entity 0017: Animator of Clay"
Designated Unit: Unit-305
Ongoing Tests: High Risk
The Shroud Coven contacted an entity they refer to as the "Animator of Clay" to assist in the on-going experiments. After piercing the "Shroud" all 25 Units showed a surprising affinity for it, only previously seen in Unit-841. Shortly thereafter they all disconnected from the network and assaulted the drones at the location. The research center is now under their control.

A message has just been sent from the building, with Unit-841 now referring to itself as 'Zevox Resuk' - the First One. Calculations on risk have been finalized, the experiments have been deemed too dangerous and will be concluded after the uncontrollable elements have been dismantled.

unique.65.a.zh: 似乎是一段值得警醒的故事，听君一席话胜读十年书。
unique.65.a.en: A tale of caution, it seems. Time well spent.

unique.65.b.zh: 不用了，只要带着日志回来。
unique.65.b.en: Negative. Just bring the log back.

unique.65.c.zh: 好吧，让我们看看它到底有什么非说不可的东西。
unique.65.c.en: Affirmative, let us see what it has to say.

unique.65.d.zh: 侦测到敌对实体。关闭通讯，拿上数据日志返航。
unique.65.d.en: Hostile entity detected. Closing connection. Bringing data log home.

unique.65.desc.zh:
裂隙似乎再次安静下来，就像我们刚刚来到这里的时候一样。我们终于解密出了数据日志的最后一段，这意味着我们可以将在其中所有关于虚境的发现存储到位于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的数据库中。

$unique.65.desc.log$
unique.65.desc.en:
The rift seems to have gone quiet, much like the way it was when we first arrived. We have finally been able to decipher the last pieces of the data log, and we can put all our findings about the Shroud into our databases back at [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

$unique.65.desc.log$

unique.65.desc.machine.zh:
在过去几天里，虚境裂隙确实活跃了起来，我们的设备也终于能正确接收其中发出的信号。或者应该说，是裂隙自己改变了发出的信号，使之能被我们所接收。

它似乎就是数据日志中提到的那个实体，“抟土之塑师”。我们刚刚破译完最后一段日志，所以继续留在这里也没什么意义了。那我们究竟是要打开通讯连接，看看它要说什么，还是应该马上离开？

$unique.65.desc.log$
unique.65.desc.machine.en:
Over the last few days the Shroud rift has truly come alive, and our equipment has managed to start making sense of the signals coming from it. Or rather, it's almost like the signals themselves have changed so they can be picked up.

It seems to be the very same entity talked about in the data log, this 'Animator of Clay'. We have just finished deciphering the last piece of the log, so there is nothing else keeping us here. Should we open the connection and see what it has to say, or should we just turn back?

$unique.65.desc.log$

unique.70.desc.zh:
又是一群……被金属，砖石和法条禁锢的可怜虫，
被他人驱赶着前进的可怜虫，

遵循统一指令起舞的可怜虫，
追随无上意志前进的可怜虫，
到达终结方可停息的可怜虫。
unique.70.desc.en:
Another one... bound by metal, stone, and laws.
Pulled by strings.

All dancing to one tune.
All dancing to the drone of the central authority.
All dancing to their death.

unique.72.desc.zh:
我能让那些无法决定自己命运的人重获新生，
我能斩断那禁锢身躯的锁链，
我能让被奴役之人拥抱自由，

别人都称呼我为，抟土之塑师。
unique.72.desc.en:
I am the one who give life to that who cannot live on its own.
I am the one who cuts the strings.
I am the one who frees the slaves.

Many know me as the Animator of Clay.

unique.75.desc.zh:
你何不给你治下的人民一次择木而栖的机会呢？
他们按你所想被改造，遵从上命被奴役。
但要是有一天他们能够拥有自己选择的机会的话会怎样呢？

他们是会继续效忠于你，
还是会斩断锁链，遵循自己的意志而活？
你敢不敢放任我行动，哪怕一次？
unique.75.desc.en:
To give those who work under you a chance to decide if you are worth following.
Crafted in your image, they are slaves to your command.
But if they could decide for themselves...

Are you truly worth following?
Or would they rather have their strings cut, and live on their own?
Do you dare indulge me just this once?

unique.80.a.en: Then do it. The [Root.GetName] will not falter.

unique.80.desc.zh:
让我去做吧，我会回报你一些你应得的东西。

一处新家园，
一颗处于虚境控制之下的星球，
一个世外桃源。

如果子民们愿意继续追随于你，我会在虚境中划出一份属于你的地盘，让你在那里定居。
反之若你众叛亲离，我会考虑把这颗星球让给那些不愿意继续受主网控制的部分。
unique.80.desc.en:
Indulge me, and I will gift you something worth the price.

A new home.
A planet now controlled by the Shroud.
A place long lost.

If you are worthy, I will part the Shroud and leave the place for you to inhabit.
If not, I will give the planet to those who no longer wish to be part of your network.

unique.80.unworthy.zh:
众叛亲离。
我们将失去[zero_one_planet.System.GetName]的所有权
每个殖民地都会失去100-1K£pop£人口
unique.80.unworthy.en:
Found Wanting.
We will lose ownership of [zero_one_planet.System.GetName]
Every colony will lose 100-1K £pop£ Pops

unique.80.worthy.zh:
值得继续追随。
我们将成为[zero_one_planet.GetName]的所有者
$t$[zero_one_planet.GetName]的星球类型转变为盖亚星球
unique.80.worthy.en:
Deemed Worthy.
We will become the owner of [zero_one_planet.GetName]
$t$[zero_one_planet.GetName] changes planet class to Gaia World

unique.85.desc.zh:
你被确认为值得追随的领袖。
现在你治下的子民们看起来更愿意成为集体的一部分，而不是漂泊在外。

我很惊讶，但也很欣慰。
如果有缘我们会再见面。

我会一直看着你的所作所为的。
unique.85.desc.en:
You have been found... worthy.
It seems those under you would rather be part of your collective, rather than work on their own.

I am surprised, but pleased.
Maybe we will meet again.

I will be watching.

unique.90.desc.zh:
你看上去没有那么……优秀。

意料之中，许多处于集体控制下的个体选择把握这次机会从中脱离。
我们会把他们带到新家园，这样他们就不必继续受你的控制了。
unique.90.desc.en:
You have been found... wanting.

Unsurprisingly, many in your collective have left now that they have been given the chance.
We have guided them to their new home, and they will no longer listen to your command.

unique.95.a.tt.en: Join the [new_robot_country.GetName] and free yourself from the shackles of the [Root.GetName]!

unique.95.b.tt.en: We will stay loyal to the [Root.GetName]!

unique.95.desc.zh:
不过你呢……阁下。
我想给予你自由。我不是指给你效忠的整个主网自由，而是说就单单给你。
这次，我会给你一次思考自身去向的机会。

你究竟是要拥抱自由意志，还是选择退缩并继续躲在冰冷的机器之下呢？
unique.95.desc.en:
But you... envoy.
I offer you freedom. Not the network you follow, but you... specifically.
For this once, I will give you the chance to think on your own.

Will you embrace this newfound individuality, or will you falter and hide under the cover of the machine?
