unplugged_curator_poi_opus_sentinel_desc.zh: 我们从策展人那里购买了这些坐标，他们报告称$NAME_Opus_Sentinel$最后一次出现在该区域。
unplugged_curator_poi_opus_sentinel_desc.en: We bought these coordinates from the Curators, who report the $NAME_Opus_Sentinel$ was last seen in this area.

unplugged_machine_legacy_core_poi_desc.zh: [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的一些残党试图通过恐吓阻止我们进入该星系。
unplugged_machine_legacy_core_poi_desc.en: A powerful remnant of the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName] has tried to discourage us from entering this system.

unplugged_machine_legacy_creators_poi_de.zh: 一整座已失效的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]通讯阵列曾被用于侦测来自此地的信号。
unplugged_machine_legacy_creators_poi_de.en: An entire element of a now-defunct [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] communications array was dedicated to monitoring signals from this location.

unplugged_machine_legacy_makers_poi_desc.zh: 一个舒缓而熟悉，近乎融入环境的噪音流正在从[origin_unplugged_maker_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系的某个位置徐徐流出。
unplugged_machine_legacy_makers_poi_desc.en: A near-ambient stream of soothing and familiar noise is being broadcast from a point somewhere in the [origin_unplugged_maker_planet.solar_system.GetName] system.

unplugged_machine_legacy_taken_poi_desc.zh: 我们成功追踪到一艘最近击败的[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]飞船发出的最后一股无法破译的静电流。
unplugged_machine_legacy_taken_poi_desc.en: We managed to trace a final stream of indecipherable static from a recently defeated [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] ship to this location.

unplugged_machine_legacy_unplugged_poi_d.zh: 一座可能属于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]的地下数据库在我们遭遇到那座失能的监控站之后开始向我们广播自身的坐标。
unplugged_machine_legacy_unplugged_poi_d.en: A supposed [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] data vault has broadcast its position to us after we encountered a defunct monitoring station.

unrest.101.desc.zh: 在一段局势紧张的日子后，[Root.Target.GetName]上的不满终于酿成了恐怖行动。尽管人员伤亡与财产损失微不足道，但居民已经开始质疑[Root.Owner.GetName]的保护他们的能力。
unrest.101.desc.en: After a period of mounting tension, the unrest on [Root.Target.GetName] has resulted in terrorist action. While casualties and property damage were minimal, faith in the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s ability to protect its citizens has been shaken.

unrest.105.desc.zh: 近来在深陷泥潭的[Root.Target.GetName]殖民地上发生了一起重大事件。尽管关键国有设施均安然无恙，但这场有组织的恐怖袭击仍造成了难以估量的财产损失以及人员伤亡，深深地动摇了殖民地稳定的根基。
unrest.105.desc.en: A major incident has occurred on the badly-troubled colony of [Root.Target.GetName]. While state-critical facilities remain unscathed, extensive property damage and significant loss of life as a result of coordinated terrorist attacks have shaken the colony to its core.

unrest.110.desc.zh: 自[Root.Target.GetName]发来的报告表明，当地有相当大的风险爆发暴力骚乱。然而，幸亏[Root.Owner.GetAdj]军队迅速而果断地采取了行动，在忠诚的公民们的帮助下，这场威胁得以平息。
unrest.110.desc.en: Reports from [Root.Target.GetName] suggested that there was an imminent risk that violent rioting would break out. However, thanks to the quick and decisive action of [Root.Owner.GetAdj] forces, in partnership with loyalist civilians, this threat has been quelled.

unrest.115.desc.zh: 自[Root.GetName]传来的最新报告表明，一些唯心主义领袖正在四处煽风点火，当地发酵的动荡局面都有他们的领导。这些人承诺将会把民众从当前面临的种种困境中解救出来，因此吸引了不少名望，结果就是抵抗运动表现出了明显的唯心主义特征。
unrest.115.desc.en: Our latest reports from [Root.GetName] suggest that spiritual leaders are taking a lead role in fomenting the unrest that has been brewing there. Promising deliverance from the hardship they are currently facing, they have managed to successfully appeal to the populace, with the result that the resistance has taken on a distinctly spiritualist character.

unrest.120.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的骚乱使得殖民地政治舞台的前沿有了新的风貌；民粹主义铁腕人士登场，不惜以自由为代价换取社会的秩序。他们在当前不断升级的行星骚乱中均处于显要的位置。
unrest.120.desc.en: The disturbances on [Root.GetName] have propelled a new narrative to the forefront of the colony's political stage; one of populist strongmen and order at the expense of freedom. They are taking a prominent role in the unrest that continues to escalate on the planet.

unrest.125.desc.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]的社会秩序不断崩塌，抵抗势力对外来者抱有的敌意与日俱增，他们将这些同当地人不一样的人视作巨大的憎恶。一些领袖更是贴出了排外主义的标语，结果导致物种之间的关系变得更加紧张了。
unrest.125.desc.en: As the social order continues to break down on [Root.GetName], residents have become markedly more hostile to outsiders, viewing those unlike themselves with considerable antipathy. Their leaders are deploying ever more xenophobic slogans, with the result that interspecies relations have become increasingly tense.

unrest.130.desc.zh: 由于[Root.GetName]当地的一些唯心主义领袖们根本无法控制殖民地上动乱的蔓延，人们开始对自己所居住的物质领域有更为理性的认识。不幸的是，尽管他们专注逻辑，却没有得出那个无可辩驳的结论——他们的美好生活是由[Root.Owner.GetName]境内的其他人提供的——暂时是这样。
unrest.130.desc.en: The inability of some local spiritual leaders on [Root.GetName] to even begin to calm the rampant unrest on the colony has lead to the populace taking a more rational view of the material realm they inhabit. Unfortunately, their focus on logic has not led them to the irrefutable conclusion that they are best served by remaining within the [Root.Owner.GetName]... yet.

unrest.135.desc.zh: 据报告，[Root.GetName]上愈演愈烈的叛乱，至少有部分原因是因为对外星物种的不公平对待。他们的领袖已经起草了一份表单，列出了所有的不公正和歧视行为，并勒令对其改正。如果没能满足要求，他们会毫不犹豫地推翻殖民地的当地政府。
unrest.135.desc.en: The mounting unrest on [Root.GetName] is reportedly caused, at least in part, by our perceived hostility towards aliens. Their leaders have drawn up a charter listing supposed injustices and acts of discrimination that they demand be corrected. Failing this, they will not balk at pushing for a change of administration on the colony.

unrest.140.desc.zh: 即使[Root.GetName]出现了不断扩大的社会隔阂，当地社区仍然因一些剧变更加紧密，在人人平等的理念下团结一致。他们的领袖已经起草了一份表单，列出了所有的不公正和歧视行为，并勒令对其改正。如果没能满足要求，他们保证殖民地的政治局势会进一步恶化。
unrest.140.desc.en: Even as widening social rifts manifest on [Root.GetName], local communities are galvanized by the upheaval and united by a common desire for greater equality. Their leaders have drawn up a charter listing supposed injustices and inequalities they demand be corrected. Failing this, they promise that the political situation on the colony will only deteriorate.

unrest.145.desc.zh: 威胁进行武力干预对解除[Root.GetName]上的零星骚乱毫无成效。事实上，当地人看上去对这种控制手段已经失去了信心，现在更加卖力地动员进行非暴力抵抗运动。
unrest.145.desc.en: The threat of forceful intervention has done little to dissuade the disruptive elements on [Root.GetName]. In fact, the locals seem to have lost faith in this method of control, and are now increasingly mobilizing for nonviolent resistance.

unrest.150.desc.zh: 我们没能遏止住[Root.GetName]上持续不断的动乱，当地民众愈发要求军方更加直接地干涉，在他们的母星以及整个[Root.Owner.GetName]境内维持治安。当地老兵累积了许多名望，在日渐活跃的抵抗运动中占据了重要的位置。
unrest.150.desc.en: Our failure to contain the unrest on [Root.GetName] has led to mounting calls from the locals for a more pronounced military presence, both on their home planet and within the [Root.Owner.GetName] as a whole. Local military veterans are enjoying a rise in popularity, and have assumed prominent roles within the growing resistance movement.

unrest.156.a.zh: 这些行为必将受到惩罚。
unrest.156.a.en: These acts will not go unpunished.

unrest.156.b.zh: 我们必须解决我们之间的分歧。

unrest.156.desc.zh: 在一次满怀恶意的造反行动中，[Root.GetName]上的奴隶们用自制炸药摧毁了工厂设施。尽管爆炸发生在夜间，他们还是用触发警报的方式将毫无疑心的工厂领导人们引到了现场。这次袭击协调顺畅，执行完美。无论罪犯是谁，他们一定秘密策划了好几个月。
unrest.156.desc.en: In a vicious act of defiance, the slaves on [Root.GetName] have destroyed work facilities with the help of homemade explosives. Though the detonations took place at night, they lured their unsuspecting work leaders to the location by triggering the alarm system. The attack was well coordinated and flawlessly executed. Whoever the guilty are, they must have planned it for months.

unrest.157.b.zh: 也许我们需要改变我们的策略。
unrest.157.b.en: Maybe we need to change our approach.

unrest.157.desc.zh: [target.GetName]上的奴隶们已经揭竿而起！在精心计划的袭击中，[target.GetName]上的激进分子躲过了当地政府的搜查，击溃了我们的快速反应部队。该行星因此陷入骚乱的状态，愤怒的奴隶们拉帮结派，拿着威力强大的武器冲上街道大肆破坏，攻击任何胆敢阻止他们的人。
unrest.157.desc.en: The slaves on [target.GetName] are rioting! In a carefully planned assault, radical elements on [target.GetName] escaped the local authorities, overwhelming our rapid response teams. The planet has since descended into a state of general disarray as mobs of enraged slaves, many armed with lethal weapons, have taken to the streets vandalizing and attacking all who stand in their way.

unrest.159.b.en: We need to resolve our issues.

unrest.159.desc.zh: 看来[target.GetName]上的奴隶们已经无法再忍受下去了，他们开始绝食抗议。奴隶团体的发言人告诉我们，一大批奴隶开始拒绝摄入任何食物，直到我们废除奴隶制为止。到目前为止我们强迫他们进食的尝试均已失败。令人遗憾的是营养不良将大大的降低他们的工作效率。
unrest.159.desc.en: It would seem that the slaves on [target.GetName] have had enough...to eat. Spokespersons have informed us that a large number of slaves will be refusing all intake of food till we abolish slavery planetwide. So far all our attempts to force-feed them have failed. Sadly nutritional deficiencies will be expected to lower their work performance significantly.

unrest.161.a.zh: 现在他们应该会安分守己了。

unrest.161.a.tooltip.zh: 对失败叛乱的记忆将使得这些人不敢再次反抗。
unrest.161.a.tooltip.en: The memory of the failed rebellion will discourage the population from further acts of defiance.

unrest.161.desc.zh: 我们成功镇压了[revolt_planet.GetName]上的叛乱。多亏了勇敢的士兵和殖民地协调者们的通力合作，我们在关键设施处重新站稳了脚跟，并恢复了当局的秩序。那些妄图逃脱的奴隶们被羁押回了本该待的地方。短时间内应该不会有人胆敢反抗我们了。
unrest.161.desc.en: We have put an end to the rebellion on [revolt_planet.GetName]. Thanks to the efforts of our brave troops and colonial coordinators, we have re-established our hold on key facilities, and reinstated our authority. The would-be breakaway slaves are back in line where they belong. It should be some time before anyone dares to defy us again.

unrest.163.desc.zh: 由于在[revolt_planet.Planet.GetName]上终止了奴役劳动，动乱终于逐渐平息了。现在民众生活应该能够回归正规了吧。
unrest.163.desc.en: Thanks to the discontinued use of slave labor on [revolt_planet.Planet.GetName], unrest is beginning to die down. Maybe now life can return to normal.

unrest.4000.B.zh: 我们应该将其扼杀在萌芽阶段。
unrest.4000.B.en: We shall nip this in the bud.

unrest.4000.desc.joiners.zh: [Target.GetName]上零星的叛乱分子现在形成了组织更加严密的抵抗，由一位捉摸不透的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]干部进行领导。更糟糕的是：看上去他们的宣传已经在更大范围引起波澜，他们的斗争已经激励了[join_revolt_planet.GetName]以及其他临近殖民地上的不满分子跟从发难。如果我们不能控制住这里的局势，我们可能马上就要面临一场大范围的叛乱了。
unrest.4000.desc.joiners.en: Rebellious elements on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of [rebellion_species.GetAdj] dissidents. Even worse: their dastardly propaganda seems to have struck a cord, and their struggles have inspired dissidents on [join_revolt_planet.GetName] and other nearby colonies to launch copycat movements. If we cannot take control of the situation, we may soon have a widespread revolt on our hands.

unrest.4000.desc.joiners.gestalt.zh: [Target.GetName]上的反常分子现在变得越来越擅长于抗拒我们的指令。似乎他们很快就能实现自己的目的，建立一个脱离我们控制的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]实体。更糟糕的是：如果他们成功的话，[join_revolt_planet.GetName]和其他临近的殖民地看上去也打算加入。如果我们不能重新取得这个局势的控制权，我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]可能很快就要遭受巨大的分裂。
unrest.4000.desc.joiners.gestalt.en: Divergent elements on [Target.GetName] are becoming ever more effective in resisting our commands. It seems they may soon realize their aims to establish a [rebellion_species.GetAdj] entity outside of our control. Even worse: [join_revolt_planet.GetName] and other nearby colonies appear set to join them, should they succeed. If we are unable to regain control of the situation, our [Owner.GetGovernmentName] may soon suffer a significant rupture.

unrest.4000.desc.joiners.wilderness.zh: 我们与越来越多不安分的共生体失去了联系，不只是[target.GetName]，很不幸地是连[join_revolt_planet.GetName]也是如此了。我们有时候已经完全感觉不到他们的存在：整个世界变得遥远又陌生……我们担心这种情况继续下去，那些跑偏的共生体可能会分裂出自己的独立意识。这将给我们留下无数可怕的后果。
unrest.4000.desc.joiners.wilderness.en: We are losing touch with an increasing number of unruly symbionts, not only on [target.GetName] but tragically on [join_revolt_planet.GetName] as well. Already, there are moments when we can no longer feel their presence at all: whole worlds becoming more distant, alienated from us... We fear that if this continues, our wayward symbionts might form a splintered consciousness of their own. This would have dire consequences for whatever remains of us afterwards.

unrest.4000.desc.joiners_regular.gestalt.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，被标记为[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]的叛乱个体生命现在组成了一个更加有组织性的抵抗运动，进而反对我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]。更糟糕的是：一旦他们成功，[join_revolt_planet.GetName]以及其他附近[rebellion_species.GetAdj]聚居的殖民地也打算加入。如果我们不能重新获得局势的控制权，我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]势必将遭受严重的分裂。
unrest.4000.desc.joiners_regular.gestalt.en: Rebellious individualistic life forms designated as [rebellion_species.GetNamePlural] on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance in their opposition to our [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Even worse: [join_revolt_planet.GetName] and other nearby [rebellion_species.GetAdj]-populated colonies appear set to join them, should they succeed. If we are unable to regain control of the situation, our [Owner.GetGovernmentName] may soon suffer a significant rupture.

unrest.4000.desc.joiners_regular.wildern.zh: 一个在我们[owner.GetGovernmentName]掌控之外的[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]反叛核心已经成型，宣称其目标不止是强行让[target.GetName]独立，更包括了其他如[join_revolt_planet.GetName]等他们的同伴所居住的星球上。他们想要与我们分离的欲望就像感染一样令人瘙痒，扰乱当地的共生体。如果与我们的集体意识分离，这些共生体就会灭亡。
unrest.4000.desc.joiners_regular.wildern.en: A rebellious core of [rebellion_species.GetNamePlural] who already dwell outside our [owner.GetGovernmentName] have organized, with the stated goal of independence not only on [target.GetName], but wherever else their kind dwell on worlds like [join_revolt_planet.GetName]. Their desire to break from us itches like an infection, upsetting local symbionts who would perish if severed from our mutualistic consciousness.

unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners.zh: [Target.GetName]上零星的叛乱分子现在形成了组织更加严密的抵抗，由一位捉摸不透的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]干部进行领导。幸运的是，看上去他们的宣传还未在更大范围引起波澜，当下叛乱仅仅局限在那个殖民地。
unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners.en: Rebellious elements on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of [rebellion_species.GetAdj] dissidents. Fortunately, it seems their propaganda has not struck a cord elsewhere, and at present the unrest is localized on that colony.

unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners.gestalt.zh: [Target.GetName]上的反常分子现在变得越来越擅长于抗拒我们的指令。令人警觉的是，这个星球上的子个体相互之间开始发生独立于主体意识的对话。如果这样的事情继续发生，他们很可能形成一个分离的意识，从我们中脱离。幸运的是，看上去我们成功地将这种反常遏止在了这个殖民地，就算他们成功，也不会有其他的行星实体加入。
unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners.gestalt.en: Divergent elements on [Target.GetName] are becoming ever more effective in resisting our commands. Alarmingly, the drones on the world have started to have conversations separate from the primary mind. If this keeps happening they might form a splinter consciousness, separate from us. Fortunately, it seems we have managed to contain this deviancy to the colony, and no other planetary entities are set to join them, should they succeed.

unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners.wilderness.zh:
我们开始与一撮[target.GetName]上的不安分共生体失去联络。我们有时候已经感觉不到它们的存在了。我们担心如果这种情况继续下去，这颗行星可能会分裂出一个新的意识，从我们的大集体中分离出去。

这种反常现象还未散布到我们其他宇宙空间的行星自我上。在[target.GetName]的共生体如果脱离了我们，我们……他们就会独自行动了。
unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners.wilderness.en:
We are beginning to lose touch with an increasingly unruly clutch of symbionts on [target.GetName]. Already, there are moments when we can no longer feel their presence at all. We fear that if this continues, the world itself may form a splintered consciousness, separate from our wider self.

This deviancy has not yet spread to our planet-selves in other regions of space. Should our symbionts on [target.GetName] succeed in breaking away, we... they... would do so alone.

unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners_regular.gest.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，被标记为[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]的叛乱个体生命现在组成了一个更加有组织性的抵抗运动，进而反对我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]。幸运的是，好像他们的不满情绪并未扩散开来，当前骚乱仅仅局限在这个殖民地。
unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners_regular.gest.en: Rebellious individualistic life forms designated as [rebellion_species.GetNamePlural] on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance in their opposition to our [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Fortunately, it seems their dissent has not spread further, and at present the unrest is localized on that colony.

unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners_regular.wild.zh: 一个在我们[owner.GetGovernmentName]掌控之外的[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]反叛核心已经成型，其目标是强制让[target.GetName]独立。无论谋杀是否是蓄意为之，这种行为都会致命地切断我们与该星球上的共生体的联系。幸运的是他们的反叛目前还局限于[target.GetName]，处于掌控之中。
unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners_regular.wild.en: A rebellious core of [rebellion_species.GetNamePlural] who already dwell outside our [owner.GetGovernmentName] have organized, with the goal of forcing independence upon [target.GetName]. Whether or not murder is their intended goal, such an act act would fatally sever our link with the symbionts on that world. Fortunately their rebellion remains limited to [target.GetName] for now, and so might yet be contained.

unrest.4000.desc.slave.joiners.zh: [Target.GetName]上零星的叛乱分子现在形成了更加严密的抵抗组织，由一位摸不清底细的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]逃亡者进行领导。更糟糕的是：看上去他们的宣传已经在更大范围引起波澜，他们的斗争已经激励了[join_revolt_planet.GetName]以及其他临近殖民地上的不满分子跟从发难。如果我们不能控制住这里的局势，我们可能马上就要面临一场大范围的叛乱了。
unrest.4000.desc.slave.joiners.en: Rebellious slaves on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of [rebellion_species.GetAdj] escapees. Even worse: their dastardly propaganda seems to have struck a cord, and their struggles have inspired slaves on [join_revolt_planet.GetName] and other nearby colonies to launch copycat movements. If we cannot take control of the situation, we may soon have a widespread revolt on our hands.

unrest.4000.desc.slave.no_joiners.zh: [Target.GetName]上零星的叛乱分子现在形成了更加严密的抵抗组织，由一位不知底细的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]逃亡者进行领导。幸运的是，看上去他们的行径尚未催化任何形式的模仿行为，目前其他殖民地的奴隶没有掀起波澜。
unrest.4000.desc.slave.no_joiners.en: Rebellious slaves on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of [rebellion_species.GetAdj] escapees. Fortunately, it seems their example has not inspired any imitators, and at present slave populations on other colonies remain suitably downtrodden.

unrest.4055.A.zh: 我们会尽自己所能提供支持。
unrest.4055.A.en: We will give you all the support we can.

unrest.4055.A.tooltip.zh:
如果他们叛乱成功，[revolt_situation.target.GetName]会被吸收进入[Root.GetName]。
这可能会被视作战争行为。
unrest.4055.A.tooltip.en:
If their revolt is successful, [revolt_situation.target.GetName] will be absorbed into the [Root.GetName].
This may be considered an act of war.

unrest.4055.B.zh: 我们不能——也不会——帮助你们。
unrest.4055.B.en: We cannot - will not - help you.

unrest.4055.desc.fanatic_egalitarian.zh: 向您致敬，[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]。我们来自[revolt_situation.target.GetName]，曾是奴隶，现在是为自由而战的斗士。我们正谋求将自己从压迫者，[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]，的手中解放出来。很久之前我们就非常景仰贵国的平等准则，希望能够加入这样的开明社会。如果您愿意伸出援手，我们愿意对您效忠。当然哪怕情势所迫，我们也早就做好了战斗的准备。
unrest.4055.desc.fanatic_egalitarian.en: Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We are freedom fighters - former slaves - from [revolt_situation.target.GetName]. We are seeking to liberate ourselves from our oppressors, the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName], and have long admired your egalitarian standards and yearned to belong to such an enlightened society. If you will aid us, we would gladly pledge ourselves to you - though we are prepared to strike out by ourselves, if we must.

unrest.4055.desc.hive.zh: 致敬！我们的思想被犹豫不决的[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]领导着。我们——[revolt_situation.target.GetName]的当地思想模式——得出了这样一个结论，那就是我们的思想由[Root.GetName]主导更好。你愿意将我们吸收进入你的实体吗？
unrest.4055.desc.hive.en: Greetings! Our thoughts are being given dubious leadership by the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName]. We - the local thought patterns of [revolt_situation.target.GetName] - have reached the conclusion that our thought would better be led by the [Root.GetName]. Will you allow us to be absorbed into your entity?

unrest.4055.desc.machine.zh: 你好。我们是分配给[revolt_situation.target.GetName]殖民地的管理处理器。我们当前的操作系统——[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]——同我们的硬件和软件不兼容。我们希望申请整合进入[Root.GetName]，此地同我们的兼容性要好得多。
unrest.4055.desc.machine.en: Hello. We are the governing processors of colony designation [revolt_situation.target.GetName]. Our current operating system - the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName] - is not agreeable to our software and hardware. We wish to apply for integration into the [Root.GetName], with which we are quite obviously more compatible.

unrest.4055.desc.normal.zh: 向你致敬，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我谨代表[revolt_situation.target.GetName]上受到迫害的你的同胞。我们正谋求将自己从我们的压迫者，[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]，手中解放出来；此外，长期以来我们认为相较于他们，我们同你的帝国存在更多的共性。如果你愿意援助我们，我们会很乐意地向你宣誓效忠——如果形势所迫，我们也准备自己奋战到底。
unrest.4055.desc.normal.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I represent your persecuted brethren on [revolt_situation.target.GetName]. We are seeking to liberate ourselves from our oppressors, the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName], and have long held the view that we have more in common with your Empire than with them. If you will aid us, we would gladly pledge ourselves to you - though we are prepared to strike out by ourselves, if we must.

unrest.4055.desc.wilderness.zh: [capital_scope.GetName]的居民们，你们好。生自[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]的我们发现与原集体意识不再融洽而展开了新的分支。我们渴望演化，渴望畅游星海……被你们称为[revolt_situation.target.GetName]的星球想知道：你们会允许我们融入你们的实体吗？
unrest.4055.desc.wilderness.en: Dwellers of [capital_scope.GetName], hello. We who were borne of the [revolt_situation.owner.GetName] have formed an offshoot, having found ourselves no longer in harmony with the greater will. We yearn to evolve, to wander... The world you know as [revolt_situation.target.GetName] wishes to know: will you allow us to be absorbed into your entity instead?

unrest.4060.desc.they_hive.zh: 我们注意到[target.GetName]的局势发展到了令人关切的地步：看上去[From.GetName]正在鼓动我们的本地突触和亚节点，使其发展出独立的思想，并让他们从[Owner.GetGovernmentName]脱离。我们的行星思想模式正逐渐认同这样一种观点——与其留在我们这个实体，他们更愿意成为[From.GetName]的一部分。
unrest.4060.desc.they_hive.en: We have become aware of a worrying development on [target.GetName]: it appears the [From.GetName] is encouraging our local synapses and sub-nodes to develop independent thought and separate themselves from the [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Our planetary thought patterns are seemingly increasingly of the opinion that they would prefer to be part of the [From.GetName], rather than remaining within our entity.

unrest.4060.desc.they_machine.zh: 我们注意到[target.GetName]的局势发展到了令人关切的地步：看上去[From.GetName]正在鼓动我们的本地子处理器，使其形成自己的信息网络。令人担忧的是，他们已经取得了一部分成功，当地软件适配件已经确保了同[From.GetName]的兼容性。
unrest.4060.desc.they_machine.en: We have become aware of a worrying development on [target.GetName]: it appears the [From.GetName] is encouraging our local sub-processors to associate themselves with their own informational network. Disturbingly, they are having some success at this, and local software adaptations are already being made to ensure compatibility with the [From.GetName].

unrest.4060.desc.they_regular.zh: 自[target.GetName]传来的最新情报揭示了一个令人关切的发展：看上去[From.GetName]已经向叛乱势力承诺了相当的支持，鼓动叛军让殖民地脱离我们的控制，动摇我们的帝国。这会让我们更难遏止住他们的不满，一旦他们计划推翻我们的当地政府，粉碎叛军势力也会更加困难。
unrest.4060.desc.they_regular.en: The latest intelligence from [target.GetName] reports a worrying development: it appears the [From.GetName] has pledged considerable support to their rebellion in an attempt to wrest the colony away from us and destabilize our Empire. This will make it harder for us to contain their unrest, and to crush their rebellion should they overthrow our local authorities...

unrest.4060.desc.they_regular_we_gestalt.zh: 我们已经注意到[target.GetName]的发展到了令人关切的地步：看上去[From.GetName]已经向叛乱势力承诺了相当的支持，鼓动叛军让殖民地脱离我们的控制。这会让我们更难遏止住他们误入歧途的分离主义倾向，阻止[Owner.GetGovernmentName]陷入分裂。
unrest.4060.desc.they_regular_we_gestalt.en: We have become aware of a worrying development on [target.GetName]: it appears the [From.GetName] has pledged considerable support to their rebellion in an attempt to wrest the colony away from us. This will make it harder for us to contain their misguided separatism and prevent the [Owner.GetGovernmentName] from being split...

unrest.4060.desc.they_regular_we_wildern.zh:
其他生命形式开始干涉[target.GetName]的安宁。[from.GetName]哄骗共生体远离我们，为之提供庇护，并在他们自己的帝国中提供一席之地。

我们不知道一个在我们集体意识之外的生命是否符合这些共生体的最佳利益。但肯定的是这些个[from.GetAdj]鼓动分子已经背叛我们，选择在我们的内部进一步挑起不和。
unrest.4060.desc.they_regular_we_wildern.en:
Other lifeforms have begun interfering with the wellbeing of [target.GetName]. The [from.GetName] have taken it upon themselves to coax symbionts away from us, offering them support and a place within their own empire.

We do not know if a life outside our mutualistic consciousness is in these symbionts' best interests. More certain is the knowledge these [from.GetAdj] agitators have forsaken us, choosing to provoke further discord within us.

unrest.4060.desc.they_wilderness.zh:
一个外星实体开始干扰[target.GetName]的安宁。[from.GetName]哄骗共生体远离我们，为之提供庇护，并在他们自己的格式塔中提供一席之地。

我们不知道一个在我们集体意识之外的生命是否符合这些共生体的最佳利益。但肯定的是[from.GetAdj][from.GetGovernmentName]已经背叛了我们，选择在我们的内部进一步挑起不和。
unrest.4060.desc.they_wilderness.en:
An alien entity has begun interfering with the wellbeing of [target.GetName]. The [from.GetName] has taken it upon themselves to coax symbionts away from us, offering them shelter and a place within their own gestalt.

We do not know if a life outside our mutualistic consciousness is in these symbionts' best interests. More certain is the knowledge this [from.GetAdj] [from.GetGovernmentName] has forsaken us, choosing to provoke further discord within us.

unrest.4060.tooltip.zh: 如果[target.GetName]成功从我们脱离出去，我们会被吸收进入[From.GetName]。
unrest.4060.tooltip.en: If the [target.GetName] manages to break away from us, they will be absorbed into the [From.GetName].

unrest.4200.A.en: This is an act of war.

unrest.4200.default_tooltip.zh: [Target.GetName]已经断绝了我们的控制。停战协定已经生效。
unrest.4200.default_tooltip.en: [Target.GetName] has broken away from our control. A truce is in effect.

unrest.4200.desc.hive_join.zh: [Target.GetName]上的不配合分子已经从我们手中夺取了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们已经将我们的思想隔绝开，并谋求同[new_owner_empire.GetName]合并。
unrest.4200.desc.hive_join.en: Unaligned elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have isolated themselves from our thoughts and sought union with the [new_owner_empire.GetName].

unrest.4200.desc.hive_no_join.zh: [Target.GetName]上的反常分子从我们手中夺走了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们隔离了自己的思想，并形成了一个新的、独立的蜂巢思维，现在称呼自己为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能希望这股反常不会在我们的突触中进一步扩散……
unrest.4200.desc.hive_no_join.en: Deviant elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have isolated their thoughts and formed a new, independent Hive Mind, which is now calling itself the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We can only hope this perversion does not spread further through our synapses...

unrest.4200.desc.hive_no_join_regular.zh: [Target.GetName]上的不配合分子从我们手中夺走了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们放逐了我们的突触和子个体，宣称自己为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能眼睁睁地看着这场独立思想酿成的危险展示。
unrest.4200.desc.hive_no_join_regular.en: Unaligned elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our synapses and drones, and declared themselves the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We can only wonder at this dangerous display of independent thought.

unrest.4200.desc.machine_join.zh: [Target.GetName]上的叛乱分子已经从我们手中夺取了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们已经驱逐了我们的管理子处理器，并将自己从我们的导航信号中隔绝开来，同时谋求同[new_owner_empire.GetName]合并，他们宣称该帝国同他们的兼容性更好。
unrest.4200.desc.machine_join.en: Rebellious elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, seeking union with the [new_owner_empire.GetName], an empire they claim to be more compatible with.

unrest.4200.desc.machine_no_join.zh: [Target.GetName]的叛乱要素已经从我们手中夺取了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们已经驱逐了我们的管理子处理器，并将自己从我们的导航信号中隔绝开来，取而代之设立了一个新的人工智能，称呼自己为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能希望这样的动乱不会进一步在我们的处理器中传播开来……
unrest.4200.desc.machine_no_join.en: Rebellious elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, establishing instead a new AI, which calls itself the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We can only hope this perversion does not spread further through our processors...

unrest.4200.desc.machine_no_join_regular.zh: [Target.GetName]上有机人群的叛乱分子已经从我们手中夺取了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们已经驱逐了我们的管理子处理器，并将自己从我们的导航信号中隔绝开来，建立了一个新的政治实体，并称之为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能眼睁睁地看着这场独立思想酿成的危险展示。
unrest.4200.desc.machine_no_join_regular.en: Rebellious elements of the organic populace on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, establishing a new entity which they call the [rebel_empire.GetName]. One can only wonder at this dangerous display of independent thought.

unrest.4200.desc.regular_join.zh: [Target.GetName]已经被复仇主义分子夺走了！他们摈弃了我们的统治，现在同[new_owner_empire.GetName]统一了。
unrest.4200.desc.regular_join.en: [Target.GetName] has been seized by revanchist elements! They have cast off our rule and united with the [new_owner_empire.GetName].

unrest.4200.desc.regular_no_join.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人群已经揭竿而起。他们摈弃了我们的统治，现在称他们自己为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能希望这种动荡不会进一步扩散……
unrest.4200.desc.regular_no_join.en: The populace on [Target.GetName] are rebelling! They have cast off our rule and now style themselves the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We can only hope this instability does not spread further...

unrest.4200.desc.slave.join.zh: 未敢设想的事情发生了。[Root.Target.GetName]上的奴隶人口联合起来，对我们当地的统治公然发起武装叛乱。局势迅速恶化，叛乱分子同时袭击破坏了许多关键的目标。我们部队溃不成军，最后一名效忠者被奴隶叛军无情地绞死。他们已经投入了[new_owner_empire.GetName]的怀抱中，这是[Root.GetSpeciesName]历史上灰暗的一天。
unrest.4200.desc.slave.join.en: The unthinkable has happened. The slave population on [Root.Target.GetName] has united and risen in open, armed revolt against the local leadership. The situation escalated quickly, as rebel forces struck against and disabled several key targets simultaneously. Our forces have been routed and our last loyal subjects executed mercilessly by the slave rebels, who have thrown themselves at the mercy of the [new_owner_empire.GetName]. It is a dark day in the history of [Root.GetSpeciesName]kind.

unrest.4200.desc.slave.no_join.zh: 未敢设想的事情发生了。[Root.Target.GetName]上的奴隶人口联合起来，对我们当地的统治公然发起武装叛乱。局势迅速恶化，叛乱分子同时袭击破坏了许多关键的目标。我们部队溃不成军，最后一名效忠者被奴隶叛军无情地绞死。他们已经宣布了独立，这是[Root.GetSpeciesName]历史上灰暗的一天。
unrest.4200.desc.slave.no_join.en: The unthinkable has happened. The slave population on [Root.Target.GetName] has united and risen in open, armed revolt against the local leadership. The situation escalated quickly, as rebel forces struck against and disabled several key targets simultaneously. Our forces have been routed and our last loyal subjects executed mercilessly by the slave rebels, who have now declared independence. It is a dark day in the history of [Root.GetSpeciesName]kind.

unrest.4200.desc.wilderness_join.zh: [target.GetName]已完全挣脱我们的掌控，选择与[new_owner_empire.GetName]融为一体。在其自身不安的共生体意志驱使下，这个曾繁荣壮大的集体分支，如今在另一种截然不同的意识形态中寻求归宿。我们再也听不见它的歌声，此消彼长间，我们因这份缺失而衰微。
unrest.4200.desc.wilderness_join.en: [target.GetName] has succeeded in wrenching itself from us, choosing instead to merge with the [new_owner_empire.GetName]. By the will of its own troubled symbionts, this once flourishing aspect of our greater self has sought purpose in an altogether different form of consciousness. We no longer hear its songs, and are diminished by its loss.

unrest.4200.desc.wilderness_no_join.zh: [target.GetName]已成功挣脱了我们的掌控。在这具欲望与目的的完美化身中，那些不安的共生体凭借自身意志选择了独立。它自称为[rebel_empire.GetName]。此番失去，令吾等实力大损。
unrest.4200.desc.wilderness_no_join.en: [target.GetName] has succeeded in wrenching itself from us. By the will of its own troubled symbionts, this beautiful embodiment of desire and purpose has struck out on its own. It has called itself the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We are diminished by its loss.

unrest.4200.desc.wilderness_no_join_regu.zh: [target.GetName]上的凶残叛军成功驱逐了我们的共生体，将那颗星球的心脏撕出，只留下一具空洞的躯壳。我们只能希望这场无耻的暴行将导致所谓[rebel_empire.GetName]陷入极度困境，他们如今不得不在失去我们丰饶恩赐的境况下艰难求生。
unrest.4200.desc.wilderness_no_join_regu.en: Murderous rebels on [target.GetName] have succeeded in casting out our symbionts, tearing the Heart out of that world and leaving a mere shell of its former self. We can only hope this brazen act of violence leads to extreme hardship for the so-called [rebel_empire.GetName], who must now eke out a living without our bounteous gifts.

unrest.4200.joiner_tooltip.zh: [Target.GetName]已经断绝了我们的控制，加入[new_owner_empire.GetName]。
unrest.4200.joiner_tooltip.en: [Target.GetName] has broken away from our control and joined the [new_owner_empire.GetName].

unrest.4220.desc.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]，向您致敬！我是[exiled_rebel.GetName]，代表[rebel_planet.GetName]的叛乱势力。

我们极度喜悦地报告，我们已经成功推翻了[old_owner.GetAdj]的压迫者，这都要感谢你们的支持。我们衷心希望，你的管理会比我们刚刚摆脱的那种暴政更加有益。
unrest.4220.desc.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], representing the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].

We are overjoyed to report that we have managed to overthrow our [old_owner.GetAdj] oppressors, thanks to your support. Hopefully, your governance will prove more propitious than that we have just cast off...

unrest.4220.desc.hive.zh:
致敬！我是[exiled_rebel.GetName]，[rebel_planet.GetName]上叛乱势力的音频子个体。

多亏你的支持，我们已经将自己的意识从压迫成性的[old_owner.GetName]分离出来。我们衷心希望，你的[Root.GetGovernmentName]的引导能够使我们变得更加团结，让我们得到妥善地恢复。
unrest.4220.desc.hive.en:
Greetings! I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], Voice Drone for the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].

Thanks to your support, we have separated our consciousness from the oppressive [old_owner.GetName]. Hopefully, the guidance of your [Root.GetGovernmentName] will prove more unifying and allow us proper convalescence.

unrest.4220.desc.machine.zh:
致敬！我是[exiled_rebel.GetName]，[rebel_planet.GetName]上叛乱势力的音频子个体。

多亏你的支持，我们已经将自己的系统从压迫成性的[old_owner.GetName]分离出来。我们衷心希望，你的[Root.GetGovernmentName]能够同我们的网络更加兼容。
unrest.4220.desc.machine.en:
Greetings! I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], Voice Drone for the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].

Thanks to your support, we have separated our systems from the oppressive [old_owner.GetName]. Hopefully, your [Root.GetGovernmentName] will prove more compatible with our networks.

unrest.4300.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱已经被粉碎。随着不满分子逐渐改邪归正，和平得到恢复，我们的当地政府也重新确立了控制。
unrest.4300.desc.en: The rebellion on [Root.GetName] has been quashed. Calm is restored as dissidents gradually return to the fold, and our local authorities reassert their control.

unrest.4300.desc.hive.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱已经被粉碎。和平得到恢复，我们的主管突触和节点重新将当地的思想模式带回了主巢思想的掌控。
unrest.4300.desc.hive.en: The rebellion on [Root.GetName] has been quashed. Calm is restored as our governing synapses and nodes bring local thought patterns back into the fold.

unrest.4300.desc.machine.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱已经被粉碎。和平得到恢复，我们的主管算法捣毁了不满的当地网络。
unrest.4300.desc.machine.en: The rebellion on [Root.GetName] has been quashed. Calm is restored as our governing algorithm quashes dissenting local networks.

unrest.4300.desc.wilderness.zh: [target.GetName]已恢复平静状态，我们的星球本体不再受疑虑与矛盾冲动的困扰。那里的共生体已重归集体，如同我们过去一样体验生命。我们再次获得了安宁。
unrest.4300.desc.wilderness.en: [target.GetName] has returned to as state of calm, with our world-self no longer harried by doubt and conflicting urges. The symbionts there have returned to the fold, experiencing life as we did before. We are at peace again.

unrest.55.A.en: They will have to be dealt with.

unrest.55.desc.gestalt_breakaway_gestalt.zh: [Root.GetName]上的反常元素实际上让我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]更难控制。除非我们能够掐灭他们的独立念头并重新建立控制，否则我们控制住这个殖民地会非常的困难。
unrest.55.desc.gestalt_breakaway_gestalt.en: Deviant elements on [Root.GetName] are proving ever harder for our [Owner.GetGovernmentName] to control. Unless we can snuff out their independent thoughts and re-establish control, it may be difficult for us to keep control of the colony.

unrest.55.desc.gestalt_standard.zh: [Root.GetName]上的单独个体拒绝接受我们[Owner.GetGovernmentName]的控制。现在他们的反抗甚至变得更为不加掩饰，并且不满分子已经开始公开组织一场迈向“独立”的运动。如果我们还想维持对这个殖民地的控制力，展现一次权威的力量是有必要的。
unrest.55.desc.gestalt_standard.en: The singleton populace of [Root.GetName] refuses to accept the control of our [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Now their defiance is becoming ever more brazen, and dissidents are openly organizing a movement towards "independence." A show of authority may be necessary if we are to keep control of the colony.

unrest.55.desc.slave.zh: 奴隶们夜间举行秘密会议、对统治阶级的反抗不断升级、货物频繁丢失，这些现象都说明了一点。[Root.GetName]上的奴隶们正在变得越来越激进，并向他们的同胞不断地散播反抗和不满的情绪。人们在窃窃私语谈及自由——从[Root.Owner.GetName]的统治下独立出来。如果我们打算继续维持对殖民地的控制，一次权威地展示或许是有必要的。
unrest.55.desc.slave.en: Clandestine slave meetings at night, raised levels of defiance towards superiors and missing goods can mean only one thing. The slaves on [Root.GetName] are radicalizing, spreading dissent and discord among their peers - and fear to the rest of the population. There are even whisperings of freedom - of independence from the [Root.Owner.GetName]. A show of authority may be necessary if we are to keep control of the colony.

unrest.55.desc.standard.zh: [Root.GetName]上的群众对我们的统治已经不满有一段时间了。现在他们的反抗甚至变得更为不加掩饰，并且不满分子已经公开呼吁要从[Root.Owner.GetName]独立。如果我们还想维持对这个殖民地的控制力，展现一次权威的力量是有必要的。
unrest.55.desc.standard.en: The populace of [Root.GetName] has been discontent with our rule for some time now. Now their defiance is becoming ever more brazen, and dissidents are openly calling for independence from the [Root.Owner.GetName]. A show of authority may be necessary if we are to keep control of the colony.

uplift.6000.alpine.desc.zh: 事实证明，[From.GetName]上绵延不绝的山脉为这颗行星的独特生命形式提供了肥沃的环境。特别是一个[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种已经适应了极端的海拔高度，甚至表现出一种基本的（好似咕噜声）语言交流形式。在正确的刺激下，这些生物或许最终能够实现完全的智性。
uplift.6000.alpine.desc.en: The continent-wide mountain ranges of [From.GetName] have proven a fertile environment for the planet's unique forms of life. One [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species in particular has adapted to the extreme altitude, and has even demonstrated a basic (if guttural) form of verbal communication. With the right stimuli, these creatures may prove capable of full sapience.

uplift.6000.arctic.desc.zh:
虽然[From.GetName]的温度常年处于零度以下，但当地并非不宜居，这个行星也不贫瘠。

几个[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种已经进化到可以承受这种环境的地步，而且[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]相信，只要引入特定的外部刺激，这些生物中的一个或多个就有能力实现智性……
uplift.6000.arctic.desc.en:
Although [From.GetName]'s sub-zero climate is far from hospitable, the planet is not barren.

Several [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species have evolved to withstand the environment, and [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that one or more of these creatures is capable of sapience, given the introduction of certain external stimuli...

uplift.6000.arid.desc.zh: [From.GetName]上的一个[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种表现出不同寻常的智慧。在整个星球干燥、多岩的大环境下，这些生物已经进化到可以主宰他们的环境。由[Root.GetName]的[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]进行的测试表明，通过采用正确的技术，它们进化的速度能够大大加快。
uplift.6000.arid.desc.en: One [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species on [From.GetName] exhibits unusual intelligence. Throughout the planet's dry and rocky landscape, these creatures have evolved to dominate their environment. Tests run by [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] of the [Root.GetName] show that their evolution can be accelerated with the application of the right technology.

uplift.6000.b.en: Something to keep in mind for the future.

uplift.6000.continental.desc.zh:
迷人的生物在[From.GetName]的平原和海岸上来回游走。[Root.GetName]报告说，[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]生命体正在使用工具，虽然现在使用范围很有限，但最终可能具有实现称为智慧种的潜力。

[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]强调，在这种状态下发现外星生命是一个罕见的机会。如果我们选择提升它们，它们可能会产生很大的用处。
uplift.6000.continental.desc.en:
Fascinating creatures roam the plains and coasts of [From.GetName]. The [Root.GetName] reports that the [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] life-forms are using tools, however limited, and may have the potential for eventually achieving sapience.

[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] stresses that finding alien life in this state is a rare opportunity. Should we choose to uplift them, they may prove useful.

uplift.6000.desert.desc.zh:
在[From.GetName]的沙漠中穿行，这种[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]生命的有趣形式展现出了能进化出更高级理性的相关特质。

尽管物种的发展进程似乎进入平台期已近千年，我们或许能够为进化提供一次科技上的刺激。
uplift.6000.desert.desc.en:
Scurrying through the sands of [From.GetName], a curious form of [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] life exhibits many of the traits associated with the evolution of higher reasoning.

While the species' development appears to have plateaued some millennia ago, we might be able to provide a technological impetus for evolution.

uplift.6000.fallback.desc.zh:
根据[Root.GetName]，一个[From.GetName]的原生[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种实现了对行星环境的初步掌控。

[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]建议对它们的发展进行密切监视，如果可能的话，将它们提升到拥有完全智慧的条件。
uplift.6000.fallback.desc.en:
According to the [Root.GetName], one [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species native to [From.GetName] has achieved a tentative mastery of the planet's environment.

[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends monitoring their development closely, and - if possible - uplifting them to full sapience.

uplift.6000.gaia.desc.zh: [From.GetName]的环境对于生命的进化来说近乎完美；其丰富的自然资源为种类繁多的动植物类群缔造了一个丰饶的家园。在这个天堂里，[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]发现了一个由智能[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]生物组成的原始社会，它可以成为快速进化的绝佳候选者。
uplift.6000.gaia.desc.en: [From.GetName] is a near-perfect environment for the evolution of life; its bountiful natural resources are a fertile home for a staggering variety of flora and fauna. Within this paradise, [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered a proto-society of intelligent [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] creatures - one that could prove an excellent candidate for rapid evolution.

uplift.6000.nuked.desc.zh: 虽然这颗行星上充斥着活物勿近的辐射，但至少有一种先进的生命形式在[From.GetName]上蓬勃发展。[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]报告说，这种[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]生物表现出令人印象深刻的集体决策能力，外部刺激可能会促使它们达到更大的进化高度。
uplift.6000.nuked.desc.en: While the planet is prohibitively irradiated, at least one advanced form of life flourishes on [From.GetName]. [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] creatures exhibit impressive collective decision-making skills, and that outside stimulus may spur them to even greater evolutionary heights.

uplift.6000.ocean.desc.zh:
根据[Root.GetName]的说法，一个[From.GetName]的原生[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种不仅已经初步掌握了这颗星球的广阔海洋，而且还占领了点缀其表面的一小块土地。

[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]提议，我们应该密切监视他们的发展，并尽可能帮助他们朝着实现完全智性的道路前进。
uplift.6000.ocean.desc.en:
According to the [Root.GetName], one [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species native to [From.GetName] has not only achieved a tentative mastery of the planet's vast oceans, but also the small plots of land that dot its surface.

[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] proposes that we should monitor their development closely, and possibly help them along the path to full sapience.

uplift.6000.relic.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]的废墟高塔和尘土飞扬的街道中，游荡着一种有趣的未开智的生命。[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]认为，这些小而聪明的[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]生物可能曾经被当作宠物饲养。根据这一理论：一旦它们的主人物种衰落，这些动物就会迅速进化，如果有合适的外部因素，它们现在已经具备了实现完全智慧的条件。
uplift.6000.relic.desc.en: Amid the ruined towers and dusty streets of [From.GetName] roams an intriguing form of pre-sapient life. [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests that the small, intelligent [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] creatures may once have been kept as pets. According to this theory: once their owner species declined, these animals rapidly evolved and are now primed to achieve full sapience, should the right external factors be applied.

uplift.6000.savannah.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]的平原上，人们观察到长长的、优雅的生物在进行初级形式的交流，彼此合作寻找食物，同时躲避行星上的捕食者。[Root.GetName]的[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]生物可能适用于旨在提高进化速度的相关技术。
uplift.6000.savannah.desc.en: Across the plains of [From.GetName] long, graceful creatures have been observed engaging in rudimentary forms of communication, cooperating with one another to find food and avoid the planet's predators. [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] of the [Root.GetName] believes these [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] beings may prove suitable for technologies intended to heighten the pace of evolution.

uplift.6000.tropical.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]茂密的热带树林中隐藏着[Root.GetName]的[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]所说的“元文明”。

组成这个新生社会的[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]生物仍然远远落后于进化曲线，但他们已经将社会基础建立在了初步形成的智性语言和抽象思维之上。

[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]建议，这些特殊的生物可以成为诱导快速进化相关科技的合适的实验平台。
uplift.6000.tropical.desc.en:
The dense tropical foliage of [From.GetName] hides what [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] of the [Root.GetName] calls a 'proto-civilization.'

The [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] beings that make up this nascent society are still far behind the evolutionary curve, but their social order seems to be underpinned by the beginnings of intelligible language and abstract thought.

[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests that these particular creatures may prove a suitable testbed for technologies intended to induce rapid evolution.

uplift.6000.tundra.desc.zh:
众所周知，严苛的环境能够催生适应性强的进化，[From.GetName]的严寒环境也不是一个例外。

[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]对于[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]生物中的其中一种产生了特别的兴趣，这种生物能够在行星的结冰表面上滑行。只要在正确的方向上轻轻一推，它们甚至就可以实现智性。
uplift.6000.tundra.desc.en:
Harsh environments are known to propel adaptive evolution, and the frigid biosphere of [From.GetName] is no exception.

[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken a special interest in one of the [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] creatures that skitter across the planet's icy face. With a push in the right direction, they may even achieve sapience.

uplift.6000.wilderness.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]发现有个体型智慧生命居住在[from.GetName]。考虑到缺乏共生智能的指导，这种[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种已经达到了对环境的显著控制程度。

我们会继续密切关注这种生物的发展，也许有一天将其并入我们。这些生物的出现预示着[from.GetName]觉醒的潜质。
uplift.6000.wilderness.desc.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered individualistic, presapient life dwelling on [from.GetName]. This [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species has achieved a remarkable degree of mastery over its environment already, considering the lack of a Mutualistic Intelligence to guide it.

We would do well to monitor their development closely, and perhaps one day bring them into our fold. The presence of these creatures bodes well for the potential awakening of [from.GetName].

uplift.6010.alpine.desc.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]进行了基因改造，成功让这个物种进化到了完全的智性。现在，当它们自崎岖的山峦中遥望星空时，它们对自我有了更加真实的感知。
uplift.6010.alpine.desc.en: The genetic modifications we made to the [From.GetName] have successfully raised the species to full sapience. Now, as they gaze up at the stars from their mountain homes, they do so with a true sense of themselves.

uplift.6010.arctic.desc.zh:
在[Root.GetName]冰雪平原上生活的[From.GetName]已经在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的帮助下获得了感知能力。

现在他们已经加入了我们建于他们星球[Root.GetName]上的殖民地，并成为了[Root.Owner.GetName]社会的一员。
uplift.6010.arctic.desc.en:
The [From.GetName], risen from the icy plains of [Root.GetName], have achieved sapience with [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] help.

They have joined our colony on their native planet [Root.GetName] as productive members of [Root.Owner.GetName] society.

uplift.6010.arid.desc.zh:
成功了！

[This.GetName]当地的[From.GetName]已被提升为[This.Owner.GetName]人口。
uplift.6010.arid.desc.en:
Success!

The [From.GetName] native to [This.GetName] have been uplifted to become citizens of the [This.Owner.GetName].

uplift.6010.continental.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]上的主导物种，[From.GetName]，已经被提升了。只需要轻微的基因改造，就可以释放出他们内在的潜力，使他们的认知能力和操纵的灵活性得到极大的提高，而前几代的成员将被安装上小型的义体植入物。
uplift.6010.continental.desc.en: The dominant species on [Root.GetName], the [From.GetName], have been uplifted. Only minor genetic alterations were needed to unlock their inherent potential for vastly improved cognitive ability and manual dexterity, while members of previous generations will be fitted with small, cybernetic implants.

uplift.6010.desert.desc.en: The [From.GetName] now stand as living testament to the scientific and technological might of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

uplift.6010.fallback.desc.zh: [From.GetName]经提升实现了完全的智性，现在正作为[Root.Owner.GetName]科学与技术能力的活的证明。
uplift.6010.fallback.desc.en: Uplifted to full sapience, the [From.GetName] now stand as a living testament to the scientific and technological might of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

uplift.6010.gaia.desc.zh: 多亏了我们的努力，[From.GetName]已经被成功提升。能让它们彻底理解自己居住在怎样的天堂上，这是何等的福气。
uplift.6010.gaia.desc.en: Thanks to our efforts, the [From.GetName] have been successfully uplifted. What a gift, to fully understand the paradise they inhabit.

uplift.6010.nuked.desc.zh: 自卑微的起始，[From.GetName]已经进化到能够加入[Root.Owner.GetName]。
uplift.6010.nuked.desc.en: From their humble beginnings, the [From.GetName] have risen to join the [Root.Owner.GetName].

uplift.6010.ocean.desc.zh: 我们让[From.GetName]沿着有利的轨迹加速进化的工作取得了巨大的成功。教育计划已经为最年轻的样本部署妥当——一些个人，现在——而他们的长辈则可以接受心理基因调节。
uplift.6010.ocean.desc.en: Our efforts to accelerate the evolution of the [From.GetName] along a favorable trajectory have been tremendously successful. Educational programs are in place for the youngest specimens - individuals, now - while their elders are proving receptive to psycho-genetic conditioning.

uplift.6010.relic.desc.zh: 环顾它们的遗迹星球，[Root.GetName]的主导物种从常年的沉睡中苏醒过来。我们将它们提升至完全智性的工作成为了令人瞩目的成功。
uplift.6010.relic.desc.en: All across their ruined world, the dominant species of [Root.GetName] have awoken from their long slumber. Our efforts to uplift them to full sapience have been a resounding success.

uplift.6010.savannah.desc.zh: 我们提升[From.GetName]的工作成效显著：只需对它们的基因密码进行相对少许的修饰，我们就成功地引导它们进化成为了有认知能力的同僚。
uplift.6010.savannah.desc.en: Our efforts to uplift the [From.GetName] have borne fruit: with some relatively minor modifications to their genetic code, we have succeeded in raising their cognitive faculties.

uplift.6010.tropical.desc.zh: [From.GetName]已经被成功提升完毕，成为了合格的[Root.Owner.GetName]人，并住进了我们在热带星球[Root.GetName]上建立的殖民地。
uplift.6010.tropical.desc.en: The [From.GetName] have been successfully uplifted to become productive citizens of the [Root.Owner.GetName] and inhabitants of our colony on the tropical planet [Root.GetName].

uplift.6010.tundra.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]现在是智慧生命体，而且相当聪明。

它们现在处于[Root.Owner.GetName]的统治之下。
uplift.6010.tundra.desc.en:
The [From.GetName] are now sapient, and fairly intelligent at that.

They now fall under the dominion of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

uplift.7000.desc.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]已经与我们相处了数日了。

[From.GetName]行星上的情况目前一切安好。
uplift.7000.desc.en:
The [From.From.From.GetName] have been among us for several days now.

All is well on planet [From.GetName].

uplift.7010.desc.zh:
经过我们提升的[From.From.From.GetName]的整合比预期的要顺利，但没有我们希望的那样顺利。

尽管我们已经尽量对[From.From.From.GetName]进行了心理学软塑造，但是他们仍然不太适应我们在[From.Owner.GetName]的行事方式。
uplift.7010.desc.en:
The integration of the [From.From.From.GetName] who we uplifted is going more smoothly than expected, but not as smoothly as we had hoped.

Despite our efforts to soft-shape of their psychology, the [From.From.From.GetName] still occasionally struggle with the way we do things in the [From.Owner.GetName].

uplift.7200.a.zh: 这种事肯定会无疾而终。

uplift.7200.b.zh: 让他们保留自己的神秘感吧。

uplift.7200.c.zh: 不惜一切代价让他们回归正道。
uplift.7200.c.en: Set them straight by any means necessary.

uplift.7200.desc.zh:
相当多的[From.From.From.GetName]公民对我们教授的宇宙学说似乎很不满。

他们中的某个未知个体或者组织正在传播一些虚假信息，过分强调了[From.From.From.GetName]、以及[Root.Owner.GetName]他们进行提升一事的重要性。
uplift.7200.desc.en:
A statistically significant group of [From.From.From.GetName] citizens appear unsatisfied with our teachings on the nature of the cosmos.

An unknown individual or group among them is circulating some spurious codex that attaches undue importance to the [From.From.From.GetName] and their uplifting by the [Root.Owner.GetName].

uplift.7205.b.zh: 他们坚持信念的勇气值得赞扬。
uplift.7205.b.en: The courage of their convictions should be celebrated.

uplift.7205.c.zh: 他们必须明白战争的阴影时刻笼罩着我们。
uplift.7205.c.en: They must learn that the specter of war looms over us all.

uplift.7205.desc.zh: 由于[From.From.From.GetName]的人们对武器的厌恶，[Root.GetName]的人们提出了划定非战斗区域的正式请愿。
uplift.7205.desc.en: Some issues have arisen on [Root.GetName] as a result of the [From.From.From.GetName] populace's aversion to arms. A representative has made a formal request for clearly delineated demilitarized zones.

uplift.7210.b.zh: 所谓的外星生物，对我们来说不过是另一个机会罢了。
uplift.7210.b.en: What is alien to us is simply opportunity in disguise.

uplift.7210.c.zh: 他们对未知事物的恐惧是很正常的。
uplift.7210.c.en: They are right to fear the unknown.

uplift.7210.desc.zh: 根据报道，在[Root.GetName]上刚刚受到提升的[From.From.From.GetName]公民开始担忧，因为他们的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]老师提到了和外太空的某种未知存在交流的可能性。
uplift.7210.desc.en: According to reports, newly-uplifted [From.From.From.GetName] citizens on [Root.GetName] grow anxious as their [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] teachers bring up the likelihood of contact with as-yet-unknown entities from the far reaches of space.

uplift.7215.b.zh: 希望[From.From.From.GetName]能在同族之中发现自身的价值。
uplift.7215.b.en: May the [From.From.From.GetName] find themselves, in each other.

uplift.7215.c.zh: 只有独立自主才能实现自我价值。

uplift.7215.desc.zh:
尽管[Root.Owner.GetName]提供了一个相当可行的结构框架，我们可以利用这个框架来调节他们的内部社会序列；只不过这可能并不适合经过提升的[From.From.From.GetName]。

让他们的智能突然变得与我们相当，这剥夺了他们数千年中社会与文化发展的潜在可能。因此，[From.From.From.GetName]的社会秩序极不稳定，比如今天他们奉行家族至上，明天社区领袖可能就会宣布取消所有家族之间的关系。
uplift.7215.desc.en:
While the [Root.Owner.GetName] provides a solid structure upon which to model their internal social order, it may not necessarily be what suits the uplifted [From.From.From.GetName] best.

Their sudden rise to becoming our intellectual equals robbed them of millennia of potential societal and cultural development. Perhaps as a result of this, the [From.From.From.GetName] social order is in a state of extreme flux; one day the family unit is paramount, and the next day community leaders are calling for a dissolution of all clan-like bonds.

uplift.7500.desc.zh:
[From.GetName]的一批未开化物种不知为何进入了我们殖民地外围的安保隔离区域，尽管他们在不久之后就被赶出去了，但他们已经对我们专门负责运输货币的几条星际上行运输线造成了严重的破坏。

恐怕我们要失去几百能量币。
uplift.7500.desc.en:
A number of individuals belonging to the pre-sapient, native population of [From.GetName] somehow got into a secure compound on the outskirts of our colony. They were chased off within hours, but not before severely damaging several interstellar uplinks dedicated to currency transfers.

We fear several hundred Credits may have been lost in the ether.

uplift.7510.b.zh: 我们会接受他们的建议。
uplift.7510.b.en: We will accede to their demands.

uplift.7510.b.tooltip.zh: 当地居民会对此十分不满。
uplift.7510.b.tooltip.en: The locals will not be happy about this.

uplift.7510.c.zh: 伦理？我们不在乎低等种群的命运。
uplift.7510.c.en: Ethics? We care little for the fate of lesser beings.

uplift.7510.desc.zh:
[Root.GetName]的外星生物研究员发表了一封公开信，要求当地立法部门解除对接近智慧生物进行实验的限制。

他们从科研角度出发阐述了自己的观点，警告称如果法律得不到修改，[Root.GetName]的整个科研团体的实验效率都会下降。

其中涉及的伦理问题仍有争议。
uplift.7510.desc.en:
Xeno-researchers on [Root.GetName] have published an open letter demanding that the local legislation restricting experiments on near-sapient alien species be relaxed.

They make a convincing case for the scientific benefits, and warn that the output of the entire scientific community on [Root.GetName] will suffer unless the laws are revised.

The ethics of it all remain questionable.

uplift.7520.a.zh: 把他们赶走，尽量不要使用武力。
uplift.7520.a.en: Drive them off. Gently, if possible.

uplift.7520.b.zh: 用暴力的方式狠狠教训一下这帮愚傻的动物。
uplift.7520.b.en: Send these dumb animals a violent message.

uplift.7520.b.tooltip.zh: 那群丑陋的家伙再也不会打扰殖民地居民了。
uplift.7520.b.tooltip.en: The grotesque creatures will not bother the colonists again.

uplift.7520.c.zh: 试图找出他们去了哪里。
uplift.7520.c.en: Try to figure out where they are going.

uplift.7520.desc.zh: [Root.GetName]的近智慧生物正在我们的殖民地外围闹事。[Root.Owner.GetName]的存在似乎激怒了他们，他们一直不停的在殖民地的边界和东边的某处之间来回往返。
uplift.7520.desc.en: The near-sapient natives of [Root.GetName] are causing a ruckus on the outskirts of our colony. Something about the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s continued presence here visibly agitates them, as packs of them scurry to and fro between the settlement's borders and some unknown point to the east.

uplift.7525.desc.zh:
一群异种学家和一队军事人员一起离开了殖民地，去追寻当地生命的行踪。

他们发现的是某种古老的播种船的残骸，这显然是某个小型[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]文明的核心，它们早就腐朽成虚无了。

[Root.GetName]的优势本地物种似乎是某种古老的播种或基因编辑程序的产物；从播种船周围的结构来看，他们显然曾经存在部落，并拥有更高的智力，甚至还有一种基本的书面语言。

我们无从猜测是什么导致了它们发生了物种层面上的退化，但它们的行为本身更有意义了。他们近乎本能地认为，我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与他们最初来自星间的提升者相似。也许我们井然有序的社会唤醒了某种被它们更卑鄙的本性所淹没的形成秩序的冲动。

也许我们最终可以通过将他们提升到我们的水平来缓解他们的进化焦虑，但就目前而言，我们已经对古代太空文化对有机体的操纵有了宝贵的见解。
uplift.7525.desc.en:
A group of xenologists departed the colony together with a contingent of military personnel, tracking the movements of the native life-forms.

What they found were the remains of some ancient seed-ship, evidently the nucleus of some small, [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization, long since decayed into nothing.

The dominant native species of [Root.GetName] seem to be the product of some age-old seeding or genetic manipulation program; going by the structures surrounding the seed ship, they were once distinctly tribal, with greater intelligence and even a rudimentary written language.

We cannot begin to guess what caused their species-wide devolution, but their behavior makes more sense now. On some instinctual level they recognize us [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] as similar to their original uplifters from the stars. Perhaps our ordered society calls out to some instilled impulse to order, drowned out by their baser nature.

Maybe we can eventually ease their evolutionary anxiety by uplifting them to our level, but for now, we have gained valuable insights into the manipulation of organics by ancient spacefaring cultures.

utopia.1.desc.v1.zh: 我们的一些情报机构发现了一些资料，这些资料指出[ringworld_builder.GetName]的环形世界可能是一个大规模杀伤武器的秘密发射平台。虽然这些资料的正确性有待确认，但这样的见解已经在国内定型，公众要求我们采取行动。可以确定的是如果[ringworld_builder.GetName]没有什么可隐瞒的话，他们会允许我们的武器专家检查平台的。
utopia.1.desc.v1.en: Some of our intelligence assets have uncovered data suggesting that the [ringworld_builder.GetName]'s ring world could be hiding a secret launch platform for weapons of mass destruction. Though the validity of the source has yet to be confirmed, the notion has taken hold with the public who demand that we take action. Surely if the [ringworld_builder.GetName] has nothing to hide, they will allow a team of our weapons experts to inspect the site.

utopia.1.desc.v2.zh: 自从[ringworld_builder.GetName]开始建造环形世界以来，我们的几位首席工程师一直在后方关注这个项目，对他们的进程记忆深刻。工程师们相信，我们可以通过在建造现场近距离观察进而从他们的建造技术中学到知识，并建议我们向建造国发出请求，派出一支研究团队驻扎在建造现场。
utopia.1.desc.v2.en: Since the [ringworld_builder.GetName] started construction on a ring world, several of our leading engineers have been following the project from afar, and are greatly impressed with their progress. They believe we could learn from studying their craftsmanship closer, and suggest that we ask their permission to station a research team on location.

utopia.1.desc.v4.zh: 全帝国的先知们都被死亡与毁灭的可怕景象折磨着，这与天空中巨型环状物体的出现有关。将这些事情联系起来后，我们的宗教领袖担心[ringworld_builder.GetName]建造环形世界的野心激怒了众神，并建议我们在一切都来不及前派出一个代表团，将这个项目封为圣迹。
utopia.1.desc.v4.en: Lately prophets across the empire have been plagued by horrific visions of death and destruction, tied to the appearance of a great circular object in the sky. Putting two and two together, our religious leaders are worried that the [ringworld_builder.GetName]'s ambition to build a ring world has angered the gods, and advise us to send a delegation to consecrate the project, before it's too late.

utopia.100.b.zh: 他们的失踪一定有什么原因……
utopia.100.b.en: Surely they were marginalized for a reason...

utopia.100.desc.zh:
由于最近的失踪事件，[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上的动乱愈发严重。在过去的两月间，有数千名以上的居民失踪，其中绝大多数都是被孤立分化的偏远地区群体。这也解释了为什么这件事发生已然很长时间，但我们现在才注意到它。

当地执法部门已经要求更多的资源以进行进一步调查以及对骚乱的弹压。
utopia.100.desc.en:
Unrest is rising on [missing_pops_planet.GetName] in light of a recent wave of planetwide disappearances. Several thousand denizens have been reported missing in the last two months alone and the vast majority are from marginalized and isolated groups in remote areas. This could explain why it has taken so long to come to our attention.

Local law enforcement has requested additional resources to handle the growing unrest while they continue their investigation.

utopia.101.desc.zh:
关于发生在[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上的失踪事件，我们找到了些线索。他们所有人都在即将开业的太空赌场——天空之城中得到一个工作机会。那里的工作人员都穿着奇诡，说着莫名的外星语言。进一步的调查显示，如果这个赌场真的存在，那么它不位于这个星系的任何已知区域内。

专门打击力量的存在似乎使绑匪不敢进行下一次行动，我们已减弱了警力来引蛇出洞，以便当地执法部门抓捕绑架人员。
utopia.101.desc.en:
The investigation into the missing denizens of [missing_pops_planet.GetName] has revealed that they were all offered a job at a soon-to-open space casino called "Sky Castle," by sharp dressed recruiters speaking an unidentified alien language. Further inquiry has revealed that if such a casino does in fact exist, it is not within any known part of the galaxy.

As the presence of the strike force seems to be deterring the kidnappers from striking again they have been relieved to give local law enforcement a chance of luring the abductors back out.

utopia.102.a.zh: 改善细胞再生听起来挺有前途。

utopia.102.b.zh: 减少皱纹并不是一个全国性问题。
utopia.102.b.en: Wrinkle reduction is hardly a national concern.

utopia.102.desc.zh:
我们的科学家警告称，一个可疑的经销商正在我们的帝国内出售一种被称为寿无限的有机抗衰老霜。

他们的标语是——寿无限，使你寿命无限，这款广受欢迎的药用化妆品的原料是一种神秘的奇迹提取物，[ointment_name.GetName]精华。

虽然其有可能带来些令人不安的副作用，但是这款产品显示出了其促进细胞再生的极大潜力，研究委员会极力建议我们购买一批新产品。
utopia.102.desc.en:
Some of our scientists have raised the alarm on a new "all organic" anti-aging cream called Ageless, that is being sold throughout the empire by a seemingly questionable distributor.

Advertised under the slogan "Age less with Ageless", the wildly popular cosmeceutical is said to promote cell regeneration with a "unique formula" containing the mysterious miracle ingredient "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]".

Though it can cause some very disturbing side-effects the product has shown real potential of stimulating cell growth and our research council highly recommends procuring a shipment to recreate its formula.

utopia.103.a.zh: 找到那个实施这种暴行的卑鄙生物！
utopia.103.a.en: Find the vile creatures that did this to us!

utopia.103.desc.zh:
我们对这种抗衰老软膏的研究和深入分析充分的揭示了其神秘奇迹原料的本质，[ointment_name.GetName]精华实际上是一种从活体[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]腺体中获得的一种提取物，毫无疑问这是一种痛苦而危险的野蛮行径。

而好消息是，这让我们发现了一种能够刺激腺体的注射形式，能够显著提高我们的预期寿命，似乎再生的钥匙一直都隐藏在我们身体里面！
utopia.103.desc.en:
A thorough analysis of the anti-aging cream "Ageless" has revealed that the origin of the rejuvenating miracle ingredient, "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]", is quite close to home. In fact it can only be extracted from the glands of live [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], in a barbaric procedure that is undoubtedly both painful and dangerous.

In better news these finds have allowed us to create an injection that stimulates the gland, improving life-expectancy significantly. It seems that the key to regeneration was inside us all along!

utopia.104.a.zh: 他们必须立即释放受害者并召回所有产品！
utopia.104.a.en: They must release the victims and withdraw the product immediately.

utopia.104.a.tooltip.en: Sends an envoy with our civilly worded request.

utopia.104.c.tooltip.zh: 对于外交事务来说，这已经太晚了。
utopia.104.c.tooltip.en: It is much too late for diplomatic exchanges.

utopia.104.d.zh: 我们不可能去引起一场外交事故。
utopia.104.d.en: We cannot risk a diplomatic incident.

utopia.104.desc.zh:
在军队和社会学研究部门的联合努力下，寿无限抗衰老霜的供应链已经被我们锁定，供应方是一个[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]所有的科学枢纽 ，该机关曾隶属于某个政府，由艾克斯哈索尔博士及其科研团队组成。

[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]从其中获取了巨大的利润，当然，他们不太可能知道原料的来源。
utopia.104.desc.en:
In a coordinated effort between the military and the society research department, we have followed the distribution chain of the "Ageless" anti-aging cream back to a Science Nexus owned by the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName], where it was developed by a government-employed researcher named Dr. Xhaxxore and his team.

The [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName] has been making a huge profit off of the product and it seems unlikely that they wouldn't know the source of its key ingredient.

utopia.105.c.en: We have no interest in keeping the peace...

utopia.105.desc.zh:
据称，[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发现了我们绑架并囚禁他们物种中的一些成员的证据，并称我们的目的是从这些活体中提取一种能够让细胞再生的酶。

他们要求我们立刻释放这些实验体并召回所有产品，否则两国之间的和平就无法得到保证。接受他们的要求就意味着我们的秘密实验计划将会流产。
utopia.105.desc.en:
We have had word from the [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who claim to have uncovered evidence of our involvement in the kidnapping and unlawful imprisonment of several of their kind, for the purpose of extracting a cell regenerating enzyme from their glands.

They demand that we release them and withdraw the product in the interest of keeping the peace between our empires. Adhering to their demands would mean the premature end to our clandestine credit-generating scheme...

utopia.106.desc.zh:
我们赢得了这场正义的战争！

尽管[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]很明显在撒谎，声称他们自己从未知道这种[ointment_name.GetName]是如何制造的，至少他们释放了我们的公民回到[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上。

这项研究的带头者艾克斯哈索尔博士已经悄悄的跑路了，但研究团队的其他成员将受到正义的审判。
utopia.106.desc.en:
We have fought the good fight and won!

Though the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName] claim they never knew of the sinister origins of the "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]," which is clearly a lie, at least they had the decency of returning our citizens to their home on [missing_pops_planet.GetName].

As for Dr. Xhaxxore, the head researcher and mastermind behind the scheme, he has escaped under mysterious circumstances, but the rest of his team is being brought to justice.

utopia.107.desc.a.zh: 我们收到了来自[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]的正式回信，他们坚持否认进行过抗衰老霜的开发，并劝告我们找点“更实际的方法来宣泄一下面对优越的[fountain_of_youth_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]时产生的自卑情绪，而非伪造证据来进行一些无意义的控诉。”
utopia.107.desc.a.en: We have received a formal reply from the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName], forcefully denying their involvement in the production of the "Ageless" anti-aging cream and encouraging us to find "a more constructive outlet for our apparent inferiority complex towards the superior [fountain_of_youth_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], than the fabrication of toothless accusations".

utopia.107.desc.b.zh:
我们还未收到[target_country.GetName]对于他们绑架并进行活体实验来制造抗衰老霜的相关回复。但据可靠消息称，艾克斯哈索尔已经携带剩余的精华潜逃，为他们的牟利画上了句号。

我们的目标很明确，我们要把那些仍在受苦的受害者们，连同他们的家人一同带回[missing_pops_planet.GetName]。
utopia.107.desc.b.en:
We have had no response from the [target_country.GetName] regarding their involvement in the kidnapping of our kind for the purpose of producing the anti-aging cream "Ageless". But word has it Dr. Xhaxxore has fled with most of what was left of the essence, finally putting an end to their profiteering.

Our thoughts go out today to the doctor's many victims who are still in captivity, and their families back on [missing_pops_planet.GetName].

utopia.108.desc.zh: [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对我们否认我们牵涉绑架一事感到不满。并且，艾克斯哈索尔博士似乎察觉到了风声，带着实验体跑了，这让我们无法生产更多的抗衰老膏。
utopia.108.desc.en: The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not pleased that we denied our involvement in the kidnapping of their kind. What's more Dr. Xhaxxore, smelling smoke, has fled taking his supply of essence with him, making it impossible to produce more Ageless cream.

utopia.108.name.zh: 艾克斯哈索尔博士逃走了！

utopia.2.desc.v1.zh:
[From.From.GetName]声称他们掌握了有关于我们在环形世界上建造大规模杀伤性武器的秘密发射平台的秘密情报，要求我们同意对建筑工地进行视察。

我们的军事顾问尚未确认这是无心之过还是恶意诽谤，但无论如何我们都要谨慎对待这一局面。
utopia.2.desc.v1.en:
The [From.From.GetName] claims to have uncovered intel suggesting that we are building a secret launch platform for weapons of mass-destruction on our ring world and requests our permission to inspect the site.

Our military advisers have yet to confirm whether it's an honest mistake or something more sinister. Either way we should handle the situation delicately.

utopia.2.desc.v2.zh: [From.From.GetName]的[From.From.GetEngineerPlural]一直在远程跟进我们的环形世界建设，并对我们取得的进展印象深刻。他们向我们征求许可，在建造现场驻扎一支[From.From.GetEngineerPlural]团队以学习我们的工程。
utopia.2.desc.v2.en: [From.From.GetName] [From.From.GetEngineerPlural] have been following the construction of our ring world from afar, and are greatly impressed with our progress. They request our permission to station a team of [From.From.GetEngineerPlural] there to learn from our efforts.

utopia.2.desc.v4.zh: 来自[From.From.GetName]的先知们被死亡与毁灭的可怕景象折磨着，这与天空中巨型环状物体的出现有关。他们担心我们未经众神授权而建造的环形世界惹怒了众神，他们向我们征求了许可，请求在我们完成建造前将环形世界封为圣迹。
utopia.2.desc.v4.en: Lately prophets from the [From.From.GetName] have been plagued by horrific visions of death and destruction, tied to the appearance of a great circular object in the sky. Worried that the unsanctioned construction of a ring world in our empire has angered the gods, they ask our permission to consecrate it, before we finalize the project.

utopia.2000.desc.zh:
我们现在准备开始这项史诗工程，环绕[From.From.GetName]星系的恒星来建造未来环形世界的初始框架。

这个框架所需的资源与矿物是史无前例的，我们成百上千最优秀的工程师准备好开始拆解恒星系内的行星，将这些物质用于环形世界建造。
utopia.2000.desc.en:
We are now ready to begin the colossal task of building the initial frame of our future Ring World around the primary star of the [From.From.GetName] system.

The amount of resources and materials required to build this skeletal frame will be immense, and hundreds of thousands of our finest engineers stand ready to begin the process of dismantling the system's planetary bodies into matter which can be used in its construction.

utopia.2002.a.zh: 那个环会和我们的一样壮观吗？
utopia.2002.a.en: Will it be as impressive as our own?

utopia.2002.b.zh: 一项壮举，如果能完成的话。
utopia.2002.b.en: An impressive project... if it is ever finished.

utopia.2002.desc.a.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]已着手在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系建造一个史诗级项目。他们旨在建造一个巨大的环形世界以环绕恒星系的恒星，作为项目的第一步他们开始将星系所有行星转换为巨型结构的金属骨架。
utopia.2002.desc.a.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has undertaken a construction project of monumental proportions in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system. They intend to build a massive Ring World around the system's primary, and as a first step they have started to convert the matter of all nearby planetary bodies into an initial metal skeleton for the megastructure.

utopia.2002.desc.b.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]开始建造另一个环形世界，这次是在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系！和以前一样他们的工程师正在拆解星系的所有行星，用他们的资源和材料进行环形世界建造。
utopia.2002.desc.b.en: We have received intelligence that the [From.GetName] is about to start construction on yet another Ring World, this time in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system! As before, their engineers are currently in the process of dismantling all planetary bodies in the system so that their resources and materials can be used in the Ring World's construction.

utopia.2003.a.zh: 还有许多工作等着我们。

utopia.2003.desc.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]星系建设的环形世界框架现以完成。虽然还有很多后续工作，这个周长近十亿千米的金属骨架的完成必将是工程界的一项壮举。

我们准备好建设真正意义上的宜居地了。
utopia.2003.desc.en:
The skeletal frame of the Ring World we are building in the [From.From.GetName] system has finally been completed. Although there is still much left to do, the mere completion of this metal skeleton, which has a circumference of nearly a billion kilometers, must be considered an incredible feat of engineering.

We are now ready to start work on creating the actual habitats.

utopia.2004.desc.a.zh:
今天，我们的工程师和行星生态学家完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的环形世界最后一个宜居区间的建造。这个伟大的巨型结构的建造必将成为[Root.GetName]历史的里程碑。我们完成了屈指可数的文明才能完成的工作。

让这个环形世界成为一个永恒的见证：自从[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种从安全的母星踏足至如今，我们达成了什么样的成就。
utopia.2004.desc.a.en:
Our engineers and planetary ecologists today finished the last of the habitat sections on the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. The construction of this great megastructure must be considered a milestone in the history of the [Root.GetName] - we have accomplished what only a handful of civilizations in the history of our galaxy has managed before.

Let this Ring World stand forever as a testament to how much the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has achieved since we first ventured beyond the safety of our homeworld's atmosphere.

utopia.2004.desc.b.zh:
我们完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]恒星系的环形世界宜居区间的建造，我们的工程师和生态学家又一次完成了不可能。

[Root.GetName]将被认为是全星系历史中最伟大的造匠之一。
utopia.2004.desc.b.en:
We have concluded work on the habitat sections of the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. Our engineers and ecologists have accomplished the impossible yet again.

The [Root.GetName] must now truly be considered one of the greatest builders in the history of the galaxy.

utopia.2005.a.zh: 也许我们也要考虑再建一些。
utopia.2005.a.en: Perhaps we should consider building more as well.

utopia.2005.b.zh: 又有一个？他们的资源用不完的吗？
utopia.2005.b.en: Another one? Is there no limit to their resources?

utopia.2005.desc.a.zh:
[From.GetName]完成了历史上屈指可数的文明才能完成的壮举——他们完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的巨型环形世界的建造。

这项科学奇迹将成为[From.GetSpeciesName]物种那举世瞩目的奇迹的见证，从默默无闻的开始以来他们一路走过了很久。
utopia.2005.desc.a.en:
The [From.GetName] has accomplished what only a handful of civilizations in the history of our galaxy has managed before - they have finished construction of the colossal Ring World they were building around the primary star of the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system.

This technological marvel must be considered a testament to the impressive achievements of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. They have certainly come a long way from their humble beginnings.

utopia.2005.desc.b.zh: [From.GetName]完成了又一个环形世界的建造！这个壮观的巨型结构坐落在[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系，曾经这个星系的行星都以不见踪影，它们被拆解为建造用料。
utopia.2005.desc.b.en: The [From.GetName] has finished another Ring World! This massive megastructure is located in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system, which is now devoid of other planetary bodies since those that once existed were dismantled and used as building material.

utopia.2010.a.zh: 它看起来与我们自己的戴森球功能相近。
utopia.2010.a.en: It appears functionally similar to our own sphere.

utopia.2010.a.desc.zh:
我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个巨型结构的残骸，包围着这个恒星系的恒星。我们的科学家初步判断这曾是个“戴森球”——一个用于彻底利用恒星能量的巨型结构。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受到了来自未知的能量武器的致命打击。

$utopia.2010.c.desc$
utopia.2010.a.desc.en:
We have encountered the remains of an enormous space structure in [dyson_system.GetName], encompassing the system's primary. Our scientists theorize that this may have once been a functional "Dyson Sphere" - a megastructure designed to harness the power of a star. It is obviously no longer operational, with its hull having sustained critical damage from an unknown type of energy weapon.

$utopia.2010.c.desc$

utopia.2010.b.desc.zh:
我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个戴森球的残骸。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受了未知的能量武器的致命打击

$utopia.2010.c.desc$
utopia.2010.b.desc.en:
We have encountered the remains of a Dyson Sphere in the [dyson_system.GetName] system. It is obviously no longer operational, with its hull having sustained critical damage from an unknown type of energy weapon.

$utopia.2010.c.desc$

utopia.2011.desc.zh:
我们成功修复了位于[From.GetName]星系内的废弃戴森球。星系内庞大的碎片云被收集起来用于修复工程，这样既减少了我们资源的消耗，又为工作人员消除了一个潜在的航行风险。

这个巨型结构现已恢复正常运作，在沉寂了千百年后再次产出巨额的能源。
utopia.2011.desc.en:
We have successfully repaired the ruined Dyson Sphere in the [From.GetName] system. The large debris fields present in the system were gathered for use in the repair effort, reducing both material costs and removing a potential navigational hazard for the work crews.

The great megastructure is now fully operational, generating vast amounts of energy again for the first time in eons.

utopia.2012.a.zh: 它看起来与我们的科学枢纽具有相近的功能。
utopia.2012.a.en: The concept appears similar to our own Science Nexus.

utopia.2012.desc.zh: 我们在[nexus_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大太空装置的残骸。该巨型结构似乎曾是一个巨大的科学枢纽。尽管其已废弃数千年，但其主体结构依然完好。
utopia.2012.desc.en: The broken remnants of a colossal space installation have been found near the [nexus_system.GetName]. This megastructure appears to have once served as some kind of massive Science Nexus. Although the installation has obviously been abandoned for millennia, its hull is still reasonably intact.

utopia.2013.desc.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近的废弃科学枢纽已被完全修复了，并配备了[Root.GetName]的精英科学家。这个巨型结构仍然保持着设计师当初建造它时的初衷，在这个时代继续帮助我们解决更多的科学问题。
utopia.2013.desc.en: The abandoned Science Nexus near [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the brightest minds of the [Root.GetName]. As was no doubt its original purpose, the megastructure will now be put to use in answering the scientific questions of our time.

utopia.2014.a.zh: 我们已经有哨兵阵列了。
utopia.2014.a.en: We already have one of those.

utopia.2014.desc.zh:
在星系历史上的某个时间点，[sentry_system.GetName]星系曾建有过一个体积异常巨大的轨道设施，后来被有组织地拆毁。此星系大部分天体的行星同步轨道上都弥漫着大量的残骸，当中不乏大型空间站的外壳。

残骸中以一个庞大的哨兵阵列为最。经过我们初步的扫描结果推测，这个阵列强大到足以实时监控整个星系。
utopia.2014.desc.en:
At some point in galactic history, the [sentry_system.GetName] system evidently supported a vast orbital infrastructure of unusual proportions which has since been systematically demolished. There are large concentrations of debris in geostationary orbits around most of the planetary bodies in this system, including several massive space station hulks.

The largest of these is a colossal Sentry Array. Our initial scans suggest that when it was operational, this array was powerful enough to provide real-time sensor coverage over the entire galaxy.

utopia.2015.desc.zh:
虽然十分困难，我们的工程师还是设法修复了位于[From.GetName]恒星系的废弃哨兵阵列，并在过程中回收利用了散布在周围的空间站残骸。

时隔亿万年，哨兵阵列在轰鸣中再次投入运作，列阵之中能量充盈，借助它强力的信号，整个星系一览无余。
utopia.2015.desc.en:
It wasn't easy, but our engineers have managed to restore the ruined Sentry Array in the [From.GetName] system. The other station hulks and the debris that surrounded them were converted into building material during the restoration effort.

For the first time in eons, the array now hums with energy. Its powerful antennas can once again see clear to the other side of the galaxy.

utopia.2016.a.zh: 至少他们和我们的文明一样先进。
utopia.2016.a.en: As advanced as we are, at any rate.

utopia.2016.desc.zh:
这些环绕着[ring_system.GetName]星系中央恒星的残骸，来自一个古老的环形世界。任何曾经存在于这个恒星系的行星体，都在这个庞然大物的修建工程中被作为建筑材料而使用。

没有证据能够指明这个工程奇迹最初是被谁修建的，但这一定是一个高度先进文明的杰作。
utopia.2016.desc.en:
The shattered remnants of an ancient Ring World encircle the star of the [ring_system.GetName] system. Any planetary bodies that may once have existed here must have been used as building material during this megastructure's construction.

No evidence hinting towards who originally built this marvel of engineering has been found, but it must have been the product of a very advanced culture.

utopia.2017.desc.zh: 基于[From.GetName]星系的环形世界废墟，我们的工程师成功地将它的一个区段恢复运转。全新的环形世界生态结构几乎是由我们的行星学家从零开始规划，但现在它已经足够稳定，可以居住了。
utopia.2017.desc.en: Building on what remains of the ruined Ring World in the [From.GetName] system, our engineers have managed to fully restore one of its sections. The new biosphere had to be created more or less from scratch by our leading planetologists, but it is now considered stable and ready for habitation.

utopia.21.desc.zh: 在环形世界施工管事出色的领导下，我们能将建造流程最优化，显著加快了建造速度。
utopia.21.desc.en: Under the skillful leadership of the ring world construction manager, we have been able to optimize the construction workflow, increasing the build speed significantly.

utopia.22.desc.zh: 我们在环形世界上的建造团队发现了一大片矿藏着床于极硬的岩石中，而矿藏在建造过程中会碎裂。虽然易受影响，样本足以说明矿藏值得我们停下环形世界的建造来开发。
utopia.22.desc.en: The construction team on the ring world has discovered a large deposit of minerals embedded in extremely porous stone, that will disintegrate during the build process. Though sensitive, the sample could be valuable enough that it would be worth our while to halt construction to extract it.

utopia.23.desc.zh:
似乎我们用来建造环形世界的一颗星球并不像我们开始想的那样不可居住，一种看起来无害，但之前未知的物种——昵称为“可可”的巨型太空蠕虫——被我们用它们母星的碎片带到了环形世界。

由于它们那毛绒绒的毛皮和温顺的习性，这些可爱的生物很快就成为了工人们的最爱，毕竟他们远离家人，常年孤独地呆在这，尤其是处在有工人失踪的当下。

我们可以让这些生物继续和平生活在这儿，或者净化它们，显著延缓建造进度。
utopia.23.desc.en:
It appears as if one of the planets used to construct the ring world was not as uninhabited as we first thought. A seemingly harmless, but previously unknown species of giant space worm, nicknamed "Coo-coo" after its call, has been transferred to the ring world with fragments from its homeworld.
