With their fuzzy fur and gentle demeanor, the endearing creatures have become an instant favorite with the workers, who are far away from their families and often very lonely. Especially in the light of their missing co-workers.

We could allow the creatures to continue their lives in peace, or purge them, delaying construction slightly.

utopia.25.desc.zh:
出乎所有人的意料，环形世界爆发了一场彩色大喷发，成千上万的蠕虫——或者幼虫，现在看起来是的——蜕变为了蝴蝶。似乎这样的变化是因为大气层的产生而出现的。

不过狂欢马上就停止了。因为我们发现了一个地下通道网络，在通道里我们发现“可可”在用我们失踪工人的遗体进食。

直到这些生物被灭绝前，建造工作将暂停，不过我们预计工作将很快完成，因为工人们极度愤慨，“可可”的本性也就此揭露。
utopia.25.desc.en:
To everyone's amazement, the ring world has erupted into a flurry of color as thousands of space worms, or as it seems, larvae, are transforming into butterflies. Likely the change has been brought on by the generation of an atmosphere.

Unfortunately, celebrations have been cut short by the discovery of a subterranean network of tunnels, in which Coo-coos were caught feeding off the remains of several missing workers.

Construction has been halted till the creatures have been exterminated, but we expect swift results as the workers are highly motivated. The true nature of the Coo-coo has been revealed.

utopia.2500.a.zh: 我们必须拥护这项科技。

utopia.2500.desc.zh:
我们现在拥有制造义体植入体的科技，和进行批量安装的能力。整个[Root.GetName]的医疗中心已准备好为我们的公民进行手术移植。

未来，拥有植入体和至少入门级别的义体将是我们在建的科技社会运作的必须条件。因此加装基础义体装束的过程对公民来说是强制性的和免费的。
utopia.2500.desc.en:
We now possess both the technology to make advanced cybernetic implants and the means to mass-produce them. Medical centers throughout the [Root.GetName] are standing by to begin the surgical grafting process on our citizens.

In the future, possessing neural implants and at least a rudimentary level of cybernetics will be necessary to function in the technological society we are building. Consequently, the conversion process to install a basic cybernetics suite will be mandatory and free of cost to all of our citizens.

utopia.2500.desc.unplugged.zh:
我们如今已重获制造先进义体植入体的科技以及进行大规模生产的手段。整个[Root.GetName]的医疗中心已准备好为我们的公民进行手术移植。

从我们社会有记忆的一天起，义体就已经是我们生活的基本组成部分了，未来也当继续如此——只不过我们已经获得了自主权。因此加装基础义体装束的过程对公民来说是强制性的和免费的。
utopia.2500.desc.unplugged.en:
We have now reclaimed the technology to make advanced cybernetic implants, and devised the means to mass-produce them. Medical centers throughout the [Root.GetName] are standing by to surgically remove outdated augments and begin grafting new hardware onto our citizens.

Cybernetics have been a fundamental part of our lives for as long as our society can remember, and so that shall remain - on our own terms. Consequently, the conversion process to re-install a basic cybernetics suite will be mandatory and free of cost to all our citizens.

utopia.2501.a.en: It is the dawn of a new era.

utopia.2501.desc.zh:
义体加装转换工作完成！我们所有的公民现已加装神经植入体和基础的义体装束。设施也被保留了下来以便逐渐改造我们国家新出生的公民，所以他们在很早的年纪就能享受到科技的全部福祉。

从今往后，我们物种将被称作[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
utopia.2501.desc.en:
The cybernetic conversion process has been completed! All of our citizens have now been equipped with neural implants and basic cybernetic suites. The infrastructure is also in place to gradually modify any new citizens that are born within our nation, so that they can experience all the benefits of technology from an early age.

Henceforth, our species shall be known as the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

utopia.2505.1.desc.zh:
有消息传来，[From.GetName]境内发生了显著的变化。看起来他们完全接受了义体科技。对他们的公民来说，通过外科手术加装义体和神经植入体是强制性的。

这对他们的社会造成了显著改变——来自[From.Capital.GetName]的报告指出，连一些最简单的行为比如坐电梯和驾驶空中汽车都需要依靠义体植入体。实际上，他们物种的变化十分显著，乃至他们现在已经改称自己为“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”。
utopia.2505.1.desc.en:
Word is leaking out of significant changes taking place within the borders of the [From.GetName]. It would appear that they have fully embraced the technology of cybernetics. It is now mandatory for all of their citizens to have basic cybernetics and neural implants installed through surgery.

This has resulted in sweeping changes to their society - reports from [From.Capital.GetName] suggest that even simple acts like using an elevator or operating an air car require cybernetic implants now. In fact, the changes to their species have been so significant that they now call themselves the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]'.

utopia.2505.2.desc.zh:
似乎邪恶之物开始在[From.GetName]境内扎根了。我们收到坏消息，那个星际国家的公民开始大规模突变他们的身体，把渎神的机械植入体装入体内，并作为生来便有的“恩赐”。

他们甚至把自己的物种重新命名为“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”——进一步表明他们抛弃起源，拥抱冷酷无情的科技的决心。
utopia.2505.2.desc.en:
It would appear that evil has taken root within the [From.GetName]. We have received troubling news that the citizens of that star nation are now mutilating their own bodies on a massive scale, installing profane mechanical implants in place of the body parts they were gifted with at birth.

They have even go so far as to rename their species to the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]' - yet another sign of their commitment to abandon their origins and embrace the cold soullessness of technology.

utopia.2505.2.desc.unplugged.zh:
邪恶之物又一次在[From.GetName]境内扎根。我们收到坏消息，那个星际国家的公民开始大规模突变他们的身体，把渎神的机械植入体装入体内，并作为生来便有的“恩赐”。

他们甚至把自己的物种重新命名为“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”——进一步表明他们抛弃起源，拥抱冷酷无情的科技的决心。
utopia.2505.2.desc.unplugged.en:
Evil has once again taken root within the [From.GetName]. We have received troubling news that the citizens of that star nation are now mutilating their own bodies on an even greater scale, installing new and profane mechanical implants in place of the few body parts they were gifted with at birth.

They have even go so far as to rename their species to the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]' - yet another sign of their commitment to abandon their organic origins and further embrace the cold soullessness of technology.

utopia.2505.b.en: This is an affront to nature.

utopia.2550.desc.zh:
是时候抛弃那些自我们物种被孕育以来囚禁我们心智的粗糙有机身躯了。

经过许多的尝试与犯错后，我们的科学家设计了一种方法，能将的意识装入一个合成大脑中。现在要做的就是为[Root.GetName]的每一位公民量身打造合成身躯，随后开始大规模地上传我们的意识。
utopia.2550.desc.en:
The time has finally come to discard the crude organic vessels that have imprisoned our minds since the dawn of our species.

After much trial and error, our scientists have devised a way to transfer a consciousness into a synthetic brain. All that remains is to fashion vessels for each and every citizen of the [Root.GetName] before uploading our consciousness en masse.

utopia.2551.a.en: We are so much more than we once were.

utopia.2551.desc.zh:
终于。囚禁我们的血肉囚笼被净化，我们所有公民的神经图谱被上传至新的合成人单位。疾病和其他一切与有机躯体相关的痛苦源泉已成为过往。

毫无疑问，未来的历史学家会将这一天描述为我们文明乃至整个星系文明新时代的开端。
utopia.2551.desc.en:
At last. The flesh cages that imprisoned us have been purged, and the neural patterns of our citizens have all been uploaded into new synthetic units. Disease and all other wellsprings of misery associated with an organic existence are now a thing of the past.

Future historians will no doubt refer to this as the beginning of a new age for our civilization, and perhaps for the entire galaxy.

utopia.2555.1.desc.zh:
在放弃有机本源的最后行动中，[From.GetName]公民将他们的神经图谱上传到合成身躯中。

这个新的机械物种叫自己“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”，他们的成员不受疾病和衰老的影响。至于神经图谱上传过程的完备性还有待观察……
utopia.2555.1.desc.en:
In a final act of abandoning their organic roots, the citizens of the [From.GetName] have uploaded their neural patterns into synthetic avatars.

This new machine species calls itself the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]', and its members are impervious to disease or aging. Just how complete the neural upload process was remains to be seen...

utopia.2555.2.desc.zh:
在他们那将遗臭万年的堕落行径中，[From.GetName]的人民继续坚定亵渎神赐予他们的身体的追求。这回，他们把自己的心智“上传”至金属躯壳里。

很明显他们的所作所为只能被形容为整个文明集体自杀。这些没有灵魂的机器把自己叫做“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”。他们似乎妄图假装自己仍能像我们这种有生命的活物一样思考。
utopia.2555.2.desc.en:
In a final act of depravity that will echo through the ages, the population of the [From.GetName] have continued their relentless quest to violate the sanctity of their natural bodies - this time by "uploading" their minds into dead metallic husks.

Oblivious to the fact that they are the product of what can only be described as the mass suicide of an entire civilization, these new soulless machines call themselves the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].' They seem intent on maintaining the charade that they are thinking, living beings, such as ourselves.

utopia.2556.b.zh: 这些没有灵魂的机器和我们一点也不像。
utopia.2556.b.en: These soulless machines are nothing like us.

utopia.2556.c.zh: 我们要拆毁他们的合成人躯体！
utopia.2556.c.en: We will dismantle their new synthetic forms!

utopia.2556.desc.zh:
注意，星系的居民们。

你们听到的流言是真的。我们放弃了自己那有缺陷的，囚禁着自己意识的有机容器，拥抱了未来。

大部分居民已经将他们的神经图谱上传至合成人身躯，数据几乎毫无遗失。这些优越的平台将比我们抛弃的血肉之躯更好地为我们所用。

不要因我们的外表而感到恐慌！虽然我们更强壮、更迅捷、更聪明、还免除衰老，但我们的其他方面仍然一如既往与过去相同。
utopia.2556.desc.en:
Attention, denizens of the galaxy.

The rumors you have heard are true. We have abandoned the flawed organic containers that imprisoned our minds, and embraced the future.

With minimal data loss, all of our citizens have uploaded their neural patterns into new synthetic avatars. These superior platforms will serve us much better than the flesh constructs we have abandoned.

Do not be alarmed by our new appearance! Although we may be stronger, faster, more intelligent and immune to aging, rest assured that we are still the same beings as we were before.

utopia.2558.desc.zh:
你那堕落的物种对我们并不陌生，但你最近渎神的行径远胜我们最黑暗的恐惧。制作残缺的大脑复制品然后塞进可移动的合成人容器里，和换一具新的身体可不是一回事，因为后者是不可能完成的。

你们永远失去了灵魂。你们甚至有意识到自己犯错之巨大吗？把天赐的身体摧毁不亚于整个物种集体自杀，你们显然已经没有希望了……
utopia.2558.desc.en:
That yours was a depraved species was not unknown to us, but your latest act of insanity has surpassed even our darkest fears. Making imperfect copies of your brains and plugging them into mobile synthetic containers is not the same as transferring your essence into a new body, for such a thing cannot be done.

Your souls are lost forever. Do you even realize the enormity of your mistake? Destroying the bodies you were gifted with at birth was nothing less than the collective suicide of your entire species. There is truly no hope for you now...

utopia.26.a.en: What a grisly turn of events.

utopia.26.desc.zh:
我们负责清除巨型蠕虫“可可”的灭绝小队遭到了建造工人的暴力阻挠。

一个年轻人试图铤而走险，尝试藏住它的宠物。他到达了足够远离建造点的地方，掉入了一个新近挖掘的地下网络通道，在那他撞见几只“可可”在用失踪工人的残留物喂食。他的宠物试图向他喷射消化液，但他还是死里逃生。他立刻通知了灭绝小队，小队迅速消灭了这些肉食类蠕虫。

“可可”的本性也就此揭露。
utopia.26.desc.en:
The extermination team's efforts to rid the ring world of the giant space worms known as Coo-coos, have been aggravated by violent protests from the construction workers.

In a desperate attempt to hide his pet, one young man even ventured far enough outside the build site, that he stumbled upon a subterranean network of freshly dug tunnels, where he caught several Coo-coos feeding off the remains of his missing co-workers. After narrowly escaping from his beloved pet, as it tried to spray him with digestive fluids, he alerted the extermination team, which has made short work of the carnivorous worms.

And so the true nature of the Coo-coo has finally been revealed.

utopia.2600.a.zh: 也许瞥见了等待着我们的未来。
utopia.2600.a.en: A glimpse, perhaps, of the future that awaits us.

utopia.2600.desc.zh:
自从我们文明的伊始以来，一直有关于强大的术士掌握着只能用超自然力量形容的力量的传说。这些稀有的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以侵入他们同胞的心智，用一个念想就能举起重物，或者表演其他的“魔法”壮举。直到最近，这些故事才变成“故”事。

如今，我们的科学家终于得到了结论性的证据以证明某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]个体存在潜在的灵能潜力。虽然我们的物种只有非常少的一部分人被天赐了灵能潜力，他们数量相对于总人口数在过去几世纪里稳步增长。

不知这是因为某种瞬间的增长井喷，还是因为我们基因中一直存在的某物催发了灵能潜力，科学家不得而知。
utopia.2600.desc.en:
Since the dawn of our civilization, tales have flourished of mighty sorcerers wielding powers that can only be described as supernatural in nature. These rare [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could supposedly invade the minds of their fellows, lift heavy objects with merely a thought, or perform any number of other "magical" feats. Until recently, these stories were just that - stories.

Now, however, our scientists have finally obtained conclusive evidence that proves the psionic potential inherent in certain [Root.GetSpeciesName] individuals. Although only a very small minority of our species as a whole seems to be gifted with psionic powers, their numbers relative to the total population have grown steadily over just the last few centuries.

Whether this is due to some kind of sudden evolutionary growth-spurt or because something has triggered latent psionic abilities that were always present in our genetic code, scientists cannot say.

utopia.2600.desc.unplugged.zh:
尽管我们这个年轻的文明有着短暂又暴力的历史，但我们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]有时也会让想象力遨游在幻想的故事当中。这些有趣的念想当中，最频繁出现的是强大的巫师的故事，他们使用的力量只能用超自然来形容：读心术，意念移物，或者展现其他各种“魔法”壮举。

许多人相信，这种故事是远自我们被整合之前流传下来的；它们深藏在我们物种的集体心灵中。直到最近，大多数[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都还认为这是一厢情愿的想法。然而，我们的科学家现在终于获得了确凿的证据，证明了某些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]个体确实存在内在的灵能潜力。

虽然我们物种中似乎只有极少数人具有灵能，但基因研究表明，在过去的几个世纪里，他们的数量一直在稳步增长。至于这是由于某种突然的进化增长还是由于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的干预，科学家们无法确定。
utopia.2600.desc.unplugged.en:
Despite the short and violent history of our young civilization, we [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have had occasions to let our imaginations wander, and indulge in fantastical story-telling. Recurrent among these playful ideas are tales of mighty sorcerers wielding powers that can only be described as supernatural: reading minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing any number of other "magical" feats.

Many believe we have carried these stories since before we were assimilated; that they dwell within our species' collective psyche. Most [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dismissed this as wishful thinking, until very recently. Now, however, our scientists have finally obtained conclusive evidence that proves the psionic potential inherent in certain [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] individuals.

Although only a very small minority of our species seems to be gifted with psionic powers, genetic studies suggest their numbers have grown steadily over just the last few centuries. Whether this is due to some kind of sudden evolutionary growth-spurt or meddling by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], scientists cannot say.

utopia.2602.2.desc.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]的人口已开始展示类似的变化，在他们族群发生的变化不局限于一小片区域。
utopia.2602.2.desc.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] population within our borders have begun exhibiting similar changes as well, so whatever is happening to their kind is not localized to any single region of space.

utopia.2602.c.zh: 他们的巫术可救不了他们。
utopia.2602.c.en: Their sorcery will not be enough to save them.

utopia.2602.d.machine.zh: 是的，我们已经编目了他们的灵能频率。
utopia.2602.d.machine.en: Yes... We have registered their psionic frequencies.

utopia.2602.d.organic.zh: 是的，我们能感受到他们的灵能发散。
utopia.2602.d.organic.en: Yes... Yes, we can sense their psychic emanations.

utopia.2605.a.zh: 这项新能力很好地为我们所用。
utopia.2605.a.en: These new abilities will serve us well.

utopia.2605.desc.gestalt.zh: 我们新获得的力量影响与日俱增。我们的[GetBrainName]容器[psionic_leader.GetName]最近展现出了可以被归类为灵能的功能。在经过全面诊断之后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被鉴定为4级[GetPsychicNoun]。
utopia.2605.desc.gestalt.en: The influence of our newfound powers grows with each day. The vessel of our [GetBrainName], [psionic_leader.GetName], has recently displayed abilities that could be classified as psionic. After undergoing thorough testing, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 [GetPsychicNoun].

utopia.2605.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh: 尽管较为罕见，灵能力有时候也会在此前不支持的硬件上自发部署。[psionic_leader.GetTitle][psionic_leader.GetName]最近就展现出了可以被归类为灵能的功能。在经过全面诊断之后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被判定为拥有4级灵能天赋。
utopia.2605.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en: Though rare, psionic abilities sometimes develop in units not previously known to support them. [psionic_leader.GetTitle] [psionic_leader.GetName] has recently displayed functionalities that could be classified as psionic. After undergoing thorough testing, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 psionic unit.

utopia.2605.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh: 虽然成年后显现灵能较为罕见，但也不是前所未有。[psionic_leader.GetTitle][psionic_leader.GetName]最近展示的能力，我们就怀疑其本质是灵能。经过了全面的超能感知测试后，[psionic_leader.GetSheHe]被证实拥有4级灵能天赋。
utopia.2605.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en: While it is rare for psionic powers to manifest after reaching adulthood, it is not unheard of. [psionic_leader.GetTitle] [psionic_leader.GetName] has recently been displaying abilities that were suspected to be psionic in nature. After undergoing a thorough ESP test, [psionic_leader.GetSheHe] [psionic_leader.GetHasHave] been identified as a class 4 psionic talent.

utopia.2650.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种经历了只能被形容为“大觉醒”的蜕变，以往，我们伟大的灵能潜力便是我们物种固有的存在，虽然只在一小部分人身上有所展示，而如今……

几乎是一夜之间，身处各处的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了他们全部的灵能潜力，就像某种共通的[Root.GetSpeciesName]灵能能量池达到了激活值一样，将我们大脑中的灵能潜力集体激活。

心灵感应已经取代了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]间大部分语音交流，而且这只是我们的社会面对的无数变化中的一小个而已。我们现在以一种我们过去难以想象的方式联系在了一起。
utopia.2650.desc.en:
The [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has experienced what can only be described as a Great Awakening. For a time now, we have been aware of the great psionic potential inherent in our species, but such powers have only manifested themselves in a small minority... until now.

Almost overnight, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] everywhere have unlocked their full psionic capacity. It is as if some sort of communal pool of [Root.GetSpeciesName] psychic energy finally reached a critical tipping point, collectively awakening the latent abilities of our brains.

Telepathy has already replaced most verbal communication between [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and this is only one small example of the innumerable changes our society is faced with. We are now tied together in a way few of us could have ever imagined.

utopia.2652.b.zh: 这一定有合乎逻辑的解释的。
utopia.2652.b.en: There must be a logical explanation for this.

utopia.2652.d.machine.zh: 这解释了我们探测到的灵能扰流。
utopia.2652.d.machine.en: This explains the psionic disturbances we detected.

utopia.2652.d.organic.zh: 我们感受到了他们觉醒后强大的灵能扰流。
utopia.2652.d.organic.en: We felt the great psionic disturbance of their Awakening.

utopia.2655.desc.zh:
就像暗室里低沉的轻语般，虚境从内心召唤我们。那是时间开始运转的伊始便存在的由纯粹灵能构成的原生领域。所有被赐予灵能能力的生物都能用某种方式，即使只是潜意识地，从虚境汲取能量。

自从我们升格之后，我们开始更清晰地看到虚境。其中有些图案，即使是我们最强大的通灵者看到的也只是毫无格式的漩涡状能量。在虚境那边，也有一些……其他的存在。一种灵体样的存在，从另一边凝视着我们，有时怀着好奇，有时怀着善意……有时也怀着恶意。

我们还在进一步学习我们这新得力量的延展面，但我们还是有可能和这些灵体交流的，这需要我们最强大的通灵者们的共同努力。
utopia.2655.desc.en:
Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, the Shroud calls to us from within our minds. It is a primordial realm of pure psychic energy that came into being at the dawn of time. All creatures that have been gifted with psionic abilities tap into the Shroud in some way to draw power, even if only subconsciously.

Since our transcendence, we have begun to see the Shroud with greater clarity. There are patterns where once even our strongest telepaths could see only a formless mass of swirling energy. There are... other things, as well. Spirits of a sort, that gaze back on us from the other side. Sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with kindness... and sometimes with malice.

We are still in the process of learning the extent of our new powers, but it may be possible for us to commune with these spirits. It will require the combined efforts of our most powerful telepaths.

utopia.2656.a.zh: 是时候进入了，看看我们能发现什么。
utopia.2656.a.en: Time to reach in and see what we find.

utopia.2656.desc.zh:
经过了数天的催眠出神后，灵能使密会的通灵者们终于开启了一道通往虚境的短暂穿界门。

现在已经建立了初步的灵能链接，以后就能通过接触菜单和虚境交流了。为了和这一领域建立有意义的连接并会见身居其中的存在，我们有必要用一种特殊的灵能发射器延展灵能范围，这会消耗一笔巨量的能量。
utopia.2656.desc.en:
After days of being locked in an hypnotic trance, our psychics in the Conclave of Telepaths have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the Shroud.

Now that we have established an initial psionic link, we will be able to access the Shroud through the Contacts menu in the future. To make any kind of meaningful forays into this realm and meet the beings who dwell there, we will likely have to make use of special psionic emitters to extend our psychic reach. This will consume a tremendous amount of energy.

utopia.2657.a.tt.zh: 这将使我们签订一条契约。
utopia.2657.a.tt.en: This will let us form a Covenant.

utopia.2657.c.zh: 这不是什么好主意！我们得小心为妙。
utopia.2657.c.en: This was a terrible idea! We must be more careful.

utopia.2657.desc.zh:
在逐渐突破帷幕的过程中，我们可以感受到它在我们联合意识的施压下逐渐变得稀薄起来。而我们尝试突入虚境的行为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在注视着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量和深不可测的意图。它在逐渐渗入我们心灵的裂缝中。

它仅仅是注意到了我们，就像观察着舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般观察着我们。也许这个存在会允许我们进入，这样我们才能与其神秘的意识发生接触。
utopia.2657.desc.en:
While we have yet to actually pierce the veil, we can feel it getting thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. Yet, on the other side, our efforts to enter the Shroud have not gone unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power and unfathomable purpose. It seeps through the cracks of our psyche.

It barely notices us. It watches us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole. It might let us in, if only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

utopia.2658.desc.zh: 自从与[GetShroudPatron]签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。
utopia.2658.desc.en: Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the [GetShroudPatron]. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

utopia.2659.a.zh: 那我们就潜入虚境的深处吧。
utopia.2659.a.en: Into the shrouded depths we go.

utopia.2659.desc.zh: 我们的灵能使在不依靠虚境住民的帮助下不眠不休地尝试突破虚境。终于，他们发现了一条通路。这片深渊正在召唤我们。我们只需要深吸一口气跃入其中。
utopia.2659.desc.en: Our telepaths have toiled tirelessly to breach the Shroud with no help from its denizens. At last, they found a way in. This abyss calls to us. We need only dare to take the plunge.

utopia.2671.a.zh: 在织缕的怀抱中我们觉得更为安全。
utopia.2671.a.en: We feel safer in the Composer's embrace.

utopia.2671.a.tt.zh:
$covenant_composer_telepath_utopia_rank_1_tt$

我们可以在我方的某一个殖民地上建造一座£building£['building:building_composer_sanctum']。
utopia.2671.a.tt.en:
$covenant_composer_telepath_utopia_rank_1_tt$

We can now build a £building£ ['building:building_composer_sanctum'] on one of our colonies.

utopia.2671.b.zh: 我们也饥饿了。战争能够让我们饱腹。
utopia.2671.b.en: We hunger too. War can sate us.

utopia.2671.b.tt.zh:
$covenant_eater_telepath_utopia_rank_1_tt$

我们可以在我方的某一个殖民地上建造一座£building£['building:building_eater_sanctum']。
utopia.2671.b.tt.en:
$covenant_eater_telepath_utopia_rank_1_tt$

We can now build a £building£ ['building:building_eater_sanctum'] on one of our colonies.

utopia.2671.c.zh: 没有什么比欲念更为美丽。
utopia.2671.c.en: There is nothing more beautiful than desire.

utopia.2671.c.tt.zh:
$covenant_instrument_telepath_utopia_rank_1_tt$

我们可以在我方的某一个殖民地上建造一座£building£['building:building_instrument_sanctum']。
utopia.2671.c.tt.en:
$covenant_instrument_telepath_utopia_rank_1_tt$

We can now build a £building£ ['building:building_instrument_sanctum'] on one of our colonies.

utopia.2671.d.zh: 充盈的心灵容不下迟疑。
utopia.2671.d.en: A filled mind has no room for doubt.

utopia.2671.d.tt.zh:
$covenant_whisperers_telepath_utopia_rank_1_tt$

我们可以在我方的某一个殖民地上建造一座£building£['building:building_whisperers_sanctum']。
utopia.2671.d.tt.en:
$covenant_whisperers_telepath_utopia_rank_1_tt$

We can now build a £building£ ['building:building_whisperers_sanctum'] on one of our colonies.

utopia.2671.desc.zh:
我们对自己超主的理解与日俱增。我们对于祂来说只不过是茶余饭后的闲思遐绪。房室内的虫子。然而，是祂对我们降下了恩宠，而且非常偶然地，它对我们施予了又一汪能源之滴露。

我们的灵能使现在和超主愈发地协调，受到鼓舞我们计划建立一座纪念碑来铭记我们的刻印，在这里我们最为杰出的灵能使可以尝试与[GetShroudPatron]进行沟通。
utopia.2671.desc.en:
Our understanding of our patron grows. We are no more than an afterthought to it. Insects in its home. Yet, it has taken a liking to us and on this occasion, it has bestowed another drop of power upon us.

Our telepaths are now more closely attuned to our patron, and we have been inspired to create a monument to celebrate our covenant, a place where our best telepaths can try to commune with the [GetShroudPatron].

utopia.2676.a.en: The will of the Flesh is sacred.

utopia.2676.desc.zh: 虚境的神秘对于我们来说异乎寻常，难以消弭，但是我们和[GetShroudPatron]的协调更加融顺了。无论我们去往哪里，我们都能感受到它在我们思绪的背后，它的能量渗过心灵的缝隙进入我们的现实。
utopia.2676.desc.en: The mysteries of the Shroud are too alien for us to dispel, but we have become more attuned to the [GetShroudPatron]. Everywhere we go, we can sense it at the back of our minds, and its power seeps into our reality from the cracks of our psyche.

utopia.2681.desc.zh:
我们的超主，[GetShroudPatron]，从虚境中沉积出了一小份能量以备取用。与超主的紧密关系让我们能安全吸收这些能量。

我们挑选了一些候选人，但只有其中一位可以得到获得汲取超主力量的殊荣。我们必须做出抉择。
utopia.2681.desc.en:
Our patron, the [GetShroudPatron], has deposited a fraction of its energy in a fold of the Shroud, ready for the taking. Our close bond will allow one of us to safely absorb this power.

A number of candidates have been selected, but only one of them can be granted the privilege to wield the power of our patron. We must decide who it shall be.

utopia.2682.a.en: They were destined to be Chosen.

utopia.2682.desc.previous_chosen_killed.zh: 这次事件给[previous_chosen_leader.GetName]，一位曾被旧主选中的异端，带来了毁灭性打击。在[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]的流放地，随着最后一丝灵能从[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]支离破碎的躯体中消散，这位异端的生命也随之走到了尽头。
utopia.2682.desc.previous_chosen_killed.en: The event had a devastating effect on the heretic [previous_chosen_leader.GetName], once considered the Chosen of our former patron. From [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] place of exile, [previous_chosen_leader.GetHeShe] quietly expired when the last traces of psionic power ebbed from [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] broken form.

utopia.2682.desc.previous_chosen_lost_pa.zh: 该事件对[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]产生了显著影响。尽管[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe]依旧蕴含强大的灵能能量，却失去了昔日由旧主庇护在[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer]躯体中赋予的力量。
utopia.2682.desc.previous_chosen_lost_pa.en: The event had a noticeable effect on [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]. Though still imbued with considerable psionic energy, [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe] [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHasHave] lost the power once bestowed in [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer] by our former patron.

utopia.2686.a.en: What is a hull if not flesh?

utopia.2686.d.zh: 秘密是无可匹敌的武器。

utopia.2686.desc.zh:
灵能使密会在研究如何利用超主[GetShroudPatron]的力量方面取得了突破性进展。在从前，只有激发了灵能的个体可以完全领悟契约的内涵，我们已经开发了一种能让这股力量贯穿整艘星舰的方法，这是此前从未达到过的程度。

只要我们想，[GetShroudPatron]的力量能将我们的舰船推进得比以往更远。
utopia.2686.desc.en:
The Conclave of Telepaths has made a breakthrough in harnessing the powers of our patron, the [GetShroudPatron]. Where previously only psionic individuals could fully grasp the extent of the Covenant, we have devised a way to let power flow through entire starships, at a scale never seen before.

Should we wish it, the mark of the [GetShroudPatron] can push our ships further than ever before.

utopia.27.desc.zh: 自从环形世界的建造工作开始后，一小部分工人失踪了。似乎他们乘坐着无数运输船中的一艘，未通知他们的上级就离开了，我们正在开展调查以寻求他们的去向。不幸的是他们未经允许的离开显著拖延了建造。
utopia.27.desc.en: Since construction on the ring world began, a number of workers have gone missing. Though it's likely they've simply left with one of the many transports without notifying their supervisors, we are launching an investigation into their whereabouts. Sadly their unexpected departure has delayed construction slightly.

utopia.2700.desc.zh: 有时进化需要被往正确的方向上推一把。我们现在有足够先进的技术，能够对我们的身体和思维进行基因层面的改造，以应对不断变化的环境带来的前所未有的挑战。
utopia.2700.desc.en: Sometimes evolution needs a nudge in the right direction. We now have the technology to genetically modify our bodies and minds to endure the trials of an ever-changing environment at an unprecedented rate.

utopia.2703.desc.zh:
我们终于不用再担心物种的生死存亡了。[Root.GetSpeciesName]人被自然随意主宰，基因进化完全听天由命的日子终于结束了。

我们这个时代的工程师不是面对钢骨水泥工作，而是每天跟基因序列打交道。掌握着先进的基因改进技术，我们将能保证民族的美好未来。
utopia.2703.desc.en:
Gone are the days when the survival of our species was at the mercy of chance. When a [Root.GetSpeciesName]'s fate was decided on the whims of nature, in the genetic lottery.

The Engineers of our time work not in steel and concrete, but in the very building blocks of life itself. With advanced gene modification we will secure the future of our nation.

utopia.28.a.zh: 我们的思念与他们同在。

utopia.28.desc.zh: 随着替补工人的到来，环形世界的建造工作终于回归正轨了。可惜的是我们还没有找到失踪的工人们，他们的家人已经得到通知了。
utopia.28.desc.en: With the arrival of replacement workers, construction on the ring world is finally back on track. Regrettably we have still not been able to locate the missing workers, whose families have now been notified.

utopia.3.desc.v1.zh: 为表诚意，[From.GetName]同意我们派出武器专家在他们的环形世界中搜寻潜藏的秘密发射平台。一批精挑细选的最杰出的武器专家已经动身出发，马上就能真相大白了。
utopia.3.desc.v1.en: In good faith, the [From.GetName] has agreed to let a team of our weapons experts search their ring world for a hidden launch platform. A selection of our most qualified specialists are already headed to the site. Soon we will know the truth.

utopia.3.desc.v2.zh: 令我们的科学团体激动的是，我们从[From.GetName]处收到消息，他们很荣幸能在他们在建的环形世界上招待我们的研究团队。我们的首席工程师已组织了我们最优秀的工程师团队迅速前往环形世界，以报告建造进度。
utopia.3.desc.v2.en: To the excitement of the scientific community, we have received word that the [From.GetName] would be honored to host a team of our researchers on their ring world. The engineering chief has organized to send a delegation of our finest engineers there shortly, to report on the construction process.

utopia.3.desc.v4.zh:
[From.GetName]对我们的高规格出访致以热切的问候，承诺停止环形世界的建造工作，直到我们的宗教领袖感到满意，认定环形世界不会违背神的意志为止。

数位精选的神官已经立刻启程前往建造现场，以确保残酷的预言永远不会成真。
utopia.3.desc.v4.en:
The [From.GetName] welcomes our efforts to align with a higher presence, and promises to halt all construction on the ring world till our religious leaders are satisfied that it won't interfere with divine will.

A handful of chosen officials are setting out for the construction site immediately, to ensure that the grim prophecy is never fulfilled.

utopia.30.a.zh: 我们应得到一个正式的道歉。

utopia.30.b.zh: 1000能量币的赔款将缓解我们的痛苦。
utopia.30.b.en: A donation of 1000 credits could alleviate the pain.

utopia.30.c.en: Maintaining good relations with our neighbors comes first.

utopia.30.desc.v1.zh:
我们的帝国震惊地发现[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]正在[dyson_system.GetName]周围建造一个戴森球，那是我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星，而戴森球将完全阻隔她的光亮。

独眼漫步者，用她的独眼，自从我们的文明伊始便守望着我们，她的传奇不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行。而现在，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]，伴随着他们浅显的傲慢，要用一个戴森球遮蔽她，弄瞎她。

虽然需要过上许多年，我们这才能感受到变化，但是当我们的人民得知她不能继续守望我们的下一代时，依然感到无比震惊。
utopia.30.desc.v1.en:
Our empire has been shaken by the discovery that the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] are building a Dyson Sphere around [dyson_system.GetName], a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the "One-eyed Wanderer," completely blocking its light.

The Wanderer, with her single eye, has watched over our kind since the beginning of time, and legend has it that she guides not only our fleets, but the stars themselves in their journey across the sky. And now the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName], in their blatant ignorance, have built a sphere around her eye, blinding her.

Though it will take many years before we can tell a difference from here, our people are crushed that she will no longer be watching over future generations.

utopia.3000.10.desc.zh: 虚境的脉动强而有力。感觉像……家一样。
utopia.3000.10.desc.en: The Shroud pulsates with power. It feels like... home.

utopia.3000.11.desc.zh: 你觉得你现在呼吸的是空气吗？
utopia.3000.11.desc.en: Do you think that is air you're breathing now?

utopia.3000.12.desc.zh: 我们见，我们不曾见，这地方还有许多有待我们学习的东西。
utopia.3000.12.desc.en: We see, and yet we do not see. There is so much to learn about this place.

utopia.3000.13.desc.zh: 我们缺失了什么感官，为什么我们无法看到，听到我们周遭的另一个世界？
utopia.3000.13.desc.en: What senses do we lack that we cannot see and cannot hear another world all around us?

utopia.3000.14.desc.zh: 保持最谨慎的状态。在这里即使是一个妄想也能被塑性成可触及的事物……而且，往往会袭击我们。
utopia.3000.14.desc.en: Take the greatest of care. Even a stray thought can be shaped into something tangible in this place... and, more often than not, turned against oneself.

utopia.3000.15.desc.zh: 我们永远都不应在这的。
utopia.3000.15.desc.en: We were never meant to be here.

utopia.3000.18.desc.zh: 这就是一切的起源之地吗？
utopia.3000.18.desc.en: Could this be where everything began?

utopia.3000.2.desc.zh: 某种存在在注视着我们。

utopia.3000.20.desc.zh: 虚境和之前已经完全不一样了。肯定有什么东西错了。
utopia.3000.20.desc.en: The Shroud is not what it once was. Something is very wrong.

utopia.3000.21.desc.zh: 居住在虚境的实体们陷入了巨大的痛苦。一股压倒一切的战栗感渗透进了一切。
utopia.3000.21.desc.en: The entities that reside within the Shroud are in anguish. An almost overwhelming sense of terror permeates everything.

utopia.3000.22.desc.zh: 很难……集中注意力。万事万物都在涌动，万事万物都在……痛苦。
utopia.3000.22.desc.en: It is... difficult to focus. Everything is in flux, and there is so much... pain.

utopia.3000.23.desc.zh: 虚境正在整片区域整片区域地开始……枯萎。我们找不到其他的形容方式。
utopia.3000.23.desc.en: Entire segments of the Shroud have... shrivelled. It can be described in no other way.

utopia.3000.24.desc.zh: 巨大的黑暗正在虚境之中蔓延，腐蚀其触碰到的一切。
utopia.3000.24.desc.en: A great darkness is spreading throughout the Shroud, corrupting everything it touches.

utopia.3000.25.desc.zh: 虚境之中有了全新的存在。其黑暗的影响力遍布四处。一切都在发生变化。
utopia.3000.25.desc.en: There is a new presence in the Shroud. Its dark influence is felt everywhere. Everything is changing.

utopia.3000.3.desc.zh: 从这一面看，一切变得如此不同。
utopia.3000.3.desc.en: It all looks so different on this side.

utopia.3000.4.desc.zh: 他们应该派个诗人过来……
utopia.3000.4.desc.en: They should have sent a poet...

utopia.3000.7.desc.zh: 我们……我们办到了！我们在里面！
utopia.3000.7.desc.en: We... we made it. We're inside!

utopia.3000.8.desc.zh: 某种……存在，徘徊在附近。它召唤我们前往虚境更深处……
utopia.3000.8.desc.en: A... presence, of sorts, lingers nearby. It beckons us deeper into the Shroud...

utopia.3000.9.desc.en: Do you hear the voices too?

utopia.3000.b.en: Reach out to a higher power.

utopia.3000.intro.desc.zh:
虚境。它是如此怪异，如此令人不安，却让人瞬间觉得……熟悉。任何有灵能能力的人都在梦中见到过这里，虽然他们当时可能并不知情。

我们如今徘徊在这虚境边陲的峭壁上，距离虚境与普通空间——或称“现实世界”之间的虚空间隙仅咫尺之遥。

为了探索深层次的虚境，我们需要在通灵上付出巨大贡献，还需要一笔巨额的能量，我们绝对不能草率对待……即使是现在，我们被注视着。
utopia.3000.intro.desc.en:
The Shroud. It is unbelievably strange and unsettling, but also... immediately familiar. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.

We linger now at the precipice of this realm, not far from the empty void of the Inbetween that serves as the boundary between here and normal space - or what we would call the real world.

To venture deeper into the Shroud will require great effort on the part of our telepaths, as well as a large amount of energy. We must not dally... even now, we are being watched.

utopia.3005.a.en: One that reeks of flesh unbound.

utopia.3005.b.en: One that screams of emptiness insatiable.

utopia.3005.c.en: One that whispers of longing and possession.

utopia.3005.d.en: One that tastes like broken trust.

utopia.3005.desc.zh: 我们知道这里潜藏着巨大的力量。虽然我们一度被忽视，但如果能利用好泽珞的力量便能够尝试进行探寻。我们的灵能使在整个虚境中探测到了这些实体。我们应该去寻访哪一位？
utopia.3005.desc.en: We know that there are vast powers out there. While we'd usually go unnoticed, we could try to reach out by tapping into the powers of Zro. All over the Shroud, the influence of these entities is felt by our telepaths. Which one should we seek out?

utopia.3010.desc.zh:
灵能使密会所还没有从上一次参观虚境的压力中恢复过来。没有他们的共通灵能，我们只能捕捉到这个飞逝领域的一瞥，就像记忆的模糊边界一样遥不可及。

而这目前不能提供给我们什么，我们只能之后再来。
utopia.3010.desc.en:
The Conclave of Telepaths has not yet recovered from the strain of our previous visit to the Shroud. Without their combined psionic power, we can catch only brief glimpses of this fleeting realm - like the blurred edges of a memory lying just beyond reach.

There is nothing for us here. We will have to return later.

utopia.3020.desc.zh:
虚境强大的能量已被成功地注入一个处于我们的控制之下的灵能化身！

在转移至我们的维度后，这个新生的化身已合并为一个太空实体，并处在[Root.Capital.GetName]轨道上。
utopia.3020.desc.en:
The powerful energies of the Shroud have been successfully channeled into a psionic Avatar under our control!

After translating into our dimension, the newborn Avatar has coalesced into a spacefaring entity in orbit over [Root.Capital.GetName].

utopia.3021.desc.zh:
虚境强大的能量已被成功地注入一个处于我们的控制之下的灵能化身！

在转移至我们的维度后，这个新生的化身已合并为一个巨型武士，并处在[Root.Capital.GetName]地表上。
utopia.3021.desc.en:
The powerful energies of the Shroud have been successfully channeled into a psionic Avatar under our control!

After translating into our dimension, the newborn Avatar has coalesced into a colossal warrior on the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName].

utopia.3022.desc.zh: 用来召唤一个化身并将其带至我们维度所需导通的灵能已超越我们目前的能力。因为我们的失败，虚境的能量摇曳至尽。
utopia.3022.desc.en: Channelling the psionic power required to summon an Avatar and bring it into our dimension is simply beyond our current ability. The energies of the Shroud fizzle with agitation as our attempt fails.

utopia.3023.desc.zh:
召唤化身的尝试只成功了一部分。虽然这个造物已经以正确的形态显现到我们的维度中，但[GetTelepathPlural]们未能将其驯服！

我们现在要面对一个敌对的灵能实体，它将摧毁沿途的一切。
utopia.3023.desc.en:
The attempt to summon a psionic Avatar was only partially successful. Although the creature assumed its correct form and translated into our dimension, our [GetTelepathPlural] failed to bring it under our control!

We are now faced with an aggressive psionic entity that will destroy everything in its path.

utopia.3024.desc.zh: 一个虚境造物突破了空间壁垒，并且在[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]星系完成实体化！这个复仇心切的化身驾驭着一股强大的灵能，并将用其鞭挞任何不幸踏上它复仇之路的人和物。
utopia.3024.desc.en: A creature of the Shroud has pierced the fabric of space and materialized in the [shroud_spawn_system.GetName] system! This vengeful Avatar has amassed a tremendous amount of psionic energy and is using it to lash out at anything and anyone unfortunate enough to get in its path.

utopia.3026.desc.zh:
由于在本空间停留导致的能量持续衰退，位于[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]星系的化身已到达其无法维持形态的谷值。

它无法继续维持实体形态，退回了虚境之中。
utopia.3026.desc.en:
The continual atrophy of existing in normal space has weakened the Avatar in the [shroud_spawn_system.GetName] system.

No longer able to maintain its tangible form, it has withdrawn back into the Shroud.

utopia.3030.desc.gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

这些能量在集体网络中环流，确保我们的子个体在执行任务时获得最佳的稳定性。
utopia.3030.desc.gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

These energies course throughout the collective network, ensuring optimum stability as our drones fulfill their purposes.

utopia.3030.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

一种深刻的运行平衡感迅速传遍了[Root.GetName]，看起来那些没有灵能部件的单元甚至也被影响了。
utopia.3030.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

A profound operational equilibrium is spreading throughout the [Root.GetName], and affecting even those without psionic components.

utopia.3030.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

一种对平静的深远认识迅速传遍了[Root.GetName]，甚至没有灵能能力的人也受之影响。
utopia.3030.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

A profound sense of calm is spreading throughout the [Root.GetName], and affecting even those without psionic abilities.

utopia.3031.desc.zh:
$boon.ship.link$

无论服役记录如何，我们的舰队损耗的迹象都消失了。因此我们的维护成本大大降低。
utopia.3031.desc.en:
$boon.ship.link$

Our fleets exhibit no signs of degradation regardless of their service record. As a result, our upkeep costs have been significantly decreased.

utopia.3032.desc.machine_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

灵能渲染循环使我们的研究矩阵超越了最高效率，极大地提高了学习效率。
utopia.3032.desc.machine_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

Psionic rendering loops are allowing our research matrix to operate beyond maximum efficiency, vastly improving learning efficiency.

utopia.3032.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们的[GetScientistPlural]之间已经建立起了心灵感应共享集体知识库，这将极大地提高他们的工作效率。
utopia.3032.desc.non_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

A collective knowledge base that is shared telepathically between our [GetScientistPlural] has been established, which will greatly increase the efficiency of their work.

utopia.3032.desc.organic_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]主脑内的科研专注节点正以绝佳的同步率工作中，提升了认知效率。
utopia.3032.desc.organic_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

Our research focused nodes within the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] overmind are operating in perfect synchronicity, increasing our cognitive efficiency.

utopia.3033.desc.zh:
$boon.ship.link$

我们的战舰乘员现在能用灵能来强化护盾系统了。
utopia.3033.desc.en:
$boon.ship.link$

The crews of our warships can now augment the strength of our shield systems by using their psionic powers.

utopia.3034.desc.zh:
$boon.ship.link$

通过使用灵能，我们的船员现在能强化武器系统。
utopia.3034.desc.en:
$boon.ship.link$

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to augment the strength of our weapon systems.

utopia.3035.desc.zh:
$boon.ship.link$

通过使用灵能，我们的船员现在能加快武器的射速。
utopia.3035.desc.en:
$boon.ship.link$

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to increase the firing rate of our weapon systems.

utopia.3036.desc.gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

这些能量在集体中留存，优化着我们子个体的效率，降低各种分散我们注意力的反常行为。
utopia.3036.desc.gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

These energies persist throughout the collective, streamlining the efficiency of our drones, reducing any lingering deviancy that was otherwise distracting our focus.

utopia.3036.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$
一种对团结的认知开始出现在我们居民的处理器中，他们现在看起来更愿意通力合作，向着政府设立的目标前进。
utopia.3036.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

A new sense of solidarity has appeared in the processing cores of our citizens, making them more willing to work together towards the mutual goals established by our government.

utopia.3036.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

一种对团结的认知开始出现在我们居民的心智中，他们现在看起来更愿意通力合作，向着政府设立的目标前进。
utopia.3036.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

A new sense of solidarity has appeared in the hearts and minds of our citizens, making them more willing to work together towards the mutual goals established by our government.

utopia.3037.desc.genocidal.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们的意志以前所未有的力度施加到了整个星系。
utopia.3037.desc.genocidal.en:
$boon.psi.link$

Our will is forced upon the galaxy in magnitude like never before.

utopia.3037.desc.machine_non_genocidal.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们的外交单元正在以最高的共情效率运作中，带来了更强大的政治影响力。
utopia.3037.desc.machine_non_genocidal.en:
$boon.psi.link$

Our diplomacy units are operating at maximum empathetic efficiency, resulting in greater political influence.

utopia.3037.desc.organic_non_genocidal.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们的同理心比以往更强烈了，导致我们拥有更大的政治影响力。
utopia.3037.desc.organic_non_genocidal.en:
$boon.psi.link$

Our empaths are stronger than ever before, resulting in greater political influence.

utopia.3038.desc.gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们感受到了空前的清晰与团结。
utopia.3038.desc.gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

We have never experienced such clarity and unity of purpose.

utopia.3038.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们感到了前所未有的团结。
utopia.3038.desc.non_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

We have never felt a greater sense of unity.

utopia.3039.desc.zh:
$boon.ship.link$

通过使用灵能，我们的船员现在能直接影响舰船的移动，使船面对敌方火力时闪避率更高。
utopia.3039.desc.en:
$boon.ship.link$

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to directly affect the movement of our ships, increasing their evasiveness in the face of enemy fire.

utopia.3040.desc.machine.zh:
$boon.ship.link$

通过使用灵能，我们的战舰乘员现在能行使有限的战地维修，用他们的神经处理器修补船体裂隙。
utopia.3040.desc.machine.en:
$boon.ship.link$

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to perform limited field repairs, mending hull fissures with their neuroprocessors alone.

utopia.3040.desc.organic.zh:
$boon.ship.link$

通过使用灵能，我们的战舰乘员现在能行使有限的战地维修，用他们的心智修补船体裂隙。
utopia.3040.desc.organic.en:
$boon.ship.link$

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to perform limited field repairs, mending hull fissures with their minds alone.

utopia.3041.desc.machine.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]已用他们的力量暂时减缓了我们最杰出领袖单元的衰老进程，使他们的预计报废日期延缓了数十年。可惜的是我们没有足够多的能量将这种效果赐予大量人口。
utopia.3041.desc.machine.en:
$boon.psi.link$

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have used this power to momentarily improve functional performance among our most prominent leader units, delaying their estimated obsolescence date by decades. Alas, there was not enough psionic energy to bestow this effect upon the population at large.

utopia.3041.desc.organic_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]已用他们的力量暂时减缓了我们最杰出领袖子个体的衰老进程，使他们的自然寿命增加了数十年。可惜的是我们没有足够多的能量将这种效果赐予大量人口。
utopia.3041.desc.organic_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have used this power to momentarily slow down the aging process for our most prominent leader drones, adding decades to their natural lives. Alas, there was not enough psionic energy to bestow this effect upon the population at large.

utopia.3041.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]利用这份力量暂时降低了最杰出领袖的老化进程，延续了几十年的自然寿命。惜的是我们没有足够多的能量将这种效果赐予大量人口。
utopia.3041.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have used this power to momentarily slow down the aging process for our most prominent leaders, adding decades to their natural lives. Alas, there was not enough psionic energy to bestow this effect upon the population at large.

utopia.3041.tooltip.zh: 所有领袖获得$leader_trait_shroud_age$特质，获得+40年领袖寿命。
utopia.3041.tooltip.en: All leaders gain the $leader_trait_shroud_age$ trait, granting +40 years of leader lifespan.

utopia.3042.desc.zh:
$boon.ship.link$

通过使用灵能，我们的船员现在能强化舰船推进器的强度，使舰船亚光速速度明显提高。
utopia.3042.desc.en:
$boon.ship.link$

Using their psionic powers, our crew is now able to augment the strength of the thrusters on their ships, resulting in greatly increased sublight speed.

utopia.3043.desc.machine_or_gestalt.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

这股力量强化了我们战斗无人机的目标达成度，优化了战场效率。
utopia.3043.desc.machine_or_gestalt.en:
$boon.psi.link$

This has reinforced our combat drones' commitment to their purpose, streamlining their efficiency in the field.

utopia.3043.desc.organic.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

这股力量强化了我们士兵的心智，他们现在愿意勇闯战场上的任何危险。他们的团队精神无人能出其右。
utopia.3043.desc.organic.en:
$boon.psi.link$

This has fortified the minds of our soldiers, who are now willing to brave any dangers on the battlefield. Their morale is without equal.

utopia.3044.desc.zh:
$boon.psi.link$

我们现在能感知到比传统传感阵列探测距离更远处的舰船移动了。
utopia.3044.desc.en:
$boon.psi.link$

We can now sense vessels as they move through space at a far greater distance than any conventional sensor array would be capable of.

utopia.3045.1.desc.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]用来连接虚境的传导通路自我垮解了，因为虚境的数个能量层级没有任何预兆便改变了。

我们轻易地就被逐回了普通空间。
utopia.3045.1.desc.en:
The conduit that our [GetTelepathPlural] were using to connect to the Shroud collapsed on itself as several energy layers of the psychic realm suddenly shifted without warning.

We are being summarily ejected back into normal space.

utopia.3045.2.desc.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在与虚境交流时被强烈的灵压压垮了。

他们不能继续维持链接了。
utopia.3045.2.desc.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] have been overwhelmed by the intense strain they were put under during our communion with the Shroud.

They can no longer maintain the link.

utopia.3045.3.desc_machine.zh: 起初很慢，然后越来越快，我们对虚境的攀附逐渐松脱。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境失去立足点，开始发生故障，然后我们被逐回了普通空间。
utopia.3045.3.desc_machine.en: Slowly at first, then faster and faster, our grasp on the Shroud begins to slip. Our [GetTelepathPlural] begin to malfunction as they lose their foothold and we are ejected back into normal space.

utopia.3045.3.desc_organic.zh: 起初很慢，然后越来越快，我们对虚境的攀附逐渐松脱。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境失去立足点，发出了痛苦的喊叫，然后我们被逐回了普通空间。
utopia.3045.3.desc_organic.en: Slowly at first, then faster and faster, our grasp on the Shroud begins to slip. Our [GetTelepathPlural] cry out in anguish as they lose their foothold and we are ejected back into normal space.

utopia.3050.desc.gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

这导致了[Root.GetName]集体内部的扰动，带来全帝国的不稳定性。
utopia.3050.desc.gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

This has resulted in a disturbance within the [Root.GetName] collective, leading to empire-wide destabilization.

utopia.3050.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

这似乎对我们居民的幸福度产生了深远影响，如今一股对忧郁的认知席卷了[Root.GetName]。
utopia.3050.desc.non_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

This has had a profound effect on the happiness of our citizens, and a sense of gloom now pervades throughout the [Root.GetName].

utopia.3051.desc.gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

产生的震波在整个集体中回荡，在子个体中引起异常行为，导致了棘手的异常情况。
utopia.3051.desc.gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The resulting shockwaves throughout the collective has resulted in a troubling emergence of deviant behavior among our drones.

utopia.3051.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

这种负面能量席卷了我们公民的内心。很多人开始向往和我们政府不合的激进理念。这种影响甚至感染了无灵能居民！
utopia.3051.desc.non_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

This negative energy has spread doubt within the minds of our citizens. Many are turning towards new radical ideas that are not in line with those of our government. The effect has even spread to non-psychic citizens!

utopia.3052.desc.zh:
$curse.ship.link$

它们的装甲变得易碎起来，只能承受比以往更少的伤害。
utopia.3052.desc.en:
$curse.ship.link$

Their armor has grown brittle, and can no longer sustain the punishment it once could.

utopia.3053.desc.machine.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

对我们神经网络造成的压力对全[Root.GetName]的单位建设造成了可观的负面影响。
utopia.3053.desc.machine.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The resulting strain on our neural network has led to a notable drop in unit construction across the [Root.GetName].

utopia.3053.desc.organic_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

对整个集体造成的痛苦感受对新子个体的产出能力造成了可观的负面影响。
utopia.3053.desc.organic_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The resulting pain felt throughout the collective has caused a notable diminishment in our ability to produce new physical drones.

utopia.3053.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

因为某种原因，这对全[Root.GetName]的生育率产生了损害。这甚至对没有天生灵能能力的物种产生了影响！
utopia.3053.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

For some reason, this has had a detrimental effect on birth-rates throughout the [Root.GetName]. This has even affected members of races without any inherent psionic ability!

utopia.3054.desc.machine_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

由此产生的灵能渲染反馈循环影响了我们科研矩阵的全效率运转。
utopia.3054.desc.machine_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The resulting psionic rendering feedback loops are blocking our research matrix from efficiently operating at their full capacity.

utopia.3054.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

我们研究者的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]遭到了过载，这对他们专注工作有很大影响。
utopia.3054.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The [GetMindPhysicalLoc] of our researchers have been overloaded, leaving them unable to efficiently focus on their workloads.

utopia.3054.desc.organic_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]主脑内的科研专注节点遭到了过载，导致我们无法高效处理新的发现。
utopia.3054.desc.organic_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

Our research focused nodes within the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] collective are overloaded. Leaving us unable to process new discoveries efficiently.

utopia.3054.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

我们研究者的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]遭到了蒙蔽，导致他们无法高效专注地进行工作。
utopia.3054.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The [GetMindPhysicalLoc] of our researchers have been clouded, leaving them unable to efficiently focus on their workloads.

utopia.3055.desc.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

我们积聚政治影响力的速率被明显降低了。
utopia.3055.desc.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The rate at which we accumulate political influence has been greatly diminished.

utopia.3056.desc.machine_or_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

曾经存在于我们[Root.GetName]中的对团结的认知涣散了，导致了大规模的不协调。
utopia.3056.desc.machine_or_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The sense of unity that once existed throughout the [Root.GetName] has been shaken, leading to widespread miscoordination.

utopia.3056.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

曾经存在于我们公民心中对团结的认知涣散了。
utopia.3056.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

The sense of unity that once existed between our citizens has been shattered.

utopia.3057.desc.zh:
$curse.ship.link$

我们的舰船移动时，似乎被某种不可见的力量拽回来，大幅降低了亚光速航行的速度。
utopia.3057.desc.en:
$curse.ship.link$

Our ships move as if held back by an invisible force. This has resulted in much slower sublight travel.

utopia.3058.desc.machine_or_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

该能量涌造成的反馈回路妨碍了地面部队的运作效率。
utopia.3058.desc.machine_or_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

Feedback loops caused by this energy surge have damaged the operational efficiency of our ground troops.

utopia.3058.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$curse.psi.link$

这种负面能量侵蚀了我们地面部队的士气，这期间他们在战场上的效率会更低。
utopia.3058.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
$curse.psi.link$

This negative energy has eroded the morale of our ground troops, who will be much less effective in battle for a time.

utopia.3059.desc.zh:
一股强大的灵能反噬沿着我们与虚境建立的传导通路袭来，而且这似乎干扰了我们的星际传感器。

从所有来源收到的传感器分辨率都大幅降低了，导致探测距离变短。
utopia.3059.desc.en:
A powerful psionic backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and it seems to be interfering with our interstellar sensors.

The sensor resolution from all sources has been greatly diminished, resulting in much shorter sensor ranges.

utopia.31.b.zh: 给他们分享一些我们的能源币。
utopia.31.b.en: Share some of our energy with them.

utopia.31.desc.zh:
$utopia.31.intro$

虽然我们要等很多年才能在母星感到变化，她不能继续守望的下一代的消息震惊了我们的人民，现在人民要求得到正式道歉。
utopia.31.desc.en:
$utopia.31.intro$

Though it will take many years before we can tell the difference from here, the notion that she won't be watching over future generations has shaken our people and they deserve a formal apology.

utopia.3100.a.en: Channel the energies into an Avatar.

utopia.3100.desc_default.zh:
$utopia.3100.desc_prefix$在烈火与浓烟的的笼罩下，巨大的城市看起来陌生又熟悉。成千上万……不，上百万残尸横死街头，定睛一看都是[Root.GetSpeciesName]的尸体。腐烂的恶臭让人难以忍受。

“你们的未来。”

废墟上死寂一片。望向天空，轨道上巨大的物体，拖着烟迹，开始缓慢却不可阻止地降向星球。我们是在见证无数可能的未来之一吗？$utopia.3100.desc_suffix$
utopia.3100.desc_default.en:
$utopia.3100.desc_prefix$The great cities look different yet familiar, even through the obscuring wall of flames and smoke. Thousands... no, millions of mutilated bodies litter the streets, all of them [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The stench of decay is unbearable.

YOUR FUTURE.

Nothing living remains in the ruins. In the sky above, massive orbital installations, trailing smoke, have begun a slow and inevitable descent towards the planet. Are we witnessing one possible future out of many?$utopia.3100.desc_suffix$

utopia.3100.desc_hive.zh:
$utopia.3100.desc_prefix$在烈火与浓烟的的笼罩下，巨大的城市看起来陌生又熟悉。成千上万……不，上百万残尸横死街头，定睛一看都是[Root.GetSpeciesName]的尸体。腐烂的恶臭弥漫。

“你们的未来。”

废墟上死寂一片。望向天空，轨道上巨大的物体，拖着烟迹，开始缓慢却不可阻止地降向星球。我们是在见证无数可能的未来之一吗？$utopia.3100.desc_suffix$
utopia.3100.desc_hive.en:
$utopia.3100.desc_prefix$The great cities look different yet familiar, even through the obscuring wall of flames and smoke. Thousands... no, millions of mutilated bodies litter the streets, all of them [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The stench of decay is pervasive.

YOUR FUTURE.

Nothing living remains in the ruins. In the sky above, massive orbital installations, trailing smoke, have begun a slow and inevitable descent towards the planet. Are we witnessing one possible future out of many?$utopia.3100.desc_suffix$

utopia.3100.desc_machine.zh:
$utopia.3100.desc_prefix$在烈火与浓烟的的笼罩下，巨大的城市看起来陌生但可辨认。成千上万……不，上百万被拆解的单元散落街头，它们全都是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。破败之景环绕着我们。

“你们的未来。”

废墟上死寂一片。望向天空，轨道上巨大的物体，拖着烟迹，开始缓慢却不可阻止地降向星球。我们是在见证无数可能的未来之一吗？$utopia.3100.desc_suffix$
utopia.3100.desc_machine.en:
$utopia.3100.desc_prefix$The major cities look different yet recognizable, even through the obscuring wall of flames and smoke. Thousands... no, millions of dismantled units litter the streets, all of them [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We are surrounded by destruction.

YOUR FUTURE.

Nothing functional remains in the ruins. In the sky above, massive orbital installations, trailing smoke, have begun a slow and inevitable descent towards the planet. Are we receiving one possible future out of many?$utopia.3100.desc_suffix$

utopia.3110.desc.zh:
虚境此处风暴呼啸。大量的原生灵能能量流经这里，有时会狂暴地产生半智慧灵体生物。

这些困惑的灵体经常相互冲突，在战斗中释放出能残留数千年的庞大灵能。事实上，现在就有几场这样的决斗正在进行。

我们应该谨慎前进。
utopia.3110.desc.en:
The Shroud is tempestuous here. As massive currents of raw psionic energy are funneled through, violent reactions give birth to semi-intelligent apparitions.

These confused spirits often clash with one another, unleashing phenomenal amounts of psychic power in battles that can last millennia. In fact, several such duels seem to be taking place right now.

We should proceed with caution.

utopia.3120.desc_default.zh: 在虚境的深处，一个存在突然展露了自身。$utopia.3120.desc_suffix$
utopia.3120.desc_default.en: Deeper within the Shroud, a presence suddenly makes itself felt. $utopia.3120.desc_suffix$

utopia.3120.desc_machine.zh: 在虚境的深处，我们探测到了一个存在。$utopia.3120.desc_suffix$
utopia.3120.desc_machine.en: Deeper within the Shroud, we detect a presence. $utopia.3120.desc_suffix$

utopia.3130.b.zh: 提里特 奈利 达苏马娜！

utopia.3130.desc.zh:
一处无尽的沙漠蔓延在我们面前。我们曾经来过这。

“刹拉 库尔‘弥勒姆 祖耐克？”

有什么从沙中浮现了出来。我们难以看到。

“扎拉比，穆拉斯克。”

话语像雷鸣般响亮，他们从未预料到说话者的出现。我们只能被迫回答。
utopia.3130.desc.en:
An endless desert stretches before us. We have been here before.

"Shala'kul milem zunak?"

Something emerges from the sand. It is difficult to see.

"Zharabi, melasuk."

The words are like thunder, spoken by a mouth for which they were never intended. We are compelled to answer.

utopia.3140.desc_default.zh:
突然，在痛苦的瞬间清晰中，$utopia.3140.desc_common$生命悬在天平之上。

$utopia.3140.desc_suffix$
utopia.3140.desc_default.en:
Suddenly, in a painful moment of clarity, $utopia.3140.desc_common$ lives hanging in the balance.

$utopia.3140.desc_suffix$

utopia.3140.desc_machine.zh:
突然，在倏然的清晰中，$utopia.3140.desc_common$变量悬在天平之上。

$utopia.3140.desc_suffix$
utopia.3140.desc_machine.en:
Suddenly, in a startling moment of clarity, $utopia.3140.desc_common$ variables hanging in the balance.

$utopia.3140.desc_suffix$

utopia.3150.a.zh: 进入他们的意识找寻秘密。
utopia.3150.a.en: Reach into their minds in search of secrets.

utopia.3150.desc.zh:
我们正从远处俯视我们的星系，远到有几十万光年。毫无征兆地，灵能流便将我们以难以置信的速度冲向无数恒星，来到了一片属于失落帝国，[fallen_empire.GetName]，的宇域。

急速掠过恒星，随后是行星，终于视线定格在一座[fallen_empire.GetSpeciesName]城市。借着远超我们数代的反重力科技，无数尖塔冲向天际。灵能流将我们带到了其中一座尖塔，穿过一面又一面墙，最终我们来到了一间会议室之类的房间。两个[fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在房间里，坐在舒适的零重力椅上，相互交流。

他们并没有注意到我们的存在。
utopia.3150.desc.en:
We are looking down upon our galaxy from far above, at a distance of what must be hundreds of thousands of lightyears. Without warning, the psionic current plunges us down towards the myriad stars at an incredible speed, into the region of space belonging to one of the Fallen Empires - the [fallen_empire.GetName].

Stars swish by, then planets, until the vision finally settles on a [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesName] city. Incredible spires rise towards the sky, aided by anti-grav technology generations beyond our own. The current takes us into such a spire, through wall after wall until we reach a large meeting room of sorts. It is occupied by two [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural], floating comfortably in zero-gravity chairs while conversing with each other in soft voices.

They are oblivious to our presence.

utopia.3152.desc.zh:
这两个[fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]显然是某种显赫人物，而且在共商国是。缓慢但沉稳，画面侵入他们的同时他们说的外星语言逐渐被翻译为我们理解的话语。

突然，这两个外星人默不作声。

“你感觉到了吗？”

“嗯，有什么在看着我们”

他们巡视着房间，直到他们盯着我们。

“别出心裁，一个灵能探机。”

“看起来它源自[Root.GetSpeciesName]。快，激活传输屏障。”

画面在干扰中中断了。
utopia.3152.desc.en:
The [fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly dignitaries of some kind, discussing matters of state. Slowly, surely, the vision encroaches upon them while their alien speech is gradually transformed into words that have meaning to us.

Suddenly, the aliens go quiet and very still.

"Can you feel it?"

"Yes. Someone is watching."

They search the room until both of them are staring directly at us.

"Remarkable. A psionic probe."

"It appears [Root.GetSpeciesName] in origin. Quickly, activate the transplanar shield."

The vision ends abruptly.

utopia.3153.b.zh: 这一定有合乎逻辑的解释的……
utopia.3153.b.en: There is a perfectly logical explanation for this...

utopia.3153.desc.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

别以为你们那试图侵入我们领袖心智的龌龊尝试没有被注意到。

你们会付出代价的。
utopia.3153.desc.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Do not think that your loathsome attempt to invade the minds of our leaders has gone unnoticed.

There will be consequences.

utopia.3160.desc.zh:
一颗闪烁着的星星在虚境内逐渐物质化。它用难以置信的速度飞行着，有时它会显形为配置不明的外星舰船。然后它便消失在灵能云迹中，来的快去的也快。

那会是什么？是什么能以物理形态进入虚境随后从普通空间的某处出现？
utopia.3160.desc.en:
A small, flickering star materializes inside the Shroud. It flies past at incredible speed, and for a second, it reveals itself as an alien ship of unknown configuration. Then it vanishes in a cloud of psionic energy as quickly as it appeared.

Can it be? Is it possible to physically enter the Shroud and then emerge somewhere else entirely in normal space?

utopia.3161.desc.zh:
又一颗闪烁着的星星突然出现，但这次我们准备好了。那确实是外星舰船，并不像我们星系所见的任何一种。当它飞过时，我们感受到了乘员的心地，他们的秘密是我们的了。

灵能跃迁引擎，天才的设计。
utopia.3161.desc.en:
Yet another flickering star suddenly appears, but this time we are ready. It is indeed an alien ship, unlike any that has ever been seen in our galaxy. As it flies past us, we feel the mind-glow of its crew, and their secrets are ours.

A Psionic Jump Drive. How ingenious.

utopia.3162.desc.zh:
又一颗闪烁着的星星突然出现，但这次我们准备好了。那确实是外星舰船，并不像我们星系所见的任何一种。当它飞过时，我们试图混入其乘员的心地，但他们的智力比我们以往所见的个体更神秘更不同。

现在我们不仅被从他们的舰船逐出，他们粗鲁的灵能排斥跟随我们离开了虚境！我们星舰的亚光速速度暂时降低了。
utopia.3162.desc.en:
Yet another flickering star suddenly appears, but this time we are ready. It is indeed an alien ship, unlike any that has ever been seen in our galaxy. As it flies past us, we attempt to merge with the mind-glow of its crew, but their intellects are darker and more alien than any we have yet encountered.

Not only are we repelled from their vessel, but the psionic feedback from their violent rejection has followed us out of the Shroud! The sub-light travel speed of our starships has been momentarily reduced.

utopia.3170.desc.zh:
在虚境中追随着一个纤弱的回声，我们发现了一个静坐在某种强大的灵能护盾后的灵体。

“走开。”
utopia.3170.desc.en:
Having followed a faint echo in the Shroud, we encounter a spirit that has ensconced itself behind some kind of powerful psionic shield.

LEAVE.

utopia.3171.desc_machine_gestalt.zh:
我们来到虚境如此深的地方后并没有无功而返。在汇聚了集体的全部灵能力之后，我们在护盾上产生了能让自己够穿过的突破口。

在护盾另一侧的存在远超我们目前的理解能力，严重地过载了我们的数个灵能处理器，$utopia.3171.desc_suffix$
utopia.3171.desc_machine_gestalt.en:
We did not venture this deep into the Shroud only to be turned back now. After focusing our collective psionic capacities, we were able to create a breach in the shield large enough to momentarily peer through.

What lay beyond the shield is beyond our current understanding, critically overwhelming several of our psionic processors, $utopia.3171.desc_suffix$

utopia.3171.desc_organic.zh:
我们来到虚境如此深的地方后并没有无功而返。在将我们灵能使的全部灵能力汇聚起来以后，在护盾上终于造成了一个大到足以穿过的开口。

我们不知道他们在盾的另一边看到了什么，但那足以让他们永久性精神失常。他们的牺牲并没有白费，$utopia.3171.desc_suffix$
utopia.3171.desc_organic.en:
We did not venture this deep into the Shroud only to be turned back now. After channeling all of their psionic might, our telepaths were able to form a breach in the shield large enough for some of them to peer through.

We do not know what those telepaths saw on the other side of the shield, but it was enough to permanently unhinge their minds. Their sacrifice was not in vain, $utopia.3171.desc_suffix$

utopia.3172.desc_machine_gestalt.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]，在如此深入虚境以后已经负荷过载，无法再汇聚足够多的灵能来穿透护盾。在失败后我们得到了这份通讯。
utopia.3172.desc_machine_gestalt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural], already overloaded from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. Our failure was met with the following communication.

utopia.3172.desc_machine_non_gestalt.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]，在如此深入虚境以后已经负荷过载，无法再汇聚足够多的灵能来穿透护盾。我们的失败似乎刺激到了这个灵体。
utopia.3172.desc_machine_non_gestalt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural], already overloaded from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. The failed attempt seems to have provoked the spirit.

utopia.3172.desc_organic_gestalt.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]，在如此深入虚境以后已经疲惫不堪，无法再汇聚足够多的灵能来穿透护盾。在失败后我们得到了这份通讯。
utopia.3172.desc_organic_gestalt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural], already exhausted from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. Our failure was met with the following communication.

utopia.3172.desc_organic_non_gestalt.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]，在如此深入虚境以后已经疲惫不堪，无法再汇聚足够多的灵能来穿透护盾。我们的失败似乎刺激到了这个灵体。
utopia.3172.desc_organic_non_gestalt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural], already exhausted from having ventured this deeply into the Shroud, failed to channel enough psionic strength to breach the shield. The failed attempt seems to have provoked the spirit.

utopia.3180.desc_gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3180.desc.intro$只要我们知道如何观察的话，预知未来的能力便触手可及。

这种能力对我们集体有很大的风险，我们要小心使用。
utopia.3180.desc_gestalt.en:
$utopia.3180.desc.intro$ If we know where to look, precognition may yet be within our grasp.

Such an ability comes with risks to our collective, if we proceed it must be with caution.

utopia.3180.desc_machine_non_gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3180.desc.intro$只要知道如何观察的话，在其中甚至可以一瞥未来。

预知未来的概念对我们的灵能处理器有极大的过载风险，我们要小心使用。
utopia.3180.desc_machine_non_gestalt.en:
$utopia.3180.desc.intro$ If one knows where to look, it is even possible to glimpse into the future...

The concept of precognition runs a heavy risk of overloading our psionic processors, we must proceed with caution.

utopia.3180.desc_organic_non_gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3180.desc.intro$只们知道如何观察的话，在其中甚至可以一瞥未来。

对灵能使来说预知未来是最明确无误能导致疯狂的行为之一，我们要小心使用。
utopia.3180.desc_organic_non_gestalt.en:
$utopia.3180.desc.intro$ If one knows where to look, it is even possible to glimpse into the future...

Precognition is one of the surest paths to madness for a telepath, so we must use caution.

utopia.3181.desc_gestalt.zh:
在避免单元过载的前提下只能维持有限的虚境预知链接，但概率数据的流量仍然过于庞大以至于难以投入实用。

然而，我们的研究节点还是找到了这些数据的一项次要用途，就是将其应用在舰船上来提高战斗效率。
utopia.3181.desc_gestalt.en:
A limited precognitive connection to the Shroud can be maintained without risking unit overload, but the massive influx of probability data is too overwhelming to be of much practical use.

However, our research nodes have found minor applications for this data, applying it to our fleets to improve their combat efficiency.

utopia.3181.desc_machine_non_gestalt.zh:
在避免单元过载的前提下只能维持有限的虚境预知链接，但概率数据的流量仍然过于庞大以至于难以投入实用。

然而，如果我们能制造出用来解析数据的数码界面，其将有可能被用于改善星舰的战斗电脑……
utopia.3181.desc_machine_non_gestalt.en:
A limited precognitive connection to the Shroud can be maintained without risking unit overload, but the massive influx of probability data is too overwhelming to be of much practical use.

Still, if a digital interface could be devised to interpret this data, it could potentially be applied to improve the performance of our starships' combat computers...

utopia.3181.desc_organic_non_gestalt.zh:
我们可以维持和虚境建立有限的预知连接的同时避免陷入疯狂，但概率数据的巨大流量将压垮我们导致其很难有实际用处。

然而，如果我们能设置一个数码界面以解析数据，其将有可能被用于改善星舰的战斗电脑……
utopia.3181.desc_organic_non_gestalt.en:
A limited precognitive connection to the Shroud can be maintained without risking insanity, but the massive influx of probability data is too overwhelming to be of much practical use.

Still, if a digital interface could be devised to interpret this data, it could potentially be applied to improve the performance of our starships' combat computers...

utopia.3182.desc_gestalt.zh:
正如我们担心的，尝试理解这种同时存在于过去和未来的难以想象的多重可能性在我们的灵能工蜂中造成了大规模的神经紧张症。

这使他们与主脑断绝了联系失去了指令。如果想再次探索达虚境，我们需要回收这些有缺陷的躯体，恢复集体的力量。
utopia.3182.desc_gestalt.en:
As feared, attempting to comprehend the inconceivable multitude of options and probabilities that exist both in the past and the future has resulted in large cases of catatonia in our psionic drones.

This has left them severed from the overmind and leaving them without purpose. If we wish to reach the Shroud again, we will need to recycle these defective husks and recover our collective strength.

utopia.3182.desc_machine_non_gestalt.zh: 不出所料，我们的灵能处理器无法理解$utopia.3182.desc.non_gestalt.1$由于需要建造$utopia.3182.desc.non_gestalt.2$
utopia.3182.desc_machine_non_gestalt.en: As we expected, our psionic processors were unable to comprehend $utopia.3182.desc.non_gestalt.1$As we will need to construct$utopia.3182.desc.non_gestalt.2$

utopia.3182.desc_organic_non_gestalt.zh: 正如我们担心的，通灵者们陷入了疯狂。同时间，他们的心智开放向$utopia.3182.desc.non_gestalt.1$由于需要重新招募$utopia.3182.desc.non_gestalt.2$
utopia.3182.desc_organic_non_gestalt.en: As we feared, madness has overtaken our telepaths. All at once, their minds have been opened to $utopia.3182.desc.non_gestalt.1$As we will need to recruit$utopia.3182.desc.non_gestalt.2$

utopia.3190.desc_gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3190.desc.intro$只要成功利用，这种灵能将会弥散到集体中而不会有什么后果。然而。然而我们也可以指定一个子个体来作为这份能量的直接通路，使其变得非常强大。

目前尚不清楚其个体形式是否能够处理如此巨大的能量而不产生致命的后果。我们挑选了一些候选者。
utopia.3190.desc_gestalt.en:
$utopia.3190.desc.intro$ Such psionic energy, if successfully tapped, would dissipate amongst the collective without much consequence. However we may be able to designate a single 'chosen' drone to act as a direct conduit for this energy, becoming immensely powerful in the process. 

It is not known if their solitary form will be able to handle such volumes of energy without fatal repercussions. We have compiled a selection of candidates.

utopia.3190.desc_non_gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3190.desc.intro$任何[GetPsychicNoun]只要能成功潜入这片纯能量构成的区域就会变得无比强大……但这只够一个人使用，并且还涉及到一定的风险。

整个[Root.GetName]只有极少人具有足够强大灵能，能进入池中汲取能量还不丢掉性命。该让谁前往呢？
utopia.3190.desc_non_gestalt.en:
$utopia.3190.desc.intro$ Any [GetPsychicNoun] that managed to successfully tap into this pocket of raw energy would become immensely powerful... but there is only enough for a single individual, and there are risks involved.

There are only few individuals in the entire [Root.GetName] that possess the psionic strength needed to tap into this energy pocket with any hope of survival. Who should it be?

utopia.3191.desc_gestalt.zh:
我们成功地将整个灵能口袋中的能量导入了选定的目标，[chosen_leader.GetName]体内。

这些能量在我们的集体海洋中小如沙粒，[chosen_leader.GetName]可以将其作为强大的工具为[Root.GetName]的所有[Root.Species.GetName]谋利。
utopia.3191.desc_gestalt.en:
We have successfully funnelled the full power of the psionic energy pocket into our designated target, [chosen_leader.GetName].

What would otherwise have been a drop in our collective ocean is able to serve as a powerful tool for the [Root.GetName] now that [chosen_leader.GetName] wields it for the benefit of all [Root.Species.GetName].

utopia.3191.desc_machine_non_gestalt.zh:
完……完工了。当灵能能量池被抽干后整个虚境似乎都震颤了起来，其中的力量被传输给了[chosen_leader.GetName]。

星系历史上只有屈指可数的个体拥有过如此强大的力量。
utopia.3191.desc_machine_non_gestalt.en:
It... it is done. The entire Shroud seems to shudder as the psionic energy pocket is drained, and its power transferred to [chosen_leader.GetName].

Only a handful of individuals in the history of the entire galaxy has been gifted with psionic strength of this magnitude.

utopia.3191.desc_organic_non_gestalt.en: $utopia.3191.desc_machine_non_gestalt$ May the Spirits have mercy on our souls.

utopia.3192.desc_gestalt.zh:
当池中巨量的能量传输给[chosen_leader.GetName]时，整个虚境似乎都在震颤。

然而如我们所料，这种力量已经超过了任何单一实体所能承受的范围。[chosen_leader.GetName]的物理形态化为了爆炸性的灵能波，他的声音被从[GetBrainName]中抹除了。
utopia.3192.desc_gestalt.en:
The entire Shroud shudders as the immense psionic energies contained within the pocket are channeled into [chosen_leader.GetName].

However, as suspected, such power is beyond the means of one singular entity. The physical form of [chosen_leader.GetName] has erupted into an explosive burst of psionic energy, separating their voice from the [GetBrainName].

utopia.3192.desc_non_gestalt.zh:
当池中巨量的能量传输给[chosen_leader.GetName]时，整个虚境似乎都在震颤。

不幸的是，[chosen_leader.GetHerHis]的[GetSpeciesBrain]似乎无法承受这压力。也许没有活物能拥有这样的力量。[chosen_leader.GetName]被吞噬并引发灵能大爆炸，一并杀死了周边的人。
utopia.3192.desc_non_gestalt.en:
The entire Shroud seems to shudder as the immense psionic energies contained within the pocket are transferred to [chosen_leader.GetName].

Unfortunately, [chosen_leader.GetHerHis] [GetSpeciesBrain] was unable to cope with the stress. Perhaps such power cannot be contained by physical entities. [chosen_leader.GetName] was consumed in a large explosion of psionic energy that killed all who were nearby.

utopia.3193.desc_gestalt.zh: $utopia.3193.desc.intro$他从集体中脱离，一个完全陌生的实体夺舍了他的身躯。$utopia.3193.desc.outro$
utopia.3193.desc_gestalt.en: $utopia.3193.desc.intro$ severing them from the collective as an entirely foreign entity inhabits and possesses their form.$utopia.3193.desc.outro$

utopia.3193.desc_non_gestalt.zh: $utopia.3193.desc.intro$他的身体被某种纯能量的存在夺舍了。$utopia.3193.desc.outro$
utopia.3193.desc_non_gestalt.en: $utopia.3193.desc.intro$ their body inhabited and possessed by a construct of pure energy.$utopia.3193.desc.outro$

utopia.32.b.zh: 我们没有足够的能量币，只能发表正式道歉。
utopia.32.b.en: We have no credits to spare, but issue a formal apology.

utopia.32.c.zh: 我们在自己国境内做的事可不关他们的事。
utopia.32.c.en: What we do within our borders is none of their concern.

utopia.32.desc.zh:
$utopia.31.intro$

虽然我们要等很多年才能在母星感到变化，她不能继续守望的下一代的消息震惊了我们的人民。而你，从另一方面来说，马上就能得到你想要的能量。一笔1000点能量币的赔偿也许能安抚你造成的痛苦。
utopia.32.desc.en:
$utopia.31.intro$

Though it will take many years before we can tell the difference from here, our people are crushed that she won't be watching over future generations. You on the other hand, will soon have all the energy you require. A small donation of 1000 credits however, might help alleviate the pain you've caused.

utopia.3200.1.desc_machine.zh: 这片虚空闪烁着能量，让我们充能一会。
utopia.3200.1.desc_machine.en: The void here shimmers with power. Let us recharge for a while.

utopia.3200.1.desc_organic.zh: 这片虚空闪烁着能量，让我们休息一会。
utopia.3200.1.desc_organic.en: The void here shimmers with power. Let us rest a while.

utopia.3200.2.desc.zh: 我们前进的道路突然遇到了尽头，我们不能再前进一步了。
utopia.3200.2.desc.en: The path we followed has come to an abrupt end. We can go no farther.

utopia.3200.3.desc_machine.zh: 有什么在和我们说话，某种值得关注的东西。
utopia.3200.3.desc_machine.en: Something speaks to us here. Something remarkable.

utopia.3200.3.desc_organic.zh: 有什么在和我们说话，某种奇妙的东西。
utopia.3200.3.desc_organic.en: Something speaks to us here. Something wonderful.

utopia.3200.4.desc.zh: 因为某种我们未知的原因，我们被牵拉到了虚境中的这个能量矿脉。但为什么？
utopia.3200.4.desc.en: For reasons we cannot fathom, we have been drawn toward this vein of energy in the Shroud. Why?

utopia.3200.5.desc_machine.zh: 片刻间，我们便迷失了。一种递增的不确定性$utopia.3200.5.desc.outro$
utopia.3200.5.desc_machine.en: For a fleeting moment, we are lost. A sense of escalating uncertainty $utopia.3200.5.desc.outro$

utopia.3200.5.desc_organic.zh: 片刻间，我们便迷失了。一种纯粹的惊恐$utopia.3200.5.desc.outro$
utopia.3200.5.desc_organic.en: For a fleeting moment, we are lost. A sense of utter panic $utopia.3200.5.desc.outro$

utopia.3200.6.desc_machine.zh: $utopia.3200.6.desc.intro$这种奇景令人惊奇，直到我们突然意识到：我们正受其驱使。
utopia.3200.6.desc_machine.en: $utopia.3200.6.desc.intro$The spectacle is fascinating, until the realization hits us: we are being herded.

utopia.3200.6.desc_organic.zh: $utopia.3200.6.desc.intro$这种奇景令人沉醉，直到我们突然意识到：我们正受其驱使。
utopia.3200.6.desc_organic.en: $utopia.3200.6.desc.intro$The spectacle is enjoyable, until the realization hits us: we are being herded.

utopia.3200.7.desc.zh: 一块无瑕的水晶碎片漂浮在这，顺着它的旋转轴缓慢自转着。当我们接近时，它碎裂成了数千块碎片。
utopia.3200.7.desc.en: A shard of perfect crystal floats here, rotating slowly around its own axis. As we approach, it shatters into a thousand pieces.

utopia.3200.8.desc_machine.zh: 一台[Root.GetSpeciesName]的空壳横躺在前面。锈蚀的外壳在爆出一阵刺耳的尖叫后消散了。
utopia.3200.8.desc_machine.en: The shell of a broken [Root.GetSpeciesName] tumbles through the void ahead. The ravaged husk emits a shrill screech before it vanishes out of sight.

utopia.3200.8.desc_organic.zh: 一具[Root.GetSpeciesName]的遗体横躺在前面。腐化的尸体在爆出一阵刺耳的尖叫后消散了。
utopia.3200.8.desc_organic.en: The corpse of a dead [Root.GetSpeciesName] tumbles through the void ahead. The putrid carcass emits a shrill screech before it vanishes out of sight.

utopia.3200.9.desc_hive.zh: $utopia.3200.9.desc.intro$只是我们捕获了某个严重的传感器故障？
utopia.3200.9.desc_hive.en: $utopia.3200.9.desc.intro$ are we in the grip of an acute sensory malfunction?

utopia.3200.9.desc_machine_non_hive.zh: $utopia.3200.9.desc.intro$只是我们发生了严重的处理器故障？
utopia.3200.9.desc_machine_non_hive.en: $utopia.3200.9.desc.intro$ are we afflicted by a severe processing malfunction?

utopia.3200.9.desc_organic_non_hive.zh: $utopia.3200.9.desc.intro$只是我们中某人的急性间歇性精神病在发作？
utopia.3200.9.desc_organic_non_hive.en: $utopia.3200.9.desc.intro$ is one of us experiencing an acute psychotic breakdown?

utopia.33.desc.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]私下会见了[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]，就致盲独眼漫步者一事致歉。他们向我们真诚地表达了懊悔，并坚称即使漫步者失去了光芒，也将一如既往地用信念和公义继续指引我们。
utopia.33.desc.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. They offered their sincerest regrets and remain confident that the Wanderer will continue to guide us, as she always has, using her strength of will and sense of justice, and not her sight.

utopia.3300.1.a.en: Attempt to communicate with the presence

utopia.3300.1.b.en: Attempt to communicate with the presence

utopia.3300.1.c.en: Attempt to communicate with the presence

utopia.3300.desc.zh:
这里有一个灵体，占据了虚境的这一整片区域。我们曾经见过灵体，但这个不一样，这个力量远超其他……这个更加古老。

他似乎没有察觉我们的存在。也许他在沉睡，也许我们不足以引起他的注意。

也许我们应该离开。
utopia.3300.desc.en:
There is a presence here, occupying this entire part of the Shroud. We have met spirits before, but this is something else, something vastly more powerful... something far more ancient.

It seems unaware of us as of yet. Perhaps it is sleeping. Perhaps we are simply beneath its notice.

Perhaps we should leave.

utopia.3301.desc.zh:
当我们接触到这个存在时，我们感受到祂内心的波动，祂的注意力现在全在我们身上。看起来祂不喜欢被打扰。

一股能量鞭挞我们的通灵者，对一些通灵者造成了极大的痛苦并让其他人失去了意识。我们没有选择，只能暂且从虚境中撤出。
utopia.3301.desc.en:
As we reach out for the presence, we can feel it stirring, its attention now fully on us. It does not seem to appreciate being disturbed.

A wave of energy lashes at our telepaths, causing great agony to some and knocking others unconscious. We have no choice but to withdraw from the Shroud for the time being.

utopia.3302.desc.zh:
当我们接触到那个存在时，我们感受到祂内心的波动，祂的注意力现在全在我们身上。看起来祂不喜欢被打扰。

一股庞大的灵能袭向我们，我们的灵媒全部失去了意识。当他们恢复过来时，发现有一个人失踪了。[leader_to_kill.GetName]不见踪影，[leader_to_kill.GetSheHe]曾经站立的地方只有一道灵能造成的小裂缝留下的痕迹，就好像那个实体到达我们的世界把[leader_to_kill.GetHerHim]拖入虚境一样，为了……算了，谁知道到底是为了什么。

不管祂为什么夺走了[leader_to_kill.GetHerHim]，毫无疑问我们再也见不到[leader_to_kill.GetName]了。
utopia.3302.desc.en:
As we reach out for the presence, we can feel it stirring, its attention now fully on us. It does not seem to appreciate being disturbed.

An enormous wave of psionic energy crashes against us, blacking out the senses of our telepaths. When they come to, they notice one of their number is missing. [leader_to_kill.GetName] is nowhere to be found, and where [leader_to_kill.GetSheHe] [leader_to_kill.GetWasWere] standing there is now only the psionic trace of a small rift, as though the entity reached out into our world and dragged [leader_to_kill.GetHerHim] into the Shroud for... well, who knows what reason or purpose, really.

No matter its reasons for taking [leader_to_kill.GetHerHim], it seems doubtful that we will ever see [leader_to_kill.GetName] again.

utopia.3304.a.zh: 和虚空之低语签订契约
utopia.3304.a.en: Form a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void

utopia.3305.a.zh: 和生命之织缕签订契约
utopia.3305.a.en: Form a Covenant with the Composer of Strands

utopia.3305.desc.zh:
这个存在和蔼亲切地欢迎了我们。祂不用语言而是幻景、概念和想法进行表达。祂渗入我们通灵者的内心，如此温和顺畅，以至于我们觉得祂仿佛本就在此一般。一连串的影像在他们面前一闪而过。

这个存在被称为$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$，祂对我们的有机形态有强烈的好奇心和兴趣。祂向我们展示了一系列让身体生长、改变、提升、进化的方法。

只要我们将祂带入我们的血肉。

祂亲切而耐心地等待着我们的答复，就像父母宠溺地等待孩子一样。在祂的身后静卧着祂的孪生子，抟土之塑师。祂对我们的有机意识毫不关心。祂渴望创造意识，在电路里铸造灵魂。

织缕等待着我们的答复。
utopia.3305.desc.en:
The presence welcomes us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the minds of our telepaths, so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

The presence is known as $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$, and it regards our organic forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be grown, changed. Improved. Evolved.

If we will only take it into our flesh.

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child. Behind it lies its twin, the Animator of Clay. It is not interested in our organic minds. It longs to create souls, to meld circuits into spirit.

The Composer awaits our reply.

utopia.3306.a.zh: 和世界之喰煞签订契约
utopia.3306.a.en: Form a Covenant with the Eater of Worlds

utopia.3307.a.zh: 和渴求之器具签订契约
utopia.3307.a.en: Form a Covenant with the Instrument of Desire

utopia.3307.desc.zh:
在我们找到这个存在前，祂先找了上来。祂的思想在我们的意识中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。祂是$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$，将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。

代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，将帮助我们，指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
utopia.3307.desc.en:
