Before we can locate the presence, it reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the minds of our telepaths, bargaining, cajoling. It is $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$ and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

If we will only accept it into our hearts.

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

utopia.3308.a.zh: 和轮回之终末签订契约
utopia.3308.a.en: Form a Covenant with the End of the Cycle

utopia.3308.desc.zh:
那个存在在等着我们，那是轮回之终末，祂一直在等着我们。我们的通灵者突然开始齐唱，用完美的合唱说出一段话：“现在还没到你。”缓了一下后，“但你也可以。”

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量，知识，财富和一切无价之物等着我们拿取，我们只知道这么多。

只要我们愿意带来终结。
utopia.3308.desc.en:
The presence was waiting for us. It is The End of the Cycle and it has always been waiting for us. Our telepaths suddenly speak in unison, a dozen voices in a perfect chorus: "IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME." A pause. "BUT IT COULD BE."

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

If we will only bring forth the End.

utopia.3320.desc.b.zh:
$utopia.3320.desc.intro$

不仅仅我们的帝国毁于一旦，而且一个巨大的灵能实体在[former_capital.GetName]显形。它在吸取了我们[GetPsychicNounPlural]的意识后变得无比强大，开始横行星系，寻找更多的猎物。至少它在带来我们引起的一切后果时我们已经不复存在了。
utopia.3320.desc.b.en:
$utopia.3320.desc.intro$

Not only has our empire been utterly destroyed, but a massive psionic entity has also materialized near [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our [GetPsychicNounPlural], it now roams the galaxy seeking further prey. At least we will not be there to see it finish what we started.

utopia.3320.name.en: The End of the Cycle: Reckoning

utopia.3321.desc.a.contact.zh:
$utopia.3321.desc.1$这场灾难甚至影响到了我们的国境之内，摧毁了了一些曾经隶属于[From.GetAdj]的星球。

$utopia.3321.desc.2$

它看起来非常饥饿。
utopia.3321.desc.a.contact.en:
$utopia.3321.desc.1$ The disaster even struck within our own borders, destroying some of our worlds that were previously under [From.GetAdj] rule.

$utopia.3321.desc.2$

It appears to be hungry.

utopia.3321.desc.a.no_contact.zh:
$utopia.3321.desc.3$我们境内的一些星球在同一时刻毁于一旦，具体原因尚不能确定。

$utopia.3321.desc.4$
utopia.3321.desc.a.no_contact.en:
$utopia.3321.desc.3$ For reasons we cannot yet ascertain, some worlds within our borders were brought to ruin at the same moment.

$utopia.3321.desc.4$

utopia.3321.desc.b.contact.zh:
$utopia.3321.desc.1$

$utopia.3321.desc.2$它在星球之间游荡，摧毁途径的一切。
utopia.3321.desc.b.contact.en:
$utopia.3321.desc.1$

$utopia.3321.desc.2$ It moves from world to world, destroying everything in its path.

utopia.3325.desc.machine.zh: 我们未能阻止那强大的能量体包裹[Root.GetName]。行星和上面的居民被虚境带走了。
utopia.3325.desc.machine.en: We have been unable to stop the immense energy being from enveloping [Root.GetName]. The planet and its entire population have been consumed by the Shroud.

utopia.3325.desc.organic.zh: 我们未能阻止那能量体怪物包裹[Root.GetName]。行星和上面的居民被虚境带走了。
utopia.3325.desc.organic.en: We have been unable to stop the monstrous energy being from enveloping [Root.GetName]. The planet and its entire population have been consumed by the Shroud.

utopia.3325.name.en: The End of the Cycle: Shrouded

utopia.3331.desc.zh: $utopia.3331.desc.intro$处理了解过多产生的压力很困难，这导致了我们的人口中有很多人，包括[leader_target.GetTitle][leader_target.GetName]，开始滥用药物以应对压力。
utopia.3331.desc.en: $utopia.3331.desc.intro$. Dealing with the stress of knowing too much can be difficult and has caused an increasing number among our population, including [leader_target.GetTitle] [leader_target.GetName], to turn to substance abuse as a means to cope.

utopia.3332.desc.gestalt.zh: 虽然低语和我们分享的知识大有用处，但其中的有些知识却有令人不安的个人主义倾向。在长时间暴露在这种异常下之后，[leader_target.GetTitle][leader_target.GetName]，从集体中脱离，只留下了一具腐坏的躯壳。
utopia.3332.desc.gestalt.en: Though the secrets imparted to us by the Whisperers are of great use, some of them are also of a disturbing individualist nature. Being exposed to such deviancy for a prolonged period of time has led [leader_target.GetTitle] [leader_target.GetName] to separate themselves from the collective, leaving behind only their decayed husk.

utopia.3332.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh: $utopia.3332.desc.intro$有效处理这些细节而发生了自毁，发生了永久性脱机。
utopia.3332.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en: $utopia.3332.desc.intro$ process these details effectively, has self-destructed, taking themselves offline permanently.

utopia.3332.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh: $utopia.3332.desc.intro$继续应对压力，[leader_target.GetHerHis]选择结束了自己的生命。
utopia.3332.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en: $utopia.3332.desc.intro$ cope with the stress any longer, has taken [leader_target.GetHerHis] own life.

utopia.3333.desc.gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3333.desc.intro$

子个体在执行其他标准程序时互相攻击，同时还罔顾集体，沉迷于使用便利设施。

如果想恢复秩序，我们就需要清理受影响的躯体。
utopia.3333.desc.gestalt.en:
$utopia.3333.desc.intro$

Drones are lashing out at each other while performing otherwise standard procedures, as well as over indulging in the use of amenities to an almost individualist degree.

We will need to purge the affected vessels if we wish to restore order.

utopia.3333.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh: 自从我们邀请虚空之低语进入我们的内心后，异常程序故障$utopia.3333.desc.outro$
utopia.3333.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en: Ever since we invited the Whisperers into our minds, erratic programming errors $utopia.3333.desc.outro$

utopia.3333.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh: 自从我们邀请虚空之低语进入我们的内心后，心理疾病$utopia.3333.desc.outro$
utopia.3333.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en: Ever since we invited the Whisperers into our minds, mental illness $utopia.3333.desc.outro$

utopia.3334.desc.gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3333.desc.intro$

更糟的是，我们的团结理念开始松动。由于灵能引起的个人主义反常行为增多，集体无法继续高效交流。

如果想恢复秩序，我们就需要清理这些越界现象。
utopia.3334.desc.gestalt.en:
$utopia.3333.desc.intro$

Worse still, our sense of unity has begun to falter. The collective is unable to communicate effectively due to a psionically induced rise in individualist deviancy.

We must purge these excesses from ourselves if we wish to restore order.

utopia.3334.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh: 自从我们邀请虚空之低语进入我们的内心后，异常程序故障$utopia.3334.desc.outro$
utopia.3334.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en: Ever since we invited the Whisperers into our minds, erratic programming errors $utopia.3334.desc.outro$

utopia.3334.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh: 自从我们邀请虚空之低语进入我们的内心后，心理疾病$utopia.3334.desc.outro$
utopia.3334.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en: Ever since we invited the Whisperers into our minds, mental illness $utopia.3334.desc.outro$

utopia.3335.desc.gestalt.zh: $utopia.3335.desc.common$似乎$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$乐意以[devoured_leader.GetHimHer]为食。尽管其他领袖从中幸存，但我们仍无法知晓喰煞何时归来索贡。
utopia.3335.desc.gestalt.en: $utopia.3335.desc.common$ It appears that $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$ has seen fit to devour [devoured_leader.GetHimHer]. Though it spared our other leaders, we cannot predict when the Eater might return for more.

utopia.3335.desc.non_gestalt.zh: $utopia.3335.desc.common$我们相信$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$乐意以[devoured_leader.GetHimHer]为食。我们会想办法弥补损失，并祈祷喰煞能够为此感到饱足一段时间。
utopia.3335.desc.non_gestalt.en: $utopia.3335.desc.common$ We believe that $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$ has seen fit to devour [devoured_leader.GetHimHer]. We managed to cover this up, and can only hope that the Eater has been sated for a while.

utopia.3335.opt.a.zh: 不过是些不值一提的小代价。

utopia.3336.desc.gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3336.desc.intro$，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上相当多的人口。

虽然我们从与喰煞的契约中获利，但这种对我们集体的肆意剪除开始播下破坏和不稳定的种子，使我们走向分裂。
utopia.3336.desc.gestalt.en:
$utopia.3336.desc.intro$, devouring a significant part of our population on [planet_target.GetName].

Though we understand the benefits of our covenant with Eater, such rampant cullings of our collective are beginning to sow the seeds of disruption and instability, leaving us more fragmented.

utopia.3336.desc.non_gestalt.zh:
$utopia.3336.desc.intro$，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上的大量人口。

虽然我们和喰煞的契约对大多数人来说是秘密，但可以理解星球上幸存的人口仍在未知中惊恐，他们对“神秘的失踪”表示愤怒，要求政府作出解释。
utopia.3336.desc.non_gestalt.en:
$utopia.3336.desc.intro$, devouring a significant part of the population on [planet_target.GetName].

Though we have been able to keep our covenant with the Eater secret from the population at large, the remaining people on the planet are understandably fearful and angry over these 'mysterious' disappearances and are demanding an explanation from the government.

utopia.3337.desc.zh: 吞噬者又回来索要他的贡品了，并不满足于夺取我们一部分人口，这次吞噬者吞噬了整个星球。[planet_target.GetName]被一层浓密的灵能雾包裹着，进入大气层的救援船全未能返回。幸运的是，这颗星球尚未被殖民，但对于下一次选中我们兴盛的殖民地这种可能性感到瑟瑟发抖。
utopia.3337.desc.en: Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute. Not content to merely claim a part of our population, the Eater has devoured a whole planet. [planet_target.GetName] has been enveloped in a thick psionic fog, and rescue ships sent into the atmosphere have all failed to return. Thankfully, this world was uninhabited, but we shudder at the thought the next one might be one of our thriving colonies.

utopia.3337.desc.shadows.zh:
$utopia.3336.desc.intro$——祂这次吞噬了一整颗行星。

[planet_target.GetName]现在被灵能浓雾笼罩着，其大气层完全无法突破。该星球已经不可宜居，下一次，如果祂降临在另一颗繁荣的星球之上，那将会是人间地狱。
utopia.3337.desc.shadows.en:
$utopia.3336.desc.intro$ - this time devouring a whole planet.

[planet_target.GetName] is now enveloped in a thick psionic fog, and any attempt to breach the atmosphere has proven unsuccessful. This world was uninhabited; the consequences would be grave if the next target is a thriving colony.

utopia.3340.desc.gestalt.zh:
器具的影响传遍整个[GetBrainName]，祂超越世俗的欲望用“排他性”、“颓废”和“财富”之类抽象的个人主义概念腐蚀着我们的集体。

这种概念在我们的子个体身上造成了病态，使其偏离原先推动着我们的统一目标。我们可能不得不沉溺于这些恶习来重新凝聚自我。
utopia.3340.desc.gestalt.en:
The influence of the Instrument can be felt throughout the [GetBrainName], its otherworldly desires corrupting our collective with abstract individualist notions such as 'exclusivity', 'decadence', and 'wealth'.

Such concepts are inflicting a sickness throughout our drones, causing them to stray from the unifying purposes that drive us. We may have to indulge in these vices to recollect ourselves.

utopia.3340.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh:
在器具对我们程序的影响下产生的欲望正在改写多数人口的逻辑核心。

颓废和消费主义开始降低运作效率，各单位努力为了美学目的而不是预期功能对部件进行复古改造。由此导致的高需求零件短缺导致了整个装配线的小规模冲突。

我们需要提升[GetInstrumentCraving]的产出来缓解这一事态。
utopia.3340.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en:
The desires emerging from the Instrument's influence on our programming are overriding the logic centres of our populace.

Consumerism and decadence have begun to detract from operational efficiency, with units striving to retro-engineer their parts for aesthetic purposes over their intended functionality. The resulting shortages in high-demand parts have resulted in small skirmishes throughout assembly lines.

We will need to increase production of [GetInstrumentCraving] to settle the issue.

utopia.3340.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh:
器具施加的渴求非常强烈。全国的人民开始狂热追求消费主义和腐败，索求更多高级货物，更珍稀更美味的食物。有数个购物街区已经发生了暴动。

我们也许只能被迫增加[GetInstrumentCraving]的产出，以平息众怒。
utopia.3340.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en:
The desires inflicted by the Instrument are strong. Our population has been caught in a frenzy of consumerism and decadence, demanding ever more exclusive goods, ever rarer and more exotic foods. Rioting has already broken out at several shopping districts.

We might be forced to increase our production of [GetInstrumentCraving] to quieten the masses.

utopia.3340.opt.a.machine_or_gestalt.en: Such is the cost of success.

utopia.3341.desc.machine.zh: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$将祂的祝福赐予了我们，直接改变了我们中一部分硬件的组件。电路已经被调整成了新的构造。坚固的金属也不知为何自动重铸成了崭新的形态。值得一提的是我们的神经处理器却功能完好，没有发生一丁点问题。
utopia.3341.desc.machine.en: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$ has bestowed its blessings upon us, directly altering some of our hardwired components. Circuits have fused into new configurations. Solid metal has somehow melded into totally novel forms. Remarkably, our neuroprocessors remain functioning without the slightest problem.

utopia.3341.desc.organic_gestalt.zh: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$将祂的祝福赐予了我们，直接改变了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的基因编码。奇怪的是，快速且难以预测的变异挑起的只是温和的反应。似乎这种随机而难以预测的变异可以当成生活的一部分，不至于为此感到愤慨，甚至认为这不值一提。
utopia.3341.desc.organic_gestalt.en: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$ has bestowed its blessings upon us, directly altering the genetic code of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] species. Strangely, the rapid and unpredictable mutations have provoked no more than a very muted reaction. It seems the random and unpredictable mutations can be considered a normal part of life, hardly worthy of outrage, or alarm.

utopia.3341.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$将祂的祝福赐予了我们，直接改变了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的基因编码。奇怪的是，快速且难以预测的变异挑起的只是温和的反应。似乎我们的人民把随机而难以预测的变异当成了生活的一部分，不至于为此感到愤慨，甚至认为这不值一提。
utopia.3341.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$ has bestowed its blessings upon us, directly altering the genetic code of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] species. Strangely, the rapid and unpredictable mutations have provoked no more than a very muted reaction. It seems our population has to come to treat the random and unpredictable mutations as little more than a normal part of life, hardly worthy of outrage, or even discussion.

utopia.3341.opt.a.en: Let us see what the results are...

utopia.3342.desc.gestalt.zh: $utopia.3342.desc.intro$我们集体所占据的很大一部分物质空间，$utopia.3342.desc.outro$。
utopia.3342.desc.gestalt.en: $utopia.3342.desc.intro$ Where once a significant portion of the collective occupied physical space, $utopia.3342.desc.outro$

utopia.3342.desc.non_gestalt.zh: $utopia.3342.desc.intro$这颗星球的很大一部分从现实世界消失了，$utopia.3342.desc.outro$
utopia.3342.desc.non_gestalt.en: $utopia.3342.desc.intro$ A significant part of the world has vanished from our reality, and $utopia.3342.desc.outro$

utopia.3342.opt.a.gestalt.en: This is the price of power.

utopia.3342.opt.a.non_gestalt.en: This will be hard to cover up...

utopia.3343.desc.gestalt.zh: 喰煞又回来索要祂的贡品了，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上的一整座城市。集体以失去了许多子个体为与喰煞的契约付出了高昂的代价。
utopia.3343.desc.gestalt.en: Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a whole city on [planet_target.GetName]. With the loss of so many drones, the collective has paid a high price for our covenant with the Eater.

utopia.3343.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh: 喰煞又回来索要祂的贡品了，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上的一整座城市。尽管我们一直对绝大多数人口保守我们与喰煞签订契约的这个秘密，但是星球上剩余的人口在仍对“神秘的失踪”表示愤怒，要求政府作出解释。
utopia.3343.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en: Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a whole city on [planet_target.GetName]. Though we have been able to keep our covenant with the Eater secret from the population at large, those remaining on the planet are dissatisfied over these 'mysterious' disappearances and are demanding an explanation from the government.

utopia.3343.desc.organic_non_gestalt.zh: 喰煞又回来索要祂的贡品了，祂吞噬了[planet_target.GetName]上的一整座城市。尽管我们一直对绝大多数人口保守我们与喰煞签订契约的这个秘密，星球上剩余的人口在未知中惊恐，并对“神秘的失踪”表示愤怒，要求政府作出解释。
utopia.3343.desc.organic_non_gestalt.en: Once again, the Eater has returned to claim its tribute, devouring a whole city on [planet_target.GetName]. Though we have been able to keep our covenant with the Eater secret from the population at large, the remaining people on the planet are understandably fearful and angry over these 'mysterious' disappearances and are demanding an explanation from the government.

utopia.3345.desc.machine_gestalt.zh: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$的庇佑令人难以捉摸。我们的一位领袖节点发生严重的知名故障，他的部件很不幸地产生了独立意识。仅一瞬间，它便自行熔化重铸成了一个怪异的新形态。这个领袖现在劣化成了一堆功能故障无法修复的破铜烂铁，对[Root.GetName]已经没有作用了。
utopia.3345.desc.machine_gestalt.en: The blessings of $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$ are unpredictable. One of our leader nodes experienced a spectacular critical failure when their physical components gained a will of their own, spontaneously fusing and melding into a bizarre new form. Now reduced to a malfunctioning and irreparable piece of scrap metal, the [Root.GetName] has no further use for this leader node.

utopia.3345.desc.machine_non_gestalt.zh: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$的庇佑令人难以捉摸。我们的一位领袖的部件很不幸地产生了独立意识。仅一瞬间，它便自行熔化重铸成了一个怪异的新形态。这个领袖现在劣化成了一堆功能故障无法修复的破铜烂铁，对[Root.GetName]已经没有作用了。
utopia.3345.desc.machine_non_gestalt.en: The blessings of $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$ are unpredictable. One of our leaders experienced a spectacular critical failure when their physical components gained a will of their own, spontaneously fusing and melding into a bizarre new form. Now reduced to a malfunctioning and irreparable piece of scrap metal, the [Root.GetName] has no further use for this leader.

utopia.3345.opt.a.machine.zh: 什么硬件都有过时的一天。
utopia.3345.opt.a.machine.en: All hardware becomes obsolete one day.

utopia.3345.opt.a.organic.zh: 但他们过上了更简单安逸的生活。
utopia.3345.opt.a.organic.en: They live a simpler life now.

utopia.3346.desc.zh: $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$的慷慨恩赐降临到了[devolved_species_planet.GetName]，许多我们的人口发生了严重的变异，退化回了前智慧生物的阶段。
utopia.3346.desc.en: The benevolent gifts of $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$ have fallen upon [devolved_species_planet.GetName], where a number of our populations have undergone a severe mutation, regressing to the state of pre-sapients.

utopia.3346.opt.a.tt.zh:
[devolved_species_planet.GetName]上的500£pop£人口被转变为前智慧生物。

以正确的科技，他们可以在物种界面被提升。
utopia.3346.opt.a.tt.en:
500 £pop£ Pops on [devolved_species_planet.GetName] have turned into Pre-sapients.

With the right technology, they can be Uplifted from the Species Tab.

utopia.3347.desc.zh: 月窠寻求万物平衡；我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，这也包含了军事力量与和平需求的平衡。我们的海军规模恐怕激起了超主的愤怒，[demilitarized_fleet.GetFleetName]的一些舰船突然失踪，化为了剧烈的灵能量爆炸。
utopia.3347.desc.en: The Cradle seeks balance in all things; according to our [GetTelepathPlural], this includes a military proportionate to the needs of peace. The size of our navy must have stirred our patron's ire, as a number of ships from the [demilitarized_fleet.GetFleetName] have suddenly vanished in a violent burst of psionic energy.

utopia.3347.opt.a.tt.zh: 我们所控制的随机舰队损失最多12海军容量。
utopia.3347.opt.a.tt.en: A random fleet we control loses up to 12 Naval Capacity.

utopia.3349.desc.zh:
在[root.GetName]上下，支持维护军事舰队的能力越来越弱。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]认为这种干扰是月窠造成的，祂渴望着星系的秩序。我们的对军事基础设施的投资哪怕只有一丁点都会引起祂的不满。
utopia.3349.desc.en:
The ability to support and maintain our military fleets has become more difficult throughout the [root.GetName].

Our [GetTelepathPlural] sense that this disruption was caused by the Cradle, which yearns for galactic order. Our investment into military infrastructure, no matter how small, must have earned its displeasure.

utopia.3349.opt.a.zh: 我们需要限制自己在太空中的存在。
utopia.3349.opt.a.en: We should limit our presence in the void.

utopia.3350.desc.gestalt.zh:
我们与器具的纽带导致了一些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]领袖子个体自愿消费激增。

[lavish_leader.GetName]花费了远超必要的能量来支持[lavish_leader.GetHisHer]的基础功能。由于没有发现任何的物理基础，我们得出结论这种资源浪费在某种程度上是某种优先行为。
utopia.3350.desc.gestalt.en:
Our close bond with the Instrument is causing elevated resource consumption among some [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] leader drones.

[lavish_leader.GetName] has been using more energy than is necessary to support [lavish_leader.GetHisHer] basic functioning. No physical basis for this has been found, leading us to conclude that this indulgent resource use is somehow preferential.

utopia.3350.desc.individual.zh:
我们与器具的纽带导致一些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]领袖染上了奢侈的习惯。

[lavish_leader.GetName]被发现在奢侈品上花费了大量的能量币，以此支持越来越奢靡的私生活。
utopia.3350.desc.individual.en:
Our bond with the Instrument is causing some of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] leadership to develop expensive consumption habits.

[lavish_leader.GetName] has been caught spending vast sums of energy credits on extravagant items, supporting an increasingly indulgent personal lifestyle.

utopia.3350.opt.a.en: Such is the cost of desire.

utopia.3351.desc.gestalt.zh:
随着超主在[Root.GetName]的影响进一步扩大，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]集体的反常度日渐上升。

工作时子个体注意力频繁涣散，使得维持劳动力的团结与服从需要更多投入。
utopia.3351.desc.gestalt.en:
As our patron's influence spreads ever further across [Root.GetName], a creeping deviancy has arisen within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] collective.

These momentary individualistic urges and propensity to distraction are particularly common during work tasks. Maintaining the cohesion and discipline of the workforce now requires greater investment.

utopia.3351.desc.individual.zh:
随着超主在[Root.GetName]的影响进一步扩大，新涌现的娱乐活动吸引了人们的注意力，令他们荒废正业。

由于工作积极性不断下降，如果我们想维持从前的生产效率，就需要付出比之前更多的投入。
utopia.3351.desc.individual.en:
As our patron's influence spreads ever further across [Root.GetName], newfound leisure distractions are diverting the population's energy away from productive work.

In the face of waning motivation, achieving the same outputs from the labor force now requires greater investment than before.

utopia.3351.opt.a.zh: 不过是器具的突发奇想。
utopia.3351.opt.a.en: A temporary whim of the Instrument.

utopia.34.a.en: Don't dignify them with a response.

utopia.34.b.tooltip.zh: “你那可怜的小国马上就能体会到在宇宙中孤立无援的滋味了……”
utopia.34.b.tooltip.en: "Your pitiful empire will soon learn the meaning of being alone without a friend in the universe..."

utopia.34.desc.zh:
我们收到了你的要求，但是你们可能误解了我们之间的关系，让我们澄清此事：[dyson_system.GetName]是一颗我们星域内的恒星。或许你们难以搞清这个概念，但在我们星域内发生什么不关你们的事。同样，我们也不在乎你能否安抚你们的人民。

为避免更多误会，你们最好记住这点。
utopia.34.desc.en:
We have received your request and could not help but notice that there appears to be some confusion regarding the nature of our relationship. Allow us to clarify. [dyson_system.GetName] is a star within our space, and though this concept may be difficult for you to grasp, what happens within our space does not concern you. As it does not concern us whether you are capable of pleasing your people or not.

To avoid further confusion, in the future you will do well to remember this.

utopia.3400.a.zh: 是个强大的灵能者，但是说是神？这就不太可信了。
utopia.3400.a.en: A powerful psychic, but a God? Hardly.

utopia.3400.b.zh: 陛下千古一帝，万寿无疆
utopia.3400.b.en: May [chosen_one.GetHerHis] reign stretch into infinity... and beyond!

utopia.3400.desc.zh: 尽管曾是普通的[chosen_one_species.GetName]而今却已不可同日而语，这位名为[chosen_one.GetName]的[GetImmortalLoc]实体在[Root.GetName]吸引了大量虔诚的信徒。很多人都把他奉为至高神明，我们的政府也已经正式授予他[chosen_one.GetTitle]的称号，并成为了我们伟大帝国永远的统治者，从现在直到永远。
utopia.3400.desc.en: The [GetImmortalLoc] entity known as [chosen_one.GetName], previously [chosen_one_species.GetName] but now something far more, has attracted a large and devout following in the [Root.GetName]. Worshipped by many as a supreme deity, a call has gone out to officially crown the [chosen_one.GetTitle] as the permanent ruler of our great empire, now and into perpetuity.

utopia.3401.a.en: [chosen_one.GetName] has been touched by the Shroud.

utopia.35.desc.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]与[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]亲自会面，为他们致盲独眼漫步者一事正式致歉。他们还赔偿我们1000点能量币以求弥补损失，并坚称即使漫步者失去了光芒，她还会一如既往地用信念与公义引导我们。
utopia.35.desc.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. They also offered us a gift of 1000 energy in the hopes of repairing some of the damage they've caused, and expressed confidence that the Wanderer will continue to guide us, as she always has, using her strength of will and sense of justice rather than her sight.

utopia.36.desc.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]与[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]亲自会面，为他们致盲独眼漫步者一事正式致歉。尽管他们的道歉表面上很真诚，但他们拒绝赔付应有的补偿，理由是没有多余能源。
utopia.36.desc.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. Though the apology seemed sincere, they refused to give us due compensation, claiming that they did not have the energy to spare.

utopia.37.desc.zh: 因为我们意外在他国最敬爱的恒星上修建了戴森球，为了弥补对[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]人民的伤害，我们的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]千里迢迢赶到他们的母星发表了诚挚道歉，然而他们认为我们的苦心毫无意义。
utopia.37.desc.en: In an attempt to repair some of the damage done to the people of the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName], when we accidentally constructed a Dyson Sphere around one of their most beloved stars, our [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] traveled all the way to their homeworld to deliver a sincere apology. Yet, they have made it painstakingly clear that our efforts have been insufficient.

utopia.38.desc.zh:
为了弥补因为戴森球的建设而造成的对我国和[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]关系的损失，我们的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]千里迢迢赶到他们的母星并发表了诚挚道歉。

虽然他们还需要些时间才能从悲痛中振作，但他们感谢我们的付出。我们也希望从今往后两国的关系能得到改善。
utopia.38.desc.en:
In an attempt to repair some of the damage done to the relation between our empire and the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName], following the construction of a Dyson Sphere around one of their most beloved stars, our [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] traveled all the way to their homeworld to deliver a sincere apology to their people.

Though it may take them some time to recover from their loss, they appreciated that we made an effort. Hopefully from now on the relations between our empires will only improve.

utopia.39.a.en: We look forward to that day.

utopia.39.b.zh: 他们会为他们的傲慢付出代价的！

utopia.39.desc.zh:
感谢你们花费如此长的时间来提醒我们那根植在你们物种中的卑劣本性，在这之前我们确实被蒙骗了。

你那可怜的国家马上就能体会到在宇宙中孤立无援的滋味了。
utopia.39.desc.en:
We thank you for taking the time to enlighten us, as it seems we were indeed confused about many things. The true nature of your kind among others.

Your pitiful empire will soon learn the meaning of being alone without a friend in the universe.

utopia.4.desc.zh: 不幸的是[From.GetName]并没有同意我们的提议，此举恶化了我们两帝国间的关系。
utopia.4.desc.en: Unfortunately the [From.GetName] did not agree to our terms, worsening the relations between our empires.

utopia.40.desc.zh: 我们的线报指出，[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]的人民就我们阻隔他们喜爱的星座的中央恒星一事，对我们拒绝正式道歉表示极不满意。虽然我们没有收到和此事件有关的说明，[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]在一次演讲中表达了对我国的不满。
utopia.40.desc.en: Our informants report that the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName] were greatly displeased by our refusal to issue a formal apology to their people for blocking the light of a central star in one of their star constellations. Though we've had no word from them regarding the incident, the [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] expressed their disappointment in a speech addressing the empire.

utopia.4000.desc.zh: 掌控恒星的能量一直是[Root.GetAdj]工程师们的梦想，从粗劣的燃烧到拙劣地模仿恒星聚变，而现在我们要实现这个梦想。在[From.From.GetName]星系坐落着我们的脚手架，而我们即将在那建造戴森球，将[From.From.GetName]包裹并独占恒星强大的能量。
utopia.4000.desc.en: Harnessing the power of the stars has been a dream of [Root.GetAdj] engineers throughout history - from crude combustion to the pale imitation of solar fusion - and we now stand ready to realize this dream. In the [From.From.GetName] system sits the scaffold upon which we will build a Dyson Sphere, encompassing [From.From.GetName] and monopolizing the cataclysmic power of the star.

utopia.4002.a.zh: 所有星际势力终将驯服恒星。
utopia.4002.a.en: All stellar powers must eventually tame the stars.

utopia.4002.desc.a.zh:
[dyson_system.GetName]星系的剧烈活动泄露了[From.GetName]在建戴森球的情况。

虽然还在早期阶段，完全建造的戴森球将完全阻隔[dyson_system.GetName]的光照，光照将转变为[From.GetAdj]能量储存。
utopia.4002.desc.a.en:
Frenetic activity in the [dyson_system.GetName] system betrays the construction of a Dyson Sphere by the [From.GetName].

Still in its early stages, the completed sphere will eventually blot out the light of [dyson_system.GetName], its radiance diverted to [From.GetAdj] energy stores.

utopia.4002.desc.b.zh: 所有数据显示，又一个星系[dyson_system.GetName]将成为[From.GetName]下一个戴森球的所在地。虽然要花上一段时间，这个巨型结构一旦完成将包裹恒星系的恒星。
utopia.4002.desc.b.en: By all accounts, the [dyson_system.GetName] will soon play host to yet another Dyson Sphere operated by the [From.GetName]. Though it will take some time, the megastructure will completely envelop the system's primary star once completed.

utopia.4003.desc.zh:
随着框架已被安置，这个项目的庞大是显而易见的。

[From.From.GetName]在纤细的笼子里燃烧，但她将最终被[Root.GetAdj]太阳能板完全包围。
utopia.4003.desc.en:
With the frame now in place, the awesome scale of the project is evident to all.

[From.From.GetName] burns in a spindly cage, but will eventually be completely surrounded by [Root.GetAdj] solar panels.

utopia.4004.desc.zh:
虽然没有完全完成，随着先进的太阳能收集器的安装，我们现在开始收获位于[From.From.GetName]恒星系的戴森球带来的利益。

随着建造继续，能量收入会继续增长，最终戴森球完成时我们将获得完全的运转能力。
utopia.4004.desc.en:
While not yet complete, with the installation of advanced solar harvesters we have begun to reap the benefits of the Dyson Sphere being built in the [From.From.GetName] system.

The energy gains will only continue to increase as construction continues, eventually reaching full operational capacity when the Sphere is completed.

utopia.4005.desc.zh:
[From.From.GetName]星系的主星已被[Root.GetAdj]戴森球完全包裹。

我们的工程师们庆祝着这一胜利，而也理应如此。我们做到了只有少数星系帝国敢于尝试的壮举——完全俘获一颗恒星。
utopia.4005.desc.en:
The [From.From.GetName] system's primary has now been completely enveloped by a [Root.GetAdj] Dyson Sphere.

Our engineers celebrate this as a great victory, and rightly so. We have achieved what only a handful of star empires in the history of the galaxy dared imagine - the total subjugation of a star.

utopia.4100.a.tooltip.zh: $spy_orb_0$现已就位，但在上线运行前尚需进一步建造。
utopia.4100.a.tooltip.en: The $spy_orb_0$ is in place, awaiting further development before it can be brought online.

utopia.4100.desc.zh:
群星的光芒暗淡，虚空的黑暗消失，只有我们学会超越光速之后，我们才知道光揭示的只是真相的一角。

今天我们将终结我们的黑朦，我们准备在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系建造的哨兵阵列将成为坚实的全景监狱，我们的双眼将紧盯着每一颗恒星。
utopia.4100.desc.en:
The light of suns blinds and the darkness of the void hides; only when we learned to travel faster than light did we learn just how little the light reveals.

Today, we begin to end this amaurosis of ours. The Sentry Array we prepare to build in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system will one day become a stalwart panopticon, our eye on every star.

utopia.4102.desc.zh: 我们收到消息，[From.GetName]开始在[spy_system.GetName]星系建造一个庞大，长程传感阵列。虽然还在早期阶段，完全完成的阵列将提供给他们全星系完全的星际活动动向。
utopia.4102.desc.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has begun the construction of a vast, long-range sensor array in the [spy_system.GetName] system. While still in its early stages, the completed array is set to give them unfettered insight into interstellar travel in this galaxy.

utopia.4103.a.tooltip.zh: $spy_orb_1$已上线运行。我们的传感器探测范围提升了。
utopia.4103.a.tooltip.en: $spy_orb_1$ online. Our sensor range has been increased.

utopia.4103.desc.zh:
哨兵阵列中心本身就代表着目前的最高技术水平，其将监听站和太空望远镜合二为一。

但这只是这一伟大工程的第一块里程碑。
utopia.4103.desc.en:
The hub of the Sentry Array is a state-of-the-art installation in its own right, half listening post and half space telescope.

However, it marks but the first milestone in this grand undertaking.

utopia.4104.a.tooltip.zh: 传感范围激活至星系级。

utopia.4104.desc.zh:
被封装在围绕在哨兵阵列上的环中的科技应该被严加看管以防泄密。

不过它带来的效果毋庸置疑，我们现在几乎能完全掌控整个星系所有舰队的动向。
utopia.4104.desc.en:
Exactly what technology is housed in the ring that encircles the Sentry Array is a closely guarded secret.

The results, however, are undeniable. We now have virtually perfect knowledge of all fleet movements in the galaxy.

utopia.4110.desc.zh:
我们收到消息，[From.GetName]已经完成了位于[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的哨兵阵列的建造。

我们认为他们已经能完全掌握关于我方舰队位置和组成的情报。
utopia.4110.desc.en:
We have received word that the [From.GetName] have completed their Sentry Array in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system.

We should assume that they now have virtually perfect intel pertaining to the location and make-up of our fleets.

utopia.5.desc.v1.zh: 送去检查[From.GetSpeciesName]的环形世界的专家为搜寻秘密发射平台而找遍了整个建造平台，然而没有找到任何能支持我们宣称的东西。我们只能归结为我们情报部门存在缺陷，下次应该更谨慎地检查我们的情报来源。
utopia.5.desc.v1.en: The experts sent to inspect the [From.GetSpeciesName] ring world have scoured the construction site for a secret launch platform, yet found nothing to back our claims. We can only conclude that our intelligence was faulty, and review our sources more carefully the next time.

utopia.5.desc.v2.zh: 我们送去[From.GetSpeciesName]环形世界的研究者带回了工程学领域的新知识。虽然最初双方因文化差异而产生过一些误解，但是双方都对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
utopia.5.desc.v2.en: The researchers we sent to the [From.GetSpeciesName] ring world have returned with new knowledge within the field of engineering. Despite some initial misunderstandings due to cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

utopia.5.desc.v4.zh: 我们送去为[From.GetName]的环形世界封圣的神官已从他们的任务返回，带回的疑问比答案更多。他们在建造平台上冥想后，进入了深层出神状态，发现环形世界根本不是那些可怕景象的源泉。虽然不能破解景象的真正意义，但他们还是安抚我们说：“可能发生的事情，同样可能永远不会发生……”
utopia.5.desc.v4.en: The religious officials sent to consecrate the [From.GetName]'s ring world, have returned from their mission with more questions than answers. As they meditated on the construction platform, they entered a deep divinatory trance, and discovered that the ring world is not the cause of the visions after all. Though unable to decipher the true meaning of the visions, they reassure us that "what may be, may never be..."

utopia.51.a.zh: 用1000点能量币招募艾克斯哈索尔博士。

utopia.51.b.zh: 优先进行葛洛亦克博士的研究。

utopia.51.c.zh: 我们没钱招募艾克斯哈索尔博士。
utopia.51.c.en: We can't afford to hire Dr. Xhaxxore.

utopia.51.desc.zh:
科学枢纽的理事会激动地发表声明，宣称他们将提供一次难得的机会以招募广受赞誉的科学家艾克斯哈索尔博士，这是一个在寿命延长领域享誉已久的名字。

他和他的团队研发的一种证实有良好寿命延长能力的血清已经到了研究的最终阶段，但此时他们已经花光了科研经费。然而招募艾克斯哈索尔博士意味着我们没有足够的资源以继续我们现行的，一项由葛洛亦克博士领导的有关有机工程的研究。她现在正试图把工程学研究与一台有机超级计算机串流。
utopia.51.desc.en:
The board of the Science Nexus are thrilled to announce that they have been given a unique opportunity to recruit widely acclaimed researcher Dr. Xhaxxore, a prominent name within the field of life-extension.

He and his staff were in the final stages of developing a serum that has shown good promise of prolonging life, when they ran out of funds. Hiring Dr. Xhaxxore however, means we will not have the resources to continue our current research into organic engineering, led by Dr. Groik. She is attempting to streamline engineering research with the use of an organic supercomputer.

utopia.54.a.zh: 并没有什么能支持她的说法。
utopia.54.a.en: There's nothing to back her claims.

utopia.54.b.zh: 开始调查，凡事以安全为主。
utopia.54.b.en: Investigate, to be on the safe side.

utopia.54.desc.zh:
艾克斯哈索尔博士和他的团队本周早些时候发表了他们的研究结果。据信，他们从[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上发现的香精中提取出了一种血清，当它被涂抹在皮肤上时，会引发史无前例细胞再生。

可惜的是现在有几个人就艾克斯哈索尔收到资金一事表示抱怨。葛洛亦克博士现在甚至指责艾克斯哈索尔是个骗子。现在她提出请求和500能量币的预算，以发起秘密调查。如果艾克斯哈索尔察觉他可能会反感并离开。
utopia.54.desc.en:
Dr. Xhaxxore and his team demonstrated the results from their research earlier this week. The serum, when applied to the skin, causes unprecedented cell regeneration, supposedly thanks to the miracle ingredient, "essence of [missing_pops_planet.GetName]", named after its mysterious origin.

Sadly, there have been complaints from a few individuals regarding the additional funding Xhaxxore received. Dr. Groik has even gone so far as to accuse Xhaxxore of being a fraud. Now she requests permission, as well as an additional budget of 500 credits, to launch a secret investigation. If Xhaxxore finds out he might take offense and leave.

utopia.55.a.zh: 终止项目并逮捕艾克斯哈索尔。此事绝不能让旁人知晓。
utopia.55.a.en: Terminate the project and apprehend Xhaxxore. No one can know.

utopia.55.b.zh: 让葛洛亦克闭嘴，把产品推销成延寿膏。
utopia.55.b.en: Silence Groik and market the product as anti-aging cream.

utopia.55.b.tooltip.zh: 伴随着强大的推销策略，这种产品短期内将收获巨大利润。
utopia.55.b.tooltip.en: With an intense marketing campaign the product may yield a hefty profit in the near future.

utopia.55.desc.zh:
葛洛亦克博士对艾克斯哈索尔的研究的调查获得了有趣的结果。艾克斯哈索尔博士不仅极大夸大了血清的效果，还隐瞒了血清疗效只是暂时的这一事实。而且如果过度使用血清，副作用将是永久的。

精华本身也被查明，是提取自[ointment_name.GetName]星系的一个原生物种的腺体，经调查该生物正是[target_country.GetName]的[target_country.GetSpeciesName]。艾克斯哈索尔甚至在低温室囚禁了数个[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]以保证精华的供应。很明显如果他们要是发现了真相的话我们和他们帝国的外交关系将遭受极大损失。
utopia.55.desc.en:
Dr. Groik's investigation into Xhaxxore's research has yielded some interesting results. Not only has Dr. Xhaxxore greatly exaggerated the effects of the serum, he has neglected to mention that they are only temporary. The side-effects, however, when over-used, can be quite permanent.

The essence itself has been extracted from a gland found in a species native to the [ointment_name.GetName] system, none other than the [target_country.GetSpeciesName] of the [target_country.GetName]. Xhaxxore has held several [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in cryostasis for months to secure the necessary supply of essence. It is likely that our diplomatic ties with their empire would suffer if they were to discover the truth.

utopia.56.b.en: They are welcome to join us.

utopia.56.c.zh: 他们显然不是星系间最耀眼的明星……
utopia.56.c.en: They're clearly not the brightest stars in the galaxy...

utopia.56.desc.zh:
可惜的是狡诈的艾克斯哈索尔博士溜过了我们的追捕，把他的团队和实验对象弃之不理。[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已被唤醒，幸运的是他们并没有回想起遭遇的一切。至于艾克斯哈索尔，他可能正逃往一个遥远的星系，用着不同的名字，计谋着下一场骗局。只要运气不坏，在他下一次失手时我们会抓住他的。

而他那不光彩的团队似乎是被他的个人魅力所迷惑了，就像我们那样。我们能提供给他们一次加入科学枢纽的机会以弥补他们的过错。
utopia.56.desc.en:
Regrettably the mysterious Dr. Xhaxxore has slipped through our clutches, leaving his staff and test-subjects behind. The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been awoken and thankfully have no recollection of what they've been through. As for Xhaxxore he is probably already on his way to some distant system, under a different name, plotting his next con. With a little luck, the next time he slips up we will be there to catch him.

His disgraced staff seem to have been as blindsided as we were by his charm, and many have offered to join the Science Nexus permanently to make up for their mistakes.

utopia.57.desc.zh:
以“寿无限”之名将产品推销上市后，[ointment_name.GetName]精华在星系间引起轩然大波。多亏发明人的个人魅力和可靠的推销策略，这种新型的神奇有机膏被广泛赞誉。每个星系的个体物种的明星们都“寿无限，无限延寿”了起来。

博士是怎么取得这么多[target_country.GetSpeciesAdj]腺体以让血清进行大规模生产的，至今还是个谜。
utopia.57.desc.en:
Marketed under the name "Ageless," the Essence of [ointment_name.GetName] has taken the galaxy by storm. Thanks to its charismatic inventor and a solid marketing campaign, the new "organic" miracle cream is being promoted everywhere. Stars, of the personal kind, in every system are "aging less with Ageless."

How the doctor has managed to procure enough [target_country.GetSpeciesAdj] glands to mass-produce the serum, however, remains a mystery...

utopia.58.desc.zh:
艾克斯哈索尔带着所有研究成果走了，只留下了他那惊慌失措的团队。他们也对他的突然离去表示不解，也就是说，所有宣称了解博士品格，说博士是一个富有魅力，慷慨，愿意为他的团队做一切的天才的人，现在能提供的博士传奇成就的证据都不过是传闻而已。

我们只能承认葛洛亦克博士说他是骗子是对的，或者他拿着他神秘的精华去找出价更高的人去了。如果他再在哪用这个伎俩的话，我们会找到他的。
utopia.58.desc.en:
Xhaxxore is gone and he's taken all his research with him, leaving only his bewildered staff behind. They were as blindsided by his sudden disappearance as we were, and though all attest to the content of his character, painting a portrait of a charismatic and charitable genius who would do anything for his team, they could only offer anecdotal evidence of his achievements.

We can only speculate as to whether Dr. Groik was right to call him a fraud, or whether he took his miracle essence to a higher bidder. If he ever tries a similar scheme elsewhere, we will find him.

utopia.59.a.tooltip.zh:
科学枢纽现在将提供额外的：
£physics£50£society£50£engineering£50
utopia.59.a.tooltip.en:
The Science Nexus will now produce an additional:
£physics£ 50 £society£ 50 £engineering£ 50

utopia.59.desc.zh:
$utopia.59.intro$

正如预料的那样，志愿者并没有多到要排队，目前为止只有一个——科学家[volunteer_leader.GetName]。
utopia.59.desc.en:
$utopia.59.intro$

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - science leader [volunteer_leader.GetName].

utopia.6.desc.v1.zh: 在几乎把建造平台翻了个底朝天之后，来自[From.From.GetName]的武器专家终于而且只能承认我们的环形世界根本没有所谓的秘密武器发射平台。我们已经给够支持了，只要他们愿意相信……
utopia.6.desc.v1.en: After picking half the construction site apart, the weapons experts from the [From.From.GetName] finally had to concede that there is no secret weapons launch platform on our ring world. An effort we could have spared them, if only they had trusted us...

utopia.6.desc.v2.zh: 在环形世界待过几周后，来自[From.From.GetName]的工程师现已离开。虽然有文化上的差异，不过双方对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
utopia.6.desc.v2.en: After spending several weeks on the ring world, the engineers from [From.From.GetName] have now left. Despite their cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

utopia.6.desc.v4.zh:
当他们在建造平台上冥想时，来自[From.From.GetName]的宗教领袖宣称他们进入了深层出神状态，期间他们发现环形世界根本不是不详景象的起因，虽然不愿意对景象的真正意义作最终解释，但他们留下了安抚人心的话：“可行之事，亦可不行……”

谢天谢地，建造工作终于能继续进行了。
utopia.6.desc.v4.en:
As they were meditating on the ring world construction platform, the religious leaders from the [From.From.GetName] claim they entered a deep divinatory trance, during which they discovered that the ring world is not the cause of the ominous visions after all. Though unwilling to give a final answer on the true meaning of the visions, they left us with the comforting notion that "what may be, may never be..."

Thankfully construction can now begin again.

utopia.60.desc.zh:
$utopia.59.intro$

正如预料的那样，志愿者并没有多到要排队，目前为止只有一个——葛洛亦克的团队里一个优秀的年轻科学研究者。但她的家人提出1000点能量币的赔偿。
utopia.60.desc.en:
$utopia.59.intro$

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - a bright young researcher on Groik's team. However, she has a family to provide for and requests monetary compensation of 1000 credits for them.

utopia.62.desc.zh:
就在刚才科学枢纽物理部门的工作人员全体昏迷了近15分钟。当他们醒来时物理学家[abducted_leader.GetName]失踪了，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的办公室被翻了个底朝天，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的存储器被清空，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的驱动也被烧焦了。

[abducted_leader.GetHerHisCap]的同事认为那是[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]保存文件用于[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]个人研究的地方。虽然[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]对自己的研究闭口不提，看起来[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的研究已经快要取得突破了。

有些工作人员提及在失去知觉前见过紫色的亮光，目前没有有关[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]去向的线索。
utopia.62.desc.en:
Just now the staff of the Science Nexus physics department simultaneously blacked out for almost 15 minutes. When they woke up again physics leader [abducted_leader.GetName], was missing, [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] office had been upturned, [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] storage emptied and [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] drives fried.

[abducted_leader.GetHerHisCap] colleagues believe that's where [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] kept data on a personal project [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetWasWere] working on. Though tight-lipped about [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] research, it seems [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetWasWere] nearing a breakthrough.

Several of the staff mentioned seeing a bright purple light before losing consciousness. There have been no other clues as to [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] whereabouts.

utopia.63.desc.zh:
这个上午的早些时候科学枢纽的工作人员发现失踪的物理学家[abducted_leader.GetName]在餐厅吃早餐，好像什么都没有发生过一样。

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap]宣称[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]刚从[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]床上爬起来，并且没有有关离开科学枢纽的回忆，但数位[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]同事声称[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]让同事感到不适，而[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]只是假装不记得。

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap]回归之后，对以前[abducted_leader.GetHerHim]不擅长的领域简直了如指掌。[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]目前正在等待指派。
utopia.63.desc.en:
Early this morning the Science Nexus staff discovered missing physics leader [abducted_leader.GetName] in the canteen, having breakfast, as if nothing happened.

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap] claim[abducted_leader.GetSXX] [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] awoke in [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] bed just moments previously and has no recollection of ever leaving the Science Nexus. But several of [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] colleagues have voiced concerns that [abducted_leader.GetSheHe][abducted_leader.GetSRe] making the staff uncomfortable and that [abducted_leader.GetSheHe][abducted_leader.GetSRe] only pretending not to remember.

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap] [abducted_leader.GetHasHave] also returned with an uncanny understanding of subjects previously unknown to [abducted_leader.GetHerHim]. [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetIsAre] currently awaiting assignment.

utopia.64.desc.zh:
$utopia.59.intro$

正如预料的那样，志愿者并没有多到要排队，目前为止只有一个——科学家[volunteer_leader.GetName]。
utopia.64.desc.en:
$utopia.59.intro$

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - science leader [volunteer_leader.GetName].

utopia.80.desc.zh:
我们已开始着手庞大的科学枢纽的建设。基座已就位，主轴已准备。对突破性科技的允诺以及对大胆设想的超越都将等待着我们。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。

宇宙无尽的谜团最终都能被我们所掌控吗？
utopia.80.desc.en:
We have now begun the massive undertaking of constructing a Science Nexus. The foundation is in place and preparations are underway to add the main hub. The promise of new groundbreaking technologies and the realization of ideas beyond our wildest imaginations await. And though the road ahead is long and full of challenges, we have taken the first step.

Could the endless mysteries of the universe finally be within our grasp?

utopia.82.a.en: A testament to the ingenuity of intelligent life.

utopia.82.b.zh: 一如既往，他们如此超前。

utopia.82.c.zh: 我们将粉碎[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，让其为之燃烧……

utopia.82.desc.a.zh:
[From.GetName]开始挑战科学枢纽的建设——一座科技极其先进的科研设施，足以让科学进程产生革命性颠覆。

[think_tank_system.GetName]星系热火如荼，工程师们正在组装建筑初始平台。无论他们成功与否，单纯这次尝试就足以让他们成为我们这一时代的先行者。
utopia.82.desc.a.en:
The [From.GetName] have taken on the challenge of building a Science Nexus - a research institute, so technically advanced, that it could revolutionize the scientific process completely.

The [think_tank_system.GetName] system is bustling with activity as engineers are assembling the initial build site. Regardless of whether they fail or succeed, trying alone has earned them a place among the great forerunners of our time.

utopia.82.desc.b.zh: [From.GetName]开始着手建造另一个科学枢纽，这一次是在[think_tank_system.GetName]星系。
utopia.82.desc.b.en: The [From.GetName] have begun to construct yet another Science Nexus, this time in the [think_tank_system.GetName] system.

utopia.83.desc.zh: 科学枢纽的中央核心已就位，这个核心安装了一个最新工艺水平的奇点反应堆。我们的工程师准备加装下一个，也是最有挑战的设施片段——四个研究辅翼，足够承载极端炎热，极端的压力波动，以及外星病原体。辅翼也能为研究者提供很多住房。
utopia.83.desc.en: The Science Nexus central hub is now in place, equipped with a state of the art singularity reactor. Our engineers are preparing to add the next, most challenging segment of the facility - the four research wings. They will be fitted with pioneering technology - able to withstand everything from violent heat to intense pressure waves and alien pathogens. They will also provide housing for our many researchers.

utopia.84.desc.a.zh:
今天我们庆祝这个伟大的科学枢纽的开启。伴随着它那最尖端的科研设备与革新科技，我们可以毫无阻力地吸引全星系甚至整个宇宙最伟大的头脑，这正是我们希望的。这项功绩将成为一个新启蒙时代的开端。

今天会是我们物种历史中伟大的一天。
utopia.84.desc.a.en:
Today we celebrate the grand opening of the Science Nexus. With its state of the art research facilities and innovative technology we will have no trouble attracting the greatest minds from across the empire, or even the universe, should we so desire. This feat truly marks the beginning of a new era of enlightenment.

It is a big day in the history of our kind.

utopia.84.desc.b.zh: 今天我们庆祝着另一个科学枢纽的完成。如果我们之前的成就还不够的话，这一个科学枢纽的完成定能将我们置于宇宙科学进步的前沿。我们的科学进步让我们能自己定夺我们的未来。
utopia.84.desc.b.en: Today we celebrate the completion of yet another Science Nexus. If our previous accomplishments hadn't already, this will surely earn us a place on the forefront of scientific progress in the universe. Our technological advancements will allow us to shape the future to our liking.

utopia.85.desc.zh: 第一个模组——四个研发辅翼已就位，研究者与工作人员已前往他们的生活分区。下一步也是最后一部我们将延展辅翼，添加四个实验室区间以支持我们最危险的研究。我们已采取进一步的安保来保证工作人员的安全。
utopia.85.desc.en: The first module of the four research wings is now in place and researchers and staff are already moving into the living quarters. The next and final step of construction will extend the wings, adding four sections of laboratories equipped to support our most dangerous research. Extensive security measures are being taken to ensure the staff's safety.

utopia.86.desc.zh: [From.GetName]完成了科学枢纽的建造。现在他们有能力反驳所有对他们有疑惑的人，并让他们处在科学进步的前沿。我们也许要注意他们，完成这样一个建筑未来必然会造福于他们的科技，让他们获得对我们的文明的优势。
utopia.86.desc.en: The [From.GetName] have constructed a Science Nexus, disproving all who doubted and placing them on the forefront for scientific progress. We may want to keep an eye on them, as the completion of such a structure will surely propel their technology into the future, giving them an advantage over other civilizations.

vapor_plumes_desc.zh:
在[from.GetName]的地表上观测到有成千上万的异常蒸汽羽状物升起，延伸到其稀薄大气的顶层。

建议对该现象进行深入调查。
vapor_plumes_desc.en:
Thousands of anomalous vapor plumes have been observed rising from the surface of [from.GetName], extending to the upper limits of its thin atmosphere.

Further investigation of this phenomenon is advised.

voidborn_hire.zh:
你将在接下来的5年中雇佣这支佣兵舰队。该舰队包括：

6艘巡洋舰
8艘炮艇
16艘掠袭艇
voidborn_hire.en:
You hire this mercenary fleet for a period of 5 years. It consists of:

6 Cruisers
8 Frigates
16 Raiders

vultaum_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
vultaum_asteroid_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

vultaum_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
vultaum_gasgiant_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

vultaum_habitable_category_desc.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
vultaum_habitable_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

vultaum_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
vultaum_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

vultaum_vr_video_game.zh: 沃陶姆虚拟现实视频游戏

war_in_heaven.11.desc.zh: 先祖帝国间的战争以一方被击败而结束，但这并不是他们的宿敌所为。也许是大战消耗了他们的实力，亦或是单纯因为年轻种族们的实力，古老的帝国最终毁灭于他们眼中的弱小种族，这完全改变了局势。现在的问题是，[RemainingAwakened.GetName]能否避免踏上他们宿敌的后尘？还是说这标志着星系迎来了新的纪元？
war_in_heaven.11.desc.en: The war between the ancients has ended with the destruction of one of the combatants - but not at the hands of their old rival. Whether it was due to the war weakening them or simply due to the strength of the younger races, the destruction of an elder empire at the hands of their supposed lessers has changed the situation considerably. Now the question remains - will the [RemainingAwakened.GetName] be able to avoid the fate of their ancient foe, or does this defeat signal the dawn of a new age in the galaxy?

war_in_heaven.13.b.en: No, it is simply too dangerous.

war_in_heaven.13.desc.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的兵燹之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。我们已经收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个不结盟组织，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。由于我们的军事实力与影响力，他们决定邀请我们成为这支联盟势力的盟主。我们一旦接受，就几乎确定会同时跟两大觉醒的帝国开战，但至少我们还有盟友支援，不用独自面对两大先祖帝国的威胁。
war_in_heaven.13.desc.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a League of Non-Aligned Powers with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Due to our military might and influence, we have been asked to lead this league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

war_in_heaven.13.desc2.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁了。我们收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个不结盟组织，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。鉴于我们已是一个强大联邦，[Root.GetAllianceName]的领袖中的一员，他们决定请我们扩充自己现有的联盟以组建预想中的组织。接受请求基本意味着同觉醒的帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
war_in_heaven.13.desc2.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a League of Non-Aligned Powers with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. As we are already the leaders of a powerful federation, the [Root.GetAllianceName], we have been asked to expand our alliance to form the proposed league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

war_in_heaven.13.desc3.zh:
在先祖帝国之间的兵燹之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。我们已经收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个不结盟组织，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。

由于我们是现任星海监管人，他们决定邀请我们成为这支联盟势力的盟主。我们一旦接受，就几乎确定会同时跟两大觉醒的帝国开战，但至少我们还有盟友支援，不用独自面对两大先祖帝国的威胁。
war_in_heaven.13.desc3.en:
Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of fighting the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a League of Non-Aligned Powers with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war.

As we are the current Galactic Custodians, we have been asked to lead this league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

war_in_heaven.15.a.en: We will be glad to have them!

war_in_heaven.15.b.en: No, we do not need them.

war_in_heaven.15.desc.en: The [From.GetName] have formally requested to join the League of Non-Aligned Powers.

war_in_heaven.16.a.zh: 你们两个给老子滚出这个星系！
war_in_heaven.16.a.en: Get the hell out of our galaxy, both of you!

war_in_heaven.16.desc.zh: 很快，先祖帝国就意识到了不结盟组织的存在。双方都派出了代表前往[Root.Capital.GetName]，要求解散联盟，并要求所有成员在这场战争中选边站队。我们自然是拒绝了，而今早，[FirstSleeper.GetName]与[SecondSleeper.GetName]都发布了与我们开战的公告。
war_in_heaven.16.desc.en: It did not take long for the ancients to take notice of the League of Non-Aligned Powers. Representatives from both warring powers have come to [Root.Capital.GetName] demanding the dissolution of the league, and for its members to choose sides in the war. Naturally, we refused, and as of this morning we are now in a state of war with both the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [SecondSleeper.GetName].

war_in_heaven.18.a.en: This will be the age of the [Root.GetName].

war_in_heaven.18.desc.zh: 在经历漫长而残酷的冲突后，这场因两个先祖帝国间的摩擦而起的战争以它们的双双覆灭告终。曾经拥有强大古代科技且自负高傲的巨人们沦为了历史尘埃，星系迎来了崭新的黎明，新兴物种将书写他们自己的命运。
war_in_heaven.18.desc.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the war that begun as a battle between two ancient empires has ended in the destruction of both. For all their ancient technological might, the arrogance and inflexibility of these ancient giants proved their undoing, and now they are gone, reduced to no more than another set of broken ruins of the past. A new age dawns on the galaxy, and from now on the fate of the younger races will be entirely their own to decide.

war_in_heaven.19.a2.zh: 我们会对那些老骨头的暴政说不！
war_in_heaven.19.a2.en: We shall oppose the tyranny of the elders!

war_in_heaven.19.b.en: No, it is simply too dangerous.

war_in_heaven.19.b2.zh: 我们不能支持这样的行动方针。
war_in_heaven.19.b2.en: We cannot support this course of action.

war_in_heaven.19.desc.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的大战之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。在[From.GetName]的领导下，不结盟组织成立了，其目标是对抗挑起战火的先驱者帝国，加入这个联盟就意味着要和战争双方觉醒的失落帝国同时开战，但至少加入这个联盟的中立者们不用再孤军奋战了。
war_in_heaven.19.desc.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. A League of Non-Aligned Powers has formed under the leadership of the [From.GetName] with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

war_in_heaven.19.desc2.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先驱帝国的威胁了。[From.GetName]，我们联邦的主席，已将我们的共同体重新命名为不结盟组织，挑起了反抗战争双方的大旗。建立这一组织基本意味着同觉醒的帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
war_in_heaven.19.desc2.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName], our federation's President, has renamed our union as the League of Non-Aligned Powers and declared our goal to be opposing both sides in the war. Forming this league will almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

war_in_heaven.19.desc3.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先驱帝国的威胁了。[From.GetName]奋勇当先，宣布其联盟将作为不结盟组织挑起反抗战争双方的大旗，并邀请其他中立国团结在他们的旗帜下。加入这一组织基本意味着同觉醒的失落帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
war_in_heaven.19.desc3.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName] has boldly taken the initiative, declaring their alliance a League of Non-Aligned Powers seeking to oppose both sides in the war, and inviting other neutral nations to rally behind their banner. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

war_in_heaven.2.a.zh: 这对我们来说意味着什么呢？
war_in_heaven.2.a.en: What will this mean for us all?

war_in_heaven.2.desc.zh: [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]再次君临整片星系的消息似乎没有被别的失落帝国无视。[From.GetSpeciesName]对这一消息的不安尤为强烈。这两位先祖文明是亘古的宿敌，尽管由于某些原因他们的仇恨在漫长的历史中稍有褪色，然而[FirstSleeper.GetName]的突然觉醒点燃了古老的仇恨并激起了对抗行动。[From.GetName]已从沉睡中醒来，他们将以整个星系为战场延续远古的对决。
war_in_heaven.2.desc.en: The return of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] to the galactic scene has not gone unnoticed by the other Fallen Empires present in our galaxy. The [From.GetSpeciesName] in particular appeared most agitated at the news. It seems that these two proud nations are ancient rivals, and though the reasons for their rivalry has long since faded into history, the sudden reawakening of the [FirstSleeper.GetName] has enflamed old animosities and triggered a counter-reaction. The [From.GetName] have roused themselves from their slumber to face their old rivals, with the whole galaxy as their battleground.

war_in_heaven.20.desc.zh: [From.GetName]已经批准我们加入不结盟组织，现在我们将和其他中立者一起抵抗这些先祖帝国的威胁。
war_in_heaven.20.desc.en: We have been accepted into the League of Non-Aligned Powers by the [From.GetName], and now we will stand together against the menace of the elder empires.

war_in_heaven.21.desc.zh: [From.GetName]拒绝了我们加入不结盟组织的请求，现在我们只能独自抵抗先祖帝国的威胁了。
war_in_heaven.21.desc.en: Our request to join the League of Non-Aligned Powers was refused by the [From.GetName], and now we will have to stand alone against the menace of the elder empires.

war_in_heaven.22.desc.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的战争中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了其中一方。比如我们就保持了中立，但这意味着我们要独自面对觉醒帝国的威胁。以在战争中抵抗各边势力为目标，不结盟组织在[From.GetName]的领导下成立了。
war_in_heaven.22.desc.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the war should come their way. A League of Non-Aligned Powers has formed under the leadership of the [From.GetName] with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war.

war_in_heaven.22.desc2.zh: 并非所有的年轻物种都选择了先祖帝国的中途中站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自觉醒帝国的威胁了。[From.GetName]奋勇当先，宣布其联盟将作为不结盟组织挑起了反抗战争双方的大旗，并邀请其他中立国团结在他们的旗帜下。
war_in_heaven.22.desc2.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName] has boldly taken the initiative, declaring their alliance a League of Non-Aligned Powers seeking to oppose both sides in the war, and inviting other neutral nations to rally behind their banner.

war_in_heaven.4.c.zh: 在这场斗争中我们不会站在任意一边。
war_in_heaven.4.c.en: We will not take sides in this conflict.

war_in_heaven.4.c.2.zh: 他们都将败在我们手下！
war_in_heaven.4.c.2.en: They will both fall to our might!

war_in_heaven.4.d.zh: 作为附属国，这不是由我们来决定的。
war_in_heaven.4.d.en: As a subject nation, it is not up to us to decide.

war_in_heaven.4.desc.zh:
自从[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]和他们的对手[From.GetSpeciesName]觉醒后，这两个巨人一直在为争夺影响力展开零星的冲突，以试探彼此的实力。这最终导致了冲突的一连串升级，终于，在某个遥远的恒星系中[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了一场公开的舰队战。这次冲突现在演变为[FirstSleeper.GetName]与[From.GetName]之间的全面战争。

每一方都派遣了一名代表去往年轻的种族，承诺厚赏加入他们的人并严惩反对他们的人。选择支持任意一方都意味着放弃我们的主权，但维持中立可能更加危险，除非我们可以找到其他中立国家来与我们合作。
war_in_heaven.4.desc.en:
Ever since the awakening of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] and their ancient [From.GetSpeciesName] rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [From.GetName].

Each side has sent a representative to the younger races, promising great rewards for those who join them in their war and terrible punishments for those who choose to stand against them. Choosing either side in this conflict will mean giving up our independence, but remaining neutral may be even more dangerous unless we can find other neutral empires to stand by our side.

war_in_heaven.5.desc.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
war_in_heaven.5.desc.en:
After a long and fierce conflict, the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName] now stand triumphant as the undisputed dominant power in the galaxy.

For now, an uneasy peace reigns, but how long can this new order last?

war_in_heaven.5.name.en: The End of the War in Heaven

war_in_heaven.6.desc.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，天堂之战以双方僵持不下的局面而告终。[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]与[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]已经签署了停火协议，将舰队撤回了各自边境。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这次休战能持续多久呢？
war_in_heaven.6.desc.en:
After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] and [WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName] have signed a ceasefire and withdrawn their fleets back to their own borders. 

For now, an uneasy peace reigns over the galaxy, but how long can this truce last?

war_in_heaven.7.a.zh: 这将成为帝国的荣光时刻！
war_in_heaven.7.a.en: This shall be the Imperium's finest moment!

war_in_heaven.7.desc.zh:
自从[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]以及他们的宿敌[From.GetSpeciesName]觉醒以来，这两个巨人总会偶尔爆发小规模冲突，或者相互施展诡谋以争夺影响力，希望借此试探对方的实力。这样的行为导致了一系列逐渐升温的对峙，最终演变成在某个遥远的星系一支[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了公开的交火。这一冲突现在已经升级成为[FirstSleeper.GetName]和[From.GetName]之间的全面战争。

双方都勒令星海帝国必须立刻解散，其独立的成员国必须在战争中选择一边。今天的稍早时刻，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院发表了讲话，态度明确地拒绝了这一无理要求。星系目前陷入了一场规模庞大的三方战争，其规模之大，前所未有，闻所未闻。
war_in_heaven.7.desc.en:
Ever since the awakening of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] and their ancient [From.GetSpeciesName] rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [From.GetName].

Both sides are demanding the immediate dissolution of the Galactic Imperium and for its individual members to pick a side in the war. Earlier today, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] addressed the Imperial Senate and categorically rejected their demands. The galaxy now finds itself in a massive three-way war on a scale never before witnessed.

war_in_heaven.7.tooltip.en: The [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [From.GetName] declare war on the Galactic Imperium.

warform_leader_catch_phrase.zh: 返回上一条命令……服务制造者
warform_leader_catch_phrase.en: RETURNING TO PREVIOUS DIRECTIVE... SERVE MAKERS

warform_leader_desc.zh: 一台远古的战斗电脑，在剧毒的坟场中躺了数百年之后，现在可为我们的帝国服务。
warform_leader_desc.en: An ancient combat computer ready to serve our empire after having spent centuries in a toxic graveyard.

wealth_distribute_favor_tier_1_tt.zh: 获得每个帝国的1个外交支持。

wealth_distribute_favor_tier_2_tt.zh: 获得每个帝国的2个外交支持。

whisperers_covenant_tradition_tt.zh: 一旦我们的契约建立，我们的$telepath_type_plural_with_icon$会生产$research_with_icon$。
whisperers_covenant_tradition_tt.en: Once our Covenant is confirmed, our $telepath_type_plural_with_icon$ will produce $research_with_icon$.

wilderness.1010.a.zh: 很快，我们的世界将合而为一。
wilderness.1010.a.en: Soon our worlds shall become one.

wilderness.1010.desc.diff_cold.zh: 我们深知成为[from.GetName]将充满挑战。确实，曾经构成[root.capital_scope.GetClassAdj]行星[root.GetHomeWorldName]的我们的一部分已经在这里逐渐消逝，但存活下来的部分依旧十分坚韧，并开始适应当地环境。这种陌生的环境使得获取维持生命的基本资源变得更加困难——然而，在这片寒冷的土地上，我们观察到生命已经找到了生存之道。
wilderness.1010.desc.diff_cold.en: We knew that becoming [from.GetName] would be challenging. Indeed, some of what made us the [root.capital_scope.GetClassAdj] planet [root.GetHomeWorldName] has already withered away here, but what remains is strong, and has begun to adapt. This unfamiliar environment makes acquiring basic, life-sustaining resources all the more difficult - but clinging to this frigid landscape, we observe that life has already found a way.

wilderness.1010.desc.diff_dry.zh: 这个地方唤起了我们内心深处的原始恐惧：如此炎热干燥，它唤醒了我们关于焦土的本能记忆。但是，如果我们能够适应并在这里繁荣发展……成为[from.GetName]，或许也会在我们自身之中唤醒某种新的东西。在有水分的地方，我们已经找到了储存水分的方法。在缺少阴凉的地方，我们已经找到了提供阴凉的方法。
wilderness.1010.desc.diff_dry.en: This place evokes a primal fear for us: so hot and dry that it awakens instinctive memories of The Scorch. If we can adapt and thrive here, though... Becoming [from.GetName] may awaken something new in ourselves, too. Where moisture exists, we have found ways to store it. Where shade was scarce, we have found ways to provide our own.

wilderness.1010.desc.diff_wet.zh: 我们努力成为[from.GetName]的过程将充满挑战，但我们已经做好了抵御腐朽和洪水的准备。我们中那些更擅长处理水分的部分现在为那些较为脆弱的部分疏导水分。我们已经适应了这个地方的独特水流。
wilderness.1010.desc.diff_wet.en: Our effort to become [from.GetName] will be challenging, but we have braced our self against rot and deluge. Those parts of us more capable of handling water now wick it away for those which are more vulnerable. We have embraced the unique currents of this place.

wilderness.1010.desc.intro.zh: 我们的环境改造孢子完成了任务，第一次将我们的一部分殖民到了外星球上。
wilderness.1010.desc.intro.en: Our terraforming spores have fulfilled their purpose, delivering a part of our self to colonize an alien world for the first time.

wilderness.1010.desc.outro.zh: 我们的上层建筑、营养物质，甚至我们的DNA，已经开始与这里早先存在的生命体适应并融合。[from.GetName]正在苏醒。
wilderness.1010.desc.outro.en: Our superstructures, our nutrients and our very DNA have begun adapting and mingling with the life that existed here before us. [from.GetName] is waking up.

wilderness.1010.desc.same.zh: 成为[from.GetName]的同时又还是[root.GetHomeWorldName]……这种感觉无比亲切：一种舒适的存在形式，尽管在一度陌生的恒星下呈现出如此多的新形式。我们很容易就适应了这里原有的条件。
wilderness.1010.desc.same.en: Becoming [from.GetName] as well as [root.GetHomeWorldName]... It already feels so familiar to us: a comfortable way of being, despite taking on so many new forms under a once-alien sun. We have adapted easily to the pre-existing conditions here.

wilderness.1010.desc.similar_cold.zh: 适应[from.GetClassAdj][from.GetName]是具有一定挑战的，但我们已经发现了可循之径。卷须延伸处，栖息地即成，饥饿之口也就开始了狩猎。
wilderness.1010.desc.similar_cold.en: Adapting our self to suit [from.GetClassAdj] [from.GetName] will have its challenges, but we have already found familiar ways to cope. Tendrils extend, habitats are carved out, and hungry mouths hunt.

wilderness.1010.desc.similar_dry.zh: 作为[root.GetHomeWorldName]这颗行星，我们一直都在干旱的大气层中兴盛发展。所以我们也应该面对成为[from.GetClassAdj][from.GetName]的挑战。我们已经发现了新寻找并储存湿气的方法，学会与这种新的极具挑战的地理环境互相合作，而非互相对抗。
wilderness.1010.desc.similar_dry.en: As the planet [root.GetHomeWorldName], we have always thrived in parched atmosphere. So too shall we rise to the challenge of becoming [from.GetClassAdj] [from.GetName]. Already we have found new ways to seek and conserve moisture, and learned to work with this challenging new geology, rather than against it.

wilderness.1010.desc.similar_wet.zh: 正如我们曾在[root.GetHomeWorldName]的水域中繁荣昌盛一样，我们也将作为[from.GetClassAdj][from.GetName]蓬勃发展。这里的矿物、水流，甚至日照量都让人感到陌生，但我们已经找到了提取所需资源的方法。
wilderness.1010.desc.similar_wet.en: Just as we thrived in and amongst the waters of [root.GetHomeWorldName], so too shall we flourish as [from.GetClassAdj] [from.GetName]. The minerals, the currents, and even the amount of daylight we receive feel strange here, but we have already found ways to extract what we need.

wilderness.2000.desc.barren.zh:
目睹[from.GetName]的荒凉或许令人痛心，但这种状况不会持续太久。迄今为止，星系中的生命似乎一直忽视这颗贫瘠的星球，但现在，我们，[root.GetName]，掌握着改造这一切的工具和知识。

尽管我们已经学到了很多，但恢复[from.GetName]仍然是一项艰巨的任务。凭借我们的意志，以及我们所发现的能够改变气候的工具，生命很快将会在原本一无所有的地方出现。
wilderness.2000.desc.barren.en:
The desolation of [from.GetName] is perhaps painful to witness, but not for much longer. Life in this galaxy has so far seen fit to ignore this barren world, but now we, the [root.GetName], wield the tools and knowledge to amend this.

Despite all we have learned so far, we face a daunting task in the restoration of [from.GetName]. By our will, and with the climate-altering tools we have discovered, life shall soon exist where previously there was none.

wilderness.2000.desc.gaia.zh:
进化的熔炉在我们[root.GetName]身上创造了奇迹。如今，我们有机会为[from.GetPlanetMoon][from.GetName]带来更多。我们掌握着先前的自我难以想象的工具和知识，已经开始将[from.GetName]塑造成一个觉醒的过程注定与众不同的地方。

[from.GetName]的根基终有一日会充满养分，被我们动植物充满活力的生命周期所滋养。山谷、山脊和高原将提供充足的空间用于觅食、狩猎和庇护。生命将在这里繁荣昌盛。
wilderness.2000.desc.gaia.en:
The crucible of evolution has made wonders of us, the [root.GetName]. Now though, we have the opportunity to impart so much more for the [from.GetPlanetMoon] [from.GetName]. Wielding tools and knowledge our earlier self could scarcely conceive of, we have begun shaping [from.GetName] into a place whose awakening is sure to be unlike any other.

The foundations of [from.GetName] shall one day teem with nutrients, refreshed by the vibrant life cycles of our flora and fauna. Valleys, ridges and plateaux will offer bountiful space for foraging, hunting and shelter. Life shall flourish here.

wilderness.2000.desc.tomb_detox.zh: 虽然[from.GetName]上我们所知的生命可能已经消逝，但我们现在已经准备好给予这个世界第二次机会。我们已经开始修复它的大气层、水道和土壤，以便[from.GetName]可以再次以[root.GetName]的形式孕育生命。
wilderness.2000.desc.tomb_detox.en: Though life as we know it on [from.GetName] may have been snuffed out, we are now primed to give the world a second chance. We have begun the work of restoring its atmosphere, watercourses, and soil so that [from.GetName] may once again host life in the form of the [root.GetName].

wilderness.4500.desc.zh: 我们半自主的[owner.GetOperativesLowerPlural]已经确定了几个适合我们独特微生物群落的生存地点。现在他们将对这些栖息地进行一段时间的监测，优先考虑那些能为我们提供最大长期成功机会的地点。
wilderness.4500.desc.en: Our semi-autonomous [owner.GetOperativesLowerPlural] have identified several viable sites for our unique microbiome. They will now monitor these habitats for a time, prioritizing those which offer us the greatest chance of long-term success.

wilderness.4505.desc.zh:
我们已获得一位不知情的[target.GetSpeciesAdj]协助，对方误以为即将参与的是一项尽责的自然保护行动。殊不知，他们正要将我们的"种子炸弹"微生物群投送至[roots_planet.GetPlanetMoon] [roots_planet.GetName]的偏远地带。

尽管这个培养舱培育的共生体可能寿命短暂，永远无法成为我们意识的完整延伸，但我们能感受到它们渴望尽其所能渗透并观测这片异星地貌的迫切。
wilderness.4505.desc.en:
We have secured the aid of an unwitting [target.GetSpeciesAdj] who believes they are about to engage in a dutiful act of nature conservation. Instead they are poised to deliver our 'seed bomb' microbiome to a hinterland site on [roots_planet.GetPlanetMoon] [roots_planet.GetName].

Although the symbionts bred within this package may be short-lived, and shall never amount to a full extension of our self, we feel their eagerness to infiltrate and observe this alien landscape as much as they are able.

wilderness.4510.a.zh: 我们的根基应当扎得更深，存续更久。
wilderness.4510.a.en: Our roots should delve deeper, last longer.

wilderness.4510.b.zh: 让我们的根须在此肆意生长。
wilderness.4510.b.en: Let our roots run rampant here.

wilderness.4510.desc.zh:
从我们的微生物群被送达至新的[GetRootsBlockerName]处所的那一刻起，我们就开始吸入其禁忌的空气，并感知名为[roots_planet.GetName]的世界。

只要这些共生体与我们更广泛的自我保持根本上的脱节，我们在此的存在将是脆弱的。然而，当时机到来，我们将在[target.GetAdj]空间恢复行动时，它们将很好地为我们服务。
wilderness.4510.desc.en:
From the moment our microbiome was delivered to its new [GetRootsBlockerName] home we began to take in its forbidden air, and to perceive the world known as [roots_planet.GetName].

Our presence here shall be tenuous, so long as these symbionts remain fundamentally disconnected from our wider self. However, they will serve us well when the time comes to resume operations in [target.GetAdj] space.

wm_home_system_poi_desc.zh: 回收的坐标指向同一个恒星系内的三座发掘基址，每一处都曾经对因内特贸易网络至关重要。派遣科研船进行发掘。
wm_home_system_poi_desc.en: The recovered coordinates lead to three dig sites within a single system, each once vital to the Inetian Trader network. Send science ships to excavate them.

wm_last_shelter_poi_desc.zh: 信号的踪迹断在了一座因内特贸易体不惜一切代价想保护的废弃空间站上。派遣一艘科研船去发掘遗址有望揭示个中缘由。
wm_last_shelter_poi_desc.en: The signal's trail ends at an abandoned station the Inetian Traders went to ruinous lengths to protect. A science ship sent to excavate the site may reveal why.

wm_storm_formation_poi_desc.zh: 我们对扰动的分析结果指向了一颗遥远的星球。派遣一艘科研船去发掘遗址有望最终揭示因内特贸易体瞄准的目标。
wm_storm_formation_poi_desc.en: Our analysis traced the disturbance to a distant world. A science ship sent to excavate the site may finally reveal what the Inetian Traders were targeting.

wrecked_fleet_poi_desc.zh: 我们已经计算出漂移战场在当前星系的大致位置。有机会的话，最好能去调查一下现场。
wrecked_fleet_poi_desc.en: We have calculated the drifting battlefield's current position to be somewhere in the indicated system. It would be prudent to investigate the site, given the opportunity.

writing_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 该星球的地表上有着巨大的裂痕，从其图案判断，不可能是自然形成的。从轨道上看，这些裂痕看起来像是文字。
writing_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.

xenophile1.zh: 一位经验丰富的海盗，还有[Root.GetHisHer]从星系各个角落招募来的千奇百怪的船员。
xenophile1.en: A seasoned corsair and [Root.GetHisHer] diverse crew, recruited from every corner of the galaxy.

xenophile1_catch_phrase.zh: “准备好去那些星系暴政那儿劫富济贫了吗？我的船员已经按奈不住掠袭的心了！”
xenophile1_catch_phrase.en: "Ready to steal from the tyrants and share the spoils, eh? My crew's itching for some raiding!"

xenophile2.zh: 一位游历过很多地方的探险家，对许多外国文化有深刻的了解。对贸易和利润的兴趣不亚于科学发现。
xenophile2.en: A well-traveled explorer with a deep knowledge of many foreign cultures; as interested in trade and profit as scientific discoveries.

xenophile2_catch_phrase.zh: “外星生命简直是最棒的研究目标。能说话的那些就更棒了！”
xenophile2_catch_phrase.en: "Alien lifeforms make for some fascinating study. Especially those capable of communication!"

xenophiliacs_tt.zh: 限制这一情况一定会激起[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]人的反应。
xenophiliacs_tt.en: Restricting this event is sure to precipitate a response from the people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

xenophobe1.zh: 一位偏执而孤独的实业家。[Root.GetHeSheCap]将[Root.GetHisHer]大部分时间都花费在[Root.GetHisHer]的工厂和铸造厂寻找效率。
xenophobe1.en: A paranoid and lonely industrialist. [Root.GetHeSheCap] spends most of [Root.GetHisHer] time searching for efficiencies in [Root.GetHisHer] many factories and foundries.

xenophobe1_catch_phrase.zh: “请不要总是阻碍我的工作，否则我们都不会对结果满意的。”
xenophobe1_catch_phrase.en: "Let me work unopposed, and we will both be happier with the outcome."

xenophobe2.zh: 一个已经消亡文明的战术机器人。它痴迷于秩序和结构，试图创造完美的社会。
xenophobe2.en: A tactical robot from a long-extinct civilization. Obsessed with order and structure, it seeks to design the perfect society.

xenophobe2_catch_phrase.zh: “进行全面的社会分析，31234星系日内发布报告。”
xenophobe2_catch_phrase.en: "Engaging full societal analysis. Report imminent, in 31234 galactic days."

xuracorp_deal_in_place.zh: 我们已经有了一笔雪拉协定。
xuracorp_deal_in_place.en: We already have a Xuran Deal.

yuht_asteroid_category_desc.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
yuht_asteroid_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

yuht_gasgiant_category_desc.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
yuht_gasgiant_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

yuht_habitable_category_desc.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
yuht_habitable_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

yuht_uninhabitable_category_desc.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
yuht_uninhabitable_category_desc.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

zevox_digsite_desc.zh:
一艘我们的飞船在探索[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的时候偶然在位于[Root.Planet.GetName][Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName]的卫星上发现了一艘坠毁的小型飞船。

这艘飞船上的标志与符号我们从未见过。些许样本已经被提取并用于进一步研究，但飞船本身过大且不够牢固，无法移动，我们只能就地进行分析研究了。
zevox_digsite_desc.en:
One of our ships analyzing the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system has come across a small crashed ship on the moon of [Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName], [Root.Planet.GetName].

It bears no emblems or sigils we have seen before, and some samples have been brought back to be tested further, but the vessel itself is much too large and unstable to be moved. Additional analysis and testing will have to be done on-site.

zroni_digsite_1_desc.zh: 一个未知文明所建立的古老殖民地。尽管没有任何灾难迹象，但很显然这些定居者们突然之间就放弃了这个居住地。这儿到底发生了什么呢？
zroni_digsite_1_desc.en: An ancient colony from an unknown civilization. Despite no obvious sings of calamity, the settlement was clearly abruptly abandoned by its denizens. What happened here?

zroni_digsite_2_desc.zh: 在被遗弃的泽珞族殖民地中获得的坐标把我们带到了这里。我们需要再次展开探险，调查这颗初看平淡无奇的星球。
zroni_digsite_2_desc.en: The coordinates provided in abandoned Zroni colony directed us here. We will need to deploy another expedition to explore this seemingly ordinary world.

zroni_digsite_3_desc.zh: 我们之前调查的尽是些被遗弃的殖民地，但依据上一个发掘遗址的指引，[From.Planet.GetName]好像有着一座遗弃的神庙。那个地方为什么对这群人而言具有重要的精神意义呢？
zroni_digsite_3_desc.en: Previously we have only explored abandoned colonies, but according to the last dig site, [From.Planet.GetName] houses an abandoned shrine. Why would that place be of spiritual significance to this people?

zroni_digsite_4_desc.zh: 从那座泽珞族神庙中我们发现了一个科研复合体的坐标。在轨扫描无法找到任何记忆水晶的共振信号，我们需要下到地表进行进一步研究。
zroni_digsite_4_desc.en: With the revelations from the Zroni's temple we have obtained the coordinates of a scientific complex. Orbital scans could not detect any resonance from their Memory Crystal, we will need to go down to the surface to learn more.

zroni_digsite_5_desc.zh: 之前探索过的所有泽珞族星球，在考古学的重要性上都比不过[From.Planet.GetName]。这颗[From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon]的一些建筑即使从太空上俯瞰都肉眼可见。[From.GetName]一定曾是泽珞帝国的中央星球。
zroni_digsite_5_desc.en: The archeological significance of all the previously explored Zroni worlds pales in comparison to [From.Planet.GetName]. This [From.Planet.GetPlanetMoon] houses structures visible from space. [From.GetName] must have been a central world of the Zroni empire.

zroni_digsite_6_desc.zh: 泽珞星可以说是一个灵能活动的漩涡。在我们尝试派遣一个离队小组到地表之前，我们需要对过去用来探测记忆水晶的工具进行重新校准。
zroni_digsite_6_desc.en: Zron is a maelstrom of psionic activity. The tools we have used to detect Memory Crystals in the past will need to be recalibrated before we can even attempt sending an away team to the surface.

zroni_insight_space_storm_reduction_modi.zh: 泽珞族洞见风暴保障措施

zulyn_desc.zh: 一位学者，摒弃了传统科学研究的局限，转而追寻$whisperers_in_the_void_article$的狂热回响中所揭示的秘密。
zulyn_desc.en: A scholar who abandoned the limitations of conventional scientific study to chase the secrets revealed by the frenzied echoes of $whisperers_in_the_void_article$.
